atha prathamādhyāye prathamaḥ pādaḥ 
padamañjarī
vṛddhirādaic || 1|1|1||
tripadamidaṃ sūtram--vṛddhiḥ, ād, aij iti | atra cākāraḥ
prayogasthairākārairarthavān | jātyabhiprāyaṃ caikavacanam |
aicchabdastu aikāraukārābhyām | saṃjñinordvitve'pi dvivacanaṃ na
bhavati; dvayorapyekaśabdarūparūṣitatvenaikyamāpannayorivābhidhānāt
| evaṃ sarveṣveva pratyāhāreṣvekavacanaṃ draṣṭayam | samāhāradvandvo
vā--ādaijiti | 
"dvandvāccudaṣahāntāt samāhāre" iti samāsāntastu na bhavati;
samāsāntavidheranityatvāt | anityatvaṃ ca "dvitribhyāṃ pāddanmūrddhasu"
iti mūrddhanśabdasya nirddeśādavasīyate | anyathā "dvitribhyāṃ ṣa
mūrdhnaḥ" iti ṣapratyayāntatvānmūrdheṣviti nirddeśyaṃ syāt |
ādaicchabdātsamāsatvādarthavatvādvā vibhaktyutpatau "coḥ kuḥ "
padasyeti kutvaṃ prāptam, ayasmayāditvena bhatvānna hi bhaviṣyati;
chandovatsūtrāṇi bhavanti | vṛddhiśabdasya trayīśabdānāṃ pravṛttiriti
pakṣe "vṛdhu vṛddhau" ityasmādbhāve ktini vyutpattiḥ,
abhedopacārācca vṛddhiyukteṣvādaikṣu vṛttiḥ | na caivaṃ
lakṣaṇayaivādaikṣu vṛddhiśabdasya vṛttisiddheḥ sūtrasyānarthakyam;
niyamārthatvāt | anyathā varddhanakriyāyogiṣvikārādiṣu pluteṣu ca
varteta | mā tatra vartiṣṭa, ādaikṣveva vartatāmiti niyamaḥ |
catuṣṭayīpakṣe tu katham, yāvataśca saṃjñātvena viniyukte sati
"sici vṛddhiḥ" ityādau pradeśāntara eva vṛddhiśabdasyādaikṣu
pravṛttiryuktā, na tvatraiva saṃjñāviniyuktikāle ? ucyate; "nityaḥ
śabdārthasambandhaḥ" iti darśanena kvacidapi puruṣavyāpārātpraag
vācakaḥ san puruṣavyāpāreṇa vācakaḥ kriyate | ataḥ sarve śabdāḥ
saṃjñārūpeṇa sarvānarthān pratipādayituṃ samarthāḥ | tatrāniyatārthena
vyavahārāsiddherniyamārtha eva puruṣavyāpāraḥ--mayā prayuktasya
vṛddhiśabdasyādaijartha iti | evaṃ tāvatpadārtho vyākhyātaḥ |
vākyaviṣayāḥ punaraṣṭau vikalpāḥ-anarthakam, sādhvanuśāsanam,
prayoganiyamārtham, ādeśārtham, āgamārtham, viśeṣaṇārtham,
tadguṇādhyāropārtham, saṃjñārthamiti | tatrānarthakābhidhānaṃ
pramādāśrayadoṣādanavadhānādaśaktervā bhavati | na caitaccatuṣṭayaṃ
bhagavataḥ sambhavati; ācāryo hi darbhapavitrapāṇiḥ śucāvavakāśe
prāṅmukha āsīno maṅgalapūrvakaṃ mahatā praṇidhānena sūtrāṇi
praṇītavān | tatrāśakyaṃ varṇenāpyanarthakena bhavitum, kiṃ
punariyatā sūtreṇa ! sādhvanuśāsanamapi na bhavati,
siddhatvādvṛddhiśabdasya ktinnantatvāt, ādaicchabdasya cārthavatvāt | nanu
chandovadbhāvena sūtra eva prayogaḥ siddhyati, sūtrādvahirapi
kutvābhāvārthaṃ nipātanametat syāt, ucyate;
vṛddhiśabdasyaivamananvayaprasaṅgaḥ, saṃbhūyakāritvaṃ ca padānāṃ
vyutpattisiddham, ato nāyaṃ pakṣaḥ | nāpi prayoganiyamārtham, yatra
hi sahaprayogaprasaṅgastatra niyamaḥ kartavyaḥ | na ca
vṛddhyādaicchabdayoḥ sahaprayogaprasaṅgaḥ,
viniyogātprāgasambandhād utarakālaṃ vṛddhiśabdenaiva gatatvāt | kiṃ
ca neha prayoganiyama ārabhyate | nanvārabhyate,"paraśca" iti ? padasya
nārabhyate | padasyāpyārabhyate "upasarjanaṃ pūrvam " iti ?
yayoraikapadyaṃ nāsti tayornārabhyate | tayorapyārabhyate "te
prāgdhātoḥ" "kṛñcānuprayujyate liṭi" iti ?
naivaṃvidhenoccāraṇenārabhyate | evamapyārabhyate
"vidāṅkurvantvityanyatarasyām" iti ? nātra kevalaḥ prayoga eva
niyamyate, kintu āmādikamapi vidhīyate, ataḥ kevalasya
prayoganiyamasya sākṣāduccāraṇena kvacidapyabhāvānnāyaṃ
prayoganiyamaḥ | ādeśārthamapi na bhavati;
sthānyarthābhidhānasamarthasyaiva hyādeśatvam | na ca vṛddhiśabda ādaicām,
te vā tasyārthamabhidhātuṃ samarthāḥ | nirdeśācca; yadayaṃ "sici
vṛddhiḥ" "yātivātidrāti" "rāyaḥ"ṅāvaḥ" ityāha, tato jñāyate--na
vṛddhiśabda ādaicāṃ te vā tasyādeśāḥ iti | athādaicśabdasya
vṛddhiśabda ādeśaḥ kasmānna bhavati, na hyatra kiṃ cilliṅgamasti ?
satyam; ayaṃ tu pakṣo na saṃbhavatyeva, aicchabdo hyādirantyeneti
saṃjñātvena viniyuktaḥ kathamasya svarūpasya grahaṇam; aśabdasaṃjñeti
niṣedhāt | etaireva liṅgairāgamārthatvaṃ na bhavati | ṣaṣṭha|lbhāvācca,
"pūrvau tu tābhyām" iti pañcamyāḥ ṣaṣṭha|lrtho'vagamyate |
ṭitvādiliṅgābhāvācca, na hi tadrahitaḥ kaścidāgamo dṛṣṭaḥ |
viśeṣaṇatvamapi na bhavati, asaṃbhavādaprayojanatvācca | na hyasti
saṃbhavo vṛddhaśibdaścāsāvādaicchabdaśceti, nāpi varddhanakriyā''daij
iti | evaṃ viśeṣaṇe ca prayojanamapi nāsti | etena
tadguṇādhyāropo'pi nirastaḥ | yathā hi siṃho māṇavaka iti
siṃhaguṇā māṇavake āropyante, naivamatra sambhavaḥ prayojanaṃ vā'sti;
ataḥ pāriśeṣyātsaṃjñāsaṃjñisambandha evetyālocyāha-'vṛddhiśabda'
ityādi | viparyayastu na bhavati--vṛddhiśabdaḥ saṃjñī, ādaicaḥ saṃjñeti |
sa hi tridhā syāt--ādaijityayaṃ śabdaḥ, ā ai au ityayaṃ samudāyaḥ,
te vā pratyekamiti | tatrādaicchabdastāvanna sambhavati; aijityasya
saṃjñāśabdatvāt, svarūpagrahaṇāsambhavāt, gauravād, anāvṛteśca |
āvartinyo hi saṃjñā bhavanti, vṛddhiḥ śabdaścāvartate; nādaicchabdaḥ |
nāpi samudāyaḥ, gauravādanāvṛteśca | astu tarhi pratyekam,
lāghavādāvṛteśca--"aṣṭana ā vibhaktau", "pūtakratorai ca" "manorau
vā " iti ? na; prayojanamantareṇaikasyānekasaṃjñākaraṇasyāyuktatvāt,
na hyayaṃ vṛddhiśabdaḥ sahasreṇa nāmabhiḥ stotavyaḥ | śabdenārthasya
saṃjñātvaṃ mā vijñāyīti śabdagrahaṇam, etaccārthe
vyavahārāsambhavāllabhyate | tadiha vṛddhiśabdaḥ saṃjñātvena vidhīyata
iti samudāyenānarthakādipakṣanirāsaḥ | vṛddhiśabda ityanena
viparyayanirāsaḥ | vṛddhiśabdaḥ saṃjñā, na punarādaicchabda iti
vacanavyaktyā śabdagrahaṇenārthanirāsaḥ-vṛddhiśabdaḥ saṃjñā na punarartha
iti | yatra samudāyasya kāryamicchati karoti tatra prayatnam--"ubhe
abhyastam" iti | tatra hyubhe grahaṇaṃ samuditapratipatyartham | anvarthāṃ vā
mahatīṃ saṃjñāṃ karoti-"halo'nantarāḥ saṃyogaḥ" iti | iha tu
mahāsaṃjñākaraṇaṃ maṅgalārtham | ata eva prathamamuccāraṇam; anyathā hi
sataḥ kāryiṇaḥ kāryeṇa bhavitavyamiti "adeṅ guṇaḥ"
ityādivannirdiśyeta | ato yatnābhāvātpratyekameva saṃjñā |
kiñca--laukikaprayoge vyavasthitānāmādaicāṃ saṃjñayā bhavitavyam |
na ca samudāyasya kvacitprayogaḥ, ato'saṃbhavādapi pratyekameva saṃjñā
| liṅgācca-kiṃ liṅgam ? "prasthe vṛddhamakarkyādīnām"
"mālādīnāṃ ca" iti | idaṃ hi "mālāprasthaḥ" ityādāvavṛddhamiti
paryudāse prāpte vacanam,ataḥ pratyekameva saṃjñā tadāha-pratyekamiti
||
tatrāpi trayaḥ prakārāḥ-lugādisaṃjñāvatadbhāvitānāmeva,
ṭisaṃjñāvadvā'tadbhāvitānāmeva, anunāsikādisaṃjñāvadubhayeṣāṃ
veti | tatra yadi tadbhāvitānāmeva--ye vṛddhisaṃjñayā bhāvyante,
teṣāmeva syāt, śālīyo mālīya iti chāe na syāt; āmramayaṃ
raikulamayam--vṛddhalakṣaṇo mayaṇ na syāt; āmraguptāyaniḥ--"udīcāṃ
vṛddhāt" iti phiñ na syāt | athātadbhāvitānāmeva--gārgīyaḥ,
aitikāyanīyaḥ, aupagavīyaḥ-chāe na syāt ; ato
doṣadarśanādagṛhyamāṇaviśeṣatvāccobhayeṣāṃ
saṃjñetyāha-'sāmānyene'ti | ākāro'naṇtvādeva na bhinnakālānāṃ
grāhaka iti na tannivṝtyarthaṃ taparatvam, nāpi guṇāntarayuktānāṃ
grahaṇārtham | abhedakatvācca guṇānām, loke hi muṇḍenāpi caurye
kṛte saṃjātakeśo'pi pratyabhijñāya nigṛhyate | tathā "aḍudātaḥ"
ityudātavacanaṃ liṅgam, anyathā hyudātaguṇamevāṭamuccārayet |
ato'narthakaṃ taparakaraṇamityata āha--'taparakaraṇami'ti | taścāsau
paraśca taparaḥ, tasya karaṇamuccāraṇam, ākārātparasya
takārasyoccāraṇamityarthaḥ | atha vā-taḥ paro yasmāditi
tadguṇasaṃvijñāno bahuvrīhiḥ,
takārasahitasyākārasyoccāraṇamityarthaḥ | 'aijarthami'ti | aicorarthaḥ
prayojanaṃ yasya tatathoktam | "taparastatkālasya" ityatra taḥ paro
yasmāditi bahuvrīhirāśritaḥ | tatkathaṃ
taparakaraṇamaijarthamityāśaṅkya pañcamīsamāso'pi tatrāśrita iti
darśayati-'tādapi para' iti | itikaraṇo hetau | yasmāt tādapi
parastasmādaijartha iti | aijarthatvameva
prakaṭayati--'khaṭvailakādiṣvi'ti | asati taparakaraṇe
trimātracaturmātrayorapyaicoḥ savarṇagrahaṇena grahaṇād vṛddhisaṃjñā
syāt, tataśca vṛkṣailakaḥ, vṛkṣaudanaḥ, khaṭvailakā, khaṭvaudana iti
trimātracaturmātrasthāninostrimātracaturmātrāvevaikāraukārau
syātāmiti tannivṛtyarthaṃ taparakaraṇam | āśvalāyana ityādīni
tadbhāvitānāmākārādīnāṃ krameṇa rūpodāharaṇāni |
aśvaletikaśabdau naḍādī | upamanyuśabdo bidādiḥ | lakṣaṇasya
bahuviṣayatvasūcanārthaṃ caturthasyodāharaṇasyopanyāsaḥ |
ākārasyātadbhāvitasya kāryodāharaṇamāha--'śālīyaḥ, mālīya' iti |
aikāraukārayostvatadbhāvitayorudāharaṇaṃ raikulamayaṃ
naukulamayamiti, vṛddhalakṣaṇo mayaḍ bhavati ||
adeṅ guṇaḥ || 1|1|2 ||
pūrveṇa tulyametat | 'taparakaraṇaṃ tviha sarvārthami'ti | na tu
pūrvavadanyatarārthamiti tu śabdasyārthaḥ | asati hi tasmin
dīrghaplutayorapi guṇasaṃjñā syāt; tataśca taratīti kadācidakāraḥ
syāt, kadācidākāraḥ, raparatve kṛta
ekasyādhyardhamātratvādaparasyārdhatṛtīyamātratvāt | na cākārasya
vṛddhisaṃjñā bādhikā; ekasaṃjñādhikārādanyatra saṃjñāsamāveśāt | eṅaśca
trimātracaturmātrasya guṇasaṃjñāyām-ratheṣā,khaṭveṣā, aśvoḍhaḥ,
vaḍavoḍha iti trimātraturmātrau syātām | taritetyādīni
tadbhāvitānāmadeṅaṃ krameṇa rūpodāharaṇāni | pacanti
jayantītyakārasya kāryodāharaṇe | atrāntyakāre parataḥ śabakārasya
"ato guṇe" iti pararūpaṃ bhavati |
ekārasyātadbhāvitasyodāharaṇam-'ahaṃ pace 'iti | okārasya tu na
saṃbhavati ||
iko guṇavṛddhī || 1|1|3 ||
'paribhāṣeyami'ti | nādhikāraḥ; asvaritatvāt, asaṃyujyanirdeśācca
| adhikāre hi "iko guṇavṛddhī na dhātulopaḥ" iti saṃyujyaiva
nirdiśet | nāpi vidhiḥ, "ikaḥ sthāne guṇavṛddhī bhavataḥ" iti
lakṣaṇāntareṇa vidhāsyāmānatvāt | nanu yadāyaṃ svatantro vidhistadā
teṣvika ityasyopasthāpakābhāvād yātetyādāvaniko'pi vidhiḥ
syāt, iha tu sārvadhātukādyabhāve'pi dadhi madhvityādau vidhirastu ?
evaṃ tarhi guṇavṛddhyadhikāre punarguṇavṛddhigrahaṇānna vidhiḥ | yadyapi
prakṛtaṃ guṇavṛddhigrahaṇaṃ saṃjñāparam, iha
tvanuvṛttisāmarthyātsaṃjñiparaṃ bhaviṣyati | "adeṅ guṇaḥ" ityatra
cānuvartamānamapi vṛddhigrahaṇaṃ na saṃbadhyate,
anyavacanāccakārākaraṇācca | anyā hi tatra guṇasaṃjñocyate, cakāraśca
na kriyate; ato vidhipakṣe punarguṇavṛddhigrahaṇaṃ na kartavyam | ata
evādhikāro'pi na bhavati | paribhāṣāyāṃ tu tasyāṃ
viśiṣṭaviṣayatvasiddhaye kartavyaṃ taditi vakṣyāmaḥ | ataḥ
paribhāṣeyam |
yogo vāyaṃ vyapadiśyeta, sūtraṃ vā, tatkatham "iyam" iti
strīliṅganirddeśaḥ ? ucyate-yathāyaṃ yogaḥ, yathā vā sūtramidam,
evaṃ paribhāṣāpi, tatsāmānādhikaraṇyādiyamiti nirdeśaḥ | nanu
paribhāṣātvaṃ vidhitsitam, idaṃśabdastu uddeśakaḥ, siddharūpasya
coddeśaḥ, sūtrarūpatā yogarūpatā vā siddheti punarapyuddeśakasya
strīliṅgānupapatiḥ | kaścidatra paribhāṣeyamityanūdya
sthāniniyamārthatā vidhīyate-"yeyaṃ paribhāṣā sā
sthāniniyamārtheti, na tu paribhāṣārūpatā vidhīyate" ityāha, sa
vācyaḥ-"asiddhaṃ paribhāṣātvaṃ kathamanūdyate" iti | avyāpakaścāyaṃ
parihāraḥ śamarthaḥ padavidhiḥ" ityādau | tatra
paribhāṣeyamityetāvacchrūyate, na punaretadartheti | vayaṃ tu
brūmaḥ-nirdiśyamānapratinirdiśyamānayoraikyamāpādayanti sarvanāmāni
paryāyeṇa talliṅgabhāñji bhavanti | tatra yathā "aṇau yatkarma ṇau
cetsa kartā" iti karmākāraparāmarśino'pi tacchabdasya vidhīyamānasya
kartrākārasya liṅgaṃ bhavati, tadvadihāpi sūtramevoddiśyata
idaṃśabdasya vidhīyamānaparibhāṣākārasya liṅgaṃ bhaviṣyati |
'sthāniniyamārthe'ti | igākhye sthānini guṇavṛddhyorniyamo'rthaḥ u
prayojanaṃ yasyāḥ sā tathoktā | "dvandve ghi" ita vṛiddhiśabdasya
pūrvanipātaḥ prāptaḥ sūtranirdeśena nityaṃ bādhyate;"dharmādiṣu
ubhayam" iti vacanāditi sūcayannāha-'vṛddhiguṇā'vityādi |
kiṃ punaranena granthenocyate ? nanu niyamarūpeṇāsya sūtrasya
pravṛttiriti; yathā "eca igghrasvādeśe" hrasva ādiśyamāna eca igeveti |
yadyevam, aniyamaprasaṅge niyama iti
"sārvadhātukārdhadhātukayoḥ","sici vṛddhiḥ" ityatraiva syāt, atra
hyasatyasminyoge'lo'ntyasya bhavantau
vṛddhiguṇāvanantyasyāviśeṣitatvādikaścānikaśva prāpnutaḥ, na tu
midimṛjipugantaladhūpadharcchidṛśikṣiprakṣudreṣvapi|
atrālontyasyetyanika eva prasaṅgaḥ | atha sarvavākyānāṃ
sāvadhāraṇatvāt prāptamevāvadhāraṇamika evetyeva śabdenābhidhīyate,
na punarniyamo'nena pradarśyate; yathā-"tapastapaḥ karmakasyaiva" iti |
ato vidhirūpeṇaivāsya vyāpāro vivakṣitaḥ, paribhāṣātvācca
guṇavṛddhividheḥ saṃskārakaṃ vidhyantaramidam, yathā "idgoṇyāḥ"
ityādeḥ"alo'ntyasya" ityayamiti pakṣaḥ | tato
nāprāptāyāmalo'ntyaparibhāṣāyāmiyamārabhyamāṇā tasyā bādhikā
syāt | tataśca yatraiṣā, na tatra sā pravarteteti jusi guṇo yatheha
bhavati--abibhayuḥ abibharuriti, evamanenijuḥ paryaveviṣuratrāpi
prāpnoti | "sārvadhātukārdhadhātukayoḥ" yatheha bhavati cetā
stoteti; evamīhitā, ūhitā, umbhitā atrāpi prāpnoti |
atha tu sāmānyaviśeṣayorasambhave bādhyabādhakabhāvaḥ; asti cātra
sambhavo yad alo'ntyasya guṇavṛddhī syātām ikaśca, tataḥ "jusi ca"
ityādau guṇavṛddhiliṅgādikparibhāṣāpyupatiṣṭhata, aṅgasyeti
sthānaṣaṣṭhīnirdeśāt, "alo'ntyasya" ityeṣāpi | tatra ca na
samuccayo'ṅgāntyasyāniko'pi guṇo bhavati, tadavayavasya
ceko'nantyasyāpīti | nāpi

tyajyeta, ucyete ca vṛddhiguṇau "mṛjervṛddhiḥ" "miderguṇaḥ" iti,
tau sarvādeśau syātām | ato vidhirūpeṇa niyamarūpeṇa vāsya
sūtrasya vyāpāro nābhyupagantavyaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? anena kriyate
padopasthāpanam; yatra brūyād guṇo bhavatīti, vṛddhirbhavatīti;
tatreka ityetat ṣaṣṭha|lntaṃ padamupatiṣṭhatāmiti | "alo'ntyasya"
ityasya tu vākyabhāvaḥ | evaṃ hi vijñāyamāne "sici vṛddhiḥ" ityādau
yatrāntya ik saṃbhavati, tatreka ityetenopasthitenāṅge viśeṣite
tadantavidhau satīgantāṅgasya guṇa iti vākyavyāpāre pariniṣṭhate
paścādalo'ntyasyetyetadigantasya prāptaṃ guṇaṃ
tato'pakṛṣyāṅgāntyasya vidhate, na tvika
ityasyopasthānavelāyāmupatiṣṭhate | "miderguṇaḥ" ityādau tu
yatrāntya iṅ na saṃbhavati tatrāṅgeneki viśeṣite'ṅgasyeko
guṇa iti vākyavyāpāre parisamāpte sthānaṣaṣṭha|lbhāvātsvayaṃ na
pravartate, na tvika ityanena sahopatiṣṭhate,
yenāviśeṣādubhayornivṛttiḥ syāditi siddhamiṣṭam |
vṛttikāreṇa tvasya sūtrasya prayojanaṃ piṇḍīkṛtya
pradarśitam-sarvathāntyasya vā'nantyasya veka eva guṇavṛddhī bhavataḥ, na
tvakṣaravyāpāraḥ | ata eva 'veditavyau' ityāha | akṣaravyāpārapradarśane
tu ika eva sthāne bhavata ityetāvadvaktavyaṃ syāt | 'svasaṃjñayā
śiṣyamāṇā'viti | vṛddhirbhavati guṇo bhavatītyevaṃ
vidhīyamānāvityarthaḥ |
'ika iti kimi'ti | pradhānāvayavākṣepeṇa samudāyasyaivākṣepaḥ-sūtraṃ
kimarthamityarthaḥ | 'ātsandhyakṣare'tyādi | nanu "gāpoṣṭak" iti ṭakaḥ
kitkaraṇaṃ sāmaga ityādāvāllope ca siddhaṃ syāt sāmaga iti | tathā
glāyatītyādau sandhyakṣarāṇāmapyupadeśasāmarthyād guṇo na
bhaviṣyati, itarathā prakriyālāghavārthamekāramevopadiśet |
"janerḍaḥ" iti ḍitkaraṇādvyañjanānāmapi guṇo na bhaviṣyati |
yadi hi tasya syād, arddhamātrasya mātrike'kāre guṇe kṛte siddhaṃ
syādupasaraja iti | yadyevam,miderguṇo'ntyādvyāvartitaḥ
sarvādeśaḥ syāt | kiṃ ca gamerapyayaṃ ḍo bhavati, tasya ca sthānata
āntaryādokāro guṇaḥ syāt;
rainauglauśabdebhyaścācārākvibantebhyastṛjādau guṇaprasaṅgo
yadyabhidhānamasti; tathā citaḥ, cinutaḥ,bhinnaḥ, bebhidyate ityādau
"kṅiti ca" iti pratiṣedhārthamapi guṇasyeglakṣaṇatvameṣitavyam |
atha vṛddhigrahaṇaṃ kimartham ? "mṛjervṛddhiḥ" iko yathā syāt,
alo'ntyasya mā bhūt | yogavibhāgātsiddham--"mṛjervṛddhiracaḥ",
mṛjeraco vṛddhirbhavati, aṅgākṣiptena pratyayenāco viśeṣaṇāt
ṅyamārṭ" aṭo na bhaviṣyati, sici vṛddhistarhyakārasya mā bhūt,
acikīrṣīt | ato lopo bhaviṣyati,
"ṇyallopāviyaṅyaṇguṇavṛddhidīrghebhyaḥ pūrvavipratiṣiddham?" iti
vacanāt, yathā-cikīrṣaka iti | ākārasya nāsti viśeṣaḥ;
sagvidhānādasaṃbhavaśca | ejantamapi na saṃbhavati; ātvavidhānāt |
rainauglośabdānāmācārakvibantānāmaviśeṣaḥ, gośabdasya
kvibantasya "āñta iddhātoḥ" ityataḥ "dhātoḥ" ityanuvṛteḥ dhātureva
yo dhāturiti vijñānāt sici vṛddhyabhāvaḥ | abhaitsīdityādau
"sici vṛddhiḥ" ityanena vyañjanasya nāprāptāyāṃ vṛddhau vidhīyamānā
halantalakṣaṇā vṛddhirbādhikā, ṅeṭi" ityayaṃ ca niṣedho yāvatī
halantasya vṛddhiḥ, sici vṛddhiriti vā, halantasyāca iti vā, sā sarvā
na bhavatīti vijñāyate | tena anardīdityādau antyasya vṛddhirna
bhaviṣyati | tadevam "iko vṛddhiryathā syād adeṅvyañjanānāṃ mā
bhūd" ityevamarthaṃ tāvad vṛddhigrahaṇaṃ na kartavyam | evaṃ tarhi
mṛjyate, mṛṣṭa ityādau "kṅiti ca" iti pratiṣedhārthaṃ
mṛjervṛddheriglakṣaṇatvam | idamapi
yogavibhāgātsiddham--mṛjervṛddhirityasyānantaramajādau kṅiti
veti vaktavyam--parimṛjanti parimārjjanti,parimamṛjatuḥ
parimamārjaturityevamartham | tatra yogavibhāgaḥ-"ajādau kṅiti
mṛjeraco vṛddhirbhavati" | kimarthamidam ? niyamārtham--kṅiti
yadi bhavati ajādāveveti | tena mṛjyate mṛṣṭa ityādau na
bhaviṣyati, tato vā, ajādāvapi vikalpeneti | sici vṛddhestarhi
pratiṣedhārthamiglakṣaṇatvam | "ṇu stutau" "dhū vidhūnane" kuṭādī,
nyanuvīd nyadhuvīd | atrāpyantarbhūtasijmātrāpekṣatvādantaraṅga
uvaṅ siti halantatvāt ṅeṭi" iti niṣedhaḥ | yadi sicyantaraṅgaṃ
bhavati, acaiṣīd ahauṣīd ahauṣīd-guṇaḥ syāt | astu, tasyaiva
vṛddhiḥ kariṣyate ? akārṣīdityādau halantalakṣaṇā vṛddhiḥ,
atārīdityādau halantalakṣaṇāyāḥ ṅeṭi" iti pratiṣedhe "ato
halādeḥ " iti vikalpaṃ bādhitvā "ato larantasya" iti nityā vṛddhiḥ |
alāvīdityādāvuvarṇānteṣu seṭi sicyantaraṅgatvād
guṇāvādeśayoḥ kṛtayorapi "ato larantasya" ityatra vakārasyāpi
luptanirdiṣṭatvānnityā vṛddhiḥ | yadyevam, mā bhavānavīt,
amavīdityatrāpi tarhi vakārapraśleṣānnityā vṛddhiḥ syāt |
sicyantaraṅgaṃ bhavatītyukte "hmyantakṣaṇa" ityatra ṇiśvigrahaṇaṃ na
kartavyam; aunayīt?, aśvayīdityatrāntaraṅgatvād
guṇāvayādeśayoḥ kṛtayoryāntānāṃ netyeva siddhatvāt | tatsthāne
"avimavīṅiveśayiṣyāmaḥ-"ato larantasya" ityatra vakārapraśleṣeṇa
prāptavṛddhiravimavyorneti | tadevamanarthakaṃ vṛddhigrahaṇam ? 
nānarthakam, sicyantaraṅgasya pravṛttimāśritya hi vṛddhigrahaṇaṃ
pratyākhyāyate,yadi ca sicyantaraṅgaṃ syāt cinīprabhṛtibhyo
yaṅgalugantebhyaściriṇotijiriṇotibhyāṃ ca luṅ isici
acecāyīd; anenāyīd, acirāyīd, ajirāyīditi? na syād;
guṇāyādeśayoḥ kṛtayoḥ yāntānāṃ neti pratiṣedhaprasaṅgād |
iglakṣaṇāyāṃ tu sici vṛddhau tayaivāntaraṅgaṃ bādhyate, yadi syād,
na kvāpi sicīgantamaṅgaṃ bhavet, tataścācirāyīdityādi siddham |
yathā ca tayā guṇāyadeśau bādhyete, evaṃ nyanuvīdityuvaṅapi
bādhyeta | ataḥ pratiṣedhārthamapi vṛddheriglakṣaṇatvameṣitavyamiti
sarvamavadātam | evaṃ bahuvaktavyatvād vṛttikāreṇa vṛddhigrahaṇasya
prayojanaṃ na darśitam |
atha kathaṃ svasaṃjñayā śiṣyamāṇāvityeṣa viśeṣo labhyate
ityāha-'guṇavṛddhigrahaṇami'tyādi | iha pūrvasūtrābhyāṃ
guṇavṛddhigrahaṇamanuvartate | tenaivādeṅamādaicāṃ ca grahaṇe siddhe
yatpunarguṇavṛddhigrahaṇaṃ tatsvasaṃjñayā vidhānaniyamārtham; anyathā
prakṛtaṃguṇavṛddhigrahaṇaṃ taṭasthamupalakṣaṇaṃ syād--'vastuto ye
guṇavṛddhī tadvidhau' iti | sa tu vidhirguṇavṛddhiśabdābhyāṃ
prakārāntareṇa vetyeva viśeṣo nāśritaḥ syāt,
punarguṇavṛddhigrahaṇasāmarthyātu śabdavyāpāro'pyāśrīyate--guṇavṛddhī
ye guṇavṛddhī, evaṃ śabdite ye guṇavṛddhī ityanyatarasya
guṇavṛddhigrahaṇasya svarūpapradhānatvaṃ sampadyate | tenāyaṃ viśeṣo
labhyata ityarthaḥ | anyathā "acaśca" ityasya svasaṃjñayā vidhāne niyamasya
"diva ut" ityādiṣvaguṇavṛddhisaṃjñakeṣu; tatsaṃjñeṣu ca yatreṅ na
saṃbhavati "aṣṭana ā vibhaktau" ityādau, tatra caritārthatvāt "diva
aut" ityādiṣu guṇavṛddhisaṃjñakeṣu yatrek saṃbhavati tatrāyaṃ
niyamaḥ syāt | dyauḥ panthāḥ, saḥ,imamiti | sa ityetadanudāharaṇam,
na hyatregasti |
evaṃ prakaṭito'smābhirbhāṣye paricayaḥ paraḥ |
tasya niḥśeṣato manye pratipatāpi durlabhaḥ ||
na dhātulopa ārdhadhātuke || 1|1|4 ||
"durīṇo lopaśca" duḥśabda upapade iṇo dhātorapratyayo bhavati,
dhātośca lopaḥ | duḥkhena īyateuprāpyate dūramityatra yadyapi
kṛtsnasya dhātorlopaḥ saṃbhavati, tathāpyevaṃviṣaye guṇavṛddhyoḥ
prāptyabhāvādekadeśe dhātuśabdo vartata ityāha--dhātvekadeśa iti |
"dhātulopa" iti tatpuruṣe sati ārddhadhātukagrahaṇaṃ lopaviśeṣaṇam,
guṇavṛddhiviśeṣaṇam, ubhayaviṣeṣaṇaṃ vā-iti trayaḥ kalpāḥ | tatra yadi
lopaviśeṣaṇam--ārddhadhātukanimite dhātulope sati yatkiñcid
nimite guṇavṛddhī na bhavata ityarthaḥ syāt | tataśca preddham ityatra
prapūrvādindheḥ ktapratyaye tannimite nalope sati prāpnuvata
ādguṇasyāpi niṣedhaḥ syāt | yadyapīka ityanuvartate, tathāpi
dvayoḥ ṣaṣṭhīnirddiṣṭayoḥ sthāne bhavannanyataravyapadeśaṃ labhata iti
syādeva | na ceha sūtre "ika" ityasya rūpaparatve pramāṇamasti |
utarasūtre tu pramāṇaṃ vakṣyāmaḥ | nanu "pūrvaṃ dhātuḥ sādhanena
yujyate" ityasmin darśane
prathamopanataktapratyayāpekṣatvādupadhālopo'ntaraṅga iti tadapekṣaḥ
pratiṣedho'pyantaraṅgaḥ, "pūrvaṃ dhāturupasargeṇa yujyate" iti tu
darśane prathamopanatopasargāpekṣatvād guṇo'ntaraṅgaḥ, tataśca
"asiddhaṃ bahiraṅgamantaraṅge" iti pratiṣedho na bhaviṣyati ?
naitadasti; ṅājānantarye" iti niṣedhāt | atha
guṇavṛddhiviśeṣaṇamārddhadhātukagrahaṇam, tato'yamarthaḥ
syāt--yatkiñcana nimite dhātulope satyārddhadhātukanimite
guṇavṛddhī na bhavata iti ; tadā preddhamityatra doṣo na,
guṇasyātannimitatvāt; kintu knopayatītyatra "knūyī śabde"
ityasmāṇṇici puki ca yalope pugantalakṣaṇasya guṇasya niṣedhaḥ
syād | ata ubhayaviśeṣaṇam--ārddhadhātukanimite dhātulope
satyārddhadhātukanimite guṇavṛddhī na bhavata iti |
tatra sakṛcch4%atasyobhayaviśeṣaṇatvameva tāvad durlabham ? athāpi
syād, evamapi lopaguṇavṛddhīnāmekārddhadhātukanimitatvaṃ na labhyate
| tataśca vibhajyānvākhyānapakṣe bhedyata ityatra bhiderṇyantātkarmaṇi yaki
bhid a i a ya iti sthite nityatvātpūrvaṃ ṇilope kṛte yakamapekṣya
pravṛte? pratyayalakṣaṇena ṇicamapekṣya prāpnuvato guṇasya niṣedhaḥ
syād, dvayorapyārddhadhātukanimitatvāditi tatpuruṣe sati sarvathā
doṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā''ha--'tasya lopo yasminni'ti | asminpakṣe
dhātorlopo yasminniti anyapadārthabhūtenārddhadhātukena lopo
viśeṣyate, sākṣācca guṇavṛddhī, dhātorlopo yasmin tasminniti |
ekārddhadhātukanimitatvaṃ ca lopaguṇavṛddhīnāṃ labhyata iti na kaścid
doṣaḥ | 'te na bhavata' iti | anena guṇavṛddhyorayaṃ niṣedhaḥ, na
pūrvasūtravyāpārasyeti darśayati | padopasthāpanaṃ hi
pūrvasūtravyāpāraḥ | na caivambhūta ārddhadhātuke tasya prasaṅgaḥ,
"dīdhīvevīṭām" iti cāsambaddhaṃ syādupasthānaniṣedhe | 'loluva'
ityādi | lūpūbhyāṃ yaṅ, dvirvacanam, "guṇo yaṅlukoḥ" guṇe
niṣiddhe uvaṅ | 'marīmṛja 'iti | "rīgṛdupadhasya ca" | lolūyādibhya
ityādinā sūtrārthamudāharaṇeṣu darśayati | nanu ca yaṅkārasyāto
lope kṛte tasyā sthānivatvādeva guṇavṛddhī na bhaviṣyataḥ,
yathā--pāpacaka iti "ata upadhāyāḥ" iti vṛddhiḥ, na hyatrānena niṣedhaḥ
sidhyati, kiṃ kāraṇam ? aniglakṣaṇatvāt | nālopo labhyate,
"yaṅe'ci ca " iti samudāyalukā pratipadavihitena bādhitatvāt |
yogavibhāgātsiddham--ato lopo bhavatyārddhadhātuke, tato "yasya"
ya ityasya samudāyasya yo'kārastasyāpi lopo bhavati |
kimarthamidam ? viśeṣavihitena samudāyalukā'to lopo mā
bādhīti | tena sthānivatvādeva guṇavṛddhī na bhaviṣyataḥ | yathaiva tarhi
guṇavṛddhī na bhavata evaṃ cekṣiyaḥ, cekriyaḥ, loluvaḥ, toṣṭuavaḥ,
suśruva itīyaṇuvaṅavapyacpratyayamapekṣya na syātām | mā bhūtāmaci,
ya eva tvasau sthānyakārastadāśrayau bhaviṣyataḥ | sa hi yakāre lupte
pratyayasaṃjñakaḥ | nanu kṣetriyaḥ toṣṭuava ityatrāntaraṅgānapi vidhīn
bahiraṅgo lug bādhata iti akṛtsārvadhātukayordīrghāt prāgeva
yaṅe luki kṛte sthānivadbhāve satyapi cekṣi a a, toṣṭua a a iti
sthite sthānyakāreṇa saha laghūpadhamaṅgaṃ saṃjātamiti acpratyaye guṇaḥ
syādeva ; na antaraṅgāviyaṇuvaṅai bhaviṣyataḥ, aśiśriyad
adudruvad iti yathā | ataḥ sthānivatvādeva siddham, nārtho'nena ?
ucyate; sarvatra dīrghānteṣu hrasvānteṣu ceyaṇuvaṅeḥ kṛtayoḥ
punarlaghūpadhalakṣaṇo guṇaḥ prāpnoti | na ca punarapi
sthānivadbhāvaḥ, ādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvatvāt | kiñca yadyato lopaḥ
kriyeta, jaṅgama ityatra "gamahan" ityupadhālopaḥ syāt |
athātrānaṅīti pratiṣedhastarhi darīdṛśa ityatra "ṛdṛśoḥ" iti guṇaḥ
syād; dedya ityatra "dīṅe yuḍaci" iti yuṭ syāt; sanīsraṃsaḥ,
danīdhvaṃsa ityatra "aniditām" ityupadhālopaḥ syāt; yāyāvara
ityādiṣvākāralopaḥ syāt | yadā punaryogavibhāgamakṛtvā
viśeṣavihitaḥ samudāyaluk kriyate, tadā halacorādeśasya
sthānivatvābhāvādupadhālopādayo na bhavantītyavaśyaṃ samudāyasya
lugeṣitavyaḥ | evaṃ ca loluva ityādāvapi guṇavṛddhī syātāmiti
sūtramapi kartavyam || 'lūñ lavite'ti | prāgeva dhātusaṃjñāyā
bhavannanubandhalopo dhātulopo na bhavati | 'reḍasī'ti | "ruṣa riṣa
hiṃsāyām" | "anyebhyo'pi dṛśyante" iti vic, verapṛktasya
lopaḥ--na dhātulopo bhavati |
nanvasatyapi dhātugrahaṇe
lupyate'sminnityadhikaraṇasādhanalopaśabdasyāśrayaṇādanaimitike'nubandhapratyayalope na bhaviṣyati | tatra lopaśabdo hi saṃjñāśabdaḥ, kathamasyādhikaraṇasādhanatā labhyate | 'roravītī'ti | "ru śabde" yaṅluki tipi rūpam | nanvasatyapyārdhadhātukagrahaṇe dhātorlopo yasminniti bahuvrīhirvijñāsyate, roravītītyatra ca yaṅluganaimitikaḥ | na hyārddhadhātukagrahaṇaṃ bahuvrīhitve pramāṇam; satyapi tasmiṃstatpuruṣasambhavāt | idaṃ tarhi prayojanam--"turvī thurvī dhurvī hiṃsārthāḥ", murchā mohasamucchrāyayoḥ, tebhyo yaṅlugantebhyastibādau sārvadhātuke parato rāllope totorti momortītyādau charavorlopasya guṇasya caikanimitatvānniṣedhaḥ syādeva | 'ika ityeve'ti | ika ityasyānuvṛttiṃ prati na śaṅkā kāryetyevaśabdasyārthaḥ | ataḥ abhāji, rāga iti "bhañjeśca ciṇi", "ghañi ca bhāvakaraṇayoḥ" ityupadhālopaḥ ||
prakriyātarkagahanapraviṣṭo hṛṣṭamānasaḥ |
haradatahariḥ svairaṃ viharan kena vāryate ||
kṅiti ca || 1|1|5 ||
kṅidgrahaṇaṃ yadi vidhīyamānasya pratiṣedhasya viśeṣaṇaṃ
syād--guṇavṛddhī kṅiti na bhavata iti, tato vidhisaṃsparśāt "
tasminniti nirdiṣṭe pūrvasya" ityasyopasthānāt kṅityanantara eva
pratiṣedhaḥ syāt | yadyapi pratiṣedhasya vidhānadaśāyāṃ paurvāparyaṃ na
saṃbhavati, tathā niṣedhyamānayorguṇavṛddhyorapi; tathāpi sthānina
iko'nantare kṅiti pratiṣedhaḥ syāt | evaṃ hi
vidhānotarakālamapi tāvad guṇavṛddhyabhāvarūpasya pratiṣedhasya
kṅidanantaraḥ sambhavati, "iko yaṇaci" ityādāvapyetāvadeva
paurvāparyaṃ yadvidhānadaśāyāṃ tu sthāninaḥ, utarakālaṃ tu vidheyasya |
yadā tvanūdyamānayorguṇavṛddhyorviśeṣaṇam-kṅiti sati ye
guṇavṛddhī prāpnutaste na bhavata iti,
tadā'nuvādakatvātasminnityādikāyāḥ paribhāṣāyā anupasthānam | na
hi "kṅiti sati ye guṇavṛddhī" ityukte vidhivyāpāreṇa kṅitaḥ
kaścit saṃsparśaḥ | vidhyaṅgabhūtāśca paribhāṣāstatraivopatiṣṭhante
nānuvāde, tasyāpi parārthatvād,dvayośca parārthayoḥ parasparaṃ
sabandhābhāvāt; anyathā "vṛddhiryasyācāmādistadvṛddham"
ityatrekparibhāṣopasthāne śālīya iti vṛddhasaṃjñāyā
abhāvātallakṣaṇaśchāe na syāt | tathā ca "udīcāmātaḥ sthāne" iti
sthānegrahaṇaṃ kṛtam-ātaḥ sthāne yo'kāra ityanuvādakatvāt "ṣaṣṭhī
sthāneyogā" iti sthāneyogo na labhyeteti | ato'smin pakṣe
kṅitīti sati saptamī "yasya ca bhāvena" iti | kiṅitorhi
satālakṣaṇena bhāvena guṇavṛddhyoḥ prāptalakṣaṇo bhāvo lakṣyate,
nimitasya ca satayā nimitinaḥ prāptirlakṣyata iti "kṅiti sati ye
guṇavṛddhī prāpnutaḥ " ityasya "kṅinnimite ye guṇavṛddhī prāpnutaste
na bhavata" ityartho bhavati | bhinnaḥ, mṛṣṭa ityādau copadhāyā api
prāpnuvantyau guṇavṛddhī kṅitaṃ nimitamāśritya prāpnuta
ityetatsarvamālocyāha--nimitasaptamyeṣeti | nimitātsaptamī
nimitasaptamī, pañcamyarthe śeṣatvena vivakṣite paṣṭhīsamāsaḥ |
kṅinnimite iti | etena guṇavṛddhiviśeṣaṇaṃ kṅidgrahaṇamiti
darśayati | nanu ca vidhīyamānatayā prādhānyāt
pratiṣedhasyaivaitadviśeṣaṇaṃ yuktam, naitadasti; yatra hi guṇaḥ
kṛtātmasaṃskāraḥ pradhānopakārāya mahate prabhavati, tatrātmano'pi
saṃskāramanubhūya pradhānena sambadhyate, yathā-pānīyamelādisaṃskṛtaṃ
puruṣeṇa | uktaṃ ca-
"guṇaḥ kṛtātmasaṃskāraḥ pradhānaṃ pratipadyate | 
pradhānasyopakāre hi tathā bhūyasi vartate ||" iti |
iha ca guṇavṛddhyoḥ kṅidgrahaṇena viśeṣitayormahān
pradhānapratiṣedhasyopakāro bhavati; vyavahitasyāpi tatsiddheḥ | 'bhinna'
iti-"radābhyām" iti natvam | 'mṛṣṭa' iti - vraścādinā ṣatvam |
'cinvantī'ti-"sārvadhātukamapit" "huśnuvoḥ sārvadhātuke" |
yadyeṣā nimitasaptamī, śacaṅante doṣaḥ; "dhi dhāraṇe" "ri
gatau"tudādī tābhyāṃ tipi "tudādibhyaḥ śaḥ" "ṇiśridrusrubhyaḥ kartari
caṅ" dhi a ti, ri a ti, śri a t, dru a t, iti sthite
śacaṅntasyāṅgasya tipi laghūpadhalakṣaṇaśca guṇaḥ prāpnoti, śacaṅeḥ
parataḥ pūrvasya sārvadhātukalakṣaṇaśca, tatra śacaṅnimitasyaiva
pratiṣedhaḥ syād, na tiṅnimitasya | pakṣāntare tu
tiṅnimitasyāpi guṇasya śacaṅeḥ parataḥ pratiṣedho labhyate | na
vā bahiraṅgalakṣaṇatvādvahirbhūtatibāśrayo guṇo
bahiraṅgo'ntarbhūtaśacaṅnimitābhyāmiyaṇuvaṅbhyāṃ bādhiṣyate |
"glājisthaśca gsnuḥ" ityatra vakṣyati--"giccāyaṃ pratyayo na kit,
tena stha īkāro na bhavati" iti,"gsnorgitvānna stha īkāraḥ" iti ca |
tataśca bhūṣṇurityatra pratiṣedho na syādityata
āha--'gakāro'pyatre'tyādi | 'cartve bhūtaḥ'-cartvaṃ prāptaḥ | ata
eva gakarapraśleṣāt saṃkhyātānudeśo na bhavati; anyathā kṅitau
dvau, guṇavṛddhī api dve iti saṃkhyātānudeśaḥ prāpnoti-kiti
guṇasya, ṅiti vṛddheriti | jñāpakādvā, yadayaṃ "miderguṇaḥ" iti
śyani ṅiti guṇaṃ śāsti, tajjñāpayatyācāryaḥ-ṅātra saṃkhyātānudeśo
bhavati" iti | yadi tarhi ksnupratyayo gid, bhūṣṇuritīṭ
prāpnoti, naiṣa doṣaḥ; "rśyukaḥ kiti" ityatrāpi
gakāraścartvabhūto nirdiśyate, sautratvācca nirdeśasya
cartvasyāsiddhatvātprāptamapi "haśi ca" ityutvaṃ na bhavati, "kupvoḥ"
iti visarjanīyaśca bhavati | 'kāmayate' iti-"kamerṇiṅ" |
'laigavāyana' iti-liguśabdātṅaḍādibhyaḥ phak" iti phak |
"orguṇaḥ" iti guṇasya pratiṣedhaḥ kathaṃ na bhavati yāvatokāra igeva ?
naitadasti; atra hi cakāraḥ kriyate, sa ityartho vijñāyate, teneka
itīmaṃ śabdamuccārya vidhīyamānayorguṇavṛddhyoḥ pratiṣedhaḥ, na
caivamorguṇaḥ | mṛjerityādi | iha trimuni vyākaraṇam, yathotaraṃ
ca munīnāṃ prāmāṇyamiti darśanasthitistena sūtrakāreṇānuktaṃ
vārtikakāra āha,taduktaṃ ca dūṣayati, evaṃ bhāṣyakāro vārtikakāreṇa
| vyākhyātṛtvamapi dvayoścāstītyetāvat,?
"yasminvidhistadādāvalgrahaṇa" ityanena tadādividhau
siddhe'pyādigrahaṇaṃ mukhye'jādau yathā syād
vyapadeśivadbhāvenājādau mā bhūt | tundaparimṛjaḥ, yūyaṃ
mamṛja, tvayā mamṛje | 'saṃkramo nāme'tyādi | saṃkrāmato'pakrāmato
guṇavṛddhī asmāditi kṛtvā | 'laghūpadhaguṇasyāpyatra pratiṣedha' iti|
atra sūtre laghūpadhaguṇasyāpi pratiṣedhaḥ, na tu
"sārvadhātukārddhadhātukayoḥ" ityetasyaivetyarthaḥ | anena
nimitasaptamyāḥ phalaṃ darśitam | atra ityanena sūtraṃ nirdiśyate | iha
acinoditi ṅito liṅastibādeśaḥ, sthānivadbhāvād ṅiditi
guṇapratiṣedhaḥ prāpnoti, iha "acinavam" iti ṅito liṅe mipi
tasyāpi sthānivadbhāvaparamparayā ṅitvād guṇipratiṣedhaḥ
syādityata āha-'acinavami'tyādi | yadi ṅiti yatkāryaṃ tad iṅito
lakārasyādeśe sthānivadbhāvātsyāt, yāsuṭo canamanarthakaṃ
syād; liṅe ṅitvādevi tadādeśeṣu ṅitkāryasya siddhatvāt ||
dīdhīvevīṭām || 1|1|6||
'dīdhīvevyo'riti | "dīdhīṅ dīptadevanayoḥ" "vevīṅ vetinā
tulye" ityetayoḥ | atha dīṅ kṣaye" "dhīṅ anādare" "veñ
tantusantāne" vī gatyādiṣu"-eteṣāṃ grahaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavati ?
dīṅastāvanna bhavati, "mīnātiminotidīṅaṃ lyapi ca" iti
cakāreṇaijviṣaya ātvavidhānāt | veño'pi na bhavati,
guṇaprāptyabhāvāt, naitadasti; cakārastāvanmīnātiminotyarthaḥ
syāt, dīṅe'pi grahaṇaṃ lyabarthaṃ syāt, veño'pi praveyamityatra
"īdyati" iti ītve kṛte guṇaḥ prāpnoti | evaṃ tarhi caturṇāṃ
grahaṇe'bhiprete, asandehārthaṃ "vīvedhīdīṭām" iti brūyāt |
kiñca-"avayavaprasiddheḥ samudāyaprasiddhirbalīyasī" | 'iṭaśce'ti |
ārdhadhātukasyeḍityāgamasya | nanu dhātusāhacaryāt "iṭa kiṭa gatau"
ityasya dhātorgrahaṇaṃ yuktam, satyam; prasiddhyatiśayādāgamasya
grahaṇam, āgamo hi prasiddhataraḥ | śāstre'lpācaratvena
pūrvanipātābhāvācca dhāturiṭ, dīdhīvevyostu
dhātutvātprakṛtitvād "abhyarhitaṃ ca" iti pūrvanipātaḥ | atha
dīdhīvevyoḥ kimarthaṃ grahaṇaṃ, yāvatā chāndasāvetau cchandasi ca
dṛṣṭānuvidhiḥ, dṛśyate ca guṇaḥ "hotrāya vṛtaḥ kṛpayannadīdhet",
"adhīdhayurdāśarājñaḥ" iti, atastayoranarthakaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ ?
kecidāhuḥ-"ādīdhyanamāvevyanam ityudāharato vṛttikārasya
nānayośchāndasatvamabhipretam, anyathā hi cchandasyeva
kiṃcidudāhāryam" iti, idaṃ tu vārtikaviruddham;
yadāha-"dīdhīvevyośchandoviṣayatvād dṛṣṭānuvidhānācca
cchandasyadīdhedadīdhayuriti ca guṇadarśanādapratiṣedhaḥ" iti | '
ādīdhyanami'ti | lyuṭi "eranekācaḥ" iti yaṇādeśaḥ | 'kaṇite'ti |
"kaṇiraṇī śabdārthau" luṭi tipau ḍādeśastāsi ṭilopaḥ, kaṇit a
ā iti sthite takārantaṃ laghūpadhamaṅgamiti prāptasya guṇasya
pratiṣedhaḥ | nanu ca ṅeḍvaśi kṛti" ityata iḍityanuvartamāne
"ārdhadhātukasyeṭ" iti punariḍgrahaṇam "iḍeva yathā syād,
vikāro mā bhūd" ityevamarthaṃ bhaviṣyati | yadyevam; alāvīt,
pipaṭhiṣateḥ kvipi pipaṭhī rityatra "akaḥ savarṇe dīrghaḥ"
"rvorupadhāyāḥ" iti ca dīrgho na syād | aṅgaprakaraṇe niyamādāṅga
eva vikāro nivartyate, iha ca pipaṭhiṣaterapratyaye napuṃsake jasaḥ
śiḥ, ato lopasya sthānivatvānnumna bhavatīti śāntamahataḥ" iti
dīrdhatvaṃ na bhavatīti pipaṭhiṣi brāhmaṇakulānīti bhavati ||
halo'nantarāḥ saṃyogaḥ || 1|1|7 ||
antaramavakāśāvidhiparidhānāntarddhibhedatādarthye |
cchidrātmīyavinābahiravasaramadhye'ntarātmani ca ||
ityantaraśabdo'nekārthaḥ | iha cchidravācino grahaṇam;
itareṣāmasambhavāt | na vidyate'ntaraṃ yeṣāṃ te'nantarāḥuniścchidrāḥ |
etamevārthaṃ vyaktena śabdāntareṇa
darśayati-'bhinnajātīyairajbhiravyavahitāḥ śliṣṭoccāritā' iti |
evambhūtā hi halo niścchidrā bhavanti bhinnajātīyairiti vacanaṃ tatraiva
vyavadhānaprasiddheḥ | śliṣṭoccāritā iti vacanādavagrahe'pi saṃjñā na
bhavati-apsvityapsu, vidyate hyatrāntaramarddhamātrākālaḥ | 'saṃyoga' iti |
yadyekaikasya halaḥ śilaṣṭoccāritasyaiṣā saṃjñā syād ? iha ca
niryāyādityatra pratyekaṃ saṃjñitve sati rephe yakāraḥ saṃyoga iti
"vānyasya saṃyogādeḥ" ityetvaṃ syāt | samudāyasya saṃjñitve "aco
rahābhyām" iti yakārasya satyapi dvirvacane
tasyāsiddhatvādetvābhāvaḥ, iha ca saṃskṛṣīṣṭa "ṛtaśca saṃyogādeḥ"
itīṭ, saṃskriyata iti "guṇo'rtisaṃyogādyoḥ" iti guṇaḥ,
dṛṣatkarotīti kakārasaṃnidhau dakārasya saṃyogādyoḥ"? iti
lopaḥ syāt, niryāta iti śaṃyogāderātaḥ" niṣṭhānatvaṃ syāt;
samudāye tu saṃjñini naite doṣā ityālocyāha--'samudāyaḥ
saṃjñī'ti |
mahāsaṃjñākaraṇamanvarthasaṃjñāvijñānārtham-śaṃyujyante'sminmitho
halaḥ" iti | nairantaryaṃ ca śrutaṃ saṃjñirūpe'nupraviśatīti yuktam |
pratyekapakṣe tu tadupalakṣaṇaṃ syād | ataḥ samudāya eva saṃjñī yukta
iti bhāvaḥ | "halaḥ" iti bahuvacananirddeśād dvayoḥ saṃjñā na
syādityāśaṅkyāha--'jātau ce'ti | ca śabdo yasmādarthe,
yasmājjātau bahuvacanam, tena dvayorbahūnāṃ ceti |
atha yatra bahavo halaḥ saṃśliṣṭāstatra kiṃ dvayorbahūnāṃ cāviśeṣeṇa
saṃjñā ? āhosvidvahūnāmeva ? yadi bahūnāmeva, iha
"masjinaśorjhali" ityantyādacaḥ pare numi mansj iti sthite
nasajānāmekā saṃjñā, na tu sajayoriti śkoḥ saṃyogādyoḥ"
iti salopo na syāt, naiṣa doṣaḥ; masjerantyāt pūrvaṃ
numeṣitavyaḥ, magna ityupadhālopo yathā syāt; anyathā
dvayossaṃjñāśrayeṇa satyapi saṃyogādilope tasyāsiddhatvānnalopo na
syād | iha tarhi nirgleyāt, saṃsvariṣīṣṭa, saṃsvaryate,
nirglāna iti etveḍguṇaniṣṭhānatvāni na syuḥ ? astu
tarhyaviśeṣeṇa, kutaḥ ? niścchidratvasyāviśeṣāt !na ca
dvirvacananyāyena samudāyasyaiva syāditi vācyam; yathā dvirvacanaṃ
samudāyāvayavaikācoryugapat kartumaśakyam, naivamatrāśaktiḥ,
yathā ca samudāye dvirukte'vayavā api dviruktā bhavanti--vṛkṣaḥ pracalan
sahāvayavaiḥ pracalatīti nyāyena , na ca tatheha samudāye pravṛtayā
saṃjñayā'vayavānāṃ tatkāryasiddhiḥ | ato nāyaṃ dvirvacananyāyasya
viṣayaḥ | ato'viśeṣeṇa dvayorbahūnāṃ ceti sthitam | yadyevam,
indramicchati indrīyati, tataḥ san indidrīyiṣatītyatra dvau
saṃyogau-nadau, darau ca; tatra ṅa ndrāḥ" iti pratiṣedho
nakāravaddakārasyāpi syāt | na vājvidheḥ, ajāderiti vartate, tatra
karmadhārayāt pañcamī, āderacaḥ pare nadarā na dvirucyanta ityarthaḥ |
ūgni?rityādīni rūpodāharaṇāni | 'tilāntstryāvapatī'ti |
"he mapare vā" iti vartamāne "ḍaḥ si dhuṭ" iti ca ṅaśca" iti
dhuṭ cartvam | tatra yadā na dhuṭ, tadā nasatarayāḥ; yadā dhuṭ
tadā natasatarayāḥ | 'titaucchatrami'ti | "tanoterḍauḥ sanvacca" iti
ḍaupratyayaḥ, vyastoccāraṇasāmarthyād guṇābhāvaḥ, sanvadbhāvād
dvirvacanamitvaṃ ca, ṭilopaḥ | 'saṃyogāntalopaḥ syādi'ti |
yadyacorapyanantarayoḥ saṃyogasaṃjñā syāditi bhāvaḥ | nanu ca "che ca"
iti tuki kṛte takāraḥ padānto na saṃyogaḥ, naitadasti, "che ca"
ityayaṃ tug hrasvamātrabhakto na tadantagrahaṇena gṛhyata iti padaṃ
saṃyogāntameva | pacatīti rūpapratyudāharaṇam | panasamiti
kāryapratyudāharaṇam | 'skossaṃyogādyoriti lopaḥ syādi'ti |
yadi sakāramakārayoḥ sāntarayorapi saṃyogasaṃjñā syāditi bhāvaḥ
||
mukhanāsikāvacano'nunāsikaḥ || 1|1|8 ||
yadyatra "mukhaṃ ca nāsikā ca" iti dvandvaḥ syād, "dvandvaśca prāṇitūrya"
ādisūtreṇaikavadbhāvaḥ syāt, tataśca śa napuṃsakam" iti
napuṃsakatve, "hrasvo napuṃsake" iti hrasvatve ca 'mukhanāsikavacanaḥ'
iti prāpnotītyutarapadalopinaṃ tatpuruṣaṃ darśayati-'mukhasahitā
nāsike'ti | 'tayoccāryata' iti | etena "kṛtyalyuṭo bahulam"
iti karmaṇi lyuṭṃa darśayati | "tayā" iti karaṇe kartari vā tṛtīyā;
karaṇasyaiva kartṛtvena vivakṣaṇāt | sūtre'pi "mukhanāsikāvacanaḥ"
iti "kartṛkaraṇe kṛtā bahulam" iti tṛtīyāsamāsaḥ, ṣaṣṭhīsamāso
vā | 'anusvārasyaiva hi syādi'ti | tasminnuccāryamāṇe nāsikāyā
eva vyāpāro na mukhasya, tena tasyaiva syād, na tu ñamaṅaṇanānām,
nāpyabhra āÄ apa ityasya; taduccāraṇe mukhasyāpi
vyāpārādityevakāreṇa darśayati | nanu yathā "prāsādavāsina
ānīyantām" ityukte ye prāsāda eva nivasanti, ye ca prāsāde bhūmau
ca, te dvaye'pyānīyante, prasādavāsānvaya ubhayeṣāmastīti,
tathehāpiṅāsikāvacanaḥ" ityukte yaḥ kevalanāsikāvacanaḥ, yaśca
mukhanāsikāvacanaḥ-ubhayorapi grahaṇaṃ bhaviṣyati; nāsikānvayasya
vivakṣitatvāt | tatkimucyate'nusvārasyaiva hi syāditi,
anusvārasyāpi hi syāditi tu vaktavyam ? ucyate; iha trīṇi
darśanāni-kṛtsna evānunāsiko mukhena nāsikayā coccāryate,
pūrvo bhāgo mukhena paro nāsikayā, viparītaṃ vā |
nāsikyabhāgānurāgāccetaro'pi bhāgastadvadeva bhāsate iti |
tatrotarasmindarśanadvaye nāsikānvayasya
bhāgaviṣayatvānnāsikāvacanagrahaṇenobhayavacano na gṛhyate iti
suṣṭhūaktam--'anusvārasyaiva hi syādi'ti | 'kacaṭatapānāṃ mā
bhūdi'ti | te hi mukhenaivoccāryante ityasati nāsikāgrahaṇe
teṣāmeva syāt, tataśca tarptumiti "anudātopadeśa"
ityanunāsikalopaḥ syāt,"odanapak" iti "anunāsikasya kvijhaloḥ
kṅiti" iti dīrghaḥ syāditi
mahāsaṃjñākaraṇamanvarthasaṃjñāvijñānārtham-"anu paścānmukhasya nāsikā
vyāpriyate yasmin",ṅāsikāyā vā paścānmukhaṃ vyāpriyate yasmin"
iti | tena bhāgaviṣayo nāsikāvyāpāra iti sūcanāt
prāsādavāsinyāyasyāyamaviṣaya ityuktaṃ bhavati |
tulyāsyaprayatnaṃ savarṇam || 1|1|9 ||
tulyaśabdo'yaṃ yadyapi tulayā saṃmitaṃ tulyamiti ṅauvayodharma" iti
yatamutpādya vyutpādyate, tathāpi vyutpatyarthameva tulopādīyate,
rūḍhaśabdastvayaṃ pravīṇaḥ, pratilomādivadityāha-'tulyaśabdaḥ
sadṛśaparyāya' iti | nanu ṅauvayodharma" ityatra vakṣyati--"yathā tulā
dravyāntaraṃ paricchinati, tathā tulyāmapi sādṛśyena
paricchinatītyetatulayā tulyasya sādharmyam" iti, satyam; na hyaevaṃ
laukikāḥ pratiyanti | tathā hi -"tulya" ityukte śadṛśa" iti pratyayo
bhavati, na tu kaścidavayavārthaḥ pratīyate | 'āsye bhavamāsyami'ti |
lokasiddhaṃ tāvadāsyamoṣṭhātprabhṛti prākkākalakād-asyante
kṣipyante'nena varṇā iti kṛtvā | kākalakaṃ nāma grīvāyā unnatapradeśaḥ
| iha tu tasminnāsye bhavamāsyamityarthaḥ | "digādibhyo yat"
"śarīrāvayavācca" iti yatpratyayaḥ | kiṃ
punastadityāha--'tālvādisthānami'ti | yasminvarṇā niṣpadyante tat
sthānam | ādiśbdena nāsikādīnāṃ grahaṇam | nāsikāpi na bāhyā
varṇotpatinimitam, kiṃ tarhi ? antarāsye carmavitatamasti,
paṇavacarmavat, tatsaṃbaddhā rekhā nāsikā, tasyāṃ vāyunā'bhihatāyāṃ
varṇotpatiḥ | yadi punarlaukikamāsyaṃ gaḥhyaeta, tadā
tulyāsyaprayatnamiti dvandvagarbho bahuvrīhiḥ syāt-āsyaṃ ca prayatnaśca
āsyaprayatnau, tau tulyau yasyeti; tripado vā bahuvrīhiḥ - tulya
āsya prayatno yasyeti | tatra dvandvagarbhe āsyagrahaṇaṃ vyarthaṃ syāt,
sarveṣāṃ hi tatulyam | visarjanīyasyaikīyamatenorasyatvāt
sāvarṇyābhāve'pi na doṣaḥ, tripade tu bahuvrīhāvāsyena prayatnasya
viśeṣitatvādāsyādvāhyāḥ prayatnā hāpitā bhavanti, kintu
tālvādisthānaṃ tulyatvenāviśeṣitaṃ syāt | tataśca
bhinnasthānānāmapi jabagaḍadānāṃ savarṇasaṃjñā prāpnoti | tata
ūrgja iti "jharo jhari" iti gakārasya jakāre lopaḥ syād |
atastaddhitāntasyaiva grahaṇam | tatrāpi yadi dvandvagarbho bahuvrīhiḥ
syāt, sthānena prayatno na viśeṣitaḥ syāt; tataśca
kakāraṅkārayormithaḥ savarṇasaṃjñā na syāt; bāhyaprayatnasya bhinnatvāt
| tataśca śaṅkiteti "anusvārasya yayi parasavarṇaḥ" iti ṅkāro na
syāt | atha satyapi bāhyaprayatnabhede ābhyantarasya
prayatnasyābhedamāśritya saṃjñā syāt, cakāraśakārayorapi
satyābhyantarabhede bāhyābhedamāśritya savarṇasaṃjñā prāpnoti | tataśca
aruścyotatīti vakṣyamāṇapratyudāharaṇaṃ nopapadyate itīmaṃ doṣaṃ
dṛṣṭvā tripado'yaṃ bahuvrīhiriti darśayati--'tulya āsye prayatno
yasye'ti | taddhitānta āsyaśabdo na
svāṅgavācyeveti"amūrddhamastakāt" ityaluṅna bhavati |
nanvasminnapi pakṣe bhinnavibhaktikatvāt prādhānyāccāsyaṃ
tulyatvenāviśeṣitaṃ syād; naivātrāsyaṃ tulyatayā viśeṣyate,
bhedanibandhanā hi tulyatā | na ca kakhagaghaṅaṃ bhinnaṃ sthānam,
ekatvātkaṇṭhasya, kintu taddhitāntasyāsyaśabdasyāśrayaṇasāmarthyādasya
ityekatvaṃ vivakṣitam | tenaikasminneva tālvādike sthāne yaḥ
prayatnaḥ, sa tulyo yayorityāśrayaṇānna kaściddoṣaḥ | 'samānajātīyaṃ
pratī'ti | etacca saṃjñāvidhānasāmarthyāllabhyate, anyathā
yatkiñcanavarṇāpekṣayā tulyāsyāprayatnatvena savarṇatve labdhe
tadāśrayamanyasyāpi kāryaṃ syāt, savarṇasaṃjñāvidhānamanarthakaṃ syāt |
na ca rephoṣmanivṛtyarthaṃ vacanam; rephasyāpi rephaḥ savarṇa eva,
evamūṣmasvapi draṣṭavyam | saṃbandhiśabdatvādvā sambandhiśabdo hi
tulyāsyaprayatnaśabdaḥ, tataśca yathā tulyāya kanyā dātavyetyukte dātrā
tulyāyeti gamyate, tathehāpi | atha vā, mahatī saṃjñā kriyate;
anvarthā yathā vijñāyeta-samānae'sya varṇaḥ savarṇa iti | yadi ca
samānajātīyameva prati savarṇasaṃjñā bhavati, evaṃ samāno'sya varṇo
bhavati |
'catvāra' ityādi | dvividhāḥ prayatnāḥ-bāhyāḥ, ābhyantarāśca |
tatrābhyantarāścatvāro vṛtau darśitāḥ | ābhyantaratvaṃ
punareṣām-sthānakaraṇavyāpāreṇa; utpattikāla eva bhāvāt | sthānaṃ
tālvādi, karaṇaṃ jihvāyā agropāgramadhyamūlāni | bāhyāḥ
punarekādaśa-vivāraḥ, saṃvāraḥ, śvāsaḥ, nādaḥ, ghoṣaḥ, aghoṣaḥ,
alpaprāṇaḥ, mahāprāṇaḥ, udātaḥ, anudātaḥ, svaritaśceti | bāhyatvaṃ
punareteṣām--varṇaniṣpatikālādūrdhvaṃ vāyuvaśenotpateḥ | tatra
spṛṣṭakaraṇāḥ sparśāḥ, kādayo māvasānāḥ sparśāḥ | spṛṣṭṃa
spṛṣṭatāguṇaḥ, karaṇaṃ kṛtiruccāraṇaprakāraḥ, spṛṣṭatānugataṃ karaṇaṃ
yeṣāṃ te tathoktāḥ | evamanyatrāpi - īṣatspṛṣṭakaraṇā antaḥsthāḥ;
yaralavā antaḥsthāḥ | vivṛtakaraṇā ūṣmāṇaḥ svarāśca; śapasahā
ūṣmāṇaḥ, svarāḥ sarva evācaḥ | vargāṇāṃ prathamadvitīyāḥ;
śaṣasavisarjanīyajihvāmūlīyopadhmānīyāḥ; yamau ca prathamadvitīyau;
vivṛtakaṇṭhāḥ, śvāsānupradānāḥ aghoṣāḥ; vargayamānāṃ
prathame'lpaprāṇāḥ, itare mahāprāṇāḥ | vargāṇāṃ tṛtīyacaturthāḥ,
antaḥsthāḥ, hakārānusvārau,yamau tṛtīyacaturthau saṃvṛtakaṇṭhā
nādānupradānā ghoṣavantaśca | vargayamānāṃ tṛtīyā antaḥsthā
alpaprāṇāḥ, itare mahāprāṇāḥ | yathā tṛtīyāstathā pañcamāḥ,
ānunāsikyameṣāmadhiko guṇaḥ | tatra yamā nāma
vargeṣvāditaścaturṇāṃ pañcameṣu parataḥ ta eva nāsikyā bhavanti |
tadyathā--palikrīrin, cakhnatuḥ, āgmannāyaḥ, jaghnatuḥ,
apnasvatīmityādi? | ya ete dvividhāḥ prayatnāḥ, teṣāmiha
savarṇasaṃjñāyāmābhyantarāḥ spṛṣṭatādayaścatvāra evāśrīyante, na
vivārādayo bāhyāḥ; āsyagrahaṇena teṣāṃ nivartitatvāt | a a a
ityādi | atra savarṇasaṃjño bhavatīti prakṛtaṃ bahuvacanāntaṃ
vipariṇatamanuṣajyate, trayo'kārā mithaḥ savarṇaṃsaṃjñā bhavantītyarthaḥ |
kathaṃ trayo'kārāḥ, yāvatā pratyuccāraṇaṃ bhede'nantāḥ, abhede tveka
eva ? tatrāha--'udāte'ti | anena prakāreṇa traya ityarthaḥ | evaṃ ca "trayaḥ"
ityasya "trividhā"ityartho bhavati | tatrākuhavisarjanīyāḥ kaṇṭhayāḥ,
icuyaśāstālavyāḥ, upūpadhmānīyā oṣṭhayāḥ, ṛṭuaraṣā mūrddhanyāḥ,
lṛtulasā dantyāḥ, eai kaṇṭha|ltālavyau, oau kaṇṭha|leṣṭhayau,
vakāro dantoṣṭhayaḥ-ityevaṃ tulyasthānaprayatnāḥ sarve'kārādayo
mithaḥ savarṇasaṃjñā bhavantīti | 'antaḥsthā | dviprabhedā' iti | atrāpi
pūrvavadanuṣaṅgaḥ, antaḥsthā ityukte'pi rephanivṛtyarthaṃ svarūpeṇa
paṭhati | 'yavalā 'iti | 'rephoṣmaṇāṃ savarṇā na santī'ti |
vijātīyābhiprāyametat | sajātīyāstu
rephoṣmāṇastulyasthānaprayatnāssavarṇā bhavantyeva | tatra rephasya
tāvadyavalā bhinnasthānā ṛṭuaraṣā bhinnaprayatnā anye bhinnasthānaprayatnāḥ |
evamūṣmaṇāmapi savarṇābhāvo veditavyaḥ |
'vargya' ityādi | varge bhavo vargyaḥ, digāditvādyat |
'vargyeṇa'--svavargāntaḥpātinā | tadyathā kakāraḥ khakāreṇa |
'tarpte'ti | "tṛp prīṇane" | 'icuyaśānāmi'ti | eṣāṃ madhye
yeṣāṃ prasaṅgaḥ, teṣāṃ mā bhūdityarthaḥ | 'aruś ścyotatī'ti | 
"ścyutir kṣaraṇe" | aruḥśabdasya rutvavisarjanīyayoḥ "vā śari" iti
sakāraḥ, tasyāpi ścutve śakāraḥ |
'ṛkāralṛkārayori'ti | sthānabhedānna prāpnotītyārambhaḥ |
śrutatvāccānayorevamithaḥ savarṇasaṃjñā vidhīyate, na tvetayoranyena
saha | 'hotṛkāra' iti | kathaṃ punaratra samudāyino'ntaratamo
bhavati na samudāyasya, tatrāpi ṛkārasyaiva na lṛkārasyetyata
āha-'ubhayori'tyādi | ubhayorantaratamo dīrgho na sambhavati,
lṛkārasyāpi dīrgho na sambhavatītyata āñkāra eva bhavatyubhayorityarthaḥ
| nanu ca naitatsavarṇasaṃjñāyāḥ prayojanam, katham ? "akaḥ savarṇe"
ityatra tu vakṣyati "ṛti ṛ vā vacanam, lṛti lṛ vā vacanam" iti |
tatra cāyamarthaḥ-akāṃ savarṇe ṛti parato vā ṛ bhavati; dvimātro'yam,
madhye dvau rephau tayorekā mātrā,abhito'jbhakteraparā,
īṣatspṛṣṭaścāyam | tatra prayatnabhedādṛkāreṇāgrahaṇād
anaṇtvāddīrghasaṃjñāyā abhāvādaprāpto'yaṃ vidhīyate | lṛti lṛ vā
vacanamityayamapi dvimātra īṣatspṛṣṭaśca, madhye dvau lakārau,
tayorekā mātrā'bhito'jbhakteraparā | pūrvavadaprāptau vidhīyate |
tatra ṛti ṛ vā vacanamityatra vāśabdo dīrghasya samuccayārthaḥ,
tenāprāpta eva dīrgho bhaviṣyati | nanu yadyavidhāyaiva savarṇasaṃjñāṃ
taducyate, tato'ka iti sambandhādaṅmātrasya lṛti tatkārya syād
dadhylṛkāro madhvlṛkāra iti, saṃjñāvidhāne tu ṛkāra
ṛkārasyaiva savarṇa iti tatraiva vyavasthitaṃ bhavati | tasmādavidheyā
savarṇasaṃjñā ? na vidheyā, yadetad ṛtīti "etadṛta iti vaktavyam,
savarṇa ityeva, ṛkārasya ṛkāra eva savarṇaḥ" iti ṛtyeva bhaviṣyati |
tata lṛti, ṛta ityeva | idaṃ cāsavarṇārtham, tena lṛti rūpadvayaṃ
siddham-hotṛkāraḥ, hotlṛkāra iti | tanna vaktavyaṃ bhavati | katham
? ṛ vā vacanam, lṛ vā vacanamiti bruvatāpi tayoractvaṃ
vaktavyam; anyathā vidhānamātramanayoḥ syād, na tvackāryaḥ plutaḥ |
sati tvactve tābhyāṃ trimātrayorapi sāvarṇyād grahaṇe sati
plutasaṃjñā bhavatīti plutasiddhiḥ | evaṃ ca hotṛ ṛkāra iti
ṛkārayo rephadvayayuktatvādvivṛtatvācca kadācidrephadvayayukta ṛ
bhaviṣyati, kadācidvivṛtaḥ śuddho dīrghaḥ | lṛkāre'pi
kadācidṛkārāntaratama ṛkāraḥ, kadācid lṛkārāntaratama lṛkāra
iti, satyam; savarṇasaṃjñāyāṃ tanna vaktavyaṃ bhavati, tadvocyeta, idaṃ
vā, ko nvatra viśeṣaḥ | idaṃ vā'vaśyaṃ vaktavyam, idamapi siddhaṃ bhavati
"ṛtyakaḥ" - khaṭvālṛkāraḥ, mātṛlṛkāraḥ | "vā
supyāpiśaleḥ"-upalṛkārīyati, upālkārīyatīti |
ṛditāmlṛditāṃ ca dhātūnāṃ
pṛthagupadeśasāmarthyādanubandhakāryāṇaamasaṅkaraḥ ||
nājjhalau || 1|1|10 ||
atrājjhalau na kenāpi savarṇasaṃjñau bhavata iti tāvadartho na bhavati;
saṃjñāyā nirviṣayatvāt | etāvanto varṇā acaśca halaśca |
nāpyacāmajbhirhalāṃ halbhiḥ savarṇatvaniṣedhaḥ; ata eva nirdeśāt |
anyathā'kārasyākāre dīrgho na syānnājiti, nāpyajjhalāviti
pūrvasavarṇaḥ | tasmādacāṃ halāṃ ca mithaḥ savarṇasaṃjñā niṣidhyate |
tatra ca yadyapi ṅājjhalau" iti sāmānyenoktam,
tathāpyakārahakārayorikāraśakārayośca prāptiriti tatraiva niṣedhaḥ
| yadyevam, nāṇśalāviti vaktavyam ? na tāvadevaṃ lāghave viśeṣaḥ |
kiṃ ca prāguktaṃ pakṣadvayaṃ sambhāvyeta | 'acca hal ce'ti | anena
nātrājjhalornirdeśa iti darśayati | tatrāpi na doṣaḥ kaścit, kintu
pakṣāntarasambhāvanaiva | tulyāsyaprayatnāviti prasaṅge hetumāha |
savarṇadīrghatvaṃ na bhavatīti pratiṣedhasya phalaṃ darśayati | nanu
dīrghavidhāvacītyanuvartate, taccāvaśyamanuvartyam, kumārī śete
ityatra mā bhūditi, na hyātrānena niṣedhaḥ siddhyati | kiṃ kāraṇam ?
vākyāparisamāpteḥ | iha hi varṇānāmupadeśaḥ pūrvam, tata itsaṃjñā,
tataḥ "ādirantyena sahetā" iti pratyāhāraḥ, tataḥ ṅājjhalau" ityasya
niṣpatiḥ, tasmiṃśca niṣpanne satyapavādaviṣayaparihaareṇeṣṭaviṣaye
savarṇasaṃjñā pravartate, na tvetatsūtraniṣpatisamaye | tataśca
"aṇuditsavarṇasya ca" ityetat svāṅgabhūteṣu
upadeśetsaṃjñāpratyāhārasavarṇatveṣu niṣpanneṣu "asya cvau"
ityādiṣu vartate, na tvaṅgeṣūpadeśādiṣviti ṅājjhalau"
ityagṛhītasavarṇānāmacāṃ grahaṇamiti siddham | avaśyaṃ
cāgṛhītasavarṇānāmevācāṃ grahaṇameṣṭavyam, anyathā hyajiti gṛhyamāṇa
ikāraḥ śakārasya? grāhakaḥ syāt | na cāsminnapi sūtre'yameva
niṣedhaḥ, svātmani kriyāvirodhāt | ato'jgrahaṇenāpi śakārasya
grahaṇam, halṣu copadeśāddhalgrahaṇenāpīti śakāradvayasya mithaḥ
savarṇasaṃjñā na syāt | tataśca "paraḥśatāni kāryāṇi" ityatra
śatātparāṇi, śatādadhikānīti vigṛhya "kartṛkaraṇe kṛtā bahulam"
iti bahulavacanātsamāse pāraskarāditvātsuṭi kṛte "anaci ca" iti
śakārasya dvirvacane paraśśśatānīti sthite madhyamasya śakārasya 
"jharo jhari savarṇe" iti lopo na syāditi sarvadā
śakāratrayaśravaṇaprasaṅgaḥ | ato'gṛhītasavarṇānāmacāṃ
grahaṇādīkāraśakārayorapratiṣiddhaṃ savarṇatvamiti "kumārī śete"
ityatra mā bhūditi dīrghavidhau "aci " ityanuvartyaṃ
tadanuvṛttisāmarthyāccājeva yo'j na kathañcana hal, tatraiva
dīrghatvavijñānāddhakāraśakārayorakārekārābhyāṃ sāvarṇyena
grahaṇādactve satyapi haltvasyāpi bhāvāddīrghābhāvaḥ siddhaḥ, satyam;
ajgrahaṇamapyanyārthamanuvartyam, idamapi vaipāśo matsyaḥ, ānaḍuhaṃ
carmmetyatra yasyeti lopābhāvārthaṃ kartavyaṃ daṇḍahasto
dadhiśītamityetadubhayathāpi siddhyatīti
pradarśanārthamudāharaṇadvayamupanyastam | 'vaipāśā 'iti -bhavārthe'ṇ |
'ānaḍuhami'ti-vikāre "prāṇirajatādibhyo'ñ" ||
īdūded dvivacanaṃ pragṛhyam || 1|1|11 ||
atra catvāraḥ pakṣāḥ sambhavanti-īdādi viśeṣyam, dvivacanaṃ
viśeṣaṇam, tatra dvivacanāntatvamīdāderna sambhavatīti
dvivacanasaṃjñakamīdādi pragṛhyamiti prathamaḥ pakṣaḥ | īdādi viśeṣaṇam,
dvivacanaṃ viśeṣyam, viśeṣaṇena tadantavidhāvīdādyantaṃ dvivacanamiti
dvitīyaḥ pakṣaḥ | pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣayā tadantavidhau sati paścād
dvivacanāntasyedādibhirviśeṣaṇādīdādyantaṃ dvivacanāntamiti tṛtīyaḥ
| īdādiviśiṣṭena dvivacanena tadantavidhāvīdādyantaṃ yad
dvivacanam, tadantaṃ pragṛhyamiti caturthaḥ | tatrādye pakṣe-agnī, vāyū,
khaṭve ityādāveva syāt; ekādeśasya paraṃ pratyādivadbhāvena
dvivacanamīdādīti, pacete pacethe pacāvahe
ityādāvekāramātrasyādvivacanatvānna syāt | tṛtīye
tu-kumāryoragāraṃ kumāryagāram, vadhvoragāraṃ vadhvagāram;
ityatrāpi syāt-etaddhi pratyayalakṣaṇena dvivacanāntamīdādyantaṃ ca śrūyate
| yathā hi "tāvakīnaḥ" ityādāvādeśena saṃkhyāviśeṣo vyajyate,
tathehāpi satyāṃ pragṛhyasaṃjñāyāṃ prakṛtibhāvena dvitvamabhivyajyeteti
syād dvivacanāntasyāpi samāsaḥ | caturthe
kumāryagāramityādāvaprasaṅgaḥ; dvivacanasyānīdādyantatvāt,
kintvaśukle śukle samapadyetāṃ śuklyāstāṃ vastre-atrāpi prāpnoti,
katham ? śuklaśabdādvastravṛterdvivacanamau, ṅapuṃsakācca" iti
śībhāvaḥ, tataścviḥ, śīśabdasya śupo dhātu" iti luk, "asya
cvau" taddhitāntatvātsuḥ, avyayatvālluk; atra śīśabda īkārāntaṃ
dvivacanam, tadantaśca samudāyaḥ pratyayalakṣaṇeneti pragṛhyasaṃjñā
prāpnoti | ayaṃ ca tṛtīye'pi pakṣe samāno doṣaḥ | kiṃ
ca-saṃjñāvidhau pratyayagrahaṇe tadantavidhipratiṣedhāt
tadantapakṣotthānameva nāsti, ato dvitīyaṃ pakṣamāśrityāha-'īd ūd
ed ityevamantaṃ dvivacanami'ti | nanvasminnapi pakṣe īdūtoḥ
kevalayoreva saṃbhava ityagnī ityādikaṃ yadyapi sidhyati,
tathāpyekārāntasya tu dvivacanasya "pacete" ityādau sambhavātatraiva
syāt, na khaṭve ityādau; vyapadeśivadbhāvenātrāpi bhaviṣyati |
kiṃ punaratra pramāṇamayameva pakṣa āśrīyata iti ?
tṛtīyacaturthayostāvadasambhava eva; saṃjñāvidhau pratyayagrahaṇe
tadantavidhipratiṣedhāt | saṃjñāyāśca saṃjñyapekṣāyāmanantaraśrutaṃ
dvivacanameva saṃjñītyuktamiti prathamasyāpyasambhavaḥ | atra caturthaḥ
pakṣo'sambhavādeva nirastaḥ; na doṣavatvāt | śuklyāstāṃ vastra ityatra
hi "antaraṅgānapi vidhīn bahiraṅgo lugvādhate" iti
antaraṅgamapi śībhāvaṃ bādhitvā śupo dhātu" iti luki
kṛte'nīkārāntaṃ dvivacanaṃ bhavati | agnī ityādau pragṛhyatvāt
"plutaḥ pragṛhyā aci" iti prakṛtibhāvaḥ | pratyudāharaṇeṣu tadabhāvāt
svarasandhiḥ | taparakaraṇaṃ guṇāntarabhinnānāṃ tatkālānāṃ
grahaṇārthamiti cet, na; abhedakatvād guṇānām | bhinnakālānāṃ
nivṛtyarthamiti cet, na; īdūtoranaṇtvāt |
syādetat-jātipakṣe yadyapi dīrghoccāraṇasāmarthyāt prayatnādhikyāt
akurvahyatretyādau hrasvānāṃ na syāt, plutānāṃ tu syādeva | ekārasya
tvaṇtvādapi plutasya prasaṅgaḥ, ataḥ plutanivṛtyarthaṃ
taparakaraṇamiti, tanna; iṣṭatvāt | 
kimarthaṃ punaḥ plutānāṃ pragṛhyasaṃjñeṣyate ? pragṛhyāḥ prakṛtyeti
prakṛtibhāvo yathā syāt | mā bhūdevam, plutaḥ prakṛtyetyeva
bhaviṣyati | yatra tarhi plutāśrayaḥ prakṛtibhāvaḥ
pratiṣidhyate-"aplutavadupasthite" iti, tatra pragṛhyāśrayaḥ prakṛtibhāvo
yathā syād agnī3 itīti | iha ca agnī3
apragṛhyasyetyanunāsikaparyudāso yathā syāt | ataḥ plutānāmapi
pragṛhyasaṃjñāyā iṣṭatvānna tannivṛtyarthamapi taparakaraṇamityata
āha-'taparakaraṇamasandehārthami'ti | asati hi tasmin samāhāradvandve
napuṃsakahrasvatve ca kṛte yvīti nirdeśe sandehaḥ syāt |
itaretarayogādvandve'pi sandeha eva | tasmādasandehārthaṃ taparakaraṇam
| yadyasandehārthamapi taparatvaṃ kriyate, tadeva plutasyeṣṭāṃ saṃjñāṃ
vyāvartayati,tat plutasya kathaṃ saṃjñā ? mā bhūt plutasya, tasya
tvasiddhatvāt sthānini pravṛtā saṃjñā svārasandhimanunāsikaṃ ca
pratibhantsyati, siddhaḥ plutaḥ svarasandhiṣu,plutaḥ prakṛtyeti
liṅgāt | anyathā kāryiṇo'satvātkasya prakṛtibhāvo vidhīyate !
yasya ca vikāraprasaṅgaḥ, plutaprakaraṇe tasya prakṛtibhāvo vidheyaḥ,
plutasyāsiddhatvena tasya vikārāprasaṅga iti plutasyāsataḥ
prakṛtibhāvavidhānamanupapannam | astu, svarasandhiprakaraṇe plutaḥ
siddhaḥ, saṃjñāvidhāvasiddhaḥ | saṃjñāvidhau ca siddhaḥ, katham ? kāryakālaṃ
saṃjñāparibhāṣam, tataśca pragṛhyāḥ prakṛtyetyatrāsyopasthānāt
saṃjñāpi svarasandhiprakaraṇāntargatā | evaṃ tarhi siddhaḥ plutaḥ
svarasandhiṣviti nāśrīyate, plutabhāvī prakṛtyeti sthānina eva
prakṛtibhāvo vidhāsyate ? evamapyanunāsikaparyudāso na sidhyati,
kāryakālapakṣe saṃjñāyāmapi plutasya siddhatvāt | evaṃ tarhi
"yathoddeśaṃ saṃjñāparibhāṣam" tataścāsmin pradeśe saṃjñāyāṃ
kriyamāṇāyāṃ plutasyāsiddhatvāt sthānini pravṛtā saṃjñā
svarasandhimanunāsikaṃ ca pratibhantsyati | nanu yadyapi saṃjñāyāmasiddhaḥ
plutaḥ, anunāsikaparyudāse tu siddhaḥ, tataśca yasyānena saṃjñā kṛtā
dvimātrasya, na so'nunāsikavidhiṃ prati sthānī, kintu trimātra eva | na
ca sthānivadbhāvātasyāpi pragṛhyatvam, alvidhitvāt | avaśyaṃ ca
"siddhaḥ plutaḥ svarasandhiṣu" ityāśrayaṇīyam, daṇḍa-ā3ḍhakamiti
plutasya savarṇadīrgheṇa nivṛttiryathā syāt | tathā ca "aṅuṇ" ityatra
sarvaireva granthakārairuktam | tathā suślokā3 iti
sauśloketi--atrāpi "aplutavadupasthite" iti plutāśraye
prakṛtibhāve pratiṣiddhe guṇo bhavan plutameva nivartayati, na tu
sthāninam; anyathā hyādeśarūpe plutaḥ śrūyeta | tadiha yathoddeśe'pi
saṃjñāparibhāṣe, kathamiveṣṭasiddhiḥ ? kathaṃ vā grantheṣu
pūrvāparavirodhaparihāraḥ ? iti vipaścitaḥ praṣṭavyāḥ |
'maṇīvādīnāmi'ti |śiddhaye" iti śeṣaḥ | na punarmaṇīvādīnāmaparaḥ
pratiṣedho vidheyaḥ | na cedaṃ vacanam,
bhāṣyavārtikakārābhyāmapaṭhitatvāt; kintu maṇīvādīnāṃ nirvāhaḥ
kartavya ityarthaḥ | tatra "maṇīvoṣṭrasya lambete" ityatra
vāśabdasyopamānārthasya prayogaḥ | rothasīvetyādau
thachāndasatvāditi nirvāhaḥ ||
adaso māt || 1|1|12 ||
"svaritenādhikāraḥ" ityatra dvau pakṣau-arthādhikāraḥ,
śabdādhikāraśceti | tatrārthādhikāro nāma-yasya yasminsūtre
svaritatvaṃ pratijñātaṃ tatra tasya yo'rthaḥ sa utaratrādhikriyata iti |
śabdādhikārastu sa eva
śabdo'vivakṣitārtho'dhikṛtastatatsūtrānuguṇamarthaṃ pratipādayatīti |
tatrārthādhikāre pūrvatredādibhistadantaṃ pratyāyitam, ihānuvṛtam
"māt" ityanena viśeṣyeteti "amuke'tra" ityatrāpi prasaṅgaḥ,
śabdādhikāre tvidādimātrasyehānuvṛtasyāpi viśeṣyābhāvādasati
tadantavidhau "māt" ityanena viśeṣaṇādadoṣa iti
tamāśrityāha-'tasmātpare īdūdedantā' iti | 'pragṛhyasaṃ jñā' iti |
pragṛhyaśabdaḥ saṃjñā yeṣāṃ te tathoktāḥ | yadyapi pūrvasūtra eva
pragṛhyaśabdaḥ saṃjñātvena viniyuktaḥ, tathāpīha saṃjñino na pratyāyayati;
svarūpapadārthakasyaiva tasyehānuvṛteḥ | kimarthamidamucyate, yāvatā
strīnapuṃsakayordvivacane mutvasyāsiddhatve'pyekārāntatvāt
pūrveṇaiva siddhā saṃjñā; svarasandhiprakaraṇe ca
mutvasyāsiddhatvādekārasyaiva vikāraprasaṅge prakṛtibhāvo'pi
siddhaḥ,anunāsikaparyudāsaśca kāryakālapakṣe liṅgatraye'pi dvivacane
siddhaḥ ? "aṇo'pragṛhyasya" ityatropasthitena pūrvasūtreṇa saṃjñāyāṃ
kriyamāṇāyāṃ mutvasya siddhatvāt |
ato'nunāsikaparyyudāse'dvivacanārtho'yamārambhaḥ, prakṛtibhāve tu
puṃsi dvivacanārthaśca | nanvārabdhe'pyasminyathoddeśapakṣe saṃjñāyāṃ
kartavyāyāṃ mutvamītvayorāśrayātsiddhatve'pi svarasandhiprakaraṇe
tayorasiddhatvādayāvekādeśaprasaṅgaḥ, amī āsate ityayādeśaḥ, amū
āsāte iti puṃsyāvādeśaḥ, amī atra iti "eṅaḥ padāntādati"
ityekādeśaḥ | na ca saṃjñāyā vaiyarthyam;
anunāsikaparyudāsenārthavatvāt | tatra hi kartavye
mutvamītvayorasiddhatvābhāvādyayoranena saṃjñā kṛtā tāveva ?na, na
taṃ prati | kāryakālapakṣe tu saṃjñāyāmapi kartavyāyāmāśrayāt
siddhatvaṃ nāśrayaṇīyam;"aṇo'pragṛhyasya" ityatropasthite'smin kartavye
mutvamītvayoḥ siddhatvāt, tāvatā cāsya caritārthatvāt |
tadevamubhayorapi pakṣayoḥ svarasandhiḥ syādeva ? ucyate;
yadyanunāsikaparyudāsa eva prayojanamabhaviṣyad
"aṇo'pragṛhyasyānunāsiko'daso na " ityevāvakṣyat | amuke,
amuyetyādāvanaṇtvādanavasānatvāccāprasaṅgaḥ | ataḥ
saṃjñārambhasāmarthyāt prakṛtibhāvārthatvamapyasya vijñāyate, tacca
svarasandhiprakaraṇe mutvamītvayoḥ
siddhatvamantareṇānupapannamityubhayorapi pakṣayoḥ
sāmarthyādasiddhatvabādhaḥ |
'māditi kimi'ti | "adasa" iti ṣaṣṭhī, amī amū ityatra ca
mūtvamītvayoḥ sthānināvekādeśāvantavadbhāvādadas-śabdagrahaṇena
gṛhyaete iti tadādeśayorapi tadgrahaṇena grahaṇādasti
tāvadiṣṭasiddhiḥ | editi ca nivartiṣyate, na ca mātparāvīdūtau
sambhavata ityatiprasaṅgo'pi nāstīti praśnaḥ | 'amuke'treti' |
ekayoganirddiṣṭānāmekadeśānuvṛttirdurjñāneti bhāvaḥ | na ca
mādityasmin satyapi edgrahaṇasāmarthyādatra prasaṅgaḥ; mādityasya
vaiyarthyaprasaṅgāt | na ca vikalpaḥ; atulyabalatvāt | taddhi pūrvatra
caritārtham, māditi tvakṛtārtham | na cānuvṛttisāmarthyam;
anyānurodhenāpyanuvṛttisambhavāt ||
śe || 1|1|13 ||
"śe" iti śruteraviśeṣāt "kāśe","kuśe" ityatrāpi prasaṅga iti
matvā pṛcchati--kimidamiti | supāmādeśa iti | kāśe taityatra tu
lākṣaṇikatvādagrahaṇamiti bhāvaḥ | yuṣma iti | ṣaṣṭhībahuvacanasya
"supāṃ suluk" ityādinā śe ādeśaḥ,"śeṣe lopaḥ" | asme iti |
caturthībahuvacanasya śe | tve me iti | saptamyekavacanasya
tvamāvekavacane | asame indrābṛhaspatī iti |
chāndasamudāharaṇamityuktvā, itaratu lokikamanukaraṇamityuktena
yuṣme vājabandhavaḥ, tve rāyaḥ, me rāya ityeṣāmapyanukaraṇatvamuktaṃ
syād | ato yadatretaraditi vivakṣitaṃ tatsvarūpeṇa paṭhati | yuṣme
itītyādi | laukikamanukaraṇamityanena ca sūtrasyāvaśyārabhyātvaṃ
darśaṃyati | "asme indrābṛhaspatī" ityādi chāndasatvādapi siddhyet
| idaṃ tu padakārairiti paraṃ prayujyamānaṃ laukikam, ato na
chāndasatvātsiddhiriti || 
nipāta ekājanāṅ || 1|1|14 ||
" vyāharati mṛgaḥ", "vyavahṛpaṇoḥ samarthayoḥ" iti nirdeśādekājiti
karmadhārayaḥ, na bahuvrīhirityāha-ekaścāsāviti | yadyevam,
taekagrahaṇamanarthakam, nipāto'jityevāstu, tatra nipātenāj
viśiṣyate | nipātasaṃjñako'jiti viparyayastu na bhavati; "ajanto
nipātaḥ" iti vyāvartyābhāvād halantānāṃ satyasati vā pragṛhyatve
viśeṣābhāvāt | nanu purostīti halantasya prakṛtibhāvādro rutvaṃ
na syāt,naitadasti; pragṛhyasaṃjñāyāṃ rutvasyāsiddhatvāt, sakārasya ca
kāryāntarāprasaṅgāt | nanu cedamasti prayojanamacā nipātasya
viśeṣaṇe kim ? ajantasya yathā syād, ajmātrasya mā bhūt iti | evaṃ
satyanāṅityanarthakaṃ syāt, ato nipātenāj viśeṣyate, nārtha
ekagrahaṇena, na; acsamudāyanivṛtyarthaṃ tarhyekagrahaṇam aiu apehīti
samudāyasyaiva syād, nāvayavānām; ekājdvirvacanavadajantasyaiva
prakṛtibhāvaḥ syāt, pūrvayostu svarasandhiḥ syāt | nanu ca
nipāto'jiti caikatvasya vivakṣitatvāt samudāyasya na bhaviṣyati,
evaṃ tarhyacsamudāyagrahaṇaśaṅkānirāsārthamekagrahaṇaṃ kurvan
jñāpayati-"varṇānirddeśeṣu vyaktisaṃkhyā na vivakṣyate, jātireva
nirddiśyate" iti | tena dambherhalgrahaṇasya
jātivācakatvātsiddhamityupapannaṃ bhavati | 
nipāta iti kimiti | nipātasyaivaikāco'rthavatvasambhava iti praśnaḥ |
cakārārātreti--kṛño liṭi tipo ṇal | anvayavyatirekābhyāṃ
pratyayasyāpyarthavatvamiti bhāvaḥ | ākāro'tra ṅidviśiṣṭa upātaḥ,
prayoge ca na kvacin ṅkāraḥ śrūyate | ato'rthavaśena iṅtvāiṅtve
vyavasthāpayati |
īṣadartha ityādi | īṣadarthe-ā a uṣṇāḥ u oṣṇaḥ | āṅīṣadartha iti
coktam | kriyāyoge - ā a itaḥ u etaḥ | prādiṣu paṭhitaḥ |
maryādābhividhau ceti | samāhāradvandva āgamasyānityatvānnumabhāvaḥ |
maryādāsahito vā'bhividhiḥ | maryādāyām- ā a udakāntād u
odakāntāt | abhividhau - ā a ahicchatrād uāhicchatrāt | āha ca
--"vinā tena maryādā, saha tena ityabhividhiḥ" |
"āṅmaryādābhividhyoḥ" iti ca ṅinnirddiṣṭaḥ pūrvaprakrāntasya
vākyasyānyathātvadyotanāya ākāraḥ prayujyate-ā evaṃ nu manyase, naivaṃ
pūrvamamaṃsthāḥ, saṃprati tvevaṃ manyase iti | tathā smṛteḥ sūcakaḥ
ākāraḥ prayujyate, tataḥ smṛto'rtho nirdiśyate-ā evaṃ kila taditi
||
ot || 1|1|15 ||
nanu cāhoprabhṛtayo nipātasamāhārāḥ, aha a u u aho,
utāāhoūtāho, athāūatho, yā a u uyo, na a u u no, mā a u u mo,
ca a u uco; yadyapyarthabhedo na pratīyate, tathāpyanarthakānāmapi
nipātānāṃ darśanāt samāhāratvaṃ nānupapannam,
tataścādivadbhāvāt pūrveṇaiva siddhā pragṛhyasaṃjñā, yathā--"eṣo uṣā
apūrvyā" iti | eṣā a u u eṣo ityāśaṅkya, ekanipātā iti
darśayati--odanto yo nipāta iti | cādiṣu tathā pāṭhāditi bhāvaḥ
| samāhārapakṣe ca āho itītyādau "uñaḥ" "Äṣ" ityayaṃ vidhiḥ
prāpnoti | athāpi samāhāra, evamapi sūtraṃ kartavyam "o
citsakhāyam" "o ṣuṃ vartamarutaḥ" ityādyartham | ā a u u o
ityatrāntavadbhāvādanāṅiti pratiṣedhaḥ prāpnoti, atrāpi paryudāse
siddham; āṅnāṅerekādeśa ādivadbhāvādanāṅgrahaṇena gṛhyata iti
| ihānado'do'bhavaditi ? cvyantatvānnipātatve'ḍapi
pratipadoktasyaukārasya grahaṇānna bhavati | evamapyagaurgauḥ samapadyata
gobhavadityatra prāpnoti; gauṇamukhyayormukhye kāryasaṃpratyayānna
bhaviṣyati | atra hi jaḍa|ladidharmeṇāropitagotve vāhīke gośabdo
vartate iti gauṇārthatvamasya | kathaṃ tarhi gaurvāhīkastiṣṭhati, gāṃ
vāhīkamānayeti vṛddhyātve bhavatoḥ ? ucyate; svārthe
pravṛtātprātipadikādvibhaktāvutpannāyāṃ kāryeṣu kṛteṣu
śabdāntarasannidhānādatra gauṇatvaṃ pratīyate | kārakāṇāmapi hi
kriyayā sambandhaḥ, na paraspareṇa; gāmānaya, vāhīkamānaya,
gaustiṣṭhati, vāhīkastiṣṭhatīti | paścātu vākyopanyāsāt
sāmānādhikaraṇyādgauṇārthe prādurbhāvo bhavati | iha tu
gauṇārthaprādurbhāvādutarakālaṃ cvyantatve sati
pragṛhyasaṃjñāprāptiriti viśeṣaḥ | ataḥ padakāryeṣvevāyaṃ nyāyaḥ, na
prātipadikakāryeṣviti siddham |
saṃbuddhau śākalyasyetāvanārṣe || 1|1|16 ||
"saṃbuddhau" ityanenā'nūdyamāna okāro viśeṣyate, ataḥ
kṅitītivannimitasaptamīyamityāha--saṃbuddhinimita iti |
parasaptamyāṃ tu trapo itītyādau napuṃsake na syāditi bhāvaḥ |
avaidika iti | anāṣa ityasyārthamāha, ṛṣirvedaḥ taduktamṛṣiṇetyādau
darśanāt | nanu ca
gavityayamāhetyatrānukāryeṇārthavatvātprātipadikatve sati vibhaktyā
bhāvyamityata tāaha --atretyādi | ata eva hi
vibhaktyabhāvādapadāntatvācchākalyasyāpi pratyudāharaṇe "lopaḥ
śākalyasya" iti lopo na bhavati |
bhedasyāvivakṣitatvāditi | bhedanibandhano hi
pratipādyapratipādakabhāvaḥ, sa tasminnavivakṣite na bhavati | asatyarthavatva
iti | yadyanarthakaḥ; kathaṃ tarhi prayujyate ? prayojanavatvāt,
prayojanamanukāryapratītiḥ | yadyapyabhidhānavyāpāro nāsti, tathāpi
tadānīmuccāritaṃ rūpaṃ sādṛśyādanukāryapratipatiparam, bhedaśca
sanneva na vivakṣita iti anukāryasyāpaśabdatve'pi nāsyāpaśbadatvam |
śākalyagrahaṇaṃ vibhāṣārthamiti | tatra bahvṛ cāḥ pragṛhyamevādhīyate,
taitirīyāstvapragṛhyam |
añaḥ || 1|117 ||
yadyayameko yogaḥ syād "aña Äṣ" iti yathāpaṭhitaṃ sūtrakāreṇa, tataḥ
"uñaḥ" ityasya śrutenādeśena sambandhaḥ syād, na pragṛhyasaṃjñayā; sā tu
"nipāta ekājanāṅ" iti nityaiva syāt, śākalyaśrutyanuvṛtyā
cādeśe vikalpite rūpadvayameva syād- u iti, Äṣ itīti; na tu
vitīti tṛtīya | ato vibhajya vyācaṣṭe | tatra yadyapi pūrvasūtreṣu
sāmānādhikaraṇyena nirdeśātpradeśeṣviva pragṛhyaśabdo
dvivacanādyabhidheyaḥ, tathāpīha ṣaṣṭhīnirdeaṣātsvarūpapadārthakaḥ sampadyate |
ata evāha--uñaḥ pragṛhyasaṃjñā bhavatīti | pragṛhyamityeṣā saṃjñā
bhavatītyarthaḥ | purvatra tu dvivacanaṃ pragṛhyasaṃjñaṃ bhavatītyuktam, anena
ca pragṛhyasaṃjñāyā eva vikalpanād- u iti, vitīti sādhitaṃ rūpadvayam
||
Äṣ || 1|1|18 ||
śākalyasya matena pragṛhyasaṃjñakaśceti | anenāsminnapi yoge
dvayamapyetadanuvartyamiti darśayati | yadi "śākalyasya" iti
nāpekṣyeta tadā pragṛhyasyoño nityamādeśaḥ syāt, anuvṛtasya
pragṛhyaśabdasya paṣṭha|lntatayā vipariṇāmāt, tataśca Äṣ iti, vitīti
dve eva rūpe syātām; u itīti na syāt | śākalyagrahaṇena tu
vikalpe sati tadapi bhavati | tathā pragṛhyagrahaṇānanuvṛtau
pragṛhyāpragṛhyayorapyādeśe vikalpaḥ syāt | tatra pragṛhyasyādeśe'pi
siddhamiṣṭam, apragṛhyasya tu yaṇ sānunāsiko vakāraḥ syāt | ataḥ
pragṛhyagrahaṇamapyanuvartyam | trīṇi rūpāṇīti | trīṇyeva rūpāṇi
bhavanti | trīṇi ca bhavantītyarthaḥ | iha yadetanūÄ padakārairucyata
ityanukaraṇe "yaro'nunāsike'nunāsiko vā " ityeṣa vidhirbhavati
| 
īdūtau ca saptamyarthe || 1|1|19 ||
śākalyasyetāviti nivṛtamiti | asvaritatvāt | iha caśbdena
pratnena prakṛtamanukṛṣyate, tatra saṃjñāyā ananuvṛtau vidheyaṃ
nāstīti saivānukṛṣyate | māmakyāṃ tanvāmiti prāpta iti |
saptamyarthaṃ darśayati | māmakītanūśabdau śupāṃ suluk" iti
luptasaptamīkau | māmakī iti, tanū itīti | kāryodāharaṇe | gaurī
adhiśrita iti tu saṃhitāpāṭhe'pi kāryodāharaṇamiti | sa eva tatra
darśataḥ |
agnā bhavātīti | rūpapratyudāharaṇam, kāryaṃ tu padakāle |
dhītītyādi | dhīti-mati-suṣṭuatiśabdebhyaḥ parasya tṛtīyekavacanasya
pūrvasavarṇa īkāraḥ, taddarśayatidhītyā, matyetyādinā | vāpyaśvaḥ,
nadyātiriti | śaṃjñāyām" iti saptamīsamāsaḥ | atha
kriyamāṇe'pyarthagrahaṇe kasmādevātra na bhavati, asti hyatrāpi saptamyarthaḥ
? ucyate; jahatsvārthā vṛttiriti pakṣe
samāsasyaivārthavatvātpūrvotarapadayorvarṇavadānarthakyamiti
saptamyartho nāsti | ajahatsvārthāyāmapi vṛtāvupasarjanapadaṃ na
svārthamātre paryavasyāti; kintu tatsaṃsṛṣṭe pradhānārthe |
tatrārthagrahaṇasāmarthyādyāvānartho vākye saptamyantenābhidhīyate
kevalo'saṃsṛṣṭarūpastasayaiva grahaṇamiti saṃsṛṣṭe na bhaviṣyati |
taparakaraṇaṃ guṇāntarabhinnānāṃ tulyakālānāṃ grahaṇārthamiti cet,
na; abhedakatvād guṇānām | bhinnakālānāṃ plutānāṃ
nivṛtyarthamiti cet, na; anaṇtvādasaṃbhāvācca | na hi
saptamyarthavṛtti plutāntaṃ sambhavatītyata āha-taparakaraṇamityādi |
īdūtāvityādi | "īdūtau saptamī" ityevāstu, ṅārtho'rthagrahaṇena |
lupte'rthagrahaṇādbhavediti | asatyarthagrahaṇe saṃjñāvidhau
pratyayagrahaṇe tadantavidhipratiṣedhāt saptamyā eva saṃjñā syāt,
tataśca śomo gaurī adhiśritaḥ" ityatra na syālluptatvāt |
arthagrahaṇe tvarthanimiteyaṃ saṃjñā, na tu pratyayaśravaṇanimitā | ataḥ
"lupte'rthagrahaṇādbhavet"| nātra saptamī lupyate, pūrvasavarṇo'tra
bhavati-supāṃ sulugiti | tato'kaḥ savarṇe dīrghatvena
tasyādivatvāt saptamīgrahaṇena grahaṇād astyeva saptamīti
śaṅkatepūrvasya cediti | dūṣayati-āḍāmbhāva iti | yadi hyatra
pūrvasavarṇaḥ syāt, dīrghā deśaṃ bādhitvā''ḍāmau syātām, ato
lugeva yuktaḥ | tasmādarthagrahaṇaṃ kartavyam ? na kartavyam,
yasmātsarvatraiva lukā bhāvyamiti na kvacitsaptamyasti | ucyate
cedam-"tatra vacanasāmarthyātsaṃjñāvidhāvapi tadantavidhirbhaviṣyati |
nedaṃ vacanāllabhyam,yato vacanādyatra dīrghatvaṃ tatraiva syād-dṛtiṃ na
śuṣkaṃ sarasīśayānam " iti | atra hi saraḥ śabdātparasya ṅiśabdasya
"iyāḍiyājīkārāṇāmupasaṅkhyānam" itīkāre kṛte saptamyeva
śrūyate iti tatraiva syād, na gaurī ityādau | tatrāpi sarasī yadi |
tatrāpi siddham, katham ? yadi sarasīśabdo vidyate | asaṃdigdhe
saṃdigdhābhadhānametad, śāstrāṇi cetpramāṇaṃ syuriti yathā | asti ca
sarasīśabdaḥ, dakṣiṇāpathe mahānti sarāṃsi śarasyaḥ" ucyante | tataśca
sarasīśabdo'pi luptasaptamīka eveti vacanātadantavidhirityetadeva
sthitam | evaṃ tarhi-jñāpakaṃ syātadantatve | "īdūded" ityatra
catvāraḥ pakṣā upanyastāḥ, tatra tadantatve ityanena
tṛtīyacaturthapakṣāvupalakṣayati | tatra jñāpakaṃ syād-iha pragṛhyaprakaraṇe
pratyalakṣaṇaṃ na bhavatīti; yadi syāt, pūrvoktanyāyena saṃjñāvidhau
pratyayagrahaṇe tadantavidherāśrayaṇāt luptāyāmapi saptamyāṃ
pratyayalakṣaṇena saptamyantamiti saṃjñā bhaviṣyati, kimarthagraṇena ? tena
tadantatve yo doṣa uktaḥ-pratyayalakṣaṇena saṃjñā prāpnoti, sa na
bhavatīti saṃjñāvidhau pratyayagrahaṇe tadantavidherabhāvādeva
tadantapakṣastatra naiva sthita ityāha--mā veti ||
dādhā ghvadāp || 1|1|20 ||
kimidaṃ prayogasthānāmanukaraṇam-prayoge ye dādhārūpāḥ śrūyante,
te ghusaṃjñā bhavantīti ? āhosvit upadeśe dhātupāṭhe'pasthitānāṃ
yāvatāmanukaraṇaṃ dādhārūpaṃ saṃbhavati teṣāmiti ? kiṃ cātaḥ ? yadi
prayogasthānāmanukaraṇam, śiti na prāpnoti, do-praṇidyati,
deṅ-praṇidayate, dāṇ-praṇiyacchati, dheṭ-praṇidhayati; kiṃ kāraṇam
? adādhārūpatvāt | praṇidātā prakaṇidhātā ityādāveva tu syāt |
kimucyate śiti na prāpnotīti, yāvatā
dodeṅdheṭāmaśityapyātve kṛte'pi lākṣaṇikatvānna prāpnoti ?
naiṣa doṣaḥ; "gāmādāgrahaṇeṣvaviśeṣaḥ" iti dodeṅe
tāvadgṛhyaete | asyāśca paribhāṣāyā daipaḥ pitvaṃ liṅgam; anyathā
hi lākṣaṇiktvādevāsya grahaṇaṃ na bhaviṣyati | "do dad ghoḥ" ityatra
ca "daḥ" ityetaddheṇnivṛtyarthaṃ satasya ghusaṃjñāṃ jñāpayati,
dadhātestu "dadhāterhiḥ" iti hyādeśāvidhānādeva
dadbhāvāprasaṅgaḥ | yadi "gāmādāgrahaṇeṣvaviśeṣaḥ" tarhi
arthavatparibhāṣāpi nivarteta, tatra ko doṣaḥ ? pranidārayati-atrāpi
prāpnoti | astu, ṇatvaṃ kasmānna bhavati ? "upasargāt" ityanuvartate,
sambandhiśabdaścāyamupasarga iti, tasmādevaṃ vijñāsyāmaḥ-gadādīnāṃ ya
upasargastatrasthānnimitādutarasya tāneva gadādīnpratyupasargasya
neriti | pranidārayatītyatra ca yaṃ pratyupasargo nāsau dārūpaḥ, yaśca
dārūpaḥ na taṃ pratyupasargaḥ, tasyānarthakatvād | ataḥ śityeva doṣaḥ |
upadeśasthānāṃ tvanukaraṇe dodeṅdheḍanukaraṇānāmapi "ādeca
upadeśeśiti" ityātvasadbhāvāteṣāṃ dāṇdāñdhāñāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ
siddhyati | ātvadhiṣaye'pyekadeśavikṛtasyānanyatvāt siddham |
sarveṣāṃ ca svarūpeṇānukriyamāṇatvāt
lakṣaṇapratipadoktayorniranubandhaketi ca paribhāṣayoranupasthānam,
nāpi pranidārayatītyatra prasaṅgaḥ, na hi "dīṅ"
ityetadanukaraṇasyātvamasti | kṛtātvamapi
kiñcinmātrasādharmyādanukaraṇaṃ na virudhyate, yathā gavityayamāheti
kṛtāvādeśamapi gośabdasyeti nirdoṣaṃ dvitīyaṃ
pakṣamāśrityāha-dārūpāścatvāra ityādi | evaṃ ca
dīṅe'nukaraṇasyātvābhāvāt tṛjādiṣu "mīnātiminotidīṅam"
ityātve dārūpasyāpi ghusaṃjñā na bhavati, pranidātā-ṇatvaṃ na bhavati |
upādāstāsya svaraḥ śikṣakasya-śthādhvoricca" itītvaṃ na bhavati |
kecitu saṃjñāmicchanti | teṣāmapyupādāstetyatra na bhavati, "
sannipātalakṣaṇo vidhiranimitaṃ tadvighātasya" iti |
ṭhpraṇidadātītyādau nergadeti ṇatvam | praṇidyatīti-"otaḥ śyani" | 
dātaṃ barhirati | lūnamityarthaḥ | ghusaṃjñāyā abhāvād "do dad ghoḥ
" iti na bhavati | avadātamityatra ca "aca upasargātaḥ" iti na bhavati |
nanu dābdaiporananukaraṇādeva na bhaviṣyati, asmadāyataṃ
khalvanukaraṇaṃ dāpdaiporna kariṣyāmaḥ, tanna; asati
tasminpratipadoktameva dādhārūpamanukaraṇaṃ gṛhyate | sati tu tasmin
yāvatāmanukaraṇaṃ dādhārūpaṃ sambhavati lākṣaṇikaṃ pratipadoktaṃ vā,
tāvatāṃ sarveṣāmanukaraṇaṃ bhavati | "udīcāṃ māṅe vyatīhāre" iti
ca meṅaḥ kṛtātvāsya nirddeśo
jñāpayati-ṅānubandhakṛtamanejantatvam" iti | na hi "māṅ māne"
ityasya vyatīhāre vṛttiḥ sambhavati, tena daipaḥ pakāre śrūyamāṇa
evātvaṃ bhavatīti adābiti pratiṣedho bhavati | saṃjñāpravṛttisamaye ca
yaddābrūpam, tasya pratiṣedha iti praṇidāpayatītyatra prageva pukaḥ
pravṛtāṃ ghusaṃjñāmāśritya ṇatvaṃ bhavati | "dādhā ghvapit" iti
vaktavyam, pit ghusaṃjño na bhavatīti | bakāro vā dvayoranubandhaḥ,
sūtramapi bakārāntameva paṭhitavyam | bhāṣyavārtikavirodhastu
mahāpadamañjaryāmasmābhiḥ prapañcitaḥ ||
ādyantavadekasmin || 1|1|21 ||
"dvandve ghi" ityetadvādhitvā "ajādyadantam " ityantaśabdasya pūrvanipātaḥ
prāpno'smādeva nirddeśānna bhavati | na cātyantabādhaḥ,
antādivacceti liṅgāt | asahāyasyetyādinā sūtrārambhasya
prayojanamāha | sati parasmin yasmātpūrvaṃ nāsti sa ādiḥ, sati ca
pūrvasminyasmātparaṃ nāsti so'ntaḥ, tadetadubhayamasahāye na
sambhavati | tasmādādyantayoryānyupadiṣṭāni uktāni kāryāṇi
tānyasahāyasyāpi yathā syurityayamārambhaḥ |
asahāyasyetyanenāsahāyavacana ekaśabdo na saṃkhyāvacana iti darśayati
| bahuṣvapi vyavasthitasyaikatvasaṃkhyāstīti "ekasmin" iti vyarthaṃ
syāditi bhāvaḥ | "ekasmin" ityupameye saptamīśravaṇādupamānasyāpi
saptamīsamarthatetyāha-saptamyarthe vatiriti | vartamānāditi śeṣaḥ |
"tatra tasyeva" iti ivārthe vatiḥ | pūrvaṃ tvasahāyasyeti ṣaṣṭhīnirdeśaḥ
saptamyarthasyaiva śeṣarūpavivakṣayā | kāryārthatvātsarvātideśānāṃ
prādhānyātkāryātideśo'yamityāha-kārye bhavatīti | |
ādyantavadvyapadeśo nimitam | "pūrvavatsanaḥ" iti tu nirmūlam,
vyapadeśātideśe hi kurute, kurve ityādau antavadvyapadeśe'pi
antyo'jādirasyetyevaṃ rūpasya bahuvrīhyarthasyābhāvāṭṭisaṃjñāyā
abhāve ṭeretvaṃ na syāt | kurvāte ityādau tu dṛṣṭasya
ṭeretvākhyasya kāryasyātideśe na doṣaḥ | ābhyāmiti | atra dve
antatve upayujyete-ākārāntasyāṅgasyālo'ntyasya dīrgha iti |
sabhāsannayana iti | asatyekagrahaṇe yatrādivyapadeśo nāsti
madhye'sahāye ca so'tideśasya viṣayaḥ |
"vṛddhiryasyācāmādistadvṛddham" ityatrādigrahaṇasyāpyetadeva
vyāvartyamiti vikalpaḥ syāt-kadācid vṛddhasaṃjñā, kadācinna iti |
tasmādākāramāśritya pakṣe vṛddhasaṃjñā na bhavatīti granthārthaḥ ||
taraptamapau ghaḥ || 1|1|22 ||

taraptamapau ghaḥ || 1|1|22 ||
tarateḥ "ṛdop" ityapi guṇe bhūtapūrveṇa pakāreṇa yadyapi tarabiti
rūpaṃ bhavati, tathāpi tamapā sāhacaryāt pratyayasyaiva grahaṇamityāha
--tarapatapau pratyayāviti | tena nadyāstaro nadītara iti hrasvo na
bhavati | atha vā tarabiti rūpāśraya saṃjñā, rūpanirgrahaśca prayoge
upadeśe vā | tatra na kvacitprayoge tarabiti rūpamastītyupadeśagataṃ
gṛhyate | na cātraupadeśikaṃ tarabrūpamasti, satyāmapi vā ghasaṃjñāyāṃ
na doṣaḥ, hrasvatvaṃ hi samānādhikaraṇe strīliṅge vidhīyate |
ātiśāyanikaprakaraṇa eva tādī ghaḥ, pitau gha iti vā kartavye
prakaraṇotkarṣeṇa saṃjñākaraṇamanyo'pi tarabastīti sūcanārtham, tena
"alpāctaram" "lopaśca balavataraḥ" ityādau svārthe tarap siddho
bhavati ||
bahugaṇavatuḍati saṃkhyā || 1|1|23 ||
yadyapi "vatuḍatī" iti saṃjñāvidhau pratyayagrahaṇam, tathāpi kevalayoḥ
pratyayayoḥ saṃjñāyāṃ prayojanābhāvāt tadantayoreva grahaṇam |
vahukṛtva ityādi-śaṃkhyāyāḥ krayābhyāvṛttigaṇane
kṛtvasuc,"śaṃkhyāyā vidhārthe dhā" "bahvalpārthāt" iti vartamāne
"saṃkhyaikavacanāt" iti śas | śaṃkhyāyā atiśadantāyāḥ kan" |
tāvatkṛtva iti-"yatadetebhyaḥ parimāṇe vatup", "ā sarvanāmnaḥ" |
katikṛtva iti--"kimaḥ saṃkhyāparimāṇe ḍati ca" |
bahugaṇaśabdayorityādi | kathaṃ punargahaṇaṃ nāsti ?
saṃkhyetyanvarthasaṃjñeyam saṃkhyāyate'nayeti saṃkhyeti | na ca yo
vaipulye bahuśabdaḥ--bahurodana iti, saṃkhyeye vā gaṇaśabdaḥ-ikṣūṇāṃ
gaṇa iti, nābhyāṃ saṃkhyāyate | yadi tarhi saṃkhyāvācinoreva grahaṇaṃ
kimarthaṃ tayoriha saṃjñā vidhīyate ! yāvatā saṃkhyāpradeśeṣu
laukikyapi saṃkhyā gṛhyate; anyathā pañcakaḥ, saptaka ityādau śaṃkhyāyā
atiśadantāyāḥ" iti kan na syāt,"atiśadantāyāḥ" iti ca
pratiṣedho'narthakaḥ syāt, śāstrīyāyāḥ saṃkhyāyāstiśadantāyā
abhāvādityata āha--bhūryādīnāmityādi | etena
niyamārthametayorgrahaṇamiti darśayati | tulyajātīyāpekṣatvācca
niyamasya; bhūryādīnāmevāniyatabahutvācināṃ nivṛttiḥ,
nābahutvaviṣayayordvyekaśabdayoḥ, nāpi niyatabahutvavācināṃ
tryādīnām, tadāha--bhūryādīnāmiti |
aghapūrvapadaśceti | ardhaśabdaḥ pūrvapadaṃ yasya, sa ca pūraṇapratyāntaḥ;
pūraṇapratyayāntasyārdhaśabdaḥ pūrvapadaṃ sambhavati, samāsa eva hi
pūrvapadaṃ sambhavati | arghapañcamaśūpa iti | ardha pañcamaṃ yeṣāmiti
vahuvrīhiḥ | ardhapañcamairardhādhikaiścaturbhiḥ śūrpaiḥ krīta iti
"taddhitārtha" iti samāsaḥ | "śūrpādañanyatarasyām" iti vihita
syāñaṣṭhaño vā "adhyardhapūrvadvigoḥ" iti luk | kathaṃ punarluk,
yāvatā nāyaṃ samāsaḥ nāpi kan ? samāsakanvidhyarthamiti
sambandhasāmānye ṣaṣṭhī, tena samāse vidhīyamāne samāsanimite
vānyasminvidhīyamāna ityarthaḥ |
ṣṇāntā ṣaṭ || 1|1|24 ||
iha kasmānna bhavati-vipruṣaḥ, pāmāna iti ? saṅkhyeti vartate | nanu
ca tatsaṅkhyāgrahaṇaṃ saṃjñāpradhānam, ihānuvṛtamapi ṣṇāntānāṃ
saṃjñāmeva vidadhyād, na tu ṣṇāntetyasya viśeṣyaṃ samarpabhed; ata
āha--strīliṅganirdeśāditi | "ṣṇāntā" ityatra strīliṅgasya
viśeṣyāpekṣāyāṃ sambadhyamānaṃ pradeśeṣviva saṃjñipradhāne
bhaviṣyatītyarthaḥ | ata evātrāntagrahaṇam | itarathā varṇagrahaṇe sarvatra
tadantavidhirityeva siddham |
iha kasmānna bhavati-śatāni, sahasrāṇi ? numi kṛte tasya
pūrvabhaktatvānnāntā saṅkhyā bhavati | astu, lukkasmānna bhavati ?
sarvanāmasthānasannipātakṛto num na tad vihanti | atheha kathaṃ
saṃjñā-aṣṭānāmiti ? kathaṃ ca na syāt ? aṣṭan a ām iti sthite
paratvānnityatvācca "aṣṭana ā vibhaktau" ityātve
kṛte'nāntatvādasatyāṃ saṃmajñāyāṃ nuḍ na syāt, aṣṭano
dīrghagrahaṇaṃ jñāpakam-kṛtātvasyāpyaṣṭanaḥ saṃjñā bhavatīti | etacca
tatraivopapādayiṣyāmaḥ | yadvā, prāgeva vibhaktyutpateranuddiśya
prayojanaviśeṣaṃ ṣaṭsaṃjñā bhaviṣyati | sā ca kṛte'pyātve na
nivartate ||
ḍati ca || 1|1|25 ||
ḍatyantā ca yā saṃkhyeti | anena saṃkhyāgrahaṇānuvṛttiṃ darśayati |
asatyāṃ hyanuvṛtau pāterḍatiḥ patayaḥ-atrāpi syāt | atheha
saṃkhyāgrahaṇānuvṛtāvapi kasmādevātra na bhavati, sāmānyena hi ḍateḥ
saṃkhyāsaṃjñā vihitā ? ucyate; saṃkhyāsaṃjñāyāṃ hi vatunā
sāhacaryātaddhitasya ḍatergrahaṇam, na tvauṇādikasya ||
ktaktavatū niṣṭhā || 1|1|26 ||
iha ktaktavaturūpāśrayeyaṃ saṃjñā, rūpanirgrahaśca prayoge upadeśe vā
bhavati | na ca prayoge sānubandhakaṃ rūpamastītyupadeśagataṃ grāhyam |
tatra ṅapuṃsake bhāve ktaḥ" "ñītaḥ" iti ktasya kvacidupadeśo'sti |
yadi tasyaiva syād, liṅgāntare,kālāntare dhātvantare ca na syāt
| ktavatostu na kvacidupadeśaḥ, tatkenavihitayoḥ ktaktavatvoreṣā
saṃjñā vidhīyate ? anayaiva saṃjñayā | vakṣyati--niṣṭheti | yadyevam,
itaretarāśrayaḥ prāpnoti-vihitayoḥ saṃjñā, saṃjñayā ca vidhānamiti,
naiṣa doṣaḥ; bhāvinī saṃjñā vijñāyate sūtraśāṭakavat |
tadyathā-kaścitkañcit tantuvāyamāha-asya sūtrasya śāṭakaṃ vayeti | sa
paśyati-yadi śāṭako na vātavyaḥ; atha vātavyo na śāṭakaḥ; śāṭako
vātavyaśceti vipratiṣiddham; sa manye vātavyo yasminnute śāṭaka
ityetadbhavatīti | tadvadihāpi tau bhūte kāle bhavataḥ,
yayorvihitayorniṣṭhetyeṣā saṃjñā bhaviṣyatīti ||
sarvādīni sarvanāmāni || 1|1|27 ||
dvandvatatpuruṣayorutarapadaliṅgatvena napuṃsakatvāyogād
bahuvacanāsaṃbhavācca sarvādīnīti bahuvrīhirityāha-sarvaśabda
ityādi | ādiryeṣāmiti | yadyevaṃ
bahuvrīheranyapadārthapradhānatvātsarvaśabdopalakṣitānāṃ
viśvādīnāmeva saṃjñā syād, nopalakṣaṇasya sarvaśabdasya | yathā
citragurānīyatāmityukte asya tā gāvaḥ sa evānīyate, na citrā gāva
ityāśaṅkyāha-tānīmārnati | atra "tāni" ityeva siddhe imānīti
pratyakṣaviṣayeṇedaṃśabdena gaṇapaṭhiteṣu sarvaśabdasyāntarbhāvaṃ
sūcayan tadguṇasaṃvijñānaṃ bahuvrīhiṃ darśayati | tasya u
anyapadārthasya, guṇaḥuvartipadārthaḥ, so'pi kāryī saṃvijñāyate
yasmin bahuvrīhau sa tadguṇasaṃvijñānaḥ | matvarthe hi bahuvrīhiḥ |
bhūmādiṣu ca matub vidhīyate | tadyatra svasvāmibhāvādisambandhaḥ
pravṛttinimitam, na tatropasarjanasya kāryayogaḥ |
yathā-gomantamānayeti, saṃbhavati hyaraṇyāvasthitābhirapi gobhiḥ
svasvāmibhāvaḥ | yatra tu saṃyogasamavāyayo ranyatarat
pravṛttinimitam, tatra svabhāvādevopasarjanasyāpi kāryoyogaḥ,
yathā-daṇḍinamānaya, viṣāṇinamānayeti , no khalu gṛhāvasthitena
daṇḍena daṇḍasaṃyuktaḥ puruṣo bhavati | evaṃ bahuvrīhāvapi-citraguḥ,
śuklavāsā iti | ihāpyādiśabdo'vayavavacana udbhūtāvayavabhedaḥ
samudāyaḥ samāsārthaḥ, tatra samudāyasya yugapallakṣye
prayogābhāvatadantarbhūtānāṃ saṃjñā bhavantī viśvādīnāmiva
sarvaśabdasyāpi bhaviṣyati | atra ca liṅgam-"adaḥ sarveṣām" iti
nirdeśaḥ, "āmi sarvanāmnaḥ suṭ" | sarve iti--"jasaḥ śīḥ |
pūrvayostūpanyāso jasantatāmasya darśayitum | sarvasmai
ityādi--śarvanāmnaḥ sme" "ṅasiṅyoḥ smātsinau" |
ubhaśabdo dvivacanaviṣaye eva prayujyate, asati dvivacane naiva
prayujyate, na hi bhavati ubhau putrāvasya ubhaputra iti ubhayaśabdo'tra
tatsthāne bhavati ubhayaputra ityādi | na ca dvivacane
kiñcitsarvanāmakāryamasti;
smaiprabhṛtīnāmekavacanabahuvacanaviṣayatvāt, kākacośca nāsti
viśeṣa iti tasyeha pāṭhe prayojanamāha-ubhaśabdasyetyādi | ubhābhyāṃ
hetubhyām,ubhayorhetvoriti tṛtīyāṣaṣṭhayau bhavataḥ |
ubhayeṣām, ubhayasminniti | ubhāvavayavāvasyeti vyutpādyamāna
ubhayaśabdo yadā tirohitāvayavabhedaṃ samudāyamācaṣṭe tadaikavacanaṃ
bhavati-ubhayo maṇiriti | yadā tu vargadvayārabdhe samudāyini
vartamāno vargyabhedānugataṃ samudāyamācaṣṭe tadā
bahuvacanam-ubhaye devamanuṣyā iti |
ḍatara-ḍatameti | saṃjñāvidhau pratyayagrahaṇe'pi tadantayorgrahaṇam;
kevalayoḥ prayojanābhāvāt |
vakṣyamāṇeneti | "prathamacaram" ityādinā | sarvaśabdaparyāyasyeti |
asti ca sarvaśabdaparyāsaḥ samaśabdaḥ ṅabhantāmanyake same","mā no
vṛkāya vṛkye samasmai","uruṣyāṇo'ghāyataḥ samasmāt", "uto
samasminnāśiśī hi no vaso," "mā naḥ samasya dūḍhayaḥ" iti yathā |
etacca śarveṣāṃ nāmāni" ityanvarthasaṃjñākaraṇāllabhyate | sa eva hi
samaśabdaḥ sarveṣāṃ nāma bhavati yaḥ sarvaśabdaparyāyaḥ | yadyanvarthasaṃjñā,
"pūrvapadāt saṃjñāyām" iti ṇatvaṃ kasmānna bhavati ? asmādeva
nipātanāt | yadi śarvādoti sarvanāmāni",tarhīhāpi
prāpnoti-sarvo nāma kaścit tasmai sarvāya dehīti, iha cātikrāntaḥ
sarvasmai atisarvāya dehīti; tasmātsaṃjñānāmupasarjanānāṃ ca
sarvādīnāṃ saṃjñāpratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ | na kevalaṃ saṃjñāyāḥ, pāṭho'pi
teṣāṃ gaṇe nāstīti vaktavyam; saṃjñāmātrapratiṣedhe hi
sarvanāmaprayuktameva kāryaṃ teṣāṃ na syāt | pāṭhāśrayaṃ tu
syādeva--"tyadādīnāmaḥ" tannāmakaḥ kaścit,tatsa,tadau, tadaḥ;
atikrāntastamatitat, atitadau, atitadaḥ; "adaḍḍatarādibhyaḥ
pañcabhyaḥ", kataramatikrāntaṃ brāhmaṇakulamatikataramiti |
saṃjñāpratiṣedhastāvanna vaktavyaḥ |
abhivyaktapadārthā ye svatantrā lokaviśrutāḥ |
śāstrārthasteṣu kartavyaḥ śabdeṣu na taduktiṣu ||
tatra yathā bāhurnāma kaścitasyāpatyaṃ bāhavaḥ, "bāhvādibhyaśca" itīñ
na bhavati saṃjñā, śvaśurasyāpatyam "rājaśvaśurādyat" na bhavati,
dhānyamātuḥ svasā, "mātupitṛbhyāṃ svāsā" iti ṣatvaṃ na bhavati;
evamihāpi saṃjñābhūtānāṃ sarvādīnāṃ saṃjñā, tannibandhanaṃ ca kāryam,
antargaṇakāryaṃ ca na bhaviṣyati |
yadvā-"vyavasthāyām" ityatra "asaṃjñāyām" iti vibhajyate, tena ca
gaṇapāṭho viśeṣyate-yānyetānyanukrāntāni sarvādīni
tānyasaṃjñāyāṃ draṣṭavyānīti | upasaṃrjanapratiṣedho'pi na kartavyaḥ,
sarvādīnāṃ saṃjñā vidhīyate, tatra kaḥ prasaṅgo yat sarvādyantasya
syāt ? sarvaśabdasya tu satyāmapi saṃjñāyāmaṅgasyāsarvanāmatvāt
smāyādyaprasaṅgaḥ | yadyevam, paramasarvasmai ityādāvapi na syād;
yato yadaṅgaṃ na tatsarvanāma, yacca sarvanāma na tadaṅgamiti | mā
bhūdaṅgaṃ sarvanāma, tāvayavasyaiva tu sravanāmatve "aṅgādhikāre
tasya ca tadutarapadasya ca" iti samudāyasya ca kāryaṃ bhaviṣyati;
yathā--asthyādīnāmanaṅ paramāsthneti | na
caivamatyasthnetyādivadatisarvāyetyādāvupasarjane'pi
prasaṅgo'rthadvārakasya sambandhasyāśrayaṇātsarvanāmārthagatamekatvādikaṃ
yā vimaktirāheti; yathā-"aṣṭābhya auś" "ṣaḍbhyo luk" iti
paramāṣṭau paramapañcetyādau bhavati, priyāṣṭānaḥ priyapañcāna
