ityādau na bhavati; tadvadatrāpi | "tyadādīnāmaḥ"
ityādyantargaṇakāryamapyevameva draṣṭavyam | yatu rūpāśrayaṃ kāryam
"yuṣmadasmadoranādeśe" iti, na pāṭhāśrayam, nāpi saṃjñāśrayaṃ
tadasthyādyanaṅvadupasarjanae'pi bhavati | yatūpasarjanadaśāyāḥ prāgeva
prāptaṃ tadapi bhavati atikrānto bhavakantamatibhavakāniti,
tasmānnārthastadantasya saṃjñayā, ucyate; avyayasarvanāmnāmityakac
paramabhavakāniti tadantānna syāt | "pañcamyāstasil" paramasarvataḥ,
"saptamyāstral" paramasarvatra,"ā sarvanāmnaḥ" "viṣvagdevayośca
ṭeradra|lñcatau vapratyaye" paramatadra|lṅ paramayadra|lṅtyādiu na
syāditi tadantasya saṃjñeṣitavyā | kathaṃ punariṣyamaṇāpi labhyate ?
jñāpakāditi vakṣyāmaḥ | tatadantasya ca bhavantī paramasarvādivad
atisarvāderapi syāditi upasarjanapratiṣedho'pi vaktavyaḥ ? na
vaktavyaḥ, anvarthasaṃjñāvijñānādeva siddham | vṛtau hi
pradhānārthasaṃsargādupasarjanāni na sarvārthāni, yathāsambhavaṃ ca
sārvārthyāmiti pratyakṣaparokṣatādiviṣeṣavācitve'pi
tadidamādīnāṃ bhavatyeva | anvarthatvādeva ca saṃjñābhūtānāmapi
saṃjñābhāvaḥ | evaṃ tāvatsaṃjñānibandhanaṃ smāyādyaupasarjanānāṃ
nibāritam | tyadādyantargaṇakāryaṃ tu syādeva; pāṭhasya sthitatvāt |
evaṃ tarhi tantrāvṛtyekaśeṣāṇāmanyatamāśrayaṇād dvitīyo'pi
sarvanāmaśabda upātaḥ, tena pāṭho viśeṣyate-yāni sarveṣāṃ nāmāni
tāni sarvādīnīti, tena sarvādipāṭhopajīvanena
pravartamānamantargaṇakāryamapi vyavasthāsyate | yadvā-saṃjñāyā
anvarthatvātatatsaṃbandhayogyānāṃ sarvārthānāṃ
tāvatpāṭho'vaśyābhyupagantavyaḥ | tataśca prakārāntarajuṣāṃ pāṭhe
pramāṇābhāvādeva siddhaḥ pāṭhātparyudāsaḥ ||
vibhāṣā diksamāse bahuvrīhau || 1|1|28 ||
atra samāsāvayavānāṃ sarvādīnāṃ saṃjñā vikalpyata ita vṛtau lakṣyate,
yathāha- digupadiṣṭa ityādi | diśāmupadiṣṭa ukte
"diṅnāmānyatarāle" ityasminsamāse'vayavatvena vartamānānītyarthaḥ
| na cāvayavānāṃ saṃjñāvikalpe kiñcitprayojanamasti, smāyādikaṃ
tāvadaṅgāśrayam, kākacośca nāsti viśeṣaḥ,
digvācināmakārāntatvāt | śarvanāmno vṛttimātre" iti
pūrvapadasya puṃvadbhāvoṣa'pi na prayojanam, tatra hi mātragrahaṇaṃ
kvacitsarvanāmatvena dṛṣṭānāṃ saṃpratyasarvanāmatve'pi yathā syāt,
tathā ca dakṣiṇapūrvāyā iti saṃjñābhāvapakṣe'pi bhavati |
syādetat--avayavānāmeva saṃjñā, kāryaṃ tu "aṅgādhikāre tasya ca
tadutarapadasya ca" iti | evamapi dakṣiṇapūrvataḥ, dakṣiṇapūrvatratyatra
tasilādayo na syuḥ; tasmātsarvādyante bahuvrīhau saṃjñā vikalpyate |
"sarvādīni" ityayaṃ tu vṛttigranthaḥ śarvādyante pravartamānā saṃjñā
sarvādīnyapi gocarayati" ityevaṃparo vyākhyeyaḥ | yadvā--avayavānāṃ
saṃjñāvidhānena tadantasyāpi siddhyati, tadantavidherabhyupagamāditi
|
samāsagrahaṇaṃ kimiti | na bahuvrīhiḥ samāsatvaṃ vyabhicaratīti praśnaḥ
| dakṣiṇadakṣiṇasyai iti | "ekaṃ bahuvrīhivat" ityanuvṛtau "ābādhe
ca" iti dakṣiṇaśabdasya dvirvacanam ṅa bahuvrīhau" ityayamapi niṣedho
na bhavati, tatrāpi samāsādhikārāt | dakṣiṇotarapūrvākaṇāmiti |
asati bahuvrīhigrahaṇe yathā ṅa bahuvrīhau" iti pratiṣedhaṃ bādhate,
evaṃ "dvandve ca" ityetamapi bādheta | atha kriyamāṇa'pi bahuvrīhigrahaṇe
yā pūrvā sotarā yasyonmugdhasya tasmai pūrvotarāya dehītyatra
kasmānna bhavati ? pratipadokto yo
diksamāsaḥ-"diṅnāmānyantarāle" iti, tasya grahaṇam | yadyevam,
tata eva hetordvandve na bhaviṣyati ? satyam; utarārthamavaśyaṃ kartavyaṃ
bahuvrīhigrahaṇamihāpi vispaṣṭārthaṃ bhaviṣyatīti manyate ||
na bahuvrīhau || 1|1|29 ||
atra vṛtau dvidhā sūtrārtho lakṣyate--bahuvrīhāviti
niṣedhādhikaraṇam-bahuvrīhi saṃjñā na bhavati, bahuvrīhyādhārā saṃjñā na
bhavatīti; bahuvrīheḥ saṃjñā na bhavatīti | sarvādyadhikaraṇaṃ
vā--bahuvrīhau yāni sarvādīni tāni sarvanāmasaṃjñāni na bhavantīti
| tatra sarvanāmasaṃjñāyām ityādinā''dyaṃ pakṣaṃ dvitīyaṃ sūtrārthaṃ
darśayati | kathaṃ punarjñāyate'bhyupagatastadantavidhiriti ? ata eva
niṣedhāt | dvitīyaṃ sūtrārthaṃ darśayati--bahuvrīhāvityādi |
prathamasyodāharaṇamāha--priyaviśvāyeti |
"sarvanāmasaṃkhyayorupasaṃkhyānam" iti sarvanāmnaḥ pūrvanipāte
prāpte "vā priyayasya" iti priyaśabdasya pūrvanipātaḥ | dvyanyāyeti
| śarvanāmasaṃkhyayoḥ" iti dvyanyayoḥ pūrvanipāte prāpte
paratvāt saṅkhyāyāḥ pūrvanipātaḥ | dvitīyasyodaharaṇamāha--iha
ceti | atra ca pratiṣedho'yamārabhyata ityanuṣaṅgaḥ; atrāsati
niṣedhe'kaci sati tvakatpitṛko makatpitṛka iti prāpnoti, sati
tu "prāgivātkaḥ" iti ke sati "pratyayotarapadayośca" iti
tvamādeśayostvatkapitṛko matkapitṛka iti siddhyati ṅadyaḥtaśca"
iti samāsānte kapi | nanu ca bahuvrīhāvayaṃ niṣedhaḥ, iha ca prāgeva;
tatastvakaṃ patā'syi ahakaṃ pitā'syeti vākyāvasthāyāmevākac
prāpnoti ? evaṃ tarhi pratiṣedhasāmarthyāt yadvākyopamardeana
bahuvrīhirbhavati tasyāmevāvasthāyāṃ niṣedho bhaviṣyati | atra ca
prathamaḥ sūtrārthastadantavivijñāpanāyaivopanyastaḥ, na tu
priyaviśvāyetyādau samudāyasya saṃjñāprasaṅgaḥ; asarvārthatvāt, yathā
atisarvāyetyādau |
bahuvrīhāviti vartamāne punarbuhuvrīhigrahaṇaṃ
kimarthamityāha--bahuvrīhāvityādi vastrāntaravasanāntarā iti |
vasanamantaraṃ yeṣāmiti bahuvrīhau dvandvaḥ | atrāsati
bahuvrīhigrahaṇe vartamānadvandvāśrayo niṣedhaḥ syāt, tataśca jasi
vibhāṣā syāt | punarbahuvrīhigrahakaṇātu yadanto dvandvaḥ,
so'ntaraśabdo bahuvrīheḥ pūrvamatrāsīd iti bahuvrīhyāśrayo nitya
eva niṣedho bhavati | idaṃ tu "tadantasya saṃjñāniṣedha" iti
prathamapakṣānurodhena pratyudāharaṇam | na tvatra prasaṅgaḥ;
asarvārthatvāt | vasantyasminniti vasanaṃ gṛham, tena
"virūpāṇāmapi samānārthānām" ityekaśeṣābhāvaḥ ||
tṛtīyāsamāse || 1|1|30 ||
samāse iti, vartamāne ityādi | mukhyasyaiva grahaṇe prāpte
gauṇasyāpi grahaṇārthaṃ punaḥ samāsagrahaṇamityarthaḥ | na ca
tṛtīyāsamāsamātrārthe vākye prasaṅga ityāha--pūrvasadṛśetyādi |
etacca lakṣaṇapratipadoktaparibhāṣayā labhyate | tvayakā, mayaketi |
"yuṣmadasmadostṛtīyaikavacane","tvamāvekavacane", "yo'ci"
subantayoḥ prāk ṭerakac ||
dvandve ca || 1|1|31 ||
ayaṃ samudāyasyaiva niṣedho nāvayavānām, kutaḥ ? tyādādīnāṃ
tāvat "tyadādīni sarvairnityam" iti ekaśeṣeṇa bhāvyam, prāk ca
tyādādibhyo'kārāntāḥ,tatra na kākacorviśeṣaḥ; śarvanāmno
vṛttimātre puṃvadbhāvaḥ" tviṣyata eva-dakṣiṇotarapūrvāṇāmiti,
so'yaṃ pratiṣedho jñāpayati-"asti sarvanāmasaṃjñāyāṃ tadantavidhiḥ"
iti ||
vibhāṣā jasi || 1|1|32 ||
jasaḥ kārya prati vibhāṣeti | tat katham ? vyavasthitavibhāṣeyam |
yadvā, jasīti kāryāpekṣayādhikaraṇasaptamī--jasādhāraṃ yatkāryaṃ
śībhāvākhyaṃ tatra kartavya iti | anye tvāhuḥ- jasa ī jasī
śabdarūpāpekṣayā napuṃsakahrasvatve saptamyā lukā nirdeśaḥ-jasa īkāre
kartavya iti | kiṃ punaḥ kārakaṇamevaṃ vyākhyāyate ?
tatrāha--akajhīti | hi śabdo yasmādarthe | yadyaviśeṣeṇa vikalpaḥ
syāt, katara katama as iti sthite kutsādyarthavivakṣāyāṃ
yasyāmavasthāyāmakajvidhiṃ prati saṃjñā syāt, tataśca
tanmadhyapatitatvātadgrahaṇe śībhāvaḥ syāt; ke tu sati na bhavati ||
prathamacaramatayālpārdhakatipayanemāśca || 1|1|33 ||
ubhayaśabdasyetyādi | ubhāvavayavāvasya "ubhādudāto nityam" iti
tayapo'yajādeśaḥ | sthānivadbhāvādbhavatyayaṃ tayabantaḥ, tathāpi
gaṇe pāṭhād nityaiva saṃjñā bhavati | nanu gaṇe
pāṭhasyobhayasminnubhayeṣāmityādiravakāśaḥ, iha tayabgrahaṇasya
dvitaye dvitayā iti, ubhayaśabdājjasyubhayaprasaṅge paratvādiyameva
vibhāṣā prāpnoti, naiṣa doṣaḥ; antaraṅgā nityā saṃjñā
vibhaktyanapekṣatvāditi saiva pravartate |
kākacoryathāyogaṃ vṛttiriti | nemaśabde'kaco vṛttiḥ, anyeṣu
kasyetyeṣa yathāyogārthaḥ | kaḥ panardoṣo nemaśabde, yadi jasaḥ
kāryaṃ prati na syāt, pakṣe ko'pi syāt ? astu; nemake,
nemakāḥ"-nitye'pyakaci tasya tadgrahaṇena grahaṇādasmin vikalpe
sati etadrūpadvayaṃ bhavatyeva, satyam; prathamādiṣu pakṣe'kajna
bhavatītyevamparo granthaḥ ||
pūrvaparāvaradakṣiṇotarāparādharāṇi vyavasthāyāmasaṃjñāyām || 1|1|34
||
asaṃjñāyāmiti | saṃjñāyāmasatyām, pūrvādayaścetsaṃjñārūpā na
bhavantītyarthaḥ | vyavasthā u niyamaḥ, sa cātrārthādavadhyapekṣa
ityāha-svāmidheyāpekṣa ityādi | pūrvādīnāṃ śabdānāṃ svābhidheyo
digdeśakālasvabhāvo'rthastamapekṣate, tena vāpekṣyate yaḥ sa
svābhidheyāpekṣaḥ | avadhiḥ u maryādā; pūrvadeśasya yatpūrvatvaṃ
tatparadeśamapekṣya bhavati, parasyāpi yatparatvaṃ tatpūrvadeśam | evaṃ
dikkālayorapi draṣṭavyam |
tasmātpūrvādiśabdavācyo'rtho'vaśyamavadhiṃ kañcidapekṣya bhavati | tatra
yo'yamapekṣāyā niyamaḥ sā vyavastheti tāvadvivakṣitam | tasyāṃ
gamyamānāyāṃ pūrvādiśabdānāṃ svābhidheya eva vartamānānāmiyaṃ
saṃjñā bhavati, na tu vācyāyām |
pravīṇā ityartha iti | anena vyavasthābhāvamāha | na hi pravīṇaśabda
sāpekṣamarthamācaṣṭe | satyāmeva vyavasthāyāmityanenānvarthatāṃ
darśayati | sumerumavadhimapekṣya kuruṣūtaraśabdo vartate, atra jasaḥ
kāryaṃ pratīti noktam; viśeṣābhāvāt ||
svamajñātidhanākhyāyām || 1|1|35 ||
ajñātidhanākhyāyāmityasyārthamāha-na cedityādi | yatra
śabdāntaranirapekṣaḥ svaśabdo jñātidhane svarūpeṇācaṣṭe tatrāsau
saṃjñārūpeṇa pravartate | ātmāyā ityartha iti | putrāṇāṃ gavāṃ satyapi
jñātidhanatve na tenākāreṇa tatra vartate, kintvātmīyākāreṇetyarthaḥ
| ākhyāgrahaṇe tvasati jñātidhanayoḥ paryavasānādatrāpi prāpnoti |
dhūmāyanta ityādi | yatholmukānyaśliṣṭāni asaṃhatāni dhūmāyante,
saṃhatāni prajvalanti; tadvat jñātayo'pītyarthaḥ | svā jñātaya iti |
svaśabdasyānekārthasya vyaktīkaraṇāya paryāyasyāpi jñātiśabdasya
prayogaḥ, sa eva tu na prayuktaḥ; niraṅkuśāḥ kavivāca iti ||
antaraṃ bahiryogopasaṃvyānayoḥ || 1|1|36 ||
bahirityanāvṛto deśa ucyate | bahirityanena yogo bahiryoga
itītiśabdādhyāhāreṇa vigṛhya samāsaḥ | sa cānāvṛtasya bāhyasya
vastuno bhavati | upasaṃvīyate vidhīyate
vāso'ntareṇetyupasaṃvyānam, karmaṇi lyuṭ | nagarabāhyā iti |
bahiryogaṃ darśayati | paridhānīyamantarvāsaḥ, prāvaraṇīyaṃ bahirvāsaḥ
| antare tāpasa iti | atra saṃjñābhāvād ṇeóḥ sminna bhavati | "jasi" iti
vartamāne kathaṃ saptamāntaṃ pratyudāharaṇe dīyata ityata
āha--gaṇasūtrasya cetyāda | gaṇasūtramapyevameva paṭha|lte |
kasmātpunaraprastutasya gaṇasūtrasya pratyudāharaṇaṃ dīyate, na sūtrasya ?
"apurīti vaktavyam" iti vakṣyati, tad gaṇasūtraviṣayaṃ yathā
syāditi; tasyāyaṃ prastāvaḥ | sūtrasyāpyanayā diśā pratyudāharaṇaṃ
gamyata iti na pṛthagdarśitam | antarāyāmiti |
prākārādvahirvartinyāmityarthaḥ | yadyapi gaṇasūtre'ntaraśabdaḥ paṭha|lte,
tathāpi tasyaiva sarvanāmatvāt ṭāpā sahaikādeśo'pi tadgrahaṇena
gṛhyata taiti syāt prasaṅgaḥ | liṅgaviśiṣṭaparibhāṣayā vā
ṭābantasyaiva saṃjñāprasaṅge vacanam | vibhāṣāprakaraṇa ityādi |
yathāyamarthaḥ siddhyati, tathā "vibhāṣā dvitīyātṛtīyābhyām" ityatra
vakṣyāmaḥ ||
svarādinipātamavyayam || 1|1|37 ||
tasilādiriti | "pañcamyāstasil" ityārabhya "edhācca" ityetadantaḥ |
śastasī -- "bahvalpārthācchas", pratiyoge "pañcamyāstasiḥ" |
saṃkhyāyāḥ "kriyābhyāvṛttigaṇane kṛtvasuc","dvitricaturbhyaḥ suc" |
āsthālāviti | "iṇa āsiḥ" ayāḥ,"pratnapūrva"-tvaṃ pratnathāḥ |
cvyarthāḥ-śaṃpadyakartari cviḥ""vibhāṣāsātiḥ kārtsye","deye trā
ca", amu cacchandasi","kimetiṅvyayaghādāmu" | nipātā vakṣyanta iti |
atha kimarthaṃ svarādīnāṃ pṛthaggrahaṇaṃ kriyate, te cādiṣveva
paṭha|leram ? na; cādīnāmasatvavacanānāṃ nipātasaṃjñā, svarādīnāṃ
punaḥ satvavacanānāmasatvavacanānāṃ cāvyayasaṃjñā-svasti vācayati,
svaḥ praśyeti | kriyāsambandhe'nekaśaktidarśanāt satvavācitvam | atha
"prāgrīśvarānnipātāḥ svarādīni cādayo'satve" ityevaṃ sūtranyāsaḥ
kriyeta, kaḥ punaratra viśeṣastatra vā svarādigrahaṇaṃ kriyeta ? atra vā ?
kiṃ ca ṅipāta ekājanāṅ" iti pragṛhyasaṃjñā svarādīnāmapyekācāṃ
prasajyeta-"kimo't","dakṣiṇādāc", "ekācca taddhitaḥ";
kenprabhṛtayastu kṛta ekācassanti | atha "cādirekājanāṅ" iti
kriyate tadā cādīnāmasatvavacanatvaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ na labhyate ? naiṣa
doṣaḥ; "cādayo'satve" ityatrāsatvāgrahaṇaṃ cādīnāṃ pāṭhaviśeṣaṇam,
yathā-"tiṅe gotrādīni" ityatra kutsanābhīkṣṇyagrahaṇaṃ gotrādīnām,
tena yatra yatra cādigrahaṇaṃ tatra sarvatra viśiṣṭanāmeva grahaṇam,
tatrāyamapyarthaḥ--"ubhe saṃjñe na kartavaṃye bhavataḥ-avyayam, nipātaḥ"
iti | katham ? "prāgrīśvarānnipātāḥ" iti vā "avyayāni" iti vā sūtraṃ
kartavyam, tataḥ svarādīni "taddhitaścāsarvavibhaktiḥ" yāvad
"avyayībhāvaśca" iti, tataḥ "cādayo'satve" ityārabhya yāvad
"adhirīśvare", vibhāṣā kṛñi" iti; tatra yasmin pradeśe nipātagrahaṇaṃ
tatra cādigrahaṇamastu, avyayapradeśeṣvavyayagrahaṇaṃ nipātagrahaṇaṃ ceti,
tatu tathā na kṛtamityeva |
avyayamityanvarthasaṃjñati | sadṛśam ityādi | śrutiśceyamātharvaṇī
praṇavavidyāyāṃ triṣu liṅgeṣu strīpunnapuṃsakeṣu sadṛśam,
liṅgaviśeṣapratipādane'sāmarthyāt | vibhaktiṣvati | kārakeṣu
vacaneṣviti | ekatvādisaṃkhyāsu, avyayībhāvasya
śaktilirṅgaviśeṣayoge'pi vacanādavyayatvam"yasmānna vyeti nānā
na gacchati yatvadharmānna gṛhṇātītyarthastatasmādavyayam" iti |
yacchabdarūpaṃ na vyeti tadavyayamiti vā | kiṃ punaḥ
prayojanamanvarthasaṃjñākaraṇe ? upasarjjanapratiṣedhaḥ-atyuccaisau,
atyuccaisa iti | atikrāntapradhānasyātra satvadharmaparigrahāt uccaiḥśabdaḥ
paṭha|lte, kaḥ prasaṅgastadantasya ? etaj
jñāpayatyācāryaḥ--"astyavyayasaṃjñāyāṃ tadantavidhiḥ" iti | tena
paramasvaḥ, paramoccairiti svarādiprādhānye tadantasyāpi bhavati |
kuśabdaḥ svarādiṣu paṭhitavyo'vyayasaṃjñārthaḥ ||
taddhitaścāsarvavibhaktiḥ || 1|1|38 ||
iha yadyapi saṃjñāvidhau pratyayagrahaṇe tadantavidhipratiṣedhastathāpi
kevalasya taddhitasya saṃjñāyāḥ prayojanābhāvāt tadantavidhirvijñāyata
ityāha-taddhitāntaḥ śabda iti | akac tāvatprātipadikasya subantasya vā
vidhīyate | "avyayādāpsupaḥ" ityatrāpyavyayādvihitasya supo luk,
na tu parasya; atyuccaisāvityādāvapi prasaṅgāt | "tatpuruṣe
tulyārtha",ṅāvyayadikcchabda","khityanavyayasya" ityatrāpi
pūrvapadasyāvyayasya grahaṇam | sarvā vibhaktiryasya sambandhinī na
bhavati so'sarvavibhaktiḥ |
kiṃ punaridaṃ taddhitasya vaśeṣaṇam ? āhosvitadāntasya ? kathañcedaṃ
taddhitasya viśeṣaṇam, kathaṃ vā tadantasya ? yadi sarvā vibhaktiryasya
sambandhinī na bhavati--kāraṇatvena yasyotpatau sarvā vibhaktiḥ kāraṇaṃ
na bhavati, yathā "pañcamyāstasil" ityādāviti kāryamanyapadārthaḥ,
tadā taddhitasya viśeṣaṇaṃ bhavati--taddhitasyaiva hyutpattirna tadantasya |
evaṃviśiṣṭena taddhitena tadantavidhau-tādṛśataddhitānto'vyayamityartho
bhavati | atha tu sarvā vibhaktiryasya kāryatvena sambandhinī na
bhavati-yasmātsarvā vibhaktirnotpadyata iti kāraṇamanyapadārthaḥ, tadā
tadantasāya viśeṣaṇaṃ bhavati | na hi
taddhitamātrādvibhaktiyutpattiprasaṅgaḥ | tatra pūrvasmin pakṣe vinā,
nānetyatra na syād; na hi vinañbhyamāmityatra pratiniyatā
kācidvibhaktirāśrīyata iti sarvavibhaktyantābhyāṃ vinañbhyāṃ nānāñau
bhavataḥ | avyayebhyastu niḥ saṅkhyebhyaḥ sāmānyavihitāḥ svādayo
vidyanta eveti pakṣe ye'pi bhavadādiprayoge tasilādayo
vidhīyanta--"itarābhyoṣa'pi dṛśyanta" iti, te'pi sa bhavāÄstato
bhavāṃstaṃ bhavantaṃ tato bhavantamityādisarvavibhaktyantebhya utpadyanta iti
tatrāpi na syāt | "tasyāpatyam""tatra bhavaḥ" ityādau ca
ṣaṣṭha|ladikaikaiva vibhaktirnimitam, na tu
sarvetatyaupagavādāvatiprasaṅgaśceti dvitīyaṃ
pakṣamāśrityāha--yasmādityādi | tata ityādau "prāgdiśo vibhaktiḥ"
iti tasilādīnāṃ vibhaktitvātyadādyatvam |
kathaṃ punarete'sarvavibhaktayaḥ; yāvatā yatra ca saṅkhyā sambhavati
tatrāyamupadeśāḥ, avyayebhyastu niḥsaṅkhyebhya ityasminpakṣe
"avyayādāpsupaḥ" iti jñāpakāśrayaṇe ca sarvavibhaktayaḥ; atha
saṅkhyākarmādayaśca svādīnāmarthāstena sahāsyaikavākyateti pakṣaḥ,
tato'vibhaktitvamevāsatvabhūtārthānāmāpadyeta ? ucyate;
"dvyekayordvivacanaikavacane" ityatraikasminnityapanīya "ekavacanam"
iti pṛthak sūtraṃ kartavyam, tataḥ "dvibahvordvivacanabahuvacane" iti,
tataścaikavacanamekasminnapi bhaviṣyati, saṅkhyākarmādyabhāve
cāprāptaprāpaṇārthatvādekavacanamityasya sūtrasya, dvitvabahutvayostu
prāptaṃ dvivacanabahuvacanābhyāṃ bādhyate, tataścāsatvavacanebhyo'pi
saptānāṃ vibhaktīnāṃ saptāpyekavacanāni bhavanti |
avyayībhāvādapyevameva, tāvatāpi nāvyayībhāvāt
"tṛtīyāsaptamyoḥ" ityasyopapateḥ,
tadidamucyate-"ekavacanamutsargataḥ kariṣyate" iti | evaṃ sthite
yasmātsarvā vibhaktirnotpadyata ityekavacanena
vigraho'vayavakārtsnyavṛttiḥ sarvaśabdo yasya trikasya vibhaktiśaṃjñā
vihitā tanniravaśeṣaṃ yasmānnotpadyate, kintu tadekadeśa
evatyarthastadāha--yasmān sarvā vibhaktiriti | yadi tu sarvā
vibhaktaya iti bahuvacanena vigṛhyaeta tataḥ sarvānnīna itivat prakāra
kārtsnya'pi sarvaśabdasya saṃbhavād ekavacanamātrotpatāvapi sarvā
vibhaktayaḥ, saptāpyekavacanānyasatvavacanebhya utpadyanta iti na
syādasarvavibhaktitvamiti bhāvaḥ | iha "tenaika dik""tasiśca"
ityekasminnarthe vidhīyamānayorapyaṇtasoraṇ dravyapradhānaḥ, tasistu
dravyopasarjanatṛtīyārthapradhāna iti tasyāsatvavacanatā |
taddhita iti kimiti | asarvavibhaktiravyayamityevāstu, mā
bhūtsarvameya prakaraṇaṃ ye hi svarādayaḥ, ye ca nipātāḥ, ye ca
kṛnmejantāḥ, ye ca ktvādayaḥ, yaścāvyayībhāvaḥ, sarve te'sarvavibhaktaya
iti praśnaḥ | ekaḥ dvau, bahava iti | etebhyo'pi saptasvapi
vibhaktiṣvekaikameva vacanamutpadyata iti syādatiprasaṅga iti kartavyaṃ
taddhitagrahaṇam | tasmiṃśca kṛte prakaraṇamapi kartavyamiti bhāvaḥ |
viśatyādayastu kṛtaikaśeṣā dvivacanabahuvacanāntā api bhavantīti
nāsarvavibhaktayāḥ | evaṃ dvayatrayobhayaśabdā ayajantāḥ | evamapi
godayoradūrabhavo grāmaḥ "adūrabhavaśca" ityaṇaḥ "varaṇādibhyaśca" iti
lupi yuktavadbhāvāt sarvāsu vibhaktiṣu
dvivacanasyotpaterastyatiprasaṅgaḥ | syādayaṃ paryanuyogaḥ--yadi
taddhitānto godaśabdaḥ,vayaṃ tu "lubyogāprakhyānād" "yogapramāṇe
ca tadabhāve darśanaṃ syāda" ityadhīyānā naivaṃ paryanuyojyāḥ; evamapi
śaṅkhāyāssaṃjñāsaṅghasūtrādhyayaneṣu" saṃjñāyāṃ svārtha utpādyaḥ,
pañcaiva pañcakāḥ śakunayaḥ--atra prāpnoti, pacatirūpaṃ
pacatikalpamityādau ca ekavacanamevotpadyata iti syādevātiprasaṅgaḥ
| tasmātaddhitānāṃ pāṭha evāśrayaṇīyaḥ, tadāha--śiddhaṃ tu
pāṭhātasilādayaḥ prāk pāśapaḥ, śasprabhṛtayaḥ prāk samāsāntebhayaḥ,
māntaḥ kṛtvorthāḥ, tasivatī nānāñāviti" ||
kṛnmejantaḥ || 1|1|39 ||
atrāpi pūrvavatadantasya saṃjñeti sthite mejantagrahaṇaṃ kadantasya
viśeṣaṇam--"kṛdantammejantamabyayam" iti | kṛta eva vā-kṛdyo
mejantastadantamavyamiti | tatrādyo pakṣe pratāmau pratāmaḥ, lavamācaṣṭe
iti ṇici kvipi ṇilope ūṭhi "etyedhatyūṭhsu" iti vṛddhau
lauratrāpi prāpnoti, bhavati hyaetat pratyayalakṣaṇena kṛdantam,
mejantaṃ ca śrūyata itīmaṃ doṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā dvitīyaṃ pakṣamāśrityāha--kṛdya
iti | nanvatrāpi kārayāñcakāra--āmantasya na prāpnoti, pūrvatra tu
liṭaḥ kṛtvātsiddham, atrāpi svarādiṣvāmiti pāṭhāt siddham |
athāpi tatra taddhitasya pāṭhaḥ; evamapi kṛdantatvādutpannānāṃ supām
"āmaḥ" iti lugbhaviṣyati, "leḥ" iti hi tatra nānuvartate |
svāduṅkāramiti | śvādumi ṇamul"
svādumityarthagrahaṇātsampannaṅkāramityapi bhavati, svādumiti |
nipātanātpūrvapadasya māntatvam | "yena vidhistadantasya" ityeva
siddherapārthakamantagrahaṇaṃ tatrāha-antagrahaṇamityādi | nityayoge
bahuvrīhivijñānādaupadeśikapratipatiḥ | ādhaya iti |
āṅpūrvāddhāñaḥ "upasarge ghoḥ kiḥ",caturthyekavacane "gherṅiti"
ādhaye, bhavatyayaṃ saṃpratyejantaḥ, nopadeśe | evaṃ
cikīrṣave-karoteḥ sannantāt śanāśaṃsabhikṣa uḥ ", kumbhakāraśabdaḥ
karmaṇyaṇantaḥ "bahuvacane jhalyet", atrāvyayasaṃjñāyām "avyayāt"
iti luk syāt, sannipātaparibhāṣayā'pyetatsiddham, tathā
lakṣaṇapratipadoktayoḥ pratipadoktasyaiveti | antagrahaṇaṃ tu yatnāntaraṃ
draṣṭavyam ||

avyayībhāvaśca || 1|1|41 ||
luṅmukhasvaropacārā iti | atra makhasvaropacārau nivartyapānatayā
prayojanam, maśakārtho dhūma itivat | luk pravartyamānatayā |
upāgnīti | avyayāditi luk | pūrvapadaprakṛtitvara eveti |
samāsasvareṇāntodātatvam | upapayaḥ kāma iti |
"śīlikāmibhikṣācaribhyo ṇaḥ" karmaṇi ghañantena vā bahuvrīhiḥ, atra
mukhasvaranivṛttireva sākṣātprayojanam, luk tu
"nāvyayībhāvādato'm" iti viśeṣapratiṣedhāt siddhaḥ, "ataḥ
kṛkamikaṃsa" ityatra ca "anutarapadasthasya" iti vartate |
nanvanyadapyavyayakāryaṃ sambhavati-upāgnikamityakac, upakumbhamanya iti
mumpratiṣedhaḥ, upakumbhībhūta iti "asya cvau"
itītvasyopasaṅkhyānikaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ, upāgnyadhīyāneti
"subāmantrite" ityasyaupasaṃkhyānikaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ, tatkuto'yaṃ
kāryaniyama ityata āha - sarvamidamityādi | iha cetyādinā ṅa
lokāvyaya" ityatra yadvakṣyati --"avyayapratiṣedhe
tosunkasunorapratiṣedhaḥ" iti, tasyāvaktavyatāṃ darśayati ||
śi sarvanāmasthānam || 1|1|42 ||
kuṇḍānīti | "jaśśasojha śiḥ" śarvanāmasthāne" iti vartamāne
"napuṃsakasya jhalacaḥ" iti num | śarvanāmasthāne cāsambuddhau" iti
dīrgho yadyapi "jasaḥ śīḥ" ṅapuṃsakācca" iti vihitasya śīśabdasya
śabdalūpāpekṣayā napuṃsaka hrasvatve "śi" iti rūpaṃ sambhavati, tathāpi
lākṣaṇikatvānna tasya grahaṇam, sarvanāmasthānapradeśeṣu śigrahaṇe
suṭo grahaṇaṃ na syāt | śisuṭoriti vacane napuṃsakasuṭo'pi
grahaṇaṃ prāpnoti, ataḥ saṃjñā tāvatkartavyā | kimarthaṃ tu mahatī
kriyate ? ke cidāhuḥ-sarvanāma tiṣṭhatyasminnati
sarvanāmasothānam, nāma pratipadikam,
sarvaśabdo'vayavakārtsyavacanaḥ sarvāvayavayuktaṃ yatra nāma
tiṣṭhatītyarthaḥ, tenānyatra nyūnaṃ nāma tiṣṭhatītyartho gamyate, kiṃ
siddhaṃ bhavati ? "upeyuṣaḥ" ityādau samprasāraṇe kṛte
pūrvakṛtasyeṭo nivṛttiḥ siddhā bhavati; anyathā
nivṛttikāraṇābhāvāt avatiṣṭheteti | evaṃ tu kasmin prātipadike
kiṃ nyūnamiti na jñāyeta ! tasmātpūrvācāryānupālabdhumeṣā mahatī
saṃjñā praṇītā || 
suḍanapuṃsakasya || 1|1|43 ||
suḍiti pañca vacanānīti | anenauṭaṣṭakāreṇa pratyāhāraḥ, na
ṭāśabdasyeti darśayati | ādirantyenetyatrāntyatvaprayuktā yasyetsaṃjñā
tena pratyāhāraḥ | lakāre tvakārasyetsaṃjñāvidhānasāmarthyāt
pratyāhāra iti bhāvaḥ | napuṃsakādanyatreti | anena pūryudāsatāṃ
darśayati | prajyapratiṣedhe hi kuṇḍāni tiṣṭhantīti jasaḥ śau, pūrveṇa
yā prāptistasyā api pratiṣedhaśaṅkāyām "anantarasya vidhirvā
bhavati pratiṣedho vā" iti parihartavyaṃ syād,
asamarthasamāsaścāśrayaṇīyaḥ syāt | napuṃsake na vidhiriti |
strīpuṃsasambandhinaḥ suṭa upādānād | na pratiṣedha iti |
vidhipradhānatvāt paryudāsasya | tenetyādi | yata evaṃ
napuṃsakenāsya vyāpāraḥ tena jaso yaḥ śistasya pūrveṇa saṃjñā
bhavatīti | sāmanī iti | napuṃsakācceti śībhāvaḥ | "vibhāṣā
ṅiśyoḥ" ityillopābhāve dīrgho na bhavati ||
na-veti vibhāṣā || 1|1|44 ||
navāśabdo'yamekanipāto'pyasti pratiṣedhavāvī, navoktārthatvāditi
yatā, tasya grahaṇe "vibhāṣādiksamāse" iti prakṛte " na bahuvrīhau"
iti pratiṣedho'narthakaḥ syād | vibhāṣāpradeśeṣu ca na śabda
evopādeyaḥ syād | ata eva saṃkhyāvācino nakārāntasyāpyagrahaṇam
| pratyagrastrīliṅgavacano'pi na gṛhyate; pradeśeṣvasambhavāt | na hi
"vibhāṣā śveḥ" ityādau vidheyasya navapurāṇtvaṃ strīliṅgatā vā
sambhavati | tasmānnipātasamudāyo'yamityāha-neti | pratiṣedha
ityādi | tayoḥ pratiṣedhavikalpayorityanenārthayoreṣā saṃjñeti
darśatam | nanu ca śva rūpaṃ śabdasya" iti vacanānnavāśabdayoreva
grahaṇaṃ yuktam, tatrāha-itikaraṇa ityādi | karmāṇi lyuṭ,
itiścāsau karaṇaśca so'rthasya saṃjñino nirdeśo yathā
syādityevamarthaḥ | itiśabdo hi padārthaviparyāsakṛt | tatra loke
bāhyārthapradhāneṣu śabdeṣvitiśabdaḥ prayuktaḥ, arthapadārthakatvāt
pracyāvya śabdapadārthakatve vyavasthāpayati gaurityayamāheti | iha tu
vyākaraṇe śvaṃ rūpam" iti vacanāt svarūpapadārthaḥ | tataśca
navāśabdābhyāṃ paratra prayukta iti śabdastau
svarūpapadārthakatvātpracyāvyārthapadārthakatve vyāvasthāpayati |
tasmādarthayoreva saṃjñā |
vibhāṣāpradeśeṣu ityādinā pratiṣedhavikalpayorekasminneva yoge
sahopasthāpanaṃ viṣayabhedeneti taṃ darśayati | tathā sati
viṣayabhedo durjñānaḥ syāditi bhāvaḥ | tatretyādinā pūrvaṃ
pratiṣedhaḥ pravartate, pañcādvikalpa iti darśayati | yadi tu pūrvaṃ
vikalpaḥ pravarteta paścātpratiṣedhaḥ, tato vikalpapravṛttiranarthikaiva
syāt | ānupūrvī ca saṃjñāvidhivākye śrutaiva
pradeśavākyeṣvapyāśrayituṃ yuktā | ubhayatravibhāṣāḥ prayojayantīti |
prāptavibhāṣāyāmaprāptavibhāṣāyāṃ ca saṃjñākaraṇasyānupayogāt |
tathā hi--prāptavibhāṣāyāṃ tāvad "vibhāṣopapadena pratīyamāne"
iti śvaritañitaḥ" ityādinā nityamātmanepade prāpte vibhāṣā
vidhīyate | vibhāṣāśabdaścāyaṃ "vā" "anyatarasyām"
ityādivadvikalpavācitvena prasiddhaḥ | tena bhāvābhāvayoḥ
pratipāditayorbhāvāṃśasya prāptatvādabhāvāṃśaparatā vijñāyate,
bhāvāṃśaḥ sthita eva | aprāptavibhāṣāyāmapi "vibhāṣorṇoḥ"
ityabhāvāṃśasya prāptatvād bhāvāṃśaparatā vijñāyate "vibhāṣā śveḥ"
ityatra tu yadi vidhimukhena vibhāṣā śrutiḥ pravartate, pitsveva
saṃprasāraṇaṃ vibhāṣā syāt, kitsu tu yajāditvānnityameva syāt |
atha pratiṣedhamukhena pravṛttistadā kitsvena vikalpaḥ syānna pitsu |
na ca śakyaṃ vaktum--pitsu vidhimukhena pravartate, kitsu
pratiṣedhamukheneti; ekatvādvākyasya tasya cānyataravikalpa
evopakṣīṇatvāt | saṃjñākaraṇe tu pūrvaṃ pratiṣedhe kitsu pravṛte
kidakidākhyo liṭ sarva eva samīkṛto bhavati;
sarvasyāsamprasāraṇanimitatvāt | tato vikalpaḥ sarvatra vidhimukhena
pakṣe samprasāraṇaṃ sampādayati | etacca--"ākṛtau padārthe samudāye
sakṛllakṣaṇaṃ pravartate" iti darśane prayojanam | yadā tu pratilakṣyaṃ
"vibhāṣā śveḥ" ityasya vyāpāraḥ, tadā kvacidvidhimukhena
kvicitapratiṣedhamukhena pravartata iti saṃjñākaraṇamantareṇāpīṣṭṃa
siddhyati | tatā ca "hṛkroranyatarasyām" ityādāvanyatarasyāṃgrahaṇe
vā grahaṇe cobhayatravibhāṣāsviṣṭasiddhaḥ | sūtrārambhe tu saṃjñāpyarthaḥ,
vibhāṣetyarthaḥ | saṃjñā navārthayoriti vyākhyeyam | śuśāveti |

yaṇaḥ sthāna iti | kathaṃ punaranuvāde sthānasambandho labhyate ? "ṣaṣṭhī

ādyantau ṭakito || 1|1|46 ||
atra dvau pakṣau sambhavataḥ-saṃjñā syāt, paribhāṣā veti | tatra

midaco'ntyāt paraḥ || 1|1|47 ||
"acaḥ" iti nirdhāraṇe ṣaṣṭhī, jātāvekavacanamityāha--acāmityādi |

| samānajātīyasyaiva nirddhāraṇaṃ bhavatītyantyo'pyajeva vijñāyata

sthāneyogatvasyaivāyamapavādo yukta ityā

tatrābhakte--tātā piṇḍānāmiti nalopo na syāt | tacchabdāt

eca igghrasvādeśe || 1|1|48 ||
paribhāṣeyaṃ sthāniniyamārthā | "hrasvo napuṃsake"
ityādāvavupatiṣṭhate | ihaicāṃ pūrvo bhāgo mātrātmakaḥ
kaṇṭha|le'kārasadṛśāḥ | edaitorutarastālabya ikārasadṛśaḥ |
odautoroṣṭha|l ukārasadṛśaḥ | evamavayavasamāhārātmanāmecāṃ
hrasvaśāsaneṣu samudāyāntaratamasyābhāvād avayavāntaratamo hrasvo
bhavan kadācidakāraḥ syāt, kadācidikārokārau; mā
kadācidakāro bhūdityevamarthamidamārabhyate, tadāha--igeva hrasvo
bhavatīti | yadi tvayaṃ vidhiḥ syāt, tadā hrasvādeśa iti
viṣayopalakṣaṇametatsyād--yasminviṣaya eco hrasvādeśaprasaṅgasta
tregbhavatīti | tataśca dīrghāṇāṃ sthāne dīrdhā evakaḥ syuḥ
savarṇagrahaṇāt, naiṣadoṣaḥ;"bhāvyamāno'ṇ sarvarṇānna gṛhṇāti"
"bhāvyamāno'pyakāraḥ savarṇān gṛhṇāti" "diva ut"
ititaparakaraṇād amūbhyāmitivat; tathaicāmikāṃ ca sāmyāt
saṃkhyātānudeśo'pi syād, ādeśagrahaṇaṃ cānarthakaṃ syāt | tata
ādeśagrahaṇasāmarthyād hrasvādeśe hrasvadeśanakāla ikkartavyaḥ,
hrasvādeśaṃ kurvannikaṃ kuryādityarthaḥ | yadvā -ādiśyata ityādeśaḥ,
hrakvaścāsāvādeśaśca hrasvādeśaḥ | nirddhāraṇe saptamī,
jātāvekavacanam | ādiśyamāneṣu hrasveṣu madhye igeva hrasvo
bhavatīti sarvathā niyamarūpeṇāsya pravṛttiḥ | prāptipūrvakaśca niyama
iti ye prāptā antaratamāsteṣveva niyamaḥ | na ca ṛkāralṛkārau
prāptāviti kuto yathāsaṅkhyam ? kuto dīrghaprasaṅgaḥ ? evaṃ
ceṇityeva siddhe iggrahaṇaṃ pareṇa mā bhūditi | atiri | atinu |
rāyamatikrāntaṃ nāvamatikrāntaṃ brāhmaṇakulamiti pradisamāse
napuṃsakahrasvatvam | upagviti | avyayībhāvaḥ | raiśabdaścchandasyeveti
bhāṣyam | ekārasyāprasiddhatvādudāharaṇaṃ na pradarśitam |
heśabdamatikrāntaṃ brāhmaṇakulamatihi | atikhaṭva iti | upasarjanahrasvaḥ |
deśvadeteti | āmantritādyaudātatvam | devada3ta | "guroranṛta"
ityādinā plutaḥ ||
ṣaṣṭhī sthāneyogā | yoganiyamārtheti | yadyapi ṣaṣṭhī
sthāneyogaivetyasyāṃ vacanavyaktau yata
evakārastato'nyatrāvadhāraṇamiti ṣaṣṭhīniyamaḥ śrutyā pratīyate
tathāpi sthānanimitaka eva sambandhaḥ ṣaṣṭha|la vācya
ityarthātsambandhaniyamo'pi bhavatīti bhāvaḥ | yoge vā niyamo
yoganiyamaḥ | yadi yoganiyamaḥ kriyate loke'pi niyamaḥ
prāpnoti, avayavaṣaṣṭha|ladayaśca na siddhyanti; tataśca "śāsa
idaṅhaloḥ" śāseścāntyasya syādupadhāmātrasya ca, "ūdupadhāyā
gohaḥ" goheścāntyasya syād upadhāmātrasya ca, tatrāha-iha śāstre yā
ṣaṣṭha|lniyatayogeti | etena śāstre'yaṃ niyamaḥ,
śāstrāṅgatvātparibhāṣāṇām; tatrāpyaniyamaprasaṅga iti darśayati |
aniyamaprasaṅge niyamaḥ kartavyo lokavat, tadyathā-loke grāmāntaraṃ
jigamiṣuḥ kaścitkañcidāha-"panthānaṃ me bhavānupadiśatu" iti, sa
yatra saṃdehaḥ, pathi dvaividhyāt,
tatraivopadiśati-"amuṣminnavakāśe'nena pathā gaccha" iti; evamihāpi
"asterbhūḥ" asteḥ sthāne'nantaro veti saṃdehe niyamaḥ kriyate -
sthāneyogaiveti | etadeva spaṣṭayati-sthāneyogasya nimitabhūta iti
| nimitabhūte, nimitatvaṃ prāpte | nimitagrahaṇaṃ kurvan śthāne"
iti nimitasaptamīti darśayati |
sthānaśabdo'yamastyapakarṣavacanaḥ-gosthāne'śvo badhyatāmiti, asti ca
nivṛttivacanaḥ-śleṣmaṇaḥ sthāne kaṭuakamauṣadhamiti, asti ca
prasaṅgavacanaḥ--darbhāṇāṃ sthāne śaraiḥ prastaritavyamiti, tadiha
caramasya grahaṇamityāha--sthānaśabdaśceti | caśabdo'vadhāraṇe
bhinnakramaśca vācītyasyānantaraṃ draṣṭavyaḥ | prasaṅgavācyeveti
kathamivetyāha--yatheti | nivṛttivācī na gṛhyate,
asterupadeśasāmarthyāt | na hyārdhadhātuke nivartitasya sārvadhātuke
śravaṇamupapadyate, na hi mathurāyāṃ vyāpāditaḥ srughne jīvati |
nāpyapakarṣavacanaḥ, na hyarthena nityasambaddhasya tato'pakarṣaḥ sambhavati |
nāpyārddhadhātukādapakarṣaḥ, na hi nitye prakṛtipratyayasamudāye
prakṛterapakarṣaḥ sambhavati | svābhāvika eva hyasteraprayoga ārddhadhātuke
bhūśabda sya ca prayogo'nena prakāreṇānvākhyāyate, ataḥ prasaṅgaḥ eva
sthānam | prasaṅgaḥ prāptiḥ, asteḥ prāptau bhūḥ prayoktavya ityarthaḥ |
astinārthaṃ pratipādayitumudyaukta ārddhadhātuke viṣaye bhavatinā
pratipādayediti yāvat | prasaṅgasambandhasyetyādinā
sūtrārthamudrāharaṇe darśayati | bruva ityupalakṣaṇam |
kiṃ punarbahavaḥ ṣaṣṭha|lrthā yata idamucyata ityata āha --bahavo hīti |
ekaśataṃ ṣaṣṭha|lrthāḥ tatra svasvāmibhāvādayaḥ śabde na sambhavanti,
samīpādaya eva tu sambhavantītyato yāvantaḥ śabde sambhavantītyuktam |
vyavahitamapi samīpaṃ bhavatītyanantarādbhedenopādānam |
sthāneyogetyasamāsaśced yogeti strīliṃgaṃ ṣaṣṭhīśabdena ca
sāmānādhikaraṇyamanupapannam | samāse'pi tatpuruṣaścet tau ca
pūrvoktadoṣau, saptamyā lukprasaṅgaśca, bahuvrīhāvapi
lukprasaṅgo'nivārya evetyata āha--ṣaṣṭhī sthāneyogetyādi |
yadvā--ayogeti padacchedaḥ | na vidyate yogo yasyāḥ sā'yogā | tatra
yogaḥ mantareṇa ṣaṣṭha|la evābhāvād viśiṣṭo yogo yasyā
nāstītyarthaḥ | evaṃ ca kṛtvāsaṃdeha evopasthānamityevaṃ sarvatra siddhaṃ
bhavati | atha vā - yogavatī yogā, ṣaṣṭha|laścāvaśyambhāvī yoga iti
sāmarthyād bhūmni matvarthīyo'kāraḥ, bahavo yogā yasyāḥ santīti |
asminnapi pakṣe sandehaviṣaya upasthānamiti siddham |
bhāṣye sūtraṃ pratyākhyātam, katham ? "asterbhūḥ" ityatra sandehaḥ
--sthāne'nantaraḥ, samīpa iti ? lakṣyānurodhāt sthāna iti
vyākhyāsyāmaḥ | idaṃ tu ṣaṣṭha|lntaṃ yathā sthānena yujyeta; ataḥ
ṣaṣṭhayuccāritā | tena ṅirddiśyamānasyādeśā bhavanti" iti
siddhaṃ bhavatīti | tatra sūtre ṣaṣṭha|lntaṃ gṛhyate--ṣaṣṭha|lntameva
nirddiśyamānaṃ sthānena yujyate, na tu pratīyamānamiti | tena
"pādaḥ pat" ityasyāyamarthaḥ--pādantasyāṅgasya yo|vayavaḥ pācchabdaḥ
sūtre ṣaṣṭha|la nirdiṣṭaḥ, tasya pacchabda ādeśaḥ, na tu pratīyamānasya
tadantasyeti ||

itikaraṇo hetau | yasmādūṣmaguṇayuktāḥ, tasmādūṣmaguṇayuktasya
hakārasya dvitīyāḥ prasaktā ityarthaḥ | "śādaya ūṣmāṇaḥ sasthānena
dvitīyā hakāreṇa caturthāḥ" iti śikṣā | atroṣmaśabdo guṇavacanaḥ,
sasthāneneti itthaṃbhūtalakṣaṇe tṛtīyā | haśaṣasāḥ khacchādīnāṃ
dvitīyānāṃ sthānā yathā te ūṣmāṇa evaṃ dvitīyā apītyarthaḥ |
phakārasya sasthāna ūṣmā nāsti, tasmātasya viśeṣata ūṣmatvaṃ vaktavyam
| hakāreṇa caturthā iti, yathāhakāra ūṣmā evaṃ te'pītyarthaḥ | evaṃ
nādavato nādavanta itītyatrāpi hetvartho yojyaḥ | iha iṣṭam,
uptam--āntaryato'rddhamātrasya vyañjanasyārddhamātrek saṃprasāraṇaṃ
prāpnoti; iha ca dadhyatra, kumāryatra,
brahmabandhvartham--mātrikadvimātrikatrimātrikāṇāmikāṃ
mātrikadvimātrikatrimātrikā yaṇaḥ prāpnuvantyāntaryataḥ | naiva loke
vede'rddhamātra igasti, nāpi mātriko dvimātriko vā yaṇ, yo'sti
sa bhaviṣyati | ihāntaratamaśabdaḥ saptamyanto'pi paṭhito bhāṣye |
"sthāne'ntaratama uraṇ raparaḥ" iti saṃhitāpāṭho'nityaḥ" tatra
padacchede saptamyantamapi sambhavati | tatra cāyamarthaḥ-ṣaṣṭhīti
vartate,antaratamo ya ādeśasya sthānī, tatra ṣaṣṭhī, tasyādeśa iti
"akaḥ savarṇe dīrghaḥ" ityādau vidhīyamānasya dīrghasyāntaratame
sthāninyaka iti ṣaṣṭha|lepasaṃhārāt siddhamiṣṭham | tathā "vānto yi
pratyaye" ityatraiva ityanuvṛtāyāḥ ṣaṣṭha|la
vāntādeśasyāntaratamayorodautorupasaṃhārāt siddham,
itarathaijmātrasya vāntādeśaḥ syāt | atra yakṣe doṣaḥ -"iko yaṇaci"
iti yaṇo ye'ntaramā ikastatra ṣaṣṭhīti dadhyatretyādāveva syāt,
kumārthatretyādau na syāt | tathā "iko guṇavṛddhī"
guṇavṛddhyorye'ntaratamā ikastatra ṣaṣṭhīti ihaiva syād-netā,
lavitā, nāyakaḥ, lāvakaḥ; cetā, stotā, cāyakaḥ, tāvaka ityatra na
syāt | evaṃ doṣavatvādasya pakṣasya yathāvyākhyātameva sādhīyaḥ |
"vānto yi pratyaye" ityatra parihāraṃ vakṣyati ||
uraṇ raparaḥ || 1|1|51 ||
atra catvāraḥ pakṣāḥ sambhavanti--"uḥ sthāne raparo'ṇ bhavatītyanena
raparatvaviśiṣṭo'ṇ bhāvyate" iti prathamaḥ pakṣaḥ | "uḥ sthāne'ṇeva
bhavati,sa ca rapara iti aṇanaṇprasaṅge'ṇ niyamyate, tasya ca rapatvaṃ
vidhīyate" iti dvitīyaḥ pakṣaḥ | "ya uḥ sthāne'ṇvidhīyate ityanūdya tasya
prasaṅgāvasthāyāmeva rapatvamātraṃ vidhīyate" iti caturthaḥ pakṣaḥ | tatra
prathamapakṣe--nāprāpteṣūdātādiṣu vidhīyamāno'ṇ teṣāṃ bādhakaḥ
syāt, tairanavaruddhasya viṣayasyābhāvāt | evaṃ hi tadā vacanavyaktiḥ,
ṣaṣṭhīnirddiṣṭamātrasyābhāvānnādeśo'ntaratamo bhavati, ṛvarṇasya
tvaṇ rapara iti, tataśca kṛtirityatra "ñnityādirnityam" iti
prāptamṛkāraṃ bādhitvāṇ raparaḥ syāt; prakṛtamiti śeṣanighātaḥ
svaritaśca, nṛÄḥ pāhīti pūrvasavarṇadīrghatvamanunāsikaṃ ca
bādhitvāṇ raparaḥ syāt, kartā, kāraka iti ca guṇavṛddhī
bādhitvā'ṇ bhavannakāra eveti niyamābhāvādikārokārāvapi raparau
syātām; ye cāmī prātipadamuḥ sthāna ādeśāḥ "āñta iddhātoḥ"
ityādayaḥ-teṣu raparatvaṃ na syāt |
dvitīye tu kāmaṃ guṇavṛddhyordoṣo na syāt | tathā hi --
"sarveṣu guṇavṛddhisaṃjñakeṣu prāpteṣu aṇeva bhavati" iti
niyamādakārākārāveva guṇavṛddhī rapare bhavata iti siddhaṃ
kartetyādi, śāstrāntareṇa yo'ṇ prasaktaḥ sa eva niyamādapi
bhavatītīkārokārāvapi na prāpnutaḥ | nanu "anuyamaprasaṅge
niyamaḥ" iti vṛddhāveva syād, asti tatrāniyamaprasaṅga iti kṛtvā;
guṇastu kartetyādau mātrikasya mātriko'kāra eva
prāpnoti;taritetyādau dvimātrasya dvimātra eva bhaved, aṇeveti tra
niyamābhāvāt taritetyādāveṇeóva guṇaḥ syāt; kartetyādau tu
yadyapyakāra eva guṇo labhyate, tasya rapatvaṃ tu na labhyate, yo
hyaṇanaṇprasaṅge'ṇeveti bhavatīti niyamato yo'ṇ tasyaiva raparatvaṃ
vihitam; ato nimayamapakṣe'pi guṇaviṣaye doṣastadavastha eva ?
ucyate, dve ete paribhāṣe ādeśaniyamārthe--śthāne'ntaramaḥ" iti ca
"uraṇ raparaḥ" iti ca | tatra pūrvasyā avakāśaḥ "cajoḥ
kughiṇṇyatoḥ" ityādi, asyā avakāśo yatrāntaratamye viśeṣo
nāsti, yathā tāraka ityādau, vṛddhīnāṃ kartā tāritetyādau | guṇo
bhavatītyukte sarveṣu guṇeṣu prāpteṣu śthāne'ntaratamaḥ" iti
niyamo'stu, "uraṇ raparaḥ" iti vā paratvāt "uraṇraparaḥ"
ityayameva bhaviṣyati | ataḥ suṣṭhūaktam-ṅiyamapakṣe guṇaviṣaye na
kaściddoṣaḥ" iti | kintūdātādiṣu doṣastadavastha eva syāt,tathā
hi-kṛtirityādāvudāto bhavatītyukte sarveṣadātasaṃjñakeṣu
prāpteṣu paratvādanenāṇa evodātāḥ syuḥ te ca raparāḥ |
evamanudātādiṣvapi draṣṭavyam | ye ca pratipadāmādeśāḥ "ṛta
iddhātoḥ" ityevamādayaḥ, teṣvaniyamaprasaṅgābhāvādasti niyame
rapatvaṃ na syāt, tadāha--"uraṇ raparavacanamanyanivṛtyarthaṃ
cedudātādiṣu doṣaḥ" iti |
tṛtīya pakṣe udātādiṣu na doṣaḥ; ñnityādibhirantaratamasyaiva
vidhānāt | kiratītyādau ca na dauṣaḥ | guṇavṛddhyoruktadoṣaḥ
syādeva, tathā hi--vihitasya paścādanena raparatvaṃ vidhīyate,
vidhānakāle tvāntaryato mātrikasya; mātrike guṇe rapare
kartetyādi yadyapi sidhyati, taritetyādau tveṇeóva guṇaḥ syād;
vṛddhiṣu ca vidhānasamaye kasyāścidāntaryābhāvāt tisṛṣu
pravṛtāsvākārasyāṇtvāt raparatve kārakastāraka iti yadyapi
siddhati, vāyakastāvaka ityadyaniṣṭamanusajyata eva | ata evameteṣu
pakṣeṣu doṣasadbhāvāccaturthaṃ pakṣamāśrityāha--
uḥ sthāne'ṇprasajyamāna evetyādi | etacca
sthānadvayagrahaṇānuvṛterlabhyate | tatraikamuḥ sthāne yo'ṇ vidhīyata
ityanuvāde'pi sthānasambandhalābhāya | dvitīyaṃ tu so'ṇ prasaṅga eva
prasajyamānāvasthāyāmeva raparo bhavatīti raparatvasya
kālavidhānārtham | śthāne'ntaratamaḥ" ityatra hi yadyapi tālvādivacanaḥ
sthānaśabdaḥ, tathāpi na tenātra kaścidartho'stīti prasaṅgavacana eveha
sampadyate | evaṃ ca guṇavṛddhyoḥ prāptyavasthāyāmevāṇo parapāḥ
sampannā iti pramāṇato'ntaratamāveṇèócau bādhitvā sthānato'ntaratama
eva bhaviṣyatīti na kaściddoṣaḥ | na
cānekāltvātsarvādeśaprasaṅgaḥ; ānupūrvyā siddheḥ |
yadāṅgasyeti ṣaṣṭhī antye'lyanusaṃhṛtā tadāyamuḥ sthāne, yadāyamuḥ
sthāne tadā raparaḥ, yadā raparastadānekāliti na punaḥ parāvṛtya
sarvādeśo yujyate |
dvaimātura iti | "māturutsaṅkhyāsambhadrapūrvāyāḥ" | kheyamiti | "ī
ca khanaḥ" | saudhātakiriti | śudhāturakaṅ ca " |
atrāyamakaṅadeśo'naṇtvādraparo na bhavati | atha yo'trāṇ sa paraḥ
kasmānna bhavati ? anādeśatvāt, samudāyo hyatrādeśaḥ | yadyevam,
khaṭvarśya ityādāvapi raparatvaṃ na syāt, pūrvaparayorhi
samudāyo'tra sthānī nāvayava ṛkāraḥ, ucyate; pūrvaparayoriti
dvivacananirddiśātayoreva sthānitvaṃ na samudāyasya, anurdeaśāt |
ata eva dvayoḥ sthāninorbhinnādiṣu natvavat dvāvādeśau sāyātām
iti tatraikagrahaṇaṃ kriyate | tata ṛkārasyāpi sthānitvamastyeva |
tadidamucyate-"yo hyubhayoḥ sthāne bhavati labhate
so'nyatarabyapadeśam" iti | atastatrāpi raparatvaṃ bhaviṣyati ||
alo'ntyasya || 1|1|52 ||
"alaḥ" iti jasantaṃ cedayamarthaḥ syāt-alātmakā ādeśā antyasyeti |
tatra rahorajasāṃ lopaḥ sarvādeśaḥ syād--nīrajīkarotīti |
antyasya caviśeṣitatvāt "vasusraṃsudhvaṃsvanaḍuhāṃ daḥ" iti datvaṃ
padasyāpyantyasya syāt--paramānaḍudbhyāmiti | asandehārthaṃ
cālo'ntyasyeti vācyaṃ syād | ato'lontyasyetyanena
sāmānādhikaraṇyāt ṣaṣṭha|lntamiti sthitam | yadi "ṣaṣṭhī
sthāneyogā" ityenaikavākyatā'sya syāt, tato'yamarthaḥ syāt--"iha
śāstre yā kācana ṣaṣṭhī sāntyasyālo bhavati sā sthāneyogā iti |
tataśca "ārddhadhātukasyeḍvalādeḥ"
ityasyāpyante'lyanusaṃhārādārddhadhātukāntyasyaiveṭ syāt, sa ca
bhavan "ādyantau ṭakitau" ityantyātprāk syāt | "ādyantau ṭakitau"
ityanena hi sthāneyogātvameva ṣaṣṭha|la bādhyate, na
punarantye'lyanusaṃhāro'pi | ato bhinnaṃ vākyam,
tadāha--ṣaṣṭhīnirdiṣṭasyetyādi | sāmānyavacane'pi "ṣaṣṭhī
sthāneyogā" ityādhikārāt sthāna ṣaṣṭhīnirdiṣṭasyeti veditavyam;
anyathā ṣaṣṭhīmātrasyādhikāre yasya ṣaṣṭhonirdiṣṭasya yatkāryaṃ
yathābhūtamucyate--ādeśarūpam, tāathagamarūpaṃ vā, tatathābhūtameva
tadantasya bhavatītyarthaḥ syāt | tataśca sa eva doṣo ya
ekavākyatāyām | ataḥ "ṣaṣṭhī sthāneyogā" iti sarvamanuvartyam |
ayañcārtho bhavati--śthānaṣaṣṭhīnirdiṣṭasya yaducyate tatadantyasyālo
bhavati, na tasya kṛtsnasya" iti | so'yaṃ kāryasyāntye'lyanusaṃhāro
vṛttikāreṇa darśitaḥ |
yadvā-"yā sthāneyogā ṣaṣṭhī sā'ntyasyālaḥ" iti ṣaṣṭha|la
evānusaṃhāro veditavyaḥ | atra pakṣe "ḍicca" ityasyāyamarthaḥ -"yatra
ṅidādeśo ividhīyate tatra yā ṣaṣṭhī sāntyasyālaḥ" iti | evaṃ sarvatra |
kāryānusaṃhāre tu yatāśrutameva ṣaṣṭhayāḥ syād, anusaṃhāre
"ḍicca" ityādāvasaṅgatiḥ | ataḥ kāryānusaṃhāro vṛttikāreṇa
darśitaḥ ||
ṅcci || 1|1|53 ||
hotāpotārāviti | "ṛto ṅisarvānāmasthānoyaḥ"iti guṇaḥ |
"aptṛn" ityādinā dīrghaḥ | mātāpitarāviti | "pitāmātrā"
ityekaśeṣābhāvapakṣe'bhyarhitatvānmātuḥ pūrvanipātaḥ;
"piturdaśaguṇaṃ mātā gauraveṇātiricyate"| atha tātaṅntyasya
kasmānna bhavati ? tatrāha--tātaṅītyādi | ananyārthaṅtveṣvinaṅadiṣu
caritārthametad guṇavṛddhipratiṣedhārthatayā caritārthaṅtve tātīṅ
pareṇa "anekālśitsarvasya" ityanena bādhyata ityarthaḥ |
nanūtsargāpavādayorayukto vipratiṣedhaḥ, atulyakakṣatvāt, na
cāntareṇa sarvādeśatāṃ guṇavṛddhipratiṣedhārthatvasyonmeṣa eti
caritārthatvamapi ṅtvisya cintyam ? na brūmo
guṇavṛddhipratiṣedhārthasya niścitatvād durbalaṃ ṅtvimiti; ki tu
sarvādeśe'pi tātaṅ guṇivṛddhipratiṣedhaḥ prayojanaṃ sambhāvyate |
tāvatā ca kiyānapi vilambo bhavati | anaṅadiṣu sarvādeśatve na
kiñcin ṅtvisya prayojanamiti sarvādeśārthatāsambhāvanāpi
nāstīti | teṣveva sahasā pravartate | tataśca tripratiṣedhopapatiḥ |
atha vā - "eruḥ" ityasyānantaram "tuhyaestātaṅaśiṣi" iti vaktavyam,
erityeva | evaṃ vaktavye ṅtkiraṇaṃ guṇavṛddhipratiṣedhārthameveti
niścitamiti vipratiṣedhopapatistadāha--tātaṅ iṅtkiraṇasya
sāvakāśatvādvipratiṣedhātsarvādeśa iti | 
atha vā - yathopadarśitaṃ guṇavṛddhipratiṣedhārthatvaṃ
sarvādeśatāmantareṇa nopapadyata iti antareṇaiva vipratiṣedhaṃ
sarvādeśastātaṅ bhavati ||
ādeḥ parasya || 1|1|54 ||
śāstre na kvacitparasyetyuccāryya kāryaṃ vidhīyata iti
nirviṣayametadityabhiprāyeṇāha--kva ceti | yatretyādi |
pañcamīnirdeśeṣu "tasmādityutarasya" iti parasya kāryaṃ vidhīyata
ityarthaḥ | āsīna iti | "āsa upaveśane" anudātet | dvīpamiti |
dvidhāgatā āpo|sminniti "ṛkpūrabdhūḥpathāmānakṣe" iti akāraḥ
samāsāntaḥ ||
anekālśitsarvasya || 1|1|55 ||
anekālagrahaṇaṃ kimartham ? "asterbhūḥ" sarvasya yathā syāt,
alo'ntyasya mā bhūt; naitadasti prayojanam; "ṅcci"
ityetanniyamārthaṃ bhaviṣyati--"yadyanekālantyasya bhavati, ṅdevi" iti |
evamapyasatyanekālgrahaṇe "ato bhisa ais" ityādiṣu
pañcamīnirdeśeṣvanekālapyādeśa ādeḥ parasya syāt, sati tu
tasmin dvāvetau "alo'ntyasya" ityasyāpavādau--"ādeḥ
parasya","anekālśitsarvasya" iti; tatra "ādeḥ parasya"
ityasyāyamavakāśo ya ekāladeśo lopo vā--"ī dāsaḥ"
"bahorlopo bhū ca vahoḥ" āsīnaḥ, bhūyān ; "anekālśitsarvasya"
ityasyāvakāśo yatra pañcamīnirdeśo nāsti-"asterbhūḥ" | ihobhayaṃ
prāpnoti-"ato bhisa ais",
apavādavipratiṣedhādanekālśitsarvasyetyayameva bhavatīti
siddhamiṣṭam |
śidgrahaṇaṃ kimartham ? "jasaḥ śī" sarvasya yathā syāt,
anekālityeva bhaviṣyati, śakāre lupte nānekāl,
ānupūrvyātsiddham | yadāyaṃ sarvādeśastadā pratyayaḥ, yadā
pratyayastadetsaṃjñā, yadetsaṃjñā tadālopaḥ, yadālopastadaikāl
tadiha sarvādeśatvamantareṇa naikāltvamupapadyate | iha tarhi "idama
iś" "idaṃ kimorīśkīḥ" ? atra hyantareṇāpi sarvādeśatāṃ
pragevetsaṃjñā bhavati | nanvatrāpi śakāraḥ prayojanāntarābhāvād
anekāltvamādeśasya saṃpādya nivartiṣyate | iha tarhi
"ghvasoreddhāvabhyāsalopaśca" iti ? lopaḥ śitsarvasya yathā syāt |
"idam iś" ityādāvapi prayojanābhāvaditsaṃjñaiva śakārasya na
syāditi śravaṇaprasaṅgaḥ ||
sthānivadādeśo'nalvidhau || 1|1|56 ||
nanu tatsthānāpannasya taddharmalābho lokavedayoḥ siddha eva | loke
tāvadekasminnupādhyāye mṛte
tatsthānaniviṣṭasyāpyabivādanādyaupādhyāyadharmalābho bhavati, ekasmiṃśca
rājani proṣite tatsthāne'bhiṣiktasya tatputrāderapi taddharmalābho
bhavati | vede'pi vrīhisthānapatitā vīvārādayo'vaghātādīn
vrīhidharmān labhante | tadvadatrāpyastisthānāpanno bhūrastidharmān
dhātutvādīn lapsyate,
nārtho'nenetyāśaṅkyāha--sthānyādeśayorityādi |
ayamabhiprāyaḥ--upādhyāyatvaprayuktā upādyāyadharmā
rājadharmāścābhiṣiktatvaprayuktā vrīhidharmācāpūrvasādhanatvanibandhanāḥ,
na tatatsvarūpanibandhanā iti yuktaṃ tatprakārajuṣo bhavantīti | iha tu
svaṃ rūpamitivacanādastyādisvarūpanibandhanā dhātutvādayo dharmā na
bhavanādyarthābhidhānalakṣaṇakāryaprayuktāḥ, tacca svarūpamādeśānāṃ
nāstīti tatsthānāpannānāmapi na syuriti tadāha--pṛthaktvāditi |
rūpabhedādityarthaḥ |
nanvetatprakārajuṣo'pi tatsthānāpannasya taddharmalābho dṛṣṭate, yadā
hyupādhyāyaḥ śiṣyeṇa yajñārthamupanimantritaḥ kāryavyāsaṅgāt
svaśiṣyamanyaṃ prerayati tadā sa tatra
gatvā'grāsanādīnupādhyāyadharmān labhate,
atrāpyupādhyāyapratinidhitvāt tadbuddhyaiva taddharmā anuṣṭhīyante;
evaṃ kṛte tu satyupādhyāya iti na tatsthānāpannatayā, na caivamatra
saṃbhavatītyārabdhavyameva sūtram |
yuṣmadasmadorādeśaniṣedhātsiddham | yadayaṃ
"yuṣmadasmadoranādeśe" ityāha, taj jñāpayati-"bhavati
sthānikṛtamādeśaḥ" iti; alāśraye cāprasaṅgaḥ, "ado jagdhiḥ"
lyabgrahaṇāt | yadi hi sthānyalāśrayamapyādeśe syāt kitītyeva
siddhe lyabgrahaṇanarthakaṃ syāt, satyam; "utarārthaṃ tāvat
sthānivadādeśa iti vaktavyam | ajādeśasya viṣayaviśeṣe sthānivatvaṃ
vakṣyāmi, padāntādividhiṣu pratiṣedhaṃ vakṣyāmi" iti | so'nyārthaḥ
sannihaiva kriyate liṅgānāśrayaṇāya |
ṣoḍhātideśaḥ-nimitātideśaḥ, vyapadeśātideśaḥ, śāstrātideśaḥ,
rūpātideśaḥ, tādātmyātideśaḥ, kāryātideśa iti | tatra
nimitamaśakyamatideṣṭuṃa brāhmaṇyavat, na hi
brāhmaṇasyāgrabhojanādinimitaṃ brāhmaṇyaṃ vacanaśatenāpi
kṣatriye'tideṣṭuṃa śakyate | "pūrvavatsanaḥ" ityatrāpi na prakṛtigataṃ
nimitaṃ ṅtvāidi sanante'tidiśyate, kintu prakṛtigatameva tat
sanā vyavadhāne'pyātmanepadanimitamiti | etāvatā
nimitātideśavāco'yuktiḥ |
vyapadeśātideśaḥ saṃjñāpakṣānna bhidyate, tatra ca vaterānarthakyaṃ vakṣyate,
kaḥ punarāyuṣmato vyapadeśo'bhipretaḥ ? kiṃ sthānīti vyapadeśaḥ,
yathā "ādyantavadekasmin"ityatra vyapadeśātideśapakṣaḥ ? uta sthānino
ye vyapadeśā dhāturaṅgamityādayaḥ, ta ādeśasya bhavanti ? iti |
pūrvaḥ pakṣo bhavato'pyanabhipretaḥ, dvitīyasya tu saṃjñāpakṣānmahān
bhedaḥ | tathāhi --saṃjñāpakṣe yatra sthānirūpamuccāryyate "āṅe
yamahanaḥ " ityādau, tatraiva kāryaṃ syād, na
dhātostavyādayo'hgasyenādaya ityādau; na hyatra saṃjñātvena
viniyuktamastyādi sthānirūpamuccāritam; yaccoccāritaṃ na sā
saṃjñā, tāadeśasyaiva kāryaṃ syād na sthāninaḥ, na hi saṃjñoccāritā
svayaṃ kāryeṇa yujyate, sthāninastu vyapadeśa
ādeśastayātidiśyamāne dhātostavyādayo'ṅgasyenādaya ityādau
sthānyādeśayorubhayorapi kāryaṃ siddhyati; ubhayorapi
vyapadeśasadbhāvāt | "āṅe yamahanaḥ" ityādikaṃ tu
sthānisvarūpanibandhanaṃ kāryamādeśasya na syāt,na hyatra
kāścidvyapadeśo ya ādeśasyātidiśyeta | athāpi śvaṃ rūpam"
iti vacanāddhannityapi hantervyapadeśa iti tasminnatidiṣṭe kāryaṃ
sidhyatītyucyate; evamapi pūrvoktastāvadviśeṣo vidyata
ityāstāmetat |
apradhānatvātu vyapadeśo na bhavati | ata eva śāstrātideśo'pi na
bhavati | sthānirūpe cā'tidiśyamāna ādeśavidhānaṃ vyarthaṃ syāt | na
ca vacanadvayaprāmāṇyādvikalpaḥ, "vā liṭi" iti vikalpāraṃbhāt |
tādātmyātideśo'saṃbhavānna bhavati, dvayorhi
sahāvasthitayoranyo'nyatādātmyamatidiśyate, subāmantritayoriva,
iha tvādeśena sthānī nivartita ityasaṃbhavaḥ | ataḥ
pāriśeṣyātprādhānyācca kāryātideśo'yam,
tadāha-sthānyāśrayakāryamiti, sthānyāśrayeṣu kāryeṣviti ca |
tātparyataścāyaṃ kāryātideśo varṇyate | akṣarāṇi tvādeśaḥ
sthāninā tulyaṃ vartata ityetāvatyeva paryavasitāni | kena tu
prakāreṇa tulyatvamityapekṣāyāṃ tatkāryāpatyeti tadāha--sthāninā
tulya vartata iti | sthānivaditi | sthānyāśrayeṣviti | bahuvrīhiḥ |
analvidhāvityasyārthamāha--analāśrayeṣviti | etena vidhīyate iti
vidhaḥu kāryam, alāśrayo vidhiralvidhirityutarapadalopī samāsa
iti darśayati | kimarthaṃ punarutarapadalopāśrayaṇam ? syādetat-sati
tasmin, yaścāli vidhiḥ, yaścālo vidhiḥ,yaścālaḥ parasya
vidhiḥ-yajeḥ ktaḥ, iṣṭaḥ, ka iṣṭa ityatra saṃprasāraṇasya sthānivatvāt ko
yaṣṭetyādivat "haśi ca"ityutvaṃ prāptaṃ na bhavati, sa iṣṭa ityatra
"etatadauḥ" sulopo na bhavati | alo vidhiḥ - dyaukāmaḥ, ukārasya
"lopo vyorvali" iti na bhavati | utvaṃ tu "aharvimaladyau" ityatra
caritārtham | alaḥ parasya vidhiḥ-dyauḥ, panthāḥ, saḥ-halṅyābiti
lopo na bhavati | alā vidhiḥ-vyūḍhoraskena | atra śo'padādau" iti
vasarjanīyasya sthāne vihitasya sthānivatvāt
visarjanīyasyāṭasūpadeśād "aḍvyavāye" iti ṇatvaṃ prāptaṃ na
bhavati | ataḥ sarvavibhaktyarthasaṃgrahāthaṃmutarapadalopāśrayaṇam |
anyathā hi ṣaṣṭhīsamāsa evāśrīyate'lsthānika eva vidhirāśritaḥ
syāditi, tanna; sambandhasāmānye ṣaṣṭha
īvijñānādapi sarvavibhaktyarthasaṃgrahasya siddhatvāt | anuvāde hi
sthāneyogābhāvāt sarvo'lsambandhī vidhiḥ pratipatsyate | evaṃ
tarhi yatra guṇabhāvenāpyalāśrīyate, tatrāpi niṣedho yathā
syāt-prapaṭha|leti, atra hi valāderiti pratyayaḥ prādhānyanāśritaḥ, val
tu guṇabhāveneti aprādhānyānna syāt | utarapadalope tu bhavati;
alāśrayatvādiḍvidheḥ | yadyalāśrayeṣu sthānivatvaṃ na bhavati,
vṛkṣāya--śupi ca" iti dīrgho na syāt; yañādau
supītyalāśrayatvāt | aruditāmityatra sārvādhātukasya
tasastāmādeśe 
"rudādibhyaḥ sārvadhātuke " iti valāśraya iṇ na syāt, ata
āha-sthānyalāśrayāṇīti | sthānino'l sthānyal, sa āśrayo yeṣāṃ
tāni tathoktāni |
ayamabhiprāyaḥ-yathā gurupadguruputre
vartitavyamanyatrocchiṣṭabhojanāt pādepasaṃgrahaṇācceti atideśe
pravṛte, yadā guruputraḥ svayaṃ gururbhavati tadocchiṣṭṃa bhujyate
pādau copasaṃgṛhyaete, tatkasya hetoḥ ? atideśenaikvākyatāmāpannaḥ
pratiṣedha ātideśikīmeva prāptiṃ pratiṣedhatīti,
tathehāpyātideśika evālvidhiḥ pratiṣidhyate | na ca vṛkṣāya,
aruditāmityatrātideśāpekṣā; svayameva yañāditvādvalāditvācca |
tataśca yatra sthānina evālāśrīyate sa eva niṣidhyate, yathā-prapaṭha|letyatra
| na hyatra lyap svayaṃ valādiriti | nanu ca guruputrasya svayaṃ gurutva
ucchiṣṭabhojanādau na mātrayāpyatideśāpekṣā, iha tu satyapi syameva
yañāditve nāntareṇātideśaṃ dirghaḥ siddhyati; asuptvāt |
aruditāmityatrāpi satyapi svayaṃ
valāditve'sārvadhātukatvādatideśenaiva veṭ prārthanīyaḥ, satyam;
dve kārye-supsaṃjñā ca, dīrghatvaṃ ca | na hi "prayogasamavāyyeva
kāryamatideśyam " iti niyamo'sti, yatu śāstrīyaṃ
tadevātidiśyate | na ca supsaṃjñā'lāśrayeti; tasyāmatidiṣṭāyāṃ
svāśrayaṃ yañāditvamāśritya dīrghatvaṃ bhaviṣyati |
aruditāmityatrāpyātideśikaṃ sārvadhaatukatvaṃ svāśrayaṃ ca
valāditvamāśrityeḍ bhaviṣyati | 
nanu ca vṛkṣāyetyatra sthānina ekārasyāltvātadāśrayaṃ
suptvamalāśrayameva, ucyate; kāryāpekṣamalvidhitvaṃ
nodāharaṇāpekṣam | etaduktaṃ bhavati--yasmin kārye vidhīyamāne'la
evāsādhāraṇaṃ kiñcidrūpaṃ nimitādirūpeṇāśrīyate--"haśi" "hali"
"vyorvali""halṅyābbhyaḥ""aḍvyavāye" iti - sa evālvidhiḥ;
"supi ca" ityatra tu naivaṃvidhaṃ kiñcidasti, kevalaṃ
vṛkṣāyetyatrodāhāraṇe'lātmakaḥ sthānīteyatāvat
kimudāharaṇamiti praśnaḥ | dhātvādyādeśāḥ prayojanamityutaram | tatra
"prayujyate'neneti prayojanam" udāharaṇaṃ na prayujyata
ityarthātpraśnānurūpaṃ prativacanam |
nanu cāstibruvorārddhadhātuke parata ādeśābhyāṃ bhāvyam, tat
kimatideśenetyata āha--ārddhadhātuke viṣaya ityādi |
dādhikam | dadhni saṃskṛtam "dadhnaṣṭak" | avyayādeśa iti |
ktvāmātrasya lyabādeśaḥ, ktvāntasyāvyayasaṃjñā, sa kathamavyayādeśaḥ,
tasmāt ktvāgrahaṇena lyapo grahaṇātadantasyāpi saṃjñā
bhavatītyevamparametat | tatrāpi "kṛdgrahaṇe gatikārakapūrvasyāpi
grahaṇam" iti prastutyeti saṃghātasya bhavati |
vakkaraṇaṃ kimiti | vināpi tena tadartho gamyate, yathā
ṅtkidityādāviti priśnaḥ |
sthānītyādi | asati vatkaraṇe saṃjñāprakaraṇatvāt sthānyādeśasya
saṃjñā vijñāyeta, maivaṃ vijñāyīti vatkaraṇamityarthaḥ | kimarthaṃ punaḥ
sthānyādeśasya saṃjñā neṣyata ityāha--svāśrayamapīti | saṃjñāyāṃ hi
sthānisvarūpanibandhanam "āṅeyamahanaḥ" ityādi kāryamādeśa eva
syād, na sthānini; na hi saṃjñoccāritā svayaṃ kāryeṇa yujyate |
"ātmanepadeṣvanyatarasyām" iti ca viṣayasaptamī vijñāyate |
svāśrayamapīti | ko'rthaḥ ? sthāninyapītyarthaḥ | tathā cotaragranthe
"ubhayatra" iti saptamīnirddeśaḥ |
ādeśagrahaṇaṃ kimiti | yathā "pitṛvatsthūlaḥ" ityukte
sambandhiśabdātputra iti mamyate, tathehāpi sthānivadityukte ka
ityapekṣāyām "yadapekṣaṃ sthānitvaṃ sa evā deśaḥ" iti gamyata praśnaḥ |
ānumānikasyetyādi | dvividho hi ādeśaḥ--pratyakṣaśca "asterbhūḥ"
ityādiḥ, ānumānikaśca "eruḥ" ityādiḥ | atrekāreṇekārāntaḥ
sthānyanumīyate, viṣaṇeneva gauḥ | ukāreṇa cokārānta ādeśaḥ
tatastesturiti sampadyate | tatrāsatyādeśagrahaṇe pratyakṣasyaiva grahaṇaṃ
syānnānumānikasya, punaḥśratestu vyāptyarthatvāt ādeśamātraṃ
sthānivadbhavati | tena pacatvityatra "tiṅntaṃ padam" iti padasaṃjñā
siddhā bhavati | nanu cekāramātrasyokāramātramādeśo'stu, kiṃ
tadantānumānana ? evaṃ hi "eruḥ" ityetacca yathāśrutameva vyākhyātaṃ
bhavati; ādeśagrahaṇaṃ ca na kartavyaṃ bhavati,
"ekadeśavikṛtisyānanyatvāt padasaṃjñā bhaviṣyati | evaṃ tarhi
punaḥśrutireva liṅgam, ekadeśavikāraḥ śāstre nāśrīyata iti,
tena--
sarve sarvapadādeśā dākṣīputrasya pāṇineḥ |
ekadeśavikāre hi nityatvaṃ nopapadyate ||
iti siddhaṃ bhavati |
dyaupithityadādeśā iti | "diva aut",
"pathimathyubhukṣāmāt","tyadādīnāmaḥ-ityete | nanu sāmānyātideśe
viśeṣānatideśaḥ, tataśca yathā brāhmaṇavadasmin kṣatriye vartitavyamiti
brāhmaṇamātrakāryameva bhavati, na māṭharādiviṣeṣakāryam; tathā
"sthānivadādeśaḥ" ityukte yaḥ sthānī yadākāraviśiṣṭaḥ sūtre
śrūtastadādeśasya tadākāraprayuktenaiva kāryeṇa bhavitavyam | "ktvo
lyap" ityatra ca vastusthityā sannihitamapi valāditvaṃ sthānirūpeṇa
nāśritam | tathā hi-iḍādirapi ktvā bhavatyeva,ktvā kevalo'pi
datvāyeti yaganto'pi, iṣṭvīnamiti mānto'pi; tatra
ktvāmātrapratibaddhaṃ yatkāryaṃ kṛtvapratyayatvādi,
tadādeśe'tidiśyatām, valāditvasya tu kuto'tideśaḥ ? evaṃ ka
iṣṭa ityādāvapi ca yaṇa ik bhavati, divo'lo'ntyasyotvautve
bhavataḥ, pathyādīnāmantyasyādbhavati, tyadādīnāmantyasyākāraḥ,
visarjjanīyasya satvamityevaṃ yaṇādirūpeṇa sthānina āśrayaṇam |
tataśca tatadākāraprayuktasyaiva kāryasyāpi atideśaḥ, na
haltvādiviśeṣanibandhanasyeti nārtho'nalvidhāvityanaina | yatra tarhi
viśeṣarūpameva sthānitvenāśrīyate, yathā-"cchvoḥ śūṭha" iti
vakāraḥ, tatra tatkāryamādeśasya mā bhūd-akṣadyauubhyām | vali lopo
na bhavati |
athātrāpi vakārāntasyāṅgasyālo'ntyasyoḍiti rūpeṇa sthānina
āśrayaṇam, evamapi viśeṣātideśajñāpanārthamidamucyate; anyathā
lyapo valāditvavat kitvasyāpyatideśo na syāt,
devitvetyādāvakito'pi ktvaḥ sambhavāt | anubandhāśca
sthāninyasanta eva kāryeṣu yujyanta iti tatkāryeṣvanalvidhāviti
niṣedho na bhavati | liṅgācca | yadayaṃ śerhyapicca" ityāha,
tajjñāpayati-bhavatyanubandhakāryāṇāmatideśa iti ||
acaḥ parasmin pūrvavidhau | aca iti sthāninirdeśa iti |
yadyapyanūdyamānādeśaviśeṣaṇatvāt sthānaṣaṣṭhī na labhyate, tathāpyaco
ya ādeśa ityukte tatsthānika eva pratīyata iti | parasminniti
nimitabhāve saptamī, na parasaptamī; paraśabdenaiva
paratvasyoktatvāt, parasminya ādeśa iti anuvādatvācca, kiti ye
guṇavṛddhī itivat; pūrvavidhāviti viṣaya iti prakṛtatvāt
sthānivatvasya | 
pūrvavidhau kartavye sthānivaditi | evaṃ padatātparyaṃ darśayitvā
vākyārthamāha--ajādeśa itāyadi | kimarthamidamucyate, pūrvatra
sthānikāryamādeśe'tidiṣṭam, iha tu sthānini sati pūrvasya
yatkāryaṃ tadādeśe'pi sati purvasya bhavatītyatidiśyate | nanu
tatrāpi sthāninimitamanyasya tadapyatidiśyate, yathā vṛkṣāyeti
"supi ca" iti dīrghatvam ? evaṃ tarhyālvidhyarthamidam | tathā
hi-vavraścetyudatve ṅa saṃprasāraṇe saṃprasāraṇam" iti vakārasya
saṃprasāraṇapratiṣedhaḥ sthānyalāśrayo'smādvacanādbhavati | idaṃ ca
śaṃprasāraṇe paraḥ pratiṣedhaḥ" iti pakṣe prayojanam,
śaṃprasāraṇabhāvini yaṇyeva pratiṣedhaḥ" iti tu pakṣe na prayojanam |
ihācitīkaḥ, bahucitīka iti citeḥ kapi dīrghatve kṛte
"hrasvānte'ntyātpūrvam" iti sthānyalāśrayaḥ svaro bhavati | evaṃ
yāteryaṅntāt ktici ato lope yalopavidhiṃ prati
sthānivatvaniṣedhād yalope ca yā yā ti iti sthite
yaṅkāralopasya sthānivatvāt "āto lopa iṭi ca" ityākāralope
punaryalope yātiriti bhavati | na ca punarākāralopaḥ, punaśca
yalopa iti pratyayamātrasya śravaṇaprasaṅgaḥ, āllopasya
sthānivatvācciṇoluṅnyāyenāsiddhatvādvā | tathā ca varevidhau
sthānivatvaṃ niṣidhyate-yāyāvara iti | sthānivadbhāvādāto lopo
mā bhūditi | tathā tiṣṭha
teryaṅntāt ktic, allopayalopayosteṣṭhīti sthite allopasya
sthānivatvādiyaṅ bhavati, tathā cotarasūtrekaṇḍūatirityatra
upaṅprasaṅgaṃ codayitvā "astu tasyaiva cchravoḥ śūḍityūṭha
kariṣyate" ityuktam, iyaṅ ci kṛte yalope ca teṣṭhitiriti bhavati
| na ca punariyaṅ, ādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvatvāt | tathā pepīyateḥ ktici
allopayalopayoḥ "eranekācaḥ" iti yaṇi yalope peptiriti bhavati
| "śo tanūkaraṇe" yaṅntāt ktici allopayalopāllopeṣu
pūrvatrāddhīye na sthānivaditi sthānivatvaniṣedhācchaśāṃ ṣa iti ṣatve
śāṣṭiriti bhavati | evaṃ cicīyateścektirityeṣā dik |
tathā titaumācaṣṭa iti ṇici ṭilopasya sthānivatvādayo
ñṇitītyasyābhāve "ataḥ upadhāyāḥ" iti sthānyalāśrayā vṛddhirbhavati |
na cātra kvilugupadhātvetyupadhāvidhi prati sthānivatvaniṣedhaḥ, tasya
pratyayavidhiviṣayatvāt, satyāṃ ca vṛddhau puki sati titāpayatīti
bhavati | na ca pukyapi sthānivatvam; ādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvatvāt | nanu
pūrvasya kārye kartavye sati sthānivatvena bhavitavyam, atra ca sarvatra
sthānivatve sati pūrvasya kāryaprāptiriti itaretarāśrayam | nātra
sthānivatvāt prageva pūrvasya kārye prāpte sthānivatvam, kiṃ tarhi ?
prāgvā paścādvā pūrvasya kārye pūrvasya kārye cikīṣite | ata eva
varevidhau sthānivatvaniṣedhaḥ | tadevamalvidhyarthamidam |
kiñca--brāhmaṇavadasminkṣatriye vartitavyamityatra brāhmaṇāśrayaṃ kāryaṃ
prāpyate, na tu svāśrayaṃ yuddhādikaṃ vyāvartyate | pūrvasūtre'pi
sthānyāśrayaṃ prāpyate, na svāśrayaṃ vyāvartyate, yathā--vṛkṣāyeti
dīrghatvamādeśāśrayaṃ bhavati; bhavitā, bhavitum, bhavitavyamiti guṇaḥ
| iha tu sthānyalāśrayameveṣyate, svāśrayaṃ neṣyate | tathā ca
paṭayatīti ṭilope kṛte prāptā upadhāvṛddhirna bhavati, avadhīditi
halantalakṣaṇā, bahukhaṭvaka iti "hrasvānte'ntyātpūrvam" itisvaro na
bhavati, vāyvoryalopo na bhavati, tanvantītīṇ na bhavati | evaṃ
bahūni svāśrayanivṛttirudāharaṇāni | ata eva dvarvacanādividhau
sthānivatvaniṣedhaḥ | ato'jādeśaḥ paranimitakaḥ pūrvasya vidhau
sthānivadeva yathā syāt, mā bhūtsvayaṃ nimitamiti
niyamārthamapīdamārabdhavyam |
kathaṃ punarekena yatnenobhayaṃ labhyam, vidhiśca, niyamaśca ?
vidhigrahaṇasāmarthyāditi tannirūpaṇe vakṣyāmaḥ | atha vā - vidhigrahaṇaṃ
vidhimātre sthānivadbhāvā yathā syādaśāstrīyo ca viparīte ca |
tena paṭayatītyādau sthānini dṛṣṭo
vṛddhyabhāvādiraśāstrīyo'pyatidiśyate | tatra vṛttikāreṇa
yatnasādhyatvādaśāstrīyodāharaṇani darśitāni | vidhiśabdaḥ
karmasādhanaḥ, pūrvasyeti śeṣalakṣaṇaṣaṣṭhī; pūrvasya vyavasthitasya sataḥ
sambandhini kārye kartavye iti | pūrvatvaṃ tvatrājapekṣamāśrīyate;
nādeśāpekṣam, nimitāpekṣaṃ vā | na cājapekṣe pūrvatva vidhiśabdo
bhāvasādhanaḥ sambhavati | bāvasādhane hi tasmin, pūrvasyeti karmaṇi
ṣaṣṭhīvijñānāt pūrvasminvidhātvye sthānivadityarthaḥ syād |
avasthite cāci tataḥ pūrvaṃ kiñci dvidheyaṃ bhavati, iha cādeśāḥ
sthānivaditi vacanāt ādeśena sthānī nivartita iti nāyamarthaḥ
sambhavati | atrādeśaḥ paranimitakaḥ, tasyaivādeśasya sthānibhūto
yo'c, tataḥ pūrvasmin vidhātavya iti | tathā hi-"aco ya ādeśaḥ"
ityādeśātprāgavasthānūdyate, tataśca saṃnidhānāt
pratīyamānamavadhitvamapi tadavasthasyaivāco yuktam | ata
evocyate-"yo'nādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvastasya vidhiṃ prati sthānivadbhāvaḥ"
iti | ādeśanamādiṣṭṃa tadakṛtaṃ yasya so'nādiṣṭaḥ, akṛtādeśādacaḥ
pūrvasyetyarthaḥ | ādeśātprāgavasthāyāmiti yāvat | na cāsyā
avasthāyāḥ pūrvasmin vidhātavye tadādeśaḥ sthānivaditi sambhavati
| nanu karmasādhane'pyajādeśaḥ sthānivadbhavati-akṛtādeśācaḥ
pūrvasya vidhāviti nāyamarthaḥ sambhavati, sthānivadbhāvadaśāyāmaca
