sthānivadbhavatīti "etyedhatyūṭhasu" iti vṛddhiḥ | ye tu "kvau
luptaṃ na sthānivat" iti paṭhanti teṣāmetanna syāt | tathā
pipaṭhiṣateḥ kvau, ato lope napuṃsake bahuvacane jasijhallakṣaṇe
numi jasnimite'pi kartavye'yo lopasya sthānivatvaniṣedhaḥ syāt,
kvau kṛtatvāt | kvau vidhiṃ pratītyatra tu pakṣe pratiṣedho na bhavati,
pipaṭhīṣi brāhmaṇakulāni, numyasati śāntamahataḥ" iti dīrghatvaṃ na
bhavati | devayatedyauuÇrityatrobhayathāpi sidhyati | luk-lukā lupte
na sthānivat, āmalakyā vikāraphalam ṅityaṃ vṛddhaśarādibhyaḥ" iti
mayaṭaḥ "phale luk" "luktaddhitaluki" iti ṅīpo luk parinimitakaḥ
yasyeti lope na sthānivad bhavati | kecitvetadarthaṃ sūtre varāī u
vare iti īkārapraśleṣaṃ varṇayanti, īvidhiṃ prati na sthānivaditi |
upadhātveupadhātve kartavye na sthānivat | parikhaaśabdāccāturarthike
ṇikṛte pārikhe bhavaḥ pārikhīya iti "vṛddhādakekāntakhopadhāt" iti
chāe na syāt, ākāralopasya sthānivatvādanupadhākhakāra iti |
pratyayavidhiviṣayaṃ caitat, yatropadhāsaṃjñānibandhana pratyayo
vidhātumiṣyate tatraivetyarthaḥ, ghaṭayatītyādau tu tanna bhavati |
caṅparo ye nirhāso hrasvastatra na sthānivadbhavati--vāditavantaṃ
prayojitavān avīvadad vīṇāṃ parivādakena, yo'sau ṇau
ṇirlupyate tasya sthānivadbhāvād ṇau caṅyupadhāyā hrasvo na
syāt, yaścaṅparo ṇirna tasminnaṅgasyopadhā,
yasmiṃścāṅgasyopadhā na caṅpara iti | kutvam--pācayateḥ ktici
pāktiḥ | kutvamupalakṣaṇam | lehayaterleḍhiḥ, dohayaterdogdhiḥ,
yācayateryāktiḥ, veśayaterveṣṭirityādi ||
dvirvacane'ci || 1|1|59 ||
"acaḥ parasmin" ityatra "yo'nādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvaḥ" iti sthitam |
sāckasya dvirvacanaṃ na tvacaḥ pūrvasyetyaprāptaṃ sthānivatvaṃ vidhīyate,
rūpātideśārtha ca |
atra ṣaṭ pakṣāḥ sambhavanti | acītyādeśopalakṣaṇam, dvirvacana iti
viṣayanirdeśaḥ, aci yo'jādeśaḥ sa dvirvacane sthānivadbhavatīti
prathamaḥ pakṣaḥ | acītyetadapi sthānivadbhāvenaiva sambadhyate, dvirvacana
iti viṣayanirdeśād, dvirvacane kartavye'jādeśaḥ
sthānivadbhavatyaci para iti dvitīyaḥ | dvirvacananimitatvādajeva
dvirvacanagrahaṇena viṣeṣyate,
dvirvacanamasminnastītyarśāadyacpratyayāntena vā, adhikaraṇasādhanena vā,
ādeśopalakṣaṇam, dvirvacananimite'ci yo'jādeśa- sa sthānivaditi
tṛtīyaḥ | evaṃ viśeṣitaṃ vājgrahaṇaṃ sthānivadbhāvasya viśeṣaṇam,
ajādeśaḥ sthānivadbhavati dvirvacananimite'ci parata iti caturthaḥ |
dvirvacanagrahaṇamā vartate, tatraikenājviśeṣyate, pareṇa viṣayī
nirdiśyata iti sthite tadviśeṣitamajgrahaṇaṃ sthānivadbhāvasya
viśeṣataṇam, dvirvacane kartavye'jādeśaḥ sthānivadbhavati
dvirvacananimite'ci parata iti pañcamaḥ | evameva
sthite'jgrahaṇamādeśopalakṣaṇam, dvirvacananimite'ci yo'jādeśaḥ
sa dvirvacane kartavye sthānivadbhavatīti ṣaṣṭhaḥ |
atrādye pakṣe'co dvirvacanenāviśeṣitatvād dvirvacananimite'pyaci
ādeśaḥ syānivatsyāt, tataścācikīrtad ityatra ṇici "upadhāyāśca"
itītvasya "caṅ" īti dvirvacane sthānivadbhāvādacakīrtaditi syāt
| dudyauuṣati--ūṭhi yaṇādeśaḥ sthānivatsyāt | bhavanamicchati,
bhavanīyateḥ san, bibhavanīyiṣati-lyuṭi kṛtayorguṇāvādeśāyoḥ
sthānivatve bubhavanīyiṣatītyaniṣṭṃa rūpaṃ prāpnoti | dvitīye tu
acikīrtadityatra na doṣaḥ, itvasya takāreṇa vyavahitatvāt
sthānivadbhāvabhājo hyādeśasya
sthānivatvavidhānavelāyāmacyacanantare sthānivatvena bhavitavyam |
evaṃ hyaci parataḥ sthānivadbhāvaḥ kṛto bhavati | dudyauuṣatītyādau tu
syādeva | yayāvityatra "āta au ṇalaḥ" ityaukāreṇa vṛddhau kṛtāyāṃ
saṃpratyādeśātparo'jnāstīti sthānivatvaṃ na syāt |
jagmaturityādau ca "gamahana" ityupadhālopasya vyavahitatvānna syāt
| tṛtīye tu kālāvadhāraṇaṃ kartavyam, anyathā
dvirvacanādutarakālamapi sthānirūpamevāvatiṣṭheta | caturthe tu
yayau, jagmaturityādau pūrvoktanyāyena sthānivadbhāvo na
prāpnoti, kālāvadhāraṇaṃ ca kartavyam | pañcame'pi yayau,
jagmaturityādau na syāt, ata eteṣu pakṣeṣvevaṃ doṣasambhavāt
ṣaṣṭhṃa pakṣamāśrityāha-dvirvacananimiteḥ'cītyādi | atra hi pakṣe
dvirvacanenāco viśeṣaṇādacikīrtat, dudyauuṣati,
bibhavanīyiṣatītyādau na doṣaḥ | ādeśopalakṣaṇatvācca
yayāvityādāvapi na doṣaḥ punaśca dvirvacanagrahaṇāt
kālāvadhāraṇamapi labhyate | nanu "dvirvacananimite'ci yo'jādeśaḥ"
ityucyamāne nunāvayiṣati, cakṣāvayiṣati, pusphārayiṣatītyādau
ṇeradvirvacananimitatvātannimitāvādeśaḥ, ākāraśca na
sthānivatsyāt; tataścābhyāsa ukāro na śrūyeta, naiṣa
doṣaḥ;"puyaṇji" iti jñāpakād dvitvanimite'pi ṇau
sthānivatvāpāyāt | tathā hi- na hi ṇau kṛtasya
sthānivadbhāvamantareṇa oḥ parāḥ puyaṇjyo'varṇaparāḥ sambhavanti;
pipaviṣati, yiyaviṣati-ityatra sambhava iti cet, kimetāvatā
pugrahaṇaṃ pratyāhāragrahaṇaṃ jagrahaṇaṃ cārthavadbhavatīti ?
jñāpakamuktārthasya yadyevam; acikīrtadityatretvasya
sthānivatvādacakīrtaditi syāt, naiṣa doṣaḥ; jñāpakasya
tulyajātīyāpekṣatvāt yatrotarabhāgasyādyo'varṇaparo bhāvastatraiva
sthānivatvajñāpanāt | nanvevamapi "oḥ puyaṇ" ityatra
ṇerityaśravaṇātsāmānyena dvitvanimitaṃ sthānitvaṃ vijñāyeta,
tataśca vibhavanīyiṣatītyatrāpi syāt, na hyatrājamātraṃ
dvirvacananimitam, kva tarhi syāt ? cakāra, cakre ityādau hyajmātraṃ
pratyayaḥ | syādetat-parasminnityanuva-tamacītyanena viśeṣyate, tatra
yasminvidhistadādāvalgrahaṇamiti tadādividhirbhavati | ajādau
parasminniti dvirvacananimitatvenāpi ajādyeva viśeṣyata iti |
evamapi cakraturityatra syāt, yad dvirvacananimitamajādi na
tadādeśasya nimitam; acyeva yaṇo vidhānāt | yaccādeśasya
nimitaṃ na tad dvirvacanasya nimitam; papataḥ cakhnaturityādāvena
tu syāt | kiñca "yasminvidhiḥ" iti vacanādyatra kiñcidvidhīyate
tatraiva tadādividhiḥ, iha tu aci yo'jādeśa
ityanuvādatvātadādividherevāsambhavastasyamādajeva gṛhyate, na
tadādiḥ, ucyate; cakraturityādāvatusodvirvacanaṃ prati
nimitatvenāśrayaṇe'pyaci paratrāvasthite dvirvacanaṃ
dṛṣṭamityetāvatājeva dvirvacananimitamityucyate | samudāye'pyayaṃ
dvirvacanaśabda upacāreṇa pravartate | evamapi papaturityatra na syāt,
āllopasyājādinimitaṃ nājmātram, naiṣa doṣaḥ; "aci yo'jādeśaḥ"
iti ko'rthaḥ ? aci yo dṛṣṭa ityarthaḥ | yaścāci vidhīyate,
yaścājādau-dvāvapi aci dṛṣṭāveveti sarvatra sidhyati | atha
vā-ajādāvāllopo na halādau, tatra prāptāprāptavivekenāca eva
mimitatvam | dvirvacana eva kartavya iti
evakāreṇaitaddarśayati--dvirvacanagrahaṇamacaṃ viśinaṣṭi,kālaṃ
cāvadhārayatīti | ekasyobhayasambandhe hi bhavati evakāraḥ-devadato
grāmaṃ gacchatu sa eva gāmānayatviti | yadyatrāpi pūrvavatkāryātideśaḥ
syāt; cakraturityādāvanackatvādaprāptaṃ dvirvacanaṃ
sthānivadbhāvād bhavadapi yaṇādyādeśayuktasyaiva syādityabhayāse
sthānirūpaṃ na śrūyeta, tadarthamāha-rūpātideśaścāyamiti | "ca"
śabdo'vadhāraṇe | kathaṃ punaravagamyate rūpātideśo'yamiti ?
ajgrahaṇāt | taddhijeghrīyata ityatra "ī ghrādhmoḥ" iti halādau
vihitasyetvasya sthānivatvaṃ mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ kriyate | yadi ca
rūpaṃ sthānivat, tato'satyajgrahaṇe ghrāyghrīydhmāydhmīy
iti dvirvacanaṃ syāditi tannavṛtaye'jagrahaṇamarthavad bhavati | atha
hi--kāryaṃ sthānivad bhavati, tasya satyapi sthānivatve
īkārayuktasyaiva dvirvacanamiti nārtho'jgrahaṇena | bhasestu kvasau
"ghasibhasorhali" ityupadhālope kṛte satyasati vā
dvirvacanebhsvāniti śrutau viśeṣābhāvaḥ | chāndasaca kvasuḥ,
cchandasidṛṣṭānuvidhānamato jñāpakamevājgrahaṇam | tatra yadyapi
sthānyeva svarūpamāpadyate,
tathāpyātideśikānātideśikarūpabhedāśrayastu vatirdvirvacana eva
kartavya ityetadeva spaṣṭayati | niyatakāla iti | kṛte dvirvacane
ityādinā niyatakālatvameva darśayati | yadi kṛte dvirvacane
punarādeśarūpamevāvatiṣṭhate, yathā--cakraturityādau
dvirvacanādūrdhvaṃ pūrvaṃ kṛto yaṇādeśa eva śrūyate tathā
ninyaturityādāvapi dvirvacanātpūrvamekāctvādi, yaṅadeśe kṛte
sthānivadbhāvād dvirvacane'pi pūrvapravṛta iyaṇeóva syāt | astuḥ
tasya "asiddhavadatrābhāt" ityasiddhatvād "eranekācaḥ" iti yaṇi sati
śravaṇaṃ na bhaviṣyati | yadvā-pūrvapravṛto'pīyaṅ dvirvacanakāle'pahṛta
iti punaḥ pravartayitavyaḥ, tasyāṃ ca daśāyāma nekāctvādyaṇā bādhyate
| yadyevam, iyeṣa uvoṣeti iṣeruṣeśca liṭi tipi ṇali
pravṛttsyāpi guṇasya dvirvacanakāle'pahṛtatvātkṛte dvirvacane punaḥ
pravṛttiḥ, tataścānādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvatvenābhyāso dṛṣṭa iti
tasyābhyāsasya uvaṅ kirtavye guṇasya sthānivadbhāvādasavarṇaṃ iti
pratiṣedhaḥ syāt | asavarṇagrahaṇasāmarthyātsthānivatvaṃ na bhaviṣyati |
asta vicanasyāvakāśaḥ-iyarti, iyṛtaḥ | hyaekamudāharaṇamasavarṇegrahaṇaṃ
prayojayati | yadyetāvatprayojanaṃ syāt, artāvityeva brūyāt | ki
tarhyucyate--dvirvacane punarādeśarūpamevāvatiṣṭhata iti, atra hi
"punaḥ" śabdād, "avatiṣṭhate" iti vacanācca
pūrvakṛtasyaivādeśasyonmajjanamevoktaṃ pratīyata iti ? nāyamarthaḥ;
api tu kṛte dvirvacane sthānirūpaṃ nāvatiṣṭhate yatprāptaṃ
tadbhavatītyevaṃparametat |
allopetyādi | upalakṣaṇametat | taturiḥ, papurirityadau "āñta
īddhātoḥ" "udoṣṭha|lpūrvasya" "bahulaṃ cchandasi" iti itvotvayarapi
sthānivatvaṃ bhavati |
āṭiṭaditi | aṭaterṇyantālluṅ ciṅ "ijāderdvitīyasya" iti
ṭiśabdasya dvirvacanam, "āḍajādīnām" | nināyetyādi | "ṇalutamo
vā" iti yadā ṇitvaṃ nāsti tadā guṇaḥ, ṇitvapakṣe vṛddhiḥ |
nenailolāiti dvirvacanamiti | gṛṇavṛddhyostu sthānivadbhāve
viśeṣābhāvānnoktaḥ |
jagle, mamla iti | bhāve liṭ, anaimitikamātvam, śiti tu
pratiṣedha ityātvasya sthānivatvaṃ na bhavati | śravaṇamityādi | yadi
kālo nāvadhāryeta, tadotarakālamapi sthānirūpaṃ prasajyeta,
tataścākārasya śravaṇe sati pareṇa saha "vṛddhireci" iti vṛddhiḥ syāt
| ihādhijage iti "gāṅliṭi" iti dvilakāranirdeśena lakārādau
liṭi gāṅadeśavidhānādajnimitatvābhāvāt sthānivatvābhāvaḥ ||
adarśanaṃ lopaḥ || 1|1|60 ||
iha darśanaṃ jñānamupalabdhiḥ | tacca
śabdānuśāsanaprastāvācchabdaviṣayaṃ sacchravaṇaṃ bhavatītyāha-aśravaṇamiti
| śravaṇaṃ ca śrotṛvyāpāraḥ, tanniṣedhe "lopo vyorvali" ityasya
vakārayakārau valparau na śrotavyāvityarthaḥ syāt | tataśca
prayoktṛvyāpāra uccāraṇamaniṣiddhaṃ syāt | asati śravaṇe
uccāraṇamanarthakameva syāditi śravaṇaniṣedhena
taddhetubhūtamuccāraṇameva niṣiddhaṃ bhavatītyāha-anuccāraṇamiti |
"lopo vyorvali" ityasya ko'rthaḥ ? vakārayakārau valparau
noccārayitavyāviti | anenāpi prakāreṇāsminviṣaye tayorabhāva
eva vyākhyāpito bhavati, na hi vidyamānayoranuccāraṇamupapadyata
ityāha-abhāva iti | svābhāvika evābhāva ityarthaḥ | vināśa iti |
kāryaśabdadarśana etat | anarthāntaramiti | śabdaviṣayāṇāmeṣāmartho
na bhidyata ityarthaḥ | śvaṃ rūpam" iti vacanād adarśanaśabdasyaiva
saṃjñāyāṃ lopapradeśeṣu adarśanaśabda evādeśaḥ syādityata āha--etaiḥ
śabdairiti | etacca ṅaveti vibhāṣā" ityata itikaraṇānuvṛterlabhyate
| atha vā-mahatī saṃjñā kriyate, anvarthā yathā vijñāyeta-lopanaṃ lopa
iti | na cādarśanaśabdo lopanakriyā bhavati | yadyevam,
pradeśeṣvevārthagrahaṇamastu, kiṃ saṃjñayā ? tanna; asati saṃjñākaraṇe
śvaṃ rūpam" iti vacanāt pradeśeṣu lopaśabda evādeśaḥ syāt |
sati tvaśabdasaṃjñeti niṣedhānna svarūpagrahaṇaṃ bhavati | na śabdasyeti |
arthasiddhamapyetadvispaṣṭārtha punaruktam | nanu
vidhipradeśeṣvitaretarāśrayaḥ prāpnoti-sato'darśanasya saṃjñā,
saṃjñayā cādarśanaṃ bhāvyata iti, tanna; na hi
lopavidhānātpragasadevādarśanaṃ vacanena bhāvyate,
anityatvaprasaṅgāt, kiṃ tarhi ? sadevādarśanaṃ
sādhutvenānvārūyāyate | yadyevam, sarvasya svaviṣayādanyatra
svabhāvato'darśanamastīti lopasaṃjñā syāt | tataśca dadhi, madhviti
ṇico'darśanasya lopasaṃjñāyāṃ pratyayalakṣaṇena vṛddhiḥ syāt |
aṅgasya vṛddhiḥ, aṅgasaṃjñā ca vidhānapratibaddhā | kvipastarhyadarśanasya
lopasaṃjñāyāṃ tuk prāpnoti, tatrāha-prasaktasyeti | evaṃ
manyate-śthāne" iti vartate; sthānaṃ ca prasaṅgaḥ; tena prasaṅge
yadadarśanaṃ tasya lopasaṃjñā, na ca dadhītyatra kvipaḥ
kenacitprasaṅgo'sti | evamapi gramaṇīrityatra
karmadhātukartṛsannidhānādasti aṇaḥ prasaṅga iti tadadarśanasya
saṃjñāyāṃ vṛddhiḥ syāt | yo'trāṇaḥ prasaṅgaḥ, kvipā so'pāhriyate |
sāmānyaśāstraṃ hi viśeṣasannidhau tadvyatirikta eva viṣaye pratītiṃ
janayati | tena śatsūdviṣa" ityasya sannidhau "karmaṇyaṇ" ityanena
nayateraṇ bhavatīti buddhireva na janyate ||
pratyayasya lukśalulupaḥ || 1|1|61 ||
"adarśanam" iti sambandhāt "pratyayasya" iti karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī | yadi
pratyayādarśanasya lugadisaṃjñāsaṅkaraḥ prāpnoti, vidhānadaśāyāṃ
yayā kayācana saṃjñayā bhāvitasya pratyayādarśanasyānuvādapradeśeṣu
yatkiñcanasaṃjñoccāraṇe'pi grahaṇaprasaṅgaḥ, tataśca-atīti luksaṃjñāyā
bhāvitasyāpi śapo'darśanasya "ślau" ityatra grahaṇād dvirvacanaṃ
syāt; juhotīti-"uto vṛddhirluki hali" iti vṛddhiḥ syāt;
harītakyā phalāni-"luktaddhitaluki" iti ṅīṣo luk syāt;
"lavaṇāl luk" lavaṇassūpaḥ, yuktavadbhāvaḥ syāt; tathā
lopasaṃjñayā bhāvitasyāpi luksaṃjñāyā agomati gomatī sampannā
gomatībhūtā brāhmaṇīti cverlope "luk taddhitaluki" iti luk
syādityata āha-anekasaṃjñāvidhānāccetyādi |
yadyatadbhāvitasyāpyetāḥ saṃjñāḥ syuḥ, nekasaṃjñākaraṇamanarthakaṃ syāt
| ekāmeva saṃjñāṃ kṛtvā tayaiva sarvāṇi kāryāṇi vidhīyeran !
tasmādanekasaṃjñāvidhānādyayā saṃjñayā yadadarśanaṃ bhavatitaṃ tasyaiva sā
saṃjñeti saṃjñānāṃ saṅkaro na bhavati | yadyevam,
vidhipradeśeṣvitaretarāśrayaḥ prāpnoti | na cātra nityatayā
parihāraḥ sambhavāti; adarśanameva hi nityam; na
punarlugādisaṃjñayā bhāvitam | tatra yadi tayā saṃjñayā
bhāvitasyādarśanasya sā saṃjñeti, vyaktamitaretarāśrayo bhavati,
tatrāha-vidhipradeśeṣu ceti | adiprabhṛtibhyaḥ parasya śapastadbhavati,
yasya bhūtasya luksaṃjñā bhaviṣyatītyevaṃ bhāvinyāḥ saṃjñāyā vijñānānna
bhavatītaretarāśrayatvadoṣaḥ | lopasaṃjñātvadarśanamātrasya vidhīyata
iti lugādisaṃjñāviṣaye'pi bhavatyeva | na ca lugādisaṃjñābhibadhiḥ;
ekasaṃjñādhikārādanyatra saṃjñānāṃ samāveśāt | ata eva " na
lumatāṅgasya" iti niṣedhaḥ | varaṇā iti | "adūrabhavaśca" ityaṇaḥ
"varaṇādibhyaśca" iti lup |
pratyayagrahaṇaṃ kimati | na tāvadapratyayanivṛtyartham; lug, aṇiñoḥ,
tadrājasya yañañośca, śapaḥ, yaṅaḥ, sicaḥ, leḥ, supaḥ iti sarvatra
pratyayasyaiva nirdeśād, anuvādeṣu ca tadbhāvitasyaiva tasya
saṃpratyayāt | "gostriyorupasarjanasya" ityatra yogo
vibhajyate--"gorupasarjanasya striyāḥ" iti, "luk taddhitaluki" iti
striyā ityeva;goriti nivṛtam; itarathā kṛte'pi pratyayagrahaṇe
gamerḍo luk syāt, "kaṃsīyaparaśabyayoryañañau luk ca" ityatra
ṅyāpprātipadikādhikārāt kaṃsīyaparaśavyayoḥ
pratipadikātparasya bhāgasya lugvijñāsyate, na prakṛtibhāgasya; anyathā
kṛte'pi pratyayagrahaṇe kameḥ saḥ kaṃsaḥ, parān śṛṇāti paraśuriti
ukārasakārayorluk syāt, ato'pratyayanivṛtyartha tāvatpratyagrahaṇaṃ
na kartavyam | yatra tarhi na
kaścinnirdiśyate--"atribhṛgukutsavasiṣṭhagotamāṅgirobhyaśca" iti,
atra pratyayapratipatyarthaṃ pratyayagrahaṇaṃ bhaviṣyati ? naivam; tatrāpi
"yaskādibhyo gotre" ityayo gotragrahaṇānuvṛteratryādibhyo gotre
yo vihitastasya luk, tathā "janapade lup" ityatra
"ṅyāpprātipadikātapratyayaḥ " ityanuvṛteḥ janapade vihitasya
cāturarthikapratyayasyaiva lup | "lavaṇālluk" ityadiṣvapi
prakṛtasya, ataḥ pratyayasya pratipatyarthamapi na kartavyaṃ bhavati | sarvatra
cātryādibhyaḥ pratipadikāllavaṇāditi pañcamyadhikāreṇa sannihitasya
ṣaṣṭhaāā prakalpayiṣyati, sā cāniyatayogatvāt sthānaṣaṣṭhī
bhaviṣyatīti sthānaṣaṣṭhīpratipatyarthamapi pratyayagrahaṇaṃ na kartavyaṃ
bhavati |
evaṃ tarhi sarvādeśārthaṃ pratyayagrahaṇam; asati tasmin
"yañañośca",śupo dhātu prātipadikayoḥ" ityādiṣu yatrānekāl
pratyayaḥ, tatrālo'ntyasya syāt, "lavaṇālluk" ityādau tu ādeḥ
syāt; sati tu pratyayagrahaṇe tatsāmarthyāt sarvādeśo
lugādirbhavati ? jñāpakātsiddham, yadayam "ghorlopo leṭi vā" iti
lope prakṛte "lugvā duhadiha" iti lukaṃ
śāsti,tajjñāpayati--"lugādayaḥ sarvādeśāḥ" iti | "alo'ntyasya"
hyadarśanaṃ prakṛtena lopenāpi siddham | viparyayastu na bhavati,
"ghorlopaḥ" ityatra tāvadasaṃjātavirodhitvād "alo'ntyasya" iti
pravartate, paścālluggrahaṇaṃ tasyaiva sarvādeśatāṃ gamayati |
sāmānyena ca jñāpakaṃ samarthayiṣyate--"lopavyatiriktamadarśanaṃ
sarvādeśaḥ" iti | ataḥ sarvādeśārthamapi pratyagrahaṇaṃ na kartavyamiti
praśnaḥ |
itaro'pi viditābhiprāyaḥ pariharati | āgastayaḥ kuṇḍinā iti |
asati pratyayagrahaṇe āgastyakauṇḍinyayorityatra "lugaṇiñoḥ" ityato
luggrahaṇamanuvartate vā ? na vā ?
anuvṛtau--sthāninau dvau, lukā saha traya ādeśā iti vaiṣamyādasati
yathāsaṅkhye ekaikasya traya ādeśāḥ paryāyeṇa syuḥ |
tataścāgastayo'pi kuṇḍināḥ syuḥ, kuṇḍināścāgastayaḥ syuḥ | luk
ca kriyamāṇo yadi jñāpakātsarvādeśaḥ, tata ubhayatrāpi
vibhaktimātraśravaṇaprasaṅgaḥ |
atha nivṛtam--tato'gastayaḥ, kuṇḍinā ityatra na kaściddoṣaḥ |
agastīnāṃ chātrā āgastīyā ityatra tu prāgdīvyatīye'jādau pratyaye
vivakṣite'pyagastyādeśasya ni,edhābhāvāt pravṛtāvavṛddhatvācchāe na
syāt; pratyayagrahaṇe tu sati
luggrahaṇānuvṛtyā''gastyakauṇḍinyayoḥ pratyayāṃśasya lugna bhavati |
pariśiṣṭayorbhāgayoryathāsaṃkhyamagastikuṇḍinacāvityarthaḥ sampadyate;
tenagastayaḥ, kuṇḍinā iti ca siddhyati | prāgdīvyatīye ca
vivakṣite "gotre lugaci" iti luki pratiṣiddhe
tatsanniyogaśiṣṭatvādagastyādeśe'pi nivṛte āgastyaśabdasya
vṛddhatvācche kṛte śūryatiṣyāgastya" iti yalope cagastīyā iti
siddhyati | kauṇḍinye ca nāsti viśeṣaḥ, nivṛte'pi
kuṇḍinajādeśe kauṇḍinyaśabdādapi "kaṇvādibhyo gotre" iti aṇi
kṛte "āpatyasya" iti yalope kauṇḍinā ityeva bhavitavyam | ata
āgastyakauṇḍinyayorityatrāvaśyamanuvartyaṃ luggrahaṇam | tataśca
pūrvoktadoṣaparihārāya pratyayagrahaṇamapi kartavyam |
vayantu brūmaḥ-śarvādeśārthamapi pratyayagrahaṇaṃ sāmānyena
jñāpakamagatikagati" ita ||
pratyayalope pratyayalakṣaṇamiti || 1|1|62 ||
sūtrārambhasya prayojanamāha--pratyayanimitamityādi |
lakṣaṇaśabdo'yamasti bhāvasādhanaḥ prādurbhāvavacanaḥ, asti ca
karaṇasādhano nimitavacanaḥ | tatrādyasya grahaṇe pratyayalope sati
pratyayasya prādurbhāvo bhavatītyarthaḥ syāt | tatra luptasyaiva pratyayasya
punaḥ prādurbhāvavidhau lopavidhirvyarthaḥ syāt | nanu ca yaḥ
pratyasyaiva lopaḥ "ṇeraniṭi" ityādi, tasya vaiyarthyaṃ nāmāstu; yastu
"ṭeḥ" ityādinā sāmānyena vihitaḥ, sa yadā pratyayasya
bhavati--bhikṣumācaṣṭe bhikṣayatīti, tadā tasya punaḥ prādurbhāve'pi na
tasya vaiyarthyam; upratyaye caritārthatvāt | evaṃ tarhi luptasyaiva
pratyayasya punaḥ prādurbhāva iṣṭe, na pratyayasya lopa iti
vaktavyam--sāmānyavihito lopaḥ pratyayasya na bhavatīti |
atha pratyayāntarasya luptapratyayanimitakasya pādurbhāvo vidhīyate,
yathā--grāmaṇīriti kvipo lope tannimitasya sorvidhiḥ | evamapi
"pratyayalope pratyaya" ityeva vaktavyam--pratyayasya lope na
tannimitakaḥ pratyayo bhavatīti | ato nimitaparyāyeṇa lakṣaṇaśabdena
bahuvrīhiḥ, kāryaṃ cānyapadārthaṃ ityāha--pratyayahetukaṃ kāryamiti |
pratyāsateśca yaḥ pratyayo yasya kāryasya nimitaṃ tasya lope'pi
tadbhavatītyarthaḥ |
padasaṃjñā bhavatīti | nanu ca sthānivadbhāvenāpi siddhā padasaṃjñā,
iha tarhi tā tā piṇāḍānāmiti-tacchabdātparasya jasaḥ śiḥ,
"śeścchandasi bahulam" iti lope ṅapuṃsakasya jhalacaḥ" iti num,
"sarvanāmasthāne" iti dīrghaśca bhavati; anaḍvān-- sorlope
numbhavati; adhok--aḍguṇau bhavataḥ; nyamārṭ-mṛjervṛddhiḥ;
underlaṅ itilope śnamāṭau bhavataḥ; "śnānnalopaḥ"--aunat;
agnicit-kvipo lope tugbhavati ? etānyapi sthānivadbhāvenaiva
siddhyanti; alvidhitvāt | sarvatraivālmatrapratyayaḥ, tadāśrayo
vidhiralvidhiriti | naitatsuṣṭhūacyate, uktaṃ hi kāryāpekṣamalvidhitvaṃ
nodāharaṇāpekṣamiti | numādividhau ca sarvatra śāstre
yadrūpamāśrīyate--sarvanāmasthāne sārvadhātuke piti kṛti
suptiṅntamiti, sādhāraṇaṃ tadalaścānalaśca | kevalaṃ tātā
piṇḍānāmityādyaudāharaṇe'rthādalātmakaṃ tadityetāvat |
iha tarhi atṛṇeṭ-"tṛhi hisāyām", laṅ, tip, śnam,"itaśca"
itīkāralopaḥ, takārasya halṅyādilope halādau piti
sārvadhātuke vidhīyamāno'lvidhiḥ "tṛṇahaim" asmādbhavati;
tathā āśīrityatra "śāsa īdaṅhaloḥ" itītvaṃ lupte'pi kvipi bhavati
| nanu ca "varṇāśraye nāsti pratyayalakṣaṇam"; naivaṃvidhaṃ vacanamasti |
dvitīyasya pratyayagrahaṇasya prayojanamidaṃ paṭha|lte - atra hi "
pratyayalope tallakṣaṇam" ityeva siddhe punaḥ pratyayagrahaṇādyatra
pratyayasyaivāsādhāraṇaṃ rūpaṃ nimitatvenāśrīyate supi sārvadhātuke
kṛti suptiṅntamiti tadeva yathā syāt | tena
gohitamityavādeśo na bhavati | na hi "eco'yavāyāvaḥ" ityatra
pratyayasyāsādhāraṇaṃ kiñcidrūpamupātam, kintvacīti yadupātaṃ
tadgave hitamityasminnudāharaṇe arthātpratyayātmakamityetāvat |
itvemāgamayostu halādau kṅiti halādau piti sārvadhātuka iti
pratyaya eva prādhānyena nimitam, hal tu tadviśeṣaṇamiti nemau
varṇāśrayau | tasmādalvidhyarthamidamārabdhavyam |
yadyevam, bhasaṃjñāṅīpṣpheṣu doṣaḥ | bhasaṃjñāyāṃ tāvad-rājñaḥ
puruṣo rājapuruṣa iti śrūyamāṇe pratyaye yathā saṃjñā bhavati, evaṃ
lupte'pi syāt | tataśca tayā padasaṃjñāyā bādhitatvād lanopo na
syāt | nanu ca dve atra padasaṃjñe--svādāviti ca, suptiṅntamiti ca
| tatra yā svādau padamiti padasaṃjñā, sā'pavādabhūtayā bādhyate; yā
tu śuptiṅntam" iti padasaṃjñā, sā na bādhanīyā, yathā--śrūyamāṇe
pratyaye "rājñaḥ" iti samudāyasya ? naitadevam; śrūyamāṇe pratyaye
tataḥ pūrvasya bhāgasya bhasaṃjñā, samudāyasya tu visarjanīyāntasya
padasaṃjñeti yuktam-vibhinnāvadhikayā bhasaṃjñayā padasaṃjñā na bādhyata
iti | lupte tu pratyaye yasyaivāvadheḥ svādau padamiti
padasaṃjñā,subantaṃ padamityapi tasyaivāvadheḥ padasaṃjñā | tatraivāvadhau
bhasaṃjñā bhavantī yathā'yavadatvāt svādilakṣaṇāṃ padasaṃjñāṃ bādhate,
tathā subantalakṣaṇāmapi paratvādvādhate |
evaṃ tarhi ṅa lumatāṅgasya" iti pratiṣedhād bhasaṃjñā na bhaviṣyati,
yacīti saptamīnirdeaṣāt | tataḥ pūrvasya bhāgasya vastuto'sya
pravartamānā bhasaṃjñāpyaṅgakāryameva | evaṃ ca budhvā ṅa
ṅisaṃbuddhyoḥ" ityatra ṅai nalopaḥ pratiṣidhyate, yadi
pratyayalakṣaṇena bhasaṃjñā syād, apavādatvādevārdrea carmanniti nalopo
na bhaviṣyatīti kiṃ tena pratiṣedhena ? iha tarhi citrāyāṃ jātā
"citrārevatīrohiṇībhyaḥ striyāmupasaṃkhyānam" ityaṇo luki
"luktaddhitaluki" iti ṭāpi lupte, citra iti sthite
pratyayalakṣaṇenāṇantatvāt ṅīp prāpnoti, naiṣa doṣaḥ;
"ṭiḍḍhāṇañ" ityatra "ataḥ" ityanuvartate, tatra cāṇākāro
viśeṣyate--aṇo'kāra iti, tataścākāra eva ṅīpo nimitam; aṇ tu
tadviśeṣaṇamiti pratyayalakṣaṇatvābhāvād ṅībabhāvaḥ |
iha tarhi vataṇḍasyātyaṃ strī "vataṇḍācca" ityañaḥ "luk striyām" iti
luki vataṇḍī-śārṅgaravādilakṣaṇaṃ ṅīnaṃ bādhitvā "prācāṃ
ṣphastaddhitaḥ sarvatra" iti sarvatragrahaṇasya pūrvatrāpakarṣātprācāṃ matena
yañantalakṣaṇaḥ ṣphaḥ prāpnoti, yathā āvaṭa|laccāpaṃ vā bādhitvā ṣpha eva
bhavatīti ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; atrāpi yañākāro viśeṣyate-yaño'kāra
iti, yañavayavo yo'kārastadantāditi | tenātrāpyakāra eva
nimitam, tadviśeṣaṇantu yañiti ṣpho na bhavati | ayaṃ tarhi
doṣaḥ-parivīriti, paripūrvāddhyeñaḥ kvipo lope yajāditvāt
saṃprasāraṇe pūrvatve ca tuk prāpnoti, "halaḥ" iti dīrghaśca; tatra
vipratiṣedhena dīrgha iṣyate, sa vipratiṣedho na siddhyati |
kiṅkāraṇam ? iha pratyayalope sarvāṇi pratyayāśrayāṇi kāryāṇi
paryavasannāni, tānyanena pratyutthāpyante, anenaiva tuk, anenaiva
dīrghaḥ-tadekayogalakṣaṇayorayukto vipratiṣedhaḥ ? naiṣa doṣaḥ;
avasthite pratyaye, tannibandhanaṃ yatkāryaṃ bhavatyeva tadevānena lupte
tasmin pratyutthāpyate, na tu yasya prāptimātraṃ tadapi |
parivīyetyādau śrūyamāṇe pratyaye dīrgha eva paratvād bhavati, na
tuk; tataścātrāpi yadi kvibevāsthāsyad, dīrgha evābhaviṣyaditi sa
evānena pratyutthāpyate | tadevamārabdhavyaṃ sūtraṃ na kaściddoṣa iti
sthitam |
atrocyate--yaduktaṃ "tṛṇaha im" halāśraya iti; nāyaṃ halāśrayaḥ,
halīti nivartiṣyate | yadi nivartate, tṛṇahāni--atrāpi prāpnoti ?
nābhyastasyācītyato nācītyanuvartate, tataścānalvidhitvāt
sthānivadbhāvenaiva siddha imāgamaḥ | āśīrityatrāpi "āsāsaḥ
kvāvupasaṃkhyānam" ityasmād vacanātsiddhamitvam | ārabdhe'pi
khalvasmiṃstadavaśyaṃ vaktavyam | yadi tāvat "śāsa idaṅhaloḥ" ityatra
śāsimātrasya grahaṇam, tato niyamārtham "āśāsaḥ kvāveva yathā
syād, āśāsta ityādā mā bhūt" iti | atha yasmācchāseraṅ
vihitastasya grahaṇam, tato yathā''śāsta ityādau na bhavati tathā
kvipyapi na syāditi vidhyarthamidam | iha tarhi bidasyāpatyāni
bahūni "anuṣyānantarye bidādibhyo'ñ" bidāḥ, bidānāmapatyaṃ
yuvā, "ata iñ", tasya ṇyakṣatriyārṣañitaḥ" iti luki kṛte, año
gotrabahutva utpannasya luki prāpte"gotre'lugaci" iti pratiṣedha
iṣyate, so'jādāviti lupte'pyasmādvacanādbhavati ? etadapi nāsti
prayojanam; acīti viṣayasaptamī, tena gotra iti vivakṣite'nutpanna
eva luki pratiṣiddhe paścādiño lugiti siddhamiṣṭam |
tadevamalvidheḥ kasyacid darśanāt sthānivadbhaavenaiva siddhamiti
nārtho'nena |
evaṃ tarhi niyamārtamidam-"pratyayalope pratyayalakṣaṇameva yathā syāt
pratyayāpratyalakṣaṇaṃ mā bhūt" iti | etaduktaṃ bhavati--yasminkārye
vidhīyamāne pratyayasyaivāsādhāraṇaṃ kiñcidrūpaṃ nimitatvenāśrīyate,
tadeva pratyayalope'pi bhavati, na punaḥ pratyayāpratyasādhāraṇaṃ
rūpamāśritya yadvidhīyate taditi | tena śobhanā dṛṣado yasya
sudṛṣaditi śormanasī alomoṣasī" ityutarapadādyaudātatvaṃ na
bhavati | anyathā lupte'pi jasi sthānivadbhāvenāsantamutarapadamiti
syātprasaṅgaḥ | pratyayalakṣaṇaṃ tu na bhavati, "aninasmangrahaṇānyarthavatā
cānarthakena tadantavidhiṃ prayojayanti" ityasmātasya grahaṇāt |
vṛttikāreṇa tu " niyamārthamapyetat pratyayalope sarvatra pravartate"
iti matvoktaṃ padasaṃjñā bhavatīti | āghnayeti | "āṅe yamahanaḥ" |
saṃgmīyeti | śamo gamyacchi" ityātmanepadam, "iṭo't", bahulaṃ
cchandasi" iti śapo luk, ubhayatra "gamahana" ityupadhālopaḥ ||
na lumatāṅgasya || 1|1|63 ||
"lumatā" iti luśabdo yasminnasti sa lumānulugādiḥ saṃjñāśabdaḥ |
karaṇe ca tṛtīyā, lope ca karaṇatvam | "pratyayalope" ityanuvṛteḥ
lumatā śabdena pratyayalope sati aṅgasya pratyayalakṣaṇaṃ kāryaṃ na
bhavati | tatra ca pratyāsaterluptapratyayāpekṣayā yenāṅgasaṃjñā
pratilabdhā tasya tannimitaṃ kāryaṃ na bhavatīsyarthaḥ | etadeva vastuto
darśayati --lumatā lupte pratyaye yadaṅgamiti | tenotkrāmetyatra
"ato heḥ" iti luki kṛte parasmaipadāpekṣayā yayaṅgaṃśabantaṃ na
tasya dīrghatvam, yasya ca dīrghatvaṃ na tatparasmaipadāpekṣayāṅgam |
kiṃ tarhi ? śabapekṣayeti niṣedhābhāvāt pratyayalakṣaṇena "kramaḥ
parasmaipadeṣu" iti dīrgho bhavati, tathā "gameriṭ parasmaipadeṣu"
ṅa vṛdbhyaścaturbhyaḥ" iṭo vidhipratipredhau jigamiṣa vivṛtseti
parasmaipadalukyapi bhavataḥ | lumatā lupte parasmaipade yadaṅgaṃ
sanantaṃ na tasyeṭo vidhiniṣedhau, kiṃ tarhi ? sakārādeḥ
pratyayasyeti | idaṃ cānyadasmin granthe
darśitam-nāṅgasyetyanenāṅgādhikāraḥ pratinirdiśyate ṅa lumatā
lupte pratyaye āṅgaṃ bhavati" iti, kiṃ tarhi ? lumatā lupte pratyaye
yadṅgaṃ tasyāṅgamanāṅgaṃ ca sarvaṃ pratiṣidhyate iti | tena
gargāḥ, bidāḥ-yañañorluk, uṣṭragrīvaḥ-"ive pratikṛtau" iti kanaḥ
"devapathādibhyaśca" iti lup, panthāḥ priyo'sya
pathipriyaḥ--śupodhātu" iti sarvanāmasthānasya luk | atra
"ñnityādirnityam","pathimathoḥ sarvanāmasthāne" iti
cādyaudātasyānāṅgasyāpi niṣedho bhavati |
saptamīnirddeśāddhyetadvastuto'ṅgasya kāryam | tathā'hardadāti
- "roḥ supi" iti ratvapratiṣedho na bhavati | yadyanāṅgamapi
pratiṣidhyate, avadhi bhavatā dasyuḥ, āgāyi bhavatā grāmaḥ, adhyagāyi
bhavatā'nuvākaḥ; luṅ pirato'ṅgasya vidhīyamānā haniṇiṅadeśāḥ
"ciṇo luk" iti luṅe luki na syuḥ | na luṅ hiniṇiṅadeśā
vidhīyante, kiṃ tarhi ? luṅ yidārdhadhātukaṃ tatra | tataśca luṅi
yadaṅgaṃ ciṇantaṃ na tasya haniṇiṅadeśāḥ, yasya ca te na
tallukyaṅgamiti niṣedhābhāvaḥ |
iha tarhi "mā hi dātāṃ sarpirāgacchet" iti sijāmantritayorluki
sati "ādiḥ sico'nyatarasyām""āmantritasya ca" iti ādyaudātatvaṃ na
syāt ? naitadaṅgasya ciṇantaṃ kāryam, kiṃ tarhi ? tadantasya;
ṣaṣṭhīnirdeśāt | tena payaḥ sāmetyādau padasaṃjñā ca bhaviṣyati |
nanu yadyapi tadantasyādyaudātatvam, padasaṃjñā'pi, tathā lupte idānīṃ
pratyaye vastuto'ṅgasya prāpnuta iti bhavitavyaṃ niṣedhena ? nātra
lupte pratyaye yadaṅgasya prāptaṃ tanniṣidhyate, kiṃ tarhi ?
avasthite'pi pratyaye yatataḥ pūrvasyāṅgasya kāryaṃ tanniṣidhyate |
vṛkṣā mā hi lābiṣṭāmityādau ca śrūyamāṇo pratyaye tadantasyaiva
padasaṃjñā svaraśceti lupte'pi bhaviṣyataḥ | evaṃ ca rājñaḥ puruṣa iti
śrūyamāṇe ṅasi, tataḥ pūrvasya bhasaṃjñā na tadantasyeti
aṅgakāryatvāt lupte'pi tasmin pratyayalakṣaṇena prāptā'nena
niṣidhyate ||
iha tarhi atrerapatyāni "itaścāniñaḥ" iti ṭhakaḥ "atribhṛgu" iti luki
kṛte atraya iti taddhitasya "kitaḥ" ityantodātatvaṃ syāt,
tadantakāryatvāt, naiṣadoṣā; taddhitasyaivāntodātatvam, na
tadantasya |
iha tarhi sarvaḥ stomo yasya sarvastomaḥ-śarvasya supi"
ityādyaudātatvaṃ na syāt, supīti saptamīnirddeśāt ? kartavyo'tra
yatnaḥ | yatnaśca-sarvasya supa iti ṣaṣṭhīnirddeśaḥ ṣaṣṭhīnirdaśe tu
tadantakāryatvāt sicsvaravat sidhyati | nanu dvayoripa
pakṣayoḥ-abhūvan, pratyayalakṣaṇena jusprāpnoti, "ātaḥ" iti niyamānna
bhaviṣyati |
iha tarhi devadataṃ yājayāñcakāra--"āmaḥ" iti lukaṃ bādhitvā
paritvātibādhiṣu kṛteṣu teṣāṃ ca luki pratyayalakṣaṇena
tiṅntatvādāmantasya ca vidhātaḥ, tataḥ parasyānighātaśca prāpnoti,
lerityanuvṛterlāvasthāyāmeva lugbhaviṣyati | iha ca devadato
yuṣmatputra iti ṣaṣṭhantasya vidhīyamānau vāṃnānau "dvitīyāsthāyoḥ
iti sthagrahaṇānna bhavataḥ | ṣaṣṭhīcaturthīdvitīyāsvavasthānaṃ
śrūyamāṇasyaiva sambhavati |
iha tarhi paramavācā, paramagauduhā, paramalihā, paramadaṇḍinā,
paramadivāparamakumāryeti samāsārthā yā vibhaktiḥ,
tāmāśrityotarapadasya padasaṃjñāyāṃ prāptayām, "coḥ kuḥ",
"dāderdhātorghaḥ","ho ḍhaḥ ", nalopaḥ pratipadikāntasya" "diva
ut","iko'savarṇe śākalyasya hrasvaśca" iti -ete vidhayaḥ prāpnuvanti
naiṣa doṣaḥ; bhasaṃjñāviṣaye tāvatsaiva padasaṃjñāṃ bādhiṣyate | nanu ca
samudāyasya padasaṃjñā svādiṣvati prāptā sā tulyāvidhikayā
bhasaṃjñayā bādhyatām, yā tutarapadasya subantamiti prāpta sā kathaṃ
bādhyate, bhinnāvadhitvāt ? evaṃ tarhi śuptiṅntam" ityataḥ
subantamityanuvartanīyam, tataścāyamartho
bhavati-"yajādāvasarvanāmasthāne parataḥ pūrvassamudāyo bhasaṃjño
bhavati | tatra ca samudāye yatsubantaṃ vartate tadapi bhasaṃjñaṃ bhavati
yajādāvanantare" iti | tatra ca samudāyasya bhasaṃjñā pradhānaśiṣṭā,
avayavasya tvanvāyaśiṣṭā | yatra ca subantaṃ paśyati tatra tasyāpīti,
tena rājña ityādau subantābhāve'pi bhavati | subantasadbhāve tu
tasya samudāyasya ceti vivektavyam | sarvanāmasthāne'pi
"asarvanāmasthāne" iti pratiṣedhāt padasaṃjñā na bhaviṣyati | nanu
"svādiṣu" iti yā prāptiḥ samudāyasya, tasyā eva sa pratiṣedhaḥ,
netyāha; tatrāpi subantamityanuvartate, prasajyapratiṣedhaścāśrīyate,
tatsāmarthyāt "anantarasya vidhirvā bhavati pratiṣedho vā" iti
nāśrīyate; tataścāyamartho bhavati--śarvanāmasthāne parataḥ pūrvasay
samudāyasaṃya svādiṣviti prāptā padasaṃjñā na bhavati | tatra ca
yatsubantamavayavatvena vartate, tasya subantasya padasaṃjñā na bhavati"
iti | yadyevam; suvāk, surājeti sāvapi samudāyasyāvayavasya ca
svādiṣviti vā subantamiti vā padasaṃjñāyā abhāvāt kutvādi na
syāt | evaṃ tarhi "asarvanāmasthāne" ityatra utarasūtrādyacītyapakṛṣyate,
tato yajādau sarvanāmasthāne yā ca yāvatī ca padasaṃjñā, sā sarvā
pratiṣidhyate; sau tu svādiṣviti ca subantamiti ca bhavatyeva |
yadyevam, śrūyamāṇae'pi sau pūrvasya padasaṃjñā prāpnoti, tatra ko
doṣaḥ ? "eco'pragṛhyasya" ityatra padāntagrahaṇaṃ codayiṣyati-bhadraṃ
karoṣi gaurityatra mā bhūditi | tatra kriyamāṇe'pi padāntagrahaṇe
plutavikāraḥ prāpnoti, naiṣa doṣaḥ;
vākyapadayorantyasyetyevametadvijñāyate, tadevaṃ samāseṣūtarapadasya
padatvaṃ nāstīti sthitam | yadyevam, dadhisecau, dadhisecaḥ
śātpadādyoḥ" iti ṣatvaniṣedho na prāpnoti, naivaṃ
vijñāyate-padasyādiḥ padādiḥ, padāderneti, kathaṃ tarhi ? padādādiḥ
padādiḥ, dāderneti | kathamagniṣu, vākṣu, tvakṣu ? sātpratiṣedho
jñāpayatisvādau yatpadaṃ tataḥ parasya neti | avaśyaṃ ca
padādādirityevaṃ vijñeyam, anyathā "gatikārakopapadānāṃ
kṛdbhiḥ saha samāsavacanaṃ prāk subutpateḥ" iti yatra
subantamutarapadaṃ tatra pratiṣedho na syāt |
iha tarhi bahusecau, bahusecam, bahuco'padatvāt, pratiṣedho na
prāpnoti, vaktavyamevaitat "bahucpūrvasya na" iti, tatrāyaṃ
sūtranyāsaḥ-sāte saḥ ṣatvaṃ na bhavati, tato "bahucaḥ",bahucaḥ parasya
ṣatvaṃ na bhavati; ādigrahaṇaṃ na kartavyam, "ādeḥ parasya" ityeva
siddham | tadidaṃ bahujgrahaṇena nimātavyam |
kāryate, hāryate iti | ṇyantātkarmaṇi lakāraḥ, yak, ṇilopaḥ |
nanu cātrāntaraṅgā vṛddhirutpannamātra eva ṇau bhavati, lopastu yaki
bhavan bahiraṅgaḥ | evaṃ tarhi vibhajyānvākhyānapakṣe
etatpratyudāhṛtam ||
aco'ntyādi ṭi || 1|1|64 ||
ante bhavo'ntyaḥ digāditvādyat, antyāditi bahuvrīhiḥ |
yadyapyacāmityetadapekṣo'ntyaśabdastathāpi sambandhiśabdatvena
nityasāpekṣatvādiviruddhaḥ samāsaḥ nirdhāraṇe ṣaṣṭhīti | yadyevaṃ
nirddhāraṇasyānekāśrayatvād aca ityekavacanamunapapannam,
tatrāha-jātāviti | yo'ntyo'jiti |nirddhāraṇasya
sajātīyaviṣayatvādajiti labhyam | icchabda ityādi rūpodaharaṇam |
kāryaṃ tvagnici tamācaṣṭe ṇici "ṇāviṣṭhavat" iti ṭilopaḥ |
pacete ityādi kāryodāharaṇam ||
alo'ntyātpūrva upadhā || 1|1|65 ||
samudāya evāntyo bhavatītyāha--dhātvādāviti | "alaḥ" iti jasantaṃ
ced antyasyāviśeṣitatvāt samudāyādapi pūrvasya saṃjñāyāṃ śiṣṭa
iti śakārasyetvaṃ syād, asandehārthamalityeva ca brūyād;
ato'ntyādityānayā samānādhikaraṇā pañcamītyāha--antyādala iti |
yadyevam, pūrvasyāviśeṣitatvāt samudāyasyāpi saṃjñāyāṃ śiṣṭa
iti " śā" iti samudāyasyetvaṃ prāpnoti, "alo'tyasya" ityantyasya
bhaviṣyati | ṅānarthake'lontyavidhiranabhyāsavikāreṣu", tatra
yathā-ābhyāmityatra "hali lopaḥ" idrūpasya vidhīyamāno lopo'ntyasya
na bhavati, tathātrāpi na syād; ato'lo'ntyātpūrvo'liti
āha-aleveti | evakāraḥ paunarvacanikaḥ, yathāntyo'l, evaṃ
pūrvo'pyaleveti | kathaṃ punarddhitīyasalgrahaṇamantareṇāyamartho
labhyate ? lokataḥ | loke hyamīṣāṃ brāhmaṇānāmantyātpūrva
ānayatāmityukte eka evāntyātpūrvo'nantara ānīyate, na samudāyaḥ |
saṃyogopadhagrahaṇaṃ kṛñarthamityatrāvayavadharmeṇa samudāyasya
saṃyogasyopadhāvyapadeśaḥ | akāra ityādīni rūpodāharaṇāni |
kāryaṃ tu pācaka ityādau "ata upadhāyāḥ" iti vṛddhiḥ | bhedaka ityādau
"punagantalaghūpadhasya ca" iti guṇaḥ | śiṣṭa iti | śāserniṣṭhā,
"śāsa idaṅhaloḥ" itītvam, "śāsivasighasīnāṃ ca" iti ṣatvam ||
tasminniti nirdiṣṭe pūrvasya || 1|1|66 ||
itikaraṇasya gaurityayamāhetyādau svarūpapadārthakatvena
vyavasthāpakatvādarśanāt "tasminnaṇi ca"
ityatropātasyaidamanukaraṇam, tataśca tatraivāsya pravṛttiḥ syād |
asti ca tatra vyavacchedyaṃ he yauṣmākīṇamasmabhyaṃ dehi, āsmākīnaṃ
yuṣmabhyaṃ dadāmīti paranivṛttiḥ, tāmināṃ
bhrāntimapākaroti--tasminniti saptamyarthanirdeśa iti | etena
"tasyāpatyam" "tatra bhavaḥ" ityādivat svatantrasya sarvanāmno'yaṃ
nirdeśaḥ, tadvadeva tasminniti sāmānyaviśeṣaṇamaci,
halītyādīnāmupalakṣaṇam; na tvanukaraṇamiti darśayati |
etaccetikaraṇāllabhyate | sa hi padārthaviparyāsakṛt | śāstre ca
svārupapādarthaḥ, tasya viparyāso'rthapadārthakatā | yadi ca "tasminnaṇi
ca" ityatraivaitadupāsthāsyata tatraiva pūrvagrahaṇamakariṣyateti bhāvaḥ |
kimarthaṃ punaridamārabhyate ? "iko yaṇaci" ityādau sandehaḥ-kiṃ
satsaptamī ? kiṃ vā gaṅgāyāṃ ghoṣa iti vadaupaśleṣikādhikaraṇe
saptamī ? iti | tatra satvaṃ parasya ca pūrvasya ca sambhavati,
evamupaśleṣo'pi | tatra pūrvasya parasya ca vyavahitānantarasya yaṇ
prāptaḥ, dadhyudakādiṣu tu yugapadekasya
kāryitvanimitatvāyogātparyāyeṇa yaṇ prāptaḥ; iṣyate ca pūrvasyaiva
syādanantarasyaiveti, tatra nimārthamidam--saptamīnirdeśe pūrvasya
bhavati anantarasyaiveti | "iko yaṇaci" ityādeśca sakṛtpravṛttiḥ, sā
cevaṃ viśoṣiteti na kvāpyaniṣṭaśaṅkā | tatrādyaṃ niyamaṃ
darśayati-pūrvasyaiveti | vyāvatyaṃ darśayati-notarasyeti |
pacatyodanamiti | yadyapyatrāniyamaprasaṅgo nāsti, tathāpi "iko
yaṇaci" ityasminsūtre'niyamaprasaṅge niyamaḥ kriyata ityetadapi
bhavatyevodāharaṇam | dvitīyaṃ niyamaṃ darśayati-nirdiṣṭagrahaṇamiti
| diśiruccāraṇakriyaḥ, niḥśabdo nairantarye, nirantaraṃ diṣṭo
nirdiṣṭa ityevamānantaryamartho bhavati, tatraivaṃ vacanavyaktiḥ-aci
halītyādau pūrvasyaiva kāryaṃ bhavati, tatra nirdiṣṭe u nirantara
evoccārita iti tatrārthātpūrvasyānantarasyetyartho bhavati |
tadāha-vyavahitasya mā bhūditi | anyathā vyavahite mā bhūditi
vaktavyam; pūrvapadasya vyavahite'pi vṛtestasya prasaṅgāt ||
tasmādityutarasya || 1|1|67 ||
nirdiṣṭagrahathaṇamanuvartata iti | tenātrāpi vyavahite kāryaṃ na
bhavatīti bhāvaḥ | atrāpi itiparatvādanukaraṇamiti kasyācid bhrānti
syāt; "tasmānnuḍ dvihalaḥ" ityatra "ata ādeḥ" iti
dīrghatpūrvasyāṅgasyāsambhavāt prayojanābhāvāt yadyapi
tasyānukaraṇaṃ na bhavati; "tasmācchaso naḥ puṃsi" "tasmānnu ḍaci"
ityatra tu vyavacchedyamasti, uccārito'nupalabhyate, gauranaśva iti
pūrvasya mā bhūditi, atastayorevedamanukaraṇamiti tāmimā
bhrāntipākaroti-tasmāditi pañcamyarthanirdeśa iti | etena
pūrvasasūtravat svatantrasya sarvanāmno'yaṃ nirdeśaḥ | tadvadeva ca
tasmāditi sāmānyamatiṅ ityādīnāṃ viśeṣāṇāmupalakṣaṇam, na
tvanukaraṇamiti darśayati | etacchetikaraṇāllabhyata ityuktam |
kimarthaṃma punaridamārabhyate ? "tiṅṅatiṅaḥ" ityādau
kārakavibhākterasambhāvaddigyogalakṣaṇā pañcamīti,
dikcchabdastvadhyāhāryaḥ; tatra pūrvotaraśabdayoradhyāhāraḥ
sambhavatīti niyamārthā paribhāṣeyam | tadāha--utarasyaiva kāryamiti
| tadevaṃ pūrvasya cāsya ca vṛttikāreṇa niyamārthatvaṃ darśitam |
ṣaṣṭhīpraklṛptipakṣo'pi bhāṣye pradarśitaḥ | katham ? "ṣaṣṭhī" iti
vartate, saptamyarthanirdeśe pūrvasyānantarasya ṣaṣṭhī |
pañcamyarthanirdeśe, utarasyānantarasya ṣaṣṭhīti; tatra "iko yaṇaci"
ityādau yatra pūrvameva ṣaṣṭhī vidyate tatra pūrvasyānantarasya,
notarasyānantarasya sā ṣaṣṭhītyucyate | "āne muk" "īdāsaḥ"
ityādau tu yatra ṣaṣṭhī nāsti, tatra ṣaṭha|lpi prakalpyate sā
cāniyatayogatvāt sthānaṣaṣṭhī bhavati | yasya ca sthānaṣaṣṭhī syaiva
kāryamiti sarvatra kāryaniyamo'pi sidhyati | yatra tūbhayanirdeśa statra
yā'navakāśā sā itarasyāḥ ṣaṣṭhaāā prakalpayati, yathā-"āne muk" iti
saptamī ṅiravakāśā "ato yeyaḥ" iti pañcamyāḥ pūrvasūtre
sāvakāśāyāḥ | evam " ī dāsaḥ" iti pañcamī "āne muk" thaiti
saptamyāḥ,ubhayostvanavakāśayoḥ paratvātpañcamī saptamyāḥ ṣaṣṭhī
prakalpayati, yathā-"āmi sarvanāmnaḥ suṭ" iti sarvanāmna iti
pañcamyanavakāśāmīti saptamyā anavakāśāyāḥ | atha saptamyutarārthā
tathāpyādityanuvṛtayā pañcamyā samānādhikaraṇā śarvānāmnaḥ" iti
pañcamyapi sāvakāśā ṣaṣṭhaāā prakalpayati | evaṃ niyamapakṣe'pi
paratvānavakāśatvābhyāṃ vyavasthāṃ draṣṭavya | "dīrghācche tugbhavati"
ityatra ṣaṣṭhayāḥ sthāne pañcamīvyākhyānād dīrghasyaiva tuk bhavati,
na tu cchasya; tathā ca śurācchāyā" iti nirdeśa upapadyate ||
svaṃ rūpaṃ śabdasyāśbadasaṃjñā || 1|1|68 ||
svarūpasya paryāyāṇāṃ ca grahaṇe prāpte niyamārthā paribhāṣeyam |
śāstrāṅgatvācca paribhāṣāṇāṃ śāstra eva niyamaḥ, na loka
ityāha--śāstre svamevetyādi, grāhyamiti | "grāhmam" iti ṇijantād
yat, etaccādhyāhāreṇa labdham | śabdasyeti "kṛtyānāṃ kartari vā"
iti ṣaṣṭhī, śabdaḥ svameva rūpaṃ grāhayati bodhayatītyarthaḥ | saṃjñāpakṣe
tu vṛtāveva śabdaḥ saṃjñānuccāraṇaṃ ca nopapadyeta | sūtre
ṣaṣṭhīnirdeśo'pi nātīva yuktaḥ syāt; saṃjñāsaṃjñisambandhe prāyeṇa
sāmānādhikaraṇyadarśanāt | rūpaśabdena cehāgniśabdatvādikaṃ
śukasārikāpuruṣādibhirudīritā subhinnāsu śabdavyaktiṣu samavetaṃ
sāmānyamibhidhīyate | "agnerḍhak" iti sūtrakāreṇa yā
vyaktiruccāritā, tasyāḥ sarvoccāraṇeṣvanugataṃ sāmānyaṃ
vācyamityarthaḥ | sāmānyasya kāryayogo vyaktidvāraka iti tena
tenoccāritāyā stasyāstasyā vyakterḍhag bhavatītyarthaḥ sampadyate |
evakārasya vyacchedyaṃ darśayati--na bāhyae'rtha iti | śabdasaṃjñāṃ
varjayitveti | śabdasaṃjñāsu svarūpaṃ grāhyaṃ nabhavatītyarthaḥ |
aniyamaprasaṅge niyamaḥ kartavyastaṃ darśayati-śabdenetyādi | loke
gaurupalabhyatāmityukte'rtha eva kāryayogo gamyate, na hi
śabdarūmupalabhya kṛtī bhavati; vyākaraṇe tu
pratyayavidhānādikāryamarthe na sambhavati, tena saha
paurvāparyāyogāt | tena "agnerḍhak" ityukte lokavadartha eva
tāvatpratīyate, tatra sambhavo nāsti; atastadvācināṃ sarveṣāṃ
sampratyayaḥ syād, yathā-ākṛtiyodanāyāṃ vyaktīnām, mā bhūdeṣa
doṣaḥ; upātādeva yathā syāditi niyamārthamidamārabhyata ityarthaḥ |
audaśvitkamiti | udaśviti saṃskṛtamiti saptamīsamarthāṭṭak,
"isusuktāntātkaḥ" |
ghugrahaṇeṣvityādi | anyathā "upasarge ghoḥ kiḥ" iti kipratyayo
dhātoreva ghoḥ śabdārthatsyāt, na tu dādhābhyaḥ | "ī halyaghoḥ"
ityatra tu ghuśabdasyānākārāntatvāddādhānāmeva grahaṇaṃ sidhyati |
kumārīgha ityatra "gharūpa" iti hrasvaprasaṅgaḥ |
nanu ca pradeśeṣu saṃjñisampratyāyanārthaṃ saṃjñākaraṇamiti sāmarthyāt
svarūpagrahaṇaṃ na bhaviṣyati, naitadasti; ubhayagatiriha śāstre
sambhavatīti saṅkhyākarmakaraṇādiṣviva svarūpasya saṃjñinaśca pradeśeṣu
grahaṇaṃ syāt | jñāpakātsiddham; yadayaṃ "ṣṇāntā ṣaṭ" iti
ṣakārāntāyāḥ saṅkhyāyāḥ ṣaṭsaṃjñāṃ vidadhāti,
tajjñāpayati-saṃjñāśabdo na svarūpagrāhaka iti | anyathā "ṣaḍbhyo
luk""ṣaṭcaturbhyaśca" ityādau svarūpasyāpi ṣaḍityasya grahaṇāt
ṣakārāntāyāḥ saṅkhyāyāḥ ṣaṭsaṃjñāṃ na vidadhyāt |
nanu ca ṣakārāntā saṃjñā ṣakārāntasya kāryamiṣyate, saṃjñāpi
ṣakārāntaiva; ato nārtho'śabdasaṃjñetyanena ? satyam;
pratipatigauravaparihārārthaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ | śabdaśabdena
cābhedīpacārāt vyākaraṇamucyate, śabde saṃjñā śabdasaṃjñā; evaṃ ca
karmakaraṇamityādiṣvarthasaṃjñāsvapi śāstrīyāsu svarūpagrahaṇaṃ na bhavati
|
atha rūpagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, iha yāvatā
pratītāvupadeśānapekṣatvādasādhāraṇatvānnityasambandhitvācca tadeva
śabdasya svārtho hi svapratītau sambandhagrahaṇamapekṣate, paryāyairapi
pratyāyanātsādhāraṇaścānityasaṃbandhaścānukaraṇadaśāyāmabhāvāt, na
cārtho grāhakaḥ śakyate kartum, grāhyatve ca sūtramanarthakaṃ syāditi
nārtho rūpagrahaṇena ? evaṃ tarhyotaj jñāpayati--śāstre svarūpeṇa
samānakakṣyo'rthaḥ" iti | tenārthavadgrahaṇenānarthakasyetyupapannaṃ
bhavati | tatra jñāpakādartho'pi grāhyaḥ; svaṃ rūpamiti vacanād | rūpaṃ
ceti sāmarthyādarthavato rūpasya grahaṇam | tena kāśe kuśe ityatra
"śe" pragṛhyasaṃjñābhāvaḥ siddhaḥ |
sitadviśeṣāṇāmiti vārtikaṃ vyācaṣṭe-sinnirdeśaḥ kartavya iti |
vṛkṣas ityevam | tato vaktavyamiti | svaṃ rūpamityasyānantaram |
nanu kiṃ prayojanamityukte vṛkṣādītivaktavyam,
kimucyate-vṛkṣādyarthamiti ? vṛkṣādiṣu prayojanamasyetyukte vṛkṣādyasya
prayojanamityarthāduktaṃ bhavatītyadoṣaḥ | asyārthasya nyāyataḥ siddhiṃ
vibhāṣetyatra vakṣyāmaḥ |
pitparyāyavacanasya ceti | cakārātsvasvarūvasya viśeṣāṇāṃ ca | idaṃ
vācanikameva | jitparyāyasyetyāsyāpi nyāyataḥ siddhiṃ vakṣyāmaḥ |
jhitasya ceti | idaṃ vācanikameva | mṛgapakṣiṇastu pinnirdeśaḥ kartavya
ityāhuḥ | athaikasyeti | iyamiṣṭireva ||
aṇuditsavarṇasya cāpratyayaḥ || 1|1|69 ||
saṃjñāsūtrametat na paribhāṣā; prasiddhārthaviniyogāt | pareṇa
ṇakāreṇeti | etacca "laṇ" ityatra pratipāditam | svasya ca rūpasyeti
yadyapi prathamāntaṃ prakṛtam, tathāpi savarṇasya ceti ṣaṣṭha|lntasyānantaraṃ
śrūyamāṇaścaśabdo'nyasya ṣaṣṭhantasyābhāvāt tasyaiva ṣaṣṭha|lntatāṃ
prakalpayatīti bhāvaḥ | pratyayaṃ varjayitveti | tena tatroccāritameva
rūpaṃ gṛhyate | "ād guṇaḥ" ityādi | yatheha bhavati devendra iti, evaṃ
khaṭvendra ityādāvapi bhavati | asya cvo | yatheha bhavati
śuklībhavatīti, evaṃ mālībhavatītyādāvapi bhavati | yasyeti ca |
yatheha bhavati dākṣiḥ plākṣiriti, evaṃ cauḍirbālākirityādāvapi
bhavati | jūḍābalākāśabdau bāhvādī |
nanu ca "akaḥ" "aci" ityādau pratyāhāragrahaṇe kathaṃ
madhyavartirikārādibhissavarṇagrahaṇam, uccārito hi saṃjñāśabdaḥ
saṃjñinaṃ pratyāyayati, na ca madhyavartināmuccāraṇamasti | te
hyagādisaṃjñābhiḥ saṃjñitvena pratyāyyante, kva tarhi syāt ? "asya
cvau" "yasyeti" yatra saṃjñāyā uccāraṇamasti | pratyāhāre cādyo varṇa
uccāritatvātsavarṇagrahāhakaḥ | syādetat-akṣarasamāmnāya uccāritā
ikārādayaḥ savarṇānāṃ grāhakā iti | agādicodanāsu
īkārādayo'pi hrasvavatsaṃjñitvenaiva pratīyante tvikārādibhiḥ
pratītaiḥ pratyāyyanta iti, na; aparakālatvāt | iha
varṇānāmupadeśastāvad, upadeśotarakālā itsaṃjñā,
itsaṃjñotarakālamādirantyenaitatpravartate, tato'ṇ savarṇasyeti |
tadanenopadeśādiṣvaṅgeṣu niṣpanneṣu anyatra "asya cvau" ityādau
savarṇānāṃ grahaṇaṃ bhavati, nāṅgeṣu, nāpi svātmani; aniṣpannatvāt
| yadi tvasminnapi sūtre savarṇagrahaṇaṃ
syāt,"ādṛgamahanaḥ","āñdorap" ityādau akārādayo'pi savarṇān
gṛhṇīyuḥ | ato'smin sūtre'kṣarasamāmnoye cāgṛhītasavarṇānāṃ
grahaṇam | tataśca tadeva sthitam pratyāhāreṣu madhyavartibhiḥ
savarṇagrahaṇaṃ na syāditi, naiṣa doṣaḥ; uccāryamāṇaireva
pratyāyakairbhavitavyamiti nāsti niyamaḥ, buddhyupārūḍhāstu
pratyāyakāḥ | asti ca madhyavartināṃ buddhyupārohaḥ, tataśca
saṃjñitvena pratyāyyamānasyāpi pratyāyakatvaṃ bhaviṣyati | atra
jñāpakam--"dīrghājjāsi ca" iti pratiṣedhaḥ | sa hi kumāryāvityādau
"prathamayoḥ pūrvasavarṇaḥ" iti dīrgho mā bhūditi | tatra cāka iti
vartate | khaṭve ityādau tu ṅādici" ityeva siddhaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ |
"dīdhīvevīṭām""lvādibhyaḥ" ityādayaśca nirddeśā
evamevopapadyante,yadi madhyavartibhirapi savarṇagrahaṇaṃ bhavati |
svarānunāsiketyādirudātaḥ sūtre gṛhītaḥ svarāntarabhinnamapi
gṛhṇāti, evamanudātasvaritau ca | tathā sānunāsiko
niranunāsikam, so'pi tam |
dīrgho na bhavatīti | asati tvapratyaya ityasmin pratyayenāpi
savarṇagrahaṇāt dīrgho'pi syāt | atyalpamidamucyate-"apratyayaḥ" iti,
"apratyayādeśaṭitkiṃnmita iti vaktavyam" | pratyaye pratyudāhṛtaṃ tatra |
ādeśe-"idam iś",itaḥ; iha viśeṣa vihitatvāttyadādyatvaṃ
bādhitvā trimātrika ādeśaḥ prāpnoti | ṭiti--"ārddhadhātu kasyeḍ
valādeḥ", paṭhiteti dīrgho'pi syāt | "graho'liṭi dīrghaḥ"
ityetatu graherdīrgha eva, na hrasva iti niyamārthaṃ syāt | "vṛto vā"
ityetadapi vavaritheti liṭi dīrgho mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ syāt |
kiti-"bhuvo vugluṅliṭoḥ" babhūva, anunāsiko'pi syāt |
miti-"am sambuddho" he anaḍvan, āmapi syāt, evaṃ tarhyapratyaya
iti neha saṃjñāgrahaṇam, kiṃ tarhi ? anvarthagrahaṇam-pratīyate vidhīyata
iti pratyayaḥ, bhāvyamānaḥ savarṇānna gṛhṇātītyarthaḥ | iśādayopi
bhāvyante | saṃjñāpratyayasya tu nāvaśyakaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ |
yenārthampratiyanti sa pratyayaḥ, na hi
dīrghaplutayorarthasyābhidhānamasti | "kuhoḥ ścuḥ" ityādau
bhāvyamānasyāpyuditvāsāmarthyādapratyaya iti niṣedhābhāvaḥ | tathā ca
paṭha|lte-"bhāvyamāno'ṇ savarṇānna gṛhṇāti" iti ||
taparastatkālasya || 1|1|70 ||
taḥ paro yasmāditi bahuvrīhiṃ darśayati | tādapi parastapara iti
pañcamītatpuruṣam || sa punarasmādeva nipātanādveditavyaḥ |
ekasyāpi taparaśabdasya tantrāvṛtyoranyatarāśrayaṇādarthabhedo na
viruddhaḥ | tatra bahuvrīherliṅgam--"ato bhisa ais" iti
taparakaraṇam | tatpuruṣasya liṅgam-vṛddhirādaic" ityaijarthaṃ hi
tadityuktam |
taparo varṇa iti | varṇasyaiva savarṇaṃsambhavādvarṇa ityuktam |
tatkālasyeti bahuvrīhiḥ-sa kālo'syeti | ayukto'yaṃ nirdeśaḥ |
tadityanena taparo varṇaḥ parāmṛśyate, prasiddhaparimāṇā ca kriyā
prasiddhaparimāṇasya kriyāntarasya paricchedikā | kālo
yathā--divasamadhīta iti, divasaśabdenodayādirastamayānta
ādityagatiprabandha ucyate | sa cādhyayanasya paricchedakatvāt kālaḥ;
varṇastu kriyātmako na bhavatītyayuktaṃ varṇavācinastacchabdasya
kālaśabdena sāmānādhikaraṇyam ? evaṃ tarhyutarapadalopī samāso
draṣṭavyaḥ, uṣṭramukhavat | gamyamānārthatvācca prayoga eva lopaḥ,
yathā-uṣṭro mukhamasyetyeva vigrahaḥ | na ca praṇī praṇyantarasya
mukhamiti sāmarthyāt sādṛśyapratītiḥ | uṣṭra iva mukhamasyeti
mukhenaiva mukhasya sādaḍaśyaṃ prasiddham, na kṛtsnenoṣṭreṇeti
sāmarthyādayamartho bhavati-uṣṭramukhamiva mukhamasyeti | evamihāpi
varṇaḥ kālo na bhavatīti sāmarthyātadīyā kriyāntareṇa nimeṣādinā
paricchinnā satī varṇāntarasya paricchediketi varṇa eva paricchedaka
ityucyate | sa kālo'syetyasya ko'rthaḥ ? tatkālasaṃbandhinī kriyā
paricchedikā asyetyarthaḥ | etadeva darśayati--ātmanetyādinā ||
taparavarṇasannadhāvuccārito'pyayamātmaśabdastatsahacaritāyāmuccāraṇakriyāyāṃ vartate, varṇena kriyāyāstulyatvānupapateḥ | yādṛśī taparasya varṇasyoccāraṇakriyā nimeṣādiparicchinnā, tādṛśyuccāraṇakriyā'syetyarthaḥ |
guṇāntarayuktasyeti | yadgraṇaka upātastato
guṇāntarayuktasyetyarthaḥ | kiṃ punaridaṃ niyamārtham ?
ahosvidvidhyartham ? tatrāṇityanuvṛtau niyamārtham-taparo
varṇastatkālasyaiveti | nivṛtau vidhyartham | tatrādye pakṣe "āto
dhātoḥ", "ātāṃ puṅṇau" "yasyeti ca"
"viḍvanoranuvāsikasyāt" ityādau "bhedakā guṇāḥ" "ityasmin
darśane yadgraṇaka upātastato guṇāntarayuktasya grahaṇaṃ na syāditi
dvitīyaṃ pakṣamāśrityāha-vidhyarthamiti | atra hetumāha-aṇiti
nānuvartata iti | yadi vidhyarthamidam, tato'syānaṇsu
caritārthatvādaṇsu pūrvameva pravarteta, tatrāha-aṇāmanyeṣāṃceti |
etadeva viśadayati-ato bhisa aisityevamādiṣviti | na pravartata
eveti | pareṇānena bādhitatvāditi bhāvaḥ | virodho hyatra
vartate-pūrvasūtreṇa hyaṣṭādaśānāṃ grahaṇam, anena tu ṣaṇṇāmiti |
kimudāharaṇamiti | abhedakatvāt guṇānāmanaṇsu siddhamiti praśnaḥ,
aṇsu bhinnakālanivṛtyarthaṃ tāvadārabdhavyaṃ sūtram | tadevānaṇsvapi
vidhimukhena pravartamānamiṣṭṃa sādhayatītyutaram |
viḍvanoranunāsikasyāditi | kasya punaratra savarṇasya
grahaṇamiṣyata iti cintyam | tasmādupalakṣaṇametat | "āto dhātoḥ"
"yasyeti ca" ityādāveva prayojanam |
tatkālasyeti kimiti | pradhānāvayavadvāreṇa sūtramevākṣipyate |
khaṭvāmiriti | varṇāśrayavidhāvantādivadbhāvo na bhavati ||
ādirantyena sahetā || 1|1|71 ||
idamapi saṃjñāsūtram, ādyantayormadhyāpekṣatvānmadhyavartināṃ saṃjñitvaṃ
vijñāyate, śvaṃ rūpam" ityanuvṛteḥ svarūpasya
cetyāha-madhyavartināmiti | yadyapyādyantāvavayavā avayavinaḥ
samudāyarūpasya sambandhinau tathāpi tasya yugapallakṣye
prayogābhāvātsamudāyināṃ saṃjñeti darśayati-varṇānāmiti | svasya
ca rūpasyeti | svarūpamādereva gṛhyante, nāntyasya; aprādhānyāditi
dadhyatreti kevala eva yakāraḥ pravartate, na ṇakāreṇa sahitaḥ |
sahagrahaṇādādyantau samuditau saṃjñeti samudāyādeva vibhaktirbhavati
"iko yaṇ" iti, nādimātrāt | ṭā ityanena grahaṇaṃ mā bhūditi |
tāvato'vadheravivakṣitatvānnāyamantyaḥ "ṭāṅasiṅasāminātsyaḥ"
"dvitīyāṭausvenaḥ" iti tṛtīyaikavacanasyāsau viśeṣaṇārthaḥ ||
yena vidhistadantasya || 1|1|72 ||
svarūpavidhiparihārāyāyamārambhaḥ | idamapi saṃjñāsūtram | yeneti
karaṇe tṛtīyā | vidhīyata iti vidhiḥ, karmasādhanaḥ kipratyayaḥ |
vidhirvidhīyata iti | vadhiśabdena vidhānayogyaṃ vastvabhidhīyate, tasya
sāṃpratikakriyāviśeṣadyotanāyākhyātaprayogaḥ | āsane āste, karaṇena
karotītivat | tadantasyesi bahuvrīhiḥ | tadityanena yeneti
nirdiṣṭaḥ śabdo nirdiśyate, tadāha--ātmāntasyeti |
antaśabdasyāvayavavācitvātadākṣiptasya samudāyasyeyaṃsaṃjñetyāha
--samudāyasya saṃjñā bhavatīti | avaśyalāvyamiti |
mayūravyaṃsakāditvātsamāsaḥ, "lumpedavaśyamaḥ kṛtye" iti malopaḥ |
atheha kasmādejantasya saṃjñā na bhavati "eco'yavāyāvaḥ" iti, kiṃ
syāt ? anekāltvādayādayaḥ sarvādeśāḥ syuḥ; tataśca
cayanalavanādiṣvayanamiti prāpnoti,
prakaraṇādivaśāccākṣādivadarthaviśeṣāvagatiḥ syāt, naiṣa doṣaḥ;
"nirdiśyamānasyādeśā bhavanti" ityevaṃ bhaviṣyanti | atha vā-yathā ecā
tadantavidhiḥ, evamayādibhirapi bhaviṣyati | evamapi"ād guṇaḥ" ityatra
ādityavarṇānto gṛhyate, acīti cājāderiti khaṭvendra
ityādāvavarṇāntasya samudāyasyājādeśca guṇaprasaṅgaḥ |
ṣaṣṭha|lnirdeśānnirdiśyamānasyetyapi nāsti | evaṃ tarhi naivaṃvidho'sya
viṣayaḥ | yeneti karaṇe tṛtīyetyuktam, karaṇaṃ ca paratantram;
kartradhiṣṭhitasyaiva karaṇatvāt | na ca "erac" ityādāvikārādīnāṃ
pāratantryam, dhātvādīnāṃ ca svātantryaṃ svarūpato'vabhāsate |
vā syāditi | vṛkṣādīnāmato vivakṣānibandhanaṃ tadubhayamiti |
viśeṣaṇatvena vivakṣitaṃ paratantramapradhānam, viśeṣyatvena vivakṣitaṃ
svatantraṃ pradhānam | tena viśeṣaṇaṃ viṣeṣyasya tadantasya saṃjñetyuktaṃ
sambhavati | viśeṣyasannidhau ca viśeṣaṇaṃ bhavati, sannidhiśca
kutracitsākṣānnirdeśena, yathā-"īdūdeddvivacanam" iti dvivacanasya |
kvacidadhikāradyathā-"erac" iti dhātoḥ | kvacidākṣepād, yathā-"iko
jhal" iti sanā dhātoḥ | "eco'yavāyāvaḥ" ityādau na
kathaṃcidviśeṣyasaṃnidhiriti naitatpravartate | yadi viśeṣaṇaṃ
tadantasya saṃjñā, tataḥ "udoṣṭha|lpūrvasya" ityatra ṛkārastadantasya
dhātoḥ saṃjñeti oṣṭha|lpūrvagrahaṇaṃ dhātoreva viśeṣaṇaṃ syād, na
ñakārasya; saṃjñāyāḥ saṃjñipratyayanārthatvāt | tataśceha
syāt-saṅkīrṇamiti; pūrtamityādau ca na syāt | evam "utaśca
pratyayādasaṃyogapūrvād " ityatrāsaṃyogapūrvagrahaṇamaṅgasya
viśeṣaṇaṃ syāt, notaḥ, naiṣa doṣaḥ; iyaṃ hi saṃjñā
guṇapradhānabhāvāpekṣā tataśca "utaśca pratyayād" ityādau
viśeṣaṇasambandhavelāyāṃ guṇabhāvāsphuraṇātamanubhūya paścāt
viśeṣyeṇa sambandhe saṃjñā bhavati |
samāseti | anenaitadāha-śritādayo paścāt viśeṣyāstadviśeṣaṇaṃ ca
sup | evaṃ ṅaḍādibhyaḥ phak" ityādau naḍādiviśeṣyaṃ prātipadikaṃ
viśeṣaṇamiti | kaṣṭṃa paramaśrita iti | śritāntametatsubantaṃ na
bhavatīti sambuddhyantaṃ paṭhitavyam, taddhipratyayalakṣaṇena subantaṃ
bhavati śritāntaṃ ca śrūyate |
netyāheti | kaḥ punarāha ? utaravādī, ācāryo vā |
ugidvarṇeti | ugitā varṇena ca prātipadikaṃ viśeṣyamityarthaḥ |
yasminvidhiriti tadantavidhyapavādastadādividhiḥ, ato
viśeṣaṇenaiva bhavati ||
vṛddhiryasyācāmādistad vṛddham || 1|1|73 ||
samudāyasyaivācāmādiḥ sambhavatīti sa eva yasyetyanenocyata
ityāha--yasyeti samudāya ucyata iti | saṃjñinirdeśārthaṃ cedam;
anyathā tacchabdena kiṃ parāmṛśyate, tadityasyānupādāne vṛddhereva
sā vṛddhasaṃjñā syāt | acāṃ madhya ityādi | atra
yasyetyasyācāmityanena sambandhaḥ, ādiśca nirdhāryate, vṛddhirvidheyo
dharmaḥ | ādiśabdaścopakramavacanaḥ-upakramyata ityupakramaḥ, prathama
uccāryata ityarthaḥ | yasya samudāyasya sambandhināmacāṃ madhye prathamata
uccāryamāṇo vṛddhisaṃjñaka ityarthaḥ | acāmiti jātau bahuvacanamiti |
tena dvayorapi bhavatīti bhāvaḥ | ekasyāpi vyapadeśivadbhāvād
bhavati | śālīya iti | atra samudāyasya halāditve'pyajapekṣayā
prathamo'c vṛddhiriti saṃjñā bhavati | nanu ca nirddhāraṇasya
tulyajātīyaviṣayatvānnirddhāryamāṇa ādirapyajeva pratīyate, na vā
ākāro'c; akṣarasamāmnāye'nupadeśāt | kathaṃ tarhi somapaṃ
brāhmaṇakulamiti ackāryaṃ hrasvatvaṃ bhavati; savarkaṇagrahaṇāt, na
tvactvāt | ihāpi tarhi savarṇagrahaṇābhāvātpratīyate | astu,
tathāpratīyamāna eva savarṇaṃ grahīṣyati yathājgrahaṇe maghyavartīkārādiḥ
| kiñca-acāmiti nirddhāraṇāaśraye tāvadakārasyoccāritatvād
ākāro'pi pratīyate | tena
nirddhāryamāṇasyāpyākārādestathābhūtamevāctvaṃ pratīyata iti
yatkiñcidetaccodyam |
vā nāmadheyasyeti | nāmadheyaśabdaḥ sāṅketikeṣu ruḍhaḥ |
devadatīyā iti | kāśyādiṣu deśavācī devadataśabdaḥ paṭha|lte |
"eṅ prācāṃ deśe" iti vṛddhasaṃjñakaḥ kāśyādibhiḥ
sāhacaryādityadeśavācinaśccha eva bhavati | vāhīkagrāmavācino|ṣapi
devadakataśabdasaryānāditvenāsāṅketikatvād aprācāṃ
deśavācitvācca vṛddhasaṃthajñāyā abhāvāt kāśyādilakṣaṇau ṭhaññiṭhau
na bhavataḥ |
gotrāntādityādi | gotraśabdena gotrapratyayāntaṃ gṛhyate,
tadantādasamastavat kevalāt gotrāntādyaḥ pratyayo bhavati sa eva
tadantādapi bhavatītyarthaḥ | 
ghṛtarauḍhaiiyā iti | rūḍhaṛsyāpatyam "ata iñ"
śauṣikeṣvartheṣviñaścetyaṇaḥ ṅa dvyacaḥ prācyabharateṣu" iti
niṣedhād "vṛddhācchaḥ" | evaṃ vṛddhāmbhīyāḥ-ambhaso'patyam
śambhūyo'mbhasoḥ salopaśca" iti bāhvādiṣu pāṭhādiñ, salopaśca
| odanapāṇinīyā iti | paṇino'patyamityaṇ "gāthividathi" iti
prakṛtibhāvāt "ṭeḥ"ca iti ṭilopābhāvaḥ, pāṇinasyāpatyaṃ paṇino
yuveti iñ, tasya chātrā iti vivakṣite "yūni lug" iti iño luki
kṛte'pi pratyayalakṣaṇena "iñaśca" ityaṇ prāpto gotrādhikārānna
bhavati | "kaṇvādibhyo gotre " ityatra tāvat pāribhāṣikaṃ gotraṃ
gṛhyate tadeva "itaśca" ityatrāpyanuvartate, tena yūnīñ na bhavati |
kaśyapaśabdo bidādiḥ, kataśabdo gargādiḥ, jihvācapalo
haritabhakṣaśca kātyastato'ṇena bhavati | kaḥ punaratra
pratyayātideśaprastāvaḥ, yāvatā śeṣādhikāre prāgdīvyato'ṇetra
caitadvaktavyam ? satyam; kaiścitu gautrāntasya vṛddhasaṃjñā vihitā,
evamapi vṛddhāmbhīyā iti siddheḥ | vārtikakārastu--"vṛddhasaṃjñāyāṃ
satyāṃ piṅgalakāṇavasya chātrāḥ paiṅgalakāṇvā iti "vṛddhācchaḥ"
syāt | pratyayātideśe tu "kaṇvādibhyo gotre" ityaṇ labhyate" iti
manyamānaḥ pūrvavākyena paramatamupanyasyānena vākyena nirasyati
sma; tadeva paṭhitaṃ vṛttikāreṇa || 
tyadādīni ca || 1|1|74 ||
utarārthamiti | tatra prayojanavatvāt yasyācāmādireṅiti
sambandhasambhavācca | iha tu na sambadhyata iti | ayogyatvād
nirddhāraṇasya sajātīya vaṣayatvāt tyadādīnāṃ cājātmakatvābhāvād
na hyasti sambhavaḥ | yasyācāmādayastyadādaya iti | na ca tyadādisthe'ci
tyadādiśabdo vartata iti kliṣṭakalpanāyuktā;
utarārthamapyanuvṛttisambhavāt | taduktam - utarārthamanuvartata iti |
tyādāyanirati | "udīcāṃ vṛddhādagotrād" iti phañ,
"pratyayotarapadayośca" ||
eṅprācāṃ deśe || 1|1|75 ||
prācāṃ deśābhidhāna iti | prāci deśe ye vasanti te prācaḥ
puruṣāsteṣāṃ sambandhī yo deśastadabidhāna ityarthaḥ | etena śrutasya
viśeṣaṇaṃ prācāṃ grahaṇaṃ nācāryāṇāmiti darśayati | tathā hi sati
matenetyadhyāhāryaṃ syāditi bhāvaḥ | eṇīpacanīya ityādi |
eṇīpacanādibhyaścchaḥ | daivadatā iti | "vāhīkagrāmebhyaśca" iti
vṛddhāditi vihitau ṭhaññiṭhau na bhavataḥ | kāśyādipāṭhādapi na
bhavataḥ; tatrāpi vṛddhādhikārāt | evaṃ kroḍo nāma grāmastatra bhavaḥ
krauḍa ityaṇeva bhavati | kuṇinā tu prācāṃgrahaṇamācāryanirdeśārthaṃ
vyākhyātam, bāṣyakāro'pi tathaivāśiśriyat | tena sepuraṃ
skonagaraṃ ca vāhīkagrāmau, tatra "vāhīkagrāmebhyaśca" iti ṭhaññiṭhau
bhavataḥ--saipurikī, saupurikā; skaunāgarikī, skaunagarikā | asya
vyavasthitavibhāṣāvijñānācca
kroḍadevadataśabdayoraprāgdeśavācinoṣṭhaññiṭhau na bhavataḥ |
śaiṣikeṣvevārtheṣviyaṃ vṛddhisaṃjñeṣyate | tenāpatyavikārayoḥ
"udīcāṃ vayavasthitavibhāṣayaiva siddham | vṛttikārapakṣe tvetsarvaṃ
vacanātsādhyam | gaumatā iti |
gomatī pragdeśe nadī deśagrahaṇena na gṛhyate, ṅadīdeśo'grāmāḥ"
iti nadyāḥ pṛthaggrahaṇāt "eḍ prācāṃ deśe" "udīcāṃ
vṛddhādagotrād" ityādiṣu prāgudañcau śrutau,
tayorvibhāgajñānārthamāha-prāgudañcāviti | śarāvatī nāma nadī
utarapūrvābhimukhī, tasyā dakṣiṇapūrvaṃsyāṃ diśi vyavasthito deśaḥ
prāgdeśa; utaraparasyāmudagdeśaḥ, tau śarāvatī vibhajate; tayā
maryādayā tayo rvibhāgo jñāyate | kṣīrodakamiti |
"jātiraprāṇinām" ityekavadbhāvaḥ | kvacit "kṣīrodake" iti
pāṭhātatra niyatavyaktivivakṣayā jātiparatvābhāvād dvivacanam |
kimarthaṃ vibhajate ? viduṣāṃ śabdasiddhyartham | yadyapi nadyā
evamuddeśo na bhavati --viduṣāṃ śabdā vyavasthitāḥ siddhyanti;
tathāpi tayā hetubhūtayā vyavasthitaṃ śabdasādhutvamiti
uddeśo'dhyāropyate | saivaṃbhūtā sā no'smān pātu | kvacit
prāgudīcāviti pāṭhaḥ, tatra "acpratyanvavapūrvāt"
ityatrājitiyogavibhāgādacpratyayaḥ | "uda īt" itītvam |
pragudīcamiti pāṭhe samāhāradvandvaḥ |
"dvandvāccudaṣahāntātsamāhāre" iti ṭac | kvacit prāgudīca iti
pāṭhaḥ, tatrāvayavabahutvasya samudāya āropaḥ
prāgdeśānnudagdeśāÄścetyarthaḥ ||
iti haradatamiśraviracitāyāṃ padamañjaryā prathamadhyāyasya 
prathamaḥ pādaḥ samāptaḥ
