gāṅkuṭādibhyo'ñṇiniṅt || 1|2|1 ||

kuṭa ādiryeṣāmiti bahuvrīhāvantarvartinyā vibhaktyā padatve'pi
jaśtvaṃ na bhavati; anukriyamāṇarūpavināśaprasaṅgāt | atha vā 'kuṭa
kauṭilye' iti dhātupāṭhe yo'kārastena saha sānubandhānukaraṇaṃ
draṣṭavyam |
atra catvāraḥ pakṣāḥ sambhavanti-itsaṃjñakena ṅkāreṇa saha
sambandhapratipādanam, ṅito vā ividhiḥ, saṃjñākaraṇam, tadvadatideśo
veti | tatrādye pakṣe gāṅkuṭādibhyaḥ paro'ñṇitapratyayo iṅd
uitsaṃjñakaṅkārayuktaḥ, itsaṃjñako ṅkārastasyāstītyarthaḥ | atra
yeṣāmasti ṅkāro yaṅadīnāṃ teṣu vyartho'nuvādaḥ, yeṣāṃ nāsti
tavyādīnāṃ teṣu mithyodyamityupakrimamātramayaṃ pakṣaḥ |
atha dvitīyaḥ ? 'gāṅkuṭādibhyaḥ' iti pañcamyā 'añṇit' iti
prathamāyāḥ ṣaṣṭha|laṃ prakalpitāyāṃ ṅidādeśaḥ prāpnoti | atra prathamāyā
na ca vaiyarthyam, lāghavārthaṃtvāt | tatra ṅiditi karmadhāraye,
asamāse vā 'ādeḥ parasya' iti tavyādīnāmādeṇÇókāraḥ prāpnoti,
kathaṃ punaritsaṃjñako nāmādeśaḥ syāt svayaṃ nivṛtyabhimukhaḥ ? ko
doṣaḥ ? sthāninaṃ nivartya nivartiṣyate !
syādetat-idgrahaṇasāmarthyādādeśo na bhaviṣyati, ādeśatve hi
'laśakvataddhite' ityeva siddhetsaṃjñetyāgamo ṅkāro vidhāsyata iti,
tanna; anenetsaṃjñā yathā syāt tena mā bhūdityevamarthamidgrahaṇaṃ
syāt | kaḥ punaratra viśeṣastena vā satyāmanena vā ? ayamasti
viśeṣaḥ-tena satyāṃ lopaḥ syāt, anena punarnaṃ | tasyeti
prakṛtaparāmarśāt tasyaitasya prakṛtasyetsaṃjñakasyeti | evaṃ ca
śrūyamāṇa eva ṅkāre ṅtkāryāiṇi bhavanti | tatra 'neḍvaśi kṛti'
ityatra varamanādau kṛtīti yadi parigaṇanam, tadātra
pratiṣedhābhāvāt kuṭiṅa kuṭiṅmiti prāpnoti | atha tu
sambhavodāharaṇapradarśanam, tadātrāpi pratiṣedhāt kuṭṅa
kuṭṅmiti prāpnoti | bahuvrīhau tu ye'mī prasiddhā ṅtiśca
ṅadayasya eva tṛjādīnāmādeśāḥ syuḥ | na cāntaryato vyavasthā, yatra
khalvantaratamasyānantaratamasya ca prasaṅgastatrāntaratamaparibhāṣā | na
cātrāntaratamānāṃ tavyaṅadīnāṃ prāptiḥ; loke śāstre vā
teṣāmaprasiddheḥ | na cāntaratamaparibhāṣaiva tān kalpayitumarhati;
niyāmakatvātasyāḥ | santu vā tavyāṅdayaḥ, te'pi tvādeśā bhavantaḥ
'ḍicca' ityantyasyaiva syuḥ | nanu ca nātra śrautaḥ sthānyādeśabhāvaḥ, kiṃ
tarhi ? gāṅkuṭādibhyaḥ paro'ñṇitpratyayo iṅd
itsaṃjñakaṅkārayukta iti siddhānuvādamātrākṣaravyāpāraḥ | sa tu
siddhānuvādau vidhānamantareṇa nopapadyate iti ṅkārasyetsaṃjñakasya
vidhiḥ kalpyate | kimataḥ ? yadyevam, idaṃ tato bhavati
vidhivākyasyāśrutatvāt kva paribhāṣāṅgatāmupeyāt--'ṣaṣṭhī
sthāneyogā' iti vā, 'ādeḥ parasya' iti vā, 'ḍicca' iti vā ?
naitadasti, yasmāt ṣaṣṭhīprakalpenena śrauta eva sthānyādeśabhāva
upapāditaḥ | astu vā kalpitavidhānam, ya eva tvasau vidhiḥ kalpyate,
tatraiva paribhāṣāṅgabhāvamupaiti; vidhyaṅgatvātparibhāṣāṇām |
paribhāṣāḥ khalu vidheraṅgabhūtā
anuvādavākyaśrutārthānyathānupapatyā vidhivākyameva kalpante iti
sarvathā duṣṭa evāyaṃ pakṣaḥ |
saṃjñākaraṇe 'kṅiti ca' ityatrāsya grahaṇaṃ na syāt;
saṃjñārūpasyānuccāritatvāt | ṅcchibdaḥ saṃjñā, ḍicchabdaścoccāritaḥ
pratyekasambandhamapīdgrahaṇaṃ kid yasyetyetāvadeva sampādayet |
na bānvarthā'vayavadvayayuktā saṃjñeti pratyabhijñābhāvāt
kṅtprideśeṣvasya grahaṇaṃ na syādeva | tathā kevale ṅcchibda
uccārite tasyaiva grahaṇaṃ syād, nayaṅadīnām; kṛtrimākṛtrimayoḥ
kṛtrime kāryasampratyayāt | tataśca grahijyādisamprasāraṇaṃ
gṛhṇātītyādāvena syād, na jarīgṛhyateta ityādau | na ca
yaṅadīnāṃ ṅtkāriṇasya vaiyarthyam; kṅtprideśeṣu yatra saṃjñārūpaṃ
na pratyabhijñāyate tatra grahaṇārthatvāt | nanu caivaṃ gāhkuṭādibhyaḥ
parasya ṅtsiṃjñāvidhānamanarthakamāpadyate, katham ? kṅtipradeśeṣvasya
grahaṇaṃ nāstītyuktameva | kevalaśca hicchabdo grahijyādisūtra eva, na
ca tatra gāṅ gṛhyate, nāpi sarve kuṭādayaḥ, kiṃ tu vyatireka eva
satyam; nyāyāgate'rthe kiṃ kurmaḥ ! tyajyatāmayaṃ pakṣaḥ |
tadevameteṣāṃ pakṣāṇāṃ duṣṭatvāt caturthaṃ
pakṣamāśrityāha-atideśo'yamiti | iṅadeśo gṛhyate iti |
'iṅśca''gāṅ liṭi' 'vibhāṣā luṅlṛṅeḥ' iti vihitaḥ |
ṅkārasyānanyārthatvāditi | iṅadeśasya hi yo ṅkārastasyaitadeva
prayojanam--iha tasyaiva grahaṇaṃ yathā syāditi | atha sāmānyagrahaṇaṃ
kasmānna bhavati ? asamānatvādādeśasya | ṅkāro'nyārthaḥ;
ātmanepadasya sthānivadbhāvenaiva siddhatvāt, dhātostucaritārthaḥ |
yadyevam, ābgrahaṇe cāpa eva grahaṇaṃ prāpnoti,
pakārasyānanyārthatvāt,na; evaṃ hi cāpo'nubandhāvanarthakau
syātām, ṭāpaśca ṭakāraḥ | ato yacca yāvacca samānaṃ sambhavati
caritārthapitvamacaritārthapitvamapi tatsarvamāśrīyate, na
cābrūpamevayāvat | kuṅśabda iti | tadanantaraṃ vṛtkaraṇād
'ākūtam' iti prayogadarśanāt 'kūṅ dīrghānto
dbhavatītyarthaḥ' ityantareṇāpi vatiṃ vatyartho gamyate,
yathā-siṃho māṇavaka iti | yadyayamatideśaḥ, 'asaṃyogālliṭ kid'
iti prakaraṇe'pi kitkāryātideśo'ṅgīkartavyaḥ, tataśca
sisṛkṣatītyatra satyapi 'halantācca' iti sanaḥ kitvātideśe
svāśrayamakitvamāśritya 'sṛjidṛśoḥ' ityamāgamaḥ prāpnoti |
atideśena parāśrayaṃ kāryaṃ prāpyate, na tu svāśrayaṃ nivartyate |
siddhaṃ tu prasajyapratiṣedhāt kiti na bhavatīti | tataśca svāśrayasya
kāryasyābhāvādātideśikakitvāśrayaḥ pratiṣedho bhaviṣyati | iha tarhi
uccukuṭiṣati-'ṅtiḥ' ityātmanepadaṃ prāpnoti ? iṅito
dhātorātmanepadamucyate, iha cātideśena sana eva ṅtvim, na
dhātoḥ | yatrāvayave liṅgamacaritārthaṃ tatra samudāyasya viśeṣakaṃ
bhavati; iha tvavayava eva guṇapratiṣedhādikaṃ ṅtvisya prayojanamasti |
yaṅntādapi tarhi na prāpnoti, tasmānnaivaṃ śakyaṃ vijñātum--iṅito
dhātoriti, tataścaikaṃ sanameva ṅtimāśrityātmanepadaṃ prāpnoti ?
naiṣa doṣaḥ, saptamīsamarthādvatiḥ-ṅtīvi t | nanu ca nātra
vatirnirdiśyate, satyam; paratra paraśabdaprayogāt kalpyamāno
vatirvyākhyānāt saptamyantādāśrīyate | evamapi pratiyogini
saptamī prāpnoti-añṇitīti ? evaṃ tarhi 'anudātaṅtiḥ' ityatra
'upadeśe' iti vartate, upadeśe yo ṅt, tita ātmanepadaṃ bhavati |
adhyagīṣateti | 'vibhāṣā luṅlṛṅe' iti
gāṅadeśaḥ,'ātmanepadeṣvanataḥ' ghumāsthādisūtreṇetvam |
vyacerityādi | 'vyaca vyājīkaraṇe' tudādau kuṭādibhyaḥ prāk
paṭha|lte | udviciteti | grahijyādinā samprasāraṇam |
uruvyacā iti bahuvrīhiḥ | kathaṃ vivyacitha ? 'anasi' iti
paryudāso'yamasunpratyayasya kṛtvā tatsadṛśo kṛti kāryaṃ vijñāyate
|
kathaṃ likhitum, svayameva likhiṣyate, yāvatā kuṭeḥ pūrvaṃ likhiḥ
paṭha|lte ? kaścidāha-" kuṭasyādiḥ, kuṭa ādiryeṣāṃ te kuṭādayaḥ,
kuṭādiśśca kuṭādayaśceti bahūvrīhitatpuruṣayoḥ sahavivakṣāyām
'svarabhinnānāṃ yasyotarasvaravidhiḥ sa śiṣyate' iti bahuvrīheḥ śeṣaḥ
| tatra tatpuruṣavṛtayā saṃgṛhīto likhirapi ṅtvisya nimitam" iti
| evaṃ tu likhitvā, lekhitvā; lilikhiṣati, lilekhiṣati;
'śakuniṣvālekhane' ityanupapannaṃ syāt |
tasmādyadyavaśyamupapādanīyam--'saṃjñāpūrvako vidhiranityaḥ' iti
guṇo na bhaviṣyati | 'dhū vidhūnane', kuṭādiḥ, tasya
'artilūdhūsūkhanasahacara itraḥ' itītrapratyaye guṇo na prāpnoti | nātra
guṇa iṣyate, dhuvitramityeva bhavati, kalpasūtrakārāṇāṃ tu
prayogāśchāndasatvādupapādanīyāḥ | atha vā -'bhañjabhāsamido
ghurac''vidibhidicchiderṅd' īti vaktavye pratyayāntarakaraṇaṃ
jñāpakam--ātideśikaṃ ṅtvimanityamiti ||

vija iṭ || 1|2|2 ||

ovijī bhayacalanayoriti | yastu 'sṛjiviji viddhyaniṭsvarān'
it viciḥ, na sa gṛhyate; aniṭtvāt | itarastu īditvasāmarthyāt
seṭ, vṛddhasaṃjñāsūtrād yasyādiriti vartate,
teneḍviśeṣyate-yasyādiriḍiti | tenotamaikavacanasya grahaṇaṃ na
bhavati, na hyasau kasyācidādiḥ | ata evāgamamātrasyāyaṃ ṅtvividhirna
bhavati, kiṃ tarhi ? tadādeḥ pratyayasyetyāha--iḍādiḥ pratyaya iti |
udviciteti | ṅtvāllighūpadhaguṇābhāvaḥ ||

vibhāṣorṇoḥ || 1|2|3 ||

'ūrṇuñ ācchādane' ñid, nopadhaḥ; 'raṣābhyām' iti ṇatvena pāṭhaḥ
| prorṇunāva--rephaviyoge'bhyāsātparasya nakārasya śravaṇaṃ bhavati |
prorṇuviteti | ṅtvipakṣe uvaṅ, anyatra guṇaḥ ||

sārvadhātukamapit || 1|2|4 ||

apiditi paryudāsaścet, cyavante ityatra cyu a ante iti sthane
nityatvādantaṅgatvāccaikādeśaḥ | na ca vārṇādāṅgaṃ balīyaḥ,
nānāśrayatvāt | tatra kṛte parasyehāpit āśritatvātaṃ
pratyādivadbhāvāt pidapitorekādeśo'pidgrahaṇena gṛhyata iti
śabekādeśavataḥ sārvadhātukasya ṅitvād guṇiniṣedhaḥ prāpnoti |
prasajyapratiṣedhe tu pitvanimito niṣedhaḥ pūrvasya kāryamiti pūrvaṃ
pratyantavadbhāvād ṅtvābhāviḥ | astu tarhi prasajyapratiṣedhaḥ ?
yadyevam, tudānītyatra vikaraṇotamayoḥ pidapitorekādeśaḥ parasya
pito ṅtviniṣedhe kartavye ādivatsyāt, ityaṅtimutamamāśritya
guṇaḥ prāpnoti | 'antādivacca' ityatra pūrvaparau
samudāyāvabhipretau, nācau | kiṃ kāraṇam ? ādyantayoravayavatvāt,
sthāninoracorekādeśena nivartitatvācca | ataḥ sthānināvacau
pūrvaparau yayoḥ samudāyayorantādī, ekādeśo'pi
tayorevāntādivadbhavatītyayamatideśārthaḥ | ata eva brahmabandhūrityatra
ekādeśo'pi pratipadikaṃ pratyevāntavadbhavati, dhruvai tuvai ityatra ca
utaimaikavacane kṛtsnayoreva pidapitorekādeśa iti acāveva
pratyādivatve syādeva doṣaḥ |

evaṃ tarhyakādeśasya pūrvavidhau sthānivadbhāvātpakṣadvaye'pi yathā
sthānikāle yathāyogaṃ guṇasya pravṛttinivṛtī bhavataḥ, tathā
kṛte'pyekādeśe sthānibuddhyā bhaviṣyataḥ |
evamubhayornirdoṣatve'pi prayajyapratiṣedha evāśrayaṇīyaḥ | tatra
hi--tadāśrayaṇasāmarthyādyacca yāvacca pito ṅtviṃ prāptaṃ tasya sarvasya
niṣedhādidamapi siddhaṃ bhavati-acinod, acinavamiti | atra hi
ṅito liṅ ādeśasya sthānivadbhāvena prāptasya niṣedho bhavati |
paryudāse tvatideśenaikavākyatvāt tasyaiva paryudāsāt
sthānivadbhāvakṛtaṃ ṅtviṃ syādeveti yāsuṭo canaṃ
jñāpakamāśrayaṇīyaṃ syāt | kiṃ ca 'ṅcci pinna bhavati' ityayamapyatrārtha
iṣyate | ato na brūtādbhavānityatra tātaṅḥ sthānivadbhāvātprāptasya
pitvasya niṣedhāt pidāśrayo bruva iṇ na bhavati,
tṛṇāḍhādbhavān--tṛṇaha iṇ na bhavatītyeṣā dik | ata etadarthamapi
prasajyapratiṣedha āśrayaṇīyaḥ | tatra hi pṛthakkṛtasya naño
yatheṣṭamabhisambandho bhavati--pid ṅnni bhavati, ṅcci pinna bhavati |
tatra yasyaupadeśikaṃ pitvaṃ tasyātideśaprāptaṃ sthānivadbhāvaprāptaṃ
ca ṅtviṃ niṣidhyate; yasya punaraupadeśikaṃ ṅtviṃ tasya
sthānivadbhāvaprāptaṃ pitvaṃ niṣidhyata iti vivektavyam |
kuruta iti | ṅtvāidvikaraṇasya guṇābhāvaḥ, 'ata utsārvadhātuke'
ityutvaṃ ca bhavati | atra ca tṛtīyāsamarthādvatirāśrayaṇīyaḥ, na
pūrvavatsaptamīsamarthāt | tena pacete ityatra 'āto ṅtiḥ' iti
ṅito yitkāryaṃ tadapi bhavati | yadyevam, cinuta iti
'tāsyanudātet' iti lasārvadhātukānudātatvaṃ prāpnoti ? naiṣa
doṣaḥ; upadeśagrahaṇamubhābhyāmapi sambadhyate-ṅdupideśād,
adupadeśāditi | 'ahnviṅeḥ' iti vā paryudāsāt
tatsadṛśasyopadeśaṅkāravato grahaṇamiti sarvamanavadyam ||
asaṃyogālliṭ kit || 1|2|5||
liṭā''kṣipto dhāturasaṃyogagrahaṇena viśeṣyata ityāha
asaṃyogāntāddhātoriti | nanu cātra paryudāsatvamuktaṃ pratīyate,
tataśca saṃyogāntasadṛśād halantadeva
syād-bibhidatuḥ,bibhidurityādau; ninyaturityādau tu na syāt
? jñāpakāt siddham, yadayam 'ṛtaśca saṃyogāderguṇaḥ' iti
sasmaraturityādau guṇaṃ vidhate, tajjñāpayati-nātra nañivayuktanyāyo
dhātumātrasyaiva grahaṇamiti | ṅtve prikṛte kitvātideśasya
prayojanam --ījanam, ījatḥ, ījuḥ, yajādīnāṃ kitīti
samprasāraṇaṃ yathā syāt; jajāgaratuḥ,
jajāgaruḥ-'jāgroviciṇṇalṅtsu' īti guṇo yathā syāt | yadi
punargāṅkuṭādibhyo'pi kitvamevātidiśyeta ? naivaṃ śakyam; iha
hi doṣaḥ syād--'ṇu stutau''dhū vidhūnane' tṛc, nuvidā
dhuvidā--'rśyukaḥ kiti' itīṭpratiṣedhaḥ prāpnoti, yathā-lūtvā,
lūnaḥ ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; pūrvasya kāryatideśo'yamityuktam | iha tarhi
kuṭitvā, puṭitvā--'na ktvā seṭ' ityātideśikasyāpi kitvasya
pratiṣedho nātideśikasya bhavatīti, satyam; asati ktvāgrahaṇe, sati
tu tasmin sanaḥ 'na ktvā seṭ' iti niṣedho na labhyate ityajñāpakaṃ
vakṣyate-'na ktvā seṭ' iti niṣedho nātidaeśikasya bhavatīti,
satyam; asati katvāgrahaṇe, sati tu tasmin sanaḥ 'na ktvā seṭ'
iti niṣedho na labhyate ityajñāpakaṃ tatra ḍhalgrahaṇam | tathā
'sārvadhātukamapid' iti kitvātideśe jāgṛtaḥ, jāgratīti guṇaḥ
syād, ṅtvāitideśe tvaviciṇṇalṅtsviti piryudāso bhavati |
'ṛdupadhebhyo liṭaḥ kitvaṃ guṇāt pūrvavipratiṣedhena' |
kitvasyāvakāśaḥ-ṛjatuḥ, ṛjuḥ na hyatra vidhyantarasya kasyacitprasaṅgaḥ;
guṇasyāvakāśaḥ--vartitvā,vardhitvā; vavṛte,
vavṛdhurityatrobhayaprasaṅge kitvaṃ bhavati pūrvavipratiṣedhena | iha
tu bibidatuḥ bibhiduḥ, nityatvādeva kitvaṃ siddham; taddhi kṛte'pi
guṇe prāpnotyakṛte'pi, guṇastu kitve sati na prāpnoti | vavṛte
ityatra tu guṇe kṛte saṃyogāntatvāt kitvaṃ na
prāpnotītyubhayamanityamiti pūrvavipratiṣedha ucyate | sa cāyaṃ
kāryātideśapakṣe sphuṭameva vaktavyaḥ | tathā hi-anenaiva
kitkāryātideśa ījaturityādau yatra vidhyantarasyāprasaṅgastatra
samprasāraṇamitadiśya caritārthamatideśaṃ paratvād guṇo bādheta |
śāstrātideśe vā 'kṅiti ca' ityetacchāstramatidiśyate, tacca yadyapi
guṇasyāpavādabhūtam, tathāpyanyatra caritārthatvād
durbalenātideśenātidiṣṭaḥ 'kṅiti ca' iti pratiṣedho durbala
iti taṃ bādhitvā guṇaḥ syādeva ||
indhibhavatibhyāṃ ca || 1|2|6 || 
indheragantuka ikāro na tu 'ikśtipau dhātunirdeśe' itīk
pratyayaḥ, tena 'aniditām' iti nalopo na bhavati | samīdha iti |
'ñiṅndhī dīptau' anudātet, eśaḥ kitvād 'aniditām'
ityupadhālopadvirvacane savarṇadīrghatvam | babhūviva, babhūvitheti |
kitvādyathākramaṃ vṛddhiguṇau na bhavataḥ | indheḥ saṃyogārthamityādinā
pūrvaṇāsiddhaṃ darśayan sūtrārambhaṃ samarthayate |
ayaṃ yogaḥ śakyo'vaktum, katham ? indheranantaraścchandasyeva liḍ
bhavati, bhāṣāyāṃ tvijādeścetyāmā bhavitavyam, cchandasi ca
'cchandasyubhayathā' iti liṭaḥ sārvadhātukasaṃjñā, 'sārvadhātukamapit'
iti ṅitvādupidhālopaḥ | śnami tu kartavya ārdhadhatukasaṃjñā,
chāndasatvādvā śnamabhāvaḥ | bhavaterapi 'bhuvo vugluṅliṭoḥ' iti
vugvidhīyate, tatra bhūa, bhūitha iti sthite vuk prāpnoti,
vṛddhiguṇau ca; kṛtākṛtapasaṅgitvena nityo vuk, naca
śabdāntaraprāptaḥ, ekadeśavikṛtasyānanyatvād; vuki ca
kṛte'najantatvādalaghūpadhatvācca vṛddhiguṇau na bhaviṣyataḥ | avaśyaṃ
caitadevaṃ vijñeyam-'vukā vṛddhiguṇau bādhyete' iti | yo hi
manyate-'kitvādime guṇavṛddheḥ kiti neti pratiṣedhaḥ,
aniglakṣaṇatvāt | evaṃ tarhi jñāpakārthamindhigrahaṇam, etaj,
jñāpayati-'indherbhāṣāyāmapyanitya ām' iti, samīdhe samīdhāñcakra iti
bhāṣāyāmapi bhavati | bhavaterapi vuganityaḥ, kiṃ kāraṇam ? uriti
vartate, na ca guṇavṛddhyoḥ kṛtayoruvarṇānto bhavatirbhavati;
uriti nivartiṣyate ? yadi vivartate; bobhāva, ahaṃ kila
bobhava-yaṅlukyapi nityatvād vuk prāpnoti | anuvartamāne
punarurityasmin ubhayoranityayoḥ paratvād guṇavṛddhyoḥ
kṛtayoranuvarṇāntatvād vuṅna bhavati | athedānīṃ
yaṅlukyapyanenaiva liṭaḥ kitvaṃ kasmānna bhavati ? śtipā nirdeaṣaśāt
| yadi punarvugvidhāveva śtipā nirdeśaḥ kriyate ? naivaṃ śakyam; iha
hi doṣaḥ syād-bobhūvat;, bobhūvuḥ | yadā punaḥ kitvavidhau
śtipā nirdeśaḥ kriyate, na vugvidhau; tadā yaṅluki pitsu
vacaneṣu liṭaḥ kitvābhāvād guṇavṛddhyoḥ
kṛtayorurityadhikārād vuṅna bhavati | apitsu vacaneṣu
'asaṃyogālliṭ kit' iti kitve sati
guṇābhāvāduvarṇāntatvādvug bhavati | nanu
cokram--'ārabhyamāṇe'pi kitve vṛddheḥ pratiṣedho na siddhyati,
agnilakṣaṇatvād' iti, naiṣa doṣaḥ; ṅdgrihaṇamapyanuvartate,
tatsāmarthyādanaglikṣaṇāyā api vṛddheḥ pratiṣedho bhaviṣyati, satyam;
astyaṃ śuṣkastarkaḥ | vārtikakārastu na kṣamate, yadāha-'indheścchando
viṣayatvād bhuvo vuko nityatvātābhyāṃ liṭaḥ kidvacanānarthakyam'
iti |
śranthigranthītyādi | 'śrantha grantha saṃdarbhe', 'dambu dambhe''ṣvañja
piraṣvaṅge' | śrethatu;, śrethuriti kitvādupadhālopaḥ,
etvābhyāsalopāvapyatra vaktavāyau | debhaturiti | nalope kṛte 'ata
ekahalmadhye'nādeśādeḥ' ityetvābhyāsalopau | na ca lopasyā
siddhatvam, ābhācchāstrīyasyāsiddhatvasyānityatvāt | pariṣasvaja iti |
'ṣvañjapariṣvaṅge', anudātet,'upasargātsunoti' iti ṣatvam
'sadisvañjyoḥ parasya liṭi' iti parasya pratiṣedhaḥ | atra
kecidveti paṭhanti, śaśranthaturityādyapi bhavati | atha pitsu vacaneṣu
katham ? yadi saṃyogārthameva vacanam, pitsu na bhāvyam | atha
saṃyogāntārthaṃ pidarthaṃ ca ? pitsvapi bhāvyam | kiṃ punaratrārthatatvaṃ
devo jñātumarhati ||
mṛḍamṛdagudhakuṣakliśavadavasaḥ ktvā || 1|2|7 || 
'kliśa hiṃsāyām', anudāted, divādirakarmakaḥ; 'kliśū
vibādhane' rkyādiḥ sakarmakaḥ, parasmaipadī-dvyorapi grahaṇam |
kimarthaṃ punaridam, tāvatā kideva hi ktvā ? tatrāha--na ktvā
seḍityādi | apakarṣaḥ u apavādaḥ nanvidameva niyamārthaṃ
bhaviṣyati-'mṛḍādibhya eva ktvā kidbhavati nānyebhyaḥ' iti nārthaḥ 'na
ktvā seṭ' ityanena; kathaṃ lūtvā pūtvā-tulyajātīyasya seṭo
niyamaḥ ? nanu 'kliśaḥ ktvāniṣṭhayoḥ' iti
vikalpeneḍvidhānādaniṭ ktvā sambhavati ? evaṃ tarhi
mṛḍamṛdavadavasāṃ kitvāvidhānaṃ niyamārtham, itareṣāṃ tu 'ralo
vyapadhāt' iti vikalpabādhena vidhisambhavānniyamo na bhaviṣyati |
evamapi viparīto'pi niyamaḥ syād--mṛḍādibhyaḥ ktvaiva kiditi |
uditvā, uṣitveti | yajāditvātsamprasāraṇam 'śāsivasighasīnāṃ ca'
iti ṣatvam, 'vasatikṣudhoriṭ' ||
rudavidamuṣagrahisvapipracchaḥ saṃśca || 1|2|8 ||
sannarthamiti | tatra caritārthatvādaniṭaḥ ktvāḥ kitvāvidhānaṃ
niyamārthaṃ na bhavati ||

iko jhal || 1|2|9 ||
sanākṣiptasya dhātorikā
viśeṣaṇātadantavidhirbhavatītyāha--igantāddhātoriti | 'ik smaraṇe'
ityāsya tu dhātorgrahaṇaṃ na bhavati, na hyataḥ paro jhalādisan
sambhavati, katham ? 'iṇo gā luṅ' 'ṇiu gamiravabodhane' 'sani ca'
'iṇvadika iti vaktavyam' 'gameriṭ parasmaipadeṣu'--adhijegamiṣati |
nanu ca bhāvakarmaṇaorātmanepade 'anudātopadeśa'
ityanunāsikalopārthametatsyāt, tatra tu rūpe vipratipatiḥ,
gameriṅadeśasya grahaṇamiti vacanāt 'ajjhanagamāṃ sani' iti dīrgho
na bhavati-adhijigaṃsyata iti kecit |
anye tvāhuḥ-ṭhṭhṭhajjhanagamān' ityatrājgrahaṇaṃ na kartavyam, katham ?
'sani dīrghaḥ' ityeko yogaḥ, acaśca , evaṃ siddhe'jagrahaṇaṃ
pravṛttibhedena gamerapi viśeṣaṇāartham--ajādeśasya gameriti;
tenāsyāpi dīrgheṇa bhāvyam, ajādeśatvād-adhijigāṃsyata iti
rūpamiti | tadevaṃ dhātorapi grahaṇaṃ yuktameva | evaṃ tarhi jhalā
sāhacaryād gargādiṣu jigīṣuśabdasya pāṭhācca pratyāhārasya
grahaṇamutarasūtre ca iksamīpāddhalaḥ para ityanupapannaṃ dhātugrahaṇe |
jhalādiriti | kathaṃ punassatsaptamīnirdeśe tadādividhiḥ śakyo
vijñātum ? jhalmātrasya sano'sambhavāt | nanu ca
cikīrṣitetyādavato lope sati sambhavati, apūrvavidhatvācca na
lopasya sthānivatvām; evaṃ tarhi vṛddhisaṃjñāsūtrādyasyādiriti
vartate san kidbhavati, kīdṛśaḥ ? yasya ḍhalādiriti | etena
tadantavidhirapi nirasto veditavyaḥ | cicīṣatīti | 'ekācaḥ'
itīṭpratiṣedhaḥ | tuṣṭūaṣatīti | 'śarpūrvāḥ khayaḥ' | śiśayiṣata iti
| 'pūrvavatsanaḥ' | kimarthamiti | yogavibhāgaviṣayaḥ praśnaḥ | sūtraṃ
tūtarārthaṃ kartavyam | dīrghatvaguṇasya bādhakaṃ bhaviṣyatīti | nanu
'kuṅśabde' kaṭādiḥ, cukūṣata ityasmi dīrghasyāvakāśaḥ ?
dīrghānto'yamityavocām | iha tarhi 'gu purīṣotsarge' 'dhru
gatisthairyayoḥ' kuṭādī, jugūṣati, dudhūṣati | evamapi
pratyāhāragrahaṇamanarthakam 'uto dīrgha' iti vaktvayam ? asti
pratyāhāragrahaṇe prayojanam, kim ? pratibhedena gamimapi
viśeṣayiṣyāmīti | yadyetāvatprayojanaṃ syāt 'uto dīrgha' ityuktvā
iṅhanyoriti vaktavyam-yeṣāṃ sameriṅadeśasya grahaṇamiti pakṣaḥ |
yeṣāmaniṅadeśasyāpi grahaṇaṃ teṣāmihanyoriti vaktavyam, hanā
sāhacaryādiriti dhāturgṛhyate, nekāraḥ,
tasmādajgarahaṇasāmarthyāddīrghatvaṃ guṇasya bādhakaṃ bhaviṣyatīti
suṣṭhūaktam | yathaiva tarhi jhalādau guṇo bādhyate, evamiṅadāvapi
bādhyeta--jijaviṣayati, nātra dīrdhaḥ pravartate, kiṃ asati hi kitve
nāprāpte vidhyantare ārabhyamāṇaṃ dīrghatvaṃ yathā guṇaṃ bādhate evaṃ
ṇilopamapi bādhena | nanu yatra nāprāpte tasya bādhakaḥ, kva ca
nāprāpte ? dīrgha ārabhyate, guṇe ṇilope tu jñīpsatītyatra prāpte,
cicīṣatītyatrāprāpte pākṣika eva parihāraḥ | yatra bādhyaṃ
bhedenāpekṣyate--'idamasminviṣaye prāptamidamastinviṣaye' iti,
tatraikabādhenopapatau satyāmanekabādho na nyāyya iti kimekaṃ
bādhyatāmityapekṣāyām 'yena naaprāpte sa bādhanīṭaḥ' ityucyate,
evaṃ hyapekṣitavidhirbhavati | yadi tu 'nāprāpte vidhyantare
idamārabhyate' iti kāryasāmānyamapekṣyate, tadā sarvameva bādhanīyam
| etena purastādapavādanyāyena ṇilopameva dīrghatvaṃ bādheta, na
guṇamityapi codyaṃ nirastam; yasyādayamapi nyāyaḥ
kāryasamānyacintāyāṃ nāstyeva | ataḥ suṣṭhūaktam--ṇilopamapi
bādheteti | dīrghatvasyāvakāśadānāyeti | etadeva
sphuṭayati-cicīṣatītyādi ṣviti | sati hi katve cicīṣatītyādau
kitvenaiva guṇo bādhyate, na dīrgheṇetyabādhitvaiva vidhyantaraṃ
sāvakāśo dīrghaḥ paratvāṇṇilopena bādhyata ityarthaḥ | jñīpsatīti |
'māraṇatoṣaṇaniśāmaneṣu jñā', 'jñapa micca' iti curādiṣu pāṭhād
ṇici puki 'mitāṃ hrasvaḥ', san, 'sanībantarddha' itīḍabhāvakṣe
'āpjñapṛdhāmīt' itītvam, 'atra lopo'bhyāsasya ' | kimartho
yogavibhāga ityaśaṅkya prayojanamāha--ikaḥ kitavamityādi | guṇo
mā bhūdityevamarthamika utarasya sanaḥ kitvaṃ vidhīyataityarthaḥ |
dūṣayati-dīrghārambhāditi | guṇo na bhaviṣyatīti śeṣaḥ | kṛte
bhavediti | śāstramāvartamānaṃ japādivadbharme sādhanamiti bhāvaḥ |
anarthakaṃ tviti | śāstrapūrvakātprayogāddharmo na tu pravṛttimātrāditi
bhāvaḥ | nanu ca 'sani mīmāghu' ityatra minoterapi mīgrahaṇaena
grahaṇārthaṃ dīrghavidhiḥ syād, mā bhūnmīgrahaṇena grahaṇam,
'mīnātiminotidīṅaṃ lyapi ca' ityātve kṛte
'gāmādāgrahaṇeṣvaviśeṣaḥ' iti māgrahaṇena grahaṇaṃ bhaviṣyati;
tatrāyamapyartho mīgrahaṇamapi na kartavyaṃ bhavati | hrasvārthamiti |
hrasvānāmeva dīrghavidhānāsāmarthyād guṇo na syād, dīrghāṇāṃ tu
punaḥ prāpnoti--lulūṣati; na hi dorghānteṣu dīrghaśāstraṃ
pravartate, pūrvameva tadrūpasadbhāvāditi bhāvaḥ | sāmārthyāddhi
punarbhāvyamiti | sāmarthyam u prayojanasadbhāvaḥ, yathā 'mo rāji
samaḥ kvau' iti makārasyaiva makāro vidhīyate, vikārāntaraṃ mā
bhūditi | tathā dīrghasyāpi guṇo mā bhūditi punardīrdho bhaviṣyati
| yadi tarhi prāpnuvanvidhiḥ dīrgheṇa bādhyate, āñditvāmapi na
prāpnoti-cikīrṣati, tatrāha--āñditvaṃ dīrghasaṃśrayamiti | dīrghaḥ
saṃśrayo nimitaṃ yasya tatathoktam | yaṃ vidhiṃ pratyupadeśo'narthakaḥ
sa vidhirbādhyate, yasya tu vidhernimitameva nāsau bādhyate | na
cātrākṛte dīrghe āñditvaṃ prāpnoti | iha tarhi-titīrṣati, akṛte'pi
dīrghatve āñditvaṃ prāpnotīti ? āñditvānivṛtyarthameva dīrghatvaṃ
syād, ata āha-dīrghāṇāṃ nākṛte dīrgha iti | dīrghāṇāmapyakṛte
dīrghatve ṛditvaṃ na prāpnoti, kiṃ kāraṇam ? itvotvābhyāṃ
guṇavṛddhī bhavato vipratiṣedhena, ato yāvaddīrdheṇa guṇo na
bādhitaḥ, tāvaditvaṃ na pāpnoti; tasmānnārtha eteneti sthite
prayojanamāha--ṇilopastviti ||
halantācca || 1|2|10 ||
samīpavacano'ntaśabda iti | avayavavacanastu na bhavati,
dhātāvanyapadārthe 'yena vidhistadantasya' ityeva tadantavidheḥ
siddhatvāt | ikastvanyapadārthatvaṃ naiva sambhavati, na hi varṇo
varṇāntarasyāvayava upapadyate | hal cāsāvantaśceti | karmadhārayaṃ
darśayati | nipātanādviśeṣaṇasya paranipātaḥ | tatra ca kasyānto
halitayapekṣāyāmika iti pañcamyantaṃ sannihitaṃ ṣaṭha|lntaṃ vipariṇamyata
ityāha-igantāditi | ikamapekṣamāṇasyāpyantaśabdasya nityasāpekṣatvāt
sūtre karmadhārayaḥ, bahuvrīhau tu dhātoranyapadārthatvaṃ naiva
sambhavati, antaśabdo hi niyatadeśameva samīpamācaṣṭe paraṃ nāma, na
samīpamātram | na ca dhātoḥ parasamīpāvasthite hali tataḥ paraḥ
sansambhavati; iki tvanyapadārthe-yasyekaḥ parasamīpe hal na
tasyānantaraḥ sū sambhavatītyekena halā vyavadhāne vijñāyeteti
dhipsatītyatra na syād | haliti jātigrahaṇāt siddhāvapi
pratipatigauravaprasaṅgaḥ | nanu ca mā bhūdantagrahaṇam, 'halaḥ'
ityevāstu, ikā halviśeṣyate, tena ca dhātuḥ-ikaḥ paro yo hal
tadantāddhātoriti | na caivamatra śaṅkanīyam--"asatyantagrahaṇe
igvato halantāditi vijñāyeta, tataśca yajeḥ san 'sanyataḥ' yiyakṣate
ityatrāpi kitve sati saṃprasāraṇaṃ prāpnoti" iti; na hīkcchabdasya
mukhye'rthe sambhavati tadvati vṛttiryuktā, kiṃ ca 'igvataḥ' ityasya
vyāvartyamapi na sambhavati | yāyajyateḥ sani yāyajiṣata ityatra sanna
jhalādiḥ | tasmādantagrahaṇaṃ cintyaprayojanam |
iha dhīpsatīti ya iksamīpe hal nakāro na tataḥ paraḥ san, yataśca
paraḥ san bhakārāt na sa iksamīpa iti kitvaṃ na syādityata
āha-dambheriti | dambherapi parasya sanaḥ kitvaṃ siddham, kutaḥ ?
halgrahaṇasya jātivācakatvāt | 'tatprayojakaḥ' itivatsamāsaḥ |
jātivācī halśabdaḥ, ekaiva ca jātirnakārabhakārayoḥ | vyaktidvārakaṃ
ca jāteriksamīpatvaṃ tadapekṣayātra sanaḥ paratvam |
bhakāravyaktiriksamīpe vartata iti jātirapi vartate, bhakāravyakteḥ
paraḥ sanniti jāterapi paraḥ | viparyayastu sannapi
śāstreṇānāśritatvādakiñcitkaraḥ | nakāravyaktiriksamīpe na vartata
iti jātirapi na vartate | nakāravyakteḥ paraḥ sanna bhavatīti jāterapi
paro na bhavatīti | dhīpsatīti | 'dambha icca' kitvādupadhālopaḥ
'ekāco baśo bhaṣ jhaṣantasya sdhvoḥ' iti bhaṣbhāvaḥ, dvirvacanam,
'atra lopo'bhyāsasya' ||
liṅasicāvātmanepadeṣu || 1|2|11 ||
ātmanepadeṣu parata iti | etatsica eva viśeṣaṇam, na
liṅparasmaipadasya; jhalgrahaṇānuvṛtyaiva vyāvartitatvāt |
bhitsīṣṭeti | bhidiḥ svaritet, 'liṅḥ sīyuṭ','suṭ tithoḥ' |
bhutsīṣṭeti | budhiranudātet, pūrvavad bhaṣ | abuddheti |
cleḥ sic', jhalo jhali', 'jhaṣastathordho'dhaḥ','jhalāṃ jaś jhaśi' iti
dhakārasya dakāraḥ | yakṣīṣṭeti | svaritetvādātmanepadam,
vraścādiṣatvam, 'ṣaḍhoḥ kaḥ si' |
adrākṣīditi | amāgame yaṇi ca kṛte 'vadavraja' ityakārasya vṛddhiḥ ||
uśca || 1|2|12 ||
liṅasijbhyāmākṣiptasya dhātorurityanena tadantavidhirityāha-
ṛvarṇāntāditi | 'ṛ gatau' ityasya tu grahaṇaṃ na bhavati;
'sartiśāstyartiśca' ityaṅe vidhānena sico'sambhavāt |
nanvaṅvidhau kartarītyanuvṛteḥ karmaṇi sijapi sambhavati, evaṃ tarhi
śailīyamācāryasya yatrāsya dhātorgrahaṇamicchati tatra śtipā nirdeśaṃ
karoti-'artipipartyośca','sartiśāstyartibhyaśca' iti svarūpeṇāpi
grahaṇaṃ dṛṣṭam | evaṃ tarhi vyāptinyāyādvarṇagrahaṇam | akṛteti |
'hrasvādaṅgāt' iti sico lopaḥ | avariṣṭeti |
'liṅasicorātmanepadeṣu' itīṭ | 'vā gamaḥ' | saṃgaṃsīṣṭeti |
'samo gamyarcchi' ityātmanepadam ||
hanaḥ sic || 1|2|14 ||
sautratvānnirdeśasyāllopo na kṛtaḥ | āhasateti |'āṅe yamahana'
ityātmanepadam, 'ātmanepadeṣvanataḥ' ityadādeśaḥ | sijgrahaṇaṃ
liṅnivṛtyarthamiti | prakṛtaṃ sijgrahaṇaṃ liṅsaṃbaddhamiti
tadanuvṛtau tasyāpyanuvṛttiḥ syāditi bhāvaḥ |
nanu ca 'hano vadha liṅ' īti liṅ vidhādeśo nityaḥ,
dhāniṣīṣṭeti ciṇvadiṭi
vadhādeśābhāve'pyajhalāditvādaprasaṅgastat kiṃ
liṅnivṛtyetyatrāha-ukṣaratreti | utarārthamavaśyaṃ sijgrahaṇaṃ
kartavyam, tadihaiva kriyate, nyāyānusaraṇe pratipatigauravaṃ mā
bhūdityevamārthamityarthaḥ |
ātmanepadagrahaṇamityādi | yamaḥ parasmaipadeṣu 'yamaramanamātām'
iti sagiṭau bhavata iti jhalādiḥ sijna bhavati | upayamane tu
nityamātmanepadam, sthādhvoḥ parasmaipadeṣu sico lug
bhavati,'vā gamaḥ' ityatrāpi parasmaipadeṣvaṅ bhavati, līṅ
yāsuṭnivṛtyarthameva ca jhalgrahaṇamanuvartyam,
evamasminnapyadhāniṣātāmiti ciṇvadiṭi mā bhūditi, tadevam 'vā
gamaḥ' ityārabhyātmanepadagrahaṇaṃ cintyaprayojanam | kimarthaṃ
punaridam, yāvatā ātmanepadaṃ ṅiti sijantasyāṅgasya
'aniditām' ityeva nalopaḥ siddhaḥ, uccāraṇārtho hi sica ikāraḥ,
nānubandhaḥ ? jñāpanārtham | etaj jñāpayati-'na
sijantasyopadhālopo bhavati' iti | tenāmāsteti siddhaṃ bhavati |
nanu ca sici 'anudātopadeśa' iti lopo yathā syād, ātmanepade
upadhālopo mā bhūdityevamarthamidaṃ syāt, kaḥ punaratra
viśeṣaḥ-sici vā lopo bhavatu, ātmanepade vā ? ayamasti
viśeṣaḥ-ātmanepade lope sati 'ato lopaḥ' prāpnoti, sici tu
na; ābhīyasyānunāsikalobasyāsiddhatvāt | yadyapi
upadhālopo'pyābhīyastathāpi vyāśrayatvādasiddhatvaṃ na
prāpnoti-ātmanepade upadhālopaḥ, sicyato lopaḥ | yadyevam,
bahiraṅga upadhālopaḥ, bahirbhūtātmanepadāpekṣatvād;
antaraṅgo'llopaḥ, antarbhūtasijapekṣatvāt 'asiddhaṃ
bahiraṅgamantaraṅge' |
nanu caiṣā paribhāṣāpyābhācchāstrīyā 'vāha ūṭha' ityatra jñāpiteti
tasyāmantaraṅgabahiraṅgayorasiddhatvād yathā papuṣa
ityādāvallopādiṣu vasoḥ saṃprasāraṇasyāsiddhatvaṃ na bhavati,
tathātrāpi na syāt, tataścāto lopaḥ syāditi
sicyevānunāsikalopa eṣitavya iti vaktavyameva sicaḥ kitvamiti
jñāpakānupapateḥ, amaṃstetyādāvupadhālopaḥ syāt | tasmāt sica
ikāro'nubandha eva, nauccāraṇārthaḥ | tena 'aditām' iti
pratiṣedhādupadhālopābhāvaḥ | 'idito num' ityatra dhātugrahaṇaṃ
sijantanivṛtyarthameva kriyate, na dhātūpadeśāvasthāyāmeva num
yathā syādityevamartham | kuṇḍetyādisiddhaye ca
yatnāntaramāstheyamiti kecit; neti vayam | upadhālope'pi
nāto lopena bhavitavyam | kiṃ kāraṇam ? 'upadeśa' iti vartate
upadeśe yo'kārāntastasya lopaḥ, ihāpi tarhi na
prāpnoti--'dhinvikṛṇvyora ca' dhinutaḥ, kṛṇutaḥ,
nopadeśagrahaṇena prakṛtirabhisambadhyate--upadeśe yā
prakṛtirakārānteti, kiṃ tarhi ?
ārdhadhātukamabhisambadhyate--ārddhadhātukopadeśe yadakārāntaṃ tasyeti
| tadevamupadhālope'pi na kaściddoṣa iti jñāpakāryameva vacanamiti
sarvamanākulam||yamo gandhane || 1|2|15 ||
nanu yamiruparame paṭha|lte, kathaṃ gandhane vartata ityata
āha--anekārthatvāditi | udāyateti | parāvadyaṃ svayaṃ
prakāśitavānityarthaḥ | udāyaṃsta pādamiti | apakṛṣṭavānityarthaḥ ||
sthādhvoricca || 1|2|17 ||
cakāreṇa kitvaṃ samuccīyata ityāha--sicca kiditi | prayojanaṃ
guṇo mā bhūditi | itvaṃ tu guṇavidhānārthameva syāt; laghutvāt
| upāsthiteti | 'upānmantrakaraṇe' 'akarmakācca' ityātmanepadam,
'hrasvādaṅgāt' iti sico lopaḥ | na cetvaṃ sijītyucyate, kiṃ
tarhi ? ikāraścāntādeśassicca kidbhavatītyetāvat |
tenetvasyāsijnimitatvād bhavatyeva lopaḥ |
iccetyādi | takāra idyasya tasya bhāvaḥ takoretvam, iccetyatra nirdeśe
kasya, kāryasya siddhaye ikārasya takāretvaṃ kriyata ityarthaḥ | dīrgho mā
bhūditi | āntaryataḥ prāpnotīti bhāvaḥ | ṛte'pi sa iti |
ikāravidhānenāpi vinetyarthaḥ | kitve hi ghumāsthādisūtreṇaiva
dīrghassiddhaḥ, tasmāditvavidhānasāmarthyād anantaratamo'pi hrasva eva
bhaviṣyatītyarthaḥ | bhāvyamāno'ṇsavarṇānna gṛhṇāti ityayamapyatra
parihāraḥ saṃbhavati | anantara iti | asadṛśa ādeśe kriyamāṇe hrasva iva
pluto'pi syāt,sa mā bhūdityarthaḥ | plutaśceti | anena taparatvaṃ
pratyākhyāyate | yadyanena pluto vidhīyeta, tadā yatra viṣaye
'anantyasyāpi praśnākhyānayoḥ' ityādinā pluto
vihitastatrāpyanenaiva syād, asminkartavye tasyāsiddhatvāditi
pakṣe'nuvādadoṣaḥ prāpnoti,tato hrasva eva bhaviṣyati | anye tu
taparatvamanena samarthitaṃ manyanteasati takāra āntarayaṃto dīrghasya
dīrghaḥ prāpnoti | nanu coktam-'siddho'tra dīrghaḥ' iti ? siddhe
satyārambho niyamārthaḥ syād-dīrgha eva yathā syāt pluto mā
bhūditi tadidamuktam--anntara ityādinā | ghumāsthādisūtreṇānena vā
dīrghe sati yadyapi viśeṣo nāsti, tathāpyanantare'vidyamāne'pi
viśeṣe pluto mā bhūditi dīrghaḥ syādityarthaḥ | mā bhūd iti
cet tatrāha-plutaśceti | sa cāsati taparatve na prāpnoti, sati tu
tasmin dīrghasyāprasaṅgādvidhireva saṃpadyata iti svaviṣaye pluto na
vyāvartyate | tadevamanyatra bhinnakālanivṛtyarthaṃ taparakaraṇam, iha tu
dīrghanivṛtyarthaṃ plutapravṛtyarthaṃ ca vastubalātsamapādi ||
na ktvā seṭ || 1|2|18 ||
na kidbhavatīti | kitkāryaṃ na karotītyarthaḥ | na punaḥ
kakārasyetsaṃjñābhāvāt kinna bhavatīti | prakṛto hi kicchabdaḥ
kitkāryakāriṇi vartata iti tadarthasyaiva niṣedho
yuktaḥ-devitvetyādau guṇapratiṣedhākhyaṃ kitkāryaṃ na bhavatīti |
nigṛhītiriti | atra 'titutra' itīṭpratiṣedho na bhavati,
titutreṣvagrahadīnāmiti vacanāt | nikucitiriti | 'kuñca
kauṭilyālpībhāvayoḥ' | eṣūdāharaṇeṣu saṃprasāraṇam,
guṇapratiṣedhaḥ, upadhālopaśca kitvādbhavanti |
na seḍityādi | pūrvāddhemeko granthaḥ, utarārddhācca netyapakṛṣyate
| na seḍityetāvatāpi yogenākitve kṛte gudhito
gudhitavānityatra niṣṭhāyāmavadhāraṇānniyamānna bhaviṣyati | 'niṣṭhā
śīṅsvidimidikṣvididhṛṣaḥ' iti niyamaḥ-śīṅadibhya eva parā
niṣṭhā na kiditi | viparītastu niyamaḥ-niṣṭhèaveti vyākhyānānna
bhavati | liṭi tarhi pratiṣedhaḥ syāt, tataśca jagmiva, jagmima
'gamahana' ityupadhālopo na syād, ata āha-jñāpakāditi |
pūrvācāryaprasiddhyā parokṣe liḍucyate, yathā-bhavantī laṭ,
śvastanī luṭ | kiṃ jñāpakamityata āha-sanīti | 'iko jhal' ityatra
jhalgrahaṇasyaitatprayojanam--śiśayiṣata ityatra mā bhūditi | yadi ca
na seḍiti pratiṣedha ātideśikasyāpi kitvāsya syād
jhalgrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt | prāpnotvatra kitvam, 'na seṭ' iti
pratiṣedho bhaviṣyati | tadetad jhalgrahaṇamaupadeśikasya
kitvasyāyaṃ pratiṣedho nātideśikasyetyasyārthasya jñāpakaṃ viduḥ |
nanu cotarārthaṃ jhalgrahaṇam, sthāghvoritvaṃ jhalādau yathā syāt
ciṇvadiṭi mā bhūditi-upāsthāyiṣātām, atra hi upāsthās
ātāmiti sthite, itvaṃ ca prāpnoti ciṇvadbhāvaśca,
paratvācciṇvadbhāve yukca prāpnoti vṛddhiśca, kāpavādatvādyauki
kṛte yakārasyetvaprasaṅgaḥ; na ca punarvṛddhirlabhyate, pūrvameva
yukā bādhitvāt, tasmādutarārthaṃ jhalgrahaṇam ? naitadasti;
yasmāditvaṃ kitvasaṃyogenocyate, na cātra kitvamasti; na seḍiti
pratiṣedhāt | na hyatrāsyāṃ daśāyāṃ jhalgrahaṇasya jñāpakatvaṃ
sthitamityātideśikasyāpi kitvasyāyaṃ pratiṣedho bhavati | reṇa
tulyaṃ sudhīvanīti | śobhanā dhīvāno'syāḥ sudhīvā strī 'ano
bahuvrīheḥ' iti prakṛtasya ṅīpo niṣedhe sati
'saṃniyogaśiṣṭānāmanyatarābhāve ubhayorapyabhāvaḥ' iti yathā repho
na bhavati tadvadihāpītyarthaḥ | vasvarthamiti | arthaśabdo nivṛtau |
jagmivānityatra kvasauḥ kitvapratiṣedho mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ tarhi
ktvāgrahaṇamityarthaḥ | dūṣayati-kiṃdatīdeśāditi | siddhamiti śeṣaḥ |
astvatraupadeśikasya kitvasya pratiṣedhaḥ, ātideśikaṃ kitvaṃ
bhaviṣyati | yatratarhi tatpratiṣidhyate saṃyogāntaṣvañjeḥ,
ājivān-atra hi nalope kṛte dvirvacana ekadeśe ca
'vasvekājāddhasām' itīḍāgamaḥ, tatra kṛte kitvapratiṣedhād
nalopanivṛtau dvihaltāt nuṭi satyekāctvābhāvādiṇnivṛtau
kitvanalopādīnāṃ cakrakaprasahgaḥ | evaṃ tarhi chāndasaḥ kvasuḥ, liṭ
cchandasi sārvadhātukamapi bhavati 'sārvadhātukamapid' iti ṅtviṃ
ṅtītyupidhālopaḥ | na ca saṃyogānteṣu kitvaṅtviyoḥ
kaścidviśeṣaḥ, tasmādvasvarthamapi ktvāgrahaṇaṃ na bhavati | evaṃ
tarhi-nigṛhītiḥ prayojanam | ktinktijnivṛtyarthaṃ
ktvāgrahaṇamityarthaḥ |
yadi punarupariṣṭādyogavibhāgaḥ kriyate-na seṇniṣṭā
śīṅsvidimidi kṣvididhṛṣaḥ, mṛṣastitikṣāyām,
udupadhādbhāvādikarmaṇoranyatarasyām; tataḥ pūṅśca-pūṅśca parā
niṣṭhā seṇ na kidbhavati; tataḥ ktvā ca, ktvā ca seṭ kinna bhavati
| atra 'pūṅḥ' iti nivṛtamiti, tataḥ ktvāgrahaṇaṃ śakyamakartum ||
niṣṭhā śīṅsvidimidikṣvididhṛṣaḥ || 1|2|19 ||
' ñiṣvidā snehanamocanayoḥ' ityasya bhauvādikasya
ñiddhātorgrahaṇam, na tu 'ṣvidā gātraprakṣaraṇe' iti daivādikasya;
ñidbhiḥ sāhacaryāt, asya cāñitvāt | 'ñikṣvidā
snehanamocanayoḥ' iti daivādikasya grahaṇam, na tu 'ñikṣvidā
avyakte śabde' ityasya bhauvādikasya; midinā sāhacaryāt,'ñidhṛṣā
prāgalbhye' | śayitavāniti | 'atvasantasya' iti dīrghaḥ |
prakṛtigrahaṇe yaṅlugantasyāpi grahaṇaṃ bhavati, sa eva dhāturdvirucyata
iti kṛtvā tatrāpavādaḥ smaryate |
śtipā śapā'nubandhena nirddiṣṭṃa yadgaṇena ca |
yatraikājgrahaṇaṃ kiñcitpañcaitāni na yaṅluki || iti |
tadahi śīṅe'nabandhanirdeśo yaṅluṅnivṛtyarthaḥ, śeśyitaḥ,
śeśyitavān-- 'eranekācaḥ' iti yaṇ ||
mṛṣastitikṣāyām || 1|2|20 ||
idameva titikṣāgrahaṇaṃ jñāpakam-anekārthā dhātava iti; anyathā
mṛṣistitikṣāyāmeva paṭha|leta iti tadapārthakaṃ syāt |
apamṛṣitamiti | avispaṣṭamityarthaḥ ||
udupadhādbhāvādikarmaṇoranyatarasyām || 1|2|21 ||
dyautitamiti | 'dyauta dīptau' napuṃsake bhāve ktaḥ | pradyautita iti |
'ādikarmaṇi ktaḥ kartari ca' iti kartari ktaḥ | muditamiti | 'mudī
harṣe ' | likhitamiti | śabvikaraṇānāmeveti na tāvat
sthitamityaśabvikaraṇo'pi likhiḥ pratyudāhṛtaḥ | evaṃ prabhukta itiṃ |
sthite tasmin khiṭikiṭī bhauvādī, kruśiśca; khiṭitaṃ kruṣṭamiti
prakyudāhartavyam ||
pūṅḥ ktvā ca || 1|2|22 ||
ihānyatarasyāṃgrahaṇānuvṛtau seḍityasya ca nivṛtau iḍvidhau
'pūṅśca' iti śakyamakartum, utarasūtre ca vāgrahaṇam; katham ?
aniṭoreva ktvāniṣṭhayoranena kitvaṃ vikalpyate,tatra yadā kitvaṃ
tadā 'śyakaḥ kiti' iti pratiṣedhāt pūtaḥ pūtavān pūtveti,
akitvapakṣe tviṭi pavitaḥ pavitavān pavitveti bhavati, seḍgrahaṇaṃ
tu vicchidyeta; tasmātseḍityasminnutārthamanuvartamāne 'pūṅśca'
ityārabhya utaratra vāgrahaṇamiha nityatāsiddhyartham, puvitveti pakṣe
mā bhūtadāha-anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇaṃ na svaryate; utarasūtre
punarvāvacanāditi | na seḍiti vartata iti | nanu pūṅḥ parayoḥ
ktvāniṣṭhayoriṭo na bhavitavyam, 'śyukaḥ kiti' iti pratiṣedhādata
āha-pūṅśceti | pūṅ paro niṣṭhāpratyaya ityādi |
kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ sākṣāt śrutaṃ ktvāpratyayamapahārayānuvṛtasya
niṣṭhāpratyayasyānvayo darśiyata udāharaṇaṃ ca ? ata
āha-ktvāpratyayasyeti | etadeva draḍhayati-tathā coktamiti | iḍādyoḥ
ktvāniṣṭhayornityamakitvamiṣyate, tataśca ktvāgraṇamutarārthamiti
bhāradvājīyairevamuktam | utarārthamapi yadihaiva kartavyaṃ
seḍityenena sambandhārtham; anyathā niṣṭhānivṛtau tatsambaddhaṃ
seḍityetadapi nivarteta ! anubandhoccāraṇaṃ vispaṣṭārthaṃ na pūño
nivṛtyartham; iḍvidhau pūṅ eva grahaṇāt | pūñaḥ ktvāniṣṭhayoḥ
iḍabhāvānnāpi yaṅluki nivṛtyartham; iḍvidhāvanubandhanirdeśena
yaṅlukyapi 'na ktvā seṭ' iti pratiṣedhasya sthitatvāt | na ca
ktvāgrahaṇasārthyātasyāpi pratiṣedhaḥ;
tasyotaratrāpyupayogasambhavāt, anubandhanirdeśasya ca niṣṭhāyāṃ
caritārthatvāt | evaṃ ca 'ktvāgrahaṇamutarārtham' iti
vṛttigranthasyāvirodhaḥ, tena popuvitavāniti niṣṭhāyāṃ bhavati |
ktvāyāṃ tu guṇo popavitveti bhavati ||
nopadhātthaphāntādvā || 1|2|23 ||
niṣṭheti nivṛtamiti | pūrvasūtre cānukṛṣṭatvāt | guphitveti |
'gupha gumpha granthane' |
rephitveti | 'ripha katthanayuddhanindāhiṃsādāneṣu' |
athaitadvikalpābhāve'pi 'ralo vyupadhād' iti vikalpo'tra kasmānna
bhavati ? nopadhagrahaṇasāmarthyāt | nanu ṛkāropadho nopadhagrahaṇasya
vyāvartyaḥ sambhavati 'ṛpha hiṃsāyām'- arphitveti, naitadasti;
traiśabdyaṃ hyanayordhātvorbhavati | sati tāvat, anopadhasya 'na ktvā
seṭ' iti niṣedhe sati arphitveti bhavati, nopadhasya
tvasminvikalpe-ṛphitveti | asatyapi nopadhagrahaṇe
sarvatrāsminvikalpe pravṛte'pīdameva rūpatrayaṃ bhavati | antagrahaṇaṃ
jñāpanārtham-yatnamantareṇāsminprakaraṇe na tadantavidhirbhavatīti,
tenotarasūtre 'ṛtaḥ' iti dhāturgṛhyate, na ṛdantaḥ ||
vañciluñcyṛtaśca || 1|2|24 || 
'vañcu gatau' bhauvādiḥ, 'vañcu pralambhane' curādiḥ,so'pi gṛhyate,
'anityaṇyantāścurādayaḥ' iti | 'luñca apanayane', ṛtiḥ sautro
dhātuḥ 'ṛterīyaṅ'iti, sa ca ghṛṇāyāṃ vartate ||
tṛṣimṛṣikṛśeḥ kāśyapasya || 1|2|25 ||
'ñitṛṣā pipāsāyām','mṛṣa titikṣāyām', 'kṛśatanūkaraṇe' |
kāśyapagrahaṇaṃ pūjārthamiti | 'kāśyapasyaitadviṣayaṃ vijñānaṃ
nānyeṣām' ityasādhāraṇajñānodbhāvanamācāryasya pūjādvāreṇa
śāstrasyāpi pāramparyapratipādanena prāmāṇyapritapādanāt pūjā
bhavati ||
ralo vyupadhāddhalādeḥ saṃśca || 1|2|26 ||
ktvāpratyayasya 'na ktvā seṭ' iti kitve pratiṣiddhe sano'pyakitve
svataḥ siddha ubhayatra vidhimukhenedaṃ pravartata ityāha-vā kitau bhavata
iti | didyotiṣate iti | 'dyautisvāpyoḥ saṃprasāraṇam' |
eṣiṣiṣatīti | iṭi kṛte--'ajāderdvitīyasya' ||
ūkālojjhrasvadīrghaplutaḥ || 1|2|27 ||
ūḥ kālo yasya sa ūkālaḥ 'taparastatkālasya' itivannirdeśaḥ
samarthanīyaḥ | etacca saṃjñino viśeṣaṇam, ca 'ū' ityekasyaiva
śabdasyoccāraṇādviśeṣaṇasyaikatvāt saṃjñāpyekaiveti yaścodayet
taṃ pratyāha--ū iti trayāṇāmityādi | praśleṣaṇam u praśliṣṭam, tena
nirdeśaḥ u praśliṣṭanirdeśaḥ | tena viśeṣaṇatrayaparicchinnāstrayaḥ
saṃjñina ityarthaḥ | praśleṣaṇe pramāṇamāha-hrasveti | hrasvadīrghapluta iti
na tāvadekā saṃjñā; gauravādanāvṛteśca | atastisṛṇāṃ saṃjñānāṃ
dvandvo'yam | na caikasyānekasaṃjñākaraṇe prayojanamasti |
lugādisaṃjñāsvapi tadbhāvitatvena pratyayādarśanasya bheda āśitaḥ,

pāṭho'ntaḥ karaṇamantra iti | nanu vāgindriyeṇa śabda uccāryate sa
kathamantaḥ karaṇena sarvendriyasādhāraṇena vyapadiśyate, satyam;
vāgindriyasya sthūlo vyāpāra upāṃśuprayoge nāsti, sa eva ca
tadvyāpāratvena prasiddha iti sūkṣmavyāpāre mana eva pradhānaṃ manyate |
nyūṅkhā ityādi | ṣoḍaśeti pāṭhaḥ, okārā iti ca, na tvete
makārāntāḥ, teṣu prathamasaptamatrayodaśāstraya udātāstrimātrāḥ, itare
trayodaśā anudātā ardhaukārāḥ | etacca āśvalāyanena
caturthe'hanītyasmin khaṇḍe lakṣaṇenoktamudāhṛtaṃ ca |
'ṣaḍoṅkārāḥ' iti pāṭhe mūlāntaraṃ mṛgyam | e3 viśvamityādi |
eśabdo gītipūraṇaḥ, nipāta ityanye | viśvaśabdaḥ kvanpratyayānta
ādyaudātaḥ, viśvamantriṇaṃ pāpmānaṃ saṃdaheti sambandhaḥ,
gītivaśādeśabdo'nekamātraḥ | vākyaviśeṣasthā gītaya iti |
taduktamṛṣiṇā-'gītiṣu sāmākhyā' iti ||
uccaistarāṃ vā vaṣaṭkāraḥ || 1|2|35 ||
vaṣaṭśabdena cātra vauṣaṭśabdo lakṣyate iti | samānārthatvād
dvāvapi hi tau devatāsaṃpradānasya dyotakau | kāragrahaṇaṃ tu
jñāpakam-avarṇādapi kārapratyayo bhavatīti | tena evakāra ityādi
siddhaṃ bhavati |
yadyevamiti | lakṣaṇāyāṃ hi pratipatigauravaṃ bhavatīti bhāvaḥ |
vicitrā hīti | kvacidakṣaralāghavamāśrīyate,
kvacitpratipatilāghavamiti vaicitryam | uccaistarāmiti | uccaiḥśabda
udātabhavane vartate, tatra bhavanakriyayāpekṣayā pratyayaḥ | udātatara
ityartho vivakṣitaḥ, prakarṣaśca vauṣaṭśabde
'brūhipreṣayaśrauṣaḍvahānāmādeḥ' iti yaḥ pluto vihitaḥ
tadapekṣayā veditavyaḥ | santyudātāḥ, ayaṃ tūdātataraḥ |
antyasadeśasyetyeke | plutodātasya ca
vidhānasāmarthyāccheṣanighātābhāvo'siddhatvādvā
dvayorapyacorudātataro bhavatītyeke | tadā yājyāntāpekṣaḥ prakarṣaḥ
svārthi kastarabityanye | tato hyudātamātramprathamasya siddhamiti
dvitīyasyāco vidhīyate | vaṣaṭkāraśabdo'yaṃ mantrabrāhmamayoḥ
kalpasūtreṣu vauṣaṭśabde nirūḍhaḥ | vaṣaṭ kriyate'neneti
vaṣaṭkāraḥ | 'mā mānpramṛja' iti mantre, 'trayo vai vaṣaṭkārāḥ
vauṣaḍiti vaṣaṭkaroti' iti brāhmaṇe ca vaṣaṭkāro'ntyaḥ |
'sarvatroccaistarāṃ balīyānyājyāyā' iti sūtre uccaistarāmiti
śrutiprakarṣo vidhīyata ityāhuḥ ||
vibhāṣā cchandasi || 1|2|36 ||
yajñakarmaṇītyasya nivṛtyarthamiti | nanu yadyayaṃ yogo yajñakarmaṇi
syāt, pūrvo yogo nirviṣayaḥ syāt | na ca japanyūṅkhasāmānyasya
viṣayaḥ, japādivyatiriktastu pūrvasya viṣaya iti vyavasthā; tathā hi
satyatraiva japādigrahaṇaṃ kartavyaṃ syāt, kiṃ cchandograhaṇena ?
cchandograhaṇātu cchandomātro'yaṃ vikalpa iti gamyate, tataśca
yajñakarmaṇītyasyānuvṛtau pūrvo nityo vidhirnirviṣayaḥ syāt ? evaṃ
manyate--ūhamantrāṇāmacchandastvāte pūrvayogasya viṣayā iti
cchandorūpeṣu mantreṣvayameva vikalpaḥ syāditi | yadyauuhamantreṣu
sāvakāśaḥ pūrvo yogaḥ, tadā yajñakarmaṇītyasya vibhāṣāgrahaṇena
virvṛtāvapi cchandorūpeṣvanūhiteṣu mantreṣu paratvādayameva
vikalpaḥ prāpnoti, naiṣa doṣaḥ; yajñakarmaṇītyatra karmagrahaṇaṃ
yajñānuṣṭhānamātre sarvatra nityo vidhiryathā syādityevamartham |
yadyapyūhyamānā mantrā na bhavanti, tathāpyamantrāṇāmeva teṣāṃ yajñakarmaṇi
prayujyamānānāṃ pūrvayogasya viṣayatvaṃ bhavatyeva | ye tu
japādiparyudāsena mantrāṇāmeva tatra grahaṇamicchanti, teṣāṃ
sāmarthyalabhyā yajñakarmaṇītyasya nivṛttiriti vibhāṣāgrahaṇamanarthakaṃ
syāt | iṣa ityādi | iḍannam, ūrg balam | caturthekavacanasya
'sāvekācaḥ' ityudātatvam | 'tvāmau dvitīyāyāḥ' iti
tvādeśo'nudātaḥ | agne tyāmintritādyaudātatvam | āṇupasargaḥ |
yāhīti | 'tiṅṅatiṅaḥ' 'vī gatyādiṣu', 'mantre vṛṣeṣapaca'
ityādinā ktinnudātaḥ, agniśabdo'ntodātaḥ | ami pūrvatvam
'ekādeśa udātenodātaḥ' | īle iti | 'īḍastutau'
laḍutamaikavacanam | bahvṛcā dvayoracormadhye sthitasya ḍakārasya
lakāraṃ vidadhati | purohitam | 'puro'vyayam ' iti gatisaṃjñā,
'gatiranantaraḥ' iti pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaraḥ, puraḥ
śabdo'sipratyayānto'ntodātaḥ | śanśabdo nipātaḥ,
nasādeśo'nudātaḥ devaḍiti pacādiṣu paṭha|lte, ṭitvān
ṅīp,'anudātasya ca yatrodātalopaḥ' abhipūrvādiṣeḥ ktini
śakandhvāditvāt pararūpe'bhiṣṭetyādau ca 'niti kṛtyatau' iti
pūrvapadaprakṛtisvareṇābhiśabdasyāntodātatvaṃ caturthyekavacanam |
na subrahmaṇyāyāṃ svaritasya tūdātaḥ || 1|2|37 ||
subrahmaṇyā nāma nigada iti | apādabandhe gadirvartate, yathā gadyamiti,
niśabdaḥ prakarṣe | uccairapādabandhaṃ yajurātmakaṃ yanmantravākyaṃ paṭha|lte
sa nigadaḥ, nitarāṃ gadyata iti karmaṇi 'nau gadanada' ityap, tasya ca
subrahṇaṇyāśabdopalakṣitatvāt subrahmaṇyāśabdoparityaktistrīliṅga
eva nāma | oṅkārastitsvareṇa svarita iti subrahmaṇi sādhuriti
yatpratyayaḥ, titsvareṇa svaritaḥ | tasya ṭābekādeśaḥ
svaritānudātayorāntaryāt svaritaḥ, tato nipāternauśabdena
'omāṅeśca' ityudātasvaritayorekādeśaḥ svarita eva |
'āmantritamādyaudātam' iti āṣṭamikastu nighāto'samānavākyatvānna
bhavati | tasyāneneti | na ca tasyāsiddhatvam, idaṃ hi
prakaraṇamasiddhakāṇḍa utkraṣṭaḍavyamityuktam | ata evāsminnudāte
kṛte śeṣanighāto'pi na bhavati; yathoddeśapakṣe'nudātaparibhāṣāyāṃ
kartavyāyām asiddhatvena varjyamānābhāvāt | teneha dvāvapyudātau
sampannau thaiti | paścima eko'nudāta iti | na ca tasya
'udatādanudātasya' iti svaritaprasaṅgaḥ;
prakaraṇotakarṣeṇasyāsiddhatvād, 'nodātasvaritodayam' iti
niṣedhācca | dvāvanudātāviti | vakāracchakārau, śiṣṭṃa spaṣṭam |
'asāvamuṣyetyantaḥ' etasminneva subrahmaṇyānigade prathamāntasya
ṣaṣṭha|lntasya cānta udāto bhavati | gārgyo yajate, dākṣeḥ pitā
yajate--titsvare prāpte vacanam | 'syāntasyopotamaṃ ca'
syaśabdāntasyopotamamutamaṃ cobhayamudātaṃ bhavati | gārgyasya pitā
yajate 'vā nāmedhayasya' | devadatasya pitā yajate ||
devabrahmaṇoranudātaḥ || 1|2|38 ||
svaritasyodāte prāpte iti | kathaṃ prāptaḥ, yāvatā'siddhaḥ svaritaḥ ?
evaṃ tarhyetajjñāpayatyācāryaḥ-'tasyāditaḥ' ityārabhya nabasūtrī
'udātādanudātasya svaritaḥ' tyismātparā draṣṭavyeti | uktāni
prayojanāni, utaratra ca vakṣyāmaḥ | sāmānyāpekṣatvājjñāpakasya
navasūtryapyutkṛṣyate, na subrahmaṇyāsvara eva | dvayorapi padayoriti |
dvitīyasya padatparasyāpi nighāto na bhavati; ' āmantritaṃ
pūrvamavidyamānavad' iti pūrvasyāvidyamāntvāt | prathamasyāpi na
bhavati; bhinnavākyatvāt ||
svaritātsaṃhitāyāmanudātānām || 1|2|39 ||
anudātānāmiti bahuvacanaṃ jātau, tenaikasya dvayorbahūnāṃ ca
bhavati--ekasya pacati, dvayorāgniveśyaḥ; bahūnāṃ tu vṛtāveva
darśitam | itamityantodātamiti | idaṃ-śabdaḥ
prātipadikasvareṇāntodātaḥ, vibhaktiranudātā, tyādādyatve 'ami
pūrvaḥ' 'ekādeśa udātenodātaḥ' | vidhikāla eveti | yadyapyatra
vihitasyānudātavidhāne'pi na kaściddoṣaḥ, tathāpi tatvena
vyavahartavyamityevamuktam | tasmāt svaritāditi | na ca
tasyāsiddhatvam; utkṛṣṭatvād navasūtryāstena kāryaṃ
devadatetyādāvivekaśrutirbhavatyeva | gaṅgeprabhṛtīnāmiti | na ca
yamuneprabhṛtīnāṃ vyavadhānam; jāterekatvād, vyaktīnāṃ
satīnāmapyanāśritatvād akiñcitkaratvam | tataḥ pareṣāmiti |
'nāmantrite samānādhikaraṇe' iti māṇavakaśabdasyāvidyamānatvaṃ na
bhavati |
ñavagrahe mā bhūditi | idameva ca saṃhitāgrahaṇaṃ
jñāpakam--pañcamīnirdeśe kālo na vyavadhyāyaka iti | tena
'tiṅṅatiṅaḥ' ityavagrahe'pi bhavati-agnimīle |
udātasvaritaparasya sannataraḥ || 1|2|40 ||
paraśabdaḥ pratyekamabhisambadhyata ityāha--udātaḥ paro yasmāditi |
sannaśabdena nīcairartha ucyate, tenānudātatvaṃ lakṣyata
ityāha--anudātatara iti | prakarṣaḥ sthānyanudātāpekṣaḥ | mātara
ityanudāta iti | samāsaikadeśo niṣkṛṣṭānukṛtaḥ, devā ityādīnāṃ
trayāṇāmāmantritānāmekībhūtānāmādyaudātatve śeṣanighātaḥ |
'vibhāṣitaṃ viśeṣacane bahuvacanam' iti vidyamānapakṣe
cāmantritanighātaḥ, jasaḥ sakārasya rutvam, tasya sraṃsanayuktasya 'ato
roraplutāt, iti ukāro'nudātaḥ, 'ādguṇaḥ'
so'pyāntaryato'nudātaḥ, acchabdākārasya śeṣanighātaḥ,
tayoranudātayoḥ 'eṅaḥ padāntādati' ityekādeśa
āntaryato'nudātaḥ | sarasvatīkārasyeti | nanu ca navasūtryutkṛṣyata
iti jñāpitam, tataśca gaṅgeprabhṛtīnāmiva sarasvatīkārasyāpi
pūrveṇaikaśrutireva prāpnoti, kaḥ punaḥ sannatarasyāvakāśaḥ, yaḥ
svaritātparo na bhavati ? agniriti | na ca vipratiṣedhena sannataro
labhyate; pūrvatrāsiddhe nāsti vipratiṣedho'bhāvādutarasya | evaṃ tarhi
'na mu ne' ityatra neti yogavibhāgāt siddhatvaṃ bhaviṣyati | iha
devadatasya nyaṅ iti 'nyadhī ca' iti pūrvapadaprakṛtisvare
'udātasvaritayoryaṇaḥ' ityañcatyakārasya svaritaḥ pūrvasya sannataraṃ
pratyasiddho na bhavati; prakaraṇotkarṣād | 'udātasvaritayoḥ' ityeva
siddhe paragrahaṇaṃ bahuvrīhāvekavacanavivakṣārthamiti gaṅgeprabhṛtīnāṃ
sannatarābhāvaḥ ||
apṛkta ekāl pratyayaḥ || 1|2|41 ||
ghṛtaspṛgiti | 'kvinpratyayasya kuḥ' iti kutvam | arthabhāgiti | atra
'verepṛktasya' iti lopaḥ prayojanam | ekālgrahaṇaṃ kimiti |
samudāyadvāreṇāyamekapadaviṣayaḥ praśnaḥ, anyathā pratyayamātrasya saṃjñā
syāditi pradeśeṣu pratyayagrahaṇameva kartavyaṃ syāt, kiṃ sañjñayā !
yatra yadyalantasya syāt, kevalasya cāpyantavadbhāvāt algrahaṇaṃ vyarthaṃ
syāditi tatsāmarthyādalsamudāyasya na bhaviṣyatīti bhāvaḥ |
darviriti | 'dṛ vidāraṇe' auṇādiko vin pratyayaḥ | varṇagrahaṇe
jātigrahaṇādalsamudāyā gṛhyante iti bhāvaḥ | syādetat-'verapṛktasya'
ityatra 'vo'pṛktasya' ityastu, kvibādiṣu ca mā bhūdikāraḥ, na cānyaḥ
pratyayo vakāro'stīti, tannaḥ 'rājani yudhikṛñaḥ' rājakṛtvā,
tamācaṣṭa iti ṇici ṭilope kvipi ṇilope ca kṛte kvanipaḥ
sambandhī pratyayo vakāro'sti | avaśyaṃ ca kvibādīnāmuccāraṇārthe
kaścidajāsaṃjanīyaḥ, tatrākāre 'sṛśṛbhyāṃ vaḥ' ityādiṣvapi lopaḥ
prasajyeta | ukāre tu ṇvulādiṣu | anyatra tu gauravamiti
yathānyāsameva sādhīyaḥ | nanu ca yadyalsamudāyo'pi gṛhyate,
algrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syād | ato yadyapi 'nipāta ekājanāṅ'
ityatraikagrahaṇādvarṇagrahaṇe jātigrahaṇaṃ jñāpitam,
tathāpyatrālgrahaṇasāmarthyātsamudāyasya na bhaviṣyatīti
cintyaprayojanamekagrahaṇam | tathā'pṛktapradeśareṣvalgrahaṇenaiva
siddhe nārthaḥ saṃjñayā; natarāmmahatyā, natamāmpūrvanirddiṣṭayā |
surā iti | surāṃ sunotīti kvipi tuk surāsutamācaṣṭe iti
ṇici ṭilopaḥ kvib ṇilopaḥ, atra dhātusakārasya 'halṅyābbhya'
iti lopo na bhavati, pratyayaparibhāṣayā siddham | tipā
sāhacaryāccaikavacanasya grahaṇaṃ siddhamiti pratyayagrahaṇamapi
cintyaprayojanameva ||
tatpuruṣaḥ samānādhikaraṇaḥ karmadhārayaḥ || 1|2|42 ||
atra 'tatpuruṣaḥ' 'samānādhikaraṇaḥ' iti dvayorapi padayormukhyārthatve
brāhmaṇarājyaṃ śobhanamityādau yatra bāhyaena padena tatpuruṣasya
sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ tatraiva saṃjñā syād, na tu paramarājyamityādau;
śabdāntarasyāprayogādityanyataradgoṇārthamiti sthite
kāmacārādyadi tatpuruṣaśabdo gauṇaḥ syāt tatpuruṣārthāni padāni
samānādhikaraṇānīti, tataḥ sahagrahaṇābhāvāt pratyakaṃ saṃjñā iti
śaṅkyeta, atastatpuruṣa iti padaṃ mukhyārthamityāha-tatpuṣa iti |
samāsaviśeṣasyetyādi | itaradgauṇārthamityāha-samānādhikaraṇapada
iti | samānādhikaraṇāni padānyāśrayatvena yasya santi sa tathoktaḥ;
avayavadvārakaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyamaupacārikamapi
padāntanirapekṣamantaraṅgamiti tadevāśrīyata iti bhāvaḥ | bhavati
hyavayavadharmeṇa samudāyasya vyapadeśaḥ, yathā-samaṃ cūrṇamiti | atra
hyavayavadvārakaṃ cūrṇasya sāmyam, na tu kṛtsnasya cūrṇasyānyena |
paramarājyamiti, akarmadhārayerājyam ityatrākarmadhāraya iti
niṣedhādutarapadādyaudātatvābhāve samāsāntodātameva bhavati |
pācakavṛndāriketi | 'na kopadhāyāḥ' iti pratiṣedhaṃ bādhitvā
'puṃvatkarmadhāraya' iti puṃvadbhāvo bhavati |
tatpuruṣa iti kimiti | pratipadoktatvādadhikārāvagatervā
samānādhikaraṇādhikāravihitastapuruṣa eva pratipatsyata iti praśnaḥ |
pācikābhārya iti | ayamevārtho duravadhāra iti bhāvaḥ |
brāhmaṇarājyamiti | atrotarapadādyaudātatvameva bhavati | atha
'pūrvakālaika' ityasya prakaraṇasyānte 'karmadhāraya' iti kasmānnoktam,
yo'yaṃ samānādhikaraṇādhikāravihitastatpuruṣaḥ sa karmadhāraya iti,
evaṃ hi 'tatpuruṣaḥ samānādhikaraṇa' iti na vaktavyaṃ bhavati ? satyam;
ekasaṃjñādhikārātu karmadhārasaṃjñayā tatpuruṣasaṃjñāyā bādhaḥ syāditi
dvigoriva punastatpuruṣasaṃjñāvidhānāya karmadhārayapadamupādeyam |
punaśca paryāyaprasaṅge samāveśāya cakāro'pi vaktavyaḥ nanvevaṃ
kariṣyate-dvigukarmadhārayau ceti ? evaṃ tu na kṛtamityeva ||
prathamānirdiṣṭṃa samāsa upasarjanam || 1|2|43 ||
samāsa ityadhikaraṇanirdeśo'yam | kaṣṭaśritādayaśca samāsāḥ, teṣu
kiṃ prathamānirddeṣṭṃa bhavitumarhati ? samāse sati yasmātprathamā
vidhīyate, na ca tathābhūtaṃ sambhavati | samāse hi kṛte tata eva
prathamotpadyate, na tadavayavād | antarvartinyā ca vibhaktyā śritaśabda
eva prathamānirdiṣṭo na kaṣṭaśabdaḥ | sāpi na samāse satyutpannā, kiṃ
tarhi ? vākyakāla eva | nirdiṣṭagrahaṇaṃ cānarthakaṃ syāt, samāse
prathamāntamityeva vācyaṃ syad, ato mukhyasyāsambhavādgauṇaḥ
samāso gṛhyate ityāha-prathamayetyādi | kathaṃ punaḥ samāsa iti
śāstrasya grahaṇamityāha-samāsavidhāyīti |
samāsavidhāyitvātādarthyātācchabdyamityarthaḥ | nirdiṣṭagrahaṇādeva ca
tulye'pi samāsārthatve vākyaṃ na gṛhyate, na hi tatra nirdeśārthā
prathamā, arthaprayuktatvāt | dvitīyetyetatprathamānirdiṣṭamiti |
prathamayā vibhaktyā uccāritam | yadyevam, tasyaiva saṃjñā syānna
kaṣṭādīnām, na hi te śāstre prathamānirdiṣṭāḥ | ya eva dvitīyetyasya
prathamānirdeśaḥ, sa eva kaṣṭādīnāmapi; tatparatvātasya | yathā
vakṣyati-'tasyeti sāmānyaṃ viśeṣopalakṣaṇārthaṃ tadīyaprāthamyaṃ
viśeṣāṇāṃ vijñāyate' iti | kaṣṭaśritādiṣūpasarjanatvāt
pūrvanipātaḥ | mahāsaṃjñākaraṇamanvarthasaṃjñāvijñānārtham |
loke'pradhānamupasrajanamucyate, ihāpyapradhānamupasarjanam |
pradhānamapradhānamiti ca sambandhiśabdāvetau, tena yatprati yadapradhānaṃ
tadeva prati tadupasarjanaṃ bhavati, tena rājñaḥ kumārīśrita iti
'dvitīyā śrita' ityatra prathamānirdiṣṭasyāpi kumārīśabdasya saṃjñā na
bhavati | yadi syāt, pūrvanipātāniyama upasarjanahrasvatvaṃ ca syāt |
anvarthatve tu śritādīnevāpekṣya dvitīyāntamupasarjanamiti na
prasaṅgaḥ | evaṃ rājñaḥ kumāryā ityatra dvayorapi 'ṣaṣṭhī' ityatra
prathamānirdeśe'pi kumārīmapekṣya rājña upasarjanatvam, na taṃ prati
tasyāḥ | yadyanvarthasaṃjñā, nārtho'nena, pradeśeṣvevānvarthagrahaṇamastu |
vākye'pi tarhi syāt-kumāraāā śritā gavāṃ kulam | atha
saṃjñāvidhirvākye kasmānna bhavati, yāvatā 'samāse' iti
prathamānirdeśasyādhāro na saṃjñāyāḥ ? tathā gokulaṃ kumārīputra
ityatra samāse'pi pūrvanipātavad hrasvatvaṃ kasmānna bhavati ?
tasmātsatyevopasarjanatve upasarjanagośabdantasyopasarjanatvāt
strīpratyayāntāntasya prātipadikasya hrasvavidhānātsamāsādhikāre
pūrvanapātivacanācca vākye tau na bhavata iti vācyam |
saṃjñāvidhānaṃ tūnmatagaṅgamityādau dvayorapyaprādhānye
pūrvanipātaniyamārtham | yatra cānanyārthaḥ prathamānirdeśastatra
prathānasyāpi yathā syādityevamarthaṃ ca | yathā-pācakavṛndārakaḥ,
puruṣavyāghraḥ, arddhapiplī, pūrvakāya iti atra 'vṛndārakanāgakuñjaraiḥ
pūjyamānam', 'upamitaṃ vyāghrādibhiḥ','arddhaṃ
napuṃsakam','pūrvāparādharotaram' iti prathamānirdeśasyedameva
prayojanam; samāsasya viśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣyeṇa ṣaṣṭhītyeva siddhatvād |
na ca pūjyamānatādiviṣaya eva yathā syāditi niyamārthastadārambhaḥ ?
upasarjanasaṃjñārthatve'rddhādipūrvapadasya
viśiṣṭarūpasyārddhapippalītyādeḥ samāsasya vidhisambhavāt
tasmādetadarthāpi saṃjñā | anvarthatvaṃ tu sati saṃbhave vyavasthāpakam
||
ekavibhakti cāpūrvanipāte || 1|2|44 ||
vibhaktiśabdaḥ supāṃ vācakaḥ, kārakaśaktivacano vā; vibhajyate'nayā
prātipadikārtha iti kṛtvā | samāse vidhīyamāne iti |
yadupamardanena samāso bhavati tasmanvākya ityarthaḥ,
samāsarūpaprāptyabhimukhe padatraya iti yāvat | etana samāsārthaṃ
vākyamatra samāsaḥ, na pūrvasūtra iva śāstramiti darśayati | śāstre
sarvamevibhaktimityekavibhaktītyanarthakaṃ syāt, mukhye'pi samāse
pratyayalakṣaṇenaikavibhaktitvaṃ samarthanīyamiti vākyamevātra samāsaḥ |
ekasmiṃśca prayoge sarvamekavibhaktikamiti
viśeṣaṇaopādānasāmarthyataprayogabhedenāpi yasya na sarvavibhaktitvaṃ
tadāśrīyata ityāha-yanniyatavibhaktikamiti | etadeva spaṣyayati-dvitīye
sambandhinītyādi |
kecidāhuḥ-'yena saha samāsyate dvitīyasambandhī' iti, evaṃ tu
pañcānāṃ khaṭvānāṃ samāhāraḥ pañcakhaṭvīti vā ṭābanta iti
strīliṅgapakṣe upasarjanahrasvatvaṃ na syāt | samāhāro hyatra
nānāvibhaktiyukto na pañcañśabdaḥ, tasmātapradhānārthavācī śabdo
dvitīyaḥ sambandhaḥ | niṣkauśāmbiriti kauśāmbīśabdo
niṣkramaṇakriyāpekṣayā'pādānaśaktiyogāt piñcamyante eva, na tasya
kriyāntaramapekṣya śaktyantarāveśaḥ sambhavati | niḥśabdastu
niṣkrāntapradhāno nānāśaktibhiryujyate |
niṣkauśāmbiriti | kuśāmbena nirvṛtā nagarī kauśāmbī,
'gostriyorupasarjanasya' iti hrasvaḥ | nirvārāṇasiriti | ano jalaṃ
tadvaraṃ yasyāḥ sā varāṇā gaṅgā, tasyā adūrabhavā nagarī vārāṇasī |
purāṇe tu varaṇā cāsiśca nadyau, śakandhvādiḥ, tayoradūrabhavā
pṛṣodarāditvādrephākārasya dīrghaḥ | nisaḥ pūrveṇopasarjanatvam,
pradhānasyāpi hi prathamānirdeśasāmarthyāt bhavatītyuktam |
ihāsyāvakāraśo'prathamānirddiṣṭaḥ, pūrvasyāvakāśo'nekavibhaktiḥ
nīlotpalādiḥ, arddhipippalyādiśca; kaṣṭaśritādiṣu kaṣṭādaya
ekavibhaktikāḥ prathamānirdiṣṭāścetyubhayaprasaṅge paratvādanenaiva
prāpnoti, tataśca'apūrvanipāte' iti pratiṣedhaprasaṅgaḥ, na;
apratiṣedhāt | nāyaṃ prasajyapratiṣedhaḥ-pūrvanipāte neti, kiṃ tarhi ?
paryudāso'yam, pūrvanipāte na vidhirna pratiṣedhaḥ |
prasajyapratiṣedhe'pyanantaraprāptiḥ pratiṣidhyate, kuta etad ?
anantarasya vidhirvā bhavati pratiṣedho vā bhavati, pūrvā
prāptirapratiṣiddhā tayā bhaviṣyati | na ceyaṃ prāptiḥ pūrvāṃ prāptiṃ
bādhate, pratiṣiddhatvāt ||
arthavadadhāturapratyayaḥ prātipādakam || 1|2|45 ||
abhidheyavacano'rthaśabda iti | na prayojanavacano'vyabhicārāt; na
nivṛttivacanaḥ, svayaṃ nivṛtasya kiṃ saṃjñayā ! na dhanavacanaḥ,
svasvāmibhāvasyāsambhavāt | taccābhidheyaṃ
caturddhā-cātiguṇakriyādravyabhedena; gauḥ, śulkaḥ, pācakaḥ, ḍittha iti
| yadyarthavataḥ saṃjñā, abhāvaśaśaviṣāṇādīnāṃ na prāpnoti; arthābhāvāt
| mā bhūdanena, samāsa iti bhaviṣyati ? na; arthaṃvadityanuvṛteḥ |
anyarthā'narthake'tra vidhisambhāvat samāsagrahaṇaṃ niyamārthaṃ na syāt,
ucyate; yeṣāṃ tāvadbhūtalādyāśrayaṃ ghaṭādipratiyogikaṃ nāstīti
buddhibodhyaṃ tatvāntaramabhāvastanmate tenārthenārthavatvam;
yeṣāmapyāśrayābhimataṃ bhūtalādisvarūpameva tadbuddhiviśeṣo vā
pratiyogino ghaṭāderabhāvastanmate tenaiva
bhūtalādinārtha'vatvamityabhāvasya tāvatsiddhā saṃjñā |
śaśaviṣāṇamityatrāpi gavādiṣvanubhūtaviṣāṇaṃ śaśamastakavartitayā
buddhyotprekṣya tasyaivābhidhānāya śabdaprayogaḥ | buddhyupāroha
eva cārthasya śabdaprayoge kāraṇam, na bahiḥ satā | yadi bahiḥ
santamevārthaṃ śabdā abhidadhati; ghaṭo nāstīti prayogo na syād;
ekatra paunaruktyād, aparatra virodhād | buddhyuarūḍhasya bahiḥ
satvāsatvāpratipādanāyopapadyatae prayogaḥ | evamapākṣīt, pakṣyati,
asya sūtrasya śāṭakaṃ vayetyādāvapi buddhyupārūḍha eva
pacyādīnāmarthaḥ; na tu śabdaprayogakāle bahiḥ siddhaḥ |
ḍitthādīnyavyutpannānyudāharaṇāni | vyutpatau kṛdantatvādeva
siddham | sarvanāma dhātujamityatrāpi pakṣe'vyayārthamanukaraṇaśabdārthaṃ
ca sūtramārabhyameva | nanu laukike prayoge
śabdānāmarthavatādhyavasāyaḥ, sa ca vākyasyaiva padasya vā vibhaktyantasya;
na tu prakṛtibhāgamātrasyeti kathaṃ tasya niṣkṛṣyārthavatvaniścayaḥ !
yeṣāṃ hi sahaiva prayogasteṣāṃ saṅghātasyaivārthavatā yathā
varṇānām ? ucyate; anvayavyatirekābhyāṃ śabdārthaniścayaḥ, yasya
śabdasyānvaye yo'rthaḥ pratīyate, vyatireke ca vyatiricyate sa
tasyārthaḥ | vṛkṣau vṛkṣā ityādau ca pratyayasāmānyavyabhicāre'pi
tadviśeṣavyabhicāraḥ, vṛtau sāmānyavyabhicāraśca vṛkṣakhaṇḍaṃ vārkṣī
śākheti, arthastu mūlaskandhaphalapalāśādimān yāvadvṛkṣaśabdaṃ
pratīyate | 
nāntasyāvadheriti | nanu 'vana ṣaṇa sambhaktau','dhana dhānye'
ityetayordhātvoretau śabdau pacādyaci vyutpāditau,
tatrādhāturiti niṣedho bhaviṣyati | evaṃ tarhyavyutpattipakṣa etaduktam,
ata evodāharaṇatvenāpyanayorupanyāsaḥ | kiṃ cāsatyartha vadgrahaṇe
prativarṇaṃ saṃjñāprasaṅgaḥ, na ca prativarkaṇaṃ dhātusaṃjñā, na
cādhāturapraratyaya iti paryudāsāśrayaṇād arthavato grahaṇam |
anarthakayorapi dhātupratyayayoḥ sambhavād, yathā-adhīte, yāvaka iti |
atra hyadhipūrvasyeṅe'rthavatvaṃ na tu iṅ; tisya kvacidapyaprayogād |
yāvaka ityatrāpi yāvaśabdasyaivārthavatvaṃ na tu kanaḥ; antareṇāpi
tadarthāvagamāt | na ca jñāyate-kena dharmeṇa sādṛśyamiti ! na
cārthavadgrahaṇaparibhāṣayārthavato grahaṇam ? eṣā hi
niyatarūpopādāne vyavasthāpayati, na cātra rūpaviśeṣopādānam |
nanu satyāmapyanarthakasya saṃjñāyāṃ saṃkhyākarmādiṣu vidhīyamānāḥ
svādayo na bhaviṣyanti, naitadasti; aviśeṣeṇotpadyante, utpannā
nāmarthaniyamaḥ, tataścāvyayavat svādayaḥ syureva | nalopo hi
syāditi | vibhaktestu śravaṇaṃ na bhavati, samudāyasyāpi pṛthak
prātipadikasaṃjñāyāṃ tadantarbhāvālluko bhāvāt | yadyevam,
dvirvacananyāyenāvayavasya na bhaviṣyati, yuktaṃ tatra paj ityatra
yenaivācā samudāya ekāc, tenaiva tadavayavo'cchabdaḥ paśabdaśca; na
caikasyaikadā'nekaṃ pratyavayavatvaṃ nirūpayituṃ śakyam |
kiñca--samudāyadvirvacanenāvayavā api dvirucyante,
tadātmakatvāttsya | iha tvavayavānāṃ samudāyasya ca saṃjñānibandhanaṃ
śabdatvaṃ pṛthageva | tatra samudāyasya yat tena yasyaiva kāryaṃ
nāvayavānām | nanu ca eti, ābhyām, aupagavaḥ, a apehīti,
dhātuprātipadikapratyayanipātānāmekavarṇānāmarthadarśanāt
vṛkṣādiṣvapi varṇā arthavantaḥ, tathā kūpa iti kakāre sati kaścidartho
gamyate, yūpa iti yakāropajane'rthantaram, tena manyāmahe yaḥ kūpe
kūpārthaḥ sa kakārasya, yo yūpe yūpārthaḥ sa yakārasyeti; tathā
'brāhmaṇa' ityukte yo'rtho gamyate nāsau bakārādīnāmanyatarāpāye'pi
gamyate | yeṣāṃ ca saṃghāto yatkāryaṃ karoti pratyekamapi tat
kurvanti, yathā-tilānāṃ khārī tailamutpādayati, pratyekaṃ ca tilāḥ |
ye ca yasmin pratyekamasamarthāsteṣāṃ saṃghāto'pi tatrāsamarthaḥ,
yathā-pratyekaṃ sikatāstailaṃ notpādayanti tathā khāryati tāsām |
ataḥ saṃghātārthavatvāccārthavanto varṇāḥ, tatkathamarthavadgrahaṇe
satyapi teṣāṃ nivṛttiḥ | anarthakāstu,
prativarṇānāmarthānupalabdheḥ, na hi 'brā' ityukte kaścidartho gamyate
| ato dhātvādīnāmekavarṇānāmarthavatvād anya'pi varṇā arthavanta
ityanupalabdhibādhitametad | evamanye'pi hetavo bādhitaviṣayāḥ |
kiṃ ca kūpo yūpa ityanvayavyatirekābhyāṃ kakārayakārayorthavatve
yūpa iti caturṇāṃ varṇānāmānarthakyamabhyupagataṃ syāt; atha
teṣāmarthavatvaṃ bhūyiṣṭhaḥ kūpe yūpārthaḥ syāt, kūpārthaśca yūpe,
yatra bhūyasāmarthavatāmanvayaḥ, vyatirekastu kasyacit; tatrārthānāmapi
bhūyasānumapṛtirbhavati, vyatirekastu kasyacid; yathā devadata
gāmabhyāja śuklām, devadata gāmabhāyāja kṛṣṇāmiti | ataḥ saṃghātā
eva tenārthavantaḥ | saṃghātārthavatvācceti heturanaikāntikaḥ,
tailāgnivartisaṃghātena dīpaḥ, na pratyekam, rathāvayavaiścakrādibhiḥ
saṃhatairvrajikriyā | kiñcārthavatāṃ viparyāse'rthapratyayasyāpi
viparyāsaḥ-āhara pātraṃ pātramāhareti, apāye cāpāyaḥ-gāmabhyāja
śuklāṃ gāmabhyājeti, upajane copajanaḥ-gāmabhyāja śuklāmiti |
varṇeṣu tu naivam, hinastīti siṃho hanti hataḥ ghnanti | ataḥ
saṃghātā evārthavantaḥ |
ahanniti | hanterlaṅ itip 'itaśca' lope halṅyādilopo'ṭ, sa
hangrahaṇenaiva gṛhyate, atra prāgeva laṇutpateḥ saṃjñāyāṃ
tasyāmutarakālaṃ padatve sati nalopaḥ syāt | yadvā
prātipadikasaṃjñā padasaṃjñāsamakālemeva syāt, na vā'pratyaya iti
pratiṣedhaḥ; 'na ṅasimbuddhyoḥ' iti liṅgāt; anyathā he
rājannityādāvapratyaya iti niṣedhādaprātipadikatvādeva
nalopaprasaṅgāt |
adhāturiti śakyamakartum, 'supo dhātu' iti dhātugurahaṇaṃ
jñāpakam-na dhātoriyaṃ saṃjñeti | naitadasti jñāpakam,
pratiṣiddhārthametat syāt, śyenāyata ityādāvapratyaya iti niṣiddhā
saṃjñeti bhid, bhūḥ, pūrityevamādau kvibantatve
kṛdantatvādutarasūtreṇa saṃjñā | na ca tasyā api pratiṣedho'yam,
'madhye'pavādāḥ' iti nyāyāt, paryudāsatvādvā |
kāṇḍe iti | prathamādvivacanasya 'napuṃsakācca' iti śībhāvaḥ, apratyaya
iti ca pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣayā tadantasya niṣedhaḥ | yatra hi pratyayaḥ
saṃjñirūpe'nupraviśati, yathā- 'taraptamapau ghaḥ' iti, tatra
padasaṃjñāyāmantavacanena tadantavidhipratiṣedhaḥ | iha tu paryudāse
pratyayavyatiriktaḥ saṃjñī, prasajyapratiṣedhe'pi na saṃjñāvidhau
pratyayagraṇaṃ, kiṃ tarhi ? pratiṣedha iti, nāsti niṣedhaḥ | nanūtarasūtre
kṛtaddhitagrahaṇaṃ niyamārthaṃ bhaviṣyati-pratyayāntasya yadi bhavati
kṛtaddhitāntasyaiveti, ucyate; asmin satyapratiṣedhe saṃjñāvidhau
tadantavidhipratiṣedhātpratyayasya yadi bhavati kṛtaddhitasyaiveti
sthāniniyamaḥ syāt | sati tvasmin, atra tāvatpratyayāntasya niṣedha
iti utarasūtre'pi taddhitāntasya grahaṇaṃ bhavati | atha
kriyamāṇe'pyapratyaya ityasminnapuṃsakahrasvatvaṃ kasmānna bhavati ?
paryudāse tāvatpratyayāpratyayayorekādeśasya pūrvaṃ
pratyantavadbhāvaḥ, prasajyapratiṣedhe'pyantaraṅgatvāt prāgeva
pratyayotpateḥ kāṇḍaśabdasya pravṛtā saṃjñeti ekādeśasyāntavadbhāva
ityāstyeva prātipadikatvam | tathā ca
brahmabandhūrityūṇeókādeśasyāntavatvāt svādyutpattiḥ | na cāpratyaya
ityasya vaiyarthyam; trapuṇī ityādau yatraikādeśatvaṃ nāsti
tatrārthavatvāt | evaṃ tarhi napuṃsake yadvartate tasyahsvaḥ,
vibhaktyantaṃ tu saṃkhyāpradhānaṃ kārakaśaktipradhānaṃ ca, na ca
tayorliṅgayogaḥ, na cānyavadbhāvenārthaḥ śakyo'tideṣṭuamiti na
bhavati hsvaḥ | yadyevam, trapuṇī ityādāvapyevameva na bhaviṣyati,
nārtho'nena, na cānyaḥ pratyayānto vyāvartyaḥ sambhavati | tathā hi,
ṣaḍvidhāḥ pratyayāḥ--sanādayaḥ, kṛtaḥ tiṅḥ, supaḥ,
strīpratyayāḥ,taddhitāśceti | pratipadikakāryamapi 'hrasvo napuṃsake
prātipadikasya' 'gaustriyorupasarjanasya' iti hrasvatvam,
'ṅyāpprātipadikāt' iti pratyayavidhiśca | tacca
kṛtaddhitāntasyeṣyata thaeva | sanprabhṛtiṣu yeṣāṃ tāvaddhātutvaṃ
teṣāmadhāturityeva pratiṣedhaḥ, śyanśabādīnāmapi vikaraṇānāṃ
liṅgābhāvaḥ, saṃkhyākarmādyabhāvo'patyādyarthāyogaśca | evaṃ
tiṅntānām, yathā-yaḥ pacatirūpam, tasyāpatyam iti
rūpabantatvātsatyapi prātipadikatve | ye tu sambhavanti svārthikāste
'tiṅśca' iti jñāpakānna bhavanti | strīpratyayānāṃ tu viruddhena
napuṃsakenāyoga eva, kumārīputra ityatra 'gostriyoḥ' iti hrasvaḥ
syāditi ced ? atha kriyamāṇe'pi pratiṣedhe rājakumārīputra ityatra
kasmānna bhavati, atra hi samāsatvādastyeva prātipadikatvam ? ato
yastatra parihāraḥ, sa evātrāpi bhaviṣyati | pratyayavidhistviṣyata eva |
'ṅyāpprātipadikāt' iti subantasya hrasvatvaṃ na prāpnotītyuktameva
| supāṃ cāprasaṅgaḥ; tadvidhānadaśāyāṃ tadantasyāsambhavāt,
liṅgābhāvāt strīpratyayābhāvaḥ | taddhitāstviṣyanta eva 'samarthānāṃ
prathamādvā' iti | ato nārtho'nena, utarasūtre taddhitagrahaṇena ca,
ucyate; 'bahuṣu bahuvacanam' 'karmaṇi dvitīyā' ityādināṃ
svādividhivākyena bhinnavākyatāpakṣe sarvebhyaḥ pratyayāntebhyaḥ svādayaḥ
syuḥ yathā-avyayebhyaḥ | vikaraṇāntācca svārthikāstaddhitāḥ
syurevetyato'pratyayagrahaṇaṃ kartavyaṃ taddhitagrahaṇaṃ ca | kāṇḍe kuḍa|l
ityetayostu pratyudāharaṇatvam 'hasvo napuṃsake'
ityatropapādayiṣyāmaḥ |
atha pratyāyamātrasya saṃjñā kasmānna bhaviṣyati, satyāṃ hi saṃjñāyāmuktena
nyāyena bahupaṭava ityādau svādayaḥ syuḥ ?
ucyate-vyapadeśivadbhāvena pratyayāntavadpratyaya iti pratiṣedho
bhaviṣyati | yadyevam, kṛtaddhitamātre'pi vidhisambhavāt utarasūtre
tadantavidhirna bhavati | atra parihāraṃ vakṣyāmaḥ ||
kṛtaddhitasamāsāśca || 1|2|46 ||
kṛto vihitāstadādaya iti veditavyam | atra hi
kṛdgrahaṇaparibhāṣā nopatiṣṭhate, tena mūlakenopadaṃśamiti
vākyasya saṃjñā na bhavati | madhye'pavādanyāyena hyapratyaya iti niṣedhaḥ
kṛdgrahaṇena bādhyate, na tu samāsagrahaṇena kṛto niyamaḥ |
saṃjñāvidhau pratyayagrahaṇe'pyatra
tadantavidhirbhavatītyatrīpapatimāha--apratyaya iti | pratyayāntasya
niṣedho na kevalasya pratyayasyetyāśrityaitaducyate | aprāptaprāpaṇaṃ
vidhiḥ, na ca tadā kṛtaddhitamātrasyāprāptā saṃjñā tadantasyatvaprāpteti
vidhyarthatvātadantasyaiva grahaṇam | yeṣāṃ tu pūrvatra pratyayamātrasyāpi
niṣedhasteṣāmarthavadgrahaṇānevṛterarthavadviśeṣasya tadantasya grahaṇaṃ
samāsagrahaṇamanarthakam, arthavatvātpūrveṇaiva saṃjñāsiddherityata
āha-arthavatsamudāyānāmiti | karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī | niyamaḥ u vyāvṛttiḥ |
nanu surājā atirājetyādau antarvatinyāṃ vibhaktau luptāyāṃ
samudāyasya saṃjñā, tāmapekṣya sorutpannasya halṅyādilope
tasyāmavasthāyāṃ nalopārthaṃ yā saṃjñā prāpnoti tasyāḥ
pratyayalakṣaṇenāpratyaya iti niṣedhe prāpte vidhyarthametatsyāt ?
jñāpakātsiddham, 'na ṅisaṃbuddhyoḥ' iti niṣedho jñāpayati-na
pratyayalakṣaṇena niṣedha iti; anyathā uktena nyāyena he rājannityādau
nalopaprasaṅgāt | naitadasti jñāpakam; hai surājannityādau yatra
samāsagrahaṇena saṃjñā vihitā tatra nalopaprasaṅge niṣedhaḥ syād |
evaṃ tarhyatrāpyapratyaya ityanuvartate, tena pratyayānte samāse
vidhyarthatvāsaṃbhavānniyamārthameva samāsagrahaṇam |
yadvā-anuddiśya prayojanaviśeṣaṃ na kṛtsaṃjñā pravartate, tasyāṃ tu
satyāṃ yasyāmavasthāyāṃ yatkāryaṃ prāpnoti tasyāṃ tadbhavati, na
pratikāryamāvartanīyā saṃjñetyayaṃ pakṣa āśrīyate | atra ca pakṣe
subutpatyarthaṃ nalopārthaṃ ca samāsasaṃjñānantarameva sakṛtsaṃjñā
pravartate, na tu nalopadaśāyāmiti vidhyarthatvāsambhavānniyamārthameva
samāsagrahaṇam | tulyajātīyasya ca niyamena vyāvṛttiḥ, kaśca
tulyajātīyo yasyārthavatsamudāyasya pūrvo bhāgastāvatpadam,
yaścaiva hi subantānāṃ samāsaḥ-rājapuruṣa iti, yaścaiva hi
tiṅntānām--"ākhyatamākhyātena kriyāsātatye', aśnītapibatā,
khādatamodateti, yaśca subantānāṃ tiṅntānāṃ ca-'jahi karmaṇā
bahulamābhīkṣṇye', jahijoḍaḥ, jahiśakaṭa iti, yaśca subantānāṃ
prātipadikānāṃ ca--gatikārakopapadānāmiti, vastrakrīti
niṣkakrītīti, sarvatrātra pūrvo bhāgastāvatpadam | ataḥ sa
tulyajātīyo niyamena vyāvartyate, tena bahupaṭava ityatra jasantasya
purastādvahuci kṛte notaratrata saṃghāte pūrvo bhāgaḥ padamityasati
niyame īṣadasamāptilakṣaṇenārthenārthavatvātsatyāṃ saṃjñāyāṃ
pūrvotpannasya jasaḥ 'supo dhātu' iti luki kṛte citsvaro'pi
bhavan 'catiḥ saprakṛterbahujakajarthamiti' paṭuaśabdokārasya bhavati |
pūrvotpannasya tu jaso'vasthāne tasyaiva syāt | vākyasyārthavata iti
| pratyekaṃ padairapratītasya saṃsargasya vākyena
pratīyamānatvātasyārthavatvam, samudāyācca
pratyayasyāvidhānānnāstyapratyaya iti niṣedhaḥ | na ca 'nāsti yasmin
pratyayaḥ so'pratyayaḥ' iti bahuvrīhiḥ śakya āśrayitum; bahupaṭava
ityatrāpi ni,edhaprasaṅgāt ||
hrasvo napuṃsake prātipadikasya || 1|2|47 ||
sūtre napuṃsakaśabdena tadvaddravyaṃ vivakṣitaṃ na
liṅgamātramityāha-napuṃsakaliṅge'rthe iti | napuṃsakaṃ
liṅgamasyeti bahuvrīhiḥ |
grāmaṇīriti | 'satsūdiṣa' ityādinā kvip | prātipadikasyeti
kimiti | napuṃsakaliṅgaṃ dravyasyaiva dharmaḥ, dravyavācitvaṃ ca
prātipadikasyaiva, na subantasya; śaktisaṅkhyāprādhānyāt | na
dhātostiḍantasya vākyasya vā; kriyāpradhānatvāt | varṇāstvanarthakāḥ,
strīpratyayānāṃ tu viruddhena napuṃsakenāyoga iti praśnaḥ | kāṇḍe
kuṇḍa|le iti | atra 'apratyayaḥ' iti niṣedhāt pratipadikatvaṃ nāsti |
nanu ca ekādeśaḥ pūrvaṃ pratyantavadbhāvāt prātipadikagrahaṇena
gṛhyate iti kriyamāṇe'pi prātipadikagrahaṇe hrasvatvaṃ syādevāt
āha-prātipadikagrahaṇasāmarthyāditi | kathaṃ puna sāmarthyam, yāvatā
yatrāntavadbhāvo nāsti-vāḥ vārī trapuṇī ityādau, tadvyāvartyaṃ
syāt ? atha śaktisaṅkhyāpradhānatvāt tatra napuṃsakenāyogaḥ, kāṇḍe
ityādāvapi evamape na bhaviṣyati | na hyantavadbhāvena prātipadikatve
satyapi śaktisaṅkhyāprādhānyaṃ hīyate | evaṃ manyate-'asati
prātipadikagrahaṇe napuṃsakavṛteranapuṃsakavṛteśca ya ekādeśaḥ sa
napuṃsakavṛttigrahaṇena gṛhyate napuṃsaka iti syātprasaṅgaḥ |
prātipadikagrahaṇe tu mukhyaprātipadikagrahaṇārthatvād
atidiṣṭaprātipadikatvasya hrasvasyābhāvaḥ' iti | utārthaṃ ca
prātipadikagrahaṇam | iha vanāya, vanābhyām, vanārtham, vanebhya iti
hrasvo na bhavati, bahiraṅgayordīrghatvayorasiddhatvāt |
kāṇḍībhūtamityatra pūrvaṃ napuṃsakatve'pi cvyantadaśāyām
avyayatvenāliṅgatvād hrasvābhāvaḥ ||
gostriyorupasarjanasya || 1|2|48 ||
strīti pratyayagrahaṇamiti | atra hetumāha-svaritatvāditi |
'svaritenādhikāraḥ' ityasya yatra svaritatvaṃ pratijñāyate tatra
tadadhikāro grāhya ityayamapyarthaḥ | iha ca strīgrahaṇaṃ svaryate, tena
striyāmityadhikṛtya vihitānāṃ ṭābādīnāṃ grahaṇaṃ bhavati; nārthasya,
nāpi svarūpasya | ktinnādīnāṃ tu hrasvabhāvitvābhāvādagrahaṇam |
uparsjanagrahaṇaṃ tayorviśeṣaṇamiti | pratyekaṃ sambandhātu dvivacanaṃ
na bhavatītyāha-gorupasarjanasyetyādi | strīpratyayāntasyeti pāṭhaḥ |
pāribhāṣikaṃ hyatropasarjanaṃ gṛhyate | na ca strīpratyayamātrasya
pāribhāṣikopasarjanatvasambhavaḥ | tābhyāmiti | upasarjanena
gośabdena strīpratyayāntena ca yadi tābhyāṃ tadantavidhirna vijñāyate,
tadā upasarjanasya gośabdasya strīpratyayāntasya ca prātipadikasya hrasva
ityarthaḥ syāt; tataśca gokulaṃ rājakumārīputra ityatrāpi syāditi
bhāvaḥ | iha tu 'kumārīputraḥ' ityatra prātipadikatvādevāprasaṅgaḥ |
upasarjanastrīpratyayāntāntasyeti pāṭhaḥ | upasarjanaṃ yat
strīpratyayāntaṃ tadantasyetyarthaḥ | yadi tu laukikenopasarjanena
strīpratyayamātraṃ viśeṣya paścātena prātipadikasya
tadantavidharvijñāyite--upasarjanaṃ yaḥ strīpratyayastadantasya
prātipadikasyeti, tato harītakyaḥ phalānītyatrāpi syāt;
strīpratyayārthasya phalaṃ pratyupasarjanatvātaddhitāntatvena
prātipadikatvācca | ata evamevāśrayaṇīyam--strīpratyayāntaṃ
yacchāstrīyamupasarjanaṃ tadantasya prātipadikasyeti |
niṣkauśāmbiriti | kauśambītyekabibhaktītyupasarjanaṃ strīḥ
tyayāntaṃ tadantaṃ samāsaprātipadikam | atheha kathaṃ hrasvatvam
atirājakumāririti, yāvatā kumāraśabdān ṅībvihato na tu
rājakumāraśabdāt ? satyam; anuparjane strīpratyaye tadādiniyamo
nāsti | atha gośabdena strīpratyayāntena ca prātipadikasya
tadantavidhau satyapi gokulaṃ rājakumārīputra ityatra kasmānna bhavati,
yāvatā 'yena vidhistadantasya' ityatra 'svaṃ rūpam' ityanuvartate,
tataśca yena tadantavidhiḥ tatsvarūpasyāpi grahaṇena bhāvyam ? evaṃ tarhi
gośabdena prātipadikasya viśeṣaṇasāmarthyāt kevalasya na bhavati;
anyathā gośabdasyaivopasarjanasya hrasvaṃ vidadhyād, 'yena
vidhistadantasya' ityatra 'svaṃrupam' iti nivartyam |
vyapadeśivadbhāvo'pi prātipadike nāsti | rājakumārīputra ityatra
tu parihāraḥ--śāstrīyamapyupasarjanaṃ sati
sambhave'nvarthamevāpradhānamupasarjanamiti, pradhānaṃ cāpekṣyāpradhānaṃ
bhavati | strīpratyayāntasya ca prātipadikatvaṃ
samāsamantareṇānupapannam, samāsaścāvayavātmakaḥ; dvayaṃ cātra
saṃnihitam-pradhānamapradhānamiti; tatraivaṃ vijñāsyāmaḥ-yat
strīpratyayāntaṃ samāsaprātipadikaṃ tadantarbhūtamevāpekṣya
strīpratyayāntasyāprādhānyamiti | iha tu tatrānantarbhūtaṃ
putramapekṣyāprādhānyamiti na bhavati hrasvaḥ |
īyasa ityādi | īyasunnantādyaḥ strīpratyayo vihitastadantāntasyetyarthaḥ
| bahuśreyasīti | 'praśasyasya śraḥ' ṅīp, bahvyaḥ śreyasyo'syeti
bahuvrīhiḥ, 'nadyaḥtaśca' iti kap, 'īyasaśca' iti pratiṣedhaḥ, puṃsyapi
sorhalṅyādilopaḥ | bahuvrīheriti kim ? atiśreyasiḥ ||
luktaddhitaluki || 1|2|49 ||
strīgrahaṇamanuvartate iti | na tu gograhaṇam, kutaḥ ?
pratyayādarśanasya luksaṃjñāvidhānād gośabdasyāvyutpannatvād
vyutpattipakṣe'pyasvaritatvāt | upasarjanasya ceti | 'anuvartate'
ityapekṣate | laukikaṃ cātropasarjanaṃ gṛhyate, na śāstrīyam | pūrveṇa
hrasvatve prāpte iti kvacitpaṭha|lte, tatra kvaciditi viśeṣaḥ |
pūrvasūtreṇa hi śāstrīyamupasarjanaṃ gṛhītaṃ tasyāvakāśo yatra na
taddhitalugniṣkauśāmbiriti; asyāvakāśo yatra
śāstrīyamupasarjanam-āmalakamiti | taddhitalukca yathā--pañcendra iti,
atra hi samāsārthe nānāvibhaktike pañcendrāṇītyekavibhaktikamiti
astyupasarjanatvam; tatrobhayaprasaṅge paratvādayameva lug hrasvaṃ
bādhata ityarthaḥ |
kecitvasmādeva granthāt pūrvasūtre'pi laukikasyoparjanasya grahaṇaṃ
manyante, teṣāṃ harītakyaḥ phalāni iti lubviṣaye hrasvaprasaṅga
ityuktam | syādevam--lupi yuktavaditi śabdārthayorapyatideśaḥ
prakṛtyarthasya yalliṅgaṃ yaśca tadabhidhāyī pratyayaḥ
tayordvayoratideśaḥ, tatraupadeśikasya hrasvatva ātideśikasya śravaṇaṃ
bhaviṣyatīti ? yadyevam, yuvatiriva puruṣaḥ 'lum munaṣye'
yuvatiḥ, dvau tiśabdau śrūyeyātām; tasmāt 'lubyogāprakhyānāt'
iti lupaḥ pratyākhyānena vātra parihāro vācyaḥ, śāstrīyaṃ
vopasarjanaṃ grāhyam | granthasya ca vyākhyāta evārthaḥ |
abhāvarūpeṇa lukā paurvābharyāsambhavāllukīti satsaptamītyāha-luki
satīti | pañcandra iti | 'taddhitārtha' iti samāsaḥ,'sāsya devatā'
ityaṇaḥ 'dvigorluganapatye' iti luk, 'indravaruṇa' ityādinā
vihitasya ṅīṣo'nena luk, sanniyogaviśiṣṭānāmanyatarābhāva
ityānuko nivṛttiḥ | pañcaśaṣkula iti | 'tena krītam' ityārhīyasya
ṭhakaḥ 'adhyarddhapūrva' iti luk | āmalakamiti | 'nityaṃ
vṛddhaśarādibhyaḥ' iti mayaṭaḥ 'phale luk' | badarīkuvalīśabdābhāyām
'anudātādeśca' iti añ | śaṣkulyādayo gaurādiṅīṣantāḥ |
avantītyādi | avanti-kunti-śabdābhyāmapatye '
vṛddhetkosalājādāññyaṅ' | kuroḥ 'kurunādibhyo ṇyaḥ',
striyāmavantīti luk, kuruśabdād 'ūṇutaḥ' ityuṅ | itarābhyām
'ito manuṣyajāteḥ' iti ṅīṣ | atrāpatyalakṣaṇā jātiḥ
strīpratyayāntena prādhānyenābhidhīyate ||
id goṇyāḥ || 1|2|50 ||
pañcagoṇiriti | goṇiśabdaḥ parimāṇavacanaḥ, āvapanavacanaśca;
tatrādyāt 'prāgvateṣṭhañ', dvitīyādārhīyaṣṭhak | tayoḥ pūrvalluk |
iditi yogāvibhāga iti | ihedgrahaṇamanarthakam, goṇyā
ityevāstu, hrasva ityeva, lukastu vacanāsāmarthyādananuvṛttiḥ ?
tadetadidgrahaṇameva liṅgaṃ yogavibhāgasya | yadi yogavibhāgaḥ
kriyate, sarvatretvaṃ prāpnoti, tatrāha-sa ceti | yadi sarvatra syād
goṇīgrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāditi bhāvaḥ | nanu taddhitaluki lugapyuktaḥ,
itvaṃ ceti, tayorvikalpaprasaṅge nityamitvameva yathā
syādityevamarthaṃ goṇīgrahaṇaṃ syāt, tatkarthaṃ tato viśiṣṭaviṣayatvaṃ
yogavibhāgasya ? ucyate; eka eva tāvadyogaḥ sūtrakāreṇa paṭhitaḥ,
tatsāmarthyād vibhāgasaṃskāro'pyanuvartate, avibhaktaśca yogo
viśiṣṭaviṣayaḥ | idgrahaṇasāmarthyātkriyamāṇo vibhāgo
viśiṣṭaviṣaya eva kalpyate; ata
evocyate--yogavibhāgādiṣṭasiddhariti | sa punarviśiṣṭo viṣayo
vyākhyānādavaseyaḥ | taparakaraṇaṃ tatkālārtham--dīrghasya dīrgho mā
bhūd | vacanaṃ tu lugghrasvabādhanārthaṃ syād | asati ca takāre,
prāptapratiṣiddha īkāra evaṃ pratiprasūtaḥ syād, na tvapūrva ikāro
vihitaḥ syād iti bhāvyamānatvameva na syāt ||
lupi yuktavadvyakticavane || 1|2|51 ||
abhidheyavalliṅgavacanayoḥ prāptayorayamārambhaḥ | abhāvarūpasya lupo
liṅgasaṅkhyātideśāsambhavādāha--lupīti lupsaṃjñetyādi |
kvacitu saptamyanto lupśabda upādīyate tatrāpi prakṛtyartha
evābhidhātumiṣṭaḥ | saptamyupādānaṃ tu sūtre paṭhitatvād,
yathā-matāviti matvartha ucyata iti | yuktavaditi niṣṭhāpratyenetyādi
| atra hetumāha--sa hīti | yunakti sambadhnāti | yadyapi pratyayārtho'pi
prakṛtyarthamātmanā yunakti, tathāpi na tasyeha grahaṇam; ānarthakyād,
na hi tasyaiva liṅgasaṅkhye tasyaiva vidhātavye |
atha vetyādi | pūrvaṃ 'yujiryoge' ityasya ktavatvantasya ṣaṣṭhīsamāso
darśataḥ, idānīṃ tu tasyaiva dhātoḥ ktāntasya vatinirdeśaḥ,
asamāsaśceti pradaśyate | yuktaḥ prakṛtyartha iti | atra
hetuḥ--pratyayārthena sambaddha iti | asminnapi pakṣe pūrvavadeva
pratyayārthasyāgrahaṇam | saptamyarthe vatiriti | 'lupi' iti
pratiyogini saptamī nirddeśāt saptamyarthe vartamānādivārthe
vatirityarthaḥ | vyaktiśabda āvirbhāvādike'pyarthe vartate |
vacanaśabdo'pi bhīmaseno bhīma itivad, ekavacanādiśabdānāṃ
thaekadeśaprayogo'pi sambhāvyeta, tasya ca grahaṇe 'pañcālānāṃ
nivāsaḥ' iti vākyāvasthāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhīdarśanātasyā evātideśaḥ syāt;
kurupañcālā iti ca dvandve vākyā vasthāyāmatidiṣṭasya vacanasya luki
samudāyād bahuvacanaṃ na syāt, tatastatsampratyayo mā
bhūdityāha--vyaktivacane iti cetyādi | pūrvācāryanirdeśāśrayaṇe
kāraṇamāha -tadīyamevetyādi | kuta ityata āha-tathā cetyādi | na
hi svakṛtameva svayaṃ pratyācaṣṭa iti yuktam; 'viṣavṛkṣo'pi saṃvardhya
svayaṃ chetumasāmpratam' iti nyāyāditi bhāvaḥ |
pañcālāḥ kṣatriyā iti | pañcālasyāpatyāni bahūni 'janapadaśabdāt
kṣatriyādñ' 'te tadrājāḥ', 'tadrājasya bahuṣu' | teṣāṃ nivāso
janapada iti | asya vakṣyamāṇena 'pañcālāḥ' ityanena sambandhaḥ | 'tasya
nivāsa' ityaṇaḥ 'janapade lup' | kurava ityādi | 'kuravaḥ kṣatriyāḥ'
ityādikaṃ tu pūrvānusāreṇa gamyamānatvānnoktam |
kuruśabdādapatye 'kurunādibhyo ṇyaḥ' magadhādibhyaḥ 'dvayañmagadha'
ityaṇ, śeṣaṃ pūrvavat |
lupīti kimiti | taddhito'nuvṛtaḥ
sāhacaryādarthamupasthāpayiṣyatīti praśnaḥ | luki mā bhūditi | anyathā
'taddhitaluki' ityanuvṛtestatraiva syāditi bhāvaḥ | lavaṇaḥ sūpa iti |
'saṃsṛṣṭe''lavaṇālluk' | vyaktivacane iti kimiti | yuktavaditi
ktāntādvatirevāśrayiṣyate, ṣaṣṭhīnirddeśo vā kariṣyate iti
manyate | śirīṣāṇāmadūrabhāva ityādi | arīhaṇādiṣu varāhādiṣu
kumudādiṣu śirīṣaśabdasya pāṭhād vuñcchaṇādisūtreṇa
vañādayo'smādbhavanti, teṣāṃ ca viśeṣavihitatvāllukā na
bhavitavyam, satyam; 'autsargiko'pi tata iṣyate' iti vakṣyati, tasya
varaṇādidarśanāllup | asati vyaktivacanagrahaṇe śirīṣeṣu
yadvanaspatitvaṃ tas|yāpi grāme'tideśaḥ syāt, tataśca ṇatvaṃ
prāpnoti; ṇatvavidhau viphalī vanaspatiriti nāśrīyate viśeṣaḥ | ata
eva vṛkṣavṛterṇatvaṃ bhavatyeva | śirīṣavanamiti | nanu ca grāme'pi
vartamāno guṇabhūtaṃ vanaspatitvamāheti ṇatvaprasaṅgaḥ, na cātra
kiñcitpradhānāśrayaṃ kāryamasti yena guṇaḥ svakāryaṃ nārabheta | na ca
vyaktivacanagrahaṇasya vaiyarthyam, asati hi tasminprakṛtyarthagatasya
vyatirekasyāpyatideśāt ṣaṣṭhī prasajyeta; sati tu tasmin
saṅkhyāmātrātidaeśe vyatirekasahitāyāḥ saṅkhyāyā anatideśād
? nāyaṃ doṣaḥ; evaṃ tarhi ṇatvavidhau pradhānavanaspatigrahaṇād atra
tadabhāvaḥ |
harītakyaḥ phalānīti | harītakīśabdād gaurādiṅīṣantād
'anudātādeśca' ityañaḥ 'harītakyādibhyaśśca' iti lup | atra
vyaktireva yuktavadbhavati, vacanaṃ tvabhidheyavadeva | khalatikaṃ
vanānīti | khalatikaśabdo varaṇādiḥ, samāse utara padasya
bahuvacanasya lupo niyamārthametad-lubarthasya bahutvātideśaḥ
samāse yadi bhavati utarapadasyaiveti, madhurāpañcālāḥ; iha na
bhavati-pañcālamadhure iti, bahuvacanasyeti vacanād | dvitvātideśaḥ
pūrvapadasyāpi bhavati-godau ca grāmaḥ madhurā ca godamadhurā iti ||

viśeṣaṇānāṃ cājāteḥ ||1|2|52 ||
pūrvaṃ prakṛtyarthagatayorliṅgasaṅkhyayorlubarthe'tideśaḥ kṛtaḥ, na
tu lubante śabde iti tatra vartamānānāṃ viśeṣaṇānāṃ siddha eva
yuktavadbhāvaḥ | vacanaṃ tu jātipratiṣedhārtham | atha vyadhikaraṇānāṃ
vidhyarthaṃ kasmānna bhavati, brahmadatasya pañcālā iti ? 'tatpuruṣaḥ
samāsanādhikaraṇaḥ' ityataḥ samānādhikaraṇānuvṛteḥ | godāviti |
godau hradau varaṇādiḥ, grāmajanapadaśabdau jātivācinau tābhyāṃ
lubartho jātirūpeṇocyate | jātyarthasya cetyādi | jātirūpasya
cārthasya, na jātivācinaḥ śabdasyetyarthaḥ | tena kiṃ siddhaṃ
bhavatītyāha--teneti | dvāragrahaṇenaitaddarśayati --jātau prakrāntāyāṃ
yadviśeṣaṇamupanipatitaṃ tajjātimeva sākṣādviśinaṣṭi, taddvāreṇa
tu lubartho viśiṣṭaḥ pratīyate; tatra viśeṣaṇaviṣeṣyabhāvaṃ prati
kāmacāra iti ramaṇīyādīnāṃ jātyupanipāte yuktavadbhāvo na
bhavati; lubartho panipāte tu bhavati | yadyevam, nārtho'nena,
lupo'nyatrāpyayaṃ prakāro dṛṣṭaḥ, yathā--badarī sūkṣmakaṇṭakā
madhurāvṛkṣa iti, madhurādīnāṃ badaryupanipāte
talliṅgasaṅkhyāyogaḥ, vṛkṣopanipāte vṛkṣaliṅgasaṅkhyogaḥ,
vṛkṣasya ca niyataliṅgata ? evaṃ tarhi yatatratatrocyate--guṇavacanānāṃ
hi śabdānāṃ nāśrayato liṅgavacanāni bhavantīti, tadanena kriyate |
viśeṣaṇānāṃ guṇavacanānāmityarthaḥ | yuktavadvyaktivacane |
āśrayavalliṅgasaṃkhye ityarthaḥ | yadā tu jātiviśeṣaṇaṃ tadā neti |
padasaṃskārapakṣe ca vācanikametat; pade hi padāntaranirapekṣe
saṃskriyamāṇe liṅgasarvanāmanapuṃsakaṃ vastvantarānapekṣamekatvaṃ ca
prāptamiti śuklaṃ paṭā iti prāpte bhāvino bahiraṅgasyāśrayasya
liṅgasaṃkhye vidhīyete | vākyasaṃkāre tvayamanubāda eva;
āśrayaviśeṣaniṣṭhatvena viśeṣaṇānāmapi
talliṅgasaṃkhyayorasiddhatvāt |
manuṣyalupīti | munaṣyalakṣaṇe lubarthe viśeṣaṇānāṃ pratiṣedhaḥ |
lubantasya tu bhavatyeva-cañcābhirūpa iti, tṛṇapuruṣaścañcā tatsadṛśo
manuṣyaścañcā 'saṃjñāyām' iti kan, 'lummanuṣye' iti lup |
carmavikāraviśeṣo varghrikā ||
tadaśiṣyaṃ saṃjñāpramāṇatvāt || 1|2|53 ||
saṃjñāpramāṇatvāditi | pramāṇānāÄ hi pramāṇatvaṃ pratipādakatvaṃ
svārthapratyāyanalakṣaṇam | etacca sarveṣāmeva śabdānāmasti, na
saṃjñāśabdānāmeva | ucyate cedaṃ tatra viśeṣo vijñāyata
ityāha--saṃjñāśabdā hītyādi | ye saṃjñāśabdāste nānāliṅgasaṃkhyā
api svābhidheyagataliṅgasaṃkhyāpekṣayā bhinnaliṅgasaṃkhyā api
pramāṇam, svārthasya pratipādakā ityarthaḥ | bhavatu
saṃjñāśabdānāmevaṃvidhaṃ pramāṇatvam, kimāyātaṃ yaugikānāṃ
pañcālādiśabdānāmitya āha-pañcālā varaṇā ityādi | tadanena
pakṣadharmatvaṃ hetoruktam, pūrvaṃ tu dṛṣṭāntagato heturvyākhyātaḥ |
dṛṣṭāntamāha--yatheti | yuktavadbhāvamārabhamāṇo'pi nātra kañcidyatnaṃ
karoti, tadavaśyamayaṃ śabdasvabhāva evāśrayaṇīyaḥ | kaściddhi śabdaḥ
svabhāvāt samudāyasaṃkhyāmabhidhate, kaścidavayavasaṃkhyām, yathā-vanaṃ
vṛkṣā iti | evaṃ liṅge'pi draṣṭavyam ||
lubyogāprakhyānāt || 1|2|54 ||
