kiṃ kāraṇamiti | 'nimitakāraṇahetuṣu sarvāsāṃ prāyadarśanam' iti
prathamā dvitīyā vā | tathā ca yogāprakhyānādityutaropapatiḥ |
yogaḥujanapadādeḥ kṣatriyādibhiḥ sambandhaḥ,
tasyāprakhyānādanupalabdherityarthaḥ | tadāha--na hīti | etadeva
vivṛṇoti-naitaditi, saṃjñā etā iti | yadyapi saṃjñāśabdā api
paṅkajādayo'pekṣitapravṛttinimitāḥ santi, tathāpīha
prakaraṇādanepekṣitapravṛttinimitā apīti boddhavyam | ata
evāha-tasmādatretyādi | nanu yogāprakhyāne'pi taddhita utpadyate,
tadyathā--'kambalācca saṃjñāyām' kambalyamūrṇāpalaśatamiti, satyam;
yatra rūpe viśeṣo'sti | nanu ca saṃjñāpramāṇatvāditi
pañcālādiśabdānāmayaugikatvamupapāditamityarthāllubapi
pratyākhyāt eva, kimanena kriyate ? ucyate; saṃjñāpramāṇatvādityanena
dṛṣṭāntagato hetuḥ śabdenoktaḥ tasyaiva tvarthātpañcālādigatatvena
pratīyamānasyāsiddhimāśaṅkaya yogāprakhyānāditi
yaugikatvāmapākurvan hetumeva samarthayate ||
yogapramāṇe ca tadabhāve darśanaṃ syāt || 1|2|55 ||
pañcālādaya ityādi | pūrvayogasyāpratibhāsa uktaḥ, yastu
tamapajānīte taṃ pratyanenāniṣṭamāpadyata iti darśayati-yogapramāṇe
hīti | 'hi' śabdo hetvarthe prayuñjānaḥ sūtre 'ca' śabdo hetau
prayukta iti darśayati | etadeva vyācaṣṭe-yadīti, adarśanamayogaḥ
casyāditi | darśanaṃ jñānaṃ tacca prayogasyoccāraṇasya phalam, ataḥ
phalābhāvena hetvabhāvo vivakṣita ityācaṣṭe | yoganimitako hi
yogābhāvena pradarśanaṃ yujyate, yathā-daṇḍīśabda iti bhāvaḥ | nanu
bhūtapūrvamapi nimitaṃ bhavati, tataśca samprati
varaṇādiyogābhāve'pi bhūtapūrvaḥ sa eva nimitaṃ bhaviṣyati,
naitadevam; bhūtapūrvanimito hi vyapadeśo gauṇaḥ syād, na
cāyaṃ gauṇaḥ; padāntarasya prayogamantareṇā'pi pratīyamānatvāt |
kiñca yaugikatve puruṣāntarasaṃbaṃdhanibaṃdhano'pi vyapadeśaḥ kasmānna
pravartate ? viparyayo vā kasmānna bhavati ? deśasambandhādrājasu
pañcālaśabda ityato'kṣādiśabdavadanekārtha evāyaṃ pañcālādiśabdaḥ ||
pradhānapratyayārthavacanamarthasyānyapramāṇatvāt || 1|2|56 ||
arthavacanamiti | karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhayāḥ samāsaḥ | nanu ca
pradhānapratyayayoḥ kartrornirdeśādubhayaprāptāvityanenātra ṣaṣṭhī, tataśca
'karmaṇi ca' iti niṣedhaḥ prāpnoti, naiṣa doṣaḥ ; pradhānapratyayoratra
karaṇatvaṃ vivakṣitam | kastarhi kartā, puruṣaḥ, samudāyo vā
pradhānopasarjanayoḥ prakṛtipratyayayośca ? etaduktaṃ
bhavati-pradhānapratyayābhyāṃ karaṇābhyāṃ puruṣeṇa samudāyena vā
yadarthasya vacanaśabdena saha 'kartṛkaraṇe kṛtā bahulam',
'kṛdgrahaṇe gatikārakapūrvasyāpi grahaṇam' itica samāsaḥ | nanu ca
pratyayo'pi prakṛtyapekṣayā pradhānam, kasmādbhedenopādīyate ?
ucyate; yadā 'prakṛtiḥ pratyayārthaṃ prati viśeṣaṇatayā svārthamabhidhate'
iti siddhaṃ bhavati, tadā pratyayasya prādhānyam, tadevedānīṃ
paribhāṣyata iti pūrvācāryaistāvatpratyayo bhedena
nirdiṣṭaḥ-pradhānopasarjane, prakṛtipratyayāviti, tataśca
tallakṣaṇanirākaraṇe pratyayo'pi bhedenopādeyaḥ | aśkyatvāditi |
aśakyatvamanantaprakāratvāt | bahuvrīhāvanyapadārtha ucyate;
plakṣanyagrodhamiti samāhāraḥ; kvacitpradhānayoreva
sahābhidhānam-plakṣanyagrodhāviti | svārthikeṣu ca paprakṛtipratyayau
prakṛtyarthaṃ saha brūtaḥ-śuklatara iti; tathā ākhyāteṣu
kriyāpradhānamākhyātamiti; tathā 'kartari kṛt' 'kartari tṛtīyā',
tatra 'kṛtsu śaktimad dravyaṃ pradhānamucyate' iti kriyābhede
śaktyantarāvirbhāvaḥ; pācakaṃ paśyeti vibhaktiṣu
śaktiprādhānyam-ityādyanantaprakāramarthābhidhānamaśakyaṃ paribhāṣitumiti
lokata evārthāvagateḥ kathametadityāha-yairapītyādi ||
kālopasajane ca tulyam || 1|2|57 ||
arthasyānyapramāṇatvāditi | kathaṃ punarayamatra heturlabhyata
ityāha-tulyaśabdo hetvanukarṣaṇārtha iti kathametadityāha
--aśiṣyaviśeṣaṇaṃ caitaditi | caśabdo hetau | ānyāyyāditi |
rātreścaturddhā vibhaktāyāḥ paścime yāme nyāyyaṃ svāpādutthānam;
śāstrīyatvāt | prathame gate ca saṃveśanaṃ śayanam | atra lakṣaṇe
rātrermadhyayāmadvayaṃ nādyatanam, dvitīye tu tadapi |
ubhayato'rddharātramiti | bahuvrīhiḥ kṛtsno divasa āgāminyā rātreḥ
pūrvārdhenātītāyāḥ paścimārghena ca yukta ityarthaḥ | yadyevamiti |
yadyarthasyānyapramāṇatvādityayamevātrāpi heturityarthaḥ | pūrvasūtra
eveti | evaṃ hi tulyamiti na vaktavyaṃ bhavatīti bhāvaḥ ||
jātyākhyāyāmekasminbahuvacanamanyatarasyām || 1|2|58 ||
jātyākhyāyāmiti viṣayasaptamī | evamekasminnityapi vyadhikaraṇe
caite saptamyau | jātirnāmetyādinā sūtrārambhasya
kāraṇamāha-eko'rtha iti | yadyapi vaiśeṣikaparibhāṣitā saṃkhyā
jāterna vidyate, tasyā dravyadharmatvāt; tathāpi bhedagaṇanarūpā saṃkhyā
vidyata eva | yathoktam -- 
diṣṭiprasthasuvarṇādi mūrtabhedāya kalpate |
kriyābhedāya kālastu saṃkhyā sarvasya bhedikā || iti |
baiśeṣikāśca vyāvaharanti --pañca karmāṇi, catuviṃśatirguṇā iti |
jāterākhyeti | ākhyānamākhyāu pratyayanam | ekasminnartha iti |
jātyākhye bahuvacanaśabdo'yamanvartho na pāribhāṣikaḥ, uktirvacanam,
bahūnāṃ vacanaṃ bahuvacanam | tataścāyamarthaḥ -ekasminnarthe
bahūnāmuktirbhavatīti sāmarthyādvatyartho gamyate-bahūnāmivoktiḥ |
yadi ca jātyartho bahuvadbhavatīti bahūnāmivoktirbhavatīti
sāmarthyāt sa evārthaḥ saṃpadyata ityāha-jātyartho bahuvadbhavatīti |
tena kiṃ siddhaṃ bhavatītyāha -teneti | yadi tu jātiśabdādvahuvacanaṃ
jātyādi vidhīyeta, tato viśeṣaṇebhyaḥ saṃpannādibhyo na syāt,
teṣāmajātiśabdātvāditi bhāvaḥ |
devadata iti | yadyapi jātipadārthavādipakṣe hyatrāpyavasthābhedānugatā
jātiḥ śabdavācyā, tathāpīha sāmarthyādabhinnapiṇḍasamavetā
jātirāśrīyata ityanatideśaḥ | kāśyapa iti | kaśyapaśabdādvidādyañ,
tata ivārthe saṃjñāyāṃ kan 'lummanuṣye' | bhavatyayaṃ jātiśabda iti |
guṇabhūtāyā gotrajāterabhidhānāt | na tvanena jātirākhyāyata iti
| pradhānyeneti bhāvaḥ | asatyākhyāgrahaṇe jātau vartamānādityarthaḥ
syāt, tatra yathā vyaktiparyantābhidhāne gavādibhyo'pi bhavati,
evamatrāpi syāt | sati tu tasmiṃstatsāmarthyājjātiprādhānye bhavati |
vrīhiyavāviti | nanu ca yathā kāśikosalīyā iti janapadalakṣaṇo
vuñ vidhīyate, na ca janapadarūpaḥ samudāyo'vayavābhyāmārabhyate;
ato yatsvatantraṃ prātipadikaṃ na tajjanapadavāci, yajjanavadavāci na
tatsvatantraṃ prātipadikamiti kuto vuñaḥ prasaṅgaḥ ! ayaṃ tu
jātipratyāyane vidhirna jātiśabdāditi syādeva prasaṅgaḥ |
saṃkhyāprayoge iti | ekasyaiva bahutvātideśe kriyamāṇa
ekaśabdaprayoge'pi syāditi bhāvaḥ | ārabhyamāṇe'pyetasmin gotvaṃ
vrīhitvamityādi niṣkṛṣya jātyabhidhānenaivāyaṃ vidhiriṣyate |
vyaktiparyante tvabhidhāne jātivyaktyostādātmyaṃ sambandha iti
jātirūpeṇa vyaktīnāmabhidhāne ekavacanaṃ siddham | vyaktyātmanā tu
jāterabhidhāne bahuvacanamiti nārtho'nena ||
asmado dvayośca || 1|2|59 ||
'asmadaḥ' ityabhidheyasambandhena ṣaṣṭhītyāha--asmado yo'rtha iti |
pañcamyāṃ tu tatra vartamānasya tiṅntasya na syāditi bhāvaḥ | ekatve
dvitve ceti | nanu cāsmatacchabdaḥ pratyagātmani vartate, sa caikastasya
kathaṃ dvitvayogaḥ, ekatvamapi tasyāyuktaṃ viśeṣaṇam, avyabhicārāt ?
ucyate; yadā'nyatrātmatvamadhyāropyate-ayaṃ me dvitīya ātmeti, yadā
vā 'tyadādīni sarvairnityam' iti ekaśeṣaḥ kriyate, tadā
sambhavatyanekārthatvam | atha yatraivāsmacchabdo bahuvacanāntaḥ
prayujyate, tatra kathaṃ dvitvaikatvaviśeṣāvasāyaḥ,
prakaraṇādārācchabdasyeva dūrāntikayoḥ | ahamiti |
'ṇeóprathamayoram', 'tvāhau sau' | vayamiti |
'maparyantasya','yūyavayau jasi', śeṣe lopaḥ' | āvāmiti |
'yuvāvau dvivacane', 'prathamāyāśca dvivacane' ityātvam |
saviśeṣaṇasyeti | 'tvaṃ rājā
vayamapyupāsitaguruprajñābhimānonnatāḥ' ityatronnatatvameva vidhīyate
| na ca vidheyo'rtho viśeṣaṇamiti atideśo bhavatyeva |
yuṣmadīti | bhāṣyavārtikayorapaṭhitamapi
śiṣṭaprayogadarśanātpaṭhitam ||
phalgunīproṣṭhadānāṃ ca nakṣatre || 1|2|60 ||
cakāra ityādi | kecidāhuḥ--jyotiṣāmāvasthikī nakṣatratā
candrayoge sati bhavati, anyadā tu jyotiṣṭvameva | candrayogaśca
dvayoḥ samuditayoriti dvayoreva bahuvacane siddhe cakāreṇa
dvayorityanukarṣannācāryo jñāpayati--nakṣatragrahaṇaṃ jyotiṣa
upalakṣaṇamiti | upalakṣitajyotiṣṭvamekaikasyāpyastīti
ekanivṛtyarthaṃ dvayorityanukarṣaṇīyamiti |
tatrocyate--satyapyekaikasya jyotiṣṭve na tatra phalgunīśabdo
vartate, evaṃ proṣṭhapadādiśabda udbhūtāvayavabhedaḥ samudāya eva
tābhyāmucyate | ata eva 'cchandasi punarvasvorekavacanam'
'viśākhayośca' iti sūtrārambhaḥ | nakṣatraśabdaśca nighaṇṭuaṣu
tārakāparyāya eva paṭhitaḥ | vede'pi 'nakṣatrebhiḥ pitaro dyāmapaṃśan'
'tvaṃ nakṣatrāṇāṃ medhyasi citram' 'nakṣatreṇa yuktaḥ kālaḥ' ityatra
vṛttikāro vakṣyati-'kathaṃ punarnakṣatreṇa puṣyādinā kālo yujyate'
iti, tadapyanupapannam; āvasthike nakṣatrarūpe puṣyādibhiryosya
kādācitkatvāt | 'tiṣyapunarvasvoḥ' ityatra ca uditau
tiṣyādibhiryogasya kādācitkatvāt | 'tiṣyapurvasvoḥ' ityatra ca
uditau tiṣyapunarvasū dṛśyete | itthaṃ candrayoge'pyudāhariṣyate |
pratyudāharaṇe ca jyotiḥsvabhāvamevārthaṃ darśayati-tiṣyapunarvasavo
māṇavakā iti, tasmānnāyaṃ vṛttikārasya pakṣaḥ--āvasthikī nakṣatrateti |
jyotirmātravacana evāyam | cakāreṇa
dvayorityasyānukarṣaṇamapi--udbhūtāvayavabhedaḥ
samudāyo'bhidhīyate, na tvekaikaṃ jyotiriti pradarśanārtham |
proṣṭapadānāmiti saptamyarthe ṣa,ṭhī, nakṣatre iti vā ṣaṣṭha|lrthe
saptamītyāha-phalgunyordvayorityādi | nakṣatrayoriti
pratyekamabhisambaddhyate | sūtre tu vyatyayenaikavacanam |
atrāpyarthasya bahutvātideśa iti viśeṣaṇasyāpi bhavati | pūrve
phalgunyāviti | phalgunībhyāṃ phalgunībhirvā yuktaḥ kāla iti aṇ,
'lubaviśeṣe','lupi yuktavadvyaktivacane' |
phalgunyau māṇavike iti | phalgunyorjāte 'phalgunyaṣāḍhābhyāṃ ṭānau
vaktavyau' iti ṭapratyayaḥ, 'ṭiḍḍhāṇañ' iti ṅīp ||
cchandasi punarvasvorekavacanam || 1|2|61 ||
dvayordvivacane prāpta iti | pūrvasūtre cānukṛṣṭasya
dvayorityasyehānanuvṛtāvapi
punarvasuśabdenodbhūtāvayavabhedasya jyotirdvayasya
samudāyasyābhidhānād dvayorevāyaṃ vidhiriti darśayati ||
viśākhayośca || 1|2|62 ||
kimartho yogavibhāgaḥ ? iha cakāreṇa cchandasautyanuvartayiṣyāmīti
tenotaratra 'cchandasi' iti nānuvartate |
tiṣyapunarvasvaurnakṣatradvandve bahuvacanasya dvivacanaṃ nityam ||
1|2|63 ||
tiṣyapunarvasvauḥ ityanenaiva sūtreṇa dvicanāpekṣayā
saptamīdvivacanam | nakṣatradvandve iti satsaptamīḥ; nakṣatradvandve sati
tiṣyapunarvasvorarthayordvayorivoktirbhavatīti dvandvāpekṣayā
ṣaṣṭhīdvivacanaṃ vā | teṣāṃ dvandva iti | atra tacchabdād dvivacanaṃ na
bhavati, vākyasya prastutatvādadvandvārthavṛttitvād | atra
pāribhāṣikayordvivacanabahuvacanayorgrahaṇe bahuvacanasya
dvivacanamādeśaḥ syāt | tatra jasādeśe prathamādvivacane 'jasi ca' iti
guṇaḥ syāt, viśeṣaṇānāṃ ca na syāditi matvāha-bahuvacanasya
prasaṅga iti | bahūnāmarthānāmuktiprasaṅga ityarthaḥ | dvivacanaṃ bhavati
| dvayorivoktirbhavatītyarthaḥ |
tiṣyapunarvasavo māṇavakā iti | tiṣyapunarvasuśabdābhyāṃ nakṣatraṇo
lupi jātārthe sandhivelādisūtreṇāaṇ, tasya
'śraviṣṭāphalgunyanurādhā' ityādinā luk | nātra dvandvo nakṣatre
vartate, kiṃ tarhi ? māṇavakeṣu | tatrāpi na gauṇaḥ; yogaparamparayā
vṛteḥ | paryāyāṇāmapīti |
punarnakṣatragrahaṇasāmarthyādarthasyaivāyamanapekṣitopātaśabdāsyātideśo bhavati, tena paryāyāṇāmapi grahaṇaṃ siddhyati |
dvandva iti kimiti | tiṣyaśca punarvasūceti vākye
samāse'pyutarapadārthapradhāne bahutvaṃ na sambhavati, tādṛśaḥ samāsaśca
na sulabhaḥ, bahuvrīhiśca na sambhavati vyadhikaraṇatvāt, 'saṃkhyāpūrvo
dviguḥ' apyapūrvo'vyayapūrvaḥ, avyayībhāvaścāsambhāvya eveti dvandva eva
bhaviṣyatīti manyate | yastiṣya ityādi | avayavena vigrahe
udbhūtāvayavabhedaḥ samudāyajha samāsārthaḥ | unmugdhāḥ
puruṣāstadāha-tiṣyādaya eveti | kvicitu ime tiṣyapunavasavo
magadhā iti paṭha|lte, tatrāpi vaikṛtyavacanāmuheḥ kartari ktaḥ,
aviviktā ityarthaḥ | ṛtavo muhyantīti yathā | nakṣatrasamāsa evāyamiti |
samudāyasamudāyinorabhedāditi bhāvaḥ | sarvo dvandva iti | nanu ca
ekavadbhāvaprakaraṇe prāṇyaṅgādīnāṃ samāhāra eva dvandvaḥ,
dadhi-payāadaunāmitaretarayoga eveti niyama āśritaḥ; tataśca
tasmin prakaraṇe'nupātānām 'cāthedvandvaḥ' ityeva
samāhāretaretarayogayordvandvasiddhaḥ, kiṃ jñāpakopanyāsena ?
satyam; viparīto'pi niyamaḥ sūtre
sambhāvyeta--prāṇyaṅgādīnāmeva samāhāra iti |
tasmādvahuvacanagrahaṇena prāṇyaṅgādīnāṃ niyamyatvaṃ jñāpyate |
vṛkṣādivibhāṣāprayojanaṃ tatraiva vakṣyāmaḥ ||
sarūpāṇāmekaśeṣa ekavibhaktau || 1|2|64 ||
samānaṃ rūpaṃ yeṣāmiti sarūpā iti | 'jyotirjanapada' ityādinā
samānasya sabhāvaḥ | 'saha rūpeṇa vartanta iti sarūpāḥ' iti tu na
bhavati; vyabhicārābhāvāt | rūpaśabdaścaiha śrotragrāhyae śabdasambandhini
svarūpe vartate, na cakṣurgrāhyae śuklādau;
śabdānuśāsanaprastāvātadāha--sarupāṇāṃ śabdānāmiti | nirdhāraṇe
caiṣā ṣaṣṭhī, samudāyāpekṣayā vā |
atra pañca pakṣāḥ sambhavanti | samānaparyāya ekaśabdaḥ 'tenaikadik'
itivat | samiantvaṃ ca bhedādhiṣṭhānamiti pṛthak sarvebhyaḥ
samānāyāṃ vibhaktau parata ekaḥ śiṣyata iti prathamaḥ | 'dvandve' iti
vartate, tatra virūpeṣu sāvakāśamapi dvandvamekaśeṣo na
bādhte,nimitatvāt; sarūpāṇāṃ dvandve kṛte samāsādekasyāṃ
vibhaktau parata iti dvitīyaḥ | atra pakṣe saḍkhyāvācyekaśabdaḥ | 'hrasvo
napuṃsake' ityataḥ 'prātipadikasya' iti vartate, ekavibhaktāviti
sārūpyopalakṣaṇam | ekavibhaktau yāni sarūpāṇi dṛṣṭāni teṣāṃ
prātipadikānāmevānaimitika ekaśeṣa iti tṛtīyaḥ | vibhaktiśabdaḥ
kārakaśaktivacanaḥ, vibhajyate'nayā prātipadikārtha iti kṛtvā;
ekasminkārake vivakṣiktiṃ prasūta iti ; pṛthag vibhaktyantānāmekaśeṣa
iti caturthaḥ | sarūpasamudāyādekasyāṃ vibhaktau parata iti pañcamaḥ |
tatrādye pakṣe-vṛkṣas vṛkṣas vṛkṣas iti sthite pūrvayornivṛtau s
s vṛkṣas iti sthine madhyasambandhinaḥ sorhalṅyādilope
taditarayoḥ śravaṇaprasaṅgaḥ | evamādyantayorapi nivṛtau draṣṭavyam |
parayordvayornivṛtāvapi śiṣyamāṇasambandhino lopapāsiddhireva |
godau varaṇā ityādau ca pṛthag dvivacanayoḥ parata ekaśeṣe tayoḥ
śravaṇaprasaṅgaḥ | yatra hi pratyayanimitā prakṛtinivṛttistatra
kevalasyāpi pratyasya prayogo bhavatyeva, yathā--iyāniti |
dvitīye tu--aśva aśva au iti sthite
vibhaktyapekṣāccheṣātpūrvamantaraṅgatvātsamāsāntodātatve kṛte
yadi pūrvaśeṣaḥ sarvānudātaṃ padaṃ syād paraśeṣe tu
aśvaśabdāntodātaḥ syāt, iha ca ṛkca ṛkca ṛcau antaraṅgatvāt
'ṛkpūrabdhūḥ' iti samāsānte kṛte vibhakterakāreṇa
vyavadhānānnaikaśeṣaḥ syāt | samāsānto hi samāsagrahaṇena
gṛhyamāṇastameva na vyavadadhyāt, sarūpaṃ tu vyavadadhātyeva |
ekagrahaṇaṃ vānarthakam, na hi dvandvādyaugapadanekā vibhaktiḥ sambhavati |
yadi punarekavibhaktāvityetadakṛtvā dvandvakriyānantaramevaikaśaṣa
ityucyeta, evamapi pādau pādā ityādau dvivacanabahuvacane na
syātām ; prāṇyaṅgādīnāṃ samāhāra iva dvandva iti niyamād |
tṛtīye tu pakṣe jananīvacano yo mātṛśabdaḥ, yaśca 'māṅ māne'
ityasmātṛci dhānyamātṛvacanaḥ, tayorapi mātā mātṛbhyām iti
kvacidvibhaktau sarūpatvātsarvatraikaśeṣaprasaṅgaḥ | tathā
haritaśabdādvarṇādanudātāditi ṅībnakārayoryo harīṇīśabdaḥ
sampadyate, yaśca hariṇaśabdājjātilakṣaṇe ṅīṣi, tayorna syāt;
ṅyantayoḥ sārūpye'pi prātipadikāvasthāyāmasārūpyāt |
caturthe tu nivartamānaḥ śabdo yadyapi saha vibhaktyā nivartate,
śiṣyamāṇasya tvekavacanaśravaṇaprasaṅgaḥ |
ataḥ pañcamaṃ pakṣamāśrityāha--sarūpāṇāṃ śabdānāmekavibhaktau parata iti
| sarūpasamūdāyādekasyāṃ vibhaktau parata ityarthaḥ | nanu
'ṅyāpprātipadikāt' ityekavacanāntānāṃ dvandvaḥ, tatra caikatvaṃ
vivakṣitam, tatkathaṃ prātipadikasamudāyādvibhaktiḥ ? astu pratyekaṃ
prātipadikatvam, samudāyo'pi tvarthavatvātprātipadikam, kaḥ punaḥ
samudāyasyārthaḥ ? parasparasambandhaḥ, ekaikena viśakalito'rtha ucyate |
samudāyena tu sambandhaḥ tulyajātīyasya cārthavatsamudāyasya
samāsagrahaṇena nivṛttiḥ | kaśca tulyajātīyaḥ ? yatra pūrvo bhāgaḥ
padam | na cātraivamiti samudāyādvibhaktiraviruddhā | sā
tvanudbhūtāvayavabhedatvād dvivacanaṃ bahuvacanaṃ vā, na
tvekavacanam | nāvau janāvau
kartārāvityādāvacparatvādāvādiṣvapi kṛteṣu virūpāṇāmapi
samānārthatvādekaśeṣaḥ | śeṣaśabdo'yaṃ nāgarāje anante apradhāne
taupayuktādanyatra ca na vartate, kiṃ tarhi ? nivṛttimadavasthāna
ityāha-ekaḥ śiṣyate itare nivartante iti | nanvasmin pakṣe
ekagrahaṇamanarthakam, na hi samudāyadyaugapadenekā vibhaktiḥ sambhavati ?
ucyate, asatyekagrahaṇae pṛthak sarvebhyo vibhaktau parata iti
prathamo'pi pakṣaḥ sambhāvyeta | ato yatra pakṣa ekaiva vibhaktiḥ sarūpāṇāṃ
sambhavati sa evaikagrahaṇādā śrīyate | atha vā caturthe pakṣe granthaḥ-kathaṃ
tarhi vibhaktau parata iti, na hi kārakaśaktyā śabdānāṃ paurvāparyaṃ
bhavati, ucyate; iṣṭavācī paraśabdaḥ ekasyāṃ vibhaktāviṣyāyāṃ
ekasminkārake vivakṣita iti yāvat | nanu
coktam-śiṣyamāṇasyaikavacanaśravaṇaprasaṅga iti, na vedānīṃ
nivartamānasaṅkhyāveśādupajāyamāne dvitvabahutve
dvivacanabahuvacane upajanayitumutsahete,
pratyayāntatvenāprātipadikatvāt, naiṣa doṣaḥ;
sahavivakṣāyāmekaśeṣaḥ | kā punaḥ sahavivakṣā ? uktamatra-
anudbhūteva bhedānāmekā prakhyopajāyate |
yadā sahavivakṣāṃ tāmāhurdvandvaikaśeṣayoḥ || iti |
ayamarthaḥ--yadā bahavo'rthā ekasyāṃ buddhau upārūḍhāḥ,
yathā--puro'vasthitasya hastasya pañcāṅgulayaḥ, te caikasminguṇe
kriyāyāṃ vā tathaiva viniyujyante-śobhanā iti vā, dṛśyanta iti vā,
tadā sahavivakṣā | tathā hi-ātmano yā buddhistāṃ paratra saṃkramayituṃ
prayoktrā śabdaḥ prayujyata iti | yadi cāvayavāḥ pṛthak
pṛthagavadhāritāḥ syuḥ, yathā vātāyanagatena krameṇa gacchantaḥ tato
bhinnaireva śabdaiḥ pratyakaṃ paryavasāyibhirekavacanāntairabhidhīyateran
| samudāyākārā tvanusyūtāvayavabhaidaikā buddhiḥ tāṃ paratra
saṅkramayitumiticchatā tadanurūpaṃ śabdaḥ prayoktavyaḥ | na ca
tādṛśasya samudāyasyāsādhāraṇaḥ
kaścicchabdo'sstītyavayavaśabdairevāsau pratipādyaḥ | upapadāyte
cāvayavaśabdairevābhidhānām; samudāyasamudāyinorabhedāt | sa
caikaika evāvayavaśabda udbhūtāvayavabhedasamudāyapratipādānād
dvivacanānto bahuvacanānataśca pravartata iti naikavacanaśravaṇaprasaṅgaḥ
| yadyevam, ekenaivāvayavaśabdena tādṛśasya samudāyasyābhidhātuṃ
śakyātvānna yāvadavayavaśabdaprayogaprasaṅgaḥ |
atha matam-anyo'nyasannidhāveva samudāyarūpārthābhidhānaśaktiḥ
prādurbhavati, kathaṃ tarhi ekaṣeṣārambhe ekasya sā bhavati, na hi
sato'satī śaktirekaśeṣavacanena kartuṃ śakyate ? ucyate;
virūpeṣvanyo'nyasannidhāne samudāyārthābhidhānaśaktiḥ prādurbhavati |
paṭuaguptāvityatrāpi hyudbhūtāvayavabhedaṃ samudāyaṃ
pratipādayitumavayavaśabda eva pratyekaṃ dvivacanāntaḥ pravartate, anyathā
dvivacanabahuvacanāyogātsvārthamātraparyavasāyibhiravayavaśabdaiḥ
krameṇaivoccaraṇādartho'pi pratīyate | krameṇa cānekārthapratītau
dvivacanabahuvacane na bhavataḥ | samuccayaśca bhavati, tadyathā vākya- -
paṭuaśca guptaśceti | ato virūpeṣvevaṃ darśanātsarūpeṣvapi
dvandvāśaṅkāyāṃ sarūpeṣvekasyaivānekārthapratipādanaśaktirastīti
vacanena vyutpādyate |
anye tu tṛtīyamapi pakṣaṃ granthārūḍhṃa varṇayanti | sarūpāṇāṃ
śabdānāmekavibhaktau parata ekaśeṣo bhavati; ekavibhaktau parataḥ
sarūpāṇāmityanvaḥ, na tvekaśeṣa iti | ekasminkārake vivakṣite,
ekavibhaktau vā parato ye sarūpā dṛṣṭāḥ śabdāsteṣāmityarthaḥ | tatra ca
śiṣyamāṇa eva nivartamānasyāpyarthamācaṣṭe | agniciditi
pratyayanivṛtau prakṛtivaditi dvivacanabahuvacane yathāyogaṃ bhavataḥ |
tatra yaduktam-haritahariṇayarṅyantayorna syāditi, tanna;
prātipadikagrahaṇaṃ nānuvartate, tena ṅyantayoheva sārūpyād
bhaviṣyati | yadapyuktam-mātṛśabdayoḥ prasaṅga iti,
arthavipratiṣedhānna bhaviṣyati | kṛte hyaekaśeṣe tābhirityanuprayoge
punartho na gamyate, tairityukte stryarthaḥ | vakṣyamāṇasya vā
evakārasyehānukarṣaṇādekavibhaktau yāni
sarūpāṇyevetyāśrayaṇātparicchetṛvācinaśca 'aptṛntṛc' iti
sarvanāmasthāne dīrghavidhānādasārūpyādekaśeṣābhāvaḥ | atra pakṣe
ekagrahaṇaṃ cintyaprayojanam | tadevaṃ pañcasu pakṣeṣu trayaḥ svīkṛtāḥ
|
vṛkṣaśca vṛkṣaśceti | 'anaimitika ekaśeṣaḥ ' iti pakṣe vibhaktau
sārūpyaṃ darśayituṃ vibhaktyantena vigrahaḥ | kathaṃ punarvigrahaḥ, yāvatā
ekaśeṣavṛttirnityā ? naitadvṛtyā samānārthavākyam, pratyekamatra
vivakṣā | ātaśca pratyekam; yato'tra bhedanibandhena
samuccayaścaśabdena dyotyate, bhinnārthamapi kiñcinmātrāsādharmyādvākyaṃ
bhavatyeva | samānārthantu bādhyata eva, yathā-vṛkṣau ca vṛkṣau vṛkṣāśca
vṛkṣāśca vṛkṣā iti | nanu yadyetāvadekārthābhiniveśinaḥ
śabdāḥ--ākāśadravyatvagotvādayaḥ, na teṣu
dvivacanabahuvacanenāpyekaśeṣaḥ; ye tvanekārthābhiniveśinaḥ--gauḥ
śuklaḥ, pācaka ityādayaḥ, teṣvanusyūtaṃ kiñcidarthagatamekaṃ
gotvādinimitaṃ vaktavyam; anyathā sambandhagrahaṇāsambhavādatra
gavādiṣu tadguṇatā jātirnimitaṃ na, yathā śuklādiṣvapi
guṇamātraniṣṭhaṣu | guṇaniṣṭheṣu tu svagatayā jātyā ekībhūto guṇaḥ
| evaṃ pācakādiṣvapi gotvāśvatve sāmānye, niḥ sāmyāni
sāmānyānītyatra bhinneṣvabhinnapratyayahetutvaṃ tāvetāvityādau
parokṣatvapratyakṣatvādikam |
abhāvāścatvāra ityatra nirūpākhyatvamityādi sarvatra draṣṭavyam |
nimitatadvatośca tādātmyam, sarvaṃ hi vastu ekaṃ nānā ca
gavādirūpeṇaikaṃ khaṇḍādi prātipadikarūpeṇa nānā | evaṃ sthite yadi
tāvajjātireva śabdārthastadā tasyā ekatvānnānekaśabdaprasaṅgaḥ |
athāpyubhayam, evamapi jātirūpeṇaiva śabdo dravyamabhidhate na
prātisvikenākāreṇeti nāstyanekaśabdaprasaṅgaḥ |
kevaladravyapadārthapakṣe'pi asminviṣaye'nekārthābhidhānasāmarthyaṃ
śabdasya dvyādipadavadabhyupagantavyam, anyathā satyapyekaśeṣe tanna
syāditi siddhamekaśabdatvam | dravyagatasaṅkhyāpratipādanāya
dvivacanabahuvacane bhaviṣyata; nārtha etenetyāśaṅkyāha --
pratyarthamityādi | ekaikasminnarthe yasmācchabdānāṃ niveśastato'nekena
śabdenānekasyābhidhānaṃ siddhyati | tatraivaṃ sthite'nekārthābhidhāne
kartavye yāvantaste'rthāstāvatāṃ śabdānāṃ prayogaḥ prāpnoti, iṣyate
caikaśabdatvam, tasmādekaśeṣa ārabhyate |
ayamabhiprāyaḥ--kevalaṃ jātipakṣe akṣāḥ pādāḥ māṣā ityādau
anekaśabdatvaṃ syād, na hi bibhītakadevanaśakaṭākṣeṣvanusyūtaṃ
kiñcitsāmānyamasti | ata eva tatra vyutpattirbhedenāpekṣyate,
evamubhayapakṣe'pi | kevaladravyapakṣe'pi vṛkṣaśceti
vākye'nekaśabdadarśanādvirūpeṣu dvandvadarśanāccārambhaṇīyametaditi |
rūpagrahaṇaṃ kimiti | antaraṅgatvādaheyatvādupadeśānapekṣatvācca
rūpakṛtameva samānatvaṃ grahīṣyate iti praśnaḥ | pratipatilāghavaṃ ca
samānānāmityucyamāne bhavati rūḍhiśabdatvena rūḍhiriti
tulyārthāvagamāt | rūpagrahaṇe tu
vartipadārthamavagamyānyapadārtho'vagantavya iti gauravaṃ bhavati |
bhinne'pyarthe iti | 'svaṃ rūpam' ityatra rūpagrahaṇena jñāpitaṃ śāstre
rūpavadartho'pi tantramiti | tataścārtharūpābhyāṃ samānatvaṃ gṛhyaeteti
bhāvaḥ |
ekagrahaṇaṃ kimiti | śeṣa ityekatvaṃ vivakṣyata iti praśnaḥ |
dvibahvoriti |dvitvabahutvaviṣayasyānekasya śabdasyetyarthaḥ | nanu
dvayorbahūnāṃ ceti bahuvacanaprasaṅgād iha śeṣavidhānadvāreṇa
saṃskriyamāṇatvācchiṣyamāṇaṃ pradhānam, pradhāne ca saṅkhyā na
vivakṣyate, yathā-grahaṃ saṃmārṣṭīti, viṣama upanyāsaḥ; saṃmārge
vidhau dvitīyānirdeśāt grahāḥ pradhānabhūtāḥ, saṃmārgastu teṣāṃ
saṃskāraḥ | saṃskāro nāma tasya bhavati yacchāstrāntare prayojanavatyāṃ
kriyāyāṃ sādhanatvena viniyuktam, saṃskṛtasya vā yasya viniyogaḥ,
dravyamātrasya rūpasaṃskāro'narthakaḥ syāt | yadiha saṃmārgasaṃkāro
vidhīyamānaḥ śāstrāntare viniyuktaṃ grahamapekṣate tatar navasaṅkyā
grahā śrutā iti tadapekṣaḥ saṃmārgavidhirnavānāmapi bhavitumarhati |
grahamityekavacanaṃ tu karmatvamātramabhidhāyakatārthaṃ bhaviṣyati | iha tu
śeṣasya vākyāntare'navadhāraṇādidamevotpativākyāmiti
vivakṣaṇīyā saṅkhyā, paśumālabhetetivat, satyam;
idamevaikagrahaṇaṃ jñāpakam-śāstrāntarānavagate'pi pradhāne saṅkhyā na
vivakṣyata iti, tena karturīpsitatamamityatra īpsitatamasya saṅkhyāyā
avivakṣā siddhā bhavati |
śeṣagrahaṇaṃ kimiti | sādhvanuśāsanaprakramātsarūpāṇāmekaḥ
sādhurbhavatīti vijñāsyata iti bhāvaḥ | ādeśo mā bhūditi | asati
hi śeṣagrahaṇe 'ṣaṣṭhī sthāne yogā' iti vacanāt sthānaṣaṣṭhī syāt,
tataścādeśaḥ syād, astu; śabdato'rthataścāntaratamo bhaviṣyati ?
naivaṃ śakyam, svare hi doṣaḥ syād dvayoraśvaśabdayoḥ samudāyaḥ
sthānī, tatra ca dvāvudātāviti dvyudāta ādeśaḥ syādetena
dvyanudātatvaṃ vyākhyātam |
ekavibhaktāviti kimiti | nānāvibhaktau vairūpyamavaśyaṃbhāvīti bhāvaḥ
| payaḥ paya iti | ekavibhaktāvityasminnasati sarūpāṇāṃ sarvatra saha
prayogo na syād | atha kriyamāṇe'pyasminnanaimitikapakṣe
kasmādevātra na bhavati, etadapi hyaekasyāṃ vibhaktau parataḥ sarūpaṃ
dṛṣṭameva ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; ekagrahaṇamasminpakṣe atiricyata ityuktam,
tatsāmarthādekasyāmeva vibhaktau viṣayabhūtāyāṃ bhaviṣyati | atra tu
satyekaśeṣe paryāyeṇa vibhaktiḥ syāt |
atha vā-kiṃ na etena pakṣeṇa kleśato vyākhyeyena ? stāṃ dvāveva pakṣau
? iha ekaśceti saṅkhyāśbadānāmekaśeṣo na bhavati, anibhidhānād |
viṃśatyādīnāṃ tu bhavatyeva ||
vṛddho yūnā tallakṣaṇaścedeva viśeṣaḥ || 1|2|65 ||
vṛddhaśabdo'yaṃ loke carame vayasi prasiddhaḥ,yuvaśabdo dvitīye,
tayoriha grahaṇe taruṇaśca vṛddhaśca yuvā ca sthaviraścetyādau syāt |
'vṛddhiryasyācāmādistadvṛddham''jīvati tu vaṃśye yuvā'- -anayoḥ
śāstrīyayorgrahaṇe aupagavaścānantara aupagaviśca yuvetyādāvapi
syāt | ato yuvaśabdasya tāvatkṛtrimasya vyavahitāpatyavācino'tra
grahaṇam, tatsāhacaryādvṛddhaśabdasyāpi vyavahitāpatyavācinaḥ
śāstrāntare prasiddhasya grahaṇamityāha--vṛddhaśabda ityādi | gotragrahaṇe
tvapatyādhikārādanyatra laukikasya grahaṇamityapatyamātrasya grahaṇaṃ
syāt | kvacitpunaradhiko'pi granthaḥ paṭha|lte--yūneti sahayoga
eṣā tṛtīyeti | sa idānīntanaiḥ prakṣiptaḥ, yūnā saha vacana iti
sahaśabdaṃ prayuñjānaḥ sūtre sahayoge tṛtīyeti darśayati | ata eva
jñāpyate-sahavivakṣāyāmekaśeṣa iti | viśeṣo vairūpyamiti | śabdasya
vṛddhayuvanimitasya grahaṇānnānya iti bhāvaḥ | padārthaṃ darśayitvā
tadayamartha ityāha-vṛddhayuvanimitakamevetyādi |
samānāyāmākṛtāviti | ākṛtiḥ śabdasya pravṛttinimitaṃ
gargāpatyatvādi | kvacitu prakṛtāviti pāṭhaḥ, prakṛtiḥ
mūlaprakṛtirgargaśabdādiḥ | gārgyaścetyādi | gargavatsaśabdābhyāṃ
gargāditvādyañantābhyāṃ yūni 'yañiñośca' iti phak |
gārgyāyaṇāviti | prakaraṇādinātra jīvadvaṃśyatāvasāyaḥ; śabdasya
gotradvayasyāpi sādhāraṇatvād |
yadyevam, gārgyaśca gārgyaśceti gotraśabdayoreva
pūrveṇaikaśeṣo'sti prakaraṇādinaiva yuvatvamanyatarasya gaṃsyate |
yūno hi dvāvākārau-jīvadvaṃśyatvam, pautraprabhṛtyapatyatvaṃ ca; tatra
viśeṣāvivakṣāyāṃ sāmānyaśabdo na nivartate, yathā-vastuto
bhūtānadyatane'pi 'abhūnnṛpo vibudhasakhaḥ' iti luṅ bhavati,
tasmānnārtha etena ? ucyate; prakaraṇānapekṣeṇa śabdena jīvadvaṃśyatvaṃ
pratipādayitukāmo dvandvaṃ prayuñjīta gārgyāyaṇāviti | ato
dvandvanivṛtyarthaṃ vacanam | pratyudāharaṇe tu sarvatra dvandvo
bhavati--gārgyavātsyāyanāviti | nanvatra viśeṣāntarasadbhāve'pi
tallakṣaṇo viśeṣo vidyata iti syādekaśeṣaḥ, naiṣa doṣaḥ;
evamarthavacanaṃ vyajyate-yo'sau viśeṣo yasya
sadbhāvātpūrveṇāpaprāptiḥ, sa tallakṣaṇaścediti | evaṃ ca
yāvaduddeśyaṃ vidheyasambandhāt sūtrārambhahetubhūtasya kṛtsnasya
viśeṣasya tallakṣaṇatvavidhānāt kuto'tra prasaṅgaḥ ! iha tu
prāpnoti--bhāgavitibhāgavitikāviti, kṛtsnasya viśeṣaṇasya
tallakṣaṇatvāt ? evakāreṇa tu vyāvartyate, na hyatra tallakṣaṇa eva
viśeṣastadāha--kutsā sauvīratvaṃ cāparo viśeṣa iti |
viśeṣaheturityarthaḥ ||
strī puṃvacca || 1|2|66 ||
strītvasya vairūpyakāraṇasyādhikyādvacanaṃ puṃvacceti vakṣyāmīti ca |
atra strīśabdasya svaritve stryadhikāravihitānāṃ ṭābādīnāṃ
grahaṇādayamartho bhavati- puṃvat strīpratyayo na bhavati | yathā
puṃvadasyāstanāvityabhāvātideśastadvat | tataśca
strītvasyānivṛtatvād gārgyaśca striyo gārgyāyaṇaśca gargā ityatra
'yañañośca' iti lug na syāt | 'astriyām' ityadhikārāt
prasajyapratiṣedhe'yaṃ doṣaḥ | paryudāse tu śiṣyamāṇasya
nivartamānārthābhidhāyitvādisti strīsadṛśo'yaṃ doṣaḥ |ca
paryudāse tu śiṣyamāṇasya nivartamānārthābhidhāyitvādasti
strīsadṛśo'rthaṃ iti siddhyati | iha tu gargānpaśyeti
strītvasyānivṛtatvānnāyaṃ puṃsāṃ bahutve śas utpanna iti natvaṃ na
syāt | stryarthavṛteḥ śabdasya tu grahaṇe strīśabdasya puṃśabdasyeva
rūpaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ syāt | strītvaṃ tvanuvṛtameva | tatra yadyapi gargā
iti bahuṣu puṃśabdasya rūpamiti tasminnatidiṣṭe jasādiṣu na
doṣaḥ, natvaṃ tu vibhaktikāryaṃ na syāt | evaṃ stryarthagrahaṇe tu
pumarthātideśātatpratibaddhānāṃ kāryāṇāṃ siddhiriti na kaścid
doṣaḥ | strīti cokte'rtha eva pratiyate |
śabdānāmarthaparatvātsvarūpagrahaṇaṃ tvanāśaṅkyameva; vṛddho
yūnetyanuvartanād | ato'rthasyaiva grahaṇamityāha-stryarthaḥ
pumarthavadbhavatīti | gārgī cetyādi | gārgyavātsyaśabdābhyām |
'yañaśca' iti ṅīp | dākṣīti | 'ito manuṣyajāteḥ' dākṣī iti ṅīṣi
nivṛte iñantād dvicane 'prathamayoḥ' iti dīrghaḥ | itamapi
dvandvanivṛtyarthameva vacanam ||
pumān striyā || 1|2|67 ||
strīpuṃsalakṣaṇaścedeva viśeṣa iti | padāntaragamye'pi tallakṣaṇe
viśeṣe bhavati, yathā-gauścāyaṃ gauśceyamiti etau gāvau carata iti
| evaṃ kanyākhukṛkavākugrāmaṇīkhalapūprabhutiṣu puṃsaḥ śeṣo
veditavyaḥ | iha kasmānna bhavati-haṃsaśca varaṭā ca kacchapaśca
ḍuliṣvaruśyaśca rohicca aśvaśca vaḍavā ca puruṣaśca yoṣiṃcceti,
sarvatrāpyatra strīpuṃsakṛta eva viśeṣaḥ ? 'sarūpāṇām' iti vartate,
tena samānāyāṃ prakṛtau yatra strīpuṃsakṛta eva viśeṣastatraiva bhavati
| iha tu brāhmaṇavatsaśca brāhmaṇīvatsā cetyatra prāpnoti, naiṣa doṣaḥ'
strīpuṃsayoḥ sahavivakṣāyāmekaśeṣaḥ | sā ca pradhānayoreva bhavatīti
yatra pradhānastrīpuṃsakṛta eva viśeṣastatraivaikaśeṣaḥ, iha
tvapradhānakṛto'pītyekaśeṣābhāvaḥ | ihāpi
mṛgakṣīrādivajjātivivakṣāyāṃ kukkuṭāvityādi siddham |
dvandvanivṛtyarthantu vacanam | prāgityavyayamiti | prapūrvādañcateḥ
kvinnantādastāteḥ 'añcerluk' iti luki 'taddhitaścāsarvavibhaktiḥ'
ityavyayatvaṃ satvāsatvayordvandvaikaśeṣau cintyau ||
bhrātṛputrau svasṛduhitṛbhyām || 1|2|68 ||
idamapi dvandvanivṛtyarthaṃ vacanam | svasṛśabdasya hyaekāpatyatvaṃ
nimitam, duhitṛśabdasyāpatyatvameva | bhrātṛputraśabdayoḥ
strītvapuṃstvaṃ cobhayatra viśeṣaḥ | tatra 'bhrātarau putrau' iti
strīpuṃstvāvivakṣāyāṃ siddhaṃ svasṛduhitrorabhidhānam |
ekaśeṣārambhe'pyayameva nirvāhaḥ ||
napuṃsakamanapuṃsakenaikavaccāsyānyatarasyām || 1|2|69 ||
śuklā ca śuklaṃ ceti | vibhaktau vibhaktyantayoścāsārūpyādaprāpta
ekaśeṣaḥ, śuklaṃ ca śuklaśceti vibhaktyantayorasārūpyam |
vibhaktau sārūpye'pi puṃnapuṃsakayoḥ paryāyaḥ syāditi vacanam,
ekavadbhāvārthaṃ ca | tallakṣaṇaścedeva viśeṣa iti vartata iti | śuklaṃ
ca kṛṣṇaścetyatra mā bhūt | evākārastu himahimānyau
araṇyāraṇyānyāvityatra mā bhūditi | 'atra himāraṇyayormahatve' iti
mahatvamaparo viśeṣaḥ, anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇamānantaryādekavaccetyanena
sambandhyate, na tvekaśeṣeṇa cetyāha-ekavaccetyādi | asya
grahaṇamekavaccetyasyotaratrānuvṛttirmā bhūditi | iha śuklena ca
vastreṇa śuklena ca kambalena tenānena śukleneti
tallakṣaṇaviśeṣābhāvādekaśeṣo na prāpnoti,
sāmānyavivakṣāyāmekaśabdatvamekavacanaṃ napuṃsakatvaṃ ca bhaviṣyati |
yadyepam, tadidaṃ śuklamityatrāpyevameva bhaviṣyati, nārtha etena ?
dvandvanivṛtyarthaṃ tu vacanam |
anapuṃsakeneti kimiti | napuṃsakenāpi sahavacane
sarūpāṇāmityekaśeṣeṇa bhavitavyamiti praśnaḥ, tena yathā syādenena
mā bhūditi pratyutaram | ko nvatra viśeṣa ityatra āha- ekavacceti ||
pitā mātrā || 1|2|70 ||
abhyarhitatvānmātuḥ pūrvanipātaḥ, 'piturdaśaguṇaṃ mātā
gauraveṇātiricyate' | pitarāvityabhidhānaṃ
janayitṛtvamātravivakṣāyāṃ liṅgāvivakṣāyāṃ samarthanīyam |
ekaśeṣārambhe'pi dvandvastviṣyata eveti nārtha etena ||
śvaśuraḥ śvaśrvā || 1|2|71 ||
pitṛśvaśurau mātṛśvakṣūbhyāmiti noktam, lāghavārtham |
śvaśrūśabdo'vyutpannaṃ prātipadikaṃ
śvaśurasyokārākāralopaścetyūṅntatve pratyayāntatvād
brahmabandhūrityādivadekadeśābhāvāccāprātipadikatve'pi
śvaśretyasmādeva nirdeśālliṅgāt supastaddhitāśca bhavanti |
śvaśrūśvaśurāviti | abhyarhitatvādeva pūrvanipātaḥ, 'śvaśrūḥ
pūrvajapatnī ca mātṛtulyā prakīrtitā' atrāpi
dampatyorjanayitṛtvamātravivakṣāyāṃ liṅgāvivakṣāyāṃ samarthanīyam
| anārambhapakṣe'pi śvaśrūśvaśurāvityabhidhāne dvandvastviṣyata veti,
nārtha etena ||
tyādādīni sarvaurnityam || 1|2|72 ||
sarvaśabdasyārthamāha--tyadādibhiranyaiśceti | etadeva prakaṭayati -
sarvagrahaṇamiti | tyādibhiranyaiśceti | yadidaṃ sākalyamuktaṃ
tadarthamityarthaḥ; anyathā pratyāsateḥ 'tallakṣaṇaścedeva viśeṣaḥ'
ityadhikārādvā tyadādibhireva sahavacane syāditi bhāvaḥ | sa ca
devadataśceti | nanu devadato'pi sāmānyavivakṣāyāṃ tacchabdenaiva
nirdeaṣṭuṃa śakyate, tataśca sarūpāṇāmityeva siddham | na cārabdhe'pi
sūtre vṛtau viśeṣo'ntarbhāvayintuṃ śakyaḥ, tāvityasya
sarūpasādhāraṇatvādvirūpāṇāṃ ca nānāvidhātvāt, satyam;
taddevadatāvityādidvandvanivṛtyarthaṃ vacanam, anyathā 'tatputrastadīyaḥ'
ityādivṛtyantaravad dvandvo'pi syāt |
yadyatparamiti | tyadādipāṭhe śabdaparavipratiṣedhāśrayaṇāditi bhāvaḥ |
sa ca yaśca yāvityādi | bhāṣye tu 'pūrvaśeṣaḥ khalvapi dṛśyate - sa ca
yaśca tau' ityuktam | iha cāhaṃ ca bhavāṃścāvāmiti bhavatītyāhuḥ |
tyadāditaḥ śeṣe puṃnapuṃsakato liṅgavacanāni | ādyāditvātasiḥ,
tyadādīnāṃ śeṣe saha vivakṣito yo'rthaḥ pumān, yacca napuṃsakaṃ
tadvaśena liṅgavacanāni bhavantītyarthaḥ | sa ca devadata ca tau, sā ca
devadataśca tau, tacca devadatā ca te | puṃnapuṃsakayostu
sahavivakṣāyāṃ paratvānnapuṃsakavaśena vyavasthā | tacca devadataśca te,
iha sa ca kukkuṭaḥ sā ca mayūrī - kukkuṭamayūryāvete, ardhaṃ
pippalyāstad ardhaṃpippalī ca sā ardhaṃpippalyau te iti
paravalliṅgamiti samāsārthasya liṅgātideśātadviśeṣaṇasyāpi
sarvanāmnastadeva liṅgaṃ bhavati ||
grāmyapaśusaṃgheṣvataruṇeṣu strī || 1|2|73 ||
grāme bhavā grāmyāḥ | 'grāmādyakhañau' | puṃsaḥ śeṣe prāpta iti |
'pumān striyā' ityanena | sāmarthyāditi | pradhānasya saṃghasya
tāruṇyātāruṇye na sambhavata ityasmātsāmarthyād guṇabhūtānāmapi
paśūnāṃ viśeṣaṇamityarthaḥ |
etau gāvāviti | yadyapi dvayorapi saṃgho bhavatyeva, tathāpīha
saṃghagrahaṇasāmarthyāṃdvahūnāṃ saṃgho gṛhyate, anyathā
śeṣasyānekaviṣayatvād anarthakaṃ na syāt |
anekaśapheṣviti | śaphāḥ u khurāḥ | uṣṭrāṇāṃ
tvāraṇyatvādekaśeṣābhāvaḥ ||

iti śrīharadatadamiśraviracitāyāṃ padamañjaryo prathamasyādhyāyasya 
dvitīyaḥ pādaḥ samāptaḥ ||
| | |atha prathamādhyāye tṛtīyaḥ pādaḥ
padamañjarī
bhūvādayo dhātavaḥ|| 1|3|1 ||
"bhū" ityevamādayaḥ śabdā ityanena pāṭhanibandhaneyaṃ saṃjñeti
darśayati| yadi tvanāddatya, pāṭhām, kriyāvacano dhāturityucyeta,
tata āṇaveduityādiṣvapi syāt| kathaṃ
punarapabhraṃśānāmanuśāsanamāśaṅkyate? kuto tu khalvetad
āṇavedvityādayo'pabhraṃśā iti, yāvatā ye śāstreṇānugamyante te
sādhavaḥ? avaśyaṃ cātubandhādiviśiṣṭṃa rūpaṃ pāṭhenaiva darśanīyam, na
hi tadrūpaṃ prayoge sambhavati| ato'nyārthaḥ san gaṇapāṭha evāśrito
bhavatīti dhātutve sati laḍ bhavati| edhate, sparddhate ityanudātetau|
yadi pāṭhamātranibandhaneyaṃ saṃjñā, yā-vā-div-śabdānāṃ
sarvanāmavikalpasvargavācināṃ samānaśabdānāmapi prasaṅgaḥ? na ca
prāpaṇādi rartho niyāmakaḥ, anārṣatvād,
abhiyuktairutarakālanirdiṣṭatvād, anekārthatvābhyupagamācca, satyam;
saṃjñāyāṃ ko doṣaḥ? na tāvaddhātupratyayānāṃ laḍādīnāṃ prasaṅgaḥ;
kartrādīnāmabhāvāt, icyate, yāḥ paśyeti ṭhāto dhātoḥ' iti lopaḥ
syāt| nanu adhātuḥ iti niṣedhād aprātipādikatvādvibhaktireva na
syāt, nautadasti;vibhaktāvutpannāyāṃ tyadādyatve ṭāpi ca yārūpatve
sati dhātutvam, subutpattidaśāyāṃ tu yadityasya nāsti dhātutvama;
vāśabdātu subeva na syāt; evaṃ divśabdādapi| na ca ṭhdiva
aut; ityetaddhātutvābhāve liṅgam; kkibantasya dīvyatiḥ supi
sambhavāt| sānubandhakatve'pi tasyaiva grahaṇaṃ syād, ataḥ
samānaśabdānāṃ pratiṣedho vaktavya ityata āha-dhātuśabda ityādi|
kkacitu ṭhbhū'ityevamādayaḥ śabdā ityasyānantaraṃ kriyāvācina iti
paṭha|lte, tasmin pakṣe yāsya granthasya śaṅkā sā tasya draṣṭavyā| asya
tu kathaṃ punaḥ sūtre'nupātaḥ kriyāvacana ityayaṃ viśeṣo labhyate? ata
āha-dhātuśabdaḥ pūrvācāryasaṃjñeti| tataḥ kimityāha- te ceti|
tato'pi kimityāha-tadihāpīti| mahatyāḥ pūrvācāryasaṃjñāyā
āśrayaṇaṃ tadīyopādhipari-grahārthameveti bhāvaḥ|| 
yāvitsiddhamasiddhaṃ vā sādhyatvenābhidhīyate|
āśritakramarūpatvāt sā kriyetyabhidhīyate||
siddhaṃ vā bhavatvasiddhaṃ vā, śabdena tu yadvastu sādhyatvenābhidhīyate
sā kriyā sādhyatve cāśritakramarūpatvāt pūrvāparībhūtāvayavatvaṃ
vitatarūpatvaṃ yatadrūpamabhidhīyate tasyaikasmin kṣaṇe'navasthānam,
yadāha-kriyā nāmeyam atyantāparihaṣṭa'śakyā ca sā piṇḍībhūtā
nidarśayitum iti| ekaikasya kriyākṣaṇasya pratyakṣatve'pi samūharūpā
dhātuvācyā kriyā na pratyakṣetyarthaḥ| kramavanta eva kṣaṇā ekaphalo ddeśena
saṃpādyāmānatvāt aikyamivāpannā dhātuvācyāḥ
tadyathā-pacatītyadhiśrayaṇādayo'dhaḥ śrayaṇāntāḥ kledanaphalāvacchinnāḥ|
evamapacadityatrāpi kriyā sādhyaiva| tāhaśasyaiva hi rūpasya tatrātyayaḥ
pratīyate yatpūrvāparībhūtaṃ kriyate| ghaṭa ityatra tu ghaṭaśabdena
cakrodaragato'pi ghaṭaḥ siddharūpa ucyate,ekasminneva kṣaṇe
yaddarśanayogyaṃ rūpaṃ tena rūpeṇetyarthaḥ| tadevaṃ kriyāvacano
dhāturityāśrayaṇādatiprasaṅgo nāstīti sthitam|
iha bhūrādiryaṣāmiti bahuvrīhau yaṇādeśe kṛte
ṭhbhūvādayaḥ'ityanupapanno nirdeśa ityata āha-bhūvādīnāṃ vakāro'yaṃ
maṅgalārtha iti| abhidhānadharmasyāpyabhidheye upacāraḥ, yathā-bhramare
dvirepha iti| bhūvādīnāṃ saṃjñīnāṃ sambandhī yo vakāraḥ,
tadabhidhāyini bhūvādiśabde sthito'yaṃ prayujyate, lakṣaṇenāprapto
nipātyata ityarthaḥ| sa ca maṅgalārthaḥ | apūrvasya lābho maṅgalam,
sādhuśabdaprayoge'pi dharmo bhavati, bhūvādiśabdaśca sādhuḥ| kiṃ ca
vakāre satyavikṛto bhūśabdo vyahṛtyādi smārayatītyapi dharmo
bhavatīti|
prakārāntaramāha-bhuvo vārthaṃ vadantīti| bhuvo dhātorarthaṃ vadantīti
vā, bhūvādaya iti nirdeśa ityarthaḥ| arthakathanaṃ caitad | vyutpattistu
bhavanaṃ bhūḥ, kriyāsāmānyabhuvaṃ vadantītyauṇādiko'yam,
ṭhvasivapiyajirājivrajisadihanivāśivādivāribhya iñ'iti kartari
vadeḥ iñ pratyayaḥ| yadi kriyāsāmānyaṃ ye vadanti te saṃjñinaḥ,
astibhavatividyatīnāmeva syād, na pa catyādīnāṃ viśeṣavācinām?
viśepakṣe gaṇapāṭhasāmarthyāt so'pyaṅgīkriyate, anyathā śabvikaraṇā
ye seṭo niranubandhakā antargaṇakāryavarjitā bhūprabhṛtayasteṣāṃ
pāṭho'narthakaḥ syād| bahuvīhestu bhūtvādiśabdasya
pṛṣodarāditvātsādhutvam| tṛtīyaṃ prakāramāha-bhvarthā vā vādayaḥ
smṛtā iti| bhavanaṃ bhūḥ so'rtho yeṣāṃ te bhvarthāḥ, evambhūtā vādayo
vātra saṃjñinaḥ smṛtā ityarthaḥ| kimidaṃ vādaya iti ? ṭhvā
gatigandhanayoḥ,' vā ādiryeṣāṃ te vādayaḥ vā gati ityārabhyā
curādisamāpteḥ| tathā ca bhvādayo vādayaḥ bhūprabhṛtaya ā ṭhvā
gatigandhanayoḥ' ityasmād| vādayaśca vādayaśca
bahuvrīhitatpuruṣayoḥ sahavivakṣāyāṃ svarabhinnānāṃ yasyotaraḥ
svaravidhiriti bahuvrīheḥ śeṣaḥ| tato bhuvo vādaya iti
vācyavācakasambandhe śeṣaṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| asminpakṣe
pāṭhaviśeṣo'rthaścetyubhayaṃ sūtrākṣarairevopātaṃ bhavati||
padamañjarī
upadeśe'janunāsika it|| 1|3|2 ||
upadiśyate'nenetyupadeśa iti| akartari ca kārake iti karaṇe ghañ |
nanu ca neyaṃ saṃjñā, paratvācca karaṇādhikaraṇayoḥ iti lyuṭ
prāpnoti, halaśca ityatrāpi saṃjñāyāmityeva| lyuṭ tāvanna bhavati,
kṛtyalyuṭo bahulam iti| akartari ca ityatra cakāro
bhinnakramaḥ-saṃjñāyāṃ ceti, tena kkacidasaṃjñāyāmapi bhavati|
athopadiśyate'nenetyatropadeśaḥ ko'rthaḥ? vidhānam| yadyevam laṇ
edha vṛddhau ityādau na syāt, na hyatra kiñcidvidhīyate|
athānirjñātasvarūpasya svarūpajñāpanaṃ tat,
ācāre'vagalbhaklībahoḍebhyaḥ kkip ityatra galbhādyakārasa na syāt na
hi galbhādīnāṃ svarūpajñāpanārthamuccāraṇam;pañcamīnirddeśena
kkipo vidhānāt| yadyevam, kkibanenānirjñātarūpo jñāpte, tatra
cāyaṃ bhavatyakāra iti bhaviṣyati| śāstravākyānīti|
laṇ-edha-sparddhetyādīnāmapi viśiṣṭaprayojanaparatvenoccāraṇād
vākyatvam| asyaiva vivaraṇam-sūtrapāṭha iti| khilapāṭhaḥudhātupāṭhaḥ
prātipadikapāṭhaḥ, vākyapāṭhaśca| tatra sūtre matubāderukāraḥ, dhātuṣu
edhādyakāraḥ prātipadikeṣu bhavacchabdasyokāraḥ,vākye galbhādyakāraḥ|
nanu ca sarvatrātra śuddho'c paṭha|lte, nānunāsika ityata
āha-pratijñānunāsikyā iti| pratijñāmātreṇa samadhigamyamānunāsikyaṃ
yeṣāṃ te tathoktāḥ| pratijñānunāsikā iti tu prasiddhaḥ pāṭhaḥ| tatra
pratijñāsamadhigamyatvād anunāsike pratijñāśabdo draṣṭavyaḥ| tataḥ
samānādhikaraṇapado bahuvrīhiḥ| tacca pratijñānaṃ nāniyamena bhavati,
ki tarhi? yatrācāryāḥ smaranti tatraiva| sūtrakāreṇa tāvadvivakṣitāḥ
sarve'nunāsikāḥ paṭhitāḥ, ḍulabhaÄṣ prāptau itivat, lekhakaistu
saṃkīrṇā likhitāḥ tatra smṛtiparamparayā nirṇeyamityarthaḥ| 
abhra āÄ apa iti| nāyaṃ sūtrādiṣu svarūpeṇoccarito|nunāsikaḥ kiṃ
tarhi ? ṭhāṅe'nunāsikaścchandasi'ityanunāsikaśabdena vihitaḥ| atha
kriyamāṇe'pyupadeśagrahaṇe uñaḥ Äṣ ityatra kasmānna bhavati ?
vidhānasāmarthyād| itsaṃjñāyāṃ hi tasya lopaḥ iti lopaḥ syāt|
yadyevam, atrāpi vidhānasāmarthyādeva na bhaviṣyati| evaṃ tarhi
udāharaṇadigiyaṃ darśatā | idaṃ
tatrodāharaṇam-aṇo'pragṛhyasyānunāsikaḥ kadhīcchati brāhyaṇakulamiti
kyajantātkvipi allope, vali lope, napuṃsakahrasvatvaṃ dadhi iti|
yadyatretsaṃjñā syāt ṭhidito num dhātoḥ iti num syāt|
atrāpyanunāsikavidhānasāmarthyādevetsaṃjñā na bhaviṣyati | nanu ca
yatretsaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ prayojanaṃ na sambhavati, yathā-dadhi, madhviti
prātipadikeṣu tatretsaṃjñāyā abhāvaḥ| atrānunāsikavidhānamarthavat,
naitadevam; lopasyetkāryasya sarvatra sambhavāt |
tasmādaṇo'pragṛhyasya itsaṃjñāyāmeva
vidheyāyāmanunāsikavidhānasāmarthyādevātra lopo na bhaviṣyati|
evaṃ tarhyutarārthamavaśyam ṭhupadeśa' iti vaktavyam, tadihāpi
vispaṣṭarthaṃ bhaviṣyatīti manyate| āto maninniti| atra
makārasyetsaṃjñā na bhavati| yadi syād, anyebhyo'pi ddaśyante iti
halante'ntyādacaḥ paraḥ syāt | sarvasyeti|
daridrāprabhṛtisambandhino'pi ||
padamañjarī
halantyam|| 1|3|3 ||
antaśabdo'tra samāptau vartate;nāvayave;nāvayave asambhavāt| na
samīpe;atiprasaṅgāt | yena samāpyate samudāyastadante
bhavamanty, digāditvādyat| halantye sarvaprasaṅgaḥ, sarvasya halaḥ
sāṃjñā prāpnoti| sarvo hi hal taṃ tamavadhiṃ pratyanto bhavati,
antyagrahaṇaṃ tvādinivṛtyarthaṃ syād, ata āha-dhātvāderiti|
ādiśabdana sūtraprātipadikapratyayanipātāgamādeśānāṃ grahaṇam|
śīṅ, laṇ,nadaṭ, san, āṅ, trapujatunoḥ ṣuk, cakṣiḍaḥ khyāñ
iti yo'yaṃ dhātvādirūpaḥ samudāyastadarthaḥ sa upadeśaḥ, na tu
nāntarīyakāvāntarasamudāyārtha ityantyasya samudāyāpekṣāyāṃ
prādhānyāddhātvādereva grahaṇamiti bhāvaḥ| agniciditi| atretsaṃjñāyāṃ
lopaḥ syāt| na ca tuko vaiyarthyam;āgatyetyādau
caritārthatvāt| na ca kvipaḥ pitvasya vaiyarthyam,
āgnicitāvityādau caritārthatvāt| yadyapyatrobhayatrāpi
tāvato'vadhestakāro'ntyaḥ, tathāpi mukhyasamudāyasya nāntya iti
nāsti prasaṅgaḥ| iha ca daṇḍinniti nakārasyetsaṃjñāyāṃ satyām ṭhna
ṅisaṃbuddhyoḥ'iti niṣedhāllopābhāve'pi samudāyasya
nitvādādyaudātatvaprasaṅgaḥ, yathā-śrotriyaśabde vākyārthe
padavacanamiti pakṣe | athopadeśānuvṛtāvapi sanutarityasya rephasya
kasmānna bhavati? svarādiṣvantodātapāṭhasāmarthyāt|
iha ṭhśaṣasar' ṭhhal'iti yo lakārastasyetsaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ halityayaṃ
pratyāhāra upapadyate, sati ca pratyāhāre laṇityatra lakārasya
haltvātasyaiva ṭhśaṣasarhal',ityatrānte nirdiṣṭatvāditsaṃjñā,
tadāśrayaśca pratyāhāra iti itaretarāśrayatvāt pratyāhāro nopapannaḥ|
tataśca sarveṣāmeva ṇakārādīnāmitsaṃjñā na syāditi sarva eva
pratyāhāravyavahāro'nupapannaḥ, ṭhādirantyena'ityetasyāpi
vaiyarthyam? syādetathalityatra hakārāt para lṛkāraḥ, tasya
lṛkārasyaikādeśo laparaḥ, tasya ṭhupadeśe'janunāsikaḥ'iti itsaṃjñā,
sa eva ṭhhalantyam' ityatrāpyekādeśena lapareṇa nirdiṣṭa iti|
evamapītaretarāśrayameva, lṛkārasyetsaṃjñeti tasmādvaktavyo'tra
parihārastamāhahasya l halityādi| sādhāraṇaṃ bhavetantram,
yathā-tulyakakṣyayorbhuñcānayo pradīpaḥ| sa ceha prayatnaviśeṣaḥ,
yathā-śveto dhāvatītyatra sādhāraṇenaikenaiva prayatnena
dvayorvākyayoruccāritayoḥ phalaṃ sampadyate, tathehāpyekena tantreṇa
prabalena dvitīyaṃ halgrahaṇamupātaṃ parigṛhītaṃ veditavyam | tasya
dvitīyasyārthamāha-hasyeti| samīpasamīpisambandhe ṣaṣṭhīsamāsa
ityarthaḥ| tataḥkimityāha-tenetyādi| etad
darśayati-hakārasamīpavartino lakārasya na
pratyāhārasamāśyayoṇaenetsaṃjñā, kiṃ tarhi? sākṣādupādāneneti|
pramāṇam? agṛhyamāṇaviśeṣatvameva| nanu gṛhyate
viśeṣaḥ-ṭhkṛtrimākṛtrimayoḥ kṛtrimasya grahaṇam'iti, kṛtrimo hi
pratyāhāraḥ satyam;sa evāsati tantre'nupapanna iti tvayaivoktam||
padamañjarī
na vibhaktau tusmāḥ|| 1|3|4 || 
vṛkṣāditi takārasyetsaṃjñāyām ṭhtitsvaritam'syāt| nanu
cādeśotarakālaṃ sthānivadbhāvenāsya vibhaktisaṃjñā,
upadeśānantaramevetsaṃjñā prāpneti? satyam; pratiṣedhasāmarthyatu
bhāvinyapi vibhaktitve pratiṣedho bhaviṣyati| vargagrahaṇaṃ
kim?vṛkṣānityatrāpi yathā syāt kva punarupadeśe
nakāro'yamantyaḥ, ma tāvatasya kvacidupadeśaḥ? ṭhśaso na'ityatra
tvakāro nakārasyetsaṃjñāparitrāṇārtha iti śakyaṃ vaktum| iha tarhi
ṭhjhasya ran'paceranniti| brāhyaṇā iti| rūpodāharaṇametat|
kāryodāharaṇaṃ tu bhavataḥ iti| atra ṭhsiti ca'iti padatve jaśtvaṃ
syāt| pacataḥ pacatha ityatra prayojanābhāvādeva na bhaviṣyatīti śakyaṃ
vaktum| apacatāmityādi| tāmādayastasādīnāmantyādacaḥ pare syuḥ|
kimo't ityasya prāgdiśo vibhaktiḥ iti vibhaktitvam| iṭo't
ityasyāpi sthānivadbhāveneti tayorapi pratiṣedhaḥ prāpnoti,
tatrāha-kimo'dityādi| anityatvaṃ tu ṭhidamasthamuḥ' iti
thamorukāro'nubandhādvijñāyate| kvacitu vṛtāveva
ṭhidamasthamuḥ'ityukārānubandhanirdaśādanityatvamupalakṣyate iti
paṭha|lte| idānīṃ tadānīmiti| dānīmastu pratiṣredho bhavatyeva|
anityatvaṃ hi jñāpitam, na punaḥ prāgdiśīyeṣvasyāpravṛttiḥ||
padamañjarī
ādirñiṭuaḍavaḥ || 1|3|5 ||
ādiśabdaḥ pratyekamabhisaṃbaddhyate, tenaikavacanamupapadyate iti bhāvaḥ|
atra ṭhṭua' iti na ṭavargasya
grahaṇam;ukārasyānanunāsikatvenānuditvāt,ṭhcuṭūa'ityutaratra
vargagrahaṇād, ñiḍubhyāṃ sāhacaryācca| minni iti| ṭhāditaśca'
ṭhradābhyāṃ niṣṭhāto naḥ '| vepathuriti | ṭvito'thuc|
uptrimamiti| ḍvitaḥ ktriḥ ktrermam nityam
yajāditvātsaṃprasāraṇam|
paṭuayatīti| pṛthvādiṣu ṭuaśabdasyopadeśaḥ, atretsaṃjñāyāṃ
satyāmavayave kṛtaṃ liṅgaṃ samudāyasya viśeṣakamiti
samudāyādathucprasaṅgaḥ| kevalasyānudāharaṇatvam;itkāryābhāvāt|
kaṇḍūayatīti| nanu cāyaṃ dīrghāntaḥ kaṇḍvādiṣūpadiśyate, evaṃ
tarhi kaṇḍūamicchatīti kyajantāt kvipi kaṇḍu brāhmaṇakulaṃ
tadicchatīti punaḥ kyaci draṣṭavyam,
tatretsaṃjñāyāmantaraṅgatvādakṛta eva dīrdhe bhavatyayaṃ ḍuśabdaḥ,
gaṇapaṭhitaśca kaṇḍūaśabda ekadeśavikṛta iti syāt prasaṅgaḥ|
ñikārīyatīti| nāyaṃ samudāyaḥ kvacidupadiṣṭaḥ|| 
padamañjarī
ṣaḥ pratyayasya|| 1|3|6 ||
rajakīti| ṭhṣidgaurādibhyaśca' iti ṅīṣ| kathaṃ
punaratropadhālopaḥ, yāvatā aniditāṃ hala upadhāyāḥ kṅiti
ityucyate? jñāpayatirañjerakṅityapi kvacidupadhālopo bhavatīti |
ṣoḍa iti| ṣaḍ dantā asya vayasi dantasya datṛ ṣaṣa utvam,
datṛdaśadhāsūtarapadādeḥ ṣṭuatvam | ṣaṣo'ntyasyotvam
utarapadāderḍakāraḥ, ṣoḍantamācaṣṭe iti ṇici ṭilope pacādyaci
ṇilopaḥ| ṭhṣaṇu dāne'ṭhñamantāḍḍaḥ', uṇādayo bahulam iti
bahulavacanāt itsaṃjñāsatvayorabhāvaḥ| ṣaḍika iti| anukampitaḥ
ṣaḍṅguliḥ bahvaco manuṣyanāmnaṣṭhaj vā ṭhṭhājādāvūrddhaṃ
dvitīyādacaḥ' iti ṅguliśabdasya lopaḥ, yasyetilopasya
sthānivadbhāvāt ṣakārānte'vadhau bhasaṃjñāyā abhāvādantarvartinīṃ
vibhaktimāśritya padatvājjaśtvam| atretsaṃjñāyāṃ ṅīṣprasaṅgaḥ|
yadyapyete samudāyā na kvāpyupadiśyante, ṣakārastu ṣaṣa utvam, ṣaṇu
dāne ityupadeśastho bhavati| aviṣaḥ mahiṣa iti| avimahyaeṣṭiṣac |
nanvatra prayojanābhāvādeva ṣakārasyetsaṃjñā na bhaviṣyati; īkārasya
ṭitvādeva siddheḥ| na ca pakṣe ṅīṣarthaḥ ṣakāraḥ, ṅīpoṣa'pi citaḥ
parasyodātanivṛttisvareṇodātatvāt, satyam; anyatarasyaiva
śravaṇārtha upadeśaḥ syāditi ṭakārasyāpi śaṅkyota||
padamañjarī
cuṭūa|| 1|3|7 ||
ādī iditi| prārambhe vartamānāvityarthaḥ| kauñjāyanya iti|
cphañantāt ṭhvratacphañorastriyām'iti svārthe svarthe ñyaḥ|
śaṇḍikādibhyo ñya iti| so'syā bhijanaḥ iti tatra vartate| manduraja
iti | ḍa|lapossaijñācchandasoḥ iti hrasvaḥ| annāṇṇa iti | ṭhdhanagaṇaṃ
labdhā'ityato labdheti tatrānuvarte| kimartho yogavibhāgaḥ,ṭhcuṭūaṣāḥ
pratyayasya'ityeka eva yogaḥ kriyatāmata āha-pṛthagityādi|
keśacuñcuḥ keśacaṇa iti | atra cakārasyetsaṃjñāyām
ṭhcitaḥ'ityantodātatvaṃ syāt, pitkaraṇantu paryāyārthaṃ syāt|
avādityasyānuvṛttirdarśitā|| 
padamañjarī
laśakvataddhite|| 1|3|8 ||
priyaṃvada iti| ṭharurdviṣadajantasya mum' | jiṣṇuriti| snupratyayasya
gitvapakṣe gakārasyedamudāharaṇam| cūḍāla iti | matvarthe
ṭhprāṇisthādāto lajanyatarasyām'iti | atra prayojanābhāvādeva na
bhaviṣyatīti śakyaṃ vaktum| karṇiketi| ṭhkarṇalalāṭāt
kanalaṅkāre'iti bhavārthe kan| atra ṭhkiti ca' iti vṛddhiḥ syāt,
rūpañca na sidhyet| atha tudircchidirprabhṛtiṣu irityasya samudāyasya
kenetsaṃjñā?mā bhūtsamudāyasya, rephasya halantyam iti bhaviṣyati,
ikārasya upadeśejanunāsika it iti| irito vā ityātrāpi-- iśca
raścerau tāvitāvasyeti vigrahaḥ, na tu irityayaṃ samudāyaḥ sa
idyasyeti| avaśyaṃ ca ikārasya pṛthagītsaṃjñeṣitavyā, svariteta
ityātmanepadaṃ yathā syāditi| yadyevam, ṭhidito num dhāttoḥ'
iti num prāpnoti, kumbhīdhānyanyāyena na bhavati; yasya punaḥ
kumbhyāṃ vānyatra vā, nāsau kumbhīdhānyaḥ| nāyaṃ nyāyo numvidhau
śakya āśrayitum| iha hi na syāt-ṭuanadi' nandathuriti| jñāpakāt
siddham, yadayam ṭhna haśaḥ' iti ksasya pratiṣedhaṃ śāsti,
tajjñāpayati-neditāṃ numbhavati; anyathā haśeriditvānnumi sati
anigupadhātvāt ksasya prāptireva nāsti, kiṃ tanniṣedhena|
parihārāntaramapyatra numvidhau vakṣyate|| 
padamañjarī
tasya lopaḥ|| 1|3|9 ||
tasya grahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā'bhāvo lopaḥ, sa ca kasyacideva
bhavati,tatra prakaraṇāditsaṃjñakasyaiva lopo bhaviṣyatītyata āha-tasya
grahaṇamityādi| ādirñiṭuaḍava iti | asati tasya grahaṇe ye'nekāla
itsaṃjñakā ñiprabhṛtayasteṣvalo'ntyasya lopaḥ syāt, tasya
grahaṇasāmarthyātu sarvasya bhaviṣyati| etacca ṭhnānarthake'lontyasya
vidhīḥ' ityanāśrityoktam||
padamañjarī
yathāsaṅkhyanudeśaḥ samānām|| 1|3|10 || 
saṅkhyāśabdenānna kramo lakṣyata iti| katham? avyabhicārāt | yatraika
evoddeśyanuddeśī ca, yathā ṭhmudrādaṇ'iti, na tatra niyamaprasaṅga
ityanekatvasaṅkhyāyā 
eveha grahaṇam| sā ca kramaṃ na vyabhicarati;yugapadanekasya
śabdasyoccārayitumaśakyatvāt| mukhye tvarthe'yamarthaḥ syātsamānāṃ
samasaṅkhyānāmuddeśināṃ yā saṅkhyā caturādilakṣaṇā tayā uddeśyaḥ
tvādevāsyārthasya siddhatvād| ataḥ kramapara eva saṅkhyāśabda iti |
yathākramagrahaṇaṃ tu na kṛtam, saṅkhyādvārakaṃ sāmyaṃ yathā
vijñāyeta;anyathā sthānaprayatnā dikṛtamapi samatvaṃ pratīyeta| nanu ca
kriyamāṇamapi saṅkhyāgrahaṇaṃ kramaparamiti kathamataḥ
saṃkhyāsāmyapratipatiḥ? satyam; krame śabdaḥ paryavasyati,
mukhyo'pyarthaḥ pratīyate|sa hi pratīto lākṣaṇikaṃ gamayati; tasmāt
saṃkhyāgrahaṇasāmarthyāt taddvārakameva sāmyaṃ gṛhyate|
yathāsaṃkhyamiti| ṭhyathā'sāhaśye' iti vīpsāyāmavyayībhāvaḥ| anudeśo
bhavatīti | sambandhī bhavatīti draṣṭavyam | tathā ca vabhyati-anudeśinaḥ
sambadhyante iti| anudiśyata ityanudeśa iti | akartari ca kārake
saṃjñāyām ityasaṃjñāyāpi karmapi ghañ| anuśabdaḥ paścādarthe,
ddaśiruccākriya ityāha-paścaccāryata ityartha iti | yaduktaṃ saṃkhyādvārakaṃ
sāmyaṃ gṛhyate iti taddarśayati-samānāṃ samasaṃkhyānām| asyaiva
vivaraṇam-samaṃpaṭhitānāmiti | uddeśināmiti| kañciddharmaṃ
vidhātuṃ prasiddhavacchabdaparāmarśayogyena rūpeṇa upādānamuddeśaḥ,
tadvanta uddeśinaḥ, vidheyatayā paścāduccāraṇamanudeśaḥ,
tadvanto'nudeśinaḥ| yadyapi sūtre uddeśino na
śrutāstathāpyanudeśaśabdasya sambandhiśabdatvāt samasaṃkhyatvasya ca
pratiyogyapekṣatvāt ta eva gamyante| uddeśināmanudeśināṃ ceti
yathākramamityetadapekṣayā ṣaṣṭhayau| yathākramamiti|
pūrvavadavyayībhāvastṛtīyāntaṃ caitat| 
tadayamatrārthaḥ- samasaṃkhyānāmuddeśināmanudeśināṃ ca yoyaḥ
kramaḥuprathamacaramabhavastena tenānudeśinaḥ sambadhyante, uddeśibhiḥ
sahetyarthād gamyate | kvacit uddeśibhiriti paṭha|lte| tatra
sahayoge tṛtīyā| prathamād prathama ityādinā sūtrārthamudāharaṇe
yojayati| vahanti, varṣanti, nadantītyādau loka eva
yathāsaṃkhyasambandhasya ddaṣṭatvānnārtha etena ? ucyate;vyutkrameṇāpi
sambandho loke ddaśyate-kanyābrahmacāriṇau, daṇḍakandukahastāviti|
yogyatāvaśādatra sambandha iti cet; krameṇāpi sambandhaḥ, tadvaśādeva
yogyā hi nadyo vahane, ghanāśca varṣaṇe| ata evaikasya dharmiṇi bahuṣu
dharmeṣu vihiteṣu vidhānakrameṇānyathā vā yogyatānurūpa eva
sambandho bhavati-amumudvartaya, snāpaya, bhojaya; bhojaya,
snāpayaudvartayeti syādetat-svataḥ prāptiriyaṃ yaduktakrameṇa
sambandhaḥ| tathā hi, yogyatāviśeṣānavadhāraṇe prathamapratītayoḥ
sambandhaḥ, bādhakābhāvāt| tāvatā hi dvayorapi caritārthatvam,
dvitīyasya dharmiṇo dharmasya vā pratiyogyayekṣāyāṃ prathamaśrutasya
caritārthatvād, acaritārthana dvitīyena pratiyogināṃ sambandhaḥ |
evaṃ sarvatra tasmāt svataḥ prāptaḥ prāptyā kramasambandhaḥ siddhaḥ iti|
yadyevam, lakṣaṇetthambhūtākhyāna ityādau vaiṣamye'pyevameva syād,
yāvatāṃ sāmyaṃ tāvatāmāditaḥ krameṇa sambandhaḥ, pariśiṣṭasya tu
sarvairanantareṇa vetyataḥ samānāmiti vakṣyāmītyārambhaḥ|
svariteneti viśeṣaṃ vakṣyāmīti| kvaciddhi sāmye'pi neṣyate|
athārabhyamāṇe'pyasmin paramsaipadānāṃ ṇalādayaḥ, luṭaḥ prathamasya
ḍāraurasaḥ,ṭheco'yavāyāva'ityatra kathamasya pravṛttiḥ, yāvatā
parasmaipadādisaṃjñayā yugapadeva saṃjñināṃ pratītiḥ, na krameṇa?
satyam; tibādisūtre, akṣaramāmnāye ca tibādayaḥ krameṇa pratītiḥ, sa
eva kramo niyāmako bhaviṣyati| evaṃ dvandve'pi | pāghretyādau
yugapadadhikaraṇavacanatāyāṃ dvandve'pi kramasya pratīteḥ sa eva
niyāmakaḥ| nanu ca tipo ṇal, taso'tusa, paḥ pibaḥ, jighraḥ-ityevaṃ
bhinnavākyatayopadeśo'stu, evaṃ hīdaṃ na vaktavyaṃ bhavati?satyam; evaṃ
tu gauravaṃ syāt tasya rūpeṇānidaśāt, tatra
vibhakterbhedenoccāraṇācca| tathā ṭhvido laṭo vā '
ityatrānantaryānmasometyeva sambadhyeta, tadāha--
saṃjñāsamāsanirdeśāt sarvaprasaṅgo'nudeśasya| tatra yathāsaṃkhyavacanaṃ
niyamārtham, saṃjñāsamāsanirdeśacca pṛthagviktisaṃjñyanuccāraṇārthaḥ,
prakaraṇe ca sarvasampratyārthaḥ iti| taudeya ityādau ṭhso'syābhijanaḥ'
ityatrārthepratyayaḥ|
ihetyādi| ekayogatvapakṣe codyam, bhinnayogapakṣe tu yogavibhāgo
yathāsaṃkhyanirāsārtha iti vakṣyati| kecitu vibhajya yogaṃ paṭhanti,
anye tvekameva| svaritenetyādi parihāraḥ| kathaṃ punarayaṃ viśeṣo
labhyata ityāha--svaritenādhikāra ityādi| yadyevam, svarite ddaṣṭe
sandehaḥ syāt, na jñāyate--kimayaṃ yathāsaṃkhyārthaḥ?
āhosvidadhikārārthaḥ?iti| sandehamātrametad, bhavati,
sarvasandeheṣu cedamupatiṣṭhate--ṭhvyākhyānato viśeṣapratipatirna
hi sandehādalakṣaṇam'iti | tatra vyākhyānānnirṇayo bhaviṣyati||
padamañjarī
svaritenādhikāraḥ|| 1|3|11 ||
atra pāribhāṣikasya ṭhsvaritasya grahaṇe raṣābhyānnoṇaḥ'ityādau
nakārādervyañjanasyādhikāropalakṣaṇaṃ noktaṃ syād,
pāribhāṣikasyāñdharmatvāditi matvāha--svarito nāma varṇadharma
iti| varṇamātradharma ityarthaḥ| sa cāyaṃ dharmaḥ salādhmātāditulyaḥ
kevalaṃ sūtreṣveva bhavati, na prayoge| kvacitu svarito nāma
svaradoṣo varṇadharma iti pāṭhaḥ| tatra svaradoṣaḥūccāraṇadoṣaḥ,
adhikāraśabdo bhāvasādhanaḥ| viniyoga iti| vyāpāraṇam| atha
śabdasyaviniyuktasya ko vyāpāra
ityāha--adhikṛtatvādutaratropatiṣṭhata iti | upasthānamapyetadeva
yadutāsya tatrabuddhisthatā| utaratretyulakṣaṇam, kvacit
pūrvatrāpyupatiṣṭhate;sūtrakāreṇa paṭhitasyāsya svaritatvasya
saṃkīrṇatvāt pāṭhasya viṣayavibhāgo durjñeya ityāha-pratijñāsvaritā
iti| pratyāya ityādyaudāharaṇāni|
kimartha punaridamucyate, yāvatā nirddiśyamānaṃ loke'dhikriyate,
yathā-devadatāya gaurddīyatāṃ kambalaśceti devadatāyeti gamyate,
tathā ṭhsṛ sthire' ityādīnāṃ sākāṅkṣatvādanuvṛtairghañādibhireva
sambandho bhaviṣyati? anyanirdeśastannivartakaḥ, tadyathā--devadatāya
gaurddīyatām, viṣṇumitrāya kambala iti kambalo gornivartako
bhavati, tathehāpi ṭhabhividhau bhāve' itīnuṇ ghaño nivartakaḥ
syāt, tataśca ṭhākrośe'vanyergrahaḥ' ityādiṣvanantara inuṇeva syāt,
tasmātparibhāṣā| adhikāraparimāṇajñānaṃ tu na jñāyate--
kiyantamavadhimadhikāro'nuvartata iti?
yathā-prāgabhyāsavikārebhyo'ṅgadhikāraḥ?, dhātoriti prāk
lādeśebhyaḥ? utādhyāyasya parisamāpteḥ? evaṃ
tarhyubhayārthamidam--adhikārārthaṃ ca nivṛtyarthaṃ ca | katham?
svaritenādhikāraḥ svarite ddaṣṭe'dhikāro na bhavatītyarthaḥ, tena
viṃśatikāt khaḥ| ityatra svaritatvaṃ pratijñeyaṃ taddarśanācca
dvitripūrvādityasya nivṛttiraṣyate tatra tāvatitho'lanubandhanīyaḥ,
yathā--dvitripūrvānniṣkāt ityatrekāraḥ| tena
dvayoryogayoranuvṛttirbhaviṣyati | evamanyatrāpi yatra tāvatitho'l
nāsti tatra prāgvacanaṃ kartavyam, yathā--aṅgasya prāk ṭeḥ iti tad
guru bhavati| syādetat,vyākhyānāt parimāṇaṃ jñāsyate iti?
adhikāro'pi tarhi vyākhyānāt jñāyatām| inuṇghañiti saṃdehe
ghañiti vyākhyāsyāmaḥ, inuṇa ānantaryam, ghaño'pyanuvṛttisāmarthya
ddaṣṭamityastyeva saṃdehaḥ| ṭhgrahavṛddaniścigamaśca'ityādiṣu
tvanantarasyāpa evādhikāraḥ, na ddaṣṭānuvṛttisāmarthyasyāpi ghañaḥ,
siddhatvād, vyākhyānādvā| yadapyutprekṣitam--ākāṃkṣārahite'pi
vākye prakṛtasya sambandhārthaṃ śāstrīyo'dhikāraḥ- yathā
dūrāntikārthabhyo dvitīyā ca ityatra pañcamyadhikāra iti | tatrāpi
vyākhyānameva śaraṇamiti tadeva sarvatrāstu nārtha etena ? idaṃ tarhi
prayojanam--anyatra ddaṣṭasyādhikārasya svaritenopalakṣaṇaṃ yathā
syād, yathā--ṭhgostriyorupasarjanasya'ityatra strīgrahaṇasya, na
hyaetallaukikenādhikāreṇa siddham, ānuṣaṅgikaṃ vāsya prayojanaṃ
yat sākākṣeṣu vyahitasya cānuvṛttiḥ|| 
padamañjarī
anudātaṅti ātmanepadam|| 1|3|12 ||
aviśeṣeṇetyādi| lasya tibādayaḥ, ṭhlaṭaḥ śatṛśānacau'ṭhliṭaḥ
kānajvā'ṭhkvasuśca'ṭhlṛṭaḥdvā'ityātmanepadaparasmaipadayorvihitvādāpādaparisamāpterniyamārthaṃ prakaraṇamityarthaḥ | ekavākyatayā vidhāvitaretarāśrayaṇaprasaṅgaḥ| syādetat--yathā ṭhbahuṣu bahuvacanam',ṭhkarmaṇi dvitīyā'ṭhṅyāpprātipadikāt'ityetairekavākyabhūtaiḥ svādīnāṃ viśiṣṭavidhiḥ, evamanena prakāreṇa lasya tibādaya ityādibhiśca tiṅamapi viśiṣṭavidhirastu iti, yadyevam; ātmanepadaparasmaipadasaṃjñābhyāṃ tibādīnāṃ vidhiḥ, vihitānāṃ ca saṃjñābhyāṃ bhāvyamitītaretarāśrayaṃ prāpnoti| svarūpeṇa viśiṣṭavidhauśatrādiṣvatiprasaṅgaḥ| syānmatam-lasya tiptasjhisipthasthamipvasmam lasya tibādayo bhavanti, tataḥ ṭhanuparabhyāṃkṛñaḥ'-kartaryanupūrvāt karoteḥ parasya lasya tibādayo bhavanti| kimarthamidam? ṭhgandhanāvakṣepaṇasvaritañitaḥ'iti vakṣyati, tidvādhanārthaṃ kartṛgrahaṇam;ṭhbhāvakarmeṇoḥ' iti vakṣyamāṇasya taṅe bādho mā bhūditi | evam ṭhabhipratyatibhyaḥ kṣipaḥ' ityādi ṭhluṭi ca klupaḥ' ityevamantaṃ kṛtvā tataḥ ṭhanudātaṅtistātāṃjhathāsāthāndhvamiḍvahimahiṅ', anudātaṅtiḥ parasya lasya tādayo bhavanti, tibādīnāmapavādaḥ, tato ṭhbhāvakarmaṇoḥ'ityādi, ṭhvibhāṣopapadena pratīyamāne'ityevamantaṃ kariṣyate, tatrāyamapyarthaḥ-ātyanepadagrahaṇaṃ śeṣagrahaṇaṃ parasmaipadagrahaṇaṃ ca na kartavyaṃ bhavati| evamapi prakaraṇāntarāvasthitānāṃ śatrādīnāṃ niyamo na syād, ato na svarūpeṇa viśiṣṭavidhiryuktaḥ| saṃjñāśrayaṇe tu yatraitsaṃjñakayorvidhānaṃ tatra sarvatropasthānānnāyaṃ doṣaḥ, kiṃ tvitaretarāśrayaḥ prāpnoti| yadi tvasya sūtrasya śāṭakaṃvayetivad bhāvinī saṃjñā vijñāyeta, tato netaretarāśrayaṃ lāghavaṃ prati na kaścidviśeṣa iti kiṃ mudhā bhāvisaṃjñāśrayaṇakhedeneti bhinnavākyatayā niyamapakṣa evāśrito vṛttikāreṇa|
yadyevam, vikaraṇavyavadhāne niyamāprasaṅgaḥ,
liṅliṭśnamślulukṣu vacanānubandhayorarthatvād | iha hi
vikaraṇānāmavakāśaḥ- alādeśāścānaśādayaḥ;niyamasyāvakāśaḥ,yatra
vikaraṇā na santi-sparddhiṣīṣṭa, pasparddhe, āste, śete,
ararti,juhoti, bhinati, bhūyadityādi;edhate, kurute, niviśate
ityādāvubhayaprasaṅge paratvādvikaraṇeṣu kṛteṣu
tairvyavadhānānniyamo na syād| asati niyame, yadi tāvat
prakṛtiniyamo'nudātaṅdāidibhya ātmanepadameva, śeṣāddhātoḥ
parasmaipadameveti,tato'smin viṣaye
ubhayaprasaṅgaḥ;pratyayaniyame'pi tulyajātīyasya niyamena
vyāvṛttiriti dhātoranantarasya lasya yadyātmanepadaparasmaipade bhavataḥ,
anudātaṅccheṣānintaramevetyevaṃ niyamo vijñāyamāno
dhātvantarādeva vyāvartayediti vikaraṇavyavadhāne
niyamāpravṛtāvubhayaprasaṅga eva| ekavākyatayā vidhāne tu nāyaṃ
doṣaḥ, vihiteṣu lādeśeṣu sārvadhātukāpekṣairvikaraṇairbhāvyam,
vidhānaṃ cānena prakaraṇena saheti netaḥ prāgvikaraṇasambhavaḥ|
syādayo lāvasthāyāṃ vidhīyamānā api
lakāraviśeṣāpekṣatvadvahiraṅgā iti
lamātrāpekṣeṣvantaraṅgeṣvādeśeṣu kṛteṣveva bhaviṣyantīti na
tatrāpi doṣaḥ| jñāpakāt siddham, yadayaṃ ṭhvṛdbhyaḥ syasanoḥ'iti
sye vikalpaṃ śāsti, tajjñāpayati-vikaraṇebhyo niyamo balīyāniti|
etenaitadapi nirastam-caṅṅbhyāmātmanepadaprasaṅga iti,
katham?pūrvaniyame pravṛte paścāt caṅṅai bhavata iti|
pratyekamicchabdasyānvaya ityāha-anudāteta iti| ye dhātavo
ṅtiśceti| samudāyasambandhe tu cakṣiṅ eva syāt;sa hyanudātena
paṭha|lte, vicakṣaṇa ityatra yujyathā syād|
ñakārastvanudātetvanibandhanasyātmanepadasyānityatvajñāpanārthaḥ, tena
ṭhevāyaṃ nāgaḥ sahati kalabhebhyaḥ paribhavam',ṭhna sahāmi
sāhasamasāhasiki'ityādi siddham|
dhātava ityetat kuto labhyate? kecidhuḥ-ṭhbhūvādayo dhātavaḥ'
ityato dhātugrahaṇamanuvartate, tacca ṭhanudātaṅtiḥ' ityanena
sāmānādhikaraṇyāt pañcamyā vipariṇamyate, ata eva
caṅṅbhyāmātmanepadaṃ na bhavatīti| yaṅntādapi tarhi na prāpnoti
bebhidyata iti, yaṇeóva hyatra ṅd, ni tadanto dhātuḥ, avayave
cācaritārthaṃ liṅgaṃ samudāyasya viśeṣakaṃ bhavati, tasmadiha
dhātoriti nānuvartyam| prāyovṛtā tu vṛtau dhatava ityuktam|
caṅṅestu parihāra ukta eva| yadyayaṃ prakṛtiniyamaḥ syād anudātaṅti
ātmanepadameveti, tṛjādayo na syuḥ?vacanād bhaviṣyanti| asti
vacanasyāvakāśaḥ-parasmaipadinaḥ,tatrāpi niyamaḥ-śeṣāt
parasmaipadameveti, tena vacanād bhaviṣyanti| tulyajātīyasya ca
niyamena vyāvṛttiḥ, kaśca tulyajātīyaḥ? ātmanepadasya parasmaipadam,
tasya ca tat| evamapi ṭhśeṣāt kartari'iti śeṣagrahaṇaṃ na kartavyaṃ
prakṛtiniyamapakṣe, katham? prakṛtayo niyatāḥ, ātmanepadaṃ
parasmaipadaṃ cāniyatam, tato vakṣyāmi-parasmaipadamiti, tanniyamārthaṃ
bhaviṣyati-yatra parasmaipadaṃ cānyacca prāpnoti tatra
parasmaipadameveti| pratyayaniyamastu nāntareṇa śeṣagrahaṇaṃ śakyo
vijñātumiti śeṣagrahaṇaṃ kurvataḥ sūtrakārasya sa evābhipreta
ityāha-tebhya ātmanepadaṃ bhavati, nānyebhya iti | yadi
pratyayaniyamo'yam? ṭhśeṣāt kartari parasmaipadam' ityatra yadi
tāvadevaṃ niyamaḥ-kartari yadi bhavati śeṣadeveti, tato'śeṣat
kartari mā bhūd, bhāvakarmaṇostu śeṣācca parasmaipadaṃ prāpnoti|
atha śeṣādyadi bhavati kartaryeveti? tataḥ śeṣād bhāvakarmaṇormā
bhūd, aśeṣātu bhāvakarmakartṛṣu triṣvapi prāpnoti| na
caikasminvākye niyamadvayaṃ śakyaṃ vijñātum-śeṣādeva bhavati,
tatrāpi kartaryeveti | evaṃ tarhi yogavibhāgena niyamadvayaṃ tatraiva
sādhayiṣyāmaḥ| āsta ityādi| ṭhāsa upaveśane' ,ṭhvasa ācchādane',ṭhṣūṅ
prāṇiprasave',śīṅsvapneadādayaḥ| ṭhśīṅḥ sārvadhātuke guṇaḥ'||
padamañjarī
bhāvakarmaṇoḥ|| 1|3|13 ||
bhāvyata iti bhāvaḥ, ṇyantād bhavateḥ karmaṇi ghañ| dhātvarthaḥ
kriyātmaka ucyate, karma tu pāribhāṣikam| dhañādividhau tu ṭhbhāva'
iti śuddhād bhavaterbhāve ghañ| bhāvaḥusatā,dhātvarthasya
siddhatāvasthocyate| ayamapi niyama iti darśayitumanyataḥ
siddhimāha-laḥ karmaṇi cetyādi | kathaṃ punarayaṃ niyamaḥ, yāvatā
ṭhanudātaṅti evātmanepadm'iti pūrveṇa niyamena yathā śeṣāt
kartaryātmanepadaṃ vyāvartitam, evaṃ bhāvakarmaṇorapīti tadviṣaye
vidhyarthamidaṃ yuktam?satyam;yadi pūrvasūtre pravṛttiḥ,viparyayo'pi
śakyate vaktum-bhāvakarmaṇorevātmanepadamiti, asminniyame pravṛte
ṭhanudātaṅtiḥ'kartaryātmanepadamaprāptamiti pūrvasūtramapi
vidhyarthamiti| tena dvayorapi lasya tibādaya ityetadapekṣayā
niyamārthatvam, parasparāpekṣayā tu
vidhyarthatvamevamāpādaparisamāpterdravyam| ata evasyānyathāsiddhaṃ
darśayatāpyevaśabdo na prayuktaḥ| tibādisūtreṇa dhātusāmānyavihitaṃ
ca lakāramāśritya tibādayo vihitāstatraibhya eva dhātubhya iti pūrve
niyamaḥ, ayaṃ tvetayore vārthayoriti| nanu cātrārthaniyama eva
granthe pratīyate, ayaṃ tvatrārthaḥ-ṭhlaḥ karmaṇi ca'iti bhāvakarmaṇoryo
vihito lakāto lakārastasya sāmānyena tibādayaḥ sarve vakṣyante, na
tvātmanepadameva, atastadeva yathā syādityamārambha iti| pratyayaniyame
tu bhāvakarmakartṛṣvapi vihitasya lasya sāmānyena taṅ vakṣyata iti
vācyaṃ syāt, satyam;ayaṃ tvatrārthaḥ-ṭhbhāvakarmaṇoḥ'ityupalakṣaṇam,
bhāvakarmakartṛṣvityarthaḥ, tibādaya iti sūtre tipaḥ
prathamanirdeśādevamuktam| tibādiṣvantarbhūtāstaṅ ityarthaḥ,
taṅanāviti yāvat | kiṃ punaḥ syād yadyayamarthaniyam syād? iha
ko bhavatā lābho labdhaḥ, ko bhavatā dāyo data iti karmaṇi ghañ na
syād| ṭhakartari ca' ityasya tvapādānādiravakāśaḥ yadyapi
tulyajātīyasya parasmaipadasya niyamena vyāvṛttiriti
parihāro'sti;tathāpi pūrvasūtre tāvat pratyayaniyama itīhāpi sa
evāśritaḥ| glāyata iti| ṭhglai mlai harṣakṣaye'| supyata iti | ṭhñiṣvap
śaye', ṭhvacisvapi ityādinā saṃprasāraṇam| kriyata iti| ṭhriṅ
śayagliṅkṣu'yadā ṭhkarmavatkarmaṇā'ityayaṃ śāstrātideśoḥ
vyapadeśātideśo vā, tadā śāstravyapadeśayoratidiṣṭayoḥ svena
śāstreṇa tatatkaryaṃ bhavati tatra karmaṇyātmanepadamityasyāvakāśaḥ śuddhaṃ
karma, kartari parasmaipadamityasya śuddhaḥ
kartā,karmakartaryubhayaprasaṅge paratvātparasmaèpadaṃ prāpneti, ata
āha-kamakartarītyādi| dvitīyaṃ kartṛgrahaṇamanuvartata iti| ṭhkartari
karmavyatīhāre'ityataḥ kāryātideśapakṣe tvātmanepadameva | paramiti
| nāyaṃ parihāro vācyaḥ||
padasañjarī
kartari karmavyatīhāre|| 1|3|14 ||
atra laukikaṃ karma gṛhyate, na pāribhāṣikamityāha-karmaśabdaḥ
kriyāvācīti| nanu kṛtrimatvātpāribhāṣikasyaiva grahaṇaṃ yuktaṃ tato
devadatasya dhānyaṃ vyatilunantītyatraiva syāt, evaṃ manyate-iha
ṭhkartari vyatīhāre'itīyatā siddhaṃ, karaṇādivyatīhāre kasmānna
bhavati, ucyate;kriyāyāḥ sādhyatvāt prādhānyaṃ
kriyayāptumiṣṭatamatvātādarthyete;tadyadi sādhanaṃ karma gṛhyaeta, tadā
kriyāyā api saṃdarśanaprārthanādhyavasāyairāpyamānatvāt
kṛtrimakarmatvamiti punarubhayorapi grahaṇāt karmagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ
syāt| kiṃ cātmanepadenākṣipto'nuvṛto vā dhātuḥ
karmavyatihāreṇa viśeṣyate-tatra vartamānāddhātoriti, na ca
sādhanakarmaṇi dhātorvṛttiḥ sambhavati, tasya kriyāvācitvāditi|
vinimayo vyatyāsa ityarthaḥ| etadeva spaṣṭayati-yatreti|
yogyatāvaśādasyedaṃ sādhanam, asyeyaṃ kriyā sādhyeti
nirjñātayorviparyāsaḥ sādhyasādhanabhāvasya sa vyatīhāra iti
vivakṣitam| yatretyupakramātu sa vyatīhārasya viṣayo vivakṣita
ityarthaḥ| parasparakaraṇamapi karmavyatīhāra ucyate-saṃpraharante
rājānaḥ, vyātyukṣīmabhisaraṇaglahāmadībyanniti| vyatilunata iti |
ṭhluñ chedane' ṭhātmanepadeṣvanataḥ'ityadādeśaḥ,
ṭhśnābhyastayoḥ'ityākāralopaḥ, ṭhpvādīnāṃ hrasvaḥ'|
anyonyayogyamanyonyaviṣaye vā lavanaṃ kurvantītyarthaḥ |
evaṃrūpaścārtho'nekakartṛkatve sati pratīyata ityekavacanaṃ na bhavatīti
kecidāhuḥ| vyatyase, vyatihe ityekavacanamapi tatra
tatrodāhariṣyate| ṭhanyo vyatiste tu mamāpi dharmaḥ' iti
bhaṭṭiprayogaḥ|
karmavyatīhāra iti kimiti | kartṛgrahaṇameva vyatilunata ityādau
prāpakatvenopayokṣyata iti bhāvaḥ|
atha kartṛgrahaṇaṃ kimartham ? bhāvakarmanivṛtyarthaṃ na vā pūrveṇa
bhāvād| bhāvakarmaṇorhi pūrveṇātmanepadaṃ bhavatyeva--vyatilūyate
vyatipūyat iti, tena yathā syād, anena mā mūt, kaḥ punaratra
viśeṣaḥ ? tena vā syādanena vā ? ayamasti viśeṣaḥ-anena sati ṭhna
gatihisārthebhyaḥ' iti pratiṣedhaḥ prāpnoti--vyatigamyate grāmaḥ,
vyatihanyante dasyava iti| na vānantarasya pratiṣedhād vyatihanyata
ityatra dve prāptī--ṭhbhāvakarmaṇoḥ'iti ca | tathā ṭhanantarasya
vidhirbhavati pratiṣedho vā'iti anantarā karmavyatīhāralakṣaṇa prāptiḥ
pratiṣidhyate, pūrvā tu bhaviṣyati, nārthaṃ etena kartṛgrahaṇenatyata
āha--kartṛgrahaṇamiti| ṭhśeṣātkartari'iti pradarśanametad | ṭhāṅe
do'nāsyavirahaṇo'ityādāvapyasyopayogaṃ vakṣyāmaḥ|| 
padamañjarī
na gatihiṃsārthebhyaḥ|| 1|3|15 ||
vyatigacchantītyādi| ṭhgamlṛ sṛplṛ gatau'ṭhtṛhi hisi hiṃsāyām'
ṭhhana hiṃsāgatyoḥ',gameḥ ṭhiṣugamiyamāṃ cchaḥ'ṭhche ca'iti tuk,
sṛperladhūpadhaguṇaḥ, hantergamahanetyupadhālopaḥ, ṭhho hanteḥ'iti
kutvam|
hasādīnāmiti| hasiprakārāṇaṃ śabdakriyāṇāmityarthaḥ|
upasaṃkhyānamiti| saṃkhyāyateusaṃkṣipya pratipādyate'nenārtha iti
saṃkhyānamusūtram, tasyopoccāritamupasaṃkhyānaṃ sūtram, samīpa
idamapi sūtraṃ paṭhitavyamityarthaḥ| haraterapratiṣegha iti|
arthagrahaṇasāmarthyāhyae śabdāntaranirapekṣāgatihisayorvartante ta iha
gṛhyanta iti upasargavaśena hisārthatvāddharaterapratiṣedha ityāhuḥ| iha
tu ṭhtataḥ saṃprahariṣyantau ddaṣṭvā karṇadhanañjayau'iti
yotsyamānāviti vivakṣitam, na vyatīhāraḥ| iha ca saṃvyavaharante
gargairiti vaheragatyarthatvādapratiṣedhaḥ, deśāntaraprāpaṇaṃ hi
vaherarthaṃḥ- bhāraṃ vahatīti;nāntarīyakastu gatipratyayaḥ
kanyāprāpaṇamukhena gargaiḥ sambadhyanta ityarthaḥ||
padamañjarī
itaretarānyo'nyopapadācca|| 1|3|16 ||
upoccāritaṃ padamupadam, na pāribhāṣikam;asamvād|
asatyupapadagrahaṇe pañcamītirdeaśe parasyaivānantarasya syāt;
ṭhtasmādityutarasya'iti vacanāt| saptamīnirdeśe tu ṭhtasminniti
nirdiṣṭe pūrvasya'iti pūrvasyaivānantarasya syāt| tatra yadyapi
lakāro'nantaraḥ paro na sambhavati, dhātustu sambhavati;pūrvastu
dhāturanantaro na sambhavati, lakārastu saṃbhavati| tṛtīyānirdeśastu
pañcamīsādhāraṇatvādanadhyavasāna ityupapadagrahaṇaṃ kriyate|
itaretarasyatyādi| laukike tu śabdavyavahāre lāghavaṃ
pratyunādarād itaretarādiśabdastaṅ upasargāśca
karmavyatīhāradyotanāya samuccīyante | karmavyatīhāre ṭhsarvanāmno
dve bhavatassamāsavacca bahulam'yadā na samāsavat prathamaikavacanaṃ tadā
pūrvapadasyeti ṣaṣṭha|lekavacanāntasyetaraśabdasya dvirvacane
samāsavadbhāvena subluki samāsatvādeva prātipadikatvāt punaḥ
ṣaṣṭha|lekavacanam| anyaśabdasya tu bahulagrahaṇādasamāsavadbhāve
pūrvapadasthasya ṣaṣṭha|lekavacanasya prathamaikavacanam| evaṃ
parasparasyetyatrāpi sūtravākyayoḥ prakṛtibhāgamātrasyānukaraṇaṃ
draṣṭavyam||
padamañjarī
nerviśaḥ|| 1|3|17 ||
śeṣātkartari parasmaipade prāpte iti| anārambhasyāpi śeṣapakṣe
nikṣepāt| ātmanepadaṃ vidhīyata iti| yadyapi tibādisūtrāpekṣayā
sarvasyaiva prakaraṇasya niyamārthatvam, ṭhanudātaṅti
ātmanepadam'ṭhbhāvakarmaṇoḥ' iti sūtradvayāyekṣayā tu vidhyarthatvamapi
sambhavatīti matvaivamuktam| evaṃ sarvatra draṣṭavyam|
nyaviśatetyatra laṅ iniviś l iti sthite lādeśo
lakāramātrāpekṣatvād antaraṅgaḥ, aḍāgamastu
luṅadiviśeṣāpekṣatvādvahiraṅga iti pūrvaṃ lādeśe vikaraṇaśca
prāpnoti aḍāgamaśca, nityatvādvikaraṇaḥ| aḍāgamo hi vikaraṇe kṛte
tadantameva laṅ pirato'ṅgam tadādigrahaṇasya
syādinumarthatvāditi tasyaiva prāpnoti, akṛte vikaraṇe
dhātumātrasyoti śabdāntaraprāpteranityaḥ;tataśca vikaraṇāntasya
vidhīyamāno'ḍāgamo dhātumātraṃ pratyabhakta iti neśca dhātośca
vyavadhāyaka ityātmanepadaṃ na prāpnotītyata āha-yadāgamā ityadi| evaṃ
manyate-bāhyaepasargasambandhāpekṣatvādayaṃ vidhirbahiraṅgaḥ,
asmiṃścāpravṛte lādeśo'pyapravṛta eva, apavādaviṣayaparihāreṇa hi
tena pravartitavayam| anirvṛtaśca lādeśo vikaraṇotpatau na
nimitam, tena lāvasthāyāmevāḍ bhavan dhātumātrasyaiva bhavati,
tataśca tadavayavatvānna tasyaiva vayavadhāyaka iti | kathaṃ
tarhyuktam--vyavadhāne'pi bhavatīti? śrutimātrāpekṣayā| kvacitu-aṭā
nāsti vyavadhānamityeva pāṭhaḥ| madhuni viśantīti aṅgabhakto num
ṇeóranavayava iti niśabdasyānarthakyam| kvacitu madhūni niviśanti
bhramarā iti śasantaṃ paṭha|lte||
padamañjarī
parivyavebhyaḥ kriyaḥ|| 1|3|18 ||
paryādaya upasargā gṛhyanta iti kathaṃ ṭhkriyaḥ' iti ṣaṣṭhī, usargaireva
paryādibhirarthadvārako viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvalakṣaṇasambandhaḥ, na ca
kriyo ce upasargāstebhyaḥ paraṃ dhātvantaraṃ sambhavatīti
krīṇāterevātmanepadaṃ bhavatīti| yadvā--paryādiviśeṣaṇāya
ṣaṣṭhīmanubhūyātmanepadasambandhe ṭhkriyaḥ'iti pañcamī sampadyate,
tadāha--ityetebhya utarasmāt krīṇāteriti|
bahuvīti| bahavo vayaḥ pakṣiṇo'sminniti bahuvrīhiḥ, karmapadaṃ
caitat, pakṣivācino viśabdasya napuṃsakatvābhāvād vibhaktyāsya
vyavadhānātkevalo nodāhṛtaḥ| nanu bahuvrīhāvapi jahatsvārthāyāṃ
vṛtau verānarthakyam, ajahastvārthāyāmapi
tadarthasyopasarjanatvamiti na bhaviṣyati ? evaṃ tarhyudāharaṇadigiyaṃ
darśitā| ida tatrodāharaṇam-ve krīṇāsi,
atraikadeśavikṛtasyānanyatvātprasaṅgaḥ, vī krīṇītaḥ- atraikādeśasya
pūrvaṃ pratyantavadbhāvātprasaṅgaḥ||
padamañjarī
viparābhyāṃ jeḥ|| 1|3|19 ||
sāhacaryāditi| dvayorddaṣṭāpacāratve'pi parasparasāhacaryādityarthaḥ|
ṭhnerviśaḥ' ityādiprakaraṇasāhacaryādvā | bahuvīti| atrāpi ve jayasi,
vī jayata ityudāhāryam| parā utkṛṣṭā| atha kathaṃ jeriti nirdeśaḥ,
yāvatā prakṛtivadanukaraṇaṃ bhavatīti ṭhaci śnudhātu'
ityādineyaṅadeśena bhavitavyam, na ca dīrgheṣu sāvakāśamiyaṇṃó
paratvād ṭhgheṇÇóti' iti guṇo bādhata iti yuktam;hṛsveṣvapi
pūrvavipratiṣedhena iyaṅ iṣṭatvāt| tathā ca ṭhkṣiyaḥ' iti nirdeśaḥ?
ucyate; dhātutvaṃ tāvadarthāśrayam--kriyāvacano dhāturiti, iha vā
vivakṣitārthaṃ rūpamātramanukṛtamiti| anukāryasyāpi dhātutvaṃ nāsti
prāgevānukaraṇasya||
padamañjarī
āṅe do'nāsyaviharaṇe|| 1|3|20 ||
yathaivāvatsā dhenurānīyatāmityukte sambhavadvatsasambandhā
godhenurevānoyate, na mahiṣyādidhenuḥ, tathehāpi
sambhavadāsyaviharaṇasya ṭhḍudāñ dāne' ityasyaiva grahaṇam, na tu
ṭhgāmādāgrahaṇeṣvaviśeṣaḥ' iti sarveṣāṃ
dārūpāṇāmityāha-āṅpūrvāddāña iti|| ādata iti | ślau
dvirvacanam, pūrvavadākāralopaḥ, dakārasya cartvam| kvacid-āṅe
ṅidriśiṣṭasya kim ? bhikkṣāmādadātīti paṭha|lte, tatra
smṛtāvākāraḥ|
āsyaviharaṇasamānakriyādapīti| kathamiha ṭhāṅe do'nāsye'itīyatā
siddhaṃ dravye dhātorvṛtyasambhavādāsyasamavāyinyāṃ kriyāyāṃ
vartamānasya samudāyasya niṣedho vijñāyate, nacaivaṃ svaṃ mukhamādata
ityatrāpi mukhaviṣayatvādānasya pratiṣedhaprasaṅgaḥ, grāhyāsya eva
samavetā kriyā, tasyāṃ vartamāno dadātirāsye vṛttirbhavati,
grahaṇantu grāhyahiṇorubhayorapi samavetam| anāsya iti paryudāsaḥ,
āsyānāsyasamudāyaścāsyādanya iti vidhireva bhaviṣyati | evaṃ siddhe
viharaṇagrahaṇaṃ viharaṇaviśeṣopalakṣārtham, tenāsatyapyāsye tāddaśe
viharaṇe bhaviṣyati yāddaśamāsyaviharaṇam āsyavyādānam|
vipādiketi | pādasphoṭaḥuvipādikā|
svāṅgakarmakācceti| svamaṅgaṃ svāṅgam na tu
pāribhāṣikamadravādilakṣaṇam| etacca nyāyasiddhamevoktam, katham ?
kartarīti vartate, āsyaśabdaścāyaṃ sambandhiśabdaḥ,
kasyāsyamityapekṣāyāṃ yasmin kartaryātmanepadaṃ tasya
cetadāsyamiti vijñāte tena parakīyāsyaviharaṇe vidhireva bhavati||
padamañjarī
krīḍo'nusaṃparibhyaśca || 1|3|21 ||
māṇavakamanukrīḍatīti| māṇavakena saha krīḍatītyarthaḥ| ṭhtṛtīyārtha'
ityanuḥ karmapravacanīyasaṃjñakaḥ| karmapravacanīyasaṃjñakaḥ| āgameriti
ṇyantasyedaṃ grahaṇam| āgamayasva tāvaditi| sahasva kañcitkālaṃ mā
tvariṣṭhā ityarthaḥ|
śikṣeriti| ṭhśikṣa vidyopādāne' ityasyānudatetvādeva siddhamiti
śakeḥ sannantasya grahaṇam| śikṣata iti| ṭhsani mīmāghu' ityaca is,
ṭhskoḥ saṃyogādyoḥ' iti salopaḥ, ṭhatra lopo'bhyāsasya'
dhanurviṣaye jñāne śaktau bhavitumicchatītyarthaḥ| kriyāviṣayo hi
śakeḥ prayogaḥ- bhoktuaṃ śaknoti, gantuṃ śaknotīti| tadiha jñānaṃ
viṣayaḥ, ātmanepadenaiva jñānaviṣayatvasya gamitatvājjñānamiti na
prayujyate|
āśiṣi nātha iti| ṭhnāthṛ nādhṛ yācñopatāpaiśvaryāśīḥṣu'
anudātet| niyamārthatu vacanam-āśiṣyeva yathā syād yāñcādiṣu
mā bhūditi| anudātetvaṃ yujartham| sarpiṣo nātha iti | ṭhāśiṣi
nāthaḥ' iti karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī sarpirme bhūyādityāśāsta ityarthaḥ|
harateriti| gatiḥ prakāraḥ| paitṛkamiti| piturāgataṃ prakāraṃ satataṃ
śīlayantītyarthaḥ ṭhṛtaṣṭhañ'| pratyudāharaṇe sāddaśyamātraṃ vikṣitam,
na prakāratācchīlyam|
kirateriti| vikṣepārthaḥ kiratiḥ| harṣādayastu viṣayatvenopatāḥ |
tatra harṣo vikṣepasya kāraṇam| jīvikākulāyakaraṇe tu phalam|
eteṣvartheṣu apāccatuṣpāt iti susuḍvidhīyate| āpṛcchata iti|
ṭhpraccha jñīpsāyām' tudādiḥ, grahītyādinā samprasāraṇam| vācā
śarīsparśanamiti | ṭhtvatpādau spṛśāmi, naitanmayā kṛtam'
ityevaṃrūpaḥ śapathaviśeṣaḥ| devadatāyeti| ṭhślāghahnuṅsthāśapām'
iti sampradānasaṃjñā || 
padamañjarī
samavapravibhyaḥ syaḥ|| 1|3|22 ||
santiṣṭhata iti| pāghrādisūtreṇa tiṣṭhādeśaḥ| atrāpyupasargagrahaṇādiha
na bhavati-ve tiṣṭhasi, vī tiṣṭhata iti|
astiṃ sakāramiti| śtaḥ santītyādau sakāramātrasya darśanāt ṭhsa
bhuvi' ityave dhātuḥ pāṭhayaḥ, astītyādau piti sārvadhātuke
aḍāgamo vidheyaḥ, āstām āsannityādau āḍāgamaḥ syāt" iti
āpiśalā manyante | guṇasya tvāgamatve udāharaṇaṃ mṛgyam||
padamañjarī
prakāśanastheyākhyayośca|| 1|3|23 ||
svābhiprāyakathanamiti| kathanamāviṣkaraṇamātraṃ na tu śabdenaiva,
tenābhāṣamāṇāyāmapi kanyakāyāṃ bhavati| tiṣṭhatyasminniti|
prakaraṇādinātra vivādapadanirṇetuḥ pratītiḥ, na tu śābdīti
vigrahavākye ātmanepadaṃ na kṛtam| saṃśayya karṇādiṣviti|
saṃśayasthāneṣu karṇādīn nirṇetṛtvenāśrayatītyarthaḥ|| 
padamañjarī
udo'nūrdhvakarmaṇi|| 1|3|24 ||
karmaśabdaḥ kriyāvācīti| sādhanakarmaṇi dhātorvṛtyasambhavāditi
bhāvaḥ| uda īhāyāmiti | īhāuparispandaḥ| īhāgrahaṇamityādi|
īhātmakaṃ yadanūrdhvakarma ityevamanūrdhvakarmaṇa eva
viśeṣaṇamīhāgrahaṇam, na punaranūrdhvakarmagrahaṇamapanīya īhāgrahaṇaṃ
kartavyamityucyate ityarthaḥ| tathā hi satyāsanādutiṣṭhatītyatrāpi
syāt, parispandarūpatvādutthānasyeti bhāvaḥ| uda
īhāyāmityetatkarmagrahaṇāt siddhamityāhuḥ| katham? ṭhīhā'nūrdhva'
ityetāvatā'nūrdhvatāviśiṣṭṃa kriyāvācitvaṃ siddham, dhātoḥ
kriyāvācitvāt| evaṃ siddhe karmagrahaṇāllokaprasiddhaṃ parispandātmakaṃ
karma gṛhyata iti||
padamañjarī
upānmantrakaraṇe|| 1|3|25 ||
pāribhāṣikamatra karaṇaṃ gṛhyate, mantraḥ karaṇaṃ yasyārthasya
tasminvartamānādityarthaḥ|
upādityādi| amantrakaraṇārthamidam| saṅgatakaraṇamupaśleṣa iti|
vināpi maitrīsambandhāt| stru ghnamupatiṣṭhate iti| prāpnotityarthaḥ| 
bhikṣuka iti| lipsayā hetubhūtayā brahmaṇakulamupagacchatītyarthaḥ|| 
padamañjarī 
akarmakācca|| 1|3|26 ||
atrāsambhavāt kriyā karma na gṛhyate, na hyāsti sambhavaḥudhātuśca
bhavatyakriyāvacanaśceti|| nanu ca
sādhanakarmaṇāmyakarmakatvamavyabhicārādaviśeṣaṇam, na hi
śabdātmakasya dhātoḥ karmaṇā yogaviyogau sambhavataḥ, sādhanayogasya
kriyādharmatvādata āha-akarmakakriyāvacanāditi| etenādvārakametad
dhātorviśeṣaṇamiti darśayati| yāvadbhuktamiti| yathārthe
yadavyayamiti vīpsāyāmavyayībhāvaḥ| saptamyantaṃ caitat| saṃnidhīyata
ityartha iti| bhāve lakāraḥ| arthatovyākhyānaṃ caitat-yo hyupatiṣṭhate
sa saṃnidhate, yaśca saṃnidhate tena saṃnidhīyate|
akamakāditi kimiti| pūrvasūtre ṭhupāt' iti yogavibhāgādiṣṭasya
siddhaṃpaśyati| na caivamatiprasaṅgaḥ, ṭhmantrakaraṇe' ityasya
niyamārthatvāt-sakarmakādyadi bhavati mantrakaraṇa eveti|
rājānamupatiṣṭhatīti| viparīto'pi niyamaḥ syāt-karaṇe yadi
bhavati mantrakaraṇa eveti, tataścātra syādeveti bhāvaḥ|| 
padamañjarī
udvibhyāṃ tapaḥ|| 1|3|27 ||
utapati suvarṇamityatra santāpane vilāpane vā tapirvartata iti
sakarmakatvam|
svamaṅgaṃ svāṅgamiti| yasminkartaryātmanepadaṃ tasya cet
svamaṅgamityarthaḥ| yadyanvarthagrahaṇam? tato'prāṇinyapi kartari yasya
yadaṅgaṃ tatkarmakādapi prasaṅgaḥ| pāribhāṣike tveṣa doṣo na
bhavati; tasya prāṇisthatvāt| anvarthe'pi na doṣaḥ, tapeḥ
prāṇikartṛkatvāt| pāribhāṣikasya tvasambandhiśabdatvāt
kartuścetsvamaṅgamityevaṃ na pratīyeteti bhāvaḥ||
padamañjarī
āṅe yamahanaḥ|| 1|3|28 ||
āhateti|ṭhanudātopadeśa'ityanunāsikalopaḥ| āghnata iti|
pūrvavadādeśopadhālopau kutvaṃ ca | āhanti śiraḥ parakīyamiti|
ṭhājaghne viṣamavilocanasya vakṣaḥ' ityatra tu gāṇḍīvī
viṣamavilocanasya vakṣa etya svaṃ vakṣo hatavānityarthaḥ |
mallo'pyutsāhavardhanāya svaṃ vakṣa etya evaṃ vakṣo hatavānityarthaḥ|
mallo'pyutsāhavardhanāya svaṃ vakṣa āspālayati|| 
padamañjarī
samo gamyṛcchipracchisvaratyartiśruvidibhyaḥ|| 1|3|29 ||
ṭhsamo gamyacchibhyām' ityetāvatsūtram| pracchayādayastu
vārtikaddaṣṭāḥ sūtrarūpeṇa paṭhitāḥ, sūtrakāravadvārtikakāro'pi
śāstrasya kartā, na vyākhyāteti darśayitum| tatra hīti|
utarārthamanuvartamānamapi yogavibhāgasāmarthyāt tatra na sambadhyata
ityarthaḥ|
na lābhārthasyeti| satāvicāraṇārthayostvanudātetvādātmanepadena
bhāvyameveti bhāvaḥ| ddaśeścetyādi| idaṃ vaktavyarūpeṇaiva paṭhitam|
vicitrā hi vṛteḥ kṛtiḥ vṛttikāreṇa| athāsminnakarmakādhikāre ye
sakarmakā hanigamiprabhṛtayaḥ, teṣāṃ kathamakarmakatvam? ucyate--
dhātorarthāntare vṛterdhātvarthenopasaṃgrahāt|
prasidveravivakṣātaḥ karmaṇo'karmikā kriyā||
vahati bhāramiti-prāpaṇe sakarmako vahiḥ, syandane tvakarmakaḥ|
vahanti nadya iti--prāpaṇe sakarmako vahiḥ, syandane tvakarmakaḥ| vahanti
nadya iti--prāṇaviśiṣṭṃa dhāraṇaṃ jīvatirāha,tatra prāṇānāṃ
dhātunaivopātatvānna tena karmaṇā sakarmakatvam, na ca prāṇakarmake
dhāraṇe'nyasya karmatvamiti jīvatirakarmakaḥ|
prasiddheryathā--varṣatītyanupāte karmāntare niyamena jalaṃ pratīyata
iti na tena sakarmakatvam, tena ṭhvṛṣṭe deve' iti kartari kto
bhavati| vyabhacāriṇā tu rudhirādinā sakarmaka evaḥ rudhiraṃ varṣati,
śarānvarṣatīti | karmavivakṣāyāṃ tatkarmikaiva kriyā pratiṣiddhā syād,
na pākamātramityavivakṣā karmaṇaḥ|| 
padamañjarī
nisamupavibhyo hvaḥ|| 1|3|30 ||
nihvayate iti| kathaṃ punaratrātmanepadam, yāvatā ṭhhvā'
ityākārāntādiyaṃ pañcami, ekārāntaścāyam, na ca vikṛtiḥ prakṛtiṃ
saṃgṛhṇāti? satyam; ākārāntātpañcamī, na tvidaṃ
prayogasthasyākārāntasyānukaraṇam, kiṃ tarhi?
dhātupāṭhe'vasthitaikārāntasya tasyaiva lakṣaṇavaśādātvam| na
cātukriyamāṇarūpavināśaprasaṅgaḥ; śāstravāsanayā tasyaiva pratīteḥ,
yathā--ṭhyasyeti ca' itīkārākārayoḥ||
padamañjarī
sparddhāyāmāṅḥ|| 1|3|31 ||
saviṣaya iti | hetubhāvena ca viṣayatvam, ata eva hetau śānac
prayuktaḥ| sparddhamānastasyāhvānamiti| śabdakriya eveti| yadyapi
sparddhāyāṃ paṭha|lte, tathāpyāṅpūrvastatra na vartate, kiṃ tarhi?
śabdanakriyāvācītyarthaḥ||
padamañjarī
gandhanāvakṣepaṇasevanasāhasikyapratiyatnaprakathanopayogeṣu kṛñaḥ||
1|3|32 ||
apakāraprayuktamiti apakāreṇa prayuktamanena me'pakṛtamityetayā
buddhyā kṛtamityarthaḥ| atha vā--kathaṃ mayā'pakṛtaṃ syāditi buddhyā
pravartitamityarthaḥ| hisātmakamiti| sūcitasya vadhabandhanādikā hiṃsā,
iha tu tatkaraṇatvātsūcanameva hiṃsā svabhāvamityuktam| kathaṃ
punarjñāyate gandhanaṃ hiṃsātmakamityata āha-- tathā hīti|
curādāviti| svabhāvānuvādaḥ| sāhasikyamiti| sahasā vartate
sāhasikaḥ ṭhojaḥsahombhasā vartate' iti ṭhak, tasya karmaṇi ṣyañ |
vartikāuśakuniviśeṣaḥ| edhodakasyeti| samāhāradvandvaḥ| ṭhkṛñaḥ
pratiyatne' iti ṣaṣṭhī| upaskuruta iti| ṭhupātpratiyatna' ityādinā
suṭ||
padamañjarī
adheḥ prasahane|| 1|3|33 ||
prasāhanamabhibhava iti| ṭhsā sāhayā yudhā nṛbhiḥ pṛtanāṣāḍ' ityādau
darśanāt| kecitu ṭhṣaha marṣaṇe'bhibhave cchandasi' iti paṭhanti, tatra
ṭhcchandasi' iti prāyikaṃ draṣṭavyam| aparājayo veti| parājetuṃ
samarthasyaiva kṣamayā yastadabhāvaḥ sa ityarthaḥ| tathā ca bhāraviḥ-
ṭhbhavāddaśāścedadhikurvate parān' iti,
bhavāddaśāścetparānadhikurvateu kṣamayā na parājayante, kṣamanta ityarthaḥ,
tadahana vā tena parājita ityartha iti| tenātmanepadavācyena kartrā
tamityedvācyaḥ karmabhūto na parājita ityarthaḥ|
pṛthagyogakaraṇamityādi| prakathanopayogaprasahaneṣu ṭhadheḥ'
ityucyamāne gandhanādiṣvapi adhipūrvādeva syāt| atha tatrādhigrahaṇaṃ
na kriyeta, prasahane'pyadhyabhāve'pi prasaṅgaḥ;ata utsargeṇa prasahanaṃ
viśeṣayisyāmīti prasahane vā utsargaṃ viśeṣayiṣyāmīti
yogavibhāga ityarthaḥ||
padamañjarī
veḥ śabdakarmaṇaḥ|| 1|3|34 ||
ṭhudo'nūrdhvakarmaṇi' ityādivat karmaśabdaḥ kriyāvācī mā
vijñāyītyāha-- karmaśabda ityādi| vipūrvasya karoteḥ śabdakriyāyāṃ
vṛtyasambhavāt, kṛtrimasambhave laukikasya grahaṇāyogācca| kiṃca ṭhveḥ
śabdaḥ' ityeva vaktavyam, karmagrahaṇamanarthakam, vikareti paya iti
sakarmakatvād utareṇāpi na bhavati||
padamañjarī
akarmakācca|| 1|3|35 ||
odanasya pūrṇā iti| suhitārthayoge ṣaṣṭhī bhavati, jñāpanāt,
yadayaṃ pūraṇaguṇasuhitārtheti suhitārthayoge yā ṣaṣṭhī sā na
samasyata ityāha, tajjñāpayatyācāryaḥ- bhavati suhitārthayoge
ṣaṣṭhīti| akarmakāditi kimiti| pūrvasūtre veriti
yogavibhāgeneṣṭasiddhiṃ manyate, na caivamatiprasaṅgaḥ, śabdakarmaṇa
ityasya niyamārthatvāt--karmaṇi yadi bhavati śabda eveti, kaṭṃa
vikarotīti| viparīto'pi niyamaḥ sambhāvyeta-śabde yadi bhavati
karmaṇyeveti, tataścātrāpi syāditi bhāvaḥ||
padamañjarī
sammānanotsañjānācāryakaraṇajñānamṛtivigaṇanavyayeṣu niyaḥ|| 1|3|36
||
sammānanādiṣuviśeṣaṇeṣu satsviti| yuktaṃ
sammānanācāryakaraṇavetanānāṃ viśeṣaṇatvam, tatra hi prāpaṇameva
dhātvarthaḥ, sammānanādīni tu tameva viṣayatayā vyavacchindanti|
utsañjanādīnāṃ tvayuktam; teṣāmeva dhātvarthatvāt,
