tadvyatiriktasya viśeṣyasyāsambhavāt, ucyate;
sammānanāderutsañjanādeśca viśeṣaṇatvaṃ samānaṃ pūrvoktaṃ
dhātvarthaviśeṣaṇam, utarastu dhātuviśeṣaṇamiti viśeṣyamātraṃ
bhidyate, ataḥ suṣṭhūaktam--sammānanādiṣu viśeṣaṇeṣviti| cārvi
buddhiriti| cāruśabdāt ṭhvoto guṇavacanāt'iti ṅīṣ|
ācāryo'pi cārvīti | yathā yaṣṭīḥ praveśayeti
puruṣeṣvajahatsvaliṅga eva yaṣṭiśabdaḥ, tadvaccārvīśabdaḥ| te
yuktibhirityādi| pūrvasmin vākye guṇabhāvenāpi prakṛte| te
śiṣyāḥ yuktibhiḥ pratipādyamānāḥ, niṣpādyamānā ityarthaḥ| sthāpyamānā
iti tu vyākhyāne padārthānāmacetanatvāt na mukhyaṃ sammānanam|
utkṣipatītyartha iti| tenotsañjanaṃ nayaterartha iti darśayati|
ācāryakaraṇamācāryakriyeti| sūtravṛtau ca kāraṇāvasthāyā
vivakṣitatvāt cviḥ prāpto'pi vikalpādhikārānna kṛtaḥ| tathā
cācāryīkurvanniti cviḥ prayuktaḥ| nanupanayanaṃ māṇavakasya saṃskāraḥ,
yenāsāvadhyayane yogyo bhavati, na tvanenācārye kaścidatiśayo
janyate; ācāryaśabdasya tu pravṛttinimitamupanīyādhyāpanaṃ nāma
kriyāviśeṣaḥ, yathopādhyāyaśabdasyaikadeśādhyāpanaṃ
tatkathamācāryakaraṇa ātmanepadaṃ vidhīyate ityata
āha--māṇavakamīddaśenetyādi | evaṃ
manyate--upaniyādhyāpanenāddaṣṭarūpaḥ kaścidatiśaya ācārye janyate,
tadeva pravṛttinimitamācāryaśabdasyeti tadāha--svayamācāryaḥ
sampadyate iti | ṭhātmānamācāryīkurvan' iti ca hetulakṣaṇe laṭaḥ
śatrādeśaḥ| īddaśeneti | yāddaśaḥ śāstrokto vidhistāddaśenetyarthaḥ|
nanu yadyācāryakamupanayanasya prayojanaṃ tatkartrabhiprāyamiti nārtha
ācāryakaraṇa ātmanepadavidhānena? ucyate; nopanayanenācāryakaṃ
janyate, kiṃ tarhi? tatpūrvakeṇādhyayanena| upanayanakriyāyāstu
māṇavakasaṃskāraḥ sākṣātphalam| evaṃ saṃskṛtasya māṇavakasya
yadadhyāpanaṃ tenācāryakaṃ janyate iti na tadupanayanāyaḥ kriyāyāḥ
phalam| pacca tasyāḥ phalaṃ tanmāṇavakagāmi, na kartṛgāmi|
niścinotītyartha iti | anena jñānaṃ nayaterartha ityāha| kāraṃ
vinayate iti| kara eva kāraḥ, prajñādiḥ, rājagrāhyae bhāgaḥ karṣakaiḥ
kalpitaḥ||
padamañjarī
kartṛsthe cāśarīre karmaṇi|| 1|3|37 ||
nayaterātmanepadavidhānātatsambandhyeva kartā lakāravācyaḥ pratyāsanno
gṛhyata ityāha--nayateḥ karteti| tadekadeśo'pi śarīramiti|
apiśabdo'vadhāraṇe| iha śarīrasyaiva caitanyaviśiṣṭasya kartṛtvaṃ
laukikāḥ pratiyanti, na tadvyatiriktasya buddhīndriyādimataścatanasya
| na ca śarīramevaśarīrasthaṃ bhavati, atastadekadeśa eva tadgrahaṇena
gṛhyate ityarthaḥ| atra krodhādyapanayanaphalaṃ kartrabhiprāyamiti
ṭhsvaritañitaḥ'ityeva siddhe niyamārthamidam-- kartṛsthe
karmaṇyaśarīrastha eveti | atha katham ṭhvigaṇyya nayanti pauruṣaṃ
vijitakrodharayā jigīṣavaḥ' iti? kecidāhuḥ-apagame
vartamānādidamātmanepadavidhānaṃ bhavati, atra tu karotyarthe prāptyarthe
prāptyarthe vā vartate, anekārthatvāddhātūnāmiti||
padamañjarī
vṛttisargatāyaneṣu kramaḥ|| 1|3|38 ||
sarga utsāha iti | ṭhsṛṣṭaścedbrāhmaṇavadhe', ṭhyenendralokāpajayāya
sṛṣṭaḥ'ityādau darśanātsṛjirutsahārthaḥ| vṛtyādiṣviti kim?
apakrāmati||
padamañjarī
upaparābhyām|| 1|3|39 ||
upaparābhyāmiti māṇavakaḥ kutupamiti| upasarganiyamaḥ kimartha
ityarthaḥ| saṃkrāmatīti| ṭhkramaḥ parasmaipadeṣu' iti dīrghaḥ||
padamañjarī
āṅ udramane|| 1|3|40 ||
ākrāmati māṇavakaḥ kutupamiti| avaṣṭabhnātītyarthaḥ| hrasvā kutūḥ
kutupaḥ, ṭhkutvā ḍupac'| kutupamiti pāṭhe kutapo darbhasaṃstaraḥ|
ākrāmati dhūmo harmyatalamiti| udramanapūrvikāyāṃ vyāptāvatra
kramirdraṣṭavyaḥ| iha tu ṭhnabhaḥ samākrāmati candramāḥ kramāt' iti
kramirvyāptau vartate; nodramane||
padamañjarī
veḥ pādaviharaṇe|| 1|3|41 ||
vikrāmatyajinasandhiriti| dvidhā bhavati, sphuṭatītyarthaḥ|| 
padamañcarī
propābhyāṃ samarthābhyām|| 1|3|42 ||
anyo'nyasāhacaryātpropayorupasargayorgrahaṇam, na
prātipadikāntakarmapravacanīyayoḥ, nāpi kriyāntarasambandhinoḥ,
nāpyanarthakayorityāha-pra upa ityetābhyāmupasargabhyāmiti|
tulyārthāviti| etena samo'rtho yayoritisamarthau,
śakandhvāditvātpararūpam, saṃśabdasyaiva
vā'nekārthatvātulyārthatvamiti darśayati| nanu ṭhsamarthaḥ
padavidhiḥ'ityādau sambandhārthatvaṃ prasiddham, satyam; iha tu dhātvartha
prati pāratantryānna paraspareṇa sambandhārthatvam | dhātunā
copasargayoḥ sambandho'vyabhicārī, tasmātpūrvokta evārthaḥ| prakramate
iti | ārabhata ityarthaḥ||
padamañjarī
anupasargadvā|| 1|3|43 ||
aprāptavibhāṣeyamiti| ṭhupaparābhyām' ityasya niyamārthatvād
vṛtyādisūtramanupasargaviṣayameveti na tatrāyaṃ vikalpa iti bhāvaḥ||
padamañjarī
apahrave jñaḥ|| 1|3|44 ||
śeṣādityādi| asatyasmin sūtre ayamaviśeṣa eva bhavatīti bhāvaḥ|
sopasargāśceti| tena ṭhanupasargāj jñaḥ' ityanena kartrabhiprāye
kriyāphale na siddhyatīti bhāvaḥ| upajānīte iti | ṭhjñājanorjā'||
padamañjarī
akarmakācca|| 1|3|45 ||
akartramiprāyārtamidamiti| atha kartrabhiprāye katham,
tatrāha-kartrabhiprāyo hīti| nanu
sopasargātkartrabhiprāye'pyanenaivātmanepadameṣitavyam--auṣadhasyānujānīte, auṣadhasyānujijñāsata iti; tasmātsarpiṣo jānīte ityudāharaṇābhiprāyametadvetavyam| kathaṃ cāyamakarmaka iti| ṭhsarpiṣaḥ' iti karmaṇi śeṣatvena ṣaṣṭhī, na māṣāṇāmaśnīyāditivat| tena sarpirādinā jñeyena sakarmaka iti matvā praśnaḥ|
akarmakāditi kimiti| yadi sarpirādi karaṇatvena vivikṣitam, tarhi
karaṇāditi vaktavyamityabhiprāyaḥ| evamucyamāne sakarmakādapi
syādeveti darśayatisvareṇeti||
padamañjarī
sampratibhyāmanādhyāne|| 1|3|46 ||
utkaṇṭhāsmaraṇam utkaṇṭhāpūrvakaṃ smaraṇam| māturiti|
ṭhadhīgarthadayeśām'iti ṣaṣṭhī | nanu ṭhśeṣa' iti tatrānuvartate, tena
karma śeṣatvena vivakṣitavyamiti
akarmakatvātpūrveṇātrātmanepadaprasaṅgaḥ| ṭhanādhyāne' ityasya tu
mātaraṃ saṃjānātīti vyāvartyaṃ syādyatra karmataiva vivakṣitā, naiṣa
doṣaḥ; ṭhanādhyāne'iti vibhajyate, tena pūrvayogasyāpi śeṣo
bhaviṣyati||
padamañjarī
bhāsanopasaṃbhāṣājñānayatnavimatyupamantraṇeṣu vadaḥ|| 1|3|47 ||
bhāsanādiṣviti| atrāpi kiñciddhātorviśeṣaṇam, kiñciddhātvarthasya|
upasāntvanam u upacchandanam, dhātoḥ, bhāsanādi dhātvarthasya |
bhāsamāna iti | hetau laṭaḥ śānajādeśaprayogeṇa bhāsanaṃ hetutvena
viśeṣaṇamityāha | śiṣyaiḥ stūyamāno bhāsate| tathā coparyupari
śāstrārthasya pratibhāsanāt suṣṭhua vadanaṃ bhavati, tejobhaṅge tu na
śaknuyādvaditum| jānāti vaditumiti| ṭhśakavṛṣa' ityādinā
tumun, atra vadatyartho jñānasya viṣayaḥ, jñānaṃ viṣayi|
tadviṣayamityādi| atra yatnasyāviṣkaraṇarūpasya vadatyarthasya karma|
vimatipatitā iti hetugarbhaviśeṣaṇaṃ prayuñjāno vimatirhetutvena
viśeṣaṇamityāha| vimatau hi satyāṃ vicitrabhāṣaṇarūpo vadatyartho
nivartate| upacchandayatīti| ṭhbhadre bhajasva mās, idaṃ te dāsyāmi'
iti, svābhilaṣite pravartayatītyarthaḥ|| 
padamañjarī
vyaktavācāṃ samuccāraṇe|| 1|3|48 ||
manuṣyāḥ prasiddhā iti| yadyapi kukkuṭādirutamapisvarūpema
vyaktam-asyedaṃ rutamasyedamiti| manuṣyavāktu vyaktatarā bhavati,
varṇātmakatvād, arthāvagatihetutvācca, atasta eva gṛhyante|
śukaśārikādīnāṃ tu puruṣaprayatnavaśena kvācitkaṃ vyaktavāktvam, na
svabhāvikamiti ne teṣāṃ grahaṇam|
varatanu sampravadanti kukkuṭā iti|
apanaya pādasarojamaṅkataḥ, śithilaya bāhulatāṃ galāddatām|
kva ca vadanāa'śukamākulīkṛtam,||||||iti pūrvapādāḥ|
kv citu kṛtsna eva ślokaḥ paṭha|lte, tatra varatanuriti bahuvrīhau
yadi hrasvantastanuśabdaḥ, tataḥ ṭhsaṃbuddhau ca' iti guṇaprasaṅgaḥ,
dīrghānte tu nadīlakṣaṇaḥ kap prāpnoti| kecidāhaḥ-tanuśabdaḥ
strījātau kavibhiḥ prayujyate, tasmād ṭhūṇutaḥ' iti ūiṅ kṛte
karmadhārayo'yamiti||
padamañjarī
anorakarmakāt|| 1|3|49 ||
vyaktavācāmiti vartata iti| na tu samuccāraṇa iti sarvānuvṛtau
vacanamidamanarthakaṃ syāditi bhāvaḥ| tadvyaktavāksambandhino
vaderiti sūtrārthamāha--vyaktavāgviṣayādidi| anuḥ sāddaśye iti|
tena kalāpasyeti tulyārthayoge śeṣalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhīti bhāvaḥ|
yathetyādi| vadanamātrasāddaśye tātparyamiti karma na vivakṣitamiti
bhāvaḥ| anuvadati| punarvadatītyarthaḥ||
padamañjarī
vibhāṣā vipralāpe|| 1|3|50 ||
saṃvatsarān vadantīti sāṃvatsarāḥujyautiṣikāḥ| evaṃ mauhūrtikāḥ||
padamañjarī
avād graḥ|| 1|3|51 ||
ṭhgiraḥ' iti pāṭhe dhātvanukaraṇatvād vibhaktāvitvam | ṭhgraḥ'iti tu
pāṭhe rūpamātrānukaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam| tasya hyavapūrvasyeti|
niyataviṣayāṇyapi kriyāviśeṣaṇāni bhavanti, yathā--uryādayaḥ
kṛbhvastibhyo'nyaviṣayā na bhavantīti bhāvaḥ||
padamañjarī
samaḥ pratijñāte|| 1|3|52 ||
pratijñānamabhyupagama iti | kecidāhuḥ-"paropadeśanirapekṣamātmanaiva
vipratipannasya pakṣaghya parigraho'bhyupagamaḥ, pareṇa prārthitasyārthasya
niyamavacanam ṭhetāvaddāsyāmi' iti, ṭhasminkāle dāsyāmi'
ityevaṃrūpaḥ pratiśravaḥ| pareṇa yuktyā sādhitasyārthasya
sammānnam--samīcīnamuktamatra bhavatetyevaṃ rūpamaṅgīkaraṇamiti,
pratijñāsāmānyāvāntarabhedā ete, na tu paryāyāḥ" iti| vṛttikārastu
parasparaviṣayo'ṅgīkaraṇādivyahāradarśanāt paryāyatvameva
manyate||
padamañjarī
udaścaraḥ sakarmakāt|| 1|3|53 ||
utkramyeti ullaṅghayetyarthaḥ| uccaratīti upariṣṭad gacchatītyarthaḥ||
padamañjarī
samastṛtīyāyuktāt|| 1|3|54||
vibhaktirgṛ hyate iti | tatraiva tṛtīyāśabdasya mukhyatvāt | yadyevam,
tayā saha dhātoḥ sambandho na bhavati; na hi tṛtīyā dhātuvācyā,
nāpi dhātustṛtīyānta ityata āha-tayetyādi| tṛtīyārthena
dhātvarthasya yogādaupacāriko dhātostṛtīyāyoga ityarthaḥ|
yadyapyatreti| na hi ceṣṭārūpasañcaraṇamantarema karaṇaṃ sambhavati,
ato'śrute'pi karaṇapade tapasā śrutena veti
gamyamānatvātadarthayogasya sambhavaḥ| tṛtīyā tviti| etadarthameva hi
pūrvamuktam--vibhaktirgṛ hyata iti| tṛtīyāyuktāditi vā'narthakaṃ
stāt| yadi tadarthayogaḥ syāt, sarvatraivaṃ tadarthabhāvāditi bhāvaḥ||

padamañjarī
dāṇaśca sā ceccaturthyarthe|| 1|3|55 ||
vaktavyamevaitaditi| sūtre cecchabdaścaśabdaścārthe,
anekārthatvānnipānāmiti| kecid-dāṇastṛtīyāyuktādātmanepadaṃ
bhavati, sā ca tṛtīyā caturthyaveditavyācakṣate; evamapi
ṭhaśiṣṭavyavahāre' iti vaktavyameva, aśiṣṭānāṃ saṅkīrṇācārāṇāṃ
yo vyavahāra ācāraḥ tasminnityarthaḥ| dāsyā samprayacchata iti | yo
dāsyā saha bhuñjānastayā dataṃ svayaṃ ca tasyai dadāti tadviṣayo'yaṃ
prayoga ityāhuḥ| kathamātmanepadamiti| na kathañcit,
ṭhtasmādityutarasya' ityatra nirdiṣṭagrahaṇasyānantaryārthatvāditi bhāvaḥ|
viśeṣaṇaṣaṣṭhīti | evaṃ ca pūrvasūtre'pyaśvena samudācarata
ityādāvapi bhavitavyam||
padamañjarī
upādyamaḥ svakaraṇe|| 1|3|56 ||
iha svasya sato rūpāntareṇa yatkaraṇaṃ tatsvakaraṇamiti na gṛhyate, kiṃ
tarhi? yadā'svaṃ svaṃ karoti tadā bhavitavyam, cvipratyayastu
vikalpitatvānna bhavati| pāṇigrahaṇaviśiṣṭamiti| pāṇigrahaṇaṃ nāma
kaścitkanyāsaṃskārastadviśiṣṭamityarthaḥ| bhāṣye tu-asvasya sataḥ
svatvāpādanameva svakaraṇamityuktam| bhaṭṭikāvye'pi tadanuguṇaḥ
prayogaḥ- upāyaṃsta mahāstrāṇi, upāyaṃsata nāsatam, nopāyaṃsta
daśānana iti| devadato yajñadatasya bhāryāmupayacchati,
yajñadatasambandhinīṃ bhāryāṃ dāsyādirūpeṇa svīkarotītyarthaḥ|
pāṇigrahaṇābhāvād vṛttikāramate yuktaṃ pratyudāharaṇ,
bhāṣyakāramate tvatrāpi bhavitavyam||
padamañjarī
jñāśrusmṛkaddaśaṃ sanaḥ|| 1|3|57 ||
śruddaśorapauti| śruvaḥ sūtra eva nirdeśād ddaśa upasaṃkhyānāt||
padamañjarī
nānorjñaḥ|| 1|3|58 ||
pūrveṇeti| anantarasūtreṇa yatprāptaṃ tatpratiṣidhyate, kuta etat?
ṭhanantarasya vidhirvā bhavati pratiṣedho vā' iti| tathā ceti|
anantarasya pratiṣedha ityuktam, evaṃ sati sakarmakasyaivāyaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ
sampadyate, anantarayogasya sakarmakaviṣayatvād, akarmakāviṣayatvād
ṭhakarmakācca' iti prāgeva vihitatvāt| tenākarmakāt
ṭhpūrvavatsanaḥ' ityātmanepadaṃ bhavatyeva-auṣadhasyānujijñāsata iti|
auṣadhena pravartitumicchatītyarthaḥ||
padamañjarī
pratyāṅbhyā śruvaḥ|| 1|3|59 ||
upasargagrahaṇaṃ cedamiti| parasparasāhacaryāt| devadataṃ pratīti|
ṭhlakṣaṇetthaṃbhūta' ityādinā pratiḥ karmapravacanīyaḥ, nopasargaḥ||
padamañjarī
śadeḥ śitaḥ|| 1|3|60 ||
yadyatra śadeḥ paro yaḥ śit, tata ātmanepadaṃ bhavatītyevaṃ vyadhikaraṇe
pañcamyāvāśritya vyākhyāyeta, tato'pi vikaraṇe satyanena vidhinā
bhavitavyam| sārvadhātuke ca parato vidhīyate, tataśca
prāgevāsmadvidheḥ sārvadhātukaṃ bhavaccheṣatvatparasmaipadaṃ syāt,
tasmiṃśca sati tannimite śiti vikaraṇe kṛte parasmaipadasya
nivṛttirna siddhyet| na hi nirvṛtasya nirvṛttirvacanaśatenāpi
śakyate kartumiti-imaṃ vyadhikaraṇapakṣe doṣaṃ ddaṣṭvā
sāmānādhikaraṇye pañcamyāviti darśayannāha-śadiryaḥ śiditi| kathaṃ
punaḥ śadiḥ śidbhavatī, vikaraṇe hi śakāra id bhavati,
tatrāha-śidbhāvīti | śidbhāvī yasmāt sa tathoktaḥ|
śidbhāvitvād upacāreṇa śadireva śidityuktamityarthaḥ| śito vā
sambandhīti | ṭhśitaḥ' ityasya ṣaṣṭha|lntatāṃ darśayati| kaśca śadiḥ śitaḥ
sambandhī? yastasya prakṛtiḥ| prāgeva ca śidutpattiyogyatayā
tatprakṛtitvamastyeva | śīyata iti | pāghrādisūtreṇa śīyādeśaḥ|| 
padamañjarī
mriyaterluṅliṅeśca || 1|3|61 ||
luṅliṅeḥ iti sthānaṣaṣṭhīyam, viṣayasaptamī vā| niyamārthamiti|
yadi niyamaḥ kriyate, ṅtkiraṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā'prāpte
vidhiravāstu? iha mā hi mṛteti luṅ ṭhtāsyinudātet' iti
ṅllikṣaṇaḥ sārvadhātukanighāto yathā syāt| tiṅnighāto'tra ṭhhi
ca' iti pratiṣiddhaḥ||
padamañjarī
pūrvatsanaḥ|| 1|3|62 ||
pūrvavaditi| ṭhtena tulyam' ityādinā tṛtīyacāntādvatiḥ, na
pañcamyantāt; lakṣaṇābhāvāt | yathā ca brāhyaṇena tulyaṃ vaiśyādadhīta
ityukte brāhmaṇādivad vaiśyādadhīte iti pañcamyartho gamyate,
tathehāpi pūrvasmādiva sanantādapyātmanepadamityartho labhyate|
ṭhtulyārthaiḥ' iti hi tṛtīyā sarvavibhaktyarthānantarbhāvayati| yadi
sanaḥ pūrvo yo dhāturiti| etena ṭhsanaḥ' iti pūrvasyāvadhinirdeśaḥ|,
na tvātmanepadāpekṣayā parapañcamīti darśayati|
yadyevam, sanantādātmanepadamiti na labhyeta, ṭhsanaḥ' ityasya
sakṛcch4%atasyāvadhinirdeśenopakṣīṇatvād, ata
āha-tadvatsanantādapīti| avadhitvenāpi tāvatsanaḥ śrutatvāt
pratyāsatyā tadantādeva vidhirvijñāyata iti bhāvaḥ| athaivaṃ kasmānna
vijñāyate sanantādātmanepadaṃ bhavati, pūrvavaditi śrauto'nvayaḥ,
tatra kutaḥ pūrvavadityapekṣāyāṃ sannihitatvātsana eva pūrvavaditi
vijñāsyata iti ? evaṃ manyate-evaṃ vijñāyamāne'yameva yogaḥ
pūrvasyāvadhiḥ sambhāvyeta, yathā-ṭhpūrvatrāsiddham' ityatra tata eva
yogāt pūrvatreti| tataścāyamarthaḥ syād-ṭhanudārtaṅtiḥ'
ityārabhyetaḥ pūrvaṃ ye dhātavo nirdiṣṭāstebhyaḥ
sanantebhyastadvadevātmanepadaṃ bhavatīti, tataścotaro vidhiḥ
sanantānna syāt-ṭhbhujo'navane',babhukṣata iti,tasmātsanaḥ
pūrvavadityeva śrauto'nvaya eṣṭavya iti| yadyayaṃ kāryātideśaḥ
śāstrātideśo vā vijñāyeta, tadā sanprakṛtau prayogāntare
ddaṣṭamityeva nimitanirapekṣaṃ kāryaṃ śāstraṃ
vātidiśyamārnīmahāpyatidiśyeta-śiśatsati, mumurṣati; śīyate,
mriyate ityatra ddaṣṭatvāditi mate'nayoḥ pakṣayordoṣaṃ ddaṣṭvā
nimitātideśamāśrityāha-yena nimiteneti| nimitasya
tulyatvātaddvārakaṃ yadātmanepadāvidhestulyatvaṃ tadāśrīyate
ityarthaḥ| pūrvamiti| sanutpateḥ prāk prayogāntara ityarthaḥ|
pūrvasmāditi yuktaḥ pāṭhaḥ, tathā ca sanantādapīti saṅgacchate| yadyapi
prakṛtigataṃ ṅtvāidikaṃ sanante dhātau vacanaśatenāpi
prāpayitumaśakyam nimitaṃ bhavatītyatideśārthaḥ, tāvatā ca
nimitātideśavācoyuktiḥ| āsisiṣata iti | iṭi kṛte
ṭhajāderdvitīyasya' iti siśabdasya dvirvacanam| nivivikṣata
iti|ṭhhalantācca' iti sanaḥ kitvam, vraścādiṣatvam, ṭhṣaḍhoḥ kaḥ si'|
ācikraṃsata iti | āṅ ātmanepadanimitatvāt ṭhsnukramoḥ' itīḍ
naiva bhavati|
nimitātideśāśrayaṇasya phalamāha-iheti| kāraṇamāha-na hīti |
śidādyapīti| śidbhāvitvādikamapītyarthaḥ| ādiśabdena
luṅliṅergrahaṇam, tacceha nāsti| kṛte sani tadantameva
śidbhāvi, na śadimriyatibhyāt| śiśayiṣata ityādau tu kṛte'pi
sani tadānīmapi ṅtvāidikaṃ prakṛtigataṃ vidyata iti bhāvaḥ|
yadi tarhi nimitātideśaḥ, anucikīrṣatītyatrāpi prasaṅgaḥ;
gandhanāderarthasya ṅtvisya cātmanepadanimitasya sanyapi parasmaipade
nimitatvāt| kāryātideśe tu na doṣaḥ;ṭhanuparabhyāṃ kṛñaḥ' iti
parasmepadenāpavādenātmanepadasya bādhitatvādata āha--yasya ceti |
na yogyatāmātreṇa nimitatvam, kiṃ tarhi? kurvadrūpasyeti
snukramorityatra vakṣyata iti bhāvaḥ| yadi kurvadrūpaṃ nimitam,
jugupsata ityādau katham, na hyatra prakṛtigatamanudātetvaṃ
tatrātmanepadaṃ kadācidapi karoti nityasanatvād gupādīnāmata
āha--ihetyādi| na vātrānenātmanepadam, kiṃ tarhi? ṭhanudātaṅtiḥ'
ityanenetyarthaḥ| kathaṃ punaḥ samudāyasya jugupsāderanudātetvamata
āha--avayava iti| avayave hyacāritārthaṃ liṅgaṃ sāmarthyātsamudāyasya
viśeṣakaṃ bhavati| yadyevam, gopayati tejayatītyadāvapi prasaṅgaḥ|
atha yaṃ samudāyaṃ yo'vayavo na vyabhicarati, tatra kṛtaṃ liṅgaṃ tasya
viśeṣakaṃ bhavati; ṇijantaṃ ca vyabhicarati, vināpi tena jugupsata
iti gupeḥ prayogādityucyeta| vaktavyo vā viśeṣaḥ,
ayamucyate-ṭhgupa gopane' ityasya sanvidhau grahaṇam, tasmācca nityaṃ
saneva bhavati, nāparaḥ pratyayaḥ pratyayaḥ| gopāyatītyādikastu
prayogaḥ ṭhgupū rakṣaṇe' ityasya, sa cānya eva| avaśyañcaitadevaṃ
vijñeyam-anya eva sanprakṛtiḥ tasmācca saneva bhavatīti; anyathā
nindāyā anyatra yathā ṇij bhavati tathā laṅadirapi syāt| evaṃ
tijiprabhṛtayo'pi, kṣamādyarthe yatra sanniṣyate tatrānudāteto
nityasanantāśca; kṣamādibhyo'nyatra tu tatra ṇijiṣyate tatrānanubandhakā
eva curādau paṭhitavyāḥ||
padamañjarī
āmpratyayavatkṛño'nuprayogasya || 1|3 63 ||
nanvāmantasyādhātutvādaddaṣṭamātmanepadam, tatkathaṃ
kṛño'tidiśyate? syādiyamanupapatiḥ, yadi pratyayagrahaṇaṃ na kriyate,
kṛte'pi vā tasmin pratyayagrahaṇe karmadhārayastadguṇasaṃvijñāno
vā bahuvrīhirāśrīyeta; iha tvatadguṇasaṃvijñāno
bahuvrihiḥ,dhāturanyapadārthastadāha--āmpratyayo yasmāditi| vigrahaḥ
samudāyaḥ samāsārtha iti, ām pratyayo yasyeti vagrahaḥ syāt;
pratiyogini ṣaṣṭhīnirdeśāt, ṭhtatra tasya' iti
ṣaṣṭha|lantādvatirityāha--āmpratyayasyaiveti kṛño'nuprayogasyeti|
samānādhikaraṇe ṣaṣṭhayau| anuprayogaśabdaḥ karmasādhanaḥ| īkṣāñcakra
iti |ṭhīkṣa darśane' ṭhīha ceṣṭāyām' liṭ, ṭhijādeśca' ityām,
ṭhāmaḥ' iti lerluk| ṭhakartrabhiprāyārtho'yamārambhaḥ' iti bruvatā
vidhyarthamevaitadityuktam| tatra doṣamudbhāvayitumāha--yadīti|
kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ vidhyarthatvamaṅgīkṛtya tadanuguṇo doṣa
udbhāvyate, na punarniyamārthatvamaṅgīkṛtya tadanuguṇo doṣa
udbhāvyeta? satyam; akartrabhiprāye yācayāñcakre, ubjāñcakāreti
prāpte āmpratyayavadeva, tatra vidhiniyamasambhave vidhireva jyāyān,
tasmādevamucyate--ṭhubja ārjave', ṭhunbha pūraṇe'| ubhayamityādi
parihāraḥ| kathamiti| naikenaiva yatnenobhayaṃ labhyamiti bhāvaḥ|
īkṣāmbabhūveti| ṭhbhavateraḥ' ṭhbhuvo vug luṅliṭoḥ'| kathaṃ
punariti| ṭhkṛñaḥ' ityatra svarūpagrahaṇaṃ manyamānasya praśnaḥ|
pratyāhāragrahaṇamiti| yadi tatra svarūpagrahaṇaṃ syād, iha
kṛñgrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syād; anyasyānuprayogasyābhāvāditi bhāvaḥ| ata
eva viparyayo'pi na bhavati-tatra svarūpagrahaṇaṃ syād ihi
pratyāhāragrahaṇamiti, iha hi pratyāhāragrahaṇe
bhvastyorapyātmanepadavidhiḥ prayojanam| yadi cānuprayogavidhinā
kṛñ evānuprayuktaḥ syāt, tadā
bhvastyoranuprayogābhāvādātmanepadavidhiranupapannaḥ syāt|
tasmādiha svarūpagrahaṇam, āmanuprayogavidhau pratyāhārasyeti
siddham| ṭhabhividhau sampadā ca' iti sampado'pi
tatrāntarbhāvādanuprayogaḥ prāptaḥ ṭhsanādyantā dhātavaḥ' ityato
dhātvadhikārāddhātūpasargasamudāyasya na bhavati| yo'tra dhātustasyāpi
na bhavati; arthavipratiṣedhāditi tatraiva vakṣyāmaḥ||
padamañjarī
propābhyāṃ yujerayajñapātreṣu|| 1|3|64 ||
propābhyāṃ yujerayajñapātreṣu|| yujiryoge iti | ṭhyuja samādhau'
ityasya,na daivādikasya, anudātetvādeva siddham, yujariti ca
vivakṣita ikāraḥ, na tvāgantukaḥ| yajñapātraviṣayatā cāsyaiva
sambhavatīti bhāvaḥ| prayuṅkta iti| ṭhrudhādibhyaḥ śnam'
ṭhśnasorallopaḥ' kutvacartve, anusvāraparasavarṇau|
svarādyantopasṛṣṭaditi| svaraḥua i, ādiranto vā yasya sa svarādyantaḥ|
tenopasargeṇa sambandhaḥ, svarādyantopasṛṣṭaḥ- sam nis dus
ityetān varjayitvā sarva evopasargāssaṃgṛhītāḥ||
padamañjarī
samaḥ kṣṇuvaḥ|| 1|3|65 ||
iha ṭhśarpare visarjanīyaḥ' ityasyāvakāśo yatra
kupvorasambhavaḥ-puruṣaḥ tsarukaḥ; ṭhkupvoḥḥ kaḥ pau ca' ityasya
yatra śarparau kupū na sambhavataḥ- puruṣaḥ karotīti;
śarparayorubhayoḥ prasaṅge pūrvatrāsiddhe nāsti
vipratiṣedho'bhāvādutarasyeti ṭhśarpare visarjanīyaḥ' iti nityaṃ
visarjanīya eva bhavati | tena ṭhsamaḥ kṣṇuvaḥ' na kartavyamiti bhāvaḥ|
saṃkṣṇuvata iti| adāditvācchapo luk, ṭhātmanepadeṣvanataḥ' iti
jhasyādādeśaḥ,ṭhaci śnudhātu'ityādinovaṅ|| 
padamañjarī
bhujo'navane||1|3|66 ||
anavanapratiṣedhenetyādi| saṃsargavadviprayogo'pi
viśeṣasmṛtihetuḥ| yathā dogdhrīparyāyo dhenuśabdaḥ saṃsargibhiḥ
viśeṣe'vasthāpyate--savatsā dhenurānīyatāṃ sakiśorā savarkareti,
tathā'vatsā'kiśorā'varkareti| yasyā ānayane ddaṣṭaḥ saṃsargaḥ saiva
tatra gṛhītā ānīyate; tadvadihāpītyarthaḥ||
padamañjarī
ṇeraṇau yatkarma ṇau cetsa kartānāghyāne || 1|3|67 ||
atra ṭhṇeḥ' iti yadyapi sāmānyanirdeśaḥ,tathāpi pucchabhāṇḍādiṇiṅ na
gṛhyate; aṇau karmaṇo ṇāvasambhavāt, kamerṇi ṅstuṭhāyādaya
ārddhadhātuke vā' iti vacanādaṇyantāvasthā sambhavati| karmaṇaśca
kartṛtvam--kamiṣyate yoṣitaṃ devadataḥ kāmayiṣyate
yoṣitsvayameveti, tathāpi ṅitvādevi siddhe so'pi na gṛhyata iti
ṇica eva grahaṇamityāha--ṇicaśceti kartrabhiprāye kriyāphale
siddhamevātsanepadamiti| akartrabhiprāyārtha iti| upalakṣaṇametat,
kartrabhiprāye padāntareṇa dyotite ṭhvibhāṣopapadena pratīyamāne' iti
vikalpaṃ bādhitvā nityo vidhiryathā syādityapi draṣṭavyam|
atraikavākyatāyāmayamartho bhavati--ṇyantādātmanepadaṃ
bhavatyaṇyantāvasthāyāṃ yatkarma ṇyantāvasthāyāṃ yadi sa kartā bhavati
ādhyānādanyatreti| tatra karmāntaranivṛttirna kṛtā syāt,
tataścehāpi prasajyeta--ārohanti hastinaṃ hastipakāstānārohayati
hastīti| kiṃ ca ukte'rthe ṭhṇeraṇau karmaṇi' ityetāvadeva vācyam;
kartarītyeva ṇyantādātmanepadaṃ bhavati, ṭhaṇau karmaṇi kartari'
ityukte ko nāma vivakṣito'rtho na siddhyati| ṭhsaḥ'
ityetaccānarthakam; yatadornityasambandhādevādhyāhārataḥ siddheḥ|
tasmādyathāśrutamātraṃ na vivakṣitamiti matvā pṛcchati--kathamiti|
itaro'pi vākyabhedāśrayaṇena pariharati--aṇau yatkarmetyādi|
ṇerātmanepadaṃ bhavati ādhyānādanyatretyekaṃ vākyam, tato'ṇau
yatkarmeti dvitīyam| atra vākye yatadornityasambandhādyacchabdena tacchabda
ākṣipyate| karmāntarasya cānirdeśād uddeśyatayāpi śrutaṃ
karmatvameva vidhīyate| tacca vidhīyamānaṃ sāmarthyāṇṇoriti
sannihitatvāṇṇayantāvasthāyāmeva vidhīyate | kiṃ tatsāmarthyam? aṇau
yatkarmetyanuvādasāmarthyādevāṇau karmatvasiddhestatraiva
tadvidhānasyāsambhavaḥ| tadevamaṇau yatkarmetyetāvata evāṇau yatkarma
ṇau cetatkarmetyartho bhavati| anena ca karmāntaranivṛttiḥ kriyate, na
tvaṇau karmaṇo ṇau karmabhāvaḥ pratipādyate| sa karteti vākyāntareṇa
tasya kartṛtvapratipādanāt ekasya yugapadekasyāṃ kriyāyāṃ
karmatvakartṛtvayorubhayorasambhavāt| tato ṇau cediti tṛtīyaṃ
vākyam--aṇau yadityeva, aṇau yatpratipādyaṃ vastu ṇau cetadeva
pratipādyamityarthaḥ| tataḥ sa karteti caturtham| atrāṇau yatkarma ṇau
cediti sarvamanuvartate| ṭhanādhyāne' ityetadapi prasajyapratiṣedhe
pañcamaṃ vākyam|
tatra vṛttikāreṇa trīṇi vākyāni svavācā
darśitāni-ṇyantādātmanepadaṃ bhavatītyekaṃ vākyam, aṇau yatkarma ṇau
cetadeva karmeti dvitīyam, sa eva kartā bhavatīti tṛtīyam|ṭhṇau
ced' grahaṇaṃ samānakriyārthamiti tu vakṣyati, atastadapi
vākyamabhyupagatameva|
ārohantītyādi| aṇau karmapradarśanārthamidamuktam, idaṃ
tatrodāharaṇam--ārohayate hastī svayameveti| āṅpūrvo ruhiḥ
nyagbhavanopasajaṃne nyagbhāvane vartate, nyagbhavantaṃ hastinaṃ
nyagbhavayatītyarthaḥ| yadā tu hastinaḥ saukaryātiśayapratipādanāya
hastipakavyāpāro na vivakṣyate, tadā nyagbhavamātre ruhirvartate, tatra
ca hastinaḥ kartṛtvam| uktaṃ ca--
nivṛtapreṣaṇaṃ karma svakriyāvayave sthitam|
nivartamāne karmatve svakartṛtve'vatiṣṭhate|| iti
asya ca kartuḥ karmasthakriyeṣu
karmakāryāṇyatidiśyante-ṭhkarmavatkarmaṇātulyakriyaḥ' iti,
tadyathā-lūyate kedāraḥ svayeveti| lunātirhi dvidhābhavanopasarjane
dvidhābhāvane vṛtaḥ kartṛvyāpārāvivakṣāyāṃ dvidhā bhavanamātre
vartate| duhistu kartṛsthakriyatvāt karmakāryāṇi na labhata
ityetāvat| tato nyagbhavanavṛte ruherhastipakavyāpāre
ṇijutpadyate, tadā ca ya evārtha ārohayanti hastinaṃ hastipakāḥ, sa
evārtha ārohayanti hastipakā iti | punaḥ
saukaryātiśayavivakṣāyāmavivakṣite hastipakavyāpāre nyagbhavanamātre
rohirvartate-ārohayate hastī svayameveti| suṣṭhua
nyagbhavatītyarthaḥ| uktaṃ ca-
nyagbhāvanaṃ nyagbhavanaṃ ruhau śuddhe pratīyate|
nyagbhāvanaṃ nyagbhavanaṃ ṇyante'pi pratipadyate||
avasthāṃ pañcamīmāhurṇyantānāṃ karmakartari|
nivṛtapreṣaṇāddhātoḥ prākṛte'rthe ṇijucyate|| iti|
evaṃ siñcaterapyārdrībhavanopasarjanamārdrībhāvanamarthaḥ| tato
nivṛtapreṣaṇamityādi pūrvavat| secayate hastī svayameva,
secane'tyantamanukūlo bhavatītyarthaḥ| evaṃ ddaśirapi
karmavyāpāramātravṛttiḥ,ṇijutpanne punastatrāparo'pi,
tadudāharaṇam-darśayate rājā svayameva, darśanenānukūlo
bhavatītyarthaḥ| so'yaṃ nivṛtapreṣapakṣa ucyate|
aparaḥ prakāraḥ-ārohanti hastinaṃ hastipakāḥ, tān
saukaryātiśayāddhastī prayuṅkte iti; hastivyāpāre
ṇijutpadyate-ārohayati hastī hastipakāniti| tatra
saukaryātiśayapratipādane tātparyamiti karma na vivakṣyate,
tato'karmako bhavati; yathā-neha pacyate, neha bhujyate iti
pākamātrapratiṣedhe tātparyamiti karmāvivakṣāyāṃ bhāve lo
bhavati-ārohayate hastī svayameva, suṣṭhua nyagbhavatītyarthaḥ| eṣa eva
hi hastinaḥ prayojakavyāpāraḥ| evamitarayorapi draṣṭavyam|
so'yamadhyāropitapreṣaṇapakṣa iti gīyate|
tadevamubhayorapi pakṣayoḥ saiva kriyā, yā'ṇyantāvasthāyām| na ca
karmāntaramasti, kartāpi sa evetyudāharaṇopapatiḥ| svayamiti
vacanaṃ kartrantaravyudāsārtham|
ṇeriti kimiti| aṇau karmatvānuvādena ṇau kartṛtvavidhānāt
prādhānyāṇṇyantādeva bhaviṣyatīti praśnaḥ| sādhvārohatīti| sāghu
nyagbhavatītyarthaḥ| atra karmavyāpāramātre ruhirvartate,
kartṛsthakriyatvātu karmavadbhāvābhāvādyagātmanepade na bhavataḥ,
śapparasmaipade bhavataḥ, aṇau yatkarmetyaṇyantāvasthāyāmapi
śrutatvātato'pi syāditi bhāva| nanu prādhānyāṇṇyantādeva
bhaviṣyatītyuktam, kimarthamaṇau yatkarma ṇau cetsa karteti?
ayamupādhiryasminneva prayoge saṃbhavati, tatraivātmanepadaṃ yuktam,
sādhvārohatītyatra ca nāyaṃ prakāraḥ sambhavati| ārohayate hastītyatra
tu ṇicaḥ prakṛtibhūte ruhāvaṇyante yatkarma ṇyante sa eva karteti
tatraiva bhaviṣyati, satyam; tadevamutarārthamavaśyaṃ ṇeriti
vaktavyamihāpi vispaṣṭārthaṃ bhaviṣyatīti manyate|
aṇāviti kimiti| karmatvakartṛtvayoryaugapadyāsambhavāt ṇau ca
kartṛtvasya śrutatvādavasthāntare ṇāveva karmatvaṃ vijñāsyata iti
praśnaḥ| gamayatīti| ṭhgaṇasaṃkhyāne' curādāvadantaḥ paṭha|lte, ato
lopasya sthānivadbhāvād upadhāvṛddhyabhāvaḥ| gaṇyamāno gaṇo
yadā gaṇanakriyāyāmānukūlyaṃ pratipadyate, tadā
tadvyāpāramātravṛterhetumaṇṇici punaḥ karmavyāpāramātre
āropitasyaivāyaṃ prayogaḥ| gaṇayati gaṇaḥ svayameveti| atra ṇāveva
gaṇeḥ karma, ṇāveva kartā ityātmanepadaṃ na bhavati|
karmavadbhāvenāpi na bhavati; kartṛ sthakriyatvāt| gaṇanaṃ hi
saṃkhyānimitaḥ paricchedo jñānaviveṣaḥ| bhāṣye tu
bhāgaśo'vasthāpane gaṇirvartate| bhāgaśo'vatiṣṭhamānaṃ gaṇaṃ
gopālako'vasthāpayatītyarthamaṅgīkṛtya tatrānukūlatvād gaṇasyaiva
kartṛ tvavivakṣāyāmasti karmasthabhāvakatvamiti
karmavadbhāvādātmanepadamudāhṛtam| nanu cāṇāvakarmakādityatra
vakṣyati-ṭhhetumaṇṇico vidhiḥ' iti, pratiṣedho'pi pratyāsatestasyaiva
nyāyya iti, taccet, satyam; idamapi pratyudāharaṇamayuktameva,
ucyate-yuktaṃ tatra hetumaṇṇico vidhiriti; tatra budhādisūtre ṭhṇaḥ'
iti vartate, budhādibhyaśca hetumaṇṇijeva sambhavati| iha tu
sāmānyena grahaṇaṃ viśeṣahetvabhāvāt| nanu cāṇau
yatkarmetyucyate curādīnāṃ ca nityaṇyantatvātkevalānāṃ
prayogābhavād aṇau karmaṇo'sambhavād atrāpi hetumaṇṇica eva
vidhiḥ, netyāha; ṭhā dhṛṣādvā' iti vibhāṣitaṇicāmapi
keṣāñcitsambhavāt| bhāṣye tu hetumaṇṇico vidhiriti sthitam|
lāvayati dātraṃ svayameveti| karaṇasya dātrasyāpi taikṣṇyātiśayena
lavane yadānukūlyaṃ tatpratipādanāya lāvakānprati
prayojakatvavivakṣāyāṃ ṇic|
iha ṇyantādātmanepadaṃ bhavatyaṇau yatkarma sa cetkartetyukte gamyata
etadyasmād ṇyantādvidhiḥ tatraivāṇyante yatkarma sa cetkarteti, ato
ṇau cedgrahaṇamarthakam, tatrāha-ṇau cedgrahaṇaṃ
samānakriyārthamiti| prayojyaprayojakabhāvalakṣaṇe'pi kriyābhede mā
bhūt, ṇicprakṛtyarthabhūtāyāmeva kriyāyāṃ yathā syādityarthaḥ| yathā
punarayaṃ śabdārthastathoktaṃ purastāt| ārohayamāṇo hastī bhītān
secayati mūtreṇeti| yena prayojyaprayojakabhāvalakṣaṇe'pi kriyābhede
ātmanepadaṃ vāryata evānena dhātubhedādatyantabheda iti
matvaitatpratyudāhṛtam, bhītāścātrārohayateḥ karma| ārohayamāṇa
iti| ṭhṇicaśca' ityātmanepadaṃ śānac, bhītā hyārehyamāṇā bhītyā
mūtrayanti, tena hastī sicyate| karmāvivakṣāyāṃ tu
secayaterakarmakatvam|
uddeśapratinirdeśāt labdhe yatsagrahe punastadgraho vākyabhedena
karmāntaranivṛtaye ityāha-yatsagrahaṇamananyakarmārthamiti|
sthalamārohayati manuṣyānityatra karmāntaramapyasti manuṣyāḥ,
ruhergatyarthatvānmanuṣyāṇāṃ karmasaṃjñā| kathaṃ punaratrāṇau karmaṇo
ṇau kartṛtvam,yāvatā sthalamaṇau karma hastī tu ṇau kartā?
syādetatārohayamāṇa ityatrāṇau karmaṇo hastina eva kartṛ tvam,
sa eva ca sthalamārohayatītyatrāpi karteti| evamapi pratyāsaterevātra
na bhaviṣyati, tathā hi ṇyantādātmanepadaṃ bhavati| aṇau yatkarma ṇau
cet sa kartetyukte pratyāsateretad gamyate-yena ṇicā
ṇyantādātmanepadaṃ vidhitsitaṃ tenaiva ṇicā'ṇyante tatprakṛtibhūte
dhātau yatkarma sa eva cetkartā tasminneva ṇyanta iti| atra ca
yatrāyamupādhiḥ, kṛtameva tatrātmanepadam-ārohayamāṇa iti| yatratu
na kṛtam-sthalamārohayatīti, na tatrāyamupādhiriti
naivātmanepadaprasaṅgaḥ| iha tarhi-ārohanta hastinaṃ hastipakāḥ,
tānārehayati hastīti? kiṃ punaratra neṣyate? vṛttikṛtā neṣyate,
bhāgavṛttikāreṇa tviṣyate| tathā māghaḥ
prayuṅkte-ṭhkareṇurārohayate niṣādinam' iti|
kateti kimiti| bhāvakarmaṇoḥ siddhatvāt kartaryeva bhaviṣyatīti
manyate| aṇau yatkarma tasminneva kartari yathā syāt, kartrantare mā
bhūdityevamarthaṃ kartṛgrahaṇamiti darśayannāha-tānārohayati mahāmātra
iti| gatyarthatvacca ruheḥ hastipakānāṃ karmasaṃjñā | yadyevam,
karmāntarasambhavādevātra na bhaviṣyati? naitadevam? astītyatrāṇau
karmaṇo hastino ṇāvapi karmatvenānvayaḥ| na vā sati kartṛ
tvavidhau karmāntaravyāvṛttirlabhyate| yadvā-prayojakavyāpāramātre
tātparyādyadā hastipakāḥ karmatvenāvivakṣitāḥ, tadedaṃ pratyudāhaṇaṃ
draṣṭavyam| vanagulmasyeti| karmopalakṣaṇametat, na tvatra vanagulmasya
karmatvamasti; śeṣatvena vivakṣitvāt| tasmādvanagulmamiti
pradarśanīyam| smarayatyenamiti| ṭhsmṛ ādhyāne' ghaṭādiḥ, vanagulmasya
ramaṇīyatvapratipādanāya prayojakatve vivakṣite ṇic| enamiti|
buddhyarthatvātkokilasya karmasaṃjñā| etadapyupalakṣaṇam, atrahi
karmāntarasadbhāvādeva prāptirnāsti karmāvivakṣāyāṃ pratyudāharaṇaṃ
draṣṭavyam|
nanu cātra karmakartari mūlodāharaṇānīti| nanu
cādhyāropitapreṣaṇapakṣe ārohayato hastinaḥ karmatvābhāvātkarmaṇā
samānadhātau tulyakriyatvābhāvāt pacatyodanaṃ devadato
rādhyatyodanaṃ svayamevetivatkarmavadbhāvo na prāpnoti, satyam;
ārabdha evāsmin sūtre so'pi pakṣaḥ sambhavāt pradarśitaḥ, anārabdhe
tu nivṛtapreṣaṇapakṣaprakriyaivāśrayiṣte| nanu tatrāpi
vyāpāradvayābhidhāyiṣu ruhādiṣu bhavatyevam, ye tu kevalakartṛ
vyāpāravācino ddaśyādayaḥ teṣu katham, na hi ddaśiḥ karmavyāpāraṃ
kañcadācaṣṭe? syādetat-viṣayabhāvāpatiḥ karmavyāpārastadāpādanaṃ
kartṛ vyāpāra iti| yadyevam, icchāpi ddaśyarthaḥ syāt| nanvatrāpi
viṣayabhāvāpatiḥ, tadāpādanaṃ ca vidyate, atha darśanaviṣayabhāvāpādanaṃ
ddaśyarthaḥ, nanu tadeva nirūpyate kiṃ nāma taddarśanam iti, atrocyate;
mā nāmākhyātakarmavyāpāraḥ, asti tāvatkarmaṇo'pi vyāpāraḥ,
kārakatvāt, tatra ṇijutpattidaśāyāṃ tāvatyeva vartiṣyate,
udāharaṇadaśāyāṃ ṇyanto'pīti manyate| tathā ca ruhiḥ kartṛ yuk
karmaṇābhidheya iti yuktaṃ kevalakartṛ vyāpāravācināṃ
gamiddaśiprabhṛtīnāṃ kartṛ sthakriyatvam; kathaṃ tu
viklityupasarjanavikledavacanaḥ paciḥ,
dvidhābhavanopasarjanadvidhābhāvanavacanaśca lunātiḥ karmasthakiyaḥ,
nyagbhavanopasarjananyagbhāvanavacanastu ruhiḥ kartṛ sthakriyaḥ? ucyate;
ruhirapi gatyarthaḥ, tathā ca ṭhyaddhitupariṃ cchandasi' ityatra bhāṣyakāro
vakṣyati-hastinamārohatītyatra hi uparigamanalakṣaṇa eva ruherarthaḥ,
tatpunarnyagbhavanahetutvād nyagbhāvanamityucyate, uparigamanarahitaṃ
tu nyagbhāvanamātraṃ ruherartho na bhavati, yadā khalu kvacid bhūmāveva
tiṣṭhan vṛkṣasya śākhāṃ hastābhyāmavanamayati, tadā
nāsāvārohatītyucyate| tasmād gativiśeṣa eva ruherarthaḥ| kastarhi
kriyāṇāṃ karmakartṛ sthatāyāṃ hetuḥ? uktamatra-
viśeṣadarśanaṃ yatra kriyā tatra vyavasthitā|
kriyāvyavasthā tvanyeṣāṃ śabdaireva prakalpitā|| iti|
viśeṣadarśanena śabdānusāreṇa vā kriyāyāstātsthyaṃ kathyate| etacca
kāraṇagatamārohasya kartṛsthatvaṃ pratipādayati, na tu karmasthatām|
na hi hastināmārohati, vṛkṣamārohati, parvatamārohatītyādau
karmabhede'pyārohaṇe rūpabhedaḥ pratīyate,
yathā-ghṛtamāsataṇḍulādiṣu pākaḥ| na ca hastī nyagbhavatvityevaṃ
kārakavyāpāraḥ, kiṃ tarhi? hastipakā uparyāsīranniti| pāke tu
taṇḍulādigato viklityādirūpo viśeṣo yathā syādityeva
kārakavyāpāraḥ| tasmatkarmabhede rūpabhedāduddeśasya ca karmagatatvāt
paciḥ karmasthakriyaḥ,viparyapādruhiḥ kartṛ sthakriya iti siddham| eva
cāruhyate hastī svayameveti karmavadbhāvaṃ prarśayanto
bhāṣyanyāyavirodhādupekṣyāḥ| ddaśikartṛ sthabhāvaka iti| atha siciḥ
kasmādupekṣitaḥ? karmasthakriyatvād| ārdrībhavanaṃ hyatra pradhānam,
tadarthatvātkārakavyāpārasya| kimarthaṃ tarhyudāhṛtaḥ? viśeṣābhāvāt|
na hyatrānena ṭhkarmavatkarmaṇā' ityanena vā ātmanepade sati
kaścidviśeṣaḥ, tenāpi sati yakciṇau na bhavataḥ, ṭhṇiśranthigranthi
'iti pratiṣedhāt| bhāṣye'pi karmavadbhāvāt
siddhimāśaṅkyādhyānapratiṣedhārthamityuktvā smarateḥ kartṛ
sthabhāvakatvāt karmavadbhāvasya prāptirnāstītyabhidhāyoktam| evaṃ
tarhi siddhe sati yadādhyānapratiṣedhaṃ śāsti,
tajjñāpayatyācāryaḥ-bhavatyevañjātīyakānāmātmanepadamiti| kimetasya
jñāpane prayojanam? paśyanti bhṛtyā rājānam; darśayate bhṛtyān
rājā svayameva-atrātmanepadaṃ siddhaṃ bhavatīti| evañjātīyakānāmiti
kartṛ sthakriyāṇāmityarthaḥ| evaṃ ca bruvatā vidhyarthametadityuktaṃ
bhavati, viśeṣapratiṣedhena sāmānyavidheranumānāt| atra darśayate
bhṛtyān rājetyetadekamudāharaṇamanupapannam;
karmāntarasadbhāvāt| tatra vṛttikāraḥ ṭhtyajedekaṃ kulasyārthe' iti
nyāyād udāharaṇametadgamayitavyaṃ manyate| asminnudāharaṇe
kamavyāpāramātre vivakṣite siddhaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ|
anye tvāhuḥ-asmādevodāharaṇādaṇau ye kartṛ karmaṇī
tadvyatiriktakarmāntarasadbhāva evātmanepadaṃ na bhavati,
yathā-sthalamārohayati manuṣyāniti, iha tvaṇau kartṛṇāṃ bhṛtyānāṃ
ṇau karmatvamiti| evaṃ smārayatyenamiti kokīlasya karmatve'pi
pratyudāharaṇamupapannam, ṭhkareṇurārohayate niṣādinam' iti
prayogaścopapanna iti teṣāṃ sūtrākṣarāṇyeva tāvadadhikāni, bhāṣyaṃ ca
sarvamudāharaṇavarjamanupapannam||
prayogāṇāṃ tu nirvāho ṇicaścetyātmanepadāt|
jayādityasya hṛdayaṃ gūḍhametatprakāśitam||
padamañjarī
bhīsmyorhetubhaye|| 1|3|68 ||
bhayamaniṣṭāpātaśaṅgāsādhanamātraṃ lokiko hetuḥ, na vāntareṇa
sādhanaṃ kriyā sambhavatīti viśeṣaṇasāmarthyāt kṛtrimatvācca
pāribhāṣikasya hetorgrahaṇamityāha--hetuḥ prayojaka ityādi|
tataścedbhayaṃ bhavatīti| yadyevam, smayatyartho na viśeṣitaḥ syāt,
na hi smayaterbhayamarthaḥ, a'ta āha-bhayagrahaṇamiti|
citavikārasyopalakṣaṇamityarthaḥ| vismayo'pi tata eveti| atra
cedbhavatītyanuṣaṅgaḥ| bhīṣayata iti| ṭhbhiyo hetubhaye ṣuk'|
bhāyayata iti|ṭhbibheterhetubhaye' iti vaikalpikamātvam| evaṃ ca atra
ṣuk na bhavati; tadvidhāvākārapraśleṣāt| vismāpayata iti| ṭhnityaṃ
smayateḥ' ityātvam| ṭhartihrī' ityādinā puk| kuñcikayeti|
kāraṇādatra bhayam, na hetoḥ| yadyapi tadvyāpāre ṇijvidhānāt
prayojakasādhyameva bhayam, tathāpi viśeṣaṇopādānasāmarthyādevaṃ
vijñāyate-anyanirapekṣāddhetoreva yadbhayamiti| evaṃ ca mauṇḍa|lènaṃ
bhāyayatītyatrāpi guṇaguṇinorbhedavivakṣāyāṃ na bhavati| udāharaṇe
tu tādātmyasya vivakṣitatvāddhetoreva bhayam||
padamañjarī
gṛdhivañcyoḥ pralambhane|| 1|3|69 ||
pariharatītyartha iti| varjayatīti yāvat||
padamañjarī
liyaḥ sammānanaśālīnīkaraṇayośca|| 1|3|70 ||
viśeṣābhāvāditi| niranubandhakaparibhāṣā tu ṭhvāmadevād
ḍa|lḍḍa|lai' ityatra jñāpitā pratyayagrahaṇaviṣayaiveti manyate| saṃmānane
śālīnīkaraṇe ca vartamānāditi| saṃmānanaṃ viṣayaḥ,na dhātvarthaḥ|
yadāha--pūjāmadhigacchatītyartha iti| dhātvarthe tu pūjayatīti vācyaṃ
syāt, yathā nyakkarotītyartha iti| akarmakaścāyacamasmin prayoge
pūjākhyasya karmaṇa ātmanepadasahitena dhātunaivopātatvāt
putrīyatītivadityāhuḥ| jaṭābhiriti| hetau tṛtīyā, yasya hi
jaṭāḥ santi loke sa pūjyate||
padamañjarī
mithyopapadāt kṛño'bhyāse|| 1|3|71 ||
upoccāritaṃ padamupapadam,mithyāśabda upapadaṃyasya sa tathoktaḥ|
mithyā kārayate iti ātmanepadenaivābhyāsasya dyotitatvāt
ṭhnityavīpsayoḥ' iti dvirvacanaṃ na bhavati| sadoṣamiti| etena
mithyāśabdasyārthamācaṣṭe| asyaiva vivaraṇam-svarādiduṣṭamiti|
ādiśabdena rūpaṃ gṛhyate| asakṛditi abhyāsaṃ darśayati|
uccārayatītyartha iti ṇyantasya karoteruccāraṇe
vṛttiranekārthatvāddhātūnām| evaṃ ca prakṛtibhūtaḥ karotiruccāraṇe
vartate, akarmakaśca||
padamañjarī
svaritañitaḥ kartrabhiprāye kriyāphale|| 1|3|72 ||
kartāramabhipraitīti kartrabhiprāyam,ṭhkarmaṇyaṇ',kriyāphalaṃ ceha
karmaiveti nāsti niyamaḥ tenākarmakebhyo'pi yajiprabhṛtibhyaḥ
svargādike phale kartṛ gāminyayaṃ vidhirbhavatyeva| kartāraṃ cediti|
kriyāphalasya kartṛ gāmitvahyaetanāyātmanepadaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ| yadi
yacca yāvacca kriyānantarabhāvi phalaṃ tatra kartṛ gāminyayaṃ
vidhirbhavati, ihāpi syād-yajanti yājakāḥ, pacanti pācakā iti;
dakṣiṇādeḥ kartṛ gāmitvādityatra āha-praghānabhūtamiti| kiṃ
punastadityata āha-yadarthamiti| yaduddiśyetyarthaḥ| kriyā ārabhata iti|
sāmagrīsamavadhānātmikā ādyā pravṛttiḥuārambhaḥ, yāmantareṇa
yājakādīnāmapravṛttiḥ, svargādikaṃ hi phalaṃ prekṣuḥ sāmagraāā
samavadhāpya pravartayati, sā pravartitā yathāyathaṃ pravartate| kathaṃ
punaretallabhyate-pradhāne phale kartrabhiprāyaiti? pradhānatvādeva|
kiñca-yat kicana phalaṃ sarvatra kartrabhiprāyaṃ bhavati| nanu yatra
kriyābhyāsamātre tātparyam, tatra na kiñcitpalaṃ kartṛgāmi, tatrāpi
kiñcitphalaṃ kartṛgāmi, tatrāpi kiñcitphalaṃ kartṛgāmi, kiṃ
kauśalam? punaḥ punarabhyāse hi kriyāsu kauśalaṃ bhavati,
tasmātpradhāne phale kartrabhiprāya iti siddham| yajata iti| kecidāhuḥ-
ṭhdevatāyai idaṃ na mama' ityevaṃvidho mānasaḥ saṅkalpo yāga iti,
teṣāṃ yajanti yājakā iti ṛtvigvyāpāre prayogo nopapadyate| anye
tvāhuḥ-ṭhhomādiṣvabhiṣṭvādiṛtvigvyāpāro yāgaḥ' iti, teṣāṃ
yajativyāpāpāraprayogo nopapadyate| evaṃ tarhyubhayaṃ
yajerarthaḥ-ṛtvagvyāpāraśca, yajamānavyāpāraśca| taduktam-yajādiṣu
cāviparyāso nānākriyāṇāṃ yajyarthatvāditi|
na tadarthaḥ kriyāramma iti| nanu ṛtvijāmārambhastadartha eva,
naitadevam; ṭhādyā pravṛttirārambhaḥ' ityuktam, sā ca yajamānasya-
svargamahaṃ labheyeti, na punarime dakṣiṇāṃ labheranniti|
yathā-avaghāte kriyamāṇe svedaśca bhavati vaituṣyaṃ ca bhavati, bhṛtiśca
labhyate, atha ca vaituṣyārtha evāvaghāgaḥ, tadvadatrāpi| taduktaṃ hariṇā-
yasyārthasya prasiddhyarthamārabhyante pacādayaḥ|
tatpradhānaṃ phalaṃ na lābhādi prayojanam|| iti |
iha svāmidāsau pacata iti| kriyāmātravivakṣāyāṃ parasmaipadaṃ bhavati|
svāmigate tu dharme dāsa āropite svāmidāsau pacete
ityātmanepadaṃ bhavati|
athābhipragragaṇaṃ kimartham? viprakṛṣṭe'pi phale yathā syād| dvividhaṃ
kriyāphalam, ddaṣṭam--annaputravṛṣṭiśatruvadhādikam, addaṣṭṃa ca
svargādi| tatra pūrvaṃ pratyāsannamavaśyaṃbhāvīti pradhānam, itaratu
vidhurapratyayopanipāte sati
vyabhicārasaṃbhavādviprakṛṣṭatvaccāpradhānam| saṃbhavati
hyavikalamanuṣṭhātuṃ yāgasyāpi madhye vairāgyotpatau
mokṣārthapravṛtau satyāmanutpattiḥ svargasya| tataśceha tasya grahaṇaṃ na
syād| abhipragrahaṇe tu sati abhirābhimukhye vartate, praśabdastvārambha
iti kartāraṃ pratyābhimukhyena kriyāphalaṃ cetatpraiti etum ārabhate
evamātmanedaṃ bhavatītyartho bhavati| tathā ca yadyapi svargādikaṃ
svarūpeṇānnādivat tadānīṃ naiti tasya tvaṅkurāvasthā
kartārametīti taddvāreṇa phalamevaitumārabhata iti sarvatra
siddhyati| phalasyaiva hyaṅkarāvasthā pūrvaśabdavācyā||
apādvadaḥ|| 1|3|73 ||
padamañjarī
ṇicaśca|| 1|3|74 ||
atra kaścidāha-idamātmanepadaṃ curādiṇico na bhavati, kutaḥ?
jñāpakāt| kiṃ jñāpakam? lakṣaṇateḥ svaritetvamiti|
nātrāprāptabhāṣita masti| pārāyaṇe'pi curādiṇica
ātmanepadamudāhṛtam-eṣa vidhiścurādiṇijantātsyāditi| kaścana
niścunute sma-aprāptavacane'tra na kiṃcana ddaṣṭam, lakṣayateḥ
svaritetvamanārṣam||
padamañjarī
samudāṅbhyo yamo'granthe|| 1|3|75 ||
udyacchati cikitsāmityatra adhigamapūrvake udyame yamirvartate,
cikitsāśāstramadhigantumudyamaṃ karotītyarthaḥ| 
padamañjarī
anupasargājjñaḥ|| 1|3|76 ||
sakarmakārthamidam, anyatra ṭhakarmakācca' iti siddhatvāt| gāṃ jānīta
iti |svarga lokaṃ na pratijānātīti| ṭhsaṃpratibhyāmanādhyāne'
ityanenāpi na bhavati; ādhyānaviṣayatvāt| prajānātīti vā pāṭhaḥ||
padamañjarī
vibhāṣopapadena pratīyamāne|| 1|3|77 ||
aprāptavibhāṣeyamityāha-tadupapadeneti| atra ca ṭhsvaritañitaḥ'
ityārabhya pañca sūtrāṇyanuvartante| samīpe śrūyamāṇamiti| na tu
pāribhāṣikam;asaṃbhavāt | evaṃ pañcasūtryāmudāhāryamiti| na
kevalamudāhṛtayorddhayoḥ; api tu pañcasvapi sūtreṣvityarthaḥ| svaṃ
yatnaṃ kārayate kārayati vā| svaṃ vrīhiṃ saṃyacchate saṃyacchatīti vā|
svaṃ gāṃ jānīte jānīte vā||
padamañjarī
śeṣātkartari parasmaipadam|| 1|3|78 ||
ātmanepadaniyamaḥ kṛta iti| prakṛtyāśrayo'rthāśrayaśca,
anudātaṅitorevātminepadaṃ bhāvakarmaṇoreveti| sarvata iti
sarvābhyaḥ prakṛtibhyaḥ sarveṣu cārtheṣvityarthaḥ| tadarthamiti| sarvataḥ
prāptinivṛtyarthamityarthaḥ| yena viśeṣaṇeneti| anubandhādinā|
yāti vātītyanubandhaśeṣaḥ, āviśati praviśatītyupasargaśeṣaḥ,
gandhanāderanyatra karotītyādirarthaśeṣaḥ| gandhanādiviśiṣṭo hi
kṛñādiḥ śeṣagrahaṇena pañcamyantena nivartyamāno
nāgṛhītaviśeṣaṇanyāyena viśeṣaṇaṃ gandhanādyapi vyāvartayati|
śeṣādeva nānyasmāditi| upalakṣaṇametat, kartaryeva nānyatretyapi
draṣṭavyam|
pacyate, gamyata iti| nanu kriyamāṇe'pi kartarigrahaṇe yadi tāvadevaṃ
niyamaḥ- kartari yadi bhavati śeṣādeveti; tato'śeṣātkartari mā
bhūt, śeṣātu bhāvakarma kartṛ ṣu triṣvapi prāpnoti| athāpyevaṃ
niyamaḥ- śeṣādyadi bhavati kartaryeveti, tataḥ śeṣādbhāvakarmaṇormā
bhūd, aśeṣātu triṣvapi prāpnoti | ukto'tra parihāraḥ-
ṭhyogavibhāgo'trābhipretaḥ'iti| tatra prathame yoge śeṣādeveti
niyamaḥ, dvitīye tu kartaryeveti| karmakartarītyapi
bhāvakarmaṇorityatrokta evārtho vismaraṇaśīlānanugrahītuṃ punarapi
smāritaḥ||
padamañjarī
anuparābhyāṃ kṛñaḥ|| 1|3|79 ||
atrāpi dvitīyaṃ kartṛ grahaṇamanuvartate| anukriyate svayameva,
parākriyate svayameva||
abhipratyatibhyaḥ kṣipaḥ|| 1|3|80 ||
prādvahaḥ|| 1|3|81 ||
parermṛṣaḥ|| 1|3|82 ||
vyāṅparibhyo ramaḥ|| 1|3|83 ||
padamañjarī
upācca|| 1|3|84 ||
upapūrvo ramirnivṛttivināśayorvartate, uparato'dhyayanād,
uparatonidhanādidi| na cānayorubhayorapyarthayoḥ
sakarmakatvamupapadyate, tatkathaṃ sakarmakasyodāharaṇam? ata
āha-uparamayati yāvaditi| kathaṃ punaraṇyanto ṇyarthe vartate? ata
āha-antarbhāvitaṇyartha iti||
vibhāṣā'karmakāt|| 1|3|85 ||
padamañjarī
budhayudhanaśajaneṅprudrustrubhyo ṇeḥ|| 1|3|86 ||
prāpnotīti| gamyata iti vacanaṃ tu prāptiheturvyāpāraḥ|
kuṇjikā stravatīti| kuṇḍikāyāmudakaṃ kuṇḍikodakavyāpāro vā
kuṇḍikāyāṃ cchidravatyāmupacaryate| nanu syandanamapi dravadravyakartṛkaṃ
calanameva; tathā prasiddhyabhāvāt||
padamañjarī
nigaraṇacalanārthebhyaśca|| 1|3|87 ||
calayatīti| ṭhcala kampane' ghaṭādiḥ| ādayate devadateneti|
ṭhgatibuddhi' ityādinā'ṇau kartuḥ karmasaṃjñā prāptā, ṭhatikhādyoḥ
pratiṣedhaḥ' iti vacanānna bhavati||
padamañjarī
aṇāvakarmakāccitavatkartṛkāt|| 1|3|88 ||
aṇāviti kimiti| ṇyantasya prayojyena karmaṇā
sakarmakatvamavaśyambhāvīti manyamānasya praśnaḥ| cetayamānamiti| ṭhcitī
saṃjñāne' curādiḥ| hetumaṇṇico vidhiriti| budhādisūtrādiha
ṇijgrahaṇamanuvartate, budhādibhyaśca hetumatyeva ṇic sambhavati,
tasmādihāpi tasyaiva grahaṇamiti bhāvaḥ| tatra yathā-ṭhbrāhmaṇa
ānīyantāmanyatrānadhīyānebhyaḥ' ityukte pratyāsateryadadhyayanaṃ
brahmaṇānāṃ sambhavati tadadhīyānebhya iti gamyate, na
tvadhyetvayamātramadhīyānebhya iti, tadvadihāpi tasyaiva gamyate
yajjātīyasya vidhau grahaṇamiti|
ārohayamāṇamiti| ṭhṇeraṇau' ityātmanepadaṃ śānac
tatraivāsyākarmakatvamupapāditam| prayuṅ kta iti pāṭhaḥ|
prayojayatīti pāṭhe ṇerartho mṛgyaḥ||
padamañjarī
na mādamyāṅyamāṅyasaparimuharucinṛtivadavasaḥ|| 1|3|89 ||
lugvikaraṇālugvikaraṇayoralugvikaraṇasya grahaṇamiti
pibativasatyorgrahaṇam, na pātivastyoḥ;
tenāṇāvakarmakatvavivakṣāyāṃ parasmaipadaṃ bhavatyeva| pāyayate iti|
ṭhśācchāsāhvāvyāvepāṃ yuk'|
pādiṣviti|| dheḍapyasmin sutre paṭhitavya ityarthaḥ| samīci iti
prathamādvivacane ṭhvā cchandasi' iti pūrvasavarṇadīrghaḥ||
padamañjarī
vā kyaṣaḥ|| 1|3|90 ||
lohitāyate iti| alohito lohito bhavatītyatrārthe kyaṣ,
ṭhakṛtsārvadhātukayoḥ' iti dīrghaḥ| paṭapaṭāyatīti| paṭacchabdasya
ḍājviṣaye dvirvacanam, ṭhavyaktānukaraṇāt' iti ḍāc, ṭilopa;
ṭhnityamāmreḍite ḍāci'| kathamiti| na kathañcidityarthaḥ| kiṃ
kāraṇamityāha-yāvateti| na niyamena vyāvartitamātmanepadamanena
śakyaṃ prāpayitum,na hyaśakyārthevacanasya vyāpāraḥ, vāvacanaṃ tu
kevalasya lasya prayogartha syādidi bhāvaḥ| | evaṃ tarhītyādi
parihāraḥ| vikalpitaṃ vibhāṣitam,pākṣikamityarthaḥ| kathaṃ punaḥ
parasmaipadaprakaraṇena vicchinnamātmanepadaṃ śakyaṃ vidhātum,ata
āha-tacceti| nanu śābdaḥ sannidhiḥ sambandhakāraṇam, pratiṣedhena
cāpavādabhūtasya bhāvāmātraṃ pratipādyate, ātmanepadaṃ tu svenaśāstreṇa
bhavati, na bhāvanā tasya sannidhirbhavati, ucyate; tātparyato'pi
sannidhiḥ, sannidhirevāpavādāpanayanasya cotsargapravṛtau tātparyam,
tena parasmaipadaṃ bhavatītyasyātmanepadaṃ bhavatīti tātparyārthaḥ|
yadvā-ihāpi pratiṣedha eva vidheyaḥ, sa ca pūrvasūtravadihātmanepadaṃ
pravartayiṣyati| kiṃ tarhi ucyate-anantaraṃ sannidhāpitāmiti,
nanvevamihaiva sannidhāpitaṃ bhavati? syādevam, yadi parasmaipadena
kyaṣantādātmanepadaṃ bādhitaṃ syād, niyamena tadvyāvṛttiḥ, tatra
svaviṣaye parasmaipadapratiṣedho vikalpyamānaḥ kiṃ kāraṇamātmanepadaṃ
pravartayet? pūrvatra tvapavādamapanayatā pratiṣedhenātmanepadaṃ
pravartyate, tasmādihāpi tadanuvṛttisāmarthyāt yāddaśaḥ pratiṣedha
ātmanepadapravṛtyavinābhāvī prakṛtaḥ, tāddaśa eva vidhīyata iti
matvoktam-ṭhanantaraṃ sannidhāpitam' iti| yadyātmanepadaṃ vidhīyate,
kenedānīṃ parasmaipadaṃ pakṣe bhavatītyata āha-tena mukta iti| iha
ṭhpropābhyāṃ samarthābhyām' ṭhanupasargādvā' ityanantaraṃ ṭhkyaṣaḥ' iti
sūtraṃ kartavyam- kyaṣantādātmanepadaṃ bhavatīti, nedaṃ
duḥkhamanubhavitavyaṃ bhavati, ṭhvā' grahaṇañca na kartavyaṃ bhavati,
utaramapi yogadvayaṃ tatraiva kāryam? tathā tu na kṛtamityeva||
padamañjarī
dyaudbhyo luṅi|| 1|3|91 ||
dyauterekatvādvahuvacanamanupapannamityāśaṅkyāha-tatsāhacaryāditi|
cchatrinyāyeneti bhāvaḥ| luṭhādayo'pīti| pratyāsannānāmeva
sāhacaryāt pratītiḥ syādityāśaṅkāmapanetuṃ
dūravartināmupādānam| kvacit śvityādaya ityanantarāṇāmeva
pāṭhaḥṣa kṛpūparyantā iti| tadanantaraṃ vṛtkaraṇāda etaduktaṃ
bhavatītyāha-bahuvacananirdeśāditi| vyadyautaditi| ṭhpuṣādi' iti
sūtreṇāṅ| na ca tata evāṅvidhānāt parasmaipadaṃ śakyaṃ vijñātuma;
nityatvaprasaṅgāt, luṅe'nyatrāpi prasaṅgacca| anudātetvaṃ tu
yujarthaṃ syāt||
padamañjarī
vṛdbhyaḥ syasanoḥ|| 1|3|92 ||
ṭhsyasanoḥ' iti satsaptamī| dyau tādiṣveva vṛtādayaḥ paṭha|lnta iti|
yadyevamiyaṃ prāptirvṛdbhyaḥ pūrvāṃ prāptiṃ bādheta, tataśca avṛtat,
avartiṣṭeti luṅ ivikalpo na syāt tathā cotaratra cakāraḥ
kriyate-imāṃ prāptiṃ pakṣe itarāprāptirna bādheteti,
dyautādipāṭhasārthyātso'pi bhaviṣyati| yadvā-luṅītyatra svarayiṣyate,
vartyatītyādau ṭhna vṛdbhyaścaturbhyaḥ' iti iṭpratiṣedhaḥ||
padamañjarī
luṭi ca klṛpaḥ|| 1|3|93 ||
evaṃ tarhīti| sāmānyasya viśeṣo vādhaka iti bhāvaḥ| kalptetyādau
ṭhtāsi ca klṛpaḥ' itīṭpratiṣedhaḥ||
iti haradataviracitāyāṃ padamañjaryāṃ prathamādhyāyasya tṛtīyaḥ pādaḥ||atha prathamādhyāye caturthaḥ pādaḥ
padamañjarī
ā kaḍārādekā saṃjhā|| 1|4|1 ||
ā kaḍārādekā saṃjñā|| āṅmaryādābhividhyoriti| samāsasya
vikalpitatvād| ṭhākaḍārāt' iti nirdeśaḥ, samāse tvākaḍāramiti
syāt| iha dvau kaḍāraśabdau bhavataḥ-ṭhprākkaḍārāt samāsaḥ', ṭhkaḍārāḥ
karmadhāraye' iti ca, tatra ko'vadhirityata āha-ṭhkaḍārāḥ karmadhāraye'
iti vakṣyatīti| kutaḥ punaretat? svātantryāt| svatantro hyasau
prathamānirdeśena svayaṃ kāryayogitvāt| prākkaḍārādityayaṃ tu
paratantro'vadhitvena svayaṃ kāryayogitvābhāvād,vyāpteśca
nyāyād| evaṃ hi bhūyasāmanugraho bhavati| liṅgacca, yadayaṃ
ṭhtatpuruṣaḥ' ṭhdviguśca' iti dvigostatpuruṣasaṃjñāṃ śāsti, taj
jñāpayati-anuvartate dvitīye'pyekasaṃjñādhikāra iti; anyathā
ṭhdiksaṅkhye saṃjñāyām' ityatra tatpuruṣādhikārādeva
samāveśasiddhestadartho yatno'pārthakaḥ syāt| kimartha,
punariyānavadhirupādīyate, na ā dvandvāt ityevocyeta, na hi
ṭhcārthe dvandvaḥ' ityataḥ paratrāsyopayogaḥ? ucyate; ṭhdvandvaśca
prāṇitūrya' ityayamapyavadhiḥ sambhāvyate, tataśca
sambuddhisaṃjñāmantritasaṃjñayoḥ samāveśo na syāt| 
kā punarasāviti| ekā saṃjñā bhavatītyetāvat sūtravyāpāraḥ, tatra
viśeṣādarśanāt praśnaḥ| ṭhyā parānavakāśā ca' iti vacanād
nyāyācca vyavastheti bhāvaḥ| nanu yadyārabdhe'pyasmin
paratvānavakāśatvābhyāmeva vyavasthā vācyā, anārabdhe'pyasmin
ābhyāmeva vyāvasthā bhaviṣyati,nārtha etena ? tatrāha-anyatreti|
ayambhāvaḥ- yatra prayojanamekaṃ bhavati, sahānavasthānalakṣaṇe vā
virodhaḥ, tatraivānavakāśaḥ sāvakāśaṃ bādhate,
yathā-naivāraścarurnakhāvapūtānāmiti, nakhāvapanena vaituṣyaphalakena
tatphalako'ghāto bādhyate| aṣṭāśriyūpaḥ kartavyaḥ, vājapeyasya tu
caturaśra iti, aṣṭāśritvacaturaśratvayorvirodhāt bādhyabādhakabhāvaḥ|
vipratiṣedho'pi virodhātmakatvātatraiva bhavati,
tadyathā-kṛtkṛtyapratyasaṃjñānāṃ taddhitatadrājapratyayasaṃjñānāṃ ca| sati
tvasmin sūtre ekasyaikaiveti niyamādvirodho jāyate, virodhe ca
sati paratvānavakāśatvābhyāṃ vyavasthā śakyate vaktumiti,
tatrānavakāśāyā udāharaṇamāha-vakṣyatīti| śikṣā, mikṣeti| ṭhgurośca
halaḥ' ityakārapratyayaḥ| yadyapyatra samāveśe'pi na kaściddoṣa, tathāpi
vastutaḥ samāveśo nāstīsyetāvatā idamudāsamāveśe'pi na
kaściddoṣaḥ, tathāpi vastutaḥ samāveśo nāstītyetāvatā
idamudāharaṇam| samprati yatra samāveśe sati doṣaḥ,
taddarśayati-atatakṣaditi| parasyāstūdāharaṇam-dhanuṣā vidhyatīti,
śarāṇāmapāyaṃ pratyavadhibhūtasyaiva dhanuṣo vyadhanaṃ prati
sādhakatamatvamityubhayaprasaṅge paratvātkaraṇasaṃjñāpādānasañjñāṃ
bādhate| tathā ṭhkāsyapātryāṃ bhuṅkte' ityadhikaraṇasañjñā,
dhanurvidhyatīti kartṛsaṃjñā| uktaṃ ca-apādānamutarāṇīti| iha gārgyo
dhānuṣka iti anavakāśābhyāṃ bhapadasaṃjñābhyāmaṅgasaṃjñāyā
dhātupratyayeṣu sāvakāśāyā bādhaḥ prāpnoti? jñāpa kātsiddham,
yadayamṭhsupi ca',bahuvacane jhalyet',ṭhtaddhiteṣvacāmādeḥ' iti
svādiṣu taddhiteṣu cāṅgasya sataḥ kāryaṃ śāsti, taj
jñāpayati-samāviśatyasaṃjñā bhapada saṃjñābhyāmiti| dvaye hi
svādayaḥ-yajādayo halādayaśca; tatra yajādaṣu bhasaṃjñā, halādiṣu
padasaṃjñeti aṅgasya sataḥ kāryavidhānamanupapannaṃ syāt|
gurulaghusaṃjñe varṇamātrasya vidhīyete, nadīghisaṃjñe tu tadantasyeti
tābhyāṃ samāviśataḥ, tadyathā-vātsībandhuriti| ṭhnadī bandhuni' iti
pūrvapadāntodātatvaṃ vātsībandho iti ṭhguroranṛtaḥ' iti plutaśca
bhavati| viśca nā ca vinarau, ṭhdvandve ghi' iti pūrvanipātaḥ,
vinnorbhāvo vainnam ṭhigantācca laghupūrvāt' ityaṇ,vinarāvacaṣṭe
iti vinayati, pravinayya gataḥ ṭhlyapi laghupūrvāt' ityayādeśo
bhavati|
bhāṣye tviṣṭaviṣaye samāveśo nyāsāntareṇa sādhitaḥ- prākkaḍārāt
paraṃ kāryamiti| tatrāyamarthaḥ- prākkaḍārāt saṃjñākhyaṃ kārayaṃ paraṃ
bhavatīti saṃjñāprakaraṇāt saṃjñaivātra kāryamityucyate, parā
saṃjñetyeva tu noktam,ṭhvipratiṣedhe vā' iti vakṣyati, tatra paraṃ
kāryamityanuvṛttiryathā syāditi tatra yasyāḥ saṃjñāyāḥ parasyāḥ
pūrvayā'nakāśayā bādhaḥ prāptaḥ, sā parā bhavatīti vidhirūpeṇāsya
pravṛttiḥ| nanvanakāśayāpipūrvayā naiva parasyā bādhaḥ prāpnoti;
virodhābhāvāt, virodhābhāvāt, phalaikyābhāvācca, saṃjñānāmanyatra
samāveśasya ddaṣṭatvāt, satyam; etadeva jñāpayati--bhavatyatra prakaraṇe
saṃjñānāṃ bādhyabādhakabhāva iti| tena parayānavakāśayā pūrvā
bādhyate, dvayośca sāvakāśayorvipratiṣedhe paramiti paraiva
bhavatīti| niyamaphalasyāpi siddhirasti nyāse'ṅgasaṃjñā parā kāryā,
pūrve na bhapadasaṃjñe| evaṃ sarvatra yatra samāveśa
iṣṭo'sminpakṣe-ṭhṛtoraṇ',ṭhcchandasi ghas',ṛtviya iti, atraṭhsiti ca'
iti-padasaṃjñāviṣaye paraṃ kāryamiti vacanād bhasaṃjñāpi syāt|
tataśca ṭhorguṇaḥ' prāproti, sitkaraṇaṃ padatve sati avagrahārthaṃ
syāt| ṭhśeṣo bahuvrīhiḥ' ityatra ca śeṣagrahaṇaṃ kartavyam, anyathā
ṭhanyapadārthe ca saṃjñāyām' iti avyayībhāvasaṃjñaiva bādhiketi
śeṣagrahaṇamanarthakam| tadevaṃ śeṣagrahaṇameva
pramāṇam--nyāsāntaramapi sūtrakārasyavābhimatamiti||
padamañjarī
vipratiṣedhe paraṃ kāryam|| 1|4|2 ||
vipratiṣedha iti| ṭhṣidhu śāstre',ṭhṣidhu gatyām' iti
bhauvādikayoranyatarasya rūpam, tasya hi ṭhsedhasicasañjasvañjām'
iti ṣatvamiti| upasargavaśācca virodhārthatvam| dhātunāṃ
hyupasargavaśādanyaścārtha upajāyate,tadyathā--prahāraḥ, upahāraḥ, anuhāraḥ,
saṃhāra iti| ṭhṣidhū saṃrāddhau' ityasya tu daivādikasya ṣatvaṃ nāsti,
ṭhsedhaṣica' iti śapā nirdeśāt| ṭhādeśapratyayayoḥ' iti vihitasya
tu ṭhsātpadādyoḥ' iti niṣedhaḥ| nanu ṭhgatikārakopapadānāṃ
kṛdbhiḥ saha sāmāsavacanaṃ prāk subutpateḥ'iti vacanānnāyaṃ
sakāraḥ padādiḥ| ṣatvaviṣaye paribhāṣeyaṃ na bhavati, yadi syād,
goṣṭhaḥ, bhūmiṣṭha ityādau sakārasyāpadāditvāt
ṭhādeśapratyayayoḥ'ityeva ṣatvasiddherambādau gāvādigrahaṇamanarthakaṃ
syāt|
paraśabdo'yaṃ triliṅgaḥ-paro deśaḥ, parā senā, paraṃ kāryamiti|
ato'yamavyutpannaḥ, pacādyajanto vā, na tu ṭhṛdorap' ityabantaḥ,tathā
hi sati triliṅgatā na syāt||
kṛllyuṭ napuṃsake bhāve striyāṃ ktinnādayo yataḥ|
ato ghañādyāḥ puṃsyeva yathā pākaścayo lavaḥ||
vāsarūpavidhirnnāsti, kṛllyuṭtumunkhalartheṣu
vāsarūpavidhirnāstīti vacanāt| striyāmapi nāsti, ṭhastriyām' iti
pratiṣedhāt| ato bhāvaghañādayaḥ puṃsyeva| kartṛvarjite tu kārake
puṃnapuṃsakayoḥ, na kathāñcit striyām| paraṃ kāryamiti | paraṃ
yatkāryametvādi tadbhavatītyarthaḥ, atha vā-yatparaṃ tatkāryaṃ bhavati,
kartavyaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ|
anye tvāhuḥ- na kriyāpadatvena kāryaśabdasyānvayaḥ, nāpi paraṃ kāryaṃ
bhavati, na tu śāstramityevaṃ śāstrādivyāvṛtaye kāryaśabdaḥ, kiṃ
tarhi? yatkāryaṃ kṛtyarhaṃ paraṃ tadbhavatīti vacanavyaktiḥ| arhe
kṛtyapratyayaḥ, kiṃ siddhaṃ bhavati? tulyabalavirodha iti siddhaṃ bhavati| na
hyapavādādīnāṃ sannidhāvutsargādīnāṃ kṛtyarhatvam,
tairbādhitatvāditi| viśedho vipratiṣedha iti| tadvācitvenaiva
loke prasiddhatvād vipratiṣiddhamityukte viruddhamiti gamyate, tasya
viṣayaṃ darśayati-yatretyādi| yatra viṣaye, vṛkṣābhyām,
vṛkṣoṣvityādau caritārthāvityarthaḥ| vyaktipakṣe tu tadviṣayayoḥu
vidhyoranyatra caritārthatvāsambhavād anyo'rthaḥ
prayojanamanayostāvanyārthau| dvau prasaṅgauukārye dīrghatvetvādike
yugapatprāpnutaḥ| sa vipratiṣedhaḥ, vipratiṣedhasya viṣaya ityarthaḥ,
tulyabalayorvirodho yasmin sa tathoktaḥ| paraṃ kārye bhavatīti|
yatkāryaṃ kṛtyarhaṃ paraṃ tadbhavatītyarthaḥ|
tulyabalavirodha ityasya vyāvartyaṃ darśayati-utsargāpavādetyādi| tatra
ṭhśyādvyadha' ityākārāntalakṣaṇo ṇapratyaya utsargaḥ, taṃ
paramapyanupasarga sāvakāśaṃ bādhitvā'navakāśatvāt ṭhātaścopasarge'
iti ka eva bhavati-saglaḥ, samlaḥ| radherṇici ṭhradhijabhoraci' iti
num kṛtākṛtaprasaṅgitvānnityaḥ, ṭhata upadhāyāḥ' iti vṛddhiranityā,
numi kṛte'kārasyānupadhātvādaprāpteḥ| tatra pūrvo'pi numeva
bhavati-randhayatīti| aśiśriyad, adudruvad
ityātrāntarbhūtacaṅpekṣatvād iyaṇuvāntaraṅgau bahiraṅgaṃ
laghūpadhaguṇaṃ paramapi bādhete, apavādādīnāṃ tu
parasparasaṃpradhāraṇāyāṃ nityādapyantaraṅgam, tasmādapavādaḥ| uktaṃ
ca--
paraṃ viduḥ pūrvaparopapatau parasya nityasya ca nityameva|
nityāntaraṅgopagame'ntaraṅgaṃ tasmādvidhiḥ prātipado balīyān||
iti|
dvayorekatropanipātaḥūpapatiḥ, parasya nityasya ceti| atra upa
samastadyākṛtau padārthe dvayorapyanyatra kṛtārthatvādvipratiṣedhe sati
parasparapratibandhādapravṛttireva prapnoti, tadyathā--yo hi
dvayostulyabalayorekaḥ preṣyo bhavati sa tayoḥ paryāyeṇa kāryaṃ
kāroti; yadā tamubhau yugapatpreṣayato nānā dikṣu ca kārye
bhavatastadā yadyasāvavirodhārtho bhavati ubhayorna karoti, tatra
vidhyarthamidaṃ paraṃ bhavatīti tasmin kṛte yadi pūrvasyāpi
nimitamasti tadapi bhavatyeva| yathā--bhindhakīti, bhind hi iti
sthite paratvāddhibhāvepunaḥ prasaṅgavijñānādakaj bhavati| vyaktau tu
padārthe sarvavyaktyuddeśena śāstrasya
pravṛtestadviṣayopanipātino'nyatra caritārthatvātparyāyeṇa pravṛtau
prāptāyāṃ niyamārthamidam-vipratiṣedhe parameva bhavati, na
pūrvamiti| etatsūtrārambhācca pūrvasya lakṣaṇasya
tatrānārambho'numīyate, taducyate-ṭhsakṛdgatau vipratiṣedhe
yadvādhitaṃ tadvādhitameva' iti| tadyathā-juhutāt tvamiti
paratvātātaṅadeśe kṛte sthānivadbhāvena prāptaṃ dhitvaṃ na bhavati|
lakṣyānurodhena vyaktyākṛtipadārthāśrayaṇādanayoḥ
paribhāṣayorviṣayavibhāgo'vaseyaḥ||
padamañjarī
yū stryākhyau nadī|| 1|4|3 ||
atra hrasvayoridutorgrahaṇe yadyapi savarṇagrahaṇāddīrghayorapi saṃjñā
labhyate, hrasvayorapi tu syāt;tataśca he śakaṭe, he dheno atrāpi
prāpnoti; iha ca śakaṭibandhuḥ-ṭhnadī bandhuni' iti
pūrvapadāntodātatvaṃ prasajyate; iha ca bahuśakaṭiḥ
bahudhenuriti-nadyaḥtaśca' iti nityaḥ kapsyāt, naiṣa doṣaḥ, ṭhṅiti
hrasvaśca' ityetanniyamārthaṃ bhaviṣyati-ṅtyevi hrasvau nadīsaṃjñau
bhavataḥ, nānyatreti| kaimarthyānniyamo bhavati vidheyaṃ nāstīti
kṛtvā, iha cāsti vidheyam, kima? nityā nadīsaṃjñā prāpnoti, sā
vibhāṣā vidheyā, ato husvayorapi syādeveti doṣaṃ ddaṣṭvā
dīrghayorgrahaṇamiti darśayati--ī ca ū ca yū iti| samāsavidhau
subadhikārānnaitad dvandvasya vigrahavākyam, kiṃ tarhi? arthapradarśanam|
atra cānukāryānukaraṇayorabhedavivakṣayā vibhaktirna kṛtā | kvacitu
vibhaktyantameva paṭha|lte| nanu dīrghayorgrahaṇe ṭhyū' iti nirdeśo
nopadyate, ṭhdīrghājjasi ca' iti pūrvasavarṇapratiṣedhād, ata
āha-avibhaktiko'yaṃ nirdeśa iti| ṭhdīrghājjasisuluk' iti
luptatvād ṭhvā cchandasi' iti pūrvasavarṇenāpahṛtatvādvā nāsmin
vibhaktiḥ śruyate ityavibhaktikaḥ|
anye tu naivāyaṃ dvandvaḥ, kintu pṛthak pade ityuktamityāhuḥ|
avibhaktikatvaṃ cātukāryānukaraṇayorabhedavivakṣayā| striyamācakṣāte
stryākhyāviti| nanu stryākhyā iti prāpnoti, ṭhanupasarge' iti ko
vidhīyate, yastu ṭhātaścopasarge' iti kaḥ, ayamakarmopapade
caritārthaḥ, karmaṇi tvaṇā bādhyate, yathā vakṣyati--akārādanupapadāt
karmopapade vipratiṣedheneti tatrāha--mūlavibhujādiṣu
darśanāditi| evaṃ ca kṛtvā idamapi siddhaṃ bhavati--
yasmin daśasahastrāṇi putre jāte gavāṃ dadau|
brāhmaṇebhyaḥ priyākhyebhyaḥ so'yamuñchena jīvati || iti||
iha īdūtoreveyaṃ saṃjñā vidhīyeta? tadantasya vā? ādye pakṣe kṛt
striyāṃ na syād--ādhyai, brāhmaṇyai, he lakṣmi, he yavāgviti;
samudāyo hyatra stryākhyaḥ, na tvīdūnmātram; ṅyūṅereva tu syāt,
striyāṃ vidhānādanvayavyatirekābhyāṃ ca stryākhyātvāditi dvitīyaṃ
pakṣamāśityāha--īkārāntamityādi| varṇagrahaṇe sarvatra
tadantavidhiriti tadantavidhilābhaḥ, ṭhsuptiṅntam' ityatra suptiṅeḥ
pratyayatvādanyatrāpi pratyayagrahaṇeṣu tadantavidhirnivāritaḥ| kathaṃ
punarjñāyatevarṇayorevedaṃ grahaṇaṃ na pratyayoriti,
iyaṇuvaṅsthānapratiṣedhāt| yadi tadantasya saṃjñā, kathaṃ
vakṣyati-śīnadyoḥ parataḥ nadyantādaṅgādutarasya iti? samudāyasya
nadītvātadavayavabhūtāvīdūtāvapi tathoktau|
anye tvāhuḥ- varṇayoreva saṃjñā, samudāyadharmasya stritvasyāvayava
āropāt| kṛt striyāmapi bhavati, atra ca
liṅgam-iyaṇuvaṅsthānapratiṣedha iti; teṣāṃ gurunadīsaṃjñayoḥ
samāveśo na syād, ekaviṣayatvāt|
yū iti kimiti| ṭhṇeórāmnadyāmnībhyaḥ' ityatra pṛthagābgrahaṇād āpo
na bhaviṣyatīti manyate| mātre duhitre iti ṭhndyaḥtaśca' iti
ṛkāragrahaṇamastryartha syād| bahupitṛka ityatretyajñāpakam
ṛkārāntānāṃ saṃjñābhāvasya| grāmaṇīḥ khalapūriti|
rūpodāharaṇametatsambuddhyantaṃ vā draṣṭvyam| athākhyagrahaṇaṃ
kimartham, yāvatā yu striyāmityetāvatā stryarthavṛttitvaṃ labhyate,
tatrāha--ākhyāgrahaṇamiti| āṅpūrvaṃsya ṭhkhyā' ityasya
dhātorgrahaṇamityarthaḥ| kvacitu ākhyagrahaṇaṃ kimiti praśnaḥ|
śabdārthastrītva iti ākhyāgrahaṇasāmarthyātpadāntaramanapekṣya yau
svayameva striyamācakṣāte ityāśrīyate| iṣvaśaniprabhṛtīnāṃ
tūbhayaliṅgānāṃ śabdārtha eva strītvamiti ṭhṅiti hrasvaśca' iti
nadīsaṃjñā bhavatyeva| evaṃ paṭuarānīyatāmityukte striyamapyānīya
kṛtībhavati|
anye tvāhuḥ-ākhyāgrahaṇasāmarthyānniyama āśrīyate-striyameva
yāvācakṣāte na tu liṅgantarayuktam iti| grāmaṇīkhalapūśabdayostu
kriyāśabdatvena triliṅgatvānna bhavati| iṣviśaniprabhṛtīnāṃ tu
strīviṣayantavābhāve'pi ṭhṅiti hrasvaśca' ityāyatra kevalasya
strīśabdasyaivānuvṛttirnākhyāgrahaṇasyeti bhavatīti teṣāmāṅpūrvasya
dhyāyateḥ kvipi samprasāraṇe-ādhyai brāhmaṇyai ityatrāpi na syāt|
tasmātpūrva eva prakāra āśrayaṇīyaḥ|
kathaṃ tarhi pratyudāharaṇam-grāmaṇyai striyai iti, khalapvai striyai iti?
ucyate; kriyāśabdatve'pyetayoḥ puṃsi mukhyā vṛttiḥ, puṃsāmeva
hyamucito dharmo yaduta grāmanayanaṃ nāma| evaṃ khalapavanamapi| ādhyānaṃ
tu stripuṃsasādhāraṇamiti viśeṣaḥ|
ṭhpathamaliṅgagrahaṇaṃ ca prayojanaṃ kviblupsamāsāḥ,' yaḥ śabdaḥ
prathamastritvayuktadravyamabhidhāya paścādyena kenacitprakārāntareṇa
liṅgāntarasaṃyuktaṃ dravyāntaramāha, tasya
tadānīmastryākhyatvādaprāptā saṃjñā vidhīyate|
kvip--kumārīmicchati kumārīyati, kumārīyateḥ kvip, kumārī
brāhmaṇaḥ, tasmai kumāryai brāhyāṇāya| lup--ṭhlummanuṣye' iti lup,
kharakuṭyai brāhmaṇāya| yadyapyatra yacuktavadbhāvāt strītvamapyasti,
tathāpi svāśrasya puṃstvasyānivṛternā'yaṃ striyāmeva vartata
ityākhyāgrahaṇādaprāptiḥ | samāsaḥ- atitantryai brāhmaṇāya|
avayavastrīviṣayatvāt siddham, samāse tāvadavayavastantrīśabdaḥ
striyāmeva vartata iti tadānīmeva saṃjñā, tataśca varṇasaṃjñāpakṣe
samudāyasya nadyantatvāt kāryasiddhiḥ; tadantapakṣe tu ṭhaṅgadhikāre
tasya ca tadutarapadasya ca' iti vacanād atitantrībandhurityatrāpi
ṭhnadī bandhuni' iti svaraḥ siddhaḥ; nadyā pūrvapadasya viśeṣaṇāt,
kvibluporapi pūrva striyāmeva vartitvāt, paścādapi
tadaparityāgenārthāntare vṛttiḥ|
tatrārthāntarasaṃsargātprāgevāntaraṅgatvātpravṛtā saṃjñā satyapi
paścālliṅgāntarayoge tasya ca bahiraṅgatvānna nivartiṣyate|
yadyevam, iyaṇuvaṅsthānapratiṣedhe yaṇsthānapratiṣedhaprasaṅgaḥ;
avayavayoriyaṇuvaṅsthānatvād| yathā hyavayavasya
striviṣayatvātsamudāyasya saṃjñā bhavati, tathāvayavasyeyuvasthānatvāt
samudāyasya yaṇsthānasyāpi pratiṣedhaprasaṅgaḥ, yathā--dhiyau,
ādhyāviti? siddhaṃ tvaṅgarūpagrahaṇād, yasyāṅgasyeyuvau
tatpratiṣedhādaṅgasyeyaṇuvaṅvidhanāsamarthyādaṅgasyākṣepaḥ, tena
yasyāṅgasyeyaṇuvaṅai nirvartetetasya nadīsaṃjñā niṣedhaḥ| ādhyai
ityatra tvavayavasyāṅgatvaṃ nāsti, aṅgasya ṭheranekācaḥ' iti
yaṇvidhānād iyaṇuvaṅsthānatā nāstīti niṣedhābhāvaḥ| etadarthameva
tatra sthānagrahaṇam--iyaṇuvaṅeryadā sthitistadā pratiṣedho yathā
syād, yadā tvapavādena bādhastadā mā bhūditi| evaṃ ṭhṅiti hrasvaśca'
ityatrāpyaṅgasyākṣepāt so'pi vidhiraṅgasyaiva strītve bhavati,
nāvayavasya--śakaṭyai, atiśakaṭaye brāhmaṇāya; śriyai, atiśriye
brāhmaṇāya||
padamañjarī
neyaṇuvaṅsthānāvastrī|| 1|4|4 ||
iyaṇuvaṅe sthānamanayoriti| vaiyadhikaraṇye'pi gamakatvādvahuvrīhiḥ|
anye tvadhikaraṇe lyuṭṃa vidhāya kartari ṣaṣṭhayāḥ samāsaṃ kurvanti|
atha katham ṭhvimānanā subhru kutaḥ piturgṛhe' iti? pramāda evāyam|
anyetvāhuḥ-anityo'yaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ, sakṛdvaddhatvāt | tathā ca
paribhāṣā-ṭhsakṛdvaddhamanityaṃ dvirbaddhañca subaddham' iti| atra jñāpakaṃ
tado dāvacanamityāhuḥ||
padamañjarī
vā''mi|| 1|4|5 ||
saṃhitāsāmye'pi ṣaṣṭhībahuvacanasya grahaṇam, na tu
dvitīyaikavacanasya, nadīkāryābhāvāt| nāpi saptamyekavacanasya; tasya
nadīsaṃjñotarakālamṭhṇeórāmnadyāmnībhyaḥ' iti vidhānāt| na ca ṭhāmi
iti viṣayasaptamī yujyate;ṭhtasminnipinirdiṣṭe' iti vacanāt,
tadāha-āmi parato vā nadīsaṃjñau na bhavata iti| śrīṇāmiti |
nadīsañjñāpakṣe ṭhhrasvanadyāpo nuṭ'||
padamañjarī
ṅiti hrasvaśca|| 1|4|6 ||
yadyatra hrasvaviśeṣaṇārtham ṭhyū' iti nānuvartyata,
tadehāpisyād--mātre duhitre iti, tasmātadihānuvartate|
nanvevamapi viśeṣaṇaṃ na prakalpateyū hrasvāviti; yadi yū, na hrasvau;
atha hrasvau, na yū;yū hrasvau ceti vipratiṣiddham; āhāyaṃ yū
hrasvāviti, tata evaṃ vijñāsyāmaḥ- yvoḥ hrasvāviti, kau ca yvoḥ
hrasvau savarṇau ? tadāha--hrasvaśca yvoḥ sambandhī yaḥ stryākhya iti|
atrāpi samudāyadharmasyāvayava āropād hrasvayoḥ stryākhyatvam,
tadantaviśeṣaṇaṃ vā| iyavaṇuṅsthānau ca yū iti| nanvekaṃ ṭhyū'
grahaṇamanuvartate, tacca hrasvaviśeṣaṇa evopakṣīṇam, tatkathaṃ punaḥ
ṭhyū' iti labhyate ? ucyate; cakāro'tra kriyate, sa saṃjñinaḥ
samuccayārthaḥ, iyaṇuvaṅsthānāviti prakṛtaṃ yvoreva ca
tatsthānatvamityarthād ṭhyū' iti labhyate| svaritatvādanuvṛtaṃ tu
ṭhyū' ityetad hrasvaviśeṣaṇamiti na kaściddoṣaḥ||
padamañjarī
śeṣo ghyasakhi|| 1|4|7 ||
ṭhā dhṛṣādvā' ityasminnadhikāre ṭhśiṣa asarvopayoge,
vipūrvo'tiśaye' iti paṭha|lte, tatra ṇicpakṣe karmaṇi ṭherac', anyathā
ghañ| hrasva iti vartata iti| anyathā grāmaṇyāderapi syād
astryākhyatvena śeṣatvād, yasya nadīsaṃjñā na vihitā tasya śeṣatve
mātre ityatrāpi syāditi matvā pṛcchati--kaśceti| itarastu
hrasvaviśeṣaṇārthaṃ ṭhyū' ityasyānanuvṛttimāśrityāha--hrasvamiti|
hrasvāntamityarthaḥ| yadāha--ivarṇovarṇāntāditi| kvacitu
hrasverṇovarṇāntamiti pāṭhaḥ, hrasvātmako ya ivarṇa uvarṇaśca
tadantamityarthaḥ| hrasvena śeṣasya viśeṣaṇatvāt tadantavidhiḥ| evaṃ ca
ṭhasakhi' iti sakhiśabdasya pratiṣedho na tatsambandhina ikārasya, kiṃ saddhaṃ
bhavati? iha śobhanassakhā asya susakhiḥ, susakherāgacchatīti ghisaṃjñā
siddhā bhavati| na hyayaṃ samudāyaḥ sakhiśabdaḥ, tadantavidhiśca grahaṇavatā
prātiṣedhādihāpi na syāt| yadi tadante niṣedho na bhavati
ṭhyasyeti ca' ityatra ivarṇasya ī iti yadudāharaṇaṃ sakhiśabdāt
ṭhsakhyaśiśrīti bhāṣāyām' iti ṅīṣi sakhi ī iti sthite ikārasya
lopaḥ| asati tu lope savarṇadīrdhasya pūrva pratyantavadbhāvāt
sakhīmatikrānto'tisakhiḥ, atisakherāgacchatītyatrāsakhīti
dhisaṃjñāpratiṣedhaḥ syāditi tannepapadyate| satyapyantavadbhāvena
sakhigrahaṇena grahaṇe samudāyasya sakhiśabdādanyatvāt| yadā khalu
puṃlliṅgepyatisakhiriti bhavati, tadā kaḥ prasaṅgo
yadantavadbhāvena syāt? yatu tatrodāhariṣyate so'nāsthāvādo
draṣṭvyaḥ| śeṣagrahaṇaṃ cintyaprayojanam| ekasaṃjñādhikārādeva hi
stryākhyasya ṅiti nadīsaṃjñāpakṣe ghisaṃjñā na bhavaṣyati||
padamañjarī
patiḥ samāsa eva|| 1|4|8 ||
siddhāyāmiti| prāptāyāmityarthaḥ, na punarniṣpannāyām, na hi
niṣpannāyāṃ niyamena nivṛttiḥ śakyā vaktum| patiśabdaḥ samāsa eva
ghisaṃjño bhavatīti| kiṃ punaridaṃ samāsāvayavasya patiśabdasya saṃjñā
vidhīyate? āhosvitadantasamāsasya? yadi samāsasya ? patiśca gṛhaṃ ca
patigṛhe-atra dvandve ghiḥ iti pūrvanipāto na prāpnoti; atha
patiśabdasya? prajāpatinetyādikasya ghisaṃjñākārtha na prāpnoti| atha
vā ṭhpatiḥ samāsaeva' iti niyamena kiṃ vyāvartyate? asamastaḥ
patiśabdaḥ| patiśabdasya vyāvartyamānā kena tadantasya vyāvartyate?
patiśabdasambandhī ya īkārastadāśrayā sā ghisañjñā bhavati, yadi samāsa
evetyartho vivakṣitaḥ| tena samāse patiśabdasyānantyasyāpi
bhavati-patiśca gṛhaśca patigṛhe, ṭhdvandve ghiḥ' iti pūrvanipātaḥ|
patiśabdāntasya samāsasyāpi bhavati-prajāpatineti, ata eva vṛttikṛtā
patiśabdānurūpasūtrārtho darśitaḥ| udāharaṇantu tadantānurūpaṃ
darśitam| atha katham
naṣṭe mṛte pravrajite klībe'tha patite patau|
pañcasvāpatsu nārīṇāṃ patiranyo vidhīyate|| iti? 
chandovaddaṣayaḥ kurvanti| atha pūrvatraiva ṭhasakhipatī' iti
kasmānnoktam? utaratra patyureva vikalpo yathā syāt| kiñca
ṭhasakhipatī' ityucyamāne patiśabdasya samāse'pi na syāt--patigṛhe
iti| tathā ca sakhiśabdasya samāsāvayavasyāpi ghisañjñāyā
abhāvāt--sakhigṛhe,gṛhasakhāyāviti cāniyamaḥ pūrvanipātasya||
padamañjarī
ṣaṣṭhīyuktaścchandasi vā|| 1|4|9 ||
ṣaṣṭha|lntena śabdeneti| ṣaṣṭha|la vibhaghaktyā yukta iti tu na bhavati|
tathā hi-ṣaṣṭha|lamityeva brūyād, yuktagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt|
ṣaṣṭhīgrahaṇaṃ kimiti| atra kecidyogasyāvarjanīyatvādyaukta ityeva
viśiṣṭo yogaḥ pratyeṣyata iti manyante, vacanamantareṇa viśeṣo
durjñāna ityutaram| ayamatra yogavibhāgaḥ kartavyaḥ-ṭhṣaṣṭhīyuktaḥ
cchandasi',ṣaṣṭhīyuktaḥ patiśabdaḥ cchandasi ghisañjño bhavati; tato ṭhvā',
cchandasītyeva, yacca yāvacca śāstre kāryaṃ tatsarvaṃ cchandasi vikalpena
bhavatiḥ sarve vidhayaścchandasi vikalpyanta ityarthaḥ| ubhayatravibhāṣā
ceyam, ṭhbahulaṃ cchandasi' ityādikastvasyā eva prapañcaḥ||
padamañjarī
hrasvaṃ laghu|| 1|4|10 ||
iha sarpiṣṭvāmityatra ṭhhrasvātādau taddhite' iti ṣatvārthaṃ hrasvasaṃjñayā
garusaṃjñāyā samāveśa iṣyate| atatakṣadityatra tu sanvadbhāvanivṛtyarthaṃ
laghusaṃjñāyā gurusaṃjñayā bādha iṣyate| ato hrasvapradeśeṣu
saṃyogaparasyāpi mātrikasyagrahaṇaṃ yathā syāt, laghupradeśeṣu mā
bhūditi yathāpradeśe saṃjñādvayaṃ kartavyam||
saṃyoge guru|| 1|4|11 ||
dīrgha ca|| 1|4|12 ||
padamañjarī
yasmātpratyayavidhistadādi pratyaye'ṅgam|| 1|4|13 ||
karteti| luṭ| kariṣyatīti| lṛṭ| akariṣyaditi| lṛṅ,ṭhṛddhanoḥ
sye' itīṭ| yasmāditi saṃjñinirdeśāthamiti| nanu tadādītyanena
saṃjñī nirdiśyate, na yasmādityanena tatrāha-tadādītisaṃbandhāditi|
sati hi yasmādityasmin tadādītyanena saṃjñā nirdeaṣṭuṃa śakyate,
nānyathā | sati hi parāmarśanīye tadityanena parāmarśo bhavati,
anyathā tadādītyasaṃbaddhameva syāt| ṭhnerviśaḥ'
ityupasargādvidhirastīti| yadyapi niratra dhātuviśeṣaṇam-- neḥ paro
yo viśiriti, dhātostaṅvidhānād niyamavidhirapi dhātoriva
nopasargāt, tathāpyupasargasyāpi tatrānvayo'stīti matvā
evamuktam|
vidhigrahaṇaṃ kimiti| ṭhyasmātpratyaya' ityukate sākāṅkṣatvād
yasmādvidhīyata ityadhyāhariṣyata iti praśnaḥ | paraśabdasyāpyadhyāhāraḥ
syādityutaram| strī iyatīti| idaṃ parimāṇamasyāḥ ṭhkimidabhyāṃ vo
ghaḥ' iyādeśaḥ,ṭhidaṃkimorīśkī',ṭhyasyetica' iti lopaḥ,ṭhugitaśca'
iti ṅīp, strīśabdāt sorhalṅyādilopaḥ| atra iyacchabde
parato'ṅgasaṃjñā syād bhasaṃjñā ceti tannimito yasyeti lopaḥ
prasajyeta| iśādeśasya yasyeti lopaḥ, tasyābhīyasyāpyasiddhatvaṃ na
bhavati, prāgbhādasiddhatvamiti keṣāñcidabhyupagamād|
sthānivadbāvo'pi nāsti, padāntaranirapekṣe hīyatīśabde
vyutpādyamāne strīśabdo'nādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvaḥ|
nanu kriyamāṇe vidhigrahaṇe syādeva saṃjñā, astyeva hyatra strīśabdād
vibhakteḥ pratyayasya vidhiriyatpratyayaśca paraḥ, naiṣaḥ; sati vidhigrahaṇe
pratyāsateryasmādyaḥ pratyayo vihitastasminneva pratyaye
paratastadādyaṅgamityartho bhavati| iha ca strīśabdādvihito luptaḥ,
śruyamāṇaśca na tato vihitaḥ, tadādigrahaṇamanarthakam,
yatadornityasambandhādeva yasmātpratyayo vidhīyate
tadaṅgamityarthalābhād ata āha-tadādivacanamiti| syādayo
vikaraṇāḥ| ādiśabdena śabādergrahaṇam| asati tadādigrahaṇe
yacchabdavatacchabdasyādhyāhārād yasmātpratyayavidhistasyaiva saṃjñā
syād na tu tata ārabhya ā tasmātprayayādyaḥ saṃghātaḥ tasya| tataśca
kariṣyāvaḥ, pacāvaḥ, dīvyāvaḥ, tudāva ityādau ṭhato dīrgho yañi '
iti dīrgho na syāt; syādyantasya samudāyasyānaṅgatvāt| tataśca
pāpāva ityādāveva syāt, ṭhpayagatau' yaṅlugantasya ṭhlopo
vyorvali' iti lope rūpam| kuṇḍānīti| yadā num parādiḥ, tadā
ṭhsupi ca' iti dīrghaḥ sidhyati| dadhīnītyādāvanakārāntatvānna
sidhyati, pūrvāntapakṣe sāmānītyādivatsidhyati| yadā tvabhaktapakṣaḥ
tadaitatprayojanaṃ tadādigrahaṇasya, pūrvāntapakṣastu tatra sthita
ityaprayojanametat| 
nanu ca ṭhprātipadikāntanumvibhaktiṣu ca' iti numgrahaṇaṃ kurvataḥ
sūtrakārasyābhakto numityabhiprāyo lakṣyate, anyathā māṣavāpāṇītyatra
prātipadikāntatvādvibhaktinakāratvādvā ṇatvasiddheranarthakaṃ tatsyāt?
naitatsūṣṭhūacyate; tatra hi samāsaprātipadikānto na gṛhyate, kiṃ tarhi?
pūrvapadādityanuvṛtestadākṣiptasyotarapadaprātipadikasyānto
gṛhyate, samudāyabhaktaśca num utarapadaprātipadikānto na bhavati|
tataśca yathā gargāṇāṃ bhaginī gargabhaginītyatra ṇatvaṃ na bhavati, tathā
numo'pi na syāt| na tarhidānīmidaṃ bhavati-gargabhagiṇīti? bhavati,
yadaitaddhākyaṃ bhavati-gargāṇāṃ bhago gargabhagaḥ so'syā astīti| tadā
hyanutarapadasthatvāt pūrvapadāt sañjñāyāmeveti niyamābhāvaḥ,
tadyathā- mātṛbhogāya hito mātṛbhogīṇa iti| evamapi māṣān
vaptuṃ śīlamasyāḥ māṣavāpiṇī-atra na prāpnoti,
ṅībatrotarapadasyānto na tu nakāraḥ| nakāra evātrāntaḥ, katham?
gatikārakopapadānāṃ kṛdbiḥ saha samāsavacanaṃ prāk subutpateḥ,
ataḥ syādyarthaṃ kriyamāṇaṃ tadādigrahaṇaṃ numyapīṣṭṃa sādhayatīti matvā
numgrahaṇaṃ kṛtam| yadi tadādītyucyate kartetyādau na prāpnoti,
na hyatra tadādi kiñcidasti, kiṃ tarhi? tadeva,
vyapadeśivadbhāvādbhaviṣyati, vākyabhedādvā,
yasmātpratyayavidhistadaṅgam, tadādi ca| ihaṭhprakṛtyādi
pratyaye'ṅgam' iti iyatā siddhe gurunirheśa eva liṅgaṃ
vākyabhedasya|
atha kathaṃ bhinati, saṃcaskaraturityatra sanumkasya ca
samudāyasyāṅgasaṃjñā? kathaṃ ca na syād? iha tasya vā grahaṇaṃ bhavati?
tadādervā? na cedaṃ tannāpi tadādi| idamapi tadādi, katham? naivaṃ
vijñāyate-sa ādirasyatatadādīti| kathaṃ tarhi
tasyādistadādistadādirasyeti? tathāpi uṣṭramukhavadekasyādiśabdasya
lopaḥ| evaṃ hi vijñāyamāne bhinatītyatra yasmātpratyayavidhibhidestasya
ādirbhakāraḥ, sa ādiḥ sannantasya samudāyasyeti sidhyati| evaṃ
saṃcaskaraturityatrāpi ṭhtanmadhyapatitastadgrahaṇena gṛhyate' iti
cātrobhayatra sajñāsiddhiḥ| athātra śnamaḥ pūrvasya bhiśabdasyaṅgasañjñā
kasmānna bhavati? bhavatu, ko doṣaḥ? guṇastāvatṭhsārvadhātukamapid'
iti ṅitvādevi na bhaviṣyati| iha anakti, bhanakti- ṭhato dīrgho yañi'
iti dīrghaḥ prāpnoti, tiṅīti tatra vartate| atha
vā-ṭhyasmātpratyayavidhiḥ' iti dīrghaḥ prāpnoti, tiṅīti tatra vartate|
atha vā-ṭhyasmātpratyayavidhiḥ' iti vacanādyasmin pratyaye vidhīyamāne
yatpañcamyā nirdiṣṭṃa tatra tadevāṅgam, śnami ca vidhīyamāne ye
pañcamyā nirdiṣṭā rudhirādayo na te tatra parataḥ, ye'tra śnami
paratoti'prabhṛtayo na te pañcamyā nirdiṣṭā iti sañjñaabhāvaḥ|
śyarthamiti| ṭhcaturthī tadartha' iti samāsaḥ| asti hyatra
caturthyekavacanasya vidhirityasati punaḥ pratyayagrahaṇeṅgaśabdasya
sambandhiśabdatvābhāvāt vastuto'ṅgamātrāśraya iyaṅ syāt| sati
tu saptamīnirddiṣṭapratyayagrahaṇe'ṅgaśabdaḥ sambandhiśabdo bhavati,
tataścāṅgasyeyaṅ bhavati| acītyakte yadapekṣaṃ yadaṅgam, tatra
tasyājādāviti vijñānādarthaśabde parata imaṇuvaṅai na bhaviṣyataḥ|
kiṃ punaraṅgasaṃjñāyāḥ prayojanam? aṅgasyetyadhikāraḥ| naitadasti;
yadetadaṅgasyetyetat pratyaya iti vakṣyāmīti| evamapi prākarot
praihiṣṭa-sopasargasyāḍāṭau prāpnutaḥ, naiṣa doṣaḥ, pratyayagrahaṇe
yasmātsa vihitastadādergrahaṇaṃ bhavatīti| kva punareṣā paribhāṣā?
nanveṣāpyatraiva yogavibhāgena siddhā, ṭhyasmātpratyayavidhistadādi
pratyaye' ityetāvāneko yogaḥ| pratyaye gṛhyamāṇe yasmāt tasya
vidhistadādi gṛhyata ityarthaḥ, tena ṭhñnityādiḥ' ityādau yatra pratyayaḥ
saptamyā nirdiśyate tatra tadādergrahaṇam, tena devadato gārgya iti
saṃghātasya ñitsvaro na bhavati| ṭhsupāatmanaḥ kyac' ityatra tu supā
karmaṇo viśeṣaṇātadantavidhau siddhe mahāntaṃ
putramityādāvatiprasaṅge tadādiniyamena vyudāsaḥ| yadi
tadādiniyamaḥ kriyate strīpratyaye'pi syāt, tataḥ ṣyaṅntasya
pūrvapadasyocyamānaṃ saṃprasāraṇaṃ paramakārīṣagandhīputra ityatra na
syād-yatpūrvapadaṃ na tatṣyaṅntam, yatṣyaṅntaṃ na tatpūrvapadam,
naiṣa doṣaḥ, ṭhneyaṇuvaṅsthānāvastrī' ityataḥṭhastrī' ityanuvartate,
tacca svarūpapadārthakatvena prakṛtamapīhārthapadārthakaṃ saṃpadyate,
tadayamartho bhavati-pratyayagrahaṇe tadādi gṛhyate
prakṛtamapīhārthapadārthakaṃ saṃpadyate, tadayamartho bhavati-pratyayagrahaṇe
tadādi gṛhyate strī cennābhidhīyate| strīpratyaye tadādiniyamo
nāstītyarthaḥ| yadyevam,atikārīṣagandhyāputraḥ-atrāpi prāpnoti,
pradhānaṃ yā strī tasyāmeva tadādiniyamapratiṣedhaḥ, apradhānastriyāṃ tu
tadādiniyamo bhavatyeva| tena yāvānaṃśaḥ striyaṃ prādhānyena
pratipādayati, tāvataḥ strīpratyayāntasya grahaṇaṃ bhavati| tadgrahaṇe tu
gatikārakapūrvasyāpi grahaṇaṃ bhavatīti ṭhgatiranantaraḥ'
ityanantaragrahaṇaṃ jñāpayiṣyate| 
padamañjarī
suptintaṃ padam|| 1|4|14 ||
suptiṅiti pratyāhāragrahaṇamiti| subiti saptamībahuvacanasya grahaṇaṃ
na bhavati; yadi syāt, ṅisaṃbuddhyoḥ padatvābhāvādeva
nalopasyāprasaṅgāt ṭhna ṅisaṃbuddhyoḥ' iti pratiṣedho'narthakaḥ
syāditi bhāvaḥ| saptamībahuvacanasya ca pakāreṇa pratyāhāro na kapaḥ
pakāreṇa; tasyāhārastadā svaravidhāvapi tathaiveti suptvādeva
svarasiddheḥ pitvamanarthakameva syāt| yadi ca subgrahaṇeṣu kapaḥ
pakāreṇa pratyāhāro'bhimataḥ syāt ṭhsupyasarvanāmasthāne' ityeva
brūyāt, ṭhsvādiṣu' iti gurunirdeśo'narthakaḥ syāt| brāhmaṇā iti|
padatvādrutvaviśarjanīyau|
nanu yasmātpratyayavidhistadādītyanuvṛtasya suptiṅbhyāṃ
viśeṣaṇādeva tadantasya grahaṇaṃ siddham, nārtho'ntagrahaṇena,
tatrāha-padasaṃjñāyāmiti| ihāsatyantagrahaṇe suptiṅameva saṃjñā
syāt, tataścāgniṣvityādau ṭhsātpadādyoḥ' iti ṣatvaniṣedhaḥ
syādityāśaṅgya kriyamāṇamantagrahaṇamuktasyārthasya jñāpakaṃ saṃpadyate|
gaurībrāhmaṇitareti| tarabantasya ghasaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ tatrotarapade
parato gaurīśabdasya puṃvadbhāvaṃ bādhitvā paratvād hrasvatvaṃ
syāt| tarapi tu parato brāhmaṇīśabdasya na syāt; tataśca
gaurībrāhmaṇatareti syād, gaurabrāhmaṇitareti ceṣyate| vṛtau tu
samāsapradarśanaparaṃ vākyamupātam, na tvetatkāryodāharaṇam|
gaurabrāhmaṇitareti samāse rūpam||
padamañjarī
naḥ kyeḥ|| 1|4|15 ||
kya iti kyackyaṣkyaṅamiti| ṭhsaṃjñāyāṃ samaja' ityasya tu kyapograhaṇaṃ
na bhavati; prayojanabhāvāt| na tāvanmanyetyatra nalopaḥ prayojanam,
satyapi padatve'prātipadikatvāt;subantamityanuvṛtervā kyapi
vidhyarthametanna bhavati|
nanu kyajādayaḥ subantāddhidhīyanta iti pratyayalakṣaṇena siddhaṃ padatvam,
nārtha etena tatrāha-siddhe satīti| nāntameveti| kya eva
nāntamityevaṃ tu viparītaniyamo na bhavati; ṭhna ṅasimbuddhyoḥ'
iti niṣedhāt| vācyatīti| atra padatvābhāvātkutvajaśtve na bhavataḥ
ye tu gosamānākṣaranāntādeva kyaj bhavati, nānyebhya ityāhuḥ,
teṣāṃ kyaṅkyaṣoreva niyamasya vyāvartyaṃ
pradarśanīyam-tapasyatītyādau||
padamañjarī
siti ca || 1|4|16 ||
bhavadīya iti| padatvājjatvam| ūrṇāyuriti padasaṃjñāyā
nirastatvād yasyeti lopābhāvaḥ| evam ṛtviya iti ṭhorguṇaḥ' na
bhavati, cakāro'nuktasamuccayārthaḥ tena
bhuvaddhārayatormatoścchandasi ṭhtasau matvarthe' iti bhasaṃjñāṃ
bādhitvā padasaṃjñā bhavati, tena bhuvadvadbhyaḥ, dhārayadvadbhyaḥ||
padamañjarī
svādiṣvasarvanāmasthāne|| 1|4|17 ||
svādiṣviti suśabdādekavacanāditi| saptamībahuvacanādārabhya
grahaṇaṃ na bhavati; ṭhasarvanāmasthāne' iti niṣedhāt, yadi hi
rājaśrita ityādau sarvanāmasthāne ṭhsubantam' iti prāptāyāḥ
saṃjñāyāḥ niṣedho'bhīṣṭaḥ syāt, tatraiva ṭhasarvanāmasthāne' iti
brūyāt| atha rājavānityādāvantarvartiniṣedha iti ced, na; lumatā
lupte pratyayalakṣaṇābhāvāt, ṭhtasau matvarthe' iti padasaṃjñābādhanāya
bhasaṃjñāvidhānācca| ā kapa iti| yadi punaḥ saptamībahuvacanaparyantā
ekaviṃśatiḥ pratyayā gṛhyaeran, tadā subgrahaṇameva kuryād,
anuvartayedvā; ṭhasarvanāmasthāne' ityanena sambandhātsaptamyā
vipariṇāmāt siddham| kimatha punarā kapaḥ pratyayā gṛhyante, yāvatā
subantātaddhitotpatiḥ samarthādhikārāt, svārthikā api
subantādeva,ṭhghakālataneṣu' iti liṅgat, tataśca rājatvaṃ
rājatetyādāvantarvartinyā vibhaktyā subantaṃ padamityeva siddham?
satyam; bhasaṃjñārthaṃ tvā kapaḥ pratyayā gṛhītāḥ| rājatvamityādi|
subantatve'pi| paratvādanena padatvaṃ yuktamityeṣāmupanyāsaḥ|
rājānau, rājāna iti| atrāpadatvānnalopābhāvaḥ, rājetyatra tu
pratyayalakṣaṇena niṣedho na bhavati ṭhna ṅasimbuddhyoḥ' iti
liṅgānnaitalliṅgamupapadyate| he varmanniti napuṃsake lumatā
lupte sarvanāmasthāne niṣedhābhāvādastyeva padatvamiti tatrārthavān
pratiṣedhaḥ| evaṃ tarhi nāyaṃ prasajyapratiṣedhaḥ- sarvanāmasthāne neti,
kiṃ tarhi? paryudāso'yam-padanyatsarvanāmasthānaditi|
sarvanāmasthāne na vidhirna pratiṣedhaḥ; yadi kenacitprāpnoti,
bhavatyeva, pūrveṇa prāpnoti, atha vā-anantarā yā prāptiḥ sā
pratiṣidhyate | kutaḥ punaretad? ṭhanantarasya vidhirvā bhavati
pratiṣedho vā'| atha vā-ṭhsarvanāmasthāne' ityatra yacītyapakṛṣya
sambadhyate, tena yajādau padasaṃjñā niṣidhyate, na halādāviti
rājetyāte, svādau, evaṃ hi ṭhasarvanāmasthāne' iti na vaktavyaṃ
bhavati? utarārtha suṭha|lpi napuṃsake bhasaṃjñā yathā syāt, sāmnī ityatra
mā bhūd| bhasañjñā ṭhvibhāṣā ṅiśyoḥ' īti
vacanasāmarthyādevābhasyāpyallopo bhaviṣyati| tatrāyamapyartho
yasyetyādau ṭhśyāṃ pratiṣedhaḥ' iti na vaktavyaṃ bhavati; abhatvādeva
siddham| iha tarhi supadī brāhmaṇakule iti padbhāvo na
syādabhatvāt, iha ca sāmāni paśyeti bhatvādallopaḥ syāditi
yathānyāsamevāstu||
padamañjarī
yaci bham|| 1|4|18 ||
yakārādāvityādi| ṭhyasminvidhistadādāvalprahaṇe' iti
tadādividhiḥ| gārgya ityādau bhatvādyasyeti lopaḥ|
nabho'ṅgiromanuṣāṃ vatyupasaṃkhyānamiti| dve apyete upasaṃkhyāne
chandoviṣaye ityāhuḥ| nabha iveti| tṛtīyāsamarthādvatervidhānāt
tulyārthāpadarśanametat, nabhasā tulyaṃ vartata iti vigrahaḥ|
padanibandhanakāryanivṝtyathameva caiṣāṃ bhasañjñā vidhīyate, na tu
bhatvanimitaṃ kāryaṃ yathā syāditi; asambhavāt|
nabhasvad, aṅgirasvaditi| atrāpadatvādrutvābhāvo manuṣvadityatra
padatve rutvaṃ syād na tu ṣatvam; apadāntasyeti vacanāt|
vṛṣaṇvasuḥ vṛṣaṇāśva iti| padatve sati ṭhpadāntasya' iti
pratiṣedhāṇṇatvaṃ na syāt, nalopaśca syād| bhatve'pyallopo na
bhavati; anaṅgatvāt||
padamañjarī
tasau matvarthe|| 1|4|19 ||
nabhasvad, aṅgirasvaditi| atrāpadatvādrutvābhāvo manuṣvadityatra
padatve rutvaṃ syād, na tu ṣatvam; apadāntasyeti vacanāt|
vṛṣaṇvasuḥ, vṛṣaṇaśva iti| padatve sati ṭhpadāntasya' iti
pratiṣedhāṇṇatvaṃ na syāt, nalopaśca syād| bhatve'pyallopo na
bhavati; anaṅgatvāt||
tasau matvarthe|| matvarthīyenākṣiptāyāḥ prakṛtestakārasakārābhyāṃ
viśeṣaṇātadantavidhirityāha-takārasakārāntamiti| matvarthe pratyaye
iti| vyadhikaraṇe saptamyau, matorartho matvarthastatra yaḥ pratyayo
vartate tasminnityarthaḥ| atha vā samānādhikaraṇe matuśabdena
sāhacaryātadartho lakṣyate-maturartho yasya tasminnityarthaḥ|
udaśvitvāniti| bhatvāt padatvābhāve jaśtvaṃ na bhavati, ṭhjhayaḥ' iti
vatvam| udakena śvayati varddhate udaśvit, kvipi
ṭhudaśvito'nyatarasyām' iti nipātanāt saṃprasāraṇābhāvaḥ,
saṃjñāyāmudbhāvaḥ| payasvīti| ṭhasmāyāmedhāstrājo viniḥ'
bhatvādrutvābhāvaḥ|
athārthagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, na ṭhmatau'ityucyate, svādiṣviti vartate,
vyadhikaraṇe saptamyau, matau ye svādayaḥ| kathaṃ punaḥ śabde nāma
śabde vartate'sambhavāt, arthe vṛttirvijñāsyate? yadyevaṃ labhyeta, kṛtaṃ
syāt; tatu na labhyam, na hi sāmānādhikaraṇye sambhavati
vaiyadhikaraṇyaṃ śakyaṃ vijñātum, tataśca matāveva syāt-payasvān
yaśasvāniti, iha tu na syāt-payasvī, yaśasvīti, ato'rthagrahaṇaṃ
kartavyam| yadyarthagrahaṇaṃ kriyate, matupi na prāpnoti;
tasyārthaviśeṣaṇatvāt, satyam; arthaviśeṣaṇaṃ matub,
viśeṣyākāro'pi tatrāsti| asyāstyasminniti ca matupo'rthaḥ, sa ca
vinyādīnāmiva matupo'pyaviśiṣṭaḥ, yathā-devadataśālāyāmāsīnā
brāhmaṇā ānīyantāmityukte viśeṣaṇabhūto'pi devadataḥ sita brāhmaṇaye
ānīyate| yatra upalakṣyākārasyāsambhavaḥ tatraivopalakṣaṇasya
kārthāyogaḥ, tadyathā-citragurānīyatāmiti, na hi citragavīṇāṃ gāvaḥ
santi||
padamañjarī
ayasmayādīnicchandasi|| 1|4|20 ||
yadi saṃjñā vidhīyeta ānantarthādbhasaṃjñāvidhānadvāreṇaiva nipātanaṃ
syāt, padasaṃjñā na syād, bhapadasaṃjñayoḥ samāveśo na syāt,
tasmātsādhutvameva yuktaṃ vidhātumiti matvāha-ayasmayādinītyādi|
sādhutve prakāraviśeṣaṃ darśayati| bhapadasaṃjñādhikāra ityādi|
dvāramūpāyaḥ| ayasmayamiti| ayaso vikāraḥ ṭhdvyacaścchandasi' iti
mayaṭ||
padamañjarī
bahuṣu bahuvacanam|| 1|4|21 ||
bahuvacanaṃ vihitamiti| tataśca tasya vidheyavibhaktinirddiṣṭasyāpi
prāptatvādanuvādyatvam, na tu vidheyatvamiti bhāvaḥ|
bahutvasaṃkhyānubhūtavibhaktirnirdiṣṭāpyapratvādvidhīyata
ityāha-tasyāneneti| ihaṃ cāparamanena granthena
darśitam-svādividhivākyena hi bhinnametad vākyam,| tatrāpi
vidhyarthaṃ na tu niyamārthamiti| yadāha-bahuvacanaṃ vihitamiti|
