bahutvasaṃkhyāvācyatvena vidhīyata iti ca| yadi punarekavākyatayā
viśiṣṭavidhiḥ syād,itaretaraśrayaṃ prāpnoti-vihitānāṃ jasādīnāṃ
bahuvacanasaṃjñā,saṃjñayā ca vidhānamiti| kiṃ cāvyayebhyo niḥsaṃbhyaḥ
svadayo na syurato bhinnavākyatvameva yuktam,tatrāpi
vidhyarthatvameva|
iha kecinmanyante-svārthadravyaliṅgasaṃkhyākarmādyātmakaḥ pañcakaḥ
prātipadikārtha iti| āditastrika ityanye| tatra śabdapravṛttinimitaṃ
svārthaḥ, sa cāneka prakāraḥ- svarūpaṃ jātirguṇaḥ kriyā dravyaṃ
sambandhaśceti, ḍittho gauḥ śuklaḥ pācakaḥ yaṣṭiḥ puruṣaḥ daṇḍīti|
jātyādiśabdeṣvapi jātyādimātraniṣṭheṣu svarūpameva
pravṛttinimitam| abhidhānābhidheyayorabhedādhyāsāt
śabdarūpānurakto'rtho'bhidhīyate| asya gauriti nāma, ayaṃ gauriti ca
pratītiveṣo bhidyate| atra heturvaiyadhikaraṇyam, sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ ca|
tatra jātyādivat svarūpamapi śabdata eva pratipannamapyarthasya viśeṣaṇaṃ
manyante| uktaṃ ca-
grāhyatvaṃ grāhakatvaṃ ca dve śaktī tejaso yathā|
tathaiva sarvaśabdānāmete pṛthagavasthite || iti|
tena svarūpamapi svārtho yujyate|
svārthasya yatra viśrāntirvācyaṃ dravyaṃ tadiṣyate||
paryavasānabhūmirityarthaḥ| taccānekaprakāram-jātirguṇaḥ kriyā dravyaṃ
svarūpamiti; gau sūklaḥ, pākaḥ, ḍitthaḥ,ṭhtūṣṇīmi bhūvaḥ' iti|
liṅgaṃ strītvādi| saṃkhyāekatvādi, karmādayo vakṣyamāṇāḥ
kārakaviśeṣāḥ|
tadiha dvitīyaṃ darśanaṃ vṛttikāreṇāśritam| anvayavyatirekābhyāṃ hi
śabdārthaniścayaḥ, yasya śabdasyānvaye yo'rthaḥ pratīyate, vyatireke ca
vyatiricyate sa tasyārthaḥ| vṛkṣaḥ vṛkṣau ityādau ca tatadvacanānvaye
sā sā saṃkhyā pratīyate vayatireke ca vyatiricyate satyapi
prakṛtyanvaye, tena manyāmahe-vacanārthaḥ saṃkhyeti| tathā vṛkṣaṃ vṛkṣeṇa
vṛkṣāyetyādau tatatrikānvaye sa sa karmādiḥ pratīyate, vyatireke
ca vyatiricyate, tena manyāmahe-trikārthaḥ karmādiriti| yadyapi payo
dadhi madhvityādāvantareṇa vacanamantareṇa ca trikaṃ sa so'rthaḥ
pratīyate, naitāvatā vibhaktyarthatvaṃ hīyate , na hi gargā
ityatrāntareṇāpi yañamapatyārthaḥ pratīyate iti gārgya ityatrāpi
prakṛterivāpatyamartha iti yuktaṃ vaktum, pacati pacataḥ pacantītyādau
vacanānvaye saṃkhyānvayādvyatireke ca vyatirekād vacanārtha eva
saṃkhyā, na dhātvarthaḥ| abibharbhavānityādau yadyapyantareṇāpi tiṇṃó
kartā saṃkhyā ca pratīyate, tathāpi naitāvatā tarvatra prakṛtyarthatvaṃ
yaktam| na hi bhit, cchidityādau antareṇāpi pratyayaṃ kartā pratīyate
iti bhetetyādāvapi kartā prakṛtyartho bhavati| tadevaṃ trika eva
prātapidikārthaḥ|
dhātośca kriyaiva vācyetyasatyasminnanirddiṣṭārthatvātsvārthe trika eva
jasādibahuvacanaṃ syād, na bahutva iti bahutvasaṃkhyāvācyatvena
vidhiyate| sūtre'pyantareṇāpi bhāvapratyayaṃ bhāvapradhāno nirdeśaḥ,
bahutva ityarthaḥ| āśrayāgatasya bahutvasya guṇe āropād bahuṣviti
bahuvacanam| āropasya prayojanaṃ nānā''dhārasya saṃkhyārūpasya
bahutvasya grahaṇaṃ yathā syāt| tenaikāśrayaṃ vaipulyaṃ bahuvacanasya
vācyaṃ na bhavatibahurodana iti|
kecinmanyante-saṃkhyākarmādayaśca parasparamananvitāḥ, prakṛtyarthena
cānvitā vibhaktibhirabhidhīyante-vṛkṣānpaśya, ko'rthaḥ? bahavo vṛkṣāḥ
karmeti, na tu karmībhūtā vṛkṣā bahava iti; nāpi bahavaḥ karmeti|
evamekavacane'pi ṭhpaśunā cajeta' iti paśurekaḥ paśuḥ
karaṇamityarthaḥ, na tu karaṇībhūtaḥ paśureka iti, nāpyekaḥ paśuḥ
karaṇamiti karaṇatvaikatvayoryugapadabhidhānāditi
tānnirākaroti-karmādayo'pyapara ityādi| tadīye bahutve iti|
karmādigatameva bahutvaṃ bahuvacanasya vācyam, na tu
kevalaprātipadīkārthagatamityarthaḥ| prakṛtyarthagatameva bahutvaṃ
vācyam, vṛkṣaśabdasyāvayavī vācyaḥ, na tvavayavā iti dravyapadārthapakṣe
tāvad vṛkṣaṃ paśyeti mūlaskandhaphalapalāśādīnāṃ bahutve'pi
teṣāmanabhidheyatvādvahuvacanābhāvaḥ| ākṛtipakṣe'pi
pratyāsatestadādhāragataṃ bahutvāmāśrīyate na tvavayavagatam,
bhinnavākyatayā vidhirityuktaṃ tatprayojanamāha yatra cetyādi| bhāṣye
tu pañcakapakṣāṅgīkāreṇa niyamapakṣaḥ sthāpitaḥ| tatra hyanirdiṣṭārthāḥ
pratyayāḥ svārthe iti svārthe'pi jasādi bahuvacanaṃ bahutve'pi
siddham, tasyāpi svārthatvātatrāpyarthaniyamād-bahuṣu
bahuvacanameva, dvyekayordvivacanaikavacane eveti| evaṃ ṭhkarmaṇi
dvitīyā' ityādāvapi karmaṇi dvitīyaivetyevamādiko'rthaniyamo
veditavyaḥ| evaṃ hi pratyayānāmaniyatatvādavyayebhye niḥsaṃkhyebhyo
niṣkārakebhyaśca svādayaḥ siddhyanti| atha vā,
pratyayaniyamaḥ-bahuṣveva bahuvacanaṃ dvyekayoreva
dvivacanaikavacane| tulyājātīyasya ca niyamena vyāvṛttiḥ-bahuṣveva
bahuvacanaṃ na dvyekayoḥ, ekasminnevaikavacanaṃ na saṃkhyāntare,
dvayoreva dvivacanaṃ na saṃkhyāntara iti| ṭhkarmaṇi dvitīyā'
ityādāvapyevam-karmaṇyeva dvitīyā, na kārakāntara iti| evamapi
hyavyayebhyaḥ svādayaḥ siddhyanti||
padamañjarī
dvyekayordvivacanaikavacane|| 1|4|22 ||
dviśabdena sāhacaryādekaśabdaḥ saṃkhyāvācī| ayamapi bhāvapradhāno
nirdeśaḥ, ata evaṭhdvyekayoḥ' iti dvivacanam,
tadāha-dvitvaikatvayoriti| etadapītyādi| anenāsyāpi vidhyarthatvaṃ
darśayati| kathaṃ tarhi sāmānyavihitayoriti, yāvatā niyamārthatve
etad ghaṭate? ucyate; sādhāraṇaparyāyaḥ sāmānyaśabdaḥ
sasaṃkhyaniḥsaṃkhyasādhāraṇyena vihitayorityarthaḥ| arthābhidhānamiti|
arthaḥuvācyo'bhidhīyateukathyate yena tadarthābhidhānam|
dvyekayoritayatra ṭhsaṃkhyāyā alpīyasyaḥ' ityekaśabdasya
pūrvanipāto'smādeva nipātanānna bhavati|
saṃkhyeyavacanaṣvevārthadvārakamalpīyastvamityanye|| 
padamañjarī
kārake|| 1|4|23 ||
adhikāro'nekaprakāraḥ| saṃjñā, viśeṣaṇam, sthānī, prakṛtiḥ,
nimitam, ādeśa iti| ṭhpratyayaḥ', ṭhśeṣe', ṭhpūrvaparayoḥ'
ṭhṅyāpprātidikāt' ṭhdhātoḥ'ṭhārddhadhātuke mūrddhanyaḥ' iti tadiha
vidheyānirdeśāt svaritatvāccādhikāratve sthite prakāramāha-kāraka
iti viśeṣaṇa||ṃadhikriyata iti| na tāvatsañjñātvenādhikāraḥ; sañjñāyā
bhāvyamānatvātsaptamyanupapateḥ| atha sañjñānurūpaḥ prathamānirdeśa eva
kasmānna kṛtaḥ, yuktaṃ caitad kārakasaṃśabdaneṣu
vakṣyamāṇānāmapādānādīnāmeva ṣaṇṇāṃ grahaṇasyeṣṭatvād; anyathā
naṭasya śṭaṇotīti kārakaśeṣasyāpi prasaṅgāt? ucyate;
sañjñāpakṣe--apāye yad dhruvaṃ tat kārakasañjñaṃ bhavati,
apādānasañjñaṃ cetyayamartho bhavati, evamanyatrāpi; tataśca
kārakāpādānasañjñayoryugapadvidhānāt parasparaṃ
nimitanimitibhāvābhāvādakārakasyāpi vyāpāraśūnyasyāpādānasañjñā
prāpnoti| viśeṣaṇādhikāre tu-kārakeṣu madhye yadapāye dhruvaṃ sā
na prāpnoti| ato viśeṣaṇānurūpa eva nirdeśaḥ kṛtaḥ, na tu
sañjñānurūpaḥ|
kārakasañjñā tvanvarthatvād vyāpāraśūnyasya na bhavati| kiṃ ca
kārakasaṃjñāyā apādānādisañjñābhiḥ samāveśo na prāpnoti,
tataścaṭhstamberamaḥ' ityatra saptamyāṃ śruyamāṇāyāṃ
gatikārakopapadāditi svaro na syāt, ṭhkārake' iti nirdhāraṇe
saptamī, sāmānyāpokṣaṃ caikavacanam| kārakaśabdo'yamasti
ṇvulantaḥ-karotīti kārakamiti, astyavyatpannaḥ sañjñāśabdo
nimitaparyāyaḥ; tatra pūrvasya grahaṇe'pādānādiṣu kārakaśabdo na
pravartota, yathā kartṛśabdaḥ, teṣāmasvatantratvāt; svātantrye vā
pakṣe kartṛsañjñā prasajyeta, naiṣa doṣaḥ; sarvameva khalu kārakaṃ
yathāyathamavāntaravyāpāraṃ nirvartayat pradhānakriyāyāmupayujyate,
sā ca sakalakārakajanyā phalabhūtā viklityādirūpā kriyā pradhānakriyā|
yadvā-sāmānyabhūtā kriyā pradhānakriyā phalajananā nāma, sarvāṇi hi
kārakāṇi phalajananāya pravartante, ato yadyatphalajananārūpaṃ
tatsarveṣveva kārakeṣvaviśiṣṭam| kiñcitkhalu kārakaṃ kenacideva
rūpeṇa phalaṃ janayatīti phalajananā sarveṣāmabhinnarūpā|
avāntarabhedavivakṣāyāṃ tu karaṇādirūponmeṣaḥ|
na ca vaiśeṣikāṇāmivāsmākamekā kriyā nānekatra samavetā,
dhātvartho hi kriyā, na parispanda eva| dhātunā ca
sakalakārakānuyāyyodanādiphalāvacchedena ekīkṛto
vyāpāro'bhidhīyate| tasyāmekasyāṃ pradhānakriyāyāmupayogo
yathāyathamavāntaravyāpāramukhena, tadyathā-apādānasyāvadhibhāvopagamanaṃ
vyāpāraḥ, sampradānasyatu preraṇānumatyanirākaraṇādiḥ, karaṇasya
kāṣṭhāderjvalanādiḥ, adhikaraṇasya sambhavanadhāraṇādiḥ, kamaṃṇo
nirvṛtyādiḥ, kartuḥ prasiddha eva, prayojakasya preṣaṇādiḥ| na caivaṃ
sati karaṇādīnāmapi kartṛsañjñāprasaṅgaḥ, paratantratvat| pradhānena
hi kartrā samavāye karaṇādīni paratantrāṇi, vyavāye
svatantrāṇi;tadyathā-amātyānāṃ rājñā saha samavāye pāratantram,
vyavāye svātantryam| yadyevam, kārakavyapadeśo'pi karaṇādyavasthāyāṃ
na syāt? karaṇam kārakamiti adhikārasāmarthyāt|
kārakaśabdopanītasvātantryamavasthāntaragataṃ vijñāsyate| avasthāntare
yat svatantraṃ tatsādhakatamaṃ karaṇamiti kartuṃreva tvekasya sāṃpratikaṃ
svātantryam, tacca kartṛsañjñāṅgatayā coditam| yadi tarhi
vyutpattipakṣe'pyavasthāntaragatameva svātantryam, evaṃ tarhi
karaṇādyavasthāyāṃ nimitabhāva evābhyupagato bhavati? yadyevam, kiṃ
doṣapratividhānavyasanena| nimitaparyāyasyaiva grahaṇamastviti
manyamāna āha- kārakaśabdaśceti| kasya heturiti|
dravyaguṇaviṣayo'pi hetuḥ kārakaṃ prāptamityabhiprāyaḥ|
kārakaśabdo'yaṃ kriyāhetāveva prasiddha ityāha-kriyāyā iti|
anāśritavyāpāraṃ nimitaṃ hetuḥ, āśritavyāpāraṃ kārakam, uktaṃ ca--
dravyādiviṣayo hetuḥ kārakaṃ niyatakriyam| iti|
anāśrite tu vyāpāre nimitaṃ heturiṣyate|| iti ca|
kathaṃ tarhi pūrvamuktam-anarthāntaramiti, na hi
sāmānyaviśeṣavacanānāmanarthāntaravācitvam? satyam;
sāmānyaśabdayorapi arthaprakaraṇādinā viśeṣavṛttimabhipretya tu
tathoktam| vṛkṣasya parṇaṃ patatīti| parṇaviśeṣaṇatvenātra vṛkṣo
vivakṣitaḥ, na tvapāyasya nimitatvenetyapādānasaṃjñā na bhavati, na
vāpāyasyāvivakṣitatvāt| sati hyavadhau gatirapāyo bhavati, nānyathā|
na cātra vṛkṣo'vadhitvena vivakṣitaḥ| tathā hi--vṛkṣamajahatyapi parṇe
vṛkṣasya parṇaṃ patatīti bhavati prayogo yadā vṛkṣaḥ cchinnaḥ patatīti,
satyam; ata evāsminnatṛptaḥ sannāha--māṇavakasya pitaramiti| atra
pituḥ sambandhitvena māṇavako vivakṣitaḥ, na tu praśnakriyāṃ prati
nimitatveneti karmasaṃjñā na bhavati; asati tu kārakādhikāre
tasyāpi syāt| śeṣalakṣaṇā tu ṣaṣṭhī akathite duhyādiparigaṇanādrājñaḥ
puruṣa ityādau sāvakāśā| yadi tarhi viśeṣaṇamidam, dhruvādīnāṃ na
saṃjñā, ṭhkārakaddataśrutayorevāśiṣi'--ityādau yatra kārakaśabdaḥ
saṃśabdyate tatrāpādānādīnāṃ vakṣyamāṇānāṃ paṇṇāmeva grahaṇamiṣyate,
tanna siddhyati| saṃjñāpakṣe tu na doṣaḥ, saṃjñā hyāvartamānā saṃjñinaṃ
pratyāyati| syādetat-pradeśeṣvapi kriyānimittaparyāyasya
kārakaśabdasyopādānam, tacca nimitamapādānādyeveti, tadasat;
naṭasya śṭaṇotītyādau kārakaśeṣasya āha-kārakasaṃśabdaneṣu ceti|
kārakagrahaṇaṃ pradeśeṣu svaryate, svaritenādhikārāvagatirbhavatīti
bhāvaḥ||
padamañjarī
dhruvamapāye'pādānam|| 1|4|24 ||
dhravamiti| dhru gatisthairyayoḥ ityasmātkuṭādeḥ pacādyaci rūpam| ye
tu ṭhdhruva gatisthairyayoḥ' iti paṭhanti, teṣāmigupadhalakṣaṇaḥ kaḥ
pratyayaḥ| apāyaḥu viśleṣaḥ, vibhāgastaddhetubhūtaśca
gativiśeṣo'vadhisāpekṣaḥ, tatra vibhāgasya dviṣṭhatvāt na
kevalamapayanneva tena yuktaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? yato'paiti so'pi yukta
evetyāha-dhruvaṃ yadapāyayuktamiti| kathaṃ punaḥ
saptamīnirddeśe'pyapāyayuktamiti pratipadyemahītyatrāha-apāye sādhya
iti| sādhyatvena viṣayatvāt sāmarthyalabhyo yoga iti bhāvaḥ|
dhruvamityekarūpamucyate- dhruvamasya śīlam, dhruvamasya rūpamiti, iha
tadapāyena viśeṣyate-upāye yad dhruvamiti, na tu sārvatrikam,
taccāpāye dhruvamucyate-yadapāyenānāviśyate upayujyate cāpāye,
taccārthādavadhibhūtamityāha-yadavadhibhūtamiti| evaṃ ca sārthād
hīnaḥ, rathātpatitaḥ, dhāvataḥ patita ityādau kriyāntarāveśāccalatve
tataddhāvanādikriyānāveśātannimitamapāyaṃ pratyaudāsīnyādastyeva
dhruvatvamiti bhavatyeva saṃjñā| uktaṃ ca--
apāye yadudāsīnaṃ calaṃ vā cadi vā calam|
dhruvamevātadāveśāt padapādānamucyate|| iti|
patataḥ patita ityatrāpi paragatapātāpekṣayā dhrauvyameva| tathā hi-
patato dhruva evāśvo yasmādaśvātpatatyasau|
tasya tvaśvasya patane kuḍa|ladirdhruva ucyate||
iha tu parasparammānmeṣāvapasarpata iti
meṣāntarakriyāpekṣamavadhitvaṃ pṛthak pṛthak|
meṣayoḥ svakriyayāpekṣaṃ kartṛtvaṃ ca pṛthakpṛthak||
gatirvinā tvavadhinā nāpāya iti kathyate||
jugupseti| praśleṣapūrvako viśleṣo'pāyaḥ, sa cātra nāsti;
buddhiparikalpitastu gauṇaḥ, na ca mukhye saṃbhavati gauṇasya grahaṇaṃ
yuktam| ata eva ṭhbhītrārthānām' ityāderārambha iti
vākyakārasyābhiprāyaḥ| atra ca kārakaśeṣatvāt ṣaṣṭhī prāpnoti-naṭasya
śṭaṇotīti yathā| pratyākhyānaṃ tu sādhakatamamiti tamabgrahaṇaṃ
liṅgama, kārakaprakaraṇe yathāsambhavameva sādhakatvamiti|
tadiha-adharmājjugupsate ityādau jugupsādipūrvikāyāṃ nivṛtau
jugupsādīnāṃ vṛttiriti sthite ya eṣa manuṣyaḥ prekṣāpūrvakārī
bhavati, sa paśyati- duḥkhaheturadharmo nainaṃ kariṣyāmīti; sa
buddhyā taṃ prāpnoti, prāpya taca tato nivartate| dharmātpramādyati
dharmānmuhyatīti| ya eṣa nāstikaḥ puruṣaḥ, sa paśyati-nānena dharmeṇa
kiṃcidāpyate, nainaṃ kariṣyāmīti sa buddhyā taṃ prāpnoti, prāpya
ca tato nivartate, tatra dhrumapāyaityeva siddhamiti| taccaitat--
nirddiṣṭaviṣayaṃ kiñcidupātaviṣayaṃ tathā|
apekṣitakriyaṃ ceti tridhā'pādānamucyate||
yatra dhātunāpāyalakṣaṇaḥ saṃjñāviṣayo nirdiśyate,
yathā-grāmādāgacchatīti, tannirdiṣṭaviṣayam| yatra
dhāturdhātvantarārthāṅgaṃ svārthamāha, yathā-balāhakād vidyotate
vidyaud iti, atra hi niḥ saraṇāṅgavidyotane
vidyautirvartate-balāhakanniḥ-sṛtya vidyotata ityeva;
kusulātpacatītyatrā''dānāṅge pāke pacirvartate-kusūlādādāya
pacatīti, tadupātaviṣayam| apekṣitakriyaṃ tu-yatra kriyā na śruyate,
pramāṇāntareṇa tu pratīyate, yathā-āgacchantaṃ puruṣaṃ pratyakṣeṇa
paśyannāha-kuto bhavāniti, so'pi tadeva
pratyakṣasiddhamāgamanamupajīvannāha-pāṭaliputrāditi|
dhruvagrahaṇaṃ kim? grāmādāgacchati śakaṭena--atra śakaṭasya mā bhūt| atha
kriyamāṇe'pi dhruvagrahaṇa iha kasmānna bhavati--dhanuṣā vighyatīti, atra
hi śarāṇāmapāyaṃ prati avadhibhāvenaiva dhanuṣaḥ sādhakatamatvam?
satyam; ubhayaprasaṅge paratvātkaraṇasaṃjñā bhaviṣyati|
nanvevamakriyamāṇe'pi śakaṭasya naiva bhaviṣyati, evaṃ saṃjñāntaraviṣaye
sarvatra| vṛkṣasya patraṃ patatītyatra tvapāyasyāvivakṣitatvādakārakatvācca
na bhaviṣyati | saṃjñinirdeśārthaṃ tu na hi ṭhkārake' iti saptamyantena
śakyaḥ saṃjñī nirdeaṣṭuam, siddhaṃ tu nirddhāryamāṇasya
saṃjñitvādapāyaviṣayeṣu kārakeṣu madhye yatkārakaṃ
saṃjñāntarasyāviṣayastadapādānamiti, tadevaṃ dhruvagrahaṇaṃ
cintyaprayojanam||
padamañjarī
bhītrārthānāṃ bhayahetuḥ|| 1|4|25 ||
bhayaṃ bhīḥ, trāṇaṃ trāḥ, sampadāditvādbhāve kvip| bhītrau arthau
yeṣāṃ te bhītrārthāḥ, ṣaṣṭhīprayogāpekṣayā kārakāpekṣayā
cetyāha--bibhetyarthānāmityādi| atra bibhetitrāyatiśabdau
tadarthayorvartete, tadartho'rtho yeṣāmityarthaḥ| trāṇaṃ bādhakebhyo
rakṣaṇam, bādhakāśca bhayahetava iti trārthānāmapi bhayahetuḥ kārakaṃ
bhavatyeva| corebhya iti | corayateḥ pacādyaci coraḥ| kvacit
caurebhya iti pāṭhaḥ| tatra svārthikaḥ prajñādyaṇ| cchatrādiṣu vā
curāśabdaḥ paṭha|lte, sa cā'pratyayādityasya ṭhṇyāsaśrantho yuc' iti
yuci bādhake prāpte tasmādeva nipātanādakārapratyaye ṇiluki ca
vyutpādyate, tataścurā steyaṃ śīlamasyeti ṇe kṛte sa evārtho
bhavati| bibhetīti| ṭhñibhī bhaye' juhotyādiḥ| udvijate iti|
ṭhovijībhayacalanayoḥ' taudādiko'nudātet| araṇye iti| atra
tatsthebhyo vṛkṣādibhyo bhayam, nāraṇyāt| nanu ca
dhruvamityanuvartiṣyate, na cāraṇyamavidhitvena vivakṣitam,
paratvāccādhikaraṇasañjñaiva bhaviṣyati, satyam; pūrvasyaivāyaṃ
prapañcaḥ, katham? bhayādipūrvikāyāṃ nivṛtau bhyādayo
vartante-bibhetīti korthaḥ? bhītyā nivartata ityarthaḥ, trāyata iti
ko'rthaḥ? corakṛtādvadhādestrāṇena nivartayatītyarthaḥ| kathaṃ tarhi
coramadhyavartini corebhyo bibhetīti prayogaḥ, na hyatra
nivṛttirasti? atrāpi bhītyā nivartitumicchatītyartho draṣṭavyaḥ|
tadevaṃ
buddhiparikalpito'pāyostītyupātaviṣayamidamapādānamiti|
kṛtasna eva prayogaprapañce kimavayavaparyanuyogena! ||
padamañjarī
parājerasoḍhaḥ|| 1|4|26 ||
atra dhātupāṭhagatasya jītyetāvanmātrasyānukaraṇam| tataḥ parāpūrvo
jiḥ parājirityutarapadalopī samāso draṣṭavyaḥ| nanu
ṭhprakṛtivadanukaraṇaṃ bhavati' ityadhāturiti prātipadikasañjñāyāḥ
pratiṣedhādasubantatvātsamāso na prāpnoti, na; apratiṣedhāt, nāyaṃ
prasajyapratiṣedhaḥ-dhātorneti, kiṃ tarhi? paryudāso'yam--yadanyad
dhātoriti, dhātorna vidhirna pratiṣedhaḥ| evamapīyaṅadeśaḥ
prāproti, paratvād gherṅtīiti guṇo bhaviṣyatīti, samudāyasya
vā, samudāyo'nukaraṇam, kvasthasyasamudāyasya? prayogasya| yadyevam,
adhyayanātparājayate-atra prāpnoti, na hyatra parājīti rūpamasti, kva
tarhi syād? yatra parājīti rūpamasti-adhyayanātparājita iti|
udāharaṇe parājirnyunībhāve vartate-adhyetuṃ hrasati
glāyatītyarthaḥ| akarmakaścāyamatrārthe, tatra ṣaṣṭha|laṃ prāptāyāṃ vacanam,
pratyudāharaṇe tvabhibhave vartate| ṭhviparābhyāṃjeḥ' ityatrārthadvaye'pi
vartamānasya grahaṇam| ayamapi prapañco nyūnībhāvapūrvikāyāṃ
nivṛtau vṛteḥ siddham| adhyayanātparājayate-ko'rthaḥ? nyūnībhāvena
glānyā tato nivartate ityarthaḥ| tena pratyudāharaṇe
paratvātkarmasañjñā bhaviṣyatīti na codanīyam||
padamañjarī
vāraṇārthānamīpsitaḥ|| 1|4|27 ||
īpsitaśabdo'yamastyabhipretaparyāyaḥ, tasya grahaṇe yavānāmānmīyatve
gavāṃ ca parakīyatva eva syād, na viparyate? na khalvasyaitadabhipretaṃ
yadutātmīyā gāvaḥ parakīyānyavānmā ghasanniti, mā bhūvanyavā
vārayitumīpsitāḥ; vāryamāṇānāṃ tu gavāmīpsitāḥ, na vātra
viśeṣaḥ śrutaḥ karturīpsita iti| iha tarhi na syād-agnermāṇavakaṃ
vārayati kūpādandhamiti, na hyagrikūpau vārayiturvāryamāṇasya
vābhipretau? kriyāśabdasya tu grahaṇe
vāryamāṇasyānthādergamanādikriyayā kūpāderāpyamānatvāt
siddhyati, andhaścāpaśyannapi gantavyaṃ jigamiṣati, anyathā na
kvacitasya pravṛttiḥ syāt| yavebhyo gā vārayatīti| ṭhvṛñ āvaraṇe'
curādiḥ| athātra gavāmapādānasaṃjñā kasmānna bhavati,
īpsitatamo'pīpsito bhavatyeva, yathā śuklatamo'pi śuklaḥ?
paratvātkarmasaṃjñā bhaviṣyati| karmasaṃjñāyā avakāśaḥ-
vāraṇārthebhyo'nyatra, apādānasaṃjñāyāstu prakarṣarahitamītsitam,
ipsitatamasya tūbhayaprasaṅge paratvātkarmasaṃjñā| ayamapi prapañcaḥ, asti
hyatrapi buddhivyavasthito'pāyaḥ, katham? paśyatyayam-yadi gāvaḥ kṣetre
gaccheyurdhruvaṃ sasyavināśaḥ, sasyavināśe'dharmaśca rājabhayaṃ ca; sa
buddhyā saṃprāpya navirtayatītyato na codanīyam-pratyudāharaṇe
kṣetrasyādhikaraṇasaṃjñā bhaviṣyatīti||
padamañjarī
antarddhau yenādarśanāmacchati|| 1|4|28 ||
antarddhau iti neyaṃ ṭhnimitātkarmayoge' iti saptamī, yathā
hi-vetanena dhānyaṃ lunātītyatra vetanasya dhānyena
yogo'sti,tathehāpyadarśanamicchatītīcchākarmaṇā'darśanenāntarddheryogo nāsti| athādarśanasya yatkarma ātmākhyamātmano'darśanamicchatīti tenāntarddheryogo'sti? yasyaivādarśanaṃtasyaivāntarddhānamityucyeta| evamapi ṭhnimitātkarmayoge' iti kiṃ nimitaṃ gṛhyate, kāraṇam? prayejanaṃ vā? kāraṇaṃ cejjāḍa|lena baddhaḥ- atrāpi prāpnoti, ya eva baddhyate tatraiva jāḍa|lmiti; tasmāt prayojanasya tatra grahaṇam| yathā-carmaṇi dvīpinaṃ hantīti carma dvīpihananasya prayojanam| iha tvantarddhānamadarśanasya kāraṇam, antarhitaḥ khalvasau na ddaśyate| tasmādviṣayasaptamyeṣā, satsaptamī vā| yeneti kartari tṛtīyā| nanu ca darśanena yogāt ṭhkartṛ karmaṇoḥ kṛti' iti ṣaṣṭha|la bhāvyam| ubhayaprāptau karmaṇyeveti niyamāt tṛtīyā bhaviṣyati| kama tvatrādarśanasyātmā| nanvātmane iti na śrūyate, mā śrāvi; yenādarśanamicchatītyukte kasyetyapekṣāyāmātmana iti gamyate| antarddhinimitamiti| antarddhinā kāraṇenetyarthaḥ| ṭhnimitakāraṇahetuṣu sarvāsāṃ prāyadarśanam' iti prathamā| atha vā-bahubrīhiradarśanasya samānādhikaraṇaṃ viśeṣaṇam| sūtra'nupāto'pi tacchabdo yatadornityasambandhāllabhyata evetyāha-tatkārakamiti| antarddhate iti| tirobhavatītyarthaḥ| nilīyate iti| ṭhlīṅ śleṣaṇe' daivādikaḥ|
caurānna diddakṣate iti| ātmānaṃ te mā drākṣurityevamartham| nanu
paratvātkarmasaṃjñā bhaviṣyati, satyam; ayamapi prapañcaḥ, katham?
paśyatyevam-yadyaupādhyāyaḥ paśyed dhruvaṃ me preṣaṇamupālambho vā
bhavediti, sa buddhyā saṃprāpya nivartate|
yenetyasminnasatyadarśanamicchataḥ śiṣyasyaiva syāt,
dhruvamityanuvartiṣyate| evaṃ tarhi sūtrasyāvācakatvaṃ mā bhūt| asati
hi tasminnantarddhau dhruvamapādānasaṃjñaṃ bhavati tacced
dhruvamadarśanamicchatītyarthaḥ syāt| na ca dhruvamicchati, yaccecchati na
tad dhruvamityavācakaṃ syāt||
padamañjarī
ākhyātopayoge|| 1|4|29 ||
niyamapūrvakaṃ vidyāgrahaṇamiti| tatraivopayogaśabdasya rūḍhatvāt|
yathā teṣāṃ mantrāṇāmupayoge dvādaśāhamadhaḥ śayyoti niyamo
bhikṣācaraṇādiḥ| naṭasya śrṛṇotīti| kiṃ punarnaṭaḥ kārakam? utāho
na ?, yadi kārakam? karma saṃjñā prāpnoti-ṭhakathitaṃ ca' iti|
athākāram? upayogagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| astu kārakam, na
hyupādhyāyānnaṭasya vyāpāre kaścidanyo viśeṣaḥ; anyadato niyamāt|
duhyādiparigaṇanātu karmasaṃjñā na bhavati| kvacitu naṭasya gāthāṃ
śrṛṇoti, granthikasya kathāṃ śrṛṇotīti pāṭhaḥ, tatrāpi naṭādinimitaṃ
gāthādeḥ śravaṇaṃ karotītyartha; na tu gāthādiviśeṣaṇaṃ naṭādiḥ;
akārakatvaprasaṅgāt| granthikaḥukathāyā vācayitā| ayamapi prapañcaḥ,
katham? upādhyāyānnissarantaṃ śabdaṃ gṛhṇātīti sphuṭa evātrāpāyaḥ|
idaṃ tarhi prayojanam-ṭhupayoga iti vakṣyāmi, naṭasya mā bhūt' iti?
nanu naṭasya satyapyavadhitve śeṣarūpeṇa vivakṣaṇāt ṣaṣṭhī bhaviṣyati,
yathā na māṣāṇāmaśnīyāditi vastutaḥ karmatvaṃ māṣāṇām, satyam;
sa eva vivakṣāniyamaḥ sūtrakāreṇa pradarśyate-upayoge'vadhitvaṃ
vivakṣitam, anyatra śeṣatvamiti||
padamañjarī
janikartuḥ prakṛtiḥ|| 1|4|30 ||
janeḥ kartā janikarteti karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhayāḥ samāsaḥ| ayameva ca
nirdeśo jñāpayati-ṭhkartari ca' iti pratiṣedho'nitya iti| kaḥ
punarasāvityata āha-janyarthasyeti| etaduktaṃ
bhavati-janiśabdo'yamṭhiñjādibhyaḥ' iti janerbhāva iñamutpādya
vyutpāditaḥ| ṭhjanivadhyośca' iti vṛddhipratiṣedho janyārthavācī, na
tu ṭhikstipau dhātunirdeśe' iti ikpratyayāntaḥ, ṭhgamahana'
ityupadhāyā lopaprasaṅgat| nāpyāgantukenekāreṇa dhātornirdeśaḥ;
śabdātmakasya dhātoḥ kartrā sambandhāyogāt| athāpyarthadvārako yogaḥ
syād? evamapi dhātunirdeśe tasyaiva prayoge syād, na paryāyasya;
aṅgādaṅgāstambhavo'stīti| arthagrahaṇe tvatrāpi bhavatīti|
prakṛtirityasya vivaraṇam--kāraṇamiti| upādānakāraṇamityarthaḥ| 
anye tu dhruvagrahaṇānuvṛtereva prakṛtiparigrahe siddhe prakṛtigrahaṇaṃ
kāraṇamātraparigrahārthaṃ varṇayanti| ata eva vṛtāvuktam-kāraṇamiti, na
punarupādānakāraṇamiti| tena ca putrātpramodo jāyata ityādāvapi
bhavatīti| kiṃ punaḥ sat jāyate? utāsat? na tāvatsat;
janmavaiyarthyāt| yadi janmanaḥ prāgeva sat, kiṃ janmanā? athaivamapi
janma, jāyasva jāyasvetyeva ghaṭo jāyate| nāpyasat; asataḥ
kartṛtvāyogāt, śaśaviṣaṇāderapi janmaprasaṅgacca| uktamatra--
pūrvāvasthāmavijahatsaṃspṛśan dharmamutaram|
saṃmūrcchita ivārthātmā jāyamāno'bhichīyate|| iti|
etacca ṭhānmahataḥ' ityatropapādayiṣyāmaḥ| kiñcāsmākamanena
dustarkeaṇa, asti tāvat ṭhśrṛṅgāccharo jāyate' iti prayogaḥ, sa
upapādanīya ityetāvat! ayamapi prapañcaḥ| loke hi yadyasmājjāyate
tatato nirgacchatītyucyate, lokaprasiddhyanusāreṇa śabdaprayogaḥ,
arthatatvaṃ tu tathā bhavatvanyathā vā||
padamañjarī
bhuvaḥ prabhavaḥ|| 1|4|31 ||
bhavanaṃ bhūḥ, sampadāditvātkvip| atrāpi praśabdo draṣṭavyaḥ| na hi
kovalasya bhavatyarthasya prabhavanena yogaḥ kiṃ tarhi? sopasargasya bhuvaḥ|
karteti| bhavatyarthasya kartetyarthaḥ, bhuvo vā dhātoḥ| kathaṃ
punardhātornāma kartā syād, dhāturvai śabdaḥ, śabde'sambhave'rthe
kārthaṃ vijñāsyate| ṭhtasu upakṣaye' bhāve ktaḥ, ṭhvi gatau' tastā,
vitasteti, aśoṣyetyarthaḥ| prathamata upalabhyate iti| upalabhateḥ
karmavyāpāre prabhavatiḥ, pravartata ityarthaḥ| prakāśata iti yāvat| etena
janyarthābhāvātpūrveṇāsiddhaṃ darśayati| anekārthatvāddhātūnāmasminnarthe
vṛttiḥ| ayamapi prapañcaḥ| katham? bhavanapūrvake niḥsaraṇe
prabhavatirvartate||
padamañjarī
karmaṇā yamabhipraiti sa saṃpradānam|| 1|4|32 ||
karmaṇā karaṇabhūteneti| kathaṃ punarekameva vastu yugapatkarma ca
karaṇaṃ ca bhavati? kriyābhedāddānakriyāyāṃ karmābhiprāyeṇa kriyāyāṃ
karaṇam, dīyamānāyā hi gavā śiṣya upādhyāyāmabhipraiti saṃbadhnāti
īpsati vā, abhaprapūrvo hīṇ īpsatinā samānārthaḥ|
abhiprertāmatyukte īpsitamiti gamyate| uktaṃ ca--
anirākaraṇātkartustyagāṅgaṃ karmaṇopsitam|
preraṇānumatibhyāṃ vā labhate sampradānatām|| iti|
tyāgo dānam, tyāgasyāṅgaṃ śeṣabhūtaṃ karmaṇā
gavādinepsitamāptumiṣṭṃa saṃpradānatāṃ labhate, anirākaraṇādvā,
evamastviti anumānādvā, devebhyaḥ sumanaso dadāti, yācakāya bhikṣā
dadāti, upādhyāyāya gāṃ dadāti; na tu nirākurvan saṃpradānaṃ
bhavatīti ślokārthaḥ|
atra kecidāhuḥ- ṭhkugatiprādayaḥ' ityatra vārtikam- ṭhudātavatā tiṅa
gateḥ samāsavacanam' iti| yo jāta eva prathamomahasvāvo devā
kratunā paryabhūṣat, yo yaḥ śambaramanvavindat, yasmānna ṛte kiṃ
vajayante, yo vai prayavayatāmapyenaṃ pratipadyate-ityādyaudāharaṇāni| atra
sarvatra ṭhyadvṛtānnityam' iti nipātapratiṣedhāt tiṅntamudātavat,
tataścāyamabhipraitītyatrāpi samāse sati prātipadikatvāt
vibhaktyutpattiḥ syāditi|
neti vayam; tasya chandoviṣayatvāt| yadi karmaṇā yamabhipraiti sa
saṃpradānam, ajāṃ nayati grāmamiti ajairnayatikriyā
karmabhissaṃbadhyamānasya grāmasya saṃpradānatāṃ prāpnoti? na prāpnoti,
kiṃ kāraṇam? karmaṇeti karaṇe tṛtīyetyaktam| na ca yathā
śiṣyasyopādhyāyasambandhe gauḥ karaṇam, evamajā grāmasambandhe|
īpsatinā samānārthe tu sutarāmaprāptiḥ| tathā hi- ṭhyamabhipraiti'
ityukte yamiti nirdiṣṭasya śeṣitvam, karmaṇeti nirdiṣṭasya gavādeḥ
karaṇasya śeṣatvaṃ ca pratīyate; yathā-ṭhkartrabhiprāye kriyāphale' iti
kartuḥ śeṣitvaṃ kriyāphalasya śeṣatvam, na cātra śeṣaśeṣibhāvaḥ
pratīyate| kiṃ ca ṭhnīvahyaerharateśca' iti dvikarmakeṣu nayatiḥ
parigaṇyate, ato'pi grāmasya na bhaviṣyati|
atha kimarthaṃ mahatī saṃjñā kriyata ityāha-anvarthasaṃjñāvijñānāditi|
samyakpradīyate yasmai tatsaṃpradānamityanvarthatvātsañjñāyā
dadātikarmaṇā yamabhipraiti sa saṃpradānamityarthaḥ| evamapi rajakasya
vastraṃ dadāti, ghnataḥ pṛṣṭhṃa dadātītyatra kasmānna bhavati? adānatvāt,
kiṃ punardānam? dānaṃ kiñcaduddiśyāpunargrahaṇāya svadravyatyāgāḥ,
yathā-vṛkṣāya jalaṃ dadāti, devebhyaḥ sumanasaḥ, yācakāya bhikṣām,
upādhyāyāya gām, khaṇḍikopādhyāyastasmai capeṭikāṃ dadāti, na
śūdrāya matiṃ dadyāditi| karatalaprahāraḥucapeṭikā| rajake tu
punargrahaṇāddānābhāvaḥ, upamānātu dadātipramogaḥ,tatra
kārakaśeṣatvānnaṭasya śrṛṇotītivat ṣaṣṭhī
karmaṇeti kim, yāvatā upādhyāyāya gāṃ dadātītyatra
gorupādhyāyasya vābhipreyamāṇatvam,yato gaurdānakriyayā
karaṇabhūtayābhipreyate, gavā tūpādhyāyaḥ; tatra paratvādroḥ
karmasaṃjñeti pāriśeṣyād upādhyāyasyaiva saṃpradānasaṃjñā bhaviṣyati?
naitadasti;satyapyubhayorabhipreyamāṇatve'ntaṅgatvātkarmaṇa eva
gavādeḥ syāt| karmasajñā tu dadātikarmaṇo'nyatra sāvakāśā,
kārakaprakaraṇe ca prakarṣo nāśrīyate, na
tvantaraṅgabahiraṅgabhāvo'pi | yaṃsagrahaṇe'kriyamāṇe'bhipretureva
saṃpradānasaṃjñā syāt; śrutapadārthasambandhe sati tenaiva
nirākāṅkṣatvādadhyāhārānupapateḥ| satyapi vādhyāhāre yaḥ sa
ityevādhyāhārāt tata upādhyāyāya śiṣyeṇa gaurdīyata ityatrārthe
śiṣyāyopādhyāyasya gaurdīyata iti syāt| karmasaṃjñāyāṃ hi
kartṛgrahaṇaṃ svatantropalakṣaṇārthamiti tena śiṣyasya kartṛ
tvābhāve'pi goḥ karmasaṃjñā yujyata eva| tathā ca sārthāddhīyata iti
karmaṇi lakārotpatiḥ|
abhipragrahaṇaṃ kim, yāvatā karmaṇā yameti gacchati prāpnoti
saṃbadhnātītyarthaḥ, abhipraitītyukte sa eva? abhipragrahaṇe'kriyamāṇe
kālavivakṣā syāt; tataśca yameva saṃpratyeti tatraiva syāt, yamagāt
yaṃ caiṣyati tatra na syāt; abhipragrahaṇe punaḥ kriyamāṇe na doṣo
bhavati| abhirābhimukhye vartate, praśabdaścādikarmaṇi,
tataścopasargadvayopādānasāmarthyātkālāntarāvacchinnā kriyā
nāśrīyate| nanu yathā ṭhtena dīvyati' ityādau
saṅkhyākālayoravivakṣā, tathehāpi saṃkhyāvatkālasyāpyavivakṣā
siddhā, satyam; ayameva nyāyasiddho'rtha upasargadvayopādānena
pradarśyate| yadā tvabhipraitītyasya īpsatītyarthaḥ, tadābhipragrahaṇaṃ
kartavyameva| 
kriyāgrahaṇamapi kartavyamiti vārtikam, etadvyācaṣṭe-kriyayetyādi|
nanu kriyāmapi loke karmetyupacaranti-kiṃ karma kariṣyasi, kāṃ
kriyāmiti, tatra karmaṇā yamabhipraitītyeva siddham| evamapi kartavyam;
ṭhkṛtrimākṛtrimayoḥ kṛtrime kāryasaṃpratyayo bhavati'
saṃdarśanaprārthanādhyavasāyairāpyamānatvāt| kriyāpi kṛtrimaṃ karma,
tathā hi-ya eva manuṣyaḥ prekṣāpūrvakārī bhavati, sa buddhyā
tāvatkañcidarthaṃ saṃpaśyati-idamīddaśamiti, tad ddaṣṭṃa prārthayate-ayi
mamedaṃ syāditi, tatastadupāyabhūtāṃ kriyāṃ paśyati-asyā
etatphalamiti, tataḥ prārthayate-kathamiyaṃ niṣpapādyatāmiti,
tatastatsādhanāni samavadhārya kartumadhyavasyati|
pratīyamānakriyāpekṣo'pi kārakabhāvo bhavatyeva, yathā-praviśa
piṇḍīmityatra bhakṣayeti gamyate| sūtrakāraśca
sūtrayati-ṭhkriyārthopapadasya ca karmaṇi sthāninaḥ' iti| evamapi
kriyāgrahaṇaṃ kartavyam; dadātikarmatvāt| nigarhate iti|
nāstikyānnindatītyarthaḥ| ṭhgarha galha kutsāyām' anudātet|
yuddhāyeti| yuddhaviṣayaṃ saṃnāhapūrvakaṃ niścayaṃ karotītyarthaḥ|
nahyatiḥ svaritet| patye śete iti| patimupasṛtya śeta ityarthaḥ|
yadi tarhi kriyayābhipreyamāṇasyāpi bhavati kaṭaṅkarotītyādāvapi
prāpnoti, vacanāddhi karmasaṃpradānasaṃjñayoḥ paryāyaḥ syāt?
naitatsārvatrikam, kiṃ tarhi? prayogadarśanavaśena niyataviṣayam|
karmaṇaḥ karaṇasaṃjñetyādi| etachandoviṣayam, sarve vidhayaścchandasi
vikalpante, iti yathāprāptamapi prayogo bhavati| bhāṣye tu
dadātikarmaṇeti nāśritam, prayogāśca bahavaḥ-aryamṇe caruṃ
nirvapet, devebhyo brahmāedanamapakṣat, devebhyo havyaṃ vahantaḥ
cchandāṃsi vai devebhyo havyamūrdhā, yadaṅgamāśuṣe tvam, śaṃ naḥ
karatparvate ityādayaḥ, tanmate kriyāgrahaṇaṃ na kartavyam| kathaṃ yatra
saṃpradānatvamiṣyate? tatra saṃdarśanādīnāṃ kriyāyāśca bhedo
vivakṣyate, tataśca tairāpyamānā kriyāpi kṛtrimaṃ karmeti siddhaṃ
tayābhipreyamāṇasya saṃpradānatvam, yatra tu neṣyate tatra bhedo na
vivakṣyate, tataścaudanādyekaphalāvacchedenaikīkṛtayā
kriyayā''pyamānasya karmatvameva bhaviṣyati-kaṭaṅkaroti, odanaṃ
pacatīti| gatyartheṣu tūbhayaṃ vivakṣyate-bhedaḥ, abhedaśca; tatra
bhedavivakṣāyāṃ grāmaṃ gacchatīti prayoga iti ṭhgatyarthakarmaṇi'
ityetadapi na vaktavyaṃ bhavati||
padamañjarī
rucyarthānāṃ prīyamāṇaḥ|| 1|4|33 ||
rucinā samānārthā iti| vastukathanametat| vigrahastu rucirartho
yeṣāmiti| te ca rucinā dhātunā dhātunā samānārthā bhavanti|
prīyamāṇa iti| ṭhprīñ tarpaṇe' ityasmāt kraiyādikāt
sakarmakātkarmaṇi laḥ| daivādikastu ṅdikarmakaḥ, tarpamāṇa ityarthaḥ|
anyakartṛka iti| yo'bhilāṣasyāśrayaḥ prīyamāṇastato'nyakartṛka
ityarthaḥ| kathaṃ punaranyāśrayasyābhilāṣasyānyaḥ kartā bhavati, yāvatā
yadāśrayavyāpāraṃ dhātuḥ prādhānyenācaṣṭe sa kartā? nedaṃ kartṛ
lakṣaṇam, kintu svātantryameva| tacca kvacidvāstavam,
kvacidvaivakṣikam| tadatra mādhuryātiśayena svaviṣayaṃ
devadatāśrayamabhilāṣaṃ janayanmodakastatra karteti gīyate| na caivaṃ
laṣerapi prasaṅgaḥ, devadato modakamabhilaṣyatīti?
abhidhānaśaktivaicitryādāśrayakartṛ ko'bhilāṣo laṣervācyaḥ, rucestu
viṣayakartṛkaḥ| ddaṣṭaścāyamabhidhānaprakāraniyamo'nyatrāpi, tadyathā-ghaṭaḥ
paśyatīti ddaśerāśrayakartṛ kaṃ jñānaṃ vācyam| ghaṭaḥ prakāśate ityatra
prakāśerviṣayakartṛkam| viṣaya eva hi spaṣṭālokamadhya vartitvādinā
saukaryeṇa devadatāśraye jñāne karteti vyapadiśyate, na tu jñānena
kaścidatiśayo viṣayo janyate|
ko'yaṃ prakāśo nāma, yaṃ prākaṭha|lmācakṣate bhāṭṭāḥ, tatra
kārakaśeṣatvena ṣaṣṭhīprasaṅge vacanam| anye tu prīyamāṇaṃ devadataṃ
modakaḥ prīṇayatīti karmasaṃjñāṃ prāptāṃ manyante| apare tvevamāhuḥ-
devadato rocayati modakamiti hetutve prāpte vacanamiti,
devadataṃ hi prāpya rocate modako na sarvān, nānecchā hi
prāṇina iti| evamutareṣvapi yogeṣu draṣṭavyam| uktaṃ ca--
hetutve karmasaṃjñāyāṃ śeṣatve cāpi kārakam|
rucyarthādiṣu śāstreṇa saṃpradānākhyamucyate|| iti|
pathīti| hetukarmasaṃjñāvadadhikaraṇasaṃjñā bādhyeteti bhāvaḥ| kiṃ ca
prīyamāṇagrahaṇādevādityo rocata iti dīptivācināmagrahaṇam||
padamañjarī
ślāghahūnuṅsthāśapāṃ jñīpsyamānaḥ|| 1|4|34 ||
jñīpsyamāna iti| ṭhmāraṇatoṣaṇaniśāmaneṣu jñā' iti ghaṭādiṣu
paṭha|lte, tasmānniśāmane'rthe hetumaṇṇici sani
ṭhāpjñapṛdhāmīt',ṭhatra lopo'bhyāsasya',karmaṇi laṭaḥ śānajādeśaḥ|
niśāmanaṃ ceha jñānamātramucyate, na cakṣurvijñānameva,
yadāha-boghayitumabhipreta iti| kathaṃ tarhi
prayujyate--tajjñāpayatyācārthaḥ, vijñāpanā bhartṛṣu siddhimetīti?
tasmānniśāneṣviti pāṭhaḥ| ṭhśo tanūkaraṇe' lyuḍantaḥ, saṃjñapitaḥ
paśurityudāharaṇam| jñīpsyamāno jñapayitumiṣyamāṇa iti
prayogaḥṭhjñapa micca' iti curādiṇijantasya| anye tu -ṭhmitāṃ hrasvaḥ'
ityatra ṭhvā citavirāge' ityato
vetyanuvṛtervyavasthitavibhāṣāvijñānāccāniṣṭe viṣaye
hrasvābhāvamāhuḥ| devadataṃ prati ślāghamānāstāṃ ślāghāṃ tameva
jñapayitumicchatītyartha iti| ślāghā stutiḥ, pratyakṣeṇa devadataṃ
stautīti yāvat| evaṃ hi tāṃ devadataḥ śakyate jñāpayitum| anye
tvāhuḥ- devadatāyātmānaṃ paraṃ ślāghyaṃ kathayatītyartha iti| tathā ca
bhaṭṭikāvyam--
ślāghamānaḥ parastrībhyastatrāgādrākṣasādhipaḥ|| iti|
ātmānaṃ ślāghyaṃ parastrībhyaḥ kathayannityarthaḥ| evaṃ devadatāya
nihnuta iti| ṭhhnuṅ apanayane' devadataṃ prati nihnvānastāṃ
nihnutiṃ tameva jñāpayitumicchatītyarthaḥ| ityeṣa evaṃśabdasyārthaḥ|
nihnutirapalāpaḥ, saṃnihitameva devadataṃ
dhanikāderapalapatītyarthaḥ| anye tu hnotavyaṃ kiñciddevadataṃ
jñāpayatītyartha ityāhuḥ- devadatāya tiṣṭhata iti| īddaśo'hamiti
devadatasya sthanena prakāśayatītyarthaḥ| devadatāya śapate iti| śapathena
kiñcitprakāśayatītyarthaḥ| devadataḥ ślāghate iti| jñīpsyamānavacanāt
karmasaṃjñaiva bādhyate, na kartṛsaṃjñetyarthaḥ| evaṃ gārgikayā ślāghate
sabhāyāmiti karaṇādhikaraṇasaṃjñe na bādhyete| kvacitu devadataṃ
ślāghate iti pāṭhaḥ| tatrāyaṃ bhāvaḥ-yasmāyākhyāyate sa jñīpsyamāna
ityākhyāyāmānā dvinīyaiva nyāyyeti| ye tvākhyāyamānaṃ jñīpsyamānaṃ
vadanti teṣāṃ yasmāyākhyāyate tataḥ ṣaṣṭhī bhavati--devadatāya
ślāghate yajñadato viṣṇumitrasyeti||
padamañjarī
dhārerutamarṇaḥ|| 1|4|35 ||
utamamṛṇaṃ yasyeti| utamamūtkuṣṭatamam,
utkṛṣṭārthavṛterucchabdātamapi dravyaprakarṣatvādāmabhāvaḥ| arteḥ ktaḥ,
ṛṇam ṭhṛṇamādhamarṇye' ityatra kālāntare
deyadravyavinimayopalakṣaṇārthamādhamarṇyagrahaṇamityutamarṇe'pi natvaṃ
bhavati| atra bahuvrīhau niṣṭhāyāḥ pūrvanipāte
ṭhjātikālasukhādibhyaḥ'paravacanam iti
sukhāderākṛtigaṇatvādasmādeva vā nipātanāddaṇaśabdasya
paranipātaḥ| śataṃ dhārayatīti| ṭhdhṛṅ avasthāne',dhriyamāṇaṃ
svarūpeṇāvatiṣṭhamānaṃ svabhāvādapracyavamānaṃ śataṃ prayuṅkta iti ṇic|
grāma iti| nanvatra paratvādadhikaraṇasaṃjñaiva bhaviṣyati; utamarṇe'pi tarhi
hetusañjñā syāt||
padamañjarī
spṛherīpsitaḥ|| 1|4|36 ||
curādāvadantaḥ paṭha|lta iti| tena spṛhayatītyatrāto lopasya
sthānivadbhāvāllaghūpadhaguṇo neti bhāvaḥ| īpsita iti| ṭhmatibuddhi'
ityādinā vartamāne ktaḥ| īpsitamātre iyaṃ saṃjñā| prakarṣavivakṣāyāṃ
tu paratvāt karmasaṃjñaiva bhavati--puṣpāṇi spṛhayatīti| yadā
tvīpsitamīpsitatamaṃ vā śeṣatvena vivakṣyate, tadā ṣaṣṭhī bhavati||
padamañjarī
krudhadruherṣyāsūyārthānāṃ yaṃ prati kopaḥ|| 1|4|37 ||
guṇeṣviti| śaucācārādiṣuḥ dāṣā viṣkaraṇamiti|
dambhādidoṣādhyāsa ityarthaḥ| tatra krudhadruhāvakarmakāviti
kārakaśeṣatvānnaṭasya śrṛṇotītivat ṣaṣṭha|laṃ prāptāyāṃ vacanam,
itarayostu sakarmakatvād dvitīyā prāpnoti| atra ca
citadoṣarūpatvaṃ yadyapi krodhādīnāmaviśiṣṭam,
tathāpyanyeṣāmevañjātīyakānāṃ
dveṣādīnāmagrahaṇārthamavāntarabhedavivakṣayā pṛthagime nirdiṣṭāḥ, na
tu citadoṣārthānāmiti| tenāsmān dveṣṭītyatra na bhavati,
anabhinandanaṃ hyasyārthaḥ| tathā cācetaneṣvapi prayujyate--auṣadhaṃ
dveṣṭīti| kathaṃ punarekena krudhinā sarve krudhādayaḥ śakyā
viśeṣayitumata āha--krodhastāvaditi| bhāryāmīrṣyatītyatra kevalaṃ
parairddaśyamānāṃ bhāryāṃ, na tu tāṃ prati kopaḥ||
padamañjarī
krudhadruhorupasṛṣṭayoḥ karma|| 1|4|38 ||
upasargeṇa sambaddhayoriti| ṭhupasargāḥ kriyāyoge'
upasṛjantītyupasargāḥ, pacādyaci nyaṅkvāditvāt kutvam|
tenopasṛṣṭayorityasyopasargeṇa sambaddhayorityayamartho bhavati|
svanikāyaprasiddhirvā||
padamañjarī
rādhākṣyeryasya vipraśnaḥ|| 1|4|39||
yasyeti karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī, yadvividhaṃ pṛcchayata ityarthaḥ|
yatsambandhītyādi| yatsambandhinaḥ śubhāśubhasya vipraśna iti| devadatāya
rāghyatīti| ṭhrādho'karmakādvadvāveva' iti divādau, tatra
vṛddhāvityupalakṣaṇamakarmakāditi vacanād
vṛddhāvakarmakatvāvyabhicārāt| evakārastu bhinnakramaḥ-
rādho'karmakādeva śyan bhavati, yathā-vṛddhāviti| tena
satyapyevakāre paryālocanasya vṛttiraviruddhā| tatra
dhātvarthenopasaṃgrahājjīvatyādivad rādho'karmatvamaviruddham|
nimitaṃ veda naimitikaḥ, uñchādiṣu vasantādiṣu vā nimitaśabdo
draṣṭavyaḥ| yasyagrahaṇamanarthakam, yaṃ pratītyeva, tatra yaṃ prati vipraśna
ityanvaye kiṃ nāma vivakṣitaṃ na sidhyati||
padamañjarī
pratyāṅbhyāṃ śruvaḥ pūrvasya kartā|| 1|4|40 ||
dvivacananirdeśāt pratyekamupasargasambandha ityāha-- āṅpūrvasya
pratipūrvasya ceti| kaḥ punaratra pūrvo vyāpāra
ityatrāha--pratyāṅpūrvaścetyādi pareṇa prayuktasyeti| idaṃ me
dehītyevaṃ prārthitasyetyarthaḥ| pūrvasyāḥ kriyāyā iti| sūtre tu
vyāpārarūpavivakṣayā pūrvasyeti nirdeśaḥ, yatra hetusañjñāyāṃ
prāptāyāṃ devadatena pratiśrāvayatīti prayoganivṛtaye
vacanamityāhuḥ| vivakṣāntare ca devadato gāṃ pratiśrāvayatīti
bhavatyeva||
padamañjarī
anupratigṛṇaśca|| 1|4|41 ||
pūrveṇa sāhacaryādatrāpi pratyekamupasargasambandha ityāha--anūpūrvasya
pratipūrvasya ceti| kaḥ punaratra pūrvo vyāpāra ityatrāha--hotā
prathamamityādi| anya iti| adhvaryuḥ| kathaṃ punarjñāyate-anupratipūrvo
gṛṇātiḥ śaṃsituḥ protsāhane vartata ityāha--anugaraḥ pratigara
ityādi| anugīryate protsāhyate yena śabdena so'nugaraḥ| evaṃ
pratigaraḥ, othāmo daivetyevamādikaḥ śabdaḥ; tena hi pratigīryate|
padamañjarī
sādhakatamaṃ karaṇam|| 1|4|42 ||
ṭhṣidhū saṃrāddhau' ityasya hetumaṇṇyantasya
ṭhsiddhyaterapāralaukike' ityātve ṭhrādha sādha saṃsiddhau' ityasya vā
ṇyantasya sādhakaśabdaḥ| kriyātmakaścārthaḥ| prayojyaḥ kartā, sidhyataḥ
sādhyavato vā kriyātmano'rthasya prayojakatamaṃ sādhakatamam| nanu
sāmag«adhīnā kriyāsiddhirno khalu kartrādīnāmanya tamāpāye'pi
kriyā niṣyadyate, tatkimapekṣaḥ kārakāṇāṃ madhye ekasyātiśayayogaḥ
syāt? ucyate; chedyadravyānupraveśo vyāpāraḥ, kāṣṭhāde pāke
prajvalana janitoṣṇasparśānupraveśaḥ, tadanantarameva kriyāsiddhiḥ naivaṃ
kārakāntareṣvanupraveśaḥ tadvyāpārānantaraṃ vā kriyāniṣpatiḥ
samasti, ataḥ-
kriyāyāḥ pariniṣpatiryadvyāpārādanantaram|
vivakṣyate yadā tatra karaṇaṃ tatadā smṛtam||
ṭhvivakṣyate' ityanenaitad darśayati-deśakālāvasthādivaśena yasya
kriyā pratyupayogātiśayena vyāpāraḥ pratyāsīdan vivakṣye, tadā
tasya karaṇatvaṃ bhavatīti| yathā sthālyadhikaraṇatvena prasiddhā, tasyā api
tanutarakapālatayā prakarṣavivakṣāyāṃ karaṇatvaṃ bhavati-sthālyā pacyata
iti| uktaṃ ca--
vastutastadanirdeśyaṃ na hi vastu vyavasthitam|
sthālyā pacyata ityeṣā vivakṣā ddaśyate yataḥ|| iti|
na caivaṃ karturapi karaṇatvavivakṣāprasaṅgaḥ; bhinnajātīyatvāt|
sakalasādhanaviniyogakārī khalvasau, na ca śatadhano niṣkadhanena saha
sparddhate!kathaṃ tarhyaśvena dīpikayā rathena sañcarate iti bahūnāṃ
karaṇatvam, yāvatā teṣvapi yadāsannopakārakaṃ tadeva karaṇaṃ
yuktam? ucyate; kārakāntarāpekṣaḥ karaṇasyātiśayaḥ, na svakakṣāyām;
tena sarveṣāṃ kriyāniṣpatau saṃnipatyopakārakatvāt siddhaṃ
karaṇatvam|
tamabgrahaṇaṃ kimiti| kārakādhikārāt siddhe sādhakatve punaḥ
sādhakaśrutiḥ prakarṣārthā bhaviṣyatīti praśnaḥ| gaṅgāyāṃ ghoṣa iti|
asati tamabgrahaṇe ādhāro nāma yatrādhārātmā vyāpto
bhavatyādheyena, tenehaiva syāt- tileṣu tailam, payasi sarpiriti;
gaṅgāyāṃ ghoṣa ityatra na syāt| tamabgrahaṇaṃ tu jñāpayati-iha
prakaraṇe sāmarthyagamyaḥ prakarṣo nāśrīyate, tenehāpi bhavati| yadā ca
deśadharmo ghoṣaṃ pratyādhārabhāvaḥ strotasyupacaryate, tadevaṃ
tamabgrahaṇasya prayojanam; yadā tu gaṅgāśabdastīre vartate tadā
na prayojanam| ādheyena vyāptisambhavānmukhya evādhārabhāva iti||
padamañjarī
divaḥ karma ca|| 1|4|43 ||
nanu cākṣān dīvyatītyatra pātayatītyarthastatra karmatvaṃ siddham;
akṣairdīvyatīti, kriḍatītyarthaḥ, tatra karaṇatvaṃ siddham,
kimarthamidamityāśāṅkyāha--pūrveṇa karaṇasaṃjñāyāmiti| akṣaiḥ
krīḍatītyasyāmeva vivakṣāyāmakṣān dīvyatītīṣyate, atra ca
karaṇasaṃjñaiva prāpnoti, akṣānpātayatītyatra cārthe'kṣairdīvyatīti
neṣyate, ataḥ sādhakatamasyaiva karaṇasaṃjñāyāṃ prāptāyāmayamārambha
ityarthaḥ| atha kimarthaścakāraḥ? karaṇasaṃjñāpi yathā syāt naitadasti
prayojanam; vakṣyamāṇamanyatarasyāṃgrahaṇamihaiva kariṣyāmi,
tatrāha--cakārātkaraṇasaṃjñaṃ ceti| yugapatsaṃjñādvayaṃ yathā syāditi
bhāvaḥ| anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇe tu paryāyaḥ syāt--yadā karma na tadā
karaṇam, yadā karaṇaṃ na tadā karma; cakārātu yugapadeva saṃjñādvayaṃ
bhavatītyarthaḥ| yaugapadyaprayojanaṃ manasā dīvyatīti karmatvādaṇ
pratyayaḥ, karaṇatvācca tṛtīyāṭhmanasaḥ saṃjñāyām' ityaluk-manasā
devaḥ| iha cākṣairdeavayate devadato yajñadateneti, akṣairiti
tṛtīyāprayoge'pi dhātoḥ sakarmakatvād ṭhgatibuddhi'
ityādinā'ṇyantāvasthāyāṃ karturyajñadatasya karmasaṃjñā na bhavati,
ṭhaṇāvakarmakāt' iti parasmaipadaṃ ca| yadi tarhi samāveśaḥ- akṣān
dīvyatīti paratvāt tṛtīyā prāpnoti; paryāye tu nāyaṃ doṣaḥ,
karmasaṃjñāpakṣe karaṇasaṃjñāyā abhāvāt| samāveśe tu karaṇasaṃjñāyā
avakāśaḥ-videvanā akṣāḥ, ṭhkaraṇādhikaraṇayośca' iti lyuṭ;
karmasaṃjñāyā avakāśaḥ-dīvyante bhavatākṣāḥ, ṭhbhāvakarmaṇoḥ' iti
yagātmanepade; akṣānityatra bhayasaṃjñākāryaprasaṅge paratvātṛtīyā
syāt, naiṣa doṣaḥ; kāryakālaṃ hi saṃjñāparibhāṣam, tataśca ṭhkarmaṇi
dvitīyā' ityatra yadasyopasthānaṃ tadanavakāśamiti dvitīyā bhaviṣyati|
ayaṃ tarhi samāveśe doṣaḥ- dīvyante'kṣā iti karmaṇyabhihite'pi
karaṇasyānabhihitatvātṛtīyā syāt, devanā akṣā iti lyuṭā
karaṇasyābhidhāne'pi karmaṇo'nabhidhānena dvitīyā syāt? naiṣa
doṣaḥ; ekaiva kārakaśaktiḥ saṃjñādvayayoginī| tataśyaikasmin
kārake'bhihite kārakāntaramapyabhihitameva bhavati; śakterekatvāt||
padamañjarī
parikrayaṇe saṃpradānamanyatarasyām|| 1|4|44 ||
parikrayaṇaśabde dhātugatameva rephamāśritya ṭhraṣābhyām' ityeva
ṇatvam, prathamopanipatitatvād, yathopasargābhāve krayaṇamiti; na
tūpasargasthamāśritya ṭhkṛtyacaḥ' ityanena tasya paścādupanipatitatvena
bahiraṅgatvāt| vetanādineti| vetanaṃ bhṛtiḥ, niyatakālatvameva
spaṣṭayati| nātyantikaḥ kraya eveti| pariśabdaḥ sāmīpyaṃ dyotayati|
krayo nāmātyantikaṃ svīkaraṇam, niyatakālaṃ tu tasya samīpameveti
pariśabdasyārthaḥ||
padamañjarī
āghāro'dhikaraṇam|| 1|4|45 ||
ādhriyante'smin kriyā ityādhāra iti ṭhadhyāyanyāyodyāva'
ityādinā'dhikaraṇe ghañ| kriyāpekṣatvāt kārakabhāvasya
kriyāgrahaṇam| yadi kriyādhārasyādhikaraṇasaṃjñā, kartṛkarmaṇoreva
syāt| kartṛsthā hi kriyā bhavati karmasthā vā| kartṛsaṃjñāyāḥ
ko'vakāśaḥ? ye karmasthakriyāḥ- pacatyodanaṃ devadata iti|
nanvatrāpyadhiśrayaṇāderādhāraḥ karteti syādeva prasaṅgaḥ? ayaṃ
tarhyavakāśaḥ- devadatāya rocate modaka ityuktam, atra
devadatasthasyābhilāṣasya modakaḥ karteti| athāpyanavakāśā kartṛsaṃjñā?
evamapi paryāyaḥ syāt| atha karmasaṃjñāyāḥ ko'vakāśaḥ? ye
kartṛsthakriyāḥ-ādityaṃ paśyatīti| ataḥ
kartṛkarmaṇorevādhikaraṇasaṃjñāprasaṅga ityata āha--kartṛ
karmaṇorityādi| kathaṃ punaḥ sākṣātkriyādhāre sambhavati
kriyādhārabhūtakartṛ karmavyavadhānena kriyādhārasya gauṇasya grahaṇaṃ
śakyaṃ vijñātum? karaṇasaṃjñāyāṃ tamabgrahaṇena
jñāpitametad-yathākathañcitkriyādhārasyāpi karaṇasaṃjñā bhavatīti|
mukhyasyāpi tu kasmānna syād? āsta iti kartṛsthāyāḥ kriyāyā
udāharaṇam| pacatīti karmasthāyāḥ|
trividhaṃ ca tadadhikaraṇam--aupaśleṣikam, vaiṣayikam, abhivyāpakaṃ
ceti| kaṭe āste,gurau āvasati, tileṣu tailamiti||
adhiśīṅsthāsāṃ karma|| 1|4|46 ||
padamañjarī
abhiniviśaśca|| 1|4|47 ||
neralpāctarasyāpūrvanipātād ṭhabhini' iti
samudāyānukaraṇamityāha--abhiniparvūsyeti| anyathā'bhipūrvasya
nipūrvasya ceti brūyāt||
padamañjarī
upānvadhyāṅvasaḥ|| 1|4|48 ||
vasareśyarthasyeti| arthaśabdo nivṛttivacanaḥ, vyadhikaraṇe ṣaṣṭhayau,
aśyarthasya yo vācakastasyetyarthaḥ| bhojananivṛttivācina iti yāvat|
yadvā--śīṅe'rthaḥ śyarthaḥ, na śyarthastasya, asthānārthasyetyarthaḥ|
sthāne'pi hi śīṅ vartate-jalāśayamiti| tena grāme
tiṣṭhatītyatrārthe grāmamupavasatīti bhavati| asthānārthatve grāma
upavasatīti, sa tarhi pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ? na vaktavyaḥ, katham?
nātropapūrvasya vaseḥ grāmo'dhikaraṇam, kiṃ tarhi?
anupasargasya--grāme vasan trirātramupavasati| etaduktaṃ
bhavati--viśiṣṭādhārāvasthitatvena niścite devadate
bhojananivṛttiviśiṣṭakālaṃ pratipādayitumidaṃ prayujyate--grāma
upavasatīti, tatrāntaraṅgatvāt pratīyamānavasikriyāpekṣo
grāmasyādhikaraṇabhāvaḥ| upavasanaṃ tu svarūpeṇaiva kālamapekṣata iti
kālenaivāntaraṅgaḥ sambandhaḥ, grāmādinā tu bahiraṅga
ityaprayuktamapi trirātrādikaṃ karma bhavati||
padamañjarī
karturīpsitatamaṃ karma|| 1|4|49 ||
kartuḥ kriyayetyādi| karturyadāptumiṣṭatamamityanvayaḥ, karturiti
cepsitāpekṣāyā ṭhktasya ca vartamāne' iti kartari ṣaṣṭhī| īpsita iti
ṭhmatibuddhi' ityādinā vartamāne ktaḥ| kriyayeti karaṇe tṛtīyā,
kartā hi nāma yaḥ kriyāmanutiṣṭhati tena karturyadiṣṭatamamityukte
tatkriyāveśādasau kartā bhavati tayā karaṇabhūtayeti gamyate, kartrā
yadāptumiṣyate ātmīyayā kriyayetyarthaḥ|
īpsitaśabdo'yamastyabhiprete rūḍhaḥ-īpsito'bhipreta iti; asti
kriyāśabdaḥ- ṭhāplṛvyāptau' san, ṭhāpjñapṛdhāmīt',
āptumiṣṭamīpsitamiti; tatra kriyāśabdasyeha grahaṇamiti
darśitam--āptumiṣṭatamamiti|
karmaṇa iti| aśvasya| sa hi bhakṣaṇakriyayā māṣānāptumicchati| yadyevam,
yathāśvasya vastuto bhakṣaṇe kartṛtve satyapi samprati bandhanaṃ prati
karmatvena vivakṣitatvādakartṛtvād māṣāṇāṃ karmasaṃjñayā na bhavati,
tathā sārthāddhīyata ityatrāpi hīyamānaṃ sārtho jahātīti vastuvṛtena
tyāgena karturapi sārthasya saṃpratyapādānarūpeṇa vivakṣitatvād
akartṛtvātkarmaṇi yagātmanepade na syātām| 
atrāhuḥ- karmakartaryatra yagātmanepade, katham? jahātirayaṃ gamanāyāṃ
vartatedevadataṃ sārtho jahāti, apagamayatītyarthaḥ, eṣaiva ca
sārthasyāpagamanā yaduta kṣudupaghātādinā devadatasyāpagame
tatsamarthācaraṇam| yadā tu kṣudhādinā svayamevāpagacchati, tadā
karmakartṛ tvam, tadāyaṃ prayogaḥ| tataśca hīyata iti sārthaḥ
svayamevāpagacchatīti, punaḥ kuto hīyate? ityapekṣāyāṃ sārarthena
sambandha iti|
tamabgrahaṇaṃ kimiti| īpsitatamasyāpīpsitatvasambhavād
udāhaṇasiddhiṃ manyate| payasaudanaṃ bhuṅkta iti| karaṇasaṃjñā tu dātreṇa
lunātītyādau sāvakāśā, na hi dātraṃ lavanepsitam| ṭhtathā yuktam'
ityanenāpi na bhavati, dveṣyodāsīnaprāpyayostatra gahaṇāt|
satyapyatra payaso bhujikriyāyāṃ prakṛṣṭopakārakatve īpsāyāḥ
prakarṣābhāvaḥ| yatra tarhi paya evepsitatamam, tatra prāpnoti, tadyathā
kaścit kañcidāha-siddhaṃ bhujyatāmiti, sa āha-prabhūtaṃ
bhuktamasmābhiriti, itara āha-payo bhaviṣyatīti, aparastvaramāṇa
āha-payasā khalu bhuñjīyeti, atra prāptāprāptavivekena payasa
evepsitatamatvaṃ na tvodanasya, atrāpyodanamevepsitatamam;
payasastu saṃskārakatvātkaraṇatvam| na tvasya kevale guṇe ādaraḥ, kiṃ
tarhi? tatsaṃskṛte odane, na hyasau kevalasya payasaḥ pānena
saṃtuṣyatīti| yadi tamabgrahaṇaṃ kriyate, payasaudanaṃ bhuṅkta
ityatraiva syāt, pacatyodanamityādau na syāt, na hīpsitatamaṃ
yuktam, asati pratiyogini vastu yatulyajātīyaṃ tadeva
pratiyogitāṃ bhajate| kārakaṃ cātra na kiñcidiṣṭamīpsitaṃ
payasastvīpsyamānātvād yujyate pratiyogitā,naiṣa doṣaḥ; atrāpi
kriyāpekṣaḥ prakarṣaḥ, ādau hi kartā phalārtha kriyāmabhīpsati, ataḥ
phalārthamiṣyamāṇatvādīpsitā kriyā| phalaṃ tu
svarūpeṇeṣyamāṇamīpsitatamaṃ kriyāyā api karmatvaṃ
saṃdarśanādiviśeṣāntaraspardhayā| yatra tarhi phalābhāvastatra na syāt,
kva ca phalābhāvaḥ ? vikārye-kāṣṭhani bhasmīkarotīti, na hi kāṣṭhāni
phalarūpāṇi| mā bhūvan tāni svarūpeṇa phalāni, bhasmātmanā tu
phalāni? prāpye tarhi na syāt--ādityaṃ paśyati, himavantaṃ
śrṛṇotīti, na hyatra kriyayā kaścidatiśayo janyate| atrāpyatiśayo
janyate--prākaṭa|lṃ nāma? yo hi yaṃ paśyati śṛṇoti vā tasyāsau
prakaṭo bhavati, pratipatrādyatiriktapuruṣāpekṣayā tu
viśeṣonāstītyucyate| yadvā--tamabgrahaṇena yatrāpakṛṣṭecchā tadeva
vyāvartyate, tena paśyatītyādāvādityādīnāmapi
pratiyogino'satvenāpakarṣābhāvād bhaviṣyati, atra ca liṅgam
ṭhlalāṭakukkuṭyau paśyati' iti|
karmetyanuvartamāna iti| adhiśīṅsthāsāmityataḥ|
ādhāranivṛtyarthamiti| prācyaṃ karmagrahaṇāmādhāreṇa saṃbaddhamiti
tadanuvṛtau tasyāpyanuvṛttiḥ syāditi bhāvaḥ| ādhārānuvṛtau ko
doṣastatrāha--ādhārasyaiva hi syāditi| kvetyāha--gehamityādi| yatra
tu na syātadāha--odanaṃ pacatītyādi|
etaccepsitatamaṃ karma trividham--nirvartyam, vikāryam,
prāpyamiti| tathāyuktamapi dvividham--dveṣyam, itaracca| ṭhakathitaṃ ca'
ityaparam| saṃjñāntaraprasaṅge cānyat--ṭhdivaḥ karma ca' ityādi|
tadevaṃ saptavidhaṃ karma| uktaṃ ca--
nirvartya ca vikāryaṃ ca prāpyaṃ ceti tridhā matam|
taccepsitatamaṃ karma caturdhā'nyatu kalpitam||
audāsīnyena yatprāpyaṃ yacca karturanīpsitam|
saṃjñāntarairanākhyātaṃ yadyaccāpyanyapūrvakam|| iti|
tathā--
yadasat, jāyate sadvā janmanā yat prakāśyate|
tannirvartyaṃ vikāryaṃ tu karma dvedhā vyavasthitam||
prakṛtyucchedasambhūtaṃ kiñcitkāṣṭhādi bhasmavat|
kiñcid guṇāntarotpatyā suvarṇādivikāravat||
kriyākṛtaviśeṣāṇāṃ siddhiryatra na gamyate|
darśanādanumānādvā tatprāpyamiti kathyate || iti|
tatra nirvartyam--ghaṭṃa karotīti, vyaktyabhiprāyoṇa
janmasāmānyābhiprāyeṇa prakāśanam| nanu ca yadi ghaṭaḥ? na kartavyaḥ;
atha kartavyaḥ? na ghaṭaḥ ; ityanupapanna ghaṭa karotīti? naiṣa doṣaḥ;
tathāvidhaṃ vastu karoti yasya niṣpannasya ghaṭa iti
saṃjñeti--ayamatrārthaḥ| evamodanaṃ payatītyādāvapi|
vikāryam--kāṣṭhāni bhasma karoti, suvarṇaṃ kuṇḍalaṃ karotīti|
prāpyam--ādityaṃ paśyatīti| na hyatra pratyakṣeṇa anumānena vā
kriyājanyaḥ kaścidatiśayo gamyate, yathā--nirvartyavikāryayoḥ
rajjuṃ sṛjati, kāṣṭhṃa dahati, devadataṃ roṣayatīti| kārakatvaṃ tu
prāpyasyābhāsopagamādibhiḥ, ādityo hyabhāsamupagacchati, yato
ddaśyate abhivyaktimupayāti, yato vyaktamupalabhyate sahate ca
darśanam, yataḥ śakyate draṣṭuṃa tadevābhāsopagama; vyaktiḥ,
soḍhatvamiti karmaṇo viśeṣāḥ prāpyamāṇasya kriyāsiddhau
vivakṣitāḥ||
padamañjarī
tathā yuktaṃ cānīpsitam|| 1|4|50 ||
tatheti pṛthak padam, nopasamastam; lakṣaṇābhāvāt|
cakāro'vadhāraṇe, anekārthatvānnipātānām, tathetyasya cānantare
draṣṭavya ityāha--tenaiveti| īpsitādanyatsarvamanīpsitamiti|
yathā adharmānṛtādibhirutarapadārthapratipakṣabhūtaṃ yadvastu
tatpratiṣedhadvāreṇābhidhīyate,
tathehānīpsitaśabdenepsitapratipakṣabhūtaṃ na dveṣyamevābhidhīyate, kiṃ
tarhi? aśva--loṣṭa--ityādivadīpsitavyatiriktaṃ sarvamiti
sarvaśabdasyārthaḥ| viṣaṃ bhakṣayatīti| na kasyāpi viṣamīpsitatamamiti
bhāvaḥ| nanu ya eva manuṣyo vyādhyādinā sarvataḥ pīḍito maraṇameva
jyāyo manyate, tasya viṣamapīpsitatamameva; yadiṣṭṃa guḍādibhrāntyā
viṣe pravartate tasyāpi tadīpsitatamameva, yadiṣṭṃa guḍādi,
tadbuddhireva tatra pravartate; ato'tra pūrveṇaiva
siddhamityudāharaṇāntaropanyāsaḥ| grāmaṃ gacchanniti| nātra
vṛkṣamūlānīpsitatamāni pūrvamanabhisaṃhitatvānnāntarīyakaṃ hi
tadupasarpaṇam| na cātrāpi yāvad grāmaṃ gacchanniti na prayujyate
tāvannāntarīyakatā na pratīyata iti pūrveṇaiva siddham, yathā--nadī
kūlaṃ kaṣatītyatrācetanatvādīpsābhāvaḥ,
padāntarasambandhātpratīyamāno bahiraṅgatvātkarmasaṃjñāṃ na
pratibadhnāti? bhavatvayaṃ pratipatāraṃ prati upapādanaprakāraḥ, yastu
prayuṅkte sa pūrvamevepsāprakarṣābhāvaṃ jānan tatkathaṃ prayuktamiti
pūrveṇāsiddhireva| evaṃ ca nadīkūlamityatrāpi anenaiva karmasaṃjñā|
tathā yatra kriyāyāmeva tātparyaṃ na phale, nāntarīyakā tu phalasiddhiḥ,
tatrāpyanenaiva bhavati|
atha kriyāphalayogi karmeti kasmād noktam? yadīpsitatamaṃ yad
dveṣyamitaracca tatra sarvatrānugatametad, yaduta kriyāphalayogitvaṃ
karturapi tarhi karmatvaṃ syāt, kriyāphalasya saṃyogasya tatrāpi
bhāvāt| bhāvāt| atha parasamavetakriyāphalayogīti lakṣaṇam?
evamapyātmā jñātavya ityatra na syāt , saṃvidaśca svayaṃ
prakāśābhimatāyāḥ karmatvaṃ syāt| ghaṭamahaṃ jānāmītyatra hi
tritayameva bhāsate--ghaṭaḥ, jñānam, ātmā ceti| tatra jñānaṃ kriyā,
tatphalaṃ śabdaprayogādirūpo vyavahāraḥ, tena yujyamānasya ghaṭasya
yathā karmatvaṃ tathā jñānasyāpi syāt| jñānaṃ hi kriyā bhavati
vyavahārūpasya phalasyāśrayabhūtam, tasyaiva jñānasya yat svarūpaṃ
tadapekṣayā yaḥ para ātmā tatra ca samavaitītyalamiyatā|
corānityatrāpi martṛkāmo vā mitrādirūpeṇa viparyasyamāno vā
corānupasarpatīti pūrveṇaiva siddham||
padamañjarī
akathinaṃ ca|| 1|4|51 ||
akathitaśabdo'yamastyapradhāne rūḍhaḥ, tadyathā--akathito'hamasmin grāme,
apradhānabhūta iti gamyate| asti ca kriyāśabdo'kīrtitaparyāyaḥ| ṭhkatha
vākyapravandhe', curādāvadantaḥ paṭha|lte, tatra pūrvasya grahaṇe ṭhpāṇinā
kāṃsapātryāṃ dogdhi payaḥ' ityatra pāṇikāṃsapātryorapi syāt|
karaṇādhikaraṇasaṃjñayostu pacatyādiravakāśaḥ, na hi tatrāsya
prasaṅgaḥ; ṭhduhiyāci' iti parigaṇanāt, ato dvitīyasya grahaṇam,
tadāha--kenākathitam? apadānādibhirviśeṣakathābhiriti| kimatra
pramāṇaṃ tadāha--keneti| karaṇanirdeśaḥ| rūḍhiśabdeṣu hi
vyutpatyarthameva kriyopādīyate; na tatra karaṇādi sambadhyate, na hi
gacchatīti gaurityatra keneti praśno ratheneti prativacanaṃ vā
bhavati| iha ṭhkārake' ityanuvartanāt satyeva kārakatve'kathitasya
saṃjñayā bhāvyamiti sāmarthyādviśeṣakathābhirityuktam| 
parigaṇanaṃ kama dharmādīti| tasya tu prādhānyaṃ tadarthatvāt pravṛteḥ|
sambadhyata iti| sacata ityasyārthakathanametat,ṭhṣaca samavāye'
svaritet| kecitu parasmaipadibhiḥ saha dhātumenaṃ paṭhanti ṭhṣaca
savāye'ṭhrapa lapa vyaktāyāṃ vāci' iti| tatrāhuḥ-ṭhṣacasevane'
ityasyānudāteto'nekārthatvātsamavāye pravṛttiriti, sambadhnāteśca
karmavyāpāre sacirvartata iti kartṛpadasya karmapadenārthakathanaṃ
nānupapannam, yathā--rādhyatyodana ityasya pacyata iti| uktamiti|
ācaritamityasya vivaraṇam| sūtrakāreṇeti| kaviśabdo
medhāvimātravacano'pi prakaraṇāt sūtrakāre prayukta iti darśayati|
gāṃ dogdhi paya iti| nanu cātrāyamarthaḥ- gauḥ payastyajati, dogdhā
gavā payastyājayatīti; tatra prayojakavyāpāreṇāpyamānatvāt siddhā
goḥ karmasaṃjñā| na ca vācyam--ṭhprayojakavyāpāreṇāpyamānasya yadi
bhavati gatyarthādiṣvevetyutarasūtre niyamādatra na prāpnopi,
yathā--pacantaṃ devadataṃ prayuṅkte, pācayati devadatenetyatra'
iti;ṇyantaṣveva sa niyamaḥ, ayaṃ tu prakṛtyantaḥ, naitadasti; yathā
ṇyanteṣu dhātuṣu kriyāviśiṣṭasya prayuktiḥ pratīyate--gamayatīti,
naivamatra viṣkriyasyāpi gavāderdohananayanādiṣu viniyogāt|
tathā hyaduhānāpi gaurduhyate, agacchanto bhārādayaḥ śirasā nīyante,
tasmāddegdhītyekasyā eva kriyāyāḥ śravaṇād gopayasorbhedena
karmatvaṃ na bhavati| ṇici tu sati prakṛtyaṃśasya pratyayāṃśasya ca
bhedena dve vācye iti karmabhedopapatiḥ|
gamayati grāmaṃ devadatamiti| yadā tu duheḥ kṣaraṇamarthaḥ-kṣarati goḥ
kṣīram, kṣīraṃ kṣārayati devadata iti, tadā yadyapi
gorapāye'vadhibhāvo vidyate; tathāpyavivakṣite
tasminnimitatvamātrāpekṣāyāmudāharaṇopapatiḥ| evaṃ
cāvadhitvavivakṣāyāmapādānasaṃjñāyāṃ bhavatyeva--gerduhyate paya iti|
yadā tu payasyeva viśeṣaṇaṃ gauḥ, tadā ṣaṣṭhī--goḥ payo dogdhīti|
pauravaṃ gāṃ yācate iti| purorapatyaṃ pauravaḥ| nanu
vihitātrāpādānasaṃjñā pauravādasau gāmādate, na yācanādeva tata
ādate, yācito'sau yadi dadāti tata ādate, nanu mā
nāmāditā''ditsate tāvat, tadapi na; yataḥ
svabhāvaparicicchitsuranāditsamāno'pi yācate| gāmavaruṇaddhi
vrajamiti| nanu ca gāṃ vrajaṃ praveśayatītyayamatrārthaḥ, tataśca siddhaṃ
vrajasya karmatvam? atha vraje gāmavasthāpayatītyarthaḥ, tarhi
kathitātrādhikaraṇasaṃjñā; yadā tarhyavarodhanakriyāṃ prati nimitatvamātraṃ
vivakṣyate na karmatvaṃ nādhikaraṇatvaṃ tadedamudāharaṇam| vrajena
hetunā'vasthāpayatītyarthaḥ|
māṇavakaṃ panthānaṃ pṛcchatīti| ṭhpraccha jñīpsāyām', tudādiḥ,
grahijyādinā saṃprasāraṇam| nanu ca kathitātrāpādānasaṃjñā, sa hi
tasmādupadeśamādate na praśnamātrādādate, pṛṣṭo'sau yadyaupadiśati
tata ādate| mā nāmāditā, āditsate tāvat tadapi na,
anāditsamāno'pi svabhāvaparijñānāyā pṛcchati|
bhikṣiryācivadvyākhyeyaḥ| kimarthaṃ
punaryācibhikṣyorubhayorupādānam, na hyanayorarthe bhedo'sti,
arthāśrayā ceyaṃ saṃjñā, na duhyādisvarūpāśrayā| samānārthe'pi hi
gṛhyate--devadataṃ śataṃ prārthayata iti? ucyate, ananuyārthasya
yācatergrahaṇārtham| tenāvinītaṃ vinayaṃ yācate, kruddhaṃ prasādaṃ
yācata ityatrāpi bhavati| sakṛdupātasya corabhayarūpānupapateḥ
bhikṣirapi gṛhītaḥ|
vṛkṣamavacinoti phalanīti| yadyapyavacinvad vṛkṣān phalamādate
ityapādānasaṃjñāyā ayaṃ viṣayaḥ, tathāpi yadā vṛkṣo nāvadhitvena
vivakṣyate nimitarūpeṇaiva tu vivakṣyate, tadedamudāharaṇam|
brūte'nuśāstīti| ṭhbrūñ vyaktāyāṃ vāci' ṭhśāsu anuśiṣṭau',
adādī, yadyadyapyatra dharmeṇa vacanānuśāsanakarmaṇā
māṇavakasyābhipreyamāṇatvam, tathāpi dadātikarmābhāvātsaṃjñāyā
aprasaṅgaḥ| ye tu tatra dadātikarmaṇeti nāśrayanti, teṣāmapi
nimitatvamātraṃ vivakṣitaṃ nābhipreyamāṇatvamityudāharaṇopapatiḥ||
athānye'pi dvikarmakāḥ-
nīvahyaerharateścāpi gatyarthānāṃ tathaiva ca|
dvikarmakeṣu grahaṇaṃ draṣṭavyamiti niścayaḥ||
ṭhgatyarthānām' ityutarasūtropalakṣaṇam| nī--ajāṃ nayati grāmam|
vahivahati bhāraṃ grāmam| harati--bhāraṃ harati grāmam| cakāreṇa
jayatyādayaḥ samuccīyante--śataṃ jayati devadatam, śataṃ muṣṇāti
devadatam, śataṃ daṇḍayati devadatam, karṣati grāmaṃ śākhām|
idaṃ vicāryate--dvikarmakebhyo dhātubhyaḥ karmaṇi lādaya utpadyamānāḥ
kimīpsitatame karmaṇi pradhāne utpadyante? āhosvidanena yasya
karmatvaṃ tasmin guṇakarmaṇīti? tatroktam--
pradhānakarmaṇyākhyeye lādīnāhurdvikarmaṇām|
apradhāne duhādīnāṃ ṇyante kartuśca karmaṇaḥ|| iti||
ayamarthaḥ- ye dvikarmakā dhātavasteṣāṃ pradhāne karmaṇīpsitatame vācye
lādīnāhuḥulādayo bhavantītyāhuḥ| lādayaḥulakṛtyaktakhalarthāḥ|
pradhānāpradhānayorbhinnakakṣayoryugapadabhidhānāsaṃbhave
pradhānasyaivābhidhānaṃ nyāyyam, pradhānatvādeveti bhāvaḥ| nī--nīyate
grāmamajā, neyā, nītā, sunayā| vahi--uhyate bhāro grāmam,
voḍhavyaḥ, ūḍhaḥ, suvahaḥ| hṛñ--hriyate bhāro grāmam, hartavyaḥ, hṛtaḥ,
suharaḥ| kṛṣ--kṛṣyate śākhā grāmam, kraṣṭavyā, kṛṣṭā, sukarṣā|
apradhāne duhādīnāmiti| atra daṇḍiprabhṛtayo'pi gṛhyante, na tu
duhiyācīti ślokapaṭhitā eva| eteṣāṃ duhādīnāmapradhāne
karmaṇyākhyeye lādīnāhuḥ | etadapi nyāyasiddham; yataḥ payo'rthī
pūrvaṃ gavi pravartate, ataḥ śūddhasya duhergavābhisambandhaḥ, godohena
tu payasa ityantaraṅgatvādakathitakarmaṇastatraiva lādayo bhavanti| evaṃ
sarvatra|
duhi--gaurduhyate payaḥ, dohyā, dugdhā, sudohā| yāci--pauravo
gāṃ yācyate, yācyaḥ, yācitaḥ, suyācaḥ| rudhi--vrajo'varudhyate gām,
avarodhyaḥ, avaruddhaḥ,svavarodhaḥ| pracchi--māṇavakaḥ panthānaṃ pṛcchayate,
praṣṭavyaḥ, pṛṣṭaḥ, supracchaḥ| bhikṣi--pauravo gāṃ bhikṣyate, bhikṣitavyaḥ,
bhikṣitaḥ, subhikṣaḥ| ciñ--vṛkṣo'vacīyate phalāni, avacetavyaḥ,
avacitaḥ, svavacayaḥ| brūñ--ucyate māṇavako dharmam, vaktavyaḥ, uktaḥ,
suvacaḥ| śāmu--anuśiṣyate māṇavako dharmam, anuśāsitavyaḥ,
anuśiṣṭaḥ, svanuśāsaḥ| daṇḍi--gargāḥ śataṃ daṇḍa|lnte, daśḍyāḥ,
daṇḍitāḥ, sudaṇḍāḥ| ji-śataṃ jīyate devadataḥ, jetavyaḥ, jitaḥ,
sujayaḥ| muṣi--muṣyate devadataḥ śatam, moṣitavyaḥ, muṣitaḥ,
sumoṣaḥ|
ṇyante kartuśca karmaṇa iti| abhidhāna iti śeṣaḥ| aṇyantāvasthāyāṃ
karturṇyantāvasthāyāṃ karmaṇaḥ sato'bhidhāne lādīnāhurityarthaḥ|
etaduktaṃ bhavati-ye gatyarthādayo'ṇyantāvasthāyāmapi sakarmakā
ṇyantāvasthāyāmutarasūtreṇa dvikarmakā jātāḥ, teṣu ṇyantāvasthāyāṃ
yadutarasūtreṇopajātaṃ karma tatra lādayo bhavantītyarthaḥ| gamayati
grāmaṃ devadatam, gamyate grāmaṃ devadataḥ, gamayitavyaḥ, gamitaḥ;
sugamaḥ| budhyarthaḥ- bodhyate māṇavako dharmam, bodhayitavyaḥ,
bodhitaḥ, subodhaḥ| pratyavasānārthaḥ- bhojyate māṇavaka odanam,
bhojayitavyaḥ, bhojitaḥ, subhojaḥ| śabdakarma-pāṭha|lte māṇavako
vedam, pāṭhayitavyaḥ, pāṭhitaḥ, supāṭhaḥ| akarmakaḥ- āsyate māṇavako
māsam, āsayitavyaḥ, āsitaḥ, svāsaḥ|
buddhipratyavasānārthaśabdakarmakeṣu guṇakarmaṇi lādaya iti
matāntaram| bodhyate māṇavakaṃ dharmaḥ, bhojyate māṇavakamodanaḥ,
pāṭha|lte māṇavakaṃ veda ityādi|
tadayamatra nirṇayaḥ- nīvahihṛkṛṣibhyaḥ pradhānakarmaṇi lādayaḥ;
tatsambandhasya pūrvabhāvitvāt| duhyādibhyo
jidaṇḍamuṣibhyaścāpradhāne; tatsambandhasyānantaraṅgatvāt|
buddhipratyavasānārthaśabdakarmakeṣu guṇakarmaṇi pradhāne vā yatheṣṭam;
gatyarthākarmakayoḥ hṛkrośca ṇyantayoḥ prayojye karmaṇīti|
prayojyasya ca
prādhānyenābhidhīyamānāprayojakavyāpāreṇāpyamānatvāt prādhānyam|
guṇabhūtaprayojyavyāpārakarmaṇastu guṇabhāva ārthana nyayena
prayojyavyāpāraprādhānyam, tadarthatvāt prayojakavyāpārasya|
tatprādhānyācca tatkarmaṇo'pi prādhānyamityanye| sarvathā lādayaḥ
prayojyakarmaṇīti sthitam|
akarmakāṇāṃ ca dhātūnāṃ kālabhāvādhvagantavyadeśāḥ karmasaṃjñakā
iṣyante| uktaṃ ca--ṭhkālabhāvādhvagantavyāḥ karmasaṃjñā hyakarmaṇām,
deśaścākarmakāṇāṃ tu karmasaṃjño bhavatīti vaktavyam' iti|
adhvagantavyeti--gantavyo'dhvā, adhvā gantavyaḥ, kaḍārādiṣvadhvaśabde
draṣṭavyaḥ| gantavyatvena prasiddhasya niyataparimāṇasya krośādergrahaṇārthaṃ
gantavyagrahaṇam, tenādhvānaṃ svapitīti na bhavati| nanu ca
ṭhkālādhvanoḥ' iti siddhā dvitīyā, kiṃ karmasaṃjñayā? deśasya
tāvadvaktavyā| kālādhvanorapi lādividhānārtha karmatvameṣitavyam|
āsyate māsaḥ, āsitaḥ, āsitavyaḥ,svāsaḥ| evaṃ śayyate krośa ityādi|
bhāvaḥ- godohamāste| yāvatā kālena gaurduhyate tāvantaṃ kālamāsta
ityarthaḥ| godohādīnāṃ māsādivat kālatvenāprasiddhatvādbhāvasya
pṛthag grahaṇam| deśaḥ- kurūn svapiti, kuravaḥ supyanta ityādi|
ṭhkālādhvanoratyantasaṃyoge' iti tu
sūtramakriyātyantasayogārtham--māsaṃ guḍadhānāḥ, sarvarātraṃ kalyāṇī,
krośaṃ kuṭilā nadīti| na tarhi vaktavyam--kālābhāvādhvagantavyā iti?
na vaktavyam, nātrāsirāsanamātre vartate, kiṃ tu tatpūrvake vyāpane
vartate--māsamāste | ko'rthaḥ? māsamāsanaena vyāpnotīti| evaṃ
vademadhīte, māsaṃ vedādhyayanena vyāpnotītyarthaḥ| atha ṭhkartṛ
karmaṇoḥ kṛti' iti ṣaṣṭhī dvikarmakeṣu kiṃ pradhāne karmaṇi bhavati?
āhosvid guṇe bhavati? āhosvidubhayoḥ? ubhayoriti prāptaṃ
dvitīyāvadbhāṣyakāravacanātu guṇakarmaṇi vikalpena ṣaṣṭhī|
pradhānakarmaṇi nityā--netā'śvasya strughnamiti vā|
ihākathitaṃ karmetyetāvadastu, māstu pūrvasūtradvayam,
tadviṣayasyāpyakathītatvāt, satyam; naṭasya śrṛṇotītyatra mā
bhūditi duhyādiparigaṇanamavaśyaṃ kartavyam, tasmiṃśca kriyamāṇe
odanaṃ pacati, vṛkṣamūlānyupasarpatītyatra na syāditi pūrvamapi
yogadvayamārabhyata iti||
padamañjarī
gatibuddhipratyavasānārthaśabdakarmākarmakāṇāmaṇi kartā sa ṇau|| 1|4|52
||
gamayati māṇa vakaṃ grāmamiti| kathamatra grāmasya karmatvam, yāvatā
karturīpsitatamaṃ karmetyucyate,na ca saṃprati māṇavakaḥ kartā; anena
karmasaṃjñakatvāt| tatra yathā māṣeṣvaśvaṃ badhnātītyatra vastuto
bakṣaṇenepsitatamānāmapi māṣāṇāṃ karmasaṃjñā na bhavati, tatkasya
hetoḥ? aśvasya saṃpratyakartṛtvāt, tadvadatrāpi na prāpnoti; mā
bhūṇṇicyutpanne māṇavakaḥ kartā, prāktadutpateḥ prakṛtyarthe kartā
bhavati, tadānīmeva ca grāmasyābhisambandhaḥ grāmakarmaṇyasau gamane
preṣyate--grāmaṃ gaccheti| ato yasyāmavasthāyāṃ grāmasya karmatvaṃ na
tasyāṃ māṇavakasya karmatvam, yasyāṃ ca ṇyantāvasthāyāṃ māṇavakasya
karmatvaṃ na tasyāṃ grāmasya karmatvam; pūrvapravṛtatvād|
māṣeṣvaśvamityatra tu naivaṃ saṃbhavati| yāpayatīti| ṭhyā prāpaṇe' ityatra
prāptyā gatirlakṣyataiti yātirgatyarthaḥ|
nīvahyaeriti| nanvetayorgatiphalaṃ prāpaṇamartho na gatiḥ, ṭhna
gatihiṃsārthebhyaḥ' ityatra ca bhāṣyam--na ṭhvahirgatyarthaḥ' iti, satyam;
guṇabhāvenāpi gatiḥ pratīyata iti matvā pratiṣedha uktaḥ|
vaheraniyantṛkasyeti| vakṣyāmīti copakṣepaḥ| vāhayati
balīvardānyavānityatrāṇau balīvardāḥ kartāraḥ, ṇyante tu niyantā
sārathiḥ kartāḥ, tatra pratiṣedhapratiṣedhādvidhireva bhavati|
budhyarthagrahaṇena jñānamātravācināmeva grahaṇam, na tu
tadviśeṣavācināṃ smaratyādīnāmityāhuḥ| vṛtāvapi
tathaivodāhṛtam|
ādikhādyoriti| apara āha--sarvameva pratyavasānakāryamaderna bhavati,
nāvaśyamiyameva karmasaṃjñeti ṭhnigaraṇacalanārthebhyaśca' iti padamapi na
bhavati, idamekamiṣyate--ṭhkte'dhikaraṇe ca
dhrauvyagatipratyavasānārthebhyaḥ'--idameṣāṃ jagdhamiti|
bhakṣeriti| gatyarthādiṣu prāyeṇa hetumaṇṇica eva saṃbhavād
hetumaṇṇico vidhiriti pratiṣedho'pi pratyāsatestasyaiva nyāyya
iti curādiṇijanto'pyaṇyantaeveti bhakṣeḥ prāptiḥ| bhakṣayati
balīvardān sasyamiti| kṣetrasthānāṃ yavānāṃ bhakṣyamāṇānāṃ hisā
bhavati, tasyāmavasthāyāṃ kaiściccaitanyābhyupagamāt| svāmino vā
hisā draṣyavyā|
iha karmaśabdena kvacitkriyā gṛhyate, yathā--ṭhkartari karmavyatīhāre'
iti, kvacit sādhanakarmā--ṭhveḥ śabdakarmaṇaḥ' iti, iha
śabdakriyāṇāmiti cet? ṭhhvayatyādīnāṃ pratiṣedhaḥ'--hvayati putraṃ
devadataḥ, hvāpayati putraṃ devadatena; krandati putraṃ devadataḥ,
krandayati putraṃ devadatena; śabdāyate devadataḥ, śabdāyayate
devadatena| akarmakatvādathātra prasaṅgaḥ, śabdalakṣaṇakasya
karmaṇo'ntarbhāvāt karmāntarāyogācca|
ṭhśrṛṇoteścopasaṅkhyānam' --aśabdakriyatvāt śrṛṇoti ślokaṃ
devadataḥ, śrāvayati ślokaṃ devadatam; na ca budhyarthatvādatra siddhiḥ,
cetatyādayo hi jñānamātravacanā budhyarthāḥ| astu tarhi sādhanakarmaṇo
grahaṇam, śabdakarmaṇa iti cet? jalpatiprabhṛtīnāmupasaṃkhyānam,
jalpati putraṃ devadataḥ, jalpayati putraṃ devadatam; vilapati putraṃ
devadataḥ, vilāpayati putraṃ devadatam; ābhāṣate putraṃ devadataḥ
ābhāṣayati putraṃ devadatam| ddaśeḥ sarvatra, yadyapi kriyāgrahaṇam
athāpi sādhanagrahaṇam, athāpyubhayagrahaṇam-sarvathā ddaśerupasaṃkhyānam|
paśyati rūpatarka kārṣāpaṇam, darśayati rūpatarkṃa kārṣāpaṇam| yadā
cāyaṃddaśiḥ cakṣuḥ sādhanake jñānaviśeṣe vartate tadetadvaktavyam;
jñānamātravacanatve tu budhyarthatvādeva siddham; tadevamubhayorapi
pakṣayorddoṣāntaṃ bhāṣyaṃ nānyataraḥ pakṣo niraṇāyi| 
vṛttikārastu ye śabdakriyāḥ śabdasādhanakarmāṇaśca
tānavivādasiddhānudāharativacanena bodhayatītyarthaḥ| emanyatrāpi|
tatra buddhyarthatvādeva siddham| yadyapyanyā buddhiranyā bodhanā,
upasarjanībhūtāpi tāvadbuddhirastīti buddharthatvamastyeva,
upasarjanībhūto'pi ca gatyādirartho gṛhyate, anyathā
gamayatītyādīnāmagatyarthatvādevāprasaṅgādaṇigrahaṇamanarthakaṃ
syāditi, astu cetanaviṣaye, evamacetanaviṣaye katham? yaḥ
kaṃcijjalpati tamanyo jalpayati, na hyatra prabodhanāpyasti|
akarmakāṇāmiti|
kālabhāvādhvagantavyadeśavyatiriktakarmarahitānāmityartho'tra grāhyaḥ,
anyathā māsamāste devadataḥ, māsamāsayati devadatam,
godohamāsayati, krośamāsayati, kurūnāsayatītyatra na syāt;
kālādikarmaṇā sakarmakatvāt| evaṃ ṭhlaḥ karmaṇi ca' ityādāvapi
yatrākarmakagrahaṇaṃ tatra sarvatra draṣṭavyam, tena māsamāsyate
devadatenatyādau bhāve lādayaḥ siddhā bhavanti| uktañca--siddhaṃ tu
kālakarmaṇākarmakatvadvacanāditi| kālagrahaṇamupalakṣaṇam|
vatkaraṇātsvāśrayamapi bhavati--māsa āsyate devadatena--māsakarmaṇi
lo bhavati| sa tarhyakarmakavacanād bhāve vaktavyaḥ? na vaktavyaḥ;
akarmakāṇāmityucyate, na ca kālādibhiḥ kecidakarmakāḥ|
kālādibhirapyakarmakāḥ yadā te na vivakṣyante, tadyathā--śete
devadato na bhuṅkte iti| nāpyavivakṣitakarmāṇo'karmakāḥ, kiṃ tarhi?
ye'tyantāvidyamānakarmāṇo dhātavo'karmakāḥ, nārthāḥ| yasya dhātoḥ
svarūpāvadhikamakarmakatvam, na ca kālādikarmakāḥ, nārthāḥ| yasya
dhātoḥ svarūpāvadhikamakarmakatvam, na ca kālādikarmaṇā
svarūpāvadhikamakarmakatvaṃ kasyāpi sambhavatīti
sāmarthyātadvyatiriktena karmaṇā'karmakatvaṃ vijñāyate| kimarthaṃ
punaridamucyate, yāvatā svavyāpāre svatantrasyāpi prayojyasya
prayojakavyāpāre vivakṣite tena pradhānabhūtenāpyamānatvād
antaraṅgatvena pūrvapravṛtāmapi kartṛ saṃjñāṃ bādhitvā karmasaṃjñā
bhaviṣyatīti? evaṃ tarhi siddhe satyārambho
niyamārthaḥ-prayojakavyāpāreṇāpyamānasya yadi bhavati
ganyarthādīnāmeva, nānyeṣāmiti| tena pācayatyodanaṃ devadato
yajñadatenetyatra pūrvaṃ pravṛtāyā eva kartṛ saṃjñāyā avasthānāt
kartari tṛtiyā bhavati| uktaṃ ca--
guṇakriyāyāṃ svātantryātpreṣaṇe karmatāṃ gataḥ|
niyamāt karmasaṃjñāyāḥ svadharmeṇābhidhīyate|| iti|
kartuḥ svadharmārtṛtīyā| atha katham--
ayacitāraṃ na hi devadevamadriḥ sutāṃ grāhayituṃ śaśāka| iti?
svatantrāḥ kavayaḥ| yadvā--sutāṃ prati kiñcidudvāhaviṣaye grāhayituṃ
bodhayituṃ na śaśāketyevaṃ vyākhyeyam; tatra budhyarthatvāt
siddham||
padamañjarī
hṛkroranyatarasyām|| 1|4|53 ||
gatyarthādayo nivṛtāḥ tenobhayatra vibhāṣeyam| yadā haratirgatau
vartate-harati bhāraṃ devadata iti, abhyavahāre vā-abhyavaharati
māṇavakamodanamiti| karotiścāpyakarmakaḥ- odanasya pūrṇāḥ chātrāḥ
vikurvata iti, tadā pūrveṇa prāpte| nanu ṭhanantarasya vidhirvā bhavati
pratiṣedho vā' iti niyamasyaiva vikalpo yuktaḥ, gatyarthādiṣveveti
yo'yaṃ niyamaḥ sa ṭhhṛkroranyatarasyām' iti, tataśca pakṣe
niyamābhāvāt gatyādyarthādanyatra pakṣe karmatvaṃ pakṣāntare ca kartṛ tvaṃ
bhavatu, gatyādyarthatve tu nityavat karmasaṃjñā prāpnoti| evaṃ tarhi
vārtikakāreṇa ubhayatravibhāṣāsviyaṃ paṭhitā, tatsāmarthyādanantarasya
vidhiriti nāśrīyate, aviśeṣeṇa hṛkrorvikalpaḥ pravartate| 
abhivādiddaśoriti| abhivādayateraprāpte vibhāṣā
ddaśerbudhyarthatvāt ddaśeḥ sarvatreti vā prāpte| abhivādayate iti|
ṭhṇicaśca' ityātmanepadam| parasmaipade tu abhivādayati guruṃ
devadeteneti kartṛ saṃjñaiva bhavati|
darśayate iti| karmasaṃjñābhāvapakṣe karmāntarasyābhāvāt ṭhṇeraṇau'
ityātmanepadam, anyatra tu ṭhṇicaśca' iti||
padamañjarī
svatantraḥ kartā|| 1|4|54 ||
svatantraśabdo'yaṃ tantuvāyavacano'pyasti--svaṃ tantramasya svatantraḥ,
vitatāstantavassvatantramityucyate; asti ca sādhāraṇadravye puruṣe
vartate sādhāraṇaṃ bhavetantram, svaṃ dhanaṃ tantraṃ sādhāraṇamasya
svatantraḥ; asti ca pradhānavacanaḥ- sva ātmā tantraṃ pradhānamasya svatantra
iti| tatrādyayorgrahaṇe tayorapādānādiviṣaye kartṛsaṃjñā syāt,
paratvādviśeṣavihitatvācca tantuvāyādāgacchatītyādau; iha ca na
syāt-devadato gacchatīti, idamādyayorgrahaṇe doṣaṃ ddaṣṭvā
tṛtīyamarthamāśrityāha--svatantra iti| pradhānabhūta ucyata iti|
svatantraśabdasya tatraiva prasiddhataratvāditi bhāvaḥ| kiṃ ca
kārakadhikārāt kriyāviṣayaṃ svātantryaṃ gṛhyate, na ca
tantuvāyastantuvāyatayā kriyāyāmupayujyate, kiṃ tarhi?
pradhānatayaiveti tadvācina eva grahaṇaṃ yuktam| yadi pradhānabhūta ucyate,
evaṃ satyapradhānāpekṣatvāt pradhānabhāvasya yatrādhikaraṇādīnyapradhānāni
kārakāṇi santi--kāṣṭhèaḥ sthālyāmodanaṃ pacatīti atraivaḥ syāt; na
tvāste śete ityādāvityaśaṅkya prādhānyenāguṇabhāvo lakṣyata iti
darśayati--aguṇībhūta iti| tena yasya guṇabhāvo nāsti, sa kartā|
kārakāntarāvivakṣāyāmapa cāguṇibhāvo'styeva| kaḥ punaratra
kārakāṇāṃ guṇaguṇibhāvaḥ? yadā ekāpāye'pi kriyā na nirvartate,
uktamatra--
prāganyataḥ śaktilābhānnyagbhāvāpādanādapi|
tadadhīnapravṛttitvāt pravṛtānāṃ nivartanāt||
addaṣṭatvātpratinidheḥ praviveke'pi darśanāt|
ārādapyupakāritvāt svātantryaṃ karturiṣyate || iti|
kāṣṭhādīni kartrā pravartitāni karaṇādiśaktiṃ pratilabhante, kartā tu
prāgeva| kartṛ saṃnidhau ca karaṇādini nyagbhavanti, tadadhīne ca
teṣāṃ pravṛttinivṛtī| pradhānakartṛśca pratinidhirna ddaṣṭaḥ,
karaṇādīnāṃ tu ddaṣṭaḥ-vrīhyapacāre nīvārairijyate| pravivekaḥu
abhāvaḥ| karaṇādyabhāve'pyāste, śete ityādau kevalaḥ kartā ddaśyate, na
tu karturabhāve karaṇādīni ddaśyante|
ārādapyupakāritvāditi| yadyapyasau taṭasthaḥ phalasiddhāvupakaroti, na
tu karaṇādivadanupraviśya tathāpītyarthaḥ| etacca prāyeṇa cetaneṣveva
sambhavati, nācetaneṣu--ratho yātītyādau, naiṣa doṣaḥ; uktalakṣaṇe
kartari dvayaṃ ddaṣṭam--pradhānyam,āguṇabhāvaśca| tatrāguṇabhāvaḥ
acetaneṣu cetaneṣvapi sambhavati| sa cāyamaguṇabhāvo na
pratiniyataviṣayaḥ, yasyaiva tu vivakṣyate,
tasyaivetyāha--svātantryeṇa vivakṣyata iti| vivakṣyata
ityasyodāharaṇam--sthālī pacatīti|
anye tu vyācakṣate--aguṇabhāvenābhidhīyamānavyāpāro guṇabhūto
guṇabhūtadhātūpātavyāpāraḥ kartetyarthaḥ| kasya ca vyāpāro
dhātunā'guṇabhāvenopādīyate? yasya vivakṣyate tasyeti sarvatra
siddhamiti||
padamañjarī
tatprayojako hetuśca|| 1|4|55 ||
tadityanenana kartā sambaddhyate iti| kartṛ saṃjñāviśiṣṭaḥ svatantra
ityarthaḥ| nanu ca prayojakasannidhau prayojyasya pāratantryaṃ kartṛ sanni
dhāviva karaṇādīnām, tatkathaṃ svatantraḥ parāmṛśyate? kathantarāṃ ca
kartṛ saṃjñāviśiṣṭaḥ? kathantamāṃ ca pācayatyodanaṃ devadato
yajñadateneti? prayojye tṛtīyā bhavati, pūrvameva ca svatantrasya
kartṛḥ sataḥ prayuktirapi kimarthā? māyaṃ viraṃsīditi prayuṅkte
iti ced, bhavatvevaṃ pravṛtapravartane, yatra tu balātkāreṇa pravartyate
tatra katham? ucyate; apravṛtapravartane'pi yāvatsvārthādarśanāt
prayojye na pravartate tāvatprayojakaḥ pācayatīti na vyapadiśyate,
tadānīmapi ca smṛtyārūḍhā prayuktirvidyata iti anuvartamānā hi prasaktiḥ
prayojyasyāphalaniṣpateḥ pravṛtau heturna madhye vicchinnā|
loḍādivācyastu praiṣaḥ prayojyasyā pravṛtāvapi bhavati| uktaṃ ca--
dravyamātrasya tu praiṣe pṛcchāderloḍ vidhīyate|
pravṛtasya yadā praiṣastadā sa viṣayo ṇicaḥ|| iti|
tadevaṃ ṇijvācyā prayuktiḥ pravṛtapravartanārūpeṇa pratīyata iti
prakṛtyarthe kartṛḥ sataḥ prayojaka ityaviruddham| imameva cārtha
darśayituṃ tacchabdopādānam; anyathā kasya prayojaka ityapekṣāyām,
prakṛtatvādeva svatantrasya prayojaka iti lābhādanarthakaṃ tat syāt|
tasya prayojakastatprayojaka iti| nanu ṭhtṛjakābhyāṃ kartari'ṭhkartari
ca' 
nnnnntiṣedhāt kathamatra samāsa ityata āha-nipātanātsamāpta iti| atra
vicannnnnnpāsaprakaraṇa eva vicārayiṣyāmaḥ|
saṃjñāsamāveśārthaścakāra iti| asati hi tasmin ekasaṃjñādhikārāt
kartṛ saṃjñā na syāt| kurvāṇaṃ prayuṅkte iti| kurvāṇadaśāyāṃ yā
prayuktiḥ smṛtyārūḍhā, saiva ṇijvācyetyevaṃ vigrahaḥ|
hetutvādityādinā samāveśasya prayojanaṃ darśayati||
padamañjarī
prāgīśvarānnipātāḥ|| 1|4|56 ||
prāgrīśvarānnipātāḥ|| prāci kāle deśe vā prāk| adhirīśvare iti
vakṣyatīti| īśvaraprakṛtibhāgasya pūrvapadāntena repheṇa sahānukaraṇaṃ
draṣṭavyam| anukāryeṇārthenārthavatvāt vibhaktyatpatiḥ, ca vā ityatra
nipātatve sati ṭhsvarādinipātamavyam' ityavyayasaṃjñā bhavati|
ṭhnipātā ādyaudātāḥ' iti tu svaro na bhavati,
udāhṛtānāmanudātānāṃ gaṇe pāṭhāt| anyeṣāṃ tu tadapi bhavati|
nanu yathā ṭhpratyayaḥ' ityādiradhikāro
vināpyavadhinirdeśenābhimataviṣaye pravartate, tathāyamapi
pravartiṣyate, nipātāḥ' ityevāstu, nārtho'vadhinirdeśenetyata āha--
prāgvacanamiti| prāgvacanadvāreṇāvaghinirdeśasya prayojanamuktam|
ayamarthaḥ- asatyavadhinirdeśe ṭhnipātāḥ' ityasya pratiyogamanuvṛtau
satyāmapyekasaṃjñādhikārāt paryāyaḥ syāt, na tu samāveśaḥ; sati
tu tasmin īśvarāt prāgyāvantaḥ saṃjñinaḥ sarvāstānnaikadhyamihāpekṣya
sakṛtsaṃjñā vidhīyate, pratisūtramadhikārātvaparāvṛttiḥ, tasyāśca
samāveśaḥ prayojanamiti|
atha vā prāgvacanaṃ kimartham, yāvatā pañcamyeva prāgiti
dikśabde'dhyāhariṣyate, parāgityasya tvadhyāhāro na bhaviṣyati,
ṭhcādayo'satve' ,ṭhprādayaḥ'
ityanayorvidheyāsambhavenānarthakyaprasaṅgāt? ata
āha--prāgvacanamiti| ayaṃ bhāvaḥ- adhyāhāreṇa siddhe
prāggrahaṇasāmarthyātantreṇa dvau prākcchabdāvuccāryete| tenāyamartho
bhavati--prāgrīśvarādye vyavasthitāste prāk nipātasaṃjñā bhavanti,
nipātāḥ santo gatyādisaṃjñā iti| tena nimitameva nipātasaṃjñā
gatyādisaṃjñānāmiti samāveśasiddhiriti|
rīśvarāditi saha repheṇānukaraṇe prayojanamāha--rīśvarādvīśvarānmā
bhūditi| rīśvarādityucyate, ṭhadhirīśvare'
ityayamīśvaraśabdo'vadhiryathā syāt,ṭhśakiṇyamulkamulau' ṭhīśvare
tomunkasunau' ityayaṃ mā bhūd ityevamarthamityarthaḥ| yadā saṃhītayā
sūtrāṇi paṭha|lnte, tadā śīśvaraśabdo'stītyabhipretya
rīśvarādityuktam| jñāpakāt, siddham, yadayaṃ ṭhkṛnmejantaḥ' iti
kṛto māntasyaijantasya vā'vyayasaṃjñāṃ śāsti, tajjñāpayati--anantara
īśvaraśabdo'vadhirna vyavahita iti, anyathā sesenprabhṛtīnāṃ
ṇamulkamulośca nipātatvādevāvyayasaṃjñāyāḥ siddhatvādanarthakaṃ
tatsyāt? naitadasti jñāpakam, kṛnmejantaḥ paro'pi saḥ, ṭhīśvare
tosunkasunau' ityasmātparo'pi kṛnmānta ejantaścasti kṛtyārthe
tavaikenityādyejantaḥ, ṇamulādiśca māntaḥ, tadarthametat syāt|
yatarhyavyayībhāvasyāvyayatvaṃ śāsti, tajjñāpayati--anantarasya
grahaṇamiti; anyathā dvitīye nipātasaṃjñāvyāpārād avyayībhāvasya
nipātatvādevāvyayasaṃjñāyāḥ siddhatvādanarthakaṃ tatsyāt, naitadasti;
ṭhsamāseṣvavyayībhāvaḥ' tulyajātīyavyāvṛtaye niyamārthametatsyāt,
na tvanantarasya grahaṇe jñāpakamityarthaḥ| evaṃ tarhi
laukikanyāyādevānantarasya grahaṇaṃ bhaviṣyati, laukike
hyaedakāntātpriyaṃ prāpyamanuvrajediti ya evānantara udakānta ā
tato'nuvrajya bāndhavā nivartante tadvadatrāpi? tatrāha--laukikaṃ
cātivartate iti| laukikaṃ nyāyaṃ loka evātivartate; yato
dvitīyamapyudakāntaṃ snohātiśayādanuvrajya nivartante
tasmādrīśvarādityucyate vīśvarānmā bhūditi sthitam| nanu ca ṭhna
lokāvyaya' ityatra lokādīnāmavyayatvādeva ṣaṣṭhīpratiṣedhe siddhe
punarupādānaṃ jñāpakaṃ bhaviṣyatī--anantarasya grahaṇamiti, naitadasti;
avyayasaṃjñāyā evābhāvaṃ jñāpayet, nipātasaṃjñā tu syādeva; tataśca
cikīrṣvartha ityādauṭhnipāta ekājanāṅ' iti pragṛhyasaṃjñā syātu|
prothamiti| paryāptamityarthaḥ| ṭhprotha yaryāptau', pacādyaci
kriyāviśeṣaṇatvānnapuṃsakatvam||
padamañjarī
cādayo'satve|| 1|4|57 ||
na cetsatve vartate iti| satve ced vartate tadā saṃjñā na
bhavatītyarthastadāha--prasajyapratiṣedho'yamiti| atha paryudāse ko
doṣaḥ? paśuśabde'tra paṭha|lte sā jātiviśiṣṭe dravye vartate, tasya
nipātatvaṃ syāt, jātidravyasamudāyarūpo hyarthaḥ kevalādanyo
bhavati; tathā prādaya ityatra viprātīti vipraḥ, ṭhātaścopasarge' iti kaḥ|
atra praśabdaḥ kriyāviśiṣṭe dravye vartate| tatra kriyādravyasamudāyasya
dravyādanyatvānnipātvānnipātatve satyavyayasaṃjñāyāṃ
tadantavidherabhyupagamāt vipraśabdasyāvyayasaṃjñā syāt,
prasajyapratiṣedhe tu yatra dravyagandhastatra sarvatra pratiṣedho bhavati| kva
tarhi vartamānaḥ paśuśabde'satvavacano bhavati? ddaśyarthe, lodhaṃ nayanti
paśu manyamānā ityatra ddaśyarthena mananaṃ
viśeṣyate--darśanametanmananam, samyak manyamānā ityarthaḥ|
satvaśabdo'yaṃ sato bhāvaḥ satvamiti satājātivacano gṛhyata iti
bhrāntimapanayati--satvamiti ca dravyamucyate iti| idaṃ taditi
sarvanāmaparāmarśayogyaṃ vastu dravyamucyate| uktañca--
vastupalakṣaṇaṃ yatra sarvanāma prayujyate|
dravyamityucyate so'rtho bhedyatvena vivakṣitaḥ|| iti|
svārtheneti śeṣaḥ| siddharūpo yo'rthaḥ svārthena viśeṣyatayā
vivakṣitastad dravyamityarthaḥ| uktaṃ ca--
svārthasta yatra viśrāntirvācyaṃ dravyaṃ taducyate| iti|
evaṃ ca kṛtvā--sīdati, niviśate yatra jātyādikaṃ
śabdapravṛttinimitaṃ viśeṣaṇabhāveneti satvaṃ dravyam|
saderauṇādikastvaprakyayaḥ ṭhtābhyāmānyatroṇādayaḥ'
ityadhikaraṇasādhanaḥ| caṇiti paṭha|lte, sa cedarthe vartate,
ṇakāraścaṇkaccidyatrayuktamiti viśeṣaṇārthaḥ| naño ñakāraḥ ṭhnalopo
nañaḥ' iti viśeṣaṇārthaḥ| nalopo nasyetyucyamāne vāmanaputraḥ-
atrāpi prāpnoti? pākṣika eṣa doṣaḥ; ṭhalugutarapade' iti vartate,
tatra yadotarapadenākṣiptaṃ pūrvapadaṃ nasya viśeṣaṇam, tadā
pūrvapadabhūtasya nasya lopa ityucyamāne naivātra prāpnoti, naśabdena
pūrvapade viśeṣyamāṇe tadantavidhisadbhāvādatrāpi syāt|
athāsminpakṣe ṭhnañaḥ' ityucyamāne'pi straiṇaputra ityatra nañaḥ kasmānna
bhavati? atulyatvātpratyayasya ñakāro vṛddhisvarayoścaritārthaḥ,
nipātasya tvacaritārthaḥ| tatheti paṭha|lte, so'vyutpannaḥ samuccaye
vartate, tasya tu thālantasya litsvareṇādyaudātatvaṃ siddham|
avyayatvamapi ṭhtaddhitaścasarvavibhaktiḥ' ityeva siddham|
nanvavyutpannasyāpi vibhaktapratirūpakā ityeva siddham, satyam;
prapañcārthaḥ pāṭhaḥ| evaṃ velāyām, mātrāyāmityāderapi|
svarapratirūpakā iti| ṛti ṛ vā vacanamityādayaḥ, teṣāṃ
nipātasaṃjñāvidhānadvāreṇa sadbhāva eva pratipādyate, na punareṣāṃ
nipātatve kiñcitprayojanamastīti||
padamañjarī
prādayaḥ|| 1|4|58 ||
ayaṃ yoga utarasmādvibhajyate, pūrvasmācca; yadi punaḥṭhprādaya
upasargāḥ kriyāyoge' ityucyate, naivaṃ
śakyamityāha-pṛthagyogakaraṇamiti| utarasyā upasargasaṃjñāyā eva
ṭhkriyāyoge' iti viśeṣaṇaṃ yathā syāt, nipātasaṃjñāyāṃ mā
bhūdityevamarthamutarasmād yogādasya vibhāga ityarthaḥ| atha
vā--cādiṣveva prādīnapi paṭhitvā pūrvasmādyogāt kimartha
vibhajyate, tatrāpyāha--upasargāḥ kriyāyoga iti| vādīnāmiti|
calopo'tra draṣṭavya iti ca--vadīnāmiti| parā jayanti senā iti|
parā utkuṣṭāḥ| paradeśasthitā vā dravyatvātatra vartamānasya
parāśabdasya na bhavati, yatra tvekavacanaṃ paṭha|lte--parā jayati seneti,
tatra rūpodāharaṇaṃ draṣṭavyam; halṅyābiti sulopāt,
parāśabdasyādyaudātatvācca||
padamañjarī
upasargāḥ kriyāyoge|| 1|4|59 ||
kriyāyoge iti tṛtīyā, nipātanāt samāsaḥ, ṭhkartṛ karaṇe kṛtā'
iti bahulavacanādvā| yadvā--kriyayā karaṇabhūtayā prādīnāṃ
dhātubhiryogāt karaṇe tṛtīyayā eva samāsaḥ| praṇayatīti|
ṭhupasargādasamāse'pi iti ṇatvam| pranāyaka iti| nanvatrāpi
gamikriyāyogo'styeva, satyam; prādayaḥ punarevamātmakāḥ, yaduta
śrutāyāṃ kriyāyāṃ tāmeva viśiṃṣanti, aśrutāyāṃ tu sasādhanāṃ
kriyāmākṣipanti| tatra kriyāyogagrahaṇasāmarthyād yatkriyāyuktāḥ
prādayastaṃ pratyupasargasaṃjñā bhavatītyayamartho bhavati| atra ca
yatkriyāyuktaḥ prādiḥ sa gamirna prayujyate, yaśca prayujyate na
tatkriyāyukta iti nāsti ṇatvaprasaṅgaḥ|
marucchabdasyeti| upasargasaṃjñaiveṣyate, na nipātasaṃjñā| tasyāṃ hi
satyāṃ nipātādyaudātatvamṭhtṛtīyā karmaṇi' iti
pūrvapadaprakṛtisvareṇa syāt, antodātaśca marutaśabda iṣyate|
nanūpasargasaṃjñāyāmapi ṭhupasargāścābhivarjam' ityādyaudātatvaṃ
syādeva, na; nānenāpūrvamādyaudātatvaṃ vidhīyate, kiṃ tarhi?
ṭhnipātāḥ' ityeva siddhe'theḥ pratiṣedhārthametat| kiṃ ca
nipātasaṃjñāyāmavyayasaṃjñā syāt| atha ṭhupasarge dhoḥ
kiḥ'ṭhātaścopasarge' ityetau vidhī kasmānna bhavataḥ? anabhidhānāt|
maruta iti| marucchabdatakārasya ṭhanaci ca' iti dvirvacane ṭhjharo jhari'
iti madhyamasya madhyamayormadhyamānāṃ vā lope trairūpyaṃ bhavati, kathaṃ
punaratra tatvam, yāvatāyamanajanta ityata
āha--saṃjñāvidhānasāmarthyāditi| uktaḥ prayojanāntarābhāvaḥ| evaṃ tu
marunnayatīti takāravyavāye'pi ṇatvaṃ prāproti
tasmātatvavidhāveveṣyate|
śracchabdasyeti| aṅvidhāveveṣyate, kipratyayo hi na bhavati,
tadāha--ātaścopasarge iti| bhidādipāṭhāt ṭhprajñāśraddhārcā' iti
nipātanādvā siddham||
padamañjarī
gatiśca|| 1|4|60 ||
ṭhgatiranantaraḥ' iti puṃlliṅganirdeśād gamyata iti gatiḥ,
ṭhkticktau ca saṃjñāyām' iti kticama, nipātanācca ṭhna ktici dīrdhaśca'
iti na bhavati| prakṛtyeti| atra gatitvāt kṛtsvaro bhavati,
samāsastu prāditvādeva siddhaḥ| prādibhyo'nyatra samāso'pi
prayojanam| prakṛtamiti| ṭhgatiranantaraḥ' iti pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaraḥ|
yat prakarotīti| tiṅlakṣaṇasya nighātasya ṭhnipātairyadyadi' iti
niṣedhe tipaḥ pitvādanudātatvam, vikaraṇasya pratyayasvaro dhātoḥ
śeṣanighātaḥ, ṭhtiṅcodātivati' iti praśabdasyānudātatvam| etacca
prayojanacatuṣṭayaṃ gatisaṃjñā prakaraṇe sarvatra draṣṭavyam|
cakāraḥ saṃjñāsamāveśārtha iti| anyathaikasaṃjñādhikārādekatra
saṃjñādvayavidhānācca paryāyaḥ syāditi bhāvaḥ| kārikāśabdasyeti|
kārikā kriyā maryādāsthitirityarthaḥ| yatna ityapare, dhātvarthanirdeśa
iti ṇvul| yastu kartari kārikāśabdaḥ kārikā dāsīti, yacca
ślokavācī--tayorgrahaṇaṃ na bhavati; kriyāyogagrahaṇena
kārikāśabdasya viśeṣaṇāt kriyāvṛtargrahaṇāt| yatkārikāṃ
karotīti| nipātatvādavyayatve sati vibhakterluk|
punarutsyūtamiti| gatitvātsamāsaḥ| ṭhgatirgatau' iti nighāto
bhavatīti| yadyapyatra ṭhpravṛddhādīnāṃ ca' ityutarapadāntodātatvena
śeṣanighātaḥ siddhaḥ, tathāpi paratvādayameva nighāto yukta iti bhāvaḥ|
iha ca punarādheyamiti| gatitvātsamāse kṛte
kṛdutarapadaprakṛtisvareṇaṭhyato'nāvaḥ' iti dheyaśabda ādyaudātaḥ|
canohita iti| nipātatvādādyaudātasya canaḥśabdasya ṭhgatiranantaraḥ'
iti prakṛtisvaraḥ||
padamañjarī
ūryādicviḍācaśca|| 1|4|61 ||
cvyantā ḍājantāśceti| yadyapi padasaṃjñāyāmantagrahaṇena ṭhsaṃjñāvidhau
pratayayagrahaṇe tadantavidhirnāsti' iti jñāpitam,
tathāpiṭhkriyāyoge' ityanuvṛtestadantagrahaṇamiti bhāvaḥ| na hi
pratyayamātrasya kriyāyogaḥ sambhavati, svārthikatvena
svayamanarthakatvāt, cveraśrāvitvācca| kṛbhvastiyoga iti| na
kevalam, saṃjñāprayogo'pyanyatra bhavati, na hi bhavati urīsaṃpadyate
iti, śrauṣaḍādīnāṃ svāhāparyantānāṃ cādiṣu pāṭhād
akriyāyoge'pi nipātatvam| āviḥśabdasya sākṣātprabhṛtiṣu pāṭhāt
kṛño yoge vikalpaḥ, kṛbhvastiyoge tvanena nityam| kathaṃ tarhi
ṭhāviścakṣuṣo'bhavadasāviva rāgaḥ', ṭhabhavan yugapadvilolajihvā
