yugalīḍhobhayasṛkkadhāramāviḥ iti? svatantrā kavayaḥ| śuklīkṛtyeti|
ṭhasya cvau' itītvam| paṭapaṭāśabdaḥ ṭhvā kyaṣaḥ' ityatra vyutpāditaḥ||
padamañjarī
anukaraṇaṃ cānitiparam|| 1|4|62 ||
itiḥ paro yasmāditi| pañcamīsamāsastu lakṣaṇābhāvānnāśritaḥ|
teneti khāṭkṛtyetyatra iteḥ paratve'pi bhavati| khāḍiti kṛtvā
niraṣṭhīvaditi| atrāsati pratiṣedhe gatisaṃjñāyāṃ samāsaḥ syāt,
dhātoścānantaraḥ prayoga iti rūpamevaitanna sidhyet| ṭhṣṭhivu
nirasane', ṭhṣṭhivuklamucamāṃ śiti' iti dīrghaḥ| bhūtakālopanyāsaḥ
kimarthaḥ? kasyacitkaverayaṃ prayoga udāhṛtaḥ-
ṭhcumbanasaktaḥ so'syāḥ cyutamūlaṃ daśanamātmano vadane|
jihvāmūlaspṛṣṭṃa khāḍiti kṛtvā niraṣṭhīvat||'
padamañjarī
ādarānādarayoḥ sadasatī|| 1|4|63 ||
prītisaṃbhrama iti| prītipūrvikā pratyutthānādiviṣayā tvaretyarthaḥ|
paribhavaudāsīnyamiti| avajñayā kartavyaṃ pratyatthānādika
pratyupekṣetyarthaḥ| asadanādaragrahaṇaṃ kimartham? asatkṛtyetyatrāpi
yathā syāt| mā bhūdasacchabdasya gatisaṃjñā, satkṛtyetyanena
nañsamāso bhaviṣyati? naivaṃ śakyam; sati śiṣṭatvāt
kṛdutarapadaprakṛtisvaraṃ bādhitvā
avyayapūrvapadaprakṛtisvareṇādyaudātatvaṃ syād| asatkṛtamityatra tu
satkṛtaśabde ṭhgatiranantaraḥ' iti svare pravṛte praścānnañsamāse'pi
tasyeva svaraḥ| asacchabdasyāpi kṛtaśabdenāpi samāse tasya
nipātatvādādyaudātasya gatitvātprakṛtibhāve'pi sa eva svara iti
nāsti viśeṣaḥ| iha ca yadāsatkarotītyasacchabdasya nighāto na
syād, avyayasaṃjñāpi tasya na syādityasacchabdasyaiva gatinipātasaṃjñe
eṣitavye| na cātra sacchabdena tadantavidhirlabhyate;
viśeṣyasyābhāvāt|
nanvatra sacchabdasyaiva saṃjñāstu, kāryapradeśeṣu prakṛtasya tena
tadantavidhirbhaviṣyati, avyasaṃjñāyāṃ tāvadastyeva
tadantavidhiḥ-paramoccairiti, yathā ṭhkugatiprādayaḥ' ityatrāpi
subiti pravartate, supetyeva nivṛtam, tadratinā viśeṣyate
ṭhgatiranantaraḥ' ityatra pūrvapadam ṭhgatirgatau' ityatrāpi padasyeti
prakṛtam| bhavatu tadantavidhinā kāryam, anādarāvagatistu kutaḥ?
asatyanādaragrahaṇe, na sadasadityādaraniṣedhānnaiva śakyam,
ādaraprasaṅga eva hi syāt, gurumasatkṛtyeti
cāṇḍālamasatkṛtyetyatra na syāt| yathā'brāhmaṇa iti
kṣatriyādirevocyate, na loṣṭādiḥ, anādaragrahaṇe tu sati
bahuvrīhirvijñāyate--avidyāmānādaro'nādara iti|
bahuvrīhiścātyantābhāve, prasaktābhāve, aprasaktābhāve ca bhavatīti
sarvatra saṃjñā sidhyati, tasmādanādaragrahaṇaṃ kartavyam| asadgrahaṇaṃ
tu śakyamakartum| ādarānādarayoḥ sadityevāstu, tatra yathā
goṣpadaṃ sevityatrāsevite goṣpadaśabdo na
saṃbhavatītyagoṣpadārthamasevitagrahaṇam; evamanādare'pi sacchabdo na
sambhavatītyasacchabdārthamānadaragrahaṇaṃ bhaviṣyati|
satkṛtvā, asatkṛtveti| śobhanavacano vidyamānavacano vā sacchabdaḥ
tadviparītavacano'sacchabdaḥ||
padamañjarī
bhūṣaṇe'lam|| 1|4|64 ||
alamiti pratiṣedha ityādi| tadyathā alaṃ--kṛtvā, alaṃ bhoktum, alaṃ
bhuṅkte, alaṃ karoti kanyāmiti||
padamañjarī
antaraparigrahe|| 1|4|65 ||
antarhatvā, madhye hatvetyarthaḥ| antaḥ śabdasyetyādi|
upasargasaṃjñāyāmevaitannoktam--antaḥ śabdaprasaṅgena vakṣyāmīti| yadā
copasargasaṃjñocyate; tadāntarṇayatītyādivadantarhaṇyāt,
antarhaṇanamityādāvapi ṭhhanteratpūrvasya' iti ṇatvaṃ siddham|
antarayaṇamityatrāpi ṭhkṛtyacaḥ' ityeva siddhamiti ṭhantaradeśe'ṭhayanaṃ
ca' iti sūtradvayamapi deśapratiṣedhārthaṃ draṣṭavyam||
padamañjarī
kaṇemanasī śraddhāpratīghāte|| 1|4|66 ||
kaṇeśabdaḥ saptamīpratirūpako nipāto'bhilāṣātiśaye vartate|
manaḥśabdo'pi sāhacaryādabhilāṣāvṛttireva vijñeyaḥ| kaṇehatyeti|
atiśayenābhilaṣya tannivṛttiparyantaṃ pibatītyarthaḥ|
tadāha--tāvaditi| śraddhā pratihanyata ityarthaḥ| iti yāvadasyetyapekṣate|
pratyudāharaṇe kaṇeśabdaḥ pūkṣmataṇḍulāvayavo'dhikaraṇabhūte vartate|
manaḥśabdo'pi cetasi||
padamañjarī
puro'vyayam|| 1|4|67 ||
asipratyayāntaḥ puraḥ śabdo'vyayamiti|
ṭhpūrvādharāvārāṇāmasipuradhavaścaiṣām' ityasipratyayaḥ, pūrvaśabdasya
purādeśaḥ, ṭhtaddhitaścāsarvavibhakti' ityavyayasaṃjñā,
visarjanīyasthānikaḥ sakāra upacāraḥ| puraskṛtyeti| pūrvasmindeśe
kṛtvetyarthaḥ| pūḥ purau, puraḥ kṛtveti| etadatra pratyudāharaṇam|
itarayostūpanyāsastatsāhacaryātpura iti śasantam, nāvyayamiti
pradarśanārthaḥ| atra ṭhnamaspurasorgatyoḥ' iti satvaṃ na bhavati,
samāsaśca na bhavati||
padamañjarī
astaṃ ca|| 1|4|68 ||
astaṃ kṛtveti| ṭhasu kṣepaṇe',niṣṭhā, udito vā' ṭhyasyavibhāṣā' iti
iṭpratiṣedhaḥ| nanu lākṣaṇikatvādevātra na bhavati,
kimavyayagrahaṇānuvṛtyā? evaṃ tarhyastaṃśabdoḥ avyayamiti jñāpyate| na
hyayaṃ cādiṣu svarādiṣu vā paṭhyate||
padamañjarī
accha gatyarthavadeṣu|| 1|4|69 ||
acchetyanukaraṇatve'vibhaktiko nirdeśaḥ, ṭhsupāṃ suluk' iti
vibhakterlu ptatvāt| abhiśabdasyārtha iti| ābhimukhye| acchāedyoti|
yajāditvāt saṃprasāraṇam, udakamacchṃa gacchati, akaluṣamityarthaḥ||
padamañjarī
ado'nupadeśe|| 1|4|70 ||
upadeśaḥ parārthaḥ iti| vākyaprayoga ityarthād gamyate| adaḥ-
kṛtyeti| etatkartavyamiti svayamālocyetyarthaḥ||
padamañjarī
tiro'ntarddhau|| 1|4|71 ||
tirobhūyeti| samāsakṛtsvarau prayojanam| tirobhūtamiti|
bhavaterakarmakatvātkartari ktaḥ ṭhgatiranantaraḥ' ityatra ca karmaṇīti
vartate, tasmāt samāsathāthādisvarāvatra prayojanam| tiro
bhūtveti| pārśvato bhūtvetyarthaḥ||
padamañjarī
vibhāṣā kṛñi|| 1|4|72 ||
tiraskṛtyeti| ṭhtiraso'nyatarasyām' iti satvam| pratyudāharaṇe
tu na bhavati, tatra gatyanukāryānukaraṇayorbhodasyāvivakṣitatvāt
sūtre vibhaktyabhāvaḥ||
padamañjarī
upāje'nvāje|| 1|4|73 ||
sākṣātpramṛtīni ca|| 1|4|74 ||
sākṣātprabhṛtiṣviti| asākṣādbhūtaṃ yadā sākṣātkriyate tadā yathā
syāt yadā yatu sākṣādbhūtameva rūpāntareṇa kriyate tadā mā
bhūdityevamartham| mithyāprabhṛtiṣvapi draṣyavyam|
etaccāntaraṅgatvāllabhyate, tathā hi--sākṣātkṛtamityukte śrutasya
tasyaiva rūpasya karaṇaṃ pratīyate, na tvaśrutarūpāntarasya|
nanvasatyāmapi prakṛtivivakṣāyāṃ tasyaiva rūpasya karaṇaṃ pratīyate, atha
ca cvyarthavṛttitā nāsti, tasmāccvyarthagrahaṇameva kartavyam| atha
cvyanteṣvapi sākṣādādiṣu ayaṃ vikalpaḥ kasmānna bhavati? astu, anena
mukte punaḥ prasaṅgavijñānād ṭhūryādicviḍācaśca' ityeṣā
bhaviṣyati? naivaṃ śakyam, yadetallavaṇādīnāṃ makārāntatvanipātanaṃ
tadapi cvyanteṣu syāt| evaṃ lavaṇādīnāṃ māntā lavaṇādaya
ādeśāḥ kariṣyante, tatra
yadyekadeśavikṛtasyānanyatvālllavāṇīśabdasyāpi pakṣe lavaṇamādaśaḥ
kriyate na kaścid doṣaḥ; traiśabdyaṃ hi naḥ sādhyam--lavaṇaṃkṛtya,
lavaṇaṃ kṛtvā, lavaṇīkṛtyeti, taccaivaṃ siddham| vṛttikārastu
ṭhmakārāntatvaṃ nipātyate' iti vadati, sa manyate--cvyanteṣu
pūrvavipratiṣedhena nityā saṃjñā bhavati, vikalpena tu sanniyuktaṃ
māntatvaṃ nipātanamiti| agnau, vaśeprabhṛtayo vibhaktipratirūpakā
nipātāḥ, prādurāviśabdayorūryāditvāt prāpte vibhāṣā||
padamañjarī
anatyādhāna urasimanasī|| 1|4|75 ||
urasimanasiśabdau nipātau| urasikṛtyeti| abhyupagamyetyarthaḥ|
manasikṛtya, niścityetyarthaḥ||
padamañjarī
madhye pade nivacane ca|| 1|4|76 ||
maghye pade nivacane ca || avibhaktiko nirdeśaḥ, madhyepadeśabdau
nipātau| nivacanaṃ vacanābhāva iti| tatra nipātanādekārāntatvaṃ na
punareṣā saptamī| vācaṃ niyamyeti| vyākhyānānnipātanaṃ
cāviśeṣeṇa, na tu saṃjñāsanniyuktaṃ nivacane kṛtveti
udāhṛtatvādityāhuḥ||
padamañjarī
nityaṃ haste pāṇāvupayamane|| 1|4|77 ||
dārakarmeti| anye tu svīkaraṇamātramicchantihastekṛtya mahāstrāṇīti,
hastepāṇau śabdau nipātau||
padamañjarī
prādhvaṃ bandhane|| 1|4|78 ||
makārāntamavyayamiti| cādiṣu pāṭhāt| ānukūlye vartate iti|
tena bandhane vartamānaḥ prādhvaṃśabdaḥ ityayamartho na bhavati| kathaṃ tarhi
bandhane ityasyānvaya ityata āha--taditi|
bandhana iti| satsaptamyarthadvārakaśca prādhvamityanena sambandhaḥ, bandhane
sati yadānukūlyaṃ tadvandhanahetukamiti bhāvaḥ|
prādhvaṃ kṛtvā gata iti| prasthito'dhvānaṃ prādhvaḥ, ṭhatyādayaḥ krāntādyarthe'
iti samāsaḥ, ṭhupasargādadhvanaḥ' ityac lākṣaṇikatvādevātra na
bhaviṣyati; tasmādavyayasyaivāyaṃ prayogaḥ, ānukūlyaṃ tu
bandhanahetukaṃ na vivakṣitamiti vyācakṣate||
padamañjarī
jīvikopaniṣadāvaupamye|| 1|4|79 ||
jīvikāujīvanopāyaḥ, ṭhsaṃjñāyām' iti karaṇe ṇvul| ṇyantādvā
kartari upinipūrvātsadeḥ ṭhsatsūdviṣa' iti kvip, ṭhsadiraprateḥ' iti
ṣatvam, upaniṣadurahasyaṃ vedāntajanyaṃ jñānam, vedāntabhāgo vā|
āpamya iti| upamīyate'nayetyupamā ṭhātaścopasarge' ityaṅ, tasyā
bhāva aupamyam| viṣayasaptamī caiṣā,
upamānopameyasambandhanimitādabhedopacārādyāvupameyaniṣṭhau
bhavataḥ, tāvaupamyaviṣayau| jīvikākṛtya, upaniṣatkṛtyeti|
jīvikāmiva kṛtvā, upaniṣadamiva kṛtvetyarthaḥ| yadyapi gatisamāso
nityaḥ, tathāpīvaśabdaprayoge svārthaniṣṭhatvādīddaśavākyaṃ bhavatyeva||
padamañjarī
te prāgdhātoḥ|| 1|4|80 ||
niyamārthamidam| sa punarniyamaḥ saṃjñāniyamo vā syāt, prayoga
niyamo vā syāt? tatra saṃjñāniyame teśabdena prādaya
upaniṣatparthantāḥ svarūpeṇa parāmṛśyante, na
gatyupasargasaṃjñāviśiṣṭena rūpeṇā; saṃjñayoraniṣpādanāt|
anenekavākyatāpannaiḥ pūrvasūtraistayorvidhānāt| te prādaya
upaniṣatparyantā dhātoḥ prāgeva prayujyamānā gatyupasargasaṃjñā
bhavantītyarthaḥ| prayoganiyame tu labdhagatyupasargasaṃjñāḥ
parāmṛśyante| te gatyupasargasaṃjñakā dhātoḥ prāgeva prayoktavyā
ityarthaḥ|
tatrādye pakṣe svarūpeṇa parāmarśaḥ prādīnāmiva cādīnāmapi syāt,
tataśca nipātasaṃjñāyā api niyamaḥ syāt| athāpi
gatyupasargasaṃjñayoreva niyamaḥ, evamapyanarthakaṃ vacanam, prayoga eva
hi teṣāmaprāṅ neṣyate| na punaraprāk prayujyamānānāṃ saṃjñāyāṃ
kiñcidaniṣṭamāpadyate| ṭhcchandasi pare'pi' vyavahitāśca' iti rūpadvayaṃ
cānarthakam,paravyavahitānāṃ saṃjñaiva niṣiddhā, na tu prayogaḥ| na ca
tenāpi saṃjñaiva vidhīyate, niṣprayojanatvāt| kiṃca ṭhanukaraṇaṃ
cānitiparam' ityanitiparagrahaṇa manarthakaṃ syāt, ṭhkhāḍiti kṛtvā
niraṣṭhīvat' ityatra vyavahitasyānukaraṇasya gatisaṃjñaiva niṣiddhā,
prayogastu kena vāryate! prayoganiyame tu dhātoḥ
prāgevānukaraṇasya prayogaḥ syād, na tvitiśabdena vyavahitasyeti
anitiparamiti vaktavyam| ataḥ prayoganiyama evāyaṃ yukta iti
matvāha--te gatyupasargasaṃjñakā iti|
athāsminnapi pakṣe nipātānāmapi teśabdena parāmarśaḥ kasmānna bhavati?
vyavahitatvāt| kathaṃ tarhyupasargāṇāṃ parāmarśaḥ, nopasargāstena
rūpeṇa parāmṛśyante, kiṃ tarhi? gatirūpeṇa, teṣāmapi gatitvāt|
anenaivābhiprāyeṇa vṛtāvupasargāṇāṃ pṛthag grahaṇam| cādayastu
naivamiti na te parāmṛśyante| nanu yatra loke saṃkīrṇaḥ prayogaḥ-
gaurgāvīti, tatra sādhuparijñānāya śāstramarthavat| yatra tvasaṃkīrṇa
eva prayogo na tatra śāstrakṛtyamasti; na ca kaścit prapacatīti
prayoktavye pacatīti preti prayuṅkte| yadyapi loke prayogo na
ddaśyate viparītaḥ, cchandasi tu paravyavahitaprayogadarśanād
bhāṣāyāmapi tathā prayogaḥ śaṅkyeta, darśitaścādyatve'pi bhāṣāyāmeva
gaterāviḥśabdasya paravyavahitaprayoga ūryādisūtre| kiṃ ca ṭhudi
kūle rujivahoḥ' kūlamudvaha ityatra ṭhudi' ṭhkūla' iti dvayorapi
saptamīnirdeśādupapadatvātsamāse kṛte ṭhupasarjanaṃ pūrvam' iti
śāstravaśātparyāyeṇa pūrvanipātaṃ manyeran ityupasarjanasaṃnipāte
pūrvaparavyavasthārthamidaṃ vaktavyam| yadyevam, ṭhkartṛkarmaṇośca
bhūkṛño'ḥ- sukhena kaṭaḥ kriyate, sukaṭṃakarāṇi vīraṇāni,
duṣkaṭṃakarāṇi, atra sudusoḥ prāgdhātoḥ prayogaḥ prāpnoti--kaṭṃa
sukarāṇīti| khalaḥ khitkaraṇamidānīṃ kimarthaṃ syāt? anavyayasya hi
mumucyate, khitkaraṇasāmarthyād avyayasya bhavatu, yadi vā ṭhkṛdrahaṇe
gatikārakapūrvasyāpi grahaṇam' iti sukaraśabde parataḥ kaṭasya
bhaviṣyati, kartavyo'tra yatnaḥ|
dhātugrahaṇamanartakam, kutaḥ? prāgityapekṣāyāṃ yatkriyāyuktāḥ
prādayastataḥ prāgiti vijñāsyate; naivaṃ śakyam, iha ca kartuṃ precchati
pracikīrṣatīti sanvācyayā icchayā praśabdasya yoga iti sana eva prāk
praśabdaḥ prayujyeta, dhātugrahaṇāt tu dhātoreva cikīrṣateḥ prāk
prayujyate|
tegrahaṇamupasargārthamiti| nanu yadi gatisaṃjñārahitāḥ
kevalopasargasaṃjñā eva prādayaḥ syuḥ, tato'sati tegrahaṇe
gatīnāmanantaratvāta eva saṃbadhyeran, na tūpasargā iti tadarthaṃ
tegrahaṇaṃ kartavyam? te'pi tu gatisaṃjñakāḥ, tataścānantarāṇāṃ
gatīnāmapi sambandhe prādīnāmapi gatitvādeva grahaṇaṃ siddham|
syādetat--asati tegrahaṇe gatisaṃjñaiva kevalā yeṣām, teṣāmeva
syād; nobhayasaṃjñakānāṃ prādīnāmiti? na; kevalagaterabhāvāt|
nanu cāyamasti ṭhanukaraṇaṃ cāniti param' iti, na; tasyāpi
nipātatvāt, ucyate; asati tegrahaṇe prakṛteṣvapekṣā cet katipaye
saṃbadhyeran; nopasargaparyantāḥ| vyāptinyāyātu bhūyasāmapekṣāyāṃ
na prādiṣveva paryavasāne kāraṇamastīti cādayo'pyapekṣyeran |
tegrahaṇe tu sati gatisaṃjñāyā anantaratvātena rūpeṇa parāmarśo na
katipayānāmeva bhavatīti prādīnapi vyāpnoti, cādaāāśca
parisaṃcaṣṭe iti tegrahaṇamupasargārthaṃ bhavati| tatparyantānāṃ ca yathā
syāt teṣāmeva ca yathā syādityarthaḥ| gatayo hyanantarā iti|
ye'nantarāsta eva katipaye gṛhyaeran, pratyāsatāviti bhāvaḥ| vyāptau
tu doṣaḥ sujñānatvānna kaṇṭhoktaḥ||
padamañjarī
cchandasi pare'pi || 1|4|81 ||
na ca pareṣāmiti| naca ṭhgatirgatau' ityasyāpi sambhavaḥ,
parabhūtānāmekākināmeva darśanāditi manyate||
padamañjarī
vyavahitāśca|| 1|4|82 ||
dikcchabdānāmavyavahite mukhyā vṛttiriti prāk parastācca
vyavahitānāṃ prayogārthamidaṃ vacanam| ata eva bhāṣāyāṃ
vyavahitānāmaprayogaḥ| kathaṃ tarhi gativyavāye prayogaḥ-abhyuddharati,
samudāharatīti? na tulyajātīyaṃ vyavadhāyakaṃ bhavati,
tadyathā--kimanantare ete brāhmaṇakule iti pṛṣṭaḥ sannāha--nānantare,
vṛṣalakulamanayormadhya iti vijātīyaṃ vyavadhāyakaṃ nirdiśati,
jātervā samāśrayaṇānnāsti vyavadhāyakatvam| evaṃ ca
gatiranantaragrahaṇam, ṭhgatirgatau' iti vacanam, ṭhabhipraiti'
itinirdeśaścopapanno bhavati||
padamañjarī
karmapravacanīyāḥ|| 1|4|83 ||
vakṣyāmāṇānāṃ saṃjñināṃ bahutvādvahuvacanam, yathā--nipātāḥ, kṛtyā
iti| kvacitu sāmānyavivakṣayaikavacanam, ṭhgatiśca',ṭhpratyayaḥ'ṭhkṛt'
iti|
mahāsaṃjñākaraṇamanvarthasaṃjñākaraṇamanvarthasaṃjñāvijñānārtham--karmaukriyāṃ proktavantaḥ karmapravacanīyā iti| bhūte ṭhkṛtyalyuṭo bahulam' iti kartari kṛtyaḥ| ke ca karma proktavantaḥ? ye prayujyamāne kriyāpade--ṭhanubhūyate kambalaḥ' ityādau kriyāviśeṣaṃ dyotitavantaḥ, na saṃprati kriyāviśeṣaṃ dyotayanti, kiṃ tarhi? sambandhaviśeṣam, tadyathā--śākalyasya saṃhitāmanuprāvarṣaditi| na hyatrānuranubhūyate ityādāviva kriyāviśeṣaṃ dyotayati, kriyāpadābhāvāt; nāpi ṣaṣṭhīvatsambandhamācaṣṭe--saṃhitāmiti; dvitīyāyāstadarthatvāt| nāpi kriyāpadamākṣipati, yathā--prādeśaṃ viparilikhatīti, viśabdo vimānakriyāṃ prādeśaṃ vimāya parilikhatīti | tathā hi--sati prādeśamitivat kārakavibhaktiprasaṅgaḥ, śeṣasambandhasya vā pratītiprasaṅgaḥ| tadevamanuḥ saṃhitāpravarṣaṇayoryaḥ śeṣasambandho dvitīyābhihitastaṃ viśeṣe'vasthāpayati| hetuhetumadbhāvena rūpeṇa viśiṣṭakriyājanitatvena vā sambandhasya tatsaṃnidhau sampratyayāt saṃhitāmanuniśamya prāvarṣaditi| uktaṃ ca--
kriyāyā dyotako nāyaṃ na sambandhasya vācakaḥ|
nāpi kriyāpadākṣepī sambandhasya tu bhedakaḥ|| iti|
kvacitu pravṛttinimitābhāve'pi vacanasāmarthyādiyaṃ saṃjñā pravartate,
yathā--ṭhsuḥ pūjāyām' ṭhatiratikramaṇe ca iti||
padamañjarī 
anurlakṣaṇe|| 1|4|84 ||
yāvateti| yāvatāśabdo nipāto nanvityarthe| anyetyartha ityanye|
lakṣaṇetthabhbhūtākhyānetiṣa siddheti| tatra cāvaśyamanorgrahaṇaṃ
kartavyamirtthabhūtākhyānādiṣu yāthā syāt| lakṣaṇagrahaṇaṃ ca
pratyādyartham, ato'rthāntarasaṃjñāntarasaṃjñāntarasādhāraṇatvātadevāstu,
idaṃ tu na kartavyamiti bhāvaḥ| hetvarthantviti | tu śabdaḥ pakṣaṃ
vyāvartayati| hetuḥu karaṇam, arthaḥu prayojanaṃ prayojako'sya
vacanasyetyarthaḥ| nanu ca tatra cātra ca lakṣaṇagrahaṇameva kriyate, tadyadi
heturlakṣaṇaṃ na bhavati, ihāpi na gṛhyate, atha bhavati tatrāpi nārtha
etena? tatrāha--hetutṛtīyāmiti| satyam; lakṣyate'nena tallakṣaṇamu
cihnaṃ jñāpakam, kāraṇamapi niyataṃ kāryaviśeṣāvagatihetutvād
lakṣaṇaṃ bhavatyeva| uktaṃ bhāṣye--lakṣaṇena heturapi vyāpto nāvaśyaṃ
tadeva lakṣaṇaṃ yena punaḥ punarlakṣyate,kiṃ tarhi? yatsakṛdapi
nimitatvāya kalpate padapi lakṣaṇamiti| kintu yena nāprāptinyāyena
karmapravacanīyayukte dvitīyā ṣaṣṭha|la evāpavādaḥ| tataśca
lakṣaṇetthaṃbhūtetyanorlakṣaghaṇe karmapravacanīyasaṃjñāyā avakāśo yo
heturna bhavati-vṛkṣamanuvidyotate, hetutṛtīyāyā avakāśaḥ- dhanena
kulamiti; hetubhūte tu lakṣaṇe ubhayaprasaṅge paratvāt tṛtīyā
syāt, tāmapi bādhitvā dvitīyaiva yathā syāt| punaḥ saṃjñāvidhāne
kakṣāntaraprāptatvād dvitīyaiva tṛtīyā bādhate| uktaṃ ca--
hetuhetumatoryogaparicchedo'nunā kṛte|
ārambhādvādhyate prāptā tṛtīyā hetulakṣaṇā|| iti|
ṭhtṛtīyārtha' ityanena tu purastādapavādanyāyena ṭhsahayukte'pradhāne'
ityasyaiva bādhaḥ, na hetutṛtīyāyā iti vaktavyametat||
padamañjarī
tṛtīyārthe|| 1|4|85 ||
nadīmanvavasiteti| sahārtho'tra tṛtīyārthaḥ| anvavapūrvātṭhṣiñ
bandhane' ityasmāt kartari ktaḥ||
padamañjarī
hīne|| 1|4|86 ||
hīnetkṛṣṭasambandhe saṃjñeti| karmapravacanīyavibhaktistu tena
vyatiricyamāna utkṛṣṭa eva bhavati, na hīne,
abhidhānāśaktisvābhāvyāt nobhābhyāmekayaiva dvitīyayā dviṣṭhasyāpi
sambandhasyābhidhānāt ṣaṣṭhīt||
padamañjarī
upo'dhike ca|| 1|4|87 ||
atrāpyadhikinā vinādhikasyāsambhāvad adhikādhikisambandhe saṃjñā
vidhīyate| vibhaktirapyadhikina eva bhavati, nādhikāt| upakhāryo droṇa
iti| khāraśabdo gaurādiḥ, khārī tāvadasti, adhiko'pi tasyāṃ
droṇo'stītyarthaḥ| ṭhyasmādadhikam' iti saptamī||
apaparī varjane|| prakṛtena vākye pratipādyamānenetyarthaḥ|
pariparitrigartebhya iti ṭhpañcamyapāṅparibhiḥ' iti pañcamī,
ṭhparervarjane' iti dvirvacanam, karmapravacanīyena pañcamīsahitena
dyotite'pi varjane bhavati, ubhayorapi vidhānasāmarthyāt|
pariṣiñcatīti| pariḥ sarvato bhāve, atrāsyāḥ saṃjñāyā abhāvād
upasargatve sati ṭhupasargātsunoti' iti ṣatvaṃ bhavati, ṭhśe
mucādīnām' iti num||
padamañjarī
āṅ maryādāvacane|| 1|4|89 ||
maryā maraṇadharmāṇo manuṣyāḥ, auṇadiko yapratyayaḥ, tairādīyate
maryādā, ṭhātaścopasarge' ityaṅpratyayaḥ| avadhirmaryādeti| nanu
yatrāvadhiḥ kāryeṇa yujyate so'bhividhiḥ, yatra na sā maryādā;
avadhistu sādhāraṇaṃ tatkāthamavadhirmaryādā? nāyamatrārtho yo'vadhiḥ
sā saryādeti, kiṃ tarhi? yā maryādā so'vadhirityarthaḥ|
vacanagrāṇaditi| iha maryādāyāmiti vācye vacanagrahaṇaṃ kriyate,
tasyaitatprayojanamevaṃ yathā vijñāyeta--ucyate'sminniti vacanam,
maryādāyā vacanamiti karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhayāḥ samāsaḥ| maryādāśabdo
yatrocyate ṭhāṅmaryādābhividhyoḥ' iti tasyāṅe grahaṇam, sa
cābhividhivṛttirapītyatrāpyabhividhergraṃhaṇaṃ bhavati|
yadvā--vacanagrahaṇasāmarthyādavāntarabhedo na vivakṣyate, avadhimātraṃ
gṛhyate| ā mathurāyā iti| vṛṣṭo deva ityapekṣyate, ṭhmantha
viloḍane' auṇādikaḥ kurac pratyayaḥ| īṣadarthe kriyāyoge ca mā
bhūditi| vākyasmaraṇayostvaṅitvādevāprisaṅgaḥ, tatreṣadarthe ā
kaḍāraḥ pañcamī na bhavati, kriyāyoge samāhāra iti ṭhgatirgatau' iti
nighāto bhavati||
padamañjarī
lakṣaṇetthaṃbhūtākhyānabhāgavīpsasu pratiparyanavaḥ|| 1|4|90 ||
lakṣyate yena tallakṣaṇamu cihnaṃ jñāpakam| ayaṃ prakāra ittham,
prathamāntādidamasthamuḥ iha tvidamā pratyavamṛśyasya sannihitasya
kasyacidabhāvātprakāraviśeṣamātravṛttiritthaṃśabdaḥ| ṭhbhū prāptau'
ātmanepadī, ṭhā dhṛṣādvā' iti ṇijabhāvapakṣe gatyarthatvātkartari ktaḥ|
tata itthaṃśabdādavyayādapi vṛttiviṣaye satvadharmopādānātkarmaṇi
dvitīyā, śritādiṣu gamyādīnāmiti sāmasaḥ, kañcit prakāraṃ prāpta
itthaṃbhūtaḥ, itthaṃbhūtasyākhyānamitthaṃbhūtākhyānam| svīkriyamāṇāā'śo
bhāgaḥ, yastvaṃśamātre prayogaḥ priyaṅgorbhāga iti sa bhāgasāddaśyāt|
vyāptumicchā vīpsā, sā cāṣṭame sṣaṣṭayiṣyate, ete lakṣaṇādayo
yathā vibhaktisamīpādayo'vyayārthā nevaṃ pratyādīnāmarthāḥ, kiṃ tarhi?
saṃjñāyāḥ pratyādīnāṃ viṣayatvena nirdiṣṭāḥ ityāha--vīpsāyāṃ ca
viṣayabhūtāyāmiti| etacca liṅgavipariṇāmena lakṣataṇādibhirapi
sambandhanīyam| vṛkṣaṃ pratīti| atra vṛkṣo lakṣaṇaṃ vidyotanasya,
pratyādayastu prāptikrayājanito lakṣyalakṣaṇabhāva ityevaṃ
sambandhaviśeṣe'vasthāpayanti--vṛkṣaṃ prāpya vidyotate, vṛkṣe pradeśe
vidyotata ityarthaḥ| sādhuriti| atrāpi prāptikriyājanita eva
viṣayaviṣayibhāvasambandhaḥ, yathā vṛkṣe ddaṣṭe vidyotanaṃ lakṣyate,
naivamatrāsādhutvāpatiritītthambhūtākhyānagrahaṇam| yadatra māmiti|
yo mama bhāgaḥ sa dīyatāmityarthaḥ| atra svīkaraṇakriyājanitaḥ
svasvāmisambandhaḥ| vṛkṣaṃ vṛkṣamiti| vīpsā dvirvacanena dyotyate|
pariśabdastu kriyayaiva sambadhyate, dvitīyā ceha karmaṇi|
karmapravacanīyasaṃjñā tūpasargasaṃjñā--nivṛtyarthā tena
ṭhupasargātsunoti' iti ṣatvaṃ na bhavati| aśabdasāhacaryāditi|
pariśabdo'yaṃ ddaṣṭāpacāro varjane cāvarjane ca karmapravacanīyaḥ|
apaśabdastu varjane eva| karmapravacanīyādhikāre pañcamī vidhīyate,
tatra sāhacaryaṃ vyavasthāhetuḥ||
padamañjarī
abhirabhāge|| 1|4|91 ||
abhāgaiti kimiti| abhidheyaṃ prayojanaṃ ca parijñātuṃ praśnaḥ| ata
evobhayaṃ darśayati | bhāgaḥ svīkriyamāṇāā'śaḥ| yadatra mamābhiṣyāditi|
nanu anvarthasaṃjñāvijñānādevātra na bhaviṣyati, saṃpratyeva hyasau
vibhajanakriyāṃ dyotayati? pratyādīnāmapi tarhi na syād?
vacanādbhaviṣyati| abherapi tarhi prāpnoti, tasmād ṭhabhāge' iti
vaktavyam, tatropasargatvāt ṭhupasargaprādurbhyāmastiryacparaḥ' iti
ṣatvam| athaivaṃ kasmānna kṛtam--ṭhlakṣaṇetthaṃbhūtākhyānavīpsāsvabhiḥ,
pratiparī bhāge ca, cakārāllakṣaṇādiṣu ca,
anurlakṣaṇatṛtīyārthayośca, cakārādbhāge lakṣaṇādiṣu ca, tato
hīne, upo'dhike ca'; ityevaṃ hi dviranorgrahaṇam, abhāga iti ca na
vaktavyaṃ bhavati| evaṃ hi dviścagrahaṇaṃ kriyate iti padayoḥ sāmyam,
akṣaralāghavaṃ tu nāddatam||
padamañjarī
pratiḥ pratinidhipratidānayoḥ|| 1|4|92 ||
mukhasaddaśa iti| mukhyaḥ kvacitkārye śatruvadhādau ddaṣṭasāmarthyaḥ|
yastu tadabhāve tatkāryakaraṇāya pratinidhīyate upādāyate sa
pratinidhiḥ, karmaṇi kipratyayaḥ| datasyeti utamarṇena |
pratiniryātanamiti| pratyarpaṇam| arjunataḥ pratīti|
ṭhpratinidhipratidāne ca yasmād' iti pañcamī, pratiyogo
pañcamyāstasiḥ| māṣāniti| tilān gṛhītvā māṣān
dadātītyarthaḥ||
padamañjarī
adhiparī anarthakau|| 1|4|93 ||
nanu cānarthakayoḥ kriyāyogābhāvād gatyupasargasaṃjñayoḥ
prāptyabhāvānna tadvodhanārtha karmapravacanīyasaṃjñāvidhānamupapadyate,
nāpi pariśabdayoge pañcamīvidhānārtham, tadvidhau varjanārthasya
grahaṇād| apādānatvācca siddhā pañcamī, yathā'dhiśabdasya
prayoge--kuto'dhyāgacchatīti| ata eva dvitīyāvidhānārthamapi
nopapadyate; tasmādanarthakayoḥ saṃjñāvidhānamanarthakamityata
āha--anarthāntaravācināviti| yathā tiṣṭhati, nitiṣṭhati,
paribhavatītyādau dhātūpātādarthādarthāntaravācitvam,
naivamatrārthāntaravācitvam; kintvāgacchatīti prayoge yo'rthaḥ sa
evādhipariyoge tābhyāmucyate tadatra viṣaye dhātoradhiparyośca
sahābhidhāyitvam; yathāgajaśabde yo'rthaḥ sa eva mataṅgaja iti sarvaiḥ
sahābhidhīyate| evaṃ vṛṣaśabde yo'rthaḥ sa eva vṛṣabhaśabde|
tadevamanarthāntaravācitvādanarthakakalpatvādanarthakāvityuktam, na
tvabhāvāt| tayośca gatisaṃjñābādhāya karmaṃpravacanīyasaṃjñā vidheyeti
darśitaṃ bhavati| kuto'dhyāgacchatīti| kiṃśabdāt ṭhapādāne
cāhīyaruhoḥ' iti tasiḥ, tasya ṭhtaseśca' iti tasilādeśaḥ,
ṭhgatirgatau' iti nighātābhāvaḥ||
padamañjarī
suḥ pūjāyām|| 1|4|94 ||
susiktaṃ bhavateti| bhavacchabdātkartari tṛtīyā| karmapravacanīyayukte
dvitīyā na bhavati; ṭhupapadavibhakteḥ kārakavibhaktirbalīyasī' iti|
suṣiktaṃ kiṃ tavātreti| kṣepo'yam, na pūjā||
padamañjarī
atiratikramaṇe ca|| 1|4|95 ||
padamañjarī
apiḥ padārthasaṃbhāvanānvavasargagarhāsamuccayeṣu|| 1|4|96 ||
padāntarasyetyādi| svārthastāvadavyabhicārānna gṛhyate iti
padāntarasyārthaḥ padārthaḥ| tatrāpi padāntaraprayoge satyapiḥ
prayujyamānastadarthe kañcidviśeṣamādhate| yathā--nīlaśabda utpale, na tu
tasminnevānyūnānatirikte vartate; tathā sati
paryāyatvaprasaṅgenāprayogārhatvāt| ataḥ padāntarasyāprayoga eva
tadarthe pravṛto bhavatīti bhāvaḥ| sarpiṣo'pi syāditi| prārthanāyāṃ
liṅ, tasyā eva durlabhaviṣayatāmapiśabdo dyotayan syādityanena
sambadhyate iti ṣatvaprasaṅgaḥ, durlabhatvaṃ ca viṣayasyaiva bhavati, yadi
tasyā bindumātramapi na labhyata ityatrāpiśabdasāmarthyādvinduriti
gamyate, tadāha--mātrābindustokamityasthārthe'piśabdo vartata iti|
tadupajanite ca vyatireke sarpiṣa iti ṣaṣṭhī| dvitīyā tu na bhavati,
apinā yogābhāvāt| sa hi syādityanena sambadhyata ityuktam|
adhikārthavacaneneti tatsambhāvanamityarthaḥ| api siñcediti|
sambhāvane liṅa tasyaiva duṣkaraviṣayatāmapirāha| kāmacāra
icchāpravṛttiḥ| api siñcedeti | siñca vā mā vā, stuhi vā mā vā,
yatheṣṭṃa kurvityarthaḥ| jālmo'paśabdaḥ| api siñcediti| garhārthe
liṅ| upasargasaṃjñābādhanāditi| syādityatra ṭhupasargaprādurbhyām'
iti sicaḥ ṭhupasargātsunoti' iti ṣatvaprasaṅgaḥ||
padamañjarī
adhirīśvare|| 1|4|97 ||
tadayamiti| yathā ṭhhīne ityatra hīnotkṛṣṭasambandhe saṃjñā,
ṭhupo'dhike ca' ityatrādhikādhikisambandhe, tathātrāpītyarthaḥ|
vibhaktistu tatrānyatarasmāducyate, iha tu na tathetyāha--tatra
kadāciditi| ṭhyasya ceśvaravacanam' ityatrārthadvayam--īśvaraśabdo
bhāvapradhānaḥ, yasya svasyeśvara ucyate tammātsvātsaptamītyaparaḥ| tatra
yadā svāmyarthe vyatirekavivakṣā tadā tataḥ saptamī, svasya tu
vyatireke tata iti| na punarubhābhyāṃ yugapadbhavati, ekayaiva
vibhaktyā dviṣṭhasyāpi sambandhasyābhidhānāditi matvā ṭhkadācid'
ityaktam| brahmadata iti| brahmadatasya svāḥ pañcālā ityarthaḥ|
ādhapañcāleṣviti| pañcālanāṃ brahmadataḥ svāmītyarthaḥ||
padamañjarī
vibhāṣā kṛñi|| 1|4|98 ||
ṭhadhirīśvare' ityanuvṛteḥ prāpte vibhāṣeyam| yadatra
māmadhikariṣyatīti| adhipūrvaḥ karotirviniyoge vartate,
yathā--adhikṛto'yamiha grāme| ṭhsvaritenādhikāraḥ' iti ca, īśvaro
bhavatyevamatra māṃ viniyokṣyata ityarthaḥ| karmaṇi dvitīyaiṣā| yadyevam,
saṃjñāvidhānasya kiṃ prayojanaṃ tatrāha--karmapravacanīyasaṃjñāpakṣa iti|
ṭhnipātairyadyadi' iti nidhātapratiṣedhāt syapratyayasvareṇa
tiṅntamudātavat||
padamañjarī
laḥ parasmaipadam|| 1|4|99 ||
la iti ṣaṣṭhīti| atha prathamābahuvacane ko doṣaḥ, ṭhāmaḥ' iti
lāvasthāyāmeva lupyamānasya liṭaḥ saṃjñā syāt| tataścekṣāmityatrāmna
syād, na hyato liṭparaḥ sambhavati, śeṣādeva, śeṣādeva
parasmaipadamiti niyamāt? jñāpakāt siddham,
yadayamāmpratyayavadityāha, taj
jñāpayati--bhavatyātmanepadibhyo'pyāmiti| ayaṃ tarhi doṣo
lakārasyaiva saṃjñā syānna tadādeśānāṃ tibādīnāmiti?
sthānivadbhāvāteṣāmapi bhaviṣyati| ṭhtaṅanāvātmanepadam' ityatra
tarhi ṭhla' iti prathamāntasya taṅanābhyāṃ sambandho na syāt, na hi
taṅanau lau bhavataḥ| nanu caivaṃ vijñāsyatetaṅanabhāvī lakāra eva,
taṅanāvityakta iti| evamapi gatyantare sati na kliṣṭakalpanā yuktā,
tasmāt ṭhlaḥ' iti ṣaṣṭhī| ādeśāpekṣeti| na ca saṃjñāpekṣā, lakārasya
parasmaipadamiti saṃjñā bhavatīti, kutaḥ? sāmānādhikaraṇyena prāyeṇa
saṃjñāvidhānāt| kiñca--jasi yo doṣaḥ, so'sminnapi syāt; ubhayatra
lakārasya saṃjñitvāt| tasmādādeśāpekṣā ṣaṣṭhī| yadyevam, anavakāśā
puruṣasaṃjñā parasmaipadasaṃjñāṃ śatṛkvasoḥ sāvakāśāṃ bādheta| jasi
tu lakārasya parasmaipadasaṃjñā tiṅaṃ tu puruṣasaṃjñeti
bhinnaviṣayatvānnāsti bādhaprasaṅgaḥ| yadyapi jaspakṣe'pi
tibādīnāmādeśānāmapi ṭhsthānivadādeśaḥ' ityanena parasmaipadasaṃjñā
bhaviṣyati; tathāpi tasyā anākaḍārīyatvātsamāveśasiddhiḥ|
ṣaṣṭhīpakṣe'pi jñāpakātsiddham, yadayam ṭhsici vṛddhiḥ parasmaipadeṣu'
ityāha, taj jñāpayati--bhavati tiṅamapyeṣā saṃjñeti| na hi
sijviṣaye śatṛkvasū sambhavataḥ, sāmānyāpekṣaṃ ca jñāpakamiti
ātmanepadasaṃjñayā puruṣasaṃjñānāṃ samāveśasiddhiḥ, anyathā
parasmepadeṣu sāvakāśāḥ puruṣasaṃjñāḥ
taṅkṣvanavakāśayātmanepadasaṃjñayā bādhyeran| atha vā--puruṣasaṃjñāyāṃ
parasmaipadātmanepadagrahaṇānuvṛterayamartho bhavati, laṭaḥ
parasmaipadātmanepadasaṃjñakāḥ satastrīṇi trīṇi padāni bhūtvā
prathamādisaṃjñā bhavantīti tena samāveśasiddhiḥ||
padamañjarī
taṅanāvātmanepadam|| 1|4|100 ||
atha kasmāllasyetyasyānantaramete saṃjñe na vihite, evaṃ hi
puruṣasaṃjñābhiranyatrasiddho'nayoḥ samāveśo bhavati,
tatrāha--pūrveṇeti| ātmanepadasaṃjñayā parasmaipadasaṃjñāyā bādho yathā
syādityevamarthamasmin prakaraṇe'nayorvidhānamiti bhāvaḥ|
mahāsaṃjñākaraṇaṃ pūrvācāryānurodhena||
padamañjarī
tiṅstrīṇi trīṇi prathamamadhyamotamāḥ|| 1|4|101 ||
trīṇi trīṇīti vīpsāyāṃ dvirvacanam| tatra ca samudāyasyāvayavasca
pṛthakpadatvamiṣyate, ā pacasi pacasi devadatetyekāntatā yathā
syāt, kuṇḍaṃ kuṇḍaṃ vāg apacannapacannityādau
pūrvapade'pyanusvārādi padakāryaṃ yathā syāditi; tena
padacchedakāle trīṇitrīṇītyekaṃ padam, dve vā| iha tiṅaṃ trikāḥ
saṃjñāstu tistra iti vaiṣamyāt saṃkhyātānudeśo na prāpnoti| atra
yadyapyekaikasya trikasyānekasaṃjñāvidhāne prayojanaṃ nāsti, naitāvatā
yathābhimataviṣayalābhaḥ, tatrāha--tiṅe'ṣṭādaśa pratyayā iti|
evaṃ manyate--saṃjñā api ṣaḍeva, kathamekaśeṣanirdeśo'yam? tatra yadi
prathamaśca prathamaśca prathamau, madhyamaśca madhyamaśca madhyamau, utamaśca
utamaścotamau; prathamamadhyamotamā iti kṛtaikaśeṣāṇāṃ dvandvaḥ
kriyeta, tato nābhimatasaṃkhyātānudeśaḥ syāt|
tasmātkṛtadvandvānāmekaśeṣaḥ-prathamamadhyamotamāśca
prathamamadhyamotamāśca prathamamadhyotamā iti| na caivamapi vijñāyate,
kimādita ārabhya trīṇi vacanāni gṛhyante?
āhosvidicchatastrikaparigrahe'pi yathāsaṃkhyaśāstraṃ kramate, kiṃ tarhi?
vihiteṣu saṃjñānāṃ krameṇa sambandhaṃ vidhate| evaṃ tarhi lokata
etatsiddham, tadyathā--vihavyasya dvābhyāmagnirupastheya iti, na cocyate
ānupūrvyaṇeti, atha ca vihavyākhyasya sūtrasyādita ārabhya
ānupūrvyeṇa dvābhyāṃ dvābhyāmṛgbhyāmagnirupasthīyate, na yābhyāṃ
kābhyāñcit; tatra tiṅe'ṣṭādaśa pratyayā ityanenādita ārabhya
trikāṇāmānupūrvyeṇa grahaṇaṃ necchāta iti darśayituṃ tiṅgrahaṇena
saṃniveśo'stīti darśitam| na ca ṭhparasmaipadasaṃjñakaḥ' ityādinā tu
kṛtadvandvānāmekaśeṣo na kṛtaikaśeṣāṇāṃ dvandva iti darśitam| yadi
vā parasmaipadagrahaṇamātmanepadagrahaṇaṃ cānuvartate, tiṅgrahaṇaṃ tu
satṛkvasornivṛtyartham| tadanuvṛtau ca dvau rāśī bhavataḥ, tayośca
vyāpārabhedena sūtrametatpravartate| tatra caikaikaṃ trayastrikā iti|
yathāsaṃkhyasiddhiḥ| tatra na cetyādinā rāśidvayaṃ dvarśitam|
tatretyādinā tu vyāpārabhedaḥ| atrāpi mahāsaṃjñākaraṇaṃ pūrvavat||
padamañjarī
tānyekavacanadvivacanabahuvacanānyekaśaḥ|| 1|4|102 ||
ekaśa iti| ṭhsaṃkhyaikavacanācca vīpsāyām' iti prathamāntācchas|
prakṛtatvādeva trīṇītyasya sambandhe siddhe tānivacanaṃ
puruṣavacanasaṃjñayoḥ samāveśārtham, anyathā hyaekasaṃjñādhikāre
vacanaprāmāṇyātparyāyaḥ syāt, tataśca ṭhāḍutamasya picca' ṭhnityaṃ
ṅtiḥ' iti kāryaṃ vacanasaṃjñāpakṣe utamasaṃjñāyā abhāvānna syāt|
tānītyasmistu sati tānyetāni prathamādisaṃjñāviśiṣṭāni
trīṇitrīṇītyevaṃ parāmarśāllabdhaprathamādisaṃjñāvidhānād bhavati
samāveśaḥ|
nanu trikāṇāṃ puruṣasaṃjñā ekaikasya vacanasaṃjñeti
viṣayabhedānnāyamekasaṃjñādhikāraviṣayaḥ, tanna; yathā vṛddhisaṃjñā
pratyekamādaicāṃ bhavati, tathā puruṣasaṃjñāpi trīpitrīṇīti vacanāt
triṣu pravartamānāpi tibādiṣu pratyekameva pravartate, na samudāye;
tasya prayoge'bhāvāt, pratyekameva teṣāṃ dhātorutpateḥ| trigrahaṇaṃ
tu maryādārthamādita ārabhya trayāṇāṃ prathamasaṃjñā bhavatīti, na punaḥ
samudāye saṃjñāpravṛtarthaṃ tāni tiṅstrīṇitrīṇi padāni bhūtveti|
tibādisūtre samāhāradvandve'ṣṭādaśāvayavapadāni tiṅśabdasya
trīṇitrīṇīti samānādhikaraṇasyāpi puṃlliṅgatāpi
sūtravadbhavati||
padamañjarī
supaḥ|| 1|4|103 ||
subiti pratyāhāragrahaṇaṃ prathamaikavacanādārabhya supaḥ pakārāt|
kapastu pakāreṇa na bhavati, prāgdiśīyānāṃ vibhaktisaṃjñāvidhānāt;
anyathā vibhaktisaṃjñāyāmapi idameva subgrahaṇamanuvartata iti
suptvādeva siddhe'narthakaṃ tatsyāt| tiṅaṃ trikeṣviti| kimarthaṃ
punaridamuktam? iha kaścinmanyate--sūtre
cakārasyākaraṇātsaṃjñāmātramiha sambadhyate, nānyatkiñciditi tatra
ddaṣṭāntapradarśanena trīṇitrīṇyekaśa ityanayoranuvṛttiṃ yathā tiṅaṃ
vacanasaṃjñā vihitā tathaiva supāmapītyarthaḥ| tathā ca svayaṃ ca śabdaṃ
paṭhitvā vyācaṣṭe--supaścetyādi||
padamañjarī
vibhaktiśca|| 1|4|104 ||
cakāraḥ puruṣavacanasaṃjñābhyāṃ samāveśārthaḥ| tiṅaṃ vyavahitānāmapi
svaritatvādanuvṛttiḥ| tiṅaṃ vibhaktitve prayojanam--ātāmādau ṭhna
vibhaktau tusmāḥ' iti niṣedhaḥ, supāṃ tu tyadādyatvādikamapi||
padamañjarī
yuṣmadyaupapade samānādhikaraṇe sthāninyapi madhyamaḥ|| 1|4|105 ||
ṭhlasya tibādayaḥ' ityanenaikavākyatāmāpannenānena tibādīnāṃ
viśiṣṭavidhānam, uta vihitānāṃ tibādīnāṃ bhinnenānena vākyena
niyamaḥ? iti saṃśaye niyama ityāha--lasyetyadhikṛtyeti|
viśiṣṭavidhāne tvitaretarāśrayaṃ syāt--satāṃ tibādīnāṃ
prathamādisaṃjñā, saṃjñāyāṃ ca tibādayo bhāvyanta iti| sa punarniyama
upapadaniyamo vā syād--yuṣmadi madhyama eva asmadyautama eva, śeṣe
prathama eveti; puruṣaniyamo vā--yuṣmadyeva madhyamaḥ, asmadyevotamaḥ,
śeṣa eva prathama iti| tatrādye pakṣe kurvaṃstvaṃ kurvāṇastvamiti
yuṣmadi śatṛśānacau ca na syātām, tṛjādayaśca na syuḥ--kartā tvaṃ
kārakastvamiti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; etāvān viṣayo yuṣmadasmadupapadaṃ
śeṣaśca sarvaścāsau puruṣeṣu niyataḥ| ucyante ca tṛjādayaste
vacanādbhaviṣyanti| tulyajātīyasya ca niyanena vyāvṛttiḥ--yuṣmadi
madhyama eva, na prathamotamau; asmadyautama eva, na prathamamadhyamau; śeṣe
prathamotamāviti| evaṃ tarhi tibādisūtre vidhīyamānatvāt
prādhānyāteṣāmeva niyamo yukaḥ, śeṣagrahaṇāccopapadaniyame hi
yuṣmadasmadī niyate, puruṣā aniyatāḥ, śeṣaścāniyataḥ| tatra prathama
ityetāvadapyucyamānaṃ niyamārthaṃ vijñāyate, tatra ca
niyamāntarasyāsaṃbhavāt prathama eveti niyamaḥ; yatra ca
prathamāprathamaprasaṅgastatraivaṃvidho niyamaḥ kartavyaḥ; śeṣa eva ca tathā
prasaṅga iti tatraiva niyamo bhaviṣyati, kiṃ śeṣagrahaṇena!
puruṣaniyame tu madhyamotamau niyatau yuṣmadasmadī vā niyate,
prathamaśca tatra yuṣmadasmadorapi prathamaprasaṅgo śeṣa eva prathama ityevaṃ
prathamaniyamaḥ kartavyaḥ| na cāntareṇa śeṣagrahaṇamevaṃniyamaḥ śakyate
kartumiti kartavyameva śeṣagrahaṇam| ataḥ śeṣagrahaṇam|
sūtrakārasyāpi puruṣaniyama evābhipreta iti tamevāśrayati--teṣāmayaṃ
puruṣaniyamaḥ kriyata iti|
teṣāmityudbhūtāvayavabhedastibādisamudāya ucyate,
puruṣāpekṣayā'vayavaṣaṣṭhī| teṣāṃ tibādīnāmavayavo yo
madhyamapuruṣastasyopapadaniyamaḥ kriyata ityarthaḥ, sāpekṣasyāpi
puruṣaśabdasya gamakatvāt samāsaḥ| atha vā teṣāmiti karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī,
puruṣadvārako niyamaḥ puruṣaniyamaḥ, puruṣadvāreṇa te niyamyanta
ityarthaḥ| upoccaritaṃ tadamupapadam,
śākapārthivāditvādutarapadalopī samāsaḥ, upaśabdaḥ sāmīpye, tataśca
vyavahite na bhavitavyamiti śaṅgāmapanayati| vyavahite ceti|
samīpa ityeva siddhe upapadagrahaṇādāpekṣikasyāpi sāmīpyasya grahaṇam|
vyavahitamapi ca vyavahitatarāpekṣayā saṃnikṛṣṭamiti bhāvaḥ|
upapadagrahaṇaṃ tu pūrvabhūte'pi yuṣmadi yathā syād, anyathā
ṭhtasminniti nirdiṣṭe pūrvasya' iti parabhūte eva syāt| nanu yathā
sthāninyapīti vacanāt sarvathā'prayujyamāne'pi bhavati tathā
pūrvaprayoge'pi parabhūtasyāprayogāt sthāninīti bhaviṣyati,
naitadasti; saptamīnirdeśāt prayogapakṣe parabhūta eva syāt|
samānābhidheya iti| adhikaraṇaśabdo'bhidheyavacana iti darśayati| punaḥ
samānābhidheye lakāreṇa niyimyamānena vā puruṣeṇaḥ trividhaṃ
cābhidheyaṃ lakārāṇāmbhāvaḥ karma kartā ca, tatra
dravyavācinoryuṣmadasmadorbhāvavācinā lāntena
sāmānādhikaraṇyāsaṃbhavāt kartṛkarmaṇoreva
grahaṇamityāha--tulyakāraka iti| tulyamekaṃ kārakaṃ yasya tatathoktam,
sthāninyapīti sthānaśabda prasaṅgavācī, sthānamasyāstīti sthānī| tatra
ca prayujyamānasyāprayujyamānasya ca prasaṅgo'sti| ucyate cedaṃ
sthānamasyāstīti, tatra sāmarthyādavadhāraṇaṃ vijñāyate--prasaṅga eva
yasya, na tu prayoga iti| yadvā svanikāyaprasiddhireṣā--yasya sthāne
ādeśo vidhīyate sa sthānīti| iha tvaprayujyamānatā sāddaśyāt
yuṣmadi prayujyate, sarvathā sthāninyapītyasyāprayujyamāne'pītyarthaḥ|
apiśabdātprayujyamāne'pi, tadāha--sthāninyapītyādinā|
sthāninyapīti ko'rthaḥ? prayujyamāne'pyaprayujyamāne'pītyarthaḥ|
upapadagrahaṇaprāptasya cārthasyāpiśabdo'nuvādaḥ| samānādhikaraṇa iti
kim? tvayā gamyata ityatra mā bhūt|
kvacitu vṛtāvevāyaṃ granthaḥ paṭha|lte, iha ca atitvaṃ pacati atyahaṃ
pacatītyatrātikrāntapradhāne samāse
yuṣmadasmadorasāmānādhikaraṇyāt prathama eva bhavati, iha
tvīṣadasamāptastvaṃ tvatkalpaḥ pacasi, matkalpaḥ pacāmīti
kālāntaraddaṣṭaguṇarahito yuṣmadasmadartha eva
tvatkalpamatkalpaśabdābhyāmucyata iti madhyamotamau bhavataḥ,
tatsaddaśapadārthāntarābhidhāne tu prathamaḥ, tathā tvataraḥ pacasi, mataraḥ
pacāmi, paramatvaṃ pacasi,paramāhaṃ pacāmīti,
kālāntarāddaṣṭaguṇātiśayaviśiṣṭo yuṣmadasmadartha evocyate iti
bhavatyeva| evaṃ ca yuṣmadarthe madhyamaḥ, asmadartha utama itīyatā siddhaṃ
yuṣmadasmadarthe cellakāra utpannastarhyeva madhyamotamāvityarthaḥ, tathā tu
na kṛtamityeva| iha cātvaṃ tvaṃ saṃpadyata iti tvadbhavatīti bhavati;
prakṛtereva vikārarūpeṇa sampatau kartṛtvāt| etacca ṭh ānmahataḥ'
ityatropapādayiṣyāmaḥ| tathā ca mantre--ṭhyadagne syāmahaṃ tvaṃ tvaṃ
vāsyā aham' iti, ahaṃ tva syāṃ tvaṃ vāhaṃ syām' iti prakṛtyāśrayaḥ
puruṣo ddaśyate| iha bhavānpacatviti yuṣmadarthapratīteḥ sthāninyapīti
madhyamaḥ prāpnoti, na vā yuṣmadarthatvāt, aliṅgaḥ
sambodhanaviṣayaśca yuṣmadarthaḥ| bhavadarthastu liṅgavān na ca
sambodhanaikaviṣayaḥ| yathaiva hi māṇavakādhīṣṭetyabhimukhībhāvo
gamyate, evaṃ tvamadhīṣvetyapi| tathā ca yuṣmadaḥ sarvatraiva saṃbodhane
prathamā āmantritādyaudātatvaṃ ca bhavati, padātparatve ca nighāta iti
kecidāhuḥ| uktaṃ ca---
sambodhanārthaḥ sarvaṃnna madhyame kaiścidiṣyate|
tathā sambodhane sarvāṃ prathamāṃ yuṣmado viduḥ||
yuṣmadarthasya siddhatvānniyatāvādyaudātatā|
yuṣmadaḥ prathamāntasya paraścenna padādasau || iti|
satyam; sambodhanaikaviṣayo yuṣmacchabdaḥ, prathamā tu śuddhaiva;
abhimukhībhāve'syāpi prātipadikārtha evāntarbhāvāt, yatra
tvanantarbhāvaḥ, tatra tadabhidyotanāya sambodhane ceti prathamā vidhīyate
svaropi; anyathā yuvaṃ hi sthaḥ svarpatī, yūyaṃ yāta svastibhiḥ, haye
devā yūyamidāpayastha' iti pādādāvapyantodātatvaṃ
padātparatve'pyanighātaḥ| tadevaṃ
bhavacchabdasyāsambodhanaviṣayatvālliṅgavatvāccāyuṣmadarthatvād
madhyamo na bhavatīti sthitam||
padamañjarī
prahāse ca manyopapade manyaterutama ekavacca|| 1|4|106 ||
prahāse gamyamāna iti| yatra bhūtārthābhāvādvañcanaiva kevalaṃ tatra
vakturabhiprāyāviṣkaraṇe prahāso gamyate| manyati
śabdasyekadeśānukaraṇaṃ manyeti, manya upapadaṃ yasya sa tathoktaḥ| lasya
dhātorvidhānātadādeśatvācca madhyamasya dhāturanyapadārtha ityāha|
manyopapade dhātāviti| prakṛtibhūte satītyarthaḥ| sa caikavaditi|
arthadvārakaścotamasyaikavadbhāvaḥ, ekasya vācako bhavatītyarthaḥ,
dvayorbahuṣu mantṛṣu ekavacanameva bhavatīti yāvat| yatra hi dvau
mantārau bahavo vā, tatraikavadbhāvo vidheyaḥ; anyatra tu
manturekatvādeva siddham| ekavacceti| ca śabdenvācaye,
tenaikavadbhāvāve'pi ekasminnapi mantari pradhānaśiṣṭau
madhyamotamau bhavataḥ| 
anvācayameva darśayitumayatnasādhyamekaṃ mantāramudāharati--ehi
manye odanaṃ bhokṣyasa iti| satyapyodane bhoktumāgataṃ śyālādikaṃ
prati etatprayujyata iti parihāsāvagatiḥ| dvibahvostūdāharaṇe--ehi
manye odanaṃ bhokṣaghyethe nahi bhokṣyethe bhuktaḥ so'tithibhiḥ; ehi
manye rathena yāsyatha yātastena pitā iti| madhyamotamayoḥ
prāptayoriti| yuṣmadasmadarthasya gamyamānatvāt pratyudāharaṇavat
prakṛtamupapadagrahaṇaṃ yuṣmadā sambaddham| tacca
tathaivaihāpyanuvartyamiha mā bhūt--etu bhavānmanyate odanaṃ bhokṣye
bhuktaḥ so'tithibhiriti| tadaśakyaṃ manyatinā sambandhumiti
punarihopapadagrahaṇam, anayathā manyatau parata eva syāt|
śyanānirdeśānmana jñānaityasya grahaṇam, na tu ṭhmanu avabodhane'
ityasya, ehi manuṣe rathena yāsyāmīti evaṃ tasya bhavati|
pratyudāharaṇe atithiṃ prati tathābhūtārthavācanam||
padamañjarī
asmadyautamaḥ|| 1|4|107 ||
yatra yuṣmadasmadī dve apyupapade bhavatastatra yadi kartṛśaktī
svādhāraniyate vivakṣyete, tadā lakāro'pi bhedenotpadyate--tvaṃ
cāhaṃ ca pacasi, pacāmi ceti| sahavivakṣāyāṃ tu dvayorapi
śaktyoreko lakāra utpadyate| tatra yuṣmadi madhyamaḥ, asmadyautamo
vipratiṣedhena--tvaṃ cāhaṃ pacāvaḥ, ahaṃ ca tvaṃ ca vṛtrahan
saṃyujyāvaḥ' iti| yadāpi tyadādīnāṃ yadyatparamityasmadaḥ śeṣastadāpi
syāninyapīti madhyamaprāptau paratvādutama eva bhavati--āvāṃ pacāvaḥ||
padamañjarī
śeṣe prathamaḥ|| 1|4|108 ||
upapada iti nivṛtam| śeṣa iti viṣayasaptamī, na punaḥ parata iti
tadāha--śeṣa iti| madhyamotamaviṣayādanya ucyata iti| anyo viṣaya
ityarthaḥ| yatra yuṣmadasmadī samānādhikaraṇe na stastatra śeṣa ityanena
yuṣmadasmadorabhāvaḥ śeṣaḥ, na punaranyasadbhāva iti darśayati| kiṃ
siddhaṃ bhavati? tvaṃ ca devadataśca pacathaḥ, ahaṃ ca devadataśca pacāvaḥ,
tvaṃ cāhaṃ ca devadataśca pacāma iti| atra yadyapi yuṣmadasmadoranyasya ca
yaḥ samudāyaḥ sa yuṣmadasmadbhyāmanyaḥ, tathāpi yuṣmadasmadī tāvatsta
iti tatsadbhāvanimite syādeva prathamaḥ| yadāha--tatra yuṣmadanyeṣu
prathamapratiṣedhaḥ śeṣatvāditi||
padamañjarī
paraḥ sannikarṣaḥ saṃhitā|| 1|4|109 ||
paraśabdo'tiśaye vartata iti| yathā paraṃ sukhaṃ paraṃ duḥkhamiti,
digādiṣu vartamānasya grahaṇaṃ na bhavati sannikarṣasya
digdeśakālāyogāt| arthāntarāpekṣamanyatvam,
avyabhicārisannikarṣaḥ pratyāsatiriti, na tu saṃśleṣaḥ, tasya
varṇeṣvasaṃbhavāt| sa hi saṃyogaśced dravyadharmatvānna śabdasya guṇasya
saṃbhavati| samavāyaścenna varṇe varṇaḥ samavaiti;
śabdasyākāśasamavāyitvāt| yeṣāṃ tu śabdo dravyaṃ teṣāṃ na kvāpi
śabdaḥ samavaiti| atiśayo'pi saṃyogasamavāyayoḥ kīddaśa iti na
vidmaḥ| pratyāsatestvapekṣābhedāt sambhavati prakarṣāprakarṣayogaḥ,
tasmātpratyāsatireva sannikarṣaḥ|
nanu ca krameṇoccāryamāṇeṣu varṇeṣu pūrvasya varṇasya ye
niṣpādakāḥ sthānādayasteṣāṃ vyāparoparatau varṇāntarasya ye
niṣpādakāsteṣāṃ vyāpārārambhaḥ| tatrāvaśyaṃmadhye kiyatyapi kālakalā
bhavati, sūkṣmatvātu nopalabhyate; padmapatraśatavyaktibhedavat,
tatkathaṃ paraḥ sannikarṣa ityatrāha--ardhamātrākālavyavadhāna iti| satyam,
etāvadvyavadhānamavarjanīyatvātsahyate, adhikena tu kālena vyavadhānaṃ
paragrahaṇena vyāvartyata ityarthaḥ| yadyevam, drutāyāmeva vṛtau syānna
madhyamāyāṃ vilambitāyāṃ vā, na hi tathā tayoḥ sannikarṣo yathā
drutāyāṃ tulyaḥ sannikarṣaḥ| sarvāsu vṛttiṣu
nairantaryeṇoccāraṇādyavarṇopalambhakabhedātu vṛttiviśeṣaḥ| drutāyāṃ
svalpa upalabdhikālaḥ, madhyamāyāmadhikaḥ, vilambitāyāmadhikataraḥ|
dvividhā hi dhvanayaḥ- prākṛtāḥ, vaikṛtāśca| prākṛtā
varṇānāmutpādakāḥ, vaikṛte tu punaḥ punarupalambhaḥ, madhyavartī tu
kālaḥ sarvāsu vṛttiṣu tāvāneva| yadvā--yasyāṃ vṛtau yāvatā
kālena vyavāyo'vaśyambhāvī, tatodhikena vyavāyaḥ paragrahaṇena
vyāvartyate| padasya padāntareṇa yadānantarthaṃ tatraiva loke
saṃhitāśabdaḥ prasiddhaḥ| tathā ca--saṃhitāmadhīte na padāni, tataśca
kumāryāvityādau padāvayave saṃhitākāryaṃ na syāditisūtrārambhaḥ||
padamañjarī
virāmo'vasānam|| 1|4|110 ||
viratirvirāma iti| virāma iti bhāve ghañ| virāmaḥu
varṇoccāraṇābhāvaḥ| arthāntaramāha--viramyate'neneti vā virāma
iti| ṭhkṛtyalyuṭo bahulam' ityasaṃjñāyāmapi ṭhhalaśca' iti karaṇe
ghañ, pūrvatrābhāvaḥ saṃjñī utaratrāntyo varṇaḥ, tena hi viramyate|
tatrādye pakṣeṭhkharavasānayoḥ' iti parasaptamī, kathaṃ punaravasānena,
paurvāparyamabhāvo hi saḥ, kharā vā, katham? na hi yadā kharasti tadā
rephaḥ, yadā rephastadā khar; varṇānāṃ kramabhāvitvād,
uccaritapradhvaṃsitvācca| atha tatra buddhiparikalpitaṃ paurvāparyaṃ
tadabhāve'pi samānam| evaṃ ṭhvāvasāne' ityatrāpi| dvitīye tu pakṣe
kharavasānayorityekāpi saptamī viṣayabhedādbhadyate--khari parato
rephasya visarjanīyo bhavati, avasāne ca rephe sthānini visarjanīya
iti sthanyādeśasya viṣayatā vivakṣyate| evaṃ ṭhvā'vasāne' ityatrāpi|
dadhiṃ madhuÄ iti | ṭhaṇo'pragṛhyasyānunāsikaḥ' atra ṭhvāvasāne' iti
vartate| nanu ca lokaevāvasānaśabdo virāme prasiddhaḥ, yadyapyavapūrvaḥ
syatiravagatau vartate kenaitadavasīyata iti? parābhave'pi avasito
devadata iti| avasānaśabdastu virāma eva prasiddhaḥ| na ca
rephasyāvagatiparābhavayoḥ karaṇatvaṃ sambhavatīti nārthaḥ
saṃjñākaraṇena, tadāha--saṃhitāvasānayorlokaviditatvāt
siddhamiti| saṃhitāśabdo'pi sannikarṣamātre prasiddhaḥ, na padayoreva
sannikarṣa iti vārtikakāro manyate||
haradatamiśraviracitāyāṃ padamañjaryo prathamādhyāyasya catuthaḥ pādaḥ||kāśikāvṛttiḥ - 2 
padamañjarī
atha dvitīyādhyāye prathama pādaḥ 
1 samarthaḥ padavidhiḥ || 2-1-1 || 
paribhāṣeyamiti| nādhikāraḥ, padavidhigrahaṇāt, anyathā
vakṣyamāṇānāṃ parāṅvadbhāvadīnāṃ padavidhitvāvyabhicārādanarthakaṃ
tatsyāt| paritaḥ u sartatra, paratra, vyavahite ca, anantare ca -
bhāṣyate kāryamānayeti karaṇe ṭhgurośca halaḥ' atyakārapratyayaḥ|
bhāvasādhana eva vā'bhedopacārātsūtre prayujyate| idaṃśabdasya sūtre
prayuktasyāpi vidheyaparibhāṣāśabdasāmānādhikaraṇyāt strīliṅgatā|
sa karva iti| nanu yaḥ kaścitpadavidhiriti sāmānyanirdeśenaiva
tadhdarmabhūtā vyāptiruktā, kiṃ karmagrahaṇena? naitadastiḥ ṭhyaḥ kaścid
brāhmaṇa ānīyatām' ityukte kṣatriyādinivṛttiḥ pratīyate, na vyāptiḥ|
prathamapaṭhitamapi samarthasabdamullaṅghyoddeśyasamarpakatvabalādārthena
krameṇa prathame bhāvinaṃ padavidhiśabdaṃ vyākhyāsyānvidhiśabdaḥ
karmasādhana iti darśayati-vidhīyata iti vidhiriti| kāryamityarthaḥ|
padānāmiti| śeṣalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhī| padānāṃ satāṃ yatkāryaṃ vidhīyata
ityarthaḥ| yadi tu bhāvasādhano vidhiśabda āśrīyeta-vidhānaṃ
vidhiriti, tataḥ padeṣu kṛdyogalakṣaṇā karmaṇi ṣaṣṭha

ī-padānāmasatāṃ niṣpādanaṃ padavidhiriti, tatra
samāsatadhditasubdhātuvṛtayo na saṃgṛhītāḥ syuḥ| tatra hi padānāṃ
satāṃ samāsādikāryaṃ vidhīyate, na punaḥ padatvam| nanu ca
karmasādhanapakṣe'pi vibhaktividhānamasaṃgṛhītaṃ syāt, padānyeva hi
tatra vidhīyante na tu padānāṃ satāṃ kiñcid? ucyate-ṭhkarmaṇi
dvitāyā' ityādinā tu niyamaḥ kriyate, na padavidhiḥ|
athāpyekavākyatayā svādisūtreṇa vibhaktīnāṃ vidhānam? evamapi
kārakavibhaktiṣu tāvatkriyākārakayoravinābhūtaḥ sambandhaḥ,
upapadavibhaktīnāṃ tu ṭhanatarāntareṇayukte'
ityādīnāmupasargavibhaktīnāṃ ca ṭhnerviśaḥ' ityādīnāmekavākyatāyāṃ
bhinnavākyatāyāṃ ca padavidhitvamastyeva; upapadānāmupasargāṇāṃ ca
padatvāt| samāsādirityādiśabdena tadhditavṛtyādīnāṃ grahaṇam,
tadhditā api subantādutpadyante| ṭhsamarthānāṃ prathamādvā' ityasya tu
samarthagrahaṇasya prayojanaṃ tatraiva vakṣyāmaḥ| evam ṭhisusoḥ'
sāmarthye' ityādīnāmapi samarthaḥ śakta iti; tatraiva samarthasabdasya
rūḍhatvāt| svakāryaniṣpādanakṣamo hi loke ṭhsamarthaḥ' ityucyate|
arthapratipādanaṃ ca śabdānāṃ svakāryavyutpādyatvena cādhikṛtā
laukikāḥ vaidikāñca yasya kasyacitpratipādane samarthāḥ, ucyate cedaṃ
samartha iti, tatra sāmarthyādviśeṣo'vagamyate, sa tu viśeṣaḥ
pratyāsaterevaṃrūpa ityāha-vigrahavākyārthābhidhāne iti| viśeṣeṇa
gṛhyate u jñāyate'nena samāsārtha iti vigrahaḥ| tādṛśaṃ ca tadvākyaṃ
ceti viśeṣaṇasamāsaḥ| yadvā-viśeṣeṇa grahaṇaṃ vigrahaḥ, tadarthaṃ vākyaṃ
vigrahavākyam, aśvaghāsādivatṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| atha
vā-abhedopacārādvigrahārthavākyaṃ vigraha iti viśeṣaṇasamāsaḥ,
tadyathā-rājapuruṣa ityayaṃ samāsaḥ, tadarthaṃ vigrahavākyaṃ rājñaḥ puruṣa
iti, asya yo'rthastadabhidhāne rājapuruṣaśabda samarthaḥ, ato'pi
tatpratīteḥ, sa punā rājaviśiṣṭaḥ puruṣaḥ| samartho veditavya iti|
sādhutveneti śeṣaḥ| yaḥ padavidhiḥ sa vigrahavākyārthābhidhāne
samarthaḥ sanāsādhurbhavatītyasminpakṣe sūtrārthaḥ, nārthāntaraṃ sādhīyaḥ
paśyāmaḥ| tatu sāmarthyaṃ prayogato'nusartavyam| na punariyaṃ
vṛttirasya vākyasyārthābhidhānasamarthā,
nānyasyetyetatsūtrākṣarairlabhyate| ata evāsminvyākhyāne'parituṣṭaḥ
sanvyākhyānāntaramāha--atha veti| atra pakṣe upacaritavṛttiḥ
samarthaśabdaḥ, tadāhasamarthapadāśrayatvāditi| samarthānāṃ padānāṃ
sambadhdārthānāṃ saṃsṛṣṭārthānāsiti| yaḥ padānāṃ vidhiḥ sa
samarthānaaṃ viditavyaḥ| samarthānāmiti ko'rthaḥ? saṃbadhdārthānāṃ
saṃsṛṣṭārthānāṃ vetyarthaḥ| tatra vākye saṃbadhdārthatā| vyapekṣā hi tatra
sāmarthyam| anyo'nyāpekṣā u vyapekṣā| ākāṃkṣāmannidhiyogyatveṣu
satsuḥ yaḥ parasparasambandhaḥ sā vyapekṣā| vākye hi ṭhrājñaḥ' iti
padaniyatasaṃbandhyapekṣayodbhūtasaṃbandhaṃ viśeṣaṇabhūtamarthamācaṣṭe,
svasaṃnihitaṃ yogyaṃ ca puruṣamapekṣate| mamāyamiti ṭhpuruṣaḥ'
ītyenenāpi puruṣaḥ svaniṣṭho'bhidhīyamānaḥ svasaṃnihitaṃ
rājatvamavacchedakatvenāpekṣate-ahamasyeti| ato
viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvena sambandho'niyatasaṃbandhiviṣayatvāccāpekṣayā
yo yaḥ sannihito yogyaśca tena sambadhyate-rājñaḥ puruścāścaśca,
rājño dedatasya ca puruṣa iti, nārthāntarasya| vṛto tu
saṃsṛṣṭārthatā| ekārthībhāvo hi tatra sāmarthyam| vṛtau hi rājapadaṃ
rājānamabhidhāya na tāvati paryavasyati, puruṣamapyācaṣṭe,
yathā-ṭhgaṅgāyāṃ ghoṣaḥ' iti gaṅgāpadaṃ tīram| yadi tu tāvatyeva
paryavasyetato yathā vākye rājñaḥ puruṣo'śvaśceti dvābhyāṃ sambandho
bhavati, tathā rājapuruṣo'śvaścetyatrāpi syāt|
svaviśeṣaṇasambandho'pi syād-ṛdhdasya rāḍapuruṣa iti yathā ṛdhdasya
rājñaḥ puruṣa iti tathā puruṣapadamapi rājaviśiṣṭameva
puruṣamācaṣṭe, na puruṣamātram| yadi tathā syātato yathā vākye
rājñaḥ puruṣo devadatasya ceti dvābhyāṃ sambandho bhavati, tathā
rāpuruṣo devadatasya cetyapi syāt| ato yasya viśeṣasya
bhāvādayaṃ viśeṣaḥ sa ekārthībhāvaḥ| bhāṣyoktāścāpare
viśeṣāḥ-ṭhsubalopo vyavadhānaṃ yatheṣṭamanyatareṇābhisambandhaḥ
svarabhedaśca saṃkhyāviśeṣo vyaktābhidhānamupasarjanaviśaṃṣaṇaṃ ca
yogaśca ' iti| tathā supi alopaśca bhavati vākye-rājñaḥ puruṣaḥ,
nīlamutpalamiti samāse tu dyorekasminviśiṣṭe'rthe vṛteḥ
pṛthagarthābhāvātsvabhāvata eva vibhktanivartate| saiva ca svābhāvikī
nivṛttiḥ śāstreṇānvākhyāyate-ṭhsupo dhātuprātipadikayoḥ' iti
pratyayalakṣaṇena nalopādikārthaṃ yathā syāditi| pṛthagarthābhāve tu
pathagvibhaktirna bhavati| tathā varṇeṣu vyavadhānaṃ ca pṛthagaparthatva eva
dṛṣṭaḥ--rājñaḥ puruṣa iti dvāvapi nitsvareṇādyaudātī| abhedena dṛṣṭaḥ,
yathā--puruṣa iti vṛtau caikasvaryaṃ dṛśyate| kiṃ ca,
saṃkhyāviśeṣo'vagamyate pṛthagaretheṣu--rājñaḥ rājñoḥ rājñāṃ
puruṣa iti| vṛtau tvavyaktamabhidhānaṃ viṣṭhati, brāhmaṇakambala iti
mandeho bhavati-saṃbudhdirvā syāt? ṣaṣṭhīsamāso vā? iti, na
cātrasvarānnarṇayaḥ| vākye'pyāmantritanighātaḥ kambalaśabdo
ghṛtāditāvādantodātaḥ, samāse'pyantodātatā| upasarjanaviśeṣaṇaṃ
ca vyākhyātam| yogaśca bhavati pṛthagartheṣu-rājño gauścāścaśca
kambalaśceti| vṛtau tvekārthyādbhedanibandhanasya samucca
yasyābhāvāccaśabdo nivartata-rājño gavāśvakambalā iti,
tadetairviśeṣairvajñāyate saṃbhinnobhayarūpaḥ pāsūdakavadavibhāgāpanno
vṛtāvartha iti| tena rājñaḥ puruṣamānaya rājapuruṣamānayeti ca
yadyacapyeka evānīyata iti kāryayogino'bhedastathācyabhidhānaprakāro
bhidyate, yathā-brāhmaṇānāṃ śataṃ bhojyatāmiti| tadevaṃ
vṛttivākyayorartho bhidyata iti sthitam| evaṃ ca tra tatra vāvacanaṃ
cintyaprayojanam; bhinnārthayā vṛtyā vākyasya bādhā'prasaṅgāt|
anye tu jahatsvārthā vṛttiriti vadanto
vartipadānāmānarthakyamevāhuḥ, tatu na rocayāmahe| kiṃ rājapuruṣa
ityatra rājārtho na gamyate? omiti cet, puruṣamātrānayanaṃ
prāpnoti| atha gamyate? kiṃnibandhanā tasyāvagatiḥ? na tāvat
samāsasya tatra śāktiḥ kalpyā; rājaśabdanibandhanāyāmapi
tasyāmanarthābhāvāt| na ca vākye rājapadaṃ vyutpannaṃ punaḥ samāse
viyutpattimapekṣate, tāvatyeva ca pratipadyate rājārthaḥ| ate na
jahatsvārthā vṛttiḥ, arthābhidhānaprakārabheda ityetadeva sāṃpratam| tatra
sambadhdārthānāṃ saṃsṛṣṭārthānāmiti sthataṃ paribhāṣāpravṛtau
heturnānyatarat, yato mā bhūdvyapekṣāmātrāśrayeṇa sāpekṣasyāpi
vṛttiḥ| yadeyevam, parāṅgavadbhāve vibhaktividhāne ca sā na
pravarteta; tatraikārthībhāvasyāsambhavāt| mā pravartiṣṭa,
parāṅgavadbhāvetnnimitagrahaṇaṃ nodayiṣyati| vibhaktividhāne'pi
kriyākārakayorvyapekṣā'vinābhāvinī kvacidyauktagrahaṇam;
kvacidyogagrahaṇam, kvacit-tṛtīyayā yogasyākṣepa iti na kvāpi
doṣaḥ| ata evānantaramapi parāṅgavadbhāvamullaṅghya
samāsamudāharati--vakṣyatīti| samarthagrahaṇaṃ kimiti| sūtraṃ
kimarthamityarthaḥ| na hi kevalena padavidhigrahaṇena kiñcatkriyate|
paśyetyādi| nanu ca śritādibhirdvitīyāṃ
viśeṣayiṣyāmaḥ-śritādiyoge yā dvitīyoti| evamapi sāpekṣas
prasaṅgaḥ-mahatkaṣṭṃa śrita iti, bhavati hyatra śritādinimitā dvitīyā,
samarthagrahaṇe tu sati na bhavati| yadyapyatra vākyāvasthāyāṃ
vyapekṣānakṣaṇasāmarthyamasti, vṛtyavasthāyāntu naikārthībhāvaḥ
saṃbhavatītyavocāma| kathaṃ tarhi devadatasya gurukulamiti sāpekṣasya
vṛta? nātra guruṇa devadatasya sambandhaḥ; kiṃ tarhi? samudāyena,
gurudvārakaśca sulena sambandha ityarthād guruṇāpi yogo bhavati|
uktaṃ ca-
samudāyena sambandho yeṣāṃ gurukulādinā| 
saṃspṛśyāvayavāṃste'pi yujyante tadvatā saha|| iti
atha vā--pariparūrṇārthasyānyena sahaikārthībhāvaḥ svārthaparipūrtiśca
samābandhi śabdasya pratiyogineti bhavati tadapekṣasyāpi vṛttiḥ| uktaṃ
ca -
sambandhiśabdaḥ sāpekṣo ntyaṃ sarvaḥ prayujyate| 
svārthavatsā vyapekṣā'sya vṛtāvapi na hāyate|| iti
kiṃ tvaṃ kariṣyasītyādi atra śakyaṃ vaktum| tatkṛtārtheneti| tacchabdaḥ
prakṛtaparārmśāya tṛtīyāntaṃ samasyata--tadarthena yaḥ kṛco
guṇastadvacaneneti| atra ca yasya samāsaḥ śahkyate--śaṃkulayeti, na
tadarthena kṛtaṃ khaṇḍanam; yadathaṃna ca kṛtaṃ khaṇḍanamupaleneti, na
tasya samāsaḥ śaṅkyaca iti na bhaviṣyatīti| tasmānmahatyā śaṃkulayā
khaṇḍa iti sāpekṣamudāhartavyam| gaccha tvaṃ yūpāyeti|
ṭhgatyarthakarmaṇi' iti caturthī| tadvā-ṭhkriyārthāpapadasya ca karmaṇi' iti,
yūpamāhartu gaccheti, atrāpyetadarthatvādeva dāruṇo na
bhaviṣyatīti sāpekṣaṃ pratyudāhartavyam-mahate yūpāya dārviti|
yaṇādeśo nityaśca tugbhavatīti| dvāvapyetau varṇavidhī, nityastuk
ca ṭhdīrghāt' ityāyameva, yastu ṭhpadāntādvā' iti vikalpitastuk sa
padavidhitvādatra na bhavati| anye tu yaṇādeśo'nityaśca
tugabhavatītyakārapraśleṣaṃ varṇayantaḥ ṭhpadāntādvā' iti
vikalpitastugbhavatīti vyācakṣate| nanvasau padavidhirneti?
āha-tatrantagrahaṇaṃ evaṃ sidhde'ntagrahaṇasyaitatprayojanam-padāntasya
dūrghasya varṇasya vidhistug yathā syāti, dīrghāntasya padasya mā
bhūditi|| 

2 subāmantrite parāṅvatsvare || 2-1-1 || 
parasyāṅgavaditi| tasyaiva
padasyāmantritasyāṅgavadekadeśavadbhavati, tadgrahaṇena gṛhyata
ityarthaḥ| tādātmyātideśo'yamiti| aṅgaśbadasyāvayavavacanatvāt
tasyāmantritasyātmā tadātmā, tasya bhāvastādātmyam,
tatsvabhāvatvamityarthaḥ| etadeva spaṣṭayati-subantamiti| anupraviśati u
antarbhavati, subantāmantritasamudāya ekasminnāmantrite saṃpanne yaḥ
svaraḥ śakyate kartuṃ sa kartavya ityarthaḥ| kaḥ punarasau? ādyaudātatvam,
samudāyasya ca padātparatve nighātaḥ| kuṇḍenāṭanniti| nanvatra sati
tāvatparāṅgavadbhāve samudāyasyādyaudātatvaṃ śeṣanighāmantritaṃ
nihanyate| yadā tarhyaṭannityetatpādādau vartate tadā nāsti nighāta
iti dvayorādyaudātatvaṃ syāt| kiṃ ca puṃlliṅgo'pi
kuṇḍaśabdo'sti-patyau jīvati kuṇḍaḥ syānmṛte bhartari golakaḥ|
iti| 
kuṇḍīti ca jānapadādisūtreṇa ṅīṣi bhavati| paraśunā vṛścanniti|
ṭhāṅparayoḥ khaniśrṛbhyāṃ ḍicca' iti kupratyayāntatvādantodātaḥ
paraśuśabdaḥ, madraśabdaḥ ṭhmadeśca' iti rakpratyayāntaḥ, kaśmīraśabdo
dhṛtāditvādantodātaḥ, ṭhsubantasya parāṅgavadbhāve
tannimitagrahaṇam' tasyāmantritavācyasyārthasya yannimitaṃ
tadabhdhāyyeva subantaṃ parāṅgavadityarthaḥ| udāharaṇeṣu
tṛtīyāntasya tāvannimitatvamastyeva;ṣaṣṭha|lntasyāpyasti, bhṛtyanimitā
hi rājatā, deśanimitā vā| evaṃ goṣu svāminnityatrāpi bhavati|
tannimitatvābhāve tu na bhavati-marutvāṃ indra vṛṣabho raṇāya,
marudbhirindra sakhyaṃ te astu, māyābhirindramāyinam, etenāgne
brahmaṇā vāvṛdhasva, kṣettreṇāgne svāyussambharasva, mitreṇāgne
mitradheye yatasva| subiti kimiti| tannimitagrahaṇādeva tiṅntasya
sidhdo nirāsa iti praśnaḥ| pīḍa|le pūḍa|lmāneti| na hi sūtrakāro
vārtikakāravacanenātivyāptinivāraṇaṃ manyata iti bhāvaḥ| ṭhpīḍa
avagārahane' curādiṇic, ubhayatra karmaṇi laṭ,
ekatrotamaikavacanamiṭ, avapatra śānac, yaki ṇilopaḥ,
ṭhtāsyanudātet' iti iṭo' nudātatvam, yakaḥ pratyayasvaraḥ,
ṭhekādeśa udātenodātaḥ' ityekāra udātaḥ,
pīḍa|lmānetyatrāmantritanighātaḥ| nanu ca samarthagrahaṇānuvatayaivātra na
bhaviṣyati, astya trāpi sāmarthyam, katham? sambodhanapadaṃ kriyāyā eva
viśeṣakam, tathā ca brajāni devadatetyatrāmantritanidhāto bhavati|
uktaṃ ca 
sambodhanapadaṃ yadyatatkriyāyā viśeṣakam| 
brajāni devadateti nidhāto'tra tathā sati|| iti| 
atha vā- hetuhetumadbhāvalakṣaṇo'tra sambandhaḥ, he pīḍa|lmāna
tvatpīḍayāhamapi pīḍa|l iti| gete gārgya iti| gehaśabda
uñchāditvādantodātaḥ, ekasyāmāsanādikāyāṃ kriyāyāṃ dvayorapi
kārakatvātaddvāreṇāsti sāmarthyam| paragrahaṇaṃ kimiti|
sannidhānādāmantritasyayaiva bhaviṣyatīti praśnaḥ| pūrvasya mā bhūditi|
nimitabhāva evāmantritasyopakṣīṇatayā pūrvasyāpi syāditi bhāvaḥ|
evaṃ ca pūrvasyāmantritatvamatantram| gārgyaḥ kuṇḍenāṭannityādāvapi
bhavati sannidhānāt| amantritatvamapi tantramiti ceta; yadyevam,
parameva saṃnihitamiti na pūrvaṃ pratyaṅgatvaprasahgaḥ| devadataḥ
kuṇḍenāṭannityatra pūrvaṃ pratyaṅgatve sati samudāyasyādyaudātatvaṃ
śeṣanighātaḥ| aṭannityāmantritanighāta iti svaraḥ| paragrahaṇe tu sati
devadataśabdasyāmantritādyaudātatvam| tathā kuṇḍenāṭannityamyāpi
nidhātastu na bhavati; ṭhamantritaṃ pūrvamavidyamānavat' iti
devadataśabdasyāvidyamānavatvād| cchansi tu paramapi
pūrvasyāṅgavadṣyate-ā te pitarmarutāṃ sumnametu| putarityanena
saha marutāmityasyāpi nighātaḥ| yathā matpuṇḍībhūtaḥ| tatra subantasya
mṛtpiṇḍātmanā paraṇāmāsambhavādekībhāvapratipādanaparametat|
mṛtpiṇḍa ivaikatāmāpanna ityarthaḥ| yadvā, piṇḍīśabdo'pyasti-praviśa
piṇḍīmiti, tasyāyaṃ prayogaḥ| bhūtaśabdaupamārthaḥ-pitṛbhūta iti
yathā| kimarthaṃ punarevaṃbhūtasyasvaraprāptaye yatna ityata
āha-ubhayorapīti| asatyaṅgagrahaṇe
kāryavyapadeśaśāstrāṇāmanyatamātideśaḥ syād| yathā parasya
kāryamāmantritasya svaraḥ āmantritavyapadeśaḥ svaraśāstraṃ vā, tathā
subantasyāpi tadbhavatīti| evaṃ cobhayorādyaudātatvaṃ syāt| nanu
ca padātparasya nighātādubhayoranudtatvaṃ mā bhūdti vācyam;
satyam, āmantritasyāpādāditve sati, pādāditve taduktam|
vatkaraṇaṃ kimiti| paratra paraśabdaprayogādeva vatyartho lapsyata iti
praśnaḥ| svāśrayamapi yathā syāditi| nānena kvācitkatvamasyocyate|
evaṃ hi viṣayavibhāge na jñāyate-kvāhgavadbhavati? kva neti? nāpi
kādācatkatvam-kadācidaṅgavat, kadācinneti, evaṃ hi sarvatra
vikalpaḥ syāt| tasmādamayatrārtha--asati vadgrahaṇe ām
kuṇḍenāṭanniti sthite aṭannityasya nighāte prāpte
kūṇḍenetyasyānupraveśātkuṇḍenāṭannityekamāmantritaṃ sampannam| na
ca tadekāntaramiti pratiṣedhābhāvānnighāta eva syāt| vatkaraṇe tu
sati aṭannityasya tāvadekāntaratvānnighātapratiṣedhe ādyaudātatvaṃ
prāptam| tasyāṃ daśāyāṃ
kuṇaḍenetyamyānupraveśātsamudāyasyādyaudātatvaṃ bhavati| tadevaṃ
samudāyasyānaikāntaratve'pi aṭannityasya yadekāntaratvaṃ vatkaraṇena
labdhaṃ tenaiva samudāyasya nighātanivṛttirādyaudātatvaṃ ca bhavati|
kūpe sñcanniti| atra parāṅgavadbhāve sati aikapadyatṣatvaprasaṅgaḥ,
svāśrayaṃ padāditvaṃ bhaviṣyati, sarvātideśeṣu hyavirudhdaṃ svāśrayaṃ
bhavati| kiṃ ca nātrātideśikaṃ sakārasya kiñcicchāstrīyaṃ kāryamasti,
ato'pi svāśrayaṃ bhavatyeva, yathā namate daṇḍaḥ svayamevetyatra
yakpratiṣedhe śap| idaṃ tarhi-ṭhcarma namn', atra parāṅgavadbhāve
sati samānapadasthatvāṇṇātvaṃ syāt| satyapi samānapadatve
ṭhparvapadātsaṃjñāyāmagaḥ' iti niyamādasaṃjñāyāṃ na bhaviṣyati| nāyaṃ
niyamasya viṣayaḥ, pūrvapadaśabdo hi samāsāvayave rūḍhaḥ| tena samāsa
e niyam| atha tu pūrvaṃ padaṃ pūrvapadaṃpūrvapadādatyaviśeṣeṇa
niyamo vyākhyāyeta, tataḥ svaragrahaṇaṃ śakyamakartum| akriyamāṇe ca
tasmin, samānādhikaraṇasyopasaṃkhyānamityetadamapi
śakyamakartum| kathaṃ parasyāṅgavadbhāve kṛte ciṇo
luṅnyāyena viṣyabhedāllakṣaṇasyāvṛtau pūrvasyāpi
parāṅgavadbhāvo bhaviṣyati? sati tu svaragrahaṇe svahādanyatra
paraśunā vṛścannityatra vṛścanniti pratipadikam; na ca
pratyayalakṣaṇenāpratyaya iti pratiṣeṣaḥ, ṭhna ṅgiṃbudhdyoḥ' iti
niṣedhālliṅgāt; tatra parāṅgavadbhāvena
prātipadikānupraveśāt ṭhsupo dhātuprātapadikayoḥ' iti subluk
prasajyeta; svahagrahaṇe tu satu subluki kartavye
parāṅgavadbhāvābhāvaḥ? naitadasti; parāṅgavadityāmantritaṃ
saṃnidhānātparaśabdena gṛhyate; tasya rūpasya
sūbantaikāntatvātsubantakārya eva parāṅgavadbhāvaḥ, na
prātipadikakārye| uccairadhīyāneti| uccairnīcaiḥ śabdau
svarādṣvantodātau paṭhitau, adhikaraṇaśaktiprādhānyāñca
tasminnimitaṃ ca || 

3 prākkaḍārātsamāsaḥ || 2-1-3 ||ṭhyathā'sādṛśye' iti
anantarasūtrātikrame na kiñcatkāraṇam| nanu ṭhpratyayaḥ'
ityādivatsamāsa ityeva svaritatvādadhkāro'stu, kiṃ prāgvacanena?
tatrāha-prāgāvacanamiti| prākkaḍārādityavadhitanirdeśa ityarthaḥ|
saṃjñāsamāveśārthamiti| anyathaikasaṃjñādhkārātparyāyaḥ syāt|
avadhinirdeśe tu sati tatsāmarthyātprāggrahaṇamāvartate| tena prāk
samāsasaṃjñā bhavanti, samāsāḥ santo'vyayībhāvādisaṃjñā iti
samāveśasidhdiḥ| atha vā-kaḍārāditi pañcamyaiva prāgiti
dikśabdo'dhyāhariṣyate| na ca prāgityasyādhyāhāraprasaṅgaḥ,
tadadhyāhāre hi ṭhdiksamāse bahuvrīhau' ṭhtṛtīyāsamāse' ṭhdvandve ca '
samāsa ityādyanupapannaṃ syāt; kaḍārātprāṅnirdiṣṭānāṃ
samāsasaṃjñāyā abāvāt| tasmātprāgityevādhyāhariṣyate, nārthaḥ
prāgvacanena, tatrāha-prāgvacanamiti||

4 saha supā || 2-1-4 || 
sahavacanaṃ kimartham, yāvatā tṛtīyaiva sahārthamākṣepsyati, yathā
ṭhvṛdhdo yūnā' iti? sahabhūtayoḥ samāsasaṃjñā yathā syād ekaikasya
mā bhūd; anyathā pūtreṇa sahāgataḥ pitetyatra yathā dvayorapyāgamanena
sambandhaḥ, evaṃ samāsasaṃjñāpi pratyekameva syāt, sahagrahaṇe tu
sahabhūtayorekā saṃjñā bhavati| kiṃ ca syād yadyekaikasya saṃjñā syāt?
iha ṛkpāda iti samāsāntaḥ prasajyeta, dvau ca svarau syātām|
ṭhkṛtadhditasamāsāśca' ityatra tu samāsaśca samāsaścotyokaśeṣo
vyākhyāsyate, tena samāsasamūhasya saṃjñāvidhiniyamārtha iti vākyasya
na bhaviṣyati; anyathā tvekaikasya samāsasya pratyayāntatvādvidhyarthaṃ
samāsakagrahaṇaṃ syat| ṭhsamāsāñca tadviṣayāt' ityatrāpi
prātipadikādityanuvartate, samūhasya ca prātipadikatvam, na
tvekākasya samāsasyeti samāsādityekatvādivakṣayā samūhādeva
sidhdaḥ pratyayaḥ| tadevaṃ samudāyasya yathā syādekaikasya mā bhūditi
sahagrahaṇam| naitadasti prayojanam, ṭhsamāsaḥ' iti mahatī saṃjñā
kriyate-anvarthasaṃjñā yathā vijñāyeta| 
yasminsamudāyo dapadvayaṃ parasparaṃ samasyate sa samāsaḥ| ṭhhalaśca'
ityadhikaraṇe ghañ| tasmādanarthakaṃ sahagrahaṇam tatrāha-sahagrahaṇaṃ
yogavibhāgārthamiti| sahetyeko yogaḥ, subityeva, sup saha
samasyate, kena? padavidhitvātsamarthena| anuvyacaladiti| tatra
subityekatvasya vivakṣitatvādhdeḥ pūrvaṃ samāsaḥ, paścādanoḥ, tatra
nityasamāsatvādhdeḥ śākalābhāvaḥ| samāsānyodātatvaṃ tu na
bhavati;ṭhtiṅṅatiṅaḥ' iti nighātāt| anoḥ ṭhgatirgatau' iti
nighātaḥ, veèryaṇādeśe ṭhudātasvaritayoḥ' ityaṭaḥ svaritatvam|
anye tu-satiśiṣṭṃa samāsānyodātatvaṃ bhavatītyāhuḥ| vibhaktistu
satyapi samāsatvena prātipadikatvena bhavati; tiṇèókatvasyoktatvāt|
yadvā-vacanagrahaṇamukteṣvapyekatvādiṣu yathā syāditi
prathamaikavacanam, halṅyādilopaḥ| evaṃ
caikapadyādāmanuvyacaladdevadateti ṭhāma ekantaramāmantritamanantike'
iti nighātapratiṣedho bhavati| yaugavibhāgaśceṣṭasidhdyartha
ityatiprasaṅgo nīdbhāvanīyaḥ|| 

5 avyayībhāvaḥ || 2-1-5 || 
iha laghvartha saṃjñākaraṇamityekākṣarā saṃjñāṃ kāryā, kimarthaṃ mahatī
kriyate ityāhṛ-anvathasaṃjñā ceyamiti| anavavyayamavyayaṃ
bhavatītyavyayībhāvaḥ, ṭhbhevaterṇa upasaṃkhyānam' iti ṇapratyayaḥ|
anvarthatve kiṃ sidhyatītyata āhateneti|
pūrvapadagraṅṇamavyayasyopalakṣaṇārtham| sūpaprati,
śākapratītyādāvutarapadārthapradhānyānna syātasmādavyayībhāve'vyayārthaḥ
pradhānamiti sūtyate| evaṃ hyavyayānavyayasamudāyo'vyayadharmabhādavyayaṃ
bhavatīti| kiṃ sidhdaṃ bhavati? samṛdhdā madrāḥ samadrā
ityādāvutarapadārthapradhānye'vyayībhāvasyātiprasaṅgaḥ parihṛto
bhavati| pāregaṅgam, dvimuni, unmatagaṅgamityādau caca
vacanādavyayībhāvaḥ| evaṃ cānavyayamavyayaṃ
bhavatītyanvarthatayaivāvyayakāryasyāpi lābhād ṭhavyayībhāvaśca'
ityetadapi na taditi cot, na; atraiva parigaṇayyānvarthatvena vā
viśiṣṭakāryaviṣayamavyayatvamanunīyatām||

6 avyayaṃ
vibhāktasamīpasamṛdhdivyṛdhdyarthābhāvātyayāsampratiśabdaprādurbhāvapaścādyathānupūrvyayaugapadyasādṛśyampatisākanyāntavacaneṣu || 2-1-6 ||
śrutatvādavyayasyaiva vibhaktyadayo viśeṣaṇāni, na
samāsasyetyāha-vibhaktyādiṣviti| samasyata iti| yadyapi ṭhsamāsa' iti
saṃjñāmātraṃ vidhūyate, tathāpyayamabudhavodhanāya bhnnayoḥ śabdayoḥ
saṃśleṣaḥ prakriyāyāṃ kriyata iti ṭhsamasyate' ityuktam| vacanagrahaṇaṃ
pratyekamabhisambadhyata iti| tañca karmasādhanaṃ vibhaktyādibhiḥ
samānādhikaraṇam| vibhaktyādiṣu vācyeṣu yadavyayaṃ varatate u
vibhaktyādīnarthānyadavyayaṃ vakti, dyautayatītyarthaḥ| vibhaktiśabdena
kārakaśaktirabhidhāyate vibhajyate'nayā pratipadikārtha iti kṛtvā|
strīṣvadhikṛtyeti| strīṣu kathā pravartyata ityanvayaḥ| adhikṛtyeti,
prastutyetyarthaḥ| saṃnidhānāñca striya eva prasutatyeti gamyate,
strīviṣayā kathā pravartyata ityarthaḥ| prāyeṇa tu pravartate iti|
atrāhuḥ-adhikṛtya yā kathā mā strīṣu pravartata ikatyarthaḥ, tatra
prastāvane kathane ca karturekatvātsidhdaḥ ktvāpratyaya iti| anye
tvāhuḥ-kṛtyasya kathā kartavyakathetyarthaḥ, sā strīṣu adhipravartate
strīṣvadhāti ca prakriyāvākyam, na tvetatprayogārham; samāsasya
nityatvāt| adhistrīti| ṭhavyayūbhāvaśca' iti napuṃsakatvāda ṭhhrasvo
napuṃsasake' iti hrasvaḥ| saptamyarthe yadavyayamiti| vibhaktivacanatāṃ
darśayati| upakumbhamiti| kumbhasyopeti prakriyāvākyaṃ ṣaṣṭha|lntena
samāsaḥ| duḥśakam duryavanamiti| manuṣyajātivacanau
śakayavanaśabdau, kimarthaṃ punarvṛdhdigrahaṇam, arthābhāva ityeva
sidhdam? na sidhdyati; yena samasyate tadrathasyābhāvo'rthābhāvaḥ, na
cātra śakānāmabhāvaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? tadīyāyā ṛdhdeḥ| arthābhāva
ityarthagrahaṇaṃ yatra dharmisvarūpasyaivābhāvastatra yathā syāt,
dharmamātrapratiṣedhe mā bhūt, tadyathā-brāhmaṇena brāhmaṇyāmutpāditatvena
kasyacidbrāhmaṇatvaṃ prasajya pratiṣedhati-nāyaṃ brāhmaṇo
yastiṣṭhanmūtrayati| itaretarābhāve ca mā bhūt-gauraśco na
bhavatīti; atrāpi vastvantanaṃ pratiṣidhyate, na dharmisvarūpam|
atiśītamityarithābhāvaḥ| kālanavacchinno'bhāva āśvīyate, iha tu
saṃpratyabhāva ityayasya bhedenopādānam| atitaisṛkamiti| tisṛkā
nāma grāmaḥ, ṭhtisṛbhāve saṃjñāyāṃ kanyupasaṅkhyānam' tatra bhavaṃ
taisṛkam u ācchādanam| tacca kālaviśeṣa upabhogyam| uṣṇe śīte
vā atiśabdo nedānīmityasyārthe vartate| upabhogakriyā ca vṛtau
svāvādevāntarbhavati, yathā-dadhyupasikta odano dadhyodana iti|
taddhdareṇa pūrvotarapadayoḥ sāmarthyam, nedānūmupabhogārhaṃ
taisṛkamācchādanamityarthaḥ| ācchādanāpekṣasyāpi daisṛkaśabdasya
gamakatvātsamāsaḥ| nātra taisṛkasya kālānavacchinno bhāvaḥ, nāpi
saṃprati tasāyābhāvaḥ, kiṃ tarhi?
tadupabhogasyetyarthābhāvādatyayāccāsaṃpratibhidyate| tatpāṇinīti|
tacchabdo nipāto'pyasti| pratyarthamiti| arthamarthaṃ pratīti vākyamapyatra
bhavati; bhāṣyaprayogāt| yadi vā nātrāvyayaṃ vīpsāvṛtti, kiṃ tarhi?
karmapravacanūyatvātsamvandhamavacchinati| vīpsā tu dvirvacanadyotyā|
anupūrvasya bhāva ānupūrvyam-brāhmaṇāditvātṣyañ, ṣyañaḥ
ṣitkaraṇātstriyāmapi bhavati tasya prayogaḥ| evaṃ jyeṣṭha
anupūrvyeṇeti| sacakramita| sahaśabdasasya samāsaḥ, ṭhavyībhāve
cākāle' iti sabhāvaḥ, evamutareṣvapyudāharaṇeṣu|
guṇabhūte'pītyādi| yadi ṭhsādṛśye' iti nocyate,
pūrvipadārthapradhāno'vyayībhāva iti yadā sādṛśyaṃ
viśaṃṣyatvātpradhāvanaṃ tadaiva syāt sādṛśyaṃ kikhyeti, guṇabhūte na
syāt| sadṛśaḥ kikhyeti| sādṛśyavataḥ prādhānyadarśanena sādṛśyasya
guṇabhāvaṃ darśayacati| sarikhīti| pūrvavaddhrasvaḥ| apacitaparimāṇaḥ
śrṛṃgālaḥ kikhī| aprasidhdodāhaṇam; cirantanaprayogāt|
sampatiśabdasya samṛdhdau rūḍhatvātpunarupādānaṃ
vyarthamityāśṅkyāha-sampatiranuparūpa ātmabhāva iti| sabrahma
brābhravāṇāmiti| teṣāmanurūpo brahmabhāva ityarthaḥ| satṛṇāmiti| na
cātra tṛṇabhakṣaṇaṃ vāstavamityāha--na kiñcidati|
tṛṇabhakṣaṇamadhiko'rthaḥ, tadvacanena kiṃcidabhyavahāryaṃ na
parityajatītyayamarthaḥ pratipadyate tṛṇāni
bhakṣayankathamanyatparityajediti| paragrahāpekṣayeti|
ṭhidānīmetāvānpradeśo'dhyetavyaḥ' iti yāvataḥ pradeśasya
paragrahastadapekṣayā samāptiḥ u anutaḥ, sa cāsakale'pyadhyayane
bhavatīti bhāvaḥ| sāgnīti| agnyādayaḥ śabdāstadarthe granthā vartante,
tadānīṃ parigṛpītasya pradeśasyāgnyādirantaḥ, na tu tataḥ
pareṇādhyayanaṃ nāsti; tataśca na sākalyamityāha iyamiti|| 

7 yathā'sādṛśye || 2-1-7 || 
sādṛśye samāsasya pūrveṇaiva sidhdatvādasaṃdehārthaṃ sādṛśye
yathetyavacanācca naño'tra praśleṣaḥ| asādṛśye iti kititi| sūtraṃ
kimarthamityarthaḥ| yathā devadata iti | devadatasya yajñadataṃ
pratyupamānatvaṃ yathāśabdo dyotayati|
tatropamānasyopameyāpekṣatve'pi yathā-devadataśabdayoḥ
sāmarthyātparasparema samāsaprasaṅga iti bhāvaḥ| atha pūrveṇātra sādṛśya
iti vā, yathārtha iti vā kasmānna bhavatītyāha pūrveṇaiveti|| 

8 yāvadavadhāraṇe || 2-1-8 || 
yāvanti pātrāṇīti| yāvadityavyayaṃ cāsti, tadhditāntaṃ ca vidyate,
ato nityamasāse'pi tadhditāntena vigrahaḥ|

9 suppratinā mātrārthe || 2-1-9 || 
astyatra kicitsūpa iti kiñcidityavyayaṃ sūpa iti puṃlliṅgena
samānādhikaraṇam| subiti vartamāna iti| ṭhsubāmantrite' ityataḥ|
avyayanivṛtyarthamiti| pūrvahi subgrahaṇamavyayagrahaṇena saha vigrahaḥ
kṛtaḥ| svarādīnāṃ ca doṣāmanyamahaḥ, divāmanyā rātririti
vṛttiviṣayo satvapradhānatādarśanānmātrāvati
vṛttiravirudhdetyavyasyaiva samāsaḥ syāt|| 

10 akṣaśalākāsaṅkhyā pariṇā || 2-1-10 || 
akṣaśālākāsaṅkyāśabdā iti| akṣaśalākāśabdau sahkyāvācinaśca
śabdā ityarthaḥ| kvacitu-akṣaśabdaḥ śalākāśabdaḥ saṅkhyāśabdāścoti
pāṭhaḥ| kitavavyavahāra iti kitavā u dyauutakārāḥ, teṣāṃ
vyavahāle'kṣaśalākānāṃ pātataṃ tatraivāyaṃ samāsa iṣyate,
etaccābhudhānasvābhāvyāllabhyate| karva utānā iti| śalākānāmapi
prakṛtatvātsarve ca sarvāśca sarve, utānāśca utānāśca utānāḥ,
avāścaścāvācyaśācāvāñcaḥ, ṭhpumānstriyā' iti puṃsaḥ śeṣaḥ|
tasyaivāsyeti| pātayiturityarthaḥ| vipātaḥ u parājayaḥ| anyathāpāte
sati, jaye yādṛśaḥ pātaḥ sarve utānāḥ patantyavāñco veti
tato'nyādṛśeṣu keṣucjutāneṣu, keṣucidavākṣu patatsivatyarthaḥ|
akṣeśeti| vṛtāpekṣayā kartari tṛtīyā| parameṇeti| atiśayenātaḥ
paramityarthaḥ pañcaparūti na bhavatīti yāvat| asyopapadānaṃ slokena
kriyate| pañcasu tvekarūpeṣviti| atrāpi puṃsaḥ śeṣaḥ| ekarūpāsviti
prāyeṇa pāṭhaḥ| tatra śalākānāmeva grahaṇam| jaya eva bhaviṣyatīti|
lṛṭo'rtho mṛgyaḥ, yataḥ pañcasvekarūpeṣu jaya eva bhavati, tena
parameṇa catuḥparītyanvayaḥ| akṣādayastṛcīyāntā iti| anyathā
vṛtāvayaṃ samāsa iṣyate, tatra cākṣādīnāṃ kartṛtvātaḥtīyaiva
yukteti bhāvaḥ| pūrvektasyeti| pūrvavṛtasyetyarthaḥ|
anekārthatvādhdātūnāṃ vaciriha vartane vartate, tadeva yathā na
taditi tacchabdena parāmṛśyate| pūrvajaye vṛtasyākṣāderyathā
datvṛtamabhūt, yadi saṃprati tathā na bhavati evaṃ samāso
bhavatītyarthaḥ| pūrvoktasyeti sāmānyāpekṣamekavacanam|
jayakāle'kṣādīnāṃ yadekarūpaṃ vartanaṃ tadhdiparīte vartane pariṇā
dyotye samāsa iti yāvat| ekateva'kṣaśalākayoriti|
akṣaśalākāśabdayorekavacanāntayoḥ samāsa ityarthaḥ|
idamapyabhidhānasvābhāvyādeva labhyate, anthā ṭhrājapuruṣaḥ'
ityādāvivābhedaikatvamavagamyeta, na tu śudhdamekatvam| prāyeṇa tu
ṭhkitavavyavahāre ca ekatve'kṣaśalākayoḥ' iti ślokarūpema paṭha|lte,
tatrārthāntaraṃ mṛgyaṃ saṃhitākāryaprasaṅgaśca| kitavavyavahāra iti
kim? akṣeṇedaṃ na tathā vataṃ yathā pūrvaśakaṭe| ekatva iti kim?
akṣābhyāmakṣairvā idaṃ na tathā vṛtam| akṣādaya iti kim?
prasaṅgenedaṃ na tathā pūrvajaye, pariṇeti vacanātsubantamātreṇa na
bhavati|| 

11 vibhāṣā || 2-1-11 ||

12 apaparibahirañcavaḥ pañcamyā || 2-1-12 || 
nanu bahiḥśabdena yoge na kenacitpañcamī vidhīyate, tatkathaṃ yasya
pañcamyantena samāsaḥ? bahirgato grāmādityatra tvasāmarthyānnaiva
samāsena bhavitvayamata āha-bahiḥśabdeneti| na ca vacanasāmarthyādvahiḥ
śabdasyāpañcamyantena samāso bhavatviti vācyam; pañcamīgrahaṇād|
iha hyapapariśabdau parasparasāhacaryayādvarjanārthau gṛhyate, tau ca
karmapravacanīyau, tadyauge ca pañcamyeva vihitā|
añcatirapyapaparisāhacaryādavyayameva gṛhyate,
tadyoge'pyañcūtarapadalakṣaṇā pañcamyevāsti| tadetatpañcamīgrahaṇaṃ
jñāpayati-ṣaṣṭhīviṣaye bahiryoge pañcamī bhavatīti| 

13 āṅ maryādābhividhyoḥ || 2-1-13 || 
ṭhmaryādābhividhyoḥ' iti śakyamakatuṃm, katham? pañcamyeti
vartate, āṅa ca karmapravacanūyenaiva yoge pañcamī vihitā,
etayośyaivārthayorāṅḥ karmapravacīyasaṃjñā-ṭhāṅ maryādāvacane' iti|
tatra hi vacanagrahaṇaṃ maryādoktimātre yathā syād ityabhividhāvapi
bhavati| tatraiva vā'bhividhigrahaṇamevāstu|| 

14 lakṣaṇenābhipratī ābhimukhye || 2-1-14 || 
abhyāgna, pratyagnīti| agni pratīti vigrahaḥ, ṭhabhirabhāge'
ṭhlakṣaṇetthambhūta' iti abhipratyoḥ karmapravacanīyatvād dvitīyā|
tatrāgnirlakṣaṇam, tena hi śalābhānāṃ pāto lakṣyate, abhipratī ca
lakṣyalakṣaṇabhāvaṃ dyotayitvābhimukhyamapi dyotayataḥ| srughnaṃ pratigata iti
yena deśenāgnirgatasteneti pratītirbhavati,
gamanasyāgnirlakṣaṇabhābhimukhyaṃ cāsti, ṭhyena-tena' śabdena saha
samāsaḥ syāt| abhyaṅkāḥ, pratyaṅkāḥ iti| abhinavo'ṅka āsām,
pratinavo'ṅka āsāmiti bahuvrīhiḥ| aṅko'tra bhavati gavāṃ
lakṣaṇam, ābhimukhyaṃ tu nāsti| nanu ca sati saṃbhave'vyayārthe
pradhāne'vyībhāva ityuktam, kathamatra prasaṅgaḥ? evaṃ
tarhyetajjñāpayati-bhavatiyatra prakaraṇe bahuvrīhiviṣaye'vyayībhāva iti|
tena ṭhsaṃkhyā vaṃśyena', dvimuni vyākaraṇamityetatsidhdaṃ bhavati|| 

15 anuryatsamayā || 2-1-15 || 
yatsamayeti ṣaṣṭhīsamāso'yam| kathaṃ punaḥ samāyāśabdena yoge
ṣaṣṭhī, yāvatā ṭhabhitaḥ paritaḥ samayā' iti dvitāyayā bhavitavyam?
naiṣa doṣaḥ; samayāśbadasya mukhyo'rthaḥ sāmīpyam, tadyoge dvitīyā|
iha tu samayāśabdavācinyanuśabde samayāśabdo vartate,
tadāha--anaryatsamayā| samayāvācīti| yasya samayeti ko'rthaḥ?
samayāvācītyarthaḥ, tadiha mukhyenārthenāyogad dvitīyā na bhavati,
ṣaṣaṭha|leva tu bhavati, tasyāśca samāsaḥ| na ca pūraṇaguṇeti pratiṣedhaḥ;
anavyayatvāt| sāmīpye hi vartamāna-
samayāśabdo'satavavācitvādavyayam| iha tvanūśabdārthe vartate, tatra
yathā ṭhabhirābhāge' ityādāvanukaraṇasyāvyayasaṃjñā na bhavati,
tathāsyāpi| evaṃ ca yatsamayetyavibhaktikaḥ sautro nirdeśaḥ| vṛtāvapi
yatsamayeti sūtrānukaraṇena vibhaktyabhāvaḥ| teneti| tadvācinā
śabdenetyarthaḥ| anuvanamiti| vanasyānviti sāmūpyasambandhe
ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ, asyārthamāha-vanaṃ samayeti|| 

16 yasya cāyāmaḥ || 2-1-16 || 
lakṣaṇeneti vartata iti| anyathā āyāmo gaṅgāyā
ityasyārthe'nugaṅgamiti syāt|
atrāpyāyāmavācitvādanurevāyāmaśabdenocyate, ityāha
anuryasyāyāmavācīti| anugaṅga vārāṇasīti| ṣaṣṭha|lntena
gaṅgāśabdena samāsaḥ| gaṅgāyā anviti| āyāmo lakṣamatvaṃ cānunā
dyotyate, lakṣaṇasya lakṣyāpekṣatvāllakṣyaṃ samāsārtha
ityarthādupamānopameyabhāve samāsa iti vārāṇasyā
sāmānādhikaraṇyam-gaṅgāyā ivāyāmo yasyāḥ, gaṅgevāyatā
vārāṇasītyarthaḥ| tadvadatyantāyatetyartha iti kecit| tathā ca
ṭhanugaṅgametatsutram' ityekaśeṣasūtre bhāgavṛttikāraḥ prayuṅkte|
neti vayam| kiṃ prāgāyatā vārāṇasī? utodagāyatā? iti saṃdehe
idamucyate-anugaṅgaṃ vārāṇāsīti, yathodagāyatā gaṅgā
tathodagāyatā vārāmasītyarthaḥ| gaṅgāyāmānusāreṇa
vārāṇasyāyāma ityarthaḥ| yamunāyāmena mathurāyāmo lakṣyata iti| na
yamunā svarūpeṇa lakṣaṇam, kiṃ tarhi? āyāmena, mathurāpi na svarūpeṇa
lakṣyam, kiṃ tarhi? āyāmena| tatra
prāptāptavivekenedamucyate-yamunāyāmena mathurāyāmo lakṣyata
iti|| 

17 tiṣṭhadguprabhṛtīni ca || 2-1-17 || 
samudāyā eva nipātyanta iti | gaṇe tathā pāṭha eva teṣāṃ
nipātanam| tena śatṛśānajādyapi bhavati| ṭhsupo
dhātuprātipadikayoḥ' iti ca prakriyākāryaṃ na kartavyamiti bhāvaḥ|
avyayībhāvasaṃjñāni bhavantīti| samāsasaṃjñāpi vidheyā, antodātatvaṃ
ca | prātipadakasaṃjñā ca yathā syāditi| tiṣṭhadgu kālaviśeṣa iti|
kālaviśeṣa ityetadutarairapi sambadhyate, ata evānte vakṣyati-ṭhete
kālaśabdāḥ' iti, etāvānkālaviśeṣa ityasyādhikāra ityarthaḥ|
vibhaktyantareṇa na samābadhyante iti| avyatirikta eva prātipadikārthe
prayoga eṣāṃ kartavyaḥ, nānyatretyarthaḥ| anyapadārthe ca vartanta iti|
tiṣṭhadgu, vahadgu, āyatīgavamityetairapyasya sambandhaḥ; anyathā
kālaśabdatvāyogāt| cakāro'vadhāraṇārtha iti|
anekārthatvānnipātānām| aparaḥ samāso na bhavatīti| vṛtyantaraṃ na
bhavatītyarthaḥ| ṭhātiṣṭhadgujapansadhyām' iti tu pañcamyā ṭhavyayāt'
iti luk, na samāsaḥ| tiṣṭhadgu, vahadgviti| laṭaḥ śatrādeśo
nipātanāt, ṭhgostriyoḥ' iti hrasvaḥ| āyatīvagamityatra tu
puṃvadbhāvābhāvaḥ śatrādeśayaḥ samāsantaśca| khaleyavaṃ khalebusamiti
saptamyā aluk| lūyamānayavādiṣu śānajādeśaḥ| samabhūmi,
samapadātīti|| samatvaṃ bhūmaeriti pūrvapadārthaprādhānye'vyayībhāvaḥ|
kacit samaṃbhūmi samaṃpadātīti pāṭhaḥ, tatra pūrvapadasya mumāgamaḥ|
anye tu saṃbhūmi saṃpadātīti paṭhanti, tatra samasyāntalopaḥ,
saṃśabdasya vā samāsaḥ| suṣāmādau śobhanatvaṃ samasya vigatatvaṃ
duṣṭatvaṃ nirgatatvamapagatatvaṃ samasyeti| vigrahaḥ| āyatosamā
āyatīsamam, śatrādeśaḥ, pūrvavat puṃvadbhāvaśca | samā u
saṃvatsaraḥ| evaṃ pāpasamaṃ puṇyasamamiti| prāhvādiṣu caturṣu
pragatatvamahna ityādivigrahaḥ| saṅgataṃ pratigatamasya samprati|
viparītam asamprati| ic karmavyatīhāra iti| ayameva
dvidaṇḍa|ladiṣvapi vidhīyata iti tatrāpyavyayībhāvaḥ| daṇḍādaṇḍīti|
daṇḍeśca daṇḍèaśca prahṛtyedaṃ yudhdaṃ pravṛtam, ṭhtatra tenedamiti
sarūpe' iti bahuvrīhiḥ| ṭhanyeṣāmapi dṛśyate' iti pūrvapadasya
dīrghaḥ| ica avyayībhāvatvenāvyayatvātsupo luk|| 

18 pāre madhye ṣaṣṭha|la vā || 2-1-18 || 
vāvacanāditi| nanu mahāvibhāṣayaivāpavāde'vyayībhāve vikalpite
pakṣe ṣaṣṭhī samāso'pi bhaviṣyati, so'pi vikalpita iti vākyamapi
bhaviṣyati? ucyate--iha vākyenābhidhāne prāpte vṛttirārabhyamāṇā
vākyasya bādhikā prāpnotīti vikalpena vākyameva
pakṣe'bhyanujñāyate| tatrāpavādavikalpo vākyasyaiva prāpaka
ityutsargasya nityo bādhakaḥ syād, vāvacanātso'pi
pakṣe'bhyanujñāyata iti trairūpyasidhdiḥ| etadeva vāvacanaṃ
jñapakam--yatrotsargāpavādau mahāvibhāṣayā vikalpitau
tatrāpavādena mukte utsargo na bhavatīti| tena pūrvaṃ
kāyasyetyatraikadeśisamāsena mukte ṣaṣṭhīsamāso na bhavati,
dakṣasyāpatyaṃ dākṣirityatra iñā mukte'ṇna bhavati| ekārāntatvanipātanaṃ
yatra saptamyartho na sambhavatipāregaṅgādānayeti, tadartham| mbave
tu ṭhtutpuruṣe kṛti bahulam' iti bahulavacanādalukā sidhdam || 

19 saṃkhyā vaṃśyena || 2-1-19 || 
ekalakṣaṇa iti| ekasvabhāvaḥ santānaḥ u sambandhaḥ,
santānināmekalakṣaṇatvātsantānasyaikalakṣaṇatvam| dvau munī iti|
pāṇinikātyāyanau| trimunīti| tau ca bhāṣyakāraśca| janmanā
tvekalakṣaṇasyodāharaṇam-ekaviṃsati bhāradvājamiti| yadā tu vidyayā
saheti ṭhlakṣaṇenābhipratī' ityatra prakārāntareṇāpyayamarthaḥ sādhitaḥ || 

20 nadībhiśca || 2-1-20 || 
nadīvacanaiḥ śabdairiti| nadībhiriti bahuvacananirdeśātsvarūpasya
saṃjñā nadyāśca grahaṇamiti bhāvaḥ| samāhāre cāyamiṣyata iti| anyathā
purastādapavādanyāyena ṭhpūrvakālaika' ityasyāyaṃ bādhakaḥ syāt|
samāhāre tu paratvād dviguheva syāt,
tataścaikanadītyatrāvyayībhāve sati tannibandhanaḥ
ṭhnadīpaurṇamāsyāgrahāyaṇībhyaḥ' iti ṭac prāpnoti napuṃsakatvaṃ ca,
na hyatra viśeṣavācināmeva grahaṇamiti pramāṇamasti| yastu
ṭhgodāvaryāśca nadyaśca' ityac samāsāntaḥ, sa
pañcanadamityādāvavyayībhāva eva bhavati, ekanadītyatra tatpuruṣe na
bhavati| samāhāravivakṣāyāṃ ca ekāpūpīvadekanadamityapi bhavati|
tathānyapadārthe'pyavyayībhāvaḥ syād dvīrāvatīko deśa iti| na cātra
paratvādvahuvrīhiḥ; aśeṣatvāt, na hyasati samāhāragraṇe'yaṃ śeṣo
bhavati| tasmātsuṣṭhūaktam - samāhare cāyamiṣyata iti|
etaccābhidhānasvābhāvyāllabhyate|| 

21 anyapadārthe ca saṃjñāyām || 2-1-21 || 

22 tatpuruṣaḥ || 2-1-22 || 
utarapadārthapradhāna iti| pūrvākāyaḥ, ardhdapippalītyādau tvadhikāra
vaśātatpuruṣa iti saṃjñā|| 

23 dviguśca || 2-1-23 || 
samāsāntā iti| yadyapi ṭhrājāhaḥsakhibhyaṣṭac' ṭhtatpuruṣasyāṃguleḥ
saṃkhyāvyayādeḥ' iti ṭajacau tatpuruṣanibandhanau, tathāpi
prakṛtibhedādbhedavivakṣayāṃ vahuvacanam| pañcarājamiti|
ukatarapadasyānakārāntatvātstrītvābhāvaḥ| samāsārthotarapadasyāntāḥ
samāsāntā iti tu pakṣe pātrāditvāt| kvacat pañcarājīti
strīlṅgasya pāṭhaḥ, sa bhāṣyavirodhādapapāṭhaḥ| dvyaha iti|
1ṭhahnaṣṭakhoreva' iti ṭilopaḥ, ṭhrātrāhnāhāḥ puṃsi'| pañcagavamiti|
ṭhgoratadhditaluki' iti ṭac, pūrvavatstrītvābhāvaḥ|| 

24 dvitīyāḥ śritātītapatitagatātyastaprāptāpannaḥ || 2-1-24 || 
śritādiṣu gatyarthatvātkartari ktaḥ| patirapi sakarmakaḥ, nejjihmāyanto
narakaṃ patāmeti yathā| atyāsaḥ u vyatikramaḥ, gativiśeṣa eva|
prāptirapyatra gatireva, na phalam| evamāpatirapi| iha
śritapatitagatairayaṃ sāso na vidheyaḥ, katham? yaḥ kaṣṭṃa śritaḥ kaṣṭṃa
tena śritaṃ bhavati tatra bahuvrīhiṇā sidhdam; nārthabhedaḥ, na
rūpabhedaḥ, na svarabhedaḥ| tatpuruṣe'pi ṭhahīnedvitīyā' iti
śritapatitāgebhyaḥ purvapadaprakṛtisvara eva bhavati| atītādibhistu
svarasidhdaye vidheyaḥ, tathā hi- taistatpuruṣe thāthādisvareṇa
bhāvyam, nāhīnasvareṇa; ṭhatītātyastayorahīne' iti niṣedhāt,
prāptāpannayostvahīne dvitīyānupasarga iti vacanāt| bahuvrīhau tu
pūrvapadaprakṛtitasvareṇa bhāvyam, tasmācchritādibhirayaṃ samāso na
vidheyaḥ| tatrāyamabyarthaḥ, ṭhahīne dvitīyā' ityetadapi na vaktavyaṃ
bhavati| jātisvaraprasaṅgastu, yadā jātikālasukhādibhyaḥ pare
śritādayo bhavanti tadā pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaraṃ bādhitvā
ṭhjātikālasukhādibhyo'nācchādanāt' ityantodātatvaprasaṅgaḥ| nanu
ca tatpuruṣārambho'pi bahuvrīhyarthavivakṣāyāṃ na daṇḍavārito
bahuvrīhiriti jātisvaraḥ syādeva? evamapyasti bhedaḥ, tatpuruṣe
ṭhahīne dvitīyaa' iti pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaraḥ, bahuvrīho ṭhjātikāla'
ityantodātatvamiti dvausvarau bhavataḥ; anārambhe tu jātisvara eva
syāditi| evaṃ tarhi yadetadvā jāta iti tadvā
jātaśritapatitagateṣviti vaktavyam? evamapi ṭhahīne dvitīyā'
ityetadapi na vaktavyamityastyeva lāghavam| etāvāÄstu viśeṣaḥ -
tatpuruṣārambhe tatra pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratvam, bahuvrīhau tu
jātisvara iti dvayoḥ samāsayodvêasvaryam; anārambhe tu
bahuvrīhāveva dvaisvaryamiti? atrocyate -
jātikālasukhādivyatiriktaiḥ saha bahuvrīhau śritādīnāṃ niṣṭheti
pūrvanipādaprasaṅgādrūpabhetaḥ, tathā sarvatra kabapi prāpnoti|
nanvasau ṭhśeṣādvibhāṣā' iti vikalpitaḥ, sa ca tatpuruṣārambhe'pi
bhavatyeva, bahuvrīherapyabhyupagamāt? evamapi bahuvrīhāvapi
dvaisvaryābhyupagamātpurvapadaprakṛtisvarapakṣe'pi
bahuvrīhitvānapāyātpakṣe kapaḥ prasaṅgaḥ; tatpuruṣārambhe tu tatraiva
ṭhahīne dvanitāyā' iti pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaraḥ, bahuvrīhau tu
jātisvara eva nityamityantodātādeva kabna
pūrvapadaprakṛtisvarādityastyeva viśeṣaḥ| tathā'rthabhejo'pi
ṭhgatyarthākarmaka' iti kartari kto dhātvarthasya
sarvātmanā'niṣṭhitatve'pi bhavati - āruḍho vṛkṣaṃ devadata iti
vṛkṣasya evocyate| karmaṇi tu bhavansarvātmanā niṣṭhatatve bhavati -
ārūḍho vṛkṣo devadateneti, tathehāpi kaṣṭṃa śrita iti
kaṣṭamanubhavannevamucyate, kaṣṭṃa śritamanenetyanubhūtakaṣṭaḥ
śritaśabadavivakṣitasyārthasya sākṣādavagatirbhavati tatpuruṣe|
bahuvrīhau tvarthāt, tadyathā - rājñaḥ sakhetyukte nūnaṃ hājāpyasya
sakheti sa eṣa sūkṣmadṛśāmeva viṣayaḥ| gamigāmyādīnāmiti|
uṇādīnāmanyeṣāṃ ca saṃgrahārthamubhayorupādānam| grāmaṃ gamīti|
ṭhgameriniḥ' ityauṇādika inipratyayaḥ ṭhbhaviṣyati gamyādayaḥ' iti
bhaviṣyati kāle| grāmaṃ gāmīti| āvaśyake ṇini| ṭhgatyārthakarmaṇi'
ityatra dvitīyāgrahaṇamapavādaviṣaye'pi vidhānārthamiti kṛtprayoge
dvitīyaiva bhavati| oganaṃ bubhukṣuriti| bhujeḥ san, ṭhsanāśaṃsabhikṣa
uḥ'| ṭhna lokāvyaya' iti ṣaṣṭhīniṣedhaḥ|| 

25 svayaṃ ktena || 2-1-25 ||
ṭhdhāvu gatiśudhdyoḥ', ṭhudito vā' iti ktvāyāṃ
vikalpiteṭtvāt ṭhyasya vibhāṣā' itīṭpratiṣedhaḥ, ṭhcchavoḥ
śūḍanunāsike ca' ityūṭha, ṭhetyedatyūṭhasu' iti vṛdhdiḥ|
svayaṃvilīnamiti| ṭhlīṅ śleṣaṇe', ṭhsvādayaoditaḥ', ṭhoditaśca'
iti niṣṭhānatvam, kṛda«ahaṇe gatikārakapūrvasyāpi
grahaṇādvilīnaśabdaḥ ktāntaḥ| aikapadyamaikasvarye samāsatvāditi| samasanaṃ
samāsaḥ, saṃjñā vā, tato hetorityarthaḥ || 

26 khaṭvā kṣepe || 2-1-26 || 
khaṭvārohaṇaṃ catyādi| vinindito mārgaḥ u vimārgaḥ|
bhūmiśayanārho brahmacārī, vedādhyayanakāle tenādhītya snātvā
gurubhiranujñātena khaṭvā roḍhavyā| yatvanyathā khaṭvārohaṇaṃ
tadvimārgaprasthānam| taccodāharaṇamanyasyāpyevaṃvidhasyopalakṣaṇam,
tena khaṭvāmārohatu mā vā'rukṣadvimārgaprasthitaḥ khaṭvārūḍha
ityucyata ityarthaḥ| 

27 sāmī || 2-1-27 || 
tasyāsatvavācitvāditi| dravyādhārā hi karmaśaktiḥ; ato dravyavācina
eva dvitāyā bhavati, nādravyavācina ityarthaḥ||
