28 kālāḥ || 2-1-28 || 
iha ṭhkālā atyantasaṃyoge' ityeko yogaḥ kartavyaḥ, tatra ṭhktena'
ityasya nivṛtatvātsarvatra samāsaḥ sidhdyati, kimarthaṃ yogavibhāge
ktāntena samāso vidhīyata ityata āha - anatyantasaṃyogārtha
vacanamiti| anatyantasaṃyogameva darśayati - ṣaṇmuhūrtā iti|
carācarā iti| careḥ pacādyaci ṭhcaricalipativadīnāmupasaṃkhyānamāk
cābhāyāsasya' iti dvirvacanamāgāgamaścābhyāsasyeti|
caranto'navasthitā ityarthaḥ| kadācidahariti| utarāyaṇe|
kadācidrātrimiti| dakṣiṇāyane| tatastaiśca ṣaḍbhirmuhūrtairahno
rātreśca nāstyatyantasaṃyogaḥ| māsapramita iti| māṅ ādikarmaṇi
kartari ktaḥ, māsaṃ paricchetumārabdhavānityarthaḥ| pratipaccandramā iti|
na ca tena māsasyātyantasaṃyoga iti bhāvaḥ|| 

29 atyantasaṃyoge ca || 2-1-29 || 

30 tṛtīyā tatkṛtārthena guṇavacanena || 2-1-30 || 
tṛtīyāyāścchandase luki ṭhgūṇavacanena' ityanena sāmānādhikaraṇyam|
artheneti pṛthak padam, ata eva guṇavacanenārthaśabdena ceti|
kīdṛśena guṇavacanena? tatkṛteneti| taditi sarvanāmnā prakṛtasya
tṛtīyāntasya pratyavamarśaḥ, sa ca śabdaḥ| na ca śabdena guṇavacanasya
karaṇaṃ sambhavatītyataḥ sāmarthyātadarthakṛteneti vijñāyata ityāha -
tṛtīyāntārthakṛteneti| yāvaditi| yāvacchabado
nipātastātparyaparyāyatāṃ darśayati| arthadvārakaṃ cedaṃ guṇavacanasya
viśeṣayaṇam, artha eva hi tṛtīyārthena kriyate, na guṇavacanaḥ śabdaḥ|
vacanagrahaṇaṃ kim, yāvārthena samāsāsambhavād guṇavacanevaiva
bhaviṣyati? evaṃ yathā vijñāyetaguṇamuktavān guṇavacanaḥ,
ṭhkṛtyalyuṭaḍo bahulam' iti lakṣito gṛhyate, na tu yasya guṇasya hi
bhāvād dravye śabdaniveśa iti tacchabdapravṛttinimitam;
tṛtāyāntārthakṛte sarvatraiva tasya bhāvāt| śaṃkulākhaṇḍaḥ, kirikāṇa
iti| ṭhkhaḍi bhedane', ṭhkaṇa nimīlane' ityābhyāṃ ghañi
vyutpāditāvetau kriyārūpāpanne gaṇe
vartitvānmatublopādabhedopacārādvā tdavati dravye varteta iti
guṇavacanau bhavataḥ| dhānyenārtha iti| arthyata ityarthaḥ u prayojanam,
arthanaṃ vārthaḥ u prārthanā, abhilāṣaḥ| sarvatra karaṇe tṛtīyāyaaḥ
samāsaḥ| akṣṇā kāṇa iti| nātrākṣṇatm, kiṃ tarhi? anyenaiva kenāpi
kiryādinā, akṣṇā tu kevalaṃ kāṇo lakṣyata iti tatkṛtatvābhāvaḥ|
kiṃca daghnā paṭuanityatra mā bhūdityevamarthamapi tatkṛtagrahaṇaṃ
kartavyam| nanu yadi dadhikṛtaṃ pāṭavaṃ vivakṣitam - dadhnā kṛtaḥ
paṭuariti, tato bhavitavyameva samāsena; atha bhojanādyapekṣo dadhnaḥ
karaṇabhāvaḥ - dadhnā bhuṅkte paṭuariti, tato'sāmarthyādeva na
bhaviṣyati? ihāpi tarhi na syāt - kuaṃkumena lohitaṃ kopenaṃ
mukhamiti, atrāpi hi korotikriyayā karaṇsaya sambandhaḥ -
kuaṃkumena kṛtaṃ lohitāmiti| kva tarhi syāt? śaṃkulayā khaṇḍa
ityādāveva tu syāt, yatra pūrvotarapadayoḥ kriyākārakalakṣaṇaḥ
sambandhaḥ| tasmādyatrotarapade kriyā na gamyate tatrāpi tatkṛtatve sati
yathā syādbhojanādidvārake sāmarthye mā bhūditi tatkṛtagrahaṇam|
guṇavacaneneti kimiti| jātivacaneṣu
jāternityatvātatkṛtasyāsambhavaḥ| kriyāvacane tviṣyata eva|
ṭhkartṛkaraṇe kṛtā bahulam' iti dravyavāciṣvapi tatkṛtasyāsambhava
eva| na hyākāśasya tatvaṃ kenacit kriyate, ato guṇavacanenaiva
bhaviṣyatīti praśnaḥ| gobhirvapāvāniti|
gosambandhidadhyādyaupayogādeva tasya vapāvatvaṃ pūvaratvamityasti
tatkṛtatvam, na tvasau guṇavacanaḥ|| 

31 pūrvasadṛśasamonārthakalahanipuṇamiśraślakṣṇaiḥ || 2-1-31 || 
pūrvasūtre'rthaśabdena samāsasya
sādhtatvādihārthagrahaṇamarthanirdeśārtam| taccānantareṇonaśabdenaiva
sambadhyate, na pūrvādibhiḥ; samasadṛśabdayoḥ pṛthagupādānāt|
etadevetyādi| samasadṛśaśabdābhyāmnyatredaṃ tadyoge tulyārthairiti
tṛtīyāsti| iha tulyārthayoge ṣaṣṭha|lpi pakṣe vidhīyate, tatastasyāḥ
samāse mātuḥ sadṛśo mātṛsadṛśa iti sidhdam, kimarthamiha
sadṛśagrahaṇam? ṭhtatpuruṣe tulyārthatṛtīyā' iti
pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaro yathā syāt, sidhdo'tra prakṛtisvaraḥ -
ṭhsatṛśapratirūpayoḥ sādṛśye' iti | tacca tatra sadṛśagrahaṇamavaśyaṃ
kartavyam, yadā ṣaṣṭhīsamāsastadāntodātatvaṃ mā bhūditi| nanu
cedānīmanabhidhānāt ṣaṣṭhīsamāso na bhaviṣyati? naivaṃ śakyam,
anuksamāse hi doṣaḥ syāt, 
ṭhṣaṣṭha|la ākrośe' - dāsyāḥ sadṛśaḥ, vṛṣalyāḥ sadṛśa iti,
tasmātatkartavyam, idaṃ tu na kartavyam? idamapi kartavyam,
hetutṛtīyārthaṃ vidyayā hetunā sadṛśo vidyāsadṛśa iti, na hyatra
ṭhtulyārthaiḥ' iti ṣaṣṭhī bhavati, pratiyoginyeva hi sā vidhīyate|
evamapi na kartavyam - tatkṛtatatvātpurveṇaiva sidhdam, yo hi
vidyayā sadṛśaḥ, vidyākṛtaṃ hi tatsādṛśyam, tatra pūrveṇaiva sidhdam|
ṭhmiśragrahaṇe sopasargasyāpi grahaṇam' guḍasaṃmiśrā dhānā
ityevamartham? jñāpakātsidhdam, yadayaṃ ṭhmiśraṃ cānupasargamasandhau'
ityanupasargagrahaṇaṃ karoti, tajjñāpayati - miśragrahaṇe
sopasargasyāpi grahaṇamiti| pūrvādiṣviti| avaraśabdo'pi sūtre
paṭhitavya ityarthaḥ|| 

32 kartṛkaraṇe kṛtā bahulam || 2-1-32 || 
ṭhkartṛkaraṇe' iti prathamādvivacanam| vṛtau vastuvyākhyānaṃ kṛtam -
kartari karaṇe ca yā tṛtīyeti| tathā cotaratra vakṣyati ṭhkartṛkaraṇe
kṛtyaiḥ sahādhikārthavacane samasyete' iti|
parvopādhivyabhicārārthamiti| avyāptyativyāptiparihārthamityarthaḥ|
pādahāraka iti| hriyata iti hāraka iti ṭhkṛtyalyuṭo bahulam' iti
karmaṇi ṇvul, pādābhyāmityapādānapañcamyantasya samāsaḥ| gale
copaka iti| ṭhcupa mandāyāā gatau', hetumaṇṇijantātkarmaṇi ṇvul,
ṭhamūrdhdamastakāt' yatyulk| kṛdrahaṇamanartakam; anyasyābhāvāt| iha
kartṛkaraṇa kriyāyā eva bhavataḥ kriyā ca dhātuvcyā, dhtośca dvaye
pratyayāḥ - kṛtastiṅśca| tatra supetyadhikārātiṅnte na prasaṅgaḥ|
tadvitanivṛtyarthaṃ tu - iha kāṣṭhèaḥ pacatitarām, kāṣṭhèaḥ
pacatirūpam, kāṣṭhèaḥ pacatideśyam, hastena kṛtapūrvī, dadhnā
bhuktapūrvī, dhṛteneṣṭīti|| 

33 kṛtyairadhikāryavacane || 2-1-33 || 
stutinindāprayuktamiti| stutyā nindayā ca pravartitaṃ stotuṃ
ninditaṃ ca kṛtamityarthaḥ| adhyāropitārthavacanamiti|
asannevāropito'dhyāropitaḥ| kākapeyeti| evaṃ nāma pūrṇatoyā
nadī yataṭasthaiḥ kākairapi śakyā pātumiti stutiḥ; evaṃ
nāmālpatoyā catkākairapi śakyā pātumiti nindā; ubhayatra śakyārthe
kṛtyaḥ| śvalehya iti| evaṃ nāmāśuciḥ kūpo yajjalaṃ śvāna eva
leḍhuamarhantīti nindā; ahrārthe kṛtyaḥ| bāṣpacchedyānīti| evaṃ nāma
komalāni tṛṇāni yadvāṣpeṇāpi chetuṃ śakyānīti stutiḥ; evaṃ
nāma kathitāni tṛṇāni yadvāṣpeṇāpi chetuṃ śakyānīti nindā|
kaṇṭakasaṃceya iti| evaṃ nāma klinna odano yatkaṇṭakaiḥ śakyaḥ
saṃcetumiti stutiḥ; evaṃ nāmālpa odano yatkaṇṭakaiḥ saṃcīyata iti
nindā| pūrvasyaivāyaṃ prapañca iti| yadyapi
stutinindāparatvātkriyopādānasya kartṛkaraṇayorgauṇatvam,
tathāpi bahulavacanātpūrveṇaiva sidhdam, tathā ca kākapītā
nadātyatrākṛtyairapyadhikārthavacanaiḥ samāso dṛśyate, ataḥ prapañca
evāyam, nāprāptavidhiḥ, nāpi niyama ityarthaḥ|| 

34 annena vyañjanam || 2-1-34 || 
dadhyodana iti| nanu ca neha kriyā śrūyate, na cāntareṇa kriyāṃ
dravyāṇāṃ paraspareṇa sambandha ityasāmarthyādatra samāso na prāpnoti,
athāsapyapi sāmarthye vacanāpsamāsaḥ? ihāpi tarhi syāt - kiṃ dadhnā,
odano bhūjyatāmiti, tatrāha - vṛtau kriyāyā antarbhāvāditi|
svabhāvādeva vṛtāvantarbhūtā kriyeti taddvārakasya sambandhasya
sadbhāvātsāmarthyamityarthaḥ|| 

35 bhakṣyeṇa miśrīkaraṇam || 2-1-35 || 
kharaviśadamiti| kharam u kaṭhinam, vibhaktāvayavam; kharaṃ ca tadviśadaṃ
ca kharaviśadam, hanucalanenādanīyamityarthaḥ| yadabhyavahāryaṃ
tadbhakṣyamityucyate; tatraiva yadantasya erajantasya ca bhakṣayate
rūḍhatvāt| bhakṣayatistvanyatrāpi bhavati-abbhakṣaḥ, vāyubhakṣa iti|
gauṇo'tra bhakṣayatirityanye || 

36 caturthī tadarthārthabalihitasukharakṣatai || 2-1-36 || 
arthaḥ parābhṛśyata iti| yadyapi caturthīti caturthyantaḥ śabdaḥ sannihitaḥ,
tathāpi śabdaṃ prati tādarthyāsambhāvātadartha eva parāmṛśyate ityarthaḥ|
ityetaiḥ śabdaiḥ saheti| tatra tadarthena subantenetyarthadhdarakaṃ
viśeṣamam, svarūpeṇa subantasya tādarthyāsambhavāt|
dvitīyastvarthaśabdaḥ pṛthageva nibhatam| prakṛtivikārabhāve samāsa
iṣyata iti| jñāpakāt| yadayaṃ balirakṣitagrahaṇaṃ karoti tajjñāpayati -
vikṛtiścaturthyantā prakṛtyā samasyata iti; anyathā kuberabaliḥ,
gorakṣitamityatrāpi tādarthyasambhavādanarthakaṃ tatsyāt|
hitasukhagrahaṇaṃ tu ṭhhitayoge caturthī vaktavyā', ṭhcaturthī cāśiṣi'
ityatādarthye'pi caturthīsambhavānna jñāpakam| yadi vikṛtiḥ prakṛtyā
samasyate - aśvebhyo ghāsaḥ, aśvebhyaḥ surā 'śvasuram, ṭhvibhāṣāsenā'
iti napuṃsakatvam, hastibhyo vidhā hastividhā, vidhā u annaviśeṣaḥ;
atra na prāpnoti? aśvaghāsādayaḥ ṣaṣṭhīsamāsā bhaviṣyanti| nanu svare
viśeṣo bhavati caturthīsamāse hi sati ṭhcaturthī tadartha' iti
pūrvapadaprakṛtisvareṇa bhāvyam, ṣaṣṭhīsamāse tu
samāsāntodātatvena? naiṣo'sti viśeṣaḥ; caturthīsamāse'pi naiva
pūrvapadaprakṛti svareṇa bhāvyam; jñāpakāt, yadayaṃ ṭhkte ca' iti
caturthyantaṃ pūrvapadaṃ prakṛtisvaraṃ bhavatityāha, tajjñāpayati -
prakṛtivikārabhāvābhāva eṣa svaro na bhavatīti; anyathā
gorakṣitamityatrāpi ṭhcaturthī tadartha' ityeva sidhderanarthakaṃ
tatsyāt| naitadasti jñāpakam; hitārthametatsyāt - gohitamityatra
hi tādarthyaṃ nāsti| evamapi ṭhhite ca' iti vaktavye ṭhkte ca' iti
sāmnyavacanaṃ jñāpakameva, sarvathā kuberavalirityāda ai mā
bhūdityevamartha prakṛtivikārabhāve svara eṣitavyaḥ| atha randhanāya
sthālītyatra ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ kasmānna bhavati? kaścidāha bhavatyeva, tadyathā -
gogrāsaḥ, lālāmbujam, krīḍāsaraḥ, vāsabhavanam, nāṭa|lśāleti|
apara āha - randhanasthālyādayo'nabhidhānāt ṣaṣṭhīsamāsa na bhavantīti|
ubhāvapi pratibrūmaḥ yeṣu ṣaṣṭhīsamāsa iṣyate teṣu caturthīsamāsa
evāstu, yeṣu tu neṣyate teṣu tu caturthīsamāsa
evānabhidhānānneṣyatām, mākārijñāpanārthaṃ balirakṣitagrahaṇam,
svarastu caturthīsamāse'pi pūrvoktena prakāreṇa prakṛtivikārabhāva
eva vyavasthāsyate| kiṃ caivaṃ sati sūtremevaitadanarthakam,
yūpadārvādāvapi ṣaṣṭhīsamāsa evāstu, ṭhcaturthī tadartha' ityetatu
ṭhṣaṣṭhī tadartha' iti kriyatām, jñāpakācca svarasya vyavasthā kriyatm|
nanvarthabheda| bhavati-ṣaṣṭhīsamāse sambandhamātraṃ gamyate, caturthīsamāse
tu tādarthyaṃ sambandhaviśeṣaḥ? naiṣo'sti viśeṣaḥ, ārabhyamāṇe'pi
caturthīsamāse na daṇḍavārita- ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ, tatrārthaprakaraṇādinā
viśeṣo'vaseyaḥ| yadyevam, kevale'pi ṣaṣṭhīsamāse tathā
viśeṣo'vasaṃsyate, kiñca sidhdante'śvavaghāsādiṣu
tāvadarthaprakaraṇādinā tādarthyavisāyaḥ sarvatraiva tathāstu,
nārthau'nena? ucyate-hitaśabdena tāvatṣaṣṭhīsamāso na bhavati; tadyoge
caturtyā nityatvāditi caturthīsamāsa eva vaktavyaḥ| tataśca ṭhkte ca'
ityatrāpi caturthīgrahaṇaṃ kartavyaṃ gohitamityādyartham| evaṃ ca
gorakṣitamityatra na syāt, caturthyā asambhavāt| ṭhṣaṣṭhī tadartha'
ityasya cāprasaṅgaḥ, prakṛtivikārābhāvāditi rakṣitenāpi
caturthīsamāsa eva vidheyaḥ| arthaśabdenāpi yoge
tādarthyasaṃbavdhaviśeṣasyaniyamena pratīyamānatvāccaturthyā
sambhavitavyamiti nenāpi caturthīsamāsa eva cartavyaḥ|
balisukhagrahaṇamapi kartavyam, tādarthyasya samāse niyamena
pratītiryathā samayādityevamartham| tasmādāravdhavyameva sūtram|
prakṛtivkārabhāva eva samāsa ityasya tu prayojanaṃ cintyam| arthena
nityasamāsavacanamiti| anthā mahāvibhāṣādhikārād brāhmaṇāyārtha
iti vākyamapi syāt| sarveliṅgatā ceti| paraliṅgatāyā
apavādaḥ, abhideyavaśena ca sarvaliṅgatā na sarvatreti darśayati|
brāhmaṇārthe paya ityādi| sarthabiti cet, itsaṃjñābhāvaḥ,
iyaṇuvaṅprasaṅśca| syādetat - tadarthaṃ vikṛteḥ prakṛtāvityatra
tadarthe sarthaviti sūtraṃ kartavyam, caturthī vartate,
caturthasimarthātadarthe'bhidheye sarthappratyayo bhavati, sakāraḥ
padasaṃjñārthaḥ - rājārthaḥ, gavārthaḥ, pitvādanudātatvam; evaṃ cārtha
iti pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaro na vidheyaḥ, pratyayatvācca na tena vigrahaḥ,
tadhditatvāccābhidheyavalliṅgatā sidhdyatīti? tanna;
sakārasyetsaṃjñābhāvaprasaṅgāt| atha ṭhādirñiṭuaḍavaḥ' ṭhṣaḥ
pratyayasya' iti dviṣakārakanirdeśāśrayaṇenetsaṃjñā syād? evamapi
vuñcchaṇādiṣu tṛṇādibhyaḥ se prasaṅgaḥ, rśyartham bhvarthamityatra
ceyaṇuvaṅai syātām, bahuvrīhāvātvakapoḥ prasaṅgaḥ| syaidetat -
yadbrāhmaṇārthaḥ payastasya brāhmaṇo'rthaḥ prayojaka iti śakyate vaktum,
ato brāhmaṇo'rtho'syeti vigṛhya bahuvrīhiḥ kariṣyate, tena
caturthyantena | vigrahābhāvaḥ
pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratvamabhidheyavannaṅgatā ca sidhdyatīti? tanna;
mahadarthamityatratvakapoḥ prasaṅgāt| tadarthasyārthādeśa
udabhāvaprasaṅgaḥ| syādetat - ṭhcaturthī tadartha' ityanena samāsaṃ
vidhāyārtha ityanenāśena tadarthavācana utarapadasyārthaśabda ādeśo
vidhīyate, vibhāṣādhikārācca yūpārthaṃ dāru yūpadārvituyabhayaṃ
bhāviṣyati, tato balirakṣitayorapi vibhāṣārthaśabda ādeśo bhavati
kuberārtho baliḥ kuberabalirityādi| kimarthamidam, pūrveṇaiva
sidhdam? jñāpakārtham, etaj jñāpayati - prakṛtivikārābhāvādanyatra
nityo'rthādeśa iti| tena randhanārthā sthālītyādi bhavati, na tu
randhanasthālītyādi| aśvaghāsādayastu pūrvavat| atra samāse kṛte
utarapadasya vidhīyamānenārthaśabdena vigraho na bhaviṣyati,
yasyāvasthāne'rthādeśastalliṅgatā sthānivadbhādhena bhaviṣyati, arta
iti pūrvapradaprakṛtisvarastu vidheya eveti, tanna; udakārtho vīvadha
iti vīvadhaśabdasyārthādeśe kṛte sthānivadbhāvena
manthaudanādisūtreṇodabhāvaprasaṅgāt| ataścaturthīsamāsa eva
vidhayaḥ| tathā cārtena nityasamāsaḥ sarvaliṅgatā ca vaktavyā? na
vaktavyā, brāhmaṇāyeti caturthyā tādarthyasyoktatvādarthaśabdena vigraro
na bhaviṣyati| ṭhliṅgamaśaiṣyaṃ lokāśrayatvālliṅgasya' iti
karvaliṅgatā ca sidhdā| 
tadetatpratipadyantāṃ bhāṣye kṛtapariśramāḥ| 
nānye sahastramapyandhāḥ sūryaṃ paśyanti nāñjasā|| 

37 pañcamī bhayena || 2-1-37 || 
bheyeneti svarūpagrahaṇādavyāptiriti matvā''ha --
bhayabhībhītibhībhiriti vaktavyamiti| evaṃ sūtranyāsaḥ kartavya ityarthaḥ|
vyākhyānātvarthagraṇe ṭhvṛkebhyastrāsaḥ' ityādāvapi prasaṅgaḥ iti bhāvaḥ|
sa tarhi tathā nyāsaḥ kartavya? netyāha - pūrvasyaiva bahulagrahaṇasyeti|
yathā hi ṭhpādahārakaḥ' ityādai
bahulagrahaṇātsarvepādhivyabhicārārthādbhavati, evamatrāpi
bhaviṣyatītyarthaḥ| adhamajugupsuriti ṭhjugupsāvirāma'
ityadharmasyāpādānasaṃjñā|| 

38 apetāpoḍhamuktapatitāpatrastairalpaśaḥ || 2-1-38 || 
alpaśabdād ṭhbahvalpārthāt' iti śasa, ṭhśasi bahvalpārthasya' iti
puṃvadbhāvaḥ| kārakatvaṃ tu samasanakriyāyāṃ karmatvāt| ata eva
pañcamī samasyata iti karmaṇi lakāraḥ| tatra tu bahvalpārthānmaṅgale
vacanamiti vakṣyati| tasmādata eva nipādanādatra śasati yuktam| alpā
pañcamīti| alpābhyaḥ prakatṛtibhya utpannetyarthaḥ| 

39 stokāntikadūrārthakṛcchrāṇi ktena || 2-1-39 || 

40 saptamī śauṇḍèaḥ || 2-1-40 || 
atra sāhacaryād dhūrtādiṣvajahatsvārtha eva śauṇaḍaśabdaḥ prayujyate,
yathā - cchatriṇo gacchantīti| atra ca pramāṇaṃ bahuvacananirddeśaḥ,
ate'ntareṇāpyādiśabdaṃ tadartho gamyate ityāha - śauṇhādibhiriti|
gaṇapāṭhasāmarthyātu bahuvacananirdeśo'rthanirdeśāryaḥ,
bahuvacanāntasya vā samāsārtha iti na cānyatsaptamyā nimtamasti| na
caitadeva jñāpakaṃ śakyamāśrayitum; śauṇḍo devadata ityādāvapi
prasaṅgād, ata āha - vṛtāviti| antaḥśabdo'tra paṭha|lte,
tadyoge'vayavina ādhāratvavivakṣāyāṃ saptamī, yathā vṛkṣe śākheti,
vane'ntarvanāntaḥ| asya vikalpitatvādavyayībhāvo'pi bhavati,
antarvaṇam, ṭhpranirantaḥ' iti ṇatvam| adhiśabdaḥ paṭha|lte,
tasyāvikaraṇaprādhānye'vyayībhāvaḥ - adhisatrīti| ādheyaprādhānye
hyayaṃ tatpuruṣaḥ - brāhmaṇādhaiinamiti| ṭhadyautarapadātkhaḥ' iti khaḥ|
brāhmaṇeṣvadhīti vākyam|| 

41 sidhdaśuṣkapakvandhaiśca || 2-1-41 || 
sāṅkāśyasidhdiḥ kāmpilyasidhda iti| saṅkāśena nirvṛtaṃ vanaṃ
sāṅkāyam| kampilena nirvṛtaṃ kāmpilyam| cāturthikaḥ
saṅkāśādibhyoṇyaḥ tatra tapasā sidhda ityarthaḥ|| 

42 dhvāṅkṣeṇa || 2-1-42 || 
ṭhsvaṃ pūpaṃ śabdasya' iti vacanātparyāyāṇāṃ na prāpnetītya āha -
dhvāṅkṣeṇetyarthagrahaṇamiti| vyākhyānāccaitadavasīyate| tīrthe
dhvāṅkṣa iveti| upamānopamoyabhāve sati kṣepo gamyate,
nānyathetīvaśabdaḥ prayuktaḥ| yathā tīrthe dhvāṅkṣā na ciraṃ sthātāro
bhavanti, evaṃ kāryeṣvanavasthitastīrthadhvāṅkṣa irtarthaḥ, tadāha -
anavasthita ityartha iti| vṛtau
tvivārthasyāntarbhāvādivaśabdsayāprayogaḥ||

43 kṛtyairṛṇe || 2-1-43 || 
yatpratyayāntenaiveṣyate iti | ṭhalpaśaḥ' ityanuvṛteretallabhyate|
kṛtyairiti bahuvacanaṃ tu prakṛtibheprāyam| ṛṇagrahaṇaṃ ca
niyogopalakṣaṇārthamiti| niyogaḥ u avaśyambhāvaḥ|
ṛṇamavaśyadeyamiti niyogasāhacaryānniyogamātramupalakṣayati| tena
kiṃ sidhdaṃ bhavatītyāha - ihāpīti| pūrvāhṇogeyamiti|
ṭhtatpuruṣe kṛti bahulam' ityuluk| yathā ṛṇamavaśyaṃ deyam,
evamidamapi pūrvāhṇe'vaśyaṃ geyamiti niyogo'sti|| 

44 saṃjñāyām || 2-1-44 || 

45 ktenāhorātrāvayavāḥ || 2-1-45 || 
divā vṛtamiti| aikapadyamaikasvaryaṃ ca na bhavati| nanu ca
divāśabdo'dhikaramaśaktipradhānaḥ tatrabhihitaḥ so'rtho'ntarbhūtaḥ
prātipadikārthaḥ sampanna iti prathamaivāsmādbhavati, ataḥ
saptamyabhāvādevātrāprasaṅgaḥ| naiṣo'sti niyamaḥ - adhikaraṇaktipradhāna
iti; divāmanyā rātrirityapi darśanāt| kathaṃ
ṭhrātrivṛtamanuyoktumudyata' iti? ṭhkartṛkaraṇe kṛtā bahulam' iti
manyate| evaṃ cānyajanmakṛtamityādyapi bhavati|| 

46 tatra || 2-1-46 || 
tatretyetatsaptamyantamiti| tatrabhavānityādau vibhaktyantare'pi
darśanādadhrakaṇapratipādane tatraśabdādapi saptamyevāpekṣyeti manyate||


47 kṣepe || 2-1-47 || 
avataptenakulasthitaṃ tavaitaditi cirantanaprayogaḥ, tasyārthamāha -
cāpalametatavetyartha iti| yathā avatapte pradeśe nakulā na ciraṃ
kthātāro bhavanti, evaṃ kāryāṇyārabhyayaścāpalena na ciraṃ tiṣṭhati sa
evamucyata ityartaḥ| ṭhkṛdgrahaṇe gatikārakapūrvasyāpi grahaṇam' iti
nakulasthitaśabdena samāsaḥ, pūrvavadaluk|| 

48 pātresamitādayaśca || 2-1-48 || 
yuktārohyādiparigragarthamiti| yuktārohyādayaścetyatraiṣāmapi
parigraho yathā syādityarthaḥ| pratra eva samitā iti| bhojanasamaya eva
saṅgatā ityarthaḥ| pātrebahulā iti| bhojanasamaya eva saṅghībhavanti,
nānyakārya ityarthaḥ| ubumbaramaśakādiṣviti| yastatraiva tṛpto
nāsmātparamastīti manyate, so'yamadṛṣṭavistāraḥ puruṣa
udumbaramaśakādirucyata ityarthaḥ| pratiṣidhdasevaneneti| śatruṣu
bhāryāyāṃ vā puruṣāyitavyam, mātari puruṣāyitaṃ pratiṣidhdap|
nirīhatayeti| piṇḍī u odanapiṇḍaḥ, tatraiva śūro nānyatreti
nirīhatā| paramapātresamitā iti| evaṃrūpaṃ vṛtyantaraṃ na bhavati,
paramāḥ pātresamitā iti vākyameva bhavatītyarthaḥ|| 

49 pūrvakālaikasarvajaratpurāṇanavakevalāḥ samānādhikaraṇena || 2-1-49
|| 
bhinnapravṛttinimitasyetyādi| bhinnagrahaṇaṃ paryānivṛtyartham|
ekagrahaṇaṃ gauraśca ityādinivṛtyartham| kvacid
bhinnanmitaprayuktasyeti pāṭhaḥ, bhinnena nimitena pravṛttinimitena
pravartitasyetyarthaḥ| ṭhviśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣyeṇa' iti sidhde
pūrvakālādīnāṃ pūrvanipātārthaṃ vacanam, ekaśabdasya tu ṭhdiksaṃkhye
saṃjñāyām' iti niyamātprāptyarthameva| pūrvakāla ityarthagrahaṇamiti|
pūrvaḥ kālo'sya pūrvakālaḥ, pūrvamanuṣṭhata ityarthaḥ| sa ca
caramānuṣṭhitamapekṣya bhavatītyarthātenaiva samāso vijñāyata ityāha -
parakāleneti| snātānulipta iti| pūrvaṃ snātaḥ paścādanulipta
ityarthaḥ| atra kriyāśabdatvātpācakapāṭhakādivatpūrvanipātaḥ
paryāyātsyāt| ekaśāṭiti| śāṭaśabdājjatilakṣaṇo ṅīṣ,
ṭhekatadhdite ca' iti hrasvaḥ| sarvamanuṣya iti| atra viśeṣaṇamityapi
samese na doṣaḥ, tasmātkriyāvācināṃ kūṇavācināṃ vā samāso
darśanīyaḥ| evaṃ jaradādiṣvapi ekasyāḥ śāṭīti| atra bhavitavyameva
ṣaṣṭhīsamāsena, tasmādekarasyāḥ śauklyagiti pratyudāhartavyam| atra
hi guṇena neti pratiṣedhaḥ|| 

50 diksaṃkhye saṃjñāyām || 2-1-50 || 
ṭhviśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣaṇa' iti sidhde niyamārthametat - saṃjñāyāmeva
,nānyatreti| pūrvasūtramityādau tvadigvācitvāt samāsaḥ|| 

51 tadhditārthotarapadasamāhāre ca || 2-1-51 || 
tadhditārthotarapadasamāhāre ca || ṭhviśeṣyeṇa' iti sidhdasya
pūrveśāniyamādaprāptavidhirayam| agṛhyamāṇaviṣayatvādvāyamapi
niyamaḥ śakyate vaktum - ayaṃ niyamaḥ pūrvo vidhiriti| ekāpi
saptamī viṣayabhedādbhidyata ityāha - tadhditīrthe viṣayabhūta
ityādinā| tadhditārthe'bhidheya ityevaṃ tu vijñāyāmāne
pāñcanīpitirityādau dadhdito durlabhaḥ syāt; tadarthasya
samāmenaivoktatvāditi bhāvaḥ| asmin pakṣe'rthagrahaṇaṃ
cintyaprayojanam| dadhdite viṣaya ityevāstu, tadhdite parata iti tu
vijñāyamāne itaretarāśrayaṃ prāpnoti - samāsātadhdito vidheyaḥ,
tadhdite ca samāsa iti| kiñca - ṭhtadhditārthe'bhidheye' ityāsman pakṣe
na doṣaḥ, ṭhdvigorlugalapatye' iti lugvacanaṃ jñāpakamutpadyate -
dvigostadhdita iti sarvatadhditasādhāraṇo dviguḥ, tatrāvaśyaṃ
viśeṣābhidhāanāya tadhdita utpadyata ityapi śkayaṃ vijñātum| athevaṃ
kasmānna vajñāyate - tadhditārthe dvigurbhavati, tadhdito yathā syāditi
dvigurbhavatīti, yathādārārthaṃ ghaṭāmahe, dārā yathā syuriti ghaṭāmaha
iti? nevaṃ śakyaṃ vijñātum; evaṃ hi vijñāyamāne dadhditotpataye
vidhīyamānā samāsasaṃjñā viṣayāntare na syāt| evaṃ tasyaiva
samāsasya vidhīyamānā dvigusaṃjñāpi, tataśca pañcāratnirityatra
igante dvigāviti svaro na syāt, tasya tu samāhāradviguravakāśaḥ,
yathā - svare vidhīyamānaḥ parāṅgavadbhāvaḥ ṣatvaṇatvayorna bhavati,
tathātrāpi| paurvaśāla iti| pūrvasyāṃ śālāyāṃ bhava iti tadhditārthe
vivakṣate samāsaḥ, tatastadhditaḥ| pūrvaśālāpriya iti| pūrvā śālā
priyāsyeti tripade bahuvrīhau priyaśabde utarapade parataḥ
pūrvayostatparuṣe sati samāsāntodātatvaṃ śālāśabdasya bhavati,
asati tvavāntaratatparuṣe satadi samāsāntodātatvaṃ śālāśabdasya
bhavati, asati tvavāntaratatpuruṣe pūrvapadaprakṛtisvareṇa
pūrvaśabdasyādyaudātatvamavatiṣṭheta| samāhāre dikśabdo na
sambhavatīti| sa hi samūharupatvādbhedanibandhanaḥ, saṃkhyaiva ca
bhedamācaṣṭe, dikśabdastu pratyarthaniyataḥ| vibhaktirapi samāse
nivartate| nanu yathā ṭhkākasamūhaḥ' ityatra vibhaktyabhāve'pi
bhedāvagatistathātrāpi bhaviṣyati, tasmātprayogābhāvādityevātra
heturvaktavyaḥ| pāñcanāpitiriti| pañcānāṃ nīpitānāmapatyamiti
samāse, ata iñ| pañcakapāla iti| pañcasu kapāleṣu saṃskṛta iti
samāse ṭhsaṃskṛta bhakṣāḥ' ityaṇaḥ ṭhdvigorlugalapatye' iti luk|
pañcagavadhana iti| pañca gāvo dhavamasyeti tripade bahuvrīhau kṛte
dhanaśabda utarapade parataḥ pūrvayostatpuruṣe ṭhgoratadhditaluki' iti
ṭaci| ayamutarapade tatpuruṣo mahāvibhāṣādhikārādvikalpena
prāpnoti, nityo baktavyaḥ; anyathā pañcagodhana ityapi syāt| uktaṃ ca
ṭhdvandvatatpuruṣayorutarapade nityasamāsavacanam' iti, vākca dṛṣacca
priye asya vāgdṛṣadapriya iti tripadabahuvrīhau pūrvayordvandvaḥ, sa ca
nitya iṣyate - nityaṃ samāsānto yathā syāditi| pañcapūliti|
pañcānāṃ pūlānāṃ samāhāra iti vigrahaḥ, na tu pañcapūlāḥ samāhṛtā
iti| bhāvasādhano hi samāhāraśabdaḥ - samāharaṇaṃ samāhāraḥ u
viprakīrṇānāmekatra rāśīkaraṇam| pañcagrāmaḥ, ṣaṇṇagarī,
tripurītyatraikasmin kṣaṇe kriyāyāṃ samanvayādbhinnadeśānāmapi
budhdyā rāśokaraṇaṃ bhavati| atha karmasādhane ko doṣaḥ? iha
pañcakumārīti, kumāryarthapradhānyātsamāsaśāstre
cāpradhamānirddiṣṭatvādekavibhaktitvābhāvāccopasarjanatvābhāvād
ṭhgostriyorupasarjanasya' iti hrasvo na syāt, kāmamatra
nupaṃsakahrasvatvaṃ sidhdam| iha pañca khaṭvāḥ samāhṛtāḥ pañcakhaṭvīti
vā ṭābanta iti satrīliṅgapakṣe hrasvābhāvād ṭhdvigoḥ' iti ṅīb na
syāt| bhāvasādhane tu samāsārthe samāhāre
nānāvibhaktibhiryujyamāne'pi kumārīśabdasya nityaṃ ṣaṣṭha|lèva yoga
iteyakavibhktikatvātsidhdamupasarjanatvam| tasmādbhāvasādanaḥ|
dvigurekavacanamityetatu ṭhsa napuṃsakam' iti vakṣyāmītyāhabhyate,
kathaṃ pañcapūlāmānayotyukte pūlānāmānayanam, nāntareṇa
dravyānayanaṃ bhāvānayanaṃ sambhavati, yathā nāntareṇa
pratrānaynamagnerānayanaṃ sambhavati? evamapi samāhāragrahaṇamanarthakam,
bhāvasādhano hi samāhāraśabdaḥ samūhaparyāyayaḥ, samūhaśca
tadhditārthastatra ṭhtadhditārtha' ityeva sidhdam| yadyevam,
dadhditotpatiḥ prāpnoti? utpadyatāṃ dadhditaḥ, ṭhdvigoḥ' iti
lugbhaviṣyati| lukkṛtāni prāpnuvanti,
pañcapūlī-ṭhaparimāṇabistācita' iti ṅīpprātiṣedhaḥ prāpnoti,
ṭhpañcagavam, ṭhgoratadvitaluki' iti ṭac na prāpnoti? naiṣa doṣaḥ;
aparimāṇetyatra na tadhditalukītyapāsya ṭhsamāhāra' iti vaktavyam,
tanniyamārtham - aviśeṣeṇa dvigoṅībbhavati,
aparimāṇāntādvistācitakambalyāntācca samāhāra eveti,
pañcānāmaśvānāṃ samāhāraḥ pañcaśvī| kva mā bhūt? pañcabhiraśvaiḥ krītā
pañcāśvā| ṭhgoratadvitaluk' ityatrāpyatadhditalukītyapāsya ṭhdvigoḥ
samāhāra' iti vaktavyam, tanniyamārtham - gośabdantasya
tatpuruṣasyāviśeṣeṇa ṭaj bhavati, dvigostu samāhāra eveti,
pañcānāṃ gavāṃ samāhāraḥ pañcagavam| kva mā bhūt? pañcabhirgobhiḥ
krītaḥ pañcaguḥ paṭaḥ| evamapi pañcakumārītyatra ṭhluk tadhditaluki'
iti strīpratyayasya luk prāpnoti| tasmātadhditanivṛtyartham|
samāhāragraṇātu samāsasyaiva samāhāro vācyaḥ, na tadhditasyeti
vyākhyānātadhdito notpadyata iti sidhdamiṣṭam| iha pañca gāvo'sya
santi pañcaguḥ puruṣa iti matvarthamya tadhditārthatvādayaṃ samāsaḥ
prāpnoti, na bahuvrīhiḥ; aśeṣatvāt, tasya tu citragvādiravakāśaḥ,
yatra diksaṃkhye na staḥ| sati cāsminsamāse matupaḥ śravaṇa syāt|
aprāgdīvtīyatvād dvigorlugāpi nāsti| tasmānmatvarthe pratiṣedho
vaktavyaḥ|| 

52 saṃkhyāpūrvo dvigaḥ || 2-1-52 || 
kvacidanantaro'pokṣyate, yatraitaducyate - 'anantasya vidhirvā bhavati
pratiṣedho vā' iti; kvacitsamudāyaḥ, yathā - ṭhna ṣaṭsvasrādibhyaḥ'
ityatra vakṣyate - tasmānnobhāviti, tadiha samudāyo'pekṣte?
anantaro vā? iti saṃśaye'nantara ityāha - tadhditārtha ityādi| ayaṃ
bhāvaḥ - samudāyāpekṣāyāṃ
saṃkhyāpūrvapadasamānādhikaramasamāsamātraparigrahe dvimuni
vyākaraṇasyetyavyayībhāvasyāpi syāditīgante dvigāviti
svaraprasaṅgaḥ| samānādhikaraṇatatpuruṣāpekṣāyāmapi ekaśāṭītyatrāpi
syāt| saṃkhyāśabdopādanavihitatpuruṣaparigrahe'pi ṭhdiksakhye
saṃjñāyām' ityasyāpi grahaṇātsaptaraṣaya ityatra dvigusvaraprasaṅgaḥ|
yogavibhāgaścānarthakaḥ, ṭhdiksakhye saṃjñāyāṃ
tadhditārthotarapadasamāhāre' ityekayogaḥ kartavyaḥ syāditi|
kathamekāpūpīti? atra hyaekaścāsāvapūpaśceti pūrvakāleti samāse
kṛte dvigatve sati ṭhakārāntotarapado dviguḥ striyāṃ bhāṣyate' iti
ṭhdvigoḥ' itaiikāraḥ sidhdyati, nānyathā| na
caikaśāṭītivajjātiṅīṣnena samāsaḥ sakyatekartum,
kevalasyāpūpaśabdasya pūṃlliṅgatvāt? ucyate - atrānantarasūtreṇa
samāhāra eva samāsaḥ| nanvanekaviṣayaḥ samāhāro nekasya sambhavati,
katham? ehaisamapyapūpaṃ kaścitkṛpaṇo dadadanekaṃ manyate, tathā
dānaśradhdātiśayādapūpamahatavādvā'nekasminyaḥ saṃgamastamekasminnapi
karoti| anena pratigrahītā kṛpaṇo vyākhyātaḥ,
tatraropitabahutvāśrayaḥ samāhāra iti sadhdam|| 

53 kutsitāni kutsanaiḥ || 2-1-53 || 
kutsitānīti| ṭhkutsa avakṣepaṇe' matyādisutre
cakārasyānuktasamuccayārthatvādvartamāne ktaḥ|
bahuvacananirdeśādubhayatrārthagrahaṇaṃ na svarūpagrahaṇamityāha -
kutsitavācīnīti| vaiyākaraṇakhasūciriti| sūcayateḥ ṭhicca'
itīkāraḥ| yaḥ pṛṣṭaḥ san praśnaṃ vismārayituṃ khaṃ sūcayati u khaṃ
nirīkṣate - aho nirmalaṃ gagalamiti, sa evasucyate| atra vyākaraṇasya
vedāṅgasyādhyayanaṃ praśastamapi pratibhānābhāvena
niṣphalatvātkutsyate| yājñikakitava iti| kiṃ tavāstīti
dhanamātrapraśnena jātyādinirapekṣo dyauute pravartamānaḥ kitavaḥ| iha tu
kitava iva kitavaḥ, yo yājñiko yājyasya dhanasatāmevāpekṣate na
yāgārhatām, sa yājñikakitava ityucyate, tadāha -
ayājyayājakastṛṣṇapapara iti| mīmāṃsakadurdurūṭa iti| ṭhdula
utkṣepe', duḥpurvaḥ auṇādikaḥ kūṭapratyayaḥ| ṭhbahulamanyatrāpi' iti
ṇiluk, larayorekaviṣayatvasmaraṇād durduruṭa iti bhavati|
vaiyākaraṇaścaura iti| kathametatpratyudāharaṇam, yāvatā cauratavena
garhyamāṇatvādbhavatyeva vaiyākaraṇakutsā, tatraha - na hyatreti|
pratyāsateḥ śabdapravṛteḥ śabdapravṛttinimitakutsāyāṃ samāsena
bhavitavyam, atra ca vaiyākaraṇaḥ kutsyate cauratvena, na tu
vaiyākaraṇatvam| kutsino brāhmaṇa iti| atra ṭhviśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣyaṇa' iti
bhavitavyameva samāsena| yadi neṣyate, bahulagrahaṇaṃ śaraṇam|| 

54 pāpāṇake kutsitaiḥ || 2-1-54 || 

55 upamānāni sāmānyavacanaiḥ || 2-1-55 || 
upamīyatene'netyupamānamiti| upapūrvānmāṅḥ karaṇe lyuṭi samāsa
iti darśayati| bhāṣye tu mānasya samīpamupamānamityarthakathanamātram|
avyayībhāve upamānānīti rūpāsidhidiprasaṅgāditi bhāvaḥ|
upapūrvakaśca māṅasādṛśyahetuke paricchede rūḍhaḥ| yena vastvantaraṃ
sādṛśyena paricchidyate tadupamānam, tadyathā - gauriva gavaya iti;
gauḥ karaṇam, puruṣaḥ paricchetā, sa hi goḥ sādṛśyena gavayaṃ
paricchinati - gosadṛśo gavaya iti| sāmānyavacanairiti|
samānaśabdaḥ dharmaḥ - sāmānyam, caccopamānasya śrutatvātasya
copameyāpekṣatvātayoreva sādhāraṇo dharmo vijñāyata ityāha -
upamānopamayayorityādi| tadviśiṣṭopameyavanairiti| tena
sādhāraṇena dharmeṇa viśiṣṭṃa yadupameyaṃ tadvacanaiḥ, na tu
sādhāraṇadharmamātravacanairitiyarthaḥ| vacanagrahaṇāccāyamarthau labhyate,
sāmānyamuktavantaḥ u sāmānyavacanāḥ| ye sāmānyamuktvā tadvati dravye
paryavasyanti te tathoktāḥ, yathā guṇamuktavān guṇavacana iti| tacca
sāmānyavadupamānaśabdasya saṃbandhiśbadatvātadākṣiptamupameyameva
vijñāyata iti suṣṭhūaktam - tadviśiṣṭopamevacanairiti|
śastrīśyāmeti| atra śyāmaguṇaviśiṣṭatvena pramidhdatvādupamānaṃ
śastrī, upameyā devadatā, tayoḥ saadhāraṇo dharmaḥ śyāmatvam,
tadabhidhāya tadviśiṣṭāyāṃ śyāmāśabdaḥ paryavasyātīti bhavati
sāmānyavacanaḥ| nanu ca samānādhikaraṇeneti| vartate, iha ca
śastrīśabdaḥ śastryāṃ vartate, śyāmāśabdastu devadatāyām, yadāha -
ṭhupamānavācīni subantāni tadviśiṣṭopameyavacanaiḥ' iti; tathā
vigrahavākye ivaśabdaḥ prayuktaḥ - śastrīva śyāmeti? satyam;
vacanasāmarthyātu vaiyadhikaraṇye'pi samāsaḥ| yadyevam, mṛgīva capalā
mṛgacapalā, haṃsīva gadgadā haṃsagadgadā, puṃvatkarmadhārayeti
sāmānādhikaraṇyalakṣaṇaḥ puvadbhāvo na prāpnoti? naiṣa doṣaḥ;
jātāyantaranivṛttiparāyāṃ codanāyāṃ strītvamakiñcitkaram, tatra
kukkuṭāṇḍam, mṛgakṣīramityādivadidamapi sidhdam| nanu cānyadeva
cāpalaṃ striyāḥ, anyadeva puṃsaḥ? satyam; jātimātropādāne'pi
prakaraṇādivaśāt strītvaṃ pratyāyiṣyate, tacca bahiraṅgatvānna
strīpratyayasya nimitam| anyathā puṃvadbhāvena nivṛtau strīpratyayasya
tavāpi kathaṃ viśaṃṣāvagatiḥ| astvevam, yadi tu mṛgīva capaleti
strīpratyayāntasya samāsaḥ kriyate, tadā mṛgīcapaleti prāpnoti, na
hi tena samāso daṇḍavāritaḥ, samānādhikaraṇādhikāraśca bādhyeta|
evaṃ tarhi samānādhirakaṇasamāsa evāyam - śastrī cāsau śyāmā ceti,
kathaṃ punardeavadatāyāṃ śastrīśbadaḥ, jātivacano hyasau
sādṛśyanimitādabhodopacārāt, yathā - gaurvāhīka iti| yadyevam,
śastraśabdo'pyupameye saṃkrānta ityupamānavācitvaṃ nopapadyate?
satyam; pūrvāvasthāśrayeṇa tūpamānatvaṃ draṣṭavyam|
ivaśabdaprayogastūpamānapradarśanārthaḥ, na prakriyāvākyāṅgamiti na
kaściddoṣaḥ| nanu śyāmaguṇatvena sādharmyeṇa śastrīśabdo devadatāyāṃ
prayujyata iti śyāmaśabdo na prayogārhaḥ, tanna; bahavo hi śastryāṃ
guṇāḥ - tīkṣṇā sūkṣmā pṛthuḥ śyāmeti, tatrāsati śyāmaguṇena
śastrītvasāropitamiti| nanu sadapi śyāmapadaṃ devadatāmupasthāpya
caratārthamiti naiva śastrīguṇo nirddiśyate, naitadasti; naivamatra
vacanaṃ vyajyate yā śyāmā sā śastrīveti| kathaṃ tarhi śastrīva śyāmā
devadateti? asyāṃ tu vacanavyaktāvivaśabdena tāvadupameyaniṣṭhatvena
pratīyate, upameyaniṣṭho guṇa upamānaṃ spṛśatyeva| atha vā
candramukhītyādāvanirdiṣṭo'pi guṇaḥ priyadarśanatvādiḥ
prasidhdivaśādupamānanimitatvena pratīyate, tadopameye'pi
tāvacśrutaḥ kathamupamānaṃ na sprakṣyati| phālā iva taṇḍulā|
dīrghatvādinā dharmeṇa|| 

56 upamitaṃ vyāghrādibhiḥ sāmānyāprayoge || 2-1-56 || 
upamitamityatra bhūtakālo na vivakṣyata ityāha -
upamoyamupamitamiti| sāmarthyāditi|
upameyamupamānāpekṣamityetatsāmarthyena cetsāmānyavācīti yadā
prakaraṇādivaśānniyataḥ sādhāraṇaguṇaḥ pratīyate tadā samāsaḥ, yadā tu
guṇāntaravyavacchedāya viśiṣṭaḥ sādhāraṇaguṇavacanaḥ śabdaḥ prayujyate
tadā na samāsa ityarthaḥ| puruṣo'yaṃ vyāghra iveti|
upamānapradarśanametat, atra hi vaiyadhikaraṇyātsamāsasyāprasaṅgaḥ|
yadā tu vyāghraśbadastādhdarmyātpuruṣe vartate tadā sāmānādhikaraṇye
sati samāsaḥ| ata evoktam - viśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣyeṇeti prāpte iti|
puruṣo'yaṃ vyāghra iva śūra iti| nanu sāmānyaśabdaprayoge sati
tadapekṣatvādasāmarthyādeva na bhaviṣyati, evaṃ tarhyatajjñāpayati - bhavati
pradhānasya sāpekṣasya vṛttiriti| tena rājapuruṣo'bhirupa aupagavaḥ
śobhana ityādi sidhdaṃ bhavati| nyāyasidhda evārthe
liṅgadarśanamidam|
prādhānyādevānekopakāryatvasambhavātpuruṣavyāghro'bhirupa iti
bhavatyeva| śauryaṃ hyatra samānadharmaḥ, nābhirupam| ata eva
ṭhsāmānyāprayoge' ityuktam, na tu ṭhguṇāprayoge' iti||

57 viśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣyeṇa bahulam || 2-1-57 || 
bhedakamiti| asiścchinatītivat karaṇasya kartṛtvavivakṣāyāṃ ṇval|
viśeṣaṇamiti| ṭhśiṣlṛ śeṣaṇe' vipūrvaḥ, viśeṣyate'neneti
viśeṣaṇam, karaṇe lyaṭ| yatsādhāraṇākāreṇa pratipannaṃ bahuprakāraṃ
vastu prakārāntarebhyo vyavacchadya ekasminprakāre vyavasthāpayati tatpadaṃ
viśeṣaṇaṃ bhedakamiti cocyate| viyavasthāpyamānaṃ viśeṣyaṃ
bhedyamiti ca| nanu ca viśeṣyamiti ca sambandhiśabdāvetau, tataśca
viśeṣaṇamityukte gamyata eva - viśeṣyeṇeti, evaṃ viśeṣyeṇetyukte
gamyate-viśeṣaṇamiti, tatkimarthamubhayamupādīyate? yatra
pūrvotarapadayordvayorapi pratyakaṃ viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvastatraiva yathā
syād, yathā-nīlotpalamiti| atra hi nīlārtho
bhramarādisādhāraṇarupeṇa pratipanna utpalārthenotpale vyavasthāpyate,
utpalārtho hi raktādisādhāraṇarupeṇa pratipanno nīlārthena nīle
vyapasthāpyata iti bhavati pratyekamubhayabhāvaḥ| yatra tu sa nāsti na tatra
samāso bhavati, yathā pratyudāharaṇe-takṣakaḥ sarpa iti, na hi takṣakaḥ
sarpatvaṃ vyabhicarati| nanu vyabhicarati, kriyānimitako'pi
takṣakaśabdo'sti - takṣṇotīti takṣata iti? satyamasti; na tvasau
nāmadheyena gāhate tulyakakṣatām, drāgeva rūḍhau pratibhā kriyāśabdo
vilambitā| iha tu śiṃśapāvṛkṣa iti, śiśaṃpāśabdasya phale'pi
darśanādvakṣavyabhicārādbhavatyeva samāsaḥ, na cātra vṛkṣapratītipūrvikā
phale pratītiryena bahiraṅgā syāt| yatheva hi pañcālādayaḥ śabdā
janapadināṃ janapadasya ca sādhāraṇyenānyo'nyayogamapekṣante
tadvadede'pi| yathovāca bhagavān-ṭhlubyogāprakhyānāt' iti iha tarhi
katham ṭhatha jayāya nu merumahībhṛtaḥ' iti, na merurmahībhṛtvaṃ
vyabhicarati? niraṃkuśāḥ kavayaḥ| yadi tarhi yatra
pratyekamubhayabhāvastatra samāsaḥ, ubhayorapi viśeṣaṇatvamiti
prathamānirdiṣṭatvādupasarjanatve sati pūrvanipātāniyamaḥ syād -
nīlotpalam? artha taścāprādhānyam| tadiha dravyaguṇopanipāte
dravyaṃ pradhānam, apradhānaṃ guṇaḥ| dravyaṃ hi kriyāsidhdau
sākṣādupayujyate, guṇastu dravyāvacchedadvāreṇa| ato guṇavacanasyaiva
pūrvanipātaḥ, na dravyavacanasya| nanūtpalaśabdo'pi jātiśabdaḥ, na
dravyaśabdaḥ; yadi tu jātiviśiṣṭe dravye paryavasānād
dravyaśabdatvam, hantaivaṃ nīlaśabdo'pi guṇiviśiṣṭe dravye
paryavasyan dravyaśabdaḥ syāt? atrocyate-utpateḥ prabhṛtyā
vināśājjātirdravyaṃ na jahāti, na tu bhavati śābaleyasya gauriti|
tasmājjātyātmakameva dravyaṃ pratīyata iti jātiśabdo dravyatvena
vyavasthāpyate| guṇāḥ punaḥ satyeva dravye kadācidupayanti,
kadācidapayanti - paṭasya śakla iti, vyatiriktā api dravyātsvaśabdaiḥ
pratyāyyanta iti na guṇātmakaṃ dravyaṃ bhavatīti na guṇaśabdo
dravyaśabdatve vyavasthātumarhati| ata eva ṭhśvetaṃ chāgamālabheta' iti
codanāyāṃ śvetābhāve kṛṣṇāśchāga ālabhyate, na tu chāgābhāve
piṣṭapiṇḍīmālabhya kṛtī bhavati| kriyādravyayorupanipāte'pyevameva
draṣṭavyam - yācakabrāhmaṇa iti| yatra tu guṇaśabdayoḥ, kriyāśabdayoḥ,
gaṇakriyāśabdayoścopanipātaḥ, tatrāniyama eva bhavati - khañjakubjaḥ,
kubjakhañjaḥ; pācakapāṭhakaḥ, pāṭhakapācakaḥ; khañjapācakaḥ, pācakakhañja
iti| śiśapāvṛkṣa iti| dravyaśabdayorevopanipāte'pi vṛkṣatvasya
vyāpakatvānmahāviṣayatvād dūrātprathamata evopalambhācca prādhānyam,
śiśapātvasya tu viparyayādapradhānyamiti na tatrāpyaniyamaḥ|
viśeṣaṇamiti kimiti|| viśeṣyaśabdasya sambandhiśabdatvādeva
viśeṣaṇamiti lapsyata iti praśnaḥ| takṣakaḥ sarpa iti| nanu
takṣakaśabdo'pi viśeṣaṇaṃ bhavatyeva? evaṃ manyate-viśeṣyaśabdasya
sambandhiśabdatvādeva pūrvapadasya viśeṣaṇatve labdhe
punarviśeṣaṇagrahaṇamutarapadasya
viśeṣaṇatvapratipatyartham-viśeṣeyeṇa viśeṣaṇaṃ samasyate,
taccedviśeṣyaṃ viśeṣaṇamiti| na cātrotarapadaṃ viśeṣaṇam; takṣakasya
tapaṃtvāvyabhicārāditi| lohitastakṣaka iti| nātra takṣato viśeṣyaḥ,
tasya lohitatvāvyabhicārāt| yadyevam lohito viśeṣaṇaṃ na
syāt; tasyāpi viśeṣyāpekṣatvāt? evaṃ tarhi ṭhpāṭhakramādathakramo
balāyam' iti takṣako lohita iti pāṭho draṣṭavyaḥ, atra hi takṣako
viśeṣaṇaṃ bhavati; lohitatvasya takṣatakatvavyabhicārāt| yadyevam,
lohitatvasya viśeṣyatvamapi syāt? astyeva tasya viśeṣyatvam,
pūrvapadasya tu viśeṣyatvābhāvātpratyudāhaṇatvam| evaṃ ca kṛtvā
takṣakaḥ karpa ityetadevāsminnapi praśne pratyudāharaṇaṃ bhavati|
vispaṣṭārthaṃ tūbhayorupādānam|| 

58 pūrvāparaprathamacaramajaghanyasamānamadhyamadhyamavīrāśca || 2-1-58 ||
pūrvasyaivāyaṃ prapañca iti| guṇakriyāśabdena saha samāse pūrvādīnāṃ
pūrvanipātaniyamārthaṃ tu na bhavati, bahuṃḍlagrahaṇenaiva sidhdatvāditi
manyate|| 

59 śreṇyādayaḥ kṛtādibhiḥ || 2-1-59 || 
ekena śilpena paṇyena vā yedīvanti, teṣāṃ samūraḥ u śreṇiḥ| tatra
pṛthaksthitānāṃ śreṇikaraṇe yathā syāt, śreṇisthānāmeva tu
daṇḍādirūpeṇa karaṇe mā bhūdityāha - śreṇyādiṣu cvyarthavcanamiti
iti| śraṇyādayaḥ paṭha|lnte iti| tena tatrādiśabdo vyavasthāvācī|
kṛtādirākṛtigaṇa iti| prayogadarśanenākṛtigrāhyae gaṇaḥ u
ākṛtigaṇaḥ| atrādiśabdaḥ prakāre| cvyantānāmityādi| paratvāditi
bhāvaḥ| ākṛtigaṇe'pyudāharaṇarupeṇa katipayānpaṭhati|
kṛta||ṃatetyādi|| 

60 ktena nañviśiṣṭenānañ || 2-1-60 || 
viśiṣṭaśabdo'yamadhike vartate, taccādhikyaṃ kvacitsāvadhāraṇam,
tadyathā - devadato yajñadatātsvādhyāyena viśiṣṭaḥ, svādhyāyenaiva
viśiṣṭo'nye guṇāḥ samā iti gamyate| kvacinniravadhāraṇam, tadyathā -
devadato yajñadatsvādhyāyena viśiṣṭaḥ, svādhyāyena
tāvadviśiṣṭo'nye guṇāḥ samā bhūyāṃso vā netannirupyate|
vākyasyaikarūpatve'rthaprakaraṇādinā viśeṣanirṇayaḥ| tatra
nirañdhāraṇapakṣe - sidhdaṃ ca tadabhaktaṃ cetyatrāpi syāt, ktāntayoḥ
prakṛtibhede'pi nava tāvadhika iti viśiṣṭagrahaṇaṃ cānarthakaṃ syāt,
ktena sanañā nañityeva vācyaṃ syāt, ataḥ sāvadhāraṇapakṣamāśrityāha -
nañaiva viśeṣo yasyeti| prakṛtyādikamityādiśabdena
pratyayopasargayorgrahaṇam tatra sidhdaṃ ca tadabhaktaṃ ceti
prakṛtiratulyā, kartavyamakṛtamiti pratyayaḥ, prakṛtaṃ cānapakṛtaṃ
cetyupasargaḥ, evaṃ ca pūrvapadamapi ktāntameva labhyata ityāha -
anañktāntamiti| anañiti śakyamakartum, na hi pūrvapade sanañi
utarapade nañadhiko bhavati| kṛtaṃ ca tadakṛtaṃ ceti| avayavadharmeṇāyaṃ
samudāyasya vyapadeśaḥ, ekameva ca vastvekadeśakaraṇātkṛtaṃ ca
bhavatyekadeśākaraṇādakṛtaṃ ceti nātra kaścidvirodhaḥ| yadi tarhi
sāvadhāraṇapakṣa āśrīyate, evaṃ sati yasya nuḍaparo|dhikaiḍāgame
vā, tena saha samāso na syādityata āha -- nuḍiṭāviti|
nuḍiḍgrahaṇamāgamopalakṣaṇam, nyāyasya tulyatvātenacchannācchannamiti
tugadhikasyāpi gahaṇam| aśitānaśiteneti| ṭhaśa bhojane'
ṭhtasmannuḍaci'| kliṣṭākliśitaneti| ṭhkliśaḥ ktvāniṣṭhayoḥ' iti pakṣe
iṭ; tatra nuṭ pratyayāntabhaktaḥ, iṭ pratyayabhaktastuk nañbhakta iti
sarveṣāmutarapade'ntarbhāvaḥ| iha tu chātācchitamiti
ṭhśācchāeranyatarasyām' itītve kṛte nenādhikyātsamāso na
prāpnoti? atra kecidāhuḥ - nuḍiḍgrahaṇa marthābhedakasya
vikāramātrasyopalakṣaṇam, tenehāpi samāso bhavatīti| trātātrāṇa
marthābhedakasya vikāramātrasyopalakṣaṇam, tenehāpi samāso
bhavatīti| trātātrāṇamityatra tu
niṣṭhānatvasyāsidhdatvādbhedakatvābhāvaḥ,
gauṇatvātsāmānādhikaraṇyasya pūrveṇa na prāpnotītyārambhaḥ|
pūrvanipātaniyamārthaśca - kṛtākṛtamityeva yathā syāt, akṛtamiti
mā bhūt| kṛtāpakṛmiti| ekadeśasyeṣṭasya karaṇādekadeśasya
cāniṣṭasya karaṇādekamavavastu kṛtaṃ bhavatyapakṛtaṃ ca| bhuktaṃ ca
tadatyavahaṛtatvāt, vibhuktaṃ cāśobhanatvādbhuktavibhuktam,
viśabdo'trośobhanatvaṃ dyotayati virūpam| evaṃ pīnavipītam|
gamanam u gatam, pratyāgamanam u pratyāgatam, tat kṣuṇṇabhuvā
pratyāgamanena saha caritaṃ gamanaṃ gatapratyāgatam, yātaṃ ca
tadanuyātaṃ tadānīmeva punargamanāt yātānuyātam|
krayākrayiketi| ṭhalpe' iti kapratyayaḥ, tadantaśca svabhāvātstriyāṃ
vartate| krayākrayiketi ṭhanyepāmapi dṛśyate' iti dīrghaḥ| mahān
krayaḥ krayaśabdenocyate gobalīvardanyāyena| evaṃ puṭāpuṭikā,
phalāphalikā, mānonmāniketi| śākapārthavādīnāmiti| ṭhsidhdaye'
iti śeṣaḥ| pṛthorapatyaṃ pārthavaḥ, kecitpāthiveti paṭhanti,
pṛthivyā īśvaraḥ pārthivaḥ, ṭhtasyeśvaraḥ' ityañ, tasyābhyavahāryeṣu
śākaṃ priyatvātpradhānam| tatra sāhacaryādeva
tadvyapadeśatvalābhādutarapadalopo na vaktavyaḥ| samāsastu vaktavyaḥ,
gauṇatvātsāmānādhikaraṇyasya|| 

61 sanmahatparamotamotkṛṣṭāḥ pūjyamānaiḥ || 2-1-61 || 
pūjyamānairiti vacanāditi| pūjyamānasya pūjāpekṣatvāditi bhāvuḥ|
ata eva saditi svarūpagrahaṇaṃ na śatṛśānacoḥ, na hi tau
pūjāmāhatuḥ| utkṛṣṭo goriti| udhdṛta ityarthaḥ| mahājanaḥ,
mahodadhirityādau pūjābhāve'pi viśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣyeṇeti samāsaḥ|
vacanaṃ tu guṇakriyāśbadairapi samāse sadādīnāmeva
pūrvanipātaniyamārtham|| 

62 vṛndarakanāgakuñjaraiḥ pūjyamānam || 2-1-62 || 
vṛndākaraśbado devajātivacajanaḥ, itarau hastijātivacanau,
tatropamānatve sati pūjāvacanatā sambhavati| tatra
vyāghrāderākṛtigaṇatvātsidhde samāse pūjāyāmeva yathā
syānnindāyāṃ mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ vacanam| iha mā bhūt -
māṇavako'yaṃ nāgo yasmānmūrka iti| samānyaprayoge'pi yathā
syādityanye| suṣīma iti saṃjñeyaṃ nāgaviśeṣasya| yadyevam,
viśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣyeṇetyadhikārādevātra na bhaviṣyati, na hyanāgaḥ
suṣīmo'sti? tasyam; pratyudāharaṇadigiyaṃ darśitā, māṇavako'yaṃ
nāga iti pratyudāharaṇam|| 

63 katarakatamau jātiparipraśne || 2-1-63 || 
katarakaṭha iti| ṭhgotraṃ ca caraṇaiḥ saha' iti jātiḥ tathā ca
pratyudāharaṇamiti| pūrvaṃ vṛttiṣūpanyastamupapannaṃ bhavatīti śeṣaḥ|| 

64 kiṃ kṣepe || 2-1-64 || 

65
poṭāyuvatistokakatipayakṛṣṭidhenuvaśāvehabdaṣkayaṇīpravaktṛśrotriyādhyāpakadhūrtairjātiḥ || 2-1-65 || 
ubhayavyañjaneti| vyajyate'nena strītvādikamiti vyañjanam u stanādi,
ubhayoḥ strīpuṃsayorvyañjanaṃ yasyāḥ sā tathoktā, napuṃsake
poṭetyarthaḥ| poṭāśabdastu tatrapi strītvayuktaḥ pravartate| śabdānāṃ
citraśaktitvāt ṣaṇḍaśabdo yathā pumān||
dhūrtagrahaṇamakutsārthamiti| kutmāyāṃ tu ṭhkutsitāni kutsanaiḥ' iti
sidhdamiti bhāvaḥ| tatra kaṭhadhūrta iti| yaḥ kaṭhaḥ sa dhūrta ityarthaḥ, na tu
kaṭhatvaṃ kutsyate|| 

66 praśaṃsāvacanaiśca || 2-1-66 || 
rūḍhiśabdāḥ praśaṃsāvacanā gṛhyanta iti| praśaṃsayeti vaktavye
vacanagrahaṇādiha grahaṇaṃ rūḍhiśabdānāṃ praśaṃsāmātravācimām| tena ye
yaugikāḥ praśastaśobhanaramaṇīyādayaḥ, ye ca viśeṣavacanāḥ
śucimṛdvāyaḥ, ye ca jātiśabdāḥ santaḥ paratra prayogātpraśaṃsāṃ
gamayanti siṃho māṇavaka iti, te sarve vyudastā bhavanti|
matallikādaya iti| ṭhmatallikā macarcikā prakāṇḍamudhdatallajau|
praśastavācakānyamūni' ityamaraḥ| āviṣṭaliṅgatvāditi|
niyataliṅgatvādityarthaḥ| svaliṅgopādānā iti| svasyaiva
liṅgasyopādānaṃ yeṣu te tathoktāḥ| ṭhpraśaṃsāvacanapoṭāyuvati'
ityekayoge kartavye yogavibhāgaścintyaprayojanaḥ|| 

67 yuvā khalatipālitavalinajaratībhiḥ || 2-1-67 || 
saṃjñāyūno gahaṇe gārgyāyaṇaḥ khalatirityādābeva tu syānna ca tasya
jaratīśabdena sāmānādhikaraṇyam| na ca gārgyāyaṇī yuvatirasti;
satriyāṃ yuvasaṃjñāprātiṣedhāt, ato yuveti svarūpagrahaṇamityāha -
yuvāśabda iti| khalatyādibhiḥ samānādhikaraṇairiti| kathaṃ
punaryuvaśabdasya jaratīśabdena sāmānādhikaraṇyam puṃlliṅgasya
strīliṅgeneti, tatrāha - strīliṅganirdeśa iti| asyāṃ hi
paribhāṣāyāṃ satyāṃ yuvaśabdasya grahaṇe yuvatiśabdasyāpi
grahaṇādupapadyate yuvatijaratīśabdayoḥ samānādhikaraṇyam, asatyāṃ
tu nopapadyata ityarthāpatyā parabhāṣā jñāyate| yuvakhalatīti|
ṭhkṛdikārādaktinaḥ' ṭhsarvato'ktinnarthādityeke' iti ṅīṣ| valiśabdaḥ
pāmādiḥ| yuvajaranniti| jaradbhirityapi pāṭhaḥ kenacidācāryeṇa
bodhita iti pulliṅgenāpi samāso bhavatīti bhāvaḥ|
yuvatirjaratīti| kathaṃ virudhdavācanoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyam,
anyo'nyādharmopalambhātadrūpatvāropādbhaviṣyati| yadyevam,
vibhinnaliṅgayorapyevameva samānādhikaraṇyasambhavātkathaṃ paribhāṣā
jñāpyata iti cintyam; yuvaśabdasya pūrvānipātaniyamārthaṃ vacanam,
aniyamo hi guṇaśabdatvātsyāt|| 

68 kṛtyatulyākhyā ajātyā || 2-1-68 || 
tulyāparyāyāśceti| ākhyāgrahaṇaṃ svarūpanirākaraṇārthamiti bhāvaḥ|
bhojyoṣṇādāvaniyame prāpte pūrvanipātaniyamārthaṃ vacanam|
tulyamahāniti| ṭhsanmahat' ityasyākṛtyatulyākhyeṣu
sāvakāśatvātkṛtyatulyākhyeṣu paratvādayameva samāso yakta iti
bhāvaḥ| bhojya odana iti| pratiṣedhasāmarthyād viśeṣaṇamityapi na
bhavati|| 

69 varṇo varṇena || 2-1-69 || 
ṭhviśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣyeṇa' iti vartate, tatra dvayoḥ svarūpagrahaṇena
viśeṣaṇatā bhavet| varṇaścāsau varṇaiti| kiṃ vyāvṛtam?
kimanvitam? athaikatra viśeṣāṇāṃ rūpasyānyatra ca grahaḥ? śaklaścāsau
varṇa iti na syāt, varṇo viśeṣaṇaṃ śuklasya varṇatvāvyabhicārāt,
tasmādubhayatra viśeṣagrahaṇamityāha - varṇaviśeṣavācītyādi|
kṛṣṇasāraṅga ityādi| nānāvarṇasamāhāraḥ sāraṅgaḥ, tathā sabalaḥ,
tasya varṇāntarasamāhāre'pi bhāvātkārṣyānvayo niyate na syāditi
kṛṣṇo viśeṇam| evaṃ lohitāśabde'pi draṣṭavyam| nanu ca
kṛṣṇaśabdo'trāvayave vartate, na samudāye; tasya sāraṅgatvāt,
tatkathamavayavavṛteḥ kṛṣṇaśabdasya samudāyavṛttinā sāraṅgaśabdena
sāmānādhikaraṇyamata āha - avayavadvāreṇetyādi|
kṛṣṇāvayavasambandhātsamudāya eva kṛṣṇa ucyata ityarthaḥ| ata evātra
gauṇaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyamiti sūtrārambhaḥ| nanu ṭhtṛtīyā tatkṛtena'
ityevātra sidhdaḥ samāsaḥ katham? sāraṅgaśabdo guṇavacanaḥ
sāraṅgatvaṃ kṛṣṇāvayvakṛmityastyeva sidhdiḥ; tatrāyamapyarthaḥ -
ṭhvarṇo varṇeṣvanete' iti pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaro na vaktavyo bhavati,
tatpuruṣe tulyārthatṛtīyetyeva sidhdatvāt, tadavayavaṃ
vaktavyametatpratiṣedhārtham, iha mā bhūt - kṛṣṇaito lohitaita
iti| idaṃ tu na vaktavyam? idamapi vaktavyam, ihāpi yathā
syāt-śuklababhruḥ kṛṣṇaśuklā haritaśuklaḥ babhrūkapilaḥ, yasya
kaścidavayavaḥ śuklaḥ kaścid babhruḥ sa samudāyo'vayavayvaśabdābhyāṃ
tathocyata iti nātra tatkṛtatvasaṃbhavaḥ| atra kṛṣṇasāraṅga ityādau
yatraiko'vayavayavaśabdaḥ, aparaḥ samudāyaśabdaḥ,
tatrāvyavasyāpradhānatvādupasarjanatvātpurvanipātaḥ|
dvayostvavayavaśabdayoḥ paryāya iti draṣṭavyam| iha yasmin prayoge
vīraiḥ puraṣaṃstadvān grāmaḥ pratipādayitamiṣṭastatra
prathamamevānyapadārthavivakṣā kāryā vīrāḥ puruṣā asminsantīti
vīrapuruṣako grāma iti bahuvrīhireva nityaṃ yathā syāt; anyathā
pūrvamanapekṣite'nyapadārthe vīrāḥ puruṣā vīrupuruṣā iti
karmadhāraye kṛte paścādanyapadārthavivakṣāyāṃ matvarthīye sati
vīrapuruṣavān grāma ityādyaniṣṭamapi kadācidanuṣajyeta| sarvaśabdasya
tvakārāntaiḥ karmadhārayo'pīṣyate| tasmācca matvarthavivakṣāyām ṭhata
iniṭhanau' iti ṭhanaṃ bādhitvā inireva bhavatīti vaktavyam sarva dhanaṃ
sarvadhanaṃ tadasyāstīti sarvadhanī, sarvabījī, karvakeśī| yatra
karmadhārayo jātiviśeṣavacanaḥ, tatra karmadhārayānmatvarthīyo bhavati -
kṛṣṇasarpavānvalmīkaḥ, lohitaśālimān grāmaḥ, gaurakharavadaraṇyam,
gauramṛgavaditi| na hi bahuvrīhiṇā tajjātyā tadvatavaṃ śakyaṃ
pratipādayitum|| 

70 || kumāraḥ śramaṇādibhiḥ || 2-1-70 || 
kumāraśabdasya pūrvanipātaniyamārtha vacanam ||

71 catuṣpādo garbhiṇyā || 2-1-71 || 
catuṣpājjātiriti| kecidāhuḥ -
poṭādisūtrājjātigragaṇamanuvartyamiti| anye tvāhuḥ - ye
śabdāntaranirapekṣāścatuṣpājjātivacanāḥ, ta evāntaraṅgatvād
gṛhyante, na tu kālākṣyādayo yaugikāḥ
śabdāntarasaṃnidhānāccatuṣpādviṣayā iti| garbhiṇīśabdasya
paranipādārthaṃ vacanam||

72 mayūravyaṃsakādayaśca || 2-1-72 || 
vyaṃsakaḥ u dhūrtaḥ, mayūraścāsau vyaṃsakaśyeti vyaṃsakaśabdasya
guṇavacanatvātpurvanipāte prāpte vacanam| evaṃ chātravyasakādīnāṃ
kambojamuṇḍaparyantānām| anye tvāhuḥ - mayūraiva vyaṃsakaḥ, chātraiva
vyaṃsakaḥ kamboja iva muṇḍaḥ, yavana iva muṃḍaḥ, umānasamāso'yam,
ṭhupamānāni samānyavacanaiḥ' ityeva sidhde pūnarvidhānaṃ tatpuruṣaṃ
tulyārthatṛtīyeti pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaro mā bhūditi, sa
hyupamānasaṃśbadenena vihite samāse vidhīyata iti| punardāyeti|
ṭhpunaścanasau cchandasi' iti gatisaṃjñā vārtikakārīyeti||
gaṇakāreṇedaṃ paṭhitam, ehi iḍeti yasminkarmaṇi tad ehīḍam,
evam ehīyavam| ehi vāṇijeti yasyāṃ kriyāyāṃ sā ehivāṇijā|
evam-apehi vāṇijā, prehivāṇijā| ehi svāgatamiti yasyāṃ
kriyāyāṃ sā ehisvāgatā| ihavitarkā, loṇmadhyamaikavacanam| proha
karaṭamiti yasyāṃ sā prohakaraṭā; evaṃ prohakardamādaya
āharavasanāntāḥ| ṭhkṛtī chedane' tadeva vacanam, mucāditvānnum|
kṛnta vicakṣaṇeti yasyāṃ kriyāyāṃ sā kṛntavicakṣaṇā| udhdara
utsṛjeti yasyāṃ sodhdarotsṛjā| ṭhākhyātamākhyātena' iti
sidhde'sātatyārtha vacanam| evam udhdamavidhamā, utpacavipacā,
utpatanipatā| udakca avākca uccāvacam, uccaiśca nīcaiśca uccanīcam,
ācitaṃ copacitaṃ ca ācopacam, niścitaṃ ca pracitaṃ ca niścapracam
- sarva ete nipātyate| na kiñcana vidyate yasya so'kiñcanaḥ,
snātvākālakādiṣu samāsāntodātatvaṃ lyababhāvaśca nipātanāt|
pratīyamānakriyāpekṣaṃ ca samānakatṛkatvam-snātvākālakaḥ saṃpanna iti|
jahi karmaṇeti| jahīti loṇyamadhyamaikavacanam; tadetatkarmaṇā
bahulaṃ samasyate ābhīkṣṇye gamyamāne samāsena cetkartā
vidhīyate| jahi joḍamityābhīkṣṇyena ya āha sa jahijoḍaḥ| aśnīta
pibatetyevaṃ yatra satatamabhidhīyate sā aśrātapibatā| evaṃ
pacatabhṛjjatā, ṭhbhrasja pāke' bhindhi lavaṇamiti yasyāmabhidhīyate sā
bhindhilavaṇā| evaṃ pacalavaṇā| avihitalakṣamastatpuruṣa iti| yasya
tatapuruṣasya lakṣaṇaṃ na kṛtam, prāptaprayogaśca bhavati, sa
mayūrakhyaṃsakāderākṛtigaṇatvādatraiva draṣṭavya ityarthaḥ|| 
iti śrīharadatamiśravicitāyāṃ padamañjayau dvitīyādhyāyasya prathama
pādaḥ ||
atha dvitīyādhyāye dvitāyaḥ pādaḥ 
1 pūrvāparādharotaramekadeśinaikādhikaraṇe || 2|2|1 || 
ekadeśo'syāstītyekadeśīti| ekagopūrvāditi ṭhañ prāpnoti, ata
eva nirdeśādinirdraṣṭavyaḥ| ekadaṇḍītyayaṃ tvapaśabdaḥ eko daṇḍo
yasyeti bahuvrīhiṇaiva gatatvānmatvartha eva durlabhaḥ, kiṃ
punariniṣṭhañā bādhitaḥ? ekadeśabdastu karmadhāraya evāvayavavacana iti
na tatra bahuvrīhiṇā gatatvam, yathā - kṛṣṇasarpavāniti|
sāmarthyādekadeśavacanā iti| ekadeśamapekṣyaikadeśī bhavati,
nānyathetyetatsāmarthyam| ekādhikaraṇagrahaṇamekadeśino
viśeṣaṇamiti| satsaptamyantavaiyadhikaraṇyeneti bhāvaḥ, tadāha - eka
cediti| ekatvasaṃkhyāviśiṣṭamityarthaḥ| samānābhidheyavacana
ekādhikaraṇaśabdo na bhavati, avayavāvayaviśabdayoḥ
sāmānādhikaraṇyānupapateḥ, samānādhikaraṇyeneti prakṛtatvācca|
syādetat - ṭhsamudāyeṣu hi dṛṣṭāḥ śabdāḥ avayaveṣvapi vartante'
iti nyāyena samānādhikaraṇye sati pūrvaścāsau kāyaśceti
viśeṣaṇamityeva sidhdaḥ samāso nārtha etena, evaṃ ca kṛtvā
paravalliṅgamityatra tatpuruṣagrahaṇaṃ na kartavyaṃ bhavati, katham?
utarapadārthapradhānatvādeva sidhdamiti, tatraha -
ṣaṣṭhīsamāsāpavādo'yaṃ yoga iti| sidhdaṃ tu kathañcitpūrvakāya
iti, kāyapūrva ityasya nivṛtyarthameva tu sūtraṃ kartavyamityarthaḥ|
pūrve kāyasyeti| yadyapi diśi dṛṣṭaḥ śabdo dikśabda
ityāśrayaṇātsampratyadigvṛttinīpi yoge pañcamī bhavati, ṭhtasya
paramāmreḍitam' iti liṅgādavayavavṛttibhiryoge ṣaṣṭhī bhavati|
pūrve nābheḥ kāyasyeti| nābheriti digyogalakṣaṇā pañcamī,
māyasambandhī nābhyapekṣayā pūrvo bhāga ityarthaḥ| tatra nābhirekadeśī na
bhavatīti na tena samāso bhavati| yastvekadeśī kāyastena samāso
bhavatyeva - pūrvakāyo nābheriti, pūrvaśabdasya sambandhiśabdatvena
nityasāpekṣatvāditi kecidāhuḥ| anye tu -
yatrārthaprakaraṇādināvadhirgamyate tatraiva samāsaḥ, na śabdopādāne
ityāhuḥ| pūrve chātrāṇāmiti| neyaṃ nirdhdāraṇe ṣaṣṭhī, kiṃ tarhi?
samudāyaḥ chātrāṇāmityanenocyata iti bahuvacanam, yathā-chātrāṇāṃ
pañcama iti, tataśca chātrāṇāmekadeśitvamastyeva, kiṃ tu
bahutvasaṃkhyāviśiṣṭānāmiti samāsābhāvaḥ|
saṃkhyāvisāyapūrvasyetyādi| na hyanyathā sāyapūrvatvamahvasyopapadyate
iti bhāvaḥ| kecitu - sarveṇaikadeśavācinā kālavācinaḥ samāso
bhavati, na tvamahanśabdasyaiveti jñāpakaśarīraṃ varṇayanti, tena
madhyarātra ityapi sidhdaṃ bhavati|| 

2 ardhdaṃ napuṃsakam || 2|2|2 ||
āviṣṭaliṅga iti| niyataliṅga ityarthaḥ| tasyedaṃ grahaṇamiti|
tatraivārthe napuṃsakatvasyāvyabhicārād| avayavavācī hyabhidheyavuśena
triliṅgaḥ - apūpārdhdaṃ mayā bhakṣitam, dantārdhdamāsyātpatitam,
grāmārdhdaḥ, nagarārdhaḥ, sarpiṣārdhyayā vyanaktatoti|
ṭhtasyārdhdāḥ śastvārdhdāḥ pariśiṣya madhye nividaṃ dadhāti'
iti| bhāṣye tvavayavavācī puṃliṅga ityupalakṣaṇam | kvacitu
samapravibhāge strīliṅgatā dṛśyate - ekāntṛcerdhdā yugmāsu' iti,
yagmāsu ṛkṣu ardhdāḥ śastvā nividaṃ dadhyādityarthaḥ, tasyārṣatvena
nirvāhaḥ| ardhamiti napusakanirdeśaḥ śabdarūpāpekṣayāpi sambhāvyeta,
yathā ṭhsvamajñātidhanākhyāyām' ṭhbandhuni bahuvrīhau' iti,
tasmānnapuṃsakamityuktam| ardhdapippalīti| pippalīśabdasya ṭhekavibhakti
ca' ityupasarjanasaṃjñā na bhavati; ekavibhkāyavaṣaṣṭha|lntamiti
vacanāt| ardhdaṃ pippalīnāmiti| na tarhīdānīmidaṃ bhavati -
ardhdāni pippalīnāmardhdapippalya iti; naitadasminvigrahe bhavati,
khaṇḍasamudāye bhavati - ardhdapippalī cārdhdapiplī cārdhdapippalya iti|
devadadataśabdena samāso na bhavatīti| devadato'tra svāmī, na
tvekadeśī| yastvekadeśī paśustena bhavatyeva samāsaḥ -
ardhdapaśurdeavatadatasyeti, devadatasvāmikaṃ paśorardhdamityarthaḥ| tatra
samudāyena sambandhānnāsti sāpekṣatvam| ayaṃ yogaḥ śakyo'vaktum|
kathamardhdapippalī? sāmānādhikaraṇye bhaviṣyati ardhdaṃ cāsau
pippalī ceti| nanu ca yadyardhdaṃ na pippalī, atha pippalī nārdhdam,
ardhdaṃ pippalī ceti vipratiṣidhdam? nāsti viprātiṣedhaḥ;
samudāye hi dṛṣṭāḥ śabdā avayaveṣvapi vartante| kiñca
samapravibhāgādanyatrārdhdandrādāvayameva gatiprakāraḥ, samapravibhāge'pi
tathāstu| idaṃ tarhi prayojanam -- mpravibhāge ṣaṣṭhīsamāso mā
bhūditi? iṣyate ṣaṣṭhīsamāsoṣa'pi, tathā ca bhagavānpiṅgalanāgaḥ
prayuṅkte ṭhsvarārdhdaṃ cāryārdhdam' iti| evaṃ tarhi
gauṇatvātsāmānādhikaraṇyasya viśeṣaṇasamāso na kila
syādityamārambhaḥ|| 

3 dvitāyatṛtīyācaturthaturyāṇyanyatarasyām || 2|2|3 || 
anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇātso'pi

kāśikāvṛtau 
padamañjarī
dvitīyatṛtīyacaturthaturyāṇyanyatarasyām| 2|2|3||
dvidīyatṛtīyacaturthaturyāṇyanyatarasyāt||
anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇātso'pi bhavatīti nanu ca pūraṇapratyayāntā evaite
dvitīyādayaḥ, tatra pūraṇaguṇasuhitetyādinā pratiṣedhena
bhavitavyam, yadāpi ṭhpūraṇādbhage tīyādan'iti
svārthiko'npratyayaḥ kriyate, tadāpi ṭhpūraṇaguṇasuhitārtha'
ityarthaśabdasya pratyekamabhisambandhātpūraṇārthagrahaṇam, na tu
tadadhikāravihitapratyayagrahaṇamiti bhavitavyameva pratiṣedhena, tatkathaṃ
so'pi bhavatītyāha--pūraṇaguṇetyādi| vākyasya mahāvibhāṣayaiva
siddhatvātṣaṣṭhīsamāsaprāptyarthamevānyatarasyāṃgrahaṇamiti bhāvaḥ| pūrvaṃ
tu ṣaṣṭhīsamāsāpavādo yoga ityādyaprāptyabhiprāyeṇoktam|
yadvā---satyasminyoge ṣaṣṭhīsamāsapratiṣedhasyāsya ca
ṣaṣṭhīsamāsabodhakatvamaviśiṣṭamiti matvā tathoktam|
ayamapi yogaḥ śakyo'vaktum, katham?
samudāyāvayavayoraupacārike sāmānādhikaraṇye sati
dvitīyabhikṣādi siddham, mukhyārthavṛtau ṣaṣṭhīsamāse tu
bhikṣādvitīyamityādi bhaviṣyatīti| naitatsuṣṭhūacyate, anenaiva
khalvanyatarasyāṃgrahaṇena ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ prāpyate, kathamasminyoge'sati
bhaviṣyati||
prāptāpanne ca dvitīyayā|| 2|2|4 ||
prāptāpanne ca dvitīyayā|| prāptajīvika iti| ṭhekavibhakti'
ityupasarjanatvād hrasvatvam| prāptā jīvikā yeneti karmaṇi
ktāntena bahuvrīhāvapyetatsiddham, samāsāntodātatvārthaṃ tu
vacanam| iha prāptamukhaḥ, prāptaduḥ kha ityādiṣu
ṭhjātikālasukhādibhyaḥ' iti prāptāpannayoḥ paranipātaprasaṅgaśca| iha
liṅgaviśiṣṭaparibhāṣayā prāptāśabdasyāpyayaṃ samāso
bhavati---prāptā jīvikāṃ prāptajīvikā iti puvadbhāvo vaktavyaḥ|
bhāṣye tvakāraḥ pūrvapadasya vidhīyata ityuktam| cakāreṇa
samuccayārthenākārapraśleṣo'numīyate, sautratvācca nirdeśasya
prakṛtibhāvābhāvaḥ, prāptāpanne dvitīyāntena saha samasyete, a ca atvaṃ
ca bhavati prāptāpannayorityarthaḥ||
kālāḥ parimāṇinā|| 2|2|5 ||
kālāḥ parimāṇinā|| sāmarthyātparimāṇavacanā iti|
parimāṇamapekṣyaparimāṇo bhavati, nānyathetyetatsāmarthyam| tatra ca
yadyapi kālaḥ prasthādivatsarvato mānaṃ na bhavati, tathāpi
paricchedahetutvātparimāṇamityucyate| māso jātasyeti kasya
punarayaṃ māsaḥ paricchedakaḥ; na tāvajjātasya, tasya hi diṣṭa|ladi
parimāṇaṃ na tu māsaḥ; nāpi jananakriyā, tasyā
ekakṣaṇabhāvitvānmāsena sambandhābhāvāt?
ucyate---jananakriyāvadhirmāse na paricchadyate| māso jātasyeti,
ko'rthaḥ? jananakriyāyā ūrdhvamasya māso jātaḥ, atīte māse'sya
jananamiti yāvat| anena prakāreṇa māso jātasya parimāṇam,
yathā---māse deyamṛṇamiti ṛṇadānasyāvadhirmāsena paricchidyate|
māsajāta iti| yathā gāvo'sya santīti gomāniti vākye
ṣaṣṭhīnirdiṣṭasyāpi tadvato vṛtau prādhānyam, tatkasya hetoḥ?
abhihitaḥ ṣaṣṭha|lrtho'ntarbhūtaḥ prātipadikārthaḥ saṃpanna iti,
yathā---citrā gāvo'sya citraguḥ puruṣa iti bahuvrīhāviti,
tadvadatrāpi vākye ṣaṣṭhīnirdeaṣṭasyāpi tadvato jātasya vṛtau
prādhānyāṃ draṣṭavyam| tathā ca māsajāto dṛśyatāmiti kriyāyogo
jātasyaiva bhavati, na punararddhapippalyādivatpūrvapadārthasya|
dvyahajāta iti| dvayorahnoḥ samāhāraḥ ṭhrājāhaḥ sakhibhyaṣṭaca,'ṭhna
saṃkhyādeḥ samāhāre' ityahnādeśasya pratiṣedhaḥ| kathaṃ tarhi
dvyahajāta iti, dve ahanī asya jātasyeti trayāṇāṃ padānāṃ
yugapadanena samāse kṛte jātaśabda utarapade parataḥ
pūrvayordvigurbhaviṣyati? nanu ca ṭhsupsupā'ityekatvasaṃkhyāyā
vivakṣitatvād dvayordvayoḥ na bahūnāṃ yugapat?
ucyate----vaktavyamevaitad utarapadena parimāṇinā dvayoḥ
samāsavacanamiti; parimāṇivacanenotarapadena dvigoḥ siddhaye
samāso vaktavyaḥ| atha dvayoryugapaditi gamyate,
tasmādvacanādbahūnāmapyayaṃ samāso bhavati| evaṃ dvau māsau jātasya
dvimāsajātaḥ, tripade tatpuruṣe jātaśabda utarapade parataḥ
pūrvayostatpuruṣe sati kālānte dvigāvapi pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaro
bhavati| dvayormāsayoḥ samāhāro dvimāsam pātrādi, dvimāsaṃ
jātasyeti vigṛhya samāse kriyamāṇe sati
śiṣṭatvātsamāsāntodātatvaṃ syāt| iha māsau jātasya, māsā
jātasyeti dvivacanabahuvacanāntānāmayaṃ samāso bhavati| vṛtau
vibhaktau nivṛtāyāṃ dvitvabahutvāvagatau pramāṇābhāvād
abhedaikatvasaṃkhyāpyatra na bhavati, śuddhameva tvekatvaṃ gamyate| yatra
dvayorbahuṣu vānusyūta ekaḥ śabdārthastatraivābhedaikatvasaṃkhya,
māsaśabdastvaktaparimāṇamarthamācaṣṭa iti dvitvabahutvāvagatau
vibhaktimapekṣate, svatastvekatvasyaivāsādhāraṇaḥ||
nañ|| 2|2|6 ||
nañ|| vibhaktiñakārayorviśeṣābhāvād ñakāroccāraṇam|
supānaśabdasya viśeṣaṇātpāmādilakṣaṇasya nasyāsuvantatvādevāgrahaṇaṃ
siddham| ihābrāhmaṇādiśabdeḥ kṣatriyādyabhidhānamiṣyate, tatra
jātimātrapare brāhmaṇaśabde na vidyate brāhmaṇyaṃ yasya so'brāhmaṇaḥ
kṣatriyādirityanyapadārthapradhānaḥ samāso bhavati| tatra nāprāpte
bahuvrīhāvārambhādanena tasya bādhanādabrāhmaṇako deśa ityapi na
siddhyati; na hi pravṛttinimitamātraniṣṭheṣu brāhmaṇādiśabdeṣvayaṃ
samāsaḥ, nadvanniṣṭheṣviti niyāmakamasti| iha cāvarṣā hemanta iti
hemantasya yadvacane tatsamāsasya prāpnoti, liṅge tu
paravalliṅgamiti vacanāddoṣābhāvaḥ| iha ca aso'sarvasmai
ityutarapadārthasyopasarjanatvātyadādikāryaṃ sarvādikāryaṃ ca na
syāt| yadā tvasatsāmānyavartamāno nañ brāhmāṇādibhirviśeṣyate,
brāhmaṇatvenāsatkriyāntareṇa tu san kṣatriyādiko'brāhmaṇa iti, tadā
pūrvapadārthapradhānam; tatra nañarthasya prādhānyātsaṃkhyāyogaḥ
casamāsasya na syāt, vācanikī tu paravalliṅgatā bhavatu|
syādetat----śabdaśaktisvābhāvyādasatvarūpamarthaṃ vākye na nañācaṣṭe,
samāse tu satvarūpam, tena siddhaḥ saṃkhyaayogaḥ?
evamapyapavādenānenāvyayībhāvasya bādhādamakṣikamiti na siddhyati,
tasya tu nirmakṣikamityādiravakāśaḥ, aso'sarvasmai iti ca
pūrvavatsmāyādyasiddhiḥ| astu tarhyatrotarapadārthapradhānaḥ? yadyevam,
brāhmaṇamātrasyānayanaṃ prāpnoti? yadyautarapadārthapradhānatā tatra hetuḥ,
ihāpi tarhi rājapuruṣamānayetyukte puruṣamātrasyānayanaṃ prāpnoti?
astyatra viśeṣaḥ, rājā viśeṣakaḥ prayujyate| ihāpi tarhi nañ
viśeṣakaḥ prayujyate? kathaṃ nañ nāma syāt, aniyataguṇasya
guṇaviśeṣapratipādanāya hi viśeṣaṇaṃ pravartate, na tadupaghātāya|
nañā ca brāhmaṇārthaḥ sarvātmanā pratiṣidhyamānaḥ pratiṣidhyata iti
kathamasataḥ prādhānyaṃ
syāt!tasmādutarapadārthaprādhānyamicchatā'sminviṣaye nañanarthakaḥ,
anvākhyanasāmarthyātu sādhutvamevaṃbhūta syārthavadanarthakāvayavasya
samāsasyeti vācyam, tataśca brāhmaṇamātrasyānayanaṃ prāpnoti? naiṣa
doṣaḥ; nivṛtapadārthako'tra brāhmaṇaśabdaḥ, sā ca nivṛttiḥ svābhāvikī
nañā dyotyate, ko'parthaḥ? kevalo brāhmaṇaśabdaḥ prayujyamānaḥ
prasiddhivaśānmukhyameva brāhmaṇamācaṣṭe; nañprayogeṇa tu kṣatriyādau
sādṛśyādinā nimitenādhyāropitaṃ brāhmaṇyaṃ na tātvikamiti
dyotyate| tadevaṃ mukhyo brāhmaṇaśabdasyārtho nivṛtaḥ jātaścāmukhyaḥ
kṣatriyādiriti na brāhmaṇamātrānayanam, nāpi na kasyacidānayanamiti
siddham| uktaṃ ca----
ṭhprāk samāsātpadārthānāṃ nivṛttirdyotyate nañā|
svabhāvato nivṛtānāṃ rūpabhedādalakṣitā||' iti|
syādetat---arthapratyāyanāya śabdaḥ prayujyate brāhmaṇārthaścennivṛttiḥ,
kiṃ mudhā brāhmaṇapadaṃ prayujyate? tanna; asati brāhmaṇapade
netyetāvatsucyamāne kasyārtho'tra nivartayitumiṣṭa iti na jñāyate|
brāhmaṇapade tu sati tadarthasya kṣatriyādau mukhyaḥ satāvirahaḥ pratīyate|
anyaddarśanam---sarva ete śabdā guṇasamudāye vartante, smaryante
ca----
ṭhtapaḥ śrutaṃ ca yoniścetyetadbrāhmaṇyakāraṇam|
tapaḥ śrutābhyāṃ yo hīno jātibrāhmaṇa eva saḥ||"iti
tathā ca śrutiḥ----
ṭhṣaḍ vyādhayo yaṃ puruṣaṃ tapanti jaihvo hārda audaro raitasaśca|
taptaśca gharmaḥ śiśiraśca śītaḥ brāhmaṇastaṃ smarārthaṃ garutman'|| iti
gauraḥ śucyācāraḥ piṅgalakeśa ityādayaśca dharmāḥ, tadeṣāṃ
samudāye brāhmaṇaśabdaḥ, evaṃ kṣatriyādiśabdeṣvapi draṣṭavyam| evaṃ
sthite samudāyeṣu vṛtāḥ śabdāḥ avayaveṣvati vartanta iti
nyāyājjātibhinne guṇabhinne vā yadā brāhmaṇaśabdo vartate tadā
svābhāvikī jātiguṇanivṛttirnañā dyotyate,
aviṣṭāṃśasadbhāvapratipādanāya brāhmaṇaśabdaprayogaḥ| yadyevam,
dvayorapi bhinnaviṣayatvaprasaṅgaḥ, katham? yasyāṃśasya sadbhāvaṃ
brāhmaṇaśabda āha, na tasyābhāvaṃ nañāha; yasyābhāvaṃ nañāha, na tasya
sadbhāvaṃ brāhmaṇaśabda āha? naiṣa doṣaḥ; dvāvapyetau
samudāyāvalambinau kṛtavat, tadyathaikadeśakaraṇākaraṇābhyāmekameva
vastu kṛtaṃ cākṛtaṃ ca bhavati, tathehāpyekadeśavibhāgāt samudāya
eva nivṛta utyate, ekadeśasadbhāvācca sa eva sannabhidhīyata iti
sarvamanavadyam|
ihāneko jana āgata iti dvyādiṣvekatvamāropitaṃ pratīyate,
mukhyaṃ tu pratiṣidhyate, kṣatriyādāviva brāhmaṇyamityekavacanameva
bhavati dvyādisaṃkhyā pratīyate| tadevamutarapadārthapradhāna iti
sthitam| atra ca liṅgam---ṭhetatadoḥ sulopo'koranañ'
ityatrānañsamāsagrahaṇam| anyathaitatadorarthadvāreṇa sambandhinaḥ
sorlopo vidhīyamāno naiṣo dadātyaso dadātītyatra kathaṃ
prāpnuyāt| iha na brāhmaṇasya bhāva iti bhāvena nañā ca yugapatsambandhe
vivakṣite tvatalau ca prāpnutaḥ, samāsaśca; tatra yadi paratvātvatalau
kṛtvā paścātpunaḥ prasaṅgavijñānānnañsamāsaḥ, kriyate, tataḥ
ṭhtatpuruṣe tulyārtha' iti pūrvapadaprakṛtisvareṇādyaudātaṃ padaṃ
syāt, pratyayasvaro nañsvaraśceṣyata iti samāse kṛte tvatalau
kāryau| āha ca---tvatalbhyāṃ nañsamāsaḥ pūrvavipratiṣiddhaṃ tvataloḥ
svarasiddhyarthamiti| tatra bhāvapratyayastāvatprakṛtyarthasya
sāpekṣatvenāsāmarthyānna bhavati, nañsamāsastu pradhānasya
sāpekṣatvādbhavati||
īṣadakṛtā|| 2|2|7 ||
īṣadakṛtā|| īṣad guṇavacaneneti vaktavyamiti| akṛtetyapanīya
sūtre guṇavacanagrahaṇaṃ kartavyamityarthaḥ| akṛteti cocyamāna
īṣadrārgya ityādāvativyāptiḥ, īṣadunnatityādāvavyāptiḥ syāditi
bhāvaḥ| īṣadrārgya iti| nanu ca gārgyo bhavati vā na vā na
punarīṣadrārgyaḥ kaścita? ucyate; gārgyatvena saha ya
ekārthasamavetāḥ kriyāguṇāstadapekṣayā jāteḥ
prakarṣādiyogaḥ----gārgyataraḥ, gārgyakalpaḥ, īṣadrārgyaḥ, gārgyapāśa
iti; yathā----gotaraḥ, gokalpaḥ, gopāśa iti||
ṣaṣṭhī|| 2|2|8 ||
ṣaṣṭhī|| kṛdyogā cetyādi| ṭhkartṛkarmaṇoḥ kṛti' iti
kṛcchabdopādānena yā vihitā sā kṛdyogā| idhmapravraścana iti|
ṭhovraścū cchedane', ṭhkaraṇe lyuṭ| palāśaśātana iti| palāśāni
śātyanteupātyante yena daṇḍādinā sa palāśaśātanaḥ|
kimarthamidamucyata iti| sūtreṇa siddhiṃ manvānasya praśna|
pratipadavidhānā cetyādi| yadā tasya vaktavyasyārambhaḥ tadedamapi
vaktavyam| tasya tvanārabhyatāṃ tatraiva vakṣyāmaḥ| apakarṣa iti| apavāda
ityarthaḥ||
yājakādibhiśca|| 2|2|9 ||
yājakādibhiśca|| pratiprasavārthamiti| anyena nivartitasya punaḥ
pravṛtyabhyanujñānamupratiprasavaḥ| tatsthaiśca guṇaiḥ ṣaṣṭhī samasyata iti
vaktavyamiti kvacidvṛtau paṭha|lte, tasyārthaḥ----tacchabdena sannidhānād
guṇā eva parāmṛśyante, tasmiṃstvātmani ye guṇāḥ sthitāstaiḥ ṣaṣṭhī
samasyate| na ca svātmanyavasthānaṃ kasyacitsambhavati, bhedanibandhano
hyādhārādheyabhāvaḥ; viśeṣato guṇānāṃ dravyāśritatvāt|
tasmādabhidhānavyāpārāpekṣayā tatsthatvamucyate| gandhādayo hi guṇāḥ
svaśabdairdravyātpṛthakkṛtā eva ca pratyāyyante ---candanasya gandha iti, na
tu kadācid dravyeṇaikatvamāpannāḥ na hi bhavati candanaṃ gandha iti|
śuklādayastu kadācid dravyātpṛthagbhūtāḥ pratyāyyante--paṭasya śukla
iti, kadācid dravyasyopañjakāstenaikatvamāpannāḥ----śuklaḥ paṭa iti|
tatra ye guṇā dravyātpṛthagbhūtā eva svaśabdena pratyāyyante
tatparigrahāya ṭhtatsthaiḥ' ityuktam| balākāyāḥ śauklyamityatra tu
yadyapi śauklyaśabdena dravyātpṛthagbhūtasyaivābhidhānam, tathāpi tadeva
śauklyaṃ śuklaḥ paṭa ityatra dravyeṇaikatāmāpannaṃ pratyāyyate| arthasya
tatsthatvamāśrīyate, iti śabdabhede'pyarthaḥ sa eveti nāsti śauklyasya
tatsthatvamiti samāsābhāvaḥ| rūpavānpaṭa ityatra bhedāśrayeṇaiva
matvarthīyenābhedo'dhyavasīyate iti tatsthameva rūpamiti paṭarūpamiti
bhavatyeva samāsaḥ| ayamapi ṭhguṇena na' iti pratiṣedhasya
purastādapakarṣaḥ| candanagandha iti| ṭhgandhaṃ vikrīṇīte'iti
candanagandhādau gandhaśabdo jātinimitakaḥ, na guṇaśabdaḥ;
mālatīkusumādiṣvadarśanāditi tatstha eva gandhaḥ| bhāṣye tu ṭhna tu
tadviśeṣaṇaiḥ' iti paṭhitam, teṣāṃ guṇānāṃ yāni viśeṣaṇāni taiḥ
saha samāso na bhavati---ghṛtasya tīvro gandhaḥ, candanasya mṛduḥ sparśa
iti tīvramṛduśabdābhyāṃ samāso na bhavati| tadidamanyathāsiddhamiti
vṛttikāreṇa upekṣitam katham? ghṛtasya gandhena sambandhaḥ, na
tadviśeṣaṇena tībreṇa| yadāpi prakaraṇādivaśātīvraśabda eva viśeṣe
gandhe vartate, tadupajanita eva vyatireke ghṛtasyeti ṣaṣṭhī, tathāpi
tīvraṃ ghṛtamiti darśanātatsthatvābhāvādeva samāsāprasaṅgaḥ||
----------||||||||||||||------------

kāśikāvṛttiḥ
dvitīyādhyāye dvitīyaḥ pādaḥ ipadamañjarī
na nirghāraṇe|| 2|2|10 ||
na nirddhāraṇe|| jātiguṇakriyābhiriti| upalakṣaṇametat; kataro
bhavatordeavadata iti saṃjñāyāmapi nirddhāraṇadarśanāt| kṣatriyo
manuṣyāṇāṃ śūratama iti| atra kṣatriyaśabdena samāsaprasaṅgaḥ;
tadapekṣayā hi manuṣyāṇāmiti ṣaṣṭhī, na śūratamāpekṣayā,
guṇaśabdatvācca na tena samāsaprasaṅgaḥ| kṛṣṇā gavāmiti|
nātrāyamarthaḥ----gavāṃ madhye yā kṛṣṇā sā sampannakṣīratameti, evaṃ hi
kṛṣṇāśabdasya gavāmityanena sambandhaḥ| na ca tasya samāsaprasaṅgaḥ;
guṇena neti pratiṣedhāt| tasmādravāṃ madhye yā sampannakṣīratamā sā
kṛṣṇetyayamatrārthaḥ| dhāvannadhvagānāmiti| atra dhāvacchabdena
samāsāprasaṅgaḥ; satsaṃjñakatvāt| śīghratamaśabdastu guṇaśabdo na
veti cintyam| pratipadavidhānā ceti| śeṣalakṣaṇāṃ muktvā sarvānyā
pratipadavidhānā ṣaṣṭhī| kathaṃ gṛhasvāmī, vidyādāyādaḥ, pṛthivīśvara
iti, yāvatā ṭhsvāmīśvara' ityādinā pratipadamatra ṣaṣṭhī ? nānena ṣaṣṭhī
vidhīyate, kiṃ tarhi? saptamī| sā tu ṣaṣṭhaāā mā bādhiṣṭeti cakāreṇa
śeṣalakṣaṇaivābhyanujñāyate| ata eva ṭhna nirddhāraṇe' iti sūtrārambhaḥ|
ṭhyataśca nirddhāraṇam' ityatrāpi hi cakāreṇa śeṣalakṣaṇaiva ṣaṣṭhī
pratiprasūyate; anyathā sāpi pratipadavidhānaiva syāditi kiṃ ṭhna
nirddhāraṇe' ityanena| sarpiṣo jñānamiti| ṭhjño'vidarthasya karaṇe' iti
ṣaṣṭhī| atrāhuḥ---ṭhjño'vidarthasya karaṇe' iti ṣaṣṭhīprakaraṇe ṭhśeṣe'
iti vartate, tatra na māṣāṇāmaśnīyāditivat ṭhṣaṣṭhī śeṣe'
ityanenaiva siddhā ṣaṣṭhī, prakaraṇaṃ tu niyamārtham| ṣaṣṭhī bhavatyeva
śrūyata eva, na tasyāḥ samāso bhavatītyarthaḥ| samāse ṭhsupo
dhātuprātipadikayoḥ' iti subluk syāt| tasmātpratipadavidhānā
ceti na vaktavyam, evaṃ ca kṛtvā ṭhkṛdyogā ca' ityapi na vaktavyam,
ṭhkartṛkarmaṇoḥ kṛti' ityatra hi ṭhśeṣe' iti nivṛtamiti vakṣyate,
tena kartṛkarmavivakṣāyāmaprāptaiva ṣaṣṭhī tena vidhīyata iti kutaḥ
samāsanivṛttiriti||
pūraṇaguṇasuhitārthasadavyayatavyasamānādhikaraṇena|| 2|2|11 ||
pūraṇaguṇasuhitārthasadavyayatavyasamānādhikaraṇena|| pratyekamiti|
pūraṇādibhirityarthaḥ| svarūpavidhiriti| pūraṇādīnāmarthaparyantānāṃ
caturṇāmityarthaḥ| ata eva guṇaśabdena nādeṅaṃ grahaṇam, kiṃ tarhi ?
ṭhsatve niviśate'paiti' ityādilakṣaṇalakṣitasya guṇasya grahaṇam; nāpi
naño guṇapratiṣedhe yasya guṇasya hi bhāvādivatpravṛttinimitamātrasya
grahaṇam, sāmānyāderapi prasaṅgāt; nāpi lokaprasiddhasya
śuklādereva grahaṇam, kaṇṭakasya taikṣṇyamityāderapīṣṭatvāt;
guṇaśabdena ca kevalaguṇavācino guṇopasarjanadravyavācinaśca
vyāptinyāyāśrayeṇa gṛhyante| tatra guṇasya
guṇyapekṣatvātkevalaguṇavacanairguṇena samāsaniṣedhaḥ----kaṇṭakasya
taikṣṇyamiti| guṇavacanaistu tatsambandhino niṣedhaḥ----brāhmaṇasya śuklā
dantā iti, na cātra dantāpekṣayā brāhmaṇasyeti ṣaṣṭhī, tataśca
śuklenāsambandhādaprasaṅga eva samāsasya| yadā tarhyarthātprakaraṇādvā
dantā dyarthaṃ eva śuklādiśabdasya vṛttirvijñātā bhavati, tadā tatsambandha
eva ṣaṣṭhītyasti samāsaprasaṅgaḥ, ṭhśatasahasrāntācca niṣkāt',
ṭhkrośaśatayojanaśatayorupasaṃkhyānam' ṭhkhārīśatamapi na dadāti'
ityādi munitrayaprayogād goviṃśatirityādau saṃkhyayā samāso na
niṣidhyate|
saṃjñāpramāṇatvādutarapadārthaprādhānyamityādiprayogadarśanādanityo
guṇena niṣedha iti karaṇapāṭavaṃ buddhimāndyaṃ
yatnagauravamityādisiddhiḥ|
phalānāṃ suhita iti| karaṇasyaiva śeṣatvavivakṣayā ṣaṣṭhī,
śeṣatvavivakṣaiva ca niyatā suhitārthayoge karaṇasyetyāhuḥ,
kṛdyogalakṣaṇāyā eva ṣaṣṭha|la niṣṭhāyoge niṣedhaḥ| brāhmaṇasya
kurvanniti| neyaṃ ghaṭādyapekṣayā ṣaṣṭhī---brāhmaṇasya ghaṭṃa kurvanniti, evaṃ
hyasāmarthyādeva samāsasyāprasaṅgaḥ; kiṃ tarhi? kurvanniti kiṅkara
ucyate, sa hi kurvan bhavati, tato yathā brāhmaṇasya pācaka iti
sākṣādeva pācakena sambandho na punarodanadvāreṇa, tadvadihāpatīti
draṣṭavyam| corasya dviṣanniti ca sata udāharaṇam, atra ṭhdviṣaḥ śaturvā
vacanam' iti pakṣe ṣaṣṭhī bhavati| brāhmaṇasya kṛtveti| brāhmaṇārthaṃ
kṛtvetyarthaḥ, sambandhasāmānyarūpeṇa vivakṣitatvāt ṣaṣṭhī| purā
sūryasyodetoriti codāharaṇam, atra hyavyayaprapiṣedhe
ṭhtosunorapratiṣedhaḥ' iti kartaryeva ṣaṣṭha|lsti| evaṃ
vṛkṣasyoparītyādikamapyudāharaṇam| tavyatā sānubandhakeneti|
ṭhniranubandhakagrahaṇe na sānubandhakasya grahaṇam' iti bhāvaḥ|
brāhmaṇakartavyamiti| kartari ṣaṣṭhayāḥ samāsaḥ
kṛdutarapadaprakṛtisvareṇāntasvaritametat, niranubandhakena tu
samāse utarapadaṃ madhyodātaṃ syāt, so'yaṃ
svarārthastavyenaniṣedhaḥ| śukasya mārāvikasyeti| mā rāvītyāheti
mārāvikaḥ, ṭhtadāheti mā śabdādibhya upasaṃkhyānam' iti ṭhak,
śabdena kriyāyāḥ pratiṣedhako mārāvikaḥ, saṃjñaiṣā śukaviśeṣasya,
kvacitu mārāvidasyeti pāṭhaḥ, tatra mārāviśabdaṃ dadātīti
mārāvidaḥ, sa evārthaḥ| kiṃ ca syāditi| bhavitavyamevātra
viśeṣaṇasamāsena, tat ṣaṣṭhīsamāsa evāstu, ko doṣa iti praśnaḥ|
pūrvanipātāniyamaḥ syāditi| dvayorapi
prathamānirdiṣṭatvenopasarjanatvāditi bhāvaḥ| nanu
viśeṣaṇasamāse'pi dvayorapi yatra
viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvastatreṣyuktam, atastenāpi samāse
viśeṣaṇamiti prathamānirdeśo dvayorapi tulyaḥ| atha
tatrāpradhānamupasarjanamārthaṃ cāprādhānyamiti dravyaguṇādiṣu tena
prakāreṇa vyavasthā, ṣaṣṭhīsamāse'pi tathaiva vyavasthā bhaviṣyati|
tasmādyatatra pratyudāharaṇam---takṣakaḥ sarpa iti, tayoḥ ṣaṣṭha|lntayoḥ
samāsaprasaṅga eva doṣaḥ, tannivṛtaye ca pratiṣedha iti vācyam|
tadiha ṭhkiṃ ca syāt' ityādikamevānupapannam, udāharaṇaṃ tūpapannam
yadi mārāvikaśabdaḥ saṃjñā| atha so'pi yogavṛttiḥ tarhi
tadapyanupapannam| evaṃ pāṭaliputrake'pi draṣṭavyam||
ktena ca pūjāyām|| 2|2|12 ||
ktena ca pūjāyām|| tasyeti| matyādisūtravihitasya sarvasyaiva ktasya
grahaṇaṃ na tu pūjāyāmeva vihitasyetyarthaḥ| kathaṃ tarhi
pūjāgrahaṇamityāha----pūjāgrahaṇamiti| vivakṣitasya ktasya
taṭasthamupalakṣaṇaṃ pūjāgrahaṇam, gṛhasyeva kākaḥ, na tu
samāsaniṣedhārthamityarthaḥ| tena matibuddhyorapi vihitasya grahaṇaṃ
bhavatīti bhāvaḥ| pūjāyāṃ vihita iti| vartamānāditi śeṣaḥ|
rājñāmiti| ṭhktasya ca vartamāne' iti ṣaṣṭhī| kathaṃ rājābhimata iti,
asti hi bhaṭṭikāvye prayogaḥ----ṭhkānahaṃ sa rāmamahitaḥ kṛtavān'
iti, ṭhmaha pūjāyām' rāmasya mahita ityarthaḥ? kaścidāha----"yadā
vartamāne ktastadā ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaniṣedhaśca, yadā bhūte ktastadā kartari
tṛtīyaiva bhavati, yathā----ṭhpūjito yaḥ surairapi' iti, tasyāḥ
ṭhkartṛ karaṇe kṛtā bahulam' iti samāsaḥ" iti| syādevaṃ yadi bhūte
kto labhyaḥ, na; nāprāpte tasminnārabhyamāṇaḥ ṭhbhatibuddhipūjārthebhyaśca'
iti vartamāne ktastasya bādhako bhavati, yathā ca vaḍavāyā vṛṣe vācya
iti apatye prāpto ṭhak tato'pakṛṣya vidhīyate, apatye tvaṇeva
bhavatīti vakṣyati| evaṃ ca ṭhpūjito yaḥ surairapi'
ityacikatsyo'paśabdaḥ| tvayā jñāto mayā jñāta tu bhavatyeva;
tenetyadhikāre upajñāta iti nirdeśāt|
apara āha---ṭhktena ca pūjāyām' ityādiṣu kārakaṣaṣṭha|la eva niṣedhaḥ|
tadeva tu kartādikārakaṃ yadā śeṣarūpeṇa vivakṣyate tadā bhavatyeva
samāsa iti| tatra svare viśeṣaḥ, kārakaṣaṣṭhayāḥ samāse kṛtsvaro
bhavati, śeṣaṣaṣṭhayāḥ samāse samāsāntodātatvamiti| evaṃ tu yat
ṭhjanikartuḥ prakṛtiḥ', ṭhtatprayojako hetuśca'
ityādāvucyate---ṭhnipātanātsamāsaḥ' iti, tadanupapannam; śeṣaṣaṣṭha|la
eva samāsasya siddhatvāt| atha ye'mī navīnā vaiyākaraṇā ārabhante
tadapārthakamāpadyeta| tasmādāptaprayogasya yathākathaṃcinnirvāhaḥ, na tu
yathāruci padyayoga iti dhīrā manyante||
ṭhktena' iti nivṛtam| karmagrahaṇaṃ ṣaṣṭhīviśeṣaṇam| karmaṇi ca yā
ṣaṣṭhī sā na samasyate| ṭhubhayaprāptau karmaṇi' iti ṣaṣṭha|la idaṃ
graharagam| āścaryo gavāṃ doho'gopālakena| rocate odanasya
bhojanaṃ devadatena| sādhu khalu payasaḥ pānaṃ devadatena| vicitrā
sūtrasya kṛtiḥ pāṇininā||
adhikaraṇavācinā ca|| 2|2|13 ||
adhikaraṇavācinā ca|| ṭhadhikaraṇa' ityeva siddhe vācigrahaṇaṃ
cintyaprayojanam, katham? ṭhkavṛte lipsāyām',ṭhyadvṛtānnityam'
iti, nāyamadhikaraṇe ktaḥ, ka tarhi? bhāve| kimo vṛtaṃ yasmin yado
vṛtaṃ yasminniti vyadhikaraṇapado bahuvrīhiḥ||
karmaṇi ca|| 2|2|14 ||
karmaṇi ca || ubhayaprāptau karmaṇīti|
anekārthatvānnipātānāmitītyarthe caśabdo'yam, tena
karmaṇītyuccārya yā ṣaṣṭhī vidhīyate sā na samasyata ityarthaḥ| yadi ca
yā kācana karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī gṛhyaeta ṭhkartari ca' iti niṣedhaṃ na kuryād;
aneneva siddhatvāt| sādhu payasaḥ pānamiti| karmaṇi ca yena
saṃsparśāditi nityasamāsārthavacanamiti vakṣyati, tatra payaḥ
sukhamityudāhariṣyate| idaṃ tu śarīrasukhasyāvivakṣāyāṃ
rogādyabhibhūto'śaknuvanneva yadā sādhu pibati, tadā draṣṭavyama||
tṛjakābhyāṃ kartari|| 2|2|15 ||
tṛjakābhyāṃ kartari|| kartṛ grahaṇaṃ ṣaṣṭhīviśeṣaṇamiti| atha
kasmādviparyayayo nāśrīyate---iha tṛjakaviśeṣaṇaṃ kartṛ
grahaṇamutaratra ṣaṣṭhīviśeṣaṇamiti, evaṃ tṛjgrahaṇamutarārthamiti na
vaktavyaṃ bhavati? ucyate; ṭhnityaṃ krīḍājīvikayoḥ' ityatra
tṛjgrahaṇasyānanuvṛttiḥ śaṅkyeta ṭhkartari ca' ityatra
sambandhāsambhavāt, na hi tṛjprayoge kartari ṣaṣṭhī sambhavatīti|
nanu ca ṭhtṛjkrīḍājīvikayornāstītyakaevodāhriyate' iti vakṣyati,
evaṃ tarhi tathānāśritamityeva| bhavataḥ śāyiketi|
ṭhparyāyārhaṇotpatiṣu ṇvuc'| tṛcprayoge kartari ṣaṣṭhī nāstīti|
tenaiva karturabhihitatvāt|
ikṣubhakṣikāmiti| karmaṇi ṣaṣṭha|la samāsaḥ| ma iti| ṭhdhārerutamarṇa' iti
saṃpradāne caturthī||
kartari|| 2|2|16 ||
kartari|| sambhave vyabhicāre ca sati viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvo
bhavatītyāha sāmarthyāditi| sambandhiśabdasyeti| avayavaprasiddheḥ
samudāyaprasiddhirbalīyasīti bhāvaḥ|
anyastvāha---hotṛśabdasāhacaryāditi; tanna, na hi tatra bahvaco
hotā gṛhyate| sa eva sambandhiśabdaḥ kṣīrahotetyādau kṣīptetyeva
gamyate||
nityaṃ krīḍājīvikayoḥ|| 2|2|17 ||
nityaṃ krīḍājīvikayoḥ|| neti nivṛtamiti| nityagrahaṇād,
mahāvibhāṣādhikārādvilakpenaiva pākṣikasya pratiṣedhasya
siddhatvānnityaḥ pratiṣedho bhaviṣyati, kiṃ nityagrahaṇena ! tṛc
krīḍājīvikayornāstīti| vāmanastu ṭhake jīvikārtha' ityatra ṭhaka iti
kiṃ ramaṇīyakartā' iti jīvikāyāṃ tṛcaṃ pratyudāhariṣyati| sa
manyate---mā bhūtkrīḍāyāṃ tṛc, lakṣaṇābhāvāt, jīvikāyāṃ tu
ṇvultṛcāviti ṇvuliva tṛc kasmānna syāditi| anye tu
tadanusāreṇedamapyevaṃ vyācakṣate---krīḍājīvikayornāstīti
dvyornāsti, kintvanyataratraivetyarthaḥ| aka evodāhriyata iti|
ubhayatretyarthaḥ| uddālakapuṣpabhañjiketyādau| saṃjñāyāmiti ṇvula|
nityagrahaṇamutarārtham| na hi vākyena krīḍājīvikayoravagatirasti,
kriyākārakasambandhamātrāvagamāt||
kugatiprādayaḥ|| 2|2|18 ||
kugatiprādayaḥ|| kuśabdo'vyayaṃ gṛhyata iti| svarādiṣvapaṭhito'pyayaṃ
paṭhitavya iti bhāvaḥ| nityasamāsaviṣayasyāsya
pūrvapadaprakṛtisvarāṇāmavyayatvam, yathā vakṣyati---avyaye
nañkunipātānāmiti vaktavyamiti| na dravyavacana iti|
pṛthivyādidravye yo vartate sa na gṛhyata ityarthaḥ| durnindāyāmiti|
praśapte dveṣānnindā bhavati, pāpaṃ tu vastusthityā garhitamiti
dvayorapyupādānam|
prāyikamiti| anyatheṣadarthe ceti koḥ kādeśavidhānamanupapannaṃ
syāt| duṣkṛtamiti| durnindāyāmiti viṣayanirdeśo gatitvena
prāptasyāpi samāsasya niyāmakaḥ syāditi manyate| yadā tu
prādigrahaṇaprāptasyaiva niyāmakastadā gatitvādevātra siddhaḥ samāsaḥ|
duratra kṛcchrārtho'nabhidhānātkṛteḥ khal na bhavati, duṣkara
ityādāvupapadasamāsaḥ, āmandrairindra haribhirityāṅe mandraṃ
pratyagatitvādanīṣadarthatvācca samāsābhāva ityaikasvarthaṃ na bhavati|
suṣṭuatamiti| suśabdo'tiśaye, na pūjāyām| ata
evopasarganibandhanaṃ ṣatvam| atistutamiti| ṭhatiratikramaṇe ca' iti
karmapravacanīyatvātṣatvābhāvaḥ||
prādayo gatādyartha iti| vṛttiviṣaye gatādyarthavṛtayaḥ prādayo
gatitvābhāve'pi prādigrahaṇena samasyanta iti|
paryadhyayana iti| pariśrānto'dhyayanārthamityarthaḥ|
vāsasī iveti| ṭhvaserṇicca' ityasunpratyayānto vāsaḥ śabdaḥ,
vastraśabdaḥ ṣṭranpratyayāntaḥ, dvāvapi nityādyaudātau|
prādiprasaṅga iti| sūtre prādigrahaṇamagatyarthamiti karmapravacanīyānāṃ
pratiṣedha ucyate, pratyādiviṣayaścāyaṃ niṣedhaḥ| svatyostu samāso
bhavatyeva| vṛkṣaṃ pratīti| karmapravacanīyena yogād
dvitīyāvatsamāsasyāpi prasaṅgaḥ, udātavatā siṅa gateḥ
samāsavacanam---yo jāta eva paryabhūṣat, yaḥ śambaramanvavindat,
yo'ntarikṣaṃ vimame, yau vai prajavaṃ yātām, apathena pratipadyate||
upapadamatiṅ|| 2|2|19 ||
upapadamatiṅ|| edhānāhārako vrajatīti| ṭhtumunṇvulau kriyāyāṃ
kriyārthāyām' iti ṇvul| atiṅiti kimiti| yenābhiprāyeṇa pṛṣṭṃa
tamāviṣkaroti|
nanu ceti| etajjñāpayatīti| syādetat---mukhyasya tiṅntasya
pratiṣedho'narthaka iti| yastena samānārthaḥ subantastasya pratiṣedho
vijñāyate| tatra yadyapi kālakārakasaṃkhyopagrahayuktaḥ pūrvāparībhūtaḥ
kriyārūpastiṅntārthapradhāno'rtho na subantasya sambhavati, tathāpi
kriyāvācitvamātreṇa tadarthatvamāśrīyate, kriyāvācyupapadaṃ na
samasyata ityarthaḥ| tena kārako gataḥ, kārakasya vrajyeti
gatabrajyāśabdayoḥ kārakaśabdena samāso na bhavati; anyathā hi
kriyārthāyāmiti saptamīnirdeśenopapadatvādanayorapi samāsaḥ
syāditi? tanna; anupapadatvāt| kriyāyāṃ kriyārthāyāmiti
saptamīnirdeśena kriyāvācina upapadatvam, dhāturevātra
kriyāvacanastadāśrayaśca ṇvul pratyayaḥ| gataśabdastu kriyopasarjanaṃ
kartāramāha, vrajyāśabdo'pi yastasya siddhatā nāma dharmastatra dhañādayo
bhavantīti dhātvarthasya siddhatāyāṃ vartante, ato
yatkriyāvācitvādupapadaṃ na tatsubantam, yatmubantaṃ na
tatkriyāvāci nāpyupapadamiti nārtha evamanātiṅgrahaṇena|
etayoryogayoriti| nanu cāsminneva yoge tadanabhisambandho yuktaḥ,
yatrātiṅgrahaṇamasti, na pūrvatra? evaṃ
manyate---yogavibhāgenātiṅgrahaṇaṃ pūrvasūtreṇāpi
sambandhanīyamiti| yadyevam, kuśabde prādiṣu cātiprasaṅgaḥ, tatrāpi
prāk subutpateḥ samāsaḥ syāt? evaṃ tarhi pūrvasūtre gatigrahaṇaṃ
pṛthakkṛtya tenaivātiṅgrahaṇaṃ sambandhanīyam|
gatikārakopapadānām, asyāyamarthaḥ---gatīnāṃ
kārakāṇāmupapādānāṃ ca kṛdbhiḥ saha yaḥ samāsastenatena lakṣaṇena
sa utarapadātsubutpateḥ prāgeva kāryaḥ, pūrvapadantu subantameva
samasyata iti| gatīnāṃ tāvat---vyājighratīti
vyāghrī,ṭhpāghrādhmādheṭddaśaḥ śaḥ' iti prāptasya jighrateḥ ṭhsaṃjñāyāṃ
pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ' iti niṣedhāt ṭhātaścopasarge' iti kaḥ,
vyāṅerghraśabdena gatisamāsaḥ, sa yadyautarapade subante jāte
paścātsyāt, tataḥ subutpataye saṃkhyākarmādiyogo vivakṣitavyaḥ,
tadyogācca prāgeva liṅgayogaḥ svārthamabhidhāya śabda iti nyāyāt,
tataśca liṅganimitaḥ pratyayo bhavan
ghraśabdamātrasyājātivācitvādāp syāt, tataśca vyāṅerghrāśabdena
samāsaḥ, tato vyāghrāśabdasya jātitve'pyanakārāntatvājjātilakṣaṇo
ṅīṣ na syāt; prāk subutpateḥ samāso bhavan liṅgayogamapi
nāpekṣata ityantaraṅgatvātsa eva tāvadbhavati paścātstrīpratyayo
bhavanṅīṣeva bhavati, pūrvapadasya tu subantatvātpadakāryāṇi
bhavanti, nirgata iti rutvam, saṃyyanteti parasavarṇavikalpa
ityādīni| kārakāṇām abhrerliptā'bhraliptī, ṭhkartṛ karaṇe kṛtā
bahulam' iti samāsaḥ, yadyautarapadasya saubantatvaṃ syātpūrvavaṭṭāp
syāt, tataḥ ṭhkrītātkaraṇapūrvāt' ṭhktādalpākhyāyām' iti ṅīṣ na
syād; ata ityadhikārāt, vacanasāmārthyādvā pūrvaśabdaṃ
vyavasthāvacanamāśritya vākyāvasthāyāmeva syāt, ata ityadhikāro vā
vyavacchidyeta| prāk subutpateḥ samāse pūrvavatsiddhamiṣṭam| atrāpi
pūrvapadasya subantātvāccarmakrītītyādau nalopādikāryāṇi
bhavanti| upapadānām--kacchena pibatīti ṭhsupi sthaḥ' ityatra supīti
yogavibhāgātkaḥ, kacchapī, vyāghrītulyam, māṣānvapati
ṭhsupyajātau ṇinistācchīlye' māṣavāpiṇī, ṅīpaḥ prāk samāse
prātipadikasyānto nakāra iti ṇatvaṃ bhavati| subantasya tu samāse
ṅīpsamāsasyānto na tu nakāra iti na syāt| atrāpi
pūrvapadasyasubantatvāccarmakārādau nalopādipadakārya bhavatyeva|
atropapadagrahaṇaṃ
gatikārakavyatiriktopapadaparigrahārtham--mṛṣāvāpiṇī, iṣaddarśāyā
apatyaṃ aiṣaddarśeyaḥ, atra darśaśabdena samāse sati samudāyātstrībhyo
ḍhakaṃ bādhitvā darśāśabdāt strīpratyayalakṣaṇo ḍhak syāt,
strīpratyaye tadādiniyamābhāve'pi darśāśabdādapi
kadācitsyādityeṣā dik|
jātānyasyāḥ paribhāṣāyāḥ prayojanāni| kathaṃ
punatiṅgrahaṇenāyamarthaḥ sādhayituṃ śakyaḥ, yāvatā
prathamāntamatiṅgrahaṇaṃ prathamāntasyaiva subgrahaṇasya nivṛttiṃ
sūcayediti pūrvapade padakāryāṇi na syuḥ, utarapade coktamiṣṭṃa na
sidhyati, tadetatkriyamāṇamatiṅgrahaṇaṃ viparyayameva sādhayati,
tadapi gatyupapadayoreva kārakeṣu tu ṭhkartṛ karaṇe kṛtā
bahulam' ityādāvasyāḥ kathāyā aprasaṅga eva?
ucyate---yogavibhāgenātiṅgrahaṇaṃ gatināpi saṃbadhyata ityuktam,
evaṃ sthite yogadvayavihitasamāsamatiṅgrahaṇena
viśeṣayiṣyāmaḥ----gatiḥ samasyate atiṅ samāso bhavati, upapadaṃ
samasyate atiṅ ca samāso bhavatīti| tadevamṭh māiṅ luṅ' mā
kārṣīdityādau tiṅntena samāso mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ
kriyamāṇamatiṅgrahaṇaṃ supeti tṛtīyāntasya nivṛttiṃ sādhayatīti
gatyupapadayostāvatsiddhimiṣṭam| vṛtāvapi ṭhsup supeti na
saṃbadhyate' iti samudāyasya nivṛttirvivakṣitā, na kevalasya
subgrahaṇasya| pratyudāharaṇamapi diṅmātraṃ pradarśitam, na hi tatra
tiṅntena samāsaḥ, ki tarhi? tiṅntasya subannena, ṭhkartṛ karaṇe
kṛtā bahulam' ityatrāpi kṛteti na vaktavyam, katham ? kartṛ
karaṇayoḥ kriyāpekṣatvātkriyāvacanena tāvatsamāsaḥ,dhātuśca
kriyāvacanaḥ, dhātośca dvaye pratyayāḥ---kṛtastiṅśca, tatra
subadhikārātiṅntenāprasaṅgaḥ, tadetat kṛdgrahaṇaṃ
kṛdantāvasthāyāmeva yathā syādityevamarthamiti kecit|
neti vayam| kāṣṭhèaḥ pacatitarām, dadhnā bhuktapūrvītyādau
taddhitāntena samāso mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ kṛdgahaṇaṃ kartavyaṃ
kaṣṭaśritādiṣu prāksubupateḥ samāso na sādhita iti
kaṣṭaśritetyādi na siddhyati| eva tarhi gatikārakopapadānāmiti
paribhāṣā pūrvācāryaiḥ paṭhitā sūtrakāreṇāpyatiṅgrahaṇena taddeśa
āśrītā| tatra sāmānyāpekṣāṃ jñāprakamiti kṛtsnameva paribhāṣārthaṃ
jñāpayatīti siddhamiṣṭam|
tadetatpratipadyantāṃ bhāṣye kṛtapariśramāḥ|
nānye sahasramapyandhāḥ sūrya paśyanti nāñjasā||
amaivāvyayena || 2|2|20 ||
amaivāvyayena|| svāduṅkāramiti| svādumi ṇamul, svādumītyata
eva nipātanātpūrvapadasya māntatvam| svādumītyarthagrahaṇam, tena
saṃpannakāramityatrāpi bhavati| nanu siddhe vidhirārabhyamāṇo niyamāya
bhavati, evakāraḥ kimarthaḥ? iṣṭato'vadhāraṇārthaḥ, evaṃ yathā
vijñāyeta---amaivāvyayeneti, maivaṃ vijñāyi---amāvyayenaiveti|
anavyayasyāsambhavādevāyaṃ niyamo na bhaviṣyati| nanu cāyamasti
svaśayaṃ brāhmaṇakulamiti---ṭhadhikaraṇe śeteḥ' ityac, ṭhato'm' iti
