sorambhāvaḥ, anenānavyavena samāso mā bhūdityevamartho niyamaḥ
syāt, na; atra hyantaraṅgatvādanutpanna eva sāvupapadasamāsena
bhāvyam, paścātsupeti
vidhānavelāyāmanavyayasyāmo'sambhavānniyamāntareṇa vacanasya
caritārthatvādviparītaniyamo na bhaviṣyatītyata
āha----evakārakaraṇamiti| amaiva yadupapadaṃ tatsamasyate, tadeva
samasyata ityakṣarārthaḥ, na punaramaiva samasyata iti| tatrāmaiva
yadupapadamityatra tulyavidhānamiti vākyaśeṣaḥ| kiṃ cāmaiva
tulyavidhānaṃ yena vākyenāmeva kevalo vidhīyate, na
pratyayāntarasahitastena vākyena yadupapadaṃ vidhīyate tatra
saptamīnirdeśātadamaiva tulyavidhānam| niyamāṅgabhūtastvevakāro
niyamasvabhāvādeva labhyate---amaiva yatulyavidhānaṃ na tu
pratyayāntarotpatau nimitamiti tadapekṣayā'nupapadatvād
avyayāntareṇa samāso nāśaṅkanīyaḥ| agre bhojamiti|
ṭhvibhāṣāgreprathamapūrveṣu' iti ktvāṇamulau| avyayagrahaṇaṃ kim?
asatyavyayagrahaṇe ṭhamaiva tulyavidhānaṃ tadevopapadaṃ samasyate'
ityucyamāne kumbhakārādāvipi na syāt| atha
pūrvasūtrasyānavakāśatvādamaiva
tulyavidhānasyopapadasyāvyayaviṣayatvātadviṣaya eva niyamo
vijñāsyata ityucyate? evaṃ tvamaiva niyamaḥ syād---amantenopapadasya
yaḥ samāsaḥ so'maiva tulyavidhānasyeti, tatra ko doṣaḥ?
agrebhojamityatraiva na syāt, agre bhuktvā, kālo bhoktumityatra tu
syādeva; avyayagrahaṇe tu sati avyayenopapadasya yaḥ so'maiva
tulyavidhānasyeti vijñānānna kaścidoṣaḥ||
tṛtīyāprabhṛtīnyatarasyām|| 2|2|21 ||
tṛtīyāprabhṛtīnyatarasyām|| tṛtīyāprabhṛtīnīti| yatpunaramā
cānyena tasyāprāpta iti upapadaviśeṣaṇārtha evakāro'tra nānuvartata
iti bhāvaḥ| uccaiḥ kāramiti| yadā samāsastadā
kṛdutarapadaprakṛtisvaraḥ, ṭhādirṇamulyanyatarasyām'
ityādyaudātatvam| yadā tu na samāsaḥ, tadoccairityantodātam;
svarādiṣu tathā pāṭhāt| kāramityādyaudātam||
ktvā ca|| 2|2|22 ||
ktvā ca|| ktveti tṛtīyāntam| ṭhātaḥ' ityākāralopaḥ,
yathā---ṭhsamāse'nañpūrve ktve lyap' iti ṭhktvi skandisyandyoḥ'
iti||
śeṣo bahuvrīhiḥ|| 2|2|23 ||
śeṣe bahuvrīhiḥ|| upayuktādanyaḥ śeṣa iti| ṭhśiṣa asarvopayoge'
ityasmātkarmaṇi ghañ| kaśca śeṣa iti| nanu copayuktādanyaḥ śeṣa
ityuktam, satyam, sarveṣāmeva padānāṃ
sāmānyaviśeṣarūpeṇopayogātsarveṣu ca pūrvotarānyapadārtheṣu
yathāyogaṃ tatpuruṣāvyayībhāvayorvidhānādupayuktādanyo na
sambhavatīti punaḥ praśnaḥ| uktaṃ ca---ṭhśeṣagrahaṃ
padataścennābhāvādarthataścedaviśiṣṭam' iti| yatrānyaḥ samāso nokta
iti| yeṣāṃ padānāṃ yasminnarthe'vyayībhāvādikaḥ samāso na vihitaḥ
sa śeṣa ityarthaḥ| athaivaṃ kasmānna vijñāyate----spatasu supāṃ trikeṣu
yasya trikasya śrṛṅgagrāhikayā samāso noktaḥ, yathā---prathamāyāḥ,sa
śeṣa iti? kaṇṭhekāla ityādāvaprathamāntānāmapi samāsasyeṣṭatvāt|
śeṣagrahaṇaṃ prākkaḍārātparaṃ kāryamityasminpakṣe kartavyam,
ekasaṃjñādhikārapakṣe na kartavyamityākaḍārasūtra eva pratipāditam||
anekamanyapadārthe|| 2|2|24 ||
anekamanyapadārthe|| anekaṃ subantaṃ saha samasyata iti|
parasparamityarthaḥ| tadanena subityetadatrānuvartate, na
supetyetad; utarapadasyāpyanekamityanenaiva pratipāditatvāditi
darśayati| sarveṣu vibhaktyartheṣviti| padena prakṛtyarthopasarjanaḥ
pratyayārtho'bhidhīyata iti vibhaktyarthasya
prādhānyātasyaivānyapadārthagrahaṇena prahaṇamiti bhāvaḥ| ata eva
prāptodako'yaṃ grāma iti grāmaśabdānuprayogaḥ, anyathā yāvānevārtho
grāmapadasya tāvato'bhidhāne gatārthatvānna syāt, yathā---dvandve
ca--śabdasya| yadā tu samāsena vibhaktyartha eva sambandhādirabhīpsyate
tadā vibhaktirmānuprayoji,
dravyasyānabhihitatvātadvācino'nuprayogaḥ kasmānna syāt yadi
vibhaktyartho'bhidhīyate, kathaṃ grāmādibhiḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ
talliṅgasaṃkhyāyoge vā bahuvrīhirbhavatiprāptodako grāmaḥ,
uddhṛtaudanā sthālīti? ucyate---vibhaktyarthasya
sambandhāderāśritatvena
guṇatvādabhedopacārātsāmānādhikaraṇyamāśrayataśca liṅgavacanāni
bhaviṣyanti śuklādivat, yathā---śuklaṃ vastram, śuklā paṭī, śuklaḥ
kambalaḥ, śuklaiḥ, śuklā iti| nanvevaṃ yathā śuklaśabdena
kadācidguṇa ucyate, kadācit guṇī; tathā bahurvīhāvapi
prāpnoti| naiṣo'sti niyamaḥ----guṇaśabdena
kadācidguṇamātramabhidhīyat iti, paṭvādiṣvadarśanāt, na hi
bhavati devadatasya paṭuariti; tadvadihāpi nityameva guṇiniṣṭhatā
bhaviṣyati| evamapi bahuvrīhiṇā yathā vibhaktyarthasyābhidhānāt
ṣaṣṭha|ladayo na bhavanti, tathā
liṅgasaṃkhyayorapyabhidhānātayorvācakāḥ pratyayā na prāpnuvanti ?
naiṣa doṣaḥ; svāthiṃkāṣṭābādayaḥ, striyāṃ yadvartate
tasmātsvārthikāṣṭabādayo bhavantīti tena bahuvrīhiṇā'bhihite'pi
strītve bhaviṣyanti| evaṃ ca kṛtvā ṭhano bahuvrīheḥ' ityādyaupapannaṃ
bhavati|
samāsena ca bāhyakriyāpekṣā yā
karmādiśaktistadrahitasamāsaprātipadikārthamātrasyaivaikatvāderuktatvāditi karmādigataikatvādipratipādanāya vacanāni bhaviṣyanticitraguṃ paśya, citraguṇā kṛtamiti| evamapi prathamā na prāpnoti, samāsena saṃkhyāyā abhidhānāt? vacanagrahaṇādekaḥ, dvau, bahava itivadbhaviṣyati| atha vā----liṅgamātraṃ saṃkhyāmātraṃ bahuvrīhiṇābhihitaṃ na viśeṣastatrāvaśyaṃ viśaiṣārthinā tadvācī śabdaḥ prayoktavyaḥ, evaṃ ca kṛtvā saha prakṛtvā saha prakṛtyarthena vibhaktyarthe bahuvrīhiṇābhidhīyamāne'pi na kaściddoṣaḥ| kathaṃ sāmānyamanabhihitaṃ viśeṣasyānuprayogaḥ? sāmānyasya tarhi na prāpnoti----devadataḥ kaściditi, sāmānyamapi viśeṣaḥ, yathā viśeṣeṇa viśeṣāntaraṃ vyāvartyate tadvatsāmānyena viśeṣo vyāvartyate, anyathā sandehaḥ syāt---sāmānyamatra vivakṣitam? viśeṣo vā ? iti|
prāptodako grāma ityādini dvitīyādyartheṣu yathākramamudāharaṇāni|
ūḍho ratho yena, upahṛtaḥ paśuryasmai, uddhṛta odano yasyāḥ,
citrā gāvo yasya, vīrāḥ puruṣā yasminniti vigrahāḥ| prathamārthe tu
na bhavatīti| anabhidhānāt, evamanantarādiṣu na bhavati----citrā
gāvo yasyānantarā iti| anekamiti kimiti|
supsupetyadhikārādeva tatpuruṣavadvahuvrīhirapyekasya na
bhaviṣyatīti praśnaḥ| bahūnāmapi yathā syāditi| anyathā supsupeti
saṃkhyāyā vivakṣitatvādyathā tatpuruṣo bahūnāṃ na bhavati---mahatkaṣṭṃa
śrita iti, tathā bahuvrīhirapi na syāditi bhāvaḥ| jñāpakātsiddhim,
yadayaṃ taddhitārthetyutarapade dviguṃ rāsti tajjñāpayati---bahūnāmapi
samāsa iti| yadyevam, tatpuruṣe'pi prasaṅgaḥ, atha
citragurityatrotarapadasyāpyupasarjanasaṃjñā prayojanaṃ kasmānna bhavati,
satyanekagrahaṇe supetyasya nivartitatvādutarapadamapi tenaiva
pratyāyyate, tadapi samāsaśāstre prathamānirdiṣṭṃa bhavati, nānyathā? evaṃ
manyate----citragustiṣṭhati, citraguṃ paśyeti pradhānasyānyapadārthasya
nānāvibhaktiyoge'pi vartipadayornityaprathamāntatvādekavibhaktītyeva
siddhamupasarjanatvamiti|
susūkṣmajaṭakeśeneti| suṣṭhua sūkṣmā jaṭāḥ keśā asyeti caturṇāṃ
bahuvrīhau ṭhṅyāpoḥ saṃjñācchandasorbahulam' iti
bahulavacanādhrasvatvam,yadvā suṣṭhua sūkṣmā jaṭā yeṣu te
susūkṣmajaṭāstāddaśāḥ keśā asyeti punarbahuvrīhiḥ| evaṃ suṣṭhua
gajājinaṃ vāsa ācchādanaṃ yasya tena sugajājinavāsasā,
tṛtīyāntodāharaṇam; śloke tathā paṭhitatvāt|
ṭhsusūkṣmajaṭakeśena sugajājinavāsasā|
samantaśitirandhreṇa dvayorvṛtau na siddhyati'||
iti bhāṣye ślokaḥ paṭhitaḥ tatra tu ślokapūraṇārthaṃ tṛtīyānirdeśaḥ|
anyagrahaṇaṃ bahuvrīhitatpuruṣayorviṣayavibhāgārtham, asati tasmin
kaṇṭhekāla ityādau vyadhikaraṇapade sāvakāśaṃ bahuvrīhi svapadārtha iva
nīlotpalaṃ sara ityādau samānādhikaraṇe tatpuruṣo bādheta|
anyagrahaṇe tu sati svapadārthe sāvakāśaṃ tatpuruṣaṃ
paratvādvahuvrīhirbādhata iti na kaściddoṣaḥ|
padagrahaṇaṃ kim? padārthe yathā syādvākyārthe mā bhūt|
kaścitkañcinnadyāṃ siṣṇāsumāha----nadyāṃ grāhāḥ santīti, etāni
padāniṭhtasmātatra mā snāsīḥ' iti vākyārthaṃ gamayantīti teṣāṃ
bahuvrīhisaṃjñā prāpnoti| arthagrahaṇaṃ kim, yāvatā padepadāntarasya
vṛtyasambhavādeva padārthe bhaviṣyati? kṛtsne padārthe yathā syāt,
anyathā prādhānyādvibhaktyartha eva syānna prakṛtyarthe dvavye| tatra
yaduktam----abhedopacārāddharmiṇo'bhidhāne siddhe'pi
śuklādivaddharmamātrasyāpi kadācidabhidhānaṃ prāpnoti,
tadanenāpākriyate| paṭvādiśabdavannityaṃ dharminiṣṭho
bahuvrīhiriti pratipādanena bahuvrīhiḥ
samānādhikaraṇānāmityādirabhidhānasiddhasyārthasya prapañcaḥ|
uccairmukha iti| uccaiso'thikaraṇapradhānatvādvaiyadhikaraṇyādvacanam|
saptamyupamāneti| saptamyantamupamānavāci ca pūrvapada yasya tasya
śabdāntareṇa samāsastatrasthasyotarapadasya lopa ityarthaḥ| kaṇṭhestha iti|
ṭhsupi sthaḥ' iti kaḥ| ṭhamūrddhamastakāt' ityaluk| kaṇṭhesthita iti
pāṭhetu saptamīti yogavibhāgātsamāsaḥ| samānādhikaraṇatvātsamāse
siddhe vacanamutarapadalopārtham, tena vaiyadhikaraṇye'pyatra
gamakatvamastīti pradarśyate| uṣṭrakhamivoti| avayavadharmeṇa
samudāyavyapadeśāduṣṭrasyopamānatetyupamānapūrvapadamuṣṭramukhaśabdaḥ, atropamānopameyayorvauyadhikaraṇyavadvacanamutarapadalopārthaṃ ca| uṣṭramukha iti| uṣṭro mukhamasyeti| vigrahaḥ, na ca prāṇī prāṇyantarasya mukhamupapadyata iti sāmarthyāt sāddaśyāvagatiḥ, mukhena ca sukhasya sāddaśyaṃ prasiddhamityuṣṭramukhamiva mukhamasyetyayamartho bhavati| tasmādutarapadalopo na vaktavyaḥ|
samudāyavikāraṣaṣṭha|la iti| samudāyāvayavasaṃbandhe
prakṛtivikārasaṃbandhe ca yā ṣaṣṭhī tadantātparaṃ yadutarapadaṃ
tadantasya samāsasya śabdāntareṇa saha bahuvrīhirityarthaḥ| keśacūḍa
iti| idamapi keśasamāhāre keśaśabdasya vṛteḥ siddham| evaṃ
svarṇavikāre svarṇaśabdasya vṛteḥ svarṇālaṅkāra iti siddham| vacanaṃ
tu keśamasāhāracūḍaḥ, svarṇavikārālaṅkāra ityutarapadasya śravaṇaṃ
mā bhūditi|
prādibhyo dhātujasyeti| idaṃ na vaktavyameva, prādayo hi sasādhanāṃ
kriyāṃ prāhuḥ---yathā niṣkauśāmbīḥ, nirvārāṇasiḥ, prācārya iti|
evaṃ naño'styarthānāmityetadapi|
subadhikāra iti| astīti tiṅntamiti matvā vacanaṃ
nipātatvātsiddham| upasargavibhaktipratirūpakā nipātāḥ, svarādiṣu
cāstiśabdaḥ paṭha|lte| iha kiṃ sabrahmacārīti? bahuvrīhirayam| ke
sabrahmacāriṇastava, kiṃ sabrahmacārī tvamiti pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaro
hyatreṣyate, tatra kaṭhasabrahmacāryahamiti sambhāvitamprativacanam| yatu
kaṭho'hamiti na tatsākṣātprativacanam,kiṃ tarhi? ārthikam| ahaṃ
tāvatkaṭha ityukte gamyata etannatu te'pi kaṭhā iti| kaṭhasya hi kaṭhā eva
sabrahmacāriṇo bhavanti, nānye| samāne brahmaṇi vratacāryeva sabrahmācārī
bhavati| ke sabrahmacāriṇastaveti vākyena tu praśne kaṭhā iti
prativacanam| samāsena tu praśne kaṭhā iti prativacanaṃ kadācidapi na
bhavati; vartipadārthānāmupasarjanatvāt, kiṃ sabrahmacārītisamāsena
sabrahmacāriṇāmabhidhānāt| iha dvau droṇāvarddhadroṇāścārddhatṛtīyā
droṇā iti? arddhastṛtīyo yeṣāmiti bahuvrīhāvudbhūtāvayavabhedaḥ
samudāyaḥ samāsārtha iti bahuvacanaṃ droṇaśabdaśca
droṇayorarddhadroṇe'pi lakṣaṇayā vartata iti sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ ca
bhavati||
saṃkhyayāvyayāsannādūrādhikasaṃkhyāḥ saṃkhyeye|| 2|2|25 ||
saṃkhyayāvyayāsannādūrādhikasaṃkhyāḥ saṃkhyeye|| upadaśā iti|
ṭhbahuvrīhau saṃkhyeye ḍajabahugaṇāt' iti ḍaci ṭilopaḥ, daśānāṃ
samīpe ye bhavanti ta ucyante, te punarnavaikādaśa vā|
pūrvapadārthapradhāno'yaṃ samāsaḥ|
upaśabdo'yamārācchabdenaikārthatvātsamīpe samīpini ca vartate| tatra
samīpiprādhānye'yaṃ bahuvrīhiḥ| sāmīpyaprādhānye ṭhavyayaṃ
vibhaktisamīpa' ityavyayībhāvaḥ| upadaśaṃ dantoṣṭhā iti| atra
dharmadharmiṇopabhedopacārātsāmānādhikaraṇyam| upaviśā iti| ṭhti
viṃśaterḍiti' iti lopaḥ| āsannā daśānāmāsannadaśāḥ, te'pi
navaikādaśa vā| adhikadaśāstvekādaśa| dvau vā trayo vā dvitrāḥ,
vārthe'yaṃ samāsaḥ| vārthaśca yadi vikalpaḥ syāt, tato yadi dvau
bhavatastadā bahuvacanaṃ na syāt| tasmātsaṃśayo'tra vārthaḥ, sa
cāniyatasaṃkhyāvimarśaḥ, tatra tu trayo'pi sarvadā parisphurantīti
tadapekṣaṃ bahuvacanam| atha vā----pañcaivātra sarvadā bhavanti, katham?
vimarśajñānamubhayapakṣālambi ekaṃ ca tatra, yathā---dvau vā trayo vā
puruṣā ānīyantāmityatra puruṣaśabde tiṅnte ca bahuvacanameva
bhavati, kasya hetoḥ? miśriteṣu tayorvṛteḥ| evaṃ dvitripadamapi
miśriteṣu vartata iti saiṣā pañcādhiṣṭhānā vāk, ato
bahuvacanameva bhavati| ānayanādikārthaṃ tu dvayostrayāṇāṃ vā
yathāruci bhavati| vākyavadeva samāsasya caiṣā hi āpat, atasteṣu
miśriteṣu vṛttiḥ, tena dvau vā puruṣā ānīyantāmiti vākye
dviśabdād dvivacanameva bhavati| tricaturā iti| ṭhcaturo'cprakaraṇe
tryupābhyāmupasaṃkhyānam' ityac| dvidaśā iti| atra dviśabdena
daśatvāvṛttigatā dvitvasaṃkhyā pratipādyate, na daśatvasaṃkhyā; ekatvāt|
nāpi saṃkhyāyuktāḥ, bahutvāt| tatra vākye sucamantareṇābhyā
vṛteranavagamātsuc bhavati, tataścāsvapadavigrahaḥ kriyate---dvirdaśa
dvidaśā iti| vṛtau tu svabhāvādeva sucamantareṇābhyāvṛttisaṃkhyāṃ
dviśabda evāheti saṃkhyāvācitvātsamasyate|
nanvatra vārthaḥ sujarthaścānyapadārthe iti pūrveṇaiva siddham, tanna; sucaḥ
svārthikatvātadartho'pi padārtha eva| matvarthe pūrvayogaḥ;
amatvarthārtho'yamārambhaḥ| nanu prāptodakādi prathamārthaṃ varjayitvā
sarvavibhaktyartheṣu yathābhidhānaṃ bhavatītyuktam, evaṃ tarhi prathamārthe'pi
yathā syādityayamārambhaḥ| atha prathamārthaṃ varjayitvetyetadanāddatya
yathābhidhānaṃ bhavatītyucyate, evaṃ tarhi tasyaiva prapañcaḥ saṃkhyāyāḥ
samāsaḥ, avyayānāṃ tu caturdaśādibhiḥ saṃkhyeyavācibhiḥ samāso
vidheya eva| kecitu ye viṃśatyādayaḥ saṃkhyāne vartante taiḥ
pūrveṇaiva siddham---adhikā viṃśatiryeṣāṃ ta ime'dhikaviṃśāḥ,
viṃśatisaṃkhyā āsannā yeṣāṃ te āsannaviṃśā iti, tatra
ṭhsarvanāmasaṃkhyayoḥ' iti viṃśatiśabdasya pūrvanipātaḥ prāpnoti,
tasmādviṃśatyādyarthamapyavyayādīnāṃ grahaṇaṃ kartavyameva||
diṅnāmānyantarāle|| 2|2|26 ||
diṅnāmānyantarāle|| dakṣiṇapūrveti|
antarālasyānyapadārthatvātpūrvaṇaiva siddhe vacanamidaṃ tvamatvarthepi
yathā syātprathamārthepi yathā syādvaiyadhikaraṇye'pi yathā syāt| kiṃ ca
ṭhvibhāṣā diksamāse bahuvrīhau' ityatra diśāṃ pratipadoktasya
bahuvrīhergraharṇa yathā syāt, yāsa pūrvā sotarāsyonmugdhasya
tasmai utarapūrvāya dehītyatra mā bhūdityevamarthaḥ|
atastadartho'pyayamārambhaḥ| kababhāvārthaṃ ca ṭhśeṣādvibhāṣā' ityatra
śeṣādhikāravihitasya bahuvrīhergrahaṇam| ṭhanekamanyapadārthe'
ityatraiva śeṣagrahaṇamanuvartate, tenātra kamna bhavati| ṭhsarvanāmno
vṛttimātre' iti mātragrahaṇād ṭhvibhāṣā diksamāse' iti yadā
sarvanāmasaṃjñā nāsti tadāpi bhavati||
tatra tenedamiti sarūpe|| 2|2|27 ||
tatra tenedamiti sarūpe|| itikaraṇa ityādi| tataḥ samāsāllaukikasya
yadi vivakṣā bhavati---evamarthaṃ samāso bhavati, nānyārthamityevamarthaṃ
sūcayitumitiśabda ityarthaḥ, tena kiṃ siddhaṃ
bhavatītyāha---laukikamarthamiti| kaḥ punarasau laukiko'rtha
ityāha---tataścetyādi| etadeva vivṛṇoti---yatatretyādi|
gṛhyate'sminniti grahaṇamukeśādi, praharaṇamudaṇḍādi,
karmavyatīhāraḥūuparasparagrahaṇaṃ parasparapraharaṇaṃ ca| sa cāvyayamiti|
tiṣṭadguprabhṛtiṣu pāṭhenāvyayatvāt| nanvatra
yuddhasyānyapadārthatvātpūrveṇaiva siddham, na;
vaiyadhikaraṇyādekaśeṣaprasaṅgācca| tathā hi---grahaṇapraharaṇe ca
keśādīnāṃ sahavivakṣitatvādekavibhaktitvāccaikaśeṣaḥ prāpto'nena
vacanena bādhyate| katham? na samūhavivakṣāyāṃ bahuvrīhisaṃjñā,
samūhaścaikaśeṣe nopapadyate| nanu cāsatyasminpūrvayogenaiva
paratvādekaśeṣo bādhiṣyate? na śakyate bādhitum; antaraṅga
ekaśeṣaḥ bahuvrīhiścānyapadārthāpekṣatvādvahiraṅgaḥ||
tena saheti tulyayoge|| 2|2|28 ||
tena saheti tulyayoge|| tulyayoga iti|
tulyayogaḥūsamānasambandhaḥ| saputra iti| ṭhvopasarjanasya' iti
sabhāvaḥ| nanvatra pitā pradhānamanyapadārtho'bhidheyaḥ, satyam;
vyadhikaraṇayoḥ prathamārthe'pi yathā syādityayamārambhaḥ, kababhāvārthaṃ ca|
uktaścātra kababhāvaḥ| daśabhiḥ putrairiti| itthambhūtetyarthaḥ|
prāyikamiti| jñāpakāt, yadayaṃ ṭhvibhāṣā sākāṅkṣe',
ṭhcchandasyanekamapi sākāṅkṣam', ṭhpūrvādiniḥ' ṭhsapūrvācca',
ṭhsapūrvāyāḥ prathamāyāḥ',ṭhvibhāṣā sapūrvasya' iti vidyamānārthe'pi
samāsaṃ nirddiśati, tajjñāpayati----prāyikaṃ viśeṣaṇamiti||
cārthe dvandvaḥ|| 2|2|29 ||
cārthe dvandvaḥ|| samuccayetyādi| yadā parasparanirapekṣāḥ padārthā
ekasminpratisambandhini samuccīyante tadā samuccayaḥ,
yathā---aharaharnayamāno gāmaśvaṃ puruṣaṃ puśuṃ vaivasvato na tṛpyati
surāyā iva durmadīti| durmadī yathā surāyā na tṛpyati tathā yamo
gavādīnnayamāna ityarthaḥ| atra nayatikriyāyāmekasyāṃ gavādīnāṃ
samuccayaḥ, gamyamānatvācca ca--śabdasyāprayogaḥ| evaṃ rājño
gauścāśvaśceti dravye dravyayoḥ, raktaḥ śuklaśceti dravye guṇayoḥ,
raktaḥ paṭaḥ kuṇḍalaṃ ceti guṇe dravyayoḥ samuccaya ityādi draṣṭavyam|
yadānekasya prādhānyātadanurodhena tvitaradanvācīyate tadānvācayaḥ,
yathā---bhikṣāmaṭa gāñjānayeti| atra hyadarśanādanānayannapi gāmaṭatyeva
bhikṣām, anaṭÄastu bhikṣāṃ na gāmānayati,aṭannapi nānviṣya
gāmānayati| itaretarayogastu
parasparāpekṣāṇāmavayavabhedānupagamena
samudāyarūpatāmāpannānāmekasminnarthe'nvaye sati bhavati,
yathā----devadatayajñadatābhyāmidaṃ kāryamiti| tathaikāpāye'pi
tadbhavati, udbhūtāvayavabhedatvācca dvivacanabahuvacane bhavataḥ,
tāddaśānāmevāvayavatirodhānasaṃhatirūpeṇānvaye tatsamāhāraḥ,
yathā---cchattropānahamiti, saṃhatipradhānatvātvekavacanam|
tatretyādi| syaadetat----samuccaye parasparānapekṣatve'pi
gavādīnāmekakriyādvārakaṃ sāmarthyaṃ dadhyodanādivadastyeveti, tanna
yuktam; dadhyodanādāvekatvāt kriyāyāḥ| iha tu karmabhedātkriyā
bhidyate, tathā ca ṭh samuccaye'nyatarasyām' ityatra bhrāṣṭramaṭa
maṭhamaṭetyādikaṃ karmabhedanibandhanaṃ kriyābhedamāśrityodāhariṣyate|
anvācaye tvapradhānameva cārthe vartate, na pradhānamityanekasya padasya
cārthe vṛtyabhāvādapi samāsābhāvaḥ| iha paṭuaścāsau
khañjaścetyekasmindharmiṇyanekadharmasamuccayāccārthasadbhāvātsamānādhikaraṇayorapi dvandvasaṃjñāprasaṅgaḥ, tataśca ṭhdvandve ghi' iti niyamaḥ syāt, viśeṣaṇamityādinā tu tatpuruṣakaraṇe khañjapaṭuarityapi siddhyati? naiṣa doṣaḥ; ekasaṃjñādhikārādviśeṣavihitatvātetpuruṣasaṃjñaiva bhaviṣyati, anyathā nīlaṃ ca tadutpalaṃ cetyādāvapi dvandvaḥ syāt| yadvā---ṭhśeṣa' iti vartate, ato viśeṣaṇamityatropayuktatvānna bhaviṣyati| sāmānādhikaraṇyābhāve tu dvandva eva---paṭuakhañjāvāgatāviti|
plakṣanyagrodhāviti| caśabdasyāvyayatve'pi tadarthe vidhīyamānasya
dvandvasya svabhāvādeva liṅgasaṃkhyāyogaḥ| kathaṃ puna ratra dvivacanam,
yāvatā śabdapaurvāparyādarthābhidhāne'pi paurvāparyam, tataśca
plakṣaśabdaḥ sahārthena nivṛtaḥ nyagrodhaśabda upasthitaḥ, eka
evārthastasyaikatvādekavacanameva prāpnoti, tathā ca ṭhādyantau ṭakitau'
iti krameṇa pratītimaṅgīkṛtya yathāsaṃkhyamityasya pravṛttiḥ, na ca
krameṇa dvayorarthayoḥ pratītau dvivacanaṃ bhavati;yathā vā vākye
plakṣaśca nyagrodhaśceti, atra nyagrodhārthapratītidaśāyāṃ
plakṣārthasyāpratītitareva kāraṇam? astu tarhi yugapadadhikaraṇavacane
dvandvaḥ| kimidaṃ yugapadadhikaraṇavacana iti? adhikaraṇaṃ vartipadārthaḥ,
adhikaraṇe yugapadvacanaṃ yugapadadhikaraṇavacanam, tatra dvandvo bhavati|
kena punaryugapad dvayorvacanam? ekaikena padena| etaduktaṃ
bhavati---yāvatāṃ padānāṃ dvandvo yadi tāvatāmanyo'nyārthābhidhānaṃ
yugapadbhavatyevaṃ dvandvo bhavatīti| atra hi
dvivacanabahuvacanānyathānupapatireva pramāṇam; vigrahe cāpi
darśanāt| vigrahe khalvapi yugapadvacanatā
ddaśyate---pramitrayorvaruṇayoḥ, dyāvācidasmai pṛthivī namete iti; kiṃ
punaḥ samāse, yatra cānyācānyā ca śaktiḥ prādurbhavati! kathaṃ punaḥ
plakṣaśabdena nyagrodhābhidhānam, tena vā tasya? sāhacaryāditi| yadvā
tadvā nimitaṃ bhavatu, yadyapi ya lokavyavahāre kevalasya plakṣaśabdasya
nyagrodhābhidhāyitvaṃ na ddaṣṭṃa nyagrodhaśabdasya vā plakṣābhidhāyitvam,
dvandvāvayavānāṃ tvanekārthābhidhāyitvaṃ na kevalānāmityadoṣaḥ|
niyataviṣayāścāpi śabdārthā bhavanti, yathā---bhrātṛśabdasyaikaśeṣa eva
svasari vṛtti, putraśabdasya duhitari| etenaitadapi
nirastam----ekenoktatvātasyārthasya parasya prayogo nopapadyata iti|
kathaṃ dvandvāvayavānāmeva parasparasannidhānādeṣā
śaktirvahnisannidhāviva ghṛte dravatā, no khalu vahnivigatau bhavati,
yadi tarhi plakṣo'pi dvyartho nyagrodho'pi dvyarthaḥ,
bahutvādvahucanaṃ prāpnoti? nātra catvāro'rthāḥ, kiṃ tarhi?
yābhyāmevātraiko dvyarthastābhyāmevāparo'pi|
syādetat---ubhayoratra paryāyatve yathā plakṣanyagrodhau
plakṣanyagrodhāviti dvirvacane pratītiḥ, evaṃ plakṣanyagrodhāvityatrāpi
prāpnoti, tanna; yugapadutpādāt| tadyathā
dvayorakṣṇoryugapadvisphāritayoḥ purovartinyarthadvaye yugapadekā
pratītirjanyata tathehāpi draṣṭavyam| nanu yadā plakṣaśabdo na tadā
nyagrodhaśabdaḥ, yadā nyagrodhaśabdo na tadā plakṣaśabda iti kathamatra
yugapadvyāpāraḥ? smṛtisthayoryugapadvyāpārādadoṣaḥ| padāni
hi śrutamātrāṇi svaṃ svamarthaṃ smārayanti,
paścādākāṅkṣāsannidhiyogyatveṣu parāmṛṣṭeṣu
smṛtisthānyabhidadhati, tasyāmeva smṛtau yugapadārohātsambhavatyeva
yugapadvyāpāraḥ| yā ca sā padārthānāṃ smṛtiḥ sā kramabhāvinīti
tatkrameṇaiva yathāsaṃkhyādivyavasthā yugapadabhidhāne'pyupapadyate|
tadevaṃ yugapadadhikaraṇavacane dvandva iti sthitam|
ihaikaviṃśatirdvāviśatiriti, yadyayaṃ dvandva syād ekaṃ ca
viṃśatiścetītaretarayoge dvivacanabahuvacanaprasaṅgaḥ, samāhāre ca
ṭhsa napuṃsakam' iti napaṃsakaprasaṅgaḥ, ata eva ekādhikā
viṃśatirekaviśatiriti śākapārthivāditvātsamāsaḥ kriyate? naivaṃ
śakyam, ṭhrājanyabahuvacanadvandve'ndhakavṛṣṇiṣu saṃkhyā' iti
pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaro na syāt| tasmād dvandva evāyam| sa samāhāre
netaretarayoge, anabhidhānāt| napuṃsakatvantu ṭhliṅgamaśiṣyaṃ
lokāśrayatvālliṅgasya' iti na bhavati||
upasarjanaṃ pūrvam|| 2|2|30 ||
upasarjanaṃ pūrvam|| ānayamo hi syāditi| yadyapi viparītaprayogo
loke na ddaṣṭaḥ parapuruṣāparādhātu vākyavatsambhāvyetetyarthaḥ| iha
rājñaḥ puruṣasya putro rājāpuruṣaputra iti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaśāstre
dvayorapi
prathamānirddiṣṭatve'pyupasarjanasaṃjñā'nvarthatvādapradhānasyaiva bhavati,
puruṣaścātra rājāpekṣayā pradhānamiti pūrvanipātaniyamaḥ||
rājadantādiṣu param|| 2|2|31 ||
rājadantādiṣu param|| na kevalamityādi| atra
vihitapūrvanipātasyeti pāṭhe vihitaḥ pūrvanipāto yasya
tasyetyarthaḥ| prāyeṇa tu vihitasyeti pāṭhaḥ| tatrāpavāda iti śeṣaḥ|
anyasyāpi ghyāderyaḥ pūrvanipāto yathālakṣaṇaṃ vihitastasyāpyapavāda
ityarthaḥ| agre vaṇamiti| ṭhvanaṃ puragā' ityādinā ṇatvam| tadeva tarhi
ṇatvavidhānaṃ paranipātasya jñāpakaṃ bhaviṣyati? tanna, ṭhupasarjanaṃ
pūrvam' iti niyamo na pravartata ityetāvato'pyarthasya jñāpakatvena
tadupapannam, tasmātkathaṃ niyamena paranipātaḥ syāt! iha ca
nipātanādalugiva ṇatvamapi na bhaviṣyatīti tatrāgregrahaṇaṃ
śakyamakartum| pūvekālasyeti| ṭhpūrvakālaika' iti
prathamānirddeśādupasarjanasyetyarthaḥ| ulūkhalamusalādidvandveṣu
kvacidalpākṣaratvātkvacid
ghyantatvātkvacidajādyadantatvātpūrvanipātaprasaṅgaḥ, kvacidaniyamaḥ|
ddaṣadupalamiti| pramāda pāṭhaḥ; tena paranipātasyāpi siddhatvādiha
pāṭhaḥ śakyo'kartum||
dvandve ghi|| 2|2|32 ||
dvandve ghi|| dvandve'nekamiti
prathamānirdeśātsarveṣāmevopasarjanatvādaniyame prāpte vacanam|
anekaprāptāviti| ākṛtau padārthe samudāye sakṛllakṣaṇaṃ pravartate,
na prativyaktyāvṛtyā| tatraikasyaiva pūrvanipātena jātau lakṣaṇaṃ
pravṛtameveti na punaḥ pravartate| nanvākṛtipakṣe'pi paṭuaguptau
mṛduguptāvityādiṣu bahuṣu vyaktiṣu yathā yugapatpravartate,
tathātrāpi pravartatām? evaṃ manyate---ekasya
yugapadavadhyavadhimadbhāvo virodhānna sambhavati| na
cāntamapekṣyobhayoḥ pūrvatvamanyatareṇa vyavadhānāditi, atra ca yadā
paṭuamṛdvordvandvaṃ kṛtvā paścācchuklaśabdasya dvandvaḥ kiyate
tadālpāctaratvātasya pūrvanipāte śuklamṛdupaṭavaḥ, śuklapaṭuamṛdava
iti ca bhavati| vispaṣṭapaṭuariti| vispaṣṭaśabdaḥ pravṛttinimitasya
pāṭavasya viśeṣaṇamiti vispaṣṭṃa paṭuariti vigṛhya ṭhsupsupā' iti
samāsaḥ||
ajādyadantam|| 2|2|33 ||
ajādyadantam|| ajādīti pṛthak padam, viśeṣaṇasamāso vā|
aśvendrarathā iti| rathaśabdasya paścātsamāse rathāśvendrā ityapi bhavati|
dvandve ghyantādajādyadantaṃ vipratiṣedheneti| ṭhdvandve ghi'
ityasyāvakāśaḥ---paṭuaguptau; ṭhajādyadantam'
ityasyāvakāśaḥ---uṣṭrakharam; indrāgnī ityatrobhayaprāptau paratvād
ṭhajādyadantam' ityetadbhavati vipratiṣedheneti||

kāśikāvṛtau
dvitīyādhyāye prathamaḥ pādaḥ ipadamañjarī
alpāctaram|| 2|2|34 ||
alpāctaram|| ata eva nipānatātsvārthe tarap, kutvābhāvaśca| yadi tu
prakarṣe tarap cetadā ṭhdhavakhadirapalāśāḥ' ityādau bahuṣu
sannihiteṣu dvivacanopapadatvābhāvādasyāpravṛtāvaniyamaḥ syāt|
dvayoreva tu syāt---plakṣanyagrodhāviti| śaṅkhadundubhivīṇā iti|
tūryāṅgānāmityekavadbhāvo na bhavati;
tūryaśilpopajīvināmeva tatra grahaṇāt| niyatadravyavivakṣāyāṃ
jātiratvābhāṃvāt ṭhjātiraprāṇinām' ityetadapi na bhavati|
śaṅkhavīṇābhyāṃ dundubherdvandve dundubhiśaṅkhavīṇā ityapi bhavati|
evaṃ mṛdaṅgaśca śaṅkhapaṇavau ca mṛdaṅgaśapaṇaṅkhavāḥ, dhanapatiśca
rāmakeśavau ca prāsādo dhanapatirāmakeśavānāmityādi bhavati| tathā
hotā ca potā ca neṣṭā codrātā ceti bahūnāṃ yugapad dvandve
tṛtīyasyotarapadamanantaramiti tasyaivānaṅ bhavati,
netarayoḥ---hotṛpotṛneṣṭodrātāraḥ| dvayordvayordvandve
trayāṇāmapyānaṅ bhavati---hotāpotāneṣṭodrātāra iti|
evamanyatrāpi dvandvakriyāyāmānupūrvyaviśeṣādrūpaviśeṣo vedatavyaḥ|
pūrvābhyāmalpāctaramityetatpūrvānusāreṇa gamya mānatvād vṛtau
na paṭhitam| ṭhdvandve ghi' ityasyāvakāśaḥ---paṭuaguptau, ṭhalpāctaram'
ityāsyāvakāśaḥ---plakṣanyagrodhau; vaagagnī ityatrobhayaprāptau
alpāctaramityetadbhavati| ajādyadantamityasyāvakāśaḥ----uṣṭrakharam,
alpāctaramityasya sa eva; vāgindrāvityatrobhayaprāptau
ṭhalpāctaram'ityetadbhavati|
ṛtunakṣatrāṇāmiti| ṛtūnāmānupūrvyaṃ prādurbhāvakṛtam,
nakṣatrāṇāmudayakṛtam| mātāpitarāviti| ṭhācāyaṃ!śreṣṭho
gurūṇām, mātetyeke, iti smṛtiḥ| ṭhpiturddaśaguṇaṃ mātā
gauraveṇātiricyate' iti ca|
śraddhāmedhe iti| satyāṃ śraddhāyāmarthakriyākāriṇī medhetyabhyarhitatvaṃ
śraddhāyāḥ| dīkṣātapasī iti dīkṣārthaṃ tapa ityabhyarhitatvaṃ dīkṣāyāḥ|
laghvakṣarādapi tapaso vipratiṣedhādabhyarhitamityetadeva bhavati|
samānākṣarāṇāmityatra nāstīti| tena ṛtunakṣatrāṇāmityatraiva
varṇagrahaṇaṃ na kṛtamiti bhāvaḥ| varṇānāmutpattikṛtamānupūrvyaṃ
śrūyata eva---ṭhmukhato brāhmaṇamasṛjadvāhubhyāṃ rājanyamūrubhyāṃ vaiśyaṃ
padbhyāṃ śūdram' iti|
saṃkhyāyā alpīyasyā iti| dvandve cādvandve cetyāhuḥ| alpīyasa iti
pāṭhe alpīyaso'rthasya vācikāyā ityarthaḥ| navatiśatamiti| dvandvaḥ,
ṭhdvyekayoḥ' iti tu sautro nirdeśaḥ||
saptamīviśeṣame bahuvrīhau|| 2|2|35 ||
saptamīviśeṣame bahuvrīhau|| kaṇṭhekāla iti| yadā kaṇṭhe
kiñcidastīti nirjñāte kāla iti viśeṣaṇaṃ prayujyate tadā
saptamīgrahaṇena prayojanam, anyadā tu viśeṣaṇatvādeva siddham|
sampradhāraṇāyāmiti| idamastu idameveti nirūpaṇāūusampradhāraṇā|
paratvāditi| śabdaparavipratiṣedhādityarthaḥ| evamarthameva ca
ṭhsaṃkhyāsarvanāmnoḥ' iti noktam| gaḍvādibhya iti gaḍvādayaḥ
prayogato draṣṭavyāḥ||
niṣṭhā|| 2|2|36 ||
niṣṭhā|| avamuktopānatka iti| uraḥ prabhṛtitvātkap| nanu cetyādi|
yathā citraguriti| guṇadravyaśabdayorupanipāte guṇaśabdasya
viśeṣaṇatvam, kriyādravya śabdayorapi kriyāyā eva viśeṣaṇatvam|
tataśca pūrveṇaiva siddhamiti bhāvaḥ| vivakṣānibandhanatvāditi| yadā
kṛta kiñcidaneneti nirjñāte kaṭa iti prayujyate tadā kaṭo
viśeṣaṇamiti manyate| kaṭe kaṭena kṛtamiti vā vigrahītavyamiti|
evaṃ vigrahe kṛtasya viśeṣaṇatvaśaṅkaiva nāstīti bhāvaḥ| kvacitu
vāśabdo na paṭha|lte, tatra vivakṣānibandhanatvādityukte tāmeva
vivakṣāṃ darśayatīti vyākhyeyam|
jātikālasukhādibhyaḥ paravacanamiti| jñāpakātsiddham,
ṭhjātikālasukhādibhyo'nācchādanād' ityāha,
tajjñāpayati---jātyādibhyaḥ parā niṣṭhā nipatatīti| śārṅgajagdhīti|
śārṅga jagghamanayeti bahuvrīhiḥ|
ṭhktādalpākhyāyām',ṭhasvāṅgapūrvapadādvā' iti ṅīṣ|
atrāhuḥ----niṣṭhāśabdena yā vihitā niṣṭhā tasyā grahaṇam| tena
susthitam, cāruhasitamityādau ṭhnapuṃsake bhāve ktaḥ' ityasya
paranipāta iti||
vā''hitāgnyādiṣu|| 2|2|37 ||
kaḍāśaḥ karmadhāraye|| 2|2|38 ||
kaḍārāḥ karmadhāraye|| bahuvacananirddaśādādyartho'vagamyata
ityāha---kaḍārādaya iti||
iti śrīharadatamiśraviracitāyāṃ padamañjaryāṃ
dvitīyādhyāyasya dvitīyaḥ pādaḥ||

-----||||||-----kāśikāvṛtau
atha dvitīyādhyāye tṛtīyaḥ pādaḥ
anabhihite|| 2|3|1 ||
anabhihite|| anabhihitaśabdo'yamanekārthaḥ, tathā hi---abhipūrvasya
dadhāterhinoteścaitadrūpaṃ sambhavati; abhipūrvaśca dadhātirbandhane'pi
ddaṣṭaḥ----aśvābhidhānīmādata iti, uccāraṇe'pi---abhihitaḥ śloka iti,
pratipādane'pi----abhihito'rtha iti; hinotirapi gatau vṛddhau ca
vartate, iha tu vakṣyamāṇānāṃ karmādīnāṃ
bandhanādyarthacatuṣṭayāsambhavātpratipādanavacano'bhihitaśabda
ityāha---anabhihite anirdiṣṭe anukta iti| vaciratra pratipādanavacanaḥ|
uktārthānāmaprayoga iti yathā sāmānyena ṭhabhihite'
ityetāvatyucyamāne kaṭṃa karoti bhīṣṇamudāraṃ darśanīyamityatra
kaṭaśabdādviśeṣyavācina utpadyamānayā dvitīyayā'navayavena kaṭagatasya
karmatvasyābhihitatvādbhīṣmādibhyo dvitīyā na syāditi manyamānaḥ
pṛcchati---kenānabhihita iti| itaro'pi viditābhiprāya
āha---tiṅkṛtaddhitasamāsairiti| bahuṣu prayukteṣu
keṣāñcidvarjanena keṣāñcitkāryānvapratipādanamūuparisaṃkhyānam,
pratyudāharaṇeṣu sarvatra dvitīyā na bhavati|
kaṭṃa karoti bhīṣmamityādi| kaṭaḥ kṛto bhīṣma udāro darśanīya iti
karoterutpadyamānaḥ ktapratyayo'navayavena sarvakarmābhidhate tadvad
dvitīyāpīti yo mandadhīrmanyate taṃ pratīdaṃ parigaṇanabh,
sūkṣmaddaśastu prati na vaktavyameva| tathā hi prātipadikādutpadyamānā
dvitīyā yadākāraviśiṣṭo'rthaḥ prātipadikenābhidhīyate
tadākāraviśiṣṭasyaiva karmabhāvamācaṣṭe| kaṭhaśabdena
kaṭatvajātiviśiṣṭo'rtho'bhidhīyate,na bhīṣmādyākāraviśiṣṭa iti
tatpratipādanāya yathā bhīṣmādiśabdaprayogo bhavati tathā
tadākāraviśiṣṭasya karmatvābhidhānāya dvitīyā bhaviṣyati|
ktapratyayastu prakṛtyarthasya na karmatāmācaṣṭe, kintu prakṛtyarthaṃ prati
yasya karmabhāvaḥ tamiti yuktaṃ yadanavayavena sarvakarmābhidhate| nanu ca
karmādayo vibhaktyarthāsteṣāṃ ca tiṅadibhirabhiritavacanamanarthakam,
anyatrāpi vihitasyābhāvādabhihite, yatrāpyanabhihitādhikāro na
kriyate tatrāpi śabdāntarapratipādite'rthe naiva vihitaṃ bhavati, tad
yathā---bahupaṭuariti bahucoktatvādīṣadasamāpteḥ satyapi sambhave
kalpabādayo na bhavanti, dvirdaśa dvidaśāḥ---samāsenoktatvātsujarthasya
sujna bhavati, paṭuaguptau---dvandvenoktatvāccārthasya ca--śabdo na
prayujyate; tadvadatrāpi tiṅadibhirabhihitatvādeva dvitīyādayo na
bhaviṣyanti|
nanvabhihitārthasyāpi prayogo ddaṣṭaḥ----apūpau dvāviti, satyam;
ayaṃ tu nyāyaḥ yadutābhihite vihitaṃ na syāt, na hi vyasanitayā
śabdaḥ prayujyate, api tvarthābhidhānāya, sa cedarthaḥ
śabdāntareṇābhihitaḥ kimiti śabdāntaraṃ prayujyate,
akṣinikocādibhirapyavagate'rthe śabdo naiva prayujyate, kiṃ punaḥ
śabdenaivābhihite| apūpau dvāvityādau tu dvāvānaya kau dvau
tāviti sāmānyopakrame vākyamiti yathākathañcidupapādanīyam,
tasmānnārtha etenetyāśaṅkya saṃkhyāpi vibhaktyartha iti
darśayannāha---bahuṣu bahuvacanamityevamādineti|
ayamarthaḥ----ṭhtrikaḥ prātipadikārthaḥ' ityasmindarśane
karmādivadekatvādisaṃkhyāvibhaktyarthaḥ, tatra karmādīnāṃ
yugapadvibhaktibhirabhidhīyamānānāṃ parasparaṃ
viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvamanāpannānāṃ
kevalaprātipadikārthagatānāmabhidhānaṃ vṛkṣa eko vṛkṣaḥ karma
paśurekaḥ paśuḥ karaṇamiti vābhidhānam, paścāccaikakriyānvayabalena
parasparasambandha iti prābhākarā manyante|
bhāṭṭāstu paramparāsambaddhasya svatantrasyānekārthasyākṣāḥ, pādāḥ,
māṣā ityādāvabhidhānadarśane'pyekaśeṣamantareṇādarśanāt
yajetetyādau ca kṛtikāryayoryugapalliṅabhidhīyamānayorapi
viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvasya prābhākarairapyabhyupagamātadvadeva
viśiṣṭābhidhānaṃ manyante| 
asmākamapyayameva pakṣaḥ| tatra karmādayo viśeṣaṇam, ekatvādayo
viśeṣyāḥ, karmaṇi yadekatvaṃ tatra dvitīyaikavacanamiti| viparyayo
vā---ekatvādiviśiṣṭṃa yatkarma tatra dvitīyeti| tatra yadyapi
karmādiprādhānyapakṣe tiṅadibhiḥ pradhānabhūtānāṃ
karmādināmabhihitatvādaprasaṅgaḥ, dvitīyādīnāṃ saṃkhyāprādhānyapakṣe
karmādiṣvabhihiteṣvapi pradhānabhūtasaṃkhyābhidhānāya dvitīyādayaḥ
syureva| prābhākare tu pakṣe karmādyaṃśābhidhāne'pi
saṃkhyāṃśasyānabhihitasyābhidhānāya dvitīyādayaḥ syuriti|
anabhihitakarmāśrayeṣviti| anabhihitāni karmādīnyāśrayo yeṣāṃ
teṣvityarthaḥ| etena karmaṇītyādisaptamīnirddeśa
ekatvādīnāmādhāratayā, na punarabhidheyatayeti darśitam| anabhihita
iti| yadi prasajyapratiṣedhaḥ syātato dvayoḥ kriyayoḥ
kārake'nyatareṇābhihite'pi vibhaktyabhāvaprasaṅgaḥ, prāsāda āste
ityatra sadikriyāyā āsikriyāyāścaikamadhikararagaṃ prāsādākhyaṃ
taccānyatareṇa sadipratyayena ghañābhihitam---prasīdantyasminprāsāda
iti, tatrābhihite na bhavatītyucyamāne saptamī na syāt| paryudāse
tvāsipratyayena yadanabhidhānaṃ tadāśrayā saptamī sidvyati| nanu ca
prāsādākhyasya dravyasya kārakatvādabhihitatva danyatvaṃ nāsti? naiṣa
doṣaḥ; śaktiḥ kārakam, tatra
sadikriyāśaktyabhidhāne'pyāsikriyāśakteranabhidhānam| nanvevaṃ
prasajyapratiṣedhe'pi yā śaktirabhihitā tatra mā bhūdvibhaktiḥ, yā
tvanabhihitā tatra bhaviṣyati? ucyate---anabhihite
karmaṇītyekatvādīnāmādhāranirddeśaḥ saṃkhyā ca dravyadharmaḥ,
ato'nabhihite karmaṇītyādibhirapi śaktidvāreṇa
dravyamevocyate----anabhihitā yā karmādiśaktistadādhārabhūtaṃ yad
dravyaṃ tasyaikatvādiṣu vibhaktaya iti| evaṃ ca yadi prasajyapratiṣedhaḥ
syātato'bhihitaśaktidvāreṇa dravyasyābhihitatvātpratiṣedhaḥ syāt;
paryudāse tu anabhihitaśaktidvāre vidhiriti spaṣṭa eva phalabhedaḥ|
yatra tarhi śaktibhedo nāsti tatra katham---āsane āste, śayane śeta
iti? atrāpyāsanaśayanādiśabdairāsanādikriyāyogyaṃ
vastumātramanudbhutaśaktikamabhihitamiti tasya
śaktyudbhavapratipādanāya vibhaktirbhaviṣyati|
yadi tarhi paryudāso'yamiti nirmīyate, iha paktvā bhujyata odanā
iti bhujipratyayenāpyabhihita odane ktvāpratyayenānabhidhānamāśritya
dvitīyā prāpnoti, bhāve hi ktvāpratyayaḥ; prasajyapratiṣedhe tu
bhujipratyayenābhidhānamāśritya pratiṣedhaḥ siddhyati? ucyate;
nātraudanasya yugapadubhābhyāṃ śābda evānvayaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? bhujinaiva,
sannidhānātu pacinānvayaḥ| kevalaśabdavyāpāranirūpaṇe tu
kimiṣṭakāḥ paktvaudano bhujyate, utaudanameveti na jñāyate, ataḥ
śabdavyāpārāpekṣayābhidhānameveti dvitīyā na bhaviṣyati|
anabhihitavacanamanarthakam; prathamāvidhānasyānavakāśatvāt| kṛtaḥ kaṭa
ityādiṣu dvitīyādayo mā bhūvinniti sūtrārambhaḥ| yadi cātrāpi
syuḥ, kvedānīṃ prathamā syāt| nanvanavakāśatvātprathamā bhavantī kṛtaḥ
kaṭa ityādāveva bhavatīti na punaḥ kaṭṃa karotītyādāvapīti
kuto'yaṃ niyamaḥ? ucyate---kṛtaḥ kaṭa ityādau yadyapi
kṛtaśabdasannidhāne kaṭasya karmatā pratīyate, tathāpi tatra
vākyārthatvādavyatirikta eva prātipadikārtha iti prathamā bhaviṣyati,
yathā---viraḥ puruṣa iti| kaṭṃa karotītyatra tu kaṭaśabdenaiva
karmaśaktimānartho'bhidhīyata iti vyatiriktatvātprātipadikārthasya
prathamā na bhaviṣyati| nanvakārakeṣu sāvakāśā prathamā,yathā---vṛkṣa
iti? atrāpyastīti pratīteḥ kartṛ tvātṛtīyāprasaṅgaḥ| yatra
hyanyatkriyāpadaṃ na śrūyate tatrāntaraṅgatvādastīti gamyate,
labdhasatākasya hi viśeṣaṇāntarayogo bhaviṣyati| athāpi yatra
viśeṣaṇāntaranivṛtau tātparyam, na kriyāsambandhe,
yathā---nīlamutpalaṃ na raktam, rājño'yaṃ puruṣo na devadatasyeti,
na hyatra nīlamutpalamutpalamasti, rājñaḥ puruṣo'stīti pratītiḥ,
atostyevākārakamavakāśa ityucyeta? evamapi vipratiṣedhātprathamā
bhaviṣyati| dvitīyādīnāmavakāśo yatra prātipadikārthasya
vyatirekaḥ----kaṭṃa karotīti;
prathamāyāstvakārakamavakāśaḥ----nīlamutpalamiti; kṛtaḥ kaṭa
ityatrobhayaprasaṃge paratvātprathamaiva bhaviṣyati| nanu tāmapi bādhitvā
paratvāt, ṣaṣṭhī prāpnoti, śeṣalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhī prātipadikārthamātrasya
prathamāvidhāvupayogādaśeṣatvānna bhaviṣyati| iha tarhi kartavyaḥ kaṭa
iti kṛtprayoge prathamāṃ bādhitvā ṭhkartṛ karmaṇoḥ kṛti' iti ṣaṣṭhi
syāt, tatpratiṣedhārthamanabhihitādhikāraḥ kartavyaḥ| tadevaṃ
saṃkhyāvibhaktyartha ityasminpakṣe kartavyaṃ sūtramiti sthitam||
karmaṇi dvitīyā|| 2|3|2 ||
karmaṇi dvitīyā|| dvitīyādayaḥ śabdā iti|
svanikāyaprasiddhireṣetyarthaḥ| 
ubhasarvatasoriti| ubhayasarvaśabdayostasilantayoḥ prayoga ityarthaḥ|
ubhayaśabdaikadeśa ubhaśabdo'nukṛtaḥ; ubhaśabdasya tasilantasyābhāvāt,
tasya dvivacanaṭābviṣayatvāt| dhigityavibhaktiko nirddeśaḥ|
āmroṅtānteṣviti| kṛtidvirvacaneṣvityarthaḥ| ubhayataḥ sarvata iti|
pañcamyāstasil| dhigiti| nindārtho'yam| uparyuparīti|
ṭhuparyadhyadhasassāmīpye' iti dvirvacanam| tato'nyatrāpītyuktam,
tānevānyānparigaṇayati---abhita ityādi| abhito grāmamiti| ubhayata
ityarthaḥ| parita iti| sarvata ityarthaḥ| ṭhparyabhibhyāṃ ca' iti tasil|
ābhimukhyavṛttirapi vibhaktipratirūpako nipāto'bhitaḥ śabdo'sti,
so'pi gṛhyate| samayānikaṣāśabdau samīpavacanau gṛhyaete| hāśabdaḥ
śokādivṛttiḥ hā kanye ityādau
kārakavibhaktitvādantaraṅgatvātsambodhanavibhaktirmavati| bubhukṣitaṃ
na pratibhātīti| pratiratra kriyāviśeṣakatvā dupasargo na
karmapravacanīya iti paṭha|lte|
tṛtīyā ca hoścchandasi|| 2|3|3| ||
tṛtīyā ca hoścchandasi|| yavāgvāgnihotramiti| kva
punaragnihotraśabdo vartate? haviṣi; teṣvagnihotramadhiśrayet,
agnihotraṃ śaraśarāyat,
tadāhuryasyāgnihotramadhiśritamamedhyamāpadyetetyādiṣu darśanāt|
juhotirapi prakṣepe| ekasminneva prayoge yavāgūśabdāt tṛtīyā,
agnihotraśabdād dvitīyā; yavāgvākhyaṃ havirdeavatoddeśena
prakṣipatītyarthaḥ|
ayaṃ yogaḥ śakyo'vaktum, katham? agnihotraśabdo jyotiṣyati
vartate---agnihotraṃ prajvalitamiti| juhotirapi prīṇane| tadyadā
yavāgūśabdāt tṛtīyā tadā yavāgvāgnihotraṃ prīṇayatītyarthaḥ, yadā
tu dvitīyā tadā yavāgvākhyaṃ dravyamagnihotraṃ haviragnau
prakṣipatītyarthaḥ|
mīmāṃsakāstvāhuḥ----agnihotraśabdaḥ karmanāmadheyamiti, ddaśyate
ca---sa eṣa yajña pañcavidho'gnihotraṃ darśapūrṇamāsāvityādi| tasya
vā etasyāgnihotrasya sapta ca śatāni ca, etadvā
agnihotramanyedyaurhūḍyate ajarāmarya vā etadyadagnihotramiti ca ta
ityāhuḥ| karaṇatvāt tṛtīyāyāṃ prāptāyāṃ pakṣe dvitīyārthaṃ
vacanam| idaṃ ca sūtrānuguṇaṃ na bhavati, karmaṇīti hi vartate||
antarāntareṇa yukte|| 2|3|4 ||
antarāntareṇa yukte|| antarāntareṇaśabdāvityādi| nanu yathā
naurnāvi baddhā netaretaratrāṇāya bhavati tāddagetat, dvayorapi
nipātatvavyabhicārāt, satyam; sāhacaryātsājātyaṃ lakṣyate,
sajātīyavijātīyabhāve sajātīyapratyayo bhavati,
tadyathā--gurubhārgavāvityukte grahayoreva pratītirbhavati, na
tvācāryaparaśurāmayoḥ| yadvā antarāśabdenātṛtīyāntena
sāhacaryādantareṇetyasyāpyatṛtīyāntasya grahaṇam, sa ca nipāta eva|
tathāntareṇa śabdenāṭābantena
sāhacaryādantarāśabdasyāpyaṭābantasyaiva grahaṇam, sa ca nipāta eva|
ṣaṣṭhaeyapavādo yoga iti| asatyasminyoge śeṣatvāt ṣaṣṭhī
prāpnoti| sati tvasminnupayuktatvāt ṣaṣṭhī na
bhavatītyapavādatvametat| madhyamādheyeti| ādheyaparatantramityarthaḥ|
sapabtamyantasya madhyaśabdasyārthe vartata iti yāvat| antarā tvāṃ ca māṃ
ca kamaṇḍaluriti| tava ca mama ca madhye kamaṇḍalurityarthaḥ| atra yathā
madhyasyāvadhyapebhāyāmavadhibhūtābhyāṃ yuṣmadasmadbhyāṃ yogaḥ,
tathā''dhārasyādheyaparatantratvādādheyena kamaṇḍalunāpi yogatato'pi
dvitīyā prāpnoti, naiṣa doṣaḥ, kamaṇḍalurityatra tiṣṭhatyastīti vā
kriyāpadānuṣaṅgātkamaṇḍaluḥ kartā, sa ca tiṅabhihita iti prathamaiva
bhaviṣyati, kārakavibhaktitvāt| tadetat ṭhsahayukte'pradhāne'
ityatropapādayiṣyāmaḥ| nipātayorgrahaṇādiha na bhavati, kiṃ tena
tayorantareṇa jñātena! viśeṣavacano'yam---antarāyāṃ puri
vasatīti srughnasya prākāra iti, nātra srughnasyāntarāśabdārthena yogaḥ,
kiṃ tarhi? prākāreṇa||
kālādhvanoratyantasaṃyoge|| 2|3|5 ||
kālādhvanoratyantasaṃyoge|| māsamadhīta iti| nanu karmatvādevātra
dvitīyā siddhā, katham? ṭhkālabhāvādhvagantavyāḥ karmasaṃjñā hyakarmaṇām'|
avaśyaṃ karmasaṃjñaivāśrayaṇīyā---āsyate māsaḥ, āsitavyaḥ āsita iti
karmaṇi lakṛtyaktakhalarthā yathā syuriti, satyam; idamapyavaśyaṃ
vaktavyam---dravyaguṇābhyāmatyantasaṃyoge dvitīyāyathā syāditi| tatra
kriyātyantasaṃyoge'pi paratvādanenaiva yuktā dvitīyā|
māsasyetiṭhkṛtvo'rthaprayoge kāle'dhikaraṇe' iti ṣaṣṭhī||
apavarge tṛtīyā|| 2|3|6 ||
apavarge tṛtīyā|| apavargaḥ phalaprāptau satyāṃ kriyāparisamāptiriti|
tatraivāpavargaśabdo loke prasiddha iti bhāvaḥ| kartṛvyāvṛtāviti|
aśaktyādinā karturuparamādityarthaḥ, tatra madhye kriyā vicchinneti
pravṛtyapāyaḥ, na tvapavṛkteti||
saptamīpañcamyau kārakamadhye|| 2|3|7 ||
saptamīpañcamyau kārakamadhye|| kārakamadhya iti|
madhyasyāvadhidvayāpekṣatvād dvivacanāntena samāsaḥ,
kālādhvanoścaitadviśeṣaṇamityāha---kārakayormadhye yau
kālādhvānāviti| adya bhuktvetyādi| nanuṃ cātra devadata ekaḥ kartāḥ
tatkathaṃ kārakayormadhye kāla ityāha---kartṛśakatyoriti| syādevaṃ
yadi dravyaṃ kārakaṃ syāt, śaktistu kārakam, seha bhidyate--ekā adya
bhujeḥ sādhanam, aparā dvyahabhujeḥ, tenānayormadhye kāla ityarthaḥ|
kartṛkarmaṇoriti| iṣūnasyatīṣvāsaḥ puruṣaḥ sa kartā, iṣvasane
vyadhane sthāne vā karma lakṣyam| armāpādānayoriti| karma tadeva
sāmarthyād gamyamānaṃ dhanurapādānaṃ yataḥ śarā apayanti|
karmādhikaraṇayorveti| karma tadevādhikaraṇamiheti nirddiṣṭaḥ
pradeśaḥ| iha kālādhvānau dvau, saptamīpañcamyāvapi dve, tataśca
saṃkhyātānudeśaḥ prāpnoti---kālātsaptamī, adhvanaḥ prañcamīti, ata
āha---saṃkhyātānudeśa ityādi| asvaritatvāditi| svaritena
liṅkena yathāsaṃkhyamityetat tatraiva pratipāditam||
karmapravacanīyayukte dvitīyā|| 2|3|8 ||
yasmādadhikaṃ yasya ceśvaravacanaṃ tatra saptamī|| 2|3|9 ||
yasmādadhikaṃ yasya ceśvaravacanaṃ tatra saptamī || yasmādadhikaṃ
tadasminnadhikamiti ca nirdeśādadhikaśabdayoge paryāyeṇa
saptamīpañcamyau bhavataḥ| upakhārtho droṇa iti| ṭhupo'dhike ca' iti
karmapravacanīyasaṃjñā| yasya ceśvaravacanamityādi| dvayamanenocyate,
dvayorapi bhavati, tatrāpi paryāyeṇeti tatra dvayorapi tāvadbhavati,
katham? īśvara ucyate yena tadośvaravacanamaiśvaryam, atha vā
īśvaraśabdo bhāvapradhānaḥ īśvaraḥ tasyoktirīśvaracanam, yasya svāmina
īśvaratvamucyate tataḥ saptamītyarthaḥ| atha vā---yasyeti svaṃ
nirdiśyate, yasya svasyeśvara ucyate tataḥ svātsaptamītyarthaḥ| paryāyeṇa
vā bhavati; śeṣaviṣaye karmapravacanīyavibhaktyārambhādekata utpannayā
vibhaktyā dviṣṭhasyāpi saṃbandhasyābhidhānāt| adhi brahmadata iti| ṭhsaptamī
śauṇḍèaḥ' iti samāsapakṣe brahmadatādhīnā iti bhavati
vibhaktyarthavṛttitve'dhibrahmadatamityavyayībhāvaḥ| ayaṃ yogaḥ
śakyo'vaktum, svāminyādhāre pañcālāḥ sthitā sveṣvādhāreṣu
brahmadataḥ sthitaḥ, tatra yadā yadadhikaraṇaṃ tatra saptamī bhaviṣyati, evaṃ ca
kṛtvā ṭhadhirīśvare' iti karmapravacanīyasaṃjñā na vaktavyā,
aisvaryavaṣayaścādhiḥ kriyayā naiva yujyate| ato
gatyupasargatvabādhārthāpi na yujyate||
pañcamyapāṅparibhiḥ|| 2|3|10 ||
pratinidhipratidāne ca yasmāt|| 2|3|11 ||
pratinidhipratidāne ca yasmāt|| yasmādityanenaiva sūtraiṇa pañcamī|
mukhyasaddaśaḥ pratinidhiriti| mukhyaḥ kva citkārye rūḍhaḥ, yaśca tadabhāve
tatkārye pratinidhīyate sa tatpratinidhiḥ| karmaṇi ṭhupasarge ghoḥ kiḥ'|
evaṃ pratidānamityapi, karmaṇyevalyuṭ| datasyeti| athātrānenaiva
sūtreṇa pañcamī prāpnoti, yathā----yasmāditi, evaṃ tarhi karmaṇi
ṣaṣṭhī| nanu na datameva pratyarpyate, kiṃ tarhi? dravyāntaram, satyam;
tulyamūlyatvātadeva pratyapitamiti pratipatiḥ,
pratiniryātanamupratyapaṃṇam, atra bhāve lyuṭa| yasmātpratinidhiriti|
sūtravadeva pañcamī| evaṃ yataścetyatrāpi| urjunataḥ| pratīti|
pratiyoge pañcamyāstasiḥ| arjuno yuddhādau
prasiddhastatsaddaśo'bhimanyurityarthaḥ| māṣānityādi| ye pūrva
gṛhītāstilāstebhyo māṣāḥ pratidānam| saṃbandhisaṃbhabandhāditi|
pratinidhirmukhyamapekṣya bhavati, pratidānamapi pūrvadatam, tataśca
yasya karmapravacanīyasya pratinidhipratidānābhyāṃ yogastasya tābhyāmapi
mukhyapūrvadatābhyāṃ taddvārako yogo'stītyarthaḥ||
gatyarthakarmaṇi dvitīyācaturthyau ceṣṭāyāmanadhvani|| 2|3|12 ||
gatyarthakarmaṇi dvitīyācatuthyāé ceṣṭāyāmanadhvani||
ceṣṭākriyāṇāmiti| vastu vyākhyānametat, sūtre tu saptamī
ceṣṭāyāmiti| parispandanakriyāṇāmiti| parispandana eva ceṣṭāśabdaḥ
prasiddha iti bhāvaḥ| ṭhsvaṃ rūpam' iti
vacanātsvarūpagrahaṇāśaṅkāyāmāha---adhvanyarthagrahaṇamiti|
saptamīnirdeśāditi bhāvaḥ| saptamīnirdeśe hyanadhvanikarmaṇītyanvayaḥ|
nānadhvanaḥ prakṛteriti artha eva karma nādhvaśabdaḥ,
tenādhvaparyāyebhyo'pari caturthī na bhavati| dvitīyā tu ṭhkarmaṇi
dvitīyā' iti bhavati|
āsthitaḥ saṃprāpta iti gantrādhiṣṭhita ityarthaḥ| yatra tviti| yadotpathena
panthā evākramitumiṣyate tadā bhavatyeva caturthītyarthaḥ| iha kasmānna
bhavati---ajāṃ nayati gramamiti? agatyarthatvāt| pratītā hyatra gatirna
tvasau nayaterarthaḥ; prāpaṇavācitvāt| iha tarhi striyaṃ gacchatīti
caturthī prāpnoti? siddhaṃ tvasaṃprāptavacanāt, asaṃprāptaṃ yadvastu
gamanena saṃprepsyate tasminkarmaṇīti vaktavyam, strī tu
saṃprāptaiveti caturthyabhāvaḥ| adhvanaścānapavādaḥ| saṃprāpto hyadhvā,
yadā tvasaṃprāptaḥ saṃprepsyate tadā bhavitavyameva caturthyetyuktaṃ
purastāt|
na caturthyeveti| nañaḥ kākvā prayogādvikalpetetyanenānvayaḥ|
karmaṇi caturthyāṃ vikalpitāyām ṭh tathāyukte karmaṇi dvitīyā'
ityeva dvitīyā bhaviṣyatīti bhāvaḥ| grāmāya ganteti| dvitīyā
tāvatkṛdyoge ṣaṣṭhaāā bādhate, tayā ca tulyakakṣā caturthī dvandvena
pratipādyata iti caturthyapi kṛhyaege bhavatīti bhāvaḥ|
ayaṃ yogaḥ śakyo'vaktum, katham?
saṃdarśanaprārthanādhyavasāyairāpyamānatvātkriyāpi kṛtrimaṃ karma| tatra
yadā gamanasya saṃdarśanādīnāṃ ca svarupabhedo vivakṣyate tadā
saṃdarśanādikarmaṇā gamanenābhipreyamāṇasya grāmasya
saṃpradānatvāccaturthī| abhedavivakṣāyāṃ tu gamanasya karmatvābhāvād
grāmaḥ karmaiva bhavatīti dvitīyā siddhā nārtha eteneti bhā,yakārasya
pakṣaḥ| tatra kṛtprayoge ṣaṣṭha|leva bhavati|
caturthī saṃpradāne|| 2|3|13 ||
caturthī saṃpradāne|| tādarthya iti| tacchabdena kārthaṃ prati nirdiśyate,
tasmai idaṃ tadarthamiti samāsena viśiṣṭakāryaprayojanaṃ
kāraṇamabhidhīyate| tadarthasya bhāvastādarthyamiti ṣyañā
kāryakāraṇasambandho'bhidhīyate; samāsakṛtaddhiteṣu sambandhābhidhānāṃ
bhāvapratyayeneti vacanāt| tatra dviṣṭhatve'pi sambandhasya
ṣaṣṭhīvadviśeṣaṇādeva caturthī bhavatī---yūpāya dārviti|
hetutṛtīyāpi viśeṣyānna bhavati| hetuhetumadbhāvasyāpi
caturthyaiva pratyāyitatvāt, ṣaṣṭhīviṣaye ca hetutṛtīyā| iha tu
prātipadikārthasyāvyatirekātprathamaiva bhavati| yadi tarhi tādarthya
upasaṃkhyānaṃ kriyate, nārthaḥ saṃpradāne caturthyā, yo'pi hyupādhyāyāya
gaurdīyate upādhyāyārthaḥ sa bhavati| avaśyaṃ saṃpradānagrahaṇaṃ kartavyam
ṭhrucyarthānāṃ prīyamāṇaḥ' ityādyartham|
valṛpi saṃpadyamāna iti| saṃpatirabhūtaprādurbhāvarūpotpatiriha
gṛhyate, tatra yadrūpamupajāyate tato vikārāccaturthī| mūtrāya kalpate
yavāgūriti | prakṛtivikārayorbhedavivakṣāyāṃ caturthī|
abhedavivakṣāyāṃ tu mūtraṃ saṃpadyate yavāgūriti prathamaiva bhavatīti
kecidāhuḥ| anye tvabhedavivakṣāyāmeva caturthīmicchanti| yadā tu
ṭhjanikartuḥ prakṛtiḥ' ityapādānatvaṃ vivakṣyate, tadā
vikārāccaturthī na bhavatīti kecidāhuḥ---mūtraṃ saṃpadyate yavāgvā
iti| anye tatrāpi caturthīmicchanti---mūtrāya saṃpadyate yavāgvā iti|
utpāteneti| prāṇināṃ śubhāśubhayo sūcako bhūtavikāra utpātaḥ|
arocakina iti| aruciḥuarocakam, ṭhrogākhyāyām' iti ṇvul,
bahulavacanādastrīliṅgatā||
kriyārthopapadasya ca karmaṇi sthāninaḥ|| 2|3|14 ||
kriyārthopapadāsya ca karmaṇi sthāninaḥ|| kriyā kriyārthopapadaṃ
yasyeti| nanu nāsminnarthe'kṣarāṇi santi
tatrāha---tumunṇvulāvityādi| paribhāṣitamupapadaṃ kriyārthamanyatra
sambhavatītyayameva viṣayo gṛhyate| atra ca viṣaye kriyaiva
kriyārthopapadaṃ tenāyamartho labhyate iti bhāvaḥ| ṭhyatra gamyate cārtho
na ca prayujyate śabdaḥ sa sthānī' iti
svanikāyaprasiddhimāśrityāha---sthānino'prayujyamānasyeti| edhebhyo
vrajatīti| nanu cātra ṭhtādarthye' ityeva caturthī siddhā, ihāpi tarhi
prāpnoti--edhānāhartu vrajatīti? haraṇārthā vrajikriyā, na
punaredhārthā cedudāharaṇe'pi tarhyevameva| etāvāṃstu
viśeṣaḥ---pratyudāharaṇe śabdaḥ prayujyate, udāharaṇe tu neti
pratīyamānā ca kriyā kārakavyapadeśasya nimitam| tatra yathā
pratyudāharaṇe āharaṇāpekṣayā dvitīyā sambhavatyevamudāharaṇe'pi
pratīyamānaharaṇāpekṣā dvitīyaiva syādityayamārambhaḥ| bhakṣiratra
sthānīti| praviśa gṛhaṃ piṇḍaāā bhakṣayeti gamyamānatvāt| na tu
kriyārthopapada iti| yadyapi piṇḍībhakṣaṇārtha gṛhapraveśanaṃ tathāpi
pāribhāṣikamupapadaṃ na bhavatīti bhāvaḥ| śakaṭeneti| nanu
ṭhmadhye'pavādāḥ' iti dvitīyāmeva caturtī bādhiṣyate, na
karaṇatṛtīyām, evaṃ tarhi pratyudāharaṇadigiyaṃ darśitā| idaṃ tvatra
pratyudāharaṇaṃ draṣṭvyam---brāhmaṇasyaidhebhyo vrajatīti| asati
karmagrahaṇe itaropapadavibhaktivadiyamapi śeṣaviṣayaiva syāt||
tumarthācca bhāvavacanāt|| 2|3|15 ||
tumarthācca bhāvavacanāt|| tumunā samānārthastumartha iti|
vastuvyākhyānametat, vigrahastu tumartho'syeti tumśabdena tumartho
lakṣyate| tumarthabhāvavacanapratyayāntāditi| tumartho bhāvavacanaḥ
pratyayo'nte'sya tatathoktam| tasyedaṃ grahaṇamiti| sa eva hi tumartho
bhāvavacanaḥ, nānyaḥ| pākāya vrajatīti| nanvatra tādarthyaiva siddham; na
caivaṃ pācako vrajatītyabhāvavacanādapi prasaṅgaḥ, atra kartā pradhānaṃ na
ca taṃ prati tādarthyamasti, kiṃ tu praka-tyartha prati; evaṃ tarhi
bhāvavacanenaiva tādarthyasya dyotitatvāccaturthī na siddhyatīti
sūtrārambhaḥ| na hyaetallakṣaṇanetro jñātumarhati---dhañādīnāṃ
caturthīsāpekṣāṇāmeva tādarthyaprakāśane śaktiriti|
tumarthagrahaṇaṃ śakyamakartum, katham? pākaḥ, tyāgaḥ, rāga iti
kriyārtho papadagrahaṇamanuvartiṣyate| nanvetat ṣaṣṭhīnirdiṣṭam,
pañcamīnirdeaṣeṭena cehārthaḥ; arthādvipariṇāmo bhaviṣyati,
bhāvavacanādityanena sambandhāt| na vai bhāvavacanasya
kriyārthopapadatvaṃ sambhavati, kiṃ tarhi? dhātoḥ|
dhātorbhāvavacanasyāsambhavādevaṃ
vijñāsyate--kriyārthopapadāddhātoryo vihito bhāvavacana iti||
namaḥ svastisvāhāsvadhālaṃvaṣaḍa|legācca|| 2|3|16 ||
namaḥ svastisvāhāsvadhālaṃvaṣaḍa|legācca|| alamiti
paryāptyarthagrahaṇamiti| alamityarthagrahaṇaṃ tatrāpi
paryāptigrahaṇamityarthaḥ| tatra tāvadarthagrahaṇaṃ tasmai prabhavatīti
nirdeśāt, iha cālaṃ kurute kanyāmiti ṭhupapadavibhakteḥ
kārakavibhaktirbalīyasī' iti dvitīyā bhaviṣyati|
evamalamodanenetyatrāpi karaṇe tṛtīyā, odanena na
kiñcitsādhyamityarthāvagamāt, tena
bhūṣaṇapratiṣedhayoragrahaṇātparyāpterevagrahaṇam| cakāraḥ
punarityādi| anyathā svastiyoge caturthyā avakāśaḥ---svasti
jālmāya, jālmatvādāśīrabhāvād bhūtakathanametat;
kuśalārthairāśiṣi caturthī cetyasyāvakāśaḥ---anye kuśalārthāḥ,
kuśalaṃ devadatasya kuśalaṃ devadatāya; svasti gobhyo bhūyāt,
ubhayaprasaṅge paratvātpakṣe ṣaṣṭhī syāt||
manyakarmaṇyanādare vibhāṣā'prāṇiṣu|| 2|3|17 ||
manyakarmaṇyanādare vibhāṣā'prāṇiṣu|| manyateḥ karma manyakarmeti|
ṭhmana jñāne'ityasya daivādikasya dhātoḥ śyanā upalakṣaṇam, na tu
prayogasthasya śyanantasyānukaraṇamityarthaḥ| tena śyano'bhāve'pi
bhavati---ṭhtṛṇāya matvā raghunandano'pi bāṇena rakṣaḥ
pradhanānnirāsthat' iti| śyānā tu tānādikasya ṭh manu avabodhane'
ityasyaiva nirāsaḥ| anādarastiraskāra iti| na tvādarābhāvamātram,
katham? anṛtādivannañaḥ pratipakṣavācitvāditi bhāvaḥ| manyakarmaṇi
prakṛṣṭakutsitagrahaṇamiti vārtikam, yadvācinaścaturthī vidhīyate
tataḥ prakarṣeṇa yadi kutsā pratipādayitumiṣyate tadā caturthī bhavati,
na tu sāmānyavivakṣāyām| tena pratiṣedhayuktāyāṃ kutsāyāṃ
caturthīvidhānaṃ saṃpadyata iti matvāha---na tvā tṛṇāyeti|
ṭhmanyakarmaṇyanādara upamāne vibhāṣā prāṇiṣu' iti āpiśaliradhīte
sma, na tatra pratiṣedhāpekṣā, tathā ca bhaṭṭiprayogo nidarśanīyaḥ|
aśmānaṃ ddaṣadamityādi| tatvākhyānametat| yasya mātā na paśyatīti|
darśanayogyam| vyavasthitavibhāṣā ceti| nanu yeṣu prāṇiṣu
neṣyate, te nāvādayo bhaviṣyantīti kiṃ vyavasthitavibhāṣayā?
vṛttikāra evātra sākṣātprayojanaṃ vakṣyati| 
natvā nāvamiti| nāvā tāryamudakaṃ nāvyaṃ tadyadaiva tīrṇaṃ tadaiva
nāvamapi santīṃ tvāṃ nāhaṃ nāvaṃ manye, prayojanasya niṣpannatvāditi
bhāvaḥ| evaṃ yāvannabhuktaṃ śrāddhimityatrāpi draṣṭavyam| prāṇiṣu
tūbhayamiti| viṣayavibhāgena| etadapīti| etadeva
sākṣātprayojanamanyatra nāvāditvādeva siddherityavocāma||
kartṛkaraṇayostṛtīyā|| 2|3|18 ||
kartṛkaraṇayostṛtīyā|| prakṛtyābhirūpa iti| kriyāyā
aśravaṇātkartṛkaraṇayorabhāvātṣaṣṭhī prāpnoti|
prāyeṇa yājñika iti| prāyaśabdo bahvarthaḥ, bahavo yājñikā ityarthaḥ|
gārgyo'smīti| prathamā ṣaṣṭhī vā prāpnoti| sameneti| atra dvitoyā
prāpnoti| dvidroṇeneti| dvayordroṇayoḥ samāhāro dvidroṇaṃ
pātrādiḥ, dvau droṇau kṛtvetyarthaḥ, atrāpi dvitīyā prāpnoti|
pañcakeneti| pañca pātrādiḥ, dvau droṇau kṛtvetyarthaḥ, atrāpī
dvitīyā prāpnoti| pañcakeneti| pañca parimāṇamasya pañcakaḥ saṅghaḥ,
tatra saṃghasaṃghinorabhedavivakṣāyāṃ
paśūnityanenaitatsamānādhikaraṇamityatrāpi dvitīyaiva prāpnoti|
sāhasreṇeti| sahasraparimāṇaḥ saṃghaḥ sāhasraḥ| sarvamanyatpūrvavat|
ityupasaṃkhyānamārabhamāṇasyābhiprāyaḥ|
pratyākhyānaṃ tu---iha tāvatprakṛtyābhirūpa iti gamyamānāpi kriyā
karaṇādivyapadeśasya nimitam| iha ca karotikriyā gamyate,
karaṇāntaravyudāsāya ca prakṛteḥ karaṇatvaṃ vivakṣitaṃ
svabhāvenāyamabhirūpaḥ kṛtaḥ, na vastrālaṅkārādinetyarthaḥ|
prāyeṇetyayamarthaḥ---asmin grāme ye viprāḥ santi te bāhulyena
yajñamavīyata iti tatra yājñikaśabdābhidheyamadhyayanaṃ prati bāhulyasya
karaṇatvaṃ saṃdhībhūya yajñamadhīyata iti tatra yājñikaśabdābhidheyamadhyayanaṃ
prati bāhulyasya karaṇatvaṃ saṃdhībhūya yajñamadhīyata ityarthaḥ| iha tarhi
kathaṃ viśiṣṭaveṣaṃ kaṃcit ddaṣṭvādhyavasyati---prāyeṇāyaṃ yājñika
iti?
atrāpyayamarthaḥ----asmistāvadyājñikānāmācārādibāhulyamupalabhyate,
ato'nenācārādibāhulyena yājñiko'yaṃ janairjñāyata iti| tatra
pratīyamānajñānaṃ prati karaṇatvam| kecit---prāyeṇaśabdo
vibaktipratirūpako nipāto jñātamityasyārthe vartate ityāhuḥ|
ddaśyate ca prāyeṇa sāmagryavidhau guṇānāmiti, prāyeṇa niṣkrāmati
cakrapāṇāviti ca| gātreṇeti| anenāhaṃ jñāye iti
jñānakriyāyāmasmīti bhavanakriyāyāṃ vā gotrasya karaṇatvam|
sameneti| patho gamane karaṇatvaṃ samena pathetyarthaḥ| dvidroṇeneti|
dvidroṇādyarthe mūlye dvidroṇādiśabdastasya ca krayaṃ prati kāraṇatvam,
dvidroṇādīnāṃ ca mūlyam, tena dvidroṇādyeva krīyate
ityarthabhedo'pi nāsti||
sahayukte'pradhāne|| 2|3|19 ||
sahayukte'pradhāne|| kriyāguṇadravyairdvayoḥ sambandhe sati sahaśabdasya
prayogo bhavati, ataḥ ṭhputreṇa sahagataḥ pitāḥ' ityādīni
kriyādisambandhe yathākramamudāhaṇānyupanyastāni| nanvatra sarvataḥ
sahārthasvabhāvādeva pituḥ putrasya vā gamanādinā sambandhaḥ pratīyate,
tatkutaḥ pituḥ prādhānyam? kecidāhuḥ----yasya kriyādisambandho
viśiṣṭakālaḥ prajñātaḥ sa yadānyasyāprajñātaviśiṣṭakālakriyāsambandhasya
tatpratipādanārthamupādīyate, yathā---ṭhayaṃ puruṣaḥ kadāgataḥ'
ityapekṣāyām ṭhrājñā sahāgataḥ' iti puruṣāgamanaṃ
viṣiṣṭakālamupapādayituṃ vākyaṃ pravartata iti puruṣasya prādhānyam,
rājñastūpalakṣaṇatvenopātatvādaprādhānyamiti| evaṃ tu ṭhbhṛtyaiḥ saha
rājāgataḥ' ityatra na syād, na hi bhṛtyāgamanaṃ prasidvakālaṃ yena
tatkālatvaṃ rājāgamanasya pratipādyeta| yatra
cobhayorapyajñātakriyādisambandhastatrāpi na syāt---putreṇa sahāgataḥ
piteti| tasmādvaktavyamaprādhānyamata āha----pituratretyādi| pūrvaṃ
prajñāto'prajñāto vā yasya kriyādisambandhaḥ śabdenocyate tasya
prādhānyam| yasya tu sahārthānyathānupapatyā pratīyate
tasyāpradhānyam|
kasya tunaḥ śabdenocyate? kasya vā pratoyate? yasya vivakṣyate|
etaduktaṃ bhavati---dvayostāvatkriyāsambandhe sati sahaśabdasya prayogaḥ,
tatra yadā dvayorapi kriyādisambandhaḥ śabdenocyate--sahāgatau
pitāputrāviti, tadā dvayorapi prādhānyānna bhavati; yadā tvekasya
kriyādisambandhaṃ śabdena pratipipādayiṣatyaparasya
sahārthānyathānupapatyā tadā tasyāprādhānyātadvācinastṛtīyeti| evaṃ
ca kṛtvā saha śākhayā prastaraṃ praharatīti yadyapi prastarasya
praharaṇasambandhaḥ prajñātaḥ, sūktavākena prastaraṃ praharatīti,
śākhāyāstvajñātaḥ; tathāpyuktena nyāyena śākhāśabdātṛtīyā
siddhyatīti vibhaktivyatyāso na vācyaḥ| nanu putreṇa sahāgata
ityādau pitureva kartuḥ ktādibhirabhidhānam, na tvapradhānasya
putrādestasyāpi tu sahārthasāmarthyātkartṛtvaṃ
pratīyata--ityanabhihite kartṛkaraṇayoriti tṛtīyā siddhā| iha tarhi
putreṇa sahāgamanaṃ pituriti ṭhkartṛ karmaṇoḥ kṛti' iti ṣaṣṭhī
prāpnoti, iha ca tilaiḥ saha māṣānvapati
tilānmāṣānvapatītyarthapratīterddhitīyā prāpnoti, iha ca putreṇa saha
sthūlaḥ, putreṇa saha gomāniti dravyaguṇasambandhapratipādana eva
tātparthamiti kriyāgandhasyaivābhaavātkartṛgandho'pi
nāstītyārabhyamevāvaśyaṃ sūtram| sahārthena yoge vidhānāditi|
yuktagrahaṇādarthagrahaṇaṃ labhyate, anyathā ṭhsahe pradhāne' ityeva vācyaṃ
syāt| vināpi sahaśabdena vṛddho yūnoti nipātanāditi
kvacitpaṭha|lte|
ihāpradhānavacanaṃ pradhānanivṛtyartha kriyate, pitustṛtīyā mā
bhūditi; tatra prātipadikamātrāpekṣatvādantaraṅgatvātprathamā
bhaviṣyati, nārtho'pradhānavacaneneti manyamānaḥ pṛcchati---ū pradhāna
iti kimiti| śiṣyeṇa sahopādhyāyasya gauriti| yathātrāpradhāne
ṣaṣṭhīviṣaye tṛtīyā, evaṃ pradhāne'pi syāditi manyate|
atrāhuḥ----yathā grāmaṃ na gacchatītyādau grāmagamanayoḥ
pūrvamabhisambandhaḥ praścānnañā prati ṣidhyate, evamupādhyāyasya pūrvaṃ
gavā sambandhaḥ paścātatsambandhaviṣiṣṭasya goḥ sahārthena yogaḥ; anyathā
kasya sahatvaṃ pratipādyeta, ato gavā sambandhasyāntaraṅgatvā
dupādhyāyāt ṣaṣṭhī bhaviṣyatīti nārtha etena||
yenāṅgavikāraḥ|| 2|3|20 ||
yenāṅgavikāraḥ|| aṅgaśabdo'vayavavācī prasiddha; tataścāyaṃ
sūtrārthaḥ syād---yena guṇenāṅgasyākṣyādervikārastatastṛtīyeti,
tataścākṣi kāṇamasyetyādāveva tu syāt, kāṇāderguṇavacanādeva ca
syād; akṣṇā kāṇa ityādāvakṣyāderna syādityālocyānyathā
vyācaṣṭe--aṅgaśabdo'tretyādi| arśa ādyacpratyayāntaḥ
śarīravacano'ṅgaśabdaḥ sūtre upāta ityarthaḥ| yeneti ca
yadapekṣamaṅgino'ṅgitvaṃ sa hetutvena nirddaśyate,
hetutvenetivadanyeneti hetau tṛtīyeti darśayati|
vikṛteneti| sāmarthyādevaitallabhyate, na hyavikṛtamaṅgamaṅgino
vikāraṃ prati hetuḥ| akṣṇā kāṇa iti| kathaṃ punaḥ puruṣaḥ kāṇaḥ
yāvatākṣidharmaḥ kāṇatā, tenākṣyeva kāṇaṃ bhavati na puruṣaḥ?
ityāha---avayavadharmeṇeti| tadevaṃ yadaṅgagato vikāro'vayavadharmaḥ
samudāya āropādaṅginaḥ pratipādyate, tatra yadaṅgagato
vikārastatastṛtīyā bhavati| kathaṃ punarakṣiśabdaḥ prayujyate, yāvatā
kāṇaśabdo'kṣigatameva vikāramācaṣṭe, tatra kāṇo devadata ityukte
naiva saṃdeho bhavati---kiṃ svayameva kāṇaḥ, kiṃ vākṣṇaḥ
kāṇatayeti,nāpyevaṃ saṃdehaḥ----kimakṣṇaḥ kāṇatayāsau kāṇaḥ, kiṃ
vā pādasyeti,tadanarthako'kṣiśabdasya prayogaḥ? evaṃ pādena khañjaḥ,
pāṇinā kuṇirityādau pādādīnām? ucyate---akṣyādyaupakrame
vākye'kṣṇetyukte na jñāyate kiṃ nirūpayati? kiṃ vā kāṇa iti? tatra
nirūpayatyādinivṛtaye kāṇaśabdaprayogaḥ, yathā---dvāvānaya kau tau
dvāvityukte brāhmaṇāvati| aṅgavikāra iti kimiti| aṅgagahaṇaṃ prati
praśnaḥ| kvacitu tathaiva pāṭhaḥ| akṣi kāṇamasyeti| nanvatra paratvātprathamā
bhaviṣyati, na; asatyaṅgrahaṇe'vaiva syāt mukhyo hyatra vikāraḥ|
udāharaṇe tu gauṇaḥ, avayavadharmasyāvayavinyāropāt||
itthambhūtalakṣaṇe|| 2|3|21 ||
itthambhūtalakṣaṇe|| idaṃśabdātsannihitavācinaḥ prakāravacane thāl,
ṭhidamasthamuḥ' iti thamupratyaye kṛte itthamiti bhavati| na cātra
kiñcitsannihatamastītītthaṃśabdaḥ sannihitaparityāgena
prakāraviśeṣamācaṣṭe, ṭhbhū prāptāvātmanepadī ca',ṭhā dhṛṣādvā' iti
ṇijabhāvapakṣe gatyarthatvātkartari ktapratyayastadāha--kañciditi|
tasyeti karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī| lakṣyate yeneti lajñaṇam| yena
śvetacchatrādinā rājatvādiprakāraviśeṣāpannatayānyo lakṣyate
taditthambhūtalakṣaṇam| tatreti| vartamānādityarthaḥ| kamaṇḍalunā
chāttropādhyāyayorgacchatośchātrasya haste kamaṇḍalurbhavati,
kamaṇḍalunā chāttro'yamiti jñātavānityarthaḥ| yadyevam, īddaśe jñāne
kamaṇḍaloḥ karaṇatvādeva tṛtīyā siddhyati? evaṃ tarhi pramātā
pramiti daśāyāmevātmanaḥ pramitiviśeṣaṃ pratipādayituṃ vākyaṃ
prayuṅkte--kamaṇḍalunāyaṃ chātra iti, tadā jñānakriyāyā
apratibhāsādapratipādyatvācca karaṇatvāsambhavaḥ| udāharaṇaṃ tvevaṃ
vyākhyeyam---kamaṇḍalunā chātra ityevaṃ rūpaṃ jñānamabhūditi|
ko'rthaḥ? adrākṣīditi nidiṣṭasya draṣṭuarjñānaviśepo'tra kathyate, na
prayokturityarthaḥ| 
iha kamaṇḍalupāṇiśchātra iti bahuvrīhau kṛte kamaṇḍaluśabdātṛtīyā
prāpnoti; na ca pratyalakṣaṇenāpratyaya iti prātipadikasaṃjñāpratiṣedhaḥ,
ṭhna ṅisaṃbuddhyoḥ' iti liṅgat; na ca ṭhsupo
dhātuprātipadikayoḥ' iti saṃpratyutpannāyāstṛtacīyāyā luglabhyate,
tasyāḥ samāsprātipadikaṃ pratyanavyavatvādityata āha---iha na bhavatīti|
samāse'ntabhūtatvāditi| samāsārthaṃ prati guṇabhūtatvādityarthaḥ|
itthambhūtasya lakṣaṇaṃ yatpradhānaṃ tatra tṛtīyā| bahuvrīhau tu
vartipadānāṃ svārthopasarjanānyapadārthābhidhāyitvānnāsti
prādhānyam||
saṃjño'nyatarasyāṃ karmaṇi|| 2|3|22 ||
saṃjño'nyatarasyāṃ karmaṇi|| saṃjānīta iti| ṭhsaṃpratibhyāmanādhyāne'
ityātmanepadam, ṭhjñājanorjā' iti jādeśaḥ| ādhyāne tu
ṭhadhīgarthadayeśām' iti ṣaṣṭhī bhavati---mātuḥ saṃjānātīti|
kṛtprayoge tvanādhyāne'pi paratvātṭhkartṛ karmaṇoḥ kṛti' iti
ṣaṣṭhī bhavati---mātuḥ saṃjñāteti||
hetau|| 2|3|23 ||
hetau|| ṭhtatprayojako hetuśca' śāstrīyasya hetoścakāreṇa
kartṛsaṃjñāvidhānātkartṛkaraṇayorityeva tṛtīyāyāḥ
siddhatvāllaukikau heturgṛhyata ityāha---phalasādhanayogya ityādi|
loke hyaṅkurādikāryotpādane
yogyatāmātraprayukto'nāśritavyāpāro dravyaguṇakriyāviṣayo
bījādirhetuḥ| uktaṃ ca----
dravyādiviṣayo hetuḥ kārakaṃ niyatakriyam| iti|
anāśrite tu vyāpāre nimitaṃ heturucyate|| iti ca|
udāharaṇeṣu kriyāyā abhāvātkaraṇatvamanāśaṅkanīyam| yūpāya
dārvityatra tādarthya vivakṣitam, na tu sadapi hetutvamiti
dāruśabdāt prathamaiva bhavati||
akartaryṛṇe pañcamī|| 2|3|24 ||
akartaryṛṇe pañcamī|| bandhita iti| bandherṇyantasya niṣṭhāntasya
rūpam' śatamṛṇaṃ ca bhavatīti| utamarṇāya dhāryamāṇatvāt|
prayojakatvācca kartṛsaṃjñakamiti| ṭhtatprayojako hetuśca' iti
cakāreṇa kartṛ saṃjñāvidhānāt| nanu ca pūrvasūtre laukikasya
hetorgrahaṇam, ayaṃ tu śāstrīyaḥ; śāstrīyasyāpi laukikatvamastyeva|
atha vā kasya hetoḥ pūrvasūtre śāstrīyasyāgrahaṇam---kartari siddhā
tṛtīyeti? na tvevam, pañcamyā asiddhatvādihārthameva sāmānyagrahaṇaṃ
syāt||
vibhāṣā guṇe'striyām|| 2|3|25 ||
vibhāṣā guṇe'striyām|| ṭhsatve niviśate'paiti' iti lakṣitasya
guṇasya grahaṇam; tadanurūpatvādudāharaṇapratyudāharaṇayoriti
kecit| anye tu ṭhparvato vahnimān dhūmavatvāt' ityādāvanenaiva
pañcamīmicchantaḥ paratantramātrasya grahaṇaṃ varṇayanti, yathā---yasya hi
guṇasya bhāvāditi| ṭhvibhāṣā guṇe' iti yogavibhāgāt ṭhnāstīha
paṭo'nupalabdheḥ' iti striyāmapi kvacidbhavati|
kecitvapādānapañcamīmetāmicchanti, tathā ca ṭhnāstīha
ghaṭo'nupalabdhitaḥ' iti ṭhapādāne cāhīyaruhoḥ' iti tasilapi
bhavati, yogavibhāgavādināṃ tvādyāditvātasiḥ||
ṣaṣṭhī hetuprayoge|| 2|3|26 || 
ṣaṣṭhī hetuprayoge|| hetuśabdasyeti| prayogasya
śabdadharmatvādevamuktam, na tvanenārthagrahaṇaṃ vyāvartyate;
yaryāyaprayoge'pi ṭhnimitakāraṇahetuṣu' iti vakṣyamāṇena ṣaṣṭha|la
iṣṭatvāt| hetuśabdasya prayoge sati hetuhetumadbhāvalakṣaṇasyaiva
sambandhaviśeṣasya niyamena pratītau ṭhhetau' iti tatīyāpavādo
yogaḥ||
sarvanāmnastṛtīyā ca|| 2|3|27 ||
sarvanāmnastṛtīyā ca|| ṭhsarvanāmnaḥ' iti prayogāpekṣā ṣaṣṭhī|
sarvanāmnī hetuśabdasya ca prayoga iti| pañcamyāṃ tu hetuśabdādayaṃ
vidhirna syāt| kathaṃ tarhi sarvanāmnastṛtīyā bhavatīti? atrāpi
sarvanāmnaḥ prayoga ityartho draṣṭvyaḥ|
nimitakāraṇahetuṣviti| yadyapyasmin sūtra idaṃ vṛttikāreṇa
paṭhitam, bhāṣyakāreṇa tu ṭhhetau' ityatra
paṭhitatvādasarvanāmno'pyetadvibhaktividhānaṃ gamyate, tatra ca
prāyagrahaṇādevāsarvanāmnaḥ prathamādvitīye na bhavataḥ, anyāstu
yathādarśanaṃ bhavanti---annena kāraṇena vasati, annāya kāraṇāya vasati,
annātkāraṇād, annasya kāraṇasya, anne kāraṇe iti|
paryāyopādānaṃ tviti| nanu viparītamidaṃ svarūpavidhau
paryāyopādānaṃ kartavyam, arthagrahaṇe tu na kartavyamiti; kiṃ
cārthagrahaṇe satyekaśeṣaprasaṅgaḥ, virūpāṇāmapi
samānārthānāmekaśeṣavacanāt? evaṃ manyate---yathā ākṛtigameṣu
kecidupalakṣaṇārthaṃ paṭha|lnte, evamihāpi svarūpaparā eva
nimitādiśabdā upalakṣaṇārthāḥ----evamarthānāṃ śabdānāmiti||
apādāne pañcamī|| 2|3|28 ||
apādāne pañcamī|| prāsādāditi| atra lyabantasyāprayoge'pyartho
gamyata iti dvitīyā prāpnoti| 
āsanāditi| saptamyatra prāpnoti| pratyākhyānaṃ tu---prekṣaṇamucakṣuṣā
padārthānāṃ jñānam, taijasaṃ cakṣurbahirniḥ sṛtya viṣayān gṛhṇāti,
niḥsaraṇāṅgake ca prekṣaṇe dhāturvartate, tatrāṅgabhūtaniḥ saraṇaṃ
prati prāsāda upātaviṣayamapādānaṃ bhavati---prāsādātprekṣata iti,
korthaḥ? prāsādapradeśāccākṣuṣaṃ tejo niḥ sārya padārthān
gṛhṇātīti|
praśnākhyānayośceti| viśiṣṭe praśnākhyāne gṛhyaete yatra loke
pañcamī prayujyate| iha na bhavati--kasyāyamartho rājño'rtha iti| kuto
bhavāniti| kriyāyā abhāvādanapādānatvāt
phalavadvacanapratyakṣādipramāṇasiddhāmāgamanādikriyāmapekṣyedaṃ
prayujyate, tatra prayokturākhyātuśca manasi viparivartamānamāgamanaṃ
pratyapekṣitakriyamapādānam---pāṭaliputrāditi|
yataśceti| yadavadhitvenāśrityādhvakālayoḥ paricchedastata ityarthaḥ|
gavīdhumannāma nagaram, sāṃkāśyaṃ tapovanam|
kṛtikāyuktā paurṇamāsī kārtikī, paurṇamāsyām ṭhlubaviśeṣe'
iti lubna bhavati ṭhsāsminpaurṇamāsī' ityadhikāre ṭhvibhāṣā
phalgunīśravaṇākārtikīcaitrībhyaḥ' iti nirdeśāt| agre hāyanamasyā
ityāgrahāyaṇī, prajñāderākṛtigaṇatvātsvārthiko'ṇ,
ṭhāgrahāyaṇyaśvatthāt' iti nipātanāṇṇatvam| tadyau ktāditi| tena
pañcamyantārthenārthadvāreṇa yuktātkāle
vartamānānmāsādiśabdādityarthaḥ| yadvā---tayā pañcamyā yukto
yo'rthaḥ kārtikyādistataḥ paro yaḥ kālo māsādistatra
vartamānādityarthaḥ| arthataśca paratvaṃ na śabdata iti vyavahite'pi
bhavati, kārtikyāgrahāyaṇyormadhyavartī māsaḥ kārtikyāḥ paro bhavati|
adhvana iti| tadyauktādityapekṣyate| pratyākhyānaṃ tu-vākyaikadeśasyātra
prayogaḥ| tadayamarthaḥ----gavīdhumato niḥsṛtya yadā catvāri
yojanāni gatāni bavanti tataḥ sāṃkāśyam, caturṣu yojaneṣu
gateṣu satsu sāṃkāśyamitiṣa gatāniti ka karmaṇi niṣṭhā, yadā
janairyojanāni gatāni bhavanti tatastaiḥ sāṃkāśyaṃ prāpyata ityarthaḥ|
yadvā----adhvavartināṃ niḥ saraṇaṃ gamanaṃ vādhvanyāropya niḥsṛtya
gatāniti lyapaḥ kartari ktasya ca prayogaḥ tasya pratīyamānaniḥ
saraṇakriyāpekṣapāpādānatvam, gatānīti ca
prātipadikārthasyāvyatirekātprathamā gateṣu satsviti ṭhyasya ca
bhāvena bhāvalakṣaṇam' iti saptamī, āgrahāyaṇī māma iti kārtikyāḥ
paratra māse gate sati āgrahāyaṇī bhavatītyarthaḥ| tatra digyogalakṣaṇā
pañcamī, saptamī pūrvavat||
anyārāditarartedikśabdāñcṛtarapadājāhiyukte|| 2|3|29 ||
anyārāditarartedikśabdāñcṛtarapadājāhiyukte|| anya
ityathegrahaṇamiti| vyākhyānāt| nirddiśyamānapratiyogīti| yathā
devadatayajñadatayoḥ prakṛtayorāha---devadataḥ śūraḥ, itaraḥ kātara
iti; tasyānyārthāntarbhāvo'stīti cintyam| ṛte yajñadatāditi|
kathaṃ yatkiñcidrājasūyamṛte somamiti? chāndasatvāt, kathaṃ ṭhna
māmṛte rāma bālī'iti? kva karma pradhvastaṃ phalati puruṣārādhanamṛte'
iti ca? niraṃkuśāḥ kavayaḥ|
śabdagrahaṇamiti| sati hi tasmin diśi ddaṣṭaḥ śabdo dikśabda
ityutarapadalopī samāso labhyate, tena yadā kadāciddiśi ddaṣṭena
saṃprati deśakālavartināpi yoge bhavati---grāmātpūrvo
deśaścaitrātpūrvaḥ phālguna iti| avayavavācibhistu yoge na
bhavati---pūrva kāyasyeti, ṭhtasya paramāmreḍitam' iti nirdeśāt|
nanu cāyamapīti| sadh«aṅ
devadatenetyādāvadikśabdārthamañcūtarapadagrahaṇaṃ na bhavati,
dikśabdaiḥ sāhacaryādasyāpi dikśabdasyaiva grahaṇāditi bhāvaḥ|
dakṣiṇeti| ṭhdakṣiṇādāc' ; āhi ca dūre' utarācca' ityājāhī
pratyayau||
ṣaṣṭha|ltasarthapratyayena|| 2|3|30 ||
ṣaṣṭha|ltasarthapratyayena|| atra tasyaternañpūrvasya kvipyatasiti
rūpasambhave'pi pratyakṣaśrutatvātpratyayāpratyayaparibhāṣayā ca pratyayasyaiva
grahaṇamiti siddhaṃ nārthaḥ pratyayagrahaṇena| purastāditi|
ṭhpūrvādharāvarāṇāmasipuradhavaścaiṣām' ṭhastāti ca' iti
pūrvaśabdasya purādeśaḥ| uparya pariṣṭāditi| ūrdhvaśabdasyopaśabda
ādeśo rilriṣṭātilau pratyayau bhavataḥ, ṭhtataḥ paścāddhastī' iti
bhāṣyakāraprayogātpañcamī|| 
enapā dvitīyā|| 2|3|31 ||
enapā dvitīyā|| ṭhtatrāgāraṃ
dhanapatigṛhādutareṇāsmadīyam'---stryadhikārātpareṇa
vāsarūpavidhinā'vaśyaṃ bhavati, tataḥ pareṇa nāyamanuvartata ityādīnāṃ
cintyaṃ sādhutvam||
pṛthagvinānānābhistṛtīyānyatarasyām|| 2|3|32 ||
pṛthagvinānānābhistṛtīyānyatarasyām|| anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇena pakṣe
yathāprāptasyābhyanujñānāt tṛtīyayā mukte śeṣatvātpakṣe ṣaṣṭhī
prāpnoti| atha syādanekārthatvā nnipātānāmanyatarasyāṃgrahaṇaṃ
samuccayārtham, na vikalpārthamiti? evamapyanantarā dvitīyā
samuccīceta| athāpi yogavibhāgenāsyā api siddhiḥ, evamapi
tadanantarā ṣaṣṭhī samuccīyeta na kathañcana pañcamī, sā ceṣyate,
tatkathamityāha---pañcamīgrahaṇamiti| iheti| na pūrvayoryogayoḥ
maṇḍūakagatayo'dhikārā bhavanti, yadyanuvṛttisāmarthyātpañcamī,
anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇaṃ tarhi kimartham? samuccayārtham| tatra kiṃ
samuccīyate? ityapekṣāyām ṭhpañcamīgrahaṇamihānuvartate' ityucyate|
yogavibhāgaḥ kartavya iti| asatyapi munitrayavacane
prayogabāhulyādevaṃ vyākhyātam||
karaṇe ca stokālpakṛcchrakatipayasyāsatvavacanasya|| 2|3|33 ||
karaṇe ca stokālpakṛcchrakatipayasyāsatvavacanasya|| yadā
dharmamātramiti| yadyogād dravyaṃ stokādivyapadeśamāsādayati te
guṇā dharmāḥ, ubhayavacanā hyaete dravyamāhurguṇaṃ ca śuklādivat| yadā
guṇavacanāstadā'satvavacanatetyarthaḥ| kriyāviśeṣaṇe karmaṇīti|
ākhyātena hi kriyā sādhyamānāvasthocyate---calati, calanaṃ
karotīti| atastadviśeṣaṇaṃ stokādi karma bhavati---stokaṃ calanaṃ
,karotīti| evaṃ tu viśeṣyavacanasstokaśabdo dravyavacana iti nātra
prasaṅgaḥ| yatra ca phalāntaraṃ sāvyaṃ prati dhātvarthaḥ karaṇatayā
vivakṣyate tatra viśeṣaṇatvaṃ na syāt--śobhanaṃ jyotiṣṭomena
svargakāmo yajeteti| atra hi yathā phalabhāvanāyāṃ karaṇabhūtasya
yāgasyābhidhāyakād jyotiṣṭomaśabdāt tṛtīyā bhavati, tathā
tadviśeṣaṇācchāebhanaśabdādapi syāt|
anyastvāha---saṃdarśanaprārthanādhyavasāyairāpyamānatvātkriyāyāḥ
karmatvāt tadviśeṣaṇasya karmatvaṃ syāditi tasyāpi saṃdarśanādīnāṃ
kriyāyāścābhedavivakṣāyāṃ karmatvaṃ na syād, na hi tatra kriyāyāḥ
karmatvamasti||
dūrāntikārthaiḥ ṣaṣṭha|lntarasyām|| 2|3|34|| 
dūrāntikārthaiḥ ṣaṣṭha|lntarasyām|| pakṣe pañcamyarthe vacanam, ṣaṣṭhī tu
śeṣatvādeva siddhā| yadyovam, anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇamanarthakaṃ
ṣaṣṭhīmātravacane vaiyyarthyādeva prakṛtā pañcamī vidhāyiṣyate,
tatrāha---anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇamiti| vacanasāmarthyāddhi prakṛtavidhāne
vijñāyamāne tṛtīyāyā api vidhiḥ syāt| nanu kṛtamapyanyatarasyāṃ
grahaṇaṃ vikalpārtham, samuccayārtha vā; vikalpārthe tāvat ṣaṣṭha|la
mukte svādisūtreṇā prāptāḥ sarvā eva vibhaktayaḥ syuḥ,
samuccayārthe'pi prakṛtā tṛtīyā kasmānna samuccīyate?
ucyate---ṭhpṛthagvinānānabhiḥ' ityatra tāvad ṭhanyatarasyāṃgrahaṇena
pañcamī samuccīyate' ityuktam, ata ihāpyekapraghaṭṭakatvātsaiva
samuccīyate| ata etadapi na codanīyam---ṭhanyatarasyāṃgrahaṇe prakṛte
punaranyatarasyāṃgrahaṇaṃ kimartham' iti; tatrāpi hi pakṣe tṛtīyā
syāt||
dūrāntikārthebhyo dvitīyā ca|| 2|3|35 ||
dūrāntikārthebhyo dvitīyā ca|| prātipadikārthe vidhānamiti|
arthāntarasyānirddeśāditi bhāvaḥ| nanvanirdeśe'pyarthāntarasya
śeṣaviṣaye pūrvavibhaktiviṣaye ca vidhānametadyaḥktam, prathamāviṣaye
tu paratvātsaiva prāptoti? neṣa doṣaḥ; utaratrāpyetadanuvartate,
tenotaravibhaktiviṣaye'pi sarvatra yathābhidhānaṃ bhavati| tathā ca
dūrādāvasathānmūtramityadhikaraṇe'pi bhavati----āvasathasya dūra
ityarthaḥ| prātipadikārthe vidhānamityetatadāhṛtaviṣayaṃ draṣṭavyam|
tathā ca---ṭhsatvavacanebhyo yathāyathaṃ vibhaktayo bhavanti' iti vakṣyati,
pratipadikārtha eva tu vidhāne yathāyathamityanupapannam, prathamaiva
bhavatīti vācyaṃ syāt||
saptamyadhikaraṇe ca|| 2|3|36 ||
saptamyadhikaraṇe ca|| ktasyenviṣayasyeti| innantaḥ śabdo viṣayo
vṛttibhūmiryasyaktāntasya tasyetyarthaḥ| adhītī vyākaraṇa iti|
adhītamaneneti vigṛhya śrāddhamanenabhuktamityato'neneti vartamāne
ṭhiṣṭādibhyaśca' itīnipratyaye kṛte taddhitārthena kartrā
sahaikībhūtasyādhītasya niṣkṛṣya vyākaraṇādinā sambandhābhāvāt
ktapratyayenānabhihite vyākaraṇādau guṇabhūtayāpi
prakṛtivācyayā'dhyayanakriyayā'dhītavān vyākaraṇamitivat karmatayā
sambandhamāne kṛtapūrvī kaṭamitivad dvitīyāyāṃ prāptāyāṃ saptamī
vidhīyate| iha māsamadhītī vyākaraṇa iti
kālakarmaṇorbahiraṅgatvātsaptamyabhāvaḥ|
sādhurdeavadato bhātarīti| atra
sādhutvāsādhutvayormātāpitṛviṣayatve'pi kriyāyā
abhāvādadhikaraṇatvābhāvādvacanam| ṭhsādhunipuṇābhyām' ityeva
siddhe'narcārthamatra sādhugrahaṇam, tena tatvakathane'pi bhavati|
arcāgrahaṇaṃ tatra nipuṇārtham| kathaṃ tarhi tatra
pratyudāhariṣyate--arcāyāmiti kiṃ sādhurbhṛtyo rājña iti?
ucyate,rājñau bhṛtyena saha śābdo'nvayaḥ, na sādhunā---rājño bhṛtyaḥ
sa sādhuriti| tatra rājani vānyatra veti naitacchabdena spṛśyate,
pratyāsatyā tu rājaviṣayameva sādhutvaṃ gamyata ityetāvatā taṃ
pratyudāharaṇaṃ draṣṭavyam|
kārakārhāṇāmiti| kārakaśabdo bhāvasādhanaḥ,
kārakatvārhāṇāmityarthaḥ| ṛddheṣviti| ṛddhā bhojanakriyāmarhantīti
kārakarhāḥ, lakṣyalakṣaṇabhāvāvivakṣāyāmapi yathā syāditi vacanam|
daridreṣvāsīneṣviti daridrā bhoktuaṃ nārhantītyakārakārhāḥ|
tadviparyāse ceti| kārakārhāṇāmakārakatve'kārakārhāṇāṃ ca
kārakatva ityarthaḥ|
nimitātkarmayoga iti| yat kriyāprayojanaṃ yadarthaḥ
kriyārambhastatphalamiha nimitam, tadvācinaḥ saptamī bhavati| yadi tasya
nimitasya karmaṇā karturīpsitatamena saha samavāyādilakṣaṇaḥ
sambandho bhavatītyarthaḥ, tatra hetutṛtīyāyāṃ prāptāyāṃ vacanam, tatra
hantikarmaṇā dvīpyādinā carmādernimitasya samavāyaḥ sambandhaḥ|
camarīmiti| camaraśabdājjātilakṣaṇo ṅeṣ| puṣkalakaḥuśaṃkuḥ, sa
sīmni sīmājñānārtha hato nikhāta ityarthaḥ, tena ca nihanyamānena
śaṅkunā sīmnaḥ saṃyogaḥ sambandhaḥ| karmasambandha iti kim? vetanena
dhānyaṃ lunāti||
yasya ca bhāvena bhāvalakṣaṇam|| 2|3|37 ||
yasya ca bhāvena bhāvalakṣaṇam|| iha bhūyo darśanāśrayo
lakṣyalakṣaṇabhāvaḥ, yathā---agnidhūmayoḥ, tataścodita āditye tamo
naṣṭam, udite candramasi samudraḥ pravṛddha ityādāveva syād; tvagniṣu
hūyamāneṣu gata ityagnihavanaṃ yadā gamanena saha punaḥ punarna
ddaṣṭacanaṃ tadā na tatasya lakṣaṇamitīha na syādityāśaṅkyāha---prasiddhā
ca kriyeti| prasiddhireva kriyāyāḥ kriyāṃ prati lakṣaṇatve upayujyate,
na punardarśanam, etaduktaṃ bhavati---nirjñātakālā kriyā anirjñātāyā
kriyāyāḥ sakṛdapi kālaparicchedahetutvenopātā bhavatyeva
lakṣaṇamiti||
ṣaṣṭhī cānādare|| 2|3|38 ||
ṣaṣṭhī cānādare|| ṭhanādare' iti pūrveṇa saptamī, etacca
bhāvalakṣaṇabhāvasya viśeṣaṇam, yaścānādare sati bhāvalakṣaṇaḥ,
so'nādarādhiko bhavatītyāha---anādarādhika iti|
anādaraviṣiṣṭe'nādriyamāṇa ityarthaḥ| rudataḥ prāvrājīditi|
pitrādikasye rodanamanāddatya pravrajyāṃ kṛtavānityarthaḥ||
svāmīśvarādhipatidāyādasākṣipratibhūprasūtaiśca|| 2|3|39 ||
svāmīśvarādhiparidāyādasākṣipratibhūprasūtaiśca|| gavāṃ dāyāda iti|
dīyata iti dāyaḥu aṃśaḥ, dāyamādata iti sopasargādapi dāyāda iti
nipātanātkaḥ| gavāmityetatsamudāyasya viśeṣaṇamavayavamapi
dāyāṃśaṃ spṛśatīti gavātmakasya dāyasyādātetyayamartho bhavati|
gavāṃ prasūta iti| gā evānubhavituṃ jāta ityarthaḥ||
āyuktakuśalābhyāṃ cāsevāyām|| 2|3|40 ||
āyuktakuśalābhyāṃ cāsevāyām|| āyukto gauḥ śakaṭa iti|
āṅīṣadarthe īṣadyaukta ityarthaḥ||
yataśca nirdhāraṇam|| 2|3|41 ||
yataśca nirdhāraṇam|| jātiguṇakriyābhiriti| pradarśanametat|
amīṣāṃ chātrāṇāṃ devadataḥ paṭuariti saṃjñayāpi
nirdhāraṇadarśanāt||
pañcamī vibhakte|| 2|3|42 ||
pañcamī vibhakte|| vibhaktamasyāstīti| nirddhāryamāṇāt| etaduktaṃ
bhavati---nirddhāryamāṇasya nirddhāraṇāśrayasya ca vibhāge sati
nirddhāraṇaṃ bhavati, tataśca sarvatraiva nirddhāraṇāśraye vibhaktamastīti
sāmarthyādavadhāraṇamāśrīyate---yasminnirdhāraṇāśraye vibhāga eva, na
kenacidātmabhāva iti| tena gavāṃ kṛṣṇetyādau yadyapi
gomaṇḍalātkṛṣṇā gauḥ pṛthak kriyate, tathāpi
gavātmanāntarbhāvo'stīti na bhavati| udāharaṇe cu
māthupāṭaliputreṣu prāṇitvenāntarbhāve'pi
śabdopātākārāpekṣayānantarbhāvādvibhāga eva bhavati| pratyākhyātaṃ
caitatsūtramapādānaprakaraṇe---
buddhyā samīhitaikatvātpañcālān kurubhiḥ pṛthag|
yadāḥ vibhajate vaktā tadā'pāyaḥ pratīyate|| iti||
sādhunipuṇābhyāmarcāyāṃ saptamyaprateḥ|| 2|3|43 ||
sādhunipuṇābhyāmarcāyāṃ saptamyaprateḥ|| sādhuśabdaḥ ṭhkṛvāpājimi'
ityuṇantaḥ, ṭhpuṇa karmaṇi śubhe' ityasmānnipūrvāt ṭhigupapadha' iti
ke, nipuṇa iti bhavati| ṭharca bhāvyam'
ityasmādbhauvādikātṭhgurośca halaḥ' ityakāraḥ, caurādikātu
yucā bhāvyam| apraterityatra prayoga ityadhyāhāryam, tadāha---na
cetpratiḥ prayujyata iti sādhurmṛtyo rā5 iti| pūrvamevaitad
dūṣitamupapāditaṃ ca| nipuṇaḥ putro māturiti tu tatatvakathane
nyāyyaṃ pratyudāharaṇam||
prasidotsukābhyāṃ tṛtīyā ca|| 2|3|44 ||
prasidotsukābhyāṃ tṛtīyā ca|| ṭhṣiñ bandhane' prakarṣeṇa
baddhaḥūuprasitaḥ, tadāha---yastatranityamavabaddha iti nityamityanena
praśabdasyārthamācaṣṭe| avabaddha ivāvabaddhaḥ, yo hi yatra prasaktaḥ sa
tatrāvabaddha iva bhavatīti bhāvaḥ| tena prakaṣaṇa mitaḥ śuklatara ityasya
grahaṇaṃ na bhavatīti pradarśitaṃ bhavati| keśeṣu prasita iti| tatpara
ityarthaḥ|
nakṣatre ca lupi|| 2|3|45 ||
nakṣatre ca lupi|| nakṣatre prakṛtyarthe sati yo lupsaṃjñayā lupyamānasya
prakyayasyārthastatra vartamānāditi sūtrākṣarānvayaḥ|
yaccocyate---nakṣatre lupītita pañcamyarthe saptamī
lubantānnakṣatravācina ityartha iti, tatrotarābhyāṃ phalgunībhyāṃ notarā
gacchediti viśeṣaṇānnasyāt, tasyālubantatvāt| kathaṃ tarhi
lubantānnakṣatrābhidhāyinaḥ śabdāditi vṛttiḥ?
prāyovṛtyaitaduktam---lubantārthābhidhāyī prāyeṇa lubanto bhavati|
lubarthābhidhāyinaḥ śabdamātrādityarthaḥ| lubantāditi| lubante
samāptāvasyeti bahuvrīhiḥ, sthānirvārakaṃ ca lupo'ntyāvayavatvaṃ
draṣṭavyam|
adhikaraṇa iti vartata iti| evaṃ ca puṣpaṃ pratīkṣate, puṣpāya
spṛhayati, puṣpasya samīpa ityādāvapi na bhavati||
prātipadikārthaliṅgaparimāṇavacanamātre prathamā|| 2|3|46 ||
prātipadikārthaliṅgaparimāṇavacanamātre prathamā|| prātipadikāthaḥ
sateti| atra jighṛkṣitasyedaṃ lakṣaṇam, na prātipadikārthamātrasya;
gauḥ, śuklaḥ, pācakaḥ, ḍittha ityādāvasambhavāt| yo'rthaḥ sanneva
kevalaṃ na jātyādirūpo na liṅgasaṃkhyākārakaśaktiyogī, sa iha
prātipadikārthatvena vivakṣitaḥ, yathā---avyayārtha ityarthaḥ| avyayārtho
hi kevalamastīti śakyate vaktum, na punarīddaśastāddaśa iti| gauḥ
śukla ityādau tu satvarūpe'rthe liṅgagrahaṇādeva siddhyatīti
bhāvaḥ|
anye tvāhuḥ----anvayavyatirekābhyāṃ yasya yo'rthaḥ pratīto yamarthaṃ
prātipadikaṃ na vyabhicarati yena vinā prātipadikasyāprayogaḥ, sa
sarvaḥ prātipadikārthaḥ| satāgrahaṇaṃ tūpalakṣaṇam, tena satā gotvaṃ
śoklyaṃ śuklo guṇaḥ pācako ḍittho gauḥ śukla
ityādikamapyudāharaṇamiti| nanvatra sarvatra liṅgagrahaṇādeva siddham,
na; mātragrahaṇaṃ kriyate, taccāvadhāraṇārtham, payomātraṃ
vratayatītivat| tataśca strī pumānnapuṃsakamityādāveva tu
syād---yatra liṅgamevārthaḥ, satetyādau tu
jātyādyavikārthasadbhāvānna syāt| atha kanyāmātraṃ
varayatītivanmātraśabdasya vyāptivacanatvālliṅgamātre prathamā
liṅgamastītyeva prathamā bhavatīti vyākhyānādadhikārthasadbhāve'pi
prathamā bhavatīti? ucyate---hantaivaṃ vṛkṣaṃ paśyetyādau
karmādisadbhāve'pi caliṅgamastītyeva prathamā syāt; karmaṇyeva
dvitīyetyasminpratyayaniyamapakṣe karmādīnāṃ
dvitīyādiṣvaniyatatvāt! vacanamekatvādīti|
pūrvācāryaprasiddheriti bhāvaḥ|
uccairiti| atra prathamāyāṃ satyāṃ grāma uccaistava svamityādau
ṭhsapūrvāyāḥ prathamāyā vibhāṣā' iti temayādivikalpo bhavati,
padatvaṃ tu ṣaṭha|lapi siddham, yasmin hyarthe dvitīyādayo na vihitāḥ
sa śeṣaḥ| nanvasaṅkhyatvādavyayārthasya kathaṃ ṣaṣṭhī syāt?
ekatvādyarthaniyame ṣaṭhayāḥ saṅkhyāyāmaniyatatvāt, pratyayaniyame'pi
tulyajātīyāpekṣatvānniyamasyaikatvādibhiḥ parasparameva
vyāvartanāt| vidhivākyapakṣe tu svādisūtreṇa bhinnavākyasya ṭhbahuṣu
bahuvacanam' ityādeḥ saṅkhyāsambhave vidhyarthatvāt|
nanu ṅyāpprātipadikātsvādayo vidhāsyante, tatrārthe prathametyukte
kasyārtha ityapekṣāyāṃ yasmātsvādividhistadartha iti vijñāsyate,
nārthaḥ prātipadikagrahaṇena,tatrāyamapyarthaḥ---liṅgagrahaṇaṃ na kartavyaṃ
bhavati kumārī sīmetyādāvapyata eva siddham, prātipadikagrahaṇe tu
kriyamāṇe sīmādiśabdānāṃ strīyuktārthāvyabhicāre'pi
pratyayāntatvenāprātipadikatvātadarthe prathamāsiddhyarthaṃ liṅgagrahaṇaṃ
kartavyaṃ syāt? ucyateprātipadikagrahaṇaṃ
tāvadarthapadenāsambaddhamityatraiva vakṣyate,
liṅgahaṇamanekaliṅgārtham--taṭaḥ, taṭam, taṭī; kumāraḥ,
kuṇḍam, kuṇḍaḥ, kuṇḍikā; anyathā yenārthena vinā
prakṛteraprayogastadarthamātre vidhīyamānā prathamā
nānāliṅgebhyastatadviśeṣamantareṇa prayujyamānebhyo na syāt| atha
mātragrahaṇamakṛtvā vyāptivacanaṃ vāṅgīkṛtyādhikārthasadbhāve'pi
prakṛtyarthasyānvaya iti syāt? yadyevam, vṛkṣaṃ paśyetyādau
karmādyādhikye'pi syātpratyayaniyamapakṣe, tadiha vṛtau kumārī,
kuṇḍamityudāharaṇam, vṛkṣaśabdastvarthādudāhṛtaḥ| nanu mā
bhūnmātragrahaṇam, mā ca bhūlliṅgagrahaṇam, mā ca kāri ṭhsaṃbodhane
ca' iti sūtram, sarvatrārtha ityeva prathamā bhaviṣyati; na caivaṃ
karmādiṣvapi prasaṅgaḥ, karmaṇi
dvitīyevetyevamarthaniyamasyāśrayaṇāt? evamapi ṭhrājñaḥ puruṣaḥ' iti
ṣaṣṭha|lrthe'pi syāt, śeṣalakṣaṇā hi ṣaṣṭhī, upayuktādanyaśca śeṣaḥ, tatra
yadi prakṛtyarthasyādhikye'pi prathamā syāt| tatastasyāpi
prathamāvidhāvupayuktatvātṣaṣṭhī na syāt| atha
vacanasāmarthyātsvasvāmibhāvādau ṣaṣṭhī bhavantī liṅgādhiko'pi
syād| ato mātragrahaṇaṃ tāvatkartavyam, tasmiṃśca kriyamāṇe
liṅgagrahaṇam, ṭhsaṃbodhane ca' iti sūtraṃ ca kartavyam;
tadādhikye'pi yathā syāditi|
parimāṇagrahaṇaṃ kimiti| artha iti vā liṅga iti vā siddhiṃ manyate|
droṇaḥ, khārīti| ayaṃ bhāvaḥ----yenārthena vinā
prakṛteraprayogastasminnarthe prathamā| droṇādayaśca lauhaṃ dārumayaṃ
parimāṇamevārtha na vyabhicaranti| yadā tu droṇādiparimite
vrīhyādau vartante tadā tasya vyabhicāritvānna syāt| na ca
liṅgagrahaṇādapi siddhiḥ----tadādhikyamātre hi tena syāditi,
parimāṇagrahaṇaṃ conmānādīnāmupalakṣaṇam, tena ghṛtaṃ
palamityādāvapi bhavati| atha lavaṇena saṃsṛṣṭaḥ, lavaṇaḥ sūpaḥ, lavaṇaṃ
śākamityatra kathaṃ prathamā, lavaṇaśabdo hi lavaṇajātīyameva dravyaṃ na
vyabhicarati, vyabhicarati tu saṃsṛṣṭam?
ucyate---sādhāraṇaśabdo'yam, lavaṇajātīyasya saṃsṛṣṭasya
cākṣādiśabdavat| evaṃ ca ṭhlavaṇālluk' iti vacanādvijñāyate| tatra
yathā dadhidādikaśabdayoḥ prathamā bhavatyevamatrāpi bhaviṣyati| iha tarhi
kathaṃ śuklaḥ paṭa iti, śuklaśabdo guṇameva na vyabhicarati,
vyabhicarati tu tadvantam, paṭasya śukla iti darśanāt? atrāpi
ṭhguṇavacanebhyo matupo lug vācyaḥ' iti vacanātsādhāraṇaśabdataiva|
iha tarhi kathaṃ gaurvāhīka iti, gośabdo hi sāsnādimantameva na
vyabhicarati, vyabhicarati tu vāhīkam? atrāpi vāhīke
sāsnādimadrūpāropādrośabdaḥ prayujyate, tatra yathā
sāsnādimadvṛterbhavatyevaṃ vāhīkavṛterapi bhaviṣyati| yadyevam,
droṇaḥ khārītyādāvapyevameva bhaviṣyati,
lavaṇādiśabdavatsādhāraṇaśabdāḥ syuḥ gaurvāhīka ityādivadrauṇā vā,
gaṅgāyāṃ ghoṣa itivallākṣaṇikā vā; nānyā gatirasti, sarvathā
siddhā prathamā| kiṃ ca parimeyavṛttibhyo dvitīyādayo yathā bhavanti
tathā prathamāpi bhavati| atha prasthena parimitā vrīhaya ityevaṃ
prātipadikārthavyatireke'pi yathā syāditi parimāṇagrahaṇam|
yadyevam, prastheneti tṛtīyā na syāt, śeṣavivakṣāyāṃ ca ṣaṣṭhī na
syāt, prāstika iti taddhitaśca na syāt tadetatparimāṇagrahaṇaṃ
cintyaprayojanam|
ukteṣvapīti| anyathānabhihitādhikārāt ṭhbahuṣu bahuvacanam'
ityādināsyaikavākyatvātiṅkṛtaddhitasamāsairiti parigaṇanasya
pratyākhyātatvādekādiśabdairekatvādīnāmabhihitatvāduktārthatvād
vā na syāditi bhāvaḥ| ekaḥ dvo bahava iti| atha kathamekaṃ
kṛtamityādau dvitīyādayo bhavanti, na hi tatra kaścidyatno'sti?
ucyate, tatrārthadvayamasti---karmādayaḥ, ekatvādayaśca|
tatraikatvādīnāmabhidhāne'pi karmādipratipādanāya dvitīyādayo
bhaviṣyanti; iha tvanabhihitārthāntarābhāvānna syāt|
nanvatrāpyekādibhiḥ śabdairekatvādiviśiṣṭṃa dravyamabhidhīyate
tatraikatvādiguṇasya niṣkṛṣyābhidhānāya prathamā bhaviṣyati, yathā
guṇopasarjanadravyavacanācchuklādiśabdātpravṛttinimitabhūtasya guṇasya
niṣkṛṣyābhidhāne bhāvapratyayaḥ---paṭasya śauklamiti| tadevaṃ
vacanagrahaṇamapi śakyamakartum|
prātipadikagrahaṇaṃ kimiti| ukto'tra praṣṭuarabhiprāyaḥ|
nipātasyānarthakasyeti| anyathārthābhāvānna syāditi bhāvaḥ| pralambata
iti| kiṃ punaratra prathamayā prārthyate? padatvam; ṣaṣṭha|lamapyetatsiddham,
tathā hi--karmādiṣu dvitīyādayo vihitāḥ praka-tyarthamātre prathamā,
tatra prakṛtyarthābhāve svasvāmibhābādirsabandhasadbhāve
