cāpayuktādanyatvātsiddhā ṣaṣṭhī| na ca tasyā ekatvādiṣu niyamaḥ;
uktotaratvāt| tadevamarthaliṅgamātre prathametyetāvadevāvaśyaṃ
kartavyam, mātragrahaṇamapi na kartavyam| karmādyādhikye kasmānna bhavati?
jñāpakāt, yadayam ṭhsaṃbodhane ca' ityāha| yadi hyādhikye'pi
syātadanartharka syāt| utarārthe hi ṭhsaṃbodhane sāmantritam' ityeva
vaktavyaṃ kiṃ yogavibhāgena! ihāvadhāraṇārthānmātragrahaṇāt
ṭhsaṃbodhane ca' iti jñāpakādvā''dhikye prathamayā na bhavitavyam, tataśca
ṭhvīraḥ puruṣaḥ' ityādau padasāmānādhikaraṇye
viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvasyādhikārthasya pratīteḥ prathamā na prāpnoti, na;
vākyārthatvāt| yadatrādhikyaṃ sa vākyārthaḥ, pūrva
svārthamātraniṣṭhābhyāmubhābhyāṃ prathamā vidhīyate,
paścātvākāṃkṣāvaśenānyonyānvaye viśeṣāvagatirupajāyamānā
bahiraṅgatvātprathamapravṛtaṃ saṃskāraṃ na bādhata ityarthaḥ|
apara āha---abhihite prathameti lakṣaṇaṃ kartavyam, tiṅadibhirabhihite
kartrādau vṛkṣastiṣṭhati, kṛtaḥ kaṭaḥ, śatyaḥ, prāptodako grāma
ityādau prathamā bhavatītyarthaḥ, tatra vīraḥ puruṣaḥ
ityādāvādhikye'pyabhihitatvātsiddhā prathameti| atra ko doṣaḥ? yatra
kriyā nāsti tatra na syāt---vṛkṣaḥ, plakṣaḥ| tatrāpi kriyā'sti, katham?
vṛkṣaḥ plakṣaḥ, astīti gamyate| iha tarhi prāsāda āsta iti sadikrayāyāḥ,
āsikriyāyāścaikamadhikaraṇaṃ prāsādākhyam, tacca sadipratyayena
ghañābhihitaṃ prasīdatyasminprāsāda iti āsipratyayena
tiṅanabhihitam, tatra sadipratyayena yadabhidhārna tadāśrayā prathamā
prāpnoti| yatra ca viśeṣaṇasaṃbandhe tātparyam---nīlamutpalaṃ na
raktamiti, tatrāpi na syāt; kriyāyā abhāvāt|
anyastvāha---tiṅsamānādhikaraṇe prathameti lakṣaṇaṃ tiṅntena
yatsamānābhidheyaṃ devadataḥ pacatīti, tatra prathamā; prāsāda āsta ityatra
tu vaiyadhikaraṇyātadabhāvaḥ, vīraḥ puruṣa ityādau cādhikye'pi
tiṅasāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ prati yogyatvādbhavatīti| atra ko doṣaḥ?
devadataḥ pacatīti devadataḥ pac laṭ iti sthite
yāvatiṅamutpattirnāsti
tāvatiṅasāmānādhikaraṇyābhāvātprathamaiveti niyamasyāpravṛtau
devadataśabdādaviśeṣeṇa vihitāḥ svādayaḥ sthitā iti
śatṛśānacornimitasyāprathamāsāmānādhikaraṇyasya vidyamānatvātāveva
syātām, tiṅaṃ tvābhāvaḥ syāt| na ca tiṅvidherānarthakyam;
tiḍādiṣu sāvakāśatvāt| prathamaiveti| niyamasyāpi sa eva viṣayaḥ
syāditi doṣa| pakṣe cāyaṃ doṣaḥ, katarasmin pakṣe? ṭhlaṭaḥ
śatṛśānacau' ityatra dvau pakṣau--aprathameti paryudāsaḥ,
prasajyapratiṣedho veti| tathā ṭhkarmaṇi dvitīyā' ityādāvapi prakaraṇe
dvaitaṃ bhavati--vibhakti niyamaḥ syāt, arthaniyamo veti;
tadyadārthaniyamaḥ paryudāsaścāśrīyate tadā'yaṃ doṣaḥ| katham? armaṇi
dvitīyevetyasmin niyame dvitīyādīnāmaniyatatvāt
prātipadikārthamātre'pi bhāvātadāśrayau śatṛśānacau prāpnutaḥ,
prasajyapratiṣedhe tu prathamāyā api tatra bhāvātadāśrayaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ
pratiṣedhaḥ pravartata iti na doṣaḥ; śatṛśānacorabhāvātiṅkṣu satsu
tatsāmānādhikaraṇyātprathamaiveti niyamena dvitīyādīnāṃ
vyāvartitatvāt| yadā tu dvitīyādīnāṃ karmādiṣu
niyamaḥ---karmaṇyeva dvitīyeti, tadā tadabhāve
tāsāmabhāvādaniyatāyāśca prathamāyāḥ sannidhānātparyudāse
prasajyapratiṣedhe ca nāsti śatṛśānacoḥ prasaṅgaḥ; tadabhāve ca
tiḍbhu satsu tatsāmānādhikaraṇyātatraiva prathamā bhavatīti niyamena
karmādiṣu prathamāvyāvṛttiriti na doṣaḥ|
nanu ca vibhaktiniyame karmādyabhāvena yadyapi dvitīyādīnāṃ
tatrābhāvastathāpi śeṣaṣaṣṭhī prāpnoti, tathā hi---yadi
tiṅasāmānādhikaraṇya eva prathametyasmānniyamātprāgeva dvitīyādivat
ṣaṣṭha|lpi niyatā syāt? syātatrāprasaṅgastasyāḥ| sā tu śeṣalakṣaṇā|
yatra ca vibhaktyantarasya niyamo na kṛtaḥ sa śeṣaḥ, tataśca
tiṅasāmānādhikaraṇyātprāk śeṣatvāt ṣaṣṭhī prāpnotīti
tatsamānādhikaraṇyācchatṛśānacāveva syātām| paryudāse
prasajyapratiṣedhe tu na doṣaḥ, prathamāyā api bhāvāt? satyam;
dvayorapi pakṣayoḥ paryudāse bhavatyeva doṣaḥ| bhāṣye tu
vibhaktiniyame paryudāse'pi na doṣa ityanāsthāvādaḥ pākṣika eṣa
doṣa ityatraiva tātparyam| kṣantavyaṃ ca
kiñcidudgranthābhidhānamityuparamyate||
sambodhane ca|| 2|3|47 ||
sambodhane ca|| ābhimukhyakaraṇamiti| yadvastu yenākāreṇa siddhaṃ tasya
tenākāreṇābhimukhīkaraṇaṃ sambodhanam, na tvekaśrutividhāviva
kasyacidarthasyānuṣṭheyatā pratyāyanam; vākyārtho hi saḥ|
abhimukhīkaraṇaṃ tu na vākyārthaḥ, yena vīraḥ puruṣa
ityādivadyadatrādhikyaṃ sa vākyārtha iti prathamā siddhyet| yasya
padāntarasaṃprayoge satyeva pratītiḥ sa vākyārthaḥ| iha tu
devadatetyetāvatyukte ābhimukhyakaraṇaṃ gamyate, ataḥ padārtha padārtha
evātrādhikyamiti ṣaṣṭha|laṃ prāptāyāmidaṃ vacanaṃ tadāha---tadadhike
prātipadikārtha iti| asiddhena cākāreṇābhimukhīkaraṇaṃ na
saṃbhavati---rājā bhava yudhyasva svāhendraśatrurvarddhasveti| he pacan
he pacamānetyādau śatṛśānacoḥ saṃbodhane vidhāne'pi
vibhaktirahitayostayoḥ kartrādyabhidhāna eva sāmarthyam; yathā loṭo
dvirvacananirapekṣasyetyanena prathamā bhavati| yadvā---abhihitaḥ
so'rtho'ntabhūtaḥ prātipadikārthaḥ saṃpanna iti pūrveṇa bhaviṣyati,
yogavibhāga utarārthaḥ||
sā''mantritam|| 2|3|48 ||
sāmantritam|| tadantaṃ yacchabdarūpamiti|
mahāsaṃjñākaraṇamanvarthasaṃjñāvijñānārtham--āmantraṇamāmantritamiti|
abhedopacārātatsādhane śabde vartate vibhaktyantena kevalayā
saṃjñāvidhau pratyayagrahaṇe tadantasya grahaṇamiti bhāvaḥ| udāharaṇeṣu
ṭhāmantritasya ca' ityādyaudātatvaṃ bhavati, seti vacanaṃ
prātipadikārthasūtreṇāpi saṃbodhane vihitā yā prathamā tadantasyāpi
saṃjñā yathā syāt---he pacan! he pacamāna!;asati tu tasmin
ṭhanantarasya vidhirvā pratiṣedho vā' ityanantarasūtravihitāyā eva
syāt||
ekavacanaṃ saṃbuddhiḥ|| 2|3|49 ||
ekavacanaṃ saṃbuddhiḥ|| he paṭo iti| saṃbuddhau ca ṭhhrasvasya guṇaḥ' iti
guṇaḥ, ṭhsuḥ saṃbuddhiḥ' iti vaktavye ekavacanagrahaṇameko'rtha ucyate
yena tāvanmātrasya pratyayasya saṃjñārtham; agnyathā prakramābhedāya
tadantasya syāt||
ṣaṣṭhī śeṣe|| 2|3|50 ||
ṣaṣṭhī śeṣe|| upayuktādanyaḥ śeṣaḥ, karmādayaśca
prātipadikārthaparyantā upayuktā ityāha---karmādibhyo'nya iti| nanu
na karmādibhyo'nyaḥ prātipadikārthasya vyatirakaḥ saṃbhavati, katham?
kriyāmantareṇa saṃbandhānupapateḥ, sarvatra syāstannimitānāṃ
karmādīnāṃ cāvaśyambhāvāt| tathā hi---rājñaḥ puruṣa iti rājā
kartā; rājā dravyaṃ puruṣāya dadātītyarthasaṃpratyayāt| vṛkṣasya
śākheti| lokaprasiddhyā vṛkṣo'dhikaraṇam, tārkikaprakriyayā tu
śākhā| devadatasya gaurityādau tu pratigrahaṇādau kartṛtvaṃ
pratīyate---devadataḥ pratigrahītā kretā vinimātā'pahartā veti;
ucyate, naṭasya śṛṇotītyatra tāvatkriyākārakasaṃbandharūpa eva śeṣaḥ,
katham? ṭhākhyātopayoge' ityupayogagrahaṇānnaṭasyāpādanasaṃjñā
nāsti, duhyādiparigaṇanāccākathitatve'pi karmasaṃjñā nāsti, tadayaṃ
naṭaḥ kārakameva śeṣaḥ| yaccoktam---kriyāyāstannimitānāṃ ca sarvatra
bhāvānnānyaḥ prātipadikārthasya vyatireka iti,
tanna;pratigrahakrayādijanyasya sarvalokaprasiddhasya
svasvābhibhāvādisaṃbandhasyāpi durapalāpatvāt| yadi ca
parasparamupakāryopakārakabhāve saṃbandhānupapateḥ
kriyākārakasaṃbandho'pi sarvatra vastusthityā'stītyucyet, astu
tathā, na kaściddoṣaḥ; na hi yadyadvastusthityāsti tatadabhidhātavyam,
yadeva tu vivakṣitaṃ tadeva svanimitāṃ vibhaktiṃ prasūte| tatra
svasvāmibhāvādisaṃbandhavivakṣāyāṃ sannapi kriyākārakasaṃbandho na
vivakṣyata iti dvitīyādyabhāve ṣaṣṭhī bhaviṣyati| evaṃ ca mātuḥ smarati,
na māṣāṇāmaśnīyāt, anukaroti bhagavato nārāyaṇasyetyādau
śrūyamāṇe'pi kriyāśabde mātṛsaṃbaddhaṃ smaraṇamiti saṃbandhamātraṃ
vivakṣitam, karmatvaṃ tu sadapyavivakṣitamiti ṣaṣṭhī bhavati| uktaṃ ca---
saṃbandhaḥ kārakebhyo'nyaḥ kriyākārakapūrvakaḥ|
śrutāyāmaśrutāyāṃ ca kriyāyāṃ so'bhidhīyate|| iti||
ṭhṣaṣṭhī śeṣe' iti cedviśeṣyasya pratiṣedhaḥ svasvāmibhāvādisaṃbandhaḥ
ṣaṣṭha|lrthaḥ, sa ca dviṣṭhaḥ| tatra yadyapyekasmādapyutpannayāpi ṣaṣṭha|la
dviṣṭhasyāpi saṃbandhasyāvagamādubhābhyāṃ ṣaṣṭhī na bhavati, tathāpi
kadācidviśeṣyādapi prāpnoti, prathamā ca na prāpnoti;
saṃbandhasyādhikasya bhāvāt, na vā vākyārthatvāt| yadatra
puruṣasyādhikyaṃ sa vākyārthaḥ, rājña ityetatpadasannidhānātpuruṣasya
saṃbandhaḥ pratīyate, puruṣaprātipadikaṃ tu svārthamātre vartata iti tatra
prathamā ca bhaviṣyati, ṣaṣṭhī ca na bhaviṣyatīti| etaduktaṃ bhavati---rājña
iti kevalapada uccāryamāṇe
saṃbandhitvamaniyatapratiyogikamavagamyate, puruṣapadasannidhau tu
saviśeṣasya pratītirityetāvat, tataścāniyataṃ svamapekṣya prathamameva
saṃbandhāśrayā ṣaṣṭhī bhavati| nanu ca ṣaṣṭhayuccāraṇānuccāraṇakṛto
yo viśeṣo'ṅga bhavān puruṣapadādapi ṣaṣṭhīmuccārayatu,
gaṃsyate sa viśeṣaḥ? naitatsuṣṭhūacyate, na hi śabdasya
bhāvābhāvābhyāmarthasya bhāvābhāvau kriyete, kiṃ tarhi? vidyamāna evārthaḥ
pratipipādayiṣitaśca vācakapadaprayoge heturbhavati| tatra guṇasya
paropakākatvena vivakṣitatvātadante ṣaṣṭhī bhavati, puruṣasya
tūpakāryatvātvātsvaniṣṭhatvena vivakṣitatvātprathamā bhavati| tatra ca
saṃbandho guṇe padaṃ nidhāya pradhānamapi spṛśati, guṇaśca
pradhānopakārāya pravṛto'nyathānupapate rūpāntaramāśrayati| pradhānaṃ
tu svaniṣṭhatvena na rūpāntaraṃ bhajate, uktaṃ ca----
dviṣṭho'pyasau parārthatvād guṇeṣu vyatiricyate|
tatrābhidhīyamānaḥ san pradhāne'pyupayujyate|| iti|
yadā tu puruṣasyāpradhānyaṃ rājñaśca prādhānyaṃ vivakṣyate, tadā
puruṣasya rājetyapi bhavatyeva; yadā ca rājñaḥ puruṣasya gṛhamiti
tatpuruṣasya gṛhādisaṃbandho vivakṣyate tadaikasyāpi vastuno
bhinnaviṣayo guṇapradhānabhāvo na viruddhyata iti dvābhyāmapi ṣaṣṭhī
bhavati| rājña iti hi ṣaṣṭha|la rājapuruṣayoreva saṃbandho'bhihitaḥ, na
puruṣasya gṛhasya ca| iha pañcake prātipadikārthe ṭhkarmaṇi dvitīyā'
ityādau cārthaniyamapakṣe śeṣagrahaṇaṃ śakyamakartum, katham?
karmādayo niyatāḥ, śeṣo'niyataḥ, tataśca svādisūtreṇa
dvitīyādiṣu ṣaṣṭha|laṃ ca śeṣe prāpteṣu ṣaṣṭhītyetāvadapyucyamānaṃ
niyamārthaṃ sampadyate---ṣaṣṭha|leva bhavatīti| yatra ca ṣaṣṭhī ca pratyayāntaraṃ
ca prāpnoti tatraivaṃvidadho niyama ityarthāccheṣa eva bhaviṣyatīti
utarārthameva tadavaśyaṃ śeṣagrahaṇaṃ kartavyam| trikapakṣe tu svārthe
ṣaṣṭhī mā bhūditi dvitīyādīnāmiva karmādiḥ śeṣo vācyatvena
vidhātavyaḥ| tathā pratyayaniyamapakṣe karmādīnāmaniyatatvāteṣvapi
ṣaṣṭha|laṃ prāptāyāṃ śeṣa eva ṣaṣṭhī na karmādiṣviti ṣaṣṭhīniyamārthaṃ
śeṣagrahaṇaṃ kartavyam||
jño'vidarthasya karaṇe|| 2|3|51 ||
jño'vidarthasya karaṇe|| asaṃdehārthaṃ vidarthasya jñaḥ karaṇa ityeva
vaktavye tadakaraṇādavidarthasyeti padaccedaḥ, lugvikaraṇaśca
vidirgṛhyate tadartha eva jānātervṛttisaṃbhavāt,
tadāha---avidartasyājñānārthasyeti| sarpiṣo jānīta iti| ṭhapahnave
jñaḥ' ṭhakarmakācca' ityātmanepadam| pravṛttivacana iti jñānapūrvikāyāṃ
pravṛtau vartamāna ityarthaḥ| sarpiṣi rakta iti| rāgo mithyājñānasya
hetuḥ, draupadyāṃ rakto hi kīcako rahasi
bhīmasenamāliṅgyāvocad---aho utamāṅganāmīddaśī
susparśateti| pratihito veti| pratighāto dveṣasya hetuḥ, dveṣaśca
mithyājñānasya hetuḥ, yo hi parihāsaśīlena
kenacitpūyādikamaśuci dravyaṃ nirddiśyoktaḥ----sarpiretatpibeti,
sa tatra pratihatastata ārabhya sarpidveṣṭi, dviṣataścātasminnapi
tajjñānamutpadyate| yadi sarvameva grāhyam, tadātmanā sarpiḥ svabhāvatayā
pratipadyate, evaṃ satyavidarthatvaṃ nopapadyate
tatrāha--mithyājñānameveti| jñānakāryākaraṇāditi bhāvaḥ|
aviplutaviṣayaparicchedo hi jñānakāryam, tacca mithyājñānena na
kriyate, asminpakṣe udakādikarmaṇāsakarmakatvād ṭhakarmakācca'
ityātmanepadānupateḥ parasmaipadamudāhāryaṃ manyate||
adhīgarthadayeśāṃ karmaṇi|| 2|3|52 ||
adhīgarthadayeśāṃ karmaṇi|| ṭhik smaraṇe' kakāro'traiva viśeṣaṇārthaḥ,
adhipūrvasyaivoccāraṇamevamevāyaṃ prayoktavya iti jñāpanārtham|
śeṣatvena vivakṣita iti| nanu śeṣatvena vivakṣite pūrveṇaiva siddhā
ṣaṣṭhī, yathā---na māṣāṇāmaśnīyād, anukaroti bhagavato
nārāyaṇasyeti? satyam, prakaraṇaṃ tu niyamārtham----asminviṣaye
ṣaṣṭhī bhavatyeva śrūyata eva na lupyata iti| kiṃ kṛtaṃ bhavati? samāso
nivartito bhavati---mātuḥ smaraṇamiti| evaṃ pūrvasūtre paratra ca
prakaraṇe sarvatra draṣṭavyam| samāse sati ṭhsupo
dhātuprātipadikayoḥ' iti ṣaṣṭhī lupyeta, tena pratipadavidhānaṣaṣṭhī
na samasyata iti siddhaṃ bhavati| kathaṃ tarhi viśeṣasmṛteḥ saṃśaya iti
samāsaḥ? ucyate; śeṣaṣṭha|la eva samāsaniṣedhaḥ iha tu ṭhkartṛkarmaṇoḥ
kṛti' iti karmarūpavivakṣāyāmeva ṣaṣṭhī samāso bhaviṣyati| kaḥ
punaratra viśeṣaḥ---śeṣaṣaṣṭhayāḥ samāsaḥ syāt, kārakaṣaṣṭha|la vā?
ayamasti viśeṣaḥ---kārakaṣaṣṭhayāḥ samāse kṛtsvaro bhavati,
śeṣaṣaṣṭhayāḥ samāse tu samāsāntodātatvaṃ syāt,
antodātasamāsanivṛtaye pkaraṇam| yatra ca kārakaṣaṣṭhī pratiṣidhyate,
yathā---mātuḥ smṛtamiti, tatra samāso'pi mā bhūt| evaṃ cātra
prakaraṇe ye'nupātāḥ, yāni cātra pratyudāharaṇāni, teṣūbhayeṣvapi
niṣṭhāyoge śeṣaṣaṣṭhayāḥ samāsaḥ, anyatra kārakaṣaṣṭha|la apīti
veditavyam| guṇairiti| guṇeṣu śeṣatvena vivakṣiteṣu asya
niyamasyābhāvātsamāso bhavatyevetyarthaḥ| iyamevāsminprakaraṇe
pratyudāharaṇagatiriti||
kṛñaḥ pratiyatne|| 2|3|53 ||
kṛñaḥ pratiyatne|| edhodakasyeti| ṭhjātiraprāṇinām'
ityekavadbhāvaḥ| upaskuruta iti| gandhanādisūtreṇātmanepadam|
ṭhupātpratiyatna'ityādinā suṭ||
rujārthānāṃ bhāvavacanānāmajvare|| 2|3|54 ||
rujārthānāṃ bhāvavacanānāmajvare|| ṭhrujo
bhaṅge'bhidādipāṭhādasmādeva nipātanādvā'ṅ| bhāvavacanānāmiti|
nāyamartho bhāvavācināmiti, dhātūnāṃ bhāvavācitvāvyabhicārāt|
kiṃ tarhi? bhāvaśabdena ghañādivācyaḥ siddharūpo bhāva ucyate| vacana iti
kartari lyuṭ| tatra prakṛtyartho na vivakṣyate, na hi rujārthānāṃ
bhāvo vaktā pratipādayitoccārayitā vopapaddāte| tasmātpratyayārtha
eva kartā vivakṣitaḥ--bhāvo vacanaḥ kartā yeṣāmityarthaḥ,
tadāha--bhāvakartṛkāṇāmiti| caurasyāmayatīti| ṭhama roge'
curādiḥ,ṭhnānye mito'hetau' iti curādau vacanāt
ṭhjanījṛṣknasurañjo'mantāśca' iti mitvaṃ na bhavati| ṭhjñapa micca'
ityārabhya ṭhnānye mito'hetau' itaḥ prāgye paṭhitāsta eva curādiṣu
mito bhavanti, nānya ityarthaḥ| āmaya iti āṅpūrvasya mīnāterec,
ṭhmīnātiminoti' ityātvasya ṭhnimimīlīyāṃ khalacoḥ' iti
pratiṣedhaḥ| nadīkūlaṃ rujatīti| atra nadī kartrī, na bhāvaḥ| nanu
rujāśabdo vyādhau rūḍha iti nātra prasaṅgaḥ? evaṃ tarhi
pratyudāharaṇadigiyaṃ darśitā, idaṃ tu pratyudāharaṇam---śleṣmā
puruṣaṃ rujatīti, vyādhinā kāsādinā grāhayatītyarthaḥ| jvarayatīti|
ṭhjvara roge' ghaṭādiḥ| santāpayatīti| ṭhhetumati ca' iti ṇic,
santāpo'tra bhāvaḥ, kartā ca||
āśiṣi nāthaḥ|| 2|3|55 ||
āśiṣi nāthaḥ|| nāthata iti| ṭhāśiṣi nāthaḥ'
ityupasaṃkhyānādātmanepadam, taccānudātetvādeva siddhe
niyamārtham---āśiṣyeva nātha iti, tena pratyudāharaṇe
parasmaipadam||
jāsiniprahaṇanāṭakrāthapiṣāṃ hiṃsāyām|| 2|3|56 ||
jāsiniprahaṇanāṭakrāthapiṣāṃ hiṃsāyām|| na daivādikasyeti| ṭhjāsi'
iti nirdeśād ṭhhisāyām' iti vacanācca niprābhyāṃ
yathāsaṃbhavamupasṛṣṭo hano niprahaṇaḥ, ṭhhanteratpūrvasya' iti
ṇatvam| praṇihantīti| ṭhnergada' ityādinā ṇatvam| ṭhnaṭa avasyandane'
curādiḥ, ṭhnaṭa nṛtau' ityasya tu ghaṭādipaṭhitasyāgrahaṇam,
vikṛtanirdeśāt| nipātanādvaddhiriti| ghaṭādipāṭhastu ṭhghaṭādayaḥ
ṣitaḥ' ityātideśiko'ṅyathā syāt,
ṭhciṇṇamulordīrgho'nyatarasyām' iti dīrghaśca yathā
syādityevamarthaḥ||
vyavahṛpaṇoḥ samarthayoḥ|| 2|3|57 ||
vyavahṛpaṇoḥ samarthayoḥ|| samarthayoriti| saṃśabdo vṛtau
samānārthaḥ, samaśabdasya vā nipātanātpararupamiti bhāvaḥ|
saṃbaddhārthayoriti tu na vijñāyate, vyākhyānāt| saṃbhavati hi
vyavahṛpaṇorhetuhetumadbhāvaḥ saṃbandhaḥ| śatasya vyavaharatīti| śataṃ
krayavikrayarūpeṇa viniyuṅkte, dīvyati vetyarthaḥ| śalākāṃ
vyavaharatigaṇayatītyarthaḥ||
divastadarthasya|| 2|3|58 ||
divastadarthasya|| atra ṭhśeṣa' iti nānuvartate,
utarasūtradvayārambhasāmathyat| itha pūrvasūtra eva divirapi kasmānna
paṭhitaḥ, evaṃ hi tadarthasyeti na vaktavyaṃ bhavati? tatrāha---yogavibhāga
iti||
vibhāṣopasarge|| 2|3|59 ||
vibhāṣopasarge|| śalākāṃ pratidīvyatīti| atra vijigīṣādau
divirvartate, na vyavahāre||
dvitīyā brāhmaṇe|| 2|3|60 ||
dvitīyā brāhmaṇe|| mantravyatiriko vedabhāgaḥūubrāhmaṇam| gāmasya
tadahaḥ sabhāyāmiti| gāmasya sabhāyāmityanvayaḥ|
tadaharityetadudāharaṇam, ṭhsvamornapuṃsakāt' iti luk, ṭhahan'
iti rutvam|
anupasargasya nityaṃ ṣaṣṭha|laṃ prāptāyāmiti| ṭhdivastadarthasya' ityanena'
atha sopasargasyāpi pūrveṇa ṣaṣṭha|lamapi prāptāyāṃ nityadvitīyārthaṃ
kasmānna bhavatītyāha--sopasargasyetyādi||
preṣyabruvorhaviṣo devatāsaṃpradāne|| 2|3|61 ||
preṣyabruvorhaviṣo devatāsaṃpradāne|| iṣyatedêavādikasyeti| ṭhiṣu
gatau' ityasya śyanā nirdeśa
icchatīṣṇātyoricchābhīkṣṇyārthayornivṛtyarthaḥ| tadviṣaya eveti|
loṇmadhyamaikavacanāntaḥ| devatāsaṃpradāna iti| devatā saṃpradānaṃ
yasyārthasya tatra vartamānayoḥ karmaṇi kāraka ityanvayaḥ| haviṣaḥ
havirviśeṣavācina ityarthaḥ| pre3ṣyeti| ṭhbrūhipreṣya' ityādinā
plutaḥ| agyaye gomayāni preṣyeti| gomayaṃ haviṣṭvena kvāpi na
coditam| haviṣaḥ prasthitasyeti| prasthitaśabdena yadviśeṣyate
tasyetyarthaḥ| idaṃ ca bhāṣāyāmapi bhavati; utaratra cchandograhaṇāt||
caturthyarthe bahulaṃ cchandasi|| 2|3|62 ||
caturthyarthe bahulaṃ cchandasi|| yā kharveṇeti| rajasvalāyāḥ
kharvapānādipratiṣedhārto'yamarthavādaḥ| tatarhi vaktavyam---ṣaṣṭha|lrthe
caturthīti? na vaktavyam, yogavibhāgātsiddham| caturthyartha iti nāyaṃ
samāsaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? caturthī artha iti yogo vibhaktavyaḥ,
ṣaṣṭhītyanuvartate---arthe ṣaṣṭhī bhavati, caturthī ceti, tatra svārtha eva
ṣaṣṭhīcaturthyorvidhānamanarthakamityanyo'nyasannidhānādanyo'nyārthe
vibhaktidvayaṃ vijñāyate||
yajeśca karaṇe|| 2|3|63 ||
kṛtvo'rthaprayoge kāle'dhikaraṇe|| 2|3|64 ||
kṛtvo'rthaprayoge kāle'dhikaraṇe|| kṛtvasuco'rtho lakṣyate,
kṛtvo'rtho yeṣāṃ te kṛtvo'rthāḥ| pañcakṛtva iti| ṭhsaṃkhyāyāḥ
kriyābhyāvṛttigaṇane kṛtvasuc' dviriti| ṭhdvitricaturbhyaḥ suc'
arthagrahaṇametadartham||
kartṛkarmaṇoḥ kṛti|| 2|3|65 ||
kartṛkarmaṇoḥ kṛti| iha kriyāyāḥ sādhanaṃ bhavatīti| kartṛkarmabhyāṃ
kriyā sannidhāpyate, dhātureva kriyāvācī, dhātośca dvaye
pratyayāḥ---kṛtastiṅśca| tatra tiṅprayoge ṭhna lokāvyaya' iti
lapratiṣedhena bhāvyam| sa cāvaśyaṃ lapratiṣedhaḥ kartavyaḥ, ye kṛto
lādeśāstadartham---odanaṃ pacan, odanaṃ pacamānaḥ papiḥ
somam,dadirgā iti, iha tu nārthaḥ kṛdgrahaṇeneti matvā
pṛcchati---kṛtīti kimiti| kṛtapūrvī kaṭamiti| nanu kṛtaḥ kaṭaḥ
pūrvamanenetyasminvigrahe ktasya karmaṇi vidhānātenaiva
karmaṇo'bhihitatvānnaiva dvitīyā bhāvyam, evaṃ ca tadapavādaḥ ṣaṣṭha|lpi
na prāpnoti; ihāpyanabhihitādhikārāt, kṛtaśabdasya ca kaṭāpekṣasya
samāso durlabhaḥ, etena taddhito vyākhyātaḥ, tasmādayamasādhureva
pyogaḥ? satyam, viśeṣavivakṣāyāṃ naiva samāsataddhitau bhavataḥ, yadā
tu kṛtaṃ pūrvamaneneti karmasāmānye bhāve vā kta utpadyate tadā
sāpekṣatvābhāvātsamāsaḥ, kena? ṭhsupsupā' iti, tataḥ
ṭhpurvādiniḥ',ṭhsapūrvācca'itīniḥ pratyayaḥ| na ca kaṭasya ktenābhidhānaṃ
karoterutpadyamānaḥ ktapratyayaḥ karmasāmānyamevāha,
viśeṣakarmasaṃbandhātu tasyābhidhānam, na cātra taddhitenaikārthībhūtasya
niṣkṛṣya kaṭena saṃbandhaḥ sambhavati, kriyayā tu guṇabhūtayā
kārakāṇāṃ sambandho bhavati, yathā---kaṭṃa kṛtavāniti|
kṛtapūrvīśabdaścāyaṃ pūrva kṛtamanetyasminnarthe vyutpāditaḥ pūrvaṃ
kṛtavānityanena samānārthaḥ saṃpadyate, tatra karotikriyāpekṣamasti
kaṭasya karmatvam, anabhihitaṃ ca taditi kṛdgrahaṇe ṣaṣṭhī syād|
yatra ca niṣṭhāntena śabdena kartṛkarmaṇoḥ saṃbandhastatraiva niṣṭhāśrayaḥ
pratiṣedhaḥ, yathā----kaṭṃa kṛtavān, kṛtaḥ kaṭo devadateneti, iha
tu kṛtasya kaṭena saṃbandho na bhavatītyuktameva| atha tu vastuto
niṣṭhānte pade dhātuvācyakriyāpekṣe ye kartṛkarmaṇī tayoḥ
pratiṣedhaḥ, tathā sati nedaṃ kṛdgrahaṇasya prayojanam, tenaitadapi
nirastam|
asati kṛdgrahaṇe, kaṭṃa kārayati pācayatyodanaṃ devadato
yajñadateneti ṇicprakṛteḥ pacerartha prati kartṛkarmaṇoḥ
ṣaṣṭhīprasaṅgaḥ| sati tu kṛdgrahaṇe, ṇico'kṛtvānna bhavatīti
kathamiva nirastam ṭhna loka' ityatra naivaṃ jñāyate---laprakṛtibhūtasya
dhātorye kartṛkarmaṇī iti, kiṃ tarhi? lānte pade yā kriyocyate
prādhānyena guṇabhāvena vā, tatra ye kartṛkarmaṇī tayoḥ ṣaṣṭhī na
bhavatīti tenedamapyaprayojanam|
atha syād--ṭhnalokāvyaya' ityatrāvyayaviśeṣaṇārthaṃ kṛdgrahaṇam,
tenoccaiḥ kaṭānāṃ spraṣṭetyatrākṛto'pyavyayasya prayoge
niṣedhābhāva iti, tadapi na; avyayena kartṛkarmaṇī
viśeṣayiṣyāmaḥ----avyayasya ye kartṛkarmaṇī tayoḥ ṣaṣṭhī neti, na
cākṛta uccaisaḥ kartṛkarmaṇī sambhavataḥ| iha tarhi karotīti kṛditi
kṛcchabdena kartocyate, tatra kartṛkarmaṇorityeva ṣaṣṭha|lamapi
siddhāyāṃ punarvidhānaṃ guṇabhūte'ti kartari yathā
syāt----bhedikādevadatasya yajñadatasya kāṣṭhānāmiti,
bhiderṇyantātparyāyādināṇvuc, atra ṇyarthasya
prādhānyātprayojakakartā pradhānam, prayojyakartā tu prakṛtyarthasya
guṇabhāvādguṇabhūta iti pradhānetarasannidhau pradhānādeva syāt,
kṛdgrahaṇādapradhānādapi bhavati, etadapi nāsti prayojanam;
tṛtīyāvat siddham, tadyathā---pācita odano devadatena
yajñadatenetyādau pradhānāpradhānayordvayorapi kartrostṛtīyā bhavati,
tatkasya hetoḥ? ekaśabdavācyatvābhāvena virodhābhāvāt tathā
ṣaṣṭha|lpi bhaviṣyati|
iha tarhi prayojanam, ṭhubhayaprāptau karmaṇi' iti bahuvrīhiryathā
syād, anyathānyapadārthasyānupātatvātatpuruṣaḥ syātatra cāniṣṭṃa
vakṣyate| yadyevam, utaratraiva kṛdgrahaṇam kartavyam, atha
vā---anupāte'pyanyapadārthe vyākhyānād bahuvrīhirbhaviṣyati,
yathā---ṭhekāco dve prathamasya' iti, tadetatkṛdgrahaṇaṃ
cintyaprayojanam|
kecidāhuḥ---ihaiva taddhitanivṛtyarthaṃ kṛdgrahaṇamiti prajānātiti
prajñaḥ prajña eva prājñaḥ ṭhprajñādibhyaśca'iti svārthike'ṇi kṛte vyākaraṇaṃ
prājña ityatra ṣaṣṭhī na bhavati| nanu kriyamāṇe'pi kṛdgrahaṇe
kasmādevātra na bhavati, yāvatā bhavatyeva kṛto'tra prayogaḥ,na
hyatraitacchakyaṃ vaktum---pratyayārthenaikārthībhūtasya kṛdantasya niṣkṛṣya
vyākaraṇena saṃbandho na sambhavatīti pratyayasya
svārthikatvenārthāntarābhāvāt? naiṣa
doṣa;kṛdgrahaṇasāmarthyātkṛdantenaiva yoge ṣaṣṭhī vijñāsyate, iha
tu kṛtā taddhitena caikarūpaḥ saṃbandha iti na
bhaviṣyatītyalamatikṣodena! 
śeṣa iti nivṛtamiti| tenāprāptā ṣaṣṭhī vidhīyata ityasyāḥ samāso
bhavatīti kṛdyogā ca ṣaṣṭhī samasyata iti na vaktavyaṃ bhavati||
ubhayaprāptau karmaṇi|| 2|3|66 ||
ubhayaprāptau karmaṇi|| ubhayaśabdena prakṛtatvātkartṛ karmaṇī
saṃbadhyete| ubhayaprāptāviti bahuvrīhiriti| na tatpuruṣaḥ| ubhayoḥ
kartṛkarmaṇoḥ ṣaṣṭhīprāptau satyāmiti| atra prayojanaṃ
vakṣyati---karmaṇyeveti| viparītastu niyamo na
bhavati---ubhayaprāptāveva karmaṇīti| evaṃ hi pūrvasūtre
karmagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syād, anenaiva viśiṣṭavidhānamāśrayaṇīyaṃ bhāvaḥ|
āścarya iti| sakarmakebhyo bhāve kṛti vihite karmaṇi kartari ca
ṣaṣṭhī prāptā niyamena karturapanīyate| prāptigrahaṇācca prāptimātre
niyama iti kartṛkarmaṇoḥ prayoge'pi kartari tṛtīyā bhavati,
ṭhantardhau yenādarśanamicchati' iti atra hyātmana iti
gamyamānatvādastyubhayoḥ prāptiḥ| atra ca ṭhanantarasya vidhirvā
pratiṣedho vā' iti kartṛkarmaṇoriti prāptirniyamyate, śeṣaṣaṣṭhī
tu karmaryati bhavatyeva| niyamasya prayojanaṃ pakṣe tṛtīyāśravaṇam|
karmāpi yadā śeṣatvena vivakṣyate tadā tatrāpi śeṣaṣaṣṭhī bhavatyeva|
tasyāśca ṭhkarmaṇi ca' iti niṣedhābhāvātsamāse'pi bhavati| niṣedhasya
tu prayojanaṃ kṛtsvaro mā bhūditi| etadapi sūcitam---pūrveṇa
ṣaṣṭhī prāptau niyamyata iti| āścaryamidamityetāvadekaṃ vākyam, kiṃ
tadityāha---odanarayeti| atra pāke odanasya karmatvam, prādurbhāve
ca brāhmaṇānāṃ kartṛtvamityanekatvātkṛdubhayaprāptirbhavati bhediketi|
paryāyādiṣu ṇvuc| cikīrṣeti| ṭha pratyayāt'| atrobhayatrāpi
kartari tṛtīyā na bhavati| ṣaṣṭhī tu śeṣavivakṣayāpi siddhyati|
samāso'pyatra bhavati---dharmajijñāsā devadatasya,
śiṣyasyācāryaśuśrūṣeti ṭhśeṣe vibhāṣā' iti| tatra yadā niyamena
kartari tṛtīyā tadā ṭhkarmaṇi ca' iti niṣedhātpāṇininā
sūtrakṛtiḥ, ācāryeṇa śabdānuśāsanamityasādhuḥ samāsaḥ; pāṇineḥ
sūtrakṛtiḥ, ācāryasya śabdānuśāsanamiti tu sādhuḥ||
ktasya ca vartamāne|| 2|3|67 ||
ktasya ca vartamāne|| rājñāṃ mata iti| ṭhmatibuddhipūjārthebhyaśca' iti
vartamāne ktaḥ| śeṣavijñānāditi| upasaṃkhyānaṃ pratyācaṣṭe, sadapyatra
chātrasya kartṛtvamavivakṣāyāṃ tirodhīyate, saṃbandhitvamātrameva tu
vivakṣiṣyate, tataśca na māṣāṇāmaśnīyaditivatsiddhā ṣaṣṭhītyarthaḥ|
tathā ceti| upasaṃkhyāne tvetanna siddhyatīti bhāvaḥ||
adhikaraṇavācinaśca|| 2|3|68 ||
adhikaraṇavācinaśca|| tasya ca prayoge ṣaṣṭhī vibhaktirbhavatīti|
yathāsambhavaṃ yatra kartaiva sambhavati tatra kartari--idameṣāmāsitamiti,
sakarmakebhyastvadhikaraṇe kte vihite dvayorapi
kartṛkarmaṇoranabhihitanvād dvayorapi ṣaṣṭhī bhavati---idameṣāṃ
bhuktamodanasyeti| ubhayaprāptau karmaṇītyayaṃ tu niyamaḥ
ṭhkartṛkarmaṇoḥ kṛti' ityasyā eva prāpteḥ| vācigrahaṇaṃ kim?
adhikaraṇa' ityucyamāne ktopalakṣaṇaṃ vijñāyeta,
tataścārthāntaravṛterapi dhrauvyāderutpannasya ktasya prayoge ṣaṣṭhī
syāt; vācigrahaṇe tu sati yadādhikaraṇaṃ karti tadaiva ṣaṣṭhī bhavati,
padārthāntare tadā kartari tṛtīyā karmaṇi dvitīyā
bhavati---ihaibhirāsitaṃ grāme gata iti; iha gatyarthe cātuśśabdyaṃ
bhavati--idameṣāṃ gatamityadhikaraṇe, idamete gatā iti kartari,
ihaibhirgatamiti napuṃsake bhāve, kartṛvivakṣāyāṃ
idameṣāṅgatamiti tatraiva śeṣavivakṣāyām||
na lokāvyayaniṣṭhākhalarthatṛnām|| 2|3|69 ||
na lokāvyayaniṣṭhākhalarthatṛnām|| jighṛkṣitarūpavināśaprasaṅgāt
tṛnāmityatra ṇatvābhāvaḥ| u uketi| anenokārapraślaṣaṃ darśayati| tatra
laśceti pūrvadvandve ukārasya pūrvanipātaḥ syāt, paranipāte'pi
lavuketi syāt; tasmātparayordvandvaṃ kṛtvā paścāllaśabdasya dvandaḥ
kāryaḥ, ukāreṇa ca kṛto viśeṣaṇātadantavidhiḥ,
vyapadeśivadbhāvātkevalasyāpi grahaṇam| śatṛśānacāviti| tena
śānajarthaṃ tṛnniti pratyāhāro nāśrayaṇīya iti bhāvaḥ| kikinau ceti|
nanu lagrahaṇena lakārāstadādeśāśca grahītuṃ yuktāḥ---kaṭṃa
kārayāñcakāra, odanaṃ pācayati; kikinostvayuktaṃ grahaṇam,
alatvādalādeśatvācca, naiṣa doṣaḥ; ṭhkikinau liṭ ca' ityanena
liṭtvātideśaḥ kriyate, na liṭsaṃjñā| tatra ṭhkārayām' ṭhpacānaḥ'
ityādau liṭi tadādeśe ca ddaṣṭaḥ pratiṣedha kikinorapi bhaviṣyati|
udāharaṇeṣu sarvatra kārakaṣaṣṭhayāḥ pratiṣedhaḥ| śeṣaṣaṣṭhī tu
bhavatyeva---brāhmaṇasya kurvan, odanasya pacan, apāṃ perurasi,
narakasya jiṣṇavo guṇaiḥ, tāni dviṣadvīryanirākariṣṇuriti|
āgāmukamiti| ṭhlaṣapatapada' itāyadinokañ, rakṣāṃsi vārāṇasīṃ
pratyāgamanaśīlāni bhavanti, śāpādimokṣārthamityarthaḥ| dāsyāḥ
kāmuka iti| dvitīyā nivṛtyartha vacanam, ṣaṣṭhī tu śeṣavijñānādeva
siddhā| purā sūryasyeti| ṭhbhāvalakṣaṇe' ityādinā tosun| visṛpa
iti| ṭhsṛpitṛdoḥ kasun' ṭhpūṅyajoḥ śānan'
ṭhtācchīlyavayovacanaśaktiṣu cānaś' ṭhiṅdhāryoḥ śatrakṛcchriṇi'
ityeteṣu ṭhla' iti nānuvartata iti sthāpayiṣyate, tena
lagrahaṇādasiddhiriti matvā''ha----tṛnniti pratyāhāragrahaṇamiti|
dviṣaḥ śaturvā vacanamiti| ṭhdviṣo'mitre' iti yo'yaṃ śatṛpratyayaḥ,
tatprayoge vikalpena pratiṣedho vaktavya ityarthaḥ| pratyākhyānaṃ tu
śeṣavivakṣāyāṃ ṣaṣṭha|lnyatra dvitīyeti, satā ca
samāsapratiṣedhātsamāse kṛtsvarārtha kārakaṣaṣṭhī vidheyetyapi
nāsti||
akenorbhaviṣyadādhamarṇyayoḥ|| 2|3|70 ||
akenorbhaviṣyadādhamarṇyayoḥ|| akasya bhaviṣyati kāle inastu
ādhamarṇye ceti| saṃkhyātānudeśastu vyākhyānānna bhavatīti bhādaḥ|
grāmaṃ gamīti| ṭhbhaviṣyati gamyādayaḥ' nanuca nātra ṣaṣṭhayāḥ prasaṃgaḥ,
katham? gatyarthakarmaṇītyatroktam---ṭhdvitīyāgraharagaṃ kim? na
cutarthyeva vikalpyeta, apavādaviṣaye'pi yathā syādgrāmasya
gantā' iti, satyam; śraute tāvat pratiṣedhe labhyamāne kiṃ
dvitīyāgrahaṇasāmarthyāśrayaṇeneti manyate||
kṛtyānāṃ kartari vā|| 2|3|71 ||
kṛtyānāṃ kartari vā|| kartaroti kimiti| ṭhtayoreva
kṛtyaktakhalarthāḥ' iti vacanādakarmakebhyo bhāve sakarmakebhyaśca karmaṇi
kṛtyānāṃ vidhānātkartureva tairanabhidhānaṃ sambhavatīti
kartṛkarmaṇordvayoradhikāre'pi kartayeva ṣaṣṭhī bhaviṣyatīti praśnaḥ|
geya iti| ṭhbhavyageya' ityādinā kartari yatpratyayaḥ| sāmnāmiti|
karmaṇi nityameva ṣaṣṭhī bhavati|
ubhayaprāptau kṛtya iti| ubhayo kartṛkarmaṇoḥ prāptiryasmin kṛtye
tatra dvayorapi kartṛkarmaṇoḥ ṣaṣṭhī na bhavatītyarthaḥ| kraṣṭavyeti|
kṛṣedvikarmakatvātpradhāne karmaṇi kṛtyapratyayaḥ, na tvapradhāna iti
tasmin karmaṇi kartari ca prāptā ṣaṣṭhī na bhavati|
etaccayogavibhāgāllabhyate, katham? kṛtyānāmityeko yogaḥ,
atrobhayaprāptau neti ca vartate, yugapadubhayaprāptīnāṃ kṛtyānāṃ
prayoge ṣaṣṭhī na bhavatītyarthaḥ; tataḥ kartari vā, atra
ṣaṣṭhītyevānuvartate, anyatsarvaṃ nivṛtam||
tulyārthairatulopamābhyāṃ tṛtīyānyatarasyām|| 2|3|72 ||
tulyārthairatulopamābhyāṃ tṛtīyā'nyatarasyām|| śeṣaviṣaye
vidhānāditi| śeṣaityadhikriyata iti bhāvaḥ| bahuvacananirdeśādeva
svarūpagrahaṇābhāve siddhe'rthagrahaṇaṃ padāntaranirapekṣā ye
tulyānāhustatparigrahārtham| tena dyotakā ivādayo nivartitā
bhavanti---gauriva gavayaḥ, yathā gaustathā gavaya iti| tulā
devadatasyeti| tulopamāśabdau karmasādhanau tulyārthau tatra
pratiṣedhyā tṛtīyā, ṣaṣṭhī tu bhavatyeva| iha ṭhsphuṭopamaṃ
bhūtisitena śambhunā' iti śmbhunā sphuṭopamā
yasyetyupamāśabdenāpi yoge karaṇe tṛtīyā bhavati,
bhāvasādhanatvātasya, yathā---upamīyate'nenetyādau; itarathā hi
tṛtīyānukṛṣyeteti tasyānantarasūtre śrutatvād anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇe
tu sati tasya prayojanāntarābhāvātadeva cakāreṇānukṛṣyate||
caturthī cāśiṣyāyuṣyamadrabhadrakuśalasukhārthahitaiḥ|| 2|3|73 || 
caturthī cāśiṣyāyuṣyamadrabhadrakuśalasukhārthahitaiḥ|| āyuṣyādīnāṃ
sukhaparyantānāṃ dvandvaṃ kṛtvārthaśabdena
bahuvrīhīvidhānādarthaśabdenāyuṣyādibhiḥ pratyekaṃ sambandhaḥ| tatra
madrabhadraśabdayoḥ paryāyatvātsūtre bhadraśabdo na paṭhitavya iti
kecidāhuḥ| anye tvarthaśabdo'pi pṛthageva nimitam, vyākhyānācca
sarvatrārthagrahaṇaṃ varṇayanti| vṛtāvapi kvacidarthaśabdo'pyudāhriyate| 
hitaṃ devadatasyeti| ṭhhitayoge caturthī vaktavyā' ityasyānāśiṣi
caritārthatvādāśiṣi hitayoge'pyanena vikalpena bhāvyam;
anyathā'tra hitagrahaṇamanarthakamiti manyate||
iti śrīharadatamiśraviracitāyāṃ padamañjaryā
dvitīyādhyāyasya tṛtīyaḥ pādaḥ||
-------------kāśikāvṛtaui padamañjarī
atha dvitīyādhyāye caturthaḥ pādaḥ
dvigurekavacanam|| 2|4|1 ||
dvigurekavacanam|| atra yadi pāribhāṣikamekavacanaṃ
gṛhyaetānuprayogata ekavacanaṃ na syān---pañcapūlīyaṃ śobhaneti,
tasyādvigutvād ṭhdvigoḥ' iti pañcamyā ca nirddeśaḥ syāt,
ato'nvarthasyaikavacanasyedaṃ grahaṇamiti matvā''ha---ekasya
vacanamekavacanamiti| vaktīti vacanam, ṭhkṛtyalyuṭo bahulam' iti
kartari lyuṭ, ekasyārthasya vacanamekavacanamiti karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhayāḥ
samāsaḥ| tatra caikasyārthasya vācarka bhavatīti sāmānyanopakramaḥ,
paścātkiṃ tadityapekṣāyāṃ dvigurityasya puṃlliṅgasya sambandha
ityekavacanamiti napuṃsakopapatiḥ| etadeva
vyanakti---ekasyārthasyeti| evaṃ ca dvigurekārthasya vācako bhavati|
yadi dvigvartha eko bhavati, na ca vastuto'nekārthasya
vacanaśatenāpyekārthatvāmāpādayituṃ śakyamiti sāmarthyādatideśo
vijñāyate, tadāha--tadanena prakāreṇeti| taditi vākyopanyāse
kimuktaṃ bhavatītyāhadvigvartha ekavadbhavatīti| samāhāradvigoścedaṃ
grahaṇamiti| tadvitārthe yo dvigustasyaikavadbhāvo mā
bhūdityevamartha pañcabhairgobhiḥ krītāḥ pañcagavaḥ paṭā iti| atha
kriyamāṇe'pi samāhāragrahaṇe iha kasmānna bhavati---pañcapūlī ca
pañcapūlī ca pañcapūlya iti,
śiṣyamāṇasyadvigutvātadarthasyaikavadbhāvaḥ prāpnoti? na vā;
bahiraṅgatvād, bahiraṅgo'yaṃ dvigvarthaḥ satyeva
dvigāvekaśeṣātpragabhāvādekaśeṣe sati
paścādupajāyamāntavādantaraṅge prāthamakalpike dvigvarthe caritārtha
ekavadbhāvo'tra na bhaviṣyati| yadyevam, pañcagavaḥ paṭā
ityatrāpyevameva bhaviṣyati? satyam; yadā paṭāḥ pratyekaṃ
pañcabhirgobhiḥ kritāḥ, yadā tu bahavaḥ paṭāḥ saṃhatāḥ pañcabhirgobhiḥ
kriyante tadā'yamekaśeṣasyāviṣayaḥ| yadi tarhi
samāhāradvigorgrahaṇam, nārtho'nena, katham? samāhāraḥu samūhaḥ,
tasyaikatvādyauuthaṃ vanamityādivadekavacanaṃ bhaviṣyati|
yadi tarhi samāhriyata iti samāhāra iti karmasādhanaḥ samāhāraśabdaḥ,
tadā'pekṣitaparasparāḥ pañcapūlāḥ samāsārtha iti
bahuvacanaprasaṅge'tideśa ārabhyate, tadāha---pratyadhikaraṇaṃ
vacanotpateḥ saṃkhyāsāmānādhikaraṇyācca
dvigorekavacanavidhānamiti| adhikaraṇaṃ dravyam, saṃkhyāvācī
pañcādiśabdaḥ, yatsaṃkhyāviśiṣṭṃa dravyamabhidhīyate tadabhidhānayogyaṃ
vacanamutpadyate| pañcapūlīśabdena pañcapūlāḥ samāhriyamāṇā ucyante,
ataḥ samāsārthasya pañcādibhiḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyād
dvivacanabahuvacanaprasaṅge ekavacanaṃ vidhīyata ityarthaḥ|
saṃkhyāsāmānādhikaraṇyādityanena karmasādhanatvaṃ samāhāraśabdasya
darśayati, bhāvasādhane tu vaiyadikaraṇyaṃpañcānāṃ pūlānām| na vā
samāhāraikatvāditi, ayamarthaḥ----tirohitāvayavabhedaḥ samūharūpaḥ
samāhāro dvigvarthastasyaikatvādvanādivadekavacanasiddhernātra sūtreṇa
prayojanam| avaśyaṃ ca tad bhāvasādhanaḥ samāhāra āśrayaṇīyaḥ anyathā
pañcānāṃ khaṭvānāṃ samāhāraḥ pañcakhaṭvītyatra vā ṭābanta iti
strītvapakṣekhaṭvāśabdasyānupasarjanatvāt hrasvo na syāt|
anupasarjanatvaṃ cāprathamānirddiṣṭatvādanekavibhaktitvācca|
bhāvasādhane tu pañcānāṃ khaṭvānāṃ samāhāraḥ, samāhāraṃ
samāhāreṇeti samāsārthasya nānāvibhaktiyoge'pi khaṭvāśabdasya
nityaṃ ṣaṣṭha|lntatvāt ṭheka vibhakti ca' ityupasarjanatvād hrasvatvaṃ
sidhyati, ekavacanamityetadutarārthaṃ kartavyameva| pañcapūlīti|
ṭhakārāntotarapado dviguḥ striyāṃ bhāṣyate' iti strīliṅgatvād
ṭhdvigoḥ' iti ṅīp||
dvandvaśca prāṇitūryasenāṅgānām|| 2|4|2 ||
dvandvaśca prāṇitūryasenāṅgānām|| iha yasya dvandvasya kaścidavayavaḥ
prāṇyaṅgavācī, kaścitūryāṅgavācī, kaścitsenāṅgavācī;
yathā---pāṇimārdaṅgikāśvārohā iti, sa vyatikīrṇāvayavo'pi
prāṇyaṅgādīnāṃ dvandvī bhavatyevetyekavadbhāvaḥ prāpnoti,
tatrāha---aṅgaśabdasyetyādi| nanu pūrvapakṣe'pi pratyekameva
parisamāptiraṅgaśabdasya, na hiprāṇitūryasenānāmekamaṅgaṃ
sambhavati? evaṃ tarhyaṅgānāmeva rūpasya bahuvacanāntasya
sato'ṅgaśabdasya pratyekaṃ sambandhaḥ, na tu pratyekaparisamāptasya
paścādvahuvacanasambandhaḥ| trīṇi vākyāni saṃpadyanta iti| sūtraṃ tu
teṣāmeva grahaṇakavākyamiti bhāvaḥ| tatra prathamena vākyena
prāṇyaṅgānāṃ prāṇyaṅgayoreva dvandvaḥ kṛtastasyaikavadbhāvo
vidhīyate, dvitīyena tūryāṅgānāṃ tūryāṅgaireva, tṛtīyena
senāṅanāṃ senāṅgaireveti na saṃkaraprasaṅgaḥ| tathā
tūryāṅgānāmiti dvandva ekavadbhavatītyapekṣate, atrāṅgabda
upakārakavacanaḥ pūrvatrotaratra cāvayavavacanaḥ senāṅgānāṃ ceti
pūrvavadapekṣā| pāṇipādamiti| atra ṭhjātiraprāṇinām' ityeva siddhe
vyatikaranirāsārthaṃ vacanam| mārdaṅgikapāṇavikamiti| ṭhśilpam'
iti ṭhak| vīṇāvādakaeti| ṭhnityaṃ krīḍājīvikayoḥ' iti samāsaḥ,
vipañcī parivādinī, tajjīvikaḥu parivādakaḥ|
paṇavamṛdaṅgamityādau tu ṭhjātiraprāṇinām' ityeva siddham|
rathikāśvārohamiti| kathaṃ rathavājipatikariṇīsamākulamiti,
yāvataikavadbhāve sati napuṃsakahrasvatvena bhāvyam? niraṅkuśāḥ
kavayaḥ| rathavājipatisahitāḥ kariṇyo rathavājipatikariṇyastābhiḥ
samākulamiti vā samarthanīyam|
dvandvaścetyārabhya ṭhvibhāṣā samīpe' ityantasya
prakaraṇasyānārambhaṇīyatāṃ śaṅkateitaretarayoga ityādi|
siddhamevaikavacanamiti| tataścānārambhaṇīyaṃ prakaraṇamiti bhāvaḥ|
pariharati--idaṃ tviti| kaḥ punarasau viṣayavibhāga
ityāha---prāṇyaṅgādīnāmiti| kathaṃ punaḥ prāṇyāṅgādīnāṃ dvandva
ekavacano bhavatītyasya vacanasya prāṇyaṅgādīnāṃ samāhāra evetyartho
bhavatīti? vacanavyaktibhedāt| evaṃ hyatra vacanaṃ vyajyate--ya ekavacano
dvandvaḥ sa eṣāṃ bhavatīti, na punaḥ prāṇyaṅgādīnāṃ yo dvandva ityanūdya
tasyaikavacanatā vidhīyate| ekavacanāntaśca dvandvaḥ samāhāradvandvaḥ, sa
prāṇyaṅgadīnāmapi ṭhcārthe dvandvaḥ' ityeva siddha iti sa evaiṣāmiti
niyamaḥ saṃpadyate; dadhipaya ādiṣvapi yeṣāṃ brahmaprajāpatyādīnāmanena
prakaraṇena niyamasyāprāptisteṣāṃ tāvat ṭhcārthe dvandvaḥ' ityanena
prāpto dvandvaḥ pratiṣidhyate| ya ekavacano dvandvaḥ sa eṣāṃ na
bhavatīti vacanavyaktyā śrayeṇa yeṣāmapi dadhipayasī ityādīnāṃ
ṭhjātiraprāṇinām' iti niyamasya prāptisteṣām ṭhanantarasya
vidhirvā bhavati pratiṣedho vā' iti yadyapi niyamasya pratiṣedho
yuktaḥ, tathāpi brahmaprajāpatyādibhiḥ sāhacaryādekavacano dvandva
ityetāvanmātrasyāpekṣaṇātsamāhāradvandva eva pratiṣidhyate, na niyamaḥ|
vṛkṣādivibhāṣāprayojanaṃ tu tatraiva vakṣyāmaḥ|
athaivaṃ kasmānna vijñāyate----itaretarayogapakṣe'prāpta ekavadbhāvo
vidhīyata iti? ucyate--yadītaretarayogavihitadvandvasyaikavadbhāvo
vidhīyeta, ṭhdvandvāccudaṣahānta' ityādinā samāhāranibandhanaṃ kārtha na
syād| dadhipayāadiṣu tu yasya dvandvasyaikavacanaprāptistasya
pratiṣidhyeteti samāhāradvandvasyaikavacanatāyāṃ pratiṣiddhāyāmapi
dvitvabahutvābhāvād dvivacanabahuvacane na syātāmato niyama
evāṅgīkartavyaḥ| atra ca vyākhyānameva śaraṇam| atha niyamo'pi
bhavannevameva kasmādbhāvati---prāṇyaṅgādīnāṃ samāhāra eveti? na
punaḥ-----prāṇyaṅgādīnāmeva samāhāra iti? ucyate---evaṃ hi
vijñāyamāne dadhipayāadiṣu yeṣāmanena prakaraṇena niyamo na
prāpnoti teṣu pratiṣedho'narthakaḥ syāt tiṣyapunarvasvoriti
buvacanagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| taddhitasamāhāradvandvapakṣe
tiṣyapunarvasvidamityatraikavacanasya prasaṅge dvivacanaṃ mā
bhūdityevamartham yadi ca tvadukto niyamaḥ syātiṣyapunarvasvoratra
prakaraṇe'saṅkīrtitayoḥ samāhāradvandvābhāvādanarthakaṃ tatsyāt, ato
vṛttikāroktameva niyamasvarūpamiti niravadyam||
anuvāde caraṇānām|| 2|4|3 ||
anuvāde caraṇānām|| caraṇasabdaḥ kaṭhakālāpādiṣu śākhābhedeṣu
mukhyaḥ, tadadhyāyiṣu puruṣeṣu gauṇaḥ| ubhayeṣāṃ caiṣāṃ ṭhgotrañca
caraṇaiḥ saha' iti cātisaṃjñā, tatra śākhābhedavācinaḥ
ṭhjātiraprāṇinām' ityekavadbhāvasya siddhatvād gauṇo'pi
puruṣavṛttireva gṛhayata ityāha---caraṇaśabdaḥ śākhānimitaka iti|
śākhādhyayananimitaka ityarthaḥ| gauṇa iti kvacitpaṭha|lte, kvacinna|
pramāṇāntarāvagatasyeti| śabdādanyatpramāṇaṃ pramāṇāntaramu
pratyakṣādi| saṅkīrtinamātramiti| mātraśabdo'vagativyudāsāya|
nanvarthapratipādanāya prayogaḥ, sa cedarthuḥ pramāṇāntareṇāvagataḥ,
kimiti śabdaḥ prayujyate? kāryāntaravidhānārtham| yadā hi
kaṭhakālāpeṣūditeṣu āvābhyāṃ tatra gantavyamiti saṃvādaḥ kṛto
bhavati, sa ca vismṛtyodāste tadā taṃ
pratīdamucyate---nanūdasthātkaṇṭhakālāpaṃ kimāsyate iti| kaṭhena
proktamadhīyate kaṭhāḥ, vaiśampāyanāntevāsitvāṇṇiniḥ,
ṭhkaṭhacarakālluk', kalāpiśabdāt ṭhkalāpino'ṇa', nāntasya ṭilope
sabrahmacārītyādinā ṭilopaḥ, ubhayatrādhyetraṇo luk| etena kauthumo
vyākhyātaḥ| yadā tu prathamata eva śabdopadeśa iti|
pramāṇāntareṇānavagatasya śabdenādyaṃ pratyāyanamityarthaḥ| udaguriti|
ṭhātaḥ' iti jherjus, ṭhusyapadāntāt' iti pararūpatvam| ṭhadyatanī' iti
luṅḥ pūrvācāryasaṃjñā| anandiṣariti| ṭhṭuanadi samṛddhau',ṭhsijabhyasta'
iti jus|
adhvaryukraturanapuṃsakam|| 2|4|4 ||
adhvaryukraturanapuṃsakam|| adhvaryuśabda ṛtvigviśeṣe prasiddhaḥ, na ca
tena kratorviśeṣaṇamupapadyate, na hi so'sti
kraturyatrādhvaryorananvayaḥ, nāpi so'sti yatrādhvaryorevānvaya iti
mukhyārthāsambhavādaupacārikagrahaṇamityāha---adhvaryuveda iti|
yajurveda ityarthaḥ| tatra hyādhvaryavaṃ vidhīyate|
karmasvarūpasyetikartavyatāyāḥ| phalasya copadeśaḥūuvidhānam|
adhvaryukratuvācināṃ śabdānāmanapuṃsakaliṅgānāmiti| kathaṃ tarhi
sūtre sāmānādhikaraṇyamityāha---adhvaryukraturiti|
tāddaśāvayavatvād dvandva eva tathokta ityarthaḥ| yadi
punaranapuṃsakamityanena mukhyayā vṛtyā dvandva evocyeta tadā ṭhsa
napuṃsakam' ityasyāyamapavādo vijñāyeta| na vā'bādhenopapatau
satyāṃ bādho nyāyyaḥ| arkaścāśvamedhaśca arkāśvamedham|
sāyāhnaścātirātraśca sāyāhnātirātram|
iṣuvajrāviti| sāmavede eṣāṃ vidhānam|
rājasūyavājapeyaśabdāvarddharcādiṣu paṭhitau, tatastau
napuṃsakaliṅgau pratyudāharaṇam||
adhyayanato'viprakṛṣṭākhyānām|| 2|4|5 ||
adhyayanato'viprakṛṣṭākhyānām|| ākhyāyate'nenetyākhyeti
śabdamātramihākhyāśabdenocyate, na rūḍhiśabda eva| asaṃdehārthaṃ
viprakṛṣṭākhyānāmadhyayanata ityakaraṇādaviprakṛṣṭeti padacchedaḥ|
ākhyānañca na svarūpeṇāviprakarṣaḥ, kintu pravṛttinimitadvāreṇa,
taccehādhyayanam, tadāha---adhyayanata iti| adhītiḥuadhyayanam,
adhyayanenādhyayanataḥ, ādyāditvātasiḥ,
pravṛttinimitabhūtasyādhyayanasyāviprakṛṣṭatvātaddvāreṇāviprakṛṣṭā
ākhyā yeṣāṃ te'dhyayanato'viprakṛṣṭākhyāḥ| etadevāha---adhyayanena
nimitenetyādi| padakakramakamiti| padānyadhīte padakaḥ, ṭhkramādibhyo
vun,' evaṃ kramakaḥ| vṛttiḥu saṃhitā, tāmadhīte vārtikaḥ,
ukthāditvāṭ ṭhak, atra pravṛttinimitasyādhyayanasyāviprakarṣaṃ
darśayati---saṃpāṭha iti| saṃpāṭha iti| saṃpaṭhanaṃ saṃpāṭhaḥ,
adhyayanamityarthaḥ| pratyāsanna iti| padānyadhītya kramo'dhyetavya iti
kṛtvā| evaṃ kramakavārtikamityatrāpi nānadhotya saṃhitāṃ
kramo'dhyetuṃ śakya iti pratyāsatirvijñeyā||
jātiraprāṇinām|| 2|4|6 ||
jātiraprāṇinām|| jātivācyavayavatvājjātirdvandva iti gauṇo
nirddeśaḥ| ārāśastrīti| ārāupratodaḥ| dhānāśaṣkulīti| ṣaṇṇāṃ
rasānāṃ kulaṃ śaṣkulī, gaurādipāṭhādrūpasiddhiḥ|
nandakapāñcajanyāviti| sañjñāśabdāvetau, ṭhkhaṅgo'syanandakaḥ,
śaṅkhaḥ pāñcajanyaḥ prakīrtitaḥ|
jātiparatve ceti| jātiprādhānye ityarthaḥ| na
niyatadravyavivakṣāyāmiti| yadā kvaciddeśādau niyatānāṃ
dravyaviśeṣāṇāṃ vivakṣā tadā jātiśabdatve'pyekavadbhāvo na
bhavatītyarthaḥ| badarāmalakānīti| phalajātivācināvetau||
viśiṣṭaliṅgo nadī deśo'grāmāḥ|| 2|4|7 ||
viśiṣṭaliṅgo nadī deśo'grāmāḥ|| viśiṣṭaliṅgānāmityasya
vivaraṇam---bhinnaliṅgānāmiti| vipūrvaḥ śiṣirbhidinā
samānārthaḥ| tathā ca bhedaka viśeṣaṇaṃ bhedyaṃ viśeṣyamityucyate| ṭhktena
nañviśiṣṭena' ityatrāpi bhedadvāreṇaivādhikyamartho vyākhyātaḥ---yasya
hi nañ bhedakaḥ sa nañādhiko bhavati| nadīvācināmityādi| kathaṃ
tarhi sūtre viśiṣṭaliṅgādiśabdānāṃ dvandvena
sāmānādhikaraṇyamityāha---nadyavayava ityādinā| agrāmāvayavo'grāma
ityapi draṣṭavyam| agrāmā iti caikavacanasthāne bahuvacanam|
asamāsanirdeśa evāyamiti| samāse hi vyatikīrṇāvayo dvandva
ekavatsyāt| gaṅgākurukṣetre iti samāso hi bhavannitaretarayoge
ced dvivacanaprasaṅgaḥ, samāhāre cennapuṃsakatvaprasaṅga iti bhāvaḥ|
udhyairāvatīti| ṭhujjha utsarge', ṭhbhidyodhyau nade'| deśaḥ khalvapīti|
udāhriyata iti śeṣaḥ
jāmbavaśālūkinyāviti| jāmbavaṃ nagaram, śālūkinī grāmaḥ,
tatrobhayataśca grāmāṇāmiti pratiṣedha eva bhavati| grāmobhayāvayavastu
dvandvo nodāhṛtaḥ| janapado hi deśa iti| janā yatra sañcaranti sa
deśa ityarthaḥ| avaśyaṃ janapado deśa ityaṅgīkartavyamityāha---tathā
ceti| grāme nādhyeyam|
abhakṣyā grāmakukkuṭā ityādau grāmagrahaṇena nagaramapi gṛhyate,
tadvadihāpinagarāvayavasyāpi dvandvasyātra pratiṣedhaḥ syāt,
jñāpakātsiddham, yadayam ṭhprācāṃ grāmanagarāvayasyāpi dvandvasyātra
pratiṣedhaḥ syāt, jñāpakātsiddham, ṭhprācāṃ grāmanagarāṇām' iti
grāmagrahaṇe nagaragrahaṇaṃ karoti, tajjñāpayati----iha śāstre grāmagrahaṇe
na nagaraṃ gṛhyata iti? naitatsuṣṭhūacyate, vakṣyati hi tatra ṭhgrāmatvādeva
siddhe nagaragrahaṇaṃ pravṛttibhedajñāpanārtham,
grāmagrahaṇamaṅgaviśeṣaṇam----pūrvaiṣukāmaśamī, nagaragrahaṇaṃ
tūtarapadaviśeṣaṇam---pūrvapāṭaliputrakaḥ' iti, vāhīkagrāmebhyaśca
udīcyagrāmāccetyādau grāmagrahaṇena nagaragrahaṇaṃ na
syātasmādāha---agrāma ityatra nagarapratiṣedha iti| grāmāśrayasya
pratiṣedhasya pratiṣedha ityarthaḥ|
ubhayataśceti| grāmanagarātmake ubhayasminsati grāmāśrayaḥ pratiṣedha eva
vaktavyaḥ, na punarnagarāśrayaḥ pratiṣedha ityarthaḥ||
kṣudrajantavaḥ|| 2|4|8 ||
kṣudrajantavaḥ|| kṣudraśabdo'yamastyeva kṛpaṇe---kṣudro'yaṃ puruṣa iti,
astyaṅgahone śīlahīne ca---ṭhkṣudrābhyo vā' iti, asti
parimāṇāpacaye---kṣudrāstaṇḍulā iti; iha tu
jantuśabdasamabhivyāhārādantimasya grahaṇamityāha--apacitaparimāṇaḥ
kṣudra iti| alpaśarīra ityarthaḥ|
apacayasyāpekṣikatvādanavasthā mā bhūditi
smṛtimupanyasyati---kṣudrajanturanasthiḥ syāditi| yasyāsthīti na
vidyante so'nasthiḥ| smṛtyantaramāha---atha veti| kṣotavyaḥ kṣudraḥ,
arhārthe'pi ṭhsphāyītañci' ityādinā rak pratyayaḥ, yaḥ kṣudyamāno'pi na
mriyate, yathā---jalūkā, sa kṣudrajantuḥ; yastu mriyate sa
pāpanimitatvānna kṣodārhaḥ| kṣudra eva ya iti vyutpattivaśādevāyaṃ
prasiddha ityarthaḥ| smṛtyantaramāha----śataṃ veti| prasṛtirañjalerarddhaṃ
yeṣāṃ śataṃ prasṛtau bhavati, śatenārddhāñjaliḥ pūryata ityarthaḥ|
smṛtyantaramāha---kecidā nakulādapīti| nakulaparyantāḥ kṣudrajantava
ityarthaḥ|
itarāsāṃ tadvirodhāditi| anasthādibhiḥ smṛtibhirye prayogā
upadarśitā na te sarve tābhiḥ saṃgṛhyanta ityayamatra virodhaḥ||
yeṣāṃ ca virodhaḥ śāśvatikaḥ|| 2|4|9 ||
yeṣāṃ ca virodhaḥ śāśvatikaḥ|| virodho vairamiti| na
sahānavasthānādiḥ, chāyātapāvityādāvapi prasaṅgāt|
pūrvasūtrāccānuvṛtena jantugrahaṇena virodhasya viśeṣaṇāt|
jantūnāṃ hi virodho vairameva bhavati| śāśvatiko nitya iti|
śaśvaditi traikālyamāha| ṭhtatra bhavāḥ' iti kālāṭṭhañi tāntādapi
nipātanādikādeśaḥ, avyayānāṃ bhamātre ṭilopābhāvaśca|
gopālasyāpatyāni gaupālayaḥ, atra kādācitko virodhaḥ| cakāraḥ
punārityādi| paśuśakunidvandvāvakāśaḥ----mahājorabhraṃ
mahājorabhrāḥ, haṃsacakravākaṃ haṃsacakravākāḥ;
virodhināmekavadbhāvasyāvakāśaḥ---śramaṇabrāhmaṇam,
mārjāramūṣikam; aśvamahiṣaṃ kākolūkamityatrobhayaprasaṅge
paratvātpaśuśakunivibhāṣā syāt, cakārādayameva bhavati||
śūdrāṇāmaniravasitānām|| 2|4|10 ||
śūdrāṇāmaniravasitānām|| śūdraśabdo'tra
traivarṇikavyatiriktajātimātravacanaḥ, na vṛṣalaparyāyaḥ,
niravasitapratiṣedhāt| niravasita iti| niravapūrvātsyateḥ
karmaṇiktaḥ| tatra prakṛtyarthamāha----niravasānaṃ bahiṣkaraṇamiti|
anekārthatvāddhātūnāmupasargavaśādveti bhāvaḥ| pātrādvahiṣkaraṇamiha
vivakṣitamityāha---yairiti| saṃskāreṇāpīti| ṭhbhasmanā śudhyate
kāṃsyam' ityādinā smṛtikārairuktena na śudhyati, tena tatra bhoktuaṃ
na labhanta iti tato bahiṣkṛtā bhavanti||
gavāśvaprabhṛtīti ca|| 2|4|11 ||
gavāśvaprabhṛtīti ca|| dvandvarūpāṇīti anvayātprabhṛtīnīti
napuṃsakopapatiḥ| gavāśvaprabhṛtīni kṛtaikavadbhāvānyeva paṭha|lnte,
teṣāmanena sādhutvamātraṃ vidhīyate, na tvekavadbhāva
ityāha---gavāśvaprabhṛtīnīti| gavāśvādīnāṃ caturṇāmpaśudvandve vibhā
ṣāyāṃ prāptāyāṃ vacanam| evamuṣṭrakharam, uṣṭraśaśamiti|
darbhaśarādīnāṃ tṛṇolapaparyantānāṃ tṛṇadvandve vibhāṣāyāṃ
prāptāyāṃ dāsīdāsādīnām ṭhpumānstriyā' ityekaśeṣābhāvo'pi
nipātanāt|
śāṭīpaṭīkamityādīnāmaprāṇijātivacanānāmabahuprakṛtyarthaḥ pāṭhaḥ|
anyeṣāṃ kubjavāmanādīnāmaprāpte vacanam| yathoccāritaṃ
dvandvavṛtamiti| gaṇe yāddaśāḥ kṛtāvaṅadeśāḥ paṭhitāstāddaśānāmeva
dvandvavṛtaṃ dvandvakāryamekavadbhāvalakṣaṇaṃ bhavati| rūpāntareṣviti|
ṭhavaṅ sphoṭāyanasya' iti vikalpitatvādyadā nāsti tadetyarthaḥ| etena
gaṇapāṭhe rūpameṣāṃ vivakṣitam, na pūrvotarapadanirdeśamātre
tātparyamityuktaṃ bhavati||
vibhāṣā
vṛjñamṛgatṛṇadhānyavyañjanapaśuśakunyaśvavaḍapūrvāparādharotarāṇām||
2|4|12 ||
vibhāṣā
vṛkṣamṛgatṛṇadhānyavyañjanapaśuśakunyaśvavaḍapūrvāparādharotaraṇām||
atra vṛbhādibhiḥ pratyekaṃ dvandve viśeṣyate| na caiko vṛkṣaśabdo
dvandvaḥ, na ca dvayoḥ sahaprayogaḥ, ekaśeṣāt| na ca paryāyāṇāmapi
sahayogaḥ, virūpāṇāmapi samānārthānām' ekaśeṣavacanāt, nāpi
viśeṣeṇa sahaprayogaḥ----vṛkṣaśca dhavaśceti,
vṛkṣaśabdenaivāśeṣaviśeṣākṣepāddhavādiśabdaprayogasya niṣphalatvāt|
kathaṃ tarhi ṭhgobalīvadāê' ityādau sāmānyaviśeṣayoḥ saha prayogaḥ?
balīvardaśabdasaṃnidhau gośabdasya strīgavīṣveva vṛterddhayorapi
viśeṣavacanatvāditi ced, ihāpi tarhi dhavapadasaṃnidhau vṛkṣaśabdasya
tadvyatiriktaviṣayatayā dvandvaprasaṅgaḥ? kiṃ ca vākye'pi kathaṃ
sahaprayogaḥ----brāhmaṇā āgatā vasiṣṭho'pyāgata iti ?
prādānyakhyāpanārthamuktārthasyāpi prayoga iti ced, dvandve'pi tarhi
prāpnoti| tasmānadanabhidhānamevāśrayaṇīyam, na hi vṛkṣadhavamiti
loke'bhidhānamasti, ato vṛkṣaviśeṣavācināṃ grāhaṇam| evaṃ
mṛgādiṣvapi draṣṭavyam|
ityeteṣāṃ dvandva iti| eteṣāmityekāpi ṣaṣṭhī
viṣayabhedādbhidyate---vṛkṣādīñcchakuniparyantānpratyavayavaṣaṣṭhī,
aśvavaḍavādīn prati nirddhāraṇaṣaṣṭhī| ye'trāprāṇinasteṣāṃ
ṭhjātiraprāṇinām' iti nityaṃ samāhāradvandve prāpte ubhayatra
vidhīyate | yo vibhāṣāprāptaikavacano dvandvaḥ sa eṣāṃ bhavatīti
vacanavyaktyāśrayaṇena teṣāmeva vṛkṣādīnāmanyaiḥ saha dvandve
yathāprāptaṃ nityo vikalpito vā ekavadbhāvo
bhavati----vrīhikuśaplakṣamiti, ṭhjātiraprāṇinām' iti nityaḥ,
plakṣaśabdasparśā ityatrādravyavācitvātṭhjātiraprāṇinām'
ityasyāpravṛtau ṭhcārthe dvandvaḥ' ityubhayatra prāpto bhavati| paśugrahaṇaṃ
hastyaśvādiṣu paratvāt senāṅgalakṣaṇasya nityavidherbādhanārtham|
mṛgaśakunigrahaṇaṃ kimartham, na hyaeteṣāmanena prakaraṇena nitya
ekavadbhāvaḥ prāptaḥ, yadvādhanāya vikalpo'bhyanujñāyate, anyatra
prāptyabhāvādeṣāmubhayatraiva dvandva iti niyamo na sambhavati?
athaiṣāmevobhayatra dvandva iti niyamaḥ syāt, kva tarhyeṣāṃ syāt?
kvaciditi cet, yadyevam, ṭhcārthe dvandvaḥ' iti
sāmānyalakṣaṇamanavakāśasyāt, viṣiṣṭavidhānameva tadānīmāśrayaṇīyaṃ
syāt prāṇyaṅgādīnāṃ samāhāre dadhipayāadīnāmitaretarayoge
vṛkṣādīnāmubhayatreti? athaiṣāmevobhayatretyanenānyeṣāmubhayatrāpi
dvandvo vāryate, anyataratra tu bhavatyeva| evamapi kvānyatreti na
jñāyate, ṭhsarvo dvandvo vibhāṣayaikavadbhavati' iti cānupapannaṃ
syāt? ucyate---yatulyajātīyānāmevāyaṃ vikalpastatraiva niyamaḥ
pravartate---mṛgaviśeṣavācināṃ mṛgaviśeṣavācibhirevobhayatra
dvandvaḥ, anyaistu sahānyataratreti| nanvemapi na
jñāyate---kvānyataratreti, syādetad evam, yadyaubhayatraiṣāṃ dvandva iti
śrutaṃ syāt| iha tu vibhāṣaikavacano dvandva iti śrūyate, tataśca yo
vibhāṣāprāpta ekavacano dvandvaḥ sa mṛgaviśeṣavācināṃ
mṛgaviśeṣavācibhireva nānyairiti vacanavyaktau vyaktameva
jñāyate---anyaiḥ sahetaraetarayogadvandva iti| athāsyāṃ vacanavyaktau
vibhāṣāgrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā vibhāṣaivaikavacanānto dvandvaḥ
prāptastatraitāvadevāstu--ya ekavacano dvandvaḥ sa eṣāmebhireveti ?
ucyate---asati vibhāṣāgrahaṇe vacanavyaktyantaramapi
sambhāvyeta---eṣāmebhiḥ sahaikavacana eva dvandva iti, yathā
prāṇyaṅgadiṣu| sati tu tasya niyamasyāsambhavādabhimato niyamaḥ
saṃpadyate| evaṃ pūrvāparam, adharotaramityatrāpi niyamasvarūpaṃ
vijñeyam|
ṭhpaśudvandva' ityeva siddhe'śvavaḍavagrahaṇaṃ pratipadavidhānārtham| tatra
pratipadavidhānādaśvavaḍavamityekavadbhāvapakṣe ṭhpūrvavadaśvaḍavau'
ityetadvādhitvā ṭhsa napuṃsakam' ityetadeva bhavati, tacchabdena
hyaekavadbhāvabhājaṃ parāmṛśya vidhīyamānaṃ
napuṃsakatvamekavadbhāvavadeva pratipadavihitaṃ bhavati|
ṭhpūrvavadaśvavaḍavau' ityetatu ekavadbhāvābhāvapakṣe
pravartate----aśvaḍavau, aśvavaḍavān iti| etadevābhipretya
vṛttikārastatra vakṣyati---aśvavaḍavayorvibhāṣaikavadbhāva ukta ityādi|
bahuprakṛtiriti| bahavo bahutvasaṃkhyāyuktā vartipadārthāḥ prakṛtiḥ
kāraṇaṃ yasya dvandvārthasya sa bahuprakṛtiḥ, tadarthābhidhāyitvād
dvandvo'pi bahuprakṛtiḥ| nedaṃ svatantraṃ lakṣaṇam, svātantrye nityaṃ
cedvanaspatyādīnāmapi etatsūtravihitaṃ vikalpaṃ bādhitvā
bahuprakṛtitve nitya ekavadbhāvaḥ syāt, vikalpe phalādīnāmapi
ṭhjātiraprāṇinām' ityādilakṣaṇāntareṇa prāptaṃ nityamekavadbhāvaṃ
bādhitvā bahuprakṛtitve vikalpaḥ syāt| ato lakṣaṇāntarasya
śeṣo'yam| tatrāpi yadi ṭhvibhāṣā vṛkṣa' ityatra paṭhitatvādasyaiva
śeṣatvaṃ syātato vanaspatyādiṣvabahuprakṛtitve evadvikalpābhāve'pi
ṭhjātiraprāṇinām' iti nityo vidhiḥ syāt, phalādiṣu tu na
doṣaḥ; etadvikalpaprāptyabhāvāllakṣaṇāntaraprāptereva niyamanāt
tasmātsarvasyaiva prakaraṇasyārthaśeṣastadetadāha---eṣāṃ
bahuprakṛtireveti| eṣāṃ phalādīnāṃ dvandvo'nena lakṣaṇāntareṇa vā
ekavadbhavan bahuprakṛtirevaikavadbhavatītyarthaḥ| badarāmalake iti|
atra ṭhjātiraprāṇinām' iti na bhavati| rathikāśvārohāviti| atra
senāṅgalakṣaṇaḥ| plakṣanyagrodhāviti| atrāyaṃ vikalpaḥ,
ṭhjātiraprāṇinām' nityaśca na bhavati| avanaspatīnāṃ tu
vṛkṣiviśeṣāṇāmabuhuprakṛtitve'pyayaṃ vikalpo
bhavatyeva---āmrapalāśam, āmrapalāśau| anye tu vanaspatigrahaṇaṃ
vṛkṣamātropalakṣaṇaṃ manyante| rurupṛṣatau, haṃsacakravākāviti|
atrāpyasya vikalpasyābhāvaḥ| yūkālikṣe iti| ṭhkṣudrajantavaḥ'
ityasyābhāvaḥ| vrīhiyavau, kuśakāśāvityatra tūbhayoḥ||
vipratiṣiddhaṃ cānadhikaraṇavāci|| 2|4|13 ||
vipratiṣiddhaṃ cānadhikaraṇavāci|| pasparaviruddhamiti|
sahānavasthānādilakṣaṇo virodhaḥ, ṭhvipratiṣiddhānām' ityādisūtre
tu tadvācyavayavatvād dvandvarūpameva tathoktamiti bhāvaḥ|
adravyavācināmiti| etenādhikaraṇaśabdo dravye vartate, nādhāra iti
darśayati| na hi dvandvāvayavānāmādhāre vṛttiḥ sambhavati;
vibhaktyarthatvādādhārasyeti bhāvaḥ| ayamapi niyamārthaḥ prārambha;
niyamasvarūpaṃ ca---ya ekavacano dvando vibhāṣāprāptaḥ sa yadi
vipratiṣiddhavācināṃ bhavatyadravyavācināmeva, dravyavācināṃ
tvitaretarayoga iti||
na dadhipaya ādīni|| 2|4|14 ||
na dadhipaya ādīni|| yathāyathamiti| vyañjanatvādvikalpasya
prāptistatrāditistriṣu, pūrvasūtravikalpasya śuklakṛṣṇāviti, na
tviha| yadyevam, pratiṣiddhe'sminvikalpe jātilakṣaṇo nityaḥ
syādekavadbhāvaḥ? parihāro'tra vakṣyate---striyāṃ yaduktaṃ tanneti|
yathā ṣaṭsvabhidhāsyate tathātrāpyekavadbhāvamātrameva niṣidhyate |
kiṃ ca, brahmaprajāpatyādiṣvatra paṭhiteṣu
samāhāradvandvaniṣedhamukhenetaretayogadvandvo vyavasthāpyate,
tatsāhacaryādeteṣvapi caturṣu tadeva yuktam||
adhikāraṇaitāvatve ca|| 2|4|15 ||
adikāraṇaitāvatve ca|| vṛttirvartaḥu samāsaḥ, so'syāstīti
samāsāvayavabhūtaṃ vartipadam, tasyārtho'dhikaraṇamityucyate, kathaṃ
punastadadhikaraṇamityāha--sa hīti| niyamasya cātra pratiṣedhaḥ
prāṇyaṅgādīnāṃ samāhāra eveti niyamo vartipadārthasyeyatāyāṃ
gamyamānāyāṃ na bhavatīti, na punaḥ pūrvasūtravatsamāhāradvandvasya
pratiṣedhaḥ| yadyevam, pratiṣiddhe'pi niyame ṭhdaśa dantoṣṭhāḥ'
ityadhikaraṇaitāvatve'pi ṭhcāthe dvandvaḥ' ityanena samāhāre'rthe
dvandvaḥ syādeva, ye cātra prakaraṇe'saṃkīrtitāsteṣu
niyamasyāprasaṅgādasatyasminpratiṣedhe ṭhcārthe dvandvaḥ' ityanena
samāhāre dvandvaḥ syādeva---daśa brāhmaṇakṣatriyā iti, ataḥ
prakṛtānāmanyeṣāṃ ca sarveṣāmekavacano dvandvo na bhavati,
ṭhadhikaraṇaitāvatve' iti samāhāradvandva eva pratiṣedhyaḥ?
ucyate---ṭhadhikaraṇaṃ vartipadārthaḥ' ityuktam, na ca samāhāradvandve
vatipadārthasyaitāvatvaṃ śakyaṃ pratipādayitum,
daśādiśabdaprayoge'pi hi tasyaiva dvandvārthasya samāhārasya
saṅkhyāviśeṣo'vagamyate, na vartipadārthasya, yathā
dvigau---daśapañcapūlya iti| ato vartipadārthasya saṅkhyāviśeṣaṃ
pratipipādayiṣatā'vaśyamitaretarayoga dvandvo vidheya iti
daśabrahmāṇakṣatriyā ityādau tāvadadoṣaḥ| yadyevam, anenaiva nyāyena
ṭhdaśa dantoṣṭhaḥ' ityādāvapi samāhāradvandvo na bhaviṣyatīti nārthaḥ
pratiṣedhena? maivam; asatyasminpratiṣedhe prāṇyaṅgādīnāṃ samāhāra
eveti niyamāditaretarayogadvandvo na syāt| na ca samāhāradvandve
daśādiprayoge'pi vartipadārthasya saṅkhyāviśeṣaḥ pratipādayituṃ
śakya iti adhikaraṇaitāvatve pratipipādayiṣite dvandva eva na
syādityārabhyaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ| daśa dantoṣṭhā iti| atra daśaśabdasya
pratyekaṃ sambandhādvartipadārthasyeyatā gamyate, samudāyasambandhe'pi
dantoṣṭhātmakavartipadārthagataiva saṅkhyā||
vibhāṣā samīpe|| 2|4|16 ||
vibhāṣā samīpe|| ṭhadhikaraṇaitāvatve' ityadhikārātsamīparūpa
etasminniti gamyate, vṛtau tvarthamātraṃ darśitam| adhikaraṇaitāvatvasya
samīpa iti| atra ca bhāvapradhānaḥ samīpaśabdaḥ, adhikaraṇaitāvatvasya
sāmīpye paricchitāvityarthaḥ| atra vispaṣṭa eva niyamasya pratiṣedhaḥ, na
hi vibhāṣā samāhāradvandvaḥ pratiṣedhyaḥ| avyayībhāvo vihita iti|
ṭhavyayaṃ vibhakti' ityādinā| yadyapyatra saṅkhyayeti nāsti, saṅkhyayāpi
tu bhavatyeva| bahuvrīhiriti| ṭhsaṅkhyayāvyayāsanna' ityādinā|
tatraikavadbhāvapakṣe'vyayībhāvo'nuprayujyata iti ekārthasyaikārtha iti
bhāvaḥ| aikārthyañca tasya sāmīpyapradhānatvāt|
yadyapyavyayībhāvo'vyayatvānniḥ----saṅkhyastathāpi
bhedābhāvarūpamaikārthyamastyeva| sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ ca
sāmīpyatadvatorabhedāśrayeṇa pratipādyam| adhikaraṇaitāvatvamapi
samāhārasamāhāriṇorbhedāvivakṣayaivopapādyam| itaratra
bahuvrīhiriti| bahvarthasya bahvartha iti bhāvaḥ| bahvarthatvaṃ ca tasya
samīpipradhānatvāt| nanu
dvandvārthasyaikavadbhāvādanuprayogasyāpyekavacanatā siddhā, kimetayā
kliṣṭakalpanayā? ucyate--avyayībhāvasyaivānuprayoge tasyāvyayatvā
dvahutvābhāvād bahuvacanaṃ na syāt,satyapi vā tasminnambhāve
kṛte upadaśā iti na syāt| bahuvrīhereva cānuprayoge upadaśasya
pāṇipādasyeti ṣaṣṭhī syād, upadaśampāṇipādasyeti ceṣyate; ato
yathoktameva sādhīyaḥ||
sa napuṃsakam|| 2|4|17 ||
sa napuṃsakam|| paravalliṅgatāpavādo yogaḥ| sagrahaṇaṃ vyavahitasya
dvigorapi yathā syād, anyathā'vyavahitasya dvandvasyaiva syāt,
naitadasti; ekavacanamityetāvanmātramevāpekṣiṣyāmahe,
naikavacanaviśeṣaṃ dvandvam| evaṃ tarhi yo'tra prakaraṇe'saṅkīrtitaḥ
samāhāradvandvastasyāpi yathā syāt? anyathā prakṛtasyaiva dvandvasya
dvigośca syāt| nanu prakaraṇamapi nāpekṣiṣyate, yadyevam, ekasaṅkhya
ityādāvekārthasya syāt, ato'vaśyāpekṣyaṃ prakaraṇam|
tasmiṃścāpekṣyamāṇe prāṇyaṅgādisambandhādirūpeṇa dvandvaḥ prakṛta iti
tasyaiva syāt| sa ityetasmiṃstu sati apekṣyamāṇe'pi prakaraṇe
prāṇyaṅgādisambandhaparityāgena yo'tra prakaraṇe saṃkīrtito dvandvo
dviguśca ṭhsa napuṃsakam' iti sarvasya samāhāradvandvasya napuṃsakatvaṃ
labhyate, ekādau cātiprasaṅgo na bhavati| tathā ca ṭhyuvoranākau'
ityādāvucyate---yuvoriti samāhāradvandve sa napuṃsakaprasaṅgaḥ|
ato yāvānkaścana samāhāradvandvaḥ prāṇyaṅgādisambandhī, anyo vā,
sarvasyāsya napuṃsakatvaṃ vidhīyata iti siddham|
akārāntotarapada iti| atrāta ityadhikāre ṭhdvigoḥ' iti ṅībvidhānaṃ
liṅgam| pañcakhaṭvīti| strītvapakṣe upasarjanahrasvatvam|
ano nalopaśceti| ṭhutarapadatve cāpadādividhau' iti
pratyayalakṣaṇapratiṣedhātpadatbābhāvānnalopavacanam|
pātrādibhya iti tādarthya eṣā caturthī pātrādyantānāṃ dvigūnāṃ siddhaya
ityarthaḥ| pātrādirākṛtigaṇaḥ||
avyayībhāvaśca|| 2|4|18 ||
avyayībhāvaśca|| pūrvapadārthapraghānasyeti| adhistrītyādau
pūrvapadārthasyāliṅgatvādiliṅgataiva prāpnoti|
anyapadārthapradhānasyeti| unmattgaṅgamityādeḥ| puṣyāhamiti|
karmadhāraye ṭhrājāhaḥ sakhibhyaṣṭac', ṭhrātrāhnāhāḥ pusi'
ityasyāpavādaḥ| sudinamiti| sudinaśabdaḥ praśastavacanaḥ| sudināsu
samāsu kāryametaditi tathā| tripathamiti| ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| dvigoḥ
pātrāditvātsiddham| virūpaḥ panthā vipatham,prādisamāsaḥ|
kriyāviśeṣaṇānāṃ ceti| kriyādvāreṇa strīliṅgatve prāpte
vacanam||
tatpuruṣo'nañkarmadhārayaḥ|| 2|4|19 || 
tatpuruṣo'nañkarmadhārayaḥ|| asandehārthaṃ nañkarmadhārayastatpuruṣa
ityanyāsādanañkarmadhāraya iti padacchedaḥ| atra karmadhārayaśabdo
bhāvapradhānaḥ, nañca karmadhārayaśca nañkarmadhārayau, tau na vidyete
yasmiṃstatpuruṣe so'nañkarmadhāraya iti bahuvrīhiḥ| tatpuruṣe
tvasminnañmātrasya tatpuruṣasyābhāvātadyauktatatpuruṣo nañśabdena
lakṣaṇoyaḥ syāt, liṅgavacanayoścānyatarasya vyatyayo vācyaḥ
syāt, ato bahuvrīhireva nyāyyaḥ| vṛtau vastumātraṃ
darśitam---nañsamāsaṃ karmadhārayaṃ ca varjayitveti| vibhāṣā
seneti| anantareṣu sūtreṣvasya nātīvopayogaḥ, ṭhsañjñāyāṃ kanthā'
ityatra tāvadanādiḥ sañjñā gṛhyate, na vā tatpuruṣo nañsamāsaḥ
karmadhārayo vā uśīnareṣu sañjñāsti, upajñopakramamityatrāpi
ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣādvinā tadāditvāsampratyayaḥ| ṭhchāyā bāhulye' ityatrāpi
pūrvapadārthadharmo bāhulyaṃ ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣamantareṇa na gamyate|
sabhārājetyatra tu rājā'manuṣyapūrveti vacanānnañsamāsasya
karmadhārayasya ca sabhāntasyāprasaṅgaḥ| dvandvasya tu prāpnoti---īśvaraśca
sabhā ca īśvarasabhe iti, atastatrāpi tatpuruṣa
ityasyāṃśasyopayogo'styeva| ṭhaśālā ca' ityatra samūhavacanaḥ
sabhāśabdaḥ, samūhasya ca samūhyapekṣā sphuṭatareti ṣaṣṭhī tatpuruṣasyaiva
bhaviṣyati, nānyasya, brāhmaṇaśca sabhā ca brāhmaṇasabhe, asabhā, paramasabheti|
ataḥ ṭhvibhāṣāsenā' ityatraivāsya sākṣādupayoga iti bhāvaḥ||
saṃjñāyāṃ kanthośīnareṣu|| 2|4|20 ||
saṃjñāyāṃ kanthośīnareṣu|| tatpuruṣasya kanthayā
viśeṣaṇātadantavidhirityāha---kanthāntastatpuruṣa iti|
sauśamikanthamiti| suśamasyāpatyāni sauśamayaḥ||
upajñopakramaṃ tadādyācikhyāsāyām|| 2|4|21 ||
upajñopakramaṃ tadādyācikhyāsāyām|| upajñāyata ityupajñeti| karmaṇi
ṭhātaścopasarge' ityaṅpratyayaḥ| upakramyata ityupakrama iti karmaṇyeva
ghañ | ṭhnodātopadeśasya' iti vṛddhipratiṣedhaḥ| upajñā
copakramaśceti samāhāradvandvaḥ| tadantastatpuruṣa iti| sūtre tu
upajñopakramaṃ tatpuruṣarūpamityevaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyena
viśeṣaṇam,tayaurupajñopakramayorityādervivaraṇam---yadīti|
ādiḥuprāthamyam| pāṇinyupajñamiti| kartari ṣaṣṭhayāḥ samāsaḥ|
pūrvāṇi vyākaraṇānyadyatanādikālaparibhāṣāyuktāni, tadrahitaṃ tu
vyākaraṇaṃ pāṇiniprabhṛtipravṛtamityasti tadāditvasyākhyānam|
vyāḍa|lu pajñamiti| aḍaḥ vṛścikalāṅgūlam, tena ca taikṣṇyaṃ
lakṣyate, vigatāḍo vyaḍaḥ, tasyāpatyaṃvyāḍirācāryaḥ|
svāgatādipāṭhāt ṭhna yvābhyām' ityeṣa vidhirna bhavati| duṣiti
saṅketaśabdaḥ, yathātra vṛtkaraṇam| nando rājā| mānāni
prasthādīni| vālmīkiślokā iti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| astyatra
tadāditvasyācikhyāsā; vālmīkiḥ prathamaṃ ślokaprabandhaṃ dadarśati
prasiddheḥ| devadato yajñadatenopajñāyate yajñadatenopakramyate iti
kriyāsambandhamātramatra vivakṣitam||
chāyā bāhulye|| 2|4|22||
chāyā bāhulye|| pūrvapadārthadharmo bāhulyamiti| katham? bāhulya
iti nimitasaptamī| bāhulye sati yā chāyā tadvācī
yaśchāyāśabdastadantastatpuruṣa iti sūtre'kṣarānvayaḥ| tatra kasya
bāhulyamityapekṣāyāmāvārakaradravyanimitakatvācchāyāyāstadvāhulya
iti gamyate| tena yāni bahūni sambhūyopalambhayogyāmupajīvyāṃ vā
chāyāmārabhante teṣvayaṃ vidhiḥ||
sabhā rājā'manuṣyapūrvā|| 2|4|23 ||
sabhā rājāmanuṣyapūrvā|| iha sabhāśabdaḥ śālāvacanaḥ| iha kasmānna
bhavatīti| ṭhsvaṃ rūpam' iti vacanādihaiva bhavituṃ yuktamiti praśnaḥ|
paryāyavacanasyaiveti| na svarūpasya, nāpi viśeṣāṇāṃ
candraguptādīnāmityarthaḥ| etadevāptoktena draḍhayati----taduktamiti|
kathaṃ punaretallabhyate? dvāvatra nañau---arājapūrvā,
amanuṣyapūrvāceti, tatra nañivayuktanyānayena rājaśabdasaddaśāḥ
paryāyā eva gṛhyante, amanuṣyaśabdo rūḍhirūpeṇeti| kathaṃ tarhi
ṭhamanuṣyakartṛke ca' ityatra pitaghnaṃ ghṛtamityudāhariṣyate?
vyākhyānātatra manuṣyādanyamātrasya grahaṇaṃ na rūḍhirityarthaḥ||
aśālā ca|| 2|4|24 ||
aśālā ca|| sabhāśabdo'yaṃ śālāvacanaḥ, saṃghavacanaśca, tatra
śālāpratiṣedhāditarasya grahaṇamityāha---saṃghātavacana ityādi| tatra
pūrvasūtreṇa rājāmanuṣyapūrvatve śālāvacanasyāpi bhaviṣyati,
aśālāvacanasya tvanena rājāmanuṣyapūrvatvābhāve'pīti||
vibhāṣā senāsurācchāyāśālāniśānām|| 2|4|25 ||
vibhāṣā senāsurācchāyāśālāniśānām|| tatpuruṣa iti prakṛtaṃ
ṣaṣṭhībahuvacanāntaṃ vipariṇamyate, napuṃsakamiti ca bhāvapradhānaṃ
saṃpadyate| senādyantānāṃ tatpuruṣāṇāṃ napuṃsakatvamityakṣarārthaḥ|
vṛtau tu vastumātraṃ daśitam| yadvā---prathamāsthāne ṣaṣṭhī|
kuḍa|lcchāyamiti| bāhulyābhāve'nena vikalpaḥ, bāhulye nityārtham
ṭhchāyā bāhulye' ityuktam| śvaniśamiti| yasyāṃ niśāyāṃ śvāna
upavasanti sā śvaniśamityucyate| sā punaḥ kṛṣṇacaturdaśī tasyāṃ hi
śvāna upavasantīti prasiddhiḥ||
paravalliṅgaṃ dvandvatatpuruṣayoḥ|| 2|4|26 ||
paravalliṅgaṃ dvandvatatpuruṣayoḥ|| kimarthamidam? iha dvandve trīṇi
darśanāniavayavārthā evāpekṣitaparasparāḥ dvandvārtho na tu
tadvyatiriktaḥ samudāyo nāmetyekam; avayavārthavyatirikta eva
samudāyo dvandvarthaḥ, sa cāvayavaliṅgena liṅgavāniti dvitīyam;
sa eva svayaṃ liṅgaśūnya iti tṛtīyam| tatra pūrvake darśanadvaye
vibhinna liṅgāvayavadvandve yugapadubhayaliṅgatānupapateḥ paryāyeṇa
liṅgadvayaprasaṅge parasyaiva liṅgaṃ bhavatīti niyamārtha bhavati|
tṛtīye tu samāsārthasyāliṅgasya paravalliṅgatā bhavatīti
vidhyarthaḥ| tatpuruṣo'pi
dvividhaḥ----pūrvapadārthapradhāno'rdhapippālyādiḥ; utarapadārthapradhāno
rājakumāryādiḥ| tatrotarapadārthapradhāne prādhānyādeva
paravalliṅgasya siddhatvātpūrvapadārthapradhāne vidhyartha bhavati| tatra
vṛttikāreṇa vidhipakṣa āśritastadāha---parasya yalliṅgaṃ
tadbhavatīti| evaṃ hi sūtrasyaikarūpā vacanavyaktirbhavati, itarathā
tatpuruṣe vidhirūpā dvandve niyamarūpeti vacanavyaktibhedaḥ syāditi
bhāvaḥ| dvandvasya tatpuruṣasya veti| etena dvandvatatpuruṣayoriti
ṣaṣṭhīyamiti darśayati| saptamyāṃ tvayamartho bhavati---dvandve tatpuruṣe
ca yatparaṃ tadvallaṅgiṃ bhavatīti| tatra
kāryiṇo'nupādānātparaśabdatvātadākṣiptasya pūrvapadasya
liṅgavidhirbhavati|
yadvā---dvandve tatpuruṣe ca viṣaye parasyaiva liṅgaṃ
bhavatītyakṣarārthaḥ| tatrāpi pūrvapadasyaiva liṅgavidhiḥ| atra pakṣe
mayūrīkukkuṭāvityatrotarapadārthaliṅge pūrvapadārthasyātidiṣṭe
strīpratyayasya nivṛttiḥ prāpnoti; kukkuṭamayūryau, rājakumārī,
arddhapippalītyādau pūrvapade strīpratyayaprasaṅgaḥ| ki punarasminpakṣe
kiṃcidiṣṭṃa sidhyati? āhosviddoṣāntameva? sidhyatītyāha| iha
pūrvakāyaḥ ardhadroṇa iti, yatra pūrvapadaṃ napuṃsakamutarapadaṃ ca
puṃlliṅgam, tatra parasya liṅge pūrvasyātidiṣṭe samāsasyāpi
tadeva bhavati, na ca pūrvavadiha kiṃcidaniṣṭamāpadyate| dvandve'pi
pūrvake darśanadvaye guṇakarmaṇī dravyaguṇāvityādau yatra
puṃnapuṃsakābhyāṃ bhinnaliṅge pūrvotarapade, yatra vā'varṇāntaṃ
strīpratyayāntaṃ vā padaṃ na bhavati----gatisthāne, yoṣitpūruṣau,
titiribalāke iti, tatrotarapadārthaliṅge
pūrvapadārthasyātidiṣṭe dvandvasya paryāyeṇa dvayorapi liṅge
pravṛte'pi sarvamiṣṭṃa sidhyati, pūrvavadeva na kiṃ
ñcidaniṣṭamāpadyate| ṭhvyatirikto dvandvārthaḥ svayaṃ liṅgaśūnyaḥ' ityatra
tu pakṣe dvandvārthasyāliṅgatvaṃ tadavasthameveta doṣāntimeva|
dvandvasya tatpuruṣasya ceti| dvandvārthasya tatpuruṣārthasya cetyarthaḥ|
tenānuprayoge'pi tadevaṃ liṅgaṃ bhavati| yadi tarhi ṣaṣṭha|laśrayaṇena
samāsārthasya paravalliṅgamatidiśyate, ṭhpūrvavadaśvavaḍavau' ityatrāpi
pūrvapadārthaliṅgaṃ samāsārthe'tidiśyate, tataścotarapadārthasya
strītvaṃ sthitameveti ṭāpaḥ śravaṇaprasaṅgaḥ| saptamīpakṣe tu
ṭhpūrvavadaśvavaḍavau' ityatrāpi
pūrvapadārthaliṅgamutarapadārthasyātidiśyata iti vaḍavāśabdasya
puṃstvātideśāt strītvābhāve ṭāponivṛttiḥ sidhyati|
nipātanātsiddham| kiṃ nipātanam? na tāvat ṭhpūrvavadaśvavaḍavau'
iti nipātanamāśrayitumucitam, vacanāntare'natideśaprasaṅgād
aśvavaḍavān, aśvavaḍavairiti| evaṃ
tarhyaśvavaḍavapūrvāparādharotarāṇāmityatra
ṭāpo'nuccāraṇānnipātānādaśvavaḍavayordvandve ṭābnivartiṣyate|
apara āha---ṭhcārthe dvandvaḥ' ityatrānekamityadhikārātsarveṣāmeva
vartipadārthaṣyati| ihāpi tarhi prāpnoti----kukkuṭamayūryāviti?
astu, kā rūpasiddhiḥ? paravalliṅkamiti śabdaśabdārtho, ko'rthaḥ?
liṅgaśabdena liṅgābhidhāyī pratyayo'rthaścatantreṇaikaśeṣeṇa
vācyate| tadayamartho bhavati---dvandvārthasya tatpuruṣārthasya parasyeva
liṅgaṃ bhavati, tadabhidhāyī pratyayaśca parasyaiva bhavati tābhyāmiti|
tatra ca yatra dravyaguṇau guṇakarmaṇī----arddhadroṇa ityādau,
liṅgābhidhāyī pratyayo na saṃbhavati tatrārtha evātidiśyate,
ubhayasambhave tūbhayam---yathā kukkuṭamayūryāviti,
tataścaupadeśikasya hrasvatve'pyātideśikasya śravaṇaṃ bhaviṣyati; tasya
cānupasarjanatvātadantasya cāprātipadikatvātpunarhrasvatvābhāvaḥ| iha
tarhi datāgārgyāyaṇyau, datākārīṣagandhye iti hrasvatve kṛte
samāsātpunaḥ ṣphaṣyaṅai prāpnutaḥ? stām, ṭhbhasyā'ḍhea taddhite' iti
pūrvotpannayornivṛttirbhaviṣyati| yatra tarhi puṃvadbhāvo nāsti
abhatvād, yathā---datā ca yuvatiśca datāyuvatī iti, tatra dvayoḥ
strīpratyayayoḥ śravaṇaprasaṅgaḥ, tasmādupasarjanahrasvatvaṃ dvandve na
bhavati| anvarthā hyupasarjanasaṃjñā'pradhānasya vidhīyate, dvandve
cāvayavārthānāmeva kāryānvayādaprādhānyābhāvaḥ| paravalliṅgamiti
cārtha evātidiśyate, aśvavaḍavāviti ca nipātanādityetadeva
samprati|
dviguprāptāpannetyādi| sa tarhi pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ? na vaktavyaḥ,
tatpuruṣagrahaṇaṃ na kariṣyate, paravalliṅgaṃ dvandvasyetyeva| kathaṃ
pūrvakāyaḥ, ardhapippalīti? ekadeśisamāso nārapsyate, karmadhāraya
evātra bhaviṣyati---pūrvaścāsau kāyaśca, ardhaṃ cāsau pippalī ceti|
pūrvādayaḥ śabdā ekadeśe vartante, kāyādayastu samudāye,
kathameṣāṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyam? avayavena samudāyopacārāt|
tadevaṃ karmadhāraye kṛte prādhānyādevotarapadārthasya liṅgaṃ
bhaviṣyati, nārthastatpuruṣagrahaṇena, nāpyekadeśisamāsena
ṣaṣṭhīsamāsapraṅgaḥ iti cenna; iṣṭatvādanabhidhānācca|
tatraitsyāt--yadyapi pūrvakāya ityādīti rūpāṇi karmadhārayeṇāpi
sidhyanti, tathāpi mukhyārthavṛttiṣu kāyādiśabdeṣu yathā pūrvaṃ
kāyasyetyevamādi vākyaṃ bhavati, tathā kāyapūrva ityādi
ṣaṣṭhīsamāso'pi syād, atastannivṛtaye ekadeśisamāsa ārabdha iti?
tacca naivam; iṣṭatvādanabhidhānācca| tatra tāvad ṭhdvitīyatṛtīya'
ityatrānyatarasyāṃprahaṇātsūtrakārasya ṣaṣṭhīsamāsa
iṣṭaḥ---bhikṣādvitīyamiti, ṭharddhaṃ napuṃsakam' ityatrāpi bhāṣyakāra
āha---ṭhiṣyate'tra ṣaṣṭhī samāso'pi, tadyathā---apūpārdhaṃ mayā bhakṣitam'
iti| asti ca paiṅgalesūtre prayogaḥ---svarārdhaṃ cāryārdhamiti|
pūrvāparetyatra tvanabhidhānāt ṣaṣṭhīsamāso na bhaviṣyati||
pūrvavadaśvavaḍavau|| 2|4|27 ||
pūrvavadaśvavaḍavau|| aśvaḍavayoriti| ṭhvibhāṣā vṛkṣa' ityatra ṭhpaśudvandva'
ityeva siddhe'śvavaḍavagrahaṇaṃ pratipadavidhānārtham, tatra
pratipadavidhānādaśvavaḍavamityekavadbhāvapakṣe imaṃ vidhaṃ bādhitvā ṭhsa
napuṃsakam' ityetadeva bhavati| tacchabdena hyaekavadbhāvabhājaṃ
parāmṛśya vidhīyamānaṃ napuṃsakatvamapyekavadbhāvavadeva
pratipadavihitaṃ bhavati| yastu pūrvavadityatideśaḥ sa
ekabadbhāvābhāvapakṣe caritārthaḥ, tadāha---tatraikavadbhāvādanyatreti|
na nipātanamiti| nipātane hi pūrvavaditi vacanamanarthakam,
avivakṣitamityarthaḥ| nipātane tu tadvivakṣitaṃ syād,
yathoccāritarūpaviṣayatvānnipātasya||
hemantaśiśirāvaherātre ca cchandasi|| 2|4|28 ||
hemantaśiśirāvaherātre ca cchandasi|| hemantaśiśirāviti| atra
napuṃsakatvaṃ prāptaṃ śiśiraśabdasya napuṃsakatvāt| kecitu ṭhhemantaḥ
śiśiro'striyām' ityubhayaliṅgaṃmanyante, teṣāmatra
hemantaśiśirāvityanarthakam| ahorātre iti| atra ṭhrātrāhnāhāḥ
puṭhsa' iti puṃstvaṃ prāptam| liṅgavyatyaya ukta iti | ṭhvyatyayo
bahulam' ityanena|| 
rātrāhnāhāḥ puṃsi|| 2|4|29 ||
rātrāhnāhāḥ puṃsi|| ityete puṃsi bhāṣyante iti|
kecidāhuḥ---rātrādīnāmevānena puṃstvaṃ vidhīyate, tadantasya tu
paravalliṅgamityeva siddhamiti| evaṃ tu samāhāre ṭhsa napusakam'
ityetadeva syāt, paravalliṅgapavādatvātasya, tasmādrātrādyantasya
samāsasyaivedaṃ liṅgavidhānaṃ yuktam,| evaṃ hi samāhāre'pi
paratvādidameva pravartate| ityete puṃsi bhāṣyante ityatra tvetadantā
ityartho draṣṭavyaḥ| trirātra iti| samāhāre dviguḥ, ṭhahaḥ sarvaikadeśe'
ityac samāsāntaḥ| pūrvāhṇa iti| ahnaḥ pūrvo bhāgaḥ, ekadeśisamāsaḥ|
ṭhrājāhaḥ sakhibhyaṣṭac',ṭhahnehna etebhyaḥ' ityahnādeśaḥ,
ṭhahno'dantāt' iti ṇatvam| dvyaha iti| ṭhna saṃkhyādeḥ samāhāre'
ityahnādeśābhāvaḥ, ṭhahnaṣṭakhoreva' iti ṭilopaḥ|
anuvākādayaḥ puṃsiti| vākyaviśeṣasya tāḥ saṃjñāḥ karmaṇi ghañantā
iti napuṃsakatve prāpte vacanam||
apathaṃ napuṃsakam|| 2|4|30 ||
apathaṃ napuṃsakam|| ṭhpathaḥ saṃkhyāvyayādeḥ'
ityasyāparakālabhāvitvādayamārambhaḥ| apathamiti| ṭhpatho vibhāṣā' iti
yadā samāsāntapratidheṣo na bhavati tadā ṭhṛkpūrabdhūḥ' samāsāntaḥ|
samāsāntanirdeśācca tadabhāvapakṣe puṃstvameva bhavati--apanthā iti|
tatpuruṣa iti vartataiti| etadarthameva ṭhsa napuṃsakam' ityasyānantaraṃ
na kṛtam|| 
ardharcāḥ puṃsi ca|| 2|4|31 ||
ardharcāḥ puṃsi ca|| sāhacaryācchatrinyāyena
kārṣāpaṇādīnāmapyardharcaśabdena grahaṇamityāha----ardharcādaya iti
bahuvacanamatra pramāṇam| śabdarūpāśrayā ceyaṃ dviliṅgateti|
asmiṃścchabdarūpe liṅgadvayaṃ bhavatītyetāvadatra vivakṣitam, na
punarasya śabdasya yāvānarthastatra sarvatra liṅgadvayaṃ
bavatītyevamapītyarthaḥ| kimevaṃ sati siddhaṃ
bhavatītyāha----kvaciditi| arthabhedena vyavasthayāpi bhavalliṅgadvayaṃ
tatraiva śabde saṃpravṛtamiti bhāvaḥ| atrodaharaṇamāha---yatheti|
ṭhśaṅkhaḥ padmaśca vijñeyau dhanadasya mahānidhī'| kriyāśabdasyeti|
tadyathā---bhūtaṃ kāṇḍam, bhūtā śālā, bhūto ghaṭa iti|
yaugikasyābhidheyavalliṅgamiti| yadyapi lavaṇavṛterapi
saindhavaśabdasya yogo'pi nimitam, tathāpi rūḍhiśaktirapi tatra
nimitam| ato yaugikasyeti kevalayoganimitasyetyarthaḥ|
abhidheyavalliṅgamiti, yathā---sindhau bhavaṃ saindhavaṃ jalam,
saindhavo matsyaḥ, saindhavī śapharīti| utkarṣe tuṃlliṅga iti|
candanasāraḥ, khadirasāra iti| dharma ityapūrve puṃlligā iti|
yāgādikriyājanyaḥ svargādiphalānuguṇaḥ kartaryutpannaḥ
saṃskāraviśeṣaḥūapūrvam| bhāṭṭāstu apūrvasādhane yāgādāveva
dharmaśabdaṃ puṃlliṅgammanyante----ṭhcodanālakṣaṇo'rtho dharmaḥ',
ṭhdravyakriyāguṇādīnāṃ dharmanvaṃ sthāpayiṣyate' iti|
śābare'pyuktam----ṭhyo yāgamanutiṣṭhati taṃ dhārmika ityācakṣate'
iti||
idamo'nvādeśe'śanudātastṛtīyādau|| 2|4|32 ||
idamo'nvādeśe'śanudātastṛtīyādau|| anvādeśo'nukathanamiti|
śabdārthakathanametat, yāddaśastvatrābhipretastāddaśaṃ paścādvakṣyati|
ābhyāṃ chātrābhyāmiti| ādeśa eṣaḥ| atho ācchabhyāmiti|
eṣo'nvādeśaḥ| athośabdena cātrānvādeśa'bhivyajyate|
nanu tṛtīyādāvayamādeśastatatra ca ṭāyāmosi cainādeśo vakṣyate,
anyāḥ sarvā halādayaḥ, tatra halilopenaivābhyāmityādirūpaṃ siddham;
nārtha ādeśavacanena, tatrāha--ādeśavacanamiti|
ajñātādyarthavivakṣāyāmakaci kṛte ṭhhali lopaḥ' ityatra ṭhanāpyakaḥ'
ityato'ka ityadhikārādidrūpalopo na syāt, satyapi ca
tasminnābhyāmityādi rūpaṃ na siddhyat;
tasmātsākackārthamādeśavacanam| sāckārthe cāsmin śitkaraṇaṃ
sarvādeśārtham, na vāntyasya vikāravacanānarthakyāt| yadi
hyayamantyasya vikāraḥ syādvacanamidamanarthakaṃ syāt; tyadādyatvenaiva
siddheḥ| arthavadvādeśapratiṣedhārtham| antyasyāpi
vikāravacanamarthavadeva, ye'nya ādeśā ābhyāmityādau dīrghādayaste
mā bhūvannityakārasyāpyakāravacanaṃ syāt, yathā---morājisamaḥ kvau'
iti makārasya makāravacanamanusvāranivṛtyartham| nanu ca kṛte'pya
kaci anenādeśe satyābhyāmityādirūpasya sādhāraṇyā9dajñātādyarthagatiḥ
prakaraṇādhīnā| yadyevam, anutpattirevākaco'stu,
prakaraṇādinaivājñātādyarthaḥ pratipatsyate,| ato'nudātatvameva
vidheyam, nādeśaḥ? ucyate----asatyādeśe
prakaraṇādikamantareṇākacaiva kaścidajñātādikaṃ pratipādayet, maivaṃ
pratipīpadadityādeśavacanam| utarārtha ca| anudātavacanaṃ kimartham,
yāvatā ṭhūḍidampadādi' iti vibhakterudātatvaṃ śeṣanighātenaiva
siddham| anudātavacanaṃ vibhaktvayantasyānudātārtham, śeṣanighātena
hi prakṛterevānudātatvaṃ siddhyati| kathaṃ
punaridamastṛtīyādāvaśādeśo bhavati, sa cānudāta ityanena
vibhaktyantasyānudātatvaṃ vidhātuṃ śakyam? nānena
vibhaktyantasyānudātatvaṃ vidhīyate, kiṃ tvanena prakṛteranudātatve
kṛte ṭhūḍiḍham' ityatrāntodātādityadikārādasati
vibhakterudātatveṭh anudātau suppitau' ityanudātatvādābhyāmityādi
padaṃ kṛtsnamevānudātaṃ bhavati| yadyanvādeśo'nukathanam, ihāpi
prāpnoti---devadataṃ bhojajaya, imaṃ ca yajñadatamiti, asti
hyatrānvādeśaḥ, tatra dvidīyāṭaussvenaḥ' ityenādeśaḥ prāpnoti? ityata
āha---neheti| ekasyaivābhidheyasyetyādi| tatraivānvādeśaśabdaḥ
prasiddhatara iti bhāvaḥ||
etadastratasostratasau cānudātau|| 2|4|33 ||
etadastratasostratasau cānudātau|| punarvacanamanudātārthamiti|
pāñcamiko'śādeśa udātaḥ syād, anudātaśceṣyate ityanudātārtha
punarvacanam| tratasoriti vacanaṃ nimitabhāvārtham; anyathā ṭhtratasau
cānudātau' ityanvācayo vijñāyeta---yatra tratasau paśyasi tatra
tāvanudātāviti| kimarthaṃ punastratasoranudātatvamiṣyate,
yāvatā'trāta ityādau tratasoḥ kṛtayoḥ prakṛterlitsvare kṛte
śeṣanighātena pratyayānudātatvesatyaśanudātaḥ kariṣyate? yadyevaṃ
labhyate, kṛtaṃ syāt; tatu na labhyam| iha hi tratasoḥ
kṛtayorlitsvaraśca prāpnoti, anena cānudāto'śādeśaḥ, tatra yena
nāprāptinyāyenāpavādatvānnityatvāccānudāte'śādeśe kṛte
tadvidhānasāmarthyādapavādasya litsvarasyāpravṛtānutsargaḥ pratyayasvara
eva tratasoḥ syāt, yathā---goṣpadapramityatra ṇamula ulopena sahi
vidhānāllitsvarāpravṛtau pratyayādyaudātatve sati
kṛdutarapadaprakṛtisvareṇāntodātaṃ padaṃ bhavati| tasmāt ṭhtratasau
cānudātau' iti vaktavyam||
dvitīyāṭaussvenaḥ|| 2|4|34 ||
dvitīyāṭaussvenaḥ|| anantaratvādetada evainādeśaḥ prāpnoti,
idamo'pīṣyate, tadidamo grahaṇaṃ kartavyam? na kartavyam,
ṭhidamo'nvādośe' ityata idama ityanuvartiṣyate,
etadastratasorityatrāpi saṃbandhātasyāpi
tratasorādeśaprasaṅgastatrāha---idamo
maṇḍūakaplūtinyāyenānuvṛttiriti| idamapyatra vaktavyam----idamo
hapratyayena bādhitatvātralo'sambhāvātratasohityatrāsambandha iti|
yadi paramanuvṛttisāmarthyātasyāpyādeśena bhāvyam, na cāsati trali
tadvidhānamupapadyata iti tralaḥ satā parikalpyate? kalpyate? tadapi na;
utarārthamapyanuvṛttisambavāditi| enaditi napuṃsakaikavacane
vaktavyamiti| enādeśe kṛte ṭhato'm' ityambhāve satyenamiti
prāpnotyata enadādeśo vaktavyaḥ| yadyevam, ayameva sarvatrāstu, nārtha
enādeśena, katham---enam enau enān, ainena, enayoriti?
tyadādyatve kṛte bhaviṣyati, napuṃsakaikavacane tu nityatvāt
ṭhsvamornapuṃsakāt' iti luki kṛte enaditi syāditi siddham, iha
tvenaṃ śrita iti dvitīyāsamāse yadyapyenādeśo'thāpyenadādeśaḥ,
ubhāyabhyāmapi na bhāvyam, katham? ṭhantaraṅgānapi vidhīn
bahiraṅgo lugbādhate',tasmādetacchrita iti bhavati| ekamaeva
vidhānamiti| ṭhayaṃ daṇḍaḥ' ityanena daṇḍasya satāmātramupalakṣyate, na
tu kiñcidvidhīyate| evamīṣadartha ityādinā ākārasya svarūpamātraṃ
nirdiśyate, na tu kiñcidvidhīyate||
ārdhadhātuke|| 2|4|35 ||
ārdhadhātuke|| vadhyāditi| āśiṣi liṅ, ṭhliṅaśiṣi'
ityārdhadhātukasaṃjñā| hanyāditi| vidhyādiliṅ| viṣayasaptamī
ceyamiti| sāmānyanirdeśo'yam| tatra vyāpitvānnityatvācca na tena
saha deśakālakṛtaṃ paurvāparyaṃ sambhavati, tasyādviṣayasaptamī| yadi
tu vyaktinirdeśena parasaptamī syāt, bhavyamityādi na syāt| tathā
hihalantatvādastyādīnāmṭhṛhalorṇyad' iti ṇyati kṛte tatra parata
ādeśairbhāvyam| tatra dvayorvṛddhau kṛtāyāṃ tṛtīyasya ca
yuki---bhāvyam, pravaiyam, ākhyāyyamiti prasajyeta| iha ca ṭhbruvo
vaciḥ' bruvo'jantatvādyati kṛte vacyādeśe ca vacyamiti prāpnoti,
viṣayasaptamyāṃ tu naiṣa doṣa ityāha---teneti| yathāprāptamiti| yo
yataḥ prāpnoti, sa tato bhavatītyarthaḥ| ṭhasiddhavadatrābhāt' ityasya
bhāvābhāvavyavasthārtham| atra cāṅgādhikāre ca
dvirārdhadhātukādhikāraḥ kriyate| yadi
hyaete'pyādeśāstatraivavīdhīreyan, jakṣatuḥ, adhijage, adhyagīṣṭa,
babhūva, vivyaturiti ghasādyādeśānāmasiddhatvādupadhālopātallope
tvavugyaṇo na syuḥ| yadi tvatolopādayo'pyatravidhīyeran; gataḥ,
gatavānityanunāsikalopasyāsiddhatvātṭhgrato lopaḥ' syādityeṣā
dik||
ado jagdhirlyapti kiti|| 2|4|36 ||
ado jagdhirlyapti kiti|| ṭhlyap' iti pṛthak padaṃ
luptasaptamīkam| iha padadvayāpekṣaṃ samāsamapekṣamāṇo
lyabbahiraṅgaḥ, ktvāpratyayamātrāpekṣastu jagdhyādeśo'ntaraṅgaḥ; tatra
ktvāvasthāyāmeva jagdhau kṛte prajagdhyeti siddham, nārtho
lyabgrahaṇena| evaṃ tarhi lyabviṣaye'pyantaraṅgatvāti kitītyeva
siddhe jagdhau lyabiti yaducyate tajjñāpayati---antaraṅgāṇāmapi
vidhīnāṃ hiprabhṛtīnāṃ lyapā bhavati bādhanamiti| vidhāya,vihāya,
pradāya, prakhāya, prakhanya, prasthāya, prakamya, āpṛcchaya, pradīvya,
prapaṭha|letyeṣu vidhiṣu ṭhdadhāterhiḥ' ṭhjahāteśca ktvi' do dad
ghoḥ' ṭhjanasanakhanāṃ sañjhaloḥ' ṭhdyatisyatimāsthāmiti kiti'
ṭhanunāsikasya kvijhaloḥ kṅiti' ṭhcchavoḥ śūḍanunāsike ca'
ṭhārdhadhātukasyeḍvalādeḥ' ityete vidhayaḥ ktvāvasthāyāmeva prāptā
bahiraṅgena lyapā bādhyante|
eṣa evārthaḥ ślokāntareṇa bhāṣye kathitaḥ----jagdhividhirlyapi
yatadakaraṇam| akaraṇaṃ niṣprayojanamityarthaḥ| siddhamadasti kitīti
vidhānāt| ado jagdhividhānamityarthaḥ| jñāpakārtha lyapi
jagdhividhānamityāha---hiprabhṛtīstu sadā bahīraṅgo lyabbharatīti
kṛtaṃ tadu viddhi| lyabbharatīti, lyabādeśo haratiuvyapanayati,
bādhate ityarthaḥ| ṭhu' iti nipāto'vadhāraṇe| tadevāsya
prayojanamityarthaḥ||
luṅsanorghaslṛ|| 2|4|37 || 
luṅsanordhastu|| nanu ṭhsṛghasyadaḥ kmarac' iti vacanād
nnnnnnnnntyantaramasti? satyam; aderātsīd atsiṣatītyaniṣṭṃa rūpaṃ
mā bhūditi yogārambhaḥ| prātīti praghasa iti, pacādyac| asyāpi
sūtravadeva prayojanam||
ghañapośca|| 2|4|38 ||
bahulaṃ cchandasi|| 2|4|39 ||
bahulaṃ cchandasi|| ghastāmiti| luṅ ṭhmintre ghasa' ityādinā
calerluk, ṭhbahulaṃ cchandasyamāṅyoge'pi' ityaḍabhāvaḥ|
sagghiriti| ṭhghasibhasoḥ' ityupadhālopaḥ, ṭhjhalo jhali', samānā
gdhiriti caṭhsamānasya cchandasi' iti sabhāvaḥ| anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇameva
kasmānna kriyata iti, kaḥ puranevaṃ sati guṇa ityāha----tadeveti|
prakṛtyantarasya sadbhāvādasya prayojanaṃ prayojanaṃ mṛgyam||
liṭa|lnyatarasyām|| 2|4|40 ||
liṭa|lnyatarasyām|| prakṛtyantarasyāsarvaviṣayatvajñāpanārthamidam|
tena yatra liṅgaṃ vacanaṃ vā nāsti, tatra tasya prayogo na bhavati|
tatra lṛditkaraṇaṃ luṅ priyogasya liṅgam, ghasiśca
sānteṣvityanudātapāṭho valādāvārddhadhātuka, ṭhsṛghasyadaḥ kmarac'
iti vacanaṃ kmaraci| bhūvādau parasmapadiṣu pāṭhātparasmaipade
prayogaḥ||
veño vayiḥ|| 2|4|41 ||
hano vadha līṅ|| 2|4|42 ||
hano vadha liṅ|| yikārāntaścāyamādeśa iti| kuta etat?
śailīyamācāryasya yatra vyañjanānta ādeśastatrekāramuccārayati, yathā
jagdhyādau| tasmādikārākaraṇādakārānto'yamādeśaḥ| halantalajñaṇā
vṛddhirna bhavatīti| utarasūtreṇa vadhādeśe kṛta iti bhāvaḥ||
luṅ ci|| 2|4|43 ||
ātmanepadeṣvanyatarasyām|| 2|4|44 ||
ātmanepadeṣvanyatarasyām|| āhasateti| ṭhāṅe yamahanaḥ'
ityātmanepadam| ṭhātmanepadeṣvanataḥ, ṭhhanaḥ sic' iti sicaḥ
kitvāt ṭhanudātopadeśa' ityanunāsikalopaḥ||
iṇo gā luṅi|| 2|4|45 ||
iṇo gā luṅ|| iguriti| ṭhgātisthā' iti sico luk, ṭhātaḥ' iti
jherjus, ṭhusyapadāntāt'| iṇvadika iti vaktavyamiti| yadyasyaivāyaṃ
prakaraṇasya śeṣaḥ syāt ṭhiṇikorgā luṅ---īti sūtranyāsaḥ kartavyaḥ'
ityavakṣyata; yatastu khalu pṛthagiṇvadika ityāha, tena
manyāmahe---sarvasya śāstrasya śeṣo'yamiti| tena ṭhiṇo yaṇ'
ṭhetistu śāsu' ityādyapi bhavati----adhiyanti, adhītyeti||

gāṅ liṭi|| 2|4|49 ||
gāṅ liṭi|| dvilakārako'yaṃ nirdeśaḥ---liṭi lakārādāviti| tena
prāgevādeśebhyo lāvasthāyāmevādeśo bhavati| kiṃ siddhaṃ bhavati?
adhijage---ṭhdvirvacane'ci' iti sthānivadbhāvo na bhavati|
ṅtkiraṇamanarthakaṃ sthānivadbhāvādeva
siddhamātmanepadamityāśaṅkyāha---gāṅyanubandhakaraṇamiti| gāṅiti
grahaṇaṃ yathā syāditi| nanu caitadapi sthānivadbhāvādeva siddham,
netyāha---na hīti| ṭhgāṅkuṭādibhyaḥ' iti ucyamāne ṭhkai gai rai
śabde' iṇo gā luṅītyetayorapi grahaṇaṃ prāpnoti,
tataścāgāsīnnaṭaḥ, agāsātāṃ grāmau devadatenetyatrāpi
ghumāsthādisūtreṇetvaṃ prasajyeta| 
apara āha---yatra sānubandhakātṣaṣṭhayuccāryate,
tatrākṛtāyāmevetsañjñāyāmādeśaḥ pravartate, satyāmapi vā
tasyāmanubandhakāryamādeśe na bhavatītyasyārthasya jñāpanārtha
gāṅyanubandhakaraṇamiti| kiṃ prayojanam? ṭhcakṣiṅḥ khyāñ'ṅti
ityātmanepadaṃ na bhavati; ñidādeśakaraṇasāmarthyāt ṭhsvaritañitaḥ'
ityetadeva bhaviṣyati| iha tarhi ṭhlaṭaḥ śatṛśānacau', laṭa iti
sānubandhakātṣaṣṭhī, pacamānaḥ, ṭhṭitaḥ' ityetvaṃ na
bhavatīti?prakṛtānāmātmanepadānāmetvavidhānādiha na bhavati| iha
tarhiṭhyuvoranākau' ityatra bhujyaḥ, śaṃyurityatra mā bhūditi,
anunāsikokārānubandhau yuvū sūtre nirdiṣṭau; tataśca nandanaḥ,
kārakaḥ, nandanā, kārikā sthānivadbhāvādugillakṣaṇau ṅībnumau
prāpnutaḥ, asmāj jñāpakānna bhavataḥ| anunāsikayaṇostatra grahaṇam, na
tvanunāsikokārānubandhayoriti nātrogitkāryaprasaṅgaḥ| iha hi
ṭhserhyapicca,'sipo hiriti vaktavyam, apicceti na vaktavyam, iha ca
ṭhtuhyaestātaṅ iti tipsipostadāśiṣīti
sānubandhakātṣaṣṭhīmuccārthādeśo vidheyaḥ, ṅtkiraṇaṃ na kartavyam|
iha ca ṭhtasthasthamipām' iti pakāro noccārthaḥ,
tenācinavamityādau guṇasiddhiḥ, ṭhaṇiñoranārṣayoḥ ktvo lp'
ityādaai yatra sthānyanubandhakāryamiṣyate tatrānanubandhakaḥ
sthānyupādeyaḥ| vārāhyā prakṛtyetyādau vṛddhirguṇapratiṣedhaśca bhabrati
tadevamasya pakṣasya mandatvādanupanyāsaḥ||
vibhāṣā luṅlṛṅe|| 2|4|50 ||
ṇau ca saṃśceṅeḥ|| 2|4|51 ||
ṇau ca saṃśceṅe|| adhyāpipayiṣatīti| ṭhkrīṅjīnāṃ ṇau' ityātvam|
adhyajīgapaditi| luṅ ciṅ ṭhṇiu caṅyupadhāyā hrasvaḥ',ṭhsanvallaghuni',
ṭhdīrgho laghoḥ'||
asterbhūḥ|| 2|4|52 ||
asterbhūḥ|| bhavatereva bhavitetyādau

anuprayoge tviti| anuprayogeuviṣaye
bhuvāubhūbhāvenāsteranivṛttiṃ manīṣiṇaḥ smaranti| kartuḥū
