bruvo vaciḥ|| 2|4|53 ||
bru vo vaciḥ|| bruva ārdhadhātuke prayoganivṛtyartha vacanam|
vaktetyādikaṃ tu vacereva siddham||
cakṣiṅḥ khyāñ|| 2|4|54 ||
cakṣiṅḥ khyāñ|| kartrabhiprāye kriyāphale ākhyāsyate, ācakhye
ityātmanepadaṃ yathā syāt, tṛjādau cakṣitetyādi mā bhūditi ca
yogārambhaḥ| ākhyātetyādi ṭhkhyā prakathane' ityasyaiva siddham| atra
yathānyāse ākārātpūrvo bhāgaḥ khakārayakārātmeti syādākhyāteti,
kakāraśakārātmāpi tviṣyate---ākśāteti,
tadetadāha--kśādirapyayamiti| kakāre'kāra uccāraṇārthaḥ|
apara āha---khyādirevāyamādeśa iti| atrāpyakāra uccāraṇārthaḥ| tatra
cartve kṛte kśātetyādi bhavati| kathamākhyāteti khakārayakārayoḥ
śravaṇam? asiddhakāṇḍe ṇatvavidhānānāntaraṃ khśāñaḥ śasya yo veti
śasya yatvaṃ vibhāṣā vaktavyam| tatra cartve yatvaṃ
siddhamityākhyātetyādi yatvapakṣe rūpam, anyadā kaśāteti rūpam|
avaśyaṃ ca śasya yatvamityāśrayaṇīyam| iha supracaṣṭe suprakhyaḥ,
ṭhātaścopasarge' iti kaḥ, tato yatvasyāsiddhatvātsuprakhyasya bhāva iti
ṭhyopadhādgurūpotamāt' iti vuñ na bhavati, ayopadhatvāt|
tasminsati ṣyañ bhavati----sauprakhyamiti| tathā suprakhyena nirvṛte
deśe bhavaḥ sauprakhyīyaḥ, sauprakhyīyaḥ, dhanvayopadhāditi vuñ na
bhavati, ṭhvṛddhācchaḥ' eva bhavati| akhyātaḥ, yatvasyāsiddhatvādyaṇvatvā
bhāvāt ṭhsaṃyogādeḥ' iti natvaṃ na bhavati, ṭhna
dhyākhyāpṛmūrcchimadām' ityatra khyāgrahaṇaṃ na kartavyaṃ bhavati| puṃsaḥ
khyānaṃ puṃkhyānamityatra yatvasyāsiddhtvāt ṭhpumaḥ khayyampare'iti
ruvidhirna bhavati| paryākhyānam, yatvasyāsiddhatvācchakāreṇānaṭā
vyavāyāt ṭhkṛtyacaḥ' iti ṇatvābhāvaḥ| naṭaḥ khyātetyatra
yatvasyāsiddhatvāt kharaḥ śarparatvāt ṭhśarpare visarjanīyaḥ' iteyaṣa
vidhirbhavati| nanvasiddhe śasya yavacane'pi ṭhkhyā prakathane'
ityasyautpatika eva yakāra iti tatra vuñādiprasaṅgaḥ? evaṃ tarhi
so'pi khśādiḥ, śasya yavacanamapi sādhāraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam|
nṛcakṣā rakṣa iti| chāndasaḥ prasogaḥ| bhāṣāyāṃ tu nṛcakṣau rakṣa iti|
vicakṣaṇa iti| ṭhanudātetaśca halādeḥ' iti yuc| vadhaka iti| ato
lopasya sthānivatvādvṛddhyabhāvaḥ| gātramiti| ṣṭranigādeśaḥ|
ajiramiti| ṭhajiraśiśira' iti nipātanamanāddatyoktam||
vā liṭi|| 2|4|55 ||
ajervyaghañapoḥ|| 2|4|56 ||
ajervyaghañapoḥ|| pravayaṇīyaḥ, pravāyaka ityādau guṇavṛddhiviṣaye
hrasvadīrghayoraviśeṣaṃ manvānaḥ pṛcchati---dīrghoccāraṇaṃ kimiti|
dīrghavyākhyānamityarthaḥ| ghañapoḥ pratiṣedhe kyapa upasaṅkhyānamiti|
kyapi yaḥ pratiṣedhastasya kyapsambandhī bhavatīti kyapa ityuktam|
yastvāha---apītyeva kyapi siddhaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ, katham? abiti
pratyāhāraḥ, apo'kārādārabhyā kyapaḥ pakārād iti, tasya
saṃvītiriti ktinyapi pratiṣedhaḥ prāpnoti,
tasmātsaṃjñāgrahaṇātsamajyetyatra vībhāvābhāvaḥ| na hyādeśena saṃjñā
gamyate| valādāvārghadhātuke veṣyata iti| nārtho'nayeṣṭa|la, nāpi
ghañapoḥ pratiṣedhena, nāpi kyapa upasaṅkhyānena, nāpi ṭhvā yau' iti
sūtreṇa; etāvadastu---ṭhvā liṭi', ajervītyeva,
vyavasthitavibhāṣeyam, tena ghañapāḥ kyapi naiva bhavati, valādau yau
ca vikalpaḥ, anyatra nityam||
vā yau|| 2|4|57 ||
ṇyakṣatriyārṣañito yūni lugaṇiñoḥ|| 2|4|58 ||
ṇyakṣatriyārṣañito yūni lugaṇiñoḥ|| ṇyādayo gotrapratyayā iti|
ṭhgotrādyauunyastriyām' iti gotrapratyayāntādeva yūni
pratyayavidhānāt| kṣatriyagotrasyakṣatriyādabhedopacārāt
kṣatriyaśabdenābhidhānam| ṛṣerapatyamārṣam, ṭhitaścāniñaḥ' iti ḍhaki
prāpte śivādipāṭhādaṇ| ḍhagapīṣyate----ārṣeyaṃ vṛṇīte iti|
tasmācchubhrādiṣvapi paṭhanīyaḥ| evaṃ gotrarūpābhyāṃ kṣatriyārṣābhyāṃ
pratyayasyopalakṣaṇād ṇyādayo gotrapratyayā ityuktam| kṣatriyāditi|
kṣatriyagotrapratyayāntādityarthaḥ| ārṣāditi| ṛṣyabhidhāyino
gotrapratyayāntādityarthaḥ| prathamanirdiṣṭād
ṇyāntādaṇo'sambhavāccaramanirddiṣṭo'pīñeva prathamamudāhṛtaḥ|
kṣatriyagotrasya tatra grahaṇamiti| aurasaśabdena sāhacaryāt| sa hi
ṭhjanapadaśabdāt kṣatriyādañ' ityañantatvātkṣatriyaśabdaḥ| urasaśabdaḥ
sakāropadho janapadavācī, tasmādyauuni prāgdīvyatīyo'ṇiti| ṭhpheśccha
ca' iti ca ñacchau tu na bhavataḥ, yamundaśca suyāmā ceti
parigaṇanāt| kaṇvādibhyo gotre iti śaiṣiko'ṇiti| vāmarathasya
kaṇvādivatsvaravarjamiti kurvādiṣu pāṭhāditi bhāvaḥ|
abrāhmaṇagotramātrāditi| atra bhāṣye trīṇi
vākyānyupanyastāni---aṇiñorluki
tadrājāhyuvapratyayasyopasaṃkhyānamiti prathamam,
asyodāharaṇam---baudhiḥ pitā, baudhiḥ putrā; audumbariḥ pitā,
audumbariḥ putraḥ, budhodumbarābhyāṃ śālvavayavālakṣaṇa iñ
ṭhyañiñośca' iti phak, tasya luk| anaṇiñarthametadvacanabh|
śālvāvayayavetyatrodumbarāstilakhilā ityādi saṃbhavodāharaṇaṃ na
parigaṇanamiti budhaśabdādapīñ bhavati|
kṣatriyagotramātrādyauvapratyayasyopasaṃkhyānamiti dvitīyam| mātraśabdo
vyāptyarthaḥ, tadrājāditi niyamo nāsti---kṣatriyagotramātrāditi|
tena jābālaśabdādata iño'tadrājādapi parasya phako lug
bhavati---jābāliḥ pitā, jābāliḥ putraḥ| vṛttikāreṇonyastaṃ
tṛtīyam| atrāpi mātraśabdo vyāptyarthaḥ| kṣatriyādityāpi niyamo
nāsti---abrāhmaṇagotramātrāditi, tena vaiśyagotrādapi bhavati|
bhāṇḍijaṅghakarṇakharakau vaiśyau, tābhyāmata iñ tadantātphako luk|
vyāpakatvāccedamupanyastaṃ vṛttikāreṇa||
pailādibhyaśca|| 2|4|59 ||
pailādibhyaśca|| pīḍayateḥ pacādyaci kapilādidarśanādasya latve pīlā|
anye pailādaya iñantā iti| tatra bāhvādiṣu ṭhudañcu' iti paṭha|lte|
ukāra uccāraṇārthaḥ,kvini nopadhatvaṃ nipātyate| audañciḥ| ṭhacaḥ'
ityakāralopaḥ, ṭhuda īt' itītvaṃ ca na bhavati; luptanakārasya tatra
grahaṇāt| bhūliṅgaśabdaḥ śālvāvayavaḥ| sātyakiśabdamapi
kecitpaṭhanti, so'pi bāhvādīñantaḥ| satyakaśabdād ṭhṛṣyandhaka'
ityaṇā bhāvyam| śeṣā ata iñantāḥ| śālaṅkiriti| asmādeva
nipātanācchalaṅkoriñ, śalaṅkādeśaśca| tadrājāccāṇa iti|
tadrājasaṃjñakādaṇaḥ parasya yuvapratyayasya lugbhavati| ṭhdvañmagadha'
ityaṇantādāṅgaśabdāt ṭhaṇo dvyacaḥ' iti phiño luk| āṅgaḥ
pitā, āṅgaḥ putraḥ| tadevaṃ gaṇavākyametadekam, pūrvapataṭha
tāini trīṇīti catvāri yathotaramadhikaviṣayāṇi||
iñaḥ prācām|| 2|4|60 ||
iñaḥ prācām|| ṭhprācāmavṛddham' ityādau prāggrahaṇaṃ vikalpārtham,
iha tu na tathetyāha---gotraviśeṣaṇamiti| yuvapratyayasya
lugvidhānādarthādākṣiptaṃ gotramiti bhāvaḥ| pannam u prāptam agāraṃ
yena sa pannāgāraḥ| mantharā u mandībhūtā eṣaṇā yasya sa mantharaiṣaṇaḥ||
na taulvalibhyaḥ|| 2|4|61 ||
na taulvalibhyaḥ|| ṭhtula upamāne', auṇādiko valac| tulvalaḥ|
dhārayatipārayatibhyāṃ nandyādilyuḥ---dhāraṇaḥ, pāraṇaḥ| devā
mitramasyeti devamitraḥ| devebhyo yajño'sya devayajñaḥ| ṭhpuṣa
puṣṭau', kyap, puṣyaḥ| vilakṣaṇau karṇāvasya vikarṇaḥ| kareṇuṃ
pālayati kareṇupālaḥ| ṭhasu kṣepaṇe', kurac---asuraḥ|
ṭhhṛñharaṇe', anupūrvāllaṭaḥ śatrādeśaḥ, puṣkare sīdatīti
puṣkarasat, bāhvādī anuśatikādī ca| pariśiṣṭāḥ pārāyaṇe
draṣṭavyāḥ||
tadrājasya bahuṣu tenaivāstriyām|| 2|4|62 ||
tadrājasya bahuṣu tenaivāstriyām|| iha bahuṣvityanena
jasādibahuvacanaṃ vā gṛhyaeta? artho vā ? ādye pakṣe'yamartho
bhavati---jasādiṣu bahuvacaneṣu paratastadrājasyāstrīliṅgasya
lugiti| dvitīye---bahuṣvartheṣu vartamānasyeti| bahuvacanaśabde hi
jasādiṣu viniyukte tadekadeśena bahuśabdenāpi jasādi śakyaṃ
lakṣayitum| saṃjñānāmekadeśasyāpi prayogadarśanād bhīmo
bhīmasenaḥ, satyā satyabhāmeti| jasādīnāṃ ca bahutvād bahuṣviti
bahuvacanopapatiḥ| nanvevamapi mukhyatvādarthagrahaṇameva yuktam?
satyam; tenaiva grahaṇādasya pakṣasya sambhavaḥ| taddhi priyavāṅgā
ityādau bahuvacanaṃ paramiti lukaḥ prasaktasya nivṛtaye kṛtam|
arthagrahaṇe cātra tadrājasya bahutve vṛtyabhāvādeva luko'prasaṅgaḥ|
yadyevam, asmādeva liṅgād bahuvacanasyaiva
niścayādartagrahaṇasyāsambhavaḥ? ucyate---astriyāmiti pratiṣedhādasya
pakṣasya sambhavaḥ| taddhyāṅgyaḥ striya ityādau tadrājasya bahuṣu
vartamānasya luṅmā bhūditi kṛtam| bahuvacanagrahaṇe cātra
strīpratyayena vyavadhānādeva luko'prasaṅgaḥ| na cāmbaṣṭhasyāpatyāni
bahvyaḥ striyaḥ ṭhvṛddhetkosalājādāñ ñyaṅ' ṭhyaṅścāp' āmbaṣṭha|la
ityatrekādeśasyāntavadbhāvādavyavadhānāllukprasaṅgaḥ; ekādeśasya
pūrvavidhau sthānivadbhāvādatrāpi cāpā vyavadhānāt| tadevaṃ
liṅgadvayadarśanātpakṣadvayasambhavaḥ|
evamutareṣvapi yogeṣu draṣṭavyam| tatrādyo
pakṣe'tikrānto'ṅgānatyaṅgaḥ, atigargaḥ, aṅgebhya
āgato'ṅgarūpyaḥ, gargarūpya ityādau bahuvacanaparatvābhāvālluṅna
syāt| na caca vṛtyarthe vākye yacchasādi bahuvacanaṃ tatraiva
paratastasyāmevāvasthāyāṃ luglabhyate'ntaraṅgatvāditi vācyam;
ṭhantaraṅgānapi vidhīn bahiraṅgo lugbādhate' iti vacanāt| na
ca lupte'pi tasminpratyayalakṣaṇena luglabhyaḥ, ṭhna lumatāṅgasya' iti
niṣedhāt| nanu ca na lugaṅgasya kāryam, kiṃ tarhi? tadekadeśasya
pratyayamātrasya, aṅgarūpya ityādau ca samarthātaddhitotpateḥ vṛtyarthe
vākye yadvahuvacanamaṅgebhya ityādi tatraiva luk bhaviṣyati| idaṃ
tarhi----atrerapatyāni bahūni ṭhitaścāniñaḥ' iti ḍhak, tasya ṭhkitaḥ'
ityantodātatvam, tasya jasi parataḥ ṭhatribhṛgu' iti luki kṛte
udātanivṛttisvaraḥ prāpnoti, tasmād dvitīyaṃ
pakṣamāśrityāha---bahuṣu vartamānasyeti|
nanvatrāpi pakṣe āṅgaśca vāṅgaśca sauhmaśra aṅgavaṅgasuhmāḥ,
gārgyaśca vātsyaśca vājayaśca gargavatsavājā ityādau dvandve lugna
syāt; atra hyaekaikasminnevārthe pratyaya utpannaḥ, pūrvatra tu
pakṣe'ntimasyāpi tāvatsiddhyati, bahuvacanaparatvāt? naiṣa doṣaḥ;
yugapadadhikaraṇatāyāṃ dvandvaḥ, tatraikaikasya vartipadasya
bahvarthakatvāllugbhaviṣyati| nanvevamapi taddhite
utpattidaśāyāmekaikasminnevārthe utpanna iti tadrājo yo bahuṣu yañ
yo bahuṣu añ yo bahuṣvityucyamāno luṅ na syādeva| nanvatra
bahuṣvityanena na pratyayamātraṃ viśeṣyate, kiṃ tarhi?
pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣayā tadantagrahaṇe sati tadantaṃ
viśeṣyate---tadrājāntaṃ yadvahuṣu yañantaṃ yadbahuṣu añantaṃ
yadvahuṣviti| yadyevam, kaśyapasyāpatyaṃ kāśyapaḥ bidādyañ, tasya
pratikṛtaya iti ṭhive pratikṛtau' iti kan, tasya ṭhjīvikārthe
cāpaṇye' iti devapathādiṣu arcāsu pūjanārthāsviti pāṭhādvā lupi
kṛte kāśyapā ityañantasya pratikṛtibahutve luk prāpnoti? naiṣa
doṣaḥ; ṭhyañañośca' ityatra ṭhyaskādibhyo gotre' ityato ṭhgotre'
ityanuvartate, tena gotrabahutve luk pratikṛtibahutve na
bhaviṣyati| nanvevamapyāṅgasyaikasya pratikṛtayo bahvya iti
tadrājāntasya bahuṣu vṛterlukprasaṅgaḥ| nahmatredamasti---tadrājāntaṃ
yadapatyaṃ bahutve vartata iti | evaṃ tarhi tenaiva grahaṇamasminpakṣe na
kartavyamityuktaṃ tadatropayokṣyāmahe---yasminnarthe lugbhāvī pratyaya
utpannastenaiva cetkṛtaṃ bahutvamiti| iha cāpatye pratyaya utpannaḥ
pratikṛtikṛtaṃ ca bahutvam, yadyevam, āṅgasyāpatyāni ṭhaṇo
dvyacaḥ' iti phiñ, tasyābrāhmaṇagovamātrāditi vā ṭhtadrājāccāṇaḥ'
iti vā luk, aṅgāḥ, baidasyāpatyāni ṭhata iñ', ṭhṇyakṣatriya' iti
luk, bidāḥ, atra gotre pratyaya utpanno yuvakṛtaṃ cātra bahutvāmiti
luṅ na syāt? naiṣa doṣaḥ; tenaivetyasya tajjātīyenaivetyarthaḥ,
yuvā cāpatyatayā tajjātīyo na pratikṛtiḥ| evaṃ ca kṛtvā dvandvo
yadā lopināmalopināṃ ca bhavati tadā na
bhavati----āṅgadevadatayajñadatāḥ, gārgyadevadatayajñadatāḥ| iha tu
bhārgavaśca vātsyaścāgrāyaṇaśca bhṛguvatsāgrāyaṇā iti, yadyapi
nalopibhireva kṛtaṃ bahutvam, āgrāyaṇe naḍādiphako lugabhāvāt;
tathāpyapatyatayā tajjātīyatvamastīti lugbhavatyeva| yadyevam,
gārgyaśca kāśyapaśca gālavaśca gārgyakāśyapagālavānāmityatra gālave
ṛṣyaṇo lugabhāve'pyapatyatayā tajjātīyatvādyañañorlukprasaṅgaḥ| evaṃ
tarhi bhṛguvatsāgrāyaṇeṣu ṭhagārgyakāśyapagālavānām' iti
nirdeśadvayāllopibhirapatyapratyayaiḥ kṛte bahutve vikalpaḥ| tadevaṃ
tadrājāntasya bahutve vartamānasyeti sthitam| vṛtau tu
tadrājasañjñakasya pratyayasya bahuṣu vartamānasyeti vyadhikaraṇo
ṣaṣṭha|le, bahuṣu vartamānasyāstrīliṅgasya tadrājāntasya yo'vayavaḥ
pratyayastasyetyarthaḥ| tenaiva cetadrājeneti| atrāpi
tadrājāntenetyarthaḥ| tadrājetyāpi lopipratyayopalakṣaṇam|
aṅgagargalohadhvajā ityādāvapi bhavatītyāhuḥ| ihāṅgasyāpatyāni
bahūnyaṅgāsteṣāmapatyaṃ yuvā yuvānau vā āṅgaḥ āṅgāviti
yuvasaṅkrānteḥ prāggotre'lugacīti pratiṣedhāllugabhāvaḥ, paścātu
bahutvābhāvād| acīti ca viṣayasaptamī, tena yuvapratyaye
paścāllumatā lupte'pi viṣayabhūta eva tasmin prāgeva lukaḥ
pratiṣedhaḥ, lupte'pi vā pratyayalakṣaṇena| nanvacīti
vacanādvarṇāśrayo'yam, netyāha; acīti prāgdīvyatīyasya pratyayasya
viśeṣaṇaṃ pratyayaśca luki nimitam|
āṅgyaḥ striya iti| iha ca āṅgī ca vāṅgaśca sauhmaśceti dvandre
āṅgotiśabdena strītvayuktānāmabhidhānātadaṇo lugna bhavati,
āṅgīvaṅgasuhmā iti bhavatītyāhuḥ||
yaskādibhyo gotre|| 2|4|63 ||
yaskādibhyo cagotre|| pratyayavidheścānyatreti| gotre yatra pratyayo
vidhīyate ṭhgotre kuñjādibhyaścphañ' ityato'nyatretyarthaḥ| tatra
tāvadapatyādhikāre gotragrahaṇādeva pāribhāṣikasya grahaṇam, anyatra
laukikasyetyatra jñāpakaṃ vakṣyāmaḥ| puṣkarasacchabdasyeti| kimartha
punarayamatra paṭha|lte, yāvatā ṭhbahvaca iñaḥ prācyabharateṣu' ityeva siddhaṃ
puṣkarasadaḥ prācyatvāt, tathā cetaḥ prācāmiti prāptasya lukaḥ
pratiṣedhāya taulvalyādiṣu paṭhitaḥ? evaṃ tarhi gopanādiṣu
kecitaulvalyādayaśceti paṭhanti, taulvalyādiṣu prakṛtibhāgā api
gopavanādiṣu draṣṭavyā ityarthaḥ| tena ṭhna gopavanādibhyaḥ' iti
niṣedhe prāpte'trāsya pāṭhaḥ| ayameva ca pāṭho
jñāpayati---gopavanādiṣu taulvalyādayo'pi paṭhitā iti||
yañañośca|| 2|4|64 ||
yañañośca|| gotrapratyayasya bahuṣu vartamānasyeti| atrāpi
vyadhikaraṇe ṣaṣṭhayau| bahuṣu vartamānasya samudāyasya sambandhī yo
gotrapratyayo yatra añ ca tasyetyarthaḥ| tena dvandve'pi
bhavati---gargavatsavājāḥ, bidaurvabharadvājā iti| gārgyaḥ striya iti|
ṭhyañaśca' iti ṅīp, ṭhhalastaddhitasya'| baidya iti| ṭhśāṅgarravādyaño
ṅīn'|
ekadvayoriti| ekatvadvitvayorityarthaḥ| ṭhsaṃkhyāyā alpīyasyāḥ'
ityekaśabdasya pūrvanipātaḥ| ṭhdvyekayoḥ' iti nirdeśād
dviśabdasyāpi bhavati| gārgyayoḥ kulaṃ gārgyakulamiti|
prakaraṇādivaśād dvitvāvagatau dvivacanāntasyāpi viruddhaḥ samāsaḥ||
atribhṛgukutsavasiṣṭhagotamāṅgirobhyaśca|| 2|4|65 ||
bahvaca iñaḥ prācyabharateṣu|| 2|4|66 ||
bahvaca iñaḥ prācyabharateṣu|| bharatāpatyeṣu
bharataśabdā'bhedopacārādvartate, yathā----ṭhraghūṇāmanvayaṃ vakṣye' iti|
yudhiṣṭhirārjunaśabdābhyāṃ kurvāṇo'pavādo bāhvādilakṣaṇa iñ|
balākāśabde'pi bāhvādiḥ|
bharatāḥ prācyā eveti| ṭhprācyabharateṣu' iti dvandvastu
sāmānyaviśeṣavācinorgobalīvardanyāyeneti bhāvaḥ||
na gopavanādibhyaḥ|| 2|4|67 ||
na gopavanādibhyaḥ|| pariśiṣṭānāṃ haritādīnāṃ pramādapāṭha iti|
nanu ceha sthāne na gopavanādayaḥ paṭha|lnte, kiṃ tarhi? caturtha eva
bidādiṣu tadupajīvanenaitatpravartate| atha caturtha pāṭhaḥ pramādaja
ityujyate, bidādyañapi tarhi na prāpnoti| atha gopavanādibhyaḥ paratra
pāṭhaḥ pramādajaḥ pūrvatra pāṭhayaḥ----ityucyet, evamapi
ṭhharitādibhyo'ñ' ityeṣa vidhirgopavanādīnāmapi prāpnoti|
tasmādyathāvyavasthita eva pāṭhe madhye vṛtkaraṇaṃ vartavyam, iha vā prāk
haritādibhya iti vaktavyam| yathoktam----ṭhgopavānādibhyaḥ pritiṣedha
prāggharitādibhyaḥ' iti| vṛttikārastu caturthe'tra capṛthak pāṭhṃa
manyate||
tikakitavādibhyo dvandve|| 2|4|68 ||
tikakitavādibhyo dvandve|| dvandvarūpāṇyeva gaṇe paṭha|lnte| tikādīni
pūrvapadāni kitavādīnyutarapadāni, tatra ṭhtikādibhyo dvandve'
ityucyamāne pūrvapadeṣveva lugāśaṅkyeta utarapadeṣvapi yathā
syāditi tikakitavādibhya ityuktam| ādiśabdaḥ
pratyekamabhisambadhyate, tadāha---tikādibhyaḥ kitavādibhyaśceti||
upakādibhyo'nyatarasyāmadvandve|| 2|4|69 ||
upakādibhyo'nyatarasyāmadvandve|| dvandve cādvandve ceti| katham ṭhadvandve'
ityucyamāne dvandve cādvandve ca bhavati, tadāha----advandvagrahaṇaṃ
dvandvādhikāranivṛtyarthamiti| nātra śāstrīyo'dhikāraḥ
svaritatvanibandhano vivakṣitaḥ na hi pūrvasūtre dvandvaśabda
āsaktasvarita, tasmāllaukiko'dhikāro vyapekṣālakṣaṇaḥ| tadiha
dvandvaśabdena tadviṣayā vyapekṣābhidhīyate, tasyā nañā niṣedhaḥ---advandve
iti| kimuktaṃ bhavati? dvandva iti nāpekṣyata iti, tadanapekṣāyāṃ dvadve
cādvandve ca bhavati| ṭhadvandva' ityasminnasati laukiko'dhikāro dvandvasya
śaṅkyet, dvandvacaiṣāmeva parasparaṃ gṛhyate, teṣāṃ pūrveṇa nityaṃ
lugbhavatīti| bhāṣye tu bhrāṣṭakikāpiṣṭhalaya
ityudāharaṇātikakitavādiṣvasya pāṭho'nārṣa iti niścayaḥ||
āgastyakauṇḍinyayoragastikuṇḍinac|| 2|4|70 ||
āgastyakauṇḍinyayoragastikuṇḍinac|| kuṇḍinośabdasya yañi
ṭhbhasyā'ḍhea taddhite' iti puṃvadbhāve ṭhnastaddhite' iti lope kauṇḍa|l
iti prāpnoti, asmādeva nipātanātpuṃvadbhāvaḥ| asati ca
tasminnīkārasya yasyeti lopaḥ, tasya
sthānivatvādābhīyatvenāsiddhatvādvā ṭilopābhāvaḥ|
āgastyakauṇḍinyetyetayorgotrapratyayayoriti vyadhikaraṇe
ṣaṣṭhayau, etayoryāvavayavāvītyarthaḥ| tāveva svarūpeṇa
darśayati---aṇaśca yañaśceti| madhyodāto hi kuṇḍinīśabda iti|
kuṇḍamasyātīti ṭhatainiṭhanau' pratyayasvaraḥ, ṅībanudātaḥ| nanu
mānuvṛtaṃ luggrahaṇam, pratyayāntayoravādeśau stāmata
āha---tayorityādi| yadi hi pratyayāntayorevādeśau
syātām---ṭhgotre'lugaci' iti pratiṣedho na syād, luko hyasau
niṣedho nādeśasya, tataścādeśe satyavṛddhatvādaṇeva syāt; luki
tu sati tasya pratiṣedhe
tatsanniyogaśiṣṭasyādeśasyāpyabhāvāddhṛddhalakṣaṇaśco bhavati| tatra
viśeṣo nāstīti kimartha tarhīdamuktam---aṇaśca yañaśca bahuṣu
lugbhavatīti? evaṃ manyate----yadi kuṇḍinajādeśaḥ samudāyasya syād
agastyādeśo'pi tathā syād; ato'vaśyaṃ luganuvarttyaḥ,
anuvṛtasya ca kauṇḍinyenāpi saṃbandhaḥ; viraedhābhāvāditi||
supo dhātuprātipadikayoḥ|| 2|4|71 ||
supo dhātuprātipadikayoḥ|| atra ṭhsupaḥ' iti saptamībahuvacanaṃ na
gṛhyate; ṭhpañcamyā stokādibhyaḥ' ityādinā
pañcamyādīnāmalugvidhānāt| nāpi kapaḥ pakāreṇa pratyāhāraḥ,
taddhitānāṃ vidhānasāmarthyāt; anyathā taddhitāntasya
prātipadikatvātadavayavasya sarvasyaiva taddhitasya luk syāt,
ṭhdvigorluganapatye' ityetaccānarthakaṃ syāt| ataḥ suśabdādārabhya
supaḥ pakāreṇa pratyāhāra ityāha--supo vibhakteriti|
dhātuprātipadikayoriti yadi saptamī syād dhātuprātipadikayoḥ
parataḥ supau luk syāt---kāṣṭhèaḥ pacati, śobhanaiḥ kāṣṭhèariti,
tasmātṣaṣṭhīyamityāha---supo vibhakterdhātusaṃjñāyāḥ
prātipadikasaṃjñāyā iti| dhātuḥ saṃjñā yasyāstasyā ityarthaḥ| kathaṃ
punarvibhaktirdhātusaṃjñā prātipadikasaṃjñā vā bhavati,
tatrāha---tadantargatā iti| evamapi dhātuprātipadikayoravayavabhūtā
vibhaktayaḥ syurna tatsaṃjñāḥ? neṣa doṣaḥ; samudāyeṣu hi vṛtāḥ śabdā
avayaveṣvapi vartante| dhātuprātipadikayoravayavasya supa ityapi
vyākhyāne na kaściddoṣaḥ| pratyuta ṭhsupaḥ' ityasya dvivacanāntena
sambandho na durupapādo bhavati, tathā tu na vyākhyātamityeva||
adiprabhṛtibhya śapaḥ|| 2|4|72 ||
adiprabhṛtibhya śapaḥ|| katham ṭh na viśvasedaviśvaste viśvaste'pi na
viśvased' iti, tathā bhaṭṭikāvye---ṭhāśvaseyurniśācarāḥ' iti, tathā
ṭhna viśvasetpūrvavirodhitasya' iti? niraṅgaśāḥ kavayaḥ| apara
āha---ṭhkṣamūṣ sahane' ghaṭādiḥ; tatra ṭhghaṭādayaḥ ṣitaḥ' iti siddhe
ṣitkaraṇaṃ jñāpakam---anityaṃ gaṇakārthamiti,
tenaivamādiprayogopapatiriti nātra kiñṭacidapabhāṣitamasti||
bahulaṃ cchandasi|| 2|4|73 ||
yaṅe'ci ca|| 2|4|74 ||
yaṅe'ci ca|| aci pratyaye parata iti| pacādyacītyarthaḥ| etadeva
jñāpakam---sarvadhātubhyaḥ pacādyac bhavatīti| pratyāhāragrahaṇaṃ tu na
bhavati, tathā hi sati---aṇītyeva vaktavyam; anyājādeḥ
pratyayasyāsaṃbhavāt| na tu cchandasīti| ṭhhuśnuvoḥ sārvadhātuke'
ityatra vārtikam---ṭhhuśnugrahaṇamanarthakamanyasyābhāvāt'| yānti
vātītyatra kṅtītyidhikārānna bhaviṣyati, yātaḥ vātaḥ,
acītyanuvartate| yānti vānti, oriti| yuvanti ruvanti, anekāca
iti vartate| ayuvan, aruvan, aḍāgamo'siddhaḥ| prorṇavanti,
asaṃyogapūrvasyeti vartate| yaṅluṅnivṛtyartha tarhi
huśnugrahaṇam---yoyuvati, roruvati| yaṅlugarthamiti
cedārdhadhātukatvāstiddham, chāndaso yaṅluk, tatra ṭhcchandasyubhayathā'
ityārdhadhātukatvādeva na bhaviṣyati| tadevaṃ
yaṅlukaśchāndasatvamabhyupagamya huśnugrahaṇaṃ pratyākhyātaṃ
vārtikakāreṇa| sa manyate---cakāreṇātra ṭhbahulaṃ cchandasi' iti
sarvamanuvartiṣyate, tenāci pratyaye parataḥ cchandasi bhāṣāyāṃ yaṅe
lug bhavatītyekaṃ vākyam, cchandasi bahulamanaimitiko lugiti
dvitīyam, prasiddhaśca tathā chāndaso yaṅlugiti| prayogaśca
cirantanaḥ padye gadye ca kāvyākhyāyikādau
vikaṭapadaepanyāsapradhānairapi kavibhirna kṛto ddaśyate|
bhāṣyakārastu ṭhhuśnuvoriti vakṣyanti, evaṃ
tarhyetajjñāpayati---bhāṣāyāmapi yaṅluk' iti, tena cecidīti,
cecchidīti, yoyavītītyādi siddhaṃ bhavati| vṛttikārastu
manyate----ṭhyadi jñāpakenāpi tāvadbhāṣāyāmapi yaṅlukaḥ prayoge
bhavati, hantaivamatraiva cchandograhaṇaṃ mānuvṛtat! prayegastu
jñāpakāśrayeṇaiva yathābhidhānaṃ vyavasthāsyate' iti, ato na
bhāṣyavārtikavirodho vṛteḥ śaṅkanīyaḥ||
juhotyādibhyaḥ śluḥ|| 2|4|75 ||
juhotyādibhyaḥ śluḥ|| śabanuvartate, na yaḍiti| ślāviti
dvirvacanavidhānāt| yaṅnuvṛtau hi ślunā tatra lupte'pi
ṭhsanyaṅeḥ' iti ṣaṣṭha|laśrayaṇād dvirvacanasiddheranarthakaṃ tatsyāt|
bibhartīti| ṭhbhṛñāmit' ityabhyāsasyetvam| nenektīti|
ṭhṇijirśaucapoṣaṇayoḥ',ṭhṇijāṃ trayāṇāṃ guṇaḥ ślau'||
bahulaṃ cchandasi|| 2|4|76 ||
gātisthāghupābhūbhyaḥ sicaḥ parasmaipadeṣu|| 2|4|77 ||
gātisthāghupābhūbhyaḥ sicaḥ parasmaipadeṣu|| abhūditi|
ṭhbhūsuvostiṅ' īti guṇapratiṣedhaḥ| luganuvartate, na śluriti|
vyākhyānāt| 
iṇpibatyorgrahaṇamiti| iṇādeśo gā iṇityuktaḥ, tatra
gātītyādāvikasyeṇoya ādeśastadanukaraṇo gā tipi śablukā
nirdiṣṭaḥ, sthānivadbhāvātprakṛtivadanukaraṇaṃ bhavatīti caca| tena
ṭhgāmādāgraha8ṇeṣvaviśeṣaḥ' iti lākṣaṇikasyāpi gārupasya yadyapi
grahaṇaṃ prāptam, tathāpi gātīti nirdeśādeva tasya nivṛttiḥ| tathā
ṭhlugvikaraṇālugvikaraṇayoralugvikaraṇasyaiva grahaṇam' iti
pibatereva grahaṇam| agāsīt, apāsīditi| ṭhkai gai rai śabde' pā
rakṣaṇe' yamaramanamātāṃ sakca' iti sagāgamaḥ, sicaśceṭ,
ṭhastisico'pṛkte' itīṭ, ṭhiṭa īṭi'| pai ovai śoṣaṇe' ityasya
lākṣaṇikaṃ pārūpamiti grahaṇābhāvaḥ|
agāsātāmiti| karmaṇyātmanepadam, ātām||
vibhāṣā ghrāgheṭśācchāsaḥ|| 2|4|78 ||
vibhāṣā ghrāgheṭśācchāsaḥ|| dheṭaḥ sānubandhakasya nirdeśa
ātvaparihārārthaḥ| ṭhdhā' ityucyamāne pratipadoktatvāddhāña eva grahaṇaṃ
syāt| nanu satyapyanubandho ccāraṇe'nubandhānāmanekāntatvāt
ṭhnānubandhakṛtamanejantatvam' ityudīcāṃ māṅ itivadātvaṃ
prāpnoti? satyam; ayameva nirdeśo jñāpayati---sānubandhānukaraṇe
nāvaśyakamātvamiti| tena sūtrādvahirapi veñaḥ, dheṭaḥ, daipa ityādi
prayogopapatiḥ| aghrāsātāmiti| karmaṇyātmanepadam, ātām|
sumanasāviti| ṭhstriyaḥ sumanasaḥ puṣpam' ityamarasiṃhaḥ,
ṭhapsumanassamāsikatāvarṣāṇāṃ bahutvaṃ ca' iti pāṇinīyaṃ sūtram|
tadvahutvaṃ prāyikaṃ manyate, ekā ca sikatā tailadāne samarthā' iti
bhāṣye prayogāt|| 
tanādibhyastathāsoḥ|| 2|4|79 ||
tanādibhyastathāsoḥ|| udāharaṇeṣu svaritetvādātmanepadam| thāsā
sāhacaryāditi| yadyapi tāvadayaṃ taśabdo
ddaṣṭāpacāraḥ---astyātmanepadamasti ca parasmaipadam, asti
caikavacanamasti ca bahuvacanam| ayaṃ tu khalu thāḥ
śabdo'ddaṣṭāpacāra---ātmanepadamekavacanaṃ ca, tasyāsya ko'nyaḥ
sahāyo bhavitumarhati, anyadata ātmanepadādekavacanācceti bhāvaḥ|
ātmanepadasyeti| upalakṣaṇametat| ekavacanasyetyapi draṣṭavyam||
mantre ghasahvaraṇaśavṛdahādvṛcakṛgamijanibhyo leḥ|| 2|4|80 ||
mantre gasahvaraṇaśavṛdahādvṛcakṛgamijanibhyo leḥ|| clerevātra
grahaṇamiṣyate, na liṅadīnām, tadarthaṃ ṭhsicaḥ'
ityanuvartayanti---sico yo liḥ sthānibhūtastasyeti vyācakṣate|
sici prakṛte ligrahaṇam ṭhādiḥ sico'nyatarasyām'
ityādisickāryaṃ mā bhūditi| pūrvatra hi mā hi dātāmiti
sicsvaro bhavatyeva| hvareti vihitaguṇasyānukaraṇam,
akāraścāgntuka uccāraṇārthaḥ| akṣanniti| ṭhluṅsanorghaslṛ',
ṭhgamahan' ityupadhālopaḥ, ṭhśāsivasi' iti ṣatvam| prāṇaḍiti|
braścādinā ṣatve jaśtvacatve| prāṇagiti pāṭhe ṭhnaśervā' iti
kutvam| āprāditi| ṭhprā pūrtau' āṅpūrvaḥ| ajñateti| ṭhjanī
prādurbhāve', anudātet| bahuvacanasya ṭhātmanepadeṣvanataḥ'
ityadādeśaḥ, pūrvavadupadhālopaḥ, ścutvam| brāhmaṇe
prayogo'yamiti| mantravyatirikto vedabhāgaḥubrāhmaṇam| yathāha
bhagavāñjaimaniḥ----ṭhyaccodakeṣu mantrākhyā iti mantralakṣaṇāntaram,
śeṣe brāhmaṇaśabdaḥ' iti| bahvacānāṃ hariścandrabrāhmaṇe hariścandraṃ prati
varuṇasyaitadvākyam---ajñata vā asya dantā iti| kathaṃ punarmantragrahaṇe
brāhmaṇagrahaṇaṃ bhavati? tatrāha---mantragrahaṇantviti| mantrasya
cchandorūpatvātaena tadupalakṣyate| bāhulyena tu mantre
darśanānmantrāgrahaṇaṃ kṛtam||
āmaḥ|| 2|4|81 ||
āmaḥ|| āma utarasya lerlugbhavatīti| yadyapi sicā lirviśeṣitaḥ,
tathāpīha lerityevānuvartata iti bhāvaḥ|
vidāmakranvidāṅgurvantvityatra luṅloṭornipātanāllugbhavati|
tarabādīnāṃ cāmantādanutpattireva, tasyānabhivyaktapadārthatvāt| ayaṃ
ca lugnāprāpteṣu tibādiṣu vidhīyamānatvāllādeśānāmapavādaḥ|
tenāmantasyātiṅntatvāccakṣuḥ kāmam, yājayāñcakāretyatra
ṭhtiṅṅatiṅaḥ' iti, tasya cānighātaḥ, tasmācca nighātaḥ siddho bhavati|
kathamāmantasya padatvam? subantatvāt| lakārasya
kṛtvātprātipadikatvam| tiṅbhāvino hi lakārasyātiṅiti
pratiṣedhaḥ, na cāyaṃ tiṅbhāvī| supaḥ śravaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavati? āmaḥ
svarādiṣu pāṭhādavyayatvāt| taddhitenāmā sāhacarye'pi taddhita eva na
gṛhyate, api tu vyāpterataddhito'pi nañā tuca samāsaprasaṅgaḥ, na
kārayāṃ na hārayāṃ ṭhnañ' subantena samasyata iti samāsaḥ prāpnoti?
naiṣa doṣaḥ; abhivyaktapadārthena hi yājayāñcakāreti nañaḥ sāmarthyam,
na tvanabhivyaktapadārthenāmantamātreṇa| āmantebhyo ṇalaḥ
pratiṣedhaḥ----śaśāma, tatāma;vṛddhau kṛtāyāṃ sthānivadbhāvena ṇalo
ligrahaṇena grahaṇe luk prāpnoti? arthavad grahaṇātsiddham| arthavata
āmantasya grahaṇam, na caiṣo'rthavān| evamapi ṭhamagatyādiṣu', tipo
ṇal, āma----atra prāptoti, arthavatvāt? ṭhlakṣaṇapratipadoktayoḥ
pratipadoktasyaiva grahaṇam' iti atra na bhaviṣyati||
avyayādāpsupaḥ|| 2|4|82 ||
avyayādāpsupaḥ|| tatra śālāyāmiti| śālāśabdasannidhau
strītvayuktadravyagatakārakaśaktyabhidhānātasyāmitivatatretyatrāpi yadi
strīpratyayaḥ syātpadādeva strītvaṃ pratīyeteti vyāmohanivṛtyartha
ṭāpo lugvaktavyaḥ, yathā----ṣaṭsañjñakebhyaḥ pratiṣedha iti bhāvaḥ|
vārtikakārastvāha----ṭhavyayādāpo lugvacanānarthakyaṃ
liṅgābhāvāt' iti| kṛtvā, hṛtveti| yadā ṭhbahuṣu bahuvacanam'
ityādeḥ svādividhivākyenaikavākyatā, tadā nissaṅkhyebhyo
niṣkārakebhyaścāvyayebhyo'smādeva lugvidhānālliṅgatsvādayo
bhavanti, bhinnavākyatāyāmapi niyamapakṣe tulyajātīyasya niyamena
vyāvṛttiḥ----bahuṣveva bahuvacanaṃ na dvayorekasmin, dvayoreva
dvicanaṃ naikasminna bahuṣu, ekasminnevaikavacanaṃ na dvayorna bahuṣu,
ityavyayebhyaḥ svādīnāṃ sambhavaḥ| trikapakṣe tu yatra saṅkhyā sambhavati
tatraiva sā vācyatvena vidhīyate, avyayebhyastu niḥ saṅkhyebhyaḥ
sāmānyavihitāḥ svādayo vidyanta eveti sarvathāvyayebhyaḥ
subutpattireṣitavyā---pratyayalakṣaṇena padasañjñā yathā syāditi|
tubiti ca saptamībahuvacanasya pakāreṇa pratyāhāraḥ, na kapaḥ; āpaḥ
pṛthagupādānāt||
nāvyayībhāvādato'mtvapañcamyāḥ|| 2|4|83 ||
nāvyayībhāvādato'mtvapañcamyāḥ|| kimarthaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ? pūrvasūtreṇa
luṅmābhūditi| amatra vidhīyate, sa nāprāpte lukārabhyamāṇastasya
bādhako bhaviṣyati, yatra tarhi pratiṣidhyate, pañcamyāstatra luk
prāpnoti| pratiṣedhe tu satita tatsāmarthyād dve vākye
bhavataḥ-----nāvyayībhāvādityekam, amtvapañcamyā iti dvitīyam| atra
cāta ityapekṣyate| tatrāpañcamyā ityanenānantarasya vidhirvā bhavati
pratiṣedho veti pañcamyā ādeśaḥ pratiṣiddhyate, na
pūrvavākyavihitaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ| imamevārtha tuśabdena
dyotayati---aviśeṣeṇa pritaṣedhaḥ amtvapañcamyā iti,
tadetaduktam----tasminpratiṣiddhe pañcamyāḥ śravaṇameva bhavatīti|
vākyabhedastu vṛtāveva spaṣṭaḥ| upakumbhāditi|
samīpabhūtātkumbhādityarthaḥ| kumbhasya samīpādityapare|
unmatagaṅgādiranyapadārthapradhānaḥ satvavācyavyayībhāvaḥ
kriyāsambandhasadbhāvādapādānatvātpañcamyā mukhyamudāharaṇam||
tṛtīyāsaptamyorbahulam|| 2|4|84 ||
tṛtīyāsaptamyorbahulam|| subhadramiti| madrāṇāṃ
samṛddhirityavyayībhāvaḥ, tataḥ saptamī, tasyā nityamambhāvaḥ|
ekaviśatibhāradvājamiti| ekaviśatirbharadvājā vaṃśyā iti ṭhsaṅkhyā
vaṃśyena' iti samāsaḥ| tatra vartipadārthānāṃ
svārthopasarjanārthāntarābhidhāyitvādbhāradvājaśabda
ekatvaviśaṣṭārthāntare saṅkrānta ityaño lugabhāvaḥ| neti vayam,
gargāṇāṃ kulaṃ gargakulamityādāvapi prasaṅgāt| tasmād
bhāṣyakāraprayogādatra lugabhāvaḥ||
luṭaḥ prathamasya ḍārīrasaḥ|| 2|4|85 ||
luṭaḥ prathamasya ḍārīrasaḥ|| parasmīpadasyātmanepadasya ceti| yadyevaṃ
parasmaipade trayaḥ prathamapuruṣasaṃjñakāstibādayaḥ, ātmanepadeṣvapi
trayastādaya iti ṣaṭ sthāninastraya ādeśā iti
vaiṣamyātsaṃkhyātānudeśo na prāpnoti| mā bhūtsaṃkhyātānudeśaḥ,
āntaryato vyavasthā bhaviṣyati? arthataścāntaryam, ekārthasyaikārtho
dvyarthasya dvyartho bahvarthasya bahvarthaḥ| kathaṃ
punarḍādīnāmaikārthyādhyavasāyaḥ, yāvatā yastipaḥ sthāne sa ekārthaḥ,
yastassthāte sa dvyarthaḥ yo jheḥ sthāne sa bahvarthaḥ? netyāha,
prayogadarśanādapyaikārthyādikamadhyavasātuṃ śakyam| atha vā''deśā
api ṣaḍeva nirdiśyante, katham? ekaśeṣanidaśāt, ḍāraurasaśca
ḍāraurasaśceti kṛtadvandvānāmekaśeṣaḥ| yadi tu ḍā ca ḍā ca ḍā, rau
ca rau ca rau, ras ca ras ca ras, ḍā ca rau ca ras ca ḍāraurasa
iti kṛtaikaśeṣaṇāṃ dvandvaḥ syāt? aniṣṭaḥ saṃkhyātānudeśaḥ
prāpnoti tiptasorḍā, jhitayo rau, ātāṃjhayo rasiti| kartiti|
luṭ,tip, tasya ḍā ityayaṃ sarvādeśaḥ|
nānubandhakṛtamanekāltvam| astu tarhmantyasyaiva, tipastakāreṇa
saha ṭilopo bhavati| nanu takārāntamaṅgaṃ na bhavati,
ḍitkaraṇasāmarthādanaṅgasyāpi bhaviṣyati, yathā---siddhānte'bhasyaapi|
atha vā''nupūrvyātsiddham, katham? antyasyāpyayaṃ sthāne bhavannapratyayaḥ
syād, asatyāṃ pratyayasaṃjñāyāṃ ḍakārasyetsaṃjñā nāsti, asatyāṃ
cetsaṃjñāyāmanekāl, yadānekāl tadā sarvādeśaḥ, yadā
sarvādeśastadā pratyayaḥ, yadā pratyayastadetsaṃjñā, yadetsaṃjñā tadā
lopastadaikāl, na cedānīṃ pratyāvṛtyāntādeśo bhavitumarhati?
tadetadānupūrvyātsiddham| kartārau, kartāra iti| ṭhri ca' iti
tāsastyorlopaḥ| adhyeteti| ṭhiṅ adhyayane'| athātra ḍāraurassu
kṛteṣu ṭeretvaṃ kasmānna bhavati? pūrvamevāsminyoge sthāniṣu
pravṛtatvāt| iha hi taśabdasya ṭeretvaṃ ca prāpnoti, ḍādeśaśca;
dvayorapi śabdāntaraprāpteranityatvātparatvāṭṭeretve kṛte punaḥ
prasaṅgavijñānāḍḍādeśaḥ| evaṃ raurasorapi draṣṭavyam| atha vā---
pūrvameva ḍārauraso bhavantu, thāsaḥ sevacanaṃ jñāpakam----ye
tiṅadeśāsteṣāṃ ṭeretvaṃ na bhavatīti, anyathā ṭhthāsaḥ sa' ityeva
vācyaṃ syāt| kartāsīti| ṭhtāsastyoḥ' iti salopaḥ||
iti śrīharadatamiśraviracitāyāṃ padamañcaryo dvitīyādhyāyasya
turīyaścaraṇaḥ||
| samāpto'yaṃ dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ |

atha tṛtīyādhyāye prathamaḥ pādaḥ i padamañjarī 
pratyayaḥ|| 3|1|1 ||
pratyayaḥ|| iha yadi sarvāneva saṃjñinaḥ svarūpeṇa nirddiśya saṃjñā
vidhīyeta---san pratyayaḥ kyac pratyayaḥ, kyaṅ pratyaya iti, tato
gauravaṃ syāt| atha ṭhsap' pratyaya iti sanaḥ saśabdādārabhya kapaḥ
pakāreṇa pratyāhārāśrayeṇātra vā pradeśāntare vā saṃjñā vidhīyeta,
tadānekasya pakārasya sambhavātsandehaḥ syāt| tathā hi
rpyāsatinyāye āśrīyamāṇe sipaḥ pakāreṇa syād, vyāptau tu
ṭhtaptanaptanathanāśca' iti tanapaḥ| syādetat----vyāptirevāśrayiṣyate,
atha ca tanapaḥ pakāreṇa pratyāhāro na bhaviṣyati; jñāpakāt, yadayam
ṭhica ekāco'mpratyayavacca' ityamaḥ pratyayavadbhāvaṃ śāsti, anyathā
ṣaṣṭhe'pi pratyayasaṃjñāvyāpārādamo'pi svata eva
pratyayatvātadvadbhāvo nātideśyaḥ syāditi ? tanna; tatra hyamiti
dvirāvartate, tataścāpratyayapratibaddham ṭhauto'mśasoḥ'
ityādiviśiṣṭṃa kāryaṃ yathā syāditi so'tideśaḥ syāt|
nanvevamapi pratyayagrahaṇamanarthakam, amvaditi vaktavyam, ataḥ
pratyayagrahaṇātpratyayaprayuktamapi kāryamatideśyamati pratīyate,
tajjñāpakamuktārthasya bhaviṣyati? evamapyama āgamatvātpugādivadaprāpteḥ
pratyayatvātideśaḥ syāt| astu vā jñāpakam, evamapi kuta
etadvyāptirāśrīyate, na punaḥ pratyāsatiriti? kiñca
yathānyāsādrauravaṃ sthitameva, sabityasyādhikasya karaṇāt? ato
gauravātiprasaṅgaparihārāyādhikāreṇeyaṃ saṃjñā vidhīyate|
tadāha---pratyayaśabdaḥ saṃjñātvenādhikriyate iti|ṭhkārake' iti
tadviśeṣaṇamadhikriyate, svādiṣu kapparyanteṣu prakṛtiriyamadhikriyata
itivat| ṭhpratyayaśabdaḥ saṃjñādhikriyate' iti vaktavye saṃjñātveneti
vacanamanarthabhedāt| tathā hyamatra karmakaratvenādhikṛtaḥ, ayamatra
karmakaro'dhikṛtaḥ, nārthabhedo'sti; kintu ṭhkarmakaro'dhikṛtaḥ'
ityukte yaḥ karmakaraḥ so'dhikṛto rūpāntareṇetyapi gamyate,
karmakaratveneti punarucyamāne tasyaivākārasyādhikṛtatvaṃ gamyate|
adhikriyateu viniyujyate sūtrakāreṇa| yānu nādīnanukramiṣyāmaḥu
anukrameṇa vidhāsyāmaḥ| sūtrakārāyamāṇasya vṛtakārasyaitadvacanam|
yadi tarhyadhikāreṇa saṃjñā kriyate,
pratiyogamupasthānātprakṛtyupapadopādhivikārāgamānāmapi
prāpnoti---ṭhharaterddatināthayoḥ paśau' harateriti prakṛtiḥ,
ddatināthayorityupapadam, paśāvityupādhiḥ; ṭhhanasta ca'
ityādirvikāraḥ, ṭhtrapujatunoḥ puk' ityāgamaḥ| satyāṃ ca saṃjñāyāṃ
prakṛtipratyayayoḥ taryāyeṇa parasparāpekṣaṃ paratvaṃ syāt;
śabdāntarāpekṣaṃ vā prakṛteḥ, prakṛtyapekṣaṃ tu pratyayasya? upapadasyāpi
paratvāt ṭhupasarjanaṃ pūrvam' ityetadrājapuruṣādiṣu sāvakāśaṃ
bādhitvā paratvaṃ syāt, yatra samāsābhāvātṭhupasarjanaṃ pūrvam'
ityasyāprasaṅgaḥ, tatropapadasya paratvaṃ syāt? evaṃ ca sati bhoktuaṃ
vrajatītyevameva nityaṃ syānna tu vrajati bhoktumiti, upādherapyarthasya
paratvāsambhave'pi tadvācinaḥ prayogāniyame prāpte paraśceti niyamaḥ
syāt? ādyaudātatvaṃ ca yathāyathaṃ svarāntaraṃ bādhitvā syāt?
aṅgasaṃjñā tu vidhānapratibaddhā, na ceha prakṛtyādayaḥ
kutaścidvidhīyante iti na sā prakṛtyādiṣu parataḥ pūrvasya
prāpnoti? nanu ca pratiyogamupasthāne'pi
vākyabhedaprasaṅgātprakṛtyādīnāṃ saṃjñā na bhaviṣyati, tathā
hi---haraterddatināthayoḥ karmaṇorupapadayoḥ paśau kartarīn
pratyayo bhavatītyekaṃ vākyam, te ca haratyādayaḥ pratyayasaṃjñakā iti
dvitīyam, sambhavatyekavākyatve vākyabhedastu neṣyate? naitadasti;
sanādīnāmapyasatāṃ saṃjñānupapatervākyabhedenaiva saṃjñā vidheyā,
tataśca sanādīnāmekena vākyena vidhirapareṇa saṃjñāvidhiḥ, evaṃ
prakṛtyādīnāmapi prāpnoti? tatrāha---prakṛtyupapadetyādi|
ayamabhiprāyaḥ----prakṛtyādīnāṃ sanādyautpatau
nimitatvenopādānātpārārthyātsvasaṃskāraṃ prati prayojakatvābhāvaḥ
yathā--yaḥ pīṭhe sa devadata iti pīṭhasya devadatasaṃjñā na bhavati|
nanu sanādyautpativākye prathame teṣāṃ pārārthyam, na dvitīye
saṃjñāsaṃjñisambandhapratipādanapare vākye, tataśca
saṃjñāvidhānaparamevaṃrūpameva---guptijkidbhyaḥ san pratyaya iti,
tataśca tatrāpi bhūtavibhaktyānirddeśānnimitatvātpārārthyaṃ
sthitameva| kiñca, yogyavibhaktyabhāvācca na prakṛtyādīnāṃ saṃjñā,
prathamāntasya ṣaṣṭha|lntasya vā saṃjñāsambandhaḥ ṭhvṛddhirādec' ṭhsvaṃ rūpaṃ
śabdasya' iti| na ca dvitīye vākye yogyavibhaktyadhyāhāreṇa saṃjñā
bhavitumarhati; yogyavibhaktinirddiṣṭeṣu sanādiṣu
caritārthatvāt| upapadasaṃjñā tu saptamīniddiṣṭasya vidhīyamānā
yuktaṃ yadvākyabhedena yogyavibhaktyadhyāhāreṇa ca bhavatīti| kiñca,
pradhānetarasannidhau pradhāne kāryasaṃpratyayo bhavati, yasya
cāpūrvavidhānaṃ tatpradhānam; ataḥ prathamavākye tāvatsanādīnāmeva
prādhānyam, dvitīye'pi saṃjñā saṃjñinamapekṣamāṇā yatpūrvavākye
pradhānatayāvagataṃ tadevāpekṣate, na tu pāratantryādapradhānamiti
siddhamiṣṭam| evamapi vikārāgamānāṃ prāpnoti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; mahatī
saṃjñā kriyate, anvarthasaṃjñā yathā vijñāyeta---pratiyantyanenārthamiti
pratyaya iti| na ca vikārāgamābhyāmarthaṃ pratayinti| yadyevam, ṭhaveḥ
kaḥ' ityādīnāṃ samāsāntānāṃ ca na syād, na
hyaeṣāmanvayavyatirekābhyāṃ kaścidartho'vadhāryate, tadabhāve'pi
kevalāyā eva prakṛtestadarthāvagamāt|
yadapyucyate----anirddiṣṭārthāḥ pratyayāḥ svārthe bhavantīti svārtha
evaiṣāmartha iti, tadapi kalpanāmātram;
anvayavyatirekagamyatvādarthavatvasya| itaretarāśrayatvaṃ ca bhavati---sati
pratyayatve svārthe vidhānam, svārthe vidhānāccārthavatve sati pratyaya
saṃjñeti| evaṃ tarhi prayojanābhāvānna bhaviṣyati? tathā hi teṣāṃ
sthānaṣaṣṭha|lasambandhasyāvayasambandhasya ca pratipādanātparatvaṃ tāvanna
sambhavati, āgamānāṃ cānudātatvavidhānādādyaudātatvasyāsambhavaḥ, sati
tu prayojane āgamasyāpi śnamaḥ śakārasyetsaṃjñārtha bhavatyeva saṃjñā|
atha ṭhhanaśca vadhaḥ' ṭhnābhi nabhañca' ṭhvirāga viraṅgañca' ityādau
vadhādīnāmanekālānāmādeśānāṃ saṃjñā kasmānna bhavati, sambhavati hi
teṣu paratvaṃ prayojanam? yadyapi sthānina ādeśena nivartitatvānna
tadapekṣaṃ paratvam, śabdāntarāpekṣayā syādeva paratvam| yathoktaṃ
prāk--gupādiṣu arthavatvaṃ ca teṣāmasti, vidheyatvātprādhānyaṃ ca,
yogyā ca vibhaktiḥ| ataḥ sarvathā vadhādiṣu saṃjñānivṛtaye yatnaḥ
kartavyaḥ| kartavyam, karaṇīyāmati| atra pratyayasaṃjñāyāṃ
dhātoraṅgasaṃjñā, aṅgasya guṇaḥ| anantaramapi sanādikamatikramya
vyavahito'pi tavyadādirudāhaḥtaḥ, tatrādyaudātāderapi
pratyayakāryasya sambhavāt| sanādau tu nitsvareṇa dhātusvareṇa ca
tadvādhyate||
paraśca|| 3|1|2 ||
paraśca|| ayamapyadhikāra iti| na kevalam ṭhpratyaya'
ityayamevetyapiśabdārthaḥ| yoge yoge upatiṣṭhate iti| anena
paribhāṣāto'dhikārasya bhedako dharmo darśitaḥ| paribhāṣā hi na
pratiyogamupatiṣṭhate, kintvekadeśasthitaiva sarvaśāstre vyāpriyate|
paraśca sa bhavatītyādi| anenehasthāyā evāsyāḥ paribhāṣāyāḥ
pratyayavidhau sarvatra vyāpāro darśitaḥ| liṅgavatī ceyaṃ paribhāṣā,
pratyayasaṃjñā ca liṅgam| dhātorveti| kriyāvācinyāḥ
prakṛtestiṅntāderapyupalakṣaṇametat| prātipadikādveti|
akriyāvācinyāḥ prakṛteridamupalakṣaṇam, tena ṅyāporapi
grahaṇam| taitirīyamiti| titiriṇā proktamadhīte,
ṭhtitirivarantukhaṇḍikokhācchaṇ' ṭhcchandobrāhmaṇāni ca
tadviṣayāṇi',ṭhtadadhīte tadveda', ṭhproktālluk',
brāhmaṇakulasyābhidheyatvānnapuṃsakanvam| cakāraḥ punarasyaiva
samuccayārtha iti| anyasya samuccetavyasyābhāvāt| teneti| anyathā
bahulavacanasya sarvopādhivyabhicārārthatvāduṇādiṣu paratvasyāpi
vikalpaḥ sambhāvyeta, iha ṭhguptijkidbhyaḥ san' ityādau
digyogalakṣaṇā pañcamī, tatra pūrvaḥ para iti vā
dikśabdasyāśravaṇādaniyamenādhyāhāre satyaniyamena prayogaprasaṅge
niyamārthamidam---para eva pratyayo na pūrva iti| ṭhgāpoṣṭak'
ityādau ṣaṣṭhīnirddeśe'pyānantaryasambandhe
ṣaṣṭhīvijñānādānantaryasya ca pūrvatve'pi bhāvādaniyamaprasaṅga
eveti tatrāpi niyamārthameva| naitadasti prayojanam, ṭhvibhāṣā
supo bahuc purastātu' ityetanniyamārtha bhaviṣyati---bahujeva
purastādbhavati nānyaḥ pratyaya iti, tataśca bahuci pūrvatvasya
niyatatvādanyaḥ pratyayaḥ para eva bhaviṣyati, ṣaṣṭhīnirdeśeṣu
madhyaśabdādhyāhāreṇa madhye'pi prasaṅga iti cet,
na;ṭhavyayasarvanāmnāmakac prākṭeḥ' iti niyamāt akajeva
prakṛtimadhye bhavati, nānya iti? naitadevam; yadi tāvadevaṃ
niyamaḥ----bahujeva purastādakajeva madhye iti, tato
bahujakacorniyamo na syāt| atha bahuc purastādeva akajmadhya
eveti, tato deśasyāniyatatvātatra pratyayāntaraṃ syādeveti
sarvathāniṣṭaprasaṅgaḥ| kiñca akajeva prāk ṭerityevaṃ niyame prāk
ṭeḥ pratyayāntaraṃ mā bhūt, madhyāntare tu syādeva;
madhyaviśeṣāśrayatvānniyamasya| na ca ṭhtasmādityutarasya' ityanayā
paribhāṣayātra paratvaṃ siddhyati, yatra hi prāgova sataḥ kasyacit
kiñcidvidhīyate, yathā---padātparayorapādādau
vartamānayoryuṣmadasmadorvānāvau bhavata iti, sa tasyā viṣayaḥ; iha
tu prāgasanta eva sanādayo vidhīyante, na teṣāṃ sambandhi kiñcit,
pratyayasaṃjñaiva teṣāṃ kāryamiti cet, na; evamapi
prāgutpattiranivāritā syāt| tathā hi---asatāṃ sanādīnāṃ
sajñāvidhiranupapanna ityekena vākyena sanādīnāṃ vidhirdvitīyena ca
teṣāmeva saṃjñāvidhirityaṅgokaraṇīyam, tataśca dvitīye vākye
sataḥ kāryamiti kṛtvā paribhāṣopasthānena prāk prayuktānāṃ saṃjñaiva
kevalaṃ na syādutpattistvaniyatadeśaiva syāt; prathamavākye
paribhāṣānupasthānāt| syādetat---ṭhguptijkidbhyaḥ san'
ityādāvekaiva pañcamī, sā caikameva dikśabdamadhyāharet, tatra pūrvaḥ
paro veti saṃśaye pūrvaśabdādhyāhāre dvitīyasya vākyasya
svarasabhaṅgaḥ syāt| gupādibhyaḥ paraḥ san pratyayasaṃjño bhavatīti
hi tasya svarasataḥ prāpto'rthaḥ, sa ca pūrvavākye pūrvaśabdādhyāhāre
sati bhagnaḥ syāt, atastatparirakṣaṇāya paraśabda evādhyāhariṣyate|
bhavatu votpatiraniyatadeśā, paścātu sata eva parasya
yatkṛtyapratyayasaṃjñādiśāstrakāryam, tannānyadeśasya,yaddeśasya ca
śāstrīyaṃ kāryaṃ taddeśo'nyadeśaṃ nivartayiṣyati;
viśeṣaśāstrānvitatvena tasyaiva sādhutvāditi? astvevam, atha yeṣu
pratyayasaṃjñaiva na bhavati----ṭhśameḥ khaḥ' śaṅkhaḥ, ṭhkaṇeṣṭhaḥ' kaṇṭha
ityādiṣu, teṣu kathaṃ paratdam, dvitīyavākyavyāpārābhāvāt?
bhavato vā kathaṃ bhavānapi hi ṭhyaḥ pratyayaḥ sa paraḥ' iti pratyayapūrvakaṃ
paratvaṃ paribhāṣate? satyam; paribhāṣāpakṣe na syātparatvam,
adhikārapakṣe tu pratyayatvapūrvakaṃ paratvaṃ na bhavati; kintu
paratvaviśiṣṭasyaivotpannasya paścātpratyayasaṃjñā, iha tu
bahulavacanātpratyayatvābhāve'pi paratvamavirūddham| evamapi nārtha
etena, bahulavacanādeva paratvamevātra vyavasthāsyate? evaṃ tarhi
prayoganiyamārthamidam---para eva pratyayo na kevala iti; anyathā
pratyayārthamātravivakṣāyāṃ kevalo'pi pratyayaḥ prayujyeta,
yathā---kimasya dvayasam, kimasya mātramiti; yathā vā prakarṣavivakṣāyāṃ
taratamabhāvaḥ tāratamyamiti| nanu prakṛtiviśeṣaṃ nirddiśyaiva
vidhīyate, tatra pūrvoktayā nītyā paratvaviśiṣṭasyaiva vidhānamiti
nāsti kevalasya prayogaḥ? evamapi prakṛtyarthamātravivakṣāyāṃ
kevalāyāḥ prakṛteḥ prayogaḥ syādeva, yathā---pac, vṛkṣeti| yatra
punarubhayaṃ vivakṣitam----prakṛtyarthaḥ, pratyayārthaśca, na tatra
kevalāyāḥ prakṛteḥ prayogaprasaṅgaḥ ; na kevalā prakṛtiḥ
pratyayārthamabhidhātuṃ samartheti| lakṣaṇayā samartheti cet? no
khalvārabhyamāṇamapyetallakṣaṇayā prayogaṃ nivārayitumarhati, ataḥ
kevalaprakṛtyarthavivakṣāyāṃ kevalā prakṛtirmā prayojīti sūtrārambhaḥ|
caśabdaścāvadhāraṇe, pratyayaḥ paro bhavatyeva, na tu kadācinna bhavatīti
vacanavyaktiḥ| ā padatvaniṣpateścāyaṃ niyamaḥ, niṣpanne tu pade
tāvadeva prayujyate| apatyādyarthāntaravivakṣāyāṃ tu tasmādapi
pratyayāntaraṃ bhavati||
ādyudātaśca|| 3|1|3 ||
ādyudātaśca|| uhāsvarakasyāca uccāraṇāsambhavātsarva eva
svaravidhirniyamārthaḥ, tatra ṭhcitaḥ' evānta udātaḥ, rityeva madhya
udātaḥ, tideva svaritaḥ, suppitāvevānudāto,
dūrātsambuddhāvevaikaśrutyamati| svarāntarāṇāmanyatra niyamāt
pāriśeṣyādādyaudāta eva pratyayo bhaviṣyati, nāsvarakaḥ
nāpyanyasvarakaḥ, tatrāha---aniyatasvarapratyayaprasaṅga iti| aniyataḥ
svaro yasya so'niyatasvaraḥ, sa cāsau pratyayaścāniyatasvarapratyayaḥ
tasya prasaṅge pratyayo'niyatasvaro mā bhūdityevamarthamityarthaḥ|
aniyatasvaraprasaṅga iti pāṭhe tvaniyatasya svarasya prasaṅga ityarthaḥ|
ayamabhiprāyaḥ---ādyaudātatvamapi ṭhñnityādirnityam' ityādau
niyatatvānna syād, anyatrāniyamaḥ syādeva yatrāyaṃ niyamo nāsti|
kiñca tvadukte niyame cidātīnāmaniyamaḥ syād| ataścito'nta eva,
titsvarita evetyādikaṃ tatra tatra niyamasvarūpamāśraṇīyam, tataśca
pratyayasyāniyatasvaratvameva syāt| kiñca,
rityevopotamanudātamityapi niyame'nyatropotamanudātaṃ mā
bhūd| madhyāntaraṃ tu syādeva; madhyaviśeṣāśrayatvānniyamasya| tasmādye
ekācaḥ pratyayāsteṣvaniyatasvaraprasaṅge vacanamidamudātārtham| ye
punaranekācaḥ pratyayāsteṣu deśasyāpyaniyamaḥ
prāpnotikadācidādeḥ, kadācinmadhyasya, kadācidantyasyeti| teṣu
vacanamidamudātārtham, tatrāpyaderudātārthamiti| kimartha punaḥ
pratyayasaṃjñāsanniyogenāyaṃ svara ucyate, na ṭhñnityādirnityam'
pratyayasya ca lasārvadhātukamanudātaṃ suppitau ceti svaraprakaraṇa
evocyeta, evaṃ hi prakaraṇamabhinnaṃ bhavati? kiñca, dvirādyaudātagrahaṇaṃ
dviścādyaudātagrahaṇaṃ na kartavyaṃ bhavati? 
syādetat--tatra kriyamāṇe pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣayā tadantasya svaraḥ
prāpnoti, iha tu kriyamāṇe nāyaṃ doṣo bhaved, utpanno hi
pratyayastadāśrayāṇāṃ tadantavidhyādīnāṃ nimitaṃ bhavati, na
tūtpadyamānaḥ, na khalūtpadyamāno ghaṭa udakāharaṇādīnāṃ
nimitamavakalpate, tataśca ṭhādyaudātaśca' ityasya pratiyogamupasthāne
sati utpadyamāna eva tavyadādirādyaudāto bhavati, evaṃ tibādiranudāta
iti doṣābhāvaḥ, ataḥ pratyayasaṃjñāsanniyogena casvaro vidhīyata iti?
tanna; jñāpakātsiddham, yadayaṃ ñnityādirudāto bhavatītyāha, taj
jñāpayati---pratyayasya cetyatra na tadantavidhirbhavatītyanudātatvamapi
tadantasya na bhaviṣyati; dhātoranta udāto bhavatītyādeḥ
prakṛtisvarasya vidhānasāmarthyāt| yatra hyanudātaḥ pratyayaḥ----yāti,
vṛkṣābhyāmityādau, tatra prakṛtisvaraḥ śrūyate; yātaḥ, yānti,
vṛkṣatvamityādau satiśiṣṭena pratyayādyaudātatvena bādhyate| yadi ca
pratyayāntasyānudātatvaṃ syād nirviṣayaṃ
dhātuprātipadikāntodātatvaṃ syāt| idaṃ tarhi
prayojanam---lavitavyamityādau pratyayotpatikāle evāgyudātatve
kṛte paścādbhavanniḍanudāto yathā syāt, anyathā lūatavya iti
sthite ādyaudātatvaṃ śabdāntaraprāptyā'nityam, iṭ tu svarabhinnasya
prāpnoti, ubhayoranityayoḥ paratvādiṭi kṛte tasya pratyayagrahaṇena
grahaṇe sati iṭa evādyaudātatvaṃ syāt? etadapi jñāpakātsiddham,
yadayam ṭhyāsuṭparasmaipadeṣūdāto ṅcci' ityāha,
tajjñāpayati---āgamā anudātā iti; anyathā cinuyātāmityādau
yāsuṭaḥ pratyayāditvātsiddhamudātatvamityanarthakaṃ tatsasyāt| nanu
pidarthametatsasyāt, anyathā cinuyādityādau pidbhakto
yāsuṅnudātaḥ syāt? yadyotāvatprayojanaṃ syād, yāsuṭ
parasmaipadeṣu bhavati, apicca liṅbhavatīti pitvameva pratiṣedhet|
avaśyaṃ caitajjñāpakamāśrayaṇīyam, anyathā
pratyayasaṃjñāsanniyogenādyaudātatvavidhāvapi laviṣīyetyādau
lāvasthāyāmanackatvādasati svare viśeṣavihitatvātparatvācca
sīyuṭi kṛte paścāllādeśe pratyayādyaudātatvamityānupūrvyā sīyuṭa
eva syāt| jñāpakāśrayaṇe tu sīyuḍanudātaḥ ṭhiṭo't' ityakāra
udāto bhavati| kathaṃ bhavati, yāvatā sīyuṭi kṛte'kārasya
vicchinnamāditvam? naiṣa doṣaḥ; yāsuṭa udātavacanaṃ
jñāpakam---pratyayādyaudātatve kartavye āgamā avidyamānavadbhavantīti;
anyathā cinuyātāmityādau yāsuṭaḥ
pratyayāditvātsiddhamudātatvamityanarthakaṃ tatsyāt| kiñca,
lavitavyamityādau pūrvamādyaudātatve satyapi paścādbhavanniṭ
kimityanudāto bhavati śeṣanighātena? nāyaṃ śeṣanighātasya viṣayaḥ,
svaravidhiśeṣatvātasya| yasminpade yasyāmavasthāyāṃ yasyāca udātaḥ
svarito vā vidhīyate tasminpade tasyāmavasthāyāṃ sannihitamajantaraṃ
nihanyata ityarthaḥ| na cāyaṃ prakāro'tra sambhavati| iha tarhi strughne
bhavā straughnī pratyayasanniyogenāṇa udātatve sati ṅīpa
udātanivṛttisvaraḥ siddho bhavati; anyathā straughna ī iti sthite
ṭhpratyayasya ca' ityādyaudātatvaṃ bādhitvā paratvādyasyeti lope kṛte
udātanivṛtyabhāvānna syāt, na vā bahiraṅgalakṣaṇatvāt| lopo hi
ṅīpa utpattimapekṣate, svarastu nirapekṣaḥ| avaśyaṃ
cātrāntaraṅgatvamevāśrayaṇīyam, anyathā kaṃsena krītā
ṭhkaṃsāṭṭiṭhan' ṭita iti ṅīp, kaṃsa ṭha ī iti sthite
ṭhñnityādiḥ' ityādyaudātatvaṃ bādhitvā paratvādyasyeti lopaḥ syāt,
tataśca nitsvare lopena bādhite pratyayasaṃjñāsanniyogena
vidhīyamānamādyaudātatvamakārasya sthitamiti tasya lope ṅīpa
udātanivṛttisvaraḥ syāt| nanu ca
ṭhacaścitkaraṇātpūrvamikāradeśastataḥ pratyayādyaudātatvamiti
nāstyudātalopaḥ| iha tarhi utse jātā ṭhutsādibhyo'ñ',ṅīp, utsa a
ī iti sthite ñitsvaraṃ bādhitvā paratvādyasyeti lope pūrvāktayā
nītyā ḍīpa udātanivṛttisvaraḥ syāt? naiṣa doṣaḥ; nitsvaro hi
pratyayasvarasyāpavādaḥ, na cāpavādaviṣaya utsargo'bhiniviśate, tatra
tāvadatra pratyayādyaudātatvaṃ bhavati, apavādaṃ ñnitsvaraṃ pratīkṣyata iti
kuta udātalopaḥ! iha tarhi atrerapatyam ṭhitaścāniñaḥ' iti ḍhak,
āyannādiṣūpadeśivacanaṃ svarasiddhyarthamiti
pratyayasvarātpūrvameyādeśaḥ, ṅīp ātreya ī iti sthite taddhitasya
kita iti svaraṃ bādhitvā paratvādyasyeti lope kṛte
udātanivṛttisvara īkārasya na prāpnoti
tasmādāntaraṅgatvamevāśrayaṇīyam| evaṃ ca sraughnītyatrāpi
antaraṅgatvādeva siddhamiṣṭamiti nārtha etadarthena
pratyayasaṃjñāsanniyogenādyaudātavacanena| idaṃ tarhi
prayojanam---gopāyāti dhūpāyati, utpattisanniyogenādyaudātatve
paścāt ṭhsanādyantā dhātavaḥ' iti dhātusaṃjñāyāṃ
dhātorityantodātatvaṃ bhavati| yadi tu ñnityādirnityaṃ pratyayasya
cetyucyeta, paratvāddhātusvaraṃ pratyayasvaro bādheta| syādetat| 
anudātasya tarhyatra pradeśe karaṇe kiṃ prayojanam?
syādetat----kāryaśabdāṭṭāpi svaritatvātprāgekādeśe kṛte tasya
pūrva pratyantavadbhāvātitsvaritaśca prāpnoti, paraṃ
pratyādivadbhāvātpitsvaraśca, paratvātsvarito bhavati| yadi tu
lasārvadhātukamanudātaṃ suppitau cetyucyeta paratvādanudātvaṃ
syāditi? tanna; tatra hi ṭābu tpaterapi prāgeva svarito bhavati,
satyapi vā ṭāpi svaritaikādeśayorubhayoranityayoḥ
paratvātsvaritatve kṛte āntaryataḥ svaritānudātayorekādeśaḥ
svarito bhaviṣyati| idaṃ tarhi---āmbaṣṭha|la yaṅścāpyekādeśe kṛte
pitsvaraśca prāpnoti citsvaraśca, paratvāccitsvaro bhavati, anyatra
kriyamāṇo pitsvaraḥ syāt? atrāpi cāpaścitkaraṇasāmarthyādevaca
citsvaro bhaviṣyati| sāmānyagrahaṇāvighātārthe hi cakāre ṭāpprakaraṇa
eva yaṅṣṭāpaṃ vidadhīta| evaṃ tarhi tadeva tasminprayojanaṃ
tadantavidhirmā bhūditi| yadukta prakṛtisvarasya vidhānasāmarthyāditi?
tatra āste śeta ityādau lasārvadhātukamātrasyānudātatve sati
dhātusvarasya sāvakāśatvāt| prātipadikāntodātatvamapi agnimān,
vāyumān, agrīnāmityādau ṭhhrasvanuḍbhyāṃ matup'
ṭhnāmanyatarasyām' iti svarasiddhyartha syāt, atra hyantodātāditi
vartata ityalamapi karkaśena kṣodena||
anudātau suppitau|| 3|1|4 ||
anudātau suppitau|| subiti pratyāhārasyedaṃ grahaṇam, na
spatamībahuvacanasya; pitvādevānudātatvasya siddhatvāt| ata eva
vṛtau ṭhsupaḥ' iti bahuvacanam| pita etatu prakramānurodhena
bahuvacanam| supaśca pakāreṇa pratyāhāraḥ, na kapa; ṭābādīnāṃ
pitkaraṇāt| pacatīti| śabantodāharaṇam, tipastvadupadeśāt
ṭhlasārvadhātukam' ityeva siddham||
guptijkidbhyaḥ san|| 3|1|5 ||
guptijkidbhyaḥ san|| gupa gopane iti| ṭhgupa vyākulatve', ṭhgupū
rakṣaṇe'ityetayostu grahaṇaṃ na bhavati; tijinā saha gaṇe
paṭhitasyānudātena eva guperihāpi grahaṇāt| pratyayasaṃjñā
cādhikṛtaiveti| kā punaratra vismaraṇāśaṅkā, kintvanvarthā
pratyayasaṃjñā, anarthakasya gupādisano na syādityāśaṅkānena
nivāryate| adhikārasāmarthyādanarthakasyāpi bhavatītyarthaḥ| anvarthatā
tvarthavadanarthakasambhave'rthavato grahaṇehetuḥ| nindādayastu
gupādīnāmarthā na sanaḥ, anyathā gupādīnāmānarthakyaprasaṅgāt|
dhātūnāṃ cānekārthatvaṃ tatra tatra ddaśyate| pratyayāstu svārthikā api
bhavanti samāsāntādivat| jugupsate iti|
dhātorityevamanabhidhānādasya sano'nāddhadhātukatvādiḍabhāvaḥ|
nindākṣameti| prāyikametadupādhivacanam| tathā ca ṭhkṣetriyac
parakṣetre cikitsyaḥ' ityatra granthaḥ----ṭhatha vā kṣetriyāṇi tṛṇāni
sasyārthe kṣetre jātāni cikitsyāni vināśayitavyāni, atha vā
kṣetriyaḥ pāradārikaḥ, paradārāḥ parakṣetrem, tatra cikitsyo
nigṛhītavyaḥ' iti| saṃśaye'pi ddaśyate----tadvyacikitsan, ya evaṃ
vidvānvicikitsati, tacchuśruvānṛṣirvyacikitsaditi ca| anyatreti|
arthāntaravṛterddhātvantarādityarthaḥ| etacca ṭhpūrvavatsanaḥ' ityatra
nipūṇataramupapāditam|
gupādiṣvanubandhakaraṇamātmanepadārthamiti| etadapi
tatraivopapāditam| gupādīṣviti bahuvacanaṃ
mānvadhādisūtrābhiprāyam| kitistuparasmaipadī, tathā cānantarameva
prayogā darśitāḥ| sano nakāraḥ svarārthaḥ,
nitkaraṇasāmarthyāddhātusvaro na bhavati---yatstotāraṃ jighāṃsasi
sakhāyam| viśeṣaṇārthaśca---ṭhajjhanagamāṃ sani' ṭhhaneḥ saḥ' haṃsa ityatra
mā bhūt| ṭhstautiṇyoreva ṣaṇyabhyāsāt',suṣupiṣa indramityatra mā
bhūt| ṭhsanyaṅeḥ' ityatrāpi ṭhliṭi dhātoḥ' ityato
dhātorityanuvṛtairyadyapi tṛṇādibhyaḥ se'prasaṅgaḥ| haṃsaḥ, vatsa
ityādau tu syādevoṇādīnāṃ vyutpattipakṣe| pratīṣiṣatītyatra
pratipūrvādiṇaḥ sani vihite ṭhajāderdvitīyasya' iti śabdasya
dvirvacanaṃ yathā syādevamarthaḥ| ṭhyathaṣṭṃa nāmadhātūnāmiti vaktavyam'
putrīyiṣiṣati| anyatra tvārddhadhātuke ṭhato lopaḥ' sārvadhātuke
śapā sahaikādeśa iti nāsti viśeṣaḥ||
mānbadhadānśānbhyo dīrghaścābhyāsasya|| 3|1|6 ||
mānbadhadānśānbhyo dīrghaścābhyāsasya|| atra mānbadhī anudātetau,
śeṣau svaritetau| abhyāsasya cekārasyadīrgho bhavatīti| ṭhsanyataḥ'
itītve dīrgho bhavatītyarthaḥ| nanu viśeṣavihito dīrghaḥ
sāmānyavihitamitvaṃ bādhitvā'varṇasyaiva prāpnoti? jñāpakātsiddham,
yadayaṃ ṭhdīrgho'kitaḥ', ityatrākita ityāha,
tajjñāpayati----nābhyāsavikāreṣu bādhyabādhakabhāva iti| taddhi
yaṃyamyate ityādau nuki kṛte mā bhūditi| yadi cābhyāsavikāreṣu
bādhyabādhakabhāvaḥ syātato viśeṣavihitatvānnuki
kṛte'najantatvādeva na bhaviṣyati dīrghaḥ, kiṃ pratiṣedhena? ata eva
ḍīḍhokyate ityādau hrasvatve kṛte guṇo bhavati, anyathā babādhe
caritārthaṃ hrasvaṃ pāpacyate ityādau caritārtho dīrghaḥ paratvādvādheta|
apara āha---sūtropāta evārtho vṛttikāreṇokta iti kathamabhyāsasyeti
padacchedaḥ, abhyāsasya vikāra abhyāsaḥ, sa cetvameva| tathā
hi---lopasya tāvadabhāvarūpatvādadaiśo vidhātumaśakyaḥ, yadi ca
hrasvasya dīrghatvaṃ syātca taddhitanirdeśo'narthakaḥ syāt, dīrghaśrutyā
ṭhacaśca' ityupasthānādajantasya dīrghavidhānāddīrghasya hrasvasya vā dīrgho
viśeṣābhāvātasmāditvameva taddhitena pratyāyyate| atha vā sanyāhatya
vihitasya vikārasya grahaṇaṃ tadāha---abhyāsasya cekārasyeti|
sarvaśeṣa iti | na kevalaṃ tasyaivāpi tu pūrvayorapi
dvayorityarthaḥ| tena kvacinna bhavatīti| arthāntaravṛttibhyo
dātvantarebhya ityarthaḥ| etacca ṭhpūrvavatsanaḥ' ityatropapāditam|
mānayatītyādayaścurādiṇyantāḥ| niśāna iti ṇyantādeva pacādyac|
mānerjijñāsāyāmiti| yadyevam, jñānārthavṛtermānerutarasūtreṇaiva
san siddhaḥ? satyam, dīrghavighānārtha vacanamiḍabhāvārtha ca|
badhervairupye iti| citasya durgandhādyanubhavanimito vikāro
vairūpyam| śāneniṃśāne iti| niśānamutīkṣṇīkaraṇam, yatraivāyaṃ
paṭhitaḥ ṭhśāna tejane' iti tatraivetyarthaḥ||
dhātoḥ karmaṇaḥ samānakartṛkādicchāyāṃ vā|| 3|1|7 ||
dhātoḥ karmaṇaḥ samānakartṛkādicchāyāṃ vā||
karmatvasamānakartṛkatvayoḥ kriyāpekṣatvādicchāyāyaśca
pratyayārthatvenāpi tāvacchutatvātadapekṣe eva te vijñāyete ityāha
---iṣikarma yo dhāturiṣiṇaiva samānakartṛka iti| arthaddhārakamiti|
dhātvarthasya karmatvātsamānakartṛkatvācca dhātustathā vyapadiśyate na
svarūpeṇetyarthaḥ, kiṃ kāraṇam? asambhavāt| yadyapi
karotimicchatītyādau dhātoḥ svarūpeṇāpi karmatvasambhavaḥ, tathāpi
na tasya svarūpeṇārthadvāreṇa vā samānakartṛkatvaṃ sambhavati| kiṃ cātra
śtipā nirdeśātsvarūpaparatvam, sanprakṛtestu
lokavyutpatyanusāreṇārthaparatvameva, ataḥ
suṣṭhūaktam---dhātorarthadvārakaṃ viśeṣaṇamiti| icchāyāḥ kriyāyāḥ
karmabhūta icchayaiva samānakartṛko'rtho yasya dhātostasmātsan
bhavatītyarthaḥ| cikīrṣati, jihīrṣatīti| kṛhṛñbhyāṃ san, ṭhiko
jhal' iti kitvam, ṭhajjhanagamāṃ sani'iti dīrghaḥ, ṭhṛta
idvātoḥ',ṭhhali ca' iti dīrgha;, sanaḥ ṣatvam, dvirvacanam,
halādiśeṣaḥ, hrasvaḥ, ṭhkuhoścuḥ' iti cutvam---kakārasya cakāraḥ,
hakārasya jhakāraḥ, ṭhabhyāse carca' iti jaśtvam---jakāraḥ, ṭhsanādyantā
dhātavaḥ' iti dhātusaṃjñāyāṃ laḍādiḥ| 
dhātugrahaṇaṃ kimiti| ṭhkarmaṇaḥ samānakartṛkāt' iti vacanādvākyānna
bhaviṣyati| na hyaetadubhayaṃ vākyārthasya sambhavati,
subantādapi---putramicchatītyādau asamānakartṛkatvānna bhaviṣyati,
yatrāpi samānakartṛkatvam---gamanamicchati, āsanamicchatītyādau,
tatrāpi kyajbādhako bhaviṣyati| yadyapi putramicchatītyādau
asamānakartṛke kyac sāvakāśaḥ tathāpi cikīrṣatītyādāvasubante
sāvakāśaṃ sanaṃ subanteṣu samānakartṛkeṣu paratvādvādhiṣyate|
yatrāpi kyac pratiṣidhyate kyaci māntāvyayapratiṣedha
iti----kartumicchatīti, tatrāpi
kāmyajbādhakaḥ|ṅyāpprātipadikeṣvapi khaṭvākumārīputrādiṣu na
samānakartṛkatvam| āsanaśayanādau tvakarmatvam, na hi
ṅyāppratipadikaṃ karmābhidhāyi, vibhaktyabhidheyatvātkarmādīnām|
dhātorapi tarhi na syāt? atha tatra vastuto dhātvarthasyecchayā
vyāpyamānatvātkarmatvam, prātipadikādapi syāt, athātra
karmarūpānabhidhānānna syāt, dhātorapi na syāditi samānaṃ vacaḥ?
evaṃ tarhyasamānakartṛkatvādevātra na bhaviṣyati| śayanāsanādau hi
prakṛtyarthasyaiva samānakartṛkatvakriyārūpatvād, na
pratyayārthasyākriyārūpasya, ṭhkriyārūpasya siddhatā nāma yo dharmastatra
ghañādayaḥ' iti smaraṇāt| tiṅntādapi yata eva hetoḥ
pākamicchatītyatrārthe pacatīcchatīti na bhavati, tata eva hetoḥ sannapi
na bhaviṣyati| tadevaṃ na dhātumapahāya kvacidapi prasaṅga iti praśnaḥ|
sopasargādutpattirmā bhūditi| anyathā saṅghātasya
viśiṣṭakriyāvacanatvātata eva sansyāt, tataśca sannantatvena tasyaiva
dhātutvātata eva laṅyupasargātpūrvo'ḍāgamaḥ prāpnoti| nanu
liṅyapyupasargasya dvirvacanaprasaṅgo doṣaḥ śakyo darśayitum?
satyam; aṭprasaṅgamapyaparaṃ doṣaṃ darśayituṃ laṇudāhṛtaḥ| nanu
dhātureva viśiṣṭakriyāvācī, upasargastu sannidhimātreṇopakārako
na tu kasyacidarthasyābhidhānena, yathā---bhuṅkte ityatra
bhujirevābhyavahāre vartate, ātmanepadaṃ tu kartari, atha
cāntareṇātmanepadaṃ nābhyavahāro gamyate; tadvadupapasargasannidhāne
dhātureva viśiṣṭāṃ kriyāmāha, tataścārthadvārake
karmatvasamānakartṛkatve api dhātoreva, na saṅghātasya, avaśyaṃ
caitadevaṃ vijñeyam----dhātureva ca kriyāvacī, katham? yo hi
manyate saṅghātaḥ kriyāvācīti, kriyamāṇe'ti, kriyamāṇe'pi tasya
dhātugrahaṇe yo'tra dhāturna tasmādutpattiḥ prāpnoti,
akarmatvādasamānakartṛtvācca? evaṃ manyate---praśabdasannidhau
tāvatprakarṣākhyo viśeṣo gamyate, na ca prakarṣamapi dhāturevācaṣṭe;
praśabdasya vaiyarthyaprasaṅgāt; sati caivaṃ samudāyasyaiva karmatvam|
na hyasau karotyarthamātreṇa santuṣyati, nāpi prakarṣamātreṇa| na caivaṃ
yo'tra dhātustasmādanutpattiprasaṅgaḥ, tasyāpi karmatvāt| tathā ca
kaṭṃa karoti, bhīṣmamudāraṃ darśanīyamiti samudāyacikīrṣāyāmapi
bhīṣmādibhyo dvitīyā bhavati; teṣāmapi karmatvāt| nanvevamapi
yathā janapadasamudāyo janapadagrahaṇena na gṛhyate, tathā
karmasamudāyasyākarmatvātsamudāyādutpattirna bhaviṣyati| yatra tarhi
samudāyasyaiva karmatvaṃ tatra katham, yathā---prasthātumicchati
pratiṣṭhāsata iti, atra hi tiṣṭhatīti gatinivṛttiḥ pratīyate,
praśabdāsannidhau tu gatiḥ, tatra yathā jigamiṣatītyekameva karma
tadvadatrāpi tataśca samudāyādeva syāt? yadyevam, yo'tra dhātuḥ kathaṃ
tataḥ san, na hyasau karma, karmaṇa iti naiṣā dhātusamānādhikaraṇā
pañcamī, kiṃ tarhi? ṣaṣṭhī---karmaṇo'vayavāddhātoriti?
cikīrṣatītyādāvapi kevalasyāpi vyapadeśivadbhāvena
karmāvayavatvam| evamapyasamānakartṛtvānna prāpnoti,
dhātumātrasyākriyāvācitvāt| ataḥ samānakartṛkādityapi ṣaṣṭha|lrthe
pañcamīti vyākhyeyam| tadevaṃ saṅghātanivṛtyartha dhātugrahaṇamiti
sthitam|
karmama iti kimiti| jigamiṣatītyādau prayoge pratyayavācyāyā
icchāyāḥ karmāpekṣāyāṃ pratyāsatyā prakṛtyartha eva karma pratyeṣyate|
yadyapi kriyā karaṇamapyapekṣate, sphuṭatarā tvicchāyāḥ karmāpekṣeti
saiva prakṛtyarthena pūrayiṣyate, nārthaḥ karmagrahaṇeneti praśnaḥ|
gamanenecchatīti| asyāṃ vivakṣāyāṃ gamermā bhūdityarthaḥ| asati hi
karmagrahaṇe satyāparīcchāyāḥ karmāpekṣāyāṃ yathaitadvākyaṃ
bhavati---gamanenecchatīti, tathā sannapi syāditi bhāvaḥ| icchāyāmiti
kimiti| śabdavairādisūtre yat ṭhkaraṇe' iti tadihaivāstu,
abhidhānaśaktisvābhāvyācca karaṇaviśeṣa icchāyāmeva san bhaviṣyati,
namasprabhṛtibhyaḥ kyajiti praśnaḥ| kartujānātīti| lakṣaṇaikaśaraṇo
naivaṃ pratipādyeteti bhāvaḥ|
vāvacanādvākyamapi bhavatīti| nanu ṭhsamānakartṛkeṣu tumun' iti
tumunvidhānasāmarthyādeva vākyaṃ bhaviṣyati, asti
tasyāvakāśaḥ---cikīrṣitumicchatīti| na hyatra sanaḥ prasaṅgaḥ; ṭhsanantānna
saniṣyate' iti vakṣyamāṇatvāt| dhātoriti vidhānādityādinā
dhātugrahaṇasya prayojanāntaraṃ darśayati| na pūrvatreti| tathā ca
jugupsate ityādāviḍabhāvaḥ|
āśaṅkāyāmiti| āśaṅkāusambhāvanā, prayoktṛdharmaḥ,
tadviśiṣṭakriyāvacanātsvārthe pratyayaḥ| kūlaṃ pipatiṣatīti|
kūlasyācetanatvādicchāyā asambhavaḥ| śvāmumūrṣatīti|
śunaścetanatve'pi jīvitasya priyatvādvyādhyādyabhibhave'pi
tiryaktvānmartumicchā na bhavatīti, śaṅke patiṣyati kūlam,
śaṅke mariṣyati śvetyatrārthaḥ| pratyākhyānaṃ tu---yo yadicchati sa
tasya pūrvarūpāṇi karoti, yathā---devadataḥ kaṭṃa cikīrṣuḥ sannahyati
rajjukīlapūlādikaṃ cādate; kūlasyāpi ca pūrvarūpāṇi
ddaśyante---loṣṭāḥ śīryante, bhidā jāyante| śvānaḥ khalvapi mumūrṣava
ekāntaśīlāḥ sthūlākṣāśca bhavanti, tadiha
pūrvarūpadarśanādicchādhyāropyate---icchatyevāyaṃ ya
evamicchāvinābhūtāni pūrvarūpāṇi karoti| gauṇamukhyanyāyaśca
kvacillakṣyāpekṣayā nāśrīyate, tataścādhyāropitecchāśrayaḥ pratyaya
iti| 
viśeṣaṇaṃ kimiti| icchāgrahaṇaṃ kimityarthaḥ|
śeṣikāditi| sanprasaṅgādanyo'niṣṭaḥ pratyayo vāryate|
śeṣādhikāravihitaḥ śaiṣikaḥ maturbanthe bhavo matubarthīyaḥ,
gahāderākṛtigamatvācchaḥ, matupo'rtho matubarthaḥ, so'syāstīti
matubarthikaḥ| ṭhata iniṭhanau'| śaiṣikapratyayāntācchèaṣikaḥ sarūpapratyayo
neṣṭaḥ, tadyathā---śālāyāṃ bhavo ghaṭaḥ śālīyaḥ, tatra bhavamudakam,
punaśchāe na bhavati; virūpastu bhavatyeva---ahicchatre
bhavamāhicchatram, tatra bhavamāhicchatrīyam, aṇantācchāe bhavati| tathā
daṇḍo'syāstīti daṇḍikaḥ, ṭhata iniṭhanau' so'syāstīti punaṣṭhanna
bhavati; virūpastu bhavatyeva---daṇḍimatī seneti| sananantānna
saniṣyate iti| sarūpa ityeva| sārūpyeṇa cātra sāddaśyaṃ lakṣyate,
taccārthadvārakamiti icchāsanantāditi pūrvokta evārtho bhavati, etacca
nyāyasiddham| tathā hi---jātau padārthe samudāye sakṛllakṣaṇaṃ
pravartate, tataśca tatpravṛteḥ prāk
tatpratyayāntaprakṛtyasambhavātadantānnāsti tatpratyayaprasaṅgaḥ| iha yo
grāmaṃ gantumicchati tasya yadyapi grāmo na svarūpeṇeṣṭaḥ----grāmo me
syāditi, tathāpi gamyamānatārūpeṇa so'pīṣṭa eva| grāmo
jigaṃsyate, jigamiṣitaḥ, jigamiṣitavyaḥ, sujigamiṣa iti icchā
vācinaḥ sanantāt grāme karmaṇi lādayo bhavanti| gamiṃ prati
karmatvaṃ grāmasya spaṣṭameva| ata eva grāmaṃ jigamiṣati, grāmāya
jigamiṣatīti ṭhgatyarthakarmaṇi' iti dvitīyācaturthyau bhavataḥ||
supa ātmanaḥ kyac|| 3|1|8 ||
supa ātmanaḥ kyac|| atrāpīcchāyāmityanuvṛtestadapekṣameva
subantasya karmatvaṃ vijñāyate ityāha---iṣikarmaṇa iti| ātmaśabdo'yaṃ
paravyāvṛttivacanaḥ svaśabdaparyāyo gṛhyate, na cetanadravyavacanaḥ| sa
hi gṛhyamāṇa icchayā vā sambadhyeta, subantena vā| tatrecchayā sambandhe
kartari ṣaṣṭhī, ātmanaḥ icchāyāmātkakartṛkāyāmicchāyāmātmā
cedicchatītyarthaḥ syāt, tataścātmagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt,
sarvaivehecchā''tmakartṛkā, tasyāstaddharmatvāt| subantasambandhe tu
devadatasya putramicchati yajñadata ityatrāpi prāpnoti, parasyāpi
hīṣyamāṇa ātmana eveṣṭo bhavati; tasyāpyātmatvāt| anarthakaṃ
cātmagrahaṇaṃ syād; vyāvartyābhāvāt| vṛkṣasya jalamicchati,
khaṭvāyāḥ pādamicchatītyādau yatrācetanārtha kiñcidiṣyate
tadvyāvartyamiti cet, na; tatrāpi cetanasyaiva paramaśeṣitvāt|
sarvameva hi bhogyaṃ cetanānāmeva śeṣabhūtaṃ khaṭvāyāḥ
pādamicchatītyatrāpi yasya tat khṭavādikamupabhogyaṃ tadarthameva
tadiṣyate, khaṭvādikaṃ tu tasyaiva dvāramātram; ataḥ
paravyāvṛttivacana evātmaśabdaḥ| tatrāpi yadīcchayā sambandhaḥ syāt,
pūrvavat kartari ṣaṣṭha|lamātmagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt, sarvasyā
evecchāyā eṣitṛkartṛkatvā diti subantena sambadhyate,
subantātkarmaṇa icchāyāmabhidheyāyāṃ kyaj bhavali,
taccetsubantamātmanaḥ svasya sambandhi bhavati| kasya
svasyetyapekṣāyāmicchayā eṣituḥ sannidhāpitatvāt
tasyevaiṣiturātmanaḥ sambandhi iti vijñāyate,
tadāha----eṣiturevātmasamambandhinaḥ subantāditi| na caivamātmanaḥ
putraṃ parasya dāsamicchatītyatrāpi subantasyātmasambandhitvātprasaṅgaḥ,
nātra yathākathaṃcidātmasambandhitvaṃ vivakṣitam, kiṃ tarhi? iṣyamāṇameva
rūpamātmasambandhitvena yadeṣyate tadā pratyayaḥ| putrīyatīti| ṭhkyaci
ca' itītvam|
supa iti kimiti| karmaṇa iti vacanātiṅntādaprasaṅgaḥ, na hi
tiṅntaṃ karma| dhātoścāprasaṅgaḥ viśeṣavihitena sanā
bādhitatvāt| ṅyāpprātipadikādutpatāvapi na kaściddoṣaḥ; ṭhnaḥ
kye' iti padasaṃjñāvidhānāt| tacca kriyamāṇe subgrahaṇe
niyamārtham---nāntameva kye padamiti| tadeva
ṅyāpprātipadikādutpatau vidhyartha bhaviṣyati| nanvasati
subgrahaṇe ṅyāpprātipadikātsubantāccotpattvyamaviśeṣāt,
tataśca ṭhnaḥ kye' ityetadyadyevaṃ vidhyartham, ubhayathāpi doṣaḥ; niyamārthe
hi vācyatītyādau prātipadikātsubantāccotpatau yadyapi
doṣābhāvaḥ, nakārānteṣu prātipadikādutpattipakṣe nalopo na
syāt| atha teṣu prātipadikā duptau vidhyartham, evaṃ sati
vācyatītyādau subantādutpattipakṣe jaśtvādipadakāryaṃ syāt, ataḥ
subantādeva yathā syātprātipadikānmā bhūditi niyamārthaṃ
subgrahaṇaṃ kartavyameva| evaṃ tarhi karmagrahaṇād
ṅyapprātipadikādaprasaṅgaḥ subantameva hi karmābhidhāyi;
pañackapakṣe'pi dyotakavibhakterapekṣitatvāt| tadevaṃ subantamapahāya
na kvacitprasaṅga iti matvā praśnaḥ|
vākyāditi| padasamūhādityarthaḥ| mahantaṃ putramicchatīti| kiṃ ca
syādyadyatra syāt? pratyayārthe guṇabhūtayormahatputraśabdayorasati
parasparasambandhe samāso na syāt, tathā ca tannibandhanamātvaṃ na
syāt| kimidānīṃ na bhavati---mahāputrīyatīti? bhavati, yadaitadvākyaṃ
bhavati----mahānputro mahāputraḥ mahāputramicchīti| atha kriyamāṇe'pi
subgrahaṇe kasmādevātra na bhavati? pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣayā
samudāyasyāsubantatvāt| kiṃ punarayaṃ karmaṇoḥ samudāyaḥ?
āhosvitsamudāyaḥ karma? kiṃ cātaḥ? yadi karmaṇoḥ samudāyaḥ, na
karmagrahaṇena gṛhyate iti samudāyādaprasaṅga? atha samudāyaḥ karma,
avayavād dvitīyā na prāpnotyakarmatvāt? evaṃ tarhi karmaṇorevāyaṃ
samudāyaḥ, subgrahaṇaṃ tu yadatra karma tasmānmā bhūditi| atha
kriyamāṇe'pi subgrahaṇe kasmādeva tasmānna syāt, subantameva hi
tat? asāmarthyāt| kathamasāmarthyam? sāpekṣamasamartha bhavatīti|
akriyayāṇe punaḥ subgrahaṇe nāyaṃ padavidhirbhavati| yatra hi
padasyaivāsādhāraṇaṃ kiñcidrūpamāśritaṃ sa padavidhiḥ, karmagrahaṇaṃ tu
na padasyaivāsādhāraṇam, ṭhdhātoḥ karmaṇaḥ' ityapadepi ddaṣṭatvāt|
anye tvāhuḥ----samudāyasyāpi karmatvamavayavayośca mahatvaviśiṣṭasya
putrasyaiṣyamāṇatvāditi teṣāṃ samudāyādavayavācca mā bhūditi
subgrahaṇam| rājñaḥ putramicchatīti| nanvasāmarthyādevātra na
bhaviṣyati, kathamasāmarthyam? sāpekṣamasamarthaṃ bhavatīti? yatra
tarhyantareṇāpi tṛtīyasya padasya prayogaṃ parasyeti gamyate tatra mā
bhūt yathā---aghamicchati, vyasanamicchatīti, na hi
kaścidātmano'ghamicchati| kakāra ityādi| syādetat----ṭhnaḥ kye'
ityatrāpi mā kāri kakāra iti? yadyevam, sāmasu sādhuḥ atrāpi
prāpnoti| cakātstadavighātārtha iti| svarastu pratyayasvareṇa siddho
dhātusvareṇa vā, akārastu ddaṣadamicchati ddaṣyadyati, ddaṣadyaterṇvul,
ṭhato lopaḥ',ṭhyasya halaḥ',ṭhkyasya vibhāṣā'----ddaṣadakaḥ, atrāto
lopasya sthānivadbhāvāt ṭhata upadhāyāḥ' iti vṛddhirmā bhūt|
mṛdamicchati mṛdyati, mṛdyateḥ ṭhaco yat', ato lopādi
pūrvavat---mṛdyam, ṭhyato'nāvaḥ' ityādyaudātatvaṃ yathā syāditi|
putrīyatītyādau ca śapā sahaikādeśa udāto bhavati| 
kyaci māntāvyayapratiṣedha iti| māntagrahaṇaṃ prātipadikasya
viśeṣaṇam, na subantasya | tena putramicchatītyādau kyaj bhavati,
kāvicchati kānicchatītyādau ca na bhavati| uccaurnīcairiti|
adhikaraṇapradhānayorapyanayorādheye yadā vṛttistadā karmatvam,
gosamānākṣaranāntādityeke| gośabdātsamānākṣarānnāntācca kyaj
bhavatītyeke manyante| akārādayo daśa samānākṣarāḥ; tatra
lṛvarṇāntasya, ṛkārāntasya ca prātipadikasyābhāvādekārānpūrveṣāṃ
saptānāmacāṃ grahaṇam| asminpakṣe vācyatītyādi na siddhyati,
tasmānnāyaṃ sthitaḥ pakṣa ityāhuḥ| ata evāsya vṛtāvanupanyāsaḥ|
parecchāyāmiti| śeṣaṣṭhayāḥ samāso na kartṛṣaṣṭhayāḥ,
subantadvārakaśca parasyecchayā sambandhaḥ, parasya subantārthā yā icchā
tasyāmityarthaḥ| aghāyava iti| ṭhkyācchandasi' ityupratyayaḥ, ṭhaśvāghasyāt'
ityātvam| etadeva kyaci parata ātvavidhānaṃ jñāpakam cchandasi
parecchāyāmapi kyaj bhavatīti, na hi kaścidātmano'ghamicchati| na
cācārakyajartham, cchandasyaghaśabdācāre kyaco'darśanāt|
athāsmātkyajantāllakṛtyaktakhalarthā bhavantaḥ kva bhavanti? yathāyogaṃ
bhāve kartari ca, na tu karmaṇi| prakṛtyarthaviśiṣṭāyā
niyataviṣayaayā icchāyāḥ kyajantenābhidhānam, na sā vastvantaraṃ
viṣīyakaroti, ato jīvatyādivadakarmakaḥ kyajantaḥ| ācārakyajante
tūpamānakarmaṇaḥ putrāderantarbhāve'pi
upameyasyacchātrāderanantarbhāvātasminkarmaṇi lādayo
bhavantyeva---putrīyyatecchātraḥ putrāyitavya ityādi,
yathā----śyenāyate kāka iti upamānakarturantarbhāve'pi
upameyakartarilo bhavati, tadvat| iha ca māṇavakaṃ muṇḍaṃ karoti
muṇḍate māṇavakaḥ, muṇḍayitavyo māṇavaka iti ṇyanto
dhāturmauṇḍa|lguṇaviśiṣṭadravyamātramantarbhāvayituṃ śaktaḥ, na tu
māṇavakādikaṃ viśeṣamiti tasya dhātāvanantarbhāvātatra lādayo
bhavanti| yadyevam, anena hetunā kyajantādapi prāpnoti| māṇavakaṃ
muṇḍamicchati muṇḍīyati māṇavakam, muṇḍīyyate māṇavaka iti, nātra
kyacā bhavitavyamasāmarthyāt? kathamasāmarthyam? sāpekṣamasamartha
bhavatīti| ṇijapi tarhi na prāpnoti? syādetat----nobhau
karotiyuktau mauṇḍa|lṃ māṇavakaśca, na hi māṇavakatvaṃ kriyate, tataśca
muṇḍaṃ karotītyatraivārthe muṇḍa|ltoti ṇijutpadyate| muṇḍaṃ karoti
māṇavakamityatra vākye'pi muṇḍasyaiva karmatvam,
tatsāmānādhikaraṇyātu māṇavakād dvitīyotpatiḥ| tadevaṃ
māṇavakādayo mauṇḍa|lsyādhāraviśaeṣapratipādanārthamupādīyamānāḥ
karotiyuktā na bhavanti| yadā punarubhau karotiyuktau bhavataḥ, na
bhavati tadā vṛttiḥ, tadyathā---balīvarddaṃ karoti taṃ ca muṇḍaṃ
karoti muṇḍayati balīvaddamiti ṇijbhavati| yadyevam, anenaiva
hetunā kyajapi na prāpnoti| yadi cādhāratvenāpi
māṇavako'pekṣyate, punarapi sāpekṣatā|
kiñca, yadi na māṇavakaḥ karotiyuktaḥ, kathaṃ tat lakāra
utpadyate---muṇḍa|lte māṇavaka iti? kaścāyaṃ nyāyo na māṇavakaḥ
karotiyukta iti? na hyasau mauṇḍa|lmātreṇa santuṣyati,māṇavakasthamasau
mauṇḍa|lbhinirvattayati, tataśca svarūpeṇākriyamāṇo'pi māṇavako
muṇḍaparūpeṇa kriyate, iṣyate ca| tadevaṃ sati yadi ṇij bhavati
kyajapi syād atha kyajna bhavati ṇijapi na syāditi samānaṃ vacaḥ| evaṃ
tarhi muṇḍādayo guṇavacanāśca sāpekṣāḥ, ucyate ca ṇic, sa
vacanātsāpekṣebhyo'pi bhaviṣyati, kyac punaranapekṣebhyaḥ
putrādibhyaḥ sāvakāśa iti māṇavakaṃ muṇḍamicchatītyādau sāpekṣebhyo
na bhaviṣyatīti? yadyapyayamapi ṇij guṇamātrakaraṇavivakṣāyāṃ
sāvakāśaḥ---muṇḍayatyayaṃ nāpitaḥ pravīṇo mauṇḍa|lkaraṇaiti, tathāpi
tatkarotīti siddhe ṇici punarvidhānamidaṃ sāpekṣebhyo'pi yathā
syādityevamarthameva| yadvā--dvividhā muṇḍādyaḥ---dhātavaḥ,
prātipadikāni ca| tatra sūtre dhātava upātāstebhyaḥ svabhāvata eva
viśiṣṭakriyāvacanebhyo ṇijbhaviṣyati, prātipadikānāṃ tu vigraha
eva---māṇavakaṃ muṇḍaṃ karotīti| atha vā nedaṃ yugapadubhayaṃ
bhavati----vākyaṃ ca pratyayaśca, tataśca muṇḍayatīti dravyamātraṃ
pratīyate, tatra viśeṣārthinā viśeṣo'nuprayoktavyaḥ| atha
vā---muṇḍasyaiva śuddhena karotinā'nvayaḥ, mauṇḍa|lviśiṣṭena tu
māṇavakasya, yathā---gāṃ dogdhi paya iti śuddhasya duheḥ pūrvaṃ
gavabhisambandhaḥ, paścātu goduhinā payasaḥ| kyacpratyayastvanabhidhānānna
bhavati| māṇavakaṃ muṇḍayatītyukte māṇavakaṃ
muṇḍamivācaratītyarthāntarameva pratīyate|
tadevamicchākyajantādbhāve kartari ca lādaya iti sthitam||
kāmyacca|| 3|1|9 ||
kāmyacca|| kimartho yogavibhāgaḥ, na ṭhsupa ātmanaḥ kyackāmyacau'
ityekayoga eva kriyate, evaṃ hi cakāro na kartavyo bhavati?
tatrāha---yogavibhāga ityādi| ekayoge hi sati utarasūtre
dvayorapyanuvṛttiḥ syāt| nanu yogavibhāge'pyānantaryātkāmyaca
evānuvṛttiḥ prāpnoti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; cakāro'tra kriyate, sa
kyaco'nukarṣaṇārthaḥ, tadanukarṣaṇasya caitadeva
prayojanam--utaratrānuvṛttiryathā syāt| kāmyacastu
yogavibhāgasāmarthyādananuvṛttiḥ| prayojānābhāvāditi|
agnikāmyatītyādau guṇaniṣedho na prayojanam,
anārddhadhātukatvādeva guṇasyāpraṅgat| ṭhvijupe cchandasi' upayaṭ,
upayajamicchati upayaṭkāmyatītyatra na saṃprasāraṇaṃ prayojanam;
yajādibhiḥ kito viśeṣaṇāt---yajādibhyo yo vihitaḥ kiditi|
vākkāmyatītyatrāpi dhātoḥ sarūpagrahaṇe kāryavijñānānna saṃprasāraṇaṃ
prayojanam|
cakārāditvādveti| kecidvyācakṣate---ante'sya cakāro'narthakaḥ,
dhātusvareṇaivāntodātatvasya siddhtvāt, sa ādau kartavyaḥ| atha
vā---ante'pi kṛto niyamārthaḥ saṃpadyate---cidvāyaṃ vyapadeṣṭavyo
nānubandhāntareṇeti tenānte kṛta āditvaphalasaṃpādanādāditaḥ
saṃpadyata iti| anye tu ṭhsupa ātmanaḥ kyac' ṭhkāmyacca' iti
dvicakārakanirdeśāśrayeṇa cakārāditvaṃ varṇayanti' citkaraṇaṃ tu
putrakāmiṣyatītyatra sati śiṣṭamapi syasvaraṃ citsvara eva yathā
syāditi||
upamānādācāre|| 3|1|10 ||
upamānādācāre|| ṭhkuḍa|le' ityupameye saptamīśravaṇādupamānamapi
saptamyantameveti karmavivakṣāyāmetatprayogasambhavādvacanārambhaḥ|
kuṭa|lamiti tu yuktaḥ pāṭhaḥ|| 
kartuḥ kyaṅ salopaśca|| 3|1|11 ||
kartuḥ kyaṅ salopaśca|| ācāra iti vartata iti tena
tadapekṣamupamānasya kartṛtvaṃ vijñāyata iti bhāvaḥ| salopaśceti|
yadyayaṃ caśabdaḥ samuccayavṛttirgṛhyaeta tadekameva vākyaṃ
syāt----kyaṅsalopau bhavati iti, tataśca yatraiva salopastatraiva
kyaṅapi syād---ojāyata iti, iha tu na syāt----śyenāyate kāka
iti| ato'nvācaye caśabde
vākyabhedaścāśrayaṇīyaḥ---aviśeṣeṇopamānātkartuḥ kyaṅ bhavati, yatra
tu sakāraḥ sambhavati tatra tasya lopa iti tadidamuktam|
anvācayaśiṣṭaḥ salopastadasambhave'pi kyaṅ bhavatīti| śyenāyata iti
ṭhakṛtsārvadhātukayordīrghaḥ'| 
salopavidhāvapīti| salopasyānvācayaśiṣṭatvena vākyabhede
satyayamapi guṇo bhavatītyartaḥ| 
apiśabdenaitaddarśayati---kyaṅvidhau tāvatsambaddhyate
vākyasaṃpādanāya, evaṃ salopavidhāvapīti| ojāyata iti| ojaḥ
śabdo vṛttiviṣaye tadvati vartate|
ojasopsarasonityaṃ payasastu vibhāṣayeti| anyasya tu yaśaḥ
prabhṛternaiva bhavatītyeke, neti vayam| ojopsarovyatiriktasya
sakārāntasyopalakṣaṇārthaṃ payograhaṇam| ata eva salopo vā|
ojasopsarasornityamiti sāmānyena vārtikam; tena yaśāyate
ityādyapi bhavatisalopo'psarasa evetyayaṃ tu pakṣo bhāṣye'pi na
sthitaḥ| salopavidho karturiti sthānaṣaṣṭhī saṃpadyate iti|
pratyayavidhau yatpañcamyantaṃ tadeva lopena
sambandhe'rthādvibhaktivipariṇāmo bhavatīti ṣaṣṭha|lntaṃ sampadyata ityarthaḥ|
tatrālo'ntyasyeti niyame satīti| sakāreṇa
karturviśeṣaṇātadantavidhivijñānātadarthameva ca seti pṛthak padaṃ
luptaṣaṣṭhīkam| kvacit alo'ntyaniyame satīti pāṭhaḥ, tatra
sūtraikadeśānukaraṇatvātsamāse'pi vibhakterlugabhāvaḥ,
yathā----asyavāmīyamiti|
ācāra ityādi| kyaṅpavādo'yam| ṭhgalbha dhārṣṭa|le, ṭhklībṛ
adhārṣṭa|le' ṭhhoḍḥa anādare'---ete pacādyajantā gṛhyante, tsaya
cākārasya vākye'nudātatvānunāsikatve pratijñāyete, tena
kvibantādātmanepadaṃ bhavati| vāvācanātkvipā mukte kyaṅ bhavati,
kvipsanniyogenānunāsikatvapratijñānāt kyaṅpakṣe itsaṃjñā na
bhavati| kimartha punaridam, yāvatā galbhādayo dhātava evānudātenaḥ
paṭha|lnte, tebhyo galbhata ityādi siddhyati, etebhya eva pacādyajantebhyaḥ
kyaṅ ivagalbhāyate ityādi, yadyapi dhārṣṭa|ladāvarthe galbhādayaḥ
paṭha|lnte, tathāpyanekārthatvāddhātūnām avagalbha ivācaratītyatrārthe'pi
ta eva vartiṣyante? satyam; avagalbhāṃcakre ityādau
pratyayāntatvādāmyathā syādityevamartha kvib vidhīyate|
atha yadā dhātubhya eva liḍ vidhīyate tadā kathaṃ bhavitavyam?
avajagalbhe, viciklībe, vijuhoḍe iti| anye tu---dhātubhya eva
kvib vidhīyate iti vadanta etāni rūpāṇi na sambhavantītyāhuḥ,
bhāṣyavirodhāt| bhāṣyakārastāvatsarvaprātipadikebhya ityanena
siddhimāśaṅkate---na tarhīdānīmityādinā| na hi dhātugrahaṇe sati
tena siddhiśaṅkopapadyate| vārtikakāro'pi ṭhsarvaprātipadikebhyaḥ'
iti vadan galbhādiṣvapi prāpitadikagrahaṇameva manyate| na kevalaṃ
galbhādibhya eva, api tarhi sarvebhya eva prātipadikebhya iti hi
tasyārthaḥ| ṭhsarvaprātipadikebhyaḥ' ityatra ṭhsarvebhyaḥ' iti vaktavye
prātipadikagrahaṇāt prātipadikādeva kvib vidhīyate, na
subantāt; tena padatvābhāvādaśvatīti ṭhato guṇe' iti śapā
pararūpaṃ bhavati, vidhuraviśabdābhyāṃ kvipi śapi gupe ṭheṅaḥ
padāntādati' iti na bhavati| vidhavati, ravayati, rājanatīti
nalopo na bhavati| vācatītyādau tu kutvajaśtvādi na bhavati|
ye'pi sarvaprātipadikebhyaḥ kvipamicchanti, tairapi galbhādyanukramaṇaṃ
kartavya mātmanepadārthānanubandhānāsaṃkṣyāmīti||
bhṛśādibhyo bhuvyacverlopaśca halaḥ|| 3,1,12 ||
bhṛśādibhyo buvyacverlopaśca halaḥ|| lopavidhau ṭhbhṛśādibhyaḥ' iti
pañcamī sthānaṣaṣṭha|la viriṇamyate, halā ca bhṛśādayo viśeṣyante,
tatra tadantavidhau sati halantānāṃ lopo vidhīyamāno bhṛśāyate
ityādāvahalantena cabhavati, tadāha----halantānāṃ ca
vijñāyamāne'halantānāṃ pāṭho'narthakaḥ syāt| acveriti
pratyekamabhisambandhayate iti| tenaikavacanamupapadyate iti bhāvaḥ|
kimarthe punaridamucyate iti| ṭhacveḥ' ityetadadhikṛtya praśnaḥ|
teneti| anuprayujyamānena bhavatinetyarthaḥ| na ca bhavateranuprayogaṃ
bādhitvā kyaṅ bhavitumarhati, acvyanteṣu sāvakāśatvāt| kiñca,
bhavaterabhāve cverapi nivṛttiprasaṅgaḥ, tadyoge tasya vidhānāt|
kathaṃ tarhi ḍājantātkyaṣ bhavati, yāvatā ḍājapi bhavatiyoge
vidhīyate? atra parihāraṃ vakṣyati---kṛbhvastibhiriva kyaṣāpi yoge
ḍāj bhavatītyetadeva jñāpakamiti| tatsaddaśapratipatyartha tarhīti|
nañivayuktanyāyena cvyantasaddaśā bhṛśādayaḥ kathannāma pratīyeranniti
cvyantaparyudāsaḥ kriyate, sāddaśyaṃ
cābhūtadbhāvaviṣayatvenetyāha---abhūtatadbhāvaviṣayebhyo
mṛśādibhya ityādi| bhṛśāyate ityādi| ajantānām
ṭhakṛtsārvadhātukayoḥ' iti dīrghaḥ, halantānāṃ tu lopaḥ----asumanāḥ
sumanā bhavati sumanāyate, durmanāyate ityādi|
bhṛśībhavatīti| idānīmevoktam---nāstyatra prasaṅgaḥ iti,
tasmādacvyarthaviṣayaṃ pratyudāharaṇaṃ pradarśanīyam----kva divā bhṛśā
bhavantīti| ye rātrau bhṛśā nakṣatrādayaste divā kva pradeśe
bhavantītyarthaḥ| iha manaḥ śabdaḥ sopasargaḥ paṭha|lte----sumanas,
durmanas, abhimanas, unmanas; atra kiṃ sopasargātsaṅghātātpratyayo
bhavati? āhosvidupasargaravitānmanaḥ sabdādeva? iti vicāraḥ tadartha
ca kimupasargaḥ prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇaṃ sumanaḥ śabdāditi? uta
pratyayārthaviśeṣaṇam---subhavato, durbhavatau, abhibhavatau,
udbhavatāviti ? kathaṃ punarmanaḥ śabdena saha paṭhita upasarge
pratyayārthaviśeṣaṇamāśaṅkyate, tadviśeṣaṇatve hiprāgbhavateḥ paṭha|leta?
naiṣa śakyaḥ prāgbhavateḥ paṭhitum, evaṃ hi sarvebhya eva bhaśādibhya
upasargaviśiṣṭa eva bhavatyarthe pratyayaḥ syād, manaḥ śabdādeva ca
viśiṣṭe'rthe iṣyata ityevamartho manaḥ----śabdena saha pāṭhaḥ syāt| tatra
yadā manāḥ śabdena svādīnāṃ bahuvrīhīstadā prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇaṃ te
bhavanti; yadā tvasamastā eva tadā pratyayārthaviśeṣaṇam| manaḥ śabdaśca
vṛttiviṣaye tadvati vartate manasvī suṣṭhua bhavatītyādāvarthe kyaṅ
pratyayaḥ| prāptyarthasya vā bhavateḥ ṭhā dhṛṣādvā' iti vikalpitaṇico'tra
viṣaye grahaṇam, tena manaḥ karma śobhanaṃ prāpnotītyādirartho
bhavati| tatrādye pakṣe'ḍāḍlyabdvirvacaneṣu doṣaḥ, aṭ---svamanāyata,
duramanāyata| āṭ---abhyamanāyata, udamanāyata| upasargasyāpi kyaṅnte
dhātāvantarbhāvātataḥ pūrvamaḍāṭau prāpnutaḥ, parau ceṣyete|
lyap---sumanāyya, abhimanāyya, upasargasya
ktvānte'nupraveśātadvyatiriktapadābhāvādasati samāse
lyapo'bhāvātsumanāyitveti syāt| dvirvacanam---kyaḍantātsani
kṛte upasargasya sanante'nupraveśātasya dvirvacane sati
susumanāyiṣate abibhimanāyiṣate iti syād, sumimanāyiṣate
abhimimanāyiṣata iti ceṣyate? naiṣa doṣaḥ, curādau ṭhsaṃgrāma yuddhe'
iti paṭha|lte, sa na pāṭhayaḥ; saṃgrāmaśabdād yuddhavācinaḥ ṭhtat
karoti tadācaṣṭe' ityeva ṇicaḥ siddhatvāt| paṭha|lmānastu
jñāpayati----sopasargātsaṅghātāddhātusaṃjñānimitakapratyaye
vidhitsite upasargāḥ pṛthak kriyante, pariśiṣṭādeva tu pratyaya
iti| saṃgrāmaśabdo hi sopasargaḥ saṃghāta eva curādāvapi paṭha|lte, na
tūpasargasaddaśāvayavaṃ śabdāntaram| tathā ca ṭhvā padāntasya' iti
parasavarṇavikalpo bhavati, anyathā sa na syāt| sa evamarthaḥ
paṭha|lte---asaṃgrāmayata śūraḥ, saṃgrāmayitvā, sisaṃgramayiṣata ityādi
rūpaṃ yathā syāditi, tataścoktasyārthasya jñāpakaḥ| niyamārtho
vā---dhātusaṃjñāhetuḥ pratyayaḥ sopasargādyadi bhavati
saṃgrāmaśabdādeveti| nanu cātrānudātedayaṃ saṃgrāmayatiriṣyate,
tataścātmanepadārthamanubandhamāṃkṣyāmīti pāṭhaḥ syāditi kathaṃ
jñāpako niyamārtho vā bhavet? syādetat---anubandhāsañjanārthe hi
pāṭhe ṭhgrāma yuddhe' ityeva paṭhitavyam, saṃśabdastu dyotakaḥ
prayogadarśanādeva labhyate iṅkoirivādhiḥ, niyamārthastu saṃgrāmeti
pāṭha iti| evamapi yathā iṅkoridheḥ pūrvamāṇ na bhavati,
tathā'syāpi na syāt, tasmād dvitīyaḥ pakṣa āśrīyate| yadyevam, yathā
śyenāyata iti ācārārthasya kyaṅektatvādāṅḥ prayogo na bhavati tathā
svadīnāmapi na syāt| tadviśiṣṭa evārthe kyaṅe vidhānād
yuktameko pasargeṇa viśiṣṭārthe kyaṇutpadyata iti tasya tenābhidhānam,
iha punaranekena| tatra---manāyata ityukte saṃdehaḥ syāt subhavatau
durbhavatau veti? tatrāsaṃdehārthamupasargaḥ prayoktavyaḥ| ayaṃ tarhi
doṣaḥ---manaḥ śabdātkyaṅ kṛte mināyata ityasya tiṅntasya
svāderatiṅntādutarasya nighātaḥ prāpnoti| pakṣāntare tu
sumanāyata ityādi tiṅntaṃ saṃpadyate itai
tadvyatiriktābhāvānnighātābhāvaḥ| evaṃ tarhi bhṛśādiṣūpasargasya
parāṅgavabhāvaṃ vakṣyāmi ṭhsubāmantrite' ityasyānantaraṃ
bhṛśādiṣūpasarga iti| ihāpi tarhi prāpnoti---abhibhṛśāyate
subhṛśāyata iti? yadi neṣyate ṭhmanasyupasarge' iti vakṣyāmi, manaḥ
śabde parata upasargastasyaiva parasya manaḥ śabdasyāṅgavadbhavati svare
kartavye iti| evaṃ ca devadataḥ sumanāyata ityādau upasargasyāpi
ṭhtiṅṅatiṅaḥ' iti nighāto bhavati| yo'pyāha---sumanaḥśabdātpratyaye
vidhitsite upasargaḥ pṛthak kriyate, pariśiṣṭādeva pratyaya iti,
tenāpi svare parāṅgavadbhāvo vaktvya eva| tadevaṃ
pratyayārthaviśeṣaṇaṃ svādayaḥ, manaḥ śabdādeva kevalātpratyaya iti
sthitam| yadi tu sāmānyena jñāpakamiṣyate saṅghātātpratyaye
vidhitsite upasargāḥ pṛthak kriyante iti, nātraiva, yathā ṭhprabhau
parivṛḍhaḥ' ityatra vakṣyate----parivṛḍhamācaṣṭe iti ṇici katvāpratyaye
kṛte parivṛḍhayyeti lyab bhavatīti, tato jñāpakāntaraṃ mṛgyam| ca
kiṃcidudgranthābhidhānaṃ sūribhirityuparamyate||
lohitādiḍhānbhyaḥ ksaṣ|| 3|1|13 ||
lohitādiḍājabhyaḥ ksaṣ|| paṭapaṭāyatīti| avyaktānukaraṇāditi
ḍāci vivakṣite ṭhḍāci bahulaṃ dve bhavataḥ' iti dvirvacanam, tato
ḍāp, paṭatpaṭā iti sthite ṭhnityamāmreḍite ḍāci' iti paṭacchabdasya
yastakāre yaśca paraḥ pakārastayoḥ pararūpaṃ pakāraḥ, lohitaḍājbhyaḥ
kyaṣvacanaṃ bhṛśādiṣvitarāṇi' iti vārtikam, tadetatpaṭhitābhiprāyaṃ
na punaranenādigrahaṇaṃ pratyākhyāyata ityāha---yāni paṭha|lnte iti|
nidrākaruṇākṛpāśabdā vṛttiviṣaye tadvati vartante, anidro
nidrāvān bhavati, akaruṇaḥ karuṇāvān bhavati, akṛpaḥ kṛpāvān
bhavatītyatrārthe pratyayaḥ| ūparipaṭhitebhyastu kyaṣeva
bhavatītyasyopapādanam| ākṛtigaṇaścāyamiti| kuta ityata
āha---tathā ceti| kva punaḥ sāmānyagrahaṇārthaḥ kakāraḥ?
kyacvyośceti| ṭhāpatyasya' iti vartate, na cāyamāpatyādiṣyate| iha
tarhi ṭhkyasya vibhāṣā'? ṭhhalaḥ' iti vartate, na cāyaṃ halantādiṣyate|
iha tarhi ṭhkyācchandasi' ? etadyācchandasīti
vaktavyam----bhuraṇyusturaṇyuriti, kaṇḍvādiyagantādapi yathā
syāditi| ṭhvā kyaṣaḥ' ityetadvā yādityevāstu| na caivam
ṭhpāśādibhyo yaḥ' pāśyā, atra prasaṅgaḥ? sāmānyavihitānāntiṅaṃ
niyamārtha prakaraṇam| na ca pāśādayātpirasmaipadamātmanepadaṃ vā
prāptamasti| athāpyācārakvibantātsambhaved? evamapi ṭhvā yaṣaḥ'
ityevāstu tatrāha--naḥ kye iti| kakāramanubandhamāsañjataḥ
sūtrakārasyāpyākṛtigaṇatvamabhipretamityāha---na hīti| bhāṣye
tvādigrahaṇapratyākhyānaparameva vārtikaṃ vyākhyātam| kakāro'pi
pratyākhyātaḥ| kathaṃ punaḥ paṭapaṭāyatāti kyaṣyoge ḍāj bhavati,
yāvatā kṛbhvastiyoge sa vidhīyate?
tatrāha---kṛbhvastibhirivetyādi| bhavatyarthe kyaṣ vidhīyate, sa
bhavatiprayoge na bhavati, tenaivoktatvātasyārthasya| ato
bhavateraprayoga eva kyaṣā bhavitavyam| yadi ca kyaṣā yogo ḍājca
na syāḍḍājantāt kyaṣvidhānamanupapannaṃ syāditi bhāvaḥ| atha
kimartham ṭhvā kyaṣa'iti sūtramārabhyate, na kyaṣ ceti cakāro'tra
kartavyaḥ, lohitādibhyaḥ kyaṣ bhavati cakārāt kyaṅ ca, tatra
kyaṅpakṣe ātmanepadam, kyaṣpakṣe parasmaipadamiti siddhamiṣṭam? aho
sūkṣmadarśī devānāṃpriyaḥ, yadidamapi na ddaṣṭam---ṭhkyaṅmāninośca'
iti| iha tarhi ṭhprātipadikagrahaṇe liṅgaviśiṣṭasyāpi grahaṇam' iti
lohinīśabdādapyayaṃ kyaṣ bhavati, sati caivaṃ kyaṅntādātmanepadaṃ
kyaṣantātparasmaipadamiti vijñāyamāne ātmanepadapakṣe
ṭhkyaṅmāninośca' iti puṃvadbhāve sati alohinī lohinī bhavati
lohitāyata iti prāpnoti, adya punaḥ kyaṣantādātmanepade vikalpite
lohinīyate lohinīyatītīṣṭṃa siddhyatīti spaṣṭa eva phalabhedaḥ|| 
kaṣṭāya kramaṇe|| 3|1|14 ||
kaṣṭāya kramaṇe|| caturthīsamarthāditi| saṅgatārthaḥūusamarthaḥ,
ṭhcaturthyā samartha' iti tṛtīyāsamāsaḥ| pratyayārthena kramaṇena saha
saṅgatārthatvaṃ yasya caturthīkṛtaṃ tasmādityarthaḥ| etacca ṭhkaṣṭāya' iti
nirdeśādeva labhyate| kramaṇaśabdasya pādaviharaṇe prasiddhatvātatraiva
pratyayo mā vijñāyītyāha---kramaṇe'rthe'nārjava iti| anārjavaṃ
kauṭilyam, iha tvanārjavaśabdo'nākaraṇarūpe kramaṇe
paryavasyatyarthāt| kiṃ punaḥ kramaṇam? utsāhaḥ, yathā
vyākaraṇādhyayanāya kramate utsahata ityartha iti vyākhyātam| kaṣṭāya
karmaṇe kramata iti| ṭhkṛcchragahanayoḥ kaṣaḥ' iti kṛcchra iḍabhāvaḥ,
