kṛcchramuduḥ kham| iha tu tatkāraṇaṃ pāpaṃ karma, kṛcchrṃa pāpaṃ karma
kartumutsahata ityarthaḥ| ṭhvṛttisarga' ityātmanepadam| prāyeṇa tu
parasmaipadaṃ paṭha|lte, tatra pāpaṃ karma kartukāmaḥ
kuṭilamācaratītyarthaḥ anutsāhatvātparasmaipadam|
atyalpamidamucyata iti| sarvalakṣyāsaṃgrahāt| kathaṃ tarhi
vaktavyamityāha---satrakakṣetyādi| asminpakṣe dvidīyāntebhyaḥ pratyayaḥ;
cikīrṣāṃ prati karmatvāt| kaṇvacikīrṣāyāmiti|
prakṛtipratyayasamudāyasyāyamarthanirdeśaḥ| kaṇvamupāpam| satrādayo
hi vṛttiviṣaye pāpaparyāyāstebhyaścikīrṣāyāṃ pratyayaḥ, pāpaṃ
cikīrṣatītyasvapadena vigrahaḥ| ajaḥ kaṣṭṃa krāmatīti| kramiratra
pādaviharaṇe vartate, kaṣṭṃa gahanadeśaṃ krāmati gacchatītyarthaḥ||
karmaṇo romanthatapobhyāṃ varticaroḥ|| 3|1|15 ||
karmaṇo romanthatapobhyāṃ varticaroḥ|| ṭhkarmaṇaḥ' iti pañcamī,
romanthatapobhyāmityanena sāmānādhikaraṇyāt|
pratyekasambandhātvekavacanam| vartīti| ṇyantād vṛteḥ ṭhṇyāsaśrantho
yuc' iti yuci prāpte'smādeva nipātanāt ktin| yujapi
bhavati---vartanā | caraṇaṃ car, saṃpāditvādbhāve kvip| hanucalana
iti| hanucalanasahacaritaṃ carvitasya mukhapradeśe ākṛṣya carvaṇaṃ
tatretyarthaḥ| kīṭo romanthaṃ vartayatīti| avagīrṇamapādānapradeśānniḥ
sṛtaṃ romanthākhyaṃ dravyaṃ vartayatiu vṛtaṃ karoti, gulikāṃ
karotītyarthaḥ| nātra hanucalanamasti| tapasaḥ parasmaipadaṃ ceti| evaṃ
ca ṭhnamovarivaḥ' ādisūtre tapaḥ śabdaḥ paṭhitavyastathā tu na
kṛtamityeva| iha ṭhtapasyate lokaṃ jigīṣuragneḥ' iti ṭhtapasyate
lokaṃ jigīṣuragneḥ' iti chāndasatvādātmanepadam||
bāṣpoṣmabhyāmudvamane|| 3|1|16 ||
śabdavairakalahābhrakaṇvameghebhyaḥ karaṇe|| 3|1|17 ||
sukhādibhyaḥ kartṛvedanāyām|| 3|1|18 ||
sukhādibhyaḥ kartṛvedanāyām|| vedanāyāmiti| ṭhvida
cetanākhyānanivāseṣu' ityasmāccurādiṇyantādbhāve ṭhṇyāsaśrantho
yuc' , ṭhghaṭṭivandividibhyaśca' ityaupasaṃkhyāniko vā|
vedanāyāmarthe'nubhava iti| pratyakṣajñānamuanubhavaḥ| yadyapi
vedanāśabdo jñānamātravacanastathāpi kartṛgrahaṇena sukhādīni
viśeṣyante, kartṛgatānāṃ ca sukhādīnāṃ vedanā'nubhavarūpaiveti
matvaivamuktam| kriyāpekṣaṃ kartṛtvaṃ vedanāsaṃnidhānātadapekṣameva
vijñāyate| kartrā ca sukhādīni viśeṣyante na vedanā;
vyabhicārābhāvāt| sarvaiva hi vedanā vedayitureva bhavati,
tadetadāha----vedayituścetkartuḥ sukhādīti bhavantīti|
āśrayāśrayibhāvalakṣaṇaśca sambandhaḥ, na janyajanakabhāvalakṣaṇaḥ| evaṃ ca
kartṛgrahaṇaṃ luptaṣaṣṭhīkaṃ pṛthakpadam| vedayata iti| ṭhā
kusmādātmanepadī' ityadhikāre vediḥ paṭhitaḥ| evaṃ ca pratyudāharaṇe
parasmaipadapāṭhaḥ pramādajaḥ| prasādhakaḥ u abhyaṅgādeḥ kartā,
saṃprasādhyamānasya netravikārādinā sukhamanumānato jānāti||
namovarivaścitraṅḥ kyac|| 3|1|19 ||
namovarivaścitraḍaḥ kyac|| karaṇaviśeṣe pūjādāviti| ṭhkaraṇe' iti
sāmānyānuvṛtāvapyabhidhānaśaktisvābhāvyādviśeṣa upalabhya iti bhāvaḥ|
namasyati devāniti| ṭhnamaḥ svastisvāhā' iti caturthī na bhavati,
pratyayārthe guṇībhūtasya namaḥ śabdasya niṣkṛṣya sambandhābhāvāt| atha
vā---namasyati namaskāreṇa pūjayatītyarthaḥ| tatra ṭhupapadavibhakteḥ
kārakavibhaktirbalīyasī' iti dvitīyeva bhavati| evaṃ ca namaskaroti
devānityādāvapi dvitīyeva bhavati| paricaryāyāmiti| paricaryāu
śuśrūṣā| citrīyate iti| avayavakṛtaṃ liṅgaṃ samudāyasya viśeṣakaṃ
bhavatīti kyajantādātmanepadaṃ bhavati, ṭhkyaci ca' itītvam|
etadarthameva ca śabdavairādisūtre citraśabdo na paṭhitaḥ| citrīyata
iti| vismayata ityartha ityeke| vismāpayata ityartha ityanye| tathā ca
bhaṭṭikāvye māyāmṛgaṃ prakṛtya bhavati ṭhtataścitrīyamāṇo'sau'
iti||
pucchabhāṇḍacīvarāṇṇiṅ|| 3|1|20 ||
pucchabhāṇḍacīvarāṇṇiṅ|| pucchādudasane paryasane veti|
udasanamūtkṣepaṇam| paryasanamuparitaḥ kṣepaṇam| utpucchayata iti|
nanu yathā''cāre kyaṅ ivihite āṅḥ prayogo na bhavati, tatkasya
hetoḥ? āṅviśiṣṭasyaiva caratyarthasya kyaṅabhidhānāt,
tadvadihāpyutkṣepaṇe ṇiṅe vidhānādudaḥ prayogo na prāpnotīti?
astyatra viśeṣaḥ----paryasane'pyayaṃ vidhīyate| tatrodasanaṃ
dyotayitumucchabdaḥ, paryasanaṃ dyotayituṃ pariśabdaśca prayoktavyaḥ|
samācayanamurāśīkaraṇam, arjanamu dravyalābhopāyaḥ, yācñādi|
ṅkāra ātmanepadārtha iti| tenotarasūtre pucchādayo na śakyāḥ
paṭhitumiti bhāvaḥ||
maṇḍamiśraślakṣṇalavaṇavratavastrahalakalakṛtatūstebhyo ṇic|| 3|1|21 ||
maṇḍamiśraślakṣṇalavaṇavratavastrahalakalakṛtatūstebhyo ṇic||
kimarthamidam, na prātipadikāddhātvartha ityeva siddham; na ca
tatkarotītyādinā tatra dhātvarthaniyamaḥ kriyate,
rājānamatikrāntavānatyararājadityapi darśanāt? muṇḍaṃ karoti
māṇavaka mityādau' sāpekṣebhyo'pi ṇij yathā syādityevamartha
prapañcārtha vā| halikalyostvadantatvanipātanārtham, anyathā hali i
kali i iti sthite ṭhaco ñṇiti' iti vṛddhiḥ prāpnoti,
ṭhṇāviṣṭhavat' iti ṭilopaśca; tatra lopaḥ śabdāntaraprāptyā'nityaḥ,
vṛddhistu ṭilope kṛte'prāptevaityubhayoranityayoḥ paratvād
vṛddhau kṛtāyāmaikārasya lopastannāglopyaṅgaṃ bhavatīti
ṭhsanvallaghuni' iti sanvadbhāvaḥ syāt, ṭhdīrgho laghoḥ' iti dīrghaśca,
atvanipātane tu yadyapi paratvād vṛddhistathāpyageva lupyate iti
sanvadbhāvo na bhavati, tadāha---halikalyoradantatvanipātanaṃ
sanvadbhāvapratiṣedhārthamiti| upalakṣaṇametat, ṭhdīrgho laghoḥ' iti
dīrghābhāvārtha ca| ṭhdīrgho laghoḥ' ityatrāpyanaglopa iti vartate| evaṃ
ca balipaṭuaprabhṛtibhyo ṇici abivalat, apīpaṭaditi bhavati, na
tvababalat apapaṭaditi| ṭhsatyāpapāśa' ityatra muṇḍādayaḥ
paṭhitavyāstathā tu na kṛtamityeva||
dhātorekāco halādeḥ kriyāsamabhihāre yaṅ|| 3|1|22 ||
dhātorekāco halādeḥ kriyāsamabhihāre yaṅ|| ṭhhalādeḥ' iti
viśeṣaṇādekāca iti bahuvrīhiḥ| kriyāsamabhihāre vartata iti|
samabhihriyamāṇāyāṃ kriyāyāṃ hi vartata ityartaḥ| anena samabhihārasya
prakṛtiviśeṣaṇatvaṃ darśayati| kriyā hi dhātuvācyā|
samabhihāraviśiṣṭāpi kriyaiva bhavati, ataḥ prakṛtiviśeṣaṇatvameva
yuktam, yathā atiśayena śuklo'pi śukla evetyatiśayānaṃ
prakṛtyarthastadvat| tasmādyaṅpratyayo bhavatīti| kva? anirdiṣṭāryāḥ
pratyayāḥ svārthe bhavantīti tatraiva| samabhihāre dyotye
prakṛtyarthasamabhihriyamāṇatvadyotanāyetyarthaḥ, yathā
prakṛtyarthasyātiśayadyotanāya tarabādayastadvat| iha biprakīrṇānaṃ
mūrtānāmekakālānāmekatra rāśīkaraṇaṃ samudāyabhāvāpatirmukhyaḥ
samabhihāraḥ, yathā---pūlādīnām| dhātuvācyā tu kriyaikaiva| yadyapi
ṭhdivu krīḍāvijigīṣāvyavahāradyautistutikāntigatiṣu' ityanekārthe
diviḥ paṭha|lte, tathāpi na yugapadanekārthamācaṣṭe, kiṃ tarhi?
prayogabhedena| yadyapi cāśrayabhedādviṣayabhedācca bhidyate pākaḥ----anya
eva hi devadatakartṛkaḥ pākaḥ, anya eva cānyakartṛkaḥ, anyaścaudanasya
pāko'nya eva tailādīnām; tathāpi dhātunā nivṛtabhedaiva sā
pratyāyyate| ata eva bhavadbhirāsyata ityādau bahuvacanaṃ na bhavati| na
khalu kartṛbhedaḥ kartṛ-bhedaḥ kriyāvyaktibhedena vyāptaḥ,
ekaphalāvacchinnāmekāmeva kriyāṃ kurvatsvapi bahuṣu pacantīti
darśanāt| tadevaṃ dhātuvācyā samūharūpā pradhānakriyaikaiveti
samabhihārābhāvaḥ| adhiśrayaṇādīnāṃ tu guṇakriyāṇāṃ
yugapadekadhātuvācyatve'pi kramajanyatvādutpannāpavargitvena
yugapadavasthānābhāvādamūrtatvācca kadhātuvācyatve'pi
kramajanyatvādutpannāpavargitvena yugapadavasthānābhāvādamūrtatvācca
samabhihārābhāvaḥ| tadevaṃ mukhyasya samabhihārasya
dhātvarthaviṣaye'sambhavād gauṇo gṛhyate, taddarśayati,
taddarśayati---paunaḥ punyaṃ bhṛśārtho veti| dravyāṇāṃ
dravyāntarairavyapetānāṃ samabhihāro bhavati, tathā kriyāṇāmapi
kriyāntarairavyapetānāmetadubhayaṃ bhavati| tatra pradhānakriyāṇāṃ paunaḥ
yunyaṃ samabhihāraḥ, punaḥ punaranuṣṭhīyamānaviṣayaṃ hi tat|
pradhānakriyaiva ca punaḥ punaranuṣṭhīyate| avayavakriyāṇāṃ tu
bhṛśārthatā samabhihāraḥ, buddhigocarānekasakalāvayavakriyāviṣayā hi
sā| pāpacyata iti| ṭhdīrgho'kitaḥ' iti dīrghaḥ| dedīpyata iti| ṭhguṇo
yaṅlukoḥ' yaṇèóva samabhihārasya dyotitatvāt| ṭhkriyāsamabhihāre
dve bhavataḥ ' iti vā ṭhnityavīpsayaeḥ' iti vā dvirvacanaṃ na bhavati|
dhātoriti kimiti| anyasya kriyāsamabhihāre vṛttyasaṃbhavātpraśnaḥ|
bhṛśaṃ prāṭatīti| atra dhātūpasargasamudāyasya
viśiṣṭakriyāvacanatvātato yaṅsyāt, tataścopasargasya dvirvacanaṃ
syāt| yadi sopasargasaṃghātasyaiva kriyāsamabhihāre vṛttiḥ,
prapāpacyata ityādau yaṅ na prāpnoti ? yo'tra dhātuḥ sa na
kriyāsamabhihāre, yaśca kriyāsamabhihāre na sa dhāturiti|
tasmādvātureva samabhihāraviśiṣṭakriyāvācī, upasargastu
sannidhimātreṇopakārakaḥ| tataśca saṃghātātprāptyabhāvānnārtho
dhātugrahaṇena| yatra tarhi saṃghātenaiva viśiṣṭā
kriyocyate----prateṣṭhīyata iti, atra hi
kevalastiṣṭhatirgatinivṛttivacanaḥ prapūrveṇa tu saṃghātena
gatikriyaivocyate, yathā---jaṅgamyata iti?
atrāpyanekārthatvāddhātūnāṃ tiṣṭhatireva gatau tannivṛtau ca vartate,
upasargastu sannidhimātreṇopakāraka iti dhātorutpattiraviruddhā,
tasmādārdhadhātukasaṃjñārthameva dhātugrahaṇam| tena ṭhbruvo vaciḥ'
ityādi bhavati| ānuṣaṅgikī tvathātunivṛttiḥ|
atha kathaṃ yaṅntādātmanepadaṃ bhavati? kathaṃ ca na syāt? iṅito
dhātorātbhanepadamucyate, yaścātra dhāturna sa ṅt, ni hyayaṃ
samudāyasyānubandhaḥ| yaśca ṅtprityayo nāsau dhātuḥ| yatra cāvayave
kṛtaṃ liṅgamacaritārtha tatra samudāyasya viśeṣakaṃ bhavati, ayaṃ
ṅkārastu bebhidyata ityādau guṇaniṣedhādau caritārthaḥ?
kaścidāha---kriyāsamabhihāre yaṅtyikāro'tra praśliṣyate, sa
cānudāto'nunāsikaḥ pratijñāyate,tatrānudātatvamavayave'caritārtha
samudāyasya viśeṣakaṃ bhavati, ṭhanudātetaśca halādeḥ' ityetacca na
bhavati ṭhjucaṅkramyadandramya' ityatra
caṅkramyadandramyagrahaṇālliṅgaditi, sa vaktavyaḥ| atha kathaṃ
ṛteroyaṅntādātmanepadaṃ bhavati, so'pi hi ṅkāro guṇanivṛtau
caritārtha iti? sa ced brūyātasyāpyādita ikāra īkāre vā
anudātaḥ praśliṣyata iti, pratibrūyādenam---ikāre numprasajyeta,
īkare ṭhśvīdito niṣṭhāyām' niṣṭhāyām' itīṇniṣedhaḥ syāditi?
naiṣa doṣaḥ; numvidhau ṭhgauḥ pādānte' ityato'ntagrahaṇamanuvartate,
tenānte ikāra itsañjñako yeṣāṃ teṣāṃ num| ṭhśvīdito
niṣṭhāyām' ityatrāpyekāca iti vartate? satyama;
prativihitamāyuṣmatā, mudhā punarayaṃ prayāsaḥ, tathā
hi---ṭhanudātaṅtiḥ' ityatra na dhātugrahaṇamasti, tataḥ kima? idaṃ tato
bhavati---pratyayameva ṅtimāśrityātmanepadaṃ siddhaṃ bhavati| na
caivamaśiśriyad avocadityādau caṅṅbhyāmapi prasaṅgaḥ; prāgeva
vikaraṇebhyaḥ ṭhanudātaṅtiḥ' ityetatprakaraṇaṃ pravartate; anyathā
ṭhvartate' ityādau vikaraṇavyavadhānānniyamo na syāt| yathā ca
prāgeva vikaraṇebhyo niyamaḥ pravartate, pravṛte tu niyame vikaraṇa
iti tathā tatraiva pratipāditamityalamiyatā|
sūcisūtrītyādi| sūcyādibhyo yaṅ vaktavyaḥ, kimartham?
sūcyādīnāmanekājartham, aśādīnāmahalādyartham,
ūrṇotestvanekājarthamahalādyarthaṃ ca| sosūcyata iti| ṭhsūca paiśunye',
sūtra avamocane', mūtra prasravaṇe' curādiṇyantāḥ| atra ṇilopo'pi
yaṅ ārdhadhātukatve prayojanam| aṭāṭa|lte| ṭhaṭa paṭa gatau',
ṭhajāderdvitīyasya'iti ṭa|lśabdasya dvirvacanam| aśaryate iti| ṭhṛ gatau'
ṭhguṇo'tisaṃyogādyoḥ' ṭhyaṅ ci' iti guṇaḥ, ṭh na ndrāḥ
saṃyogādayaḥ' ityatra ṭhyadā raparasya pratiṣedhaḥ' iti vacanādrephasya
dvirvacanam| aśāśyate iti| aśnoteraśeśca grahaṇamityāgamaḥ|
prorṇonūyate iti| ṭhūrṇuñ ācchādane' nopadho'yam, āṣṭamikaṃ
tu ṇatvam, tasyāsiddhatvānnuśabdasya dvirvacanam| nanu
ṭhpūrvatrāsiddhayimadvirvacane? syādetat----āṣṭamikaṃ tu
dvirvacanamabhipretya taducyate, yathā caujaḍhadityatra
ḍhatvādīnāmasiddhatvāddhata ityetad dvirucyate iti? tanna; evaṃ hi
ṣupibhūto dvirucyata iti vakṣyamāṇaṃ vyāhanyeta| evaṃ tarhi
pūrvatrāsiddhīyamadvirvacana ityetadanityam, ṭhubhau sābhyāsasya' iti
liṅgāt; anyathā ṭhaniteḥ' iti ṇatve kṛte tasya siddhatvāṇṇiśabdasya
dvirvacane sati siddhaṃ syātprāṇiṇiṣatīti| iha kasmānna
bhavati---lunīhi lunīhityevāyaṃ lunātīti? bhavatyeva| lolūyata
iti loṭ tarhi na prapnoti yaṅa bādhitatvāt, antaraṅgo yaṅ
kriyāsamabhihāramātrāpekṣatvāt; loṭ tu bahiraṅgaḥ,
kriyābhedāśraye dhātusambandhe bhāvakarmakartṛṣu ca vidhānāt|
sāvakāśaśca loṭ, ko'vakāśaḥ? anekājahalādiśca---jāgṛhi
jāgṛhītyevāyaṃ jāgarti, īkṣasvekṣasvetyevāyamīkṣata iti| evaṃ tarhi
vetyanuvṛteḥ pakṣe paṅ, yadā na yaṅ tadā loḍ bhaviṣyati|
yaṅe'kāro'ṭāṭa|lte ityādau dvirvacanārthaḥ||
nityaṃ kauṭilye gatau|| 3|1|23 ||
nityaṃ kauṭilye gatau|| ṭhdhātoḥ' iti varte, gatāviti tasya
viśeṣaṇam, gatau vartamānāddhātoriti| kauṭilye iti|
saṃnidhānād gativiṣayameva kauṭilyaṃ gamyate| cakramyate, dandramyata
iti ṭhkramu pādavikṣepe', drama mīmṛ gatau, ṭhnugatā'nunāsikāntasya',
yo'lpīyasyadhvani gatāgatānikaroti sa kuṭilāṃ gati
sampādayannevamucyate|
nityagrahaṇamanarthakam, anabhidhānādeva vākyaṃ na bhaviṣyati, na hi
caṃkramyata iti vṛterartha kuṭilaṃ kramātīti vākyaṃ śaknoti
gamayitum; saṃśayo hi vākyādbhavati----kiṃ gatikauṭilyam? uta
vakrahṛdayatvanibandhanaṃ jihvācaraṇamiti? vṛtau tu gatikoṭilyameva
niyataṃ gamyate, kauṭilyamātrapratipādane ca vākyaṃ
nivārayitumaśakyamaniṣṭṃa cāta āha---nityagrahaṇaṃ
viṣayaniyamārthamiti| gatikauṭilyaṃ viṣayaḥ, tatraiva yaṅ yathā
syādityevamarthamityarthaḥ, tadāha---gativacanānnityaṃ kauṭilya eva
bhavatīti| vyavacchedyaṃ darśayati---na tu kriyāsamabhihāra iti| nanu
yathā ṭhvaḍavāyā vṛṣe vācye' ityapatyeprāptastato'pakṛṣya vidhīyate,
yathā vā ṭhñītaḥ kta' bhūte prāptastato'pakṛṣya vartamāne vidhīyate,
evamatrāpi dhātumātrātkriyāsamabhihāre yaṅ vihitaḥ, gativacanāt
tu kauṭilya iti? takrakauḍinyanyāyenaiva bādhaḥ siddhaḥ| yathā vā
vivakṣitārthānabhidhānādvākyaṃ na bhavati tathā samabhihārānavagamādtra
pratyayo na bhaviṣyati| athaivamapi vacanāpekṣā? vākyanivṛtāvapi
vacanamapekṣasva! tadetannityagrahaṇaṃ cintyaprayojanam||
lupasadacarajapajabhadahadaśagṛbhyo bhāvagarhāyām|| 3|1|24 ||
lupasadacarajapajabhadahadaśagṛbhyo bhāvagarhāyām|| luplṛ cchedane',
ṭhṣadlṛ viśaraṇagatyavasādaneṣu'| ṭhāṅḥ sadiḥ padyarthe' ityasya tu
corādikaṇijantasya ekāca ityasyānuvṛteragrahaṇam| ṭhcara
gatyarthaḥ',ṭhjapa jalpa vyaktāyāṃ vāci',ṭhjabhī jṛbhī gātravināme',ṭhdaha
bhasmīkaraṇe', ṭhdanśa daśane'| anunāsikalopanirdeśo
yaṅlukyapyanunāsikalopārtha---dandaśītīti| ṭhgṛ nigaraṇe'
tudādiḥ, ṭhgṛ śabde' rkyādiḥ, tatrākārāntavikaraṇena
sāhacaryādādyasya grahaṇamityeke| dvayorapītyapare|
dhātvarthagarhāyāmiti| bhāvaśabdo dhātvarthe vartata iti darśayati|
garhitamiti kriyāviśeṣaṇam, tena bhāvagarhā'tra gamyate| garhitatvaṃ
tu chedanasya, niṣiddhatṛṇādiviṣayatvāt, ṭhloṣṭhamardī tṛṇacchedī
nakhakhādī ca yo naraḥ' iti evamutaratrāpi yathāsambhavaṃ garhitatvaṃ
bhedena draṣṭavyam| cañcūryate iti| ṭhcaraphalośca' iti nuk,
ṭhutparasyātaḥ', ṭhhali ca' iti dīrghaḥ| jañjapyate ityādau
ṭhjapajabhadahadaśabhañjapaśāṃ ca' iti nuk| nijegilyata iti| ṭhṛta
iddhātoḥ', raparatvam, dvirvacanam, abhyāsasya guṇaḥ, jegirya iti
sthite ṭhgro yaṅ' īti latvaṃ ca prāpnoti, ṭhhali ca' iti dīrghaśca,
tatra dīrghasyāsiddhatvāllatve kṛte vihatanimitatvāddīrghābhāvaḥ| anye
tu ṭhna mu ne' ityatra neti yogavibhāgenāsiddhatvaṃ bādhitvā dīrghe
kṛte latvāmicchanti, nātrāptavākyamasti|
garhāyāmiti kimiti| bhāvasyetyeva taddharmaviśeṣo lapsyate iti
praśnaḥ| dharmaviśeṣānupādāne praśaṃsāyāmapi syādityāha---sādhu
japatīti| japati vṛṣalo mantramiti| atra
svaravarṇādibhreṣābhāvādbhāvagarhā nāsti| vaidikamantrajapaṃ prati
śūdrasyānadhikārātu sādhanabhāve garhitaḥ, yasya khalvīddaśī
gatiḥ----ṭhśūdrasya vedamupaśrṛṇvatastrapujatubhyāṃ śrotrapratipūraṇam,
uccāraṇe jihvācchedaḥ dhāraṇe śarīrabhedaḥ' iti nāsau
japitumarhati| nityagrahaṇamityādi|
pūrvavadetadvyākhyeyam||
satyāpapāśarūpavīṇātūlaślokasenālomatvacavamavarṇacūrṇacurādibhyo ṇic|| 3|1|25 ||
satyāpapāśarūpavīṇātūlaślokasenālomatvacavamavarṇacūrṇacurādibhyo ṇic|| styāpetyakāra uccāraṇārthaḥ| satyamācaṣṭa iti| nanu bhāṣye satyasya kṛñyāpuk, satyaśabdātkṛñi karotyarthe ṇijbhavati āpukca, satyaṃ karoti satyāpayatītyuktam? satyam; kṛñgrahaṇamanārṣam, pradarśanārtho vā karotirdraṣṭavya iti manyate|
āpugvaktavya iti| āpugvacanasāmarthyāṭṭilopo na bhavati| kvacitu
vṛtāvevāyaṃ granthaḥ paṭha|lte| atha kathaṃ punaḥ śabdāpayediti?
chandovaddaṣayaḥ kurvanti| etena prakṣālāpayediti gṛhyaprayogo
vyākhyātaḥ| pāśādvimocane iti| prāyiko'yamarthanirdeśaḥ, anyatrāpi
bhavati; anyathā vipāśatīti viśabdasya prayogo na syāt,
viśabdaviśiṣṭasyaiva mocanasya ṇyarthatvāt, yathācārakyacyāṅḥ
prayogo na bhavati| evamupavīṇayadītyādāvapi draṣṭavyam|
tūlamutṛṇāgraṃ tenānukṛṣṇāti anughaṭṭayatītyarthaḥ|
anugṛhaṇātīti tu pāṭhāa na samīcīno'rthaḥ| abhiṣeṇayatīti|
ṭhupasargāt sunoti' ityādinā ṣatvam| akārāntastvacaśabda iti|
ṭhtvaca saṃvaraṇe' ityasmāddhātoḥ ṭhpuṃsi saṃjñāyām' iti ghaḥ|
avaghvaṃsayatīti| vikiratītyarthaḥ| ṭhprātipadikāddhātvarthe' ityeva siddhe
satyasyāpugvidhānārtha vacanamanyeṣāṃ prapañcārtham| bhālinyo
hyupaślokayantītyādau sāpekṣebhyo yathā syādityevamartha vā| kathaṃ
punarvimocanādirartho'nirdiṣṭo labhyata ityata
āha---svābhāvikatvāditi| pratyayārtho nirdiśyata iti|
sūtrakāreṇānirdiṣṭo'pi pratyayārtho vyākhyākārairnirdiśyata ityarthaḥ||
hetumati ca|| 3|1|26 ||
hetumati ca|| loke phalasādhanayogyaḥ padārtho heturityucyate,
tasya grahaṇe adhyayanena vasatītyatrāpi prasajyeta, hetumadgrahaṇaṃ
cānarthakaṃ syāt, katham? ṭhkaraṇe' iti vartate, tasya viśeṣaṇaṃ
hatumatīti, karaṇaṃ kriyā, sarvaiva ca kriyā hetumatoti kiṃ
viśeṣaṇopādānena ! nanu śabdopāte hetau yathachā
syādityevamarthametatsyādyathā ṭhsamastṛtīyāyuktāt' ityatra
śrayamāṇāyāṃ tṛtīyāyāmātmanepadaṃ yathā syātadarthayogamātre mā
bhūdityevamartha tṛtīyāyuktagrahaṇam| evaṃ tarhyasati virodhe
kṛtrimākṛtrimayoḥ kṛtrimasyaiva grahaṇaṃ yuktamiti ṭhtatprayojako
hetuśca' iti yasya saṃjñā vihitā tasyaiva pāribhāṣikasya grahaṇamiti
matvā''ha---hetuḥ svatantrasya kartuḥ prayojaka iti| tadīyo vyāpāra
iti| pravartanā| tasyāstvavāntarabhedamāha----preṣaṇādhyeṣaṇādilakṣaṇa
iti| bhṛtyādernikṛṣṭasya pravartanāupreṣaṇam, ājñetyarthaḥ|
gurvāderārādhyasya pravartanāu aghyeṣaṇam, prārthanetyarthaḥ|
ādiśabdena tatsthamarthācaraṇaṃ gṛhyate, tacca bahudhā bhidyate---anumatiḥ,
upadeśaḥ, anugraha iti| tatra yasyānumatimantareṇārtho na nirvartate
tasya rājāderanumatyā prayojakatvam, vaidyādestu ṭhmustāparpaṭakaṃ
pibejjvaritaḥ' ityādyaupadeśena pravartakatvam, yaḥ punaḥ
kenacijjighāṃsitaṃ palāyamānaṃ niruṇaddhi, niruṇaddhiśca hanyate, tatra
niroddhā hanturanugrahaṃ karotītyanugraheṇa tasya pravartakatvam|
sarvaścāyaṃ viśeṣaḥ prakaraṇādigamyaḥ| sarvatrānugataṃ pravartamānameva
tu ṇijarthaḥ| nanu yathā pitṛmānityukte yaṃ prati pitṛtvaṃ sa eva
gamyate tathātrāpi yaṃ prati hetutvaṃ sa eva hetumāniti yuktam,
kañca prati hetutvam? ṭhtatprayojakam' iti vacanātkartāraṃ pratīti
prāptaṃ ṭhkārake' ityadhikārātkriyāpekṣatvācca kārakabhāvasya
yasminvyāpāre prayojakarūpeṇopayujyate tameva prati, sa ca
prayojyavyāpāro'dhiśrayaṇādiḥ sarvasādhanasādhyo viklityādirveti
tayoreva hetumatvaṃ yuktam, na punaḥ prayojakavyāpārasya| na hi
tatrāsau prayojakarūpeṇopayujyate, kiṃ tarhi? kartṝūpeṇa, yathā
kāṣṭhasya pākāpekṣaṃ karaṇatvaṃ na tu jvalanāpekṣam, tadapekṣaṃ tu
kartṛtvameva? ucyate---ṇicaḥ prakṛtibhūtena dhātunaivābhidhīyate
so'rthastena phalābhāvātatra ṇijna bhaviṣyati| nanu pacatītyukte na
jñāyate----kiṃ svayameva pacati? utānyena pravartitaḥ? ityato'nyena
pravartitasyeyaṃ pravṛttiriti dyotanāya ṇij bhavatu? evaṃ tarhi
hetoriti vaktavyam, ṭhkaraṇe' ityeva, hetoḥ karaṇe vyāpāre
abhidheye ṇij bhavatītyarthaḥ| tathā tu na kṛtam| kā gatiridānīṃ
sūtrasya? abhidhānasvābhāvyamatra hetuḥ, svabhāvato hi ṇic pratyayaḥ
prayojakavyāpāramācaṣṭe| tena pākādyapekṣayā yo labdhahetuvyapadeśaḥ
sa hetutvenopalakṣito yasyāstītyevaṃ prayojakavyāpāra eva
matupocyate| atra dvau pakṣau sambhavataḥ----hetumatīti
prakṛtyarthanirddeśaḥ----hetumati yo dhāturvartata iti, pratyayārtho
vā---hetumati karaṇe'bhidheye ṇij bhavatīti|
nanu pacati pācayatīti ca vyaktamarthāntaraṃ gamyate, tatkathamasya
prakṛtyarthatvaṃ śaṅkyate? ucyate---iha hi kaḥ paceḥ pradhānārthaḥ? yāsau
taṇḍulānāṃ viklitiḥ, adhiśrayaṇādīnāṃ tu tādarthyātadavacchedena
pacyarthatā| yo hi pānārthamudakamāharati, vikrayārtha ca
kāṣṭhānyāharati, śītaṃ cāpanetumagniṃ samindhe nāsau
pacatītyucyate, tatkasya hetoḥ? vikliti prati tādarthyābhāvāt
tadavacchedābhāvācca| atastādarthyādevādhiśrayaṇādīnāṃ pacyarthatā,
tadvatprayojakavyāpāro'pi tādarthyādeva pacyādivācyo bhaviṣyati|
ṇicpratyayastu dyotakaḥ, tathā ca yo'pyekānte tūṣṇīmāsīno
bhaktabījabalīvarddaiḥ pratividhate, sa ucyate----pañcabhirhalaiḥ
kṛṣatīti| tadevaṃ pakṣadvayasambhave yadyādyaḥ pakṣa āśrīyate tato yathā
prakṛtyabhihite ṇij bhavati, evamuktapreṣitādiśabdābhirite'pi
syād--uktaḥ karoti, preṣatitaḥ karotīti,
hetumadviṣayatvātkarotyarthasya, pratyayārthapakṣe
tūktārthatvāṇṇijabhāvaḥ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; prayojakavyāpārasya dyotanāya
ṇijvidhīyate tasya svaśabdena dyotitatvād dyotyābhāvānna bhaviṣyati|
iha tarhi pācayatyodanaṃ devadato yajñadatena dvayoḥ
kartrorlenābhidhānaṃ prāpnaeti, dhātuvācyavyāpāre hi kartari lo
bhavati pacinā ca prayojakavyāpāro'pyabhidhīyate, pratyayastu dyotaka
iti dhātuvācyavyāpāratvasāmyāt kartrorapi sāmyamiti
dvayorapyabhidhānaṃ prāpnoti---pācayato devadatayajñadatāviti|
pratyayārthapakṣe tu prakṛtyarthopasarjanasya ṇyarthasya prādhānyātasyaiva
kartari lakāraḥ| iha ca gamito grāmaṃ devadato yajñadateneti
prayojakavyāpārasyāpi gamivācyatvādavyatirikto gatyartha iti kṛtvā
gatyarthānāṃ kartari ktaḥ prāpnoti, prayojyasya tu
karmatvātatraiveṣyate| uktaṃ hi ṭhṇyante kartuśca karmaṇaḥ' iti| iha ca
vyaticchedayante, vyatibhedayante---avyatirikto hisārtha iti kṛtvā
prayojakavyāpāravyatihāravivakṣāyāmapi ṭhna gatihiṃsārthebhyaḥ' iti
pratiṣedhaḥ prāpnoti|
tadevamādye pakṣe doṣadarśanād dvitīyaṃ
pakṣamāśrityāha---tasminnabhidheya iti| kiṃ cānvayavyatirekābhyāṃ
śabdārthāvasāyaḥ| na ca pacati paṭhati gacchatītyādāvantareṇa ṇicaṃ
kvacidapi prayojakavyāpāro'vasīyate, utpanne tu ṇici pratīyate,
atastadarthatvameva yuktam| pañcabhirhalaiḥ kṛṣatītyatra
tvanekārthatvāddhātūnāṃ kṛṣireva pratividhāne'pi vartata iti
yuktam, na punastaddarśanena sarvatra prakṛtyarthatvam| nanvatrāpi pakṣe
pācayatyodanaṃ devadato yajñadatenetyatra ṇyarthasya prādhānyātena
vyāpyamānasya prayojyasya karmasañjñā prāpnoti?
gatibuddhipratyavasānārtheti niyamānna bhivaṣyati| iha tarhi grāmaṃ
gamayati, grāmāya gamayatīti vyatirikto gatyartha iti kṛtvā
ṭhgatyarthakarmaṇi' iti dvitīyācaturthyau na prāpnutaḥ? naiṣa doṣaḥ;
grāmo'tra gamereva karma, grāmakarmakaṃ gamanaṃ kurviti praiṣārthaḥ| iha
tarhi edho dakasyopaskārayatīti vyatiriktaḥ karotyarthe iti ṭhkṛñaḥ
pratiyatne' iti ṣaṣṭhī na prāpnoti, suṭ tu
karotidhātumātrāśrayatvāṇṇijutpatāvapi tasya rūpasya
bhāvātsiddhyati? atrāpyedhodakakarmake karotyarthe prayujyate iti
ṣaṣṭhī bhaviṣyati| iha tarha ibhiṣāvayatīti vyatiriktaḥ sunotyartha
iti ṭhupasargātsunoti' iti ṣatvaṃ na prāpnoti? athātrāpyabhiṣavaṃ
kurvityupasargaviśiṣṭe prakṛtyarthe prayuktiriti siddhaṃ ṣatvam, yadā
tu ṇyatainaivopasargasya saṃbandhastadā ṣatvaṃ bhavati na veti cintyam|
iha tarhi bhedikā devadatasya yajñadatasya kāṣṭhānāmiti prayojye
kartari kṛdyogalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhī na prāpnoti, apradhānatvāt?
tṛtīyāvadbhaviṣyati, tadyathā---pācayatyodanaṃ devadato
yajñadateneti prayojye kartaryañadhāne'pi tṛtīyā bhavati
vyāptestathā ṣaṣṭha|lpi bhaviṣyati| atheha kathaṃ ṇij bhavati----bhikṣā
vāsayanti, kārīṣognidhyāpayatīti? kathaṃ ca na syāt?
acetanatvāt, cetanāvata etadbhāvati---preṣaṇam, adhyeṣaṇamiti?
naiṣa doṣaḥ; nāvaśyaṃ sa eva vāsaṃ prayājayati ya āha---uṣyatāmiti,
yo'pi tūṣṇīmāsīnastatsamarthamā carati so'pi vāsaṃ prayuṅkte,
bhikṣāśca pracurāśca vyañjanavatyaśca labhyamānā vāsaṃ prayuñjate| tathā
kārīṣo'gnirnirvāta ekānte suprajvalitaḥ
śītakṛtamadhyayanavirodhinamupadravamapanayan adhyayane'nukūlo
bhavati| tatra yathā--anumatirupadeśo'nugrahaḥ----ityeteṣu ṇij
bhavati tathā'trāpi bhaviṣyati| yadyapyanumatyādiṣu
prayojyavyāpāracoddeśena pravṛttiḥ, iha tu na tathā;
tathāpyanukūlācaraṇameva prayojakavyāpāratvenādhyāropyate| iha
kaścitkañcidāha---pṛcchatu māṃ bhavān, anuyuktāṃ māṃ bhavāniti,
tatra praṣṭā prayojyastasya prerakaḥ prayojaka iti tadvyāpāre ṇij
prāpnoti, ekaviṣayatvacca ṇico loḍādīnāṃ ca paryāyaprasaṅgaḥ?
naiṣa doṣaḥ, kartuḥ prayojako heturityuktam, prayojyaścātra na
kartā| na hyasau samprati pṛcchati tūṣṇīmāste tasya nirvyāpāratvāt
kārakatvameva nāsti kutastadviśeṣaḥ kartṛtvam? kartṛtvameva hi
tasya vidhīyate praśnakriyāyāṃ kartā bhaveti, yathā----rājā bhava
yudhyasveti rājatvameva vidhīyate tatra tadevaṃ prayojyo'karteti
prayojako'pi na hetuḥ, kimidānīṃ pūrvameva kartuḥ sataḥ
prayojako hetuḥ! yadyevam, vyarthā prayuktiḥ| athāpyuparatiśaṅkayā
kacitprayukterarthavatvaṃ tathāpi yatrāpravṛto balādinā pravartyate
tatra ṇij na prāpnoti? na brūmaḥ----pravṛttipravartana eva ṇijiti,
kintu pravartatito'pi prayojyo yatra pravartata eva, na tu nivartate
tatra ṇij bhavati| anuvartamānā prayuktiḥ prayojyapravṛtau hetuḥ, na
madhye vicchinnā| ataḥ prayojyapravṛ-tivelāyāmapi buddhau
viparivartamānā saiva pravṛttihetustasyāmeva ca daśāyāṃ ṇijvācyo
bhavati| tadevaṃ prayojyapravṛtyupahitaprayuktirṇijarthaḥ, kevalā tu
loḍartha iti vivekaḥ| uktaṃ ca----
dravyamātrasya tu praiṣe pṛcchayāderloḍ vidhīyate|
sakriyasya yadā praiṣestadā sa viṣayo ṇicaḥ|| iti||
kiśca---prayoktṛdharmaḥ prayuktirloḍarthaḥ aniyatakartṛkātu
prayuktirṇijarthaḥ| 
tatkarotītyupasaṃkhyānamiti| taditi karmaparametat, tena
dvitīyāntātpratyayaḥ karotītyatra prakṛtyarthamātraṃ vivakṣitaṃ na
pratyayārthaḥ, tena
ṇyantādbhāvakarmaṇorbhūtabhaviṣyatorddhitvabahutvayośca lo bhavati|
sūtraṃ karoti sūtrayatīti| iha vyākaraṇasya sūtraṃ karotīti vākye
dravyarūpaṃ sūtraṃ sūtraśabdenocyate, tatra vyapadeśivadbhāvena
vyatirekanibandhanā ṣaṣṭho, vṛtau tu vyākaraṇaṃ sūtrayatīti
pratyayārthabhūtakarotyarthābhidhāyī sūtraśabdaḥ sampadyate| uktaṃ
hiṭhparārthābhidhānaṃ vṛttiḥ' iti| tena satvabhāvo nivṛta iti
sūtravyākaraṇayorabhisambandho nivartate| asti ca vyākaraṇasya
karotinā sāmarthyamiti dvitīyā bhavati| yadi tu vyākaraṇaṃ sūtraṃ
karotīti vākye eva sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ tadā māṇavakaṃ
muṇḍayatītivad vyākaraṇaṃ sūtrayatītyayatnasiddham| ṭhsūtra
avamocane'ṭhmūtra prasravaṇe' iti curādau pāṭhādeva sūtrayatīti
sidhyati| anekārthatvāccārthāntare'pi bhaviṣyati| gaṇapāṭhasiddha eva
tvartha upasaṃkhyānenāpi pradarśitaḥ|
ākhyānāditi vākyaṃ vyācaṣṭe----ākhyānātkṛdantāditi| ākhyāyata
ityākhyānam, ṭhkṛtyalyuṭo bahulam' iti karmaṇi tluṭ|
yatkiñcidākhyāyate tatsarvaṃ
rājāgamanādikamapyākhyānamihābhipretam,na
kaṃsavadhanalocapākhyānādikameva saṃjñā bhūtam| kṛdantāditi
kṛdgrahaṇena gatikārakapūrvasyāpi grahaṇamiti
kaṃsavadharājāgamanasūryodgamanāderari kṛdantatvam|
prakṛtipratyāpatiriti| kṛto yā prakṛtiḥ sā vikāraparityāgena
svenaiva rūpeṇāvatiṣṭhata ityarthaḥ| prakṛtivacca kārakamiti| yatatra
kṛdante saṃnihitaṃ kārakaṃ tatprakṛtivadbhavati| kṛtprakṛteḥ śuddhe
ṇici yāddaśaṃ bhavati tāddaśamasyāpi ṇyantasya bhavatītyarthaḥ| kaṃsaṃ
ghātayatīti hanteḥ ṭhhanaśca vadhaḥ' ityap pratyayo vadhādeśaśca|
hananamuvadhaḥ , kaṃsasya vadha iti karmaṇi ṣaṣṭha|la samāsaḥ, tato ṇic,
kṛto luk, prakṛteḥ pratyāpatirvadhādeśaparityāgena
hantirūpeṇāvasthānam| yadyapyatra
sanniyogaśiṣṭānāmanyatarābhāvādubhayorapyabhāva ityeva
vadhādeśanivṛttiḥ siddhyati; tathāpi puṣyeṇa yogaṃ jānāti,
puṣyeṇa yojayatītyatra kutvasyāsanniyoga śiṣṭatvātannivṛttirna
siddhyatīti prakṛtipratyāpatavicanam| atha kathaṃ kaṃsamaghātayat,
rājānamajīgamat, yāvatā kaṃsavadharājāgamanaśabdābhyāṃ ṇici
vihite'ṅgasaṃjñā nāmadhātutvaṃ ca tayoreva syātām,
tataścāḍdvirvacane api tayoreva syātām? naiṣa doṣaḥ;
ṭhprakṛtivacca kārakam'ityuktam| kṛtprakṛteśca śuddhe ṇici vihite
kaṃsādikārakaṃ kīddaśaṃ bhavati? dhātāvanantarbhūtaṃ dvitīyādyantam,
tenātrāpi tāddaśenaiva rūpeṇa bhavitavyam| tena
rājānamāgamayatītyatra nalopābhāvo'pyupapanno bhavati| evamapi
kaṃsaṃ ghātayatītyatra ṭhho hanterñṇinneṣu' iti kutvam, ṭhhanasto
ciṇṇaloḥ' iti tatvaṃ ca na prāpnoti, kiṃ kāraṇam? dhātoḥ
svarūpagrahaṇe tatpratyaye kārya vijñāyate| evaṃ tarhi prakṛtivacca
kārakamiti cakārobhinnakramaḥ kārakamityasyānantaraṃ draṣṭavyaḥ,
kāryaśabdaścādhyāhāryaḥ| etaduktaṃ bhavati----kṛtprakṛtirhantyādiḥ,
tasyāḥ śuddhe ṇici yāddaśaṃ rūpaṃ bhavati tathā'syāpi ṇyantasya bhavati,
kāryaṃ ca tadvadeva bhavatīti | etenāḍdvirvacane api vyākhyāte|
balibandhamiti| bandhanamubandhaḥ, pūrvavatkarmaṇi ṣaṣṭhayāḥ samāsaḥ|
śeṣaṃ pūrvavat| rājāgamanamiti| atra kartari ṣaṣṭhayāḥ samāsaḥ|
rājānamāgamayatīti| atra kṛtprakṛtau rājā kartā, tasya gameḥ śuddhe
ṇici ṭhgatibuddhi'ityādinā karmasaṃjñā
bhavatītyasminnapyaupasaṃkhyānike ṇici tathaiva karmasaṃjñā bhavati| iha
tu devadata pākamācaṣṭe iti ṇici vihite devadatena pācayatīti
bhavati| na hi devadatasya śuddhe ṇici karmasaṃjñā'sti;
gatyarthādīnāmeveti niyamāt| iha tu mṛgaramaṇamācaṣṭe mṛgān
ramayatīti yadā pratipādyasya darśanārthamākhyānaṃ tadā ṇijiṣyate,
nānyadā| tatra yadā'raṇyastho ramamaṇānmṛgānpratipādyamācaṣṭe----eta
sminnavakāśe evaṃ mṛgā ramanta iti, tadā tasya pratipādyadarśanārthā
pravṛttiriti ṇij bhavati| yadā tu grāme mṛgaramaṇamācaṣṭe tadā tatra
mṛgāṇāmasambhavānna taddarśanārthā pravṛttiriti mṛgaramaṇamācaṣṭa iti
vākyakeva bhavati| etacca mṛgaramaṇādiviṣayameva, rājāgamanādau
tvanyadāpi bhavati|
āṅlepa iti| atrākhyānāditi na sa sambaddhyate, maryādāyāṃ ya
ākārastasya lopo bhavati| kṛllugityādi pūrvavat| ārātrivivāsa
iti| vivasanamuvivāsaḥ, atikramaṇam, rātrervivāso rātrivivāsaḥ,
kartari ṣaṣṭhayāḥ samāsaḥ, tataḥ ṭhāṅ maryādābhividhyoḥ'
ityavyayībhāvaḥ| yāvadrātreratikramaṇaṃ tāvatkathāḥ kathayatītyarthaḥ|
vaserakarmakatvād ṭhgatibuddhi' ityādinā rātreḥ karmasaṃjñā
hetumaṇṇici bhavati, tadvadasminnapi ṇici bhavati---rātri
vivāsayatīti|
citrīkaraṇe prāpīti| tadityeva| citrīkaraṇamuāścaryakaraṇam|
prāpiuprāpnotyarthe citrīkaraṇe gamyamāne tatprāpnotītyasminnarthe
ṇic bhavati, kṛllugityādi pūrvavat| sambhāvayate iti ṭhbhū
prāptāvātmanepadī', ujjayityā māhiṣmatī vidūre deśa iti tāvato
deśasya prāgudayādatikramaṇamāścaryam| sūryamudgamayatīti|
ṭhprakṛtivacca kārakam' iti sūryaśabdasya pṛthakkaraṇam|
saṃgrāmayatereva sopasargāditi nyāyāducchabdasyāpi pṛthakkaraṇam|
atrāpi sūryasya hetumaṇṇici karmatvādasminnapi ṇici karmatvam|
nakṣatrayoge jñīti| tadityeva| jñi jānātyarthenakṣatrayoge yatkṛdantaṃ
vartate tasmātajjānātītyasminnarthe ṇij bhavati, kṛllugityādi
pūrvavat| puṣyayogamiti| puṣyeṇa candramaso yogaḥ puṣyayogaḥ,
puṣyeṇeti kartari tṛtīyā, ṭhubhayaprāptau karmaṇi' iti niyamāt
ṣaṣṭhī na bhavati| candramasa iti| niyamena gamyamānatvādubhayaprāptiḥ,
puṣyo hi candramasaṃ yunanaktiusambadhnāti, tatra
yujergatyādiṣvanantarbhāvādaṇau kartuḥ puṣyasya suddhe ṇici
kartṛtvamevetyasminnapi ṇici kartṛtvātṛtīyā bhavati| puṣyeṇa
yojayatīti| lakārastu pradhāna eva kartari bavati, yathā śuddhe ṇici|
tatarhīdaṃ bahu vaktavyam? vaktavyam, iha tāvatsūryamudgamayatīti
yo yasya pravarttyaḥ sa tasyābhiprāyaṃ nirvartayati|
gantuścāyamabhiprāyaḥ---māhiṣmatyāṃ sūryodgamanaṃ sambhāvayeyamiti,
taṃ ca sūryo nirvartayati, enadeva pravartyasya pravartyatvaṃ yaduta
pravartayiturabhiprāyasampādanam| na hi kaścitparo'nugṛhītavya iti
pravartante sarva ime svabhūtyartham| ye tāvadete gurūn śuśrūṣante,
te'pīha---prīto gururadhyāpayiṣyati paratra cābhyudeṣyābha iti
pravartante| dāsāścāpi---bhaktaṃ ca lapsyāmahe, paribhāṣāśca na no
bhaviṣyantīti pravarddhante| ṭhyaḥ saninda upālambhastatra
syātparibhāṣaṇam'| śilpino'pi---mitrāṇi ca no bhaviṣyanti
vetanaṃ ca lapsyāmaha iti pravartante| yadyapyatra sarvatra tataduddeśena
pravṛttiḥ, sūrye tu naḥ tathāpyabhiprāyasaṃpatimātreṇa
prayojyaprayojakabhāvādhyāropeṇa ṇij bhaviṣyati| iha ca kaṃsaṃ
ghātayatīti----ye tāvadete kaṃsadhātānukāriṇāṃ naṭānāṃ
vyākhyānopādhyāyāste kaṃsānukāriṇaṃ naṭṃa sāmājikaiḥ
kaṃsabuddhya gṛhītaṃ tāddaśenaiva vāsudevena ghātayanti, ye'pi
citraṃ vyācakṣate---ayaṃ mathurāprāsādaḥ, ayaṃ kaṃsaḥ ayaṃ
bhagavānvāsudevaḥ praviṣṭaḥ, etāḥ kasaṃkarṣiṇyo rajjavaḥ, ete
udgūrṇā nipātitāśca prahārāḥ, ayaṃ hataḥ kaṃsaḥ ayamākṛṣṭa iti,
te'pi citragataṃ kaṃsaṃ tāddaśenaiva vāsudevena ghātayanti, citre'pi
hi tadbuddhireva paśyatām| etena citralekhalā vyākhyātāḥ| ye'pi
granthaṃ vācayantaḥ kaṃsavadhamācakṣate kāthikā nāma, te'pyutpattiprabhṛtyā
vināśātkaṃsādīn varṇayanti, te'pi varṇyamānāḥ śrotṛṇāṃ
buddhisthāḥ pratyakṣavadbhavanti| citamapi teṣāṃ tadātmakamiva bhavati,
ata eva vyāśritāśca bhavanti|nānāpakṣasamāśrayaḥuvyāśrayaḥ|
kecitkaṃsabhaktāḥ, kecidvāsudevaktāḥ| varṇānyatvaṃ khalvapi
puṣyanti---kecidraktamukhāḥ kecitkālamukhāḥ| traikālyamapi loke
lakṣyate, kathāyāṃ vācyamānāyāṃ hi vaktāro bhavanti---gaccha hanyate
kaṃsaḥ, gaccha ghāniṣyate kaṃsaḥ, kiṃ gatena---hataḥ kaṃsaḥ! iti| tadevaṃ
kāthako'pi buddhisthena vāsudevena ghātayati, śrotāpi||
śabdopahitarūpāÄśca buddherviṣayatāṃ gatān| 
pratyakṣamiva kaṃsādīn sādhanatvena manyate||
evaṃ rājānamāgamayatītyādāvapi yathāsambhavaṃ draṣṭavyam||
kaṇḍvādibhyo yak|| 3|1|27 ||
kaṇḍavādibhyo yak|| yadīme kaṇḍvādayo dhātava eva syustato
vāgrahaṇamanuvartate vā? na vā? anuvṛtau yagabhāvapakṣe laḍādiṣu
satsu kaṇḍavatītyādyaniṣṭṃa prasajyet, kaṇḍūarityādi ca na syāt;
dhāto- subabhāvāt| kvibantātsupsambhave'pi kaṇḍūariti na
vedanāmātraṃ gamyate; kartari kvipo vidhānāt?
saṃpadāditvādbhāve kvibbhaviṣyati| evamipa kaṇḍvau
kaṇḍvaḥ, ṭhaciśnudhātu' ityuvaṅ prāpnoti, kaṇḍvā, kaṇḍve
ṭhnoṅdhātvoḥ' iti vibhakterudātaniṣedhaḥ syāt,
mantuvalgurityatra ca tuk prasaṅgaḥ? atha nānuvartate, kaṇḍūariti na
sidhyati, yagantātsampadāditvādbhāve kvipyallopayalopayoḥ
kṛtayorbhaviṣyati? na caivamallopasya sthānivatvāduvaṅ ṭhkvau
luptaṃ na sthānivat' iti vacanāt| nanu ca kvau vidhi prati sa
pratiṣedhaḥ, anyathā lavamācakṣāṇo laurityatra kvau luptasya ṇeḥ
sthānivatvābhāve'pi sthānivatvābhāve'pi ṇau kṛtasya ṭilopasya
sthānivatvādūṭha na syāt, ato'tra sthānivatve satyuvaṅ syādeva?
cchastu ṭhcchavoḥ śūṅ' ityūṭha kariṣyate| na coṭha|lpi kartavye
sthānivatvam; tasyakvau vidhitvād ādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvatvācca, ata
evoṭhi kṛte punaruvaṅe'prasaṅgaḥ| evamapi kaṇḍvau, kaṇḍvaḥ,
kaṇḍve---dhātuvidhiḥ prāpnoti, manturvalguriti ca na
siddhyati, yaki dīrghe kṛte mantūrvalgūriti syāt| atha
prātipadikānyeva? tatrāpi vāgrahaṇānanuvṛtau sa eva doṣo yo
dhātupakṣe| anuvartatāṃ tarhi vāgrahaṇam, santu ca prātipadikānyeva,
tatrāpyayamarthaḥ-----kakāro nānubandhavyo bhavati
anārddhadhātukatvādeva guṇo na bhaviṣyati? naivaṃ śakyam; iha hi
sukhyati, duḥkhyati, magadhyatītyato lopo na syād;
anārdhadhātukatvādeva| na ca vyañjanānta eva śakyaḥ paṭhitum,
yagabhāvapakṣe'pi tathā prayogaprasaṅgadata ubhaye kaṇḍvādaya
ityāha----dvividhāḥ kaṇḍvādaya iti| dhātubhya eva pratyayo vidhīyata
iti| nityamiti bhāvaḥ| tena pakṣe kaṇḍavatītyādi na bhavati| na tu
prātipadikebhya iti| tena kaṇḍvau, kaṇḍvaḥ,
manturityādiprayogasiddhiḥ| na cāsminnapi pakṣe
yagantātsampadādikvibvidhīyate tadā pūrvoktadoṣānuṣaṅgaḥ, kiṃ
kāraṇam? ddaśigrahaṇādetebhyaḥ kvib syād, na caitebhya idānīṃ
kvib ddaśyate| pūrvatra tu pakṣe kaṇḍūarityādisiddhyarthameva kvib
draṣṭavyaḥ|
kathaṃ punarjñāyate---ubhaye kaṇḍvādaya iti? taccalokena
darśayati----ghātuprakaraṇāditi| anuvṛtena dhātugrahaṇena
viśeṣaṇātkakārāsañjanācca dhātutvameṣābhimatamiti vijñāyata
ityarthaḥ| yatastu khalvayamācāryaḥ kvaciddīrghamuccārayati---kaṇḍūañ
hṛṇīñ mahīṅiti, tato manye---dhāturvibhāṣita iti| dhātutvameṣāṃ
vibhāṣitamiti manya ityarthaḥ|
atha kaṇḍvādīnārthanirdeśaḥ| kaṇḍūañ gātravikarṣaṇe| mantu
aparādhe| hṛṇīṅ roṣe| valgu pūjāmādhuryayoḥ| asmanas upatāpe|
mahīṅ vṛddhipūjanayoḥ| leṭa
 loṭ dhaurtye pūrvabhāve svapne| irasa iraj irañ īrṣyāyām|
dravas paricaraṇe| medhā āśugrahaṇe| kuṣubha kṣepe| magadha
pariveṣṭane| tantas pampas duḥkhe| sukha duḥ kha tatkriyāyām|
sapara pūjāyām| arara ārākarmaṇi| bhiṣaj cikitsāyām|
bhiṣṇajupasevāyām| iṣudha śaradhāraṇe| caraṇa bhuraṇa gatau| curaṇa
caurye ca| turaṇa tvarāyām| bhuraṇa dhāraṇapoṣaṇayoḥ| gadgada
vākssvalane| elā kelā khelā vilāse| liṭ alpārthe kutsāyāṃ ca|
loṭ dīptau||
gupūdhūpavicchipaṇipanibhya āyaḥ|| 3|1|28 ||
gūpūdhūpavicchipaṇipanibhya āyaḥ|| vicchāyatīti| vicchirayaṃ
tudādau paṭha|lte, tatsāmarthyādāyapratyayāntādapi śavikaraṇo bhavati,
na tu śap, yathā---jugupsate ityātmanepadam, tena vicchāyantī
vicchāyatīti ṭhācchīnadyornum' iti numvikalpo bhavati| anye tu
sārvadhātuke'pyāyapratyayasyaiva tudādipāṭhasāmarthyena
vikalpamāhuḥ| stutyartheneti| bhaṭṭikāvye tu
vyavahārārthādapyāyaḥ---ṭhna capolebhe vaṇijāṃ paṇāyān' iti|
anubandhaḥ kevale'caritārtha iti| avayaveṣvacaritārtha liṅgaṃ
samudāyasya viśeṣakaṃ bhavati, yathā---gupādīnāmanudātatvamiti
bhāvaḥ| ye tu vyavahārārthādapyāyamicchanti teṣāmapi paṇiṣyate
pāṇayiṣyatītyādāvanubandhaḥ kevale caritārthaḥ||
ṛterīyaṅ|| 3|1|29 ||
ṛterīyaṅ|| sautra iti| asminneva sūtre uccarita ityarthaḥ| ghṛṇāyāṃ
vartata iti| nātra kṛpāyāṃ ghṛṇāśabdaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? jugupsāyāsa;
ṭhghṛṇā jugupsākṛpayoḥ' iti vacanāt| jugupsāunindā,
bībhatsetyarthaḥ| ṛtīyāśabdo bībhatsāparyāyo nighaṇṭuaṣu paṭhitaḥ|
atha kasmādīyaṇucyate na cchaṇeóvocyate, tasya īyādeśe kṛte ṛtīyata
iti siddham, paratvādiḍāgame kṛte satyapratyayāditvādīyādeśoca
na syāditi cet? na; antaṅgatvāt, āyannadiṣūpadeśivadvacanaṃ
svarasiddhyarthamiti vacanādantaraṅgatvam| jñāpanārtha tu,
etajjñāpayati---dhātupratyayānāmayannādayo na bhavantīti, tena
ṭhkaṇeṣṭhaḥ' ityatrekādeśo na bhavati| kvacitu vṛtāvevaṃ
paṭha|lte---ṭhṛteścchaṅ' ityeva siddhe īyaṅvacanaṃ
jñāpak---dhātuvihitānāmāyannādayo na bhavantīti| atra
brūmaḥ---ṭhdvivacanavibhajyopapade tarapcchasunau' ityeva siddhe
īyasunvacanaṃ jñāpakaṃ prātipadikapratyayānāmāyannādayo na bhavantīti|
ucyante cāyannādayaste vacanādubhayeṣāmapi syuḥ,
tasmāddateścchaṅtyāidi vṛtau na paṭhanīyamiti||
kamerṇiṅ|| 3|1|30 ||
kamerṇiṅ|| iha ṇiṅe ṇakāraḥ ṭhṇeraniṭi' iti viśeṣaṇe caritārtho
ṅkāro'pyātmanepadārtha ityubhayoścaritārthayoḥ prāpnoti,
jñāpakātsiddham, yadayam ṭhna kamyamicamām' iti kamermitsaṃjñāyāṃ
pratiśedhaṃ śāsti, taj jñāpayati---bhavatyatra vṛddhiriti, tasya hi
prayojanam---ṭhmitāṃ hrasvaḥ' iti hrasvo mā bhūditi yadi cātra vṛddhirna
syād hrasva evopadheti kṛtvā nitsaṃjñāpratiṣedho'narthakassyāt|
naitadasti jñāpakam, yadā ṇiṅntāddhetumaṇṇic kriyate tadā
ṇiṅntasya ṇici yā vṛddhistasyā hrasvo mā bhūdityevamarthametatsyāt,
na ca ṇijapekṣāyā api vṛddherṇiṅmeva ṅtimapekṣya pratiṣedhaḥ| kiṃ
kāraṇam? ṅtīiti nimitasaptamī| nanu ca na ṇiṅntasya ṇici
vṛddhyā bhavitavyam; ṇiṅa vyavahitatvāt, ṇilope kṛte
sthānivadbhāvādvyavadhānameva| yadā tarhi ṇiḍantācciṇṇamulau
savatastadā ṭhciṇṇamulodīrgho'nyatarasyām' ityeva vidhirmā
bhūdityevamartho mitsaṃjñāprātiṣedhaḥ syāt| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇam? tatra
ṭhdīrgho'nyatarasyām' ityucyate na prakṛto hrasva eva vikalpyeta, evaṃ
hi kamermitsaṃjñāpratiṣedho na rtavyo bhavati| katham? yadā ṇīṅ
vṛddhirnāsti tahā hrasva evopadheti satyapi hrasvavikalpe
naivāniṣṭaprasaṅgaḥ, aśami aśāmītyādi ca siddham? naivaṃ śakyam;
yadā śamiprabhṛtibhyo ṇijantebhyo dvitīyo ṇic kriyate tadā na
syāt| yaśca ṇamulparo ṇij dvitīyaḥ, na tasmin prathamena ṇicā
vyavahitatvāt| yasmiśca midaṅgaṃ prathame ṇici, nāsau
ciṇṇamulparaḥ, dvitīyena vyavahitatvāt| ṇilope'pi kṛte
sthānivadbhāvādvyavadhānameva| ṭhdīrgho'nyatarasyām' ityucyamāne
punaratrāpi bhavati, dīrghavidhiṃ prati sthānivadbhāvaniṣedhāt| tathā
śamiprabhṛtibhyo yaṅntebhyo ṇicyallopayalopayorallāpasya
sthānivadbhāvādasatyāṃ vṛddhau ciṇṇamuloḥ kṛtayoraśaṃśami,
asaṃśāmi, śaṃśamam, śaṃśāmamiti na syāt| dīrghaḥ
punarvikalpyamāno'trāpi bhavati; tadvidhau
sthānivadbhāvapratiṣedhāt| tathā ṭhheḍḥa anādare' ghaṭādiḥ, ṭheca
igghrasvādeśe', hiḍa|lti, tatra ciṇṇamuloḥ kṛtayorhrasve vikalpyamāne
ahiḍi, aheḍīti syāt; dīrghe tu punarahiḍi, ahīḍīti bhavati|
tasmāddīrgha eva vikalpanīyaḥ, tataśca mitsaṃjñāpratiṣedho'pi
tannivṛtaye vaktavyaḥ| tathā ṭhāyādaya ārddhadhātuke vā' iti ṇiṅbhāve
ṇici sati vṛddhau kṛtāyām ṭhmitāṃ hrasvaḥ' iti hrasvo mā
bhūdityevamartho'pi sitsaṃjñāpratiṣedho vaktavya evetyajñāpakametat|
evaṃ tarhyasthāne'yaṃ yatnaḥ kriyate, naivātra pratiṣedhaḥ prāpnoti, kiṃ
kāraṇam? iglakṣaṇayorguṇavṛddhyoḥ pratiṣedhaḥ na caiṣā iglaṅṇā
vṛddhirityalamati karkaśaprakriyātarkānusaraṇena||
āyādaya ārddhadhātuke vā|| 3|1|31 ||
āyādaya ārddhadhātuke vā|| ṭhārddhadhātuke' iti
parasaptamyāmāyādividhibhirekavākyatā syāt,
bhinnavākyatāyāmayamartho bhavati----gupādibhya ārddhadhātuke parato
vā''yapratyayo bhavati, evamutaratrāpi, tataścārddhadhātuke eva
vikalpenāyādayaḥ syuḥ, sārvadhātuke naiva syuḥ? naiṣa doṣaḥ,
pṛthāgārambhādyadi hyārddhadhātuka evāyādīnāmutpattiḥ syātato
gupādibhiḥ saṃyujyaiva nirdiśet---gupādibhya ārddhadhātuke veti,
evaṃ hi āyādaya iti na vaktavyaṃ bhavati| pṛthakataṃ nirdiśati, tena
manyāmahe---vyāpārabhedenaikavākyateti| tataścāyamartho
bhavati---gupādibhyo nityamāyādayo bhavantyārddhadhātuke veti|
evamapi gupāderyadārddhadhātukaṃ prāptaṃ tatra tato vihite
vikaraṇavikalpe nāyādayaḥ syu; tataśca strībhāvavivakṣāyaṃ
guperapratyayāntatvābhāvāt ktini kṛte yadāyapratyayo na bhavati
tadā guptiriti kāmamiṣṭṃa siddhyati| yadā tu bhavati
tadā'llopayalopayorgopātirityaniṣṭṃa prāpnoti, gopāyeti
ceṣṭṃa na siddhyati| bhinnavākyatāyāmāyādyantādyadārddhadhātukaṃ praptaṃ
tatra tato vihite āyādayo vā bhavantītyarthaḥ syāt| tatra
cāyādyāntādyadārddhadhātukamiti vadatā teṣāmutpattistāvadaṅgīkṛtaa|
na cotpannānāmutpattivikalpaḥ śakyate kartumiti lokanyāyena
nivṛttivikalpo bhavati| tataścāyapratyayāntāt
strībhāvavivakṣāyāmapratyayādityakāre kṛte nivṛtyabhāvapakṣe
gopāyeti kāmamiṣṭṃa siddhyati| nivṛttipakṣe tu gopetyaniṣṭṃa
prāpnoti, guptiriti ceṣṭṃa na siddhyati| liṭi ca
nivṛtyabhāvapakṣe gopāyāñcakāreti kāmamiṣṭṃa siddhyati,
nivṛttipakṣe tu yadi liṭi parato nivṛttistathāpi pratyayalakṣaṇena
kāspratyayādityāmā bhavitavyam, athāpyāmi kṛte nivṛttistathāpi
tasyaiva śravaṇaṃ prāpnotīti sarvathā gopāṃcakāretyaniṣṭṃa
prāpnotīti, jugopeti ceṣṭṃa na siddhyati| tasmād duṣṭa evāyaṃ
parasaptamīpakṣa iti matvāha---ārddhadhātuke viṣaya iti| ko'rthaḥ?
ityāha---ārddhadhātukavivakṣāyāmiti|
ārdhadhātukamihotpādayiṣyāmīti buddhau satyāmityarthaḥ|
viṣayasaptamīpakṣe'pi bhinnavākyatāyāmārddhadhātuke vidhitsite
āyādayo bhavantītyukte, kuto vidhitsite?
ityapekṣāyāmāyādyantasyāpi dhātutvātata iti gamyate tataśca
nivṛttipakṣa evāśrita iti sa eva doṣo yaṃ pūrvamavocāma|
tasmādekavākyatayotpativikalpa ityāha---nityapratyayaprasaṅge
tadutpattirārddhadhātukaviṣeye vikalpyata iti| kimevaṃ sati siddhaṃ
bhavatītyāha--tatreti||
sanādyantā dhātavaḥ|| 3|1|32 ||
sanādyantā dhātavaḥ|| sanādayo'nte yeṣāmiti| antaśabdaḥ samīpavacanaḥ,
vaiyadhikaraṇye'pi gamakatvādvahuvrīhiḥ| atha vā---vṛtāvarthamātraṃ
darśitam, sūtre tvavayavavācino'ntaśabdasya samānādhikaraṇasyaiva
bahuvrīhiḥ| sanādayo'ntāvayavā yeṣāṃ samudāyānāmityanena
tadguṇasaṃvijñāno bahuvrīhiriti darśayati| dhātusaṃjñā iti|
dhātuśabdo'tra svarūpapadārthaḥ, na bhūvādipadārthakaḥ; tāvatīnāṃ
saṃjñānāṃ vidhāne prayojanābhāvāt| ṭhsuptiṅntam'
ityatrāntagrahaṇajñāpitā saṃjñāvidhau pratyayagrahaṇe pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣā
na pravartata iti, tataścāsatyantagrahaṇe tadantavidhirna
syādityatrāntagrahaṇaṃ kṛtam| evaṃ sthite yadyapūrva evānena
tadantavidhiḥ kriyate, tato devadataścikīrṣatītyatra devadatādeḥ
samudāyasya saṃjñā prasajyeteti
matvāha----pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣaivetyādi| apūrvavidhau gauravam,
pratiprasave tu yatnasya lāghavaṃ bhavatīti bhāvaḥ| ṭhbhūvādayaḥ'
ityasyānantaraṃ sanādyāntāścetyucyamāne sanādīnāmiyatāparicchedo
na syāt| evaṃ tarhi ṭhsaṅntāśca' ityucyatām, saṅiti pratyāhāraḥ
sanaḥ saśabdārabhyā ṇiṅe ṅkārāt| evamapi sandehassyāt,
caṅadiṣvapi ṅkārasya bhāvāt| evaṃ tarhi ṭhsanādyantāḥ'
ityasyānantaram ṭhbhūvādayaśca' iti vaktavyam|
syādetat----evamucyamāne sanādyantaśabdavad bhūvādiśabdo'pi
prakṛtāpekṣaḥ syātataścānukrāntānāṃ gupādīnāmeva syāditi?
evamapi bhūvādigrahaṇamanarthakaṃ gupādayaśceti vaktavyam| nānarthakam;
bhuvo vādayo bhūvādaya ityevamarthameva syād| bhūvādipāṭha idānīṃ
kimarthaḥ syād ? antargaṇakāryārthaḥ, anubandhāsañjanārthaśca| yeṣāṃ
tarhi tadubhayaṃ na saṃbhavati bhūraṇiprabhṛtīnāṃ teṣāṃ pāṭhaḥ kimarthaḥ?
alamatinirbandhena||
syatāsī lṛluṭoḥ|| 3|1|33 ||
syatāsī lṛluṭoḥ|| iha yadyapi ṭhlṛ' ityanukaraṇamuccāritamekameva,
tathāpi tasya pratipādyabhūtamanukārthaṃ bhidyate---lṛṭ, lṛṅ iti| yatra ca
pratipādyānāṃ saṃkhyāṃsāmyaṃ tatra saṃkhyātānudeśaḥ, na
tūcvāritarūpasāmye; anyathā parasmaipadānāmityekaṃ ṇalādayastu
naveti vaiṣamyānta syāt| tathā ḍāraurasaḥ prathamasyetyatrāpi na
syāt| tadevam ṭhlṛ' ityasya dve pratipādye, luṭiti cāparamiti
trīṇi nimitāni, nimitinau tu dvāviti vaiṣamyātsaṃkhyātānudeśo
na prāpnotītyatrāha----lṝūpamutsṛṣṭānubandha sāmānyamekameveti|
nātra pratipādyaṃ bhidyate yatadubhayānugatamutsṛṣṭānubandham ṭhlṛ' iti
sāmānyarūpaṃ tadanukriyate| etacca lṛluṭoriti dvivacana
nirdeśādavasīyate, tatrayathānukaraṇe na bhedastathānukārye'pītyarthaḥ|
kariṣyatīti| ṭhṛddhanoḥ sye' itīṭ| śvaḥ karteti| ṭhśvaḥ'
ityasyopanyāsastṛjantaśaṅkānivṛtyarthaḥ| iditkaraṇamiti|
itsaṃjñakasyekārasya karaṇamityarthaḥ| anunāsikalopapratiṣedhārthamiti|
anyathā mantās ā iti sthite ṭilope kṛte nakāra
upadhetyātmanepade ṅiti parataḥ ṭhaniditām' iti nalopaḥ
prāpnoti, tasya ṭhaniditām' itīditvanibandhanaḥ pratiṣedho yathā
syādityarthaḥ| mantā, saṅganteti| ko'rthaḥ? mantetyetatpadaṃ
saṅgantaṃ bhaviṣyatītyarthaḥ, na tu saṅgantetyetadudāharaṇam;
anopadhatvāt| anusvāraparasavarṇayoḥ kṛtayorapi
tayorasiddhatvādanopadha eva| 
anye tvāhuḥ----yadyasiddhatvātsaṅgantetyetadanudāharaṇam,
mantetyetadapi udāharaṇaṃ na bhavati, atrāpi
ṭilopasyābhīyasyāsiddhatvād mantās ā iti sthite nakāra upadhā na
bhavatīti|
yadi matam----ā bhācchāstrīyamasiddhatvamanityam, ṭhśnasorallopaḥ'
iti taparakaraṇāt? taddhyāstāmāsannityādau mā bhūdityevamartham,
tatrāṭo'siddhatvādeva lopo na bhaviṣyati, kiṃ tannivṛtyarthena
taparatvena! tajjñāpayati----asiddhatvamanityamiti| tena
debhaturdeabhurityatra ṭhśranthigranthidambhisvañjinām' iti liṭaḥ
kitvānnalope tasyāsiddhatvābhāvādetvābhyāsalopau bhavataḥ, tadatra
ṭilopasyāsiddhatvānmanta ā iti sthite upadhaiva nakāra
ityudāharaṇamiti| yadyevam, pūrvatrāsiddhīyamasiddhatvamapyanityam ṭhna
mu ne' ityatra neti yogavibhāgāt, tathā caikādeśasvaro'ntaraṅgaḥ
siddho bhavati, sijlopa ekādeśe siddho bhavati, niṣṭhādeśaḥ
ṣatvādiṣu siddho bhavati, dvirvacanaviṣaye ca pūrvatrāsiddhīyaṃ na
bhavati, tataścānusvāraparasavarṇayoḥ siddhatvāt
saṅgantetyetadapyudāharaṇameveti|
anye tu saṃhanteti paṭhanti, hanteḥ ṭhbhāvakarmaṇoḥ'
ityātmanepadam, tatra sampūrvasya pāṭhe prayojanaṃ mṛgyam| evaṃ
tāvajjayādityenāsiddhatvamanityamāśritya
ṭhtāseriditkaraṇamanunāsikalopapratiṣedhārtham' ityuktam|
vāmanastu ṭilopasya siddhatvādeva nalopo na bhaviṣyatīti
manyamānaḥ ṭhiditoo' ityatra vakṣyati---ṭhtāsi sicoriditkārya
nāstītyuccāraṇārtho niranunāsika ikāraḥ paṭha|lte' iti| yadi tu
tāserikāro'nubandhaḥ syātato numvidhau dhātostāsermā
bhūdityevamarthaṃ syāt, tataścadhātūpadeśāvasthāyāmeva num
bhavatītyayamartho na sādhitaḥ syāditi tasyābhiprāyaḥ| jayādityastu
ṭhnumvidhāvupadeśivadvacanaṃ pratyayasidvyartham' iti vacanameva
śaraṇamaśiśrayat|
iha vikaraṇāḥ kecana lakāropādānena vidhīyante, yathā-----syādayaḥ,
te kiṃ lāvasthāyāmeva bhavanti ? utāho ādeśeṣu kṛteṣu? yadi
lāvasthāyāmeva, tatastāsyanudātedityatra yadvakṣyate----tāseḥ parasya
lasārvadhātukasyānudātavacanaṃ jñāpakam, satiśiṣṭo'pi
vikaraṇasvaro lasārvadhātukasvaraṃ na bādhata ityasyārthasyeti,
tannopapadyate; lāvasthāyāmeva tāsau kṛte tasya ca pratyayādyaudātatve
paścāllādeśeṣu kriyamāṇeṣu teṣāmeva svaraḥ satiśiṣṭo bhavati,
tataścānudātavacanamaprāptavidhireva syāt| tatra ko doṣaḥ? cinutaḥ
cinvantiḥ, cinvanti; krīṇītaḥ, krīṇanti, satiśiṣṭo vikaraṇasvara eva
prāpnoti, dvitīye tu pakṣe pūrva tibādayaḥ paścātāsiriti tasyaiva
svaraḥ satiśiṣṭaḥ, tataśca nighātasvareṇaiva sārvadhātukānudātatve
siddhe tāsigrahaṇaṃ kriyamāṇamuktā rthasya jñāpakaṃ sampadyate| astu tarhi
tathā| yadyevam, dhātumātrātsārvadhātukamātre bhāvakarmaṇoryak
kartari tu śabvidhīyata iti yakśapāvutsargau teṣvevārtheṣu
dhātumātrātsārvadhātukaviśeṣe syādaya iti te'pavādāḥ? tathā
divāderdhātuviśeṣātkartari śyanādayaḥ śapo'pavādāḥ, tatra
deviṣyati taniṣyatītyādāvubhayaprasaṅge'pavādavipratiṣedhāt
śyanādayaḥ syuḥ? pakṣāntare tvantaraṅgāḥ syādaya eva siddhyanti?
naiṣa doṣaḥ; ṭhdivādibhyaḥ śyan' ityādiṣu
syādayo'nuvartiṣyante---divādibhyaḥ śyan bhavati, lṛluṭostu
syatāsī bhavato divādibhya iti| evaṃ sarvatra| etenaitadapi nirastaṃ
yatkhalvidamāśaṃkyate----pareṇa lāvasthāyāṃ vidhīyamānāḥ syādayaḥ
kimiti sārvadhātukotpatiṃ pratīkṣanta iti, katham?
utaratrānuvṛtereva, sārvadhātuke yagbhavati, bhāvakarmaṇorlṛ
luṭostu syatāsī bhavataḥ sārvadhātuke| evaṃ sijādiṣvapi
draṣṭavyam| tadevamādeśeṣu kṛteṣu syādaya iti sthitam||
sibbahulaṃ leṭi|| 3|1|34 ||
sibbahulaṃ leṭi|| joṣiṣanmandiṣaditi| ṭhjuṣī prītisevanayoḥ'
ṭhmadi stutimodasvapnagatiṣu', anudātau, vyatyayena parasmaipadam,
sica iṭ ṭhleṭo'ḍāṭau' iti tipo'ṭ, ṭhitaśca lopaḥ
parasmaipadeṣu' itīkāralopaḥ, tatra ca veti vartate| tāriṣaditi|
ṭhtṛ plavanataraṇayoḥ',ṭhsibbahulaṃ cchandasi ṇidvaktavyaḥ' iti
vacanādvṛddhiḥ, amīṣāṃ bhavitā bhāviṣaditi yathā| chāndaso vā dīrghaḥ|
patātīti| ṭhśala hula patlṛ gatau', leṭo'ḍāṭau' ityāṭ
śapāsahaikādeśaḥ| cyāvayātīti| ṭhcyuṅ pruh pluṅ gatau' ṇyantaḥ|
ihāvayāsiṣīṣṭhā iti yāteravapūrvālliṅ bihulavacanāstip, thāsaḥ
sīyuṭ, iṭ| ṭhekāca upadeśe'nudātāt' iti tu pratiṣedho na
bhavati; sipā vyavadhānāt||
kāspratyayādāmamantre liṭi|| 3|1|35 ||
kāspratyayādāmamantre liṭi|| ām pratyayo bhavatīti| halantapakṣe
etaduktam, adantapakṣe tvāmaḥ pratyayo bhavatīti vaktavyam| amantraviṣaya
iti| mantraviṣayaścetprayogo na bhavatītyarthaḥ| ṛgyajuḥ sāmalakṣaṇo
mantram, tatraivābhiyuktairmantraśabdasya prayogāt| ātharvaṇā api mantrā
ṛgyajuṣa evāntarbhavanti| tāntrikeṣu mantraśabdaprayogo
mantravadupacārāt| cchandasīti noktam, brāhmaṇe'pi yathā syāt---atha
ha śunaḥ śepa īkṣāṃcakre te ha tadantarvedyāsāñcakrire avijñātāni ca
darśayāñcakāra| kāsāñcakra iti| āmantasya padatvamṭh āmaḥ'
ityatropapāditam| nonāveti| nauteryaṅlugantātpratyayalakṣaṇena
prāpta ām na bhavati| kārayanekāca iti vaktavyamiti| yathānyāse hi
kaśabdādaśabdādvāgādibhyaścācārakvibantebhya ekājbhyo'pi
pratyayāntatvādāmprasaṅga,
culumpādibhyaścāpratyayāntatvādaprasaṅgaḥ;
ato'vyāptyativyāptipahihārāya pratyayagrahaṇamapanīyānekājgrahaṇaṃ
kartavyamityarthaḥ| tatra kaśabdasya ṇali ṭhaco ñṇiti' iti vṛddhau ṭhāta
au ṇalaḥ' cakau, anyatra ṭhato lopaḥ' cakatuḥ, cakuḥ; aśabdasya ṇali
rūpam---au iti, anyatra ṭhata ādeḥ' iti dīrdhatve ṭhāto lopa iṭi
ca'atuḥ, uḥ| cakāsāṃcakāreti| ṭhcakāsṛdīptau'| daridrāñcakāreti|
ṭhāta au ṇalaḥ' ityatra okāre vidhātavye aukāravidhānaṃ
daridrāterārddhadhātukalopa utyākāralope'pyaukārasya śravaṇārtham,
tena dadaridrāvityapi bhavatītyāhuḥ| culumpāñcakāreti!
culumpatirvārtikakāravacanātsādhuḥ|
āmo makārasya ṭhhalantyam' itītsaṃjñā kasmānna bhavatītyāha---āmo
mitvamiti| kārayāścakāretyādau prayoge ya āmśabdastasyāmitvaṃ
makāra itsaṃjñako yasya nāsti so'mit tasya bhāvaḥ amitvam| kuta
ityāha? adantatvāditi| ad ante samīpe yasya so'dantaḥ, sūtre
vidhānavelāyāṃ samīpe'kāravatvādityarthaḥ| tenaitanna
codanīyam---ām cetkathamadantaḥ, athādantaḥ kathamāmiti| sūtre
vidhīyamānasyaiva vā pratyayasyopalakṣaṇamāma iti| aguṇatvaṃ
videstatheti| vidāñcakāretyatra viderāmi guṇābhāvo'pi tathā,
adantatvādevetyarthaḥ| adantatvādityetatprasaṅgena cedamihoktam,
ṭhuṣavidajāgṛbhyo'nyatarasyām' ityatra tu vaktavyam| tatra hi
viderakārāntatvamāmpratyayasanniyogena nipātyate, tatrāto lopasya
sthānivatvād guṇo na bhavati| na punaḥ ṭhvida jñāne' ityakāro
vivakṣita ityucyate; vetītyādau śravaṇaprasaṅgāt| abhyupetyāpi
makārāntatvamitsaṃjñābhāvamāha---āskāsorāmvidhānācceti|
āmo'mitvamityanuṣaṅgaḥ, sati hi mitve āskāsorām
bhavannapyacāmantyātparaḥ syāt, tathā ca savarṇadīrghatve
satyakiñcitkaraḥ syāt| ataḥ ṭhdayāyāsaśca' kāspratyayāditi
āskāsorāmvidhānādapyāma'mitvamavasīyate tyirthaḥ|
āscakāsorvidhānācca ityanye paṭhanti, tadayuktam; na hi sūtre cakāsa
āmvidhānamasti| yadapi kāsyanekājgrahaṇaṃ tadapi culumpādau
sāvakāśam| nanvadantatvapakṣe āmāmantra iti nirdeśyaṃ
syātatrāha---pararūpaṃ katantavaditi| yathā ṭhsarvatra
lohītādikatantebhyaḥ' ityatra pararūpam, evamatrāpi
nipātanātpararūpamityuktaṃ bhavati||
ijādeśca gurumato'nṛcchaḥ|| 3|1|36 ||
ijādeśca gurumato'nṛcchaḥ|| ṛcchativarjita iti| ṛcchatinā tyaktaḥ
tadrūparahita ityarthaḥ| ṛcchateranya iti yāvat| iyaja, uvapeti|
yajivapyorutame ṇali ṭhṇalutamo dhā' iti ṇitvābhāvapakṣe
vṛddhyabhāvād gurūpotamatvābhāvaḥ| atha thali
pratyudāharaṇam---iyajitha, iyaṣṭha; uvapitha, uvaptheti| nanvatra
sannipāta paribhāṣayaiva na bhaviṣyati, liṭsannipātajaṃ hi abhyāsamya
saṃprasāraṇaṃ tadvighātakasyāmo nimitaṃ na bhavati, āmi hi sati
lerlukā bhavitavyamiti liṭsannipātamasau vihanyāt? idaṃ tarhi
pratyudāharaṇam---iyeṣeti, na hyatra liṭsannipātajamijāditvam| atha
kriyamāṇe'pi gurumadgrahaṇe kasmādevātra na bhavati, yāvatā guṇe
kṛte gurumāneṣa bhavati? evamīṣaturityādāvapi savarṇadīrdhatve
kṛte gurumāneva bhavati? satyam; sati garumadgrahaṇe
sannipātaparibhāṣayaivātrāpyām na bhavati, liḍānantaryahetukatvād
gurumatāyāḥ| atha vā ṭhgurunataḥ' iti nityayoge matup, nityaṃ yasya
guruṇābhisambandhaḥ| yadyevam, ṭhuchī vivāse' vyucchāñcakāra, ṭhuccha uñche'
ucchāñcakāra āgamanimitā cāsya gurumatā, tasmādām na prāpnoti?
jñāpakātsiddham, yadayamanṛccha ityāha,
tajjñāpayati---bhavatyevañjātīyake āmiti| sa tarhi
jñāpakārthamṛcchatipratiṣedho vaktavyo bhavati| nanu cacāmnivṛtyartha
evāsau kartavyaḥ, nārtha āmnivṛtyarthena? jñāpakātsiddham, yadayam
ṭhṛcchatyṛtām' iti liṭi parato guṇaṃ śāsti,
tajjñāpayati---nāsmādām bhavatīti| na ca
tatrarchatītyarteśtipānirddeśaḥ; ṭhṛcchati ṛ ṛtām' ityarterapi
svarūpeṇaiva praśleṣāt| praśleṣe bahuvacanamatra pramāṇam| arteśca
liṭi guṇavi dhāne prayojanaṃ tatreva vakṣyāmaḥ|
tasmāddacchaterguṇavidhānaṃ jñāpakameva| tasmādāmna bhavatīti sa
eṣo'nṛccha iti pratiṣedho jñāpakārtha eva kartavyaḥ syāt| evaṃ hi
liṭīti vihitaviśeṣaṇam----ijādergurumato yo
liḍvihitastatreti| tena liḍnimitā yasya gurumatā tasmācca na
bhaviṣyati, āgamanimitā yasya gurumatā tasmācca bhaviṣyati| ṭhanṛccha'
iti pratiṣedhastu kriyatām, mā vā kāri| kvacitu gurumata iti
kim, uboṣeti paṭha|lte, tatra uvoṣetyudāharaṇamayuktam,
ṭhuṣavidajāgṛbyaḥ' iti vikalpavidhānamanavakāśaṃ syāt|
prorṇunāveti|ṭhajāderddhitīyasya' ṭhna ndrāḥ saṃyogādayaḥ' iti
nuśabdasya dvirvacanaṃ kāryāntarasiddhyartham,
avaśyamūrṇoterṇuvadbhāvavo vācyaḥ, tenaivāmo'pi pratiṣedhaḥ siddha
ityāha---atha vā vācya iti| tatra yaṅ bhāvāitideśaḥ,
āmiṭostvabhāvātidaśaḥ; nautestayorabhāvāt|
uḍupagrahaḥūuiṭpratiṣedhaḥ, ṭhvibhāṣā guṇe' iti pañcamī| phalasya cātra
hetutvaṃ yathā---adhyayanena vasatīti| ekāca iti vartamāne rṭhśyukaḥ
kiti' iti ya iṭpratiṣedhaḥ tato'pi hetorṇuvadbhāvo vācya
ityarthaḥ| udāharaṇāni---prorṇonūyate, prorṇunāva, prorṇutaḥ,
prorṇutavāniti||
dayāyāsaśca|| 3|1|37 ||
dayāyāsaśca|| dayāyāsaḥ sarva'pyanudātetaḥ| palāyāñcakre iti|
ṭhupasargasyā yatau' ityupasargasya latvam||
uṣavidajāgṛbhyo'nyatarasyām|| 3|1|38 ||
uṣavidajāgṛbhyo'nyatarasyām|| vida jñāne iti|
satāvicāraṇārthayostvātmanepadinorlābhārthasya cobhayapadino
grahaṇaṃ na bhavati, parasmaipadibhyāmuṣijāgṛbhyāṃ jāgartinā''dādikena
sāhacaryāditi bhāvaḥ| vivedeti|
āmpratyayasanniyogenādantatvapratijñānādatra guṇo bhavatyeva| ata
evāha---videradantatvapratijñānādāmi guṇo na bhavatīti||
bhīhrībhṛhuvāṃ śluvacca|| 3|1|39 ||
bhīhrībhṛhuvāṃ śluvacca|| śluvatkāryāpekṣayā sūtre ṣaṣṭhī,
sanniyogariṣṭatvāccām, pratyayo'pi tebhya eva vijñāyate| dvitvetve
iti| ṭhślau' iti dvirvacanam, ṭhbhṛñāmit' itītvam, tatra ṭhślau'
iti vartate| ṭhna lumatāṅgasya' iti guṇapratiṣedhastu na bhavati, kiṃ
kāraṇam? ṭhpratyayalope pratyayalakṣaṇam' ityasyāḥ prāpterayaṃ
pratiṣedhaḥ| śrūyamāṇatvādāmaḥ'||
kṛñcānuprayujyate liṭi|| 3|1|40 ||
kṛñcānuprayujyate liṭi|| anuprayujyata ityanuśabdaḥ paścādarthe| tatra
kasya paścādityapekṣāyāmāmaḥ prakṛtatvātasyaiveti vijñāyata
ityāha---āmpratyayasyeti| yo'yamāmpratyayo
vihitaḥ----karmadhārayo'yam, na tu bahuvrīhiḥ---āmpratyayo
yasmātso'yamāmpratyayastasyeti| tathā hi satyāmpratyayavaditivādamaḥ
pratyayasya prakṛtyupalakṣaṇatvāddhātorāmaśca madhye kṛñaḥ prayoga uktaḥ
syāt| paścātkṛñanuprayujyata iti|
paścācchabdasannidhāvanuśabdo'yamanuvādaḥ| liṭi parata iti| liṭi
parataḥ sthito yaḥ kṛñ so'nuprayujyata ityarthaḥ| sūtre'pi liṭīti
nānuprayogasya nimitanirdeśaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? ṭhparokṣe liṭ' ityanena
vihite liṭi parabhūte yaḥ kṛñ so'nuprayujyata iti vacanavyaktiḥ|
cakāretyādipadamanuprayujyata iti yāvat| kṛjiti pratyāhāreṇeti|
ṭhkṛbhvastiyoge' iti kṛśabdādārabhya' kṛño dvitīya' ityā kṛño
ñakārātpratyāhāraḥ| atra ca pramāṇamāmpratyaya ityatra kṛñgrahaṇam| yadi
hyatra svarūpagrahaṇaṃ syātadānyasyānuprayogasyābhāvādanartharka tatra
kṛñgrahaṇaṃ syāt| ata eva viparyayo'pi na bhavati---tatra
pratyāhāragrahaṇam, iha svarūpagrahaṇamiti; na hyatra
svarūpamārtgagrahaṇe tatra kṛbhvastīnāmanṛprayogatvānuvāda upapadyate|
tatsāmarthyāditi| pratyāhāragrahaṇamāmarthyetyarthaḥ| asterbhūbhāvo na
bhavatīti| anyathā'sandehārtha ṭhkṛbhvanuprayujyate liṭi' ityeva
brūyāditi bhāvaḥ| tatra eṣi iṭi ca rūpe vipratipannā ubhayatra ṭhha
eti----īkṣāmāha iti kecit| anye tu tāsimāhacaryādiṭa|leva
hatvamiti! apare tu sāhacaryādeva sārvadhātuka eveti
hatvamityubhayatra īkṣāmāsa iti rūpamiti sthitāḥ|
ihāmantametadanabhivyaktapadārthakam, nāsmādbhāvakarmakartṛviśeṣaḥ
puruṣaviśeṣaḥ saṃkhyāviśeṣo vā gamyate, kevalaṃ
pūrvāparībhūtānadyatanakālaṃ parokṣe sādhanādiviśeṣākāṅkṣaṃ
kriyārūpamarthamāha| tatrāvaśyaṃ tadākāṅkṣanivṛtaye
viśeṣavācipadamanuprayoktavyam, tasmādanuprayujyata ityaṃśo na
vidhātavyaḥ? idaṃ tarhi prayojanam-----kṛbhvastīnāmeva yathā
syāddhātvantarasya mā bhūt| kasya punaḥ prāpnoti?
sāmānyavacanasyānuprayujyeta---kārayāṃ papāceti| viśeṣavacanasya
vā, tatrāpi so'nuprayujyeta----uṣāmuvoṣa, vidāṃviveda,
jāgarāñjajāgāreti| tatsamānārtho vā---uṣāndadāhe tītyādi|
arthāntaravacano vā---uṣāmpapāceti| prathame pakṣe yāvadapekṣameva
nānuprayuktaṃ syādadhiko'pyartho gamyeta pākādiviśeṣo nāma,
dvitīyatṛtīyayostvanuprayogeṇaiva sakalārthāvagaterāsaprayogo
vyarthaḥ syāt, caturthe tvarthāntaragata eva viśeṣo gamyeta, na
tvāmavagataḥ, tadrataviśeṣābhidhānāya tvāmanuprayogavyasanam| ata eva
pratyāhārāntarbhūtasyāpi sampadyateranuprayogo na bhavati, anyathā
tasyāpi syāt| ṭhsanādyantā dhātavaḥ' ityato dhātvadhikārādvā
dhātūpasargasamudāyasya na bhaviṣyati| evamapi yo'tra dhānuprayokṣyate|
evaṃ hi sāmānyasya sannihite eva viśeṣe
paryavasānātadratasādhanādiviśeṣābhidhānamāmantargataviśeṣābhidhānameva saṃvartate| tathā bhvastyoranuprayujyamānayorāmantavaśena sakarmakatvaṃ bhavati----ṭhtasyātapatraṃ vibharāmbabhūve,' ṭhahaṃ kila vyapekṣāmāsa' iti, tadupapadyate, tena dvayoḥ sahaprayogaḥ| yadi tu sāmānyavacana eva prayujyeta; kriyāviśeṣo na gamyeta, āmantasyaivānabhivyaktiḥ| tasmātkṛñcetyayamapyaṃśo na vidheyaḥ| idaṃ tarhi prayojanaṃ liṭparasyaiva yathā syāt, pratyayāntaraparasya mā bhūt| kiṃparasya punaḥ prāpnoti? kṛtparasya| na kṛtparasyānuprayokṣyamāṇapuruṣaviśeṣābhivyaktiḥ| liṭi tu viruddhakālataiva lṛluṭorapi| liṅadiṣvapi vidhyādyarthāntarapratītiprasaṅgaḥ, luṅ bhūtimātraṃ gamyeta nānadyatanaviśeṣaḥ, laṭi na pārokṣyaṃ gamyeta|
nanu ca yathānuprayoge prakṛtivācyasya sāmānyasyāmantarvācye
viśeṣe paryavasānam, evaṃ pratyayavācyasyāpyāmantarvācye'nadyatane
parokṣe ca viśeṣe paryavasānādyaujyata eva luṅe'nuprayogaḥ, tathā
ṭhhaśaśvatorlaṅ ca' iti liḍartha eva laṅ vidhīyate,
laṅntasyānuprayogaḥ prāpnoti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; ekasyā ākṛteścaritaḥ
prayogo dvitīyasyāstṛtīyasyāścabhaviṣyati| ko'rthaḥ? yayā prakṛtyā
prayogaḥ prārabhyate tayaiva samāpanīyaḥ, yathā---khādire badhnāti
pālāśe baghnātīti yūpadravyavikalpe khādireṇa prayoge prārabdhe
daivānmānuṣādvā kasmāccidaparādhātkhādirāpacāre mukhye palāśe
labhyamāne'pi tatparityāgenālabhyamānasyāpi khādirasya pratinidhinā
bādarādinā prayogaḥ parisamāpyate| evaṃ hi prārabdhaḥ prayogaḥ
parisamāpito bhavati| dravyāntaropādāne tu prayogāntaraṃ syād;
dravyabhede kriyābhedāt| pratinidhistu mukhyabuddhyaivopādīyate;
tadavayavānāṃ tatra bhūyasāṃ sambhavāt| tathehāpyāmantena
liṭprayogaḥ prārabdho'parisamāptaḥ sākāṅkṣaḥ
tasyākāṅkṣāpūraṇena sa eva prayogo'nuprayogeṇa parisamāpyamāno
yuktaṃ yalliṭparasyaivānuprayogeṇa parisamāpyate, tasmānnāsti
pratyayāntaraparasyānuprayogaprasaṅgaḥ| tasmālliṭītyayamapyaṃśo na
vidhātavyaḥ| idaṃ tarhi prayojanam--anuprayogaḥupaścātprayogo yathā
syāt-īkṣāṃcakre, cakreīkṣāmiti mā bhūt| vyavahitanivṛtyartha
ca--īkṣāṃ devadataścakre| kathaṃ vyavahitanivṛttiḥ? āmapekṣayā
paścādbhāvasya tatraiva mukhyatvāt| tadevaṃ
pūrvanivṛttirvyavahitanivṛttiśca prayojanamiti sthitam| iha tu
tānha rājā madayāmeva cakāreti bahbṛcavrāhmaṇe
vyavahitaprayogaśchāndasaḥ| kathaṃ bhaṭṭikāvye ṭhukṣāṃ pracakre nagarasya
mārgān, ṭhbibhayāṃ pracakārāsau' iti? kathaṃ vā ṭhtaṃ tātayāṃ
prathamamāsa',ṭhprabhraṃśayāṃ yo nahuṣaṃ cakāra' iti? vārtikakāraḥ
pṛcchayatām, yaḥ paṭhati---ṭhviparyāsanivṛtyartha vācyam,
vyavahitanivṛtyartha ca' iti!||
vidāṃkurvantvityanyatarasyām|| 3|1|41 ||
vidāṃkurvantvityanyatarasyām|| ihotaratra cānuprayogānusāreṇa
āmante lakāra unneyaḥ| viderloṭa|lampratyaya iti| nipātyata
ityanuṣaṅgaḥ, tathā guṇābhāvaścetyatra| evaṃ loṭo lugityatra, tathā
kṛñaśca loṭparasyānuprayoga ityatra| sarvametadaprāptamiti
nipātyate| itikaraṇaḥ pradarśanārtha iti| sarveṣāṃ
loḍvacanānāmupalakṣaṇārtha ityarthaḥ| kimevaṃ sati siddhaṃ
bhavatītyāha---na kevalamiti| pracuraprayogatvātu sūtre bahuvacanaṃ
paṭhitam| kaścitu bhāṣyavārtikakārānuktatvādupalakṣaṇatvaṃ necchati,
sa itikaraṇasya prayojanaṃ bravītu||
abhyutsādayāṃprajanayāṃcikayāṃramayāṃmakaḥ
pāvayāṃkriyādvidāmakrinniticchandasi|| 3|1|42 ||
abhyutsādayāṃprajanayāṃcikayāṃramayāṃmakaḥ
pāvayāṃkriyādvidāmakrinniticchandasi|| akariti| kṛño sipi cleḥ
ṭhmantre ghasa' ityādinā lukū, sipo halṅyādilopaḥ| kranniti|
tatraiva bahuvacanaṃ jhiḥ| kriyāditi| tasyaivāśiṣi liṅ, ṭhliṅaśiṣi'
ityārddhadhātukatvādvikaraṇābhāvaḥ, ṭhriṅśaya' iti riṅ| dvirvacanaṃ
ceti| cakārātkutvaṃ na| abhyudasīṣadaditi! saderṇyantālluṅi
caṅyupadhāyā hrasvaḥ, ṭhcaṅ' īti dvirvacanam| ṭhhalādiḥ
seṣaḥ',ṭhsanballaghuni' itītvam, ṭhdīrgho laghoḥ'| bhāṣāyāmiti|
anyatarasyāmityanuvṛteścchandasyapi yathādarśanaṃ bhavatyeva| bhāṣāyāṃ
tvetadeva rūpamiti abhyudasīṣadaditi bhāṣāyāmityuktam||
cli luṅi|| 3|1|42 ||
cchi luṅ|| ikāri uccāraṇātha iti|
cakāralakārasaṃyogacasyakevalasyoccārayitumaśakyatvāt| na
tvayamanubandhaḥ, prayojanābhāvāt| cakāraḥ svarārtha iti|
etadutarasūtre vakṣyāmaḥ| asya sijādīnādeśānvakṣyatīti| yadyevam,
kimartho'yamu padiśyate, yāvatā śravaṇārtho vā bhavatyupadeśaḥ?
kāryārtho vā? na cāyaṃ cliḥ kvacicśruyate, nāpi
kvibādīnāmivāśrīyamāṇasyaivāsya kiñcitkārya ddaśyate, tasmāt
sicamevotsṛjya tasyāpavādāḥ ksāpavādāḥ vidhīyeran? naivaṃ
śaṅkyam, evaṃ hi ṭhmantre ghasa' ityādisūtre bahūnāṃ grahaṇaṃ kartavyaṃ
syād---gamyarthamaṅe grahaṇam, ākārānteṣu dheṭontarbhāvātadarthaṃ ca
caṅe grahaṇam, tasya hi ṭhvibhāṣā dheṭśvyoḥ' iti caṅ,
dhātvantarārtha sico grahaṇam, yadi janeḥ----ṭhdīpajana' iti vihitasya
ciṇo luk cchandasi ddaśyate tatastasyāpi; tānyetāni trīṇi catvāri
vā grahaṇāni bhavanti| clyutsarge punaḥ sarveṣāṃ sthānibhūtasya
tasyaivaikasya grahaṇam| nanu ca kriyamāṇe'pyutsarge tānyeva trīṇi
grahaṇāni bhavanti----ṭhcli luṅ', ṭhcleḥ' isic',ṭhmantre ghasa'
ādisūtre ca yadetalleriti| evaṃ tarhi yadetad
ṭhgātisthāghupābhūbhyaḥ sicaḥ' iti cleriti vakṣyāmi, tadeva ca
mantreghasādisūtre'pyanuvartiṣyate, tallāghavaṃ bhavati| yadi
lerityucyate, kiṃ lyavasthāyāmeva lukaṃ kariṣyati? utāho
ādeśeṣu kṛteṣu sthānivadbhāvena? yadi lyavasthāyāmeva luk;
aguḥ, asthuḥ----ṭhsijabhyastavidibhyaśca' iti jus na prāpnoti ? mā
bhūt ṭhsij' ityevam, ṭhātaḥ' ityevaṃ bhaviṣyati? tatrāpi
sijgrahaṇamanuvartate| sijgrahaṇaṃ nivartiṣyate? yadi nivartate,
abhūvannityatrāpi prāpnoti| kena? ṭhsijabhyasta' iti| netyāha;
idānīmeva hyuktam---lyavasthāyāmeva lugiti|
tadevam ṭhātaḥ' ityatra ṭhṅtiḥ' ityevānuvartate, na ṭhsicaḥ' iti,
laṅyapi tathaiva syāt| dheṭaśca ṭhvibhāṣā dheṭ' ṭhlaṅ
śākaṭāyanasyaiva' iti niyamādvikalpo bhaviṣyati| evamapi mā hi
sthātām, ṭhādiḥ sico'nyatarasyām' ityeva svaro na prāpnoti|
athādeśeṣu kṛteṣu tatoḥ ṭhvibhāṣā ghrādheṭ' ityatrāpi tathaiva
syāt, dheṭaśca ṭhvibhāṣā dheṭśvyeḥ' iti caṅapi vikalpitaḥ| tatra
yathā sicā lugalukau, tathā'dhāt adhātām adhuḥ, adhāsīt
adhasiṣṭāṃ ādhāsiṣuriti siddhamiṣṭam; caṅe'pi lugabhāvapakṣe
adadhat, adadhatām, adadhan iti siddham, lukpakṣe tu pratyayalakṣaṇena
dvirvacane'dadhādityapi caturtha rūpaṃ prāpnoti? na caṅe luki
dvirvacanam; ṭhna lumatāṅgasya' iti pratiṣedhāt| bahuvacane tarhi
caṅe luki adhānityaniṣṭṃa rūpaṃ prāpnoti, traiśabdyameva
ceṣyate----adhuḥ, adhāsiṣuḥ, adadhanniti? nanu ca caṅe'pi luki āta
iti jus bhaviṣyati, yathā sicaḥ? naitadasti; sijgrahaṇaṃ
tatrānuvartate| nivartiṣyate sijgrahaṇam? yadi nivartate, ṭhātaḥ'
ityetaddheṭaścaṅe luki vidhyarthatvasambhavānniyamārtha na syāt,
tataścābhūvannityatra pratyayalakṣaṇena sica iti jus prāpnoti,
idānīmeva hyaktaṃ kṛteṣvādeśeṣu lugiti? evaṃ tarhi
yadetastijabhyasteti, enat ṭhclyabhyasta' iti vakṣyāmi| kiṃ kṛtaṃ
bhavati? luṅlukyapi clyabhyasteti jus siddho bhavati, ṭhātaḥ'
ityatrāpi sijgrahaṇānuvṛterniyamādabhūvannityatra jusabhāvaśca siddho
bhavati| kṛteṣvādeśeṣu lugiti sijlakṣaṇaḥ svaraḥ siddho bhavati|
yadi clyabhyastetyucyate, clyaṅcaṅkṣu doṣaḥ----adhukṣan,
avocan, apīpacannatrāpi jus prāpnoti| tasmātsijabhyastetyeva
vaktavyam| ṭhātaḥ' ityatrāpi sijgrahaṇamevānuvartanīyam----niyamo
yathā syādvidirmā bhūditi| tataśca tadeva
sthitam----bahuvacane'dhāniti prāpnoti| yadā ca dheṭaścaṅe luk
kriyate tadā na kevalaṃ bahuvacane, sarveṣveva vacaneṣu
sijlakṣaṇasvarābhāvātsvare cātuḥ śabdyaprasaṅgaḥ| tasmād
ṭhgātisthāghupā' ityatra sica ityeva vaktavyam, tataśca tadeva
sthitam----tānyeva trīṇi grahaṇāniti|
pratyutākriyamāṇe utsarge mantreghasādisūtre dvayoreva grahaṇam,
katham? dheṭo janeśca caṅciṇau vikalpitau, tatra yāni luka
udāharaṇāni, sica eva tāni bhaviṣyanti | ko nvatra viśeṣaḥ? ayamasti
viśeṣaḥ---sico luki ṭhādiḥ siconyatarasyām' ityanena svareṇa
bhavitavyam, caṅciṇostu neti| tasmād dvayorapi pakṣayostrīmi
grahaṇāni, nārthaścotsargeṇa? taducyate---asati hyutsarge ṭhmantreghasa'
ityatra yebhyaḥ sico luk kriyate teṣām ṭhādiḥ
sico'nyatarasyām' ityeṣa svaraḥ prāpnoti| sati tvasmiṃlleriti
tadavasthāyāmeva lugvidhānāt sijabhāvāt yathāyathaṃ svaraḥ siddho
bhavati| tathā''kārānte sico luki kriyamāṇe ṭhsijabhyasta' ṭhātaḥ'
iti jus prāpnoti, lestu lukyantarbhāva eva bhavati| tasmādutsargaḥ
kartavyaḥ| tathā ṭhśala igupadhādaniṭaḥ ksaḥ' ityatrāniṭa iti
lerviśeṣaṇaṃ yathā syād| asati punaśclyutsarge tasyaiva
tadviśeṣaṇaṃ bhavati dhātoḥ na vidyate yasmātparasyeḍiti, tatra ca
luṅadeśānāṃ
sārvadhātukatvātsampratipannamaniṭtvamavyabhicārādaviśeṣaṇamiti
pratyayāntaragataṃ tadāśrayaṇīyam----na vidyate pratyayāntarasya
yasmātparasyeḍiti| tato guherna syāt---aghukṣaditi, vidyate
hyasmātparasya gūhitetyādāviṭ svaratyādisūtreṇa vikalpitam|
athāpi pākṣikeṇeḍabhāvenāniḍiti vyapadiśyeta? nityaṃ ksaḥ
prāpnoti, hyutsarge punaraniḍ iti tasyaiva viśeṣaṇaṃ bhavati| sa ca
kadācidaniṭ kadācitseṭ| yadāniṭ tadā ksaḥ, yadā seṭ tadā
sijiti siddhamiṣṭam---aghukṣat, aguhīditi| tasmācclyutsargaḥ
kartavya iti| sthānitvena vidhānaṃ kartavyamityarthaḥ||
cleḥ sic|| 3|1|44 ||
cleḥ sic|| ikāra uccāraṇārtha iti| na tvanubandhaḥ| yadyevam,
asaṃstetyatra sijantasyāṅgasyātmanepadaṃ ṅtimapekṣya ṭhaniditām'
iti nalopaḥ prapānoti? jñāpakātsiddham, yadayam, ṭhhanaḥ sic' iti
hanteḥ parasya sicaḥ kitvaṃ śāsti, taj jñāpayati---na
sijantasyopadhālopo bhavatīti| yathā caitajjñāpakaṃ tathā
tatraivoktamiti tatraivāvadhāryam| cakāraḥ svarārthaḥ iti|
antodātārthaḥ| nanu sico'nackatvāt kathaṃ cakārāḥ svarārthaḥ, iti
kṛte sācko bhavati? evamapi pratyayasvareṇa siddham| na siddhyati,
nāprāpte svarāntare vidhīyamānamāgamānudātatvaṃ pratyayasvaraṃ
bādhena? evaṃ tarhi cleścitvātsthānivadbhāvāccitsvaro bhaviṣyati,
tatrāha---āgamānudātatvaṃ hīti| citsvaramapi bādheteti|
sthānivadbhāvakṛtam| nanu ca yadi mā hi
lāvīdityatrāgamānudātatvaṃ syāt, cleściktaraṇamanarthakaṃ syāt?
evaṃ manyate---cleścakāro mantreghasādisūtre sāmānyagrahaṇe
caritārthaḥ; anyathā niranubandhakatvādasyaiva grahaṇaṃ syāt, na liṭaḥ,
tataśca ṭhāmaḥ' ityatra niranubandhakasya lerasambhavālleriti
nānuvarteta, tataśca paratvādantaraṅgatvācca tibādiṣu kṛteṣu
paścālluki kārayāmityasya pratyayalakṣaṇena tiṅntatvād devadataḥ
kārayāñcakāreti tasya ca nighātaḥ, tasmāccānighātaḥ syāt|
tasmādāma ityatra lerityanuvartanīyam| tasya ca tatrānuvṛttiḥ
pūrvatrasāmānyagrahaṇe satyupapadyate| tasmāccleścakārasya
caritārthatvātsthānivadbhāvātprāptaṃ citsvaramapi bādheteti
sambhāvane liṅ, sambhāvyeta bādhanamityarthaḥ| anubandhāntareṇāpi
sāmānyagrahaṇasiddhe cakārānurodhena citsvara eva bhaviṣyatīti
śakyate vaktumiti bhāvaḥ|
spṛśabhṛśeti| ṭhspṛśa sparśane',ṭhmṛśa āmarśane' ṭhkṛṣa vilekhane'----
ityetebhyaḥ kse āpte,ṭhtṛpa prīṇane' ṭhddapa harṣavimocanayoḥ'
----ābhyāṃ puṣāditvādaṅ pripte sijapi pakṣe'bhyanujñāyate|
aspṛkṣaditi| vraścādiṣatve ṭhṣaḍhoḥ kaḥ si' katvam| kāsprākṣīditi|
ṭhanudātasya cardupadhasya ca' iti pakṣe amāgamaḥ, ṛkārasya yaṇa,
ṭhvadavraja' ityādinākārasya vṛddhiḥ, amabhāvapakṣe ṛkārasyaiva vṛddhiḥ|
evamutaratrāpi||
śala igupadhādaniṭaḥ ksaḥ|| 3|1|45 ||
śala ṅgupadhādaniṭaḥ ksaḥ|| śalanto yo dhāturigupadha iti nanu
clerguṇanimitatvādakṛta eva kse lāvasthāyāmeva guṇaḥ prapnoti,
tataścegupadhāditi viśeṣaṇaṃ na prakalpyate? naiṣa doṣaḥ;
viśeṣaṇasāmarthyātprāgeva guṇāt kso bhaviṣyati| nanu ca kṛte'pi
guṇe bhūtapūrvagatyā vihitaviśeṣaṇāśrayaṇena vā kso bhaviṣyati,
kitkaraṇamidānīṃ kimarthaṃ syāt? ṭhksasyāci' iti viśeṣaṇārtham|
ṭhsasyāci' ityucyamāne punarvadihanikamikaṣibhyaḥ se vatsau
vatsāḥ---atrāpi prāpnoti? ṭhuṇādayo'vyutpannāni prātipadikāni'
ityanarthakatvānna bhaviṣyati| evamapi vuñcchaṇādiṣu tṛṇādibhyaḥ se
prasaṅgaḥ---tṛṇānyasmindeśe santi tṛṇasau tṛṇasā iti?
naitadevam; ṭhghorlopo leṭi vā' iti prakaraṇe---dhātupratyayānāṃ
grahaṇam, kiṃ ca ṭhlugvāduhadiha' ityatrāci' ityataḥ ksasyeti vartate,
teca duhādiṣu yasya sambhavaḥ, pūrvasūtre'pi tasyaiva grahaṇaṃ
bhaviṣyati| tadevaṃ kitkaraṇasāmarthyād guṇo na bhavatīti sthitam|
cleraniṭa iti| yadyapi cleḥ sijādibhirādeśairbhavitavyamiti
kvacidapyaśravaṇānna seṭtvamaniṭtvaṃ vā, tathāpi duh la iti sthite
ksasyāyaṃ viṣaya iti sicā na bhāvyam| kso'pi tāvanna bhavati,
yāvadasyāniṭtvaṃ na jñātam, tatra lakārasyaiveṭaḥ prāptau
tanniṣedhātseṭtvamaniṭtvaṃ ca nirūpyate iti viśeṣaṇopapatiḥ|
aghukṣadityādi| ṭhdāderddhātorghaḥ', ṭhekāco vaśo bhaṣ'| alikṣaditi|
ṭhliha āsvādane' ṭhho ḍhaḥ'| ṭhbhidir vidāraṇe' ṭhcchidir
dvaidhīkaraṇe',ṭhkuṣa niṣkarṣe',ṭhmuṣa steye'||
śliṣa āliṅgane|| 3|1|46 ||
śliṣa āliṅgane|| śliperdhātoriti| ṭhśliṣa āliṅgane' ityasya,
na tu ṭhśriṣu śliṣu pruṣu pluṣu dāhe' ityasya; āliṅgane
vṛtyabhāvād, aniṭa iti cādhikārātsānubandhakatvācca| atra
niyamārthametaditi| nanu śliṣirayaṃ puṣādiḥ, tathā ca
pratyudāharaṇe aṅ bhavati, tataśca puṣādipāṭhātpraptamaṇṃó
bādhitvā''liṅgane kso yathā syādityevaṃ vidhisambhavānniyamo
nopapadyate| astu vidhiḥ, evamapyāliṅgane ksaḥ, anyatrāṅiti
siddhamiṣṭam? satyam; siddhaṃ parasmaipade, ātmanepade
tvaṅbhāvādāliṅgane'nāliṅgane ca pūrveṇa ksaḥ prāpnoti,
iṣyate ca tatrāpyāliṅgane kso'nyatra sic, tacca niyame
satyupapadyate| sa ca niyamo nopapadyate; vidheyabhāvāt? yoga
vibhāgātsiddham---ṭhśliṣaḥ ityako yogaḥ śliṣaśca kso bhavati|
kimarthamidam? puṣādyaṅe bādhanārtham| yathaiba tarhyaṇṃó bādhate tathā
ciṇamapi bādheta---samāśleṣi kanyā devadateneti?
ṭhpurastādapavādā anantarānvidhīnbādhante notarān' iti
tatrāliṅgane'nāliṅgane ca śliṣaḥ kso bhavati| idamidānīṃ
kimartham? niyamārtham---āliṅgana eva, nānyatra|
yogavibhāgasāmarthyādyā ca yāvatī ca ksasya prāptiḥ sā sarvā
niyamyate, na tvanantarasya vidhirvā bhavatīti| śliṣa iti yā prāptiḥ,
ṅbādhanārthā saiva| evamapi niyamo nopapadyate, katham? śliṣa
ityetadaṅbādhanārtham| na ca tadatyantāyāṇṃó bādhituṃ prabhavati;
puṣādipāṭhasāmarthyāt, tataścāṅksayoḥ sarvatra vikalpe prāpte,
dvitīyo yogaḥ-----āliṅgane ksa eva nityaṃ yathā syānmā
kadācidaṅ bhūdityevamarthaḥ syāt, kiṃ tarhyucyate---niyamo
nopapadyate iti! nanu tatrabhavatāpi mukhāntareṇa niyama evoktaḥ?
etāvāṃstu viśeṣuḥ----mayā pratyayaniyama uktaḥ---āliṅgana eva ksa
iti, tvayā punararthaniyamaḥ---āliṅgane ksa eveti, sarvathā
niyamānna mucyāmahe| tatra lakṣyānurodhādvidheyavibhaktinirddeśena
pradhānatvādvā pratyayaniyama eva bhaviṣyati||
na ddaśaḥ|| 3|1|47 ||
na ddaśaḥ|| pūrveṇeti| ṭhśala igupadhāt' ityanena| aṅasicau bhavata
iti| parasmaipadeṣvanyatra sijeva| adarśaditi| ṭhṛddaśo'ṅ guṇiḥ'|
adrākṣīditi| ṭhsṛjiddaśorjhalyamakiti'| atha ṭhcleḥ sic'
ityasyānantaraṃ ksasya bādhanārtha sijeva kasmānna vihitaḥ,
iritvasāmarthyādaṅapi bhaviṣyati? satyam; tatrāpi ṭhddaśaśca' iti
cakāraḥ kartavya iti lāghave nāsti viśeṣaḥ||
ṇiśridrusrubhyaḥ kartari caṅ|| 3|1|48 ||
ṇiśridrusrubhyaḥ kartari caṅ|| cakāro viśeṣaṇārtha iti| ṭhcaṅ' ityitra
ṭhaṅ' ityucyimāne ṭhasyativaktikhyātibhyo'ṅ' ṭhṣidbhidādibhyo'ṅ'
atrāpi prāpnoti| yadi punarayaṃ ṅe vidhīyate cakāraḥ
śakyo'kartum| cintyaṃ prayojanamasya| aśiśriyadityādi| atra caiṅ
dhāturaṅgaṃ caṅntaṃ tu tipi tatra caṅaśrayasya guṇasya caṅmeva
ṅtimapekṣya pratiṣedhaḥ, kiṃ kāraṇam, kṅitīti nimitasaptamī? naiṣa
doṣaḥ; antaraṅgaviyaṇuvaṅai antarbhūtacaṅpekṣatvāt, bahiraṅgo
guṇo bahirbhūtatibapekṣatvāt| akārayiṣātāmiti| ṇyantātkarmaṇi
luṅ, dvivacanam, ātām| kamerupasaṅkhyānamiti| nanu kamerṇiṅ
vihitaḥ, na ca prakṛtyantaraṃ kamiḥ sambhavati, ṇiṅntātu sūtreṇaiva
siddhaṃ tatrāha---āyādaya ārddhadhātuke veti yadā ṇiṅ nāstīti|
ṇiṅpakṣe sanvadbhāva iti| sanvatsūtre caṅparo ṇirityāśrayaṇāt|
tatra hi ṭhsanvallaghuni caṅ' īti vaktavye paragrahaṇaṃ bahubrīhyartham, tatra
ṇiranyapadārthaḥ, anyasyāsambhavāt||
vibhāṣā dheṭśvyoḥ|| 3|1|49 ||
vibhāṣā dheṭśvyoḥ|| aṅe'pyatra vikalpa iti| ṭhjṛstambhu'
ityādinā| aśvaditi| ṭhśvayateraḥ'| aśvayīditi| ṭhhmyanta'ityādinā sici
vṛddheḥ pratiṣedhād guṇaḥ| adhiṣātāmiti| karmaṇi dvivacanam,
ātām| ṭhsthāghvoricca' iti kitvetve||
gupeścchandasi|| 3|1|50||
gupeścchandasi|| yasmādāyapratyayo nāmti tatrāyaṃ vidhiriti| sūtre
kevalasyoccāraṇād ṭhgupa gopane' ṭhgupa vyākulatve' ityanayostu
grahaṇaṃ na bhavati; cchandasi ddaṣṭānuvidhānāt| darśane tu tayorapi
grahaṇam| ajūgupatamiti| ṭhgupū rakṣaṇe' ṭhtasthasthamipām' iti
thasastam, ṭhtujādīnāṃ dīrgho'bhyāsasya'| agauptamiti|
ūditvādiḍabhāvapakṣe ṭhjhalo jhali' iti sico lopaḥ|
agopāyiṣṭamiti| āyapratyayāntātsic||
nonayatidhvanayatyelayatyardayatibhyaḥ|| 3|1|51 ||
nonayatidhvanayatyelayatyardayatibhyaḥ|| ardda gatau yācane ceti| ṭhardda
hiṃsāyām' ityasyāpi grahaṇam, yadicchandasi darśanamasti| etebhya
iti| tatronayatiścurādiḥ,dhvanirapi ṭhgarva māne iti
prāgetasmādadantāḥ' ityadhikāre curādiḥ paṭhitaḥ, ghaṭādau cāpi
paṭha|lte| elayatiścurādiḥ, arddayatirhetumaṇṇyantaḥ| pūrveṇeti|
ṭhṇiśri'ityādinā| ūnayīriti| madhyamapuruṣaikavacanam, pūrvavadvṛddhau
pratiṣiddhāyāṃ guṇaḥ, ṭhna māṅyoge' ityāḍāgamapratiṣedhaḥ| mā
tvāyato jarituḥ kāmamūnayīḥ---idaṃ pratisavyasya ṛṣervacanam|
tvāyataḥūtvāmicchataḥ, jarituḥūstoturmama, kāmamuabhilāṣaṃ mā
ūnayīḥūunaṃ mā kārṣīrityarthaḥ| prāyeṇa tu tibantaṃ paṭha|lte,
kṛtāḍāgamaṃ ca, tadanyatra draṣṭavyam| aunina iti| sipi caiṅ
ṭhajāderddhitīyasya' iti naśabdasya dvirvacanam| prāyeṇa
tūdāharaṇavadidamapi tibantaṃ paṭha|lte| dhvanayīditi| tip, ṭhna
māṅyoge' ityaḍāgamapratiṣedhaḥ| ārddidaditi| ṭhajāderdvitīyasya'
ṭhna ndrāḥ saṃyogādayaḥ' iti daśabdasya dvirvacanam||
asyativaktikhyātibhyo'ṅ|| 3|1|52 ||
asyativaktikhyātibhyo'ṅ|| brūñādeśo veti| vāśabdaḥ samuccaye|
evamutaratrāpi| puṣāditvādeva siddha iti| parasmaipadeṣu|
paryāsthateti| ṭhupasargādasyatyūhyaervāvacanam' ityātmanepade'iṅ
ṭhasyatesthuk'| avocaditi| ṭhvaca um'| ākhyaditi| ṭhāto lopa iṭi
ca'||
lipisicihvaśca|| 3|1|53 ||
lipisicihvaśca|| lipisicisahito hvā---iti ṭhmayūravyaṃsakādayaḥ'
iti samāsaḥ| samāhāradvandve tu napuṃsakahrasvatvaṃ syāt,
itaretarayoge bahuvacanam| ṅsau ṭhāto dhātoḥ' ityākāralopaḥ|
yogavibhāga utarārtha iti| ṭhasyativaktikhyātilipisicihvaḥ'
ityekayoge tvasyādīnāmapyutaratrānuvṛttiḥ syāt, tataśca
tebhyo'pyātmanepade vikalpaḥ syāt||
ātmanepadeṣvanyatarasyām|| 3|1|54 ||
ātmanepadeṣvanyatarasyām|| alipta, asikteti| ṭhjhalo jhali' iti
salopaḥ, ṭhliṅasicāvātmanepadeṣu' iti kitvād guṇābhāvaḥ||
puṣādidyautādylṛditaḥ parasmaipadeṣu|| 3|1|55 ||
puṣādidyautādylṛditaḥ parasmaipadeṣu|| ekenaivādiśabdena
pratyekaṃ sambandhādeva siddhe dvayorupādānaṃ cintyaprayojanam|
divādyantargaṇa iti| ṭhpuṣa puṣṭau' ṭhśuṣa śoṣaṇo' ityevamādirā
gaṇasamāpteḥ| yatu madhye ṭhṣṇiha prītau vṛt' iti vṛtkaraṇaṃ
tadradhādiparisamāptyartham| etacca ṭhasyatigrahaṇamātmanepadārtha
puṣāditvāt' iti vārtikāravacanādvijñāyate| na bhūvādiriti|
ṭhpuṣa puṣṭau',ṭhśriṣu śliṣu pruṣu pluṣu dāhe' ityevamādiḥ, asya
yadi grahaṇaṃ syātpuṣādyanantaraṃ pāṭhād dyautādīnāṃ pṛthaggrahaṇaṃ na
kuryāt| rkyādyantargaṇo veti| ṭhpuṣa puṣṭau' ṭhmuṣa steye'
ityevamādiḥ| tatra hi catvāra eva paṭha|lnte, tatra yadi te jighṛkṣitāḥ
syurlṛdita eva tān kuryāt; svaritetvāderapi nenaiva
siddhatvāt| atha puṣādayo dyautādayaśca lṛdita eva kasmānna paṭhitāḥ?
aśakyaste tathā paṭhitum; āditāmauditāmuditāmūditāṃ ca tatra
bhāvāt| tadyathā---puṣādiṣu tāvat ṭhñiṣvidā gātraprakṣaraṇe',ṭhmadī
harṣe',ṭhsamu upaśamane',ṭhṣidhū rāddhau' iti; dyautādiṣvapi ṭhśvitā
varṇe',ṭhñimidā snehane' ṭhñikṣvidā snehavimocanayoḥ',ṭhsraṃsu
dhvaṃsu bhraṃsu avasraṃsane' ṭhsyandū prasravaṇe' ṭhkṛpū sāmarthye' iti|
adyut, aśvitaditi| ṭhdyaudbhyo luṅ' īti pakṣe parasmaipadam|
aloṭiṣṭeti| ṭhluṭa luṭha pratighāte'||
sartiśāstyartibhyaśca|| 3|1|56 ||
sartiśāstyartibhyaśca|| śāseradāditvācchapo luk, itaratra
nipātanāt| śāsu anuśiṣṭāviti| sartyartibhyāṃ parasmaipadibhyāṃ
sāhacaryādasyaiva grahaṇam, na tu ṭhāṅḥ śāmu icchāyām'
ityātmanepadina iti darśayati| ṛ gatāviti| ṭhṛ gatiprāṇayoḥ' iti
bhauvādikaḥ, ṭhṛ sṛ gatau' iti jauhotyādikaḥ| duyorapyatra
nirddeśa iti kecit, vayaṃ tu
jauhātyādikayorevārtisartyorgrahaṇaṃ manyāmahe| asaraditi|
ṭhṛddaśo'ṅ guṇiḥ'| aśiṣaditi| ṭhśāsa idaṅhaloḥ'|
ṭhśāsivasighasīnāñca' iti ṣatvam|
pṛthagyogakaraṇamātmanepadārthamiti| anyathā
puṣādidyautādylṛditsartiśāstyartibhyaḥ' ityekameva yogaṃ
kuryāt| evaṃ hi pṛthagvibhaktinirddeśaścakaraśca na kartavyo bhavati|
samaranteti| ṭhsamo gamyṛcchi' ityātmanepadam, ṭhbahulaṃ
cchandasyamāṅyoge'pi' ityāḍbhāvaḥ, chāndasatvādasya
prayogasya----samanyavo yatsamaranta senāḥ, saṅkalpā asya samaranta|
tathā bhaṭṭikāvye ṭhsamāranta mamābhīṣṭāḥ saṅkalpāstvayyupāgate'
iti| kaścidāha---bhāṣyaviruddhamidam, bhāṣyakāreṇa hi ṭhsamo
gamyucchi' ityatra māsamṛṣātāṃ māsamṛpateti ātmanepade sijudāhṛta
iti|
atrāhuḥ--śāsisāhacaryādartisartyoravidyamānaśapojauhotyādikayoriha grahaṇam; ṭhsamo gamyṛcchi' ityatra tu bhauvādikasyāpyartergrahaṇam, tatra bhauvādike'rtau sica udāharaṇamaviruddhamiti||
irito vā|| 3|1|57 ||
irito vā|| abhiteti| svaritvādātmanepadam||
jṛstambhumrucumlucugrucuglucugluñcuśvibhyaśca|| 3|1|58 ||
jṛstambhumrucumlucugrucuglucugluñcuśvibhyaśca|| astambhaditi|
ṭhaniditām' ityupadhālopaḥ| anyataropādāne'pi rūpatrayaṃ
siddhyatīti| katham? yadi tāvad glucirupādīyate
tasmādaṅasicoḥ----glucat, aglocīdityetad dvayaṃ siddhyati,
gluñcestu sici tṛtīyamagluñcīditi| atha gluñcirupādīyate
tasyāglucat agluñcoditi rūpadvayaṃ siddhyati, glucestu sici
tṛtīyamaglocīditi, kimartha tarhi
ubhayorupādānamityatrāha---arthabhedātviti| kecidityādi| idaṃ
bhāṣyaviruddham; bhāṣyakāro hi ṭhanekārthatvāddhātūnāmarthabhedo na
prayojaka ubhayopādānasya' ityanyataropādānaṃ pratyākhyātavān||
kṛmṛddaruhibhyaścchandasi|| 3|1|59 ||
kṛmṛddaruhibhyaścchandasi|| amaraditi| vyatyayena parasmaipadam||
ciṇ te padaḥ|| 3|1|60 ||
ciṇ te padaḥ|| sāmarthyāditi|
dhātorātmanepaditvātparasmaipadabahuvacanasya sthāne yastaśabdaḥ
ṭhtasthasthamipām' iti vihitaḥ, tasyāsminviṣaye'sambhavaḥ|
sāmarthyādudapādīti| ṭhciṇo luk'| udapatsateti|
ṭhātmanepadeṣvanataḥ' ityadādeśaḥ| iha veti nivṛtam;
utaratrānyatarasyāṃ grahaṇāt||
dīpajanabudhapūritāyipyāyibhyo'nyatarasyām|| 3|1|61 ||
dīpajanabudhapūritāyipyāyibhyo'nyatarasyām|| janī prādurbhāve,
budha avagamane iti | ṭhjana janane' budha bodhane' saityetayostu
parasmaipadinoriha grahaṇaṃ na bhavati; dīpyādibhirātmanepadibhiḥ
sāhacaryāt| tena parasmaipadibhyāṃ karmavyatīhāre
ātmanepadaikavacane'pi taśabde ciṇ na bhavati| yadi
parasmaipadinoriha grahaṇaṃ syāt, ātmanepadinorna syāt;
sānubandhakatvāt| kartari cāyaṃ vikalpaḥ, bhāvakarmaṇostu ṭhciṇ
bhāvakarmaṇoḥ' iti nityameva ciṇ bhavati, paratvādiha
kartarītyanuvṛtervā||
acaḥ karmakartari|| 3|1|62 ||
acaḥ karmakartari|| karmakartarīri| yatkarma bhūtvā kartā bhavati
tatraityarthaḥ| prāptavibhāṣeyamiti| ṭhkarmavatkarmaṇā' ityatideśena
nityaṃ ciṇaḥ prāpteḥ| akāri kaṭo devadateneti| atra śuddhe karmaṇi
ṭhciṇ bhāvakarmaṇoḥ' iti nityameva ciṇ bhavati| nanviha
kartarotyanuvartiṣyate, yadyevam, śuddhe kartari syāt, karmaṇīti
vākyabhedena kartā viśeṣayiṣyate----karmaṇi kartarīti ? naitadevaṃ
śakyate labdhum; karmaṇītyucyamāne karturnivṛttireva syāt,
cakāre'pi kriyamāṇe karmaṇi ca bhavati kartari ca
bhavatītyadhikaraṇayoreva samuccayaḥ syād, na sāmānādhikaraṇye
pramāṇamasti||
duhaśca|| 3|1|63 ||
duhaśca|| aprāptavibhāṣeyam ṭhna duhasnunamāṃ yakciṇau' iti ciṇaḥ
pratiṣedhāt| tatra duhigrahaṇe yakpratiṣedhārtha ciṇgrahaṇaṃ
snvādyartham| adugdheti| ṭhksasyāci'ṭhlugvā duhadiha' iti ksasya
luk||
na rudhaḥ|| 3|1|64 ||
na rudhaḥ|| rudhira āvaraṇe iti| ṭhano rudha kāme' ityasya tu grahaṇaṃ na
bhavati, kartṛsthabhāvakatvena karmakarturabhāvāt||
tapo'nutāpe ca|| 3|1|65 ||
tapo'nutāpe ca|| karmakartarīti| ṭhtapastapaḥ karmakasyaiva' iti yatra
karmavadbhāvovihitaḥ| tatra bhāvakarmaṇorapīti| apiśabdāt
ṭhkarmavatkarmaṇā' iti yatra karmavadbhāvo'tidiṣṭastatrāpi bhavati|
atapta tapastāpasa iti| asyārtham ṭhtapastapaḥ karmakasyaiva' ityatra
vṛttikāra eva vakṣyati| anvavātapta pāpeneti| pāpeneti pūrva
yatpāpaṃ karma kṛtaṃ tena paścātapto'bhyāhata ityarthaḥ| śuddhe karmaṇi
lakāraḥ, pāpeneti kartari tṛtīyā| karmāvivakṣāyāntu śokārthe vā
tapau bāve lakāraḥ, pāpeneti hetau tṛtīyā| yadābhyāhananārthasya
karmakartā vivakṣyate, tadā karmavatkarmaṇetyatideśādātmanepadam,
tadāpi hetau tṛtīyā||
