ciṇ bhāvakarmaṇoḥ|| 3|1|66 ||
ciṇ bhāvakarmaṇoḥ|| ciṇgrahaṇaṃ vispaṣṭārthamiti| ṭhciṇ te padaḥ'
ityatasteśabdavadanuvṛteḥ| yatu dīpajanetyādāvanyatarasyāṃgrahaṇam,
tanna; ṭhrudha' iti tatpratiṣedhavidhāveva nivṛtam, anyathā
pratiṣedhavidhānamanarthakaṃ syāt| na ca pratiṣedhasyānuvṛttiśaṅkā,
prāptipūrvako hi pratiṣedhaḥ| na ca bhāvakarmaṇoḥ kenacicciṇaḥ
prāptirasti||
sārvadhātuke yak|| 3|1|67 ||
sārvadātuke yak|| ihāśiṣi liṅ iliṭi cāntareṇāpi vikaraṇaṃ
sarveṣveva dhātuṣu tiṅameva sadbhāve bhāvakarmakartārastrayo'pi
pratīyante-----bhaviṣīṣṭa tvayā, kṛṣīṣṭa ghaṭaḥ, bhūyāt, kriyāt,
babhūve, cakre ghaṭaḥ, babhūva, cakāreti| atijuholyādau kartā| 
kvacitiṅamabhāve'pi pratīyante trayo'pyamī|
aśāyyakāri gaccheti ciṇaḥ sannidhimātrataḥ||
adhogabibharityādau dhātumātre'pi kartṛdhīḥ|
tathā vyatisa ityādau dhātvabhāve'pi kartṛdhīḥ||
evaṃ sthite bhūyoviṣayābhyāmantavayavyatirekābhyāṃ śabdārthāvasāyaḥ|
vyabhicārabhūmiṣu tu tasmiṃstasminviṣaye tasya tasya śabdasya sa sa
mahimeti kalpayitumuci tam| na punaḥ kvacidvyabhicāradarśanena
sarvatrānāśvāsaḥ| tāddaśau cānvayavyatirekau tiṅameveti teṣāmeva
bhāvakarmakartāro vācyāḥ| sūtrakāro'pyāha---ṭhlaḥ karmaṇi ca bhāve
cākarmakebhyaḥ' iti, lādeśāśca tiṅḥ, tato'pi teṣāmeva te'rthā
iti manyamāna āha----bhāvakarmavācigi sārvadhātuke parata iti|
utarasūtre ca kartṛvācini sārvadhātuke parata iti śayyata iti|
ṭhayaṅ ci kṅiti'| atha yadā dvau kartārau bahavo vā, tadā
kathamāsyate bhavadbhyām, āsyate bhavadbhiḥ----dvivacanabahuvacane
kasmānna bhavataḥ? bhāve bhedābhāvād| dhatvartho hi bhāvaḥ| 
kartṛbhede'pi nāvaśyaṃ dhātvartho bhidyate yataḥ|
ekāmeva kriyāvyakti bahuṣūtpādayatsvapi||
ddaṣṭamete pacantīti karmabhedo'pi tāddaśaḥ|
paśyaikasyāṃ kriyāvyaktau pacyante taṇḍulā iti||
na kālabhede śabdaikyamāsyāsiṣyata āsyate|
pākau pākā iti tvatra śabdaikyādekaśeṣatā||
ataśca---
nivutabhedā sarvaiva kriyā''khyātebhidhīyate|
śruteraśakyā bhedānāṃ pravibhāgaprakalpanā|| iti| 
tadevamākhyātena bhāvasvarūpagato bhedaḥ pratīyata iti
dvivacanabahuvacanābhāvaḥ| yatra tu svarūpagata eva bhedastatra bhavatyeva,
yathā----uṣṭrāsikā āsyante, hataśāyikāḥ śayyante iti| uṣṭrāṇāṃ
hyāsikāḥ svata eva vilakṣaṇāḥ, hatāśca nānāprakāraṃ śerate utānā
avātānā vikīrṇakaśā visrastavastrā iti tatsāmyādākhyātavācyasyāpi
bhāvasya svarūpagatabhedāvabhāsād bahuvacanam|
ivaśabdaprayogamantareṇāpi cevārthāvagatirbhavati,
tadayamarthaḥ----yāddaśāni hatānāmanekaprakārāṇi śayanāni tāddaśāni
devadatādibhiḥ kriyanta iti| kecitvatra karmaṇi lakāramicchanti,
uṣṭrāsikāhataśāyikālakṣaṇasya bhāvasyaḥ ṭhkālābhāvādhvagantavyāḥ' iti
karmatvāt, yathā----godohaḥ supyate iti|
kakāro guṇavṛddhipratiṣedhārtha iti| mṛjyata ityatra vṛddhipratiṣedhaḥ|
yagvidhāna iti| nanu ca ṭhkarmavatkarmaṇā tulyakriyaḥ' ityatideśādeva
yak siddhaḥ, kimupasaṅkhyānena tatrāha---vipratiṣedhāddhīti| yadā
ṭhkarmavatkarmaṇā' ityayaṃ śāstrātideśaḥ, tadā tenatena śāstreṇa
karmakāryāṇi bhavanti| tatra karmaṇi yagbhavatītyasyāvakāśaḥ----śuddhaṃ
karma, pacyate odana iti; kartari śabityasyāvakāśaḥ----śuddhaḥ kartā,
bhavati pacatīti; karmakartaryubhayaprasaṅge paratvācchabeva
syādityarthaḥ| tatarhi upasaṅkhyānaṃ kartavyam? na kartavyam; ṭhna
duhasnunamāṃ yakciṇau' iti yakpratiṣedho jñāpayati----bhavati
karmakartari yagiti| kāryātideśe tu tasmiṃstenaiva sūtreṇa
bhavanyageva paro bhavati||
kartari śap|| 3|1|68 ||
kartari śap|| pakāraḥ svarārtha iti| upalakṣaṇametat,
ṅtvipratiṣedhārthaḥ, ṭhśapśyanornityam' iti viśeṣaṇārthaśca| śakāraḥ
sārvadhātukārtha iti| sañjñāparo'tra sārvadhātukaśabdo na
sañjñiparaḥ, sārvadhātukasañjñārtha ityarthaḥ| kartṛgrahaṇasya
ṭhkarmavatkarmaṇā' ityatropayogaḥ| iha tu sārvadhātuke śab bhavati,
śyan bhavatīti sāmānyavidhāne'pi bhāvakarmaṇoryagapavāda iti
kartaryeva śabādayo bhaviṣyanti||
divādibhyaḥ śyan|| 3|1|69 ||
divādibhyaḥ śyan|| ṭhmṛga anveṣaṇe' iti curādāvadanteṣvātmanedī
paṭha|lte, tatra mṛgayat iti bhavitavyam| divādiṣvapi
pāṭhānmṛgyatīti sādhuḥ| kaṇḍvādiṣu vā mṛgaśabdo draṣṭavyaḥ||
vā bhrāśabhlāśabhramukramuklamutrasitruṭilaṣaḥ|| 3|1|70 ||
vā bhrāśabhlaśabhramukrumuklamutrasitruṭilaṣaḥ|| ubhayatravibhāṣeyam|
anavasthānārtho bhramiḥ, kramitrasī ca divādayaḥ, truṭistaudādikaḥ,
itare bhauvādikāḥ| bhrāmyatīti| ṭhśamāmaṣṭānāṃ dīrgaḥ śyani' iti
dīrghaḥ| bhauvādikasya tu na bhavati, aśamāditvāt| krameḥ ṭhkramaḥ
parasmaipadeṣu' iti dīrghaḥ| klamestu ṭhṣṭhivuklamvācamāṃ śiti' iti
traserdivādipāṭhe cintyaṃ prayājanam| klamestu puṣādikāryārthaḥ||
yaso'nupasargāt|| 3|1|71 ||
yaso'nupasargāt|| daivādika iti| divādipāṭho'sya
sopasargārthaḥ| anupasargāditi kimiti| ṭhsamyasaśca' ityetatsama
evopasargānnānyasmāditi niyamārtha bhaviṣyatīti bhāvaḥ| āyasyati,
prayasyatīti| tulyajātīyānāṃ halantānāmeva vyāvṛttiḥ syāditi
manyate||
saṃyasaśca|| 3|1|72 ||
saṃyasaśca|| iha ṭhsamaḥ' ityevāstu, ṭhyasaḥ' ityanuvartiṣyate, ṭhṣama ṣṭam
veklavye' ityasya grahaṇaśaṅkānivṛtyartha tu ṭhsaṃyasaḥ' ityuktam| evaṃ
tarhi ṭhsamo yasaḥ', ṭhanupasargācca' ityastu||
svādibhyaḥ śnu|| 3|173 ||
svādibhyaḥ śnu|| sinotīti| ṭhṣiñ bandhane'
rkyādipāṭhātsinātītyapi bhavati||
śruvaḥ śrṛ ca|| 3|1|74 ||
akṣo'nyatarasyām|| 3|1|75 ||
tanūkaraṇe takṣaḥ|| 3|1|76 ||
tanūkaraṇe takṣaḥ||anekārthatvāditi | ata eva
viśeṣaṇopādānādanekārthvaṃ vijñāyate| pradarśanārthastu gaṇe
dhātūnāmarthanirddeśaḥ| santakṣati vāgbhiriti| nirbhartsayatītyarthaḥ||
tudādibhyaḥ śaḥ|| 3|1|77 ||
tudādibhyaḥ śaḥ|| tudatīti| tudati iti sthite paratvātprāptamapi
guṇaṃ nityaḥ śo bādhate||
rudhādibhyaḥ śnam|| 3|1|78 ||
rudhādibhyaḥ śnam|| śnampratyayo bhavatīti| yadyapi pratyayasaṃjñāyāṃ
prakṛtyupapadopādhikārāgamānvarjayitvetyuktam, tathāpi
vidhīyamānatvena prādhānyāt śabādivadarthavatvācśnamaḥ pratyayasaṃjñā
bhavatīti bhāvaḥ| tena śakārasya pratyayāditvāditsaṃjñā| śapo'pavāda
iti| deśabhedenobhayoḥ satyapi sambhave nāprāpte
tasminnārabhyamāṇatvādekārthatvāccāpavādatvam| vikaraṇā hi
sārvadhātukasya dhātoścārthābhidhāne sahāyatāṃ pratipadyante| śakāraḥ
śrānnalopa iti viśeṣaṇārtha iti| athārddhadhātukasaṃjñā mā
bhūdityevamarthaḥ kasmānna bhavati? satyāṃ hi tasyāmanakti,
bhanakti----ṭhato lopaḥ'syāt, ruṇaddhi, guṇaḥ syāt; hinasti,
tṛṇeḍhi---iḍāgamaḥ syāt; ṭhneḍvaśi kṛti' ityetadapi nāsti,
akṛtvāt? sarvametat śramaḥ pūrvabhāgasyānaṅgatvānna bhaviṣyati|
kathamaṅgatvam? yasmātpratyayavidhiriti| ko'rthaḥ? pratyaye
vidhīyamāne yatpañcamyā nirddiṣṭṃa dhātoḥ prāripadikāditi
tadādi tasminpratyaye parato'ṅgamiti| yaccāmyā nirddiṣṭṃa
rudhādibhyo dhātubhya iti na tasmātpratyayaḥ, yasmācca pratyayaḥ
pūrvabhāgātsa na tasminvidhīyamāne pañcamyā nirddiṣṭaḥ,
tasmācchanāditi vaśeṣiṇārtha eva śakāraḥ| ṭhnānnalopaḥ' ityucyamāne
ṭhyajayācayatavicchapraccharakṣo naṅ' yajñānām, yatnānāmatrāpi
prāpnoti, ṭhnāmi' iti dīrghatve kṛte nāditi vyapadeśābhānna
bhaviṣyati, paratvāllopa eva prāpnoti| yatu ṭhato dīrgho
yañi',ṭhsupi ca' iti dīrdhatvam, na ca tadatra pravartate, kiṃ kāraṇam?
ṭhsannipātalakṣaṇo vidhiranimitaṃ tadvighātasya' iti| ihāpi tarhi na
syād---vṛkṣāyeti? ṭhkaṣṭāya kramaṇe' iti nirdeśādbhaviṣyati|
ihāpi tarhi---yatnānāmiti? nirddiśātsāmānyāpekṣāyā
jñāpanāddīrgho bhaviṣyati| evamapi tasya pūrvasmādvidhau
sthānivatvānnaśabda evāyamiti nalopaḥ syādeva| tasmādviśeṣaṇārthaḥ
śakāraḥ kartavyaḥ| atha kriyamāṇe'pi śakāre iha kasmānna
bhavati----viśnānām, praśnānāmiti? ṭhlakṣaṇapratipadoktayoḥ
pratipadoktasya grahaṇam'||
tanādikṛñbhya uḥ|| 3|1|79 ||
tanādikṛñbhya uḥ|| tanītītyādi| ṭhtanu vistāre',ṭhṣaṇu
dāne',ṭhkṣaṇu hisāyām'|
anyatanādikāryamiti| tanādikāryāpekṣo niyama ityarthaḥ|
vyāvartyadarśayati---tanādibhyastathāsoriti vibhāṣā sico lug
na bhavatīti| nanvastu lugvikalpaḥ, tadabhāve ṭhhrasvādaṅgāt' iti
lopo bhaviṣyati, na ca vikalpena bādhaḥ, vikalpaṃ prati
nityasyāsiddhatvāt; na ca tanādipāṭhasamārthyādapadāvo
vacanaprāmāṇyāditi nyāyenāsiddhatvabādhādvikalpena nityasya
vādhaḥ,tanādipāṭhasya vikaraṇavidhau caritārthatvāt;
vikalpo'pyatataḥ atathā ityādau caritārthaḥ; pratyuta kriyamāṇe
kṛñgrahaṇe tanādiṣu kṛñaḥ pāṭhasyānanyārthatvādyenanāprāptinyāyena
vikalpo nityavidhiṃ bādheta? idaṃ hi kṛñgrahaṇavidhau tanādiṣu
pāṭhaścaritārtho mā vijñāyītyevamarthameva syāditi
kṛñgrahaṇapratyākhyānameva nyāyyaṃ manyāmahe||
dhinvikṛṇvyora ca|| 3|1|80 ||
dhinvikṛṇvyora ca|| ato lopasya sthānivadbhāvād guṇo na
bhavatīti| tena prakriyālāghavāya dhinviṇvyorlopa eva nokta iti
bhāvaḥ| lope hi guṇassyāt| na caca ṭhna dhātulopa ārddhadhātuke'
iti niṣedhaḥ, pratyayasanniyogaśiṣṭatvena
lopasyānārddhadhātukanimitatvāt| nanu numanuṣaktayorgrahaṇaṃ
kimartham? numi kṛte'tvaṃ yathā syād, ṭhdhivikṛvyoḥ'
ityucyamāne'tve kṛte'ta eva paro num prasajyeta; atvaṃ hyantaraṅgaṃ
pratyayasanniyogena vidhānāt; numāgamastu bahiraṅgaḥ, utpanne
pratyaye'ṅgasya sato vidhānāt| nanu cāstvaṅgasya num,
lāvasthāyāmeva bhaviṣyati; tibādīnāmantaraṅgatvāt| tibādiṣveva
tarhi bhaviṣyati, na; nityenātvena bādhanāt| numāgamastu
śabdāntaraprāpteranityaḥ| antaraṅgastarhi numāgamastadvidhau
dhātugrahaṇāt? taddhi dhātusaṃjñāpravṛttikāla eva num yathā
syādityevamartham; anyasyodito'sambhavāt| kathamasambhavaḥ?
yadidānīmevoktam----tāseriditkaraṇamanunāsikalopapratiṣedhārthamiti| nanvatrāpi pakṣe ṭhnumvidhāvupadeśivadvavacanaṃ pratyayasiddhyartham' iti vacanādupadeśa eva num bhaviṣyati ? evaṃ tarhyantaraṅgatvādeva prāptasya numo'yaṃ nirddeśaḥ||
rkyādibhyaḥ śrā|| 3|1|81 ||
stambhustumbhumkambhuskumbhuskuñbhyaḥ śnuśca|| 3|1|82 ||
stambhustumbhuskambhuskumbhuskuñbhyaḥ śnuśca|| uditvipratijñānāditi|
eṣāṃ hyukāro'nunāsika itsaṃjñakaḥ pratijñāyate, tasya
prayojanam----ṭhudito vā' iti ktvāpratyaye iḍvikalpaḥ| yadi
caitadvikaraṇaviṣayā evaite syustannopapadyate| tasmāduditvena
pratijñānātsarvārthatvaṃ vijñāyate, sarve pratyayāḥ
prayojanameṣāmityarthaḥ| sarvapratyayaśeṣatvabhiti vā||
halaḥ śraḥ śānajjhau || 3|1|83 ||
halaḥ śraḥ śānajjhau|| puṣāṇ, muṣāṇeti| loṭ, sip, tasya hiḥ,
rṭhkyādibhyaḥ śnā',tasya śānac| cakāraḥ svarārthaḥ| atra
sannipātaparibhāṣayā anityatvād ṭhato heḥ' iti herluk|
nanu ca śnāpratyayasya prakṛtatvātasyaiva śānajādeśo bhaviṣyati,
nārthaḥ śna iti sthāninirddeśenāta āha---śra iti sthānītyādi|
ādeśa ityeṣa saṃpratyayaḥ---avagamo yathā syādityevamarthaḥ| asati tu
tasmin kiṃ syādityāha---pratyayāntaramiti| astu pratyayāntaram,
rṭhkyādibhyaḥ' ityanuvṛtestebhya eva halantebhyo bhaviṣyatīti na
kaściddoṣa ityata āha----sarvaviṣayamiti| arkyādiviṣayamapītyarthaḥ|
rkyādyanuvṛttirdurjñāneti manyate| śānacaḥ
śitkaraṇañcintyaprayojanam; sthānivadbhāvenaiva siddheḥ| iha
ṭhñimidā snehane' divādiḥ, vyatyayena cchandasi śnā, tasya
śānajādeśaḥ, midāna| ṭhmiderguṇaḥ' iti pratiṣedhaviṣaye
vidhīyamāno guṇo na bhavati, punaḥ śitkaraṇena
ṭhsārvadhātukamapit' ityasyāpi punaḥ pravṛteriti kecit| neti
vayam; yathaiva vyatyayena śnā bhavati, evaṃ guṇaviṣaye ikāro
bhaviṣyati||
cchandasi śāyajapi|| 3|1|84 ||
cchandasi śāyajapi|| gṛbhāyeti| grahijyādisūtreṇa saṃprasāraṇam,
ṭhhṛgrahorbhaścchandasi' iti hakārasya bhakāraḥ| badhāneti| ṭhbandha
bandhane',ṭhaniditām' iti nalopaḥ||
vyatyayo bahulam|| 3|1|85 ||
vyatyayo bahulam|| yathāyathamiti| svasmin svasminviṣaye ityarthaḥ|
vyatigamanaṃ vyatyaya iti| vyatipūrvādiṇo bhāve ṭherac'|
anyo'nyaviṣayāvagāhanamityarthaḥ| kvacidityādinā vyatyayasya prakāraṃ
darśayati| na maratīti| parasmaipadamapyatra vyatyayena| neṣatviti|
nayaterloṭi śapsipau| taruṣemeti| taratervidhyādau liṅ, tathā
ca ṭhtaremeti prāpte' iti vṛttiḥ;itarathā ṭhtīryāsmeti prāpte' iti
vaktavyaṃ syāt, tataśśap sip u tyaya iti trayo vikaraṇāḥ,
dhātorguṇaḥ| taruṣamas, tato yāsuṭ, ṭhliṅḥ salopo'nantyasya'
ṭhnityaṃ ṅtiḥ' ṭhato yeyaḥ' yalopaḥ, ṭhādguṇaḥ' taruṣema|
bahulagrahaṇamanarthakam, pūrvasūtrādapiśabdasyānuvṛtau cchandasi
vyatyayo'pi bhaviṣyati, apiśabdādyathāprāptañceti sarvamiṣṭṃa
siddhyati| ata āha----bahula grahaṇamiti| sarvasya prakṛtasyāprakṛtasya
ca vidhervyabhicāro vyatyayalakṣaṇo yathā syādityevamarthamityarthaḥ|
evamarthe bahulagrahaṇe sati yadiṣṭṃa siddhyati tatślokena
darśayati---suptiṇupagrahetyādi| tatra supām vyatyayaḥ---dhuri
dakṣiṇāyāḥ| dakṣiṇasyāmiti prāpte| tiṅam----caṣālaṃ ye aśvayūpāya
takṣati| takṣantīti prāpte| lādeśavyaṅgyaḥ kriyāsādhanaviśeṣaḥ
svārthaparārthatvavyaktavāktvādiko yaḥ sa mukhya upagrahaḥ| yathoktam----
ya ātmanepadādbhedaḥ kvacidarthasya gamyate||
anyataścāpi lādeśānmanyante tamupagraham|| iti|
ātmanepadāddhetorityarthaḥ| evamanyataścāpi lādeśaditi, iha tu
tadvyaktinimitatvātparasmaipadātmanepadayorupagrahaśabdo vartate| sa
brahmacāriṇamicchate| icchatīti prāpte| ūrmiryuvyati, yudhyata iti
prāpte| liṅgama---madhostṛptā ivāsate, madhuna iti prāpte|
bhāṣāyāmapi madhuśabdaṃ puṃlliṅgaṃ prayuñjate----ṭhmadhūṃśca bibhrati
rmayasuraviṭapina iti', taccintyam| naraḥupuruṣaḥ----adhā sa
vīrerddaśabhirviyūyāḥ, viyūyāditi prāpte, ṭhyu miśraye' ṭhvipūrvaḥ,
āśiṣi liṅ| kālavācī pratyayaḥ kālaḥ----śvo'gnīnādhāsyamānena,
luṭo viṣaye lṛṭ| hal---triṣṭuabhaujaḥ "suphitamugravīram,ṭhśubha
śobhārthe' bhakārasya phakāraḥ| āśvalāyanasūtre taitirīye ca bhakāra eva
paṭha|lte ac----upagāyanti mā patnayo garbhiṇayaḥ, dīrghasya hrasvaḥ|
svaravyatyayaḥ----ṭhparādiścchandasi bahulam' ityatra vakṣyate| kartṛ śabdaḥ
kārakamātrasyopalakṣaṇārthaḥ, tadvācināṃ śabdānāṃ vyatyaya ityarthaḥ|
vibhaktīnāṃ vyatatya iti yāvat| yaṅam---yaṅiti pratyāhāraḥ yaṅe
yaśabdādārabhya ṭhliṅyāśiṣyaṅ' iti ṅkāreṇa, teṣāṃ
vyatyayaḥ----āṇḍā śuṣmasya bhedatītyādinā vṛtāveva darśitaḥ| eṣāṃ
suprabhṛtīnāṃ vyatyayamicchati caśāstrakṛt pāṇinirācāryaḥ| so'pi
tathāvidho vyatyayo bāhulakena siddhyati| bahulasya bhāvo
bāhulakam, manojñāditvādruñ| tatpunarbahulaśabdasya
pravṛttinimitaṃ yadvahvarthādānam| ca---śabdo hetau|
yasmādevamuktaprakāro vyatyayo bahulagrahaṇenaiva siddhyati,
tasmādvahulagrahaṇaṃ kṛtamityarthaḥ||
liṅyāśiṣyaṅ|| 3|1|86 ||
liṅyāśiṣyaṅ|| śaṣo'pavāda iti|
liṅaśiṣītyārddhidhātukatvātkathamatra śapaḥprāptirityata
āha---cchandasyubhayatheti| śabgrahaṇaṃ copalakṣaṇam| śakeḥ
śnorapavādaḥ, sthādiṣvevāyamaṅ prāyeṇa ddaśyata
ityāha----sthāgāgamītyādi| upastheyamiti| upapūrvātiṣṭhaterāśiṣi
liṅ, mipombhāvaḥ, yāsuṭassārvadhātukatvāt ṭhliṅḥ
ssalopo'nantyasya', aṅ ṭhāto lopi iṭi ca', ṭhato
yeyaḥ',ṭhādguṇaḥ'| evamupageyamiti| gamemeti| mas| vocemeti|
aṅ, ṭhvaca um', yāsuṭ, iyādeśaḥ,vali lopaḥ| ddaśeragvaktavya iti|
aṅ ihi sati ṭhṛddaśo'ṅ' īti guṇassyāt||
karmavat karmaṇā tulyakriyaḥ|| 3|1|87 ||
karmavat karmaṇā tulyakriyaḥ|| karmaṇā, tulyaṃ vartata iti karmavat
ṭhtena tulyam' ityādinā vatiḥ,na tu ṭhtatra tasyeva' iti; tulyakriya
iti pratiyogini prathamānirdeśāt| anyathā tulyakriye
tulyakriyasyeti vā nirddeśyaṃ syāt| tathā hi vākye tāvadyato
vatirbhavati, yaśya pratiyogī---ubhābhyāmapi tābhyāṃ ṣaṣṭhīsaptamyau
bhavataḥ,viprasyevāsya śīlam, mathurāyāmiva pāṭaliputre prākāra
iti; ubhayorapi sambandhitvād, ādhāratvācca| tataścotpanne'pi vatau
pratiyoginaste eva ṣaṣṭhīsaptamyāvupatiṣṭhete| tulyārthayoge tu
yā tṛtīyā sopamānādeva bhavati, nopameyāt;
tulyaśabdasyopameyaniṣṭhatvāt, tadyathā---candreṇa tulyaṃ mukhamiti
tataśyotpanne'pi vatāvupameyātprathamaivāvatiṣṭhate|
karmaṇeti paribhāṣikaṃ karma gṛhyate, na laukikaṃ kriyā karma; tasya hi
grahaṇe kriyayā tulyā kriyā yasyeti kimuktaṃ syāt kriyāyāḥ, yayā
kayācana kriyayā tulyatvād! atassādhanakarmaṇo grahaṇam| tatra
sādhyasādhanayoratyantabhedānmukhyena karmāa kriyāyāḥ
sāddaśyāsambhavātkarmaśabdena tatsthā kriyā lakṣyate| bhavati hi
tātsthyātācchabdyam, yathā---mañcāḥ krośantīti| tadetadāha---karmaṇi
kriyā karmeti|
viśeṣaṇasya vaiyarthyaṃ na cedānīṃ prasajyate|
karmaṇaḥ kriyayā tulyā na sarvasya kriyā yataḥ|| iti ||
karmaṇaḥ kriyayā tulyakriyaḥ, na sādhānāntarasyetyevaṃ
pratipatyarthatvādityāha---karmasthayā kriyayā tulyakriya iti|
tulyaśabdasya nityasāpekṣatvātkarmasthayā kriyayetyetadapekṣasyāpi
sūtravadvahuvrīhirnānupapannaḥ| tulyaśabdo'yamasti
sādhāraṇavacanaḥ----etau tulyadhanāviti, sāddaśyavacanastu prasiddha eva;
tatrādyasya grahaṇe karmaṇeti yadi mukhyavṛttistadā kartuḥ karmaṇaśca yā
sādhāraṇī kriyā, tatra yaḥ kartā karmaṇā saha sādhāraṇakriyaḥ
sakarmakeṣu yaḥ kartetyuktaṃ bhavati| tatra tulyakriya ityanarthakam,
karmaṇetyeva vācyaṃ syāt| karmaṇā saha yaḥ kartā pratipādyata ityarthaḥ|
atha gauṇavṛttistadāyamartha----kriyayā hetunā sādhāraṇakriyaḥ| kayā
kriyayā? karmasthayā kriyayeti| evamapi pacatyodanaṃ devadata ityatrāpi
prāpnoti, yāsau karmasthā viklitirūpā kriyā tayā
sādhāraṇakriyatvāt| ato'sminpakṣe'niṣṭraprasaṅgaḥ, prasiddhataraśca
saddaśaparyāyastulyaśabda iti prayuñjānaḥ ṭhsāddaśyavacanastulyaśabdaḥ, na
sādhāraṇavacanaḥ' ityācaṣṭe| kartṛbhūta iti| kartari sampanna ityarthaḥ|
cvervikalpitatvādatrābhāvaḥ| atha vā--kartṛśabdaḥ kartṛtve vartate,
bhūta iti ṭhbhū prāptau' ityasya ṭhā dhṛṣādvā' iti ṇijabhāve rūpam,
kartṛtvaṃ prāpta ityarthaḥ| tatra pacatyodanamityatra kartṛkarmavyāpāraha
yoratanyantabhedena sāddaśyābhāvātkarmavadbhāvābhāvaḥ| evamapi
bhidyamānaḥ kusulaḥ pātrāṇi bhinnatītyatrāpi prāpnoti, yāddaśī hi
pātreṣu kriyā'vayavaviśaraṇātmikā tāddaśyeva kusūle'pi kartari
lakṣyata iti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; karmasthayā kriyayā tulyā kriyā yasya
karturityukte kartutvopayoginī yā kriyā yadāveśādasau kartā
bhavati saiva kriyā gamyate; iha tu pātreṣu ddaśyamānaṃ dvidhābhavanaṃ
kusūle'pi daivagatyā ddaṣṭamityetāvanna punastatsamāveśādasau
bhinati, svayamabhidyamāno'pi kusūla upari patan pātrāṇi bhinatyeva|
evamapyanyo'nyamāśliṣataḥ, anyo'nyaṃ spṛśataḥ, anyo'nyaṃ gṛhṇītaḥ
----atra prāpnoti, atra hi yatkriyāveśātkartā bhavati saiva karmaṇyapi
dṛśyate? satyaṃ ddaśyate; na sā karmatvopayoginī, na hyasau
tadāveśātkarma bhavati; svayamanāśliṣyato'pi pareṇāśliṣyamāṇasya
karmatvasambhavāt| tadetaduktaṃ bhavati----karmaṇaḥ karmatvopayoginī
yā kriyā tayā tulyā yasya kartṛtvopayoginī kriyā sa karmaṇa
tulyakriyaḥ| evañca yasyaiva karmaṇaḥ karmāvasthāyāṃ yā kriyā
kartravasthāyāmapi yadi saiva kriyā bhavati sa kartā karmavadityuktaṃ
bhavati| idamapyatraivoktam----ṭhyasmin karmaṇi kartṛbhūte'pi' iti|
tasminneva karmaṇi kartravasthāṃ prāpta iti hyatrārthaḥ| evañca
kartṛkarmāvasthābhedādekasyā api kriyāyā bhedāśrayaṃ
sāddaśyamupapādyam|
atideśo
rūpanimitatādātmyavyapadeśaśāstrakāryātideśabhedenānekavidhaḥ,
tavādistrayāṇāmasambhavaḥ| vyapadeśātideśastu saṃjñāpakṣānna bhidyate|
tatra vaktaraṇamanarthakam| ataḥ śāstrātideśaḥ, kāryātideśa iti dvāveva
pakṣau| tatra śāstrātideśe ṭhbhāvakarmaṇoḥ' ityādiṣu
śāstreṣvatidiṣṭeṣu tena tena śāstreṇa tatatkāryaṃ pravartate, tataśca
ṭhbhāvakarmaṇoḥ' ityasyāvakāśaḥ---śuddhaṃ karma, pacyate odanaḥ,
ṭhśeṣātkartari parasmaipadam' ityasyāvakāśaḥ---śuddhaḥ kartā, pacati
paṭhati; karmakartaryubhayaprasaṅge paratvātparasmaipadaṃ prāpnoti? naiṣa
doṣaḥ; ṭhkartari karmavyatīhāhe ityataḥ kartṛgrahaṇamanuvartate, tena
kartaiva yaḥ kartā tatra parasmaipadam, karmakartari na bhaviṣyati| iha
tarhi karmaṇi yag bhavatītyasyāvakāśaḥ---śuddhaṃ karma, pacyate, odanaḥ,
ṭhkartari śap' ityasyāvakāśaḥ---śuddhaḥ kartā, pacati paṭhati;
karmakartaryubhayaprasaṇeó paratvācchap prāpnoti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; ṭhkartari
śap' ityatra kartṛgrahaṇanna kartavyam, sārvadhātuke śabiti sāmānyasya
bhāvakarmaṇoryagapavādo bhaviṣyati, evaṃ siddhe yatkartṛgrahaṇaṃ kriyate
tasyaitatprayojanam----kartaiva yaḥ kartā tatra śabādayo yathā syuḥ,
karmāpadiṣṭe mā bhūvanniti? satyaṃ prativihitamāyuṣmatā! vṛthā
punarayamprayāsaḥ, kāryātideśāśrayeṇaiva siddheḥ| tatra
hyanenaivātmanepadam, anenaiva yagiti paratvādyagātmanepade
siddhyataḥ| pradhānaṃ ca kāryam, tadarthatvādatideśāntarāṇām| ataḥ
kāryātideśa kartṛgrahaṇamasti, yadapi prakṛtamṭhkartari śap' iti,
tadapi saptamyantam ṭhtulyakriya' iti prathamāntena sambaddhuaṃ nārhati,
tatrāha---kartari śabityata iti|
yagātmanepadetyādi| lāntasya kartā karmavaditi
vakṣyamāṇatvādyagādīnāmeva sambhava iti bhāvaḥ| midyate ityādīni
trīṇyātmanepadasyodāhaṇāni yagādīnāṃ krameṇa| kathaṃ punaḥ kāṣṭhasya
bhidāṃ prati kartṛtvam, yāvatā bhidyate'sau devadatena? yo
hyudyamananipātanādi kuṭhārasya karoti sa bhedane kartā ucyate|
sarveṣāmeva kārakāṇāṃ prātisviko'vāntaravyāpāro'sti,
akiṃcitkarasya kārakatvānupapateḥ| etacca kārakaprakaraṇe
evopapāditam| tatra ca svavyāpāre svatantratvaṃ sarvatraivāsti|
kārake kartṛvyāpāreṇa tiraskṛtatvātu nyagbhūtaṃ svātantryamiti
kartṛtvaṃ na bhavati, karaṇādisaṃjñaiva bhavatītyetāvat| sakarmakāstu
keciddhātavaḥ karmavyāpāramapyabhidhāya
tāvatyevāparyavasyantastadupasarjanaṃ kartṛvyāpāramācakṣate,
tadyathā----bhidirddhidhābhavanopasarjanaṃ dvidhābhāvanamāha| na
khalvayamudyamananipātanamātravacanaḥ; rajake'pi prasaṅgāt, sopi hi
vastramudyacchati nipātayati ca| atha ca na bhinatītyucyate;
dvidhābhavanābhāvāt| etena cchinatilunatī vyākhyātau| tathā pacirapi
viklityupasarjanaṃ vikledanamāha| tatra yadā karmaṇaḥ
saukaryātiśayapratipādanāya kartṛvyāpāro na vivakṣyate, tadā
nivṛtapreṣaṇaṃ karma svakriyāvayavasthitaṃ nivartamāne karmatve sve
kartṛtve'vatiṣṭhate| dhāturapi tadvyāpāramātre vartate| kathaṃ
punarubhayavacano dhātuḥ karmavyāpāramātravacano bhavati? ko
virodhaḥ? anekārthā dhātavaḥ, samudāyeṣu ca vṛtāḥ śabdā avayeṣvapi
vartante, tadevaṃ karmavyāpāramātravāciṣu kartṛtvameva
kāṣṭhādīnām, na tu karmatvagandho'pyasti; dhātavaścaite
prayoge'sminnakarmakāḥ, yathā---viklidyati dvidhā bhavatīti; kathaṃ tarhi
karmaṇā tulyakriyaḥ kartā? na brūmaḥ----asmin prayoge yatkarma tena
tulyakriya iti, kiṃ tarhi? prayogāntare yatkarma tena tulyakriya iti|
nanvevaṃ pacatyodanaṃ devadataḥ, rādhyatyodanaḥ svayameva---atrāpi
prāpnoti? atra parihāraṃ vakṣyati---dhātvadhikārāditi|
kartṛkarmaṇordhātoranyatrāsambhavādeva
siddhestadanuvṛttirekatvavikṣārthā----yasminneva dhātau yatkarma tena
tulyakriyastasyaiva dhātoḥ karteti| tena dhātubhede na bhaviṣyati? 
āha--adhyāropo'yamastu, ko'rthaḥ? kṛtsna eva dhātvarthaḥ
karmaṇyadhyāropyate kimatra devadatena odana eva pākaṃ karotīti|
evaṃ hi saukaryātiśayaḥ sutarāṃ pratipādito bhavati,
karaṇādhikaraṇavat, yathā---sādhvasiścchinati, sādhu sthālī pacatīti|
tatra yeṣu tāvatkṛtsna eva dhātvarthaḥ karmaṇyapi sambhavati---ātmanā
buddhyate, ātmanā mucyate, ātmanā hanyate, ātmanā tāḍa|lte iti,
teṣu śuddhe karmaṇi lakāraḥ kena cidrūpeṇa kartṛtvam,
kenacidrūpeṇa karmatvamiti| tathā bhidyate kusūla iti yatrāpi cetano
bhetā na ddaśyate tatra vātātapakālābhivarṣaṇānāmanyatamasya
kartṛtvam, adhyāropo vā| pacyate odanaḥ svayameva, lūyate
kedāraḥ svayamevetyādāvadhyāropa eva, ātmanaivovanaḥ pacyate, na
tu devadateneti, kaevaṃ nāma pāke'nukūlo bhavatītyarthaḥ| tadevaṃ
śuddhe karmaṇi lakārotpaternārtha etena| yadyevam, bhidyate
kusūleneti bhāve lo na syāt, sakarmakatvāt? athāpyatra bhidyate
kusūlenātmeti karmaṇi vyākhyāyeta| evamapi bhetavyaṃ kusūlena,
īṣadbhedaṃ kusūleneti bhāve kṛtyaktakhalarthā na syuḥ? na ca tatrāpi
karmaṇīti śakyamāśrayituṃ napuṃsakaliṅgadarśanāt| tathā namate
daṇḍaḥ svayameva, kārayate kaṭaḥ svayameva, acīkarata kaṭaḥ
svayameva---yakciṇoḥ pratiṣiddhayorapi śapcaṅai na syātām,
akartṛtvāt| tasmātkarmavyāpāramātravācibhyaḥ kartari bhāve ca lādaya
ityetadeva sādhīyaḥ| tathā ca śrṛtaṃ pāka ityatra paceḥ karmavyāpāre
kartṛvyāpāre ca śrṛtamiti bhavati; dvayorapi
pākaśabdābhidheyatvāt|
evaṃ hi yā vimṛṣṭā śāstraṃ na kariṣyāmiti matiḥ, sāpi tyājyā|
asati sūtre ṭhna duhasnunamāṃ yakciṇau' iti pratiṣedhasya viṣayo na
pradarśitaḥ syāt| kiñca, yadyapi pacyate odanaḥ svayamevetyādikaḥ
prayogaḥ karmaṇi samarthyate, kartari tu lakārotpatau pacatyodana
ityādikaḥ prayogo'pi prasajyeta| tasmādārabdhavyaṃ sūtram|
atrodāharaṇeṣu kartrantaravyudāsārtha svayamiti prayujyate, na
tvetadudāharaṇāṅgam| prayukta etasminnātmanetyasyārthe vṛteḥ
prākṛtamevaitatkarma syāt---svāśrayamapi yathā syāditi| asati
vatkaraṇe kartuḥ karmasaṃjñā jñāyeta, tataścānena karmaṇā
sakarmakatvād ṭhbhāve cākarmakebhyaḥ' iti bhāve lo na syāt| sati
tu tasminsvataḥ prāptasyākarmakavyapadeśasyānivartanādakarmakāṇāṃ
bhāve laḥ siddho bhavati, akarma kāṇāṃ bhāve yo lo vidhīyate sa
siddho bhavatītyarthaḥ| kathaṃ siddho bhavati, yāvatā nityo'yamatideśaḥ,
nitye cāsmiṃstatra lavidhirapi karmakāryameveti syādevātideśaḥ?
ātideśikāviruddhaṃ svāśrayaṃ vatinā prāptate, na tu viruddhamapi| na
hyayaṃ vikalpārthaḥ---kadācitkarmavat, kadācinneti| atha lāntasya
karteti vakṣyamāṇatvādetatsūtrapravṛteḥ prāgeva ṭhlaḥ karmaṇi ca'
ityetatpravṛttiraṅgīkriyate, tacca pravartamānamakarmakatvādbhāve
kartari ca pravartate, yadā kartari tadā'yamatideśa iti bhāve lavidhiḥ
samarthyeta| yadyevam, mā bhūdvatiḥ, lakāravācyasya kartuḥ
karmasañjñaivāstu, yagātmanepadayostvaprasiddhiḥ paratvācchabādīnāṃ
parasmaipadasya ca prasaṅgaḥ; na ca karmasañjñayā kartṛsañjñāyā bādhaḥ,
ekasañjñādhikārādanyatra sañjñānāṃ samāveśāt? satyam; ukto'tra
parihāraḥ----tadetadvatkaraṇaṃ sarvasāddaśyārtham| tenodāharaṇeṣu
kāṣṭhādibhyo dvitīyā na bhavati; ityarathā karmakāryatvātprāpnoti,
abhihitatvānna bhaviṣyati| bhavedayaṃ parihāraḥ śāstrātideśe,
kāryātideśe tvanenaiva karmakāryāṇi prāpyante, na
cātrānabhihitādhikāro'stīti syādeva dvitīyā| vatkaraṇātu
sarvasāddaśyārthādyathā karmaṇyabhihitena bhavati, evaṃ kartaryapīti
dvitīyābhāvaḥ| yadā tarhyakarmakatvādbhāve lakārastadā prāpnoti,
tatrāha-----liṅyāśiṣyaṅtyāidi| tatra lagrahaṇamanuvṛta ṣaṣṭha|la
vipariṇamyate ityabhiprāyeṇāha---lāntasya karteti| lakāravācyaḥ
kartetyarthaḥ| kusūlād dvitīyā na bhavatīti| bhidyate
kusūlenetyanantarodāhṛteṣu udāharaṇeṣu tu vatkaraṇādeva
sarvasāddaśyārthād dvitīyāyā abhāva iti bhāvaḥ| tadevaṃ
vṛttikārasyābhipretam----etadvatiḥ sarvasāddaśyārtha iti| kiñca,
nāvaśyaṃ dvitīyaiva, kṛtyaktakhalarthā apyasminviṣaye kartaryatideśena
prāpnuvanti----bhetavyaḥ kusūlaḥ svayameva, bhinnaḥ kusūlaḥ svayameva,
īṣadbhedaḥ kusūlaḥ svayameveti; bhaava eva ceṣyante---bhetavyaṃ
kusūlena kusūlasya vā, ṭhkṛtyānāṃ kartari vā',ṭhbhinnaṃ kusūlena,
īṣadbhedaṃ kusūleneti| atra vārtike ktagrahaṇamanyatra
sahapāṭhātpaṭhitam, yathā-----kakāro guṇavṛddhipratiṣedhārtha iti|
bhavatyeva hyaebhyo'karmakatvād ṭhgatyarthākakarmaka' iti kartari ktaḥ| tathā
ca ṭhsinotergrāsakarmakartṛkasyeti vaktavyam' iti niṣṭhā---natve|
sino grāsaḥ svayameveti kartari kta udāhariṣyate|
tasmātkṛtyakhalartheṣvevaiṣa doṣaḥ, atastatra lāntasya
kartetyāśrayaṇādevātideśābhāvaḥ|
karmaṇeti kimiti| dhātuvācyā kriyā kartṛ karmaṇoreva samavetā,
tatra sāddaśyasya bhedādhiṣṭhānatvātkartṛsthayā kriyayā tulyakriyaḥ kartā
na sambhavatīti karmasthaiva kriyā āśrayiṣyata iti matvā praśraḥ|
karaṇādhikaraṇābhyāmiti| tatsthakriyayetyarthaḥ| sādhvasiścchinatīti| kiṃ
punaratra karaṇādhikaraṇavyāpāramātre dhāturvartate? āho svitatra
kṛtsnadhātvarthādhyāropaḥ? na tāvadādyakalpaḥ, tāvati
dhātoravṛterasinā cchinatatyatrāpi naiva karaṇavyāpāro
dhātunopādīyate, kevalaṃ
karaṇatvādavāntaravyāpāro'stītyetāvat| dvitīye tu
bhinnakriyatvādevāprasaṅgaḥ| tasmātkaraṇādhikaraṇavyāpāramātre'pi
dhātorvṛttimaṅgīkṛtya pratyudāhṛtaṃ draṣṭavyam| kvacitu
karaṇenāpi tulyakriyasya karmavadbhāva iṣyate, yadāha---karaṇena
tulyakriyaḥ kartā bahulamiṣyate, parivārayati kaṇṭa
kairvṛkṣam, parivārayante kaṇṭakā vṛkṣam----ātmanepadaṃ bhavati|
vṛttikārastu ṭhṇicaśca' ityātmanepadamupapadyata iti manyamāno
naitadupasamacaṣṭa| 
dhātvadhikārātsamāne dhātāviti| ekasyaiva dhātorityarthaḥ| etacca
prāgeva vyākhyātam|
karmasthabhāvakānāmityādi| yadyapi kriyābhāvaśabdayorabhinna evārthaḥ,
tathā ca ṭhyasya ca bhāvena bhāvalakṣaṇam' iti kriyāpi gṛhyate,
ṭhlakṣaṇahetvoḥ kriyāyāḥ' ṭhkarmaṇā tulyakriyaḥ' iti ca vāco'pi;
tathāpyasmin granthe bhedenopādānādarthabhedo
draṣṭavyaḥ---aparispandarūpo dhātvartho bhāvaḥ, parispandarūpastu kriyā|
kva punarasau karmasthaḥ? kva vavā kartṛ sthaḥ? kecidāhuḥ----yeṣu
karmabyāpāropasarjanaḥ kartṛvyāpāro'bhidhīyate teṣu karmasthaḥ,
yeṣu kartṛ vyāpāra eva teṣu kartṛ stha iti| neti vayam;
pradhānakriyā yatra samavaiti kartari karmaṇi vā tatstho dhātvarthaḥ,
yaduddeśena kārakavyāpāraḥ sā pradhānakriyā, yathā---pacerviklitiḥ,
gamerdeaśāntaraprāptiḥ| evañca kṛtvā
nyagbhavanopasarjananyagbhāvavacano'pi ruhiḥ
kartṛsthakriyaḥ---ārohanti hastinaṃ hastipakā iti;
uparideśaprāpteruddeśyāyāḥ kartari samavāyāt, tatreha karmasthena
vyāpāreṇa kartṛvyāpārasyopamānāt|
asya cārthasya kartṛsthavyāpāreṣvasambhavānnyāyaprāpta evārtho
vṛttikāreṇa darśitaḥ| tatra kartasthavyāpārasya kartṛsthasya
codāharaṇamātraṃ ślokena darśayati----karmasthaḥ pacaterbhāva iti|
pacyate ghaṭa ityatra taddeśasyaiva ghaṭasya pāka iti bhāvo'sau bhavati,
karmasthaśca---pacyate odana ityatra parispandata eva, pākyasya
pākābhinirvṛttiriti karmasthaiva paceḥ kriyā bhavati| karmasthā ca
bhideḥ kriyeti| bhidyate kusūla ityatrāvayavaviśaraṇātmikā bhidikriyā
bhedasya parispande sati bhavatīti karmasthā ca bhideḥ kriyā bhavati|
māsāsibhāvaḥ kartṛstha iti| māsamāste ityatra ṭhkālabhāvādhvagantavyāḥ
karmasañjñā hyakarmaṇām' iti māsakarmako'yamāsidhātuḥ, tatra
māsāsidhātau pratīyamāno'rtho bhāvaḥ; aparispandarūpatvāt, sa ca
kartṛstha ityarthaḥ| kartṛ sthā ca gameḥ kriyeti| gamerarthaḥ kriyā, sā ca
kartṛ sthetyarthaḥ| tenāsyate māsaḥ svayameva, gamyate grāmaḥ
svayameveti na bhavati| atheha kathaṃ karmavadbhāvaḥ---tasmādudumbaraḥ
salohitaṃ pacyate phalamiti? atrāhuḥ---paciratra viṣaye dvikarmakaḥ,
vṛkṣasya pākamantareṇa phalasya pākāsambhavāt| tatra ṭhapradhāne
duhādīnām' iti vṛkṣo'kathitaṃ karmeti tatra lakāraḥ, kālastu
karteti| idaṃ tu vaktavyameva, ṭhsṛjiyujyoḥ śyaṃstu' iti ṭhsṛji
visarge',ṭhyujiryoge'---anayoḥ sakarmakayoḥ kartā karmavadbhavati;
tatra sṛjeḥ śraddhopapanne kartari karmavadbhāvaḥ, yagviṣaye ca śyan,
ciṇviṣaye tu ciṇeveṣyate; sṛjyate mālāṃ devadataḥ, śraddhayā
niṣpādayatītyarthaḥ| śyani sati prakṛterādyaudātatvaṃ bhavati, yaki tu
sārvadhātukānudātatve yaka evodātatvaṃ syāt-----asaji mālām,
śraddhayā niṣpādayati smetyarthaḥ| ṭhyujir'---yujyate brahmacārī
yogena||
tapastapaḥ karmakasyaiva|| 3|1|88 ||
tapastapaḥ karmakasyaiva|| ṭhkriyābhedādvidhyarthamidam' iti vakṣyati| kathaṃ
tarhyevakārasyānvaya ityāśaṅkya vākyabhedena vyācaṣṭe---tapa santāpe,
asya kartā karmavadbhavati, sa ca tapaḥ karmakasyaiveti| evakārasya
vyavacchedyaṃ darśayati----nānyakarmakasyeti| etacca
śrutasyaivakārasyānvayo vaktavya iti matvoktam, na punarasya
kiñcitpratojanamasti| kriyābhedāditi| atyantabhedādityarthaḥ|
niyamapakṣe'pi kriyāṇāṃ ca bhedo'pekṣitaḥ; tulyatvasya
bhedādhiṣṭhānatvāt| kriyābhedameva darśayati---upavāsādīnīti| duḥ
khayantītyartha iti| ṭhsukhaduḥkha tatkriyāyām' iti curādipāṭhāṇṇic|
anena tāpasasya karmatve taperduḥ khanamartha iti darśitam|
arjayatītyartha iti| anenāpi tāpasasya kartṛtve taperarjanamartha iti
darśitam| kvacitu ārjayatīti pāṭhaḥ, tatrāṅpūrvasya prayogaḥ|
nanvemapi śarīrasantāpalakṣaṇā kriyā'vasthādvayo'pi tulyā, na hi
śarīrasantāpādanyadarjanaṃ tāpasasya vyāpāraḥ? tadasat; vastusthityā
sato'pi śarīrasantāpasyāśabdārthatvāt, kathamanyathā tapasaḥ
karmatvam! tasmādarjanamu niṣpādanam, alabdhasya lābhaḥ; duḥkhaṃ tu
śarīrasantāpa eveti spaṣṭa eva kriyābhedaḥ| vidhyarthametaditi yaduktaṃ
tadevopasaṃharati---pūrveṇāprāptaḥ karmavadbhāvo vidhīyata iti|
atapta tapastāpasa iti| ṭhtapo'nutāpe ca'iti ciṇaḥ pratiṣedhātsic,
ṭhjhalo jhali' iti lopaḥ|| 
na duhasnanamāṃ yakciṇau|| 3|1|89 ||
na duhasnanamāṃ yakciyau|| ṭhduha prapūraṇe',ṭhṣṇu prasravaṇe'| ṭhṭuadu
upatāpe', ṭhhame hasane',ṭhṇu stavane' ityeteṣāṃ tu grahaṇaṃ na bhavati,
nautihasatyorakarmasthakriyatvāt| yadi ca teṣāṃ grahaṇāmiṣṭṃa
syādasandehārtham ṭhna dunuhasnamām' ityeva brūyāt,
avayavaprasiddheśca samudāyaprasiddhirbalīyasī|
karmavadbhāvāpadiṣṭāviti| etena ṭhanantarasya vidhirvā bhavati
pratiṣedho vā' iti karmavatkarmaṇeti prāptayoryakciṇorayaṃ
pratiṣedhaḥ; na tu ṭhciṇ bhāvakarmaṇoḥ', ṭhsārvadhātuke yak'iti
śuddhe karmaṇi bhāve prāptayoriti darśayati| dugdha iti| yaki
pratiṣiddhe śap, tasya adāditvālluk, ṭhdāderdhātorghaḥ',
ṭhjhaṣastathordho'dhaḥ' jaśtvam| duhirayaṃ dvikarmakaḥ, tatra ṭhapradhāne
duhādīnām' iti yasminkarmaṇi lakārastasya kartṛtvavivakṣā, pradhānaṃ
tu karma karmaiveti, yathā----ṭhsvayaṃ pradugdhe'sya guṇairupasnutā
vasūpamānasya vasūni medinī' iti| adugdheti| ṇic bhāve ksaḥ,
ṭhlugvā duha' ityādinā tasya luk|
nanvidānīmevoktam----ṭhduheranena yak pratiṣidhyate, ciṇ tu
ṭhduheśca' iti pūrvameva vikalpitaḥ' iti,
tasmānnaitadatrodāhartavyam| prasnuta iti| yaki pratiṣiddhe
pūrvavacchapo luk prāsnoṣṭeti| ciṇpratiṣedhe sic| namata iti|
antarbhāvitaṇyartho'tra namiḥ| tatra yathā nayamati daṇḍaṃ devadataḥ,
namayate daṇḍaḥ svayameveti ṇyantasya karmasthakriyatvam, evamasyāpi
draṣṭavyam|
ṇiśranthigranthītyādi| ṇīti ṇiṅe ṇicaśca sāmānyena grahaṇam| ṭhśrantha
grantha sandarbhe' curādāvādhṛṣīyau, tayorṇijabhāvapakṣe grahaṇam| tathā
rkyādiṣvapi paṭha|lete tayorapi grahaṇam| ṭhbrūñ vyaktāyāṃ vāci'|
ātmanepadavidhāvakarmakā ye dhātavo nirddiṣṭāste
yadāntarbhāvitaṇyarthāḥ sakarmakā bhavanti ta ime ātmanepadākarmakāḥ|
vṛtau kvacideṣāmudāharaṇāni paṭha|lnte, kvacinna| ṇici-----kāryate
kaṭaḥ svayameva, acīkarata kaṭaḥ svayameva, yakciṇoḥ pratiṣiddhayoḥ
śapcaṅai bhavataḥ| ṇiṅ-----pucchamudasyati, utpucchayate gauḥ, sa
yadāntarbhāvitaṇyarthastadā utpucchayate gām| punaḥ saukaryātiśayena
kartṛtvavivakṣāyāmutpucchayate gauḥ svayameva, udapupucchata gauḥ
svayameva| śranthigranthyorādhṛṣīyayoḥ-----granthati granthaṃ devadataḥ,
śranthati mekhalām, granthate granthaḥ svayameva, agranthiṣṭa granthaḥ
svayameva; śranthate mekhalā svayameva, aśranthiṣṭa mekhalā svayameva|
kraiyādikayostu----grathnīte granthaḥ svayameva, śrathnīte mekhalā
svayameva| brañ---bravīti kathāṃ devadataḥ, brūte kathā svayameva|
vacanaṃ śabdaprakāśanaphalatvātkarmastham| ātmanepadākarmaka-----ṭhveḥ
śabdakarmaṇaḥ' ṭhakarmakācca' vikaurvate saindhavāḥ, valgantītyarthaḥ|
tānyadā'nyo valgayati tadā teṣāṃ karmatvam| punaḥ
saukaryātiśayātkartṛtvavivakṣāyām----vikurvate saindhavāḥ
svayameva, vyakṛṣata saindhavāḥ svayameva, yakciṇau na bhavataḥ| kvacitu
bṛtau---āhanti māṇavakam, āhate māṇavakaḥ svayameveti paṭha|lte,
tadayuktam; āhanti māṇavakamiti sakarmakatvādātmanepadābhāvācca|
anye punarāhuḥ-----ātmanepadākarmaketi dhātupalakṣaṇam,
hantiśrāyam ṭhāṅe yamahanaḥ' ityatra yadā
karmāvivakṣayā'karmakastadātmanepadasya nimitaṃ syāt,
tasyādyasakarmakatve'pyaviruddhamudāharaṇamiti|
bhūṣākarmakirādisanāṃ yakciṇoḥ pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ| karmaśabdaḥ
kriyāvācī, bhūṣāphalaṃ ca śobhākhyaṃ karmaṇi ddaśyata iti karmasthā
bhūṣā| alaṃkurute kanyā svayameva, alaṃkariṣyate kanyā svayameva,
alamakṛta kanyā svayameva; avakirate hastī svayameva, avākīrṣṭa hastī
svayameva, avakariṣyate hastī svayameva----yakciṇciṇvadbhāvā na
bhavanti| san---mumukṣate vatsaḥ svayameva, amumukṣiṣṭa vatsaḥ
svayameva; cikīrṣate kaṭaḥ svayameva, acikīrṣiṣṭa kaṭaḥ
svayameva----prakṛtyarthāpekṣamatra karmasthakriyatvam, icchā tu kartṛsthā|
ārtha ca prakṛtyarthasya prādhānyam; tadarthathvādicchāyāḥ||
kuṣirajoḥ prācāṃ śyan parasmaipadaṃ ca|| 3|1|90 ||
kuṣirajoḥ prāyāṃ śyan parasmaipadaṃ ca||
yagātmanepadayorapavādāviti| śyanyako'pavādaḥ,
parasmaipadamātmanepadasya| śyanyakoścātra numisvare ca
viśeṣaḥ----kuṣyantī jaṅghā, śyani ṭhśapśyanornityam' iti nityaṃ
numāgamaḥ, nitvāccādyaudātatvaṃ bhavati; yaki tu ṭhācchīnadyornum'
iti numvikalpaḥ, laḥ sārvadhātukānudātatve ca yaka evodātatvaṃ
syāt|rajyatīti| ṭhaniditām' iti nalopaḥ| kuṣyate, rajyate iti
pakṣe yagātmanepade bhavataḥ|
liṅliṭoriti| āśiṣi liṅtra gṛhyate, yaduktam---kuṣairajoḥ
śyanvidhāne sārvadhātukavacanam, avacane hi liṅliṭoḥ pratiṣedha
iti| syādiviṣaye ceti| ādiśabdena sijādīnāṃ grahaṇam| cukuṣe,
rarañca iti| liṭ, ātmanepadam, tasya eśādeśaḥ| koṣiṣīṣṭeti|
ṭhliṅḥ sauyuṭ', ṭhsuṭ tithoḥ' laghūpadhaguṇaḥ| raṅkṣīṣṭeti|
ṭhekācaḥ' itīṭpratiṣedhaḥ, ṭhcoḥ kuḥ' iti kutvam gakāraḥ, tasya
cartvamkakāraḥ| akoṣi, arañcīti| ciṇ||
dhātoḥ|| 3|1|91 ||
dhātoḥ|| ā kuto'yamadhikāraḥ kiṃ prāglādeśād?
āhosvidādhyāyaparisamāpteḥ? iti vicāre dvitīyaṃ pakṣamāśrayati--ā
tṛtīyādhyāyaparisamāpteriti| 
eśaḥ śitkaraṇāt, taddhi dhātorityadhikāre sati ṭhtasmādityutarasya'
ṭhādeḥ parasya' takārasya sthāne etve sati akārasya sthāne ṭeretve
ayādeśe ca satyayeśabdasya śravaṇaṃ mā bhūdityevamartha kiyate|
prāglādeśātpunarddhātvadhikāre'lo'ntyasya vidhayo bhavantīti
ekārasyaikāravacane prayojanaṃ nāstīti kṛtvāntareṇāpi
śakāramantye'lyanusaṃhāraṃ bādhitvā sarvādeśo bhaviṣyati, kiṃ
śakāreṇa! yadyādhyāyaparisamāpterayamadhikāraḥ? ādye yoge na vyavāye
tiṅḥsyuḥ, ādye yoge tibādisūtre ye'mī lāvasthāyāṃ syādayo
vidhīyante teṣu kṛteṣu tairvyavadhāne tibādayo na syuḥ|
kariṣyati, hariṣyati, kartā, śabādiṣu tu na doṣaḥ; teṣāṃ
sārvadhātukāśrayatvādakṛte lādeśe prāptyabhāvāt; tibādayaśca tatra
sāvakāśāḥ|
na syādetvam, ṭeṣṭitāṃ vyavāya ityeva---pacate yajate, kva tarhi
syāt? āste, śete, dhate, rundhe, bebhidāte ityādau yatra na
vikaraṇāḥ santi| 
eśaḥ śitvam ṭhliṭastajhayoreś' ityayameś śitkartavyaḥ|
etaccopakrama eva vyākhyātam|
yacca loṭo vidhate tacca vikaraṇavyavāye na syāt---ṭhloṭo
laṅvat'ṭheruḥ' ṭhserhyapicca' ityādi, pacatu, pacatamityādi, stautu,
juhotu, bhinatu, āstāmityādāveva syāt|
yaccāpyuktaṃ laṅliṅestacca na syāt---ṭhnityaṃ
ṅtiḥ',ṭhitaśca',ṭhtasthasthamipāṃ tāntantāmaḥ' ṭhliṅḥ sīyuṭ' ṭhyāsuṭ
parasmaipadeṣūdāto ṅcci' ityādi, tathā ṭhthāsaḥ se' pacase ityādau
na syāt? naiṣa doṣaḥ; vihitaviśeṣaṇaṃ
vijñāsyate---dhātorvihitasya loṭa iti| yadyevam, ṭhvido laṭo vā'
ityatrāpi viderddhātorvihatasya laṭastibādīnāṃ ṇalādaya iti
vijñāyamāne vindati, vindataḥ, vindantīti lābhārthasya vikaraṇena
vyavāye'pi ṇalādayaḥ prāptuvanti? na kvaciddhihitaviśeṣaṇaṃ
dhātugrahaṇamiti sarvatra tathā bhavitavyam| atha vātra dhātunā vihitaṃ
viśeṣayiṣyāmaḥ, vidinā''nantaryam---dhātorvihitasya laṭo
videranantarasyeti, ṭhsijabhyastavidibhyaśca' ityavāpi dhātunā
vihitaṃ viśeṣyate, abhyastena
cānantaryam---dhātorvihitasyābhyastādanantarasya ṅito jheiriti;
tenājakṣiṣyan, ajāgariṣyannityādau na bhaviṣyati| ṭhātaḥ' ityatra
katham, yadi tāvaddhātorvihitasyākārādanantarasyeti, alunan
apunan atrāpi prāpnoti? atha ākārāntādvātorvehitasyeti,
apibannityatra prāpnoti? astu dhātorvihitasyākārādanantarasyeti,
alunan ityatra lunā jhi iti sthite ṭhśnābhyastayorātaḥ' iti lope
kṛte ākārābhāvānna bhaviṣyati, nātra lopaḥ prāpnoti? ṭhī halyaghoḥ'
itītvena bādhyate| evamapyākārānna bhaviṣyati? nātretvaṃ prāpnoti,
antibhāvena bādhyate? nātrāntibhāvaḥ prāpnoti, jūsbhāvena
bādhanāt? tadevaṃ lopa ītven, ītvamantibhāvena, antibhāvo
jusbhāvena, jusbhāvo lopena, lopa ītveneti lopa
ītveneti cakrakamavyavasthā prāpnoti? naiṣa doṣaḥ;
āyannādiṣūpadeśivadvacanādupadeśakāla eva jhasyāntibhāve kṛte
lopaḥ, lopena vyavasthā| kiṃ cāta ityatra
sijgrahaṇamanuvartate---ākārāntātsijlugantāditi, tena na
kvāpyaniṣṭaprasaṅgaḥ| tadevamādhyāyaparisamāpterdhātvadhikāra iti
sthitam|
vakṣyati tavyatavyānīyara iti| kiṃ ca syāt yadi tavyādividho
dhātoritita nānuvarteta ṅyāpprātipadikādapi tavyādyaḥ syuḥ?
sādhane tavyādayo vidhīyante, sādhanaṃ ca kriyāyāḥ| kriyāyā
abhāvātsādhanābhāvaḥ, sādhanābhāvād ṅyāpprātipadikātavyādayo
na bhaviṣyanti| kathaṃ tarhi karmādiṣu vidhīyamānā dvitīyādayo
bhavanti, naiva prātipadikārthasya sādhane dvitīyādayaḥ, kiṃ tarhi?
śabdāntaravācyakriyāpekṣe tasyaiva karmādibhāve; tavyādayastu
prakṛtivācyakriyāpekṣe sādhane caritārthā na
ṅyāpprātipadikādbhaviṣyanti? idaṃ tarhi
prayojanam----satyāṇavayetyādayo ye'pabhraṃśāḥ
kriyāvacanāstebhyastavyādayo mā bhūnniti; na hi te dhātavaḥ,
bhūvādipāṭhāśrayatvāddhātusaṃjñāyāḥ| kiñca, sopasargāllaṅadayo mā
bhūvanniti dhātvadhikāraḥ kriyate; anyathā prākarota, prāsthita,
adhyaiṣṭeti dhātūpasargasamudāyasya viśiṣṭakriyāvacanatvātataḥ
pratyayavidhāvaṅgasaṃjñāyāmaḍādiprasaṅgaḥ|
codayati----dhātugrahaṇamanarthakam, yaṅvidhau dhātvadhikārāditi|
ṭhdhātorekācaḥ' ityatra yaṅvidhau dhātvadhikārāditi
ṭhdhātorekācaḥ' ityatra yaṅvidhau yaddhātugrahaṇaṃ
tasyehādhikārādityarthaḥ| parihārati-----kṛdupapadasaṃjñārtha
tviti| etadeva vyācaṣṭe----asminniti| asminnevetyavadhāraṇaṃ
draṣṭavyam| taddarśayati---pūrvatra mā bhūtāmiti| asatyasminnadhikāre
dhātvadhikāre yatsaptamyā nirddiṣṭṃa tadupapadamityetāvānarthaḥ
syāt, tataśca pūrvatrāpi syāt-----ṭhcli luṅ' luṅnti upapade
cliriti| evaṃ kṛtsaṃjñāpi dhātorvihitasyātiṅe bhavatīti
pūrvatrāpi syāt, tataśca kariṣyatītyatra syapratyayasya kṛtsaṃjñāyāṃ
kṛdantaṃ prātipadikamiti prātipadikatve sati tiṅekte'pyekatve
vacanagrahaṇādekavacanasya cotsargatvātsorutpattiḥ prasajyeta|
tasmādasmindhātvadhikāre yathā syātāṃ pūrvatra mā bhūtāmiti
punarddhātvadhikāraḥ kriyate|
nanu cādhikāreṇa te saṃjñe vidhāsyete, pratyayasaṃjñā ca tatra, te
pūrvatra bhaviṣyata ityāśaṃkya prayojanāntaramāha----ārddhadhātukasaṃjñārthe
ceti| kaḥ punarārddhadhātukasaṃjñāyāṃ dvitīyadhātugrahaṇasyopayoga
ityata āha----dhātorityevaṃ vihitasyeti| lūbhiriti| atra satyapi
prātipadikatve dhātutvamapyasti; pūrvapravṛtāyā dhātusaṃjñāyā
anivartanāt| tataśca dhātorevāyaṃ vihita iti ārdhadhātukasaṃjñā
syādeva| yadi tu śamidhātorityatra dhātugrahaṇasya
dvitīyasyārddhadhātukasaṃjñārthaṃ svaritatvaṃ pratijñāyeta, ayamapyadhikāraḥ
śakyo'kartum| vāsarūpavidhirapyadhikāreṇa siddhaḥ, tena ksādibhiḥ
sicaḥ samāveśo na bhaviṣyati||
tatropapadaṃ saptamīstham|| 3|1|92 ||
tatropapadaṃ saptamīstham|| ṭhsaptamostham' ityasyārthamāha--saptamyā
nirdiṣṭamiti| saptamyā vibhaktyoccāritamityarthaḥ| saptamyantena
padena pripāditamiti vā| asminpakṣe sūtre saptamośabdena
saptamyantamucyate| saptamyantepade karmaṇītyādau pratipādyatvena
sthitaṃ kumbhādikamityarthaḥ| prathame tu pakṣe kamaṇītyāderyaḥ saptamyā
nirdeśaḥ, sa eva kumbhamityāderapi prayogagatasya saptamyā nirdeśaḥ,
yathā----ṭhtasyāpatyam' ityādau tasyeti sāmānyaṃ
viśeṣāpalakṣaṇārthamiti tadoyameva prāthamyaṃ viśeṣāṇāmapi bhavati,
tadvadatrapi| kumbhakāra iti atropapadatvātsamāsaḥ,
kṛdutarapadaprakṛtisvaratvaṃ ca bhavati|
sthagrahaṇamityādi| sūtreṣu yaḥ saptamyā vibhaktyā nirdeśa uccāraṇaṃ
saptamyantena vā padena pratipādanaṃ tadeva saṃjñāṅgamiti
pratipatyarthamityarthaḥ| nanu saptamīśabdena sāhacaryātsūtrādiṣu
saptamyā nirdiṣṭṃa grahīṣyate, nārtha etadarthena grahaṇena?
tatrāha----anyathā hīti| mukhyārthasambhave gauṇasyāgrahaṇāt saptamyā
eva saṃjñāsyāt; saṃjñāvidhau pratyayagrahaṇe tadantavidhipratiṣedhāt| na
cāsatassaṃjñinaḥ saṃjñāśakyā vidhātumiti yatra saptamī śrūyate tatraiva
syādityarthaḥ| stamberama iti| ṭhstambakarṇayoramijapoḥ' ityac,
ṭhtatpuruṣe kṛti bahulam' ityaluk| yatra veti| yatra sūtre
saptamīśrutiḥ, saptamīśabdasya śravaṇamityarthaḥ| aśabdasaṃjñeti
svarūpagrahaṇapratiṣedhādabhyupagamyavādo'yam, sarvatheṣṭṃa sidhyatītyatra
tātparyam| sthagrahaṇātviti| sthagrahaṇe sati sautrasaptamyupalakṣitasya
saṃjñāvidhānātsarvatra sidhyatītyarthaḥ|
nanu ca laghvartha saṃjñākaraṇam, tatkimartha gurvī saṃjñā kriyata ityata
āha----gurusaṃjñākaraṇamiti| ṭhupoccāritaṃ
padamupapadam'---ityevamarthānugatā saṃjñā anvarthasaṃjñā|
samarthaparibhāṣāvyāpārārthamiti| iha yadā
svārthadravyaliṅgātmakastrikaḥ| prātipadikārtaḥ, tadā nāntareṇa
vibhakriṃ karmādhikaraṇādyaupapadamupapadyata ityavaśyamutpādyā vibhaktiriti
padavidhitvādeva siddhaḥ paribhāṣāvyāpāraḥ, pañcakapakṣe'pi tu
prātipadikasyaiva karmādyabhidhāyitvena
padavidhitvābhāvātparibhāṣāvyāpāro na syādityanvarthayā saṃjñayā
balātpravartyate? naitadasti; pañcakapakṣe'pi vibhakyutpatyā padatve
satyeva pratyaya iti pratipādanāt| nanu ṭhgatikārakopapadānāṃ
kṛdbhiḥ saha samāsavacanaṃ prāk subutpateḥ' iti
vacanātkathamupapadasya mubantatvam----sāmi smartā bhavān?
ṭhupapadamadiṅ' ityatra hi supeti tṛtīyāntameva nivṛtam, subiti
prathamāntamanuvartata ityavocāma, kathamaparathā carmakārādau
nalopādi syāt! paśya kumbhaṃ karoti kaṭamiti| dhātoriti
vartate, karmādiśabdāśca sambandhiśabdāḥ, tata evaṃ vijñāsyāmaḥ----yasya
dhātoryatkarmeti| evamapi mahāntaṃ kumbhaṃ karotītyatra prāpnoti? na
vā bhavati; dhātoryatkarmeti| evamapi mahāntaṃ kumbhaṃ karotītyatra
prāpnoti? na vā bhavati; mahākumbhakāra iti bhavati,
yadetadvākyam----mahān kumbho mahākusbhaḥ mahākumbhaṃ karotīti|
yadā tvetadvākyam-----mahāntaṃ kumbhaṃ karotīti, tadā neṣyate| kiṃ
ca syād yadyatra syāt? kumbhaśabdasya kāraśabdena samāse kṛte tadartha
ekārthībhāvāt mahaccabdena samāso na syād, anvarthatvādeva
saṃjñāyāḥ saptamīnirdiṣṭatve'pi prakṛtyarthaviśeṇātadviśeṣaṇānāṃ ca
upoccāritapadatvābhāvādupapadasaṃjñā na bhavati|
atha tatra---grahaṇaṃ kimartham? dhātvadhikāraḥ
pratinirdiśyate------tatraitasmiṃstṛtīye dhātvadhikāra iti| naitadasti
prayojanam, adhikārādapyetatsiddham? idaṃ tarhi
prayojanam---saptamīsthasya pratyayotpatiṃ prati nimitatvaṃ yathā
syāditi, katham? pratyaya iti vartate---saptamīsthamupapadasaṃjñaṃ
bhavati, tatra copapade satyeva pratyaya iti| atha karmaṇītyādikā
satsaptamī, tatkuto'satyupapade pratyayaprasaṅgaḥ? na; karmaṇītyādikā
sautrī spatamyarthāpekṣā, tathā hi satyaṇpratyayasyābhidheyaṃ karma
syāt----yathā---ṭhdhaḥ karmaṇi ṣṭran' iti, tathā copapadatvaṃ na
pratīyeta, ato yathetsaṃjñārthamanunāsikatvaṃ pratijñāyate
tathārthanirapekṣā kevalamupapadasaṃjñāyā liṅgaṃ saptamī, tathā na
chātoraṇ bhavati karma copapadamityetāvānarthaḥ syāt| karmaṇaḥ
pratyayotpatiṃ prati nimitatvaṃ na pratīyeta, tasmātadarthaṃ
tatra---grahaṇam, kimidānīṃ heya evāyaṃ granthastatraitasmindhātvadhikāra
iti? na brūmo heya iti, sopaskārastu
bhavati---eta---smindhātvadhikāre yatsaptamyā nirdiṣṭṃa tadupapadasaṃjñaṃ
bhavati, tatra ca sati pratyaya iti||
kṛdatiṅ|| 3|1|93 ||
kṛdatiṅ|| tiṅvarjita iti| tiṅtvena tyaktastiṅtvena rahitaḥ,
tiṅe'nya iti yāvat|
atiṅiti kimiti| iha kriyamāṇo'pyayaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ svāśrayāmeva tiṅḥ
kṛtsañjñaṃ bādhītuṃ prabhavati, na tu lakārasya
kṛtvātsthānivadbhāvena prāptām; ṭhanantarasya vidhirvā bhavati
pratiṣedho vā' iti vacanāditi matvā praśnaḥ| tiṅbhāvino
lakārasyaiva kṛtasañjñā pratiṣiddhyate, pratiṣedhasāmarthyādvā
sthānivadbhāvo na bhaviṣyatītyutaram| cīyātstūyāditi| nanu ca
jñāpakādetatsiddham, yadayam ṭhakṛtsārvadhātukayoḥ' iti pṛthak
sārvadhātuke pratiṣedhaṃ śāsti, tad jñāpayati----akṛditi
pratiṣedho na tiṅkṣu bhavatīti| yadi syāt; cinuyāt,
sunuyādityādau sārvadhātuke'pi kṛtpratiṣedhādeva dīrdho na
bhaviṣyati, kiṃ pṛthak sārvadhātukaparyudāsena! iha tarhi pacati,
paṭhati----ṭhhrasvasya piti kṛti tuk' iti tuṅ mā bhūditi?
tugvidhau dhātvāderityato dhātugrahaṇamanuvartiṣyate|
evamapi---cikīrṣati, jihīrṣatītyatra prāpnoti? śapā vyavadhānānna
bhaviṣyati| ekādeśe kṛte nāsti vyavadhānam? ṭhekādeśaḥ pūrvavidhau
sthānivadbhavati' iti vyavadhānameva| nātra sthānivadbhāvaḥ
prāpnoti; paratvādantavadbhāvena bāddhyate|
tasmāccikīrṣatītyādau tuṅmā bhūdityatiṅiti pratiṣedhaḥ
karttavyaḥ| kiñca, tiṅntasya kṛdantaṃ prātipadikamiti
prātipadikasaṃjñāyāṃ paceran---nalopaḥ prāpnoti, papāca
brāhmaṇī-----ṭāpprāpnoti, sarvatra ca svadyautpatiḥ prasajyeta,
tadetadasmādanyārthādatiṅiti pratiṣedhādeva siddhe cīyādityādau
jñāpakaṃ nāśrayitavyamiti vṛttikāro manyate sma||
vā'sarūpo'striyām|| 3|1|94 ||
vā'sarūpo'striyām|| ṭhasarūpaḥ' iti padacchedaḥ, anyathā lādhave
viśeṣābhāvalādasandehartha ṭhsarūpo'striyāṃ vā' iti brūyāt|
apavādaviṣaye'pi keṣāñcitkṛtāṃ pravṛttiryathā syādityevamarthamidaṃ
vacanam| yathoktam-----asarūpasya vāvacanamutsargasya bādhakaviṣaye
nivṛtyarthamiti| paribhāṣā ceyam, asmindhātvadhikāre
stryadhikāravyatirekeṇa yānyasarūpasyāpavādasya vidhāyakāni śāstrāṇi
taccheṣabhūtā, tatra tatra vacane kriyamāṇe gauravaṃ syāditi
sādhāraṇarūpeṇa paribhāṣyate| tatra ca ṭhasarūpaḥ' iti vyartha kṛṇmātrasya
vikalpane sarvasyaivāsarūpatvādyatkiñcitkṛdapekṣayā; asarūpapadaṃ
caitatsāpekṣaṃ pratiyogini yato'tra bhinnarūpatvamasarūpatvamityate|
kenaciddhi kiñcitsarūpamasarūpaṃ vā bhavati, tatra kenāsarūpa
ityapekṣāyāṃ svavidhānavelāyāṃ yaḥ svasminviṣaye prāptaḥ sa eva
buddhisthaḥ pratiyogī gamyate, apavādavidhānasamaye cotsargaḥ, tamapi
viṣayamavāgāṛḍhuamuḍhaukamāna upārūḍho buddhau bhavatīti tadapekṣayā
bhinnarūpo'pavāda evātrāsarūpo vivakṣita
ityāha---asarūpo'pavādapratyaya iti| evaṃ sthite
yadyayamutpattivikalpassyād, apavādapratyayo vā bhavatīti, tataḥ
svaviṣaye kāmaṃ vikalpastasya labhyate, na tūtsargaḥ pravarteta|
tatrātadviṣayo hyasau, utsargāpavādaśāstrayorhi pramitivyāpāre
paryavasite paścādiyamatraiva pradeśesthitā'pavādasya pakṣe pravṝti
pratibadhnāti| apavādaśāstreṇa yaḥ svīkṛto
viṣayastadvyatiriktaviṣayā sāmānyaśāstrasya
pramitirityapavādasyāpravṛtāvapi naivotsargasya tasminviṣaye
pramitiḥ pravṛttirvopapadyate, taddhitavat; tadyathā----dakṣasyāpatyam ata
iñi vikalpite pakṣe'ṇ na bhavati, api tu vākyameva bhavati, tatkasya
hetoḥ? ṭhsamarthānāṃ prathamādvā' iti taṭasthena pakṣe
pravṛttirniruddhyate, na punarekavākyatayā prāptireva
vikalparūṣiteti, tathehāpīti| apavādābhāvapakṣe prakṛtireva
kartrādyabhidhānāyānujñātā syād, yathāgnicidityādau
kvibādilope, tadāha---tatrotpatirvā prasaṅgo yathā taddhita iti|
tamimamutpattivikalpapakṣe doṣaṃ ddaṣṭvā bādhakatvaṃ vikalpyata
ityāha---vābādhako bhavatīti| uktaṃ ca ṭhsiddhaṃ tvasarūpabādhakasya
vāvacanāt' iti, asarūpo vā bādhako bhavatīti vaktavyamityarthaḥ|
nanu tatratatrocyate---yatrānyatkriyāpadaṃ na śrūyate tatrāstirbhavatipara
iti, tataścāsarūpo vetyukte bhavatītyevādhyāhāro yuktaḥ, na
punarvā bādhaka iti? ucyate---utpattivikalpasya prayojanaṃ kevalāyāḥ
prakṛteḥ prayogaḥ, kevalā ca prakṛtiḥ svārthamātramabhidhātumasamarthā,
kiṃ punaḥ kartrādikamabhidhāsyati! prakṛtipratyayasamudāye hi
prayujyamāne'nvayavyatirekābhyāmayaṃ prakṛtyarthaḥ, ayaṃ pratyayārtha iti
vyavasthāpyate; anutpannapratyayā tu prakṛtirna kañcidapyartha gamayati|
prayogo'pi hi tasyā durlabhaḥ; paraśceti niyamāt| taddhite
tvanutpattipakṣe'pyutsargapravṛttivyatirekeṇa pratyayāntaramasti ṣaṣṭhī,
iha tu na tatheti sāmarthyādvahiraṅgamapi bādhakatvamapi kalpyate|
nanu caca śāstraṃ śāstreṇa bāddhyate, na punaḥ kārya kāryeṇa,
nidānocchedenaiva hi nidānina ucchedaḥ śakyate kartum, na hi
pradīpe'nucchinne tatprakāśa ucchidyate, tatkimucyate---apavādapratyaya
iti, evaṃ tu vaktavyam----apavādaśāstramiti?
ucyate----sarvasyaivāpavādaśāstrasya svagatamasārūpyamavyabhicārīti
pratyayadvārakaṃ tadāśrayaṇīyamityapavādapratyaya ityuktam| evambhūtasya
pratyayasya vidhāyakaṃ śāstramityarthaḥ|
yadvā----pratyayasya bādhakatvavikalpasāmārthyācchāstramapi pakṣe bādhakaṃ
bhaviṣyati| 
atha vā vṛtau vastumātraṃ darśitam; yathā tvayamartha upapadyate tathā
sūtraṃ vyākhyeyam| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam---paribhāṣeyamityuktam,
tatrekparibhāṣāvadiyamapi padamupasthāpayati----asmindhātvadhikāre
yatrāsarūpo'pavādapratyayo vidhīyate tatra vetyupatiṣṭhate,
stryadhikāre tu neti| kiṃ kṛtaṃ bhavati? ṭhdadātidadhātyorvibhāṣā'
ityādivat pramitireva vikalparūṣitā bhavati, tatastadvadevotsargasya
pravṛttisidviriti| atha ṭhasarūpa utsargapratyayo'pavādaviṣaye vā
bhavati' iti vijñāyamāne ko doṣaḥ? na khalu kaściddoṣaḥ;
apavādavikalpe prāpte vibhāṣā, utsargavikalpe tvaprāptavibhāṣeti,
kintu pratiyogyapekṣamasarūpapadamapyapavādameva gocarayatītyuktam|
ṭhastriyām' ityatra pakṣatrayaṃ sambhavati---abhidheyasaptamī vā
syāt---striyāmabhidheyāyāṃ vāsarūpo na bhavatīti, striyāmityeva
vā vihitasyāsarūpasya niṣedhaḥ syāt---striyāmityuccārya ye
vidhīyante te neti, strīgrahaṇaṃ vā svaryate
svaritenādhikārāvagatirbhavatīti---striyāṃ ktaninnityasminnadhikāre
neti| tatrādye pakṣe vikṣipā, vikṣopikā, vikṣepteti kaviṣaye
ṇvultṛcau na syātām| dvitīye tu ṭhkarmavyatihāre ṇac
striyām' vyāvakrośī, vyāvakruṣṭiriti ṇayo viṣaye ktin na
syāt, dvayorapi striyāmityuccārya vidhānāditi, mamādyayoḥ
pakṣayordoṣaṃ ddaṣṭvā tṛtīyaṃ
pakṣamāśrityāha----stryadhikāravihitapratyayaṃ varjayitveti|
kecidāhuḥ----apavādapratyayaṃ varjiyitveti vaktavye pratyayaṃ
varjayitveti vacanaṃ pratyayamātraparigrahārtham,
tenotsargāpavādayordvayorapi stryadhikāraniveśinorayaṃ
pratipedhaḥ| kiṃ siddhaṃ bhavati? āsanā,
āsyā-----stryadhikāravihitenāpi yucāpavādena ṛhalorṇyataḥ samā
veśaḥ siddho bhavati| ghañastu ktinnādibhiranabhidhānādasamāveśa iti|
anye tu----apavādo vā bādhako bhavatīti prakṛtatvātsa evātra pratyaya
iti vyācakṣate, tena ghañaḥ ktinnādibhirasamāveśaḥ| āsyetyatra
kṛtyalyuṭo bahulamiti ṇyaditi| ṇvultṛcāvutsargāviti|
cāvutsargāviti| dhātumātre vidhānāt| igupaghajñāprīkiraḥ ka
ityapavāda iti| dhātuviśeṣe vidhānāt| kiṃ punaḥ
prayogagatamasārūpyam? āhośvidupadeśagatam? kiṃ cātaḥ? prayoge
lādeśeṣu pratiṣedhaḥ----hyae'pacadityatra luṅapi prāpnoti, prayoge
hyasarūpatvāt, laṅyanackastakāraḥ pratyayaḥ luṅ ipākṣīditīcchabdaḥ; śvaḥ
kartetyatra lṛḍapi prāpnoti? jñāpakātsiddham, yadayam ṭhhaśaśvatorlaṅ
ca' iti liḍviṣaye laṇṃó śāsti, taj jñāpayati----na lādeśeṣu
vāsarūpavidhiriti| evamapi grāmaṇīḥ, grāmanāya iti
kvibādiviṣaye'ṇādayo na syuḥ, na hi kvibādayaḥ prayoge
rūpavantaḥ, lopavidhānāteṣām| tasmādupadeśagatamasārūpyam|
yadyevam, anubandhabhinneṣu vibhāṣāprasaṅgaḥ, kāṇorapi hyupadeśe
bhinnaṃ rūpam, prayoge tu samānam, tatrāha---nānubandhakṛtamiti|
anubandhānāmanekāntatvātatkṛtamasārūpyaṃ nāśrīyate, tathā ca ṭhudīyāṃ
māṅḥ' iti śrūyamāṇe'pi ṅkāre
tasyānekāntatvādavyāhatamejantatvamityātvaṃ prayuktam|
ṭhdadātidadhātyorvibhāṣā' iti vibhāṣāgrahaṇaṃ ca liṅgamasyārthasya;
anyathā'nubandhakṛtādasārūpyādeva śaviṣaye ṇo bhaviṣyatīti kiṃ
tena!
iha ktalyuṭtumunkhalartheṣu vāsarūpavadhiḥ prāpnoti| hasitaṃ chātrasya
śobhanaṃ hasanaṃ chātrasya, atra ktalyuḍaviṣaye ghañapi prāpnoti|
tumuna----icchati bhoktum, atra ṭhicchārtheṣu liṅloṭau' iti loṭ
prāpnoti, tumunā ca bādha iṣyate, liṅ tu ṭhliṅ ca' iti
vacanādbhavātyeva| yadyevam, asmādeva niyamālloḍapi na bhaviṣyati|
kalartha----āto yuc' īṣatpānaḥ, atra khalapi prāpnoti| nanu
stryadhikāre tāvadastriyāmiti pratiṣedhādasyāpravṛttiḥ parastādapi
vicchinnatvādeva na bhaviṣyati? syādetadevam, yadyayamadhikāraḥ syāt,
paribhāṣā tveṣetyuktam| iṣyate ca stryadhikārādūrdhvamapi
vāsarūpavidhiḥ-----āsitvā bhuṅkte,āsyate bhoktumityapi yathā
syād; anyathā bhojanārthatvādāsanasya paurvakālyamavagamyate
tumarthādhikārādbhāve ktvāpratyayastatraiva ca lakāra iti
samānaviṣayatvādvādhyabādhakabhāvaḥ syāt| tathā kālo bhoktum,
kālo bhojanasya---mumunā lyuṭo bādhaḥ syāt| tasmāt
stryadhikārasya parastādapi vāsarūpavidhireṣitavyaḥ, ṭharhe
kṛtyatṛcaśca' ityatra kṛtyatṛjgrahaṇaṃ jñāpakam---stryadhikārasya
parastādanityaiṣā paribhāṣeti| tasmāt ktalyuṭtumunkhalartheṣu
pratiṣedho|vaktavya eva||
kṛtyāḥ prāṅ ṇvulaḥ|| 3|1|95 ||
kṛtyāḥ prāṅ ṇvulaḥ|| ṇvulatṛcāviti vakṣyatīti| ṭhrogākhyāyāṃ
ṇvul bahulam' mityayaṃ tvavadhirna bhavati; ṭharhe kṛtyatṛcaśca' iti
pṛthak tṛco grahaṇāt| yadyevam, ṭhprāṅ ṇvulaḥ' iti na vaktavyam,
ṭhkṛtyāḥ' ityevāstu, tṛjgrahaṇādeva jñāpakātparato'nuvṛttirna
bhaviṣyati, yogāpekṣaṃ ca jñāpakam ṭhṇvultṛcau'
ityasmādyogātprāk kṛtyasañjñādhikāra iti? satyam; ṭhkṛtyāḥ'
ityetāvadeva paṭhitaṃ sūtrakāreṇa| vṛttikārastu, bhāṣye
pūrvapakṣarūpeṇa paṭhitaṃ sūtre pracikṣepa| vicitrā hi vṛteḥ
kṛtirvṛttikāreṇa! ṭhkṛtyāḥ' iti bahuvacanamanuktasamuccayārtham,
tena ṭhkelimara upasaṅkhyānam' ityādi nopasaṃkhyeyaṃ bhavati||
tavyatavyānīyaraḥ|| 3|1|96 ||
tavyatavyānīyaraḥ|| vaseriti| ṭhvasa nivāse' ityasya grahaṇam, na tu
ṭhvasa ācchādane' ityasya lugvikaraṇasya| ṭhtayoreva kṛtyaktakhalarthāḥ'
iti vacanātkartari na prāpnotīti vacanam, ṇidvadbhāvārthaṃ ca|
vāstavya iti| tadvitānto vā punareṣabhaviṣyati, vāstuni bhāvo
vāstavyaḥ, digāditvādyat| avāstavya ityatra svarabhedo nāsti,
ṭhkṛtyokeṣṇuc' iti yadantodātatvaṃ tadeva ṭhyayatoścātadarthe'
ityanena bhaviṣyati| kelimara iti| kakāro guṇavṛddhipratiṣedhārthaḥ,
rephassvarārthaḥ| 
karmakartari cāyamiṣyata iti| bhāṣye tu ṭhpacelimā māṣāḥ, paktavyāḥ;
bhidelimāssaralāḥ, bhetavyāḥ' iti śuddhe karmaṇi pradarśitam||
aco yat || 3|1|97 ||
aco yat|| ajgrahaṇaṃ kimiti| pūrvasūtra eva yadgrahaṇaṃ
kartavyamiti praśnaḥ| yāvatetyādi| dvaye hi dhātavaḥ----ajantāḥ,
halantāśca| tatra halantād ṇyataṃ vakṣyati, ataḥ pāriśeṣyādajantādeva
yadbhaviṣyatītyabhiprāyaḥ|
ajantabhūtapūrvādapīti| pūrva bhūto bhūtapūrvaḥ sup supā' iti
samāsaḥ, ajantaścāsau bhūtapūrvaśca ajantabhūtapūrvaḥ| ditsyaṃ
dhitsyamiti| dāño dhāñaśca san, dvirvacanam, ṭhsanimīmāghu'
ityādinā isa, ṭhsaḥ syārddhadhātuke' iti tatvam, ṭhatra lopo'bhyāsamya'
ditsa dhitsa iti sthite, anutpanna evārddhadhātuke buddhisthe evāto
lope kṛte sampratyayaṃ kṛte sampratyayaṃ halanta hi ṇyat syād;
ajgrahaṇātu bhūtapūrvamajantatvamāśritya yadbhavati| tena
ṭhyato'nāvaḥ' ityādyaudātatvam, ṇyati tu titsvaritaṃ syāt|
cikīrṣyamityādau tu ṇyadyatorviśeṣābhāvaḥ| ṭhyato'nāvaḥ' ityatra hi
ṭhdvyacaḥ' iti vartate| yadā tvāddhaṃdhātuke parato lopaḥ,
tadaitadajgrahaṇaṃ na kartavyameva|
takiśasītyādi| ṭhtaki hasane',ṭhśasu hisāyām',ṭhcate cade
yācane',ṭhyatī prayatne',ṭhjanī prādurbhāve',ṭhyato'nāvaḥ' iti svarārtha
janeryadvidhānaṃ janyamiti rūpam, na tu ṇyatāpi siddham;
ṭhjanivadhyośca' iti vṛddhipratiṣedhāt| śasimapi
kecitpaṭhanti-----tadvā nārāśaṃsyaṃ rādvyaṃ ca|
hano vā vadha ceti| hantervā yatpratyayo bhavati, tatsanniyogena ca
vadhādeśaḥ| vadhyamiti| taddhitānto vā punareṣa
bhaviṣyati---vadhamarhatīti vadhyaḥ, ṭhdaṇḍādibhyaḥ' iti yat|yadi
taddhitaḥ, samāso na prāpnoti---asivadhyaḥ, musalavadhya iti, kṛti
punaḥ sati ṭhkṝtṛkaraṇe kṛtā bahulam' iti samāsaḥ siddho bhavati|
ghātyamiti| ṭhhanastociṇṇaloḥ' iti tatvam, ṭhho
hanterñṇinneṣu' iti kutvam||
poradupadhāt || 3|1|98 ||
poradupadhāt|| pākyaṃ vākyamiti| ṭhcajoḥ ku ghiṇṇyatoḥ' iti
kutvam| kopyaṃ gopyamiti| ṭhkupa kopane', ṭhgupa vyākulatve'|
āpyamiti| ṭhāplṛ vyāpto' eṣu triṣu ṭhyato'nāvaḥ' ityādyaudātatvaṃ
na bhavati, titsvarita eva tu bhavati||
śakisahośca|| 3|1|99 ||
śakisahośca|| śaklṛ śaktāviti| upalakṣaṇametat, ṭhśaka vibhāṣito
marṣaṇe' ityasyāpi grahaṇam| ṣaha marṣaṇa iti| nanu ṭhṣaha śakyarthe'
ityasyaiva parasmaipadino'nanubandhakasya grahaṇaṃ prāptam, naiṣa doṣaḥ;
pratyayavidhiviṣayatvādananubandhakaparibhāṣāyāḥ, tasmād dvayorapi
grahaṇam| anye tu ṭhkṛtyalyuṭo bahulam' iti vṛttikāroktayoreva
grahaṇamicchanti||
gadamadacarayamaścānupasarge|| 3|1|100 ||
gadamadacarayamaścānupasarge|| anupasargemya iti| sūtre ṭhanupasarge' iti
vyatyayena pañcamyarthe saptamīti bhāvaḥ| ata
evopasargādanyo'nupasargastasminnanupasarge upapada ityartho na bhavati|
evaṃ hi kevalebhyo na syāt, ṭhvadaḥ supi kyap ca' ityatra
subgrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt? ṭhanupasarge' iti hi vartate tatra
nañivayuktanyāyeyenopasargasaddaśasya subantasya grahaṇaṃ bhaviṣyati|
niyamārthamiti| anupasargādeva yathā syātsopasargānmā bhūditi|
kathaṃ tarhi tena na tatra bhavedviniyamyamiti? pramādapāṭho'yam,
viniyāmyamiti pāṭhaḥ| etena ṭhiti yatnopacaryam' iti vyākhyātam|
carerāṅ cāgurāiviti| sopasargārtha vacanam| ācayā deśa iti
gantavya ityarthaḥ| upanetāuguruḥ||
avadyapaṇyavaryā garhyapaṇitavyānirodheṣu|| 3|1|101 ||
avadyapaṇyavaryā gahyapaṇitavyānirodheṣu|| avadyamiti| nipātyata iti|
vadernañyupapade ṭhvadaḥ supi kyap ca' iti yatkapoḥ
prāptayoryadeva yathā syād----garhya eva ca yathā syādityubhayārtha
nipātanam| avadyaṃ pāpamiti| avadanārhatvāt| anudyamanyaditi|
gurunāmādi| taddhi garhyaṃ na bhavatyatha ca vadanārhamapi na bhavati| atra
kyabeva bhavati, yajāditvātsamprasāraṇam, ṭhnalopo
nañaḥ',ṭhtasmānnuḍaci'| paṇyaṃ vyavahartavyamiti| nipātanasya
rūḍha|lrthatvāt paṇyaśabdasya ca tatraiva rūḍhatvāt| uktaṃ ca-----
dhātusādhanakālānāṃ prāptyartha niyamasya ca|
anubandhavikārāṇāṃ rūḍha|lrthaṃ ca nipātanam|| iti|
pāṇyamanyaditi| stutyamityarthaḥ| varyeti striyāṃ nipātyata iti|
sūtre'vadyādīni avibhaktikāni pṛthak padāni, na tu dvandvasya
jasantanirdeśa iti bhāvaḥ| śatena varyeti| ṭhvṛṅ sambhaktau' ityasyedaṃ
nipātanam; tatraivānirodhasambhavāt| vṛtyānyeti| ṭhvṛñ varaṇe'
ṭhetistuśāsvṛ' ityādinā kyap| vāryā ṛtvija iti| ṭhetistuśāsvṛ'
ityatra vṛño grahaṇam, vṛṅstu strīliṅgādanyatra ṛhalorṇyadeva
bhavati| bhaṭṭikāvye tu puÄlliṅge'pi yadeva prayuktaḥ----ṭhsugrīvo
nāma varyo'sau bhavatā cāruvikramaḥ' iti||
vahyaṃ karaṇam|| 3|1|102 ||
vahyaṃ karaṇam|| vaherddhātoḥ karaṇe yatpratyayo nipātyata iti|
arthavyākhyānametat| ṭhvahyamiti nipātyate karaṇaṃ cedbhavati' iti
vaktuaṃ yuktam||
aryaḥ svāmivaiśyayoḥ|| 3|1|103 ||
aryaḥ svāmivaiśyayoḥ|| svaminyantodātatvañceti| atha yo vaiśyaḥ
svāmī ca, tatra katham? ucyate-----vaiśyākhyāyāmādyaudātatvam,
svāmyākhyāyāmantodātatvam| tathā ca ṭharyasya svāmyākhyāyām' iti
phiṭsūtre ākhyāgrahaṇaṃ kṛtam| āryo brāhmaṇa iti| prāptavya ityarthaḥ||
upasaryā kālyā prajane|| 3|1|104 ||
upasaryā kālyā prajane|| upapūrvātsarteriti| bhauvādikasya
jauhotyādikasya ca ṭhsartiśāstyartibhyaśca' iti nirdeśātsūtrādvahirapi
lukā nirddeśaḥ| prāptakālā kālyeti| ṭhtadasya prāptam' iti
vartamāne ṭhkālādyat' iti yat| prajananamuprajanaḥ, bhāve ghañ,
ṭhjanivadhyośca' iti vṛddhipratiṣedhaḥ| upasaryā gauriti| garbhādhānārtha
vṛṣabheṇopagantuṃ yogyetyarthaḥ, vṛṣabhopagamanasya prāptakāleti
yāvat| upasāryeti| upasaraṇīyā, prāptavyetyarthaḥ||
ajarya saṅgatam|| 3|1|105 ||
ajarya saṅgatam|| saṅgamane kartarīti| sūtre ṭhsaṅgatam' iti
ṭhnapuṃsake bhāve ktaḥ|' iti darśayati| kartarīti ṭhtayoreva
kṛtyaktakhalarthāḥ' iti bhāve bhā bhūditi nipātanāśrayaṇam| tena bhāve
saṅgatakartṛke'pi ṇyadeva bhavati----ajārya saṅgateneti|
ajariteti| tṛc||
vadaḥ supi kyap ca|| 3|1|106 ||
vadaḥ supi kyap ca|| anupasarge iti vartata iti| ṭhsatsūdviṣa' ityādau
sūtre vakṣyati----upasargagrahaṇaṃ jñāpakamanyatra subgrahaṇe upasargagrahaṇaṃ
na bhavatīti| taccāvaśyaṃ tathaivāśrayaṇīyam----ṭhsupyajātau'
ṭhspṛśo'nudake kvin' ityādāvupasargagrahaṇaṃ mā bhūditi, tataśca
nārtha ihānupasargagrahaṇānuvṛtyā| subante upapade anupasarga iti|
yadyapi pūrva bahuvrīheḥ pañcamyarthe saptamīti vyākhyātam, iha tu
virodhābhāvātatpuruṣātsvārtha eva saptamīti bhāvaḥ| brahmāedyamiti|
bhāve kyap, pūrvavatsaṃprasāraṇam| brahmavedaḥ, tasya vadanamityarthaḥ|
kathaṃ punaḥ sakarmakādbhāve kṛtyapratyayaḥ yāvatā bhāve cākarmakebhyaḥ
ṭhtayoreva kṛtyaktakhalarthāḥ' iti vakṣyati; na ca
karmāvivakṣayā'karmakatvam; brahmaeti karmaṇaḥ śrutatvāt?
tasmādutarasūtrādiha bhāvagrahaṇamapekṣaṇīyamityāhuḥ||
bhuvo bhāve|| 3|1|107 ||
bhuvo bhāve|| yatu nānuvartata iti pūrvasūtre cānukṛṣṭatvāt|
nanu ṭhtayoreva kṛtyaktakhalarthāḥ' iti bhāvakarmaṇoḥ kṛtyā
vidhīyante, ṭhanupasarge' iti cānuvartate, anupasargaśca
bhavatirakarmaka eva, ataḥ sāmarthyādbhāva eva bhaviṣyati? nanu ca
prāptyarthaḥ sakarmaka eva? satyam; vyaktinirddeśāt, prāthamyācca
satārthasyaiva grahaṇam| na caca kālādikarmaṇi prasaṅgaḥ anabhidhānāt,
tatkimartha bhāvagrahaṇam? ityatrāha---bhāvagrahaṇamutarārthamiti| ṭhhanasta
ca' iti sakarmakādapi hano bhāve yathā syād---brāhmahatyā vartata iti,
karmaṇi mā bhūt----tvayā ghātyo vṛṣala iti||
hanasta ca|| 3|1|108 ||
hanasta ca|| brahāmahatyeti| svabhāvataḥ strīliṅgatvamasya kyabantasya,
yathānyeṣāṃ bhāve kṛtyānāṃ napuṃsakatvam| cchandasi tu kyabantasyāpi
napuṃsakatvamiṣyate----sanādeva dasyuhatyāya jajñiṣe| cchandisa ca
striyāṃ cidvaktavyaḥ----asyai brahmahatyāyai tṛtīyaṃ parigṛhāṇeti|
praghāto vartata iti| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ ghañ pratyudāhriyate, na
ṇyadityata āha----ṇyatu bhāve na bhavatīti| karmāvivakṣāyāmakarmakatve
satyapīti bhāvaḥ| sakarmakātu bhāve ṇyataḥ prāptireva nāsti||
etistuśāsvṛddajuṣaḥ kyap|| 3|1|109 ||
etistuśāsvṛddajuṣaḥ kyap|| ṭheti' iti tipā nirddeśaḥ kimarthaḥ?
dhātograṃhaṇaṃ yathā syādivarṇāntasya mā bhūditi| atra ceṇa eva
grahaṇam, neṅkoḥ, tiyoradhipūrvayoreva prayogādetīti
nirdeśānupapateḥ| tathā ca----ṭhrakṣārtha vedānāmadhyeyaṃ vyākaraṇam'
iti bhāṣye yadeva prayuktaḥ| kecitu ṭhiṇvadika iti vaktavyam' iti
vacanādadhītyā mātetyapyudāharanti| stutya iti| hrasvasya tuk| śiṣya
iti| ṭhśāsa idaṅhaloḥ' itītvam, ṭhśāsivasighasīnāṃ ca' iti
ṣatvam, ṭhāṅḥ śāsu icchāyām' ityasyāpi grahaṇamaviśeṣāt|
tenāśāsyamiti dhātusvareṇa madhyodātaṃ padaṃ bhavati| ṇyati tu
ṭhgatikārakopapadātkṛt' iti antasvaritatvaṃ syāt| kecitu ṭhśāsu
anuśiṣṭau' ityasyaiva grahaṇamicchanti| orāvaśyaka ityādi| iha
stugrahaṇasyāvakāśa āvaśyakāvivakṣāyām----stutya iti;
ṭhorāvaśyake' ityasyāvakāśaḥ----avaśyalāvyamiti; avaśyastutya
ityatrobhayaprasaṅge paratvād ṇyatsyāt, punaḥ kyabgrahaṇātkyabeva
bhavati| vṛgrahaṇe vṛño grahaṇamiṣyate na vṛṅ iti| jñāpakāt,
yadayam ṭhīḍavandavṛśaṃsaduhāṃ ṇyataḥ' iti vāryaśabdasyādyaudātatvaṃ
śāsti, tatra ceḍivandibhyāṃ sāhacaryādātmanepadino vṛṅe
grahaṇam|
śaṃsiduhītyādi| ṭhśaṃsu stutau' ṭhduha prapūraṇe' guhū ṭhsaṃvaraṇe' |
śasyamiti| kyappakṣe upadhālopaḥ| bhāṣye etadupasaṅkhyānaṃ na ddaṣṭam|
āṅpūrvāditi| ṭhañjū vyaktimrakṣaṇakāntigatiṣu'| ājyamiti|
ṭhkṛtyalyuṭo bahulam' iti karaṇe kyap, pūrvadupadhālopaḥ| atha
kasmād ṇyatyevopadhālopo noktaḥ?
kutvaprasaṅgātitsvaraprasaṅgācca| tasmātkyabanta eṣaḥ| yadyevam,
avagrahaḥ prāpnoti---ājyamityā ajyamiti? avagṛhyatām, ko doṣaḥ? na
hi lakṣaṇena padakārā anuvarttyāḥ, kintu padakārairnāma
lakṣaṇamanuvartyam| padavicchedo hi pauruṣeyaḥ, saṃhitaiva tu
nityā| artha cārthaniścayābhāve nāvagṛhṇanti; yathā---- hariva iti,
kiṃ hariśabda ikārānta uta haricchabdastakārānta iti sandehāt|
kathamiti| iṇa evaitadrūpamiti manyamānasya praśnaḥ| eriti| ṭhi gatau'
ityasya||
ṛdupadhāccāklṛpicṛteḥ|| 3|1|110 ||
ṛdupadhāccāklṛpicṛteḥ|| klṛpicṛtī varjayitveti| ṭhklṛpū
sāmarthye' ṭhcṛtī hiṃsāgranthanayoḥ'
kṛperlatvasyāsiddhatvāddakāralṛkārayossavarṇasaṃjñāvidhānācca
ṛdupadhātvam| kṛta saṃśabdane ṇyadeva bhavatīti|
ṭhanityaṇyantāścurādaya' iti ṇijabhāvapakṣa iti bhāvaḥ| idameva ca
taparakaraṇaṃ liṅgam----anityaṇyantāścurādaya iti| ṇijantātu
ṇilope kṛte cākṛte ca ditsyaṃ dhitsyamitivadyadeva bhavati|
pāṇisargyeti| pāṇibhyāṃ sṛjyata ityupapadasamāsaḥ,
pūrvavatkutvam| evaṃ samavasargyetyatrāpi||
ī ca khanaḥ|| 3|1|111 ||
ī ca khanaḥ|| dīrghoccāraṇaṃ kimartham, na ṭhi ca khanaḥ' ityevocyeta,
dīrghasya hrasvasya vā ādguṇe nāsti viśeṣaḥ, hrasvādeśe
ṭhṣatvatukorasiddhaḥ' ityekādeśasyāsiddhatvād dhrasvāśrayastuk
syāditi cet? na; padāntapadādyorekādeśastugvidhāvasiddhaḥ, anyathā
vṛkṣecchatramiti ṅavādguṇasyāsiddhatvād ṭhche ca' iti hrasvāśrayo
nityastuk syādityata āha----dīrghanirddeśa ityādi| etena
hrasvadvayamatra vidhīyate, na dīrgha iti darśayati| pūrva tu
yathāśrutāśrayaṇenoktamīkāraścāntādeśa iti| tatreti| praśleṣe sati|
ye vibhāṣetyātvabādhanārtha iti| anyathā ṭhye vibhāṣā'
ityasyāvakāśaḥ---khāyate, khanyate; asya tvavakāśaḥ----yasminpakṣe ātvaṃ
nāsti; ātvapakṣe ubhayaprasaṅge paratvādantaraṅgatvāccātvaṃ syāt|
etacca ṭhye vibhāṣā' iti viṣayasaptamīpakṣa ucyate| tadā hi yakārādau
buddhistha eva bhavadātvamantaraṅgam, ayaṃ tvikāraḥ kyapā saha
vidhānādvahiraṅgaḥ| parasaptamīpakṣe tvidamevetvamantaraṅgam,
paranimitamanapekṣya vidhānāt||
bhṛño'saṃjñāyām|| 3|1|112 ||
bhṛño'saṃjñāyām|| bhartavyā ityartha iti| etena kriyāśabdatvaṃ
darśayan saṃjñātvamapākaroti| saṃpūrvādvibhāṣeti| asaṃjñāyāmeva
sūtreṇa nityaṃ prasaktasya kyapo'yaṃ vikalpaḥ| prāptavibhāṣetyarthaḥ|
saṃjñāyāmityādi| pratiṣedhasyeti śeṣaḥ| asaṃjñāyāmityasya
pratiṣedhasya bhāryo nāma kṣatriya ityatra puṃsi ddaṣṭatvāccaritārthatvānna
teusūtrakārasya bhāryā śabdaḥ siddhyatītyaparthaḥ| puṃsi caritārthe hi
pratiṣedhe striyāṃ kyapā bhavitavyam| nanu bhāryāśabdo'pi saṃjñā,
abhriyamāṇāpi hi bhāryā bhāryetyucyate, tatkuto'sya kyapaḥ prasaṅgaḥ?
na brūmo'nena kyapā bhavitavyamiti; yastu saṃjñāyāmeva vidhīyate
ṭhsaṃjñāyāṃ samajani' ityādinā, tasyātra prasaṅgaḥ| na ca tasyāpi
pratiṣedhasāmarthyānnivṛttiḥ, puṃsi pratiṣedhasya caritārthathvāditi
codyam| utaramāha---striyāṃ bāvādhikāro'stīti| nanu ṭhsañjñāyāṃ
samajaniṣada' ityatra vakṣyati---ṭhbhāva iti na svaryate pūrvaka
evārthādhikāraḥ' iti, yathā---samajanti tasyāmiti samajyā, niṣadanti
tasyāmiti niṣadyetyādi bhavati, tatkathamidamucyate----striyāṃ
bhāvādhikāro'stīti? nedamapūrva codyam, vṛttikāra eva hi tatra
vakṣyati----kathaṃ taduktaṃ striyām bhāvādhikāro 'stīti| striyāṃ
strīprakaraṇe ṭhsaṃjñāyāṃ samajani' ityādinā kyapi vidhīyamāne
bhāvasyādhikāro'bhidheyabhāvopagamalakṣaṇo vyāpāro'sti;
śabdaśaktasvābhāvyād| bhāvi eva tena kyab bhavati, na karmaṇi, tena
bhāryā prasiddhyatīti karmaṇītyabhiprāyaḥ| ṭhekānubandhakagrahaṇe na
dvyanubandhakasya' iti ṭhbhṛñ bharaṇe' ityasyaiva kyabvidhau grahaṇam, na
ṭhḍubhṛñ dhāraṇapoṣaṇayoḥ' ityasya| atastasmādvā ṭhbhṛñ bharaṇe'
ityasmāddīrghāntādvā bhāryeti prasiddhyatīti parihārāntaramapyatra
sambhavati||
mṛjervibhāṣā|| 3|1|113 ||
mṛjervibhāṣā|| parimārgya iti| ṭhmṛjervṛddhiḥ' pūrvavatkutvabh||
rājasūyasūryamṛṣodyarucyakupyakṛṣṭapacyāvyathyāḥ|| 3|1|114 ||
rājasūyasūryamṛṣodyarucyakupyakṛṣṭapacyāvyathyāḥ|| rājñā sotavya
iti| abhiṣiktaḥ kṣatriyo rājā, tena sotavyo'bhiṣavadvāreṇa
niṣpādayitavya ityarthaḥ, karmaṇi kyab dīrghatvaṃ ca nipātyate| rājā
vā iha sūyata iti| atra pakṣe latātmakaḥ somo rājā, rājānaṃ
krīṇantītyādau darśanāt| sunotiratrāpyabhiṣave| adhikaraṇe
kyabnipātanaṃ rūḍha|lrtham, tena jyotiṣṭomādau na bhavati|
pūrvasminnapi pakṣe'śvamedhādāvatiprasaṅgaḥ| sūsatibhyāmiti| nanu
ṭhsarterutvaṃ suvatervā ruḍāgamaḥ' ityabhidhānādvikalpo'trābhipreta iti
cārthābhāvād dvandvānupapatiḥ? bhāṣyakāraprayogātu dvandvaḥ| prayuktaṃ
hi bhāṣye ṭhsūsartibhyāṃ ca sarterutvaṃ suvatervā ruḍāgamaḥ' iti|
sartarutvamiti| dīrghatvaṃ tu raparatve sati ṭhhali ca' ityeva siddham|
suvatervā ruḍāgama iti| suvateriti pañcamī, suvateḥ parasya kyapa
ityarthaḥ| rugāgama iti pāṭhe ṣaṣṭhī| saratīti ākāro| ṭhṣū preraṇe'
tudādiḥ, karmaṇi lokaṃ prerayatītyarthaḥ, udite hi tasminkriyāsu
lokasya pravṛttiḥ| kartṛ pratyayena kartari nipātanaṃ darśayati| evaṃ
rucyāvyathyayorapi draṣṭavyam| āha ca ṭhsūryarucyāvyathyāḥ kartari'
iti| kupyamiti| saṃjñāyāmetadiṣyate, suvarṇarajatavyatiriktasya
dhanasyeyaṃ saṃjñā| sarvatrātiprasaṅgo nipātanāśrayeṇa parihāryaḥ|
karmakartari nipātanamiti| antodātasya ceti draṣṭavyam| āha
hi----ṭhkṛṣṭapacyasyāntodātatvaṃ karmakartari ca' iti| śuddhe tu
karmaṇi kṛṣṭapākya ityeva bhavati||
bhidyoddhyau nade|| 3|1|115 ||
puṣyasiddhyau nakṣatre|| 3|1|116 ||
puṣyasiddhyau nakṣatre || puṣyantyasminnarthā iti| ārabdhā iti śeṣaḥ|
siddhantyasminniti| atrārthā ityapekṣyate| puṣpasiddhaśabdau paryāyau|
svarūpaparatvātu sūtre dvandvaḥ||
vipūyavinīyajityā muñjakalkahaliṣu|| 3|1|117 ||
lipūyavinīyajityā muñjakalkahaliṣu|| vipūyo muñja iti|
rajvādikaraṇāya śodhayitavya ityarthaḥ| vinīyaḥ kalka iti|
kalkaśabdo'yamasti piṣṭa auṣadhe----ṭhpathyā suṇṭhī saindhavāṃśasya kalkaḥ
peyo nityaṃ sarvarogakṣayāya' iti, taile ghate vā auṣadhe prakṣipte
yadajīṣaṃ tatrāpi vartate, tāpe ca prasiddhaḥ----ṭhtapo na kalko'dhyayanaṃ
na kalkaḥ' ityādau; iha tu prathamasya grahaṇamiti kecit| viśeṣeṇeti
vayam, tathā ca māghaḥ prāyuṅkta----ṭhavinīya saṃbhramavikāsibhaktibhiḥ'
iti| jitya iti| balenākraṣṭavyaḥ| kṛṣṭasamīkaraṇārthaṃ sthūlaṃ kāṣṭhṃa
haliricyutyate||
pratyapibhyāṃ graheścchandasi|| 3|1|118 ||
padāsvairibāhyāpakṣyeṣu ca|| 3|1|119 ||
padāsvairibāhyāpakṣyeṣu ca|| asvairiṇīti| ṭhīra preraṇe'
svayameverituṃ śīlamasyā iti tācchīliko ṇiniḥ,
ṭhsvādīreriṇoḥ' iti vṛddhiḥ| bāhyāyāmiti| bahirbhavā
ṭhbahiṣaṣṭilopaśca' iti yañṭilopau, pakṣe bhavaḥ pakṣyaḥ
digāditvādyat| yasya pragṛhyasaṃjñā vihiteti| nanu padāvayavasya
dvivacanādeḥ pragṛhyasaṃjñā, na tu padasya? satyam; yaugikastvayaṃ
padaśabdaḥ----padyate magyate'nenārtha iti| yadvā prātiśākhye
dvivacanānte pada eva prakṛhyaśabdaḥ prasiddhaḥ| sannikarṣo'tra gṛhṇāterarthaḥ|
svarasandhyabhāvādagnī ityādau kiyatāpi kālena
vyavadhānātparasparamaco na sannikṛṣyante| avagṛhyamiti| samāse
pūrvapadam, tatra hi padakāle'vagraho vicchedaḥ gṛhyakā ime
gṛhītikā ityartha iti| ubhayatrānukampāyāṃ kan| pañjarādibandhena
paratantrīkṛtāḥ śukādaya ucyante| grāmagṛhyaeti| śeṣalakṣaṇāyāḥ
ṣaṣṭhayāḥ samāsaḥ| vāsudevagṛhyaetyatra tu kartari ṣaṣṭhayāḥ
śeṣaṣaṣṭha|la vā samāsaḥ||
vibhāṣā kṛvṛṣoḥ|| 3|1|120 ||
vibhāṣā kṛvṛṣoḥ|| vṛṣyamiti| ṭhvṛṣu secane'||
yugyaṃ ca pattre|| 3|1|121 ||
yugyaṃ ca pattre|| patatyaneneti patramiti| ṭhdāmnīśasa' ityādinā
karaṇe ṣṭran| ṭhtadvahati rathayugaprasaṅgam' iti prāgdīvyatīyenaiva
yathā siddham| svare'pi nāsti bhedaḥ----kyapi dhātusvaraḥ, yatyapi
ṭhyato'nāvaḥ' ityādyaudātatvam, ayugyamityatrāpi na svare bhedaḥ,
ṭhyayatoścātadarthe' ṭhkṛtyokeṣṇuccārvādayaśca'
ityubhayatrāntodātavidhānāt||
amāvasyadanyatarasyām|| 3|1|122 ||
amāvasyadanyatarasyām|| amāśabdaḥ sahārthe vartata iti| amātya ityādau
darśanāt| tasminnupapada iti| upapadatvamapi nipātanādeva, ameti
vā saptamyā lukā nirdeśaḥ| takāroccāraṇātprakṛtasya
kyapastāvannipātanaṃ na bhavati| yadi tu paramaprakṛtasya yato
nipātanaṃ syāt svare doṣaḥ----syāt---yati sati vasyāśabde
ṭhyato'nāvaḥ' ityādyaudātatvam; kṛdutarapadaprakṛtisvaratve'pi sa eva
svaro'vatiṣṭheta, ṇyati tvantasvaritatvaṃ bhavati| tathā yatā
mukte'māvāsyetyadhikaraṇe ṇyanna prāpnoti, ṭhkṛtyalyuṭo bahulam'
iti bhaviṣyati| evamapyupapadasamāso na prāpnoti?
mayūravyaṃsakāditvādbhaviṣyati| evamapi ṭhgatikārakopapadāt' iti
svaro na prāpnoti? tathā ṭhamāvāsyāyā vā' iti ṇyadantasya yatkārtha
tadyadantasyāmāvasyaśabdasya na syād, bhinnatvāt? iti yadantapakṣe
doṣaṃ ddaṣṭvā prakṛtasyāpi ṇyata eva nipātanamityāha----ṇyatpratyayo
bhavatīti| kiṃ tarhi ucyate-----ṇyatpratyayo bhavatīti, na
punarṇyatpratyayo nipātyata iti? satyam, sa evārthaḥ, nipātanād
ṇyatpratyo bhavatītyarthaḥ| anyatarasyāṃ vṛddhyabhāvo nipātyata iti|
ṇyatpratyayo nityaḥ, vṛddhyabhāvastu pākṣika ityarthaḥ| saha vasata iti|
sannikṛṣṭau vasata ityarthaḥ| yaduktam---ṇyatprayayo nipātyata iti,
tatrāyaṃ guṇa ityāha---ekadeśavikṛtasyānanyatvāditi| ṇyati
hyamāvāsyeti svataḥ prāptaṃ rūpam, vṛddhyabhāvastu tasyaiva vikāra
iti bhāvaḥ| yadvā-----ṇyati vṛddhau kṛtāyāṃ pakṣe hrasvo'pi nipātyate,
sa eva vṛddhyabhāva uktaḥ| evaṃ śloke'pyavṛddhitāmiti|
kimatra nipātyata ityāśaṅkāyāṃ ślokaḥ-----amāvasorityādi|
vṛddhibhāvābhāvakṛtaviśeṣāśrayo dvivacananirddeśaḥ| nipātayāmīti|
ekasyaiveti śeṣaḥ, abhāpūrvayorvasorṇyantayormadhya ekasya
vṛddhyabhāvamahaṃ nipātayāmītyarthaḥ|
sūtrakāreṇaikyamāpannasyaitadvacanam| tathā sati kiṃ
siddhamityatrāha---tatheti| ekā
taddhitavṛttirekadeśavikṛtasyānanyatvād etayordvayorapi
siddhyatītyarthaḥ| svaraśca me prasiddhyatīti| evaṃ nipātayato mama
svaro'pi siddhyati| vyākhyātaḥ svaraḥ||
cchandasi
niṣṭarkyadevahūyapraṇīyonnīyocchiṣyamarthastaryādhvaryakhanyakhānyadevayajyāpṛcchacyapratiṣīvyabrahmavādyabhāvyastāvyopacāyyapṛḍāni|| 3|1|123 ||
cchandasi
niṣṭarkyadebahuyacapraṇīyonnīyocchiṣyamaryastaryādhvaryakhanyakhānyadevayajyāpṛcchayapratiṣīvyabrahmavādyabhāvyastāvyopacāyyapṛdāni|| nugabhāvaśceti| yadā juhotestadeti bhāvaḥ| upacāyyapṛḍamiti| ṭhmṛḍa sukhe'ṭhpṛḍa ca' ityetasmāt ṭhigupadhalakṣaṇaḥ kaḥ, upacāyyaṃ ca tatpṛḍaṃ ceti karmadhārayaḥ| hiraṣye ceti vaktavyamiti| hiraṇye'bhidheya ityarthaḥ| vyatyayamiti| ādyantaviparyāsa ityarthaḥ|
ṇyadekasmāditi| ekasmādvātorṇyatpratyayo nipātyate, tadanantareṣu
devahūyādiṣu caturṣu caturbhyo dhātubhyaḥ kyab nipātyate,
upasargabhedānnayaterbhedaḥ| dvau kyapāviti| dvābhyāṃ dhātubhyāṃ dvau
kyapau nipātyete ityarthaḥ| ṇyadvidhiścaturiti| sujantametat,
kriyābhyāvṛttivācicaturo vā ṇyadvidhīyata ityarthaḥ||
ṛhalorṇyat|| 3|1|124 ||
ṛhalorṇyat|| ṛvarṇāntāditi| artestu grahaṇaṃ na bhavati; halā
sāhacaryāt, paraṃ kāryamiti nirddeśād, ṭhīḍavandavṛśaṃsaduhāṃ
ṇyataḥ' iti liṅgācca||
orāvaśyake|| 3|1|125 ||
orāvaśyake|| avaśyaṃ bhāva āvaśyakamīti| manojñāditvād vuñ,
avyayānāṃ bhamātre ṭilopaḥ| kiṃ punaravaśyārthavācinyupapade
pratyaye? āhosvidāvaśyake dyotye? tatrādye pakṣe
upapadarahitātpratyayo na syāt---lāvyaṃ pāvyamiti, tasmād
dvitīyaḥ pakṣa āśrīyata ityāha---āvaśyake dyotya iti|
svarasamāsānupapatiriti| upapadapakṣe upapadasamāso labhyate,
gatikārakopapadātkṛdityutarapadaprakṛtisvaratvaṃ ca; dyotyapakṣe
tvetadubhayamapi na siddhyatītyarthaḥ| avaśyalāvyamīti|
ṭhlumpedavaśyamaḥ kṛtye' iti malopaḥ| dyotitārthasyāpi
kvacitprayogo ddaśyate, lāghavaṃ pratyanādarāt| na tvetadatra
vaktavyam; ṭhlumpedavaśyamaḥ kṛtye' iti vacanādeva dyotite avaśyamaḥ
prayoga iti tasyāvaśyakartavyādau caritārthatvāt|
mayūravyaṃsakāditvāditi| tasyākṛtigaṇatvāditi bhāvaḥ|
utarapadaprakṛtisvaratve ceti | mayūravyaṃsakādinipātanādeva
svaro'pi bhaviṣyatītyapi śakyaṃ vaktum||
āsuyuvapirapilapitrapicamaśca|| 3|1|126 ||
āsuyuvapirapilapitrapicamaśca|| puprabhṛtīnāṃ dvandvena
āsunoterdvandva ityāhuḥ|
sunoterabhisambandhastadāha---āṅpūrvātsunoteriti| ṭhṣu
prasavaiśvaryayoḥ' ityasyatvagrahaṇam ṭhkṛtyalyuṭo bahulam' iti| ṭhyu'
iti ṭhyumiśraṇe ityasya grahaṇam| ṭhyuñ bandhane' ityasya tu
sānubandhakatvādagrahaṇam| yato'pavāda iti| ṭhaco yat'
ṭhporadupadhāt' iti yathāyogaṃ prāptasya| dābhyamiti|
dabherdhātuṣvapaṭhitasyāpi curādau ṭhbahulametannidarśanam' iti
vacanācchiṣṭaprayogācca kṣapayatyarthayatyavadhīrayatyādivaddhātutvaṃ
draṣṭavyam||
ānāyyo'nitye|| 3|1|127 ||
ānāyyo'nitye|| rūḍhireṣeti| tena ghaṭādāvatiprasaṅgo
nodbhāvanīya iti| nipātanācca rūḍhitvam| uktaṃ hi----rūḍha|lrthaṃ ca
nipātanamiti| kutaḥ punaranityatvamityatrāha---tasya
cānityatvamiti| nityamajāgaraṇāditi| satatamajvalanādityarthaḥ,
jvalanameva hi tasya jāgaraṇam| dakṣiṇāgnāvapi viśiṣṭa eveṣyate, na
sarvatraiveti darśayati---yaśceti| yoniḥūtpatisthānam|
vaiśyakulādityādināyonivikalpaṃ darśayati|
ānāyyo'nitya iti cediti| ghaṭādiṣvapi prasaṅga iti śeṣaḥ|
bhavediti| sambhāvane liṅ| nipātanādeva sambhāvyata ityarthaḥ|
ekayonāviti| āhavanīyena| āneyo hyanyathā bhavediti|
ghaṭādāvanityebhinnayonau ca dakṣiṇāgnau, ṭhaco yat' iti yadeva
bhavatītyarthaḥ||
praṇāyyo'sammatau|| 3|1|128 || 
praṇāyyo'sammatau|| asammatāviti bahubrīhityāha---avidyamānā
saṃmatirasminniti| sammatiścātra saṃmananaṃ prītiviṣayabhāvopagamanaṃ
karmavyāpāro vivakṣyate, na saṃmantṛvyāpāraḥ; tathā satyasaṃmantari
nipātanaprasaṅgāt, tasya cāniṣṭatvādityabhiprāyeṇāha----saṃmatatā
saṃmatiriti| saṃmatiramilāṣo'pyucyata iti| bhogaviṣayo'pyādaraḥ
sammatiśabdenocyate, tantreṇetyarthaḥ||
pāyyasānnāyyanikāyyadhāyyā mānahavirnivāsasāmidhenīṣu|| 3|1|129 ||
pāyyasānnāyyanikāyyadhāyyā mānahavirnivāsasāmidhenīṣu||
mīyate'neneti mānam, hūyata iti haviḥ, nivasatyasminniti
nivāsaḥ, samidhāmādhānī ṛk sāmidhenī| māṅe ṇyatpratyaya iti|
karaṇe tatra ṭhāto yuk ciṇkṛtoḥ' iti yuk| meyamanyaditi|
bhāvakarmaṇoryadeva bhavatītyarthaḥ| sānnāyyamiti| samyagnīyate
homārthamagniṃ pratīti karmaṇi ṇyat| havirviśeṣa iti| aindraṃ
dadhyamāvāsyāyāmaindraṃ payo'māvāsyāyāmiti
vihitayordadhipayasoḥ| māghastu yathāśrutārthagrāhī havirmātre
prāyuṅkta----ṭhhutamayamavalīḍhea sādhu sānnāyyamagniḥ' iti|
nicīyate'smindhānyādikamiti adhikaraṇe ṇyat| dhāyyeti|
dhīyate'nayā samiditi karaṇe ṇyat, pūrvavadyauk| ṛgviśeṣasyeti|
ṭhpravovājā abhidyavaḥ' ityādikasya| ki tarhi kācideveti|
samidhyamānavatīṃ samiddhavatīṃ cāntareṇa vikṛtiṣu prakṣipyamāṇā
pṛthuyājā amartya ityādikā| kathaṃ punarayaṃ viśeṣo labhyata
ityāha----rūḍhiśabdohya yamiti| ata eva nipātanāśrayaṇamiti bhāvaḥ|
rūḍhitvameva draḍhayati----tathā ceti| dhāyyāḥ śaṃsatīti jyotiṣṭome
marutvatīye śastre vidhānametat| sāmidhenīgrahaṇaṃ
prayogaviṣayopalakṣaṇārthamiti bhāvaḥ||
kratau kuṇḍapāyyasaṃcāyyau|| 3|1|130 ||
kratau kuṇyapāyyasaṃcāyyau||ṇyati prakṛte yatpratyayāntaḥ
kuṇḍapāyyaśabdo nipātya ityuktam, tatra prayojanamāha---yato'nāva
itīti| yadutarapadasyādyaudātatvaṃ kṛdutarapadaprakṛtisvareṇa sa eva
svaraḥ siddho bhavatītyarthaḥ| ṇyati tu svaritatvaṃ syāt||
agnī paricāyyopacāyyasamūhyāḥ|| 3|1|131 ||
agnī paricāyyopacāyyasamūhyaḥ|| agnāviti| na jvalane, kiṃ tarhi?
tadarthaiṣṭakācayanaviśeṣe; tatraiva rūḍhatvāt| iha saṃpūrvāt ṭhūha
vitarkea, ityasmādanekārthatvādvaherarthe vartamānāddhalantatvād ṇyati
samūhyamiti siddham| tathā ca----ṭhsamūhyaṃ cinvīta paśukāmaḥ paśavo vai
puruṣaḥ paśūnevāsya tatsamūhati' iti vahyarthenohinā brāhmaṇe
samūhyaśabdo niruktaḥ||
cityāgnicitye ca|| 3|1|132 ||
cityāgnicitye ca|| cityo'gniriti| karmaṇi yadapavādaḥ kyab
nipātyate, tenādyaudātatvaṃ bhavati| bhāve yakārapratyaya iti| kimartha
punaratrāpi kyabeva na nipātitaḥ, evaṃ hi tuga nipātyo na bhavati,
tatrāha---tenāntodātatvaṃ bhavatīti| agnāvityeveti| tacca
cityaśabdasyaiva viśeṣaṇārtham, nāgnicityāśabdasya; tasya bhāve
nipātitatvāt| tadetaddarśitam---ceyamanyaditi||
ṇvultṛcau|| 3|1|132 ||
nandigrahipacādibhyo lyuṇinyacaḥ|| 3|1|134 ||
nandigrahipacādibhyo lyuṇinyacaḥ|| ādiśabdaḥ pratyekamabhisambaddhyata
iti| gaṇapāṭhāditi bhāvaḥ| apoddhṛtya ye paṭha|lnta iti| te gṛhyanta
ityanvayaḥ| apoddhṛtyeti buddhyā pṛthakkṛtyetyarthaḥ| kimartha
punarapoddhṛtya pratyayavidhānam, yāvatā nandanādīnāṃ gaṇapāṭhādeva
siddhaṃ sādhutvam? ucyate---asatyasminnaṣṭādhyāyyāṃ
kvacidapyanupayogādraṇatrapayāṭho'nārṣo'dhyavasīyeta|
nandivāśītyādi| ṭhṭuanadi samṛddhau', ṭhvāśrṛ śabde',ṭhmadī harṣe',
ṭhduṣa vaikṛtye',ṭhrādha sādha saṃsiddhau',ṭhvṛdhu vṛddhau',ṭhśubha śumbha
śobhārthe',ṭhruca dīptau'| dūṣaṇa iti| ṭhdoṣo ṇau' ityūtvam|
sahitapītyādi| ṭhṣaha marṣaṇe', tapa santāpe',ṭhśamu damu upaśame'|
jalpana ityādi| ṭhjalpa japa vaktāyāṃ vaci'| ṭhramu krīḍāyām',ṭhddapa
harṣavimocanayoḥ',ṭhkradi āhvāne rodane ca'| ṭhkṛṣa
vilekhane',ṭhhṛṣu alīke'| ṭhardda hiṃsāyām',janamarddayatīti
janārdanaḥ, karmaṇyaṇi prāpte| evamutaratrāpi karmaṇyupapade
draṣṭavyam| ṭhyu miśraṇe',ṭhṣūda kṣaraṇe'| madhunā'suraḥ, taṃ sūdayatīti
madhusūdanaḥ| ṭhñibhī bhaye', ṇici ṭhbhiyo hetubhaye ṣuk'| ṭhlūñ
chedane',ṭhṇaśa adarśane',ṭhdamu upaśame,----ṇyantau, citaṃ nāśayatīti
citanāśanaḥ, kulaṃ damayatīti kuladamanaḥ|
grāhītyādi| ṭhgraha upadāne',ṭhṣaha marṣaṇe',ṭhtasu upakṣaye',ṭhdasu
ca',ṭhbhasa bhartsanadīptyoḥ'| tiṣṭhaterāto yuk| ṭhmatri
guptabhāṣaṇe' curādiḥ, ardda hisāyām| rakṣetyādi| ṭhrakṣa
pālane',ṭhśru śravaṇe',ṭhḍuvap bījasantāne',ṭhśo tanūkaraṇe'---eṣā
niśabda upapade ṇiniḥ| yācītyādi| ṭhṭuayācṛ yācñāyām',ṭhhṛñ
haraṇe',ṭhvraja gato'ṭhvadavyaktāyāṃ vāci',ṭhvasa nivāse'---eṣāṃ
pratiṣiddhānāṃ ṇinibhavati, prātaṣiddhārthānāmityarthaḥ| pratiṣiddhārthatā
ca nañpūrvāṇāṃ bhavatīti darśayati| ayācītyādi| yadyapi
viśabdo'pi vigarddabharathirityādau pratiṣedhe ddaṣṭaḥ, yācyādīnāṃ
tu vipūvāṇā ṇinirna ddaśyata iti nañyeva ṇinirvijñāyate|
acāmityādi| ajantānāṃ dhātūnāmacitakartṛkāṇāṃ pratiṣiddhārthānāṃ
ṇinirbhavati, na vidyate citamasyetyacitaḥ sa kartā yeṣāṃ te
tathoktāḥ| viśayī viṣayīti| ṭhśīṅ svapne',ṭhṣiñ bandhane',
vṛddhyabhāvo nipātanāt| abhibhāvī bhūta iti|
abhibhūtavānabhibhāvī| aparādhī, avarodhī| ṭhrādha sādha
saṃsiddhau',ṭhrudhir āvaraṇe'| paribhavī, paribhāvīti| pakṣe
vṛddhyabhāvaḥ|
