pacetyādi| ṭhḍupacaṣpāke'| ṭhvaca paribhāṣaṇe',ḍuvapiruktārthaḥ, evaṃ
vadirapi| ṭhcala kampane',ṭhpatlṛ gatau'| nadaḍiti| ṭhnada avyakte
śabde'| ṭhakāro ṅībarthaḥ, evamutaratrāpi| ṭhbhaṣa bhartsane',pluṅ
gatau',ṭhcara gatyarthaḥ',ṭhgṛ nigaraṇe',ṭhtṛ plavanataraṇayoḥ',ṭhcura
steye',ṭhdivu krīḍādau',ṭhsūdiruktārthaḥ,ṭhjṛṣ vayohānau',mṛṅ
prāṇatyāge',ṭhkṣamūṣ sahane',ṭhṣivu tantusantāne',ṭhmiṣa
sparddhāyām',ṭhkupa krodhe',ṭhmidhṛ medhāhisanayoḥ',ṭhvraṇa
gātracūrṇane'curādiḥ, ṭhnṛtī gātravikṣepe',ṭhddaśir
prekṣaṇe',ṭhsṛplṛgatau'| ṭhḍubhṛjh dhāraṇapoṣaṇayāḥ',jāraṃ vibhartīti
jārabharā| evaṃ śvānaṃ pacatīti śvapacā, nyaṅkvadiṣu śvapākaśabdasya
pāṭhātpakṣe karmaṇyaṇapi bhavati| pacādirākṛtigaṇa iti| tatsambandhina
ādiśabdasya prakāravacanatvāt| tathā ca ṭhśivaśamariṣṭasya kare' iti
kṛño'c pratyayaḥ kṛtaḥ| ghaṭeśca ṭhkarmaṇi ghaṭo'ṭhac' iti| tathā
yaṅntānāṃ ṭhyaṅe'ci ca' iti yaṅe'sminnaci luguktaḥ| bhāṣye ca
ṭhajapi sarvadhātubhyo vaktavyaḥ' ityuktam| pacādyanukramaṇaṃ tu
nadaḍityādāvanubandhāsañjanārtham, karmopapadānām igupadhānāṃ ca
bādhakabādhanārtham, deveḍityubhayārtham, anyeṣāṃ tu prapañcārtha
draṣṭavyam||
igupadhajñāprīkiraḥ kaḥ|| 3|1|135 ||
igupadhajñāprīkiraḥ kaḥ|| igupadhādīnāṃ samāhāradvandve napuṃsakatvena
hrasvaprasaṅgaditaretarayoge dvandvaḥ, vyatyayena bhyasaḥ
pañcamyekavacanam| tatra kṛśabdasya
dhātvanukaraṇatvātprakṛtivadanukaraṇam, vibhaktāvitvam| jña iti|
ṭhāto lopa iṭi ca' priya iti| ṭhprīñ tarpaṇe',iyaṅadeśaḥ| kira iti|
ṭhkṛ vikṣepe',ṭhṛta iddhātoḥ'| pacādiṣu draṣṭavyā iti yadyapyajapi
tṛjādivatsarvadhātubhyo bhavati, tathāpyapavādabādhanārthamete
pacādiṣvavaśyaṃ pāṭha|la ityarthaḥ||
ātaścopasarge|| 3|1|136 ||
pāghrādhmādheṭddaśaḥ śaḥ|| 3|1|137 ||
pāghrādhmādheṭddaśaḥ śaḥ|| ṭhpā pāne',ṭhghrā gandhopadāne',ṭhdhmā
śabdāgnisaṃyogayoḥ',ṭhdheṭ pāne',ṭhddaśir prekṣaṇe'|ṭhpā rakṣaṇe'
ityasya tu lugvikaraṇatvādagrahaṇam| utpiba ityādi| pāghrādisūtreṇa
yathāyogaṃ pibādaya ādeśāḥ| vyāghra iti| atra ṭhātaścopasarge' iti ka
eva bhavati; atra ca ṭhvyāghrādibhiḥ' iti vacanaṃ liṅgam||
anupasargāllimpavindadhāripārivedyaudejicetisātisāhibhyaśca||
3|1|138 ||
anupasargāllimpavindadhāripārivedyaudejicetisātisāhibhyaśca||
ṭhanupasargāt' iti vyatyayenaikavacanamityāha----anupasargebhya iti|
ṭhlipa upadehe',ṭhvidlṛ lābhe'āgāminā numā
sanumkayorgrahaṇam, tena vidhyantarāṇāmagrahaṇam| ṭhdhṛñ
dhāraṇe',ṭhdhṛñ avasthāne'----ṇyantayordvayorapi grahaṇam| ṭhpāra tīra
karmasamāptau',ṭhvida cetanākhyānādiṣu' curādiḥ,
jñānādyarthānāmanyatamo vā hetumaṇṇyantaḥ| ṭhejṛ kampane'ṇyantaḥ,
ṭhcitī saṃjñāne' curādiḥ, sātirhetumaṇṇyantaḥ, ṭhṣaha marṣaṇe'
curādirhetumaṇṇyanto vā| limpaḥ, vinda iti| ṭhtudādibhyaḥ śaḥ'
ṭhśe mucādīnām' iti num| dhārayādiṣu śabguṇāyādeśāḥ|
nau limperiti| cchandasi tu ṭhcchartā ca vidhartā ca vidhāraya' iti
ddaśyate|
aravinda iti| arākārāṇi dalānyaraśabdenocyante||
dadātidadhātyorvibhāṣā|| 3|1|139 ||
dadātidadhātyorvibhāṣā|| dadaḥ, dadha iti| śapaḥ śluḥ, dvirvacanam,
ṭhśnābhyastayorātaḥ' ityākāralopaḥ| ṭhdada dāne',ṭhdadha
dhāraṇe'ityetābhyāmaci kṛte dadaḥ dadha iti siddham, dādhābhyāmapi ṇe
kṛte dāyo dhāya iti, idaṃ tu vacanaṃ svarārtham---adadaḥ adadha iti
ṭhackāvaśaktau' ityantodātvaṃ mā bhūt, nañsvara eva yathā
syāditi||
jvalitikasantebhyo ṇaḥ|| 3|1|140 ||
jvalitikasantebhyo ṇaḥ|| itiśabda ādyartha iti|
anekārthatvānnipātānām ṭhuccāvaceṣvartheṣu nipatantīti nipātāḥ'
iti niruktakāro nipātaśabdaṃ nirāha| jvalitītyavibhaktiko
nirddeśaḥ, jvalādibhya ityarthaḥ| kasirante yeṣāṃ te kasantāḥ, tatra
ye kasamadhītya vṛditi paṭhanti teṣāṃ mate kasantagrahaṇaṃ
cintyaprayojanam| nanu ca ṭhjvala dīptau' iti dviḥ
paṭha|lte----ghaṭādiṣu, parastācca; teṣāmasatyasminviśeṣaṇe sandehaḥ
syāt----kiṃ pūrvo jvalirādiḥ? uta para iti? ataḥ kasaḥ
samīpabhūtebhyo jvalādibhya iti viśeṣaṇamarthavat, naitatsuṣṭhūacyate;
yadyantaśabdaḥ samīpavacanaḥ, bahuvrohau tatpuruṣe ca kasergrahaṇaṃ na
prāpnoti, pūrvatra jvalatāvādāvabhiprete tadanantara eva
dhāturupādīyeta; paropadeśenaiva jvalatergrahaṇasiddheḥ|
ghaṭādipāṭhaśca mitsaṃjñāyāṃ caritārthaḥ, itarastvacaritārtha iti sa
evādirbhaviṣyati| aco'pavāda iti| tasyāpi sarvadhātuviṣayatvāditi
bhāvaḥ| ṭhbhramu calane' ityasya jvalādipāṭhaḥ kimarthaḥ,yāvatā pacādyaci
bhrama iti siddham, ṇe'pyetadeva rūpam, ṭhnodātopadeśasya' iti
pṛddhipratiṣedhāt? ihābhrama iti ṭhackāvaśaktau' iti svaro mā
bhūditi||
śyādvyadhāsru saṃsvatīṇavasāvahṛlihaśliṣaśvasaśca|| 3|1|141 ||
śyādvyadhāsu saṃsvatīṇavasāvahṛlihaśliṣaśvasaśca|| anupasargāditi
nivṛtamiti| utarasūtre punaranupasargagrahaṇāt| vibhāṣeti ceti|
nivṛtamityapekṣyate| vibhāṣā grahaṇaṃ hyanupasargagrahaṇena sambaddham,
atastannivṛtāvasyāpi nivṛttiḥ| śyaiṅ iti | ṭhśyaiṅ gatau'
ityasmāt śī āt śyāditi śīṅe yaṇādeśena grahaṇaṃ na bhavati;
vyākhyānāt, jhaṭiti pratītāvanārohācca| ākārāntebhya iti| etena
ateracchabdāntānāṃ patiprabhṛtīnāmakārāntānāṃ ca grahaṇaṃ na bhavatīti
darśayati| etadapi vyākhyānādeva| ṭhvyadha tāḍane',ṭhsru gatau'
āṅpūrvaḥ, saṃpūrvaśca, ṭhiṇ gatau' atipūrvaḥ, ṭhṣo'ntakarmaṇi'
ṭhhṛñ haraṇe' avapūrvau, ṭhliha āsvādane',ṭhśliṣa
āliṅgane',ṭhśvasaprāṇane'| ye'tra sopasargāstebhyaḥ sopasargebhya eva
bhavati, śeṣebhyastvaviśeṣeṇa| bādhakabādhanārthamiti| ṭhātaścopasarge'
iti viśeṣavihitaḥ kaḥ sāmānyavihitasya ṇasya bādhakaḥ,
tadvādhanārthamidam| etenāvasyaterupādānaṃ vyākhyātam| avaśyāya
iti| pūrvavadyauk||
dunyoranupasarge|| 3|1|142 ||
dunyoranupasarge|| dāva iti| vanavahniḥ| kathaṃ tatraiva dava iti?
nayatisāhacaryātsānubandhakasya dunoteriha grahaṇam|
niranubandhakāddavateḥ pacādyaci bhaviṣyati| karaṇasādhano vā
ṭhṛdorap' ityabantaḥ||
vibhāṣā grahaḥ|| 1|3|143 ||
vibhāṣā grahaḥ|| vyavasthitavibhāṣā ceyamiti| etadeva
spaṣṭayati---jalacara iti| bhava iti| bhavatyeva na tu kadācinna bhavatīti
bhavaḥudevaḥ, saṃsāraśca| bhāvāḥupadārthāḥ||
gehe kaḥ|| 3|1|144 ||
gehe kaḥ|| geha iti| pratyayāthaṃsya karturviśeṣaṇam, nopapadam;
ṭhgṛhapatinā saṃyuktaḥ' iti nirdeśādityāha---gehe kartarīti|
tāstthyāddārāśceti| gehamityapekṣyate, tena gauṇasyāpi gehasya
grahaṇamiti darśayati| tacca tantrāvṛtyoranyata rāśrayaṇena labhyate,
tatra veśmani puṃlliṅgabahuvacanānta eva----gṛhānha dāhako bhavati,
gṛhānutarayā saṃkāśayate, gṛhāngaccha, gṛhānahaṃ sumanasaḥ prapadya
iti| napuṃsakaliṅgo'bhidheyavacanaḥ, evaṃ dāreṣvapi| anye
tu---gṛhaśabdo veśmanyeva mukhyaḥ, dāreṣu gauṇa iti vadanti, tathā
ṭhna gṛhaṃ gṛhamityāhurgṛ hiṇī gṛhamucyate' iti veśmanyeva
mukhyatāṃ darśayanti| yathā vṛttikāreṇoktaṃ tathā dāreṣvapi mukhya
eveti lakṣyate||
śilpini ṣvun|| 3|1|145 ||
śilpini ṣvun|| pūrveṇa sāhacaryāt silpinītyapi pratyayārthasya
viśeṣaṇam, nopapadamityāha----śilpini kartarīti| kriyāsu
kauśalaṃ śilpaṃ tadyasyāstīti silpo| 
nṛtikhanītyādi| etadvacanameva; tenāhvātā, āhvāyaka ityādau na
bhavati| rañjenunāsikalopaśceti| etatu jñāpakātsiddham, yadayam
ṭhjanījṛṣknusurañjo'mantāśca' iti mitsaṃjñāṃ śāsti,
tajjñāpayati----rañjerakitve'pyanunāsikalopo bhavatauti||
gasthakan|| 3|1|146 ||
gasthakan|| gāyateriti| ṭhkai gai śabde',ṭhgāmādāgrahaṇe ṣvaviśeṣaḥ'
iti ṭhgāṅ gatau' ityasyāpi grahaṇaṃ prāptam, anabhidhānānna bhavati|
thakanpratyayo hi gāyatyarthaviṣayameva śilpinamabhidhātuṃ samarthaḥ||
ṇyuṭ ca|| 3|1|147 ||
ṇyuṭ ca|| ṇakāro yugarthaḥ, ṭakāro ṅībarthaḥ| yogavibhāga utarārtha
iti| utaratra ṇyuṭa evānuvṛttiryathā syāt, thakano mā bhūditi||
haśca vrīhikālayoḥ|| 3|1|148 || 
haśca vrīhikālayoḥ|| jahāteriti| ṭhohāk tyāge'| jihāteriti|
ṭhohāṅgatau'| prāyeṇa jihīteriti pāṭhaḥ, sa tvayuktastipaḥ
pitvādītvābhāvāt| jahāteḥ kakāro'tra sāmānyagrahaṇārthaḥ, anyathā
ekānubandhakatvādasyaiva syāt| atha hāṅ ityucyeta, evamapi
tasyagrahaṇaṃ na syāt, tasmād dvayorapi grahaṇam| ṭhbrīhikālayoḥ'
iti karturviśeṣaṇam, nopapadam; tricaturbhyo hāyanasya
ṭhdāmahāyanāntācca' iti vacanāditi matvāha---vrīhau kāle ca
kartarīti| jahatyudakamiti| kṛtveti| vrīhau hāyanaśabdasya
pravṛttinimitaṃ darśitam| jāṅgaladeśodbhavāḥ kecid vrīhayo
hāyanā ityāhuḥ| jihīte bhāvāniti| bhāvāḥ padārthāstān jihīte
gacchati paricchedakatvena vyāpnotītyarthaḥ||
prusṛlvaḥ samabhihāre vun|| 3|1|149 ||
prusṛlvaḥ samabhihāre vun|| ṭhprusṛlva' iti pañcamyāḥ sthāne jas,
ṭhossupi' iti yaṇādeśaḥ| sādhukāritvaṃ lakṣyata iti| prāyaḥ
sahacaritvāt punaḥ punaranuṣṭhānaṃ samabhihāraḥ, yaśca yāṃ kriyāṃ
punaḥ punaranutiṣṭhati tasya prāyeṇa kauśalamupajāyate, ataḥ prāyaḥ
sāhacaryātsādhukāritvaṃ lakṣyate, lakṣaṇayā tatra vartata ityarthaḥ, tena
kiṃ siddhaṃ bhavatītyāha----sakṛdapīti||
āśiṣi ca|| 3|1|150 ||
āśiṣi ca|| āśiṣi gamyamānāyāmiti| na vācyāyām; kartari kṛt'
iti kartureva vācyatvāt| prārthanāviśeṣa iti|
aprāptasyābhilaṣitasya prāptumicchā prārthanāuāśīḥ| sa cetkriyāviṣaya
iti| ṭhdhātoḥ' ityadhikārād, dhātośca kriyāvacanatvāt| amuṣyāḥ
kriyāyā iti| jīvanādikāyāḥ, anena prayoktṛdharmatvamāśiṣo
darśayati| jīvatāditi| āśiṣi loṭprayogeṇodāharaṇe āśiṣaṃ
darśayati||
iti śrīharadatamiśraviracitāyāṃ padamañjaryo tṛtīyasyādhyāyasya
prathamaḥ pādaḥ||

--------|||||||||||--------kāśikāvṛtau
atha tṛtīyādhyāye dvitīyaḥ pādaḥ ipadamañjarī
karmaṇyaṇ|| 3|2|1 ||
karmaṇyaṇ|| karmaṇīti| nedaṃ svarūpagrahaṇam; aśabdasaṃjñā iti
pratiṣedhāt| nanu cārthasyeyaṃ sañjñā na śabdasya, aśabdasañjñeti
naivaṃ vijñāyate-----śabdasya sañjñā śabdasañjñeti, kiṃ tarhi? śabde
saṃjñā sabdasaṃjñeti| śabdaśabdena śabdānāmanuśāsanaṃ
vyākaraṇamucyate, asati ca bādhe kṛtrimākṛtrimayoḥ kṛtrimasyaiva
grahaṇaṃ yuktam| tasmātpāribhāṣikasya karmaṇo grahaṇamaṅgīkṛtya
tasyāvāntarabhedamāha----trividhaṃ karmeti| tā eva tisro vidhā
darśayati---nirvartye vikārye prāpyaṃ coti| yadasajjāyate sadvā
janmanā yatprakāśate tannirvatyam, yathā-----kumbhaṃ karoti, putraṃ
prasūta iti| yasya tu sata eva kaścidvikāraḥ kriyate tadvikāryam, sa ca
vikāraḥ kvacitpratyakṣagamyaḥ, yathā---kāṣṭhāni bhasma karoti, suvarṇa
kuṇḍalaṃ karotīti, kvacicchāstragamyaḥ----brīhīn prokṣatīti, atra
prokṣaṇena brīhīṣu kaścidatiśayo janyata iti śāstrādeva gamyate|
etāvatā ca bhedena saṃskāryametatkarmeti cāturvidhyaṃ mīmāṃsakā
manyante| kriyākṛtaviśeṣābhāve tu prāpyaṃ karma,
yathā-----vedamadhīte, carccāṃ pārayatīti| nanu na
ṭhkarturīpsitatamam' ityetadeva karma trividham, anyadapyasti
ṭhtathāyuktaṃ cānīpsitam' iti, tacca dvividham---dveṣyamitaracca; tathā
ṭhakathitaṃ ca', evaṃ ṭhdivaḥ karma ca', tathā ṭhadhiśīṅsthāsāṃ karma' iti|
tadevamavāntarabhedavivakṣāyāṃ saptavidhaṃ karma| uktaṃ ca----
nirvartya ca vikārya ca prāpyaṃ ceti tridhā matam|
tatrepsitatamaṃ karma caturdhānyatu sañjñitam||
audāsīnyena yatprāpyaṃ yacca karturanīpsitam|
sañjñāntarairanākhyātaṃ yadyaccāpyanyapūrvakam|| iti|
tatkimucyate trividhaṃ karmeti?
kecidāhuḥ----karturīpsitatamamevātra gṛhyate'nyatrāṇ na bhavatīti|
anye tvāhuḥ-----ādityaṃ paśyatītyādau mā bhūdityevamartha karmaṇi
nirvartyamāne vikriyamāṇa iti vaktavyamityāśaṅkya
vārtikakāreṇoktam----karmaṇi nirvartyamānevikrīyamāṇa iti
cedvedādhyāyānāmupasaṃkhyānamityādi| tadanena pradarśyate
trividhamapi karma gṛhyate, na punaḥ prāpyaṃ na gṛhyata iti, na tu
sūtrāntaroktaṃ vyāvartyate| tathā ca ṭhdivaḥ karma ca' ityatra
samāveśasya prayojanamuktam---manasā deva ityatra karmatvādaṇ,
karaṇatvātṛtīyeti| evaṃ ca vṛkṣāvāsaḥ parvatādhivāsa ityādyapi
yathādarśanaṃ bhavatīti| anabhidhānāditi| taccānabhidhānaṃ yatrāptairuktaṃ
tatraiva| anyatra tu yathālakṣaṇaṃ bhavatyeva, tathā ca
paṭhati----yathālakṣaṇamaprayukte'iti|
śīlikāmītyādi| ṭhśīla samādho',ṭhbhakṣa adane' curādiḥ, ṭhkamu
kāntau' ṇiṅntaḥ, ṭhcara gatyarthe' āṅpūrvaḥ, ṇasya ṇitkaraṇaṃ
carervṛddhyartham| pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratvaṃ ceti|
kṛdutarapadaprakṛtisvarasyāpavādaḥ| māṃsaśīleti| atrāṇi sati
ṅīpsyāt, ṇe'pi kvacidaṇkṛtaṃ bhavatītyetatu tācchīlika eva ṇe
bhavati| ṭhmanerdīrghaśca' iti sapratyayānto māṃsaśabdaḥ| kalyāṇaśabdaḥ
ṭhlaghāvante dvayośca bahvaṣo guruḥ' iti madhyodātaḥ|
asyāyamarthaḥ----ante laghoḥ parato dvayoścāntayorlaghvoḥ parato
bahvaṣaḥ śabdasya yo guruḥ sa udāto bhavati| bahvaṣa iti bahvaca
ityarthaḥ|ṭhaṣ' ityacaḥ pūrvācāryasañjñā|
īkṣikṣamibhyāṃ ceti| atrāpi pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratvaṃ cetyeva,
vākyabhedastu vaicitryārthaḥ| iha yo māsaṃ bhakṣayati māṃsaṃ tasya bhakṣo
bhavati, tatra bhakṣayateḥ karmaṇyerajantasya bahuvrīhiṇā siddham|
evamanyatrāpi| yaḥ punaraṇyantastasya ghañantasya bahuvrīhiḥ, nārtha etena|
nanu bahubhakṣa ityatra bahornañvadityutarapadāntodātatvaṃ prāpnoti?
evaṃ tarhi bhāve'jantena vyadhikaraṇapado
bahuvrīhirbhaviṣyati----bahuṣu bhakṣo'sya bahubhakṣa iti,
tatrotarapadārthasya bahutvābhāvādvahusvaro na bhaviṣyati? satyam;
aṇbādhanārtha tu vacanam, akārādanupapadātkarmotapapado
vipratiṣedhena| pacādibhyo'c,
anupapado'kārastasyāvakāśaḥ----pacatīti pacaḥ,
karmopapadasyāvakāśaḥ----kāṇḍalāvaḥ śaralāvaḥ; odanapāva
ityatrobhayaprasaṅge paratvādayamevāṇ bhavati| tenopadhāvṛddhiḥ,
upapadasamāsaśca nityo bhavati| aci tu ṣaṣṭhīsamāso vikalpitaḥ
syāt| na caca vācyaṃ yugapadvivakṣāyāṃ bhavatu vipratiṣedhaḥ, kevale
pacyarthe vivakṣite'ci kṛte paścādodanasambandhe vivakṣite odanapaca
ityapi prāpnoti? ekatvātprayogasya| na hi tasminneva prayoge
vivakṣitaṃ cāvivakṣitaṃ ca karma bhavati| tasmādodanapaca
ityasādhureva| gaṅgādharaḥ, śrīdharaḥ, vajradharaḥ, bhūdharaḥ, sragdhareti tu
sañjñāśabdāḥ| yadā tvajapi sarvadhātubhya iti pakṣaḥ, tadāpavādatvādeva
tasyāṇ bādhakaḥ| tathā ṭhigupadhajñāprīkiraḥ kaḥ'
anupapadastasyāvakāśaḥ---vikṣipaḥ, vilikhaḥ, karmopapadasya sa eva;
kāṣṭhabheda ityatrobhayaprasaṅge paratvādayamevāṇ bhavati| tathā
ṭhanupasargāllimpavinda' ityanupapadaḥ śastasyāvakāśaḥ----limpatīti
limpaḥ, karmopapadasya sa eva; kuṅmalepa ityatrobhayaprasaṅge
paratvādayamevāṇ bhavati| ṭhātaścopasarge' iti
ko'nupapadastasyāvakāśaḥ----suglaḥ suglaḥ, karmopapadasya sa eva;
gosandāya ityatrobhayaprasaṅge paratvādayamevāṇ bhavati||
hvāvamaśca|| 3|2|2 ||
hvāvamaśca|| veñ tantusantāne iti| ṭhvā gatigandhanayoḥ' ityasya
grahaṇaṃ na bhavati; akarmakatvāt| bhramaṇārtho hyasau----sarvā diśa āvāti
vāta āvātu bheṣajamiti| sopasargasya tu sakarmakatve'pyagrahaṇam;
pūrveṇaivāṇaḥ siddhatvāt| vātā vānti diśo daśeti
prayogaścintyaḥ| athāpi kvacitkathañcitsakarmakatvam, tathāpi hveñā
sāhacaryātsānubandhakasyaiva veño grahaṇam| māṅ māne iti| iṅito
mārūpasyopalakṣaṇametat, tena ṭhmeṅ praṇidāne' ityasyāpi grahaṇam|
ṭhmā māne' ityasya tu saṃbhāvanārthasyākarmakatvādagrahaṇam|
āto'nupasarge kaḥ|| 3|2|3 ||
āto'nupasarge kaḥ|| kavidhau sarvatra prasāraṇibhyo ḍo vaktavyaḥ|
saṃprasāraṇabhājaḥūuprasāraṇinaḥ| ṭhjyā vayohānau' brahma jinātīti
brahmajyaḥ, sarvatragrahaṇānnāvaśyamihaiva ṭhātaścopasarge'āhvaḥ prahvaḥ, ke
hi saṃprasāraṇaprasaṅgaḥ, āhva a iti sthite saṃprasāraṇe pūrvatve ca
kṛte uvaṅadeśe āhuvaḥ prahuva iti prāpnoti, evaṃ brahmajiya iti
prāpnoti| nanu saṃprasāraṇe kṛte āto lopastasya
sthānivadbhāvādiyaṇuvaṅai na bhaviṣyataḥ, lopo na
siddhyati----antaraṅgatvātpūrvatvaṃ prāpnoti, samānāśraye ca
vārṇādāṅgaṃ balīya iti? evaṃ tarhi prāgeva saṃprasāraṇādāto
lopo bhaviṣyati, paratvād nityaṃ saṃprasāraṇam,
kṛtākṛtaprasaṅgitvāt' āto lopastvanityaḥ, kṛte saṃprasāraṇe
pūrvatvena bāddhyate---yasya ca nimitaṃ lakṣaṇāntareṇa vihanyate
tadanityam| tadevaṃ paratvādāto lopaḥ, tataḥ saṃprasāraṇam, tata
iyaṇuvaṅai prasaktāvāllopasya sthānivatvānna bhaviṣyataḥ| nanu
yo'nādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvastasya vidhiṃ prati sthānivadbhāvaḥ,
ādiṣṭāccaiṣo'caḥ pūrvam---idānīmeva hyuktaṃ pūrvamallopaḥ paścāt
saṃprasāraṇamiti? evaṃ tarhyākāralopasyāsiddhatvāduvaṅ na bhaviṣyati|
ihāpi tarhi juhuvatuḥ juhuvatuḥ āllopasyāsiddhatvāduvaṅ na
prāpnoti? ābhīyamasiddhatvamanityamityatra na bhaviṣyati| atha vā
ṭhsaṃprasāraṇācca' ṭheḍaḥ padāntāt' ityatra eṅ iti
yogavibhāgaḥ---saṃprasāraṇādeṅ pirataḥ pūrvaparayoḥ
pūrvamekādeśo bhavatīti| kimarthamidam, na ṭhsaṃprasāraṇācca' ityeva
siddham? jñāpanārtham-----yatra saṃprasāraṇātpara eṅ saṃbhavati tatra
ṭhādeca upadeśe'śiti' ityātvaṃ na bhavatīti| yadi syātpūrvatvena
tasya nivṛttividhānamanupapannaṃ syāt| tena
juhuvaturityatrānaimitikatvenāntaraṅgamapyātvamakṛtvā
eṅbhāvādeva liṭi vihite saṃprasāraṇe pūrvatve na sthānivatvaṃ
nāsiddhatvamiti siddhamiṣṭam| āhvaḥ, prahvaḥ, brahmajya ityatra
tvākārāntalakṣaṇaḥ pratyayo nāsatyātve bhavitumarhatīti
pūrvamātvam, tataḥ pratyayaḥ, āllopaḥ, saṃprasāraṇam,
asiddhatvādiyaṇuvaṅerabhāvaḥ||
supi sthaḥ|| 3|2|4 ||
supi sthaḥ|| supīti na saptamībahuvacanasya grahaṇam, kiṃ tarhi?
pratyāhārasya; ṭhsuptiṅntaṃ padam',ṭhsupa ātmanaḥ kyac',ṭhsupo
dhātupratipadikayoḥ',ṭhavyayādāpsupaḥ' ityādau tasyaiva
prasiddhvāt| dvābhyaṃ pibatīti| nanu rūḍhiśabdā dvipādayaḥ,
tataścāsantamapyavayavārtamāśritya karmopapada eva kaḥ kariṣyate?
naitadevam; dvābhyāṃ pibatītyāderavayavārthasya
sambhavato'parityāgenaiva vyutpatau sambhavatyāmasyāḥ kalpanāyā
ayuktatvāt| yatra tvatyantamasambhavaḥ, yuktā tatraiva sā kalpanā,
yathā---tailatapāyikādau| anena bhāve yathā syāditi|
ārambhasāmarthyātāvadayaṃ karturapakṛṣyate, na cānyo'rtho
nirddiśyate| anirddiṣṭārthāśca pratyayāḥ svārthe bhavanti, svārthasca
dhātūnāṃ bhāva eva| nanu ṭhghañarthe kavidhānam' iti bhāve kaḥ siddhaḥ?
satyam; nityasamāsārthantu vacanam, anyarthā pākṣikaḥ ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ
syād| nitya eva tūpapadasamāso bhavati, tathā
cākhūnāmutthānamityasvapadena vigrahaḥ kṛtaḥ| ghañarthe kavidhānamityatra
sthagrahaṇaṃ kartṛvarjite kārake'pi yathā syāditi||
tundaśokayoḥ parimṛjāpanudoḥ|| 3|2|5 ||
tundaśokayoḥ parimṛjāpanudoḥ|| tundaparimṛja iti|
mṛjerajādau saṃkrama ityatra ṭhyasminvidhistadādau' ityeva siddhe
ādigrahaṇaṃ mukhyājādiparigrahārtham, tena
vyapadeśivadbhāvenājādāvatra ke vṝaddhirna bhavati|
ālasya ityādi| ālasye gamyamāne sukhotpādane ca pratyaya ityarthaḥ|
tatra sāmarthyādalase kartari sukhasya cāhartari pratyayo bhavatītyuktaṃ
bhavati| śokāpanoda evānya iti| yassaṃsārānityatādyaupadeśena
śokameva kevalamapanudati, na tu sukhamutpādayati sa
śokāpanodaḥ| mūlavibhujādibhya iti| tādarthya eṣā caturthī,
mūlavibhujādisiddhyarthamirtthaḥ| ākṛtigaṇaścāyam, tena
mahīdhra---kudhra---śiroruhādi siddhaṃ bhavati| kākaguhā iti| kākebhyo
gūhitavyā iti karmaṇi kapratyaya iṣyate, ato ghañarthe
kavidhānamityatredaṃ draṣṭavyam||
pre dājñaḥ|| 3|2|6 ||
pre dājñaḥ|| dadāteriti| upalakṣaṇametat| ṭhgāmādāgrahaṇeṣvaviśeṣaḥ'
iti sarveṣāmeva dārūpāṇāṃ grahaṇamiṣyate| jānāteśceti|
janestvallopenāyaṃ nirdeśo na bhavati; ṭhkhano gha ca' ṭhhanaśca vadhaḥ'
ityādau dhātunirddeśe'llopasyākaraṇāt| preṇopasṛṣṭāditi|
praśabdenopasargeṇa sambadbhādityarthaḥ| ṭhanupasarge' iti cānuvartate,
tena kevalena preṇopasṛṣṭādityarthaḥ| ataśca gosampradāya ityaṇeva
bhavati||
sami khyaḥ|| 3|2|7 ||
gāpoṣṭak|| 3|2|8 ||
gāpoṣṭak|| gāyateriti| ṭhgāmādāgrahaṇeṣvaviśeṣaḥ' iti gāṅe
lugvikara raṇasyāpi grahaṇaṃ prāptaṃ pibatisāhacaryātu na bhavati|
sāmagīti| ṭakaḥ kitvādāto lopaḥ, ṭitvān ṅīp|
surāśīdhvoḥ pibateriti vaktavyamitya| pibateriti
lugvikaraṇālugvikaraṇaparibhāṣālabhyasyaivārthasya kathanam,
upapadaparigaṇanaṃ tu vācanikameva| kṣīrapeti| striyāmeva viśeṣāt
strīliṅgamudāhṛtam||
harateranudyamane'c|| 3|2|9 ||
harateranudyamane'c|| acprakaraṇa iti| liṅgaviśiṣṭaparibhāṣayaiva
ghaṭagrahaṇena ghaṭīgrahaṇe'pi siddhe ghaṭīgrahaṇam paribhāṣāyā
anityatvajñāpanārtham| sūtragrāha evānya iti| yassūtraṃ
kevalamupādate, na tu dhārayati tatrāṇeva bhavatītyarthaḥ||
vayasi ca|| 3|2|10 ||
vayasi ca|| saṃbhāvyamānaṃ veti| tenāsatyapi kavacagrahaṇe vayasi
gamyamāne kavacahara iti bhavatīti bhāvaḥ||
āiṅ tācchīlye|| 3|2|11 ||
āṅ tācchīlye|| puṣpādyāhiraṇe ityādinā tācchīlyamudāharaṇe
darśayati| svābhāvikīti| svabhāve bhavā svābhāvikī, adhyātmādiḥ|
svaśabdo dvārādiṣu paṭha|lte, tadādividhiśca tatreṣyate|
bhāṣyakāraprayogātu dvārādikāryābhāvaḥ, svārthikasvābhāvikaśbdau
bhāṣye prayuktau| asya vivaraṇam---phalānapekṣeti| kathaṃ punaḥ
phalamanapekṣya tatra pravartate, na hi svabhāvaḥ paryanuyogamarhati||
arhaḥ|| 3|2|12 ||
stambakarṇayo ramijapoḥ|| 3|2|13 ||
stambakarṇayo ramijapoḥ|| ramerakarmakatvāditi| nanu
ṭhvyāṅparibhyo ramaḥ' ṭhupācca'
ityatrodāhṛtam---devadatamuparamatīti? evaṃ manyate---ṭhanupasarge'
iti vartata iti| japeśca śabdakarmakatvāditi| mantraṃ japatītyādau
tatraiva prayogadarśanāt| karma na saṃbhavatīti| kevalasya ramerjapeśca
karmādyaśabdātmakamiti bhāvaḥ| sūcakaḥūpiśunaḥ| stamberama iti|
ṭhtatpuruṣe kṛti bahulam' ityaluk| karṇe japitā maśaka iti|
upāṃśuśabdāyitetyarthaḥ||
śami dhātoḥ saṃjñāyām|| 3|2|14 ||
śami dhātoḥ saṃjñāyām|| dhātumātrāditi|
mātragrahaṇenāpavādaviṣaye'pi vidhānaṃ bhavatīti darśayati| śaṅkara
iti| ehikamāmuṣmikaṃ mokṣākhyaṃ ca sukhaṃ karotīti śaṅkaraḥ|
dhātugrahaṇasya prayojanaṃ darśayanmātragrahaṇapratipāditamevārtha
spaṣṭīkaroti---śamisaṃjñāyāmiti| asminsūtra ityarthaḥ| asati
dhātugrahaṇe śamiśaṃjñāyāmityasyāvakāśaḥ----śambhavaḥ, śaṃvada iti,
ṭhkṛño hetutācchīlye' ityasyāvakāśaḥ----śrāddhakara iti; śaṅkarā
ityatrobhayaprasaṅge paratvāṭṭa eva syād, dhātugrahaṇasāmarthyādajeva
bhavati| kuṇḍakhāḍavastvācāryo manyate---gṛṇāteḥ śabdakarmaṇa
etadrūpam, pṛṣodarāditvādrakārasya kakāra iti, tanmate dhātugrahaṇaṃ
cintyaprayojanam|| 
adhikaraṇe śeteḥ|| 3|2|15 ||
adhikaraṇe śeteḥ|| parśvādiṣviti| anadhikaraṇārthamidam| tadvigraheṇa
darśayati----pārśvābhyāmiti| digdhasahaśaya iti| digdhena saha śete
ityaci kṛte mayūravyaṃsakāditvātsamāsaḥ| digdasahaśabdo
mayūravyaṃsakādistasyopapadasamāsaḥ| avamūrddhaśaya iti| avanatāṃ
mūrddhā yasya avamūrddhā adhomukhaḥ śeta ityarthaḥ| girau ḍaścandasīti|
yadi cchandasītyucyate, katham ṭhgiriśamupacacāra pratyahaṃ sā
sukeśī',ṭhāropitaṃ yadririśena paścāt' iti? niraṃkuśāḥ kavayaḥ|
anye tvāhuḥ-----iha yo girau śete giristasyāstīti lomādiṣu
darśanācchapratyayaḥ| tathā cātraiva vārtikam----taddhito veti| na ca
lomādiṣvapi cchandograhaṇamasti, tena bhāṣāyāmapi giriśa iti
bhavati| evaṃ ca kṛtvā nighaṇṭuaṣu pāṭho'pyupanno bhavati| girau śeta
iti| girāvāsta ityarthaḥ||
careṣṭaḥ|| 3|2|16 ||
bhikṣāsenādāyeṣu ca|| 3|2|17 ||
bhikṣāśenādāyeṣu ca|| bhikṣācara iti| caratiratra tatpūrvake arjane
vartate, caraṇena bhikṣāmarjayatītyarthaḥ| senācara iti| senāṃ
praviśannucyate| ādāyacara iti| ādāya gacchatītyarthaḥ, bhakṣayatīti vā|
kathaṃ sahacaraḥ, sahacarīti? pacādiṣu caraḍiti paṭha|lte, supsupeti
samāsaḥ||
puro'grato'greṣu sarteḥ|| 3|1|18 ||
puro'grato'greṣu sarte|| agre ityeteṣviti|
etenāgraśabdasyaikārāntatvaṃ nipātyata iti darśayati|
etaccāgreśabdasyaca paranipātanādeva vijñāyate, anyathā ṭhajādyadantam'
iti pūrvanipātaḥ syāt| kimartha punarekārāntatvaṃ nipātyate,
yāvatā saptamyā alukāpyagresara iti siddham? yadā tarhyagraṃ sarati
agreṇa saratīti vā vigṛhyate tadāpyagresara ityeva yathā syāt| kathaṃ
ṭhyūthaṃ tadagrasaragarvitakṛṣṇasāram' iti? ṭhkṛtyalyuṭo bahulam' iti
samarthanīyam||
pūrve kartari|| 3|2|19 ||
kṛño hetutācchīlyānulomyeṣu|| 3|2|20 ||
kṛño hetutācchīlyānulomyeṣu|| karoterddhātoriti|
prasiddhataratvād dvyanubandhakasyāpyasyaiva grahaṇam, na tu ṭhkṛñ
hisāyām' ityasyeti bhāvaḥ| ānulomye ca gamyamāna iti| etena
hetvādīni nopapadānīti darśayati, etacca ṭhśami dhātoḥ' ityatra
dhātugrahaṇātkṛño hetvādiṣu ṭapratiṣedhārthādvijñāyate| upapadatve
hi śamyapapade ṭapratyasya prāptyabhāvādanarthakaṃ tatsyād| atau
naiṣāmupapadatvam, nāpi pratyayārthatvam,ṭhkartari kṛt' itsasya
bādhaprasaṅgāt| na cāsati virodhe bādhā yuktā| heturaikāntika
kāraṇamiti| ekāntaśabdo vinayādiṣu draṣṭavyaḥ,
niyatamavyabhicārītyarthaḥ| etena laukikasya hetorgrahaṇamiti
darśayati| na hi kevale kṛñi prayojakakartā sambhavatīti bhāvaḥ| nanu
laukikenāpi hetunā karturviśeṣaṇamayuktam, avyabhicārāt, na
hi karturanimitatvamasti? satyam;
punarhetuśabdopādanādaikāntikatvamāśrīyate, anyathā
nimitamātramupādīyeta| anukūlatāūārādhyacitānuvartanam|
yaśaskarī vidyeti| ṭhataḥ kṛkami' ityādinā visarjanīyasya
satvam||
divāvibhāniśāprabhābhāskarāntānantādibahunāndīkiṃlipilibibalibhaktikartṛcitrakṣetrasaṃkhyājaṅghābāhvaharyataddhanuraruṣṣu|| 3|2|21 ||
divāvibhāniśāprabhābhāskarāntānantādibahunāndīkiṃlipilibibalibhaktikartṛcitratretrasaṃkhyājaṅghābāhvaharyataddhanuraruṣṣu|| yathāyogamiti| tatra divāśabdo'hrīti saptamyantasyārthe vartata iti tasya karmatvānupapateḥ ṭhsupi' ityanenābhisambandhaḥ, śeṣāṇāṃ tu karmaṇītyanena| yadi tu doṣāmanyamahaḥ, divāmanyā rātriritivad vṛttiviṣaye karmatvamabhyupagamyeta, tadā divāśabdasyāpi karmaṇītyanena saṃbandhaḥ| sakārasyeti| bhāskarānteti bhāśabdasya pratyayasanniyogena sakāro nipātyate, tasmādbhāskara ityatra visarjanīyajihvāmūlīyau na bhavataḥ| atha vā----sakārasya visarjanīyajihvāmūlīyau na bhavataḥ, kutaḥ? nipātanāt| bhāskarānteti sūtre sakāroccāraṇameva nipātanam| kārakara iti| kara eva kāraḥ, prajñāditvātsvārthe'ṇa| anantakara iti| antakaraśabdena nañsamāse'pyetadrūpaṃ sambhavati, svare hi doṣaḥ syāt----satiśiṣṭo'vyayapūrvapadaprakṛtisvaraḥ prasajyeta, iṣyate hi gatikārakopapadātkṛditi kṛdutarapadaprakṛtisvareṇāntodātatvam| bahukara iti| bahuśabdo vaipulyavacanaḥ, saṃkhyāvacanasya tu casaṃkhyāgrahaṇenaiva siddham| lipilibiśabdau paryāyau| ahaskara iti| ahan ṭhroḥ supi' iti rophaḥ, pūrvavatsatvam| dhanuṣkaraḥ, aruṣkara iti|
ṭhnityaṃ samāse'nutarapadasthasya' iti ṣatvam, ṭhkiṃyatadvahuṣu
kṛño'jvidhānam' iti vārtikena sūtrasya
bādhitatvāṭṭasyābhāvāddhetvādiṣvanyatra kiṃkarītyasādhurityāhuḥ|
kvacid granthaḥ---atha vā vacādiṣu pāṭhaḥ kariṣyata iti|
tatrāyamarthaḥ----iha kimādigrahaṇamapanīya pacādiṣveva ṭhkiṃyatadvahuṣu
kṛñaḥ' iti paṭhitavyamiti||
karmaṇi bhṛtau|| 3|2|22 ||
karmaṇi bhṛtau|| karmaṇīti svarūpagrahaṇamiti| anuvṛtena
karmaṇītyanena viśeṣaṇāt| karmanirveśa iti| karma kriyā, tasya
niṣkrayāya deyaṃ bhaktādidravyamityarthaḥ||
na śabdaślokakalahagāthāvairacāṭuamūtramantrapadeṣu|| 3|2|23 ||
stambaśakṛtorin|| 3|2|24 ||
stambaśakṛtorin|| stambakaririti|
nitvātkṛdutarapadaprakṛtisvareṇotarapadamādyaudātaṃ bhavati||
haraterddatināthayoḥ paśau|| 3|2|25 ||
haraterddatināthamoḥ paśau|| paśau kartarīti| etena pratyayārthasya
kartuḥ paśurviśeṣaṇam, na tu tasya bādhaka iti darśayati| dhātorhi
pratyayavidhānātadarthasya yena sambandhastatra vācye pratyayo
bhavitumarhati| dhātvarthasya ca kriyāyāḥ sādhanena sambandhaḥ|
paśuśabdastu catuṣpājjātīyaṃ vastusvarūpeṇācaṣṭe, na śaktimadrūpeṇa,
natarāṃ śaktirūpeṇeti| na paśvarthaḥ svarūpeṇa pratyayārtho
bhavitumarhatīti yuktamuktampaśau kartarīti| evaṃ sarvatra
pratyayārtaviśeṣaṇaṃ draṣṭavyam||
phalegrahirātmambhariśca|| 3|2|26 ||
phalegrahirātmambhariśca|| upapadasyaikārāntamiti|
cchandasyakārāntatvamapi ddaśyate---yā vanaspatīnāṃ phalagrahiriti| sa
kukṣimbharivaccakāreṇa samuccetavyaḥ||
cchandasi vanasanarakṣimathām|| 3|2|27 ||
cchandasi vanasanarakṣimathām|| vana ṣaṇa saṃbhaktāviti| gaṇe
sahapaṭhitayo rbhauvādikayoreva grahaṇam, na tu ṭhvanu yācane' ṭhṣaṇu
dāne' iti tānādikayoriti bhāvaḥ| atra sāhacaryameva hetuḥ,
niranubandhakatvaṃ ca| brahmavanimiti| brahma vanati, kṣatraṃ vanatīti
vivakṣayāmin pratyayaḥ, tadantād dvitīyaikavacanam| gausanimiti|
gāṃsanatoti vigrahaḥ| pathirakṣī iti| panthānaṃ rakṣata iti vigrahaḥ|
havirmathantīti havirmathayasteṣāṃ hadirmathīnām||
ejeḥ khaśa|| 3|2|28 ||
ejeḥ khaśa|| ṇyantāditi| ejestvayamikā nirdeśo na bhavati; khaśaḥ
śitkaraṇāt| taddhi sārvadhātukatve sati śabyathā syāditi| na caijeḥ
prakṛtyantarasya śapi satyasati vā viśeṣo'sti| na cevamihārthatve
sambhavati, kevalotarārthatvaṃ yuktam| sitkaraṇaṃ mumarthamiti|
khitkāryopalakṣaṇametat| śunindhayaḥ nāḍindhayaḥ, nāsikandhaya iti
hrasvatvamapi prayojanam| śakāraḥ sāvadhātukārtha iti|
sārvadhātukasaṃjñārtha ityarthaḥ| vātaśunītyādi| vātādiṣu
yathāsaṃkhyamupapadeṣu ajādibhyo dhātubhyaḥ khaś pratyayo bhavati|
śarddhajahā iti| ṭhohāk tyāge' juhotyāditvācchapaḥ ślau
dvirvacane ṭhśnābhyastayorātaḥ' ityākāralopaḥ||
nāsikāstanayordhmādheṭoḥ|| 3|2|29 || 
nāsikāstanayordhmādheṭoḥ|| nāsikandhama iti| pāghrādisūtreṇa
dhamādeśaḥ| taccaitadityādinā yathāsaṃkhyābhāve hetumāha, taccaitat
yathāsaṃkhyābhāvalakṣaṇaṃ kāryam| etena ca vyākhyātṛṇāṃ mūlatvena
sūtrakārasyāpyatra kiṃcidabhipretamityetāvatpradarśyate| tenaitanna
nodanīyam-----utarasūtravatpratyekamabhisambandhaḥ kasbhānna bhavati,
viparyayo vā kasmānna bhavatīti| stanandhayati| atraiva ṅībiṣyate,
nānyatretyāhuḥ||
nāḍīmuṣṭa|leśca|| 3|2|30 ||
nāḍīmuṣṭa|leśca|| ghaṭindhamaḥ, kharindhama iti| ghaṭīughaṭaḥ,
kharīugarddabhī, jātilakṣaṇo ṅīṣ| khārītyanye paṭhanti sa ca
parimāṇavacanaḥ| vātaśabdo na ddaṣṭaḥ||
udi kūle rujivahoḥ|| 3|2|31 ||
udi kūle rujivahoḥ|| yatra pratyekamupapadatvamicchati tatra
samudāyātsaptamīmuccārayati, yathā---nāḍīmuṣṭa|leriti| iha tu
viparyayaḥ kṛtaḥ; tasmāt ṭhudi' iti satsaptamī| ṭhkūle' iti
tvarthanirapekṣaivopapadasaṃjñāyāṃ liṅgam| tatra ca ṭhte prāgdhātoḥ'
iti ucchaśabdasya dhātoḥ prāk prayogaḥ| tataḥ pūrvaḥ kūlaśabdaḥ|
tadetaddarśitam----utpūrvābhyāṃ kūle karmaṇyupapada iti||
vahābhre lihaḥ|| 3|2|32||
parimāṇe pacaḥ|| 3|2|33 ||
parimāṇe pacaḥ|| parimāṇaśabdaḥ kāṣṭhādinirmite prasthādau vartate,
na tasya likledavācinā pacinā karmatvenānvayaḥ| ato na
svarūpagrahaṇam, kiṃ tarhi? tadviśeṣāḥ prasthādayo gṛhyante, te ca
parimeye parimeye vrīhyādau ca vartante| tatra parimāṇaniṣṭhānāṃ na
pacinānvaya iti parimeyaniṣṭheṣu pratyayaḥ| na tarhi
parimāṇavācitvam, na; parimāmādhyāropeṇa parimeye
prasthādiśabdasya pravṛteḥ||
mitanakhe ca|| 3|2|34 ||
mitanakhe ca|| nakhampaceti| paciratra tāpavacanaḥ||
vidhvaruṣostudaḥ|| 3|2|35 ||
vidhvaruṣostudaḥ|| aruntuda iti| ṭharurdviṣadajantasya mum' iti
ukārātparo mum, saṃyogāntasya lopaḥ||
asūryalalāṭayorddaśitapoḥ|| 3|2|36 ||
asūryalalāṭayorddaśitapoḥ|| asūryampaśyā iti| pāghrādisūtreṇa
paśyādeśaḥ| guptaparaṃ caitaditi| yadvacanam---ṭhasūryampaśyā
rājadārāḥ' iti, etad guptipradhānam; tena satyapi sūryadarśane
prayogo na viruddhyata iti bhāvaḥ| guptiparatvameva prakaṭayati evaṃ
nāmeti||
ugrampaśyerammadapāṇindhamāśca|| 3|2|37 ||
ugrampaśyerammadapāṇindhamāśca|| ugra paśyatīti| kriyāviśeṣaṇametat|
irammada iti| ṭhmadī harṣe' divāditvācchayani prāpte tadabhāvo
nipātanāt| irāūdakam| pāṇindhamāḥ panthāna iti| te punaryeṣu
gacchadbhiḥ sarpādyapanodanāya pāṇayo dhmāyanteuśabdyante||
priyavaśe vadaḥ khac|| 3|2|38 ||
priyavaśe vadaḥ khac|| cakāraḥ khaci hrasvaḥ iti viśeṣaṇārtha iti| ṭhkhe
hrasvaḥ' ityucyamāne ṭhejeḥ khaś' aṅgamejayaḥ, janamejayaḥ---atrāpi
prāpnoti?ṭhekānubandhakagrahaṇe na dvyanubandhakasya' ityatra na
bhaviṣyati| iha tarhi---ṭhkulātkhaḥ' kulīnaḥ, yasyeti lopanivṛtaye
hrasvaḥ syāt? tatra dhātupratyayasya grahaṇaṃ tatprakaraṇasāhacaryādeṣa
cintyaprayojanaścakāraḥ| pratyayāntarakaṇamutarārthamiti| ṭhdviṣantapaḥ'
ityatra hrasvaṇilopauyayāsyātām, śap ca mā bhūditi| yadyevam,
utaratraiva kartavye iha karaṇe kiṃ prayojanam? anyebhyo'pi bhavatīti
jñāpanārtham| tena ṭhgameḥ supyupasaṃkhyānam' iti na vaktavyaṃ bhavati|
mitaṅgama iti| asaṃjñārthamidam, saṃjñāyāṃ tu ṭhgamaśca' iti
vakṣyamāṇenaiva siddham|
dviṣatparayostāpeḥ|| 3|2|39 ||
dvipatparayostāpeḥ|| dviṣantapa iti| mumi saṃyogāntalopaḥ|
dvitakārako nirdeśa iti| tatraikena dviṣacchabdo
viśeṣyate-----takārānto yo dviṣacchabda iti, sautratvānnirddeśasya
viśeṣaṇasya paranipātaḥ| tena striyāṃ na bhavatīti| anyathā
liṅgaviśiṣṭaparibhāṣayā syādeva prasaṅga iti bhāvaḥ||
vāci yamo vrate|| 3|2|40 ||
vāci yamo vrate|| śāstri iti| śāstraśabdādvidhāne dhātvarthe ṇic,
tadantātkarmaṇi ktaḥ| śāstre vihitaḥ, śāstreṇa vāuśāstritaḥ| niyama
iti| saṅkalpaviśeṣaḥ| vācaṃyama iti| ṭhvācaṃyamapurandarau ca' iti
pūrvapadasyāmantatvam| tata eva tarhi nipātanātpratyayo bhaviṣyati|
vratādanyatrāpi tarhi prāpnoti? tatraiva bratagrahaṇaṃ
kariṣyate----ṭhvācaṃyamo brate purandaraśca' iti,
tadetaccintyaprayojanam| etena purandaro vyākhyātaḥ|
vāgyāma iti| yo'śaktyādinā vācaṃ yacchati tatrāṇeva bhavati||
pūḥ sarvayordārisahoḥ|| 3|2|41 ||
pūḥ sarvayordārisahoḥ|| ṭhdda vidāraṇe' ityasya grahaṇam; na ṭhdda
bhaye',ṭhddaṅ ādare'-----ityetayorityupadeśaḥ| asaṃjñārthaṃ
sahigrahaṇam, saṃjñāyāṃ tu vakṣyati| sarvesaho rājeti| sarva
saṃpādayituṃ samartha ityarthaḥ||
sarvakūlābhrakarīṣeṣu kaṣaḥ|| 3|2|42 ||
meghartibhayeṣu kṛñaḥ|| 3|2|43 ||
meghartibhayeṣu kṛñaḥ|| karoteriti| kṛṇotestu
pūrvavadevāgrahaṇam| śivaṃkara ityapi cchandasi ddaśyate----śiva eko
dhyeyaḥ śivaṃkara iti||
kṣemapriyamadre'ṇ ca|| 3|2|44 ||
āśite bhuvaḥ karaṇabhāvayoḥ|| 3|2|45 ||
āśite bhuvaḥ karaṇabhāvayoḥ|| atra supītyupatiṣṭhate iti| na tu
karmaṇīti, bhavaterakarmakatvāt| sopasargātprāptyarthācca khacā na
bhavitavyam, anabhidhānāditi bhāvaḥ| āśitaśabdo'yam ṭhaśa bhojane'
ityasmādāṅpūrvādavivakṣite karmaṇi ktapratyayānto gṛhyate---āśitaḥ
karteti, yasyādyaudātatvaṃ vidhāsyate| yastu
ṭhdhrauvyagatipratyavasānārthebhyaḥ' iti bhāvakarmādhikaraṇeṣu ktaḥ, na
tadanto gṛhyate, anabhidhānādityāhuḥ| anye tvaśerṇyāntātprayojye
karmaṇi ktapratyaye kṛte ya āśitaśabdaḥ sa gṛhyate| evamāśitaḥ karteti
yasyādyaudātatvaṃ tatrāpi prayojya eva bhūtapūrvagatyā kartocyate,
ṭhgatibuddhipratyavasānārtha'iti aṇau karturṇau karmasaṃjñāvidhānāt|
tathā ca kṛṣannitphāla āśitaṃ kṛṣṇotīti ādyaudātasyāvagraho na
ddaśyate| kartṛgrahaṇaṃ tu tatra bhāvanivṛtyarthamiti| āśitambhava odana
iti| yāvataudanenātithyādirāśito bhavati sa evamucyate||
saṃjñāyāṃ bhṛtṛvṛjidhārisahitapidamaḥ|| 3|2|46 ||
saṃjñāyāṃ bhṛtṛvṛjidhārisahitapidamaḥ|| saṃjñāvaśādityādi|
ṭhśatruntapaḥ' ityādau yatra karmārthānugamastatra karmaṇīti sambadhyate|
yatra tu na rathantaramityādau tatra supīti| arindama iti|
antarbhāvitaṇyartho damiḥ sakarmako bhavati||
gamaśca|| 3|2|47 ||
gamaśca|| yogavibhāga utarārtha iti| utaratra gamerevānuvṛttiryathā
syād, bhṛtṛprabhṛtīnāṃ mā bhūt||
antātyantādhvadūrapārasarvānanteṣu ḍaḥ|| 3|2|48 ||
antātyantādhvadūrapārasarvānanteṣu ḍaḥ|| anubandhakaraṇasāmarthyāditi|
śravaṇārthastu ḍakāro na bhavati, ṭhpādasya padājyātigopahateṣu' iti
kṛtaṭilopasya ḍapratyayāntasya nirdeśāt|
atrātyantānantagrahaṇamanarthakam, antaśabdo'tra gṛhyate, tena karmaṇo
viśeṣaṇātadantavidhirbhaviṣyati| upapadavidhau tu na sarvatra
tadantavidhiḥ, upapadavidhau tadādyādigrahaṇamiti niyamāt| pannaṃ
patitaṃ yathā gacchatīti pannagaḥ| ṭhsuduroradhikaraṇe' iti karmaṇi
khaleva bhavati----sugamaḥ, durgama iti| anyatrāpi ddaśyata iti| evaṃ ca
sūtramapi prapañcārtham||
āśiṣi hanaḥ|| 3|2|49 ||
āśiṣi hanaḥ|| dārāviti| dāruśabda ityarthaḥ| śabdāpekṣayā
puṃlliṅgaḥ,ṭavidhānārtha vacanam, aṇ ṭhkarmaṇyaṇ' ityeva siddhaḥ|
antagrahaṇaṃ vispaṣṭārtham, ṭhalo'ntyasya' ityeva siddham||
ape kleśatamasoḥ|| 3|2|50 ||
kumāraśīrṣayorṇiniḥ|| 3|2|51 ||
kumāraśīrṣayorṇiniḥ|| ṭhsupyajātau' iti siddhe'tācchītyārthamidaṃ
vacanam,śirasaḥ, śīrṣabhāvārtha ca||
lakṣaṇe jāyāpatyoṣṭak|| 3|2|52 ||
lakṣaṇe jāyāpatyoṣṭak|| lakṣaṇavatīti| etenārśa ādyacpratyayānto
lakṣaṇaśabda iti darśayati| etacca sūtrārambhādevāvasīyate, kevale hi
lakṣaṇe utareṇaiva siddhaḥ pratyayaḥ| jāyādhno brāhmaṇa iti| yasya
tilakālādi jāyāmaraṇaliṅgamasti sa tāṃ hantīti gauṇo gadaḥ|
etena patighnī vyākhyātā| ṭhgamahana' ityupadhālopaḥ, ṭitvānṅīp||
amanuṣyakartṛke ca|| 3|2|53 ||
amanuṣyakartṛke ca|| amanuṣyaśabdo rakṣaḥ piśācādiṣu rūḍha iti
pūrvamuktam, iha tu manuṣyādanyaḥ sarva eva gṛhyate| nanu yathā
pūrvasūtre lakṣaṇagrahaṇaṃ pratyayārthasya kartuviśeṣaṇam,
evamihāpyamanuṣyagrahaṇaṃ bhaviṣyatīti nārthaḥ kartṛgrahaṇena?
ṭhamanuṣye' ityucyamāne upapadatvamapi vijñāyeta, tasmātkartṛ
grahaṇam| kṛtaghnaśabdo mūlavibhujādiṣu draṣṭavyaḥ|| 
śaktau hastikapāṭayoḥ|| 3|2|54 ||
śaktau hastikapāṭayoḥ|| viṣeṇa hastinaṃ hantīti| nanvatrāpyaśaktasya
kartṛtvānupapaterastyeva śaktiḥ? satyam;
śaktigrahaṇasāmarthyātprakarṣavijñānādanyatirapekṣasvabalenaiva hantuṃ yā
śaktiḥ sā gṛhyate, taddarśayati----hastinaṃ hantuṃ samartho hastidhno
manuṣya iti| evaṃ ca hastinaṃ hantu mā vā vadhīt
sāmarthyayogāddhastighna ityucyate| 
kaṃ pāṭayati praviśata iti| kapāṭaśabdaṃ vyutpādayati| kavāṭamiti tu
prasiddhaḥ, tatrāṭateḥ pacādyac| ṭhkavaṅ coṣṇo' iti
yogavibhāgātkoḥ kavādeśaḥ||
pāṇighatāḍaghau śilpini|| 3|2|55 ||
āḍha|lsubhagasthūlapalitanagnāndhapriyeṣu cvyartheṣvacvau kṛñaḥ karaṇe
khyun|| 3|2|56 ||
āḍha|lsubhagasthūlapalitanagnāndhapriyeṣu cvyartheṣvacvau kṛñaḥ karaṇe
khyun|| āḍhyadiṣviti| anena āḍhyadīnāmupapadatvaṃ darśayati|
karaṇe kārake ityanenāpi karaṇasya pratyayārthatvam| athaivaṃ kasmānna
vijñāyate---karaṇa upapade āḍhyadiṣu kartṛṣviti?
ucyate----ṭhcvyartheṣvaccau' iti vacanād āḍhyadiśabdāḥ
svarūpapradhānāḥ, na ca śabdānāṃ kartṛtvamupapadyate| nanu ca śravaṇena
karoti sukhamāḍhyaśabda ityatra śabdasyāpi kartṛtvaṃ sambhavati? evaṃ
tarhi vyākhyānātathā nāśrīyate| acvāviti tatpuruṣo bahuvrīhirvā,
acvyanta ityarthaḥ| pratyekaṃ sambandhātvekavacanam| kathaṃ
punacvyarthāśca bhavantyacavyantāśca bhavantītyāha----cvevikalpena
vidhānāditi| āḍha|lṅkaraṇamiti| khyunaḥ khakāro mumarthaḥ,
liṅgaviśiṣṭaparibhāṣayā strāliṅgaṣvāḍhyadiṣūpapadeṣu
hrasvārthaśca| nakāraḥ svarārthaḥ| yoranādaśaḥ|
abhyañcayantītyartha iti| anekārthatvāddhātūnām| tenātra prāganāḍhayaḥ
sannāḍhayaḥ kriyata iti abhūtatadbhāvābhāvaḥ| bhavatu vā'bhūtatadbhāvaḥ,
tathāpi yuktamevedaṃ pratyudāharaṇamityāha---prakṛteravivakṣāyāmiti|
prakṛtireva pariṇāmitvena yatra vivakṣyate, yathā-----tantavaḥ paṭo
bhavatīti, tadā cvipratyayaḥ, tathā ca
vārtikam----ṭhprakṛtivivakṣāgrahaṇaṃ ca' iti, prakṛtiḥ kāryasya
pūrvāvasthā|
acvāviti kimiti| asya vakṣyamāṇo'bhiprāyaḥ, tamāviṣkaroti----nanu
ceti| lyuṭātra bhavitavyamiti| ṭhkaraṇādhikaraṇayośca' iti| na ca
lyuṭaḥ khyunaśca viśeṣo'stīti, lyuṭi tāvadāḍhyokaraṇamiti
rūpam, svaro'pi litsvareṇotarapadādyau9dātatvam; khyunyapi
nitsvareṇādyaudātatvam, ṭhkhityanavyayasya' ṭharurdviṣadajantasya mum' iti
hrasvatvam, mum cānavyayasya vidhīyate, cvyantāścāvyayam;
ṭhūryādi cviḍācaśca' iti nipātatvāt| striyāmapyubhayatra
ṭhṭiḍḍhāṇañ' ityādinā ṅīb bhavati, ato rūpe svare ca nāsti
viśeṣaḥ| utarārthaścoti| utarasūtre khiṣṇuckhukañbhyāṃ mukte
tṛjādibhirbhavitavyamityasti viśeṣaḥ, kathaṃ tarhi
pūrvamuktam---pratiṣedhasāmarthyāditi? asminsūtre
pratiṣedhasāmarthyāditi bhāvaḥ| kevalotarārthatve hi tatraiva ṭhacvau'
ityavakṣyat, yathā vakṣyate----iha kiṃcitrapo iti| bhāṣye
tūtarārthameva sthitam||
kartari bhuvaḥ khiṣṇuckhukañau|| 3|2|57 ||
kartari bhuvaḥ khiṣṇuckhulañau||kartagrahaṇaṃ karaṇanivṛtyartham,
utarārthaṃ ca, khakāro mumarthaḥ, cakāraḥ svarārthaḥ, ñakāro
vṛddhyarthaśca| kimarthaṃ khiṣṇujikārādiḥ kriyate, na
khsnurityevocyeta, tatrāyamapyarthaḥ---svarārthaścakāro na kartavyo
bhavati, pratyayasvareṇaiva siddham? kenedānīmikārāditvaṃ
siddhyati? tatrāha---udātatvāditi| bhavatirayamudātaḥ,
tasyodātatvādiḍ bhaviṣyati| nañastviti| ṭhnañaḥ' iti pañcamī, naña
utarasya khiṣṇujantasya svaramiddhyarthamityarthaḥ|
yadyayamikārādirnakriyet, tataḥ satyapīṭi
ṭhkṛtyokeṣṇuccārvādayaśca' ityasya grahaṇaṃ na syād asya
cakārābhāvāt| athāsyāpi cakāraḥ kriyeta? evamapi lākṣaṇikatvāt
ṣatvaṇatvayoścāsiddhatvādiṣṇujiti rūpābhāvād grahaṇaṃ na syādeva,
tata ikārāditvaṃ kriyate| nanu ca satyapīkārāditve
ṭhtadanubandhakagrahaṇe nātadanubandhakasya',ṭhekānubandhakagrahaṇe na
dvyanubandhakasya' iti vā alaṃkṛñādīṣṇuca eva grahaṇena
bhavitavyam,nāsya? ikāroccāraṇasāmarthyādasyāpi grahaṇaṃ
bhaviṣyatīti manyate| yadyevam, khṣṇujayamastu, tatra
ṣatvaṇatvayoścakārasya caja karaṇasāmarthyādiṭi kṛte'syāpi grahaṇaṃ
siddhamiti cintyaprayojanamakārāiditvam||
spṛśo'nudake kvin|| 3|2|58 ||
spṛśo'nudake kvin|| nanu cetyādi| ṭhsupi sthaḥ'
ityatroktam----sakarmakeṣu karmaṇītyupatiṣṭhate'nyatra supīti, tataśca
subanta upapade kvin pratyaya ityuktamanupapannamiti bhāvaḥ|
tatkartṛpracayārthamiti| ṭhkartari kṛt' ityeva kartari kvinaḥ
siddhatvātkartranuvṛternānyatprayojanamastīti bhāvaḥ| kartṛpracayo
labhyata iti| karmaṇyupapada ekaḥ kartā, karaṇādau cāpara ityevaṃ
pracayo bhavati| ghṛtaspṛgiti| ṭhkvinpratyayasya kuḥ' iti śakārasya
ṣakāraḥ soṣmatvenāntaratamyāt, ṭhjhalāṃ jaśo'nte'| kvinaḥ kakāro
guṇavṛddhipratiṣedhārthaḥ, ikāraḥ ṭhverapṛktasya' iti viśeṣaṇārthaḥ|
nakāraḥ kimarthaḥ, ekājbhyo hyayaṃ vidhīyate tatra dhātusvareṇaiva
siddham? yastarhyanekāj----dadhṛgiti,
vakṣyatyetaddhṛṣerddhirvacanamantodātatvañceti? evaṃ tarhi ṭhkvinpratyayasya
kuḥ' ṭhkvipratyayasya' ityucyamāne sandehaḥ syāt----kveḥ kvipo vā
nirdeśa iti| kverapi nirdeśe pakārasya ṭhanaci ca' iti dvirvacanam||
ṛtvigdadhṛksragdiguṣṇigañcuyujikruñcāṃ ca|| 3|2|59 ||
ṛtvigdadhṛksragdiguṣṇigañcuyujikruñcāṃ ca|| ṛtau yajatīti|
vasantādike| ṛtuṃ yajatīti| yasminyāge ṛturddevatā,
yathā-----vasantāya kapiñjalānālabhate piśaṅgāstrayo vāsantā
ityṛtupaśūnālabhate, grīṣmo hemanta uta no vasantaḥ śaradvarṣā
ityādau tadabhiprāyametat| ṛtuprayukto veti| vasante vasante
jyotiṣā yajetetyādau yatkartṛtvaṃ tadabhiprāyametat| ṣatvañceti|
anyathā ṭhsātpadādyoḥ' iti niṣedhaḥ syāt| subantamātra iti| anyathā
sakarmakatvātkarmaṇyeva syāt| kevalādeveti| etatu
kvinvidhānasāmarthyādapi labhyate, na hi sopapadādyaujeḥ kvini kvipi
vā viśeṣo'sti, kutvasya ṭhcoḥ kuḥ' ityanenaiva siddhatvāt|
anupapade tu ṭhyujerasamāse' iti numi kṛte nakārasya kutvārtha
kvino vidhānaṃ bhavati sārthakam| yadi tu
nipātanasāhacaryātsopapadādanupapadācca yujeḥ kvin
bhavatītyucyeta, tadā ṭhsatsūdviṣa' ityatra yujigrahaṇaṃ śakyamakartum|
nalopaḥ kasmānna bhavatīti| ṭhkuñca kruñca kauṭilyālpībhāvayoḥ' iti
nopadhāvetau dhātū| tathā nikucitiriti nalopo ddaśyate,
cutvena tu jakārasya śravaṇam, tasyāsiddhatvāccakāre parataḥ ṭhcoḥ
kuḥ'iti kutvaṃ na bhavati| kuñcau kuñca ityādaai nakāropadhaṃ tu
paṭhatāṃ syāt, tatra saṅjhilīti vacanānna bhavatīti vaktavyam| saṅiti
pratyāhāraḥ sanaḥ saśabdādārabhyā mahiṅe ṅkārāt| anye tu
kuñcireka eva dhātuḥ, tasya kakārātparo repho'pi kvinsanniyogena
nipātyate ityāhuḥ| tadetat ṭhcoḥ kuḥ' ityatra vāmano vakṣyati||
tyadādiṣu ddaśo'nālocane kañca|| 3|2|60 ||
tyadādiṣu ddaśo'nālocane kañca|| ṭhpaśyārthaiśca' ityatra
vakṣyati----ālocanaṃ cakṣustādhanaṃ vijñānamiti, iha tu
jñānamātrapratiṣedhaṃ manyate| yāddak tāddagiti| ṭhddagddaśavatuṣu' iti
vartamāne ṭhā sarvanāmnaḥ' ityātvam| ñakāro viśeṣaṇārtha iti|
ādyaudātatvasya nakāreṇāpi siddhatvāt ñakāropadhasya prayojanaṃ
viśeṣaṇamevetyarthaḥ, na tu svaro na prayojanamityucyate| taṃ
paśyati taddarśa iti cakṣurvijñāne'ṇeva bhavati| kathaṃ punaḥ
prayujyamānasyaiva ddaśeranālocanārthatvamityāha---tāddaśādayo
rūḍhiśabdā iti| tataḥ kimityāha---naivātreti| rūḍhiśabdā
hyasatāpyavayavārthena vyutpādyante, yathā----tailapāyikādayaḥ|
etadarthamevānālocana ityuktam| ddaśyarthābhāve'yaṃ vidhiḥ, sati tu
ddaśyarthe'ṇeva bhavatīti| bhāṣye tu karmakartari
vyutpattirdarśitā----tamivemaṃ paśyanti janāḥ so'yaṃ sa iva
ddaśyamānastamivātmānaṃ paśyatīti| tatra karmavyāpāramātre vā
ddaśervṛttiḥ, kṛtsnadhātvarthādhyāropo vā
saukaryādiśayapratipādanāyeti draṣṭavyam|
samānānyośceti| samānasya ddagddaśavatuṣu sabhāvavidhānātsiddham|
ksaśceti| tyadādiṣu samānānyośca| tāddakṣaḥ, saddakṣaḥ, anyāddakṣa iti|
ṭhddakṣe ceti' vaktavyam' iti sabhāva ātvaṃ ca||
satsūdviṣadruhaduhayujavidabhidacchidajinīrājāmupasarge'pi kvip||
3|2|61 ||
satsūdviṣadruhaduhayujavidabhidacchidajinīrājāmupasarge'pi kvip||
ataḥ prabhṛtīti| bhāṣyakāraprayogātprabhṛtiśabdayoge pañcamī| vadaḥ
supi kyap ceti| prayojanadigiyaṃ darśitā| atra hyanupasarga iti
vartate, tasmāt ṭhspṛśo'nudake kvin' ityādau prayojanaṃ
draṣṭavyam| suvateriti| nyāyasya tulyatvāddaivādikasyāpyagrahaṇam| 
śuciṣaditi| chāndaso'yaṃ prayogaḥ-----haṃsaḥ śuciṣaditi|
ṭhpūrvapadāt' iti ṣanvam| śucisaditi pāṭhe laukikaḥ prayogaḥ|
kathamatra ṇatvamiti| grāmaṇīviṣayaḥ praśnaḥ| praṇīrityatra tu
ṭhupasargādasamāse'pi' iti ṇatvamastyeva| jñāpakāditi|
pūrvapadasthānnimitādutarasya nayatinakārasyāsañjñāyāmapi ṇatvaṃ
bhavatīti sāmānyena jñāpakamityarthaḥ| tenāgraṇīrityatrāpi bhavati|
karmaṇyaṇi tu na bhavati, nīrūpaviṣayatvāj jñāpanasya | anye tu
ṭhagragrāmābhyāṃ nayateriti vaktavyam' iti vacanājjñāpanamapi
tadviṣayam, tatrāpi nīrūpaviṣayamiti sthitāḥ||
bhajo ṇivaḥ|| 3|2|62 ||
cchandasi sahaḥ|| 3|2|63 ||
cchandasi sahaḥ|| turāsāhaṃ purodhāya, pṛtanāṣāṭ dviṣo yoddhuṃ
puruhūtaḥ pṛtanāṣāḍ iti bhāṣāyāṃ prayogāścintyāḥ||
vahaśca|| 3|2|64 ||
kavyapurīṣapurīṣyeṣu ñcuṭ|| 3|2|65 ||
havye'nantaḥ pādam|| 3|2|66 ||
janasanakhanakramagamo viṭ|| 3|2|67 ||
janasanakhanakramagamo viṭ|| viśeṣaṇārthaścoti| ṭhvivanoḥ'
ityucyamāne hi kvibādīnāmapi grahaṇaṃ syāt| athātra
niranubandhakatvādasyaiva grahaṇam? ṭhverapṛktasya' ityatrāpyasyaiva grahaṇaṃ
syāt| athātra kvibādīnāmapi grahaṇaṃ syāt?
ṭhviḍvanoranunāsikasyāt' ityatrāpi syāditi samānaṃ vaca iti
bhāvaḥ| goṣā iti| ṭhsanoteranaḥ' iti ṣatvam| agregā iti|
pūrvavadaluk||
ado'nanne|| 3|2|68 ||
ado'nanne|| annāda iti| bhāṣāyāmaṇeva bhavati| cchandasi
tvakārādanupapadādityaṇi prāpte pacādyajiṣyate, tenānnāda ityanna
ityanna ada ityavagraho bhavati||
kravye ca|| 3|2|69 ||
kravye ca|| vā'sarūpabādhanārthamiti| tathā ca vārtikam----ado'nanne
kravyagrahaṇaṃ vāsarūpanivṛtyarthamiti| kathaṃ tarhīti| yadi
vā'sarūpavidhibādhanārthamiti bhāvaḥ| kṛtavikṛteti| kṛtaṃ cchinnaṃ
tadeva punarviśeṣataḥ kṛtamiti ṭhpūrvakāla' iti samāsaḥ, tasya
pakvaśabdena punaḥ sa eva samāsaḥ, tato māṃsaśabdena
punarviśeṣaṇasamāsaḥ| pṛṣodarāditvātkravyabhāva iti| yadyevam,
kravyāda ityasya rūpasyāvarjanīyatvādalaṃ vā'sarūpabādhanārthenānena
vacanena, vārtikavirodhaścaivaṃ vadata
ityāśaṅkyāha----kṛtavikṛtetyādi| arthamedādubhayamapi nāsti
kiletyayamabhiprāyaḥ||
duhaḥ kabdhaśca|| 3|2|70 ||
duhaḥ kabdhaśca|| kāmadudheti| kāmyante iti kāmāḥ, tān dugdhe
kāmadughā arghaḥumadhuparkaḥ||
mantreśvetavahokśāspurāḍāśo ṇvin|| 3|2|71 ||
mantreśvetavahokśāspurāḍāśo ṇvin|| etebhya iti|
śvetādipūrvebhyo vahādibhyo dhātubhya ityarthaḥ| dhātūpapadasamudāyā
iti| kimarthamityāha---alākṣaṇiketi| ṭhśvetavāḥ' ityādiṣu ṭhavayāḥ
śvetavāḥ puroḍāśca' iti nipātanādrutvam| ukthaśā iti| nalope
ṭhata upadhāyāḥ' iti vṛddhiḥ, rutvam|
ḍaspadasyeti| pratyekamabhisambaddhyate, bhāvipadatvāśrayeṇa
cedamucyate, yatra ḍasantasya padatvaṃ bhaviṣyati tatra ṇvino'pavādo
ḍaspratyayo vaktavya ityarthaḥ| yadyevam, anena ḍasi kṛte sau
ṭhatvasantasya' iti dīrghe rutve ca śvetavā ityādi siddham, nārthaḥ
ṭhavayāḥ śvetavāḥ' iti nipātanena? evaṃ tarhi sambuddhyartha
nipātanam---he śvetavā indreti, ṭhatvasantasya' ityatra hi ṭhasambuddhau'
iti vartate, ḍasapi vaktavyaḥ| utvārtham----śvetavobhyām,
ukthaśobhyāmiti| evaṃ cokyaśā ityapi sambuddhyartha nipātanaṃ
kartavyaṃ yadi mantre darśanamastri||
ave yajaḥ|| 3|2|72 ||
ave yajaḥ|| avayā iti| nipātanādrutvam| yogavibhāga utarārtha iti|
ṭhpuroḍāśavayajo ṇvin' ityekayoge
śvetavahādīnāmapyutaratrānuvṛttiḥ syāt,
yajeścāvapūrvasyaivānuvṛttiḥ syāt, kevalasyaiva ceṣyate, tadartho
yogavibhāga ityarthaḥ||
vijupe cchandasi|| 3|2|73 ||
vijupe cchandasi|| atha cchandograhaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā mantra
ityanuvṛterevabhāṣāyāṃ na bhaviṣyati, tatrāha---cchandograhaṇaṃ
brāhmaṇārthamiti| mantravyatirikto vedabhāgaḥubrāhmaṇam,
yathoktam---taccodakeṣu mantrākhyā, śeṣe brāhmaṇaśabda iti| 
kimartha punaridamiti| utarasūtra eva vijgrahaṇaṃ cchandograhaṇaṃ ca
kriyatāmiti praśnaḥ| niyamārthamiti| nanu ddaśigrahaṇādeva bhāṣāyāṃ na
bhaviṣyati, satyam; tasyaiva prapañcārthamidam||
āto maninkvanibvanipaśca|| 3|2|74 ||
āto maninkvanibvanipaśca|| aśva iva tiṣṭhati aśvatthāmā,
pṛṣodarāditvātsakārasya takāraḥ| sudhīvā, supīveti|
ghumāsthādisūtreṇa ītvam| cakāro vico'nukarṣaṇārthaḥ| yadyevam,
utaratrānuvṛttirna syāt? evaṃ tarhi cakāro'pyutaratrānuvartiṣyate||
anyebhyo'pi ddaśyate|| 3|2|75 ||
anyebhyo'pi ddaśyate|| apiśabdaḥ sarvavidhivyabhicārārtha iti|
vidhīyate'neneti vidhiḥūpādhiḥ| sarvopādhivyabhicārārtha iti yuktaḥ
pāṭhaḥ| ddaśigrahaṇaṃ prayogānusaraṇārthamiti| ṭhyathā prayoge ddaśyante
tathaiva bhavanti' iti vacanavyaktyāśrayeṇeti bhāvaḥ||
kvip ca|| 3|2|76 ||
kvip ca|| nirupapadebhyaśceti| etadapiśabdasya
sarvopādhivyabhicārārthaśyānuvṛterlabhyate, na tu supītyasya
nivṛteḥ; utarasūtre ṭhsupyupasarge'pīti vartate' iti
vakṣyamāṇatvāt, ṭhcchandasi bhāṣāyāñca' iti pūrvasūtra eva ṭhcchandasi'
ityasya nivṛtatvāt| ukhāsraditi| ṭhsraṃsu dhvaṃsu bhraṃsu
avasraṃsane',ṭhaniditām' ityupadhālopaḥ, ṭhvasusraṃsu' ityādinā
datvam| vāhabhraḍiti| ṭhbhraṃśu adhaḥ patane',vraścādinā ṣatvam,
ṭhanyeṣāmapi ddaśyate' iti dīrghaḥ| ukhāyāḥ sraṃsate parṇāni, dhvaṃsate,
vāhād bhraśyatīti vigrahaḥ| dhvaṃsirantarbhāvitaṇyarthaḥ sakarmakaḥ|
kvacitu vṛtāveva vigrahavākyāni paṭha|lnte||
sthaḥ ka ca|| 3|2|77 ||
sthaḥ ka ca|| ketyavibhaktiko nirdeśaḥ| anyebhyo'pi ddaśyata iti|
kvibiti siddha evetyapekṣate| nanu tacchīlādigrahaṇaṃ tatrānuvartate,
tasmāt ṭhkvip ca' iti kvip siddha eveti vaktavyam| yadvā
tacchīlādigrahaṇaṃ tatra na sambandhanīyamiti manyate| nanvevamapi ṭhsupi
sthaḥ' iti viśeṣavihitaḥ kaḥ sāmānyavihitaṃ kvipaṃ bādheta?
vā'sarūpavidhinā so'pi bhaviṣyati| śami dhātoḥ saṃjñāyāmacam
bādhata iti| anyathā yathā kṛño hetvādiṣu ṭṃa bādhate
dhātugrahaṇātathā tiṣṭhaterapi kakvipau bādheta, atastamapyacaṃ
bādhitvā kakvipāveva yathā syātāmiti punarvacanamityarthaḥ| śaṃsthā
iti| kvipi lupte pratyayalakṣaṇena ghumāsthādisūtreṇetvamatra
prāpnoti, bhāṣyakāraprayogātu na bhavati|
kecitu---ītvamavakārādāviti vacanaṃ paṭhanti, teṣāṃ supīvā
sudhīvā, atrāpi na syāt||
supyajātau ṇinistācchīlye|| 3|2|78 ||
supyajātau ṇinistācchīlye|| brāhmaṇānāmantrayiteti| tācchīlyasya
vivakṣitatvātṛn pratyudāhṛtaḥ, ṭhna lokāvyaya' iti ṣaṣṭhīpratiṣedhaḥ|
utpratibhyāmiti| punaḥ
subgrahaṇasyopasarganivṛtyarthatvādayamārambhaḥ|
sādhukāriṇi ceti| atācchīlyārthamidam, taccaitajjñāpakātsiddhaṃ
yadayam ṭhākvestacchīla' ityatra tacchīletyabhidhāya sādhukārigrahaṇaṃ
karoti, tajjñāpayati---sādhukāriṇyatācchīlye'pi ṇinirbhavatīti|
brahmaṇi vada iti| brahmauvedaḥ| idamapyatācchīlyārtham||
kartaryupamāne|| 3|2|79 ||
kartaryupamāne|| upamānasyopemeyāpekṣatvāt kartari ca
pratyayavidhānātasyaivopapadakartopamānaṃ vijñāyeta
ityāha---upapadakarteti| uṣṭrakrośīti|
ivaśabdo gatārthatvādvṛtau naiva prayujyate|
samāsa upamānānāṃ śastrīśyāmādike yathā||
vrate|| 3|2|80 ||
vrate|| samudāyopādhiścāyamiti| na pratyayārthaviśeṣaṇam| tathā hi
sati vrata eva kartari pratyayaḥ syānna tadvatīti bhāvaḥ|
samudāyopādhitvameva spaṣṭayati---dhātūpapadetyādi|
kāmacāraḥuicchāpravṛttiḥ, tatprāptau satyāṃ niyamaḥ, sa ca dvividhaḥ
sambhavati---sthaṇḍile śete eva aśrāddhaṃ bhuṅkte evetyevaṃrūpo vā|
tatra pūrvake niyame yadaivāsāvaśaktyādinā'śrāddhaṃ na bhuṅkte tadaiva
vratalopaḥ prāpnoti| na caivaṃvidhaṃ śāstramasti---sthaṇḍile
śayitavyameva, aśrāddhaṃ bhoktavyameveti| asti tu sthaṇḍila eva
śayitavyam, aśrāddhameva bhoktavyamiti| ṭhvrate' iti tu śāstrito
niyamāḥ---ityuktam, tasmād dvitīyo niyamo vijñāyata
ityāha---sati śayana ityādi||
bahulamābhīkṣṇye|| 3|2|81 ||
bahulamābhīkṣṇyo|| ābhīkṣṇyaṃ paunaḥ punyamiti| punaḥ
punarbhavitari vartamānābhyāmavyayābhyāṃ bhāve ṣyañ, avyayānāṃ
bhamātre ṭilopaḥ| tācchīlyādanyaditi| etenaṭhsupyajātau'
ityanenāgatārthatvaṃ darśayati| phalānapekṣā pravṛttiḥutācchīlyam|
gāndhārādayastu vātādisāmyārtha deśācāravaśena kaṣāyādipāne
pravartante| udāharaṇeṣu ṭhāto yuk ciṇkṛtoḥ' iti yuk,
ṭhprātipadikāntanumvibhaktiṣu ca' iti ṇatvam||
manaḥ|| 3|2|82 ||
manaḥ|| manyatergrahaṇamiti| ṭhmana jñāne' ityasya daivādikasya| na
manuteriti| ṭhmanu avabodhane' ityasya tānādikasya| tipi guṇena
bhavitavyam| yadi neṣyate, saṃjñāpūrvako vidhiranityaḥ| kiṃ punaḥ
kāraṇaṃ prayatnena manotergrahaṇaṃ nivāryate, yāvatā iha dvayorapi
ṇiniḥ tadeva rūpam, na cārthabheda ityāha----utarasūtra iti||
ātmamāne khaśca|| 3|2|83 ||
ātmamāne khaśca|| cakārāṇṇiniśceti| vā'sarūpavidhinā siddho'pi
ṇiniravicchedāya samuccīyate| tena ṭhkaraṇe yajaḥ' ityatra
ṇinerevānuvṛttirbhavati, nānantarasya khaśaḥ| ātmaśabdo'yaṃ
paravyāvṛttiṃ kurvāṇo yastatpratiyoginamarthamācaṣṭe sa
svaśabdaparyāyo gṛhyate, na cetanadravyavacanaḥ| mananaṃ mānaḥ, bhāve
ghañ, ātmano māna ātmamānaḥ----karmaṇi ṣaṣṭha|la samāsaḥ| tatra
kasyetyapekṣāyāṃ pratyayārthasya sannihitasya manturevātmana iti
gamyate, tadāha---pratyayārthaḥ karteti| darśaniyatvādinā dharmeṇeti
viśiṣṭamiti śeṣaḥ| kartari ṣaṣṭha|lastu samāso na bhavati, sarvasyā
eva matermantṛkartṛkatvāvyabhicārād| evaṃ
cetanadravyavacane'pyātmaśabde kartari ṣaṣṭha|lamavyabhicārādaviśeṣaṇaṃ
karmaṇi ṣaṣṭha|la, na tu cetanāntare karmaṇi pratyayaprasaṅgaḥ,
tasmātsvaśabdaparyāya evātmaśabdaḥ| darśanīyammanya iti| śarīradharmamapi
darśanīyatvādikamātmadharmameva manyante saṃsāriṇaḥ
śarīraśarīriṇoragnyayogolakayorivābhedaṃ manyamānāḥ|
paṇḍitammanya iti| ekasyāpyātmanassvarūpeṇa kartṛtvaṃ
paṇḍitatvādiviśiṣṭarūpeṇa karmatvaṃ ca yujyata eva|
yathoktamācāryaiḥ----
asmatprayogasambhinnā jñānasyaiva ca kartari|
bhavantī tatra saṃvitiryujyetāpyātmakartṛkā|| iti|
khaśaḥ khakāro mumarthaḥ, darśanīyammanyā kumārītyādau hrasvārthaśca|
śakāraḥ sārvadhātukasaṃjñārthaḥ, divāditvācchayan| svarastu
satiśiṣṭo'pi vikaraṇasvaraḥ sārvadhātukasvaraṃ na bādhate iti khaśa
eva bhavati, na nitsvaraḥ| darśanīyamānī devadato yajñadatasyeti|
karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī, tadapekṣayāsyāpi darśanīyaśabdasya gamakatvātsamāsaḥ||
bhūte|| 3|2|84 ||
bhūte|| yasya satā vyapavṛktā tatsarva bhūtaśabdenocyate, tatra na
jñāyate kasmin bhūte? kiṃ vā dhātvarthe? tatrāha---dhātvadhikārācceti|
caśabdaḥ pūrvoktenārthenāsya saṅgatiṃ dyotayati| dhātvarthabhūta iti|
nanu dhātvadhikārāddhātau bhūta iti yuktam, na dhātvarthe bhūta iti?
ucyate---prayoge pratyayasya dyotyaṃ bhūtatvamarthasyaiva viśeṣaṇaṃ
bhaviturhati, viśeṣaṇāntaravat, na tu śabdasya; tasya
svābhidheyapratipādane vyagratvādviśeṣaṇasambandhaṃ pratyayogyatvāt|
kiñca---nityodhāturanityatve'pi bhūtātpratyayavidiranupapannaḥ,
uccāritalakṣaṇe bhūtatve viśeṣaṇaṃ vyartha tarhyanuccāritātpratyayavidhiḥ
sambhavati| nityaścāyaṃ bhūtaśabdo'tikrāntavācīti
niṣṭhāyāmitaretarāśrayatvādaprasiddhirityacodyam||
karaṇe yajaḥ|| 3|2|85 ||
karaṇe yajaḥ|| ṇiniranuvartate na khaśiti| atrokto hetuḥ|
agniṣṭomayājīti| nanu cāgniṣṭomaśabdaḥ karmanāmadheyam,
tatkathamagniṣṭomasya yajiṃ prati karaṇatvam, na hi tadeva tatra karaṇaṃ
bhavati; idaṃ tu yuktamudāharaṇam---someneṣṭavān somayājī,
sānnāyyeneṣṭavān sānnāyyayājīti? tatrāha---agniṣṭomaḥ
phalabhāvanāyāṃ karaṇaṃ bhavatīti| satyaṃ yāga evāgniṣṭomaḥ; yāgo'pi
phalabhāvanāyāṃ karaṇam, phalasya svargāderbhavato yā bhāvanā utpādanā
tasyāmityarthaḥ| nanu dīkṣaṇīyādirudavasānīyānto
jyotiṣṭomākhyo yāga eva svargabhāvanā na tadatiriktaḥ
kaścidvyāpāro yajanasyāsti yatraḥ yāgaḥ kāraṇyamaśnute? ucyate,
dvividho yajamānavyāpāraḥ---sāmānyarūpaḥ, viśeṣarūpaśceti| tatra
samānyarūpa ābhyantara audāsīnyapracyutirūpaḥ
kṛtiprayatnādipadābhilapyaḥ; bāhmastu dīkṣaṇīyādirudavasānīyāntaḥ
prasiddha eva| evamodanaṃ pacanītyādiṣvapyātmaguṇaḥ prayatnaḥ
bāhyaścādiśrayaṇādirdraṣṭavyaḥ| phalaṃ hi prepsan tadartha prayatate,
nodāste; yato'yamupāyaṃ jijñāsate, jānīte ca, jñātvā
copāyamanutiṣṭhati| saiṣā svargādiphaloddeśena pravṛtā
kṛtirbhāvanetyucyate| sā ca bhāvyam, karaṇam, itikartavyatāṃ ceti
tritayamapekṣate---idamanenetthaṃ bhāvayediti| yathāha----
bhāvanāpekṣyamāṇā hi sādhanaṃ ki phalasya me|
sādhanānugrahaḥ ko vetyanṛsyūtamapekṣate|| iti||
saiṣā sāmānyarūpā vṛttirna śāstrakaṭākṣamapekṣate| viśeṣarūpā
tvapekṣate, tathā hi---phalārthī tadupāyaṃ jijñāsate, tadupāyaṃ
jijñāsamānaḥ śrṛṇoti---jyotiṣṭomenasvargakāmo yajeteti| tatra
ca puruṣapravartanārūpo vidhiḥ śrūyate, na cāpuruṣārthe puruṣaḥ
pravartata iti vidhyavarūddhā bhāvanā bhāvyāpekṣāyāṃ samānapadopātamapi
duḥkharūpaṃ dhātvartamapahāya padāntaropātamapi puruṣopasarjanamapi
sukharūpaṃ svargamevāvalambate| tataḥ karaṇāpekṣāyāṃ samānapadopāto
dhātvarthaḥ karaṇaṃ bhavati, paścātsannidhisamāmnātaṃ
dīkṣaṇīyādītikartavyatayānvetītyeṣā mīmāṃsakamaryādā| yatra tu na
vidhyavarodho bhāvanāyāstatra dhātvartha eva bhāvyo bhavati,
yathā---pacati pākaṃ karoti, gacchati gamanaṃ karotītyādi
nirdiśyate| nanu bhāvanayā sampadyamānasya brāhyavyāpārasya kathaṃ tatra
karaṇatvam? ko doṣaḥ? karaṇaṃ khalu sarvatra kartṛvyāpāragocaraḥ,
kuṭhāreṇa cchinatītyatrāpi udyamananipātanarūpeṇa
kartṛvyāpāreṇāpyamānasyaiva kuṭhārasya tatra karaṇatvam, tadeva kathaṃ
dvidhābhavanarupeṇa phalenāvacchinnayostayośchedanarūpatvaṃ na
svarūpatvam, na svarūpeṇa rajake darśanāt, so'pi hi vastramudyacchate
nipātayati ca| atha dvidhābhavanābhāvānna cchinatītyucyate,
tadevamudyamananipātayośchedarūpatvaṃ kuṭhāragocaratvanibandhanamiti
tasya tatra karaṇatvam, tathehāpi bhāvanāyāṃ
svargabhāvanārūpatvamagnigṭomākhyayāgagocaratvanibandhanamiti tasya
tatra karaṇatvam| tadidamuktam---phalbhāvanāyāṃ karaṇamiti| iyaṃ hi
phalaṃ dhātvarthaṃ ca sampādayati, tatra phalabhāvanārūpatve brāhyae vyāpāraḥ
karaṇamityarthaḥ| nanvevamapi yajyartha prati agniṣṭomaḥ karaṇaṃ na
bhavati? mā bhūtatra karaṇatvam, karaṇaṃ tāvat sambandhi ca yajinā
sāmānādhikaraṇyena | atha vā---bhāvanāpi dhātoreva vācyā, na
pratyayasya; tatra dhātvarthaikadeśa ekadeśāntarasya karaṇam,
agniṣṭomaśabdaśca tatraikadeśāntare vartata iti na
kiñcidanupapannam||
karmaṇi hanaḥ|| 3|2|86 ||
karmaṇi hanaḥ|| kutsitagrahaṇamiti| pitṛvyavadhādinā yaḥ kartā
kutsyate tatrāyaṃ pratyaya iti vaktavyamityarthaḥ||
brahmabhrūṇavṛtreṣu kvip|| 3|2|87 ||
brahmabhrūmavṛtreṣu kvip|| dhātūpapadakālapratyayaviṣayaḥ| bhāṣye
tūpapadaviṣayaniyamadvayaṃ pradarśitam, tadupalakṣaṇam, na tu
niyamāntaravyāvṛtyarthamiti gamyate| brahmādiṣveva hanteriti
dhātuniyamaḥ, atrāpi niyame bhūta ityāśrayaṇāt kālāntare
upapadāntare'pi bhavatyeva----puruṣaṃ hanti haniṣyati vā puruṣaheti|
brahmādiṣu hanterevetyupapadaniyamaḥ, atrāpi bhūta
ityāśrayaṇātkālāntare dhātvantarādapi bhavatyeva---vṛtraṃ jayati
jeṣyati vā vṛtrajiditi| bhūtakāle kvibeveti kālaniyamaḥ| nānyaḥ
pratyaya iti| yathā ṭhkarmaṇi hanaḥ' ṭhkarṇaṇyaṇ' iti| upapadāntare tu
bhate'pi pratyayāntaraṃ bhavatyeva--pitṛvyaṃ hatavānpitṛvyaghātīti,
sopapadaśca pratyayo niyamena vyāvartyate| niṣṭhā tu
bhavatyeva---vṛtraṃ hatavāniti| tathā bhūta eveti pratyayaniyamaḥ, atrāpi
brahmādiṣu hanterityāśrayaṇādupapadāntare dhātvantarācca
kālāntare'pi bhavatyeva| kathaṃ punarekasminneva yoge caturvidho
niyamo labhyate? ityāha---tadetaditi| agṛhyamāṇaviśeṣatvādeva
caturvidho niyamo labdhuṃ śakyate, tatraiva tūpodvalakametaduktaṃ
veditavyam| 
bahulaṃ cchandasi|| 3|2|88 ||
sukarmapāpamantrapuṇyeṣu kṛñaḥ|| 3|2|89 ||
sukarmapāpamantrapuṇyeṣu kṛñaḥ|| svādiṣviti| suśabdaṃ
varjayitvetyanantaramevābhidhānādatadguṇasaṃvijñāno bahuvrīhiḥ,
bāhulyāśrayaṇenaivamuktam, āḍhyo grāma itivat|
trividhaśceti| etadvahulagrahaṇānuvṛtereva labhyate|
kālopapadapratyayaviṣaya iti| tatra kālaniyamātkarma kṛtavānkarmakāra
ityaṇ na bhavati| upapadaniyamāt mantramadhīmadhītavānmantrādhyāya
ityaṇeva bhavati, na tu kvip| pratyayaniyamāt mantraṃ karoti
kariṣyati veti vivakṣāyāmaṇeva bhavati, na tu kvip śāstrakṛditi|
ṭhkvip ca' iti kvip||
some suñaḥ|| 3|2|90 ||
some suñaḥ|| kāladhātūpapadapratyayaviṣaya iti| tatra bhūtakālasya
kvipi niyatatvātsomaṃ sutavānsomasāva ityaṇ na bhavati| tathā
dhātoḥ soma evopapade niyatatvātsurāṃ sutavānsurāsāva ityaṇeva
bhavati| tathā somasya sunotāveva dhātau niyatatvātsomaṃ
krītavān somakrīriti kvib na bhavati, aṇeva tu bhavati| tathā
kvipo bhūte niyatatvātsomaṃ sunoti soṣyati veti vivakṣāyāṃ
kvib na bhavati, aṇeva tu bhavati||
agnau ceḥ|| 3|2|91 ||
agnau ceḥ|| atrāpītyādi| tatra bhūtakālasya kvipi niyatatvādagniṃ
citavānagnicāya ityaṇ na bhavati| dhātoścāgnāvupapade
niyatatvādiṣṭakāciditi na bhavati| agneścinotāveva
niyatatvādagnibhṛditi na bhavati| kvipaśca bhūta eva niyatatvādagniṃ
cinoti ceṣyati vetyatrābhāvaḥ||
karmaṇyagnyākhyāyām|| 3|2|92 ||
karmaṇyagnyākhyāyām|| ṭhkarmaṇi hanaḥ' ityato'nuvṛtaṃ
karmagrahaṇamupapadam, idaṃ tu karmapratyayārthamityāha---kamaṇyeva
kāraka iti| evakāraḥ paunarvacanikaḥ| upapadaṃ tāvatkarmapratyayārtho'pi
karmaiveti| ākhyāgrahaṇaṃ rūḍhisampratyayārthamiti| agniśabdo loke
jvalane rūḍhaḥ, vede tvagnyartha iṣṭakācaye'pi pracuraḥ prayogaḥ----ya
evaṃ vidvianagniṃ cinute, agniṃ ceṣyamāṇa iti, sa mukhyo jaghanyo
vā bhavatu; iha tvasatyākhyāgrahaṇe lokaprasiddhivaśena jvalana eva
gṛhyaeta, mā grāhi, iṣṭakācaya eva gṛhyatāmityākhyāgrahaṇamityarthaḥ||
karmaṇīnirvikriyaḥ|| 3|2|93 ||
karmaṇīnirvikriyaḥ|| karmaṇīti vartamāna iti| ṭhkarmaṇi hanaḥ' ityataḥ
kartuḥ kutsānimite karmaṇīti yatkarma kriyāsambaddhaṃ kartuḥ
kutsāmāvahati tatretyarthaḥ| somādīnāṃ vikrayaḥ śāstre niṣiddhaḥ||
ddaśeḥ kvanip|| 3|2|94 ||
ddaśeḥ kvanip|| pratyayāntaranivṛtyarthamiti| pratyayāntaraṃ saha
nirdiṣṭṃa maninādi, aṇādi ca| sopapadānniṣṭhā tu
bhavatyeva---palokaṃ ddaṣṭavāniti||
rājani yudhikṛñaḥ|| 3|2|95 ||
rājani yudhikṛñaḥ|| nanu ca yudhirakarmaka iti| tatkathaṃ rājanśabde
karmavācinyupapada ityuktamiti bhāvaḥ| antarbhāvitaṇyartha iti|
anekārthathvāddhātūnāṃ lakṣaṇayā vā yadā ṇyarthamapi
yudhirevāntarbhāvayati tadā prayojyena karmaṇā sakarmako
bhavatītyarthaḥ||
sahe ca|| 3|2|96 ||
sahe ca|| asatvavacanatvānnopapadaṃ karmaṇā viśeṣyata iti| ataśca
ṭhkarmaṇi'iti nānuvartate iti bhāvaḥ| na
punaranuvartamānasyaivānnāsambandhaḥ, utaratrāpyanupayogāt||
saptamyāṃ janeīḥ|| 3|2|97 ||
saptamyāṃ janeīḥ|| manduraja iti| ṭhvājiśālā tu mandurā'|
ṭhṅyāpossaṃjñācchandasorbahulam' iti hrasvaḥ||
pañcamyāmajātau|| 3|2|98 ||
pañcamyāmajātau|| buddhyādaya ātmaguṇāḥ, khedaḥurāgaḥ, khedāt
streṣu pravṛttiriti darśanāt||
upasarge ca saṃjñāyām|| 3|2|99 ||
upasarge ca saṃjñāyām|| prajeti prāṇijātasyaiṣā saṃjñā|| 
anau karmaṇi|| 3|2|100 ||
anau karmaṇi|| pumāṃsamanujāta iti| pumāṃsamanuruddhya jāta
ityarthaḥ, tenāsya sakarmakatvam| pumanuja iti puṃsaḥ
saṃyogāntalopaḥ||
anyeṣvapi ddaśyate || 3|2|101 ||
anyeṣvapi ddaśyate|| dvirjāta iti|
māturagre vijananaṃ dvitīyaṃ mauñjibandhanam|
tatrāsya mātā sāvitrī pitā tvācārya ucyate||
niṣṭhā|| 3|2|102 ||
niṣṭhā ktaktavatū niṣṭhetyuktamiti| kakāraḥ kitkāryārthaḥ, ukāra
ugitkāryārthaḥ, ṭhatvasantasya' iti viśaṣaṇārthaśca| niṣṭhāyāmityādi|
aprasiddhiḥuaniṣpatiḥ, kasya? saṃjñāyāḥ, saṃjñino vā|
kathamityāha---saṃjñayeti| yadi dviḥ ktaktavatūpagrahaṇaṃ kriyeta--iha,
saṃjñāvidhau ca, tato na syāditaretarāśrayatvamiti saṃjñayetyuktam|
satośca tayoriti| loke śāstre vā na tāvalloke
sānubandhāvetau staḥ, śāstre'pi yadyapi ṭhñītaḥ ktaḥ' ṭhnapuṃsake bhāve
ktaḥ'iti ktaḥ svarūpeṇa vihito'sti, bhūte tu kāle nāsti, ktavatustu
na kvāpyastīti bhāvaḥ| bhāvinī saṃjñeti| saṃjñino bhāvitvāt
saṃjñāpi bhāvinī sūtraśāṭakavat tadyathā----asya sūtrasya śāṭakaṃ vayeti
tantuvāya uktaḥ, sa paśyati yadi śāṭako na vātavyaḥ, atha vātavyo na
śāṭakaḥ, śāṭako vātavyaśceti vipratiṣiddham, manye sa vātavyo
yasminnute śāṭaka ityetadbhavatīti| sāmarthyāditi| ṭhktaktavatū
niṣṭhā'iti vacanāt anyasyotpannasya niṣṭheti saṃjñāyā
abhāvaḥusāmarthyam| ādikarmaṇīti| karmaśabdaḥ kriyāvācī,
ekaphaloddeśapravṛtakṣaṇasamūharūpā kriyā, tatrādye kriyākṣaṇe'pavṛkte'pi
dhātvartharūpāyāḥ kriyāyā anapavṛktatvādvacanam| nyāyyā
tvādyapavargāt| nyāyyā tveṣā bhūtakālatā, kutaḥ? ādyapavargāt|
ādibhūtakriyākṣaṇo'pavṛktaḥ tasminneva cāvayave samūharūpo dhātvarthaḥ
parisamāptaḥ uktaṃ ca----
samūhaḥ sa tathābhūtaḥ pratibhedaṃ samūhiṣu|
samāpyate tato bhede kālabhedasya sambhavaḥ|| iti|
tathā ca prākārṣītkaṭṃa devadata iti luṅapi prayujyate| kaṭāvayave vā
kaṭaśabdo draṣṭavyaḥ, tataḥ keṣāñcitkaṭāvayavakṣaṇānāmaparisamāpteḥ
prakariṣyati kaṭṃa devadata iti lṛṭprayogo'pyaviruddhaḥ|
apara āha---jñāpakātsiddhaṃ yadayam ṭhādikarmaṇi ktaḥ' ṭhkartari
ca'ṭhudupadhādbhāvādikarmaṇoranyatarasyām' iti cāha,
tajjñāpayati---bhavatyādikarmaṇi kta iti| naitadasti jñāpakam, ṭhñītaḥ
ktaḥ' iti yo'yaṃ vartamāne ktastadviṣayametatsyāt? yadi tadviṣayameva
syādvartamānagrahaṇameva kuryāt||
suyajoṅrvanip|| 3|2|103 ||
suyajoṅrvanip|| sunoteriti| ṭhsu stru gatau',ṭhsu
prasavaiśvaryayoḥ'----ityanayoreva niranubandhakayorgrahaṇaṃ prāptam;
anabhidhānādubhayapadinā sāhacaryādvā na bhavati| ṅkāraḥ
sunoterguṇapratiṣedhārthaḥ, ikāra uccāraṇārthaḥ, pakāraḥ
svarārthastugarthaśca||
jīryateratṛn|| 3|2|104 ||
cchandasi liṭ|| 3|2|105 ||
cchandasi liṭ|| ātatāneti| ṭhṇalutamo vā' iti ṇitvapakṣe vṛddhiḥ|
dhātusambandhe sa vidhiriti| ṭhdhātusambandhe pratyayāḥ' ityadhikārāt|
liṭa ikāraṭakārau viśeṣaṇārthau, ṭhliṭaḥ kānajvā'
ṭhliṭa|lbhyāsamyobhayeṣām' ityādau ṭhla' ityucyamāne'nyeṣāmapi
laṅadīnāṃ grahaṇaṃ syāt, niranubandhakatvādasyaiva grahaṇaṃ bhaviṣyati|
parokṣe liṭo'pi tarhi na prāpnoti? ṭakāraṣṭeretvārthaśca||
liṭaḥ kānajvā|| 3|2|106 ||
liṭaḥ kānajvā|| cikyāna iti| ṭhciñ cayane',ṭhvibhāṣā ceḥ' iti
kutvam, ṭheranekācaḥ' iti yaṇādeśaḥ| na ca bhavatīti| vāvacanasya
prayojanaṃ darśayati| vā'sarūpavidhiśca lādeśeṣu nāsti,
ṭhhaśaśvatorlaṅ ca' iti vacanādityuktam| nanvanantarasūtravihitasya
liṭo nityamādeśostu, yastu ṭhcchandasi luṅlaṅliṭaḥ' iti liṭ,
tatra tiṅaṃ śravaṇaṃ bhaviṣyati? na; tasya
dhātusambandhaviṣayatvādadhātusambandhe tiṅaṃ śravaṇaṃ na syāt|
liṇmātrasya ca grahaṇamityanantarameva vakṣyati|
pūrvasyaivetyādi| pratyayāntaraṃ tu kānaj na bhavati,
vāvacanādvā'sarūpavidhinaiva luṅadīnāṃ siddhatvāditi bhāvaḥ|
liṇmātrasyeti| bhāṣye tvantarasyaiva liṭo'yamādeśaḥ, liṅgrahaṇaṃ ca
pratyayāntaratvaṃ mā vijñāyīti| vāvacanaṃ cotarārthamiti sthitam|
kānacaścitkaraṇaṃ svarārtham| kitkaraṇaṃ kimartham, na
ṭhasaṃyogālliṭ kit' ityeva siddham, tena ījānastepāna ityādau
saṃprasāraṇaitvābhyāsalopādikārya bhaviṣyati?
saṃyogāntārtham----ṭhbandha bandhane' ṭhvṛtasya yadvadvadhānasya,
tvamarṇavān badvadhānā aramṇā'atra ṭhaniditām' iti nalopaḥ,
chāndasatvādabhyāsadhakārasya halādiśśeṣeṇa nivṛtyabhāve ṭhjhalāṃ jaś
jhaśi' iti jaśtvaṃ dakāraḥ| nanu chāndasaḥ kānac liṭ ca cchandasi
sārvadhātukamapi bhavati, ṭhcchandasyubhayathā'iti vacanāt, tatra
ṭhsārvadhātukamapit' iti ṅtviṃ ṅtītyupidhālopo bhaviṣyati? na
ca saṃyogānteṣu kitvaṅtviyorviśeṣo'sti|
ṛkārāntaguṇapratiṣedhārtha tu, ṭhṛcchatyṛtām'iti ṛkārāntānāṃ
pratiṣedhaviṣaye guṇa ārabhyate sa yatheha bhavati---paritastare iti,
evamihāpi syāt----paritistirāṇa iti, tasmātkitkaraṇam|
kitkaraṇasāmarthyādbhāṣāyāmapi kānajastītyetatu
bhāṣyavirodhātupekṣyam||
kvasuśca|| 3|2|107 ||
kvasuśca|| kvasorukāra ugitkāryārthaḥ, jakṣivānityādau ṭhugidacām'
iti num, upaseduṣītyādau ṭhugitaśca' iti ṅīp, ṭhvasoḥ
saṃprasāraṇam'ityatra sāmānyagrahaṇamapyukārasya prayojanam| kitkaraṇaṃ
kimartha na ṭhasaṃyogālliṭ kit' ityeva siddham?
saṃyogāntārtham|añjeḥ ājivān---upadhālopo bhavati, chāndasaḥ
kvasuḥ liṭ| cchandasi sārvadhātukamapi tatra ṭhsārvadhātukamapit'
iti| tatvaṅtītyupidhālopo bhaviṣyati|
ṛkārāntaguṇapratiṣedhārthantu', ṭhṛcchatyṛtām' ityayaṃ guṇaḥ
pratiṣedha ārabhyate sa yatheha bhavati---teratusteruriti, tathā
titīrvānityatrāṃpi syāt| kitkaraṇasāmarthyādbhāṣāyāmapi
kvasurbhavatītyetu bhāṣyavirodhādupekṣyam| utarasūtrānarthakyaṃ ca,
yadi bhāṣāyāmapi kvasurbhavati||
bhāṣāyāṃ sadavasaśruvaḥ|| 3|2|108 ||
bhāṣāyāṃ sadavasaśruvaḥ|| ādeśavidhānādevetyādi| yadi bhāṣāyāṃ
sadādibhyo bhūtasāmānye liṇna syāt, tatastāddaśasya liṭa
ādeśavidhānamanupapannaṃ syāditi manyate| nanu ca ṭhliṭaḥ kānajvā'
ityatra punarliḍgahaṇasya prayojanamuktam---yo'pi parokṣe
liḍvihitastasyāpyayamādeśo bhavatīti, taccetsatyam, ihāpi yaḥ
parokṣe liṭ sa bhāṣāyāmapi sadādibhyaḥ sambhavatīti
tasyevedamādeśavidhānaṃ syāt? ucyate---liṅliḍviṣaye'pi
parastādanuvṛterbhavatīti vakṣyati, tato nānena parokṣe liṭa
ādeśābhidhānam, kiṃ tarhi? bhūtasāmānye, tataścādeśavidhānādeva
liḍapi tadviṣayo'numātavyaḥ| yadyevam, tasya pakṣe kvasvādeśaḥ
pakṣāntare tiṅaṃ śravaṇaṃ prāpnoti? na vāvacanena
kvasurabhisambaddhyate kvasurvā bhavatīti, kiṃ tarhi?
liḍabhisambaddhyate, bhāṣāyāṃ sadādibhyo vā liṭ; tasya nityaṃ
svasurādeśo bhavatīti| vṛttigrantho'pyasminnevārtha yojanīyaḥ|
upāsadaditi| lṛditvādaṅ| upāsīdaditi pāghrādisūtreṇa
sīdādeśaḥ| anūṣivāniti|
yajāditvātsamprasāraṇamṭhśāsivasighasīnāṃ ca' iti ṣatvam|
anvavātsīditi| ṭhsasyārddhadhātuke' iti tatvam| anūvāseti|
ṭhliṭa|lbhyāsasyobhayeṣām' ityabhyāsasya samprasāraṇam| luṅlaṅ
viṣaye'pi parastādanuvṛterbhavatīti| anyathā bhūtasāmānye luṅ
vihitastraiva dhātuviśeṣe'nenādeśavidhānenānumito liḍapavādaḥ|
tathā bhūtaviśeṣe laṅliṭau luṅ evāpavādau| sadādibhyastu
bhūtaviśeṣe etatsūtravihitaṃ ca kārya prāpnoti, laṅliṭau ca;
apavādavipratiṣedhāllaṅliṭāveva syātām||
upeyivānāśvānanūcānaśca|| 3|2|109 ||
upeyivānāśvananūcānaśca|| upapūrvādiṇaḥ kvasuriti| nipātyata
ityarthaḥ| liḍādeśaścāyam; anyathā dvirvacanābhyāsadīrghatve api
nipātayitavye syātām| tathā grāmamupeyivānityatra ṭhna lokāvyaya'
iti ṣaṣṭhīpratiṣedho na syāt| dvirvacanamiti| iḍāgamātpūrva
nityatvātkrita ityarthaḥ| abhyāsadīrghatvamiti| ṭhdirghaiṇaḥ kiti'
ityanena| tatsāmarthyāditi| yadi hyaekādeśaḥ syāddīrghavidhānamanarthakaṃ
syād; ekādeśenaiva dīrghasya siddhtvāt| nanu
cābhyāsadīrghatvasyeyaturityādiravakāśaḥ syāt, atra hi i i atus
iti sthite dīrghatvamekādeśaśca prāpnoti, ṭhiṇo yaṇ' iti
yaṇādeśaśca; tatra ṭhvārṇādāṅgaṃ balīyaḥ' iti
bahvāśrayatvenaikādeśasya bahiraṅgatvādvā yaṇeva bhavati, tataśca
dīrghavidhānamarthavadbhavati ? evaṃ manyate----atrāpi
pūrvaparavidhirekādeśaḥ pūrvavidhiriti, tatra kartavye yaṇādeśasya
sthānivatvātsyādevaikādeśaḥ;
tadevamabhyāsadīrghatvamanavakāśatvātsavarṇadīrghatvaṃ bādhata iti|
tasmātsuṣṭhūaktam-----tatsāmarthyādekādeśapratibandha iti| tatreti| evaṃ
satītyarthaḥ| sa nipātyata iti| nipātanāśrayaṇamiḍartham| anyatsarvaṃ
pūrvatraiveṇgrahaṇādeva siddhamityarthaḥ|
yadi tahīḍarthametannipātanaṃ saṃprasāraṇaviṣaye'pi prāpnoti; atra
valāderiti viśeṣānupādānāt, yathā vakṣyati----nityaścāyaṃ
valnimito vighātīti, tatrāha-----krādiniyamātprāptaśceti| caśabdo
hetau| nātrāpūrva iṅ vidhīyate, kiṃ tarhi? yo'yaṃ valādilakṣaṇa iṭ
krādiniyamena prāptaḥ ṭhvasvekājāddhasām' iti niyamena pratiṣiddhaḥ, sa
eva pratiprasūyateupratibandhapanayanena punaḥ pravartyate| tenājādā
vatiprasaṅgo na bhavatītyarthaḥ| anye tu----abhyāsadīrghatve kṛte
dhātvikārasya vyañjanaṃ yaṇādeśaṃ nipātayanti, īyvasu iti sthite
ṭhvasvekājāddhasām' ityeveṭ siddhaḥ, sa ca valādilakṣaṇa iti
nāstyatiprasaṅgaḥ|
apara āha---pūrvasūtra evegrahaṇaṃ kartavyam, nārtho nipātanāśrayaṇena|
atra yaduktam---īyaturityatrābhyāsadīrghatve kṛte ekādeśātpūrva
vārṇādāṅgaṃ balīya iti yaṇi kṛte'pi tasya sthānivatvādekādeśaḥ
prāpnoti, tataścāvaśyamabhyāsadīrghatvena bādhitavya ekādeśa iti,
tanna; na hi sthānivadbhāvena rūpamatidiśyate, rūpāśrayaśca
pūrvaparayorekādeśo na yakārasya bhavitumarhati| kiñca,
yaṇādeśena bādhitasyaikādeśasya punassthānivadbhāvenāpi
pravṛtyabhāvo bādhitatvādeva| kimato yadyevāmidaṃ tato bhavati? iṇaḥ
kvasau vihite dvirvacanaṃ ca prāpnoti, ṭhvasvekājādghasām'
itīḍāgamaśca| kimatra kartavyam? paratvādiṭ nityaṃ dvirvacanaṃ
kṛte'pīṭi prāpnoti, akṛte'pi prāpnotīti| iḍapi nityaḥ, kṛte
dvirvacane'bhyāsadīrghatve ekādeśe ca ekāctvātprāpnoti;
idānīgeva hyuktam---abhyāsadīrghatvena na bādhitavya ekādeśa iti|
tadevamubhayornityayoḥ paratvādiṭ, dvirvacanam, abhyāsadīrghatvaṃ
parasya yaṇādeśaḥ īyaturityādivatsiddhamupeyivāniti|
bibhidvānityādau nityatvātpūrva dvirvacanameva bhavati|
na cātropasargastantramiti| evamācāryāṇāmupadeśa iti bhāvaḥ|
anupasargācceti| ṭhīyivāṃsamatistridhaḥ' iti hi cchandasi ddaśyate|
luṅadayo bhavantīti| laṅliḍviṣaye'pi parastādanṛvṛterayaṃ
vidhirbhavatīti darśayati| upāgāditi| ṭhiṇo
gāluṅ',ṭhgāitisthāghupābhūbhyaḥ' iti sico luk| upaiditi|
adāditvācchapo luk,ṭhāḍajādīnām',ṭhāṭaśca'| upeyāyeti| tipo
ṇali vṛddhyāyādeśau, ṭhdvirvacane'ci' iti
sthānivadbhāvādikārasya dvivacanam ṭhabhyāsasyāsavarṇe'|
aśnāteriti| ṭhaśa bhojane'| nañpūrvāditi|
tenānyapūrvātkevalācca na bhavati| nāśīditi| tipi sici ṭhneṭi'
iti vṛddhipratiṣedhaḥ, ṭhāḍajādīnām' ṭhāṭaśca', nañā saha
savarṇadīrghatvam| nāśeti| tipi ṇali dvirvacane ṭhata ādeḥ'
ityabhyāsadīrghaḥ, nañā pareṇa ca savarṇadīrghatvam|
vaceriti| ṭhbruvo vaciḥ' ityasya| tathā ca laiṅ
anvabravīdityudāhariṣyate| anye tu ṭhvaca paribhāṣaṇe' ityasyāpi
grahaṇamicchanti| kartarīti| na bhāvakarmaṇoḥ| etacca nipātanāllabhyam|
anvavocaditi| ṭhvaca um'| anvabravīditi| ṭhbru va īṭ'| anūvāceti|
pūrvavadabhyāsasaṃprasāraṇam|
luṅ|| 3|2|110 ||
luṅ|| iha bhūtasāmānye luṅ vidhīyate, tasya viśeṣe'nadyatane
laṅliṭāvapavādau, tadviṣaye'pi luṅ ddaśyate, āgamāma ghoṣāt,
apāsa payaḥ, aśeyiṣmahi pūtīkatṛṇeṣu, abhūnnṛpo vivudhasakhaḥ
parantapaḥ, iti ciravṛtaṃ kathayataḥ prayuñcate? naiṣa doṣaḥ; viśeṣe
sāmānyamasti, tatra viśeṣāvivakṣāyāṃ sāmānyāśrayaṇena
vastuto'nadyatane'pi luṇupapadyate, drūpavivakṣāyāmeva tu
laṅliṭau, vivakṣopārūḍho hyarthaḥ śabdaprayoganimitaḥ, na vastutaḥ
sanniti| gatametat| vaseriti| ṭhvasa nivāse' rātreścaturthe yāme
pṛṣṭo yadā vākyaṃ prayuṅkte tadā
tasyātikrāntarātripraharatrayavasanamanadyatanamiti laṅprayoge luṅ
vaktavyaḥ| laṅnivṛttiparaṃ caitat luṅ bhūtasāmānyavivakṣayā siddhaḥ|
jāgaraṇasantatāviti| yadā prayoktā sakalamatikrānta rātripraharatrayaṃ
jāgarivatān tadā luṅprayogaḥ yadā suptvā prabuddhya tadā
laṅpratyaya evetyarthaḥ||
anadyatanelaṅ|| 3|2|111 ||
anadyatanelaṅ|| ṭhanadyatane' iti tatpuruṣapakṣe
paryudāsaścedvyāmiśre'pi prāpnoti---adya hyae vā'bhukṣmahīti, bhavati
hyadyatanānadyatanasamudāyo'dyatanādanyaḥ, prasajya pratiṣedhe tu
yo'trādyatanastadāśrayaḥ pratiṣedho bhavati, kintu bhūtasamānye
prāpnoti, bhūtaviśeṣe hi pratiṣedhaḥ| na ca sāmānyaṃ viśeśo
bhavati| paryudāse'pyayaṃ doṣo draṣṭavyaḥ| bahuvrīhau na
vidyate'dyatano yasmin so'nadyatano bhūto dhātvarthaḥ, tatra
vartamānāllaṅ bhavati, tataścādyatanasamudāye'dyatanasyaikadeśasya
sambhavānna bhavati prasaṅgaḥ| bhūtasāmānye'pi na bhavatyeva, vidyate hi
sāmānye viśeṣaḥ, ato bahuvrī---hirevāyaṃ yukta ityāha---anadyatana
iti bahuvrīhinirdeśa iti| bahuvrīhiṇā vivakṣitārthasya pratipādanaṃ
bahuvrīhervoccāraṇamityarthaḥ| yadi bahuvrīhinirddeśaḥ, evaṃ
satyadyatane prāpnoti, na hyadyatane'dyatano vidyate? adyatane'pi
muhūrtādiradyatano vidyate, muhūrtādāvapi kṣaṇādiḥ, katham?
vyapadeśivadbhāvena yathā mukhye bhede ādhārādheyabhāvo
bhavati---taṭe tiṣṭhatīti, tathehāpi samudāyāvayavabhedāśrayeṇa
samudāye'dyatane'vayavā adyatanāḥ santītyanadyatano na bhavatītyucyate, na
tu tatvataḥ avayavavyatirikto'tra samudāya ādhāro'sti| taduktaṃ
hariṇā-----
kālasyāpyaparaṃ kālaṃ nirddiśantyeva laukikāḥ|
na ca nirddeśamātreṇa vyatireko'nugamyate|| iti|
adya hya iti|| adya hyaścetyarthaḥ| gāmaśvaṃ puruṣaṃ nayamāna
itivaccaśabdasyāprayogaḥ| abhukṣmahīti| ṭhbhujo'navane'
ityātmanepadam, mahiṅ ṭhiliṅasicāvātmanepadeṣu' iti sicaḥ
kitvād guṇābhāvaḥ, ṭhcoḥ kuḥ' iti kutvam---gakāraḥ, ṭhkhari ca'
iti cartvam----kakāraḥ, sicaḥ sasya ṣatvam| parokṣe cetyādi|
parokṣaśabdo'yamatīndriyārthe vartate, lokavijñāte lokaprasiddhe
prayokturdarśanaviṣaye laṅntasya śabdarūpasya yaḥ prayoktā tasya
darśanaviṣaye laṅ vaktavyaḥ| nanu vipratiṣiddhamidam yadi parokṣaḥ,
kathaṃ darśanaviṣayaḥ? atha darśanaviṣayaḥ, kathaṃ parośraḥ?
śakyadarśanatvāddarśanaviṣayaḥ,
kvacidvyāsaṅgādananubhūtatvātparokṣaiti virodhābhāvaḥ|
aruṇaditi| ṭhrudhir āvaraṇe',ṭhrudhāditvāt śnam, tipo
halṅyādinā lopaḥ| sāketarodhastadānīṃ prayokturdarśanaviṣayaḥ,
śakyadarśanatvāt| lokaprasiddhaśca,
kvacidvyāsaṅgādananubhūtatvātparokṣaśca| parokṣa iti kim?
udagādādityaḥ, iṇo luṅ, gādeśādikāryam|
lokavijñāta iti| kima? cakāra kaṭṃa devadataḥ| prayoktudarśanaviṣaye
iti| kim? jaghāna kaṃsaṃ kila vāsudevaḥ, hanteḥ parokṣe
liṭ,dvirvacanam,ṭhabhyāsācca'iti kutvam---hakārasya ghakāraḥ|
kaṃsavadhaścirakālāntaravṛtatvādidānīṃ prayokturdarśanaviṣayo na
bhavati| yastu kaṃsavadhena tulyakālaḥ prayoktā sa laṅmeva
prayuktavān----āhata kaṃsaṃ vāsudeva iti| mūlodāharaṇe'pi
prayoktā sāketarodhena tulyakālo veditavyaḥ, tasyeva hyasau
darśanaviṣayaḥ, nānyasya||
abhijñāvacane lṛṭ|| 3|2|112 ||
abhijñāvacane lṛṭ|| vatsyāma iti| vaselṛṭ mas, ṭhsyatāsāṃ
lṛluṭoḥ' iti syapratyayaḥ, ṭhsasyārddhadhātuke' iti sasya takāraḥ, ṭhato
dīrgho yañi' iti dīrghaḥ|
vacanagrahaṇamityādi| asati vacanagrahaṇe'bhijñāśabda evopapade syāt,
tasmiṃstu sati yāvanto'bhijñānavacanāsteṣu bhavati| buddhyase
cetayase iti| arthaprakaraṇādinā smṛtirūpe jñāne
yadānayorvṛttistadātrāpi bhavatīti bhāvaḥ||
na yadiḥ|| 3|2|113 ||
na yadi|| yadīti satisaptamīyam| abhijñāvacanaṃ cānuvartate, tena
yatra yacchabdo'sti, tatra yadabhijñāvacanaṃ tanniyogato yacchabdena
sahitaṃ bhavatītyabhipretyāha-----yacchabdasahita ityādi| avasāmeti|
vesarlaṅ mas, ṭhnityaṃ ṅtiḥ' iti salopaḥ, dīrghaḥ,
vāsamātramityādinotarasūtrasya nāyaṃ viṣaya iti darśayati| yadi
tatrāparaṃ kiñcillakṣyamapekṣyeta tadotarasūtreṇa pākṣiko
vidhissyāt, tacca neṣyate, tasmānna tasya viṣayaḥ||
vibhāṣā sākāṅkṣe|| 3|2|114 ||
vibhāṣā sākāṅkṣe|| ubhayatravibhāṣeyamiti| prāpte cāprāpte ca|
asati yacchabde ṭhabhijñāvacane lṛṭ' iti prāpte sati yacchabde
pratiṣedhe prāpte| ākāṅkṣaṇamuākāṅkṣā, ākāṅkṣayā saha vartate
sākāṅkṣaḥ| ākākṣaṅkṣā ca cetanāvato dharmaḥ, tasmātsākākṣaṅkṣa
ityetatprayoktṛviśeṣaṇam, tena sakarmaka ityādivatsamāsaḥ|
sākāṅkṣaścetprayokteti| ṭhaṅgayuktaṃ tiṅakāṅkṣam' ityatra tu
prayoktṛgatākāṅkṣādhyāropeṇa tiṅntamākāṅkṣamiti vakṣyate| iha
tu mukhye prayoktari sambhavati, gauṇakalpanayā
dhātvarthaviśeṣaṇamayuktamiti bhāvaḥ| īddaśe punarviṣaye prayoktā
sākāṅkṣo bhavatītyāha---lakṣyalakṣaṇayoḥ sambandhe iti| yatraiko
dhātvartho lakṣyaḥ, aparo lakṣaṇam, tatra dvayorlakṣyalakṣaṇabhāvena sambandhe
sati prayokturākāṅkṣā bhavati, tatra na vāsamātraṃ pratipādya prayoktā
caritārtho bhavati, kintu tena prasiddhena bhojanādikaṃ smārayituṃ
pravartate||
parokṣe liṭ|| 3|2|115 ||
parokṣe liṭ|| parokṣaśabdo'yamatīndriyavāco prasiddhaḥ|
vyutpattistu paramakṣṇaḥ parokṣam, mayūravyaṃsakāditvātsamāsaḥ,
ṭhacpratyanvavapūrvāt' ityatrājiti yogavibhāgādac samāsāntaḥ|
vṛttiviṣaye cākṣiśabdaḥ sarvendriyavacanaḥ, na cakṣuḥ paryāyaḥ;
anyathendriyāntaravijñātaṃ vastu parokṣamāpadyeta | evaṃ ca kṛtvā
darśanaparyāyo'kṣiśabdo na bhavatīti ṭhakṣṇo'darśanāt' ityevāc
samāsānto'stu| anye tu ṭhpratiparasamanubhyo'kṣṇaḥ' iti
śaratprabhṛtiṣu pāṭhādac samāsānta ityāhuḥ| sa ca yadyapyavyayībhāve
vidhīyate, tathāpi paraśabdenāvyayībhāvāsambhavātsamāsāntare
vijñāyate| evaṃ tu ṭhkriyāyāṃ parokṣāyām' iti bhāṣyaprayoge
ṭillakṣaṇo ṅīp prāpnoti, tasmādajanta evāyam| tatra parataḥ
paraśabdasya paro bhāvo'smādeva nirddeśādbhavati,
paraśabdādutarasyākṣiśabdasyāderutvaṃ vā|
nanu cetyādi| ekaphaloddeśena pravṛtatvādaikyamivāpannā vitatarūpaḥ
kṣaṇapravāho dhātvarthaḥ, sa kārtsnyenaikasminkṣaṇe na sambhavatīti
sadvastuviṣayairindriyairna gahyate, tataścaikaikasya kriyākṣaṇasya
pratyakṣatve'pi samūharūpo dhātvarthaḥ sarvaḥ parokṣa eva,
tataścāvyabhicārādaviśeṣaṇamiti bhāvaḥ| satyametaditi| anantaroktaṃ
manyate| kimartha tarhi parokṣagrahaṇamityāha---astviti| yatra
sādhanaśaktyāśrayabhūtaṃ phūtkārasītkārādiviśiṣṭṃa saṃrabdharūpaṃ dravyaṃ
pratyakṣam, tatra dhātvartha eva pratyakṣābhimāno laukikānām|
abhimānaḥumithyājñānam, tadvyāvṛtaye parokṣagrahaṇam| yadi tarhi
yatra sādhanaśaktyāśrayaṃ dravyaṃ parokṣam, tatra liṅ bhavati tarhi utamo
na prāpnoti, tatra hi buddhīndriyaśarīrādisaṃghātaḥ kartā, sa cātmanaḥ
pratyakṣa eva| ṭhparasmaipadānām' iti tu ṇalādeśavacanaṃ ṭhṇalutamo vā'
iti ca, ṭhcchandasi luṅlaṅliṭaḥ',ṭhatyantāpahnave' iti cāparokṣe
yo liṭ tadviṣayaṃ bhaviṣyatītyata āha---utamaviṣaye'pi
citavyākṣepāditi| madasvapnādibhiścite vyākṣipte bhavati vai
kaścitsvakṛtameva na jānāti, paścādeva tvayā kṛtamiti
pārśvasthebhyaḥ śrutvā prayuṃkte---supto'haṃ kila vilalāpeti|
kiletyajñānaṃ sūcayati| atyantāpahnava iti| apahnavaḥualāpaḥ|
kaliṅgo nāmajugupsito deśaḥ, tatra praviśya tvayā cirakālaṃ
sthitamiti kaściduktassannāha---nāhaṃ kaliṅgaṃ jagāmeti| na
kevalamavasthānameva pratiṣidhyate, kiṃ tarhi? taddhetubhūtagamanamapīti
bhavatyatyantāpahnavaḥ| tathā dakṣiṇāpathaṃ praviśyāyājyayānādikaṃ tvayā
kṛtamiti kaściduktaḥ sannāha---nāhaṃ dakṣiṇāpathaṃ praviveśeti|
atrāpyayājyayājanāderhetubhūtaḥ praveśa eva pratiṣiddhyata
ityatyantāpahnavaḥ| kvacit dakṣiṇāpathaṃ praviṣṭo'sīti vṛtāveva
paṭha|lte, tatra praviśyedaṃ kṛtavānityarthaḥ||
haśaśvatorlaṅ ca|| 3|2|116 ||
praśne cāsannakāle || 3|2|117 ||
praśne cāsannakāle|| bhūtānadyatanaparokṣa iti vartata iti|
ayamartho'nuvartata ityarthaḥ,na punarevaṃvidhassamāsaḥ prakṛto'sti|
praṣṭavyaḥ praśna iti| karmasādhanaṃ praśnaśabdaṃ darśayati| karaṇasādhane tu
praśnakriyāsādhanabhūte dhātāvāsannakāla ityarthassyāt, tatrāsannakāla
ityanarthakam, na hyanuccāritātpratyayavidhānam, uccāritaścāsannakāla
eva| bhāvasādhane'pyāsannakāle praśre vartamānādityarthassyāt,
tataścārthāntaravācibhyo laṅ na syāt, ataḥ karmasādhano'yaṃ
praśraśabdaḥ| tatra pañcavarṣābhyantaramāsannakālam, pañcavarṣātītaṃ tu
viprakṛṣṭakālamiti varṇayanti||
laṭ sme|| 3|2|118 ||
laṭ sme|| naḍena sma purādhīyate iti| adhipūrvādiṅḥ karmaṇi
lakāraḥ, karmāvivakṣāyāṃ vā bhāve, naḍeneti kartari tṛtīyā| atha
vā---adhīyate iti kartari bahuvacanam, ṭhātmanepadeṣvanataḥ'
ityadādeśaḥ, naḍeneti sahayoge tṛtīyā| anye tu
vyācakṣate---purākalpe---purākalpe naḍākhyaṃ tṛṇaviśeṣaṃ haste
gṛhītvādhīyānā adhīyate smeti||
aparokṣe ca|| 3|2|119 ||
aparokṣe ca|| pūrvasūtreṇa parokṣe vidhānādaparokṣe na
prāpnotītyayamārambhaḥ, pūrvasūtra eva parokṣagrahaṇaṃ nivartiṣyate|
yadyevam, tatsambandhādanadyatanagrahaṇamapi nivarteta mā
nivṛtadityevamarthamidam, dvayorhi prakṛtayorekanivṛttiryatnena
kriyamāṇā itarasyānivṛttimanumāpayati||
nanau pṛṣṭaprativacane|| 3|2|120 ||
nanau pṛṣṭaprativacane|| pṛṣṭamiti karmaṇi ktaḥ, pṛṣṭasya prativacanaṃ
pṛṣṭaprativacanam| vṛtau tu vastumātraṃ darśitam| praśnapūrvake
prativacana iti| udāharaṇe pūrvaśaḥ praśraḥ,utara udāharaṇam|
pṛṣṭagrahaṇārthakaṃ praśnapūrvakameva prativacanam? tanna; viruddhamapi
vacanaṃ prativacanaṃ vacanābhimukhaṃ prativacanamityapi sambhavāt|
tasmāt pṛṣṭagrahaṇam| atyantāsannakāle cāyaṃ vidhiriṣyate, tatra
nirvṛtāyāmapi pākādikriyāyāṃ tatkṛtasya śramādarenuvṛttiḥ| evaṃ
ca śramādidarśanena saiva kriyā vartata iti śakyaṃ vaktumiti|
ṭhvartamāne laṭ' ityeva siddheḥ pratyākhyātamidama----ṭhnanau
pṛṣṭaprativacane'ityaśiṣyam, kriyāsamāpteravivakṣitatvāditi||
nanvorvibhāṣā|| 3|2|121 ||
puri laṅ cāsme|| 3|2|122 ||
puri laṅ cāsme|| anadyatanagrahamamityādi| luṅgrahaṇaṃ cātra
liṅgam| yadi hi bhūtamātre'yaṃ vidhiḥ syāt vibhāṣā laṭo
vidhānātena mukte luṅapi bhaviṣyati, ki luṅgrahaṇena!
anadyatanagrahaṇānuvṛtau tu laṭā mukte laṇeóva syāditi kartavyaṃ
luṅgrahaṇam| anye'pīti| laṅliṭau, abhijñāvacane
lṛṭ---abhijānāsi devadata vatsyantīha purā chātrā iti||
vartamāne laṭ|| 3|2|123 ||
vartamāne laṭ|| prārabdho'parisamāptaśceti| adhiśrayaṇādiradhaḥ
