śrayaṇaparyanta odanaphalāvacchinno vitatarūpo vyāpāranicayaḥ
pacerarthaḥ| evaṃ sarvatra sa yāvatā kālena nivartate sa kālo
vartamānaḥ, tadyogādvartamāno dhātvartha ityarthaḥ| tena niṣpannasyārthasya
bhūtatvādaniṣpannasya ca bhāvitvānniṣpannāniṣpannavyatirekeṇa
rāśyantarasyābhāvādvartamānābhāva iti codyaṃ parihṛtam| ihādhyayane
pravṛtā yadā bhojanādikriyāṃ kurvanto nādhīyate tadā adhīyata iti
prayogo na prāpnoti? naiṣa doṣaḥ;
āphalaniṣpateradhyayanamaparisamāptamantarālavartitu bhojanādikvaṃ
nāntarīyakaṃ tasyaiva vāvayavakriyā| yamapi bhavānmuktasaṃśayaṃ
vartamānakālaṃ nyāyyaṃ manyate----bhuṅkte devadata iti, atrāpyavaśyaṃ
bhuñjāno hasati jalpati pānīyaṃ vā pibati, tatra cedyauktā
vartamānakālatā, ihāpi yuktā ddaśyatām| uktaṃ ca----
vyavadhānamivopaiti nivṛta iva ddaśyate|
kriyāsamūho bhujyādirantarālapravṛttibhiḥ||
na ca vicchinnarūpo'pi sa virāmānnivartate|
sarvaiva hi kriyā'nyena saṅkīrṇaivopalabhyate||
tadantarāladdaṣṭā vā sarvaivāvayavakriyā|
sāddaśyātsati bhede tu tadaṅgatvena gṛhyate|| iti|
etadapyanenaivoktaṃ prārabdho'parisamāptaśca vartamāna iti| iha
tiṣṭhanti parvatāḥ, sravanti sindhava iti parvatādisthityādeḥ
sarvadābhāvād bhūtabhaviṣyadabhāvātatpratidvandvirūpasya
vartamānasyāpyabhāva iti laṇ na prāpnoti? naiṣa doṣaḥ;
kālatrayavartināṃ rājñāṃ yāḥ kriyāḥ pālanādikā bhūtādibhedena
bhinnāstāḥ parvatasthityāderbhedikāḥ, tataśca ye samprati
rājānastatkriyābhedena bhinnāyā parvatādisthitervartamānatvam| evaṃ
ca kṛtvā bhūtabhaviṣyatkālayogo'pyupapadyate-----tasthuḥ parvatā
naladuṣyantādikāle, sthāsyanti parvatāḥ kalkiviṣṇukāle|
laṭaṣṭakāraṣṭeretvārthaḥ||
laṭaḥ śatṛśānacāvaprathamāsamānādhikaraṇe|| 3|2|124 ||
laṭaḥ śatṛśānacāvaprathamāsamānādhikaraṇe|| śakāraḥ
sārvadhātukasaṃjñārthaḥ, ṛkāra ugitkāryārthaḥ, cakāraḥ svarārthaḥ|
prathamāśabdassupāmādye trike prasiddhaḥ, prathamāyā
anyā'prathamāudvitīyādiḥ, tatra pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣayā tadantavidhiḥ,
aprathamāntaṃ dvitīyādyantamityarthaḥ| adhikaraṇamuabhidheyam,
samānamusādhāraṇam, abhidheyaṃ yasya tatsamānādhikaraṇam,
aprathamāntena samānādhikaraṇamaprathamāsamānādhikaraṇam| tṛtīyeti
yogavibhāgātsamāsaḥ| dvipado vā
bahuvrīhīḥ-----aprathamāsamānādhikaraṇaṃ yasyeti| ṭhyasya ca bhāvena' iti
saptamī aprathamāsamānādhikaraṇe laṭi sati, tasya laṭa iti ṣaṣṭha|lrthe
saptamī| eṣa paryudāsapakṣo darśitaḥ| prasajyapratiṣedhapakṣe tu naño
bhavatinā saṃbandhaḥ| prathamāśabdena prathamāntaṃ gṛhyate| śeṣaṃ samānam|
tatrādye pakṣe kurvato'patyaṃ kaurvataḥ, pācataḥ, kurvato bhaktiḥ
kurvadbhaktiḥ kurvāṇabhaktiriti pratyayotarapadayoḥ śatṛśānacau na
syātām, na hyatra dvitīyādyantena sāmānādhikaraṇyam, na hi kurvato
devadatasya bhaktiḥ kurvato devadatasyāpatyamityatra samāsataddhitau
bhavataḥ, sāpekṣatvāt padāntaranirapekṣatve prathamāntena
sāmānādhikaraṇyābhāvaḥ| prasajyapratiṣedhe tu prathamāntena
sāmānādhikaraṇyābhāvādadoṣaḥ| astu tarhi sa eva? evamapi kurvato
bhaktirasya kurvadbhaktiḥ, kurvāṇabhaktiratra na prāpnoti, ye cāpyete
samānādhikaraṇavṛtayastaddhitāsteṣu na syāt---kurvataraḥ,
kurvāṇataraḥ; kurvadrūpaḥ kurvatkalpa iti? paryudāse'pyeṣa doṣo
draṣṭavyaḥ|
evaṃ tarhi ṭhpratyayotarapadayośca' iti lakṣaṇaśeṣaḥ kartavyaḥ, tatra
pṛthagutarapadagrahaṇam ṭhantaraṅgānapi vidhīn bahiraṅgo
lugbādhate' iti samāsārthāyā vibhakterlukikṛte
pratyayalakṣaṇapratiṣedhātpratyayaparatvārtham| nanu ca pratyayotarapadayoḥ
satoḥ śatṛśānacau bhavataḥ, tayośca kṛtvātprātipadikatve sati
vibhaktyutpatau satyāṃ taddhitāḥ, samāsaśca, samāse ca satyutarapadaṃ
taditaretarāśrayaṃ bhavati? naiṣa doṣaḥ; ḍa|lappratipadikātaddhitāḥ,
te lakārasya kṛtvādbhaviṣyanti, utarapade'pi
vidhānasāmarthyātiṅadeśaṃ bādhitvā lāntasya prātipadikatvamāśritya
subutpatau samāsa iti siddham| evamapi vīkṣamāṇasyāpatyaṃ
vaikṣamāṇirityakṛte śānaci akārāntatvābhāvādata iño'prasaṅgaḥ,
pacatitarāmityatra śatṛśānacau prāpnutaḥ, tathā pacatirūpamityādau
ṭhtiṅśca' ityetatu laṅadiviṣayameva syāt|
tadevaṃ sarvatra doṣasadbhāve samāso'pi tāvannyāyyo bhavatīti
paryudāsamāśrityāha----aprathamāntena cedityādi| tasyeti| laṭaḥ|
kathaṃ punarlaṭo dvitīyādyantena sāmānādhikaraṇyam, yāvatā ṭhlaḥ
karmaṇi ca' ityanena kartṛkarmaṇorvidhīyamāno lakāraḥ kriyāṃ prati
guṇabhūte kartṛkarmaṇī pratipādayati, tathā ca
kriyāpradhātvādākhyātasya kriyāntarayogābhāvācchaktyantarāveśābhāvaḥ,
na hi bhavati pacatyodanaṃ devadataṃ paśya pacyate odanena tṛptaḥ
apacadodanaṃ devadataṃ paśya pacyate odanena tṛpta iti,
yathā----anyeṣu kṛtsu pākaṃ paśya, pākena tṛpta iti? satyam;
tiṅbhāvino lakārasyāyaṃ svabhāvaḥ yaduktaguṇabhūte kartṛkarmaṇī
pratipādayati, śatrādiviṣayasya kriyopasarjanakartrādyabhidhānam, tataśca
kriyāntarayoge sati tannimitaṃ
dvitīyādyantasāmānāghikaraṇyamupapadyate| yadyapi kevalasya laṭaḥ
prayogābhāvādaprathamāntena sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ na kvacidupalabdham,
tathāpi tadādeśayoḥ śatṛśānacordarśanāt sthānino lakārasyāpi
tadyogyatvamanumīyate, tena laṭaḥ prakriyārtha vihitasya
kālpanikaprathamāntena sāmānādhikaraṇyamastīti doṣābhāvaḥ|
atha laḍgrahaṇaṃ kimartham----ādeśau yathā syātāṃ pratyayāntaraṃ mā
bhūtāmiti? naitadasti; pūrvasūtrata eva laḍgrahaṇaṃ svarayiṣyate,
tasyehānuvṛtasyārthāt ṣaṣṭha|la vipariṇāme tasyaivādeśau
bhaviṣyataḥ, na pratyayāntaramata āha----laḍiti vartamāne
punarlaḍgrahaṇamiti| kvacitprathamāsāmānādhikaraṇye'pi bhavata iti|
aprathamāsamānādhakaraṇatvābhāvopalakṣaṇamidam, tena kaurvataḥ,
kurvadbhaktirityādayo'pi bhavanti| sanniti| ṭhas
bhuvi',ṭhśnasorallopaḥ'| vidyamāna iti| ṭhvida
satāyām',ṭhdivādiranudātet| juhvaditi| ṭhnābhyastācchatuḥ' iti
numabhāvaḥ|
māṅyākrośa iti| māṅ luṅe'pivādaḥ, tathā punarlaḍgrahaṇādyo'pi
bhūte laṭ ṭhnanau pṛṣṭaprativacane' iti tasyāpi bhavataḥ----nanu māṃ
kurvantaṃ paśya, nanu māṃ kurvāṇampaśyeti| etacca ṭhnanau
pṛṣṭaprativacane' ityatra bhāṣyakāreṇoktam|
kecidityādi| na caivaṃ pacantampaśyetyādāvapi vikalpaprasaṅga ityata
āha---vyavasthitavibhāṣā ceyamiti| yathādarśanamiti|
prathamāsamānādhikaraṇe vikalpaḥ, pacantaṃ paśyetyādau
ṭhpratyayotarapadayośca'nityampacatitarāmityādau naiva bhavataḥ, anyathā
tiṅe'pi sthānivadbhāvātsyātprasaṅgaḥ| na tarhīdānīmidaṃ
vaktavyam---aprathamāsamānādhikaraṇa iti? vaktavyaṃ ca| kiṃ prayojanam?
nityārtham| nanvetadapi vibhāṣayaiva siddham? satyam; sa evārtho
vacanena spaṣṭīkriyate| etena ṭhsambīdhanai ca' ṭhlakṣaṇahetvoḥ' iti ca
vyākhyātam||
sambodhane ca|| 3|2|125 ||
sambodhane ca|| he pacanniti|
saṃyogāntalopasyāsiddhatvānnalopābhāvaḥ| atra sambhodhane prathamā,
ayamādeśaścetyubhayaṃ militaṃ sambodhanaṃ dyotayati||
lakṣaṇahetvoḥ kriyāyāḥ|| 3|2|126 ||
lakṣaṇahetvoḥ kriyāyāḥ|| lakṣyate cihnyate yeneti|
cihnayatiravadhārayatyādivaccurādiṣu draṣṭavyaḥ| dhātvarthaviśeṣaṇaṃ
caitaditi| nopapadaṃ kriyāyā iti vacanāt| upapadaṃ hi
dhātorbhavati, sa ca kriyāvacana iti kriyāgrahaṇamanarthakamupapadatve
syāt| kriyāyāśca lakṣaṇāpekṣayā karmatvam, hetvapekṣayā tu
śeṣatvam, tatrobhayānugrahāya karmaṇo'pi śeṣatvavivakṣayā
śeṣalakṣaṇaiva ṣaṣṭhī, vṛtau tu vastumātraṃ prādarśi| kriyāviṣayāviti|
śayānā bhuñjata iti| atra śayanaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ bhojanasya|
tiṣṭhanto'nuśāsatīti| atrāpi sthānamanuśāsanasya| arjayanvasatīti|
ṭharja pratiyatne' curādirāṅpūrvaḥ|
lakṣaṇahetvoriti kimiti| kriyāsambandhinyarthe vartamānāditi
vijñāyamāne lakṣaṇahetvorapi bhaviṣyata iti praśnaḥ, atiprasaṅgena
tūtaram| pacati ca paṭhaticeti| atra dvayoḥ kriyayorekasminsādhane
samuccayātaddvāreṇa parasparasambandho'pyastītyubhayatrāpi prasaṅgaḥ|
yaḥ kampate so'śvattha iti| bahuṣu vṛkṣeṣu tiṣṭhatsu kampanenāśvattho
lakṣyate, tacca dravyam| yadutplavate tallaghviti| atrāpyutplavanena
lāghavaṃ guṇo lakṣyate| niṣadanaṃ nimajjanaṃ tena gauravaṃ guṇo
lakṣyate| iha tu yo'dhīyāna āste sa devadata iti āsikriyāyā
evādhyayanakriyālakṣaṇam, na devadatasya, āsikriyā tu tasya lakṣaṇam|
evaṃ yastiṣṭhanmūtrayati sa brāhmaṇabruva iti, atrāpi sthitikriyā
mūtraṇakriyāyā eva lakṣaṇam, saiva tu devadatasyāśau cāderlakṣaṇaṃ na
sthitikriyeti sūtreṇaiva siddha ādeśaḥ| kathaṃ śayānā vardhate dūrvā,
āsīnaṃ vardhate viṣamiti, na hyāsanaśayate vṛddherlakṣaṇam, kiṃ tarhi?
svabhāvamātrakathanametat? bhavati vai svabhāvākhyānamapi lakṣaṇam,
yathā----caitanyalakṣaṇaṃ puruṣa iti| pūrvanipātavyamicāraliṅgamiti|
ṭhdvandve ghi',ṭhalpāctaram' iti yau pūrvanipātau tayorvyabhicāre
liṅgamityarthaḥ| tena dhūmāgnī, mṛdaṅgaśaṅkhapaṇavā
ityādiprayogopapatiḥ||
tau sat|| 3|2|127 ||
tau sat|| taugrahaṇaṃ kimartham, saṃjñāvidhiryathā syāt sadityasya
pratyayasya vidhirmā bhūditi? naitadasti prayojanam, pūrvasūtre
śatṛśānacau svarayiṣyete, tatsāmarthyātayoranuvṛtayoḥ saṃjñaiva
bhaviṣyati, tatrāha----taugrahaṇamupādhyasaṃsargārthamiti|
laṭsthānikatvād vartamānakālavihitatvaṃ copādhiḥ,
tenopādhinā'saṃbandhārthaḥ, taugrahaṇamityarthaḥ, kiṃ
siddhamityāha---śatṛśānajmātrasyeti| asati taugrahaṇe yāddaśau
śatṛśānacauprakṛtau laṭsthānikau vartamānakālau ca tāddaśayoreva
saṃjñā syāt, tataśca lṛḍādeśayorna syāt| ṭhlṛṭassadvā' ityetatu
vacanaṃ satsaṃjñakapratirūpayorvidhānārtha syāt, yathā----amī
piṣṭapiṇḍāḥ siṃhāḥ kriyantāmiti tadākārāḥ kriyante|
vihitayostūtarakālaṃ saṃjñā na sidhyati, tataśca brāhmaṇasya pakṣyan,
brāhmaṇasya pakṣyamāṇa iti samāsapratiṣedho na syāt; tasyāṃ daśāyāṃ
satsaṃjñāyā abhāvāt| evaṃ bhūtakālayorapi na syāt|
ṭhvartamānasāmīpye vartamānavadvā' iti vacanādbhūte'pi
śatṛśānacau bhavataḥ| evaṃ tatrāpi vartamānavadityatideśena
vidhānameva tayorbhūte siddhyati, na tu saṃjñā| pratyayādhikārādvi
pratyaya evātidiśyate, na sajñā| tathā ṭhnanau pṛṣṭaprativacane'ityapi
laṭaḥ śatṛśānacau bhavata ityuktam, tayorapi saṃjñā na bhavet,
taugrahaṇe sati tayorapi saṃjñā bhavati----nanu māṃ brāhmaṇasya
kurvantampaśya nanu māṃ brāhmaṇasya kurvāṇampaśyeti| atha kriyamāṇe'pi
taugrahaṇe kathamiva kālāntaravihitayoḥ saṃjñā siddhyati, yāvatā
prakṛtasyaiva vastunassarvanāmnā parāmarśaḥ? satyam;
taugrahaṇasāmarthyātu viśeṣaṇāṃśarityāgena śatṛśaṣānaco rūpamātraṃ
parāmṛśyate||
pūṅyajoḥ śānan|| 3|2|128 ||
pūṅyajoḥ śānan|| ihaite śānannādayo yadi laṭo'nuvṛttimāśritya
tasyaivādeśāḥ kriyeran, veti vaktavyam, pavamānaḥ yajamānaḥ, pavate
yajata ityapi yathā syāt, vā'sarūpavidhinā tiṅe baviṣyanti, na
lādeśeṣu vā'sarūpavidhirastītyuktam| sādhanābhidhānam---sādhanasya
cābhidhānaṃ prāpnoti ṭhlaḥ karmaṇi ca bhāve cākarmakebhyaḥ' iti
bhāvakarmaṇorapi prasaṅgaḥ| parassvaraśca na siddhyati---katīha
pavamānāḥ, ṭhadupadeśāllasārvadhātukam' ityanudātatvaṃ prāpnoti|
ātmanepadasaṃjñā---ṭhtaṅanāvātmanepadam' ityātmanepadasaṃjñā ca
prāpnoti, tataśca parasmaipadibhyaścānaś na syātkatīha nandamānāḥ|
tasmādaśakyā evaite lādeśā vijñātumiti matvāha---śānanpratyayo
bhavatīti| śakārassārvadhātukasaṃjñārthaḥ, nakārassvarārthaḥ|
yadītyādi| ṭhna lokāvyaya' ityatra svarūpasya grahaṇaṃ manyamānasya praśnaḥ|
tṛnniti pratyāhāranirdeśāditi| ṣaṣṭhīpratiṣedha ityanuṣaṅgaḥ|
dviṣaśśaturvā vacanamiti| ṭhdviṣo'mitre' iti yo'yaṃ śatṛpratyayastasya
prayoge vā ṣaṣṭhī bhavati, pratyāhāre'ntarbhāvānnityaṃ pratiṣedhe
prāpte vacanam| yasyāpi tanniti svarūpagrahaṇaṃ
tenāpyetadvaktavyam---pakṣe ṣaṣṭhī yathā syānnityaṃ mā bhūditi|
śeṣavijñānātsiddham, karmaṇi śeṣatvena vivakṣite ṣaṣṭhī, karmarūpeṇa
vivakṣite dvitīyeti||
tācchīlyavayovacanaśaktiṣu cānaś|| 3|2|129 ||
tācchīlyavayovacanaśaktiṣu cānaś|| maṇḍayamānā ityādi| ṭhmaḍi
bhūṣāyām',ṭhbhūṣa alaṅkāre' curādī, ṭhasu
kṣepaṇe',paryāsaḥūusannahanam, śikhāparyāyaḥ śikhaṇḍaśabdaḥ|
vacanagrahaṇaṃ vispaṣṭārtham||
iṅdhāryoḥ śatrakṛcchriṇi|| 3|2|130 ||
iṅdhāryoḥ śatrakṛcchriṇi|| akṛcchraḥ sukhasādhyo yasya dhātvartha iti|
astīti śeṣaḥ| ṭhata iniṭhanau' itīniḥ, aputrā bhāryādivad
bahuvrīhiṇaiva siddhe tatpuruṣānmatvarthīyaḥ kṛtaḥ; laghutvamprati
sarvatrānādarāt| iṅ ātmanepaditvāddhārayateśca kartrabhiprāye śatā na
siddhyati, lasārvadhātukānudātatvaṃ ca prāpnotītyayamārambhaḥ||
dviṣo'mitre || 3|2|131 ||
dviṣo'mitre|| asandehārtham ṭhmitre dviṣaḥ' iti
sūtrānyāsādakārapraśleṣo vijñāyata ityāha---amitraśśatruriti|
amerdviṣatīti tracpratyayaḥ, na punarayaṃ nañsamāsaḥ,
paravalliṅgaprasaṅgāt lokāśrayatvālliṅgasya| svare doṣaḥ,
citsvaro hīṣyate| bahvacāstu
madhyodātamamitraśabdamadhīyate---amitrasya vyathayā manyumindraḥ,
amairamitramardaya| dviṣessvaritatvātkartrabhiprāye śatā na
prāpnotityayamārambhaḥ||
suño yajñasaṃyoge|| 3|2|132 ||
suño yajñayaṃyoge|| karmasādhanassaṃyogaśabda
ityāda---yajñasaṃyukte'bhiṣava iti| sarve sunvanta iti| prayogaḥ| tasya
viṣayamāha---sarve yajamānāssatriṇa ucyante iti| sūtreṣu hi ye
yajamānāste ṛtvija iti sarve pradhānakartāraḥ| iha ṭhsuño yajñe'
ityeva siddham, yajñaviṣayaścetsunotyartho bhavatītyarthaḥ, tatkiṃ
saṃyogagrahaṇena? tatrāha---saṃyogagrahaṇamiti| ṭhlaṭaḥ śatṛśānacau'
ityanenāpyapradhāne kartari na bhavati,
saṃyogagrahaṇasāmarthyātpradhānakartāuadhikārī||
arhaḥ prasaṃsāyām|| 3|2|133 ||
arhaḥ prasaṃsāyām|| arhati cauro vadhamiti| ṭhlaṭaḥ śatṛśānacau'
ityanenāpi na bhavati, prathamāsamānādhikaraṇatvāt| astu vā
ṭhadupadeśāllasārvadhātukam' ityanudātaḥ||
ā kvestacchīlataddharmatatsādhukāriṣu|| 3|2|134 ||
ā kvestacchīlataddharmatatsādhukāriṣu|| tadityādi| ṭhdhātoḥ' iti
vartate, dhātuśca śabdaḥ, na tasya śīlādiprativiśeṣaṇatvamupapadyate,
tasmātasya yo'rthaḥ sa śīlādīnāṃ trayāṇāṃ viśeṣyāṇāṃ
viśeṣaṇatvena tribhistacchabdairnirdiśyate| tatra dhātvarthe śīlaṃ yasya sa
dhātvartho dharmo yasya tasya dhātvarthasya sādhukārītyevamityarthaḥ|

śīleneti| tacchīlādbhedaṃ darśayati| yo dhātvartha sāghu
karotīti| vināpi śīlenetyanuṣaṅgaḥ||
tṛn|| 3|1|135 ||
tṛn|| muṇḍayitāra iti| śrāviṣṭhāyanānāṃ gotraviśeṣāṇāmeṣa

prācām' iti vuñ, teṣāmeva deśadharmaḥ| śrāddhe siddheḥ| nirvṛte|
unnetāra iti| ayamapi kuladharmaḥ|
tṛnvidhāviti| atācchīlyādyartha ārambhaḥ| tṛjeva bhavatīti| tṛntṛcau
ṭhśaṃsikṣadādibhyaḥ saṃjñāyāṃ cāniṭau' ityanena| svare viśeṣa iti|

praśāsteti| tṛcyapīṇnāsti|
nayateḥ ṣuk ceti| guṇe kṛte ṣug veditavyaḥ, prakṛtyantaraṃ vā;
neṣati, neṣatuḥ, neṣitheti darśanāt|
aniṭtvaṃ cota| tviṣaḥ svata
evāniṭtvāduktavakṣyamāṇasarvopasaṃkhyānaśeṣabhūtamidam| tena
potā, kṣatetyaniṭatvaṃ bhavati|
kṣaderiti| dhātuṣvapaṭhito'pi kṣadirasmādeva vacanādabhyupagamyate,
ātmanepadī cāyam| ukṣāṇā vā vahataṃ vākṣadanta iti

alaṃkṛñnirākṛñprajanotpacotpatonmadarucyapatrapavṛtuvṛdhusahacara iṣṇuc|| 3|2|136 ||
alaṃkṛñnirākṛñprajanotpacotpatonmadarucyapatrapavṛtuvṛdhusahacara iṣṇuc|| kṛñiti karotergrahaṇam, prasiddheḥ, na hisārthasya| ṭhjanī prādurbhāve' ṭhḍupacaṣpāke',ṭhpaci vyaktīkaraṇe ityasyeditvānnumā bhāvyamiti nāyaṃ nirddeśaḥ sambhavati| ṭhśala hula patlṛ gatau' ṭhutpattiṣṇū ca ceratuḥ kharadūṣaṇau' iti bhaṭṭikāvye prayogaḥ|ṭhpada gatau' ityanye paṭhanti| ṭhmado harṣe',ṭhmada tṛptiyoge' ityayaṃ tu curādiḥ, tasyonmadeti nirddeśo na sambhavati| ṭhruca dīptau',ṭhtrapūṣ lajjāyām',ṭhvṛtu vartane' ṭhvṛdhu vṛdhau',ṭhṣaha marṣaṇe',ṭhcara gatyarthaḥ| ye'tra sopapadā upātāstatropātādeva rūpādbhavati, tata etanna nodanīyam----ṭhudaḥ pacapatamada' iti vaktavyam, kiṃ svarūpataḥ? pratyekamutpūrvapāṭheneti tena samutpattiṣṇuriti na bhavatītyāhuḥ| ye tu nirupapādā upātāstebhyo yathādarśanaṃ bhavati||
ṇeścchandasi|| 3|2|137 ||
ṇeścchandasi|| pārayiṣṇava iti| ṭhayāmantālvāyyetnviṣṇuṣu'

bhuvaśca|| cchandasītyucyate, tatkatham----ṭhjagatprabhoraprabhaviṣṇu

glājisthaśca gsnuḥ|| 3|2|139 ||
glājisthaśca gsnuḥ|| cartvabhūta iti| cartvaṃ prāptaścartvena vā
prāpta ityarthaḥ| rśyukaḥ kitītyatrāpīti| gakāro'pi cartvabhūto
nirddiśyata ityanuṣaṅgaḥ|
vasnorgitvānna stha īkāraḥ| sthāsnurityatra īkāro na bhavati,
ksnorgitvāt| kaṅitorītviśāsanāt| kakāre'kāra uccāraṇārthaḥ|
kṅitohiṇtvamucyate, ayaṃ tu git| yadyevaṃ jiṣṇurbhūṣṇurityatra
guṇaḥ prāpnoti? ----guṇābhāvastriṣu smāryaḥ| git kit ṅiditi
triṣu guṇābhāvaḥ smartavyaḥ; ṭhkṅiti ca' ityatra gakārapraśleṣāt| iha
tarhi bhūṣṇuriti rṭhśyukaḥ kiti' itīṭpratiṣedho na
prāpnoti?----rśyuko'niṭtvaṃ gakoritoḥ| rśyukaḥ parasya
yadaniṭtvaṃ tadgakārakakārayordvayorapītorbhavati, na kevalaṃ
kakāre; tatrāpi gakārasya cartvabhūtasya nirddeśāt| yadyevam,
cartvasyāsiddhatvād ṭhhaśi ca' ityutvaṃ prāpnoti? sautro nirddeśaḥ,
asaṃhitayā vā nirddeśaḥ kariṣyate cchandasi| daṃkṣṇavaḥ paśava iti|
ksnorgitvādupadhālopābhāvaḥ||

trasigṛdhidhṛṣikṣipeḥ knuḥ|| trasnuriti| ṭhneḍvaśi kṛti'

śamityaṣṭābhyo ghinuṇ|| 3|1|141 ||
śamityaṣṭābhyo ghinuṇ|| itiśabda ādyarthe iti|
anekārthatvānnipātānām| tatra ṭhśam' iti ādiryeṣāmiti bahuvrīhau
supo luk, ṭhśamu upaśamane',ṭhtamu kāṅkṣāyām',ṭhdamu
upasamane',ṭhśramu tapasi khede ca',ṭhbhramu anavasthāne',ṭhkṣamūṣ
sahane',ṭhklamu glānau',ṭhmadī harṣe'| ukāra uccāraṇārtha iti|
nānubandhaḥ, anubandhe hi sati śaminau śamina ityatra ṭhugidacām' iti
num prasajyeta;śaminitarā, śaminitametyatra nadyāḥ
śeṣasyānyatarasyām ṭhugitaśca' ityanyatarasyāṃ hrasvaḥ syāt;
ṭhgharūpakalpacelaḍ' iti nityamiṣyate, tasmānnāyamanubandhaḥ, kiṃ

eva' iti sthitam| tatra hrasvatvaṃ vikalpeneṣyate, na nityam|
numvidhau tu jhalgraṇamanuvartiṣyate, ajhalantatvānna praviṣyati|
śamīti| ṭhnodātasya' iti vṛddhipratiṣedhaḥ| unmādīti| nanu mādītyatra
caritārthametat, utpūrvātvalaṃkṛñādisūtreṇa viśeṣavihita
iṣṇujeva prāpnoti, vā'sarūpavidhinā ghinuṇ bhaviṣyati,
tācchīlikeṣu vā'sarūpavidhirnāstītyetatu prāyikamiti vakṣyate|
asiteti| ṭhasu kṣepaṇe',tṛnneva
bhavati||

sampṛcānurudhāṅyamāṅyasaparisṛsaṃsṛjaparidevisaṃjvaraparikṣipapariraṭaparivadaparidahaparimuhaduṣadviṣadrahaduhayujākrīvivicatyajarajabhajāticarācarāmuṣābhyahanaśca|| ṭhpucī saṃparkea', rudhir āvaraṇe'; ṭhano rudha kāme' ityasya tu daivādikasyāgrahaṇam; pṛcinā sāhacaryāt| anunā saha paṭhitasya daivādikasya grahaṇamityanye| ṭhyama uparame',ṭhyasu prayatne', ṭhsṛ gatau',ṭhsṛja visarge', devṛ devane',ṭhjvara roge',ṭhkṣip preraṇe',ṭhraṭa paribhāṣaṇe',ṭhvada vyaktāyāṃ vāci',ṭhdaha bhasmīkaraṇe',ṭhmuha vaicitye',ṭhduṣa vaikṛtye',dviṣa aprītau',ṭhdruha jighāṃsāyām',ṭhduha prapūraṇe',ṭhyujin yoge',ṭhkrīḍḥa vihāre, ṭhvicir pṛthagbhāve',ṭhtyaja hānau',ṭhrañja rāge',ṭhbhaja sevāyām',ṭhcara gatyarthaḥ, ṭhmuṣa steye',ṭhhana hisāgatyoḥ'| paridevirbūvādiriti| gṛhyate iti sambandhaḥ| krīḍārtasya tu ṇyantasyāgrahaṇam, aṇyantaiḥ sāhacaryāt, pratipadoktatvācca| ata eva ṭhdiva parikūjana' ityasya caurādikasyāpi na bhavati| saṃparkīti| ṭhcajoḥ ku ghiṇṇyatoḥ' iti kutvam| ye'tra saṃpūrvāḥ teṣāṃ dvandvaṃ kṛtvā ṭhsama etebhyaḥ' iti vaktavyam, evamāṅpūrveṣu paripūrveṣu ca, evaṃ siddhe yatpratipadaṃ paṭhati tasyaitatprayojanam---upātādaeva rūpādyathā syāt, upasargāntarayuktānmā bhūditi||

atha kimartha nindādibhyo vuñ vidhīyate, na ṭhṇvultṛcau' iti
ṇvulaiva siddham, tadeva rūpam, svaro'pyasūyatimekaṃ

nanu cātra caṃkramyaprabhṛtayaḥ keciccalanārthaḥ padistvanudātet,

jñāpakārthamiti| jñāpanaṃ jñāpakam, bhāṣyakāraprayogādbhāve ṇvul|

vāsarūpanivṛtyartha tviti| tācchīlike vā'sarūpavidhirnāstīti

bhavantīti jñāpitam| iha tu tācchīlikeṣu parasparaṃ
vā'sarūpavidhirnāstīti jñāpyate| alaṃkarteti| evamalaṃkṛñāstṛnna
bhavatītyarthaḥ| yathā tu padigrahaṇaṃ jñāpakaṃ tathā darśayati----tathā
hīti| ukañā viśeṣavihiteneti| ṭhlaśeṣavihiteneti| ṭhlaṣapatapada'

vakṣyate| ganteti| gamerlaṣapatapadādyaukañviṣaye tṛn bhavati|
vikatthana iti| ṭhvau kaṣalaṣa' iti ghinuṇviṣaye'nudātellakṣaṇo
yuj bhavati||

yuj na bhaviṣyatīti pratiṣedho'yamanarthakassyāt| tathā cetyādinā
prāyikatvasya prayojanaṃ darśayati| nānena pratiṣedhena yujrayoreva
samāveśo jñāpyate, yathā bhāṣye pratibhāsaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? jñāpakasyaiva
prāyikatvam| tena ṭhgantā kheṭṃa vikatthanaḥ' ityapi bhavati| etacca
pūrvamevoktam|

jiddakṣiviśrīṇvamāvyathābhyamaparibhūprasūbhyaśca|| 3|2|157 ||
jiddakṣiviśrīṇvamāvyathābhyamaparibhūprasūbhyaśca|| ṭhjī jaye' ji
abhibhave'---dvayorapi grahaṇam, ṭhddaṅ ādare',ṭhśriñ sevāyām',ṭhiṇ
gatau,ṭhṭuavam udvamane',ṭhvyatha bhayacalanayoḥ' nañpūrvaḥ, nañaḥ
kṛtalopasya nirddeśaḥ, nipātanācca naño dhātunā samāsaḥ, tato
valopaḥ, tataḥ pratyayaḥ| ṭhama roge',ṭhbhū satāyām'| dvayorapi
grahaṇamiti| ṭhkṣiṣ hiṃsāyām' ityasya tu sānubandhakatvādagrahaṇam|
ṣū preraṇa ityasya grahaṇamiti| ṭhṣūṅ prāṇigarbhavimocane'ṭhṣūṅ
prāṇiprasave' ityetayostu sānubandhakatvādagrahaṇam| prajorapyatraiva
grahaṇaṃ kartavyam, evaṃ hi cakāro na vaktavyo bhavati? tathā tu na
kṛmityeva||
spṛhigṛhipatidayinidrātandrāśraddhābhya āluc|| 3|2|158 ||
spṛhigṛhipatidayinidrātandrāśraddhābhya āluc|| curādāvadantāḥ
paṭha|lnta iti| tena ṇau kṛtasyāto lopasya sthānivadbhāvātpatayateḥ
ṭhata upadhāyāḥ' iti vṛddhirna bhavati, spṛhayatigṛhayatyośca
laghūpadhaguṇo na bhavatīti bhāvaḥ| śratpūrvo dhāñiti| dheṭastu
śratpūrvasyāprayoga eva| atha kimarthamālujvidhīyate, na lujevocyeta?
kā rūpasiddhiḥ? spṛhayāluḥ śapi kṛte ṭhato dīrgho yañi' iti dīrgho
bhaviṣyati? tatra hi ṭhturustuśamyamaḥ sārvadhātuke' iti
sārvadhātukagrahaṇamanuvartate, na tu tiṅgrahaṇam,
lakārasyetsaṃjñāprayojanābhāvānna bhaviṣyati, yakārāditvādvā| kiṃ
yakāro na śrūyate? luptanīrdiṣṭo yakāraḥ, evamapi śraddhālurna
siddhyati, katham? śapaḥ ślurdvirvacanam, ṭhśnābhyastayorātaḥ'
śraddadhluriti prāpnoti? athāpi ṭhsaṃjñāpūrvako vidhiranityaḥ' iti
dvirvacanaṃ na pravartiṣyata ityucyeta? evamapi jñāpanārthamāluj
vidhīyate, etaj jñāpayati---yatrālucaiva rūpasiddhistato'pyayaṃ
bhavatīti| tenāluci śīṅe grahaṇamityetanna vaktavyaṃ bhavati||
dādheṭsiśadasado ruḥ|| 3|2|159 || 
dādheṭsiśadasado ruḥ|| ṭhgāmādāgrahaṇeṣvaviśeṣaḥ' iti dārūpāṇāṃ
yathābhidhānaṃ grahaṇam| dheṭ pāne, ṭhṣiñ banvane', ṭhśadlṛ
śātane',ṭhṣadlṛ viśaraṇagatyavasādaneṣu||
sṛghasyadaḥ kmarac|| 3|2|160 ||
sṛghasyadaḥ kmarac|| ghasiḥ prakṛtyantaramasti|| 
bhañcabhāsamido ghurac|| 3|2|161 ||
bhañcabhāsamido ghurac||ṭhbhañco āmarddane',ṭhbhāsṛ dīptau,'ṭhñimidā
snehane'||
vidibhidicchideḥ kurac|| 3|2|162 ||
vidibidiccideḥ kurac|| na lābhārthasyeti|
jñānārthasyedamupalakṣaṇaṃ na lābhārthasyetyarthaḥ| kuta
ityāha---svabhāvāditi| tena ṭhlugvikaraṇālugvikaraṇayorityetadapi
na pravartata ityartaḥ| vidibhidicchiderṅiditi prakṛtasyaiva ghuraco
ṅtvāitideśenaiva siddhe ṭhpratyayāntarakaraṇamātideśikaṃ
ṅtvimanityam' iti jñāpanārtham| tena ṭhdhū vidhūnane' kuṭādiḥ,
tataḥ ṭhartilūdhū' itītrapratyayo kṛte ṅitkārya na bhavati|
kecitu---dhuvitramityevecchanti, prāṇā vai dhuvitrāṇīti chāndasaṃ
tadanusāreṇa kalpasūtreṣu prayogaḥ| karmakartarīti| māghastu śuddhe
kartari prayuṅkte---ṭhgurumatsaracchidurayā durayācitamaṅganā'
iti||
iṇnaśjisartibhyaḥ kvarap|| 3|2|163 || 
iṇnaśjisartibhyaḥ kvarap|| kvarapaḥ pakāraḥ svarārthaḥ, tugarthaśca|
itvarīti| ṭhṭiḍḍhāṇañ' ityādinā ṅīp||
gatvaraśca|| 3|2|164 ||
jāgarūkaḥ|| 3|2|165 ||
yajayapadaśāṃ yaṅaḥ|| 3|2|166 ||
namikampismyajasakamahiṃsadīpo raḥ|| 3|2|167 ||
namikampismyajasakamahiṃsadīpo raḥ|| ajasetyakāra āgantukaḥ|
kriyāsātatye iti| kriyāṇāmavicchedena pravṛttiḥūukriyāsātatyam|
kathaṃ tarhi agniṣu prayogaḥ----ajasrānajuhūta indhīranniti, ādhānād
dvādaśarātramajasrā iti? atrāpyajasrajāgaraṇādajasrāḥ||
sanāśaṃsabhikṣa uḥ|| 3|2|168 ||
sanāśaṃsabhikṣa uḥ|| na sanirdhāturiti| ṭhṣaṇu dāne' ṭhvana ṣaṇa
saṃbhaktau' iti ca dhāturna gṛhyate, kutaḥ? gargādiṣu vijigīṣuśabdasya
pāṭhāt| na śaṃseḥ stutyarthasyeti| etadāṅa saha
nirddaśādvijāyate---icchārtho hi sa tena saha paṭha|lte, na stutyarthaḥ||
vinduricchuḥ|| 3|2|169 ||
vinduricchuḥ|| videriti| jñānārthasya grahaṇaṃ netareṣām,
abhidhānāt, nipātanādvā| binduśabdastu pavargādiḥ ṭhbidi avayave'
ityasmādauṇādike ṭhmṛgayvādayaśca' ityupratyaye bhavati|
vakārasyacchandasi pakṣe bhakāra iṣyate---vaiśvadevā bhindava iti|
iṣeriti| ṭhiṣu icchāyām' ityasya| ṭhiṣu gatau' ṭhiṣa ṭhābhīkṣṇye'
ityetayostu pūrvavadagrahaṇam||
kyācchandasiḥ|| 3|2|170 ||
kyācchandasiḥ|| kya iti kyackyaṣkayaṅaṃ sāmānyena nirdeśa iti| sūtre
vṛtau ca kakārānubandhavato dhātusaṃjñānimitasya
pratyayasyopalakṣaṇāt kaṇḍvādiyako'pi grahaṇam, tena bhuraṇyuḥ
turaṇyavo'ṅgiraso nakṣatrasaparyema saparyava ityādi bhavati|
bhāṣāyāṃ ca sumnayuśabda uṇādiṣu mṛgayvādiṣu pāṭhād draṣṭavyaḥ|
mitrayuriti| ṭhkyaci ca' itītvam, ṭhakṛtsārvadhātukayoḥ' iti
dīrghatvaṃ ca na bhavati, ṭhna cchandasyaputrasya' iti niṣedhāt||
āddagamahanajanaḥ kikinau liṭ ca|| 3|2|171 ||
āddagamahanajanaḥ kikinau liṭ ca|| kikinau liṭ cāparārthe
prayujyamānāḥ śabdā vatimantareṇāpi vatyartha gamayanti, gaurvāhīka
itivadityāha---liḍvacca tau bhavati iti| kikinau bhavataḥ, liṭ ca
pratyayo bhavatītyayaṃ tvartho na bhavati; tathā hi sati ṭhliṭ kikinaḥ'
ityeva brūyāt| kāryātideśaścāyam| yadyevam, ṭhlaḥ parasmaipadasaṃjñā
kikinoḥ syāt, tataśca deṅddaṅadibhya ātmanepadibhyo na
syātām| na lakārasya parasmaipadasaṃjñā, kiṃ tarhi? tadādeśānām, na
caitāvādeśau| evamapi bhāvakarmakartṛṣu triṣvapi
liḍvadbhāvātkikinau prāpnutaḥ?
naiṣaḥ;utpannayorliṭkāryamatideśyam| utpattiśca tayoḥ kartaryeva
bhavati; ṭhkartari kṛt' ityanenāsyaikavākyatvāt| anabhidhānādvā
bhāvakarmaṇorna bhaviṣyataḥ| vartamānādhikārācca vartamāne
kikinorvidhānamiti bhūtakālatāpi virodhānnātidiśyate|
svarūpābādhena ca kāryādideśaḥ pravartata iti tibādīnāṃ
kānackvasvoścābhāvaḥ| āditi dakāro mukhasukhārtha iti| ādityayaṃ
dakāraḥ, sa ca mukhasukhārtha ityarthaḥ| na tvayaṃ tapara iti| taścāsau
paraśca taparo nāyamakārātparastakāro jaśtvena nirddiṣṭa
ityarthaḥ| kiṃ kāraṇamityāha---mā bhūditi| takāro mukhasukhārtha iti
pāṭhe tu ādityayaṃ takāraḥ sa mukhasukhārthaḥ, na tu
taparakāryasampādanārtha ityarthaḥ| papiḥ somamiti| ṭhna lokāvyaya'
iti ṣaṣṭhīpratiṣedho liṭaḥ kāryamiti somaśabdād dvitīyā|
tatuririti| ṭhbahulaṃ cchandasi' ityutvam| ṭhdvirvacane'ci' iti
sthānivadbhāvāt ṭhtṛ' ityetad dvirucyate| jajñiriti| ṭhgamahana'
ityupadhālopaḥ, cutvam|
tadvāghanārtha kitvamiti| arterṛkārāntānāṃ ca kikinorguṇo mā
bhūdityevamarthamityarthaḥ|
utsarga iti| dhātumātrādvidhānaṃ kartavyamityarthaḥ|
kasmādityatrāha---sadādibhyo daśanāditi| sediḥ nemiriti|
sadernameścaitvābhyāsalopau|
sahivahityādi| atra bhāṣāyāmityapekṣyate| pāpatiriti| ṭhnīgvañcu'
ityādinā nīgāgamaḥ prāptaḥ sāsahivāvahicācalipāpatīnāṃ
nipātanam' iti vārtikakāravacanānna bhavati| idaṃ tu vṛtau paṭhitaṃ
vākyam| apara āheti bhāṣye paṭhitam, tatrāpi
bhāṣyakāravacanānnīgabhāvaḥ| uktaṃ hi tena---tānyevodāharaṇānīti||
svapitṛṣornijiṅ|| 3|2|172 ||
śṛvandyorāruḥ|| 3|2|173 ||
bhiyaḥ kruklukanau|| 3|2|174 ||
stheśabhāsapisakaso varac|| 3|2|175 ||
stheśabhāsapisakaso vacac|| īśvara iti| ṭhneḍvaśi kṛti'
itīṭpratiṣedhaḥ| striyāmīśvarā| vinyastamaṅgalamahauṣadhimīśvarāyāḥ|
ṭhīśvaraāā sarvabhūtānām' iti tu chāndasaḥ| auṇādiko varaḍityanye|
ṭhpuṃyogādākhyāyām' ityanye| ṭhanyebhyo'pi ddaśyante' iti kvanipi
ṭhvano ra ca' iti ṅībrāvītyanye||
yaśca yaṅaḥ|| 3|2|176 ||
yāyāvara iti pūrvavadiṭi pratiṣiddhe ṭhato lopaḥ',ṭhlopo
vyorvali',ṭhallopasya sthānivatvādāllopaḥ prāpto vare kṛtasya
sthānivatvaniṣedhānna bhavati||
bhrājabhāsadhurvidyau torjipṛjugrāvastuvaḥ kvip|| 3|2|177 ||
bhrājabhāsadhurvidyau torjipṛjugrāvastuvaḥ kvip|| ṭhbhrājṛ
dīptau',ṭhbhāsṛ dīptau',ṭhturvī thurvī dhurvī hiṃsāyām',ṭhdyauta
dīptau',ṭhurja balaprāṇanayoḥ',ṭhpṛ pālanapūraṇayoḥ',ṭhju' iti
sautro dhātuḥ,ṭhṣṭuañ stutau' grāvapūrvaḥ|
javaterdīrghatvaṃ ceti| kecidāhuḥ---sūtre ṭhjū' iti dīrghaḥ paṭhitavya
iti| vidhya ntaropasaṃgrahārtha
ddaśigrahaṇamutarasūtrādapakraṣṭavyamityanye| grāvastuditi| grāvaśabdaḥ
saptamīnirdeśābhāve'pyupapadasaṃjña iṣyate| anye tu
sūtranirdeśāddhātunaiva samāse paścātkvipaṃ kurvanti||
anyebhyo'pi ddaśyate|| 3|2|178 ||
anyebhyo'pi ddaśyate|| vidhyantaropasaṃgrahārthamiti| ddaśigrahaṇe sati
yathā kvibantā dhātavo ddaśyante, tathaiva te'nugantavyā ityartho
bhavati| evaṃ ca te tathānugatā bhavanti yadi yathāyogaṃ
dvirvacanādayo--bhavanti| vidhyantarameva darśayatikvaciditi| tathā
cāheti| vārtikakāraḥ| āyataṃ stautyāyatastūḥ| kaṭṃa pravate
kaṭaprūḥ| didyuditi| ṭhdyautisvāpyoḥ samprasāraṇam' ityabhyāsya
sampasāraṇam| kathaṃ punarabhyāsasaṃjñā, yāvatā pratyāsateḥ ṣāṣṭhika eva
dvirvacane sā vidhīyate, ata evāṣṭamike na bhavati? evaṃ tarhi
ddaśigrahaṇādeva samprasāraṇam, abhyāsasaṃjñā ca draṣṭavyā| jagaditi|
ṭhgamaḥ kvau' iti malopaḥ| atrāpi pūrvavadennnnnnsakāryam| 
dve ceti cakāreṇa dīrghaḥ samuccīyamāno dīrghaśrutyā ṭhacaśca'
ityupasthānādacā ca tadantavidhyāśrayaṇājjuhoterevājantasya
vijñāyate, na dyautigamyorityāha---juhoterdīrghitvaṃ ceti|
juhūriti| karaṇasyātra kartṛtvavivakṣā|
dhīrityatrāpi karaṇasyaiva kartṛtvavivakṣā, puruṣo hi dhyāyati, na
dhīḥ||
bhuvaḥ saṃjñāntarayoḥ|| 3|2|179 ||
bhuvaḥ saṃjñāntarasoḥ|| dhanikādhamarṇayoriti| yasmai ṛṇaṃ dhāryate sa
dhanikaḥ, yo dhārayati so'dhamarṇaḥ, tayorantare madhye yastiṣṭhati
viśvāsārtha sa pratibhūrityucyate| grāmayorantare yastiṣṭhati tatra na
bhavati| etacca ddaśigrahaṇānuvṛterlabhyate| yadyebam, saṃjñeyaṃ bhavati,
tatra ṭhsaṃjñāyām' ityeva siddham? atrāhuḥ-----yāvadbhavyabhāvinyaḥ
saṃjñā bhavanti, pratibhūśabdastu satyeva tasminnṛṇapratidāne
nivartate||
viprasaṃbhyo ṅvasaṃjñāyām|| 3|2|180 ||
viprasaṃbhyo ṅvasaṃjñāyām|| mitadravādibhya iti| mitādipūrvebhyo
dhātubhya ityarthaḥ| śambhuriti| antarbhāvitaṇyartho'tra bhavatiḥ||
dhaḥ karmaṇi ṣṭran|| 3|2|181 ||
dhaḥ karmaṇi ṣṭran|| karmaṇi kāraka iti| upapadaṃ tu karma na smabhavati,
yadi syāt ṭhkarmaṇyaṇ' ityasminneva prakaraṇe ṣṭranaṃ vidadhyāt| nanu
cotarasūtre punaḥ ṣṭrangrahaṇaṃ kartavyaṃ syāt, astu laghīyo hi
karmagrahaṇātṣṭrangrahaṇam| na ceha vartamānakāle ṣṭranpratyayaḥ,
dhātrītyukte kriyākārakasambandhamātraṃ gamyate| ataḥ ṭhkarmaṇi' iti
pratyayārtha eva, nopapadam||
dāmnīśasayuyujastutudasisicamihapatadaśanahaḥ karaṇe|| 3|2|182 ||
dāmnīśasayuyujastutudasisicamihapatadaśanahaḥ karaṇe|| dāp lavana
iti| ṭhdaip śodhane' ityasya tvagrahaṇam, anabhidhānāt| yujiryoga
iti| ṭhyuja samādhau' ityasya tu pūrvavadevāgrahaṇam, anabhidhānāt|
yujiryoga iti| ṭhyuja samādhau' ityasya tu pūrvavadevāgrahaṇam|
karaṇe kārake iti| upapadaṃ tu karaṇaṃ na bhavati, ajādiṣu
daṃṣṭrāśabdasya pāṭhāt| ata eva ca pāṭhātsūtre'nunāsikalopena
nirddeśe'pi ṣṭrani na bhavati lyuṭa|leva tu bhavati| yo'tra seṭ
tataḥ ṭhtitutra' ityādineṭpratiṣedhaḥ||
halasūkarayoḥ puvaḥ|| 3|2|183 ||
halasūkarayoḥ puvaḥ|| taccetkaraṇaṃ halasūkarayoravayavo bhavatīti|
etena halasūkarayorabhidheyatvamupapadatvaṃ ca nirasyati| mukhamucyate
iti| nānyaḥ karṇādiḥ| etadapi svabhāvādeva labhyate||
artilūdhūsūkhanasahacara itraḥ|| 3|2|184 ||
artilūdhūsūkhanasahacara itraḥ|| ikāropadeśaḥ ṭhtitutra' iti ṭhekācaḥ'
iti ca yathāyogamiṭpratiṣedho mā bhūditi| svarārthaśca, iṭi hi
satyāgamānudātatvaṃ syāt, ikā tu pratyayādyaudātadtatvam||
puvaḥ saṃjñāyām|| 3|2|185 ||
puvaḥ saṃjñāyām|| barhiṣpavitramiti| barhiṣā kṛtaṃ barhiṣaḥ pavitraṃ
bhavati, tatra ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ, ṭhnityaṃ samāse'nutarapadasthasya' iti
ṣatvam| yenājyamutpūyate tatpavitram|
anāmikāyāścāṅgulerveṣṭhanaṃ japādiṣu||
kartari carṣidavatayoḥ|| 3|2|186 ||
kartari carṣidevatayoḥ|| ṛṣau karaṇe iti| ṛṣiḥūvedamantraḥ,
ṭhtaduktamṛṣiṇā' iti darśanādityāhuḥ||
ñītaḥ ktaḥ|| 3|2|187 ||
ñītaḥ ktaḥ|| bhūte niṣṭhā vihitetyādi| tatra yenanāprāptinyāyena
ktasyaiva vartamānaviṣayatayā bhūtaviṣayatā bādhyate, yathā---ṭhvaḍavāyā
vṛṣe vācye' ityatra vakṣyate---apatye prāptastato'pakṛṣya vṛṣe
vidhīyata iti| evamutaravihitasyāpi| jñātamityetatu bhūte'pi
bhavati, tenetyadhikāre upajñāta iti taddhitavidhānāt| vartamāne hi
ṭhktasya ca vartamāne' iti ṣaṣṭha|la bhāvyam| evaṃ ca ṭhpūjito yaḥ
surairapi' ityādīnāṃ sādhutvaṃ cintyam||
matibuddhipūjārthebhyaśca|| 3|2|188 ||
matibuddhipūjārthebhyaśca|| matiriccheti| buddheḥ pṛthagupādānād
buddhirna gṛhyate| mata iti| ṭhanudātopadeśa' ityanunāsikalopaḥ|
śīlita ityādi| ṭhśīla samādhau',ṭhrakṣa pālane',ṭhkṣamūṣ sahane',ṭhkruśa
āhvāne rodane ca',ṭhjuṣī prītisevanayoḥ',ṭhruṣa roṣe',ṭhhṛñ
haraṇe';ṭhhṛṣu alīke',ṭhhṛṣ tuṣṭau' iti vā; ṭhtuṣa tuṣṭau',ṭhkamu
kāntau',ṭhyama uparame',ṭhkaṣa hiṃsāyām' mṛṅ prāṇatyāge'| tatrādyau
seṭau, uditāmuditāṃ ca ṭhyasya vibhāṣā' itīṭpratiṣedhaḥ, īditaḥ
ṭhśvīdito niṣṭhāyām' iti| hṛṣṭa iti| ṭhhṛṣerlomasu' iti| kaṣeḥ
ṭhkṛcchragahanayoḥ kaṣaḥ' iti| ruṣeḥ ṭhruṣyamatvarasaṃdhuṣāsvanām' iti
vikalpaḥ|
supta iti| supeḥ ṭhtrītaḥ ktaḥ' ityeva siddhe najiṅa tacchīlādiṣu bādyā
mā bhūditi samuccīyate| kvacitu sṛpta iti paṭha|lte||
iti śrīharadatamiśraviracitāyāṃ padamañcaryo
tṛtīyasyādhyāyasya dvitīyaḥ pādaḥ||

uṇādayo bahulam || 3|3|1 || padamañjarī
vartamāne ityeveti | ṭhvartamāne laṭ' ityato
vartamānagrahaṇānuvṛteravicchedamevakāreṇa darśayati | saṃjñāyāmiti
ceti | ṭhpuvaḥ saṃjñāyām' ityataḥ ||
ṭhuṇādayaḥ' ityeva sūtramuṇādīnāṃ śāstrāntaraparipaṭhitānāṃ
sādhutvānujñānārthamastu, kiṃ bahulagrahaṇena ? tatrāha---bāhulakamiti
| ṭhlā ādāne', bahūnarthān lāti---bahulam, tasya bhāvo
bāhulakam, manojñāditvād vuñ | tatpunarbahvarthādānaṃ
bahulaśabdapravṛttinimitam | bahavaḥ punararthāḥ---kvacitpravṛttiḥ,
kvacidapravṛttiriti vakṣyamāṇalakṣaṇāḥ | prakṛteriti |
jātāvekavacanam | tanuśabdo'tra vṛttiviṣaye guṇamātravacanaḥ |
prakṛtīnāṃ tānavamalpatvaṃ dṛṣṭvā tadbāhulakamuktam,
tenāpaṭhitābhyo'pi prakṛtibhya uṇādayo bhavanti,
yathā---hṛṣerulajuktaḥ śakerapi bhavati---śaṅkuleti | tathā
teṣāmuṇādīnāṃ pañcapādyāṃ prāyeṇa samuccayanaṃ kṛtam, na tu
sākalyena; bahulavacanātvavihitā api bhavanti, yathā---arteḥ
phiḍaphiḍḍau bhavataḥ---ṛphiḍaḥ, ṛphiḍḍa iti | kāryasaśeṣavidheśca
| kāryāṇi ca saśeṣāṇi vihitāni na niḥ śeṣāṇi |
bahulavacanātvavihitānyapi bhavanti | ṭhṣaṇu dāne', ṭhñamantāḍḍaḥ',
ṭhdhātvādeḥ paḥ sa' iti satvaṃ na bhavati, kṛte vā satve ṣatvaṃ bhavati |
syādetat---yāvatyaḥ prakṛtayaḥ pañcapādyāmupātāḥ, yāvantaśca
pratyayāḥ, yāvanti ca kāryāṇi vihitāni tāvantyeva bhavantu, mā
bhūdanyeṣāṃ bahulagrahaṇena saṃgraha iti ? tatrāha---naigamarūḍhibhavaṃ hi
susādhviti | nigamaḥucchandaḥ, tatra bhavā naigamāḥ |
nigamaśabdasthāthādisvareṇāntodāta iti ṭhbahvaco'ntodātāṭṭhañ'
iti ṭhañi prāpte ṛgayanādipāṭhādaṇ | rūḍhiḥuprasiddhiḥ, tatra bhavā
rūḍhibhavāḥusaṃjñāśabdāḥ, teṣāṃ sādhutvamanupātānāṃ prakṛtyādīnāṃ
bahulagrahaṇena saṃgrahe sati bhavati, nānyathā | hiśabdo hetau |
yasmādevaṃ tasmādvāhulakamuktamityarthaḥ |
anyairapyācāryairnaigamarūḍhibhavānāṃ prakṛtyādivibhāgena vyutpādanaṃ
kṛtam, ato'smābhirapi tatkartavyamevetyabhiprāyeṇāha---nāma ceti
| niruktakāro hi yāska ācāryaḥ svaśāstre niruktaiḥ sarvameva nāma
dhātujamāha | tokamityapatyaṃnāma | śakaṭasya tokam śākaṭāyanaḥ |
yanneti | padamarthaḥ prayojanamaptya vyutpādyatveneti
padārthaḥuprakṛtyādiḥ, padārthaścāsau viśeṣaśca padārthaviśeṣaḥ,
tasmātsamutthitaṃ padārthaviśeṣasamuttham | yadevaṃvidhaṃ na bhavati,
prakṛtyādiviśeṣopādānenāvyutpāditamityarthaḥ,
taddhātujatvenohyam | kathamūhyam ? pratyayataḥ prakṛteśca | yatra śabdarūpe
parabhāgaḥ pratyayatvena prasiddhena kenacitsadṛśaḥ śrutaḥ, tatra taṃ bhāgaṃ
pratyayaṃ kalpayitvā pariśiṣṭo bhāgaḥ prakṛtitvenohyate |
ṭhhṛṣerulac' iti pratyayaṃ dṛṣṭvā śaṅkiḥ prakṛtirūhyate, tena siddhaṃ
śaṅkuletyasya dhātujatvam | yatra tu pūrvo bhāgo dhātutvena
prasiddhena kenacitsadṛśastatra taṃ bhāgaṃ prakṛtiṃ kalpayitvā pariśiṣṭo
bhāgaḥ pratyayanvenohyaḥ | yathā----ṛphiḍaḥ, ṛphiḍḍa iti,
phiḍaphiḍḍau pratyayau |
sa cāyamūho'nādipratyuktāsveva saṃjñāsu, na
sarvatretyāha---saṃjñāsviti | kāryād guṇapratiṣedhādikād
anūbandhaṃ kakārādikaṃ vidyāt | tena phiḍaphiḍḍau kitāvūhyāi |
etadevānantaroktamūhātmakaṃ śāstramuṇādiṣvanukteṣu ||
bhūte'pi dṛśyante || 3|3|2 ||
pūrvatra vartamānādhaikārāditi | tatraiva vartamānagrahaṇaṃ na
nivartitam, bāhulyena vartamāne bhavanti, kvacideva bhūte
bhavantīti kila vivekapradarśanāyeti bhāvaḥ | udāharaṇeṣu
ṭhtābhyāmanyatroṇādayaḥ' iti saṃpradānāpādānavyatirikte kārake
manin pratyayaḥ, ṭhneḍvaśi kṛti' itīṭpratiṣedhaḥ ||
bhaviṣyati gamyādayaḥ || 3|3|3 ||
yathā ṭhsyado jave' ityukte javaśabdaparyāyaḥ syadaśabdo bhavati,
tathehāpi bhaviṣyacchabdaparyāyā gamyādayaḥ
prāpnuvantītyāśaṅkyāha---pratyayasyaivetyādi | prakṛtyarthagatā
bhaviṣyatkālatā | pratyayasyaiva dyotyatvena vidhīyate, na punaḥ
prakṛtyarthaparityāgena samudāyasyetyarthaḥ | na prakṛteriti | na
prakṛterapītyarthaḥ | gamyādiṣu keciduṇādayaḥ,
kecidaṣṭādhyāyīgatāḥ | gamī, āgāmīti | ṭhgameriniḥ' ṭhāṅ iṇicca'
itīniḥ | bhāvī, prasthāyīti | asminnevādhikāre ṭhbhuvaśca' ṭhprātsthaḥ'
itīniḥ, ṇitvād vṛddhiryukca | rudhibudhiyudhiyātibhyaḥ
pratipūrvebhyo prahādiniḥ | asmādeva nipātanādityanye |
ṭhsupyajātau' ityanye | pratiyogīti | saṃpṛcādisūtreṇa ghinuṇi
ṭhcajoḥ ku ghiṇṇyatoḥ' iti kutvam | ṇini pratyaya eva
nyaṅkvādipāṭhādasmādeva nipātanādvā kutvamityanye |
anadyatana upasaṃkhyānamiti | kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ na siddhyati ? lṛṭāyaṃ
nirdeśaḥ kriyate lṛ
ṭ cānadyatane luṭā bādhyate, tena lṛṭa eva viṣaye ete syuḥ | na vā
vākyārthatvād gamyādayaḥ śabdā viśeṣe yatsāmānyaṃ tadāśrayeṇa
pravatante | anadyatanākhyastu viśeṣaḥ śvaḥ śabdamahimnā gamyate |
viśeṣavivakṣāyāṃ tu luḍeva bhavati---śvo gantā grāmamiti |
vāsarūpavidhinā ca lṛḍapi bhavati | tena bhaviṣyati,
gamiṣyatītyādayaḥ prayogā upapadyante ||
yāvatpurānipātayorlaṭ || 3|3|4 ||
ṭhpurā' ityavibhaktiko nirdeśaḥ, karmadhārayo vā |
nipātanādviśeṣaṇasya paranipātaḥ | nipātau caitau niścayaṃ
dyotayataḥ | etayośca prayoge vartamāne laṇna bhavati;
bhaviṣyatkālatayā vartamānakālatāyā bādhanāt |
yāvaddāsyatīti | yatparimāṇamasya ṭhyatadetebhyaḥ parimāṇe vatup',
ṭhā sarvanāmnaḥ' ityātvam | purā vrajiṣyatīti | ṭhpṛ
pālanapūraṇayoḥ' ṭhbhrājabhāsa' ityādinā kvip, ṭhudoṣṭha|lpūrvasya'
ityutvam | asya tṛtīyāntatvaṃ dyotayituṃ karaṇabhūtayetyuktam |
pratipadoktatvādeva nipātayorgrahaṇe siddhe nipātagrahaṇaṃ
lakṣaṇapratipadoktaparibhāṣāyā anityatvajñāpanārtham | tena ṭhātāṃ
pugṇau' ityatra lākṣaṇikarayāpyākārāntasya pugbhavati, ṭhkrīṅjīnāṃ
ṇau' krāpayati, jāpayatīti ||
vibhāṣā kadākarhyoḥ || 3|3|5 ||
ṭhanadyatane luṭ' ityatrāpyayaṃ yogo'nuvartanīyaḥ, tena
luḍviṣaye'pi pakṣe laḍ bhavati | ata eva pakṣe luḍapyudāhṛtaḥ |
etacca pūrvayoge'pi draṣṭavyam | kahiṃ bhokṣyate iti | nanu ca
karhiśabdo'nadyatanaviṣayaḥ, tatprayoge luḍeva bhavitumarhati, na
lṛṭ; na vā vākyarthatvāt | bhokṣyata iti padaṃ bhaviṣyatsāmānye
vartate, anadyatanāvagatistu karhi-śabdādhīnā | na ca vākyārthaḥ
padasaṃskāra upayujyate ||
kivṛte lipsāyām || 3|3|6 ||
kimo vṛtaṃ kivṛtamiti | vartate'sminniti vṛtam, ṭhkto'dhikaraṇe
ca' ityadhikaraṇe ktaḥ | asmādeva nipātanād ṭhadhikaraṇavāciṃnā ca'
iti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsapratiṣedhābhāva, śeṣaṣaṣṭha|la vā samāsaḥ | yatra
kiṃśabdo'vayavatvena vartate tatsarvaṃ kiṃvṛtam | tataśca kīdṛśaḥ,
kimīyaḥ, kintarāmityādāvatiprasaṅgātparigaṇanam |
vṛtagrahaṇeneti | taditi śabdarūpāpekṣaṃ napuṃsakatvam |
ḍataraḍatamauceti | ḍataraḍatamāntaṃ kiṃśabdarūpamityarthaḥ | kaṃ bhavanto
rbhojayitāra iti | asyāpi ṭhanadyatane luṭ' ityatrānuvṛttiriti
bhāvaḥ | evamutareṣvapi yogeṣu draṣṭavyam ||
lipsyamānasiddhau ca || 3|3|7 ||
ṭhlipsyamānasiddhau' iti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ | vṛtau tu vastumātramadarśi |
lipsyamānātsiddhiriti | asmādeva nipātanādvā pañcamīsamāsaḥ |
lipsyamānaṃ bhaktādi tannimitā yā svargādeḥ siddhistasyāmityarthaḥ |
nanu ca yatra lipsyamānasya siddhirgamyate, lipsāpi tatra bhavati, tataśca
pūrveṇaiva siddhaṃ nārtha etena ? tatrāha---akiṃvṛtārtho'yamārambha iti |
pūrvasūtre kivṛtagrahaṇaṃ lipsyamānasiddhirahite lipsāmātre kiṃvṛta
eva yathā syād, akiṃvṛte mā bhūdityevamartham ||
loḍarthalakṣaṇe ca || 3|3|8 ||
adhyayanapraiṣasyeti | ṭhkartṛkaraṇe kṛtā bahulam' ityatra sādhanaṃ
kṛteti vā pādahārakādyarthamiti vacanātsaptamīsamāsaḥ ||
liṅ caurdhvamauhūrtike || 3|3|9 ||
nipātanātsamāsa utarapadavṛddhiśceti |
ṭhañpratyayaścādhyātprāditvāt | ṭhbahvaco'ntodātāt' ityatra tu
ṭhvyākhyātavyanāmnaḥ' iti vartate | upādhyāyaścedāganteti |
ūrdhvamauhūrtike'nadyatanatvaṃ sambhavatīti cintyam ||
tumunṇvulau kriyāyāṃ kriyārthāyām || 3|3|10 ||
bhikṣiṣya ityasya jaṭā iti | atra bhikṣaṇakriyārthatvaṃ jaṭānām, na tu
kriyātvam; dravyatvājjaṭānām | dhāvataste patiṣyati daṇḍa iti |
astyatra dhāvanakriyopapadam, na tvasau daṇḍapātanārthaṃ dhāvati, kiṃ
tarhi ? dhāvato'rthātpatiṣyati daṇḍaḥ | udde śena hi tādarthyaṃ
vivicyate, na tu hetutvamātreṇa tādarthyam | athetyādi codyam |
pariharati---lṛṭā kriyārthopapadeneti | tumunā tu bādho
nāśaṅkanīyaḥ; bhinnārthatvāt---kartari ṇvul, tumun
punarbhāve | katham ? ṭhtumarthe sesen' ityatra tumarthagrahaṇāt |
yadi hi ṭhkartari kṛt' iti vacanātkartari tumun syātadvadeva
sesenprabhṛtayo'pi kartari bhaviṣyanti |
atastumarthagrahaṇātkartustāvadayamapakṛṣyate | na cānyo'rtho
nidiśyate, anidiṣṭārthāśca pratyayāḥ svārthe bhavanti | kaśca dhātoḥ
svārthaḥ ? bhāva eva | lṛṭ tu yadyapi bhāvakarmaṇoścaritārthastathāpi
kriyāyāṃ kriyārthāyāmupapade bhaviṣyati kāle ca
vidhānādviseṣavihitaḥ | ṇvulvidhau tu kartarīti na śrūyate,
ato'sau viśeṣavihitena lṛṭā bādhyate | atha vā kiṃ na etena
viśeṣavihita iti, dvayoḥsāvakāśatve'pi paratvāllṛṭ ṇvulaṃ
bādhaeta | punaścodayati---vāsarūpavidhineti | pariharati---evaṃ
tarhīti | nanvasati prayojane jñāpakaṃ bhavati, asti cātra prayojanam,
kim ? ṭhakenorbhaviṣyadādhamarṇyayoḥ' iti ṣaṣṭhīpratiṣedho
bhaviṣyadadhikāravihitasyākasya prayoge yathā syāt, varṣaśatasya
pūrakaḥ putrapautrāṇāṃ darśaka ityatra mā bhūditi ? evaṃ
manyate---padāntarasannidhānādatra bhaviṣyatkālatvaṃ gamyate | yadā hi
bālaviṣayametatprayujyate tadā tasyāmavasthāyāṃ varṣaśatapūraṇasya
putrapautradarśanasya cāsambhavātāvantamasau kālaṃ
jīviṣyatītyarthādgamyate, na tvatra padārtho bhaviṣyatkālatvamiti |
sthite tvasmin ṇvulvidhāne ṭhvaṣaśatasya pūrakaḥ' ityādau
bhaviṣyatkālasya padārthatve'pi na doṣa ityabhiprāyeṇa
ṭhakenorbhaviṣyadādhamarṇyayoḥ'
ityatroktam---bhaviṣyadadhikāravihitasyākasyedaṃ grahaṇam, tena
varṣaśatasya pūrakaḥ putrapautrāṇāṃ darśaka ityatra na bhavatīti ||
bhāvavacanāśca || 3|3|11 ||
vaktīti vacanaḥ, ṭhkṛtyalyuṭo bahulam' iti kartari lyuṭ, karaṇa
eva vā---bhāva ucyate yena sa bhāvavacanaḥ | atra puruṣāḥ kartāraḥ,
bhāvādhikāravihitā eva bhāvavacanā bhavantītyāha---bhāva iti
prakṛtyeti | tumunā bādhyeranniti | lṛṭ tu bhāvakarmakartṛṣu
triṣu vidhānādasamānārthaḥ | kiñci, dhātvarthasya siddhatāyāṃ ghañādayaḥ,
śuddhe tu dhātvarthe lakāraḥ, ato'pyasamānārthatvam |
iha ṭhbhāve' ityetāvadvaktavyam, evamapi hyucyamāne bhāve ye
vihitāste kriyāyāṃ kriyārthāyāmupapade bhavantītyartho labhyata eva,
tadapārthakaṃ vacanagrahaṇamiti matvā pṛcchati---atheti | vācakā yathā
syuriti | vacanagrahaṇe hi sati bhāvavacanāḥ santo
ghañādayo'sminviṣaye bhavantītyartho bhavati, bhāvasya vācakāḥ santo
bhavantītyarthaḥ | etadeva praśnapūrvakaṃ vivṛṇoti---kathaṃ ceti | yābhya
prakṛtibhya iti | ivarṇāntebhyo'c, ṛvarṇāntebhya
uvarṇāntebhyaścābiti | evam yena viśeṣaṇeneti | ṭhhastādāne
cerasteye', ṭhśriṇībhuvo'nupasarge' ityādinā |
asāmañjasyamuvyatikaraḥ, anyo'nyaviṣayāvagāhanamiti yāvat |
pākāyetyādau ṭhtumarthācca bhāvavacanāt' iti caturtho ||
aṇ karmaṇi ca || 3|3|12 ||
cakāraḥ sanniyogārtha iti | anyathā paryāyeṇa
syāt---kadācitkriyārthāyāmeva kriyāyāmupapade,
kadācitkarmaṇyeva kevale; vacanaṃ tu bhaviṣyati kāle
kādīnāmapavādānāṃ bādhanārthaṃ syāt | cakārātu
sanniyogārthātsamudāyasyaiva pratyayotpati prati nimitatvam |
upapadasaṃjñā tu pratyekameva bhavati; pratyekaṃ saptamīnirdeśāt |
tena kevalasyāpi karmaṇaḥ samāso bhavati | kāṇḍalāvo vrajatīti |
so'pavādatvāt ṇvulaṃ vādhata iti | ṇvulvidhāne ca kriyāyāṃ
kriyārthāyāmupapade vāsarūpeṇa tṛjādayo na bhavantīti jñāpitam,
na punarasmin prakaraṇe vāsarūpavidhirnāstīti | tena yo'yam
ṭhtumunṇvulau' iti ṇvul, so'syāṇo viṣaye'pi
vāsarūpavidhinā bhavatyeva---edhānāhārako vrajatīti | tathā ca
ṭhakenorbhaviṣyadādhamarṇyayoḥ' iti bhaviṣyadadhikāravihitasyākasya
bhaviṣyati prayoge karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī pratiṣiddhyate | paratvācca
kādīniti | nanu cāpūrvavidhānātpratiprasavavacanasya lāghavamastīti
aṇviṣaya eva ṇvulaṃ bādhitvāṇa syānnāpavādaviṣaye ? evaṃ manyate---iha
karmaṇīti na vaktavyaṃ vacanagrahaṇānuvṛtereva yo vacane'ṇ
so'sminviṣaye bhavatīti vacanavyaktathā karmaṇyevopapade'ṇ siddhaḥ,
tatra punaḥ karmagrahaṇaṃ karmamātraparigrahārthamityapavādaviṣaye'pi
bhavatīti | evaṃ ca paratvāditi ko'rthaḥ ?
utkṛṣṭatvādādhikyādityarthaḥ | anye tu vipratiṣedhameva vyācakṣate ||
lṛṭ śeṣe ca || 3|3|13 ||
śeṣaḥ kriyārthopapadādanya ucyate iti | kriyā kriyārthopapadaṃ
yasmin bhaviṣyati kāle tato'nyo bhaviṣyadityarthaḥ | cakārāditi
| yadi tahi śeṣe cāśeṣe ca bhavati lṛḍityevāstu, kriyāyāṃ
kriyārthāyāmiti nivartiṣyate, tena sarvatra bhaviṣyati ? evamapi śeṣa
eva syāt, aśeṣe tu tumunṇvulau bādhakausyātām |
vāsarūpavidhinā lṛḍapi bhaviṣyati | tadetat ṭhśeṣe ca' iti vacanaṃ
cintyaprayojanam | kariṣyāmīti vrajatīti | itiśabdaḥ
parasparasambandhajñāpanārthaḥ ||
lṛṭaḥ sadvā || 3|3|14 ||
ṭhlṛṭaḥ' iti vacanaṃ sthāninirdeśārtham, anyathā satsaṃjñakau pratyayau
svatantrau syātāṃ na tvādeśau | aprathamāsamānādhikaraṇādiṣviti |
ādiśabdena ṭhsambodhane ca' ṭhlakṣaṇahetvoḥ kriyāyāḥ'
ityasminviṣaye, tathā ṭhpratyayotarapadayośca'---kariṣyato'patyaṃ
kāriṣyataḥ, kāriṣyamāṇiḥ, kariṣyato bhaktiḥ kariṣyadbhaktiḥ,
kariṣyamāṇabhaktiḥ, kariṣyantī bhaktirasya kariṣyadbhaktiḥ, kariṣyamāṇā
bhaktirasya kariṣyamāṇabhaktiḥ, kariṣyataraḥ, kariṣyamāṇataraḥ,
kariṣyamāṇatamaḥ, kariṣyadrūpaḥ, kariṣyamāṇarūpaḥ, kariṣyatkalpaḥ,
kariṣyamāṇakalpaḥ | kathaṃ ṭhśvo'gnīnādhāsyamānena' ityanadyatane
śatṛśānacau bhavataḥ ? ukto'tra parihāraḥ---ṭhvyatyayo bahulam' iti
kālavyatyayena lṛṭ | atha vā---utaratrānadyatana iti yogavibhāgaḥ,
ṭhlṛṭaḥ sadvā' ityeva anadyatane yo lṛṭ tasyāpi satsaṃjñakau bhavataḥ |
kena punaranadyatane lṛṭ bhavati ? etadeva jñāpayati---bhavatyanadyatane
lṛḍiti, yadayamanadyatane lṛṭaḥ satsaṃjñakau śāsti ||
anadyatane luṭ || 3|3|15 ||
anadyatana iti bahuvrīhinirddeśa iti | ṭhanadyatane laṅ'
ityatraivaitadvyākhyātaṃ tata evāvadhāryam |
paridevane iti | paridevanamuanuśocanam | śvastanīti | luṭaḥ
pūrvācāryasaṃjñā | bhaviṣyantyartha iti | bhaviṣyantīti lṛṭaḥ saṃjñā,
tasyā arthe bhaviṣyatsāmānyaityarthaḥ | bhāvaṣyadartha iti vā pāṭhaḥ |
bhaviṣyatsāmānyarūpe'rtha ityarthaḥ | yevamiti | vilambitam |
anabhiyuktaḥuparicayarahitaḥ ||
padaruḍaviśaspṛśo ghañ || 3|3|16 ||
padyate'sāviti | karaṇasyātra kartṛtvena vivakṣā | padamityetatu
ṭhkhano gha ca' ityatra sādhayiṣyate | roga iti | ṭhcajoḥ ku
ghiṇṇyatoḥ' iti kutvam | spṛśa upatāpe iti | upatāpaḥurogaḥ ||
sṛsthire || 3|3|17 ||
ṭhsṛ' ityavibhaktiko nirdeśaḥ | sarteriti | ṭhsṛ gatau', ṭhṛ sṛ gatau'
iti dvayorapi grahaṇam | sthire kartarīti | etena sthiragrahaṇaṃ
pratyayārthasya karturviśeṣaṇaṃ nopapadamiti darśayati |
etaccārdharcādiṣu sāraśabdapāṭhādvijñāyate | nanu
sthiraśabdastiṣṭhatergatinivṛttivācina uṇādiṣu karicpratyayānto
nipātitaḥ, satistu gativacanaḥ, tatkathaṃ saraṇasya sthirakartā yujyate
? ityāha---sthira iti kālāntarasthāyītyādi | yataḥ kālāntaragamanaṃ
sambhavati, tataśca sarterdhātorarthasya kartā yujyata ityarthaḥ |
tiṣṭhanniti ca hetau śatṛpratyayaḥ | khadirasāra iti khadirāsthi, tat
dṛḍhatvāt sthiram | atīsāro vyādhiriti | śarīrāntarāvasthitaṃ
rudhirādidravyamatiśayena sārayatīti kṛtvā | antarbhāvitaṇyartho'tra
saratiḥ | ṭhupasargasya ghañyamanuṣye bahulam' iti dīrghaḥ | visāro
matsya iti | vividhaṃ saratīti kṛtvā | sāro balamiti | sārayati
ceṣṭayatīti kṛtvā | atrāpyantarbhāvitaṇyarthaḥ | saratiḥ | balavānhi
ceṣṭate, sāraśabda utkarṣe puṃlliṅgaḥ, nyāyādanapete
napuṃsakaliṅga iti ca dṛśyate ||
bhāve || 3|3|18 ||
nityānāmeva śabdānāṃ sāṅkaryasya nivṛtaye |
anvākhyānādbhāvaśabde ghañi nānyo'nyasaṃśrayaḥ ||
rāga iti | ṭhranjeśca' ṭhghañi ca bhāvakaraṇayoḥ' iti nalopaḥ | kathaṃ
punaḥ pākādirudāharaṇaṃ bhavati, yāvatā bhavatinārthanirdeśaḥ
kriyamāṇo'stibhavatividyativiṣaya eva kṛto bhavati, na pacādiviṣayaḥ
? tatrāha---kriyāsāmānyavācī bhavatiriti | satākhyaṃ sāmānyamapi
bhavatinā sādhyatvenābhidhīyata iti kriyāsāmānyavācī bhavatirbhavati |
tenārthanirddeśaḥ kriyamāṇa iti | hetau śānac,
yasmātsāmānyavācinārthanirdeśaḥ kriyate, na viśeṣavācinā
pacādinā; tasmātsarvadhātuviṣayaḥ kṛto bhavati sāmānyasya, sarveṣve
viśeṣeṣu bhāvāt, ṣaṇḍādiṣu gotvavat
viśeṣarūpāśrayaniṣedhasyābhāvācca | iha bhāvo dhātvarthaḥ, sa ca
pūrvāparībhūto'pariniṣpannaḥ, tasya ghañvācyasya kathaṃ
liṅgasaṅkhyāyoga ityāha---dhātvarthaśceti | yathā pacati pācaka
ityādau prakṛtibhāgena kriyocyate, pratyayabhāgena tu tadīyaṃ
sādhanam; tathā pākādiṣu prakṛtibhāgaḥ sādhyarūpamarthamāha,
pratyayabhāgastu tasyaiva siddharūpatāṃ
dravyadharmairliṅgasaṅkhyākārakaśaktibhiḥ sambandhayogyamākāramāhetyathaḥ
| uktaṃ ca---
ākhyātaśabde bhāgābhyāṃ sādhyasādhanavartitā |
prakalpitā yathā śāstre sa ghañādiṣvapi kramaḥ ||
sādhyatvena kriyā tatra dhāturūpanibandhanā |
satvabhāvastu yastasyāḥ sa ghañādinibandhanaḥ || iti ||
bahuvaktavyo'yamarthaḥ | iha ṭhbhāve' iti puṃlliṅgenāyaṃ nirdeśaḥ
kriyate, ekavacanena ca tatra puṃlliṅga eva, bhāve ekavacana eva ca
pratyayāḥ syurna liṅgāntare, na ca saṅghyāntare; tataśca ṭhstriyāṃ
ktin' ityatra striyāṃ bhāva iti sāmānādhikaraṇyena
sambandhāsambhavāt---striyāmakartari kārake ktin pratyayaḥ syāt,
bhāve tu puṃsīva ṭhnapuṃsake bhāve ktaḥ' ityatra ṭhakartari ca kārake'
ityasya nivṛtatvānnapuṃsake kartari ktaḥ syādbhāve tu puṃsi,
dvitvabahutvayośca pākau pākā ityādau pratyayā na syurityata
āha---puṃlliṅgamekavacanaṃ cātantramiti ||
na vinā liṅgasaṅkhyābhyāṃ satvabhūto'rtha ucyate |
ityatantramupādānaṃ tayorna tu vivakṣitam ||
dhānyāthināmupādānaṃ palālāderyathā matam |
śabdasaṃskāramātraṃ tu tannirdeśaprayojanam ||
akartari ca kārake saṃjñāyām || 3|3|19 ||
prāsaḥukuntaḥ, prasevaḥusūcyā prasevanena niṣpādya āvapanaviśeṣaḥ |
madhurāhāra iti | karmadhārayaḥ, ṣaṣṭhīsamāso vā |
meṣa iti | pacādiṣu pāṭhamanapekṣyaitadudāhṛtam, tathā ca
ṭhigupadhajñāprī' ityatroktam---devasevameṣādayaḥ pacādiṣu draṣṭavyā
iti | na hi pāṭhe sati draṣṭavyatvavacanamupapadyate | atha
vā---pratyudāharaṇadigiyaṃ darśitā, idaṃ tu
pratyudāharaṇam---bibhartyasau bharteti |
cakāra ityādi | cakāro'yaṃ bhinnakramaḥ---ṭhsaṃjñāyāṃ ca' iti,
tenāsaṃjñāyāmapi ghañ bhavati | yadyevam, mā bhūtsaṃjñāyāmiti, mā
ca bhūccakāraḥ ṭhakartari kārake' ityevāstu ? satyam; bāhulyena
saṃjñāyāṃ bhavati, kvacidevāsaṃjñāyāmiti sūcayituṃ saṃjñāgrahaṇaṃ
kṛtam | dāya iti | dīyamānaṃ sarvamucyata iti neyaṃ saṃjñā, evaṃ
lābha ityatrāpi, ubhayatra karmaṇi ghañ | kārakagrahaṇamityādi |
paryudāse hi nañivayuktanyāyena karturanyasmiṃstatsadṛse kāraka eva
pratītirbhavati, yathā---abrāhmaṇa iti kṣatriyādau | tasmātparyudāse
kārakagrahaṇaṃ na kartavyam | prasajyapratiṣedhe tu vākyabhedena
saṃjñāyāṃ ghañ bhavati, kartari tu na bhavatītyeṣo'rtho bhavati | tatra
prathame vākye'rthanirdeśābhāvād ṭhanirdiṣṭārthāḥ pratyayāḥ svārthe
bhavanti' iti svārtha eva syāt | nanu ca vihitaḥ svārthe pūrveṇaiva ?
netyāha; dhātvarthasya hi siddhatākhye dharme ghañādayo bhavantītyuktam,
iha tu sādhyarūpe śuddhe prakṛtyarthesyāt | nanu ca kartari
pratiṣedhasāmarthyādanirdiṣṭārtho'pi ghañ dhātvarthasambandhini kāraka
eva vijñāsyate ? naitadasti; asati hi pratiṣedhe ṭhkartari kṛt' iti
vacanānnāyamanirdiṣṭāthaḥ syād | ataḥ prasajyapratiṣedhārthaṃ
kākagrahaṇam | paryadāse tu na kartavyam | yadyevam, sa
evāśrayiṣyate, kiṃ kārakagrahaṇena ? tatrāha---tatkriyata iti | kiṃ punaḥ
kāraṇaṃ prasajyapratiṣedhe pratyatnalabhyaḥ samāsaḥ ? asāmarthyātatra hi nañaḥ
kriyayā sanbandhaḥ, kartri na bhavatīti na kartṛśabdena | ādeca
upadeśe'śitīti | atra yadi ṭhaśiti' iti paryudāsaḥ syāt, tadā
śito'nyatra tṛjādau pratyayo parata ātvena bhavitavyam | tataśca
suglaḥ, sumla ityatra ṭhātaścopasarge' iti ko na syāt, prāk
pratyayotpateranākārāntatvāt| pratiṣedhetvanaimitikamātvam,
śiti tu pratiṣedha iti siddhamiṣṭam ||
parimāṇākhyāyā sarvebhyaḥ || 3|3|20 ||
parimāṇākhyāyāmiti | bhāvasādhanaḥ parimāṇaśabdaḥ, ākhyānamākhyā u
uktiḥ, paricchiteruktau satyāmityarthaḥ | kasya punaḥ paricchitiḥ ?
pratyayārthasya bhāvasya kartṛvajitasya kārakasya ca | parimāṇākhyāyāṃ
gamyamānāyāmiti vṛterapyayamevārthaḥ | taṇḍulanicāya iti |
nicīyate rāśīkriyate iti nicāyaḥurāśiḥ, taṇḍulānāṃ nicāya iti
ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ | atra rāśyekatvena paricchitirgamyate | atrairaci prāpte
ghañ | prāyeṇa tu niścāya iti pāṭhaḥ, tatrāpyarthaḥ sa eva,
ṭhgrahavṛdṛniścigamaśca' ityapi prāpte ghañ śūrpanaṣpāvāviti |
niṣpūyate śoddhyate tuṣādyapanayanena yastaṇḍulādiḥ | śūrpeṇa
niṣpāvaḥ śūrpaniṣpāva iti ṭhkartṛkaraṇe kṛtā bahulam' iti samāsaḥ
| atra śūrpasaṅkhyayā paricchitiḥ | yadyapyatra ṭhnirabhyoḥ pūlvoḥ'
iti ghañ sidhyati, tathāpi
sarvāpavādārthasarvagrahaṇopādānādanenaiva ghañ
bhavitumarhatītyasyopanyāsaḥ | kārāviti | ṭhka vikṣepe' karmaṇi
ghañ, vikṣipto dhānyādiḥu kāraḥ, atrāpi saṅkhyayā paricchitiḥ |
nanu ca dhātoriti sāmānyādhikārādantareṇāpi sarvagrahaṇaṃ
dhātumātrād ghañ bhaviṣyati, nārthaḥ sarvagrahaṇena ?
tatrāha---sarvagrahaṇamiti | kiṃ punaḥ kaaraṇamapo bādhanaṃ
yatnasādhyamityata āha---purastāditi niścaya iti | atra na
kenacidiyatā gamyate | nanu ca parimāṇaśabdasya prasthādiṣu
rūḍhatvātprasthastaṇḍulaniścāya ityādāveva yuktaṃ bhavitum, na tu dvau
śūrpaniṣpāvāvityatra ? ityata āha---ākhyāgrahaṇaṃ rūḍhinirāsārthamiti
| prasthādiṣu jighṛkṣiteṣu parimāṇa ityeva vaktavyaṃ kimākhyāgrahaṇena
? ākhyāgrahaṇātu mātraco lopo vijñāyate
parimāṇamātrasyākhyāyāmuktau satyāmiti | tena parimāṇaśabdaḥ
kriyāśabda upajāyate---parimitiḥuparimāṇam paricchitiriti,
saṅkhyayāpi paricchitirbhavati | evañconmānādāvapi yathābhidhānaṃ
ghañ bhavati | yadi tarhi sarvagrahaṇātparamapyayaṃ ghañamaṃ bādhate,
strīpratyayānapi bādheta, tatrāha---ghañanukramaṇamajaporviṣaya iti |
etacca ṭhsarvebhyaḥ' iti pañcamīnirdeśāllabhyate | pañcamyanto hi
sarvaśabdo dhātuśabdena samānādhikaraṇo bhavati, tena prakṛtyāśraya
evāpavādo bādhyate, nārthāśrayaḥ | tilocchitiriti | karmaṇi bhāve
vā ktin | ūrdhvīkṛto rāśiḥ |
ṇilukceti | ṇilope sati tasya sthānivadbhāvād ghañāśrayā
vṛddhirna syāditi lugvidhīyate, tasya
paranimitakatvātkvilugupadhātveti pratiṣedhādvā
sthānivatvābhāvājjāraśabdaḥ sidhyati | jarayantīti |
ṭhjanījṛṣknasurañjo'mantāśca' iti mitvād hrasvatvam | jāraḥu
pracchannapatiḥ ||
iṅśca || 3|3|21 ||
upādhyāya iti | upetyasyādadhīyata iti apādāne ghañ | adhyāya ityatra
karmaṇi ghañ |
apādāne striyāmiti | ṭhghañanukramaṇamajaporviṣaye' iti vacanāt
striyāmaprāpto ghañ vidhīyate | upādhyāyā, upādhyāyīti | yā
svayamadhyāpayati tasyāmetadrūpam | puṃyoge tu nityameva ṅīṣ
bhavati | atra ca ṭhupādhyāyamātulābhyāṃ vā' iti vacanātpakṣe
ānugāgamaḥ---upādhyāyī, upādhyāyānī |
ṭhśṛvāyuvarṇanivṛtedhviti | śṛ' ityavibhaktiko nirdeśaḥ | śāro
vāyuriti | karaṇe ghañ| śāro varṇa iti | citrīkaraṇamatra
dhātvarthaḥ---citrīkriyate'nenāśraya iti, atrāpi karaṇe ghañ |
varṇāntarasaṃpṛktaścedvarṇaḥ śāraḥ | nivriyate āvriyate'nena
śarīramiti nivṛtamāvaraṇamucyate, ṭhkṛtyalyuṭo bahulam' iti
karaṇe ktaḥ | nīśāra iti | pūrvavaddīrghaḥ | akṛtanīśāra iti |
akṛtaprāvaraṇa ityarthaḥ | ṭhpradakṣiṇaprasavyagāmināṃ śārāṇām' iti
vārtikakāraprayogādakṣeṣvapi śāra iti bhavati ||
sami yudruduvaḥ || 3|3|23 ||
saṃyāvaḥupiṣṭavikāro'pūpaviśeṣaḥ, sampūyate miśrīkriyate
guḍajīrakādibhiriti kṛtvā ||avodorniyaḥ || 3|3|26 ||
adho nayanamavanāyaḥ, ūrdhvaṃ nayanamunnāyaḥ, unnayastu utprekṣā ||
nirabhyoḥ pūlvoḥ || 3|3|28 ||
niṣpāvaukośī dhānyaviśeṣaḥ, niṣpūyate śūrpādibhiriti kṛtvā ||
unyorgraḥ || 3|3|29 ||
udgāraḥuatipravṛddhaḥ śabdaḥ; nigāroḥubhakṣaṇam ||
kṛ dhānye || 3|3|30 ||
dhānyamiha prakṛtyartho vā syātpratyayārthasya vā kārakasyopādhiḥ ?
prakṛtyarthastāvannopapadyate, dhānyasya dravyatvāt, dhātośca
kriyāvācitvāt | pratyayārthopādhitve tu
pratyayenābhihitātvādutkāro dhānyasyeti dhānyaśabdasya prayogo na
prāpnoti | athāpi vispaṣṭapratipatyarthaṃ prayogaḥ syāt | evamapi
pratyayārthe'ntarbhūtatvāddhanye ṣaṣṭhī na syāt, dṛtihariḥ
paśuritivatsāmānādhikaraṇyameva tu syāt | tasmānnāyaṃ
pratyayārthasyopādhiḥ; nāpi prakṛtyarthaḥ; kintu pratyayārthasya
viṣayatvena viśeṣaṇamityāha---dhānyaviṣayaścediti | upapadatvamapi
na na bhavati, vyākhyānāt | anabhidhānāditi | śabdaśaktisvābhāvyāt
| utkaranikāraśabdābhyāṃ dhānyaviṣayo vikṣepa evābhidhīyate, na hiṃsā
| sāpi dhānyasya kīdṛśīti cintyam ||
yajñe sami stuvaḥ || 3|3|31 ||
sametya stuvanti yasmindeśa iti | adhikaraṇe lyuṭo'pavādo ghañiti
darśayati | saṃstavaḥuparicayaḥ ||
pre stro'yajñe || 3|3|32 ||
ṭhyajñe' iti prakṛtatvād ṭhayajñe' iti padacchedaḥ | śaṅkhādiṣu
prastāraḥuvistāraḥ |
barhiṣprastara iti | prastaraḥumuṣṭiviśeṣaḥ | barhirvikāraḥ prastaro
barhiṣprastaraḥ, ṭhṛdorap' ityap, ṭhidudupadhasya ca' iti ṣatvam ||
prathane vāvaśabde || 3|3|33 ||
vistāraḥu tiryagāyatiḥ ||
cchandonāmni ca || 3|3|34 ||
akṣarāṇāmiyatāviśiṣṭo vinyāsaviśeṣoḥuvṛtam | yasya
gāyatryādaya iti | prasadiddhatvādevamuktam | na mantrabrāhmaṇamiti |
ṭhbahulaṃ cchandasi' ityādau yadyapi teṣāmeva grahaṇaṃ prasiddhaṃ tathāpīha
teṣāṃ grahaṇaṃ na bhavati, kutaḥ ? ityāha---nāmagrahaṇāditi |
viṣṭārapaṅktiriti | vistīryante'sminnakṣarāṇītyadhikaraṇe ghañ,
tataḥ karmadhārayaḥ, ṭhcchandonāmni ca' iti ṣatvam | yadyapyatra prathanaṃ
gamyate, tathāpi śabdaviṣayatvātpūrveṇa na sidhyati | kecitu ṭhvau'
iti nānuvartayanti, tena prastārapaṅktiḥ, āstārapaṅktiḥ,
saṃstārapaṅktirityapi bhavatītyāhuḥ | ṭhkarmaṇyagnyākhyāyām'
ityādau yathā pratyayayāntaścedākhyā bhavatītyayamartho bhavati,
evamihāpi pratyayāntaścecchandonāma bhavatītyarthaḥ syād ? iti
śaṅkamānaṃ pratyāha---viṣṭārapaṅktiśabdo'tra cchandonāmeti |
avayavatvena vartata iti | ghañantaśabdarūpamityanuṣaṅgaḥ | kvacitu
tadvartata iti tacchabdaḥ paṭha|lte, tatra nānuṣaṅgaḥ | kathaṃ tarhi
cchandonāmnītyasya nirvāhaḥ ?
ityāha---cchandonāmnītyādhakaraṇasaptamyeṣeti | pratyayāntasyādhikaraṇaṃ
cchandonāma, avayavāścāvayavini vartanta iti laukikā manyante, tena
na kācidanupapatiriti bhāvaḥ ||
udi grahaḥ || 3|3|35 ||
apavāda iti | ṭhgrahavṛdṛniścigamaśca' iti prāptasya | 
cchandasi nītyādi | avayavasanniveśaviśiṣṭā yajñapātraviśeṣāḥ srucaḥ |
iha tu juhūpabhṛtorgrahaṇam; ṭhudgrābhaṃ ceti juhūmudyacchati
nigrābhaṃ cetyupabhṛtaṃ niyacchati' iti vacanāt |
ṭhhṛgrahorbhaścchandasi' iti bhatvam ||
sami muṣṭau || 3|3|36 ||
muṣṭiviṣayaśceddhātvartho bhavatīti | ṭhkṛ dhānye' ityatra
dhānyaviṣayaśceddhātvartho bhavatīti etadanusāreṇāyaṃ grantho yojyaḥ |
muṣṭiśabdo'yamastyeva parimāṇe---caturo muṣṭīnnirvapatīti,
aṅgulīnāṃ racanāviśeṣavacano'pyasti---muṣṭinā hantīti; tatra
pūrvasya grahaṇe parimāṇākhyāyāmityeva siddhatvād dvitīyasya
grahaṇamityāha---muṣṭiraṅgulisanniveśa iti | ahośabda āścarye |
muṣṭau kuśalo muṣṭikaḥ, ākarṣādipāṭhātkan||
parinyornīṇodyauuÇtābhreṣayoḥ || 3|3|37 ||
akṣādibhiḥ krīḍanaṃ dyauutam | ṭhbhrepa calane' bhreṣaṇaṃ bhreṣaḥucalanam |
abhreṣaḥuacalanam | bhreṣaviṣayaścediti | ayamapi granthaḥ
pūrvānusāreṇa yojyaḥ | anapacāra iti | kutsitaścāro'pacāraḥ,
tasmādanyaḥ praśastaḥ cāro'napacāraḥ |
etadevaspaṣṭayati---yathāprāptasyeti | yathā yena prakāreṇa
prāptiryasyeti bahuvrīhiḥ | avyayībhāve tvambhāvaḥ prāpnoti |
kvacitu yathāprāptakaraṇamiti paṭha|lte | pariṇāyeneti |
ṭhupasargādasamāse'pi' iti ṇatvam | hantīti bādhate |
samantānnayaneneti | pariṇāyenetyasyedamarthakathanam | eṣo'tra nyāya
iti | etadatra yathāprāptamityarthaḥ | pariṇayaḥuvivāhaḥ | nyayaḥunāśaḥ ||
parāvanupātyaya iṇaḥ || 3|3|38 ||
iha dviḥ parigrahaṇam, dviśceṇgrahaṇaṃ kriyate, sakṛdeva tu
kartavyam, evaṃ vakṣyāmi---parau niyo dyaute iṇo'nupātyaye
nāvabhreṣa iti ? satyam; tathā tu na kṛtamityeva ||
vyupayoḥ śeteḥ paryāye || 3|3|39 ||
pūrvasūtreṇānupātyaye paryāyaśabdo vyutpāditaḥ, tataścānupātyaya
ityadhikāreṇaiva siddhe paryāyagrahaṇaṃ punarvidhānārtham |
tenābhividhivivakṣāyāṃ paramapīnuṇaṃ bādhitvā'yameva ghañ bhavati |
rājānamupaśayituṃ paryāya ityartha iti | ṭhkālasamayavelāsu
tumun' ityatra kāle'tyarthagrahaṇam | paryāyopādānaṃ tu
prapañcārtham, yathā---ṭhnimitakāraṇahetuṣu sarvāsāṃ prāyadarśanam'
iti | tena paryāyaśabdayoge'pi tumun bhavati | tathā cāvasaro
bhoktum, avakāśo bhoktumityādyapi dṛśyate | viśayaḥu saṃśayaḥ,
upaśayaḥusamīpaśayanam ||
hastādāne cerasteye || 3|3|40 ||
hastādānagrahaṇenetyādi | yatropāyāntaranirapekṣeṇa
hastenaivādeyamādīyate, tatrāvaśyamādeyasya grāhyasya
pratyāsatirbhavati, ataḥ sāhacaryaṃ lakṣaṇāhetuḥ | vṛkṣaśikhara iti |
vṛkṣāgre yāni phalāni teṣāṃ yaṣṭa|ladinā pracayaṃ karotītyarthaḥ |
yadvā---āruhya hastenādāne'pyādeyasya pratyāsatyabhāvād ghañabhāvaḥ ||
nivāsacitiśarīropasamādhāneṣvādeśca kaḥ || 3|3|41 ||
eteṣvartheṣviti | atropasamādhānaṃ dhātvarthaḥ, anye pratyayārthasya
kārakasyopādhibhūtāḥ | cikhallinikāya iti |
cikhalliḥ---janapadaviśeṣaḥ, tatsambandhī grāmādirnivāsadeśa ityarthaḥ
| ākāyamiti | ācīyate'sminnaṣṭakā ityadhikaraṇe ghañ | kāya iti |
cīyante'sminnasthyādīni, adhikaraṇa eva ghañ | gomayanikāya iti |
prakīrṇānāṃ gomayānāmekatra rāśīkaraṇamityarthaḥ |
bahutvamatra gamyate iti | tatra tatra vikṣiptānāmeva kāṣṭhānāmityarthaḥ
| ṭhcaḥ kaḥ' iti vaktavye āderiti vacanaṃ yaṅlugante'pyāderekyathā
syād, anantyasyābhyāsasya cobhayormā bhūditi---gomayānāṃ
nikecāyaḥ, gomayānāṃ punaḥ punā rāśīkaraṇamityarthaḥ ||
saṅghe cānautarādharye || 3|3|42 ||
prāṇināṃ samudāyaḥ saṅgha iti | ṭhsaṅgodghau gaṇapraśaṃsayoḥ' iti
gaṇamātre nipātito'pi saṅghaśabdaḥ prāṇināmeva samudāye rūḍha iti
bhāvaḥ | ekadharmasamāveśeneti | ekadharmo'nugataḥ | autarādharyeṇeti |
utare cādhare cotarādharāḥ, teṣāṃ bhāva autarādharyam |
sūkaranicaya iti | stanapānāya yadotarādharabhāvena śerate tadedaṃ
pratyudāharaṇam, yadā tu bhikṣuvatpṛthakpṛthageva tiṣṭhanti,
tadedamudāharaṇameva bhavati || 
karmavyatihāre ṇac striyām || 3|3|43 ||
ṭhdhātuḥ' iti vartate, tasya viśeṣaṇaṃ karmavyatihāragrahaṇam,
karmavyatihāre vartamānādityarthaḥ | dhātośca kriyāvācitvam, na
tasya sādhanakarmavyatihāre vṛttiḥ sambhavati, ato laukikasya
kriyākarmaṇo grahaṇamityāha---karmavyatihāraḥ kriyāvyatihāra iti |
strīliṅge bhāve iti | kartūvarjite tu kārake na sa bhavati;
anabhidhānāditi bhāvaḥ | cakāro viśeṣaṇārtha iti | na svārārthaḥ,
pratyayasvareṇaiva siddhatvāt | asya cākāro na kvāpi śrūyate,
ṇajantāñca nityamañ vidhīyate, tatra satiśiṣṭatvāññitsvareṇaiva
bhavitavyam | ṇacaḥ striyāmityatra ṇātstriyāmityucyamāne
ṭhjvalitikasantebhyo ṇaḥ' ityasyāpi grahaṇaṃ syāt |
vyāvakrośītyādi | ṭhkruśa āhvāne', ṭhlikha akṣaravinyāse', ṭhhase
hasena' ṇajantādañ | sa ca kṛdgrahaṇaparibhāṣayā sopasargādapi
bhavati, taddhitatvādādivṛddhiḥ | ṭhna yvābhyām' ityayaṃ tu vidhirna
bhavati; na karmavyatihāra iti pratiṣedhāt | ṭhstriyāṃ ktin' ityatra
prakaraṇa etannoktam vāsarūpavidhiryathā syāt, tena vyāvakruṣṭiriti
ktinnapi bhavati | vyāvacorītyatra ṭhṇyāsaśranthoyuc' iti yuc
prāpnoti, ktino'pavādaḥ, tathā'yamapi ṇac yena nāprāptinyāyena
ktina evāpavādaḥ, tatrāpavādavipratiṣedhādyauci prāpte'yameva ṇajiṣyate
| vyatīkṣā, vyatīheti | atra ktinapavādaḥ ṭhgurośca halaḥ' ityakāra
eveṣyate | vyātyukṣīti ṭhukṣa secane', atrākāraviṣaye'pyayameveṣyate
| tadetadvaicitryaṃ kathaṃ bhavatīti | na kathañciditi bhāvaḥ |
kṛtyalyuṭo bahulamiti | evaṃvidhaṃ vaicitryaṃ kartuṃ
bahulagrahaṇameva bhavatīti bhāvaḥ ||
abhividhau bhāva inuṇ || 3|3|44 ||
kriyāguṇābhyāmiti | abhividhisvarūpakathanametat, iha tu dhātoḥ
pratyayavidhānātkriyāviṣaya evābhividhirgṛhyate | sāṃkūṭinamiti |
ṭhkūṭa dāhe' dīrghopadhādinuṇ, ṭhaṇinuṇaḥ'
itīnuṇantātsvāthiko'ṇ pratyayaḥ, sa ca
pūrvavatsagatikārakādbhavati, ṭhinaṇyanapatye' iti prakṛtibhāvāt
ṭhnastaddhite' iti ṭilopābhāvaḥ | samantāddāha ityarthaḥ
saṃśabdo'bhividhidyotakaḥ | sāṃrāviṇamiti | ṭhupasarge ruvaḥ' iti
ghañ upasargāntare'nabhivaidhau caritārthaḥ | saṃrāva iti | atra
saṃśabdaḥ pūjāyām | kvacitsandrāva iti pratyudāhaṇaṃ paṭha|lte,
tadayuktam; ṭhsamiyudruduvaḥ' ityasyānavakāśāt | nanu ca ṭhbhāve
kārake' iti dvaye'pi prakṛte śabdasvābhāvyātpūrvavatkārake na
bhaviṣyati, tat ki bhāvagrahaṇena ? tatrāha---bhāva iti vartamāna iti |
tena ghañ, ṭhnapuṃsake bhāve ktaḥ' iti ktaśca na bhavati | lyuṭā
tvityādi | gatārtham | svabhāvataścedaminuṇantaṃ napuṃsakaliṅgam
||
ākośe'vanyorgrahaḥ || 3|3|45 ||
ṭhgrahavṛdṛniścigamaśca' ityāpi prāpte'yamārambhaḥ |
dṛṣṭānuvṛttisāmarthyāditi | dṛṣṭamanuvṛttisāmarthyaṃ yasyeti
bahuvrīhau ṭhdvyekayoḥ' itivadbhāvapratyayamantareṇāpi
bhāvapradhāno nirdeśo dṛṣṭānuvṛttisāmarthyatvādityarthaḥ |
yadvā---anuvṛtau sāmartyamanuvṛttisāmarthyam, tato dṛṣṭaśabdena
karmadhārayaḥ | ākrośaḥ śapanamiti | na kṣepaḥ, svabhāvato ghañantasya
śapanaviṣayatvāt | śapanamuaniṣṭāśaṃsanam | avagrahaḥuabhibhavaḥ |
nigrahaḥubādhaḥ | hantaśabdaḥ kopaṃ dyotayati | avagrahaḥupadasya chedaḥ |
nigrahaḥ nirodhaḥ ||
pre lipsāyām || 3|3|46 ||
labdhumicchā lipsā | pātrapragrāheṇa caratīti | bhikṣāpātropādānena
gṛhītapātra iti yāvat | sruvagrahaṇaṃ tu dakṣiṇārthino liṅgam,
dākṣiṇahomasya sruvasādhanatvāt | pragraho devadatasyeti | pragraho
madaḥ, prakṛṣṭo vābhineveśaḥ ||
parau yajñe || 3|3|47 ||
utaraparigrāha iti | bhāve ghañ | vedeḥ sphyena svīkaraṇaṃ
parigrāhaḥ, tataḥ karmadhārayaḥ | kvacidutaraḥ parigrāha ityasamāsa eva
paṭha|lte ||
nau vṛ dhānye || 3|3|48 ||
nīvārā nāma vrīhaya iti | dhānyasāmānyoktāvapi
dhānyaviśeṣarūpavrīhiviśeṣe svabhāvato ghañantasya vṛttiriti
darśayati | atra karmaṇi ghañ, pūrvavadupasargasya dīrghaḥ | nivarā
kanyeti | ṭhgrahavṛdṛniścigamaśca' ityap karmaṇyeva | nanu ca ktinā
striyāṃ bhavitavyam, ṭhajabbhyāṃ strīkhalanāḥ striyāḥ khalanau
vipratiṣedhena' iti vacanāt ? satyam; ṭhkṛtyalyuṭo bahulam' iti
bahulavacanāt kvacit ktinādiviṣaye'pyac bhavati, pravarā
senā, pravarā gauritivat | evaṃ ca ṭhghañajabantāḥ puṃsi' iti
prāyikaṃ draṣṭavyam ||
udi śrayatiyautipūdruvaḥ || 3|3|49 ||
vakṣyamāṇamiti | evaṃ ca yautiprabhṛtibhyo vikalpaḥ prāpnoti | yadi
neṣyate, ṭhkṛtyalyuṭo bahulam' iti na bhaviṣyati ||
anye tu bhāṣye'nuktatvādasādhurevāyaṃ prayogaḥ | pradarśitastu
bhārataprayoga ārṣatvena nirvāhya ityāhuḥ ||
ave graho varṣapratibandhe || 3|3|51 ||
kutaścinnimitāditi | ṭhsatvakarmāparādhāderanāvṛṣṭirbhavennṛṇām'|
satvaśabdaḥ prāṇivacanaḥ, karmāparādhaḥukarmaviṣayo doṣaḥ,
vihitānācaraṇapratiṣiddhācaraṇanimitaṃ pāpaṃ satvakarmāparādhaḥ |
ādiśabdena ṭhtayormadhyagato bhānuḥ samudramapi śoṣayet'
ityādergrahaṇam |
avagrāho devasyeti | devakartṛko varṣābhāva ityarthaḥ || 
pre vaṇijām || 3|3|52 ||
paṇante vyavaharantīti vaṇijaḥ, ṭhpaṇerijyādeśca vaḥ', ṭhpaṇa
vyavahāre' ityasmādijipratyayo bhavatyādeśca vakāraḥ |
vaṇiksambandheneti | tulāsūtraṃ prāyeṇa vaṇijāṃ bhavatīti sāhacaryaṃ
lakṣaṇāhetuḥ | anayo veti | na tu vaṇijastantramityasyedaṃ
prayojanam ||
raśmau ca || 3|3|53 ||
rathādiyuktānāmiti | ādiśabdena śakaṭasya grahaṇam | aśvāderiti |
anuḍudāderapyupalakṣaṇametat | saṃyamanamuniyamanam | sā
raśmiriha gṛhyata iti | raśmiśabdaḥ puṃlliṅgaḥ, seti
rajjuparāmarśātstrīliṅgatā | candrādisambandhināṃ tu
raśmīnāmagrahaṇam; anabhidhānāt | iha tu bahukṛtvo
grahirupādīyate, sakṛdeva tu kartuṃ śakyam; katham ? evaṃ vakṣyāmi
ṭhudi grahaḥ sami muṣṭau ākrośe'vanyo pre lipsāyāṃ parau yajñe've
varṣapratibandhe vibhāṣā pre vaṇijām' ityādi, ṭhparau bhuvo'vajñāne'
ityasyānantaramāṅ rupluvoiriti ? tathā tu na kṛtamityeva ||
vṛṇoterācchādane || 3|3|54 ||
atrāpyācchādana iti sāmānyenoktāvapi
pūrvavadviśeṣapratipatirityāha---pratyayāntena cediti | prāvāra iti
| pūrvavaddīrghaḥ | pravarā gauriti | praśastetyarthaḥ ||
erac || 3|3|56 ||
cakāro viśeṣaṇārtha iti | vinā hi tena
thāthādisūtre'pratyayādityasyāpi grahaṇaṃ syāt | varṣamiti |
vṛṣabho varṣaṇāditi bhāṣyakāraprayogādūrṣaṇamityapi bhavati |
javasavāviti | api prāpte'j vidhīyate | svare viśeṣaḥ |
erajaṇyantānāmiti tu nāsti vacanam, ṭhkalpyādibhyaḥ
pratiṣedhavacanam' ityetadevāsti | kalpyate iti kalpaḥ, arthyate
ityarthaḥ, mantryate iti mantraḥ | aci pratiṣiddhe ghañeva bhavati ||
ṛdorap || 3|3|57 ||
lava iti | na ca tādapi parastapara iti ukārasya taparatvānnātrāpā
bhavitavyam ? tatrāha---dakāro mukhasukhārtha iti | nāyaṃ takāraḥ, kiṃ
tarhi ? dakāraḥ | etacca ṭhnirabhyoḥ pūlvoḥ' ityādyārambhādvijñāyate
| mukhaśabdena tālvādiśthānamucyate, tasya sukhamanāyāsaḥ | acorhi
halvyavahitayoruccāraṇe mukhasya lāghavaṃ bhavati | asandehaḥ,
yasyānuṣaṅgikaṃ prayojanam ||
grahavṛdṛniścigamaśca || 3|3|58 ||
niścinotestvacopavāda iti | ṭherac' iti prāptasya yastu
ṭhhastādāne cerasteye' iti ghañ sa nipūrvādapi
pūrvavipratiṣedheneṣyate, yathoktam---asteyārthamiti
cennāniṣṭatvāditi | kaḥ punarniścaya ityatrājaporviśeṣaḥ, yāvatā
tadeva rūpaṃ sa eva svaro'pi;
thāthādisūtreṇobhayatrāntodātatvavidhānādityata āha---niścigrahaṇaṃ
svarārthamiti | niścigrahaṇasāmarthyāt thāthādisvaro'tra na
pravartate, kṛtsvareṇa tu madhyodātatvameva bhavatīti bhāvaḥ |
vaśiraṇyoriti | ghañi prāpte vacanam | vaśanaṃ vaśaḥ | raṇanti
śabdāyante'sminniti raṇaḥ saṃgrāmaḥ |
dhañartha iti | bhāvaḥ kartṛvarjitaṃ ca kārakaṃ ghañarthaḥ | prasthaḥ sānuḥ,
prasnaḥ kaṭāhaḥ, prapā pānīyaśālā---sarvatra ṭhāto lopa iṭi ca'
ityākāralopaḥ | āvidha iti | grahijyādisūtreṇa samprasāraṇam |
āyudhaśabdaparyāyo'yam ||
upasarge'daḥ || 3|3|59 ||
aderdhātoriti | dārūpāṇāṃ dhātūnāmayaṃ nirdeśo na bhavati;
ṭhghañapośca' ityapi parato'derghaslādeśavidhānāt | vyadyata iti
vighasaḥu vaiśvadevaśiṣṭamannam |
ghāsastu catuṣpadāṃ bhakṣyam | ghasiḥ prakṛtyantamasti
tasmādevābvidheyaḥ | evaṃ hyaderapi ghaslṛbhāvo na vaktavyo bhavati |
utarārthaṃ tvadergrahaṇam---nau ṇa ṭhca' aderyathā syād, ghasermā
bhūditi ||
vyadhajaporanupasarge || 3|3|61 ||
vyadhajaporiti pañcamyarthe ṣaṣṭhī, anupasarga iti
prasajyapratiṣedhaḥ---upasarge sati na bhavatīti | tena kevalābhyāmeva
bhavati, na tūpasargavyatirikte'nyasminnupapade |
vṛttigrantho'pyasminnevārthe vyākhyeyaḥ | upajāpaḥumantrabhedaḥ ||
kvaṇo vīṇāyāṃ ca || 3|3|65 || 
sopasargārthamidaṃ vīṇāgrahaṇamiti | nivyatiriktopasargārthamidaṃ
draṣṭavyam; nipūrvādanupasargācca sāmānyena vidhānāt |
kalyāṇaprakvāṇeti bahuvrīhiḥ ||
mado'nupasarge || 3|3|67 ||
vidyāmada ityādi | ṭhkartṛkaraṇe' ityādinā samāsaḥ | ṭhkvaṇo vīṇāyāṃ
ca' ityasyānantaraṃ ṭhnityaṃ madaḥ pramadasaṃmadau harṣe paṇaḥ parimāṇe'
iti yadi sūtranyāsaḥ kriyeta, atrānupasargagrahaṇaṃ śakyamakartum,
anuvṛtereva siddhatvāt ? satyam; evaṃ vinyāse hi kriyamāṇe ṭhpaṇaḥ
parimāṇe' ityatrāpyanupasarga ityasyānuvṛttiḥ śaṅkyeta |
yathānyāse tūtaratrāpyanupasarga iti vacanāt ṭhnityaṃ paṇaḥ
parimāṇe' ityatrānupasarga iti na saṃbaddhyata iti vijñāyate |
tenopasarge'pi bhavati yadi parimāṇābhidhānamasti |
apara āha---"mado'nupasarge' iti sūtrapraṇayanamasya
vidheranityatvajñāpanārtham, tena māda iti siddhaṃ bhavati" iti,
nātrāptabhāṣitamasti ||
pramadasaṃmadau harṣe || 3|3|68 ||
nipātanaṃ rūḍha|lrthamiti | upātasyaiva rūḍhirūpasya sādhutvaṃ yathā
syādityarthaḥ | ṭhprasaṃbhyām' ityucyamāne prasaṃmadaḥ, saṃpramadaḥ,
vipramada ityādāvapi prāpnotīti manyate ||
akṣeṣu glahaḥ || 3|3|70 ||
akṣasya glaha iti | bhāve'p, akṣasya grahaṇamityarthaḥ | anye
tvāhuḥ---akṣaśabdenātra tatsādhanaṃ devanaṃ lakṣyate, akṣakarmaṇi
devanaviṣaye yatpaṇarūpeṇa grāhyaṃ tad glahaśabdenocyate | tathā ca
māghaḥ---ṭhvyātyukṣīmabhiraṇaglahāmadīvyan' iti | vṛtāvapyakṣasya glaha
ityakṣasādhanasya devanasya paṇabandha ityarthaḥ ||
prajane sarteḥ || 3|3|71 ||
prajananaṃ prajanaḥ, bhāve ghañ, ṭhjanivadhyośca' iti vṛddhipratiṣedhaḥ,
ṇyantādvairac | praśabdo dhātvarthaṃ viparītayati, yathā---pratiṣṭhate
ityatra prādurbhāvasya ca vaiparītyaṃ garbhagrahaṇam, tadāha---prajanaḥ
prathamaṃ garbhagrahaṇamiti | kathamavasaraḥ, prasara iti ? adhikaraṇe ṭhpuṃsi
saṃjñāyāṃ ghaḥ prāyeṇa' ||
hvaḥ saṃmprasāraṇaṃ ca nyabhyupaviṣu || 3|3|72 ||
nihava ityādi rūpaṃ tu juhotereva siddham; anekārthatvāddhātūnām
| athebhedo'pyakiñcitkaraḥ | idaṃ tu vacanaṃ hvayaterghañi nihvāya iti
rūpaṃ mā bhūditi ||
nipānamāhāvaḥ || 3|3|74 ||
āhāva iti rūpaṃ tu juhotereva siddham, anekārthatvāddhātūnām |
arthabhedo'pyakiñcitkaraḥ | idaṃ tu vacanaṃ hvayaterghañi āhvāya iti
rūpaṃ mā bhūditi | āhāva ityadhikaraṇe nipātanamityāha---tatra hīti
||
bhāve'nupasargasya || 3|3|75 ||
bhāvagrahaṇamityādi | nanu ca dvaye'pyadhikṛte lakṣyadarśanavaśādbhāva
evārthe vidhirbhaviṣyati, yathā---ṭhkarmavyatihāre ṇac striyām'
ityatra ? satyameṣa evārtho bhāvagrahaṇenākyāyate | atha
yathā---ṭhabhividhau bhāva hanuṇ' ityatra vāsarūpanivṛtyarthaṃ
bhāvagrahaṇam, tathehāpi kasmānna bhavati ? asarūpasya
bādhanīyasyābhavāt | ghañ tāvatsarūpaḥ, ktalyuṭktinastu
nāsyotsargāḥ, na hi teṣu nāprāpteṣvasyārambhaḥ, iṣyante ca
te---hūtaḥ, hvānam, hūtiriti ||
hanaśca vadhaḥ || 3|3|76 ||
sa cāntodāta iti | sūtre tathaivoccāraṇāt | kimarthaṃ
punarakārāntatvam, kimarthaṃ cāntodātatvam, yāvatā nāyamakāraḥ
kvacicchra yato'to lopo'sya bhavati ? tatrāha---tatreti |
antodātatve satītyarthaḥ | udātanivṛttisvareṇeti | ṭhanudātasya ca
yatrodātalopaḥ' ityeva udātanivṛttinimitatvādudātanivṛttisvaraḥ
| ghāta iti | atra karmādau kārake ghañ | kiṃ tarhi prakṛtena
pratyayeneti | atha dhātoranantaraṃ śrutaḥ prakṛtena dhātunā kasmānna
sambaddhayate---hanaśca vadhādeśo bhavati, hvayateśceti ? pūrvasūtre'
samprasāraṇavidhānasāmarthyāt ||
mūrtau ghanaḥ || 3|3|77 ||
abhraghana iti | abhrasya kāṭhinyamityarthaḥ | dharmaśabdeneti |
śulkādivaditi bhāvaḥ | yadyevam, guṇeneti pratiṣedhātsamāso na
prāpnoti, tatsthaiśca guṇairityetadapi nāsti ? idānīmeva
hyuktam---ṭhdharmaśabdena dharmī bhaṇyate' iti vaktavyo'tra samāsaḥ ||
antarghano deśe || 3|3|78 ||
tadapi grāhyameveti | ubhayathāpyācāryeṇa śiṣyāṇāṃ pratipāditatvāt
||
agāraikadeśe praghaṇaḥ praghāṇaśca || 3|3|79 ||
dvāraprakoṣṭho bāhya ucyata iti | dvāra pradeśe dvau
prakoṣṭhāvalindau---ābhyantaraḥ, bāhyaśca | tatra bāhyae prakoṣṭhe
nipātanam, nāgāraikadeśamātre | aitacca nipātanāllabhyate |
praviśadbhirjanaiḥ pādaiḥ prakarṣeṇa hanyata iti ap karmaṇi, pakṣe
vṛddhiśca ||
udghano'tyādhānam || 3|3|80 ||
atyādhānamiti | atiśabda uparibhāve vartate, ādadhātiḥ sthāpane,
adhikaraṇe lyuṭ | udghana ityatrāpyadhikaraṇa evāp ||
apaghano'ṅgam || 3|3|81 ||
apaghana iti | karaṇe'p ||
karaṇe'yovidruṣu || 3|3|82 ||
drughana iti | druriti vanaspatinām, ṭhvanaspatayo vai dravaḥ' iti
nigamo bhavati | pūrvapadātsaṃjñāyāmaga iti veti | saṃjñā caiṣā
kuṭhāraviśeṣasya ||
stambe ka ca || 3|3|83 ||
tatra ceti | anantarokte'pi ke tu ghanādeśo na bhavati; pūrvameva
ghanādeśasyāpsambandhitvāt | stambaghna iti | upapadasamāsaḥ, ṭhgamahana'
ityupadhālopaḥ, ṭhho hanteḥ' iti kutvam | striyāmityādi | etacca
kāpoḥ pratipadavidhānātsarvāpavādatvāt ṭhkṛtyalyuṭo bahulam'
iti vacanādvā labhyate anye punaḥ ṭhūtiyūtijūtisātiheti' iti
hanteḥ ktini nipātanānnipātanasya ca sarvāpavādatvāt
stambahetiritīcchanti | apare tu ṭhkaraṇādhikaraṇayośca' iti lyuṭi
stambahananīti bhavitavyam, yathā---rakṣoyātūnāṃ
hananītyuktamityāhuḥ | stambaghāta iti | bhāve ghañ, ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ ||
prarau ghaḥ || 3|3|84 ||
paligha iti | ṭhpareśca ghāṅkayoḥ' iti vibhāṣā latvam ||
upaghna āśraye || 3|3|85 ||
āśrayaśabda ityādi | āśrayaṇamāśrayaḥ, sa
pratyāsatyā'vinābhāvītyetallakṣaṇahetuḥ | parvatopaghna iti |
parvatenopahanyateusāmīpyena gamyata iti karmaṇyam ||
saṃghodghau gaṇapraśaṃsayoḥ || 3|3|86 ||
saṃhananaṃ saṅghaḥ, bhāve'p | udghanyateūtkṛṣṭe jñāyata iti
karmaṇyap | gatyarthā buddhyarthā iti hantirjñāne vartate | udgho
manuṣyāṇāmiti | manuṣyāṇāṃ madhye praśasta ityarthaḥ ||
nigho nimitam || 3|3|87 ||
samārohapariṇāhamiti | ārohaḥūcchrāyaḥ, pariṇāhaḥuvistāraḥ, tau
samānau yasya tatathoktam | nighā vṛkṣā iti | niviśeṣaṃ hanyante
jñāyante iti karmaṇkam ||
ḍvitaḥ ktriḥ || 3|3|88 ||
bhāve'kartari ca kārake iti vartata iti | adhikārasyāvicchedaṃ
darśayati | ayaṃ tu ktripratyayaḥ svabhāvādbhāva eva bhavati---pākena
nirvṛtaṃ paktrimamityucyate, na tu pakveneti | kevalo na prayujyata
iti | tenāvaśyamanyaśabdenaiva vigrahaḥ kartavyaḥ | taddarśayati---pākena
nirvṛtaṃ paktrimamiti | uptrimamiti | yajāditvātsamprasāraṇam |
atha ḍvinaḥ ktrimamityeva kasmānnoktam, evaṃ hi ṭhktrermam nityam'
iti na vaktavyaṃ bhavati ? naivaṃ śakyam, ṭhbhāve' ityadhikārādbhāve'pi
kṛtrimamiti prāpnoti |
athāpyabhayānuvṛtāvapyabhidhānasvābhāvyātkāraka eva karmaṇi bhavet ?
evamapi bhūtakālo na gamyeta | etadapyabhidhānasvābhāvyādbhavatu nāma
? evamarthābhidhāne prakārabhedo na syāt, na hi pakvapaktrimaśabdayoḥ
paryāyatāṃ manyante ||
ṭvito'thuc || 3|3|89 ||
ayamapi svabhāvādbhāva eva bhavati | ghañāderapavādaḥ | vāsarūpavidhanā
so'pi bhavatyeva ||
yajayācayatavicchapraccharakṣo naṅ || 3|3|90 ||
naṅe ṅkāro viccherguṇapratiṣedhārthaḥ, anyathāntaraṅgatvātuki
ṭhcachavoḥ śūḍanunāsike ca' iti satukkasya cchasyādeśe kṛte
laghūpadhatvād guṇaḥ syāt | naṅntāḥ sarve puṃlliṅgāḥ |
yācistu strīliṅgaḥ | vāsarūpavidhiśca yathābhidhānaṃ bhavati | praśna
iti | atra grahijyādisūtreṇa samprasāraṇaṃ kasmānna
bhavatītyāha---praccheriti ||
karmaṇyadhikaraṇe ca || 3|3|93 ||
karmādhikaraṇayoḥ pṛthak pṛthak saptamīnirdeśānna
tāvadubhayorupapadatvam, tatra vyākhyānātkarmopapadam, adhikaraṇaṃ tu
pratyayārtha ityāha---karmaṇyupapada iti |
athikaraṇagrahaṇamarthāntaranirāsārthamiti | arthāntaraṃ bhāvaḥ, karaṇādi
ca kārakam ||
striyāṃ ktin || 3|3|94 ||
ghañajapāmapavāda iti | yena nāprāptinyāyena ghañopavādaḥ, ajapostu
paratvādapavādo bādhaka ityarthaḥ | uktaṃ ca ṭhajavbhyāṃ strīkhalanāḥ
striyāḥ khalanau vipratiṣedhene' iti | ajaporavakāśaḥ--cayaḥ, jayaḥ,
lava iti, ktino'vakāśaḥ---kṛtiḥ, dṛtiḥ, citiḥ,
stutirityatrobhayaprāptau ktin bhavati vipranipedhena | labdhiḥ |
ṣitvādaṅapi bhavati---labheti | nanu niṣṭhāyāṃ vā
seṭo'kāravacanātsiddhamiti bruvato vātikakārasya ṭhgurośca halaḥ'
ityakāraprāptāvevābādibhyaśceti ktinnabhimata iti gamyate,
tatkathamaṅviṣaye ktinnudāhṛtaḥ ? satyam ; prayogabāhulyādidamapi
bhavatīti manyate | evaṃ ca yujvipaye'pi ktinprayujyate---āstiriti |
ata evābādayaḥ prayogato'nusartavyā ityuktam |
śruyajistubhyaḥ karaṇa iti | lyuṭi prāpte vacanam, śrutiḥ śrotram,
ijyate'nayā devatā iṣṭiḥ | ṛkāralvādibhya iti | ṛkārāntebhyo
lvādibhyaśca paraḥ ktinniṣṭhākāryaṃ labhate---ṭhradābhyāṃ niṣṭhāto naḥ',
ṭhlvādibhyaḥ' iti ca; niṣṭāyāṃ vidhīyamānaṃ natvaṃ ktino'pi
bhavatītyarthaḥ |
ktinnapīṣyate iti | ṭhastriyām' iti
pratipedhādvāsarūpavidherabhāvādidamuktam ||
sthāgāpāpaco bhāve || 3|3|95 ||
aṅe'pavādasya bādhaka iti | sthādibhyaḥ ṭhātaścopasarge' iti prāptasya |
pacestu pitvātprāptasyāṅe'pavādaḥ | kāṃsthāyikām, sthāyimityatra
ṭhvibhāṣākhyānaparipraśnayoḥ' iti prāptayorṇvuliñorapi bādhakaḥ
kasmānna bhavati ? ṭhpurastādapavādā anantarānvidhīn bādhante
notarān' iti |
kathamiti | na kathañcid; vāsarūpabidherabhāvāt | nātyantāyeti |
niyamena caturthyantapratirūpako'yaṃ nipātaḥ, yathā---cirāyeti ||
mantre vṛṣeṣapacamanavidabhūvīrā udātaḥ || 3|3|96 ||
prakṛtipratyayayoriti | prakṛtisāmānyavivakṣāyāṃ dvivacanam; anyathā
bahutvātprakṛtīnāṃ bahuvacanaprasaṅgāt | vibhaktivipariṇāmeneti
| vṛṣādīnāṃ dvandve yā prathamā tasyāḥ pañcamībhāvena yo
vipariṇāmastena prakṛtipratyayayoḥ saṃbandhaḥ, anyathā
saṃbandhānupapatirityarthaḥ | ṭhvṛṣu secane', ṭhiṣu icchāyām'
vṛṣisāhacaryādudito grahaṇam | sūtre tvakāro na vivakṣitaḥ |
ṭhmana jñāne', ṭhmanu avabodhane' dvayorapi grahaṇam | vidādīnāmapi
yathādarśanam | sarvatreti | mantre cāmantre cetyarthaḥ | vṛṣādibhyaḥ
ktipratyaye vidhātavye udātavacanamutarārtham, vrajayajorbhāve
kyabudāto yathā syāt | pramatirityādau ca ṭhtādau ca niti
kṛtyatau' iti pūrvapadaprakṛtisvarārthaṃ ca | pibaterapi mantre
ktinnudāto dṛśyate---tvaṃ sutasya pītaye, madhvaḥ somasya pītaye iti
||
ūtiyūtijūtisātihetikīrtayaśca || 3|3|97 ||
mantre iti nānuvartata iti | tena brāhmaṇe bhāṣāyāṃ cāthaṃ vidhirbhavati
| syateriti | ṭhṣo'ntakarmaṇi' ityasya | hatvābhāva iti | ṭhdyatisyati'
ityādinā prāptasyetvasyābhāvaḥ | sanoterveti | ṭhṣaṇudāne' ityasya |
hanterhinotervota | yadā hantestadā nakārasyetvaṃ nipātyate, yadā
hinotestadā tu guṇaḥ | kīrtayateriti | ṭhkṛta saṃśabdane' ityasya
curādiṇijantasya ṭhṇyāsaśranyo yuc', iti yuco'pavādaḥ
ktinnipātyate, udāṃtatvaṃ ca | iḍabhāvastu ṭhtitutra' ityādinā siddhaḥ,
ṭhupadhāyāśca' ṭhhali ca' ṭhupadhāyāṃ ca' iti dīrghatvam | kālāpāstu
yucamapīcchanti---kīrtaneti ||
vrajayajorbhāve kyap || 3|3|98 ||
ijyeti | vacyādisūtreṇa saṃprasāraṇam | yadyaudāta iti vartate,
pitkaraṇaṃ kimarthamityata āha--pitkaraṇamutaratra tugarthamiti ||
saṃjñāyāṃ samajaniṣadanipatamanavidaṣuñśīṅbhṛñiṇaḥ || 3|3|99 ||
bhāva iti na svaryata iti | pūrvasūtre yadbhāvagrahaṇaṃ
tasyehāsvaritatvānnānuvṛttirityarthaḥ | samajyeti | ghañapoḥ
pratiṣedhe kyapa upasaṃkhyānamiti vacanādvībhāvābhāvaḥ | anye tu
sajñāyāmityeva kyapo vidhānāt rūḍha|lnugamārthatvācca saṃjñāgrahaṇasya
vībhāvābhāvamāhuḥ | na hi vībhāve sati saṃjñā gamyate |
samajyāusabhā, niṣadyāuāpaṇaḥ, nipatyāupicchilā bhūmiḥ, manyāu
galapārśvaśirā manyante'nayeti kṛtvā | tayā hi kruddho jñāyate |
kyapo'jhalāditvād ṭhanudātopadeśa' ityanunāsikalopona
bhavati, tadabhāvātugapi na bhavati | anye tu---saṃjñāyāmiti
vacanādyathā samajyetyatra vībhāvo na bhavati, evaṃ
maneranunāsikalopastatra kṛte tugapītyāhuḥ; nātrāptavacanamasti |
vidyate gṛhyate'nayārthaiti vidyā | sūyatebhiṣūyate somo'syāmiti
sutyāuabhiṣavadivasaḥ | sutyamaharutamamiti tvārṣaṃ napuṃsakatvam,
śayyate'syāmiti śayyāukhaṭvādiḥ, bharaṇaṃ bhṛtyāujīvikā, īyate
gamyatenayetītyāudīpikā |
ṭhbhṛñosaṃjñāyām' ityatroktam---ṭhstriyāṃ bhāvādhikāro'sti tena
bhāryā prasiddhyati' iti, iha tu ṭhbhāva iti na svaryate' ityuktam,
tatra pūrvāparavirodhaṃ manyamānaḥ pṛcchati---kathaṃ taduktamiti |
pariharati---bhāvādhikāra iti | saṃjñāyāmityucyate, bhaṛñaśca bhāva
evotpadyamānena kyapā saṃjñā gamyate ataḥ saṃjñāvaśādyo'yaṃ bhāvasya
bhṛtyāśabdavācyatvena vyāpāraḥ sa eva taṃtra bhāvādhikāro vivakṣitaḥ,
na tu śāstrīyaḥ svaritatvanibandhana ityarthaḥ | saṃjñāyāmiti vartamāne
punaḥ saṃjñāgrahaṇaṃ bhāvārtham, pūrvakaṃ hi saṃjñāgrahaṇaṃ kārakeṇa
sambaddham | asaṃjñāyāṃ tu ktinneva bhavati ||
kṛñaḥ śa ca || 3|3|100 ||
yogavibhāga iti | kṛñaḥ kyab bhavati, tataḥ śa ca, cakārādyathāprāptaṃ
ceti | tena trīṇi rūpāṇi bhavanti; anyathā cakāreṇānantarasya kyapa
eva samuccayaḥ, na tu ktina iti ktinna syāt | śakāraḥ
sārvadhātukasaṃjñārthaḥ, tatra yadā bhāvakarmaṇoḥ śastadā ṭhsārvadhātuke
yak' ṭhriṅśayagliṅkṣu' iti riṅadeśaḥ, anyatra śakāra eva parato
riṅadeśaḥ, ṭhaci śnudhātu' ityādineyaṅ ||
icchā || 3|3|101 ||
iṣerdhātoriti | ṭhiṣu icchāyām' ityasmādbhāve śapratyayo
bhavatīti; na tvakartari kārake, svabhāvāt |
paricaryetyādi | paricaryādīnāmapi nipātanasyopasaṃkhyānam,
paricaryādayo'pi śapratyayāntā nipātayitavyā ityarthaḥ | tatra sarvatra
śapratyayo yakca nipātyate | paricaryāupūjā | parisaryāu
parisaraṇam, atra guṇo'pi nipātyate | ṭhmṛga anveṣaṇe'
curādāvadantaḥ, atrāto lopābhāvaḥ; nipātanāt | śe
