yakiṇilopaḥ---mṛgayā | aṭateḥ śe yaki yakā saha ṭakārasya
dvirvacanam, pūrvabhāge yakārasya nivṛttirdīrghatvamityetatsarvaṃ
nipātyate | halādiśeṣastu nāsti; ṣāṣṭhike
dvirvacane'bhyāsasaṃjñāvidhānād | yadā tvaṭa|lrtyasūrṇotīnāmiti
yaṅntāt ṭhapratyayāt' ityakāraḥ, tadāto lope yalope
cāṭāṭeti bhavati |
jāgarterakāro veti | vāśabdātpakṣe śaḥ, tadā sārvadhātuke yak,
ṭhjāgro'viciṇṇalṅtsu' īti guṇaḥ ||
gurośca halaḥ || 3|3|103 ||
prakṛtasya dhātorhalā viśeṣaṇātadantavidhirityāha---halanto yo
dhāturiti | ajviśeṣavācino guruśabdasya halante dhātau na mukhyā
vṛttiḥ sambhavatīti tadvati tacchabdo vijñāyata ityāha---gurumāniti |
viparyayastu na na bhavati---gurvanto yo dhāturhalvāniti;
ṭhceṣṭāyāmanadhvani' ṭhāśaṃsāyāṃ bhūtavacca' iti nirdeśāt | kuṇḍā,
huṇḍeti | ṭhkuḍi dāhe', ṭhhuḍi saṃghāte' ||
ṣidbhidādibhyo'ṅ || 3|3|104 ||
gaṇaparipaṭhiteṣviti | gaṇe tāvadbhidā cchidetyaṅntā eva
samudāyāḥ paṭha|lnte, teṣu bhidicchidiprabhṛtayo'ṅḥ prakṛtayo yāstā
iha bhidādiśabdena nirdiśyanta ityarthaḥ | kuta etat ?
dhātvadhikārāt | bhidādibhyo dhātubhya iti | ṭhbhidir vidāraṇe',
ṭhcchidir dvaidhīkaraṇe', ṭhvida jñāne', ṭhkṣipa preraṇe', ṭhguhū
saṃvaraṇe', ṭhḍudhāñ dhāraṇapoṣaṇayoḥ', ṭhmidhṛ medhṛ
hisāsaṃkleśanayoḥ', ṭhṛ gatau', ṭhhṛñ haraṇe', ṭhkṣi kṣaye', atha vā
ṭhkṣi nivāsagatyoḥ', ṭhtṛplavanataraṇayoḥ', ṭhdhṛñ dhāraṇe', ṭhlikha
akṣaravinyāse', ṭhcuda preraṇe', ṭhpīḍa avagāhane', ṭhḍuvap
bījatantusantāne', ṭhvasa nivāse', ṭhmṛjūṣ śuddhau', ṭhkrapa
kṛpāyām' ityete veditavyāḥ |
jareti | ṭhṛdṛśo'ṅ guṇiḥ' | guhā giryoṣadhyoriti | giriśabdena
tadekadeśa ucyate, anyatra gūḍhiḥ, ktinneva bhavati | ārā||||||ḍhāreti
| guṇe kṛte dīrghatvaṃ ca nipātyate | rekhā, lekheti | likheḥ pakṣe
lakārasya repho nipātyate, guṇaśca | cūḍeti | cuderḍatvaṃ
dīrghatvaṃ ca nipātyate | mitiranyeti | bhidyata iti bhitiḥukuḍa|lm,
cchitiḥucchidram | ārā śastryāmiti | śastrī śastrajātiḥ, svabhāvācca
viśeṣaḥ parigṛhyate | ārāupratodaḥ, aryante preryante'nayāśvā iti
kṛtvā | ātiṃranyeti | āṅe'rteśca ṭhupasargādṛti dhātau' iti vṛddhiḥ
| dhāryate prapātyate iti dhārā | dhṛtiranyeti | prītirdhairyaṃ ca ||
cintapūjikathikumbicarcaśca || 3|3|105 ||
yuci prāpta iti | sarveṣāmeva ṇyantatvāt | kumbrāuagram |
ṭhudīcīnakumbāṃ śamyām' iti hi dṛśyate |
cakāro'nuktasamuccayārthaḥ---tulayatestulā | atha ṭhgurośca halaḥ'
ityasyānantaraṃ kasmānna kṛtam, kimaṅvidhānena ? tatrā'pi
kartavyam, ko nvatra viśeṣaḥ | apara āha---aṅvidhānasāmarthyātpakṣe
ṇilopo na bhavati, cintiyetyādi bhavatīti, nātrāptabhāṣitamasti
||
ātaścopasarge || 3|3|106 ||
śradantarorityādi | upasarge yādṛśī vṛttiḥ pratyayotpatilakṣaṇā
tādṛśyeva tayorapi bhavatītyarthaḥ | tatra
śraddhāśabdastārakādipāṭhātsiddhaḥ, yadayam ṭhantardhau ityusarganibandhanaṃ
kipratyayaṃ niddiśati tad jñāpayati---antaḥ-śabdaḥ upasargavṛttiriti |
evaṃ ca kṛtvā antarṇayatīti ṭhupasargādasamāse'pi' iti ṇatvamapi
bhavati ||
ṇyāsaśrantho yuc || 3|3|107 ||
ṇyadbhaviṣyatīti | nanu vāsarūpavidhinā ṇyatsyāt sa
cāstriyāmiti pratiṣiddhaḥ ? tatrāha---vāsarūpapratiṣedhaśceti |
utsargāpavādasyeti | samāhāradvandvaḥ | dvayorapyutsargāpavādayoḥ
stryadhikārāvasthitayorityarthaḥ | ghaṭṭivandividibhyaśceti |
vidirlābhārtho gṛhyate, na jñānārthaḥ; ṭhvida cetanākhyānanivāseṣu'
ityasyaiva curādervedaneti jñāne siddhatvāt | na ca veteḥ ktino
nivṛtyarthaṃ vacanam; saṃvitiriti darśanāt | anveṣaṇeti | ṭhiṣa
ābhīkṣṇye' ṭhiṣagatau' iti vā | yucaścakāraścintyaprayojanaḥ,
ṭhudātaḥ' iti hi vartate tatsāmarthyādantodātatvaṃ bhaviṣyati;
pratyayasvaraiṇaivādyaudātatvasiddheḥ ||
rogākhyāṃ ṇvulbahulam || 3|3|108 ||
ākhyāgrahaṇamityādi | yadi pratyayāntaṃ rogasya nāma bhavati, evaṃ
pratyayo bhavati, nānyathetyevamarthamākhyāgrahaṇamityarthaḥ | tena
padāntaradyotye roge na bhavati---bubhukṣā bhasmakeneti | bhasmako
nāma rogaviśeṣastatrāśitapītādikaṃ śarīrasya vyāpakaṃ na bhavati,
sarvadā ca bubhukṣā bhavati | bahulagrahaṇaṃ vyabhicārārthamiti |
ṭhkvacitpravṛttiḥ kvacidapravṛttiḥ kvacidvibhāṣā kvacidanyadeva' ityayaṃ
vyabhicāraḥ | pracchadiketi | vicaciketi | ṭhcarca adhyayane'
pratyayopasargābhyāṃ rogapratītiḥ, pāmā vicacikā |
śirotiḥuśirastodaḥ | ṭharda hiṃsāyām', ṭhtitutra' itīḍabhāvaḥ,
pūrvapadasya rutvam, ṭhatororaplutāt' ityutvam, ādguṇaḥ',
ṭheṅaḥ padāntādati' |
dhātvarthanirdeśa iti | kriyānirdeśa ityarthaḥ |
ikśatapau dhātunirdeśa iti | dhātvanukaraṇa ityarthaḥ | bahulavacanācca
kvacinna bhavati---ṭhguptijkidbhyaḥ san', ṭhmānvadhadānśānbhyaḥ' iti |
śtipaḥ śitkaraṇasāmarthyādakartṛvācinyapyetasmin śabādayo
bhavanti | evamabhāvakarmavācinyapi | kvacidyagapi bhavati,
yathā---ṭhvibhāṣā līyateḥ', atra līlīṅeryakā nirdeśaḥ kṛtaḥ, śyani
tu līṅ eva grahaṇaṃ syāt, na tu līnāteḥ | kathaṃ punaḥ śitkaraṇasya
sāmarthyam, yāvatā pibatijighratirityādau śtipi pibādyādeśārthaṃ
glāyatyadāvātvapratiṣedhārthaṃ ca śitkaraṇaṃ syāt ? evaṃ tarhi
ṭhupasargātsunotisuvatisyati', ṭhvibhāṣā līyateḥ', ṭhbhavaterṇa
upasaṃkhyānam', ṭhdhyāyateḥ samprasāraṇaṃ ca'
ityevamādinirdeśācchabādayo bhaviṣyanti |
varṇāditi | varṇavācino varṇānukaraṇādityarthaḥ, na tu
varṇāduccāryamāṇāditi | kiṃ siddhaṃ bhavati ? kakāra ityādau
sāckādapi saṃghātātkāraḥ siddho bhavati; akārasyoccāraṇāthatvena
varṇamātrasyānukāryatvāt | kakārasyetsaṃjñā pratyojanābhāvānna
bhavati | bahulagrahaṇād ṭhasya cvau' ṭhyasyeti ca' ityādau
kārapratyayo na bhavati | bahulavacanādeva
kvacidvarṇasaṅghātādanukaraṇādapi bhavati---ekakāra iti | adhātu
vihitatve'pi kārapratyayasya kṛtsaṃjñādhikārasāmarthyādbhavati | tena
kṛdantatvātprātipadikasaṃjñā bhavati, iḍāgamastvanārddhadhātukatvānna
bhavati | kimarthaṃ punaḥ kārapratyayo vidhīyate, yāvatā karaṇaṃ kāraḥ,
asya kāro'kāra ityevamastu ? naivaṃ śakyam; evaṃ hi vijñāyamāne
kakārakaraṇamiti na syāt, karoteḥ paunaruktyāt |
rādipha iti | kārasyāyamapavādaḥ | kathaṃ tarhi ṭhrakārādāni nāmāni'?
vāsarūpavidhinā kāro'pi bhaviṣyati, pūrvavatkṛtsaṃjñāyāṃ
prātipadikatvam | matvārthāccha iti | matunā samānārtho matvarthastataḥ
svārthe cchaḥ | bahulavacanādabhatve'pi yasyeti lopaḥ,
pūrvavatpratipadikatvam | bahulavacanātkvacinna bhavati, yathā---ṭhtasau
matvarthe' iti | bahulavacanādeva ca matubarthaśabdādapi
bhavati---śaiṣikānmatubarthīyāditi | 
ājiriti | bahulavacanādvībhāvābhāvaḥ |
ikkṛṣyādibhya iti | dhātvarthanirdeśe ṇvulo'pavādaḥ ||
saṃjñāyām || 3|3|109 ||
uddālaḥuśleṣmatakaḥ, tasya puṣpāṇi bhajyante yasyāṃ sā
uddālapuṣpabhañjikā | varaṇapuṣpāṇi pracīyante yasyāṃ
varaṇapuṣparpacāyikā | abhyūṣaḥupūlikā'pūpaviśeṣaḥ, sa khādyate
yasyāṃ sā abhyūṣakhādikā | tālasya bhañjanaṃ yasyāṃ sā tālabhañjikā |
evaṃ śālabhañjikā ||
vibhāṣākhyānaparipraśnayoriñca || 3|3|110 ||
nanu pūrvaṃ paripraśnaḥ, paścādākhyānaṃ bhavati, tatkathaṃ kramavyudāsena
sūtre pūrvamākhyānasya nirdeśaḥ, paścātparipraśnasya ? tatrāha---pūrvaṃ
paripraśna ityādi | satyaṃ pūrvaṃ praśnaḥ paścādākhyānamiti, sūtre tu
lakṣaṇavaśādviparyaya āśrita ityarthaḥ | svayaṃ tu vyatsyāsena
vyācakṣāṇo'rthakrameṇa vyācaṣṭe, udāharati ca | kārikāmiti |
ṇvul | kriyāṃ kṛtyāmiti | ṭhkṛñaḥ śa ca', cakārātkyapca |
kṛtimiti | yogavibhāgāt ktin | gaṇimiti | ṭhgaṇa saṅkhyāne'
curādiradantaḥ | gaṇanāmiti | yuc | evamityādi | kāṃ pācikāṃ,
pacām | ṣitvādaṅ | paktiḥ---ṭhsthāgāpāpaca' iti ktin | kāṃ yāji
yājikāmim | kāṃ pāṭhi pāṭhikāṃ paṭhitim |
titutreṣvagrahādīnāmiti vacanādiṭ ||
paryāyārharṇotpatiṣu ṇvuc || 3|3|111 ||
paripāṭīti | paṭeḥ paripūrvāt ṭhiṇajādibhyaḥ' iti iṇ
tadantāt ṭhkṛdikārāktinaḥ' iti ṅīṣ | tadyorayateti | tacchabdena
dhātvartha ucyate | parasmai iti | ṭhdhārerutamarṇaḥ' iti sampradānasaṃjñā |
parasyeti tu pāṭhe parasya vistvityarthaḥ | dhāryateubādhyate |
grāmamāmiketi | karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhayāḥ samāsaḥ | udapādīti | ṭhciṇ
te padaḥ' iti kartari ciṇ | svarārthamiti | ṭhcitaḥ'
ityantodātatvaṃ yathā syāt | ṇvuli tu ṭhliti' iti
pratyayātpūrvamudātaṃ syāt ||
ākrośe nañyaniḥ || 3|3|112 ||
ākreśaḥuśapanam, na kṣepaḥ; svabhāvād | akaraṇirityādikaṃ
śapanavākyam ||
kṛtyalyuṭo bahulam || 3|3|113 ||
snānīyamiti | karaṇe kṛtyaḥ | dānīya iti | saṃpradāne avasecanādau
karmaṇi lyuṭ |
praskandanaḥ, prapatana iti | kartari | bahulagrahaṇaṃ na kartavyam,
ārambhasāmarthyādeva kṛtyalyuṭo yatra vihitāstato'nyatra bhaviṣyanti,
tato bahulagrahaṇāt kṛnmātrasya svārthavyabhicāraḥ sādhito bhavati |
ṭhtayoreva kṛtyaktakhalarthāḥ' ṭhkartari kṛt' ityayaṃ tvarthanirdeśaḥ
ṭhbāhulyādbhāvādiṣu bhavanti, kvacideva tvanyatra' iti jñāpanārthaḥ |
pādahāraka iti | karmaṇi ṇvuli pañcamyantasya sādhanaṃ kṛteti samāsaḥ
| galecopaka iti | ṭhamūīrddhamastakāt' ityaluk ||
napuṃsake bhāve ktaḥ || 3|3|114 ||
nanu ca ṭhtayoreva kṛtyaktakhalarthāḥ' iti napuṃsake bhāve ktaḥ siddhaḥ ?
satyaṃ bhūte siddhaḥ, kālasāmānye tu napuṃsake na
prāpnotītyayamārambhaḥ | iha sakarmakebhyo'pi yathā bhāve ghañādayo
bhavanti---odanasya pākaḥ, odanasya bhojanamiti, tathāyamapi ktaḥ
sakarmakebhyo bhāve bhavati; atrākarmakebhya ityavacanāditi kecidāhuḥ
| atha tadā karmaṇi kā vibhaktirbhavati ? kṛdyogalakṣaṇā karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī |
sā niṣṭhāyoge pratiṣidhyate ? napuṃsake bhāve upasaṃkhyānamiti
ṣaṣṭhī bhaviṣyati---odanasya bhuktamudakasya pītamiti | asminpakṣa
etadarthopyayamārambhaḥ, na hi tayārevetyanena sakarmakebhyo bhāve ktaḥ
siddhyati | anye tu tayorevetyetadasyāpi ktasya
viṣayavyavasthāpakaṃ manyante | taddhi ṭhniṣṭhā' iti vihitasya ktasya
bhāvamarthaṃ vidyate, ṭhakarmakebhyaḥ' iti ca viṣayaṃ vyavasthāpayati | asya
tu ṭhbhāve ktaḥ' ityanuvādenākamakebhya iti viṣayaṃ vyavasthāpayati ||
lyuṭ ca || 3|3|115 ||
yogavibhāga utarārtha iti | utaratra lyuṭa evānuvṛttiryathā syāt,
ktasya mā bhūdityevamartham ||
karmaṇi ca yena saṃsparśātkartuḥ śarīrasukham || 3|3|116 ||
karturiti karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī | ṭhubhayaprāptau karmaṇi' iti niyamādyeneti
kartari tṛtīyā, tadāha---yena karmaṇā saṃspṛśyamānasyeti | kasya
śarīrasukhamityapekṣāyāṃ kartuḥ sannidhānātasyaiva vijñāyata
ityāha---kartuḥ śarīrasukhamutpadyata iti | kimidaṃ śarīrasya
sukhamiti ? nanu śarīravyatiriktasyātmano dharmaḥ sukham ? satyam;
yasmin sukhe samutpanne śarīre'pi svāsthyamutpadyate
taccharīrasukhamityucyate | nityasamāsārthaṃ vacanamiti | kathaṃ tarhi
ṭhubhayaprāptau karmaṇi' ityatrodāhṛtam---sādhu khalu payasaḥ pānaṃ
devadateneti ? yatra pratikūlatayā sukhaṃ notpadyate tatra tadudāhṛtaṃ
draṣṭavyam | payaḥ pānaṃ sukhamiti | tatra pānena sukhaṃ na sparśena, idaṃ
tūdāhartumucitam---candanānulepanaṃ sukhamiti ? naiṣadoṣaḥ; yatra
saṃsparśanamantareṇa na sukhamutpadyate tadviṣayopalakṣaṇaṃ
saṃsparśagrahaṇam | tatra sparśanādeva sukhaṃ bhavatu
tatpūrvakātpānādervā sarvatra bhaviṣyati |
tūlikāyā iti | tūlena nirmitaḥ kaśipustūlikā, tatra
śayitvotthānaṃ sukham | agnikuṇḍasyopāsanamiti |
atrāgnikuṇḍenāspṛśyamānasyaiva sukham | guroḥ snāpanamiti |
yadyapyatra guruḥ sukhānubhavasya kartā, tathāpi na tadatrāśritam;
avyabhicārāt, kiṃ tarhi ? lyuṭ prakṛtau yatkartṛtvaṃ tadāśritam,
tadāha---snāpayaterna guruḥ karteti | mānasī tu prītiriti |
puttreṇa balavatpariṣvajyamānasya śarīratoda eva bhavati, mānasī tu
prītiḥ | nanu pratyudāharaṇeṣvapi sarvatra lyuṭ prayujyate, tatkathaṃ
pratyudāharaṇatvam ? tatrāha---sarvatrāsamāsaḥ pratyudāhriyata iti ||
karaṇādhikaraṇayośca || 3|3|117 ||
karaṇe cādhikaraṇe cābhidheye iti | upapade tu karaṇādhikaraṇe na
bhavataḥ, karaṇādhikaraṇayorityata eva nirdeśāt | kriyate'neneti
karaṇam, adhikriyate'sminnitvadhikaraṇamiti karaṇādhikaraṇasādhanau
hyaetau | yadyevam, sati nirdeśe pratyayavidhānam, sati ca
pratyayavidhāne nirdeśa | itītaretarāśrayaḥ prāpnoti ? na;
nityātvācchabdānāṃ nāsmānnirdeśātkaraṇādhikaraṇaśabdaustaḥ |
idhmapravraścana iti | karmaṇi, ṣaṣṭhayāḥ samāsaḥ | dātrādirucyate |
palāśaśātana iti || ṭhśadlṛ śātane' hetumaṇṇica, ṭhśaderagatau taḥ'
iti tatvam | yena daṇḍena vṛkṣasya parṇāni pātyante sa evamucyate |
godohanī, saktudhānī pātrī | yogaścāyaṃ yena nāprāptinyāyena
ghaño'pavādaḥ | ajapau strīpratyayāṃśca paratvādvādhate | uktaṃ hi
---ṭhajabbhyāṃ strīkhalanāḥ striyāḥ khalanau vipratiṣedhena' iti ||
puṃsi saṃjñāyāṃ ghaḥ prāyeṇa || 3|3|118 ||
dantacchada iti | ṭhcchada āvaraṇe' curādiḥ,ṭhchāderghe'dvyupasargasya'
iti hrasvaḥ | etyāsminkurvanti vyavahāramityākaraḥu utpattisthānam ||
gocarasaṃcaravahavrajavyajāpaṇanigamāśca || 3|3|119 ||
gāvaścaratyasminniti | rūḍhiśabdo'yaṃ viṣayaparyāyaḥ, tasya
yathākathaṃcinnirvacanam | tathā ca gocaraḥ, indriṃyagocara ityādyapi |
sañcarante'neti | ṭhsamastṛtīyāyuktāt' ityātmanepadam |
sañcaraḥumārgaḥ, vahaḥu skandhaḥ, vrajaḥugoṣṭham, vyajaḥutālavṛntam,
āpaṇaḥu paṇyasthānam, nigamaḥucchandaḥ | ayaṃ yogaḥ śakyo'vaktum,
pūrveṇaivaghaḥ siddhaḥ | ṭhhalaśca' iti ghañ kasmānna bhavati ?
prāyeṇagrahaṇaṃ tatrānuvartate, yathā---kaṣo nikaṣa ityatra ghañ na
bhavati, evaṃ gocarādiṣvapi na bhaviṣyati ||
ave tṛstrorghañ || 3|3|120 ||
avatāraḥurūpādiḥ, avastāraḥujavanikādiḥ | nadyavatāraḥutīrtham |
prāyeṇagrahaṇānuvṛterasaṃjñāyāmapi bhavatīti | nanu ghañ vidheyaḥ
pradhānam, tasya prāyagrahaṇamupādhiḥ, tataśca saṃjñāyāmeva kvacinna
bhavatītyarthaḥ syāt ? evaṃ manyate---saṃjñāyāmityupādhereva
prāyagrahaṇamupādhiḥ | upāderupādhirbhavati, viśeṣaṇasyaiva vā
viśeṣaṇamiti tu nāśrīyate; lakṣyānurodhāditi ||
halaśca || 3|3|121 || 
lekhaḥulekhanī | veṣṭaḥu vastrādiḥ | ṭhviṣṭa veṣṭane' | vidyete jñāyete
anena dharmādharmāviti vedaḥ | apamṛjyate'nena
vyādhyādirityapāmārgaḥu vīrudviśeṣaḥ | vīmārgaḥu samūhanī,
pūrvavatkutvadīrghatve ||
adhyāyanyāyodyāvasaṃhārādhārāvāyāśca || 3|3|122 ||
āvayantīti | etyāvayantītyarthaḥ | 
cakāro'nuktasamuccayārtha iti |
ṭhghañvidhāvavahārāvāyānāmupasaṃkhyānam' vārtikam | vṛttikārastu
ādhārāvāyaśabdau sūtre prakṣipya cakāreṇāvahāraśabdaṃ sādhayati sma,
vicitrā hi vṛteḥ kṛtirvṛttikāreṇa ||
udaṅko'nudake || 3|3|123 ||
tailamudayacyate, uddhriyate'sminniti tailodakamucarmamayaṃ
bhajanam ||
ghaḥ kasmāditi | ṭhpuṃsi saṃjñāyām' ityādinā ghe prāpte
ghañvihitaḥ, tataśca tena mukte gha eva bhavitumarhatīti bhāvaḥ |
viśeṣābhāvāditi | nanu ghe sati pratyayasvaraḥ ghañi
ñitsvareṇādyaudātaḥ, tatkathaṃ viśeṣābhāvaḥ ?
statrāha---ghañyāpahītyādi || 
jālamānāyaḥ || 3|3|124 ||
ṭhjala ghātye' ityataḥ ṭhjvalitikasantebhyo ṇaḥ' iti ṇe kṛte jālamiti
bhavati | ānīyante matsyādayo'nenetyānāyaḥ ||
khano gha ca || 3|3|125 ||
ghitkaraṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā na khanaḥ kaścidavayavaḥ kutvabhāgasti ?
jñāpanārthaṃ tu, etaj jñāpayati---anyebhyo'pyayaṃ bhavatīti | tena
bhajerbhagaḥ, padeḥ padam---karaṇe ghaḥ, ṭhkhala sañcalane' adhikaraṇe ghaḥ
khala evamādi siddhaṃ bhavati | ākhanādayaḥ khanitravacanāḥ ||
īṣadduḥ suṣu kṛcchrākṛcchrārtheṣu khal || 3|3|126 ||
taddura iti | ṭhsuduroradhikaraṇe' itinirdeśād duḥ śabdo
rephānto'pyasti | sāmbhavāditi | dura eva kṛcchre sambhavaḥ
itarayorevākṛcchre, ataḥ sāmānyenoktāvapi viśeṣaṇasya
viṣayavibhāgo labhyata iti bhāvaḥ | īṣatkāryamiti | manāgityarthe
īṣacchabdaḥ ||
kartṛkarmaṇeśca bhūkṛñoḥ || kartari karmaṇi copapade iti |
pratyayārthatvaṃ tu kartṛkarmaṇorna bhavati;
cakārasyopapadasamuccayārthatvāt | kiṃ ca, yadi tayoḥ
pratyayārthatvaṃ syād īṣadādiṣvevopapadeṣu pratyayaḥ syāt, taśca
khitkaraṇamanarthaṃkaṃsyād; anavyayasya hi num vidhīyate |
tasmātsuṣṭhūaktam---kartari karmaṇi copapade iti | atra cakāraḥ
sanniyogārthaḥ kriyate, yadā kartṛkarmaṇerīṣadādīnāṃ ca
yugapadupapadatvaṃ tadā pratyayo bhavati, samāsastu yugapatparyāyeṇa
vā bhavati | kiṃ punaratra paramupapadam ? kartṛkarmaṇī | kuta etat ?
khalaḥ khitkaraṇāt | taddhimumartham, mumāgamaścānavyayasya |
tatreṣadādīnāṃ dhātoścānantarye khitkaraṇamanarthakaṃsyāt | nanu mā
bhūdīṣado dhātoścānantaryam, yatraitannāsti---te prāgdhātoriti,
yatra tvasti suduroḥ, tatra tayoreva prāk prayogo yuktaḥ,
khitkaraṇaṃ tvīṣadāḍha|lmbhavantīm ityādau mumarthaṃ syāt,
sudurorapi ṭhkṛdgrahaṇe gatikārakapūrvasyāpi grahaṇam' iti
tatrāpi mumarthaṃ syāt, yathā ṭhudikūle rujivahoḥ' kūlamudruja iti
? vaktavyo'tra parihāraḥ---kṛtyalyuṭo bahulamiti | bahulagrahaṇaṃ
vā'trāśrayaṇīyam | īṣadāḍha|lmbhavamiti | anaaḍha|lena bhavatā
sukhenāḍha|lena bhūyata ityarthaḥ | īvadāḍha|lṅkara iti | anāṭha|le
devadataḥ sukhenāḍhayaḥ kriyata ityarthaḥ | svāḍha|lena bhūyata iti | pramāda
pāṭho'yam | atra hi khalabhāvātsuśabdasya dhātoḥ prāk prayogeṇa
bhāvyam, tasmādāḍha|lena subhūyate iti pāṭhaḥ ||
anyebhyo'pi dṛśyate || 3|3|130 ||
anyebhyo'pi cātubhyo gatyarthebhya iti | gatyarthebhyo ye'nye
dhātavastebhya ityarthaḥ | atha vā naño'tra praśleṣaḥ---anyebhyo'pi
dhātubhyaḥ, ko'rthaḥ ? agatyarthebhya iti |
bhāṣāyāmiti | ṭhcchandasi' ityadhikārādayamārambhaḥ | ṭhśāsu
anuśiṣṭau', ṭhyudha saṃprahāre', dṛśir prekṣaṇe', ṭhñidhṛṣā
prāgalabhye', ṭhmṛṣa titikṣāyām'||
vartamānasāmīpye vartamānavadvā || 3|3|131 ||
atra kecidvyācakṣate---śamīpasya bhāvaḥ sāmīpyam, bhāve ṣyañ,
vartamānasya sāmīpyaṃ vartamānasāmīpyam, ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ, vartamānasya
bhūtabhaviṣyantau prati yatsāmīpyaṃ tatra
vartamānavatpratyayātideśo'narthakaḥ, ye hi vartamāne pratyayāste
samīpabhūte'pi tasmin bhavantyeva, ato vartamānaṃ prati
bhūtabhaviṣyatoryatsāmīpyaṃ tadatra vartamānasāmīpyamityucyate,
samīpadvārakācca vartamānasya sāmīpyenābhisambandhātsamāso
nānupapannaḥ, yathā---devadatasya gurukulamiti | guṇena neti
pratiṣedho'pi na bhavati; yasmādguṇaśabdasya sambandhiśabdatvād
guṇākṣiptasya guṇina eva samāsaniṣedaḥ | na ca vartamānaḥ sāmīpyasya
guṇī, bhūtabhaviṣyatostadguṇitvāt" iti | tadidaṃ kliṣṭṃa
vyākhyānam, ṣyañnirdeśaśca kevalaṃ gauravāyaiva syādityanyathā
vyācaṣṭe---samīpameva sāmīpyamiti | na cāsmin pakṣe ṣyaño
vaiyarthyamityāha---ṣyañaḥ svārthikatvaṃ jñāpyata iti | svārthe'pi ṣyañ
bhavatīti etamarthaṃ jñāpayituṃ ṣyañā nirdeśaḥ kṛtaḥ ityarthaḥ |
cāturvarṇyādisiddhyarthamiti | ādiśabdena cāturāśramyam, anyasya
bhāvo'nyabhāvaḥ, anyabhāva evānyabhāvyamityevamādīnāṃ grahaṇam | kadā
daevadata āgato'sīti | bhūtakālena praśnaḥ, udāharaṇe
bhūtakālābhivyaktaye'yameṣa ityāgamanāvinābhūtaṃ yadrūpaṃ
śvetaparikarabandhādiyuktaṃ tadrūpaṃ pratinirdiśyate |
idānīmāgamamityarthaḥ | evaṃ ca kadeti praśne cotaraṃ saṅgacchate,
sāmīpyaṃ ca dyotitaṃ bhavati | āgamamiti | luṅ, mipo'mbhāvaḥ,
lṛditvādaṅ | kadā devadata gamiṣyasīti | atrāpi bhaviṣyatkālena
praśna udāharaṇe bhaviṣyatkālābhivyaktaye | gantāsmīti | anadyatane
luṭ | atrāpi sāmīpyaṃ yathāsambhavaṃ draṣṭavyam |
atha vatkaraṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā'satyapi tasmin
pratyayādhikārādvartamāne ye pratyayā vihitāste vartamānasāmīpye
bhavantītyeṣo'rtho labhyata eva, nārtho vatkaraṇenāta āha---vatkaraṇaṃ
sarvasādṛśyārthamiti | asati vatkaraṇe vartamāne ye pratyayā ityanena
pratyayānāṃ rūpamātraṃ lakṣyeta, tataśca saṅkaro'pi
syāt---anyasmāddhātoryo vartamāne vihitaḥ pratyayaḥ sa
dhātvantarādapi syāt | vatkaṇe tu sati sarvasādṛśyāvagateḥ
saṅkaro na bhavati | sarvasādṛśyāvagateḥ saṅkaro na bhavati |
sarvasādṛśyameva darśayati---yena viśeṣaṇeneti |
ādiśabdenopādherabhidheyasya ca grahaṇam | pacamāno yajamāna iti |
vartamāne pūṅyajoḥ śānanvihitaḥ, sāmīpye sa tābhyāmeva bhavati
| alaṅkariṣṇuriti | tacchīlādiviśiṣṭe kartaryalampūrvātkṛñ
iṣṇujvihitaḥ, sa sāmīpye'pi tasmādeva tatpūrvādeva tasminnevārthe
bhavati |
parut pūrvasmin saṃvatsare |
yo hi manyate ityādinā pratipatṛviśeṣaṃ prati prakaraṇaṃ pratyācaṣṭe
| kālāntaragatistviti | kālāntaraṃ vartamānasamīpo bhūto
bhaviṣyaṃśca kālaḥ tasya yā gatiḥu pratītiḥ sā ṭhayaṃ gacchāmi' ityato
vākyāt ṭhkadā devadata gamiṣyasi' ityasyotaratvena
prayuktādbhavati, tataḥ kimityatrāha---na ceti |
vākyārthapratipatāramiti | vākyārtho'yaṃ na padārtha iti yaḥ pratipadyate
sa vākyārthapratipatā, karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhayāḥ samāsaḥ | ṭhkartari ca' iti
pratiṣedhastvanityaḥ; ṭhjanikartuḥ' iti nirdeśāt, śeṣaṣaṣṭha|la vā
samāsaḥ | prakaraṇamiti | ita ārabhyāṣṭaḍasūtrī prakaraṇaśabdenocyate |
tathā ca śvaḥ kariṣyatītyādi | yadi vākyagamyo'pi kālaḥ padasaskāra
upayujyate, tadā naivamādyaupapadyate---anadyatane luṭaiva bhavitavyamiti
kṛtvā ||
āśaṃsāyāṃ bhūtavacca || 3|3|132 ||
tasyāśca bhaviṣyatkālo viṣaya iti | bhaviṣyatkālo'syeti
bhaviṣyatkālo dhātvarthaḥ, sa āśaṃsāviṣayaḥ, sā tu vartamānakālaiva |
evaṃ ca sāmarthyādbhaviṣyādviṣayo'yamatideśo vijñāyata
ityāha---bhaviṣyatkāla iti | āśaṃsāyāṃ gamyamānāyāmiti |
āśaṃsyamānakriyāvacanāddhātorityarthaḥ |
upādhyāścedityādikamāṃśasāvākyam, tatropādhyāyāgamanaṃ
vyākaraṇādhyayanaṃ cobhyamāśaṃsyamānamityubhayatrāpi pratyayaḥ |
adhyagīṣmahīti | ṭhvibhāṣā luṅlṛṭoḥ' iti iṅeḥ gāṅadeśaḥ,
ṭhgāṅkuṭādibhyaḥ' iti sico ṅtvim, ghumāsthādisūtreṇetvam |
sāmānyātideśe iti | atra sūtre bhūtaśabdena bhūtamātramucyate, na tu
tadviśeṣo'nadyatanaḥ | sāmānyātideśe ca viśeṣo nātidiśyate,
vrāhmaṇavadasminkṣatriye vatitavyamityukte brāhmaṇamātraprayuktaṃ
kāryaṃgamyate, na tu māṭharādiviśeṣapratyuktam, tenānadyatanaprayuktau
laṅliṭau na bhavataḥ | ihāniṣpanne niṣpannaśabdaḥ śiṣyaḥ śāsitavyaḥ,
devaścedvṛṣṭo niṣpannāḥ śālaya iti vastusvarūpakathanametat,
nātrāśaṃsā, tena sūtreṇāprāptiḥ ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; apśālibījasaṃyoga
eva niṣpatiḥ śālīnāṃ tatraiva niṣpatervṛteḥ | ata eva loko
bhaviṣyadvācinaḥ śabdasya prayogaṃ na mṛṣyati | devaścedvṛṣṭaḥ
sampatsyante śālaya iti ukte, vaktāro bhavanti---maivaṃ vocaḥ, sampannāḥ
śālaya iti brūhīti, hetubhūtakālasamprekṣitatvātsiddham |
hetubhūtasya varṣāderyaḥ kālaḥ sa eva kāryasya samprekṣitaḥ sa eva
kāryasyāpi kālo vyavasthāpyate kāraṇāntarāpekṣābhāvapratipādanāya
| tataśca kāraṇasyaiva kāryarūpeṇa
vivakṣitatvādabhedādhyavasāyātkāraṇasya bhūtatvātkāryasyāpi bhūtatvaṃ
siddhamityarthaḥ |
iha tu kaścidadhvānaṃ jigamiṣuḥ paśyati amuṣminnavakāśe kūpo
bhaviṣyatīti, anadyatane kūpo bhaviteti samāsādya kūpo'stīti,
atikramyakūpo'bhūditi, atikramyoṣitatvāt kūpa āsīditi,
atikramyāṣitvā vismṛtya kūpo babhūveta; tadatra sarvatra kūpasatāyā
vatemānatvaṃ bhūtabhaviṣyadrūpatvamiti sarvatra laḍeva prāpnoti,
luṅadayastu vaktavyāḥ ? tadāha---ṭhastyarthānāṃ bhavantyarthe sarvā
vibhaktayaḥ kartuvidyamānārthatvāt' iti | bhavantīśabdo laṭaḥ
pūrvācāryāṇāṃ saṃjñā | yadi vacanena vartamāna eva luṅadayo
vidhīyante kūpo'bhūditi prayoktavye kūpo bhaviṣyatītyapi
prayujyeta, tasmādyathāsvametā vibhaktayaḥ kāleṣu prayujyante | katham ?
indriyavyāpārasya kālasya kūpasatāṃ prati bhedakatvenāśrayaṇātasyā api
tatkālatvam; tataścendriyavyāpāre bhāvini bhaviṣyādvibhaktiḥ,
vartamāne vartamānavibhaktiḥ, bhūte bhūtavibhaktiriti siddhamiṣṭam |
uktaṃ ca---
satāmindriyasambandhātsaiva satā viśeṣyate |
bhedena vyavahāro hi vastvantaranibandhanaḥ ||
astitvaṃ vastumātrasya buddhyā tu parigṛhyate |
yaḥ samāsādanādbhevaḥ sa tatra na vivakṣitaḥ || iti ||
kṣipravacane lṛṭ || 3|3|133 ||
vacanagrahaṇaṃ paryāyārthamiti | asati tasmin ṭhsvaṃ rūpaṃ śabdasya' iti
vacanātkṣipraśabda evopapade syāt, sati tu paryāyeṣvapi bhavati |
nanu bhūtavaccetyasyāyamapavādaḥ, sa ca bhaviṣyatkālaviṣayastatra
netyeva vaktavyam, tasminpratiṣiddhe ṭhlṛṭ śeṣe ca' ityanenaiva
lṛṭ siddhaḥ, tatkiṃ lṛḍgrahaṇena ? tatrāha---neti vaktavye ityādi |
netyucyamāne ṭhlṛṭ śeṣe ca' ityanena lṛḍ bhavannanadyatane na
syāt; luṭā bādhitatvād | ato luḍviṣayo'pi yathā syāditi
lṛḍgrahaṇaṃ kriyata ityarthaḥ ||
āśaṃsāvacane liṅ || 3|3|134 ||
adhīyīyeti | iṅe liṅḥ ṭhico't', sīyuṭ, liṅḥ salopaḥ,
dhātoriyaṅ, upasargeṇa saha savarṇadīrghatvam | kṣipravacane lṛṭ,
āśaṃsāvacane liṅ vipratiṣedhena | kṣipravacane
lṛḍityasyāvakāśaḥ---kṣipramadhyeṣyāmaha iti, āśaṃsāvacane
liṅtyisyāvakāśaḥ---āśaṃse yukto'dhīyīyeti; ihobhayaṃ
prāpnoti---āśaṃse kṣipramadhīyīyeti, liṅ bhavati vipratiṣedhena |
tadetadudāharaṇe darśayati---āśaṃse kṣipramadhīyīyeti ||
nānadyatanavatkriyāprabandhasāmīpyayoḥ || 3|3|135 ||
kālānāṃ sāmīpyamiti | ṭhvartamānasāmīpye' ityārabhya
kālaprāyatvādasya prakaraṇasya sāmānyenoktāvapi kālasambandhina eva
sāmīpyasyāśrayaṇamiti bhāvaḥ | lulyajātīyeneti | tatraiva loke
sāmīpyavyavahārāditi bhāvaḥ | adāditi | ṭhgātisthā' ityādinā
sico luk | adhyāpipaditi | iṅe ṇic, ṭhkrīṅjīnāṃ ṇau'
ityātvam, ṭhartihrī' ityādinā puk, luṅ ciṅ ṭhijāderdvitīyasya'
iti piśabdasya dvirvacanam, ṇilopaḥ |
yeyaṃ paurṇamāsyatikrānteti | porṇamāsyantareṇāvyavahitā yā
paurṇamāsī tāmadhikṛtyedamucyate | sāpi yadyapyamāvāsyayānyābhiśca
tithibhirvyavahitā; tathāpi tulyajātīyena
porṇamāsyākhyenāvyahitatvātsamīpyaṃ nātivartate | ādhiteti |
dadhāterāṅpūrvasya ṭhsthāghvoricca' itītvam, ṭhhrasvādaṅgāt'
iti sico lopaḥ | ayaṣṭeti | ṭhjhalo jhali' iti sico lopaḥ,
vraścādisūtreṇa ṣatvam | aditeti | dadāte rūpaṃ pūrvavat |
yakṣyate iti | vraścādiṣatve ṭhṣaḍhoḥ kaḥ si' iti katvam, sarvatra
ṭhsvaritañitaḥ' ityātmanepadam |
iha kriyāprabandhasāmīpyayoradyatanapratyayau luṅlṛṭau iṣyete,
nānadyatanapratyayau laṅlṛṭau, tau ca luṅlṛṭau ṭhadtanavat
kriyāprabandhasāmīpyayoḥ' ityacyamāne'pi siddhyata eva, kimarthaṃ dvau
pratiṣedhāvucyete ? ityata āha---dvau pratiṣedhāviti |
yathāprāptasyeti | yathā yena prakāreṇa prāptaṃ prāptiryasyeti
bahuvrīhiḥ | avyayībhāve tvambhāvaḥ syāt | ihādyatanavacane sati
vidhānamidaṃ vijñāyate, tatra laḍvidhiprasaṅge pūrvavidhāne
hyadyatanasaṃśabdanena vihitasya kasyacitpratyayasyābhāvādadyatane
dṛṣṭasyātideśaḥ, laṭ cāpyadyatane dṛṣṭastena tasyāpi
bhūtabhaviṣyatoḥ prasaṅgaḥ, luṅlṛṭoścāyathākālaṃ vidhiḥ
prasajyeta---luṅe viṣaye lṛṭ, lṛṭaśca viṣaye luṅ | nanu ca
vatkaraṇātsādṛśyārthātsaṅkaro na bhaviṣyati ? naitadasti; iha
luṅlṛṭau bhūtabhaviṣyatoradyatane ca dṛṣṭau,
tatrādyatanavadityucyamāne tasminnevādyatane tayoratideśo'nathaka iti
kaścidaṃśo hātavyaḥ | tatrādyatanāṃśatyāgenātideśe vijñāyamāne
bhūtānadyatane luṅ, bhaviṣyadanadyatane lṛḍiti siddham | yadā tu
bhūtabhaviṣyadaśaparityāgenātideśaḥ; tadā bhūtādyatane dṛṣṭasya
bhaviṣyadadyatane, bhaviṣyadanadyatane ca dṛṣṭasya bhūtādyatane vidhānamiti
saṅkaraḥ syādeva, laṭ cobhayatra prasajyeta | vatkaraṇaṃtu
yasmāddhātoryasminnupādhau yaḥ pratyayo vihitaḥ sa tasmādeva
tasminnupādhāveva yathā syādityevamarthaṃ syāt | tena---ṭhpūṅyajoḥ
śānan' ityādau kālavyatyāsa eva bhavati, na dhātvādivyatyāsaḥ |
yadi punarayaṃ dvau pratiṣedhau kṛtvā tūṣṇīmāste, svaireva
vidhāyakairlaḍādaya utsargāḥ sveṣu sveṣu kāleṣu
apavādavinirmukteṣu bhavantīti na saṅkaraprasaṅgaḥ | ato
yathāprāptasyābhyanujñānānnāyaṃ vatiḥ; kiṃ tarhi ?
matup---anadyatanamasyāstītyanadyatanavat, sāmānyavivakṣyāṃ
napuṃsakatvam | anadyatanavatpratyayavidhirna bhavatīti |
asyāpyanadyatanavāṃścāsau pratyayaśca tasya vidhirityartha iti sarvathā
yadanadyatane vihitaṃ tatsarvaṃ na bhavati | vatau ṭhlaṅluṭau vihitau
tayoḥ pratiṣedhaḥ' ityupalakṣaṇam ||
bhaviṣyati maryādāvacane'varasmin || 3|3|136 ||
akriyāprabandhārthamasāmīpyārthaṃ ca vacanamiti |
ṭhkriyāprabandhasāmīpyayoḥ' iti nānuvartate, tadanuvṛtau hi
niyamārthametat syād---bhaviṣyatyeva maryādāvacana
evāvarasminneveti vā | vidhiniyamasambhave ca vidhireva jyāyāniti
bhāvaḥ | maryādāvacane satīti | maryādoktau satyāmityarthaḥ |
vacanagrahaṇamabhividhyartham, vacanagrahaṇe hi sati maryādāmātravacane
maryādāvacana ityartho bhavati | saiva hi maryādā yadā
kāryeṇābhisambaddhyate tadā ṭhabhividhiḥ' ityucyate |
avarasminpravibhāga iti | aparabhāgaviṣayaśceddhātvartho bhavatītyarthaḥ,
aparasminniti vacanādyasya maryādā tasya dvau bhāgau kalpayitavyāviti
gamyate | gantavya iti | adhvagamanasya bhaviṣyatvaṃ darśayaÄstatra kartavyasya
bhojanāderbhaviṣyatvaṃ darśayati | tasya yadaparamiti | anenādhvano
vibhāgo dvirityanenāpi kriyāprabandhābhāvo dvireva, nānavaratamiti
|
yo'yamadhvāgata iti | bhūtakālatāṃ darśayati | adhyaimahīti | iṅe
laṅ, śapo luk, ṭhāḍajādīnām', ṭhāṭaśca'| abhuñjmahīti |
ṭhbhujo'navane' ityātmanepadam, ṭhśnasorallopaḥ', cutvam |
tatra utarasūtre viśeṣaṃ vakṣyatīti | anahorātrāṇāmityanena ||
kālavibhāgau cānahorātraṇam || 3|3|137 ||
kālamaryādāvibhāge satīti | maryādā ca vibhāgaśca
maryādāvibhāgam---samāhāradvandvaḥ, tena kālaśabdasya ṣaṣṭīsamāsaḥ |
na cedahorātrasambandhī vibhāga iti | etenānahorātrāṇāmiti
sambandhasāmānye ṣaṣṭhī, na ṭhkartṛkarmaṇoḥ' iti darśayati | evaṃ sati
yadiṣṭṃa siddhaṃ taddarśayati---tairiti | tairanyasya kālasya
vibhāgo'nyena vā teṣāṃ taireva vā sarvathā pratiṣedhaḥ | nanu
pūrvasūtre evānahorātrāṇāmiti vaktavyam, evamapi hi
sāmarthyātkālavibhāgasyaiva pratiṣedho vijñāyate, na hi
deśavibhāgasyāhorātraiḥ sambandho'sti, tatkiṃ yogavibhāgena ?
tatrāha---yogavibhāga utarārtha iti | utarasūtre kālavibhāga eva
vibhāṣā yathā syād, deśavibhāge mā bhūditi |
āgrahāyaṇīumārgaśīrṣī |
trividhamudāharaṇamiti | prathamaṃ taivibhāgasya, dvitīyaṃ teṣāṃ
vibhāgasya, tṛtīyaṃ taisteṣāmahorātrasaṃsparśe u ahorātragandhe,
etacca prasajyapratiṣedhasamāśrayaṇāllabhyate | darśitaśca prasajyapratiṣedhaḥ
ṭhna cedahorātrasambandhī vibhāgaḥ' iti; anyathā ṭhanahorātrasambandhini
vibhāgaḥ' ityavakṣyat ||
liṅnimite lṛṅ kriyātipatau || 3|3|139 ||
kutaścidvaiguṇyāditi | pratibandhakodayaḥ sāmagrīvaikalyaṃ vā
vaiguṇyam | dakṣiṇena mārgeṇa na śakaṭṃa paryābhaviṣyaditi |
tasyamārgasya ṛjutvātsthāṇvāderabhāvācca | paryābhavanamubhaṅgaḥ |
kamalakaḥukaścitpuruṣaḥ, sa śakaṭādīnāṃ viṣameṣvapi sthāneṣu
musalādyavaṣṭambhayogena netā | amokṣyata bhavān ghṛteneti |
ghṛtamātrasyātipatau bhojanakriyābhinirvṛtāvapi lṛṅ bhavati;
kāraṇabhedādvibhinnaiva bhojanakriyā, tato ghṛtātipatau
ghṛtabhojanakriyāpyatipannaiva |
bhaviṣyatkālaviṣayametadvacanamiti | kathaṃ tarhi
bhaviṣyato'rthasyedānīmavagatistatrāha---bhaviṣyadaparyābhavanamiti |
hetumat tatra hetubhūtamiti | etena liṅnimitaṃ
hetuhetumadbhāvaṃ darśayati | liṅgena budhveti |
asakṛtprākkamalakāhvāne sati śakaṭāparyābhavanaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhāvino'pi
kamalakāhvānasya śakaṭāparyābhavanaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhāvino'pi
kamalakāhvānasya śakaṭāparyābhavanahetubhūtvaṃ liṅgena budhvā |
liṅgaṃ punaḥ kamalakāhvānatvam | ṭhbhaviṣyatkamalakāhvānamapi
śakaṭāparyābhavanasya hetuḥ kamalakāhvānatvātpūrvakamalakāhvānavat'
iti evaṃ budhvetyarthaḥ | tadatapatimiti | prakaraṇād dvicanāntasya
samāsaḥ, tayorāhvānāparyābhavanayoratipatimityarthaḥ, tatra
kamalakasya deśāntaragamanādinā tadāhvānasyātipatiravasīyate;
tadatipatyaiva ca paryābhavanasyāpyati patiḥ, śakaṭasya
gurutarabhārāropaṇādinā | bhaviṣyatkālayoratipatirito
vākyād gamyati iti | nedānīṃ kamalaka āhvātuṃ śakyate, tacca
śakaṭamapi paryābhaviṣyatyevetyavagamāt ||
bhūte ca || 3|3|140 ||
annārthī caṅkramyamāṇa iti | bhoktukāmaḥ kṣudhā kuṭilaṃ gacchannityarthaḥ
| aparaśca dvijo brāhmaṇārthīti | caṅkramyamāṇo dṛṣṭa ityanuṣaḍgaḥ |
brāhmaṇārtho bhoktāraṃ mārgayamāṇa ityarthaḥ | so'pi saṃbhramātkuṭilaṃ
gacchati | tataḥ kimityata āha---yadītyādi | yadi dṛṣṭo'bhaviṣyaditi
kvacitpaṭha|lte tatu ṭhyadāyadyorupasaṃkhyānam' iti
yadiliṅnimitatvāt lṛṅ, kiṃ tūtarasūtreṇa vikalpitaḥ | dṛṣṭa
ityeva tu pāṭho yuktaḥ | na tu bhuktavāniti | kriyātipatiṃ darśayati
| tatra hetuḥ---anyena pathā sa gata iti ||
votāpyoḥ || 3|3|141 ||
vā ā utāpyoriti āṅḥ praśleṣaṃ darśayati | tatrāṅ
utāpyorityanena sambandhādalpāpekṣatvenāntaraṅgatvādvā pūrvaṃ
pareṇa sahādguṇe kṛte pūrvaṃ pratyantavadbhāvād ṭhomāṅeśca'
iti pararūpam, yathā---āauuḍhā u oḍhā, adya oḍhā adyoḍhā, kadoḍheati |
atrotāpyoḥ samarthayoriti yatsaptamyantaṃ tadavadhitvenāpādīyate,
tatra prakṛtivadanukaraṇaṃ bhavatītyanukaraṇasyāpyapratyaya iti
pratiṣedhenāprātipadikatvādāṅe'pi yoge pañcamyabhāvaḥ |
maryādāyāmāṅiti | etacca vibhāṣā garhāprakṛtau prāgutāpibhyāmiti
smaraṇādavasīyate | garhāprakṛtau garhāviśiṣṭe prakṛtyarthe |
garhāgrahaṇamanavaklṛptyāderapi liṅnimitasyopalakṣaṇam |
ṭhvibhāṣā kathami liṅca' iti liṅnimitābhāvādutarasūtrātikramaḥ
||
garhāyāṃ laḍapijātvoḥ || 3|3|142 ||
kālasāmanaye na prāpnotīti | vidhīyate ityanena bhaviṣyatītyādeḥ
kālaviśeṣavācino nivṛttiṃ sūcayan kālasāmānye vidhiriti
darśayati | kālaviśeṣavihitāṃścetyādi | bhāṣye tveṣa
nirṇayaḥ---ṭhgarhāyāṃ laḍvidhānānarthakyam,
kriyāsamāpteravavivakṣitatvāt | tācchīlyapratipādanenātra garhā,
tataśca yadanena kriyate tatsarvaṃ vṛṣalayājanārthamiti sarvadāsau
vṛṣalaṃ yājayanneva bhavati, tataśca kriyāyāḥ samāptiravivakṣiteti
ṭhvartamāne laṭ' ityeva siddhaḥ | yadyevam, śatṛśānacāvapi prāpnutaḥ,
dṛśyete ca śatṛśānacāvapi māṃ yājayantaṃ paśyata, api māṃ yājamānaṃ
paśyeti, pratyuta sūtrārambhe satyavartamānakālavihitatvālluṭastau na
na prāpnuta iti doṣavānena sūtrārambhaḥ' iti ||
vibhāṣā kathami liṅ ca || 3|3|143 ||
vibhāṣāgrahaṇamityādi | svasmin svasmin kāle ye lṛḍādayo
vihitāsteṣāṃ ca bādhā mā bhūdityevamarthamityarthaḥ | yadyevam,
vibhāṣāgrahaṇādeva laḍapi bhaviṣyati, nārthaścakāreṇa ? satyam;
vartamāne siddhyati, kālāntare tu na siddhyati
tasmātadarthaścakāreṇa laṭaḥ gamuccayaḥ | atra liṅnimitamastīti |
kathamītyetadgarhā ca ||
kiṃvṛte liṅlṛṭau || 3|3|144 ||
ṭhkiṃvṛte lipsāyām' ityatra kiṃvṛtaṃ vyākhyātam | iha kiṃvṛte
lṛṭ ceti vaktavyam, cakārātprakṛto liṅ bhaviṣyati, nārtho
liṅgrahaṇena ? tatrāha---liṅgrahaṇamiti | cakāreṇa liṅ iva
laṭo'pi samuccayaḥ syāt; tasyāpi prakṛtvāt, tasmāt
tannivṛtyarthamiti bhāvaḥ ||
anavaklṛptyamarṣayorakiṃvṛte'pi || 3|3|145 ||
apigrahaṇaṃ śakyamakartum, katham ? yathā
ṭhupakādibhyo'nyarasyāmadvandve' ityatrādvandvagrahaṇaṃ
dvandvādhikāranivṛtyartham, tathehāpyakiṃvṛtagrahaṇaṃ
kiṃvṛtādhikāranivṛtyartham, asminnavṛte kiṃvṛte cākiṃvṛte ca
pratyayadvayaṃ bhaviṣyati, tatkriyate vispaṣṭārtham | tathā'kiṃvṛta ityapi
vispaṣṭārthameva, asvaritatvādeva ṭhkiṃvṛte'
ityasyānanuvṛteraviśeṣeṇa pratyayadvayaṃ bhaviṣyati | āha
ca---kiṃvṛtasyānadhikārādutaratrākiṃvṛtagrahaṇānarthakyamiti | nu
cākiṃvṛtagrahaṇena kiṃvṛtādanyatpadaṃ paryudāsāśrayaṇena gṛhyate,
tasyopapadasajñāṃ vakṣyāmītyakiṃvṛtagrahaṇaṃ syāt | kiṃ
punarupapadasaṃjñāyāḥ prayojanam ? samāsaḥ ? na; atiṅiti
pratiṣedhāt | yadā tarhi lṛṭaḥ satsaṃjñakau bhavatastadā samāso yathā
syāt, nāsya lṛṭaḥ satsaṃjñakau bhavataḥ, ṭhlaṭaḥ sadvā' ityatra
bhaviṣyatītyadhikārādbhaviṣyatītyevaṃ vihitasya lṛṭo grahaṇam |
ayaṃ tu kālamātre vidhānādyadyapi bhavati, tathāpi
bhaviṣyadadhikāravihito na bhavatīti nāsya śatṛśānacau bhavataḥ ||
kiṃkilāstyartheṣu lṛṭ || 3|3|146 ||
samudāya upapadamiti | kevalasya
kiṃśabdasyānavaklṛptyamarṣayorvṛtyasambhavāt | liṅe'pavāda iti |
pūrveṇāpraptasya | astitāmetyādi | bhavatkartṛkaṃ
vṛṣalayājanamastītyarthaḥ | uktaṃ hi ṭhpacyādayaḥ kriyā bhavatikriyāyāḥ
kartryo bhavanti' iti ||
jātuyadorliṅ || 3|3|147 ||
lṛṭo'pavāda iti | anavaklṛptyādisūtreṇa liṅlṛṭordvayorapi
prāptayorliṇeóva yathā syāt, lṛṇmā bhūdityavamartha ityarthaḥ |
yadāyadyorupasaṅkhyānamiti | sūtravat lṛṭo'pavādaḥ ||
yaccayatrayoḥ || 3|3|148 ||
lṛṭa evāpavāda iti | pūrvavatprāptasya | evakāraḥ paunarvacanikaḥ |
yogavibhāga utarārtha iti | utaratra yaccayatrayorevānuvṛttiryathā
syāt, jātuyadormābhūditi | ihānavaklṛptyamarṣau dvau,
yaccayatrayorityupapade api dve eva, tataśca yathāsaṅkhyaṃ prāpnoti ?
tatrāha---yathāsaṅkhyamiha neṣyate iti |
pūrvavallakṣaṇavyabhicāracihnāt bahvacaḥ pūrvanipātāt ||
garhāyāṃ ca || 3|3|149 ||
daridraścedvṛṣalayājanamapi yuktaṃ syāt, tata uktam---ṛddhaiti |
ṛddhasyāpyupabhogabāhulyena sambhāvyeta, ata uktam---vṛddha iti |
vṛddhasyāpi jātimātrabrāhmaṇasya yuktaṃ syāt, ata uktam---sadbrāhmaṇa
iti | sadvaṃśajaḥ sadācāraścetyarthato garhāmarha iti ||
śeṣe lṛjayadau || 3|3|151 ||
yaccayatrābhyāmiti | citrīkaraṇāpekṣastu śeṣo na bhavati, tasyeha
svaritatvenādhikārāt | āścaryaṃ yadi sa bhuñjīteti |
atrānavaklṛptirāścaryaṃ ca dvayaṃ gamyate, tatrāścaryanimite lṛṭi
pratiṣiddhe jātuyadorliṅvidhāne
yadāyadyorupasaṅkhyānamityanavaklṛptau liṅ | bhāṣye tu
śambhāvanārtho yadiśabdaḥ prayujyate, tataśca sambhāvanamatra
tātparyārthaḥ, na citrīkaraṇam; tataścāyadāviti na vaktavyam, liṅapi
ṭhsambhāvane'lam' ityanenaiva" ityuktam | yadāha---citrīkaraṇe
yadipratipedhānarthakyamarthānyatvāditi ||
utāpyoḥ samarthayorliṅ || 3|3|152 ||
samarthayoriti | sūtre samaśabdasya nipātanād ṭhatolopaḥ'
śakandhvāditvādvā pararūpatvam | saṃśabda eva vā vṛtau samaśabdena
samānārthaḥ, yathā---ṭhpropābhyāṃ samarthābhyām',
yathā---mukhasaṃmukhasyetyatreti bhāvaḥ |
praśnaḥ pracchādanaṃ ca gamyata iti | ādye praśno gamyate, dvitīye
pracchādanam | nanu cāpiśabdo'pi praśne
dṛṣṭaḥ---ṭhapyagraṇīrmantrakṛtṛmṛṣīṇām' api prasannaṃ hariṇeṣu te
manaḥ' iti tataśca praśne'pi samānārthatvamanayoriti uta daṇjaḥ
patiṣyatīti pratyudāharaṇānupapatiḥ ? evaṃ
manyate---apyagraṇīrityādau praṣṭavyamarthāntaramapekṣya samuccayārtha
evāpiśabdaḥ, praśnastvarthaḥ prakaraṇādinā gamyate; tena nānayoḥ praśne
samānārthatvamiti ||
kāmapravedane'kacciti || 3|3|153 ||
svābhiprāyāviṣkaraṇaṃ kāmapravedanamiti |
etadevāvayavārthaprakāśanenopapādayayati---kāma iccheti |
mārāvida tvāṃ pṛcchāmīti | mārāviśabdaṃ dadātīti mārāvidaḥ,
mārāvi ravo mākārītyarthaḥ | saṃjñaiṣā śukaviśeṣasya, taṃ haste
nidhāya kaścillālayati | pārvatyapi śukasyaiva kācidiṣṭā | prāyeṇa
tu mātāpitarau pṛcchāmīti pāṭhaḥ, tatra tadupakramaṃ
vākyam---mātāpitarau pṛcchāmi | kimatra pṛcchayate ? kaccijjīvati
te māteti ||
saṃmbhāvane'lamiti cetsiddhāprayoge || 3|3|154 ||
yogyatādhyavasānamiti | yogyatāyā niścayaḥ | etadeva
sphorayati---śaktiśraddhānamiti | śaktiḥu sāmarthyam, śraddhīyate
viṣayīkriyate yena jñānena tatathoktaṃ taditi |
sambhāvanaparyāptyetyetena paryāptāvihālaṃśabdaḥ, na
bhūṣaṇādāvityāha---yadyevaṃ sambhāvana iti | saptamyantasya kathamalamiti
cedityedviśeṣaṇamupapadyata ityāśaṅkya vipariṇāmena
vyācaṣṭe---taccetsambhāvanamiti | sambhāvanamalamiti
cāvartate---sambhāvane liṅ bhavati taccetsambhāvanamalamātmakaṃ
bhavatīti | evaṃ paryavasānenālamā sambandhaḥ, ato'tretiśabdo na
sambandhanīyaḥ | tato'lamityasmin siddhāprayoge satītyanvayaḥ | atra
cecchabdo na sambandhanīyaḥ; saptamyantena sambandhāsambhavāt | vṛtau
tu vastumātraṃ darśitam---siddhaścedalamo'prayoga iti, na punaratra
cecchabdasyānvayaḥ | paryāptamiti | svakāryanirvartane samartham,
svakāryaṃ punastasyāviparītamaviṣayaparicchedaḥ,
taddarśayati---avitathamiti | atathābhūtārthaviṣayatvaṃ jñānasya
vaitathyam, yathā---śuktikāyāṃ rajatajñānasya; tadviparītamavitatham,
tathābhūtārthaviṣayamityarthaḥ | tadīdṛśasambhāvanopādhika iti | taditi
vākyopanyāse īdṛśamalamarthaviśiṣṭṃa sambhāvanamupādhiryasyetai
tripado bahuvrīhiḥ | kvacituīdṛśe sambhāvanopādhaka ityasamāsaḥ
paṭha|lte, tatredṛśa iti na saṅgacchate; na hi dhātvarthasya kiñcidrūpaṃ
prāṅnidarśitaṃ yadīdṛśamityucyeta | sarvalakārāṇamapavāda iti |
sambhāvanasya bhaviṣyadviṣayatvādbhaviṣyadviṣayāṇāṃ
sarvalakārāṇāmityarthaḥ | api parvataṃ śirasā bhindyāditi | atra
yatparvatabhedaviṣayaṃ sāmarthyaṃ puṃsaḥ sambhāvyate tadyasya
bhīmasenādervidyata eva, tatra sambhāvanamavitathamiti
tadviṣayamudāharaṇam | api droṇapāka bhuñjīteti | yatpakvasya
bhojanaṃ tadeva pākasya bhojanam, karmasādhano vā pākaśabdaḥ |
videśasthāyīudeśāntaragataḥ | prāyeṇagamiṣyatīti |
prāyikasvadakṣiṇākṣispandanāderliṅgābhāsādāgamanaṃ sambhāvya tata
etatprayujyate, tatathyamapi bhavati, viparītamapi bhavati | alaṃ devadata
iti | paryāptaṃ haniṣyatītyarthaḥ | bhāviviṣayatvāt sambhāvanasya
sarvatra lṛṭ pratyudāhṛtaḥ |
aparā vyākhyā---sambhāvanaṃ bhāvivastūtprekṣaṇam, asati
viruddhapratyayopanipāte bhavitavyamaneneti jñānam, yathā
pratyudāharaṇe---prāyeṇāgamiṣyatīti, tasya viśeṣaṇamalamiti
cediti, alamiti cet tatsambhāvanamiti vipariṇāmenānvayaḥ | tatra
yathā ghaṭa iti jñānaṃ paṭa iti jñānamityukte jñānasya viṣayanirdeśaḥ
pratīyate, tathehāpi sambhāvanākhyasya jñānasya
viṣayanirdeśo'yamalamiti cet tatsambhāvanamalamarthaviṣayaṃ
cedityarthaḥ | alamarthaśca paryāptirna bhūṣaṇādiḥ, dhātośca
pratyayavidhānātadarthagocarameva sāmarthyaṃ gṛhyate | imaṃ
dhātvarthamanuṣṭhātuṃ samartha ityevaṃ rūpaṃ cet tatsambhāvanamityarthaḥ |
siddhāprayoge kasmin sannidhānādalaṃśabdaḥ | evaṃ tāvatsūtrākṣarāṇāṃ
nirvāhaḥ | vṛtestu---yatkriyāsu yogyatādhyavasānamiti tadiha
sūtre jighṛkṣitasya sambhāvanasya lakṣaṇaṃ na sambhavanamātrasya; anyathā
pratyudāharaṇamanupapannaṃ syāt, na hi tatra śaktiścaddhānaṃ gamyate |
kathaṃ punaratredṛśaṃ sambhāvanaṃ gṛhyata ityatrāha---tadidānīmiti |
tatkhalu sambhāvanametatsūtrapraṇayanakāle'sminsūtra ityarthaḥ | alamarthena
viṣayeṇāviśeṣyate alamiti cet sambhāvanamiti, paryāptimiti |
paryāptimita | piryāptiralamarthaḥ, na bhūṣaṇādirityarthaḥ |
vipariṇāmenānvayaṃ darśayati---taccetsambhāvanamiti |
paryāptiviṣayatvāt paryāptam, avitathaviṣayatvāt avitatham,
etaddhātvarthānuṣṭhāne paryāpto vitathārambho'yamasmin dhātvartha
ityevaṃrūpaṃ cetsambhāvanamityarthaḥ | api parvataṃ śirasābhindyāditi |
evaṃ nāmāyaṃ balavānityarthaḥ, parvataṃ tu bhinatu mā vā bhidat ||
vibhāṣā dhātau sambhāvanavacane'yadi || 3|3|155 ||
sambhāvayāmi bhuñjīta bhavāniti | bhojane bhavāṃścchakta ityutprekṣa
ityarthaḥ ||
hetuhetumatorliṅ || 3|3|156 ||
bhaviṣyati ca kāla iti | iṣyata ityapekṣyate | kathaṃ punaretad dvayaṃ
sūtre'nupātameva labhyate ? ityāha---tatreti | liṅiti vartamāne iti
| ṭhutāpyoḥ' ityādeḥ sūtrāt | hantīti palāyata iti | atra hananaṃ
hetuḥ, palāyanaṃ hetumat | varṣaṇaṃ hetuḥ, saraṇaṃ hetumat |
palāyata iti | ṭhupasargasyāyatau' iti latvam | atra ṭhlakṣaṇahetvoḥ
kriyāyāḥ' iti śatrādeśo'pi na bhavati, ṭhhatiyoge ca sadvidhiḥ' iti
vyavasthitavibhāṣāsu paṭhitatvāt ||
icchārtheṣu liṅloṭau || 3|3|157 ||
kāmapravedana iti vaktavyamiti | ṭhkāmapravedane'kacciti ityayaṃ tarhi
yogaḥ kimarthaḥ, yāvatā kāmo me bhuñjīta bhavān, abhilāṣo me
bhuñjīta bhavānityatrāpyanenaiva siddham ? yatrecchārthamupapadaṃ na
bhavati, arthaprakaraṇādinā tu kāmapravedanaṃ gamyate, tatrāpi liṅ
yathā syāt | idaṃ tarhi kimartham ? lorḍtham, liṅgrahaṇaṃ tu
loṭā bādhā mā bhūditi | evamapi ṭhleṭ ca' iti vaktavye kiṃ
liṅgrahaṇena ? prakṛtaṃ liṅgrahaṇaṃ vibhāṣāsambandham,
atastadanukarṣaṇe vibhāṣāgrahaṇasyāpyanukarṣaṇaṃ sambhāvyeta ||
samānakartṛkeṣu tumun || 3|3|158 ||
tumunprakṛtyapekṣamiti | tumunprakṛtau yaḥ kartā sa cedicchārtheṣvapi
bhavatīti, etacca sānnidhyāllabhyate | icchati bhoktumiti | ātmano
bhojanamicchatītyarthaḥ | ya eveṣeḥ kartā sa eva bhujerapītyastīha
samānakartṛkatvam | icchāyā bhujikriyāṃ prati tādarthyasyāpratīteḥ
ṭhtumunṇvulau' ityādinā tumun na siddhyatītyayamārambhaḥ |
athāpi kathañcitādarthyaṃ syāt, evamapi samānakartṛkeṣviti
vakṣyāmītyāyamārambhaḥ, tena devadatena bhoktumicchati yajñadata iti na
bhavati | icchankarotīti | atrārthe icchankartumiti na bhavatītyarthaḥ |
icchankartuṃ gacchatītyādau ṭhtumunṇvulau' ityādinā tumun | nanu
bhāve tumun vidhīyate, tatkathamicchankarotītyatra kartari prasaṅgaḥ
? evamapīcchatā kriyate ityatra prasaṅgādanabhidhānamevāśrayaṇīyam ||
liṅ ca || 3|3|159 ||
kimarthamidamucyate ? liṅ yathā syāt | siddho'tra liṅ
ṭhicchārtheṣu liṅloṭau' iti ? tasya samānakartṛkeṣu tumun
bādhakaḥ prāptaḥ | vāsarūpavidhiśca ktalyuṭtumunkhalartheṣu
pratiṣiddhastatra yathā loṇna bhavati evaṃ liṅapi nasyāt | athāpi
vāsarūpavidhiḥ syād ? evamapi liṇeóva yathā
syālloṇmābhūdityevamarthametadārabdhavyameva ||
icchārthebhyo vibhāṣā vartamāne || 3|3|160 ||
aśyāditi | ṭhvaśa kāntau' adādiḥ grahivyādinā samprasāraṇam ||
vidhinimantraṇāmantraṇādhīṣṭasaṃpraśnaprārthaneṣu liṅ || 3|3|161 ||
vidhiḥ preraṇamiti | bhṛtyādernikṛṣṭasya
kvacitpravartanamājñāpanamityarthaḥ | niyogato'vaśyambhāvena
yatkaraṇamanuṣṭhānaṃ tannimantraṇam, sa nimantraṇasya viṣaya ityarthaḥ |
avaśyakartavye, śrāddhabhojanādau dauhitrādeḥ pravartaneti yāvat,
śrāddhe hi nimantrito dauhitrādirabhuñjānaḥ pratyavaiti |
kāmacārakaraṇamiti | kāmacāra icchāpravṛttistayā yatkaraṇamanuṣṭhānaṃ
tadāmantraṇam, tadviṣayamāmantraṇamityarthaḥ | yatrānanuṣṭhāne'pi na
pratyavāyastatra pravartaneti yāvat | kalyāṇādau
hyāmantrito'bhuñjāno'pi na pratyavaiti | adhīṣṭamiti |
adhipūrvādicchaternapuṃsake bhāve ktaḥ | puṃlliṅgena pāṭhastvayuktaḥ
| satkārapūrvako vyāpāra iti | gurvāderārīdhyasya
vyāpāraṇetyarthaḥ, ṇyantāderac | idaṃ vā kartavyamidaṃ vā
kartavyamityeva bhūtavicāraṇāsampradhāraṇam | yathedamiha sampradhāryate
iti yācñā prasiddhā |
nyāyavyutpādanārthaṃ ca prapañcārthamathāpi vā |
vidhyādīnāmupadānaṃ caturṇāmapaditaḥ kṛtam ||
asti pravartanārūpamanusyūtaṃ caturṣvapi |
tatraiva liṅ vidhātavyaḥ kiṃ bhedasya vivakṣayā ||
ayaṃ vidhyādiḥ prakṛtyarthaḥ, pratyayārthaḥ, prakṛtyatheviśeṣaṇam,
pratyayārthaviśeṣaṇaṃ veti catvāraḥ pakṣāḥ | tatrādye pakṣe vidhyādiṣu
vatamānāddhātorityarthaḥ syāt, tataśca yatra prakṛtireva
vidhyādīnācaṣṭe tatraiva syāt---vidadhyānnimantrayeta, āmantrayeta,
adhīcchet, saṃpracchet, prārthayeteti; tatrāpi prakṛtyarthā
bhāvakarmakartāraścetyetāvadagamyeta, na prakṛtyarthavyatirekeṇāparaṃ
vidhyādikam | yathā cecchārthebhyaḥ ṭhvibhāṣā vartamāne' ityatra līṅ
icchediti laḍādayaśca na syuḥ; anena liṅa bādhitatvāt | dvitīye
nāprāptepu bhāvakarmakartṛpu vidhyādayo'rthā niddaśyamānāsteṣāṃ
bādhakāḥ syuriti liṅa kartrādīnāmabhidhānaṃ na syāt,
dvivacanabahuvacanānupapatiśca, vidhyādīnāmekatvāt | tṛtīye tu
yatra prakṛtireva vidhyādīnācaṣṭe tatra na
syāt---vidadhyānnimantrayeteti, na hyatra prakṛtyarthādanye
tadviśeṣaṇabhūtā vidhyādayaḥ santi | caturthe tu vidhyādīnāṃ
kartrādīnāṃ ca spaṣṭa eva bheda iti doṣābhāva iti
tamevāśrayati---vidhyādayaścaita iti | vidhyādiviśiṣṭeṣviti |
vidhyādayaḥ pravartanāviśeṣāstairviśiṣṭeṣu pravatiteṣvityarthaḥ |
sampraśnaprārthanayostu sampṛcchayamāne prārthyamāne ca kartari | nanu
ca prakṛtyā yo'rtho nābhidhīyate tatraiva pratyayena bhāvyam, na tu
prakṛtyābhihite; ṭhuktārthānāmaprayogaḥ' iti nyāyāt,
tataścāsminnapi pakṣe vidadhyādityādau tadavastha evāprasaṅgaḥ ? evaṃ
tarhi santyevātra vyatiriktā vidhyādayo viṣayabhedāt, tathā
hi---śrāddhe māṃ nimantrayeta bhavāniti matkarmakaṃ nimantraṇaṃ
tavānuṣṭheyamityarthaḥ, tatra prakṛtyabhihitaṃ nimantraṇaṃ
bhojanaviṣayam, liṅbhihitaṃ tu nimantraṇaviṣayamiti vispaṣṭa eva
nimantraṇabhedaḥ | yathaiṣitumicchatīti
kālasādhanabhedādicchayorbhedāśrayo yogastadvat | evaṃ vidhyādiṣvapi
draṣṭavyam | evaṃ ca kṛtvā prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇapakṣe'pi nātīva doṣaḥ |
āmantraṇe iha bhavān bhuñjīteti | yadīcchatītyarthaḥ | adhyepyāmaha
ityapapāṭho'yam; na hīcchateretadrūpaṃ sambhavati, iṣyatirapi
parasmaipadī, guṇaśca śyani durlabhaḥ; iṅścātrārtho nāsti, sūtre
cādhīṣṭeti iṅ na prayuktaḥ, tasmādadhīcchāma iti pāṭhaḥ | upanayeteti
| ācāryakaraṇa ātmanepadam ||
loṭ ca || 3|3|162 ||
yogavibhāga utarārtha iti | utaratra loṭa evānuvṛttiryathā syālliṅe
mā bhūditi | adhyayai iti | iṭ, utamaikavacanam, ṭeretvam, ṭheta
ai', ṭhāhutamasya picca' ityāḍāgamaḥ, ṭhāṭaśca' iti vṛddhiḥ,
prakṛterguṇāyādeśau ||
praiṣātisargaprāptakāleṣu kṛtyāśca || 3|3|163 ||
kṛtya iti | ṭhvibhāṣā kṛvṛṣoḥ' iti kyap | bhavān hi preṣita
ityādirvākyaśeṣaḥ sarveṣvevodāharaṇeṣu yojyaḥ |
na sāmānyeneti | bhāvakarmaṇorityupalakṣaṇam; bhavyageyādīnāṃ
kartaryapi bhāvāt | evaṃ tarhyetajjñāpayatīti | ṭhpraiṣādiṣveva kṛtyā
bhavanti nānyatra' iti niyamārthaṃ caitanna bhavati, aniṣṭatvāt |
anyatrāpikṛtyādṛśyante---tṛṇenaśoṣyam, budhena bodhyamiti,
agnistokaṃ tṛṇena dīpanīya iti | vastusvarūpakathanametat, na tvatra
praiṣādipratītiḥ | adhikārātpareṇeti | enapā yoge pañcamī mṛgyā |
nāvaśyamiti | kvacidbhavati, kvacinnetyarthaḥ |
ko viśeṣa iti | vidhiḥ preraṇamiti pūrvatra vyākhyātatvāt
nāstyeva bheda iti praśnaḥ | yadyaviśeṣaḥ, kathaṃ dvandvanirdeśa iti cet ?
śabdarūpasyābhidheyatvāt | ṭhko viśeṣaḥ' iti ko'nayoḥ
śabdayoviśeṣo'bhidheya ityarthaḥ | keciditi |
evamāmantraṇātisargayorapi viśeṣo jñeyaḥ | keciditi
vacanādapare'nayorviseṣaṃ necchantītyuktaṃ bhavati | teṣāmapi
praiṣātisargagrahaṇaṃ kartavyameva, tatraiva kṛtyā yathā syuriti |
ṭhprāptakāle ca' iti hyukte nimantraṇādāvapi kṛtyāḥ syuḥ | cakāreṇa
loḍapyanukarṣaṇīyaḥ---prāptakāle yathā syāditi ||
liṅ cordhvamauhūrtike || 3|3|164 ||
cakārādyathāprāptaṃ ceti | loṭ, kṛtyāśca ||
sme loṭ || 3|3|165 ||
liṅkṛtyānāmapavāda iti | anantarasūtreṇa prāptānām |
karotusmeti | smaśabdo'dhikāraṃ sūcayati---bhavānatrādhikṛta
ityarthaḥ ||
adhīṣṭe ca || 3|3|166 ||
aṅga sma rājanniti | aṅgaśabdo'nunaye | brāhmaṇānāmevādhyāpanaṃ
vṛttirato rājannityabhyarhitetyarthaḥ ||
kālasamayavelāsu tumun || 3|3|167 ||
praiṣādigrahaṇaṃ sambaddhyate iti | na ceha praiṣādayo gamyanta iti
bhāvaḥ | iha kasmāditi | kālo bhojanasyeti | tasmādbhuṅktāṃ
bhavāniti vākyārthaḥ, tena gamyate'tra praiṣa iti praśnaḥ |
vāsarūpavidhineti | nanu praiṣādiṣu kṛtyavidhānāt
stryadhikārātpareṇa vāsarūpavidhiranāstīti jñāpitam ?
tatrāha---uktamiti | anityatvameva tatra jñāpitaṃ na sarvathābhāva ityarthaḥ
| paryāyopādānaṃ paryāyāntaravivṛtyartham | anye
tvāhuḥ---avasaro bhoktumityādāvapi tumun dṛśyate, ṭhvyupayoḥ
śeteḥ' ityatra rājānamupaśayituṃ paryāya iti prayuktovṛttikāreṇa |
tasmādarthagrahaṇārthaṃ paryāyopādānam, yathā---ṭhnimitakāraṇahetuṣu'
ityatreti ||
liṅ yadi || 3|3|168 ||
tumuno'pavāda iti | kartṛkarmaṇoḥ sāvakāśo'pi liṅ
pratipadavidherbalīyastvātparatvācca bhāve tumuno bādhaka ityarthaḥ ||
arhe kṛtyatṛcaśca || 3|3|169 ||
arhatītyarha iti | pacādyac | tadyogya iti | tacchabdena dhātvarthaḥ
parāmṛśyate | arhe kartari gamyamāna iti | kvacidvācye,
kvacidgamyamāna ityubhayathānugrahāya gamyamāna ityuktam | kvacid
vācye gamyamāne veti pāṭhaḥ, tatra yathāsambhavamityanvayaḥ | tatra tṛc
ajaryakupyādiṣu, kṛtyāśca vācyatve bhavanti; liṅ bhavyageyādiṣu,
kṛtyāścobhayatra bhavanti | atha kasmāt ṭhkṛtyatṛcau' iti sūtre
kṛtyabhedavivakṣayā bahuvacanam, iha tu sāmānyavivakṣayā dvivacanam
? kvacitu vṛtāvapi bahuvacanameva paṭha|lte | tena bādhā mā bhūditi
| vāsarūpavidhiśca nāvaśyaṃ bhavatītyanantaramevoktam ||
āvaśyakādhamarṇyayorṇiniḥ || 3|3|170 ||
avaśyaṃ bhāva āvaśyakamiti | manojñāditvād vuñ, avyayānāṃ
bhamātre ṭilopaḥ | upādhiriti | pratyayārthaviśeṣaṇamityarthaḥ |
nopapadamiti | ṭhśītoṣṇābhyāṃ kāriṇi', ṭhsenāntalakṣaṇakāribhyasca'
iti nirdeśāt | upapadatve hi kevalāṇṇinirna syāt,
tatsāhacaryādādhamarṇyamapyupādhireva, nopapadam | śataṃ dāyīti |
ṭhakenorbhaviṣyadādhamarṇyayoḥ' iti ṣaṣṭīpratiṣedhād dvitīyaiva
bhavati ||
kṛtyaśca || 3|3|171 ||
bhavyageyādayaḥ kartṛvācakāḥ kṛtyā iti | bhavyageyādiṣvavayatvena
sthitāḥ kṛtyā ityarthaḥ | ādiśabdena na
bhavyageyādisūtranirddiṣṭānāmeva grahaṇam, kiṃ tarhi ?
ajaryarucyakupyakṛṣṭapacyāvyathyāvyathyādīnāmapi grahaṇam |
yogavibhāga utarātheḥ ||
śaki liṅ ca || 3|3|172 ||
prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇamiti | nopapadam, ṭhkṣayyajayyau śakyārthe' iti
liṅgāt, upapadatve hi kevalau kṣayyajayyau śakyārthe na sambhavataḥ |
bhavānkhalu śakta iti vākyaśeṣaḥ sarveṣu yojyaḥ | liṅa bādhā mā
bhūditi | striyāḥ pareṇa vāsarūpavidheranityatvālliṅa bādhāśaṅkā
| ṭhparājesoḍhaḥ' ityatrāsoḍho yo'rthaḥ----soḍhuṃa na śakyata iti |
śakyārthe ktapratyayo vyākhyātaḥ sa ṭhkṛtyalyuṭo bahulam' iti vā,
vāsarūpavidhinā vā samarthanīyaḥ ||
āśiṣi liṅloṭau || 3|3|173 ||
āśīrviśaṣṭa ityāśāsyamāna ityarthaḥ | vidhyādisūtra evāśīrgrahaṇaṃ na
kṛtam, ṭhsme loṭ' ityādiviṣaye'pi paratvādeṣa vidhiryathā
syāditi | avaśyaṃ cotarārthamihāśīrgrahaṇaṃ kartavyam ||
kticktau ca saṃjñāyām || 3|3|174 ||
tantiriti | ṭhanudātopadeśa' ityādinānunāsikalopaḥ prāpanoti,
ṭhanunāsikasya kvijhaloḥ kṅiti' iti dīrghatvaṃ ca, tadubhayamapi na
bhavati; ṭhna ktici dīrghaśca' iti pratiṣedhāt | sātiriti | sanaḥ
ktici ṭhlopaścāsyānyatarasyām' ityātvam |
kticaścakāraścintyaprayojanaḥ; ṭhna ktici dīrghaśca' ityatra
ekānubandhakaparibhāṣayā ktino nivṛteḥ siddhatvāt || 
smotare laṅ ca || 3|3|175 ||
atrotaraśabda ādikyavacano na digvacanaḥ, tena pūrvabhūte'pi
smaśabde bhavati, taddarśitam---smaśabdasahita iti ||
iti śrīharadatamiśraviracitāyāṃ padamañjaryāṃ tṛtīyādhyāyasya tṛtīyaḥ
pādaḥ ||atha tṛtīyādhyāye caturthaḥ pādaḥ
padamañjarī
dhātusambandhe pratyayāḥ || 3|4|1 ||
prayoge svārthābhidhānavyagrayordhātvoḥ paraspareṇa
sambandhābhāvādupacaritavṛttiratra dātuśabda ityāha---dhātvarthe
dhātuśabda iti | dhātvarthānāṃ sambandho dhātusambandha iti |
sambandhasyānekādhiṣṭhānatvāt vṛtāvapi saṃkhyāviśeṣo'vagamyata
iti bhāvaḥ | sakalaviṣayāpekṣayā ca bahuvacanam | ekaikaṃ vivakṣāyāṃ
tu dhātvarthayoḥ sambandha iti draṣṭavyam | yadi tu karmatvaṃ
samānakartṛkatvaṃ ca dhātorarthadvārakaṃ
viśeṣaṇamitivaddhātvorevārthadvārakaḥ sambandha āśrīyeta, iha tu na
syāt---gomānāsīt, gomān bhaviteti, dvayorhi
prayujyamānayoḥ sambandho bhavati, na cātra vartamānakāle'stiḥ
prayujyate | kīdṛśaḥ punarayaṃ dhātusambandhaḥ ?
ityāha---viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāva iti | tatra tiṅntavācyo'rtho viśeṣyaṃ
tatpradhānatvādvākyasya; subantavācyastu viśeṣaṇam, kārakasya kriyāṃ
prati guṇabhāvāt | ayathākāloktā apīti | yasminkāle
vihitāstato'nyatrāpi prayuktā ityarthaḥ | etena kālamātrasyātra bādhaḥ,
na tūpapadopādhiprakṛtipratyayārthānāmiti darśayati | etacca
ṭhvartamānasāmīpye' ityārabhya prāyeṇa kālānyatvapratipādanāllabhyate |
agniṣṭomayājīti bhūtakāla iti | bhūtaḥ kālo yasyeti
bahuvrīhiḥ, etena bhaviṣyatkāla iti vyākhyātam | tatreti |
tayormadhye | bhūtakālo'gniṣṭomayājītyevaśabdo bhaviṣyatkālena
janitetyanena sambaddhyamānaḥ sādhurbhavati | ayamapi bhaviṣyatkālaḥ
sansādhurbhavatītyarthaḥ | atha vā---svayamapi bhaviṣyatkālenā
bhisambaddhyamānaḥ, svakālaparityāgena bhaviṣyatkālaḥ sannityarthaḥ |
ayaṃ hyatrārthaḥ---puttro'sya janitā sa cāgniṣṭomena yaṣṭeti, tatra
yadi bhūtakāla eva ṇiniravatiṣṭhena tadā yāgasya bhaviṣyatāvagamo na
prāpnotītyayamārambhaḥ | evamitarayorapyudāharaṇayordraṣṭavyam | atha
viparyayaḥ kasmānna bhavati, bhaviṣyatkālo
bhūtakālenābhisambaddhyamānaḥ svakālaparityāgena bhūte
sādhurbhavati, tataścāgniṣṭomayājyasya puttro jāta ityayaṃ
vākyārtha iti ? tatrāhauviśeṣaṇaṃ guṇatvāditi | pradhānānuvartā
guṇaḥ, na guṇānuvatiṃ pradhānam, ubhayośca svakālaniṣṭhayoḥ
smbandhānupapatiriti pradhānānurodhena guṇasya kālaparityāga
ityarthaḥ |
pratyayādhikāra iti | yadyapi prakṛtaḥ pratyayaśabdaḥ svarūpapadārthakaḥ,
tathāpīha saṃjñenāmanirdeśātsaṃjñipadārthako vijñāsyata iti bhāvaḥ |
adhātvadhikāravihitā apīti | anyathā prakṛtānāṃ dhātupratyayānāmeva
grahaṇaṃ syāt | pratyayagrahaṇātu sarvaparigrahārthātaddhitānāmapi
kālāntare'pi sādhutvaṃ bhavati | gomānāsīt, gomānbhaviteti |
ṭhtadasyāstyasmin' iti matuppratyayo vartamānasatāviśiṣṭena
prakṛtyarthena viśiṣṭe'rthe vihitaḥ | dhātusambandhe tu prakṛtyarthasya
bhūtabhaviṣyatve'pi sādhurbhavati | tataścāyamatrārthaḥ---gāvo'syāsan
gomānāsīt, gāvo'sya bhavitāraḥ gomān bhaviteti |
dhātvadhikārādeva dhātugrahaṇe siddhe punardhātugrahaṇaṃ
dhātuviśeṣaparigrahārtham, tenāstibhūjanisambandhe
tadviśeṣaṇānāmeva kālānyatvena sādhutvaṃ bhavatīti kecit | na
cāyaṃ pakṣo bhāṣye siddhāntatvena sthāpitaḥ, tasmādaviśeṣeṇa
bhavatītyanye | dṛśyate cānyatrāpi
kālānyatvalam---ṭhsāṭopamurvīmaniśaṃ nadanto ye plāvayiṣyanti
samantato'mī' ityatra | nadanta iti vartamānakālaḥ plāvayiṣyantīti
avartamānenābhisambaddhyamāno bhaviṣyatkālaḥ sampadyate |
sūtrapratyakhyānaṃ tu---agniṣṭomayājīti bhūta eva ṇiniḥ,
janitetyetatsambandhātu kevalaṃ vyapadeśasya bhāvitvapratītiḥ, asya
sūtrasya śāṭakaṃ vayetivat | tataśca
bhāvivyapadeśavijñānādviśeṣaṇasya kālānyatvaṃ vākyārthavaśādasatyapi
sūtrārambhe pratyeṣyate | avaśyaṃ ca svakāla eva pratyayavidhireṣṭavyaḥ,
anyathā bhāvikṛtyamāsīdityatra bhāviśabdasya bhūtakālatve
bhāvyāsīcchabdayoḥ paryāyatvādyaugapatprayogo na syāt |
tasmādidānīmāsīdityevaṃ tatrārthaḥ | gomānāsīdityatrāpi
devadatasya vidhamānatve'pi gomadrūpasyātītatvād bhūtapratyayaḥ |
tatrārthād gavāmapyatītatvaṃ pratīyate, gomacchabdastu svamahimnā
vartamānasatāviśiṣṭameva prakṛtyarthamāha ||
kriyāsamabhihāre loṭ loṭo hisvau vā ca tadhvamoḥ || 3|4|2 ||
dhātusambandha iti vartata iti | anuprayogadhātunā ca sambandhaḥ |
kvacitvayaṃ grantho na paṭha|lte | prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇaṃ caitaditi |
upapadatvāśaṅkāṃ nirasyati | vyākhyānāccopapadatvābhāvaḥ |
samabhihāraviśaṣṭakriyāvacanāditi | kriyādharme samabhihāramātre
dhātorvṛtyasambhavādetaduktam | atra yadi ṭhloṭo hisvau' iti
vacanātasyaiva hisvau syātām, tadā sāmānyavihitānāṃ tiṅaṃ
śatṛśānaubhyāmiva hisvābhyāṃ bādhā syāt,
tatastadhvamorloṭsthānikayorabhāvāt ṭhvā ca tadhvamoḥ' iti
tayoḥ sthānitvenopādānamanupapannamiti loṭśabdena
tadādeśānāṃ grahaṇamityupalakṣyate | astu tathā, ko doṣaḥ ? iha hi
tipsipmipāṃ sthāne vihitasya heḥ sthānivadbhāvena
pitvānṅtvābhāvāllunīihitītvaṃ na syāt, brūhīti ṭhbruva īṭ'
syāt, tṛṇḍhaiiti ṭhtṛṇaha im' syāt, anudātatvaṃ ca heḥ
prasajyeta ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; ṭhserhyapicca' ityatra yogavibhāgaḥ kariṣyate,
tatsāmarthyād ṭhanantarasya vidhirvā bhavati pratiṣedho vā' iti
nāśrīyate, serhirbhavati apicca bhavati yāvānkaściddhirnāmeti | yau
tarhyutamādeśau hisvau, taroyarāḍāgamaḥ
prāpnoti---lunīhilunīhītyevāhaṃ lunāmi,
adhīṣvādhīdhvetyevāhamadhīya iti ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; āṭi kṛte
sāṭkasyādeśau bhaviṣyataḥ, sakṛtpravṛtyā lakṣaṇasya caritārthatvāt
| hisvayoḥ punarāṭ na bhaviṣyati, iha hyāṭ kriyātāṃ hisvāviti
sampradhāraṇāyāmubhayoranityayoḥ ṭhśabdāntarasya
prāpnuvanvidhiranityo bhavati' iti paratvādāṭi kṛte sāṭkasya
hisvāviti siddhamiṣṭam | evamapi heryogavibhāgena pitvābhāve'pi
svaśabdasyotamādeśasya pitvādbhuṅkṣvabhuṅkṣvetyevāhaṃ bhuñje
ityatra ṭhśnasorallopaḥ' ityakāralopo na prāpnoti,
brūṣvabrūpvetyevāhaṃ bruve ṭhbruva īṭ' prāpnoti, sarveṣāṃ ca
tiṅaṃ dvāvapi hisvau paryāyeṇa syātāṃ na tu ṭhparasmaipadānāṃ
hiḥ, itareṣāaṃ svaḥ' iti niyāmakamasti | tasmādduṣṭa evāyaṃ pakṣa
iti matvā lakārasyaivādeśau hisvāvāśrayaṇīyāviti darśayati | tasya
ca loṭa iti | nanvasminpakṣe ṭhvā ca tadhvamoḥ' ityanupapannamityuktaṃ
tatrāha---tadhvambhāvinastu vā bhavati iti | mukhyārthāsambhave
tadhvambhāvī loḍeva tathocyate ityarthaḥ |
yadi tarhi loṭa eva hisvāvādeśau na tadādeśānām, ṭhlaḥ
parasmaipadam' iti dvayorapi parasmaipadasaṃjñā syāt, tataśca dvāvapi
parasmaipadibhya eva syātām | tiṅkṣvasanniveśācca tadantasya
tiṅntatā na syāt, tataśca ṭhtiṅṅatiṅaḥ' iti nighāto na
prāpnoti | hisvayośca kṛtvātadantasya śatṛśānajantasyaiva
prātipadikatvātsvādyautpatiḥ prāpnoti, tatra ca
vibhaktisaṃjñakahisvasadṛśatvādanayorhisvayoḥ
ṭhvibhaktisvarapratirūpakāśca nipātāḥ' ṭhnipāto'vyayam'
ityavyayasaṃjñāyāṃ yadyapi vibhaktīnāṃ śravaṇaṃ na bhavati, tathāpi tataḥ
parasya ṭhtiṅṅtiṅ' iti nighātaḥ prāpnoti, dvāvapi ca kartaryeva
syātām, na tu svādeśo bhāvakarmakartṛṣu syāt | tasmādayamapi
pakṣo duṣṭa eva, tatrāha---loḍityeveti | etena dvitīyayoge
prathamāntasya loḍgrahaṇasyānuvṛtti darśayati | tatra ca
sāmānādhikaraṇyena loḍityanena hisvau viśeṣyete, na ṣaṣṭha|la
vipariṇāmena, ca na hisvau loṭau bhavataḥ; ucyate cedaṃ loṭo
hisvāviti, tataśca dharmātideśo vijñāyate,
tadāha---loḍdharmāṇau tau bhavata ityartha iti | atra ca loṭśabdena
loṭsaṃbandhinau hisvāvucyete mukhyaloṭsaṃbandhino
dharmasyātideśyasyāsambhavātprasiddhau loṭsaṃbandhinau yau
hisvau, ṭhserhyapicca' ṭhsavābhyāṃ vāmau' iti vihitau,
taddharmāṇāvityarthaḥ | kiṃ siddhaṃ bhavati ? taddarśayati---teneti |
tayohi parasmaipadātmanepadatvaṃ bhedena vyavasthitam---heḥ
parasmaipadatvam, svasyātmanepadatvamiti | atastaddharmātideśādihāpi
tadubhayaṃ bhedena, vyavatiṣṭhate, bhedena bhaviṣyatītyarthaḥ | tiṅtvaṃ
ca bhavatīti | tathā ca---hītyasya kartā vācyaḥ, svaśabdasya tu
bhāvakarmakartāraḥ | puruṣaikavacanasaṃjñe tu vidhānasāmarthyānna bhavataḥ,
yadi hi te api syātām, hisvayoranena vidhānamanupapannaṃ syād;
vacanāntareṇaiva tayostādṛśayoḥ siddhatvāt |
lunīhi lunīhītyādi | punaḥ punarlavanamayaṃ karotītyādirarthaḥ |
tatra ca loḍantaṃ punaḥ punarlavanamāha, anuprayogadhātustu kṛtiṃ
tadviṣayāṃ vadan abhivyanakti, saṃmugdha tadgataṃ sādhanādikam | evaṃ
ca sāmānyaviśeṣayorviśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvād dhātusambandha upapadyate,
ityevaśabdau, loḍantānuprayogayoḥ sambandhārthau, ayantvamahaṃśabdāḥ
puruṣaviśeṣābhivyaktihetavaḥ | atha veti | ṭhvā ca tadhvamoḥ' ityasya
phalaṃ darśayati |
alāvīditi | luṅ, sici vṛddhiḥ, sica iṭ, tipaḥ
ṭhastisico'pṛkte' itīṭ, ṭhiṭa īṭi' iti sico lopaḥ, ṭhsijlopa
ekādeśe siddho vaktavyaḥ' iti savarṇadīrghatvam | evaṃ
madhyamotamayorudāhāryamiti | lunīhi tunīhītyeva tvamalāvīḥ
alāviṣṭamalāviṣṭa | athā vā lunīta lunītetyeva yūyamalāviṣṭa |
lunīhi lunīhītyevāhamalaviṣam alāviṣva alāviṣma | evaṃ
madhyamotamayorapīti | lunīhi lunīhītyeva tvaṃ laviṣyasi
laviṣyathaḥ laviṣyatha | atha vā lunīta lunītetyeva yūyaṃ laviṣyatha |
lunīhi lunīhītyevāhaṃ laviṣyāmi laviṣyāvaḥ laviṣyāmaḥ | evaṃ
sarveṣu lakāreṣūdāhāryamiti | lunīhilunīhītyevāyamalunāt
lunātu lunīyāt lūyāt lulāva lavitā laviṣyati alaviṣyat;
adhīṣvādhīṣvetyevāyamadhyaita adhītām adhīyīta adhyeṣīṣṭa adhijage
adhyagīṣṭa adhyaiṣṭa adhyetā adhyaiṣyata adhyeṣyate | karmaṇi---lūyasva
lūyasvetyevāyaṃ kedāro lūyata ityādi | bhāve tu prasiddhaḥ
svaśabdo dṛṣṭo na veti cintyam |
athodāharaṇeṣu kathaṃ dvirvacanam, yāvatā kriyāsamabhihāraṃ
dyotayituṃ dvirvacanaṃ vidhīyate, sa cātra tasminneva vidhīyamānena
loṭaiva dyotitaḥ, atha dyotite'pi tasmin ṭhkriyāsamabhihāre dve
bhavataḥ' iti vacanasāmarthyādatra dvirvacanaṃ yaṅnte'pi prāpnoti,
vaktavyo vā viśeṣaḥ ? tatrāha---kriyāsamabhihārābhivyaktāviti | ṭhlaḥ
karmaṇi ca' iti vacanādbhāvakarmakartāro'sya vācyāḥ, samabhihārastu
dvirvacanenaiva dyotyaḥ, yaṅstu na kiñcidanyadvācyaṃ dyotyaṃ vā vidyate
iti tenaiva kriyāsamabhihārasya dyotitatvād dvirvacanābhāvaḥ | nanu
ca santu bhāvakarmakartāro'sya vācyāḥ, samabhihāro'pyupādhitvena
śrutaḥ, so'pi loṭo dyotyo bhavatu, yathā---laḍādiṣu
vartamānādayaḥ ? evaṃ tarhyasati dvirvacane śuddhasya loṭo'sya ca
sādhāraṇaṃ rūpamiti samabhihārābhivyaktaye'vaśyaṃ dvirvacanamapekṣyate |
śabdaśaktivaicitryaṃ cātra hetuḥ, yathā strītvaṃ kvacidekenaiva pratyayena
dyotyate, kvacid dvābhyām, kvacit dṛṣadityādo
prātipadikenaivetyalaṃ prabandhena ||
samuccaye'nyatarasyām || 3|4|3 ||
ṭhsamuccaye' iti samānyoktāvapi kriyāsamuccaya eva dṛśyate, dhātoḥ
pratyayavidhānādityāha---anekākrayādhyāhāraḥ samuccaya iti |
anekāsāṃ kriyāṇāmekasmin sambandhini nicīyamānatetyarthaḥ |
etenaikakriyāviṣayātsamabhihārātsamuccayasya bhedo darśitaḥ | dhātoḥ
kriyāvācitvātkriyādharme samuccayamātre vṛttirna
bhavatītyabhiprāyeṇāha---samuccīyamānakriyāvacanāditi |
ekasminsādhane yāḥ kriyāḥ samuccīyante tadvācibhyo dhātubhyaḥ pratya
ityarthaḥ |
bhrāṣṭramaṭetyādi | bhrāṣṭrāṭanādīni karotītyarthaḥ |
tatrānuprayujyamāno dhātuḥ sādhanabhedena bhinneṣvaṭaneṣvanuvartamānaṃ
kṛtivyāpāraṃ vadÄastadgatāni sādhanādīni prikāśayatīti
parasparasambandhaḥ | bhrāṣṭramuculli, khasya dūraṃ khadūramuapavarakam,
sthālyaḥ prakṣālitā yatra nidhāya pidhīyante tatsthālyapidhānam |
atha veti | prathamenāthavāśabdena ṭhvā ca tadhvamoḥ' ityasya vyāpāraṃ
darśayati, dvitīyenānyatarasyāṅgrahaṇasya | evaṃ dvitīye'pyudāharaṇe
draṣṭavyam ||
yathāvidhyanuprayogaḥ pūrvasmin || 3|4|4 ||
yathāvidhīti | padārthanativṛtau ṭhyathārthe yadavyayam' ityavyayībhāvaḥ,
anuprayoga ityanuśabdo dhātvarthānuvādī, na
paścādbhāvenānantarye'rthe | tena pūrvavyavahitaprayogo'pi bhavati |
pūrvasminniti vacanaṃ vispaṣṭārtham | samuccaye hi
sāmānyavacanasyānuprayogaṃ vakṣyati, tena tato'nyatrāyaṃ vidhiranyaśca
viṣayaḥ pūrvameva loḍvidhānam | dhātusambandhe
pratyayavidhānāditi | nanu ca hisvāntametadanabhivyaktapadārthakam,
sakhyākālapuruṣāṇāmanabhivyaktatvāt,
atastadarthābhivyaktyarthabhevānuprayogaḥ siddhaḥ ? astvevam,
kimetāvatā vṛttikārokto heturna bhavati | atha vā
yāvantamarthamabhivyaṅktuaṃ hisvāntaṃ samarthaṃ tāvato
vivakṣāyāmanuprayogāsiddhi matvaivamuktam | yathāvidhyartha vacanamiti
| nanu ca ṭhsamuccaye sāmānyavacanasya' iti vakṣyati, tatra niyamo
vijñāsyate---samuccaya eva dhātvantarasyānuprayoga iti, tataśca
kriyāsamabhihāre yathāvidhyanuyogo bhaviṣyati ? evaṃ
manyate---samuccaye sāmānyavacanasyaivānuprayoga iti niyamādanyatra
dhātvantarasyāpi syāditi cchinatīti nānuprayujyata iti |
pacatītyādebhinnārthasya tvaprasaṅgaḥ, loḍantenānanvayāt |
samānārthasya tu sambhavati sambandhaḥ, yathā--tasyaiva | evaṃ
sāmānyavacanasya karotyāderapyanuprayogaprasaṅgaḥ, tasyāpi hi
sannihetaloḍantavācye viśeṣe paryavasānātsambhavatyevānvayaḥ | nanu
caikasyā ākṛteścaritaḥ prayogo na dvitīyasyāstṛtīyasyāśca bhavati,
etacca ṭhkṛñjānuprayujyate' ityatra vyākhyātam, tatra yathā gavāṃ svāmī
aśveṣu ceti na bhavati, tathehāpi yenaiva dhātunā loṭprayogaḥ
prārabdhastenaivāsau samāpayiṣyate ? na; asyāpi nyāyasya vede loke
ca vyabhicārāt | vede tāvat---indrāya rājñe sūkara iti
caturthoprayogaprakaraṇe kṣipraśyenasya vartikā te dhāturiti ṣaṣṭhī,
mayuḥ prājāpatya iti taddhitaśca devatāsambandhe dṛśyate |
loke'pi---sasnuḥ, payaḥ papuriti liṭā sahānenijuriti laṅ
prayuktaḥ | tasmādārabhyamevaitat ||
samuccaye sāmānyavacanasya || 3|4|5 ||
nanu ca hisvāntasyānabhivyaktapadārthakatvāddhātusambandhe
pratyayavidhānāccānuprayogaḥ siddhaḥ, nārtha etena ?
tatrāha---sarvaviśeṣeti | asatyasminyato dhātorloḍvihitaḥ sa
tasyānuprayujyeta | evamapi hisvāntārthasyābhivyaktirbhavatyeva
dhātusambandhaścopapadyate |
nanu ca sarveṣu viśeṣeṣu yadanugataṃ sāmaptnyaṃ
tadvācino'nuprayoge'pi tasya sāmānyasya sannihiteṣu viśeṣeṣu
paryavasānādarthābhivyaktiśca sarveṣāṃ bhavati, dhātusambandhaśca | tatra
sāmānyavacanasyaikasyānuprayogo'stu, bahūnāṃ viśeṣavācināṃ
veti sampradhāraṇāyāmekasyaiva bhaviṣyati, laghutvātatrāha---lāghavaṃ
ceti | anyathā tarudrumādīnāmeva prayogaḥ syāt, na
vanaspatyādiśabdānāmiti bhāvaḥ | nanu bhrāṣṭramaṭetyādau
tasyaivānuprayogātkathaṃ sāmānyavacanatā ? tatrāha---bhrāṣṭramaṭetyādi
| kārakabhedāt kriyābhede satīti | bhedanibandhanaḥ
samuccayo'pyevamevātropapādyaḥ ||
cchandasi luṅlaṅliṭaḥ || 3|4|6 ||
udāharaṇeṣu dhātusambandho mṛgyaḥ | akaraditi |
ṭhkṛmṛdṝuhibhyaścchandasi' iti cleraṅadeśaḥ, ṭhṛdṛśo'ṅ guṇiḥ' ||
lirṅthe leṭ || 3|4|7 ||
joṣiṣaditi | ṭhjuṣī prītisevanayoḥ' anudātet, vyatyayena
parasmaipadam, ṭhitaśca lopaḥ parasmaipadeṣu', ṭhleṭo'ḍāṭau' iti
tipo'ḍāgamaḥ, ṭhsibbahulaṃ leṭi' iti sip, iḍāgamaḥ |
tāriṣaditi | sibvidhau bahulaṃ ṇidvadbhāva uktaḥ, tato vṛddhiḥ |
patātīti | ṭhpatlṛ gatau', tipa āḍāgamaḥ ||
upasaṃvādāśaṅkayośca || 3|4|8 || 
yadi me bhavānityādinopasaṃvādasya svarūpaṃ darśayati | kāraṇata
ityādinā | śaṅkāyāḥ anusaraṇamanugamanamityarthaḥ | ahamevetyādi |
tripuravijaye devaiḥ prarthitasya devasyaitadvacanam | ṭhīśa aiśvarye',
utamaikavacanamiṭ, ṭeretvam, ṭhvaitonyatra' ityaikāraḥ | paśavo
dvipādaścatuṣpādaśca | ṭhvāyuṃ devā abruvansomaṃ rājānaṃ hanāmeti,
so'bravīdūraṃ vṛṇai, madagrā eva vo grahā gṛhāyāntai iti |
madgraho'graṃ prathamaṃ yeṣāṃ te tathoktāḥ, graheḥ karmaṇyātmanepadaṃ
yak, grahijyādinā samprasāraṇam, jhasyāḍāgamaḥ, pūrvavadaityam |
ṭhdevāḥ somamaghnan, so'pūyadaśakyatāmāgamat, te
vāyumabruvan imaṃ naḥ svadayeti, so'bravīdvaraṃ vṛṇai,
maddevatānyeva vaḥ pātrāṇyucyāntai iti | ahaṃ devatā yeṣāṃ tāni
tathoktāni | ucyāntai iti vaceḥ ṭhvacisvapi' ityādinā samprasāraṇam,
śeṣaṃ pūrvavat | nejjihyāyanta iti | icchabda āśaṅkāṃ dyotayati |
jihmacaraṇena narakapātaḥ sambhāvyate, sa mā bhūdityarthaḥ |
jihmamukuṭilaṃ pāpam, ṭhcchandasi parecchāyām' iti kyac,
ṭhaśvāghasyāt' iti yogavibhāgonātvam | vṛtau tu vastumātraṃ
darśitam | jihmācaraṇeneti | na punarācāre upamānādanyatra
kyajasti | hetau śatṛpratyayaḥ | lirṅtha evāyamiti |
hetuhetumadbhāve, katham ? upasaṃvāde tāvatkaraṇaṃ hetuḥ, dānaṃ
hetumat; anyathā yadi me bhavānidaṃ kuryāditi liṅ na syāt,
vibhāṣā tu liṅiti | ahamapi te idaṃ dāsyāmīti lṛṭ | bhāṣye tu
dadāterapi liṅ prayuktaḥ | āśaṅkāpi kāraṇataḥ kāryānusaraṇam,
tatra kāraṇaṃ hetuḥ, kāryaṃ hetumat | athāpi karaṇamavadhiḥ,
dānamavadhimadityavadhyavadhimadbhāva upasaṃvāde pratīyate, na
hetuhetumadbhāvaḥ, āśaṅkāyāmapi niścito
hetuhetumadbhāvo nāstītyucyeta, tathāpi
liṅprayogasiddhaye'vaśyaṃ vaktavyo'tra hetuhetumadbhāvaḥ, ato
lirṅtha evāyamityarthaḥ | nityārthaṃ tu vacanamiti | cchandasi nityo'tra
liṅ dṛśyata iti manyate, tathāpi vyavasthitavibhāṣayā siddhamiti
cetadeva tarhi vacanena jñāpyate ||
tumarthe
sesenaseasenksekasenadhyaiadhyainkadhyaikadhyainśadhyaiśadhyaintavaitaveṅ tavenaḥ || 3|4|9 ||
kathaṃ jñāyata iti | ṭhkartari kṛt' iti vacanāt bhāvastumartho
nopapadyata iti praśnaḥ | apakarṣaḥuapanayaḥ, svārthaśca dhātūnāṃ bhāva iti
sādhyamānarūpaḥ | sa eva hi dhātuvācyo bhāvaḥ | ghañādivācyastu
bhāvo dhātvarthavyatiriktaḥ siddhatārūpaḥ | pibadhyai iti | ṭhyako bahulaṃ
cchandasi' iti luki pibādeśaḥ | mādayardhyai iti | yakaḥ prasaṅge
vyatyayena śap || 
dṛśe vikhye ca || 3|4|11 ||
yogavibhāgaścintyaprayojanaḥ ||
īśvare tosunkasunau || 3|4|13 ||
vitṛda iti | ṭhotṛdir hiṃsānādarayoḥ' ||
kṛtyārthe tavaikenkenyatvanaḥ || 3|4|14 ||
kṛtyānāmartho bhākarmaṃṇī iti | yadyapi bhavyageyādiṣu kartāpyarthaḥ,
vahyaṃ karaṇam, snānīyaṃ cūrṇityādiṣu karaṇādayaḥ; tathāpi na tatra
kṛtyatvena kartrādiṣu vidhānam, kiṃ tarhi ? svarūpeṇa, ataḥ kṛtyatayā
vidhānaṃ bhāvakarmaṇoreveti bhāvaḥ | didṛkṣeṇya iti | dṛśeḥ
sannantātkenyaḥ | śuśrūṣeṇya iti | śrṛṇoteḥ | sayādisūtre'pīti |
yena sayādayo vidhīyante tatra ṭhtumarthe sesenase' ityatretyartaḥ |
tasya tumarthādanyatreti | anyathā'nenaiva tumarthe bhāve'pi
siddhatvādanarthakaṃ tatsyāt ||
avacakṣe ca || 3|4|15 ||
eśpratyaya iti | śitkaraṇaṃ sārvadhātukatvārtham, tena cakṣiṅḥ
khyāñ na bhavati ||
bhāvalakṣaṇe stheṇkṛñvadicarihutamijanibhyastosun || 3|4|16 ||
saṃsthānādīnāmavadhitvena lakṣaṇabhāvaḥ | ā samāpteriti | sampūrvo
hi tiṣṭhatiḥ samāptau rūḍhaḥ; santiṣṭhate piṇḍapitṛyajña ityādau
darśanāt | ātāmitoriti | ṭhtamu glānau' ||
alaṃkhalvāḥ pratiṣedhayoḥ prācāṃ ktvā || 3|4|18 ||
ṭhtumarthe' ityeva | alaṃkṛtveti | ṭhamaivāvyayena' iti
niyamādupapadasamāsābhāvaḥ | na kartavyamityarthaḥ |
vāsarūpa iti cediti | pūrvaṃ tu praiṣādiṣu kṛtyānāṃ vacanena
ṭhstryadhikārādhūrdhvaṃ vāsarūpavidhirnāvaśyamasti' iti jñāpitatvādiha
tadabhāvamabhipretya prāggrahaṇaṃ vikalpārthamityuktam ||
udīcāṃ māṅe vyatīhāre || 3|4|19 ||
apamityeti | ṭhmeṅ prāṇidāne' ktvo lyapi
ṭhgayateridanyatarasyām' itītvaṃ, hrasvasya tuk | apūrvakālatvāditi
| pūrva hyasau yācate paścādapamayate | yadā cāsmādvacanānmayateḥ
ktvo bhavati tadā ṭhsamānakartṛkayoḥ' ityādinā yācane bhavati,
anena bādhitatvāt, yathā---dvitīyadvirvacanena prathamadvirvacanam |
anabhidhānādvā | meṅ ityādi | meṅe'yaṃ kṛtātvasya nirdeśaḥ kṛtaḥ,
na punaḥ ṭhmāṅ māne' ityasya, tasya vyatihāre vṛtyasambhavādityarthaḥ
| yadyevama , meṅ ityeva vaktavyam, tatrāyamapyartho vyatīhāragrahaṇaṃ na
kartavyaṃ bhavati, tatrāha---jñāpanārthamiti | kiṃ jñāpyata
ityāha---nānubandhakṛtamiti | prayojanamāha---teneti | yadyayamartho na
jñāpyeta, tataḥ śrūyamāṇe pakāre daipa ātvaṃ na syāt;
anejantatvāt, tataścādābiti pratiṣedhe tasya grahaṇaṃ na syāt,
ṭhdāp lavane' ityasyaiva tu syāt ||
parāvarayoge ca || 3|4|20 ||
parāvaraśabdayoḥ sambandhiśabdatvādyapadekṣaṃ parāvaratvam, tayoḥ
pūrvaparayoreva parāvarābhyāṃ yogo gamyate, ityāha---pareṇa
pūrvasyeti | pūrvaśabdenātrāvaro vivakṣitaḥ | aprāpya nadīmiti |
nadyāḥ pūrvadeśa ityarthaḥ | tataśca nadī parā bhavatīti |
paranadīyogena parvato viśeṣyati | atikramya parvatamiti |
parvatasya parastādityarthaḥ | tataścāvaraḥ parvato bhavati
tenāvaraparvatayogena nadī viśeṣyate | ayamapyapūrvakālārtha
ārambhaḥ, atikramo'tra kīdṛśa iti cintyam ||
samānakartṛkayoḥ pūrvakāle || 3|4|21 ||
kriyāpekṣatvātkartṛbhāvasya dhātvadhikāre'pi tadarthasyaiva
samānarktṛkatvaṃ vijñāyate, na dhātorityāha---samānaḥ kartā
yayordhātvarthayoriti | kamānaśabdo'yamekavācī, tatreti
nirddhāraṇe saptamīṃ darśayati | ṣaṣṭha|lamapi na doṣaḥ | saptamī
tvāśritā | pūrvakāle dhātvarthe vartamānāditi | prābhākarāstu
pūrvaprayujyamānāditi vyācakṣate, anuṣṭhāne paurvakālyaṃ
nādriyante; tadbhāṣyavārtikavirodhādupekṣyam | uktaṃ hi---āsyaṃ
vyādāya svapiti saṃmīlya hasatītyupasaṃkhyānamapūrvakālatvāditi |
nanu ca śaktiḥ kārakam, sā ca pratikriyaṃ bhidyate, tatkutaḥ
samānakartṛkatvam ? ityata āha---śaktiśaktimatoriti | iha
samānakartṛkayoriti dvivacananirdeśaḥ kriyate, tena dvayoreva
paurvakālye syāt, bahūnāṃna syāt, tatrāha---dvivacanamatantramiti
| avaśyaṃ yena kenacidvavacanena nirdeśaḥ kartavyaḥ, tatra
samānakartṛkatvasya pūrvakālatvasya ca
bhedādhiṣṭhānatvādbhedanibandhanayorvdivacanabahuvacanayoḥ
prathamabhāvitvād dvivacanaṃ prayuktam, na tvaitatantramityarthaḥ | evamapi
lokavijñānānna siddhyati, tadyathā loke---amīṣāṃ brāhmaṇāanāṃ pūrva
ānīyatām ityukte sarvapūrva evānīyate, evamihāpi sarvapūrvāyāḥ
kriyāyāḥ prāpnoti, tasmādevaṃ vaktavyam---sarveṣāmevātra vraji prati
paurvakālyam, snātvā vrajati bhuktvā vrajati pītvā vrajatīti |
ākhyātavācyā hi kriyā viśeṣyatkātpradhānam, tena tāṃ prati
sarvāsāṃ viśeṣaṇatvātparaspareṇāsambandhaḥ, taduktam---ṭhguṇānāṃ ca
parārthatvādasambandhaḥ samatvātsyāt' iti | evaṃ ca kṛtvā
prayogo'pyaniyato bhavati---snātvā bhuktvā pītvā vrajati, pītvā
snātvā bhuktvā vrajatīti |
bhuktavati brāhmaṇa iti | nanu tumarthādhikārādbhāve ktvāpratyayaḥ,
ktavatustu kartari ? evaṃ tarhyasminviṣaye bhāve na bhavatīti
pratyudāharaṇatvaṃ vācyam, ṭhśrīśailaśikharaṃ dṛṣṭvā sarvapāpaiḥ
pramucyate' ityevamādīnāṃ kartṛbhedaviṣayāṇāṃ
prayogāṇāmasādhutvameva | vrajati jalpati ceti | yaugapadyādiha
pūrvakālatā nāsti | apūrvakālatvādi | pūrvaṃ hyasau svapiti
paścādvyādadāti, yadaiva hasati tadaiva saṃmīlayati, na vā
svapnasyāparakālatvāt, asyaṃ tvasau vyādāya muhūrtamapi svapiti
saṃmīlya ca hasati, tataścotarakālabhāvistvāpahāsādyapekṣaṃ
paurvakālyaṃ tadāśrayaśca pratyayaḥ | iha kasmānna bhavati---pūrvaṃ
bhuṅkte, tato vrajatīti ? svaśabdenoktatvāt | ṭhvibhāṣāgre'
ityanenāpi na bhavati, kiṃ kāraṇam ?
sādhanapaurvākālyaviṣayāṇāmagryādīnāṃ tatra grahaṇam, anyebhyo
bhoktṛbhyaḥ pūrvaṃ bhuktvā tato vrajatīti | iha tu vrajyapekṣaṃ bhojanasya
yatpaurvakālyaṃ tatra ktvāpratyayaścodyate, tatpūrvaśabdenoktam | na ca
vacanasāmarthyādukte'pi prasaṅgaḥ;
sādhanapaurvakālyaviṣaye'gryādāvupapade caritāthetvāt |
kriyāviṣayatvācca kālavyavahārasya taddvārakameva
sādhanapaurvakālyaṃ draṣṭavyam | uktaṃ hi---
kriyābhedāya kālastu saṃkhyā sarvasya bhedikā | iti |
ihāsyate bhoktumiti vāsarūpeṇa laḍ bhavati, yadā āseḥ ktvā
bhavati tadā bhujerlaḍādaya eva bhavanti---āsitvā bhuṅkta iti, na tu
tumun ; anabhidhānāt | āsitvā bhoktumityukte prakramata
ityādīnāṃ sambandhaḥ pratīyate ||
ābhīkṣṇye ṇamul ca || 3|4|22 ||
dvirvacanasahitāviti | kena punaratra dvirvacanamityāha---ābhīkṣṇaye
dve bhavata ityupasaṅkhyānād dvirvacanamiti | ṭhnityavīpsayoḥ'
ityatra tu vāmano vakṣyati---ṭhtiṅkṣu nityatā avyayakṛtsu ca' iti |
tanmate nityagrahaṇādevātra dvirvacanam | pāyaṃpāyamiti | ṭhāto
yuk' ||
na yadyanākāṅkṣe || 3|4|23 ||
anākāṅkṣa iti | pacādyajantena nañsamāsaḥ, taddarśitam | nāparaṃ
kiñcidākāṅkṣate iti | ktvā tu pūrvasūtravihito'pīti |
ṇamul cetyuktam, tadapekṣaṃ
pūrvatvamapiśabdādanantarasūtravihito'pi ābhīkṣṇyenābhīkṣṇye ca
ktvāmātrasya pratiṣedha ityarthaḥ | etacca pūrvakāle yatprāpnoti tanna
bhavatītyevaṃ prakaraṇāpekṣayā pratiṣedhavijñānāllabhyate ||
vibhāṣāgreprathamapūrveṣu || 3|4|24 ||
agraśabdo deśaviśeṣavacano'pyasti---prabhoragre bhuṅkte iti, iha tu
prathamaśabdasāhacaryātkālaviśeṣavācino grahaṇam |
anukaraṇatvāccāgre iti vibhakterlugabhāvaḥ---asyavāmīyamiti yathā |
āmīkṣṇya iti nānuvartata iti | aprāptavibhāṣeyamityatreyaṃyuktiḥ |
tadanuvṛtau hi pūrvasūtreṇa prāpte vibhāṣā syād, evaṃ ca bruvatā
sādhanaporvakālyaviṣayā agryādaya ityuktaṃ bhavati | kriyāpaurvakālye
hi agryādibhireva tasyoktatvādābhīkṣṇye'pi
ktvāṇamuloraprāptiriti ṭhābhīkṣṇye'
ityanuvṛtāvapyaprāptavibhāṣaiva syāt | na ca
dvirvacanamantareṇābhīkṣṇyaṃ dyotayituṃ śakyamiti na
taddyotanāyāpi ktvāṇamulorvidhānamupapadyate |
nanvananuvartamāne'pyābhīkṣṇyagrahaṇe pūrvasūtrasyāvakāśo
yatrāgryādayo na santi, asya tu yatrābhīkṣṇyaṃ nāsti so'vakāśaḥ;
ābhīkṣṇye cāgryādiṣu ca satsūbhayaprasaṅge paratvādiyameva
vibhāṣā prāpnotītyubhayatra vibhāṣeyaṃ yuktā ? evaṃ
manyate---pūrvavipratiṣedhenābhīkṣṇye nitya eva
vidhirbhavatīti---agrebhojaṃbhojaṃ vrajati, agrebhuktvābhuktvā vrajati |
evaṃ pūrvaprathamayorapi draṣṭavyam | nanvevaṃ ṇamulyaprāpte
ktvāpratyaye tu ṭhsamānakartṛkayoḥ' ityādinā prāpte satyayamārambha
iti punarapyubhayatravibhāṣaiva yuktā ? naitadasti; saha vihitau yau
ktvāṇamulau yadviṣaye vāsarūpavidherabhāvo jñāpayitumiṣṭaḥ,
tāvanantarasūtravihitau
ktvāṇamulāvabhipretyāprāptavibhāṣeyamucyate, na tu
ktvāṇamulmātrapekṣayā | ktvāṇamulau pratyayau bhavata iti | kimarthaṃ
punaḥ ktvā vidhīyate, yāvatā nābhīkṣmye'pi
samānakartṛkayorityevāsau siddhaḥ ? satyam ; vibhāṣāgrahaṇena
vāsarūpavidherabhāvo jñāpyata iti vakṣyati | na ca kevalaṃ ṇamulvidhau
tadabhāvo jñāpayitumiṣyate, kiṃ tarhi ? ktvāsahitaṇamulvidhau |
tasmāṇṇamulaḥ ktvāsahitasya vidhiryathā syāditi ṇamul
cetyanuvṛtyā ktvo'pyanuvādaḥ kriyate | evaṃ hi dvayoḥ saha
vidhātumupādīyamānaṃ vibhāṣāgrahaṇaṃ tādṛśa eva viṣaye
vāsarūpavidherabhāvaṃ jñāpayatīti siddhamiṣṭam | agrebhojaṃ vrajatīti |
anyebhyo bhoktṛbhyaḥ pūrvaṃ bhuktvā vrajatītyarthaḥ | āmīkṣṇye
laḍādayo na bhavantīti | agre bhuṅkte bhuṅkte tato vrajatītyevaṃ
na bhavatītyarthaḥ |
upapadasamāsaḥ kasmānna bhavatīti | prāptavibhāṣāyāmasyāmagryādīnāṃ
pakṣe pratyayanivṛtau nimitatvam, na tu pratyayotpatau, tayoḥ
ṭhābhīkṣṇye ṇamul ca' ityanenāviśeṣeṇa
vihitatvādityanupapadatvam | aprāptavibhāṣāyāṃ tvagryādīnāṃ
pratyayotpatiṃ prati nimitatvānnimitasya
copapadasaṃjñāvidhānādupapadasamāsaḥ prāpnotīti bhāvaḥ | amaiva
yatulyavidhānamiti | etacca tatraiva vyākhyātam ||
karmaṇyākrośe kṛñaḥ khamuñ || 3|4|25 ||
udāharaṇeṣu karotiruccāraṇe vartate, tasya śabdātmakameva karma
bhavati | tatra corādiśabdāḥ śabdapradhānāḥ | coraṅkāram | ko'theḥ
? coraśabdamuccāryetyarthaḥ, tadāha---coro'sītyādi |
corakaraṇamiti | coraśabdoccāraṇam | ākrośasampādanārthamiti |
ninditaśabdoccāraṇamantareṇa tasya sampādayituśakyatvāt | na
tvasāviti | na hi coro'sīti vacanena coraḥ kriyate ||
svādumi ṇamul || 3|4|26 ||
svādumītyarthagrahaṇamiti | etacca vyākhyānāllabhyate | svādvartheṣviti |
māntatvamapi sarveṣāṃ bhavati; arthe sambhāvat | lavaṇasampannaśabdāvapi
svāduśabdāparyāyo | atha ṭhsvādumi' iti makārāntanipātanaṃ
kimartham, yāṣatā khamuñ prakṛtaḥ, so'nuvatiṣyate, tatra
ṭharudviṣadajantasya mum' iti māntatvaṃ siddhamiti ?
tatrāha---makārāntanipātanamīkārābhāvārthamiti | bhāvapratyayaviṣaye
māntatve nipātyamāne ṭhvoto guṇavacanāt' iti ṅīp na bhavati,
makārāntatvādukārāntatvābhāvādityarthaḥ | cvyantasyeti |
khamuñyapi na sarvatra mum siddhyati; tadvidau ṭhanavyayasya'
ityadhikārāditi bhāvaḥ | evaṃ tarhi māntatvameva nipātyatām,
pratyayastu prakṛtaḥ khamuñeva vidheyaḥ ? naitadasti; avyayārthameva
māntanipātanaṃ syāditi ṅīpsyādeva | ṇamuli tu māntatvamapūrvaṃ
vidhīyamānamīkārābhāvārthaṃ ca cvyantasya ca makārāntārthaṃ vijñāyate
| avaśyaṃ cotaratra ṇamul vidheya iti lāghavābhāvādihaiva kṛtaḥ |
asvādvīṃ svādvīṃ kṛtveti |
dvayorvākyayostantreṇopādānametat | svādvīṃ kṛtvā yavāgūṃ
bhuṅkta itīkārābhāvasyodāharaṇam, asvāduaṃ svāduaṃ bhuṅkta
ityavyayasya | iha yadi ktvādayaḥ pratyayāḥ ṭhkartari kṛt' iti
vacanātkartari syuḥ, iha paktvodano bhujyate devadateneti
devadatātṛtīyā na syāt, ktvāpratyayenābhihitaḥ karteti | atha
ktvāpratyayenābhidhāne satyapi bhujipratyayenānabhihitaḥ karteti
kṛtvā'nabhihitāśrayā vibhaktirbhavati tṛtīyā ? yadyevam, odane
dvitīyā prāpnoti, kiṃ kāraṇam ? bhujipratyayenābhidhāne'pi
ktvāpratyayenānabhihitaṃ karmeti | tathā yadi karmaṇi syuḥ,
paktvaudanaṃ bhuṅkte devadatena, paktvaudanaṃ bhuṅkte devadata
ityeva tu bhavati | tathāsmin ṇamulyapi svāduṅkāraṃ bhujyate
yāvagūrdeavadateneti yavāgvā dvitīyā na bhavati, svāduṅkāraṃ
yavāgūṃ bhuṅkte devadata ityatrāpi karmaṇi dvitīyā bhavati, kartari
tṛtīyā ca na bhavati | evamā tumuno draṣṭavyam | tathā
ṭhtamunṇvulau kriyāyāṃ kriyārthāyām' ṭhsamānakartṛkeṣu tumun'
ityatrāpi tumuni bhoktumodanaḥ pacyate devadatena, iṣyate grāmo
gantuṃ devadatena, bhoktumodanaṃ pacati devadataḥ, grāmaṃ
gantumicchati devadata iti sarvatrānuprayogāt yatra
lādayastadanurodhenaiva kartṛkarmaṇorvibhaktirbhavati |
tasmādavyayakṛtaḥ samānādhikaraṇa iti vaktavyam, kena
sāmānādhikaraṇye ? anuprayogeṇa | etaduktaṃ
bhavati---anuprayujyamānāddhātoryasminkārake lādayo
vihitāstatraivāvyayakṛto'pi bhavantīti | evaṃ hyubhābhyāṃ
kartṛkarmaṇorabhihitatvādyathāyathaṃ vibhaktayaḥ siddhyanti |
vṛttikārastvimamarthamanyathā sādhayitumāha---tumarthādhikārācceti |
tatra sayādisūtre tumarthagrahaṇātamun bhāve bhavatīti jñāpitam,
tadeva ca tumarthagrahaṇaṃ ṭhśakadhṛṣajñā' itiyāvadanuvartate, ataḥ sarva
ete ktvādayo bhāve bhavantīti tatra codayati----yadyevamiti |
tṛtīyā kasmānna bhavatīti | etaccopalakṣaṇam, svāduṅkāraṃ
yavāgūḥbhujyate devadatenetyatra karmaṇi dvitīyā kasmānna bhavatītyapi
draṣṭavyam | ṭhanabhihite' iti paryudāse caitaccodyam---tadā hi
satyabhidhāne'nabhidhāne ca yato'nabhidhānaṃ tadāśrayā vibhaktiḥ
prāpnoti | pariharati---bhujipratyayeneti | ṭhanabhihite' iti
prasajyapratiṣedha āśrīyate iti bhāvaḥ | tadā hi yato'bhidhānaṃ
tadāśrayaḥ pratiṣedho bhavati | nanu ca śaktiḥ kārakam, anyā ca
karaṇaviṣayā śaktiḥ, anyā ca bhujiviṣayā, tatra yadyekasyā
śakterabhidhānamanabhidhānaṃ ca syāt, syādayaṃ parihāraḥ,
yato'bhidhānaṃ tadāśrayaḥ pratiṣedha iti śaktibhedātvayuktaḥ ?
ityatrāha---na cāsminniti | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ bhedo na vivakṣitaḥ ?
ityāha---samānakartṛkatvaṃ hi virudhyata iti | nanu ca mā
nāmāsminprakaraṇe śaktibhedo vivakṣitaḥ, ṭhanabhihitena' ityatra kasmānna
vivakṣyate ? asambaddhametat ; kathaṃ hi tasminneva prayoge tadaiva
vivakṣāvivase syātām | kiñci---ṭhanabhihite'
ityekatvādīnāmādhāranirdeśo'nabhihite karmādau yadekatvādi
tatreti, dravyameva caikatvādīnāmādhāro na śaktiḥ, atastatrāpi
dravyamevānabhihitamityucyate, tasya ca
śaktidvāreṇābhidhānānabhidhānayoḥ satoryato'bhidhānaṃ tadāśrayaḥ
pratiṣedho bhavatīti yuktameva | abhyupetyāpi śaktibhedavivakṣāṃ
parihāramāha---pradhānaśaktyabhidhāne ceti | ākhyātapadavācyā kriyā
viśeṣyatvātpradhānam, viśeṣaṇabhūtā tvapradhānam, taddvāreṇa
tadviṣayayoḥ śaktyorapi guṇapradhānabhāvaḥ | tatra pradhānānuvatitvād
guṃṇānāṃ tanmukhaprekṣitvātadviruddhasvakāryārambhābhāvādyathāyathaṃ
vibhaktisiddhirityarthaḥ | uktaṃ ca---
pradhānetarayoryatra dravyasya kriyayoḥ pṛthake |
śaktirguṇāśrayā tatra pradhānamanuruddhyate ||
pradhānaviṣayā śaktiḥ pratyayenābhidhīyate |
yadā guṇe tadā tadvadanuktāpi pratīyate || iti |
vayaṃ tu brūmaḥ---sakṛt śrutasya yugapadubhābhyāṃ
sambandhābhāvādekenaiva pradhānena śābdo'nvaya iti, itareṇa tu
sannidhānādārtha iti ||
anyathaivaṃkathamitthaṃsu siddhāprayogaścet || 3|4|27 ||
kathaṃ punarasau siddhāprayoga iti | siddha odana ityādau siddhaśabdo
niṣpannavacanaḥ, tataśca siddhaścedaprayogaḥ kathamaprayujyamānātato
ṇamulvidhiriti praśnaḥ | ṭhsiddhe satyārambhoniyamārthaḥ'
itivatprāptavacanaḥ siddhaśabda ityutaram | nirthakatvāditi |
niṣprayojanatvāt | evameveti | nirarthaka eva sannityarthaḥ | etadeva
