sphorayati---anyathā bhuṅkta iti | yāvānartha iti |
udāharaṇeṣvanuprayogeṣu yā kriyā tatprakāravacanā atrānyathādayaḥ |
anyathā kṛtvā śiro bhuṅkta iti | atra tu vinā karotinā
śiraso'nyathākaraṇaṃ na pratīyate, bhujikriyāgata eva prakāre gamyate,
ato'vaśyaṃ prayojyaḥ karotiḥ ||
yathātathorasūyāprativacane || 3|4|28 ||
yadyasūyan pṛcchati prativaktīti | pṛcchati sati
yadyasūyanprativaktītyarthaḥ | ṭhasu mānasopatāpe' kaṇḍvādiḥ |
tatreti | evambhūte viṣaye yatprativacanaṃ tadasūyāprativacanamityarthaḥ
| yathākāramiti | praṣṭuamanarhaḥ sanyadi pṛcchati tadedamutaram |
yathā kṛtvāhaṃ bhokṣya iti | tatvakathanametat | kathaṃ punaratra
ktvāpratyayaḥ, yāvatā ṭhsiddhāprayoge' iti vacanādanarthako'tra
karotiḥ, tataśca bhedanibandhanasya paurvakālyasya samānakartṛkatvasya
cābhāvānnātra prāpnoti, ṇamul punarubhayābhāve'pi
vacanasāmarthyādbhavati ? ucyate; kriyāsāmānyavacanaḥ
karotistadviṣayaprakāro yathātathāśabdābhyāmucyate, tatra sāmānyasya
sannihite viśeṣe paryavasānātadviṣaya eva prakāra ukto bhavadi, tataśca
yathā bhokṣyate iti yāvānarthastāvānena satyapi karotāvityetāvatā
siddhāprayogatvamucyate, na punaratyantamabideyābhāvāt, tataśca
kriyābhedanibandhana upapanna eva ktvāpratyayaḥ | evaṃ ca kṛtvā
pūrvasūtre'pi vāsarūpeṇa ktvā bhavati | bhāṣye'pi tatra tatra
prayujyate--ṭhanyathā kṛtvā coditamanyathā kṛtvā parihāra uktaḥ',
ṭhkathaṃ kṛtvā bādhakam' ityādi ||
karmaṇi dṛśividoḥ sākalye || 3|4|29 ||
karmaṇyupapade sākalyaviśiṣṭa iti | sakalasya bhāvaḥ sākalyam,
tadviśiṣṭe karmaṇyupapade ityarthaḥ | kanyādarśaṃ varayatīti | atra
darśanaviṣayabhūtānāṃ sarvāsāmeva kanyānāṃ
vākyārthenānvayātsākalyam, sarvāḥ kanyā varayatītyatrāpi
darśanaviṣayabhūtā ityarthaḥ | atiśayapratipādanaparaṃ caitat;
yasmātkasyāścitparityāge'pi bhavatyeva | jānāti labhate vicārayati
veti | satārthasya tu viderakarmakatvādagrahaṇamiti bhāvaḥ ||
yāvati vindajīvoḥ || 3|4|30 ||
vindeti viderlābhārthasyānukaraṇam, tasya hi vindatītyādau ṭhśe
mucādīnām' iti numasti | yāvallabhate tākd bhuṅkte ityartha
iti | etenāsākalyaṃ darśayati, sākalye hi pūrveṇaiva siddham ||
carmodarayoḥ pūreḥ || 3|4|31 ||
karmaṇītyanuvṛteḥ pūreriti ṇyantasyedaṃ grahaṇam,
kevalasyākarmakatvādityāha---pūrayateriti | udarapūraṃ bhuṅkta iti
| udaraṃ pūrayan bhuṅkta ityarthaḥ | evamādiṣu prāyeṇa paurvakālyaṃ
nāsti, tasmāt ṭhpūrvakāle' iti na sambandhanīyamityāhuḥ ||
varṣapramāṇa ūlopaścāsyānyatarasyām || 3|4|32 ||
goṣpadapūramiti | goḥ padaṃ pūrayanvṛṣṭa ityarthaḥ,
vṛṣarekarmakatvātkartari ktaḥ | atrāpi ṭhpūrvakāle' iti na
sambandhanīyamityāhuḥ | sītāpūramiti | sītāulāṅgalapaddhatiḥ |
asyagrahaṇaṃ kimarthamiti | sannidhānādeva pūrayaterūlopo vijñāsyata
iti praśnaḥ | upapadasya mā bhūditi | asyetyanucyamāne
varṣapramāṇavadūlopo'pi samudāyaviṣayo
vijñāyeta---prakṛtyupapadasamudāye sannihito ya ūkārastasya lopa
iti, tataścopapadasyāpi syāditi bhāvaḥ |
ṭhūlopaścāsyānyatarasyām' iti śakyamakartum | kathaṃ
goṣpadapramiti ? ṭhprāpūraṇe' ityasmāddhātoḥ ṭhāto'nupasarge kaḥ',
kriyāviśeṣaṇatvātkarmatvanapuṃsakatve, na rūpabhedaḥ, nārthabhedaḥ, na
svarabhedaḥ | kapratyaye thāthādisūtreṇāntodātatvam; ṇamulyūlope
kṛte pūrvasya svarabhājo'bhāvāt ṭhliti' ityasyāpravṛtau
pratyayakharaḥ, tasya
kṛdutarapadaprakṛtisvareṇāvasthānamityantodātatvameva | nanu ca
ṇamuli sati ṭhkṛnmejantaḥ' ityavyayatvādvibhaktīnāṃ śravaṇaṃ na bhavati,
tarapi ca goṣpadapratarapamiti bhavati, kalpabādau ca goṣpadaprakalpa
iti bhavati, ajñātādiṣu cāvyayatvādakajbhavati, ke tu sati
sarvametanna siddhyati ? ucyate; iṣyate tāvadvibhaktīnāṃ śravaṇamekena
goṣpadapreṇeti, tarabādiṣu copanyastāni rūpāṇi neṣyanta eva |
etacca bhāṣye ūlopapratyakhyānādavasīyate |
nanu ca goṣpadapūramityādyapi ghañaiva siddham ? na siddhyati, yadi
tāvatkaraṇe ghañaṃ vidhāya tadantena karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhayāḥ samāsaḥ
kriyate, tatasthāthādisvareṇāntodātatvaṃ syād | atha bhāve ghañi
vyadhikaraṇapado bahuvrīhiḥ kriyate---goṣpadasya pūraṇamasminvarṣa
iti, tataḥ pūrvapadaprakṛtikharaprasaṅgaḥ | goṣpadapūrantarām,
goṣpadapūraṅkalpamityādi ca na siddhyati, tasmād ṭhvarṣapramāṇe'
iti vaktavyam ||
celeḥ knopeḥ || 3|4|33 ||
asmāddhātorṇyantāditi | pukā nirdeśādeva ṇyantatvamavasīyate,
vyākhyānāccela ityarthagrahaṇamityāha---celārtheṣviti | celaknīpaṃ
vṛṣṭa iti | celaṃ knopayanuśabdāyayanvṛṣṭa ityarthaḥ | yathā varṣaṇe
celāni śabdāyante tathā vṛṣṭa iti yāvat ||
nimūlasamūlayoḥ kaṣaḥ || 3|4|34 ||
atra prakaraṇe samānakartṛkatvameva | nimūlakāṣamiti | kaṣatirhisārthaḥ
| ekasyaiva dhātvarthasya sāmānyaviśeṣabhāvena bhede sati
viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaḥ | nigataṃ mūlamasya nimūlam | saha mūlena
samūlaṃ kaṣaṇaṃ karoti, saha mūlena karṣatītyarthaḥ | evaṃ sarvatra
prakaraṇe draṣṭavyam ||
samūlākṛtajīveṣu hankṛñgrahaḥ || 3|4|36 ||
jīvagrāhamiti | jīvatīti jīvaḥ, igupadhalakṣaṇaḥ kaḥ | jīvantaṃ
gṛhṇātītyarthaḥ ||
karaṇe hanaḥ || 3|4|37 ||
nityasamāsārthaṃ ceti | ṭhhisārthānām' ityanena ṇamuli
ṭhtṛtīyāprabhṛtīnyanyatarasyām' iti vikalpitaḥ samāsaḥ syād, ato
hiṃsārthe'pyanenaiva ṇamuleṣitavya ityarthaḥ |
kathaṃ punariṣyamāṇo'pi labhyate, yāvatā'hiṃsārthe hantau
sāvakāśo'yaṃ vidhiḥ, ṭhhiṃsārthānām' ityasya tu hantivyatirikto
hiṃsārtho'vakāśaḥ; hiṃsārthe hantāvubhayaprasaṅge paratvātsa eva vidhiḥ
prāpnoti ? tatrāha--pūrvavipratiṣedheneti | kathaṃ tarhi
ṭhhiṃsārthānām' ityatrodāhariṣyate---daṇḍopaghātaṃ gāḥ kālayati,
daṇḍenopaghātaṃ veti ? atrāhuḥ---yatraika eva dhātvarthaḥ
sāmānyaviśeṣabhāvena bhidyamāno viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabāvamanubhavati
so'sya viṣayaḥ; ṭhkaṣādiṣu yathāvidhyanuprayogaḥ' iti vacanāt |
atyantabhinnadhātvarthasambandhe tu tenaiva ṇamul bhavatīti | evaṃ ca
nityasamāsārtho yathāvidhyanuprayogārthaśceti, ko'rthaḥ ?
yathāvidhyanuprayogārthaḥ sannityasamāsārtha ityarthaḥ |
iha dvarhangrahaṇaṃ samūlagrahaṇaṃ ca kriyate, sakṛdeva tu śakyaṃ kartum,
katham ? evaṃ vakṣyāmi---jīvākṛtayorgrahakṛñaḥ; śuṣkacūrṇarukṣeṣu
piṣaḥ, nimūle kaṣaḥ, samūle hanaśca, cakārātkaṣaśca, tataḥ karaṇe hana
ityeva, yadetatkaṣādiṣu yathāvidhyanuprayoga iti etadgrahādiṣviti
vaktavyam | tathā tu na kṛtamityeva ||
snehane piṣaḥ || 3|4|38 ||
vyākhyānātsnehane ityarthagrahaṇamityāha---snehanavācinīti |
udapeṣamiti | ṭhpeṣaṃvāsavāhanadhiṣu ca' ityudakasyodabhāvaḥ |
ṭhśuṣkacūrṇa' ityatra snehanagrahaṇaṃ na kṛtam, karmaṇi tatra pratyayaḥ, iha
tu karaṇe ||
haste vartigrahoḥ || 3|4|39 ||
ṭhjīve grahaḥ, haste ca, varteśca' iti noktam, tatra karmopapadam, iha
tu karaṇam | vartirṇyanta iti | nirdeśa evātra pramāṇam | hastavartaṃ
vartayatīti | hastena vartayati, gulikāṃ karotītyarthaḥ ||
sve puṣaḥ || 3|4|40 ||
svapoṣamiti | pitparyāyavacanasya ceti | svarūpe'pi bhavati ||
saṃjñāyām || 3|4|42 ||
anadhikaraṇārtho'yamārambhaḥ, pūrvayogastvasaṃjñārthaḥ | kathaṃ tarhi grāme
bandha iti ? vāsarūpavidhinā ghañ bhaviṣyati ||
kartrorjīvapuruṣayornaśivahoḥ || 3|4|43 ||
jīvena naṣṭa iti | jīvena karaṇenāpadaṃ prāpta ityarthaḥ | puruṣeṇoḍha
iti | puruṣeṇa karaṇena deśāntaraṃ prāpito devadatādirityarthaḥ ||
ūrdhve śuṣipūroḥ || 3|4|44 ||
ūrdhvaśoṣaṃ śuṣyatīti | vṛkṣādirūrdhva eva tiṣṭhan śuṣyatītyarthaḥ |
ūrdhvaḥ pūryata ityartha iti | ūrdhvamukha eva san
ghaṭādirvarṣodakādinā pūrṇo bhavatītyarthaḥ ||
upadaṃśastṛtīyāyām || 3|4|47 ||
itaḥ prabhṛti paurvakālyamapyasti | mūlakopapadaṃśaṃ bhuṅkte iti |
nanu ca nātra tṛtīyāntasyopadaṃśinā saṃbandhaḥ, na hi mūlakenānya
upadaśyate, kiṃ tarhi ? tadevopadaśyate, bhujinā tu saṃbandha upapadyate
; tamprati karaṇatvāt, kiṃ tūpadaṃśinā samārthyābhāvātpratyayo na
prāpnoti, upapadasaṃjñā ca nasyāt, tadabhāvādupapadasamāso'pi na
prāpnoti, vacanasya tu daśanairupadaśya bhuṅkte ityādiravakāśaḥ
syāt ? ityata āha---mūlakādi ceti | satyaṃ mūlakāderbhujinaiva
śābdo'nvayaḥ, upadaṃśinā tu karmāpekṣāyāṃ sannidhānādyogyatvācca
vastutaḥ sambandho'styeva, bhujiṃ prati karaṇatvamanyathā nopapadyate,
tataścāyamarthaḥ---mūlakena bhuṅkte, kiṃ kṛtvā ? upadaśya, kimupadaśya
? tadeva mūlakamiti | yadi tu yatra tṛtīyāntenaiva
śābdo'nvayastatraivāyaṃ pratyayo'bhimataḥ syāt, karaṇa ityeva
brūyād, yathā--karaṇe hana iti | tasmādārthena sambandhena sāmarthye
sati pratyayādikaṃ sarvaṃ bhaviṣyati ||
hisārthānāṃ ca samānakarmakāṇām || 3|4|48 ||
ṭhdhātusambanve' ityadhikārādanuprayogadhātunā samānakarmatvaṃ
vijñāyate, ityāha---anuprayogadhātunāsamānakarmakāṇāmiti |
kālayati | ṭhkala vikṣepe' curādiḥ | daṇḍatāḍamiti | ṭhtaḍa āghāte'
curādireva | upahatyeti | ṭhvā lyapi' ityanunāsikalopaḥ, hrasvasya
tuk || 
saptamyāñcīpapīḍarudhakarṣaḥ || 3|4|49 ||
upaśabdaḥ pratyekamiti | pīḍādīnāṃ samāhāradvandvaṃ kṛtvopapūrvaḥ
ṭhpīḍarudhakarṣa' ityutarapadalopī samāsaḥ | sautraḥ puṃlliṃṅganirdeśaḥ
| karaṇādhikaraṇavivakṣābhedenopapadeṣu vibhakartidūyam |
karṣateriti bhauvādikasya, na kṛṣateriti; taudādikasya śapā
nirdeśāt | śapā nirdeśastu vihitaguṇasyoccāraṇādvijñāyate |
sūtre tu pañcamyarthe prathamā, kiñca syādyadi taudādikasya grahaṇaṃ
syāt, yāvatobhayorapi vilekhanārthatvānnārthabhedo nāpi
rūpabhedaḥ ? yadyāpyubhayorapi vilekhane pāṭhaḥ, tathāpi taudādikasya
kṣetraviṣaye vilekhane vṛttiḥ---pañcabhirhalaiḥ kṛṣatīti | tena kṣetre
upakṛṣya halenopakṛṣyeti taudādikāt ktvāpratyaya eva bhavati, na
ṇamul || 
samāsatau || 3|4|50 ||
saptamyāṃ tṛtīyāyāmityanuvartate iti | pūrvasūtre'pi
svaritatvādeva tṛtīyā'nuvartate, saptamyāṃ tu tasyā nivṛttirmā
vijñāyīti cakāraḥ kriyate | tena cānukṛṣṭamutaratra nānuvartate
iti na codanīyam | yuddhasaṃrambhāditi | kopādinā manaḥ
kṣobhapūrvako vākkāyavikāraḥusaṃrambhaḥ, yuddhārthaḥ saṃrambho
yuddhasaṃrambhaḥ, aśvaghāsādivatṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ | atyantaṃ sannikṛṣya
yuddhyante ityartha iti | sannikarṣapratipādanaparametatkeśagrahaṇaṃ
bhavatu, mā vā bhūditi ||
pramāṇe ca || 3|4|51 ||
tṛtīyāsaptamyorityeveti | arthānuvṛttipradarśanametat, na
hyaevaṃvidhaḥ śabdaḥ prakṛto'sti | dvyaṅgulotkarṣaṃmiti |
dvayoraṅgulyoḥ samāhāro dvayaṅgulam,
ṭhtatpuruṣasyāṅguleḥ' ityacsamāsāntaḥ, dvyaṅgulenotkṛṣya
paricchidyetyarthaḥ | hrasvāḥ khaṇḍāḥukhaṇḍikāḥ |
apādāne parīpsāyām || 3|4|52 ||
parīpsā tvariti | ṭhñitvarā sambhrame' ghaṭādiḥ, ṭhghaṭādayaḥ ṣitaḥ',
ṣitvādaṅ | śayyotthāyamiti | ṭhudaḥ sthāstambhoḥ' iti
tiṣṭhatisakārasya takāraḥ, pūrvadyauk | avaśyakartavyamapīti |
akṣiprakṣālanādikam | dvitīyāyāṃ parīpsāyāmityeveti | ṭhanudātaṃ
pademakavarjam' ityatrāpi parīpsā bhavatyeva, katham ? paribhāṣeyam,
padagrahaṇaṃ ca paribhāṣārtham | tenodātaḥ svarito vā yatra
vidhīyate tatra tatsamakālamevaikamacaṃ varjayitvā pariśiṣṭamanudātaṃ
kartavyam, na vilambitavyamiti ||
svāṅge'dhruve || 3|4|54 ||
svāṅgalakṣaṇaṃ caturthe vakṣyate---adravaṃ mūrtimadityādi |
akṣinikāṇamiti | ṭhkaṇa nimīlane' curādinipūrvaḥ | utripya śiraḥ
kathayatīti | nanu ca dhruvamiti nityamucyate---dhruvā dyaurdhruvā
pṛthivīti yathā; adhruvamanityam, śiraścāpyanityameva,
prāṇināmevānityatvādata āha---yasminnaṅga iti | ayaṃ
bhāvaḥ---viśeṣaṇasāmarthyātprakarṣa āśrīyate, prakarṣeṇa yadadhruvamiti |
prakarṣaśca jīvatyapi prāṇini kadācidabhāva iti ||
parikliśyamāne ca || 3|4|55 ||
parikliśyamāna iti | ṭhkliśū vibādhane' ityetasyaitad rūpam, na
tu ṭhkliśa upatāpe' ityasya, pariśca sarvato bhāva ityāha---parikleśaḥ
sarvaṃto vibādhanamiti ||
viśipatipadiskandāṃ vyāpyamānāsevyamānayoḥ || 3|4|56 ||
anavayaveneti | sākalyena | padārthānāmiti | gehādīnām |
tātparyamiti | paunaḥ punyamābhīkṣṇyamityarthaḥ | dravye
vyāptirityādinā vyāptyasevayorviṣayavibhāgaṃ darśayati |
gehānupraveśamiti | nanu vyāptau vīpsā gamyate, āsevāyāṃ ca
nityatvamiti ṭhnityavīpsayoḥ' iti dvirvacanaṃ prāpnoti, tatkasmānna
bhavatītyāha---samāseneti | yadyapi samāsa etayorarthayorna
vidhīyate, tathāpi svabhāvata etayostenābhidānam, yathā---saptaparvā
iti, parvagatāyā vīpsāyāḥ---parvaṇiparvaṇi sapta parṇānyasyeti |
tathā ca vakṣyatīti | ṭhnītyavīpsayoḥ' ityatra vakṣyati | bhāṣyakāraḥ |
tiṅkṣu nityateti | upalakṣaṇam, ṭhavyayakṛtsu ca' ityapi draṣṭavyam
|
ktvānivṛtyarthamiti cediti | ṭhābhīkṣṇye ṇamul ca' ityanena
ktvāṇamulau dvāvapi vihitau, tatra viśyādibhyo ṇamuleva yathā
syāt, ktvāpratyayo mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ punarmamulucyata iti
cedityarthaḥ | dūṣayati---neṣṭatvāditi | iṣyate hyāsevāyāṃ
viśiprabhṛtibhyaḥ ktvā---gehamanupraviśyānupraviśyāsta iti |
dvitīyopapadārthaṃ tarhīti | atra hi ṭhdvitīyāyāṃ ca' ityadhikārad
dvitīyāntasyopapadasaṃjñā labhyate, kimarthaṃ punarupapadatvamiṣyate ?
ityāha---upapadasamāsa iti | ṭhtṛtīyāprabhṛtīnyanyatarasyām' iti
vacanātpakṣa ityuktam | tena hi satyupapadābhāva iti | saptamīsthasya
kasyacidabhāvāt ||
asyatitṛṣoḥ kriyāntare kāleṣu || 3|4|57 ||
ṭhasu kṣepaṇe', ṭhñitṛṣā pipāsāyām' | kriyāmantarayatīti
kriyāntara iti | vyavadhānavācino'ntaraśabdātatkarotīti ṇici
ṭhkarmaṇyaṇ' | pāyayatīti | pibaterṇici ṭhśācchāsāhvā' ityādinā
yuk | atyasanenetyādi | yaccādya pānaṃ yacca dvyahe gate bhavitā,
tanmadhyavartitvādatyasanatarṣaṇayoḥ, etadeva
spaṣṭayannudāharaṇasyārthamāha---adya pāyayitvetyādi |
dvyahamupoṣyeti | upapūrvādvaseḥ ktvā lyap,
yajāditvātsamprasāraṇam, ṭhśāsivasighasīnāṃ ca' iti ṣatvam,
atropavāsena bhojanaṃ vyavadhīyate | ahariti | ṭhkālādhvanoḥ' iti
dvitīyā | kṛtsnamahariṣūnatyasya kṣiptvā gata ityarthaḥ |
yojanamatyasyeti | kvacitsrughnādau pāyayitvā tatā
yojanamatikramya pāyayatītyarthaḥ ||
nāmnyādiśigrahoḥ || 3|4|58 ||
ādiśergraheśceti | etenāṅe diśinaiva sambandhaḥ, na grahiṇeti
darśayati ||
avyaye'yathābhipretākhyāne kṛñaḥ ktvāṇamulau || 3|4|59 ||
ṭhayathābhipretākhyāne' iti nañaḥ praśleṣaḥ paścānnirdeśādvijñāyate,
anyathā'sandehārthaṃ pūrvaṃ nirdiśet,
ayathābhipretaśabdaścākhyānakriyāviśeṣaṇaṃ yathābhipretaṃ na bhavati
tathākhyāna ityarthaḥ | putrajanma prārthamānaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ gatvā
kenacidgopanīyavannīcairākhyātam--brāhṇa putraste jāta iti
tamamṛṣyamāṇo brāhmaṇa āha--kiṃ tarhīti | putrajanmākhyānasya
priyatve'pi ākhyānaprakārasyānabhipretatvādbhavatyudāharaṇam, ta
evāyathābhipretākhyāna ityuktam, na punarapriyākhyāna iti | ācakṣa iti
| laṭ, ṭhthāsasse', śapo luki ṭhskoḥ saṃyogādyoḥ' iti
kakāralopaḥ, ṭhṣaḍhoḥ kaḥ si' | udāharaṇe'yathābhipretākhyānaṃ
darśayati---uccairnāmeti | nāmaśabdaḥ prasiddhau, na punaridaṃ
brāhmaṇavākyamuktamiti ṭhupadaṃśastṛtīyāyām' ityatredamuktam |
samāsārthaṃ vacanamiti | etadevopapādayati---tathā hīti | ṭhktvā ca'
ityatra ṭhtṛtīyāprabhṛtīnyanyatarasyām' iti vartate, tasmādanena yaḥ
ktvā vihitastenaiva pakṣe samāso labhyate, na tu
samānādisūtravihitena, na hi tena tṛtīyāprabhṛtiṣūpapadeṣu ktvā
vidhīyata ityarthaḥ | ṇamulgrahaṇamanarthakam, prakṛto hyasau tatra ktvā
ceti vaktavyam ? ityata āha---ṇamuladhikāra ityādi |
tulyakakṣatvamutulyabalatvam || tenetyādi | yadi tu cakāreṇa
ṇamulanukṛṣyeta, utaratra nānuvarteta; yatnābhāvāt |
punarṇamulgrahaṇe tu dvandvanirdiṣṭayordvayorapyutaratrānuvṛttiḥ
siddhā bhavati ||
tiryacyapavarge || 3|4|60 ||
tiryavakṛtyeti | tiro'ñcatīti ṭhṛtvig' ityādinā kvin,
ṭhtirasastiryalope' iti tiryādeśaḥ | vyutpattimātraṃ caitat, na
tvatrāvayavārtho'sti, samudāyo hyayamapavarge vartate taddirśitam |
samāpya gata ityartha iti | tiryavakṛtveti | anṛju kṛtvā, agrataḥ
sthitaṃ pārśve kṣiptvetyarthaḥ |
ṭhtiryaci' ityayukto'yaṃ nirdeśaḥ, bhasaṃjñāyāṃ satyām, ṭhacaḥ'
ityakāralope tiraścīti bhavitavyam ? ata āha--tiryacīti
śabdānukaraṇametaditi | ṭhaca' ityarthavato'jityasya grahaṇam | sa
cārtho lokaprasiddho gṛhte; ṭhabhivyaktapadārthā ye svatantrā
lokaviśrutāḥ' iti nyāyāt | ato'ñceḥ svārthe
vartamānasyāllopaḥ | etatu tatra sthitasya śabdarūpasyānukaraṇam,
tenānukāryeṇa rūpeṇārthavanna tu laukikārthena, tena lopābhāva iti
bhāvaḥ | nanvevamapi ṭhprakṛtibadanukaraṇaṃ bhavati' iti lopaḥ
prāpnotyevāta āha---na ca prakṛtivadanukaraṇena bhavitavyamiti |
kasmādityāha---anukriyamāṇarūpavināśaprasaṅgāditi | yādṛśaṃ
rūpamanukartumiṣṭṃa tādṛśaṃ na pratīyeta, laukika eva tvarthaḥ
pratīyetetyarthaḥ | kva ca yathā prakṛtivadanukaraṇaṃ
bhavatītyāha---etado'śityādi | yadyanukriyamāṇarūpavināśe'pi
prakṛtivadanukaraṇaṃ syāt, etadaḥ, adasa ityatrobhayatrāpi
tyadādyatvādike prakṛtikārye sati etasya, amuṣyeti rūpaṃ syāt |
nanu prayojanānuvatiṃ pramāṇaṃ tataścellopaḥ prāpnoti kartavya
pavāyam ? katham ? ṭhyatadetebhyaḥ' iti tyadādyatvam , asyavāmīyamiti
yasyeti lopaḥ, gavityayamāhetyavādeśaḥ, paṭiti
karotītyanukriyamāṇarūpavināśe satyapi ṭhavyaktānukaraṇasyāta itau'
iti pararūpatvaṃ vā bhavati | tasmādubhayathā nirdeśadarśanāt
kvacitprakṛtibadanukaraṇaṃ bhavati, kvacinneti vācyam | tathā
cāsminneva sūtre bhāṣyam---sautro nirdeśa iti ||
svāṅge taspratyaye kṛbhvoḥ || 3|4|61 ||
ṭhtaspratyaye' iti bahuvrīhinirdeśa ityāha---taspratyayoyataḥ
svāṅgātadevamucyata iti | na ca ṭhkvinpratyayasya kuḥ'
itivatkadācitaspratyayāntatvena dṛṣṭe saṃpratyatadante'pi svāṅga
prasaṅgaḥ, taspratyayagrahaṇasāmarthyāt | karmadhārayo
vāyam---taspratyaye parato yatsvāṅgaṃ tasminnupapade iti | vṛtau
tu vastumātraṃ pradarśitam | yathāsaṃkhyamatra neṣyata iti | vyākhyānāt
| mukhata iti | ādyāditvātsaptamyarthe tasiḥ |
mukhe tasyatītyādi | ṭhtasu upakṣaye' ityasmānmukhaśabda upapade
ṭhanyebhyo'pi dṛśyate' iti kvip---mukhataḥ, ṭhatvasantasya ca' iti
dīrgho na bhavati; ṭhadhātoḥ' iti pratiṣedhāt |
pratyayāpratyayaparibhāṣayaivātrāprasaṅgāt nārthaḥ pratyayagrahaṇena ||
nādhārthapratyaye cvyarthe || 3|4|62 ||
nārtho dhārthaśceti | nādhāsahacarito'rtho nādhā śabdābhyāmuktaḥ,
nārtho yasya sa nārthaḥ, nārthārtha ityarthaḥ | etena dhārtho vyākhyātaḥ |
pratyayo yasmāditi | yadi pañcamyāṃ vigrahaḥ kriyate, tataḥ
prakṛterupalakṣaṇaṃ nādhārthagrahaṇaṃ syāditi sampratyatadantatve'pi
prakṛtimātre prasaṅgaḥ ? na prasaṅgaḥ, evaṃ hi vinañsaṅkhyāsviti
vaktavyaṃ syāt, ṣaṣṭha|la vigrahaḥ kartavyaḥ---nādhārthaḥ pratyayo yasya
samudāyasyāvayava iti | lyablope vā pañcamī vyākhyeyā yaṃ
samudāyāmuddiśya nādhārthaḥ pratyayo vidhīyata iti | vinākṛtya
nānākṛtyeti | ṭhvinañbhyāṃ nānāñau nasaha' iti nānāñau |
dvidhākṛtyeti | ṭhsaṅkhyāyā vidhārthe dhā' | dvaidhaṃkṛtyeti |
ṭhdvitryosca dhamuñ' | hirakpṛthakśabdau vinārthe |
nānā kṛtvā kāṣṭhāni gata iti | pūrvameva nānā santi kāṣṭhānyanyatra
kṛtvā gata ityarthaḥ | dhārthamarthagrahaṇamiti | bahavo hi dhārthāḥ
pratyayāḥ, tatrāsatyarthagrahaṇe pratyayasyaiva grahaṇaṃ syāt, nānyeṣām;
tadarthānāmarthagrahaṇe tu teṣāmapi bhavati | yaścādhādeśo dhārthaḥ
ṭhdhamuñantātsvārthe ḍadarśanam' iti tadarthamarthagrahaṇam---dvaidhakṛtya
dvaidhakāraṃ dvaidhabhūya dvaidhabhāvamiti | dhamuñādīnāṃ tu
sthānivadbhāvādeva siddhaṃ tadvidhau dha
ityadhikāreṇādeśapakṣasyāśrayaṇāt | atha nārthamapyarthagrahaṇaṃ kasmānna
bhavatītyata āha---nā punareka eveti | nanu ca nāpratyayāvapi dvau
bhavataḥ---niranubandhakaḥ, sānubandhakaśceti, tatrāsatyarthagrahaṇe
niranubandhakasyaiva grahaṇaṃ syāt, netarasya ? evaṃ
manyate---tantrāvṛtyaikaśeṣāṇāmanyatamasyāśrayaṇātasyāpi bhaviṣyati ||
anvacyānulomye || 3|4|64 || 
anvagbhūyeti | agrataḥ pārśvata- pṛṣṭhato vā'nukūlo bhūtvā''ste
ityarthaḥ | anvagbhūtveti | pṛṣṭhato bhūtvetyarthaḥ | anukūlo'nanukūla
iti śabdena na spṛśyate ||
śakadhṛṣajñāglāghaṭarabhalabhakramasahārhāstyartheṣu tumun || 3|4|65 ||
atrānantareṇāstiśabdenaivārthaśabdaḥ sambaddhyate, śakadhṛṣajñānāṃ
ghaṭāīyośca pṛthagupādānāt, tadāha---śakādiṣūpapadeṣu
astyartheṣu vaiti | tumun pratyayo bhavatīti | bhāve |
akriyārthopapadārtha ārambha iti | ṭhkriyārthopapade tumunṇvulau'
ityādinaiva siddhatvāt | tatra tāvat śaknoti bhoktum, dhaṣṇoti,
jānātīti bhojane prāvīṇyaṃ gamyate | glāyati bhoktumiti |
tatrāśaktiḥ | ghaṭate'rhatīti yogyatā | ārabhate prakramata iti |
bhujerevādyāvasthā | labhate bhoktumiti | apratyākhyātaṃ bhojanaṃ labhate
ityarthaḥ | utsahate bhoktumiti | bhojane vyāpriyata ityarthaḥ | asti
bhoktumiti | bhojanamastītyarthaḥ | pravīṇo bhoktum, kuśalo
bhoktum, paṭuarbhoktumityādau paryāptivivakṣāyāmutarasūtreṇa
tumun bhavati ||
paryāptivacaneṣvalamartheṣu || 3|4|66 ||
paryāptiḥuanyūnatā, paripūrṇatetyarthaḥ | anyūnatā ca dvidhā
sambhavati---bhojanasya prabhūtatayā vā, bhoktuḥ samarthatayā vā, ataḥ
sāmarthyenālamarthena viśinaṣṭi | alamartheṣu paryāptivacaneṣviti |
prayāpto bhoktumiti | bhojane na nyūnībhavati samartha ityarthaḥ |
puryaptamiti | prabhūtamityarthaḥ |
śakyamevaṃ kartumiti | sukarametadityarthaḥ | sambhavamātraṃ vā'tra
vivakṣitam---sambhavatyevaṃvidhasya karaṇamiti ||
kartari kṛt || 3|4|67 ||
kimarthamidamucyate ? kartarikṛdvacanamanodeśe svārthavijñānāt |
yatra vacanenārtho nirdiśyate tatra pratyāsatyā prakṛtyartha eva pratyayo
bhavati, tadyathā---ṭhguptijkidbhyaḥ san', ṭhyāvādibhyaḥ kan' iti,
evamimekṛtaḥ svārthe syuḥ, svārthe mā bhūvan kartari syuriti |
nanu ca yamicchati svārthe, āha taṃ bhāve ghañ bhavatīti ? tanniyamārthaṃ
bhaviṣyati---ghañeva bhāve nānyaḥ kṛditi | asati hyatetasminsūtre
ghañityetāvatsūtraṃ kartavyam---dhātorghañ bhavatīti,
tatrānirdiṣṭārthatvādbhāva eva ghaña bhaviṣyatīti; tataḥ ṭhpadarujaviśa'
iti dvitīyaṃ sūtraṃ kartavyam, tataśca ṭhbhāve' iti na kartavyam,
kriyamāṇaṃ tu niyamārthaṃ bhaviṣyati---ghañeva bhāve nānyaḥ kṛditi,
tataścānyaḥ kṛddhātvarthākṣipte kartari bhaviṣyati |
syādetat---karmādīnāmapi dhātvarthenākṣepāteṣvapi kṛtaḥ syuriti
? na; ṭhdhaḥ karmaṇi ṣṭran', ṭhkaraṇādhikaraṇayorlyuṭ',
ṭhdāśagāghnau sampradāne', ṭhbhīmādayo'pādāne' ityatra ṭhṣṭraneva
karmaṇi nānyaḥ' ityādiko niyamo vijñāsyate | yadyekaṃ karmādi
niyataṃ pratyayāstvaniyatā iti kārakāntare'pi ṣṭharanādayaḥ syuḥ ?
naiṣa doṣaḥ; ekamidaṃ vaakyam---dhaḥ karmaṇi ṣṭraniti, tena ca
karmaṇi vidhīyamānaḥ kathaṃ kārakāntare'pi syāt ! dvitīyo'pi vā
niyamo vijñāsyate---karmaṇyeva ṣṭraniti, evaṃ sarvatra | ya
idānīmato'nyaḥ pratyayaḥ śeṣaḥ so'ntareṇāpi vacanaṃ kartaryeva
bhaviṣyati | ṭhkartari bhuvaḥ khiṣṇuckhukañau' ṭhkartari
carṣidevatayoḥ' ityubhayatrāpi karaṇanivṛtyarthā
kartṛśrutirvidhyarthaiveti khiṣṇujādiṣu kartṛniyamo na bhaviṣyati |
tadeva tarhi prayojanam---svārthe mā bhūvanniti ? nanu
coktam---ṭhbhāve iti niyamo vijñāsyate' iti ? svārthādanyaḥ sa
bhāvo dhātvarthasya siddhatā nāma | śuddhe svārthe kṛtaḥ syuḥ, laḥ karmaṇi
ca bhāve ceti | ayaṃ tarhi niyamo bhaviṣyati---la eva bhāve iti ?
nāyaṃ niyamaḥ śakyo vijñātum, kartṛkarmaṇornirdeśena
nirdiṣṭārthatvāt lakārāḥ svārthe na syuḥ, ṭhakarmkebhyaḥ' iti ca
vakṣyāmītyevamarthametatsyāt | ataḥ suṣṭhūaktam---kartari
kṛdvacanamanādeśe svārthavijñānāditi |
atra ca dvaidham---etadvākyanirapekṣaiḥ svairvidhāyakairvākyairvihitānāṃ
kṛtāṃ paścādenenārtha ādiśyeta ? kṛdutpattivākyānāṃ vāyaṃ śeṣaḥ
syāt ṇvultṛcau kartari nandigrahipacādibhyo lyuṇinyacaḥ
kartarīti ? tatrādye pakṣe yathānena tṛjādīnāmartha ādiśyate, tathā
khyunādīnāmapyādiśyeta; viśeṣānupādānāt | tataścaite'pyanena
kartari ca syuḥ, sveṣu sveṣu vidhivākyeṣu
karaṇādīnāmapyupādānātkaraṇādiṣu ca | nanu ca khyunādiṣu
karaṇādirartho viśeṣavihitatvāt kartuśca bādhako bhaviṣyati ?
na; nānāvākyatvāt | iha ṭhdadhi brāhmaṇebhyo dīyatāṃ takraṃ
kauṇḍinyāya' iti abhinnakālatvādekaṃ vākyaṃ viśiṣṭadānasya
pratipādakamiti takreṇa dadhi bādhyate | yadā tu pūrvāhṇe
brāhmaṇabhojanaprakaraṇe ṭhdadhi brāhmaṇebhyo dīyatām' ityucyate,
aparāhṇe tu ṭhtakraṃ kauṇḍinyāya dīyatām' iti, na tadā
bādhyabādhakabhāvaḥ | tathāsminpakṣe'pi kālabhedena
vākyadvayoccāraṇādvādhyabādhakabhāvo na labhyate | tasmād duṣṭa
evāyaṃ pakṣa iti dvitīyaṃ pakṣamāśrityāha---kṛdutpattivākyānāmayaṃ
śeṣaḥ syāditi | prāgukto doṣastadavastha eva ? tatrāha---yeṣvityādi
| kuta etadityāha---arthākāṅkṣatvāditi | yeṣu vākyeṣvartho na
nirdiśyate tānyarthākāṅkṣāṇi | tathā hi---ṭhṇvultṛcau bhavataḥ'
ityukte'rthaviṣayā ākāṅkṣā jāyate---kvaitau bhavati iti ? ṭhkartari
kṛt' ityasyākāṅkṣā bhavati---kaḥ kṛt kartari bhavatīti ?
atastṛjādividhyanupasthāne śeṣaśeṣiṇorubhayorapyākāṅkṣāpūtaye
tatastatraivopatiṣṭhata ityarthaḥ | khyunādivākyeṣviti | upatiṣṭhata
ityanuṣaṅgaḥ | kāraṇamāha---sākṣādarthanirdeśe sati teṣāṃ
nirākāṅkṣatvāditi | na ca
raktapaṭanyāyenākāṅkṣotthāpanenoprasthānaṃ yujyate; svata eva
sākāṅkṣe tṛjādividhyanupasthānena śeṣasyāpi caritārthatvāt |
raktaḥ paṭo bhavatītyatra tu paṭo bhavatītyasya nirākāṅkṣatve'pi
raktapadārthasya sākāṅkṣatvādāṅkṣotthāpanenānvayaḥ | na ca
videśasthānāṃ kathamekavākyatvamiti vācyam; śāstre
videśasthānāmapyavāntaravākyānāmākāṅkṣāvaśādekavākyatvadarśanāt | yathā ---dvitīye'dhyāye lugucyate, tasya caturthaṣaṣṭhayoralugapavādaḥ ṭhgotre'lugaci', ṭhalugutarapade' iti ||
bhavyageyapravacanīyopasthānīyajanyāplāvyāpātyā vā || 3|4|68 ||
bhavya iti | ṭhaco yat', guṇaḥ, ṭhvānto yi pratyaye' iti vāntādeśaḥ
| geyo māṇavakaḥ sāmnāmiti | etena ṭhkai gai śabde' ityasyedaṃ
nipātanam, na ṭhgāṅ gatau' ityasyeti darśayati | etacca
nipātanāllabhyate | ṭhīdyati' itītvam | janya iti | ṭhaco yat' ityatra
ṭhtakiśasicatiyatijanīnāmupasaṅkhyānam' iti vacanādyat |
āplāvya iti | ṭhorāvaśyake' | āpātya iti | ṭhṛhalorṇyat' ||
laḥ karmaṇi ca bhāve cākarmakebhyaḥ || 3|4|69 ||
ṭhlaḥ' iti laṅlaṭorakārānubandhayoḥ sāmānyena grahaṇamekavacanaṃ
ceti śaṅkāmapākaroti---la ityutsṛṣṭānubandhasāmānyamekaṃ gṛhyata
iti | prathamābahuvacanaṃ caitaditi | sāmānyasyaikatve'pi
ṭhjātyākhyāyāmekasmin bahuvacanam' | athādeśāpekṣayā
ṣaṣṭha|lekavacanaṃ kasmānnāśrīyate---laḥ lasya ya ādeśa iti, yathā---ṭhlaḥ
parasmaipadam' iti ? ucyate; evaṃ vijñāyamāne lādeśānāmanenārtho
nidiśyeta, tataścāmviṣayasya lakārasyārtho na nirdiṣṭaḥ syāt,
lugatrādeśaḥ | na cābāvarūpasya tasyārthādeśanaṃ yujyate, tataścāsau
ṭhkartari kṛt' iti kartaryeva syāt | nanu ca tasya āmaḥ' iti
lukāpahāre satyanuprayoge ye lādeśāstaireva
bhāvādīnāmabhivyaktirbhaviṣyati ? naitadasti; yadā hyamviṣayo lakāraḥ
kartaryeveti sthitam, tadā
virodhādbhāvakarmavācipratyayaparo'nuprayogo naiva prāpnoti,
śrutasyaiva ca saṃbandhopapatāvādeśa ityadhyāhāro na yuktaḥ |
tasmātprathamābahuvacananāntameva yuktam | tatra dvividho
lakāraḥ---tiṅbhāvī, atiṅbhāvī ca | tatra tiṅbhāvaninaḥ
kṛtsaṃjñāniṣedhāt ṭhkartari kṛt' ityasyānupasthānātsvārthe bhāve
vidhānaṃ prāpnoti, atiṅbhāvinastu ṭhkartari kṛt' iti
vacanātkartaryeva sādhutvaṃ prāpnoti, na bhāvakarmaṇoḥ---āsyamānaṃ
śayyamānamityādāviti vacanamidamārabhyate |
nanu ca bhāvakarmaṇorātmanepadaṃ vidhīyate, śeṣātkartari
parasmaipadam, tataśca lakārasya bhāvakarmakartāro'rthā anumāsyante |
yadvā lakārasya prayoge'samavāyādādeśānāmeva te'rthā bhaviṣyanti,
nārtha etena ? ityāśaṅkyāha---sakarmakebhyo bhāve na bhavantīti |
anārabhyamāṇa etasminyathā bhāve vidhīyamānā ghañādayaḥ
sakarmakebhyo'pi bhāve bhavanti---odanasya pākaḥ, sūtrasya kṛtiriti,
tathā ṭhbhāvakarmaṇoḥ, ityanena bhāve ātmanepadaṃ sakarmakebhyo'pi
syāt, tataśtaca pacyate yavagūṃ devadateneti prayogaḥ prāpnoti,
ataḥ ṭhbhāve cākarmakebhyaḥ' iti vakṣyāmītyayamārabdhaḥ | atha tatraiva
ṭhbhāvakarmaṇorakarmakāt' ityucyate, tatrākarmakagrahaṇaṃ kartavyaṃ
syāt, nanu cehāpi kriyate ? ihāvaśyaṃ kartavyam---ṭhtayoreva
kṛtyaktakhalarthā bhāve cākarmakebhyaḥ' iti, tasmātsakarmakebhyo bhāve
mā bhūdityavamarthamayamārambha iti sthitam | kiṃ cāmviṣayasya
lakārasyārthādeśanārthamapīdaṃ vaktavyam; itarathā
pūrvoktadoṣaprasaṅgādityalamiyatā ||
tayoreva kṛtyaktakhalarthāḥ || 3|4|70 ||
tayorbhāvakarmaṇoriti | pūrvasūtre sākṣāt
śrutayorbhāvakarmaṇostacchabdena parāmarśaḥ, na cakāreṇa
saṃnidhāpitasya karturiti bhāvaḥ | ata evotarasūtre punaḥ ṭhkartari
ca' ityuktam | yadi hyanantaravākye cakāreṇa saṃnidhāpitasya
karturbhāvasya cātra ityavamarśaḥ syāt tatra kartṛgrahaṇamanarthakaṃ
syāt ; kartaryanenaiva siddhatvāt | evakāra ityādi |
kṛtvātkartari kṛtyāḥ prāptā evakāreṇa
karturavakṛṣyanteuvyāvartyante | nanu ca takrakauṇḍinyanyāyena na
karturapa karṣo bhaviṣyati, yathā ṭhvaḍavāyā vṛṣe vācye' ityatra
vakṣyate---apatye prāptastato'pakṛṣya vṛṣe vidhīyate, apatye tvaṇeva
bhavati iti ? satyam ; nyāyaprāpta evāthaṃ evakāreṇānūdyate |
śayitamiti | ṭhniṣṭhāśīṅṣvidimidikṣvididhṛṣaḥ'
ityakitvādguṇo bhavati | bhāve cākamakebhya iti vartata iti | vayaṃ
tu brūmaḥ---evakāraḥ karturapakarṣaṇāya na kartavya ityuktam,
tasyātropayogaḥ---yayorbhāvakarmaṇorlakāra
uktastayorevānyūnānatiriktayoḥ kṛtyādayo bhavantīti | yadi ca
sakarmakebhyo bhāve syustayostādṛśayoreva tu na kṛtāḥ syuriti
||
ādikarmaṇi ktaḥ kartari ca || 3|4|71 ||
karmadhārayaḥ, karmaśabdaśca kriyāvacana ityāha---ādibhūtaḥ kriyākṣaṇa
ādikarmeti | sādhanakarma tu na gṛhyate, ādiśabdena viśeṣaṇāt |
bahūnāṃ samavāye ādimadhyāntabhāvaḥ, sādhanakarma katvemeveti ki
tatrādiśabdena | tasminnādikarmaṇi bhūtatvena vivakṣita iti | etena
ṭhniṣṭhā' ityanenaivādikarmaṇi ktaḥ siddhaḥ, na punarādikarmaṇi niṣṭhā
vaktavyeti darśayati | ādye hi kriyākṣaṇe bhūte
samūharūpāropādekadeśe samūhe ceti nyāyādvā dhātvartha eva bhūto
bhavatīti yukta eva ktaḥ | prakṛtaḥ kaṭṃa devadata iti | prārabdhavānityathaḥ
| prakṛtaṃ devadateneti | atra karmaṇo'vivakṣitatvena
dhātorakarmakatvādbhāva eva ktaḥ | evaṃ prabhuktaṃ devadatenetyatrāpi ||
gatyarthākarmakaśliṣaśīṅsthāsavasajanaruhajīryatibhyaśca || 3|4|72 ||
anūṣita iti | ṭhvasati kṣudhoriṭ' | anuprāpya jāto'nujātaḥ |
evamanujīrṇaḥ | sakarmakebhyaḥ karmāvivakṣāyāṃ bhāve ktaḥ ||
dāśagoghnau saṃmpadāne || 3|4|73 ||
goghna iti | atra dānapūrvake hanena hantirvartate | arghārha iti |
arghaḥumadhuparkaḥ, tadaṅgatvena gohananaṃ vihitam | etāvad
gorālambhanasthānam---atithiḥ, pitaraḥ, vivāhaśceti | yadi
sampradāne goghna iti nipātyate cāṇḍālāderapi tenābhidhānaṃ
prāpnoti, asmai api hyāgatāya gāṃ dātumarhanti suhṛdādayaḥ ? ata
āha---nipātanasāmarthyāditi | asatyapi ceti | yathā'pacannapi
yogyatayā ṭhpācakaḥ' ityucyate, tathehāpītyarthaḥ ||
bhīmādayo'pādāne || 3|4|74 ||
uṇādipratyayāntā eta iti | bāhulyādetaduktam,
praskandanaprapatanayorapyauṇādikatvāt | tābhyāmanyatroṇādaya iti
paryudāse prāpta iti | yadyapyasatyasminsūtre'pādānasya
prakṛtatvātābhyāmiti nirdeśo nopapadyo tathāpyayamarthastāvatatra
vaktavyaḥ---tato'pādānāccānyatroṇādaya iti, tataśca syādeva
paryudāsa ityarthaḥ ||
tābhyāmanyatroṇādayaḥ || 3|4|75 ||
nanu ca ṭhanyatroṇādayaḥ' ityapyukte prakṛtatvādeva tābhyāmanyatreti
vijñāsyate ? ata āha---sampradānārtha iti | kṛṣita ityādinā karmaṇi
vṛttiṃ darśayati | atreḍāgamaścintyaḥ | evaṃ tanita ityatrāapi |
kecidāhuḥ---ṭhyasya vibhāṣā' itīṭpratiṣedho'nityaḥ,
kṛtinṛtyorīditkaraṇāt | taddhi ṭhśvīdito niṣṭhāyām'
itiṭpratiṣedhārthaṃ kriyate tatra ṭhse'sici kṛti' iti
vibhāaṣiteṭtvādeva ṭhyasya vibhāṣā' itīṭpratiṣedho
bhaviṣyatīti kimīditkaraṇena |
apara āha---curādāvadantau kṛpitanī paṭhitavyāviti ||
kto'dhikaraṇe ca dhrauvyagatipratyavasānārthebhyaḥ || 3|4|76 ||
svanikāyaprasiddhiriti | yathā yūpacaṣālādayo yājñikānāmeva
prasiddhāstathā vaiyākaraṇānāṃ nikāye eṣāṃ prasiddhiḥ | nighaṇṭuaṣu tu
abhyavahāraparyāyatayā pratyavasānaśabdasya pāṭho
vaiyākaraṇaprasiddhimūlaḥ | idameṣāmāsitamiti | ṭhadhikaraṇavācinaśca'
iti ṣaṣṭhī |
kathamityādi | kartari niṣṭhāṃ manyamānasya praśnaḥ | akāro matvarthīya
iti | arśāaderākṛtigaṇatvādac pratyaya ityarthaḥ |
iha dvirgatyarthākarmakagrahaṇaṃ ca ktagrahaṇaṃ ca kriyate, sakṛdeva tu śakyaṃ
kartum, katham ? evaṃ vakṣyāmi---ṭhktvo'dhikaraṇe ca
dhrauvyagatipratyavasānārthebhyaḥ, tato gatyarthākarmakebhyaḥ kartari ca,
cakārādadhikaraṇe ca, anuvṛtāccakārādyathāprāptaṃ ca, tataḥ
śliṣaśīṅsthāsavasajanaruhajīryatibhyaśca, kartarītyeva, etebhyaśca
kartari kto bhavati cakārādyathāprāptaṃ ca, adhigrahaṇagrahaṇaṃ tu
nātrānuvartate, yogavibhāgakaraṇasāmarthyāt, tata ādikarmaṇi ca
kartari kto bhavati cakārādyathāprāptaṃ ca, tato dāśagoghnāvityādi ?
tathā tu na kṛtamityeva ||
lasya || 3|4|77 ||
akāra uccāraṇārtha iti | nānubandhaḥ, anyathā laṅlaṃṭoreva grahaṇaṃ
syāt ; tataśca parasmaipadānāṃ ṇalādayaḥ, ṭhloṭo laṅvat',
ṭheruḥ' ityādikāryavidhānamanupapannaṃ syāt ;
liṅloṭostibādīnāmabhāvāt | lakāramātraṃ
sthānitvenādhikriyata iti | nanu cetsaṃjñāyāṃ lopaḥ prāpnoti ?
vacanasāmarthyātsatyāmapītsaṃjñāyāṃ lopo na bhaviṣyati | evamapi
litsvaraḥ prāpnoti ? ṇalo litkaraṇaṃ jñāpakam---na lādeśeṣu
litsvaro bhavatīti | kiñcedamiti | lakāramātrasya grahaṇaṃ
prāpnotīti manyamānasya praśnaḥ | ṭhdhātvadhikāro'nuvartate' iti
vakṣyamāṇābhiprāyeṇāha---daśa lakārā iti | akṣarasamāmnāye
yayānupūrvyā'kārādayaḥṣa
tadānupūrvoviśiṣṭairakārādibhiranubandhaiḥ kathyante; na tu
vidhānakrameṇetyarthaḥ |
lakāramātrasya grahaṇaṃ kasmānna prāpnotīti |
viśeṣānupādānātprāpnotyeveti bhāvaḥ | varṇagrahaṇeṣu
cārthavadgrahaṇaparibhāṣā na pravartate, tathā ca yasyeti
lopo'narthakasyāpi bhavati---daivadatiriti, akurvahyatreti yaṇādeśaḥ
| dhātvadhikāro'nuvartata iti | dhātugrahaṇamanuvartata ityarthaḥ |
evamapyagnicillunāti---atrāpi prāpnoti ? vihitaviśeṣaṇaṃ
dhātugrahaṇam | evamapi ṭhśāmāmalibhyo laḥ' auṇādikaḥ---śālā,
mālā, mallaḥ, atrāpi prāpnoti ? uṇādayo'vyutpannāni
prātipadikāni | tathāpi parihārāntaramāha---kartrādaya iti | ṭhlaḥ
karmaṇi ca' ityatra nirdiṣṭā arthāḥ kartṛkarmabhāvā ihānuvartante,
taiśca lakāro viśiṣyate---kartrādiṣu vihitasya lasyeti, tena
viśiṣṭaviṣayasyaiva lasya grahaṇam, na sarvasya ||
tiptasjhisipthasthāmabvasmastātāṃjhathāsāthāṃdhvamiḍvahimahiṅ ||
3|4|78 ||
tibādīnāṃ samāhāradvandvaḥ | pakāraḥ svarārtha iti |
pradarśanametat, ṭhsārvadhātukamapit' ityādyapi prayojanam |
iṭaṣṭakāra ityādi | nanu ṭhiṭo't' ityatra liṅtyinuvartate,
tenekārasyātvavidhāne'pi nāstyatiprasaṅgaḥ ? evamapi
tibādyavayavasya prāpnoti, yathā ṭheruḥ' ityetalloṭa ityanuvṛtāvapi
tibādyavayasya bhavati | na hi tatrāvayavaṣaṣṭhī, liṅ iti tu
sthānaṣaṣṭhītyatra pramāṇamasti | atha ṭhādyantau ṭakitau' iti
deśavidhyarthaṣṭakāraḥ kasmānna bhavatītyāha---tibādimirityādi |
tulyatvamusadṛśatvam, taccaikayoganirdiṣṭatvena lasyetyekā ṣaṣṭhī,
tatra tibādayaḥ saptadaśādeśāḥ sthāne yogaṃ prayojayanti, tāneko
notsahate vihantumityarthaḥ | mahiṅe ṅkāra ityādi |
tiṅtyupilakṣaṇam | taṅtyipi pratyāhāro bhavati | cinumahe
ityādau tu guṇapratiṣedhārtho na bhavati ; sārvadhātukamapit'
ityanenaiva siddhatvāt | yatra hyārdhadhātukameṣiṣimahīti, tatra
ṅtvārthiḥ kasmānna bhavati ? pratyāhāre caritārthasya
samudāyānubandhasyāvayavānubandhatve pramāṇābhāvāt | tṛni katham
? tasyāpi hi nakāra ṭhna lokāvyaya' ityatra pratyāhāre caritārthaḥ,
ṭhauṅ āpaḥ' ityatra ca vakṣyate---ṭhsāmānyagrahaṇārtho ṅkāraḥ, anyathā
niranubandhakasya prathamādvivacanasyaiva grahaṇaṃ syād, na
sānubandhakasyauṭaḥ' iti, tacca virudhyate; tasyāpi ṭakārasya suḍiti
pratyāhāre caritārthatayā aukārasya niranubandhakatvāt |
tasmānmahiṅe ṅkāraḥ pratyāhārārthaḥ, na tvavayavānubandha
ityācāryāṇāṃ smṛtiparamparaivātra śaraṇam ||
ṭita ātmanepadānāṃ ṭere || 3|4|79 ||
ṭito lakārasya sthāane iti | etena ṭitaḥ, ātmanepadānāmiti
vyadhikaraṇe ṣaṣṭha|laviti darśayati | yadi tu
pratyekasaṃbandhādekavacanamityāśritya
ṭitāmātmanepadānāmityāśrīyate, akurvītyatrāpi prasajyeteti bhāvaḥ
|
prakṛtairityādi | ya ete tibādayaḥ prakṛtāsteṣāaṃ madhye
yānyātmanepadāni vihitānītyevamātmanepadāni viśiṣyante | na ca
tibādīnāṃ madhye śānac sanniviśiṣṭastato na tasya prasaṅga
ityarthaḥ | evaṃ ca taṅamityeva vaktavyam | kecitu ṭhāne muk' iti
nirdeśaṃ jñāpakaṃ varṇayanti---tiṅamevaitvaṃ nānyeṣāmiti; itarathā
hyānayīti vaktavyaṃ syāt | neti vayam, yo'lādeśa ānaḥ
ṭhpūṅyajoḥ śānan' tasyāyaṃ nirdeśaḥ syād---vayamānaḥ, yajamāna
iti ||
thāsaḥ se || 3|4|80 ||
peciṣe iti | liṭ, ṭhata ekahalamadhye' ityādinā etvābhyāsalopau,
krādiniyamādiṭ | iha ṭhthaḥ saḥ' iti vaktavyam, thakārasya sakāre
kṛte parabhāgasya ṭeretve sati siddhamiṣṭam | pacathaḥ pacatha atrāpi
prāpnoti ? ṭhātmanepadānām' iti vartate | evamapyāthāmasthakārasya
prāpnoti ? dhātoriti vartate---dhātoranantaro yasthakāra iti |
ihāpi tahi na prāpnoti---pacase, cinuṣe iti ? vikaraṇena
vyavadhānāt | kva tarhi syāt ? ya ete lugvikaraṇāḥ,
śluvikaraṇāḥ, śnamvikaraṇāḥ | tasmāt ṭhthāsaḥ se' iti vaktavyam |
evamapi saśabda evādeśo vidheyo ṭeretvenaiva siddham ?
jñāpakārtham | etajjñāpayati---ātmanepadānāṃ ya ādeśāsteṣāṃ
ṭeretvaṃ na bhavatīti | tena paktā, paktārau, paktāra iti
ḍāraurasāmetvaṃ na bhavati ||
liṭastajhayoreśirec || 3|4|81 ||
pūrvasūtre jñāpitam---ātmanepadādeśānāṃ ṭeretvaṃ na bhavatīti,
tena iśirac ityetāvādeśau na vihitau | śakāraḥ sarvādeśārtha
iti | anyathā dhātorityadhikārād ṭhādeḥ parasya'iti takārasya
prasajyeta | atha ṭhśe' ityeva kasmānnoktam, śairejiti hyukte
mātrālāghavaṃ bhavati ? naivaṃ śakyam ; ṭhśe' iti pragṛhyasaṃjñā syāt |
iha ca pape somamiti pibādeśaḥ prāpnoti, jagle mamle ityādau
cātvaṃ na syāt | eśi tu na doṣaḥ, ṭhvarṇe yatsyātacca
vidhyātadādau' iti nyāyāt ||
parasmaipadānāṃ ṇalatususthalathusaṇalvamāḥ || 3|4|82 ||
tibādīnāmiti | etacca prakaraṇāllabhyate, tena kvasorṇalādayo na
bhavanti, vidhānasāmarthyādvā kvasorṇalādyabhāvaḥ | lakāraḥ svārtha iti |
anyathā pratyayasya pitvādanudātatve'pi dhātusvare kṛte dviḥ
prayogo dvirvacanamiti dvayorapyudātatvaṃ prāpnoti | ṭhanudātaṃ
padamekavarjam' iti nāsti, yaugapadyena sambhavaḥ paryāyeṇa prasajyeta |
ṇakāro vṛddhyartha iti | idamanyathāsiddham, ṭhṇalutamo vā' ityatra
yogavibhāgaḥ---al ṇidbhavatīti, tata utamo vā---vā
ṇidbhavatīti | papāceti | kathamayaṃ sarvādaśaḥ, yāvatā
ṭhnānubandhakṛtamanekāltvam', tataśca ṭhdhātoḥ' ityadhikārād
ṭhādeḥ parasya' iti vakārasya prāpnoti ? anitvātsiddham ? na hyayaṃ
ṇalvidhānasamaye pratyaya ityanitvād
ṇakārasyānekālatvātsarvādeśaḥ, tato
ṇakārasyotsaṃjñetyānupūrvyātsiddham | nanu ca ṇakāro na kartavya
ityuktam ? evaṃ tarhi lakāra ādau kriyate tasyāpyanitvātsiddham, la
utamo veti vaktavyam, evam āta au lasyeti, halṅyādisūtre
cāpyapṛktaṃ haliti halgrahaṇaṃ liṅgaṃ sarvādaśo ṇaliti, taddhi
papācetyādau mā bhūditi | sarvādeśatve ca tadupapadyate |
papaktheti | krādiniyamātprāpta iṭ ṭhupadeśe'tvataḥ' iti
pratiṣedhānna bhavati | kvacitpecitheti pāṭhaḥ, ṭhṛto bhāradvājasya' iti
niyamādiṭ, ṭhthali ca seṭi' ityetvābhyāsalopo | peceti |
dhātorityadhikārāt ṭhtasmādityutarasya ṭhādeḥ parasya' iti
thakārasyākāre dvayorato guṇe pararūpatvam ||
vido laṭo vā || 3|4|83 ||
vida jñāne iti |
satāvicārārthayostvātmanepaditvātibādīnāmasambhavaḥ,
lābhārthasyāpi vikaraṇena vyavadhānādanantarāṇāmasambhava iti bhāvaḥ ||
bruvaḥ pañcānāmādita āho bruvaḥ || 3|4|84 ||
pañca ṇalādaya iti | ādeśā api pañcaiva, tatrāpyādito ṇalādayaḥ
pañca, na punaricchātaḥ pañcetyarthaḥ | kathaṃ punadvitīyaṃ
pañcagrahaṇamādigrahaṇaṃ cāntareṇādeśeṣvayaṃ viśeṣo labhyate, nanu
sarvaireva ṇalādibhiḥ pañcānāṃ sthāne yuktambhavitum ? ucyate;
pūrvasūtre tāvadyathāsaṅkhyaṃ pravartate, tataśca tatraiva nirjñātaḥ
sthāniviśeṣeṇa ṇalādīnāṃ sambandhaḥ, ta evehānuvartanta ityatrāpi
tathaiva bhaviṣyati, tataśca sthānisambandhāditi pūrvasūtre
sthāniviśeṣeṇa sambandhasya nirjñātatvādityarthaḥ | āttheti | ṭhāhasthaḥ'
| pareṣāmiti | thādīnām | nanu ca ṭhbruvaḥ' iti yadetatpañcamyantaṃ
tadevārthādvibhaktivipariṇāmo bhavatītyādeśasambandhe ṣaṣṭha|lntaṃ
vijñāsyate, nārtho bruva iti punarvacanena ? tatrāha---bruva iti |
punarvacanamityādi | parasmaipadānāmeva hi syāditi | asati śrute
sambandhini vibhaktivipariṇāmo bhavati, iha tu parasmaipadānāmiti
śrutatvāteṣāmeva syādityarthaḥ ||
loṭo laṅvat || 3|4|85 ||
loṭo laṅvatkāryaṃ bhavatīti | atra loḍādeśeṣu loṭśabdo
vartate, laṅadeśeṣu ca laṅśabdaḥ, loḍādeśānāṃ laṅadeśavatkāryaṃ
bhavatītyarthaḥ, tadāha---tāmādayaḥ salopaśceti | yadyapyete
laṅyāhatya na vihitāstathāpi laṅdṛṣṭitvādatidiśyante | aḍāṭau
kasmānna bhavati iti | laṅyevāhatya vihitatvāt, pratyuta
tacorevātideśo yukta iti praśnaḥ | tathā jherjusādeśa iti |
kasmānna bhavatīti vibhaktivipariṇāmenānuṣaṅgaḥ | ṭhlaṅḥ
śākaṭāyanasya' iti jusbhāvo'pi laṅ evāhatya vihitaḥ | iha tu
jāgratu, vidantu ṭhsijabhyastavidibhyaśca' iti laṅ dṛṣṭo jusbhāviḥ
prāpnoti | vāgrahaṇamanuvartata iti | loṭa ityupameye
ṣaṣṭhīnirdeśādupamānaṃ paṣṭha|lntaṃ vijñāyate---laṅe yatkāryaṃ
talloṭo bhavatīti, na tu laṅ yitkāryaṃ talloṭītyaḍāṭoḥ
parihārāntaram | jherjusbhāvasya tu parihārāntaram ṭhlaṅḥ
śākaṭāyanasya' ityatra svayameva vakṣyati ||
eruḥ || 3|4|86 ||
loḍādeśānāmikārasyeti | atha tu---loḍādeśo ya ikārastasya
ityartho'bhipretaḥ syādiṭa ityeva brūyāta, ṭhtuhyoḥ
vidāṅkurvantu' iti ca nirdeśo'nupapannaḥ syād |
athedānīmiṭo'pi vyapadeśivadbhāvenetvaṃ kasmānna bhavati ? punaḥ
prasaṅgavijñānāt ṭeretvaṃ bhaviṣyati | na voccāraṇasāmarthyāditi
| yadi hinyorutvaṃ syāt ṭhserhuḥ' ṭhmernuḥ' ityeva brūyād,
evaṃ hi prakriyālāghavaṃ bhavatīti bhāvaḥ | ṭhāni loṭ', hujhalbhyo
hedhiḥ' iti liṅgaṃ hinayorutvābhāvasya ||
serhyapicca || 3|4|87 ||
lunīhīti | pitvābhāvānḍitve sati ṭhī halyaghoḥ' itītvaṃ bhavati |
rāghnuhītyatra guṇābhāvaḥ | iha sehirṅcceiti vaktavyam | nanvevaṃ
ṅtvāniṅitkāryaṃ bhavatu, sthānivadbhāvena
pitvamapyastītyanudātatvamapi prāpnoti ? ṭhṅcci pinna bhavati' iti
vacanānna bhaviṣyati, yathā---api stuyādrājānamiti, atra ṭhuto
vṛddhirluki hali' iti piti vidhīyamānā vṛddhirna bhavati |
brūtādbhavāniti, bruva iṇna bhavati | kiṃ ca nāprapte pitve
ṅtvimārabhyamāṇaṃ tadvādhiṣyate ||
vācchandasi || 3|4|88 ||
apitvaṃ vikalpyata iti | anantaratvāt | nādeśa iti,
vyavahitatvāt | yuyodhīti | ṭhbahulaṃ cchandasi' iti śapaḥ ślau
dvirvacanam | atra pitvān ṅtvābhāve ṭhiṅtiśca' iti dhibhāvaḥ ||
merniḥ || 3|4|89 ||
utvalopayorapavāda iti | yathākramam ṭheruḥ' ṭhloṭo laṅvat' iti
prāptayoḥ, ṭhitaśca' itīkāralopasyāpi laṅ dṛṣṭitvādatideśataḥ
prāptiḥ | vayaṃ tu brūmaḥ---ṭhloṭo laṅvat' iti
prāptasyāmādeśasyāpavāda iti ||
āmetaḥ || 3|4|90 ||
loṭsambandhina iti | loḍādeśasambandhina ityarthaḥ | etena
loṭaikāro viśeṣyata iti darśayati | ekāreṇa tu loṭi
viśeṣyamāṇe tadantavidhau satyekārāntasya loṭa
āmvidhīyamāno'nekāltvātsarvādeśaḥ syāt, tatra hi
ṭhnirdiśyamānasyādeśā bhavanti' iti parihāro vācyaḥ syādityarthaḥ ||
āḍutamasya picca || 3|4|92 ||
sa cotamapuruṣaḥ pidbhavatīti | āṭa eva pitvaṃ kasmānna vijñāyate,
tulyavibhaktikayohi yuktaḥ sambandhaḥ---āṭ piditi ? nirthakatvāt
| anudātatvaṃ tāvadāgamatvādeva siddham ; karavāṇi, mārjānītyādau
guṇavṛddhyorapi pratyaya eva nimitaṃ na tvāgamaḥ ||
eta te || 3|4|93 ||
iha kasmāditi | guṇasyāntavadbhāvena loḍgrahaṇena grahaṇādasti
prasaṅga iti bhāvaḥ | bahiraṅgalakṣaṇatvāditi | dvipadāśrayatvād
guṇasya bahiraṅgatvam, aikārastvekapadāśrayatvādantaraṅgaḥ, ata eva
hetoḥ ṭhāmetaḥ' ityayamapi vidhirna bhavati ||
leṭo'ḍāṭau || 3|4|94 ||
paryāyeṇati | na yaugapadyena; aḍvidhānasāmarthyāt, anyathā
savarṇadīrghatve satyaḍvidhānamakiñcitkaraṃ syāt |
āta e || 3|4|95 ||
karavaite iti | ṭhcchandasyubhayathā' iti sārvadhātukatvādvikaraṇaḥ,
ārddhadhātukatvān ṅtvābhāve ivikaraṇasya guṇaḥ,
karoteścotvābhāvaḥ, pavaite, aśnavaithe, pravaite, vigranthaithe ||
vaito'nyatra || 3|4|96 ||
etadviṣayamiti | ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ | evaṃviṣayamiti tu yuktaḥ pāṭhaḥ |
udāharaṇāni ṭhupasaṃvādāśaṅkayośca' ityatra vyutpāditāni |
dadhasa iti | ṭhthāsaḥ se', śapaḥ śnuḥ, aṭ, ṭhghorlopo leṭi vā'
ityākāralopaḥ ||
itaśca lopaḥ parasmaipadeṣu || 3|4|97 ||
parasmaipadagrahaṇamityādi | anyathā ṭeretvasyāvakāśaḥ---anye lakārāḥ,
leṭa|lpīkārādanyatra ito lopasya---parasmaipadāni;
iḍādiṣūbhayaprasaṅge paratvādito lopaḥ syāt ||
sa utamasya || 3|4|98 ||
karavāva, karavāmeti | pūrvavadguṇotvābhāvau, ṭhleṭo'ḍāṭau'
ityāṭ | utaragrahaṇamityādi | iha vasmasgrahaṇameva kartavyam |
ṭhtatrāyamapyarthaḥ---sa iti na vaktavyaṃ bhavati, ṭhalo'ntyasya' ityeva
siddham | yadā ca puruṣāntarasya sthāne vasmasau bhavataḥ, etayośca
sthāne sakārāntaṃ puruṣāntaram, tadāpi vāgrahaṇānuvṛtyaiva
lopālopau yathādarśanaṃ vyavasthitau bhaviṣyataḥ |
yathākriyamāṇe'pyutama prahaṇe vāgrahaṇaṃ cānuvartate, utaratra
nityagrahaṇaṃ syāt ṭhnityaṃ ṅtiḥ' ||
liṅḥ sīyuṭ || 3|4|102 ||
liṅśabdo'tra liṅadeśeṣu sthānivadbhāvāt prayukta ityāha
liṅadeśānāmiti | sīyuṭsakārasyārdhadātuke liṅ śrivaṇam,
sārvadhātuke ṭhliṅḥ salopo'ntyasya' iti salopaḥ |
yakārasyājādiṣu śravaṇam, anyatra lopaḥ ||
yāsuṭ parasmaipadeṣūdāto ṅcci || 3|4|103 ||
parasmaipadaviṣayasyeti | liṅḥ pareṣā parasmaipadānāmasambhavāt |
sīyuṭo'pavāda iti | nāprāpte tasminnārambhāt, tena yāsuṭi
kṛte tasya tiṅbhaktatvātadādeḥ sīyuṭprasaṅga iti na
codanīyam | satyapi hi sambhave sāmānyavidhervaśeṣavidhirbādhakaḥ |
kathaṃ tarhi kṛṣīṣṭa ityādiṣu suṭi kṛte sīyuḍ bhavati, nanu
tatrāpi suṭā sīṃyuḍ bādhanīyaḥ ? atra parihāraṃ suḍvidhau
vṛttikāraḥ svayameva vakṣyati | āgamatvādanudātatvai prāpta iti | ata
eva yāsuḍudātavacanādvijñāyate---āgamā anudātā bhavantīti, anyathā
yāsuṭaḥ pratyayabhaktatvātpratyayasvareṇaiva siddhamudātatvam | naitadasti
jñāpakam, yāni pidvacanāni tadarthametatsyāt |
yadyetāvatprayojanam, apidityeva brūyāt ! tadetadudātavacanaṃ
jñāpakameva---āgamā anudātā bhavantīti | tatra tatkāryāṇāṃ
sambhavāditi | grahijyādisūtre'pi dhātoḥ svarūpagrahaṇe tatpratyayo
kāryavijñānātpratyayasyaiva grahaṇam | kuryāditi | vikaraṇāśrayo
dhātorguṇaḥ, ṭhata utsārvadhātuke' ityutvam, ṭhye ca' ityukāralopaḥ
| kuryuriti | jherjus, ṭhliṅḥ salopo'nantyasya'
ṭhusyapadāntāt' |
sthānividbhāvādeveti | ṭhsārvadhātukamapit' ityatideśāditi
noktam ; pidarthatvān canamya | yāsuṭo canamiti |
yāsuḍāderliṅe canamityarthaḥ | idānīmeva hyuktam--ṅtviṃ tu
liṅ eva vidhīyate iti ? etacca jñāpanam---ṭhpicca ṅnni bhavati'
ityetadanāśrityocyate | tadākṣayaṇe tu sthānivadbhāvena prāptaṃ
ṅtvimaupadeśikena pitvena bādhyate iti prāptyarthameva canaṃ
syāt ||
kidāśiṣi || 3|4|104 ||
tasya yāsuṭ|||kidvadbhavatīti | tasya yāsuḍ bhavati sa ca
liṅkidvadbhavatītyarthaḥ | anyathā ṭhpratyayasyedaṃ kitvam'
ityanantaragranthena virodhaḥ syāt | prayojanābhāvāditi |
ṭhvacisvapi' ityatrāpi ṭhdhātoḥ svarūpagrahaṇe' iti pratyasyaivedaṃ grahaṇaṃ
syāt; anyathā vācyati vācikaṃ kathayati, vāgjahātītyatrāpi syāt
| guṇavṛddhipratiṣedhastulya iti | kimarthaṃ tarhi kitvavidhānamityata
āha---samprasāraṇamiti | jagaryāditi | ṭhjāgro'viciṇṇalṅtsu' īti
guṇaḥ ||
jhasya ran || 3|4|105 ||
jhasyetyakāroccāraṇātsaṅghātasyaiva grahaṇaṃ na varṇasya,
anyathāntādeśavidhāviva ṭhjhaḥ' ityeva brūyāditi manyamāna
āha---liṅadeśasya jhasyeti | jho'ntāpavāda iti | jhakārasya
yo'ntādeśastasyāpavāda ityarthaḥ | ṭhjho'ntaḥ' ityasya vā vidherapavāda
ityarthaḥ | nanu jhavarṇasyāntādeśaḥ samudāyasya ranniti kathaṃ
bhinnaviṣayayorbādhyabādhakabhāvaḥ ? virodhāt, yena
nāprāptinyāyācca | jho'ntāpavāda ityupalakṣaṇam ; kṛṣīran,
tṛṣīrannityatra ṭhātmanepadeṣvanataḥ' ityasyāpyapavādaḥ | nanu
cāpavadāvipratiṣedhādadbhāva eva prāpnoti, na;
pratipadavidherbalīyastvāt, pratipadavihito hi ranbhāvaḥ |
yadvā---kṛṣīran, tṛṣīrannityatrāpi pravartatāmadbhāvaḥ, satyapi tu
tasminpunaḥ prasaṅgavijñānātsaṅghātasya ran bhaviṣyati ||
iṭo't || 3|4|106 ||
naivāyamādeśāvayava iti | te nāstetsaṃjñayā prayojanam, svayameva
nivṛtatvādityarthaḥ | pratyutesaṃjñāyāṃ svaritatvaṃ syāt, ṭhna
vibhaktau tusmāḥ' ityatrābhyupagamavādenoktam---ṭhkimodiṭoditi
cātra prāteṣedho na bhavatyanityatvādasya' iti | arthavadgrahaṇa ityādi
| la sthāne ya iḍiti viśeṣaṇādapyāgamasyeṭo grahaṇābhāvaḥ ||
suṭ tithoḥ || 3|4|107 ||
ṭhtithoḥ' iti saptamī vā syāt ? ṣaṣṭhī vā ? ādye pakṣe
ṭhyasminvidhistadādāvalgrahaṇe' iti takārathakāroderliṅadeśasya
suṭā bhāvyamiti kṛṣīṣṭa kṛṣīṣṭhā ityatraiva syāt, kṛṣīyāstāṃ
kṛṣīyāsthāmityatra na syāt; suṭā ca sīyuṭo bādhaḥ syāt,
ubhayorapi liṅādeśabhaktatvāditi dvitīyaṃ
pakṣamāśrityāha---liṅsambandhinostakārathakārayoriti | etadeva
spaṣṭayati---takārathakārāviti | liṅ tadviśeṣaṇamiti |
liṅśabdena tadādeśā ucyante | evaṃ liṅsaṃbandhinorityatrāpi
kṛṣīṣṭeti | vidhyādau liṅ sārvidhātukatvāt ṭhliṅḥ salopaḥ'
iti lopena suṭaḥ śravaṇābhāvādāśiṣu liṇeóvodāhṛtaḥ ||
jherjus || 3|4|108 ||
jho'ntāpavāda iti | pūrvavad vyākhyeyam | jāgṛyurityādau ca
pūrvavadeva ṭhadabhyastāt' ityasyāpi bādhaḥ | paceyuriti | ṭhato
yeyaḥ' itīyādeśaḥ, śapā saha ṭhādguṇaḥ' ||
sijabhyastavidibhyaśca || 3|4|109 ||
satāvicāraṇārthayorvidorātmanepaditvādasambhava eva jheḥ,
lābhārthasyāpi vikaraṇena vyavadhānādanantarasya jherasambhavaḥ,
tasmāllugvikaraṇasyaiva vidergrahaṇamityāha---veteśceti |
abhyastavidigrahaṇamasijarthamiti | na caivaṃ loḍādiṣvapi prasaṅga
ityāha---ṅti iti cānuvartata iti ||
ātaḥ || 3|4|110 ||
sica ākārāntācca parasya jheriti | dvābhyāmanantarasyetyarthaḥ |
kathamiti | ātaḥ sicā vyavadhānād dvābhyāmānantarya na sambhavatīti
praśnaḥ | sijlugantād jherjus bhavatītyuktaṃ bhavati | abhūvanniti |
ṭhbhuvo vugluṅliṭoḥ' iti vuk | tulyajātīyāpekṣatvācceti |
dvābhyāmānantaryasyāśravaṇāt sijlugantasya grahaṇamityuktam |
tena---sijlugantādyadi bhavati āta eveti niyamāśrayaṇāt śrūyamāṇe
sici akārṣurityādāvanākārāntādapi bhavatyevetyarthaḥ ||
laṅḥ śākaṭāyanasyaiva || 3|4|111 ||
ayuḥ, avuriti | śapo luk, ṭhusyapadāntāt' iti pararūpatvam ||
laṇeóveti | luḍliṅestāvadbhavitavyam, lṛṅstu syapratyayena
jhervyavadhānamiti bhāvaḥ | yāntu, vāntviti | ṭhloṭo laṅvat'
ityatra tu vāgrahaṇānuvṛtyāpyayamarthaḥ sādhitaḥ | nanu ca
laṅgrahaṇādyatnajjusbhāvo'yaṃ loṭo mā bhūt, ṭhsijabhyasta' ityayaṃ
tu syādeva ? tatrāha---sijabhyastetyādi |
kathamityatrāha---jusbhāvamātraṃ hīti | kathaṃ punaḥ ṭhātaḥ'
ityanuvartamāne jusbhāvamātraṃ mukhyena laṅa śakyaṃ viśeṣayitum ?
ṭhlaṅḥ' iti yogavibhāgaḥ kartavya iti manyate | nanu ca ṭhāta
ityetatsijgrahaṇānuvṛtyā niyamārtham' ityuktam ,
tataścāyurityatra kenacidaprāptatvādvidhyarthametatkimevakāreṇa ?
ityatrāha---evakāra utarārtha iti | ṭhliṭ ca', ṭhliṅaśiṣi' ityatrāsya
prayojanaṃ darśayiṣyati || 
dviṣaśca || 3|4|112 ||
dviṣiradādiḥ ||

tarati nayatīti | tiṅḥ sārvadhātukatvācchap, śapaḥ
sārvadhātukatvāddhātorguṇaḥ | roditīti | śapo luki ṭhrudādibhyaḥ

||
ārdhadhātukaṃ śeṣaḥ || 3|4|114 ||
dhātusaṃśabdaneneti | dhātuśabdamuccāryetyarthaḥ | atra hi yaṅvidhau
yaddhātugrahaṇaṃ śamidhātoriti vā, yacca dhātoriti,
tadubhayamanuvartate; tatraikenādhātupratyayo vyāvartyate, apareṇa
dhātupratyayo viśiṣyate, dhātorityevaṃ yo vihita iti,
tenāyamarthaḥ | lūbhyām, lubhiḥ, jugupsate iti | yadyapyatra dhātoreva
vihistathāpi dhātuśabdamuccārya na vihita iti bhavati
pratyudāharaṇam | śeṣagrahaṇam---tiṅśitormā bhūta;
anyathaikasaṃjñādhikārābhāvātpratyayādisaṃjñānāmiva samāveśaḥ syāt |
sadyevakāro'nuvartate śakyaṃ śeṣagrahaṇamakartum ||
liṭ ca || 3|4|115 ||
pecitha, śekitheti | ṭhṛto bhāradvājasya' iti niyamādiṭ, ṭhthali
ca' seṭi' ityetvābhyāsalopau | jagle mamla iti | ārdhadhātukatvāt
ṭhāto lopa iṭi ca' ityākāralopaḥ |
yaduktam---sārvadhātukasaṃjñāyā apavāda iti, tadvighaṭayati---nanu
ceti | satyamityādinā apavādatvaṃ samarthayate ||
cchandasyubhayathā || 3|4|117 ||
sarvameva prakaraṇamiti | ṭhtiṅasitsārvadhātukam' ityārabhya catuḥ
sūtrīprakaraṇam |
bhūbhāvo na bhavatīti | tadānībhevārdhadhātukatvāt
ṭhśnasorallopaḥ' ityasyābhāvaḥ ||
iti śrīharadatamiśraviracitāyāṃ padamañjaryāṃ tṛtīyādhyāyasya caturthaḥ

padamañjarī 
ṅyāpprātipadikāt || 4|1|1 ||
adhikāro'yamiti | vidheyaparibhāṣyayoranirdeśādvakṣyamāṇānāṃ ca
svādīnāṃ prakṛtyapekṣatsvaritatvācca | ā
pañcamādhyāyaparisamāpteriti | adhikārasyāvadhiṃ darśayati |
adhikāro'nekaprakāraḥ----saṃjñādhikāraḥ, viśeṣaṇādhikāraḥ,
prakṛtyadhikāraśceti, tatra kīdṛso'yamadhikāraḥ ? ityata
āha---svādiṣu kapparyanteṣu prakṛtiradhikrayate iti |
ṭābḍāpcāpāmāvritīti | sāmānyahaṇamityanuṣaṅgaḥ |
samāhāranirddeśa iti | samāhāradvandvena teṣāṃ ṅyādīnāmayaṃ
nirdeśa ityarthaḥ | tataśca samāhārasyaikatvādekavacanameva yuktam, na
bahuvacanamiti bhāvaḥ |
kimarthamidamucyate ? ṅyāpprātipadikātpare svādayo yathā
syuriti kevalānāṃ prayogo mā bhūt | ṭhparaśca' iti
vacanātkevalānāṃ prayogo na bhaviṣyati ? idaṃ tarhi
prayojanam---ṅyāpprātipadikādeva yathā syurita prakṛtyantarānmā
bhūvan | asatihyasminnadhikāre dhātuḥ, tiṅntam, vākyam, subantaṃ
ceti ṅyāpprātipadikavyatiriktāti caturvidhā prakṛtirasti,
vakṣyamāṇāśca pratyayāścaturvidhāḥ---svādayaḥ, ṭābādayaḥ, aṇādayaḥ,
svārthikāśceti; tadiha caturvidhābhyaḥ prakṛtibhyaścaturvidhāḥ pratyayā
mā bhūvanniti kartavya evāyamadhikāraḥ |
na kartavyaḥ | nanu cāsatyasmin dhātvadhikārāddhātoreva syuḥ,
kṛdupapadasaṃjñe ca syātām, vāsarūpavidhiścasyāt ? na;
nivṛtatvāddhātugrahaṇasya | yadi paraṃ dhātorapi syuḥ, tadapi na;
karmādīnāmabhāvāt | karmādiṣu ca kārakeṣvekatvādikāyāṃ ca
saṃkhyāyāṃ svādayo vidhīyante, na ca dhātvarthasya karmādibhiryogaḥ
sambhavati | kathaṃ tarhi karmaṇi tatryadādayo bhavanti ? naiva dhātvarthasya
karmatve tavyadādayo bhavanti, kiṃ tarhi ? dhātvarthaṃ prati yatkarma
tasminvācye---kartavyaḥ kaṭa iti | svādayastu prakṛtyarthasya karmatve
caritārthā nānyasya karmatve bhavitumarhanti, tavyadādibhiśca
bādhitatvāddhātoḥ svādīnāmabhāvaḥ | nanu ca dhātvarthasyaiva karmatvaṃ
dṛṣṭam---sanprakṛtau cikīrṣatītyādau ? evamapi saṃkhyābhāvaḥ siddha
eva, avyayebhyastu ṭhavyayādāpsupaḥ' iti jñāpakātsvādayo bhavanti |
yatpunaḥ ṭhbahuṣu bahuvacanam' ityatroktam---yatra ca saṃkhyā
sambhavatīti, tadasyāṃ daśāyāṃ tathā nāśrīyate | ṭābādayastarhi
dhātormā bhūvanniti ? striyāṃ ṭābādayo vidhīyante, na ca
dhātvarthasya strītvena yogo'sti | kathaṃ tarhi striyāṃ ktinnādayo
vidhīyante ? naivātra dhātvarthasya strītve ktinnādayaḥ smaryante, kasya
tarhi ? yastasya siddhatvaṃ nāma dharmastasya | ktinnādibhiśca
bādhitatvāṭṭābādīnāmabhāvaḥ |
aṇādayastarhi dhātormā bhūvanniti ? apatyādiṣvartheṣvaṇādayo
vidhīyante, na ca dhātvarthasyāpatyādibhiryogo'sti,
samarthavibhaktyabhāvāccāṇādīnāmanutpattiḥ, ṭhtasyāpatyam', ṭhtena
raktam', ṭhtatra bhavaḥ' ityevamādibhiḥ ṣaṣṭha|ladivibhaktyantādaṇādayo
vidhīyante, na ca dhātorvibhaktiḥ sambhavati | svāthikā api
svārthakaistumunnādibhirbādhitatvādeva dhātorna bhaviṣyanti |
tiṅntātarhi svādayo mā bhūvanniti ? tiṅnteṣu kriyā pradhānabhūtā,
sādhanaṃ guṇabhūtam, tatra pradhānabhūtāyāḥ kriyāyāḥ
karmādīnāmabhāvātsvādayo na bhaviṣyanti | pacati bhavati, bhavati vai
kiñcidācāryāḥ kriyamāṇamapi codayantītyādau kartṛtvaṃ dṛṣṭamiti
cet, evamapi saṃkhyāyā abhāvaḥ siddha eva | yastu guṇabhūtaḥ
kartā'bhīdhīyate; tatra abhihitatvādeva vibhaktyabhāvaḥ siddhaḥ | na ca
guṇabhūtasya kartuḥ kriyāntarāveśaḥ sambhavati; yataḥ pācakaṃ
paśyetyādivad dvitīyādayo bhaveyuḥ | nanu putrīyavadetatsyāt,
tadyathā---putrīyaśabdādantarbhūtakriyākarmavācinaḥ kartari lakāra
utpadyate---putrīyatīti, tathehāpi pacatiśabdāt
kartṛviśiṣṭakriyāvācinaḥ kramādiṣu dvitīyādayaḥ syureva ? naiṣa
doḥ ; uktametat---prakṛtyarthasya karmatve caritārthāḥ svādayo
nānyasya karmatve bhavitumarhantīti | na caikakriyāpekṣayorbhinnayoḥ
sādhanayorekasminpade yugapadabhidhānaṃ sambhavati | putrīyaśabdastu
jīvatyādidhātuvadviśiṣṭakriyāvacana iti, tataḥ kartari
lakārotpatiraviruddhā | avaśyaṃ caitadevaṃ vijñeyam---arthābhāvādeva
tiṅntād dvitīyādayo na bhavantīti | yo hi
manyate---ṅyāpprātipadikādhikārānna bhavantīti; rūpabādyantātasya
dvitīyādayaḥ syureva, pacatirūpaṃ paśya, pacatirūpeṇa kṛtamityādi,
bhavati hyaetatprātipadikam | kathaṃ tarhi rūpabādyantātprathamaikavacanamapi
bhavati ? uktatvātsaṅkhyāyāḥ, na hi tatkartuḥ saṅkhyāyāmekavacanam |
yadi tathā syāt pacaterūpaṃ pacantirūpamiti dvivacanabahuvacane
syātām | ṭhprātipadikārtha' ityatra tu
prātipadikagrahaṇātprātipadikamātrānubandhinī prathamā bhavati |
tatrāpyekavacanameva; ṭhekavacanamutsargaḥ kariṣyate' iti vacanāt | na
caivaṃ tiṅnte'pi prasaṅgaḥ tasyāprātipadikatvāt |
ṭābādayastarhi tiṅntānmā bhūvanniti ? striyāṃ ṭābādayo
vidhīyante, na ca tiṅnte pradhānasyārthasya strītvena yogo'sti |
yadi paraṃ sādhanasya strītve ṭābādayaḥ syuḥ paced brāhmaṇaḥ,
paceran brāhmaṇya iti ? tadapi na; svabhāvato hi tiṅntāni
sādhanāśrayāṃ saṅkhyāmevopādadate, na liṅgam | uktaṃ ca---
ekatve'pi kriyākhyāte sādhanāśrayasaṃkhyayā |
bhidyate na tu liṅgākhyo bhedastatra tadāśrayaḥ || iti |
śobhanaṃ pacatītyādau kriyāviśeṣaṇasyaiva liṅgena yogaḥ, na
kriyāyāḥ, tatrāpi napuṃsakena | pacati rūpamityādāvapi
rūpabādyantavācyāyāḥ kriyāyāḥ svabhāvato liṅgena yogaḥ, tatrāpi
napuṃsakena | vicitrā hi śabdānāṃ śaktayo
yathādarśanamabhyupagantavyāḥ, na sāmānyato dṛṣṭenānumānena
vyavasthāpayituṃ śakyante | avaśyaṃ caitadevaṃ
vijñeyam---strītvābhāvātiṅntāṭṭābādayo na bhavantīti, anyathā
pacatirūpaṃ brāhmaṇītyādau rūpabādyantāṭṭāpsyādeva | 
aṇādayastarihi tiṅntānmā bhūvanniti ? apatyādiṣvartheṣvaṇāadayo
vidhīyante, na ca tiṅnte pradhānasyāpatyādibhiryogo'sti |
apradhānasya tvapradhānatvādevāpatyādibhiryogābhāvaḥ,
samarthavibhaktyabhāvāccāṇādyabhāvaḥ siddhaḥ | avaśyaṃ caitadevaṃ vijñeyam,
anyathā yaḥ pacatirūpaṃ tasyāpatyamiti rūpabādyantādaṇādayaḥ syureva |
svāthikā api jñāpakātiṅntānna bhaviṣyanti, yadayaṃ kvacitaddhitavidhau
tiṅgrahaṇaṃ karoti---ṭhatiśāyane tamabiṣṭhanau', ṭhtiṅśca' iti |
vākyādapi naiva svādayo bhavitumarhanti; armādīnāmabhāvāt | na
khalu kriyārūpasya saṃsargarūpasya bhedarūpasya vā vākyārthasya karmādibhi
strītvenāpatyādibhirvā yogaḥ sambhavati | ṭhpaśya mṛgo dhāvati'
ityādau dṛṣṭamiti cet ? evamapi saṃkhyāyogābhāvaḥ siddhaḥ |
svārthikā apyabhidhānābhāvānna vākyādbhaviṣyanti | tathā
hi---ṭhdevadatārohāśvam' ityasmādvākyātprāgivīyeṣvartheṣu ke
sulbuki ca kṛte
vākyārthasyāsatvabhūtatvācchaktiliṅgasaṅkhyāyogābhāvātsvādyautpaterabhāvād devadatārohāśvaketi bhavitavyam, na caivambhūtena vākyārthagatāḥ kutsādayo gamyanta iti |
subantādapi naiva svādayo bhavitumarhanti | nahi svādiṣu
vidhīyamāneṣu tadantā prakṛtiḥ sambhavati, yathoktam---ṭhsanantānna
saniṣyate' iti | kiñca subantamapi saṅkhyāpradhānaṃ kārakaśaktipradhānaṃ
vā, na cāsyāparaiḥ karmādibhiryogaḥ sambhavati |
ṭābādayo'pi strītvābhāvānna bhaviṣyanti | aṇādiṣu punarnāsti
viśeṣaḥ, subantādvotpatau satyāṃ prātipadikādvā | yathā caitatathā
ṭhsamarthānāṃ prathamādvā' ityatra pratipādayiṣyāmaḥ | sarvathā
rūpabādyantātprātipadikādapyaniṣṭaḥ pratyayo yadvāt
tadvaddhātvādikādapīti nārtha etenetyākṣeptā śaṅkate
tāvat---yadyapīti |
pratyayaparatvena prakṛtirlabhyate | pāriśeṣyācceyameva prakṛtirlabhyata
ityarthaḥ |
pariharati---tathāpīti | vṛddhādayo lakṣaṇaṃ nimitaṃ yasya
pratyayavidhestatra ṅyāpprātipadikasya viśeṣyatvena samprātyayo
yathā syādityevamarthamityarthaḥ | itarathā hīti | yadi
ṅyāpprātipadikagrahaṇaṃ na kriyetetyarthaḥ |
samarthaviśeṣaṇametatsyāditi | ṭhsamarthānāṃ prathamādvā' ityadhikārāt
| kiṃ ca samartham ? subantam | samarthaviśeṣaṇe sati ko dāṣaḥ ?
ṭhudīcāṃ vṛddhādagotrāt' iti phin | iha ca prasajyeta---jñānāṃ
brāhmaṇānāmapatyamiti, etaddhi samarthaṃvṛddham | iha ca na syāt---jñānāṃ
brāhmaṇānāmapatyamiti, na hyaetatsamarthamavṛddham | yatra hyādeśādivaśena
saṅkhyāviśeṣābhivyaktirbhavati na bhavati tatra
dvivacanabahuvacanāntānāmapi vṛttiḥ---tāvakaḥ, māmaka iti | yathā iha
ca phiñutpadyamāno bahutvamantareṇa vṛddhatvānupapaterbahutvaṃ
gamayet, evaṃ phinnapi dvitvamiti syādevāyaṃ prasaṅgaḥ |
avarṇa---ṭhata iñ' ihaiva syāt dakṣasyāpatyamiti, dakṣayoḥ
dakṣāṇāmityatra tu na syāt | svara---ṭhanudātāderañ', iha ca
prasajyeta---vāco vikāraḥ, tvaco vikāraḥ, etaddhi
samarthamanudātādi, ṭhsāvekācaḥ' iti vibhakterudātatvāt |
nanvatraikāco nityaṃ mayaṭamicchantīti mayaṭā bhāvyam ? idaṃ tarhi
pañcānāṃ vikāra iti ṭhṣaṭtricaturbhyo halādiḥ' iti
vibhakterudātatve sati samarthamanudātādi, prātipadikaṃ tu ṭhnraḥ
saṅkhyāyāḥ' ityādyaudātam | iha ca na syāt---sarveṣāṃ vikāra iti,
ṭhsarvasya supi' ityādyaudātaṃ padam, prātipādikaṃ tvantodātaṃ
nipātitam | dvyac---ṭhnaudvyacaṣṭhan', iha ca prasajyeta---vācā
tarati, tvacā tarati,etaddhi samarthaṃ dvyac | naugrahaṇaṃ tu niyamārthaṃ
syāt---aukārāntādyadi bhavati nauśabdādeveti | iha ca na
syāt---ghaṭena taratīti | sāmnā taratītyādau punarubhayathāpi
siddham | ṅyāpprātipadikagrahaṇe tu sati tatsāmarthyātasyaiva
viśeṣaṇaṃ vṛddhādi bhavati, samarthādhikārācca samarthātpratyayaḥ |
tatraivamabhisambandhaḥ---vṛddhādi yad ṅyāpprātipadikaṃ tasmāt
samarthāt pratyayaḥ iti |
ṭhyasmātpratyayavidhiḥ' iti pratyayavidhau pañcamīnirdiṣṭasya vidhīyamānā
aṅgabhapadasaṃjñā ṅyāpprātipadikasya yathā syurityetatu
prayojanaṃna bhavati, katham ? daivena hi jānatā yataḥ pratyayo
vihitastasyaitāḥ saṃjñāḥ pañcamyā nirddiśyatāṃ mā vā nirdeśi | iha
ca ṭhkaṃsīyaparaśavyayoryañañau lukca' iti
prātipadikātparayoścchayatorlugyathā
syādauṇādikayorukārasaśabdayormā bhūdityetadapi na prayojanam,
katham ? ṭhuṇādayo'vyutpannāni prātipadikāni', uṇāadiṣu nāvaśyaṃ
vyutpattikāryaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ | etacca ṭhataḥ kṛkamikaṃsa' ityatra
kamigrahaṇenaiva siddhe punaḥ kaṃsagrahaṇādvijñāyate, tasmād vṛddhādyeva
prayojanamadhikārasya |
ṅyābgrahaṇaṃ kriyate; pratyayāntatvenāprātipadikatvāt |
ṭhyūnastiḥ' yuvatirityasya tu taddhitāntatvātprātipadikatvam |
ṭhūṇutaḥ' ityuvarṇāntādūṅ vidhīyate,
tatraikādeśasyāntavadbhāvātprātipadikatvam |
ṭhśvaśurasyokārākāralopaśca' iti śvaśrūrityatra ṭhśvaśuraḥ śvaśrvaśca'
iti nipātanādvibhaktyādisiddhiḥ, evaṃ sthite codyam---atheti | na
prātipadikagrahaṇa iti | nañaḥ kākvā prayogātsiddhamevetyathaḥ |
anekārthatvādvā nipātānām | nanuśabdasyārthe naśabdo draṣṭavyaḥ |
liṅgaviśiṣṭasyeti | liṅganimitapratyayenādhikasyetyarthaḥ |
asyāśca paribhāṣāyāḥ
prayojanam---sarvanāmasvarasamāsopacāreṣṭhavadbhāvāḥ |
sarvanāma---bhavacchabdasya vidhīyamānā sarvanāmasaṃjñā bhavatīśabdasyāpi
bhavati, ṭhsarvanāmnāstṛtīyā ca', bhavatā hetunā, bhavato hetoḥ,
bhavatyā hetunā, bhavatyā hetoriti | svara---ṭhkuśūlakūpavumbhaśālaṃ
bile', kuśūlabilaṃ kuśūlībilam | samāsa---ṭhpūrvasadṛśa',
mātṛsadaśaḥ, mātṛsadṛśī; ṭhsadṛśapratirūpayoḥ' iti svaro'pyatra bhavati
| tathā ṭhkumāraḥ śramaṇādibhiḥ' | kumārīśramaṇā, kumāraśramaṇā, evaṃ
yuvatirvalinā, yuvavalinā | upacāra---ṭhataḥ kṛkamikaṃsakumbha',
ayaskumbhaḥ, ayaskumbhī | iṣṭhavadbhāva---ṭhṇāviṣṭhavatprātipadikasya',
kumārīmācaṣṭe kumārayati | iha tu ṭhacitahastidhenoṣṭhak',
hastinīnāṃ samūho hāstikaramiti, ṭhbhasyāḍhea taddhite' iti
puṃvadbhāvena ṅīpi nivṛte hastiśabda evāyamiti ṭhaksiddhiḥ |
ṭhtaddhite' ityeṣā hi viṣayasaptamī | avaśyaṃ ca puṃvadbhāva
evāśrayaṇīyaḥ, anyathā hastinīśabdāṭṭhaki yasyetilopagya
sthānivadbhāvāt ṭhnastaddhite' iti ṭilopo na syāt | iha ca
ṭhnentsiddhabadhnātiṣu ca sthaṇḍilaśāyini' iti
ṭhgatikārakopapadānāṃ kṛdbhiḥ saha samāsavacanaṃ prāk
subutpateḥ' iti vacanādanutpanna eva ṅīpi samāse
satīnnantamevotarapadamityalukpratiṣedhaḥ siddhaḥ | evaṃ
ṭhśayavāsavāsiṣvakālāt' grāmevāsinītyaluk | tathā
ṭhkyaṅmāninośca' ṭhsvāṅgāccetomānini' darśanīyamāninī,
dīrghamukhamāninī---māninśabda evotarapadamiti puṃvadbhāvaḥ siddhaḥ
| iha ca ṭhtṛjakābhyāṃ kartari' ṭhkartari ca' iti kartari yau tṛjakau
tābhyāṃ yoge yā ṣaṣṭhī tasyā yena saha samāsaḥ prāptaḥ sa sarvo na
bhavatīti vijñānādapāṃ sraṣṭrītyatrāpi samāsaniṣedaḥ siddhaḥ | yadi
ṭhprātipadikagrahaṇe liṅgaviśiṣṭasyāpi grahaṇam' bhavati,
atiprasaṅgo bhavati---ṭhdviṣatparayostāpe' dviṣatītapa ityatrāpi
syāt, uktamatra---ṭhdviṣatparayoriti dvitakārako'yaṃ nirdeśaḥ
takārānto dviṣacchabdaḥ' iti | iha ca gārgyā apatyam, dākṣyā
apatyamiti ṭhyañiñośca' iti phakaṃ paratvāt strībhyo ḍhagbādhate | iha
ca ṭhñnityādinityam' dākṣiḥ,
glucukāyanirityasyāmavasthāyāmādyaudātatve kṛte paścāt ṭhito
manuṣyajāteḥ' iti ṅīṣi sati śiṣṭaḥ pratyayasvara eva bhavati---dākṣī,
glucukāyanī | na cāsyāmavasthāyāmādyaudātatvaṃ punaḥ pravartate;
pūrvameva pravṛtatvāt | tathā bahavo gomanto'syāṃ
bahugomatīti prāgeva bahusvare pravṛte paścānṅīp,
pitvādanudāto bhavati | na ca punarapi ṭhbahornañvad' ityamya
pravṛttiḥ pūrvameva pravṛtatvātsamāsāccātra ṅībutpanna ityutarapadaṃ na
liṅgaviśiṣṭam | iha tarhi ṭhrājāhaḥ sakhibhyaṣṭac' madrāṇāṃ
rājñīti ṭac syāt, tataśca ṭhbhasyāḍhea taddhite' iti puṃvadbhāvena
īkāre nivṛte ṭilope ca ṭitvānṅīpi madrarājīti syāt,
madrarājñīti ceṣyate | tathā mahatī priyā yasya mahatīpriya iti
puṃvadbhāvapratiṣedhaviṣaye ṭhānmahataḥ' ityātvaṃ syāt |
tathā''ryayorbrāhmaṇakumārayoḥ, rājā ca rājabrāhmaṇītyatrāpi syāt |
tathā vibhaktyāśrayaṃ yatkāryaṃ vibhaktau parato vibhaktervā tatrāpi
doṣaḥ, yathā---ṭhna gośvansāvavarṇa' iti śunā, śuna ityatra
ṭhsāvekācaḥ' iti prāptaṃ vibhakterudātatvaṃ na bhavati | tathā
gaurādiṅīṣantāt śunyā, śunyai ityādāvapi ṭhudātayaṇo
halapūrvāt' ityasyāpi niṣedhaḥ syāt | ṭhugidacām' iti num
gomatītyādāvapi syāt | ṭhcaturanaḍuhorām'
anaḍuhītyatrekārātparaḥ syād | ṭhpathimathyṛbhukṣāmāt' śobhanaḥ
panthā asyāmiti ṭhna pūjanāt' iti samāsānte niṣiddhe ṛnnebhyo
ṅīpi bhasya ṭerlope supathītyatrāpi syāt | aṅgādhikāre
tadantasyāpi grahaṇātsupanthā itivat ṭhpuṃso'suṅ'
supaṃsītyatrāpi syāt | śobhanāḥ pumāṃso'syāmiti, uraḥ
prabhṛtiṣu pumāniti vibhaktyantasya pāṭhādekavacanāntādeva nityaṃ
kap bhavati, bahuvacanāntasya tu ṭhśeṣādvibhāṣā' iti vikalpita
eveti kababhāvapakṣe pūṅe hrasvaḥ, masuśca pratyayaḥ, ākāra
uccāraṇārthaḥ, tatra pratyasyogitvāt ṭhugitaśca' iti ṅīp |
ṭhsakhyurasambuddhau' ṭhanaṅ sau' iti ṇitvānaṅai sakhau
sakhyāvityādāvapi syātām | ṭhsakhyaśiśvīti bhāṣāyām' iti
ṅīṣvidhānaṃ tu sakhībhyāmityādyarthaṃ syāt | ṭhvibhāṣā
bhavadbhagavadaghavatām' ityatra tvavaśabdaḥ sambuddhāviti viśṣyate,
tatra ṭhyena nāvyavadhānam' ityekena varṇena vyavāye otvaṃ
pravartamānamiha na bhavati---he bhagavati, he aghavatīti,
tadabhāvātatsanniyogaśiṣṭasya rutvasyāpyabhāvaḥ |
ṭhśvayuvamaghonāmataddhite' ityatrāpi ṭhallopo'naḥ' ityataḥ ṭhanaḥ'
ityapakarṣādyauvatīḥ paśyeti samprasāraṇābhāvaḥ |
tadevaṃ liṅgaviśiṣṭaparibhāṣāyāḥ santi prayojanāni, santi ca
doṣāḥ | yāni prayojanāni tadarthameṣā kartavyā, pratividheyaṃ
doṣeṣu | pratividhānaṃ ca ṭhśaktilāṅgala' ityatra ghaṭagrahaṇenaiva siddhe
ghaṭīgrahaṇamasyāḥ paribhāṣāyā anityatvajñāpanārthamiti | tadevaṃ
sthitametat---ṅyābgrahaṇamanarthakaṃ prātipadikagrahaṇe
liṅgaviśiṣṭasyāpi grahaṇāditi |
paraharati---naitadastoti | svarūpavidhiviṣaya iti | svarūpāśrayo
vidhiḥ svarūpavidhiḥ, sa cāsau viṣayaśca tatretyarthaḥ | kimuktaṃ
bhavatītyāha---prātipadikasvarūpa grahaṇe satoti | kuta etadityata
āha---tathā ceti | yathā ca yuvañcchabdasya jaratīśabdena
samāsavacanamatrārthe jñāpakaṃ tathā tatraiva pratipādikam |
tādṛśameveti | ṭhprātipadikasvarūpagrahaṇe liṅgaviśiṣṭasyāpi
grahaṇaṃ bhavati' iti yaduktaṃ tadanuguṇamevetyarthaḥ | yadi
svarūpavidhiviṣaye paribhāṣeyam,
kathamiṣṭhavadbhāvaḥ---kumārīmācaṣṭe kumārayatīti ?
bāhulakātsiddhiṃ manyate, curādau hīdaṃ
paṭha|lte---ṭhprātipadikāddhātvarthe bahulamiṣṭhavacca' iti | bhāṣye tu
yathākathaṃcitprātipadikagrahaṇe liṅgaviśiṣṭasyāpi grahaṇamiti
sthitam | tathā ca ṭhsarvaprātipadikebhya ityeke' iti kvip
ṅyantādapi bhavati---yāminayantyahānīti |
kiñcetyādinā prayojanāntaraṃ samuccinoti | kālitareti |
kālaśabdāt jānapadādisūtreṇa ṅīṣi tarapi ṭhgharūpakalpa' ityādinā
hrasvaḥ | kiṃ punaḥ karāṇaṃ tadantātaddhitavidhirna sidhyatītyāha---
vipratiṣedhāddhīti | strīpratyayasyāvakāśaḥ---prakarṣāvivakṣāyāṃ
kālīti, prakarṣapratyayasyāvakāśaḥ---strītvāvivakṣāyāṃ kālatara iti ;
ubhayavivakṣāyāmubhayaprasaṅge paratvātaddhitaḥ syāt | ṅyābgrahaṇe
tu sati tarabvidhau prakṛtitrayādhikārasāmarthyātpūrvaṃ ṅyāpau
bhavataḥ, paścātarabiti siddhamiṣṭam |
nanu ca strītvasyāntaraṅgatvātannimitaḥ pratyayo'ntaraṅgaḥ,
prakarṣastu bāhyapratiyogyapekṣatvādbahiraṅgaḥ, tatastannimitasya
pratyayasyāpi bahiraṅgatvam | yo'pyajñātādiṣvartheṣu ṭhprāgivātkaḥ'
vidhīyate so'pyajñātādyarthāpekṣatvādbahiraṅga eva, vibhaktyantasya
hi sataḥ paścādajñātādiyogo bhavati, vibhaktayaśca saṃkhyākarmādyapekṣāḥ
| prāgeva saṃkhyākarmādiyogālliṅgena prātipadikaṃ yujyate | uktaṃ
ca---ṭhsvārthamabhidhāya śabdo nirapekṣo dravyamāha samavetam,
samavetasya tu vacane liṅgaṃ saṃkhyāṃ vibhaktiṃ cābhidhāya
tānviśeṣānavekṣamāṇaśca pūrṇamātmānamapriyakutsanādiṣu tataḥ
viśeṣye buddhiriti pūrvaṃ viśeṣaṇabhūtaḥ svārtho'bhidhātavyaḥ,
paścātadviśiṣṭṃa dravyam; tasya dharmitvena pradhānatvāt, tato
liṅgamantaraṅgatvāt | saṃkhyā hi bhedāpekṣatvādbahiraṅgā,
sāpi tu sajātīyāpekṣā vijātīyakarmādikārakaśaktyapekṣebhyaḥ
kārakebhyo'ntaraṅgeti tatastasyā abhidhānam, tataḥ kārakāṇām,
evaṃ paripūrṇārthasya paścātkutsanādibhiryogaḥ | svārthādayo hi
kutsanādihetavaḥ, dravyasya paṇḍitaka ityādau tathāvasāyāt |
tadevamantaraṅgaḥ strīpratyayaḥ, bahiraṅgāstaddhitāḥ,
antaraṅgabahiraṅgayoścāyukto vipratiṣedhaḥ ? iha tahi ṭhvarṇe
cānitye', ṭhrakte' ṭhkālācca' ityasyāvakāśaḥ strītvāvivakṣāyāṃ kālaka
iti, strīpratyayasya kālītyavakāśaḥ; kāliketyatrobhayaprasaṅge
paratvānkan syāt | tasya cātyantasvāthikatvānna tadapekṣaṃ
strīpratyayasyāntaraṅgatvamasti | nāstyatra viśeṣaḥ,
kālaśabdādapyutpatau ṭhpratyayasthāt' itītve kāliketi siddham ?
yadā tahiṃ haritaśabdāt ṭhna sāmivacane' iti ṅībnakārau bādhitvā
paratvātkan syāt, tataśca hariṇiketi na syāt | haritaśabdena
samānārtho hariṇaśabdo'sti, tataḥ karmatve ca bhaviṣyati,
haritaśabdātu haritiketi ? ayaṃ tahi---ṭhlohitānmaṇo'
ityatyantasvarthikaḥ kan ṭhvarṇādanudātāt' iti ṅībnakārau
paratvādbādheta, tataśca lohitiketyeva syāt, na
lohiniketi;ubhayamapīṣyate, tadarthaṃ ṅyābgrahaṇam |
nanu ca ṭhlohitālliṅgabādhanaṃ ca' ityanenaivaitatsiddham, tanna
vaktavyaṃ bhavati, katham ? ṭhvarṇādanudātāt' ityatra veti vartate,
tatra ṅyābantābhyāṃ lohinīlohitāśabdābhyāṃ kani vihite
yatāyogaṃ hrasvatvetvayoḥ kṛtayorlohinikā lohitiketi
siddhamiṣṭam | tadevaṃ sati ṅyābgrahaṇe liṅganimitena pratyayena
vikalpena bādhā yathā syānnityaṃ mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ tāvanna
vaktavyam---lohitālliṅgabādhanaṃ veti | nāpi
pratipadavihitatvena kanā liṅganimitasya pratyayasya nitye bādhe
prāpte | vikalpena bādhā yathā syādityevamarthamapi vaktavyam;
ṅyābgrahaṇasyānanyārthatvāt | yadi
hyaetaśvetaśabdābhyāmatyantasvārthikaḥ kanniṣyate, tadā tatra
ṅyābgrahaṇasya caritārthatvāllohitaśabdātpratipadavihitena kanā
ṅīpo nitye bādhe prāpte tadvaktavyam ? tadāpi vā na vaktavyam,
ṭhlohitānmaṇau' ityasyāpi punannapuṃsakayoścaritārthatvāt |
tadevamatyantasvārthiko'pi kan ṅyantādyathā syāditi ṅībgrahaṇaṃ
tāvatkartavyam |
ābgrahaṇaṃ tu vispaṣṭārtham | tatra samāsānteṣu doṣaḥ---bahavo
gomanto'syāṃ nagaryāmiti bahuvrīhau kṛte striyā
anyapadārthatvānṅīp ca prāpnoti kap ca, ṅyābgrahaṇān
ṅīpi kṛte kap syāt, tataśca bahugomatīketi rūpaṃ syāt,
bahugomatketi ceṣyate ? naiṣa doṣaḥ samāsārthādutarapadādakṛta
eva samāse samāsāntā bhavanti paścātadantena samāsaḥ, evaṃ hi samāsaṃ
pratyantāvayavatvamupapadyate samāsāntānām, tathā ca ṭhna kapi' ityatra
vakṣyati | tatra cotarapade samāsārthāyā vibhakteḥ purastātsamāsāntā
iti kecit | parastātsamāsānteṣu subluki taddhitāntatvena tataḥ
supi subantasya samāsa ityanye | sarvathā bahucarmiketītvaṃ
prāpnoti, ṭhasupaḥ' iti pratiṣedhāt, yathā bahuparivrājakā
madureti ? kartavyo'tra yatnaḥ | ṭhnañastatpuruṣāt' ityādau tu
granthavirodhaṃ tatra tatra parihariṣyāmaḥ | tadevaṃ
sthitametat---tadantātaddhitavidhānārthaṃ ṅyābgrahaṇaṃ vipratiṣedhāddhi
taddhitabalīyastvamiti |
yadyevam, ṭhyūnastiḥ' ṭhūṇutaḥ' iti tyūṅerapi grahaṇaṃ kartavyaṃ
tadantātaddhitavidhānārtham---yuvatitarā | bhāṣyakāraprayogāt
ṭhtasilādiṣvākṛtvasucaḥ' iti puṃvadbhāvo na bhavati,
khiddhādiṣu puṃvadbhāvād hrasvatvaṃ vipratiṣedheneti vā
parjanyavallakṣaṇapravṛtyā hrasvena bādhitatvāt | brahmabandhūtarā ṭhnadyāḥ
śeṣasyānyatarasyām' iti hrasvābhāvapakṣe ṭhjāteśca' iti
puṃvadbhāvapratiṣedhaḥ | pūrvatra tvanena pratiṣedho na labhyate;
yauvanasyājātitvāt | yāvaddravyabhāvinī hi jātiḥ, tathā ca
yuvajānirityudāhṛtam | nanvatrāntaraṅgatvādeva tyūṅai
bhaviṣyataḥ, atyantasvārthike tu kani brahmabandhuketyatra ṭhke'ṇaḥ' iti hrasve
sati nāsti viśeṣaḥ---ūṅntādvotpatau satyām, ukārāntādvā,
yuvatiśabdādapi kani puṃvadbhāvena bhvāyamiti nāstyeva viśeṣaḥ
| na cāsmātkanniṣyata ityatrāpi pramāṇamasti |
tasmānnārthastyūṅergrahaṇena
||
svaujasamīṭcchaṣṭābhyāṃbhisṇeóbhyāmbhyasṅasibhyāmbhyasṅsosāmṅyossup || 4|1|2 ||
ukārādayo'nubandhā ityādi | tatra prathamaikavacanasyokāraḥ ṭhetatadoḥ
sulopaḥ', ṭhdīrghātsutisi' ityatra kevalasya
vyañjanasyoccārayitumaśakyatvāduccāraṇārthaḥ | atra tu sūtre
aukāropaśle ṣācchakyate sakāramātramuccārayitum | ṭhanaṅsau'
ityatra viśeṣaṇārthastu na bhavati; vyāvartyasyābhāvāt | na ca
ṭhanaṅasi' ityucyamāne varṇanirdeśe ca
tadādividhisambhavātsaptamībahuvacane'pi prasaṅgaḥ; ṭhsarvanāmasthāne'
ityanuvṛteḥ | jaso jakāro'sminneva sūtre'sandigdhoccāraṇārthaḥ;
anyathā hyāikārasyāvādeśe sandehaḥ
syāt---kimaukārasyoccāraṇam, athāvityasyeti | ṭhjasaḥ śī'
ityādau viśeṣaṇārthastu na bhavati; ṭhasaḥ śī'
ityucyamāne'pyatiprasaṅgābhāvāt, śasādīnāṃ sānubandhakatvāt |
śasaśśakāra auṭaṣṭakārasyāsandigdhoccāraṇārthaḥ; anyathā ḍakāraṣṭakāra
iti sandehaḥ syāt| ṭhtasmācchasaḥ' ityādau viśeṣaṇārthastu na bhavati;
jasādīnāṃ sānubandhakatvāt | ṭhṭā' ityatra ṭakāraḥ
ṭhṭāṅasiṅasāminātsyāḥ' iti viśeṣaṇārthaḥ; anyathā ṭhsupāṃ suluk'
ityādinā vihitasyākārasyāpi grahaṇaṃ syāt | tadevameṣāṃ
caturṇāmukārādaya uccāraṇaviśeṣaṇārthāḥ | itsaṃjñāpyeṣāṃ prayoge
śravaṇaṃ mā bhūditi, na punaritkāryaṃ kiñcidasti | auṭaṣṭakāraḥ
suḍiti pratyāhāragrahaṇārthaḥ | ṇeóprabhṛtiṣu ṅkāraḥ ṭhgherṅiti' iti
viśeṣaṇārthaḥ | ṅserikāraḥ ṭhyuṣmadasmadbhāṃ ṅso'ś' ityatra
grahaṇaṃ mā bhūdityevamarthaḥ | pakāraḥ pratyāhāragrahaṇārtha iti |
ukārādayo'nubandhā yathāyogamuccāraṇaviśeṣaṇārthā
ityanenāgatārthatvādidamuktam | evaṃ ca---ṭhauṭaṣṭakāraḥ suḍiti
pratyāhārārthaḥ' ityagrimagranthena bhavitavyam |
kva punarime'rthe svādayo bhavantītyāha---saṃkhyākarmādayaśceti |
śāstrāntareṇeti | ṭhbahuṣu bahuvacanam', ṭhkarmaṇi dvitīyā'
ityādinā | tena sahāsyaikavākyateti | pūrvaṃ
tvavāntaravākyabhedāpekṣayā śāstrāntareṇetyuktam |
ākāṃkṣāyogyatāvaśena bhinnaprakaraṇapaṭhitānāmapyekavākyatā bhavatyeva
| prakaraṇabhedena tu pāṭhastiṅadividhināpyekavākyatvaṃ yathā
syāditi | ṭhbahuṣu bahuvacanam' ityatra tu
bhinnavākyatvamāśrityoktam-ṅyāppratipadikātsvādayo lasya tibādaya
iti bahuvacanaṃ vihitaṃ tasyānena bahutvaṃ saṃkhyāvācyatvena
vidhīyate iti | avyayeyastu niḥ saṃkhyebhyaḥ sāmānyavihitāḥ khādayo
vidyanta eveti ca | ekavākyatāyāṃ tu viśiṣṭe evārthe
karmādisambandhinyekatvādau svādīnāṃ vidhānātsāmānyavihitatvaṃ
nopapadyate | tasmād ṭhavyayādāpsupaḥ' ityavyayādutpannasya supo
lugvidānālliṅgādavyayebhyo'sminpakṣe svādyautpatiḥ | udāharaṇāni
yathāyogaṃ sve sve vākye prakaṭīkariṣyante ||
striyām || 4|1|3 ||
ṅyāporanenaiva vidhānāditi | prātipadikamātramatra
prakaraṇe'bhisambadhyata ityatrāyaṃ hetuḥ | prakaraṇāpekṣayā caitaducyate,
sūtrāntaravyāpārasamaye tu sūtrāntaravihitapratyayāntā prakṛtiḥ
sambhavatyeva | nanu cātra prakaraṇe sarvatra sati sambhave ṭhataḥ' iti
sambadhyarte, na ca ṅyābantamadantam | uktārthatvācca ṅyābantāt
ṅyāporaprasaṅgaḥ ? satyam ; nyāyastu nirūpyate |
codayati---striyāmityucyate iti | saptamīnirdeśena
kāryāntaravidhānārthamanūdyate ityarthaḥ | tataḥ kimityāha---keyaṃ strī
nāmeti | iha śāstre striyā aparibhāṣitatvāllaukikastrīgrahaṇe ca
khaṭvādāvavyāptiprasaṅgātprasiddhavadanuvādo'nupapanna ityarthaḥ |
svarūpasya ca jijñāsitatvātprathamāntena praśnaḥ, kasyāṃ striyāmiti
tūcyamāne viśeṣaviṣayaḥ praśnaḥ syāt | strīgrahaṇaṃ ca prasaṅgena
punnapuṃsakayorapi pradarśanārtham | ata evotare sāmānyaviśeṣāḥ
strītvādaya iti trayāṇāṃ svarūpaṃ darśitam | evaṃ ca
prathamopanipātini ṭhhrasvo napuṃsake' ityatra
liṅgasvarūpanirūpaṇamucitam, tathā tu na kṛtamityeva | tatra
laukikānāṃ lakṣaṇam---
stanakeśavatī strī syāllomaśaḥ puruṣaḥ smṛtaḥ |
ubhayorantaraṃ yacca tadabhāve napuṃsakam || iti |
bhūmādau matup, tathaiva lomaśa iti śaḥ | stanakeśavatvaṃ ca
prasiddhatvādanyasyāpi kumāryādigatasya strīpratipatihetorupalakṣaṇam
| lomaśatvaṃ ca puṃvijñānahetoḥ kumārādigatasya | ubhayorapi
strīpuṃsayoryadantaraṃ sadṛśaṃ stanalomādyaubhayavyañjanaṃ
tannapuṃsakamityarthaḥ | tenāvyayākhyātārthasya strīpuṃsatvābhāve'pi
napuṃsakatvaṃ na bhavati, anyathā ṭhtadabhāve' ityetāvatyukte
syātpasaṅgaḥ, tadabhāva ityanena kukkuṭamayūryādeḥ
strīpuṃsasamudāyarūpasya dvandvārthasya napuṃsakatvaṃ na bhavati | bhavati
hi samudāyaḥ samudāyinaḥ sadṛśa iti syātprasaṅgaḥ | nāyaṃ prasaṅgaḥ,
ṭhparavalliṅgam' ityanena samudāyasya paravalliṅgātideśāt ?
satyam; idaṃ tu vastusvarūpanirūpaṇaparaṃ draṣṭavyam | tadanena
stanakeśādisambandhaḥ, stanādaya eva vā viśiṣṭasaṃsthānāḥ,
tadupavyañjanā vā jātayaḥ strītvādaya ityuktaṃ bhavati |
atra pakṣe bhrukuaṃse ṭāp prasajyeta, bhrukuaṃsaḥustrīveṣadhārī naṭaḥ,
tasya stanakeśasambandhaṃ upalabhyate, kharakuṭa|ladīnāṃ ca
lomaśatvātpuṃstve sati kharakuṭīḥ paśyetyatra natvaṃ prāpnoti |
kharakuṭīunāpitagṛhamucyate | nanu ca svābhāvikapariṇāmaśālibhiḥ
stanādibhiratra sambandho vivakṣitaḥ, na yathākathañcit ; stanādi ca
prasiddhasyānyasyāpyupalakṣaṇamuktaṃ tatkuto'yaṃ prasaṅgaḥ ? evaṃ tahi
khaṭvāvṛkṣau na sidhyataḥ, khaṭvāvṛkṣādīnāṃ stanalomādyabhāvāt |
syādetat---yathā vastrāntarhitāni dravyāṇi nopalabhyante,
tadvatkhaṭvāvṛkṣayoḥ sadeva liṅgaṃ nopalabhyata iti ? tanna;
vastrāntarhitāni dravyāṇi vastrāpāye upalabhyante
khaṭvāvṛkṣayostilaśastatkṣaṇe'pi liṅgaṃ nopalabhyate | yathā
tarhyādityagatiḥ satī pratyakṣeṇa nopalabhyate deśāntaraprāptyā
tvanumīyate, tathā khaṭvāvṛkṣayorapi sadeva liṅgaṃ
sūkṣmatvānnopalabhyate |
satāmapi hi bhāvānāṃ ṣaḍbhiḥ
prakārairanupalabdhirbhavati---atisannikarṣād,
yathā---svacakṣurgatasyāñjanādeḥ | ativiprakarṣāt, yathā-uḍḍīnasya
śakuneḥ | mūrtāntarddhānāt, yathā---kuḍa|ladivyavahitasya
suvarṇādeḥ | andhakārāvṛtatvāt, yathāandakārākrāntasya ghaṭādeḥ |
indriyadaurbalyāt-timirādyaupaghāte cakṣurādeḥ |
atipramādāt---ṭhprāmādo'navadhānatā', viṣayāntaravyāsaktacito hi
sannikṛṣṭamaprayarthaṃ nopalabhyate | saukṣmyaṃ tu---indriyadaurbalya
evāntarbhūtam, divyacakṣuḥ śrotro hi sūkṣmamapyarthamupalabhate | evaṃ
samānābhihāro'pi tatraivāntarbhūtaḥ, tadyathā māṣarāśaumāṣaḥ prakṣiptaḥ
pṛthagnopalabhyate | evamabhibhavo'pi, tadyathā---saurībhiḥ
prabhābhirabhibhūtāni nakṣatrāṇi divā nopalabhyante | kema
punaretadavasīyate khaṭvāvṛkṣayoḥ sadeva liṅgaṃ nopalabhyata iti
? ṭābādestatkṛtasyānanyakāryasya darśanāt | yadyevam,
itaretarāśrayaṃ prāpnoti---liṅgāvagamāṭṭābādiśabdaprayogaḥ,
tadyogālliṅgāvagatiriti ? indriyadaurbalyaṃ kadācidupalabdhasya
kadācidanupalambhe kāraṇaṃ śakyamabhidhātum, khaṭvādiṣu ca
liṅgasya
kadācidapyanupalambhālliṅgaviviktakhaṭvādivastugrāhiṇā pratyakṣeṇa
liṅgābhāvaniścayātadviruddhamanumānaṃ nodetumarhati | na hi
śakyate vaktum---bhikṣugṛhaṃ gajavad deśatvādgajaśālāvat,
pratyakṣeṇendriyadaurbalyātu gajo nopalabhyata iti, tasmādasadeva
liṅgaṃ śabdaprayogamahimna khaṭvādiṣu pratīyate | bhavatvevaṃ
śrotuḥ pratītiḥ, yastvasau prayoktā sa kena liṅgamagamya tadanurūpaṃ
śabdaṃ prayuṅkte ! kiñca---kumāryarthaḥ, kumārī vastviti
kumāryādiṣvarthavastuśabdayoḥ punnapuṃsakayoranupapatiḥ | bhāṣye
tu---
āvirbhāvastirobhāvaḥ sthitiścetyanapāyinaḥ |
dharmā mūrtiṣu sarvāsu liṅgatvenānudarśitāḥ || 
āvirbhāvaḥūpacayaḥ, puṃstvam ; tirobhāvaḥuapacayaḥ, strītvam ;
antarālāvasthā sthitirnapuṃsakatvamityarthaḥ | kasya
punarāvirbhāvādikaṃ liṅgam ? satvarajastamasāṃ gumānāṃ
tatpariṇāmarūpāṇāṃ ca tadātmakānāṃ śabdasparśarūparasagandhānām |
śabdādisaṅghātarūpāśca sarvā mūrtayaḥ pratikṣaṇapariṇāmasvabhāvāśca
satvādayo guṇā na svasminnātmani mūhūrtamapyavatiṣṭhante | evaṃ
śabdādaya ākāśādayo ghaṭādayaśca |
uktañca---
sarvamūrtyātmabhūtānāṃ śabdādīnāṃ gaṇe gaṇe |
trayaḥ satvādidharmāste sarvatra samavasthitaḥ || iti |
kvathitodakavaccaiṣāmanavasthitavṛttitā |
ajasraṃ sarvabhāvānāṃ bhāṣya evopavarṇitā || iti ca |
tathā---
rūpasya cātmamātrāṇāṃ śuklādīnāṃ pratikṣaṇam |
kācitpralīyate kācit kathaṃcidabhivardhate || iti |
pravṛttimantaḥ sarve hi tisṛbhiśca pravṛttibhiḥ |
satataṃ na viyujyante vācaścaivātra sambhavaḥ || iti ca |
ṭābādyantaḥ śabda evaitā avasthā gocarayatītyarthaḥ | puruṣo
yadyapyapariṇāmī, tathāpi---
ucetaneṣu saṅkrāntaṃ caitanyamiva dṛśyate |
pratibimbakadharmeṇa yatadvāco nibandhanam ||
tataśca---
yaścāpravṛttidharmārthascitirūpeṇa gṛhyate |
anuyātīva so'nyeṣāṃ pravṛttiviṣvagāśrayā ||
sāmānyamapi gotvādi vyakteravyatirekataḥ |
pravṛttidharmaṃ taddvārā śaśaśrṛṅgādivākṣu tu ||
tasmāduktapadārthasya sambhavālliṅgayogitā |
pravṛterapi vidyante tisro hyaetāḥ pravṛtayaḥ ||
punnapuṃsakatā strītvaṃ tena syādanyaliṅgatā |
tadevaṃ sarvapadārthavyāpitvādupacayāntarālāvasthāstrīṇi liṅgāni
| evaṃ ca nakṣatre tārakā tiṣyaḥ, kumāryartho vastu iti ekasyāpyarthasya
nānāliṅgayoga upapadyate; āvirbhāvāditrayasyāpi guṇabhedena
nasminnevārthe sarvadā sambhavāt | na caivaṃ tadvṛteḥ sarvasyaiva
śabdasya triliṅgatāprasaṅgaḥ; na hyasti niyamaḥ---yaḥ śabdo yatrārthe
paryavasyati tatra vidyamānaḥ sarva evākārastena śabdenābhidhātavya iti,
kintu ya ākāro'bhīdhīyate tena satā bhavitavyamityetāvat |
tadyathā---takṣā, yuvā, kṛṣṇaḥ, kāmuka iti
takṣādaśabdānāmekārthaparyavasitānāmapi vyavasthita evākāro vācyaḥ
| tathā liṅgeṣvapi draṣṭavyam | uktaṃ ca---
sannidhāne padārthānāṃ kiñcideva pravartakam |
yathā takṣādiśabdānāṃ liṅgeṣu niyamastathā || iti |
upacīyate kumārītyatrāpi kumārīśabdaḥ svamahimnā
kasyaciddharmasyāpacayamevāha | śabdāntaraprayogātu
dharmāntarasyopacayaḥ pratīyate | evaṃ kṣīyate vṛkṣa ityatrāpacayaḥ,
tadevaṃ sarvamanākulamidaṃ darśanam |
vṛttikārastu laukikānāmevaṃ pratipaterabhāvātatpratipatyanuguṇaṃ
pakṣaṃ darśayati---sāmānyaviśeṣā iti | kānicitsāmānyānītyarthaḥ |
yadvā---satāvyatirikteṣu sāmānyeṣu sāmānyaviśeṣaśabdo rūḍhaḥ |
tisro'vāntarajātaya ityarthaḥ | uktaṃ ca---
tisro jātaya evaitāḥ keṣāñcitsamavasthitāḥ |
aviruddhā viruddhābhirgomahiṣyādijātibhiḥ ||
hastinyāṃ vaḍavāyāṃ ca strītvabuddheḥ samanvayaḥ |
atastāṃ jātimicchanti dravyādisamavāyinīm || iti |
nanu caiṣāṃ trayāṇāmapi sāmānyaviśeṣāṇāṃ sarvārtheṣu
sadbhāvo'bhyupagantavyaḥ, na gotvādikatkatipayeṣvevārtheṣu,
kathamanyathārthavyaktivastvādiśabdānāṃ bhinniliṅgānāmekasminnarthe
prayogaḥ syāt | tataśca sarvatra triliṅgapatibhāsaṃprasaṅga ityata
āha---bahuprakārāvyaktaya iti | vyajyante sāmānyaviśeṣā ābhiriti
vyaktayaḥu āśrayāḥ | etaduktaṃ bhavati---vicitratvādāśrayāṇāṃ vyañjakānāṃ
kaścidāśrayaḥ kasyacitsāmānyaviśeṣasya vyañjakaḥ, na sarvaḥ sarvasyeti
| tatra cetaneṣu stanādimatī vyaktiḥ strītvasya vyañjikā,
lomaśatvādimatī puṃstvasya, ubhayavyañjanā napuṃsakatvasya ;
acetaneṣu katham, na hi tatra kiñcidapi liṅgaṃ vyajyate ? tathā
cetane'pyarthavyaktivastvādiśabdānāṃ bhinniliṅgānāmapyanupapatiḥ,
dāraśabdasya ca puṃlliṅgasya bhāryāyāmanupatiḥ ? ata
āha---kvacidāśrayaviśeṣābhāvāditi | tadabhivyañjanasamartha
āśrayaviśeṣaḥ | tatrācetaneṣu sarvatropadeśādevābhivyaktiḥ |
upadeśaḥ punarliṅgānuśāsanādiṣu | atraiva dṛṣṭāntamāha---yathā
brāhmaṇatvādaya iti |
brāhmaṇakṣatriyādivyaktīnāmatyantasādṛśyādupadeśādeva
brāhmaṇatvādīnāmabhivyaktirbhavati; no khalu brāhmaṇakṣatriyayoḥ
puro'vasthitayorayaṃ brāhmaṇaḥ, ayaṃ kṣatriya iti prāgevopadeśātpratyaya
udeti | yathā gavāśvavyaktyorabhāve
śaśaviṣāṇādāvapyutarapadārthadvārakaḥ sāmānyayogaḥ, sāmānyaṃ
jātiḥ, strītvaṃ strītā puṃstvaṃ puṃstetyādau sāmānve'pi
sāmānyāntarasya sadbhāvaḥ, yathā---gotvādau satāsāmānyasya | na
