hyasmākaṃ vaiśeṣikāṇāmiva niḥ sāmānyāni sāmānyāni |
strīśabdo'yaṃ śuklādiśabdavadguṇamātre guṇini ca vartate, tatra
yadā guṇamātre strīśabdo vartate tadā dravyavācinaḥ
prātipadikātstrītve'bhidheye ṭābādayo bhavantīti strītvaṃ pratyayārtha
iti pakṣo bhavati | yadā tu strītvayuktaṃ dravyaṃ strīśabdenocyate tadā
paraṃ pakṣadvayaṃ sambhavati---strītvamupalakṣaṇam, viśeṣaṇaṃ veti |
tatrādye strītvopalakṣitadravyācinaḥ prātipadikāṭṭābādaya iti, ayaṃ
strīsamānādhikaraṇāditi pakṣo bhavati | dvitīye tu
strītvayuktadravyavācino'ṅgokṛtastrītvātprātipadikāditi
prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇaṃ strītvamiti pakṣo bhavati | tatra
strīsamānādhikaraṇāditi ced bhūtādiṣvatiprasaṅgaḥ---būtamiyaṃ
brāhmaṇī, pradhānamiyaṃ brāhmaṇī āvapanamiyamuṣṭriketi | ubhayostu
pakṣayornaiṣa doṣaḥ, katham ? bhūtādayaḥ
caitanyaprādhānyasambhavanavadvṛtayaḥ, na tu strītvāṅgīkāreṇa
vartante | tadevamatra pakṣe
doṣadarśanāditarayoranyataradāśrayaṇīyamityāha---strītvaṃ ceti |
ubhayathāpi yujyate iti | nanu pratyayārthapakṣe
dvivacanabahuvacanānekapratyayānupapatiḥ, katham ? eko'yamarthaḥ
strītvaṃ nāma, tadeva ca prakṛtyarthopasarjanaṃ pratyayenābhidhīyate,
tasyaikatvādekavacanameva prāpnoti ? anekaśca pratyayo
nopapadyate---gārgyāyaṇī, kārīṣagandhyā, kālitareti, katham ?
eko'yamarthaḥ strītvaṃ nāma tasyaikenoktatvād dvitīyaḥ pratyayo na
prāpnoti---uktārthānāmaprayoga iti ? strīśabde cekāro na
prāpnoti, saṃstyāne ṭhstyāyaterḍraṭ' iti ḍraṭpratyayāntena
strīśabdenoktatvāt saṃstyānaṃ strītvam ? sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ ca na
syāt---kumārī devadateti, svasvaprakṛtyarthāvacchinnayoḥ
strītvayoḥ prādhānyenābhidhānāt, tatra vyatirikanibandhā ṣaṣṭhī
prāpnoti, kutaḥ ? na tāvadanya'nyataḥ ; parasparaṃ
guṇaguṇibhāvābhāvāt, nāpi strīpratyayaprakṛteḥ ;
ṭābādibhirbādhitvāt ? yatra tarhi pratiyogini strīpratyayaḥ
pratiṣidhyate tatra ṣaṣṭhī prāpnoti---pañca brāhmaṇyaḥ, svasābhirūpeti ?
pakṣāntare tu dvayorapi dravyaniṣṭhatvādvyatirekābhāvaḥ
sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ ca bhavati, dravyasya cānekatvād
dvivacanabahuvacane api yukte | yathaiva ca prātipadikenokte'pi
strītve ṭābādayo bhavanti, tathāneko'pi pratyayo nānupapannaḥ,
taddyotako hi tadā nānāpratyayaḥ, pradīpādeścānekasyāpi
dyotakatvaṃ dṛṣṭam | pratyayārthapakṣe'pi na doṣaḥ | yadyapi strītvamātre
vācye pratyayaḥ kriyate, tathāpi strītvatadāśrayayorabhedavivakṣayā
svābhāvikatvādvā guṇapradhānabhāvasya dvayorapi dṛṣṭatvena
sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ vacanabhedaśca bhaviṣyati | gārgyāyaṇītyādau ca
dvābhyāmeva strītvamabhidhātuṃ śakyate, naikena; svabhāvāt |
yadvā---ṣphasya ṣitkaraṇasāmarthyānṅīṣ siddhaḥ, ṣyaṅ ṭhyiṅścāp'
iti vacanasāmarthyāccāb bhaviṣyati | tathā hi---atra yaṅṣyaṅeḥ
sāmānyagrahaṇāya tadavighātāya ca ṣyaṅenubandhadvayaṃ kṛtam,
kālitaretyatrānyaḥ prakarṣayukto'nyaścāprakarṣayuktaḥ,
tatrāvasthābhedādeka evārtho bhidyata iti prakarṣayuktasyānabhihitaṃ
strītvamiti tadabhidhānāya ṭābapi bhaviṣyāta | strīśabde'pi
ṭhstriyām' ityasmādeva nipātanādīkāraḥ siddha iti
suṣṭhūaktam---ubhayathāpiyujyata iti ||
ajādyataṣṭāp || 4|1|4 ||
adantācceti | akārāntādityarthaḥ | svarūpagrahaṇaṃ tu na bhavati;
acchabdāntāt nītat parītat kaliṅgagadityādeḥ
strīliṅgāditi, ṭhtadādyācikhyāsāyām' ityādernirdeśāt | pakāraḥ
sāmānyagrahaṇārtha iti | ṭhṅyāpprātipadikāt' ityādau |
pakārānurodhastu ṭābḍāpoḥ svarthaḥ | ṭakāraḥ
sāmānyagrahaṇāvighātārtha iti | anyathaikānubandhakatvādasyaiva grahaṇaṃ
syāt, na tu ḍāpcāpoḥ | khaṭveti | kathaṃ punaratrākārāntā
prakṛtiravadhāryate, yāvatā nityamevāyamābantaḥ striyāṃ vartate ?
śāstrātprayogācca | śākaṭāyanadarśane hi sarveṣāmeva vyutpattiḥ |
pañcabhiḥ khaṭvābhiḥ krītaḥ pañcakhaṭva ityādau strīpratyaye lupte
prayoga evākārāntatvaṃ dṛśyate | śubhaṃyāḥ, kīlālapā iti |
ṭhanyebhyo'pi dṛśyante' iti vic | kaḥ punaratra ṭāpi sati doṣa
ityāha---halḍa|labbhya iti sulopaḥ syāditi |
kvacijjātilakṣaṇa iti | gaṇapāṭhāvasare vibhāgaṃ darśayiṣyati |
halantānāṃ tvityādi | ajādigrahaṇamiti | prakṛtasya
prathamāntasyānvayāsambhavātadarthamajādigrahaṇamiti śeṣaḥ |
amahatpūrveti |
mahacchabdasyānukaraṇatvāllaukikārthābhidhāyitvābhāvāt ṭhānmahataḥ'
ityātvaṃ na bhavati | puṃyoge tuṅīṣaiveti | jātigrahaṇasya
prayojanamāha | nanu puṃyoge so'yamityabhisambandhātparaśabdaḥ paratra
vartata iti gauṇatvādeva na bhaviṣyati ? tasmātsukhapratipatyarthaṃ
jātigrahaṇam | amahatpūrvetyasyāthemāha---mahatpūrvasveti | atrāpi
jātiriti sambadhyate, iha pratiṣedho mā bhūt---mahatī śūdrā
mahāśūdreti, na hyatra mahatpūrvaḥ samudāyo jātivacanaḥ | kva tarhi
pratiṣedhaḥ ? yatra samudāyo jātau vartate | tadidaṃ
darśitam---mahāśūdraśabdo hyābhīrajātivacana iti | yadyevam,
samudāye jātivacane gaurakharādivadavayavārthā
bhāvādvyutpattimātraṃ kriyate, tatrāvayavārthasya
strītvasyāvivakṣitatvāt puṃsi samāse kṛte ṭāpaḥ prasaṅga iti ?
tatrāmahatpūrveti pratiṣedhaḥ sārthakaḥ | tataḥ kim ? amahatpūrvetyatra
jātiriti na sambandhanīyam | kathaṃ mahatī śūdrā
mahāśūdretyatrāntaraṅgatvāṭṭāpi kṛte paścātsup, subantasya
samāsaḥ, tataścābhinirvṛtatvāṭṭāpaḥ pratiṣedhasyāprasaṅgaḥ ?
satyam, vispaṣṭārthamevātrāpi jātiriti sambadhyate | nanu ca
śūdraśabdaḥ paṭha|lte, kaḥ prasaṅgo yanmahāśūdraśabdātsyāt ? ata
āha---tadantavidhirneti | atidhīvarī, atipīvarīti | dadhāteḥ
pibateśca ṭhāto maninkvanibvanipaśca' iti kvanipi kṛte
ghumāsthādisūtreṇetvam, dhīvānamatikrāntā pīvānamatikrānteti
prādisamāsaḥ, atra ṭhvano ra ca' iti ṅībrau bhavataḥ | asati tu jñāpane
vana iti pratyayagrahaṇam | athāpi kṛdgrahaṇam ?
sarvathātikrāntapradhāne samāse na syāt | atibhavatī, atimahatīti |
ṭhugitaśca' ityatrogidityugitprātipadikasyaivaṃ
grahaṇamityaṅgīkṛtyedaṃ prayojanaṃ darśitam | tatra tu
vakṣyati---ṭhugiditi prātipadikāprātipadikagrahaṇam, tena grahaṇavatā
prātipadikeneti niṣedhābhāvātadantavidhiḥ' iti | yadāha---ṭhugidyasya
sambhavati yathākathciditi tadantātprātipadiṃkāt' iti ca ||
atimahatītyatra śatṛvadbhāvādauṇādikādugillakṣaṇo ṅīp |
kecidgaurādipāṭhād ṅīṣaṃ varṇayanti, tadayuktam ;
anupasarjanādhikārāt | kiñca, gaurādipāṭhasya prayojanamapi na
paśyāmaḥ | nanu ca mahatīśabdo'ntodāta iṣyate, satyam;
ṭhśaturanumaḥ' ityatra nadyajādyaudātatve ṭhbṛhanmahatorupasaṃkhyānam'
ityanenaiva siddham | vibhavatyudātārthaṃ taditi cet ? tadeva
ṅībudātārthamapi bhaviṣyati | atimahatītyādau ca
ṅīṣabhāvasyoktatvān ṅībudātārthamapyupasaṃkhyānameṣṭavyam, yudi
tadantavidhirjñāpyate, pañcānāmajānāṃ samāhāraḥ
pañcājī---dvigorapi ṭāp prāpnoti ? atrāhuḥ---ṭhajādyataḥ' iti
ṣaṣṭhī ajādīnāmajantānāṃ ca yā strī tadvācye'rthe yat strītvaṃ
samavetaṃ tatra ṭābiti, pratyāsatyā ca strītvaviśeṣopalakṣaṇānāmeva
prakṛtitvaṃ vijñāyate iti matvā vṛttikāreṇoktam---ṭhajādibhyaḥ
prātipadikebhyo'dantācca' iti | na ca pañcājītyatrājārthe samavetaṃ
strītvam, kiṃ tarhi ? samāhāre |
evaṃ cāmahatpūrveti pratiṣedhaḥ śakyo'kartum, na hi mahāśūdrītyatra
śūdrārthagataṃ strītvam | tadantavidhistu ṭh anupasarjanāt' ityatra
jñāpayiṣyate | satprākkāṇḍeti | pākakarṇetyatra
vārtikam---ṭhsadackāṇḍaprāntaśataikebhyaḥ puṣpātpratiṣedhaḥ' iti,
tatraiva bhāṣyam---ṭhprākpuṣpā ca pratyakpuṣpā ca' iti | tasmādatrāpi
prākśabdo na paṭhanīyaḥ, sadackāṇḍetyeva paṭhanīyam ||
ṛnnebhyo ṅīp || 4|1|5 ||
ṅkāraḥ sāmānyagrahaṇārtha iti | ṭhṅyāppratipadikāt' ityādau |
ṭhpakāraḥ sāmānyagrahaṇāvighātārthaḥ' iti tu pūrvānusāreṇa
gamyamānatvānnoktam, atrāpi pakārānurodho'nudātārthaḥ ||
ugitaśca || 4|1|6 ||
yathākathañciditi | yadi varṇa ugit saṃbhavati, yadi vā pratyayaḥ,
athāpi prātipadikam---sarvathā yatraiṣāmanyatamaḥ prakāraḥ
saṃbhavatītyeṣa yathākathañcidityasyārthaḥ | etadeva
spaṣṭayati---tadugicchabdarūpamiti | pratyayāpratyayoḥ
prātipadikāprātipadikayoḥ śabdarūpamanyapadārthaḥ, na
prātipadikameva, nāpi pratyaya evetyarthaḥ | tatrogitā prātipadikasya
viśeṣaṇatadantavidhirbhavatītyāha---tadantāditi | pacantīti | atra
śatṛpratyaya ugit tadantaṃ prātipadikam---atibhavatī
atimahatītyatrāpi bhavati | ṭhgrahaṇavatā prātipadikena' ityayaṃ tu
pratiṣedho yatra sūtropātaṃ prātipadikasyāsādhāraṇaṃ rūpaṃ tatraiva
bhavatītyatrāpi vyapadeśivadbhāvena bhavati |
ṭhvyapadeśivadbhāvo'prātipadikena' ityayaṃ tu niṣedhaḥ
prātipadikasyaivā sādhāraṇarūpagrahaṇe atigomatītyatrāpi bhavati |
pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣā tu pratyayasyaivāsādhāraṇarūpagrahaṇe bhavati |
ghātostūgitaḥ pratiṣedha iti | vaktavya iti śeṣaḥ | sa tarhi vaktavyaḥ ?
na vaktavyaḥ, ṭhugidacām' ityatrogitvādeva siddhe'ñcatigrahaṇaṃ
niyamārtham---iha śāstre ugito yatkāryaṃ vidhīyate taddhātoryadi
bhavati añcatereveti kāryamātraṃ niyamyate, na numāgama eva |
adhātugrahaṇaṃ cādhātupūrvasyāpi numarthamiti tatraiva vakṣyate |
apara āha---ṭhugitaśca' iti yo'yaṃ caśabdaḥ
so'ñcaterluptanakārasyākaraṇam, vibhakteśca ṭhsupāṃ suluk' iti
luk, bhāvinaṃ cākāralopamāśritya ceti nirdeśaḥ kṛtaḥ,
tataścāñcatigrahaṇaṃ
niyamārtham---"akāranakāralopayoścātantratvāt ṭhnāñceḥ
pūjāyām' iti lopaniṣedhaviṣaye'pi ṅīb bhavati, prāñcī
pratyañcī brāhmaṇī" iti | ukhāsrat, parṇadhvaditi | ṭhkvip ca'
ityatrānayorvyutpattiḥ kṛtā ||
vano ra ca || 4|1|7 ||
ṭhvanaḥ' iti kvanibvanibṅvanipāṃ pratyayānāṃ sāmānyena
grahaṇam, na ṭhvana ṣaṇa saṃbhaktau', ṭhvanu yācena' iti
dhātvorvijantayoḥ, kutaḥ ? ṭhpratyayāpratyayoḥ pratyayasyaiva grahaṇam'
iti | ata eva śuno niṣkrāntā yuvānamatikrāntā niḥ śunī
atiyūnītyatrāpi na bhavati, anarthakatvādvā | śarvarīti | ṭhśṛ
hiṃsāyām', ṭhanyebhyo'pi dṛśyante' iti vanip | paralokadṛśvarīti
| ṭhdṛśeḥ kvanip' |
vano na haśa iti | vihitaviśeṣaṇaṃ haśgrahaṇam, haśantāddhātoryo
vanvihitastadantātprātipadikān ṅībrau na bhavata ityarthaḥ, tena
"sarvarītyatra pratiṣedhābhāvaḥ | tathā ṭhoṇṛ apanayena' vanipi
ṭhviḍvanoranunāsikasyāt' ityātve avādeśeavāvannityatra
saṃprati haśaḥ | paratvābhāve'pi haśantādvihitatvāt pratiṣedho
bhavatyeva---avāvā brāhmaṇīti | taṣa eva sthitaḥ siddhāntaḥ |
bahulaṃ cchandasi ṅībrau vaktavyau---yajvarīriṣaḥ | praiiriśavostuṭ
ca---prertvarī ||
pādo'nyatarasyām || 4|1|8 ||
pāda iti kṛtasamāsāntaḥ pādaśabdo nirdiśyata iti | utarasūtre
ṛcyabhidheyāyāṃ tasyaiva sambhavāt, tena pādayate kvibantasya grahaṇaṃ
na bhavati | dvipadīti | dvau pādāvasya iti ṭhbahuvrīhau
saṃkhyāsupūrvasya' ityakāralope ṭhpādaḥ pat' iti padbhāvaḥ ||
ṭābṛci || 4|1|9 ||
ṛcītyabhidheyanirdeśa iti | vyāpteḥ | viṣayanirdeśe hi
ṛgvedaviṣaya eva prayoge syāt, nānyatra ||
na ṣaṭsvasrādibhyaḥ || 4|1|10 ||
ṭhṭābṛci' iti pādantādvihitasya ṭāpo'trāprasaṅgātadanantarasya
ṅīpo'yaṃ pratiṣedha ityāśaṅkāmapanayati---yo yata iti | tatra
sarvebhya eva ṅīpprāpnoti, ṭāptu nalope
satyakārāntatāyāmupajātāyāṃ ṣaḍbhya eva | yo yaḥ prāpta iti tu
yuktaḥ pāṭhaḥ, anyathā sa tato na bhavatīti vācyaṃ syāt, vyāptiśca na
gamyeta | pañca brāhmaṇya iti | nanu cātra
brāhmaṇīśabdasāmānādhikaraṇyāt strītvāvagatiḥ, saṃkhyāśabdastu
svamahimnā bhedagaṇanamāha | tathā hi---pañcetyukte nānātvamātraṃ
dravyasya gamyate, na liṅgaviśeṣaḥ ; tathā ca liṅgānuśāsaneṣu
ṭhṣṇāntā saṃkhyā' ityaliṅgatvamuktam | yadyevam, ekā, dve, bahvya
ityatrāpi pratyayo na syāt ? saṃkhyāśabdatvena bhedagaṇanāmātrasya
śabdārthatvāt | atha tatra strītvamapi śabdārthaḥ ? pañcādiṣvapi syāt
| vaktavyo vā viśeṣaḥ---sati tasmin pratiṣedhe
nāntareṇānuprayogaṃ pañcetyādau strītvādyabhivyaktiriti
liṅgānuśāsaneṣvaliṅgatvamuktam ; asati tu pratiṣedhe
pañcādibhyaḥ strīpratyayo na bhavati, ekādibhyastu bhavatīti na
śāstraikaśaraṇaḥ pratipatumarhati | nanu vibhaktau parataḥ ṭhtricaturoḥ
striyām' tisṛcatasṛbhāvaḥ, tatraṃ saṃnipātaparibhāṣayaiva ṅībabhāvaḥ
siddhaḥ, tatkiṃ tisṛcatasṛśabdayoḥ svasrādipāṭhena ? jñāpanārtha tu |
etajjñāpayati---anityā saṃnipātaparibhāṣeti, tena tyadādyatve kṛte
ṭāb bhavati---yā, sā, ime, dve iti |
ṅīpo'nantarasyāyaṃ pratiṣedho yukta ityāśritya
codayati---ṣaṭsaṃjñānāmiti | kasmānna syāditi | ata iti hi
prāpnoti, asiddho nalopaḥ, tasyāsiddhatvānnaitadadantam |
parigaṇiteṣu kāryeṣu nalopo'siddho bhavati, ṭhnalopaḥ supsvara'
ityasya niyamārthatvāt | nedaṃ tatra parigaṇyate ? idamapi tatra
pigaṇyate, katham ? subiti na saptamībahuvacanena pratyāhāraḥ, kiṃ
tarhi ? yaṅścābiti cāpaḥ pakāreṇa, tataśca ṭāpo'pi
pratyāhāre'ntarbhāvātadvidhirapi subvidhireveti |
tadetadāha---pratyāhārāccāpeti | na syādityanuṣaṅgaḥ, kasmānna
syāditi praśnaḥ | cāpā pratyāhārānna syāditi parihāraḥ | idaṃ
cācāryadeśīyasya vacanam |
ācāryasiddhāntaṃ darśayitumetad dūṣayati---siddhaṃ doṣastvitva iti
| satyaṃ siddhamidaṃ cāpā pratyāhāre, itve tu doṣo bhavati---siddhaṃ
doṣastvitva iti | satyaṃ siddhamidaṃ cāpā pratyāhāre, itve tu
doṣo bhavati---bahūni carmāṇyasyāḥ bahucarmiketi, katham ? tatra
subvidhirita sarvavibhakyantāvayavaḥ samāsa āśritaḥ---supo vidhiḥ,
supi vidhiriti; tataśca yathā rājabhyāmityatra ṭhsupi ca' iti
dīrghatvaṃ na bhavati, tathā ṭāpi supi vidhīyamānamitvamapi
subvidhiriti tatra vartavye nalopasyāsiddhatvātkāt pūrvo'kāro
na bhavatītītvaṃ na syādityarthaḥ | siddhāntamāha---tasmānnobhāviti |
ṭhstriyām' ityarthamātramapekṣya tatra yaduktaṃ tanna bhavati, ityevaṃ
ṅīpṭāpāvubhāvapi pratiṣedhyāvityarthaḥ | nanu ca sakṛtpratiṣedhasya
pravṛttiḥ, sa ca svapravṛttisamaye yasya prasaṅgastameva pratiṣedhati,
tataśca pūrvaṃ ṅīpi pratiṣiddhe nalope ca kṛte paścātprāpnuvataṣṭāpaḥ
kathaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ ? ātmāśrayo hi syāt---svapravṛttimapekṣya
svapravṛttiriti | tasmātantrāvṛtyekaśeṣāṇāmanyatamāśrayaṇena dvirasya
pravṛttiḥ, tatra dvitīyayā pravṛtyā ṭāpaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ ||
manaḥ || 4|1|11 ||
aninasmangrahaṇānīti | an, in, as, man---ityeteṣāṃ grahaṇe
arthavatparibhāṣā na vyāpriyate, tenaiṣāmanarthakānāmapi grahaṇaṃ bhavati
| ebhiścārthavadbhiranarthakaiśca tadantavidhirbhavatītyarthaḥ |
sīmanśabdo'vyutpannaṃ prātipadikam | atikrāntā
mahimānamatimahimā, atrāpīmanica evārthavatvam, na tu manaḥ ||
ano bahuvrīheḥ || 4|1|12 ||
ñanupadhālopī bahuvrīhirihodāharaṇamiti | kuta etat ?
ityāha---upaghālopino hītyādi, vibhāṣāṃ vakṣyatīti | ṭhana
upadhālopino'nyatarasyām' ityanena | suparvetyādi | śobhanaṃ
parvāsyāḥ, śobhanaṃ carmāsyā iti bahuvrīhiḥ | ayaṃ ca ṭhna
saṃyogādvamantāt' ityallopasya pratiṣedhātanupadhālopī | 
bahuvrīheriti kimiti | samāsāditi vācyamiti bhāvaḥ |
atirājñīti | ṭhrājāhaḥ sakhibhyaḥ' iti ṭaj na bhavati;
samāsāntavidheranityatvāt |
ḍābubhābhyāmanyatarasyām || 4|1|13 ||
antarasyāṃgrahaṇaṃ kimiti | ḍāpā mukte pratiṣedho yathā
syādityevamarthaṃ tāvadetanna kartavyam, katham ? ḍābupyucyate,
pratiṣedho'pi tāvubhau vacanādbhaviṣyataḥ | yadi hi nakārāntasya
śravaṇaṃ na syāt, tadā ḍāpaivāpavādena ṅīpo bādhāt
pratiṣedho'narthakaḥ syāt | atha ḍāppratiṣedhābhyāṃ mukte ṅībapi yathā
syādityevamarthamanyatarasyāṃgrahaṇam ? tadapi na; bahurājñītyādau
ṭhana upadhālopino'nyatarasyām' ityanenaiva ṅīpaḥ siddhatvāt | yatra
tarhi tena na siddhayati---atiśarmetyādau, tadarthametatsyāt ?
yadyevam, anenaivopadhālopino'pi siddhatvād ṭhana upadhālopinaḥ'
ityetadanarthakaṃ syāt | evaṃ tarhi tadanyatarasyāṃ grahaṇaṃ na
kariṣyāmītidamanyatarasyāṃgrahaṇaṃ kriyate, katham ?
anenaivānyatarasyāṃgrahaṇenopadhālopino'nupadhālopinaśca ṅīpi
prāpite sati ṭhana upadhālopinaḥ' ityetāvadapi kriyamāṇaṃ niyamārthaṃ
bhaviṣyati---ano bahuvrīheryan ṅībvidhānaṃ tadupadhālopina
eveti, tataśca tadanyatarasyāṃgrahaṇaṃ na kartavyaṃ bhavati ? tadavaśyaṃ
kartavyam, asati hi tasminnanenānyatarasyāṃgrahaṇena
bahuvrīhimātrād ḍāppratiṣedhaṅīpsu triṣvapi
prāpteṣūpadhālopino ḍāppratiṣedhau bādhitvā nityaṃ ṅībeva yathā
syādityevamarthaṃ tatsyāt | atastadavaśyaṃ kartavyam, idaṃ tu na
kartavyamiti praśnaḥ |
pariharati---bahuvrīhāviti | ayamabhiprāyaḥ---ḍāppratiṣedhābhyā mukte
ṅībapi yathā syādityevamarthamidaṃ tāvadanyatarasyāgrahaṇam | na ca
ṭhana upadhālopinaḥ' ityasya vaiyarthyam ; niyamārthatvāt---ano
bahuvrīheryadanyatarasyāṃ ṅībvidhānaṃ tadupadhālopina eveti | tena
suparvā, suśarmetyādāvanenānyatarasyāṃgrahaṇena prāpito ṅīb na
bhavati, bahurājñītyādāveva tu bhavati |
nanvevamidamanyatarasyāṃgrahaṇaṃ mā bhūt, ṭhana upadhālopinaḥ'
ityetadeva vidhyarthamastu, ko vā viśeṣaḥ ? anenānyatarasyāṃgrahaṇena
bahuvrīhimātrān ṅīpi prāpite tanniyamārthaṃ syād, asati
vāsmin ḍāppratiṣedhayoreva prāptayorupadhālopino'prāpto
ṅīp pakṣe vidhīyate iti ? ayamasti
viśeṣaḥ---asminnanyatarasyāṃgrahaṇe sati ḍāppratiṣedhābhyāṃ mukte svena
svena sāstreṇa ṅīb bhavan vannanteṣu ṭhvano ra ca' ityanenaiva
bhavatīti bahudhīvarītyādau repho'pi bhavati | evamanena
vannantādupadhālopino'nupadālopinaśca
bahuvrīherbahudhīvansuparvannityāderṅībrephayoḥ prāpitayoranyatra
bahurājansuśarmannityādau kevale ṅīpi prāpite satiṭhana
upadhālopino'nyatarasyām' ityetanniyamārthaṃ bhavati, tena ca
niyamena suśarmetyādau ṅīb vyāvartyate | suparvetyādau ṅīpi
vyāvartite tatsanniyogaśiṣṭatvādrepho'pi na bhavati |
bahurājñītyādau tu yathāprāpto ṅībavasthitaḥ, bahudhīvarītyādau ca
ṭhvano ra ca' ityanena prāptau ṅībrephāvavasthitāviti sarvamiṣṭṃa
sidhyati | asati tvasmin, tasmiṃśca vidhyarthe'pūrva eva ṅīp tena
vidhīyata iti vannante bahuvrīhau ṭhṛnnebhyo ṅīp' ityetatsanniyuktaṃ
ṭhvano ra ca' ityetanna pravarteteti kevale ṅīpi sati bahudhīvnīti
syāt | ataḥ ṭhana upadhālopinaḥ' ityatanniyamārthaṃ yathā syātsvatantro
vidhirmā bhūdityevamarthamihānyatarasyāṃgrahaṇaṃ kriyata iti | tadidam
ṭhana upadhālopinaḥ' ityatra vṛttikāraḥ spaṣṭayiṣyati |
yadyanenānyatarasyāṃgrahaṇena pakṣe ṅībapi prāpyate dāmetyādau
mannantādapi prāpnoti ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; yogavibhāgaḥ
kriyate---ḍābubhābhyāṃ bhavati, tataḥ ṭhanyatarasyām;' ṭhano baruvrīheḥ'
ityeva varte, ṭhmanaḥ' iti nivṛtam ||
anupasarjanāt || 4|1|14 ||
prasajyapratiṣedho'yamityāha---utarasūtreṣūpasarjanapratiṣedhaṃ
karotīti | paryudāse ko doṣaḥ ? kukkuṭīpāda ityatra na syāt
pūrvapadasyopasarjanatvāt, na; antaraṅgatvātprāgeva ṅīṣi kṛte
tadantasya samāsaḥ | na cedānīmupasarjanatve ṅīṣaḥ paryudāsaḥ,
pūrvamevābhinirvṛtatvāt | kiñca prasajyapratiṣedhe'pyeṣa doṣaḥ
samānaḥ | kukkuṭītyatraiva tarhi na prāpnoti, kiṃ kāraṇam ?
anvarthamupasarjanam, apradhānamupasarjanamiti ? astvevam ;
anupasarjanaṃ tūpasarjanādanyatsarvam, na tu pradhānameva,
tenāpekṣaṇīyasyābhāve'pyapradhānādanyatvādbhaviṣyati | yadā
tarhyadharmānṛtādivadvirodhivacano'nupasarjaśabdastadā na prāpnoti,
tasmātprasajyapratiṣedhaḥ | anupasarjanādityevaṃ taditi | upasarjanānna
bhavatītyevamityarthaḥ | vakṣyati---ṭiḍḍhāṇañiti ṅībiti | kathaṃ
prathamāntasya vakṣyatītyanena sambandhaḥ ? atrāhuḥ---vakṣyati
ṭiḍḍhāṇañityetāvān granthaḥ | ṭiḍḍhāṇañiti vakṣyatītyarthaḥ | kaḥ
punaratra pratyaya ityatrāha---ṅībiti | evaṃ jāteriti ṅīṣ ityatrāpi
granthacchedaḥ, tatra ca pūrvasmin ṭhvakṣyati' ityanuṣaṅgaḥ | kurucarīti
| ṭhcareṣṭaḥ' bahukurucareti | bahuvrīhiḥ sarvopasarjanaḥ |
kathaṃ punarityādiḥ | pratyudāharaṇe yadupasarjanaṃ na tat striyāṃ
vartate, yadā ca striyāṃ vartate tadā bhavatyeva pratyayaḥ---bahvyaḥ
kurucaryo'syāṃ bahukurucarīkā, bahukukkuṭīkā madureti, yaḥ
striyāṃ vartate bahuvrīhistato'ṭitvādajātitvāccāprasaṅgaḥ | tathā
hi---ṭitprātipadikaṃ gṛhyate, tacca kiñcitsākṣāṭṭidbhavati,
yathā---nadaṭ, coraḍiti; kiñcitvavayavaṭitvadvāreṇa | yatra
hyavayavaṭitvamakiñcitkaraṃ tatra samudāyārthaṃ tadvijñāyate | sa cāvayavaḥ
kvaciddhātuḥ---stanandhayīti, kvacitkṛllyuḍādiḥ,
kvacitaddhitaṣṭa|luṭa|lulādiḥ | tatra yaṃ samudāyaṃ yo'vayavo na
vyabhicarati tadarthaṃ tasya ṭitvamiti kurucaraśabda eva ṭit, tatkuto
bahukurucaraśabdātprasaṅga iti praśnaḥ | pariharati---tadantavidhineti
| nanu grahaṇavatā prātipadikena tadantavidhiḥ pratiṣidhyate, grahaṇaṃ
copādānamātram, na tu svarūpeṇoccāraṇameva, tatkathaṃ tadantavidhiḥ
? syādetat--yatra gṛhyamāṇaṃ rūpaṃ prātipadikasyaivāsādhāraṇaṃ tatra
tadantavidhipratiṣedhaḥ, iha coraḍityādi prātipadikamapi ṭit,
lyuḍādipratyayo'pi, dheḍiti dhāturapi, tataśca yathā ṭhugitaśca'
ityatra varṇo'pyugitpratyayo'pi prātipadikamapīti
tadantavidhirbhavati, tathehāpi prasaṅga iti ? syādayaṃ prasaṅgo yadi
ṭitā prātipadikaṃ viśṣyeta, ṭiti ca prātipadikena viśeṣyamāṇe
nānena viśeṣyeṇa tadantavidhiḥ, prātipadikena cāsambhavāditi naiva
bahukurucaraśabdātprasaṅga ityata āha---jñāpitaṃ caitaditi | ṭhśūdrā
cāmahatpūrvā' ityatra jñāpitametat | avaśyañcaitaj
jñāpitamutaratrāpi paripālanīyamityāha---tathā ceti | anāśrīyamāṇe
jñāpake'ṇantādvidhīyamāno ṅīp pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣayā
kāraśabdādeva syād, na tvaṇantātkumbhakāraśabdāt | jñāpakātu
tato'pi bhavatītyarthaḥ |
nanu ca kṛdgrahaṇaparibhāṣayā kumbhakāraśabdasyāṇantatvam ?
netyāha---na cāṇiti | kṛdgrahaṇamiti | kiṃ
kāraṇamityatrāha---taddhito'pyaṇastīti | yatra tu gṛhyamāṇaṃ rūpaṃ kṛta
evāsādhāraṇaṃ tatraiṣā paribhāṣā | iha tvaupagavīti taddhitasyāpi
grahaṇamiti nāyamasyā viṣaya ityarthaḥ | atha kāraśabdādutpatau satyāṃ
ko doṣaḥ ? kaumbhakāreyo na sidhyati, pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣayā
kārīśabdātstrībhyo ḍhaki tasyaiva vṛddhisvarau syātām | ṣyaṅaḥ
samprasāraṇavadbhaviṣyati, tadyathā---ṣyaṅntasyocyamānaṃ samprasāraṇaṃ
paramakārīṣagandhīputra ityatrāpi bhavati, strīpratyaye
tadādiniyamābhāvāt; tathā kāraśabdādapyutpatau
kumbhakārīśabdasyāpi strīpratyayāntatvādbhaviṣyati, evamapi
kārīśabdādapi kadācitsyāt |
atha brūyāḥ---kārīśabdena kumbhaśabdaḥ samasiṣyate, ṭhstrībhyo ḍhak'
ityatra ca ṭhṅyāpprātipadikāt' iti
tritayādhikārasāmarthyātstrīpratyayāntātprātipadikāditi pratyayo
vidhāsyate, strīpratyayāntasya ca prātipadikatvaṃ
samāsamantareṇānupapannamiti kumbhakārīśabdādeva ḍhagutpatsyate,
ḍhyabgrahaṇāmuvṛtyā ca sauparṇeya ityatrāpi bhaviṣyatīti ?
evamapiṅyābanuvṛteḥ sauparṇeya itivat kārīśabdādapi syāt |
ṭhgatikārakopadānām' itivacanāccaṅyante samāso durlabhaḥ, tataḥ
kumbhakāraśabdādevaṅībyathā syādityutaratrāpi
tadantavidhirabhyupagantavyaḥ | na ca kumbhakāraśabdādapyutpatau
tadādiniyamābhāvātkārīśabdādapi ḍhakpratyayaprasaṅgaḥ, kiṃ kāraṇam ?
ṭhstrīpratyaye cānupasarjane na' ityanena, pratyagrahaṇe yasmātsa
tadāderadhikasya grahaṇamabhyanujñāyate, na nyūnasyāpi | nanu ca
satyapyutaratra tadantavidhau kumbhakārītyatra samudāyādapi bhavatu,
kevalātkāraśabdādapi prasaṅgaḥ, yathā---aupagavītyādau, tataśca
kaumbhakāreyaḥ pakṣe duṣyatyeva ? evaṃ tarhi kāraśabdādapyutpatau
kumbhenaikārthībhūtasya tāvato
niṣkṛṣyāpatyenāyogātadādiniyamābhāvācca samudāyādeva
ḍhagabhaviṣyati |
yadvā---kumbhenaikārthībhūtasya kārasya strītvenāyogātstrīpratyaya eva na
bhaviṣyati, asati punarutaratra tadantavidhau strīpratyayasyātrāprasaṅgaḥ,
kiṃ kāraṇam ? yadaṇantaṃ na tasya niṣkṛṣya strītvena yogaḥ, yasya ca
strītvena yogo na tadaṇantam, ata utaratrāpyavaśyaṃ pradhānena
tadantavidhirabhyupagantavyaḥ, tatra yathā pradhānena bhavati
tathopasarjanenāpi syāditi pratiṣedho'yamārabhyate | tathā ca
pūrvatropasarjanenāpi tadantavidhirbhavati, ṭhna
ṣaṭsvasrādibhyaḥ'----priyapañcā draupadīti, atikrāntā
bhavantamatibhavatīti | syādetat---pūrvatropātaṃ tadantaṃ vā
ṭhstriyām' ityanena viśeṣyate, ṭhṭiḍḍhāṇañ' ityādiṣūpātemeva
ṭidādikam, tena jñāpite'pi tadantavidhau bahukurucaretyādau
ṭidāderastrītvānna bhaviṣyati, kumbhakārītyatra tvaṇantasya striyāṃ
vṛtestadantādapi bhaviṣyati, nārtha eteneti ? tanna; tvaduktasya
viṣayavibhāgasya durjñānatvāt, ato
viṣayavibhāgajñāpanārthamadamārabhyate |
nanvārabde'pyasminnaiṣa viṣayavibhāgaḥ śakya āsthātum,
pañcājītyatrājānāmastrītvena tadantasya striyāṃ vṛteḥ ṭhajādyataṣṭāp'
iti ṭāpprasaṅgāt | ato viśeṣaṇaviśe,yabhāvaṃ prati
kāmacārāt ṭhajādyataṣṭap' ityatra ṭhṭiḍḍhāṇañ' ityādau copātaṃ
strītvena viśeṣyate, ṭhvano ra ca' ityādāvupātaṃ tadantasya ceti
nārtha etena ? evaṃ tarhi tadantavidhijñāpanārthamidamārabhyate |
amahapūrvetyetatu śakyamakartum, na hi mahāśūdretyatra samudāye
jātivacane śūdraśabdaḥ striyāṃ vartate |
apara āha---laukikasyāpradhānasyopasarjanasyeha grahaṇam,
tenāpiśilinā proktam, ṭhiñaśca' ityaṇ, tato'dhyetryām ṭhtadadhīte'
ityaṇ, tasya ṭhproktālluk' iti luk āpiśilā brāhmaṇī, atra
ṭhiñaśca' iti vihitasya proktapratyayasyāṇo'pradhānatvātadantānṅīb
na bhavati | nanvidānīmadhyetṛpratyaye lupte prakṛtireva
tadarthamāheti pradhānastriyāmadhyetryāmaṇantasya vṛteḥ syādeva ṅīp
pratyayaḥ ? syādetadevam, yadyaṇantādanupasarjanādityucyeta | vayaṃ
tvaṇamevānuparsajanatvena viśeṣayiṣyāmaḥ---amyo'nuparjana iti,
arthadvārakaṃ cāṇaḥ prādhānyam, aprādhānyaṃ ca | tadetaduktaṃ
bhavati---yasminnarthe'ṇutpannaḥ sa yadā prādhānyenocyate tadā
tadantānṅīb bhavati; yadā tu guṇabhāvene, tadā neti | iha
cādhyetryāṃ saṅkrāntatvātprathamasyāṇo'rtho guṇabhūta iti
tadāśrayastāvanṅīb na bhavati | yastvadhyetryāmutpannastadāśrayo'pi
na bhavati; tasya luptatvāt | pratyayalakṣaṇenāpi na bhavati,
aṇāakārasya viśeṣaṇāt | ṭhṭiḍṭhāṇañ' ityatra hyata iti vartate |
tatrāṇantādakārāntāditi | vijñāyamāne syāt pratyayalakṣaṇam, aṇā
tvakāre viśeṣyamāṇe varṇanimitae ṅīppratyayaḥ kathaṃ pratyayalakṣaṇena
syāt ! nanu striyāmityanuvṛtenāṇaṃ viśeṣayiṣyāmaḥ---yo'ṇ
striyāṃ vihita iti ? evamapi kāśakṛtsninā proktā mīmāṃsā
kāśakṛtsnī, tāmadhīte kāśakṛtsnā brāhmaṇīti dvitīye'ṇi
ṭhproktālluk' iti lupte'pi
prathamo'pyaṇstriyāmevotpannaḥ,tadantād brāhmaṇyāṃ
vatamānānṅīpprasaṅgaḥ | tasmātpradhānādyathā syādapradhānānmā
bhūdityetatprayojanaṃ sūtrasyeti ||
ṭiḍḍhāṇañdvayasajdaghnañmātractayapṭhakṭhañkañkvarapkhyunām ||
4|1|15 ||
iha kasmāditi | laḍādeśasya sthānidbhāvena ṭitvamastīti praśnaḥ |
pavāmānā, yajamāneti | nanu śānannādiṣu laṭa ityasya nivṛtatvād
anādeśapakṣaḥ sthāpitaḥ, pavamānetyādiṣu śānajudāhartavyaḥ |
dvyanubandhakatvāllaṭa iti | laḍādiṣvakārādayo'pyanubandhā iti
bhāvaḥ | etena liḍlṛṭau vyākhyātau---anūcānā, yakṣyamāṇeti |
lyuḍādiṣu kathamiti | dvyanubandhakatvāteṣāmapi grahaṇe na
bhāvyamiti praśnaḥ | ṭitkaraṇasāmarthyāditi | na ca laḍādiṣvapi
ṭitkaraṇasāmarthyamityāha---itaratreti | paṭhitā vidyeti |
kathamityanuṣaṅgaḥ | iṭaṣṭitvamubhayārthaṃ syāditi praśnaḥ |
āgamaṭitvamanimitamiti | āgamānāṃ ṭitvaṃ ṅīpo nimitaṃ na
bhavatītyarthaḥ | kuta ityata āha---ṭa|luṭa|lulau tuṭ ceti
liṅgāditi | yadyāgamaṭitvaṃ ṅīpo nimitaṃ syātataḥ
sāyantanītyādau tuṭa āgamasya ṭitvānṅīp siddha iti
ṭa|luṭa|luloṣṭitkaraṇamanarthakaṃ syāditi bhāvaḥ | nanu ca
ṭhpurāṇaprokteṣu' iti nirdeśena yadā tuḍ na bhavati tadā ṅībarthaṃ
tayoṣṭitvaṃ syāt ? tanna; purāṇaśabdādvahvādiṣu pāṭhānṅīṣā
bhavitavyam, antodāto hi purāṇīśabdaḥ---punaḥ punarjāyamānā
purāṇīti yathā | evamapi na jñāpakam, ṭhbahvādibhyaśca' ityatra veti
vartate, tataśca ṅīṣā mukte ṅīb yathā syāditi ṭa|luṭa|luloṣṭitvaṃ
syāditi cintyametat |
sauparṇeyīti | suparṇaśabdātpākakarṇādiṅīṣantātstrībhyo ḍhak |
nanu ca sānubandhakatvādasya grahaṇena bhavitavyamata āha---nira
nubandhaka iti | yadyapi ṭhśilāyāḍhaḥ' iti niranubandhako ḍhaśabdo'sti,
sa iha svabhāvānnapuṃsakaliṅga iti striyāṃ nāstītyuktam | yo'pi
ṭhsabhāyā yaḥ', ṭhḍhaścchandasi' iti ḍhaḥ, so'pi striyāṃ na vartate, katham
? tatra ṭhtatra sādhuḥ' iti vartate, kathaṃ ca strī nāma sabhāyāṃ sādhvī
syādyajñasabhāyāṃ hi viduṣāmadhikāraḥ ! nanu mā nāma bhūdyajñasabhāyāṃ
sādhvī, śālāyāṃ strīsabhe ca sādhvī bhaviṣyati, tatra yajñasabhāyāṃ
sādhvī brāhmaṇapariṣadityatrāpi prasaṅgaḥ ? evaṃ tarhyevaṃvidhe viṣaye
cchandasi sabheyīśabdasya prayogābhāvo'tra hetuḥ |
ṇe'pi kvacidaṇkṛtaṃ kāryaṃ bhavatīti | śīlam ṭhcchatrādibhyo ṇaḥ'
iti yo ṇastatrāṇkṛtaṃ kāryaṃ bhavatīti | katham ? jñāpakāt,
yadaṃyam ṭhkārmastācchīlye' iti ṭilopārthaṃ nipātanaṃ karoti |
yadi hi tācchīlike ṇe'ṇkṛtaṃ kāryaṃ na syānnipātanamanarthakaṃ na
syāt, karmaśabdācchatrādilakṣaṇe ṇe kṛte ṭhnastaddhite' ityeva
ṭilopasya siddhatvāt | na ca ṭhan' iti prakṛtibhāvaḥ, aṇi hi sa
prakṛtibhāvaḥ | caurī, tāpasīti | curātapaḥ śabdau cchatrādiṣu
paṭhitavyau | kvacidityasya vyāvartyaṃ darśayati---dāṇḍā, mauṣṭeti
| draṇḍamuṣṭiśabdābhyāṃ ṭhtadasyāṃ praharaṇam' iti ṇaḥ |
autsī, audapānīti | utsodapānaśabdābhyāṃ bhavārthe
ṭhutsādibhyo'ñ' | atha sārṅgaravādisūtre punarañgrahaṇaṃ
kimartham, yāvatā'nenaiva siddham, na rūpabhedo na svarabhedaḥ ?
tatrāha---śārṅgaravādyaña ityādi | bidasyāpatyaṃ baidī,
ṭhanuṣyānantarye bidādibhyo'ñ' gotraṃ ca caraṇaiḥ saha' iti jātiḥ,
tatrautsītyādau caritārthamimaṃ ṅīpaṃ bādhitvā jātilakṣaṇo ṅīṣ
prāpnoti | yadi tarhi tasya nibandhanamasti tadevāñgrahaṇamastu,
kimatrāñgrahaṇena ? na vā jātyadhikārāt, ṭhjāteḥ' iti hi tatra
vartate, anadhikāre hi puṃyogādākhyāyāṃ ṅīpprasaṅgaḥ---baidasya
strī baidī |
urudvayasītyādau ṭhpramāṇe dvayasacdaghnañmātracaḥ' |
pañcatayīti | ṭhsakhyāyā avayave tayap' | dvayasajādiṣu
anubandhoccāraṇaṃ prātipadikānāṃ grahaṇaṃ mā bhūt---kimasya
dvayasam, kisamasya mātramiti | tayaśabdo'pi tayateḥ pacādyajantaḥ
sambhavati |
ṭhanādinivṛtyarthamiti | daṇḍo'syā asti ṭhata iniṭhanau' iṇḍikā,
ṭhkāśyādibhyaṣṭha
ññiṭhau' kāśiketyādau mā bhūdityevamartham |
tādṛśīti | ṭhtyadādiṣu dṛśo'nālocane kañca', ṭhā sarvanāmnaḥ' |
kaño ñakāroccāraṇam ṭhāto'nupasarge kaḥ' godetyādau mā bhūt
| itvarīti | ṭhiṇnaśjisartibhyaḥ kvarap' | āḍha|lṅkāraṇīti |
ṭhāḍha|lsubhaga' ityādinā khyun |
nañsnañīkaktaruṇatalunānāmiti | bhāṣye tu ṭhkañkvarapaḥ'
ityetāvatsūtram, khyunaḥ pāṭho'nārṣa iti tasyāpyupasaṃkhyānameva
kṛtam | straiṇī, pāésnīti | ṭhstrīpuṃsābhyāṃ nañsnañau bhavanāt' |
śaktīkī, yāṣṭīkīti | praharaṇādhikāre ṭhśaktiyaṣṭa|lerīkak' |
taruṇī, talunīti | etayoravayo'rthaṃ grahaṇam---taruṇī surati,
vayasi tu ṭhvayasi prathame' ityeva siddham ? na sidhyati;
gaurādipāṭhānṅīṣa prāpnoti | tasmādvayasyavayasi ca
ṅībṅīṣovikalpaḥ | kvacid gaurādipāṭhātsiddhamiti paṭha|lte,
tadrūpamātrasiddhyabhiprāyaṃ draṣṭavyam, svarārthaṃ tūpasaṃkhyānaṃ
kartavyameva ||
yañaśca || 4|1|16 ||
āpatyagrahaṇamiti | apatye bhava āpatyaḥ, yañ, āpatyāditi sūtraṃ
kartavyamityarthaḥ | dvaipyeti | bhavādāvarthe yañ |
yogavibhāga utarārtha iti | utaratra yaña evānuvṛttiryathā syāt,
ṭidādīnāṃ mā bhūditi ||
prācāṃ ṣpha taddhitaḥ || 4|1|17 ||
ṣakāro ṅīṣathe iti | nanu ca ṣphapratyayenaiva strītvasya
dyotitatvānṅīṣā na bhāvyam ? tatrāha---pratyayadvayeneti |
taddhitagrahaṇaṃ prātipadikasaṃjñārthamiti | prātipadikasaṃjñā tu ṅīṣarthā
| nanu ca siddho'tra ṅīṣ, pitkaraṇasāmarthyāt, dhātostu trapādeḥ
ṣitvamaṅvidhau caritārthamiti trapā, kṣametyādau ṅīṣabhāvaḥ ?
tadetatsānnyāsikaṃ tiṣṭhatu tāvat |
sarvatragrahaṇamityādi | sarvatragrahaṇaṃ tāvad utarasūtre na kartavyam,
ārambhasāmarthyādeva ṭhprācām' ityasya nivṛtau sarvatra siddhatvāt,
atastadihāpakṛṣyate, tadayamartho bhavati---sarvatra bādhakaviṣayo'pi
prācāṃ matena yañantātṣpho bhavatīti | evaṃ saptamyartho'pi
samañjaso bhavati | āvaṭa|laccāpaṃ vakṣyatīti | asati punarapakarṣe
āvaṭa|laccābudīcāṃ mate sāvakāśaḥ paratvātṣphaṃ bādheta,
sarvatragrahaṇātṣpha eva bhavati | evaṃ ca ṭhṣācca yañaḥ' iti cābviṣaye'pi
prācāṃ ṣpha eva bhavati---śārkarākṣyāyaṇī, pautimāṣyāyaṇī,
gokakṣyāyaṇīti ||
sarvatra lohitādikatantebhyaḥ || 4|1|18 ||
lohitādīti pṛthakpadaṃ luptavibhaktikam, pūrvatra ca prācāṃ mate
ṣpho vihitaḥ, iha tu sarvatra mate | ko'rthaḥ ? sarveṣāaṃ mata
ityarthaḥ, tadāha---sarveṣāmācāryāṇāṃ mata iti | mateneti
tṛtīyāntapāṭhe sūtre paṣṭha|lntātral | svatantramiti |
yo'nyasyāvayavo na bhavati tatsvatantraṃ prātipadikam, kaḥ
punarasāvityatrāha---kapiśabdātpara iti |
lauhityāyanītyādirgargādyantargaṇaḥ | babhruśabdo'pi tatraiva paṭha|lte,
yañtu ṭhmadhubabbhrvorbrāhmaṇakauśikyoḥ' ityananaiva bhavati |
kaṇvātvityādi | kaṇvaśabdātpūrvaḥ kataśabdātūtaraḥ śakalaśabda iṣyate,
kataśakalakaṇvetyevabheṣāṃ saṃniveśaḥ kārya ityarthaḥ | kimevaṃ sati
bhavati ? ityāha---pūrvotarāviti | śakalaśabdo'nta ādiśca yathākramaṃ
yayoḥ pūrvotarayorgaṇayostau tathoktau | pūrvo gaṇo
lohitādiḥ śakalaśabdānto bhavati, utaraśca gaṇaḥ
śakalaśabdādirbhavatītyarthaḥ | satyamevaṃ bhavati, prayojanaṃ tu kim ?
ityata āha---ṣphāṇāviti |
ślokaṃ vyāṭaṣṭe---prātipadikeṣvanyathā pāṭha iti | kapikata,
kurukata, anaḍuh, kaṇva, śakaletyevaṃ gargādiṣu gaṇasanniveśaḥ | sa
evaṃ vyavasthāpayitavya iti | evamiti ślokoktayā''nupūrvyetyarthaḥ |
anaḍuhkurukataśabdāvasmātsthānādapakṛṣyānyatra pāṭhayau,
śakalaśabdastu katakaṇvayormadhye paṭhitavya iti yāvat | nanvevaṃ
gaṇadvayādapi pracyutaḥ śakalaśabdaḥ ṣphāṇau dvāvapi na pratipadyeta,
tatrāha---katantebhya iti | bahuvrīhitatpuruṣayorekaśeṣa iti |
katasyāntaḥ samīpabhūtaḥ katanta iti tatpuruṣeṇa śakalaśabda ucyate,
śakandhvāditvānnipātanādvā pararūpam | tathā kato'nto yeṣāṃ
tāni katantānīti bahuvrīhiḥ, tatra bahuvrīhitatpuruṣayoḥ saha
vivakṣāyāṃ bahuvrīhiḥ śiṣyate; ṭhsvarabhinnānāṃ yasyotarasvaravidhiḥ
sa śiṣyate' iti vacanāt | tathetyādi | ṭhkaṇvādibhyaḥ' ityapi
bahuvrīhitatpuruṣayorekeśeṣa ityarthaḥ | kaṇvasyādiḥ samīpabhūtaḥ
kaṇvādiḥ śakalaśabdaḥ, kaṇva ādiryeṣāṃ tāni kaṇvādīni, tataḥ
pūrvavadekaśeṣaḥ | tatra bahuvrīhitatpuruṣayormadhye
tatpuruṣasamāsena | madhyavartīti | gaṇadvayasya | pratyayadvayamapīti |
ṣphāṇāvityarthaḥ | śākalā iti | ṭhāpatyasya ca' iti yalopaḥ |
apara āha---pūrvotarau tadantādī grāhyāviti śeṣaḥ, pūrvo
gaṇastadanto grāhyaḥ---sarvatra lohitādiśakalāntebhya iti, utaro
gaṇastadādirgrāhyaḥ---śakalādibhyo gotra iti | evaṃ ṣphāṇau
prayojanamiti ||
kauravyamāṇḍūakābhyāṃ ca || 4|1|19 ||
kauravyamāṇḍūakayorityādi | asminsūtre āsurerapi grahaṇaṃ
kartavyam | āsurikauravyamāṇḍūakebhyaśceti vaktavyamityarthaḥ |
āsurāyaṇīti | ṣphasya taddhitatvād ṭhyasyeti ca' iti iño lopaḥ |
tadidaṃ taddhitagrahaṇameva liṅgaṃ bhavati---āsurerapi ṣpha iti |
yañādiṣvakārānteṣu savarṇadīrghatvenāpi rūpaṃ siddham | śaiṣikeṣu
cārthoṣvati | āsurīprasaṅgādidamatroktam ; anyathā
dvirāsurigrahaṇaṃ kartavyaṃ syāt | āsurīya iti |
asurasyāpatyamāsuriḥ, tena prokta āsurīyaḥ kalpa iti ||
vayasi prathame || 4|1|20 ||
śrutyeti | śravaṇamātreṇa prakaraṇādyanapekṣayetyarthaḥ | kumārīti |
prathamavayovacana evāyam, na puṃyogābhāvahetukaḥ puṃsyapi
prayogāt | yastu vṛddhāyāṃ prayogaḥ---vṛddhakumārīti, sa
puṃyogābhāvātsādharmyādveditavyaḥ |
vayasyacarama iti | caram u antyam, acarame u anatye | iha
keciccatvāri vayāṃsīcchanti---kaumārap, yauvanam, madhyatvam,
vṛddhatvamiti | yathāhuḥ---
ṭhprathame vayasi nādhītaṃ dvitīye nārjitaṃ dhanam |
tṛtīye na tapastaptaṃ caturthe kiṃ kariṣyati' || iti |
anye tu trīṇi---
ṭhpitā rakṣati kaumāre bhartā rakṣati yauvane |
putrastu sthaviribhāve na strī svātantryamarhati' || iti |
anye tu bālatva-madhyatva-vṛddhatvāni trīṇi---
ṭhāṣoḍaśādbhavedvālo yāvat kṣīrānnavartakaḥ |
madhyamaḥ saptatiryāvatparato vṛddha ucyate' || iti |
eṣu sarveṣu darśaneṣu yauvanaṃ dvitīyaṃ vayo bhavati, yauvanavacanau
ca vadhūṭaciraṇṭaśabdau, ato na prāpnoti,
tadāha---dvitīyavayovacanāvetāviti | yadā tu dve eva vayasī
upacayāpacayalakṣaṇe, tadaitanna vaktavyam ; yauvanasyāpi
prathamavayorūpatvāt |
śrutyā vartate iti yaduktaṃ tasya vyāvartyaṃ darśayati---utānaśayā
lohitapādiketi naitā vayaḥ śrutaya iti | śrutyā u śravaṇamātreṇa
naite vayaḥ pratipādayantītyarthaḥ | iha tāvadutānaśayeti
kriyākārakasambandhamātraṃ pratīyate, tadeva ca pravṛttinimitam |
utānādiṣu kartṛṣviti śeraterac pratyayaḥ, sarvaiva ca
kadācidutānā śete, ucyate cedam---utānaśayeti, tatra niyamo
gamyate---anyathā svaptumasāmarthyādutānaiva śeta iti | evamapi
sandehaḥ---bālā, vṛddheti ? tasmādutānaiva śeta iti niyame
vṛddhatvābhāve ca prakaraṇādinā'vasite bālyaṃ gamyate,
lāhitapādiketyatrāpi anyapadārthamātraṃ śrutyā pratīyate |
prakaraṇādinā svabhāvata evāsya raktau pādo nālaktakādineti pratītau
satyāṃ bāleti gamyate | itiśabdaḥ prakāre, evaprakārā na vayaḥśrutaya
ityarthaḥ | ata eva bahuvacanam, tena dvivarṣetyādāvapi na bhavati |
atrāpi prakaraṇādinā vayo gamyate, parimāṇamātraṃ tu śabdārthaḥ,
śālādāvapi prayogāt | dve varṣe bhūtā iti ṭhañaḥ ṭhvarṣāllukca',
ṭhcitavati nityam' iti luk ||
aparimāṇavistācitakambalyebhyo na taddhitaluki || 4|1|22 ||
parasaptamī tvaṣā nopapadyate, abhāvarūpeṇa lukā
paurvāparyāsambhavāt | sarvato mānaṃ parimāṇamiti | ṭhparimāṇaṃ
tu sarvataḥ' ityasya grahaṇam, na paricchedakamātrasyetyarthaḥ |
pañcamiśvaiḥ krīteti | taddhitārthe dviguḥ, ārhīyaṣṭhak |
kālaḥ saṅkhyā ca na parimāṇamiti | na hi tābhyāṃ sarvata ārohataḥ
pariṇāhataśca mīyate | evaṃ ca kālaḥ saṅkhyā ceti
pradarśanārthatvātpramāṇamapi parimāṇaṃ na bhavati, tathā cotarasūtre
ṭhkāṇḍaśabdasyāparimāṇavācitvāt' iti vakṣyati, ṭhpramāṇaviśeṣaḥ
kāṇḍam' iti ca | tena dvau śamau pramāṇamasyā iti mātracaḥ ṭhpramāṇe
lo dvigornityam' iti luki dviśam, triśameti bhavati | yadyevam,
unmānamapi parimāṇaṃ na syāt ? kaścidāha---iṣṭamevaitat,
unmānamapi naivātra parimāṇagrahaṇena gṛhyate---dvābhyāṃ niṣkābhyāṃ
krītā, prāgvatīyasya ṭhañoḥ ṭhdvitripūrvānniṣkāt' iti luk,
dviniṣkā triniṣveti bhavatīti | apara āha---bistakambalyagrahaṇaṃ
jñāpakam---unmānamapyatra parimāṇagrahaṇena gṛhyata iti;
tayorunmānaviśeṣatvāt, suvarṇabistau hesno'kṣe, ṭhkambalācca
saṃjñāyām' kambalyamūrṇāpalaśatamiti | nyāsakārastu dvau vistau
parimāṇamasyeti vigṛhṇan bistaṃ parimāṇaṃ manyate | dvivarṣeti |
kṛtavyutpādanametat | dviśatā, triśateti | dvābhyāṃ śatābhyāṃ
krīteti ṭhpaṇapādamāṣaśatādyat' iti nitye yati prāpte ṭhśāṇādvā'
ityatra ṭhśatācceti vaktavyam' iti vacanātpakṣe ṭhsaṅkhyāyā
atiśadantāyāḥ kan' iti kan, tasya ṭhadhyardhapūrvāt' iti luk |
dvibisteti | parimāṇatve ṭhaño luk, unmānatve ṭhakaḥ |
dvyāciteti | ācito daśabhārāḥ syuḥ | dvāvācitau pacati,
ṭhāḍhakācitapātrātkhonyatarasyām', ṭhdvigoṣṭhṃaśca' iti pakṣa
ṭhankhau, tābhyāṃ mukte prāgvatīyaṣṭhañ, tasya pūrvavalluk |
dvikambalyeti | krītārthe ṭhaño luk | dvyāḍhakī dvyācitetyanena
tulyam |
pañcāśvīti | samāhāre dviguḥ | imau dvau pratiṣedhāvucyete, tatraikaḥ
śakyo'vaktum, katham ? evaṃ vakṣyāmi---parimāṇāntātaddhitalukīti,
tanniyamārthaṃ bhaviṣyati---parimāṇāntādeva taddhitaluki ṅīb
bhavatīti, tena dvyāḍhakītyādau ca bhaviṣyati, pañcāśvetyādau ca na
bhaviṣyati, tato bistācikambalyebyoneti ? naivaṃ śakyam ;
viparīto'pi niyamaḥ sambhāvyeta---dvikuḍavī, pañcāḍhakī |
pañcāśvetyādau tu vyāvartakābhāvātsyādeva ḍīp |
tasmādyathānyāsamevāstu ||
kāṇḍāntātkṣetre || 4|1|23 ||
mānadaṇḍaḥukāṇḍam | ṭhdvigoḥ' ityadhikārādeva
pūrvasūtravatadantavidhau siddhe kimarthamantagrahaṇam ?
akriyamāṇe'ntagrahaṇe kṣetra ityetat kāṇḍasyaiva viśeṣaṇaṃ
vijñāyeta---kṣetre yaḥ kāṇḍaśabdaḥ, tadantād dvigoriti śrutatvāt
na tadantasya, yathotarasūtre pramāṇe yaḥ puruṣaśabdastadantāditi,
tataśceha prasajyeta---dvābhyāṃ kāṇḍābhyāṃ kāṇḍāmitābhyāṃ kṣetrābhyāṃ
krītā dvikāṇḍī vaḍaveti; iha tu na syāt---dve kāṇḍe pramāṇamasyāḥ
dvikāṇḍā kṣetrabhaktiriti | antagrahaṇe tu sati tadantasyaiva viśeṣaṇaṃ
kṣetram, na kāṇḍasya; bahuvrīhau guṇabhūtatvāt ||
puruṣātpramāṇe'nyatarasyām || 4|1|24 ||
pramāṇe yaḥ puruṣaśabda iti | pañcāratniḥ puruṣa iti śulbavidaḥ,
tatra dvau puruṣo pramāṇamatyā iti vākye pramāṇaśabdena
sambandhājjātivacano'pi puruṣaśabdaḥ pramāṇe vartate | vṛtau tu
tatsvabhāvādeva pramāṇe vṛttirdraṣṭavyā ||
bahuvrīherūdhaso ṅīṣ || 4|1|25 ||
ṭhūdhaso'naṅ' iti | samāsānte kṛta iti
samāsārthādutarapadādbhavansamāsāntaḥ pūrvaṃ bhavati, tataḥ strīpratyayaḥ
| ano bahuvrīheriti | upala7ṇametatat | ṭhano bahuvrīheḥ',
ṭhḍābubhābhyābhanyatarasyām' iti cetyarthaḥ | kuṇḍodhnīti | kuṇḍamiva
ūdho'syā iti vigrahaḥ, ṅīṣi ṭhallopo'naḥ' ityakāralopaḥ |
prāptodhā iti | ṭhprāptāpanne ca dvitīyayā' iti tatpuruṣaḥ,
ṭhatvasantasya' iti dīrghaḥ |
ana upadhālopina ityādi | asatyāṃ punaranuvṛtau
madhye'pavādanyāyena ḍāppratiṣedhayorevāyaṃ ṅīṣ bādhakaḥ syāt,
na ṭhana upadhālopinaḥ' ityasya ṅīpaḥ |
nanu ca ṭhḍābubhābhyām' ityatrānenānyatarasyāṃgrahaṇena ṅībapi
prāpyate, ṭhana upadhālopinaḥ' ityaya tu niyama ityāvīdīti
kuto'yamaniṣṭaprasaṅgaḥ ? satyam ; ana ṭhupadhālopinaḥ' ityasya tu
vidhitvābhyupagamenaitaduktam | iha bahuvrīherūdhaso ṅīṣ naśceti
vaktavyam, ūdhaḥ śabdāntādvahuvrīheḥ striyāṃ ṅīṣ bhavati
tatsanniyogena cāntyasya nakāraḥ, samāsāntaprakaraṇe tu ūdhasa'naṅiti
na vaktavyam, ṭhdhanuṣo'naṅ' ityeva paṭhitavyam, kaḥ punarevaṃ sati
guṇo bhavati ? ṭhana upadhālopinaḥ' ityatrāsyānuvṛttirnāśrayitavyā
bhavati; api ca mahodhāḥ parjanyaḥ, vuṇḍodho dhainukamiti siddhaṃ
bhavati, anyathā ṭhūdhaso'naṅ' ityatra striyāmiti vaktavyaṃ syādata
āha---samāsāntaśca striyāmeveti | iṣyata ityanuṣaṅgaḥ, tatraiva
striyāmiti vaktavyamityarthaḥ, itarathā hi kabvidhiprasaṅgaḥ |
kapo'vakāśo'nyo bahuvrīhiḥ---ayavakaḥ avrīhikaḥ,
ṅīṣastu---vibhāṣā kap, yadā na kap so'vakāśaḥ; kapprasaṅge
ubhayaṃ prāpnoti paratvātkap syāt ||
saṃkhyāvyayāderṅīp || 4|1|26 ||
pūrveṇa ṅīṣi prāpte ṅīb vidhīyata iti | yatra
pūrvapadaprakṛtisvarastatra bahuvrīhau | antodāte tu bahuvrīhau
ṅībṅīṣornāsti viśeṣaḥ, sūdhnī, ṭhnañsubhyām'
ityantodātatvam, tatrāllope
ṅībapyadātanivṛtanivṛtasvareṇodāto bhavati | dvyūdhnītyādi |
dve ūdhasī yasyāḥ, atigatamūdho'syāḥ, nirgatamūdho'syā iti vigrahaḥ
|
ādigrahaṇaṃ kimiti | saṃkhyāvyayābhyāmutaro ya ūdhaḥ
śabdastadantādvabahuvrīheriti vijñāyamāne dvayūdhnītyādi siddhamiti
praśnaḥ | dvividhodhnīti | asatyādigrahaṇe ṭhsaṃkhyāvyayābhyām' iti
pañcamīnirdeśātābhyāmanantaro ya ūdhaḥ--śabdastadantādeva syāt,
padāntaravyavāye tu na syāditi bhāvaḥ ||
dāmahāyanāntācca || 4|1|27 ||
ṭhsvīritenādhikāraḥ' ityatra dvau pakṣau---śabdādhikāraḥ,
arthādhikāraśceti | tatrādye pakṣe yasyaiva śabdasya svaritatvaṃ pratitrātaṃ
sa evānuvartate, dvitīye tu dvandvārthasyaikatvātasyaivānuvṛttiḥ
syādvā na vā, tadihādyaṃ pakṣamāśrityāha---sakhyāgrahaṇamanuvartate
nāvyayagrahaṇamiti |
hāyano vayasi smṛta iti | prakṛtiriti śeṣaḥ | hāyanānto
bahuvrīhirvayasi gamyamāne ṅīpaḥ prakṛtirācāryaiḥ smṛta ityarthaḥ |
trihāyanā śāleti | prāṇidharmo vayaḥ śālāyā na sambhavati | atha
mūlodāharaṇavat ṭhtricaturbhyā hāyanasya' ityaupasaṃkhyānikaṃ ṇatvaṃ
kasmānna bhavatītyata āha---ṇatvaṃ cetyādi | bahuvrīhyadhikārādeva
tadantavidhisiddherantagrahaṇaṃ vispaṣṭārtham ||
ana upadhālopino'nyatarasyām || 4|1|28 ||
iti parata upadhālope yasya sambhavati sa upadhālopī |
nanu siddhā evetyādi | etacca ṭhḍābubhābhyām' ityatraiva vyākhyātam |
anupadhālopino ṅīppratiṣedhārthaṃ vacanamiti | ano
bahuvrīheryadanyatarasyāṃ ṅībvidhānaṃ tadupadhālopina evetyevaṃ
niyamārthamityarthaḥ | asya ca niyamasyānupadhālopino ṅībnivṛttiḥ
phalamiti phalataḥ pratiṣedhavāco yuktiḥ | bahurāje iti | ṭhauṅ āpaḥ'
iti śībhāvaḥ | dvivacananirdeśo ḍāpo'bhivyaktaye; evavacane
ḍāppratiṣedhayo rūpasya tulyavāt |
bahumatsyeti | ṭhsūryatiṣyāgastya' ityādinā
upadhālopavidhānādupadhālopyeṣa bahuvrīhiḥ | suparveti | ṭhna
saṃyogādvamantāt' iti niṣedhānnāyamupadhālopī ||
nityaṃ saṃjñācchandasoḥ || 4|1|29 ||
nanu cchandasi dṛṣṭamevānuvidhīyate nāpūrvamutprekṣyate; tatra ca
ṅībeva ced dṛśyate tasya ca lakṣaṇamasti, ka idānīṃ tadabhāvaṃ
prayoktuaṃ prabhavati, saṃjñāśabdā apyanadiprayuktā
niyatānupūrvīkāstatrāpi ṅabeva cāyaṃ dṛśyate na tadabhāvaḥ śakyate
kartum, kimarthamidaṃ sūtram ? saṃjñācchandasoriti padamutarārthaṃ
vaktavyam | nityagrahaṇamutaratra vikalpanivṛtyartham ||
kevalamāmakabhāgadheyapāpāparasamānāryakṛtasumaṅgalabheṣajācca ||
4|1|30 ||
kevaleti bhāṣāyāmiti | asaṃjñāviṣaye iti bhāvaḥ | māmakīti |
mameyamiti ṭhyuṣmadasmadoranyatasyāṃ khañca' ityam,
ṭhtavakamamakāvekavacane' iti mamakādeśaḥ, tatrāṇantatvāt
ṭhṭiḍḍhāṇañ' ityeva siddhe niyamārthaṃ
māmakagrahaṇam---saṃjñācchandasoreva ṅībnānyatreti | māmiketi |
ṭāpi ṭhmāmakanarakayorupasaṃkhyānam' itītvam | bhāgadheyīti |
bhāgaśabdāpuṃlliṅgātsvārthe dheyapratyayaḥ, svāthikāśca
kvacidativartante prakṛtito liṅgamiti strīliṅgatā | pāpeti |
abhedopacārātadvati vartamānaḥ pāpaśabdo'bhidheyavalliṅgaḥ |
avarītyatra dvitīyo varṇo dantyoṣṭhayaḥ, na pavargyaḥ | āryeṇa
kṛteti | prāk subutpateḥ samāse'kārāntatvam | bheṣajīti |
bhiṣaja iyamityaṇi ādivṛddherabhāvo'smādeva nipātanādekāraḥ | evaṃ
ca bheṣajagrahaṇamapi niyamārtham ||
rātreścājasau || 4|1|31 ||
kathamityādi | dīrghāntājjasi ṭhdīrghājjasi ca' iti
pūrvasavarṇadīrghapratiṣedhādyaṇādeśe ṭhrātryaḥ' iti prayoga upapadyate,
hrasvāntasya tu ṭhjasi ca' iti guṇe ṭhrātryaḥ' iti rūpaṃ syāt |
dīrghāntaśca rātriśabdaḥ saṃjñācchandasorapi jasi na sambhavati,
ajasāviti pratiṣedhāt, kiṃ punarbhāṣāyāmiti praśnaḥ |
ṅīṣayamityādi | bahvādiṣu rātriśabdo na paṭha|lta iti cet,
tatrāha-tatra hīti | kṛta ikāraḥ kṛdikāraḥ, tadantānṅīṣ bhavati
ṭhdṛjāgṛbhyāṃ viḥ', daviḥ, darvī; yastu ktinsambandhī tadantānna
bhavati---kṛtiḥ, hṛtiḥ | sarvata iti |
kṛdikārādakṛdikārāccetyarthaḥ | yastu ktinnarthastasmānna
bhavati---ṭhākrośe nañyaniḥ', akaraṇiḥ, aharaṇiḥ | rātriśabdo'yam
ṭhrāśadibhyāṃ trip' iti vyutpattipakṣe kṛdikārāntaḥ, avyupatipakṣe
ṭhsarvato'ktinnarthāt' iti ṅīṣ | sūtraṃ tu ṅībartham---rātrī
vyakhyāt, rātrībhirasmā ahabhirdaśasyet; atrādyaudātatvaṃ bhavati ||
antarvatpativatornuk || 4|1|32 ||
nipātanasamārthyācceti | kāryāntaravadarthaviśeṣavṛttirapi labhyata
iti bhāvaḥ | kasminviśeṣa ityatrāha antarvatpativaditi |
gabhabhartṛsaṃyoge iti | antarvaditi | garbhasaṃyoge,
garbhiṇyāmityarthaḥ | pativaditi | bhartṛsaṃyoge, bhartṛmatyāmityarthaḥ,
jīvapatyāmiti yāvat | iha na bhavati antarasyāṃ śālāyāṃ vidyate
iti | asminviṣaye evaṃvidhaṃ vākyameva bhavati, na tu matubādītyarthaḥ
| kvacid antarvatī śāleti paṭha|lte, tadayuktam ; atra
matubabhāvasyoktatvāt | patimatī pathivīti | svāmiparyāyo'tra
patiśabdaḥ |
matubnipātyata iti | adhikaraṇapradhānasyāntaḥ
śabdasyāstinā'sāmānādhikaraṇyānna prāpnotīti kṛtvā |
vatvaṃ tu siddhamiti | ṭhmādupadhāyāśca' ityanenādupadhatvāt |
antarvatpativatorityādi | etayoḥ śabdayornipātanānmatubvatve
bhavataḥ, nuktu vidhīyate yathākramaṃ garbhiṇyāṃ jīvapatyāṃ
cābhidheyāyām--jīvaḥ patirasyāḥ jīvapatiḥ ṭhvibhāṣā sapūrvasya'
iti ṅīmnakārayorabhāvapakṣe rūpam | tatra ṅitihrasvaśca' iti
nadīsaṃjñāpakṣe ṭhidudbhyām' iti ṇeórāmādeśaḥ, jīvapatyāmiti
bhavati | vā tu cchandasi nugvidhiḥ | cchandasi viṣaye tu vikalpena
nugvidhirbhavati---antarvatī, antarvatnī | puṃsyāpi
dṛśyate---so'ntarvānabhavat ||
patyarno yajñasaṃyoge || 4|1|33 ||
yadyatra yajñaśabdena patiśabdasya sambandhāt yajñasaṃyoga ityarthaḥ syāt
? yajñasya patiriyaṃ brāhmaṇītyatraiva syāt, asti hyatrārthadvārakaḥ
sambandhaḥ, svarūpeṇa cānantaryalakṣaṇaḥ | atha yajñavācinā saṃyogo
yajñasaṃyogaḥ ? tathāpi patnīsaṃyāja ityādāveva syāt, na tviyamasya
patnītyādau | tasmādyajñaśabdasya yo'rthastena patiśabdārthasya sambandho
yajñasaṃyoga ityāha---yajñena saṃyoga iti | anyathā ṭhyajñaśabdena'
ityavakṣyat | evaṃ ca patiśabdārthasyetyapyuktaṃ bhavati, na hi
patiśabdasya yajñenārthena vācyavācakabhāvaḥ sambandhāntaraṃ vā sambhavati
| tatsādhanatvāditi | devatoddeśena svadravyatyāgaḥ uyāgaḥ |
madhyakaṃcadampatyordhanam, ṭhkuṭuambinau dhanasyeśāte jāyāpatyorna
vibhāgo vidyate' iti hi smaryate, tataśca tyāge bhāryāyā
apyanumatirapekṣyata iti tatrāsyā anumatyā sādhanatvam | madarthaṃ
karmetyevaṃrūpo'dhikāralakṣaṇasambandho'stītyāha---phalagrahītṛtvāditi
| kartṛtvamātraṃ vivakṣitam, na strītvamiti ṅībna kṛtaḥ | ṭhkartari ca'
iti samāsapratiṣedhaḥ karmaṇi ṣaṣṭha|la eva, na śeṣapaṣṭha|la iti
tasyānenopapannaḥ samāsaḥ | phalagṛhītatvāditi pāṭhe gṛhītaṃ phalaṃ
yayeti bahuvrīhau phalaśabdasya jātivacanatvād niṣṭhāyāḥ
pūrvanipāte ṭhjātikālasukhādibhyaḥ paravacanam' iti gṛhītaśabdasya
paranipātaḥ |
kathamityādi | śūdrasyaiva yajñe'nadhikṛtatvādyajñenāsaṃyogātkathaṃ
tadbhāryāyā yajñasaṃyoga iti praśnaḥ | upamānāditi | agnisākṣikaṃ
yatpāṇigrahaṇaṃ tad vṛṣalādīnāmapyasti, tadāśrayamupamānam ||
vibhāṣā sapūrvasya || 4|1|34 ||
sahaśabdo'yamasti tulyayoge, yathā---saśiṣyo gururāgata iti; asti
ca vidyamānavacanaḥ, yathā---ṭhsahaiva daśabhiḥ putrairbhāraṃ vahati gardabhī'
iti, itthambhūtalakṣaṇe tṛtīyā, vidyamāneṣveva putreṣvityarthaḥ |
pūrvaśabdo'pyasti vyavasthāvacanaḥ---pūrvaṃ madhurāyāḥ
pāṭaliputramiti; asti cāvayavaśabdaḥ---pūrvaṃ kāyasyeti | tatra
tulyayoge sahaśabdaḥ, pūrvaśabdaśca vyavasthāyāmiti pakṣe grāmasya
patiriyamiti vākye prāpnoti, pūrvasya cāpi prāpnoti,
vidyamānavacanasahaśabdaḥ pūrvaśabdaśca vyavasthāvacana iti pakṣe pūrvasya
mā bhūt, vākye tu syādeva | apayavavacanaḥ pūrvaśabdaḥ tulyayoge
sahaśabda iti pakṣe vākye'pi syāt, tatrāpi patiśabdasya
pūrvo'vayavaḥ pakārastasyāpi syāt, tasmādvidyamānavacanaḥ sahaśabdaḥ
pūrvaśabdaścāvayavavacana iti pakṣa āśrīyate | ṭhtena saha' ityatra
ṭhtulyoge' iti viśeṣaṇasya prāyikatvātsamāsaḥ | evaṃ ca sthite
ṭhsapūrvasya' iti patiśabdaviśeṣaṇaṃ nopapadyate, katham ? pakāreṇa
sapūrvatvamavyabhicārādaviśeṣaṇam | śabdāntaraṃ tu
patiśabdasyāvayavo na sambhavati, tataśca sāmarthyāt prātipadikaṃ
patiśabdena viśeṣyate, na tu tena | patiśabda iti | patiśabdena
tadantasya grahaṇam, anupasarjanagrahaṇenāpi tadantaṃ prātipadikameva
viśeṣyate, na viśeṣaṇabhūtaḥ patiśabdaḥ, anyathā bahuṃḍvrīhau na
syāt---jīvaḥ patirasyāḥ jīvapatirjīvapatnīti | ṣaṣṭhī samāsa eva
tu syād---āśāpatiḥ, āśāpatnīti | tadetat
sarvamālocyāha---patiśabdāntasya sapūrvasyānupasarjanasyeti |
grāmasya patiriyamiti | asati sapūrvagrahaṇe tadantavidherabhāvādatraiva
syāt | athāpyamahatpūrveti jñāpakātadante'pi bhavet kevalasyāpi
syādeva | tasmāt ṭhsapūrvasya' iti vaktavyam ||
nityaṃ sapatnyādiṣu || 4|1|35 ||
yāni samānādipūrvapadāni patyantāni prātipadikāni te
sapatnyādayaḥ | kuta etat ? samānādīnāmeva gaṇe paṭhāt,
sapatnyādīnāṃ cāpāṭhāt | yadyevam, samānādiṣviti vaktavyam,
pūrvagrahaṇānuvṛteḥ; samādiṣu pūrveṣvavayaveṣu satsvityarthaḥ ?
satyam ; samānasya sabhāvārthaṃ tu ṭhsapatnyādiṣu' ityuktam |
kvacitūdāharaṇānantaraṃ samānādiṣviti vaktavyaṃ
sabhāvārthamevamuktamiti vṛtāveva paṭha|lte |
apara āha---samudāyoccāraṇasāmarthyātsapatnībhārya ityatra
puṃvadbhāvo na bhavatīti nātrāptoktirasti | kiñca---sabhāvārthaṃ
samudāyoccāraṇamidamiti sāmarthyamapi cintyam | tathā he sapatni,
niḥsapatniḥ, sapatnyṛcchati, sapatnyā, sapatnyai ityādāvapi
hrasvayaṇādeśau na syātām | tasmātsabhāvārthameva
sapatnyādiṣvityuktam | nityagrahaṇaṃ vispaṣṭārthamiti |
ārambhasāmarthyādeva nityaṃ bhaviṣyatīti bhāvaḥ | dāsācchandasīti |
dāsapatnīrahigopāḥ |
pūtakratorai ca || 4|1|36 ||
yadyayamaikāraḥ pratyayaḥ syādutarasūtre udātavacanamanarthakaṃ syāt;
pratyayatvādeva siddheḥ | tasmādādeśo'yaṃ vijñāyata
ityāha---aikāraścāntādeśa iti |
traya ete yogā iti | ṭhpuṃyogādākhyām' ityatrānuvartayitavyā
ityarthaḥ | iha karaṇasāmarthyācca ṅīpsahitā evānuvartante, tena yadā
puṃyogātstriyāṃ pūtakratvādayo vartante tadā ṅīṣaṃ bādhitvā
aikārādisahito ṅīb bhavati ||
vṛṣākapyagnikusitakusīdānāsudātaḥ || 4|1|37 ||
vṛṣākapiśabdo madhyodāta iti | ṭhlaghāvante dvayośca bahvaṣo guruḥ'
iti vacanāt | asyārthaḥ---ante ekasminlaghau dvayośca laghvoḥ
parato bahvaṣaḥ śabdasya gururudāto bhavatīti | ṭhbahvaṣaḥ' iti vahvaca
ityarthaḥ | yo'smākaṃ cakāreṇa pratyāhāraḥ so'nyeṣāṃ ṣakāreṇa |
agnyādiṣu punariti | ṭhphiṣaḥ' ityanenāgnyādīnāmantodātatvam |
phiṣiti prātipadikasyānyācāryasaṃjñā | ye tu kusīdeti madhye
gurumadhīyate teṣām ṭhlaghāvante' iti madhyodātaprasaṅgaḥ ||
manorau vā || 4|1|38 ||
aikāraścodāta iti | aukārastvanudāta eva | vāgrahaṇena dvāvapi
vikalpyete iti | yadā ca dvāvapi na bhavatastadā ṅībapi na bhavati;
sanniyogaśiṣṭatvāt | manuśabda ādyaudāta iti | ṭhmana jñāne',
ṭhmṛmṛśītṛcaritsaritanidhanimimasjibhya uḥ' iti vartamāne ṭhdhānye
nit' iti ca, ṭhśṛsvṛsnihitrapyasivasihaniklidibandhimanibhyaśca'
iti upratyayaḥ, nitvādādyaudātatvam, bharuḥ, maruḥ, śayuḥ, taruḥ, caruḥ,
tsaruḥ, tanuḥ, dhanuḥ, mayuḥ, madguḥ, nyaṅkvādipāṭhāt
kutvam---prathamasyodāharaṇāni | śaruḥ, svarūḥ, snehuḥ, trapu, asuḥ,
vasuḥ, hanuḥ, kleduḥ, bandhuḥ, manuḥ---iti dvitīyasya ||
varṇādanudātātopadhāto naḥ || 4|1|39 ||
varṇānāṃ taṇatinitāntānāmiti | taśabdāntānāmetādīnāṃ
ṇaśabdāntānāṃ soṇādīnāṃ tiśabdāntānāṃ śitiprabhṛtīnāṃ
niśabdāntānāṃ pṛśniprabhṛtīnāṃ takārāntānāṃ ca pṛṣatprabhṛtīnāṃ
varṇavācināmādirudāto bhavatītyarthaḥ | gatisvareṇeti |
ṭhgatiranantaraḥ' ityanena | ghṛtāditvāditi | ṭhghṛtādīni' iti phiṣi
paṭha|lte | piśaṅgāditi | ṭhlaghāvante' iti
madhyodātatvādutarasūtreṇa ṅīṣi prāpte hībvidhīyate |
asitapalitayoriti | ṭhvarṇānāṃ taṇatinitāntānām'
ityādyaudātāvetau |
cchandasītyādi | ṭhto naḥ' iti nakāre prāpte knaśabdaṃ
ṅīpsahitamicchanti |
bhāṣāyāmapīṣyate iti | bhāṣye tu naitatpradaśitam | avadātaśabdo na
varṇavācī, kiṃ tarhi ? viśuddhavācī | evaṃ hyāha---
trīṇi yasyāvadātāni vidyā yoniśca karma ca |
etatrayaṃ vijānīhi brāhmaṇādhyasya lakṣaṇam | iti |
tenāvadātetyatra ṅībna bhavati |
anyato ṅīp || 4|1|40 ||
sāraṅgakalmāṣaśabdau ṭhlaghāvante' iti madhyodāto, ṭhśapa ākrośe',
ṭhkala tṛpaḥ', ṭhśaperbaśca' iti kalapratyayaḥ, pakārasya bakāraḥ,
pratyayasvareṇa madhyodātaḥ śabalaśabdaḥ | khaṭvāśabdo
nitsvareṇādyaudātaḥ, ṭhkhaṭ kāṅkṣe',
ṭhasūpruṣilaṭikaṇikhaṭiviśibhyaḥ kvan' | kṛṣṇaśabdo'ntodātaḥ,
ṭhkṛṣervarṇe' iti nak pratyayaḥ, ilaci prakṛte ṭhkapeśca' iti uṇādiṣu
sūtram | kapiḥ sautro dhātuḥ, kapilaśabdo'ntodātaḥ ||
ṣidgaurādibhyaśca || 4|1|41 ||
ṣidbhyaḥ prātipadikebhya iti | ṣvunādeḥ pratyayasya
ṣitvamavayave'caritārthaṃ samudāyasya viśeṣakaṃ bhavatīti
prātipadikānāṃ ṣitvam, dhātostu trapādeḥ ṣitvamaṅvidhau
caritārthamiti na tena prātipadikaṃ ṣidbhavati | rajakīti |
ṭhśilpini ṣvun' ityatra vyutpāditam |
gaurādiṣu gauraśabdasya varṇavācino'pyantodātatvātpāṭhaḥ |
matsyādānāṃ yopadhānām ṭhayopadhāt' iti jātilakṣaṇasya ṅīṣaḥ
pratiṣedhātpāṭhaḥ | anyeṣāṃ jātiśabdānāṃ strīviṣayārthaḥ pāṭhaḥ |
śvannakṣanniti etayorḍāpi prāpte | anaḍuhī, anaḍvāhīti |
anakārāntatvādaprāpte ṅīṣi sapratyayayoḥ pāṭhaḥ, ṅīṣi parato
vikalpenānyathā syāt | eṣaṇaḥ karaṇa iti | karaṇasādhana eṣaṇaśabdo
ṅīṣamutpādayati---iṣyate'nayetyeṣaṇī | adhikaraṇe lyuḍiti
ṭitvān ṅībeva bhavati | anyeṣāmapi lyuṅntānāṃ ṅīpi prāpte
pāṭhaḥ | medhaśabdasyājātivācitvād, gautamasya
śārṅgaravāditvān ṅīni prāpte vacanātpakṣe so'pi bhavati |
āyasthūṇaśabdaḥ śivādyaṇantaḥ | bhaurikyādaya iñantāḥ, teṣām
ṭhaṇiñoḥ' iti ṣyaṅprāptau | āpicchikā nāma rājānaḥ,
ṭhjanapadaśabdātkṣatriyādañ', ṭhtasya ātaśca' iti luki kṛte
pratyayalakṣaṇena ṅīpprāpnoti | agre hāyanamasya āgrahāyaṇaḥ,
prajñāditvātsvārthiko'ṇ, asmādeva nipātanāṇṇatvam---āgrahāyaṇaḥ,
ṅīpi prāpte pāṭhaḥ | kecidāgrahāyaṇīti ikārāntaṃ paṭhanti, tasya
prayojanam---āgrahāyaṇībhārya ityādau puṃvadbhāvo mā
bhūdityāhuḥ | etena pratyavarohaṇīti vyākhyātam |
sumaṅgalātsaṃjñāyāmiti | ṭhkevalamāmaka' iti ṅīpi prāpte pakṣe
so'pi bhavati | svare viśeṣaḥ, sumaṅgalaśabdo bahuvrīhiḥ, tatra
ṭhnañsubhyām' ityantodātatvānṅīpyapi satyudātanivṛtasvareṇa
bhāvyamiti nāsti viśeṣaḥ | tathā ca cchandasi | sumaṅgalīriyaṃ
vadhūrityantodātatvaṃ dṛśyate | tasmājjātivacano'vyutpannaḥ
strīviṣayaḥ sumaṅgalaśabdaḥ ṭhlaghāvante' iti madhyodāto draṣṭavyaḥ |
taruṇatalunayoḥ ṭhnañsnañīkaktaruṇa' iti ṅīpi prāpte pakṣe so'pi
bhavati | bṛhanmahacchabdayoranarthakaḥ pāṭha iti prāgevoktam |
ṛṣyaṇantaḥ saudharmaśabdaḥ | rohiṇī nakṣatre iti | nakṣatrādanyatra
rohiṇī | revatī nakṣatra iti | rayiriti dhananāma, rayirvidyate'syā
iti matupi ṭhrayermatau bahulam' iti samprasāraṇam,
nipātanādvatvam | nakṣatrādanyatra ṅīb bhavati | vikalādīnāṃ ṭāpi
prāpte | kaṭācchrāeṇivacane | kaṭī śroṇiḥ, anyatra kaṭā |
piplyādayaśceti | gaṇasūtram, pippali, harītakītyādikaṃ tu
tasyodāharaṇapradarsanam | pṛthivīti | ṭhpratheḥ ṣivansamprasāraṇaṃ ca'
iti ṣitvādeva siddhe pratyayāntasya pāṭhaḥ
puṃvadbhāvanivṛtyarthaḥ---pṛthivībhārya iti | strīvaṣiyasyāsya
puṃvadbhāvaprāptiścintyā | kroṣṭuaśabdasya ṭhstriyāṃ ca' iti
tṛjvadbhāvaḥ | kroṣṭrītyatra nirūpaṇīyamasti ṭhstriyāṃ ca' ityatra
nirūpayiṣyāmaḥ |
ṣitvādeva siddha iti | ṭhmātari ṣicca' iti
vārtikakāravacanātṣitvam, nipātanasāmarthyādvā | uktaṃ hi---
dhātusādhanakālānāṃ prāptyarthaṃ niyamasya ca |
anubandhavikārāṇāaṃ rūḍha|lrthaṃ ca nipātanam || iti |
daṃṣṭreti | yeṣāmajādiṣu daṃṣṭreti pāṭo nāsti teṣāmidaṃ
prayojanam ||
jānapadakuṇḍagoṇasthalabhājanāgakālanīlakuśakāmukakabarād
vṛtyamatrāvapanākṛtrimāśrāṇāsthaulyavarṇānācchādanāyovikāramaithunecchākeśaveśeṣu || 4|1|42 ||
vartate'nayā sā vṛttiḥ u jīvikā | svare viśeṣa iti | tameva
darśayati---utsādipāṭhādañi kṛta iti | amatramubhājanam |
kuṇḍānyeti | kriyāśabdo'yam | ṭhkuḍi dāhe', ṭhgurośca halaḥ'
ityakārapratyayaḥ | avaṭaparyāyastu kuṇḍaśabdo napuṃsake niyataḥ |
yastu ṭhpatyau jīvati kuṇḍaḥ syāt' iti manuṣyajātivacanastato
jātilakṣaṇo ṅīṣ bhavatyeva---kuṇḍīyaṃ na golīti | amatravācinastu
jātiśabdādapi strīviṣayatvānṅīṣ vidhīyate | āvapanaṃ cediti |
yatra dhānyādi prakṣipya nīyate sā goṇī, yasyāḥ punaryādṛcchikaṃ nāma
sā goṇā | sthalānyeti | kṛtrimā puruṣavyāpāreṇa niṣpāditā,
yathā---sthalayodakaṃ parigṛhṇantīti | bhājīti | ṭhbhaja viśrāṇane'
curādiḥ, ṭhṇyāsaśrantho yuc' iti yuci prāpte'samādeva
nipātanāt striyāmapyerac | śrāṇeti | ṭhśrā pāre', ktaḥ,
ṭhsaṃyogādeḥ' iti natvam | sthaulyaṃ cediti | dravye vartamānasya
nāgaśabdasya sthaulyaṃ cetpravṛttinimitamityarthaḥ | nāgaśabdo
guṇavacana iti | gajavācī nāgaśabdastatsahacaritaṃ stholyamupādāya
stryantare prayukta udāharaṇam | sarpe dṛṣṭastadgataṃ dairghyamupādāya
stryantare prayuktaḥ pratyudāharaṇamityarthaḥ | varṇaścediti |
pravṛttinimitamityarthaḥ | kālānyeti | yasyā yādṛcchikīyaṃ saṃjñā |
nīlānyeti | nīlyā raktā śāṭī, ṭhnīlyā anvaktavyaḥ' ityan |
ayovikāraścediti | ṭhphāla' iti yasyābhidhānam | kuśānyeti |
cchandogāḥ stotriyā gaṇanārthānaudumbarān śaṅkūna ṭhkuśā' iti
vyavaharanti | kāmukānyeti | yasyā maithunādanyatkāmayituṃ śīlam
| maithunecchāvato bhaṇyata iti | kāmukaśabdasya ṭhlaṣapatapada' iti
kartari vyutpāditatvāt, icchāmātre vṛtyabhāvāt | sūtre tu
pravṛttinimitamātraṃ niṣkṛṣyoktam | maithune icchā yasyāḥ sā
maithuneccheti vyadhikaraṇapado bahuvrīhirāśrayaṇīya iti bhāvaḥ |
keśaveśa iti | keśasanniveśaviśeṣa ityartaḥ ||
śoṇātprācām || 4|1|43 ||
śoṇaśabdo'yaṃ varṇavācī ṭhvarṇānāṃ taṇatinitantānām'
ityādyaudātaḥ, tatra ṭhanyato ṅīṣ' ityeva siddhe niyamārthaṃ
vacanam---prācāmeva nānyeṣāmiti ||
voto guṇavacanāt || 4|1|44 ||
guṇamuktavānguṇavacana iti | ṭhkṛtyalyuṭo bahulam' iti bhūte
kartari lyuṭṃa darśayati | sa punaryaḥ prāgguṇamabhidhāya
paścānmatublopādabhedopacārādvā tadvati vartate sa veditavyaḥ |
śuciriti | uta ityasminnasatve'pi paṭvītyādisidhyarthamevāta
ityasyāsambandho vyākhyeyaḥ, tataścehāpi prasaṅga iti bhāvaḥ |
guṇavacanānṅībiti | ṭhmanorau vā' ityasyānantaramidaṃ
paṭhitavyamityarthaḥ | utarasūtram ṭhbahvādibhyo vā' iti paṭhitavyam |
ādyaudātārthamiti | ādyaudāteṣu guṇavacanasya ṅībvidhānasya
prayojanamityarthaḥ | antodāteṣu ṭhudātayaṇo halpūrvāt' iti
ṅībapyudāta iti nāsti viśeṣaḥ | ādyaudāteṣu tu ṅībanudāta
evāvatiṣṭhate | vasvīti | ṭhśṛsvṛsnihi' ityādinā vaserupratyayaḥ,
nitvādādyaudāto vasuśabdaḥ, guṇavacanaścāyaṃ nairmalyavacanaḥ |
praśastavacana ityanye | tathā ca---atiśayena vasurvasiṣṭho bhavati
paṭuaśabdo'pyādyaudātaḥ, ṭhdhānye nit' ityadhikāre
ṭhphalipāṭinamimanijanāṃ gukpaṭinākidhataśca' iti upratyayaḥ,
phalergugāgamaḥ, pāṭeśca paṭirādeśaḥ, phalguḥ, paṭuaḥ, nākuḥ,
madhuḥ, jatu---ityudāharaṇāni | mṛduśabdastvantodātaḥ, ṭhmrada kṣode'
ṭhkurbhraśca' ityadhikāre ṭhprathimradibhrasjāṃ samprasāraṇaṃ salopaśca' iti
kupratyayaḥ, pṛthuḥ, mṛduḥ | ṭhbhrasjeḥ salopaḥ samprasāraṇañca',
nyaṅkvāditvātkutvam, bhṛguḥ | kharurīti | ṭhkharuḥ kanyā pativarā'
iti nighaṇṭuaḥ, tatra pāṇigrahaṇotkaṇṭhābhidhāyitvād
guṇavacanatvām | taparakaraṇaṃ kim ? paṭuamicchati paṭūayati,
paṭūayateḥ kvip, paṭūaḥ strī---atra mā bhūt | yadyapyayaṃ samprati
kriyāvacanaḥ, tathāpi pūrvaṃ guṇamuktavāniti kṛtvā syātprasaṅgaḥ |
iha ṭhutaḥ iti viśeṣaṇādvacanagrahaṇācca śāstrīyo'deṅguṇo na
gṛhyate | loke tūpasarjanaṃ muṇa ucyate, śāstre'pi yasya guṇasya hi
bhāvāditi viśeṣaṇamātraṃ guṇo gṛhyate, śuklādau ca prasiddhataro
guṇaśabdaḥ, vaiśeṣikādayastu rūparasādayaścaturviśatirguṇā iti
pratipannāḥ; tadiha jighṛkṣitaṃ guṇaṃ lakṣayati---satve niviśata ityādi
| sīdantyasmiñjātiguṇakriyā iti satvamudravyam | tatra yo
niviśateusamavaiti sa guṇaḥ | ṭhyo niviśate sa guṇaḥ' ityucyamāne
guṇakriyājātyorguṇatvaprasaṅgātsatva ityuktam | evamapi satā
jātirguṇaḥ syāt, sā hi dravyaguṇakarmasu triṣvapi samavaiti ?
tadarthaṃ dravya evetyavadhāraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam | evamapi dravyatvajātirguṇaḥ
syātsatve niveśātatraiva ca niveśāt ? ityata āha---apaitīti |
tataḥ satvādapaitiuapagacchati, kvacidvā kadācidvā na bhavatītyarthaḥ |
yathā---āmraphale śyāmatā pūrvamupaiti, raktatāyāṃ tatra jātāyāmapaiti
ca dravyatvajātistu sarvadā dravye niviśate nāpaiti, yadi hi
kadācitkvacidvā na syād dravyamevaitanna syāt | evamapi
gotvādijātirguṇaḥ syāt, sā hi satve niviśate, apaiti ca,
tato'śvādiṣvabhāvaat ? ityata āha---pṛthag jātiṣviti |
pṛthagiti pṛthakpadam, pṛthagbhūtāsu jātiṣvityarthaḥ | jātyādhāreṣu
dravyoṣu dṛśyamāno jātiṣu dṛśyata ityupacaryate, samāse tu sati
ṭhjātyantācchaḥ' iti nityādhikāraparigaṇitaścchaḥ prasajyeta |
tadevamuktalakṣaṇopeto yaḥ pṛthagjātīyeṣu dṛśyate sa guṇaḥ, na
caivaṃrūpā gotvādijātiḥ | yadyapi khaṇḍamuṇḍādirūpeṇa
khaṇḍamuṇḍādayaḥ pṛthagjātīyāḥ, tathāpi gotvena
tāsāmekajātīyatvameva | ye tvapaitītyasya satyevādhāre
tatparityāgamarthamāhuḥ, teṣāṃ ṭhpṛthagjātiṣu' ityanarthakam ;
gotvādijāterapyapaitītyanenaiva vyāvṛttisiddheḥ | tasmātpūrvokta
evārthaḥ |
evamapi hi kriyā guṇaḥ syāt, sā hi dravye niviśate yadā sakriyaṃ
tatraiva ca niviśate, apaiti ca tato yadā niṣkriyaṃ dravyaṃ
pṛthagjātīyeṣu gavāśvādiṣu dṛśyate ? ata āha---ādheyaśceti |
ādheyaḥuniṣpādyaḥ, yathā---pākanikṣipteṣu ghaṭādiṣu raktatā guṇaḥ |
akriyājaḥuanutpādyaḥ, yathā---tejaḥ paramāṇuṣu sa eva raktatā guṇaḥ |
tadevamāśrayabhedenotpādyānutpādyasvabhāvo guṇa iti nityotpādyasya
karmaṇo guṇatvābhāvaḥ|
evamapi dravyaṃ guṇaḥ prāpnoti, tadapi śarīrādikaṃ pādādiṣu
dravyeṣveva pṛthagjātīyeṣu niviśate saṃyogavināśe ca
tato'paiti, ādheyaṃ cākriyājam,
avayavidravyasyotpādyatvādākāśādeścānutpādyatvādityata
āha---so'satvaprakṛtirguṇa iti | ya uktalakṣaṇopetaḥ satvaprakṛtirna
bhavatiudravyasvabhāvako na bhavati, sa guṇa ityarthaḥ | atrotarārddhenaiva
sarvajātīnāṃ vyāvṛttisiddheḥ pūrvārddhaṃ vyartham, jātīnāṃ
nityatvenotpādyatvābhāvāt ? naitadevam ; asati pūrvārddhe na
jātirvyāvartate, yathā---taijasānāṃ paramāṇūnāṃ yadrūpam,
yacceṣṭakādipākyadravyagatam---tadubhayaṃ
milatamutpādyānutpādyasvabhāvamityubhayorapi guṇatvaṃ bhavati, na punaḥ
pratyekam; ubhayasvabhāvatvāt | tathā pākyadravyarūpaṃ
jātiśca---ityubhayaṃ mititamutpādyānutpādyasvabhāvamiti jātirapi
guṇaḥ syādeva, na hi sajātīyatve satīti viśeṣaṇamupātam, ataḥ
pūrvārddhena jātivyāvṛttiḥ |
nanvevamapi ṭhpṛthagjātiṣu dṛśyate' ityanenaiva
sarvajātivyāvṛttisiddheḥ pūrvakaṃ viśeṣaṇadvayaṃ vyarthameva, tasmāt
ṭhsatve niviśate' iti svabhāvakathanam | tataḥ ṭhapaiti' ṭhpṛthagjātiṣu
dṛśyate' iti ca vikalpena jātīrvyāvartayataḥ, apaitītyasya ca tatraiva
kiyantāñcitkālaṃ sthitvā tamādhāraṃ tyajatītyayamarthaḥ |
nanvevamapi ṭhpṛthagjātiṣu dṛśyate' ityanenaiva
sarvajātivyāvṛttisiddheḥ pūrvakaṃ viśeṣaṇadvayaṃ vyarthameva, tasmāt
ṭhsatve niviśate' iti svabhāvakathanam | tataḥ ṭhapaiti' ṭhpṛthagjātiṣu
dṛśyate' iti ca vikalpena jātīrvyāvartayataḥ, apaitītyasya ca tatraiva
kiyantāñcitkālaṃ sthitvā tamādhāraṃ tyajatītyayamarthaḥ |
tadevam ṭhsatve niviśate apaiti ādeyaścākriyājaśca' ityekaṃ
lakṣaṇam | ṭhsatve niviśate pṛthagjātiṣu' ityādikaṃ cāparamiti
lakṣaṇadvayamanusartavyam ||
bahvādibhyaśca || 4|1|45 ||
śaktiḥ śastra iti | śaktiśabdaḥ śastre'bhidheye ṅīṣamutpādayati---śaktiḥ,
śaktī | śastra iti kim ? śaktiḥusāmarthyam | anye śaktiśastrī iti
śabdadvayaṃ paṭhanti---śastriḥ, śastrī | itaḥ prāṇyaṅgādityādīni trīṇi
vākyāni yathotaramadhikaviṣayāṇi | tatrotaraṃ vākyadvayam
ṭhrātreścājasau' ityatraiva vyākhyātam | ikārāntātprāṇyaṅgavācino
vā ṅīṣ bhavati---dhamaniḥ, dhamanī | ṭhsarvato'ktinnarthāt' ityeva
ṅīṣi siddhe śakaṭa|ladīnāmikārāntānāṃ pāṭhaḥ prapañcārthaḥ |
paddhatiśabdaḥ ktinnantaḥ, pādasya hatiḥ paddhatiḥ, ṭhhimakāṣihatiṣu ca'
iti padbhāvaḥ | ahanniti paṭha|lte, na sa kevalaḥ striyāṃ vartate,
tasmātadanto bahuvrīhirudāhāryaḥ---dīrghamaharasyāḥ dīrghāhrī śarat,
pāṭhasāmarthyāt ṭhanupasarjanāt' iti na pravartate | asya ṅīṣo
vikalpitatvāḍ ḍāppratiṣedhāvapi bhavataḥ, ṭhana upadhālopinaḥ' iti
ṅīp ca |
bahuśabdo guṇavacana iti | antodātaśca ṭhlaṅghibaṃhyaernalopaśca'
ityapratyayāntaḥ | kimarthaṃ tarhi tasyeha pāṭhaḥ ? ityata āha---tasyeti ||
nityaṃ cchandasi || 4|1|46 ||
nityagraṃhaṇamutarārthamiti | iha tvārambhasāmarthyādeva nityo vidhiḥ
siddhaḥ, yogārambhaścintyayojanaḥ ||
bhuvaśca || 4|1|47 ||
vibhvī, prabhvīti | ṭhviprasaṃbhyo ḍvasaṃjñāyām' iti
ḍupratyayāntād ṅīṣ | svayaṃbhūriti | bhavateḥ kvip |
hrasvādeveyamiti | yadyevaṃ ṭhgherṅiti' iti guṇe kṛte ṭhbhoḥ' iti
nirdeśaḥ prāpnoti tatrāha---sautro'yaṃ nirdeśa iti | guṇasyaiva
kṛtasya chāndasa uvaṅadeśa ityarthaḥ ||
puṃyogādākhyāyām || 4|1|48 ||
puṃsā yogaḥ puṃyoga iti | yogaḥ u sambandhaḥ |
puṃyogāddhetoriti | hetau pañcamīṃ darśayati | ākhyāgrahaṇaṃ
guṇabhūtenāpi puṃsaiva sambadhyate; anyena sambandhāsambhavāt |
gaṇakādayo hi śabdāḥ puṃyogātstriyāṃ vartamānā na
puṃyogasyākhyā bhavanti, striyāṃ ca puṃyogamantareṇa na pravartante
iti striyā api nākyāstadāha---puṃsa ākhyābhūtamiti |
būtagrahaṇenaitaddarśayati---yatprātipadikaṃ prāk puṃso
vācakamabhūt, samprati tu puṃyogāddhetoḥ striyāṃ vartata iti |
gaṇakītyādi | gaṇayatīti gaṇakaḥ, ṇvula | pratiṣṭhate praṣṭhaḥ,
ṭhpraṣṭho'gragāmini' iti ṣatvam | kathaṃ punarete puṃśabdāḥ ? ityata
āha---puṃsi śabdapravṛttinimitasya sambhavāditi | gaṇayati pratiṣṭhata
iti vyutpatyā puṃsi rūīḍhā ete, na strī gaṇayati pratiṣṭhate vā |
mahāmātraśabdasyāpi pravṛttinimitaṃ hastipakānāmājñāpanam |
hastipakādhipatirhi mahāmātraḥ | yā tu svayaṃ gaṇayati pratiṣṭhate vā,
na tasyāṃ puṃyogācchabdapravṛttiḥ, api tarhi svayameva
kriyāsambandhāditi ṭāpaiva tatra bhāvyam | kathaṃ tarhi striyāṃ
pravṛttiritya āha---tadyogāditi | ko'rthaḥ ?
tasyedamiti sambandhāditi cetaddhito bhavet |
ṅīṣeva bādhaka- syāccennityaṃ bādhaḥ prasajyate ||
gaṇakasyeyamiti bhedasambandhe vivakṣite ṭhtasyedam' iti taddhitaḥ
prāpnoti | atha nāprāpte taddhite ṅīṣārabhyamāṇastasya bādhaka
ityucyate, kadācidapi taddhito na syāta, ubhayamapi
tviṣyate---prāṣṭhī, praṣṭhīti ? syānmatametat---ṭhetadeva ṅīṣvidhānaṃ
jñāpakam---bheda vivakṣāyāmapi taddhitamantareṇa praṣṭhādayaḥ striyāṃ
vartate' iti | tena ṭhna kevalā prakṛtiḥ prayoktavyā' iti niyamo'tra
bādhyate, sati hi taddhite prāṣṭhītyaṇi ṅībeva siddhaḥ, tasya
codātanivṛttisvareṇodātatvamiti kiṃ ṅīṣvidhāneneti ? tanna;
ye'nīkārāntāstaddhitāḥ---bhānoriyaṃ bhānavīyeti,
tadarthametatsyāt | evaṃ tarhyākhyāgrahaṇaṃ jñāpakam---nātra
taddhitotpatiriti, na hi taddhitāntaḥ prakṛtyarthe puṃsi vartate ?
evamapi jñāpakena taddhitasya nityaṃ bādhātprāṣṭhīti na syāt |
tasmād duṣṭa evāyaṃ pakṣaḥ |
evaṃ tarhi yathā---mañcāḥ krośanti, gaurvāhīkaḥ, gaṅgāyāṃ ghoṣaḥ,
yaṣṭīḥ praveśayetyādau
tātsthātāddharmyātatsāmīpyātatsāhacaryāccātasminnapi
tatvādhyāropeṇa tacchabdapravṛttistadvadatrāpi
praṣṭhādisāhacaryātacchabdapravṛttirbhaviṣyati ? tatrābhedena
bhedasambandhasya nivṛtatvānna taddhitaprasaṅgaḥ | vivakṣite ca bhede
taddhitotpatyā prāṣṭhītyādi bhaviṣyati ? tatrāhuḥ---yastvayā
dharmaścaritavyaḥ so'nayā saheti bhāryāyāḥ śāstrasiddhaṃ sāhacaryamiti
tasyāmevaitanṅīṣvidhānamiti | bhaṭṭikāvye tu duhitṛṣvapi
dṛṣṭaḥ prayogaḥ---ṭhkausalyayā'sāvi sukhena rāmaḥ prakkekayīto
bharatastato'bhūt' iti, kekayasya duhitā kekayī,
janapadaśabdādapatyapratyaye tu kaikayīti prāpnoti, na ca tasya
ṭhātaśca' iti luk, na prācyabhargādīti pratiṣedhātat |
tasmātso'yamityabhisambandha ityayameva pakṣo grāhyaḥ |
yadvā---yathā svāmidāsau pacata iti svāminaḥ
saṃvidhātṛtvātpaktṛtvam, dāsasya tu sākṣāt; tathā puruṣaḥ
sākṣātpratiṣṭhate stryapi saṃvidhātṛtvātpuruṣagatāyāḥ
prasthānakriyāyāstasyāmāropātpratiṣṭhata iti, tasyāmeva praṣṭhaśabdo
vyutpādyate, na tu puruṣe vyutpāditaḥ san tena
sahābhedopacārātasyāṃ vartate | na caitāvatā puṃyogādeva hetoḥ
striyāṃ vartata ityasya hāniḥ, sākṣātsvayamakartṛtvāt | atra pakṣe
prastha iti sthite subantasya samāsaḥ, sup ca saṃkhyānimitam,
prātipadikaṃ ca pūrvaṃ liṅgamabhidhate, paścātsaṅkhyāmiti
tannimitasubapekṣātsamāsātprāgevotarapadātsthaśabdāṭṭāpprasaṅgaḥ,
na ca sthaśabdādapyanenaiva ṅīṣ labhyate, praṣṭhaśabdo hi puṃsa ākhyā,
na tu sthaśabdamātram, ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; ṭhgatikārakopapadānāṃ kṛddhiḥ
saha samāsavacanaṃ prāk subutpateḥ' iti kṛdantāvasthāyāmeva
samāsaḥ, sā puṃsa ākhyeti ṅīṣ bhaviṣyati | paribhāṣāprayojanāni
ṭhupapadamatiṅ' ityatra pratipāditāni |
devadateti | striyā eva kasyāścideṣā saṃjñā---parisṛṣṭā, prajāteti
| prasūtetyarthaḥ | puṃyogādete śabdāḥ striyāṃ vartanta iti |
parisargaḥ, prasavaḥ, prajana ityarthāntaram | sa ca na puṃyogamantareṇa
sambhavati, tasmātpuṃyogāddhetoḥ striyāṃ vartate | parisṛṣṭā
prajāteti | dvau prakṛtau | ete śabdā iti bahuvacanaṃ tu
evaṃjātīyakāḥ śabdāḥ prasūtādayastadapekṣaṃ draṣṭavyam |
gopālikādīnāmiti | siddhaye iti śeṣaḥ |
sūryāddevatāyāṃ cābvaktavya iti | ṅīṣa eva pratiṣedhe vaktavyāa
cābvidhānamantodātārtham | sūryaśabdo'yamādyaudātaḥ, tatra ṭāpi
sati ādyaudātatvamevāvatiṣṭhena | sūrīti | sūryasya strī mānuṣī
kuntyādiḥ, ṭhsūryatiṣya' iti yalopaḥ ||
indravaruṇabhavaśarvarudramṛḍahimāraṇyayavayavanamātulācāryāṇāmānuk
|| 4|4|49 ||
yeṣāyiti | indrādīnāṃ mṛḍāntānāṃ mātulācāryayośca |
anyeṣāmiti | himādīnām | 
himāraṇyayormahatva iti | mahatvayogenānayoḥ strītvam, anyatra
napuṃsakatvam | duṣṭo yava iti pāṭhaḥ | yavānīti |
jātyantaramevābhidhīyate, ayameva ca doṣo yaduta
yavatvajāterabhāve tadākārānukṛtiḥ |
yavanāllipyāmiti | kecijjanapadino yavanāsteṣāṃ lipiḥ,
ṭhtasyedam' ityaṇo bādhako ṅīṣ | lipiśabdaḥ strīliṅgaḥ |
upādhyāyamātulābhyāṃ veti | upādhyāyamātulābhyāṃ yo ṅīṣ
tatsanniyogenānayorvā''nugāgamo bhavatīti vaktavyamityarthaḥ |
tatropādhyāyasyāprāpto mātulasya tu nityaṃ prāpta ānugvikalpyate |
ācāryādaṇatvaṃ ceti | kṣubhnādiṣu paṭhitavyamityuktaṃ bhavati |
aryakṣatriyābhyāṃ veti | ṅīṣānukau dvāvapyaprāptau vikalpyete |
svārtha evāyaṃ vidhiriti | yadi tu puṃyoge'yaṃ vidhiḥ syācchūadrāpi
kṣatriyasya bhāryā kṣatriyāṇī syāt, brāhmaṇabhāryā ca kṣatriyāṇī na
syāt | tasmātsvārtha eva strītvaviśiṣṭo'yaṃ vidhiḥ |
mudgalāditi | ṅīṣo litvādānugākārasya litsvaraḥ | atha
kimarthamānugvidhīyate, na anugevocyeta,
akāroccāraṇasāmarthyādato guṇe pararūpaṃ bādhitvā savarṇadīrghatvaṃ
bhaviṣyati, anyathā nugevocyeta, yathaiva tarhi pararūpaṃ na bhavati
tathaiva savarṇadīrghatvamapi na syāt ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; yaṃ vidhiṃ
pratyupadeśo'narthakaḥ sa vidhirbādhyate, tasya tu vidhernimitameva
nāsau bādhyate, tasmādānugeva vaktavyaḥ |
apara āha---ṭhindramācaṣṭe indrayati, indrayateḥ kvip, ṇilopaḥ, indraḥ
strī indrāṇī, atra dīrghasya śravaṇam, dīrghāccāraṇasāmarthyādata
ityadhikāro bādhyate' iti, evamapi kvibantaḥ puṃsa ākhyā na bhavati ||
krītātkaraṇapūrvāt || 4|1|50 ||
pūrvaśabdo'vayavavacana ityāha---karaṇaṃ pūrvamasminnityādi |
vyavasthāvācini tu pūrvaśabde karaṇaṃ pūrvamasmāditi vācyaṃ syāt
| evaṃ ca krītasya karaṇavāciśabdāntaramavayavo nopapadyata iti
tadvyatiriktameva prātipadikaṃ karaṇapūrvatvena viśeṣyate,
krītaśabdenāpi viśeṣitasyaiva
viśeṣaṇātadantavidhirityāha---krītaśabdāntātprātipadikāditi |
yadi tu vyavasthāvācinaṃ pūrvaśabdamāśritya krītaśabdo
viśeṣyati---karaṇaṃ pūrvamasmāditi, tato vākye'pi syād---aśvena
krīteti | tasmādavayavavācī pūrvaśabdaḥ, prātipadikaṃ ca
viśeṣyamiti samyaguktam | vastrakrītiti | ṭhgatikārakopapadānām'
iti vacanāt prāgeva subutpateḥ krītaśabdena saha samāsaḥ |
cābantena samāsa iti | ekādeśasya pūrvaṃ pratyantavatvātkṛdantatāyā
avighātādaviruddhaṣṭābantena samāsaḥ | atha ṭābantenāpi samāse
kasmādevātra na bhavati ? tatrāha---ata itīti | nanūdāharaṇavatprāgeva
ṭābutpateratrāpi samāsaḥ prāpnoti, vaktavyo vā viśeṣaḥ ? ata
āha---gatikārakopapadānāmityādi | na tatra bahulagrahaṇamastīti
cetatrāha---kartṛkaraṇe kṛtā bahulamiti | ṭhkartṛkaraṇe kṛtā
bahulam' ityanena tāvadatra samāsaḥ, sa ca bahulagrahaṇāt prāk
subutpateḥ kvacidbhavati, kvacidutpanne supīti manyate |
etāvataiva ca bahulaṃ taducyate iti sāmanyenoktam, na punaḥ
ṭhkartṛkaraṇe kṛtā bahulam' ityayameva samāsaḥ prāk
subutpatariṣyate | yathā tu bhāṣyaṃ tathā naitadiṣyate ||
ktādalpākhyāyām || 4|1|51 ||
alpākhyāyāmiti samudāyopādhiriti | nanu cālpairabhrairvilipteti
pūrvapadārthasyaivālpatā gamyate, na viliptārthasya ? evaṃ
manyate---abhrāṇāṃmalpatve sati tadvilepanasyālpatvamavaśyambhāvīti |
abhraviliptīti | vṛtau gatārthatvādalpaśabdasyāprayogaḥ |
candanānulipteti | bahulena candanenānuliptetyarthaḥ |
kṛdgrahaṇaparibhāṣayā samudāyasya ktāntatvam ||
bahuvrīheścāntodātāt || 4|1|52 ||
bahuvrīhiryo'ntodākta iti | atra ṭhktāt'
ityanuvṛttisāmarthyātpratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣā, kṛdgrahaṇaparibhāṣā ca
na pravartate iti bahuvrīheḥ ktāntatvam | śaṅkhabhinniti | ṭhniṣṭhā'
iti pūrvanipāto na bhavati; ṭhjātikālasukhādibhyaḥ paravacanam' iti
vacanāt | śaṅkhādayo hi jātivacanāḥ, ata eva
ṭhjātikālasukhādibhyaḥ' ityantodātatvaṃ bhavati | galotkṛtīti |
ṭhkṛtī chedane', utpūrvāt ktaḥ | galamutkṛtamasyā iti vigrahaḥ |
pādapatiteti | ṭhkartṛkaraṇe kṛtā bahulam' iti samāsaḥ,
thāthādisvareṇāntodātatvam |
antodātājjātapratiṣedha iti | antodātādvahubrīherṅīṣvidhāne
jātaśabdāntātpratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ, sa tvantagrahaṇādeva siddhaḥ | katham ?
ihāntagrahaṇaṃ na kartavyam, varṇādanudātāditivad udātāntāditi
vijñāsyate, tat kriyate nityayoge yathā bahuvrīhirvijñāyeta |
dantajātādau tu ṭhvā jāte' iti vikalpenāntodātatvam |
pāṇigṛhītyādīnāṃ viśeṣa iti | siddhaye iti śeṣaḥ | agnisākṣikaṃ
yasyāḥ pāṇirgṛhyate sā pāṇigṛhītīti bhavati | kathañciditi |
yathoktātprakārādanyena prakāreṇetyarthaḥ |
abahunañityādi | bahvādipūrvapadādvahuvrīherṅīṣ na bhavatīti
vaktavyamityarthaḥ | bahukṛteti | bahuni kṛtānyanayeti vigrahaḥ,
ṭhbahornañvadutarapadabhūmni' ityantodātatvam | akṛtā, sukṛteti |
na vidyate kṛtamanayā, śobhanaṃ kṛtamanayeti vigrahaḥ, ṭhnañsubhyām'
ityantodātatvam | māsajāteti | māso jāto'tīto'syāḥ | sukhaṃ
jātaṃ prāptamanayā, duḥ khaṃ jātamanayeti vigrahaḥ | sukhādayaḥ
ṭhsukhādibhyaḥ kartṛvedanāyām' ityatra paṭhitā gṛhyante | atha
vā---bahuvrīheśca jātipūrvāditi vaktavyam,
bahuvrīhāvantodātanimiteṣvanyeṣu pratiṣiddheṣu
jātirevāntodātanimitaṃ ktāntasyāvaśiṣyate iti jātigrahaṇamevātra
kartavyamityartaḥ ||
asvāṅgapūrvapadādvā || 4|1|53 ||
śārṅgajagdhītyādi | śārṅga jagdhamanayā, palāṇḍurbhakṣito'nayeti
vigrahaḥ | śārṅgādirabhakṣyajātiḥ | sarvatra ṭhjātikālasukhādibhyaḥ'
ityantodātatvam |
vastracchanneti | ṭhcchada apavāraṇe' curādiḥ, ṭhvā dāntaśānta' ityādino
cchanna śabdo nipātitaḥ, atra ṭhanācchādanāt' iti
pratiṣedhātpūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratvameva bhavati |
pravṛddhā cetyādinā vigrahaviśeṣeṇa tatpuruṣaṃ darśayati ||
svāṅgāccopasarjanādasaṃyogopaghāt | atikeśīti | atikrāntā
keśāniti tatpuruṣaḥ, ṭhekavibhakti ca' iti keśaśabdasyopasarjanatvam
| aśikheti | asatyupasarjanagrahaṇe'traiva prāpnoti, na
mūlodāharaṇeṣu; ṭhanupasarjanāt' ityadhikārāt | atha
bahuvrīhyadhikārādatra na bhaviṣyatītyucyeta ? atikeśītyatrāpi tarhi na
syāt | ṭhaṅgātra' ityādibhāṣye'nuktamapyetatprayogabāhulyād
vṛttikāreṇoktam |
yadyatra svamaṅgaṃ svāṅgaṃ gṛhyaeta---ślakṣṇamukhā śālā, atrāpi
prāpnoti, mukhasya śālāṅgatvāt ; dīrghakeśī rathyetyatra ca na
syāt, keśānāṃ rathyāṅgatvābhāvāt ?
tadavyāptyativyāptiparihārārthaṃ svāṅgaṃ paribhāṣyate---adravamiti |
tatra prāṇisthaṃ svāṅgamityanena ślakṣṇamukhā śāletyatra na bhavati |
evamapi bahukaphā atra prāpnoti ? tadarthamāha---adravamiti | dravatīti
dravam, tato'nyadadravam | evamapi bahujñānā---atrāpi prāpnoti ? ata
āha---mūrtimaditi | asarvagatadravyaparimāṇā mūrtiḥ, asarvagatāni
yāni dravyāṇi teṣāṃ yatparimāṇaṃ hrasvatyādi sā mūrtiḥ; sparśavad
dravyaparimāṇaṃ mūtirityanye, sā yasyāsti tanmūrtimat | evamapi
bahuśophā atra prāpnoti ? ityata āha---avikārajamiti |
vikāraḥuvātādivaiṣamyam, tato yajjāyate tanna bhavatītyavikārajam
| śophastu śvayathusaṃjñako vikārajaḥ | yadi prāṇisthaṃ svāṅgam,
rathyādiparigatānāṃ keśānāṃ svāṅgatvaṃ na syāt,
sampratyaprāṇisthatvāt, tataśca dīrghakeśī rathyeti na siddhyatyata
āha---atatsthamiti | sampratyaprāṇisthamapi kadācitprāṇini dṛṣṭṃa
cetadapi svāṅgaṃ bhavatyevetyarthaḥ | evamapi pratimāvayavānāṃ
mukhādīnāṃ svāṅgatvaṃ na prāpnoti, aprāṇisthatvāt, tataśca
dīrghamukhī pratimetyatra na siddhyati ? tatrāha--tena cediti |
atatsthamityanuṣaṅgaḥ | aprāṇisthamapi mukhādi svāṅgaṃ tena
cenmukhādinā tadaprāṇidravyaṃ tathā yutaṃ bhavati yathā
prāṇidravyamityarthaḥ | anyeṣāṃ pāṭhaḥ---tasya cetatathā yutamiti |
tatrārthaḥ---aprāṇisthamapi mukhādi svāṅgaṃ tasya cedaprāṇinaḥ
tanmukhādi tathā yutaṃ bhavati, tādṛśaṃ saṃsthānaṃ bhavati yādṛśaṃ
saṃsthānaṃ prāṇina ityarthaḥ ||
nāsikodarauṣṭhajaṅghādantakarṇaśrṛṅgācca || 4|1|55 ||
sahaniñvidyamānalakṣaṇastu pratiṣedho bhavatyeveti | katham ?
nāsikodarayostāvadayaṃ yogaḥ purastādapavādanyāyenānantaraṃ
bahvajlakṣaṇameva pratiṣedhaṃ bādhate, oṣṭhādiṣvapi
madhye'pavādanyāyena pūrvaṃ saṃyogopadhalakṣaṇaṃmeva pratiṣedhaṃ
bādhate, na sahādilakṣaṇam; ato'sau bhavatyeva---sanāsikā,
anāsikā, vidyamānanāsiketi | bimboṣṭhīti | ṭhotvoṣṭhāyorvā
samāse pararūpaṃ vaktavyam' iti pararūpam |
kabarapucchīti | kabaramunānāvarṇaṃ pucchamasyāḥ sā mayūrī | maṇiḥ
pucchamasyāḥ maṇipucchī, viṣaṃ pucchamasyāḥ viṣapucchī vṛścikī |
ulūka iva pakṣo'syāḥ ulūka iva pucchamasyā iti vigrahaḥ ||
na kroḍādibahvacaḥ || 4|1|56 ||
kalyāṇakroḍeti | aśvānāmuraḥ kroḍā, strīliṅgo'yam | tatra
bahuvrīhau pūrvapadasya puṃvadbhāvaḥ, utarapadasyopasarjanahnasvatvam
| alyāṇanakheti | agrantho'yam; ṭhnakhamukhātsaṃjñāyām' iti
pratiṣedhāt, asaṃjñāyāṃ ṅīṣa iṣṭatvāt, tasmāt kalyāṇekheti
pāṭhaḥ | ukheti hi paṭha|lte---ṭhkroḍā bālasurokhāḥ śapho gudaṃ
bhagagalau ca' iti ||
sahanañvidyamānapūrvācca || 4|1|57 ||
pūrvagrahaṇamakṛtvā ṭhsahanañvidyamānebhyaḥ' ityucyamāne sahādibhyaḥ
paraṃ yatsvāṅgaṃ tadantānṅīṣ na bhavatītyartho bhavati, tataśceha
pratiṣedhaḥ prasajyeta---vidyamānaṃ mukhamasya vidyamānamukhaḥ, kalyāṇo
vidyamānamukho'syāḥ kalyāṇavidyamānamukhīti, bhavati hyaetad
yathoktaviśeṣaṇam; iha ca na syād---vidyamānakalyāṇamukheti, na hyatra
yathoktaṃ viśeṣaṇamasti, tasmātpūrvagrahaṇam ||
nakhamukhātsaṃjñāyām || 4|1|58 ||
śūrpaṇakheti | ṭhpūrvapadātsaṃjñāyāyāmagaḥ' iti ṇatvam | evaṃ ca
śūrpaṇakhā vā rākṣasī śūrpanakhī vā | yadi yogamātraṃ na
saṃjñā---śūrpanakhī, saṃjñāyām---śūrpaṇakhā; na punaḥ śūrpaṇakhīti
ṇatvaṅīṣo samāveśaḥ sādhuḥ ||
dīrghajihvī cacchandasi || 4|1|59 ||
nipātanaṃ nityārthamiti | ṭhdīrghajihvāt' ityucyamāne prakṛtasya
ṅīṣo vikalpitatvādihāpi vikalpo vijñāyate ||
dikpūrvapadānṅīp || 4|1|60 ||
dikpūrvapadānṅīṣo'nudātatvam, ṭhsvāṅgācca' ityādinā
vihitasya ṅīṣa evāsminviṣaye'nudātatvaṃ vaktavyam, ṅībvidhāne
hyanyatrāpiṅīṣviṣayānṅīpprasaṅgaḥ | apūrve hi ṅīpi vidhīyamāne
prāggulphā, prāgjaghaneti ṅīṣviṣayādanyatrāpi ṅīpprāpnoti; ṅīṣaḥ
pratiṣedhābhāvāt ? ityasminpūrvapakṣe
idamāha---vidhipratiṣedhaviṣayaḥ sarvo'pyapekṣyate iti | tatra
vidhiviṣayāpekṣāyāḥ phalaṃ darśayati---yatra ṅīṣvihita iti | svare
biśeṣa iti | ṅīpaḥ pitvādanudātatvaṃ bhavati, ṅīṣastu
pratyayādyaudātatvaprasaṅgaḥ | prāṅmukheti | ṅīpā mukte
ṭhsvāṅgācco pasarjanāt' iti ṅīṣapi na bhavati, katham ?
uktametat---ṭhyatrotsargāpavādau dvāvapi vikalpitau tatrāpavādena
mukte utsargo na pravartate' iti |
pratiṣedhāpekṣāyāḥ phalaṃ darśayati---iha na bhavatīti | evaṃ ca kṛtvā
vākyabhedaḥ
kartavyaḥ---dikpūrvapadādasaṃyogopadhasvāṅgāntānnāsikādyantānṅīṣ bhavati; kroḍādibahvajantātu neti aparaḥ kalpaḥ, atra ṅīṣanuvartate, tasya dikpūrvapadāditi pañcamyā ṣaṣṭhī prakalpyate, dikpūrvapadādutarasya ṅīṣo ṅībādeśo bhavatītyarthaḥ | tena yatra ṅīṣ tatraiva ṅībiti siddham | evaṃ cotaratra ṅīṣeva svaryata ityupapannaṃ bhavati ||
vāhaḥ || 4|1|61 ||
sāmarthyāditi | karmaṇyupapade vaherṇvidhānātkevalasya vāhaḥ
sambhavo nāstītyetatsāmarthyam | dityauhīti | ṭhcchandasisahaḥ',
ṭhvahaśca' iti ṇviḥ, upadhāvṛddhiḥ, ṅīṣi ṭhvāha ūṭha', tatra
samprasāraṇamityanuvṛteḥ ṭhsamprasāraṇācca' iti pūrvarūpatvam,
ṭhetyedhatyūṭhsu' iti vṛddhiḥ ||
sakhyaśiśvīti bhāṣāyām || 4|1|62 ||
bhāṣāyāmityucyate, tatraitanna sidhyati---sakhī saptapadī bhava, ā
dhenavo dhunayantāmaśiśvīriti ? naiṣa doḥ; itikaraṇo'tra kriyate, sa
bhinnakramo bhāṣāyāmityasyānantaraṃ draṣṭavyaḥ, sa ca prakāre vartate,
tena cchandasyapi kvacidbhaviṣyati | bhāṣāgrahaṇaṃ tu nityārtham ||
jāterastrīviṣayādayopadhāt || 4|1|63 ||
astrīviṣayādityananyabhāve viṣayaśabda ityāha---na ca straiyāmiti |
striyāmeva yasya niyamena vṛttistatstrīviṣayam,
tato'nyadastrīviṣayamityarthaḥ |
iha laukikajātigrahaṇe brāhmaṇatvādīnāṃ gotrasya ca
nāḍāyanāderjātitve vādināṃ vipratipateḥ, caraṇaśabdānāṃ ca
kaṭhādīnāmadhyayanakriyāsambandhanibandhanatvena
pācakādivatkriyāśabdatvenāvyāptirityabhimatāṃ jāti
lakṣayati---ākṛtigrahaṇā jātiriti | gṛhyate'neneti grahaṇamiti
karaṇasāmānye padaṃ saṃskriyate, paścādākṛtiśabdasamavadhāne strītvaṃ
pratīyamānaṃ bahiraṅgatvāt pratyayasya nimitaṃ na bhavati |
grahaṇamākṛtiryasyā iti grahaṇarūpoddeśenākṛtirūpatā vidhīyate,
na tvākṛtirūpoddeśena grahaṇarūpatetyarthaḥ | ākṛtiḥusaṃsthānam,
sā grahaṇaṃ yasyāḥ sā''kṛtigrahaṇā,
avayavasanniveśaviśeṣavyaṅgyetyarthaḥ | anena gotvādijātirlakṣitā
| brāhmaṇatvādijātistu na saṃgṛhītā bhavati, brāhmaṇakṣatriyādīnāṃ
saṃsthānasya sadṛśatvāditi tatsaṃgrahāyā''ha---liṅgānāṃ ceti |
sarvāṇi liṅgāni na bhajatītyayamartho vivakṣitaḥ | tatra sarvaśabdasya
liṅgāpekṣatve'pigamakatvādbhajo ṇvipratyayaḥ, samāsaśca |
ṭhliṅgānām' iti karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī | aprāptaprāpaṇārthaṃ cedaṃ vacanam,
na tvākṛtigrahaṇetyasya saṅkocakam; tena taṭādeḥ
sarvaliṅgatve'pi ākṛtigrahaṇatvājjātitvaṃ bhavatyeva | iha kasmānna
bhavati---devadataḥ, devadateti ?upadeśāpekṣamidaṃ lakṣaṇam | ko'rthaḥ
? asarvaliṅgeṣu yeṣu jātivācitvamācāryā upadiśanti teṣveva
bhavatītyarthaḥ | ākṛtigrahaṇāyā
jāterekatvanityatvapratyekaparisamāptatvalakṣaṇān
dharmānāha---sakṛditi | ekasminpiṇḍe sakṛdupadiṣṭā ṭhayaṃ gauḥ' iti
piṇḍāntare nirgrāhyā, niścetuṃ śakyetyartaḥ | yadi caikā na syāt,
naiva gṛhyaeta | tathā nityatvābhāve'pi piṇḍena saha
vināśātpiṇḍāntare na gṛhyaeta | yadi ca pratyekaṃ sarvātmanā
parisamāptā na syāt, tasminnapi tāvatpiṇḍe sarvātmanā na gṛhyaeta
yatrākhyātā, kiṃ punaḥ piṇḍāntare ! kathaṃ punarekameva vastu bahutra
yugapatkārtsyena vartate, na hi devadatastadānīmeva srughne bhavati
madhurāyāṃ ca ? dṛśyate cetko doṣaḥ, na hi dṛṣṭe'nupapannaṃ nāma !
gotramiti | apatyamityarthaḥ | caraṇaśabdena śākhādhyāyino gṛhyante,
gotrasyānākṛtigrahaṇatvāt sarvaliḍgatvācca pṛthagupādānam,
ṭhnāḍāyanaṃ napuṃsakam' iti darśanāt |
caraṇaśabdastvadhyayanakriyāsambandhena pravṛtatvātkriyāśabda eva, na
jātiśabdaḥ |
kukkuṭī, sūkarīti | ākṛtigrahaṇāyā jāterudāharaṇam | brāhmaṇaii,
vṛṣalītyasarvaliṅgāyāḥ | tatra brāhmaṇīti rūpodāharaṇam |
śārṅgaravādiṣvasya pāṭhād vṛṣalītyetadeva ṅīpa udāharaṇam |
