nāḍāyanī, cārāyaṇīti | gotralakṣaṇāyāḥ ṭhnaḍādibhyaḥ phak' |
apatyamātrasya grahaṇādanantarāpatye'pi bhavati---avantī, kuntīti,
ṭhito manuṣyajāteḥ' iti ṅīṣbhavati | iha tu kulasyāpatyaṃ kulīnā
brāhmaṇīti ṅīṣ na bhavati; ajādiṣu darśanādityāhuḥ | kaṭhīti |
kaṭhena proktam, vaiśampāyanāntevāsitvāṇṇiniḥ, tasya
ṭhkaṭhacarakāt' iti luk, tataḥ ṭhtadadhīte' ityaṇ, tasya
ṭhproktālluk' iti luk | bahavṛcīti | bahvya ṛco'syā iti
bahuvrīhiḥ, ṭhbahvṛścaraṇākhyāyām' ityakāraḥ samāsāntaḥ | kathaṃ
punaḥ strī nāmādhīte ? mā nāmādhigīṣṭa, tadvaṃśyatvātu tācchadbyaṃ
bhaviṣyati, yathā---anadhīyamāne māṇavake |
atrāparaṃ jātilakṣaṇamuktaṃ bhāṣye---
prādurbhāvavināśābhyāṃ satvasya yugapadguṇaiḥ |
asarvaliṅgāṃ bahvarthāṃ tāṃ jātiṃ kavayo viduḥ || iti |
satvasya prādurbhāvavināśābhyāṃ yā''virbhāvatirobhāvo prāpnoti,
yāvaddravyabhāvinītyarthaḥ | guṇaiśca yugapad dravyeṇa sambadhyate
yathā nirguṇaṃ dravyaṃ na bhavati, tathā jātirahitamapītyarthaḥ |
bahvarthāmiti | arthaśabdo viṣayavācī, bahuviṣayāṃ
bahuvyaktivyāpinīmityarthaḥ | asarvaliṅgāmiti |
pūrvallakṣaṇāntaram | tatra yathā pūrvalakṣaṇaṃ tathā kumārībhāryā iti
bhavitavyam, katham ? kaumāramayāvaddravyabhāvyapi
ākṛtigrahaṇatvādbhavanati jātiḥ, tataśca ṭhjāteśca' iti
puṃbadbhāvapratiṣedhaḥ | vṛddhā, sthaviretyādau ca jātilakṣaṇo
ṅīṣprāpnoti, yathā punarutaraṃ tathā kaumārādikaṃ jātirna bhavati;
ayāvaddravyabhāvitvāt | tatra pūrvakaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ
bhāṣyakārasyābhimatam, notaram; apara āhetyabhidhānāt | tathā ca
ṅyāpsūtre yuvatitaretyatra ṭhtasilādiṣu' iti prāptasya
puṃvadbhāvasya ṭhjāteśca' iti niṣedha āśritaḥ | ata eva
vṛttikāreṇāpyetadeva lakṣaṇamupanyastamiti kecidāhuḥ | evamapi
yuvajānirityatra puṃvadbhāvo na prāpnoti, tasmād dvitīyameva
lakṣaṇaṃ sādhīyo manyāmahe | ata eva vṛddhā, sthavireti jātilakṣaṇo
ṅīṣna bhavati | yuvatitaretyatra tu
bhāṣyakāraprayogātpuṃvadbhāvābhāvaḥ |
muṇḍeti | guṇaśabdo'yam | makṣiketi | striyāmevāyaṃ niyataḥ | iha
kasmānna bhavati---mālā, balāketi ? mālāśabdo malanaṃ māla iti
ghañantaḥ puṃlliṅgaḥ, kṣetraviśeṣe napuṃsakaḥ, sraji strīliṅgaḥ |
balākāśabdo hi balāṃ kāyatīti yaugikaḥ sarvaliṅgaḥ,
bakajātivacanaḥ strīliṅgaḥ | nātra yathākathañcidastrīliṅgaviṣayatvaṃ
vivakṣitam , kiṃ tarhi ? yasminpravṛttinimite strīliṅgastasminneva
nimite yalliṅgāntare'pi vartate tadastrīviṣayam | yathā punarayaṃ
śabdārthastathā ṭhstriyāḥ puṃvat' ityatra vakṣyāmaḥ | tena nimitabhedena
nānāliṅgeṣu nāyaṃ vidhirbhavati | yadyevam, droṇī, vuṭī,
pātrītyatra na prāpnoti ? droṇaśabdaḥ pramāṇaviśeṣe puṃlliṅgaḥ;
gavādinyāṃ tu strīliṅgaḥ; kuṭaśabdo ghaṭe puṃlliṅgaḥ, gehe tu
strīliṅgaḥ; gaurādipāṭhātsiddham | 
hayagavayetyādi | gaurādiṣvidānīntanairhayādayaḥ prakṣiptā iti
vārtikakāravacanādvijñāyate ||
pākakarṇaparṇapuṣpaphalamūlabālotarapadācca || 4|1|64 ||
strīviṣayatvādeteṣāmiti | pūrvatra samānāyāmākṛtau
yadastrīviṣayamityāśrayaṇānnimitabhedena nānāliṅgānāmeṣāṃ na
sidhyatīti bhāvaḥ | odanapākādayaḥ saṃjñāśabdā
yathākathañcidvyutpādyāḥ ||
ito manuṣyajāteḥ || 4|1|65 ||
avantī, kuntīti | avanti-kuntiśabdābhyāmapatye'rthe
ṭhvṛddhetkosalājādāññyaṅ' tasya ṭhstriyāmavantikuntikurubhyaśca'
iti luk | dākṣaii, lpākṣīti | ṭhata iñ' |
viṭ, daraditi | viṭśabdājjanapadaśabdātkṣatriyādañ,
daracchabdād ṭhdvyañmagadha' ityādināṇa, tayoḥ ṭhataśca' iti luk
| udāharaṇasiddhyarthameva ṭhataḥ' ityasyānuvṛttirna
śakyā''śrayitumityatrāpi prasaṅgaḥ |
audameyīti | udakaṃ meyamasya udameyaḥ, ṭhudakasyodaḥ saṃjñāyām'
ityudabhāvaḥ, ṭhtasyāpatyam', ṭhata iñ'|
sautaṅgamī, maunicitīti | sutaṅgamamunicitaśabdābhyāṃ ṭhtena
nirvṛtam' ityatrārthe iñpratyayaḥ ||
ūṇutaḥ || 4|1|66 ||
kururiti | ṭhkurunādibhyo ṇyaḥ' tasya ṭhstriyāmavanti' ityādinā
luk | vrahmabandhūrjīvabandhūriti | vṛtasvādhyāyahīnāyā
brāhmaṇajātāvetau bahuvrīhī vartete |
ṅkāra ityādi | ṭhnodhātvoḥ' ityucyamāne, yavāgvā,
yavāgvai---atrāpi ṭhudātayaṇo halpūrvāt' iti prāptasya
vibhaktyudātasya niṣedhaḥ syāt, varṇagrahaṇe hyarthavadgrahaṇaparibhāṣā
nopatiṣṭhate | atha dīrghoccāraṇaṃ kimartham, na ṭhuṇutaḥ'
ityevocyeta, savarṇadīrghatvena siddham ? na sidhyati; satyapi
savarṇadīghatve, ṭhgostriyorupasarjanasya' iti hrasvatvaṃ prāpnoti | na
prāpnoti, kiṃ kāraṇam ? ṭhubhayata āśrayaṇe nāntādivat', tathā hi
ekādeśasyāntavatvena pratipadikasaṃjñā sampādyā, ṭhapratyayaḥ' iti
niṣedhāt | ādivatvena ca strīpratyayatvaṃ sampādyam | iti tarhi
brahmabandhūcchatram---ṣatvatukorasiddhatvād hrasvalakṣaṇo nityastuk
prasajyeta, dīrghoccāraṇātvekādeśasyāsiddhatve'pi dīrgha evāyamiti
ṭhdīrghātpadāntādvā' iti vikalpaḥ sidhyati ? etadapi nāsti
prayojanam ; padāntapadādyorekādeśo'siddhaḥ, na caipa
padāntapadādyorekādeśaḥ | tasmādanarthakaṃ dīrghoccāraṇam ?
ityāśaṅkyāha---dīrghoccāraṇaṃ kapo bādhanārthamiti |
ṭhśeṣādvibhāṣāa' iti kapo'vakāśaḥ---ayavakaḥ, avrīhikaḥ,
ūṅe'vakāśaḥ--kurūriti; brahmabandhvāderbahuvrīherubhayaprasaṅge
paratvātkap prāpnoti, dīrghoccāraṇānna bhavita, katham ? ukāradvayaṃ
dīrgheṇa nirdiṣṭam, tatra dvitīya ukāraḥ kapo bādhanārthaḥ |
adhvaryuriti | adhvaraṃ yātīti ṭhmṛgayvādayaśca' ityuṇādiṣu
darśanāt kupratyayo'dhvaraśabdasyāntalopaśca | caraṇalakṣaṇeyaṃ
jātiḥ, adhvaryuśākhādhyāyini vaṃśe bhavetyarthaḥ |
aprāṇijāteśceti | atra ṭhutaḥ' iti nāpekṣyate
tenālābū-karkandhūśabdābhyāṃ dīrghāntābhyāmapi bhavati |
ṭhkṛṣicamitanidhanisajikharjibhya ūḥ' iti vartamāne ṭhṇitkaśipadyarteḥ'
ityato ṇiditi ca, ṭhnañi lambernarlopaśca', ṭhlabi avusraṃsane',
tasmānnañpūrvādūpratyayo bhavati nalopaśca ṇitvād vṛddhiḥ,
ṭhandūdṛmbhūkarkandhūḥ' iti nipātanādūkārāntaḥ karkandhūśabdaḥ |
evamalābū-karkandhūśabdau dīrghāntau | ūṅvidhānamalābvā,
karkandhvā ityādau ṭhnoṅdhātvoḥ' iti
vibhaktyudātatvapratiṣedhārtham | kṛkavākuriti | ṭhkṛke vacaḥ kaśca'
kṛkaśabda upapade vakerdhātoruṇ pratyayo bhavati, kaścanāntādeśaḥ |
rajjuriti | ṭhsṛjerasum ca', ādilopaḥ prakṛtaḥ, sṛjeru pratyayaḥ,
ādeśca lopo'sugāgamaśca, ṛto yaṇādeśaḥ, sakārasya
jaśtvacartve, sṛjyate'sau rajjuriti | hanuriti | ṭhyusnihi'
ityādinā hanterupratyayaḥ ||
paṅgośca || 4|1|68 ||
śvaśurasyeti | puṃyogalakṣaṇasya ṅīṣo'pavāda ūṅ vidhīyate,
ṭhśāvaśerāptau' śuśabde'śnoteruran pratyayo bhavati | kimidaṃ śu
iti ? āśuśabdasyāyamādilopo nipātitaḥ | āśvāptavyaḥ śvaśuraḥ,
tasya strī śvaśrūḥ, ṭhśvaśuraḥ śvavavā' ityadinipātanādvibhaktyādi
prātipadikakāryaṃ bhavati ||
ūrūtarapadādaupamye || 4|1|69 ||
upamīyate'nayetyupamā, tadbhāva aupamyam | kathaṃ ṭhvicakare ca
kareṇukarorubhiḥ' iti ? niraṅkuśāḥ kavayaḥ; ṭhkareṇa varorubhiḥ'
iti pāṭhaḥ---kareṇa vicakare varorubhiriti ||
saṃhitaśaphalaṇakṣavāmādeśca || 4|1|70 ||
saṃhitaśabdaḥ sahitaparyāyaḥ, lakṣaṇaśabdo'rśāadyacpratyayāntaḥ, vāmaśabdaḥ
śobhanaparyāyaḥ |
sahitasahābhyāṃ ceti | ṭhsamo vā hitatatayoḥ' iti malope sati yaḥ
sahitaśabdastasya saṃhitagrahaṇenaiva siddham,
ekadeśavikṛtasyānanyatvāt | yastu saha hitena vartate iti
vyutpannaḥ sahitaśabdastasyedaṃ grahaṇamityāhuḥ | sahorūriti | sahete
iti sahau, tādṛśāvūrū yasyā ityarthaḥ | vidyamānasya vā sahaśabdasya
ūrvatiśayapratipādanāya prayogaḥ ||
kadrukamaṇḍalvoścchandasi || 4|1|71 ||
guggulvādīnāṃ cchandasi vyatyayena strītvam | patayāluśabdaḥ
ṭhspṛhigṛhi' ityādinā''lujantaḥ ||
śārṅgaravādyaño ṅīn || 4|1|73 ||
ete'ṇanta iti | śrṛṅgaru, kapaṭua, guggulu, brahman---ityetebhyaḥ
prāgdīvyato'ṇ, gotamaśabdādṛṣyaṇ,, gaurādiṣvapyayaṃ paṭhitaḥ |
ete ḍhagantā iti | bāhulyādevamuktam |
kaṇaṇḍaluśabdāccatuṣpādbhyo ḍhañ, itarebhyastu śubhrādilakṣaṇo
ḍhak | etau phagantāviti | vātsyaśabdād gargādiyañantādyauuni
ṭhyañiñośca' iti phak | nanu na striyāṃ yuvasaṃjñā,
ṭhgotrādyauunyastriyām' iti vacanāt, gotre ca ṭheko gotre' iti
niyamaḥ ? evaṃ tarhi vātsyāyanaśabdasyāsmin gaṇe
pāṭhasāmarthyātstriyāṃ yuvasaṃjñā bhaviṣyati, gotra eva vā pratyayadvayam
| muñjaśabdo naḍādiḥ | jātiriti | gotralakṣaṇā | ḍhaganta iti |
kīkasāśabdaḥ śubhrādiḥ | ñyaṅntāviti |
ṭhvṛddhetkosalājādāññyaṅ' iti kavi-śivibhyāṃ ñyaṅ,
ṭhyaṅścāp' atra prāpnoti | ehi, paryehīti | ṭhīha ceṣṭāyām'
āṅpūrvātparyāṅpūrvācca ṭhsarvadhātubhya in' itīn pratyayaḥ,
aśmarathaśabdo gargādiḥ, udapānaśabdaḥ śuṇḍikādiḥ, utsādiśca,
tatrāha---śuṇḍikādyaṇantaḥ prayojayatīti | ante tu ṅīpo ṅīno vā
nāsti viśeṣaḥ | jātiriti |
arāla--caṇḍālayorasarvaliṅgatvājjātitvam | vataṇḍaśabdasya
gotratvāt | vataṇḍasyāpatyaṃ strī ṭhvataṇḍācca' iti yañ, ṭhluk
striyām' iti tasya luk | bhogavadgorimatoriti |
matvantatvāt ṭhugitaśca' iti ṅīpi prāpte vacanam | nanu
bhogaśabdo ghañantaḥ, gauriśabdaḥ ṭhata iñ' itīñantaḥ, tau
ñitsvareṇādyaudātau, tābhyāṃ matup, pitvādanudātaḥ, tataśca na
ṅībṅīnoratrāsti viśeṣaḥ ? tatrāha---ghādiṣu nityamiti |
ugillakṣaṇe ṅīpi sati ṭhnadyāḥ śeṣasyānyatarasyām', ṭhugitaśca' iti
vikalpena hrasvatvaṃ syāt, ṅīni tu sati ṭhgharūpakalpa' iti nityaṃ
sambhavati | kathaṃ bhavati, yāvatā ugitaḥ parā yā nadī tasyā vikalpo
vihitaḥ, ṅīnapi cogitaḥ parā nadī,
bogavadgaurimatorugitvāt ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; ṭhugitaśca' iti
ityarthe'yaṃ caśabdaḥ, ugita ityevamugitsaṃśabdanena yā nadī vihitā na
cānena vihito ṅīnevaṃ vihitā nadī bhavati | yathā tu
ṭhyuvoranākau' ityatra bhāṣyam, tathogitaḥ parā yā nadītyetadeva
sthitam | saṃjñāyā anyatra hībeva bhavati hrasvaśca vikalpitaḥ |
nṛnarayorvṛddhiśceti | nṛśabdādṛnnebhyo ṅīpi,
naraśabdājjātilakṣaṇe ṅīṣi prāpte vacanam | vṛddhiśceti, vakṣyāmīti
ca anyatarasya grahaṇe'pi nārītīṣṭṃa siddham,
anyatarasyāniṣṭanivṛtyarthaṃ tu dvayorupādānam | tatra
naraśabde'ntyasya vṛddhau satyāṃ yasyetilopādānarthakyamiti yasyeti
lopastāvadbhavati, tatra kṛte rephasya vṛddhiḥ prāpnoti, kā ?
aviśeṣtparyāyeṇa sarvaiva ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; ṭhsthāne'ntaratamaḥ'
ityatrāntaratame sthāne ṣaṣṭhītyapi pakṣo vyākhyātaḥ, tato
nṛnarayoriti yaiṣā ṣaṣṭhī sā vṛddherantaratame nṛnarāvayave
sthāninyanusaṃhriyate | yatra ca ṣaṣṭhī tatrādeśa ityakārasyaiva bhaviṣyati
| atra putraśabdaṃ kecitpaṭhanti, na sa kevalaḥ striyāṃ vartata iti
tadantasya samāsasya grahaṇam | tatrāpi bahuputrā,
atiputtretyādāvanupasarjanādhikārānna bhavati | kva tarhi bhavati ?
putrapradhāne | nanu putrapradhānaṃ samāse saiva puṃlliṅgatā ?
satyam ; ṭhsūtograrājabhojamerubhyo duhituḥ putraḍ vā' iti
vātikakāreṇa yatra putraḍādeśo vihitastānyudāharaṇāni |
sūtaputrī, rājaputrīti---atra svabhāvātputraśabdo duhitṛśabdena
samānārthaḥ, na putraḍādeśa iti paṭhatāmabhiprāyaḥ |
anye tu ṭhpradyotaputrī śailaputrīti vārtikaviṣayādanyadeva ṅīna
udāharaṇam, putraḍādeśastu ṅīpi svarārthaḥ' iti manyante,
nātrāptabhāṣitamasti ||
yaṅścāp || 4|1|74 ||
pakāraḥ ṅyāpprātipadikāt' ityatra sāmānyagrahaṇārthaḥ, svarastu
paratvāccitsvara eva bhavati | ñyaṅaḥ ṣyaṅśca sāmānyagrahaṇamiti |
yadyapi ṣyaṅstriyāmeva vidhīyate, tathāpi
ḍitkaraṇasāmarthyātasyāpyatra grahaṇamiti bhāvaḥ | āmbaṣṭa|letyādi |
ambaṣṭhādibhyo'patye ṭhvṛddhetkosalājādāññyaṅ' |
kārīṣagandhyeti | svādisūtre vyutpāditam | varāhaśabdāt ṭhata
iñ'| śarkarākṣa-pūtimāṣagokakṣaśabdā gargādayaḥ |
nanu ca gaukākṣyaśabdaḥ krauḍa|ladiṣu paṭha|lte, tataḥ ṣyaṅaḥ ṭhyiṅ' ityeva
cāp siddhaḥ ? mā pāṭhi, tatra ṭhṣācca yañaḥ' ityanenaiva
śarkarākṣyādivad gaukākṣyeti siddham | yadyevam,
gaukākṣīputraḥ---ṣyaṅaḥ samprasāraṇaṃ na prāpnoti ? nātra
samprasāraṇamiṣyate, gaukākṣyāputra ityeva bhavati | evaṃ hi saunāgāḥ
paṭhanti---ṭhṣyaṅaḥ samprasāraṇe gaukakṣyāyāḥ pratiṣedhaḥ' ||
taddhitāḥ || 4|1|76 ||
yuvatiriti | taddhitasaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ ṭhkṛtaddhitasamāsāśca' iti
prātipadikasaṃjñā bhavati | bahuvacanamityādi | ṭhpratyayaḥ'
ityādivadekavacana eva kartavye bahuvacanenasaṃjñināṃ
bahutvasūcanādanukto'pi taddhitaḥ parigṛhyata iti manyate |
strīpratyayānāmāditastaddhitādhikāre kriyamāṇe ṭhprācāṃ ṣpha taddhitaḥ'
ityatra taddhitagrahaṇaṃ na kartavyam, ṭhyasyeti ca' ityatra cakāragrahaṇam,
ṭhṅyāpprātipadikāt' ityatra tu tadantātaddhitavidhānārthaṃ
ṅyāvgrahaṇaṃ kartavyameva ? satyam; ṅībādīnāṃ ṅkārasyetsaṃjñā na
syāt, ṭhataddhite' iti pratiṣedhāt | satyāmapi vā paṭvītyādau
ṭhorguṇaḥ' syāt | tasmādyathānyāsamevāstu ||
yūnastiḥ || 4|1|77 ||
yuvatiriti | tyantāt ṭhito manuṣyajāteḥ' iti ṅīṣna bhavati;
tipratyayenaiva strītvasyoktatvāt , yauvanasya vā'jātitvāt ||
aṇiñoranārṣayorgurūpotamayoḥ ṣyaṅ gotre || 4|1|78 ||
iha sambhave vyabhicāre ca sati viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvo bhavati, tena
ṭhgotre' ṭhanārṣayoḥ' iti cāṇiñmātrasya viśeṣaṇam,
ṭhgurūpotamayoḥ' ityetatadantasya, tadāha---gotre yāvaṇiñau
vihitāvanārṣau tadantayoriti | yadyapyapatyādhaikārādanyatra
laukikasya gotrasya grahaṇam, tathāpyatra pāribhāṣikasya grahaṇam ;
laukikagrahaṇasya ṭhanārṣayoḥ' iti paryudāsāśrayaṇenaiva siddhatvāt |
ihāyaṃ ṣyaṅ pratyayo vā syāt ? ādeśo vā ? pratyayavidhāvapi hi
gāpoṣṭak' ityādau ṣaṣṭhīdarśanāt, utaratra ṭhkrauḍa|ladibhyaśca' iti
pañcamīnirdeśācca pratyayapakṣo'pi sambhavatyeva | tatrādyapakṣe
udameghasyāpatyaṃ strī, ṭhata iñ', audameghi iti sthite tadantāt
ṣyaṅ ivihite audameghyāyāśchātrā audameghāśchāttrāḥ,
audameghyānāṃ saṅghaḥ, ṭhiñaśca' ṭhsaṅghāṅkalakṣaṇa' iti ca
iñantādvidhīyamāno'ṇ na syāt | athāpi
liṅgaviśiṣṭaparibhāṣayā iñantādvidhīyamāno'ṇ ṣyaṅntādapi
syāt, evamapi ṭhāpatyasya ca taddhite'nāti' iti yalopo na syāt,
ṣyaṅe'nāpatyatvāt ? naiṣa doḥ ; ṭhbhasyāḍhea taddhite' iti
puṃvadbhāvātprāgevaṇa utpateḥ ṣyaṅnivartate, tasminnivṛte ṭhiñaḥ'
ityaṇbhaviṣyati, yakārasya ca śravaṇaṃna bhaviṣyati | iha tahyāiÇdameghyāyā
upatyam ṭhstrībhyo ḍhak', audamegheya iti yalopo na syāt,
puṃvadbhāvaśca nāsti, ṭhaḍhea' iti pratiṣedhāt ? itīmamādye pakṣe
doṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā dvitīyaṃ pakṣamāśrityāha---ṣyaṅadeśo bhavatīti |
nanvasminpakṣe uḍulomno'patyaṃ strī bāhvādiṣu lomanśabdasya
pāṭhātkevalasyāpatyena yogābhāvātsāmarthyātadantasya grahaṇādiñi
tasya ṣyaṅadeśe sati ṭhye cābhāvakarmaṇoḥ' iti prakṛtibhāvāt
ṭhnastaddhite' iti ṭilopo na syāt, tataścauḍulomanyeti syāt,
auḍulomyeti ceṣyate, pratyayapakṣe iñā vyavadhānānnāsti
prakṛtibhāvaḥ, yasyeti lope'pi kṛte sthānidbhāvādvyavadhānameva
? naiṣa doṣaḥ ; nātrākṛte ṭilope ṣyaṅ prāpnoti, kiṃ kāraṇam ?
agurūpotamatvāt, tasmādiñyeva ṭilopaḥ, tato
gurūpotamatvam, tataḥ ṣyaṅtyānupūrvyātsiddhim | ayaṃ tarhi
doṣaḥ---pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣayā'ṇiñantayorgrahaṇam,
tayorvidhīyamānaḥ ṣyaṅnekāltvātsarvādeśaḥ prāpnoti ? ṭhṅcci'
ityantyasya bhaviṣyati, tātaṅnyāyena sarvādeśaḥ prāpnoti | yatra hi
ṅkārasya prayojanāntaramapi sambhāvyate tatra ṭhṅcci'
ityetadananyārthaṅtveṣvinaṅadiṣu sāvakāśaṃ bādhitvā
ṭhanekālśitsarvasya' ityetadbhavati, yathā tātaṅ | ihi ca
sarvādeśatve'pi ṭhyaṅścāp' iti viśeṣaṇaṃ prayojanaṃ sambhavati,
tasmātsarvādeśaḥ prāpnoti, tatrāha---nirdiśyamānasyetyādi |
yadyayamutamaśabdo vyutpannaḥ syāt, tadocchabdātamapi kṛte
ṭhkimetiṅvyayaghād' ityāmprāpnoti ? na vā dravyaprakarṣatvāt |
ucchabdo hi sasādhanakriyāvacana udgate vartate, tasya kriyādvārakaḥ
prakarṣaḥ---atiśayenodgata iti, tataśca dravyaniṣṭhatvātprakarṣasya
ṭhadravyaprakarṣe' iti pratiṣedho bhaviṣyati | evamapi tamapaḥ
pitvādādyaudātatvaprasaṅgaḥ ? na voñchādiṣu pāṭhāt, uñchādiṣu hi
utamaśaśvatamau sarvatreti paṭha|lte | evamapi sa tāvatpāṭhaḥ katevyaḥ,
kriyāmātrasya ca prakarṣe utamāmityāmprasaṅgaśca,
ato'nabhidānāvucchabdātamapo'nutpattireṣitavyā | kiñcavyutpanna
utamaśabdaścatuṣprabhṛtiṣu vartate, katham ? ūrdhvamuccārita udgataḥ,
sa ca prathamoccāritamapekṣate, tataśca triṣu dvāvudgatau, tayośca
dvitīyo'tiśayenodgataḥ, dvayośca sampradhāraṇāyāṃ tarapā
bhāvyam, tataśca yatrodgatā eva trayastatraiva
syāt---kārīṣagandhyetyādau; vārāhyaetyādau tu na syāt | tadevaṃ
vyutpattipakṣe doṣaṃ paśyannavyutpattipakṣamāśrityāha---utamaśabda iti |
svābhāvāditi | na vyutpattivaśādityaraythaḥ | triprabhṛtīnāmiti
vacanāddākṣī plaakṣītyādau na bhavati |
ṭiḍḍhāṇañiti ṅībeva bhavatīti | prāptimātrābhiprāyeṇedamuktam |
atra hi jātitvāt ṭhśārgaravādyañaḥ' iti ṅīnā bhāvyam |
vāsiṣṭhīti | ṭhṛṣyandhaka' ityādināṇ |
āhicchatrīti | jātādāvarthe'ṇ | evamatrādeśapakṣaḥ sthāpitaḥ |
yadyevam, hastiśiraso'patyam, bāhvāditvādiñ, ṭhaci śīrṣaḥ' iti
śīrṣādeśaḥ, iñaḥ ṣyaṅadeśaḥ, tataḥ sthānivadbhāvena śīrṣaśabdasya
śirograhaṇena grahaṇād ṭhye ca taddhite' iti śīrṣannādeśaḥ prāpnoti
? astu; ṭhnastaddhite' iti ṭilopo bhaviṣyati | ṭhye cābhāvakarmaṇoḥ'
iti prakṛtibhāvaḥ prāpnoti, tataśca hāstiśīrṣaṇyeti syāt,
pratyayapakṣe tviñā'vyavahitatvānnāsti śīrṣannādeśaḥ, yasyeti
lope'pi kṛte sthānivadbhāvādvyavadhānameva, tena hāstiśīrṣeti
siddhyati, tasmātpratyayapakṣa āśraṇīyaḥ | tadetad ṭhye ca taddhite'
ityatra vāmano vakṣyati---ṭhyadi pratyayaḥ, kathamaudamegheya iti,
āpatyādvihitaḥ ṣyaṅ so'pyāpatya eva, tatra yalope siddham' iti |
jayādityastu mene---śīrṣādeśasannipātena ṣyaṅ, sa tadvighātaṃ na
kariṣyatīti | yadyevam, ajādipratyayanibandhaḥ śīrṣādeśaḥ kathaṃ
tamajādi vihanyāt ? tataḥ kim ? ṣyaṅadeśo'pi na prāpnoti,
anityā sannipātaparibhāṣā, tena ṣyaṅ bhavati, śīrṣādeśaśca na
bhaviṣyati | ayaṃ tarhyādeśapakṣe doṣaḥ---anubandhau kartavyau
yaṅścābiti sāmānyagrahaṇatadavighātārthau, anyathā'ṇādeśe ṣyaiṅ
ṭhṭiḍḍhāṇañ' ityādinā ṅīpsyāt, iñādeśe tu ṭhiña
upasaṅkhyānam' iti ṅīṣprasaṅgaḥ ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; ṭhṭiḍḍhāṇañ'
ityatrāta iti vartate, tatra cāṇā'kāro viśeṣyate---aṇyo'kāra iti |
tatra ṣyaṅadeśe ṭhanalvidhau' iti sthānivadbhāvābhāvānṅībna
bhaviṣyati | aṇantādakārāntāditi hi vijñāyamāne
svāśrayamakārāntatvaṃ sthānivadbhāvādaṇantatvaṃ ceti syānṅīpaḥ
prasaṅgaḥ | ṭhiña upasaṅkhyānam' ityatrāpi ṭhito manuṣyajāteḥ' ityata
ṭhitaḥ' ityapekṣyate---iñya ikāraḥ tadantāditi |
iñantādikārāntāditi vā vijñāyamāne ṣyaṅadeśe sati
vārāhyaetyādivikārābhāvānḍīṣabhāvaḥ siddhaḥ | evamapi
svarārthaścābeṣṭavyaḥ, anyathā iñādeśaḥ ṣyaṅ sthānivadbhāvena
ñit, ṭābapi pitvādanudāta iti ñitsvareṇādyaudātaṃ padaṃ syāt |
syādetat---iño ñakārasyetsaṃjñāyāḥ prāgeva
pratipadavidhānātṣyaṅadeśaḥ kāriṣyate, tatra ñitsvarābhāvāt
pratyayasvare sati ṭāpyapi siddhaḥ svara iti, yathaiva tarhi ñitsvaro na
bhavati evaṃ vṛddhirapi na syād, ato ñakārasya
satyāmitsaṃjñāyāmādeśa ityāstheyam, tataśca svare
doṣaprasaṅgāccābarthamanubandhau kartavyāveva | pratyayapakṣe tu sati
śiṣṭe ṣyaṅaḥ pratyayasvare kṛte tadantādāpi siddhamiṣṭam, na
rūpabhedo na svarabhedaḥ | nanu ca ṣyaṇèóva strītvasya dyotitatvādābna
syāt ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; yathā gārgyāyaṇītyādau dvābhyāṃ strītvaṃ
dyotyate, tathā'trāpi dvayoreva sāmarthyamiti ṭābapi bhaviṣyati |
ṭhṣyaṅaḥ samprasāraṇam' ityatra viśeṣaṇārthaṃ tarhi tvayāpyanubandhau
kartavyau, iha mā bhūt---pāśānāṃ samūhaḥ pāśyā, ṭhpāśādibhyoyaḥ',
pāśyāpatiriti ? evaṃ tarhyeko'nubandhaḥ kariṣyate, ka evaḥ ? ṣakīre
ṅīṣprasaṅgaḥ | ṅkāre ṭhyaṅaḥ samprasāraṇam' ityucyamāne
lolūyāputra ityatrāpi prāpnoti ? apratyayādityakāre'to lope ca
sati akāreṇa vyavahitatvānna bhaviṣyati | vārāhīputra ityatrāapi
tarhi ṭāpā vyavadhānam ? ekādeśasya pūrvaṃ pratyantavatvānnāsti
vyavadhānam | nanu ṭh,ṣyaṅaḥ samprasāraṇam' ityatra ṭhliṭi dhātoḥ'
ityatodhātugrahaṇamanuvartate, ṭhādeca upadeśe'śiti' ityātvaṃ
dhātoryathā syād, gobhyāmityādau mā bhūdityevamartham | tatra
yaḍantasya dhātoḥ putrapatyoranantarayoḥ samprasāraṇaṃ bhavatītyukte
yo dhāturlolūyādirnāsāvanantaraḥ, yaścānantaro vārāhyādirna sa
dhātuḥ, tatra dhātutvānantaryayoranyatararūpaparityāgena
bhavatsamprasāraṇaṃ yathā vārāhīputra ityādau asatyapi dātutve
ānantaryamātrāśrayaṇena bhavati, tathā lolūyāputra
ityatrāsatyapyānantarye dhātutvāśrayaṇena syāt |
atha brūyāḥ---yaṅdhātvorna paraspareṇa viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaḥ, api
tarhi samuccayaḥ---putrapatyoranantarasya yaṅe dhātośceti ? tatra
vārāhīputra ityādau bhaviṣyati, na tu lolūyāpatirityādau;
dhātorvyavadhānāt | tataśca
sāmarthyāddhātugrahaṇasyotarārthaivānuvṛttiḥ sampadyata iti | yadyevam,
vākpatirityatra vaceḥ samprasāraṇaprasaṅgaḥ ? evaṃ tarhi dhātoriti
nivartiṣyate, ātvaṃ punargavādeḥ prātipadikasya na bhavati;
upadeśobhāvāt | svarūpajñāpanapradhāno nirdeśauupadeśaḥ |
ṭhgodvyacaḥ', ṭhnaudvyacaḥ' ityādo tu kāryāntarārthamuccāraṇam,
na svarūpajñāpanārtham | tadevaṃ pratyayapakṣa eka evānubandhaḥ kartavyaḥ |
atra saṃgrahaślokāḥ---
puṃvadbhāvādyajātau yalugaṇapi parasmin ṣyaṅ hyiaidameghe 
svārthe ṣyaṅ tadyalugḍhea kramata iha bhavedauḍulomyā parasmin |
ṣyaṅśīrṣādhīnalābhastadabhivihataye na prabhūrhāsti śīrṣye
sarvādeśo'pi tātaṅṅvi na yaṅṇiñoḥ sthāninoruktihetoḥ ||
stryuktāvapyāpparasminniha sulabha iti ṣṅai vidheyau na vā ye-
'ṇādeśe ṅīnivṛtyai tvaṇa iña iti ced dvau viśeṣyau na doṣaḥ |
ñitvādāderudātaḥ prasajati sahajādeśane vṛddhyabhāvaḥ 
pāśyāputtre nivṛtyai yaṇa ika iha ṣitvekake ṅīṣyaṅestu ||
lolūyāputra ityadvyavahita itaratrāpi dīrghā'ntavatsyād 
dhātvānantaryayoge vidhiriti sa yathānantare'dhau tathā dhoḥ |
dhātvānantaryayoścenmitha iha na hi te'pekṣitā vākpatāvik
dhornātrādhikriyātve hyupadiśiriti gorno tadevaṃ mamaikaḥ ||
gotrāvayavāt || 4|1|79 ||
gotraśabdo'yamasti pāribhāṣikaḥ ṭhapatyaṃ pautraprabhṛti gotram'
iti, asti ca laukiko'patyamātravacanaḥ, asti ca vyutpannaḥ---gūyante
śabdyante'nena svasantānaprabhavā iti pradhānabhūta ādipuruṣaḥ,
svaprabhavasyāpatyaṃ santānasya saṃjñākārī gotramityucyate,
yathā---bharataḥ, raghuḥ, yaduriti | avayavaśabdo'pyasti ekadeśe
yatsambandhādavayavatīti samudāya ucyate; asti ca pṛthagbhāve,
avayutyānuvāda ityādāvavapūrvasya yauteḥ pṛthagbhāve'pi
darśanāt; asti cāpradhāne---avayavabhūto'yamasmin grāma iti | tatra
pāribhāṣike gotre ekadeśe cāvayave ca vacanamanarthakamidaṃ syāt,
katham ? pautraprabhṛtyapatyasamudāyo gotraṃ
tadavayavaścaturthādistadapi gotrameva, tadvācino'ṇiñantātpūrveṇaiva
siddhaḥ ṣyaṅ | atha kasmiścinmahāgotre yānyavāntaragotrāṇi,
yathā---bhārgavagotrasya cyavanādīni, te
gotrāvayavāsteṣvagurūpotamārtho'yamārambhaḥ | yadyevam,
saptarṣīṇāmagastyāṣṭamānāmaṣṭau mahāgotrāṇi pravarādhyāye paṃṭha|lnte
tadvyatiriktebhyaḥ sarvebhyaḥ ṣyaṅaḥ prasaṅgaḥ; na caitadiṣṭam,
agurūpotamebhyo'pi puṇikādibhya eveṣyate | pṛthagbhāvavacane
tvavayavaśabde gotrādanyavācino'ṇiñantaatṣyaṅ ividhīyamāne
pūrvasūtre gotragrahaṇamanarthakam | athāpradhānavacano'vayavaśabdaḥ,
pāribhāṣikameva gotraṃ pravarādhyāye pāṭhāccāprādhānyam,
tato'yamarthaḥ syāt---ye'ṇiñantā gotrāpatyavācinaḥ pravarādhyāye na
paṭha|lnte tebhyaḥ ṣyaṅiti | tatrānṛṣibhyo gurūpotamebhyaḥ pūrveṇaiva
siddhaḥ, agurūpotamebhyastu saṃjñākāribhya eveṣyate, pāribhāṣike ca
gotre saṃjñākāritvaṃ viśeṣo na labhyata iti | ihāpi
prasajyeta---tuṣajako nāma kaścitasya gotraṃ strī ṭhata iñ'
tauṣajakī, apatyamātre tu gotre
yadyekadeśo'vayavastato'patyasamudāyasya pautraprabhṛtyapatyamavayava
iti tadvācino'ṇiñantātpūrveṇaiva siddhaḥ | pṛthagbhāve
tvapatyādanyavācina āhicchatrādereva prasaṅgaḥ | apradhāne
tvapradhānāpatyavācino'ṇiñantād gurūpotamānna sarvatreṣyate,
kintu saṃjñākāribhyaḥ, tatrāpi gotre | vyutpanne gotre
ekadeśavacano'vayavaśabdo na sambhavati, na hi yena puruṣeṇa
svasantānaprabhavā gūyante tadavayavāddhastapādādergotre'ṇiño'sambhavaḥ
| atha gotraṃ ca tadavayavaśceti karmadhārayastadā bhārgavādigotreṣu
ye'vāntaravyapadeśakāriṇaścyavanādayastebhyaḥ prasaṅgaḥ | pṛthagbhāve
ca ye saṃjñākaaribhyaḥ pṛthagbhūtāstuṣajakādayastebhya eva syāt | ata
evameṣu pakṣeṣu doṣasambhavādvyutpanno gotraśabdaḥ,
apradhānāvacano'vayavaśabdaḥ, karmadhārayaścasamāsaḥ |
nipātanādviśeṣaṇasya paranipātaḥ, pravarādhyāye'pāṭhāccāprādhānyam |
tadetadāha---gotrāvayavā gotrābhimatā iti |
gotramityevamabhimatāḥ, gotrābhidhāyina ityeva loke prasiddhāḥ, na
punaḥ pravarādhyāye paṭhitā ityarthaḥ | kāḥ punastā ityatrāha---kulākhyā
iti | kulamākhyāyate ābhiriti kulākhyāḥ, puṇikādibhirhi
kulamākhyāyate---puṇikāvayaṃgotreṇetyevamādi | tata iti |
tathoktaviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭābhyaḥ kulākhyābhyaḥ | agurūpotamārtha ārambha
iti | ṭhgurūpotamayoḥ' iti nivṛtam, anyatsarvamanuvartata iti
bhāvaḥ | pauṇikyetyādiḥ | puṇika-bhuṇika-mukharaśabdebhyaḥ ṭhata iñ',
tasya ṣyaṅadeśaḥ | te krauḍa|ladiṣu draṣṭavyā iti |
avṛtkṛtatvātasyeti bhāvaḥ ||
krauḍa|ladibhyaśca || 4|1|80 ||
ṣyaṅ pratyayo bhavatīti | krauḍa|ladibhya iti
pañcamīnirdeśātpratyayapakṣe'pyatra doṣābhāvāccaivamuktam |
agurūpotamārtha ityādi | tatra kroḍa|ladayaḥ prākcopayataśabdādata
iñantāḥ, caupayataprabhṛtayaḥ prāg saudhātakiśabdādaṇantāḥ,
saudhātakiśabdaḥ ṭhsudhāturakaṅca' iti iñantaḥ | sūta yuvatyāmiti |
sūtaśabdaḥ ṣyaṅmutpādayati yuvatyāṃ
prāptayauvanāyāmabhidheyāyām---sūtyā, anyatra kriyāśabdāṭṭāb
bhavati---sūtā, jātivācinastu ṅīṣ bhavati---sūtī | bhoja
kṣatriye iti | jātilakṣaṇasya ṅīṣo'pavādaḥ---bhojyā, kriyāśabdātu
ṭābeva bhavati---bhojayatīti bhojā, tataḥ pare iñantāḥ |
gaukakṣyaśabdo gargādiyañantaḥ ||
daivayajñiśaucivṛkṣisātyamugrikāṇṭhevidbhibhyo'nyatarasyām ||
4|1|81 ||
devā yajñā yaṣṭavyā asya devayajñaḥ, śucirvṛkṣo'sya śucivṛkṣaḥ,
satyamugramasya satyamugraḥ, nipātanādviśeṣyasya pūrvanipāto
mumāgamaśca, kaṇṭhe viddhamasya kaṇṭhe viddhamasya kaṇṭhe vā viddhaḥ,
ṭhamūrddhamastakāt' ityaluk | kāṇḍevidbhibhya ityanye paṭhanti,
kāṇḍena viddhaḥ, ṭhkartṛkaraṇe kṛtā bahulam' iti samāsaḥ,
nipātanātkāṇḍaśabdasyaikāraḥ | sarve iñantāḥ ||
samarthānāṃ prathamādvā || 4|1|82 ||
pratyekamatra padānāṃ svaritatvaṃ pratijñāyate, na
samudāyasyaikamityāha---trayamapīti | atra ca prayojanam---ekasya
nivṛtāvaparasya nivṛttirmā bhūditi | etadeva
spaṣṭayati---samarthānāmiti ceti | svāthiṃkapratyayāvadhiścāyamiti |
svasyāḥ prakṛterarthe bhavāḥ svārthikāḥ, adhyātmādiḥ,
bhāṣyakāraprayogād dvārādikāryābhāvaḥ, svaśabdasya tu dvārādiṣu
pāṭhādasti prasaṅgaḥ | tadādividhirhi tatra bhavati;
ādyajviśeṣaṇatvād dvārādīnām, yathā---dvārapālasyedaṃ
dauvārapālamiti | prāgdiśo vibhaktiriti yāvaditi | tata ārabhya
hi svārthikāḥ pratyayā vidhīyante, kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ svārthikeṣveṣa na
pravartate ? ityāha---svārthikeṣvityādi | tatra samarthānāmiti
sambaddhārthānāṃ cetyarthaḥ | tatra vākye sambaddhārthatā, vyapekṣā hi tatra
sāmarthyam, apekṣā ākāṅkṣā, anyo'nyāpekṣāuvyapekṣā |
anayā''kāṅkṣāsannidhiyogyatveṣu satsu yaḥ sambandhaḥ sa lakṣyate |
vṛtau saṃsṛṣṭārthatā | ekārthībhāvo hi tatra sāmarthyam | vṛtau
hyupasarjanapadāni svārthamupasarjanīkṛtya pradhānārthaparāṇi bhavanti,
yathā---gaṅgāyāṃ goṣa iti gaṅgopasarjanaṃ tīramāha | tathaupagava
ityatropaguśabdaḥ khārthopasarjanamapatyamāha | ata eva ṛddhasyaupagava
iti ṛddhatvamupagoviṃśeṣaṇaṃ na bhavati | yatra hi śabdaḥ payavasyati
tatraiva viśeṣaṇasambandhaḥ | yadi ca vākyavad vṛtāvapi khārtha eva
paryavasyetadvadeva viśeṣaṇasambandho bhavet,
pradhānapadānyapyupasarjanaviśiṣṭameva khārthaṃ bruvate | yadi tu
vākyavad vṛtāvapi pradhānapadāni svārthameva bruvīran tato
yathopagorapatyaṃ devadataḥ kalyāṇaścetyubhābhyāmapatyārthasya
sambandhaḥ, tathaupagavaḥ kalyāṇaścetyapyuktesyāt, na caivam | ato
yādṛśasya sambandhasya bhāvādayaṃ viśeṣaḥ sa ekārthībhāvaḥ | na ca
svārthikeṣu prakṛtyarthādarthāntaraṃ sambhavati yatpratyāyanāya śabdantaraṃ
prayujyeta, yena saha samarthatā syāt | etena prāthamyaṃ vyākhyātam |
ataḥ pratiyogyapekṣayā sāmathyeprāthamyayorabhāvātsvāthikeṣu
nāsyopayoga iti siddham | vikalpo'pi tatrānavasthita iti |
kvacitpravartate | etaccāṣaḍakṣādisūtre vakṣyate | iha ṭhprathamāt'
ityetadviśeṣaṇaṃ śāstravākyagatamāśrīyate, na vigrahavākyagatam;
aniyatatvāt | vākye hi prayogo'niyata iti sarveṣāṃ
prāthamyasambhavāt | kadācidapatyavadvācino'patye pratyayaḥ syāt,
kadācidapatyavācinastadvati | ayaṃ ca prakāro'satyapi ṭhprathamāt'
ityasmillabhyata ityanarthakaṃ tatsyāt |
nanu ca yasminvākye yatprathamoccāritaṃ tasmistata eva yathā syāt,
caramoccāritānmā bhūdityetatprayojanaṃ syāt ? tanna; na hi
vṛttivākyayoḥ sahaprayogaḥ, tataśca vākyagate prāthamye vyavasthāpake
sati vṛteḥ prayogo na niyata iti vyarthameva ṭhprathamāt' iti
viśeṣaṇaṃ syāt, tasmācchāstravākyagatameva prāthamyaṃ
vyavasthāpakamityāha---lakṣaṇavākyānītyādi |
samarthānāmiti nirdharaṇe ṣaṣṭhīti | tataśca nirdhāraṇasya
tulyajātīyaviṣayatvātprathamātsamarthātpratyayo bhavati, tatra
ṭhsamarthāt prathamāt' iti vaktavye ṭhsamarthānāṃ prathamāt' iti
vacanaṃ pradhānapadasyāpyupasarjanapadenaikārthībhāvapratipādanārtham;
anyathā vākyavad vṛtādapi pradhānapadasyānyenāpi sambandhaḥ
śaṅkyeta | yadi tarhi lakṣaṇavākye prathamoccāritātpratyayaḥ, evaṃ sati
ṭhtasyāpatyam' ityādau sarvanāma prathamanirdiṣṭamiti tata eva pratyayaḥ
syāt, nopagvādeḥ, na hi tallakṣaṇavākye prathamanirdiṣṭamityata
āha---tasyeti | sāmānyamityādi viśeṣalakṣaṇam,
viśeṣoṣalakṣaṇamityarthaḥ | ṭhtasmāpatyam' ityādau hi viśeṣā eva
nirdeaṣṭuamiṣṭāḥ, teṣāṃ tu sarveṣāṃ pratyakamupādāne gauravaṃ
syād, ekasyopādāne'nupātādviśeṣāntarānna syād,
yathā---adbhiḥ saṃskṛtamityādāviti sarveṣāmupalakṣaṇatvena
tasyetyādikamupātam | tasyopagvāderiti | na tu svayaṃ
kāryitayā, na hi tasyetyasya sāmānyavacanasya prakaraṇādyabhāvena
viśeṣe'navasthitasyāpatyaṃ prati sambandhiviśeṣapratipādanena
sagbandhyantaravyavacchedākhya upakāraḥ sambhavati |
sambandhisāmānyaṃtvapatyaśabdasya sambandhaśibdatvādevāvagatam, ato
yatsūtre sākṣātprathamoccāritaṃ sāmānyavāci na tasmātpratyayaḥ,
yasmācca pratyayo na tatsūtre sākṣātprathamoccāritamiti agatyā
upalakṣaṇagataṃ prāthamyamupalakṣyāṇāṃ vijñāyate | tadāha---tadīyaṃ
prāthamyaṃ viśeṣaṇāṃ vijñāyata iti | 
kambala upagorityādi | yathāpatyaśabdasya pūrvaparābhyāṃ
yatheṣṭamabhisambandho bhavati, evamaṇo'pi sambhāvyeteti bhāvaḥ | atra ca
pratyaye satyanarthakasyāpi samudāyasya taddhitāntatvena
prātipadikasaṃjñāyāmekatvādyabhāve'pi avyayebhya iva svādayaḥ syuḥ |
nanu ṭhtasyāpatyam' iti śrūyamāṇasambandhyapekṣāyāṃ vibhaktau
vijñāyamānāyāṃ nātra prasaṅgaḥ ? naitadevam; na hi lakṣaṇavākye
vibhaktyuccāraṇam, sambandhapratipādanārthasāmānyasya
sambandhāsambhavāt, kiṃ tarhi ? ṣaṣṭha|lntātpratyayavidhyartham | tathāpi
viśeṣopalakṣaṇadvāreṇa sambandhaḥ syād ? evamapi
ṛddhasyopagorapatyamityādau sāpekṣādapi syādeva |
samarthaparibhāṣayā tarhi vyavasthā bhaviṣyati ? syādeva
yadyetasmātsūtrātprāgeva subantātaddhitā iti vyavasthitaṃ syāt | iha
tu ṅyāpprātipadikādhikārāt ṣaṣṭha|ladivibhaktyarthavṛtestata eva
taddhitāḥ syuḥ | sati
tvasminsambandhapratipatervibhaktyāyatatvātsubantādeva taddhitā bhavanti,
na caivaṃ sati padakāryaprasaṅgaḥ | tathā hi---rājanye vārtraghna
ityādau bhasaṃjñayopajātayā luptavibhaktyāśrayāpi padasaṃjñā
ekasaṃjñādhikārād bādhiṣyate | rājatvaṃ rājatetyādau tu
prātipadikādapyutpatau ṭhsvādiṣu' iti padasaṃjñā bhavatyeva | nanu
taddhitaluki sarvanāmasthāne doṣaḥ, kāśyapena proktamadhīyate
ṭhkāśyapakauśikābhyāmṛṣibhyāṃ ṇiniḥ', ṭhcchandobrāhmaṇāni' iti
tadviṣayatāyām | ṭhtadadhīte tadveda' iti
dvitīyāntātkāśyapinśabdādutpannasyāṇaḥ proktālluki yadyapi kāśyapina
ityādau bhasaṃjñāyā luptavibhaktinimitayā api padasaṃjñāyā
bādhādadoṣaḥ, kāśyapibhyāmityādau tu bhavatyeva padasaṃjñā; tathāpi
kāśyapanau, kāśyapina ityādau sarvanāmasthāne bhasaṃjñāyā
abhāvālluptāmantarvartinīṃ vibhaktimāśritya padasaṃjñā syāt | na
cāsarvanāmasthāna iti pratiṣedhaḥ, kiṃ kāraṇam ? svādiṣviti yā
prāptistasyā eva saniṣedhaḥ | evaṃ tarhi ṭhasarvanāmasthāne' iti
vibhajyate, prasajyapratiṣedhaścāśrīyate, tatsāmarthyād ṭhanantarasya
vidhirvā' ityetannāśrīyate, tena sarvanāmasthāne parataḥ
pūrvasyāvadheryā ca yāvatī padasaṃjñā svādiṣviti vā subantamiti
vā sā sarvā pratiṣetsyate | yadyevam, rājā daṇḍītyādau sāvapi na
syāt, ṭhyaccibham' ityato'cītyetadasarvanāmasthāne ityatrāpekṣyate,
tenājādāveva sarvanāmasthāne sarvā padasaṃjñā niṣetsyate ? sau
halādau svādiṣviṃti vā subantamiti vā bhaviṣyatītyadoṣaḥ |
tadevaṃ satyasmin vacane subantātaddhite na kaściddoṣa iti sthitam
|
ata eva pūrvāhṇetarāṃ pūrvāhṇetamāmityādau ṭhghakālataneṣu'
ityaluk vidhāsyate | nanu satyapyasmin
svārthikeṣvasyāvyāpārātkathaṃ subantātarap syāt ? evaṃ tarhyarthakrama
evāyamīdṛśo yaduta pūrvaṃ vibhaktyā yogaḥ, paścātarapā | uktaṃ hi
priyakutsanādiṣu tataḥ pravartate'sau vibhaktyanta iti | evaṃ ca
kṛtvā'lugvidhānamapyupadyate | yadi tu tadevālugvidhānaṃ jñāpakam,
tasyāpatyamityādau na vibhaktyarthamātre tātparyam, kintu
ṣaṣṭha|ladivibhaktyantā evopalakṣayitumiṣṭāḥ |
ṅyāpprātipadikādhikārastu vṛddhādiviśeṣaṇtvenaivopayujyata
iti, tathā sati padavidhitvāt samarthaparibhāṣayaiva vyavasthā
siddhyati | kiñci---anabhidhānādasāmarthyena bhaviṣyati, nārthaḥ
samarthavacanena |
idaṃ tarhi prayojanam---yadarthābhidhānasamarthaṃ tasmādyathāsyāt | kiṃ
punastat ? kṛtavarṇāanupūrvīkaṃ padam---sautthitiḥ,
vaikṣamāṇiriti, atra savarṇadīrghatve kṛte pratyayo bhavati, suautthita
viaiikṣamāṇa---ityasyāmavasthāyāṃ na bhavati | yadi syāt,
sāvutthitiḥ vāyīkṣamāṇiriti prāpnoti, ṭhvārṇadāṅgaṃ balīyaḥ'
iti vṛddhiprasaṅgāt | nanvantaraṅgatvādvārṇeṣu kṛteṣu pratyayo
bhaviṣyati ? evaṃ tarhyetadarthaṃ samarthavacanaṃ kurvannetajjñāpayati---astīyaṃ
paribhāṣā ṭhakṛtavyūhāḥ pāṇinīyāḥ' kṛtamapi śāstraṃ nivartayantīti
| vyūhaḥuśāstrakāryam, tadantaraṅgatvātprāptamapi paścādasya
nimitavighāto bhaviṣyatīti buddhyā na kṛtaṃ yaiste'kṛtavyūhāḥ,
evaṃbhūtā bhavanti pāṇinīyā ityarthaḥ | kṛtamapītyatra
vāśabdo'dhyāhāryaḥ, kṛmapi vā śāstrakāryaṃ nivartayanti nimitābhāva
utpatsyamāne ityarthaḥ | tena papuṣa ityādi siddhaṃ bhavati |
atrāntaraṅgatvātpūrvakṛto'pīḍāgama etatparibhāṣāvaśānnivartate,
pūrvameva vāna kriyate, tataḥ śasi samprasāraṇe kṛte
valāditvādiḍabhāvaḥ | prathamāntāditi |
prathamānirdiṣṭādapatyaviśeṣavācino devadatādiśabdādityarthaḥ |
anyathā ṭhsāsya devatā' iti yathā indro devatāsya aindraḥ sthālīpāka
iti prathamāntāt ṣaṣṭha|lrthe pratyayo bhavati, evamihāpi
syāt---devadato'patyamasya daivadatirupaguriti |
vāgrahaṇaṃ kimiti |
vṛttivākyayorvyapekṣaikārthībhāvalakṣaṇādarthabhedādeva
bādhyabādhakabhāvo na bhaviṣyatīti praśnaḥ | vākyamapi yathā syāditi |
tadyathā gośabdena gāvīśabdo nivartate satyāmapi strītvapratipatau,
tathehāpyaupagavamānayetyukte ya evānīyate ṭhupagorapatyamānaya'
ityukte sa eveti pradhānārthabhedād vṛtyā vākyaṃ bādhyeteti bhāvaḥ
| yadyevaṃ samāsavṛttistaddhitavṛtyā bādhyeteti | ṭhyatrotsargāpavādau
vibhāṣā tatrāpavādena mukte utsargo na pravartate' iti rājño'nantaro
rājānantara ityādiṣu sāvakāśā samāsavṛttistaddhitavṛtyā bādhyeta,
yathā---dākṣirityaṇ pratyaya iñeti bhāvaḥ | etadapīti |
samāsavṛtyākhyaṃ kāryamityarthaḥ ||
prāgdīvyato'ṇ || 4|1|83 ||
tena dīvyatīti vakṣyatīti | yadi tasyedamanukaraṇaṃ prāgdīvyateriti
vaktavyam, kathaṃ prāgdīvyata iti nirdeśaḥ ? ata āha---tadekadeśa iti |
bhavati hi samudāyaguṇībhūtasyāpyekadeśasya pṛthakkṛtyānukaraṇam,
yathā---asyavāmīyamityatreti bhāvaḥ | ṭhpratyayaḥ'
ityādivadaṇityevādhikāre sati ṭhata iñ' ityādināpavādaprakaraṇena
vicchinnasyāṇaḥ ṭhtena raktaṃ rāgāt' ityādiṣvartheṣūpasthānaṃ na
syāt | tasmādadhikāraparimāṇakhyāpanārthaṃ prāgdīvyaṃta ityuktam |
triṣvapi darśaneṣvityādi | nanvadhikārapakṣe'pi
pratiyogamupasthānādata iñ aṇvetyaṇapi prāpnoti,
paribhāṣāpakṣe'pi prāgdīvyatīyāḥ prakṛtayastābhyaḥ sarvābhyo'ṇ
paribhāṣyamāṇaḥ kenāpavādaviṣaye na syāt, evaṃ vidhipakṣe'pi
sarvatra prasaṅgaḥ ? evaṃ manyate---yadayaṃ ṭhpīlāyā vā' iti
sūtramārabhate, tad jñāpayati---nāpavādaviṣaye'ṇ bhavatīti;
anyathā ṭhdvayacaḥ' iti ḍhak siddhaḥ, anena cāṇityanarthakaṃ tatsyāditi |
ṭhudaśvito'nyatarasyām' iti vikalpavacanamapyasminnarthe liṅgam |
vayaṃ tu brūmaḥ---ṭhprāgdīvyataḥ' iti nedaṃ dīvyatītiśabdaikadeśasya
dīvyacchabdasyānukaraṇam, kiṃ tarhi ? tatratyo'rtho
nirdiśyate---dīvyato'rthātprāgiti | tatra diverlaṭi
kṛte'rthādityanena gamyamānārthatvādaprayuktenāpyaprathamāntena
sāmānādhikaraṇyāllaṭaḥ śatrādeśaḥ kṛtaḥ |
tatrāvadherarthatvādavadhimanto'pyarthā eva pratīyante,
sajātīyaviṣayatvena prasiddhataratvādavadhyavadhimadbhāvasya, tataśca
prāgdīvyato ye'rthāsteṣvevāsya triṣvapi pakṣeṣu vyāpāraḥ | tatra
samāne'rthe prakṛtiviśeṣādutpadyamāno'pavādo'ṇaṃ bādhata iti
siddhamiṣṭam ||
aśvapatyādibhyaśca || 4|1|84 ||
prāgdīvyatīyeṣviti | ṭhapaparibarirañcavaḥ pañcamyā'
ityavyayībhāvādbhavārthe ṭhvṛddhācchaḥ' | ṭhavyayānāṃ bhamātre' iti
ṭilopo na bhavati; ṭhluṅmukhasvaropacārāḥ' iti parigaṇanāt |
ata evāvyayātayabapi na bhavati, ṭhamehakvatasitrebhyaḥ' iti
parigaṇanādvā | gaṇapatiśabdasyātra pāṭhādgāṇapatyo mantra ityapaśabdaḥ
| etena kṣaitrapatyaṃ vyākyātam | ṭhkṣaitrapatyaṃ caru nirvapet' iti tu
chāndasam | kṣaitrapatyaṃ prāśnantīti, chandovadṛṣayaḥ kurvanti ||
dityadityādityapatyutarapadāṇṇyaḥ || 4|1|85 ||
patiśabdasyotarapadaśabdena bahuvrīhau kṛte paścād dvandvaḥ, na tu
dvandvasyotarapadaśabdena bahuvrīhirityāha---patyutarapadācceti |
etacca pratyāsatervyākhyānādvā labhyate | aditigrahaṇaṃ tu
tadutarapadaparigrahārthaṃ syāt, na hyadityutarapadaṃ dityutarapadaṃ
bhavati | patyantāditi noktam, bahucpūrvānmā bhūditi |
vāḍamatipitṛmatāmiti | kurvādiṣu matiputṛmacchabdayoḥ
pāṭho'patyārtho bhāṣāyāmapi ṇyo yathā syāditi | anena tu cchandasi
sarveṣveva prāgdīvyatīyeṣu ṇyavidhiḥ | kecidvākśabdamapi tatraiva
paṭhanti, tena ṭhyānā vācyā ete vatsāḥ' iti prayogopapatiḥ |
yamācceti | yamaśabdo'pi sūtre paṭhitavya ityarthaḥ |
pṛthivyā ñāñāviti | ñāñoḥ striyāṃ viśeṣa ityāha---pāthivā,
pārthivīti | 
sthāmna iti | balavacano'yam | tasya kevalasya yadyapyapatyena yogo
nāsti, jātādinā tu yogaḥ sambhavatyeva | sarveṣu ca
prāgdīvyatīyeṣvayaṃ vidhiḥ, tasmādaśvatthāma iti bhāṣyodāharaṇādatra
tadantavidhirbhavati | aśvatthāma iti | aśvasyevra sthāma yasyeti
bahuvrīhau akāraṣṭilopaḥ, pṛṣodarāditvātsakārasya takāraḥ |
lomno'patye bahuṣviti | bāhvādiṣvayaṃ paṭha|lta itīñi prāpte
bahuṣvakāraḥ, kevalasyāpatyāanāyogātsamarthyātadantavidhiḥ |
uḍulomā iti | uḍūanīva lomānyasya, śarā iva lomānyasyeti
bahuvrīhiḥ | nanu bāhvādilakṣaṇe iñyapi kṛte tasya bahvaca iti
luki subantādiñutpanna iti pratyayalakṣaṇena ṭhsubantaṃ padam' iti
padasaṃjñāyāṃ nalopena siddham ? siddhyatu nāmedam ; uḍulomebhya
ityevamādau subvidhau nalopasyāsiddhatvādaisādirna syāt, iño
lugapi prācyabharatagotrādanyatra na sidhyati, na vātra padasaṃjñā,
ṭhasarvanāmasthāne' iti niṣedhāt | yathā ca pratyayalakṣaṇena prāptāyāḥ
subantamityasyā api padasaṃjñāyāḥ sa niṣedhastathoktaṃ purastāt |
sarvatreti | nāpatya eva | yadvā prāgdīvyatīye'nyatra ca, tena gavā
caratītyatrāpi gavya iti bhavati | gorūpyamiti |
ṭhhetumanuṣyebhyo'nyatarasyāṃ rūpyaḥ', ṭhmayaḍ ca' iti rūpyamayaṭau |
ṇyādaya iti | yena nāprāptinyāyenāṇa eva ṇyādayo'pavādāḥ,
amāpavādaistu ḍhagādibhiḥ saha sampradhārāṇāyāṃ paratvāta eva syuriti
vārtikārambhaḥ | arthaviśeṣo'patyādilakṣaṇaṃ nimitaṃ yasya
so'rthaviśeṣalakṣaṇaḥ | yastu tasvedamityarthasāmānyalakṣaṇo'ṇapavādaḥ
sa paratvādbhavati, uṣṭrapatirnāma patraṃ tasyedamauṣṭrapatam
ṭhtatrādhvaryupariṣadaśca' ityañ bhavati, na tu ṇyaḥ | diterapatyamiti
| atra ṭhitaścāniñaḥ' iti ḍhagna bhavati, ḍauleya ityādāveva tu bhavati |
vānaspatyamiti | acitādilakṣaṇaṣṭhagna bhavati, āpūpikādāveva tu
bhavati |
kathaṃ daiteya iti | atra tarhīti | gamyamānatvānna prayuktam | yadi
ṇyādayo'rthaviśeṣalakṣaṇādaṇapavādātpūrvavipratiṣedhena bhavanti,
kathaṃ tarhi daitaiyaḥ sidhyatītyarthaḥ | ditiśabdādityādi | nanu
ṭhprātipadikagrahaṇe liṅgaviśiṣṭasyāpi grahaṇam' iti ṅīṣantādapi
ṇya eva prāpnoti ? tatrāha---liṅgaviśiṣṭaparibhāṣā cānityeti |
anye tu bhāṣvārtikayoranuktatvād daiteya ityasādhuriti sthitāḥ ||
utsādibhyo'ñ || 4|1|86 ||
tadapavādānāṃ ceti | iñādīnām | baṣkayāsa iti |
baṣkayaśabdo'ñamutpādayati, ase, asamāsa ityarthaḥ |
pūrvācāryasaṃjñeyam, bāṣkayaḥ | asa iti kim ? gobaṣkayiḥ |
grahaṇavatā prātipadikena tadantavidhipratiṣedhādevātra na bhaviṣyati ?
jñāpanārthaṃ tu | etajjñāpayati---bhavatyatra tadantavidhiriti | kiṃ siddhaṃ
bhavati ? dhenuśabdo'tra paṭha|lte, tadantādapi bhavati---adhenūnāṃ
samūha ādhenavamiti | udasthāna deśa iti |
udasthānaśabdo'ñamutpādayati deśe vācye---audasthāno deśaḥ |
deśādanyatra yadṛcchayā kaścidudasthānaḥ, tasyāpatyamaudasthāniḥ |
pṛṣadaṃśa iti | pṛṣacchabdo'ñamutpādayati aṃśe
vācye---pārṣatāā'śaḥ, aṃśādanyatrāṇena bhavati | graiṣmī triṣṭuabiti |
grīṣmo devatā asyā ityaśeṣārthavivakṣāyāmautsargiko'ṇeva bhavati,
grīṣme bhavetyādiśeṣavivakṣāyāṃ tu ṛtvaṇeva siddham | na hyanenāñā
śaiṣikasyāṇo bādhaprasaṅgaḥ, arthaviśeṣalakṣaṇānāmeva pratyayānāṃ
ṇyādibhirbādhanāt | ṛtvaṇ tu śeṣamātre
vidhānānnārthaviśeṣalakṣaṇaḥ, kakṣāntaraprāptaśca | katham ?
ṭhkālaṭṭhañ' aṇo'pavādaḥ, tsayāpyṛtvaṇ | cchandaśceha vṛtaṃ gṛhyata
iti | yasya triṣṭuabādayo viśeṣāḥ | na veda iti | tena
vedavaṣiye'pi vṛte'bhidheye'ñaḥ pratiṣedhādaṇeva bhavati---graiṣmī
triṣṭuabiti |
strīpuṃsābhyāṃ nañsnañau bhavanāt || 4|1|87 ||
strīśabdātpūṃśabdātpuṃsśabdācceti | stryadhikāravihitānāṃ
ṭābādīnāṃ ṭhpuṃsi saṃjñāyāṃ ghaḥ' ityetadadhikāravihitānāṃ ca
pratyayānāṃ grahaṇaṃ na bhavati, strīpuṃsśabdayorasvaritatvāt | nāpi
strīpuṃsārthagrahaṇam, ṭhsvaṃ rūpaṃ śabdasya' iti vacanāt | pāésnamiti
| saṃyogāntasya lopaḥ' iti puṃsśabdasakārasya lopaḥ, tatra
kartavye'nusvārasyāsiddhatvātsakārasya saṃyogāntatvāt | ata eva
saṃyogāntalopaprasaṅgānnañevobhābhyāṃ na vidhīyate | evaṃ hi mā
bhūnnañ, mā ca bhūtsnañ , añ prakṛtastatraitāvadastu
strīpuṃsayornukyeti; tatrāyamapyarthaḥ, straiṇī pausnī aña itīkāraḥ
siddho bhavati ? naiva śaṅkyam; straiṇāḥ, pāésnāḥ---ṭhyañañośca' iti
bahuṣu luk prāpnoti | iha ca straiṇānāṃ saṅghaḥ
ṭhsaṅghāṅkalakṣaṇeṣvañyañiñām' ityaṇ prāpnoti ? naiṣa doṣaḥ;
ubhayatrāpi gotra iti vartate, laukikasya ca gotrasya grahaṇaṃ
ṛṣiprajanaṃ ca loke gotramupacaranti, na ca stryarṣiṇāpi
puṃśabdavācyaṃ sāmānyam | ṭhnastaddhite' iti ṭilopastarhi prāpnoti
? ṭhprakṛtyaikāc' iti prakṛtibhāvo bhaviṣyati, ṭhiṣṭhemeyassu' iti
tatrānuvartate | evaṃ tarhi nugvidhānasaamarthyāṭṭilopo na
bhaviṣyati ? yaṃ vidhi pratyupadeśo'narthakaḥ sa vidhibādhyate, yasya tu
vidhernimitameva nāsau bādhyate, tatra ṭilopārthameva nugvidhānaṃ
syāt | strīśūbdasyāpi nugeva lopasya nimitam, anyathā yasyeti
lopātparatvād vṛddhiḥ syāt, yathā---śrīrdeavatā asya śrāyaṃ
haviriti | tasmādyathānyāsamevāstu |
yogāpekṣaṃ ceti | strīpuṃsābhyāmityayaṃ yogo vatyarthe na pravartata
ityevaṃ jñāpanaśarīram, na tu snañ vatyarthe na pravartata itiyarthaḥ |
kathaṃ strītvaṃ strītā puṃstvaṃ puṃstā ceti ? ṭhā ca tvāt' ityatra
parihāro bhaviṣyati ||
dvigorluganapatye || 4|1|88 ||
dvigoriti ṣaṣṭhīti | ānantaryalakṣaṇāyāṃ tu pañcamyāṃ pañcakapālasya
puroḍāśasyedam ṭhtasyedam' ityaṇ, pāñcakapālamityatrāpi
prāpnotīti bhāvaḥ | ṣaṣṭha|lpi yadyānantaryayoge syātsa eva doṣo yaḥ
pañcamyām, tataśca ṣaṣṭha|laśrayaṇamanarthakaṃ syāditi
matvā''ha---dvigoryaḥ sambandhī nimitatveneti | yasya taddhitasyārthe
ṭhtaddhitārthotarapada' iti dviguvihitaḥ sa nimitatvena sambandhī |
pañcakapāla iti | ṭhsaṃskṛtaṃ bhakṣāḥ' ityatrārthe vivakṣite dviguḥ, am,
tasya luk | dviveda iti | ṭhtadadhīte tadveda' ityatrārthe dviguḥ |
dvaidevadatiriti | dvayordeavadatayorapatyam, ṭhata iñ',
apatanādapatyam, yasya pitrādiṣu dvau devadatasaṃjñakau sa evamucyate,
ekasya vā dataputro'nyasya sākṣātputraḥ |
dvigunimitavijñānāditi | dvigunimitasya pratyayasya
lugvidhānādityarthaḥ | pañcakapālasyedamiti | atra saṃskṛtārthe yaḥ
prathamamutpannaḥ pratyayaḥ sa eva---dvigornimitaṃ na dvitīya iti tasya
lugna bhavati | atha vaityādi | pūrvaṃ lugityanenopasthāpatisya
pratyayasya dvigorityanena vaiyadhikaraṇyamāśritya vyākhyātam, idānīṃ
sāmānādhikaraṇyamityeṣa viśeṣaḥ | kathaṃ punadvigoreva lug
labhyata ityāha---dvigoriti sthānaṣaṣṭhīti |
nanu cetyādi | ṭhpratyayasya lukślulupaḥ' iti pratyayādarśanasya
lugādayaḥ saṃjñā vihitāḥ, tataśca dvigorlugiti naiva samañjasamiti
bhāvaḥ | upacāreṇa tvityādi | atasmiṃstadrūpāropaḥūpacāraḥ, paratra
paraśabdaprayogaḥulakṣaṇā, upacāreṇa nimitena yā lakṣaṇā tayetyarthaḥ |
anye tūpacāreṇetyasya vivaraṇaṃ lakṣaṇayetyetadityāhuḥ |
advigurūpastaddhito dvigurūpatayā yathā buddhyā vivakṣyate sā lakṣaṇā
upacāra eveti | upacārasya nibandhanaṃ dvigunimitatvam | bhavati hi
kāraṇe kāryopacāraḥ---āyurghṛtamiti yathā | dvigunimitako'pi
tarhītyādi | kārye'pi kāraṇavadupacāro dṛśyate, yathā---purātanaṃ
karma bhujyata iti, tataśca dviguryasya pratyayasya nimitaṃ so'pi
guṇakalpanayā guṇaśabdenopacārasya nimitabhūto dharmo vivakṣitaḥ,
tannimitā kalpanā guṇakalpanā, mā punarupacāṃrātmikā buddhiḥ, tayā
kasmānna dvigurityacyate ? arhatyevāyamevaṃvidhaṃ vacanamityarthaḥ |
pariharati---na tasyeti | tatra hi sannihitamapi dvigutvaṃ
pratyayotpatau nopayujyate, na hyasau dvigorityevaṃ vidhīyate, kiṃ
tarhi ? prātipadikādityevamityarthaḥ | itarastviti | pratyayaḥ, yasya
lugdarśitaḥ | dvigutvasyaiva nimitamiti | tadarthe hi samāso
vidhīyate, tasyaiva ca dvigusaṃjñā, tenāsau dvigutvasyaiva nimitam |
yadyevamityādi | ubhayorapi pakṣayoretaccodyam | na hyatra
dvigornimitatvena sambandhī taddhitaḥ, nāpi dvigunimitatvādu
pacāreṇa tadvyapadeśārhaḥ, atra hi samāhāre dvigau niṣpanne
paścātaddhita utpadyate, sa ca dvigornimitaṃ na bhavatīti codyārthaḥ |
pariharati---naivātra taddhita utpadyata iti | anabhidhānāditi bhāvaḥ |
yadi notpadyate, kathamasminnarthe pañcakapāla iti rūpasiddhistasmādutpadyata
evātra taddhitaḥ, tasya ca lugvidheyaḥ ? ityata āha---traiśabdyaṃ hīti |
traya eva śabdāstraiśadbyamucāturvarṇyādiḥ | iha hyasmābhistraiśadbyaṃ
sādhyam, tacca pañcakapālīśabdātaddhitotpatimantareṇāpi
siddhyatīti nāsmātaddhita utpadyate | tāneva trīn
śabdāndarśayati---pañcasu kapāloṣviti | dvayoḥ śabdayoriti | yaḥ
samāhāre dviguḥ, yaśca taddhitārthe, dvāvapi tau samānārthau,
tayorekena pūrveṇa vigrahaḥ | avadhāraṇamatra draṣṭavyaṃ vigraha eva, na
taddhitotpatiḥ; anabhidhānāt | aparasmāt pañcakapālādutpattiḥ |
so'yamavyavikanyāya ucyate, tadyathā avermāṃsamityaviśabdena vigraha
eva, avikaśabdādutpattirvigrahaśca āvikamavikasya māṃsamiti |
sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣeti | evaṃ kṛtvā traividyaḥ, pāñcanadam,
ṣāṭkula ityatrāpi lugna bhavati | atha vā---tryavayavā vidyā trividyā,
śākapārthivādiḥ, tāmadhīte traividyaḥ, vidyātrayarūpasya ca samudāyasya
vidyātvaṃ vivakṣitamityarthabhedābhāvaḥ | pañcānāṃ nadīnāṃ samāhāraḥ
pañcanadam, ṭhnadībhiśca' ityavyayībhāvaḥ ṭhgodāvaryāśca nadyāśca'
ityacsamāsāntaḥ, pañcanade bhavaḥ pāñcanadaḥ | atha vā---abhidhāne hi
sati samāhāradvigorapi bhavatyeva taddhitaḥ | tathā
ṣaṇṇāmādipuruṣāṇāṃ kulāni tatra bhavaḥ ṣāṭkulaḥ |
avyavikanyāyācca tisro vidyā adhīte, pañcasu nadīṣu bhavaḥ,
ṣaṭsukuleṣu bhava iti vigraha eva; na dviguḥ, nāpi taddhitaḥ ||
gotre'lugaci || 4|1|89 ||
pūrvatrotaratra ca lugvidhānādiha nañ praśliṣyate | yaskādibhyo
gotra ityādineti | ṭhprāgdīvyataḥ' ityupajīvanāya tu
prakaraṇotkarṣaḥ, prasajyapratiṣedhaścāyam | acīti | yadyeṣā parasaptamī
syācchavidhāvitaretarāśrayaṃ prāpnoti---gārgīyā vātsīyā iticche
parato'lukā bhavitavyam, aluki ca sati vṛddhatvācchena
bhavitavyamiti | nanu ca che parato'lugvidhīyate, kiṃ tarhi ?
ṭhajādimātre, tatra ya evājādiḥ sambhavati tatraivālugbhaviṣyati,
tadyathā---gargāṇāṃ chāttrāḥ, ṭhprāgdīvyato'ṇ', tatra parataḥ
ṭhyañañośca' iti prāptasya lukaḥ pratiṣedhe gargā iti bhavati | yadyapyatra
satyasati vā luki nāstiviśeṣaḥ, ṭhāpatyasya ca taddhite' iti
yalopavidhānāt | iha tvattrerapatyāni bahūni ṭhitaścāniñaḥ' iti
ḍhakaḥ ṭhatribhṛgu' iti luki kṛte'trīṇāṃ chātrā ityaṇi parataḥ
pratiṣedhe sati āttreyā iti bhavati, asati tu pratiṣedhe ātrā iti
syāt ? syādetadevaṃ yadi luptasya pratyayasya punaḥ prādurbhāvo
vidhīyateta, iha tvalugiti vacanāllukaḥ pratiṣedho vidheyaḥ,
prāptasya cānabhinirvṛsya pratiṣedhena nivṛttiḥ śakyate kartum,
tataśca yadyatrāṇajādirabhipretaḥ syāt, prāgeva lukaḥ
pravṛttirabhyupagantavyā; anyathā vṛddhatvāccha eva syāt, luka
cetpravṛtaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ kiṃ kariṣyati ! yo hi bhuktavantaṃ prati
brūyānmā bhuṅkthā iti, kiṃ tena kṛtaṃ syāt ! tadihājādau
pravṛte'lukā bhavitavyam, aluki ca pravṛte'jādinā bhavitavyamiti
vyaktamitaretarāśrayam | vipratiṣedhātsiddham, luko'vakāśo yatra
prāgdīvyatīyārtho na vivakṣyate---gargā vatsā iti,
cchasyāvakāśaḥ---śālīya iti; gargāya ityatrobhayaprasaṅge paratvācchāe
bhaviṣyati | tatra parato lukaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ, antaraṅgo lug
apatyabahutvamātrāpekṣatvāt, bahiraṅgaścchaḥ
prāgdīvyatīyārthāpekṣitvāt, antaraṅgabahiraṅgayoścāyukto
vipratiṣedhaḥ | evaṃ tarhyucyate cedamajādau parato lugbhavatīti,
yadi ca tāvatyeva nimitamastīti bahutvamātrāpekṣo luk pravarteta
pratiṣedhavidhānamanarthakaṃ syāditi
yāvatprāgdīvyatīyo'jādirnotpadyate tāvallug na pravartata iti
kalpyate, tataśca vṛddhatvācche sati luki pratiṣiddhe gargīya iti
siddhamiṣṭam | viṣayasaptamyāṃ tu na kiñcidyatnasādhyam, gargāṇāṃ
chātrā ityarthavivakṣāyāmajādau pratyaye vivakṣite buddhisthe'nutpanna
eva luki pratiṣiddhe vṛddhatvācchāe bhavatīti,
tasmādviṣayasaptamīmāśrityāha---prāgdīvyatīye pratyaye viṣayabhūta iti
| khārapāyaṇīyā iti | kharapasyāpatyāni bahūni ṭhnaḍādibhyaḥ phak',
ṭhyaskādibhyo gotre' iti prāptasya lukaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ |
kaubalam, bādaramiti | kubalī-badarīśabdau
gorādiṅīṣantāvantodātau, tābhyāṃ phale vikāre ṭhanudātādeśca'
ityañ, tasya ṭhphale luk' iti prāptasya lukaḥ
tasyedamityarthavivakṣāyāṃ pratiṣedho na bhavati, tenāvṛddhatvādaṇena
bhavati | gargarūpyamiti | yadyatrāluk syād, sārgyarūpyamiti
syāt |
gārgīyamiti | ṭhtasmai hitam' iti prākkrītācchaḥ |
viṣayasaptamyā eva phalaṃ darśayati---gotrasyetyādi | gotrasyeti
gotrapratyayasyetyarthaḥ | vahuṣu lopina iti | bahuṣvartheṣu
vidhīyamānalopasyetyarthaḥ | bahuvacanāntasya praṃvṛtāviti |
pravṛttiḥuarthāntarasaṃkrāntiḥ, bahuvacanāntasya sato'rthāntarasaṃkrāntau
satyāmityarthaḥ | dvyekayoriti | yatrārthāntare saṃkrāntasya
dvitvaikatvayoḥ satorityarthaḥ | sā cārthāntarasaṃkrāntistadantādyadā
yani pratyaya utpadyate tasya ca luk kriyate tadā bhavati lupte hi
yuvapratyaye prakṛtireva tadarthamāheti bhavati saṃkrāntiḥ |
bidānāmiti | badasyāpatyāni bahūni, ṭhanṛṣyānantarye
bidādibhyo'ñ', bidāḥ, teṣāṃ bidhānāmapatyaṃ yuvā yuvānau
veti vivakṣāyām ṭhataḥ' iti iñi vivakṣite gotrapratyayasyāño lukaḥ
prāptasyānena pratiṣedhaḥ | iñaḥ ṭhṇyakṣatriyārṣa' iti luki baidaḥ,
baidāviti bhavati | parasaptamīpakṣe tvalugna prāpnoti;
ajāderabhāvāt |
idamiha sampradhāryam---iño luk kriyatāmayaṃ vā'lugiti ?
paratvādalugbhavati | iño lugnityaḥ, kṛte'pyasminnaluki prāpnoti
akṛte'pi, ayaṃ punaraluganityaḥ, na hīño luki kṛte prāpnoti;
ajāderabhāvāt ? pratyayalakṣaṇena bhaviṣyati | varṇāśraye nāsti
pratyayalakṣaṇam ? nātra varṇo nimitam, kiṃ tahi ? pratyayaḥ, tasyaiva tu
viśeṣaṇamacīti | tatra yathā halādau piti sārvadhātuke vidhīyamānaḥ
ṭhtṛṇaha im' atṛṇeḍityatrāpi bhavati pratyayalakṣaṇena tadvadihāpi
bhaviṣyati ? satyam; viṣayasaptamīpakṣe naivaṃ kleśo'nubhavanīyo
bhavati | nanūbhayorapi pakṣayorihāpi na prāpnoti---bidānāmapatyaṃ
bahavo māṇavakā bidā iti ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; dve atra
bahutve---yuvabahutvaṃ gotrabahutvaṃ ca, tatra gotrabahutvāśrayasya
lukaḥ pratiṣedho'stu punaryuvabahutvāśrayo lugbhaviṣyati |
lugvidhau hi laukikasya gotrasya grahaṇam, yuvāpi ca loke
gotramityupacaryate---gārgyāyaṇo'smi gotreṇeti |
atha yuvabahutvāśrayasyāpi lukaḥ punaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ kasmānna bhavati ?
viṣayasaptamyāṃ tāvad yasyāmavasthāyāṃ luk prāptaḥ
tasyāmavasthāyāṃ yadi kaścidajādirviṣayabhūtastato'lukā
bhavitavyam, iha cājādirviṣayabhūta utpanno luptaśca, paścādyauvasu
bahuṣu saṃkrāntau satyāṃ luk prāptaḥ, na cāsyāmavasthāyāṃ
kaścidajādiviṣayabhūta iti punarlugna bhaviṣyati | parasaptamyāmapi
gotre vartamānasyā lugbhavatyajādau parataḥ | kasminnajādau ?
prāgdīvyato ye'rthāsteṣu yo'jādistasminnityucyamāne yasmin
gotre vartamānasya luk prāptastadvyatirikte prāgdīvyatīye'rthe
yo'jādistatreti gamyate | iha ceñevājādistadartha eva ca gotre
lugiti pratiṣedho na bhaviṣyati |
yadvā---ṭhsamarthānāṃ prathamāt' ityataḥ prathamāditi vartate, tacca
ṣaṣṭha|lntaṃ vipariṇamyate, prathamārthavṛttitvācca prāthamyamāśrīyate,
tadayamartho bhavati---prathamasya gotrapratyayasya lugna bhavati, yasminnarthe
pratyaya utpannastatraivārthe vartamānasya yo luk prāptaḥ sa na bhavati |
iha tu dvitīyamarthamupasaṃkrāntasya luk prāpta iti na pratiṣidhyate |
avaśyaṃ caitadevaṃ vijñeyam---prathamasya luk pratiṣidhyata iti, anyathā
attrerapatyam ṭhitaścāniñaḥ' iti ḍhak, tasyāpatyaṃ bahavo yuvānaḥ,
ata iñaḥ ṭhṇyakṣatriyārṣa' iti luk, ḍhakaḥ ṭhatribhṛgu' iti luk,
atrayaḥ; bharadvājaśabdādvidādyañ, tadantādyauvabahutve iño luk, añaḥ
ṭhyañañośca' iti luk, atrayaśca bharadvājāśca atribharadvājāsteṣāṃ
maithunikād dvandvād vun---atribharadvājikā, tatrāluk
prāpnoti; kutsādṛṣyaṇaḥ ṭhatribhṛgu' iti luk,
kuśakādañantādiño luki kuśikāḥ, kutsakuśikikāḥ,
vasiṣṭhakaśyapikāḥ, bhṛgvaṅgirasikāḥ | aya vā--gopavanādiṣu
garghabhārgavikāśabdaḥ paṭha|lte, bhārgavaśabdasya yuvabahutve prāptasya
lukaḥ pratiṣedhārthaṃ tanniyamārthaṃ bhaviṣyati---etasyaiva
dvitīyamarthamaupasaṃkrāntasyālugbhavatīti | naiva vā punaratra
yuvabahutve vartamānasyālukprāpnoti, kiṃ kāraṇam ? gotra
ityucyate, yadyapyapatyādhikārādanyatra laukikaṃ gotraṃ gṛhyate, iha tu
pāribhāṣikasya grahaṇam, yuvaśabdasāhacaryāt ; anyathā
gotrayuvasaṃjñayoḥ samāveśe yo'yaṃ doṣo
vakṣyate---śālaṅkerapatyaṃ ṭhyañiñośca' iti phak, tasya
ṭhpailādibhyaśca' iti luk, śālaṅkeryūnaśchātrā ityarthavivakṣāyām
ṭhgotre'lugaci' ityaluk prāpnoti, tataśca ṭhyūni luk' ityasya
ṭhphakphiñoranyatarasyām' iti vikalpitatvātpakṣe phakaḥ śravaṇaṃ
prāpnotīti sa tadavastha eva syāt, asamāveśe'pi yūno
laukikagotratvādevālukprasaṅgāt | tadevaṃ gotrasya bahuṣu
lopina ityādi na vaktavyamiti sthitam |
ekavacanadvivacananāntasyetyādi | ekavacanāntasya gotrapratyayasya
dvivacanāntasya vā bahuṣvartheṣu yuvasaṃjñakeṣu pravṛtau saṃkrāntau
satyāmityarthaḥ | lopa iti | lugityarthaḥ | lope hi pratyayalakṣaṇena
vṛddhisvaraprasaṅgaḥ | nanu ca yuvabahutvāśrayo ṭhyañañośca' ityevātra
luk siddhastatrāha---na hyatrāñbahuṣūtpanna iti | añyo bahuṣu, yañyo
bahuṣviti vijñāyamāne lugna sidhyatītyarthaḥ | yadā tvañantaṃ
yadvahuṣu, yañantaṃ yadvahuṣviti vijñāyate; tadāñantasya bahuṣu
yuvasu vṛterlaukikasya ca gotrasyāpatyamātrasya tatra grahaṇātsiddha
eva luk | tathā ca---gārgyaśca vātsyaśca vājyaśca gargavatsavājāḥ,
baidaśca aurvaśca bhāradvājāśca bidaurvabhāradvājā iti
yañañorutpattivelāyāmabahutve'pi dvandve yugapadhikaraṇavacanatayā
yañantasyāñantasya bahutvopajanāllugbhavati | na caivaṃ kāśyapasyaikasya
bahvyaḥ pratikṛtayaḥ kāśyapā iti ṭhive pratikṛtau' iti vihitasya kanaḥ
ṭhjīvikārthe cāpaṇye' iti lup, ṭhharītakyādiṣu vyaktiḥ' iti
vacanād yuktavadvacanābhāve'ñantasya bahuṣu vṛterlukprasaṅgaḥ;
gotrabahutve lugvidhānāt ||
yūni luk || 4|1|90 ||
atrāpi yadyacīti parasaptamī syāt, pratyayasya yatheṣṭaprasaṅgaḥ |
yuvapratyaye śrūyamāṇe yaḥ prāpnoti sa tāvatkatavyaḥ, tatra kṛte
yuvapratyayasya luki tasya śravaṇaṃ prāpnoti, viṣayasaptamyāṃ tvajādau
viṣayabhūta eva yuvapratyaye lupte yo yataḥ prāpnoti tataḥ sa sa
bhavatīti siddhamiṣṭam | etaccodāharaṇeṣu vyaktīkariṣyate,
tadetadāha---ajādau pratyaye vivakṣita ityādi | iñaścetyaṇ
bhavatīti | parasasaptamyāṃ tu vṛddhāccha eva syāt |
pheśccha ceti | ṭhyamundaśca suyāmā ca vārṣyāyaṇiḥ phiñaḥ smṛtāḥ' iti
parigaṇanaṃ bhāṣyakāreṇa nāśritam, tena taikāyanerapicchāe bhavati |
taikāyanīyā iti | atra parasaptamyāmapyadoṣaḥ, ṭhṇyakṣatriyārṣañitaḥ'
ityatra tu vṛttikāreṇāṇo lugudāhṛtaḥ---taikāyaniḥ pitā
taikāyaniḥ putra iti, sa parigaṇanāśrayeṇa draṣṭavyaḥ, tadā ca
taikāyanīyā ityanudāharaṇam |
kāpiñjalādā iti | atrāpi parasaptamyāṃ vṛddhācchaḥ syāt | evaṃ
glaucukāyanā ityatrāpi draṣṭavyam | iha tu aupagaveryūnaśchātrā
iño luki vṛddhācchāe bhavati, parasaptamyām, ṭhiñaśca' ityaṇsyāt |
naitadasya yogasyodāharaṇam, katham ? ṭhiñaśca' ityatra ṭhgotre' iti
vartate, teneñaṃ viśeṣayiṣyāmaḥ---gotre ya iñ vihita iti
pāribhāṣikaṃ ca gotraṃ gṛhyate, katham ? ṭhkaṇvādibhyo gotre' ityatra
tāvad ṭhgotrekuñjādibhyaḥ' ityasya gotrasyānuvādaḥ---kaṇvādibhyo
gotre yaḥ pratyayo vihitastadantādaṇ bhavatīti, tatra ca
pāribhāṣikaṃ gṛhyate tasyaiva cānuvādaḥ, tadeva ca ṭhiñaśca'
ityatrāpyanuvartate, tatkuto yuvapratyayāntādaṇaḥ prasaṅgaḥ ! avaśyaṃ
caitadevaṃ vijñeyam, anyathā lupte'pīñi pratyayalakṣaṇenāṇ syādeva
|
imāni tarhyatrodāharaṇāni---yatkhacchāntāḥ | yat---ṭhrājaśvaśurādyat',
śvaśurasyāpatyaṃ śvasuryaḥ, tasyāpatyaṃ śvāśuristasya chātrā iti luki
ṭhprāgdīvyato'ṇ' bhavati śvāśuraḥ, anyathā ṭhvṛddhācchaḥ' syāt ;
ṭhkulātkhaḥ' kulīnaḥ, tasyāpatyaṃ kaulīniḥ, tasya chāttrāḥ, iño
luki kaulīnaḥ; ṭhsvasuścchaḥ', svasrīyaḥ, tasyāpatyaṃ svāsrīyiḥ, tasya
chātrā iño luki svasrīyāḥ ? naitānyudāharaṇāni; ṭhabrāhmaṇād
gotramātrādyauvapratyayasyopasaṅkhyānam' itīño luki kṛte śvaśuryaḥ
pitā śvaśuryaḥ putraḥ, kulīnaḥ pitā kulīnaḥ putraḥ, svasrīyaḥ pitā
svasrīyaḥ putra iti bhavitavyam | na ca brāhmaṇagotre
kaścidavṛddhinimitaḥ pratyayaḥ sambhavati, yata iñi kṛte cchaḥ prāpnoti;
vṛddhinimite tu gotrapratyaye nāsti viśeṣaḥ, yataḥ śrūyamāṇo'pīñi
chena bhavitavyam | lupte'pi tasmin gotrapratyayāntasyāpi
vṛddhatvācchena bhavitavyam, tadyathā---aupagavīyā iti | tadevamiña
udāharaṇaṃ na sambhavatīti sthitam |
yadi tu pūrvasūtre laukikasya gotrasya grahaṇaṃ tadā syādeveña
udāharaṇam | tathā hiśvaśuryādibhya utpannasyeñaḥ,
satyapyaupasaṅkhyānike luki tasya prāgdīvyatīyavivakṣāyām
ṭhgotre'lugaci' iti pratiṣedhena punaḥ prādurbhāvādiñāśrayaḥ
ṭhvṛddhācchaḥ' syāt, yadi tasya ṭhyūni luk' iti lugna kriyeta |
ato'smādiña udāharaṇatvapratiṣedhāyapyavasīyate---pāribhāṣikaṃ
gotraṃ pūrvasūtre bhāṣyakārasyābhimatamiti |
kimarthaṃ punaridamucyate, yāvatā yūno'pigotrarūpe vivakṣite
gotrapratyayenābhidhānātannibandhana eva pratyayo bhaviṣyati,
arthaprakaraṇādinā ca yuvaviśeṣasiddhiḥ, avaśyaṃ cārthaprakaraṇādinaiva
viśeṣo'vasātavyaḥ, ārabdhe'piyasminsūtre śabdasya sādhāraṇatvāt |
na hi jñāyate---kiṃ bhāgaviteśchātrā bhāgavitāḥ ?
āhosvidbhāgavitikasyeti ? yadā tarhi viśeṣavivakṣā, tadāpi
bhāgavitā ityeva yathā syād, bhāgavitikīyā iti jātucinmā
bhūdityevamarthamidam ||
phikphañoranyatarasyām || 4|1|91 ||
kimarthamidam, yāvatā yuvarūpavivakṣāyāṃ gārgyāyaṇīya iti,
gotrarūpavivakṣāyāṃ ca gārgīyā iti śabdasya sādhāraṇatvāt ? ityata
āha---pūrvasūtreṇeti | ṭhyūni luk' ityetadārambhaṇīyamityuktam,
tasmiścārabhyamāṇe yadīdaṃ nocyeta, phakphiñorapi nityameva luk
syāt, tataśca gārgyāyaṇīyā iti na syāt |
tasmādidamapyārambhaṇīyamityarthaḥ ||
tasyāpatyam || 4|1|92 ||
arthanirdeśo'yamiti | prakṛtyarthaviśiṣṭaḥ ṣaṣṭha|lrtho'patyarūpaḥ
pratyayārtho'nena nirdiśyata ityarthaḥ | tena samarthavibhakterapi ṣaṣṭha|la
nirdeśo darśita eva | pūrvairutaraiśceti | pūrvaistāvadaṇādibhiḥ
sambaddhyate; asaṃyuktavidhānāt, anyathā ṭhtasyāpatyamata iñ'
ityekaṃ yogameva kuryāt, yatastvasaṃyuktaṃ karoti, tato
jñāyate---pūrvaiḥ sambadhyata iti | utarairapi sambadhyate;
svaritatvātsākāṃkṣatvāccateṣām | tasyeti ṣaṣṭhīsamarthāditi |
tasyeti sāmānyaṃ ṣaṣṭha|lntaviśeṣopalakṣaṇārtham, ṭhsamarthānām' iti
ca nirddhāraṇe ṣaṣṭhī | tatra tulyajātīyasya nirddhāraṇādayamarthaḥ
sampadyate---ṣaṣṭha|lntātsamarthāditi | apatyamityetasminnartha iti |
prathamāntasyāpatyaśabdasyānyathāsambandhānupapaterayamadhyāhāro labdhaḥ |
yathāvihitamiti | ṭhyathārthe yadavyayam' iti vīpsāyāmavyayībhāvaḥ |
ṭhprāgdīvyato'ṇ' ityādibhiryo yato vihitaḥ sa tasmādityarthaḥ |
iha ṭhtasya' iti puṃnapuṃsakayoranyatareṇāyaṃ nirdeśaḥ kriyate,
ekavacanāntena ca, tena liṅgāntarādvacanāntarācca na
syāt---sumāturapatyaṃ somātraḥ, kṣatrasyāpatyaṃ kṣāttriḥ,
upagorapatyamaupagava iti | apatyamiti caikavacanena napuṃsakena ca
nirdeśaḥ kriyate, tenaikasminnevāpatye syāt, na dvayoḥ, nāpi
bahuṣu, napuṃsaka eva syāt, na
strīpuṃsayorityāśaṅkyāha--prakṛtyarthetyādi | prakṛtyartha
upagvādirviśeṣaḥ; tasyetyasya viśeṣopalakṣaṇārthatvāt | apatyamātraṃ
ceti | mātraśabdo'yaṃ liṅgavacanayorvyavacchedāya |
liṅgavacanādikamiti | ādiśabdena kālasya grahaṇam; atra hi
vartamānakālena nirdeśo'stīti pratīteḥ,
yathoktam---yatrānyatkriyāpadaṃ nāsti tatrāstirbhavatiparaḥ
prathamapuruṣo'prayujyamāno'pyastīti gamyata iti | tataśca tasya
kālasya vivakṣāyataṃ kālāntare na syāt | sarvamavivakṣitamiti |
nāntarīyakatvādupādānasyāvaśyaṃ hi kenacilliṅgādinā nirdeśaḥ
kartavyaḥ |
tasyedamityapatye'pīti | aṇādīnāṃ vidhānaṃ siddhamiti śeṣaḥ |
tasyedaṃviśeṣā hyapatyasamūhavikārādayaḥ; sambandhasāmānye'pi
sarvaviśeṣāntarbhāvāt, tataśca ṭhtasyedam'
ityanenaivāpatye'pyaṇādīnāṃ vidhānaṃ siddham, tatkiṃ
yogavibhāgenāpatye'ṇādayo vidhīyante, na ṭhtasyāpatyamata iñ'
ityapavādaiḥ saṃyukta evāpatyārtho nirdiśyate iti codyārthaṃ
pariharati---bādhanārthaṃ kṛtaṃ bhavediti | ṭhtasyedam' ityanena
vidhīyamānānāmaṇādīnāṃ yo bādhakaścchaḥ, tasya
bādhanārthamapatye'ṇādīnāṃ vidhānaṃ kṛtaṃ bhavedityarthaḥ | nanu
śaiṣikaścchaḥ, apatyādicaturthaparyantebhyo yo'nyo'rthaḥ sa śeṣaḥ,
tatkathamapatye cchasya prasaṅgo yena tadvādhanārthamidam ?
ityāha---utsargaḥ śeṣaṃ evāsaviti | yadi yogavibhāgamakṛtvā
ṭhtasyāpatyamata iñ' ityucyeta tadā
prakṛtiviśeṣasambaddhasyaivāpatyārthasyopayogaḥ, ato'nyo'patyārthaḥ
śeṣa eva syāditi syādeva vṛddhādapatye cchaḥ | yogavibhāge
tu---apatyārthasyāṇādividhāvupayogāccheṣatvābhāvācchasyāprāptireva, saivātrāprāptirbādhetyucyate | utsarga iti prakṛtisāmānyasambaddhaḥ sāmānyabhūto'patyartha uktaḥ | bādhanārthasyodāharaṇamāha--vṛddhānyasya prayojanamiti | śyaamagava iti | śyāmā gāvo'sya śyāmaguriti ||
eko gotre || 4|1|93 ||
ekaśabdo'yamanyapradhānāsahāyasaṅkhyāprathamasamānasādhāraṇavācī,
anyārthe tāvad---ṭhekānyābhyāṃ samarthābhyām', ṭhprajāmekā
rakṣatyūrjamekā', ṭhekān bandhuraparānnirāsuḥ', ṭhityeke manyante',
ṭhyajuṣyekeṣām' iti; kecitvanayoḥ prayogayoḥ kecicchabdaparyāya
ekaśabda ityāhuḥ | ṭhekaḥ pārtho dhanuṣmatām' iti pradhānārthe |
ṭhādyantavadekasmin', ṭhekahalādau', ṭhekahalmadhye' ityasahāyārthe | ṭheko
dvau bahavaḥ' iti saṅkhyārthe | ṭheke'lpaprāṇaḥ |' iti prathamārthe |
ṭhtenaikadik' iti samānārthe | ṭhdevadatayajñadatāvekadhanau' iti
sādhāraṇārthe | tatra saṅkhyāvacanaḥ sādhāraṇavacanaḥ, prathamavacano vā
gṛhyate; arthāntarāṇāmasambhavāt | gotraṃ pāribhāṣikam;
kṛtrimākṛtrimayoḥ kṛtrime kāryasampratyayāt, apatyādhikāre
gotragrahaṇācca |
kimarthamidamucyate, pautraprabhṛtāvapatye vivakṣite
mūlaprakṛteruparavādereva pratyayo yathā syād, aupagavādeḥ
pratyayāntānmā bhūditi | naitadasti prayojanam,
sanvidhivadetadbhaviṣyati, tadyathā---dhātorvidhīyamānaḥ san
sanantānna bhavati, tat kasya hetoḥ ? ākṛtau padārthe samudāye
sakṛllakṣaṇaṃ pravartate, na ca sani vidhīyamāne sananto dhātuḥ
sambhavati, tadvadihāpyapatyapratyaye vidhīyamānāpatyapratyayāntā
prakṛtiḥ sambhavatīti tataḥ pratyayo na bhaviṣyati ? viṣama upanyāsaḥ;
ekaḥ san pratyayaḥ, vidhāyakaṃ ca lakṣaṇamekameva tatra yuktam, na
tasminvidhīyamāne tadantā prakṛtiḥ sambhavatīti |
iha punaḥ ṭhtasyāpatyam' ṭhata iñ' ṭhyañiñośca' iti bahūni
lakṣaṇāni, pratyayāśca bahavaḥ; tatra kasmiścitpratyaye vidhīyamāne
pratyayāntareṇa tadantā prakṛtiḥ sambhavatyeva, tathā ca gupādīnāṃ sanaḥ
san bhavati---jugupsiṣate iti ? kiṃ punaḥ syādyadyetannārabhyeta ?
ucyate; iha kecinmanyante---putraśabdaparyāyo'patyaśabdaḥ; nighaṇṭuaṣu
tathā pāṭhālloke ca dṛṣṭatvāt | tadyathā pitāmahasyotsaṅge
dārakamāsīnaṃ dṛṣṭvā kaścitpṛcchati---kasya putro'yamiti,
kasyāpatyamiti ? sa devadatasya yajñadatasya vetyutpādayitāraṃ
vyapadiśati, nātmānam, tataśca yathā pitāmahaṃ prati puttro na
bhavati tathāpatyamiti | utpādayitaivaiko'patyena yujyate, na tu
pitāmahādayo'pīti | anye tu---kriyānimitako'patyaśabdaḥ, na
patantyanenetyapatyamiti auṇādiko yatpratyayaḥ, yasya ca yenāpatanaṃ
tatasyāpatyam | vyavahitajanito'pi pautrādiḥ
pitāmahāderapatanaheturbhavati, śrūyate hi---ṭhjāyamāno vai
brāhmaṇastribhirṛṇavā jāyate brahmacaryeṇarṣaibhyo yajñena devebhyaḥ prajayā
pitṛbhyaḥ, eṣa vā anṛṇo yaḥ putrī' iti, etena putramutpādya
pitṛṇāmanṛṇo bhavatīti pratipādanāt putrotpāditayā prajayā
patṛṇāmupikārī dṛśyate | smaryate ca---
putreṇa lokāñjayati pautreṇānantyamaśnute |
atha putrasya pautreṇa bradhnasyāpnoti viṣṭapam || iti |
itihāseṣu ca jāratkāravādiṣu mahatī
vārtā---vyavahitajanito'pyupakāraka iti | sūtrakāraśca śabdavidāṃ
mūrddhābhiṣiktaḥ sūtrayati---ṭhapatyaṃ pautraprabhṛti gotram' iti, tato
vijñāyate kriyānimitako'pyapatyaśabda iti; anyathā yathā
pautraprabhṛtiḥ putra ityanupapannaṃ tādṛgeva tatsyāt | evaṃ sati
sākṣātparamparayā vā yasya ya utpādyaḥ sa taṃ pratyapatyāmiti sarve'pi
pitāmahādayo'pyapatyena yujyante, na tūtpādayitaiveti | tatrādye
pakṣe yadyetannārabhyeta, tatastatra tatrāpatye tatatpitṛvacanātsa sa
pratyayaḥ syāt, tadyathā---upagoraupagavaḥ, tasyaupagaviḥ,
tasyaupagavāyanaḥ | evaṃ śatatame'patye
ekonaśatamapatyapratyayāḥ---ityaniṣṭṃa prāpnoti, iṣṭṃa ca na
siddhyati---aupagava iti, tṛtīyāderupaguṃ pratyanapatyatvāt |
dvitīye tūpagoḥ pañcamaḥ pūrveṣāṃ caturṇāmapatyaṃ tato yadopagoḥ
pratyayastadaupagava itīṣṭṃa tāvatsiddhyati; aniṣṭamapi ca prāpnoti,
taccāniṣṭamaniyatamaupagaviḥ, tata aupagavāyanaḥ, tata
aupagavāyaniriti | pañcame trīṇyaniṣṭāni, ṣaṣṭhe catvārītyevaṃ
yāvatithamapatyamabhidhitsitam, tāvanti dvyūnānyaniṣṭāni
prāpnuvanti, tadyathā---śatatame'ṣṭau navatiśceti | evaṃ sthite
idamārabhyate |
ārabhyamāṇe'pyetasminyadi prathamaḥ pakṣa āśrīyate tato
vidhyarthametatsyād, niyamārthaṃ vā ? kathaṃ cedaṃ vidhyarthaṃ kathaṃ vā
niyamārtham ? yadi gotraśabdena pautraprabhṛtyapatyasamudāya
ekaikamapatyamabhidhīyate tato vidhyartham, tarhi tathā niyamārthaḥ
sambhavati, ekasminnapatye'nekapratyayaprasaṅgasyābhāvād | na
tāvadekasminprayoge ekasyāḥ prakṛteranekapratyayaprasaṅgaḥ;
ekenaivoktatvāttsyārthasya | nāpi prayogabhedena nānāprakṛtibhyo
nānāpratyayaprasaṅgaḥ, sarvadā svapitṛvacanādeva prasaṅgāditi
paramaprakṛtestṛtīyādāvapatye'prāptaḥ, evamaupagavāccaturthādāviti,
tataḥ kiṃ na vidhīyate vacanavyaktibhedāt ? evaṃ hyatra vacanaṃ
vyajyate---gotra ekaḥ pratyayo bhavati, yata eka eva pratyayaḥ kartuṃ
śakyate, tata eva pratyayo bhavatītyarthaḥ | ekagrahaṇasāmarthyāccāyamartho
labhyate | nanu vidhīyamāne'pi pratyaye prakṛtipratyayāvasambandhau
syātām ? vacanasāmarthyādapatyāpatyasyāpatyatvopacārāt pratyayo
bhaviṣyatītyadoṣaḥ |
mukhye'patye caritārthaḥ pratyayo na syāditi vidhātavyamapi,
asminpakṣe sarveṣvaupagava itīṣṭṃa siddhyati,
pratyayamālāprasaṅgastadavastha eva | na hyanena tatatpitṛvacanātprāptaḥ
pratyayaḥ pratiṣiddhyate | tathā pañcame'patye upaguśabdādanena pratyaye
vihite tasyāpatyamiti ṣaṣṭha aupagaviḥ syāt | yadā tu ṭhapatyaṃ
pautraprabhṛtigotram' ityapatyaśabdena pautraprabhṛtyasamudāyaṃ
lakṣayitvā tasyaiva gotrasaṃjñā vidhīyate, ekaikasminnapatye
gotraśabdaprayogaḥ, samudāyeṣu vṛtāḥ śabdā avayaveṣvapīti
nyāyāt | atratyena vā gotraśabdenāvayavadharmeṇa
samudāyavyapadeśātpautraprabhṛtyapatyasamudāyo'bhīdhīyate tadā
niyamārtham---gotrasamudāye eka eva pratyayo bhavatīti |
yadyapyekaikasminnapatye ekaikaḥ pratyayaḥ prāpnoti, tathāpi pautra
ekastadapatye cāpara iti sakalanirūpaṇe samudāye bahavaḥ pratyayāḥ
kṛtāḥ syuriti niyama upapadyate | asminpakṣe
doṣaḥ---anantarāpatyapratyayāntātṛtīye pratyayaḥ prāpnoti,
gotraśabdopādānena hi niyamaḥ kriyate---gotra eka eveti, tataśca
gotre'nekaḥ pratyayo mā bhūt | anantara ekastṛtīye cāpara
ityevamanekaḥ kasmānna syāt ? evamapi gotre eka eva hi kṛto
bhavati | atha vā---gotrasamudāye eva evetyanena kiṃ kriyate ?
tṛtīyādeścaturthādau prāptaḥ pratiṣidhyate | yadi tṛtīyādeḥ
syātsamudāye'nekaḥ pratyayaḥ kṛtaḥ syāditi | yastvanantarastṛtīye
prāptaḥ so'bhyanujñāyate---eka evetītaravyāvṛtau niyameṣu
tātparyam | tataśca yataḥ pratyaye kriyamāṇe samudāye'nekaḥ pratyayaḥ
kṛto bhavati | tato na bhavatītyeva vacanārtho bhavati | evaṃ
catuthasyāpatyapratyayenābhidhānaṃ na prāpnoti,
dvitīyādutpannastṛtīyamevācaṣṭe na tṛtīyādutpadyata iti, kintu
aupagaverapatyamiti vākyameva | pañcamādestu vākyenāpyabhidhānaṃ na
prāpnoti, na hi tatatpitṛvacanaḥ kaścidapatyapratyayāntaḥ śabdo'sti
yena vigṛhyaeta | paramavakṛteśca tṛtīyādau na kutracitpratyayaḥ
prāpnoti, oyogāt | tadevamasminpakṣe
paramaprakṛteścotpatirvaktavyā, anantarācca tṛtīye prāptasya
pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ |
syādetat---na paramaprakṛterutpattirvaktavyā, abhedopacāreṇaiva
siddheḥ | abhedopacāraścopagvaupagavayoraupagavatadapatyayorvā |
tadevaṃ śatatame'pyapatye'bhedopacāraparamparayā aupagava ityabhidhānaṃ
sidhyati, na caivamabhedopacāreṇaiveṣṭasya siddheḥ sūtrasya vaiyarthyam,
bhedavivakṣāyāṃ pratyayamālāprasaṅganivṛtyarthatvāditi ?
evamapyanantarasya tṛtoyasya ca bhedavivakṣāyāṃ tṛtīya aupagaviḥ
syāt, tathā'nantare tṛtīyādau ca yatra pratyayo bhidyate,
yathā---gargādau, tatrāpyaniṣṭaprasaṅgaḥ | yadi tāvad gārgye
gargāpacārastadā tadapatyamapi gārgiḥ syād, gārgyaśceṣyate |
athāpi gargestadapatyasya cābhedopacāraḥ, evamapi gārgiḥ
syāditītyādau viṣaye doṣavānevābhedopacāraḥ | tadevaṃ
prathamapakṣe vidhau niyame ca doṣaprasaṅgād dvitīyaḥ pakṣa āśrīyate,
tatrāpi niyamaḥ | yadyapyekaikasminprayoge ekasyāḥ prakṛtereka eva
pratyayaḥ prāpnoti, tathāpyupagoḥ pañcame pūrvābhyaścatasṛbhyaḥ
prakṛtibhyaḥ prayogabhedena nānāpratyayaprasaṅge niyamaḥ kriyate---eva
eveti | tadidamuktam---bhedena pratyayaprasaṅge niyamaḥ kriyate |
nanu na jñāyate--ka evo bhavatīti, yo vā paramaprakṛteryo vā
pratyayāntāditi ? nanveka ityucyate, yadi ca pratyayāntātprāptaḥ
pratyayaḥ syādanekaḥ kṛtaḥ syāt | kva ? na tāvatpañcame; pūrveṣāṃ
pratyayānāmasminprayoge prasaṅgo'patyāntaraviṣayatvāt | atha
gotrasamudāye kenāsau nivāryeta ? na tāvadanenaiva, na hi
gotrasamudāyo gotragrahaṇena gṛhyate | athāpi gṛhyaeta, evamapi na
jñāyate---yo vā paramaprakṛteḥ, yo vā'nantarāditi ? yadi
punargotragrahaṇaṃ na kriyate, kriyamāṇaṃ vā'patyamātraparaṃ vijñāyate, na
syādeṣa doṣaḥ; apatye samudāye eka eveti niyamāt |
apatyādhikāre gotragrahaṇātveṣa doṣo jāyate ? naiṣa doṣaḥ;
apatyamiti vartate, gotre'patye eka evāpatyapratyayo bhavatīti
vacanavyaktiḥ | yadi ca pratyayāntātpratyayaḥ syādapatyapratyayo'neko
gotre kṛtaḥ syāt, sāmarthyena vā pratyayo
viśeṣyate---gotrābhidhāne samarthānāṃ madhye eka eveti | yadi ca
pratyayāntāt pratyayaḥ syād gotrābhidānasamartho'nekaḥ kṛtaḥ
syātprathamasyāpi samarthatvāt | yadyapyasminprayoge'patyāntare vartate
pañcamaṃ pratyapi sāmarthyaṃ tāvadasti, yadi vā ṭhtasyāpatyam'
ityādilakṣaṇaireka eva pratyayaḥ kartavyaḥ, kva ? gotre, yasminpratyaye
gotrambhiditsitaṃ tatretyarthaḥ | pratyayāntācca pratyaye tasminneva
prayoge prakṛtirūpasampādanāyāpi tāvadaneka kṛtaḥ syāt |
yadi vā prathamavacana ekaśabdaḥ, kaśca prathamaḥ ? yamakṛtvā pratyayāntaraṃ
kartuṃ na śakyate | sādhāraṇavacano vā, apatyādhikārācca yaḥ
sarvāpatyasādhāraṇaḥ sa eva gotre bhavatīti, gargaśabdādyañeva bhavatīti
| gargaśabdādyo yañ prāptaḥ sa eva bhavati, na prakṛtyantarebhyaḥ prāptāḥ
pratyayā ityarthaḥ, tadāha---pratyayo niyamyata iti | pratyayāntaraṃ
vāryata ityarthaḥ | etena prakṛtirniyamyate ityapi vyākhyātam |
atha vetyādi | asminpakṣe prathamavacana eva śabda iti darśitam | prathamā
prakṛtiriti | sūtre tu śabdāpekṣayā puṃlliṅganirdeśa iti
darśitam | eka eva śabda iti | atha vā---asminpakṣe sādhāraṇavacana
ekaśabdaḥ paramaprakṛtiśca sarvapratyayasādhāraṇī, saṅkhyāvacano vā
prathamātikrame kāraṇābhāvātparamaprakṛtirekaśabdena gṛhyate | anayoḥ
pakṣayoḥ prathamā prakṛtiriti | ekaśabdasyārthato vivaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam
||
gotrādyauunyastriyām || 4|1|94 ||
atrāpyanārabhyamāṇe'sminyoge utpādayitaryapatyayukte gotrasaṃjñāyā
yuvasaṃjñayā bādhitatvādasati pūrvasūtravyāpāre caturthe
tṛtīyātpañcame caturthātṣaṣṭhe pañcamādau yūni tṛtīyādutpattirna
prāpnoti, taṃ pratyanapatyatvāditīṣṭṃa na sidhyati | sarveṣu
tvapatyayukteṣu pañcame yūni pūrvebhyaścaturbhyaḥ pratyayaḥ prāpnoti |
tatra yadā tṛtīyātadā gārgyāyaṇa itīṣṭṃa tāvatsidhyati, aniṣṭamapi
prāpnoti; prakṛtyantarebhyo'pi pratyayaprasaṅgādityata idamārabhyate |
atrāpi yadi pūrvaḥ pakṣa āśrīyate tato vidhyarthametatsyāt,
niyamārthaṃ vā ? yadi yuvaśabdenaikamapatyamucyate, tata ekasminyūni
gotrādagotrācca prāptyabhāvāt caturthena vyavahite pañcamādau
yūni gotrādvidhyarthaṃ bhavati | atha caturthaprabhṛtyapatyasamudāyo
yuvaśabdenocyate, tato gotrāccaturthe caturthādagotrātpañcama iti
gotrādagotrācca yuvasamudāye pratyayaprasaṅge gotrādeveti
niyamārthaṃ bhavati | tatra vidhau gargyāyaṇa itīṣṭṃa sidhyati,
pratyayamālāprasaṅgadoṣaḥ syādeva; tatpitṛvacanātprāptasya
pratyayasyāniṣiddhatvāt | niyame caturthādeḥ prāptasya pratyayasya
pratiṣedho'yaṃ sampadyate---yadi caturthādeḥ syād yuvasamudāye
gotrādapi pratyayaḥ kṛtaḥ syāditi, tataśca nāniṣṭaprasaṅgaḥ; kintu
pañcamādau yūni gotrādutpattirna prāpnoti, taṃ pratyanapatyatvāditi
pañcamasya vākyenābhidhānaṃsyād---gārgyāyaṇasyāpatyamiti | ṣaṣṭhasya
tu vākyenāpi na siddhyati, na hi tatpitṛvacano'patyāpratyayāntaḥ
śabdo'sti, yena vigṛhyaeta | tadevamatrāpi dvitīyaḥ pakṣa āśrīyate,
niyamaśca, tadāha---ayamapi niyama iti | gotrādeveti |
yūnyevetyeṣa viparītaṃ niyamo na bhavati; ṭheko gotre' iti
niyamādyauuno'nyatra gotrapratyayasya prasaṅgābhāvāt | na
paramaprakṛtyanantarayuvabhya iti | anyathā prayogabhedena tebhyo'pi
syāt |
ki punaratra pratiṣidhyata iti | sarvasminnapi pratiṣidhyamāne
doṣadarśanātpraśnaḥ | tameva doṣamāviṣkaroti---yadi niyama iti |
tadekavākyatvātpratiṣedhasyeti bhāvaḥ | striyāmaniyamaḥ prāpnotīti |
paramaprakṛtyanantarayuvalakṣaṇāḥ pratyayāḥ prayogabhedena paryāyeṇa
syurityarthaḥ | atha yuvapratyayaḥ pratiṣidhyata iti | astriyāmiti
yogavibhāgena prasajyaprateṣedhāśrayeṇa ceti bhāvaḥ |
gotrapratyayenābhidhānaṃ na prāpnotīti | tadyathā ṭhgargādibhyo yañ'
gārgī gārgyāyaṇī, apatyasāmānyalakṣaṇa eva tu pratyayaḥ syāt | kiṃ
kāraṇamanabhidhānaṃ prāpnotītyata āha---gotrasaṃjñāyā yuvasaṃjñayā
bādhitatvāditi | yathā ca bādhastathā tatraiva vakṣyate |
syādetat---yuvapratyayasya striyāṃ lukkariṣyate, katham ? ṭhyūni
luk' ityasyānantaraṃ striyāṃ ceti vakṣyāmi, yūni lugityeva,
ṭhprāgdīvyataḥ' ityetannivṛtam | yadvā ṭhvataṇḍācca, luk striyām,
yūni ca' iti vakṣyāmi, luk striyāmityeva, tataśca
gārgyaśabdādutpannasya phako luki kṛte luptasyāpyarthaṃ
prakṛtirevāheti yañantātstriyāṃ vartamānānṅīṣṣphau bhaviṣyata
iti ? evamapyaupagavaśabdādata iño luki kṛte,
anupasarjanādhikārādaṇyo'nupasarjanamityucyamāna īkāro na
prāpnoti; aṇarthasyāpradhānatvāt, yūni saṃkrāntatvāt | mā
bhūdevamaṇyo'nupasarjanamiti, aṇantādanupasarjanādityevaṃ
bhaviṣyati ? naivaṃ śakyam; iha hi doṣaḥ syād---āpiśalinā proktaṃ
vyākaraṇam, ṭhiñaśca' ityaṇ, tadadhīte āpiśalā brāhmaṇī, ṭhtadadhīte'
ityaṇaḥ proktālluki aṇantasyādhyetryāṃ pradhānastriyāṃ
saṃkrāntatvānṅīpprāpnoti,
tasmādaṇyo'nupasarjanamityevāśrayaṇīyam, striyāṃ yo'ṇvihita iti
vā | yathā ca satyaupagavītīkāro na prāpnoti | yadyapyatra
pratyayalakṣaṇena iña upasaṅkhyānamitīkāraḥ syāt, iha tu
glucukāyanerapatyamautsargikasyāṇo luki ṅīnna prāpnoti, ṭhito
manuṣyajāteḥ' iti ṅīṣ bhaviṣyati | iha tarhi yaskasyāpatyaṃ
śivādyaṇ yāskaḥ, tasyāpatyaṃ strī, ṭhaṇo dvyacaḥ' iti phiñ,
striyāṃ luki īkāro na prāpnoti ? na hyatra luptaḥ pratyaya īkārasya
nimitam, yaśca śrūyate na sa striyāṃ vihita upasarjanaṃ ca | tarhi kā
gatiḥ ? ityata āha---tasmāditi | yuvasaṃjñaiva pratiṣidhyata iti | nanu
yūni yaduktaṃ tatstriyāṃ na bhavati' ityuktam, na ca yuvasaṃjñā
yūnyūktā, nahi yuvasaṃjñāyāḥ prāgyuvasaṃjñāsti ?
caturthāderjīvadvaṃśyasyāpatyasyopalakṣaṇaṃ yuvaśabda ityadoṣaḥ |
apara āha---svarūpaparo yuvaśabdaḥ, paribhāṣā ceyam---yatra yuvaśabdaḥ
śrūyate tatra ṭhastriyām' ityupatiṣṭhate | ṭhjīvati tu vaṃśye yuvā
astriyām' iti vā vyaktameva paṭhitavyamiti ||
ata iñ || 4|1|95 ||
akārāntātprātipadikāditi | ṭhata sātatyagamane' ityasya
vā'cchabdāntānāṃ vā kurvadādīnāṃ grahaṇaṃ na bhavati, yadi
syācchivādiṣu yeṣāmasyeño bādhanārthaḥ pāṭhaḥ,
śivaproṣṭhaprauṣṭhikaprabhṛtīnāṃ teṣāṃ pāṭho'narthakaḥ syāt |
vyapadeśivadbhāvādihāpi bhavati---asyāpatyamiriti, yasyeti
lope pratyayamātrasya śravaṇam | iha tu---erapatyamasya yuvreti,
ṭhyañiñośca' iti phaki yasyetilopaṃ bādhitvā paratvādādivṛddhau
kṛtāyām---āyāyana iti bhavati ||
bāhvādibhyaśca || 4|1|96 ||
kvaciditi | ajīgartādiṣūdaṅkaparyanteṣvadantatvātpūrveṇeñ
prāptaḥ, tasya ṭhṛṣyandhakavṛṣṇikurubhyaśca' ityaṇ bādhakaḥ prāptaḥ | anye
sarve'nakārāntāḥ, teṣu ca bāhuprabhṛtiṣūvarṇānteṣu,
puṣkarasadādiṣu halanteṣu cāṇ prāptaḥ | cūḍāśabdād ṭhdvyacaḥ'
iti ḍhak, vṛkalādibhyastannāmikaṇprāptaḥ | śiras, lomanniti
tadantayorgrahaṇam | ṭhsambhūyombhomitaujasāṃ salopaśca' ityeva
vaktavye pṛthak salopaśceti vacanaṃ vaicitryārtham | udañcu iti
paṭha|lte, tatra nāyamukārāntātpratyayaḥ; kintu kvinnantātpratyayaḥ,
nalopābhāvastu nipātyate---udīco'patyamaudañciḥ | etatsarvaṃ
pailādiṣvaudañciśabdapāṭhādvijñāyate |
bāhvādiprabhṛtiṣviti | prabhṛtigrahaṇena vakṣyamāṇānāṃ kuñjādīnāṃ
grahaṇam | loke vidito laukiko gotrabhāvaḥ, saṃjñākāritvam
ādipuruṣatvamityarthaḥ | etacca nyāyasiddham, katham ? arthavadgrahaṇe
nānarthakasyeti arthavatāṃ bāhvādīnāṃ grahaṇam, sa cārthaḥ prasiddhaḥ;
jhaṭiti pratīteḥ | smṛtiśāstrasya
cārthato'nāditvādanādyarthābhidhāyināmeva grahaṇaṃ nyāyyam |
bāhurnāma kaściditi | evaṃ kuñco nāma naḍo vā, tasmādiñeva
bhavati---kauñjiḥ, nāḍiriti | yatu kāryaṃ na svarūpopādānena
vidhīyate, kintu prakārāntareṇa; tadidānīntanārthābhidhāyināmapi
bhavati, ṭhata iñ', daivadatiriti | sambandhiśabdānāṃ ceti
kāryāpekṣayā ṣaṣṭhī, sambandhiśabdānāṃ śvaśurādīnāṃ yatkāryamucyate
tasya tatsadṛśe pratiṣedho bhavati | saṃjñāśvasurasyeti | saṃjñayā yaḥ
śvasuraḥ, na sambandhena | śvāsuririti | uṇādiṣu nāvaśyaṃ
vyutpattikāryaṃ bhavati, tena ṭhsāvaserāptau' iti vyutpannasya
śvasuraśabdasya ṭhna yvābhyām' ityeṣa vidhirna bhavati | tathā
ṭhmātṛpitṛbhyāṃ svasā' iti ṣatvaṃ dhānyamatari na bhavati | idamapi
nyāyasiddham; saṃjñāśvaśurasyādimatvātsambandhiśabdasyānāditvāt |
mātṛpitṛbhyāmityatrāpi prasiddhataratvājjananīvācino grahaṇam | uktaṃ
ca---
abhivyaktapadārthā ye svatantrāḥ lokaviśrutāḥ |
śāstrārthasteṣu kartavyaḥ śabdeṣu na taduktiṣu || iti |
cakāro'nuktasamuccayārtha ākṛtigaṇatāmasya bodhayatīti |
paṭhitaśabdāpekṣaḥ samuccaya iti bhāvaḥ ||
sudhāturakaṅ ca || 4|1|97 ||
vyāsaruḍetyādi | vedaṃ vyasyatīti devavyāsaḥ, ṭhkaraṇyaṇ',
tasyaikadeśaprayogaḥ---vyāsa iti, bhīmaseno bhīma itivat |
varuḍādayo jātiviśeṣāḥ | tatarhi vaktavyam ? na vaktavyam ;
prakṛtyantarāṇyevaitāni svārthikakanpratyayantāni, avyavikanyāyena
ca kan, na hi tairvākyameva bhavati | vyāsaśabdādṛṣivācino'pi
bāhvāderākṛtigaṇatvādiñ bhavati ||
gotre kuñjādibhyaścphañ || 4|1|98 ||
cakāro viśeṣaṇārtha iti | yadyatra cakāro na kriyeta tato
ṭhvrātaphañorastriyām' iti vaktavyam, tatoḥ ṭhaśvādibhyaḥ phañ'
ityasyāgrahaṇaṃ syāt | kauñjāyanya iti | svārthe ñyaḥ bahuṣu tu
ṭhñyādayastadrājāḥ' iti tadrājatvāt ṭhtadrājasya bahuṣu' ityādinā
luk |
kiṃ punaratra ñitsvaro bhavati ? uta citsvaraḥ ?
ityatrāha---ekavacanadvivacanayoriti | tatra hi ñyapratyayaḥ śrūyate, sa
ca paścādbhāvīti tannibandhano ñitsvaraḥ satiśiṣṭaḥ | bahuvacane tu
ñye nivṛte sampradhāraṇā---ñitsvaro vā, citsvaroveti ? tatra
paratvād ñitsvaraḥ prāpnoti, citkaraṇasāmarthyāccitsvaro
bhaviṣyati | ñitkaraṇasāmarthyād ñitsvaraḥ prāpnoti, astyanyat
ñitkaraṇasya prayojanam, kima ? vṛddhyartho ñakāraḥ | citkaraṇe'pi
tarhyastyanyatprayojanam, kim ? viśeṣaṇam | śakyo'tra
viśeṣamārtho'nyo'nubandha āsaṃktum | tatra
cakārānurodhāccitsvaro bhaviṣyati | vṛddhyartho'pi
tarhyanyo'nubandhaḥ āsaṃktum | tatra cakārānurodhāccitsvaro
bhaviṣyati | vṛddhyartho'pi tarhyanyo'nubandhaḥ śakya āsaṃktum, tatra
ñakārānurodhād ñitsvaraḥ prāpnoti ? evaṃ sthite
idamucyate---paramapi ñitsvaraṃ tyaktvā citsvara eveṣyata iti | evaṃ
manyate---svare yogavibhāgaḥ kartavyaḥ, itamasti ṭhcitaḥ'---cito'nta
udāto bhavati, tataḥ ṭhtaddhitasya' cita ityeva, taddhitasya cito'nta
udāto bhavati | kimarthamidam ? paratvātprāptasya ñitsvarasya
bādhanaartham | tataḥ ṭhkitaḥ', kitaśca taddhitasyānta udāto bhavatīti |
yadi tu kphapratyayaḥ kriyate, taddhitasyeti yogavibhāgaḥ
śakyo'kartum | athaivaṃ kasmānna kriyate---ṭhgotre
kuñjādibhyaścphañ, bahuṣu phak, naḍādibhyasca' iti ? naivaṃ
śakyam; iha hi doṣaḥ syāt---kauñjāyanānāmapatyaṃ māṇavakaḥ
kauñjāyanyaḥ, kauñjāyanyau; aikena yaśabdaḥ śrūyate, dvyekayorhi
cphañvidhīyate | yadā tu cphañantāt ñyo vidhīyate tadā
yūnyutpannasyeñaḥ ṭhṇyakṣatriyārṣañitaḥ' iti luki kṛte ṭhtadrājasya'
itiñyasya luki prāpte ṭhgotre'lugaci' iti pratiṣedhādyaśabdasya
śravaṇaṃ bhavati | yathā kauñjāyanyasyāpatyāni bahūni, ata iño luki
tadrājasyaiva bahuṣu vartamānatvād ñyasya luki kauñjāyanā iti
bhavati ||
naḍādibhyaḥ phak || 4|1|99 ||
śalaṅku śalaṅkaṃ ceti | dve api prathamānte | śabdarūpāpekṣayā
napuṃsakanirdeśaḥ | ṭhśalaṅku' ityetacchabdarūpaṃ śalaṅkaṃ bhavati,
tadrūpeṇa pariṇamate ityarthaḥ | iñevānyatreti |
bāhvāderākṛtigaṇatvāditi bhāvaḥ | amyupetyāpi gotramātre phako
vidhānam, parihāramāha---atha veti | iño bhāvasyeti |
śalaṅkabhāvāpaterapyupalakṣaṇametat, pūrvatra parihāre tasyāḥ sa
eva pāṭho jñāpako veditavyaḥ |
agniśarmanvṛṣagaṇa iti | agniśarmanśabdaḥ phakamutpādayati vṛṣagaṇe
gotre, āgniśarmāyaṇo bhavati vārṣagaṇyaśced, āgniśarmo'nyaḥ |
amuṣyeti paṭha|lte, tatrādaḥ śabde prātipadikamātre paṭhitavye
vibhaktyantasya pāṭhādutpanne'pi phaki lugna bhavati | āmuṣyāyaṇā,
āmuṣyaputriketyalugvidhāvasya grahaṇaṃ na kartavyaṃ bhavati | kṛṣṇaraṇau
brāhmaṇavāsiṣṭhayoriti | kārṣṇāyano bhavati brāhmaṇaścet,
kārṣṇiranyaḥ | rāṇāyano bhavati vāsiṣṭhaśced, rāṇiranyaḥ | kroṣṭua
kroṣṭṃa ceti | krauṣṭāyanaḥ ||
haritādibhyo'ñaḥ || 4|1|100 ||
ṭhharitādibhyaḥ', ṭhañaḥ' iti vyadhikaraṇe pañcamyau | haritādibhyaḥ
paro yo'ñ tadantātprātipadikādityarthaḥ | vṛttikāro'pyetadeva
vastuto vyācaṣṭe---haritādibhyo'ñantebhya iti | ṭhharitādibhyo
gotrāpatye'ñpratyayo bhavati' ityayaṃ tvartho na bhavati; bidādiṣu
pāṭhāt | 
sāmarthyāditi | gotrapratyayāntādaparo gotrapratyayo na
bhavatītyetatsāmarthyam | tasmādgotrādhikāre'pi yūni pratyayo
vijñāyate | na caivaṃ gotrādhikārasya viccheda ityāha---gotrādhikāra
iti | utarārthaṃ gotragrahaṇamanuvartata evetyarthaḥ ||
yañiñośca || 4|1|101 ||
gotragrahaṇena yañiñau viśeṣyeti iti | gotre yau yañiñau
vihitāvityevam | na caiva
pratyayārthasyāpatyasyāviśeṣitatvādapatyamātre pratyayaprasaṅga
ityāha---tadantādyauunyevāyaṃ pratyaya iti | evakāraḥ paunarvacanikaḥ--na
kevalaṃ pūrva eva pratyayo yūni bhavati, yamapi yūnyeveti |
kasmāt ? ityāha---gotrādyauunīti vacanāditi ||
śaradvacchunakadarbhād bhṛguvatsāgrāyaṇeṣu || 4|1|102 ||
śaradvadādīnāṃ bhṛgvādivaṃśaprabhavānāṃ kṛtrimā api putrāḥ santi,
svavaṃśaprabhavā api, tatrāpatyaviśeṣaṇaṃ kriyate | tatra bhṛguḥ
śaradvato'patyaṃ na bhavati; pūrvabhāvitvāt | evaṃ śunakasya vatsaḥ,
tasmādbhārgaṃvaśca vātsyaśca āgrāyaṇaśceti dvandve
yugapadadhikaraṇavacanatayā vartipadasya bahuṣu vṛteratribhṛgviti
ṭhyañañośca' iti ca gotrapratyayasya luk,
tadāha---bhārgavaścedvātsyaścediti | dārbhiriti | darbhaśabda
ṛṣivacano na bhavati, bāhvādiṣu vā pāṭhayaḥ ||
droṇaparvatajīvantādanyatarasyām || 4|1|103 ||
