pūrvamuktam--gotrādhikāraśca śivādibhyo'ṇ iti yāvaditi,
ihāpyuktam---gotra ityeveti, tatra nodayati---kathamiti |
naivātreti | yasya grahaṇamūrīkṛtya bhavānānantarye doṣamāha, sa naiva
gṛhyata ityevaśabdasyārthaḥ | mahābhāratedroṇomahābhāratadroṇaḥ |
anādiriti | idānīmeva hyuktam---bāhvādiprabhṛtiṣvityādi |
nanvevaṃ prayogasyātyantamanupapatiḥ ? ityata āha---idānīṃ tviti |
arvācīnādityarthaḥ, na punarmahābhāratadroṇo vṛttikāreṇa
samānakālaḥ; anāderidānīntanasya ca droṇa iti śrutiḥ samānā |
tatrānādidroṇasya ye vaṃśyā aśvatthāmnā samānakālāste droṇāyanā
ityucyante | tatra yad dṛṣṭṃa gotratvaṃ tadaśvatthāmnyapi
droṇaśabdāvācyāpatyatvāt skhalitabuddhayaḥ
pratipatāro'dhyāropayanti | tenādhyāropeṇāaśvatthāmani tathā
drauṇāyana ityetad gotrapratyayenābhidhānaṃ bhavati ||
anṛṣyānantarye bidādibhyo'ñ || 4|1|104 ||
gotra ityeveti | etena ye'tra ṛṣiśabdā bidaurvaprabhṛtayastebhyo
gotra evānyathā syāditi gotra ityetadihānuvartanīyamiti
darśayati---ye punarityādi |
kathaṃ punargotrādhikāre satyayamartho labhyate ?
ityatrāha---anṛṣyānantarya ityasyāyamartha iti | ṭhanṛṣi' iti pañcamyā
lukā nirdeśaḥ, ṭhānantarye' iti svārtheṣyañ | evaṃ ca pautrā
ityādāvanantarasyaivābhidhānam, na gotrasya, nāpatyasāmānyasya ca |
yadyayamartha iti | asmin hyarthe'nṛṣibhyo'nantarāpatye vidhyarthamidaṃ
bhavati, tataśca ṛṣyapatyanairantarye, ṛṣayaśca te'patyāni ca
ṛṣyapatyāni, teṣāṃ nairantarye, ṛṣirūpāṇyapatyāni nirantarāṇi yatra
tasminviṣaye pratiṣedho na kṛtaḥ syāt, tatra ko doṣaḥ ?
ityatrāha---tatredamiti | kaśyapa ṛṣistasyāpatyamapyṛṣiḥ, evam ṭhsapta
nairantaryeṇa ṛṣayasteṣāṃ saptama indrahūrnāma tatra kāśyapānām' iti
prayogo nopapadyate; añi sati ṭhyañañośca' iti lukprasaṅgāt |
tasmād ṭhanṛṣyānantarye' ityasya ṛṣīṇāmānantarye'vyavadhāne pratyayo
na bhavatītyayamartho vyākhyeya iti bhāvaḥ | prayogaṃ
tāvadupapādayati---anantarāpatyarūpeṇeti |
apatyasāmānyarūpeṇetyarthaḥ | na punarṛṣyaṇanantarāpatye vidhīyate |
tatra yathā ṭhabhūnnṛpaḥ' ityādau vastuto bhūtaviśeṣe'pi
sāmānyavivakṣayā lug bhavati, tadvadihāpi vastuto gotre'pi
tadrūpatiraskāreṇāpatyasāmānyarūpavivakṣayā ṛṣyaṇbhavatītyarthaḥ | kiṃ
punaḥ kāraṇamiyaṃ kliṣṭakalpanā''śrīyate ? ityāha---avaśya caitadevaṃ
vijñeyamiti | ṛṣīṇāmapatyānāṃ nairantaryaṃ viṣayo yasya pratiṣedhasya
sa tathoktaḥ | kauśiko viśvāmitra iti duṣyatīti | ki kāranam ?
viśvāmitrastapastepe---nānṛṣiḥ syāmapi tu ṛṣirevasyāmiti, tatra
bhavānṛṣiḥ sampannaḥ; sa punastapastepe---nānṛṣeḥ putraḥ syāmiti,
tatra bhāvan gādhirapyṛṣiḥ sampannaḥ; sa punastapastepe---nānṛṣeḥ
pautraḥ syāmiti, tatra bhavānkuśiko'pi ṛṣiḥ sampannaḥ |
tadetadṛṣyānantaryaṃ sambhavati |
parastrī paraśuṃ ceti | dvitīyānirdeśādāpadyate iti śeṣaḥ |
parastrīśabdaḥ pratyayamutpādayati, paraśuṃ cādeśamāpadyate, parastriyā
apatyaṃ pāraśavaḥ, brāhmaṇasya śūdrāyāmūḍhāyāmutpannaḥ, sā ca jātitaḥ
varastrī bhavati | yastu parabhāryāyāmutpannaḥ pārastraiṇeyaḥ sa bhavati
kalyāṇyādiḥ, anuśatikādiśca | pāraśava ityatra
pūrvotarapadasampramohādanuśatikādikāryābhāvaḥ ||
gargādibhyo yañ || 4|1|105 ||
apatyasāmānye bhaviṣyatīti | anye tu---ṭhmanutantuśabdasamudāya ekaḥ,
na tu dvau śabdau paṭhitau iti vadanti, tathā ca
brāhmaṇe---mānutantavyamuvāceti prayogaḥ |
kālavamanutantukuśikānāmiti ca pravare |
kathaṃ mānavīti | lohitādipāṭhānnityena ṣpheṇa bhāvyamiti bhāvaḥ |
anantarāpatyavivakṣāyāṃ tviti | gotrasyāpīti boddhavyam, tathā ca
jāmadagnāḥ, vātsā iti pravare prayogaḥ | vājā'se iti | vājaśabdo
yañamutpādayati, aseuasamāse | samāse tu sauvājiḥ, ṭhgrahaṇavatā
prātipadikena' ityasyānityatvajñāpanārthaḥ---ṭhase' iti pratiṣedhaḥ ||
madhubarbhvorbrāhmaṇakauśikayoḥ || 4|1|106 ||
gaṇa eva babhrukauśika iti vaktavyam, evaṃ hi dvibebhrugrahaṇaṃ na kartavyaṃ
bhavati ? tathā tu na kṛtamityeva ||
kapibodhādāṅgirase || 4|1|107 ||
kāpeya iti | ṭhitaścāniñaḥ' iti ḍhak | baudhiriti |
anṛṣitvādiñ, bāhvādirvā ||
vataṇḍācca || 4|1|108 ||
kimarthamiti | ṭhvataṇḍālluk striyām' ityeva kasmānnoktam,
kimartho yogavibhāga iti praśnaḥ | pariharati---śivādiṣvapīti |
vataṇḍo nāma ṛṣiḥ, tata ṛṣitvādevāṇi siddhe śivādiṣu tasya
pāṭho gotre gargādiyañā samāveśārthaḥ | tatra yathā'nāṅgirase
samāveśo bhavati, evamāṅgirase'pi syāditi tannivatyartho
yogavibhāga ityarthaḥ ||
luk striyām || 4|1|109 ||
vātaṇḍa|layanīti | lohitādilakṣaṇaḥ ṣphaḥ | vātaṇḍīti | ṛṣitvāt
ṣyañna bhaviṣyati ||
aśvādibhyaḥ phañ || 4|1|110 ||
ye tvatra gotrapratyayāntāḥ paṭha|lnta iti | vailya, ānaḍuhya,
āttreya---ityete | tatra bailyaśabda ṭhvṛddhetkosalājādāññyaṅ'
iti ñyaṅntaḥ, vilirnāma rājarṣaiḥ, ānaḍuhyaśabdo gargādiyañantaḥ,
āttreyaḥ ṭhitaścāniñaḥ' iti ḍhagantaḥ |
śaya āttreye iti | śayaśabdātphañ bhavati āttreyaścet,
śāyāyanaḥ | āttreyādanyatra śāyiḥ, anṛṣitvādiñ, bāhvādirvā |
anye tvaṇameva pratyudāharanti | puṃsi jāta iti | puṃsīti
prakṛtiviśeṣaṇam, jātasyāpatyaṃ jātāyanaḥ | striyāṃ tu jātāyā
apatyaṃ jāteya iti ḍhageva bhavati, anyathā liṅgaviśiṣṭaparibhāṣayā
phañeva syāt | āttreya bharadvāje iti | āttreyāyano bhavati
bhāradvājaścet, anyatrāta iñaḥ ṭhṇyakṣatriya' iti luk |
bhāradvājāttreye iti | atrigotrajo yadā bhāradvājagotrajena
putratvena svīkriyate tadā pratyayaḥ | sa hyattreyaśca bhavati bhāradvājasya
ca gotraṃ bhavati | bhāradvājāyana āttreyaśced, bhāradvājo'nyaḥ,
bidādyañeva bhavati ||
śivādibhyo'ṇ || 4|1|112 ||
yathāyathamityādi | tatrādanteṣviño'pavādaḥ,
muni--sandhibhūmiprabhṛtiṣu ṭhitaścāniñaḥ' iti ḍhakaḥ,
strīpratyayānteṣuṃ ṭhstrībhyo ḍhak' ṭhdra|lcaḥ' iti prāptasya ḍhakaḥ,
gaṅgāvipāṭśabdayostu yasminprāpte sa vṛttikāraṇaivoktaḥ,
jaratkāruśabdasya tu pāṭhe prayojanaṃ cintyam |
kecidāhuḥ---śubhrādiṣvayaṃ paṭhanīyaḥ, jāratkāreya iti yathā syāt,
tatra tu ḍhakā samāveśārtho'sya pāṭha iti | 
ṇyapratyayasya tu bādho neṣyata iti | atrā hetum ṭhudīcāmiñ'
ityatra vakṣyati | 
śubhrādiḍhakā ceti | ṭhśubhrādibhyaśca' ityatra
vakṣyati--ṭhcakāro'nuktasamuccayārtha ākṛkigaṇatāmasya bodhayati,
tena gāṅgeyaḥ pāṇḍaveya ityādisiddhaṃ bhavati' iti,
tadabhiprāyeṇedamuktam | ravaṇaviśravaṇaśabdau paṭha|lete, tau viśravaḥ
śabdasyādeśau prakṛtyantare vā vṛttiviṣaye tatsamānārthe,
viśravaso'patyaṃ vaiśravaṇo rāvaṇaḥ |
dvyaco nadyā iti | nadīvācino ye dvyacaḥ
kulyāprabhṛtayastebhyastannāmikāṇo'pavāde ṭhdvyacaḥ' iti ḍhaki
prāpte'ṇ bhavati | triveṇī trivaṇaṃ ceti | triveṇyā apatyaṃ traivaṇaḥ,
tannamikāṇi siddhe ādeśāryaṃ vacanam | athāṇgrahaṇaṃ kimartham, na
yatāvihitamityevocyeta, evagucyamāne iñādaya eva syuste
vihitāḥ, punarārambhasāmarthyādyo vihito na ca prāpnoti sa evāṇ
bhaviṣyati ? idaṃ tarhi prayojanam---ṛṣṭiṣeṇaśabdo'tra paṭha|lte, tatra
yathāvihitamityucyamāne ṭhata iñ' prāptaḥ, tasya senāntalakṣaṇo
ṇyo bādhakaḥ prāptaḥ, tatrārambhasāmarthyādiñ prasajyeta,
punaraṇgrahaṇādaṇeva bhavati ||
avṛddhābhyo nadīmānuṣībhyastannāmikābhyaḥ || 4|1|113 ||
apatyamantarhitaṃ vṛddhamiti śāstrāntare yatparibhāṣitaṃ tasyāpi grahaṇaṃ
dṛṣṭam, vṛddhasya ca pūjāyām ṭhvṛddho yūnā iti, iha tu
pratyāsateretacchāstrasiddhasyaiva vṛddhasya grahaṇamityāha---vṛddhiryasyeti
| avṛdbhābhya iti śabdadharma iti | vṛddhaparyudāse sati
nañivayuktanyāyena tatsadṛśasyaiva śabdasya sampratyayāt |
strīliṅganirdeśastu ṭhnadīmānuṣībhyaḥ' ityanena
sāmānādhikaraṇyāt | kathaṃ punararthavṛteḥ śabdavṛttinā
sāmānādhikaraṇyam ? abhedopacārāt |
avṛddhaśabdavācyatvānnadīmānuṣya evāvṛddhā uktāḥ | nadīmānuṣībhya
ityarthadharma iti | svarūpagrahaṇaṃ tu na bhavati, bahuvacananirdeśāt,
vṛddhaparyudāsācca saṃjñānadyā api grahaṇaṃ na bhavati; laukikārthavṛttinā
mānuṣīśabdena sāhacaryāt | tannāmikābhya iti sarvanāmnā
pratyayaprakṛteḥ parāmarśa iti | tā avṛddhāḥ prakṛtayo nāmāni yāsāṃ
nadīmānuṣīṇāmiti bahuvrīhiḥ | tadevaṃ tribhirapi padairartha eva
nirdiśyate, tatrārthātpratyayavidhānānupapatestadvācinībhyaḥ prakṛtibhyaḥ
pratyayo vijāyate | tadidamuktam---tenābhedātprakṛtayo nidiśyanta
iti | tenārthonābedāt | etaduktaṃ
bhavati---avṛddhaśabdācyāstannāmikā yā nadīmānuṣyastābhyo'ṇ
pratyayo bhavati, ko'rthaḥ ? tadvācinībhyaḥ pratyayo bhavatīti |
tadetadāha---āvṛddhāni yānītyādi | evaṃ ca kṛtvā---avṛddhebhyo
nadīmanuṣīnāmabhya iti vaktavyam, tathā tu na kṛtamityeva |
ḍhako'pavāda iti | strīliṅganirdeśāt bhaidyoddhyaśoṇādiṣvayaṃ
vidhirna bhavatīti bhāvaḥ ||
ṛṣyandhakavṛṣṇikurubhyaśca || 4|1|114 ||
ṛṣayaḥ prasiddhā vasiṣṭhādaya iti | ṛṣayaḥumantradarśinaḥ, te ca prasiddhā
vasiṣṭhādayaḥ, yathā indrādayo devatāḥ, tena tena paribhāṣaṇīyā iti
bhāvaḥ | vaṃśākhyā iti | keṣāñcidvaṃśānāmetā ākhyā ityarthaḥ | evaṃ
kecidvaṃśā ākhyāyanta iti yāvat | ṭhmadhye'pavādāḥ
pūrvānvidhīnbādhante notarān' ityabhiprāyeṇāha---iñāā'pavāda iti
| attryādibhya iti | tatra ṛṣyaṇovakāśaḥ---vāsiṣṭhaḥ, ṭhitaścāniñaḥ'
iti; ḍhako'vakāśaḥ---ḍulerapatyaṃ ḍauleyaḥ; āttreya
ityubhayaprasaṅge paratvāḍḍhag bhavati | senāntalakṣaṇasya
ṇyasyāvakāśaḥ--- hāriṣeṇyaḥ, atra hi ṭheti saṃjñāyāmagāt' iti
ṣatvasyāsiddhatvātsenāntametadbhavati, ṛṣyaṇaḥ sa eva; jātaseno
nāma ṛṣiḥ, tasmādubhyaprasaṅge paratvād ṇyo bhavati--jātasenyaḥ |
evamudīcāmiñ---jātaseniḥ, andhakāṇo'vakāśaḥ---śvāphalkaḥ, ṇyasya sa
eva, ugrasenādandhakādubhayaprasaṅge paratvāṇṇyo bhavati---augrasenyaḥ
| vṛṣṇyaṇo'vakāśaḥ---vāsudevaḥ, ṇyasya sa eva; viṣvaksenād
vṛṣṇervaiṣvaksenyaḥ | kurvaṇo'vakāśaḥ---nākulaḥ, ṇyasya sa eva,
bhīmasenātkurorbhaimasenyaḥ |
kākatālīyanyāyeneti | yadṛcchayā | asaṅkareṇeti |
śabdāntarairasaṅkīrṇā ityarthaḥ | saṅkalitāḥusaṃhatāḥ | subahava iti
| vyutpapādayiṣitāḥ sarve ityarthaḥ | anityo'pāśrayeṇāpi
nityasyānvākhyānaṃ dṛṣṭam, yathā---śakāśrayeṇa kālasya | atha vetyādi
| ṭhtripuruṣānūkaṃ nāma kuryāt' ityanena nyāyenāndhakādivaṃśā
api nityā eva | teṣu ye śabdā iti | andhakādiṣvevādyatve'pi ye
śabdāḥ prayujyante tebhya ityarthaḥ |
māturutsaṃkhyāsambhadrapūrvāyāḥ || 4|1|115 ||
dvaimātura iti | taddhitārtha dviguḥ, paścātaddhitaḥ | ekasyā aurasaḥ
suto'parasyāḥ kṛtrima iti dvaimāturatvam | sāmmātura iti |
prādisamāsātaddhitaḥ | bhādramātura iti | viśeṣaṇasamāsādaṇ |
tenetyādinā'rthāpekṣyasya strīliṅganirdeśasya phalaṃ darśayati |
dhānyamāturiti | dhānyaṃ yo mimīte sa dhānyamātā,
yājakāditvātṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ | dhānyamātari yo mātṛśabdastasya grahaṇaṃ
na bhavatītyarthaḥ, tena sammimīte tasyāptayaṃ sāmmātra ityutvaṃ na
bhavati, nyāyānuvādaścāyaṃ strīliṅganirdeśaḥ | sambandhiśabdasya hi
prasiddhataratvātasyaiva grahaṇaṃ nyāyyam |
saṅkhyāsambhadrapūrvāyā iti kimiti | na tāvatkevalātprasaṅgaḥ, na
hi māturapatyamiti viśeṣaṇaṃ sambhavati; apatye
mātṛsambandhasyāvyabhicātat | tena tadantasya grahaṇāt
saṅkhyādipūrvasya tāvatsiddhamiti praśnaḥ | anyapūrvasyāpi
syādityutaram | saumātra iti |
kvacidasyānantaraṃ granthaḥ---śubhrādipāṭhādvaimātreya iti | tena
vipūrvo mātṛśabdo na pratyudāhartavya iti bhāvaḥ | vayaṃ
brūmaḥ---ṭhstrībhyo ḍhak' ityatra strīpratyayavijñānādasatyarthagrahaṇe iha na
bhavati | aiḍaviḍo dāradaḥ (4|1|120 sūtre) ityasyānantaramayaṃ granthaḥ,
iha tu lekhakaiḥ pramādāllikhita iti ||
kanyāyāḥ kanīna ca || 4|1|116 ||
ḍhako'pavāda iti | ṭhdvyacaḥ' iti prāptasya | kanyāyā apatyaṃ kānīna
iti | śāstroktavivāhasaṃskārapūrvasya puruṣasamprayogasyābhāvaḥ
kanyāśabdanimitaṃ nākṣatayonitvam | yā tu vivāhasaṃskāreṇa vinā
puruṣeṇa samprayujyate sā kanyātvaṃ na jahāti | tenaitanna
nodanīyam---yadi kanyā nāpatyam, athāpatyaṃ na sā kanyā, kanyā
cāpatyaṃ ceti vipratiṣiddhamiti | apara āha---munidevatāmāhātmyādyā
puṃyoge'pi na kanyātvaṃ jahāti, yathā---kuntī, yathā---satyavatī,
sātrodāharaṇamiti, tadāha---kānīnaḥ karṇaḥ, kānīno vyāsa iti ||
vikarṇaśuṅgacchagalādvatsabharadvājātriṣu || 4|1|117 ||
atra vatsādīnāṃ mūlaprakṛtīnāṃ
vakarṇādīnpratyapatyatvāyogādapatyapratyayāntānāṃ vātsyādīnāṃ
śabdānāṃ dvandveyugadadhikaraṇavacanatayā pratyekaṃ bahutvopajananātasya
bahutvasya lopibhireva kṛtatvādapatyapratyayasya lukā nirdeśaḥ,
tadāha---vaikarṇo bhavati vātsyaścedityādi ||
strībhyo ḍhak || 4|1|120 ||
strīgrahaṇenetyādi | svarūpagrahaṇaṃ tu na bhavati; bahuvacananirdeśāt
| stryarthasyāpi grahaṇaṃ na bhavati; vimātṛśabdasyārthasya subhrādiṣu
pāṭhāt | tasya tu stryarthatvaṃ vidhavāśabdasāhacaryādvijñeyam |
kiñca---strīśabdasya svaritatvaṃ pratijñāyate, svaritena
cādhikārāvagatirbhavati, tena ṭābādistrīpratyayāntānāmeva grahaṇaṃ
yuktam | ktinnādayastu vyavadhānānna gṛhyante | aiḍaviḍaḥ, dārada iti |
iḍaviṭśabdāt ṭhjanapadaśabdātkṣatriyādañ', daracchabdād
ṭhdvyañmagadha' ityaṇ, tayoḥ striyām ṭhataśca' iti luk,
tatastadapatye'ṇeva bhavati |
vṛṣa vācye iti | vṛṣaḥubījāśvaḥ, tena cārthena
viśeṣavihitenāpatyalakṣaṇe'rthe ḍhakā bādhyate, tenāpatye'ṇeva
bhavati | vāḍava iti | catuṣpāllakṣaṇo ḍhañapi na bhavati;
acatuṣpādvācitvāt |
aṇ kruñceti | vṛṣa iti nāpekṣyate, apatya evāyaṃ vidhiḥ |
ḍhako'pavādaḥ | kruñcā ca kokilā ca samāhāradvandve
napuṃsakahrasvatvam ||
dvyacaḥ || 4|1|121 ||
tannāmikāṇo'pavāda iti | anyatra pūrveṇaiva siddhatvāt || 
śubhrādibhyaśca || 4|1|123 ||
yathāyogamityādi | tatrādanteṣviño'pavādaḥ, śalākādiṣu
tannāmikāṇaḥ, vidhavāśabdātu kṣudrālakṣaṇasya ḍhrakaḥ, catuṣpādvāciṣu
catuṣpāllakṣaṇasya ḍhañaḥ, godhāśabdādgodhāyā ḍhrakaḥ; vacanātso'pi
bhavati | kvacidautsargikasyāṇaḥ | pāṇḍaveya iti | ṭhḍhealopo'kadravā'
iti lopo na bhavati, kadrūparyudāsena strīliṅgasya grahaṇāt,
pāṇḍavaśabdādvā pratyayaḥ |
lakṣaṇaśyāmayorvāsiṣṭha iti | lākṣaṇeyo bhavati vāsiṣṭhaścet,
lākṣaṇiranyaḥ; śyāmeyo vāsiṣṭhaḥ, śyāmāyano'nyaḥ, aśvāditvātphañ
||
kulaṭāyā vā || 4|1|127 ||
kulānyaṭatīti kulaṭeti | mūlavibhujādiṣu darśanātkaḥ pratyayaḥ |
pacādyac tu na labhyate, akārādanupapadātkarmopapado
vipratiṣedhenetyaṇprasaṅgāt |
yā tu kulānyaṭantī śīlaṃ bhinatīti | ekatra kule praviṣṭā svairiṇī
yā kulāntaramaṭati sā duḥ śīlā kulaṭetyarthaḥ | kṣudrābhyo veti
paratvāditi | kṣudrāḥuaṅgahīnāḥ śīlahīnāśca | yā
punarbhikṣālipsayā suśīlāpi kulānyaṭati, tasyā iha grahaṇam ||
caṭakāyā airak || 4|1|128 ||
strīliṅganirdeśātpuṃlliṅgānna prasajyata ityāha---caṭakācceti
vaktavyamiti | evaṃ ca puṃlliṅganirdeśa eva kartavyaḥ,
liṅgaviśiṣṭaparibhāṣayā strīliṅgādapi bhaviṣyati, tathā tu na
kṛtamityeva |
striyāmapatye lugvaktavya iti | caṭakāyā apatyamiti | caṭakasyāpīti
draṣṭavyam | caṭaketi | ṭhluktaddhitaluki' iti ṭāpo luki kṛte
punarajādilakṣaṇaṣṭāp kartavyaḥ ||
āragudīcām || 4|1|130 ||
rakā, siddhatvāditi | ṭhna lakṣaṇena padākārā anuvartyāḥ'
ityavagrahe'pi nāsti viśeṣaḥ | jñāpakārthaṃ tviti | bhāvapradhāno
jñāpakaśabdaḥ | jñāpanārthamiti vā pāṭha|lm | jāḍāraḥ, pāṇḍāraiti |
hrasvāntādayaṃ pratyaya iti rakā nāsti siddhiḥ ||
kṣudrābhyo vā || 4|1|131 ||
aṅgahīnā iti | kāṇādayaḥ | śīlahīnā iti |
aniyatapuṃskādāsīprabhṛtayaḥ ||
ḍhaki lopaḥ || 4|1|133 ||
kathaṃ punarityādi | ḍhagvidhau ṭābādistrīpratyayāntānāṃ
grahaṇācchubhrādiṣvasyāpāṭhāt praśnaḥ | etadevetyādi | na hyasato
nimitabhāvaḥ sambhati ||
mātṛṣvasuśca || 4|1|134 ||
pitṛṣvasurityetapekṣyate iti | cakāreṇānukṛṣyata ityarthaḥ |
tadanuvṛtau yo'rthaḥ sampadyate, taṃ darśayati---pitṛṣvasuryaduktamiti
| kiṃ punastadityāha---cchaṇ pratyayo ḍhaki lopaśceti | tena
ṭhanantarasya vidhirvā bhavati prati ṣedho vā' iti ḍhaki lopa eva
prāpnoti, na tu cchaṇiti na codanīyamiti bhāvaḥ ||
catuṣpādbhyo ḍhañ || 4|1|135 ||
kamaṇḍaluśabdaścatuṣpādvacano'sti, dṛśyate hi---kamaṇḍalupada
ādadhīteti | jambuḥuśrṛgālaḥ ||
gṛṣṭa|ladibhyaśca || 4|1|136 ||
aṇādīnāmiti | ādiśabdena ḍhakaḥ | bahuvacanaṃ tu prakṛtibhedena
tayoreva bahutvāt tatrājabasti-mitrayuśabdayoraṇo'pavādaḥ,
śeṣāṇām ṭhitaścāniñaḥ' iti ḍhakaḥ |
gṛṣṭiśabdo ya iti | sakṛtprasūtā strī sarveva gṛṣṭirna
dhevnādiścatuṣpādeveti bhāvaḥ | apara
āha---sakṛtprasūtatvasādharmyeṇācatuṣpadīṣvapi gauṇo gṛṣṭiśabda iti
||
rājaśvaśurādyat || 4|1|137 ||
kṣatriyajātiścediti | prakṛtipratyayasamudāyena kṣatriyajātiśced
gamyetetyarthaḥ | rājanya iti | ṭhye cābhāvakarmaṇoḥ' iti prakṛtibhāvaḥ
| rājano'nya iti | sa punarvaiśyāśūdrayorutpannaḥ, ṭhan' iti
prakṛtibhāvaḥ ||
kṣatrāddhaḥ || 4|1|138 ||
ghapratyayo bhavatīti | ghaśabda eva, na taraptamapau; anyathā sarvatraiva
pratyayavidhau gha iti
taraptamaporgrahaṇātpratyayāderghakārasyeyādeśavacanamanupapannaṃ
syāt, na ca ṭhtugrāddhan', ṭhghacchau ca' iti ghanghacāvavakāśau, tatrāpi
saṃjñāśabdaḥ sānubandha upātaḥ | anubandhastu saṃjñyartha iti sambhavāt,
ṭhṅmuṇnityam' itivat | ṭhkimidabhyāṃ vo ghaḥ' ityatrāpi
taraptamaporevādeśatvaṃ vijñāayate | ayamapi jātiśabda eveti |
rājanyajātyabhidhāne gho bhavati, vaiśyāśūdrayorutpādite tu
iñevetyarthaḥ ||
kulātkhaḥ || 4|1|139 ||
utarasūtra ityādi |
pūrvapadapratiṣedhasyaitatprayojanam---āḍha|lkulādermābhūditi |
grahaṇavatā prātipadikena tadantavidhipratiṣedhādevāḍha|lkulāderna
bhaviṣyati, paśyati tvacāryaḥ---nāyaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ kulaśabde pravartata
iti | tenātra tāvatadantasya grahaṇam ṭhyena vidhistadantasya' ityatra
svarūpamityanuvṛteḥ kevalasyāti grahaṇam | sāmānyāpekṣaṃ ca
jñāpakam---ṭhprātipadikaśrutimatī paribhāṣā kuśalaśabde na pravartate
iti, tena ṭhvyapadeśivadbhāvo'prātipadikena' ityasyā apyapravṛttiḥ |
kulīna iti utarasūtre'nyatarasyāṃgrahaṇātkevalādapyanena kho bhavati |
praśasto vaṃśaḥukulam, tasyāpatyaṃ tatprabhavasyāpatyamityarthaḥ ||
apūrvapadādanyatarasyāṃ yaḍḍhakañau || 4|1|140 ||
nanu ca pūrvapadaśabdaḥ samāsāvayave rūḍhaḥ, na sya kulaśabde prasaṅgaḥ
? ityata āha---samāsasambandhina ityādi | samāsasambandhipūrvapadaṃ
kulaśabdasyāpi kathañcitsambandhi bhavati,
dvayorapyekasamāsāvayavatvāt | vyavasthāvacanastu naivātra
śaṅkanīyaḥ; pūrvapadasabhdasya samāsāvayave rūḍhatvāt | tena
ṭhdevadataḥ kulīnaḥ' ityādau vākye pratiṣedhaśaṅkā na kāryā |
bahucpūrvādapīti | apūrvādityucyamāne bahukulaśabdo bahucā
sapūrva iti, tataḥ pratyayo na syāt | kiñca---devadataḥ kulīna
ityādāvapi pratiṣedhaḥ syāt | tasmādrūḍhiparigrahārthamapi padagrahaṇaṃ
kartavyam ||
vyansapatne || 4|1|145 ||
nanu ca ṭhnityaṃ sapatnyādiṣu' iti sapatnīśabda eva strīliṅgo
vyutpāditaḥ, tatkathaṃ puṃlliṅgasya prayogastatrāha---sapatnaśabda
ityādi | ivārtha iti | sādṛśye, yathā patnī duḥ khahetustathā
śattrurapītyetatsādṛśyam | samudāyena cediti | etena
samudāyārthaḥ sapatno na prakṛtyarthaḥ, nāpi pratyayārthaviśeṣaṇam,
anarthakāvevātra prakṛtipratyayāviti darśayati | athānuvṛtasyāpatyasya
viśeṣaṇameva sapatnaḥ kasmānna bhavati ? tatrāha---apatyārtho'tra
nāstyeveti | etadevodāharaṇena spaṣṭayati---pāpmanā
bhrātṛvyeṇeti | na hi pāpmā bhrātuṣputro bhavati, ataḥ sapatnamātre
bhrātṛvyaśabdasya darśanādapatyārtho'tra nāsti | kiñca, yo'pi sapatno
bhrāturapatyaṃ sambhavati, so'pyādyaudātād
bhrātṛvyaśabdātsapatnarūpeṇaiva pratīyate, nāpatyarūpeṇa | tathā ca
bhrātṛvyo bhrātṛvya iti sahaprayogo'pi vyanvyadantayorbhavati, ataḥ
suṣṭhūaktam---ṭhapatyārtho nāstyeva' iti ||
revatyādibhyaṣṭhak || 4|1|146 ||
ḍhagādīnāmapavāda iti | tatra revatīśabdo ṅīṣantaḥ, aśva, maṇi,
dvāraśabdopapadātpālayateḥ karmaṇyaṇi ṅīp, teṣu ḍhakprāptaḥ |
ṭhvañcu pralambhane', asmādvṛkopapadāt ṭhkartaryupamāne' iti
ṇiniḥ, asmādaṇprāptaḥ vṛkakarṇadaṇḍopapadād graheḥ ṭhkarmaṇyaṇ',
kukkuṭasyevākṣiṇī yasya sa kukkuṭākṣaḥ, eṣviñ prāptaḥ ||
gotrastriyāḥ kutsane ṇa ca || 4|1|147 ||
pāribhāṣikasya gotrasya grahaṇamityāha---apatyaṃ pautreti | laukikasya
tvapatyamātrasya grahaṇaṃ na bhavati, yadi syāt ṭhtatstriyāḥ' ityeva
brūyāt, tacchabdena prakṛtasyāpatyasya parāmarśādeva tadarthalābhāt
| gārga iti | gārgīśabdo ṭhyañaśca' iti ṅībantaḥ, tasya ṭhbhasyā'ḍhea
taddhite' iti puṃvadbhāvena
puṃśabdasyātideśātgārgyaśabdādgotrastryabhidhāyinaḥ pratyayaḥ,
ṭhyasyeti ca', ṭhāpatyasya ca taddhite'nāti' ityallopayalaupau |
glaucukāyana iti | glucukasyāpatyam ṭhprācāmavṛddhātphinbahulam'
iti phin, ṭhito manuṣyajāteḥ' iti ṅīṣ, tasya puṃvadbhāvena
nivṛttiḥ, tataḥ pratyayaḥ, ṇasya ṇitkaṇabhatra vṛddhyartham, gārgyādau
prakṛtereva vṛddhatvāt | iha tu vataṇḍasyāpatyaṃ gotraṃ strī,
ṭhvataṇḍācca luk striyāṃm' vataṇḍī, tasyā apatyaṃ vātaṇḍo jālma
iti puṃvadbhāvena ṅīni nivṛte ṭhluk' striyām' ityasya
ṭhgotre'lugaci' iti pratiṣedhādvātaṇḍa|lśabdādeva pratyayaḥ | iha ca
gārgyā apatyaṃ strī gārgā, sā bhāryā yasya sa gārgābhārya iti
ṭhjāteśca' ityeva puṃvadbhāvapratiṣedhasiddhiḥ, ṭhgotraṃ ca caraṇaiḥ saha'
ityapatyamātraṃ gṛhyate, tena vṛddhinimitasya ceti
puṃvadbhāvapratiṣedho na prayojanam | kiñca---gārgyā apatyaṃ
strītyatrārthe nāsti pratyayaḥ, ṭhastriyām' iti yuvasaṃjñāyā
niṣedhādgotrasaṃjñaivāvatiṣṭhate, tatra ṭheko gotre' iti niyamānnaiva
gotrapratyayāntādaparo gotrapratyayaḥ sambhavati, tena nāsti gārgā,
natarāṃ gārgābhāryaḥ |
apara āha---asti gārgā, katham ? gārgyā apatyaṃ yā strī na sā
yuvatirnāpi gotram; na hi sā gargasyāpatyaṃ
pautraprabhṛteścāpatyasya sotrasaṃjñā vidhīyate, tadabhāvād ṭheto
gotre' iti niyamābhāvaḥ, tataśca ṇasya bhāvādasti gārgeti |
ye tu nāsti gārgetyāhuḥ, tena manyante---mātṛvaṃśaḥ pitṛvaṃśaśca
dvāvapi vaṃśau pratīyamapatyaṃ bhavati; apātahetutvāt | tataśca
gārgyā apatyaṃ yatra strī sā gargasyā patyaṃ bhavatyeva,
ṭhpautraprabhṛtigrahaṇaṃ ca vyavahitāpatyopalakṣaṇ, tena gargāpekṣayā
tasyā gotratvād ṭheko gotre' iti niyamātpratyayāntarābhāva iti |
vṛtau tu kvacitpaṭha|lte---gotrādyauunīti yūni pratyayo bhavatīti |
tadapyasminneva pakṣe ghaṭate, tadāha---gārgyā apatyaṃ pumānyuvā
bhavati gārgeyo māṇavaka iti | mātāmahāderupalakṣaṇārtho'yaṃ prayoga
iti nāsti kutsā ||
vṛddhāṭṭhak sauvīreṣu bahulam || 4|1|148 ||
atra ṭhvṛddhiryasyācāmādistadvṛddham' iti vṛddhaṃ gṛhyate, na
tvapatyamantarhitaṃ vṛddhamiti śāstrāntaraparibhāṣitam | utarasūtre hi
vakṣyati---phiño grahaṇaṃ na phinaḥ, vṛddhādhikārāditi | sauvīreṣviti
prakṛtiviśeṣaṇamiti | ṭhgotrastriyāḥ' ityato
gotragrahaṇānuvṛtergotrapratyayāntā yā prakṛtistasyā
viśeṣaṇamityarthaḥ | vṛddhātsauvīragotrāditi | idamapi
pāribhāṣikasyaiva vṛddhasya grahaṇe ghaṭate, anyathā sauvīreṣu
yadvṛddhaṃ tasmāditi vaktavyam | bhāgavitāyana iti | ṭhyañiñośca'
iti phak | tṛṇabindorapatyamiti autsargiko'ṇtārṇabindavaḥ,
tataṣṭhak | pūrvaṭhaggrahaṇaṃ ṇena sambaddham, atastadanuvṛtau
tasyāpyanuvṛttiḥ syāditi punariha grahaṇam |
bhāgapūrvapadau vitiriti | vityanta ityarthaḥ | bhāgavitiśabda iti
yāvat | gotrāṭṭhagbahulaṃ tata iti | ṭhgotrastriyāḥ' ityato
gotragrahaṇānuvṛtyā gotravacanātprātipadikādvahulaṃ yaṣṭhagucyate sa
tatastebhya eva bhāgavitiprabhṛtibhyastribhya eva bhavati, nānyebhya iti
parigaṇanaślokārthaḥ |
nanu gotragrahaṇamanuvartate, yacca sauvīrasagotravṛttiprātipadikaṃ
tadvṛddhameva, tatkimarthaṃ vṛddhagrahaṇam ? ata āha---vṛddhagrahaṇaṃ
strīnivṛtyarthamiti | taddhi gotragrahaṇaṃ striyā viśeṣaṇam,
atastadanuvṛtau strīgrahaṇamapyanuvarteta, vṛddhagrahaṇasāmarthyātu
gotragrahaṇamevānuvartate, na strīgrahaṇamiti vyācakṣate |
apatyamantarhitaṃ vṛddhamityasya tu vṛddhasya grahaṇe'samañjaso'yaṃ granthaḥ
syāt | aupagaviriti |
nanu ca parigaṇanādevātra na bhaviṣyati ? tanna; na hi
sūtrakāro'rvācīnaparigaṇanāśrayeṇātiprasaṅganivāraṇaṃ manyate,
vāgrahaṇa eva kartavye yadvahulagrahaṇaṃ kṛtaṃ tasya
prayojanamāha---bahulagrahaṇamityādi | vaicitryameva
darśayati---gotrastriyā ityārabhyeti | tatrāntyaḥ sauvīragotra eveti
| ayamevārtho yatnasādhyaḥ ||
pheśccha ca || 4|1|149 ||
yamundaścetyādi | atra vārṣyāyaṇīti śabdarūpāpekṣāyā
napuṃsakanirdeśaḥ | phiña iti | phiñantā ityarthaḥ | smṛtā iti | ete
trayaḥ phiñantāḥ prakṛtayaḥ smṛtā ityarthaḥ | sauvīreṣu ca
kutsāyāmiti | punaścakāro vṛtabhaṅgabhayānna paṭhitaḥ |
bahulagrahaṇātsiddho'yamarthaḥ pūrvaṃ vṛttikṛtā darśitaḥ, idānīṃ tu
ślokavārtikakāreṇetyapaunaruktyam | suyāmaśabdo'pi tikādiḥ |
vṛṣasyāpatyaṃ vārṣyāyaṇiḥ | ayamapi tikādireva,
ṭhdagukosalakarmāracchāgavṛṣāṇāṃ yuḍ vādiṣṭasya' iti vacanād
āyanādeśe kṛte yuḍāgamaḥ ||
phāṇṭāhṛtimimatābhyāṃ ṇaphiñau || 4|1|150 ||
tena yathāsaṃkhyāmiha na bhavatīti | evaṃ ca kṛtvā ṇasya
ṇitkaraṇamarthavadbhavati, taddhi mimataśabde vṛddhyartham | yathāsaṃkhye
tu phāṇṭāhṛtervṛddhatvāṇiṇatkaraṇamanarthakaṃ syāt | iha tu
phāṇṭāhṛtābhārya iti gārgābhārya itivatpuṃvadbhāvapratiṣedhādikaṃ
draṣṭavyam | yathā tu vārtikaṃ tathā yathāsaṃkhyamatreṣyate,
yathāha---ṭhphāṇṭāhṛterṇasya ṇitkaraṇānarvasyaṃ vṛddhatvāt',
ṭhprātipadikasya puṃvadbhāvapratiṣedhāryaṃ tu', ṭhuktaṃ vā' iti ||
kurvādibhyo ṇyaḥ || 4|1|151 ||
nanu ca ṭhkurunādibhyo ṇyaḥ' ityeva kuruśabdāṇṇayaḥ siddhaḥ,
kimarthamiha paṭha|lte ? ata āha---kuruśabdādaparo'pīti |
satyamaparo'pi ṇyapratyayo bhaviṣyati | sa tu
tratriyādityanenārthabhedamāha | tadrājasaṃjñaka ityajena rūpabhedamāha |
tikādiṣu pāṭhāditi | kurukauravyaśabdau dvāvapi paṭha|lete |
kāriṇastu rathakāraśabdāditi | kāriṇaḥuśilpinaḥ | rathakārajātistu
śilpivṛttirna bhavatīti manyate |
tasya puṃvadbhāvo na bhavatīti | ṭhbhasyā'ḍhea taddhite' iti
vidhīyamānaḥ, yadi hi syāt ṭhnastaddhite' iti ṭilopaḥ syāt |
kasmānna bhavatītyāha---strīpratyayanirdeśasāmarthyāditi |
puṃliṅgasyāpi pāṭhe liṅgaviśiṣṭaparibhāṣayā keśinīśabdādapi
siddhaḥ pratyayaḥ, puṃlliṅgātvanabhidhānānna bhaviṣyatīti bhāvaḥ |
vāmarathasya kaṇvādivatsvaravarjamiti gaṇavākyaṃ
vyācaṣṭe---vāmarathaśabda ityādi | tasyeti
prakaraṇāṇṇyapratyayāntasyeti vijñeyam | kaṇvādibaditi |
kevalānāṃ teṣāṃ kasyacitkāryasyāvidhānādyañantānāṃ kaṇvādīnāṃ
yatkāryaṃ tasyātideśaḥ | lugādikamiti | kaṇvādiṣu yañanteṣu
dṛṣṭamātrasya kāryasyātideśaḥ, na tu kaṇvāditvapratyuktasya, ata eva
svaravarjamityāha | tena lugādikamapyatidiśyate, na tu
ṭhkaṇvādibhyo gotre' ityeva pratyayavidhiḥ | vāmarathā iti |
ṭhyañañośca' iti bahuṣu luk | yañaśca ṭhprācāṃṣpha taddhitaḥ', yūni
ṭhyañiñośca' iti phak; śaiṣikeṣvartheṣu che prāpte ṭhkaṇvādibhyo
gotre' ṭhsaṅghāṅkalakṣaṇeṣu' iti cāṇ bhavati | samrājaḥ kṣatriya
iti | samrājo'patyaṃ sāmrājyo bhavati, kṣatriyaścet; sāmrājo'nyaḥ
||
senāntalakṣaṇakāribhyaśca || 4|1|152 ||
lakṣaṇeti svarūpagrahaṇamityāha---lakṣaṇaśabdāditi |
kārītyarthagrahaṇamityāha---kārivacanebhyaśceti | sādhu kurvantīti
kāriṇaḥuśilpinaḥ | nāpitya iti | prācāṃ mate ṇya udāhṛtaḥ | udīcāṃ
tu mate paratvād ṭhudīcāṃ vṛddhāt' iti phiñeva
bhavati---nāpitāyaniriti ||
udīcāmiñ || 4|1|153 ||
tākṣṇa iti | ṭhṣapūrvahandhaṛtarājñāmaṇi' ityallopaḥ | tākṣaṇya iti |
ṭhye cābhāvakarmaṇoḥ' iti prakṛtibhāvaḥ | iha ṭhsenāntalakṣaṇakāribhyo
vā' iti vaktavyam, nārtho'neneñvacanena, nāpi śivādiṣu
takṣanśabdasya pāṭhena, ṇye hi vikalpite yo yataḥ prāpnoti satato
bhavatīti lakṣṇaḥ ṭhprāgdīvyato'ṇ', anyebhyaśca ṭhata iñ' bhaviṣyati
? naivaṃ śakyam; evaṃ hi jātasenādibhya ṛṣyādilakṣaṇo'ṇ
prāpnoti ||
tikādibhyaḥ phiñ || 4|1|154 ||
kṣatriyavacana iti | yaḥ ṭhkurunādibhyo ṇyaḥ' iti vyutpāditaḥ |
auraśaśabdeneti | urasā śete uraśaḥ kṣatriyaḥ,
pṛṣodarāditvādrūpam, tasyāpatyam ṭhjanapadaśabdātkṣatriyāt'
ityañ | 
kiṃ punarevaṃ prayatnena kṣatriyavacanasya grahaṇaṃ vyākhyāyate ?
ityatrāha---tathā ceti | udāhṛtamiti | pūrvairapi vṛttikārairityarthaḥ
|
tiknoterigupadhātkaḥ, tikaḥ | kiṃ tavāstīti pravartate kitavaḥ,
pṛṣodarādiḥ | sampūrvājjānāteḥ ṭhātaścopasarge' iti kaḥ, striyāṃ
ṭāp, saṃjñā | bālairbaddhā śikhāsya sa bālaśikhaḥ | dvau
śabdāvityanye, balaterṇijantādac bālaḥ, tasya bālāyaniḥ |
śikhāśabdena tadvān lakṣyate, śaikhāyaniḥ | uraśaśabdo vyutpāditaḥ |
ṭhśaṭakutsāyām' pacādyac, tato gargāditvādyañ---śāṭa|lḥ; tato
yūni phiñ | sindhuśabdād ṭhdvyañmagadha' ityaṇ, saindhavaḥ,
atrāpi yūni phiñ | yamamunatītiyamundaḥ, śakandhvādi | praśastaṃ
rūpamasyāsti ṭhrūpādāhatapraśaṃsayoryap', rūpyaḥ | grāme bhavo grāmyaḥ
| nīla varṇe, igupadhātkaḥ nīlaḥ | ṭham roge', auṇāadika itraḥ,
amitraḥ | gaukākṣyo gargādiyañantaḥ | ṭhkṛgroruḥ', kuruḥ | devasyeva
ratho'sya devarathaḥ | tiletilaḥ, titilaḥ, pṛṣodarādiḥ, tato
matvarthīya in, titilino'patyamautsargiko'ṇ, ṭhnastaddhite' iti
ṭilopaḥ, taitilaḥ | auraśaśabdo vyutpāditaḥ | ṭhkurunādibhyo
ṇyaḥ', kauravyaḥ | bhūri asyāsti bhūriko vrīhyādiḥ, tasyaiva pakṣe
kapilāditvāllatvaṃ bhūlikaḥ, tābhyāmata iñ, bhaurikiḥ, bhaulikiḥ |
ṭhcupa mandāyāṃ gatau' ṇyantāllaṭaḥ śatrādeśaḥ, tasyāpatyaṃ
caupayataḥ, evaṃ caitayataḥ | ṭhciṭa parapreṣye', ṇyantāllaṭaḥ śatrādeśaḥ,
tasyāpatyaṃ caiṭayataḥ | ṭhśīkṛ secane', ṇijādi pūrvavat, śaikayataḥ
| kṣitamācaṣṭe kṣitayan, tasyāpatyaṃ kṣaitayataḥ | dhvajo'syāsti
dhvajavān, tasyāpatyaṃ dhvājavataḥ | dvau śabdāvityanye, ṭhdhvaja gatau'
ṇyantātpacādyac, dhvājaḥ; vanotestaḥṣa vataḥ | ṭhcadi āhlādane',
tato ramas candramāḥ, tasyāpatyaṃ cāndramasāyanirbudhaḥ |
śobhate'sau śubhaḥ, igupadhātkaḥ | gamergan, gaṅgā | vṛña eṇyaḥ,
vareṇyaḥ | sarvadhātubhyo manin, yānaṃ yāmā, śobhanaṃ yāmāsya
suyām | ārado nāma janapadaḥ, tato'patye ṭhjanapadaśabdāt'
ityañ---āradaḥ | vahyaṃ karaṇam, vahyameva vahyakā, nipātanāditvābhāvaḥ
| khalāya hitā khalyā, ṭhkhalayava' iti yat | ṭhvṛṣu secane'
igupadhātkaḥ---vṛṣaḥ | lomāni kāmayati lomakā | udakamicchatyātmana
udanyaḥ, ṭhaśanāyodanyadhanāya' ityudakasyodanbhāvaḥ, tataḥ pacādyac |
yajñayogādyajñaḥ | ete tikādayaḥ ||
kausalyakārmāryābhyāṃ ca || 4|1|155 ||
kosalaśabdād ṭhvṛddhetkosalājādāñ ñyaṅ',
karmāraśabdātkārilakṣaṇo ṇyaḥ, etayoriha grahaṇamiti
śaṅkāmapākaroti---paramaprakṛtereveti | kathaṃ tarhi vikṛtaṃ
prakṛtirūpaṃ śrūyate ? tatrāha---pratyayasaṃyogena tviti | na ceyaṃ
svamanīṣiketyāha---tathā ceti | yuḍvādiṣṭasyeti |
pūrvāntakaraṇe dāṃgavyāyaniḥ, orguṇo na syāt, ataḥ
parādikaraṇam | ādiṣṭesyeti | kṛtāyanādeśasyetyarthaḥ |
etasminnanucyamāne'navakāśatvādyauṭi kṛte'nāditvādāyanādeśo na
syāt ||
aṇo dvayacaḥ || 4|1|156 ||
kārtrāyaṇiriti | karturapatyamityaṇ, kārtraḥ, tato yūni phiñ,
tasyābrāhmaṇagotrāditi lugna bhavati, vidhānasāmarthyāt | apara
āha--- kartuśchāttraḥ kārtraḥ, ṭhtasyāpatyam' ityādāvagotre
carirtthaṃ vacanamiti | apara āha---apatyagrahaṇamāvartate,
tatraikenāṇ viśeṣyate, apareṇa pratyayārtho nidiśyate,
tataścāpatyasyaivāṇo grahaṇādastyeva vacanasāmarthyamiti ||
udīcāṃ vṛddhādagotrāt || 4|1|157 ||
kāriśabdādapīti |
kārilakṣaṇasyodīcāmiño'vakāśaḥ---tāntuvāyiḥ,
phiño'vakāśaḥ---āmraguptāyaniḥ; nāpitādubhayaprasaṅge phiñ
bhavati | yājñadatiriti | ṭhvā nāmadeyasya vṛddhasaṃjñā vaktavyā' | pakṣe
yājñadatāyaniriti bhavatyeva ||
vākinādīnāṃ kuk ca || 4|1|158 ||
yadiha vṛddhagotramiti | vākina-gāredha-kāka--ityete trayaḥ | vacanaṃ
vākaḥ so'syāsti vākinaḥ, barhiṇavadupapādyaḥ | agāre edhate gāredhaḥ,
pṛṣodarāditvādādilopaḥ, śakandhvāditvātpararūpam | kāyateḥ
kākaḥ, ṭhanyeṣāmapi' iti kaḥ | karkaṭasyāpatyaṃ kārkaṭa|lḥ, gargādiḥ,
kurvādirvā | ṭhlaṃghayaterlaṅkā, asmādeva nipātanād ghasya
kādeśaḥ | varmacarmaśabdau vrīhyādī |
iñādyapavāda iti | varmicarmiṇoraṇ prāptaḥ, laṅkāśabdāt
ṭhdvyacaḥ' iti ḍhak prāptaḥ, yañantād ṭhyañiñośca' iti phak;
seṣabhya iñ prāptaḥ, ṭhvarmicarmiṇornalopaśca' iti kuki kṛte
prātipadikasyānakārāntatvānnalopo na prāpnotīti vidhīyate |
yadi punarayaṃ kuk parādiḥ kriyate, āyanādeśo na syāt;
phasyānāditvāt | yadā na liṅgaviśiṣṭaparibhāṣayā
varmiṇī-carmiṇīśabdābhyāṃ pratyayo bhavati, tadā ṭhbhasyā'ḍhea taddhite'
iti puṃvadbhāvo na syāt ||
putrāntādanyatarasyām || 4|1|159 ||
pūrveṇāiva pratyayaḥ siddha iti | tenāsāviha vidhīyate | kathaṃ tarhi
pañcamyā nirdeśa ityāha---putrāntādityādi ||
prācāmavṛddhātphinbahulam || 4|1|160 ||
vikalpārthā iti | vikalpaprayojanam | tatrā''cāryopādānaṃ
matāntare pratyayasyābhāvaṃ dyotayati, bahulagrahaṇaṃ tu
kvacitpravṛtyādikam, anyatarasyāṃśabdastu vikalpameva,
teṣāmekenaiva siddhyatīti prakaraṇādvikalpa iti gamyate | kimarthaṃ
tarhi sarveṣāṃ grahaṇam ? tatrāha---tatreti | bahulagrahaṇaṃ
vaicitryārthamiti | pāriśeṣyādanyasya grahaṇaṃ vikalpārthamityuktaṃ
bhavati | vaicitryameva darśayati---kvaciditi ||
manorjātāvañyatau ṣukca || 4|1|161 ||
tathā ceti | apatyārthe tu sati ṭhyañañośca' iti bahuṣu luk
prasajyeta; laukikasya gotrasya tatra grahaṇāt |
apatye kutsita iti | ṇatvavidhānārthamidam, aṇaḥ siddhatvāt | na ca
ṭhna daṇḍamāṇavāntevāsiṣu' iti ṇatvasiddhiḥ,
arthaviśeṣasyāniścāyād | anadhītavedatvānmūḍhatvam |
vihitākaraṇātpratiṣiddhasevanācca kutsitatvam ||
apatyaṃ pautraprabhṛti gotram || 4|1|162 ||
tadgotrasaṃjñaṃ bhavatīti | apatyamātrasya loke
gotratvādapatyaviśeṣe gotraśabdasya niyamātparibhāṣeyaṃ yuktā, na
saṃjñeti cet ? na; liṅgavatī paribhāṣā bhavati, yathā---ṭhiko
guṇavṛddhī' iti, vidhyantaraśeṣabhūtā vā, yathā---ṭhvipratiṣedhe paraṃ
kāryam' iti, na ceyaṃ tathā; kiñca vṛddhyādayo'pi
sarvārthapratyāyanayogyāḥ saṃjñiviśeṣe śaktyavacchedena niyamyante |
atha ca tāḥ saṃjñāstatheyamapi bhaviṣyati | uktaṃ ca---
vyavahārāya niyamaḥ saṃjñānāṃ saṃjñini kvacit |
nitya eva tu sambandho ḍitthādiṣu gavādivat ||
vṛddhyādīnāṃ ca śāstre'smin śaktyavacchedalakṣaṇaḥ |
akṛtrimo hi sambandho viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyavat || iti |
yadi pautraprabhṛterapatyasya gotrasaṃjñā kriyate, gargasyāpi prāpnoti,
so'pi kañcitprati pautro bhavatyeva, tatra ko doṣaḥ ?
ṭhgotrādyauunyastriyām' iti yūni pratyayaprasaṅgaḥ, gārgyādeva tu
yūnīṣyate ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; ihāpatyagrahaṇaṃ na kartavyam,
pautrasyāpatyatvātatprabhṛterapatyasyaiva grahaṇaṃ siddham, tat
kriyate---apatyarūpeṇa pratibhāsāmānasya yathā syāt,
vastuto'patyasya mā bhūdityevamartham | ato'patyarūpeṇa
pratibhāsamānasya gargasya na bhaviṣyati | nanu cāsatyapyapatyagrahaṇe
pautraprabhṛtirūpeṇa pratibhāsamānasya saṃjñāyā vijñānātena
rūpeṇāpratibhāsamānasya margasya na bhaviṣyatīti kimapatyagrahaṇena !
yadyevam, aupagavasyāpi na syāt, so'pi hyapatyarūpeṇa pratibhāsate,
na tu pautraprabhṛtirūpeṇa, apatyamātre pratyayavidhānād
gārgyādereva tu syād---yatra gotra eva pratyayaḥ | kutaścāyamartho
labhyate---pautraprabhṛtirūpeṇa pratibhāsamānasyeti ?
tadgrahaṇasāmarthyāditi cet, sarvasyāpi yatkiñcitprativastutaḥ
pautraprabhṛtitvāvyabhicārāt pautraprabhṛtigrahaṇaṃ na kartavyaṃ bhavati |
tadgrahaṇasāmarthyādayamartho labhyata iti ? tanna;
saṃjñinirdeśārthatvādacetanavyāvṛtyarthatvācca | ṭhgotram'
ityetāvati hyukte kasya saṃjñā syāt, rathādīnāṃ ca vastuto'pi
pautraprabhṛtitvaṃ nāsti | ato vastutaḥ pautraprabhṛtergargasya mā
bhūt, apatyarūpeṇa pratibhāsamānasya yathā syādityevamarthaṃ
tvapatyagrahaṇaṃ kartavyam | sambandhiśabdatvācca
pautraprabhṛtyapatyaśabdayoryaṃ prati pautraprabhṛtitvamapatyatvaṃ ca tameva
prati gotrasaṃjñā vijñāyate | tenāṅgirasaḥ pautre gargasyānantare na
bhavati ṭhgargādibhyo yañ' | tadetatsarvamuktam |
sambandhiśabdatvādityādi | yasya yadapatyamiti | pratibhāsata iti bhāvaḥ
| tadayamatra sūtrārthaḥ---vastutaḥ pautraprabhṛtirapatyarūpeṇaṃ
pratibhāsamāno'rtho yaṃ pratyapatyarūpeṇa pratibhāsate yaṃ ca prati
vastutaḥ pautraprabhṛtiḥ, taṃ prati gotrasaṃjña iti |
apatyamiti vyapadeśāyeti | saṃjñina iti śeṣaḥ | apatyarūpeṇa
pratibhāsamānasya saṃjñino vyapadeśo yathā syādityevamarthamityarthaḥ |
iha kasmānna bhavati---gargāpatyasya tṛtīyāderapatyamiti, atra hi
gargāpatyaśabdena gargaṃ pratyapatyarūpeṇa pratibhāsamānasya vastutaḥ
pautraprabhṛtergargaṃ prati gotrasaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ gargasya caturthe
jīvadvaṃśye ṭhgotrādyauuni' iti gargāpatyaśabdātpratyayaḥ prāpnoti ? naiṣa
doṣaḥ; saṃjñāprakaraṇa evāsminkartavye'patyapratyayeṣu vidhīyamāneṣu
madhye saṃjñākaraṇaṃ pratyayavācyasyāpatyasya parigrahārtham | yadidaṃ
ṭhtasyāpatyam' ityārabhya pratyayārthatvena nirdiṣṭamapatyaṃ
tadgotrasaṃjñamiti, tenāpatyaśabdena pratibhāsamānasyāpatyasya saṃjñā
na bhaviṣyati | nanu ca ṭhte tadrājāḥ' ityatra tacchabdenājādīnāmeva
parigraho yathā syātpūrveṣāṃ mā bhūditi madhye saṃjñākaraṇaṃ syāt |
yadyetāvatprayojanaṃ syād, ṭhañādayastadrājāḥ' ityeva brūyāt,
tasmāduktameva sākṣātprayojanamasmin prakaraṇe saṃjñākaraṇasya |
sthite tvevamuktamapi prayojanaṃ bhavatyeva, ata eva tatra
vakṣyati---gotrayuvasaṃjñā kāṇḍena vyavahitatvāditi ||
jīvati tu vaṃśye yuvā || 4|1|163 ||
abhijanaprabandho vaṃśa iti | abhijanāḥupitrādayaḥ, abhijāyante yebhyaḥ
putrādaya iti kṛtvā | prabandhaḥusantānaḥ | tatra bhavo vaṃśya iti |
digāditvādyat | pautraprabhṛtyapatyamiti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ, yadyatrāpi
pūrvavat ṭhpautraprabhṛti' ityetatsāmānādhikaraṇyenāpatyaṃ
viśeṣayet, tṛtīyasyāpi jīvadvaṃśyasya yuvasaṃjñā syāt; tatra ko
doṣaḥ ? yuvasaṃjñayā gotrasaṃjñāyā bādhitatvādgargādibhyo yañ
syāt, na kaścidapatyapratyayaḥ | kiṃ kāraṇam ? gotrādeva yūnīti
niyamāt, nānantarānna mūlaprakṛteḥ | tasmādvākyenaivābhidhānaṃ
prāpnoti---gargasyāpatyaṃ gārgerapatyamiti | etenopagostṛtīyo
jīvadvaṃśyo vyākhyātaḥ, tasmādvaiyadhikaraṇyena
viśeṣaṇamityāha---pautraprabhṛtīti | ṣaṣṭhī vipariṇamya iti | atra ca
vyākhyānameva śaraṇam |
tuśabdo'vadhāraṇārtha iti | anekārthatvānnipātānāṃ bhinnakramo
yuvaśabdānantaraṃ draṣṭavya ityāha---yuvaiva bhavati, na gotramiti |
asatyavadhāraṇe ekasaṃjñādhikārādanyatra saṃjñāyāṃ
samāveśābhyupagamātkṛtyapratyayasaṃjñānāmiva gotrayuvasaṃjñayoḥ
samāveśaḥ syāt | astu, ko doṣaḥ ? yaskasyāpatyaṃ gotram
ṭhśivādibhyo'ṇ' tadantādyauuni ṭhaṇo dvyacaḥ' iti phiñ, vṛddhau,
yasyeti lope kṛte yāskāyaniriti | bahuṣu ṭhyaskādibhyo gotre'
iti phiño luk prasajyeta; ekadeśavikṛtasyānanyatvāt |
yaskādibhyo'nantarasya gotrapratyayastha lugucyate, na cātrānantaraḥ
phiñ | śivādyaṇo yasyeti lopaḥ, tasya pūrvasmādapi vidhau
sthānivadbhāvādyaskādibhyo'nantarasya vihitasyeti vā vijñāsyate |
iha ca kaṇvasyāpatyaṃ kāṇvyaḥ, tasyāpatyaṃ yuvā kāṇvyāyanaḥ,
tasyacchāttrāḥ kāṇvāyanīyā iti, ṭhkaṇvādibhyo gotre' ityaṇ na
bhavati, kaṇvādibhyaḥ paro yo'nantaro yo vā tebhyo gotre
vihitastadantādityāśrayaṇāt | iha ca
aupagavasyāpatyamaupagaviriti ṭhgotrādyauuni' iti pratipadavidhānāt,
ṭheko gotre' iti niyamo bādhiṣyate | yadi bādhyate,
aupagaveryūno'patyamiti caturthasya yūno gotratvātpañcame yūni
phak prāpnoti ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; pañcame yūni vivakṣite utpannasyeñaḥ
yūni ṭhluk' iti luki kṛte aupagavaśabdādaṇantātpunarapīñeva
bhaviṣyati | iha tarhi dākṣerapatyaṃ
dākṣāyaṇasyāpatyamityarthavivakṣāyām ṭhphakphiñoranyatarasyām' iti
phako lugabhāvapakṣe tadantādiñ prāpnoti ? kiñca
aupagaverapatyamityatrāpi lupte'pīñi pratyayalakṣaṇena phakprāpnoti ?
evaṃ tarhi ṭhgotrādyauuni' ityatra ekagrahaṇanuvartiṣyate, tenānekaḥ
pratyayo na bhaviṣyati | yastarhi ṭhgotre'lugaci' ityulak
so'trīṇāṃ yūnāṃ chātra ityādau prāpnoti, yūno'pi gotratvāt
? prāpnotu, taṃ bādhitvā paratvādyauuni lugbhaviṣyati ? naivaṃ śakyam,
phakphiñorhi doṣaḥ syāt---śālaṅkerapatyaṃ śālaṅkiḥ, pailādiṣu
pāṭhādiñ śalaṅkādeśaśca, tataḥ śālaṅkerapatyaṃ yuvā
ṭhyañiñośca' iti phak, ṭhpailādibhyaśca' iti luk, tataḥ
śālaṅkeryūnaśchātrā iti prāgdīvyatīyārthavivakṣāyām
ṭhgotre'lugaci' iti pailādiṣu lukaḥ pratiṣedhe sati ṭhyūniluk'
iti luki nitye prāpte ṭhphakphiñoranyatarasyām' iti pakṣe phakaḥ
śravaṇaprasaṅgaḥ | asatyāṃ tu yūno gotrasaṃjñāyām ṭhgotre'lugaci'
ityasyāpravṛtau pailādiṣu lugbhavatyeva | ṭhphakphiñoranyatarasyām'
ityayaṃ tu vikalpoḥ yūni ṭhluk' ityasyānantarasya, na tu
pailādiṣu luko vyavahitasyāntaraṅgasya, tata ṭhiñaśca'
ityaṇ---śālaṅkā iti bhavati | tathā pīlāyā apatyam, ṭhpīlāyā
vā' ityāṇ, pailaḥ, tasyāpatyaṃ yuvā, ṭhaṇo dvyacaḥ' iti phiñ,
tasya ṭhpailādibhyaśca' iti luk, tataḥ pailasya yūnaśchāttrāḥ pailīyā
iti ||
bhrātari ca jyāyasi || 4|1|164 ||
kanīyān bhrāteti | bhrātṛjyāyaḥ---śabdayoḥ
sambandhiśabdatvādayamartho labhyate | akāraṇatvāditi | yaḥ
sākṣātparamparayā vā kāraṇaṃ bhavati, sa loke ṭhvaṃśya' ityucyate |
gārgye jīvatīti | jyāyasi bhrātari jīvatītyarthaḥ | evaṃ
vātsyāyanādāvapi draṣṭavyam ||
vānyasmin sapiṇḍe sthaviratare jīvati || 4|1|165 ||
saptamapuruṣāvadhaya iti | ātmanaḥ prabhṛti pitrādiṣu putrādiṣu vā
gaṇyamāneṣu saptamapuruṣo'vadhiryeṣāṃ te tathoktāḥ | prāyeṇa tu
pūraṇapratyayo na paṭha|lte, saptapuruṣāvadhaya ityeva paṭha|lte, na tatra
samīcīnamarthaṃ paśyāmaḥ | samānaḥ piṇḍo yeṣāmiti sapiṇḍāḥ,
nipātanātsabhāvaḥ | smaryanta iti | tadyathā---ṭhsapiṇḍatā tu puruṣe
saptame vinivartate' iti | saptame'tīte vinivartata ityarthaḥ |
ubhayatreti | janena maraṇe cetyarthaḥ |
evamādikāyāṃ kriyāyāmiti | ādiśabdena ṭhdānaṃ pratigraho homaḥ
svādhyāyaśca nivartate' ityādikā kriyā gṛhyate | jīvadeveti |
vastuvyākhyānametat | sūtre tu jīvatītyākhyātapadam, taccedapatyaṃ
jīvatīti, prathamārthe vā śatrantātsaptamī vyākhyeyā | tarabnirdeśa
ityādi | asati tasminsthaviraśabdādvayaḥ prakarṣamātraṃ gamyeta, tarapā
tu sthānaprakarṣo dyotyate, tatastadu pādānasāmarthyāt, yathā
gotaraḥ, aśvatara ityādāvapravṛttinimitabhūtasyāpi vāhadohādeḥ
prakṛtyarthasambandhinaḥ prakarṣetarab bhavati, tathātrāpi |
sthānamupadam, pitṛtvādikam |
sthānavayonyūne iti | sthānena vayasā ca nyūne ityarthaḥ | nanu ca
jyāyasītyanuvṛterevobhayoḥ prakarṣo labhyate, ṭhpraśasyasya śraḥ', ṭhjya
ca', ṭhvṛddhasya ca' ityubhayorjyādeśavidhānāt ? tanna; nahi
sakṛtprayuktaḥ śabdo'nekārthamabhidhātuṃ samartaḥ | evamapi
tarabnirdeśo na kartavyaḥ, jyāyasītyanuvṛtereva
sthānaprakarṣalābhāt ? etadapi nāsti; sthavira iti
viśeṣaṇāntaropādāne sati jyāyasītyasyanuvṛtereva
durjñānatvāt | jīvatīti kimiti | śrutaṃ prakṛtaṃ cobhayamadhikṛtya
praśnaḥ | ata evobhayoḥ prayojanaṃ darśayati---mṛte mṛto veti | tatra
mṛta iti svapitari, mṛto veti pautraprabhṛterapatyabhūto'rtaḥ ||
vṛddhasya ca pūjāyām || 4|1|166 ||
apatyamantarhitamityādi | etaccāpatyagrahaṇena vṛddhasya viśeṣaṇād iha
paribhāṣitasya ca śabdātmakasyāpatyatvāsambhavāt vijñāyate |
pūjāyāṃ gamyamānāyāmiti | kā punaratra pūjā ? yadyauvatvameva |
yadyapi yuvaśabdo'napekṣitapravṛttinimitameva saṃjñā, tathāpi
prāyeṇālpavayaso jīvadvaṃśyatvaṃ sambhavatīti tadadhyārope sati
tatsahacaritaṃ vayo'pi pratyāyitaṃ bhavatīti pūjā bhavati |
saṃjñāsāmarthyāditi | gotrasya sato yuvasaṃjñā vidhīyate, gotrasaṃjñā
cetpravṛtā ṭheko gotre' iti niyamaḥ prāpnoti, tataśca
paramaprakṛterevotpannena pratyayenābhihitatvādaprāpto'pi
pratyayo'smādvacanādbhavatītyarthaḥ | iha pūrvatra sāmānādhikaraṇyena
saṃjñāvidhānātprakramābhedāya tathaiva saṃjñā vidhātuṃ yuktā, ko'yaṃ
vṛddhasyeti ṣaṣṭhīnirdeśaḥ ityatrāha---vṛddhasyeti | ṣaṣṭhīnirdeśa iti |
itikaraṇo hetau, vātiṃkakārīyaṃ cedaṃ sūtram | vṛttikāreṇa tu
sūtreṣu prakṣiptam | etenotarasūtraṃ vyākhyātam ||
yūnaśca kutsāyām || 4|1|167 ||
nivṛttipradhāno vikalpa iti | na punaḥ pravṛttipradhāna iti; pūrvameva
pravṛtatvāt | yadāha---yūnaśceti | na hyapravṛtāyāṃ tasyāmeṣa
nirdeśa upapadyate | nanu ca nivṛttirapyanirvṛtā yā na śakyate
kartum, yo hi bhuktavantaṃ brūyānmā bhuṅkthā iti kiṃ tena kṛtaṃ
syāt | tasmād ṭhyūnaśca' iti nirdeśo yuvasaṃjñāviṣayo
la7ṇārthaḥ | jīvadvaṃśyasya caturthāderiti, na tu yuvasaṃjñāśiṣṭasya
nirdeśa iti vaktavyam | evaṃ ca pravṛttivikalpo'pyupapadyate, sā ta
pravṛttirasatyapi sūtre labhyata iti matvā nivṛttipradhāna ityuktam |
yuvasaṃjñāyāṃ pratiṣiddhāyāmiti | tasyā abhāvapakṣa ityarthaḥ | gārgyo
jālma iti | kā punaratra kutsā ? gotratvāropiṇāmeva, ajīvadvaṃśyā
hi gotrasaṃjñakāḥ, te prāyeṇa caramavayaso bhavantīti tadārope
bhavati kutsā ||
janapadaśabdātkṣatriyādañ || 4|1|168 ||
janapadaśabdoyaḥ kṣatriyavācīti | nanvete pañcālādayaḥ śabdāḥ
kṣatriyaśabdā eva, tatsambandhātu ṭhtasya nivāsaḥ' iti taddhite kṛte
ṭhjanapade lup' iti ca lupi janapade vartante, tatkathamavarakālayā
janapadaśabdatayā nityakṣatriyaśabdatā lakṣyate ? kaḥ
punarāha---kṣatriyasambandhādeva te janapade vartanta iti,
sūtrakārastāvat ṭhlubyogāprakhyānāt' iti vadan kṣatriyeṣviva
janapade'pi svābhāvikā pañcālādiśabdasya pravṛttirityāha---pāñcāla
iti | yadapi pañcālādayaḥ śabdā janapade bahuvacanāntāḥ, kṣatriye
tvekavacanāntāḥ, tathāpi prātipadikasya viśeṣaṇaṃ janapadatvam, na
subantasyetyekavacanāntādapi pratyayo bhavatyeva | aikṣvāka iti |
ikṣvākuśabdasya dāṇḍināyanādisūtre ṭilopo nipātitaḥ |
drauhyava iti | kṣatriyavacana evāyaṃ na janapadaśabdaḥ | brāhmaṇasya
pañcālasyeti | bāhvādiprabhṛtiṣu yeṣāṃ darśanamityuktatvātkathamatra
prasaṅga iti cintyam |
kṣatriyasamānaśabdāditi | samānaḥ śabdo yasya yamānaśabdaḥ, kṣatriyeṇa
yasya samānaśabdastasmājjanapadaśabdāt tasyeti
ṣaṣṭhīsamarthādrājanyabhidheye'patyavatpratyayo bhavati | avṛddhādapīti
prāptasya vuño'pavādaḥ | kvacitu vṛtāvevāya granthaḥ paṭha|lte |
māgadha iti | ṭhdvyañmagadha' ityaṇ ||
vṛddhetkosalājādāññyaṅ || 4|1|171 ||
ḍa|lṇvaktavya iti | ḍakāraṣṭiloṣārthaḥ, ṇakāro vṛddhinimitasyeti
puṃvadbhāva pratiṣedhārthaḥ | anyasmāditi |
guṇavacanādyaudhiṣṭhirapitṛvacanācca | purīraṇvaktavyaḥ paurava iti
kvacitpaṭha|lte, tatra puruśabdasyājanapadaśabdatvātprāgdīvyatīye'ṇi
siddhe tadrājasaṃjñārthaṃ vacanam | janapadavācitve ṭhdvyañmagadha'
ityeva siddham ||
kurunādibhyo ṇyaḥ || 4|1|172 ||
ādiśabdo nakāreṇaiva sambadhyate, na kuruśabdena;
tadāderjanapadasyābhāvāt, tadāha---kuruśabdānnakārādibhyaśceti |
amañorapavāda iti | kuruśabdād ṭhdvyañmagadha' ityaṇo'pavādaḥ,
nādibhyastvañaḥ | naiṣadhya iti | kathaṃ ṭhnaiṣadho'rhati cedagham' iti ?
svacchandavāca ṛṣayaḥ | kathaṃ ṭhsa naiṣadhasyārthapateḥ sutāyām' iti ?
nirāṅkuśāḥ kavayaḥ | śeṣavivakṣāyāṃ vobhayatrāṇsamarthanīyaḥ ||
sālvāvayavapratyagrathakalakūṭāśmakādiñ || 4|1|173 ||
salvā kṣatriyeti pāṭhaḥ, tannāmiketi vacanāt, idaṃ hi tannāmikāṇaḥ
prāptyarthamuktam | na ca sālvāśabdātasya prāptiḥ, vṛddhatvāta,
salervapratyayaḥ | aṇapīṣyata iti | sālvāvayave apadātau sālvāditi
nirdeśāt, na ca nipātito'ṇ ḍhako'pavādaḥ,
ṭhsālveyagāndhāribhyā ca' iti nirdeśāt | tebhyaḥ kṣatriyavṛttibhya
iti | ṭhjanapadaśabdātkṣatriyāt' ityanuvṛteretallabhyate |
ṭhudumbarāstilakhalāḥ' iti ślokaḥ pradarśanārthaḥ | tena busa, ajamīḍha,
ājakanda--ityetebhyo|ñapi bhavati; tathā ca bhāṣya udāhṛtam---bausiḥ,
ājamīḍhiḥ, ājakandiriti | sālvāvayavasaṃjñitā iti |
sālvāvayava---ityevaṃ śabditā ityarthaḥ ||
te tadrājāḥ || 4|1|174 ||
tathā caivodāhṛtamiti | tatra ṭhtadrājasya bahuṣu tenaivāstriyām'
mityatra kāryāśrayamudāhṛtam, iha tu prakaraṇe rūpāśrayam || 
kambojālluk || 4|1|175 ||
colaḥ, śaka iti | ṭhdvyañmagadha' ityasyāṇaḥ | kerala ityatrāñaḥ ||
striyāmavantikuntikurubhyaśca || 4|1|176 ||
avantī, kuntīti | luki kṛte ṭhito manuṣyajāteḥ' iti ṅīṣa |
kurūriti | ṭhūṇutaḥ' ||
ataśca || 4|1|177 ||
takāro vispaṣṭārthaṃ iti | asati hi tasmin ṭhasya' iti nirdeśaḥ
syāt, tataśca sandehaḥ syāt---kimayaṃ varṇanirdeśaḥ ?
āhosvididama iti ? idamaśca nirdeśe'nantarasyeño luk prasajyeta,
takāre satyeṣa doṣo na bhavati, taparanirdeśasya bhūyasā varṇeṣveva
prasiddhatvāt ṭhtaparastatkālasya ' iti saṃjñākaraṇācca | kathaṃ
ṭhmādrīsutau puṣpaphale samṛddhe' iti ? svacchandavāca ṛṣayaḥ,
madrīsutāvityeva vā pāṭha|lm |
avantyādibhyo lugvacanāditi | yadyatra tadantavidhiḥ syādavantyādibhyo
lugvacanamanarthakaṃ syād; anenaiva siddhatvāt | tadantavidhau
tvasati akāramātrasya grahaṇena sidhyatītyavantyādibhyo
lugvacanamarthavad bhavati ||
na prācyabhargādiyaudheyādibhyaḥ || 4|1|178 ||
pāccālītyādi | pañcālādayaḥ śaravatyāḥ prāñco janapadāḥ |
bhargādigrahaṇamaprāgartham | bhṛño gaḥ, bhargaḥ | kṛña uḥ, karuḥ,
tamoṣatiudveṣṭi, mūlavibhūjāditvātkaḥ, karūṣāḥ | cinoteḥ kayaḥ
ādeśca kaḥ, bahulavacanāditsaṃjñābhāvaḥ, kekayaḥ | kaśermiraḥ, kaśmīraḥ
| sālvaśabdo niruktaḥ | śobhanāni sthalānyasya susthalaḥ | urasā śete
uraśaḥ | ṭhkurunādibhyo ṇyaḥ' kauravyaḥ | yaudheyītyādi | yudhāyā
apatyam, śubhrāyā apatyam, ṭhdvyacaḥ' iti ḍhak | śubhrāśabdāt
ṭhśubhrādibhyaśca' iti, tataḥ svārthe ṭhparśvādiyaudheyādibhyaḥ' ityañ |
yadyaño luk syāḍḍhaglakṣaṇe ṅīpi sati utādatanivṛttisvaraḥ
syāt, luki tu pratiṣiddhe ṭhśārṅgaravādyañaḥ' iti ṅīni
satyādyaudātaṃ bhavati |
kasya punariti | asya vakṣyamāṇo'bhiprāyaḥ, tameva prakāśayati---kathaṃ
punariti | pariharati---etadeveti parśuriti | parśuḥ kṣatriyo
janapadena samānaśabdaḥ, tasyāpatyaṃ saṅghaḥ, strītvaviśiṣṭaḥ,
ṭhdvyañmagadha' ityaṇ, tasya ṭhataśca' iti luk, punaḥ
parśvādilakṣaṇaḥ svārthiko'ṇ, tasyāpi luk | evaṃ rakṣā iti |
rakṣasaḥ kṣatriyasyāpatyam, strītvaviśiṣṭaḥ saṅghaḥ, pūrvavadaṇ,
dvayasyāpi luk, ṭhatvasantasya' iti dīrghaḥ | āsurīti |
janapadalakṣaṇasyāño luki parśvādilakṣaṇasyāṇo luk, jātilakṣaṇo
ṅīṣ | jñāpakatvameva draḍhayati---tathā coktamiti |
vārtikakāreṇaiduktam | yaudheyādiṣu trayo niruktāḥ; jyāyāsahito
bāṇo yasyāḥ sā jyābrāṇā, tasyā apatyaṃ jyābāṇeyaḥ | jyāvāneya
ityanye paṭhanti, tatra jyāvāno yasyā jyāvānā | ṭhghṛ kṣaraṇe' ṭhdhṛ
dhāraṇe' ābhyāṃ ktijantābhyām ṭhitaścāniñaḥ' iti ḍhak, ghārteyaḥ,
dhārteyaḥ | trayo gartā yeṣāṃ te trigartāḥ | ṭhbhṛño'tac', bharataḥ
| vaśeḥ karmaṇi kiḥ, uśiḥ, uśayaḥ, uṣṭā narā yasya sa uśīnaraḥ,
ṭhanyeṣāmapi dṛśyate' iti dīrghaḥ ||
iti śrīharadatamiśraviracitāyāṃ padamañjaryāṃ caturthādhyāyasya prathamaḥ
pādaḥ 
-------------------|||||||||||||||||||||------------------atha caturthādhyāye dvitīyaḥ pādaḥ ---4
padamañjarī
tena raktaṃ rāgāt || 4|2|1 ||
rañjirayamastyevābhiṣvaṅge----bhojane rakta iti; asti
varṇaviśeṣe---raktā gauḥ, lohitetyarthaḥ; asti śuklasya
varṇāntarāpādane---raktaḥ paṭa iti | tatrādyayorarthayorgrahaṇe, rūpeṇa
kāntāyāṃ raktaḥ, kopena raktaṃ mukhamityatrāpi prāpnotīti
manyamānastṛtīyamarthamāśrityāha---śuklasyetyādi |
etaccābhidhānasvābhāvyāllabhyate | rajyate'nena rāga iti | ṭhghañī ca
bhāvakaraṇayoḥ' iti nalopaḥ | bhāvasādhanastu rāgaśabdo na bhavati, na
hi rañjanakriyaiva rañjanakriyāyāḥ karaṇaṃ bhavati | rāgaviśeṣavācina
iti | svarūpagrahaṇaṃ tu na bhavati; utaratra lākṣādīnāṃ rāgagrahaṇena
viśeṣaṇāt |
rāgāditi kimiti | anabhidhānādeva kartṛvācino na bhaviṣyati,
ṭhdaivadataṃ vastram' iti hyukte svasvāmibhāvasyaiva sampratyayāditi praśnaḥ
| lakṣaṇaikaśaraṇo naitatpratipatumarhatītyuktam |
kathamiti | na hyatra varṇāntaramāhitamiti praśnaḥ upamānāditi |
rūpasādṛśyanimitāt ||
lākṣāroṭanāṭṭhak || 4|2|2 ||
śakalakardamayorvārtike darśanātsūtre prakṣepaḥ |
nīlyā iti | oṣadhiviśeṣo nīli, ambādhanārthavacanam,
nīlaśabdastu guṇaśabdatvādeva nīlīrakte vastre sidhyati |
pītāditi | rāgaviśeṣivācī pītaśabdaḥ | idamapi
vacanamaṇbādhanārthameva | svārthikakanpratyayāntastu pītakaśabda
guṇavacano vastre labhyate ||
nakṣatreṇa yuktaḥ kālaḥ || 4|2|3 ||
iha pāramarṣāḥ kālaṃ kriyātmānamicchanti, yathoktam---
āditya---graha---nakṣatra---parispandamathāpare |
bhinnamāvṛttibhedena kālaṃ kālavido viduḥ || iti |
vaiśeṣikāstu dravyamākāśakalpam, uktaṃ ca---
vyāpāravyatirekeṇa kālameke pracakṣate |
nityamekaṃ vibhu dravyaṃ parimāṇaṃ kriyāvatām || iti |
dvayorapi darśanayornakṣatreṇa kālasya yogo na sambhavati, kiṃ
kāraṇam ? aprāptipūrvikā prāptiḥuyogaḥ, kālaviśeṣāvadhāraṇārtho
hi loke pauṣādiśabdaprayogaḥ, evaṃvidha eva ca yogaḥ
kālaviśeṣāvadhāraṇaheturbhavati | dravyapakṣe tāvad dvayorapi
nakṣatrakālayornityatvātkālasya ca sarvagatatvānna kadācidayogaḥ |
kriyāpakṣe'pi nakṣatragatāyāḥ kriyāyāḥ kālakhyāyāḥ samavāyalakṣaṇo
yogo'vyabhicārādaviśeṣaṇam |
sūryādigatāyāstvasambhavādaviśeṣaṇam | yadi tu yathākathañcidyogaḥ,
tadā vyabhicārābhāvaḥ | na hi so'styahorātro yaḥ puṣyeṇa na yuktaḥ
| tasmāt ṭhnakṣatreṇa yuktaḥ kālaḥ' ityanupapanno nirdeśaḥ |
kathaṃ tarhi nirdeśaḥ kartavyaḥ, nakṣatrāderyuktāntādyaukte kāle
pratyayavidhānaṃ yuktalopaśca, puṣyeṇa yuktaścandramāṃ puṣyayuktaḥ,
puṣyayuktena yuktaḥ kāla iti puṣyayuktaśabdāccandramasi
vartamānātpratyayaḥ, yuktaśabdasya ca lopaḥ, pauṣī rātriḥ, pauṣamahaḥ,
evaṃ sarvatra | tatra yuktavadbhāve doṣaḥ, madhāyuktaśabdātpratyaye
kriyamāṇe tasya lupi maghā iti strītvabahutve na siddhyataḥ,
yuktasyaiva tu candramaso liṅgavacanaprasaṅgaḥ, ato nakṣatravācina eva
pratyayayoryogaḥ sambhavatīti matvā pṛcchati---kathaṃ punariti | na
candramasaiva yoge puṣyādīnāṃ nakṣatratā; jyotirmātravacanatvānnakṣatra
śabdasya | ye tu puṣyādīnāmāvasthikī nakṣatratā candramasā yoge
bhavatītyāhuḥ, teṣāmayaṃ praśno'nupapannaḥ | puṣyādisamīpastha iti |
mukhyārthāsambhave gauṇasyāśrayaṇamiti bhāvaḥ | tatra maghādayaḥ śabdā
aparityaktasvaliṅgasaṅkhyā eva candramasi vartante, yathā---mañcādayaḥ,
mañcān striyaḥ paśyeti | tena yuktavadbhāvaviṣaye'pi doṣābhāvaḥ
| puṣyasamīpasthena candramasā yukta ityartha iti | yadyapi candramasā
kālasya yogo nityaḥ, candramaso nityatvāt; puṣyasamīpena tu
kādācitkaḥ, puṣyasamīpatāyāḥ kādācitkatvāt | pauṣīti
ṭhsūryatiṣya' ityādinā yalopaḥ ||
lubaviśeṣe || 4|2|4 ||
yadyaviśeṣe lub bhavati, ihāpi prāpnoti---pauṣī rātriḥ,
pauṣamahariti, atrāpyadya hyae veti viśeṣo na gamyate | atha
rātrirahariti | viśeṣā vasāyātadāśrayaḥ pratiṣedho bhavati, ihāpi
tarhi na syād---adya puṣyo hyaḥ kṛtikā iti,
adyatvādiviśeṣāvasāyāt; ṭhpuṣye pāyasamaśnīyāt' ityādāveva
tu syād yatra namanāgapi viśeṣāvasāyaḥ ? ata āha---nacedityādi |
rātryādirityādiśabdena muhūrtādeḥ parigrahaḥ | viśeṣo'bhidhīyate
iti | pratyayāntena | etadeva spaṣṭayati--yāvāniti | kiyāÄśca kālo
nakṣatreṇa yujyate ? ityāha---ahorātra iti | ṣaṣṭināḍikātmaka ityarthaḥ
tāvantaṃ hi kālamekasya nakṣatrasya samīpe candramā vartate |
tadetadevaṃ yāvānkālo nakṣatreṇa yujyate tasya sarvasya
pratyayāntenābhidhānamaviśeṣaḥ, tadekadeśasyābhidhānaṃ viśeṣaḥ |
etacca pratyayānte'nupraveśādantaraṅgatvācca labhyate |
prasajyapratiṣedhaścāyam, tena pauṣo'horātra ityatra samudāyenāpi
pratīyamāno'vayavadvayātmakaḥ pratīyata iti tadāśrayaḥ pratiṣedho
bhavati, iha puṣyeṇa yuktā paurṇamāsī pauṣī, maghābhiryuktā
māghītyādau lup prāpnoti ? jñāpakātsiddham, yadayam ṭhvibhāṣā
phalgunīśravaṇākārtikīcaitrībhyaḥ' iti nirdiśati,
tajjñāpayati---paurṇamāsyāṃ lubna bhavatīti | śravaṇāśabdātu
bhavati---ṭhśravaṇākārtakī' iti nirdeśādeva | kathaṃ tarhi śrāvaṇyāṃ
paurṇamāsyāmiti ? abādhakānyapi nipātanāni bhavanti ||
saṃjñāyāṃ śravaṇaśvatthābhyām || 4|2|5 ||
viśeṣārtho'yamārambha iti | na tu saṃjñāyāṃ niyamārthaḥ; vidhisambhave
niyamāyogāt, ṭhśravaṇākārtikī' ityasaṃjñāyāmapi lupo darśanācca
|
lupi yuktavadbhāvaḥ kasmānna bhavatīti | śravaṇā rātrirityatra |
nipātanāditi | ṅīptvatra pratyayalakṣaṇena bhavati; ṭhaṇ yo'kāraḥ'
iti vijñānāt ||
dvandvācchaḥ || 4|2|6 ||
nakṣatragrahaṇamanuvṛtaṃ ṣaṣṭha|lntatayā vipariṇamyate, tacca dvandvasya
viśeṣaṇamityāha---nakṣatradvandvāditi | rādhānurādhīyā rātririti |
ekadeśadvāreṇa rātryādernakṣatradvayayogaḥ | adya rādhānurādhīyamiti |
adyetyasyāliṅgatve'pi tadviśeṣaṇasya napuṃsakatvam,
lokāśrayatvālliṅgasya, lupaṃ paratvādvādhate | ccha iti | nanu
yugapatprāptayorvipratiṣedhaḥ, na ca lupcchayoryugapatprasaṅgaḥ,
pratyayādarśanasya hi lupasaṃjñā, tasya kathaṃ pratyayena saha prasaṅgaḥ ?
tasmādayamatrārthaḥ---ṭhmadhye'pavādāḥ pūrvānvidhīnbādhante notarān'
iti, evamayaṃ lubaṇa eva bhavati, nāsya cchasya | tenāyaṃ chāe lupo
viṣaye śrūyate, etadeva lupaṃ paratvādvādhate ccha iti bādhakatvam |
paratvāditi | yato'yaṃ parastena lubasya na bhavati, tena
tadviṣaye'pyasau śrūyata iti ||
dṛṣṭṃa sāma || 4|2|7 ||
yasya sāmno viśiṣṭakāryaviṣaye viniyogo yena jñātastena
dṛṣṭamityucyate ||
kalerḍhak || 4|2|8 ||
sarvatreti | na kevalamagneḥ ṭhsāsya devatā' ityasminnevārthe ḍhak,
nāpi kevalaṃ dṛṣṭṃa sāmetyatraivārthe kalerḍhag; api tu sarveṣve va
prāgdīvyatīyeṣvityarthaḥ |
saṃgrahaśloke jati ca dviraṇ ḍidvā vidhīyate iti pāṭhaḥ | jāte'rthe
yo'ṇ vidhīyate sa vā ḍidbhavatītyarthaḥ |
na vidyāyā iti | vidyāvācina īkag na bhavatītyarthaḥ |
gotrādaṅkavaditi | aṅke yo dṛṣṭaḥ pratyayaḥ sa sarvo'tidiśyate,
na tvaṅka evāhatya vihitaḥ, tena ṭhsaṅghāṅkalakṣaṇeṣu' ityasyāṇaḥ
ṭhgotracaraṇād vuñ' ityasya ca vuño'tideśaḥ ||
vāmadevād ḍa|lḍḍa|lai || 4|2|9 ||
ḍiskāraṇaṃ kimarthamiti | yasyeti lopenaiva siddhi matvā praśnaḥ |
anayorgrahaṇaṃ mā bhūditi | atha ṭhkriyamāṇe'pi ḍitkaraṇe
kasmādevānayorgrahaṇaṃ na bhavati ? tatrāha---ananubandhaketi |
ṭhananubandhakasya grahaṇe na sānubandhakasya' iti yagrahaṇe
ḍa|lḍa|ltorgrahaṇaṃ na bhavati, ekānubandhakaparibhāṣayā tu yadgrahaṇe
ḍa|lto grahaṇābhāvaḥ | avāmadevyamiti |
avyayapūrvapadaprakṛtisvareṇādyaudātatvameva bhavati |
saṃgrahaśloke atadarthe ityanena ṭhyayatoścātadarthe' ityetatsūtraṃ
lakṣyate | nañsvara iti | nañāśrayaḥ svaro nañsvaraḥ,
utarapadāntodātatvaṃ tasminvidhīyamāne ityarthaḥ ||
parivṛto rathaḥ || 4|2|10 ||
cārmaṇa iti | ṭhan' iti prakṛtibhāvaḥ | parivṛto ratha iti |
tadekāntagrahaṇam, yena parivṛto rathastadekāntaścedbhavatīti
vaktavyam | tena carmavastrādāveva bhavati, itarathā chātrādāvapi
prasaṅga ityāha---samantādveṣṭita ityādi | vṛṇotirveṣṭane pariḥ
sarvato bhāve | yasya na kaścidavayava iti | bāhulyābhiprāyametat,
na hi cakranemiprabhṛtayaścarmaṇā pidhīyante nāpyantarāvayavāḥ | nanu
tatkārī cāyaṃ yadāha---chāttraiḥ parivṛta iti | taddveṣī ca,
yadāha---samantādveṣṭita ityādi | nāyaṃ tatkārī,
aupacāriko'yaṃ prayogaḥ, parivṛtaḥ iva parivṛtaḥ ||
pāṇḍukambalādiniḥ || 4|2|11 ||
matvarthīyenaiva siddha iti | yo he yena parivṛtaḥ sa tasyāsti | aṇo
nivṛtyarthamiti | yadyetannārabhyeta, parivṛto ratha iti vivakṣāyāṃ
pūrveṇāṇ prasajyeta ||
dvaipavaiyāghrādañ || 4|2|12 ||
dvīpivyāghrayoriti | ṭhvirūpāṇāmapi samānārthānām' ekaśeṣaḥ
prāpnoti, tatrāvāntarajātibhedena bhinnārthatvānna bhaviṣyatīti
samādhātavyam | carmaṇaiva rathasya parivaraṇaṃ sambhavati, na
vikāramātreṇeti ṭhcarmaṇī' ityuktam | dvīṣivyāghraśabdābhyām
prāṇirajatādibhyo'ñ' ityañpratyayaḥ, dvīpinaṣṭilopaḥ ||
kaumārāpūrvavacane || 4|2|13 ||
apūrvavacana iti | apūrvaśabdo bhāvapradhānaḥ | apūrvatvasya
vacanamapūrvavacanam, tasminnapūrvavacane | kasya
punarapūrvatvoktāvityāha---pāṇigrahaṇasyeti | etacca
nipātanasāmarthyāllabhyate | ubhayataḥ | ādyāditvātasiḥ |
strīpuṃsayorubhayorapyetannipātanamiṣyate, ubhayośca
pakṣayorapūrvatvaṃ striyā eva, na puṃsa ityarthaḥ | tatra kaumāreti
strīpuṃsasādhāraṇaprātipadikamātranirdeśādavasīyate---ubhayorapi
nipātanamiti | striyā evāpūrvatvamityetatu nipātanabalāllabhyate |
apūrvapatimiti | yasyāḥ pāṇirna kenacidgṛhītapūrvaḥ
sā'pūrvapatiḥ, na vidyate pūrvaḥ patiriti kṛtvā,
tāmupapannaḥuprāptaḥ, bhāryātvena svīkṛtavānityarthaḥ | sa tu
pūrvakṛtodvāho bhavatu mā vā bhūt | apūrvapatiriti | ayamapi
bahuvrīhiḥ, atrāpi puruṣaḥ pūrvavat |
komāretyādi | kaumāreti nipātyate'pūrvacane | kimatra
nipātyate ? kumāryā aṇ vidhīyate | kadā ? apūrvatvaṃ yadā tasyāḥ
| yadā kumāryā apūrvatvaṃ na puṃsastadetyarthaḥ | kumāryā bhavatīti
veti | anena yogaḥ pratyākhyāyate; yaḥ kumārīmupapannastasyāmasau
bhavati, tadāyatatvāddharmācaraṇādeḥ, tataśca ṭhtatra bhavaḥ' ityavāṇa siddhaḥ
| yadyapi vāṇyādyapi kumāryāṃ bhavati tathāpi satyabhidhāne ṭhtatra bhāvaḥ'
iti bhavatyeva | sūtrārambhe'pi hi nāsau daṇḍavāritaḥ, evaṃ
tāvatkaumāra iti siddham | striyāmapi siddham, katham ? kaumārasya
strī kaumārī, pratyāsatyā ca yasyāmasābhavan kaumāravyapadeśaṃ
labhate saivābhidhīyate na stryantaram, etacca
sūtrārambhe'pyaṅgīkartavyam ||
tatroddhṛtamamatrebhyaḥ || 4|2|14 ||
atroddharatiruddharaṇapūrvake nidhāne vartate, tena saptamīsamarthād
vibhaktirnopapadyatade | bhuktocchiṣṭamiti | śiṣṭamevocchiṣṭam, yathā
vacchinaṣṭi na sarvaṃ juhotīti bhuktaśiṣṭamityarthaḥ | yasyoddharaṇamiti
prāsiddhiriti | kṛtyalyuṭo bahulam' iti bhūte karmaṇi lyuṭ |
śarāveṣūddhṛta iti | uddhṛtyanehita ityarthaḥ ||
sthaṇḍilācchayitari vrate | 4|2|15 ||
śāstrita iti | saṃjātaśāstra ityarthaḥ |
yadvā---tṛtīyāsamarthādvidhāne'rthe ṭhprātipadikāddhatvarthe' iti ṇic,
karmaṇi ktaḥ, śāstreṇa vihita ityarthaḥ | sthaṇḍile śayituṃ vratamasyeti
| tumunatra vaktavyaḥ; vratasyākriyārūpatvāt ||
saṃskṛtambhakṣāḥ || 4|2|16 || 
saṃskṛtamityetat karmasāmānye vyutpādyate, tena
napuṃsakaliṅgamekavacanaṃ ca, bhakṣā ityetatu
apūpādyabhyavahāryaviśeṣe vyutpādyate, tena puliṅgaṃ bahuvacanaṃ ca |
tatra vākyārthagamyasyārthasya
padasaṃskāre'nupayogātsaṃskṛtamityenadbhavati, ata eva viramya
sambandhaṃ darśayati---yatatsaṃskṛtambhakṣāste ced bhavantīti, aṇau
yatkarma ṇau cet sa kartetivat, tacchabdasya
pratinirdiśyamānaliṅgatā | kharaviśadamiti | kharamu kaṭhinam,
viśadamu vibhaktam | bhakṣaśabdenocyata iti | yadyapyabbhakṣo vāyubhakṣa
iti bhakṣayateranyatrāpi prayogaḥ, bhakṣaśabdastu tatraiva prasiddha iti bhāvaḥ
||
śūlokhādyat || 4|2|17 ||
śūlokhāditi | samāhāradvandvaḥ, ukhāupātraviśeṣaḥ | yastu
svāṅgavācyukhāśabdastasyeha grahaṇaṃ na bhavati; svāṅge
saṃskartavyasyābhāvāt | kathamukhyo'gniriti | na hyasau bhakṣaḥ, bhavārthe
digāditvād draṣṭavyaḥ ||
dadhnaṣṭhak || 4|2|18 ||
iha tu dadhi kevalamādhārabhūtamiti | yathā śūre
saṃskriyamāṇasyamāṃsasya śūlam | yadyapyatra dadhyapi saṃskārakam,
tathāpi na tadvivakṣitam, kintu tadādhārasya dravyāntareṇa yaḥ
saṃskāraḥ sa eva vivakṣita iti bhāvaḥ ||
udaśvito'nyatarasyām || 4|2|19 ||
audaśvitka iti | ṭhisusuktāntātkaḥ' ||
kṣīrāḍḍhañ || 4|2|20 ||
atra saṃskṛtamityeva sambadhyate, na bhakṣā iti; tena yavāgvāmapi bhavati
| kṣeraiyīti | ṭhṭiḍḍhāṇañ' ityādinā ṅīp ||
sāsminpaurṇamāsīti saṃjñāyām || 4|2|21 ||
tataścedvivakṣeti | tataḥ pratyayāntāllokasya vivakṣā bhavati ced
evaṃ pratyayo bhavati, nānyathetyarthaḥ | saṃjñāyāmiti
samudāyopādhiriti | etadeva spaṣṭayati---pratyayāntena cediti |
pauṣī paurṇamāsīti | ṭhlubaviśeṣe' iti paurṇamāsyāṃ lubna
bhavatīti pūrvamevoktam | bhṛtakamāse ceti | bhṛtā eva bhṛtakāḥ,
karmakarāsteṣāṃ yo māsaḥ karmakaraṇādārabhya triśadrātralakṣaṇaḥ sa yadā
pauṣyā paurṇamāsyā tadvān bhavati | vastutaśca na
māghādivyapadeśabhāk tatretyarthaḥ |
tulyameva phalamiti | ki punastadityāha---prayogānusāraṇamiti |
ṇyarthāllyaṭ | saṃjñāśabdena tulyatāmiti | tulyaphalatāmityarthaḥ |
iti kaṇasya jñāpayitumiti | kiṃ punaridaṃ jñāpakasādhyam ?
tatrāha---na hyayamiti | jñāpanasya prayojanaṃ darśayati--saṃjñārthatve
tviti | saṃjñābdena tulyaphalatve ityarthaḥ | pravṛttibhedena cāyamartho
jñāpyata iti | saṃjñāyāmiti dvitīyāpravṛttiḥ, iha śāltre
ṭhsaṃjñāyām' ityasyārthe itiśabdo veditavya iti paribhāṣā sampadyate |
pūrṇamāsādaṇiti | pūrṇo māso'syāṃ tathāviti bahuvrīhau
prajñāderākṛtigaṇatvādasmādeva vā nipātanādaṇ | mā iti candramā
ucyata iti | candramaśśabdaikadeśaprayogaḥ, satyābhāmā bhāmetivat ||
āgrahāyaṇyaśvatthāṭṭhak || 4|2|22 ||
agre hāyanamasyā ityāgrahāyaṇī, prajñāderākṛtigaṇatvādaṇ,
ṭhpūrvapadātsaṃjñāyām' iti ṇatvam | aśvatthena yuktā paurṇamāsī
aśvattha iti | nipātanātpaurṇamāsyāmapi lup ||
sāsya devatā || 4|2|24 ||
yāgasampradānaṃ devateti | yadyapi devaśabdo
manuṣyādivajjātivacanaḥ, svārthikaśca tal; tathāpi samudāyaśaktyā
devatāśabdo yāge darśa pūrṇamāsau yadyatsampradānatvena coditaṃ tatra
sarvatra vartate, na sa jātiviśeṣa ityarthaḥ | deyasya puroḍāśādeḥ
svāminīti | diveraiśvaryakarmaṇo devatāśabdavyutpatti darśayati,
evaṃ ca kṛtvā ṭhvāyvṛtupitruṣaso yat',ṭhkālebhyo bhavavat' iti
vacanamupapadyate, na hyṛtuṣu pitṛṣu uṣasi vā jātirasti | tathā
pitṛdevatyam, devadevatyamiti prayogo'pyevamevopapadyate |
kathamiti | puroḍāśādikasya deyasyābhāvādindrasya sampradānatvaṃ
nāstīti praśnaḥ | mantrastutyāmapītyādi | nānenaupacārikatvaṃ
prayogasyocyate, api tu mukhya eva prayogaḥ, yāgasampradāne
sārvalaukikaḥ prayogaḥ, ayaṃ tu nairuktānāmityetāvānviśeṣaḥ |
upacarantīti bruvate, prayuñjata ityarthaḥ |
kathamityādi | pūrvoktaṃ prakāradvayamatra nāstīti praśnaḥ |
upemānāditi | kāṣāyau gardabhasya karṇāvitivad gauṇo'yaṃ
prayoga ityarthaḥ | seti prakṛta iti | prakṛtaṃ hi sāgrahaṇaṃ saṃjñayā
sambaddhamiti tadanuvṛtau saṃjñāyā apyanuvṛttiḥ syāt ||
kasyet || 4|2|25 ||
kimo vibhaktau kādeśaṃ kṛtvā kasyeti
nirdiṣṭamityāśaṅkāmapanayati---kaśabda iti | evaṃ ca kṛtvā
kāyānubrūhīti sampraiṣaḥ | kasmai anubrūhīti, ṭhna kasmai devāya
haviṣā vidhema' iti tu chāndasaḥ smaibhāvaḥ, yadindrāgnī
avamasyāmityādivat | kāyamiti | itve kṛte yasyeti lopaḥ
prāptaḥ paratvādādivṛddhyā bādhyate, śrīrdeavatāsya śrāyamitivat |
ṭhsomāṭṭa|lṇ' ityatra kagrahaṇe ca kriyamāṇe yadyapi yasyeti
lopātparatvād vṛddhirbhavati, kṛtāyāmapi vṛddhau yasyeti lopaḥ
syādeva ||
aponaptrapānnaptṛbhyāṃ ghaḥ || 4|2|27 ||
aponapāt apāṃnapāditi devatānāmadheye iti |
pṛṣodarāditvādanayoḥ sādhutvam | tayostu
pratyayasanniyogeneti | evaṃ ca aponapāte anubrūhi,
apāṃnapāte'nubrūhi, aponapātaṃ yaja, apāṃ napātaṃ yajeti
sampraiṣaḥ | vede tu aponaptre svāheti chāndasaḥ prayogaḥ ||
ccha ca || 4|2|28 ||
yogavibhāga ityādi | pūrvasūtra eva cchagrahaṇe sati ghacchau dvau
pratyayau, prakṛtī api dve iti syātsaṅkhyātānudeśaḥ |
śatarudrīyamiti | śataśabdo'nantavacanaḥ, śataṃ rudrā devatā'syeti
ghacchau, tayovidhānasāmarthyād ṭhdvigorluganapatye' lugna bhavati ||
mahendrādghāṇo ca || 4|2|29 ||
saumīti | ṭitvānṅīp, ṭhhalastaddhitasya' iti yalopaḥ ||
vāyvṛtupitruṣaso yat || 4|2|31 ||
vāyavyamiti | ṭhorguṇaḥ', ṭhvānto yi pratyaye' pitryamiti |
ṭhrīṇḥótaḥ' iti rīṅ, yasyeti lopaḥ ||
dyāvāpṛthivīśunāsīramarutvadagnīṣomavāstoṣpatigṛhamedhāccha ca ||
4|2|32 ||
aṇo ṇyasya cāpavāda iti | vāstoṣpatiśabdātpatyutarapadasya
ṇyasyāpavādaḥ, śeṣebhyo'ṇaḥ | dyāvāpṛthivyāviti | ṭhdivo dyāvā',
ṭhdivasaśca pṛthivyām' iti dyāvādeśaḥ | śunāsīrāviti | ṭhdevatā
dvandve ca' ityānaṅadeśaḥ | śuno vāyuḥ, sīra āditya iti | anye tu
ekameva śunasīramindrasya, guṇamamanyanta, yathāhaśvalāyanaḥ---ṭhindro vā
śunāsīraḥ' iti | mantraliṅgañca bhavati---indraṃ vayaṃ
śunāsīramasminyajñe havāmahe' iti | maruto'sya santi marutvānindraḥ
| agnīṣomīyamiti | ṭhīdagneḥ somavaruṇayoḥ' vāstoḥ
patirvāstoṣpatiḥ, asmādeva nirdeśātsādhuḥ |
gṛhamedhaśabdamakārāntaṃ bahvṛcā manyante | ṭhmarudbhyo
gṛhamedhebhya utarā' ityāśvalāyanaḥ | ṭhgṛhamedhāsa āgatā' iti ca
mantraliṅgam | ṭhmarudbhyo gṛhamedhibhyaḥ sarvāsāṃ dugdhe
sāyamodanam' iti tu taitirīyakam | tatra dekārānto nakārānto
veti vipratipannāḥ ||
agnerḍhak || 4|2|33 ||
kalerḍhagityatroktamevārthaṃ smarayati---prāgdīvyatīyeṣviti ||
kālebhyo bhavavat || 4|2|34 ||
kālaviśeṣavācibhya iti | svarūpagrahaṇaṃ tu na bhavati;
bahuvacananirdeśāt | vatkāraṇamityādi | asati vatkaraṇe
ṭhkālebhyo bhavaḥ' ityucyamāne yadi tāvadevaṃ sambandhaḥ, kālebhyo
bhave ye pratyayā vidhāsyante te ṭhsāsya devatā' ityatrārthe bhavantīti
devatāprakṛtiraviśeṣitā syāt, tataśca ṭhkālaṭṭhañ' iti
ṭhañindrāderapi prāpnoti | atha punarevaṃ sambandhaḥ---bhave ye pratyayā
vidhāsyante te bhavanti kālebhyo devatābhya iti ? evamapi bhavapratyayā
na viśeṣitāḥ syuḥ, tataśca ṭhdigādibhyo yat' iti yat
pratyayo'pi bhave vihitaḥ kālavācibhyo'sminnarthe prāpnoti |
athāpyevaṃ sambandhaḥ---kālebhyo bhave ye pratyayāste bhavanti, kālebhya
eva devatārthe iti tatra sakṛt śrutasya tasya
kālaśabdasyaivamubhayasambandha eva tāvad durlabhaḥ | athāpi labhyeta,
evamapi yaḥ kaścitkālādbhave pratyayo yataḥ kutaścidevatāyāḥ
syād ṛtubhyo'ṇ muhūrtāderapi prāpnoti | vatinirdeśe tu
sati sādṛśyaparigraho bhavati, tena yābhyaḥ prakṛtibhyo yena
viśeṣaṇena bhave'rthe vidhāsyante ye pratyayāḥ, ihāpi tābhya eva
prakṛtibhyastenaiva viśeṣaṇena ta eva pratyayā bhavantīti na
kiñcidaniṣṭam ||
mahārājaproṣṭhapadāṭṭhañ || 4|2|35 ||
mahārājo vaiśravaṇaḥ, proṣṭhapadaśabdātpūrveṇa nakṣatrāṇi prāpte
vacanam, navayajña āgrayaṇam | pūrṇamāsādaṇiti | asminvartata ityeva
| paurṇamāsīti | pūrṇo māso'syā tithau vartata iti vigrahaḥ, eṣeva
ca vyutpattiḥ ṭhsāsminpaurṇamāsī' ityatrāpi darśitā ||
pitṛvyamātulamātāmahapitāmahāḥ || 4|2|36 ||
pitṛmātṛbhyāmiti | svarūpapadārthakatvenābhyarhitatve
viśeṣābhāvāllaghvakṣarasya pūrvanipātaḥ,
ayonisambandhavācitvādanaṅe'bhāvaśca | ḍāmahajiti | kathaṃ
tarhyākāre'vagrahaḥ---mātā a mahaḥ, pitā a maha iti ? tasamānmahapratyayaḥ
pitṛmātṛbhyāṃ nipātitastayoścānaṅadeśa iti kecit |
vṛttikārastu saṃhitāpāṭhasyaiva nityatvāt ṭhnalakṣaṇena padakārā
anuvarttyāḥ' iti nyāyenāvagraho mā kārīti manyate | mātari
ṣiccheti | ṣitvamupasaṅkhyeyamityarthaḥ | na punaḥ ṣakāro'nubandhaḥ
kartavya iti deśābhāvāt---mātāmahā ityapi mantre dṛśyate |
averdugdha iti | dugdhaṃ kṣīram | soḍhādīnām ṭhādeśapratyayayoḥ'
iti ṣatvaṃ na bhavati, sakāroccāraṇasāmarthyāt |
niṣphalastila iti | sasyāvasthāyāṃ phalarahita ucyate, dhānyāvasthāyāṃ
prayojanaśūnya ityanye ||
tasya samūhaḥ || 4|2|37 ||
sarvasyaiva
viṣayasyāpavādairavaṣṭabdhatvātpṛcchati---kimihodāharaṇamiti |
kākaśukavakaśabdā ādyaudātāḥ ṭhprāṇināṃ kupūrvāṇām' ityanena,
asyārthaḥ---vyadhikaraṇe ṣaṣṭhayau, athādiḥ prāk śakaṭerityata
ādirityanuvṛtaṃ ṣaṣṭhībahuvacanāntaṃ vipariṇamyate, prāṇivācināṃ
ye ādibhūtāḥ kavargātpūrve acasteṣāmudāto bhavatīti | tatra
śaukamityanudāharaṇam ; khaṇḍikādiṣu pāṭhāt |
vakaśabdastūdāhāryaḥ ||
bhikṣādibhyo'ṇ || 4|2|38 ||
aṇgrahaṇaṃ bādhakabādhanārthamiti | bhikṣāśabdo'yam ṭhgurośca halaḥ'
ityakārapratyayāntatvādantodātaḥ, tataḥ ṭhanudātādeḥ' ityañ aṇo
bādhakaḥ prāpnoti, tasya bādhanārthamaṇgrahaṇam | nanu ca yadyatrāñ,
syātpunarvacanamanarthakaṃ syāt ? nānarthakam; paratvādaci
tatallakṣaṇaṣṭhak prāpnoti, tadvādhanārthamatra punarvacanaṃ syādityañ
syādeva, punaraṇgrahaṇādaṇeva bhavati | gārbhiṇamiti | ṭhbhasyā'ḍhea
taddhite' iti puṃvadbhāvena ṅīpo nivṛttiḥ, tato'ṇi
ṭhimaṇyanapatye' iti prakṛtibhāvāt ṭhnastaddhite' iti ṭilopābhāvaḥ |
tasya grahaṇasāmarthyātpuṃvadbhāvo na bhavatīti | yadi syāt,
ṭhsiddhatvātpratyayavidhau' iti vacanādanutpanna eva taddhite
puṃvadbhāvena bhavitavyam | yuvaśabdaśca' kaninyuvṛṣa' iti
kaninpratyayāntatvādādyaudāta ityautsagika evāṇ siddha iti tasyeha
pāṭho'narthakaḥ syāt | yauvatamiti | yathā tu vātikaṃ tathā
puṃvadbhāva iṣyate | āha hi---ṭhbhikṣādiṣu yuvatigrahaṇānarthakyaṃ
puṃvadbhāvasya siddhatvāt pratyayavidhau' iti ||
gotrokṣoṣṭrorabhrarājārājanyarājaputravatsamanuṣyājād vuñ ||
4|2|39 ||
apatyādhikārādanyatreti | yadyevam,
rājanyamanuṣyayorupādānamanarthakam, gotra ityevasiddham | na
tāvapatyapratyayāntau; jāteḥ pratyayārthatvāt | uktaṃ
hi---ṭhrājño'patye jātigrahaṇam, manorjātāvañyatau ṣukceti |
kiṃtarhyucyate ṭhprakṛtyā'ke rājanyamanuṣyayuvānaḥ' iti yalopo na
bhavatīti, yāvatā'nāpatyayakāratvenaiva na bhaviṣyati ? satyam ;
apatyārthatvamabhyupetyaitaducyate | yadyapatyārthatvamabhyupeyate,
rājanyamanuṣyayorgrahaṇamanarthakam ? nānarthakam; jñāpanārthatvāt,
etaj jñāpayati---naitayorapatyakṛtaṃ bhavatīti, tena yalopo na
bhavati, sarvathā ṭhprakṛtyā'ke rājanyamanuṣyayuvānaḥ' iti na vaktavyam
| aupagavakamiti | yathātra paro'pyanudātāderañ na bhavati, tathā
ṭhkhaṇḍikādibhyaśca' ityatra vakṣyate ||
brāhmaṇamāṇavavāḍavādyan || 4|2|42 ||
nakāraḥ svārtha iti | ṭhñnityādirnityam' ityādyaudātatvaṃ yathā
syāt | kimarthaṃ punarbrāhmaṇādibhyo yanvidhīyate, na prakṛto yañeva
vidhīyate, na hi vṛddheṣu yaño yano vā viśeṣo'sti---tadeva
rūpam, sa eva svaraḥ, ṭhañastvasvaritatvādananuvṛttiḥ ? jñāpanārthaṃ tu |
etaj jñāpayati---anyebhya'pyayam | kiṃ siddhaṃ bhavati ?
pṛṣṭhādupasaṅkhyānaṃ codayiṣyati tanna vaktavyaṃ bhavati |
pṛṣṭhānāṃ samūha iti | pṛṣṭhaśabdaḥ stutiviśeṣavacanaḥ | pṛṣṭhayaḥ
ṣaḍaha iti | tadvati tadupacāraḥ |
ṇasvaktavya iti | sakāraḥ padasañjñārthaḥ, tena pārśvamityatra
bhatvābhāvādorguṇo na bhavati ||
anudātāderañ || 4|2|44 ||
acitātparatvād ṭhakā bhavitavyamiti | citavanta udāhṛtāḥ,
kapotamayūraśabdau ṭhlaghāvante' iti madhyodātau, igupadhātkaḥ,
tarateḥ sanvatuk cābhyāsasyeti kipratyayāntastitiriśabdaḥ
pratyayasvareṇāntodātaḥ | sanvadbhāvenādyaudātatvaṃ na bhavati;
ṭhuṇādayo bahulam' iti bahulavacanāt ||
khaṇḍirakādibhyaśca || 4|2|45 ||
kṣudrakāśceti | kṣudrakasyāpatyāni, janapadaśabdāditi vihitasya
tadrājasya luk, mālavātu vṛddhalakṣaṇasya ñyaṅaḥ | pūrveṇāñi siddhe
iti | samāsāntodātatve sati śeṣanighātenānudātāditvāt ||
nanu ca paratvāditi | abhyupetya gotratvametaduktam, tadeva tu
nāstītyāha---na ca gotrasamudāyo gotramiti | tatra ca yathā
janapadasamudāyo janapadagrahaṇena na gṛhyata iti kāśikosalāyā ityatra
ccha eva bhavati, na janapadalakṣaṇo vuñ, tadvadatrāpi gotralakṣaṇo
vuñ na prāpnotīti bhāvaḥ | syādetat---mā bhūtsamudāyo
gotram, mālavaśabdastu gotraṃ bhavati, tataśca tadantavidhinā
samudāyādapi vuñprāpnotīti ? tatrāha---na ceti | ṭhyena
vidhistadantasya' ityatra hi ṭhsamāsapratyayavidhau pratiṣedhaḥ' ityuktam |
evaṃ tarhītyādi | kathamekena yatnenobhayaṃ śakyaṃ jñāpayitum ?
śakyamityāha, anyathānupapatyā jñāpakaṃ bhavati, ubhayena ca vinā
nāsmādañvidhānamupapadyata iti | kimātrānupapannam ? tatra
pūrvavipratiṣedhajñāpanasya prayojanamaupagavakaṃ kāpaṭavakamiti |
vuño'vakāśaḥ yadādyaudātam---glucukasyāpatyaṃ glucukāyaniḥ,
ṭhprācāmavṛddhātphin' teṣāṃ samūho glaucukāyanakamiti; añastu
kāpotamityādyagotramavakāśaḥ; gotrādanudātāderubhayaprasaṅge
paratvādañ, syāt, asmātu jñāpakād vuñeva bhavati |
tadantavidhijñāpanasya prayojanam---vanahastināṃ samūho
vānahastikam | gaudhenumiti | ṭhjaṅgaladhenuvalajānatasya'
ityutarapadavṛddhivikalpaḥ |
punarasyaiva niyamārthatvaṃ varṇayiṣyan kathamekena yatnenobhayaṃ
labhyam---jñāpanaṃ ca niyamaśca ?
ityāśaṅkyāha---kṣudrakamālavādityetāvateti | yogavibhāgena
yatnadvayamāśrīyata ityarthaḥ | kṣaudrakamālavī, kṣaudrakamālavakamiti |
ubhayatrāpi mālavādutpannasya ñyaṅaḥ ṭhgotre'lugaci' iti luki
pratiṣiddhe ṭhāpatyasya' iti yalopaḥ |
añsiddhirityādi anudātāderiti | hetugarbhaṃ viśeṣaṇam;
yato'yaṃ kṣudrakamālavaśabdo'nudātādistena
tasyādanudātāderityevāñaḥ siddhirasti | korthaḥ tasya
gaṇapāṭheneti śeṣaḥ | na kiñcitprayojanam ityarthaḥ | gotralakṣaṇo
vuñ prāpnoti, atastadvādhanārthaḥ pāṭha iti
cetatrāha---gotrādvuñiti | gotrādvuñ vidhīyate, na ca
tatkṣudrakamālavetiśabdarūpagotramityarthaḥ | tadantāditi |
mālavaśabdasya gotratvātadantavidhinā prāpnotyeva | na sa sarvata iti
| ādyāditvātsaptamyantātasiḥ, sa tadantavidhiḥ sarvatra na bhavatītyarthaḥ |
tadantatve iti | tadantavidhirastītyasminnartha ityarthaḥ | tathā ceti |
dhenuranañikamutpādayatīti āpiśaleḥ sūtram | atra
vṛddhyartho'nubandho mṛgyaḥ, ikasyaiva cesusuktāntātparasya kādeśo
draṣṭavyaḥ | arthamātraṃ vā bhāṣkāreṇa nirdiṣṭam | ikagiti ṭhakamityarthaḥ
| dhenūnāṃ samūho dhainukam | anañiti kim ? adhenūnāṃ samūha
ādhenavam, utsādipāṭhādañ | yadyapi dhenuśabdaḥ sūtre paṭha|lte,
tathāpi baṣkayāsa iti liṅgādadhenuśabdādapi bhavati | tatra yadi
sāmūhikeṣu tadantavidhirna syāt, anañiti pratiṣedho'rthakaḥ
syāt |
prayojanāntaramapyāha---senāyāmiti | yatheti | pūrvavipratiṣedhena
vuñā'ño bādhā yathā syādityevamarthaśca tasya gaṇe pāṭha ityarthaḥ |
ulūkaśabdo'tra paṭha|lte sa ṭhlaghāvante' iti madhyodātaḥ | cchandasi tu
yadulūko vadati moghametat, itthā ulūka āpaptaditi
yadādyaudātatvam, tacchāndasam | bhāṣāyāṃ tu madhyodātameva, tatra
pūrveṇaivāñ siddhaḥ, tasmādevaṃ vaktavyam---aulūkyaśabdo
gargādiyañantaḥ, yataḥ ṭhyañañośca' iti bahuṣu luki kṛte rūpam,
tadiha paṭha|lta iti | asati hi tasya pāṭhe ulūkānāṃ samūha
ityarthavivakṣāyāṃ ṭhgotre'lugaci' iti lukaḥ
pratiṣedhādaulukyaśabdād gotrāśrayo vuñprapnoti |
śukaśabdo'tra paṭha|lte, ṭhtasya samūhaḥ' ityatra tu ṭhyasya ca
nānyatpratipadavidhānamasti' ityuktvodāhṛtam--kākaṃ śaukamiti,
tasmātatra śaukamityasya sthāne bākamiti paṭhitavyam | bakaśabdaḥ
ṭhprāṇināṃ kupūrvāṇām' ityādyaudātaḥ | yugavaratreti paṭha|lte,
tatsaṅghātavigṛhītārthamicchanti---yaugavaratram, yaugam,
vāratramiti, tatra saṅghātapakṣe ṭhjātiraprāṇinām' iti
dvandvaikavadbhāve napuṃsakahrasvatve sati yugavaratreti
dīrghanirdeśo'nupapannaḥ, tasmādyaugasahitā varatreti samāsaḥ
kartavyaḥ, jātiparatvābhāvādvā ekavadbhāvābhāvaḥ ||
caraṇebhyo dharmavat || 4|2|46 ||
gotracaraṇādvuñityārabhya pratyayā vakṣyante iti | nanu ca na tatra
dharmagrahaṇamasti, tatkathaṃ dharmavadityatideśo yujyata
ityāha---tatredamiti | idameva dharmavaditivacanaṃ liḍgamasti, tatra
caraṇāddharmāmnāyayoriti | vatiḥ sarvasādṛśyārtha iti | asati
tasmin ṭhcaraṇebhyo dharmaḥ' ityucyamāne yadi tāvadevaṃ sambandhaḥ,
caraṇebhyo dharme ye pratyayā vidhāsyante te bhavanti, samūha iti
samūhaprakṛtiraviśeṣitā syāt, tataśca kākādibhyo'pi vuñādayaḥ
prasajyeran | atha punarevaṃ sambandhaḥ---dharme ye pratyayā vidhāsyante
te caraṇebhyaḥ samūhe bhavantīti ? evamapi dharmapratyayā na viśeṣitāḥ
syuḥ, tataśca ṭhtasyedam' iti vidhāsyamānā aṇādayo'pi kaṭhādibhya
āpadyeran | athāpyevaṃ sambandhaḥ---caraṇebhyo dharme ye pratyayāste
bhavanti caraṇebhya eva samūha iti ? tatra sakṛt śrutasya
caraṇaśabdasyaivamubhayasambandha eva tāvad durlabhaḥ, athāpi labhyeta ?
evamapi yaḥ kaściddharme pratyayo yataḥ kutaściccaraṇaśabdātsyāt,
ṭhkaupiñjalahāstipadādaṇ' kaṭhādibhyo'pi syāt, vatinirdeśe tu
sati sarvasādṛśyaparigraho bhavati | tena yābhyaḥ prakṛtibhyo yena
viśeṣaṇena ye pratyayā dharme vidhāsyante, ihāpi tābhyaḥ
prakṛtibhyastenaiva viśeṣaṇena ta eva bhavantīti na kiñcidaniṣṭam |
kāṭhakam, kālāpakamiti | gotracaraṇādvuñ | chāndīgyamiti |
ṭhcchandogaukthika' iti ñyaḥ | ātharvaṇamiti |
ṭhātharvaṇikasyekalopaśca' ityaṇ, ikalopaśca ||
acitahastidhenoṣṭhak || 4|2|47 ||
aṇañorapavāda iti | acitārtheṣu yenanāprāptinyāyenāṇo'pavādaḥ |
kapotādiṣu citavatsu caritārthasyāño'pi paratvādvādhaka ityarthaḥ |
hastidhenuśabdayostu
pratyayasvareṇāntodātayoranudātādilakṣaṇasyāño'pavādaḥ |
hastiśabdaḥ ṭhhastājjātau' itīnipratyayāntaḥ | dhenuśabdaḥ
ṭhgheṭo'nuśca' iti nupratyayāntaḥ | ādhenavamiti | atsādipāṭhādañ,
ṭhjaṅgaladhenuvalajāntasya' iti pakṣe vṛddhyabhāvaḥ ||
pāśādibhyo yaḥ || 4|2|49 ||
yapratyayayāntaṃ svabhāvataḥ strīliṅgam | vātaśabdo'tra
paṭha|lte---vātānāṃ samūho vātyā, pṛthagvātādarśanādayukto'tra
samūhaḥ, tasmācchīghratve pratyayo vaktavyaḥ ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; ekasyāpi
vātāvayavino digbhedena bhedo'dhyāropaḥ, tadāśrayaśca samūhaḥ |
atha vā---pratidiśaṃ vātāvayavina eva bhidyante, tathā ca
pratibhāsaḥ---vūrvovātaḥ, utaro vātaḥ, sarvato vānti vātā iti |
āha ca---vāyorvāyusammūrchanaṃ nānātve liṅgamiti |
khalagorathāt || 4|2|50 ||
atha kasmātkhalādayo'pi pāśādiṣveva na paṭhitāḥ, evaṃ hi
vibhaktirnoccārayitavyā bhavati ? tatrāha---pāśādiṣvapāṭha iti ||
initrakaṭa|lcaśca || 4|2|51 ||
yogavibhāgo yathāsaṅkhyārthaḥ, anyatā
hanitrakaṭa|lcastrayaścakārādyaśceti catvāraḥ pratyayāḥ, prakṛtayastu tisra
iti vaiṣamyaṃ syāt |
khalādibhya iti | khalādayaḥ prayogato gamyāḥ | ete'pi pratyayāḥ
svabhāvataḥ striyāmeva ||
viṣayo deśe || 4|2|52 ||
nanu ca viṣayasya deśatvāvyabhicārād deśa iti viśeṣaṇaṃ
vyarthamityata āha---viṣayaśabdo'yamiti |
atyantaśīlitaḥuatyantābhyastaḥ | tatra deśagrahaṇaṃ
grāmasamudāyapratipatyarthamiti | yadyevam, deśagrahaṇamevāstu mā
bhūdviṣayagrahaṇam ? naivaṃ śakyam; deśaśabdo'pi nānārthaḥ, deśanaṃ
deśa iti kriyāśabdasyāpi bhāvāt | śibīnāṃ viṣayo deśaḥ śaiba
iti | kathaṃ śibayo deśa iti ? nivāsavivakṣāyām ṭhtasya nivāsaḥ'
ṭhjanapade lup' iti lupi bhaviṣyati | nanvarthabhedo bhavati,
śibīnāṃ nivāso janapada ityatra svāsvāmibhāvo na pratīyate,
anyadīye'pi janapade nivāsasambhāvat; śibīnāṃ viṣaya ityatra tu
svasvāmibhāvaḥ pratīyate, na tu nivāsārthaḥ, tatrāvasatāmapi
svāmitvasambhavāt ? satyam ; ya evāsau yeṣāṃ viṣayastatraiva teṣāṃ
nivāse janapade lup smaryate, na nivāsamātre | atra
cābhidānasvābhāvyaṃ hetuḥ | evaṃ ca śibīnāṃ viṣayaḥ śaiba ityatrārthe
vibaya ityapi bhavati | evaṃ vasātīnāṃ viṣayo vāsātaḥ, teṣāmeva
nivāso vasātayaḥ | tathā gāndhārīṇāṃ viṣayo gāndhāraḥ, nivāso
gāndhārayaḥ | aṅgāḥ, vaṅgā, srughnāḥ puṇḍrā iti---nivāsarūpataiva
vivakṣyate, na viṣayarūpatā |
eṣaṃ rājanyādibyo vuñityatrāpi viṣayavivakṣāyāṃ rājanyakam,
nivāso rājanyāḥ | tatraiva bailvatādiṣu viṣayavivakṣaiva, tena
bailvatakam, āmbarīṣaputrakamityādyeva bhavati | sarvatra
cābhidhānaśaktireva hetuḥ, tadāha---viṣayābhidhāne janapade lup,
bahuvacanaviṣayād gāndhāryādibhyo vā rājanyādibhyo nityam, na
vābhidheyasya nivāsaviṣayatvāt | nivāsavivakṣāyāṃ lup,
viṣayavivakṣāyāṃ tu pratyaya iti ||
so'syādiriticchandasaḥ pragātheṣu || 4|2|55 ||
cchandasa iti na svarūpagrahaṇam, nāpi mantrabrāhmaṇayoḥ, kasya tarhi ?
akṣarāṇāmiyatāvacanaścchandaḥ śabdo'sti, yasya jagatyādayo
viśeṣāstasya grahaṇam ; prāgāthānāmādau tasyaiva sambhavāt, tena
paṅktyādiśabdebhyaḥ pratyayaḥ | yatra dve ṛcau tisraḥ kriyanta iti
caturthaṣaṣṭhau pādau bārhato pragāye
punarabhyasitvotarayoravasyedityevamādinā prakāreṇa |
tadyathā---yajñāyajñā vaḥ priyaṃ mitraṃ na śaṃsiṣāā priyaṃ mitraṃ na
śaṃsiṣamūje nipātamiti | tatra yo'yamuccāraṇaprakārastadgrathanam
| pragrathanāditi | pragāthaśabdapravṛttinimitaṃ darśayati, pragrathyata iti
pragāthaḥ, ṭhakartari ca kārake' iti karmaṇi ghañ,
pṛṣodarāditvādrephanakārayorlopaḥ | prāgāṇādveti | ṭhkṛtyacaḥ' iti
ṇatvam, ṭhkau gau śabde', pragīyata iti pragāthaḥ,
ṭhuṣikuṣigartibhyasthan' | traiṣṭuabhamiti | kuṭīra iti svārthikasyāpi
rapratyayasya yathā bhinnaliṅgatā, tathehāpi napuṃsakatvaṃ draṣṭavyam ||
saṃgrāme prayojanayoddhṛbhyaḥ || 4|2|56 ||
ṭhsamarthānāṃ prathamādvā' iti vacanātsaṃgrāmavācibhyaḥ pratyayaḥ prāpnoti,
na prayojanayoddhṛbhyaścaramanirdiṣṭebhya ityāśaṅkyāha--so'syeti
samarthavibhaktirityādi | prathamāsamarthaviśeṣaṇamiti | tena
viśeṣyadvāreṇa prayājanayoddhāra eva prathamanirdiṣṭāḥ |
pratyayārthaviśeṣaṇaṃ saṃgrāma iti | tena taddvāreṇa
saṃgrāmaścaramanirdiṣṭaḥ ||
ghañaḥ sāsyāṃ kriyeti ñaḥ || 4|2|58 ||
asyāmiti pratyayārthaḥ strīliṅga iti | tena liṅgasya vivakṣitatvaṃ
darśayati | ghañantātkriyāvācina iti | bhāve yo ghañ
tadantādityarthaḥ | śyainampāteti | patanaṃ pātaḥ, śyenānāṃ pāta iti
kartari ṣaṣṭhayāḥ samāsaḥ, tato ñaḥ, ṭhśyenatilasya pāte ñaḥ' iti
mum | prākāra iti | dravyavacano'yaṃ karmaṇi ghañantaḥ, ṭhupasargasya
ghañyamanuṣye bahulam' iti praśabdasyadīrghatvam | sāmānyena cedaṃ
vidhānamiti | etadevodāharaṇena draḍhayāta---daṇāḍapāta iti ||
tadadhīte tadveda || 4|2|59 ||
iha yo'yaṃ granthamadhīte sa taṃ svarūpatā veti, yaśca veti
so'vaśyamadhīte---ityanyataropādānena siddham,
kimarthamimāvarthāvupadiśyete, naitayorāvaśyakaḥ samāveśaḥ,
adhyayanam u śabdapāṭhaḥ, arthāvabodhaḥ u vedanam, bhavati
ca---kaścitsaṃpāṭhṃa paṭhati nārthaṃ veti, kaściccārthaṃ veti na saṃpāṭhṃa
paṭhati |
dvistadgrahaṇamityādi | ṭhtadadhīte veda' ityucyamāne samuccayo
vijñāyeta, tataśca yastadadhīte veda ca tatraiva syāt, yastu
kevalamadhīte veda vā na tatra syāt; dvistadgrahaṇe tu
vākyabhedenādhīyānaviduṣoḥ pṛthakpratyayavidhānaṃ sidhyati | nanu ca
ṭhtadasya tadasminsyāt' ityatra nānārthanirdeśe pratyekaṃ
samarthavibhaktiḥ sambandhanīyeti dvistadgrahaṇena nyāyo
vyutpādayiṣyate, ata eva ṭhtena dīvyati' ityatra pratyarthaṃ pratyayo
bhavati ? na brūmaḥ---ihaiva dvistadgrahaṇamadhīyānaviduṣoḥ
pṛthagvidhānārthamiti, kiṃ tarhi ? utaratra
ṭhkratūkthādisūtrāntāṭhaṭhak', ṭhvasantādibhyaṣṭak' ityatrāpi, kiṃ ca
kāraṇaṃ na syāt ? kratuśabdaḥ karmanāmadeyaṃ vasantādayo'pyarthāḥ, na
teṣāmadhyayanaṃ sambhavati, tasya śabdaviṣayatvāt, tatsahacarite tu
granthe sambhavati, gauṇatvātu na gṛhyate, mukhya eva tvarthe vedanaṃ
sambhavatīti tebhyo viduṣyeva syād, nādhyetari |
punastadgrahaṇātu yatnād gauṇasyāpi grahaṇātatrāpi bhavati ||
kratūkthādisūtrāntāṭṭhak || 4|2|60 ||
kratuviśeṣavācibhya iti | svarūpasya tu grahaṇaṃ na bhavati, yadi
syādukthādiṣveva paṭhet | kratusāmānyavācināmapi
sobhayāgādīnāṃ paryāyāṇāṃ na bhavati; ukthādiṣu yajñaśabdasya
pāṭhāt | tasmādviśeṣavācināmeva grahaṇaṃ tebhyo
mukhyārthavṛttibhyo veditari pratyayaḥ,
tatpratipādanaparagranthavṛttibhyastvadhyetari | vārtikasūtrika iti |
vṛtau sādhu vārtikam ṭhkathādibhyaṣṭak' | vārtikaṃ ca tatsūtraṃ ceti
karmadhārayātpratyayaḥ | evaṃ sāṃgrahasūtrika iti | kalpasūtramiti
karmadhārayaḥ, samāhāradvandvo vā |
