yajñāyajñīyātpareṇeti | enapā yoge pañcamī cintyā, enabapi
paraśabdātpākṣikaḥ, yadā tadvidhau ṭhutarādharadakṣiṇādātiḥ' iti
nānuvartate, dikśabdebhya ityevānuvartate | na ca tānyadhīyāne
pratyaya iṣyata iti | ṭhag, aṇ---ca pratyayadvayamapi neṣyate,
tenokthānyadhīyata iti vākyameva bhavati | atra ca abhidhānameva
śaraṇam, sāmalakṣaṇaṃ prātiśākhyam | aukthikya iti |
aukthikānāmānnāyaḥ, idamarthe ṭhcchandogaukthika' iti ñyaḥ |
aukthikyaśabdācca pratyayo na bhavatīti | aṇpratyaya ityarthaḥ, idaṃ
prasaṅgāduktam | sūtrāntāditi | atyalpamidamucyata
ityāha---vidyālakṣaṇakalpasūtrāntāditi vaktavyamiti | vidyā
cetyādivākyenātiprasaktasyāpavādaḥ | aṅgādipūrvo vidyāśabdaḥ
pratyayaṃ notpādayatītyarthaḥ | traividya iti | tryavayavā vidyā trividyā,
tāmadhīte traividyaḥ | tisro vidyā adhīta iti tu vigrahe
ṭhdvigorluganapatye' iti lukprasaṅgaḥ |
yāvakrītika iti | yavakrītamadhikṛtya kṛtamākhyānaṃ
yavakrītaśabdenocyate, evaṃ praiyaṅgavamadhikṛtya
kṛtamupacārātpraiyaṅgavamucyate | vāsavadatika iti |
vāsavadatāmadhikṛtya kṛtā ākhyāyikā, ṭhadhikṛtya kṛte granthe'
ityatrārthe ṭhvṛddhācchaḥ', tasya ṭhlubākhyāyikābhyo bahulam' iti lup,
tato'nena ṭhak | evaṃ saumanotarikaḥ, aitihāsika iti | iti
hāsīditi yatrocyate sa itihāsaḥ, pṛṣodarāditvātsādhuḥ |
sarvasāderiti | sarvādeḥ, sāderdvigoścotpannasya patyayasya lo
bhavati lugbhavatītyarthaḥ, arthavataḥ saśabdasya grahaṇātsarvaśabdaḥ
pṛthagupātaḥ, ṭhdvigośca' ityanena ṭhdvigorluganapatye' ityayameva
luk smāritaḥ | sarvaveda iti | sarvavedānadhīte ityaṇo luk |
savārtika iti | vartikāntamadhīte iti antavacane
sahaśabdasyāvyayībhāvaḥ, ṭhavyayībhāve cākāle' iti sabhāvaḥ, tato'ṇo
luk |
anusūriti | anusūśabdaṣṭhakamutpādayati, lakṣyalakṣaṇaśabdau cetyarthaḥ
| ānusuka iti | anusūmadhīta iti ṭhak, tasya ṭhisusuktantātkaḥ' iti
kādeśaḥ, ṭhke'ṇaḥ' iti hrasvaḥ |
padotarapāditi | padaśabda utarapadaṃ yasya sa tathoktaḥ,
pūrvapadamadhīte pūrvapadikaḥ | evamutarapadikaḥ |
śataṣaṣṭeriti | śataśabdātṣaṣṭiśabdācca paro yaḥ
pathinśabdastadantāt ṣikan bhavati | ṣakāro ṅīṣarthaḥ ||
anubrāhmaṇādiniḥ || 4|2|62 ||
brāhmaṇāsadṛśa iti | ṭhyathārthe yadavyayam' iti sādṛśye'vyayībhāvaḥ |
codayati---matvartha iti | pariharati---tatraitasmāditi |
dūṣayati---anabhidhānāditi | sākṣātparihāramāha---aṇo nivṛtyarthaṃ
tu vacanamiti | kvacitu matvartha ityādi na paṭha|lte ||
vasantādibhyaṣṭhak || 4|2|63 ||
vasantasahacarita iti | yatra vasanto varṇyate yo vā vasante'dhyeyaḥ |
vasantasāhacaryātācchadyaṃ labhate |
ukthādiṣvete paṭhitavyāḥ, te vā vasantādiṣu ? tathā tu na
kṛtamityeva | atharvanśabdo'tra paṭha|lte, sa upacāreṇa prokte granthe
vartate | atharvaṇamadhīte ātharvaṇikaḥ, ṭhdāṇḍināyanahāstināyana' iti
nipātanāt ṭhnastaddhite' iti ṭilopābhāvaḥ ||
proktālluk || 4|2|64 ||
proktasahacarita iti | arthasya proktatvādarthena ca pratyayasya
paurvāparyāyogānmukhyārthāsambhavād gauṇasya grahaṇamityarthaḥ |
apara āha---proktaśabda iha svaryate, tena tadadhikāravihitaḥ pratyayo
gṛhyata iti | yadi vā prokte bhavaḥ prokta iti sautro'yamataddhaitanirdeśaḥ
| pāṇinīyamiti | nanu paṇo'syāstīti paṇī, tasyāpatyaṃ pāṇinaḥ,
pāṇinasyāpatyaṃ paṇino yuvā pāṇiniḥ, tataḥ ṭhtena proktam'
ityarthavivakṣāyāṃ ṭhyūni luk' iti iño luki kṛte pratyayalakṣaṇena
ṭhiñaśca' ityaṇ prāpnoti ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; ṭhiñaśca' ityatra
ṭhkaṇāvādibhyo gotre' ityataḥ ṭhgotre' ityanuvartate, teneñaṃ
viśeṣayiṣyāmaḥ---gotre ya iñ vihitastadantāditi | tatra ca
pāribhāṣikaṃ gotraṃ gṛhyate, tena yūnīño na bhaviṣyati, tato
vṛddhācchaḥ; āpiśaliśabdād ṭhiñaśca' ityaṇ, ubhayatrādhyetṛpratyayasya
luk | nanvatra luki sati, asati vā tadeva rūpamiti nāsti viśeṣaḥ
? tatrāha---striyāṃ svareca viseṣa iti | asati luki striyām
ṭhṭiḍḍhāṇañ' ityādinā ṅīp syāt, aṇsvareṇāntodātatvaṃ ca
| luki tu sati ṭāb bhavati, cchasvareṇa madhyodātatvaṃ ca | āpiśale
tu svare nāsti viśeṣaḥ, yathā tu luki satyapiśaletyatra ṅībna
bhavati, tathā ṭhanupasarjanād' ityatra pratyapādi ||
sūtrācca sopadhāt || 4|2|65 ||
aṣṭakaṃ sūtramiti | aṣṭāvadhyāyāḥ parimāṇamasya, ṭhsaṃkhyāyāḥ
saṃjñāsaṅghasūtrādhyayaneṣu' iti ṭhsaṃkhyāyā atiśadantāyāḥ kan' |
saṃkhyāprakṛteriti vaktavyamiti | saṃkhyā prakṛtiryasya pratyayasya
tadantātkopadhāditi vaktavyamityarthaḥ | kālāpakamadhīte kālāpaka iti
| kalāpinā proktamedhīyate kālāpāḥ, ṭhkalāpino'ṇ', ṭhnāntasya
ṭilope sabrahmacāri' ityaupasaṃkhyānikaṣṭilopaḥ, tataḥ ṭhtadadhīte'
ityaṇ, proktālluk | kālāpānāmāmnāya iti ṭhgotracaraṇād
vuñ', kālāpakam, tataḥ ṭhtadadhīte' ityaṇ, tasya lugna bhavati |
yadi syād ñitsvareṇādyaudātatvaṃ syāt, lugabhāve tvaṇa eva svaro
bhavati, striyāṃ ca ṅīb bhavati |
catuṣṭaya iti | catvāro'vayavā asya ṭhsaṃkhyāyā avayave tayap',
ṭhhrasvātādau taddhite' iti mūrddhanyaḥ ||
cchandobrāhmaṇāni ca tadviṣayāṇi || 4|2|66 ||
proktagrahaṇamanuvartate iti | taddhyanuvartamānameva pūrvasūtra
ārambhasāmarthyānna sambadhyate | cchandāṃsi ca brāhmaṇāni ceti | tadvācīni
śabdarūpāṇītyarthaḥ | svarūpagrahaṇaṃ tu na bhavati; bahuvacananirdeśāt,
aproktapratyayāntatvācca | proktapratyayāntānīti | proktāditi
pañcamyantaṃ prakṛtaṃ prathamābahuvacanāntaṃ vipariṇamyate,
ṭhcchandobrāhmaṇāni' ityanena sāmānādhikaraṇyāditi bhāvaḥ |
adhyetṛveditṛpratyayaviṣayāṇītyanenaitaddarśayati---tacchabdenādhyetṛveditṛpratyayaḥ parāmṛśyate, vidheyatayā pradhānatvāt; nādhyetṛveditāsavarthau, tayoḥ pratyayavidhau guṇabhāvāditi | kiṃ siddhaṃ bhavati ? adhyetṛviṣayamapi vākyaṃ nivartitaṃ bhavati | ananyabhāvo viṣayārtha iti | grāmasamudāyādivṛttistu viṣayaśabdo'sambhavānna gṛhyate | atra yadyadhīte vedetyanuvarteta, tato'dhyetṛveditṛvivakṣāyāmeva tadviṣayatā vidhīyeta, tataśca tadviṣayameva vākyaṃ nivartayet, na kriyāntaraviṣayam, nāpi svātantryamupādhyantarayogaṃ ca | yadāha---tatra ṭhyathādhikārātadviṣayaprasaṅgaḥ' iti | tasmātproktagrahaṇamevānuvartate, nādhīyate vedeti | tacchabdena ca pratyayaḥ parāmṛśyate, viṣayaśabdaśca ananyabhāvārthaḥ | tena sarvametatsvātantryādi nivartate | āha ca---ṭhsiddhaṃ tu proktādhikāre tadviṣayavacanāt' iti | proktagrahaṇamevādhikriyate, nādhīte vedetyetāvarthāvityarthaḥ |
iha proktapratyayāntasya bahuprakāratā dṛśyate---svātantryam,
upādhyantarayogaḥ, vākyam, adhyetṛveditroḥ pratyaya iti | svātantryaṃ
tāvat---pāṇininā proktaṃ pāṇinīyamiti | proktārtha eva vṛttiḥ;
upādhyantarayogaḥ | mahatpāṇinīyamiti vākyam | pāṇinīyamadhīta
iti pratyayaḥ---pāṇinīyāśchātrā iti | cchandobrāhmaṇavācināṃ tu
proktapratyayāntānāṃ nityamadhyetṛveditṛpratyayāntavaiveṣyate, na tu
svātantryādi, tadarthamidamārabhyate, tadāha---teneti | evaṃ ca
kṛtvā'rthadvayasyāpiṃ tantreṇa vigrahaḥ kartavya iti darśayati | kaṭhena
proktamadhīyate kaṭhāḥ, vaiśampāyanāntevāsitvāṇṇiniḥ, tasya
ṭhkaṭhacarakālluk' iti luk tataḥ ṭhtadadhīte' ityaṇ, tatastasyāpi
ṭhproktālluk' iti luk | mudapippalādaśabdābhyāṃ proktārtho
autsagiko'ṇ | śeṣaṃ yathāyogaṃ pūrvavat |
ṛcābhaḥuvaiśampāyanāntevāsī | evaṃ tāṇḍa|lḥ | vājasaneyaśabdaḥ
śaunakādiḥ | tāṇḍina iti | ṭhapatyasya' iti yalopaḥ | bhāllaviśabda
iñantaḥ | śāṭa|lśabdād gargādiyañantād ṭhyañiñośca' iti phak |
aitareyaśabdaḥ śubhrādiḍhagantaḥ, tebhyaḥ ṭhpurāṇaprokteṣu' iti ṇiniḥ,
sarvatrādhyetṛpratyayasya luk |
brāhmaṇaviśeṣapratipatyarthamiti | brāhmaṇasya viśeṣaḥ purāṇaproktatvam |
yājñavalkyānīti | yājñavalkyaśabdaḥ kaṇvādiḥ, sulabhādautsargiko'ṇ,
atra svātantryaṃ bhavati | ṭhpurāṇaprokteṣu' ityatra
vakṣyati---ṭhyājñavalkyādayo hyacirakālapravṛtā ityākhyāneṣu vārtā'
iti | kāśyapinaḥ, kauśikina iti | ṭhkāśyapakauśikābhyāmṛṣibhyāṃ
ṇiniḥ' | pārāśariṇa iti | pārāśaryaśabdād gargādiyañantāt
ṭhpārāśaryaśilālibhyām' iti ṇiniḥ, pūrvavadyalopaḥ | karmandina iti
| ṭhkarmandakṛśāśvādiniḥ' | piṅgaśabdātpurāṇaprokteṣu' iti ṇiniḥ
||
tadasminnastīti deśe tannāmni || 4|2|67 ||
itikaraṇastataścedvivakṣeti | nanu tannāmagrahaṇādevātiprasaṅgo na
bhaviṣyati ? tanna; dvividhaṃ nāma---kadācitkenacitsaṅketitam,
nityaṃ vyavahārānupāti | tatra dvitīyasya parigrahārthamitikaraṇaḥ
kriyate, bhūmādiviśeṣaparigrahārthaṃ ca | ṭhtannāmni' ityetatu
nāmadheyatāvirodhino balīyaso'pi pratyayān bādhitum , anyathā
nāprāpte matupyārambhātasyāyaṃ bādhakaḥ | tadapavādaistviniṭhanādibhiḥ
saha sampradhāraṇāyāmapavādavipratiṣedhādiniṭhanādaya eva syuḥ ||
tena nirvṛtam || 4|2|68 ||
nirvṛtamityantarbhāvitaṇyarthād vṛteḥ karmaṇi ktaḥ ||
tasya nivāsaḥ || 4|2|69 ||
ṛjunāvāmiti | ṛjvī nauryeṣāṃ teṣāmityarthaḥ ||
adūrabhavaśca || 4|2|70 ||
adūramantikaṃ tatra bhavatītyadūrabhavaḥ, nipātanātsaptamīsamāsaḥ |
vidiśāyā iti | ṭhdūrāntikārthaiḥ ṣaṣṭha|lnyatarasyām' iti ṣaṣṭhī |
cakāra ityādi | asati tu tasminnānantaryādayamevārtha utaratra
sambadhyeta || 
aurañ || 4|2|71 ||
araḍuḥukṣatriyaviśeṣaḥ | nadyāṃ tu matupparatvāditi |
āraḍavamityādiraño'vakāśaḥ, ṭhnadyāṃ matup'
ityasyodumbarāvatītyādiḥ ||
matośca bahvajaṅgāt || 4|2|72 ||
caturarthika iti | caturṇāmarthānāṃ samūhaścaturarthī, tatra bhavaḥ,
adhyātmāditvāṭṭhañ | taddhitārthe dvigau tu ṭhaño luk syāt |
aṅgagrahaṇaṃ kimiti | ṭhmatośca vahvacaḥ' ityevāstu, vyadhikaraṇe
pañcamyau, bahvaco yo vihito matup tadantāditi vijñāyamāne
siddhyatyeva vivakṣitamiti praśnaḥ | matubantaviśeṣaṇaṃ mā bhūditi |
anyathā sāmānādhikaraṇye sambhavati, vaiyadhikaraṇyasyāyuktatvāt
tasyaiva | vaśeṣaṇaṃ syāditi vibhāvaḥ | asti cedidānīṃ
kvacidabahvañ matvānto yadarthaṃ bahvajgrahaṇaṃ syāt ?
astītyāha---svavān, śvavān ||
udakca vipāśaḥ || 4|2|74 ||
mahatī sūkṣmekṣiketi | evaṃ nāma svare'pyācāryo'vahita iti
ācāryasya praśaṃsaiṣā ||
suvāstvādibhyo'ṇ || 4|2|77 ||
aña iti | ṭhaṇgrahaṇarahitasūtrābhiprāyametat | tasya tu prayojanaṃ
svayameva vakṣyati---aṇgrahaṇaṃ matupo bādhanārtham' iti | tena
vastuto matupo'pyayamapavādaḥ | athāṇgrahaṇaṃkimartham, na
suvāstvādibhyo yathā vihitamityevocyeta, punarvacanāddhai ko
vihito na ca prāpnoti sa eva bhaviṣyati sa cāṇeva ?
tatrāha---aṇgrahaṇamiti | asatyaṇgrahaṇe madhye'pavādanyāyena
yatāvihitamityucyamāno'ṇaña eva bādhakaḥ syād, nadīmatupā tu
paratvādvādhyeta, punaraṇgrahaṇātu matupo viṣaye bhavatītyarthaḥ |
kiñca---ṭhorañ' ityasya nadyāṃ matupparatvādvādhaka ityuktam,
tatrāsatyaṇgrahaṇe yatāvihitamityucyamāne nadyām ṭhorañ' eva
syād, vacanaṃ tu matupo bādhanārthaṃ syāt |
tasmādetadarthamapyaṇgrahaṇaṃ kartavyam ||
roṇī || 4|2|78 ||
kevalastadantaśceti | anyathā grahaṇavatā prātipadikena
tadantavidhipratiṣedhātkevalādeva syāt, na tadantāt | roṇīti
punaḥ śāstranirapekṣeṇa nirdeśena śāstranirapekṣatvamiha sacyata iti
paribhāṣayā anapekṣaṇātadantādapi bhavati | nanu ca roṇīti nedaṃ
prātipadikam, strīpratyayāntatvāt; na ca ṭhgrahaṇavatā prātipadikena'
ityatra liṅgaviśiṣṭasya grahaṇam, yena strīpratyayāntenāpi
tadantavidhiḥ pratiṣidhyeta, svarūpavidhiviṣayā paribhāṣeyaṃ
prātipadikasya svarūpagrahaṇe liṅgaviśiṣṭasyāpi grahaṇaṃ
bhavatītyuktatvāt ? yathākathañcitprātipadikagrahaṇe liṅgaviśiṣṭasya
grahaṇaṃ bhavatīti bhāṣyakārapakṣaḥ, tadāśrayeṇaitaduktam | evaṃ ca
vṛttikārasyāpyayameva pakṣaḥ | ṅyāpsūtretu parapakṣo darśita iti
gamyate | ki siddhaṃ bhavati ? kumārīmācaṣṭe
kumārayati---ṭhṇāviṣṭhavad' iti ṭilopaḥ siddho bhavati
||
vuñcchaṇkaṭhajilaseniraḍhañṇayayaphakphiñiññyakakṭhakorīhaṇakṛśāśvaryakumudakāśatṛṇaprekṣāśmasakhisaṅkāśabalapakṣakarṇasutaṅgamapragadinvarāhakumudādibhyaḥ || sūtre kumudaśabdo dvirupādīyate, tatrārīhaṇakṛśāśvarśyakumudāśca kāśatṛṇādayaśceti dvandvayordvandkaraṇādekaśeṣābhāvaḥ | kumudādiṣviti | ṛśyāderanantareṣu autsargiko'pi tatra iṣyata ityādi yaduktaṃ tadevāptaprayogeṇa draḍhayati---tathā coktamiti | ṭhlupiyuktavad' ityatra bhāṣyakāraṇaitaduktam | athāsmātprayogādviśeṣavihitānāmeva pakṣe lub bhavatīti kasmānnocyate ? tathā vā bhavatu; sarvathā cātūrūpyamevātra naḥ samīhitam ||
śarkarāyā vā || 4|2|83 ||
kumudādiṣviti | ṛśyādyanantareṣu | pāṭhasāmarthyāditi | nitye hi
lupi gaṇayorasya pāṭho'narthakaḥ syāt | śakareti | aṇe lup |
śārkaramiti | tasyaiva śravaṇam | śarkarikamiti |
kumudāditvāṭṭhac | śārkarakamiti | varāhāditvātkak, ṭhke'ṇaḥ'
iti hrasvaḥ | śārkarikam, śarkarīyamiti | utarasūtreṇa ṭhakchau ||
nadyāṃ matup || 4|2|84 ||
ṭhtadasyāstyasmin' iti matupi siddhe vacanamidaṃ tadasminnastīti

iti | deśasya viśeṣaṇaṃ nadīti | yadyapi ṭhviśiṣṭaliṅga'

evaṃ ca parvateṣvapi cāturarthiko bhavati | anye tvāhuḥ---nadyapi deśa
eva, lokaprasiddheḥ; ṭhviśiṣṭaliṅga' ityatra tu nadīgrahaṇaṃ yasya

bhūdityevamarthamiti | udumbarāvatītyādau ṭhmatau
bahvaco'najirādīnām' iti dīrghatvam | bhāgīrathīti | ṭhtena
nirvṛtam' ityaṇ ||
kumudanaḍavetasebhyo ḍmatup || 4|2|87 ||
kumudvānityādau jhayaḥ ṭhmādupadhāyāśca' iti vatvam | atha
vakārādireva kasmānna vihitaḥ ? jñāpanārtham,
etajjñāpayati---anyebhyo'pyayaṃ bhavatīti | tena mahiṣmāniti siddhaṃ
bhavati, mahiṣācceti na vaktavyaṃ bhavati | etenaitadapi

śādaśabdo dopadhaḥ, ṭhpaṅko'strī śādakardamau' iti ||

padatvātsiddho nalopaḥ; kintu kuṭi pratyayāderādeśānupapatiḥ,
cchasyāpratyayāditvādīyādeśo na prāpnoti ||
śeṣe || 4|2|92 ||
apayuktādanyaḥ śeṣa iti | śabdārthakathanametat | tasyaiva
prakaṃraṇādāgataṃ viśeṣamāha---apatyādibhya iti | ete hyatropayuktāḥ |
caturarthaparyantebhya iti | catvāro'rthāḥ ṭhtadasminnasti' ityādayaḥ
paryanto yeṣāmiti vipado bahuvrīhiḥ | cāturarthyaparyantebhya iti
pāṭhe samāhāradvigoścāturvarṇyāditvātsvārthe ṣyañ | ye tu
paṭhanti---cāturarthaparyantebhya iti, te
prajñāderākṛtigaṇatvādaṇamicchanti | kimarthaṃ punaḥ śeṣavacanam ?
śeṣe ghādayo yathā syuḥ, apatyādiṣu mā bhūvan | ciranivṛtā
apatyādayaḥ ? caturṣvartheṣu tarhi mā bhūvan ; anyathā ṭhorañ'
ityādayaḥ ṭhnaḍādīnāṃ kuk ca' ityevamantā yathā caturartheṣu
bhavanti, tathā ghādayo'pi ṭhvibhāṣāa pūrvāhṇābhyām'
ityevamantāstatraiva syuḥ | na hyakasmātprakaraṇaṃ vicchidyate | nivartiṣyate
tarhi caturjñthāḥ ? asvaritatvālliṅgācca, yadayamutkarādiṣu
kāṃścid vṛddhān śabdānpaṭhati---ārdrakā, śāleti; anyathā
ṭhvṛddhācchaḥ' ityeva siddhaḥ syāt | svārthe tarhi ghādayo mā bhūvan ?
anirdiṣṭārthatvāddhi svārtha evasyuḥ, nāmī anirdiṣṭārthāḥ |
jātādiṣvartheṣu ghādayo'nuvartiṣyante ? yadyanuvartante yā yā parā
prakṛtiḥ tasyāstasyāḥ pūrvaḥ pūrvaḥ pratyayaḥ prāpnoti | nārthanirdeśaṃ
prati vyagrayoranyo'nyamabhisambandho bhavati | liṅgācca, yadayaṃ
kkaciccakāreṇa prakṛtaṃ samuccinoti ṭhraṅkoramanuṣye'ṇ ca' iti,
tajjñāpayati---na pūrvaḥ pūrvaḥ pratyayaḥ parasyāḥ parasyāḥ
prakṛterbhavatīti | atha vā---laukiko'dhikāro'pekṣālakṣaṇaḥ | na ca
ghādīnāṃ prakṛtyantarāpekṣā, nāpi grāmādīnāṃ pratyayāntarāpekṣā,
tasmādaprayojanametatsvārthe mā bhūvanniti | tadeva tarhi
prayojanam---apatyādiṣu tarhi mā bhūvanniti | nanu
coktam---ciranivṛtā apatyādayaścāturarthī ca nāpekṣyata iti ? na
brūmo'patyādīnāmatrābhisambandha iti, kiṃ tarhi ?
tasyedamityanenāpatyādiṣvapi prāpnuvanti | katham ?
ityāha---tasyedaṃviśeṣā hyapatyasamūhādaya iti | yathā ṭhtasyedam'
ityanena pāṇinīyāśchātrā iti chātrādiṣu viśeṣeṣu pratyayo
bhavati, evamapatyādiṣvapi viśeṣeṣu ghādayaḥ syuḥ; viśeṣeṣu
sāmānyabhāvāt |
nanu ca viśeṣaśabdasaṃnidhau sāmānyaśabda upātaḥ, tatra viśeṣe
paryavasyati---kauṇḍinyo brāhmaṇa iti, viśeṣāntare vā---dadhi
brāhmaṇebhyastakraṃ kauṇḍinyāyeti | tatrāpatyādiviśeṣasannidhāvupātaṃ
tasyedamiti sāmānyam, yadyapatyādiṣveva paryavasyet
sāmānyopādānaṃ vyarthaṃ syāditi viśeṣāntara eva paryavasāsyati |
kiñca yadyapatyādiṣvapi ghādayaḥ syuḥ, ṭhprāgdīvyato'ṇ'
ityatraivāṇādibhiḥ saha vidhīyeran, liṅgāccāpatyādiṣu ghādayo
na bhaviṣyanti, kiṃ liṅgam ? ṭhpheśccha ca' ityatra ṭhphervā' ityeva
ṭhagvidhānārthaṃ vaktavyam, ṭhakā mukte ṭhvṛddhācchaḥ' iti tāvacchaḥ siddhaḥ,
tadeva cchavidhānaṃ jñāpanārtham---na hyapatyādiṣu ghādayo bhaviṣyanti |
tathā gotracaraṇādvuñiti samūha idamarthāntarbhūte vuñi siddhe
ṭhgotrokṣoṣṭra' iti punarvidhānamapi liṅgamasyārthasya; tathā
ṭhrājanyādibhyo vuñ' iti rājanyādiṣu daivayātaśabdaḥ paṭha|lte, sa
ca devayātūnāmapatyāni daivayātavā iti gotrapratyayāntaḥ;
tathā'rīhaṇādiṣu bhāstrāyaṇaśabdo gotrapratyayāntaḥ paṭha|lnte, tatrāpi
ṭhgotracaraṇād vuñ' ityeva siddhaḥ; tadetairliṅgairapatyādiṣu
ghādayo na bhaviṣyanti | tadevametatprayojanaṃ nopapadyata iti
prayojanāntaramāha---kiñceti | asati he śeṣagrahaṇe prathamenaivārthena
sambandhamanubhavatāṃ kṛtārthatā vijñāyeta, dvitīyādiṣu tvartheṣu
ṭhprāgdīvyataḥ' iti viśiṣṭāvadhiparicchinneṣvartheṣu vidhīyamānā
aṇādaya eva syuḥ, śeṣaśabdastūpayuktādanyatamān
jātādīnarthānvīśīkṛtya śaknotyabhidhātumiti sarvatra ghādayaḥ
sidhyanti | ataḥ sākalyārthamapi viśeṣavacanaṃ kartavyam | lakṣaṇaṃ
cādhaikāraśceti | tatra ṭhtasyedam' ityeva cākṣuṣādayaḥ sidhyanti,
pārṣadādayastu ṭhsaṃskṛtaṃ bhakṣāḥ' iti tasmāllakṣaṇatvaṃ
nātīvopayujyate ||
rāṣṭrāvārapārāddhakhau || 4|2|93 ||
vigṛhītādapīṣyate iti | sūtre tu saṃghātasyaiva grahaṇam; anyathā

iyamapīṣṭireva ||

na vaktavyaṃ bhavati | kulyāyā yalopaśceti | kecitu tṛtīyaṃ varṇaṃ
lakāraṃ paṭhanti, anye tu ḍakāram ||
kulakukṣigrīvābhyaḥ śvāsyalaṅkāreṣu | ayaṃ yogaḥ śakyo'vaktum |

gaṇe nadīti svarūpagrahaṇam, na saṃjñā; nadyāḥ mahyādīnāṃ pṛthagrahaṇāt

bahalyudipardīti | ṭhavṛddhādapi' iti vuñi prāpte vacanam ||
raṅkoramanuṣye'ṇca || 4|2|100 ||
raṅkavo nāma janapadaḥ, tataḥ ṭhprāgdīvyato'ṇ' prāptaḥ, tasya
ṭhavṛddhādapi' iti vuñ bādhakaḥ, tasya ordeaśe ṭhañ, tataḥ
kopadhādaṇ, tataḥ ṭhkacchādibhyaśca' ityaṇ prāptaḥ, tataḥ ṣphagaṇau
vidhīyete | kopadhatvādevāṇi siddhe raṅkuśabdasya kacchādiṣu
pāṭho manuṣyatatsthayorvuñvidhānārthaḥ | manuṣye paratvāditi |
utkṛṣṭatvād apavādatvādityarthaḥ | kacchādipāṭhāramanuṣye'ṇapi
siddha iti | nanu ca manuṣyatatsthayorvuñvidhānārthastatra pāṭhaḥ
syāt, tataśca tadvyatirikate viṣaye ṣphageva syāt, yatrāṇ
vidhīyate ? naitadasti; kacchādipāṭhasyobhayārthatve bādhakābhāvāt |
nañivayuktanyāyena manuṣyasadṛśe prāṇini pratipatiḥ kriyate iti |
yastvamanuṣyaśabdo rakṣaḥ piśācādiṣu rūḍhaḥ, na tasyaiva grahaṇam ;
anabhidhānāditi manyate, athaivaṃ kasmānna vijñāyate---paratvādeva
vuñi siddhe manuṣyapratiṣedho jñāpayati---ṭhmanuṣyatatsthayoḥ'
ityasyāpyetau ṣphagaṇau bādhakāviti, tena tatsthe ṣphagaṇāveva bhavato
na vuñiti ? tanna; aniṣṭatvāt | na hi tasthe ṣphagaṇāviṣyete, kiṃ
tahi ? vujñeva | rāṅkavaḥ kambala iti ṣphagna bhavatīti | yathā tu
vārtikaṃ bhāṣyaṃ ca tathātra ṣphagiṣyate, manuṣyapratiṣaedhaśca pratyākhyātaḥ
| yathā''ha---ṭhraṅkoramanuṣyagrahaṇānarthakyaṃ
manuṣyatatsthayorvuñvidhānāt, tatsthe ṣphagaṇorjñāpakamiti
cennāniṣṭatvādaṇgrahaṇānarthakyaṃ ca kacchādibhyo'ṇivadhānāt' iti |
viśeṣavihitena ca ṣphaketi | anyathā kacchādipāṭhasya prāṇini
caritārthatvātprāṇini ṣphageva syāt ||
dyauprāgapāgudakpratīco yat || 4|2|101 ||

avyayātyap || 4|2|104 ||
ameheti | yo'vyayātyabvihitaḥ so'mādibhya eva smṛta ityarthaḥ |

iti | upariṣṭādbhava ityaṇi kṛte ṭhavyayānāṃ bhamātre ṭilopaḥ' iti
ṭilopaḥ | parataḥ śabdaḥ ṭhvibhāṣā parāvarābhyām' ityatasujantaḥ, tatra
bhavaḥ | ārātīya iti | ṭhbahiṣaṣṭilopaśca' ityanityatvajñāpanādatra
ṭilopābhāvaḥ |
tyabnerdhruva iti | niśabdād dhruve vācye tyabbhavati | niyataṃ
sarvakālaṃ bhavo nityaḥ |
niso gate iti | niḥ śabdād gate vācye tyabbhavati | niṣṭa|l iti |

evamāvirbhūtamāviṣṭa|lm |
araṇyāṇṇa iti | aṇi sati ṅīp syāditi ṇo vidhīyate |
dūretya iti | ṭhtata āgataḥ' ityatrārthe etyaḥ |
utarādāhañiti | ādyaudātārthaṃ vacanam | autarāhamiti | ṭhutarācca'

aiṣamohyaḥ śvaso'nyatarasyām || 4|2|105 ||
ṭhañapi tṛtīyo bhavatīti | vidhivākyāpekṣaṃ tṛtīyatvam,
pratyayāpekṣayā tu ṭhañ caturthaḥ, ṭhśvasastuṭ ca' ityatra
vikalpādhikārāt ṭa|luṭa|lulāvapi bhavataḥ ||
tīrarūpyotarapadādaññau || 4|2|106 ||
añjapoḥ striyāṃviśeṣaḥ---kākatīrī, cāṇārarūpyā | bahucpūrvānmā
bhūditi | anyathā bahutīraśabdādapi syāt, utarapadaśabdasya tu
samāsaviṣaye niyatatvānnāsti bahucpūrvātprasaṅgaḥ ||
dikpūrvapadādasaṃjñāyāṃ ñaḥ || 4|2|107 ||
asaṃjñāyāmiti | na caivamasaṃjñāyā iti pañcamyā nirdeśaḥ,
viṣayasaptamyāpi tadarthalābhādityāha---saṃjñāviṣayāditi |
paurvaśāla iti | pūrvasyāṃ śālāyāṃ bhava iti taddhitārthe samāsaḥ,
tataḥ pratyayaḥ | padagrahaṇamityādi | ṭhdikpūrvād' ityucyamāne
svarūpaṃ syāt, tataśca diggaja ityāderevasyāt | padagrahaṇe tu
sati digviśeṣavācināṃ grahaṇaṃ bhavati, katham ? vyadhikaraṇapado
bahuvrīhiḥ---diśaḥ pūrvapadamasminniti, ṭhdiśaḥ' iti vācakāpekṣayā
ṣaṣṭhī, diśo vācakaṃ pūrvapadasminnityarthaḥ ||
madrebhyo'ñ || 4|2|108 ||
madraśabdo janapadavacanaḥ, bahuvacananirdeśo janapadavācinaḥ
parigrahārthaḥ, tena madraparyāyo na gṛhyate | paurvamadra iti |
madraikadeśe madraśabdasya vṛterdikśabdena sāmānādhikaraṇye sati
ṭhtaddhitārtha' iti samāsaḥ ||
udīcyagrāmācca bahvaco'ntodātāt || 4|2|109 ||
śaivapuramiti | ṭhprasthapuravahāntāt' iti vuñ na bhavati;
ṭhvṛddhāt' iti tatra vartate ||
prasthotarapadapaladyādikopadhādaṇ || 4|2|110 ||
udīcyagrāmalakṣaṇasyāño'pavāda iti | tato'nyatra
vrīhiprastha--giriprastha--karikādāvautsagika evāṇ,
kailāsaprastha--kāka--śākādiṣu vṛddheṣu ṭhvṛddhācchaḥ' bhavati,
deśavācini tu mālāprasthādau ṭhprasthapuravahāntācca' iti vuñ,
ikṣvākuprabhṛtiṣu janapadavuño'pavādaḥ ṭhkopadhādaṇ' ityaṇvakṣyate,
arīhaṇakādau ca ṭhvṛddhādakekānta' iti chāe bhavati, tasmādaño'pavāda
iti suṣṭhūaktam | utarapadagrahaṇādiha na bhavati---utaromāhakiprastha
utaramāhakiprasthaḥ, tatra bha iti | ṭhprasthāntāt' iti tūcyamāne'trāpi
syāt |
aṇgrahaṇaṃ bādhakabādhanārthamiti | yadyaṇgrahaṇaṃ na kriyeta, tadā yadatra
vṛddhaṃ vāhīkagrāmavāci tasmāt ṭhprāgdīvyato'ṇ' ityaṇi prāpte
ṭhvṛddhācchaḥ' prāptaḥ, tasminṭhvāhīkagrāsebhyaśca' iti ṭhaññiṭhābhyāṃ
bādhite punarvidhānāccha eva syāt | tasmādvādhakamapi taṃ chṃa
bādhitvā aṇgrahaṇādaṇeva bhavati | 
yakṛllomaśabdaḥ paṭha|lte, yakṛllomni bhaḥ yākṛllomaḥ, ṭhan' iti
prakṛtibhāvo na bhavati, gaṇe nalopanipātanādityāhuḥ ||
kaṇvādibhyo gotre || 4|2|111 ||
gotramiha na pratyayārtha iti | śeṣādhikārasya bādhaprasaṅgāt | na ca
prakṛtiviśeṣaṇamiti | kaṇvādīnāmagotrapratyayāntānāṃ gotre
vṛtyasambhavāt | kaṇvādibhyo gotre yaḥ pratyayo vihita iti |
pratipadavihito yañeva gṛhyate | evaṃ ca kṛtvā gotramapi
pāribhāṣikaṃ gṛhyate, na tvapatyādhikārādanyatra laukikaṃ gotraṃ gṛhyata
ityapatyamātrasya grahaṇam---kaṇvo devatā'syeti | nanu ṭhkaṇvādibhyaḥ'
ityucyamāne kathamaṇantātprasaṅgaḥ ? kathaṃ vā yañantebhyaḥ syād
yeneṣṭṃa tāvatsidti ? evaṃ manyate---kevalebhyaḥ kaṇvādibhya
autsargika evāṇ, sidhyati, chāpavādatvādyogasya kaṇvādyavayave
taddhitānte kaṇvādiśbdo vartiṣyata iti ||
iñaśca || 4|2|112 ||
gotra ityeveti | pūrvatra pāribhāṣikasya gotrasya grahaṇamityuktam,
ihāpi tadevānuvartate, tenātrāpi pāribhāṣikasyaiva grahaṇādiha na
bhavati---pāṇineryūnacchāttrāḥ pāṇinīyā iti
sautaṅgameridamiti | sutaṅgamaśabdād vuñcchaṇādisūtreṇa
cāturthika iñ | atrāpatyatvameva nāstīti sutarāmagotratvādbhavati
pratyudāharaṇam ||
na dvyacaḥ prācyabharateṣu || 4|2|113 ||
nanu ca bharatāḥ prācyā eva, tatkimarthaṃ teṣāṃ svaśabdena grahaṇam ?
tatrāha---jñāpakādanyatreti | ṭhbahvaca iñaḥ prācyabharateṣu' ityatrāyamartho
jñāpatiḥ---ṭhanyatra prācyagrahaṇe bharatānāṃ grahaṇaṃ na bhavati' iti |
apara āha---jñāpakādanyatretyanvayaḥ, anyatrāsyārthasya
jñāpitatvādityarthaḥ ||
vṛddhācchaḥ || 4|2|114 ||
avyayatīretyādi | avyayātyab bhavatītyasyāvakāśaḥ---amātyaḥ,
cchasyāvakāśaḥ---śālīyo mālīyaḥ, ārācchabdācchāe bhavati---ārātīyaḥ
| ṭhamehakvatasitrebhyaḥ' iti parigaṇanamanapekṣyāyaṃ vipratiṣedhaḥ |
tīrotaravidheravakāśaḥ---kāśyatīraḥ, cchasya sa eva; vāyasatīrācchāe
bhavati vāyasatīriyaḥ | rūpyotaravidheravakāśaḥ---cārarūpyaḥ, cchasya sa
eva; māṇirūpyācchaḥ prāptaḥ, taṃ cāpi yopadhalakṣaṇo vuñ
bādhate---māṇirūpyakaḥ | prāptimātrāśrayeṇa tu cchasya
rūpyotarapadalakṣaṇasya ca ñasya vipratiṣedha uktaḥ | udīcyagrāmalakṣaṇasya
vidheravakāśaḥ--śivapura---śaivapuraḥ, vāḍavakarṣācchāe
bhavati---vāḍavakarṣīyaḥ|
kopadhavidhiḥ---ṭhprasthotarapadapaladyādikopadhādaṇ' ityayaṃ
vivakṣitaḥ, sa tasmāddhi
parasthastasyāvakāśaḥ---ṭhprasthotarapadapaladyādikopadhādaṇ' ityayaṃ
vivakṣitaḥ, sa tasmāddhi parasthastasyāvakāśaḥ---nilīnaka---nailīnakam,
ulūkā asminsanti ṭhtadasminnasti' ityaṇ, aulako nāma grāmastatra
bhavaḥ, tasmācchāe bhavati---aulūkīyaḥ | yastu ṭhkopadhādaṇ' ityaṇ,
sa janapadavuño'pavādaḥ, tasyāpi ṭhvṛddhādakekānta' ityatra
ṭhkopadhagrahaṇaṃ sosukādyartham' iti vihitaśchāe bādhako bhavati ||
bhavataṣṭhakcchasau || 4|2|115 ||
ṭhakcchas ityetāviti | sitkaraṇādavasīyate---cchaso'yaṃ nirdeśaḥ, na
śasa iti, śasi hi svādipadatvenaiva siddham | sakāraḥ padasaṃjñārtha
iti | tena bhavadīya ityatra jaśtvaṃ bhavati | bhāvatka iti |
ṭhisusuktāntātkaḥ' prakriyālāghavārthaṃ kaki vidhātavye ṭhagvidhānaṃ
striyāṃ ṅībartham---bhāvatkī |
avṛddhātu bhavati iti | śatrantāt | kvacitu bhavataḥ śaturityeva
pāṭhaḥ ||
kāśyādibhyaṣṭhaññiṭhau || 4|2|116 ||
vṛddhādityeveti | kathaṃ tarhyavṛddhebhyo yuvarājādibhyaḥ pratyaya ityata
āha---ye tviti |
yadyavṛddhebhyo vacanaprāmāṇyātpratyayau bhavataḥ, kimarthaṃ tarhi
vṛddhādhikāraḥ ? ityata āha---devadataśabda ityādi | kathaṃ bhāṣye
udāhṛtamiti | yadyapi tatra svayamapi cchapratyayamudāharatyeva, tatu
bhāṣyakāraprāmāṇyena na svātantryeṇeti ṭhbhāṣye' ityuktam | 
āpadādipūrvapadāditi | āpadādirākṛtigaṇaḥ | kālāditi |
kālaśabdāntādityarthaḥ ||
vāhīkagrāmebhyaśca || 4|2|117 ||
cchasyāpavādau iti | evaṃ ca ye chenaiva bādhitā
avyayatīrarūpyotarapadodīcyagrāmakopadhaviṣayāstadviṣaye'pyetāveva
bhavataḥ, na cedanyena bādhaḥ, tadyathā---ārānnāma vāhīkagrāmaḥ ārātkī,
ārātkā, ṭhisuktāntātkaḥ' | tathā kāstīraṃ nāma vāhīkagrāmaḥ
kāstīrikī, kāstīrikā | iha tu dāśarūpyaṃ nāma vāhīkagrāmaḥ,
ṭhdhanvayopadhāt' iti vuñ ṭhaññiṭhau bādhate---dāśarūpyakaḥ | tathā
śakalānyasminsanti śākalaṃ nāmodīcyagrāmaḥ bhūyo vāhīkagrāmaḥ,
tataṣṭhaññiṭhau bhavataḥ---śākalikī, śākalikā | iha tu sausukaṃ nāma
vāhīkagrāmaḥ prasthotarapadādisūtreṇa prāptaṃ kopadhalakṣaṇamaṇaṃ chāe
bādhate, paratvātamapyapavādatvād ṭhvṛddhādakekānta' ityatra
ṭhkopadhagrahaṇaṃ sosukādyartham' iti kopalakṣaṇaślo bādhate,
sausukīyaḥ ||
ordeaśe ṭhañ || 4|2|119 ||
naiṣādakarṣukaḥ, śābarajambuka iti |
niṣādakarṣū-śabarajambūśabdābhyāṃ ṭhañ, ṭhisusuktāntātkaḥ', ṭhke'ṇaḥ'
iti hrasvaḥ ||
vṛddhātprācām || 4|2|120 ||
vṛddhādeva prācāmiti | viparītastu niyamo na bhavati---prācāmeva
vṛddhāditi, aprāgdeśavācino vṛddhasyovarṇāntasyābhāvād yatra
pūrvasūtrasyātiprasaṅgaḥ syāt | āḍhakajambuka iti |
pūrvavatkādeśahrasvatve ||
dhanvayopadhād vuñ || 4|2|121 ||
dhanvavācina iti | dhanvaviśeṣavācina airāvatāderityarthaḥ | svarūpasya
paryāyāṇāṃ ca grahaṇaṃ na bhavati, vṛddhādhikārāt | pāredhanvaka iti |
ṭhpāremadhye ṣaṣṭha|la vā' ityavyayībhāvaḥ, ṭhacaśca' iti ṭac samāsantaḥ,
vuñi yasyeti lopaḥ | yadi tu dhanvaśabdo napuṃsakaliṅgaḥ, tataḥ
ṭhnapuṃsakādanyatarasyām' iti ṭajabhāvapakṣe vuñi' nastaddhite' iti
ṭilopaḥ | sāṅkāśyakāmpilyaśabdau vuñcchaṇādisūtreṇa ṇyāntau ||
prasthapuravahāntācca || 4|2|122 ||
vṛddhāditi vartate iti | yadyevamantagrahaṇanarthakaṃ
prasthādīnāmavṛddhatvādeva tadantavidhirbhaviṣyati ? naitadasti; ṭhvā
nāmadheyasya' iti prasthādīnāmeva padānāṃ vṛddhatvasambhavāt |
athāpyevaṃnāmno deśasyābhāvaḥ, tathāpi yathā pūrvasūtre
dhanvaviśeṣagrahaṇaṃ tathehāpi sambhāvyeta nādīpuraṃ nāma vāhīkeṣu
grāmaḥ, tatra vāhīkagrāmalakṣaṇau ṭhaññiṭhau cchasyāpavādau, ayamapi
vuñ cchasyāpavādaḥ | iha tvapavādavipratiṣedhād vuñ bhavati |
evaṃ ca pātanaprasthakaḥ, kauñjīvahaka ityatrāpi vuñeva bhavati ||
ropadhetoḥ prācām || 4|2 123 ||
īkārāntācceti | hrasvasya tu grahaṇaṃ na bhavati, tadantasya
prāgdeśavācino'sambhavāt| ekacakra iti | ekacakrā nāma pāgdeśe
nagarī, tatra ṭheṅ prācāṃ deśe' iti vṛddhasaṃjñā, kakandena nirvṛtā
nagarī kākaṃndī, strīṣu ṭhsauvīrasālvaprākṣa' ityañ | taparakaraṇaṃ
vispaṣṭārthamiti | na tu hrasvaplutayonivṛtyartham ; tadantasya
prāgdeśavācino'sambhavāt, īkārasyānaṇtvena tayoraghaṇācca |
asati tu takāre ṭhropadhayoḥ' ityucyamāne kimatra gṛhītamiti
vispaṣṭṃa na jñāyate | takāre tu sati varṇanirdeśo niścīyate,
tatraiva tasya prasiddhatvāt | ṭhīkāraropadhayoḥ' iti nirdeśe
gauravaprasaṅgaḥ ||
janapadatadavadhyośca || 4|2|124 ||
tadavadhirapi janapada eva gṛhyate iti | sa cāsāvavadhiriti karmadhāraya
āśrīyate, na tu tasyāvadhistadavadhiriti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsa ityarthaḥ | tathā
hi sati mauñjī nāmāvadhibhūto grāmaḥ, tatra bhavo mauñjīya ityatrāpi
syāt | kasya punarasāvavadhiriti cet ?
sannidhānājjanapadasyaiveti vijñāyate ||
gartotarapadācchṃa bādhitveti | anyathā tu gartotarapadācchāe
bhavatītyasyāvakāśaḥ---vṛkagartīyaḥ, janapadavuño'vakāśaḥ---āṅgakaḥ;
trigartaśabdādubhayaprasaṅge paratvācchaḥ syāt, tataśca
gartotarapadācchavidherjanapadād vuñ pūrvavipratiṣiddha iti
pūrvavipratiṣedhaḥ paṭhitavyo bhavati | traigartaka iti | utarasūtreṇa
vuñ | etenotaratra tadavadhigrahaṇasyopayogaṃ darśayati ||
avṛddhādapi bahuvacanaviṣayāt || 4|2|125 ||
aṇcchayorapavāda iti | avṛddhādaṇo'pavādo vṛddhācchasya |
ihāvṛddhādapi bahuvacanādityeva siddham; yaugiko
bahuvacanaśabdaḥ---bahūnāmarthānāṃ vacano bahuvacana iti | yadi vā
bahuvacanādvahuvacanāntādityarthaḥ, nārtho viṣayagrahaṇena ?
tatrāha---janapadaikaśeṣabahutva iti | janapadasyaikaśeṣavaśena
yadvahutvaṃ tatretyarthaḥ | vartanya iti | avayavabhedena bhedamāśritya
ekaśeṣaḥ | nāyaṃ nityabahuvacanāntaḥ; dvyekayorapi darśanāt |
takrakauṇḍinyāyeneti | pūrvasūtre hi janapadasāmānye vṛddhād
vuñ vihitaḥ, yathā---brāhmaṇasāmānye dadhidānam | iha tu
bahuvacanaviṣaye viśeṣe'vṛddhād vuñ, yathā---kauṇḍinye
takradānam, tataśca bahuvacanādapi vṛddhād vuñi prāpte
ārabhyamāṇo'vṛddhād vuñ vṛddhād vuño bādhakaḥ
syādityāpiśabdena samuccīyata ityarthaḥ | iha
bahuvacanaviṣayādityetāvatā siddhamavṛddhārtho'yamārambhaḥ |
vṛddhādhikāravicchedārthaṃ tvavṛddhādapīti vacanam ||
kācchāgnivaktragartotarapadāt || 4|2|126 ||
kacchaśabdārthamutarapadagrahaṇam | sa hi kevalo'pi kūlākhye deśe
vartate, itareṣāṃ tu kevalānāṃ deśavṛtyasambhavādeva tadantavidhiḥ
siddhaḥ | kacchādyantādityucyamāne bahucpūrvādapi
syādityutarapadagrahaṇam ||
dhūmādibhyaśca || 4|2|127 ||
aṇāaderapavāda iti | avṛddhebhyo dhūmādibhyo'ṇo'pavādaḥ,
vṛddhebhyaścchasya, udīcyagrāmebhyastvañaḥ, vāhīkagrāmebhyaṣṭhaññiṭhayoḥ |
kūlātsauvīreṣviti | kaulako bhavati sauvīreṣu, kaulamanyatra ||
nagarāt kutsanaprāvīṇyayoḥ || 4|2|128 ||
kenedaṃ muṣitamiti praśnaḥ, iha nagare manuṣyeṇetyutaram |
sambhāvyata etadityādi praṣṭuarvacanam | saṃjñānagaraṃ paṭha|lta iti |
māhiṣmatīśabdasāhacaryāt saṃjñānagaraṃ saṃjñābhūto nagaraśabda
ityarthaḥ ||
araṇyānmanuṣye || 4|2|129 ||
aupasaṃkhyānikasyeti | ṭharaṇyāṇṇo vaktavyaḥ' ityupasaṃkhyānaprāptasya |
ṭhmanuṣye' ityalpamidamucyate, ityāha---pathyadhyāyeti |
āraṇyako'dhyāya iti | yo'raṇye'dhīyate upaniṣadbhāgaḥ sa ucyate |
vihāraḥ u krīḍā ||
vibhāṣā kuruyugandhārābhyām || 4|2|130 ||
kuruśabdaḥ kacchādiṣu paṭha|lte iti kathaṃ tarhi kuruśabdād vuñaḥ
prāptiruktā, tābhyāmavṛddhādapīti nityaṃ vuñi prāpta iti ?
ādyaprāptyabhiprāyeṇa taduktam, na punaryo'nena vikalpena bādhyate
tadabhiprāyeṇa | ye'pi paṭhanti--vuñi siddha iti, prāpta ityarthaḥ | yathā
siddhe satyārambho niyamārtha iti kuruśabdārthaṃ vibhāṣāgrahaṇaṃ na
kartavyamiti pratipādayiṣyannāha---kuruśabdaḥ kacchādiṣu paṭha|lti iti |
tataḥ kimityatrāha---tatreti | kimartaṃ tarhi
vibhāṣāgrahaṇamityāha--saiṣeti | nanu yugandharaśabdādapi
ṭhavṛddhādapi' iti nitye vuñi siddhe'ntareṇāpi vibhāṣāgrahaṇaṃ
punarvacanādvikalpo vijñāsyate ? naivaṃ śakyam ; viparyayo'pi
syāt | yugandharaśabdānnityo vuñ, ṭhavṛddhādapi' ityanena tu
vibhāṣita iti punarārambho hyaevamapyupapadyate |
manuṣyatatsthayostviti | etacca kacchādiṣu pāṭhasāmarthyāllabhyate,
anyathā'nayaiva vibhāṣayā vuñaṇoḥ siddhatvātatrāsya pāṭho'narthakaḥ
syāt ||
madravṛjyoḥ kan || 4|2|131 ||
madraśabdaḥ ṭhsphāyitañci' iti rakpratyayāntaḥ, ṭhvṛjī varjane'
ṭhigupadhātkiḥ' iti kipratyayānto vṛjiśabdaḥ | janapadavuño'pavāda
iti | ṭhavṛddhādapi' iti ||
kopadhādaṇ || 4|2|132 ||
kiṃ punaradeśavācino'yaṃ neṣyate yato deśagrahaṇamanuvartate ?
ityata āha---anyatreti | pūrveṇa, prasthotarapadādisūtreṇa, evaṃ
cotarārthaṃ deśānuvṛttiḥ na tvadeśanivṛtyarthā | nanvadeśavācinaḥ
prāgdīvyatīya evāṇ siddhaḥ, prasthotarapadādisūtraṃ tu
udīcyagrāmalakṣaṇāño bādhanārtham, tatkimucyate---anyatra
pūrveṇaiveti, satyam ; sati tvevamarthe tasyārambhe
pratipadavidhānātenaiva sarvatrāṇvidhiryuktaḥ, athāṇgrahaṇaṃ kimartham,
na kopadhādyathāvihitamityevocyeta, ārambhasāmarthyāddhiyo vihito
na ca prāpnoti sa eva bhaviṣyati ? ityata āha---aṇgrahaṇamiti |
ikṣvākuśabdād ṭhordeaśe ṭhañ' prāptaḥ, tasmin
janapadavuñābādhite yadyaṇgrahaṇaṃ nakriyate punarvacanād vuñeva
syād, aṇgrahaṇe tvaṇeva bhavati | aikṣvāka iti |
dāṇḍināyanādisūtreṇa ṭilopaḥ, evaṃ cāṇgrahaṇādevāyamordeaśe
ṭhaño bādhako na paratvāt ||
kacchādibhyaśca || 4|2|133 ||
vuñoderapavāda iti | ye janapadavācino bahuvacanaviṣayāḥ,
tebhyo vuño'pavādaḥ, sindhuvarṇuśabdābhyāmordeaśe ṭhañaḥ |
sālvaśabdaḥ paṭha|lte---janapadalakṣaṇo vuñmā bhūditi | ṭhapadātau
sālvāt' ṭhgoyavāgvośca' iti niyamārthaṃ
bhaviṣyati---apadātāveva goyavāgvoreveti, vṛddhatvācchaḥ
prāpnoti ||
apadātau sālvāt || 4|2|135 ||
pādābhyāmatatīti ṭhpādasya padājyātigopahateṣu' iti padādeśaḥ, na
padātirapadātiḥ | apadātiḥuaśvarohādiḥ | apadātāveva manuṣye
tatsthe ceti | dvandvanirdiṣṭatvena tatsthe cetyukm, na tu tatsthasya
padāteḥ sambhavo'sti | apadātau sālvādevetyeṣa tu
viparītaniyamo na bhavati; ṭhgoyavāgvośca' ityārambhāt ||
gartotarapadācchaḥ || 4|2|137 ||
vāhīkagrāmalakṣaṇamiti | yadyapi ṭhvāhīkagrāmebhyaśca' iti ṭhaññiṭhau
vihitau,
tathāpyutsṛṣṭānubandhayostayoṣṭharūpāviśeṣādvāhīkagrāmalakṣaṇamityekavacananirdeśaḥ | śvāvidgartīyamiti | śvānaṃ vidhyatīti vyadheḥ kvip, samprasāraṇam, ṭhnahivṛtti' iti dīrghaḥ, śvāvidhāṃ gartaḥ śvāvidgartaḥ ||
gahādibhyaśca || 4|2|138 ||
aṇāderapavāda iti | tatra māhakiprasthaśabdāt ṭhprasthapurabavantācca'
iti vuño'pavādaḥ, vālmīkiprabhṛtibhya iñantebhyaḥ ṭhiñaśca' ityaṇaḥ,
śeṣebhya autsargikasyāṇaḥ | sambhavāpekṣamiti | yeṣāṃ deśe cādeśe
ca vṛttiḥ sambhavati gahādīnāṃ teṣāmeva viśeṣaṇam, na
tvantasthapūrvapadādīnāmityarthaḥ | pṛthivīmadhyasyeti |
pṛthivīmadhyavācyeva madhyaśabdo grāhyaḥ, na madhyāntaravācītyarthaḥ |
caraṇasambandhena nivāsalakṣaṇo'ṇiti | caraṇasambandhena
yo'ṇvidhīyate'ṇ caraṇa ityanena sa nivāsalakṣaṇau draṣṭavyaḥ |
ṭhso'yaṃ nivāsaḥ' ityajñaivārthe bhavatītyarthaḥ, tena pṛthivīmadhyaṃ
nivāsa eṣāṃ kaṭhādīnāṃ caraṇānāmityatrārthe madhyamā iti bhavati |
mukhapārśvatasorlopa iti | mukhapārśvaśabdayostasantayoḥ
pratyayasanniyogena lopo bhavati, sa ca ṭhalo'ntyasya', tatra kṛte
yasyeti lopaḥ, lopavacanam, ṭhavyayānāṃ bhamātre ṭilopaḥ'
ityasyānityatvajñāpanārtham, tenārātīya iti siddhaṃ bhavati ||
vṛddhādakekāntakhopadhāt || 4|2|141 ||
ārīhaṇakīyam, drauhaṇakīyamiti | ṭhtena nirvṛtam' ityatrārthe
vuñcchaṇādisūtreṇa yo vuñ tadantābhyāṃ pratyayaḥ,
udāharaṇadikceyamakāntasya darśitā | ṭhvṛddhācchaḥ' ityeva hyatra caḥ siddhaḥ,
na hyaetau janapadavācinau, yena kopadhādaṇaḥ prasaṅgaḥ syāt | idaṃ
tvatrodāharaṇaṃ draṣṭavyam---brāhmaṇako nāma janapado yatra brāhmaṇā
āyudhajīvinaḥ ṭhbrāhmaṇakoṣṇike saṃjñāyām' iti nipātanāt sādhuḥ,
tatra jāto brāhmaṇakīya iti | akekāntagrahaṇe kopadhagrahaṇamiti |
sūtre'kekāntagrahaṇamapanīya kopadhāditi vaktavyam,
vyāpakatvāllaghutvāccetyarthaḥ ||
anyāpaladanagaragrāmahradotarapadāt || 4|2|142 ||
antagrahaṇenaiva siddham, nārtha utarapadagrahaṇena | na ca bahucpūrve
prasaṅgaḥ, ṭhprācāṃ deśe' ityadhikārāt ||
vibhāṣā'manuṣye || 4|2|144 ||
yadyatra nañaḥ praśleṣo na syādasandehārtham ṭhmanuṣye vibhāṣā ityeva
brūyāt, lāghave viśeṣābhāvāditi matvā''ha---amanuṣye'bhidheya
iti | amanuṣyaśabdo yaugiko'tra gṛhyate, na tu rakṣaḥ piśācādiṣu
rūḍha iti darśayatyudāharaṇena parvatīyāni phalānīti ||
kṛkaṇaparṇād bhāradvāje || 4|2|145 ||
na gotraśabda iti | kuta ityāha---prakṛtiviśeṣaṇaṃ caitaditi |
caśabdo hiśabdārthe ||
iti śrīharadatamiśraviracitāyāṃ padamañjaryāṃ caturthasyādhyāyasya
dvitīyaḥ pādaḥ
-------------------|||||||||||||||||||||---------------------atha caturthādhye tṛtīyaḥ pādaḥ ---4
padamañjarī
yuṣmadasmadoranyatarasyāṃ khañca || 4|3|1 ||
ṣaṣṭhīnirdeśa utarārthaḥ | ete trayaḥ pratyayā bhavantīti | nanu
cānyatarasyāṃgrahaṇena khañcchayoḥ pakṣe'nutpattiḥ pratipādyate,
tadanutpatāvapavādābhāvātsvaśāstreṇa ṭhprāgdīvyataḥ' ityanenaivāṇ
bhavati, tatkuto'nena pratyayatrayasya vidhānam, chāe'pi tarhi
naivānena vidhīyate, tasyāpi hi cakāro'bhyanujñāpaka
eva---yadyanyo'pi kaścitprāpnoti so'pi bhavatīti, tataśchāe'pi
svaśāstreṇa ṭhvṛddhācchaḥ' ityanenaiva bhavati, eka eva tvapūrvaḥ khañ
vidhīyate | atha yasya pravṛtāvasya tātparyaṃ sa sarvo'nena vidhīyata iti
cchasyānena vidhānam | yadyevam, aṇo'pyanenaiva vidhānam, na
khañcchayoranutpattimātre'nyatarasyāṃgrahaṇasya tātparyam, tasya
mahāvibhāṣayaiva siddhatvāt, kiṃ tarhi ? aṇaḥ pravṛtāvapi |
tasmātātparyatastraya ete pratyayā bhavantītyuktam, pratyekaṃ pratyayatrayaṃ
vidhīyata iti ca | tatra khañpratyayo bhavatītyanena khaña evāpūrvasya
vidhānamiti darśitam | anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇādyathāprāptaṃ
cetyanenāṇo'bhyanujñānam | tyadāditvādyauṣmadasmadośche prāpta
ityanenāpi chṃasyābhyanujñānam | bhāṣye tu yogavibhāgena
yathāsaṃkhyābhāvaḥ pratipāditaḥ---ṭhyuṣmadasmadoḥ' ityeko yogaḥ, atra
ṭhgartotarapadācchaḥ' ityataśchāe'nuvartate; tataḥ ṭhkhañca' iti dvitīyo
yogaḥ ||
tasminnaṇi ca yuṣmākāsmākau || 4|3|2 ||
sākṣāditi | pratyakṣeṇa vihitaḥ, svarūpopādānena vihita ityarthaḥ |
hetugarbhaṃ cedaṃ viśeṣaṇam---yataḥ sākṣādvihitaḥ tataḥ khañeva
nirdiśyata iti | tasminniyukte tatraiva jhaṭiti pratyayo bhavati, na
cānukṛṣṭaśccha iti | cakāro hi samīpavartinaḥ khañaḥ
sahāyatāmātramabhidhāya nivartate | tatra
sahāyasyānirdeśātprakṛtānveṣaṇam, tatra ṭhgartotarapadācchaḥ' iti
yāvadanveṣaṇe cchasya pratītiścireṇa bhavati, tena ca nāsau
pratyavamarśārhaḥ | yadā tu yathāsaṃkhyanirāsāya pūrvasūtre
yogavibhāgastadā naiva cakāreṇa cchasyānukarṣaṇamiti na tasya
parāmarśaśaṅkā |
nimitayorityādi | dve hi nimite---khañaṇau, nimitināvapi
dvāveva---ādeśau, tataśca sāmyādyathāsaṃkhyena bhavitavyamiti matvā
praśnaḥ | yogavibhāgaḥ kariṣyata iti | ṭhkhañaṇoryuṣmākāsmākau' iti
vaktavye ṭhtasminnaṇi ca' iti vacanāccakāreṇa vākyabhedasya
sūcanādādeśayornimitābhyāṃ pratyekamanabhisambandha ityarthaḥ ||
tavakamamakāvekavacane || 4|3|3 ||
ṭhkṛtrimākṛtrimayoḥ kṛtrimasyaikavacanasya grahaṇam', tasya ca
kṛtākṛtaprasaṅgitvena ṭhsupo dhātuprātipadikayoḥ' iti luki
kṛte yuṣmadasmadorekavacanaparatā na sambhavatīti pratyayalakṣaṇena
samarthayitavyā | tadapi pratyayalakṣaṇaṃ vighaṭayannāha---nanu ceti |
vacanāditi | yadi punarekavacanaparatvenāṇākhañau viśeṣyeyātām,
ko doṣaḥ ? iha ca syātām---yuṣmākaṃ chāttro yauṣmākīṇaḥ,
āsmākīna itiḥ, iha ca na syātām---tava chātrāstāvakīnāḥ,
māmakīnā iti | tasmātpūrvasūtre khañaṇparatayā
viśeṣyete---yuṣmadasmadī, ekavacanaparatathāpi te evātra viśeṣyete,
tataśca vacanād āsmākīnaḥ---pratyayalakṣaṇaṃ bhavatītyeṣaiva gatiḥ |
anvarthagrahaṇamiti | eko'rtha ucyate yena tadekavacanam | atra ca pakṣe
ṭhekavacane' iti prathamādvivacanāntam, na saptamyantam |
arddhādyat || 4|3|4 ||
balyarthaṃ vastu bāleyam, tasyārdhamuekadeśaḥ, tatra bhavaṃ
bāleyārddhikam ||
parāvarādhamotamapūrvācca || 4|3|5 ||
ṭhsapūrvapadāṭṭhañ vaktavyaḥ' ityaupasaṅkhyānike ṭhañi prāpte
vacanam |
arddhāditi vartate iti | tataśca parāvarādhamotamebhyaḥ paro
yo'rddhaśabda ityevaṃ viśeṣaṇasāmarthyādevārddhaśabdasya
parāvarādipūrvatā vijñāsyate, tatkiṃ pūrvagrahaṇeneti ?
evamanantaroktasya codyasyaivaitatsamarthanaṃ
parihati---parāvaraśabdāviti | asmātu pūrvagrahaṇādyatpratyaya eva
bhavatīti | pūrvavipratiṣedhasūcanadvāreṇeti bhāvaḥ |
dvikpūrvapadāṭṭhañca || 4|3|6 ||
aṇo'pavāda iti | sautrīṃ prāptimabhipretyaitaduktam,
ṭhsapūrvapadāṭṭhañ vaktavyaḥ' ityuktatvāt |
padagrahaṇamityādi | ṭhdikpūrvāt' ityucyamāne svarūpavidhiḥ
syāt, tataśca digardhe jāta ityatreva syāt | padagrahaṇe tu
sati---padyate'neneti padam, diśaḥ padaṃ pūrvamasmāditi
nipātanātsamāsaḥ ||
grāmajanapadaikadeśādañṭhañau || 4|3|7 ||
paurvārddhā iti | grāmasya pūrvasminnarddhe bhava iti taddhitārthe samāsaḥ,
tataḥ pratyayaḥ | yadyapyarddhaśabdo grāmamapekṣate, tathāpyasya
nityasāpekṣatvātpradhānatvācca vṛttidvayamapyaviruddham---samāsavṛttiḥ,
taddhitavṛttiśca | ṭhañgrahaṇaṃ kimartham, nāñcetyevocyeta ? na
caivamucyamāne yato'pi samuccaya prasaṅgaḥ; pūrvasūtre
cānukṛṣṭatvāt | tasmādvispaṣṭārthaṃ ṭhañgrahaṇam ||
a sāmpratike || 4|3|9 ||
sāmpratikaṃ yuktaṃ nyāyyamucitaṃ samamucyata iti |
kasyacitkaścitprasiddha ityanekaśabdopādānam | sampratiśabda
idānīmityatrāarthe prasiddho'pi nyāyye'pi vartate | dṛśyate
hi---ṭhanāptaścatūrātro'tiriktaḥ ṣaḍrātro'tha vā eṣa samprati yajño
yatpañcarātra iti', na nyūno nātiriktaḥ, sama ityarthaḥ | sa ca prajñādau
paṭha|lte | tena sāmpratam, sampratīti ca paryāyau ||
dvīpādanusamudraṃ yañ || 4|3|10 ||
anusamudramiti | ṭhanuryatsamayā' ityavyayībhāvaḥ | saptamyantaṃ
caitad, tad dvīpasya viśeṣaṇam, tadāha---samudrasamīpe yo dvīpa
iti ||
kālaṭṭhañ || 4|3|11 ||
kālaviśeṣavācina iti | svarūpasya ca paryāyāṇāṃ ca grahaṇaṃ na bhavati;
sandhivelādisūtreṇa
sandhivelātrayodaśīprabhṛtibhyo'vṛddhebhyo'ṇvidhānāt | taddhi ṭhaño
bādhanārthaḥ, arthagrahaṇe ca tebhyaṣṭhañaḥ prasaṅgaḥ |
iha ṭhgauṇamukhyayormukhye sampratyayaḥ' iti nyāyānmukhyayā vṛtyā ye
kāle vartante māso'rddhamāsa iti, tata evāyaṃ pratyayaḥ syād; na tu
gauṇavṛtyā kālavṛteḥ, kadambapuṣpasāhacaryātkadamba kālaḥ,
vrīhipalālasāhacaryād vrīhipalālaṃ kāla
ityāderityāśaṅkyāha---yathākathañciditi | yena kenacitprakāreṇa |
etadeva spaṣṭayati---guṇavṛtyāpīti | paratra
paraśabdapravṛteryannibandhanaṃ sa guṇaḥ, tannibandhanā vṛttirguṇavṛttiḥ |
etacca sandhivelādisūtre'nena kālagrahaṇena nakṣatrāṇi yadviśinaṣṭi
tato labhyate | na hi mukhyāthaḥ kālaśabdo'sti nakṣatrāṇāṃ sambhavati |
puṣpādisamīpasthena hi candramasā yogāllakṣitalakṣaṇayā
puṣpādiśabdānāṃ kāle vṛttiḥ | saiva ca ṭhlubaviśeṣe' iti
lubvidhānenāpyanvākhyāyate pauṣādinivṛtyartham, na tvetāvatā
kālasteṣāṃ mukhyo'rthaḥ ||
śrāddhe śaradaḥ || 4|3|12 ||
śrāddha iti karma gṛhyate iti | śraddhāsminvidyata iti ṭhprajñāśraddhārcā' iti
matvarthīyo'ṇaḥ, śraddhayā sampādyaṃ pitryaṃ karma śrāddhaśabdena ucyata ityarthaḥ
| na śraddhāvān puruṣaṃ iti | yadā sa eva ṇaḥ ṣaṣṭha|lrthe bhavati tadā
puruṣavṛttiḥ śrāddhaśabdaḥ | kathaṃ punaḥ śabdasādhāraṇye'pyayaṃ viśeṣo
labhyate ? ityāha---anabhidhānāditi | śāradikaṃ śrāddhamiti | yadyatra
vihitaṃ tatatra bhavamiti bhave pratyayayaḥ ||
śvasastuṭ ca || 4|3|15 ||
tasya ceti | ṭhañaḥ, na tu śvaḥ śabdasya | kuta etat ? ṭhaño
vidheyatvena prādhānyāt | sa ca tuḍāgama ikādeśe kṛte bhavatīti
veditavyam | nanu cāntaraṅgatvādikādeśātprāk ṭhañastuṭ
prāpnoti, ikādeśastvaṅgadhikāre
vidhānādasaṅgasaṃjñāyāmabhinirvṛtāyāṃ paścād bhavanbahiraṅgaḥ,
tuṭi ca kṛte pratyayādeṣṭhasyekādeśavidhānādyathā karmaṭha ityatra na
bhavati evamatrāpi na syāt, yadi punarayaṃ tuk pūrvāntaḥ kriyate;
naivaṃ śakyam, ṭhisusuktāntātkaḥ' iti kādeśaḥ syāt, tasmādastu
parādireva | kathamikādeśaḥ ? jñāpakātsiddham, yadayaṃ vuñcchaṇāadiṣu
ṭhacaścitkaraṇaṃ karoti, tajjñāpayati---antaraṅgebhyo'pi
pūrvamikādeśa eva bhavatīti | yadi na syāt,
pratyayasaṃjñāsanniyogaśiṣṭe pratyayasvare kṛte paścādikādeśa iti
siddhamantodātatvaṃ syāt | ṭa|luṭa|lulāvapi bhavati iti |
ṭhsāyaṃciram' ityādinā śvaḥ śabdo'vyayam, kālavācī ceti kṛtvā |
śauvastikamiti | dvārāditvād vṛddhipratiṣedhaḥ, aijāgamaśca ||
sandhivelādyaḥtunakṣatrebhyo'ṇ || 4|3|16 ||
aṇgrahaṇaṃ vṛddhāccasya bādhanārthamiti | asatyaṇgrahaṇe
sandhivelādibhyo yathāvihitamityucyamāne
yadyapyārambhasāmarthyātkālāṭṭhañ na bhavati; tathāpi sandhivelādiṣu
paṭhitātpaurṇamāsīśabdātsvātyādeśca vṛddhācchaḥ syād, vacanaṃ tu
kālāṭṭhaño bādhanārthaṃ syāt | tasmādaṇgrahaṇaṃ kartavyaṃ
vṛddhācchasya bādhanārtham | sauvātamiti | ṭhata sātatyagamane'
supūrvāt ṭhajyatibhyāṃ ca' itīṇ pratyayaḥ, svātyā yuktaḥ kāla
ityaṇ, tasya ṭhlubaviśeṣe' iti lup, tato bhavādāvarthe'nenāṇ,
ṭhna yvābhyām' iti vṛddhipratiṣedhaḥ, aijāgamaśca | jātārthe tu
ṭhśrīviṣṭāphalgunī, iti luki svātiriti bhavati | taiṣamiti | atrāpi
jātārthe pūrvavallukā bhavatavyamiti bhavādau pratyayaḥ,
ṭhtiṣyapuṣyayornakṣatrāṇi yalopaḥ' iti yalopaḥ |
saṃvatsarātphalaparvaṇoriti | sāṃvatsaraṃ phalaṃ parva vā,
sāṃvatsarikamanyat ||
prāvṛṣa eṇyaḥ || 4|3|17 ||
pravarpatīti prāvṛṭ, kvipi ṭhnahivṛtti' ityādinā dīrghaḥ |
prāvṛṣeṇya iti | bhavārthe pratyayaḥ, jāte tu prāvṛṣaṣṭhapaṃ vakṣyati |
ṭhraṣābhyām' ityeva siddhe pratyaye
ṇakāroccāraṇam---prāvṛṣeṇyamācaṣṭe prāvṛṣeṇyayateḥ kvip,
ṇilopaḥ, ṭhlopo vyorvali' iti yalopaḥ, prāvṛṣeṇityatra
ṇatvārtham ; anyathā ṭhpadāntasya' iti pratiṣedhaḥ syāt ||
varṣābhyaṣṭhak || 4|3|18 ||
vārṣikaṃ vāsa iti | ṭhkālātsādhupuṣpyatpacyamāneṣu' iti sādhvarthe
ṭhak ||
cchandasi ṭhañ || 4|3|19 ||
nabhaśca nabhasyaśca vārṣikāvṛt iti | ṭhtasyedam' ityatrārthe pratyayaḥ,
ṛtuśabdaśca ṛtvavayavayormāsayorvartate, varṣartoretau
māsāvavayavāvityarthaḥ ||
sarvatrāṇ ca talopaśca || 4|3|22 ||
haimanamiti | yadā taśabdasya samudāyasya lopastadā ṭhan' iti
prakṛtibhāvāt ṭhnastaddhite' iti ṭilopo na bhavati | yadā tu
takārasyānena lopo'kārasya tu yasyeti lopaḥ, tadā tasya
ṭhasiddhavadatrābhāt' ityasiddhatvātsthānivadbhāvācca ṭilopābhāvaḥ |
nanu ca cchandasīti nānuvartiṣyata iti | asvaritatvāt | saivetyādi
| yāsāvasvaritatvādanuvṛttiḥ saiva sarvatretyanena śabdenākhyāyate,
kimartham ? ityāha--pratyatnādhikyeneti | nanu ca tata
evāsvaritatvātpūrvasūtre'pi cchandasīti nānuvartiṣyate,
tasmādvispaṣṭārthameva sarvatragrahaṇam | bhāṣāyāmapi ṭhañaṃ smarantīti |
bhāṣye tu naitadiṣyate, tathā hi---sūtramidaṃ pratyākhyātam, katham ?
hemantaparyāyo hemanśabdo'sti---ṭhhemannāganīganti karṇau,
tasmādetau hemannaśuṣyataḥ, tadi heman pramīyate hemanto bhavati'
iti darśanāt, tatra bhāṣāyāṃ deman-hemantaśabdayorṛtvaṇi
haimanaṃ haimantamiti rūpadvayaṃ siddham, cchandasi tu hemno haimanam,
hemantasya ṭhhemantācca' iti ṭhañi haimantikam, ṭhsarve vidhayaścchandasi
vikalpyante' iti hemantaśabdādevāṇi haimantamiti rūpatrayaṃ
siddhamiti | sūtrakāreṇa tu
bhāṣāyāmetadvṛttiviṣayādanyatrartuvācino hemañcchabdasya
prayogābhāvān nalopo vihitaḥ, yathāprāptaṃ ca ṛtvaṇiti,
anantarastu ṭhañ sarvatragrahaṇasya pūrvatrānvayenaiva sarvatra siddhiriti
nāsau samuccīyate | kaḥ punaranayorviśeṣa iti | na kaściditi
bhāvaḥ trīṇirūpāṇi bhavantīti | pūrveṇa ṭhañi ekam,
anenāṇtalopayordvitīyam, ṛtvaṇi yasyeti lope paramiti trīṇi
rūpāṇi ||
sāyamciramprāhṇeprage'vyayebhyaṣṭa|luṭa|lulau tuṭ ca || 4|3|23 ||
iha ṭhyuvoranākau' ityaṅgādhikāre vihitatvādanādeśo
bahiraṅgaḥ, tuḍāgamastu pratyayasanniyogena vidhānādantaraṅga iti
tenaiva tāvadbhavitavyam, tatra kṛte'nādeśo na prāpnoti, kiṃ
kāraṇam ? aṅgasya nimitaṃ yo yustasyānādeśaḥ, tuṭi tvatra sati
tyuśabdo'ṅgasya nimitaṃ na yuśabdamātram, tataśca yathā
mṛtyurityatrānādeśo na bhavati, tathātrāpi na syāt | yadi
punarayaṃ tuk pūrvāntaḥ kriyate ? naivaṃ śakyam ; prātastanamityatra
hri visarjanīyo na syāt, apadāntatvāt | tasmātparādirevāyaṃ
kartavyaḥ, tatra cānādeśo na prāpnoti ?
tatrāha---tayoścādiṣṭayostuḍāgamo bhavatīti | ādiṣṭayoriti
kṛtādeśayorityarthaḥ | eṣa cārtha ādiṣṭaśabdasya
aśeādyacpratyayāntatvena labhyate, ādiśyata ityādiṣṭaḥ, sa yayorasti
tāvādiṣṭau, tayorādiṣṭayoriti | etacca ṭhghakālataneṣu' iti
nirdeśāllabhyate, na hyanādiṣṭayostuḍvidhāne nataśabda upapadyate |
prātastanamityatra vṛddhācchṃa paratvādvādhata iti noktam ; cchasya
bādhakamapi ṭhañaṃ bādhamānayoṣṭa|luṭa|lulorutkṛṣṭabalayordurbalena
chena saha sampradhāraṇābhāvāt | makārāntaṃ padamavyayamiti |
svarādiṣu paṭhitam | antakarmaṇa iti | antakriyasya, ṭhṣo'ntakarmaṇi'
ityasyetyarthaḥ | yadyapyasāvavasānamātravanācī, ghañantastu sāyaśabdo
divasāntavacana iti na kālādhikārasya bādhaśaṅkā |
pratyayasanniyogeneti | anyatra tvakārānta eva, yathā---sāyāhnaḥ,
sāyatara iti | āha ca---saṃkhyāvisāyapūrvasyāhnasyeti |
ekārāntatvamiti | nipātyata ityanuṣaṅgaḥ | yatra saptamyartho
nāsti---prāhṇaḥ soḍho'syetyādau, tadarthaṃ nipātanam | jātādike
tvarthe ṭhghakālataneṣu' ityalukā siddham |
ciraparutparāribhya iti | ciraśabdasya sūtra upādānāt
ṭa|luṭa|lulāvāpa bhavataḥ, na tu ṭhkiyatadvahuṣu kṛño'jvidhānāt'
itivatsūtrasya bādhaḥ | parut u pūrvasmin saṃvatsare, parāri u
pūrvatare | pratnaśabdaḥ purāṇavacanaḥ |
agrapaścāḍḍimajiti | kecidatrādiśabdamapi
paṭhanti---agrādipaścāditi, te ṭhmadhyānmaḥ' ityatrādeśceti
vaktavyamiti na paṭhanti | ḍitkaraṇaṃ paścādityatra ṭilopārtham |
ṭhavyayānāṃ bhamātre ṭilopaḥ' ityasyaivāyaṃ prapañcārthaḥ ||
vibhāṣā pūrvāhṇāparāhṇābhyām || 4|3|24 ||
saptamyā alugiti ṭhṅyāpprātipadikāt' ityatra
niraṇāyi---subantātaddhitotpatiriti, tatatraiva draṣṭavyam | yadi
subantātaddhita utpadyate, kathaṃ pūrvāhṇatana ityatra bhavati ?
tatrāha---yadā tviti ||
tatra jātaḥ || 4|3|25 ||
teṣāmataḥ prabhṛtyarthāḥ samarthavibhaktayaśca nirdiśyanta iti |
tadidamubhayamanirdeśyam, katham ? ṭhśeṣa iti lakṣaṇaṃ cādhikāraśca'
ityuktam, tatra lakṣaṇatayā cākṣuṣaṃ rūpamityādāviva
jātādiṣvapyartheṣvaṇādayaḥ siddhāḥ, adhikāratayā ca ghādaya
ityarthāstāvanna nirdeśyāḥ pratyayārthena cābhidānasvābhāvyena
samarthavibhaktayo'pi labhyante iti tannirdeśyāḥ pratyayārthena
cābhidānasvābhāvyena samarthavibhaktayo'pi labhyante iti tannirdeśo'pi
na kartavya eva | niyamārthamiti cenna; aniṣṭatvāt |
tatraitatsyāt---jātādiṣveva taddhitā yathā syuḥ, tatrāste tatra śeta
ityādau mā bhūvanniti jātādayo'rthā anukramyanta iti ? tacca naivam;
aniṣṭatvāt | anyatrāpi hi taddhitā iṣyante---cākṣuṣaṃ rūpam,
śrāvaṇaḥ śabdaḥ, cāturdaśaṃ rakṣaḥ, dārṣadāḥ saktava iti | yatra tu
neṣyante, tatrāsta ityādau---tatrānabhidhānānna bhaviṣyanti,
yathā---aṅgulyā khanatītyādau | tasmānnārtho jātādyanukramaṇena |
apavādavidhānārthaṃ tu, prāvṛṣaṣṭhabādīnapavādāÄstatra tatrāsaṅkareṇa
vakṣyāmīti avaśyānukramitavyā arthāḥ, te'nyārthāḥ santo
yogavibhāgenāṇādīnāmapyarthā nirdiśyante |
viśpaṣṭārtham, yāni punaranapavādānyarthādarśanāni,
yathā---ṭhkṛtalabhdhakrītakuśalāḥ' iti, tāni śakyānyavaktum ||
saṃjñāyāṃ śarado vuñ || 4|3|27 ||
samudāyena cediti | prakṛtipratyayasamudāyaścetsaṃjñā bhavatītyarthaḥ |
kṛtalabdhakrītakuśalā iti yāvaditi | yāvacchabdo'vadhidyotako
nipātaḥ ||
amāvāsyāyā vā || 4|3|30 ||
ekadeśavikṛtasyānanyatvāditi | ṭhamāvasyadanyatarasyām' ityatra
ṭhamāpūrvasya vaserṇyati pakṣe vṛddhyabhāvo nipātyate' ityuktam |
ṇyati ca ṭhata upadhāyāḥ' iti sāmānyena vṛddhividhānāt,
amāvāsyāśabdasya nyāyyatvādavṛddhyupadhastasyaivaikadeśavikāra iti
bhāvaḥ | ye tviha sūtre sandhivelādiṣu ca hrasvopadhamadhīyate, teṣāṃ
dīrghopadhasya na syāt; atadvikāratvāt ||
a ca || 4|3|31 ||
kimartho yogavibhāgaḥ, na caṭhamāvāsyāyā vā' ityucyeta,
cakārādvuñ, vāvacanādubhayorabhāve'ṇapi bhaviṣyati ? sayatm ;
utaratra tu vikalpānuvṛttiḥ śaṅkyeta | yogavibhāge tu
sandhivelādyaṇo'bhyanujñānāya pūrvasūtre vāgrahaṇasāmarthyādasyāpi
vikalpasiddheriha vāgrahaṇaÄ nānuvartyamiti vyavadhānādutaratra
vikalpasya nivṛttiḥ siddhā bhavati ||
aṇañau ca || 4|3|33 ||
yogavibhāgo yathāsaṃkhyārthaḥ
||
śraviṣṭhāphalgunyanurādhāsvātitiṣyapunarvasuhastaviśākhāṣāḍhābahulālluk || 4|3|34 ||
kṛtikāparyāyasya bahulāśabdasyātra dvandvaikavadbhāvena
napuṃsakahrasvatvena nirdeśaḥ, na bahvarthādānanimitasya bahulāśabdasya;
śraviṣṭādibhiḥ sāhacaryāt | citreti | ṭhluktaddhitaluki' iti luki
kṛte punaṣṭāp |
gaurādipāṭhān ṅīṣiti | ṭhrevatī nakṣatre, rohiṇī nakṣatre' iti
tatra paṭha|lte, na cemau nakṣatravācinau; jātārthavṛttitvāt |
tasmād ṭhgaurādiṣu pippalyādayaśca' iti pāṭhāteṣāṃ
cāvṛtkṛtatvādatra ṅīṣityarthaḥ |
ṭānau vaktavyāviti | striyāmityapekṣyate, ṭakāro ṅībarthaḥ, nakāraḥ
svarārthaḥ, vidhānasāmarthyāccānayorlugna bhavati |
cchaṇapi vaktavya iti | atra ca ṭhstriyām' iti nāpekṣyate ||
sthānāntagośālakharaśālācca || 4|3|35 ||
gośāleti | ṭhvibhāṣā senā' iti napuṃsakatve hrasvatvam |
tatsāhacaryātkharaśālasyāpi napuṃsakasya grahaṇam, na tu
dvandvaikavadbhāvena hrasvatvam | ekādeśasya pūrvaṃ
pratyantavadbhāvālliṅgaviśiṣṭayaparibhāṣayā strīliṅgābhyāmapi
lugbhavatyeva | yadyapi ṭābantayorapi pāṭhe
ekadeśavikṛtasyānanyatvānnapuṃsakābhyāmapi luk siddhyati,
lāghavārthaṃ tu hrasvasya pāṭhaḥ ||
vatsaśālābhijidaśvayuvacchatabhiṣajo vā || 4|3|36 ||
vatsaśāleti | hrasvāntasya dīrghāntasya vā grahaṇam |
bahulagrahaṇasyaivāyaṃ prapañca iti |
aśvayukśatabhipakśabdāvabhipretyaitaduktam ; anyayoranakṣatravācitvāt
| abhijiditi | yadyapi nakṣatramapyasti---ṭhabhijinnāma
nakṣatrapumapariṣṭādaṣāḍhānāmiti', muhūrtamapyasti ||
nakṣatrebhyo bahulam || 4|3|37 ||
vāgrahaṇānuvṛtervyavasthitavibhāṣāvijñānācca lugvyavasthāyāṃ
siddhāyām, bahulavacanaṃ kvacidanyadevetyetadartham, tena ṭānau
vaktavyāvityādi siddhaṃ bhavati | rohiṇa iti |
ṭhcitrārevatīrohiṇīyaḥ striyāmupasaṅkhyānam' ityetatu striyāṃ
niyamena lugarthe, na tu striyāmeva lugartham |
kṛtalabdhakrītakuśalāḥ || 4|3|38 ||
yadyatra kṛtaṃ jātamapi tatatra bhavatīti | yadyapi jātaṃ sarvaṃ kṛtaṃ na
bhavati, svayaṃ jātasyāpi bhāvāt ; kṛtaṃ tu sarvaṃ jātaṃ bhavati, na
hyajananasvabhāvaṃkriyate, yathā--vyometi bhāvaḥ | yacca krīta labdhamapi
tatatra bhavatīti | atrāpi labdhaṃ sarvaṃ krītaṃ na bhavati ; dānādināpi
lābhasambhāvāt | krītaṃ tu labdhameva ; krayasyāpi
lābhahetutvādityarthaḥ | tatkimarthaṃ bhedenopādānaṃ kriyata iti |
jātalabdhābhyāmeva gatamiti praśnaḥ | śabdārthasyābhinnatvāditi |
paravyāpāropahitaṃ rūpaṃ kṛtamityucyate, tadrahitaṃ tu jātamiti;
tathā mūlyapradānarūpo yaḥ svīkarturvyāpārastadupahitaṃ rūpaṃ
krītāmatyucyate, tadrahitaṃ tu labdhamiti | tatra yathā---viklinna
odanaḥ, pakva odana iti śabdārthābhedaḥ, tathātrāpītyarthaḥ | etadeva
spaṣṭayati---vastumātreṇeti | vastuta ityarthaḥ | etaduktaṃ
bhavati---krītaṃ vastuto labdhaṃ bhavatītyetāvat, śabdena tu
rūpāntaramabhidhīyate | evaṃ kṛtamapi vastṛto jātaṃ bhavati, śabdena
tu rūpāntaramabhidhīyata iti draṣṭavyam |
upasaṃharati---śabdārthastubhidyata eveti | tatrākriyamāṇe
kṛkrītayorupādāne yathā---kvāyaṃ ghaṭaḥ kṛtaḥ, krīto vā iti pṛṣṭe
srughne jāto labdha iti cotaraṃ naṃ prayujyate; tathā taddhito'pi na
syāt| tasmātkṛtakrītayostaddhitenābhidhānāya bhedenopādānamiti
||
prāyabhavaḥ || 4|3|39 ||
prāyeṇa bhavaḥ, ṭhkartṛkaraṇe kṛtā bahulam' iti samāsaḥ |
tatra bhavena kṛtatvāditi | yatprāyabhava ityasya sādhyam, tasya ṭhtatra
bhavaḥ' ityanenaiva sādhitatvādityarthaḥ | yo hi rāṣṭre prāyeṇa bhavati
tatraivāso bhavatīti ṭhtatra bhavaḥ' ityeva siddham |
śaṅkate---anityabhavaḥ prāyabhava iti cediti | yastatra kadācidbhavati
kadācinna sa prāyabhavaḥ, yasya tu niyata ādhārādheyabhāvaḥ sa ṭhtatra bhavaḥ'
iti pṛthagupādānasāmarthyādbheda āśrīyata iti yadyaucyetetyarthaḥ |
nirākaroti---muktasaṃśayena tulyamiti | yaṃ bhavānmuktasaṃśayaṃ
nyāyyaṃ tatrabhava udāharaṇaṃ manyate---sraughno devadata iti, tenaiva
tulyam, so'pi hi kadācitasmādudakdeśādabhiniṣkrāmati | tatra
cedyauktā tatra bhavatā, ihāpi yuktā dṛśyatām | athaitadapi
prāyabhavasyodāharaṇam---sraughno devadata iti | tatrabhavanasya
kimudāharaṇam ? tatra nityabhavaḥ sraughnaḥ prākāra iti | yadyevam, ṭhtatra
bhavaḥ' iti prakṛtya jihvāmūlāṅguleśchāe vidhīyate sa
tasmindṛṣṭāpacāre na syāt, dṛśyate ca--
vānaro'haṃ mahābhāge dūto rāmasya dharmataḥ |
rāmanāmāṅkitaṃ cedaṃ paśya devyaṅgulīyakam || iti |
tasmātatrabhave sāmānye prāyabhavasya viśeṣasyāntarbhāvādanarthakaṃ
prāyagrahaṇam ? idaṃ tarhi prayojanam---ṭhupajānūpakarṇopanīveṣṭhak'
prāyabhave yathā syānnityabhave mā bhūt---upajānu bhavaṃ gaḍviti |
athedānīṃ jānusamīpasthaśarīrāvayayavavācina upajānuśabdātatra bhava
iti prakṛtya ṭhśarīrāvayavādyat' iti yatkasmānna bhavati ?
anabhidhānāt | ṭhagapi tarhyanabidhānādeva na bhaviṣyati ? tadevaṃ
sthitam---etatprāyagrahaṇamanarthakam, tatra bhavena kṛtatvāditi ||
upājānūpakarṇopanīveṣṭhak || 4|3|40 ||
upajānvādayaḥ sāmīpye'vyayībhāvāḥ, samāhāradvandvasya sautraḥ
puṃlliṅganirdeśaḥ ||
sambhūte || 4|3|41 ||
avaklṛptiḥ pramāṇanatirekaśceti |
sakṛtprayuktasyāpyanekārthatvamaviruddham, tantrādyāśrayaṇāaditi bhāvaḥ |
tatrāvaklṛptiḥ u sambhāvanā, idamevaṃ bhavediti buddhiḥ;
pramāṇānatirekaḥ u ādhāraparimāṇādādheyaparimāṇāsyānatirekatā,
yasyāṃ satyāṃ sarvamādheyamādhāre'nupraviśati | sraughna iti | devadata
idānīṃ srughne sambhāvyata ityarthaḥ, srughnapramāṇādvā'natiricyate
senādiko'rtha ityarthaḥ ||
kośāḍ ḍhañ || 4|3|42 ||
kauśīyaṃ vastramiti | nanu ca na vastraṃ kośe sambhavati, vastradāyāṃ
tatkāraṇasya kośasya parāvṛtatvāt, na ca kośāntare vastrasya
sambhavaḥ, na ca tatreṣyate, tasmādvikāre kośāḍḍhañ sambhūte
hyarthānupapatiriti vārtikameva śaraṇam | ṭhtasya vikāraḥ' ityatra
prakaraṇe ṭheṇyā ḍhañ' ityasyānantaram ṭhkośācceti vaktavyam' ityarthaḥ
| arthānupapatiriti | kauśeyaśabdasya yo'rtho laukikaḥ
sūtravastralakṣaṇastasyānupapatiḥ syāt, laukiko'rthaḥ śāstreṇa
nānusṛtaḥ syāt | kṛmireva tvabhidheyaḥ prāpnoti sa hi kośe
sambhavati | kiñcāviśeṣābhidhānātkhaṅgakośādapi pratyayaḥ prasajyeta,
ityata āha---rūḍhireṣeti | rūḍhiśabdeṣu nāvaśyamavayavārtho'nveṣyaḥ,
yathā tailapāyikādiṣviti manyate | sūtrakāreṇa tu
satkāryavalādāśrayeṇa sambhūte pratyayo vihitaḥ, tatra hi
kāraṇadaśāyāmapi kāryasya satvāt tatra tatsambhavati tadanupapannam |
kāryakāraṇayorhi tādātmyamabhisambandhaḥ, na tvādhārādheyabhāvaḥ ||
kālātsādhupuṣyatpacyamāneṣu || 4|3|43 ||
kālaviśeṣavācibhya iti | svarūpagrahaṇaṃ tu na bhavati;
utaratrāśvayujyādīnāmanena kālaśabdena viśeṣaṇāt ||
upte ca || 4|3|44 ||
sūtre bhūtakālasyāvivakṣāṃ darsayati | hemante upyante iti |
yogavibhāga utarārtha iti | utarayogayorukta eva pratyayo yathā
syāt, sādhvādiṣu mā bhūt ||
āśvayujyā vuñ || 4|3|45 ||
vuño ñakāraḥ svarārthaḥ, utaratra vṛddhyarthaśca, aśvayugbhyāṃ yukteti
pāṭhaḥ, aśvayujodvitvāt ṭhnamo'śvibhyāmaśvayugbhyām' iti
darśanāt | aśvinīparyāya iti pāṭhaḥ | ṭhtārā aśvayugaśvinī'
ityamarasihaḥ | aśvanīparyāyaiti prasiddhaḥ pāṭhaḥ,
tatrāśupūrvādanerauṇādika inpratyayaḥ, pṛṣodarāditvādāderhrasvaḥ ||
kalāpyaśvatthavyavabusād vun || 4|3|48 ||
mayūrādiṣu prasiddhānāṃ kalāpyādīnāṃ śabdānāṃ kāle vṛttirna
sambhavati, tatkatham ṭhkālaviśeṣavicibhyaḥ' ityuktam ? ata
āha---kalāpyādayaḥ śabdā iti | aśvatthena vṛkṣeṇa kālasya
sambandho'vyabicārādaviśeṣaṇamiti ṭhphale luk' iti
luganto'śvatthaśabda ityāha---yasminnaśvatthāḥ phalantīti | apakṛṣṭe
yavo yavabusaṃ jātyantaraṃ vā yavādivat, yavānāmeva vā busaṃ
yavabusam ||
grīṣmāvarasamādvuñ || 4|3|49 ||
avarasamamiti viśeṣaṇasamāsaḥ | na cāvaraśabdo digvācī, yena
ṭhdiksaṅkhye saṃjñāyām' iti niyamātsamāso na syāt |
āvarasamakamiti | āgāmināṃ saṃvatsarāṇāmādyavatsare deyamityarthaḥ |
apara āha---atīte vatsare deyaṃ yadadyāpi na dataṃ tadāvarasamakamiti
||
saṃvatsarāgrahāyaṇībhyāṃ ṭhañca || 4|3|50 ||
veti vaktavye iti | vuñi vikalpite pakṣe yathā prāptaṣṭhañeva
bhaviṣyatīti manyate | ṭhañgrahaṇamityādi | asati ṭhañgrahaṇe
sandhivelādiṣu ṭhsaṃvatsarātphalaparvaṇoḥ' iti pāṭhātphale ṛṇatvena
vivakṣite vuñā mukte'ṇeta syāt, ṭhañgrahaṇātu ṭhañeva bhavati ||
vyāharati mṛgaḥ || 4|3|51 ||
vyāharati u śabdāyate ||
tadasya soḍham || 4|3|52 ||
asyeti | neyaṃ soḍhāpekṣayā kartri ṣaṣṭhī, ṭhna lokāvyaya' iti
pratiṣedhāt, kiṃ tarhi ? kartureva sambandhitvamātravivakṣayā
śeṣalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhī | niśāsahacaritamadhyayanamiti | kālasya
svarūpeṇāsoḍhatvātatsahacaritavṛteratra sūtre grahaṇamiti darśayati ||
tatra bhavaḥ || 4|3|53 ||
kālāditi nivṛtamiti | ṭhtatra jātaḥ' iti prakṛtaṃ tatragrahaṇaṃ
kālādhikāreṇa sambaddhamiti tadanuvṛtau tasyāpyanuvṛttiḥ syāditi
punariha tatragrahaṇaṃ kṛtam ṭhsaptamyarthamātraṃ yathā gṛhyaeta
kālasambandhaviśiṣṭaḥ saptamyartho mā grāhi' ityavamarthamiti bhāvaḥ |
nanu ca prakṛtaṃ tatragrahaṇaṃ pūrvasūtre taditi prathamayā samarthavibhaktyā
vyavahitam ? netyāha, śakyaṃ hi tadanyatrāpi paṭhitum ||
digādibhyo yat || 4|3|54 ||
senāmukhyamiti | yadantasya senāśabdena ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ, na tu
senāmukhyaśabdātpratyayaḥ; tadantavidhyabhāvāt || 
śarīrāvayavācca || 4|3|55 ||
śarīraṃ prāṇikāya iti | ṭhvyākaraṇasya śarīram' ityādikastu
prayogo gauṇaḥ | aṇo'pavāda iti | vṛddhātu chṃa paratvādvādhate,
pāde bhavaṃ padyam, ṭhpadyatyatadarthe' iti padbhāvaḥ | nāsikāyāṃ bhavaṃ
nasyam, ṭhnasa nāsikāyā yataskṣudreṣu' iti nasbhāvaḥ | katham
ṭhvego jaṅghorasyaḥ' iti ? kathaṃ ca na syāt, na
śarīrāvayavasamudāyaḥ śarīrāvayavagrahaṇena gṛhyate | na ca
tadantavidhirasti ? niraṅkaśāḥ kavayaḥ ||
dṛtikukṣikalaśivastyastyaherḍhañ || 4|3|56 ||
dṛtiścarmavikāraḥ, śarīrāvayavaśca | kukṣiśabdo dhūmādiḥ,
vastirnābheradhaḥ śarīrāvayavaḥ | āheyam viṣādi |
astiśabdaḥ prātipadikamiti | vibhaktipratirūpaṃ nipātasaṃjñakam, tacca
tiṅntena samānārtham---astikṣīrā gauriti, dhanavacanaṃ ca
astimāniti ||
grīvābhyo'ṇca || 4|3|57 ||
dhamanīvacana iti | dhamanīsaṅghātavacana ityarthaḥ | sa ca
yadodbhūtāvayavabhede saṅghāte vartate tadā bahuvacanam, yadā
tu tirohitāvayavabhede saṅghāte vartate tadaikavacanāntaḥ prayogaḥ
||
gambhīrāññyaḥ || 4|3|58 ||
badirdeavapañcajanebhyaśceti vaktavyamiti | ṭhprāgdīvyataḥ'
ityatroktam---ṭhdevasya yañañau, bahiṣaṣṭilopaśca' iti | taccāvaśyaṃ
vaktavyam---arthāntareṣvapi yathā syāditi | tasyaiva prapañcārtham, iha
tu bahirdeavayorgrahaṇam ||
avyayībhāvācca || 4|3|59 ||
kiṃ tahiṃ parimukhāderiti | kathaṃ punaḥ sāmānyoktāvayaṃ viśeṣo
labhyata ityāha---parimukhādīnāṃ ceti | caśabdo hetau |
digāderanantaraṃ parimukhādigaṇaḥ paṭha|lte, tasya nānyatprayojanaṃ
sambhavati avyayībhāvagrahaṇasya,
parimukhādiviśeṣaṇatayā'nvayasambhavāt, tasmātparimukhādereva
bhaviṣyati, na sarvasmādavyayībhāvāt | yadyevam,
parimukhāderityeva vaktavyamata āha---teṣāmeveti | ṭhparimukhādeḥ'
ityucyamāne bahuvrīhitatpuruṣebhyo'pi ñyapratyayaḥ syāt,
avyayībhāvagrahaṇātu tebhyo'ṇeva bhavati | utarārthaṃ
cāvaśyamavyayībhāvagrahaṇaṃ kartavyam, tatra ye paripūrvāstatra yadi
varjanaṃ gamyate tataḥ ṭhapaparibahirañcavaḥ | pañcamyā' ityavyayībhāvaḥ |
atha sarvato bhāvaḥ, tato'smādeva nipātanādavyayībhāvaḥ | upapūrveṣu
sāmīpye'nupūrveṣu ṭhanuryatsamayā' ṭhyasya cāyāmaḥ' ṭhpaścādarthe
yadavyayam' iti ca yathābhidhānaṃ samāsaḥ || 
antaḥ pūrvadāṭṭhañ || 4|3|60 ||
ādhyātmikamiti | ṭhanaśca' iti ṭac samāsāntaḥ | ādhividaikam,
ādhibhautikamiti | anuśatikāditvādubhayapadavṛddhiḥ |
adhyātmādirākṛtigaṇa iti | evaṃ ca samānaśabdādityādirasyaiva
prapañcaḥ |
ūrdhvaśabdena samānārtha ūrdhvaṃśabda iti | sa caitadvṛttiviṣaya eva |
apara āha---ṭhṭhañsanniyogena dama śabda utare ūrdhvaśabdasyaiva
māntatvaṃ nipātyate' iti | 
ūrdhvadehācceti | nātra māntatvam |
aihalaukikamiti | pūrvavadubhayapadavṛddhiḥ |
mukhatīyam, pārśvatīyamiti | mukha-pārśva-śabdābhyāṃ
saptamyāntābhyāmādyāditvātasiḥ, tata īyaḥ, avyayatvāṭṭilopaḥ | ayaṃ
gahādipāṭhasyaiva prapañcaḥ | etena paraṃ vyākhyātam |
maṇmīyāviti | gahādiṣu ṭhmadhyamadhyamaṃ cāṇ caraṇe' iti yatpaṭhitaṃ
tatra ṭhpṛthivīmadhyavācī madhyaśabdo gṛhyate' ityuktam, bhavārthe tu
tato'nyatrāpi madhyamīyamiti yatā syāditi mīyapratyayavacanam |
jātādiṣu pṛthivīmadhyavācina eva madhyamīya iti bhavati, na
madhyāntaravācinaḥ | tathā gahādipāṭhena pṛthivīmadhyaṃ nivāsā
eṣāmityasminnevārthe mādhyamā iti sidhyati, madhyāntaravācino
bhavārthe'pi yathā syāditi maṇ pratyaya uktaḥ |
madhyo madhyaṃdinaṇ cāsmāditi | madhyaśabdo madhyabhāvamāpadyate
dinaṇcāsmāt pratyayo bhavatītyarthaḥ |
sthāmna iti | sthāmanśabdāntādityarthaḥ | aśvatthāmeti | aśvasyeva sthāma
balamasyeti bahuvrīhiḥ, pṛṣodarāditvātsakārasya takāraḥ, tato
bhavārthe ṭhsthāmno'kāraḥ' ityakāraḥ tasmānena luk |
vṛkājina iti | aṇo luk |
samānasya tadādeśceti | ānantaryatvalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhī | adhyātmādiṣviti
| viṣayasaptamī urdhvandāmācca dehācceti |
ūrdhvaṃśabdāddamaśabdāntāccetyarthaḥ | ūrdhvapūrvādeva ca
dehāntādiṣyate | uktaṃ hi prāk ṭhurdhvadehācca, aurdhvadehikam'
iti | sthāmno lugajinātatheti | pāṭhe ubhayatrāpi tadantavidhiḥ ||
aśabde yatkhāvanyatarasyām || 4|3|64 ||
vāsudevavargīya iti | ṭhvṛddhācchaḥ' ityasya paratvādyatkhau bādhakāviti
vṛddhādapyanena ccha eṣitavyaḥ ||
tasya vyākhyāna iti ca vyākhyātavyanāmnaḥ || 4|3|66 ||
tasyeti ṣaṣṭhīsamarthāditi | nanu cādhikārārtho'yamiti vakṣyati,
bhavyākhyānayoryugapadadhikāro'pavādavidhānārthaḥ, kṛtanirdeśau hi
tāviti, tatkimityatra yathāvihitavidhānārthatvaṃ vyākhyāyate ?
ucyate---tātparyato'pavādavidhānāyādhikārasyānuṣaṅgike'ṇādividhānārthatve ko doṣa iti manyate, agatikagatirhi viśeṣavivakṣāyāṃ sāmānyāśrayaḥ pratyayaḥ | ata eva ṭhkṛtalabdhakrītakuśalāḥ' ityādīnyanapavādānyarthādeśanāni bhavanti | tatra bhaveceti | ayamanuvādaḥ; etasminneva viśeṣe ṭhtatra bhavaḥ' iti vihitatvāt | nanu ca vyākhyānasya pratyayārthasya samīpe śrūyamāṇaścaśabdastatsamānajātīyasyaiva pratyayārthasya samuccayaṃ karoti, na samarthavibhakteḥ; yathā ṭhkedārādyañca' iti pratyayasamīpavartinā pratyaya eva samuccīyate, na prakṛtiḥ; ṭhṭhañkavacinaśca' iti prakṛtereva na pratyayaḥ; tataśceha tasyetyupādānādbhavārthe'pi ṣaṣṭhīsamarthādeva pratyayo yuktaḥ, tatrāha---vākyārthasamīpe iti | ihetikaraṇaḥ kriyate---prakṛtaṃ vākyārthaṃ pratyavamarśāmīti | pratyavamarśasya ca prayojanam---natulyajātīyasyaiva samuccayo yathā syādityetadeveti bhāvaḥ | etameva ca nyāyaṃ nirūpayituṃ pūrvam ṭhtatra bhave ca' ityanuvādaḥ kṛtaḥ |
vyākhyātavyanāgna iti kimiti | vyākyānaśabdasya
sambandhiśabdatvādyaprativyākhyānaṃ tadeva tasyetyanena nirdiṣṭamiti
gamyata iti matvā praśnaḥ | pāṭaliputraṃ sukośalayā vyākhyāyata iti
neyaṃ kartari tṛtīyā, kiṃ tarhi ? karaṇe sukośalayā karaṇabhūtayā
puruṣairvyākhyāyata ityarthaḥ | kathamityāha---evaṃsanniveśamiti |
tādṛśo hi pāṭaliputre prākārādisanniveśo yādṛśaḥ
sukośalāyām, tena tayā tadvyākhyāyate | yadyevam, tasya
vyākhyātavyasya pāṭaliputraśabdo nāmāpi bhavati, tatkathaṃ
pratyudāharaṇam ? ata āha---na tviti | yadiha
vyākhyātavyamabhipretam, na tasya nāma bhavatītyarthaḥ | kiṃ
punarihābhipretam ? yadvyākhyātavyatayā loke prasiddhaṃ
granthātmakam, etadarthameva hi vyākhyātavyanāmagrahaṇaṃ kṛtam,
vyākhyātavyamātrasya vyākhyānaśabdasya sambandhiśabdatvenaivākṣepasiddheḥ |
nanu ca bhavārthametatsyāt, na hi tatrākṣepato vyākhyātavyasya lābhaḥ
? evaṃ tarhi nāmagrahaṇaṃ prasiddhyupasaṃgrahārthaṃ bhaviṣyati |
bhavavyākhyānayoriti | nātrāyamarthaḥ---yo'yaṃ
bhavavyākhyānayoryugapadadhikāraḥ so'pavādavidhānārtha iti;
pūrvamadhikāratvasyāvyākhyātatvāt |
tasmādbhavavyākhyānayoryugapadadhikāro'yaṃ na
tvaṇādīnāmarthanirdeśa ityarthaḥ |
kimartho'dhikārastatrāha---apavādavidhānārtha iti | aṇādīnāṃ
cāyamarthanirdeśaḥ kasmānna bhavati ? tatrāha---kṛtanirdeśau hi tāviti
| ekaḥ ṭhtatra bhavaḥ' iti, aparaḥ ṭhtasyedam'---ityevaṃ kṛtanirdeśau hi
tāvarthau | tasmātadarthametanna bhavati | pūrvaṃ
tvadhikārārthatayāvaśyakartavyasyānuṣaṅgikamarthanirdeśārthamidamiti
vyākhyātam ||
bahvaco'ntodātāṭṭhañ || 4|3|67 ||
amo'pavāda iti | vṛddhācchṃa tu paratvādvādhate | sāmastaṃ nāma śāstraṃ
tasya vyākhyānaṃ sāmastikam | ṣatvādividhāyakaṃ śāstraṃ
ṣatvādiśabdenocyate | nataḥ u anudātaḥ, anataḥ u udātaḥ |
antodātāḥ prakṛtaya iti |
udāhṛtayordvitve'pyevañjātīyāparaprakṛtyapekṣaṃ bahuvacanam, tāśca
kutvarutvādayaḥ |
gatisvareṇeti | ṭhgatiranantaraḥ' ityanena | udāta iti varṇagrahaṇam,
tena siddhastadantavidhiḥ, yathā ṭhvarādanudatād' ityatra |
tasmādantagrahaṇaṃ vispaṣṭārtham ||
kratuyajñebhyaśca || 4|3|68 ||
agniṣṭomādyartheṣu mantrabrahmaṇakalpeṣu vartamānā agniṣṭomādiśabdā
ihodāharaṇam | anantodātārtha ārambha iti | tatra
rājasūya---vājapeyaśabdau kṛdutarapadaprakṛtisvareṇa madhyodātau,
rājā sūyate, rājñā veha sūyate, vayap; tata eva
nipātanātsamāsaḥ, ṣaṣṭhīsamāso vā | pīyate'sminniti peyaḥ
ṭhkṛtyalyuṭo bahulam' ityadhikaraṇe yat; vājo yavāgūbhedaḥ,
tasya peyaḥ pāyo vājapeya iti | stutiḥustomaḥ,
agnestomo'sminniti bahuvrīhiḥ, ṭhparādiśca parāntaśca'
ityantodātaḥ | navairvrīhibhiryajanaṃ navayajñaḥu āgrayaṇam, ṭhkartṛkaraṇe
kṛtā bahulam' iti samāsaḥ, ṭhkṛdutarapadaprakṛtibhāvena naṅ eva
svaro'vatiṣṭhate' ityantodātaḥ | alpa paryāyaḥ pākaśabdaḥ,
pākaścāsau yajñaśca pākayajñaḥ, samāsasvareṇāntodātaḥ | satyanyārtha
etasyārambhe, antodātādapi yajñābhidhāyinaḥ paratvādanenaiva
ṭhañpratyayo yukta ityantodātānāmupanyāsaḥ |
kratubhya ityeva siddha iti | kratuyajñayoḥ paryāyatvāditi bhāvaḥ |
asomayāgebhyo'pīti | anyathā kratuśabdasya somayāge rūḍhatvādanyatra
na syāt, yajñagrahaṇātu tebhyo'pi bhavati | evaṃ kevalayajñagrahaṇe'pi
sa eva doṣo yaḥ kevalakatugrahaṇe, tasmād
gauṇamukhyaparigrahārthamubhayorupādānam ||
adhyāyeṣvevarṣeḥ || 4|3|69 ||
aṣiśabdāḥ pravaranāmadheyānīti | hotrādhvaryuṇā ca pravriyanta iti
pravarāḥ u bhṛgvādayaḥ, tadyathā bhārgavacyāvanāpravānaurvajāmadagneti
hotā, jamadagnivadurvavadapravānavaccyavanavadbhṛguvadityadhvaryuḥ |
etena yadyapi mantradarśiṣvṛpiśabdaḥ prasiddhaḥ, tathāpi
pravarādyāyapaṭhitānāme grahaṇamiti darśayati | vasiṣṭhasya vyākhyāna iti
| vasiṣṭhena dṛṣṭo mantra upacārād vasiṣṭha ityuktaḥ |
vāsiṣṭhī ṛgiti bhavārthe'ṇ, evakāraḥ sarvavākyānāṃ
sāvadhāraṇatvajñāpanārthaḥ ||
pauroḍāśapuroḍāśātṣṭhan || 4|3|70 ||
puroḍāśāḥ piṣṭapiṇḍā iti | ṭhdāśrṛ dāne' karmaṇi ghañ, puro
dāśyante dīyanta iti puroḍāśāḥ, pṛṣodarāditvātsamāsaḥ,
dakārasya ca ḍakāraḥ, etenaitadāha---ākṛtivacanaḥ puroḍāśaśabdaḥ, na
yūpāhavanīyādivadadṛṣṭanimita iti | teṣāṃ saṃskārako mantra iti |
ṭhmakhasya śiro'si' ityevamādiḥ | puroḍāśasahacarito mantraḥ
puroḍāśa iti | mantra eva hi vyākhyātavyo na puroḍāśaḥ ||
cchandaso yadaṇau || 4|3|71 ||
atra bhavavyākhyānau dvāvarthau, yadaṇau pratyayāvapi dvāveva, tathāpi
yathāsaṃkhyaṃ na bhavati; ṭhtasya vyākhyāne' iti yadaṇau bhavataḥ, ṭhtatra
bhavaḥ' iti cetyevaṃ samuccayāt | dvyaca iti ṭhaki prāpta iti |
utarasūtre dvyajgrahaṇena ṭhaki prāpta ityarthaḥ ||
dvyajadabrāhmaṇarkaprathamādhvarapuraścaraṇanāmākhyātāṭ ṭhak || 4|3|72
||
aṇāderapavāda iti | ādiśabdena ṭhañaḥ | tatra ṛkcchabdhe dvyakṣu
cāṇo'pavādaḥ, puraścaraṇaśabdo'pi lyuḍantaḥ
kṛdutarapadaprakṛtisvareṇa madhyodātaḥ | asipratyayo hi
saptamyantādutpadyata iti puraḥ śabdaḥ kārakam, ṭhpuro'vyayam' iti
vā gatiḥ | tena tasmādapyaṇa evāpavādaḥ | brāhmaṇādiṣvantodāteṣu
ṭhaño'pavādaḥ, ṛkārānteṣvapyaṇo'pavādaḥ | ye tu tatra
bahvaco'ntodātāsteṣu paratvādayaṃ ṭhañaṃ bādhate | nāmākhyātagrahaṇaṃ
saṅghātavigṛhītārthamiti | ākhyātārthaṃ vigṛhītagrahaṇam,
nāmaśabdātu dvyactvādeva siddham ||
aṇṛgayanādibhyaḥ || 4|3|73 ||
ṭhañāderiti | ādiśabdena ṭhakaḥ cchasya ca grahaṇam | tatra
vidyānyāyaśikṣāśabdebhyo dvyajlakṣaṇasya ṭhako'pavādaḥ,
vyākaraṇaśabdād vṛddhācchasya, śeṣā bahvaco'ntodātāḥ, teṣvañaḥ |
athāṇgrahaṇaṃ kimartham, na ṛgayanādibhyo yathāvihitamevocyeta,
vacanaprāmāṇyādyo vihito na ca prāpnoti anyena bādhitatvāt, sa
evāṇ bhaviṣyati ? ata āha--aṇgrahaṇamiti | asatyaṇgrahaṇe yad
vṛddhamantodātaṃ bahvaca, yathā---bāstuvidyeti, tasmād vṛddhācche
ṭhañā bādhite punarvacanāccha eva syād, aṇgrahaṇātvaṇeva bhavati |
ṛgayanamiti | ṭhpūrvapadātsaṃjñāyāmagaḥ' iti ṇatvaṃ na bhavati, ṭhagaḥ'
iti pratiṣedhāt | ayanaśabdaśca bhāvasādhano'bhedopacārād granthe
vartate, ṭhano bhāva karmavacane' ityantodātaḥ | padavyākhyānaśabdaḥ
ṭhmanktinvyākhyāna' ityantodātaḥ | cchandomānaśabda ṛgayanaśabdena
vyākhyātaḥ | cchando bhāveti kṛtsvareṇāntodātaḥ |
chandovicitiśabdo manktinnityantodātaḥ |
punaruktaśabdasthāthādisvareṇa | niruktaśabdaḥ
ṭhsaṃjñāyāmanācitādīnām' iti | nigamaśabdo gocarādisūtre
ghānto nipātito'ntodātaḥ | vāstuvidyā, kṣatravidyā, aṅgavidyeti
samāsasvareṇa | utpātotpādaśabdau thāthādisvareṇa | aśeḥ saran,
vaseḥ sampūrvācciditi saṃvatsaraśabdo'ntodātaḥ |
muhūrtanimitaśabdau prātipadikasvareṇa | upanipūrvātsadeḥ kvip,
upaniṣacchabdaḥ kṛtsvareṇāntodātaḥ ||
tata āgataḥ || 4|3|74 ||
tata iti mukhyaṃ yadapādānaṃ vivakṣitaṃ tadiha gṛhyata iti |
mukhyatvādeva | apādānasaṃjñā tu nāntarīyakasyāpi bhavati,
kārakaprakaraṇe hi gauṇamukhyavibāgo nāśrīyate ||
ṭhagāyasthānebhyaḥ || 4|3|75 ||
āya iti svāmigrāhyae bhāga iti | etyenaṃ svāmī, svāmināṃ
vā'yametīti kṛtvā ||
śuṇḍikādibhyo'ṇ || 4|3|76 ||
āyasthānaṭhako'pavāda iti | upalakṣaṇametat | kṛkaṇaśabdāt
ṭhkṛkaṇaparṇādbhāradvāje' iti cchasyāpyapavādaḥ | tīrthaśabdād
dhūmādilakṣasya vuño'pyapavādaḥ | udapānaśabdādutsādyaño'pyapavādaḥ |
athāṇgrahaṇaṃ kimarthaṃ na śiṇḍikādibhyo yathāvihitamevocyeta,
vacanasāmardhyāddhi, yo vihito na ca prāpnoti anyena
bādhitatvāt, sa evāṇ bhaviṣyati ? ata āha---aṇgrahaṇamiti |
udapānaśabda iha paṭha|lte, sa cotsādiḥ tatrāsatyaṇgrahaṇe
āyasthānaṭhakaṃbādhitvā ṭhutsādibhyo'ñ' ityañeva syāt |
aṇgrahaṇātveṇeva bhavati ||
vidyāyonisambandhebhyo vuñ || 4|3|77 ||
vidyāyonikṛta iti | bahuvrīhau gatārthatvātkṛtaśabdasyāprayogaḥ ||
ṛtaṣṭhañ || 4|3|78 ||
eṣūdāharaṇeṣu ṭhisusuktāntātkaḥ' | evaṃ ca prakriyālāghavāya kañevāyaṃ
vidheyaḥ, tathā tu na kṛtamityeva || 
pituryacca || 4|3|79 ||
pitryamiti | ṭhrīṇḥótaḥ', ṭhyasyeti ca' |
gotrādaṅkavat || 4|3|80 ||
ṛṅgagrahaṇena tasyedamityarthasāmānyaṃ lakṣyata iti | kathaṃ mukhye
sambhavati lakṣaṇāśrīyate ? vyākhyānamatra śaraṇam | apara āha---aṅke
yad dṛṣṭṃa tadatidiśyate, na tvaṅka āhatya vihitam |
ṭhgotracaraṇād vuñ' ityayamapi vuñ tasyedamiti sāmānye
vihito'pyañādivyatirikte viṣaye'ṅke'pi dṛṣṭa iti
tasyāpyatideśa iti | aupagavakamiti | vuña udāharaṇam |
aṇastu---vaidam, gārgyam, dākṣamiti | vatiḥ sarvasādṛśyārthaḥ,
ṭhkālebhyo bhavavat', ṭhcaraṇebhyo dharmavat' iti yathā ||
hetumanuṣyebhyo'nyatarasyāṃ rūpyaḥ || 4|3|81 ||
samādāgatamiti | samāddhetorāgatamityartaḥ | tatra ṭhhetau' iti
tṛtīyā prāpnoti, jñāpakatsiddham, yadayaṃ pañcamyantāddhetoḥ
pratyayamāha tajjñāpayati---bhavati hetau pañcamiti | naitadasti
jñāpakam, yatra ṭhvibhāṣā guṇe' iti pañcamī,
tadarthametatsyāt---jāḍa|ladāgata iti ? tasmāt ṭhvibhāṣā guṇe'
ityatra vibhāṣeti yogavibhāgādaguṇavacanādapi pañcamī bhavati ||
mayaṭ ca || 4|3|82 ||
yogavibhāgo yathāsaṃkhyanirāsārtha iti | vikalpārthenānyatarasyāṃ
grahaṇena rūpyamayaṭoḥ pakṣe'bhāvaḥ pratipādyate, tadabhāve svaśāstreṇaiva
prāptaḥ pratyayo bhavati | tena rūpyamayaṭorevānena vidhānādasati
yogavibhāge syādeva yathāsaṅkhyamiti bhāvaḥ ||
prabhavati || 4|3|83 ||
prākāśate iti | utpattivacanastu prabhavatirna gṛhyate; ṭhtatra jātaḥ'
ityanena gatatvāt||
vidūrāññyaḥ || 4|3|84 ||
ayukto'yaṃ nirdeśa ityāha---nanu ceti |
vālavāyo vidūraṃ ceti | vālavāyaśabdaḥ pratyayamutpādayati,
vidūraṃ cādeśamāpādyate, sūtre tvādeśa eva nirdiṣṭaḥ, tenānurūpaḥ
sthānī vālavāyaśabda ākṣipyate, yathā---śivādiṣu
viśravaṇaravaṇetyādeśābhyāṃ paṭhitābhyāṃ viśravaḥ śabdaḥ |
prakṛtyantarameva veti | vidūraśabdo nagarasyeva parvatasyāpi
vācakaḥ, sa evātra prakṛtirityarthaḥ | na vai tatreti cediti |
cecchabdo'kṣamāyām, parvatavācī vidūraśabdo na prasiddha iti ced
brūyātsa jitvarīvadupacāret u vyavaharet, yathā---vaṇija eva
maṅgalārtha vārāṇasīṃ jitvarīti vyavaharanti, evaṃ vaiyākaraṇā eva
vālavāyaṃ vidūramupacaranti | niyatapuruṣāpebhāpi
prasiddhirbhavatītyarthaḥ |
tadgacchati pathidūtayoḥ || 4|3|85 ||
prāptiphale parispande gamirvartate, na ca pathaḥ parispando'sti
tasmātpuruṣavarti gamanaṃ pathyupacaryata ityāha---tatstheṣviti |
athaveti | prāptāvapi gamirvarvate, yathā devabhūyaṅgata iti ||
abhiniṣkrāmati dvāram || 4|3|86 ||
dvāramabhiniṣkamaṇakriyāyāmiti |
anenaitadāha---tatstheṣvabhiniṣkrāmatsu karaṇabhūte dvāre
tadāropād dvāramevābhiniṣkrāmatītyucyata iti | abhiniṣkramaṇaṃ
dvāramiti noktam ; taditi dvitīyādhikārāt, tadā hi
kṛdyogalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhī prāpnoti ||
adhikṛtya kṛte granthe || 4|3|87 ||
ākhyāyikābhya iti | tādarthye caturthī, ākhyāyikāugadyagranthaprabhedaḥ,
tadabhidhānāya yaḥ pratyaya utpannastasya barulaṃ lub bhavatītyarthaḥ | na
cedaṃ vaktavyam, abhedopacāreṇa tācchabdyalābhād abhidhānalakṣaṇatvācca
kvacitaddhita utpadyate, kvacinna ||
śiśukrandayamasabhadvandvendrajananādibhyaścchaḥ || 4|3|88 ||
indrajananādirākṛtigaṇa iti | tena ṭhviruddhabhojanīyamadhyāyaṃ
vyākhyāsyāmaḥ' iti siddhaṃ bhavati ||
so'sya nivāsaḥ || 4|3|89 ||
iha yasya srughno nivāsaḥ srughne'sau bhavati, tataḥ ṭhtatra bhavaḥ' ityeva
siddham, śabdārthabhedātu pṛthagupādānam ||
abhijanaśca || 4|3|90 ||
abhijanāḥ pūrvabāndhavā iti | abhijāyate tebhya iti kṛtvā,
pūrvabāndhavāḥupitrādayaḥ | bandhuśabdaḥ prajñādiḥ |
tatsanbandhādeśo'pīti | yathā yaṣṭisambandhādyaṣṭiśabdaḥ puruṣe
vartate, tathābhijanaśabdo deśe | kaḥ punarasau deśaḥ ? ityāha
yasminniti | tadihetyādi | taditi vākyopanyāse | kathaṃ
punarmukhye'bhijane sambhavati gauṇātpratyayo bhavati ?
ityāha---nivāsapratyāsateriti | pratyāsannenānantarasannihitena
nivāsaśabdenābhijanasya viśeṣaṇādityarthaḥ | iha hi nivāse
yo'bhijana iti viśeṣite, tasmād deśavācina eva pratyayaḥ |
nivāsābhijanayoḥ ko viśeṣa iti | abhijanasyāpi nivāsabhūtasya
grahaṇānnāstyeva viśeṣa ityarthaḥ | tatreti | yatra svayaṃ nivasati sa
tasya nivāsaḥ | yatra tu pūrvaiḥ pitrādibhiruṣitaṃ so'bhijana ityarthaḥ |
āyudhajīvibhyaśccha parvate || 4|3|91 ||
āyudhajīvibhya iti tādarthye caturthītyādi | yadi tu
ṭhāyudhajīvibhyaḥ' iti pañcamīsyāt, parvatāditi lyablope pañcamī
vyākhyeyā syāt, tataścāyamarthaḥ syāt āyudhajīvibhyaḥ
parvatamuddiśya parvate'bhidheye chāe bhavatīti, tatra so'bhijana
ityadhikāro bādhyate ||
śaṇḍikādibhyo ñyaḥ || 4|3|92 ||
aṇāaderapavāda iti | ādiśabdena chādeḥ | tatra yadi śaṇḍikādayaḥ
parvataśabdāḥ, tataḥ pūrveṇa cchaḥ prāptaḥ; atha janapadaśabdāḥ, tato
ṭhavṛddhādapi bahuvacanaviṣayāt' iti vuñ,
śaṇḍikāśabdātkopadhādaṇ prāptaḥ ||
sindhutakṣaśilādibhyo'ṇañau || 4|3|93 ||
sindhuvarṇuprabhṛtaya iti | prabhṛtiśabdena madhumata, kamboja, sālva,
kaśmīra, gandhāra---ityete gṛhyante | kiṣkindhādibhyaścaturbhyaḥ
ṭhavṛddhādapi' iti vuñi prāpte vacanam | takṣaśilādiṣvapi
vṛddhebhyaścchaḥ prāptaḥ, śeṣebhyaḥ ṭhprāgdīvyato'ṇ' ||
acitādadeśakālāṭṭhak || 4|3|96 ||
acitavācina iti | svarūpagrahaṇaṃ tu na bhavati, deśakālapratiṣedhāt
| tatsāhacaryādeśakālayorapi svarūpagrahaṇaṃ na bhavati ||
vāsudevārjunābhyāṃ vun || 4|3|98 ||
chāṇorapavāda iti | ṭhvāsudevaśabdaḥ saṃjñā' iti vakṣyati, tena
tatrotarasya vuño'prāptiḥ | arjunaśabdo'pi yo vṛkṣaviśeṣavacano
vaṇaviśeṣavacano vā, na tatra vuñaḥ prāptiḥ; kṣatriyavacanādapi
bahulavacanād vuño'prāptireveti bhāvaḥ |
nanu cetyādi | vasudevasyāpatyam, ṭhṛṣyandhakavṛṣṇikurubhyaśca'
ityaṇ | na cātreti | na tāvad vṛddhau viśeṣaḥ; prāgeva vṛddhatvāt
| yo'pi ṭhvṛddhinimitasya' iti puṃbadbhāvapratiṣedhaḥ, so'syāpi ṭhna
kopadhāyāḥ' ityasatyeva | saṃjñeṣā devatāviśeṣasyeti |
vasatyasminsarvamiti vyutpatyā paramātmana eṣā saṃjñā | na
kṣatriyākhyeti | upalakṣaṇametatat, nāpi gotrāśakhyetyapi draṣṭavyam
|
prāsaṅgikaṃ prayojanāntaraṃ vāsudevagrahaṇasya
darśayati---ajādyadantam, alpāctaramiti ceti | itikaraṇaḥ
pratyekamabhisambaddhyate | yadyapyetajjñāpyate, tathāpi
ṭhśvayuvamaghonāmataddhite' iti nirdeśātkvacidanyathāpi bhavati ||
gotrakṣatriyākhyebhyo bahulaṃ vuñ || 4|3|99 ||
gotrakṣatriyākhyebhya iti | āṅpūrvātkhyātermūlavibhujāditvātkaḥ |
ākhyāgrahaṇamiti | āṅpūrvasya khyātegrahaṇamityarthaḥ |
yathākathañciditi | kṣatriyaśabdasāmānādhikaraṇyādyeṣāṃ kṣatriye
vṛttiḥ, yathā---śūraḥ kṣatriya iti, tebhyo mū bhūdityarthaḥ ||
janapadināṃ janapadavatsarvaṃ janapadena samānaśabdānāṃ bahuvacane ||
4|3|100 ||
janapadinām janapadivācināṃ śabdānām janapadavat
janapadavācināṃ śabdānāmiva, janapadena janapadavācinā śabdena,
samānaśabdānām samanaśrutīnām, bahuvacane bahvarthābhidhāne |
vṛterapyeṣa evārthaḥ | pratyayaḥ prakṛtiśceti | anena sarvaśabdasyārtho
darśitaḥ | janapadino janapadasvāmina iti | svasvāmibhāvasambandhe
matvarthīyaṃ darśayati | aṅgā janapadā ityādinā dṛṣṭānte
pravṛttiprakāramāha | tadvadityādinā tūdāharaṇam | sarvatra
bahuṣvartheṣu ṭhdvyañmagadha' ityādinā vihitasyāṇaḥ ṭhtadrājasya
bahuṣu' iti luki kṛte samānaśabdādavṛddhādapi bahuvacaneti vuñi
vivakṣite ṭhgotre'lugaci' iti vacanādāṅgaśabdād vuñ |
pañcālā brāhmaṇā iti | abhedopavārād brāhmaṇeṣu pañcālaśabdasya
vṛttiḥ, tatrātidheśābhāvādaṇeva bhavati |
sarvagrahaṇamityādi | asati sarvagrahaṇe prādhānyātpratyayasyaivātideśaḥ
syāt, na prakṛteḥ | vatinirdeśastu yairjanapadairye janapadinasteṣāṃ
tajjanapadapratyaya eva yathā syāt, janapadāntarapratyayo mā
bhūdityevamarthaṃ syāt | na tvenana prakṛtyatideśo labhyate,
tasmātadarthaṃ sarvagrahaṇaṃ kriyate | sa ca dvyekayoḥ prayojayatīti
pāṭhaḥ | sa ca prakṛtyatideśaḥ sarvagrahaṇaṃ dvyekayoḥ prayojayati, na
bahuṣu; tatra rūpasyā bhinnatvāt | yadāha---ṭhbahuvacane
samānaśabdānām' iti | dvyekayostu janapadavācino rūpaṃ
vṛddham, janapadavācinastvavṛddhamiti tatraiva sarvagrahaṇasya
prayojanamityarthaḥ | atideśaḥ prayojayati, atideśaṃ prayojayatīti
vā pāṭhe na samīcīnamarthaṃ paśyāmaḥ | vṛddhinimiteṣvityādi | tatra
hyatidiṣṭe'pi prakṛtirūpe punarvṛddhyā bhāvyamiti nāsti veśeṣaḥ |
madravṛjyoḥ kati viśeṣa iti | tatra vṛddhyasambhavāt |
prakṛtinirhrāse kṛta iti | nirhrāsaḥuapacayaḥ, alpatvamityarthaḥ | madrakaḥ,
vṛjika iti | asati tu prakṛtyatideśe mādrakako vārjyaka iti
syāt |
bahuvacanagrahaṇamityādi | samānaśabdatāyā yo viṣayastasya lakṣaṇaṃ
pradarśanaṃ tadartham | anyathā hīti | yadi bahuvacanagrahaṇaṃ na kriyate |
yatraiveti | bahuvacane, tatraiva hi tadrājasya luki kṛte
samānaśabdatā bhavati | ekavacanadvivacanayorna syāditi | lugabhāvena
samānaśabdatāyā abhāvāt | nanu sarvagrahaṇaṃ prakṛtyatideśārtham, sa
ca dvyekayoḥ prayojayatītyuktam, tatkathaṃ dvyekayorna syāt ?
tasmāt sarvagrahaṇādhyatra kvacitsamānaśabdānāṃ sarvatrātideśaḥ siddhaḥ
| asyaivārthasya viśpaṣṭapratipatyartham ṭhbahuvacane'
ityupalakṣaṇamupātam ||
tena proktam || 4|3|101 ||
prakarṣeṇoktamiti | adhyāpanenārthavyākhyānena vā
prakarṣeṇāprakāśitamityarthaḥ | prakarṣeṇeti vacanād grāme grāme yadyapi
kāṭhakādikaṃ devadatādibhiḥ procyate, tathāpi tebhyaḥ pratyayo na
bhavati | na tu kṛtamiti | prapūrvo vaciḥ karaṇe'pi vartate iti
bhāvaḥ | madhurāyāṃ bhavo mādhuraḥ, tato vṛddhācche prāpte
ṭhkalāpino'ṇ' ityaṇgrahaṇādadhikavidhānārthādaṇpratyayaḥ |
pāṇinīyamiti | svayamanyena vā kṛtaṃ yatpāṇininā proktaṃ
taducyate ||
titirivaratantukhaṇḍikokhācchaṇ || 4|3|102 ||
cchandasi cāyamiṣyata iti | cchandasyabhidheya ityarthaḥ | titiriṇā proktaḥ
śloka ityatra na bhavatīti | na kevalaṃ cchaṇeva, api tvaṇapi na
bhavatyanabhidhānādityāhuḥ | kathaṃ punariṣyamāṇo'pi cchandasi labhyaḥ ?
ityāha---śaunakādibhya iti |
kāsyapakauśikābhyāmṛṣibhyāṃ ṇiniḥ || 4|3|103 ||
ṇakāra utaratra vṛddhyartha iti | iha tu pūrvameva vṛddhe siddhatvāt |
yo'pi ṭhvṛddhinimitasya' iti puṃvadbhāvapratiṣedhaḥ, so'pi na
prayojanam, ṇinyantasyādhyetṛveditṛviṣayatvena striyāmavṛteḥ |
vṛtāvapi ṭhjāteśca' iti siddhatvāt, caraṇatvena jātitvāt |
