tasyāpi ceti | kathaṃ cchandobrāhmaṇānāmucyamānā tadviṣayatā kalpasya
bhavati ? tatrāha---śaunakādibhya iti | nanu ca tatrānuvṛtau
satyāmapyasya yogasya na kalpaḥ cchando bhavati, nāpi brāhmaṇam ? ata
āha---cchando'dhikāravihitānāṃ ceti | ṭhcchandobrāhmaṇāni' ityatra
cchandograhaṇaṃ svaryate, tatra svaritenādhikārāvagatirbhavatīti cchandaḥ
prakaraṇamadhyapātino'syāpi ṇinestadviṣayatā bhavatītyarthaḥ | yatu
ṭhcchandobrāhmaṇāni' ityatra cakārasyānuktasamuccayārthatvamāśritya
kalpādestadviṣayatvapratipādanam, tatprakārāntaraṃ draṣṭavyam |
idānīntanena gotrakāśyapeneti | na hyasāvṛṣiḥ; amantradarśitvāt ||
kalāpivaiśampāyanāntevāsibhyaśca || 4|3|104 ||
kalāpyantevāsināmityādi | sūtre tvabhedopacārāśrayo nirdeśaḥ |
kalāpyantevāsinaścatvāra ityādi | nanu ca śiṣyaśiṣyeṣvapi
śiṣyavyavahāro loke dṛśyate, tatkathamiyanta eveti niyamaḥ ?
tatrāhapratyakṣakāriṇa iti | kriyāsāmānyavacanaḥ karotiḥ
prakaraṇāadihādhyayane vartate | kalāpikhāṇḍāyanagrahaṇāditi | etadeva
vivṛṇoti---tathā hīti | vaiśampāyanasyāntevāsī kalāpī, yadi
cāntevāsyantevāsino'pi gṛhyaeran, kalāpigrahaṇamanarthakam,
ṭhvaiśampāyanāntevāsibhyaḥ' ityeva siddham ; kalāpyantevāsināmapi
vaiśampāyanāntevāsitvāt | tathā vaiśampāyanāntevāsī kaṭhaḥ,
kaṭhāntevāsī khāṇḍāyanaḥ, tatra vyavahitānāmapi grahaṇe
vaiśampāyanāntevāsitvādanenaiva siddhe śaunakādiṣu
khāṇḍāyanaśabdasya pāṭho niṣphalaḥ syāt | udāharaṇeṣu
cchandobrāhmaṇānīti tadviṣayatā, adhyetṛpratyayasya ṭhproktālluk' iti
luk |
ulapena caturtheneti | sahayoge tṛtīyā | kalāpina idaṃ
kālāpakam, ṭhgotracaraṇād vuñ' | tatra ṭhdharmāmnāyayoḥ' iti
paṭha|lte, tasmādihopamānācchiṣyasamūhe prayogaḥ | ālambiścarakaḥ
prācāmiti | ālambirnāma prācāṃ deśa utpannaścarakasya śiṣyaḥ | evaṃ
phaliṅgakamalāvubhau prācāmeva traya ete prācyā uktāḥ | kaṭhakalā
pinoriti | ṭhkaṭhacarakālluk' iti kaṭhālluguktaḥ |
kalāpiśabdādapi ṭhkalāpino'ṇ' tyaṇuktaḥ ||
purāṇaprokteṣu brāhmaṇakalpeṣu || 4|3|105 ||
bhāllavina ityādi | bhallu, śāṭa|layana, aitareya, piṅga, aruṇa,
parāji ityetebhyo ṇiniḥ |
yajñavalkāśmarathaśabdau kaṇvādī, tābhyāṃ yañantābhyāmapi ṭhāpatyasya'
iti yalopaḥ | nanu ca yājñavalkādīnyapi purāṇaproktānyeva,
śāṭa|layanakādibhirbrāhmaṇāntaraistulyakālatvāt ? ityata
āha---yājñavalkyādayo hīti | ākhyānāniubhāratādīni | tayā
vyavaharatīti | arthastu tathā vā bhavatvanyathā veti bhāvaḥ | tadviṣayatā
kasmānna bhavatīti | yājñavalkādiviṣayaḥ praśnaḥ, ṭhcchandobrāhmaṇāni ca'
ityatra purāṇaproktatvaviśeṣasyānāśrayaṇātprāpnotīti bhāvaḥ |
prātapadamiti | etallakṣaṇapratipadoktaparibhāṣayā labhyate | etadarthameva
ca tatra brāhmaṇagraham; cchandastvādeva siddheḥ |
kalpeṣu tarhi kasmānna bhavati yathā---kāśyapinaḥ, kauśikina ityatra ?
ityata āha---na vāyamiti | yuktaṃ tatra cchando'dhikāre tasya
yogasyānuvṛteḥ, ayaṃ tu na tatheti kalpeṣvapi tadviṣayatā na
bhavatītyarthaḥ | na cātyantabādhaiveti | ṭhsiddhaśuṣkapakvabandhaiśca' iti
nipātanādeva siddhe, ṭhśuṣaḥ kaḥ' ṭhpaco vaḥ' iti
liṅgam---ṭhbādhakānyapi nipātanāni bhavanti' iti | yathā tu
sarvādisūtre ṭhbhāṣyam, tathā ṭhanyaparāṇyapi nipātanāni
bādhakānyeva' iti sthitam ||
kalāpino'ṇ || 4|3|108 ||
yathāvihitamevocyeteti | tatra vacanasāmarthyādyo vihito na ca
prāpnoti sa evāṇ bhaviṣyatīti bhāvaḥ | evamādīnīti | ādiśabdena
maudāḥ, paippalādāḥ, śākalā ityeteṣāṃ grahaṇam| atra
muda-pippalādaḥśākalya---ityetebhyaḥ ṭhpurāṇaprokteṣu' iti
ṇinerapavādo'ṇbhavati ||
pārāśaryaśilālibhyāṃ bhikṣunaṭasūtrayoḥ || 4|3|110 ||
tadarthaṃ cchandograhaṇamanuvartyamiti | nanu tadanuvṛtāvapi kathaṃ
bhikṣunaṭasūtrayoścchandastvam ? tatrāha---guṇakalpanaya ceti |
upacārasya nimitabhūto dharmo guṇo guruśuśrūpaṇādiḥ, tannimitā
kalpanā guṇakalpanā | pārāśariṇa iti | pūrvavadyalopaḥ | śailālina
iti | śilāmalate iti śilālī, ṭhalaṃ bhūpaṇaparyāptivāraṇeṣu'
ityetasmāt ṭhsupyajāto' iti ṇiniḥ, tato'smin ṇinau
ṭilopaḥ |
pārāśaramiti | kaṇvādyaṇ | śailālamiti | autsargike'ṇi ṭhnāntasya
ṭilope sabrahmacāri' ityādinā ṭilopaḥ ||
tenaikadik || 4|3|112 ||
saudāmanīti | ṭhan' iti prakṛtibhāvaḥ |
sudāmādayaḥuparvataviśeṣāḥ ||
tasiśca || 4|3|113 ||
svarādipāṭhādavyayatvamiti | tasminnevārthe vidhaiiyamānasyāpyasya
liṅgasaṃkhyānupādānamapi svābhāvikaṃ veditavyam ||
upajñāte || 4|3|115 ||
vinopadeśena jñātamupajñātamiti | upapūrvo jānātistatra prasiddha
iti bhāvaḥ | akālakamiti |
ānyāyyādutthānādityādikālaparibhāṣārahitamityarthaḥ | gurulāghavaṃ
nāmārthaśāstram, yatropāyānāṃ gauravaṃ lāghavaṃ cintyate | ṭhdūṣū'
ityayaṃ saṅketaśabdo yatra kriyate, yathā pāṇinīye ṭhvṛt' iti,
tad duṣkaraṇaṃ vyākaraṇam; kāmaśāstramityanye ||
kṛte granthe || 4|3|116 ||
ṭhtitirivaratantu' ityādīni sūtrāṇyatra prakaraṇe na paṭhitāni |
titiryādayo hi cchandasāṃ pravaktāro na kartāraḥ; nityāni hi
cchandāṃsi na kenacitkriyante ||
saṃjñāyām || 4|3|117 ||
agranthārthamidam ||
kṣudrābhramaravaṭarapādapādañ || 4|3|119 ||
aṇo'pavāda iti | bāhulyādevamuktam, pādapaśabdāddhi cchaḥ prāpnoti
| anye tu pādapaśabdasya sthāne padapaśabdaṃ paṭhanti ||
tasyedam || 4|3|120 ||
ṭhtasyā patyam' ityatroktamevārthaṃ
smārayati---prakṛtipratyayārthayorityādi | prakṛtau ṣaṣṭha|lrthamātraṃ
vivakṣitam, pratyayārthe'pi tatsambandhimātraṃ yadyogātṣaṣṭhī,
tasminnibhidheye pratyayaḥ | mātraśabdavyavacchedyaṃ darsayati---yadaparamiti
| idaṃ śabdaḥ pratyakṣavacaṃnaḥ, tacchabdaḥ parokṣavacanaḥ | ādiśabdena
sāmānyābhidhāyitvaṃ gṛhyate | tatsarvamavivakṣitamiti | atra kāraṇam
ṭhtasyāpatyam' ityatraivoktam |
vahesturiti | tṛntṛcoḥ sāmānyena grahaṇam | sāvahitramiti |
ḍhatvādīnāmasiddhatvātpūrvamiheṭi kṛte nimitābhāvāteṣāmabhāvaḥ |
agnīdha iti | agnimindha iti kvip, agnīt ṭhṛtvigviśeṣaḥ |
ṭhtvamagnidṛtīyate' ityatra tuchāndasaṃhrasvatvam | śaraṇamugṛham,
sthānam, yatrāgnīdhrīyaṃ dhiṣṇyaṃ tadāgnīdhram, tātsthyātu mañcāḥ
krośantītivadṛtviji prayogaḥ
kalpasūtrakārāṇām---ṭhpratyāśrāvayedāgrīdhaḥ āgnīdhraṃ potāraṃ brahmaṇaḥ'
iti | cchapratyayaṃ ca tataḥ śaraṇe kurvanti,
ṭhāgnīdhrīyasakāśamutareṇāgnīdhrīyaṃ dhiṣṇyaṃ parītya' iti
śaraṇavacanācchaḥ |
samidhāmādhāna iti | yayā samidhyate'gniḥ sā samit,
sampadāditvātkaraṇe kvip | sā samidādhīyate yayā sā sāmidhenī
ṛk, ṣitvānṅīṣ, ṭhhalastaddhitasya' iti yalopaḥ ||
rathādyat || 4|3|121 ||
rathāṅga eveṣyata iti | yastu rathasya voḍhā rathya iti voḍhari
prayogaḥ, saḥ ṭhtadvahati rathayugaprāsaṅgam' iti draṣṭavyaḥ |
syādetat---ayameva tadvoḍharyapīṣyatām, ṭhtadvahati' ityatra rathagrahaṇaṃ
mā kārīti ? naivaṃ śakyam, iha dvau rathau vahati dvirathya iti
ṭhdvigorluganapatye' iti prāgdīvyatīyo luk prāpnoti | yatu
dvayo rathayoraṅgaṃ tatra dvirathamityeva bhavati ||
patrapūrvādañ || 4|3|122 ||
patantyaneneti patramiti | ṭhdāmnīśasa' ityādinā ṣṭran | aśvayukto
ratho'śvarathaḥ, ṣaṣṭhīsamāse vṛttisvabhāvādyauktārthāvagatiḥ |
tasyāṅgamāśvaratham ||
patrādhvaryupariṣadaśca || 4|3|123 ||
pattretyarthagrahaṇamitarayoḥ svarūpagrahaṇam | vyākhyānaṃ cātra śaraṇam
||
dvandvād vun vairamaithunikayoḥ || 4|3|125 ||
vairam u virodhaḥ, vīrāṇāmidamiti kṛtvā, mithunakarma
maithunikā, manojñāditvād vuñ | mithunam u dampatī, karma u
kriyāniṣpādanam | bābhravaśālaṅkāyaniketi | vuñantaṃ svabhāvataḥ
striyāṃ vartate ||
gotracaraṇād vuñ || 4|3|126 ||
vuni prakṛte vuño vidhānamavṛddheṣu vṛddhyartham | vṛddheṣu vuni
vuñi ca viśeṣo nāsti---tadeva rūpaṃ sa eva svaraḥ,
puṃvadbhāvapratiṣedho'pi ṭhna kopadhāyāḥ' ityabhayorasti ||
saṅghāṅkalakṣaṇeṣvañyañiñāmaṇ || 4|3|127 ||
pūrvasya yuño'pavāda iti | gotragrahaṇānuvṛterajādīnāṃ
gotrapratyayānāmatra grahaṇamiti bhāvaḥ |
ghoṣagrahaṇamatra kartavyamiti | ghoṣaḥ u ābhīrasthānam, tatrapi pratyayo
yathā syādityevamartham | ghoṣagrahaṇasyānuṣaṅgikaṃ
prayojanāntaramāha---tena vaiṣamyāditi |
athāṅkalakṣaṇayoḥ ko viśeṣa iti || nighaṇṭuaṣu paryāyatayā
pāṭhānnāstyeva viśeṣa ityarthaḥ |
pṛthugupādānasāmarthyādviśeṣo'trāśrīyatām ? ityāha---lakṣaṇaṃ
lakṣyasyaiveti | svamātmīyaṃ sambandhītyarthaḥ | bedī vidyā asyeti |
bidānāmasādhāraṇī yā vidyā sā yasyāsti sa baidīvidyaḥ ||
śākalādvā || 4|3|128 ||
vuño'pavāda iti | śākalaśabdasya caraṇaśabdatvāt,
taddarśayati---śākalena proktamiti ||
cchandogaukthikayājñikabahvṛcanaṭāññyaḥ || 4|3|129 ||
vuñaṇorapavāda iti | caraṇaśabdebhyo vuño'pavādaḥ,
naṭādautsargikasyāṇaḥ ||
na daṇḍamāṇavāntevāsiṣu || 4|3|130 ||
daṇḍaprādhānā māṇavā iti | arthakathanametat samāsastu karmadhārayaḥ |
sadā daṇḍadhāraṇāddaṇḍaśabdo māṇaveṣu vartate ||
raivatikādibhyaścchaḥ || 4|3|131 ||
pūrveṇeti | ṭhgotracaraṇād vuñ' ityanena raivatikīya iti |
revatyā apatyam ṭhrevatyādibhyaṣṭhak' raivatikaḥ, tataścchaḥ | anye
iñantāḥ, tatrānantarasūtrātpratiṣedho'nuvartiṣyate, raivatikādibhyo
vuñaḥ pratiṣedhe vijñāyamāne yatrāpavādo nāsti---raivatīkīya iti,
tatra ṭhvṛddhācchaḥ' ityeva siddhaḥ; kṣemavṛddhiśabdadapi gahāditvācchaḥ;
anyeṣu ṭhiñaśca' ityaṇ syāt, tasmācchagrahaṇam ||
kaupiñjalahāstipadādaṇ || 4|3|132 ||
gotravuño'pavāda iti | kuta ityāha---gotrādhikārāditi |
kaupiñjala iti | kupiñjalasyāpatyam, asmādeva nipātanādaṇ,
tadantātpunaraṇ | hāstipada iti | hastina iva pādāvasya hastipādaḥ,
pādasya lopo na bhavati; ṭhahastyādibhya' iti vacanāt |
hastipādasyāpatyam ṭhtasyāpatyam' iti asmādeva nipātanādaṇ,
padbhāvaśca, hāstipadasyedam, punaraṇ | athāṇgrahaṇaṃ kimartham ?
asatyaṇgrahaṇe'nantaraścchaḥ prāpnoti | siddho'tra cchaḥ ṭhvṛddhācchaḥ' iti ?
na siddhyati; ṭhgotracaraṇād vuñ' iti vuñprāpnoti | evaṃ
tarhi yadyetābhyāṃ ccha iṣṭaḥ syāt, raivatikādiṣvemevau paṭhet, evaṃ
hi vibhaktyanuccāraṇāllāghavaṃ bhavati | tasmātpṛthagārambhādeva chāe na
bhaviṣyati | anyastu yo vihito na ca prāpnoti sa eva bhaviṣyati, sa
cāṇeva | evaṃ tarhyasatyaṇgrahaṇe yatra vuñ prāptaḥ pratiṣidhyate, na
daṇḍamāṇavāntevāsiṣu, tatra vuño
vidhānārthametatsyātasmādaṇgrahaṇaṃ kartavyam | ṇitkaraṇaṃ ṅībartham,
puṃvadbhāvapratiṣedhārthaṃ ca---kaupiñjalī kriyā asya kaupiñjalīkriya
iti ||
ātharvaṇikasyekalopaśca || 4|3|133 ||
caraṇavuño'pavāda iti | atharvaṇā prokto
vedo'bhedopacārādatharvā, tamadhīte
vasantāditvāṭhaṭhak,---ātharvaṇikaḥ, dāṇḍināyanādisūtre
nipātanāṭṭilopābhāvaḥ | atha vā---atharvaṇā prokto vedaḥ ṭhtena
proktam' ityaṇ tataḥ ṭhcchandobrāhmaṇāni' iti
tadviṣayatāyāmātharvaṇaśabdasyāpi vasantādiṣu pāṭhādadhyetari ṭhak,
tasya vidhānasāmarthyāt ṭhproktālluk' iti lugna
bhavati---ātharvaṇikaḥ |
purvasūtramidañca vārtike darśanātsūtreṣu prakṣiptam ||
tasya vikāraḥ || 4|3|134 ||
prakṛteriti | upādānakāraṇasya | avasthāntaramiti anyathātvam |
apavādenānākrāntasya viṣayasya durlabhatvātpraśnaḥ |
kimihodāharaṇamiti | aprāṇīti | prāṇibhyo'ñaṃ vakṣyati |
ādyaudātamiti | anudātāderapyañaṃ vakṣyati | avṛddhamiti |
vṛddhānmayaṭṃa vakṣyati | yasya ca nānyaditi | yathā ṭhgopayasoryat'
iti | nitsvareṇeti | aśmabhasmaśabdau maninpratyayāntau |
ṭhmṛdastikan', mṛtikā |
tasya prakaraṇe iti | ṭhtasyedam' ityasmin | punarvacana
śaiṣikanivṛtyarthamiti | prakṛtaṃ hi tasyagrahaṇaṃ śaiṣikairghādibhiḥ
sambaddham, atastadanuvṛtau te'pyanuvarteran, idaṃ tvapūrvaṃ tasya
grahaṇaṃ kriyāmāṇaṃ ghādisambaddhasya tasyagrahaṇasya nivartakaṃ ghādīnapi
nivartayati | nanu ca vidheyatayā pradhānabhūtā ghādayaḥ, na te
guṇabhūte tasyagrahaṇe nivartamāne'pi nivartitumarhanti, na hi
guṇānuvarti pradhānam, kiṃ tarhi ? pradhānānuvartī guṇaḥ ? satyam ;
tasya grahaṇasāmarthyātpradhānabhūtānāmapi ghādīnāṃ nivṛttiḥ,
aṇāadayastu nanivartante, ṭhprāgdīvyataḥ' ṭhprāgbhavānāt' iti ca
viśiṣṭāvadhiparicchedenādhikṛtatvāt | vikārāvayavayoriti |
parastātu prāgvahateḥ ṭhprāgghitāt' iti
cādhikārāntareṇāvaṣṭabdhatvādeva ghādīnāṃ nivṛttiḥ siddheti bhāvaḥ |
syādetat--mā bhūvannanena ghādayaḥ, tasya grahaṇena nivartitatvāt ;
ṭhtasyedam' ityanena tu prāpnuvanti,
tasyedaṃviśeṣatvādvikārāvayayavayoriti ? tanna; ṭhtasyedam' ityeva
vikārāvayavayoraṇādiṣu siddheṣu panasteṣāṃ vidhānaṃ śaiṣikāṇāṃ
bādhanārthameva | kiṃ tarhyucyate---tasyeti punarvacanaṃ
śaiṣikanivṛtyarthamiti, yāvatā sūtraprakṛtireva śaiṣikanivṛtyarthā
? satyam ; tasya grahaṇe tvasati sūtrapravṛttiḥ śaiṣikānapi
viṣayīkuryāditi tasyagrahaṇasyaivāyaṃ bhāraḥ yaduta vai śaiṣikā
nivartante | hālaḥ saira iti | halaśabdaḥ ṭhnavviṣayasyānisantasya'
ityādyaudātaḥ | sīraśabdaḥ kanpratyayāntatvānnitsvareṇādyaudātaḥ, nātra
vakṣyamāṇasyāpavādasya kasyacitprasaṅga ityaṇbhavati |
idaṃ ca yogavibhāgenāṇādividhānasya prayojanaṃ darśitam | yadi hi
ṭhtasya vikāraḥ' ṭhbilvādibhyo'ṇ' ityevāpavādavidhānārthamucyeta,
tato halasya vikāra ityatra ṭhtasyedam' ityanena pratyayo vidhātavyaḥ,
tataścāṇaṃ bādhitvā ṭhhalasīrāṭṭhak' iti ṭhak prāpnoti,
tathānyasmistasyedaṃviśeṣe; yogavibhāgena tvaṇādīnāṃ
vidhānādaṇeva bhavati, tasyagrahaṇe tu ghādīnāṃ nivṛttiḥ prayojanam
| vṛjīnāṃ vikāro vārja iti, vṛjiśabdasya phiṭsūtreṣu
vikalpenāntodātatvavidhānātpakṣe ādyaudātatvādaṇ | yadi tvatra
ṭhtasyedam' ityaṇpratyayaḥ syāt; yadi vānena ghādayo vidhīyeran
tato madravṛjyoḥ kanniti kansyāt | tathā trigartānāṃ vikāraḥ
traigarta iti, trigartaśabdo bahuvrīhipūrvapadaprakṛtisvareṇādyaudātaḥ,
atra prathamaḥ ṭhprāgdīvyato'ṇ' prāptaḥ, janapadalakṣaṇo vuñ dvitīyaḥ,
gartotarapadalakṣaṇaścchastṛtīyaḥ, tadavadhigrahaṇena vihito vuñ
caturthaḥ; anena tvaṇeva bhavati | yathā raṃkūṇāṃ vikāro rāṅkava
iti---atra ṭhprāgdīvyatoṇ' prathamaḥ, tadapavādayoḥ ṭhavṛddhādapi' iti
ṭhordeaśeṭhañ' iti vuñṭhañostulyakakṣayoranyataro dvitīyaḥ,
ṭhkopadhādaṇ' iti vā kacchādipāṭhādvā'ṇtṛtīyaḥ,
ṭhmanuṣyatatsthayorvuñ' caturthaḥ; anena tvaṇ prāpta orañā
bādhitaḥ ṭhkopadhācca' iti pratiprasūyate | yadi tarhi
vikārāvayavayorghādayo na bhavanti pāṭaliputrasyāvayavāḥ
pāṭaliputrakāḥ prāsādā dati, ṭhtasyedam' ityatrārthe ṭhropadhetoḥ
prācām' iti vuñna prāpnoti ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; prāṇyoṣadhivṛkṣebhyo
hi ghādīnāmavayave nivṛttiḥ, tatra kaḥ prasaṅgo
yadaprāṇyoṣadhivṛkṣebhyo'vayave nivṛttiḥ syāt ! ||
avayave ca prāṇyoṣadhivṛkṣebhyaḥ || 4|3|135 ||
maurvamiti | mūrvāśabdaḥ ṭhtṛṇadhānyānāṃ ca dvyaṣām' ityādyaudātaḥ
| khadiramiti | khādeḥ khadiraśabdaḥ kiracpratyayānto nipātitaḥ,
tenānudātādilakṣaṇo vuñ prāpnoti | yadi tvaṇiṣyate,
bilvādiṣu paṭhitavyaḥ |
kṛtanirdeśau hi tāviti | ṭhtasyedam' ityanena | yadyapi
śaiṣikanivṛtyarthatvaṃ pūrvayogasya prayojanamuktam, tathāpi
tadanapekṣya bhāsmanam, mārtikamityādau tāvadaṇādayaḥ siddhā
ityabhisandhāyedamuktam || 
bilvādibhyo'ṇ || 4|3|136 ||
añmayaṭorapavāda iti | tatra kāṇḍa-pāṭalīśabdābhyāṃ vṛddhalakṣaṇasya
mayaṭo'pavādaḥ, śeṣebhyastvanudātādilakṣaṇasyāñaḥ, bilvaśabdasya
ṭhvilvatiṣyorvāntaḥ svaritaḥ' ityantaḥ svaritaḥ, udāto vā |
vrīhimudgaśabdau ghṛtāditvādantodātau |
masūra-godhūma-gavīdhukaśabdāḥ ṭhlaghāvante dvayāśca' iti madhyodātāḥ
| iṣeḥ ksaḥ, ikṣuḥ, pratyayasvareṇāntodātaḥ | veṇuśabdaḥ ṭhvibhāṣā
veṇvindhānayoḥ' iti pakṣe'ntodātaḥ | karpāsīśabdo
jātilakṣaṇaṅīṣantaḥ | karkandhūśabdaḥ ṭhalābūkarkkandhūdidhiṣūḥ ' iti
nipātanānmadhyodātaḥ, ṭhkuṭīśamīśuṇḍābhyo raḥ' iti kuṭīraśabdaḥ
pratyayasvareṇāntodātaḥ | mayaḍbādhanārthamiti | ṭhmayaḍvaitayoḥ'
ityādinā prāptasya mayaṭo bādhanārtham, śeṣebhyastvavṛddhebhyaḥ
śabdebhyaḥ pakṣe mayaḍ bhavatyeva | aṇgrahaṇaṃ bādhakabādhanārthaṇ |
bilvādibhyo yathāvihitamityucyamāne'pi hi
pāṭalīśabdānṅīṣantādanudātādilakṣaṇasyāño mayaṭā bādhe prāpte
punarvacanādañeva syāt ; aṇgrahaṇātvaṇeva bhavati |
kopadhācca || 4|3|137 ||
año'pavāda iti | ṭhorañ' ṭhanudātādeśca' iti prāptasya,
titiḍīkādayaḥ ṭhlaghāvante' ityādinā madhyodātāḥ ||
trapujatunoḥ ṣuk || 4|3|138 ||
aprāṇyāditvāditi | prāṇyoṣadhivṛkṣeṣvanyatamatvasyābhāvādityarthaḥ ||
oraña || 4|3|139 ||
devadāru-bhadradāruśabdau ṭhpītadravarthānām' ityādinādyaudātau |
pītadruḥ u saralo navaspatiḥ, pītadrurartho yeṣāṃ
teṣāmādirudāto bhavatītyarthaḥ ||
anudātādeśca || 4|3|140 ||
dādhitthaṃ kāpitthamiti | dadhani tiṣṭhatīti ṭhsupi sthaḥ',
upapadasamāsaḥ, pṛṣodarāditvātsakārasya takāraḥ,
kṛdutarapadaprakṛtisvareṇāntodātatvam |
palāśādibhyo vā || 4|3|141 ||
ubhayatravibhāṣeyamiti | kathamityāha---palāśakhadiretyādi |
palāśaśabdo ghṛtāditvādantodātaḥ | khadiraśabdaḥ ṭhajiraśiśara'
ityādau kiracpratyayānto nipātitaḥ | śiṃśapāśabdo ṭhdvitīyaṃ
prāgīṣāt' iti vartamāne ṭhpāntādīnāṃ gurvādīnām' iti
madhyodātaḥ | ṭhspadi kiñciccalane', ṭhanudātetaśca halādeḥ' iti
yuc, kiraterīran, karīram, ṭhkṛhṛbhyāmīṣan', śṛpṛbhyāṃ
kicca', śirīṣam, śeṣe nitsvareṇādyaudātāvetau |
vikaṅkatamūlāsayavāsaśabdāḥ ṭhgrāmādīnāṃ ca' ityādyaudātāḥ ||
śamyāṣṭlañ || 4|3|142 ||
año'pavāda iti | śamīśabdo gaurādiṅīṣantaḥ | śāmīlī srugiti |
cāturmāsye varuṇapraghāseṣu śamīmayyaḥ sruco bhavantīti śrutam ||
mayaḍvaitayorbhāṣāyāmabhakṣyācchādanayoḥ || 4|3|143 ||
maudgaḥ sūpaḥ, kārpāsamācchādanamiti | ubhayatra bilvādyaṇ,
vikārāvayavayorabhakṣyācchādanayośca yathāsaṃkhyaṃ na bhavati;
vikārāvayavayorasamāsanirdeśena pratyekamabhisambandhāt |
tadviṣaye'pi yathā syāditi | yadyetayoriti nocyeta,
utarairviśeṣapratyayairañādibhiḥ sampradhāraṇāyāṃ paratvāta eva syuḥ,
pūrveṣāṃ viśeṣapratyayānāṃ mayaḍabhāvapakṣe sāvakāśatvānmayaṭpakṣe
paratvānmayaḍeva labhyata iti prāṇirajatādibhyo'ñādaya etyuktam |
ṭhetayoḥ' iti vacanaṃ punarvidhānārthaṃ sampadyata iti pareṣāmapi viṣaye
mayaḍ bhavati ||
nityaṃ vṛddhaśarādibhyaḥ || 4|3|144 || 
nityaṃ mayaṭpratyayo bhavatīti | prāgdīvyatīyānāmapavādaḥ | aṇaṃ tu
kopadhalakṣaṇamañeva paratvādvādhate | śākamayam, āmramayamiti |
āmraśabdaḥ ṭhamitamyordīrghaśca' iti ranpratyayāntaḥ |
tadanena kriyata iti | nityaṃśabdo'tiricyamānaḥ pūrvācāryapaṭhitasya
vākyasya smāraka iti | evaṃ ca mṛcchabdasya śarādiṣu pāṭho'syaiva
prāpañcārtho draṣṭavyaḥ ||
gośca purīṣe || 4|3|145 ||
gavyaṃ paya iti | kathaṃ punaratra prasaṅgaḥ, yāvatā
vikārāvayavayoriti vartate, payaśca na vikāro nāṣayavaḥ ?
tatrāha---purīṣaṃ naṃ vikāra ityādi | akriyamāṇe purīṣagrahaṇe
iṣṭasidhyarthameva ṭhtasyedam' ityadhaikāre ṭhgormayaṭ' iti sūtraṃ
kartavyam, tataścātrāpi prasaṅga ityarthaḥ ||
piṣṭācca || 4|3|146 ||
piṣṭamaṃya bhasmeti || paiṣṭī sureti tu sāmānyavivakṣāyām
ṭhtasyedam' ityaṇ, ṭhpradīyatāṃ dāśarathāya maithilī' itivat ||
asaṃjñāyāṃ tilayavābhyām || 4|3|149 ||
yāvaka iti | yavaśabdādvikāre'ṇ, tadantād ṭhyāvādibhyaḥ' iti
svārthe kan || 
notvadvardhabilvāt || 4|3|151 ||
mauñjamiti | muñjaśabdāt ṭhtṛṇadhānyānāṃ ca dvyaṣām'
ityādyaudātatvādautsargiko'ṇ | gārmutamiti | garmucchabdaḥ
ṭhmṛgrerutiḥ', ṭhgrormuṭ ca' ityutipratyayāntatvādantodāta iti
ṭhanudātādeśca' ityañ | kathaṃ tarhi ṭhtasmā etaṃ gārmutaṃ caruṃ
nirvapet' ityantodātatvam ? sarvavidhīnāṃ cchandasi
vikalpitatvādaṇ bhaviṣyati | vādhrīti | vardhraśabdaḥ ṭhlaghāvante'
ityādyaudātaḥ, tamādaṇ, ṭhṭiḍḍhāṇañ' iti ṅīp |
matubnirdeśe ityādi | asati tasminvarṇagrahaṇaṃ sarvatra tadantavidhi
prayojayatīti tadantavidhiḥ syāt | vaiṇavīti | bilvādyaṇ || 
tālādibhyo'ṇ || 4|3|152 ||
mayaḍādīnāmapavāda iti | ādiśabdenāño grahaṇam, bahuvacanaṃ tu
tayoreva prakṛtibhedena bahutvāt | tatra tālaśyāmākābhyāṃ
vṛddhatvānmayaṭ prāptaḥ barhiṇasya vikāro
bārhiṇam---ṭhprāṇirajatādibhyo'ñ', tasmād ṭhñitaśca
tatpratyayāt' ityañ prāptaḥ, śeṣebhyo'nudātādilakṣaṇasya |
liśidṛśibhyāmindraśabda upapade mūlavibhujāditvātkaḥ, ṭhanyeṣāmapi
dṛśyate' iti dīrghatvam | ṭhcap sāntvane', pacādyac | pīyūkṣāśabdaḥ
ṭhlaghāvante' iti madhyodātaḥ, tatra hi ṭhphiṣa' ityadhaikārātprāgeva
ṭāpaḥ svarapravṛttiḥ, indrāyudhaśabda samāsasvareṇāntodātaḥ |
tālāddhanuṣīti | anyatra tālamayamityeva bhavati | aṇgrahaṇaṃ
bādhakabādhanārtham, anyathā yathāvihitamityucyamāne
bārhaṇaśabdādvṛddhalakṣaṇo mayaṭ syāt, vacanaṃ tu ṭhñitaśca
tatpratyayāt' ityaño bādhanārthaṃ syāt ||
jātarūpebhyaḥ parimāṇe || 4|3|153 ||
mayaḍādīnāmapavāda iti | ādiśabdenāño grahaṇam, bahuvacanaṃ tu
pūrvavat | tatra vṛddhebhyo hāṭakādibhyo mayaṭo'pavādaḥ,
tapanīyādibhyonudātādibhyo'ñaḥ ||
prāṇirajatādibhyo'ñ || 4|3|154 ||
aṇādīnāmiti | ādiśabdena mayaḍ gṛhyate, bahuvacanaṃ tu
pūrvavat | tatrādyaudātebhyaḥ prāṇiśabdebhyo'ṇo'pavādaḥ, vṛddhebhyo
mayaṭaḥ, rajatādiṣvapi yadādyaudātaṃ tasmādaṇo'pavādaḥ
anudātādeśtu mayaṭaḥ | kāpotam, māyūram, taitiramiti |
titiriśabdastarateḥ ṭh sanvaccābhyāsasya' iti
kipratyayānto'ntodātaḥ, śeṣau ṭhlaghāvante' iti madhyodātau |
pariśiṣṭamihādāharaṇamiti coktam, tasmācchuka-baka-gṛdhādaya
ihodāhāryāḥ | śukabakaśabdau ṭhprāṇināṃ kupūrvāṇām'
ityādyaudātau | gṛdhraśabdo ranpratyayānta ādyaudātaḥ | kathaṃ tarhi
kāpotamityādyaudāhṛtam, satyudātārthe prāṇigrahaṇe'nudātāderapi
prāṇinaḥ paratvādanenaivāñbhavitumarhatīti manyate, āha ca
ṭhanudātāderañaḥ prāṇyañvipratiṣedhena' iti ? kaḥ punaratra
viśeṣastena vā satyanena vā ? sāpavādakaḥ sa vidhirmayaṭā pareṇa
bādhyate, ayaṃ punarnirapavādaḥ, anenaiva hi paratvānmayaḍ bādhyate |
kiṃ siddhaṃ bhavati ? śvāvidho vikāraḥ śauvāvidha iti siddhaṃ bhavati |
kathaṃ siddhaṃ bhavati ? śvānaṃ vidhyatīti kvip, ṭhnahivṛtti' iti
dīrghaḥ, grahijyādisamprasāraṇam,
kṛdutarapadaprakṛtisvareṇāntodātatvādanudātādiḥ |
tatrānaudātalakṣaṇasyāño bādhakaṃ mayaṭṃa paratvādayamañ bādhate,
dvārāditvādvṛddhipratiṣedhaḥ, aijāgamaśca ||
ñitaśca tatpratyayāt || 4|3|155 ||
tayorvācakatvena yaḥ sambandhī pratyaḥ sa tatpratyayaḥ ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ |
vikārāvayavayoreveti | yadi tu ñitpratyayāntaḥ
prāṇyoṣadhivṛkṣavācī sambhavati tato'vayave'pi bhavati; dvayoḥ
prakṛtatvāt | lakṣyamanapekṣyaivamuktam | nanu ca pūrve pañcālāḥ,
paṭo dagdha ityavayave samudāyaśabdo dṛṣṭaḥ, vikāre ca
prakṛtiśabdaḥ---śālīnbhuṅkte mudgairiti
śālivikārānmudgavikārairityarthaḥ; tataśca
devadārvādyavayavavikāravṛterdeavadārvādiśabdātadvikārāvayavayostena tenāñādayo bhaviṣyanti, nārtho'nenetyāśaṅkyāha---mayaṭo'pavāda iti | satyamasti yathākathañcidiṣṭasiddhaḥ, tathāpi vṛddhalakṣaṇo mayaṇmā bhūdityevamarthamevāñvidheyaḥ | anyathā yenaiva hetunaitadvākyaṃ bhavati---daivadāravasya vikāraḥ, śāmalasya vikāraḥ, tenaiva mayaḍapi syāt, vikāryātenaiva hetunā mayaḍapi prāpnoti ? anabhidānānna bhaviṣyati, tadeva tarhyanabhidhānaṃ vidhānena pratipādyate | yadyevam, ṭhtasya vikāraḥ', ṭhuṣṭrād vuñ', auṣṭrakaṃ carma, tasya vikāra auṣṭrikopānaditi, ṭhṭiḍḍhāṇañ' iti ṅīpprāpnoti, na ceṣyate, evaṃ hi saunāgāḥ paṭhanti---ṭhvuñaścāña ītaḥ prasaṅgaḥ' iti | tasmādavayave samudāyaśabdo vikāre ca prakṛtiśabda iti tena tena lakṣaṇenāñādayo bhaviṣyanti | anabhidhānātu vikārāvayavapratyayāntānna mayaḍ bhaviṣyatītyetadeva sāmpratam | bailvamayamiti | ṭhñito yatnena mayaṭṃa sūtrakāro nivartayan anyato vaṣṭi mayaṭam' iti vṛttikṛto matam | bhāṣyavātikakārau punarāhatuḥ---ṭhtaccānabhidānamāśrayitavyam, abhidhāne hyanyato'pi mayaṭaḥ prasaṅgaḥ---bailvasya vikāraḥ' iti ||
krītavatparimāṇāt || 4|3|156 ||
ṭhcaraṇebhyo dharmavat' ityanena tulyametat | saṅkhyā ca
parimāṇagrahaṇena gṛhyata iti | cakārādunmānaṃ ca,
parimīyate'neneti parimāṇamitiyaugikaḥ parimāṇaśabda ityarthaḥ |
tadāha---na rūḍhiparimāṇameveti | naiṣkika iti | ṭhasamāse
niṣkādibhyaḥ' iti ṭhak | śatyaḥ, śatika iti | ṭhśatācca ṭhanyatāvaśate'
| sāhasramiti | ṭhśatamānaviśatikasahasravasanādaṇ' |
vatiḥ sarvasādṛśyārtha iti | kimevaṃ sati siddhaṃ bhavati ?
tadāha---adhyarddhapūrvetyādi | ādiśabdena prakṛtipratyayayoḥ prāgvateḥ
saṅkhyāpūrvapadānāṃ tadantagrahaṇamaluka' iti tadantavidheśca parigrahaḥ
| etaduktaṃ bhavati---yābhyaḥ prakṛtibhyo yena viśeṣaṇena ye pratyayā
vihitāstābhyaḥ prakṛtibhyastenaiva viśeṣaṇena ta eva pratyayā vikāre
bhavanti | dvisāhasramiti | pakṣe luk, ṭhsaṅkhyāyāḥ
saṃvatsarasaṅkhyasya ca' ityutarapadavṛddhiḥ | dvinaiṣkikamiti |
prāgvatīyasya ṭhañaḥ ṭhdvitripūrvānniṣkāt' iti pakṣa luk,
ṭhparimāṇāntasya' ityutarapadavṛddhiḥ ||
umorṇayorvā || 4|3|158 ||
umāśabdastṛṇadhānyānāṃ vetyādyaudātaḥ, ūrṇāśabdaḥ
prātipadikasvareṇāntodātaḥ, tābhyāṃ vuñabhāve yathākramamaṇañau ||
eṇyā ḍhañ || 4|3|159 ||
strīliṅganirdeśasya prayojanamāha--puṃsastvañava bhavatīti ||
gopayasoryat || 4|3|160 ||
mayaḍviṣaye tviti | ṭhmayaḍvaitayoḥ' iti vihitasya mayaṭo
viṣaye ||
drośca || 4|3|161 ||
año'pavāda iti | ṭhorañ' ityasya, sūtraprāptyabhiprāyaṃ caitat |
ekāco nityaṃ mayaṭamicchantīti mayaṭ tvasmātprāpnoti | dravyamiti
| guṇaiḥ saṃdrūyate prāpyata iti guṇasaṃdrāvaḥ ||
māne vayaḥ || 4|3|162 ||
mīyate yena tanmānaṃ prasthādi ||
phale luk || 4|3|163 ||
tadviśeṣa iti || vikārāvayavaviśeṣe | udāharaṇeṣu
āmalakīśabdād vṛddhānmayaṭo luk, itarayorgaurāditvānṅīṣ,
tābhyāmanudātādilakṣaṇasyāñaḥ, sarvatra ṭhluktaddhitaluki' iti
strīpratyayasya luk | nanu ca na phalaṃ vṛkṣasya vikāraḥ, sa hi
dvividho bhavati---yo vā prakṛtimupamṛdnāti khādiraṃ bhasmeti,
yo vā prakṛtervyapadeśāntaraṃ karoti khādiraḥ sruva iti; phalaṃ tu
naivaṃvidhamiti vṛkṣe sthitamapi kākādivanna tasya vikāraḥ,
nāpyavayavaḥ, anārambhakatvāt ; utpanne hi vṛkṣe
paścātphalamupajāyate tatkathaṃ vikārāvayavayorutpannasya pratyayasya
lugvidhīyate ? ityāha---phalitasyeti | phalaśabdastārakādiḥ,
ṭhprakṛteravasthāntaraṃ vikāraḥ' ityuktam, aphalitāvasthāyāśca
phalitā'vasthāntaraṃ bhavatyeva | tatra vṛkṣatvaṃ tūbhayatrānuvartate,
sarvatra cotarāvasthā vikāraḥ, sarvaścāvayavaḥ svotpateḥ
prāgnopasthito nāsyārambhakaḥ, yathā śrṛṅgadantādiratha ca
gavāderavayavo bhavati, tadetatphale'pi samānam |
pallavaśabdo'rddharcādiḥ | phale lugvidhānamanarthakam;
prakṛtyantaratvāt | āmalakādiśabdaḥ phale vartate, na
yaugikaḥ---āmalakyāḥ phalamiti, yathā nāmalakayogādvṛkṣe
āmalakaśabdaḥ, āmalakaphalasyeyamāmalakīti, yathāṅgādiśabdaḥ kṣatriye
janapade ca | pratyayanivṛtyarthaṃ tu yathaitadvākyaṃ bhavati---āmalakyā
vikāraḥ kuvalyā vikāra iti, tathā pratyayo'pi syāt ||
plakṣādibhyo'ṇ || 4|3|164 ||
año'pavāda iti | śigru-kākṣatuśabdābhyāmuvarṇāntalakṣaṇasya,
śeṣebhyastvanudātala7ṇasya | tatra plakṣaśabdaḥ ṭhphiṣaḥ' ityantodātaḥ,
phiṣiti prātipadikasya nāma | nyagrodhaśabdaḥ ṭhlaghāvante' iti
madhyodātaḥ | aśvatthaśabdo ghṛtāditvādantodātaḥ |
iḍgudībṛhatīśabdau gaurādiṅīṣantau | vidhānasāmarthyāditi |
yadyasya luk syādvidhānamanarthakaṃ syāt | na hyaṇo'ño vā luki
kṛte kaścidviśeṣaḥ | naiyagrodhamiti | nyagrodhasya ca ṭhkevalasya'
ityaijāgamaḥ ||
jambvā vā || 4|3|165 ||
añastu bhavatyeva | na hyaño vidhānasāmarthyam ; phalādanyatra śravaṇāt |
jambūnīti | phalasyābhidheyatvānnapuṃsakahrasve ṭhjaśśasoḥ śiḥ', num,
ṭhsarvanāmasthāne ca' iti dīrghaḥ ||
lupca || 4|3|166 ||
yuktavadbhāve viśeṣa iti | lupi hi sati ṭhlupi
yuktavadvyaktivacane' iti prakṛtyarthagate liṅgavacane bhavataḥ, luki
tvabhidheyavalliṅgavacane syātām |
phalāpākaśuṣāmiti | phalapākena śuṣyantīṭi phalapākaśuṣaḥ | vrīhayo
mudgā iti | bilvādyaṇo luk, yavamāṣatilaśabdāḥ ṭhtṛṇadhānyānāṃ
ca dvyaṣām' ityādyaudātāḥ, tebhya autsargikasyāṇo luk |
mallikāśabdo mādīnāmiti madhyodātaḥ | asyārthaḥ---atra ṭhdvitīyaḥ
prāgīṣāt' iti tryaṣāmiti vartate, makārādīnāṃ tryaṣāṃ
dvitīyamakṣaramudātaṃ bhavati | navamālikāśabdaḥ ṭhlaghāvante' iti
madhyodāto jātiśabdaḥ | vidārībṛhatīśabdau gaurādiṅīṣantau |
aṃśuśabdaḥ prātipadikaravareṇāntodātaḥ, tato matup
ṭhhrasvanuḍbhyāṃ matup' iti matubādyaudātaḥ, ṅībanudātaḥ |
tadevamaṃśumatīśabde matubakāra udātaḥ | pāṭalānīti |
bilvāditvādaṇ, sālvaśabdaḥ prātipadikasvareṇāntodātaḥ |
kvacidanyadapi bhavatīti | lupo'nyadapi kacitkāryaṃ bhavati,
tatpunarlugluporabhāvaśca | kadambamityādāvanudātādilakṣaṇasyāño
luk | kadambādayaḥ śabdāḥ ṭhlagāvante' iti madhyodātāḥ |
bailvānīti | atrobhayābhāvaḥ, bilvādyaṇ ||
harītakyādibhyaśca || 4|3|167 ||
harītakyādiṣu drākṣāprabhṛtibhyo mayaṭo lup, udātādibhyo'ṇaḥ,
anudātādibhyo'ñaḥ ||
kaṃsīyaparaśavyayoryañañau luk ca || 4|3|168 ||
prāk krītācchena kaṃsīya iti | ṭhprāk krītācchaḥ' ityadhikāre ṭhtasmai
hitam' iticchapratyayena kaṃsīyaśabdo vyutpādyata ityarthaḥ |
etenogavādibhyo yatā paraśavyaśabda iti vyākhyātam |
tatsanniyogena ca kaṃsīyaparaśavyayorlugbhavatīti | pratyayādarśanasya
luksaṃjñāvidhānātadavayavayoḥ pratyayayorlugbhavatītyarthaḥ |
atha ṭhvṛtṛhanikaṣikamibhyaḥ saḥ' iti saḥ, kaṃsaśabde sapratyayaḥ | yaśca
parāśrṛṇotīti paraśuḥ, ṭhāṅparayoḥ khaniśrṛbhyāṃṇicca' iti
kupratyayastayorlukkasmānna bhavati ?
tatrāha---prātipadikādhikārāditi | prātipadikādhikāre hi tata;
parayoścchayatorlugbhavati, na dhātupratyayasya,
āha---ṭhṅyāpprātipadikagrahaṇamaṅgapadasaṃjñārthaṃ yacchayośca
lugartham' iti, nanu ca ṭhataḥ kṛkami' ityatra kaṃsagrahaṇaṃ
liṅgam---nāvayamuṇādiṣu vyutpattikāryaṃ bhavatīti,
tenokārasakārayorlugna bhaviṣyati ? satyam ;
vṛddhāvṛddhāvarṇasvaradvyajlakṣaṇapratyayavidhau
tatsampratyayārthamavaśyakartavyasya
ṅyāpprātipadikagrahaṇasyānuṣaṅgikaṃ prayojanaṃ darśitam | ata eva
ca ṭhṅyāpprātipadikāt' ityatra nedaṃ vṛttikṛtā darśitam ||
iti śrīharadatamiśraviracitāyāṃ padamañcaryāṃ caturthasyādhyāyasya
tṛtīyaścaraṇaḥ
-----------------------||||||||||||||||||||----------------------atha caturthādhyāye caturthaḥ pādaḥ---4
padamañjarī 
prāgvahateṣṭhak || 4|4|1 ||
tadāheti | ṭhvākyādetatpratyayavidhānam' iti vakṣyati, na ca
vākyād dvitīyā sambhavati; aprātipadikatvāt | tena taditi
karmamātraṃ nidiśyate, na tu dvitīyāsamarthavibhaktiḥ |
māśabda ityāheti | śabdo mākārītyāhetyarthaḥ | saṃsargarūpasya
vākyārthasyetikaraṇena pratyavamarśe sati vacanakriyāṃ prati karmatvaṃ
sambhavati, nānyatheti matvaiṣa vigrahaḥ | vākyādetatpratyayavidhānamiti
| etaccāhau prabhūtādibhyaḥ punarvacanāllabhyate, anyathā prabhūtādayo
māśabdādaya eva bhavantu, kiṃ pṛthagvacanena !
āhāviti | āheti pade
prakṛtibhāgasyāgantukenekāreṇedamo'nukaraṇam | tatra śabde
kāryasyāsambhavādarthapratyayavidhiḥ kriyāviśeṣaṇāditi |
tadantābhidhāyina ityarthaḥ |
pṛcchatāviti | tiṅntānukaraṇametat | evaṃ gacchatāviti |
tiṅntārthe tu pratyayaḥ | susnātaṃ pṛcchatīti | susnātaṃ bhavatā,
susnāto bhavānityevaṃ vā pṛcchatītyarthaḥ | saukharātrika iti |
sukharātriṃ pṛcchati | evaṃ yaḥ pṛcchati, sā evamucyate | etena
saukhaśāyaniko vyākhyātaḥ | anuśatikāditvādubhayapadavṛddhiḥ |
gaurutalpika iti | talpaśabdena bhāryā lakṣyate ||
tena dīvyati khanati jayati jitam || 4|4|2 ||
sarvatra karaṇe tṛtīyeti | dīvyatyādāvabhihitatvātkartari tṛtīyā
nopapadyata iti tatsāhacaryājjitamityanenāpi yoge karaṇa eva
tṛtīyeti sarvaśabdārthaḥ | tena devadatena na jitamityatra na bhavati |
hetutṛtīyā tu nāśaṅkitā; anabhidhānāt | na hi
hetutṛtīyāntāvutpadyamānena ṭhakā vigrahavākyārthasyābhidhānamasti |
pratyayārtha iti | nirddhāraṇa eṣā saptamī, sāmānyāpekṣamekavacanam |
iha dīvyatītyādau tipo bahavo'rthāḥ---ekatvasaṅkhyā,
vartamānakāle, yuṣmadasmadvyatireka iti, teṣu madhya ityarthaḥ |
tadeva darśitam | saṅkhyākālayoravivakṣeti | nāntarīyakatvāt |
avaśyaṃ hi yayā kayācitsaṅkhyyā yena kenacitkālena nirdeśa iti
tayorupādānam, na tu tayorvivakṣā | tata ākṣikau ākṣikā iti
dvibahvorapi bhavati, akṣairadīvyadityādau kālāntare cākṣika iti
bhavati, nyāyasya tulyatvāt puruṣasyāpyavivakṣā, tenākṣikastvam,
ākṣaiko'hamityatrāpi bhavati | yathaiva tarhi
saṅkhyākālapuruṣāṇāmavivakṣā tathā karturapi prāpnoti,
ekapratyayavācyatvāt ? naiṣa doṣaḥ;
karturavivakṣāyāmākhyātopādānamakiñcitkaraṃ syāt | viparyayastu
na bhavati---karturavivakṣā kālādīnāṃ vivakṣeti; kartuḥ
pradhānatvāt | saṅkhyādiviśiṣṭo hi kartā''khyātānāṃ
pradhānabhūto'rthaḥ, tena sa tāvadvivakṣyate, itareṣāṃ
nāntarīyakatvādavivakṣā | kiñca, sādhanasyāpyavivakṣāyāṃ
jitamityasyopādānamanarthaṃ syāt |
ihākhyāteṣu kriyā pradhānabhūtā, guṇabhūtaḥ kartā, ata eva kiṃ karoti
devadata iti kriyāpraśne pacatītyākhyātenotaraṃ dīyate, na tu
kṛdantena pācaka itiḥ tasya satvapradhānatvāt | kiñca, yadi
kṛdanteṣvivākhyāteṣvapi kartā pradhānabhūtaḥ syād, yathā
pācakasyāpatyamityapatyādibhiryogo bhavati, tathā''khyātavācyasyāpi
syāt pacatyayamiti, kriyāveśaḥ syād, yathā---pācakastiṣṭhatīti |
tasmātkriyāpradhānamākhyātam | tataśca tadrathe vidhīyamānaḥ pratyayo'pi
kriyāpradhānaḥ syāditi tadantasyāpatyādibhiryogaḥ kriyāveśaśca na
syāt---ākṣikasyāpatyamākṣikaṃ paśyeti |
tatrāha---kriyāpradhānatve'pi cākhyātasyeti | ākhyāyate'nena kriyā
pradhānabhūtetyākhyātastiṅntaḥ, ṭhkṛtyalyuṭo bahulam' iti karaṇe
ktaḥ, svanikāyaprasiddhireṣā | svabhāvāditi | yathā ṭhtenaikadik',
ṭhtasiśca' ityetasminnarthe
vidhīyamānayoraṇtayossatvabhūtārthābhidhāyitvam,
viparyayaśca---saudāmanī vidyautsudāmato vidyauditi, tathātrāpi | na
hi svabhāvaḥ paryanuyogamarhati ||
saṃskṛtam || 4|4|3 ||
yogavibhāga utarārtha iti | utaro'pavādaḥ saṃskṛta eva yathā syāt
||
kulatthakopadhādaṇ || 4|4|4 ||
kule tiṣṭhati kulatthaḥ, asmādeva nipātanātsakārasya takāraḥ |
kecitpunaḥ sakāramevādhīyate ||
naudvyacaṣṭhan || 4|4|7 ||
iha ṭhagadhikāre sūtre kvacitpratyayasyānubandho ṅīṣarthaḥ | sahi ki
sāṃhitikaḥ, kiṃ vānubandhaḥ ? iti tatra sandehe vipayaparigaṇanaṃ
kariṣyanślokavārtikakāraḥ sarvāneva ṣitaḥ
parigaṇayati---ākarṣāditi---yadi tu yatra
sandehastānevopādāyaitāvantaṣṭhagadhikāre ṣita ityucyeta, tadā
ākarṣādiṣu pratyayasyāṣitvamanārṣamāśaṅkyeta | kusīdasūtrāditi
| kusīdādikaṃ sūtraṃ yasya tatkusīdasūtraṃ kusīdaśabdaśca,
daśaikādaśaśabdaśca |
nanu saptaite bhavanti, kusīdādisūtreṇa dvayoḥ ṣitorvidhānāt ?
ityata āha---vidhivākyāpekṣaṃ ca ṣaṭtvamiti | saptānāṃ pratyayānāṃ
vidhivākyāpekṣamaupacārikaṃ paṭtvamāśritya ṭhṣitaḥ ṣaḍete'
ityuktam ||
ākarṣāt ṣṭhal || 4|4|9 ||
ākarṣeti | ṭhpuṃsi saṃjñāyāṃ ghaḥ prāyeṇa' iti adhikaraṇe ghaḥ ||
parpādibhyaḥ ṣṭhan || 4|4|10 ||
parpādiṣu ṭhpādaḥ pat' iti paṭha|lte, pādābhyāṃ carati padikaḥ,
ṭhpadyatyatadarthe' ityatra vakṣyati--ṭhpadbhāva ike caratāvupasaṅkhyānam'
iti, so'syaiva prapañcārthaḥ ||
śvagaṇāṭṭhañ ca || 4|4|11 ||
śvāgaṇika iti | nanu ca śvaśabdo dvārādiṣu paṭha|lte, tadādividhiśca
tatreṣyate, tatkathaṃ śvāgaṇika iti ? tatrāha---śvāderiñītyatreti ||
vetanādibhyo jīvati || 4|4|12 ||
dhanurdaṇḍagrahaṇaṃ saṅghātavigṛhītārthamiti |
tantrāvṛtyekaśeṣāṇāmanyatamāśrayaṇāt ||
vasnakrayavikrayāṭṭhan || 4|4|13 ||
vaservasnamumūlyam | kriyavikrayagrahaṇaṃ saṅghātavigṛhītārthamiti
| ukto'tra hetuḥ | krayavikrayeṇeti samāhāradvandvaḥ ||
āyudhāccha ca || 4|4|14 ||
āyudhyate'neneti āyudham, ṭhghañarthe kavidhānam' iti kapratyayaḥ ||
haratyutsaṅgādibhyaḥ || 4|4|15 ||
harati u nayati, upādate vā ||
bhastrādibhyaḥ ṣṭhan || 4|4|16 ||
bhastram u carmavikāraḥ, yena lohādi dhmāyate, yena vā dhānyādikaṃ
nīyate, ṭhhūyāmāśrubhasibhyastran' iti karaṇae tran | śīrṣabhāraḥ,
śīrṣebhāra iti paṭha|lte, nipātanācchīrṣabhāvaḥ saptamīsamāsaśca,
ṭhtatpuruṣe kṛti bahulam' iti saptamyā aluk || 
vibhāṣā vivadhavīvadhāt || 4|4|17 ||
paryāhāre ceti | parita āhriyate'nena taṇḍulādiko'rtha iti
paryāhāraḥ u ubhayato baddhaśikyāā'savāhyaḥ kāṣṭhaviśeṣa ucyate |
vīvadhaśabdo vārtike darśanātsūtre prakṣiptaḥ ||
aṇkuṭilikāyāḥ || 4|4|18 ||
kuṭilavyādhānāmuparamaṇam u kuṭilikā, saṃjñāyāṃ kan ||
trermamnityam || 4|4|20 ||
ḍvitaḥ ktrirityayaṃ triśabdo gṛhyata iti |
saṅkhyāvacanastvanabhidhānānna gṛhyate | uptrimamiti | vacyādisūtreṇa
saṃprasāraṇam |
nityagaṃrahaṇaṃ svātantryanivṛtyarthamiti | pratyayarahitasya tryantasya
prayogaḥ svātantryam, svātantryanivṛtau satyāṃ yo guṇastaṃ
darśayati---tryantaṃ nityaṃ mappratyayāntameva bhavatīti |
evakāravyavacchedyaṃ darśayati---viṣayāntare na prayoktavyamiti | nanu
vibhāṣayā vākye prasakte nityagrahaṇaṃ kriyamāṇaṃ nirvṛtādhaikāre
tadviṣayameva vākyaṃ nivartayitumarhati---paktriṇā nirvṛtamiti,
yathā---ṭhana upadhālopinonyatarasyām' ṭhnityaṃ saṃjñācchandasoḥ' iti,
tataśca viṣayāntaragatatryantasya svātantryaṃ syādeva
kṛtrimarhatsuvihitamiti ? evaṃ manyate---yogavibhāgo'tra kartavyaḥ,
ṭhtrermabbhavati nirvṛte' ityeko yogaḥ, tataḥ ṭhnityam' | atra
trermabityevāpekṣyate na nirvṛta iti; yogavibhāgasāmarthyāt |
tena sarvaviṣayasvātantryasya nityagrahaṇena nivṛttiḥ kriyata iti |
nanvevamapi ṭhnityam' ityatra
nirvṛtamityasyānapekṣaṇātsvātantryāntare | nityamupādhiḥ prāpnoti
? satyam ; anabhidhānātu tathānāśrīyate |
bhāvapratyayāntādimab vaktavya iti | ṭhtena nirvṛtam' ityetasminnarthe
| pākena nirvṛtaṃ pākimamiti | evaṃ ca tryantādapi bhāvābhidhāyina
imapi kṛte yasyeti lope ca kṛtrimamityādi siddhaṃ bhavati,
svare'pi nāsti viśeṣaḥ, udātanivṛttisvareṇaivodātatvam |
sūtrārambhastu nityagrahaṇena svātantryaṃ nivartayiṣyāmītyevamarthe
veditavyaḥ ||
apamityayācitābhyāṃ kakkanau || 4|4|21 ||
apamityeti | ṭhudīcāṃ māṅe vyatihāre' iti ktvāpratyaye'paśabdena
samāse ktvo lyap, ṭhmayateridanyatarasyām' itītvam,
ṭhktvātosunkasunaḥ' ityavyayasaṃjñā | tena nātra
tṛtīyāsamarthātpratyayaḥ ||
saṃsṛṣṭe || 4|4|22 ||
nanu yadyena saṃsṛṣṭṃa tatena saṃskṛtaṃ bhavati; tataśca saṃskṛtamityeva
saṃsṛṣṭe'pi pratyayaḥ siddhaḥ ? na sidhyati; sata utkarṣādhānam u
saṃskāraḥ, ekībhāvastu u saṃsargaḥ, na ca yatrāsau
tatrāvaśyamutkarṣo'sti, aśucidravyasaṃsarge hi pratyutāpakarṣa eva
bhavati | tasmātsaṃsṛṣṭa iti vaktavyam | yadyasya
nibandhanamastyetadevāstu, mā bhūtsaṃskṛtamityetat ? tadavaśyaṃ
kartavyam, ihāpi yathā syāt---vidyayā saṃskṛto vaidyaka iti, na hyatra
saṃsargo'sti; mūrtidharmatvāt | kiñca ṭhkulatthakopadhādaṇ'
saṃskṛta eva yathā syātsasṛṣṭe mā bhūdityemavarthaṃ
saṃskṛtamityetadbhavatīti vaktavyam ||
cūrṇādiniḥ || 4|4|23 ||
cūrṇae ye saṃsṛṣṭāsteṣāṃ cūrṇamastīti matvarthīyenaiveninā siddham
? satyam ; tadrūpavivakṣāyāṃ siddham | saṃsargavivakṣāyāṃ tu ṭhak
prāpnoti | anabhidhānaṃ tu durjñānam ||
lavaṇālluk || 4|4|24 ||
lavaṇadravyavācītyādi | lavaṇaśabdo'yamastyeva guṇavacanaḥ--ṣaṇṇāṃ
rasānāmanyatamasya vācakaḥ, asti ca dravyavacano yaḥ saindhavādiṣu
vartate; tatra yo guṇavacanaḥ sa na lukaṃ prayojayati,
madhurādiśabdavadabhedopacārādeva dravye vṛttisiddheḥ | dravyaśabdastu
so'yamityabhisambandhād dravye vartamānaḥ | yadyapi praṣṭhī pracarī
yaṣṭīḥ praveśayetyādau dravyaśabdasyapi kvacidabhedopacāro dṛṣṭaḥ,
tathāpi bhedavivakṣāyāṃ tatstho'pi dṛśyate---praṣṭasyeyaṃ prāṣṭhī
yaṣṭimataḥ puruṣāniti | tasmād dravyavācyeva lavaṇaśabdo lukaṃ
prayojayati, sa ca prayojayatyeva ||
vyañjanairupasikte || 4|4|26 ||
odanādiṣu raso yena vyajyate tadvyañjanam | bahuvacananirdeśaḥ
svarūpavidhinirāsārthaḥ | upasiktaḥ u secanena mṛdūkṛtaḥ | iha
yadyenopasiktaṃ tatena saṃsṛṣṭṃa bhavati, tatra saṃsṛṣṭa ityeva siddhe
niyamārthaṃ vacanam---vyañjanebhya upasikta eva saṃsṛṣṭe yathā
syātsaṃsṛṣṭamātre mā bhūt, dadhnā saṃsṛṣṭā sthālīti ||
tatpratyanupūrvamīpalomakūlam || 4|4|28 ||
kriyāviśeṣaṇamityādi | ākhyātaṃ hi dhātvarthasya
kartavyatāmācaṣṭe---vartate u vartanaṃ karoti, supyate u svāpaḥ
kriyate, śobhanamodanaṃ pacyate u odanakarmakaḥ pākaḥ śobhanaḥ
kriyate iti | pacidhātvarthaḥ kartavya eva sambadhyamānaḥ karma sampadyate,
tasya yatsamānādhikaraṇaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ tadapi karmaiva bhavati |
prātīpikaḥ, ānvīpika iti | pratigatā āpo'sminniti bahuvrīhiḥ,
ṭhṛkpūrabdhūḥ' ityikāraḥ samāsāntaḥ, ṭhdvyantarupasargebhyo'pa īt'
itītvam | vyutpattimātraṃ caitat, pratikūlānukūlaparyāyau tvetau
| ṭhūdanordeaśe' ityūtvamatra na bhavati; adeśatvāt, deśatve
kriyāviśeṣatvāsambhavāt | sūtre īpśabdasya nirdeśāt |
prātilomikaḥ, ānulomika iti | pūrvavadvahuvrīhiḥ, ṭhac
pratyanvavapūrvāt' ityac samāsāntaḥ | atrāpi vyutpattimātram,
arthastu pūrvokta eva | prātikūlika iti | pūrvavadvahuvrīhiḥ | atrāpi
kūlārtho nāsti | pratisaraṇaṃ caitayorarthaḥ ||
parimukhaṃ ca || 4|4|29 ||
pārimukhika iti | paririha vartate, tasya ca ṭhapaparī varjane' iti
karmapravacanīyasaṃjñā, ṭhpañcamyapāṅparibhiḥ' iti pañcamī,
ṭhapaparibahirañcavaḥ' ityavyayībhāvaḥ, anena ṭhak | svāmino mukaṃ
varjayitvā yaḥ sevako vartate sa pārimukhikaḥ | sarvato bhāve vā
pariśabdaḥ, parito mukham, prādisamāsaḥ, yato yataḥ svamino mukhaṃ
tatastato vartate ityarthaḥ | evaṃ pāripārśvikaḥ ||
prayacchati garhyam || 4|4|30 ||
dviguṇārthaṃ dviguṇamiti | dvaiguṇika utamarṇa ucyate, na cāsau
dviguṇaṃ prayacchati, kiṃ tarhyekaguṇaṃ datvā dviguṇaṃ gṛhṇāti, ata eva
tadgarhyaṃ bhavatīti | tasmād dviguṇārthe dviguṇaśabdo
vartayitavyaḥ |
vārdhuṣika iti | vṛddhyarthe dhane vṛddhiśabdaḥ | prakṛtyantarameveti |
etacca vārdhuṣika ityetadvṛttiviṣayameva | niyataviṣayā api hi śabdā
bhavanti, vṛddhiśabdādanabhidhānānnaiva bhaviṣyati, tena vārdhika
ityaniṣṭaprasaṅgo nodbhāvanīyaḥ | ata katham ṭhvārdhudāsamakampata
vavānyasya ca vārddhuṣeḥ' iti ? svacchandavāca ṛṣayaḥ ||
kusīdadaśaikādaśāt ṣṭhanṣṭhacau || 4|4|31 ||
tadarthaṃ dravyaṃ kusīdamiti | atrāpi kusīdika
ityutamarṇasyābhidhānamiṣyate, na cotamarṇaḥ kusīdaṃ prayacchati, kiṃ
tahi ? adhamarṇaḥ, na ca tasya vṛddhipradānaṃ garhyam,
tasmātādarthyātācchadbyamiti bhāvaḥ | ekādaśārthaṃ daśa
daśaikādaśaśabdenocyanta iti tatraikādaśaśabdasyāpi tadartheṣu
daśasveva vṛteḥ sāmānādhikaraṇye sati viśeṣaṇasamāsaḥ, ṭhsaṃkhyāyā
alpīyasyāḥ' iti daśaśabdasya pūrvanipātaḥ | daśaikādaśāditi
nirdeśādakāraḥ samāsāntaḥ | evaṃ vākyamapyakārāntenaiva
bhavati---daśaikādaśānprayacchatīti ||
rakṣati || 4|4|33 ||
sāmājika iti | samājaḥ u samūhaḥ, samajatyasminniti kṛtvā, evaṃ
sanniveśaḥ ||
śabdadarduraṃ karoti || 4|4|34 ||
śabdaṃ karotīti | karotiriha jñāne vartate, prakṛtyādivibhāgena
jānātītyarthaḥ | etaccābhidhānasvābhāvyāllabhyate, iha na bhavati---śabdaṃ
karoti khara iti | pātraviśeṣavācī darduraśabdaḥ | anukaraṇaśabda
ityanye ||
pakṣimatsyamṛgānhanti || 4|4|35 ||
svarūpasya tadviśeṣaṇāṃ paryāyāṇāṃ ca grahaṇamiṣyata iti | atra hetuḥ
ṭhsvaṃ rūpam' ityatraivoktaḥ | mātsyika iti | ṭhsūryatiṣya' iti lopo
na bhavati; matsyasya ṅyāmiti parigaṇanāt | hāriṇikaḥ, saukarika
iti | atra mṛgaparyāyasyodāharaṇaṃ kimita na pradarśitam, yathā
pūrvayoḥ dvāvapi hyaetasmādviśeṣau, āraṇyāścatuṣpādo mṛgāḥ
ucyante, hariṇaparyāyo'pi mṛgaśabdo'sti, tadapekṣayā hāriṇika
iti paryāyodāharaṇam ||
paripanthaṃ ca tiṣṭhati || 4|4|36 ||
taditi dvitīyāsamarthāditi | paripanthaśabdaḥ
parimukhaśabdavadavyayībhāvaḥ, tatpuruṣo vā | tatrāpyavyayībhāvapakṣe
kriyāviśeṣaṇātiṣṭhaterakarmakatve'pi paripanthasya karmatvam;
tatpuruṣe tu paritaḥ panthāḥ paripantha iti ṭhkālabhāvādhvagantavyāḥ'
iti vacanātkarma, tadityadhikārasāmarthyādityanye |
pāripanthikaścora iti | yaḥ panthānaṃ varjayitvā tiṣṭhati yo vā
panthānaṃ vyāpya tiṣṭhati sa evamucyate |
laukikavākyapradarśanārthamiti | paripanthaṃ
tiṣṭhatītyetallaukikavākyaṃ tasya pradarśanārthaṃ dvitīyoccāraṇam |
athaivamarthe dvitīyoccāraṇe kiṃ siddhaṃ bhavati ?
ityāha---paripathaparyāya ityādi | kimetasya jñāpane prayojanam ?
ityāha---sa viṣayāntare'pīti | asati tu jñāpane pratyayasanniyogena
paripanthaśabdasya nipātanaṃ vijñāyate, tataśca tato'nyatra prayogo na
syāt ||
māthotarapadapadavyanupadaṃ dhāvati || 4|4|37 ||
māthaśabdaḥ pathiparyāya iti | mathyate praśādyate gantṛbhiriti kṛtvā |
daṇḍākāro matho daṇḍamāthaḥ ||
ākrandāṭṭhañca || 4|4|38 ||
ākrando deśa iti | duḥ khitānāṃ rodanasyāyanamārtāyanamucyate,
ārtairīyate prāpyata iti kṛtvā | ārtāyanamārtānāṃ trātā ākranda
ityucyate, ākrandyate ārtairāhūyata iti kṛtvā ||
padotarapadaṃ gṛhṇāti || 4|4|39 ||
padagrahaṇe svarūpaṃ gṛhyate, na suptiṅntamutarapadasya
padatvāvyabhicārād, ata evāha---padaśabda utarapadaṃ yasyeti ||
pratikaṇṭhārthalalāmaṃ ca || 4|4|40 ||
kaṇṭhṃa kaṇṭhṃa prati pratikaṇṭham, ṭhyathārthe yadavyayam' iti
vīpsāyāmavyayībhāvaḥ | ābhimukhye vā, ṭhlakṣaṇenābhipratī ābhimukhye'
iti | yastu pratigataḥ kaṇṭhṃa pratikaṇṭha iti prādisamāsaḥ, tasya grahaṇaṃ
na bhavati' anabhidhānāt ||
dharma carati || 4|4|41 ||
adharmācceti vaktavyamiti | grahaṇavatā prātipadikena
tadantavidhipratiṣedhādvacanam | ādharmika iti | nañatra virodhivacanaḥ,
pāpācāra ityarthaḥ ||
pratipathameti ṭhaÄśca || 4|4|42 ||
pratipathamiti | pūrvavadvīpsāyāmavyayībhāvaḥ, ṭhṛkpūrabdhūḥ'
ityakāraḥ samāsāntaḥ ||
samavāyān samavaiti || 4|4|43 ||
samavāyaḥ samūha ucyata iti | samavayanti tasminniti kṛtvā | na
sampradhāraṇeti | samayapūrvasyeṇaḥ sampradhāraṇāyāmapi
prayogo'stītimanyate | samāgatya tadekadeśībhavatītyartha iti | tatra
guṇabhūtasamāgamāpekṣayā samavāyamiti dvitīyānirdeśaḥ | loke tu
prāyeṇa saptamī prayujyate---dravye guṇāḥ samavayantīti ||
pariṣado ṇyaḥ || 4|4|44 ||
paritaḥ sīdantyasyāmiti pariṣat, sampadāditvādadhikaraṇe kvip,
ṭhsadiraprateḥ' iti ṣatvam ||
saṃjñāyāṃ lalāṭakukkuṭyau paśyati || 4|4|46 ||
saṃjñānaṃ saṃjñā u pratītiḥ, prasiddhirityarthaḥ | abhidheyaniyamārthamiti |
abhidheye sevakaviśeṣe bhikṣuviśeṣe ca niyamaḥ, tatraiva vṛttiryathā
syādityevamarthamityarthaḥ | na rūḍha|lrthamiti |
lālāṭika-kaukkuṭikaśabdayorḍitthādivadarūḍhatvāt tanniyogena
vartate, yāvadyoge ca vartate | yoge'pi
lalāṭakukkuṭīdarśanamātreṇa ṭhañ na bhavatītyetāvatsaṃjñāgrahaṇena
prasiddhyupasaṃgrahārthe na kriyate |
yādṛśastu yogo'tra vivakṣitastaṃ darśayati---sarvāvayavebhya ityādi |
anupaśleṣasya vivaraṇaṃ kāryeṣvanupasthāyitvamiti, dūre sthito
lalāṭameva paśyati, na punaḥ kāryeṣūpatiṣṭhata ityarthaḥ |
kukkuṭīpāto lakṣyate iti | yāvati deśe kukkuṭī patati yāvantaṃ
deśaṃ samatītya nipatītuṃ samarthā sa deśo lakṣyata ityarthaḥ |
anenāpi prakāreṇa deśasyālpatvaṃ lakṣyate, kukkuṭī patatu mā
vā'patadityāha---deśasyālpatayeti | etadeva spaṣṭayati---yo hi
bhikṣuriti | bhikṣuḥ u saṃnyāsī ||
tasya dharmyam || 4|4|47 ||
dharmaḥ u anuvṛta ācāraḥ, tato'napetaṃ dharmyam,
ṭhdharmapathyarthanyāyādanapete' iti vacanāt| dauvārikamiti |
ṭhdvārādīnāṃ ca' iti vṛddhipratiṣedhaḥ, aijāgamaśca ||
ṛto'ñ || 4|4|49 ||
hoturdharmyaṃ hautramiti | hotṛśabdasya mahiṣyādiṣu
pāṭhādapapāṭho'yam, poturdhamyamiti tu pāṭhaḥ | apara
āha---yajamānasāhacaryādṛtvigvacanasya hotṛśabdasya mahiṣyādiṣu
pāṭhaḥ, ayaṃ tu kriyāśabda udāhṛta iti |
narācceti vaktavyamiti | nṛśabdātsūtreṇaivāñi nāramiti siddhe
naraśabdāṭṭhako nivṛtyarthaṃ vacanam, anabhidhānaṃ tu durjñānam ||
avakrayaḥ || 4|4|50 ||
avakrīyate'nenetyavakraya iti | krayo nāma u svadravyatyāgena
paradravyasvīkaraṇam, tasyāvamatvamavaśabdo dyotayati | vāṇijyārthaṃ
tailadhānyādikaṃ deśāntaraṃ nayatā'smin śulkasthāne
pratibhārametāvad deyamiti taddeśādipatinā yatkalpitaṃ
so'vakrayaḥ, piṇḍaka iti cocyate | tatra svadravyameva datvā
svadravyameva svīkriyate ityayamavakrayo bhavati, na tu mukhyaḥ |
nanvityādi | avakrayasyāpyanādipravṛtatvāditi bhāvaḥ |
lokapīḍayeti | arthalobhena dharmātikrameṇa dharmāpetatvaṃ darśayati
||
tadasya paṇyam || 4|4|51 ||
paṇyamiti viśeṣaṇāmatyādi | iha yo viśeṣaṇamupādhirvopādīyate
dyetye tasmistena bhavitavyam, tadyathā---ṭhsāsya devatā', indro devatā
asya aindraḥ sthālīpāka iti devatātvaṃ vṛtāvantarbhavati, tadvadatrāpi
paṇyatvamantarbhavatīti nātrāpūrvaṃ kiñcit ||
kiśarādibhyaṣṭhan || 4|4|53 ||
kiśarādayo gandhaviśeṣavacanāstadvati vartante, gandhānpinaṣṭīti
yathā ||
śalāluno'nyatarasyām || 4|4|54 ||
śalāluka iti | ṭhisusuktāntātkaḥ' ||
śilpam || 4|4|55 ||
kauśalamiti | kriyābhyāsapūrvako jñānaviśeṣaḥ | mṛdaṅgavādanaṃ
śilpamasyeti | mṛdaṅgo vādyate yena tanmṛdaṅgavādanaṃ śilpam
bhāvasādhanasya gauṇaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyam | mṛdaṅgavādanaviṣayaṃ
śilpamasyetyarthaḥ | mārdaṅgika iti |
nanu mṛdaṅgavādanaṃ śalpimasyeti vigrahaḥ kṛtaḥ, tataśca
mārdaṅgavādanika iti bhavitavyam ? tatrāha---mṛdaṅgetyādi |
mṛdaṅgavādanaśabdātu pratyayo na bhavatyanabhidhānāt, kiṃ
tūpacaritavṛterapi mṛdaṅgaśabdādeva bhavati | ata evānabhidhānāt
mṛdaṅganiṣpādanaṃ ślipamasya mārdaṅgikaḥ kumbhakāra ityatra na
bhavati ||
maḍḍakajharjharādaṇanyatarasyām || 4|4|56 ||
ayameva nirdeśo jñāpayati---ṭhtadvādanavṛttibhyo mṛdaṅgādibhyaḥ
pratyayaḥ' iti | na hi mukhyamaḍḍukajharjharayoḥ śilpena
samānādhikaraṇyamupapadyate ||
praharaṇam || 4|4|57 ||
praharaṇamāyudham, prahriyate'neneti kṛtvā | dhānuṣka iti | pūrvavat
kādeśaḥ, ṭhiṇaḥ ṣaḥ' iti visarjanīyasya ṣatvam ||
paraśvadhāṭṭhañca || 4|4|58 || 
paraśvadhaḥ u paraśu ||
śaktiyaṣṭa|lerīkak || 4|4|59 ||
śakyate'nayā prahartumiti śaktiḥ, yaṣṭiśabdo'vyutpannaṃ prātipadikam
| kimarthamīkagucyate na kagevocyate, kā rūpasiddhiḥ ?
śaktiyaṣṭiśabdābhyāṃ bahvādiṅīṣantābhyāṃ liṅgaviśiṣṭaparibhāṣayā
kaki kṛte śāktīko yāṣṭīka iti siddham ; na sidhyati ? ṭhke'ṇaḥ' iti
hrasvatvaṃ prāpnoti | vibhāṣā ṅībuktaḥ, tadabhāvapakṣe dīrghasya śaṅkaiva
nāsti ? evaṃ tarhi ikagevocyeta, ikāre'pi hi savarṇadīrghatve
sidhyati, yasyeti lopa ikāroccāraṇasāmarthyānna bhaviṣyati |
padasyāvagrahanivṛttirikārasya prayojanam | evaṃ tarhi sūtrārambho
niṣphalaḥ syāt, pūrvasūtravihitena ṭhakaivāvagrahanivṛteḥ
siddhatvāt ? nānarthakam ; vākyanivṛtyarthatvāt | evamapi
pratyayāntaramanarthakaṃ śaktiyaṣṭa|lerityetāvadvaktavyam, ṭhak prakṛtaḥ,
tasya punarvidhānaṃ vākyanivṛtyarthaṃ bhaviṣyati, kimīkako vidhānena,
tadvidhānātuyasyeti lopo na bhaviṣyati | yathaiva tarhi yasyeti
lopo na bhavati evaṃ savarṇadīrghatvamapi na syāt; yaṃ vidhiṃ
pratyupadeśo'narthakaḥ sa vidhirbādhyate, yasya tu vidhernimitameva
nāsau bādhyate, yasyetilopaṃ ca prati ikāroccāraṇamanarthakaṃ
savarṇadīrghasya punarnimitameva ||
astināstidiṣṭṃa matiḥ || 4|4|60 ||
yadyasti matiryasya sa āstikaḥ, core'pi prāpnoti, tasyāpi
matisadbhāvāt ? tatrāha---na ceti | tadviparīta iti | paraloko
nāstīti matiryasya tannāstikaḥu laukāyatikaḥ, na tvacetanaḥ padārthaḥ,
matyabhāvamātre pratyayasyāniṣṭatvāt | diṣṭam u daivam, tadviṣayā
matiryasya sa daiṣṭikaḥ, vṛtāvapi pramāṇānupātinī matiryasyeti
daivavit, pramīyate tebhyo daivamiti |
pramāṇaśabdenetihāsapurāṇādivivakṣitam |
astināstiśabdau nipātāviti | tena prātipadikādhikāro na
bādhyate iti bhāvaḥ | vacanasāmarthyāccetyabhyupagamyavādaḥ ||
śīlam || 4|4|61 ||
śīlaṃ svabhāva iti | śīlyate punaḥ punaḥ kriyate'neneti kṛtvā |
apūpabha7ṇaṃ śīlamasyeti | śīlaviṣaye śīlatvamārepya
sāmānādhikaraṇyena vyapadeśaḥ | bhakṣaṇakriyetyādi | śīlaṃ
tāvadupātatvādantarbhavati, kriyāviṣayatvācca śīlasya
kriyādyantarbhavati, svabhāvācca bhakṣaṇakriyā, na niṣpādikā ||
cchatrādibhyo ṇaḥ || 4|4|62 ||
cchatraśīlatā śiṣyasya darśayitumāha---chādanādāvaraṇācchatramiti |
chādayateḥ ṣṭrani ṭhhasmantrankviṣu ca' iti hrasvaḥ | cchatraśīla iti |
cchatrasahacaritā chādanakriyā śīlamasyetyartha | yadi tvapūpabhakṣaṇaṃ
śīlamasyāpūpika itivat cchatrāvaraṇaṃ śīlamasya chātrika iti
vyutpādyate, tadā dāse'pi prāpnoti; abhidhānasvābhāvyātu tathā
nāśrīyate |
upasargapūrvo gṛhyate iti | tataśca tasya ṭhātaścopasarge' ityādinā
vyutpattiḥ; kevalasya sthāśabdasyābhāvāt | kevalasya tu pāṭhaḥ
sarvopasargagrahārthaḥ | cureti paṭha|lte, tatra corayateḥ ṭhṇyāsaśrantho
yuc' iti yuci prāpte'smādeva nipātanādakāraḥ, guṇābhāvaśca | na
ca yuco'nyatra bādhaḥ, coraṇetyapi bhavati ||
karmādhyayane vṛtam || 4|4|63 ||
karma u kriyā, tacca skhalitamapacārarūpaṃ vivakṣitam, na tacchīlaṃ karma,
teneha na bhavati---adhyayane japo vṛto'syeti |
etaccabhidhānasvābhāvyāllabhyate | tadetadvakṣyati---yasyādhyayane
niyuktasyetyādi | ekamanyaditi | samyakpāṭhāpekṣayā ||
bahvacpūrvapadāṭṭhac || 4|4|64 ||
svarabhede'pyanyatvaṃ bhavati, na varṇabheda evetyāha---udāte kartavye
iti | udātagrahaṇaṃ samyaksvarasyopalakṣaṇam | anudātagrahaṇaṃ
cāsamyaksvarasya ||
hitaṃ bhakṣāḥ || 4|4|65 ||
hitam, bhakṣāḥ---iti padayoḥ paryavasānena sambandhaḥ | atra ṭhhitam'
iti sāmānyopakramatvādekavacanaṃ napuṃsakatvaṃ ca | ṭhbhakṣāḥ'
ityapūpādiviśeṣeṣūpasaṃgrahātpuṃlliṅgaṃ bahuvacanaṃ ca | ata
evāha---yatatprathamāsamarthaṃ hitaṃ cetadbhavati tacca bhakṣā iti |
evaṃ tarhīti | evaṃ ca caturthyarthe pratyayo na ṣaṣṭha|lrthe | kathaṃ tarhi
pūrvamuktamasyeti ṣaṣṭha|lrtha iti ? evaṃ tarhyadhikāramātrāpekṣayā
taduktam | apara āha---ṭhhitaṃ bhakṣāstadasmai' iti sūtracchedaḥ, tataḥ
ṭhdīyate niyuktam' iti tasyā eveti |
hitārthaḥ kriyā ceti | hitārthastāvadu pātatvādantarbhavati |
bhakṣaṇakriyāpyapūpādiśabdānāṃ lakṣaṇayā tatra vṛterantarbhavati ||
tadasmai dīyate niyuktam || 4|4|66 ||
avyabhicāroniyoga iti | asminpakṣe niyuktamiti
kriyāviśeṣaṇatvātkarmaṇi dvitīyā | agrabhojanamasmai niyuktaṃ dīyata
iti | yadyagrabhojanaṃ dīyate tadāsmai evetyeṣa niyogārthaḥ | tena
kadācillope'pi na niyuktatāyā hāniḥ |
kecitviti | atra pakṣe niyuktamityantasaṃyoge dvitīyā ||
śrāṇāmāṃsaudanāṭṭiṭhan || 4|4|67 ||
ṭhśrā pāke' ktaḥ, kṣīrahaviṣoreva nipātanācchabhāvābhāve
ṭhsaṃyogāderāto dhātoḥ' iti niṣṭātakārasya nakāraḥ | śrāṇā u
yavāgūḥ | māṃsamiśra odano māṃsaudanaḥ |
ṭhañeva kasmānnokta iti | lāghāvātsa eva yukto vaktumiti bhāvaḥ | na
hyatreti | dve apyete prakṛtī pūrvameva vṛddhe, yo'pi
ṭhvṛddhinimitasya' iti puṃvadbhāvapratiṣedhaḥ, sa ṭiṭhanyapi ṭhna
kopadhāyāḥ' iti bhavati | māsaudanagrahaṇamityādi | ṭhañyeva vaktavye
ṭiṭhano vacanamevātra pramāṇamiti teṣāṃ bhāvaḥ ||
bhaktādaṇanyatarasyām || 4|4|68 ||
bhajerbhaktam u annam ||
tatra niyuktaḥ || 4|4|69 ||
niyuktamiti prakṛte punaniyuktagrahaṇamarthabhedārthameva,
tamevārthabhedaṃ darśayati--niyukto'dhikṛta ityādi | kiñca--prakṛtaṃ
niyuktagrahaṇaṃ prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇasya dīyata ityasyopādhiḥ, na tasyeha
pratyayārthatvaṃ śakyaṃ vijñātum ||
adhyāyinyadeśakālāt || 4|4|71 ||
adhīte ityadhyāyī, āvaśyake ṇiniḥ, grahyādilakṣaṇo vā | adhyanasya yau
deśakālau śāstreṇa pratiṣiddhau tāvadeśakālaśabdenocyete iti |
apratiṣiddhābhyāṃ deśakālaśabdābhyāmanyatvātparyudāsavṛtyā,
abhakṣyāsparśanīyavat | tadyathā---śūdrādiprāṇibhirbhakṣyamāṇamapi
laśunamabhakṣyamityucyate, spṛśyo'pi caṇḍālo'spṛśya ityucyate,
apratiṣiddhābhyāṃ bhakṣyaspṛśyābhyāmanyatvāt; tadvadihāpi
śmaśānacaturdaśyau svarūpeṇa deśakālāveva santāvapratiṣiddhābhyāṃ
deśakālābhyāmanyatvādadeśakālaśabdenocyete | ṭhadhyanasya'
ityetadadhyāyinā pratyayārthena sannidhāpitatvāllabhyate ||
kaṭhināntaprastārasaṃsthāneṣu vyavaharati || 4|4|72 ||
vyavaharati sambhavati paṇinā samānārthaḥ, āha hi---ṭhvyavahṛpaṇoḥ
samarthayoḥ' iti; asti vivāde---vyavahāre parājita iti, asti
vikṣepe---śalākāṃ vyaharatīti, asti kriyātatve; tadiha caramasya
grahaṇaṃ taddhitasvabhāvādityāha---vyavahāraḥ kriyātatvamiti | yatra deśe
yā kriyā yathānuṣṭheyā tatra tasyāstathānuṣṭhānamityarthaḥ |
vaṃśāḥuveṇavaḥ kaṭhinā yasminvaṃśakaṭhino deśaḥ | vardhrī u
carmavikāraḥ kaṭhinā asminvardhrakaṭhinaḥ, āhitāgnyāditvādviśeṣaṇasya
paranipātaḥ | cakrayuktena śakaṭena caratīti cakracaraḥ, sa
deśānanukrameṇa caran tatrānuṣṭheyāviparītaṃ carannevamucyate |
saṃsthānaprastārau sanniveśau ||
nikaṭe vasati | 4|4|73 ||
araṇyaṃ nivāse yasya sa āraṇyakaḥ, ṭharaṇyānmanuṣye' iti vuñ |
bhikṣuḥ - saṃnyāsī | grāmātkrośe iti | ṭhyataśca nirddhāraṇam' iti
pañcamī | ayaṃ ca viviṣo'bhidhānasvabhāvāllabhyate ||
āvasathāt ṣṭhal || 4|4|74 ||
āvasatyetamiti āvasathaḥ, ṭhupasarge vaseḥ' itiyathapratyayaḥ | ṭhakaḥ
pūrṇo vidhiriti | prāgvahatīyasya ṭhako vidhānaṃ pūrṇāmityarthaḥ,
avadhiriti pāṭhe pūrṇaḥ prāpta ityarthaḥ ||
tadvahati rathayugaprāsaṅgam || 4|4|76 ||
nanu ya evārtho rathaṃ vahatīti sa eva rathasya voḍheati, tatra tasyedaṃ
rathādyadityeva siddhaṃ nārtho rathagrahaṇena ? nanu tatroktaṃ
rathāṅgaeveṣyata iti, voḍharyapi prayogadarśanādiṣyatām ? idaṃ
tarhi prayojanam---dvau ratau vahati dvirathyaḥ, ṭhdvigorluganapatye'
iti prāgdīvyatīyo lugmā bhūt, ṭhrathasītāhalebhyo yadvidhau' iti
tadantavidhiḥ | ṭhyugyaṃ ca pattre' ityeva siddham | iha
yugagrahaṇamayugyamityatra ṭhyayatoścatadarthe' iti svarārtham,
nipātanasya tu kyabantatrādeṣa svaro na syāt |
rathāṅgavacano'yaṃ yugaśabdaḥ, iha na bhavati---yugaṃ vahati rājā
kaliṃ dvāparaṃ veti | prāsaṅgaśabdo vatsānāṃ damanakāle skanghe
yatkāṣṭhamāsajyate tadvācī gṛhyate, prasajyate iti prāsaṅgaḥ, iha na
bhavati---prasaṅgādāgataḥ prāsaṅgastaṃ vahatīti |
etaccābhidhānasvabhāvāllabhyate ||
dhuro yaḍḍhakau || 4|4|77 ||
dhūrdhūrvateḥ, ṭhbhrājabhāsa' iti kvip, ṭhrāllopaḥ' | dhuraṃ vahatīti
dhurya iti | ṭhna bhakurchuarām' iti pratiṣedhāt ṭhhali ca' iti iti
dīrghābhāvaḥ | ḍhañatra vidhīyate, na tu ḍhakañ | dhaureyo bhavitā
pituriti ca dṛśyate, dhaureyaka iti svārthike kani bhavati |
iha ṭhdhuro ḍhak ca' iti vaktavyam, cakārātprāgghatīyo
yadbhaviṣyati ||
khaḥ sarvaghurāt || 4|4|78 ||
strīliṅganirdeśo nyāyya iti | sarvā cāsau dhūśceti ṭhpūrvakāla'
ityādinā samāsaḥ, ṛkpūrabdhūḥ' ityakāraḥ samāsāntaḥ, tatra dhūḥ
śabdasya strīliṅgatvāt ṭhparavalliṅgaṃ dvandvatatpuruṣayoḥ' iti
vacanāt strīliṅganirdeśasya nyāyyatvam, yathā---ṭhbandhuni
bahuvrīhau' ityatra | dakṣiṇadhurīṇaḥ | dakṣiṇāṃ dhuraṃ vahati, utarāṃ
dhuraṃ vahatīti taddhitārthe samāsaḥ, tato'kāraḥ samāsāntaḥ ||
ekadhurālluk ca || 4|4|79 ||
ekadhurāditi nirdeśaḥ sarvadhurādityanena vyākhyātaḥ | cakāreṇa
kho'nukṛṣyate, tena sa tāvadvidheyaḥ, pratyayādarśanasya ca luk
saṃjñā | na cānyo'tra pratyayaḥ, tena khasyaiva lugvijñāyate, tasya yadi
luk syāccakāreṇānukṛṣya vidhānamanarthakaṃ syāt |
ekadhurāllugiti vaktavyam, luk svabhāvādanantarasva khasya
prākaraṇikasya yato vā vidhiranumāsyate, tadāha---tasya ca
tugbhavatīti ekadhurīṇa iti | ekāṃ dhuraṃ vahatīti taddhitārthe samāsaḥ,
tatrokto'kāraḥ samāsāntaḥ, tataḥ khaḥ ||
śakaṭādaṇ || 4|4|80 ||
śakaṭādaṇvidhānamanarthakam | kathaṃ śākṭa iti ? ṭhtasyedam' ityaṇ
bhaviṣyati, yo hi śakaṭṃa vahati śakaṭasyāsau voḍhā bhavati ?
tatrāhuḥ---ārambhasāmarthyādatrāpi tadantavidhiḥ, tena dve śakaṭe
vahati, dvaiśakaṭa iti prāgdīvyatīyo lugna bhavati ||
halasīrāṭṭhak || 4|4|81 ||
iha yo halaṃ vahati saraāā ca tasyāsau voḍhā bhavati, tatra tasyedaṃ
halasīrāṭṭhagityeva hālikaḥ saurika iti siddham, nārtho'nena ?
atrāhuḥ---ārambhasāmarthyādatrāpi tadantavidhiḥ, dvaihālikaḥ,
dvaisīrikaḥ, traisīrika iti luṅ na bhavatīti ||
saṃjñāyāṃ janyāḥ || 4|4|82 ||
jāmāturvayasyeti | sā hi praṇayakalahādau janīṃ jāmātuḥ samīpaṃ
prāpayati | janī vadhūrucyata iti | jāyate'syāṃ garbha iti kṛtvā |
ṭhjanivadhyośca' iti vṛddhipratiṣedhe ṭhkṛdikārādaktinaḥ' iti ṅīṣ ||
vidhyatyadhanuṣā || 4|4|83 ||
pādau vidhyanti padyā iti | tadantītyarthaḥ | ṭhpadyatyatadarthe iti
padbhāvaḥ | ūravyā iti | ṭhorguṇaḥ', ṭhvānto yi pratyaye' |
nanvasamarthatvāditi | sāpakṣamasamarthaṃ bhavatītyasāmarthyam, pratyayārtho
hyatra bāhyam, karaṇaṃ dhanurapekṣate | nanu vyadhanamatra sāpekṣam,
karaṇakriyayoḥ sambandhāt, vyadhanaṃ ca pradhānam,
kriyāpradhānatvādākhyātasya, bhavati ca pradhānasyaṃ sāpekṣasyāpi vṛttiḥ,
yathā---rājapuruṣaḥ śobhana iti ? bhavatu kriyāpradhānamākhyātam,
taddhitastu svabhāvātsādhanapradhānaḥ | kriyā tu guṇabhūtetyuktam sā ca
dhanurapekṣata ityasāmarthyam | anabhidhānacceti |
atraikopapatyantaramanabhidhānameva darśayati | na hīti | ṭhdhanuṣā padyaḥ'
ityukte itthambhūtalakṣaṇā sahayogalakṣaṇā vā tṛtīyā gamyate, na tu
pādau dhanuṣā vidhyatītyayaṃ vivakṣito'rthaḥ | avaśyaṃ caitadevaṃ
vijñeyam---asamarthatvādanabhidhāanāccātra pratyayo na bhavatīti | yo
hi manyate---ṭhadhanuṣeti pratiṣedhātpratyayo na bhavati' iti, tasya
śarkarābhiḥ pādau viddhyati kaṇṭakairūrū viddhyatītyatra pratyayaḥ
syādeva ? evaṃ tarhi viśeṣopalakṣaṇaparo'tra dhanuṣeti nirdeśaḥ, na
tu dhanuṣaḥ karaṇatvapratiṣedhapara ityarthaḥ | dhanuṣpratiṣedheneti |
ṭhnityaṃ samāse'nutarapadasthasya' iti ṣatvamupalakṣaṇatvameva
pratipādayati | yasyāmiti | teneha na bhavati---cauraṃ viddhyatīti
| sambhāvyate hi pracyavacchedanādikāyāṃ corasya vyadhanakriyāyāṃ
dhanuṣaḥ karaṇatvam ||
dhanagaṇaṃ labdhā || 4|4|84 ||
labdheti tṛnantametat, tṛjante tu ṭhkartṛkarmaṇoḥ kṛti' iti
ṣaṣṭha|la bhavitavyam | tṛnante tu ṭhna lokāvyayaniṣṭhā' iti
pratiṣedhād dvitīyaiva bhavati ||
vaśaṅgaṃtaḥ || 4|4|86 ||
ṭhvaśa kāntau', vaśanaṃ vaśaḥ, ṭhvaśiraṇyorupasaṅkhyānam' ityac |
kāmaḥuicchā, tāṃ prāpta iti | parecchānugāmītyarthaḥ ||
padamasmin dṛśyam || 4|4|87 ||
nirdeśādeva prathamā samarthavibhaktiriti | dvitīyā tu na bhavati;
dṛśyamiti kyapā karmaṇo'bhihitatvāt | śakyārthe kṛtyapratyaya iti |
tena yogyatve sati padasparśanābhāve'pi padyaḥ kardama iti prayoga
upapadyata iti bhāvaḥ | mudrāu sanniveśaḥ, pratirūpā mudrā pratimudrā |
nātidravo nātiśuṣka iti | pāṃsavo'ti nātyalpā nātibahulāḥ
padyāḥ ||
mūlamasyāvarhi || 4|4|88 ||
prathamāsamarthāditi | dvitīyāyā nimitābhāvānnirdeśādeva prathamaiva
bhavatīti bhāvaḥ | ṭhvṛhū udyamane', vādirayaṃ na bādiḥ | dṛśyate hi
ṭhudvṛha rakṣaḥ sahamūlamindra hyasmuṣmik pravṛhāṇa',
ṭhtadvavarhātmanodevā' iti ca āvarhaṇamāvarhaḥūtpāṭanam,
āvarho'syāstītyāvarhi, suṣṭhua pakvā na śakyante saṃgrahītum |
madhyato lūyamāne kośasthā api yasyāmavasthāyāṃ pateyustāmavasthāṃ
prāptā ityarthaḥ ||
saṃjñāyāṃ dhenuṣyā || 4|4|89 ||
yaśca pratyayo nipātyata iti | kutra ? anirdiṣṭārthatvātsvārthe,
tadāha---yā dhenurutamarṇāyeti | kathaṃ punaryati prakṛte yapratyayo
nipātyate ? tatrāhāntodāto'pi hyayamiṣyata iti | yati hi
ṭhtitsvaritam' iti svaritaḥ syād, antodātaśceṣyate, na kevalaṃ
saṃjñāyām, api tvantodāto'pītyapiśabdasyārthaḥ ||
gṛhapatinā saṃyukte ñyaḥ || 4|4|90 ||
anyasyāpītyādi | gṛhapatirhi yajamānaḥ, sa yathā gārhapatye kāryāṇi
karoti tathā dakṣiṇāgnāvāhavanīye ca, bhūyo vā''havanīye;
tasmādanyasyāpi gṛhapatinā yogo'sti | yadyevam,
tatrāpyatiprasaṅgaḥ ? ityata āha---tatreti | apara
āha---gṛhapatiragniviśeṣaḥ, tena saṃyogo
gārhapatyasyaivāgnihotre'pi gārhapatye agnaye gṛhapataye
prajāpataye, patnīsaṃyājeṣu ca tatraivejyate iti , tatrāpi
gṛhapatiragnirgṛhyate na yajamāna ityatra saṃjñādhikāra eva śaraṇam
||
nauvayodharmaviṣamūlamūlasītātulābhyastāryatulyaprāpyavadhyānāmyasamasamitasammiteṣu || 4|4|91 ||
tatra nāvādīnāṃ prathamamūlāntānāṃ pañcānāṃ dvitīyamūlādīnāṃ ca
trayāṇāṃ pūrvaṃ pṛthakpṛthak dvandvaṃ kṛtvā tato dvayoraparo
dvandvaḥ kṛtaḥ, na tvaṣṭānāṃ yugapatsahavivakṣā; ki siddhaṃ bhavati ? na
mūlayoḥ sārūpyādekaśeṣo bhavati | kā punaratra samarthavibhaktiḥ ?
ityata āha---pratyayārthadvāreṇeti | dvāram u mukham, upāyaḥ | iha
tāryādayaḥ pratyayārthāḥ, tatsambandhe karaṇe kartari hetau
tulyārthayoge ca yathāsambhavaṃ tṛtīyaiva bhavati | nāvyamiti | atra
tāvataraṇakriyāyāṃ karaṇatvam |
vayasā tulya iti | tatra hetumāha---yo yena vayastulyaḥ sa taṃ prati
vayasyaḥ | śatrau na bhavatīti | kiṃ tu mitra eva bhavati |
nanu ceti | dharmeṇa prāpyaṃ sukhādi, phalamapi dharmādanapetameva;
kāryasya kāraṇāvinābhāvāditi praśnaḥ | dharmaṃ yadanuvartata iti |
anādiḥ śiṣṭasamācārastajjanyo vā''tmaguṇo dharmaḥ,
yadanuṣṭhānamanuvartate taddharmādanapedatam, phalaṃ tu
dharmādapaityeveti kutaḥ ? ityāha---kāryavirodhitvāditi | dharmasya
kāryaṃ sukhānubhavaḥ, kāryaṃ virodhi nāśakaṃ yasya sa kāryavirodhī,
tasya bhāvaḥ kāryavirodhitvaṃ tasmādityarthaḥ | utpanne hi phale dharmo
naśyati, anyathā sakṛddharme kṛta svargamanubhavataḥ prabhavo na syāt |
vadhamarhatītyartha iti | vadhyaśabdasya ṭhdaṇḍādibhyo yaḥ' ityatrārthe
vyutpāditatvāt|
anāmyamabhibhavanīyamiti | anekārthatvāddhātūnāmāpūrvo namirabhibhave
vartate |
paṭādīnāmutpattikāraṇamiti | paṭādīnāmutpatyarthaṃ
vaṇigbhirviniyuktaṃ yadvastu tanmūlaśabdavācyamityarthaḥ | teneti |
mūlena | taditi | mūlyam | śeṣīkriyata iti |
śeṣīkaraṇamevātrābhibhava ityarthaḥ | guṇabhāvamāpadyate
kathamityāha---mūlaṃ hi saguṇaṃ mūlyaṃ karotīti | mūlyamiha kartṛ,
mūlaṃ karma, paṭādiṣu vikrīyamāṇeṣu yanmūlātiriktaṃ vastu lābho
nāma tanmūlyam, guṇo bhāgaḥ, sa punariha mūlyameva, tena saha
vartate saguṇaḥ, hiśabdo hetau | etaduktaṃ
bhavati---yasmānmūlyamātmanaiva bhāgabhūtena sabhāgaṃ mūlaṃ karoti
tasmānmūle mūlyabhibhūyate śeṣīkriyate, mūlye sati tena guṇena
saguṇaṃ mūlaṃ bhavatiḥ iyameva cāvanatiḥ, ayamevābhibhavaḥ, idameva
śeṣīkaraṇam | loke tu yāvatā dravyeṇa paṭādiko vikrīyate tatra
samudāye mūlyaśabdaḥ prasiddhaḥ, naṃ mūlatirikte bhāge, sa ca
mūlyasambhavādautatrāpi krayadravye mūlyaśabdaprayogaḥ siddho bhavati |
sītā u halāgram, sampūrvādiṇaḥ ktaḥ, samitam u saṅgatam,
nimnonnatādirahitaṃ kṛtamityarthaḥ, samīkṛtamiti yāvat |
dvisītyamiti | dvābhyāṃ sītābhyāṃ samīkṛtamiti taddhitārthe samāsaḥ,
tataḥ pratyayaḥ |
tulayā sammitaṃ tulyamiti | atra tulyārthayoge tṛtīyā | yadyapi
tadyoge ṣaṣṭha|lti bhavati, tathāpi nāvādibhissāhacaryātulāśabdādapi
tṛtīyāsamarthādeva pratyayaḥ | ata eva
pūrvamuktam---ṭhtṛtīyāsamarthavibhaktirlabhyate' iti | ṣaṣṭha|lntādapi na
kaściddoṣaḥ, nyāyastu kathitaḥ | kathaṃ punastulyasya tulayā
sadṛśatvamata āha---yatheti | evaṃ tadapīti | tadapi tulyaṃ
pratiyoginaṃ sādṛśyena paricchinati, etad vyutpādyatvena
pradarśitam | sadṛśaparyāyastulyaśabdaḥ, nāvayavārthaḥ kaścit, ata eva
ṭhtulyāsyaprayatnaṃ savarṇam' ityatroktam---ṭhtulyaśabdaḥ sadṛśaparyāyaḥ'
iti ||
dharmapathyarthanyāyādanapete || 4|4|92 ||
nirdeśādeveti | satyarthasambhave'rthāntarasya vā sambhave sati
nirdeśāditi draṣṭavyam, ṭhdhuro yaḍḍhako' ityatrātiprasaṅgo
nodbhāvanīyaḥ | saṃjñādhikārādabhidheyasya niyata iti | śāstrīyāt
patho yadanapetaṃ tat pathyam, na tu tasmādanapetaścoraḥ ||
cchandaso nirmite || 4|4|93 ||
pratyayārthasāmardhyaṃ labhyate iti | nirmāṇe cchandasaḥ karaṇatvāt |
iṣṭaparyāyaścandaḥ śabdo gṛhyate iti na vedavacanaḥ, nāpi
triṣṭuabādivacanaḥ | etacca saṃjñādhikārāllabhyate | yadyapi svacchandato
hi vacasāṃpravṛttiḥ, ṭhcchandānuvṛttidutsādhyā'
ityādāvakarāntaścchandaśabda icchāparyāyaḥ, tathāpi tasyaiva
dhātorasunnantasyecchāvācitvamaviruddhaṃ ceti manyate ||
uraso'ṇ ca || 4|4|94 ||
aurasaḥ putra iti | ātmanotpādita ityarthaḥ |
saṃjñādhikārādabhidheyaniyama iti | urasā nirmitaṃ sukhamityādau na
bhavati ||
hṛdayasya priyaḥ || 4|4|95 ||
hṛdayam u antaḥ karaṇam, priyam u prītikaram | hṛdyamiti | ṭhhṛdayasya
hṛllekhayadaṇlāseṣu' iti hṛdādeśaḥ ||
bandhane carṣau || 4|4|96 ||
ṣaṣṭhīsamarthāditi | bandhanayoge kṛdyogalakṣaṇā karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī |
ṛṣirvedo gṛhyate iti | ṭhtaduktamṛṣiṇā' ityādau darśanāt |
yatsvādhyānasampanne vasiṣṭhādavṛṣiśabdaḥ, tasya grahaṇaṃ na bhavati;
saṃjñādhikārāt ||
matajanahalātkarṇajalpakarṣeṣu || 4|4|97 ||
pratyayārthasāmarthyalabdheti | karaṇādayaḥ pratyayārthāḥ, tadvacanāḥ
karaṇādayaḥ śabdāḥ kṛdantāḥ, tadyoge yathāyatham ṭhkartṛkarmaṇoḥ
kṛti' iti ṣaṣṭhī bhavati | saṃjñādhikārāddhalasambandhācca karpaśabdo'pi
kriyāvacano gṛhyate, na parimāṇaśabdaḥ | matasya karaṇamiti karmaṇi
ṣaṣṭhī | janasya jalpa iti kartari | jalpaśabdo bhāvasādhanaḥ, ata evātra
bhāvaḥ sādhanaṃ veti noktam | halasya karṣaṃ iti karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī,
karaṇasya vā kartṛtvavivakṣāyāṃ kartari | dvihalya iti |
ṭhrathasītāhalebhyo yadvidhau' iti tadantavidhiḥ ||
tatra sādhuḥ || 4|4|98 ||
sāmanya iti | ṭhye cābhāvakarmaṇoḥ' iti prakṛtibhāvaḥ | pravīṇaḥ u
nipuṇaḥ, yogyaḥ u samarthaḥ | tatra hi paratvāditi | ṭhtasmai hitam'
ityanena caturthīsamarthātpratyayo vidhīyate, anena tu
saptamīsamarthātena nātra ṭhvipratiṣedhe param' ityetatparatvāparatvaṃ
vivakṣitam, ki tarhi ? iṣṭavācī paraśabdaḥ, upakāralakṣaṇe sādhau
prākkrītīyānāmeveṣṭatvāt ṭhtasmai hitam' ityanena vidhinā
bhavitavyamityarthaḥ | etacca saṃjñādhikārāllabhyate ||
pratijanādibhyaḥ khañ || 4|4|99 ||
janaṃ janaṃ prati pratijanamiti ṭhyathārthe--yadavyayam' iti
vīpsāyāmavyayībhāvaḥ | pratijane sādhuriti |
ṭhtṛtīyāsamaptamyorvahulam' | parasyakulam, amuṣyakulamiti |
ṣaṣṭhīsamāse'smādeva nipātanāta ṣaṣṭha|la aluk | pūrvasūtra
uktam---ṭhsādhuḥ pravīṇo yogyo vā gṛhyate, nopakārakaḥ', tatra
prākkrītīyānāmeveṣṭatvāditi, iha tu na tathetyāha---yatreti |
prākkrītīyā bādhyante iti | aprāptiratra bādhaḥ; na hi
caturthyantādvidhīyamānānāṃ saptamyantebhyaḥ prāptirasti | tatra
prākkrītīyā na bhavantīti vaktavye bādhyata
ityuktam---ṭhcaturthyantebhyo'pyanabhidhānātprākkrītīyā na bhavanti'
iti darśayitum ||
bhaktāṇṇaḥ || 4|4|100 ||
bhaktāstaṇḍulā iti | bhaktayogyāḥ, triphalīkṛtatvāt ||
pariṣado ṇyaḥ || 4|4|101 ||
ṇapratyayo'pyatreṣyate iti | ṭhpāriṣadā kṛtireṣā tatrabhavatām',
ṭhsarvavedapāriṣadaṃ hīdaṃ śāstram' iti ca bhāṣyakāraprayogāt ||
pathyatithivasatisvapaterḍhañ || 4|4|104 ||
patantyaneneti panthāḥ, ṭhgameriniḥ' ṭhpatestha ca'; atati satataṃ
gacchatītyatithiḥ, na vidyate tithiryasya so'pyatithiḥ, ekamapi
dinamatrāsthita ityarthaḥ | vasanaṃ vasatiḥ, ṭhvaseśca' ityatipratyayaḥ, tatra
yogyā vāsateyī rātriḥ | svapatirādyaḥ, svapateryogyaṃ svāpateyaṃ
dhanam ||
samānatīrthe vāsī || 4|4|107 ||
vasatīti vāsī, nipātanāṇṇiniḥ, grahyāderākṛtigaṇatvādvā
sādhuriti | nivṛtamiti | tena kiṃ siddhaṃ bhavati ? ityāha---vāsīti
pratyayārtha iti | sādhurityasyānuvṛtau tu tasyaiva viśeṣaṇaṃ
vāsigrahaṇaṃ syāt | tīrthaśabdeneha gururucyata iti |
prayāgāditīrthasādharmyāt | tarantyaneneti tīrtham, tarateḥ kthan
| mukhyasya tīrthasya grahaṇaṃ na bhavati; saṃjñādhikārāt ||
samānodare śayita o codātaḥ || 4|4|108 ||
okāraścodāta iti | titsvaritasyāpavādaḥ | śayitaḥ sthita iti |
śeteḥ sthitāvapi vṛteḥ, āmāśayaḥ, jalāśaya iti yathā | samānodarya
iti | uddīryata ityudaram, udi dṛṇāteralacau
pūrvapadāntalopaścetyalacoranyataraḥ | samānaṃ ca tadudaraṃ ca
samānodaram, ṭhpūrvāparapratham' ityādinā samāsaḥṣa tataḥ pratyayaḥ ||
sodarādyat || 4|4|109 ||
yakārādau pratyaye vivakṣita iti | ṭhvibhāṣodare' ityatra ṭhtīrthe yaḥ'
ityato ya ityanuvartate, tatra ya ityeṣā viṣayasaptamīti darśayati |
o codāta iti tu nānuvartata iti | yavidhānasāmarthyāt ||
bhavecchandasi || 4|4|110 ||
aṇādīnāṃ ghādīnāṃ cāpavāda iti | ṭhtatra bhavaḥ' iti prāptānām |
sati darśanete'pi bhavantīti | tadyathā---muñjavānnāma parvatastatra bhavo
mauñjavatastasyeti bhakṣaḥ | medhyāyeti | atra ṭhyato'nāvaḥ'
ityādyaudātatvaṃ prāpnoti, antasvaritaṃ cādhīyata iti ||
pāthonadībhyāṃ ḍa|lṇ || 4|4|111 ||
pātho'ntarikṣamiti | pāti bhūtādyavakāśadāneneti kṛtvā | yadyapi
ṭhpāterbalerjuṭ', ṭhudake thuṭ', ṭhanna ce' iti annodakayoḥ
pāthaḥ--śabdo'suni vyutpādyate, tathāpi bāhulakādantarikṣe'pi
bhavati ||
veśantahimavadbhyāmaṇ || 4|4|112 ||
veśantaḥ u palvalam, ṭhviśerjha ca', tatra bhava āpaḥ vaiśāntyaḥ ||
srotaso vibhāṣā ḍa|lḍḍa|lai || 4|4|113 ||
ṭhsruhībhyāṃ tuṭ ca' ityasun | sretaḥunadīpravāhaḥ ||
sagarbhasayūthasanutādyan || 4|4|114 ||
ṭhartigṛbhyāṃ bhan', girati gīryate vā garbhaḥ | yutā
bhavantyasminyūtham, ṭhtithapṛṣṭhagūthayūthaprothāḥ' iti kthanpratyayānto
nipātitaḥ | nutirnutam, ṭhnapuṃsake bhāve ktaḥ'|
sagarbhādayastrayo'pi karmadhārayāḥ ||
tugrād ghan || 4|4|115 ||
ṭhturustuśamyamaḥ sārvadhātuke' ityata auṇādiko ran guḍāgamaḥ ||
agrādyat || 4|4|116 ||
ṭhṛjrendrāgra' ityagraśabdo nipātitaḥ | sāmānyeneti | ṭhbhave cchandasi'
iti | tābhyāṃ bādhā mā bhūditi punarvidhīyata iti | evamapi
yadgrahaṇamanarthakam, agrādityevāstu, prākaraṇiko yadbhaviṣyati;
atha vā ṭhagrād ghacchau ca' iti cakārādbhaviṣyati,
ṭhagrapaścāḍiḍamac' ityasya samuccayo na śakyaḥ, videśasthatvāt ?
evamapyanantarasya ghanaḥ samuccayo vijñāyeta | yogavibhāge
punaranantaro ghaneva syāt, yogavibhāgasāmarthyānna bhaviṣyati | atha
katham ṭhtāśca eva cādhyajananaḥ', ṭhetacchive vijānīhi brāhmaṇādhyasya
lakṣaṇam' iti bhāṣāyāṃ prayogaḥ ? chandovadṛṣayaḥ kurvanti ||
ghacchau ca || 4|4|117 ||
cakārastugrāddhanityasyānukarṣaṇārtha iti | pūrvameva vihitasya
yato'nukarṣaṇe prayojanābhāvāt ||
samudrābhrāda ghaḥ || 4|4|118 ||
samunatīti samudraḥ, undeḥ ṭhsphāyitañci' iti rakpratyayaḥ | apo
bibhartītyabhram, mūlavibhujāditvātkaḥ | tasya lakṣaṇasyeti | tasya
pūrvanipātasya yallakṣaṇaṃ tasyetyarthaḥ | vyabhicāritvāditi |
vyabhicārasya cāyameva nirdeśo liṅgam ||
barhiṣi datam || 4|4|119 ||
ṭhbṛhernalopaśca' itīsipratyayaḥ, barhiḥ ||
dūtasya bhāgakarmaṇī || 4|4|120 ||
dūtādbhāge ṭhtasyedam' ityaṇi prāpte vacanam, karmaṇi tu
dūtavaṇigbhyāṃ cetyaupasaṃkhyānike ye ||
rakṣoyātūnāṃ hananī || 4|4|121 ||
rakṣerasuni rakṣaḥ ṭhkamimanijani' ityādinā | yātestau yātuḥ |
yātuśabdo rakṣaḥ paryāyaḥ | ṭhvirūpāṇāmapi samānārthānām'
ityekaśeṣastu na bhavati; bahvarthābhidhāyisvarūpaparatvena sūtre
bhinnārthayornirdeśāt | nirdeśādeva samarthavibhaktiriti | sā punaḥ
ṭhkartṛkarmaṇoḥ kṛti' iti karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī | vahuvacanaṃ
stutivaiśiṣṭa|ljñāpanārthamiti | taddhi bahuvacanātpratyayavidhyartham,
anyathā dvitvād dvivacanameva nyāyyaṃ syāt | kathaṃ
punarbahuvacanena stutivaiśiṣṭa|lṃ jñāpyate ? tatrāha---bahūnāmiti |
bahuvacanāntātpratyaye bahūnāṃ rakṣasāṃ hanane sāmarthyamudbhāvyate
mantre | tathā ca stutiviśiṣṭā sampūrṇā bhavati | yogaścāyaṃ
śaiṣikayoraṇcchayorapavādaḥ ||
revatījagatīhaviṣyābhyaḥ praśasye || 4|4|122 ||
rayirasyāstīti revatī, ṭhrayermatau bahulam' iti
bahulavacanātsamprasāraṇamam | ugitvānṅīp, nakṣatre tu
gaurāditvānṅīṣ | jagacchabdācchatṛvadbhāvānṅīp |
ṣaṣṭhīsamarthebhya iti | ṭhśaṃsu stutau' ityasmāt ṭhkṛtyalyuṭo
bahulam' iti bhāve kyap, tadyoge karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī bhavati, haviṣe
hitā haviṣyā, ṭhugavādibhyo yat' ||
asurasya svam || 4|4|123 ||
na suro'suraḥ u surapratipakṣaḥ | atha vā ṭhaseruran', asyatyasyate
vetyasuraḥ ||
māyāyāmaṇ || 4|4|124 ||
mīyate'nayeti māyā u asadarthaprakāśanaśaktiḥ | māṅ auṇādiko yaḥ |
neti vaktavye'ṇgrahaṇaṃ lāghave viśeṣābhāvāt ||
tadvānāsāmupadhāno mantra itīṣṭakāsu luk ca matoḥ || 4|4|125 ||
matunirhrāsaḥ u matorapacayaḥ | tadvānityavayavena samudāyo
nidiśyata iti | sa vivakṣito varca śabdādiravayavo'sminmantralakṣaṇe
samudāye'stītyevamekadeśārthābhidhāyinaḥ sarvanāmnaḥ samudāye
matubayaṃ vihita ityarthaḥ | varcaḥ śabdo yasminmantre'stīti | sa
punaḥ kumbheṣṭakopadhānamantraḥ---ṭhbhūtaṃ ca stha bhavyaṃ ca stha devasya vaḥ
savituḥ prasavaḥ' ityādikaḥ | varcasyā upadadhātīti | yathā varcasyā
bhavanti tathopadhātītyarthaḥ | tejasvānmantraḥ---ṭhvasu ca stha vāma ca stha
devasya vaḥ savituḥ' ityādikaḥ | vayasvanto
mantrāḥ---ṭhtryavirvayastraṣṭuab' ityādikāḥ, ṛtumanto
mantrāḥ---ṭhmadhuśca mādhavaśca' ityādikāḥ | mantrasamudāyādeva mā
bhūditi | nanu tadvānityasminnasati ṭhsamarthānāṃ prathamādvā' iti
vacanādāsāmiti prathamaṃ nirdiṣṭatvāt ṣaṣṭha|lntādiṣṭakāvācina
upadhāne mantre pratyayavidhiḥ prasañjanīyaḥ ? satyam ; āsāmiti prathamaṃ
na kariṣyata iti matvā praśnaprativacane, tataśca tadvānityasyābhāve
ṭhtryavirvayastriṣṭuaplandaḥ' ityamupadhānamantra āsāmiṣṭakānāmiti
vākyaṃ syāt, tataścetinā parāmṛṣṭānmantrasamudāyādeva pratyayaḥ
prāpnoti | varcasvānupasyānamantra ityādi | upasthānaṃ
mantreṇābhimantraṇaṃ vivakṣitam, ṭhśivena mā cakṣuṣā' ityādikaḥ
kumbheṣṭakābhimantraṇe viniyuktaḥ | aṅgulimānityādi | yadyapi
sarvāsāmiṣṭakānāmaṅgulimānhasta upadhānaḥ, tathāpi
yāstūṣṇīmupadheyā iṣṭakāstāsu mantravyāvṛtyarthatayā
viśeṣaṇamarthavat---eṣāṃ kapālānāmityatra mā bhūditi |
strīliṅganirdeśādatrāprasaṅga iti ceti ? evamapi śarkarāsu
prasaṅgaḥ |
anekapadasambhave'pīti | asati tvitikaraṇe mantre bahūnāṃ sambhavādyena
kenacetpadena tadvānmantro gṛhyaṃ ta tathā padaikadeśena
varṇasamudāyena, itikaraṇātvaya matiprasaṅgo na bhavati |
matubgrahaṇamutarārtham aśvimānityatra matupa eva lugyathā syāt,
hanemābhūditi | iha tu matvantātpratyayavidhānātasyaiva tugbhaviṣyati
| varcaḥ śabdādāvasuprabhṛteraprasaṅgaḥ, uṇādīnāmatryutpannatvāt
iha ṭhprāṇabhṛta upadadhāti' ityādāvabhedopacārātpratyayābhāvaḥ ||
aśvimānaṇ || 4|4|126 ||
so'śvimāniti | yadyapi bahavo'śvimanto mantrāḥ ṭhdhruvakṣitiḥ'
ityādikāḥ, tathāpi sāmānyāpekṣamekavacanam ||
vayasyāsu mūrdhno matup || 4|4|127 ||
vayasyāsviti | cchandasi yā vayasyā iṣṭakā ucyante tāsvityarthaḥ |
tāśca bahvyaḥ, tāsvantaścatasro mūrdhanvatyaḥ, ṭhviṣṭambhovayaḥ'
ityādivayasvadbhirmantrairupadheyāḥ, tatra ca yadyapi mūrddhā vayaḥ
prajāpatiścchanda ityantima ekasminneva mantre mūrddhaśabdo'sti, tathāpi
sāhacaryād ṭhviṣṭambho vayaḥ' ityādyāścatvāro mūrdhanvanta ucyante,
yathā---cchatriṇo yāntīti, tena mūrddhanvatīrupadadhātīti bahuvacanam
| mūrddhanvānapi bhavatīti | nanu ṭhano nuṭ' iti cchandasi nuḍ
vidhīyate ? satyam ; yathā sūtrakāreṇa chāndasameva padaṃ
prayuktam---ṭhvayasasyāsu' iti, tathedamapi vṛttikāreṇa, mūrdhanvānapi
bhavati cchandasītyarthaḥ | ṭhvayasyāśca tāḥ mūrdhanvatyāśca' iti ṭhubhayathāpi
cchandasyabhidhīyate' ityuktaṃ bhavati |
yatra mūrddhanśabda eva kevala iti | yathā---ṭhagne yaśasvinyaśase samarpaya'
ityādike mantre | tato mā bhūditi | tadabhidhāyino
mūrddhanśabdādityarthaḥ | mūrddhanvata iti vaktavyamiti | ṭhtadvān' iti ca'
luk ca matoḥ' iti cānuvartate, tataśca mūrddhanvata iti yuktaṃ
vaktumiti bhāvaḥ | iha tu gāyatrīḥ purastādupadadhāti, ṭhtejo vai
gāyatrī teja eva mukhato dhate mūrddhanvatī bhavati' iti mukhyo
gāyatrīṣu mūrdhaṃnvatīśabdaḥ prathamaṃ matubantaḥ prayuktaḥ, kiṃ kāraṇam ?
tadupadhānamantreṣu ṭhagnirmūrdhā bhuvaḥ' ityādiṣu vayaḥ
śabdasyābhāvāt ||
matvarthe māsatanvoḥ || 4|4|128 ||
matvarthagrahaṇāllabdharmarthaṃ darśayati---prathamāsamarthādityādi |
māsatanvoriti ṭhkṛṣicamitanidhanisajjikharjjibhya ūḥ'
ityūkārāntastanūśabdaḥ sūtre nirdiṣṭaḥ, na tu ṭhbhṛmṛśīṅ
tṛcaritsaritanimimasjibhya uḥ' ityukā rāntaḥ; ṭhdvandve ghi' iti
pūrvanipātaprasaṅgāt | anantarārthe ceti | na kevalaṃ matvarthamātra
iti caśabdasyārthaḥ |
lugakārekārarephāścetyādi |ṭh rādiphaḥ' ityatra varṇāditi na
sambadhyate, tena samudāyanirdeśe'pi iphaḥ kṛtaḥ | anye tu raśabdā
iti paṭhanti, pratyaya ityadhikāro'kārādibhiḥ sambadhyate, na tu lukā
| tapanaṃ tapaḥ, sahanaṃ sahaḥ, bhāvo'sun, ṭhtadasminnasti' iti sūtreṇa
vihitasya yato luk | kathaṃ punaratra napuṃsakatvam, yāvatā
taddhitaluki satyabhidheyavalliṅgena bhavitavyam ? ata
āha---napuṃsakaliṅgaṃ chāndasatvāditi | iṭ u annam,
iṣyamāṇatvāt | ūrk u balam, ṭhūrja balaprāṇanayoḥ',
tābhyāmakāraḥ pratyayaḥ---iṣaḥ, ūrjaḥ | śocanaṃ śuk,
pūrvavatkvip, ātapātirekeṇa śarīrādeḥ śoṣaḥ, tadvānmāsaḥ
śuciḥ | evaṃ śukraḥ |
atra chāndasatvādevāyasmayāditvadbhatvājjaśtvābhāvaḥ, tadeva
cchando'dhikāre lugādīnāṃ vidhānādbhāṣāyāṃ
śuciśukādīnāmanyāyyaḥ prayogaḥ syāt, vyutpatyantareṇa vā,
avyutpannā vā nabhasyādayaḥ śabdā māseṣu vartante |
iṣorjaśabdāvarśāadyacpratyayāntau, matvarthīye rapratyaye
pṛṣodarāditvājjaśtvābhāve śukra iti bhavati,
śocaterantarbhāvitaṇyarthādauṇādike kipratyayaye kṛte śuciriti
bhavati, śocayati saṃtāpayati prāṇina iti kṛtvā |
abhedopacārānnabhaḥ prabhṛtīnāṃ māseṣu vṛttiḥ, nabhasyaprabhṛtayastu
ṭhtatra sādhuḥ' iti yadantāḥ, ṭhmatau cchaḥ sūktasāmnoḥ' ityatra
yathāntareṇāpyarthagrahaṇaṃ matvarthe pratyayo labhyate, tathehāpi lapsyate;
nārtho'rthagrahaṇena ||
madhorña ca || 4|4|129 ||
atrāpi bhāṣāyāṃ madhuyogānmāso madhuḥ, tasya prajñādiṣu
pāṭhādādyaudātatvam ||
ojaso'hani yatkhau || 4|4|130 ||
yadgrahaṇamanarthakam, ṭhkhaśca' ityeva vaktavyam, cakārātprākaraṇiko
yadbhaviṣyati ? naivaṃ śakyam; ṭhkhaśca'
ityucyamāno'nantarasūtravihitasya ñasya samuccayo vijñāyeta,
tasmādyadgrahaṇam ||
kha ca || 4|4|132 ||
yogavibhāga ityādi | kecitpunarekameva yogamadhīyate | tathā
ca---ṭhyathāsaṃkhyāmanudeśaḥ samānām' pratyayavidhyartho
bahuvacananirdeśaḥ, bahuvacanāntāt pratyayotpatau yathāsaṃkhyamiṣyata
iti | utarārthaśceti | utaratra khasyaivānuvṛttiryathā syāt, yato mā
bhūditi ||
pūrvaiḥ kṛtaminiyau ca || 4|4|133 ||
bahuvacanāntenetyādi | bahuvacanāntātpratyayavidhyartho
bahuvacananirdeśaḥ | bahuvacanāntātpratyayotpatau yathā praśaṃsā
gamyate---pūrvairbahubhiḥ kriyata iti pratīteḥ, tena pūrvaśabdaśca
vṛddheṣu puruṣeṣu pravartata ityarthaḥ ||
sahasreṇa saṃmitau ghaḥ || 4|4|135 || 
nirdeśādeva samarthavibhaktiriti | sā punastulyārthayoge tṛtīyā |
sammita eva lakṣayitavya iti | kiṃ kāraṇ ? ityāha---tatreti | cchandasi
hi tatra sammite prayogo dṛśyate ||
somamarhati yaḥ || 4|4|137 ||
ṭhcchandasi' ityadhikārādbhāṣāyāṃ somyaśabdasya sādhutvaṃ
cintyam---ṭhāyuṣmānbhava somyeti vācyo vipro'bhivādane' iti |
kecitsaumyeti vṛddhiṃ paṭhanti | saumyaśabdo darśanīyavacanaḥ
sukhādivat ||
maye ca || 4|4|138 ||
maya iti mayaḍartho lakṣyate iti | śabde kāryasyāsambhavāt | tatra
yathāyogaṃ samarthavibhāktariti | āgate pañcamī, vikārāvayavayoḥ
ṣaṣṭhī, prakṛtavacane prathamā ||
vasoḥ samūhe ca || 4|4|140 ||
ośrāvayetyādikasyākṣarāṇi gaṇyante,
saptadaśātmakaścchandasyo'kṣarasamūhaḥ | prajāpatiḥ prajāpatinā dṛṣṭaḥ |
hastau pṛṇasveti pṛṇātiḥ pūraṇakarmā ||
nakṣatrād ghaḥ || 4|4|141 ||
samūha iti nānuvartata iti | tenānirdiṣṭārthatvātsvārthe pratyaya
utpadyata iti bhāvaḥ ||
śivaśamariṣṭasya kare || 4|4|143 ||
karotīti kara iti | pacādyac | sāmarthyalabhyā ṣaṣṭhī
samarthavibhaktiriti | sā punaḥ kṛdyogalakṣaṇo karmaṇi | bhāṣāyāṃ
śivatātiprabhṛtīnāṃ sādhutvaṃ cintyam |
iti śrīharadatamiśraviracitāyāṃ padamañjaryāṃ caturthasyādhyāyasya
caturthaḥ pādaḥ
| samāpto'yaṃ caturtho'dhyāyaḥ |
--------------------|||||||||||||||||||-------------------| tasmai kṣīgurave namaḥ |
kāśikāvṛttiḥ

padamañjarī

prāk krītācchaḥ āvatsīya iti| || 5|1|1 ||
atidohanādvatsānprati hito na bhavati godhugityevaṃ prakṛtyā nañā
ca yugapatpratyayārthasya sambandhaḥ, pradhānabhūtaśca pratyayārthaḥ| bhavati ca
pradhānasya sāpekṣasyāpi vṛttiḥ,
pradhānatvādevānekopakāryatvasyāvirodhāt, ṭhsāmānyāprayogaḥ'
iti liṅgācca| kiñca--viśeṣato'tra jñāpakamasti yadayaṃ natro
guṇapratiṣedhe ṭhsampādyarhahitālamarthāstaddhitāḥ' ityāha,
tajjñāpayati--ṭhbhavatyevañjātīyake'pi viṣaye taddhitaḥ' iti, anyathā
sampādyarhahitālamarthā ye taddhitāstadantānyutarapadāni natro
guṇapratiṣedhe pravṛttinimitapratiṣedhe vartamānātparāṇi na
sambhaveyuḥ| tatra pūrvaṃ pratyayaḥ, praścānnañsamāsaḥ| ata eva
yatnasādhyatvādavatsīya ityāderupanyāsaḥ| yastu vatsādanyasmai hitaḥ,
yo vā vatsīyādanyaḥ, na tatra kiñcidayatnasādhyam |
atha kimarthamiyānavadhirupādīyate, yāvatā na hyasya ṭhprāgvateṣṭhañ'
ityārabhya ye yogāḥ ṭhtena krītam' ityetasmātprāk paṭhitāḥ, teṣu
vyāpāro'sti, na hi tatra kaścidartho nirddiśyate, tataśca
ṭhprākṭhañaḥ' iti vaktavyam, ṭhprāgvateṣṭañ' ityayameva ca
pratyāsannaṣṭhañagrahīṣyate, na viprakṛṣṭaḥ ṭhlokasarvalokāṭṭhañ'
ityādiḥ? ityata āhārtho'vadhitvena gṛhīta iti| gṛhīto
grahītumiṣṭaḥ| ayamabhiprāyaḥ-- avaśyamatrārtho'vadhitvena grāhyaḥ, anyathā
ṭhprāk ṭhañaḥ' ityucyamāne'vadhinā sajātīyasyāvadhimato'bhāvādarthāḥ,
prakṛtayo vā'vadhimatvena gṛhyaeran-prāk ṭhaño ye'rthāḥ, yā vā
prakṛtaya iti| tatra prakṛtipakṣe'dhikārasya nadīsrotorūpeṇa
pratiprakṛtyupaśthānād ṭhugavādibhyo yacchaśca' iti yacchayoḥ
sannidhānādaviśeṣādutsargāpavādabhāvo na syāt,
tavyatavyānīyarāmiva vikalpa eva syāt| arthe tvavadhitvena gṛhīte
prāk krītādye'rthāsteṣvasyopasthānaṃ bhavati| avadhisajātīyo
hyavadhimān bhavati, yathā--ṭhmāsātparaḥ' iti kālaḥ pratīyate,
ṭhgrāmātpūrvaḥ' iti deśaḥ, ṭhalo'ntyātpūrvaḥ' ityaleva,
tato'tiprasaṅgo na bhavati| katham? samānārthe prakṛtiviseṣā
dutpadyamāno yadādiḥ prakṛtyantare sāvakāśaṃ chṃa bādhate|
yathā--takraṃkauṇḍinye dadhi, ato'rtho'vadhitvena gṛhīta iti| nanu ca
ṭhprāka ṭhañaḥ' ityucyamāne bhavatu nāmaighaṃ prākṭhaño yāḥ prakṛtaya
iti, tathāpi yadādiviṣaṣaye chāe na bhaviṣyati, jñāpakāt, yadayam
ṭhvibhāṣā havirapūpādibhyaḥ' iti vibhāṣāṃ śāsti,
tajjñāpayati-nānyaviṣaye chāe bhavatīti, evaṃ ca kṛtvā ccha
ityevādhikāro'stu, nārtho'vadhinirdeasena, jñāpakācca
pratisūtramupasthāne'pyanyaviṣaye na bhaviṣyati, prāgvateṣṭhañityādike
tu prakāraṇe nāsyādhikāraḥ, adhikārantareṇāvaṣṭabdhatvāt ? satyam;
pratipatigauravaparihārārthastvavadhinirdeśaḥ, sa cāvadhirartha eva
nirdeśyaḥ, na pratyayaḥ, anyathā ṭhlaśunaṃ ca bhakṣitaṃ vyādhiśca na nivṛtaḥ'
ityetadāpadyeta ||

ugavādibhyo yat || uvarṇāntātprātipadikād gavādibhyaśceti ||
5|1|2 ||
uvarṇādergaśabdādervaśabdādeśca yadbhavatītyartho na bhavati,
gavādigaṇapāṭhataḥ| sanaṃgurityādi|
carmavikāralakṣaṇasyāño'vakāśaḥ-vārdhra carma, vāratraṃ carmeti,
uvarṇāntalakṣaṇasya yato'vakāśaḥ--śaṅkavyam, picavyamiti;
