sanaṅgorubhayaprasaṃṅge paratvādañprāpnoti| carurnāma iviriti|
sthālīvacanasya caruśabdasya takadadhikaraṇe haviṣyupacāradvṛttiḥ|
ṭhvibhāṣā havirapūpādibhyaḥ' ityatra havirviśeṣavācināṃ grahaṇam, na
svarūpasya; tasya gavādiṣu pāṭhāt| viparyayastu na bhavati--iha
viśeṣagrahaṇaṃ tatra svarūpagrahaṇamiti; gavādiṣvasañjātavirodhitvena
svarūpagrahaṇe bādhakābhāvāt| ataḥ ṭhvibhāṣā ivirapūpādibhyaḥ'
ityatraiva viśeśagrahaṇamiti sthite tasyāvakāśaḥ--āmikṣyam,
āmikṣīyam; puroḍāśyāḥ, puroḍāśīyā iti|
annavikārebhyaśceti paṭha|lta iti| tasyāvakāśaḥ--surāḥ, suryāḥ,
surīyāḥ, odanyāḥ, odanīyā iti, uvarṇāantasakṣaṇasya yataḥ sa eva;
carusaktubhyāmubhya prasaṅge paratvādvibhāṣā prāpnoti, tatra sarvatra
pūrvavipratiṣedhena yatpratyaya eveṣyata iti| ayameva nityo yatpratyaya
ityarthaḥ|
nabhaṃ cādeśamāpadyata iti| bhasaṃjñakaṃ ca na bhavatadītyayaṃ tvartho na
bhavati, vyākhyānāt| tadarthameva hi gaṇasūtraṃ vyākhyātam, prāyeṇa
hi vṛttikāro gaṇasūtrāṇi na vyācaṣṭe| nabhyo'kṣa iti|
cchidravadrathāṅgaviśeṣaḥ-- nābhiḥ,
tacchidrānupraviṣṭakāṣṭhaviśeṣaḥ--akṣaḥ, sa tadanuguṇatvātasmai hita
ityucyate| añjanaṃ tailakṛtābhyaṅgaḥ, tadapi snehanatvānnābhaye
hitam| yatu bhāṣya uktam--ṭhnābhernabhabhāve pratyayānupapatiḥ
prakṛtyabhāvāt' iti, tannabhyaṃ cakramiti prayogābhiprāyam| na hi
cakrasya nābhivikṛtiḥ, api tvavayavaḥ| nāpi tādarthyamasti;
avayavino'vayavārthatvābhāvāt| tena ṭhtadartha vikṛteḥ prakṛtau'
ityatrārthe nabhyaṃ cakramiti naiva siddhayati| hitārthastvāśaṅkya eveti
na sarvathā pratyayānupapatistatra vivakṣiteti bhāvaḥ|
śarīrāvayavādyaditi yati kṛte iti| paratvāditi bhāva| nābhyaṃ
tailamiti bhavitavyamiti| athātrāpi nabhabhāvaḥ kasmānna bhavati ?
ityāha--gavādiyateti| śuna ityādi| śvanityasya samprasāraṇaṃ
yatpratyayaśca bhavati, pakṣe dīrghaśca tatsañiyogeneti| yadā dīrghatvaṃ
tadā śune hitaṃ śunyaṃ śūnyamiti vā, ṭhnastaddhite' iti tatra vartate,
samprasāraṇe ca kṛte nedamannantam, kāmaṃ dīrghapakṣe
tadvidhānasāmarthyāṭṭilopo na syāt, pakṣāntare tu prāpnoti,
samprasāraṇaṃ bādhakabādhanārtham, anyathā prakṛtibāvaprasaṅgāt ? evaṃ
tarhi cakāradvayamatra paṭha|lte, tatrekaḥ samprasāraṇasamuccaye draṣṭavyaḥ,
tatrānyasya samuccetavyasyābhāvātsamprasāraṇameva punarvidhīyate| tatra
punarvidhānaṃ tu tadrūpasyaivāvasthānārthaṃ bhaviṣyati| ūdhaso'naṅ
ceti| ṭhnaśca' iti noktam; lāghave viśeṣābhāvāt|
ūdhaḥśabdasyānaṅadeśo bhavati yatsanniyogena--ūdhanyaḥ, ṭhye
cābhāvakarmaṇoḥ' iti prakṛtibhāvaḥ ||

kamlācca saṃjñāyām || 5|1|3 || 
ayaṃ yogaḥ śakyo'vaktum| kathaṃ kambalya iti ?
nipātanādevaitatsiddham ṭhaparimāṇavistācitakambalyebhyo na
taddhitaluki' iti| idaṃ tarhiprayojanam--saṃjñāyāmiti vakṣyāmiti ?
etadapi nāsti prayojanam; parimāṇaparyudāsena paryudāse prāpte
tatra kambalyagrahaṇam--parimāṇasya ca saṃjñā kambalyaśabdaḥ| evaṃ tarhi
svarārthaṃ vacanam, nipātanena hi parimāṇe kambalyaśabdaḥ
sādhurityetāvadavagamyate, na tu yadanto'yamiti,
tataścāntasvaritatvaṃ na syāt| atha nipātana evāntasvaritatvaṃ paṭha|leta
? tatra vyākhyānaṃ śaraṇam, vyākhyānācca laghu sūtram ||

vibhāṣā havirapūpādibhyaḥ || 5|1|4 ||
havirviśeṣavācibhya iti| svarūpasya grahaṇaṃ na bhavati; tasya gavādiṣu
pāṭhāt| vipararyayastu na bhavati-tatra viśeṣāṇaṃ grahaṇamiha
svarūpasyeti; asañjātavirodhitvena tatraiva svarūpagrahaṇasya
nyāyyatvāt| annavikārebhyaśceti| annavikārāḥuannaprakārāḥ,
adanīyaviśeṣā ityarthaḥ, tebhyaśca vibhāṣā yad bhavati-odanyāḥ,
odanīyāḥ| yadyevam, apūpādīnāṃ kiṇvaparyantānāṃ pāṭho'narthakaḥ,
annavikāratvādeva siddheḥ, surāprakṛtidravyaṃ kiṇvam ? nānarthakaḥ,
prāpañcārthatvāt|
apara āha-yadā sādṛśyādināpūpādibhyo'rthāntare upacaryante, tadartha
eṣāṃ pāṭha iti ||

tasmai hitam || 5|1|5 ||
tasmai iti| ṭhhitayoge caturthī vaktavyā' iti caturthī| apara
āha-ayameva nirdeśo jñāpako hitayoge caturthī bhavatītyasyeti,
taccintyam; ṭhcaturthī cāśiṣyāyuṣyamadrabhadrakuśalasukhārthahitaiḥ' iti
aśiṣi viṣayaviśeṣe hitayoge caturthyāḥ sambhavāt ||

śarīrāvayavādyat || 5|1|6 ||
śarīraṃ prāṇikāya iti| etenaitaddarśayati-śīryata iti śarīramiti
śrṛṇāterīranpratyayamutpādya yadyapi śarīraśabdo vyutpādyate, tathāpi
yogarūḍhatvātprāṇikāya eva vartate, na ghaṭādāviti ||

khalayavamāṣatilavṛṣabrahmaṇaśca || vrahmaṇyamiti| || 5|1|7 ||
pūvavaṭṭilopābhāvaḥ| vṛṣaśabdo'yamakārānto gṛhyate, na tu
nakārāntaḥ; anyathā'sandehārthaṃ nakāralopamakṛtvaiva nirdiśeta,
yathā-ātmanviśvajaneti| asti ca nakārāntastatra vaktavyam, tato'pi
yadbhavatīti, anyathā tatra che ṭilope ca valṛṣīyamiti prāpnoti,
tasya ca vṛṣaśabde ādeśo vaktavyaḥ, anyathā vṛṣaṇya iti syāt;
brahmaśabdo nakārānto gṛhītaḥ, brāhmaṇaśabdaścākārānto'sti, tatra
vaktavyam-brāhmaṇaśabdādapi yaddhavatīti, anyathā tataścchaḥ syāt, tasya ca
brahman-śabda ādeśo vaktavyaḥ; anyathā brāhmayaṇyamiti prāpnoti ?
ityasminpūrvapakṣe idamāha---vṛṣṇo hitamityādi|
cchapratyayo'pi na bhavatīti| yatpratyayastu tāvatsūtre'nupādānādeva na
bhavati, na kevalaṃ sa eva, api tu cchapratyayo'pītyapiśabdasyārthaḥ| kuta
ityāha--anabhidhānāditi| tadanenāpyavyavikanyāyo darśitaḥ| traiśabdyaṃ
hi naḥ sādhyam--vṛṣāya hitam, vṛṣṇe hitam; tathā vrahmaṇe hitam,
vrahmaṇyam, brāhmaṇāya hitamiti; tatra dvayoḥ śabdayoḥ
samānārthayorekatra vigraha eva, aparatra vigrahaśca vṛttiśca bhaviṣyati,
tadyathā--avikasya māṃsam, āvikam, avermāṃsamiti| rathāya
hitārathyeti| hitārtha eva yathā syādarthāntare mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ
gavādiṣu pāṭho nāṅgīkṛtaḥ|
kecitadantavidhimicchanti---rathasītāhalebhyo yadvidhāviti| apare
tuhalasītābhyāṃ sāhacaryāccāturarthika eva tadantavidhirbhavati, na
tvasminniti ||

ajāvibhyāṃ thyan || 5|1|8 ||
ajaśabdo'yamiha puṃlliṅga upātaḥ, ata eva ṭhdvandve ghi' ityaviśabdasya
pūrvanipātaṃ bādhitvā ṭhajādyadantam' ityajaśabdasya pūrvanipātaḥ
kṛtaḥ, ṭhprātipadikagrahaṇe liṅgaviśiṣṭasyāpi grahaṇam' iti
strīliṅgādapi thyanbhavatyeva--ajāyai hitamajathyam, ṭhtasilādiṣu
thyantālau' iti parigaṇanātpuṃvadbhāvaḥ ||

ātmanviśvajanabhogotarapadātkhaḥ || 5|1|9 ||
ihotarapadagrahaṇaṃ vyāptinyāyena sarvairvā sambadhyeta,
pratyāsatinyāyena bhogaśabdenaiva vā ? tatrādyaṃ pakṣaṃ
nirākaroti---ātmanniti nalopo na kṛta iti| vivakṣitāṃ prakṛti
kārtsnyena nirddiśeyamiti nalopo na kṛtaḥ, pratyekaṃ sambandhe
cotarapadagrahaṇasya naitāvatī prakṛtiḥ syād, ato nalopākaraṇena
pratyekaṃ sambandhe nivārite bhogaśabdenaiva sambadhyate ityarthaḥ|
karmadhārayādiṣyata iti| vyāśyānamatra śaraṇam| ṣaṣṭhīsamāsāditi|
viśvasya jano viśvajanaḥusarvasādhāraṇo vesyādiḥ| bahuvrīheśveti|
viśvo jano'syeti, sa eva veśyādiranyapadārthaḥ|
pañcajanāditi| rathakārapañcamāścatvāro varṇāḥu pañcajanāḥ|
ṭhdiksaṃkhye saṃjñāyām' iti samāsaḥ| pañcajanīyamanyaditi|
ṣaṣṭhīsamāsād bahuvrīheśca ccha eva bhavatītyarthaḥ| yadā ca
prakaraṇādivaśādviśiṣṭasaṃkhyeyavṛttitvāvasāyaḥ saṃkhyā śabdānāṃ tadā
sāpekṣatvābhāvādaviruddhaḥ samāsaḥ, janādinaiva sākṣātsambandhād;
anyathā tu saṃkhyeyasyaiva janāpekṣayā vyatirekaḥ, taddvāreṇa tu
saṃkhyāguṇasyeti sākṣātsambandhābhāvād durlabhaḥ ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ|
sarvajanāditi| ṭhpūrvakālaikasarva' iti karmadhārayaḥ|
mahājanānnityamiti| nityagrahaṇaṃ sarvajanādukto kho mā bhūditi|
tatpuruṣādeviti| atra ṭhkarmadhārayādeva' iti noktam,
tvanirdeśenaiva ṣaṣṭhīsamāsavyāvṛttisiddheḥ|
iha pitṛbhogīṇādiśabdaiḥ pitrādihitasyārthasyābhidhānamiṣyate,
pitrādibhogahitasya tu prāpnoti| bhogaśabdaścāyamastyeva
dravyapadārthakaḥ, tadyathā-bhogavānayaṃ deśa ucyate, yasmin gāvaḥ
sasyāni ca varddante, bhujyata iti bhogaḥ; asti ca kriyāpadārthaḥ,
tadyathā-bhogavānayaṃ brāhmaṇa ucyate yaḥ samyak snānādikāḥ kriyā
anubhavati; asti ca śarīravācī, ahiriva bhogaiḥ paryeti bāhumiti
darśanāt, atra samudāye pravṛtasya bhogaśabdasyaikadeśeṣu phaṇeṣu
prayogaḥ, na cāhereva śarīraṃ bhogaḥ, api tu sarvaṃ śarīram;
anantatvātprayogaviṣayasyāvadhāraṇasya kartumaśakyatvāt| nighaṣṭuaṣu
tu prayogabāhulyādahiśarīre prayogaḥ| sarveṣvapi cārtheṣu
vivakṣitābhidhānaṃ na prāpnoti| tasmānnāyaṃ bogotarapadātkho
vidheyaḥ, pitrādibhya eva tu bhogīnacpratyayo vidheyaḥ--pitre hitaḥ
pitṛbhogīṇa iti| yadyevam, vāvacanaṃ kartavyam, mātrīyaṃ
pitrīyamiti yathā syād; anyathā bhogīnacā bādhitatvācchāe na
syāt| iha ca grāmaṇibhogīnaḥ senānibhogīna iti ṭhiko
hrasvo'ṅyo gālavasya' ityutarapadanibandhanaṃ hrasvatvaṃ na syāt, iha
cābbogīna iti ṭhapo bhi' iti bhakārādau gratyaye vidhīyamānaṃ tatvaṃ
prāpnoti, bogotarapadātu khavidhāne naite doṣāḥ|
arthavirodhastu bhavati, taṃ pariharati--bhogaśabdaḥ śarīravācīti|
tatra śarīraśarīriṇorabhedādya evārtho mātre hita iti, sa eva
mātṛbhogāya hita ityapi vigrahe bhavatīti bhāvaḥ| evaṃ
bhogotarapadātkhavidāne'pyarthavirodhaṃ parihṛtya tatraiva
guṇamāha--kevalebhyo mātrādibhyaśccha eva bhavatīti| evakāro
bhavatītyasyāntaraṃ draṣṭavyaḥ| bhogīnacpratyayavidhāne tu chāe na
syādeva--ityevaśabdasyārthaḥ|
rājācāryābhyāmiti| rājācāryābhyāṃ hitārthe yadi pratyayo bhavati
nityam, bhogotarapadābhyāmeva sa ca kha evetyarthaḥ| na
kevalābhyāmiti| atra ṭhpratyaya iṣyate' ityetāvadapekṣyate, na tu
ṭhkhapratyaya iṣyate' iti; prāptyabhāvāt| ata eva kecit ṭhkhaḥ pratyaya
iṣyate' iti vyastaṃ paṭhanti|
ācāryādaṇatvaṃ ceti| bhogotarapadāditi gamyate, idānīmeva
hyuktam--rājācāryābhyāṃ nityaṃ bhogotarapadābhyāmeveti ||

sarvapuruṣābhyāṃ ṇaḍhañau || sarvāditi| || 5|1|10 ||
anukaraṇatvātsarvanāmakāryābhāvaḥ, sarvanāmāni'
ityanvarthasaṃjñāvijñānāt ṭhprakṛtivadanukaraṇam' ityapi sarvanāmatvaṃ
na bhavati; anāśritārthasya śabdarūpasyānukaraṇāt|
puruṣādvadheti| pratyayārthasāmarthyena ṣaṣṭhīsamarthavibhaktirlabhyate,
kṛte tu tenatyupātaiva tṛtīyā| bhāṣyakāraprayogācca dvandvamadhye'pi
tenetyasya niveśaḥ, tatra vadhe-ṭhtasyedam' ityaṇo'pavādaḥ,
vikāre--ṭhprāṇirajatādibhyo'ñ' ityañaḥ, samūhe'pi ṭhtasya samūhaḥ'
ityaṇa eva, tena kṛte'pi granthātmake--ṭhkṛte granthe' ityaṇa eva|
pauruṣeyaḥ prāsāda ityatra na kasyacidapavādaḥ ||

māṇavacarakābhyāṃ khañ || 5|1|11 ||
manorapatyaṃ kutsitaṃ māṇavaḥ, ṭhapatye kutsite mūḍhaḥ' iti ṇatvam,
caratīti caraḥ, ṭhpacādyac' ṭhcaricalipativadīnām' iti dvirvacanaṃ
vikalpitatvādiha na bhavati, tataḥ saṃjñāyāṃ kan-carakaḥ| khaño
ñitkaraṇaṃ vṛddhayarthaṃ svarārthaṃ ca| carake vṛddhyartham, māṇave
ṭhvṛddhinimitasya ca' iti puṃvadbhāvapratiṣedhārtham-māṇavībhāryaḥ ||

tadartha vikṛteḥ prakṛtau | prakṛtirupādānakāraṇamiti| || 5|1|12 ||
upādīyate'smātkāryamityapādānm, upādānaṃ ca tatkāraṇaṃ ca
upādānakāraṇam| kāryasya hi trīṇi kāraṇāni-upādānakāraṇam,
asamāvāyikāraṇam, nimitakāraṇamiti, tatra kāryeṇāpṛthagdeśaṃ
yadbuddhiḥ kāryeṣvanuvartate, tadyathā-mṛdayaṃ kumbhaḥ, tantaghaḥ paṭa,
hiraṇyaṃ kuṇkaḍalamiti tadupādānakāraṇam|
upādānakāraṇapratyāsannamasamavāyikāraṇam, yathā-tantusaṃyogaḥ
paṭasya| taṭasthaṃ tu kāraṇaṃ nimitakaraṇam-tantu-vāyadi, tadeteṣu
triṣu yadupādānaṃ sā prakṛtiḥ,
tasyavopādānakāraṇasyotaramavasthāntaraṃ vikṛtiriti| anena
kāryopādānayorabhedamāha| yathā hi-śikyaṃ rajjuriti na
tatvāntaram, atha na ca rajjumātre śikyapratitiḥ, evamatrāpi mṛdeva
ghaṭaḥ, tanvava eva paṭaḥ, suvarṇameva kuṇḍalam, atha ca na mṛdādimātre
ghaṭādipratītiḥ| yadyapi vṛkṣādiṣu na bījādipratītirbhavati, yā tu
bījasyānantarāvasthā tatra tatpratītirbhavtyeva| evaṃ
tadanantarādiṣvapyavasthāsu pūrvapūrvā pratītirdraṣṭavya| vṛkṣasya tu
bījaṃ para parayopādānakāraṇamiti sarvamavadātam| vikṛtivācina
iti| nanu ṭhsamarthānāṃ prathamāt' iti vacanātadarkhasya ceha
prathamanirdeśātparakṛteśca tadarthatvātadvācina eva
pratyayaḥprāpnotītyata āha-taditi sarvanāmnā vikṛtiḥ pratyavabhṛśyata
iti| tena vikṛtireva sarvataḥ prathamanirdiṣṭeti bhāvaḥ|
vikṛtyarthāyāṃ prakṛtau pratyaya iti ||
aitena tadarthamiti saptamyāḥ sthāne prathamā, strīliṅgasya ca sthāne
napuṃsakaliṅgamiti darśayati| tadarthagrahaṇenetyādi| iha
prakṛtivikāravākye kvacidyogyatāmātraṃ vivakṣyate-mūtrāya kalpate
yavāgūriti; kvacitprakṛtyantaravyāvṛttiḥ, yathā--yavānāṃ dhānāḥ,
dhānānāṃ saktava iti; kvacitprakṛterananyārthatā, yathā--aṅgarebhya
etāni kāṣṭhānīti, tatreha caramo'rtho vivakṣita iti pratipādanāya
tadarthagrahaṇaṃ kṛtamityarthaḥ| kiṃ siddhaṃ bhavati ? tadāha--na
prakṛtivikāreti| pratyayārthasya cetyādi| vikṛtyarthāyāṃ hi
prakṛtau pratyaya ucyate, tacya tasyāstādarthyaṃ caturthyaiva śakyate
bodhayitumityetatsāmarthyam| kecitviti | teṣāṃ vacanādeva labhyā
caturthī|
yavānāṃ dhānā iti| yeṣāṃ sāmarthyalabhyā caturthī teṣāmidaṃ
pratyudāharaṇām| ye tu ṭhtasmai' ityanuvartayanti, teṣāṃ mūtrāya
kalpate yavāgūriti draṣṭavyam|
yā kāciditi| anupadānakāraṇabhūtāpītyarthaḥ| tatraitatsyād--na kūpa
udakasya kācidapi prakṛtistatrāha--bhavatadi ceti| kuta
ityāha--tatreti| yathaiva hi prayājādīnāṃ
dharmāṇāmutpatyādhāratvāddarśapūrṇamāsau prakṛtiḥ sauryādīnāma,
evamudakadharmāṇāṃ kṣāratvādīnāmutpatyādhāratvātkūpa udakasya
prakṛtirityarthaḥ| yadyevam, udakamapi tasya vikṛtireva sauryādivat
? ityata āha--na tviti| kuta ityata āhātyantabhedāditi|
tasyaivotaramavastāntaraṃ
vikṛtirityatra-kāryakāraṇayornātyantabhedaḥ, mṛdayaṃ kumbha iti
pratīteḥ| nāpyekāntatasyatvamaḥ mṛnmātre kumbhapratītera bhāvat|
tasmātkathañcid bhedaḥ, kathañciccābhedaḥ| etena
jātitadvatorguṇaguṇinośca bhedābhedau vyākhyātau|
na tu kośī tasya prakṛtiriti| atatkāraṇatvādanutpatyādhāratvācca,
carmapinaddhaṃ dārvādinirmitamasyādīnāṃ prakṣepasthānaṃ kośī| nanu ca
prakṛtirvikṛtiriti ca sambandhiśabdāvetau, sambandhiśabdāśca
niyatameva sambandhinamupasthāpayanti, tadyathā--mātari
vartitavyamityukte na cocyate svaśyāmiti, atha ca yā yasyā mātā
tasyāmiti gamyate, evaṃ cātrānyataropadāne'pyanyatarasya pratītiḥ
siddhayati ? ata āha--dvayorapīti| evaṃ manyate--vipūrvo'yaṃ
karotiraratyevāpakāre-daivaṃ me dausthye vikarotīti, asti
ceṣṭānānātve-vikurvate chātrā iti, astyanaucityevikṛtireṣā
strīṇāṃ yatsvātantryaṃ nāmeti, asti kārye--tantūnāṃ vikāraḥ paṭa
iti; tathā prapūrvo'pi karotiranekārthaḥ, āsti kāraṇe-tantavaḥ
prakṛtiḥ paṭasyeti, sāṃkyāstu satvarajastamasāṃ guṇānāṃ
sāmyāvasthāṃ prakṛtimāhuḥ, asti doṣāpagameprakṛtisthaṃ mana iti,
asti svabhāve-prakṛtyābhirūpa iti, asti
dharmāṇāmutpatyādhāre--yathoktaṃ purastāt,
tadevamanekārthatvānnānayoraikāntikaṃ
sambandhiśabdatvamityanyataropādānena vivakṣitaḥ prakṛtivikārabhāvo
labhyata iti| ṭhtasya vikāraḥ' ityatra tu abhidhātasvabhāvādeva kāryasya
grahaṇam, nāpakārādeḥ ||

cchadirupadhibalerḍhañ || 5|1|13 ||
chādyate'neneti cchadiḥ, ṭharciśucihusṛpiccadibhya isiḥ' ṭhismantrankviṣu
ca' iti hrasvatvam| chādiṣeyāṇi tṛṇānīti| yadhā tu
carmavikāraścchadistadā paratvāt ṭhcarmaṇo'ñ' ityañaprāpnoti, tatra
pūrvavipratiṣedhena ḍhañeveṣyate-chādiṣeyaṃ carmeti, āha ca
ṭhyaññyāvañaḥ pūrvavipratiṣedhena ḍhañca' iti| vṛttikāreṇa tu
pratipadavidherbalīyastvānnaitadupanyastamityāhuḥ| neti vyam;
ḍhaño'pi chādiṣeyāṇi tṛṇānītyatra caritārthatvāt|
bāleyāstaṇkaḍulā iti| kathaṃ punaratra prakṛtivikṛtibhāvaḥ, yadā
balyavasthāyāmapi ta eva taṇkaḍulāḥ ? nāvaśyaṃ
yatprakṛtyupamardanenaiva bhavati sa eva vikāraḥ, tadeva
guṇāntarayuktamapi vikāraḥ| asti ca balyavastāyāṃ haridrāyogena
taṇḍulānāṃ guṃṇāntarayogaḥ, antataḥ prakṣālanena śvaityamārdratā
mārdavaṃ sānniveśaviśeṣo vā bhavati| upadhiśabdātsvārthe pratyaya iti|
iṣṭireṣā| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇamadhikāraprāpto neṣyate ?
ityā--upadhīyat ityupadhirityādi| yadeva hi
tadrathāṅgamupadhīyamānatvādupadhiśabdena karmaṇi
kipratyayāntenocyate, yadyapi tasya prakṛtirasti, tathāpi tatra na
ḍhañantaṃ vartate, kiṃ tarhi? tatraiva hi rathāṅge| svabhāvaścātra hetuḥ,
na ca tadeva tasya prakṛtirbhavati, ataḥ svārthe pratyaya eṣitavyaḥ|
athāyamupadhānamupadhiriti ? kriyāvacana upadhiśabdastādarthyamapi
sambhavati, upadhānakriyārthatvād dravyasyetyucyate| evamapi
kriyāvikāro na bhavati, kriyāpi vikāro bavati; bahuvikāro'yaṃ
manuṣyo hasati nṛtyati gāyatīti darśanāt ? satyam; ṭhtadartha
vikṛteḥ prakṛtau' ityatra tu viśiṣṭa eva prakṛtivikārabhāvo
gṛhyate--yatra prakṛterucchedaḥ, yatra vā rūpāntarāpatiḥ| ata eva tatra
vivakṣitaḥ prakṛtivikārabhāva ityuktam ||

ṛṣabopānahorñyaḥ || ārṣabhyo vatsa iti| || 5|1|14 ||
mahāprāṇaḥ saṃhananavān sujātāvayavo yo vatsa ṛṣabhāvasthāprāptaye
poṣyate| carmaṇyapīti| ñyasyāvakāśaḥ--aupānahyae muñjaḥ,
atro'vakāśaḥ--vāhyaṃ carma, upānacchabdāccarmaṇi prakṛtitvena vivakṣite
sati paratvādañprāpnoti pūrvavipratiṣedhena ñya eva bhavati| ye
tu sāvakāśatve styapi pratipadavidhānaṃ balīyastve kāraṇamāhuḥ,
teṣāmayaṃ pūrvavipratiṣedo'saṅtaḥ syāt ||

carmaṇo'ñ || 5|1|15 ||
carmaṇa iti ṣaṣṭhīti| pañcamyāṃ tu carmanśabdātyarmārthāyāṃ prakṛtau
pratyayaḥ syāt--carmaṇe dvīpītyādau, na caivamabhidhānamasti ||

tadasya tadasmin syāditi || 5|1|16 ||
sambhāvane liṅiti| ṭhsabhyāvane'lamiti ca' ityādinā| iṣṭakānāṃ
bahutvenetyādinā sūtrārthamudāharaṇeṣu darśayati|
prakṛtivikārabhāva ityādinā ṭhtadartha vikṛteḥ' ityādinā siddhaṃ
darśayansūtrārambaṃ samarthayate| yogyatāmātrāmiti| tathā
cānyārthāsvapīṣṭakāsu vaktāro bhavanti--prākārīyā iṣṭakā iti|
dvistadgrahaṇamityādi| nanu viparītamidam, pratyekaṃ sambandhe hyatra
dvistadgrahaṇamanarthakam, ato'tra dvistadgrahaṇādanyatra samudāyena
sambandho yukta iti ? satyam; ayamapi tu prakāraḥ sambhavatīti
nyāyaprāptaṃ pratyekaṃ sambandhamasminsūtre sthitvā udāharaṇarūpeṇa
darśayatīti tadidamuktam| nyāyapradarśanārthamiti| pradarśanaṃ
digudāharaṇamityartha| yadi punarayaṃ nyāyo'tra na pradarśyeta, tadā
ṭhtadasyāstyasminnati matup' ityatra samudāyena
samarthavibhktisambandho vijñāyeta, tataśca śākāvānvṛkṣa ityādau yatra
dvābhapyāṃ pratyayārthābhyāṃ samarthavibhakteḥ sambandhaḥ sambhavati, tatraiva
syāt; yatra tvanyatareṇa sambandhaḥ---gomāndevadato vṛkṣvānparvata
iti, tatra na syāt|
atheheti| yadā brāhmaṇārthaṃ nirmitaṃ prāsādaṃ guṇavantaṃ ca devadataṃ
paśyansambhāvayati tadā tasya prasaṅgaḥ ||

prāgvateṣṭhañ || 5|1|18 ||
vakṣyati pārāyaṇaturāyaṇeti| atra tu pradeśe'sya karaṇamutarasūtre
yeṣāṃ paryu dāsastebhyaṣṭhañyathā syāditi--gaupucchikaḥ,
sāmpratikaḥ| ṭhañityevādhikāre siddhe ṭhprāgvateḥ' iti vacanaṃ madhye
yo'dhikāravānapavādaḥ ṭhsarvabhūmipṛthivībhyāmaṇañau',
ṭhśīrṣacchedādyacca' ityevamādistena vicchede'pi ṭhpārāyaṇaturāyaṇa'
ityevamādau ṭhañeva yathā syādityevamartham| yadyapyatra
pratyayo'vadhitvena gṛhītaḥ, tathāpyartheṣvevopatiṣṭhate, na tu
prakṛtiṣu; tenāpavādaviṣaye na bhavati| tatā ca
ṭhśūrpādañanyatarasyām' ityanyatarasyāṃgrahaṇamarthavadbhavati ||

ārhādagopucchasaṃkhyāparimāṇāṭṭhak || 5|1|19 ||
tadarhatīti vakṣyatīti| tadekadeśo'rhaśabdo nirdiśyata iti bhāvaḥ,
tadāha--ā etasmādarhasaṃśabdanāditi| tadarhamityayaṃtvavadhirna bhavati,
yadi syādārhādityanarthakam; prāgvaterityeva siddhatvāt| nanu ca
vatyarthe'pi ṭhako vidhiryathā syādityevamarthamārhāditi vacanaṃ
syād ? evamapyāṅ eva nirdeśaḥ kartavyo
vaterityevābhividhāvākāraḥ| evamapi ṭhupasargācchandasi dhātvarthe'
ityatrāpi vatyarthe ṭhakprāpnoti| tasmādvyākhyānamevātra śaraṇam|
gopucchādīnvarjayitveti| agopucchaśabdātsaṅkhayāvācinaḥ
parimāṇaśabdāccetyayaṃ tvartho na bhavati| yadi syānniṣkādiṣa
droṇaśabdasya parimāṇavācinaḥ ṣaṣṭhiśabdasya saṅkhyāvācinaḥ
pāṭho'narthakaḥ syād ? anenaiva siddhatvānnānarthakaḥ| niyamārtha
punarvacanaṃ syāt-asamāsaeva yathā syāditi ? naitadasti;
vidhiniyamasambhave videreva jyāyastvāt| abhividho vāyamākāra
iti| yadi tu maryādāyāṃ syātasya grahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt,
prāggrahaṇānuvṛtyaiva siddhatvāt, tena kiṃ siddhaṃ bhavati ?
tadāha--arhatyarthe'pi ṭhagbhavatyeveti|
saṅkhyāparimāṇayoḥ ko viśeṣa iti| parimīyate paricchidyate yena
tatparimāṇam, saṅkhyāpi ca paricicchidyate iti praśanaḥ| bhedagaṇanaṃ
saṅkhayeti| bhidyata iti bhedaḥ, mitho bhinnāḥ padārthāḥ te gaṇyante
yena tad bhedagaṇanam| ekatvādisaṅkhaṣāsāmānyopakramatvād
bhedagaṇanī saṃkhyeti na bhavati, bhedagaṇanamityanena
pṛthaktavaniveśitatvamāha| yathoktaṃ pṛthaktavaniveśitatvātsaṅyayā
karmabhedaḥ syāditi| ekatvasaṅkhayāpi bahuṣu buddhyā
sanniveśiteṣu bhedamekamashāyamāha| gurutvamānamunmānamiti|
tulādāvāropya yena dravyāntaraparicchinnagurutvena
palādiśabdavācyena pāṣāṇādinā suvarṇādergurutvamunmīyate,
tadunmānamityarthaḥ| āyāmāmānaṃ pramāṇamiti| āyāmaḥudairghyam, sa
yena mīyate tadāyāmamānam| etacca kvacitriyagabhimukhasya vastuno
bhavati, yathā--vastrāderhastādi, kvacidūrdhvādharadigavasthitasya
bhavati--hāstinamudakam, ūrudvayasamudakamiti| ārohapariṇāhamānaṃ
parimāṇamiti| ārohaḥūcchrāyaḥ, pariṇāhaḥu vistāraḥ;
tābhyāmārohapariṇāhābhyāṃ svagatābhyāṃ yena kāṣṭhādinirmitena
vrīhyādi parimīyate tatparimāṇam| pariḥ sarvatobhāve,
saṃkhyāparimāṇayorviśeṣe pṛṣṭhe unmānādaviśevapradarśanaṃ
prasaṅgena tadviśeṣasyāpyajñānasyāpanayanārtham|
ūrdhvamānamiti| ūrdhvāropaṇād gurutvamānamunmānamiti pūrvokta
evārthaḥ| kilaśabdaḥ prasiddhau| parimāṇaṃ tu sarvata iti|
ūrdhvamānamityupasamastamapi mānamityetadatrāpekṣyate| etadarthame
kecid ūrdhvaṃ mānamiti vyastaṃ paṭhanti| āyāmasteti|
mānamityapekṣyate, karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī| prasiddhastu pāṭhaḥ āyāmastviti|
tatrāyāmaparicchedyartha upacārādāyāmaśabdenoktaḥ| sahkhyā bāhya tu
sarvata iti| pūrvoktādunmānādeḥ sarvato bāhyā, tatrānantarbhāvāt|
tasyāśca saṃkhyāyate'nayeti nirvacanaṃ bhedagaṇanalakṣaṇatvaṃ
vyākhyātavyamityanusandhātavyam ||

asamāse niṣkādibhyaḥ || 5|1|20 ||
ṭhaño'pavāda iti| yena nāprāptinyāyena niṣkādibhyo hi
droṇaparyantebhyaḥ parimāṇaśabdātṣaṣṭhiśabdāṭṭhakaḥ paryudāse ṭhañeva
prāpnoti, atastasyaivāyamapavādaḥ|
tadantāpratiṣedhasyeti| tadantavidhāvapratiṣedhasyetyarthaḥ| yadi tarhi
tadantātpratyayo vijñāyate, evaṃ tarhi
ṭhvyapadeśivadbhāvo'prātipadikena' iti kevalebhyo nopapadyate ?
naiṣa doṣaḥ; asmāsagrahaṇena hi grahaṇavatparibhāṣāyā
nivṛttirākhyātā, tannivṛtau ṭhyena vidhistadantasya' iti tadantatā,
atra svasya ca rūpasya prakṛtatvātkevalādapi bhavati| yastu
manyate---pūrvatropādānasāmarthyātkevalādapi syāditi, tasya hi
lāghavārthaṃ kevalānāṃ pāṭhaḥ syāditi yat kiñcidetat|
ita utaraṃ ceti| kathaṃ punariṣyamāṇo'pi tadantavidhirlabhyate,
yāvatā ṭhgrahaṇatratā prātipadikena tadantavidhirna bhavati' iti
pratiṣdhyate ? asyāḥ paribhāṣāyā anityatvaṃ ca tasyā gargādiṣu
ṭhvājāse' iti samāsapratiṣedhād gamyate| nityatve hi sati
vājaśabdādutpdyamānasya pratyayasya samāse prāptireva nāstīti
samāse pratiṣedhaṃ na kuryāt| dviśūrpamiti| dvābhyāṃ śūrpābhyāṃ
krītamiti taddhitārthe dviguṃ kṛtvā na tāvagadeṣā lugantā
prakṛtiriti ṭhsaṃkhyāpūrvapadādapi ṭhśūrpādañnyatarasyām' ityañeva
kriyate, tasya ṭhadhyardhapūrvadvigorlugasaṃjñāyām' iti luk|
dviśorpikamiti| ṭhparimāṇāntasyāsaṃjñāśāṇayoḥ' ityutarapadavṛddhiḥ|
yaduktam--ṭhita utaraṃ saṃkhyāpūrvapadānaṃ tadantavidhiriṣyate' iti,
yaccoktam--ṭhlugantāyāstu prakṛterneṣyate' iti,
tadubhayamāptāgamena sthirīkartumāha--tathā coktamityādinā ||

śatācca ṭhanyatāvaśate || 5|1|21 ||
kano'pavāda iti| utarasūtreṇa prāptasya|
śatakamiti| ṭhtadasya parimāṇam' iti vartamāmane ṭhsaṃkyāyāḥ
saṃjñāsaṃghasūtrādhyayaneṣu' iti saṃghe pratyayārthe vivakṣite
utarasūkṣatreṇa kaneva bhavati| pratyayārtho'tra saṅgha iti|
śatamadhyāyānāṃ parimāṇaṃ yasya nidānākhyasya granthasya sa iha
pratyayārthaḥ, sa ca śatasaṃkhyāvacchinnāghyāyasamudāyātmaka iti saṃghaḥ
pratyayārtho bhavati| śatameva vastuta iti| śatātasyānanyatvāt tataśca
prakṛtyarthānna bhidyate,yadevādhyāyānāṃ śataṃ prakṛtyābhidhīyate
pratyayāntenāpi tadeveti neha prakṛtyarthātpratyayārthasya bhedaḥ| etena
yatrāvyatiriktaḥ pkayyayārthātprakṛtyarthastatra pratiṣedho bhavati, na
vyatirikta ityetadākhyātam| nanu ca ṭhsaṃghe cānautarādharye',
ṭhsaṅkhyāyāḥ saṃjñāsaṃghasūtrādhyayaneṣu' ityatra ca prāṇisamūhe
saṃghaśabdo gṛṅyate, tatkathamatra granthaviṣayo gṛhyate ?
upacāreṇetyadoṣaḥ| yadi vā saṃjñāsaṃghasūtre śabdasāhacaryādviśiṣṭaḥ
saṃgho gṛhyate, ṭhsaṃghe cānautarādharye' ityatrāpi ṭhcchandonāmni'
ityataścchandograhaṇānuvṛteḥ prāṇī gṛhyate| iha tu
yatnāntarābhāvādgranthasyāpi grahaṇamityadoṣaḥ| nanu ca śate'bhidheye
na bhavitavyam, ihaca śatyaṃ śāṭakaśatam, śatikaṃ śāṭakaśatamityukte
śataṃ pratīyata eva tatkimiti pratiṣedho na bhavati ? ityata
āha--vākyenetyādi| śatyaśatikaśabdhau sāmānyaśabdau,
sāmānyaśabdāsca prakaraṇādikamantareṇa na viśeṣe vartante| na
yāvacchāṭakaśatamityetatpadāntaraṃ prayujyate tāvatpratyayārthasya
śatatvaṃ nāvasīyate| tasmātpadāntarasannidhau
gamyamānatvādvākyārtho'sau bhavati| na śrutyeti| gamyate iti sambandhaḥ|
yatra pratyayāntena padāntaranirapekṣeṇa pratyayārthasya śatatvamākhyāyate,
tatra śrutyā pratyayāntaśravaṇamātreṇaiva gamyate, yathā pratyudāharaṇe
śataṃ parimāṇamasya śatakamityukte gamyate-ekatpratyayārtho'pi
śatameveti| iha tu vākyācchatatvaṃ pratīyate| na ca padasaṃskārakāle
vākyārthasyāṅgabhāvo'sti, tadā tasyānupathānāt|
prakṛtyarthādavyatirikte pratyayārthe pratiṣedho bhavati, na hyatirikte
vākyagamya ityetadāptavacanena draḍhayitumāha--tathā coktamityādi|
śatapratiṣedhe kartavye prakṛtyarthādanyasya ca pratyayārthasya śatatve
satyapratiṣedhaḥ| etaduktaṃ bhavati--yatrānyat prakṛtyarthaṃ śatam,
anyatpratyayārthaśatam, tatra vidhireva bhavati na pratiṣedhaḥ|
kena punaḥ samāse prāpnoti
yatastatpratiṣedhārthamasamāsānukarṣaṇārthaścakāraḥ kriyate ?
ityāha--prāgvaterityādi ||

saṃkhyāyā atiśadantāyāḥ kan || 5|1|22 ||
pañcakaḥ paṭa iti| laukikyāḥ saṃkhyāyā udāharaṇam| bahuka iti|
pāribhāṣikyāḥ| cātvāriśaṃtka iti| ṭhisusuktāntātkaḥ'| 
arthavatastiśabdasya grahaṇāditi| arthavadragrahaṇaparibhaṣayā| ḍateriti|
ityavayavasya tiśabdasyetyarthaḥ| paryudāso na bhavatīti| na
hyasāvarthavalān| katika iti| kā saṃkhyā parimāṇaṃ yeṣāmiti ṭhkimaḥ
saṃkhyāparimāṇe iti ca' iti itiḥ| saptatiśabde tu
saptadaśadarthābhidhāyinaḥ saptaśabdātparimāṇopādhikādasyeti
ṣaṣṭhayarthe tipratyayo bavatīti tiśabdo'rthavān| evaṃ navatiśabde|
aśītiśabde tu yadyapyaśīśabdasyāṣṭasvanyatra na dṛṣṭaḥ prayogaḥ| śāstro
tveṣā vyavasthā--aṣṭānāmaśībhāvastiśca pratyaya iti| viśatiśabde tu
dvayordaśatorvinbāvaḥ śatīśca pratyaya iti tiśabdo'narthaka eva, tataśca
tataḥ kan bhavatyeva-viṃśatikaḥ| evaṃ ca kṛtvā ṭhviśatikātkhaḥ
śatamānaviśatikaḥ' iti nirddeśa upapadte; kintu
ṭhviśatitriṃśadbhayāṃ ḍvunasaṃjñāyām' ityasaṃjñāyāṃ
ḍuvunvidhānātsaṃjñāyāmeva kan bhavati| ṭhatiśadantāyāḥ'
ityatrāntagrahaṇamekasaptatyā krītamityatrāpi paryudāsārtham, anyathā
pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣayā na syāt ||

vatoriḍ vā || 5|1|23 ||
tasya tvaneneti| ṭhcareṣṭaḥ' ityādivatpratyayāntaraṃ tviṇna bhavati;
ṭitkaraṇasāmarthyāt| astyanyaṭṭitkaraṇasya prayojanaṃ ṭita iti
ṅībyathā syāt ? ata ityadhikāre ṅīp, na caiṣo'kārāntaḥ,
ṭitkaraṇasāmarthyādanadantādapi ṅīp syāt,
yathā--ḍityabhasyāpyanubandhakaraṇasāmarthyāt saraja ityatra ṭilopaḥ|
eghaṃ tarhi svaritatvapratijñānena kano'nukarṣaṇasāmarthyādāgamo
bhaviṣyati ? astyanyadanuvṛteḥ prayojanam--iṭā bādho mā bhūt
kanopi vidhiryathā syāditi ? vāvacanādevala kan bhaviṣyati ? idaṃ
tarhi prayojanaṃ syāt-iṭkanau vā bhavataḥ, pakṣe
sāmanyavihitaṣṭhañiti ? tasmādvyākhyānameva śaraṇam| nanu neha
kangrahaṇamasti, yadapi prakṛtam, tadapi prathamānirdiṣṭama,
ṣaṣṭhīnirdiṣṭena cehārthaḥ, vatoriti pañcamī kaniti prathamāyāḥ
ṣaṣṭhī prakalpayiṣyati--ṭhtasmādityutarasya' iti| tāvatka iti|
tatparimāṇamasya ṭhyatadetephabhyaḥ parimāṇe vatup', ṭhā sarvanāmnaḥ'||

viṃśatitriśadbhyāṃ ḍvunasaṃjñāyam || 5|1|24 ||
viṃśaka iti| ṭhti viṃśaterḍiti' iti tiśabdasya lopaḥ, ṭhato guṇe'
iti pararūpatvam| yasyeti lopastu na bhavati, ṭhasiddhavadatrābhāt'
iti tilopasyāsiddhatvāt| nanu subantātaddhitotpatiḥ,
tataścāntarvartinīṃ vibhaktimāśritya padasaṃjñā bhavati, tatkathaṃ
pararūpatm; yā tu ḍvunamapekṣya bhasaṃjñā, sā yena nāpraptinyāyena
ṭhsvādiṣu' iti yā padasaṃjñā tāmeva vādhate, na ṭhsuptiṅntaṃ padam'
ityetāmapi ? etāmapi bādhate| katham ? paratvāt| ata eva ṭhsāmanyaḥ'
ityādau nalopādyabhāvaḥ|
kathaṃ punaratreti| triṃśatkamadhikṛtya praśnapraticane| viṃśatiśabdātu
kanaḥ siddhiḥ prāgeva pratipāditā| yadā tu
dvayordaśatorvaliśabhāvastiśca pratyaya iti pakṣaḥ, tadā
viṃśatikamapyadhikṛtya bhavataḥ ||

kaṃsāṭṭiṭhan || 5|1|25 ||
kaṃsaśabdo'yaṃ kāṃsyapātravācī parimāṇaśabdo gṛhyate, pūrvotaraiḥ
parimāṇaśabdaiḥ sāhacaryāt, na lohaviśeṣavacanaḥ,
nāpyugrasenasutavacana iti darśayati| ṭhaño'pavāgada iti| ikāra
uccāraṇārtha iti| evaṃ ca prakriyālāghavāya ṭikaneva vaktavyaḥ ? tathā tu
na kṛtamityeva|
adhikaṃ iti| ardhaśabdaḥ kārṣāpaṇasyārdhe nirūḍha iti
bhāgavadapekṣayārdhe'sāmarthyaṃ nāśaṅkanīyam|
apara āha--prakaraṇādivaśena bhāgavadviśeṣe niścite sati
nāsāmarthyamiti ||

śūrpādañanyatarasyām || 5|1|26 ||
ṭhaño'pavāda iti| śūrpaśabdasya parimāṇavācitvāt| yadyapi
paripavanaviśeṣaḥ śūrpam, tathāpi viśiśṭasaṃsthānaṃ dhānyādeḥ
parimāṇamapi| śūrpaparimito vā vrīdyadiḥ śūrpaśabdenocyate||

śatamānaviśatikasahasravasanādaṇ || 5|1|27 || 
ṭhakaṭhañorapavāda iti| śatamānaṃ| parimāṇam, sahasraṃ saṃkhyā; tābhyāṃ
ṭhaño'pavādaḥ| viṃśatyā krītaṃ viṃśatikaṃ saṃjñāśabdo'yam,
asaṃjñāyām ṭhviṃśatitriṃśadbhayāṃ ḍvunasaṃjñāyām' iti ḍvunā
bhavitavyam, sā yadi parimāṇasya saṃjñā ? tadā tato'pi
ṭhaño'pavādaḥ| atha tvarthāntarasya, tataṣṭhakaḥ| vasanaśabdātu ṭhaka eva ||

adhyardhapūrvadvigorlugasañjhāyām || 5|1|28 ||
adhyārūḍhamarddhamasminnatyadhyardham, prādibhyo dhātujasyeti bahuvrīhiḥ|
adhyardhapūrvadvigoriti samāhāradvandvaḥ, sautraḥ
puṃlliṅganirddeśaḥ| tasmādadhyardhapūrvātprātipadikād dvigośca
parasyeti| tena ṭhadhyardhapūrvadvigoḥ' iti pañcamyāśriteti lakṣyate|
yadyevam, dvigorluki tannimitagrahaṇam, dvigornimitaṃ
yastaddhitastasya lug bhavatīti vaktavyam, dvābhyāṃ śūrpābhyāṃ krītaṃ
dviśūrpam, dviśūrpeṇa krītaṃ dviśaurpikamityatra dvitīyasya mā bhūt|
tathārthaviśeṣāsaṃpratyaye tannimitādapi yatra taddhitārthadvigunā
sahārtho na bhidyate, tatrātannimitādapi| sa taddhito yasya nimitaṃ na
bhavati tasmādapi dvigoḥ parasya lugbhavatīti vaktavyam-dvayoḥ
śūrpayoḥ samāhāro dviśūrpī, dvaśūrpyā krītamityapi vigrahe
dviśūrpamityeva yathā syāt| tasmād dvigoriti naiṣā pañcamī, kā
tarhi ? ṣaṣṭī--dvigoryastaddhitaḥ| kaśca dvigostaddhitaḥ ? yastasya
nimitaṃ yasmin dvigurmavati| dviśūrpyā krītamityatra
tvanabhidhānātpratyayo na bhaviṣyati| tryaiśabdyaṃ hi naḥ sādhyamdvābhyāṃ
śūrpābhyāṃ krītam, dviśūrpam, dviśūrpyā krītamiti; tatra dvayoḥ
śabdayoḥ samānārthayorekena vigraha eva dviśūrpyā krītamiti, na tu
vṛttiḥ, anabhidhānāt| apareṇa vigrahaśca vṛttiśca-dvābhyāṃ śūrpābhyāṃ
krītaṃ dviśūrpamiti, avyavikanyāyena| vyākhyāto'vyavikanyāyaḥ| idaṃ
tāvadarthatatvam, ṭhdvigorluganapatye' ityatra ca
vṛttikāreṇāpyevameva vyākhyātam, iha tu tadanusāreṇa
gamyamānatvānnaivaṃ vivicya vyākhyātam, yasya taddhitasya lugiṣyate
so'pi dvigoḥ para ityetāvatā dvigoḥ parasyetyuktam|
pāñcalohitikam, pāñcakalāpikamiti| pañca lohinyaḥ
parimāṇamasya, pañca kalāpāḥ parimāṇamasyeti vigṛhya taddhitārthe
samāsaḥ, ṭhtadasya parimāṇam' iti ṭhañ, ṭhbhasyā'ḍhea taddhite' iti
puṃvadbhāvāllohinīśabdasyekāranakārayornivṛttiḥ,
parimāṇaviśeṣasya nāmadheye ete|
pratyayāntasya viśeṣaṇamasaṃjñāgrahaṇāmiti| na tu sannihitasyāpi
dvigoḥ; asaṃjñāyāmiti saptadamīnirddeśāt| vātiṃkakārastu
manyate--ṭhdviguviśeṣaṇamasaṃjñāgrahaṇaṃ
pañcalohita-pañcakalāpaśabdāvapi dvigū kṛtataddhitalukāveva saṃjñe,
tato nārtho'saṃjñāyāmiti pratiṣedhena' iti,
tadāha--ṭhsaṃjñāpratiṣedhānarthakyaṃ ca tannimitatvāllopasya' iti| tasyāḥ
saṃjñāyāḥ lopa eva nimitamityarthaḥ|
adhyarddhaśabdaḥ saṃkhyaiveti| saṃkhyāvācyevetyarthaḥ|
adhyarddhasyāpyekādivat paricchedahetutvāt| ata evādhyarddhena
krītamadhyarddhakamati saṃkhyālakṣaṇaḥ kan bhavati, adhyarddhakaṃsamityādau
taddhitārthe dviguśca| kvaciditi| kansamāsotarapadavṛddhibhyo'nyatra|
saṃkhyāyāḥ kriyābhyāvṛttigaṇane iti| yadā sakṛtphalāṃ tāṃ
kriyāmabhinirvartya tāmeva kurvannardhe nivartate, tadā
kṛtvasuco'bhāvadadhyardha karotītyeva bhavati ||

vibhāṣā kārṣāpaṇasahasrābhyām || 5|1|29 ||
adhyardhasahasramiti| ṭhśatamānaviśatika' iti vihitasyāṇo lak,
alukpakṣe ṭhsaṃkhyāyāḥ saṃvatsarasaṃkhyasya ca' ityutarapadavṛddhiḥ,
idānīmeva hyuktam--ṭhadhyardhaśabdaḥ saṃkhyaiva' iti|
adhyardhasuvarṇamiti| ṭhaño lug, na tu ṭhakaḥ, ārhādityatra
kriyānimitakasya parimāṇasya grahaṇād| yeṣāṃ tu rūḍhiparimāṇasya
tatra grahaṇam, tanmate ṭhako luk| adhyarddhasauvarṇikamiti|
parimāṇāntasyetyutarapadavṛddhiḥ, tatra hyunmānasyāpi grahaṇam;
śāṇapratiṣedhāt| adhyarddhe kārṣāpaṇasya, dvigau sahasrasyetyevamatra
yathāsaṃkhyaṃ neṣyate||

dvitripūrvānniṣkāt || 5|1|30 ||
adhyarddhapūrvagrahaṇamutarārthamanuvartate, iha tu na sambadhyate|
dvigugrahaṇaṃ tu sambadhyate, dvayorniṣkaṃ trayāṇāṃ niṣkamiti
ṣaṣṭhīsamāse mā bhūt| atra ca vyākhyānameva śaraṇam; anyathā
ṭhadyardhapūrvād dvitripūrvācca niṣkāt' iti samucyayo vijñāyeta|
dvinaiṣkikamiti| ṭhgrāgvateṣṭhañ', ṭhparimāṇāntasya'
ityutarapadavṛddhiḥ| dvitribhyāṃ niṣkādityeva siddhe pūrvagrahaṇaṃ
cintyaprayojanam ||

vistācca || 5|1|31 ||
cakāreṇānukṛṣyata iti| tena cānukṛṣṭamutaratra nānuvartate
ityutaratrānuvṛtyabhāva iti bhāvaḥ| bistaśabdaḥ parimāṇavācī ||

viṃśatikātkhaḥ || 5|1|32 ||
ṭhśatamānaviśatika' ityaṇi prāpte tasya ca luki kho'tra vidhīyate|

khāryā īkan || 5|1|33 ||
khāri parimāṇamiti ṭhañi prāpte tasya ca luki īkanvidhīyate|
kevalāyāśceti| ṭhadhyarddhapūrvadvigoḥ' ityadhikārātkevalāyā na
prāpnotīti vacanam| athādhyardhapūrveti na sambadhyeta, tataḥ
kevalāyāmīkanaścaritārthatvādadhyardhapūrvadvigorluk prāpnoti,
dīrghoccāraṇaṃ kimarthaṃ nekanevocyeta, savarṇadīrghatve sati siddham
? yasyetilopaḥ prāpnoti, ikāroccāraṇasāmarthyānna bhaviṣyati,
anyathā kanameva vidadhyāt, ṭhke'maḥ' iti hrasvatve kṛte sati siddham|
avagrahaḥ prāpnoti ? na lakṣaṇena padakārā anuvarttyāḥ,
padakārairnāma lakṣaṇamanuvartyam ||

paṇapādamāṣaśatādyat || 5|1|34 ||
padbāvo'tra na bhavatīti| ṭhpadyatyatadarthe' ityanena| kiṃ
kāraṇamityāha--prāṇyaṅgasyeti| ṭhpādasya padājyātigopahateṣu'
ityatra tāvat prāṇyaṅgasya pādasya grahaṇaṃ
tasyaivājyādibhirgativacanaiḥ sabandhasadbhāvāt padyatītyādāvapi
tasyaivānuvṛttiḥ| iha tu parimāṇamiti| gṛhyate iti śeṣaḥ|
paṇamābhyāṃ sāhacaryāditi bhāvaḥ ||

śāṇādvā || 5|1|35 ||
ṭhaño'pavāda iti| yadyapyunmānavacanaḥ śāṇaśabdaḥ, tathāpyārhādityatra
kriyāparimāṇasya grahaṇādasyapi paryudāsāṭṭhaña eva prasaṅga iti
bhāvaḥ|
śatācceti vaktavyamiti| pūrveṇa nitye yati prāpte vacanam|
yadabhāvapakṣe saṅkhayālakṣaṇasya kano luk ||

dvitripūrvādaṇ ca || 5|1|36 ||
vārtitake darśanātsūtreṣvetatprakṣiptam| trairūpyaṃ bhavatīti|
aṇyekam, yati dvitīyam, ṭhaño luki tṛtīyam ||

tena krītam || 5|1|37 ||
teṣāmiti| asya samarthavibhaktaya ityanenaiva sambandhaḥ, na pratyayārtha
ityanena| na hi teṣāṃ pratyayānāṃ pratyayārthā nirdiśayante ityanvayo
ghaṭate| odanapākaṃ pacatītivadvā kathañcidanvayaḥ|
teneti mūlyāditi| mūlyabhūtārthābhidhāyinaḥ karaṇe yā tṛtīyā sā
ceha samarthavibhatmirityarthaḥ| mūlenānāmyaṃ mūlyamulābha ityuktam|
anyatreti| amūlyādakaraṇe vā yā kṛtīyā tatretyarthaḥ|
anabhidhānādeveti| evakāraḥ paunarvacanikaḥ| kiñca- prasthādayaḥ śabdā
niyataparimāṇānāmarthānāṃ vācakā na mātrayāpi nyūnādhikabhāve
pravartante, na hi yathā jalamiti prasthe'pi bhavati, kuḍave'pi bhavati,
yathā vāgniriti bhrāṣṭrāgnāvapi bhavati, dāvāgnāvapi bhavati; yathā
vā eko vrīhiḥ sampanna ityādau jātyātmanā sarvāsāṃ vyaktīnāmaikyaṃ
pratīyate, tathā prasthādiṣu bhavati| tasmāteṣu vibhaktayabhāve
yāvatasye vācakāstāvadeva gamyate| vākye tu prasthābhyām,
prasthairiti dvivacanabahuvacanabalātāvato'nekasyāvagatirbhavati|
dvakam, trikamiti| atra hi prakṛtereva vācye dvitvabahutve
vibhaktistu karaṇatvamātramācaṣṭe, sā ca prakṛtirvṛtāvapi vidyate| na
hyaekena mudreneti| ekayā mudgavyaktyetyarthaḥ| jātyākhyāyāṃ
tvekavacanāntādapi bhavatyeva| nanu yad niṣkeṇa krītaṃ tasya niṣko
vasno bhavati, tataśca ṭhso'syāṃśavasrabhṛtayaḥ' ityeva siddhaḥ pratyayaḥ,
nārtha etena ? evaṃ tarhi yasya śataṃ mūlyaṃ na bhavatyatha ca tena krītaṃ
kāryavaśātadarthamidam ||

tasya nimita saṃyogotpātau || 5|1|38 ||
śubhāśubhasūcaka iti| tatprayojaka itivatvaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ|
mahābhūtānāmiti| pṛthivyādīnām| dakṣiṇākṣispandanamiti|
pāñcabhautikaśarīre dravyameva ca kriyārūpeṇa pariṇamate iti
dakṣiṇākṣispandanaṃ mahābhūtapariṇāmaḥ, tasya ca śubhasya prati
nimitatvam; jñāpakahetutvād, na tu kārakahetutvāt|
vātikamiti| śamanakopane evātra pratyayārthau, na tu nimitaṃ tābhyāṃ
viśeṣyate| prakaraṇādinā ca tayoranyatarāvasāyaḥ|
sannipātaḥuvātādīnāṃ yugapadudbhavaḥ ||

godvyaco'saṃkhyāparimāṇāśvāderyat || 5|1|39 ||
ṭhañādīnāmiti| ādiśabdena ṭhako grahaṇam| atadguṇasaṃvijñāno
bahuvrīhiḥ, bahuvacanaṃ tu ṭhaka evaikasya viṣayavahutvamāśritya
kṛtam, ṭhako'pavāda ityarthaḥ| kiṃ punaḥkāraṇamevaṃ vyākhyāyate ?
saṃkhyāparimāṇāśvādivarjitādgodvyacaṣṭhaka eva prāptatvāt|
brahmavarcasāditi| brahmaṇo varco vrahyavarcasaṃ vṛtasvādhyāyasaṃpat,
ṭhbrahmahastibhyāṃ varcasaḥ' ityac samāsāntaḥ ||

putrāccha ca || 5|1|40 ||
kathaṃ putrīyaḥ kraturiti, na hi kratuḥ saṃyoga utpāto vā bhavati ?
saṃyujyate'neneti vyutpatyā kraturapi saṃyoga eva| yena
yāgādikaraṇena puruṣaḥ phalena saṃyujyate sa yāgādirapi saṃyogaḥ,
na kevalaṃ sambandha evetyarthaḥ| etena ṭhpuroḍāśasaṃ lokyam'
ityādivyākhyātam ||

sarvabhūmipṛthivībhyāmaṇañau || 5|1|41 ||
saṃyogotpātau prati yathāsaṃkhyaṃ na bhavati, tayoḥ
pratyayārthaviseṣaṇatvena prakṛtibhyāṃ pratyayābhyāṃ cāsambandhāt ||

tatra vidita iti ca || 5|1|43 ||
yogavibhāgo yathāsaṅkhyanirāsārthaḥ, utarārthaśca || 

tasya vāpaḥ || 5|1|45 ||
tasyeti vāpāpekṣayā karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī, na tu kartari, tena devadatasya
vāpaḥ kṣetramityādau na bhavati ||
tadasmin vṛddhyāyalābhaśulkopadā dīyate|| dīyata ityekavacāntaṃ
vṛddhyādibhiḥ pratyekamabhisambaddhyata iti| tena vṛddhayādīnāṃ
bahutve'pi bahuvacanaṃ na bhavatīti bhāvaḥ| pratyekaṃ sambandhastu
dvandvapartināṃ padānāṃ buddhyā niṣkarṣāllabhyate etacca dīyata ityasya
viseṣaṇasya vṛddhyupakramatva uktam, yadā tu yatatprathamāsamartha
dīyate cetadbhavatītyevamupakramyate, paścātu kiṃ punastaddīyata
ityapekṣāyāṃ vṛddhyādayaḥ saṃtadyante tadā na kiñcidyatnasādhyam|
utamarṇadhanātiriktamiti| utamarṇena yaddatam dhanaṃ
tasmādadhikamityarthaḥ, saṃjñā vṛddhistu na gṛhyate; āyādibhiḥ
sāhacaryāt| upādānamūlātiriktamiti| paṭādīnāmupādānaṃ
tantvādi, tasya mūlamutpattikāraṇaṃ dravyam, tasmādadhikaṃ paṭādi
vikrayeṇa yallabhyate sa lābhaḥ, nirveśo bhṛtiḥ, rakṣānimitako
nirveśo rakṣānirveśaḥ, sambandhaṣaṣṭha|la samāsaḥ| śulkagrahaṇaṃ
prapañcārtham, tasyāpyāyaviśeṣatvāt, tathā ca ṭhṭhagāyasthānebhyaḥ' iti
śulkasthānādapi bhavati śaulkaśālika iti| yatra grāmādau vṛddhyādi
dīyate tatra pratyayo vidhīyamānaḥ saṃpradāne na prāpnotītyata
āha--caturthyartha upasaṃkhyānamiti| siddhaṃ tviti| vivakṣātaḥ kārakāṇi
bhavantīti saṃpradānasyaivādhikaraṇatvena
vivakṣitatvātsiddhamiṣṭamityarthaḥ| kva yathetyāha--samamiti ||

pūraṇārddhāṭṭhan || 5|1|47 ||
pūraṇavācina iti| pūryate yenārthaḥ sa pūraṇaḥ, tadvācina ityarthaḥ|
etena ṭhpūraṇa' ityarthasyedaṃ grahaṇam, na tu pratyayasyeti darśayati|
yadi tu pūraṇagrahaṇaṃ svaryeta tataḥ svaritenādhikāragatirbhavatīti
ṭhtasya pūraṇe ḍaṭ' iti pūraṇādhikāravihitā ḍaṭādayaḥ pratyayā
gṛhyaeran, yathā-gostriyorityatra stryadhikāravihitāṣṭābādayaḥ,
tataśca ṭhpūraṇādbhāge tīyādan' ityanantānna syāt, arthagrahaṇe
tato'pi bhavati, tahantamapi hi pūraṇa evārthe vartate,
svārthikatvādanaḥ| tasmādarthagrahaṇameva nyāyyam| ṭhakṭiṭhanorapavāda
iti| pūraṇādārṅīyasya ṭhako'pavādaḥ| arddhādapiarddhācyati
vaktavyamiti ṭiṭhanaḥ| striyāṃ ca viśeṣaḥ, ṭiṭhini hi sati ṅīp
syāt, ṭhani tu ṭāp bhavati| arddhaśabdo rūpakārddhasya rūḍhiriti|
rūpakamukārṣāpaṇam, tadīyasya bhāgasyārddhaśabdo vācakatvena prasiddha
ityarthaḥ| tenārddhika iti bhāgavatsāpekṣatvenāsāmarthyaṃ
nodbhāvanīyamiti bhāvaḥ ||

bhāgādyacca || 5|1|49 ||
bhāgaśbdo'pīti| na kevalamarddhaśabda evetyapiśabdārthaḥ ||

taddharati vahatyāvahati bhārādvaṃsādibhyaḥ || 5|1|50 ||
prakṛtiviśeṣaṇamiti | prakṛtiḥ prātipadikam, tasya viśeṣaṇam,
viśe,ṇaprakārameva darśayati--vaṃśādibhya ityādi| vaṃśādibhya iti
kimiti| bhārāntāditi kasmānnoktamiti bhāvaḥ| ata eva tadantaṃ
pratyudāharati--vrīhibhāraṃ vahatīti| bhārabhūtebhyo vaṃśādibhya iti|
nanu vaṃśādayaḥ śabdāste kathaṃ bhārabhūtā ityata
āha--bāraśabdo'rthadvāreṇa vaṃśādīnāṃ viśeṣaṇamiti|
bārabhūtārthābhidhāyitvādbhārabhūtebyo vaṃśadibhya ityuktamityarthaḥ|
sūtre tu pratyekaṃ sambandhādekavacanam ||

vasnadravyābhyāṃ ṭhankanau|| 5|1|51 || 
vasnaśabdena mūlyamucyate ||

saṃbhavatyavaharati pacati || 5|1|52 ||
pramāṇānatireka iti| ādhāragramāṇādādheyapramāṇasyānādhikyamityarthaḥ|
taduparsjane ca dhāraṇe saṃbhavatervṛttiriti sakarmakatvam|
upasaṃharaṇamavahāra iti| ādhārapramāṇādādheyapramāṇasya nyūnatetyarthaḥ,
tadupasarjane ca dhāraṇe'vaharatervṛteḥ sakarmakatvam, sūtre spaṣṭa
upasargaḥ| nāstyatra niyoga iti| niyogaḥuavaśyambhāvaḥ| tatpacatīti
droṇādaṇ ceti| pacatigrahaṇaṃ sambhavatyavaharatīti nivṛtyartham,
droṇaparimite ca vrīhyādau droṇaśabdastasya pākasambhavāt ||

āḍhakācitapātrātkho'nyatarasyām || 5|1|53 ||
ṭhaño'pavāda iti| na ṭhakaḥ, āḍhakādīnāṃ parimāṇatvāt| pātraṃ
bhājanamapyasti, tasya tu sambhavatyādibhiḥ sambandhānupapateḥ,
āḍhakācitasāhacaryacca parimāṇasyaiva grahaṇam ||

dvigoṣṣṭhÄaśca || 5|1|54 ||
dvyāciteti| ṭhaño luk, ṭhaparimāṇabistācita' iti ṅīpaḥ
pratiṣedhaḥ ||

kulijāllukkhau ca | 5|1|55 ||
anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇānuvṛtyā lugapi vikalpyata iti| tacca
lukkhagrahaṇādvijñāyate, anyathā kulijāccetyeva vaktavyam,
dvigoścetyeva kho'nyatarasyāmiti ca tatra ṭhankhābhyāṃ mukte pakṣe
ṭhañ, tasya ṭhadhyarddhapūrva' iti luk| evaṃ rūpatraye siddhe lukkhagrahaṇaṃ
kurvataḥ sūtrakārasya ṭhluko'pi vikalpa iṣṭa iti lakṣyate' iti
manyate| vāktekakārastu ṭhaño nityaṃ lukaṃ manyamānaḥ pūrvasūtravat
trairūpyamevecchan lukkhagrahaṇaṃ pratyācaṣṭe, ṭhkulijācca' iti siddhe
lukkagrahaṇānarthakyam, pūrvasmin trikabhāvāditi ||

so'syāṃśavasrabhṛtayaḥ || 5|1|56 ||
iha ca śataṃ yasya vakno bhavati sa tena krīto bhavati, tatra tena
krītamityeva siddham nārtho vasnagrahaṇena ? naitadasti;
yogyatāmātre'pyasyedaṃ mūlyamiti vyavahārat ||

tadasya parimāṇam || 5|1|57 ||
iha paricchadahetumātraṃ parimāṇam, na sarvato mānameva; utarasūtre
saṃkhyāyāḥ parimāṇena viśeṣaṇāt| khāraśatika iti|
khāraśabdo'kārānto vārtikakāravacanātsādhuḥ, tena hi ṭhtadasya
parimāṇam' ityatra yogavibhāgaḥ kartavya iti
darśayitumuktam-ṭhanyebhyo'pi dṛśyate khāraśatādyartham' iti|
vārṣaśatika iti| yajñādau parimāṇini pratyayaḥ| ṣaṣṭi
jīvitaparimāṇasyeti| saṃvat sareṣu ṣaṣṭhiśabdaḥ,saṃvatsarasaṃkhyāyā
hi jīvitaṃ prāyeṇa paricchadyate, jīvitaparicchedadvāreṇa tadvato'pi
ṣaṣṭiḥ saṃvatsarāḥ parimāṇamiti| tadasminparimāṇini pratyayaḥ| nanu
yasya ṣaṣṭirjīvitaparimāṇaṃ ṣaṣṭimasau bhṛto bhavati tatra tamadhīṣṭo
bhṛto bhūto bhāvītyeva siddham| evaṃ ca dviṣāṣṭika ityādau
naivādhyarddhapūrvati lukprasaṅgaḥ, tasyānārhīyatvāt, tataśca
samarthavibhakteḥ pratyayārthasya ca punarupādānena vidhānamapi na
kartavyam, na ca jīvitaparimāṇādanyatra punarvidhānena lugabāva
ityate ? evaṃ manye-tamadhīṣṭa ityatra kālāditi vartate, na ca
ṣaṣṭayādayaḥ kālaśabdāḥ| atha kāle saṃkhyeye vartamānatvāte'pi
kālaśabdāḥ ? ramaṇīyādiṣvatiprasaṅgaḥ, ramaṇīyaṃ kālaṃ bhūta iti|
tasmādyaḥ kālaṃ na vyabhicarati sa eva kālaśabda iti| dviṣāṣṭika iti|
ṭhsaṃkhyāyāḥ saṃvatsarasaṃkhyasya ca' ityutarapadavṛddhiḥ ||

saṃkhyāḥ saṃjñāsaṅghasūtrādhyayaneṣu || 5|1|58 ||
parimāṇopādhikāditi| nātra rūḍhiparimāṇaṃ gṛhyate, kiṃ tarhi ?
kriyāśabdaḥ--parimīyate yena tatparimāṇam| saṃkhyāpi ca parimīyata
iti nāsambhavi viṣeṣaṇam, nanvevamapyavyabhicārādaviśeṣaṇam, na
hyaparicchedikā saṃkhyāsti, satyam; iha tu pratyayārthasya saṃghāderyadā
paricchedikā saṃkhyā tadā pratyayo yathā syāt--pañca gāvaḥ
parimāṇamasya pañcako gosaṅga iti; iha mā bhūt--pañca gāvaḥ
saṃbhūtā asya brahmaṇasaṅghasyeti, na hyatra saṅghasyeyatāgamyate,
tasmātpratyayārthasya yadā paricchedikā saṃkhyā tadā yathā syāditi
viseṣaṇamarthavadbhavati|
tatretyādi| ihādaśabhyaḥ saṃkhyāḥ saṃkhyeye vartanta, ?????? sakhyānamātre|
tatra ya eva śakunayaḥ pañcatvasaṃkhyāyuktāḥ pañcanśabdavācyāsta eva
pañcakaśabdasyāpi, tataśca parimāṇaparimāṇibhāvābhāvātsvārtha eva
pratyayo vaktavyaḥ| yadā tu vṛttiviṣaye sambhavatyeva parimāṇī
pratyayārthaḥ--pañcatvasaṃkhyā parimāṇameṣāṃ pañcakāḥ śaṃkunaya iti|
pañcakamadhyayanamiti| pūrvaṃ tu pañcako'dhīte iti sampāṭhāpekṣayā
puṃlliṅganirddeśaḥ, ṭhadhīte' iti ca kṛta ityarthaḥ|
yathā-odanapākaṃ pacatyodanapākaṃ karotītyarthaḥ|
steme ḍavidhiriti| somayāgeṣu cchandogaiḥ kriyamāṇā
pṛṣṭādistutiḥ stemaḥ| pañcadaśa mantrāḥ parimāṇamasyeti| sāmrā
stuvīta, ekaṃ sāma tṛce kiyate iti stutividhiḥ| tatra trikasya
pañcakṛtva āvṛtyā pañcadaśa mantrā bhavanti, saptadaśasome antyāyāḥ
saptakṛtva āvṛttiḥ ekaviśe tṛcasya| ḍitkaraṇamekaviśe
tilopārtham, trayastriṃśādau ṭilopārthaṃ ca| pañcadaśaḥ, saptadaśa
ityatra tu ṭhnastaddhite' ityanenaiva ṭilopaḥ siddhaḥ|
śanśatorḍiniriti| ṭhstome' iti na sambadhyate| atrāpi ḍitkaraṇaṃ
śadantasya ṭilopārtham| pañcadaśina iti| pañcadaśāhāni
parimāṇameṣāmiti ḍiniḥ| etena triṃśino vyākhyātāḥ|
viṃśino'ṅgirasa iti| ṭhāṅgirasāyāsya gautama'
ityādipravarabhedena bhinnāni viṃśatiravāntaragotrāṇi
parimāṇameṣāmityarthaḥ|
yogaścāyaṃ pūrvasyaiva prapañcaḥ || 

paṃktiviṃśatitriṃśaccatvāriśatpañcāśatṣaṣṭisaptatyaśītinavatiśatam ||
5|1|59 ||
paṃktyādayaḥ śabāda nipātyanta iti| prakṛtinirdeśastvayaṃ na bhavati;
paṃktyādibhyaḥ prakṛte'rthe'dhikṛtaḥ pratyayo bhavatīti pañcamyā
anupadānāt, pūrveṇaiva ca siddhatvāt, utareṇa nipātanena
sāhacayacci| pratyayanirddeśo'pi na
bhavati--ṅyāpprātipadikātprakṛte'rthe paṃktayādayaḥ pratyayā
bhavantīti, loke śāstre ca ṭhśatacca ṭhanyatāvaśate' ityādau
kevalānāṃ prayogadarśanād| yatra samudāyaḥ śrūyate, avayavā
anumīyante tannipātanam, viparīto vidhiḥ| pañcānāmiti|
arthagatasya bahutvasya śabde samāropād bahuvacanam,
pañcaśabdasyotyarthaḥ| ṭilopasticca pratyaya iti| nipātyaya ityarthaḥ|
avayavanipātananāntarīyakatvātsamudāyanipātanasya|
yadvā--ṭhnipātanātsiddham' ityasya puṃlliṅgavipariṇāmenānvayaḥ,
kutvaṃ tu cakārañakārayorna nipātyam, ṭhcoḥ kuḥ' ityeva siddham|
pañca padānīti| padaśabdaḥ pādaparyāyaḥ| paṃktiśacchanda iti| tatpunaḥ
padapaṃktiḥ, yasya pañcākṣarāḥ pañca pādā bhavanti| dvayordaśatoriti|
daśadvayarūpasaṃkhyeyamācakṣāṇasya dviśabdasyetyayamatrārtho vivakṣitaḥ| evaṃ
trayāṇām daśatāmityādāvapi draṣṭavyam| śaticca pratya iti|
citkaraṇamantodātārtham| apadatvaṃ ceti| tena jaśtavacartve na
bhavataḥ| atra ṭhtadasya parimāṇamiti vartate' ityuktam, dvau daśatau
parimāṇamasyetyādiśca vigraho darśitaḥ| yadā tu nanuvartate tadā
dviśadāderdaśabdarthābhidhāyinaḥ svārthe pratyayo nipātyaḥ-- dvau
daśatau viṃśatiḥ, trayodaśatastriṃśad iti; tataśca svarthikānāṃ
prakṛtito liṅgavacanānuvṛtedviśabdāderiva
dvivacanabahuvacanaprasaṅgaḥ| viṃśatyādi bhiśca daśatāmabhidhānamiti
gavādibhirvaikyadhikaraṇyameva syād--gavāṃ viṃśatiriti, na tu
viṃśatirgāva iti sāmānādhikaraṇyam, nāpi
dviguḥ---viṃśatigavamiti, tasmādanuvartayam|
athāsyetyanena kaḥ pratinirdiśyate ? parimāṇī| kaḥ punarasau ?
bhinnāni dravyāṇi--dvau daśatau parimāṇameṣāṃ viśatiriti| yadyevam,
viṃśatyādibhirdravyāṇāmabhidhānamiti bahuvacanaprasaṅgādviśatirgāva
iti na syāt, gavāṃ viṃśatirgoviṃśatiriti ca na syād,
vyatirekābhāvāt ? athāsmin pakṣe kiñcicadiṣṭamapi siddham,
āhosviddoṣāntamevāsti ? ityāha--iha viśatigavaṃ triṃśatpūlīti
samānādhikaraṇalakṣaṇo dviguḥ siddhaḥ; tasmānna bhinnāni dravyāṇi
parimāṇīni, etacca sarveṣveva vigrahavākyeṣvasyetyekavacanena
darśitam| kastahiṃ parimāṇī ? saṅghaḥ---dvau daśatau parimāṇamasya
gosaṅgasya ṭhviṃśatitriśadbhayāṃ ḍtun' viśakaḥ saṅga iti na
syāt; saṅgāntarasya parimāṇino'sambhavāt| atomayaṃ
parimāṇibhinnā dravyāṇi tatsaṃghaśca, tatra saṅghaparimāṇini
vyadhikaraṇaprayogāḥ, dravyeṣu tu parimāṇiṣu
samānādhikaraṇaprayogāḥ, tatraiva viṃsatirgāvaḥ parimāṇamasya viṃśako
gosaṅga iti bhaviṣyatītyucyet ? evamapi viṃśatirgāva ityatra
bahuvacanaprasaṅgaḥ, tathā saṅghasya parimāṇatve viṃśatirgosaṅga iti
prāpnoti, na ceṣyate, viṃśaka ityeva hi tatreṣyate| evaṃ tarhi dvāvatra
saṅgau staḥ--dvavyāṇāmekaḥ, dravyavargayordaśatoścāparaḥ; tatra
nipātanasāmarthyāddaśatsaṃghe parimāṇini pratyayaḥ, saṅśca
samudāyamātraṃ na prāṇināmeva kiṃ hi nipātanādalabhyam, tatra
daśatsaṅghasya viṃśatiśabdenābhidhānād gosaṃghe vivakṣite viśatiḥ
parimāṇamasya viśako gosaṅgha iti ca bhaviṣyati, viśatirgosaṅgha
iti ca na bhaviṣyati, gavāṃ viṃśatirgoviṃśatiriti ca bhaviṣyati| nanu
daśatsaṅghasya daśatau guṇinau na gāvaḥ, tena daśatorviśatiriti
prāpanoti, gavāṃ viśatiriti tuna siddhayati ? ucyate; dravalyāṇāṃ
dravyasaṅgasya daśatāṃ daśatsaṅsya ca na pāramāthiko bhedo'sti,
kevalaṃ bapuddhayā parikalpyate, tataśca gavāṃ daśatośca
tātvikabhedābhāvaddaśatsaṅghamapi pratigavāmapi guṇitvamupapadyate|
vyabhicārabhāvātu daśadbhyāṃ viśatitarna viśeṣyate gavādibhireva
tu viśeṣyate, yathā--paṭasya śauklyamiti bhavati, na śuklasya
śauklāmiti vyamicārābhāvāt, tadvadatrāpi| aivaṃ
tāvadvyādhikaraṇaprayogā upapāditāḥ, viṃśatirgāva ityādikāstu
samānādhikraṇaprayogā upapādanīyāḥ, dharmavacanā ete viśatyādayo
guṇavacanā iti śuklādivadbhaviṣyati| yathā hi-paṭasya śuklo guṇa
iti guṇamātre dṛṣṭaḥ śuklaśabdo guṇaguṇinoravyatirekavivakṣāyāṃ
matublopādvā samānādhikaraṇo bavati śuklaḥ paṭa iti| evaṃ
viśatyādayo'pi| 
yadyevam, yathānye guṇavacanā dravyasya liṅgasaṃkhye anuvartante,
yathā---śuklaṃ vastram, śuklā śāṭī, śuklaḥ kambalaḥ, śuklau, śukla
iti, evaṃ viṃśatyādayopyanuvateran ? iha punarviśatirgāvaḥ
viṃśatirbalīvarddāḥ viśatirgokulānīti nityamekavacanaṃ
strīliṅgaṃ ca bhavati, śataśabdātu napuṃsakatvam, viṃśatī viśatayaḥ
śate śatānīti tu pracayabhedavivakṣāyāmekaśeṣaḥ ? atrocyate--yasya
dhamesya dhamiṇā sahābhedaḥ pratipādyate, sa ceteṣu pratyekaparisamāptaḥ
tadā tasyāpi dharmivadbhinnatvād dvivacanabahuvacane bhavataḥ, yathā
śuklau, śuklā iti| śauklyaṃ hi kambaleṣu pratyekaparisamāptam,
ko'rthaḥ ? ekaikasminnapi kambale śuklaśabdārthaḥ puṣkalaḥ, na mātrayāpi
nyūna ityarthaḥ| viśatirgāva ityatra tu viṃśatisaṃkhyā na
pratyekaparisamāptā, kiṃ tarhi ? bahuṣviti|
tadrūpabhedābhāvādekavacanameva bhavati, yathā--gāvo dhanam, indrāgnī
devatā, vedāḥ pramāṇamiti| dhinorterdhanaṃ prītihetuḥ,
samuditānāṃ ca gavāṃ prītihetutvaṃ vivakṣitam, naikaikasyā iti
dhanamekaṃ gobhirviśeṣyate, tatra dhanākāre bedābhāvād
bahuvacanābhāvaḥ| indrāgnī devateti
divaraiśvaryakarmaṇordeavatāsaṅghasya ca devatātvamekaṃ iviḥ pratīti
dvivananābhāvaḥ| devate iti tūcyamāne pratyakamaiśvarya pratīyeta,
tataśca vrīhiyavayoriva vikalpaḥ syāt| vedāḥ pramāṇamiti caturṇā
samuditānāṃ vedānāmekaṃ pramāṇatvaṃ vivakṣitamiti tasminnākāre
bhedābhāvād bahuvacanābhāvaḥ, pratyekaṃ tu prāmāṇye vedāḥ
pramāṇānīti bhavatyeva| yadyevam, trayaścatvāraḥ pañca ṣaṭ
saptetyatrāpyekavacanaprasaṅgaḥ, na hi tritvādikamapi
pratyekaparisamāptam ? ucyate; tryādayo nityaṃ saṃkhyeyavacanāḥ, na
tu kadācidapi saṃkhyānamātravacanā ityekena dhrameṇa vyāsajyavṛttinā
sahānekasya dhamiṃṇo bhedapratipādanābhāvāddharmibedāśrayaṃ
bahuvacanameva bhavati| yadyapi tritvamityādau saṃkhyānamātramapi
niṣṭaṣṭṃa pratīyate, tryādibhistu na pratīyate| devatāśabdastu yadyapi
niṣkṛṣṭadevatātvamācaṣṭe, tathāpyannirdeavatetyekenāpi sa
bhinnadevatātvamācaṣṭe, nānekenaiva sarvadā| tryādayastu na
kvacidapyevamiti viśeṣaḥ| liṅgamapi lokāśrayatvādyathādarśitaṃ
vyavatiṣṭhate, na taddhitāntatvenābhidheyavaditi sarvamanākulam|
evaṃ bhāṣyakāramatena vyākhyāya saṃprati vārtikakāramataṃ
darśayati--ṭhviśatyādaya iti| guṇaśabdā iti| rūḍhirūpā iti bhāvaḥ|
yathākathañācidvyutpādyā iti| svaravarṇānupūrvījñānārtham, na
tvavayavārthapradarśanāya, tadāha--nātrāvayavārthe'bhiniveṣṭavyamiti|
avayavārthaviṣayo'bhiniveśo na kartavya ityarthaḥ| sa tu pratītipathaṃ
nārohatīti parityajyate|
yā caiṣāmityādi| darśitā ca guṇamātre guṇini ca vṛttiḥ, etadapi
sartraṃ svābhāvikameveti darśitāmupapati sthirāṃ manyate|
sahasrādayo'pyevañjātīyakā iti| guṇamātre guṇini ca vartante,
svaliṅgasaṃkhyānuvidhāyinaścetyarthaḥ| tadvadeva draṣṭavyā iti|
svaravarṇāpūrvījñānārthaṃ viṃśatyādivadvyutpādyā ityarthaḥ| tadyathā-śataśya
daśatāṃ sahabhāvaḥ sracca pratyayaḥ|| kva punarete vyutpādyāḥ ?
pṛṣodarādiṣu| udāharaṇāmātram
pradarśanamātrametadviśatyādīnāmupādānam| itiśabdaḥ samāptau| atra
vārtikam--ṭhanārambho vā prātipadikavijñānādyathā sahasrādiṣu' iti ||

pañcaddaśatau varge vā || 5|1|60 ||
saṅghagrahaṇe prakṛte vargagrahaṇaṃ sūtrādhyayanayoranuvṛttirmā
bhūditi, aprāṇyarthaṃ ca; saṅghaśabdasya prāṇiviṣayatvāt ||

triṃśaccatvāriṃśatorbrāhmaṇe saṃjñāyāṃ ḍaṇ || 5|1|62 ||
na viṣayasaptamīti| brāhmaṇaviṣayaścetprayogo bhavatīti naivamatrārthaḥ,
naivamatrārthaḥ, tathā hi sati mantre bhāṣāyāṃ ca prayogo na syāt,
brāhmaṇādanyasya ca saṃjñāyāṃ śaṅkyeta, evaṃ ca ṭhbrāhmaṇasaṃjñāyām' iti
ṣaṣṭhīsamāsena nirdeaṣṭavyam, tathā tu na kṛtamiteyeva sūtre ca ye
okārādantaraṃ rephamadhīyate teṣāṃ pañcamyarye ṣaṣṭhīdvivacanam| ye
tu na, teṣāṃ samāhāradvandve pañcamyekavacanam ||

tadarhati || 5|1|63 ||
arhati labdhu yogyo bhavatītyarthaḥ ||

chedādibhyo nityam || 5|1|63 ||
nityagadrahaṇaṃ pratyayārthaviśeṣaṇāmiti| atha yathā ṭhnityaṃ
krīḍājīvikayo' ityatra mahāvibhāṣayā prāptasya vākyasya nivṛtyarthaṃ
nityagrahaṇam, tathehāpi kasmānna bhavati ? iṣṭatvāt, dṛṣṭatvācca|
ityate ca dṛśyate ca chedamarhatīti| na ca vākyanivṛtyarthameva
nityagrahaṇaṃ kartavyam, ṭhchedādibhyaḥ' ityevāstu, pūrveṇa siddhe
punarārambho vākyanivṛtyartho bhaviṣyati| yathā tarhi ṭhtrermapnityam'
ityatra svātantryanivṛtyarthaṃ nityagrahaṇam, tatheha kasmānna bhavati ?
iṣṭatvāt, dṛṣṭatvācca| iṣyate ca svātatryam, dṛśyate ca chedādiṣu
paṭhitasya sampraśanaśabdasya svatantrasya prayogaḥ, vidhinimantraṇādisutre
yathā| tarhyekagopūrvādityatra pratyayāntarya matupo nivṛtyarthaṃ
nityagrahaṇam, tadeha kasmānna bhavati? aprāptatvāt| na hyatra
kasyacitpratyayāntarasya prāptiḥ| yathā tarhi ṭhnityaṃ kauṭilye gatau'
ityatrārthāntaranivṛtyarthaṃ nityagrahaṇam--gativacanāddhātoḥ kauṭilya
eva, na kriyāsamabhihāra iti, tatheha kasmānna bhavati ? iṣṭatvād,
iṣyate hyarthāntare'pi yathāyogaṃ chedādibhya arhīyaḥ pratyayaḥ|
tasmādyathoktameva prayojanaṃ nityagrahaṇasya| chedaṃ nityamarhatīti| nanu
na kaścit padārtho nityaṃ chedamarhati, yo'pi vetasādiścchinnaścchinnaḥ
prarohati so'pi na sadaivacchedanārhaḥ; prarūḍhastu bhavati| yastārha
dasyuvaṃsādirnityaṃ chedanārhaḥ sa pratyayārthaḥ| apara āha--ābhīkṣṇaye
nityaśabdaḥ, yathā--nityaprahasitādāviti|
virāga viraṅgaṃ ceti| virāgaśabdāḥ pratyayamutpādayati,
tatsanniyogena viraṅgamādeśamāpadyate--virāgaṃ nityamarhati
vairaṅgikaḥ ||

śīrṣacchedādyacca || 5|1|65 ||
pratyayasanniyogeneti| tathā ca śiraḥśabdena vigraho darśitaḥ| kathaṃ
tarhi pūrvamuktam-śīrṣacchedaśabdād dvitīyāsamarthāditi ? na
prayogārhe vākye dvitīyāsamarthatā, kiṃ tarhi ? yadupamarddanena
vṛttirbhavati tatra prakiyāvakye pratyayau dvau--yacca, ṭhakca, evaṃ ca
pratyayāmabhyāṃ sanniyoga iti dvivacanāntena samāsaḥ || 

daṇḍādibhyo yaḥ || 5|1|66 ||
upāyaviśeṣaḥudaṇḍaḥ, hastālambaśca| iha ṭhdaṇḍādibhyaḥ'
ityetāvatsūtram, anantaraśca yatpratyayo vidhīyate'| tathā ca
vadhyaśabdavalyutpādanāya kyabvidhāvuktam--ṭhhano vadha ca tadvito vā'
iti, yadi cātra yadvidhīyate tata eva tadupapadyate taddhito veti|
katham ? kyapyādyaudātatvam, yatyapi taddhite ṭhyato'nāvaḥ'
ityādyaudātatvameva| yadi tvatra yo vidhīyeta tataḥ svare
viśeṣādanupapannametatsyāt| utarasūtre cāsya yasyaivānuvṛttiḥ
syāt, na yataḥ| athāpi svaritatvādyata evānuvṛttirucyate ? evamapi
vṛttikārasyaitadvaktumāpadyeta--ṭhyadanuvartate nānantaro yaḥ' iti| ye
tvibha-vadha-medhaśabdānā yadantānāmādyaudātānāṃ cchandasi
prayogāḥ--ṭhibhyānna rājā vanānyati, tasmādapi vadhyaṃ prapannaṃ na
pratiprayacchanti, apāṃ medhyaṃ yajñiyam' ityādyāḥ, te daṇkaḍādibhyo
yavidhāne'pyupapadyante| katham ? daṇkaḍādibhyo yaḥ'
daṇḍādibhyaścchandasyubhayaprasaṅge paratvādyadbhavipyati| tasmādete
prayogāḥ ṭhdaṇḍādibhyo yadvidhīyate' ityatrārthe pramāṇatvena
nopanyasanīyāḥ ||

pātrāddhaÄśca || 5|1|68 ||
ṭhakṭhañorapavāda iti| tatra ṭhako'pavādatvamupapādayati--pātraṃ
parimāṇamapyastīti| bhājanaviśeṣastu prasiddha eva, tatra ṭhako'pavādaḥ,
parimāṇavacane tu ṭhaña ityarthaḥ| pātriya iti| pātraparimitaṃ
taṇḍulādikaṃ yaḥ sthālyādirarhati, sambhavanadhāraṇakṣamatvāt, sa
evamucyate| yena vā bhukte bhojanabhājanaṃ saṃskāreṇa na śuddhyati ||

kaḍaṅkaradakṣiṇāccha ca || 5|1|69 ||
ṭhkaḍa made', kaḍatīti kaḍaḥ, kaḍaṃ karotītyata eva nipātanātkhac,
kaḍaṅkaraṃ māṣamudgādikāṣṭhamucyate| dakṣerutsāhakarmaṇaḥ karaṇe
ṭhdudakṣibhyāminan' itīnanpratyayaḥ---dakṣiṇā| cakārādyacyeti|
ghaÄstvanantaro'pi na samuccīyate, ya eva; svaritatvāt|
kaḍaṅkarīya iti| yo balīvarho durjaramapi kaḍaṅkaraṃ jarayituṃ
prabhāvati sa tadarhatadītyacyate|
alpāccassyetyādi| yaddhā--yathāsaṃkhye'bhiprete yasmādyadiṣṭaḥ, taṃ
daṇḍādiṣu paṭhṃat ||

sthālībilāt || 5|1|70 ||
cchayatāvanārtete iti| pūrvasūtre'pi na yaccakāreṇānukṛṣṭaḥ, tathā
sati ghana eva prasaṅgāt| kiṃ tarhi ? svaritatvāt| ato na
satyānuvṛttirdulebheti bhāvaḥ| pākayogyā ityartha iti| triphalīkṛtā
iti yāvat ||

yajhartvigbhyāṃ ghakhañau || 5|1|71 ||
yajñamarhatīti| sa punaryasya viduṣo'rthinaḥ śāstreṇāmaryudastasya
dravyavato yajhe'dhikāraḥ, sa veditavyaḥ|
deśasyānaivaṃvidhatvādvacanam| 
yajñatvigbhyāṃ tatkarmārhatītyupasaṃkhayānamiti| yajñakarmārhatīti|
yajñakarmānuṣṭhanayogya ityarthaḥ| ṛtvikkarmārhatīti|
ṛtvigbhavitumarhatītyarthaḥ ||

pārāyaṇaturāyaṇacāndrāyaṇaṃ vartayati || 5|1|72 |
pārāyaṇamuādita ārabhyāntādavicchedena vedādhyayanam,
turāyaṇamusaṃvatsarasādhyo iviryajñaviśeṣaḥ,
cāndrāyaṇamutapoviśeṣaḥ, vartanamuniṣpādanam| tatra pārāyaṇaṃ
guruṇā śiṣyeṇa ca nirvartyate; anyatarāsannidhāvadhyayanakriyāyā
aniṣpādanāt; śiṣya eva tviṣyate| tathā turāyaṇamubhau
vartayataḥ--ṛtvigyamānaśca; ṛtvik carupuroḍāśādi nirvartayati,
yajamāno devatoddeśena dravyaṃ tvajati; yajamāna eva tviṣyate|
ubhayatra kasmānta bhavati ? anabidhānāt ||

saṃśayamāpannaḥ || 5|1|73 ||
sāṃśayikaḥ sthāṇuriti| sthāṇurvā puruṣo vetyevaṃrūpasya saṃśayasya
viṣaya ityarthaḥ| ananaitaddarśayati-yadyapi dve api kartṛkarmaṇī
saṃśayamāpanne, tathāpi yadviṣayakaḥ saṃśayastatraiva pratyayo bhavati, na
kartari paruṣe; anabhidhānādhiti || 

yojanaṃ gacchati || 5|1|74 ||
krośaśatayojanaśatayoriti| guṇena neti pratiṣedhaḥ saṃkhyāyā na
bhavati; ata eva nirdeśāt, ṭhśatashasrāntācca niṣkāt' iti vacanācca|
tato'bhigamanamiti| atra pañcamyantātpratyaḥ ||

pantho ṇa nityam || 5|1|76 ||
nityagrahaṇaṃ pratyayārthaviśeṣaṇamiti| vākyanivṛtyarthaṃ tu na bhavati;
panthādeśo hi pratyayasanniyogena vidhīyamāno naiva vākye
sambhavati; pathinśbdena tu vākye'nabhiprete pūrvasūtra eva
nityagrahaṇaṃ kuryāt| yatra pathinśabdaḥ śrūyate,
pratyayāntaranivṛtyarthamapi na bhavati; pathaḥ kano vidhānasāmarthyāt,
pratyayāntarasya prāptyabhāvāt| panthānaṃ nityaṃ gacchatīti| nanvayamartho
na sambhavati, viśramasyāvaśyambhavitvāt; sambhavatu vā
kathañcidādityādau, tathāpi na tatraiveṣyate, udāhṛtaṃ hi--pāntho
bhikṣāṃ yācate iti ? tasmādābhīkṣaṇmunityam, parityāgābhāvo vā
||

utarapathenāhṛtaṃ ca || 5|1|77 ||
cakāraḥ pratyayārthasamuccaya iti| pratyayārthamātrasamuccaye, na yu
samarthavibhaktiyuktasya vākyārthasyetyarthaḥ| ṭhtasya vyākhyāna iti ca'
itivad vākyārthaparāmaśina itiśabdasyābhāvaditi bhāvaḥ| tena kiṃ
siddhaṃ bhavati ? ityāha--atrāpīti| dvitīyapakṣe cākrānte'nākrānte ca
prakṛtyarthe pratyayaḥ syāt, ākrānta eva tu bhavati|
vārijaṅgaletyādi| vāryādīni pūrvapadāni yasminprātipadike
tatmātpathinśabdāntādityarthaḥ|
ajapathaśaṃkupathābhyāṃ ceti| pūrvasminnevavākye'jaśaṃkuśabdau
paṭhitavyau, tathā tu na kṛtamityeva|
madhumaricayoraṇ sthalāditi| sthalaśabdotaro yaḥ pathin-śabdaḥ,
tadantānmadhumaricayorabhidheyayoraṇ bhavati| sthalapathenāhṛtamiti|
gacchatyarthe tu pratyayo na darśitaḥ; mukhyagamanāsambhavāt| sthālapathaṃ
madhukamiti| madhumaricayoranyataranirṇayāyānuprayogo na viruddhaḥ
||

kālāt || 5|1|78 ||
svarūpagrahaṇamiha na bhavati, ṭhtamadhīṣṭo bhṛto bhūto bhīṣī'
ityatyantasaṃyoge dvitīyānirddesāt ṭhmāsādvayasi' ityādau
māsādīnāṃ kālagrahaṇena viśeṣaṇācca ||

tena nirvṛtam || 5|1|79 ||
teneti karaṇe tṛtīyā| nivṛtamuniṣpāditam| antarbhāvitaṇyarthe
vṛttiḥ ||

tamadhīṣṭo mṛto bhūto bhāvī || 5|1|80 ||
bhāvīti tādṛśa evānāgata iti| svasatayā vyāpyamānakāla ityarthaḥ|
nanu ceti| yadyapi kvacitkadācinmāsamapyadhyeṇaṃ bharaṇaṃ ca kriyate,
tathāpi yāvantaṃ kālaṃ kriyate, na tāvataḥ pratyaya iṣyate, api tu
phalabhūtakriyāvyāpyakālādiṣyate| sa cādhyeṣaṇabharaṇābhyāmavyāpta iti
dvitīyānupapatiriti bhāvaḥ| adhyeṣaṇabharaṇe kriyārthe iti|
adhyāpanādikriyārthaṃ hi tayoḥ karaṇam| phalabhūtayā kriyayeti
adhyāpanādikayā|
tābhyāmeva vyāpta ityucyata iti| yathā caurairāhṛtenāgninā dagdhe
grāme vaktāro bhavanti--caurairdagdo grāma iti ||

māsādvayasi yatkhañau || 5|1|81 ||
vayasyabhidheya iti| pratyayārthasya tasya viśeṣaṇaṃ vayaḥ, tatra
viśiṣṭābhidhāne viśeṣaṇabhūtaṃ vayo'pyabhidheyamiti bhāvaḥ|
sāmarthyāditi| na hi māsamadhīṣṭo bhṛto vetyakte kācitkālakṛtā
śarīrāvasthā gamyate, bhāvinyapi nāñjasā gamyate| jātaḥ kumāro
māsaṃ bhāvītyatrāpi pūrṇe māse yā'vasthā saiva vayaḥ, tataśca tatrāpi
bhūta eva māso vayaḥpratīterheturityetatsāmarthyam| khaño tritkaraṇaṃ
svarārtham, puṃvadbhāvapratiṣedhārthaṃ ca--māsīnābhāryaḥ ||

dvigoryap || 5|1|82 ||
prāgvateḥ saṃkhyāpūrvapadānāṃ tadantavidherabhyupagamātpūrveṇa
yatkhañoḥ prāptayoryabvidhīyate| yapaḥ pitvādanudātatvam, tena
kālānte dvigāviti pūrvapadaprakṛtisvara evāvatiṣṭhate || 

ṣaṇamāsāṇṇyacca || 5|1|83 ||
autsargiko'pi ṭhañiṣyate iti| sa kathamiṣyamāṇo'pi labhyaityāha--sa
iti| yadi cakāraṣṭhañaḥ samuccayārthaḥ| kathaṃ tarhi yabbhavati ?
ityāha--svaritatvācceti| etacca vyākhyānādeva labhyate ||

avayasi ṭhaÄśva || 5|1|84 ||
cakāro'nantarasya ṇyataḥsamuccayārtha iti| na tu pūrvavat ṭhañaḥ
samuccayārthaḥ| tathā ca vārtikam-- ṭhavayasi
ṭhṃaścetyanantarasyānukarṣaḥ' iti|| 

samāyāḥ khaḥ || 5|1|85 ||
sarvatreti| pūrvatra, atra, paratra ca| tena
parijayya-labhya-kārya-sukaramiti yāvat ||

rātryahassaṃvatsarācca || 5|1|87 ||
dvaiyahnika iti| ṭhaṅnaṣṭakhoreva' iti kaniyamādasati ṭilope
ṭhallopo'naḥ' ityakāralopaḥ| nanvatra ṭhrājāhaḥsakhibhyaṣṭac' iti
paratvāṭṭacā bhavitavyam, na ca mahāvibhāṣayā ṭaṭo vikalpaḥ,
bṛhatījātyantāḥ samāsāntāśceti nityeṣu parigaṇanāt ? evaṃ tarhi
samāsāntavidharenityatvādatra na bhaviṣyati ||

citavati nityam || 5|1|89 || 
yadi citavati nityaṃ lugbhavati, kathaṃ ṭhvarṣasyābhaviṣyati' ityatra
vakṣyati-dve varṣe adhīṣṭo bhṛto vā karma kariṣyati dvivārṣiko
manuṣya iti, na hi nitye luki adhīṣṭabhṛtayorutpannasya citavati
śravaṇamupapadyate ? evaṃ tarhi bhūta evotpannasya pratyayasya lugiṣyate, na
sarvatra| etacca nityagrahaṇāllabhyate| ārambhasāmarthyādeva hi nityo
luk siddhaḥ, tatra nityagrahaṇaṃ viśiṣṭe'rthe nityaṃ lug yathā syāt|
sa punarviśiṣṭo'rtho bhūta eva; vyākhyānāt| tenādhīṣṭādau pūrveṇa
vibhāṣayaiva lugbhaviṣyati ||

ṣaṣṭikāḥ ṣaṣṭirātreṇa pacyante || 5|1|90 ||
laghutvātprathamātikrame kāraṇābhāvācca ekavacanenaiva
nirdeśādvivakṣitaṃ taditi manyamānaṃ pratyāha--bahuvacanamatantramiti|
tathā ca vārtike--ṭhṣaṣṭike saṃjñāgrahaṇaṃ kartavyam' ityekavacanaṃ
prayuktam| prayogabāhulyātu sūtre bahuvacanaprayogaḥ, ṣaṣṭirātreṇa
paccanta ityatrārthe nipātyamānasya ṣaṣṭikaśabdasya dhānyaviśeṣa eva
prayogo yathā syāt, ṇudgādiṣu mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ saṃjñāgrahaṇaṃ
kartavyamiti vārtikakāroṇoktam| tadetannipātanādeva
siddhamityabhiprāyeṇāha--saṃjñaiṣetyādi ||

vatsarāntācchaścchandasi || 5|1|91 ||
idvatsara-idāvatsaraśabdau pañcavarṣe yuge dvayorgharṣayoḥ saṃjñe| evaṃ
saṃvatsara-parivatsaraśabdāvapi ||

tena parijayyalabhyakāryyasukaram || 5|1|93 ||
parijayya ityasya vivaraṇam--śakyate parijetumiti| ṭhkṣayyajasyau
śakyārthe' ityayādeśaḥ ||

tadasya brahmacaryam || 5|1|94 ||
māso'sya brahmacaryasyeti| yadyapyatrātyantasaṃyogo gamyate, tathāpi
dvitīyā na bhavati; māsasya pradhānatvāt, ṣaṣṭhīviṣaye ca dvitīyā
vidhānāt|
ubhayathā hi sūtrapraṇayanāditi| ubhayorapyarthayoḥ sūtrakāreṇaiva
sūtrasya vyākhyātatvādit«athaḥ| mahānāmnyādibhya iti| brahmacaryasya
pratyayārthatvātsāmarthyāt ṣaṣṭhīsamarthebhyaḥ pratyayaḥ|
mahānāmnyo nāma ṛca iti| mahannāma yāsāṃ tā mahānāmnyaḥ,
vidāmaghavannityādyāḥ, ṭhnityaṃ saṃjñācchandasoḥ' iti ṅīp|
mahānāmnīścaratīti| caraṇamanuṣṭānm, tacca kriyāviṣayamiti
tatsahacaritaṃ vrataṃ tacchabdenocyate| tatra ca sa
liṅgasaṃkhyāparityāgenaiva mahānāmnīśabdo vrate vartata iti
mahānāmnīśvaratīti vigrahaḥ| māhānāmika iti| ṭhbhasyāḍhea taddhite
puvadbhāva' iti ṅīpi nivṛte ṭilopaḥ|
avāntaradīkṣādibhyo ḍiniriti|
ḍitkaraṇasaṣṭācatvāriṃśataṣṭilopārtham| anyatra syoti lopena
siddham|
aśṭācatvāriṃśaka iti| vṛttiviṣaye varṣeṣu, saṃkhyoyeṣu
aṣṭaṭatvāriṃśacchabdo vartate--prativedaṃ dvādaśavarṣāṇi
vratacaraṇāccaturṣuṃ vedeṣvaṣṭācatvāriṃśataṃ varṣāṇi vrataṃ carati|
cāturmasyānāmiti| abhideyabahutvādvahuvacanam|
kimidaṃ cāturmāsyānāmiti ? tatrāha--caturmāsāṇṇayo yajñe tatra
bhava iti| cāturmāsyānīti| saṃvatsarasādhyo iviryajñaviśeṣastasya
catvāryavāntaraparvāṇi tadapekṣaṃ bahuvacanam| cāturmāsīti| ṭhtatra
bhavaḥ' ityevāṇsiddhaḥ, tasya ṭhdvigorluganapatye' iti luki prāpte
punaraṇ vidhīyate| ṭhkālāṭṭhañ' ityasya tvaprāptiḥ
samudāyasyākālavācitvātadantavidhyabhāvācca| apara
āha--yathākathañācitkālavṛttibyo'pi ṭhaña iṣṭatvāṭṭhañyeva prāpte
tasya lukīdamaṇvidhānamiti ||

tasya ca dakṣiṇāyajñākhyebhyaḥ || 5|1|95 ||
yajñamācakṣate yajñākhyāḥ sopasārgādapi mūlavibhujāditvādasyamādeva
nipātanādvā kaḥ |
ākhyāgrahaṇamiti| āṅpūrvasya ṭhkhyā' ityasya dhātorgrahaṇamityarthaḥ|
ākhyāgrahaṇāmiti| hrasvāntapāṭhastu yuktaḥ| akālavācino'pi yathā
syāditi| svarūpagrahaṇaṃ tu bahuvacananirdeśādipi śakyaṃ
nirākatumiti bhāvaḥ| nanvekāhādayaḥ kratuśabdaḥ kālavācī na
samudāyaḥ, kathaṃ te eva gṛhyaeran ? ata āha--prāgvateriti| nanu
yā'gniṣṭomasya dakṣiṇā sāgniṣṭome bhavati, tatra
ṭhbahraco'ntodātāṭṭhañ', ṭhkratuyajñebhyaśca' iti ṭhañ siddhayati ? na
siddhayati; ṭhvāyakhyātavyanāmnaḥ' iti tatra vartate, nāmagrahaṇācca
vyākhyātavyatayā loke prasiddhasya granthasya grahaṇam|
kiñca--dvayorvājapeyayorbhavā dvaivājapeyikī--atra na prāpnoti; iha
tu ṭhprāgvateḥ saṃkhyāpūrvapadānām' iti tadantavidhiścāsti, lukca na
prāpnoti; apragdīvyatīyatvāt, anārhīyatvācca|

tatra ca dīyate kāryaṃ bhavavat || 5|1|96 ||
haimanamiti| yadyapi bhavavatpratyayā bhavantītyuktam, tathāpi
ṭhsarvatrāṇca talopaśca' ityaṇpratyayo'tidiṣṭe
tatsānnayogaśiṣṭastalopo'pi bhavati| vatiḥ sarvasādṛśyārtha iti|
ṭhkālebhyo bhavavat' ityatraitad vyākhyātam| agniṣṭome dīyate
āgniṣṭomikaṃ bhaktamiti| yadyevam, agniṣṭomasya yā dakṣiṇā
sāgniṣṭome dīyate tatra ṭhyajñākhyebhyo dīyate ityanenaiva siddham,
tathā yanmāse kāryaṃ tanmāse bhaghaṃ bhavati, tataśca
kāryagrahaṇamanarthakam, tatra bhavena kṛtatvāt ?
atrāhuḥ--ṭhṭhdvigorluganapatye' iti luk prāpnoti| athānenāpi
pratyaye sati lukkasmānna bhavati, yāvatā ṭhvatiḥ sarvasādṛśyārthe'
ityuktam ? satyam; pratyayamātrasyātideśo na luk'', iti| tadapare
na sahante--vatiḥ sarvasādṛśyārthaḥ, tatra tathā bhave tadantavidhirna
bhavati, evamatrāpi na bhavitavyam| evaṃ ca kṛtvā ṭhtatra ca dīyate'
ityatrāpi tadantavidhirna bhavati| vibhakte tu yoge bhavatyeva, tatra
bhavavadityasyābhāvāt-dvayorvājapeyayordīyate dvaivājapeyikī|
sūkṣmadṛśāmeṣa santhāḥ ||

vyuṣṭadibhyo'ṇ || 5|1|97 ||
pyuṣṭaśabdaḥ kālavācī divasamukhe vartate,
tatsāhacaryānnityaśabdasyāpi kālavācino grahaṇam,
nākāsādivṛteḥ| tatra cātyantasaṃyoge dvitīyā bhavatīti
saptamyadhikare'pi dvitīyāntātpratyayaḥ| nityaṃ dīyate kāryaṃ vā
naityam|
ṭhaṇaprakaraṇe'gripadādibhya upasaṃkhyānam' ityetatpratyācaṣṭe--na
vaktavyamiti| na kartavyamityarthaḥ| kathamityāha--atreva paṭhitavyāsta
iti| ādiśabdaḥ prakāravācyāśrayaṇīya ityuktaṃ bhavati; anyathā tatraiva
paṭhayeran, upasaṃkhyānaṃ vā kriyeta, ko viśeṣaḥ ? aṇgrahaṇamanarthakaṃ
bhavavadityanuvatiṣyate, tenāṇeva bhaviṣyati| na caivaṃ
vyuṣṭanityaśabdābhyām ṭhkālāṭṭhañ' ityasya prasaṅgaḥ, pūrveṇaiva
ṭhañaḥ siddhatvāt ? satyam; ṭhādiśabdaḥ prakāravācī' ityuktam, tatra
yadī vṛddheṣvapyetatkadācipravartate, tadā cchaḥ syāt| paṭhiteṣu tu
nāsti doṣaḥ ||

tena yathākathācahastābhyāṃ ṇayatau || 5|1|98 ||
tṛtīyāsamarthābhyāmiti| tṛtīyārthayuktābhyāmityarthaḥ| tathā ca
yathākathācaśabdaṃ prati vakṣyati--tṛtīyārthamātraṃ ca sambhavatīti
hastaśabde tu tṛtīyāntatvameva sambhavatīti pratyekamarthasambandha iti|
nanu yathāsaṃkhyaṃ prāpnoti ? tatrāha--yathāsaṃkhyamatra neṣyate iti|
pratyayau tu prati yathāsaṃkhyaṃ bhavatyeva, atra ca vyākhyānameva śaraṇam|
tṛtīyārthamātraṃ ca sambhavatīti| arthastāvatsambhavati--yathākathāca
datamityukte, anadareṇa datamiti pratītestāvanmātrameva sambhavati|
mātraśabdasya vyavacchedyaṃ darśayati--na tviti| yathākathācaśabdasya
vākyatvāt| pratyayastu vacanasāmarthyādvākyādapi bhavati ||

sampādini || 5|1|99 ||
sampādinītyatra sampaderarthamāha--guṇotkarṣaḥ sampatiriti|
karṇaveṣṭakamukarṇābharaṇam| vastrayugeṇeti| ṭhkumaci ca' iti
ṇatvam ||

karmaveṣādyat || 5|1|100 ||
karmṛuvyāyāmaḥ, veṣaḥukṛtrima ākāraḥ ||

tasmai prabhavati santāpādibhyaḥ || 5|1|101 ||
alamarthe caturthīti| alamarthe ṭhprabhavati' ityasminnupapade śeṣaviṣaye
caturthātyarthaḥ| saktumāṃsaudanādvigṛhītādapiti|
apiśabdātsaṅghātādapi--sāktumāṃsitaḥ; audanikaḥ,
āktumāṃsaudanikaḥ || 

karmaṇa ukañ || 5|1|103 ||
kārmukaṃ dhanuriti| anyatra tu na bhavati; anabhidhānāt ||

samayastadasya prāptam || 5|1|104 ||
samarthavibhaktinirdeśa utarārtha iti| iha tu samaya iti nirdeśādeva
prathamāsamarthavibhaktirlabhyate, utarārthatvādeva ca samayaśabdasya
puṃlliṅgatve'pi taditi napuṃsakanirddeśaḥ, tadapekṣayā ca
prāptaśabdasyāpi napuṃsakatvam, iha tu vākyabhedena sambandhaḥ,
yadāha--ṭhyataprathamāsamarthaṃ prāptaṃ cetatadbhavatīti ||

ṛtoraṇ || 5|1|105 ||
tapavastā prāpto'steti| upavatsāūpavāsasya kartā sa prāpto'sya
aupavastramūpavāsaḥ, prāśitramubrahmabhāgaḥ ||

cchandasi ghas || 5|1|106 ||
ṛtviya iti| ṭhsiti ca' iti padatvena bhatve niraste ṭhorguṇaḥ' na
bhavati ||

kālādyat || 5|1|107 ||
kālyastāpa iti| prātaḥkāle kālyaśabdasya vyutpatyantaraṃ mṛgyam ||

prakṛṣṭe ṭhañ || 5|1|108 ||
prakarṣeṇeti| prakṛṣṭaśabde prakṛtyarthasya niṣkṛpya kathanametat, evaṃ
prakṛṣṭe uprakarṣe| vartamānāditi| prakarṣaviśiṣṭe'rthe
vartamānādityarthaḥ| na tvatra ṭhnapuṃsake bhāve ktaḥ' darśitaḥ, karmaṇi
ktānto'yaṃ prakṛṣyate, sa prakṛṣṭa iti; anyathā prakṛṣṭo dīrghaḥ
kālo'syeni vigraho na ghaṭeta| ṭhañgrahaṇaṃ vispaṣṭārthamiti|
anyathānantarasya yato'nuvṛttirāśaṅkyeta ||

prayojanam || 5|1|109 ||
prayujyate'neneti prayojanam, karaṇe lyuṭ| kiṃ punastatphalam ?
yathāhuḥ--yamarthamadhikṛtya pravartate tatprayojanamiti|
indramahaḥuindrotsavaḥ ||

viśākhāṣāḍhādaṇmanthadaṇyoḥ || 5|1|110 ||
viśākhā prayojanamasyeti| viśākhāṣāḍhaśabdau rūḍhirūpeṇa
manthadaṇḍayorvartete, tayoryathākañcidvyutpattiḥ kriyate|
manthaḥuviloḍanadaṇḍaḥ| āṣāḍhaḥuvratīnāṃ daṇḍaḥ|
śraddhā prayojanamasyeti| atra karaṇaṃ prayojanam ||
anupravacanādibhyaścchaḥ || 5|1|111 ||
viśipūrītyādi| viśa praveśane', ṭhpūrī apyāyane', ṭhpallṛ gatau'
ṭhruha bījajanmani'--etāḥ prakṛtayo yasyānasya ṭhyuvoranākau' iti
vihitasya tasmādvidyamānapūrvapadāccha upasaṃkhyeyaḥ, kevalasyānasya
sapūrvapadatvāsambhavatsāmarthyātadantagrahaṇam| gṛhapraveśanīyamiti|
evaṃ cānupravacanādiṣu saṃveśanānuprarvaśānānvārohaṇaśabdānāṃ
prapañcārthaḥ pāṭhaḥ| svargyamiti| ṭhañi prāpte yadvidhiḥ|
puṇyāhavācanādibhya iti| sāhacaryādabhidhāne siddhe bhedavivakṣāyāṃ
pratyayaśravaṇaṃ mā bhūditi lugvacanam ||

aikāgārikaṭ caure || 5|1|113 ||
ekāgāraṃ prayojanamasyeti| ekaśabdo'sahāyavacanaḥ, asahāyaṃ hi gṛhaṃ
mumūṣiṣataścorasya prayojanam| sasahāye tu gṛhe moṣituṃ na
śaktate| ekāgāraṃ prayojanamasya bhikṣoriti| ṭhekāgāraṃ cared bhaikṣyaṃ
tatpurāṇamunervratam' iti śāstrādekāmeva yo bhikṣāṃ gṛhṇāti na
dvitīyāṃ sa evamucyate| nanvevamapyekāgārāccore ṭhañeva niyamārthaṃ
vaktavyaḥ, kiṃ nipātanena, ṭakāreṇa vā prayojanam ? ata āha--ṭakāraḥ
kāryāvadhāraṇārtha iti| avadhāraṇameva darśayati--ṅībeva bhavati, na
ñitsvara iti| vṛddhaistu nipātanādbhavatyeva| nanvevaṃ
ñitsvaranivṛttireva nipātanasya| mā bhūdvā niyamaḥ; bhikṣau kasmānna
bhavati ? anabhidhānāt|
yathā tu bhāṣyaṃ tathā ñitsvara eveṣyate| tatra hi sūtramidaṃ
pratyākhyātm-ṭhekāgārānnipātanānarthakyaṃ ṭhañprakaraṇāt' iti,
prayojanamityatra ṭhañaprakṛtaḥ, tenaivaikāgārikaśabdaḥ siddha ityarthaḥ|
ikṭpratyayamiti| idamapi pratyākhyānena viruddham ||

ākālikakaḍādyantavacane || 5|1|114 ||
ākālikakaḍiti nipātye iti| samudāyaviṣayamuktavā tatraiva vibhajya
nipātanaṃ darśayati--samānakālaśabdasyetyādi| sarveṣāmeva vākyānāṃ
nipātyata iti vakṣyamāṇenaiva sambandhaḥ| ādyantayoścaitadviśeṣaṇamiti|
etatsamānakālatvamādyantayorviśeṣaṇaṃ nipātyate ṭhādyantavacane' iti
sūtre śrutatvādityarthaḥ| ikaṭ ca pratyaya iti| kvārthe?
asyetyadhikārātṣaṣṭha|lrthe| tadāha--samānakālāvādyantāvasyeti|
samānakālau ekakālāvityarthaḥ| ādiḥujanma, antaḥuvināśaḥ, na
cotpādavināśayorekakālatvasambhava
ityavyavahitakālatvemekakālatvam| nirantare hi kāle
bhedāgrahaṇātsa eva kāla iti bhavati pratipatiḥ| tadāha--utpannānantaraṃ
vināśītyartha iti |
ākālāṭṭhaÄśceti| vāktikakāro manyate| na
samānakālaśabdasyākālaśabda ādeśo nipātyaḥ, nāpīkaṭ pratyayaḥ, kiṃ
tarhi ? ākālāṭṭhṃaśceti sūtraṃ kartavyam| cakāraḥ prakṛtasyaiva ṭhañaḥ
samucyāyārthaḥ| kimidamākālāditi ? āvṛtaḥ kālo'syetyākālaḥ| na
ca kālasyāvṛttiḥ sambhavatītyayamartho bhavati-utpattikālena samāno
nirantaro yasya vināśakāla iti| evaṃ hyutpattikāla eva
vināśo'syāvṛta iti bhavati pratyayaḥ| tataḥ svārthe ṭhanvidheya
ādyantavacane viṣaya iti| tatra ṭhañpakṣe ṅībādyaudātatvaṃ ca bhavati,
pratyayāntaranipātane tu nādyaudātatvaṃ siddhayati,
tadāha--ṭhākālanipātanānarthakyaṃ ṭhañprakaraṇā diti| 
vṛttikārastu ṭhakāroccāraṇātpratyayāntarasyaiva nipātanaṃ manyamāno
ñitsvaraṃ necchati, tanmate nipātanāpekṣayāṃ samuccayārthaścaśabdaḥ,
nipātanaṃ ca kartavyam| ākālaśabdācca ṭhanapi vidheya iti|
ākālaśabdasya cokta evārthaḥ svārthikaśca ṭhan| ādyantaviṣayā
cāvṛtakālatā|
apara āha--āvṛtaḥ kāla iti tatpuruṣo'yam, tato'syetyadhikārāt
ṣaṣṭha|lrthe pratyaya iti| sarvathā tipātanasya ṭhanaścaika
evārthaḥ--samānakālāvādyantāvasyeti|
anye varṇayanti--yeṣāṃ varṣādīnāṃ yasminneva kāle
madhyahnādāvutpattiḥ, tasminneva dvitīyadivasasambhandhini vināśaśca
tānyākālikāni, tasmātkālādanuvartanta iti kṛtvā| teṣāṃ
hyadyantayoreka eva kālo bhavati madhyāṅnādiriti ||

tena tulyaṃ kriyā cedvatiḥ || 5|1|115 ||
yatatulyaṃ kriyā cetsā bhavatīti| etena
samānavibhaktikatvātprādhānyācca rptyayārthasya viśeṣaṇaṃ
kriyāgrahaṇamiti darśayati| nirdeśānurodhe tu prathamanirdiṣṭasya
prakṛtyarthasya viśeṣaṇe bhinnavibhaktikatvādvākyaśeṣe'dhyāhāryaḥ
syāt--yatat tṛtīyāsamarthaṃ kriyā cetsā bhavatīti| tulyamitye
tacca prathamāntam, na kriyāviśeṣaṇatvena
yadāha--tulyamityetasminnarthe iti| tasya viśeṣaṇaṃ kriyāgrahaṇam|
sāmānyopakramatvātu ṭhhitaṃ bhakṣāḥ' itivatulyamiti
napuṃsakanirddeśaḥ| brāhṇaṇena tulyaṃ vartata iti| nanu brāhmaṇaśabdena
jātirdravyaṃ vocyeta, na tābhyāṃ kriyāyāstulyatvam; atyantabhedāt|
yatra tu kiñcitsāmānyam, kaścicca viśeṣaḥ, sa eva
viṣayastulyatāyāḥ| syādetat--brāhmaṇasahacaritāyāmadhyayanīdikāyāṃ
kriyāyāṃ brāhmaṇaśabdasya vṛttiḥ- brāhṇaṇena tulyaṃ vartate, ko'rthaḥ ?
yathā vrāhṇaṇo vartate tathā vartata ityarthaḥ| vartanam
uadhyayanādikriyānuṣṭānam, tena yuktameva tulyatvamiti| evamapi
mukhye sanbhavati gauṇasya grahaṇaṃ yuktam| kaḥ punarmukhyaḥ ?
kriyāvācī| pacatyādīnāṃ
tāvatkriyāvācināmaprātipadikatvādasatvabhūtārthābhidhāyitvācca
tṛtīyāsamarthatvaṃ na sambhavati| avyayakṛtānāṃ tu--kṛtvā, hṛtvā,
kartum, hartumityevamādīnāṃ yadyapi kriyāvācitvam, yathā
pañācakṛtvaḥ kṛtveti kṛtvo'rthotpatirbhivati;
tathāpyasatvabhūtārthābhidhāyitvātatīyāntatvābhāvaḥ ghañādayaśca
dātvarthasya siddhatāyāṃ bhavantaḥ satvabhūtārthābhidhāyino na
kriyāvacanāḥ| ata eva hi tatra kṛtvo'rthapratyayābhāvaḥ| na hi bhavati
pañcakṛtvaḥ pāka iti, bhavati tu pañcapākā iti| yathā pañcaghaṭā iti
bhavati, na tu bhavati pañcakṛtvo ghaṭa iti| bhoktuaṃ pāka ityādau
dhātuvācyakriyopekṣastumunpratyayaḥ| ghṛtapākena tulyastailapāka
ityādirapi viṣayo na bhavati|
nanu pañcakṛtvaḥ śayitavyamiti kṛtvasuco devanācchayitavyādayaḥ
kriyāvacanāḥ, tataḥ kim ? rājaśayitavyena tulyaṃ
devadataśayitavyamityādiravakāśaḥ syat, tatā skhathātavyena tulyaṃ
gamanaṃ mandatvāt, tathā nartitavyena tulyaṃ gamanaṃ
vahuvikāratvāditi, tatā bhokagtuṃ pāka ityādau yathā
prakṛtivācyakriyāpekṣastumun bhavati, tathā dhṛtapākena
tulyastailapāka ityadau vatirapi syāditi so'pyavakāśaḥ; tadevaṃ
pratyayārthaviśeṣaṇe'pi kriyāgrahaṇe sāmarthyātprakṛtyartho'pi kriyaiva
bhavati, na hyakriyayā kriyā tulyā bhavatīti kriyāvācibhya eva vatinā
bhavitavyaṃ prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇe sutarāmiti kathaṃ kleśena kriyāyāṃ
vartitebhyastebhyo brāhmaṇādibhyaḥ pratyayaḥ ? ucyate; yenopamīyate,
yaśyopamīyate, yaśca tayoḥ sādhāraṇo dharmaḥ--
etrayamapyapekṣyopamānopameyabhāvaḥ pravartate| tatra yadā
kriyopamānatvena vivakṣyate, tadā
sāvaśyāpekṣyasādhāraṇadharmādhāratvātkriyārūpātāṃ hitvā satvarūpatāṃ
prapadyate, tataśca sāmarthyād bhūtapūrvagatyāśrayaṇam--yasyārthasya
kriyārūpatāpūrvamabhūt samprati kriyārūapātikrameṇa
satvabhāvāpanno'pi tṛtīyāntavācyaḥ parigṛhyate| tadevaṃ samprati
mukhyakrayāvācyisambhavād bhūtapūrvakriyārūpārthavācinaḥ
śayitavyādayo'pi gauṇā eva| gauṇaṃ ca kriyāvācitvaṃ brāha
ṇādīnāmapi sambhavatīti tebhyo'pi bhavati pratyayaḥ| teṣāṃ tu na
kasyāñcidapi daśāyāṃ mukhyakriyāvācitvamityetāvāÄstu viśeṣaḥ|
yadi tarhi kriyayostulyatvale pratyayaḥ brāhmaṇādhyayanena tulyamadhyayanaṃ
karoti brāhmaṇavadadhīta ityanyaḥ sādhāraṇo dharmo'pekṣaṇīyaḥ syāt|
tasmād dravyayoreva tulyatve pratyayaḥ, kriyā tu sādhāraṇo dharma
iti yuktam| na yuktam; evaṃ hi yathā brāhmaṇena tulyaḥ
kṣatriyo'dhyayaneneti, dravyasya liṅgasaṃkhyāyogitvāt| svarādiṣu
pāṭhādbhaviṣyati ? ihapi tarhi prāpnoti-upasargocchandasi dhātvarthe ya
udvato nivato yāsi|
kiñca pāṭhādbhavatu saṃjñā, liṅgasaṃkhyākārakaśaktiyogastu kena
vāryate--svaḥ paśyetyādivat ! laukike ca prayoge kriyayoreva
sādṛśyaṃ pratīyate, na tadvatordearavyayoḥ| yatpunaruktam--sādhāraṇo
dharmo'pekṣaṇīyaḥ syāditi ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; candra iva mukhamasyā ityādau
yathā śabdānupātā api kāntyādayaḥ pratīyante, tathātrāpi
sauṣṭhavādayaḥ pratyeṣyante| tasmātsuṣṭhūaktam--yatatulyaṃ kriyā cetsā
bhavatīti| guṇatulya iti| guṇaistulya iti ? ṭhpūrvasadṛśa' iti
tṛtīyāsamāsaḥ| putreṇa tulyaḥ syūla iti| putrasya yādṛśaṃ sthaulyaṃ
piturapi tādṛśamityarthaḥ ||

tatra tasyeva || 5|1|116 ||
kimarthamidamucyate na pūrveṇaiva siddham, na siddhayati,
tṛtīyāsamarthātatra pratyayaḥ, iha tu saptamīṣaṣṭhīsamarthāt ? evaṃ tarhi
tulyārthairiti yā tṛtīyā tayevaśabdayoge sarve vibhaktayarthā
vyāptāḥ, tadyathā--brāhṇaṇa ivādhīte, brāhmaṇena tulyamadhīte; brāhmaṇamiva
paśyati, brāhṇena tulyaṃ paśyati; brāhmaṇaenevādhītam, brāhmaṇena
tulyamadhītam; brāhmaṇāyeva dadāti, brāhmaṇena tulyaṃ dadāti;
brāhmaṇādivādhīte, brāhmaṇena tulyamadhīte; brāhmaṇasyeva kṣatriyasya svam,
brāhmaṇena tulyaṃ kṣatriyasya svam; brāhṇa iva kṣatriye vartate, brāhmaṇena
tulyaṃ kṣatriye vartata iti--tataśca tṛtīyāntadeva pūrvasūtreṇa
pratyayo bhaviṣyati| tathā ca ṭhpūrvavatsanaḥ' iti
pañcamyantādvatirdṛśyate| evamapi na siddhayati, kiṃ kāraṇam ? pūrvatra
kriyātulyatve pratyayaḥ, taccāvaśyaṃ kriyāgrahaṇaṃ kartavyam, gavā
tulyo gavaya ityādau mā bhūdityevaramarthaḥ; tataśca
dravyaguṇayostulyatve vatirna syāditi
ṣaṣṭhīsaptamayantādivārthe'nena vidhīyate ||

tadarham || 5|1|117 ||
taditi dvitīyāsamarthāditi| arhaśabdaḥ pacādyajantastadyoge karmaṇi
ṣaṣṭha|la bhavitavyam, nipātanātu dvitīyā| apara
āha--vigrahavākyābhiprāyametat; yadā rājānamarhatītyevaṃ
tihntena vigrahyate tadā dvitīyā samarthamiti| sūtre tvarhamiti
karmopapadādacpratyayaḥ kṛta iti| iha kriyāgrahaṇamanuvartate--yatadarha
kriyā cetsā bhavatīti, rājānamarhati vṛtaṃ rājavadvartate, iha na
bhavati--rājānamarhati cchatram, vrāhmaṇamarhati dadhīti| yadyevam, rājñā
tulyaṃ vartate iti vigrahāśrayaṇena pūrveṇaiva vatiḥ siddhaḥ ? iha tarhi
rājavadvartate rājeti bhedābhāvena tannibandhanasya
sādṛśyasyābhāvādaprāpto vatiranena vidhīyate| atrāpi rājatvena ye
prasiddā bharatādayasta upamānānīdānīntanānāmiti siddho vatiḥ| yadā
tarhi rājaśabdaḥ sāmānyavacanaḥ prasiddhaviśeṣaviṣayo vā--rājavadayaṃ
vartate bharata iti, tadā sādṛśyābhāvādaprāptiḥ| vinītavadupasyitaṃ
ciccheda kṛtahastavaditi vinītānāmidaṃ yogyamupasthānam
kṛtahastānāmidaṃ yogyaṃ chedana miti gamyate, na tu sādṛśyam| uktaṃ
ca--
ṭhyuktamaupayikaṃ rājña ityarthasya nidarśanam|
upamānavivakṣāyāṃ tadarhamiti paṭha|lte ' || iti |
yadā tvekameva vastu
avasthābhedaparikalpitabhedamupamānopameyatvena vivakṣyate, tadā
nārtho'nena| tathā cevaśabdasya prayogo dṛśyate--rājevāyaṃ rājā
yudhyate, vaiyyākaraṇa iva vaityākaraṇo brūte, rāmarāvaṇayoryuddhaṃ
rāmarāvaṇayoriveti| uktam----
ṭhtadarhamiti nārabdhaṃ sūtraṃ vyākarṇāntare|
sambhavatyupamātrāpi bhedasya parikalpanāt' || iti |

upasargācchandasi dhātvarthe || 5|1|118 ||
sasādhane dhātvarthe iti| kriyāmātraṃ dhātvarthaḥ, statkathaṃ sasādhana iti
labhyate ? ucyate; ihārthagrahaṇaṃ na kartavyam, dhātāvityeva siddham,
kathaṃ punardhātau nāmopasargo varteta, śabde śabdāsambhavāt ? arthe
vṛttirvijñāsyate| tathā--dhātusambandhe' ityatra tat kriyate
bahuvrīhiryathā vijñāyeta--dhāturdhātvarthaḥ kriyā, arthaḥ prayojanaṃ
yasya sādhanasya tasminvartamānāditi| ṭhsasādhane dhātvarthe'
atyasyāpyayamevārthaḥ---dhātvarthaviśiṣṭe sādhana iti, na punaḥ
sādhanaviśiṣṭe dhātvartha iti| upasargāśca punarevamātmakāḥ yaduta
śrutāyāṃ kriyāyāṃ tāmeva viśiṃṣanti, yathā--āgacchatīti| yatra tu na
śrūyate tatra kriyāviśiṣṭṃa sādhanamāhuḥ---niṣkauśāmbiriti, tatra
yatra kriyā na śrūyate tatra yathā syādityevamarthaṃ dhātvartha ityuktam|
udgatāni nigatānīti| vanānāṃ viśeṣyatvānnapuṃsakatvam| udvato
nivata iti tu chāndasaṃ puṃstvamiti manyate| yaccāsmābhiruktam--
ṭhkriyā guṇabhūtā sādhanaṃ pradhānabhūtaṃ tatropasargasya vṛttiḥ' iti
tadapyatena darśaitm| sādhanaśabdena śaktimad dravyamucyate,na
śaktimātramiti liṅgasaṅkhyāyogādanvarthāvyayasaṃjñā na bhavati || 

tasya bhāvastvatalau || ṭhtasyedam' ityasyāpavādo'yam|
bhāvaśabdo'yam ṭhbhavateśceti vaktavyam' iti
ṇapratyayānto'styevābhiprāye, yathā--athaṃ bhāvaḥ' iti; asti ca
padārthamātravacanaḥ,--ṭhvicitrā hi bhāvaśaktayaḥ' iti; asti ca
śrṛṅgārādiṣu--stāyībhāvaḥ sañcārībhāva iti; ghañantastu bhavatyarthe
