kartṛvarjite ca kārake vartate| bhavatiścānekārthaḥ, tadyathā--ṭhtatra
bhavaḥ' iti satārthaḥ; ṭhdhānyānāṃ bhavane' ityutpatyarthaḥ; ṭhitthambhūte'
iti prāptyarthaḥ; ṭhbhūṣṇurbhūtikāmaḥ' iti samṛddhyarthaḥ; ṭhyasya ca
bhāvena bhāvalakṣaṇam' ityādau dhātvarthamātravacanaḥ;
vṛttikāropadarśitaścāparaḥ, tataśca ṭhtasya bhāvaḥ'
ityabhiprāyādiṣvatpirasaṅgaḥ? ityata āhabhavato'smādityādi|
yasmād gotvāderhetorgavādau gaurityevamādikamabhidhānaṃ
pravartate, gaurgaurityevamādiścābhinnākāraḥ pratyayo bhavati,
so'rtho gavādeḥ śabdasya pravṛttinimitamiha bhāvaśabdenocyate|
tatra bhavato'smādityarthapradarśanametat, na tu hetau kenacid
ghañvavihaḥ| tasmāt ṭhśriṇībhuvo'nupasarge' iti karaṇe ghañ draṣṭavyaḥ|
abhiprāyādīnāṃ cānabhidhānānna grahaṇam| uktaṃ ca---ṭhyasya guṇasya
bhāvād dravye śabdaniveśastadabhidhāne tvatalau' iti| gueṇaśabdena
yāvānkaścitparāśrayo bhedako jātyādirarthaḥ sa sarva iha gṛhyate|
ṭhyasya bhāvāt' ityetāvatyucyamāne putrasya bhāvātpitṛśabdasya
niveśa iti pitatvamiti putre pratyayaḥ syāt, putratvamiti ca
pitarīti guṇagrahaṇam; bhāvād vidyamānatvāt| dvavyamiti
viśeṣyabhūtaḥ satvabhāvāpanno'rta ucyate, tasmin
śabdaniveśaḥuśabdasya pravṛttiḥ, satvatalorabhidheya ityarthaḥ| tatra ye
rūpādayaḥ śabdā guṇamātravṛtayastebhyo guṇasamavāyini
sāmānyaviśeṣe bhāvapratyayo rūpatvamiti| ye tu śuklādayo
guṇaguṇivṛtayo guṇaguṇinorabedopacārāt, matublopādvā,
tebhyo guṇavṛttibhyo guṇasamavāyini sānānye bhāvapratyayaḥ;
guṇivṛttibyastu guṇe| aṇumahaddīrghadayo nityaṃ parimāṇini
vartante, tebhyaḥ parimāṇo guṇe bhāvapratyayaḥ, ṣatvaṃ ṇatvamiti
bhinnavarṇavyaktisamavete sāmānyaviśeṣe pratyayaḥ| gavādayo yadā
jātimātravācinastadā tebhyaḥ śabdasvarūpe pratyayaḥ, tathā hayarthe
jātau śabdasvarūpamadhyasyate--yo gośabdaḥ sa śabdārtha iti|
śabdasvarūpameva tatra pravṛttinimitam, nānyat| dravyavācibhyastu
gavādibhyo jātau pratyayaḥ, samāsakṛtaddhitāstu yadyapi kevalaṃ
sambandhaṃ nābhidadhati, tathāpi sambandhini vartamānāḥ sambandhaṃ
pravṛttinimitamapekṣanta iti tebhyaḥ sambandhe bhāvapratyayaḥ| tathā ca
rājapuruṣatvamiti svasvāmibhāvaḥ sambandhaḥ pratīyate, pācakatvamiti
kriyākārakasambandhaḥ, aupagavatvamityādāvapatyāpatsisambandhaḥ|
kecidaupagavatvamityapatyapratyayasya jātimabhidheyāmicchanti; tanmate,
arthāntaravṛttistaddhaita udāhāryaḥ--ṭhsamāsakṛtiddhiteṣu
sambandhābhidhānamanyatra rūḍha|lbhinnarūpāvyabhicaritasambandhebhyaḥ' iti,
rūḍhiśabdā gaurakharasaptaparṇalohitaśālyādayo
jātiviśeṣāvacchinnadravyavācina iti tebhyo jātāveva bhāvapratyayaḥ|
evaṃ kumbhakāratvam, hastitvamiti abhinnarūpāḥ| śuklādayo
matuvluki vijñāyamāne yadyapi taddhitāntāḥ, tathāpi tebhyo
bhāvapratyayo guṇa eva bhavati; na tu sambandhe
guṇaguṇinorjātitadvatoriva so'yamityabhisambandhena
lokanirūḍheana bhedasambandhasya nyagbhāvāt| ṭhguṇavacanebhyo luk'
iti lugvidhānadvāreṇābedenaiva guṇināmabhidhānam, na tu
bedāśrayā matvarthīyotpatirityākhyāyate| avyabhicāri sambhandhāt
sato bhāvaḥ sateti jātāveva bhāvapratyayaḥ| na hi sadvastu
satāsambandhaṃ vyabhicaratīti satāsambandhānapekṣaṇād na sambandhe
pratyayaḥ| rājapuruṣayostu sambandhasya kādacitkatvātadapekṣo
rājapuruṣaśabdaḥ svārthamabhidhate iti tataḥ sambhande pratyayo yuktaḥ|
tasmātsatsu padārtheṣu nityasamavāyini śabdapravṛttihetuḥ sataiva
bhāvapratyayavācyā, na tu satsattyoḥ sambandhaḥ samavāyākhyaḥ|
dhavakhadiratvamiti jātidvandvājjātisamudāyaḥ kutvamityādau
saṃjñāsvarūpe saṃjñiṣvadhyaste pratyayaḥ| anye tu ṭhsaṃjñāsaṃjñisambandhaḥ'
ityāhuḥ| uktaṃ ca---- 
jātiguṇājjātiguṇe samāsakṛtadvitācca sambandhe|
ḍitthādeḥ sve rūpe dhavakhadirājjātisaṅghāte || iti |
iha tu nānātvam, sahatvam, yaugapadyamityādau vṛttiviṣaye
nānāśabdo'sahabhūte'rthe vartate, sahaśabdaśca sahabhūte,
yugapacchaśabdo'pi yugapadbhūte, tato'sahabhāvādau bhāvapratyayaḥ|
evamanyatrāpi yathāsambhavaṃ draṣṭavyam| iha na brāhmaṇasya bhāva iti
kayugapadbhāvena nañarthena ca sambandhe vivakṣite pūrvaṃ nañsamāsaḥ,
paścātvatalau, tenābrāhmaṇatvamabrāhmaṇateti satiśiṣṭatvātvapratyaye
nañsamāsaḥ, paścātvatalau tenābrāhmaṇatvaṃ bhavati,
nāvyayapūrvapadaprakṛtisvareṇādyaudātatvam| nanu paratāvatvatalau
prāpnutaḥ, na vā sāpekṣatvādbrāṇārtho yatra nañarthamapekṣate|
nañsamāṃso'pi tarhi na prāpnoti, brāhmaṇasya bhāvapekṣatvāt ?
naivam; pradhānamatra brāhmaṇapadam, utarapadārthapradhāno hi nañsamāsaḥ|
bhavati ca pradhānasya sāpekṣasyāpi samāsaḥ, yathā--rājapuruṣo'bhirūpa
iti| ṭhvā cchandasi' cchandasi viṣaye kvacitpūrvaṃ tvatalau
paścānnañsamāsaḥ--ayonitvāya, aśithilatvāya| atra nañsvara eva
bhavati, kvicidviparyayaḥ| tvatalvyatirikte bhāvapratyayo pūrvaṃ sa
eveṣyate, paścānnañsamāsaḥ, tenāprathimetyādau sati
siṣṭatvānnañsvara eva bhavati| aśauklyamityādau ca nañaḥ
prakṛtāvanantarbhāvācchuklaśabdādau vṛddhiḥ pūrva nañsamāse ṭhna
nañpūrvāt' iti pratiṣedhāt ṣyañeca na syāt, satyapi vā ṣyañi
naño vaddhaiḥ syāt ? jñāpakātsiddham, yadayaṃ yuvādiṣu puruṣāse,
hṛdayāme iti nañsamāse viṣayabhūte bhāvapratyayapratiṣedhaṃ śāsti,
tajjñāpayati--tvatalāpavādapratyayo nañarthāpekṣādapi
paratvānnañsamāsaṃ bādhitvā bhavatīti ||

ā ca tvāt || 5|1|120 ||
prathimeti| ṭhturiṣṭhemeyassu' ṭhṭeḥ' iti ṭilopaḥ, ṭhraṛto
halāderlaghoḥ' iti ṛkārasya rādeśaḥ| pārthavamiti| ṭhigantācca
laghupūrvāt' ityaṇ|
apavādairityādi| imanijādaāāstvatalorapavādānvakṣyati, taiḥ saha
samāveśo yathā syādityevamarthamidam| nanu svaritatvādeva
tvatalāvanuvartiṣyete tenāpavādaviṣaye bhaviṣyataḥ ? tanna; ita
utaravākyānāṃ pratyayanirddeśena nirākāṃkṣatvātvatalorapi
pūrvasūtre vidhānādākāṃkṣāyā abhāvānnaitacchakyaṃ
vijñātum-anuvartete tvatalāviti| karmaṇi ca vidhānārāthamiti|
yebhya eva karmaṇi ṣyañādividhistebhya eva tvatalāvapi karmaṇi bhavataḥ,
na tu ṅyāpprātipadikamātrāt| cakāro nañasnañbyāmapi
samāveśārtha iti| anyathā ṭhstrīpuṃsābhyām' ityasya vidhitvapakṣe
prāgbhavanādye'rthāstānapekṣya tatraiva pradeśe nañsnañorvidhānādatra
prakaraṇe sannidhānābhāvānnemanijādivatsamāveśasiddhiḥ|
paribhāṣātve'pi yathoddeśapakṣe ṭhstrīpuṃsābhyām' ityatraiva prakaraṇe
nañsnañoḥ sannidhiḥ| na punarimanijādimadhye kāryakālapakṣe'pi
prāgbhavanādye'rthāḥ, tatra nañsnañbhyāmupasthātavyam| tatra yadi
tāvadbhāve ityarthavijñānamātra eva nañsnañorupasthānam--ṭhtasya
bhāvastvatalau' ṭhstrīpuṃsābhyāṃ bhāve nañsnañau' iti, tadasminpradeśe
sannidhāne'pi ṭhā ca tvāt' ityasmātpūrvai bhavataḥ| atha
tūtsargāpādavidhānopayogavijñānānantaraṃ nañsnavyorupasthānam,
tadā brahmaṇastva ityasmātparau nañasnañau bhavataḥ| sarvathā ṭhā ca tvāt'
ityasminpradeśe nābhyantarau| ṭhguṇapacanabrāhmaṇādibhyaḥ kamaṇi ca' ityatra
karmaṇi nañsnañorupasthānaṃ nāśaṅnīyam; prakṛtiviseṣasambaddhasya
karmārthasyopādānāt prakṛtyantareṇa tasyāsambandhāt| adhikārapakṣe
tu pratisūtramupasthānānnañsnañorimanijādiṣvantarbhāvād ṭhā ca
tvāt' ityeva nañsnañbhyāmapi samāveśaḥ sidhyati| atha
tatrāpyarthasyaivāvadhitvādartheṣvevopasthānam, tato'dhikārapakṣe'pi
nābhyantaratvamiti sarvathā cakāreṇaiva nañsnañbhyāṃ samāveśo
vācyaḥ ||

na nañpūrvātatpuruṣādacaturasaṅgatalavaṇavaṭacabudhakatarasalasebhyaḥ
|| 5|1|121 ||
ṭhanantarasya vidhirvā bhavati pratiṣedho vā' iti tvatalorayaṃ
pratiṣedha iti bhrānti vārayati| ita utare ye pratyayā iti| etacca ṭhā ca
tvāt' iti sambandhāllabhyate| caturādīnīti|
caturādyantāÄstatpuruṣānnañpūrvānityarthaḥ| nanu ṭhpṛthvādibhya
imanijvā' ityādibhiḥ pariṇaṇitābhyaḥ prakṛtibhya utaro bāvapratyayo
vidhīyate| na ca tatra kācinnañpūrvā prakṛtirgṛhyate| tadantavidhiśca
grahaṇavatā prātipadikena pratiṣidhdhaḥ| yatra tarhi svarūpagrahaṇaṃ nāsti
patyantādyagbhavati, hāyanāntādaṇ bhavati, ṭhigantācca laghupūrvāt',
ṭhyopadādgurupotamādvuñ' iti, tatra nañpūrvātatpuruṣādastyeva
prasaṅgastaddarśayati--vakṣyati patyanta purohitādibhyo yagiti|
apatitvamapatiteti| tatu ṭhā ca tvāt' ityadhikāra ityuktam, tataśca
patyantetyanenaiva tvatalorapyadhikṛtayovidhānam| tataḥ kim ? yaka
iva tvatalorapyaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ prāpnoti| astvevamadhikṛtayo stvataloḥ
pratiṣedhaḥ, ṭhtasya bhāvaḥ' ityanena punastvatalau bhaviṣyataḥ;
bādhakābhāvāt| yadi patyantādipvevāsyopayogaḥ,
patyantetyasyaiva purastādidaṃ paṭhitavyam,
tadevotaratrāpyanuvartiṣyate| evaṃ tarhtra pradeśe
pratiṣedhādhikaarasyopādānādimanijādīnāmapi pratiṣedo
vijñāyate| nanu coktam--ṭhtadantavidhyabhāvādaprasaṅgaḥ' iti ? evaṃ
tarhyetajjñāpayati-astyutaratra tadantavidhirita| kimetasya jñāpane
prayojanam ? nañpūrvādbahuvrīheranyapūrvācca
tatpuruṣātpṛthvādyantādimanijādiḥ siddho bhavati--na vidyante pṛthvo
yasya apṛthuḥ, paramapṛthuḥ, tasya bhāva iti| nātromanijādiriṣyate,
ata eva vṛttikāreṇāpi nāsya paṭavaḥ santītyapaṭuarityādi vyāvartya
darśitam, tasmādihāsya karaṇe prayojanaṃ cintyam|
ācaturyamityādau brāhmaṇāditvātṣyañ ||

pṛthvādibhya imanijvā || 5|1|122 ||
vāvacanamaṇīdisamāveśārthamiti| iha ye igantā laghupūrvāḥ
pṛthumṛduprabhṛtayasteṣvaṇaḥ samāveśaḥ| caṇḍakhaṇkaḍādiṣu
guṇavacaneṣu ṣyañaḥ, bālavatsādiṣu vayovacanalakṣaṇasyāñaḥ|
tvatalostu masāveśaḥ ṭhā ca tvāt' ityeva siddhaḥ ? ityāha--tvatalau
tu sarvatra bhavata eveti ||

varṇadṛḍhādibhtayaḥ ṣyañ ca || 5|1|123 ||
varṇaviśeṣavācibhya iti| svarūpagrahaṇaṃ tu na bhavati| yadi syād,
dṛḍhādiṣveva varṇaśabdaṃ paṭhet| varṇaśabdaśca rūpasya vācako na
brāhmaṇādīnām; dṛḍhādibhirguṇavacanaiḥ sāhacaryāt| ata eva
sāhacaryādvarṇagrahaṇātparyāyāṇāṃ grahaṇaṃ na bhavati| katham ? dṛḍhāyayo
hi guṇopasarjane dravye vartante, atastatsāhacaryādvarṇaśabdā api
tādṛśā eva gṛhyante| evañca varṇadṛḍhādīnāṃ guṇavacanatvādeva siddhe
punarvacanamanijartham |
aucitī, yāthākāmiti| brāhmaṇāaderākṛtigaṇatvātṣyañ, ṅīṣ,
ṭhhalastaddhitasya' iti yalopaḥ|
veryātalābhamatimanaḥśāradānāmiti| visabdādutare ye
yātādayastadantānāṃ samāsānāmanantaraḥ ṣyañ bhavatītyarthaḥ|
viyātatvam, viyātatā, viyātimā, vaiyātyam| vilābhatvam,
vilābhavatā, vilābhimā, vailābhyam| vimatitvam, vimatitā,
vimatimā, vaimaṣyam; igantatvādaṇapi bhavati, vaimatam,|
vimanastvam, vimanastā, vimanimā, vaimanasyam| viśāradatvam,
viśāradatā, viśāradimā, vaiśāradyam, samo matimanasoriti| sama
utare ye matimanasī tayoḥ samāsayoranantaraḥ ṣyañ--saṃmatitvam,
saṃmatitā, saṃmatimā, sāmmatyam; pūrvavadaṇsāṃmatam|
saṃmanastvam, saṃmanastā, saṃmanimā, sāṃmanasyam ||

guṇavacanabrāhmaṇādibhyaḥ karmaṇi ca || 5|1|124 ||
karmaśabdaḥ kriyāvacana iti| na sādhanakarmavacanaḥ; kriyāyā hi sādhanaṃ
sambhavati| satvaśabdāśca guṇavacanabrāhmaṇādayaḥ, atasteṣāṃ nāsti
sādhanakarmaṇā sambandhaḥ| kriyā tvātmalābhaya tairyajyate| kathaṃ tarhi
kaveḥ karma kāvyam, na hi tatra kriyābhidhīyate, kiṃ karhi, tatkṛto
granthaḥ ? atrāhuḥ--kriyākarmaṇyeva pratyayavidhānam, aupacārikastu
tatkṛte prayoga iti| apara āha--sūtre yaḥ karmaśabdo yaśca vṛtau
kriyāśabdaḥ, tadubhayamapi karmasādhanaṃ karma, kriyākāryamityarthaḥ, tena
kṛtivyāpye sādhanakarmaṇyeva pratyaya iti| bhāhmaṇādirakṛtigaṇa iti
avṛtkṛtatvāt| etadevopapādayati--ādiśabdaḥ prakāravacana iti|
kimarthaṃ tarhi guṇavacanagrarahaṇam, brāhmaṇādīnāṃ cānukramaṇam ?
keṣāñcitprapañcārtham; keṣāñcitsvārthe pratyayavidhānārtham,
keṣāñcid vādhakabādhanārtham| tatra
brāhṇamaśabdātprāṇabhṛjjātilakṣaṇe'ñi prāpte, ṭhmāṇavavāḍavābhyāṃ
gotralakṣaṇe' vuñi| ṭharhato num ca' iti numarthaḥka pāṭhaḥ; ṭharhaḥ
prāśaṃsāyām' iti śatṛpratyayaḥ--ārhantyam|
coradhūrtayormanojñāditvādvuñiprāpte so'pi bhavatyeva|
ārādhyādīnāṃ caturṇāṃ janapadavācitvādañi kṛte, tasya ca
ṭhkambojādibhyo lugvavacanam' iti luki gotravuñi prāpte pāṭhaḥ|
ekabhāvādīnāmanyabhāvaparyantānāṃ svārthe vidhānārtham| tathā ca
vārtike prayogaḥ--ṭhānyabhāvyaṃ tu kālaśabdavyavāyāt' iti|
akṣetrajñānīśvaraśabdayoḥ ṭhna nañpūrvāt' iti niṣedhe prāpte,
kuśalādīnāṃ yuvāditvādami prāpte, bāliśaśabdādvayolakṣaṇo'ñi
prāpte, rājaśabdasya purohitāditvādyaki prāpte, gaṇapatyadhipatyoḥ
patyantalakṣaṇe yaki| śeṣāṇāmalasādīnāṃ pāṭhaḥ prapañcārthaḥ|
sarvavaledādibhyaḥ svārthe iti| sarve vedāḥ sarvavedāḥ, pūrvakāloti
samāsaḥ, sarvavedānadhīt ityaṇ, ṭhsarvasāderddhigośca laḥ' iti luk,
sarvaveda eva sārvavedyaḥ| caturvedasyobhayapadavṛddhiśceti| caturo
vedānadhīte iti taddhitārthe dviguḥ, aṇo luk, caturveda eva
cāturvaidyaḥ| kvacitu cāturvaidyasyeti pāṭhaḥ, tatra siddhaya iti śeṣaḥ,
catasro vidyā adhīta ityādi ṣūrvavad vidyālakṣaṇakalpasūtrāntāditi
ṭhak, pūrvavalluk, caturvidhya eva cāturvaidyaḥ ||

stenādyannalopaśca || 5|1|125 ||
ṭhstena caurye', pacādyatu, stenaḥ| naśabdasyeti| etena saṅghātasyedaṃ
grahaṇamiti darśayati| varṇagrahaṇe tu nakāralope kṛte'kārasya
yasyeti lopaḥ| tasya pūrvavidhau sthānivadbhāvādayādeśaḥ
prāpnoti| nanu sahghātagrahaṇe'pi ṭhallo'ntyasya' ityantyasya
prāpnoti ? siddho'ntyalopaḥ ṭhyasyeti ca' iti;
tatrārambhasāmarthyātsarvasya bhaviṣyati,
ṭhnānarthake'lontyavidhiranabhyāsavikāreṣu' iti ca paribhāṣāṃ
paṭhanti| stenāditi yogavibhāgaṃ kurvantīti| bhāgye'nuktamapi
stainyaśabdasya prayogabāhulyādidamuktam || 

kapijñātyorḍhak || 5|1|126 ||
iha kapijñātī dvau, bhāvakarmaṇī cārthau dvāveveti saṃkhyātānudeśaḥ
prāpnoti, evam ṭhpatyantapurohitādibhyo yak',
ṭhhāyanāntayuvādibhyo'ṇ' ityatretyāśaṅkayāha--yathāsaṃkhyaṃ prakaraṇe
neṣyata iti| tadarthasya svaritatvasyāpratijñānāditi bhāvaḥ ||

patyantapurohitādibhyo yak || 5|1|127 ||
rājāsa yiti| rājaśabdo'se'samāse yakamutpādayati--rājño bhāvaḥ
karma vā rājyam| ṭhase' iti kim? ādhirājyam,
brāhmaṇāditvalātyañ| yadyapi tatra rājaśabdaḥ paṭha|lte, tathāpyayamevāsa
iti pratiṣedho jñāpayati--ṭhastyatra rājaśabde tadantavidhiḥ' iti| evaṃ
ca brāhmaṇādipāṭhasya samāse caritārthatvādasamāse viśeṣavihito
yageva bhavati|
apara āha--ṭhbrāhmaṇāderākṛtigaṇatvādeva tadantāt ṣyañi siddhe
rājaśabdasya tatra pāṭho yakā saha samāveśārthaḥ' iti, tathā
cāveṣṭa|ldhikaraṇe śābarabāṣye uktam--ṭhtasya karmaṇi ṣyañ' iti ||

prāṇamṛjjātivayovacanodgātrādibhyo'ñ || prāṇabhṛtaḥuprāṇinaḥ,
prāṇigrahaṇameva na kṛtaṃ vaicitryārtham| prāṇabhṛdgrahaṇātṛṇatvaṃ
tṛṇatetyādau na bhavati, jātigrahaṇāddevadatatvamityādau na bhavati|
yatvihegantaṃ laghupūrvaṃ tasmātparatvādaṇ bhavati--taitiram|
udgātrādiṣu ya ṛtvigvacanāstebhyaḥ ṭhhotrābyaścchaḥ' iti che
prāpde'ñ cavidhīyate| suṣṭhuaduṣṭhuabhyāṃ guṇavacanalakṣṇe ṣyañi,
vadhūśabdādigantalakṣaṇe'ṇi, śeṣebhyastvataloḥ prāptayoḥ| subhagaṃ
mantre iti| subhagamityetacchabdarūpaṃ mantraviṣaye
prayoge'ñamutpādayati--ṭhmahate saubhagāya', sarvavidhīnāṃ cchandasi
vikalpitatvāt ṭhhṛdbhagasindhvanta' ityutarapadavṛddhirna bhavati| ata
eva mantre kvacidañ na bhavati--saubhāgyamasyai datvāya ||

hāyanāntayuvādibhyo'ṇ || hāyanāntātvataloḥ
prāptayoraṇvidhānam| yauvanamiti| ṭhan' iti prakṛtibhāvaḥ,
manojñāditvadvuñapi bhavati| sthaviraśabdasya vayolakṣaṇe'ñi prāpte
pāṭhaḥ, hotṛśabdasyāpyudgātrāditvādañyeva| puruṣāsa iti|
puruṣaśabdo'samāse'ṇamutpādayati, pauruṣam,
prāṇabhṛjjātivācitvādañ prāptaḥ, manuṣyajātivacano hrasau na
puṃsśabdaparyāyaḥ puṃlliṅgavacanaḥ; striyāmapi
daśanāt--tasyāmasyāṃ ca puruṣīśca dhenuke dadyariti| asa iti kim?
rājapuruṣatvam| kamaṇḍaluśabdasyegantatvādevāṇi siddhe
tvatalnivṛtyarthaḥ pāṭhaḥ| hṛdayāsa iti|
dṛdayaśabdo'samāse'ṇamutpādayati-hṛdayasya bhāvo hārdam, ṭhhṛdayasya
hṛllokhayadaṇlāseṣu' iti hṛdbhāvaḥ| ase iti kim ? ahṛdayatvam|
grahaṇavatā prātipadikena tadantavidhipratiṣedhādeva siddhe
samāsapratiṣedhaścintyaprayojanaḥ| kuśalādīnāṃ kṣetrajñāntānāṃ
brāhmaṇāditvātṣyañapi bhavati|
śrotriyasya ghalopaśceti| yadā ṭhśrotriyaÄścchandodhīte' ityatra cchandasaḥ
śrotṛbhāvo ghaśca pratyaya iti pakṣaḥ, tadā ghalopaḥ; yadā tu ṭhvākyarthe
padavacanam' iti pakṣaḥ, tadā ghaśabdena ya iti rupaṃ lakṣyate| kvacitu
yalopaśceti pāṭhaḥ; tatra yalope saṅgātagrahaṇam, varṇagrahaṇe
tvakārasya yasyetilope sati ikārasya yaṇādeśaprasaṅgaḥ,
saṅghātalope tvikārasya yasyeti lopaḥ---sarvathā śrotriyasya bhāvaḥ
śrautramiti ||

igantācca laghupūrvāt || 5|1|131 ||
laghupūrvagrahaṇena prātipadikasamudāyo viseṣyate iti| yadyevam,
pūrvaśabdo'vayavavacanaḥ, vyavasthāvacano vā, tatrādye pakṣe yasya
sarvapūrvo varṇo laghustasmādeveṣvaṇuprabhṛteḥ syāt, dvitīye tu
pāṇḍuprabhṛtibhyo'pi syāt| yadā laghuḥ pūrvo
bhavatītyāśakhaṅkyāvayavavacana eva pūrvaśabdaḥ, so'pyavadhyapekṣa eva
pravartate, tatra kasyacidanirddeśe sarvapūrvaḥ pratīyate, iha tu
sannidhānādika eveti ? darśayati---laghuḥ pūrvo yasyetyādi| teneti
laghupūrveṇegantena| asminvyākhyāne, antagrahaṇamatiricyata iti
laghupūrveṇekā prātipadikasya viśeṣaṇātadantavidheḥ siddhatvāt| 
kathaṃ kāvyamiti| kāvamiti bhavitavyamiti praśnaḥ ||

yopadhād gurūpotamād vuñ || tripramṛtīnāmityādi| etacca
ṭhaṇiñoranārṣayoḥ' ityatra vyākhyātam| sahāyādveveti vaktavyamiti|
sūtreṇa nitye prāpte vikalpaḥ ||

dvandvamanojñādibhyaśca || 5|1|132 || 
yaḥ patyanto dvandvastasmādyak prāptaḥ, yastu hāyanāntastasmādaṇprāptaḥ,
anyasmātvalau, manojñādiṣvapi guṇavacanāt ṣyañ prāptaḥ,
coradhūrtābhyāmapi brāhmaṇāditvātṣyañeva, yuvaśabdādyauvāditvādaṇ,
śeṣebhyastvatalau| amuṣyaputreti| nipātanātṣaṣṭha|la aluk ||

gotracaraṇācchalādhātyākāratadaveteṣu || 5|1|133 ||
gotravācina iti| apatyādhikārādanyatra laukikaṃ gotraṃ gṛhyate,
apatyavācina ityarthaḥ| apatyapratyayāntāditi yāvat|
apara āha--gravarādhyāye paṭhitānāṃ gotrāṇāmiha grahaṇamiti|
caraṇavācinaśceti| caraṇaśabdaḥ śākhādhyāyiṣu puruṣeṣu rūḍhaḥ,
anayośca gotraṃ ca caraṇaiḥ saheti jātitvāt ṭhprāṇabhṛjjāti'
ityañprāptaḥ| pratyeka bhāvakarmaṇorarthayoriti| ṭhyathāsaṃkhyaṃ tu
sarvatraivātra prakaraṇe neṣyate' iti pūrvamevoktam| slāghādiṣu
viṣayabhūteṣviti| pratyayārthatvaṃ ślāghādīnāṃ na bhavati,
bhāvakarmaṇoḥ pratyayārthayoradhikṛtatvāt nāpi
pratyayārthaviśeṣaṇam--ye te bhāvakarmaṇī ślāghādayaścete bhavata iti;
asmbhavatā| śabdasya pravṛttinimitaṃ hi bhāvaḥ, na ca
gotracaraṇaśabdānāṃ ślāghādayaḥ pravṛttinimitam, nāpi
gotracaraṇaśabdānāṃ ślāghādikarmatvena prasiddhiḥ| tasmāt ślāghādiṣu
bhāvakarmaṇoḥ sādhyatayā viṣayabhūteṣvityevārthaḥ| tadavetastatprāpta
iti| iṇaḥ prāptyarthatvāt| tajjño veti| avapūrvasyeṇo jñāne
prasiddhatvāt| tacchabdena ceha gotracaraṇayorbhākavarmaṇī
pratinirddiśyate| gārgikayeti| ṭhāpatyasya ca' iti yalopaḥ ||

hotrābyaścchaḥ || hotrāśabda ṛtvijāṃ vācaka iti| juhoteśtran,
svabhāvataścāyamṛtvikṣvapi strīliṅgaḥ| acchāvākīyam
brāhmaṇācchṃasīyamiti| vede strīliṅgatāpi dṛśyate
ṭhso'syācchāvākīyāṃ kuryāt' iti ||

brahmaṇastvaḥ || 5|1|136 ||
brahmaṇastvaḥ || neti vaktavye iti| cchapratyaye pratiṣiddhe ṭhtasya
bhāvastvatalau' ityeva pratyayaḥ siddhaḥ, vibhakteranuccāraṇāllāghavaṃ
bhavatīti bhāvaḥ| yastu jātiśabda iti ṭhhotrābhyaḥ' ityanuvṛteḥ phalaṃ
darśayati || 

iti kaśrīharatamiśraviracitāyāṃ padamañjaryāṃ prañcamasyādhyāyasya prathamaḥ
pādaḥ |
kāśikāvṛtī

atha pañcamādhyāye dvitīyaḥ pādaḥ

dhānyānāṃ bhavane kṣetre khañ || 5|2|1 ||
dhinoteḥ ṭhkṛtyalyuṭo bahulam' iti kartari ṇyat, asmādeva
nipātanādantyasya lopaḥ, ikārasya cātvam| dhinotīti dhānyam|
ṭhdhānyamasi dhinuhi devān' iti hi dṛśyate| dhānyānāmiti
bhavanāpekṣayā kartari ṣaṣṭhī| bhavanamityadhikaraṇe lyuṭ| kṣiyaṣṭran,
kṣetram| bhavati jāyate'sminniti bhavanamiti| etenotpativacano'tra
bhavatirgṛhyate, na satāvacana iti darśayati| etacca kṣetragrahaṇāllabhyate|
kṣetraśabdo hi tṛṇānāṃ dhānyānāṃ cotpatyādhāramācaṣṭe| na hi
dhānyānāṃ satāṃ prati bhūmiḥ kṣetravyapadeśamāsādayati| mudrānāṃ
bhavanaṃ kusūlamiti| asati kṣetragrahaṇe satāvacanasyāpi bhavatergrahaṇaṃ
syādisi bhāvaḥ| kiñca--bhavanaśabdo gṛde ruḍha iti mudgānāṃ
gṛhamityatraiva prasaṅga ityapi śakyate vaktum|
yadi tarhiha kṣetragrahaṇamavaśyaṃ kartavyam, tadevāstu, kiṃ
bhavanagrahaṇena ? dhānyānāmiti śeṣalakṣaṇaṣaṣṭhī, kṣetraṃ pratyayārthaḥ| na
caivaṃ kṣetraśabdasyāpi śarīrabhāryādyanekārthatvādatiprasaṅga;
dhānyasambandhādutpattibhūmireva pratyaṣyate| tadetadbhavanagrahaṇaṃ
cintyaprayojanam ||

vrīhiśālyorḍhak || 5|2|2 ||
atrāpi nirddeśādeva paṣṭhī samarthavibhaktiḥ, vṛttikāreṇa tu
pūrvānusāreṇa gamyamānatvānnoktam ||

yavayavakaṣaṣṭikādyat || 5|2|3 ||
atra pratyayārthasāmarthyalabhyā ṣaṣṭhī samarthavibhaktiḥ ||

vibhāṣā talamāṣomābhaṅgāṇubhyaḥ || 5|2|4 ||
khañi prāpto vacanaṃ pakṣe so'pi bhavatīti| yuktaṃ yadaṇutilamāṣebhyaḥ
pakṣe kañapi bhavatīti, teṣāṃ dhānyatvāt;
umābhaṅgayostvadhānyatvādayuktam, dhānyānyeva hi camakānuvākeṣu
paṭha|lnte ṭhvrīhayasya me' ityādīni, tānyeva dhānyāni, na
comābhaṅgāvatra paṭha|lete ? ata āha--umābhaṅgayorapi
dhānyatvamāśritameveti| na camakānuvāko dhānyaparigaṇanārthaḥ,
tatrādhānyānāmapyaśmādīnāṃ pāṭhād, dhānyānāmipi kepāñcit
kodravādīnāmapāṭhāt| tasmādanyata eva thadhānyanirṇayaḥ, tatra
ṭhśaṇasaptadaśāni dhānyāni' iti smṛtiḥ, tatra comābhaṅge api
paṭhite| tasmādyauktameva yatābhyāmapi pakṣe khañ bhavatīti ||

sarvacarmaṇaḥ kṛtaḥ śakhañau || 5|2|5 ||
tṛtīyāsamarthāditi| kṛta iti pratyarthārthe carmaṇaḥ
karaṇatvātsāmarthyalabhyā tṛtīyā samarthavibhaktiḥ| sarvaśabdasya
carmaśabdena samāsaṃ kṛtvāyaṃ nirddeśaḥ| sarvacarmaṇa iti samāsaśca
sāmarthye sati bhavati, tataścarmaśabdenāsya sambandha iti
kaścidbhāmyetaṃ ptayyāha--sarvaśabdaścātreti| kathaṃ tarhi samāsaḥ?
ityāha--tatrāyamiti| asmādeva nipātanāditi bhāvaḥ| kiṃ punaḥ
kāraṇaṃ sarvaśabdaḥ kṛtena sambadhyate na carmaṇā ?
ityāha--sarvaścarmaṇetyādi| sarvaścarmaṇā kṛta iti yo'yaṃ vākyārthaḥ,
asmiṃstaddhitavṛttiriṣyate, yadi carmaṇā sambadhyeta, tato yadi
sarvacarmeti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ, tataḥ sarvasmbandhainā carmaṇā kṛta ityarthaḥ
syāt| atha karmadhārayaḥ, tataḥ sarveṇa carmaṇā kṛta iti, na tu kṛtasya
sarvatvamubhayathāpi labhyate| tasmātkṛtenaiva sambandho nyāyya iti
bhāvaḥ ||

yathāmukhasammukhasya darśanaḥ khaḥ || 5|2|6 ||
dṛśyate'smindarśana iti| adhikaraṇe| lyuṭ, kaḥ punarasau ?
ityāha--ādarśādiriti| ādiśabdena jalādikaṃ gṛhyate| pratibimbāśraya
iti| yo hi mukhādiprativimbasyāśrayastatra mukhādikaṃ dṛśyate|
mukhasya sadṛśaṃ yathāmukhaṃ prativimbam, sādṛśyapratiṣedhātkathamatra
samāsaḥ? tatrāha--nipātanāditi| bhaṭṭikāvye tu padārthānativṛtau
yathāśabapda āśritaḥ, tathā ca māyāmṛgaṃ prakṛtya bhavati
ślokaḥ--ṭhyathāmukhīnaḥ sītāyāḥ pupluve vahulo bhavan' iti,
yathāmukhaṃ darśana ityavyayībhāvasyāpi
yathāmukhaśabdasyonmatagaṅgādivat satvacanatvātkarmaśaktiyoge sati
darśanaśabdayoge kṛdyogalakṣaṇā karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī, tasyāḥ
ṭhnāvyayībhāvāt' ityambhāvaḥ| ata eva
pūrvamuktam--ṭhyathāmukhaśabdātsaṃmukhaśabdācca ṣaṣṭhīsamarthāt' iti|
samaṃ mukhaṃ saṃmukhamiti samaśabdaḥ sarvaśabdaparyāyaḥ|
nipātanādantyalopaḥ, saṃmukhasyeti karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī|
pratyayasanniyogenāntyalopanipātanānnedaṃ prayogārham, kiṃ tarhi ?
prakriyāvākyam| saṃśabdastu na samaśabdasyārthe dṛśyate| sammukhīna iti|
yatrādarśādau sarvaṃ mukhaṃ dṛśyate tadevamucyate| kathaṃ tahi ṭhsaṃyuge
saṃmukhīnaṃ tamudyantaṃ prasaheta kaḥ' iti ?
abhimukhāvastānātsādharmyādbhaviṣyati ||

tatsarvādeḥ pathyaṅgakarmapatrapātraṃ vyāpnoti || 5|2|7 ||
pariśiṣṭṃa prakṛtiviśeṣaṇamiti| tatra kevalānāṃ pathyādīnāṃ
sarvāditvāsambhavātprātipadikairapi taistadantavidhiḥ, pañcamyarthe ca
prathamā dvitīyā vetyāha---patyaṅgakarmapatrapātrāntāditi|
sarvapathīna iti| ṭhpūrvakāla' ityādinā samāsaḥ, ṭhṛkpūrabdhūḥ'
ityakāraḥ samāsāntaḥ, tasya pathyantasamāsagrahaṇena grahaṇātpathyantameva
prātipadikamiti khapratyayaḥ ||

āprapadaṃ prāpnoti || 5|2|8 ||
prāpadamiti pādasyāgramucyata iti| prārambhaḥ padasyeti kṛtvā|
tayoravyayībhāva iti| ???????????????????? ityanena|
dvitīyāsamarthāditi| kriyāviśeṣaṇe ṭhkarmaṇi dvitīyā'| āprapadaṃ
yathā tathā sarvaśarīraṃ prāpnotītyarthaḥ| śarīreṇāsambaddhasyāpi paṭasya
pramāṇamākhyāyata iti| yogyatvāt, yogyo hyasāvāprapadaṃ śarīraṃ
prāptum| vyāpnotīti prakṛte prāptanotīti
vacanamarthabhedāt--sambandhamātramuprāptiḥ, sambandhaḥ
sākalyopādhikaḥuvyāptiḥ| ṭhāprapadam' ityatra tvabhividhau
vyāptrigamyate, na garyādāyām ||

anupadasarvānnāyānayaṃ baddhābhakṣyatineyeṣu || 5|2|9 ||
anurāyāma iti| ṭhyasya cāyāmaḥ' iti vā, ṭhyathārthe yadavyayam' iti vā
'vyayībhāva ityarthaḥ| padapramāṇetyartha iti| āyāme tāvadayamevārthaḥ,
sādṛśye'pi tulyaparimāṇatayā sādṛśyamityamevārtho bhavati|
sarvānnīno bhikṣuriti| prakārakārtsnye sarvaśabdaḥ, yānyannāni
labhyante uṣṇāni śītāni sarasāni virasāni tāni sarvāṇi
bhakṣayatītyarthaḥ| ayanamaya iti gamanamātramayaśabdenocyate,
tatpratiṣedhastvanayaśabdenetyāśaṅkāmapanayati--ayaḥ pradakṣiṇamiti|
pradakṣiṇaṃ gamanamityarthaḥ| evam anayaḥ prasavyam| vāmaparyāyagamanam|
etacca rūḍhivaśāllabhyate| rūḍho hyayamayānayaśabdaḥ śāraṇāṃ
pradakṣiṇaprasavyagamane--śrṛṇantyebhirdūtakārāḥ parasparamiti
śārāḥ, dyauutasādhanaviseṣāḥ, śvān iti yeṣāṃ prasiddhaiḥ, ṭhkṛtyalyuṭo
bahulam' iti karaṇe ghañ| tatrābhimukhayoḥ krīḍatoḥ
kitavayoryadaivaikaṃ prati pradakṣiṇaṃ gamanaṃ tadevetaraṃ prati
prasavyamityayaścāsāvanayaśca ayānaya iti karmadhārayaḥ |

atha vā--ekameva pratyayānayatvam, katham? vīthībhedena| catasro
vīthayaḥ, tatrātmīyāḥ śārāḥ parapārśve sthitāḥ prathamāyāṃ
vīthyāmātmanaḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ dacchanti, dvitīyasyāṃ prakañm,
evamutarayoḥ; tatra samāhāradvandve lokāśrayatvena puṃlliṅgatā| 
apara āha--ekadeśadvāreṇa gamanasamudāyasyānayavyapadeśaḥ,
kṛtākṛtadivatsāmānādhikaraṇasamāsa evāyamiti|
pradakṣiṇaprasavyagamanamātre'pi neṣyate, kintu viśeṣa
ityāha---pradakṣiṇaprasavyagāmināmityadi| yasmin gativiśeṣe sati
gāmināmityādi| bahuvacanamayānayanimitapradarśanārtham| yadi
śārāḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ prasavyaṃ ca gacchantyevamayānayau bhavataḥ, nānyathā|
tatrāmīyāḥ śārāḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ gacchanti, parakīyāḥ prasavyam|
teṣāmevaṅgāmināṃ yāni stānāni teṣāṃ yasmin
pradakṣiṇaprasavyagamanātmake gativiśeṣe sati parairvivakṣabhūtaiḥ
śārairasamāveśaḥuanadhyasanamanākramaṇaṃ so'yānaya ityucyate, na tu
pradakṣiṇaprasavyagamanamātre sa evāyam| evaṃrūpo'thānayo yadā
sasahāyaiḥ śāreḥ padānyadiṣṭhīyante yadā veditavyaḥ |
sasahāyānāmeva hi śārāṇāṃ padāni parairna śakyante'dhyāsitum|
asahāyānāṃ tu bhaktayat eva| phalakaśirasi sthita iti| yatra
phalake'ṅke'kṣairdīvyanti tasya śirobhūtaṃ yatra sthānaṃ kitavānāṃ
prasiddhaṃ tatra sithitaḥ śāraḥ ṭhayānayīnaḥ' ityacyate;
tatraivāyānayīnaśabdasya rūḍhatvāt|
apare tu-neyo netavyaḥ, na nītastataḥ| tatra ṭhśirasi stitaḥ'
ityarthānupapāteḥ ṭhphalakaśirasi sthāpyate' ityartha iti granthena
bhavitavyamityāhuḥ| nīto vā neyaḥ; tadupalakṣaṇatvāt|
bhāvinyāvasthāyoktaḥ| ayānayasambaddhitve'pi sarveṣāṃ viśeṣyādeva
pratyayotpatiruktaiva| satyapi dvalitīyādhikāre purdditīyoccāraṇaṃ
dṛṣṭād dvitīyāntād yathā syādi tyevamartham| tena
viśiṣṭārthaneyavacanādayānayaśabdād dvidīyāntād pratyayo bhavati,
na neyavacanamātrāt| sa eva viśiṣṭo yo nayaṛḥ
pradakṣiṇaprasavyagāmītyādinā granthena darśaitaḥ|
arthāyānaya iti ko'yaṃ śabdaḥ, yadi hyayaṃ samāhāre dvandvaḥ, tasya
napuṃsakatvādayānayamiti bhavitavyam ? athetaretarayoge,
dvyarthatvādayānayāviti bhavitavyam ? nāyaṃ dvandvaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ?
mayūravyaṃsakāditvāt tatpuruṣaḥ--ayasahito'nayo'yānaya iti| atha
baddābhakṣayatineyeṣviti kathaṃ tiṅntasya dvandvaḥ ? kaḥ punarāhāyaṃ
dvandva iti? yadi na dvandvaḥ, kathaṃ neyeṣviti bahuvacanam ?
sautratvānnirdeśasya| subbyatyayena vā cchandasyekavacanasya sthāne
bahuvacanamupapannam| nanu cchandasi subvayatyaya uktaḥ, neda cchandaḥ ?
nayaśca bhavati tenāsāvayānayaṃ neyaḥ| ṭhbaddhābhakṣayatineyeṣu' iti
nipātanātiḍantasya dvandvaḥ asamāsapakṣe tu baddhetyatra
prathamaikavacanam, neyeṣviti saptamībahuvacanamityasamañjasamāpadyeta
|| 

parovaraparamparaputrapautramanubhavati || 5|2|10 ||
parasyotvavacanamiti| parasya śabdarūpasyāderutvaṃ nipātyata ityarthaḥ,
tatra ṭhādguṇaḥ'| atha vā--paraśabdasya otvaṃ nipātyate'ntyasyālaḥ,
tataḥ ṭheṅaḥ padāntādati' iti pūrvarūpaikādeśaḥ, parasyautvamiti
prāpnoti ṭhśakandhvādiṣu pararūpaṃ avkavyam' iti pararūpeṇa
nirddeśaḥ| paraparatarāṇāṃ ceti| cakāraḥ pūrvanipātanāpekṣyā
samucyayārthaḥ| artagatasya bahutvasya śabde samāropād
bahuvacanam| tacchabdāntarameva draṣṭavyamiti| avyutpannameva
prabapandhasya vācakam| ata evastrīliṅgamekavacanaṃ ca|
pāramparyamityapi tasmādeva svārthe ṣyañi bhavati kathaṃ
parovaryavaditi ? asādhurevāyam; khapratyayasanniyogena
parovareti nipātanāt ||

avārapārātyantānukāmaṃ gāmī || 5|2|11 ||
gāmīti| ṭhgameriniḥ', ṭhāṅ iṇicca' iti bahulavacanātkevalādapi
ṇinirbhaviṣyati| gamyādaya iti| yadyapyāṅpūrvā gamirgamyādiṣu
paṭha|lte, tathāpi bahulavacanādeva ṇiniriva bhaviṣyatkālatmapi
bhaviṣyatīti bhāvaḥ| akernorbhaviṣyadādhamarṇyayoriti ṣaṣṭhīpritiṣedha
iti| ṭhgatyarthakarmaṇi' ityatra yaduktam--ṭhdvitīyāgrahaṇamapavādaviṣaye
vidānārthaṃ tena kṛtpratyayaprayoge ṣaṣṭhī na bhavati--grāmaṃ gantā' iti,
tannāśritamam; pratiṣedhe ṣaṣṭhīprasaṅgasyaivābhāvāt| avārapārīṇa
iti| dvandvātpratyayaḥ| avārapāre tīre āhitāgnayādiṣu
pakṣepādubhayaṃ bhavati--avārapāre, pārāvāre iti | atntamiti |
kriyāviśeṣaṇam, evamanukāmamiti| kāmaḥuicchā, tasya
sadṛśamanukāmamukāmānurūpam, ṭhyathārthe yadavyayam' iti samāsaḥ || 
samāṃsamāṃ vijāyate || 5|2|12 ||
samāṃsamābhiti vīpseti| praṣṭavyeti śeṣaḥ| atra nirdeśe vīpsā
draṣṭavyā, tena dvicanamityarthaḥ| atha vā--vīpsāvācī samudāyo
vīpsā, vīpptāvācītyarthaḥ| subandamudāyaḥ prakṛtiriti|
prātipadikādhikāre'pi vacanasāmarthāt| garbha dhārayatītyartha iti|
dṛśyate ca vijanirrbhadhāraṇe, ṭhsa vijāyamāno garbhaṇātāmyat'
iti|
pūrvapade supo'lugvaktavya iti| anyathā taddhite utpanne yathotarapade
lugbhavati ṭhsupo dātuprātipadikayoḥ' iti, tathā pūrvapade'pi
syāt|
kecitvivatyādi| nanvatyantasaṃyoge dvitīyayā bhavitavyam ?
tatrāha--garbhavimocane tviti| tatra vamocanena yakāramātralopo na
sarvasyā vibhakteriti mātraśabdasyārthaḥ| pariśiṣṭasyeti|
āmśabdasyālugvaktavyaḥ| nanu yāṭaḥ subbhaktatvātsublukaiva lopaḥ siddhaḥ
tatra yalopavacanaṃ niyamārthaṃ bhaviṣyati--yakārasyaiva lopo na tu
sarvasya pratyayasyeti, tatkimucyate ṭhalugvaktavyaḥ' iti ? evaṃ
manyate--yathaiva nipātanātpūrvapadapariśiṣṭisya lopo na bhavati
evamutarapade'pi na syāditi|
anutpatāviti| vākye pūrvotarapadayorapi pakṣe yalopo vaktavyaḥ,
tena dvairūpyaṃ siddhaṃ bhavati ||

adyaśvīnāvaṣṭabdhe || 5|2|13 || 
avaṣṭabdha, vijana--ityetayoryathākramaṃ vivaraṇam--āsanne prasava iti|
kathaṃ punaravaṣṭabdhaśabdasyāsannamarthaḥ ? ityāha--āvidūrye hīti|
yadyapyālambane'pi ṣatvaṃ vidhīyate; tathāpi
vijanasyālambanatvāsambhavādāvidūryamevārthaḥ| kiṃ punaratra
nipātyate ? adya vā viśvo veti vārthe samāsaḥ khapratyayaḥ,
ṭilopastvavyayatvādeva siddhaḥ| adyaśvīnā vaḍaveti| vijāyata
ityasyānukūlatayā strīliṅgamudāhṛtam, na punaḥ sūtre
strīliṅganirddeśaḥ| adyaśvīno gosamūhaḥ, adyaśvīnaṃ
gomaṇḍalamityatrāpīṣṭhatvāt| ????????? hrasvāntasyāvibhiktiko
nirdeśaḥ| 
kecitviti| teṣāṃ yathābhidhānaṃ kriyādhyāhāraḥ| avaṣṭabdhamātre iti|
bhavatyādyarthe'pītyarthaḥ| adyasvīnaṃ maraṇamiti| adya vā śvo vā
bhaviṣyatītyatrārthe pratyayaḥ ||

āgavīnaḥ || 5|2|14 ||
gorāṅpūrvāditi| gośabdāntādāṅpūrvātprātipadikādityarthaḥ|
ā tasya goḥ pratidānāditi| pratidānamupratyarpaṇam| etena
vṛttiviṣaye gośabdo gopratidāne vartata iti darśayati|
kariṇīti| kṛña āvaśyake ṇiniḥ| āgavīna iti| ṭhāṅ
maryādābhividhyoḥ' ityavyayībhāve upasarjanahrasvatve ca kṛte
khapratyayaḥ, ṭhorguṇaḥ' ||

anugvalaṅgāmī || 5|2|15 ||
alaṅgagāmīti| ṭhsupyajātau' iti ṇiniḥ| goḥ paścādanusviti|
paścādarthe'vyayībhāvaḥ, upasarjanahrasvaḥ| paryāptamiti|
kriyāviśeṣaṇameva| anugviti| tataśca dvitīyāntātpratyayaḥ|
kṛdyogalakṣaṇā tu ṣaṣṭhī kriyāviśeṣaṇānna bhavati, tadyathā--śobanaṃ
pācaka iti ||

adhvano yatkhau || 5|2|16 ||
dvitīyāsamarthāditi| yadā tiṅntena vigrahaḥ--adhvānaṃ gacchatīti,
tadā dvitīyāsamarthatvam| yadāpi sūtropātena gāmītyanena viprahaḥ,
tadāpi dvitīyaiva kṛdyogalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhī na bhavati; ṭhakenoḥ' iti
pratiṣedhāt| iha ṭhadhvano yacca' iti siddham, cakārātkhaśca?
evamucyamāne utarasūtre cakāreṇānantaro yadevānukṛṣyate, na
cānukṛṣṭaḥ khaḥ| ato yatkhayordvayorapyanuvṛtyarthaṃ yatkhāvityuktam
||

abhyāmitrāccha ca || 5|2|17 ||
abyacāmitrāmiti| ṭhlakṣaṇenābhipratī ābhimukhye' ityavyayībhāvaḥ,
kriyāviśeṣaṇatvātkarmaṇi dvitīyā ||

goṣṭhātsañ bhūtapūrve || 5|2|18 ||
gāvastiṣṭhantyasminniti goṣṭha iti| cchañarthe kavidhānam,
ṭhsthāsnāyāvyadhirhāna yudhyartham' ityadhikaraṇe kaḥ, ṭhambāmbagobhūmi'
iti ṣatvam| pūrva bhūto bhūtapūrvaḥ, ṭhsupsa,upā' iti samāsaḥ|
goṣṭhaśabdasyārthadvārakaṃca viśeṣaṇatvam, na svarupeṇa, na hi
bhūtapūrvād goṣṭhaśabdātpratyayo vidhātuṃ śakyate| goṣṭho vartata
iti| samprati gavāmavastānaṃ darśayati ||

asvayaikāhagamaḥ || 5|2|19 ||
ekāhena gamyata ityekāhagamaḥ, ṭhgrahavṛdṛniścigamaśca' ityapaṃ
bādhitvā ṭhparimāṇākhyāyāṃ sarvebhyaḥ' iti, asti kacātra parimāṇākhyā,
ekāhena gamyata iti paricchedāvagamād, asmādeva
nipātanādapdraṣṭavyaḥ, ṭhkakartṛkaraṇe kṛtā bahulam' iti samāsaḥ|
aśvasyeti| kartari ṣaṣṭhī| aśvīnāni śataṃ patitveti| yāvanti
yojanānyekāhenāśvena gamyate, tāvatāṃ śataṃ gatvetyarthaḥ ||

śālīnakaupīne adhṛṣṭākāryayoḥ || 5|2|20 ||
yathākathañciditi| nātrāvayavārthe'bhiniveṣṭavyamityarthaḥ| abhiniveśe
tu yaḥka śālāyāmadhṛṣṭo bhāryājitatvādanyatra dhṛṣṭaḥ, yacca kūpe
akāryaṃ mūtraṇādi, kathaṃ tasyābhidhānaṃ prāgoti, kathaṃ tarhi
vivakṣitārthaḥ ? ityāha--śālāpraveśamarhatīti| yadakāryaṃ
tatpracchādanīyatvātkūpāvataraṇamarhatītyarthaḥ| utarapadālopaśceti|
vṛttiviṣaye śālākūpaśabdau tatkarmikāyāṃ kriyāyāṃ vartetate iti
gamyamānatvādaprayoga eva lopaḥ| kaupīnaṃ pāpamiti|
pāpasādhanatvātu puruṣaliṅge kaupīnaśabdaḥ, sādhārmyādvā; sādharmyaṃ
gopyatvāt| tatsāhacaryācca tadācchādane vāsaḥkhaṇḍe| apara
āha---kāryaśabde karotiḥ kriyāsāmānyavacanaḥ, tena
lajjāhetutvenādraṣṭavyatvātpuruṣaliṅgaṃ kaupīnam, aspṛśyatvācca
tadācchādanamiti ||

vrātena jīvati || 5|2|21 ||
vrātaśabahdo loke sahghamātravacanaḥ, iha tu na tatheti darśayituṃ
bhāṣyagranthaṃ paṭhati| nānajītīyā iti| anena
caikajātīyakṣatriyādisahghanirākaraṇam| aniyatavṛtaya iti|
niyatavṛtyāyudhajīvisaṅganiṣedhaḥ| utsedhajīvina
ityetadvyācaṣṭe| utsedhaḥ śarīramiti| ucchrāyatvāt| tadāyāsyeti|
āyāserṇyantāllyap, tena sakarmakatvam| aṇyantapāṭhe
tvantarbhāvitaṇyarthatvātsakarmakatvaṃ draṣṭayam| śarīrāyāsena
bāravahanādinā jīvanti, na tu buddhibhāvenetyarthaḥ| vrātā iti|
saṅghavacano'yamiha saṅghiṣu prayuktaḥ| evaṃbhūtānāṃ yaḥ
saṅghastadvrātamityarthaḥ| evamapi tathābhūtena saṅghena ye jīvanti
tatra prāpnoti,na ceṣyate ? tatrāha--teṣāṃ karma vrātamiti| idamarthe
che prāpte'smādeva nipātanādaṇ| yastvanya ityādi| anabhidhānamatra
hetuḥ ||

sāptapadīnaṃ sakhyam || 5|2|22 ||
sāptapadīnamiti nipātyata iti| kiṃ punaratra nipātyate ?
samarthavibhaktistṛtīyā| avāpyata iti pratyayārthaḥ, saptabhiḥ
padairavāpyata iti tadvitārthe dviguḥ samāsaḥ, saptapadaśabdātkhañ|
kathamiti| sakhyurbhāvaḥ karma vā sakhyam, tatra vyutpāditasya na
sakhiśabdena praśnaḥ, upacāreṇetyutaram, guṇapradhāna iti| guṇo
bhāvaḥ, karma ca bhāvaḥ, pravṛttinimitatvādguṇaḥ| yasya hi guṇasya
bhāvāditi karmāṇi hi sakhyaśabdavācyatvādguṇa ityuktam ||

haiyaṅgavīnaṃ sañjhayām || 5|2|23 ||
hyaegodohasya vikāra iti| duhyata iti dohaḥukṣīram, gordoho
godoha iti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ, hyaḥ śabdasya tena ṭhsupsupā' iti samāsaḥ,
tato vikāre'nudātalakṣaṇasyāño'pavādaḥ, khañ| ghṛtasyaiṣā
saṃjñeti| ghṛtasyāpi na sarvasya, kiṃ tarhi ? tasyaivāvikṛtagandharūpasya|
hyaḥśabdena kālapratyāsatipratipādanād navanītaṃ
haiyaṅgavīnamutyate, ghṛtaśabdo'pi tatraiva prayuktaḥ ||

tasya pākamūle pīlvādikarṇādibhyaḥ kuṇabjāhacau || 5|2|24 ||
pākaḥupariṇāmaḥ, mūlaḥūpakramaḥ| ṭhtasyedam' ityaṇādiṣu
prāpteṣvayamārambhaḥ, jakārasya prayojanābhāvāditsaṃjñābhāvaḥ ||

pakṣātiḥ || 5|2|25 ||
ekayogaśiṣṭānāmapi śabdānāṃ śabdādikārapakṣe yasyaiva śabdasya
svaritatvaṃ pratijñāyate, tasyaivānuvṛttirbhavati| tathā ca
ṭhdāmahāyanāntācca' ityatra saṅghayā haṇamanuvartate, nāvyayagrahaṇam|
arthādhikārapakṣe tu yugapadanyo'nyārthābhidhāyināṃ dvandvavidhānād
dvandvārthavicchedānna syādekadeśānuvṛttiḥ| pakṣasya mūlaṃ
pakṣatiḥupratipadi, pakṣiṇaśca pakṣamūle prayujyate ||

tena vitaracuñcupcaṇapau || 5|2|26 ||
vitaḥ pratīta iti| ṭhvito bogapratyayayoḥ' iti nipātanāt,
cuñācupcaṇapoścakārasya yathetsaṃjñā na bhavati, tathā ṭhcuṭūa' ityatraiva
vṛttikāreṇoktam ||

vinañbhyāṃ nānāñau nasaha || 5|2|27 ||
nasaheti prakṛtyarthaviseṣaṇamiti| yadi pratyayārthaḥ syātato dvau
pratiṣedhau prakṛtamevārtha gamayata iti sahārtha eva gamyeta, na nasaha,
api tu sahaiveti| tasmātprakṛtyartha eva bhavati| etacca
vyākhyānāllabhyate| yadyevam,sahetyeva pratyayārtho'stu, vinañoḥ
pratiṣedhārthatvāt, vigardabhārathaka ityādau viśabdasyāpi pratiṣedhe
vṛttirdṛṣṭaiva ? satyam; kriyāvācino viśabdātsahārthe pratyayo
vijñāyeta--vigatau saha vikṛtau saheti, nāño ñakāro
vṛddhyārthaḥ, svarārthaśca ||

veḥ śālacchaṅkaṭaccau || 5|2|28 ||
kva punarete śālajādayo bhavanti ?
ityāha--sasādhanakriyāvacanāditi| kriyāviśiṣṭasādhanavacanādityarthaḥ|
etacca ṭhupasargācchandasi dhātvarthe' ityatra pratyapādi| upasargāditi|
anyatropasargasaṃjñādarśanādviṣayāntare'pi prādīnāmabhidhānam| svārtha
iti| anirddiṣṭārthatvāt| vigate iti| vigamanakriyākartari
vervṛtti darśayati| tadyogāditi| viśālāvayavayogāt,
vyutpattipakṣe nānyā gatiriti bhāvaḥ|
vastugatimāha--paramārthatastviti| viśālatvamuvistīrṇatvaṃ nāma
guṇaḥ, tasmādguṇavacanā ete| vakṣmayāṇapratyayāpekṣayā bahuvacanam;
tataśca yadguṇayogācchaṅge vṛttistadgaṇayogādeva gavyapi
vṛttiḥ siddheti bhāvaḥ| tathā ca-viśālo deśa ityapi dṛśyate ||

saṃprodaśca kaṭac || 5|2|29 ||
kaṭacpratyayo bhavatīti| pūrvavatsasādhanakriyāvacanebhyasvārthe|
saṅkaṭaḥuprajñātaḥ, prakāśa ityarthaḥ| utkaṭaḥūdbhūtaḥ| vikaṭaḥuvikṛtaḥ|
alābūtiletyādi| bhaṅgābhya iti pāṭhaḥ, bhahgāśabdaṣṭāvantaḥ|
yathālābūprabhṛtibhyo rajasyabhidheye kaṭacpratyayo bhavati, rajaso
vikāratvādvikārapratyayānāmapavādaḥ| tatrālābūśabdādorañaḥ, ṭhmayaḍ
vaitayoḥ' iti mayaṭaścāpavādaḥ| tilomāśabdābhyāṃ
ghṛtāditvādantodātābyām ṭhanudātādeśca' ityaño mayaṭaśca|
ṭhumorṇayorvā' iti vuñśca, ṭhasaṃjñāyāṃ tilayavābhyām' iti
mayaṭaśca| bhaṅgāyāḥ ṭhtṛṇadhānyānāṃ ca dvayaṣām' ityādyaudātatvādaṇo
mayadasca|
goṣṭhādaya iti| prayogasamavāyipratyayarūpaṃ nirdiṣṭam| cakārastu
svarārthe'nubandvavyaḥ| tathā hi--samāsāśrayeṇa bhāṣye etatpratyākhyātam,
samāse cāntodātatvaṃ bhavati| sarvatrādiśabdaḥ prakāre| gavāṃ
sthānamiti| ṭhtasyedam' ityatrārthe ṭhsarvatra gorajādipratyayaprasaṅge
yat' iti yati prāpte goṣṭhacpratyayaḥ; aprasṛtāvayavaḥ
samūhaḥusaṅghātaḥ, prasṛtāvayavastūvistāraḥ, ubhāvapi
sāmūhitānāmapavādau|
dvitva iti| prakṛtyarthasya dvitve dyotya ityarthaḥ| uṣṭagoyugamiti| dvayaṃ
yugamityādivad dvayavayavasaṅghābhidhāyitvādekavacanam| evaṃ
hasti???gavamityādāvapi draṣṭavyam|
sneha iti| snihayantyaneneti snehaḥudravarūpa iṅgudādīnāṃ
vikāraḥ| tatra iṅgudaśabdaḥ ṭhlaghāvante' ityādyaudātaḥ, tataḥ ṭhtasya
vikāraḥ' ityaṇpratyayaḥ prāptaḥ; tilaśabdād ṭhanudātādeśca' ityañ
prāpta, so'pi tviṣyate-tilānāṃ vikārastailamiti, tatarhīdaṃ bahu
vaktavam ? netyāha; upamānātsiddham| katham ? gāvastiṣṭhantyasminnati
goṣṭham, tatsādharmyāduṣṭrādisthānamapi goṣṭhamityucyate| tatra
viseṣapratipatyarthamuṣṭādibhirviśeṣṭate--uṣṭragoṣṭham,
mahiṣagoṣṭham; mukhyārthapratipataye gobhirapi gogoṣṭhamiti| yathā
gopatiśabde svāmimātraparatayā prayukte gobhirapi
viśeṣaṇam--ṭhgavāmasi gopatireka indraḥ' ṭhvijñā hitvā gopatiṃ
śūra gonām' iti, tathā nānādravyāṇāṃ rajjuvīraṇādīnāṃ
saṅghātaḥ kaṭaḥ, tatsādharmyādanyo'pi saṅgātaḥka kaṭaśabdenocyate,
sa cāviprabhṛtibhirviśeṣayiṣyate, evaṃ
paṭavadvistīrṇo'visahgo'vipaṭa iti| tathā yugaśabdena
dvayamucyate--gavoryugaṃ goyugam, dvayātmatvasāmānyādanyadapi
yugalaṃ goyugamityucyate, tata uṣṭrādibhirviśeṣyate,
mukhyagoyugapratipataye gavāpi| tathā ṣaḍ gāvaḥ samāhṛtāḥ
paḍgavam, ṭhgorataddhitaluki' iti ṭac, pātrāditvānnapuṃsakatvam|
tatsādharmyādityādi pūrvavat| tathā tilavikāro mukhyaṃ tailaṃ
tatsādṛśyād dravarupaṃ vikāramātraṃ tailam, tata
iṅgudādibhistilaiśca viśeṣaṇam| evaṃ ca kṛtvā tilānāṃ
vikārastailamityapi bhavati, vākyaprārambhe cu tailacā bādhitatvādana
syāt|
upara āha--ṭhyathā prakṛṣṭo vīṇāyāṃ pravīṇa iti vyutpattimātraṃ
kriyate, kauśalameva tvasya nimitam, tathā ca vīṇāyāṃ praviṇa ityapi
bhavati; tathā tilānāṃ vikārastailamiti vyutpattimātram, dravarūpo
vikārastvasyārthaḥ| tathā ceṅgudādibhirviseṣaṇasiddhiḥ'tatu na
rocayāmahe; na hi tailamityukte dravarūpaṃ vikāramātraṃ pratiyanti|
śākaṭacśākinau tu vaktavyāveva ||

avāt kuṭāracca || 5|2|30 ||
avakuṭāram, avakaṭamiti| avācīnam, aprasiddhamityarthaḥ ||

nate nāsikāyāḥ saṃjñāyāṃ ṭīṭañnāṭajbhraṭacaḥ || 5|2|31 ||
namanaṃ natamiti| ṭhnapuṃsake bhāve ktaḥ' nīcaistvamityarthaḥ|
nāsikāyāḥ sambandhainīti| sambandhaśca namane kartṛtvena, sūtre tu
ṭhnapuṃsake bhāva upasaṃkhyānām' iti kartari ṣaṣṭhī|
yadvā--śeṣavijñānātsiddhamiti śeṣalakṣaṇaiva| avaṭīṭādiṣu
nāsikāsādhane namane vartamānādupasargātsvārthe pratyayaḥ| kathaṃ tarhi
nāsikā puruṣaśca tathocyate ? ityāha---tadyogāditi|
ṭīṭañaṣṭakārasyetsaṃjñabhāvaḥ ṭhcuṭūa' ityatraiva vyakhyātaḥ ||

inacpiṭaccika ci ca || 5|2|33 ||
kakāraḥ pratyaya iti| akāro vivakṣitaḥ; cakāraḥ, evakāra ityādivat
kāraśabdaḥ, kapratyaya tyirthaḥ| tathā coktamiti| sūtre niśabdasya
dvāvādeśau dvau ca pratyayau
vihitāvityādeśapratyayātravidhānārthametad vārtikakāroṇoktam|
asya cakṣuṣī ityetasminnartha iti| yadyapi cakṣuṣī prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇam,
asyeti ṣaṣṭha|lrthe pratyayaḥ, tathāpi klinnatvasya cakṣurgatatvaṃ pratyayasyaiva
dyotyabhiti matvaivamuktam|
asyetyaneneti| vākyaikadeśaṃ pratyācaṣṭe, kasmāt? nārthaḥ, ityāha|
cakṣuṣorevabhidhāna iti| cakṣuṣorvartamānātklinnaśabdātsvārthe pratyaya
ityarthaḥ| kathaṃ tarhipuruṣasyābhidhānam ? ityāha--tadyogādityādi|
arśāadiṣu ṭhsvāṅgāddhīnāt' iti paṭha|lte, tena matvarthe'kāraḥ ||

upādhibyāṃ tyakannāsannārūḍhayoḥ || 5|2|34 ||
niyataviṣayamiti| parvataviṣayam| āsa tena vṛkṣasyāsannam,
plakṣasyārūḍhamityatra na bhavatītati bhāvaḥ| athopatyakā, adhityaketyatra
ṭhpratyayasthāt kāt pūrvasya' ityanenetvaṃ karamānna bhavati ? ityata
āha---pratyayasthāt kāditi| yadyatretvaṃ syāt saṃjñārūpaṃ na sidhyet;
nopatyikādhityiketyevaṃrūpā saṃjñā| tasmāt saṃjñādhikārāditvaṃ na
bhavati ||

karmaṇi ghaṭo'ṭhac || 5|2|35 ||
ṭhkarmaṇi' ityanena karmaṇīti svalarūpagrahaṇaṃ darśayati| atha
pāribhāṣikasya karmaṇo grahaṇaṃ karamānna bhavati ? asambhavāt|
asambhavatu ghaṭaterakarmakatvāt| aṭhacpratyeye'kāroccāraṇaṃ
ṭhasyekādeśanivṛtyartham ||

tadasya sañjātaṃ tārakādibhya itac || 5|2|36 ||
tārakādiṣu bubhukṣā-pipāsāśabdau paṭha|lete, tayoḥ kimarthaḥka
pāṭhaḥ, yāvatā sannantābhyāṃ niṣṭhāyāmiṭi ca kṛte bubhukṣitaḥ,
pipāsito pipāsita iti ? satyaṃ karmaṇi siddham--bubhukṣita
odanaḥ, pipāsitamudakamiti; kartari tu na prāpnoti--bubhukṣito
devadataḥ, pipāsito devadata iti| anena tu yasya bubhukṣāpipāse
sañjāte tatra pratyaya utpadyate|
puṣpādīnāṃ tarhi kimarthaḥ pāṭhaḥ, ṭhpuṣpa vikasane', ṭhmūtra prasravame,'
ṭhvraṇa gātravicūrṇane'--- ebyo'karmakatvātkartari kte--puṣpitaḥ,
mūtrita ityādi siddham ? satyam bhūte siddham; vartamāne tu na
siddhayati, ato kavartamānārthasteṣāṃ pāṭha| kathaṃ punaranena
vartamāne bhavati, yātā'trāpi ṭhsañjāta' iti bhūte niṣṭhā ? evaṃ tarhi
gaṇe puṣpādīnāṃ pāṭhasāmarthyātsañjātamityatra bhūtakālo na
vivakṣyate| garbhādaprāṇinīti| garbhaśabdādaprāṇinyabhidheye
itañbhavati--garbhitāḥ śālayaḥ, prāṇini tu garbhiṇī gauḥ || 

pramāṇe dvayasajdaghnañmātracaḥ || 5|2|37 ||
yatatprathamāsamarthaṃ pramāṇaṃ cetadbhavatīti| anena
prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇatvaṃ pramāṇasya darśayati| yadi tu
pratyayārthaviśeṣaṇaṃ syāt--yatadasyeti nirddiṣṭa
pramāṇaṃcetadbhavatīti; tadā pramāṇasya prameyāpekṣatvātprameyaṃ
prakṛtyarthaḥ syāt yathā prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇatve prameyaṃ pratyathārthaḥ,
tataśceha prāpnoti--udakaṃ prameyamasyororiti, etaccāyuktam;
aniyataprameyaviṣayatvātpramāṇānāmekena viśeṣaṇasyānyāyyatvāt,
prameyasya tu niyatapramāṇatvapratipādanāyorumātrādayaḥ śabdāḥ
prayujyante|
prathamaśca dvitīyaśceti| urdhvāvastitena yena mīyate tadūrdhvamānam,
urvādi| tatra kecidāhuḥ--ṭhāyāmamāmanameva pramāṇaṃ sūtre gṛhyate,
tiryaṅmānameva cāyāmamānam, tataścordhvamāne'praptau
dvayasajjaghnacau pramāṇādapakṛṣyeha vidhīyete' iti| apara
āha--ṭhūrdhvāvastitenāpi yenāyāmaḥ paricchidyate
tadapyāyāmamānatvāt pramāṇamiti sūtre gṛhyate| vacanaṃ tūrdhvamāna
eva yathā syātāṃ tiryaṅmāne mā bhūtāmiti niyamārtham' iti|
anyastvāha--ṭhpariccedakamātraṃ pramāṇamihara gṛhyate' iti; tatrāpi
niyamārthametat| mātraṃ pramāṇam, tato nyāyaprāptānuvādo'yam|
prasthāmātramityapīti| api śabdādūrumātramityapi bhavati|
pramāṇe la iti| luka eṣā pūrvācāryasaṃjñā| pramāṇamiti ye prasiddhā
iti| ṭhprabāṇaśabdā ete' iti ye prasiddhāḥ---diṣṭivitastyādaya ityarthaḥ
śamaḥ, diṣṭiḥ, vitastiriti| atra mātrayo lug; itarayorasambhavāt|
śamādīnāmanūrdhvamānatvād| 
dvigornityamiti| dvigorapramāṇatvātadantavidhyabāvācca
pūrveṇāprāpto lugvidhīyate| nityagrahaṇaṃ kimiti| nātra vikalpaḥ
prakṛta iti praśnaḥ| saṃśaye śrīviṇaṃ vakṣyatīti| śravaṇaṃ śrāvaḥ,
ṭhkṛyalyuṭo vahulam', iti ghañ, so'syāstīti śrāvī,
ṭhpramāṇaparimāṇābhyāṃ saṅkhayāyāścāpi saṃśaye' iti vakṣyamāṇasya
mātracaḥ ṭhpramāṇe laḥ' ityanena lugna bhavati, paratvād; ato'mau
śrāvī| asya dvigāvapi śravaṇe prāpte lugvidīyata ityarthaḥ| dvau śamau
pramāṇamasya dviśamaḥ| kathaṃ punarava saṃśaye mātraca utpattiḥ ?
tadantavidhainā| etadeva lugvacanaṃ jñāpakam-astyatra tadantavidhiriti|
prakāraṇādivaśādasya niścayasaṃsayavipayatā prayogasyāvaseyā|
stome ḍaḍvaktavya iti|
atrāyāmamānasyāsambhavātparicchedopādhikāyāḥ saṅkhyāyāḥ
stome'bhidheye ḍaṭpratyayaḥ| ḍitkaraṇamekaviṃśa ityatra ti śabdasya
lopārtham, trayastriṃśādau ṭilopārthaṃ ca| pañcadasādau ṭhnastaddhite'
ityeva siddham---pañcadaśa mantrāḥ parimāṇamasya pañcadaśaḥ stomaḥ,
saptadaśī rātririti| stomasāhacaryādrātryādau striyāṃ vṛttiḥ,
ṭitvānṅīp ṭhtadasya parimāṇam' ṭhsaṅkhyāyāḥ saṃjñā' ityatra tu
steme ḍo vihitaḥ, tatra ṭāb bhavati yadyasti prayogaḥ, atha tu nasti
tato'syaiva sa prapañcaḥ|
śansatorhinirvaktavya iti| evaṃ ca cchandasi ca bhāṣāyāṃ ca
ḍirnervidhānāt ṭhsaṅkhyāyāḥ saṃjñāsaṅgha' ityatra
ṭhśanśatorḍiniścchandasi' iti vacanaṃ prapañcārthameva|
viśino'ṅgirasa iti| pravarabhedena viṃśatirbhedā ucyante, tatra
viṃśatiśabdātsaṅkhayānamātravācinaḥ saṃkhyeye prameye ḍiniḥ, ṭhti
viṃśaterḍiti' iti lopaḥ, yasyetilopaśca|
pramāṇaparimāṇābhyāmiti| rūḍhiśabdāvetau; bhedenopādānāt|
śamamātramiti| śamaḥ pramāṇamasya syānna vetyatrārthe mātrac| pañcamātrā
iti| pañca syurna veti saṃśayyamānārthavācinaḥ ṣaṣṭha|lrthe pratyayaḥ|
pañcatvasaṅkhyā pramāṇameṣāṃ syādvā na veti pañcamātrāḥ|
tāvadeviti| tatparimāṇamasya dhānyādistāvat, tataḥ svārthe ??????|
utarasūtre tu ṭhbhāvaḥ siddhaśca ḍāvatoḥ' ityarthāntare vakṣyate ||

puruṣahistibhyāmaṇ ca || 5|2|38 ||
hāstinamiti| ṭhinaṇyanapatye' iti prakṛtibhāvaḥ| 
dvigornityaṃ lugiti| nāyam ṭhpramāṇe lo dvigornityam'
ityasyānuvādaḥ; puruṣahastinoḥ
śamādivatpramāṇatacvenāprasiddhatvāt| ata eva puruṣadvayasamityādau
ṭhpramāṇe laḥ' iti lugna bhavati; anyathāṇo
vidhānasāmarthyāllugabhāve'pi dvayasajādīnāṃ syādeva| tasmād
pūrvo'tra lugvidhīyate| sa ca dvayasajādīnāṃ nāṇaḥ, grahaṇavatā
prātipadikena tadantavidhipratiṣedhād dvigoraṇaḥ prāptyabhāvāt|
dvipuruṣīti| ṭhpūruṣātpramāṇe'nyatarasyām' iti ṅīp ||

yatadetebhyaḥ parimāṇe vatup || 5|2|39 ||
yāvāniti| ṭhā sarvanāmnaḥ' ityātvam| ṭhugidacām' iti num,
ṭhatvasantasya' iti dīrghaḥ, halaṅyādisaṃyogāntalopau|
pramāṇaparimāṇayorekatvaṃ matvā
yaścodayet--halaṅyādisaṃyogāntalopau|
pramāṇaparimāṇayorekatvaṃ matvā
yaścodayet--parimāṇagrahaṇamanarthakam pramāṇādhikāraditi ? taṃ
pratyāha--pramāṇa iti vartamāne ityādi| sa punaranayorbhedaḥ
ṭhparimāṇaṃ tu sarvataḥ, āyāmastu pramāṇaṃ syāt' iti pūrvameva
vyākhyātaḥ| ḍāvatāviti| ihāsmābhirvatupaṃ vidhāya ṭhā sarva nāmnaḥ'
ityātvaṃ vihitam| pūrvācāryāstu ḍāvatuṃ vidadhire,
tadapekṣo'yaṃ nirdeśaḥ| viśiṣyata iti viseṣaḥ, tasya bhāvo
vaiśeṣyam, arthavaiseṣyādarthabedātparimāṇasya pramāṇāt
pṛthagnirdeśaḥ, ucyate kriyata ityarthaḥ| syādetat--ṭhyadyapi
pramāṇaparimāṇaśabdayorartho bhidyacate, tathāpi
pramāṇagrahaṇamevānuvartya tadupādhikebhya eva vatubvideyaḥ|
tatrāyamapyarthaḥ---idamapi siddhaṃ bhavati---yāvānadhvā, yāvatī
rajjuriti, atra hyāyāmamānaṃ gamyate| ye tu parimāṇe
prayogāḥ---yāvān dhānyarāśirityādayaḥ,
te'pyupamānādbhaviṣyanti| yathā siddhānte yāvānadhvā yāvatī
rajjuḥ yāvatkṛtvo bhuṅkta ityādayaḥ' iti,
tatrāha---mātrādyapratighātāyeti| yadi yathoktaṃ kriyeta tato
ḍāvaturviśeṣavihitatvātsāmānyavihitānmātrajādīnbādhena|
parimāṇagrahaṇe tu sati bhinnopādhikatvād bādhyabādhakabhāvābhāvaḥ,
tena tanmātraṃ yanmātramityādi pramāṇe siddhaṃ bhavatīti| bhāvaḥ
siddhaśceti| tatparimāṇamasya dhānyasya dairghyaṃ tādṛgasyāpītyarthaḥ|
tadevaṃ bhinnaviṣayatve sati vatvantānmātrādayaḥ siddhayanti|
ekaviṣayatve tu vatupaiva viśiṣṭasya
prameyasyoktatvātadantānmātrādayo na syuḥ,| yasyā hi tāvatpramāṇaṃ
tasya tatpramāṇamiti tāvacchabdasyaiva tatrāpi prayogaḥ syād; anyathā
hi mātrajādipratyayamālāprasaṅgaḥ|

kimidambhyāṃ vo ghaḥ || 5|2|40 ||
kiyān, iyāniti| ṭhidaṃ kimorīśkī', yasyetilopaḥ| etadeveti|
ādeśavidhānānyathānupapatyā pratyayo'numīyate| yogavibhāgena
veti| evaṃ pratipādite lāghavaṃ bhavati| ṭhādeḥ parasya' ityeva siddhe
ṭhvaḥ' iti kavacanamādeśapratipatyartham; itrathā hi ghaḥ pratyayāntaraṃ
vijñāyeta ||

kimaḥ saṅkhyāparimāṇe iti ca || 5|2|41 ||
saṅkhyāyāḥ parimāṇamiti| karaṇasya kartṛtvavivakṣayā kṛdyogalakṣaṇā
kartari ṣaṣṭhī| parimitiḥuparimāṇam| saṅkhyā pariccheda iti||
sahkhyā yaṃ paricchedaṃ paroti tatretyarthaḥ| tasya ca vakārasya ghakāra
iti| ṭhvo ghaḥ' ityanuvṛteḥ| nanu kā saṃkhyā parimāṇameṣāmityatra
kiṃśabdaḥ pariccedikāyāṃ saṅkhayāyāṃ vartate, na punaḥ paricchede?
tatrāha---pṛcchayamānatvāditi| paricchedakatvaviśiṣṭā saṃkhyā
pṛcchayate--kā saṃkhyā paricchedikaiṣāmiti, tatra paricchedasyāpi
pṛcchayamānākārāntarbhāvātsaṃkyāparicchede
vartamānādityuktamityarthaḥ| apara āha--ṭhṭhsaṃkhyāyāḥ' iti karmaṇi
ṣaṣṭhī, saṃkhyāparicchedārthapraśne vartamānaḥ saṃkhyāparicchede vartata
ityucyate| saṃkhyāyāṃ paricchetumiṣṭāyāṃ yaḥ praśnastatra
vartamānādityarthaḥ' iti| kati| ṭhṣahuṣviti vṛtau bahuvacanameva
bhavati| uktaṃ ca--ṭhanirjñāter'rthe bahuvacanaṃ prayoktavyam' iti| kathaṃ
tarhi kiyān, kiyantāviti ? nātra saṃkhyāpraśne kiśabdaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ?
parimāṇamātrapraśne| saṃkhyāpraśne tu tatrāpi bahuvacanameva
bhavati--kiyanto brāhṇā iti| yadīyā ca saṃkhyā pṛcchayate tatra
pratyayāḥ, tena kā saṃkhyā hi tadā pratyayena bhāvyam--kati
gāvo'sminvarga iti| saṅghasaṅghinorabhedavivakṣāyāṃ tu--kati
gāvo'??? varga iti, na tu vyavasthitasaṃkhyāsambandhe varge,
vargasaṃkhyāpraśne tu kati vargā iti bhavati|
atha vetyādi| asminpakṣe saṃkhyāparimāṇa iti karmadhārayaḥ,
nipātanācca viśeṣaṇasya paranipātaḥ, karaṇasādhanaśca parimāṇaśabdaḥ|
evamātmiketyasya vivaraṇam--paricchedasvabhāveti|
yatrāparicchedakatvena vivakṣyate iti| paricchedakatvena na vivakṣyata
ityarthaḥ| tathaiva vā pāṭhaḥ| kva punarevaṃ na vivakṣyate ? ityāha--kṣepe
hīti| keyameṣāmiti| keyamīdṛśānāṃ daśatvasaṃkhyā yeṣāṃm |
avratānāmamantrāṇāṃ jātimātropajīvinām|
sahasraśaḥ sametānāṃ pariṣatvaṃ na vidyate || iti|
evaṃ saṃkhyeyadvāreṇa saṃkhyāyāṃ kṣepaḥ| prakṛtaḥ parimāṇaśabdo
rūḍhiśabdatvāt saṃkhyāyā parisambanddhuaṃ nārhatīti
paricchaitimātrāvacanaḥ punarihopātaḥ ||

saṃkhyāyā avayave tayap || 5|2|42 || 
ihāsyetyadhikārātsaṃkhyāyā avayave vartamānāyāḥ svārthe
tāvatpratyayo na bhavati; avayavasvāmini tu prāpnoti--pañca avayavā
asya devadatasyeti| tatrāha--avayavāvayavinaḥ sambandhina iti|
avayavaśabdasya sambandhiśabdatvādyaṃ pratyavayavatvaṃ tatraivāvayavini pratyaya
ityarthaḥ| yathā dvayasajādiṣu pramāṇe prakṛtyarthe prameyaḥ pratyayārthaḥ,
tadvat| ????????? rephasya visarjanīye tasya satve ṭhhrasvātādau tadvite'
iti ṣatvam, ṭhṭiḍḍhāṇañ' iti ṅīp ||

dvitribhyāṃ tayasyāyajvā || 5|2|43 ||
nanu tayaḥ prakṛtaḥ so'nuvartiṣyate, ṭhdvitribhyām' iti pañcamī,
ṭhtasmādityutarasya' iti tasya ṣaṣṭha|lntatāṃ sampādayipyati; tatkiṃ
ṭhtayasya' ityanena ? tatrāha--tayabgrahaṇamityādi|
asatyāmapekṣāyāmanuvṛttiḥ ṣaṣṭhīprakṛtiśca durjāneti bāvaḥ| atha
pratyayāntare ko doṣaḥ ? trayī gatiriti tayabnibandhana īkāro na
syāt, ṭhprathamacaramataya'ka iti caiṣa vidhirna syād--dvaye, dvayā iti|
kvacit tatra ko doṣa ityādi vṛtāveva vṛtāveva paṭha|lte| cakāraḥ
svarārtha iti| tena sthānivadbhāvenānudātatvaṃ na bhavati ||

ubhādudāto nityam || 5|2|44 ||
udātavacanasāmarthyāditi| antodātatvasya citsvareṇaiva siddhatvāt|
sarvodātatvaṃ tu na bhavati, ṭhanudātaṃ padamekavarjam' iti vacanāt|
nāpi he ubhayetyatrāmantritānudātatvam, ubhayetyatra
cāmantritādyaudātatvaṃ bādhitumudātavacanam; purastādapavādanyāyena
citsvarasyaiva bādhanāt| 
ubhaśabdo yadi laukikī saṃśyeti| ubhāvityukte dvāviti pratīteḥ| atha
na saṃkyeti| kṛtvasujādisaṃkhyākāryādarśanāt; ekaḥ, ubhau, traya
ityevaṃ loke gaṇanā'darśanācca| tasya nityamayajādeśa iti| atha
pratyayāntaramevāyaḥ kasmānnāśritaḥ, tatrāyamapyarthaḥ--udāta iti na
vaktavyaṃ bhavati, pratyayasvareṇaiva siddham; yacca
sarvanāmasaṃjñāyāmuktamubhayaśabdasya jasi sarvādipāṭhānnityā saṃjñā
bhavati, na ṭhprathamacaramataya' iti vibhāṣā;
vyavasthitavibhāṣāvijñāṇatpūrvavipratiṣedhādveti, tadapyayatnasitaddhaṃ
bhavati, katham, na hyayaṃ tayapa ādeśaḥ ? satyam; ubhayītyatra tu
tayabnibandhana īkāro na syāt| yadi tu ṅībbidhau
mātrajityayacaścakāreṇa pratyāhāragrahaṇam, tataḥ
pratyayāntaratve'pyayacaḥ siddha īkāraḥ|
udātagrahaṇaṃ nityagrahaṇaṃ ca śakyamakartum, ṅībvidhau ca tayapo
grahaṇam|
atha vā--daghnañmātracorapi tatra grahaṇaṃ śakyamakartum,
dvayasajityevāyacaścakāreṇa pratyāhāro'stu; tatu tathā
nāśritamityeva|
ubhayo maṇiriti| ubhau
pītalohitāvavayavāvasyetyavayavadvinibandhano'vayavino vyapadeśaḥ|
ubhaye devamanuṣyā iti| vargadvayāpekṣamatirohitabhedānāṃ
vargiṇāmidamabhidhānam ||

tadasminnadhikamiti daśāntāḍḍaḥ || 5|2|45 ||
asminnadhikam, yasmādadhikamiti ca nirddeśādadhikaśabdayoge
saptamīpañcamyau bhavataḥ| adhikā khārī droṇeneti kartari tṛtīyāpi
bhavati| ekādaśa adhikā asmin śata iti| vyapadeśivadbāvo'pi
prātipadikena pratiṣiddhaḥ| pratyayārthena cetyādi|
prakṛtipratyayārthayostulyajātīyatve pratyaya ityarthaḥ|
nyāyasiddhaścāyamarthaḥ| tathā hi--vākye tāvadekādaśa adhikā asmin
goste iti śataviśeṣaṇatvenāpyupātā gāvaḥ
sannidhānātprakṛtyarthamapi spṛśānti| vṛtāvapyekādaśaṃ
gośatamityukte prakṛtyarthatayā gāvaḥ sannihitā eva pratīyante| yatra
tu vijātīyasaṃkhyeyavācī śabdaḥ prayujyate, tatra śabdasannihitena
tenānyadarthaṃ sannihitaṃ bādhyate| na ca vṛtau tādṛśena śabdena
prakṛtyarthaḥ śakyo viśeṣayitum; pratyayārthenaikārthībhūtatvāt,
yathā---vṛddhasyaupagava iti ||
śatasahasrayośceṣyata iti| iyamiṣṭireva|
itikaraṇo vivakṣārthastataḥ, idaṃ sarva labhyata iti| yadyapi pūrvārtho
nyāyā deva labhyate, tathāpi ṭhśatasahasrayośceṣyate' ityayamratha
itikaraṇādeva labhyate iti lāghavāya sādhāraṇo heturupadiṣṭaḥ|
kathamityādi| śate sahasre cābhidheye pratyayo bhavannatra na prāpnoti,
atra hi saṃkhyāntaramadhikaṃ śatasahasraṃ nāma, na śataṃ sahasraṃ veti bhāvaḥ|
atrāpi śatasahasrayorevānyatarasya pratyayārthatvaṃ na
saṃkhyāntarasyetyāha--śatānāmiti| sahasrāṇāṃ vā śatamiti| atrāpi
pakṣe ṭhsaṃkhyāyā alpīyasyāḥ' iti dvandve cādvandve ca smaraṇācchatasyaiva
pūrvanipātaḥ| tatra pūrvasminvigrahe śatāni saṃkhyāyanta iti tānyeva
prakṛtyarthaḥ--ekādaśa śatānyadhikānyasminnekādaśaṃ śatasahasramiti,
utaratra tu sahasrāṇāṃ saṃkhyeyatvātānyeva
prakṛtyarthaḥ--ekādaśasahasrāṇyadhikānyasminnekādaśaṃ śatasahasramiti|
prakaraṇādivaśācca śatānāṃ vā saṃkhyeyatvāvasāyaḥ |
uktamevārthaṃ ślokena darśayati--adhike samānajātāviti|
pratyayārthasambandhinyā jātyā prakṛtyarthasya jātau samānāyāṃ
satyāmadhike'rthe vartamānāt pratyaya ityarthaḥ| yadvā--ṭhsamānajātau'
iti bahuvrīhiḥ| jātyantalakṣamastu chāe na bhavati; bhāṣyaprayogāt|
pratyayārthena samānajātīye'rthe vartamānādityathaḥ| iṣṭamiti|
pratyayākhyaṃ kāryam| ekādaśaṃ śatasahasramityatra nirvāhārthamāha--yasya
saṃkhyeti| ṭhśatāni sahasrāṇi saṃkhyāyante', ityuktam, ṭhadhike
samānajātau' iti ca, tena yasya saṃkhyā yajjātīyaṃ saṃkhyāyate|
sāmānyapekṣamekavacanam| tadādhikye sa kartavyo mato mama|
etaccodāharaṇa eva vyaktīkṛtam, nātra kiñcidapūrvamuktam ||
śadantaviṃśateśca || antagrahaṇamanarthakam, kevalasya śataḥ
prātipadikasyābhāvāt; pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣayā
tadantavidhirbhaviṣyati, paṅktayādisūtre triṃśadādīnāṃ
śatpratyayāntatvena nipātitatvātatrāha--śadgrahaṇe'ntagrahaṇamiti|
pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣayā tadantavidhau sati tadādiniyamaḥ syāt,
asmistvantagrahaṇe sati yāvataḥ samudāyasyānte śacchabdastāvato
grahaṇaṃ bhavati| saṃkhyāgrahaṇaṃ ceti| ṭhsaṃkyāyā avayave tayap' ityataḥ
saṃkhyāgrahaṇamanuvartanīyamityarthaḥ| tena saṃkhyāvācinaḥ
śadantātpratyayo bhavatītyarthaḥ| ekatriśadādayaśca saṃkhyāntarasya
vācakāḥ, na tu samudāyasya; tena teṣāmapi grahaṇam,
gotriśadādayaśca na saṃkhyāvacanā iti teṣāmagrahaṇam| 
viṃśateśceti| viṃśatiśabdānantaramantaśabdaḥ paṭhitavya ityarthaḥ; anyathā
ṭhgrahaṇavatā' iti niṣedhātadantānna syāt ||
saṃkhyāyā guṇasya nimāne mayaṭ || tadasya sajjātamityata iti| tatra
tāvat ṭhtadasya' iti samudāyasya svaritatvaṃ pratijñātam, anuvṛtaṃ ca
bahuṣu yogeṣu| ṭhtadasminnadhikam' ityatra tu
punastacchabdopādānānta sambaddhayata ityetāvat| iha tu
pratibanadhābhāvātsa eva samudāyo'nuvartata ityarthaḥ, tena ṭhtadasmin'
ityasyaiva tacchabdasyānantaryādanuvṛttiryuktā| ṭhasmin' ityanena
vicchainnatvādasyetyanuvṛttiścāyukteti na codanīyam| nimānaṃ
mūlyamiti| ṭhmeṅ praṇidāne' ityasmānnipūrvātkaraṇe lyuṭ,
nimīyateḥkrīyata ityarthaḥ| guṇasyeti| karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī| so'pi
sāmarthyāditi| guṇaśabdo'pi sāpekṣaṃ rūpamācaṣṭe, tathā
hi--dviguṇam, triguṇamityukte kiñcidapekṣyeti gamyate; tatra
nimeyasya guṇatvaṃ sannihitaṃ nimānamapekṣyetyetatsāmarthyam|
yavānāṃ dvau bhāgāviti| yadyapi tulyamubhayatrāpi svatyāgaḥ parakīyasya
grahaṇam, tathāpi kvacitkācitprasṛtatarā gatiḥ, tadyathāsamāne tyāge
dhānyaṃ vikrīṇīta ityucyate, na kaścidāha--kārṣāpaṇī vikrīṇīta iti,
tena yavabhāgayoreva nimānatvam, nodaśvidbhāgasya|
deśakālāpekṣo vā nimānanimeyabhāvaḥ| nimānasya ca
nimeyāpekṣatvānnimeyaṃ pratyāyārthaḥ, ekaguṇasyadaśvito dviguṇā
yavā mūlyamityarthaḥ| tadyathā--prasthasyodaśvito dvau prasthau yavāḥ,
dvimayamudaśvidyavānāmiti| bhāgaviśeṣapratipatyatha
prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇasya yavādeḥ prayogaḥ| dviśabdaśca vṛttiviṣaye
bhāgayoreva saṃkhyeyayorvartata iti sambāndhiśabdatvena
nityasāpekṣatvātaddhaitavṛttiraviruddhā| kathaṃ punaḥ
pratyayāntasyodaśvicchabdena sāmānādhikaraṇyam, yāvatodaśvidbāge
pratyayo vihitaḥ, nodaśviti ? tatrāha--bhāge'pi tu vidhīyamāna iti|
atra cābhidhānasvābhāvyaṃ hetuḥ| apara āha--yatrodaśvito bhāgo
dviguṇairyavaiḥ krīyate, tatrārthātsamudāyo'pi dviguṇairyavaiḥ krīto
bhavati bahubhirekena vā, tadapekṣaṃ sāmānādhikāraṇyamiti|
guṇasyeti caikatvaṃ vivakṣitamityetadarthameva hi ṭhguṇanimāne' iti
laghurapi nirdeśo na kṛtaḥ| dvau bhāgau yavānāṃ trayaṃ udaśvita iti| na
tāvad ṭhbhūyasaśca vācikāyāḥ' ityuktamiti matvedamudāhṛtam, na
tvatra dviśabdo bhūyaso vācakaḥ| yadvā udāharaṇadigiyaṃ darśitā, trayo
yavānāṃ dvāvudaśvita iti darśayitavyam, nimānanimeyabhāvasya
vivaryayo vā praṣṭavya| bhūyasaśceti| pratyayārthātprakṛtyarthasya
bhūyaso yā vācikā saṃkhyātataḥ pratyaya ityarthaḥ| iha na bhavatīti|
nimānanimeyayoḥ sāmyaviṣaye na bhavatītyarthaḥ; anyathā
guṇasyetyekatvavivakṣāyāmapi syādeva prasaṅgaḥ| kutastarhi na
bhavati? anabhidhānāt |
ṭhbahorlopo bhū ca vahoḥ' iti bhūyaḥśabdasya
vyutpāditatvātprakṛtyarthasya bahutaratve sati pratyayena bhāvyam,
tataśca dviśabdānna syādityāśaṅkayāha--bhūyasa iti ceti| guṇaśabda
ityādi| na hyayaṃ bhāgamātravacanaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? samānatāmapi tasya bhāgasya
brūte |
nimeye cāpi dṛśyate iti| kathaṃ tallabhyate ?
tantrāvṛtekaśeṣāṇāmanyatamāśrayaṇena| dve atra vākte; tatraikaṃ
vyākhyātm, dvitīye nimānamiti, kṛtyalyuṭo ṭhbahulam' iti
karmaṇi lyuṭ|
guṇasyeti| karaṇasya kartṛtvavivakṣāyāṃ kartari ṣaṣṭhī, nimeyasya
nimānāpekṣatvānnimānaṃ pratyayārthaḥ, pariśiṣṭṃa sarvaṃ pūrvavat|
saṃkhyāyā iti kim ? yavabhāgau nimānamudaśvidbhāgasya
dvivacanāntādyavabhāgaśabdātpratyayo na bhavati| vrīhiyavāviti|
atrodaśvita eva nimānaṃ dvau na tadbhāgasya, tena dvimayamuśvid
vrīhiyavāviti na bhavati| dviguṇaṃ tailaṃ pacyate kṣīreṇiti|
kṣīrasambanvinau dvau guṇāvasmistaila tatenaiva subhagaṃ saha kṣīreṇa
pacyata ityucyata iti ||

tasya pūraṇe ḍaṭ || 5|2|48 ||
tasyetyekatvamavivakṣitam| ekaśya pūraṇāsambhavāt, tena
dvyādibyo dvivacanabahuvacanāntebhyaḥ pratyayaḥ| pūryate'neneti
pūraṇamiti| karaṇe lyuṭ| pūryate iti| ṇyantātkarmaṇi yak, na
prakṛtyantarāt, kartari śyat| yadi saṃkhyāvācinaḥ śabdātpūraṇe
pratyayo bhavati, ihāpi prāpnoti-pañcānāmanyato
labdhapañcasaṃkhyānāmuṣṭrikāṇāṃ pūraṇo ghaṭa iti ? tatrāha--yeneti|
saṃkhyetyasya vivaraṇam--saṃkhyānamiti| iha saṃkhyāvācinaḥ pratyayo
vidhīyate, tatra pratyāsatyā yasya saṃkhyāvācino yatpravṛttinimitaṃ
saṃkhyānaṃ pañcatvādi, tasya pūraṇa iti vijñāyate; na tu viprakṛṣṭe
pañcādiśabdavācyānantarbhūtam, yathā ṭhatiśāyane tamaviṣṭhanau'
kutsita ityādāviti bhāvaḥ| ekādaśānāṃ pūraṇa iti| tathā
vaiyākaraṇapāśa ityatra pravṛttinimitakutsāyāmapi yāpyo vaiyākaraṇa
iti vigrahaḥ, na tu yāpyaṃ vaiyākaraṇatvamitiḥ tathehāpi
saṃkhyānapūraṇe vivakṣite saṃkhyeyavācināpi vigraho na virudhyate|
ekādaśa iti| punargaṇanāyāṃ kriyamāṇāyāṃ caraṇabuddhisthena
yenaikādaśatvasaṃkhyā pūryate sa iti veditavyaḥ| evaṃ ca
vyutkrameṇāṣṭādhyāyeṣu gaṇyamāneṣu ṭhsamarthaḥ padavidhiḥ' ityadhyāyo
yadā caramaṃ gaṇyate tadā nirmāṇādvitīyasyāpi
gaṇanākrameṇāṣṭamatvavyapadeśa e bhavatyeva| nanu
prakṛtyarthavyatiriktena pratyayārthena bhavitavyam, iha
tvekādaśasvantarbhūta ekādaśānīyantāmityukte ekādaśasyāpyānayanāt
? satyam, samudāyāvacavayostu bhedāsamudāyaḥ prakṛtyartho'vayavaḥ
pratyayārthaḥ, yathā-vṛkṣasyāvayavo vārkṣī śākheti ||

nāntādasaṃkhyādermaṭ || 5|2|49 || 
ḍaṭo maḍāgamo bhavatīti| kathaṃ punarayamāgamaḥ śakyo vijñātum,
nātrāgamī nirdiṣṭaḥ, yadapi prakṛtaṃ tadapi prathamāntam,
ṣaṣṭhīnirdiṣṭena cehārthaḥ ? ata āha--nāntāditi| pañcamīgrahaṇaṃ
tāvadanuvartate, na ca tasya vidhānārthānuvṛttiḥ, pūrvameva
vihitatvāt| na ca viśeṣavihitena maṭā bādhaprasaṅge vidhānārthā
ḍaṭo'nuvṛttiḥ, evaṃ hi prakṛtasya samuccayārthaścakāraḥ kriyeta, maṭ
ceti; yathānyatra|
tato'nuvṛttisamāmarthyātṣaṭhīpraklṛptāvāgamitvameva vijñāyate| kaḥ
punarmaṭaḥ pratyayatve āgamatve vā viśeṣaḥ, yāvatā tadeva rūpaṃ sa eva
svaraḥ? satyam; ḍaṭi maṭi ca nāsti viśeṣaḥ,
ṭhviṃśatyādibhyastamaḍanyatarasyām' ityayaṃ tu tamaḍa|ldi pratyayaḥ
syādādyaudātaḥ syād, āgamatvenāgamānudātatvaṃ bhavati, na tu
pratyayasvara iti viṃśatitama ityasyāntodātatvaṃ bhavati|
ekādaśa iti| nāyaṃ saṃkhyāsamudāyaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? saṃkhyāntarameva| ata
evātra ḍaḍbhavati; anyathā so'pi na syāt| na hi saṃkhyāsamudāyaḥ
saṃkhyāgrahaṇena gṛhyate, yathā janapadasamudāyo
janapadagrahaṇena-kāśikośalīyāḥ| athāpyayaṃ saṃkhyāsamudāyaḥ; tathāpi
saṃkhyāgrahaṇena tatsamudāyo gṛhyata iti jñāpanārthameva ṭhasaṃkhyādeḥ'
iti vaktavyam; tena sarvameva saṃkyākāryamekādaśādīnāmapi bhavati
||

ṣaṭkatikatipayacaturāṃ thuk || 5|2|51 ||
tadiha saptamyā vipariṇamyata iti| yadi pūrvavat ṣaṣṭha|la vipariṇāma
iṣṭaḥ syāt, pañcamyā nirddiśet; ṣaṣṭha|la nirdeśātu
ṣaṣādīnāmevāgamitvaṃ vijñāyate| tataścānuvṛtasya
ḍaṭo'rthātsaptamyā vipariṇāma ityarthaḥ| evaṃ ca kṛtvā ṣaṣṭhāṣṭamābhyāṃ
dvitīyatṛtīyaturtheti nirddeśa upapadyate| katipayaśabdo na
saṃkhyeti| yadyapyasāvatipracayarahitaṃ bahutvamācaṣṭe, tathāpi loke
saṃkhyātvena na prasiddhiḥ, yathā--dvitrāḥ pañcaṣā iti| sāśtre'pi
naivāsya saṃkhyāsaṃjñā vihitā, kathaṃ tarhi ḍaṭpratyayaḥ ?
ityāha--tasyeti| kiṃ punasthugvidhīyate, na pañcamīnirddeśena
prakṛtasthaḍeva vidhīyeta ? naivaṃ śakyam; iha ṣaṣṭha iti jaśtavaṃ
prāpnoti, caturtha iti rephasya visarjanīyastasya ca satvaṃ prāpnoti;
thaṭaḥ parāditvena pūrvasya padatvāt| yadi punaḥ pūrvasūtre thugeva
vidhīyeta ? naivaṃ śakyam; pañcathaḥ, saptathaḥ--nalopo na syāt| iha
liṅgaviśiṣṭaparibhāṣāyā katipaśabdādābantādapi thugbhavati, tatra
ṭhbhasyāḍhea taddhite' iti ḍaṭi viṣayabhūta eva puṃvadbhāvaḥ,
katipayānāṃ pūraṇī katipayathīti bhavati|
caturaścchayatāviti| cchayadbhayāṃ ḍaṭ na bādhyate; iṭi
paratasthugvidhānāt| ādyakṣaralopaśceti| acsahitaṃ
vyañjanamakṣaraśabdenocyate, acsahitasyādervyañjanasyetyarthaḥ|
vyañjanasahitājvacane tvakṣaraśabde dvirvacananyāyena takārasyāpi
lopaḥ syāt ||

bahupūgagapasaṅghasya tithuk || 5|2|52 ||
atrāpi ṣaṣṭhīnirddesād bahvādīnāmevāgamitvam|
pūgasaṅghayorityādireka eva grantha| iha bahvīnāṃ pūraṇīti
pūrvavaḍḍaṭ pratyayaḥ puvadbhāvaśca ||

vatorithuk || 5|2|53 ||
atrāpi pūrvavadvatvantasyaivāgamitvam| iha tāvatīnāṃ pūraṇī
tāvatithīti liṅgaviśiṣṭaparibhāṣayā pratyayaḥ, puṃvadbhāvaśca|
kathaṃ punaratra liṅgaviśiṣṭaparibhāṣā, yāvatā
prātipadikasvarūpagrahaṇe sā bhavatītyuktam ? yatrāpi
prātipadikaviśeṣaṇaṃ svarūpeṇopādīyate, tatrāpi sā bhavati,
yathā--ṭhtṛjakābhyāṃ kartari'--apāṃ sraṣṭrīti| ihāpi vatoriti
viśeṣaṇaṃ svarupeṇopādīyate, tena bhavatyeva liṅgaviśiṣṭasya
grahaṇam| uktaṃ ca--bahukatipayavastūnāṃ liṅgaviśiṣṭādutpattiḥ;
prātipadikagrahaṇe liṅgaviśiṣṭasyāpi grahaṇāditi ||

dvestīyaḥ || 5|2|54 ||
tīyapratyayo bhavatīti| ḍaṭo dviśabdasya cādeśo na bhavati;
dvitīyeti nirddeśāt| yadyevam, tasmādeva nirddeśānna siddhamasya
sādhutvam ? siddhyatu sādhutvam, pūraṇāarthastu kartha labhyate!
kiñca tadāśrayaṇe
prakṛtipratyayavibhāgābhāvātprātipadikasvareṇāntodātatvaṃ syāt,
ṭhabādhakānyapi nipātanāni bhavanti' iti pakṣe ḍaṭaḥ prasaṅgaśca || 

treḥ saṃprasāraṇaṃ ca || 5|2|55 ||
aṇa iti tatrānuvartata iti| ṭhḍhralope pūrvasya dīrgho'ṇaḥ' ityataḥ|
evamapi yadi pareṇa ṇakāreṇa pratyāhāraḥ syātpunarapi syādeva
dīrgaḥ, sa tu na tathā? ityāha--pūrveṇoti| etacca ṭhlaṇ' ityatraiva
pratipāditam|
ṭhtrestṛ ca' iti noktam, pratyayo mā vijñāyīti ||

viṃśatyādibhyastamaḍanyatarasyām || viṃśatyādibhyaḥ parasyeti| kathaṃ
punaḥ ṭhdvestīyaḥ' iti tīyapratyayena satyaṃ ḍaṭpratyayo vicchinnaḥ;
pūraṇārthastu na vicchinnaḥ, so'nuvartete, tena pūraṇe yo vihitaḥ
sa āgamī vijñāyate| na ca ḍaṭo'nyo viṃśatyādibhyaḥ pūraṇe
vihito'sti|
kaḥ punaḥ paṅktyādisūtranirddiṣṭānāṃ grahaṇe sati doṣaḥ ?
tatrāha--tadgrahaṇe hīti| syādetat--tadantavidhinā
ekaviṃśatiprabhṛtibhyo'pi bhaviṣyatīti ? tatrāha--grahaṇavateti| nanu
yadayaṃ ṭhṣaṣṭa|ladeścāsaṃkhyādeḥ' ityāha, tajjñāpayati--bhavati
pūraṇaprakaraṇe tadantavidhiriti| tenaikaviṃśatiprabhṛtibhyo'pi
bhaviṣyati| atstavetat, kevalebhyastu na syāt, atadantatvāt|
vyapadeśivadbhāvena bhaviṣyati,
ṭhvyapadeśivadbhāvo'prātipadikena'| evaṃ cetyādi| laukikānāṃ
viṃśatyādīnāṃ yadīdaṃ grahaṇam, tadā ṭhṣaṣṭa|ladeśca' ityatrāpi
laukikānāmeva ṣaṣṭa|ladīnāṃ grahaṇam, tataścaikaṣaṣṭiprabhṛtibhyo
nityasya tamaṭaḥ prasaṅge ṭhasaṃkhyādeḥ' iti paryudāso yujyata eva, na
kathañcinna yujyate; aniṣṭaleśasyābhāvāt| sūtrasanniviṣṭānāṃ tu
grahaṇe tadantavidhaijñāpanārthaṃ paryudāso yujyate| kevalaṃ na tu
yujyata eva, kevalānāmaprasaṅgāditi tāvadvṛterarthaḥ| yathā tu
bhāṣyaṃ tathā sūtrasaṃniviṣṭānāṃ grahaṇam, jñāpanācca tadantavidhiriti
sthitam| na ca kevalānāmaprasaṅgastadantānāmapi bhavatīti
jñāpanaśarīram, na tu tadantānāmeva bhavatīti| yadi vā yatra
prātipadikasya śrutirasti--ṭhgrahaṇavatā prātipadikena',
vyapadeśivadbhāvo'prātipadikena' iti, tadubhayamapi na pravartate
iti sāmānyena jñāpanam| evaṃ ca kṛtvedamapi siddhaṃ
bhavatiekānnaviṃśateḥ pūraṇaḥ ekānnaviṃśatitama iti| bhavati
hyaetatsūtrasanniviṣṭaviṃśatyantaṃ saṃkhyādi saṃkhyāvāci ca| laukikānāṃ
tu grahaṇe naitatsidhyati; viṃśateḥ prāgbhāvitvādasyāssaṃkhyāyāḥ ||

nityaṃ śatādimāsārdhamāsasaṃvatsarācca || 5|2|57 ||
māsādaya ityādirvijñāyata ityanta eko grandhaḥ|
atha śatādigrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā ṭhṣaṣṭa|ladeśca' iti
vakṣyamāṇenaivasiddham ? tatrāha--ṣaṣṭa|laderityanenaiveti| yadi tena
syād, ekaśatādibhyo na syād; asaṃkhyāderiti pratiṣedhāt ||

ṣaṣṭa|ladeścāsaṃkhyādeḥ || 5|2|58 ||
saṃkyādestu viklapa evabhavatīti| na hyayaṃ vikalpasyāpi pratiṣedhaḥ|
paryudāso hyayaṃ saṃkhyādeḥ, na vidhirna pratiṣedhaḥ, yadi kenacit
prāpnoti bhavatyeva pūrveṇa ca prāpnoti, prasajyapratiṣedhe'pyanantarā
prāptiḥ pratiṣidhyate, na vyavahitā ||

matau cchaḥ sūktasāmnoḥ || 5|2|59 ||
matāviti matvartha ucyata iti| sāhacaryād mukhyasya grahaṇaṃ na bhavati|
kathaṃ hi maturabhidheyaḥ syācchabdasya śabdaḥ ? matvarthagrahaṇenetyādi|
samarthavibhaktiḥ prathamā, prakṛterarthadvārakaṃ viśeṣaṇam astitvam,
pratyayārthaḥ--asyāsminniti ca| tatra yadyapi pratyayārtho matorabhideyam,
itaradanabhidheyam; tathāpi sāhacaryamaviśiṣṭamiti
sarvametadākṣipyateusannidhāpyate, upasthāpyata ityarthaḥ| atha
vā--pradhānavaśabtitvād guṇānāṃ pradhāne pratyayārthe upasthāpite
samarthavibhaktyādikamapi guṇabhūtamupasthāpyate eva, ācamanādivat,
yathā--vrahāhṇā bhojyantāmityukte'nuktā apyācamanādayo'hgabhūtā
ākṣipyante|
ihāsyavāma ityasminnastīti
ṣaṣṭhīprathamayorupalambhādanekapadasamudāyo'yam,
tataścārtavatsamudāyānāṃ samāsagrahaṇaṃ niyamārthamiti
prātipadikasaṃjñāyā abhābādevaṃvidhebhyaḥ pratyayo na prāpnotītyata
āha--anukaraṇaśabdāśceti| svarūpamātrapradhāna iti| nātra
tadānīmuccaritamanukaraṇasvarūpaṃ vivakṣaitam, kiṃ tarhi ?
anukāryasvarūpam| mātraśabdo bāhyarthavyavacchedārthaḥ, etaduktaṃ
bhavati--yathā gavādayaḥ śabdāḥ sāsnādimadākṛtimarthaṃ
pratyāyantastenārthena tadvati matupamutpādayanti--gomān,
vṛkṣavāniti; tathānukaraṇaśabdāḥ prathamāsamarthāḥ svenānukāryeṇa
tadvati cchapratyayamiti| tatra ṭhanukaraṇaśabdāḥ' ityanena padasamudāyatvaṃ
nirasyati| anukārtho hi padasamudāyaḥ na tvanukaraṇam| kiṃ
punaranyadanukāryamanukaraṇaṃ ca, nanu rūpabhedo nopalabhyate ?
yadyapyevam, tathāpyarthabhedād bhedaḥ, anukāryasya bāhyae'rthaḥ,
anukaraṇasya tu tadevānukāryam| ata evāsyāvāmīyamityādau
vibaktyarthāpratipādanātsuptvābhāvātsyaśabdādīnāṃ lugna bhavati| ye
cāmnāyaśabdānāṃ niyamāḥ- ṭhśmaśāne nādhyeyam', ṭhcaturddaśyāṃ
nādhyeyam', ṭhśūdsya vedamupaśrṛṇvastrapujatubhyāṃ śrotrapūraṇam'
ityevamādayaḥ, te'pyanukaraṇeṣau na bhavanti| asyavāmīyamiti hi
sarvatra sarvadā sarvepāṃ ca sakāśe prayujyate|
tasmādanye'nukaraṇaśabdāḥ| anukāryaśabdāśca svarūpamātrapradāna
ityanena tvarthavatvamāha|
anekapadādapīti| anekaṃ padaṃ yatra samudāye tasmādapītyarthaḥ|
paraprasiddhyā caivamucyate, yambhavānanekapadasamudāyaṃ manyate
tasmādapītyarthaḥ| na tvatra
vastuto'nekapadatvamasti---asyavāmīyamiti, asyavāmasyeti vede
yatpadadvayaṃ paṭhitaṃ tadaikadeśasyāsyavāmaśabdasya
cchapratyayaprakṛtirasyavāmaśabdaḥ| pratipādaka ityarthavatvam,
padasamudāyatvābhāvācca prātipadikatve sati pratyayaḥ| kiṃ punaratra
cchapratyayaprakṛtateranukaraṇatve pramāṇam ? cchapratyaya eva| na
hyasāvanukaraṇatvamantareṇa sambavati|
tasmāditiśabdavacchapratyayo'pyunukaraṇatve pramāṇam ||

adhyāyānuvākayorluk || 5|2|60 ||
kena punariti| sūktasāmnoreva chāe vihita iti praśnaḥ| idameviti|
na hyasatī lugvidhānamupapadyate| vikalpena ceti| tatkathaṃ matupprakaraṇe
evāsminsūtre kartavye tadatra cchasya lugvidhānam ? tasmātpākṣiko
luganumīyate| atra kecidāhuḥ--anuvākasāhacaryādvaidiko'dhyāyo
gṛhyata iti| anye punaḥ---pauruṣeyagranthaviśeṣasyāpyadhyāyasya
grahaṇamicchanti|ca tathā ca ṭhdīrghajīvitīyamadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ'
ityadivaidyakagrantheṣu dṛśyate || 

tatra kuśalaḥ pathaḥ || 5|2|63 ||
pathi kuśala iti| ṭhāyuktakuśalābhyāṃ cāsevāyām' iti saptamī,
kauśalasya kriyāviṣayatvātpathinśabdena gamanādikā tadviṣayā kriyā
lakṣyate| yogaścāyam ṭhkṛtalabdhakrītakuśalāḥ' ityaṇo'pavādaḥ ||

ākaṣādibhyaḥ kan || 5|2|64 ||
kan || ākaṣatyasminsuvarṇādikamityākaṣaḥ, ṭhpuṃsi saṃjñāyām' iti
ghaḥ| ṭhhalaśca' iti ghañ tu na bhavati; prāyagrahaṇānuvṛteḥ, yathā nikaṣa
iti| ye tu ākarṣādabhya iti sarephaṃ paṭhanti,
teṣāmākṛṣyate'sminniti ghañi rūpam| tsaruka iti| ṭhtsakara
cchadmagatau', ṭhbhṛmṛśrṛ' ityādinauṇādika upratyayaḥ|
tsaruḥukhaḍgagrahaṇapradeśaḥ| etadarkhaṃ pratyayāntarakaraṇamivarṇāntārthaṃ ca|
akārānteṣvākarṣādiṣu prakṛtena vunāpi siddham ||

dhanahiraṇyāt kāme || 5|2|65 ||
kāma iccheti| kāmayitā tu na gṛhyate; anabhidhānāt ||

svāṅgebhyaḥ prasite || 5|2|66 ||
prasitaḥ prasakta iti| ṭhṣiñ bandhene' karmaṇi ktaḥ, yo yatra prasaktaḥ sa
tatra prakarṣeṇa baddha iva bhavatītyupamānādidamabhidhānam| keśeṣu
prasita iti| ṭhprasitotsukābhyāṃ tṛtīya ca' iti saptamī|
keśādiracanāyāmiti| keśādisthāyāṃ racanāyāṃ keśādiśabdasya
vṛtti darśayati| etaśca kriyāviṣayatvāt prasaklelebhyate|
bahuvacanamityādi| svarūpavidhinirāsārthaṃ tu bahuvacanaṃ na bhavati,
ṭhadravam' ityādinā svāṅgasya paribhāṣitatvena
svarūpagrahaṇāsambhavat || 


udarāṭṭhagādyane || 5|2|67 ||
ādyauno vijigīṣuriti| ṭhvivo'vijikagīṣāyām' iti tatra
niṣṭhānatvavidhānāt| udaraka iti| udaraparimārjanādau prasita ucyate
||

sasyena parijātaḥ || 5|2|68 ||
sasyaśabdau guṇavācīti| na dānyavācī; anabhidhānāt| kecitu
ṭhśaṃsiduhiguhibhyo vā' iti kyavantaṃ śasyaśabdaṃ paṭhanti| sasyeneti
kartari kṛtīyā| parigato jātaḥ parijātaḥ, ṭhprādayo gatādyarthe
prathamayā' iti samāsaḥ| samantātsanbaddhaḥ parigataḥ, tatra sasyasya
kartṛtvam, tadāhṛ--yo guṇaiḥ sambaddho jāta iti ||

aṃśaṃ hīrī || 5|2|69 ||
tatra ṣaṣṭhīpratiṣedhāditi| ṭhakenorbhaviṣyadādhamarṇyayoḥ' ityanena|
nanu tatra bhaviṣyadadhikāravihitasyākasya grahaṇam ? satyam;
inastvaviśeṣaṇa grahaṇam, asmādeva dvitīyānirddeśāt ||

tantrādacirāpahṛte || 5|2|70 ||
tanyante tantavo'sminnati tantramutantuvāyaśalākā, tantrātervā
eraci ṇilopaḥ| acirāpahṛta iti| aciraḥ kālo'pahṛtasyeti ṭhkālāḥ
parimāṇinā' iti samāsaḥ| pañcamīsamarthāditi| apahṛtayoge
ṭhapādāne, pañcamī' ||

brāhmaṇakoṣṇike saṃjñāyām || 5|2|71 || 
kanpratyayāntau nipātyete iti| kiṃ punaratra nipātyate,
brāhṇaṇaśabapdādāyudhajīvyupādhikātprathamāntātsaptamyarthe kanpratyayaḥ,
annaśabdādalpatvopādhikātsaptamyartha eva kanpratyayaḥ,
annaśabdasyoṣṇasyoṣṇayādeśaḥ ? tadāhayatrāyudhajīvina ityādi ||

śītoṣṇābhyāṃ kāriṇi || 5|2|72 ||
śitaṃ karoti sa śītakaḥ, yaścoṣṇaṃ karoti sa uṣṇakaḥ| kiṃ cātaḥ?
tuṣāre āditye ca prāpneti, śītoṇaśabdayohi sparśaviseṣo
mukhyo'rtheḥ, taṃ ca tāvavaśyaṃ kuruta eveti mukhyārthagrahe doṣaṃ
dṛṣṭvā gauṇārthayorgrahaṇamiti darśayannāha--kriyāviśeṣaṇāditi|
tatra śītoṣṇaśabdayorupamānād vṛttiḥ---śītamiva śītam,
mandakaraṇamityarthaḥ| śītaṃ hi mandatāyuktam; sati śīte kāryakaraṇe
pāṭavābhāvāt| evamuṣṇamivoṣṇamupaṭuakaram, śīghrakaraṇamityarathaḥ|
evaṃ kriyāviśeṣaṇābhyāṃ pratyayaḥ| dvitīyāsamarthāditi| ṭhkṛdyogalakṣaṇā
tu ṣaṣṭhī kriyāviśeṣaṇānta bhavati' iti prāgevoktam|
mukhyārthavṛttibhyāṃ tu pratyayo na bhavati; anabhidhanāt ||

adhikam || 5|2|73 ||
adhyāruḍhaśabdasyeti| yadi punaradhiśabdātsasādhanakriyāvacanāt
kannipātyate, tadā kartṛkarmaṇoranyatarasyaivābhidhānaṃ prāpnoti|
adhyārūḍhaśabdastūbhayārtha iti tasyaivedamaṅgīkṛtasādhanabhedaṃ
nipātanamucitamiti bhāvaḥ| adhiko droṇaḥ khāryām, adhikāka khārī
droṇeneti| yathaitatprayogadvayamupapadyate tathā darśayatikartari
karmaṇi cādhyārūḍhaśabda iti| ṭhgatyarthākarmaka' ityādinā ruheḥ kartari
karmaṇi ca kto vihitaḥ| nipātanasāmarthyācca
sakṛdupāto'pyaṅgīkṛtasādhanabhedaḥ saṃgṛhyate| tatra yadā kartari
tadā tatrābihitatvātprathamaiva bhavati, na tṛtīyā; yadā tu karmaṇi
tadā karturanabhihitatvātṛtīyā, karmaṇastvabhihitatvātprathamā| yadā
ca kartari tastadā karmaṇo'nabhidānādadhyārūḍhayoge yathā dvitīyā
bhavati--adhyārūḍho droṇaḥ khārīmiti, grāmaṃ gata itivat,
tathādhikaśabdenāpi yoge dvitīyāyāṃ prāptāyām ṭhyasmādadhikam'
ṭhtadasminnadhikam' iti ca nirddesāt pañcamīsaptamyau bhavataḥ ||

anukābhikābhīkaḥ kamitā || 5|2|74 ||
sūtre samāhāradvandve liṅgavyatyayaḥ, anuśabdādabhiśabdācca
sasādhanakriyāvacanātsvārthe kannipātyata ityāha--anukāmayate'nuka
iti| ṭhabhikāmayate' ityetad gamyamānatvānnoktam ||

pārśvenānvicchati || 5|2|75 ||
anujurupāyaḥ pārśvamiti| tiryagavastānātpārśvaṃ tāvadanṛju,
tadvadanyo'pyanṛjurupāya evabhucyata ityarthaḥ| ya
ṛjunopāyenānveṣṭavyānarthānanṛjunā'nvicchati sa pārśvakaḥ|
kutsito mārgaukusṛtiḥ, jālamuānāyaḥ, tābhyāṃ caratīti
kausṛtikau jālikaḥ ||

athaḥśūladaṇḍājinābhyāṃka ṭhakṭhatrau || 5|2|76 ||
tṛtīyāsamarthābhyāmiti| nirddeśādeva tṛtīyā hīyam, na pañcamī;
pūrveṇa sāhacaryāt| tīkṣṇa upāyo'yaḥśūlamiti| yathāyaḥśulaṃ
tīkṣaṇaṃ tathānyo'pi tīkṣaṇaṃ upāyo'yaḥśūlamityupacārāducyata
ityarthaḥ| dambhodaṇḍājinamiti| dambhasādhanatvāt| dambhavanto hi
prāyeṇa daṇkaḍamajinaṃ ca dhārayanti| teneti| dambhena tu dhārayatu
mā vā'dīdharadityarthaḥ, sarvatra mukhyārthāgrahaṇe'nabhidhānameva hetuḥ
||

tāvatirthaṃ grahaṇamiti lugvā || 5|2|77 || yathā ṭhtasyāpatyam' ityatra
tasyeti ṣaṣṭha|lntānāṃ sāmānyanirdeśaḥ, tathā tāvatithamiti
pūraṇapratyayāntānāṃ sāmānyanirddeśaḥ| pūraṇapratyayasya ceti| na tu
kanaḥ luk; vāgrahaṇānarthakyaprasaṅgāt,
mahāvibhāṣādhikārādvikalpena kana utpateḥ pañcamaṃ grahaṇam, pañcamakaṃ
grahaṇamiti rūpadvayasya siddhatvāt| tathā ca vārtitakam--ṭhtāvatithaṃ
grahaṇamiti lugvacanānarthakyaṃ vibhāṣāprakaraṇāt' iti| ato
lugvāgrahaṇaṃ kurvataḥ sūtrakārasya pūraṇapratyasya vā lugvidhīyata iti
pakṣo lakṣyate dvitīyena rūpeṇa granthaṃ gṛhṇātīti| atra grahaṇe
dvitīyasya karaṇatvaṃ pradarśayitumidaṃ vākyam| vastutastu dvitīyaṃ
grahaṇaṃ devadatasyeti vigrahītavyam| dvikaṃ grahaṇamiti| grahītaryapi
pratyayo vakṣyate, tena prakṛtyupādhibhūtasya grahaṇasya
niyamenāpratītergrahaṇaśabdaprayogaḥ| dvikaṃ rūpaṃ devadatasyetyeva tu
nodāhṛtam, svacchandato hi vacasāṃ pravṛttiḥ| catuṣka iti|
sanniyogaśiṣṭaparibhāṣayā ḍaṭi nivṛte thuko'pi nivṛttiḥ, rephasya
visarjanīyaḥ, ṭhidudupadhasya' iti ṣatvam|
tāvatitheneti| svārthe pratyayo vidhīyamāno grahītari na
prāpnotīti vacanam| nityaṃ ca lukaṃ vakṣyāmīti| ṣaṭka iti|
rūpaśabdasya vākye prayuktasyāpi vṛtau gamyamānatvādaprayogaḥ,
padatvājjaśtvacartve| iha yaḥ ṣaṣṭhena rūpeṇa gṛhṇāti ṣaṅbhirasau
rūpairgṛhṇāti, tataḥkiṃ saṅkhayāyāḥ, tena gṛhṇātītyeva vaktavyam,
evaṃ hi lugveti na vaktavyaṃ bhavati ? naivaṃ śakyam; evaṃ hyucyamāne
ihāpi prāpneti--ekena rūpeṇa gṛhṇātīti|
pūraṇapratyayastvekaśabdānnāsti, tena granthaviṣayameva grahaṇaṃ vijñāyata
iti| teneha na bhavati--dvitīyo hasto grahaṇo daṇḍasyoti ||

sa eṣāṃ grāmaṇīḥ || 5|2|78 ||
iha tvatko matko vā vijaya ityādāvanena kan| tvaṃ grāmaṇīrasya
tvatkaḥ, ahaṃ grāmaṇīrasya matkaḥ| prāyeṇa tvidamarthamātre prayujyate ||

śṛṅkalamasya bandhanaṃ karabhe || 5|2|79 ||
nanu na śṛṅkhalamātreṇa karabho baddhayate, kiṃ tahi ? rajjvā, kīlena
ca, tasmācchḥaṅkalamasya bandhanamiti na yuktaṃ vaktum, evaṃ tu
vaktavyam---ṭhśṛṅkhalavadasya sambanadhanaṃ karabhe kukca matoḥ iti ?
tatrāha--yadyapīti| astu rajjvāderapi karaṇatvam, śṛṅkhalasyāpi
karaṇatvamastveva; tadantareṇa bandhanasyānirvṛterityarthaḥ ||

utka unmanāḥ || 5|2|80 ||
ucchabdātsasādhanakriyāvacanāditi| sādhanamumanaḥ, kriyāugamanam,
udrate manasi vartamānādityarthaḥ| yadvatīti| udgataṃ mano yasya
tasminnityarthaḥ| utsukaḥūtkaṇṭhitaḥ ||

kālaprayojanādroge || 5|2|81 ||
arthalabhyeti| arthausāmardhyam, tena labhyā| tatra kāle saptamī
samarthavibhaktiḥ, bhavo hi tatra pratyayārthaḥ| prayojane tṛtīyā,
janito hi tatra pratyayārthaḥ| phale tu prayojane prathamā| prayojanaṃ
kāraṇaṃ rogasya phalaṃ ceti| ubhayamapi prayojayatīti
prayojanamucyate| yadi tarhi kāraṇamapi prayojanamucyate,
kālagrahaṇamanarthakam, katham ? yo'sau dvitīye'hni bhavo jvarastasya
dvitīyamapyahaḥ kāraṇam; aharantare tadanutpateḥ? satyam; sadapi
kāraṇatvaṃ yadā na vivakṣyate ṭhtatra bhavaḥ' ityeva tu vivakṣyate, tadāpi
yathā syādivyevamarthaṃ kālagrahaṇam| dvitīye'hni bhava iti|
sāmānyaśabdasyāpi dvitīyaśabdasyārthaprakaraṇādinā vṛttiviṣaye
kāle'pi vṛteḥ kālaśabdatvam| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ
sākṣātkālavācibhyo māsādibhyaḥ pratyayo na bhavati dvitīyādibhyaśca
bhavati, tatrāpi saptamīsamarthebhyo bhavārtha eva bhavati
kāraṇavācinastṛtīyāsamarthāt, phalavācinastu prathamāsamarthāt, na
hyaetatsarva sūtrākṣarairupātam ?
tatrāha--utarasūtrāsaṃjñāgrahaṇamihānukṛṣyata iti|
siṃhāvalokitanyāyena, yathā siṃhā dhāvantaḥ pṛṣṭhato'valokayante|
apara āhautarasūtre yogavibhāgaḥ, ṭhtadasminnannaṃ prāye', tataḥ
ṭhsaṃjñāyām', yadetadanukrāntaṃ tatsaṃjñāyāṃ draṣṭavyamityarthaḥ|
saṃjñāgrahaṇamubhayoḥ śeṣaḥ, etadeva cānukarṣaṇaṃ vivakṣitam |
tadasminnannaṃ prāye saṃjñāyām || 5|2|82 ||
annamuabyavahāryam, adyate smeti kṛtvā| gukaḍāmiśrā apūpā
guḍāpūpāḥukṛsarastilaudanaḥ, tilakṣoda ityanye|
traibilo'pūpastripuṭaḥ| vaṭakebhya ini riti| kani prāpte vacanam|
nanu saṃjñāgrahaṇātkanna bhaviṣyati, tasmiṃścāsati matvarthīya
inirbhaviṣyati ? na siddhayati; ṭhsaptamyāṃ ca na taṃ smṛtau' iti
vacanāt ||

kulmāṣādañ || 5|2|83 ||
kulmāṣāḥumudgāḥ ||

śrotriyaÄścchandodhīte || 5|2|84 ||
vākyārtha iti| vākyārthagrahaṇena tadāśrayaścchando'dyāyī puruṣa
upacārāducyate, kutaḥ ? mukhyo hi vākyārthaḥ kriyārūpaḥ,
sambandharūpo vā, sa cāsatvabhūtaḥ| śrotriyaśabdastu
satvabhūtārthābhidhāyī, tasminvākyārthe'vidyamānaprakṛtipratyayavibhāgaḥ
śrotriyaśabdo nipātyata ityarthaḥ| atha kathamasminapakṣe svarasiddhiḥ,
yāvatā nakāra idyasya tatra parataḥ svaro vidhīyate, na cātraivaṃ
vyapavargo'sti ? mā bhūdvayapavarge, nitkaraṇasāmarthyātadabhāve'pi
bhaviṣyati| yadvā, nitīti karmadhārayo'yam--naścāsāvicca nit,
tatra parata iti|
kathamityādi| cchandasaḥ śrotrabhāvo ghan ca pratyayaḥ, chāndasa iti na
siddhyati; ghanā'ṇo bādhitatvāt, śrotrabhāvena ca cchandaḥśabdasya
nivartitatvāditi praśnaḥ| vāgrahaṇamanuvartata iti| apara
āha--yaścchando'dhīte tadarthaṃ cānutiṣṭhati tatra śrotriyaśabdaḥ,
adhyetṛmātre tu chāndaśabda ityarthabhedānnāsti bādhyabādhakatvamiti|
ṭhekāṃ śākhāmadhītya śrotriyo bhavati' iti dharmasāstram ||

śrādbhamanena bhuktaminiṭhanau || 5|2|85 ||
śrāddhaśabdaḥ kamanāmadheyamiti| śraddhayā niṣpādyasya piñyasya karmaṇaḥ
śrāddhaśabdaḥ saṃjñā, śraddhāsminnastīti ṭhprajñāśraddhārcāvṛttibhyo ṇaḥ' iti
ṇaḥ| tatsādhane dravya iti| mukhyaśraddhasya bhojanāsambhavāt|
samānakālagrahaṇamitiṣa| bhujinā samāne kāle pratyayāntasya prayogo
yathā syāt, yadyapi bhujikriyā katipayakṣaṇasādhyā, tathāpi yāvantaṃ
kālaṃ tadāśinastṛptiśeṣastalliṅgaṃ cānuvartate tāvatsamānakālaḥ,
sa ca prāyovṛtyā'dyatana eveti tasminneva pryayāntasya prayogaḥ| yadā
tu kasyaciddurbalasya dvitīye'pyahni bhuktamapariṇataṃ tadā
prayogābhāvaḥ| tadidamāha-adya bhukte śvaḥ śrāddhika iti kaprayogo mā
bhūditi ||

pūrvādiniḥ || 5|2|86 ||
pūrvaṃ gatamanenetyādi| kriyāviseṣaṇād dvitīyāntātpratyayaḥ ||

sapūrvacca || 5|2|87 ||
vidyamānaṃ pūrvamasminniti sapūrvamiti| ṭhtena saheti tulyayoge'
ityupādhivacanasya prāyikatvādvidyamānavacanasyāpi samāsaḥ|
pūrvaśabdo'vayavavacanaḥ| na ca śabdāntaraṃ pūrvaśabdasyāvayava
upapadyate| pakārastvavyabhicārī, tena
