prātipadikasyaitadviśeṣaṇam--sapūrvaṃ yatprātipadikamiti| evaṃ ca
pūrvaśabdo'pi tasyaiva viśeṣaṇam, viśeṣaṇena ca
tadantavidhirityāha--tasya pūrvaśabdena tadantavithadhiriti|
sapūrvādityādi| yadyapi pūrvaśabdāntaṃ prātipadikaṃ sapūrvameva,
tathāpi asati sapūrvagrahaṇe tadantavidhirna labhyata iti ṭhsapūrvāt'
ityuktam| kṛtakarmaṇoḥ kṛti' ityatrāyaṃ prayoga upapāditaḥ|
yogadvayenetyādi| yadi ṭhvyapadeśivadbhāvo'prātipadikena'
ityeṣā paribhāṣā na syāt ṭhpūrvādiniḥ sapūrvāt' ityekameva
yogaṃ kuryāt, vyapadeśivadbhāvātkevalādapi bhaviṣyati, kiṃ
yogadvayakaraṇena! atra cakāraḥ kartavyo na bhavati| yadi ca ṭhgrahaṇavatā
prātipadikena' ityeṣā paribhāṣā na syāt, ṭhpūrvādiniḥ'
ityetāvadeva brūyāt, tadantavidhinā sapūrvādapi bhaviṣyatīti kiṃ
dvitīyena yogena ! tadiha yogadvayena paribhāṣādvayaṃ jñāpyate ||

cchandasi paripanthiparipariṇau paryavasthātari || 5|2|89 ||
atra paryavasthātṛśabdātsvārthe inipratyayo'vasthātṛśabdasya ca panthi,
pari--ityetāvādeśau nipātyete| bhāṣāyāṃ tu
paripanthiśabdasyāsādhuḥ prayogaḥ ||

anupadyanveṣṭā || 5|2|90 ||
padasya paścādanupadam, paścādarthe'vyayībhāvaḥ, anveṣṭarīnipratyayo
nipātyate| anupadī gavābhiti| padāpekṣayā ṣaṣṭhī, gopadasya
paścādanveṣaṇaṃ gavāmeva, hiraṇyādāvanveṣye na bhavati;
padābhāvāt| yadi tvanveṣṭaśabdātsvārthe inipratyayaḥ, eṣṭḥaśabdasya ca
padaśabda ādeso nipātyeta; yadi
vā--śrotriyavadavidyamānaprakṛtipratyamanveṣṭari nipātyeta, tato
gavāmiti ṣaṣṭhī na prāpnotikṛtapūrvī kaṭam, anuko bhāryāmabhiko
dāsīmitivat dvitīyā prāpnoti; hiraṇyādau cānveṣye--anupadī
hiraṇyamiti| tasmādyathoktameva sādhīyaḥ ||

sākṣād draṣṭari saṃjñāyām || 5|2|91 ||
sākṣācchabdo'vyayamiti| tena prakṛtivadanukaraṇaṃ bhavatīti sūtre
pañcamyā aluk, udāharaṇe ca ṭhavyayānāṃ bhamātre' iti ṭilopa iti
bhāvaḥ| saṃjñāgrahaṇādityādi| tribhiḥ sākṣād dṛṣṭṃa bhavati--yaśca
dadāti, yasmai ca dīyate, yaśca pārśve sthitaḥ paśyati, tatra sarvatra
pratyayaḥ prāpnoti| saṃjñāgrahaṇāddhanikādhamarṇayorna bhavatītyarthaḥ ||

kṣetriyac parakṣetre cikitsyaḥ || 5|2|92 ||
ṭhkṣi nivāsagatyoḥ' ityasmādyathāyogamadhikaraṇādau ṣṭran, kṣetram|
parakṣetraṃ janmāntaraśarīramiti| ātmano nivāsasthānatvātkṣetram,
paraṃ ca tatkṣetra ceti karmadhārayaḥ| tatra cikitsyaḥupratikāryopaneya
ityarthaḥ, na tu tatra bhiṣajitavya iti| yadāha--nāmṛtasyeti |
atha veti| samuccaya evātra vivakṣitaḥ, na tu vikalpaḥ|
vakṣyati--ṭhsarvacaitatpramāṇam' iti| kṛtyaḥ śakyārthe, pūrvatra tu
karmamātre, utarayorarhārthe| sasyārtha iti| anena kṣetrasya
parakīyatvamāha---paradārāḥ parakṣetramiti| karmaṇi ṣṭran,
kṣetavyāḥugantavyāḥ, upagamanārhā dārāḥukṣetram| tatreti|
tasminviṣaye| nigṛhītavya iti| daṇkaḍādinā ||

indriyamindraliṅgamindradṛṣṭamindrasṛṣṭamindrajuṣṭamindradatamiti vā ||
5|2|93 ||
antodāta iti| ṭhkṣetriyac' ityetatsāhacaryāt| rūḍhireveti| kimatra
pramāṇam? ityāha tathā ceti| na hi yaugikeṣu vyutpateraniyamo
bhavati| indra ātmeti| kāryakāraṇasaṅgātaṃ pratīśvaratvāt| vijñiyate
ca tamindraṃ santamindra ityācakṣate parokṣeṇeti| karaṇeneti|
hetugarbhaviśeṣaṇam| yathā punarayaṃ hetustathā
darśayati--nākartṛkamiti| itikaraṇo hetau| na hi
vāśyādikaraṇamanadhiṣṭhitaṃ kartrā pravartate| indreṇa dṛṣṭamiti|
dṛṣṭamujñātam, tathā ca kāryakāraṇasaṅghātaṃ prastutya bhavati
vādaḥ---ṭhsa etameva puruṣaṃ brahmatatamapaśyat', ṭhidamadarśam' ityādi|
kathaṃ punaścakṣurādikamātmanā sṛṣṭam ? ityāha--tatkṛteneti| śubhaṃ
karmauvihitam, pratiṣiddhamuaśubham--tadubhayaṃ militaṃ
kāraṇānāmutpādakam; iṣṭāniṣṭānāṃ rūpādīnāṃ
cakṣurādibhirupalambhāt| yathāyathāmiti| yo yasya viṣayaḥ--cakṣuṣo
rūpam, ghrāṇasya gandha ityādi, tadgrahaṇāyetyarthaḥ|
anyathāpi kartavyeti| tadyathā--indreṇa durjayamiti|
pratyokamabhisambadhyamāna iti| hetugarbhaviśeṣaṇam;
yasmātpratyekamabhisambadhyate tasmādityarthaḥ ||

tadasyāstyasminniti matup || 5|2|94 || 
asyāsminniti pratyayārthāviti| nanu ca yadyasya bhavati tasminnapi
tadvati, yacca yasmin bhavati tasyāpi tadbhavati; yathā--vṛkṣasya
śākhā, vṛkṣe śākheti; tatrānyataranirddeśenaiva siddham,
kimarthamubhāvarthau nirddiśyete ? naitayauravaśyambhāvī samāveśaḥ;
tathā hi--ṣaṣṭha|lrthamātranirddeśe yatrādhikaraṇaṃ tenaiva rūpeṇa
vivakṣyate, na tajjanyaḥ śeṣasambandhaḥ, yathā--vṛkṣā asminparvate
santīti na tatra pratyayaḥ syāt| na hyatra kriyākārakapūrvakaḥ
śeṣasambandho dṛśyate; vṛkṣaiḥ parvatasyānārambhāt
nāvayavāvayavibhāvaḥ| ānantaryādisambandhastu sambhavati| na tu tatra
matvarthīyo bhavati; anabhidhānāt| tathā kevalasaptamyarthanirddeśe
kārakāntarapūrvaḥ sambandho na gṛhītaḥ syāt; tataśca putravān,
gomānityādau na syād|
utpādanapratigrahādikriyāviṣayakartṛtvajanyo hyatra sambandhaḥ,
nādhārapūrvakaḥ; deśāntaragate'pi putrādau tadvāniti vyapadeśyasya
bhāvāt| sāmīpikasyāpyadhikaraṇasyāsambhavaḥ| syādetat--putrasya
pitradhīnatvādgavāṃ ca svāmyadhīnatvādgurau vasatītivadadhikaraṇaṃ
bhaviṣyati, karaṇasaṃjñāyāṃ hi tamabgrahaṇena kārakaprakaraṇe
prakarṣasyānāśrayaṇādgauṇasyāpyādhārasyādhikaraṇasaṃjñā bhavatyeveti ?
bhavatvevamadhikaraṇasaṃjñā, matvarthāyastu mukhya evādhikaraṇe
syāt--vṛkṣavān parvataḥ, gomāñjanapada ityādau; na
gauṇe--putravān gomāndevadata ityādau, na hyatra gauṇagrahaṇasya
liṅgamasti| tasmādubhayorapi nirddeśaḥ kartavyaḥ| astīti prakṛti
viśeṣaṣaṇāmiti| arthadvāreṇeti draṣṭavyam|
nanu sambhave vyabhicāre ca viśeṣaṇaviseṣyabhāvo bhavati
nīlotpalavat, na ca satāṃ padārtho vyabhicarati, tāmantareṇa
padasyoccārayitumapyaśakyatvāt; tathā hiyāvadbudvayā padārtho na
viṣayīkṛtastāvatpadasya prayogābhāvaḥ, tena buddhisatāsamāviṣṭamarthaṃ
śabdo gocarayati, tasyaiva bahirasatvāsatvapratipādanāya vṛkṣo'sti,
vṛkṣo nāstīti prayogaḥ| yadi bāhyasatāsamāvaliṣṭṃa vastu vācyaṃ
bhavet, tadā virodhapaunaruktyābhyāṃ prayogo na bhavedayam|
evamevātyantāsato'pi bahiḥ śaśaviṣāṇādīnarthānbuddhyā
viṣayīkṛtya tadvaciśabdaprayogaḥ| tasmād buddhyupārūḍhopacaritā
satā śabdaprayogasya nimitamiti na tāṃ padārtho vyabhicarati|
taduktam---ṭhna satāṃ padārtho vyabhicarati' iti| kasyacitpadasyārthaḥ
sannevaṃvidhāṃ satāṃ na vyabhicaratītyarthaḥ ?
idaṃ tarhi prayojanam--yā sampratisatā mukhyā vartamānalakṣaṇā bāhyā
tasyāṃ yathā syād, bhūtabhaviṣyatoryā
satātītānāgatavastuparāmārśinyā budvyotprekṣitopacaritarūpā
tasyāṃ mā bhūt| tena gāvo'syāsan, gāvo'lasya bhavitāra
ityatrārthe gomāniti prayogābhāvaḥ|
yadyevam, vidyamāna eva devadate tadravīnāmatītānāgatatvapratipādanāya
gomānāsīt gomānbhaviteti prayujyate, tatra prakṛtyarthasya
sampratisatāyā abhāvātpratyāyāprasaṅkaḥ ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; nātra
sākṣādgavāṃ satā kathyate, kiṃ tarhi ? gomata eṣā satā kathyate| yadi
punargavāṃ satā kathyeta; yathehāsteḥ prayogo na bhavati--gāvo'sya
santi gomāniti pratyayenaiva prakṛtyarthopādheḥ pratītatvāt,
tathehāpi na syāt--gomānāsīd, gomānbhaviteti| satyapi vā
prayoge yatheha bahuvacanaṃ bhavati--gomānāsīd, gomānbhaviteti|
satyapi vā prayoge yatheha bahuvacanaṃ bhavati--gāvo'syāsan,
gāvo'sya bhavitāra iti; evamihāpi syādgomānāsīd,
gomānbhaviteti| tasmānnaiṣā gavāṃ satā kathyate, kiṃ tarhi ?
gomatsataiṣā kathyate| tatra yadyapi yo gomānsa vidyate, gomatārūpaṃ
tu tasyādītamanāgataṃ veti bhūtabhaviṣyatprayogaḥ|
yathā--īśvaro'yamāsīddaridro'yaṃ bhaviṣyatīti|
tatrārthātprakṛtyarthasyāpyatītānāgatatvapratītirbhavati, sā
vākyārthavaśādupajāyamānā bahirahgeti nāntaraṅgaṃ śabdasaṃskāraṃ
nivartayati, yathā--grāmaṃ na gacchatīti| tadevaṃ samprati satāyāṃ
yathā--grāmaṃ na gacchatīti| tadevaṃ samprati satāyāṃ yathā syād,
bhūtabhaviṣyatsatāyāṃ mā bhūdityevamarthamastītyucyata iti sthitam|
nanu ca yatrānyatkriyāpadaṃ na śrūyate tatrāstirbhavatiparaḥ
prathamapuruṣo'prayujyamāno'pi gamyate, tataśca gāvo'sya
gāvo'sminnityukte kimityapekṣāyāṃ santīti gaṃstate,
nārtho'stigrahaṇena ? na sārvatrikametat; yadā khalu gāvo'sya
nānyasya, gāvo'sminnānyasminnityevaṃ vivakṣā, na tadāstitvaṃ
pratīyate| tasmādastīti vaktavyam|
atha kriyamāṇe'pyastigrahaṇe iha kasmānna bhavati--gāvo'sya santyanantarā
iti ? sāpekṣatvenāsāmarthyāt| iha kasmānna bhavati-citraguḥ,
śabalaguriti ? bahuvrīhiṇoktatvāt| vākye tu citrā gāvo'sya
sannīti pratyekamasāmarthyānna bhavati, samudāyātvaprātipadikatvāt|
iha tu pañca gāvo'sya santi pañcaguḥ daśaguriti ṭhtaddhitārtha' iti
dviguśca prāpnoti, bahuvrīhiśca; tatracitragurityādau sāvakāśaṃ
bahuvrīhiṃ saṃkhyāvāciṣu dvigurbādheta, tataśca taddhitārthe viṣayabhūte
vihitena dvigunā'nuktastaddhitārtha iti yatheha taddhito
bhavati-dvaimāturaḥ, pāñcanāpitiriti, ṭhdvigorluganapatye'ka iti
lugapi prāgdīvyatīyasya vidhīyate, tena matupo lugalabhyaḥ| tasmāt
ṭhtadvitārtha' ityatra yaduktam ṭhsarvatra matvarthe pratiṣedhaḥ' iti
tadevātraka śaraṇam|
bhūmetyādi| astivivakṣāyāṃ ye matubādayo vidhīyante te
bhūmādiṣu viṣayabhūteṣu bhavantītyarthaḥ|
bahūnāṃ bhāvo bhūmā, tatra bhūmni; gomān, yavamān| bahutvaṃ
cābhidhānavaśādviśiṣṭamevāśrayaṇīyam, yadāha--ṭhyāvatībhiḥ khalvapi
gobhirvāhadohaprasavāḥ kalpante tāvatīṣu satā kathyate,
kasyaciccatasṛbhirapi kalpante kasyacicchatenāpi na kalpante' iti|
evaṃ ca yavamāniti triprabhṛtiṣu bahutvasadbhāve'pi na bhavati| iha
yavamatībhiradbhiryūpaṃ prokṣatīti jātimātrasambandho vivakṣita iti
bhūmābhāve'pi bhavati| bhūmādigrahaṇaṃ tvabhidhānasvabhāvapradarśanārtham|
nindāyāṃ kakudāvartinī kanyā, praśaṃsāyāṃ rūpavān, nityayoge
kṣīriṇo vṛkṣāḥ, atiśāyane udariṇī kanyā| saṃsarge,
saṃsargaḥusaṃyogaḥ; daṇḍī saṃsaktadaṇḍa ucyate| gṛhāvasthite tu
daṇḍīti na bhavati| kvacid vṛtau granthaḥ
astivivakṣāyāmastimāniti| tatra bhūmādiṣvastivivakṣāyāṃ ca bhavati
matubādaya iti samuccayo vyākhyeyaḥ| astiśabdo vibhaktipratirūpako
nipātaḥ kartṛviviśiṣṭasatāvācī, naiṣo'sterlaṭ| pratyayāntaramapi
dṛśyate--astitvam, astiteti| avyabhicārādastisāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ
nāstītyastivivakṣāyāṃ pratyayo vidhīyate| etacca sūtre ṭhasti' iti
tantreṇa luptapañcamīkaprakṛtinirddeśāśrayaṇāllabhyate| astimāniti
ca vṛttiviṣaye kartṛviśeṣe dhane'stiśabdo vartate| na hi
kartṛsāmānyena pratyayārthasya viśeṣaṇaṃ sambhavati, sarvasyaiva hi
sarvadā yatkiñcidasti|
guṇavacanebhya iti| atra śuklādaya evābhinnarūpā guṇe tadvati ca
vartamānā gṛhyante, na tu sarvadā guṇamātravacanā rūpādayaḥ| tatra
yadyapyabhedopacārādeva śuklaḥ paṭa ityādisiddhiḥ, tathāpi paṭasya
śukla iti bhedavivakṣāyā api darśanātpakṣe matupa utpannasya
śravaṇaprasaṅgāllugvaktavya iti ||

rasādibhyaśca || 5|2|95 ||
na pūrveṇaiveti| naśabdasya kākvā prayogātsiddha evetyarthaḥ| nanvarthe
vā naśabdo draṣṭavyaḥ| anye iti| ṭhata iniṭhanau' ityādayaḥ|
kathamiti| anyanivṛtyarthe punarvacane rūpiṇītyādi na siddhyatīti
bhāvaḥ| prāyikamiti| prayogabāhulyābāhulyenāsyānyanivṛttiḥ
prayojanamityarthaḥ| tataḥ kim? ityāha-kvaciditi| kathaṃ punaḥ
prāyikatvamityāha--itikaraṇa iti| tena yatra matubantādeva lokasya
vivakṣā bhavati, tatraivānenānyanivṛttiḥ kriyate, na sarvatretyayamartho
bhavati| etacca guṇāditi gaṇāditi gaṇapāṭhamanapekṣyoktam,
tadapekṣāṃ matvā''ha-
atha veti| atra gaṇe guṇāditi paṭha|lte, tacca rasādīnāṃ sarveṣāṃ
pratyekaṃ viśeṣaṇam, na svatantram, nāpi ṭhekācaḥ' ityanena
samānādhikaraṇam| tena ye rasanendriyādigrāhyaguṇā iti ādiśabdena
cakṣurādiparigrahaḥ| teṣāmevāyaṃ pāṭha iti| tebhya
evānenānyanivṛttiḥ kriyate| rūpiṇī, rūpikaḥ śobhāyoga iti| nanu
śobhāpi puṇastathā bhāvaḥ ? satyam; guṇāditi
viśeṣaṇasāmarthyātprasiddhatarāṇāṃ rasanādīndriyagrāhyāṇāṃ guṇānāṃ
pāṭhaḥ| bhāvayoga iti| bhāvāḥuratihāsādayo nāṭa|ldharmāḥ|
bhāṣye tu ṭhurvaśī vai rūpiṇyapsarasāṃ sparśiko vāyuḥ' iti
darśanādyathābhidhānaṃ pratyayāntaramapi bhavati, tena
niyamasyāniṣṭatvātsūtramidaṃ pratyākhyātam|
ekāca iti| atra guṇāditi nāpekṣyate--svavān, khavān ||
prāṇisthādāto lajanyatarasyām || cūḍāla iti| cūḍāuśikhā, na
tvāpīḍākhyo'laṅkāraḥ| evaṃ karṇikāpi na karṇikāpi na
karṇālaṅkāraḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? tatsadṛśaḥ prāṇyaṅgaviśeṣaḥ|
prāṇyaṅgādeva hīṣyate|
śikhāvāndīpa iti| pratyudāharaṇadigiyaṃ darśitā; śikhāśabdasya
vrīhyādipāṭhāllaco'prasaṅgāt| cūḍāvānvṛkṣa iti pratyudāhāryam|
prāṇyaṅgāditi vaktavyamiti| etaccetikaraṇānuvṛterlabhyate|
cūḍālo'sīti| asītyasya ṭhtiṅṅatiṅaḥ' iti nighātaḥ,
cūḍālaśabdātsuḥ, rutvam, ṭhato roraplutādaplute' ityukāraḥ, sa
ca halāṃ sraṃsanadharmatvādanudātaḥ, pūrveṇa ṭhādguṇaḥ', ṭhekādeśa
udātenodātaḥ', tataḥ ṭheḍaḥ padāntādati' iti pūrvarūpatvamekādeśaḥ,
tasya ṭhsvarito vānudāte'padādau' iti svaritaḥ prāpnoti,
citkaraṇasāmarthyānna bhavati| yadyevam, cūḍālaḥ--āmantritādyaudātatve
śeṣanighāto na syāt, he cūḍālāamantritanidhāto na syāt,
cūḍālatvamityādau ca pratyayasvare śeṣanighātaḥ ? yadīṣyate,
vaktavyo'tra parihāraḥ; atha neṣyate, prayojanamevaitaccitsvarasya
bhavīṣyati ||

sidhmādibhyaścaḥ || 5|2|97 ||
anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇena bhatupsamuccīyata iti| anekārthatvānnipātānām,
anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇamiha samuccaye vartata ityarthaḥ| tathā ca
vārtikam--ṭhlajanyatarasyāmiti samuccayaḥ' iti| na tu pratyayo
vikalpyata iti| yathānyatrānyatarasyāṃgrahaṇaṃ vikalpārthaṃ na
tathātretyarthaḥ| kimevaṃ sati siddhaṃ bhavati ? tatrāhatasmāditi|
vikalpārthe'nyatarasyāṃgrahaṇe lacā mukte yathāprāptame syāt,
tataścākārāntebhya iniṭhanau syātām, samuccayārthe prakṛto
matubeva samuccīyata iti na doṣaḥ| kathaṃ
punarjñāyate-samuccayo'trārthaḥ, na vikalpo'rtha iti ? jñāpakāt|
yadayaṃ picchādīn, tundādīśca pṛthak paṭhati| kathaṃ kṛtvā jñāpakam
? iha ṭhtundādibhya ilacca' iti catvāraḥ pratyayā iṣyante-ilac,
iniṭhanau, matubiti; tatra yadyanyatarasyāṃgrahaṇaṃ vikalpārthaṃ
syātpicchādibhyo'pipratyayacatuṣṭayaṃ syāt| katham ? ilaco
vikalpitatvādiniṭhanau, tayorapi vikalpitatvānmatubiti; tataśca
tundādiṣveva picchādayaḥ pāṭhayāḥ, picchādiṣu vā tundādayaḥ;
pṛthakpāṭhādvijñāyate-ṭhanyatassyāṃgrahaṇena matupsamuccīyate,na
yathāprāptamabyanujñāyate' iti| evaṃ hi picchādibhyaḥ
pratyayadvayam--ilacca, matup ca; tundādibhyaścatvāra iti pṛthak
pāṭho'rthavānbhavati| nanu ca
tundādibhyo'nakārāntebhyo'pīniṭhanāviṣyate,
picchādibhyastvakārāntebhya eva; tatra yadi tundādiṣu picchādayaḥ
paṭha|leran, tadā picchādibhyo'pyanakārāntebhya iniṭhanau syātām ?
atha picchādiṣu tundādayaḥ paṭha|leran, tadā
tundādibhyo'pyākāranteyya iniṭhau na syātām ? catarhi
kānicidakārāntāni picchādiṣu paṭhati, kāni citundādiṣu,
tadyathoktasyārthasya jñāpakaṃ bhaviṣyati| tathā ṭhkeśādvo'nyatarasyām'
iti na vaktavyam; prakṛtānyatarasyāṃgrahaṇānuvatyā inṭhanmatupāṃ
siddhatvāt| tadiniṭhanoḥka prāptyarthaṃ kriyamāṇaṃ
pūrvasyānyatarasyāṃgrahaṇasya samuccayārthatvaṃ jñāpayati|
pārṣṇidhamanyordīrdhaśceti| pārṣṇīlaḥ, dhamanīlaḥ|
vātadantabalalalāṭānāmūṅ ceti| vātādibhyo laj bhavati, tasya ca
laca ūḍāgamo bhavati--vātūlaḥ, dantūlaḥ, balūlaḥ, lalāṭūalaḥ|
jaṭāghaṭākalāḥ kṣepa iti| etai śabdāḥ kṣepe gamyamāne
lacamutpādayanti--jaṭāla ityādi| kṣepa iti kim ? jaṭāvāṃstāpasaḥ|
kṣudrajantūpatāpayośceti| cudrajanturānakulāt, upatāpaḥurogaḥ|
vipādikāla iti| ṭhpādasphoṭo vipādikā'|
sidhma-gaḍuśabdayoranupatāpārthaḥ pāṭhaḥ ||

vatsāṃsābhyāṃ kāmabale || 5|2|98 ||
kāmavati balavati ceti| matvantanirddeśena
kāmabalaśabdayorarśāadyacpratyayāntatāṃ darśayati|
nanu ca vatsāṃsaśabdau vayoviśeṣe prāṇyaṅgaviśeṣe ca rūḍhau, na
kāmabalayo; tatkathaṃ tābhyāṃ lajantābhyāṃ kāmavān balavāṃścocyate
? ityata āha--vṛttiviṣaya iti| kuta etad jñāyate ? ityāha-na hyatreti|
vākye yo'nayoḥ prāsiddho'rthaḥ sa vṛtau nāstītyartha| yastvasti taṃ
darśayatadi--vatsala iti snehavānupyata iti| snehaḥurāgaḥ, kāmaḥ|
sarvatraivātra prakaraṇe matupsamuccīyata ityatrāpi matupā
bhavitavyamiti śaṅkāmapanayati--na ceti| anenaiva hetunā
vākyamapi na bhavati| atra vatsāṃsabdau dvau, asyāsminniti ca
pratyayarthāvapi dvāveva tathāpi yathāsaṃkhyaṃ na bhavati, katham ?
ajādyadantaṃ laghvakṣaraṃ pūrvaṃ nipatatītyaṃsabalaśabdayoḥ pūrvanipāte
prāpte paranipātalakṣaṇavyabhicāracihnāt| evaṃ sarvatraivātra prakaraṇe
draṣṭavyam ||

lomādipāmādipicchādibhyaḥ śanelacaḥ || 5|2|100 ||
aṅga kalyāṇa iti| ṭhaṅga' ityetat kalyāṇaviśiṣṭe'rthe vartamānaṃ
pratyayamutpādayati--kalyāṇānyaṅgānyasya aṅganā, striyā
evābhidhānam| kalyāṇa iti kim ? aṅgavatī| śākīpalālīdadravāṃ
hrasvatvaṃ ceti| śākyādīnāṃ napratyayo bhavati hrasvatvaṃ ca-śākinam,
palālinam| mahacchākaṃ śākī, nānājātīya ekasamāhāro vā|
palālakṣodaḥupalālī, bhinnāni vā śalikodravādipalalāni|
ṭhdaridrāteryālopaśca' iti daridrāterūkāraḥ pratyayo bhavati,
rikārākārayośca lopaḥ| dadrūḥutvagrogaviśeṣaḥ, sa yasyāsti sa
dadruṇaḥ| viṣvagiti| viṣvakśabdānnapratyayo bhavati utarapadalopaśca, sa
cākṛtasanderakṛtasandhikāryasya, akṛtayaṇādeśasyetyarthaḥ| viṣu
nānā añcantīti viṣvañci, tānyasya santīti viṣuṇaḥu
viṣuṣuvadākhyaḥ kālaḥ, tasya hi nānāgatīni dināni santi,
tadāśrayatvāddivasāntarāṇāṃ nyūnādhikabhāvasya| tathā mṛtyuḥ, vayuḥ,
anavasthitaprakṛtirmanuṣyādiśca viṣuṇaḥ, tatra vṛttiviṣaye
gamanakriyāntarbhāvādviṣvaggamanamasyāskatītyevaṃ
vākyaderabhidānamicchanti| yadi tu kṛte yaṇādeśe utarapadalopaḥ
syād, vali lope sati viṣṇa iti prāpnoti| lakṣmyā acceti|
lakṣmīśabdānnapratyayo bhavati akaaraścāntādeśaḥ, lakṣāmīrasyāsti
lakṣmaṇaḥ| jaṭāghaṭākalāḥ kṣepa iti| jaṭādayaḥ kṣepe gamyamāne
ilacamutpādayanti--jaṭilaḥ, ghaṭilaḥ, kalilaḥ| kṣepādanyatra jaṭāvān
|| 

prajñāśraddhārcāvṛttibhyo ṇaḥ || 5|2|101 ||
sūtre vṛttiśabdo vārtike
darśanātprakṣiptaḥ---ṭhvṛttirvicchedapratividānāt' iti|
prajñāgrahaṇaṃ kimartham? prājña ityetadrūpaṃ yathā syāt| ṭhprajñādibhyaśca'
ityaṇi kute siddhametat, prajña eva prājñaḥ, yasya hi prajñā'sti sa
prajānāti ? satyam; striyāṃ tvaṇi ṅīb bhavati--prājñī, asmistu ṇe
ṭāveva bhavati--prājñā| iha tu guṇabhūtayā kriyayā vyākaraṇādināṃ
sambandhe ṇāṇorubhayorapi vyākaraṇam--prājñaiti bhavati,
yathā--kṛtapūrvī kaṭamiti taddhitaprayoge hi ṣaṣṭhī na bhavatītyuktam
||

tapassahasrābhyāṃ vinīnī || 5|2|102 ||
vinīnyorikāraḥ--nakārasyetsaṃjñā mā bhūditi| kecitu
vinīnāvitīkārākārau paṭhanti, nakārāntapāṭhe tvitsaṃjñā
prāpnoti| pratyayārthayostvityādi| yathā tvaniṣyamāṇamapi
yathāsaṃkhyaṃ na bhavati tathā pūrvamevoktam| asantatvādityādi| tapaḥ
śabdād ṭhasmāyāmedhā' ityādinā vinipratyaye siddhe sahasraśabdādapi
ṭhata iniṭhanau' itīnipratyaye siddhe, yatpunaridaṃ vidhānaṃ
tadvakṣyamāṇenāṇā bādhā mā bhūdityevamartham| aṇeti| hetau
tṛtīyā| kartari tu kṛdyogalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhī na prāpnoti, ubhayaprāptau
karmaṇyeveti niyamāt tṛtīyā bhaviṣyati, vinīnyorbādhā mā
bhūditi karmaṇo'pi gamyamānatvāt, yathā-ṭh yenādarśanamicchati' iti
? naitadasti, akākārayoḥ prayoge niyamasya pratiṣedhāt,
tasmāddhetāveva tṛtīyā| ghañnto vā bādhaśabdaḥ paṭhanīyaḥ|
sahasraśabdādaṭṭhanapi bādhyata iti| bādhā tu ṭhana inaṇoḥ
pratipadavidhānāt ||

aṇ ca || 5|2|103 ||
aṇprakaraṇe ityādi| prakaraṇam prastāvaḥ, kāṇḍaṃ vā|
jyotsnātamisretyādisūtre paṭhitānāṃ grahaṇam| jyautsnaḥ pakṣa iti|
sa punaḥ pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ tatra hi pañcadaśasvapi tithiṣu jyotsnā
bhavatīti kṛtsnaḥ pakṣo jyotsnayā vyāpyate| etena tāmisro
vyākhyātaḥ, tamaḥsamūhastāmisram, matvarthīyo raḥ| tatra hyavayavabhūtāni
tamāṃsi vidyante tadhasminnasti sa tāmisro'paraḥ pakṣaḥ|
tamisrārātriryasminvidyata iti vā tāmisraḥ, narakaviśeṣasyaiṣā saṃjñā|
kuṇkaḍalārhaḥ kauṇkaḍalaḥ| tatra yathākathañcinmatvarthīya upapādyaḥ|
yastu saṃsaktakuṇkaḍalaḥ sa kuṇḍalī bhavati| ayaṃ ca niyama
itikaraṇānuvṛterla bhyate ||

sikatārśarkarābhyāṃ ca || 5|2|104 ||
śārkaraṃ madhviti| śarkarā mādhuryam, na tu guḍaḥ, madhuni
tasyābhāvāt|
adeśa ihodāharaṇamiti| deśe viseṣasya vakṣyamāṇatvāt ||

deśe lubilacau ca || 5|2|105 ||
matup ceti| anyatarasyāgrahaṇena matupaḥ sarvatra samuccayāt|
sikatā deśa iti| lupi yuktavadbhāvaḥ|
deśe iti kimiti|| etena yogavibhāgo'pi paryanuyukta eva bhavati,
tena ṭhsikatāśarkarābhyāṃ lubilacau ca' ityeva kasmānna kṛtamityarthaḥ
||

danta unnata urac || 5|2|106 || 
dantaśabdādunnatopādhikāditi | sūtre tu pañcamyarthe prathamā, saptamī
vā| dantā unnatā asya dantura iti| ṭhhimaśilāśarkarādanturāṇi'
ityādayo lakṣaṇāprayogāḥ ||

ūṣasuṣimuṣkamadho raḥ || 5|2|107 ||
samāhāradvandve sautraḥ pulliṅga nirdeśaḥ| suṣimadhubhyāṃ matupi
prāparte itarābhyāminiṭhanośca ro vidhīyate| ūṣāḥuhariṇapāṃsavaḥ,
suṣiḥucchidram, muṣkauuaṇkaḍau| madhūmādhuryākhyo rasaviśeṣaḥ, na
mākṣikaṃ mādhvīkaṃ vā; anabhidhānāt| evaṃ ca madhvidaṃ madhuramiti
madhunyapi prayogopapatiḥ| iha ca na bhavati--madhvasmin ghaṭo vidyata
iti| 

raprakaraṇa iti| prakaraṇamuprastāvaḥ| kaṇṭhavivaraṃ mahaditi| gardabhe
vyutpattiṃ darśayati| taikṣaṇye tvavyutpannaḥ kharaśabdaḥ| mukharaḥuvācāla;
tasya hi sarvasminvaktavye mukhamasti; vaktavyāvaktavyavivekābhāvāt|
mukhamuvāgindriyam| hastihanuḥ kuñjaśabdenocyata iti|
vṛttiviṣaye| etacca sambhavannavayavārthaḥ kimiti tyajyata
ityabhiprāyeṇoktam| jātiśabdastu kuñjaraśabdo hastiśabdavat|
nagaramiti| nagāḥuvṛkṣāḥ, parvatāśca| ayamapi jātiśabda eva, tathā
canagarī, jātilakṣaṇo ṅīṣ bhavati| nagaśabdo'yamaśmādiṣu paṭha|lte
iti vuñcchaṇādiśūtreṇāsya siddhatvāt, tasmādro na vaktavyaḥ|
pāṇḍuramiti| pāṇḍuḥuśuklo varṇaḥ, tadvatpāṇḍuraḥ|
pāṇkaḍaraśabdastvavyutpanna eva guṇamātre guṇini ca vartate || 

dyaudrubhyāṃ maḥ || 5|2|108 ||
dyauśabdo'pyutpannaṃ prātipadikamukārāntam| rūḍhiṣu ca matubna
vikalpyate iti| tadarthasya matupābhidhātumaśakyatvāt ||

keśādvo'nyatarasyām || 5|2|109 ||
matupsamuccayārthaṃ tadityuktamiti| etacca ṭhsidhmādibhyaśca' ityatraiva
vyākhyātam|
vaprakaraṇa iti| prakaraṇamuprastāvaḥ| maṇivaḥunāgaviśeṣaḥ|
hiraṇyavaḥunidhiviseṣaḥ, kuñjaraviśeṣa ityanye| vimbāvaḥ, kurarāva
iti| ṭhanyeṣāmapi dṛśthate' iti dīrghaḥ| rājīva iti|
ṭhkṛdikārādaktinaḥ' iti ṅīṣantātpratyayaḥ| 
arṇava iti| arṇamūdakam, ṭharterasunnuṭ ca'| cchandasīvanipau ceti|
cakārādvalaśca, anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇānuvṛtestu matup, tadāha---
vaśca matup ceti| rathīriti| ratho'syāstītyarthaḥ|
sumaṅgalīriti| suṣṭhuamaṅgalam, ṭhsuḥ pūjāyām' iti
prādisamāsaḥ, tato'nena matvarthīya īkāraḥ, lāghavādbahuvrīhiṇā
bhavitavyamiti nyāyaśchāndasatvādāśritaḥ|
maghavānamiti| maghaṃ dhanaṃ tadasyāstīti vanip| matupi tu
maghavacchabdaḥ, kimarthaṃ tarhi ṭhmaghavā bahulam' iti ? tatraiva vakṣyāmaḥ|
udvā ceti| ucchabdādudgatābhidhāyinā vapratyaye ṭāp| udvatīti|
matupaḥ ṭhjhayaḥ' iti vatvam, ṅīp| 
medhārathābhyāmiti| idamapi chandoviṣayam ||

gāṇḍa|ljāt saṃjñāyām || 5|2|110 || gāṇḍīvaṃ dhanuriti| arjunasya|
ajagavaṃ dhanuriti| pinākametat| ubhayathā sūtraṃ praṇītamiti|
tantranyāyāśrayeṇa| prayogaścobhayathāpi bhavati--ṭhgāṇḍīvī
kanakaśilānibhaṃ bhujābhyām' ṭhadhirohati gāṇḍivaṃ maheṣau' iti ca|
saṃjñāgrahaṇasyaiva prapañcaḥ ||

rajaḥ kṛṣyāsutipariṣado valac || 5|2|112 ||
āsutīvala iti| ṭhṣuñ abhiṣave', ktin, āsutiḥuabhiṣavaḥ|
pariṣadūla iti| paritaḥ sīdantīti pariṣat, ṭhsatsūdviṣa' ityādinā
kvip, ṭhsadiraprateḥ' iti ṣatvam| parṣacchabdamanye paṭhanti,
ṭhśadibhaso'diḥ' bāhulakātpṛṣerapi bhavati--ṭhparṣadeṣā daśāvarā'
iti hi dṛśyate; ṭhpārṣadakṛtireṣā tatra bhavatām' ṭhsarvavedapārṣadaṃ
hīdaṃ śāstram' iti ca bhāṣye| ṭhparṣadvalāmahābrahmaurāgataiḥ
kaṭhakāśramāt' iti ca bhaṭṭikāvye| pariṣacchabdastu prasiddha
eva--ṭhsahasraśaḥ sametānāṃ pariṣatvaṃ na vidyate' iti manuḥ| atra ca sūtre
ubhayorapi ubhayathā sūtrapraṇayanāt|
bhrātṛvala iti | ṭhvalaḥ' ityatrāṇgrahaṇānuvaterdīrghābhāvaḥ| putravalaḥ,
utsāhavala ityatra tvasaṃjñayāṃ dīrghābhāvaḥ| saṃjñāyāṃ tu dīrghatvam,
ṭhvalaḥ' ityatra hi ṭhvanagiryoḥ saṃjñāyām' ityataḥ ṭhsajñāyām'
ityanuvartate || 

dantaśikhātsaṃjñāyām || 5|2|113 ||
dantāvalaḥugajaḥ, ṭhdantī dantāvalo hastī' ityamarasiṃhaḥ| śikhāvalaṃ
nagaramiti| nanu deśe ṭhśikhāyā valac' iti cāturarthikenaiva
siddham, taccāvaśyaṃ kartavyam--nirvṛtādyartham ? satyam; ihāpi
sikhāgrahaṇamadeśārthamavaśyaṃ kartavyam, ihāpi yathā
syāt--śikhāvālā sthūpeti| yadyevaṃvidhā saṃjñā bhavati, tatra deśe
matvarthe paratvādanenaiva lajyukta iti matvā śikāvalaṃ
nagaramityudāhṛtam ||

jyotsnātamisrāśrṛṅgiṇorjasvinnūrjasvalagominmalinamalīsāḥ ||
5|2|114 ||
jyotsnā candraprabheti| tatrāvayavabhūtaṃ jyotirastīti
matvarthopapatiḥ| etena tamaḥ samūhe tamisraśabdo vyākhyātaḥ|
nighaṇṭuaṣu tu tamaḥ paryāyastamisraśabdaḥ paṭhitaḥ, tatra
samūhasamūhinorabhedopacāraḥ| strītvamatantramiti| vyākhyānamatra
śaraṇam| śrṛṅgādinacpratyaya iti| yadyapi sūtre cakāro'nucyāritaḥ,
tathāpyantodātasyoccāraṇādevaṃ kalpyate| urjo'sugāgama iti|
urjasvatīḥ, payasvatīḥ| ūrjasvat, payasvadityasunantānmatup
dṛśyate, iha tvanāśrayaṇe heturmagyaḥ| sūtre ūrjasvingominniti
nāntatvābhivyaktaye nalopo na kṛtaḥ ||

ata iniṭhanau || 5|2|115 ||
akārāntāditi| svarūpagrahaṇaṃ tu na bhavati, acchabdāntātkurvat,
pacadityevamāderiti ṭhrasādibhyaḥ' punarvacanāt| taddhyanena
prāptayoriniṭhanorbādhanārthamityuktam|
tapakaraṇaṃ kimiti| vrīhāyādiṣu mālādīnāmākārāntānāṃ pāṭho
niyamārtho bhaviṣyatīti praśnaḥ| kimākārāntaviṣayo niyamaḥ ? uta
strīpratyayāntaviṣayaḥ ? āhosvidābantaviṣayaḥ ? iti
sandehasambhavādaghaśyaṃ kartavyaṃ taparakaraṇamityutare'bhiprāyaḥ|
ekākṣarāditi| rasādibhyaḥ punarvacanamanyanivṛtyarthamityuktam, tatra
ca ṭhekācaḥ' iti paṭhītam, tenaitatsiddham| kāryīti|
kāryaśabdātkṛdantāt pratyayaḥ| tandulīti| jāteḥ ||

vrīhyādibhyaśca || 5|2|116 ||
śikhādibhya iti| śikhādayo'traiva vakṣyante|
ikanyavakhadādiṣviti| viṣayasaptamyeṣā| ete'pyatraiva pakṣayante|
ikanniti| ṭhannityarthaḥ| pūrvācāryaprakriyāpekṣastvikanniti nirddeśaḥ
ślokapūraṇārthaḥ| pariśiṣṭebhya ubhayamiti| etacca
sarvamitikaraṇānuvṛterlabhyate|
evaṃ tarhīti| viparyayastu na bhavati--tatra svarūpagrahaṇam,
ihārthagrahaṇāmiti; asañjātavirodhitvenānaiva svarūpagrahaṇasya
yuktatvāt ||
śīrṣānnaña iti| nañaḥ paro yaḥ śīrṣaśabdastasmādiniṭhanau
bhavataḥ---aśīrṣī, aśīrṣikaḥ| na vidyate śiro yasya sa evamucyate| ṭhaci
śīrṣe' iti śirasaḥ śīrṣabhāvaḥ, vākye'pi tasyaiva bhīvino
nirddeśaḥ ||

tundadibhya ilacca || 5|2|117 ||
svāṅgādvivṛddhāditi| vivṛddhyupādhikātsvāṅgavācina
ilajādayo bhavanti, vivṛddhau karṇāvasya kaṇilaḥ, karṇī, kaṇikaḥ,
karṇavān || 

ekagopūrvāṭṭañ nityam || 5|2|118 ||
ekaśatamasyāstīti| ekaṃ ca tacchataṃ ceti ṭhpūrvakāle' ityādinā
karmadhārayaḥ| ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣād bahuvrīherdvandvācca na bhavati;
anabhidhānāt; itikaraṇānuvṛteśca|
kathamiti| ekagośabdasyāpyanakārāntatvātpraśanaḥ| samāsānte kṛta
iti| ṭhgorataddhitaluki' iti ṭaci| kathamiti| ivarṇānta eva
śakakaṭiśabdo'stīti manyamānasya praśnaḥ--anabhidhānādeva
ekaviṃśatyādibhyo na bhaviṣyati, kim ṭhata' ityasyānuvṛtyā?
tatrāha--avaśaṃ ceti| evamādyarthamiti| evamādi yatsūtraṃ
tadarśamityarthaḥ| tataḥ pare tu ye yogāḥ ṭhvātātīsārābhyām'
ityevamādayaḥ, teṣu ṭhataḥ' ityasyopayogo nāstīti|
nityagrahaṇamityādi| anyathānyatarasyāṃgrahaṇena sarvatraivānna prakaraṇe
matupsamuccayādatrāpi prasaṅgaḥ| ekena veti| yadyavaśyaṃ
samarthayitavyamiti bhāvaḥ| tatra ṭhsupsupā' iti samāsaḥ|
kathamekadaṇkaḍīti ? ṭhekadeśinaikādhikaraṇe' iti nirdeśo
jñāpayati--inirapi kvacidbhavatīti || 

śatasahasrāntācca niṣkāt || 5|2|119 ||
niṣkādityetad guṇabhūtābhyāmapi śatasahasrābhyāṃ sambadhyate, na
tadantenetyāha---tau cediti|
suvarṇāniṣkaśatamityādi| yatra niṣkaśabdaḥ pūrvapadaṃ na bhavatītyarthaḥ|
antagrahaṇaṃ kim ? ṭhniṣkācchatasahasrābhyām' ityucyamāne sandehaḥ
syāt--kiṃ pūrvapadam ?--iti ||

rūpādāhatapraśaṃsayoryap || 5|2|120 ||
rūpyo dīnāra iti| puruṣādyākāracihnitau suvarṇaparimāṇaviśeṣau
vyavahārāya kalpitau dīnārakārṣāṇau| nigātikātāḍanādineti|
tīkṣṇāgrā āyasī śalākāunigātikā, yayā puruṣādyākakāraṃ
suvarṇādau suvarṇakārā udbhāvayanti| ṭhkṛtyalyuṭo bahulam' iti
karaṇe ṇval--nihānyate'nayā nighātikā, tayā yatāḍanam,
tadādinā| ādiśabdena mudrāpratimudraṇādi gṛhyate|
kvacinnighātikātāḍanena puruṣādyākāra udbhāvyate, kvacinmudrayā
pratimudrayate dīnārādiṣu, tadāhatamityucyata iti| āhananena
niṣapāditatvāt| 
prāyeṇa kedāraśabdaḥ paṭha|lte, tasyaivaṃvidhe'rthe prasiddhirmṛgyā|
himyāḥ parvatā iti| himavān tatparyantavartinaśca bhūmni yap|
gupyāḥuguṇavantaḥ| inirapi dṛśyate--ṭhguṇyaguṇya iti na vyajīgaṇat '
||

āsmāyāmedāsrajo viniḥ || 5|2|121 ||
matup sarvatra samuccīyata eveti| pūrvaṃ nityagrahaṇena
anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇaṃ tatraiva na sambadhyate, iha tu sambadhyata evetyeva
śabdasyārthaḥ| tathā ca ṭhtasau matvarthe' ityatra payasvān yaśasvāniti
bhāṣye udāhṛtam| payasvīti| ṭhtasau matvarthe' iti bhatvājjaśtvābhāvaḥ
||

bahulaṃ cchandasi || 5|2|122 ||
aṣṭrāvīti| aśeṣṭrani aṣṭrā, daṃṣṭāparyāyo'yaṃ mantreṣu
prayujyate--ṭhaṣṭrāṃ pūṣā śithirāmudvarīvṛjat', ṭhśunamaṣṭrā
vyacaratkapardī' iti, tatrāsmādeva pāṭhāṭṭāpa| dvayobhayahṛdayāniti|
anyeṣāṃ svata eva dīrghatvāt|
hṛdayāccāluranyatarasyāmiti| anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇeneniṭhanau prāpyete,
cakārasya ṭhcuṭūa' itītsaṃjñā| evamutaratrāpi| ante tu cakāro
naivāsti|
himācceluriti| ekārādiḥ pratyayaḥ|
balādūlajiti| sidhmādiṣu matvarthe balūlavālūlayoḥ prakārāntareṇa
vyutpattirdarśitā|
parvamarudbhyāṃ tanniti| ādyaudātārtho nakāraḥ| maruto nāma rājā,
yatredaṃ kṣūyate--ṭhmarutaḥ pariveṣṭāro marutasyāvasn gṛhe' iti|
upasargasaṃjñāyāṃ tu marucchabdasyopasaṃkyānād ṭhaca upasargātaḥ' iti
tatvamanajantatve'pi bhavati| ṭhmaruta enaṃ deyāsurmarutaḥ' iti
vyutpattirdarśitā| tatra ṭhtṛtīyā karmaṇi' iti pūrvapadaprakatisvaraḥ
prāpnoti| marucchabdaḥ ṭhmṛgorutiḥ' iti utipratyayāntatvādantodātaḥ
tatra ṭhupasargāścabhivarjam' ityādyaudātatvaṃ draṣṭavyam ||

ūrṇāyā yus || 5|2|123 || 
ūrṇāyuriti|ka padatvādyasyetilopo na bhavati ||

vāco gminiḥ || 5|2|124 ||
vāggmīti| cakārasya kutvajaśtve, dvayorgakārayoḥ śravaṇaṃ bhavati|
atha minireva kasmānnocyate, tatrāpi hi kutvajaśtvayorvāggmīti
siddhyatyeva; nanu caivameko gakāraḥ syāt, na ca ṭhanaci ca' iti
dvirvacanam, ṭhdīrghādācāryāṇām' iti kapratiṣedhāt| athāpi
dvayorekasya vā śravaṇe viśeṣo nāstītyucyeta ? evamapi
ṭhyaro'nunāsike' ṭhpratyaye bhāṣāyāṃ nityavacanam' iti
nityamanunāsikaḥ prāpnoti, tathā--vāṅbhayam, tvaṅbhayamiti || 
ālajāṭacau bahubhāṣiṇi || 5|2|125 || yo hi samyagagbhāṣata iti|
bapahvapīti bhāvaḥ ||

svāminnaiśvarye || 5|2|126 ||
svaśabdādaiśvaryavācina iti| anyatrātmātmīyajñātidhānavacino'pi
svaśabdasyaitadvṛttiviṣaye aiśvaryavācitvaṃ svabhāvato bhavati, tena
dhanavānnirdhano veśitā svāmītyucyate, na tvayaṃ dhanavacanaḥ| tathā ca
dhanasya svāmītyapi bhavati; anyathā matupa āminacā bādhaprasaṅgaḥ|
anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇena matupsamuccaye'pi dhanasya śvāmativad dhanasya
svavānityapi prāpnoti| tasmādaisvaryavacanaḥ svaśabdaḥ, na
dhanādivacana iti sthitam| dhanayogādaiśvaryamityapi nāsti;
kavāgādiviṣaye'pi darśanāt--vācaspatiḥ, vācaḥ svamīti; na ca tatra
dhanatvaprasiddhirasti ||

arśāadibhyo'c || 5|2|127 ||
svāṅgāddhīnāditi| hīnamuvikalam|
hīnasvāṅgavācino'ñbhavati| khañjaḥ pādo'syāstīti khañjaḥ| kāṇaṃ
cakṣurasyāstīti kāṇaḥ| kathaṃ kuṇirhasto'syāsti kuṇiriti ?
abhedopacārāt| khañjādiṣvapi tarhi tathaiva bhaviṣyati ? idaṃ tarhi
prayojanam-bhedavivakṣāyāṃ matubmā bhūditi| atha kuṇiśabdānmatup
kasmānna bhavati ? anabhidhānāt| śañjādibhyo'pi tarhyanabhidhānādeva
matubna bhaviṣyati ? antodātārthaṃ tu| ye ādyaudātā
hīnasvāṅgavācinasteṣvantodātatvaṃ yathā syād, yadi sambhavati|
varṇāditi| varṇavācinaḥ śuklaśabdādacpratyayo
bhavati-śuklo'syāstīti śuklaḥ paṭaḥ| ṭhguṇavacanebhyo matupo
lugvaktavyaḥ' iti siddham ? antodātārthaṃ tu| ye ādyaudātā
varṇavācinasteṣu tadvatyantodātatvaṃ yathā syāt| apara
āha--guṇivacanebhyo'yaṃ tadvati pratyayo vidhīyate, tena śuklāḥ
prāsādā asminnagare śuklaṃ nagaramiti bhavatīti ||

dvandvopatāpagarhyatpraṇisthādiniḥ || 5|2|128 ||
tadviṣayebhya iti| tacchabdenopatāpo garhyaṃ ca pratyavamṛśyate, na
dvandvaḥ; tasyaiva tadviṣayatvāsambhavāt| prāṇisthārthavācibhya iti| idaṃ
tu sarveṣāṃ grahaṇam| citralalāṭikāvatīti| niyatadravyavivakṣāyāṃ
ṭhjātiraprāṇinām' ityekavadbhāvābhāvāṭṭāpaḥ śravaṇam| siddhe
pratyaya iti| ṭhata iniṭhanau' ityanena| ṭhanādibādhanārthamiti|
ādiśabdena matupo guhaṇam ||

vātātisārābhyāṃ kuk ca || 5|2|129 ||
vātātisārayorupatāpatvāditi| atisārasāhacaryādvātasyāpi
vyādhereva grahaṇam, na vāyoriti bhāvaḥ| siddhe pratyaya iti|
ināvevetyarthaḥ| roge cāyamiṣyate iti kvacitpaṭha|lte, tatrokto
hetuḥ ||

vayasi pūraṇāt || 5|2|130 ||
māsaḥ saṃvatsaro veti| prakaraṇādivaśātpañcamādiśabdasya kāle
vṛttiḥ, tataśca ṭhvayasi dyotye' iti viśeṣaṇaṃ tatropapannamiti bhāvaḥ
||

sukhādibhyaśca || 5|2|131 ||
iniḥ pratyayo niyamyate iti| pūrvasūtre inireva bhavatīti
niyamasvarūpaṃ darśitam, ihāpi tathaiva niyamaḥ| nanvevaṃ yata
evakārastato'nyatrāvadhāraṇamiti sukhādaya eva niyatā bhavanti,
tatkimucyate--ṭhpratyayo niyamyate' iti? anyanivṛttiviśiṣṭṃa
vyasthāpanagatra niyama ityadoṣaḥ|
matubbādhanārthaṃ vacanamiti| na tu ṭhanbādhanārtham; ṭhśikhādibhya
inirvācyaḥ' ityanenaiva ṭhano nivartitatvāditi bhāvaḥ ||

dharmaśīlavarṇāntācca || 5|2|132 ||
brāhmaṇavarṇiti| brāhmaṇānāṃ varṇaḥujātiḥ, tadvān brāhmaṇavarṇī brāhmaṇa eva ||

hastājjātau || 5|2|133 ||
iniḥ pratyayo niyamyate iti| matvarthasambhavamātreṇātra prakarame
niyamavācoyuktiḥ| paramārthatastu vidhirayam, katham ?
gajaśabdavajjātiśabdo'yam, nātra matvarthagandho'sti| tathā ca
vihaste'pi gaje hastīti bhavati; jātisadbhāvāt|
hastasambandhavivakṣāyāṃ ca hastinyapi matubbhavati--hastavān, hastī;
hastavānpuruṣa itivat| evamutareṣvapi yogeṣu draṣṭavyam|
hastagrahaṇaṃ copalakṣaṇārthaṃ manyate, tena dantī, viṣāṇī,
kesarītyādi siddhaṃ bhavati ||

varṇād brahmacāriṇi || 5|2|134 ||
brahmacārīti traivarṇiko'bhimata iti| yadyapi gurukulavāsini prathamāśrame
brahmacāriśabdaḥ prasiddhaḥ, tathāpīha
lakṣyānurodhātraivarṇikamātramabhimataḥ, na tvāśrama ityarthaḥ, tasya
kādācitkaṃ vrahmacaryayogaṃ darśayati| sa hīti| brahma caratīti brahmacārī,
brahmauvedaḥ| iha tu tadadhyayanārtho niyamaviśeṣo'bhimata
ityāha--niyamamiti| tatra brahmacārīti ṭhvrate' iti ṇiniḥ|
brahmacāriśabdasya mukhyārthaparityāgena traivarṇikamātraparatve
kāraṇamāha--brāhmaṇādayastrayo varṇā iti ||

puṣkarādibhyo deśe || 5|2|135 ||
arthīti| asannihito'rtho'syetyarthaḥ| kālataścāsannidhiḥ, na deśataḥ|
tatra virodhādastīti na sambaddhyate, tataścāprāpta evenirvidhīyate,
takrakauṇḍinyanyāyena ca satopādhikādinerabhāvaḥ| arthavāniti|
sannihitārtha ucyate| tadantācceti| grahaṇavatā prātipādikena
tadantavidhipratiṣedhādayamārambhaḥ| dhānyārthīti|
dhānyarupo'rtho'sannihito'stetyarthaḥ, karmadhārayādiniḥ|
nanvarthayaterṇininaitatsiddham--dhānyamarthayate dhānyārthī ? evamapi
ṇinīti pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaraḥ prāpnoti| evaṃ tarhīdaṃ
syāt--arthanamarthaḥuprārthanā, sā yasyāsti so'rthī, dhānyasyārtho
dhānyārthaḥudhānyaprārthanā, sā yasyāsti sā dhānyārthīti| evaṃ ca
kṛtvedamapi siddhaṃ bhavati--arthikaḥ, pratyarthika iti|
ṭharthāccāsannihite' iti tūcyamāne inereva vidhānāṭṭhanna syāt|
ṭhekākṣarātkṛto jāteḥ' iti pratiṣedho'nityaḥ, tena kāryī kāryika
itivad iniṭhanau bhaviṣyataḥ, matubanabhidhānānna bhaviṣyati| na ca
dhanavācino'rthaśabdātsannihitādapīniṭhanoḥ prasaṅgaḥ;
anabhidhānāt| evam ṭharthāccāsannihitātadantācca' iti na vaktavyamiti
sthitam ||

balādibhyo matubanyatarasyām || 5|2|136 ||
anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇenetyādi| pūrvavatsamuccaye tasya vṛteḥ? cakāra eva
tu na kṛtaḥ, kiṃ kurmaḥ! yadi tu vikalpārthenānena pratyayo
vilpyeta, tato matupā mukte yathāprāptaminiṭhanau dvāvapi
syātām| nanvevaṃ sati sūtrārambho'narthakaḥ syāt, vināpyanena
pratyayatrayasya siddhatvāt, tata inireva bhaviṣyati| kuto nu
khalvetad--inireva bhaviṣyati na punaṣṭhaneva syāditi ?
tasmātsamuccayaḥ ||

saṃjñāyāṃ manmābhyām || 5|2|137 ||
prathamini, dāminīti| ṭhaninasmangrahaṇānyarthavatā cānarthakena ca' iti
tadantavidhiḥ, ṭhnastaddhite' iti ṭilopaḥ ||

kaṃśaṃbhyāṃ babhayustitutayasaḥ || 5|2|138 ||
kaṃśamiti makārāntāviti| ṭhkaśabdaḥ sukhavārvāyubrahmamastakavācakaḥ'ka
ityakārāntaḥ kaśabdo yadyapi prasiddhaḥ, makārānto'pi kvacidastīti
pradarśanārtham ṭhmakārāntau' ityuktam| udakasukhayorvācakāviti| na
yathāsaṃkhyam, kiṃ tarhi ? yathāsambhavam| kamityudakasukhayorvācakam,
śamiti sukhasya| ṭhalpāctaram' iti sukhasya pūrvanipātaḥ prāptaḥ na
kṛtaḥ sūtrakāreṇaiva; tatra vyabhicaritatvāt|
udāharaṇeṣvalanusvāraparasavarṇau, tatra yakāravakārayoḥ
sānunāsikau yakāravakārau ||

ahaṃśubhayoryus || 5|2|139 ||
ahamiti śabdāntarameveti| nanu nātra kaścicchabdaḥ prakṛto yadapekṣaṃ
śabdāntaratvaṃ syāt ? satyam; ṭhtvāhau sau' ityasmadādeśo'haṃśabdaḥ
prasiddhivasādh buddhistho nirddiṣṭaprāyaḥ, tadapekṣaṃ śabdāntaratvam|
ahaṅkakāre vartate iti|
anenārthabedamāha--ṭhgarvo'bhimāno'haṅkāraḥ'| ahaṃyuḥ,
śubhaṃyuriti| pūrvavadanusvāraparasavarṇai| ṭhūrṇāyā yus' ityatra ye
ṭhcchandasi' iti nānuvartayanti teṣāmatraivorṇāgrahaṇaṃ kartavyam ||

iti kṣīharadatamiśraviracitāyāṃ padamañjaryā pañcamasyādhyāyasya
dvitīyaḥ pādaḥ 
--------------------
kāśikāvṛtti
atha pañcamādhyāye tṛtīyaḥ pādaḥ

prāgdiśovibhaktiḥ || 5|3|1 ||
vibhaktisaṃjñāste veditavyā iti| vibhaktiriti śabdaḥ saṃjñā yeṣāṃ te
tathoktāḥ| nanu vibhaktiśabdaḥ pūrvameva suptiṅaṃ saṃjñātvena
viniyuktaḥ,ka saṃjñā ca pradeśeṣu saṃjñinaṃ pratyāyayati na svarūpam,
ataḥ suptiṅameva saṃjñātvaṃ yuktam, na vibhaktiśabdasya ? satyam;
suptiṅstu saṃjñā bhavantaḥ pratyekam, samuditā vā bhaveyuḥ; na
tāvatpratyekam, anekasaṃjñākaraṇe prayojanābhāvāt; nāpi
samuditāḥ, gauravādanāvṛteśca| āvartinyo hi saṃjñā bhavanti, na ca
samudāya āvartate| apara āh--ṭhṭhyathā ṭhkinau liṭ ca' iti
liḍvadbhāvo vidhīyate, tathātrāpi vibhaktivadbhāvo vidhīyate''
iti| suptiṅaṃ tu vidhānamatra nāśaṅkanīyam;
pūrvamevavihitatvāt| tyadādividhaya iti| tyadādīnāṃ yāni
kāryāṇi tyadāditvaprayuktāni svarūpaprayuktāni vā te
tyadādividhayaḥ| upalakṣaṇaṃ caitat, dānīmo makārasya ṭhna vibhaktau
tusmāḥ' itītsaṃjñāpratiṣedho'pi prayojanam| tataḥ, yata iti|
ṭhtyadādīnāmaḥ' ityatvam| atra sakārasyānantyatvādevetsaṃjñābhāvaḥ|
kṛta iti| ṭhkuti hoḥ' iti kubhāvaḥ| kadeti kimaḥ kādeśaḥ| kvetyatra
ṭhkvāti' kaiti kvabhāvaḥ iheti| ṭhidamo haḥ,' ṭhidama iś'| atra
pratyayasvareṇaiva saddhimudātatvam| tasmādita ityevalodāharaṇaṃ
vibhaktisvarasya; anyathā ṭhliti' iti pratyayātpūrvamudātaṃ syāt| nanu
ca ṭhmadhye'pavādāḥ' iti nyāyād ṭhanudātau suppitau' ityasyaiva
vibhaktisvaro'pavādaḥ, na litsvarasya, litsvara eva tu vibhaktisvara
paratvādbādheta? naiṣa doṣaḥ; nātrākṛte litsvare vibhaktisvaraḥ
prāpnoti, kiṃ kāraṇaṇ ? ṭhantodātāt' iti vartate, tatra
nimitameva litsvaro vibhaktisvarasya| yadyapi ṭhūḍidam' ityatra
ṭhsāvekācaḥ' ityatastṛtīyādigrahaṇamanuvartate, tathāpyā
pañcamādhyāyaparisamāpteryāvānpratyayo vibhaktisaṃjñakaḥ sarvo'sau
tṛtīyādiriti tasilādayo'pi tṛtīyādigrahaṇena gṛhyanta eva|
ataḥ paramityādi| etat ṭhsamarthānāṃ prathamādvā' ityatraiva vyākhyātam|
vāvacanaṃ tvanuvartata eveti| tasya pṛthakasvaritatvāt| atha ṭhsupaḥ,
vibhaktiśca' ityatraiva ṭhprāgdiśaśca' ityucyeta? naivaṃ śakyam; evaṃ
hyucyamāne na jñāyate--kuta ārabhya prāgdiśīyā ? iti| bahavaśca
dikśabdāḥ--digādibhyo yat'ka ityevamādayaḥ, tataścāvadhirapi na
niścitaḥ syāt| ṭhkiṃsarvanāmabahubyaḥ' ityādeśca kāryasya
viṣayaniyamārthaṃ punariha ṭhprāgdiśaḥ' iti vācyameva syāt| yadi
punarihaiva ṭhsuptiṅai ca' ityucyeta? evamapi ṭhtiṅstrīṇitrīṇi'
ityatra tiṅgrahaṇam supa iti ca tatra vaktvyaṃ
puruṣavacanasaṃjñārtham, tatra nāsti viśeṣaḥ ||

kiṃsarvanāmabahubhyo'dvyādibhyaḥ || adhikāro'yam, paribhāṣā veti
darśayati| pratyayo veditavya iti| dvābhyām, dvayorityatra
tasiltralau na bhavataḥ|
prakṛtiparisaṃkhyānamuprakṛtiparigaṇanam| vaiyākaraṇapāśa iti|
astātyādayo grahaṇavadbhyo vidhīyanta iti prakṛtiparisaṃkhyānasya
tatrāsambhavādvyavahito'pi pāśap pratyudāhṛtaḥ|
dvyādiparyudāsāditi| yadi punarayaṃ dvyādibhyaḥ prāk kiṃ
paṭha|leta, naivaṃ sakyam; ekaśeṣe hi doṣaḥ syāt, tyadādīnāṃ
yadyatparaṃ tatcciṣyatetvaṃ ca kaśca kau, bhavāṃśca kaśca kau|
bahugrahaṇe saṃkhyāgrahaṇamiti| kathamiha sarvanāmasaṃjñayā saṃjñino
nirddiśyante ? taiḥ sāhacaryād bahuśabdasyāpi saṃjñino grahaṇam,
yasya ṭhbahugaṇavatuḍatisaṃkyā' iti saṃkhyāsaṃjñā vihitā, na ca tatra
vaipulyavācino grahaṇamiti atrāpi tasya grahaṇābhāvaḥ ||

idama iś || 5|3|3 ||
śakāraḥ sarvādeśārtha iti| anyathā viśeṣavihitatvātyadādyatvaṃ
bādhitvā ṭhalo'ntyasya' iti makārasyetve halilope ca-etaḥ,
ehetyaniṣṭṃa rūpaṃ syāt ||

etetau rathoḥ || 5|3|4 ||
iśo'pavāda iti| bhāve ghañ, iśo bādhanametābhyāṃ kriyata ityarthaḥ|
yogāpekṣaṃ tvekavacanam, ayaṃ yoga iso'pavāda ityarthaḥ|
ādeśābhyāṃ vā pratyekamabhisambandhādekavavanam, yathā ṭhbhūśādibhyo
bhuvyacveḥ' iti| iśo'pavādāviti vā paṭhitavyam| rephe'kāra
uccāraṇārtha iti| akāravato rephasya prāgdiśīyasyābhāvāt ||

etado'śu || 5|3|5 ||
śakāraḥ sarvādeśārtha iti| anyathā ṭhalo'ntyasya' ityantyasya syāt|
nanu cāntyasya tyadādyatvenaiva siddhamatvam, kṛte tarhi
tasminnakārasyākāraḥ prāpnoti, akārasya akāravacane
prayojanābhāvatsarvādeśo bhaviṣyati ? astyanyadakārasyāpyakāravacane
prayojanam, kim ? yo'nyo vidhiḥ prāpnoti sa mā bhūditi| kaḥ
punarasau ? ṭhliti' iti svaraḥ| yathā--ṭhmo rāji samaḥ kvau' iti
makārasya makāravacanamanusvārabādhanārtham|
yogavibhāga iti| aśo bādhanārthaḥ| thamupratyayaḥ punariti| anyathā ya
evāsāvaviseṣavihitasthākārādiḥ ṭhprakāravacane thāl' iti tatraiva
syāt| sa tarhyupasaṃkhyeyaḥ ? netyāha, idamā thakarādiṃ
viśeṣayiṣyāmaḥ-- idamo yasthakārādiśtatreti, sa ca thamureva|
tataścāsmādeva jñāpakātthamurbaviṣyati, tena ca thālbādhyate| 
bhāṣye tu ṭhetado'n' iti nakārānta ādeśa iti sthitam| sa
cānekāltvātsarvādeśaḥ, tataḥ sthānivadbhāvātprātipadikatve sati
nalopaḥ---ataḥ, atra|| 

sarvasya so'nyatarasyāṃ di || 5|3|6 ||
ṭhdi' iti dakāradiyaṃ saptamī, tatra ṭhyasmin vidhiḥ' iti
tadādergrahaṇaṃ vijñāyata ityāha--dakārādau pratyaye parata iti|
sarvadā brāhmaṇīti| kimarthaṃ strīliṅgopanyāsaḥ ? yo hi
manyate--dīti dāśabdādiyaṃ saptamī na tu dakārāt, tatra ktvo
lyap, ṭhhalaḥ' ṭhśnaḥ' ityādivadāto lopa iti, taṃ prati dāśabdaḥ
pratyudāhṛtaḥ| evamapi lākṣaṇikatvādatra dāśabdasya na bhaviṣyati ? evaṃ
vijantametad draṣṭavyam, evaṃ ca kṛtvā puṃlliṅgamapyudāharaṇaṃ
bhavatyeva ||

pañcamyāstasil || 5|3|7 ||
tasilpratyayo bhavatīti| yadi punaḥ ṭhpañcamyāḥ' ṭhsaptamyāḥ' iti
ṣaṣṭha|laśrayeṇa pañcamyādīnāṃ tasilādaya ādeśā vijñāyeran,
subluksvaraguṇadīrghatvaitvautvasmāyādividhipratiṣedhaḥ|
subluk--ṭhavyayātyap', tatastyaḥ, tatratyaḥ, ṭhsupo
dhātuprātipadikayoḥ' iti tasitralorluk prāpnoti| svaraḥ---tadā,
yadā, ṭhanudātau suppitau' ityanudātatvaṃ prāpnoti| guṇaḥ--kutaḥ,
ṭhgheṅiti' iti guṇaḥ prāpnoti| dīrghatvam--tarhi, ṭhato dīrgo
yañi', ṭhsupi ca' iti dīrghatvaṃ prāpnoti| etvam---tarhi, ṭhato
dīrgho yañi',ṭhsupi ca' iti dīrghatvaṃ prāpnoti| etvam--teṣu, tatra,
ṭhbahuvacane jhalyet' prāpnoti| autvam-kasmin, kutra, ṭhaut'
ṭhacca gheḥ' ityautvaṃ prāpnoti| smāyāditasmāt, tasmin, tatra,
ṭhṅasiḍyoḥ smātsminau' iti smātsminau prāpnutaḥ| tasmāt
ṭhpañcamyāḥ saptamyā iti pañcamī, tasilādayaśca pratyayāḥ' iti yuktam|
ata eva ṭhitarābhyaḥ' iti pañcamīnirddeśaḥ; itarathā ṭhitarāsām' iti
vaktavyaṃ syāt| yadi tarhi tasilādayaḥ pratyayāḥ, nādeśāḥ, ṭhtaseśca'
iti tasyaterdhātorapi doṣaḥ; ṭhpratiyoge pañcamyāstasiḥ',
ṭhapādāne cāhīyaruhoḥ' ityatraapyadeśatvātpañcamyādeśasya
tasestasilādeśavidānāt ? pratyayapakṣe'pi na doṣaḥ;
taseritīkāro vivakṣitaḥ, tena dhātorna bhaviṣyati ||

taseśca || 5|3|8 ||
tasya taseriti| paratvātkṛtasya tasilo'vakāśaḥ--kuto'vahīyate,
kuto'varohatīti, tasestu gramata āgacchatītyādiḥ; kuta
āgacchatītyādāvubhayaprasaṅge paratvātasakirbhavati, tasyānena
tasilādesaḥ| tasestasilvacanaṃ svarārthamiti| litkaraṇasyoktaṃ
prayojanam| vibhaktyarthaṃ ceti| vibhaktisaṃjñārthaṃ cetyarthaḥ| anyathā
paratvātasau kṛte tasyāprāgdiśīyatvādvibhaktisaṃjñāyā
abhāvātyadādyatvaṃ na syāditi rūpameva na siddhyet ||

paryabhibhyāṃ ca || 5|3|9 ||
sarvobhayārthe vartamānābhyāmiti| atra cābhidhānasvābhāvyaṃ hetuḥ,
teneha na bhavati-pariṣiñcati, abhiyātīti; uparyarthe pariḥ,
ābhimukhye'bhiḥ| iha tvodanaṃ pariṣiñcatīti sarvatobhāve'pi
vāvacanānuvṛteḥ pakṣe tasilabhāvaḥ| sarvataḥ, ubhayata iti|
saptamyantābhyāmādyāditvātasiḥ ||

kimo't || 5|3|12 ||
takārasya ṭhna vibhaktau tusmāḥ' itītsaṃjñāpratiṣedho na bhavati;
anityatvāt| anityatvaṃ tu ṭhidamasthamuḥ' iti thama
ukārānmakārasyetsaṃjñāparihāṇārthājjñāyate| dānīmastu makārasya
bhavatyeva pratiṣedhaḥ| anityatvaṃ hi jñāpyate, na
punastaddhiteṣvasyābhāvaḥ|
utarasūtrāditi| ṭhkimo'dvā' iti sūtraṃ paṭhitavyam| ṭhha ca cchandasi'
ityatra cakāreṇa trataloḥ samuccayādiṣṭasiddhiriti teṣāṃ bhāvaḥ|
bhāgavṛttikārastu bhāṣāyāmetannecchati ||

itarābhyo'pi dṛśyante || 5|3|14 || 
pañcamīsaptamyapekṣamitaratvamiti| tayoranantaranirddiṣṭatvāt|
prāyikavidhyarthamiti| prāyiko'yaṃ vidhiryathā
syādityevamarthamityarthaḥ| tena kiṃ siddhaṃ bhavati ? ityāha-teneti| sa,
bhavān tato bhavānityādi| ayaṃ bhavāniha bhavānityādi
hasyodāharaṇam, ko bavān, kva bhavānityādi ataḥ|
dīrgāyuḥpramṛtiṣviti| ṭhnityaṃ samāse' iti satvaṃ na bhavati;
utarapadasthatvāt| ṭhisusoḥ sāmarthye iti vikalpo'pi na bhavati;
vyapekṣāyāstatrāśrayaṇāt|

sarvaikānyakiṃyatadaḥ kāle dā || 5|3|15 ||
saptamyā iti vartata iti| svaritatvāt| na tvitarābhya iti|
viparyayāt ||

idamo rhil || 5|3|16 ||
lakāraḥ svarārtha iti| yathā hīta ityatra ṭhūḍidam' ityādinā svaro
bhavati, tatheha na bhavati; litvasyācarītārthatvāt| tasilastu
litvalamidamo'nyatra caritārtham ||

adhunā || 5|3|17 ||
idamo'śū bhāvo dhunā ca pratyaya iti| tatra ṭhūḍidam' ityādinā
vibhaktisvaraḥ, sa ca ṭhādeḥ parasya'ka ityāderbhavati| bhāṣye
tvadhunāpratyaya āśritaḥ, tatredama iśo yasyetilopaḥ, nipātanācca
madhyodātatvam ||

tado dā ca || 5|3|19 ||
dāvacanamiti| apara āha--ṭhadāpratyayo'yaṃ na dāpratyayaḥ' iti,
tatrādyaudātatvaṃ pakṣe bhavati ||

tayordārhilau cacchandasi || 5|3|20 ||
tayoriti prātipadikanirddeśaḥ, vyatyayena pañcamyāḥ sthāne ṣaṣṭhī
||

sadyaḥ parutparāryaiṣamaḥ paredyavyadya
pūrvedyauranyedyauranyataredyauritaredyauraparedyauradharedyaurubhayedyaurutaredyauḥ ||
5|3|21 ||
ahanyabhidheya iti| saptamyantasyāhanśabdasyārtha ityarthaḥ|
taddarśayati--samāne'hni sadya iti| evaṃ saṃvatsare'bhidheya ityādiṣvapi
draṣṭavyam |
ubhayorahnorubhayedyauriti pāṭhaḥ| prāyeṇa tu ubhayasminnahanīti
paṭha|lte, tatrobhe ahanī avayavau yasya samudāyasya
tadahardvayamubhayamaharityuktam ||

prakāravacane thāl || 5|3|23 ||
sāmānyasya bhedako viśeṣaḥ prakāra iti| yathā brāhmaṇasāmānyasya
māṭharādayaḥ| anenaitaddarśayati--yadyapi sādṛśyamapi prakāraḥ, yathā
ṭhprakāre guṇavacanasya' ityatra vakṣyati--ṭhprakāro bhedaḥ sādṛśyaṃ ca,
tadiha sādṛsyaṃ prakāro gṛhyae' iti; tathāpi neha sādṛsyaṃ gṛhyate,
anabhidhānāditi| tena prakāreṇa tatheti| prathamāntātu na bhavati--sa
prakārastatheti; anabhidhānādeveti bhāvaḥ|
kiṃsarvanāmabahubhyo viśe,vihiṃtena thālā sāmānyavihitasya
jātīyaro bādhaprasaṅga ityāśaṅkyā''ha--jātīyaro'pīti| satyaṃ
jātīyaro'pīdṛśameva lakṣṇaṃ ṭhprakāravacane jītīyar' iti, kathaṃ
tarhyabādha? ata āha--sa tviti| arthabhedād bheda ityarthaḥ| evaṃ ca kṛtvā
prakāramātre thālaṃ vidhāya tadantātprakāravati jātīyaraṃ
prayuñjate--tathājātīyaḥ, yathājātīya iti ||

kimaśca || 5|3|25 ||
yogavibhāgā utaratra kima evānuvṛttiryathā syādidamo mā bhūditi||

dikśabdebhyaḥ || 5|3|27 ||
saptamīpañcamīprathamābhyo digdeśakāleṣvastātiḥ || diśāṃ śabdāḥ
dikśabdāḥ, ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| diśāṃ ye vācakāste divaśabdā iti| diśāṃ
ye vācakatvena dṛṣṭāḥ, ta iha dikśabdā vivakṣitā iti, na tu
diśamabhidadhānā evetyarthaḥ| tebhya iti| yadyapi pūrvādiśabdā diśi
vartamānāṣṭābantāḥ, deśakālayostu prakṛtyantā iti rūpabhedaḥ,
tathāpi ṭāpaḥ svārthikatvādvācakarūpe bhedābhāvāt ta eva dikśabdā
deśakālayorvartanta iti vācoyukternāsti virodhaḥ| ye tvarthabhedaṃ
manyante, teṣāṃ sādṛśyanibandhanastebhya iti vyapadeśaḥ| kathaṃ
punarddikśabdā deśakālayorvartante ? svabhāvākat| pūrvādayo hi
diśāmiva deśakālayorapi svabhāvādeva vācakāḥ| kathaṃ tarhi triṣu
vartamānā diśaikayā vyapadiśyante-disśabdebhya iti? ko doṣaḥ;
anvayena hyayaṃ vyapadeśaḥ, na tu diśāmeva ye śabdāḥ-ityavadhāraṇena|
atha deśakālayoranyatareṇa kasmānna vyapadiśyante ?
śiṃśapācodyametat| kiṃ ca, diśāṃ nirddeśe lāghavaṃ bhavati|
dikśabdasyopalakṣaṇatvātpunardiggrahaṇam, anyathā deśakālavṛttibhya
eva syāt, na digvṛttibhyaḥ| iha saptamyādīnāṃ vibhaktīnāmarthānāṃ
digādīnāṃ ca sāmyātsaṃkhyātātudeśaḥ syāditi ?
tatrāha---yathāsaṃkhyamatra neṣyata iti| asvaritatvāt| purastād,
adhastāditi| pūrvādharaśabdayoḥ ṭhastāti' iti pura,
adh--ityetāvādeśau| aindra|laṃ diśi vasatīti| aindrīśabdo'yam
indrasaṃbandhistrīliṅgavastumātramāha, dikśabdasannidhau tu diśi
vartate iti na dikśabdaḥ| kiñca, dikśabdebhya ityetasminnasati ye
deśavācinaḥ pañcālādayaḥ, ye ca kālavācino māsādayaḥ, tebhyo'pi
prasaṅgaḥ| asmiṃstu sati dikśabdā eva ye deśakālayorvartante tebhya
eva bhavati| digdeśakāleṣviti kimiti| ṭhdikśabdebhyaḥ'
itiśabdagrahaṇāddiśi dṛṣṭaḥ śabdo dikśabda iti vyutpatyā
deśakālavṛttibhyo'pi siddhaḥ pratyayaḥ, ṭhdikśabdāñcūtarapada' iti
pañcamīvaditi matvā praśnaḥ| pūrvasmingurāviti| pūrvaśabdo'tra
digādisambandādgurau vartate, na digādiṣu ||

dakṣiṇotarābhyāmatasuc || 5|3|28 ||
kimarthamatasujucyate, na tasujevocyet, tatrāyamapyarthaḥ--
svarārthaścakāro na kartevyo bhavati, pratyayasvareṇaivaka siddham, kā
rūpasiddhiḥ ? dakṣiṇotaraśabdāvakārānetau| yadā tarhi diśi
vartamānau dābantau bhavatasyadā yasyetilopena ṭāpo nivṛttiryathā
syādityevamartho'kāraḥ, siddhā'tra ṭāpo nivṛttiḥ, katham ?
ṭhtasilādiṣvākṛtvasucaḥ' kaiti puṃvadbhāvāt| nanu ca
samānāyāmākṛtau bhāṣitapuṃskasya tena puṃvadbhāvaḥ, ākṛtyantare
caitau bhāṣitapuṃskau, katham ? diśi vartamānāḥ pūrvādayo
nimitāntaranipekṣāḥ, deśakālayostu vyavasthāpekṣāḥ| kathaṃ tarhi
diśi vartamānānāṃ sarvanāmasaṃjñā bhavati, yāvatā
vyavasthāyāmityucyate ? atrāhuḥ--yadyapi diśi ṣartamānānāṃ vyavasthā
na pravṛttinimitam, vastutastu vyavasthā vidyate iti bhavatyeva saṃjñā|
vyavasthāyāmiti hi viṣayo nirddiśyate, na tu pravṛttinimitam|
tathā cotarāḥ kurva ityatra nirūḍhatvādvyavahārasya
prayoktṛbhiranapekṣyamāṇāyā api vastuto vyavasthāyāḥ
sadbhāvātsarvanāmasaṃjñāprasaṅge'saṃjñāyāmiti pratiṣedhaḥ kṛta iti|
tadevamākṛtibhedātasilādiṣvati puṃvadbhāvo na siddhayati| evaṃ
tarhi ṭhsarvanāmno vṛttimātre puṃvadbhāvaḥ' iti puṃvadbhāvo
bhavi,yati, yathā dakṣiṇotarapūrvāṇāmityatra,
tasmānnārtho'kārakaraṇena ? ityata āha--akāro viśeṣaṇārtha iti|
ṭhṣaṣṭhī tasarthapratyena' ityucyamāne tato grāmādāgata iti tasilāpi
yoge ṣaṣṭhī syāt ? ṭhapapadavibhakteḥ kārakavibhaktirbalīyasī'| iha
tarhi tato grāmādanya ityanyādiyoge yā pañcamī, tāṃ bāyatvā ṣaṣṭhī
syāt ? ṭhniranubandhakagrahaṇe na sānubandhakasya' ityevaṃ
tasilādiyoge na bhaviṣyati| yastarhi niranubandhakaḥ ṭhpratiyoge
pañcamyāstasiḥ' ṭhtenaikadik', ṭhtasiśca', tatra mā bhūtarjunataḥ
pratyabhimanyuḥ, sudāmato vidyauditi ||

añcerluk || 5|3|30 ||
añcatyantebhya iti| kevalebhyaḥ, liṅgaviśiṣṭebhyaśca| srīpratyayo'pi
nivartata iti| evaṃ cākāralopaḥ, ṭhcau' iti dīrghatvaṃ ca nāstīti,
prāgityatra savarṇadīrghatvam, pratyagityatra yaṇādeśaḥ ||

paścāt || 5|3|32 ||
aparasya paścabhāva iti| kevalasya liṅgaviśiṣṭasya ca |
dikpūrvapadasya ceti| digvacanaḥ pūrva padaṃ yasya tathoktaḥ|
dakṣiṇapaścāditi| dakṣiṇasyā aparasyāśca diśo yadantarālamiti
ṭhdiṅnāmānyantarāle' iti bahuvrīhiḥ, dakṣiṇāparā, tasyāṃ
vasatītyātipratyayaḥ, aparasya ca paścabhāvaḥ| ardhotarapadasya ceti|
aparasya cetyeva| vināpī pūrvapadeneti| aparasya, ardhotarapadasyeti
sambandhaḥ ||

utarādharadakṣiṇādātiḥ || 5|3|34 ||
ātipratyayo bhavatīti| dakṣiṇotarābhyāmatasujapi bhavati,
adharaśabdādastātirapi; ṭhastāti ca'
ityadharaśabdasyādhādeśavidhānālliṅgāt| atra cotarādīnāṃ
saptamyādīnāṃ ca sāmye satyapi pūrvavadyathāsaṃkhyābhāvaḥ|
astādistūtarādīnāṃ na sambhavati, dakṣiṇaśabdasya kāle
vṛtyasambhavāt ||

enabanyatarasyāmadūre'pañcamyāḥ || 5|3|35 ||
adūre cetyādi| yadyapyavadhiravadhimān vā sūtre na śrūyate, tathāpi
dikśabdānāmavadhyapekṣā pravṛttirbhavati| avadhiścāvadhimantamapekṣate
iti sāmarthyādeva viśeṣo labhyate| tatra deśakālayoravadhyapekṣāyāṃ
na vivādaḥ, diśi tu vivadante|
prāgaseriti| ṭhasipuradhavaścaiṣām' ityasmāt| divaśabdamātrāditi|
tena pūrveṇa vasatītyādyapī bhavati| añcatyantātu na bhavati;
vyavasthaitavibhāṣāvijñānāt| astu vā tadantādapi, ṭhañcerluk'
ityanuvṛterlugbhaviṣyati|
pakāraḥ svarārtha iti| ṭhenapā dvitīyā' iti viśeṣaṇārthastu na bhavati|
astveneneti, ṭhatasarthapratyayena' ityanuvṛteḥ ṭhdvitīyāṭauḥsvenaḥ'
ityasyātra grahaṇaṃ na bhaviṣyati ||

dakṣiṇādāc || 5|3|36 ||
cakāro viśeṣaṇārtha iti| anyathā vākyasmaraṇayorya
ākāro'nanubandhakastenāpi yoge pañcamī syāt|
athāpyañcūtarapadenāhinā ca sāhacaryādatasarthasyākārasya grahaṇaṃ
syāt, tathāpi paścāśabda ākārānto nipātita hati tenāpi yoge
pañcamī syāt| chāndasaḥ paścāśabdaḥ, dṛṣṭānuvidhiścchandasi bhavati?
asandehārthaṃ tarhi, ṭhañcūtarapadāhiyukte' iti hyucyamāne
ākārapraśleṣo vyākhyātavyaḥ syāt| ṭhañcūtarapadāhyāyukte' iti sūtraṃ
kariṣyate, tasmākṣaiṇāsītyatra ṭhsvarito vānudāte'padādau' iti
vidhirmā bhūditi cakārasya prayojanaṃ vācyam ||

āhi ca dūre || 5|3|37 ||
cakārādācceti| anyathā dūre vivakṣite viśeṣavihita āhireva
syāt ||

utarācca || 5|3|38 ||
ājāhī prayyayau bhavata iti| yadyapyāhiranantaraḥ, tathāpi cakāreṇa
vyavahitasyāpi ācaḥ samuccaya iti bhāvaḥ ||

pūrvādharāvarāṇāmasi puradhavaścaiṣām || 5|3|39 ||
ānantaryayoge ṣaṣṭhī| asītyavibhaktiko nirddeśaḥ| eṣāmiti vacanaṃ
vispaṣṭārtham| sannidhānāddhi pūrvādaya eva stāninaḥ śakyā vijñātum
||

astāti ca || 5|3|40 ||
astātīti saptamyantam| asipratyayeneti| adharaśabdādātināpi || 

vibhāṣā'varasya || 5|3|41 ||
avityayamādeśo bhavatīti| kathaṃ punarbahuṣvādeśeṣu prasakteṣu
ayameva bhavatu? asyaivānuvṛteḥ| atha vā--avarasya yaduktaṃ tadasatātau
vibhāṣā bhavatīti vijñāsyate ||

saṃkhyāyā vidhārthe dhā || 5|3|42 ||
vidhā prakāra iti ṭhgṛhyate' iti vakṣyamāṇena sambandhaḥ|
yadyapyodanapiṇkaḍo'pi vidhāśabdenocyate, tathāpīha prakāra eva
gṛhyata ityarthaḥ| etena ekā govidhetyādau na bhavati|
etaccārthagrahaṇāllabhyate| iha hi vidhāyāmiti vaktavye yadarthagrahaṇaṃ
kṛtaṃ tasyaitatprayojanam----vidhāśabdo yatrārthe prasiddhatarastasya
grahaṇaṃ yathā syāt| yathā ca trividham, bahuvidhamityādau prakāre
prasiddho vidhāśabdaḥ, na tathaudanapiṇkaḍe| sūtre
ca--vidhāśabdasyārtho vidhārtha iti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| evaṃ vṛtāvapi| sa ca
kriyāviṣaya iti| etaccābhidhānasvabhāvāllabhyate| tadayamartha
ityāha--kriyāprakāre iti| kathaṃ tarhi navadhā dravyam, bahudhā guṇāḥ,
ekaviśatidhā bāhvṛcyam, navadhātharvāṇo veda iti| atrāpi hi sarvatra
kriyā pratīyate--upadiśyate iti, bhavatīti vā| dvidhā gacchatītyādāve
kasyā eva gamanakriyāyā avāntaraprakārabhedaḥ pratīyate| ekadhā bhuṅkte
ityatra tu prakāraikyapratipādanena tannivṛttiḥ| ekaḥ pāka ityādau tu
pākavyakterektvaṃ vivakṣitam, na
tvavāntaraprakārabhedābhāvenaikaprakāratvamiti dhāpratyayābhāvaḥ|
tadvivakṣyāṃ tu bhavatyeva--ekadhā pāka iti| pañca pākā ityādau ca
bhinnā eva pākā vivakṣitāḥ, na tvekasya prakāravatvam| tadvivakṣāyāṃ
tu tatrāpi bhavitavyameva--pañcadhā pākā iti ||

adhikaraṇavicāle ca || 5|3|43 ||
adhikaraṇaṃ dravyamityādi| jātyādīnāmādhāratvāt| vicālanaṃ
vicālaḥuanyathākaraṇam ṇijantād ṭherac'| tacceha
saṃkhyāsannidhānātsaṃkhyāntarāpādanenetyāha--tasya vicālaḥ
saṃkhyāntarāpādanamiti| ekaṃ rāśi pañcadhā kurviti| pañca
rāśīnkurvityarthaḥ| nātra prakārabhedo gamyate, natarāṃ kriyāviṣaya
iti sūtrārambhaḥ| tatra dravyasyāpi svabhāvāddhāpratyayāntenāsatvarupeṇa
pratipādanamityavyayatvam, yathā--sudāmato vidyauditi tasantasya ||

ekāddho dhyamuñanyatarasyām || 5|3|44 ||
ṭhekād' iti śabdapradhānatvātsarvanāmakāryābhāvaḥ ekadhā rāśi
kurviti| adhikaraṇavicāle udāharaṇaṃ| aikadhyaṃ bhuṅkta iti| vidhārthe|
prakaraṇādeva labdha iti| kasmin labdhe? dhāpratyayasya sthānitve| iha hi
pūrvasūtrāddhāgrahaṇamanuvartate, sa ca pūrvameva vihita iti
vidhānāsambhavāt sthānitvameva vijñāsyate|
vidhārthe vihitasyāpi yathā syāditi|
sthānyādeśābhāvo'pyetadarthamevāśritaḥ;
pratyayāntare'pyasmindoṣābhāvāt| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ vidhārthe
vihitasya tasya na syād? ata āha--anantarasyaiva hīti| ṭhanantarasya
vidhirvā bhavati pratiṣedho vā' iti bhāvaḥ ||

dvitryośca dhamuñ || 5|3|45 ||
bhatidvaidhānīti| ekaśeṣeṇa bahuvacanam| kvacit pathi dvaidhānīti
pāṭhaḥ| dhamuñantasyāliṅgasaṃkhyatve'pi tadantātsvārthe
vihitasyāpyasya svabhāvālliṅgasaṃkhyāyogaḥ, tenāvyayatvaṃ na bhavati
||

edhācca || 5|3|46 ||
yogavibhāgo yathāsaṃkhyanirāsārthaḥ ||

yāpye pāśap || 5|3|47 ||
yāpyaśabdo'kayamastyapādānasādhanaḥ--yāpitā asmād guṇā iti
yāpyaḥukutsitaḥ, asti karmasādhanaḥ-yāpayitavyo yāpyo deśāntaraṃ
prāpayitavyaḥ, śarīrādvā'panetavyaḥ, aśakyapratīkāro yāpyo vyādhiḥ|
tatrehābhidhānaśaktisvabhāvādādyasya grahaṇamityāha--yāpyaḥ kutsita ucyata
iti|
tatra kasmānna bhavatīti| vyākaraṇe pravīṇasyāpi duḥśīlatvena
kutsitatvād bhavitavyameveti bhāvaḥ| yasya guṇasyeti| guṇo
viśeṣaṇam, dravyaṃ viśeṣyam| tasya kutsāyāṃ pratyaya iti|
etaccāntaraṅgatvāllabhyate| pravṛttinimitaṃ hi pratyāsannam;
śabdavācyatvāt| dharmāntaraṃ tu tatra vastutaḥ sadapi na śabdena
spṛśyate| yatra tu pravṛttitinimitasya kutsitaṃ na sambhavati--asako
devadataka ityādau, tatra sahacaritaguṇakriyākutsāśrayaḥ pratyayo
bhavatyeva| evaṃ ca devadatapāśa ityādyapi satyabhidhāne bhavati|
ṭhkutsite' ityatraivāyaṃ na vihitaḥ; tiṅntādapi prasaṅgāt ||

pūraṇādbhāge tīyādan || 5|3|48 ||
pūraṇārthavihitatvātīyapratyaya eva pūraṇaśabdenokta
ityāha--pūraṇapratyayo yastīya iti| svarārthaṃ vacanamiti| bhāge
nitsvareṇādyadātatvaṃ yathā syāt, rūpe tu nāsti viśeṣaḥ|
pūraṇagrahaṇamutarārthamiti| nehārtham, kutaḥ? ityata āha--na hīti|
nanu cāyamasti--ṭhmukhapārśvatasorlopaḥ, bhukhatīyaḥ' iti ?
tatrāha--mukhatīyādiranarthaka iti| mukhatīyādau yastīyaśabdaḥ
so'narthaka ityartha ||

prāgekādaśabhyo'cchandasi || 5|3|49 ||
prāgīkādaśabhyaḥ saṃkhyāśabdebhya iti| ekādaśaśabdātprāñco ye
saṃkyāśabdāstebhya ityarthaḥ, ekādaśabhyaḥ prācīneṣu saṃkhyeyeṣu ye
saṃkhyāśabdāstebhya itī vā ||

ṣaṣṭhāṣṭamābhyāṃ ña ca || 5|3|50 ||
yathāsaṃkhyamatra na bhavati, anyatarasmādanaḥ pūrveṇaiva siddhatvāt ||

mānapaśvaṅgayoḥ kanlukau ca || 5|3|51 ||
mānaṃ vrīhiparimitaṃ suvarṇam| aṣṭamo bhāga iti| kasya punaratra
luk ? ityāha--ñasya luk, ano veti| aṣṭhanśabdādbhāgo tayoreva
vihitatvat| lugvacanaṃ kim, yāvatā mahāvibhāṣayaiva pakṣe
ñānorabhāvaḥ siddhaḥ ? jñāpanārthaṃ tu, etajjñāpayati--pūrvasūtre ñānau
nityāviti || 

ekādākinicchāsahāye || 5|3|52 ||
ākinicaḥ kano veti| tayorevānena sūtreṇa vidhānāt|
ekadhetyādau tu sūtrāntaravihitasya lug na bhavati; asannidhānāt| 
saṃkhyāśabdanirāsārthamiti| anyathā prasiddhatvātsaṃkhyāprakaraṇācca
tasyaiva grahaṇaṃ svāt| astu, ko doṣaḥ ? tatrāha---tadupādāne
hīti| dvibahvoriti| dvitve bahutve cetyarthaḥ| na hi dvayorbahuṣu
vā ekatvasaṃkhyāsti| asahāyatvaṃ tu parasparavyatiriktasahāyābhāvena
bahūnāmapi bhavati| iha akinijevāyaṃ vaktavyaḥ,
savarṇadīrghatvesiddhamiṣṭam, yasyetilopaścākāroccāraṇasāmarthyānna
bhaviṣyati ? na cāvagrahanivṛtyartho'kāraḥ, nahi lakṣaṇena padakārā
anuvarttyāḥ, padakārairnāma lakṣaṇamanuvartyam ||

bhūtapūrve caraṭ || 5|3|53 ||
bhūtapūrvaśabda ityādi| kevalabhūtaśabdaḥ ṭhpautanye'pi
vartatebhūtamiyaṃ brāhmaṇīti, satye'pi vartate--bhūtavādīti, atra
bhūtaśabdo vidyamānavacanityanye; pūrvaśabdaśca digdeśayorapi
vartate, tasmādanyataropādāne vivakṣito'rtho na gamyata
ityubhayorupādānam| āḍha|lcara iti| yathātra cakārasyetsaṃjñā na
bhavati, tathā ṭhcuṭūa' ityatra pratipāditam|
ṭhgoṣṭhātkhañ' ityatraiva noktam, viśeṣavihitena khañā caraṭo bādhā
mā bhūditi| sannidhau hi bādhyabādhakabhāvaḥ, na kālabhede ||

ṣaṣṭha|la rūpya ca || 5|3|54 ||
śeṣaviṣaye vidhānātadantavyavacchedakatvādviśeṣaṇamapradhānam|
yatpunaḥ ṣaṣṭha|lakṣiptaṃ sambandhimātram, tadvyavacchedyatvādviśeṣyaṃ
pradhānam| pradānetarasannidhau ca pradhāne kāryasampratyayo bhavatīti
pratyayastāvacatatraiva vijñāyate, tataśca bhūtapūrvagrahaṇamapi tasyaiva
viśe,ṇamityāha-ṣaṣṭa|lntātpratyayavidhāna iti| hetugarbha
cedamabhidhānam-yasmāt ṣaṣṭha|lntātpratyayavidhānaṃ tasmāditi|
sampratīti| yadyapi pūrvaṃ ṅyāpprātipadikenaiva sambaddhamāsīdidānīṃ
tvevamityarthaḥ| tatra vidhāna iti saptamyantasya sampratītyasya ca
pauranaruktyaṃ manyamānā vidhānaśabdamadhikaraṇasādhanaṃ sūtraparaṃ
vyācakṣate ||

atiśāyate tamaviṣṭhanau || 5|3|55 ||
atiśayanamatiśāyanamiti| bhāve lyuṭ| yadyapyanantarameva
vakṣyati--nipātanāddīrghatvamiti, tathāpi ṭhabādhakānyapi nipātanāni
bhavanti' ityadīrgheṇāpyarthanamupapadyate| anye
tu--atiśayo'tiśāyanamiti paṭhanti, atiśāyanaṃ prakarṣa ityevānye|
prakarṣa iti| yadyapi kevalaḥ śetiḥ svapne vartate, tathāpyatipūrvasya
prakarṣe vṛttiḥ ||
upasargavaśāddhāturarthāntaravilāsakṛt|
vihārāhārasaṃhāraprahāraparihāravat || 
prakarṣaścātra nādhikyaṃ kiṃ tarhyatiśayo mataḥ|
sakarmako hyayaṃ śuklamatiśeta hatīṣyate ||
nipātanāditi| yadidamasminsūtre dīrghoccāraṇaṃ tadeva nipātanam|
ṭhsautronirddeśaḥ' ityeṣa parihāro'tra noditaḥ;
yasmātsūtrādbahirapi prayogo'syābyupeyate| etadarthameva ca
laghurapi prakarṣaśabdo nopātaḥ| prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇaṃ caitaditi| na
prakṛtyarthaḥ, atiśāyane vartamānāditi| tathā hi sati
atiśayaprakarṣādibhya eva syāt| nāpi pratyayārthaḥ, tathā hi sati
āḍha|lsyātiśayanamāḍha|ltamamiti syāt| āḍha|lsyeti karmaṇi kartari vā
ṣaṣṭhī, ubhayathāpyāḍha|ltamo devadata iti sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ na syāt|
nāpi pratyayārthaviśeṣaṇam, anyasya kasyacit
pratyayārthasyānirddeśāt| nāpi prakṛtereva viśeṣaṇam,
atiśāyanīveśiṣṭānṅyāpprātipadikāditi|
pratyayadyotyamatiśāyanaṃ prakṛtyabhihitasya pradhānasyaivārthasya viśeṣaṇaṃ
yuktam, na tvarthābhidhānaṃ prati vyagrasya guṇabhūtasya śabdasya| yadā
tvasāvaguṇabhūtaḥ, tadā bhavatyeva prakarṣayogaḥ--uccataraḥ śabdaḥ,
nīcataraḥ śabda iti| nanu śuklādivadetatsyāt, tadyathā--śuklataraḥ
paṭa iti guṇabhūtasyāpi śauklyasya prakarṣo dravyaprakarṣahetuḥ, tathā
śabde'pyastu ? viṣama upanyāsaḥ; śauklyasya prakarṣo dravyaprakarṣahetuḥ,
tathā śabde'pyastu ? viṣama upanyāsaḥ; śauklyādayo hi
dravyasamavetāḥ, yuktaṃ yatsvayaṃ prakṛṣṭā prakarṣayanti, śabdastu na
tatheti kathaṃ tatprakarṣeṇa dravyaṃ prakarṣyatām! prātipadikāditi|
prakṛteridamupalakṣaṇam| subantātu pratyayaḥ| uktaṃ
hi--ṭhpriyakutsanādiṣu' tataḥ pravartate'sau vibhaktyantaḥ' iti,
ṭhghakālataneṣu kālanāmnaḥ' ityalugvidhānamapyevamevopapadyate| svārtha
iti| yadyevam, kumāritametyavyatiriktaṃ vaya iti kṛtvā ṭhvayasi
prathame' iti ṅīp prāpnoti ? kumāraśabdādutpannena ṅīpā
vayoviśiṣṭasyārthasya strītvaṃ dyotitimati ṅībna bhaviṣyati,
tarabantātu strītvamātrābhivyaktaye ṭāb bhaviṣyati| kumāritama iti
hyucyamāne kuṭīraḥ, śamīra itivalliṅgāntaraṃ gamyeta| yadvā--nātra
prajña eva prājñaḥ yāva eva yāvaka ityādivadatyantasvāthikatvaṃ
vivakṣitam, kiṃ tarhi? īṣacchukle śuklatare ca guṇayogasya bhāvāt
śuklaśabda eva pravartitumarhati, aupagavādau tu naivamityetāvatā
svārthikatvavācoyuktiḥ| paramārthatastvasminprayoge prakṛṣṭe
śuklaśabdasya pravṛttinimitam, tamabantasya tu tadgataḥ prakarṣa iti
kuto'tra ṅīpaḥ prasaṅgaḥ! tadidamuktam--prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇaṃ ca
svarthikānāṃ dyotyaṃ bhavatīti|
atrāpi yadyapi tasmindravye bahavo guṇāḥsanti, tathāpi yasya guṇasya
bhāvād dravye śabdaniveśaḥ pratyāsatestatprakarṣāśrayaḥ pratyayaḥ|
tadyathā--śuklādibhyo guṇaprakarṣe, pācakādibhyaḥ kriyāprakarṣe,
vāhadohādayo dharmāḥ, tatprakarṣe pratyayaḥ| tadyathā--gaurayaṃ yaḥ śakaṭṃa
vahati, gotaro'yaṃ yaḥ śakaṭṃa vahati sīraṃ ca, gauriyaṃ yā
samāṃsamāṃ vijāyate, gotareyaṃ yā samāṃsamāṃ vijāyate strī vatsā
ca, aśvo'yaṃ ścatvāri yojanāni gacchati, aśvataro'yaṃ yo'ṣṭau
gacchatīti| etena saṃkhyāparimāṇapramāṇonmānaśabdā vyākhyātāḥ| na hi
svatado bhavati, dvitaraḥ prasthataraḥ vitastitaraḥ suvaparṇataramiti,
sarvathā dharmadvārako dravyasya prakarṣo na svataḥ,
yathā--śuklaguṇayogātpaṭasya śuklavyapadeśaḥ, tathā
prakarṣavyapadeśo'pi, tatprakarṣādevetyarthaḥ|
uktaṃ ca---
dravyasyāvyapadeśyasya ya upādīyate guṇaḥ|
bhedako vyapadeśāya tatprakarṣo'bhidhīyate|| iti|
ṭhavyapadeśyasya' iti dharmayogamantareṇa svarūpeṇa
vyapadeṣṭuamaśakyasyetyarthaḥ| tadevamatiśāyanaśabdo bāvasādhanaḥ,
prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇaṃ ca, svārthikaśca pratyaya iti sthitam| ata eva
prakṛtito liṅgavacanāni bhavanti| yadi tu kartṛsādhanaḥ syāt,
tadā yadi prakṛtyarthastato'tiśāyanātiśāyakātiśayitṛprabhṛtibhya eva
syāt, tatrāpi svārthe na pravṛttinimitaprakarṣe; atha pratyayārthaḥ, tataḥ
sāmarthyalabhyā samarthavibhaktiḥ| sā ca yadi tiṅntena vigrahastādā
dvitīyā---śuklamatiśete śuklatara iti| atha
kṛ-dantenātiśāyanaśabdena, tadā ṣaṣṭhī--śuklasyātiśāyanaḥ śuklatara
iti| tathā ca kālīmatiśete kālaḥ kālitara iti prāpnoti,
kālamatiśete kālī kālatareti prāpnoti| iha ca gargānatiśete
gārgyaḥ kargatara iti prāpnoti, tathā gārgyamatiśerate gargāḥ
gārgyatarā iti prāpnoti| atha karaṇasādhanaḥ tatrāpi prakṛtyarthaścedyena
guṇenātiśete tadvācinaḥ śauklyādereva syāt, śauklyena hi
śuklaḥ śuklāntaramatiśete| pratyayārthe tu śuklādiśabdādatiśāyane
guṇo pratyayaḥ prāpnoti, guṇisāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ na
syāt--śuklataraḥ paṭa iti| atha vyantātkartari
lyuḍ--atiśāyayatītyatiśāyan iti, evamapa si eva doṣo yaḥ
karaṇapakṣe| guṇā hi guṇinaṃ prayuñjate---asmābhiḥ prakṛṣṭaistvaṃ
sajātīyamatiśeṣeveti, tataśca prakṛtyantātkaraṇe lyuṭi yo doṣaḥ
sa evātrāpi bhavati| atha śetiravastānārthaḥ--pakvāśayo jalāśaya
itivat, tato'yamarthaḥ syāt--guṇā guṇini śerate, avatiṣṭhante,
tānguṇyatiśāyayatiuātmanyatiśayenāvastāpayatīti, tataśca sa eva
doṣo yaḥ prakṛtyantātkartari lyuṭi| atiśāyanaśabdaśca prakṛtyanto
na sādhitaḥ syāt| tasmād vṛttikāropadarśita evārtho nyāpyaḥ || 
paṭiṣṭha iti| ṭhturiṣṭhemeyassu' ṭeriti ṭilopaḥ| gariṣṭha iti|
ṭhpriyasthira' ityādīnā guruśabdasya garādeśaḥ|
ṭhprakarṣapratyayāntādapareṇa prakarṣapratyayena na bhavitavyam, ekenaiva
prakarṣasya dyotitatvāt' iti manyamānaṃ pratyayāha--yadā
ceti|ātiśāyikāntāditi| atiśaye bhava ātiśāyikaḥ,
adhyātmāditvāṭṭhañ, anuśatikāditvādubhayapadavṛddhiḥ|
śreṣṭhatamāryati| ṭhpraśasyasya śraḥ' atra prakarṣarahitapratiyogyapekṣayā yaḥ
prakarṣastatreṣṭanvihitaḥ, tamappratyayastu prakarṣavatpratiyogyapekṣayā yaḥ
prakarṣa iṣṭhanpratyayenadyotitastasminnityapaunaruktyam| pratyayadvayasya
vidhīyamānapratyayabhedācca dve ete vākye, tatraikeneṣṭhan, apareṇa
tadantātamap| tenaitanna codanīyam--yathā sanantānna san bhavati,
tadvidānavelāyāṃ tadantasya dhātorabhāvāt; tathā
prakarṣapratyāntādapareṇa prakarṣapratyayena na bhavitavyamiti || 
bhāṣye tu prakarṣapratyayāntādaparaḥ prakarṣapratyayo naiva bhavatīti
sthitm| tatkayam? na tāvatarabantādaparasya prasaṅgaḥ--yatra hi
trayāṇāmekaḥ śuklaḥ, dvitīyaḥ kiñcitprakṛṣṭaḥ, tṛtīyaścātyantam,
tatra kila prasaṅgaḥ śaṅkyate; tatra dvitīyasya sadapyutkṛṣṭatvaṃ
tṛtīyasannidhāvakiñcitkaram, rājasannidhāvivāmātyasyeti|
dvitīyātāvatarabna bhavati| tṛtīyādapi na bhavati, tasminneva prayoge
trayāṇāmapekṣitatvena dvivacanopapadatvābhāvāt|
eteneyasunvyāśyātaḥ| nāpi tamabantādaparasya prasaṅgaḥ| yatra hi
caturṇā dvau śuklau, tṛtīyaḥ kiñcicadutkṛṣṭaḥ, caturthaścātyantam,
tatra kila prasaṅgaḥ śaṅkyate; tatra tṛtīyasya sadapyutkṛṣṭatvaṃ
caturthasannidhau pūrvavadakiñcitkaram, caturthātu tamabeva bhavati|
eteneṣṭhanvyākhyātaḥ|
kathaṃ tarhi śreṣṭhatamāya karmaṇe iti? chāndasatvātsvārthikastamab
draṣṭavyaḥ| yudhiṣṭhiraḥ śreṣṭhatamaḥ kuruṇām iti tvanyāpyameva manyate
||

tiṅśca || 5|3|56 ||
pacatitamāmiti| ṭhkimetiṅvyaya' ityādinā''mpratyayaḥ|
guṇavacane tasya niyatatvāditi| ata eva sūtrārthakathanavelāyāmapi
tamap pratyayo bhavatītyuktam| na cānuvṛttisāmarthyānniyamasya bādhaḥ,
tamabvidhāne'pyanuvṛterupapannatvāt ||

dvivacanavibhajyacopapade tarabīyasunau || 5|3|57 ||
dvayorarthayorvacanaṃ dvivacanamiti| karaṇe lyuṭ, karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhayāḥ
samāsaḥ| yena padena dvāvarthāvucyete tad dvivacanamityarthaḥ|
etenānvarthasya dvivacanasyedaṃ grahaṇam, na pāribhāṣikasyeti
darśayati| pāribhāṣikasya hi grahaṇe, asmākaṃ ca devadatasya ca
devadato'bhirūpatara ityatra na syāt| anvarthagrahaṇe tu bhavati, tathā
hi--asmākamityanenaiko'rtha ucyate, ṭhasmado dvayośca'
ityekasminnevārthe bahuvadbhāvavidhānād; devadatasya cetyanenāpi
dvitīyo'rtha ucyate iti kabhavatyetadanvratham--dvivacanamupapadam|
vibhaktavyaḥupṛthakkartavyaḥ, sa cātiśayyamānaḥ| tasya hyupapadatvam, na
atiśayituḥ; tataḥ pratyayavidhānāt| apara
āha--ādyāderatiśayitṛviśeṣaṇātpratyayo vidhīyate,
nātiśayiturmādhurāderiti tasyāpyupapadatvamavirūddham|
pṛthakkāro'pi tasyāpyaviśiṣṭa iti| nipātanādyaditi|
ṭhṛhalorṇyat' iti ṇyato'pavādaḥ| tena vibhāgyamiti naiva bhavati|
vibhājyaśabdasyatu smṛtiṣu prayuktasya sādhutvaṃ cintyam| dvyarthe
vibhajye copapada iti| sūtre tu dvivacanaṃ ca vibhajyaṃ ca
dvivacanavibhajyam, tacca tadupapadaṃ ceti karmadhārayātsaptamī| anvarthaṃ
copapadam-upoccāritaṃ padamupapadamiti| tacca vigrahavākya eva
prayujyate| vṛtotu gatārthatvānnāvaśyaṃ prayujyate| evaṃ
copapadagrahaṇaṃ spaṣṭārtham| iha dve upapade, dve ca
prakṛtī--ṭhṅyāpprātipadikāt' ṭhtiṅśca' iti, pratyayāvapi
dvāveva, tataśca yathāsaṃkhyaprasaṅgaḥ? ityata āha--yathāsaṃkhyāmiti|
iṣṭireveyam| ayamanayoriti| anayorityetadatra
dvyarthamupapadam| paṭīyāniti| pūrvavaṭṭilopaḥ, agitvānnum,
ṭhsāntamahataḥ' iti dīrghatvam, halṅyādisaṃyogāntalopau|
mādhurā ityādi| kiṃ punaratra vibhajyam? pāṭaliputrakā hatyāha| tathā
ca tatra ṭhpañcamī vibhakte' iti pañcamī bhavati| yadyapyatrāpī
mādhurāṇāmeko rāśiḥ, pāṭaliputrakāṇāṃ cāpara iti rāśyapekṣaṃ
dvyarthatvamasti; tathāpi nāsau śabdenopādīyate,
pratyutāvayavabheda eva| ata eva bahuvacanam| iha ca-mādhurāḥ
pāṭaliputrakebhyaḥ sāṃkaśyakebyaścābhirūpatarā iti na rāśyapekṣamapi
dvyarthatvamasti| tasmādvibhajyopapadagrahaṇaṃ kṛtam|
iha dantoṣṭhasya dantāḥ snigdhatarāḥ, pāṇipādasya pāṇī
sukumāratarāvityatra tarabna prāpnoti, kiṃ kāraṇam ?
samāhārasyaikatvāt; na ca guṇabhūtavartipadārthāśrayaḥ pratyayaḥ, teṣāṃ
bahutvāt--dvātriṃśaddantāḥ, dvāvoṣṭhau ?
atrā''huḥ--vṛtāvabhedaikatvasaṃkhyāmupādadate vartipadāni, tataśca
bhedaparityāgādabedaikatvasaṃkhyāyāścopādānād--evambhūtadantoṣṭhalakṣaṇārthadvayāśrayaḥ pratyaya iti| itaretarayogadvandve tvavayavārthabedasadbhāvād dvyarthatā nāstīti tarabna bhavati| plakṣanyagrodhānāṃ plakṣā dīrghatamā iti vibhajyopapadāśrayo'pi na bhavati, katham? pratiyogyapekṣatvātprakarṣasya| sāmarthyalabhye vibhāge vibhajyopapadagrahaṇamavadhāraṇārtham--vibhāgā eva yatra śabdena pratipādyata iti| iha tu nirdhāraṇāśrayanirddeśo nirdhāryamāṇasyāpi sādhāraṇa iti na vibhāga eva kevalaḥ, kintvavibhāgo'pi| etena ṭhpañcamī vibhakte' iti pañcamī vyākhyātā| iha ṭhparudbhavānpaṭuarāsīt, paṭuataraścaiṣamaḥ' ityekasyāpi dharmiṇo guṇabhedena dvitvādhyāropātpratiyogyapekṣaḥ prakarṣaḥ, tadāśrayaśca pratyayaḥ| vyapadiśati ca--ṭhanya evāsi saṃvṛtaḥ' ṭhkaccitsa evāsi dhanañjayasatvam' iti || 

ajādī guṇavacanādeva || 5|3|58 ||
evakāraḥ kimarthaḥ ? niyamo yathā vijñāyeta; anyathā
prakarthe'jādyorvidhānādaprakarṣe vidhiḥ syāt| ṭhatiśāyane'
ityanuvartiṣyate, tatraiva punarvacanaṃ niyamārthaṃ bhaviṣyati,nārtha
evakāreṇa? tatrāha--evakāra iṣṭato'ḍavadhāraṇārtha iti| asati
hyasminviparīto'pi niyamaḥ sambhāvyate--ajādī eva guṇavacanāditi|
tatra ko doṣaḥ ? guṇavacanād vyañjanādī na syātām;
tasyājādyorniyatatvāt| yata evakārastato'nyatrāvadhāraṇamiti|
ajādyoścāniyatatvādaguṇavacanādapi tayoḥ prasaṅgaḥ| idamatibahu
kriyate--ajādī guṇavacanādeveti, evaṃ tu vaktavyam--atiśāyane
tamap, guṇavacanādiṣṭhan, dvivacanavibhajyopapada iyasun,
guṇavacanādityeva, tatastarap ca, gumavaṭacanāditi nivṛtam?
sāpam; ṭhpraśasyasya śraḥ' ityevamādyarthaṃ tu ṭhajādī' ityuktam| evaṃ tarhi
ṭhpraśasyasya śro'jādyoḥ' ityevāstu, evamapi hyaevakāro na vaktavyo
bhavati? tvatpakṣe'pi ṭhtarap ca' iti cakāraḥ kriyate, tatulyaṃ bhavati
||

tuścchandasi || 5|3|59 || 
pūrveṇetyādi| niyamabādhena prakṛtyantarasyābyanujñānamātraṃ kriyate,
na tpapūrvo vidhirityarthaḥ, tenopādhisaṅkaro na bhavati| kariṣṭha
iti| kartṛśabdātṛnnantādiṣṭhan| ata eva karmaṇi dvitīyā bhavati|
tṛjantādeva vā bhavatu, dvitīyā tu kṛtapūrvī kaṭamitivad
draṣṭavyā| dohīyasīti| liṅgaviśiṣṭaparibhāṣayā
dogdhrīśabdātpratyayaḥ| bhasyā'ḍhea taddhite puṃvadbhāvena ṅīpo
nivṛtti| yadvā, ṭhsiddhaśca pratyayavidhau' iti vacanānṅīpi nivṛte
dogdhṛśabdādeva pratyayaḥ, tataḥ ṭhturiṣṭhemeyasmu' iti tṛci nivṛte
nimitābhāvād ghatvajaśtvayorapi nivṛttiḥ ||

praśasyasya śraḥ || 5|3| 60 ||
ajādyoḥ pratyayayoḥ parata iti| nanu cājādī iti prathamāntaṃ
prakṛtam| na saptamyantam, tatkathamayamartho labhyate ? ityata
āha--ajādī iti prakṛtasyetyādi| prakṛtasya yā vibhaktiḥ prathamā sā
saptamīrūpeṇa vipariṇamyate, ūhyata ityarthaḥ|
evaṃ tarhītyādi| atha yāveva sambhavataḥ--taraptamapau, tayoreva
parato'yamādeśaḥ kasmānna bhavati? naivaṃ bhavitumarhati; ṭhajādī'
ityanuvṛttisāmarthyāt| athātraivājādyorvidhiḥ kasmānna
vijñāyate--praśasyaśabdādajādī bhavataḥ, śraścāsyādeśa iti,
tatrāyamapyarthaḥ--vibhaktivipariṇāmo na kartavyo bhavati? naivaṃ
śakyam; taraptamapau hi syātām, viśeṣavihitāvajādī
bādheyātām, upādhīnāṃ ca saṅkaraḥ syād-iṣṭhanviṣaye īyasun,
tadviṣaye ceṣṭhanniti| tadviṣaya iti| sa praśasyaśabdo viṣayo yasya sa
tadviṣayaḥ| saptamyantapāṭhe tu sa eva viṣayastatretyarthaḥ| niyamo na
pravartata iti| nayamāpravṛttijñāpanadvāreṇājādibhāvo jñāpyate, na tu
sākṣādityarthaḥ; anyathā punaranajādyorbādha upādhisaṅkaraśca syāt,
uktena prakāreṇa svaśāstreṇaivājādyorvidānānnaitaddoṣadvayamapi bhavati|
kathaṃ punarthāśrutasambandhasambhave'pi vipariṇāmaḥ śakya āśrayitum ?
śrṛṇu; ajādyorvidhiriṣṭaścetpañcamyā niradekṣyat| kiñca evaṃ
sanniyogārthaścakāro'pyakariṣyata|
ṭilopa-yasyetilopāviti| ṭhyasyeti' ityanena lopo
yasyetilopaḥ, ṭhkartṛkaraṇe kṛtā bahulam' iti samāsaḥ,
tatrānukaraṇatvādasyavāmīyamityādivadbibhakteralopaḥ| ṭhādguṇaḥ'
iti tvanaṅgatvānna pratiṣidhyate ||

jya ca|| 5|3|61 ||
yogavibhāgā utaratra jyādeśa eva yathā syāt, ādeśo mā bhūditi|
ayamanayoriti| atiśayena praśasya iti vipariṇāmenāpekṣyate, na
punarutareṇaikagranthatā| evaṃ sarvatra ||

vṛddhasya ca || 5|3|62 ||
svarūpagrahaṇam, na tu ṭhvṛddhiryasyācāmādiḥ' iti
pāribhāṣikasyetyāha--vṛddhaśabdasyeti| atra ca vyākhyānameva śaraṇam|
tayoścetyādi| yatpūrvamuktam--ṭhevamutareṣvapi yogeṣu
vijñeyam' iti, tadevānena smāritam|
vacanātpakṣe so'pi bhavatīti| nanu ca varṣādeśasyemanijavakāśaḥ
syāt? na; vṛddhaśabdādimanico'bhāvāt| yadyevam,
varṣādeso'pīhaiva vaktavyaḥ--vṛddhasya varṣiśceti, evaṃ hi
dvirvṛddhagrahaṇaṃ na kartavyaṃ bhavati? satyam; tathā tu na kṛtamityeva|
apara āha---iṣṭhanīyasunorimavemanico'pi sadbhāvaḥ kalpyate, tena
varṣimetyapi bhavati| tasya mate---varṣādeśasyemanici
caritārthatvādiṣṭhannīyasunoranena jyādeśa eva prāpnoti| tasmād
ṭhyuvālpayoḥ kananyatarasyām' ityatredamanuvartate, tena jyādeśena
mukte pakṣe varṣādeśaḥ ||

antikabāḍhayornedasādhau || 5|3|63 ||
nimitayoryathāsaṃkhyamiha neṣyata iti| ṭhajādyoḥ' iti
prakṛtayoriṣṭhanīyasunorgrahaṇātayośca
krameṇopadeśādajahatkramayoreva pratīteryathāsaṃkhyāprasaṅgaṃ manyate|
kasmātpunariṣyamāṇamapi na bhavati ? viparītakramasyāpi sambhavāt|
tathā hi--kayorajādyorityapekṣāyāmānantarthādīyasuṃstāvatpratīyate,
dvivacanānurodhātviṣṭhannapītyevamapi kramaḥ sambhavati| tadanayoḥ
kramayornānyataraḥ kramo nirddhārayituṃ śakya ityanāśrayaṇameva
tayoryuktam ||

yuvālpayoḥ kananyatarasyām || 5|3|64 ||
yuveti na saṃjñāyūno grahaṇam, kiṃ tarhi? svarūpasya; alpasāhacaryāt
vyākhyānācca| anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇamalpaśabdārtham| yuvaśabdasya tu
ṭhsthūladūrayuva' iti vacanātsiddho vikalpaḥ| yaviṣṭha iti|
sthūladūrādisūtreṇa yaṇādiparaṃ lupyate, pūrvasya ca guṇaḥ|
kanīyāniti| prakaraṇādivaśādyauvālpayoranyatarāvasāyaḥ|
ṭhprakṛtyaikāc' iti prakṛtibhāvāṭṭilopaḥ, ṭhallopo'naḥ'
ityallopaśca na bhavati|

vinmatorluk || 5|3|65
||
vinmatorityutsṛṣṭānubanadhayorvinimatupordvandvātṣaṣṭhīdvivacanam| atha vingrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā yebhyo vin tebyo matubapi bhavati, tasyaiva luki srajiṣṭha ityādi siddham, na ca vina iṣṭhacīyasunoḥ śravaṇaprasaṃgaḥ, tadantātayorabhāvāt? asmādeva hi lugvacanādvinantātayorbhāvo jñāpyate| yadā tarhi vinantāt ṭhtatkaroti tadātaṣṭe' iti ṇic kriyate, tadā vinaḥ śravaṇaṃ mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ vino lugvacanam--sragviṇamācaṣṭe srajayati ||

praśaṃsāyāṃ rūpap || 5|3|66 ||
prakṛtyarthaviśeṣṇaṃ caitaditi| pratyārthatve tu vaiyākaraṇasya praśaṃsā
vaiyākaraṇarūpa iti prāpnoti, vaiyākaraṇarūpo devadata iti
sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ na syāt,
tasmātprakṛtyarthaviseṣamam--praśaṃsāviśiṣṭebhya iti| sa punaḥ
praśasto na tu praśaṃsitā; anabhidhānāt| svārtha iti| yadyevam,
kumārīrūpetyatrānatiriktaṃ vaya iti kṛtvā ṅīp prāpnoti? naiṣa
doṣaḥ; kumārīśabdādutpannena ṅīpā vayoviśiṣṭārthagatasya
strītvasya dyotitatvādrūpabantasya strītvamātramabhivyaṅktuaṃ ṭābeva
kriyate, na ca ṅīpaiva tadabhivyaktamiti ṭāpo'prasaṅgaḥ| kumārīrūpa
ityucyamāne hi kuṭīrādivalliṅgāntaraṃ pratīyeta|
yatadvā--pravṛttinimitabhedānṅīpo'prasaṅgaḥ, kumāraśabdasya vayo
nimitam, rūpabantasya tu tadgatā praśaṃsā,
tadāhasvāthiṃkāścetyādi| atrāpi pravṛttinimitasya praśaṃsāyāmayaṃ
pratyayaḥ, tena yo vyākaraṇe'nipuṇaḥ praśastaśca vaṃśaśīlādinā, tatra
vaiyākaraṇarūpa iti na bhavati| kvacitu sahacaritadharmapraśaṃsāyāmapi
bhavati--gorūpo'yaṃ yaḥ samyagvahatīti|
atha kathaṃ vṛṣalādiśabdebhyaḥ pratyayaḥ, te hi tadā nindāvacanāḥ,
tadabhidheyānāṃ kākādivannikṛṣakhṭatacvāt ? ata
āha--prakṛtyarthasyeti| vaiśiṣṭa|lmuparipūrṇatā, tasminsati praśaṃsā
bhavati| tathā ca vṛṣalādiśabdā api svārthasya pūrṇatve sati
prasaṃsāviśiṣṭa evārthe pravartanta iti tebyo'pi siddhaḥ pratyaya iti
bhāvaḥ|
vṛṣalarupa iti| yadyapyayaṃ jātivacanaḥ, jāteśca nyūnatvam pūrṇatvaṃ
vā na bhavati; tathāpi sahacaritadharmālpatvaṃ bahutvāpekṣaṃ nyūnatvaṃ
pūrṇatvaṃ ca draṣṭavyam| yadvā--gumasamudāye śabdapravṛteḥ
śabdārthasyaivaitadubhyaṃ bhavati| yaḥ palāṇḍuneti| sahayoge tṛtīyā|
kaścid vṛṣalaḥ palāṇkaḍuaṃ bhakṣayati, kaścitsurāṃ pibati,
yastūbhayaṃ karoti tasya paripūrṇavṛṣalatvam| tathā
coraśabdārthasyāpi suguptavastvapaharaṇena paripūrṇatā bhavati|
akṣṇorabyañjanaṃ harediti| sambhāvane liṅ, evaṃvidhamapyasya
cauryasambhavatītyartaḥ| akṣṇorapyañjanaṃ haratu vā mā vā hārṣīt,
nanvevamapi yadā nindāpratipādanāya vṛṣalarūpa ityādi prayujyate
tadā na siddhyati, nindaiva hi tadā prakṛtyarthasya
vaiśiṣṭa|ladbhavati, tasmātpraśaṃsāgrahaṇamapanīya vaiśiṣṭa|lgrahaṇameva
kartavyam, yadāha--ṭhsiddhaṃ tu prakṛtayarthasya vaiśiṣṭa|lvacanāt' iti|
vṛttikārastu manyate---corarūpo'yamityādau praśaṃsaiva śabdārthaḥ,
nindāpratītistu vākyanibandhaneti| dṛśyate ca praśaṃsāparāṇāmapi
nindāparatvam, yathā--rākṣasa iti, pauruṣātiśayapraśaṃsāvacane
praśaṃsā gamyate, nirghṛṇatvapratipādane tu nindā|
pacatorūpam, pacantirūpamiti| ???????dvivacanabahuvacanaprasaṅgaḥ,
svārthikāḥ prakṛtito liṅgavacanānyanuvartanta iti kṛtvā?
tatrāha--kriyāpradhānamākyātamiti| yadyapyākhyātasya
kriyāsādhanapuruṣasaṃkhyākālopagraharūpo'neko'rthaḥ, tathāpi teṣu
tasya kriyaiva pradānamarthaḥ| kathaṃ jñāyate? yat kriyāṃ
pṛṣṭastadantenācaṣṭe--devadataḥ kiṃ karoti? pacatīti| nanu ca
dravyamapi pṛṣṭastiṅntenācaṣṭe, yathā--ka eṣu devadato yaḥ pacatīti
? yuktamatra ya iti hi padāntareṇa dravyopalakṣaṇāya guṇabhāvaṃ kriyā
nīyate| ata eva kevalenākhyātena prativacanābhāvaḥ, na hi bhavati--ko
devadataḥ, pacatīti| tasmāt kriyāpradhānamākhyātam, tiṅnto
pātārthāpekṣaṃ ca kriyāyāḥka prādhānyamucyate| vrīhinavahantītyādau
tu dravyasaṃskārārthatvādavaghātādervrīhyapekṣamaprādhānyamastyeva|
apara āha--atrāpyavaghātādereva śābdaṃ pradhānyam; sādhyatvāt| na tu
vrīhyādeḥ; sādhanatvāt| ārthaṃ tu tasya pradhānyamiti|
ekā ca kriyeti| ṭhnivṛtabhedā sarvatra kriyākyāteṣu gamyate'| kathaṃ
tarhi dvivacanabahuvacane bhavataḥ--pacataḥ, pacantīti? naite
kriyābedāpekṣe dvivacanabahuvacane, kiṃ karhi? sādhanabedāpekṣe| ata
eva bhavadbhirāsyate hatyādau kevalakriyāvacane
dvivacanabahuvacanābhāvaḥ| na ca kartṛbhedaḥ kriyābhedena vyāptaḥ;
ekaphaloddeśena pravṛtāmekāmeva pākavyakti bahuṣvapi
kurvatsu-bhavantaḥ pacanti, bhavadbhiḥ pacyata iti darśanāt|
tasmādākhyātavācyā kriyaiketi siddham| tena rūpappratyayāntād
dvivacanabahuvacane na bhavataḥ| 
atha yathā tiṅnte sādhanabhedāśraye dvicanabahuvacane bhavataḥ, tathā
rūpabantādapi kasmānna bhavataḥ?
uktotarametat--kriyāpradhānamākhyātamiti| svārthikasya hi prakṛtito
liṅgavacanaprāptiḥ, tatra ca kriyā pradhānabhūtā, sā caikā, tataśca
pradhānabhūtaprakṛtyarthānurodhena bhavadvacanamekavacanameva bhavati|
pacatirūpamityādāvapi kartuḥ saṃkhyā'bhidhīyate| supā tu kriyāyā
ekatvam| atha vātiṅektatvādrūpappratyayāntād dvivacanabahuvacane na
bhaviṣyataḥ| ekavacanaṃ tu bhaviṣyati;
tasyautsargikatvāt--ṭhekavacanamutsargaḥ kariṣyate' iti| etacca tatratatra
vyākhyātam| yadi tarhi kriyāpradhānamākhyātam, napuṃsakaliṅgamapi
rūpabantasya na syāt, kriyāyā asatatvabhūtatvena liṅgābhāvāt? ata
āha--napuṃsakaliṅgaṃ tviti| atha tamabādeḥ rūpapaśca ko
viṣayavibhāgaḥ, yāvatā'tiśāyanamapi pūjānindāviṣayam--paṭuatamaḥ,
pāpīyāniti; rūpappratyayo'pyubhayaviṣayaḥ--paṭuarūpaḥ, corarūpa iti?
ucyate--atiśāyanaṃ samānaguṇapratiyogyapekṣam, vaiśiṣṭa|lṃ tu
tannirapekṣamiti spaṣṭa eva viṣayabhedaḥ ||

īṣadasamāptau kalpabdeśyadeśīyaraḥ || 5|3|67 ||
sampūrṇateti| pravṛttinimitasya pauṣkalyamityarthaḥ| padārthaśabapdena
paryavasānabhūmirvivakṣitā| prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇaṃ caitaditi| na
pratyayārthaḥ| yadi tathā syād, guḍasyeṣadasamāptirdrākṣāyā guḍakalpā
drakṣāyā iti syāt, guḍakalpā drākṣeti dravyeṇa sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ na
syāt, ekavacanameva ca syāt, iṣyate cābhidheyavalliṅgavacane
syātāmiti| tasmātprakṛtyarthaṃviśeṣaṇam| svārtha iti| na ca
kumārikalpetyatrāpyanatiriktaṃ vaya iti ṅīpaḥ prasaṅgaḥ; na hi
kalpabantasya vayaḥpravṛttinimitam, kiṃ tarhi? tadgateṣadasamāptiḥ|
īṣadasamāptaḥ paṭuaḥ paṭuakalpaḥ, mṛdukalpa iti|
nanu ca yo'rtha etāvāneveti parijñātaḥ, tasya samāptirvā
bhavatyasamāptirvā, na ca pāṭavādiguṇa etāvāniti nirjñātaḥ,
yāvatāvadapi hi pāṭavaṃ bhavatyeva, tat kathamasyeṣadasamāptiḥ; etena
jātiśabdā vyākhyātāḥ, na hi te'ktaparimāṇamarthamācakṣate ? idaṃ tu
yuktamudāhartum--kṛtakalpam, bhuktakalpamiti| dhātvartho hi
phalāvacchinno vyāpāranicayo'ktaparimāṇaḥ| nanvatrāpi bhūte ktaḥ,
phalaniṣpatau ca dhātvartho bhūto bhavati, bhūtasya ca tasya kuta
īṣadasamāptiḥ? yadā tahi kriyaikadeśāpavargāśrayo bhūte ktaḥ,
tadodāharaṇam--kṛtakalpaṃ vastramiti| tathā ca kṛtādaya
ekadeśakaraṇāśrayā prayogā dṛśyante| yadā bhaviṣyatkālāyā
īṣadasamāptāyāḥ kriyāyā āśasyamānatvāt ṭhāśaṃsāyāṃ bhūtavacca'
iti bhaviṣyati ktapratyayaḥ, tadāpi bhavatyudāharaṇam| evam ṭhñītaḥ
ktaḥ', ṭhmatibuddhipūjārthebyaśca' iti vartamānaviṣayaktāntādapi yuktaḥ
pratyayaḥ--pūjitakalpam, jātakalpamiti| tathā tiṅntamapi
kālatraviṣayaṃ bhavatyudāharaṇam--pacatikalpam, pakṣyatikalpam,
apākṣītkalpamiti| guṇavacanaṃ tvayuktam| tadapi yuktam, nanu coktaṃ
