yāvatāvadapi pāṭavaṃ bhavatyeva nāsyeṣadasamāptiriti? naitadasti;
lokata eva guṇasyāpīyatāyā nirjñātatvāt| loke hi
paṭuarayamityucyate, yo laghunaivopāyena sādyārthānsādhayati| yasyu
na tathā sādhayati, kintvīṣadūnam, sā paṭuakalpaḥ| tadviparyayeṇa
mṛdu-mṛdukalpau vyākhyātau| jātivacane kathaṃ guḍakalpā drakṣā,
tailakalpā prasanneti? ucyate; guḍagatamādhuryaśrayeṇa drākṣāyāṃ
guḍatvāropād guḍajātyabhāvācca īṣadasamāptaṃ guḍatvaṃ drākṣāyāḥ|
tathā guḍakalpo guḍa ityapi bhavati| kathaṃ punaḥ sa eveṣadasamāptaḥ
sambhavati? guṇahāneḥ---yāvanmādhuryaṃ guḍasya prasiddham, na
tāvatpurāṇatvādidoṣopahatasya| tenāsāvīṣadasamāpto guḍa
ityucyate ||

vibhāṣā supo bahucpurastātu || 5|3|68 ||
īṣadasamāptiviśiṣṭe'rthe vartamānāditi| lyablopa eṣā pañcamī|
evambhūtaṃ subantaṃ prakṛtitvenāśrityetyarthaḥ| sūtre tu ṭhsupaḥ' iti
ṭhṣaṣṭha|ltasarthapratyayena' iti ṣaṣṭhī| sa ca purastādeveti|
etenānekārthatvānnipātānām ṭhtuśabdo'vadhāraṇe vartate' iti
darśayati| asati tu tuśabde pratyayāt pūrvatvasyāpi vidheyatayā
prādhānyādvibhāṣāgrahaṇena sambandhaḥ syāditi bhāvaḥ| 
bhāṣyakārastu manyate--ṭhudaśvito'nyatarasyām' ityādau yathā paratvaṃ
na vikalpate, tatkasya hetoḥ? pratyaya eva paratvaviśiṣṭo vidhīyate,
tatra viśeṣaṇasya gumatvādvikalpena na sambandhaḥ, guṇānāṃ ca
parārthatvāditi nyāyāt; tadvadihāpi vibhāṣāgrahaṇena bahujeva
sambhantsyate, na purastādityetat| tuśabdasya
tvavadhāraṇārthasyānyadeva prayojanam--purastādeva sarvaṃ bhavatīti|
tena liṅgasaṃkhye api prākpratyayotpateḥka prakṛtyavasthāyāṃ ye dṛṣṭe
te eva bhavataḥ| prayogaśca prāk kṛterbhavatīti| tena bahuguḍo
drākṣā, laghurbahutṛṇaṃ nara iti prakṛtivalliṅgaṃ bhavati,
nābhidheyavat| evaṃ ca bahuguḍeti strīliṅgapāṭhaḥ pramādajo
draṣṭavyaḥ; itarathā bhāṣyavirodhāt| nanu ca svārthikatvādeva
prakṛtito liṅgavacane bhaviṣyataḥ, evaṃ
tarhyetajjñāpayati--īṣadasamāptau ye svārthikāsteṣvabhidheyavadeva
liṅgavacane bhavata iti| tena guḍakalpā drakṣā,tailakalpā prasanneti
siddhaṃ bhavati|
citkaraṇamantodātārthamiti| taccāntodātatvaṃ saprakṛteḥ
samudāyasya bhavati, na bahucaḥ; citaḥ saprakṛterbahvakajarthamiti
vacanāt| yadyevam, bahupaṭava iti subantasya purastādutpatau jasa
udātatvaṃ prāpnoti? syādevam, yadi prāgutpanno jasavatiṣṭheta; iha
tu bahucyutpanne
samudāyasyeṣadasamāptilakṣaṇenārthavatvātprātipadikatve sati ṭhsupo
dhātuprātipadikayoḥ' iti luki punaraparo jasutpadyate, tasya ca
prakṛtyanekadeśatvānnodātatvam| nanu samāsagrahaṇasya
niyamārthatvātprakṛtipratyayasamudāyasya prātipadikasaṃjñā na
prāpnoti? jñāpakātsiddham, yadayamapratyayaiti pratiṣedhaṃ śāsti,
tajjñāpayati--bhavati prakṛtipratyayasamudāyasya prātipadikasaṃjñā, na tu
samāsagrahaṇena vyāvṛttiriti|
vibhāṣāvacanādityādi| anyathā tiṅnteṣu sāvakāśāḥ kalpabādayaḥ
subante viśeṣavihitena bahucā deśabhede'pi samānārthena
bādhyeran|
subgrahaṇamityādi| anyathā ṭhtiṅsca'
ityadhikārātkalpabādivadbahujapi tiṅntasyāpi purastātsyāt|
prātipadikanivṛtyarthaṃ tu subgrahaṇaṃ na bhavati; viśeṣābāvāt|
nanu cāyamasti viśeṣaḥ--bahusecauḥ, bahusecaḥ, subantādutpatau
satyām ṭhsātpadādyoḥ' iti ṣatvaniṣedhaḥ siddhyati,
prātipadikātūtpatau ṣatvaprasahgaḥ? naiṣa doṣaḥ,
subantādapyutpatāvavaśyamatra kutvaniṣedārtho yatnaḥ kartavyaḥ, sa eva
prātipadikādutpatau ṣtvaniṣedārthaḥ kariṣyate| sa ca ṭhna
lumatāṅgasya' ityatraiva darśitaḥ, iha taraptamaporavakāśaḥ prakarṣasya
vacanamīṣadasamāpteravacanam--paṭuataraḥ, paṭuatamaḥ,
kalpabādīnāmavakāśa īṣadasamāptervacanaṃ
prakarṣasyāvacanam--paṭuakalpaḥ, mṛdukalpaḥ; ubhayavacanādubhayaprasaṅge
paratvātkalpabādiṣu kṛteṣu prakarṣadyotanāya
punaḥprasaṅgavijñānātadantātaraptamapau bhavataḥ---paṭuakalpataraḥ,
mṛdukalpatara iti| yadi yadantādbhavantau yatpradhānastadantastatprakarṣe
prāpnutaḥ, kiṃpradhānaśca tadantaḥ? īṣadasamāptipradhānaḥ, prakṛtyarthaprakarṣe
ceṣyate? naiṣa doṣaḥ, neṣadasamāpteḥ prakarṣaḥ sambhavati, na
hīṣadarthasyāsamāptervā prakarṣe īṣadasamāptirbhavati || 

prakāravacane jātīyar || 5|3|69 ||
tasya vacana iti| vacanamudyotam| subantāditi| atrāpi
tiṅnivṛtyartham ṭhsupaḥ' ityanuvartate iti darśayati| prakāravati
cāyamiti| tena viṣayabedādviśeṣavihitenāpi thālā jātīyaro
bādhā na bhavati, thālntācca jātīyar siddho bavatīti bhāvaḥ|
svabhāvaścātra hetuḥ ||

prāgivātkaḥ || 5|3|70 ||
tiṅntādayaṃ pratyayo neṣyata iti| tadarthamatra ṭhsupaḥ' ityeva
sambandhanīyamiti bhāvaḥ|
akajiṣyata iti| tadarthaṃ tatra ṭhsupaḥ' ityeva sambandhanīyamiti bhāvaḥ|
kathaṃ punaranuvartamānaṃ śakyamasambhanadhum ?
tatrāha--tiṅścetyanuvṛtamiti| atra ca vyākhyānameva śaraṇam| iha
ṭhprākkuṭa|laḥ' iti vaktavyam, na hi ṭhkuṭīśamīśuṇḍābyo raḥ'
ityārabyāsyopayogaḥ; pratyayāntarairavaṣṭabdhatvāt? utarārthaṃ
tviyato'vadhergrahaṇam, ṭhvā bahūnām' ityatra hi vāvacanamakajartham|
evamapi prākkana iti vaktavyam ṭhavakṣepaṇe kan' ityayamavadhiḥ| kuto
nu khalvetad? ayameva kanavadhiḥ, na punarhasve, ṭhsaṃjñāyāṃ kan'
ṭhkutsite saṃjñāyāṃ kan' ityetayoranyataro'vadhiḥ syāt ||
avyayasarvanāmnāmakac prāk ṭeḥ || kasyāpavāda iti| nanu ca
virodhe sati bādhyabādhakabhāvo bhavati, kākacośca deśabhedānnāsti
virodhaḥ, tatkathaṃ tasyāpavādaḥ? nāvaśyaṃ deśakṛta eva virodhaḥ, ki
tahi? arthakṛto'pi| kākacośca prayojanamekam--ajñātādyarthadyotanaṃ
nāma, tasminnakacā kṛte prayojanābhāvātko na bhaviṣyati| sarvake
iti| akacastanmadhyapatitasya tadgrahaṇena grahaṇāt ṭhjasaḥ śī' bhavati,
ke tu sati na syāt|
dvayamapīhānuvartata iti| yadyevam, sarvatra subantasya prātipadikasya ca
prāk ṭeḥ pratyayaprasaṅgaḥ? tatrāha--tatreti| kvacitpratipadikasyeti|
okārasakārabhakārādau vibhaktau| kvacitsubantasyeti| uktādanyatra
vibhaktau| tvayakīti| akaco dvitīyo'kāra uccāraṇārthaḥ| citkaraṇaṃ
tu samudāyasyāntodātārtham; ṭhcitaḥ saprakṛterbahvakajartham' iti
vacanāt| idameva citkaraṇaṃ
liṅgam--saprakṛteścito'ntodātatvam, na cinmātrasyeti|
tūṣṇīmaḥ kāmiti| yathāsambhavamajñātādiṣvartheṣu| makāro
deśavidhyarthaḥ| antyādacaḥ paraḥ kām bhavati| ajñātādyarthāvivakṣāyāṃ
tūṇṇīmityeva bhavati| 
śīle ka iti| śīlamusvabhāvaḥ, niyamaśca| ajñātādyapavādaḥ| śīlaṃ
tūṣṇīṃ svabhāvāccā dadvān tūṣṇīka ityucyate, na tacchīlamātram ||

kasya ca daḥ || 5|3|72 ||
na sarvanāmagrahaṇamiti| tadiṅgrahaṇaṃ ceti draṣṭavyam;
hetostulyatvāt| adhok, avak ityādāvasiddhaṃ kutvam|
śaknotiprabhṛteryaṅluki laṭi tipīḍabhāve halṅyādilope
aśāśagityādau chāndaso yaṅe luk, cchandasi ca dṛṣṭānuvidhānam|
dhigiti| kakārāntatvamavyayasya darśayati ||

ajñāte || 5|3|73 ||
ajñāta iti sāmānyenocyate, na ca sarvathā'vijñāte śabdaprayoge evala
sambavati, na khalvasva ityajānannaśvaśabdaṃ prayoktumarhati,
tasmādviśeṣasya grahaṇamityāha--ajñātaviśeṣo jñāta iti| viśeṣameva
darśayati--svena rūpeṇeti| viseṣarūpeṇeti asya
vivaraṇam--kasyāyamaśva ityādi| ihājñātaḥ prakṛṣṭaḥ
paṭuarityarthadvayavivakṣāyāṃ paścātkaḥ---paṭuatamaka iti bhavati| iha ca
kutsitamarddhapippalyā iti vivakṣāyām pūrvaṃ samāsaḥ,
paścātkaḥ---arddhapippalīketi bhavati| etena kalpabādayo vyākhyātāḥ|
āha ca--ṭhkavidestamabādayaḥ pūrvavipratiṣiddham ekadeśipradhānaśca
samāsaḥ' iti| iha tu cchinnakataramiti--ṭhanatyantagatau ktāt' iti
paratvātkani kṛte tarab bhavati| kadācid
dvandvaḥ--plakṣanyagrodhakau, plakṣakanyagrodhakau iti vā || 

kutsite || 5|3|74 || 
prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇaṃ caitaditi| prakṛtyarthasyaitadviśeṣaṇam, na
tūpalakṣaṇamityarthaḥ| upalakṣaṇatve hi yaḥ kutsitastatra vartamānāditi
vijñāyamāne idaṃ ghṛtakam, idaṃ tailakamityatredaṃśabdādapi
prāpnoti| viśeṣaṇatve tvaṅgīkṛtakutsātpratyayaḥ, na
tvanupātakutsāt; kutsisamānādhikaraṇāt| pratyayārthatve tu
ṭhprakṛtipratyayau pratyayārthaṃ saha brūtastayoḥ pratyayārthaḥ pradhānam' iti
prakṛtyarthasya viśeṣaṣaṇatvaṃ kutsitasya viśeṣyatvaṃ prāpnoti,
viparyayaśca loke gamyate| tasmātprakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇamiti
suṣṭhūaktam| aśvaka iti| yo'śva eva san tatsādhyāṃ kriyāṃ suṣṭhua na
karoti sa evamucyate| svārthikepu hi yatra pravṛttinimitasya
viśeṣaṇāsambhavaḥ, tatrābhidheyasahacaritadharmāntarāśrayaḥ pratyayo
bhavatītyuktam| evaṃ ca devadatakaḥ, ḍitthaka ityapi bhavati
yastatsādhyāmarthaṃ samyaṅ nānutiṣṭati| sambhave tvihāpi
śabdopātamarmāśrayaiva kutsā, tadyathā--paṭuakaḥ paṇḍitaka iti svārthe
kutsā; ṭhprāpya gāṇkaḍīvadhanvānaṃ viddhi kauravakān striyaḥ' iti
liṅgakutsā, kauravakāniti kimete'rjunasaṃnidhau pumāṃsa
ityarthaḥ; kvacitsaṅkhayākutsā, yathā--idamekameva śanakamiti,
śanabharaṇe yadduḥkhaṃ tadekasyaiva bharaṇa iti śatatvarūpeṇa kutsā|
sarvathāṅgīkṛtakutsātpratyaya| atheha kathaṃ pratyayaḥ---kutsitaka iti ?
kathañca na syāt ? svaśabdenopātatvāt kutsāyāḥ ?
anukampādāvarthāntare bhavipyati| atha vā--kutsitasya yatkutsanaṃ tatra
pratyayaḥ| kutsitatvaṃ yadā kutsyate--nāsya samyakkutsitatvamiti,
tadetyarthaḥ| yathā--prakarpasya prakarpe prakṛṣṭatama iti tamappratyayo
bhavati tadvadatrāpi| etenānukampitaśabdādanukampāyāṃ pratyayo
vyākhyātaḥ || 

anukampāyām || 5|3|76 ||
kāruṇyeneti| karuṇaiva kāruṇyam| abhyupapatiriti| anugrahaḥ, upakāra
iti yāvat| parasyoti karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī| tasyāṃ gamyamānāyāmiti|
anenagrayoktṛdharmo'nukampā āvādhavad, na tu
praśaṃsādivatprakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇamiti darśayati| anye tu
prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇameva manyante, tathā cājināntasyetyādiṣu vigraha
darśayipyanti--ṭhanukampito vyāvrājinaḥ, anukampito
bṛhaspatidataḥ, anukampitaḥ śevaladataḥ' iti, na ca prayoktṛdharmasya
vigrahe darśanamasti| svapitaki, śvasitakīti| adāditvācchapo luk,
ṭhrudādibhyaḥ sārvadhātuke' itīṭ ||

nītau ca tadyauktāt || 5|3|77 ||
sāmadānādiriti| ādiśabdena bhedadaṇḍayorgrahaṇam, yadyanukampāyāṃ
tau sambhavataḥ| asambhave'pi nītisvarūpapradarśanaparaṃ draṣṭavyam|
ehakīti| āṅpūrvādiṇo loṭ, sipo hiḥ pūrveṇetyādi|
anukampāyāṃ hi vidhīyamānaḥ pratyayaḥ pratyāsateranukampyamānādeva
yukto vidhātum, tasya hi anukampāsambandhaḥ
pratayāsannastadviṣayatvādanukampāyāḥ| tena
vyavahitānnītyupāyāddhānāderna syād; atadviṣayatvādanukampāyāḥ|
tena vyavahitānnītyupāyāddhātāderna syād;
atadviṣayatvādanukampāyāḥ| dhānāśabdaḥ strīliṅgaḥ, tataḥ ke vihate
ṭhke'ṇaḥ' iti hrasvatve ca svāthikānāṃ prakṛtivalliṅgaṃ bhavatīti
kapratyayāntādāpi kṛte ṭhpratyayasthāt' itītvena bhavitavyam| prāyeṇa
tu hanta te dhānakā paṭha|lte, tatra liṅgātivṛttirdraṣṭavyā ||

bahvaco manuṣyanāmnaṣṭhajvā || 5|3|78 ||
prakaraṇamapekṣyate, na tvanantaramityāha--anukampāyāṃ nītau ca
tadyauktāditi vartata iti| madrabāhuka iti| nāmagrahaṇasyedaṃ
pratyudāharaṇam, yaugiko'yam--madrau bāhū yasyeti|
manuṣyagrahaṇasya tu stamberamādiḥ pratyudāharaṇam| apara
āha--madrabāhuriti catuṣpājjātiviśeṣo manuṣyagrahaṇasya
pratyudāharaṇam, nāmagrahaṇasya tvaupagavādiḥ pratyudāharaṇamiti|| 

ghanilacau ca || 5|3|79 || 
cakārādyathāprāptaṃ ceti| nanu ca ṭhac pūrvaṇa vihitaḥ, vāvacanāt
ko'pi, kātra cakāreṇābhyanujñā ? iti cintyam| yogavibhāgo'pi
cintyaprayojanaḥ ||

jātināmnaḥ kan || 5|3|81 ||
yo śabdā jātyantare prasiddhā manuṣyeṣu nāmatvena viniyuktāsta
ihodāharaṇam| jātireva nāma, jātirvā nāmaujātināma| vyāghriya
iti| anekārthatvānnipātānāmanuvṛtasya vāśabdasya samuccayārthatvād
ghanilacau bhavataḥ| ye tu vikalpārthameva vāśabdaṃ manyanate, te kaṃ
pratyudāharanti--vyādhrakāḥ, siṃhakā iti| svare viśeṣaḥ| ghanilacostu
śarabhila ityādyaudāharaṇam ||

ajināntasyotarapadalopaśca || 5|3|82 || 
vyāghrājino nāma kaściditi| vyāghrasyevājinamasyeti kṛtvā|
ṭhajinalopaśca' ityucyamāne mahadajinaṃ mahājinam, vyāghrasyeva
mahājinamasya vyāghramahājinaḥ, so'nukampita vyāghraka ityatra
mahacchabdasya lopo na syāt; tasmādutarapadagrahaṇam| lopaścāyaṃ
sarvāpahārī; utarapadagrahaṇāt ||

ṭhājādāvūrdhvaṃ dvitīyādacaḥ || 5|3|83 ||
ṭhṭhājādau' iti samāhāradvandve sautraḥ puṃlliṅganirddeśaḥ|
ādigrahaṇaṃ cintyaprayojanam, ṭhyasminvidhistadādau' ityeva siddham|
asminprakaraṇa iti| pratyāsatyā tayoreva buddhau sannidhānāditi bhāvaḥ|
ūrdhvamiti prathamāntasyādhyāhāreṇānvaya ityāha--ūrdhvaṃ yacchaśabdarūpaṃ
tasyeti| dvitīyāditi pañcamyā ṣaṣṭhī prakalpyate, prathamā tu
nirdeśārthaiva| ṭhsupāṃ su' iti vā ṣaṣṭhīsthāne prathamā bhavatīti|
ūrdhvagrahaṇamanarthakam, ṭhtasmādityutarasya' ityūdhvasyaiva bhaviṣyati?
tatrāha-ūrdhvagrahaṇaṃ sarvalopārthamiti| anyathā ṭhādeḥ parasya' iti
dvitīyādaco yaḥ parastasyādereva lopaḥ syād,
ūrdhvagrahaṇaṇasāmarthyātu sarvamevordhvaṃ lupyate|
ṭhagrahaṇamanarthakam, ikādeśe kṛte'jādāvityeva siddham? ata
āha--ṭhagrahaṇamiti| akṛta evaikādeśe ṭhāvasthāyāmeva lopo yathā
syād ityevamarthaṃ tāvaṭṭhagrahaṇam, kimevaṃ siddhaṃ bhavati? uko
dvitīyatve sati parasyāṃśasya lope kṛte ṭhisusuktāntātkaḥ' iti
kādeśaḥ siddho bhavati, tatraitatsyād-ikādeśe kṛte'jādilakṣaṇa eva
lopo'stu, ikādeśasya sthānivadbhāvāṭṭhagrahaṇena grahaṇādukaḥ
paratvena kādeśo bhaviṣyati? tatrā''ha--ājādilakṣaṇo hīti|
ṭhajādiṣu yadi varṇamātraṃ pratyayaḥ, akārastūccāraṇārthaḥ, tataṣṭhasya ka
ityatrāpi varṇasyaiva ṭhasya sthānitvam,
tataścālvidhitvātsthānivadbhāvo nopapadyate, saṅghātasya tu
pratyayatve tatrāpi saṅghātasya grahaṇam| tatra yadyapyupapadyate
sthānivadbāvaḥ, tathāpi sannipātaparibhāṣayā kādeśo na syādeva|
ajādeḥ pratyasya prakṛtyā yadānantarthaṃ tatkṛtaṃ hyukaḥ pratyayenānantaryaṃ
tatkathaṃ tasyājāditvaṃ vihanyāt! ata eva mathitaṃ paṇyamasya māthitika
ityatra yasyetilope kṛte satyapi takāreṇa pratyayasyānantarthe
kādeśo na bhavati| tasmāṭṭhagrahaṇaṃ kartavyam| kiñca---yadā
citrabhānuprabhṛtibhyaṣṭhajvidhīyate, tadekādeśābāvādajādilakṣaṇo
lopo na syāditi tadarthamapi ṭhagrahaṇam|
caturthādacca iti| idaṃ saṃgrahaśloka nāsti, kvācitkaṃ caitat|
anajādau vibhāṣā lopo vaktavya iti| dvitīyādaca ūrdhvasyetyeva|
lopaḥ pūvapadasya ceti ślokavātikam,
tasyopaskāraḥ--ṭhājādāvanajādau ca vaktavya iti| tatra ṭhājādau
pūrvotarayoranyatarasya nityaṃ lopaḥ, anajādau vikalpaḥ|
uvarṇālla iti| lopasya ṭhla' iti pūrvācāryasaṃjñā, tatra ṭhādeḥ parasya'
itīkāralopaḥ|
tadāderiti| sandhyakṣarātparasya lope prāpte tata ārabhya lopārthaṃ
vacanam
ekākṣarapūrvapadānāmiti| akṣaraśabdo'yamaci vartate, vyañjanasahite
kevale vā| dvitīyādaca ūrdhvasya lope prāpte tena saha lopārthaṃ
vacanam| vāgāśāriti| vāci āśīryasya sa vāgāśīḥ| vācika iti|
atra yadi dvitīyādaca ūrdhvasya lopaḥ syātadā ṭhakṛtavyūhāḥ
pāṇinīyāḥ' iti paribhāṣayā kutvajaśtvayonivṛtau vācāāika
iti sthite ākārasya yasyetilopena nivṛtāvapi tasya
sthānivadbhāvādākārāntasya bhasaṃjñāyāṃ tvantarvatinīṃ
vibhaktimākṣitya padasaṃjñā, sā cakārāntasyeti
bhinnāvadhikatvādbhasaṃjñayā padasaṃjñā na bādhyate, tataśca
kutvajaśtvayoḥ kṛtayoḥ-vāgika iti syāt| utarapadalope tu
tasyānajādeśatvāt sthānivatvābhāvātulyāvadhikayā bhasaṃjñayā
padasaṃjñāyāstaddhitāśrayāyāstāvadapavādatvādbādhaḥ| yā
tvantarvadhikayā bhasaṃjñayā padasaṃjñāyāstaddhitāśrayāyā
stāvadapavādatvādbādhaḥ| yā tvantarvatinīṃ vibhaktimāśritya subanthaṃ
padamiti padasaṃjñā, tasyā api ekasaṃjñādhikārātparatvācca bādha iti
siddhamiṣṭam |
kathamiti| acāpyutarapadalope kṛte bhasaṃjñayā padasaṃjñāyā
bādhitatvājjaśtvaṃ na syāditi praśnaḥ| ṣaṣa iti| sautra evātra lopa
iṣyate, na tvaupasakhyānika ityarthaḥ |
saṃgrahaślokatṛtīyapāde tathāśabdānantaraṃ vāśabdaḥ pāṭhayaḥ, na
tvevaśabdaḥ,| sa ca pūrvatrāpi yatheṣṭṃa sambandhanīyaḥ, iṣṭṃa ca
pūrvameva darśitam| atra codayati---saṃjñāśabdasyaikadeśe lupte kathaṃ
saṃjñino'vagamaḥ, na hi deva iti vā data iti vā saṃjñā kṛtā, kiṃ
tarhi, devadata iti ? atrāhuḥ--ekadesena samudāye'numīyate,
viṣāṇeneva gauḥ, so'numito'rthasya vācaka iti| nanu
cocyāryamāṇā eva śabdo'rtha pratyāyayati, na pratīyamānaḥ? netyāha;
smṛtyanumiti śrutiḥ ki nārtha pratyāyayati! pratyāhāreṣu vā
madhyavartino varṇāḥ kiṃ savarṇānna pratyāyanti! kiñca---
aśaktijairapabhraṃśaiḥ sādhavaḥ smāritā yathā|
śabdāḥ pratyāyayantyarthaṃ tathātrāpi bhaviṣyati ||
samudāye saṃjñātvena viniyujyamāne'vayavānāmapi
saṃjñātvamamunippadyate| kimarthaṃ tarhi lopo vidhīyate? padānāmeva
saṃjñaikadeśabhūtānāṃ sādhutvaṃ yathā syād, varṇānāṃ mā bhūditi|
uktaṃ ca---
tulyāyāmanuniṣpatau de-ya-so ityasādhavaḥ|
na hyanvākhyāyake śāsre datādivadanusmṛtiḥ ||

śevalasupariviśālavaruṇāryamādīnāṃ tṛtīyāt || 5|3|84 ||
śevalādīnāmityādi| yo'yaṃ śevalādīnāṃ tṛtīyādaca ūrdhvasya
lopa ucyate, so'kṛtasandhīnāmeva vaktavyaḥ| sandhīyate'neneti
saṃhitākāryamucyate || 

hrasve || 5|3|86 ||
yadyapi vaṃśādiṣvalpatvahrasvatvayoḥ samāveśo dṛṣṭaḥ, tathāpi
ghṛtādiṣu dravadravyeṣu na kaścidāha--hrasvaṃ ghṛtam, hrasvaṃ tailamiti;
tathā vistīrṇeṣvāyāmahīneṣu hrasvaḥ paṭa hatyucyate, na
kaścidāha--alpaḥ paṭa iti; tasmādubhayanirdeśaḥ--ṭhalpe', ṭhhrasve' iti || 

kutvā ḍupac || 5|3|87 ||
kutūrityāvapanasyākhyeti| yadyapyāvapanamātrasyākhyā, tathāpi
ḍupacpratyayāntasvabhāvāduktam--carmamayaṃ snehabājanamucyata iti ||

vatsokṣāśvarṣabhebhyaśca tanutve || 5|3|91 ||
ṭhtanutve' iti sāmānyābhidhānātkārśye'pi pratyayaprasaṅgaḥ,
tatrāha--yasya hi guṇasyeti| etacca pratyāsaterlabhyate| pratyāsannaṃ hi
śabdasya pravṛttinimitam| prathamavayā vatsa iti| prathamaṃ vayo
vatsaśabdasya pravṛttinimitamit«athaḥ| tasyeti guṇabhūtamapi vayo'tra
parāmṛśyate, tasya prathamasya vayasa ityarthaḥ| dvitīyavayaḥprāptiriti|
dvitīyaṃ hi vayaḥ prāpnuṣato vatsasya prathamaṃ vayo'lpaśeṣaṃ bhavati|
taruṇa iti| dvitīyavayā ityarthaḥ| tasya tanutvamityādi pūrvavat|
anyapitṛkateti| gardabhapitṛkatetyarthaḥ| gardabena
tvaśvāyāmutpādito'śvatara ucyate| anaḍvāniti| anaso
voḍheatyarthaḥ, anasi vaheḥ kvip, ḍaścānasaḥ ||

kiyatadonirddhāraṇe dvayorekasya ḍatarac || 5|3|92 ||
dvayorekasya nirddhāraṇe kaḍatarajbhavatītyucyate, tatrehāpi
prāpnoti--kayoranyataro devadataḥ, yayoranyataraḥ, tayoranyatara
iti; kimādīnāṃ samudāyavacitve'pi nirddhāraṇasya gamyamānatvāt?
ata āhanirddhāryamāṇavācibhya iti| etaccābhidhānasvabhāvāllabhyete|
kriyayā guṇena saṃjñayā veti| jātyā vetyāpi draṣṭavyam; kataro
bhavatoḥ kaṭa ityāderapi sambhavāt|
samudāyānnirddhāraṇavibhaktiriti| sā punaḥ ṣaṣṭhī, na saptamī; vā
bahūnāmiti darśanāt| ekasyetīti| nirddhāryamāṇanirdeśa iti| nanu
ca dvayorekasyaiva nirddhāraṇaṃ sambhavati, nārtha etena? naitadasti;
ṭhekasya' ityanucyamāne dvayoriti karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī vijñāyeta,
tataścāsmin grāme kau devadatāvityatrāpi prāpnoti|
tasmādekagrahaṇam ||

vā bāhūnā jātiparipraśne ḍatamac || 5|3|93 ||
jātiparipraśnaviṣayebhya iti| jātiparipraśnau yathāsambhavaṃ viṣayau
yeṣāṃ te tathoktāḥ| sūtre punaḥ samāhāradvandvaḥ| sannidhānācca
paripraśno'pi jātereva vijñāyate, yathā--ṭhguṇo yaṅlukoḥ' ityatra
yaṅ ca yaṅlukceti| evaṃ ca kṛtvā jātiparipraśnagrahaṇaṃ kima eva
viśeṣaṇam| ṭhjātigrahaṇaṃ tu sarvairapi sambadhyate' iti
vakṣyamāṇamupapadyate| ṣaṣṭhīsamāse tu guṇabhūtasya jātigrahaṇasya
niṣkṛṣya sambandho'nupapannaḥ syāt|
paripraśnagrahaṇaṃ kṣepanivṛtyartham|
vāvacanamakajarthamiti| kathaṃ tarhi vākyasya siddhiḥ?
tatrāha--mahāvibhāṣetyādi|
kimo'sminviṣaya iti| dvayorekasya nirddhāraṇa uktau bahūnāmekasya
nirddhāraṇe na syāditi vacanam| kathaṃ punariṣyamāṇo'pi labhyate?
tatrā''ha--tatratyādi| nanu kataro bhavatoḥ kaṭha iti dvayorekasya
nirddhāraṇe'pi jātiparipraśnasya sambhavānnānena vacanena
bahūnāmekasya nirddhāraṇe ḍatarac śakyo jñāpayitum? evaṃ
tarhi--ṭhsamāsavidhau katarakatamau jatiparipraśne sādhū bhavataḥ' ityapi
vyākhyeyamiti manyate| ajātiparipraśne'pi kimo ḍatamaj
bhavati--katamo bhavatordeavadata iti, katham ? katarakatamāvityatra
jātiparipraśnagrahaṇāt| yadi hi katamaśabdo jātiparipraśnādanyatra na
syāt, tatastatsāhacaryātkataraśabdo'pi tadarta eva grahīṣyata
ityanarthakaṃ tatsyāt ||

ekācca prācām || 5|3|94 ||
ḍatarajḍatamajityetāviti| kathaṃ punarvyavahitasya ḍataraco'nuvṛttiḥ?
ityāha--cakāra iti| ḍatamacastvanantaratvadevānuvṛttiriti bhāvaḥ|
ṭhsvasminniṣaye' iti yaduktaṃ tadeva vivṛṇoti--dvayornirdhāraṇa iti|
etacca dvayorekasya ḍataraja, bahūnāṃ ḍatamajityanuvṛtervākyabhedena
ca sambandhāllabhyate ||

avakṣepaṇe kan || 5|3|95 ||
avakṣepaḥunindā| vyākaraṇakeneti| yadyapi vyākaraṇaṃ svato vakṣepaṇaṃ
na bhavati, pratyayuta vedāhghatvātpraśaṃsanam; tathāpi yasya
tadavalepamāvahati tasyāvakṣepaṇaṃ bhavatyeva| yājñīkyakena nāmeti|
yājñikānāmāmnāyo yājñikyamukalpasūtrādi| parasyetyādinā
kutsita ityasyāsya ca kano viṣayavibhāgaṃ darśayati ||

ive pratikṛtau || 5|3|96 ||
ivārthaḥ sādṛśyamiti| kan pratyayastu svabhāvātsadṛśe bhavati, na
sādṛśyamātre; yathā-prakāre'pi vihito jātīyar-pratyayastadvati
bhavati | ???????? śeṣaṇaṃ pratikṛtigrahaṇamiti| pratikṛtiviṣayaṃ
yatsādṛsyaṃ tatra pratyayo yathā syātī ko'rthaḥ? pratikṛtisvarūpaṃ
yatsadṛśaṃ yatsadṛśaṃ tatretyarthaḥ| aśva ivāyamaśvapratikṛtiriti!
aśvapratikṛtirūpo'svasadṛśo'yaṃ padārtha ityarthaḥ| aśvaka iti|
kecidāhuḥ--ṭhaśvaśabdo'śva eva vartate, kanpratyayastu pratikṛtirūpe
sadṛśa iti svārthiko'yaṃ na bhavati' iti| apara
āha--ṭhsādṛśyanibandhanādabhedopacārād gaurvāhīka itivad aśvaśabda
eva pratikṛtau vartate, pratyayastu tasyaivopacārasya dyotakaḥ' iti|
gauriva gavaya iti| gavayo gona pratikṛtiḥ,
tṛṇacarmakāṣṭhādinirmitaṃ hi praticchandakamupratikṛtiḥ, na caivaṃ
gavayaḥ ||

lummuṣye || 5|3|98 ||
cañcāutṛṇapuruṣaḥ, tatsadṛśo manuṣyaścañcā| lupi yuktavadbhāvaḥ|
ṭhmanuṣyalupi pratiṣedhaḥ' ityetatu viśeṣaṇaviṣayam ||

jīvikārthe cāpaṇye || 5|3|99 ||
vāsudevaḥ, śiva ityādi| yāḥ pratimāḥ pratigṛhya gṛhād gṛhaṃ
bhikṣamāṇā aṭanti tā evamucyante, tā hi jīvikārthā bhavanti|

devapathādibhyaśca || 5|3|100 ||
ādiśabdaḥ prakāre iti| tena kiṃ siddhaṃ bhavati?
ityāhāakṛtigaṇo'yamiti|
arcāsūpratimāsu, pūjanārthāsu gṛheṣvāyataneṣu vā yāḥ pūjyante
tāsu, citrakarmadhvajābhyāṃ tadgatāḥ pratikṛtayo lakṣyante || 

samāsācca tadviṣayāt || 5|3|106 ||
tadityanena prakṛta ivārtho niddiśyate iti| cchapratyayastu pradhānatayā
prakṛto'pi na parāmṛśyate, anenaiva tasya vidhānāt, samāsasya
tadviṣayatvānupapateḥ| aparasminnivārtha eveti| evakāraḥ
paunarvacanikaḥ| śasrīśyāmādau tveka ivārthaḥ samāse'ntarbhūta iti
chāe na bhavati| ajākṛpāṇīyamiti| ajāyā gacchantyāḥ kṛpaṇenādhaḥ
patatā yathā vadhastatsadṛśamityarthaḥ| andhakavatikīyamiti|
vartikāuśakuniviśeṣaḥ, tasyā andhahaste patanaṃ grahaṇaṃ ca yādṛcchikaṃ
tādṛgityarthaḥ|
atakiṃtopapannamiti| acintitopapannam yādṛcchikamityarthaḥ|
citrīkaraṇamuvismayakaraṇam| kathamiti| sāmānyenāyamarthaḥ
kathamucyata ityarthaḥ|
samāsaścāyamityādi| ki punaḥ kāraṇaṃ jñāpakātsamāsasadbhāvaḥ
pratipādyate ? ityata āha--na hyasteti| sa ca evaṃviṣaya eveti|
cchapratyaviṣaya evetyarthaḥ| ananyatra bhāvo viṣayārthaḥ; tena
svātantryamupādhyantarayogoḥ, vigrahaśca na bhavati ||

ekaśālāyāṣṭhajanyatarasyām || 5|3|109 ||
anekārthatvannipātānāmanyatarasyāṃgrahaṇamiha samuccayārtham, na
vikalpārthamityāha--anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇenetyādi ||

karkalohitādikak || 5|3|110 ||
svayamalohita ityādi| upāśrayaḥūpādānabhūto lākṣādiḥ ||

pratnapūrvaviśvemātthāl cchandasi || 5|3|111 ||
ima śabda idamā samānārthaḥ prakṛtyantaram ||

pūgāñ ñyo'grāmaṇīpūrvalāt || 5|3|112 ||
pūgavācina iti| svarūpagrahaṇaṃ tu na bhavati; ṭhagrāmaṇīpūrvāt' iti
vacanāt| pūrvaśabdo hyavavavacanaḥ, na ca pūgaśabdasya grāmaṇīvacano
devadatādiśabdaḥ pūrvāvayava upapadyate| lohadhvajā iti|
ṭhñyādayastadrājāḥ' iti tadrājasaṃjñā, ṭhtadrājasya bahuṣu' iti luk|
devadatakā iti| ṭhsa eṣāṃ grāmaṇīḥ' iti kan, atra devadataśabdo
grāmaṇīvacanaḥ pūrvo'vayavaḥ, samudāyaḥ pūgavacanaḥ ||

vrātacphañorastriyām || 5|3|113 ||
utsedhajīvitvaṃ vrātasya pūgādviśeṣaḥ| kauñjāyanīti| ṭhgotre
kuñjādibhyaścphañ', ṭhgotraṃ ca caraṇaiḥ saha' iti jātitvānṅīṣ
||

āyudhajīvisaṅghāñ ñyaḍ vāhīkeṣvabrāhmaṇarājanyāt || 5|3|114 ||
yadā vāhīkaśabdaḥ puruṣepu vartate, tadā ṭhvāhīkeṣu' iti
nirddhāraṇe saptamī, yadā tu deśe tadā'dhikaraṇe|
brāhmaṇe tadviśeṣagrahamamiti| svarūpagrahaṇaṃ tu na bhavati;
brāhmaṇaśabdavācyasyāyudhajīvisaṅghasya vāhīkeṣvabhāvāt| rājanye tu
svarūpagrahaṇamiti| tadvācyasyaiva bhāvāt| tenāstriyāmiti
nānuvartata iti| tena striyāmapi--kauṇḍībṛsī, kṣaudrakī, mālavīti
bhavati| ṭhhalastaddhitasya' iti yalopaḥ ||

dāmanyāditrigartaṣaṣṭhācchaḥ || 5|3|114 ||
ṭhdāmanyāditrigartaṣaṣṭhāt' iti samāhāradvandvaḥ,
dāmanyāderāyudhajīvisaṅghātrigartaṣaṣṭhāccāyudhajīvisaṅghādityanvayaḥ| trigartaṣaṣṭhādityasyārthamāha--yeṣāmiti| antavargāḥuantragaṇaḥ| te punaḥ ke? ityāhateṣu cāa sbhṛtiriti| trigartaṣaṣṭhāḥ smaryanteujñāpyante'nayeti smṛtiḥ|
sā punaḥ-āhustrigartaṣṣaṭhānityādiḥ ślokaḥ| atra
jānakayastrigartavargāḥ, teṣu ca trigartaṣaṣṭhetaṣu, prathamapañcamau
śivādyaṇantau, śeṣāstu iñantāḥ| kecitu-ataddhitāntameva pañcamaṃ
brahmaguptaśabdaṃ paṭhanti ||

parśvādiyaudheyādibyo'ṇañau || 5|3|115 ||
pārśva ityādi| parśū, rakṣas, asura--ityete janapadaśabdāḥ,
tatrākārāntādbahuṣvapatyeṣu ṭhjanapadaśabdātkṣatriyādañ' ityañ,
itarābhyām ṭhdvyañmagadha' ityādināṇ, tadrājatvālluk, punaḥ
saṅghavivakṣāyāmanenāṇ| yaudheya iti| yudhete'sau,
yudherigupadhalakṣaṇaḥ kaḥ--yudhā, tasya apatyam ṭhdvyacaḥ' iti ḍhak,
tadantātsaṅgharūpavivakṣāyāmanenāñ--yaudheya ityādyaudātaṃ bhavati|
tathā yaudheyasyāṅko lakṣaṇaṃ vā yaudheya
iti--saṅghāṅkalakṣaṇeṣvañlakṣaṇo'ṇ bhavati| etena yaudheyādiṣu
ye ḍhagantāste sarve vyākhyātāḥ| yaudheyādīnāmasminpradeśe na pāṭhaḥ,
paṭhitā hi te caturthe--ṭhna prācyabhārgādiyaudheyādibhyaḥ' ityatra || 

abhijidvidabhṛcchālāvacchikhāvacchamīvadūrṇāvacch4%amadaṇo yañ || 5|3|116
||
abhijayatītyabhijit, vetīti vidaḥ, igupadhalakṣaṇaḥ kaḥ, tānbibhartīti
vidabhṛt, anye manvantāḥ| abhijidādibhyo'ṇantebhya iti|
sūtre'bhijidādaya evāṇiti viśeṣaṇa samāsaḥ|
abhijidādiprakṛtayaścāṇantā abhijidādayaḥ ucyante|
gotrapratyayasyeti| apatyapratyayasyetyarthaḥ| ābhijito muhūrta iti|
ṭhnakṣatreṇa yuktaḥ' ityaṇ, utarasya--ṭhsāsya devatā' iti|
ihābhijityasyāyam ābhijitaka iti ṭhgotracaraṇādvuñ' bhavati,
ṭhāpatyasya' iti yalopaḥ| gotrapratyayāntāddhyayamiṣyate| tena
svārthikatvādayamapi yañ gotrapratyaya eva bhavati ||

iti śrīharadatamiśraviracitāyāṃ padamañjaryāṃ pañcamasyādhyāyasya
tṛtīyaḥ pādaḥ ||
--------------ai namonārāyanāya namaḥ

kāśikāvṛtti
atha pañcamādhyāye caturthaḥ pādaḥ

pādaśatasya saṃkhyādervīpsāyāṃ vunlopaśca || 5|4|1 ||
ādiśabdo'yamavayavavācī, na tu vyavasthāvācī; ṭhsaṃkhyāyāḥ' iti
pañcamīnirdeśenaiva siddheḥ| na ca saṃkhyāvacanaḥ śabdaḥ
pādaśataśabdayoravayava upapadyate; anārambhakatvāt|
tasmātsaṃkhyāderiti vacanādiha grahamavatāpi prātipadikena
tadantavidhirvijñāyata ityāha--pādaśatāntasyeti| ānantaryalakṣaṇā ceyaṃ
ṣaṣṭhī vunvidhau, lopavidhau tu sthānaṣaṣṭhī| tatsaṃniyogena ceti|
cakārasya saṃniyogārthakatvāt|
anaimitikatvārthamiti| nimite bhavo naimitikaḥ, adhyātmādiḥ|
yasyotilopaḥ paranimitaka iti| īti taddhite ca parato
lopavidhānāt| padbhāvo na syāditi| pacchabdo hi tatra
sthānyupātaḥ, sthānivatve ca sati pādaśabdāntamaṅgaṃ bhasaṃjñaṃ bhavati,
na pācchabdāntamiti pādāyetyādivadatrāpi padbhāvo na syāt| asya
tvanaimitikatvāditi| na hyatra vunnimitam; sahavidhānāt|
dvipadikāmiti| taddhitena dyotitatvādvīpsāyāṃ dvirvacanaṃ na bhavati|
taddhitārtha iti samāsa iti| prakṛtyupādhirapi vīpsā vunā dyotyata
iti taddhitārtho bhavati|
dvau pādau dadātīti| utarasūtrevakṣyati--ṭhdānaṃ vyavasargeḥ' iti,
ṭhavīpsārtho'yamārambhaḥ' iti ca, tasmādbhavitavyamatra vunā|
kriyāntaraṃ pratyudāhartavyam-dvau pādau labhata ityādi|
apara āha--daḍito vyavasṛjatīti prayoga evotaro'vidhiriti|
yadvāparasvatvāpādanaṃ dānamuvyavasargaḥ, iha tu samarpaṇamātre
dadātirvartate; yatharajakasya vastraṃ dadātīti|
anyatrāpi darśanāditi| dvau dvau māṣau dadātītyādau
tvanabhidhānādatiprasaṅgabhāvaḥ ||

daṇḍavyavasargayośca || 5|4|2 ||
daṇkaḍanaṃ daṇḍa iti| ṭhdamu upaśamane' ityasmādbhāve ṭhñamantāḍuḥ'
daṇḍatervā curādiṇyantāderac| yadyapi daṇkaḍaśabdaḥ karaṇasādhano
yaṣṭāvapi vartate, tathāpi tasya grahaṇaṃ na bhavati; dhātvarthena
vyavasargeṇa sāhacaryāt| atrāpyudāharaṇe ṭhtaddhitārtha' iti samāsaḥ
strīliṅgastaddhitārthaḥ| uktaṃ ca-ṭhsvabhāvācca vunpratyayaḥ striyāṃ
vartate' iti| kathaṃ tarhi dāne vīpsāyāṃ vunpūrvasūtra udāhṛtaḥ,
yāvatā nāprāpte vīpsāyā
vunyārabhyamāṇo'vīpsāvunetayorarthayostasya bādhakaḥ prāpnoti,
yathā ṭhmatibuddhipūjārthebhyaśca' iti ṭhvartamāne ktaḥ'---bhūtaktasya, yathā
ca ṭhavṛddhādapi' ityapiśabdaḥ kriyate? ihāpi tarhi cakāraḥ kriyate,
tenādhikavidhirayamabādhakaḥ| evamapi paratvādanenaiva dāne vīpsāyāṃ
vunyuktaḥ? satyam; aviśeṣātu pūrvatrodāhṛtaḥ| yadvā--dānasya
padāntaravācyatvādeṣa vunbahiraṅgaḥ, vīpsāyāstu
tadvitadyotyatvātpūrvo vunnantaraṅgaḥ ||

sthūlādibhyaḥ prakāravacane kan || 5|4|3 ||
prakāravacane dyotya iti| prakāravacane kan dyotya ityarthaḥ| yathaudanaṃ
pacatītyatraivārthe odanapākaṃ pacatīti| yadvā-prakāraucyate
sthūlādibhiriti dyotanāyetyarthaḥ| prakāravācibhyaḥ kan bhavati,
tadeva prakāravacanatvaṃ dyotayitumiti yāvat| jātīyaro'pavāda
iti| tenāyamapi tadvadeva prakāravati kabhavati, na prakāramātra ityuktaṃ
bhavati| prakāraḥubhedaḥ, sādṛśyaṃ ca, ubhayatrāpi yathābhidhānaṃ kan
bhavati| vṛtau tu prakāro bheda ityupalakṣaṇam|
cañcadbṛhatoriti| etāvapi sthūlādiṣu paṭhitavyāvityuktaṃ bhavati|
cañcatka iti| cañcatiścalanakarmā cañcatprakāraścañcannevaṃ kaścidviśeṣa
ucyate| tathā bṛhadviśeṣo bṛhatkaḥ| apara āha--sādṛśye'tra kan,
acañcannapi yaścañcanniva lakṣyate sa bṛhatka iti| cañcāubṛṇamayaḥ
puruṣaḥ, tatsadṛśaścañcakaḥ| ṭhke'ṇaḥ' iti hrasvaḥ|
sthūlāṇumāṣeṣviti| sthūla, aṇu, ṇāpa, ipu--iti catasraḥ prakṛtayaḥ
kṛṣṇatileṣviti| kṛṣṇaprakārāstilāḥ kṛṣṇakāḥ| yavakāḥ yavasadṛśāḥ|
pādyakālāvadātāḥ surāyāmiti| pādyikā, kālikā, avadātikā,
surāviśeṣā ete| gomūtrakamugomūtraprakāraṃ
gomūtravarṇamācchādanam| yadvā--vinyāsaviśeṣo gomūtram,
tatsadṛśaṃ tu gomūtrakam| yatra tu śuklakṛṣṇādivarṇavinyāsaḥ
surāvarṇo'hiḥ surakaḥ, pūrvavad hrasvaḥ| jīrṇaprakārāḥ jīrṇakalpāḥ
śālayo jīrṇakāḥ|
jātīyaro'nantaramevāyaṃ kan vidheyaḥ, evaṃ hi punaḥ ṭhprakāravacane'
iti na vaktavyaṃ bhavati| iha tu karaṇe'jñātaḥ sthūlaprakāra iti
prakārasyājñātādīnāṃ ca yugapadvivakṣāyāṃ paratvādanena kani kṛte
punaḥ prasaṅgavijñānādajñātādidyotanāya punaḥ ko bhavati| tatra tu
karaṇe paratvātke kṛte punaḥ prasaṅgavijñānādajñātādidyotanāya
puna ko bhavati| tatra tu karaṇe paratvātke kṛte kanna syāt;
śabdāntaratvāt| satyapi vā kani sthūlakaka ityādyaudātaṃ syāt ||

anatyantagatau ktāt || 5|4|4 ||
aśeṣasambandha iti| ktaprakṛtivācyayā kriyayā sādhanasya
vyāptirityarthaḥ| bhinnakamiti| īṣadbhinnamityarthaḥ|
bhinnamiti| yadaśeṣaṃ bhidikriyāyā vyāptaṃ ghaṭādi tadabhidhīyate|
ihānatyantagateḥ prakarṣasya ca yugapadvivakṣāyāṃ pūrvavipratiṣedhena
pūrvamātiśāyika iṣyate, tadantātkanvaktavyaḥ, aktāntatvāddhi na
prāpnoti--bhinnatarakaṃ cchinnatarakamiti| āha ca--ṭhanatyantagatau
ktāntātamabādayaḥ pūrvavipratiṣiddhaṃ tadantācca svārthe kanvacanam'
iti| svārthaḥ punaranatyantagatiyukta eva, na śuddhaḥ| tathā hi sati
anatyantagatirdyotitā na syāt ||

na sāmivacane || 5|4|5 ||
sāmyartha ucyate'nena tatsāmivacanam| sāmivacane upapade iti|
upoccāritaṃ padamupapadam, tacca samāsāvayavabhūtaṃ satkevalaṃ
gṛhyate| sāmikṛtamiti| ṭhsāmi' iti samāsaḥ| arddhakṛtaṃ
nemakṛtamiti| viśeṣaṇasamāsaḥ, bahuvrīhirvā|
prakṛtyabhihitatvāditi| kā punaratra prakṛtirabhipretā ? na
tāvatsamāsaḥ, aktāntatvāt, na hi sāmikṛtādayaḥ ktāntāḥ;
pratyayagrahaṇe tadādiniyamāt| na ca kṛdgrahaṇaparibhāṣayā
ktāntatvam; sāmyādīnāmagatitvād, akārakatvācca| atha yadatra ktāntaṃ
sā prakṛtiḥ? tadapi na; hi samāse ekārthībhūtasya pṛthak
prakṛtitvabhūpapadyate| atha vākyagataḥ kṛtādiśabdaḥ prakṛtiḥ? evamapi
prakṛtyabhihitatvādityanupapannam| evaṃ tu
vaktavyam--upapadenābhihitatvāditi?
atrāhuḥ--vākyagatātkṛtādiśabdāt, samāsāvayavādvā prasaṅga
śaṅkyate|
yatūktam--prakṛtyabhihitatvādityanupannamupapadenābhihitatvāditi
vaktavyamiti? satyam; śabdāntareṇābhihitatvād dyotyābhāvātkanaḥ
prasaṅgo nāstītyarthaḥ| yadapyuktam--samāsa ekārthībūtasya
pṛthakprakṛtitvāsambhava iti ? tadapi na; prakṛtyarthasya
pratyayārthenaikārthībhāve sati prakṛtitvam| na
cārthāntareṇaikārthībhūtasya pratyayārthenaikārthībhāvaḥ sambhavatīti kila
prakṛtitvāsambhavaḥ syāt| na cātra pratyayasyā dyot vācyaṃ
vā'rthāntaramasti, yena sahaikārthībhāvaḥ prārthyeta|
tasmādupapannamekārthībhūtasyāpi prakṛtitvam| ata eva vṛtau samāsa
udāhaḥtaḥ|
kena punariti| svārthamātre kanvidheḥ pratyakṣeṇādarśanātpraśnaḥ|
anumāsvata ityutaram| yadetadutyata iti| bhāṣyakāraiḥ ucyata iti,
prayujyata ityarthaḥ, bhāṣyakāraprayoga upapanno bhavatīti yāvat|
sākṣisthānīyasya bhāṣyakāraprayogaḥ, na punaranyatra svārthe kan na
bhavatīti ||

bṛhatyā āccādane || 5|4|6 ||
bṛhatikāuprāvāraḥ ||

aṣaḍakṣāśitaṅgvalaṅkarmālampuruṣādhyutarapadātkhaḥ || 5|4|7 ||
avidyamānāni ṣaḍakṣīṇi yasminniti bahuvrīhiriti| akṣiśabdo'tra
śrotrendriye vartate ṭhbahuvrīhau sakathyakṣaṇoḥ' iti ṣac|
mantraḥumantraṇam, yad dvābyāmeva kriyata iti, tribhistu kriyamāṇaḥ
ṣaḍakṣo bhavati, catuḥprabhṛtibhistu kriyamāṇasya yadyapyaṣṭākṣatvādi
sambhavati, tathāpyavarjanīyarūpeṇa ṣaḍakṣatvamapi bhavati| tasmād
dvābhyāmeva kriyamāṇo'ṣaḍakṣīṇo bhavati| āśitā iti|
aśnoterāṅpūrvādāśitaḥ karteti jñāpakātkartari ktaḥ|
yadvā--ṇyantātkarmaṇi| āśitaṅgavīnamaraṇyamiti|
prabhūtayavasamityarthaḥ|
adhiśabdaḥ śauṇḍādiṣu paṭha|lta iti| yatra ṭhadhirīśvare' ityadheḥ
karmapravacanīyatvād ṭhyasya ceśvaravacanam' iti saptamyantā
rājādayo'dhinā samasyante| vākyamapi bhavati| rājanyadhi,
rājādhīnamiti| yathā--adhi brahmadate pañcālā iti, adhiśabdaśca
vṛttiviṣaye īśitavye vartate| apara āha--adhikaraṇe eṣā saptamī,
vṛttiviṣaye ca sasādhanakriyāvacano'dhiḥ, na tu vākya ityasvapadena
vigrahaḥ, vṛttiviṣaye ca sasādhanakriyāvacano'dhiḥ, na tu vākya
ityasvapadena vigrahaḥ, rājanyadhikṛtaṃ rājādhīnam, rājāyatamityartha
iti| utarasūtre vibhāṣāgrahaṇāditi| dvayorvibhāṣayormadhye nityā
vidhaya iti nyāyāt |
tamabādaya iti| ṭhatiśāyane tamabiṣṭhanau' ityādayaḥ| prākkana iti|
ṭhavakṣepaṇe kan' ityasmāt śukla ityukte
sāmānyaśabdatvātprakarṣasyānavagamātatadupādhidyotanāyāvaśyaṃ
prayojyāstamabādaya iti nityāḥ| atiśayena śukla ityādikaṃ tu
vākyaṃ bhavatyeva; padāntaradyotyatvādatiśayasya| ñjādaya iti|
ṭhpūgāññyo'grāmaṇīpūrvāt' ityādayaḥ| prāgvuna iti|
pādaśatādiśūtravihitāt, tasya tu purā vigraho darśita eva|
āmādaya iti| ṭhkimetiṅvyayaghādāmu' ityādayaḥ, ṭhtatprakṛtavacane
mayaṭ' ityataḥ prāgityarthaḥ| bṛhatījātyantā iti| bṛhatīśabdena
ṭhbṛhatyā ācchādane' iti vihitaḥ kanupalakṣyate|
jātyantaśabdenāpiṭhjātyantāccha badhuni' iti vihitaścchaḥ|
bahuvacananirddeśādetatsūtravihitasya khasyapāśabādīnāṃ ca
grahaṇam| yo hi vaiyākaraṇapāśāditatsūtravihitasya khasya
pāśabādīnāṃ ca grahaṇam| yo hi vaiyākaraṇapāśādiśabdebhyo'rthaḥ
pratīyate, nāsau jātucit vaiyākaraṇādisāmānyaśabdebhyaḥ pratīyata
iti te'pi tamabādivannityā eva| samāsānta śceti| ṭhsamāsāntāḥ'
ityadhikṛtya vihitāḥ ||

vibhāṣāñceradikstriyām || 5|4|8 ||
dik cāsau strī ceti dikstrī, tatra pratiṣedhaḥ na tu diśi striyāṃ
ca; strīliṅgaikavacananirdeasāt| udāharaṇeṣu ṭhacaḥ' ityakāralope
kṛte ṭhcau' iti dīrghaḥ| udīcīnamityatra tūda ṭhuda īt' itītvam|
diggrahaṇaṃ kimiti| añjatyantaḥ striyāṃ vatamāno diśyeva vartata
iti praśnaḥ| prācīnā brāhāmaṇīti| kriyānimitako
deśakālanimitako vā brāhmaṇyāṃ striyāṃ vartate, na diśīti
pratiṣedhābhāvaḥ| strīgrahaṇaṃ kimiti| digvṛttirañcatyantaḥ strīliṅga
eveti manyate| prācīnaṃ digraṇaṇīyamiti| prācīnaśabdāddigvācinaḥ
prathamāsamarthād dikśabdebhya ityutpannasyāstāteḥ ṭhañcerluk' iti
luk, ṅīpo'pi ṭhluk taddhitaluki' iti luk, tataḥ
ṭhtaddhitaścāsarvavibhaktiḥ' ityavyayatvātstrīliṅgābhāvaḥ| khe tu kṛte
svabhāvādeva napuṃsakatvam ||

jātyantāccha bandhuni || 5|4|9 || 
jātyantātprātipadikād bandhuni vartamānātsvārthe cchaḥ pratyayo yasya
bandhuśabdasyeti darśayati| etacca napuṃsakanirddeśādavasīyate,
āptaparyāyastu puṃlliṅgaḥ| yena brāhmaṇatvādijātirvyajyata iti|
vyaktyadhīnā hi jātarabhivyaktiḥ, na hi svātantryeṇa
jātucijjātirupalabhyate| etadevābhipretya--badhyate'sminniti
bandhivatyuktam| brāhmaṇajātīya iti| bhāvapradhāno'tra brāhmaṇaśabdaḥ,
ṭhdvyokayoḥ' itivat, tena bahuvrīhiḥ| brāhmaṇādirevocyate iti|
brāhmaṇatvajātyādhāro dravyātmakaḥ piṇḍa ucyaya ityarthaḥ| 
brāhmaṇajātiriti| ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ, karmadhārayo vā ||

sthānāntādvibhāṣā sasthāneneti cet || 5|4|10 ||
sasthānena cediti| karaṇe eṣā tṛtīyā, sasthānena
sasthānaśabdavācyenārthena tulyaparyāyeṇa sthānāntaṃ yadyarthavadbhavati,
evaṃ pratyayo bhati, nānyatetyartha| sasthāna iti tulya ucyata iti|
stānata iti śeṣaḥ| sthānamuprāptiḥ, sambandhaviśeṣaḥ, padamiti yasya
prasiddhaiḥ| kathaṃ punaḥ sasthānaśabdena tulya ucyate? ityāha--sāmānaṃ
sthānamasyeti| yasya samānaṃ sthānaṃ sa sasthāna ityucyate yaścaivaṃvidhaḥ
sa yadapakṣayā tasya samānaṃ sthānaṃ tena tulyo bhavati, tatra
śabdabhede'pi ????tuvṛtena sasthānaśabdasya tulyo vācyo bhavati|
sabhāvaḥ punaratra ṭhjyotirjanapada' ityādi sūtreṇa| pitṛstānīya iti|
pituriva sthānamasyeti bahuvrīhiḥ|
gosthānamiti| tiṣṭhatyasminnati sthānaṃ deśaḥ na tu tatpuruṣa iti|
samānaṃ ca tatsthānaṃ cetyevaṃrūpastatpuruṣaḥ| sthānaśabdo
nārthamupasthāpayati| yadyaupasthāpayet, tulyaṃ ca tatsthānaṃ ca
tulyasthānamityādeḥ karmadhārayādapi pratyayaḥ syāt| atha
bahuvrīhestulyasthānaśabdātsasthānaśabdādvā'yaṃ pratyayaḥ karamānna
bhavati? kaḥ punarāhaḥ-na bhavatīti! neṣyate iti karaṇādeva tu na
bhaviṣyati| cecchabdaḥ sambandhārtha iti| cecchabde sati
vibhaktivipariṇānenaidhyāhareṇa vā vākyaparyasānena ca sambandho
bhavati| asati tu tasminpañcamyantena tṛtīyāntasya sambandho'nupapannaḥ
syāt ||

kimetiṅvyaghādāmvadravyaprakarṣe || 5|4|11 ||
kima ekārāntādityādi| arthapradarśanaparametat, sūtre tu
ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ, yogavibhāgādvā pañcamīsamāsaḥ| yadyapīti| dravyaṃ
viśeṣyaṃ paryavasānabhūtam, tasya svarūpeṇa prakarṣo nāsti,
pravṛttimitadvāraka eva tu tasya prakarṣaḥ, yathoktaṃ bhāṣye--guṇasyaiva
prakarṣo na dravyasyeti| guṇaḥ pravṛttinimitam| harirapyāha--- 
dravyasyāvyapadeśyasya na vinā bhedahetunā|
prakarṣo vidyate nāpi śabdasyopaiti vācyatām ||
kriyāguṇasya iti| pravṛttinimitabhūtasya sahacaritasya
dharmamātrasyopalakṣaṇaṃ kriyāguṇagrahaṇam| dravya ucyata iti|
dravyaniṣṭho'bhidhīyata ityarthaḥ| kriyāguṇayoreveti| yo
dravyaniṣṭhayoranuvidhīyate sa tayoreva prakarṣaḥ| kiṃtarāmiti| idaṃ
ca kimidaṃ ca kim, idamanayoratiśayena kim iti tarap pratyayaḥ|
yatra svarūpeṇa jñātasya vastuno viśeṣākārā bahavo jijñāsitāstatra
kiṃśabdārthaḥ praśnaprakṛṣṭa iva bhavati, tadāśrayaḥ pratyayaḥ|
pūrvāhṇetarāmiti| ṭhghakālataneṣu' iti saptamyā aluk|
tatrāsatvabhūtasya vibhaktyarthasya prakarṣaḥ, na kālasyeti nāyaṃ
dravyaprakarṣaḥ |
uccaistarāmiti| ātrāpyucacaiḥśabdasyādhikaraṇapradhānatvānnāyaṃ
dravyaprakarṣaḥ| utcaistaraḥ parvata iti| nātrādhikaraṇapradhāna uccaiḥśabdaḥ,
kiṃ tarhi? uccaistvaṃ nāma guṇastadgataḥ prakarṣaḥ
parvataniṣṭho'bhidhīyate, svabhāvācca tarabantasyātra
satvabhūtārthābhidāyitvam, liṅgasaṃkhyāyogaśca|
uditkaraṇaṃ kim? ṭhāmi sarvanāmnaḥ suṭ' ityatrāsya sāmānyagrahaṇaṃ
mā bhūt| yadi syāt? kintarāmityatra paratvādyasyetilopaṃ bādhitvā
ṭhhrasvanadyāpaḥ' iti nuṭ prasajyeta, makārasya tvitsaṃjñā
prayojanābhāvādeva na bhaviṣyatīti ||

amu cacchandasi || 5|4|12 ||
pratarāmiti| praśabdārthasya prakarṣasya prakarṣe tarap prakṛṣṭatara
itivat| atrāapyuditkaraṇam ṭhica ekāco'mpratyayavacca' ityatrāsyāpi
grahaṇaṃ mā bhūditi| yadi syādatrāpi yad dṛṣṭṃa kāryaṃ
tadapyatidiśyeta, tatra ko doṣaḥ? iha--striyammanyaḥ, yasyetilopaḥ
prāpnoti ||

anugādinaṣṭhak || 5|4|13 ||
anugadatītyanugādī, asmādeva nipātanāṇṇiniḥ,
prakṛtisvarūpapradarśanaparaṃ caitat| na tvayaṃ kevalaḥ prayogārhaḥ;
ṭhako nityatvāt |

ṇacaḥ striyāmañ || 5|4|14 ||
vyāvakrośīti| vyavapūrvātkruśerṇac, ṭhkṛdgrahaṇe
gatikārakapūrvasyāpi grahaṇam' ṇajante'nupraveśātsamudāyādañ,
tasyāṅgatvādādivṛddhiḥ| ṭhna yvābhyāṃ padāntābhyām' ityeṣa vidhirna
bhavati; ṭhna karmavyati hāre' iti niṣedhāt|
tata iti| ṇacaḥ, ṇajantādityarthaḥ| svārtikastatraiva bhaviṣyatīti|
ṭhsvārthikāḥ prakṛtito liṅgavacanānyanuvartante' iti kṛtvā|
ativartante'pīti| vyabhicarantyapītyarthaḥ| apiśabdādanuvartante'pi,
anuvṛttistu ṭhkāsūgoṇībhyāṃ ṣṭharac' iti
ṣitkaraṇānṅīṣarthādavasīyate| ekāntato nivṛte hi
ṣakāro'rthako bhavet, tenetyādinā jñāpanasya prayojanaṃ darśayati|
prasannāusurāviśeṣaḥ| devateti| devaśabdātpuṃlliṅgādeva tal ||

aṇinuṇaḥ || 5|4|15 ||
saṃrāviṇamiti| ṭhru śabde,' ṭhkūṭa dāhe' dīrdhopadhaḥ, ṭhmṛjūṣ
śuddhau'--etebyaḥ saṃpūrvebya inuṇ, pūrvavatsagateraṇ,
ṭhinaṇyanapatye' iti prakṛti bhāvaḥ, ekānubandhakaparibhāṣayā
ghinuṇo'tra grahaṇābhāvaḥ ||

visāriṇo matsye || 5|4|16 ||
visārīti| pūrvavaṇṇiniḥ| vaisāriṇa iti| pūrvavatprakṛtibhāvaḥ ||

saṃkhyāyāḥ kriyābhyāvṛttigaṇane kṛtvasuc || 5|4|17 ||
atra ṭhupāya evābhyupāyaḥ' itivad
āvṛttirevābhyāvṛttirityāśrīyamāṇe ādyā''vṛttirna bhavatīti
ṣaṭkṛtvaḥ pravṛtau pañcakṛtva iti syāt, abhigrahaṇaṃ cānarthakam,
kriyāvṛttigaṇana ityeva vācyaṃ syāt, ato'tra vivakṣitaṃ vaktavyam?
tadāha--paunaḥ punyamabhyāvṛttiriti| punaḥ punarbhavitari
vartamānāt punaḥpunaḥśabdātpravṛttinimitasya bhavanasya
niṣkṛṣyābhidhānāya bāvapratyaya| paunaḥpunyamupunaḥ
purbhavanamityarthaḥ, asakṛtpravṛttiriti yāvat| tatra cādyā
pravṛttirantarbhavati, tadyathā--paunaḥpunyaṃ bhṛsārtho vā kriyāsamabhihāra
ityatra yo'pi dviḥ pacati tatrāpi pāpacyate iti bhavati| uktamevārthaṃ
spaṣṭayatiekakartṛkāṇāmiti| bahuvacanamatantram| dvayorapi
jananasaṃkhyānamāvṛttirbhavatyeva jananasaṃkhyānamūtpatigaṇanam|
bhinnakartṛkāsu bhinnajātīyāsu ca kriyāsu
nirantaramanuṣṭhīyamānāsvapi
kriyābyāvṛttipratyayābhāvādubhayamupātam| evambhūtānāṃ kriyāṇāṃ
janmana utpateryatsaṃkhyānaṃ gaṇanaṃ tatkriyābhyāvṛttigaṇanam|
etaccābhyāvṛttiśabdasya tatraiva prasiddherlabhyate, ata eva abhigrahaṇaṃ
kṛtam| pañcakṛtvo bhuṅkte iti| ekaivātra bhujikriyā
nivṛtabhedākhyātenaabhidhīyate, āvṛtyājaniyena
phalenaikīkṛtatvāt tasyā utpatayaḥ pañcasaṃkhyānena gaṇayante|
āvṛttikṛtaṃ phalamicchanbhujikriyāyāḥ pañcotpatyāvṛttīḥ
karotītyarthaḥ| avāntaraphalāpekṣaṃ pañcatvam, utpattibhedaśca|
bhūrivārāniti| vāraśabdasya kriyotpatyādhārajālavācitvāt
ṭhkālādhvanoḥ' iti dvitīyā| tathā ca
punaḥpunaḥśabdādutpatyādhārakālābhidhāyitvāt ṭhkālāṭṭhañ'
bhavati--paunaḥpunika iti| yadi kālaśabdaḥ, vāraśabdaḥ,
bhūriśabdo'pi tatsamānādhikaraṇaḥ kāla eva vartate, na
kriyābhyāvṛtāviti kathamatra prasaṅgaḥ? atrāhuḥ--kālṛvācitve'pi
kriyāvṛterapi gamyamānatvātprasaṅga iti| apara āha---vāraśabdaḥ
kriyāgatāmāvṛtti dyotayan kriyāviseṣaṇatvātkarma| napuṃsakatvaṃ tu
na bhavati, lokāśrayatvālliṅgasya; vāraśabdasya
nityapuṃlliṅgatvāt--bhūrivārān bhuṅkte| ko'rthaḥ? āvṛtāni
bahūnibhojanāni karotītyarthaḥ| atra ṭhbahugaṇavatuḍatisaṃkhyā' ityatra
bahugaṇagrahaṇaṃ niyamārtham--aniyatapracayavācināṃ madhye
etayoreveti, tena bhūriśabdasya laukikasaṃkyāvācitve'pyatra
grahaṇābhāvaḥ|
ambhāvṛttiḥ kriyāyā eva sambhavatītī| sādhyārthaviṣayatvātasyāḥ| na
dravyaguṇayoriti| tayoḥ siddhasvabhāvatayā śabdenābhidhānāt| punaḥ
punardaṇḍī, punaḥ punaḥ sthūla ityatrāpi gamyamānāyā bhavatikriyāyā
evābhyāvṛttiḥ, na tu dravyaguṇayoḥ| ekasya sakṛccetyatrāpītyādi|
ekaśabdena hyaekaiva kriyāvyaktirākhyāyate| na ca tasyāmāvṛteḥ sambhavaḥ;
tatrāsati kriyāgrahaṇe ṭheko bhuṅkte' ityatrāpi syāt|
tasmādutarārthaṃ kriyāgrahaṇam| evaṃ ca--kriyā cābhyāvṛttiśca
kriyābhyāvṛtī, tayogarṇanaṃ kriyābhyāvṛttigaṇanamiti dvandvagarbhaḥ
ṣaṣṭhīsamāsa iti kecita| anye tu--ihārthamapi sukhapratipataye
kriyāgrahaṇaṃ manyamānāḥ ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣagarbha tatpuruṣaṃ varṇayanti| tatra
guṇabhūtasyāpi kriyāgrahaṇasya niṣkṛṣya sambandhaḥ
tadgrahaṇasāmarthyādveditavyaḥ|
pañcapākā iti| atra kartṛbhedena vā bhinnakālāḥ kriyā eva gaṇayante,
nābhyā vṛttiḥ| sā hi bhinnakālānāmekakartṛkāṇāmekakarmakāṇāṃ ca
nairantarthe sati bhavati| yadyapyatra dhātvarthasya siddhatākhye dharme ghaño
vidhānam, tathāpi dhātunā'trāpi sādhyasvabhāvā kriyaivābhidhīyata iti
tadāśrayaḥ pratyayaḥ syādeva| tatā ca---kārakasya gatiḥ, kārakasya
vrajyetyatra ṭhtumunṇvulau kriyāyāṃ kriyārthāyām' iti ṇvul
bhavati|
akriyamāṇa ityādi| ā daśabhyaḥ saṃkhyāḥ saṃkhyeya eva vartante, ataḥ paraṃ
saṃkhyāne saṃkhyeye ca | tatrāsati gaṇanagrahaṇe kriyābhyāvṛtau
saṃkhyeyāyāṃ vartamānebhyaḥ saṃkhyeyavacanebhya eva pratyayaḥ syāt,
saṃkhyāne tu vartamānebhyo na syāt, tadāha--iha na syāditi| śataṃ
vārāṇāmiti| iyamapyatyantasaṃyoge dvitīyā| kiṃ kāraṇaṃ na syāt?
ityata āha--na hyatreti| kāraṇamāha--saṃkhyānamātravṛttitvāditi|
gaṇanagrahaṇātviti| ṭhkriyābhyāvṛttigaṇane' iti viṣayanirdeśaḥ, tatra ye
saṃkhyeyavacanāḥ, ye ca saṃkhyānamātravacanāḥ---dvaye'pi te
gaṇanāviṣayā bhavantīti sarvatra siddhiḥ| nanu śataṃ vārāṇāmityatra
yadā vārāṇāmiti prayujyate, tadā sāpekṣatvāt pratyayena na
bhāvyam? yadā tarhyarthāt, prakaraṇādvā'pekṣayaṃ nirjñātaṃ bhavati tadā
bhaviṣyati yadyevam, saṃkhyeyavacanādeva śatakṛtva iti bhaviṣyati, na
hi ṭhśatakṛtvo bhuṅkte' ityatra vārāṇāmiti vārāniti vā
prayogārham, tasmātprayojanadigiyaṃ darśitā| idaṃ tu
prayojanam--yatra sākṣādabhyāvṛttigaṇanaṃ tatra yathā syād,
abhyāvṛttigaṇanasambhavamātre mā bhūt--saptadaśa prājāpatyān
paśūnālabhata iti| asti hyatrālabhatikriyāyāḥ pratipaśu
vastuto'bhyāvṛttiḥ, tasyā viṣayabhūtāyāḥ sādhanagaṇanavṛterapi
saptadaśaśabdāt pratyayaḥ syāt ||

dvitricaturbhyaḥ suc || 5|4|18 ||
sakṛditi| ṭhrātsasya' iti suco lopaḥ| sucaścakāraḥ svarārta iti|
ṭhcitaḥ saprakṛterbahvakajartham' iti vacanāccaturityasyāntodāto
bhavati; anyathāṭhcateruran' ityuranpratyayāntatvādādyaudātaḥ syāt ||

ekasya sakṛcca || 5|4|19 ||
sakṛditi | ṭhsaṃyogāntasya lopaḥ' iti suco lopaḥ|
sucaścakāro'trāpyantodātārthaḥ, anyathā ṭhiṇbīkāpāśalyatimarcibhyaḥ
kan' iti kanpratyayānta ekaśabda ādyaudāta iti tasya sthāne
bhavansakṛcchabda āntaryata ādyaudātaḥ syāt| ekaḥ pāka ityatretyādi|
apara āha--ṭhabhyāvṛttigrahaṇādeva siddhe pūrvasūtre kriyāgrahaṇaṃ
kriyāviśeṣapratipatyartham, tena sādhyasvabhāvaiva kriyā gṛhyate|
pākādibhistu śabdaiḥ siddhasvabhāvā'bhidhīyate, yādṛśī ca pūrvasūtre
kriyā gṛhītā tādṛśyevātrāpyanuvartate' iti| tatra ca
pākādiśabdaprayoge pratyayābhāva iti ghañantādyantaprayoge'pi
kṛtvo'rthapratyayaḥ kvacit liṅgād ṭhdvirvacane'ci' iti sādhanīyo
manīṣibhiḥ || 

vibhāṣā bahorddhā'viprakṛṣṭakāle || 5|4|20 ||
aviprakṛṣṭakālagrahaṇaṃ kriyābhyāvṛttiviśeṣaṇamiti| yadyapyevam,
tathāpi gaṇanagrahaṇenaivāsya śābdo'nvaya iti napuṃsakaliṅgameva
bhavati, na strīliṅgam| gaṇanasyāviprakṛṣṭakālatvaṃ
gaṇyamānānāmabhyāvṛttināmaviprakṛṣṭakālatve satītyarthaprāptaṃ
vṛttikāreṇa darśitam| bahudhā divasasya bhuṅkte iti|
ṭhkṛtvo'rthaprayoge kāle'dhikaraṇe' iti ṣaṣṭhī, aviprakṛṣṭakālatvaṃ
cābhyāvṛtīnāṃ tatatkriyāvaśena vyavatiṣṭhate| bahukṛtvo māsasya
bhuṅkte iti| atrābhyāvṛterviprakṛṣṭakālatā'śaktidāridra|ladyapekṣayā
draṣṭavyā ||

tatprakṛtavacane mayaṭ || 5|4|21 ||
prācuryeṇa prastutaṃ prakṛtamiti| yadyapi prastutamātravacanaḥ prakṛtaśabdaḥ,
tathāpīha vacanagrahaṇādayaṃ viśeṣo labhyate| vacanagsarahaṇaṃ hi
yādṛśasya prakṛtasya loke mayaṭā vacanaṃ pratyāyanaṃ tatra yathā
syādityevartham| prathamāsamarthāditi| kena punaḥ prathamāntasya
sāmarthya pratyayastāvatsvārthikaḥ? yadyapi svārthikaḥ, prācuryaṃ tu tasya
dyotyam| tacca prakṛtyarthagatamityetāvadatra sāmarthyam|
apare punarityādi| atra prakṛtyārthādarthāntara eva pratyayaḥ,
tatpunararthāntaraṃ lyuṭā pratipāditam| saptamyartha ucyamānatā
prakṛtatā ca prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇam, taddarśayati--annaṃ prakṛtamasminnati|
ubhayathā sūtrapraṇayanāditi| prakāradvayasādhāraṇyena sūtrasya
praṇayanādityarthaḥ| atra prathame vyākhyāne taditi vispaṣṭārtham;
ṭhdevātal' ityevamādivatsamarthavibhakteḥ siddhatvāt ||

samūhavacca bahuṣu || 5|4|22 ||
āpūpikam, maudakikamiti| ṭhacitahastidhenoṣṭhak' ||

anantāvasathetihabheṣajāññyaḥ || 5|4|23 ||
āvasantyetamityāvasathaḥ, ṭhupasarge vaseḥ' ityathapratyayaḥ|
nipātasamudāyo'yamiti| vacanāccāprātipadikādapi pratyayaḥ|
upadeśapāramparye vartate iti| tadyathā--iti ha smopādhyāḥ kathayantīti|
bhiṣajyateḥ kaṇḍvādiyagantātkivapi bhiṣaka, bhiṣaja
idamityaṇ--bheṣajam, asmādeva nipātanādekāraḥ ||

devatāntātādarthye yat || 5|4|24 ||
caturthīsamarthāditi| tādarthye caturthyā upasaṃkhyānādetallabhyate|
pitṛdevatyamiti| parmadhārayātpratyayaḥ| kathaṃ punaratra
sāmānādhikaraṇyam? kathaṃ ca na syāt ? jātibhedāt, anyā hi
pitṛjātiranyā ca devatājātiḥ, darśayati ca--devā manuṣyāḥ
pitaraste'nyata āsanniti, deva eva devatā--svārthikastal ? evaṃ tarhi
talpratyayasya prakṛtirdeavaśabdaḥ pacādyaci aiśvaryārthāddiveḥ sādhyaḥ; na
jātivacanaḥ; tataḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ syāddevatāpitṛśabdayoḥ| evaṃ ca
devadevatyamityetadapi siddhayati| yāgasampradānamantrastutyaṃ vā
devatā, na jītiviśeṣa ityarthaḥ || 

pādārghābhyāṃ ca || 5|4|25 ||
gandhodakādisamudāyo'rghaḥ, tadarthabhudakādiuarghyam| cchandasya iti|
yathā gāyatryādivṛtaṃ cchandaḥśabdo'bhidhate, tathā''śrāvayetyādikamapi
saptadaśākṣarasamāhāram, tatra vartamānācchandaḥśabdātsvārthe pratyayaḥ,
vyatyayena puṃlliṅgatā|
dvitīyābahuvacanasya lugiti| chāndasatvāt| ata eva
yadantātprathamaikavacanaṃ puṃlliṅgaṃ ca bhavati|
amuṣyaśabdo naḍādiḥ, amuṣyaputraśabdo manojñādiḥ; ubhayatra ṣaṣṭha|la
alugupasaṃkhyāyate| pratyayaprakaraṇe prāsaṅgikametat, sa cāluk
tayoreva gaṇayostathaiva pāṭhātsiddhaḥ|
samaśabdādāvatupratyaya iti| ukāra ugitkāryārthaḥ--samāvatī
yajñasyāśīriti ṅīb bhavati|
ṭhagnīdhaḥ śaraṇe raṇ bhatvaṃ ca'--āgnīdhram, tato'ñ-āgnīdhrī| samānaṃ
dhāraṇamasya sādhāraṇam, anekaṃ pratyaviśiṣṭasambandham|
pṛṣodarāditvātsamānasya sabhāvaḥ, tato'ñ sādhāraṇi| ṅībarthaṃ
vacanam| kṣemaśabdādyo vaktavyaḥ, yati hi sati ṭhyato'nāvaḥ'
ityādyaudātatvaṃ syād, antodātatvaṃ ceṣyate ||

yāvādibhyaḥ kan || 5|4|29 ||
ṛtāvuṣṇaśīte iti| upṇaka ṛtuḥ, śītaka ṛtuḥ| ṛtoranyatra
tu---uṣṇo'gniḥ, śītamudakam| paśāviti| lūnakaḥ paśuḥ, viyātakaḥ
paśuḥ| anyatra--lūnā darbhāḥ, viyāto nīcaḥ| aṇu nipuṇa iti|
aṇukaḥusūkṣmadṛka, nipuṇaḥ, anyatrāṇureva| putra kṛtrime| putrako
lohādinirmitaḥ, anyatra putra eva| snāta vedasamāptau|
yasyādhyetavyo vedaḥ samāptaḥupāraṃ prāptaḥ, sa vedamadhītya
snāsyannityādisvagṛhyaektaprakrāreṇa snānāya coditaḥka
snātakaḥusamāvṛta ucyate| anyatra--nadyāṃ snātaḥ| śūnya rikta iti|
udakādinā rikto ghaṭaḥ śūnyakaḥ| anyatra--śūnyaḥ pratyayaḥ, bāhyārtharahita
ityarthaḥ| tathā śūne hitaḥ śūnyaḥ, gavādiṣu ṭhśunaḥ samprasāraṇaṃ vā ca
dīrghatvaṃ ca' iti paṭha|lte| dāna kutsite| kutsitaṃ dānaṃ dānakam|
tanu sūtre| tanukaṃ sūtramusūkṣmatantuḥ, anyatra tanuḥuśarīram|
īyasaśca|īyasunnantācca svārthe kan bhavati-śreyaskam|
kumārīkrīḍanakāni ca| kumārīṇāṃ yāni krīḍanakāniukrīḍāsādhanāni
tāni kanamutpādayanti---kaṇḍu(du)kam ||

varṇe cānitye || 5|4|31 ||
satyevāśraye yallauhityamapagacchati tadanityam| lohitakaḥ
kopeneti| kope sati bhavati kopāgagame ca satyevāśraye
nivartata ityanityametat lauhityam| 
lohito gauriti| yāvadāśrayabhāvitvādayaṃ nityo varṇaḥ|
lohitai rudhiramiti| viṣādidūṣitaṃ rudhiraṃ kadācitkṛṣṇamapi
bhavatīti viseṣaṇam| varṇagrahaṇaṃ kim ? anityatvaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ yathā
vijñāyet, anyathā lohitaśabdo varṇapravṛttinimitamupādāya yatra
dravye paryavasyati, tatrāpi viśeṣaṇaṃ sambhāvyeta| tatra ko doṣaḥ? iha
ca syāt--lohito gauriti| iha ca na syāt--lohitakāḥ pārthivāḥ
paramāṇavo'gnisaṃyogeneti| tathā varṇanirapekṣo rudhirākhye dravye
lohitaśabdasyasyāpi grahaṇaṃ syāt, anityagrahaṇamidānīṃ kimarthaṃ
syāt! nanu sarvameva rudhiramanityaṃ yatsatyevāśraye kādācitkam,
yathā--strīṇāmārtavam, tasya grahaṇārthaṃ syāt, tasmādvarṇagrahaṇam|
lohitālliṅgabādhanaṃ vā iti| ṅyāpsūtra etadvyākhyātam ||

rakte || 5|4|32 ||
yatra dravyāntarasamparkeaṇa lauhityaṃ tathādhīyate tathā
yāvadāśrayamavatiṣṭhate, tatrānityatvābhāvātpūrveṇa na
prāpnotītyayamārambhaḥ| nanvevamapi rañjanāt prāk satyeva
padādāvāśraye lauhityasyāvasthānābhāvādastyevānityatā, na
kāraṇāvasthāyāmeva rañjanāt? tadetadeva vacanaṃ
jñāpakam--pūrvatrāyāvaddravyabhāvitvamanityatvam, na punarādyantabhāva
iti| tādṛśasya tvanityatvasya grahaṇo taijasānāṃ paramāṇūnāṃ
yallauhityaṃ tadvyatiriktasya sarvasyaiva lohityasya nityatvādidaṃ
vacanamanarthalaṃ syāt ||

kālācca || 5|4|33 ||
dvayamapyanuvartata iti| dvayasyāpi svaritatvāt, na tvanantaraṃ ṭhrakte'
ityetadevetyapiśabdārthaḥ| vailakṣyeṇeti| vilakṣasya bhāvo
vailakṣyamulajjā| kālakaḥ paṭa iti| nīlyādinā kālatāmāpādita
ityarthaḥ ||

vinayādibyaṣṭhak || 5|4|34 ||
upāyād hrasvatvaṃ ceti| upāyaśabdaṣṭhakamutpādayati, hrasvatvaṃ cāpadyate|
sa ca hrasva ākārasyaiva bhavati; anyasyācaḥ svata eva hrasvatvāt|
akasmādityatra paṭha|lte, taddakārāntam, tena ṭhhasusuktāntātkaḥ' iti
kādeśo na bhavati--ākasmikaḥ, avyayatvāṭṭilopaḥ ||

vāco vyāhṛtārthāyām || 5|4|35 ||
vyāhṛta iti| ukta ityarthaḥ| anyeneti| saṃdeṣṭrā| tena hi
pūrvamuktastasyārthaḥ saṃdeśaharaṃ prati| sandeśavāgiti| sandeśarūpā
vāk sandeśavāk, sandiśyate iti sandeśaḥ, tasya vāk saṃdeśavāk
yayā saṃdiṣṭo'rtho'bhidhīyate|
apara āha--lekhyādināvadhārite'rthe pravartamānā vāk vyāhṛtārtheti|
ṭhativartante ca svārthikāḥ prakṛtito liṅgavacanāni' iti
napuṃsakatvam ||

tadyauktātkarmaṇo'ṇ || 5|4|36 || 
karmaśabdāditi| etena ṭhkarmaṇaḥ' iti svarūpagrahaṇam,
nepsitatamāderiti darśayati| etacca vyākhyānāllabhyate|
kārmaṇamiti| ṭhan' iti prakṛtibhāvaḥ| tathaiveti| yathaiva
vyāhṛtārthayā vācā pratipāditam-evametatvayā kartavyamiti,
tathaivetyarthaḥ|
aṇprakaraṇa iti| prajñādiṣvapāṭhaḥ---eteṣāṃ bhāṣāyāmaṇmā bhūditi|
sānnāyyetyādi| sānnāyyādayaḥ śabdāḥ prajñādiṣu draṣṭavyā ityarthaḥ|
antodātārthaṃ ceha sānnāpyaśabdasya grahaṇam, rūpaṃ tu ṭhpāyyasānnāyya'
iti nipātanādeva siddham| ānujāvara iti| anujādavara ityasmādeva
nipātanātpañjamīsamāsaḥ, tato'ṇ| ānuṣūka iti| sūtiḥ sūḥ,
sampadāditvāt kvip, anugatā sūretamiti bahuvrīhiḥ, kap,
ṭhpūrvapadāt' iti ṣatvam| cātuṣprāśyamiti| caturbhiḥ prāśyamiti
ṭhkartṛkaraṇe kṛtā bahulam' iti samāsaḥ, tato'ṇ| ādhāne
vrīhyaedanasyedamabhidhānam| ṭhidudupadhasya' iti ṣatvam| rākṣoghnamiti|
rakṣāṃsi hanyante'neneti dhañarthe kaḥ|
viyātavikṛtaśabdābhyāmaṇ-vaiyātaḥ, vaikṛtaḥ| varivaḥuparicaryā,
tatkaroti varivaskṛt, kvip, ṭhataḥ kṛkami' iti satvam,
variskṛdeva vārivaskṛtaḥuparicārakaḥ| agramayanamasya, agre
hāyanamasyetika bahuvrīhibhyāmaṇ---āgrāyaṇaṃ karma|
nāniṣṭvāgrāyaṇenāhitāgnirnavasyāśnīgaditi| āgrahāyaṇī,
aṇantān ṅīp| sanpyate'neneti santapanaḥ, santapana eva
sāntapanaḥukṛcchraḥ ||

oṣadherajātau || 5|4|37 ||
auṣadhaṃ pibatīti| pathyā-śuṇṭhī-saindhavādīnāṃ kalke auṣadhaśabdo
vartate, auṣadhayaḥ kṣetrarūḍhā iti| phalapākāvasāneṣu
jātiviśeṣepvatrauṣadhiśabdaḥ ||

prajñādibhyaśca || 5|4|38 ||
prajānātīti prajña iti| ṭhigupadhajñāprīkiraḥ kaḥ' iti kaḥ| atha
kimarthamubhayaṃ kriyate, iha ca prajñaśabdaḥ paṭha|lte, matvarthe ca
prajñāśabdāṇṇo vidhīyate, yaḥ prajānāti tasya prajñā'sti, yasya ca
prajñāsti sa prajānātīti, tataścānyataraiṇaiva prājña iti siddham?--
ityāśaṅkya striyāṃ viśeṣa iti darśayati--striyāmityādi|
vidan, ṣoḍanniti vibhaktyantayoḥ pāṭha ekatvavivakṣārthaḥ|
vaicitryārthaḥ ityante| śrotra śarīre| yaḥ śrotraśabdaḥ śarīre vartate,
asau aṇamutpādayati--śrautram| anyatra śrotrāmindriyam|
juhvatkṛṣṇamṛga iti| kṛṣṇamṛge vartamānājjuhvacchabdādaṇpratyayo
bhavati--jauhvataḥ kṛṣṇamṛgaḥ| anyatra juhvat| apara āha---kṛṣṇamṛge
vartamānātkṛṣṇaśabdādaṇpratyayo bhavati--kārṇṇo mṛgaḥ| anyatra tu
kṛṣṇaḥ juhvacchabdātvaviśeṣeṇāṇbhavatīti| satvantviti| sacchabdo
matvanta āgatanumko gṛhyate, satvāneva sātvataḥ ||

mṛdastikan || 5|4|39 ||
ṭhpratyayasthāt' ityeva siddhe tikana hakāroccāraṇam yatrāpo luk
kriyate tadartham---pañcabhirmṛtikābhiḥ krītaḥ paṭaḥ pañcamṛtika paṭaḥ
||

sasnau praśaṃsāyām || 5|4|40 ||
utarasūtre'nyatarasyāṃgrahaṇāditi| mṛcchabdasya sāmānyaśabdatvāt,
mṛdityukte praśaṃsāyā anavagamācca|
iha ṭhpraśaṃsāyāṃ rūpap' ityasyānantaram--ṭhvṛkajyeṣṭhābhyāṃ
tiltātilau ca cchandasi, mṛdassasnau, tikaṃśca' iti vaktavyam? tathā
tu na kṛtamityeva ||

bahvalpārthācchaskārakādanyatarasyām || 5|4|42 ||
kārakābhidhāyinaḥ śabdāditi| pañcakapakṣe prātipadikāt, trikapakṣe
subantāt| gahādiṣu ṭhmadhyamadhyamaṃ cāṇcaraṇe'
ityaviśeṣābhidhāne'pi pṛthivīmadhyasya madhyamabhāva ityuktam, iha tu
na tathetyāhāviśeṣābhidhānācceti| evamādīti|
ādiśabdenāpādānādhikaraṇayorudāharaṇaparigrahaḥ---bahubhya āgacchati
bahuśa āgacchati; bahuṣu nidadhāti bahuśo nidadhāti;
evamalpebyo'lpaśaḥ, alpeṣvalpaśaḥ| 
bahūnāṃ svāmīti| śeṣe ṣaṣṭhīvidhānānna kārakābhidhāyī bahuśabdaḥ|
paryāyebyo'pīti| apiśabdādviśeṣebhyo'pi| tatra vṛtau
paryāyasyodāharaṇam| viśeṣasya tu---triśo dadātīti, vīpsāyā
anyatra| vīpsāyāṃ tūtareṇa siddham|
ābyudayikeṣviti| abyudayaprayojaneṣu agnyādheyādiṣu aniṣṭeṣu
bhayādinimiteṣu dāneṣu| prāyikaṃ caitanmahgalavacanam, anyatrāpi
hi dṛśyate| ṭhapetāpoḍhanuktapatitāpatrastairalpaśaḥ' iti kārakatvaṃ
samāsakriyāṃ prati pañcabhyāḥ karmatvātadabhidhāyitvāccālpaśabdasya
draṣṭavyam| udīritaṃ ca---ṭhalpā pañcamī samsyate' iti ||


saṃkhyaikavacanācca vīpsāyām || 5|4|43 ||
ṭhnityavīpsayoḥ' iti dvirvacane prāpte tadapavādaḥ sasvidhīyate| kathaṃ
tahi ṭhekaikaśaḥ pitṛsaṃyuktām' iti śasdvirvacanayoḥ sahaprayogaḥ?
chandovadṛṣayaḥ kurvanti|
yadyatra pāribhāṣikasyaikavacanasya grahaṇaṃ syāt-sarvebhyo brāhmaṇebhyo
ghaṭṃaghaṭṃa dadātītyatrāpī syāt;
ghaṭaśabdasyaikavacanāntatvādityālocyānvarthasyaikavacanasyātra
grahaṇamityāha--eko'rtha ucyate yeneti| nanvevamapi sa doṣastadavastha
eva, ekavacanānkatasyaikārthatvāt? ityata āha-kārṣāpaṇādayaśceti|
anena vṛttisthaikārthatā''śrīyate, na vākyagateti darśayati| vṛtau na
ghaṭādayo jātiśabdā anekārthā bhavanti,
jātiyogasyaikānekasādhāraṇatvāt;
kintvabhedaikatvasaṃkhyāmupādadate; kārṣāpaṇādayastu paribhāṇavacanā
aktaparimāṇamarthamācakṣāṇā ityekaśeṣabalāt akṣāḥ, pādāḥ, māṣā
itivadekajātyanvayarahitānekārthapratītiḥ| vṛtau tu
vibhaktyaikaśeṣayorabhāvātsa eva kevalo'ktaparimāṇortho'vatiṣṭhate|
ataḥ kārṣāpaṇādaya evodāharaṇamiti jayādityo manyate|
vāmanastu ṭhjaśśasoḥ śiḥ' ityatrodāhariṣyati--ṭhjasā sahacaritasya
śaso grahaṇādiha na bhavati-kuṇḍaśo dadāti, vanaśaḥ praviśati' iti|
sa manyate-jātiśabdo'pi yadā arthaprakaraṇādinā vṛtāvekārthībhavati,
bhavatyeva tadā tato'pi śasiti--dvayordvayoḥ svāmīti| kathaṃ tarhi--
avratānāmavidyānāṃ jātimātropajīvinām|
sahasraśaḥ sametānāṃ pariṣatvaṃ |||||||||||| || iti ?
kathaṃ ca na syād? vīpsāyā abhāvād, akārakatvād,
anekavacanatvācca, ayaṃ hyatrārthaḥ- evambhūtānāṃ brāhmāṇāṃ sahasrasyāpi
pariṣatvaṃ na vidyata iti? nāyamatrārtho yathā tvamāttha, ki tahi ? sahasraṃ
sahasraṃ ye sametāstepāmapyevambhūtānāṃ pariṣatvaṃ nāstīti, tatra
samavāyakriyāyāṃ kartṛtvādvīpsāyāścābhāvācchas bhavati ||

pratiyoge pañcabyāstasiḥ || 5|4|44 ||
pratinā karmapravacanīyenetyādi| ṭhpratiḥ pratinidhipratidānayoḥ' iti
karmapravacanīyasaṃjñā, ṭhpratinidhipratidāne ca yasmāt' iti pañcamī |
ādyādibhya upasaṃkhyānamiti| ṭhtasyādita udātamardhahrasvam' ityetadatra
liṅgam|

āpādāne cāhīyaruhoḥ || 5|4|45 ||
sārthāddhīyata iti| ṭhohāktyāge', karmaṇyātmanedam, yak,
ghumāsthādisūtreṇetvam| kathaṃ punaḥ karmasaṃjñā, yāvatā
ṭhkarturīpsitatamaṃ karma'? na cātra sārthaḥ kartṛsaṃjñakaḥ, kintu
dhruvatvena vivakṣitvādapādānasaṃjñakaḥ| mā bhūtkartṛsaṃjñā, jahāti
tāvatsārtho devadataṃ yadi na jahyādapāya eva na saṃvarteta|
svātantryopalakṣaṇaṃ ca karmasaṃjñāyāṃ kartṛgrahaṇam, kartṛsaṃjñā bhavatu
mā vā bhūt| evaṃ cāpādanasyāpi sataḥ sārthasya hāne yatsvātantryaṃ
vāstavam, tadāśrayā karmasaṃjñā bhavati| yadyevam, māṣepvaśvaṃ
badhnātītyatra karmaṇo'pyaśvasya vastuto yadbhakṣaṇe svātantryaṃ
tadāśrayā māṣāṇaṃ karmasaṃjñā prāpnoti, tasmātkarmakartaryatra lakāraḥ|
kathamiha ḍajahātirapagamanāyāṃ vartate? devadataṃ sārtho jahāti,
apagamayatītyarthaḥ| eṣaiva ca sārthasyāpagamanā yat kṣudupaghātādinā
devadatasyāpagamane tatsamarthācaraṇam, yadā tu kṣudhādinā
svayamevāpagacchati tadā karmakartṛtvam, tataśca hīyata iti| ko'rtha ?
svayamevāpagacchatītyarthaḥ| punaḥ ṭhkutohīyate'--ityapekṣāyāṃ sārthena
sambandhaḥ|
vikāranirdeśa iti| vikṛtirvikāraḥ, iha tu tadvetutvādyagabhipretaḥ|
tatra hi ghūmāsthādisūtreṇetvavidhānāddhāturūpaṃ vikriyate| yakā
nirddeśaḥ-yasya yakītvamasti, tasya grahaṇārthamityarthaḥ| jihīteriti|
śtipo ṅtvābāvādītvānupipaterjihāteriti paṭhītavyam|
tiḍantānukaraṇaṃ vā jihīteriti draṣṭavyam|
naiṣā pañcamīti| yadantātasiḥ, naiṣā pañcamītyarthaḥ| kiṃ tarhi
tṛtīyeti| hetau, karaṇe vā tṛtīyā, tadantād
ṭhhīyamānapāpayogācca' iti tasirityarthaḥ| svareṇa, varṇena vā
vivakṣitādarthāddhīna ityarthaḥ sampadyate ||

atigrahāvyathanakṣepeṣvakatari tṛtīyāyāḥ || 5|4|46 ||
atikramya graho'tigraha iti| atiśabdo'trātikramaṇe vartate iti
darśayati| atiśabdo hi sasādhane'pyatikramaṇe dṛṣṭaḥ,
tadyathā--ṭhtasmādbrāhmaṇe rājanyavānatyanyaṃ brāhmaṇam' iti, ṭhna vai devā
namaskāramati' iti ca| tena tasyātikramaṇamātre vṛttirna sambhavati|
vṛtenātigṛhyata iti| bahuṣvāsīneṣvanyātikrameṇāyamasāviti
vijñāyata ityarthaḥ, tatra vṛtaṃ kāraṇam| cāritreṇeti| ṭhcarervṛte
hrasvaśca vā' iti ṇitranpratyayaḥ-caritram, cāritram || 

hīyamānapāpayogācca || 5|4|47 ||
udāharaṇeṣu vṛtasya hīyamānena pāpena ca yogaḥ, hetau
karaṇe vā tṛtīyā, kartā tvatra bandhujanādiḥ|
kṣepasyāvivakṣāyāmityādi| kasmādevamityāha--kṣepe hīti ||

ṣaṣṭha|la vyāśraye || 5|4|48 ||
nānāpakṣasamāśrayo vyāśraya iti| tathā ca ṭhhetumati ca' ityatra bhāṣye
prayogaḥ---vyāśritāśca bhavanti, kecitkaṃsabhaktā, kecidvāsudevabhaktā
iti| devā ityādi| arjuna indraputraḥ, karṇaḥ sūryaputraḥ| ṣaṣṭhī
cātreti | pakṣaśabdastu tasau sati na prayujyateḥ gatārthatvāt,
nānāpakṣasamāśrayaṇa evāsya vidhānāt || 

rogāccāpanayane || 5|4|49 ||
pravāhikāta iti| pravāhiphāśabdātpratīkārāpekṣayā ṣaṣṭhī,
tadantāttsiḥ, pratīkāraśabdasya tu pūrvavadaprayogaḥ||

abhūtatadbāve kṛbhvastiyoge sampadyakartari cviḥ || 5|4|50 ||
vārtikakāreṇa cvividāvabhūtatadbhāvagrahaṇaṃ kartavyamityuktam,
tadavaśyaṃ kartavyamiti manyamānaḥ sūtra eva prakṣipya
vayācaṣṭe--kāraṇasyeti| upādānam, nimitam, asamavāyīti--trīṇi
kāraṇāni, tatropādānakāraṇasyetyarthaḥ| vikārarūpeṇeti|
kāraṇasyaivotaramavasthāntaramuvikāraḥ, tena rūpeṇa
tadātmanā'bhūtasyājātasyāpariṇatasyetyarthaḥ| tadātmanā vikārātmanā
bhāvaḥujanma, pariṇāma ityarthaḥ| anena kāryakāraṇayorabhedo daśitaḥ|
yathā rajjuḥ śikyamiti na tatvāntaram, atha ca na rajjumātre
śikyapratītiḥ| evaṃ hiraṇyameva kuṇḍalam, mṛdeva ghaṭaḥ, tantava eva
paṭaḥ, dārveva yūpaḥ| atha ca na dihaṇyādimātre kuṇkaḍalādipratītiḥ,
no khalu kuṇḍalaṃ hiraṇyaṃ na bhavatīti kaścitpratyeti| yadi ca
kuṇḍalaṃ hiraṇyaṃ na bhavati, kiṃ tarhi? hiraṇyaṃ piṇḍaḥ nanu so'pi
piṇḍaḥ, evaṃ vṛtamevaṃ dīrghamiti na kiñcana hiraṇyaṃ syāt,
tasmadanuvṛtaṃ kāraṇam, vyāvartamānastvavasthābhedo vikāra iti
yuktam| kutaḥ punarayamabhūtatadbhāvaviśeṣo labhyate, na
punarabhūtvā bhavanamātraṃ bhavantyasminkṣetre śālaya iti ?
tacchabdopādānāt| yena rūpeṇa grāgabhūtaṃ kāraṇaṃ tena rūpeṇa tasya
bhāvo'bhūtatadbhāva iti hi tasyārthaḥ, anyathā'bhūtabhāva ityeva
vācyam| tadapi vā na vaktavyam; sampadyakartṛtvādeva siddheḥ|
yadvā-janmagrahaṇa eva kartavye ṭhabhūtatadbhāvaḥ' iti
vacanādyathoktārthalābhaḥ, sarvathā yatra prakṛtireva
vikārarūpatāmāpadyamānā vikārabhedena vivakṣyate tatraiva pratyayaḥ,
tatreva hi darśito'bhūtatadbhāvaḥ sambhavati| sampadyateḥ karteti|
śabdātmakasya dhātoḥ svarūpeṇa kartrā
sambandhāsambhavādarthadvārakamidamabhidhānam, sampadyarthasya yaḥ kartā sa
sampadyakartetyarthaḥ| arthakathana caitat, vigrahastu sampadyaścāsau kartā
ceti, ṭhpāghrādhmādheṭdṛśaḥ śaḥ' asmādeva nipātanātsampado'pi
bhavati| divāditvāt śyan| kvacitu sampadyate karteti| tiṅntaṃ
paṭha|lte, yaḥ sampadyate kartā sa sampadyakartetyarthaḥ| śuklīkarotīti|
prakṛtau vikārāvasthāṃ prāpnuvatyāṃ vartamānādvikāraśabdātsvārthe
cvipratyayaḥ, ikāraḥ ṭhverapṛktasya' iti sāmānyagrahaṇārthaḥ| cakārastu
tadavidhātārthaḥ, prakṛterantodātārthaśca| vakārasya ṭhverapuktasya' iti
lopaḥ, ṭhasya cvau' itītvam, ṭhūryādicviḍācaśca' iti
nipātatvenāvyayatvātsorluk|
nātra prakṛtirvivakṣiteti| prakṛtivivakṣāyāmevābhūtatadbhāvaḥ
sambhavatītyuktam| 
abhūtatadbhāvasāmarthyakṣiteti| yo vikārarūpeṇābhūtaḥ san
vikārātmanā bhavati, sa niyogatastena rūpeṇa sambadyamānaḥ sampadyakartā
bhavatītyetatsāmarthya yadrūpāntareṇa sampadyate na tadavaśyaṃ
kartṛsaṃjñameva bhavatītyabhiprāyeṇāha--kārakāntarasampatau mā
bhūditi| adevagṛhe devagṛhe sampadyata iti| adevagṛhe prāgabhūdyo
vṛkṣādiḥ, sa idānīṃ tasminpradeśe devālayībhūte devāgṛhe sampadyata
ityarthaḥ| udāharaṇadikceyaṃ vṛttikāreṇa darśitā|
kṛbhvastiyogābhāvādvinaivātra cviḥ prasajyate| tasmādadeva gṛhe
devagṛhe bhavatīti pratyudāhāryam| atra vṛkṣādeḥ sampatiṃ
pratyadhikaraṇasyāpyadevagṛhasyābhūtatadbhāvo'styeva; tasya
prāgadevagṛhasyāpi samprati devagṛhatvena pariṇāmāt| evaṃ hi
vṛkṣādestadādhāraviśiṣṭatayā'bhūtatadbhāvo yadyapi vastutaḥ
sampadyakartṛtvamapi devagṛhasyāsti, tathāpi na tadvivakṣitam, kiṃ
tahi? ādhārabhāva eveti bhavatyudāharaṇam| nanu caivaṃ sati
suklīkarotītyatrāpi na syād, atrāpi hi kāranāntarasya karmaṇaḥ
sampatiḥ, na kartuḥ? asyatra viśeṣaḥ, karmavayāpāropasarjanaṃ
kartṛvyāpāraṃ karotirāha, karmavyāpāraśca sampatiḥ--śuklaṃ
karotīti, ko'rtha? śuklaṃ sampadyamānaṃ sampādayatītyarthaḥ| tataśca
sampadyakartṛtvamasminprayoge śabdenaivopātam| itaratra tu
vṛkṣādereva sampadyakartṛtvaṃ śābdam, devagṛhasya tvārtham|
ādhārabhāva eva tu śābda iti na kaśjid doṣaḥ| iha tarhi kathaṃ
samāpībhavati, abhyāśībhavati, antikībhavatīti? kathaṃ ca na syāt ? na
hyasamīpaṃ samīpaṃ bhavatītyatrārthaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? asamīpe sthitaṃ samīpe
sthitaṃ bhavatīti? tātsthyātācchabdyaṃ bhaviṣyati ||

arurmanaścakṣuścetorahorajasāṃ lopaśca || 5|4|51 ||
atra sarvaviśeṣaṇasambandhādityādi| yadi tvabhūtatadbhāvādīnāṃ
viśeṣaṇānāṃ madye'nyatamaṃ na sambadhyate, tataścverapi
vidhyarthametatsyāt| yatastu sarvāṇi viṣepaṇāni sambadhyanete,
tato lopamātramevana na prāpranetīti tadatha vacanam, na
cvervidhānārtham| ṭhcviśca pratyayaḥ' iti tu pūrveṇaiva vihitasya
cveranuvādaḥ kṛtaḥ, tatsanniyogaśiṣṭatvaṃ lopasya darśayitum|
yadi punaviśeṣavihitena bādhā mā bhūditi cvirapyanena
vidhīyeta, tata unmanīkarotītyādāvanena pratyayo na syād;
grahaṇavacā prātipadikena tadantavidhipratiṣedhāt|
tataścaitatsanniyogaśiṣṭo lopo na syāt, pūrveṇa tu kevala eva
cviḥ syāt| tasmātpūrveṇa vihite cvau parato'ruḥprabhṛtīnāṃ
lopo bhavatītyeva sūtrārthaḥ| pūrveṇaiva ca kevalebhyastadantācca
cvirbhavati ||

vibhāṣā sāti kārtsnye || 5|4|52 ||
yadi prakṛtiḥ kṛtsnā vikāratāmāpadyata iti| abhūtatadbhāvaviṣayaṃ
kārtsnyamāśrīyata iti darśayati--vibhāṣāgrahaṇaṃ cveḥ prāpakamiti|
vikalpārthasyāpyasya prāpayitavyāntarābhāvāt| nanu vākyaṃ
prāpayitavyaṃ syāt? tatrā''ha-pratyayavikalpastiti| apara
āha--anekārthatvānnipātānāṃ samucyayo'rthaḥ|
vibhāṣāgrahaṇaṃ cveḥ prāpakamiti| vibhāṣāśabdastu nipāto na
bhavati, ṭhdvayorvibhāṣayormadhye' iti vibhakterdarśanāt, kiṃ tahi?
ṭhgurośca halaḥ' ityakāra pratyayāntaḥ--vibhāṣyate vikalpyate iti
vibhāṣeti ||

abhividhau sampadā ca || 5|4|53 || 
sa tu kṛbhvastibhireva yoge bhavatīti| vibhāṣāgrahaṇasya
vikalpārthatvātsvaśāstreṇaiva cvirbhavatīti sampadāyoge
tasyāprasaṅgāt| spaṣṭīkṛtaṃ caitatpūrvagranthe|
vibhāṣāgrahaṇānuvṛteścvirapyabhyanujñāyata iti| samuccayārthe tu
tasminnanenaiva cvirbhavansampadāpi yoge syād, abhyanujñāya iti
cānupapannaṃ syāt| atheti| ubhayatra vyāptisambhavātpraśnaḥ| sarvā
prakṛtiriti| prakārakārtsnye 'tra sarvaśabdaḥ, yathā---sarvānnīno
bhikṣuriti| yathāsyāṃ senāyāmityādi| atrāpi prakārakārtsnya eva
sarvaśabdaḥ, khaṅgaprāsādīnāmaśeṣāṇāṃ
sastrāṇāmekadeśenāpyagnyātmabhāvo'tra vivakṣitaḥ, na tvekasyā api
sastravyakteḥ sarvātmanā vikārarūpāpatiḥ| evaṃ varṣāsu
lavaṇamityatrāpi| kārtsnya tvityādi| yatraikasyāpi dravyasya
sarvātmanā vikārarūpāpatiḥ, na kaścidavayavaḥ parihāpyate, tatra
kārtsnyaṃ bhavati| tasmādarthabhedādubhayamuktam, na
tvekatraivānyataratra sampado grahaṇaṃ kṛtamiti ||

tadadhīnavacane || 5|4|54 ||
svāmisāmānyamityādi| iha ṭhadhirīśvare' iti adhiśabdasya
karmapravacanīyasaṃjñā tena yoge ṭhyasmādadhikaṃ yasya ceśvaravacanam'
iti īśvaravācinaḥ saptamī, īśvaraśceśitavyāpekṣaḥ| adhiśabdaścāyaṃ
śauṇḍādiṣu paṭha|lte iti saptamīsamāsaḥ, tato'dhyutarapadalakṣaṇaḥ khaḥ,
tatra kṛte brahmadatādhīnāḥ pañcālā iti
sāmānādhikaraṇyadarśanādadhiśabda īśitavyasāmānyabhidhāyī,
pañjālādayastu tadviśeṣavacanā iti gamyate; tataśca svāmisāmānyam,
īśitavyasāmānyaṃ ca tadadhītaśabdenocyate, tatra svāmisāmānyaṃ
prakṛtyarthaḥ, sāmānyaṃ ca viśeṣopalakṣaṇārthamiti viśeṣavācibhyaḥ
pratyayo vijñāyata itvāhasvāmiviśeṣavācina iti ||

deye trā ca || 5|4|55 ||
brāhmaṇatrākarotīti| svarādiṣvayaṃ trāntaḥ paṭhitavyaḥ,
tenāvyayatvātsorluk| apara āha--tatraiva ṭhcavyarthāśca' iti paṭha|lte,
tatra bahuvacananirddeśādacvyarthasyāpi trāpratyasya sāhacaryeṇa
parigrahādavyayatvamiti|
rājasādbhavati rāṣṭramiti| pūrveṇa sātireva bhavati ||

devamanuṣyapuruṣapurumartyebhyo dvitīyāsaptamyorbahulam || 5|4|56
||
sātīti nivṛtamiti| pūrvasūtre cānukṛṣṭatvāt ṭhkṛbhvastiyoge'
iti na sambadhyata iti tadarthamatra svaritatvaṃ kartavyam| svarite sati
nādhikāra ityayaṃ ca pakṣa āśrayaṇīyaḥ| maṇḍūakaplutyāutaratra sambandhaḥ|
ṭhsampadā ca' ityetatu sarvathaivaṃ nivṛtatvānna sambadhyate ||

avyaktānukaraṇād dvyajavarārddādanitau ḍāc || 5|4|57 ||
yatra dhvanāvityādi| yadyapyanukāryameva rūpamanukaraṇe
varṇaviśeṣarūpeṇa prakāśate, tathāpi ṭhavyaktānukaraṇasyāta itau'
ityanukaraṇasthasyācchabdasya pararūpaṃ vidhate| dhvanimātrasāmyena tu
tasyānukaraṇa mucyate| avaraśabdo'pakarṣe iti| apakarṣaḥunyūnatā,
pravṛttinimitakathanaṃ caitat, apakṛṣṭṃa tvavaraśabdasyārthaḥ|
yasyāpakarṣe kriyamāṇe ityādi| atrāpakarṣaḥuvibhāgaḥ,
samapravibhāge'rdvaśabdaḥ, avaratvaṃ cāckṛtameva, dvyacsannidhānāt|
yasminvibhajya nirūpyamāṇe suṣṭhua nyūnamapi alpamapi ardha
dvyacchabdavatsampadyate na tato nyūnam, adhikaṃ tu sambhavatu mā vā
bhūt, tad dvyajavarārddhamityarthaḥ| yasyetyādi| yadi tvakṛte
dvirvacane yasya dvyajavarārddhatā tato ḍāj bhavatīti vijñāyate,
tadā paṭacchabdārdarna syāditi bhāvaḥ|
nanvedhaṃ sati ḍāci parabhūte tadāśraye dvirvacane dvyajavarārddhatā
bhavati, tasyāṃ ca satyaṃ kaḍācā bhavitavyamitītaretarāśrayatvaṃ
prāpnoti ? tatrāha--ḍāci bahulamitītyādi| satyaṃ parasaptamyāṃ
syādeṣa doṣaḥ; viṣayasaptamī tveṣā, tato na doṣa ityarthaḥ|
udāharaṇe parabhāgasya ṭacilopaḥ, ṭhnityamāmreḍite ḍāci' iti
pūrvatakārasya paradeśca pakārasya pararūpam--ekaṃ pakāraḥ, dvitīya
udāharaṇe dakāraḥ|
dṛṣatkarotīti| vyaktānukaraṇametat, prakaraṇādinā
cānukaraṇatvānugatiḥ| kharaṭakharaṭākarotīti| kharaṭadityasya
dvirvacanādi pūravavat| ṭhdvyajarddhāt' ityucyamāne'tra na syāt, na
hyatrārddhaṃ dvyackam, kiṃ tarhi? tryackam| avaragrahaṇe tu sati bhavati;
nyūnanivṛtyarthatvādavaraśabdasya| paṭiti karotīti|
ṭhavyaktānukaraṇasyāta itau' iti acchabdasya pararūpatvam| tadyatra syād,
ḍājantasya satitvaṃ syāditi śabdamanuccārya karotirantaraḥ syāt,
itiśca, tataḥ paraḥ ekāctvādasya pratyayasvereṇaiva siddhamudātatvam,
ṭhlohitādiḍājbhyaḥ' ityatrāpi ṭhḍābhyaḥ' ityucyamāne'pi na
kaścihoṣaḥ|
iḍāyāṃ ḍāśabdo'narthakaḥ, ṭhnābhā pṛthivyāḥ' ityādau suvādeśasyāpi
ḍāśabdasyāgrahaṇam; cchandasi tataḥ kyapo'darśanāt,
tasmānnārthaścakāreṇa ? tatrāha--cakāra ityādi| paṭapaṭā asīti sthite
ṭhtiṅṅatiṅaḥ' iti nighātaḥ, ekādeśaḥ| atrāsati cakāre ṭhsvarito
vānudāte'padādau' iti pakṣe svaritaḥ syāt| citkaraṇasāmarthyātu
cidacitorekādeśasya pūrva pratyantavadbhāvāccitsvareṇāntodāta
eva bhavati|
sa svārthiko vijñeya iti| arthāntarasyābhāvāt| svārthe tu
yakāro'smādeva nipātanādvijñeyaḥ ||

kṛtro dvitīyatṛtīyaśambabījāt kṛṣau || 5|4|58 ||
kṛṣāvabhidheyāyāmiti| kasyābhidheyāyām? dvidīyādiśabdānāṃ
ḍājantānāṃ kṛñśca| taddarśayati--dvitīyaṃ karṣaṇaṃ vilekhanaṃ
karotītyartha iti| pratilomaṃ karṣatītyarthaṃ iti| śambaśabdasyātra
prātilomye vṛttiḥ, kṛñśca karṣaṇe| saha bījeneti| bījaśabdasya
bījāvāpasahite vilekhane vṛterayamartho bhavati ||

saṅkhyāyāśca guṇāntāyāḥ || 5|4|59 ||
saṅkhyāvācinaḥ śabdasyeti| etena saṅkhayyā ityasya vaṣṭa|lntatāṃ
darśayati| guṇānteti| vyadhikaraṇapado bahuvrīhiḥ, antaśabdaśca
samīpavacana ityāha--guṇaśabdo'nte samīpa iti| antaśabdasya
saṅkhyāyā ityetadapekṣamāṇasyāpi sambandhiśabdasya
nityasāpekṣatvātsamāsaḥ, nipātanācca saptanyantasyāpi tasya
paranipātaḥ| yatretyanena prakṛtirnirdiśyate| setyādinā
prakṛtisaṅkhyā| guṇāntetyucyate| saṅkhayāśabdasyānte guṇaśbado
yasyāḥ sā tathoktā| atrāpi gamakatvātsamāsaḥ| tādṛśāditi|
saṅkhyāśabdasamīpavatiguṇaśabdādityarthaḥ| antaśabdaścāyaṃ niyatameva
paratvaviśiṣṭṃa sāmīpyamācaṣṭe, na sāmīpyamātram| tena
guṇaviśatirityādau pūrvabhūte guṇaśabde'tiprasaṅgo
nodbhāvanīyaḥ| anabhidhānādvā'tra pratyayābhāvaḥ| dviguṇaṃ vilekhanaṃ
karoti kṣetrasyeti| atra vilekhanaśabdasya kṛdantasya
prayogātkṛdyogadalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭī kṣetrādbhavati| utpanne tu taddhite
tadabhāvād dvitīyaiva bhavati|
athaivaṃ kasmānna vyākhyāyate--saṅkhyāyate-saṅkhayāyā iti pañcamī,
antaśabdo'vayavavacanaḥ, saṅkhayāvācinaḥ paro yo
guṇaśabdastadantāyāḥ prakṛteriti ? ucyate; evaṃ hi sati guṇāntāyā
eva saṅkhyāyā iti viśeṣaṇaṃ syāt, na guṇaśabdasya samāse
guṇabhūtasya| evaṃ tarhi mā būdantagrahaṇam, saṅghyāyā
guṇādityevāstu, vyadhikaraṇe ca pañcamyau-- saṅkhyāyāḥ paro yo
guṇaśabdastasmāditi? evamapi vākye prasaṅgaḥ--pañca
guṇānkarotīti, viparyayaśca sambhāvyeta---guṇaśabdātparā yā
saṅkhyā tadantāditi| evaṃ tarhi saṅkhyāderguṇādityevāstu?
satyam; tathā tu na kṛtamityeva, pratyuta yathānyāse dviguṇabhāgaṃ
kṣetraṃ karotītyatrāpi prasaṅgaḥ ||

samayācca yāpanāyām || 5|4|60 ||
samayākarotīti| ṭhadya me pāravāśyaṃ śvaḥ paraśvo vāsya samayaḥ' ityevaṃ
yo bahuṣu divaseṣu ativartate sa evamutyate| samayaṃ karotīti|
samayaḥuniyamaḥ, saṅgamo vā--samayanaṃ samaya iti ||

sapatraniṣpatrādativyathane || 5|4|61 ||
patatyaneneti patramuśarāṇāṃ puṅkhagato barhaḥ| sapatraṃ śaramiti|
saha pattreṇa vartata iti| sapattraḥ, āpuṅkhānmṛgaśarīre śaraṃ
praveśayatītyarthaḥ| niṣpatrākarotīti| nirgataṃ patramasmānniṣpatraṃ
mṛgaṃ karotīti| yathāsya śarīre puṅkhapradeśo'pi na lagati, tathā
śaraṃ śarīrānniṣkrāmayatītyarthaḥ|
sapatraṃ vṛkṣamiti| patrāṇiuparṇāni| jalasecanata iti| ṭhkartṛkaraṇe
kṛtā bahulam' iti tṛtīyāsamāsaḥ| bhūmiśodhaka iti| ṭhnityaṃ
krīḍājīvikayoḥ' iti jīvikāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ ||

niṣkulānniṣkoṣaṇe || 5|4|62 ||
niṣkulākarotīti| niṣkośitaṃ kulamantaravayavānāmasmāditi
bahuvrīhau ḍāc ||

sukhapriyādānulomye || 5|4|63 ||
ārādhyacitānuvartanamiti| ārādhyāḥusvāmyādayaḥ,
teṣāmiṣṭāniṣṭakaraṇākaraṇābhyāṃ yaccitasyānuvartanamu ārādhanaṃ
tadānulomyam| priya karotyauṣadhapānamiti| prītiḥupriyam, ghañarthe
kaḥ|

duḥkhātprātilomye || 5|4|64 ||
citapīḍanamiti| svāmyāderyadaniṣṭasyācaraṇena iṣṭasyākaraṇena vā
citasya pīḍanaṃ tatprātilomyam ||

śūlātpāke || 5|4|65 ||
śūlaṃ karoti kadannamiti| śūlamūdaratodaḥ, kutsitamannaṃ kadannam
||

satyādaśapathe || 5|4|66 ||
satsu sādhu satyam, prāgghitīye yati prāpte'smādeva nipātanādyaḥ
antodāto hi satyaśabdaḥ--satyenotabhitā bhūmiḥ, ṛtaṃ ca satyaṃ
ceti| śaperathaḥ śapathaḥ, bhāṇḍamuratnādidravyajātam| tathyamiti|
tathaivautathyam, ṭhpādārghābhyāṃ ca' iti
cakārasyānuktasamuccayārthatvātsvārthe yat ||

madrātparivāpaṇe || 5|4|67 ||
parivāpaṇamiti| karmavyāpāramātravācino vaperhetumaṇṇici lyuṭ,
māṅgalyaṃ muṇḍanaṃ karotītyarthaḥ, coladīkṣādau| bhadrācceti
vaktavyamiti| madrādityarthagrahaṇamiti tu vyākhyāne
maṅgalādibhyo'pi syāt|

samāsāntāḥ || 5|4|68 ||
avayavavacano'ntaśabda ityāha-avayavā ekadeśā iti| samīpavacanastu na
gṛhyate; pratyayaparatvenaiva siddhatvāt| avayavavacanaṃ
cāntaśabdamāśrayatā samāsārthādutarapadādakṛta eva samāse samāsāntā
bhavantītyuktaṃ bhavati| evaṃ hi te samāsasyaikādeśā bhavanti, yadi
prāgeva tānpratyayānkṛtvā tadantena samāsaḥ kriyate| tathā ca ṭhna kapi'
ityatra vakṣyati--ṭhsamāsārthe hyutarapade kapi kṛte paścātsamāsena
bhavitavyamiti| ye punaratra pakṣe doṣāste ṅyāpsūtre eva
prativihitāḥ|
adhirājam, uparājamiti| vibhaktyarthe sāmīpye cāvyayībhāvaḥ,
ṭhavyayībhāve śaratprabhṛtibhyaḥ' ṭhanaśca' iti ṭac| dvipurīti|
samāhāradvandvaḥ| ṭhṛkpūrabdhūḥ' ityakāraḥ| koṣaśca niṣacca
koṣaniṣadam, srukca tvak ca
sruktvacam-dvandvāccudaṣahāntātsamāhāre' iti ṭac| vigato dhuraḥ,
pragato dhura iti| prādisamāsaḥ| tatpuruṣe tulyārtetyeṣa svaro
bhavatīti| pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaraḥ, pūrvapadaṃ cātra ṭhnipātā
ādyaudātāḥ', ṭhupasargāścābhivarjam' ityādyaudātam, uccairnīcaiḥ- śabdau
svarādiṣvantodātau paṭhitau| atha samāsagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā
ṭhbahuvrīhau saṃkhyeye,' ṭhtatpuruṣasyāṅguleḥ', ṭhavyayībhāve
śaratprabhṛtibhyaḥ' ṭh dvandvāccudaṣahāntāt' iti prāyeṇa
samāsaviśeṣagrahaṇamasti? yatrāpi nāsti tatrāpi saṅgāta eva gṛhyate,
yathā ṭhac pratyanvavapūrvātsāmalomnaḥ' iti| yatra tarhyetadubhayaṃ nāsti
ṭhṛkpūrabdhūḥ' ityādau, samāsagrahamamiti ||

na pūjanāt || 5|4|69 ||
yān śabdānupādāyeti| pūjanavacanātsamāsānto na
bhavatītyayamartho na bhavati; parigaṇitābhya eva prakṛtibhyaḥ
samāsāntavidhānāt| tatra ca pūjanārthasya kasyācidabhāvāt, abhāve
pratiṣedhānupapateḥ| surājetyādau prādisamāsaḥ |
pūjāyāṃ svalatigrahaṇamiti| pūjanagrahaṇamapi kartavyameva, avakṣepaṇe
atikramaṇe ca vartamānayoḥ svatyorgrahaṇaṃ mā bhūditi|
prāgbahuvrīhigrahaṇaṃ ceti| ṭhvahuvrīhau sakthyakṣaṇoḥ' ityataḥ
prāgayamadhikāra iti vaktavyamityarthaḥ|

kimaḥ kṣepe || 5|4|70 || 
kirājeti| ṭhkiṃ kṣepe' iti samāsaḥ| kasya rājā kirāja iti| praśne'tra
kiṃśabdaḥ|
ṭhkṣepe' iti śakyamākartum, kasmādatra na
bhavati--lakṣaṇapratipadoktayoḥ pratipadoktasyaiva grahaṇamiti?
kaśṭidāha--kṣepagrahaṇenaijjñāpayati--iyamiha paribhāṣā nāpatiṣṭhata
iti, tena ninditā dhūrasya śakaṭasya kiṃdhūḥ śaṭakamiti bahuvrīhāvapi
pratiṣedhaḥ siddho bhavatīti| tadbhāṣyavirodhādupekṣyam|
tasmādvispaṣṭārthaṃ kṣepagrahaṇam ||

bahuvrīhau saṃkhyeye ḍajabahugaṇāt || 5|4|73 ||
ṭhbahuvrīhau' iti subbyatyayena pañcamyarthe saptamī| tasyedaṃ
grahaṇamiti| tasyaiva saṃkhyeye vṛteḥ| yo'pi vārthe vartate-dvitrāḥ,
pañcaṣā iti, yo'pi ,sujarthe-dvidaśāstridaśā iti; tāvubhāvapi
saṃkhyeya eva vartete; saṃkhyeyasyaiva vārthasya sujarthasya cābhidhānāt|
upadaśā ityādau ṭilopaḥ| upaviṃśā ityatra ṭhtiviṃśaterḍiti' iti
tilopaḥ dvayorakārayoḥ ṭhato guṇe' pararūpatvam|
saṃkhyeya iti śakyamavaktum| iha kasmānna bhavati---citraguriti?
natrivayuktanyāyena bahugaṇapratiṣedhātatsadṛśavijñāne sati
saṃkhyotarapado bahuvrīhirgrahīṣyate| syādetat--vaipulyavacano'pi
bahuśabdo'sti, na saṃkhyāpadameva, gaṇaśabdo'pi
saṅghavacano'pyasti, tasmādaśakyaṃ bahugaṇasādṛśyena saṃkhyotarapadaṃ
grahītumiti ? tanna; parasparasāhacaryātsaṃkhyāpadayoreva
paryudāsāt| tasmāt prasajyapratiṣedhe'pi samāsasambhavātsādṛśyasya
cānavasthitatvāt saṃkhyeyagrahaṇaṃ kṛtam| upabahavaḥ, upagaṇā iti|
aniyatapracayavacanayorapi bahugaṇaśabdayorarthaprakaraṇādinā yadā
viśiṣṭeṣveva daśādiṣu vṛttistadā tatsamīpagatā navādaya upabahava
ityaviruddhaṃ bahuvacanam| atreti| upagaṇā ityatra svare viśeṣa iti|
ḍaci satyantodātatvaṃ syāt, tasmi, tasmistvasati
pūrvapadaprakṛtisvareṇādyaudātatvameva bhavati|
saṃkhyāyāstatpuruṣasyeti| tatpuruṣasyāvayavabhūtaṃ
yatsaṃkhyāvācyutaparapadaṃ tasmādityarthaḥ| nistriśādyathamiti| ādiśabdaḥ
prakāre, avyayādayaḥ saṃkhyāntāstatpuruṣā nistriṃśaprakārāḥ|
goviṃśatirityādau na bhavati| nistriśānivarṣāṇīti|
triṃśallākṣaṇāyāḥ saṃkhyāyā nirgatāni adhikāniṃ ekatriṃśadādīnītyarthaḥ|
nirgatastriśato'ṅgūlibhya iti| tato'pi dīrghatara ityarthaḥ|
rūḍhiśabdasyeyaṃ yathākathañcidvyutpattiḥ|
ḍacaścitkaraṇaṃ svarārtham; anyathā samāsārthādutarapadātpratyaye kṛte
paścādvahuvrīhau satiśiṣṭaḥ pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaraḥ syāt| idameva
citkaraṇaṃ liṅgam-samāsārthādutarapadātsamāsānte kṛte
paścātsamāsaḥ iti, anyathā pratyayasvara eva satiśiṣṭaḥ svaraḥ syāt|
yastu manyate--ṭhkṛte samāse
samāsāntagrahaṇasāmarthyāccāgamavatadgrahaṇena gṛhyate' iti, tasyāpi
jñāpakārthaṃ citkaraṇam; svaravidheḥ prāgeva samāsānto bhavatīti|
tena mahādhura ityādau bahuvrīhisvaro bhavati ||

ṛkpūrabdhūḥpathāmānakṣe || 5|4|74 || 
sāmārthyāditi| dhura evākṣeṇa sambandho'sti,
netareṣāmityetatsāmarthyam| etadviśeṣaṇamiti| ṭhanakṣe'
ityatrotarapadārtha etadā pratyavamṛśyate, ata evāha--akṣasambandhinī yā
dhūriti| sūtre tvakṣasya dhūrapekṣayā'dhikaraṇatvādanakṣa iti saptamī|
cakrasambaddhaḥ kāṣṭhaviśeṣo rathādyavayavaḥuakṣaḥ, tatsambandhinī dhūstasyāṃ
na bhavatītyarthaḥ| yadi tvakṣe samāsārthe na bhavatīti vijñāyeta, ihaiva
pratiṣedhaḥ syāt-dṛḍhā dhūrasya dṛḍhadhūrakṣa iti, iha tu na syād--akṣasya
dhūrakṣadhūriti| athāpyevaṃ vijñāyeta--akṣe pūrvapade na bhavatīti,
evamapīhaiva pratiṣedhaḥ syād--akṣadhūriti, iha tu na syāddṛḍhadhūrakṣa
iti| tasmādvyāptinyāyā dukta evārtho nyāyyaḥ| arddharca iti| ṭhadha
napuṃsakam' iti samāse ṭharddharcāḥ puṃsi ca' iti puṃlliṅgatvam|
bahvaca iti| bahuvrīhiḥ| lalāṭapuram, nāndīpuramiti|
ṣaṣṭhīsamāsau| paravalliṅgatā tu na bhavati,
lokāśrayatvālliṅgasya| yadyapyakārāntena puraśabdena samāse kṛte
etatsiddhyati, tathāpi vyañjanāntena samāse tasya śravaṇaṃ mā bhūditi
pūrvagrahaṇam, dvīpaṃ samīpamiti| dvirgatā āpo'sminniti
bahuvrīhiḥ, ṭhdvyantarupasargebyo'pa it' itītvam| rājadhurādayaḥ
ṣaṣṭhīsamāsāḥ| mahādhura iti| bahuvrīhiḥ, ṭhstriyāḥ puṃvat' iti
puṃvadbhāvaḥ, ṭhānmahataḥ' ityātvam| 
anṛco māṇavaka ityādi| ṛgantasya bahuvrīhernañpūrvasya māṇavaka
evābhidheye pratyaya iṣyate, tathā bahupūrvapadasya
caraṇākhyāyāmevetyarthaḥ| anṛkkaṃ sāma, bahvṛkkaṃ sūktamiti|
ṭhjñeṣādvibhāṣā' iti kap, ṭhcoḥkuḥ' iti kutvam ||

ac pratyanvavapūrvātsāmalomnaḥ || 5|4|75 ||
pratisāmamityādau prādisamāsaḥ, bahuvrīhiḥ, avyayībhāvaśca
yathāsambhavaṃ veditavyāḥ|
kṛṣṇodakpāṇkaḍurvāyā iti| kṛṣṇādiśabdāḥ pūrve yasyāstasyā
bhūmerac pratyayaḥ smṛtaḥ| kṛṣṇā bhūmirasmin kṛṣṇabhūmo deśaḥ,
udīcī bhūmirasminnudagbhūmo deśaḥ| kaḥ punassau pṛthivyā
dakṣiṇasīmā? bhūmiśabdo vā tadviśeṣe sasvasaṃpanne draṣṭavyaḥ| yasya
dakṣiṇataḥ khilaḥ saṃdeśa udambhūma| godāvaryāśca nadyāścāc pratyayaḥ|
samṛtaḥ, te nadi saṃkhyā||| utare bhavataḥ---pañcagodāvaram,
pañcanadam| ṭhnadībhiśca' iti samāhāre'vyayībhāvaḥ|
padmanābha iti| padmākāro nābhirasyeti prathamāntaryorvahuvrīhiḥ|
padmaṃ nābhāvasyeti vigrahe gaḍvādipu darśanātsaptamyāḥ
paranipātaḥ ūrṇanābha iti| ṭhṅyāpoḥ saṃjñācchandasorvahulam'
ityūrṇaśabdasya hrasvaḥ| tadetaditi| kṛṣṇabhūmādikam| 
ogavibhāgeneti| ata eva prāk pratyayanirddeśaḥ kṛtaḥ ||

akṣṇo'darśanāt || 5|4|76 ||
ṭhadarśanāt' iti vacanādakṣīvākṣītyakṣisadṛśārthavṛttirihākṣiśabda
upātaḥ| lavaṇākṣam, putkarākṣamiti| lavaṇamakṣīva, putkaraṇakṣīveti
ṭhupamitaṃ vyāghrādibhiḥ' iti samāsaḥ|
kathamityādi| nanu darśanādanyatra yo'kṣiśabdastadantādityuktam,
gavākṣakabarākṣayośca samudāyo darśanavacanaḥ, nākṣiśabda iti
kātrānupapatiḥ? satyam; akṣyantādadarśanāditi sūtrārthaḥ kasmānna
bhavatīti manyamānasyāyaṃ praśno draṣṭavyaḥ| cakṣuḥparyāya iti| tasya
prasiddhataratvāditi bhāvaḥ
