||

acaturavicaturasucaturastrīpuṃsadhenvanaḍuharksāmavāṅmanasākṣibhruvadāragavorvaṣṭhīvapadaṣṭhīvanaktaṃdivarātriṃdivāhardivasarajasaniśreyasapuruṣāyuṣadvyāyuṣatryāyuṣargyajuṣajātokṣamahokṣavṛddokṣopaśunagoṣṭhaśvāḥ || 5|4|77 ||
samāsavyavasthāpīti| kvacidbahuvrīhereva, kvacid
dvandvādevaityevaṃmādiko niyamaḥuvyavasthā| apiśabdādanyadapi
ṭilopādikaṃ tannipātanādeva| striyāḥ pumāniti| striyaṃ prati
pumān śūra ityarthaḥ|
akṣibhruvamiti| prāṇyaṅgatvādekavadbhāvaḥ| dāragavamiti| ṭhsarvo
dvandve vibhāṣayaikavadbhavati'| saptamyarthe vṛtayoravyayayoḥ
samāso'pi nipātanādeveti| cārthena yogābāvāt, na hi
bhavati-iha ca, evaṃ ceti| ahardivamiti| ṭhro'supi' iti rephaḥ|
kathamanayordvandva iti| na kathañācit, virupāṇāmapi
samānārthānāmekaśeṣārambhāt| vīpsāyāmityādi| cārthe
vidhīyamāno vīpsāyāṃ na prāpnoti, ekaśeṣārambhācca|
tasmādvīpsāyāṃ dvandvo nipātyate, vīpsādyotanāccaikena
gatārthatvamapi nāśaṅkanīyam, yathā dvirvacane--grāmogrāmo
ramaṇīya iti|
sarajasamiti| ṭhavyayībhāve cākāle' iti sahasya sabhāvaḥ|
niḥśreyasamiti| prādisamāsaḥ| niḥśreyaska iti| niścitaṃ
śreyo'neneti bahuvrīhiḥ, śepalakṣaṇaḥ kap, ṭhso'padādau' iti
satvam|
ṛgyajurunmuggha iti| ya ṛco yajuṃpi manyate|
trayo vā catvāro vā tricaturāḥ| caturṇāṃ samīpa upacaturāḥ,
ṭhbahuvrīhau saṅkhyete' iti prāptasya kaḍaco'pavādo'dajvidhīyate
||

brahmahastibhyāṃ varcasaḥ || 5|4|78 ||
varcaḥudīptiḥ| udāharaṇeṣu ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ ||

avasamandhebhyastamasaḥ || 5|4|79 ||
avagataṃ tamo'vatamasam, santataṃ tamaḥ santamasam, prādisamāsau|
andaṃ karoti andhayati, andhayateḥ pacādyac--andham, tacca tatamasca
andhatamasam ||

śvaso vasīyaḥ śreyasaḥ || 5|4|80 ||
vasuśabdātpraśastavacanādīyasun--vasīyaḥ, ṭhpraśasyasya śraḥ'--śreyaḥ|
svabāvāccetyādi| yadyapi śvaḥśabdo'ntra kālaviśeṣe vartate, tathāpīha
samāse utarapadārthapraśaṃsāmāśīrviṣayāmācaṣṭe| kutaḥ ? svabhāvat|
asyaiveti| śvaḥ śreyasaśabdasyetyarthaḥ ||

anvavataptādrahasaḥ || 5|4|81 ||
rahaḥśabdo'yamaprakāśe vartate| anugataṃ raha iti| prādisamāsaḥ,
anugataṃ raho'sminniti bahuvrīhirvā| evamavahīnaṃ rahaḥ, avahīnaṃ
raho'sminnati avarahasam| taptaṃ ca tadrahaśca taptarahasa||||| atyantaṃ
raha ityarthaḥ || 

praterurasaḥ saptamīsthāt || 5|4|82 ||
saptamyarthe vartata iti| na hyanyaduraḥśabdasya saptamīsthatvaṃ nāmeti
bhāvaḥ ||

anugavamāyāme || 5|4|83 ||
āyāme'bhidheya iti| pravṛttinamitamāyāmaḥ, tadvati tu paryavasānam|
matvarthīyākārānto vā āyāmaśabdaḥ, āyāmavatyabhidheya ityarthaḥ;
anyathā'nugavaṃ yānamiti sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ na syāt| yasya cāyāma
iti samāsa iti| nanu tatra lakṣaṇeneti vartate ? satyam; ihāpi bāhyaṃ
yānaṃ prati gavāmastyeva lakṣaṇabhāvaḥ| anuguśabdātpratyaye'bhidhātavye
nipātanāśrayaṇaṃ prasiddhyupasaṃgrahārtham, tena yadgavāṃ bāhyaṃ
tatraiva bhavati ||

dvistāvā tristāvā vediḥ || 5|4|84 ||
samāsaśca nipātyata iti| lakṣṇābhāvāt| yāvatī prakṛtatāvityādinā
nipātanasya viṣayaṃ darśayati, yasminkarmaṇyupadiṣṭā dharmāḥ
karmāntareṇopajīvyante sā prakṛtirjyotiṣṭomādiḥ,
yenopajīvyate sāuvikṛtiḥ| kasyāñcidvikṛtāviti| aśvamedhādau|
dvistāveti| tāvatīśabdena tatsambandhinyā vṛttirlakṣyate, saiva ca
dviśabdanaṃ saṃkhyāyata iti suc pratyayaḥ, parasparasāmarthya ca|
dvistāvatītyasamāso'yam| sūtre liṅgamavivakṣitamā|
dvistāvo'gnirityapi dṛśyate| na cātrāgniramidhiyate, na vediḥ?
agnirapi vedireva; utaravedivikāratvāt,
ṭhutaravedyāmagniśacīyate' iti vacanāt ||

upasargādadhvanaḥ || 5|4|85 ||
adhvaśabdasyākriyāvacanatvātaṃ pratyupasargasaṃjñābhāvādupa sargagrahaṇaṃ
prādyaupalakṣaṇam ||

tatpuruṣasyāṅgaleḥ saṃkhyāvyayādeḥ || 5|4|86 ||
aṅguliśabdāntasyetyādi| sarvatra samāsāntasambandhe ṣaṣṭhī ||

ahaḥsarvekadeśasaṃkhyātapuṇyācca rātreḥ || 5|4|87 ||
ahargrahaṇaṃ dvandvārthamiti| na tu tatpuruṣārtham;
mukhyārthavṛtayostatpuruṣāsambhavāt| na hyasti sambhavaḥ- rātriśceti,
nāpyahorātrirityasti| yadi tu rātriśabdena tadguṇamaharucyate
ahaḥ śabdena tadguṇā rātriḥ, tataḥ sambhavedapiviśeṣaṇasamāsaḥ|
gauṇārthatā tu bhavati| na ca mukhye sambhavati gauṇasya grahaṇaṃ yuktam,
tasmādahargrahaṇaṃ dvandvārtham| tathā ca--ṭhhemantaśiśirāvahorātre ca
cchandasi' iti dvandve samāsānto nirdyiṣṭaḥ| ahorātra iti|
samāhāradvandvaḥ, ṭhrātrāhnāhāḥ paṃsi', ahno rutve
ṭhrūparātrirathantareṣu' iti nakārasya rutvam, tasya ṭhhaśi ca'
ityutvam| dvirātra iti| samāhāre dviguḥ| nīrātra iti| prādisamāsaḥ,
ṭhḍhralope pūrvasya dīrgho'ṇaḥ' ||

ahne'hna etebhyaḥ || 5|4|88 ||
tasminparabhūta iti| samāsāntaprakaraṇātatra parato'yamādeśo
vijñāyate, na tadapavādaḥ sa ca ṭajeva vihita iti sāmarthyādayamartho
labhyate, vyākhyānāccāhnādeśaḥ| svayaṃ samāsānto na vijñāyate
ṭhūdhaso'naṅ' ityādivat| sāmarthyāccetyādi| sāmāsānto
navijñāyate ṭhūdhaso'nah' ityādivat| sāmarthyāccetyādi|
sāmarthyameva darśayati| na hīti| ekaśeṣavidhānād dvandvastāvanna
sambhavati, tenaiva tasyāsambandhānna ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ, nāpi
viśeṣaṇasamāsaḥ, na hi tadeva tasya viśeṣaṇaṃ sambhavati| etena
bahuvrīhirvyākhyātaḥ| dvyahna iti| taddhitārthe samāsaḥ, ṭhtatra bhavaḥ'
ityaṇ, tasya ṭhdvigorluganapatye' iti luk| sarvāhna iti|
ṭhahno'dantāt' iti ṇatvam|
ahno'hnavacanānarthakyam, ahnaṣṭakhorniyamavacanāt,ṭhahna etebhyaḥ'
ityetāvadeva sūtraṃ kartavyam, ajanuvartate, etebhyaḥ paro
yo'hanśabdastato'jbhavati, ṭaco'pavādaḥ, tatrāci
kṛte'hnaṣṭakhoreveti niyamāṭṭilopābāve'llope sati dvayahna
ityādi sidhyati, ṭhrātrāhnāhāḥ puṃsi' iti vacanāt striyāṃ
pravṛtyabhāvāṭṭajacoraviśeṣaḥ| ṭhetebhyaḥ' iti vacanaṃ
saṃkyāvyayārtham; itarathā cānukṛṣṭatvānna sambaddhyeta ||

na saṅkhayādeḥ samāhāre || 5|4|89 ||
ṭhsaṅkhayādeḥ' iti na vaktavyam; anyasya samāhāre vṛtyasambhavāt ||

utamaikābhyāṃ ca || 5|4|90 ||
kecitatvityādi| yathā ṭhprathamayoḥ' iti prathamādvitīyayorgrahaṇaṃ
dvivacananirddeśāt,
tathaivātrāpyutamagrahaṇasāmarthyādupotamotamayordvayorapi
grahaṇamiti tepāmabhiprāyaḥ| atra pakṣe utamau dvāvekaścāpara iti
bahuvacanaprasaṅgāt sautro dvivacananirdeśaḥ|
ekaśabdasyāpūrvanipātaḥ ṭhalpāctaram' ityasyānityatvajñāpanārthaḥ ||

rājāhassakhibhyaśṭac || 5|4|91 ||
iha kasmāditi| kiṃ ca syādyadyatra ṭac syāt ? ṭhbhasyāḍhea taddhite' iti
puṃvadbhāvena ṅīpi nivṛte ṭaci ṭilāpe sati ṭitvānṅīpi
madrarājīti syāt, bhadrarārjñīti cepyate| tasmādatra
ṭaco'nutpattivaktavyeti bhāvaḥ| ṭacaścitkaraṇamantodātārtham; anyathā
prayayasya samāsekadaśatvādvidhuraḥ, pradhura ityādāviva
pratyayasvaro'vyayapūrvapadaprakṛtisvareṇa bādhyeta ||

gorataddhitaluki || 5|4|92 ||
pañcagavāmiti| samāhāre dviguḥ, pañcagurityatra tadvitārthe|
pañcagavarūpyam, pañcagavamayamiti| yathātra ṭhdvigorluganapatye' iti
rūpyamayaṭorlugna bhavati tathā tatraivoktam ||

agrākhyāyāmurasaḥ || 5|4|93 ||
ṭhagrākhyāyām' iti pañcamyarthe saptamī, pañcamyantenoraḥ śabdena
sāmānādhikaraṇyāt| sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ tu ṭhsa ceduraḥśabdaḥ'
ityādinā darśitam ||

ateḥ śunaḥ || 5|4|94 ||
javana ityartha ityādi| viṣayaviśeṣādiyamarthavyavasthā śvaśabdasya ||

upamānādapraṇiṣu || 5|4|97 ||
aśvā loṣṭa iti| atra ṭh nañastatpuruṣāt' iti pratiṣedhena bhāvyam,
tasmānniḥ śvā loṣṭa iti pratyudāhartavyam ||

khāryāḥ prācām || 5|4|101 ||
dvikhārīti| ṭajabhāvapakṣe napuṃsakahnasvatvam|
ayaṃ yogaḥ śakyo'vaktum trikhāramiti? khārīśabdena samānārthaḥ
khāraśabdo'sti yathā ca ṭhtadasya parimāṇam' , ṭhsaṃkhyāyāḥ saṃjñā'
ityatra ṭhanyebhyo'pi dṛśyate khāraśatādyartham' iti vārtikam ||

dvitribhyāmañjaleḥ || 5|4|102 ||
dvābhyāmañjalibhyāṃ krīto dvayañjaliriti| añjaliparimito
vrīhyādirañjaliḥ; na pāṇidvayam, tasya mullatvāsambhavāt| tataśca
parimāṇatvātprāgvatīyasya ṭhakaḥ ṭhadhyarddhapūrva' iti luk|
dvyañjalipriya iti| vyavasthaitavibhāṣātvādutarapadadvigorna
bhavatītyāhuḥ ||

anasantānnapuṃsakācchasi || 5|4|103 || 
sutrāmāṇamiti| suṣṭhua trāyate iti ṭhāto manin', upapadasamāsaḥ|
anehasamiti| ṭhnañyāhana eha ca' ityāṅpūrvāddhantaresipratyayaḥ,
dhātūpasargayoścehādeśaḥ, naña upapadasamāsaḥ, dvitīyaikavacanam|
antagrahaṇaṃ vispaṣṭārtham ||

brahmaṇo jānapadākhyāyām || 5|4|104 ||
antareṇāpi bhāvapratyayaṃ jānapadaśabdo bhāvapradhānaḥ, ṭhdvyekayoḥ'
itivadityāha-samāsena ced brahmaṇo jānapadatvamākhyāyate iti|
yadyapyekaṃ brahmagrahaṇam, tena ca samāso viśeṣitaḥ, tathāpi
pratyāsaterbrahmaṇa eva jānapadatvaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ vijñāyate,
tasmādetatpratyayavidhānamiti| tata eva hi pratyayavidāne brahmaṇo
jānapadatvaṃ śakyamākhyātum|
devabrahmaeti| ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ, karmadhāro vā ||

dvandvācyudaṣahāntātsamāhāre || 5|4|106 ||
tatpuruṣānmā bhūditi| tatpuruṣādeva mā bhūdityarthaḥ| ṭhdvandvāt'
ityanucyamāne hi tatpuruṣādhikāro na nivarteta ||

avyayībhāve śaratprabhṛtibhyaḥ || 5|4|107 ||
jarāyā jaras ceti| jarāśabdādac pratyayo bhavati, avyayībhāve
jarasādeśaśca--upajarasam| pratiparasamanubhyo'kṣṇaṃ iti| prādibhyaḥ
paro yo'kṣiśabdastataṣṭajbhavati, tatra
paraśabdasyāvyayībhāvasambhavātatpuruṣātha grahaṇam| pratyakṣamiti|
ṭhyathārthe yadavyayam' iti vīpsāyāmavyayībhāvaḥ, parakṣmaṇaḥ parokṣam,
ṭhparokṣe liṭ' iti nirddeśātpañcamīsamāsaḥ, upasarjanasya ca
paranipātaḥ, akṣyakārasya cotvam| akṣiyogyamusamakṣam, yathārthe
yogyatāyāmavyayībhāvaḥ| anvakṣamiti| paścādarthe'vyayībhāvaḥ||

napuṃsakādanyatarasyām || 5|4|109 ||
napuṃsakagrahaṇamutarapadaviśeṣaṇamiti| nāvyayībhāvaviśeṣaṇam;
avyabhicārāt ||

nadīpaurṇamāsyāgrahāyaṇībhyaḥ || 5|4|110 ||
ṭhnadi' iti svarūpagrahaṇam, na saṃjñāyāḥ; paurṇamāsyāgrahāyaṇyoḥ
pṛthaggrahaṇāt ||

jhayaḥ || 5|4|111||
jhaya iti pratayāhāragrahaṇamiti| jhakārayakārayostu grahaṇaṃ na bhavati;
tadantasyāvyayībhāvasyāsambhavāt| yogavibāgaścintyaprayojanaḥ ||

gireśca senakasya || 5|4|112 ||
antargiramiti| vibhaktayarte'vyayībhāvaḥ| vikalpo'nuvartata eveti|
anyathā keṣāñācijjhayantānāṃ śaratprabhṛtiṣu pāṭho'narthakaḥ syāt;
ṭhjhayaḥ' ityanenaiva siddhatvāt| etenaitanna
codanīyam---ṭhdvayorvibhāṣayormadhye nityā vidhayaḥ' iti pūrvasya
vidhernityatvārthamidaṃ senakagrahaṇaṃ syāditi ||

brahmavrīhau sakthyakṣṇoḥ svāṅgāt ṣac || 5|4|113 ||
svāṅgamadravādilakṣaṇaṃ pāribhāṣikaṃ gṛhyate| duḥśliṣṭavibhaktīnīti|
durunindāyām| ninditaṃ yathā tathā śliṣṭāḥ sambaddhāḥ vibhakyo
yeṣu tāni tathoktāni, tathā hi--bahuvrīhiśabdātpañcamyā
bhavitavyam, samāsāntasambanadhe ṣaṣṭha|la vā,
yathā--ṭhtatpuruṣasyāhguleḥ' iti; iha tu saptamyekavacanaṃ śrutam|
ṭhsakthyakṣaṇeḥ' iti ṣaṣṭhīdvivacanam, saptamīdvavacanaṃ vā| na
caivambhūtenānena bahuvrīhiḥ śakyo viśeṣayutum;
bhinnavibhaktivacanatvāt| svāṅgāditi pañcamyekavacanam, tacca na
sakthyakṣaṇoḥ samānādhikaraṇaṃ viśeṣaṇamavakalpate, tatcābhipretam|
tasmādvibhaktivyatyayamāśritya vibhaktayaḥ sambandhayitavyā iti
ṭhduḥślaṣṭavibhaktīni' ityuktam|
sthūlākṣirikṣuriti| ṭhakṣṇo'darśanāt' ityacātra bhavitavyam| yadi tu
neṣyate, samāsāntavidhiranitya iti vaktavyam; tata eva tarhi ṣajapi na
bhaviṣyati| tasmātsthūlākṣā, sūkṣamākṣā veṇuyaṣṭiriti ajeva ṭāpi
pratyudāhartavya ityāhuḥ| dīrghasakthīti| dīgha sakthyasyāḥ sā
dīrghasakthī, atra ṣaci satika ṅīṣudāto bhavati, ṭaci tu sati
ṅībanudātaḥ syāt| nanu ṭacaścitkaraṇamantodātārtham, tataśca
ṅībapyudātanivṛttisvareṇodāta eva bhaviṣyati ? tatrāha--sakyaṃ
cākrāntādityādi| vibhāyeti| ṭhvibhāṣotpuccha' ityato'nuvṛteḥ
ṣacaścitkaraṇamakṣyartham| sakthyapi yadākrāntātparaṃ tadā
nityamantodātaṃ bhavati--cakrasakthaḥ, vakrasaktha iti| gaurasakthādau tu
nārthaścitkaraṇena ||

aṅgulerdāruṇi || 5|4|114 ||
aṅgalisadṛśāvayavamityādi| dāruṇi samāsārthe
mukhyābhiraṅgulībhiḥ sambandho noparpadyata iti bhāvaḥ|
nanu ca dve aṅgulī pramāṇamasya dāruṇa ityatra sambhavati? tatrāha--yasya
tvalityādi| iha ca bahuvrīherayaṃ pratyayo vidhīyate, tvadukte
codāharaṇe taddhitārthe tatpuruṣaḥ kartavyaḥ, tatra ca
ṭhtatpuruṣasyāṅguleḥ' ityacā bhavitavyam| tasmādbahuvrīhau
dāruṇi vācye gauṇa evāṅguliśabda iti suṣṭhūaktamityarthaḥ ||

dvitribhyāṃ ṣa mūdhnaḥ || 5|4|115 ||
atha kimartha ṣaḥ pratyayāntaraṃ kriyate, na prakṛtaḥ ṣajanuvartiṣyate?
dvimūrddhaḥ, trimūrddha ityatra ṭhdvitribhyāṃ pāddanmūrddhasu' iti
pākṣikamantodātatvaṃ yathā syāt| ṣaci tu sati
citvānnityamantodātatvaṃ syāt| ṭhdvitribhyāṃ pāddanmūrddhaśu
bahuvrīhau' ityasya tu samāsāntavidheranityatvātadabhāve dvimūrddhā,
ṭhtrimūrddhāna saptaraśmiṃ gṛṇīṣe' iti, so'vakāśaḥ syāt| ṣe tu sati
yadāpi samāsāntaḥ kriyate, tadāpi pakṣe'ntodātatvam, pakṣe
pūrvapadaprakṛtiśvareṇādyadātatvamiti svaradvayasiddhiḥ| anityatvaṃ ca
ṣavidhānādeva vijñāyate| nitye hi sati prakṛte ṣacyapi vihite
dvitribhyāmapi svaraḥ prāptamibhāṣārūpeṇa citsvaraṃ vādhiṣyate;
viṣayāntarābhāvāt| anityatve tu samāsānātābhāvapakṣe sāvakāśam
ṭhdvitribhyām' iti svaraṃ citsvaro vādheteti
pratyayāntarakaraṇamarthavadbhavati| evaṃ ca kṛtvā mūrdhasviti
nakārāntanirdaśa upapanno bhavati; anyathā ṭhsakyaṃ cākrāntāt'
itivadakārāntameva niddiśet| yadi nakārānto nirddiśyate,kathaṃ
samāsānte kṛte bhavati? naipa dopaḥ; vakṣyati hi tatra--ṭhyadāpi
samāsāntaḥ kriyate tadā bahuvrīheḥ kāryitvātadekadeśatvācca
samāsāntasyāntodātatvaṃ bhavatyeva' iti |

appūraṇīpramāṇyoḥ || 5|4|116 ||
pūraṇapratyayānta iti| ṭhtasya pūraṇe ḍaṭ' ityevamādayaḥ pūraṇārthe ye
pratyayā vihitāstadantā ityarthaḥ| strīliṅgā iti| ṭhpūraṇī' iti
ṅīpā nirddeśāt| pūraṇīgrahaṇena gṛhyante iti|
pūraṇārthasāhacaryāt|
api pradhānapūraṇīgrahaṇamiti| api vidhīyamāne pradhānaṃ yā pūraṇī sā
gṛhyata iti vaktavyamityarthaḥ| kvaca punaḥ pūraṇyāḥ prādānyam? ityata
āha--yatreti| na kevalaṃ vartipadārtha eveti| samāsāvayavabhūtaṃ padaṃ
vartipadam, tasyārtho vartipadārthaḥ| prathamāntaṃ caitat, na
saptamyantam| pūraṇītyetadanuṣajyate, na punaranupraviśatīti|
tatrodāharaṇe udbhūtāvayavabedasya samudāyasya kṛtaikaśeṣeṇa
rātriśabdenābhidhānādrātriṣu pañcamyā antarbhāvaḥ| kalyāṇapañcamīkaḥ
pakṣa iti| ṭhnadyaḥtaśca' iti ap| atra vartipadārtha eva pūraṇī, na
tvanyapadārthaḥ; tirohitāvayavalabhedasya pakṣasyānyapadārthatvāt|
yathā-vṛkṣaśabdasyāvayavyabhideyaḥ, na tu śākhādayo'vayavāḥ;
anumīyamānasyāśabdārthatvādityaprādhānyaṃ pūraṇyāḥ|
neturnakṣatra iti| yo netṛśabdastadantādbahuvrīherityarthaḥ| cchandasi
ceti| anakṣatrārthamidam| pañcakamāsika iti| pañcabhṛtirasya māsasya
pañcako māsaḥ, so'syāṃkhavasnabhṛtayaḥ' iti saṃkhyāyā kan, pañcako
māso'syeti bahuvrīhau kṛteṭac| apaḥ pitkasṇaṃ yatra
bahuvrīhāvantodātatvamāramyate tadbādhanārtham--apañcamāḥ,
supañcamāḥ, ṭhnañsubhyām' ityantodātatvaṃ na bhavati ||

añnāsikāyāḥ saṃjñāyāṃ nasaṃ cāsthūlāt || 5|4|118 ||
nasamiti| dvitīyānirddeśo vaicitryārthaḥ| draṇasa iti| druriva
nāsikāsya ṭhpūrvapadātsaṃjñāyāgaḥ' iti ṇatvam| vadhre bhavā vādhrī, sā
nāsikāsya vādhrīṇasaḥ, ṭhvṛddhinimitasya ca taddhaitasya' iti
puṃvadbhāvapratiṣedhaḥ| gauriva nāsikā'sya gonasaḥ| 
khurakharābhyāṃ nas vaktavya iti| kevalādeśavacanaṃ
pratyayanivṛtyartham| khuraṇāḥ, kharaṇā iti| ṭhatvasantasya ca' iti
dīrghaḥ|
śitiḥ kṛṣṇā nāsikāsya śitināḥ, aheriva nāsikā'sya ahināḥ|
arcāupratimā, tasyā iva nāsikāsya arcanāḥ, ṭhṅyāpoḥ
saṃjñācchandasoḥ' iti hrasvatvam ||

upasargācca || 5|4|119 || 
upasargagrahaṇaṃ prādyaupalakṣaṇam; nāsikāṃ prati kriyāyogābhāvāt|
vergro vaktavya iti| viśabdātparasya graśabda ādeśo bhavati;
pratyayastvajeva ||

suprātasuśvasudivaśārikukṣacaturaśraiṇīpadājapadaproṣṭhapadāḥ ||
5|4|120 ||
ṭilopādikamiti| suprātaḥ, sukhva ityatra ṭilopaḥ| ṭhavyayānāṃ
bhamātre ṭilopaḥ' ityetatu nāśritam| ādipadena ṇaṇīpadājapadayoḥ
padbhāvaḥ| śobhanaṃ prātarayeti| prātaḥ
śabdasyādhikaraṇapradhānatvātsāmānādhikaraṇyābhāvāt, prātastanaṃ karma
prātaḥśabdena lakṣyate, devadatādiścānyapadārtha ityāhuḥ| kathaṃ ca
ṭhvaradaḥ karotu suprātamahnāmayaṃ nāyakaḥ' iti? na hyayaṃ bahuvrīhiḥ,
śobhanaṃ prātastavārkaḥ karotviti hyatrārtha? ucyate; śobhanaṃ prātastanaṃ
karma yasya sandhyādestate karotviti kleśenāsya nirvāhaḥ ||

nañduḥsubhyo halisakthyoranyatarasyām || 5|4|121 ||
haligrahaṇamanarthakam? kathamahalaḥ, suhala iti? akārānto
halaśabdo'sti? nanvarthabhedo'sti-mahaddhalaṃ halirityucyate, halamātraṃ
tu halam? nāyamarthabhedaḥ kiñcitkaraḥ, kriyamāṇe'pi haligrahaṇe
halaśabdenāpi samāso na daṇkaḍavāritaḥ, tataśca prakaraṇādivaśena
viśeṣo'vagantavyaḥ; sati caivamakārāntenāpi samāse
prakaraṇādinaiva mahasvamavagaṃsyate? iha tarhi---durhala
ityakārāntenāpi samāse pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaraḥ prāpnoti,
samāsānte tu vihite citsvaro bhavati| ahalaḥ, suhala ityatra
ṭhnañsubhyām' ityantodātavidhānānnāsti viśeṣaḥ| ṭhśeṣādvibāṣā'
iti ca haliśabdātkap pratyayaḥ prasajyeta; tasmāddhaligrahaṇam| kecitu
haliśaktyoriti paṭhanti| asthiparyāyaḥ śaktiśabdaḥ ||

nityamasic prajāmedhayoḥ || 5|4|122 || asevāyaṃ na vihitaḥ,
sakāsyetsaṃjñā mā bhūditi|
evaṃ tarhītyādi| bhāṣye etannāśritam| citkaraṇam--duḥprajāḥ, durmedhā
ityatrāntodātārtham| anyatra ṭhnañsubhyām' ityeva siddham ||

dharmādanic kevalāt || 5|4|124 ||
paramaḥ svo dharmo'sya paramasvadharma iti|
ṭhsarvanāmasaṃkhyayorupasaṃkhyānam' iti svaśabdasya pūrvanipāto na
bhavati; prāptasya cābādhā vyākhyeyeti,
āhitāgnyāderākṛtigaṇatvādvā ||

jambhā suharitatṛṇasomebhyaḥ || 5|4|125 ||
dantavacano veti| ṭhimamambhasutaṃ piba' iti darśanāt ||

dakṣiṇermā lubdhayoge || 5|4|126 ||
lubdho vayādha iti| kavayastu hiṃsāmātre
prayuñjate--ṭhbālīhemābjamālī guṇanidhiriṣuṇā nirmito
dakṣiṇermā' iti yathā| vraṇitamiti| vraṇaśabdāditac| ṭhvrama
gātravicūrṇane' ityasmādvā caurādikaṇijantāktaḥ ||

ic karmavyatihāre || 5|4|127 ||
ayaṃ bahuvrīhirgṛhyata iti| asyaiva karmavyatihāre vṛteḥ|
udāraharaṇeṣu ṭhanyeṣāmapi dṛśyate' iti pūrvapadasya dīrghatvam|
tiṣṭhadguprabhṛtiṣvayamic paṭha|lte iti|
tenāvyayībhāvasaṃjñakatvādavyayatve sati sublugbhavatīti bhāvaḥ|
yadyevam, avyayībhāvasaṃjñayā bahuvrīhisaṃjñāyā
bādhanātsamāsasvareṇaivāntodātatvaṃ siddhamiti nārthaścitkaraṇena?
viśeṣaṇārthaṃ tu| asati hi tasmistiṣṭhadguprabhṛtiṣvikāramātraṃ
paṭha|leta, tataśca ṭhaca iḥ' ityasyāpi grahaṇaṃ syāt ||

dvidaṇḍa|ladibhyaśca || 5|4|128 ||
yadi ṭhdvidaṇkaḍa|ladayaḥ sādhavo bhavanti'--ityayamartho'bhipretaḥ,
ṭhdvidaṇḍa|ladibhyaḥ' iti sūtrapadasya kathaṃ nirvāhaḥ? ata
āha-dvidaṇḍa|ladibhya iti| tādarthya eṣā caturthītyādi|
samudāyanipātanācyeti| samudāyā yatra prasiddhāstatraiva
teṣāmavarodhaḥuavasthāpanaṃ yathā syādityevamarthaṃ
samudāyanipātanamityarthaḥ| dvidaṇkaḍi praharatīti| dvau
daṇḍāvasminpraharaṇe iti vigrahaḥ| iha na bhavatīti| kiṃ na bhavati?
dvidaṇḍītyetacchabdarūpaṃ sādhu na bhavatītyarthaḥ|
bahuvrīhyadhikāre'pīti| atrāpi ṭhsamudāyanipātanācca' ityayameva
hetuḥ| nanu prātipadikeṣvicpratyayāntapāṭhādeva siddhaṃ
dvidaṇḍa|ladīnāṃ sādhutvam, tatkimanena? tanna; na hi
pāṭhamātreṇejantatvaṃ śakyamavagantum; tataścāvyayībhāvasaṃjñā na
syāt| anārṣaśca pāṭhaḥ śaṅkyeta; kvacidapyanupayogāt ||

prasambhyāṃ jānunorjñaḥ || 5|4|129 ||
jñurityayamādeśa iti| pratyayastvayaṃ na bhavati; ṣaṣṭhīdvivacanena
nirdeśāt| iha hi jānuśabdasyaikatve'pi arthagataṃ dvitvam,
upapadanibandhanaṃ vā dvitvamāśritya jānunoriti nirdeśa etadartha-
kriyate--sthānaṣaṣṭhītvamasandigdhaṃ kathaṃ vijñāyeteti| cchandasi tu
svatantro'pi jñuśabdo dṛśyate--ṭhupajñubādho nabhasā', ṭhsadema
vatsajñuṃ paśukāmasya' iti ||

ūdhaso'naṅ || 5|4|130 ||
ṅtkiraṇādantyādeśatvam, akārāditvaṃ ca niścityā''hānaṅadeśo
bhavatīti| kuṇḍodhnīti| ṭhbahuvrīherūdhaso ṅīṣ', ṭhallopo'naḥ'| 
anaṅvidhānamutarārtham, iha tu nakārādeśenāpi siddham ||

gandhasyedutpūtisusurabhibhyaḥ || 5|4|135 ||
ikārādeśo bhavatīti| ṣaṣṭhīnirddeśādādeśatvāvasāyaḥ|
prakaraṇabhedāya cādeśatvaṃ vyavasthāpyate, na tvasminpratyaye'pi
kaściddoṣaḥ|

gandhaśabdo'yamasti dravyavacanaḥ---vahati jalamiyam, pinaṣṭi
gandhāniyamiti, asti ca guṇavacanaḥ---candanasya gandha iti, tatra
guṇavācino grahaṇārthamāhagandhasyetvaṃ iti|
rūpādisamudāyaḥudravyam, tasya gandhalakṣaṇo guṇa ekānta ekadeśo
bhavati, ūpādivyatiriktamavayavi dravyamiti tu pakṣe ekānta
ivaikāntaḥ; tatsthasyopalambhāt|
sugandha āpaṇika iti| āpaṇe niyukta āpaṇikaḥ; prāgvahatīyaṣṭhak|
bhavārthe vā adhyātmāditvāṭṭhak| atha vāyau kathaṃ sugandhiḥ,
dugandhiriti, na hyayaṃ gandho vāyorguṇaḥ? mā bhūtasya guṇaḥ, tena
tāvadavibhāgāpanno lakṣyate, etāvadeva ca tadekāntatvaṃ vivakṣitam,
na tadguṇatvam| evaṃ ca kṛtvā kuṅkumādyanulepanamapi yadā
devadatāderavibhāgapannaṃ bhavati tadetvaṃ bhavatyeva--sugandhirdeavadata
iti, sarvathā dravyavacananivṛttiḥ ||

alpākhyāyām || 5|4|136 ||
supo'lpo'sminsūpagandhīti| arthapradarśanametat, vigrahastu sūpasya
gandho leśo'sminniti; inyathā viśeṣaṇatvād gandhaśabdasya
pūrvanipātaḥ syāt| yadvā--asmādeva nipātanād gandhaśabdasya
paranipātaḥ ||

pādasya lopo'hastyādibhyaḥ || 5|4|138 ||
lopo bhavati samāsānta iti| yadi tvayaṃ samāsānto na syād,
ṭhādeḥ parasya' ityādeḥ syāt, ṭhśeṣādvibhāṣā' iti kap ca
prasajyet; samāsāntāpekṣasya śeṣasyāśrayaṇāt| kathaṃ
punarabhāvarupo'ntāvayavo bhavati? tatrāha--sthānidvāreṇeti ||

kumbhapadīṣu ca || 5|4|139 ||
bahuvacananirddeśātprabhṛtyartho'vagamyata ityāha-- kumbhapadīpramṛtaya
iti| samudāyā eva nipātyanta iti| kathaṃ tarhi sūtre bhūtavibhaktayā
saptamyā nirddeśaḥ? ityata āha--tatreti| viṣayagrahaṇena sūtre
viṣayasaptamīti darśayati---yathā kumbhapadyādayaḥ siddhyantīti|
yatadornityasambandhātpūrvatra tathā lopo bhavatītyartho grāhyaḥ| kimarthaṃ
punaḥ samudāyā eva nipātyante, na kumbhādīneva gaṇe paṭhitvā
tebhyaḥ parasya pādaśabdasya lopo vidhīyeta ?
tatrāha--samudāyapāṭhasya ceti| viṣayaniyamameva
darśayati--striyāmeveti| atra ca striyāmapi ṅīppratyaya eva|
ṭhpādo'ntarasyām' iti yadā ṅībviṣayabhūtastadaivetyarthaḥ|
yaccetyādi| upamānapūrvapadam-kumbhapadī, jālapadītyādi;
saṃkhyāpūrvapadamekapadī, śatapadīti| aṣṭāpadīti paṭha|lte, tatra
nipātanāddīrghatvam, ṭhaṣṭanaḥ saṃjñāyām' iti vā''kāraḥ ||

vayasi dantasya datṛ || 5|4|141 ||
dvitanniti| ṛkārasyogtkāryārthatvād ṭhugidacām' iti num ||

triyāṃ saṃjñāyām || 5|4|143 ||
acchando'rthamidam| ayogatīti| aya iva dantā asyā ayodatī,
ugitvānṅīp| samadantīti| ṭhnāsikodaroṣṭha' ityādinā ṅīṣ ||

vibhāṣā śyāvalārokābhyām || 5|4|144 ||
aroko nirdīptiriti| ṭhruca dīptau',rocanamurokaḥ, sa na vidyate
yasyeti kṛtvā ||

agrāntaśuddhaśubhravṛṣavarāhebhyaśca || 5|4|145 ||
cakāro'nuktasamuccayārthaḥ|
ahidannityādi| bhāṣye etannāśritam || 

kakudasyāvasthāyāṃ lopaḥ || 5|4|146 ||
kālādikṛtā iti| sādiśabdenāhārapariṇāmādergrahaṇam ||

trikakut vartate || 5|4|147 ||
parvate'nyapadārthe mukhyasya kakudasyāsambhavādāha--kakudākāraṃ
śrṛṅgamityādi| na cetyādi| ucyata ityasyānuṣaṅgaḥ|
saṃjñaiṣetyādi| etacca nipātanāllabhyate| evaṃ ca parvatagrahaṇaṃ
vispaṣṭārtham ||

araḥprabhṛtibhyaḥ kap || 5|4|151 ||
vyūḍhoraskaḥ, priyasarpiṣkaḥ| iti| ṭhso'padādau', ṭhiṇaḥ ṣaḥ',
upapūrvānnahyateḥ sampadāditvātkarmaṇi kvip, upanaddhā upānat,
ṭhnahivṛtti' iti dīrghaḥ, avamukte upānahau yena so'vamuktopānatkaḥ|
ṭhnaho dhaḥ' jaśtvacartve ||
vikalpa eva bhavatīti| lakṣmīśabdāt ṭhnadyaḥtaśca' iti nityaḥ kab na
bhavati; ekavacanāntapāṭhasya niyamārthatvāt| arthānnaña iti| nañaḥ paro
yo'rthaśabdastadantādbahuvrīhernityaṃ kabbhavati| nāsyārtho'sti
anarthamaḥ ||

inaḥ striyām || 5|4|152 ||
ṭhaninasmangrahaṇānyarthavatā cānarthakena ca tadantavidhaṃ prayojayanti' ||

nadyaḥtaśca || 5|4|153 ||
nadyantādbahuvrīheriti| atrāntaśabda utarapade vartate,
nadyautarapadādbahuvrīherityarthaḥ| yadvā--bahuvrīhyarthamutarapadaṃ
bahuvrīhiḥ, tasmānnadyantādityarthaḥ| kiṃ siddhaṃ bhavati?
bahugrāmaṇīrnagarī,bahukhalapūrnagarītyatra kab nivartito bhavati || 

śeṣādvibhāṣā || 5|4|154 || 
yasmādbahuvrīheriti| karmaṇi lyablope eṣā pañcamī,
bahuvrīhimāśritayetyarthaḥ, tena yatrāpyādeśaḥ
samāsāntaḥ--vyāghrapāt, sugandhiḥ, kuṇḍodhnīti; asāvapi śeṣo na
bhavati| pratyayaprāyatvādvā samāsāntasya ṭhyasmāt' ityuktam|
iha śeṣaḥ kabapekṣo vā syād, anantaro yo
bahuvrīhyadhikārastadapekṣo vā, samāsāntamākṣatrāpekṣo vā-iti trayaḥ
pakṣāḥ sambhavanti| tatrādye pakṣe-vyāghrapāt, sugandhiḥ, dvidaśāḥ, anṛcaḥ,
vidhura ityādau nityakabviṣayavarjaṃ sarvatra prasajyeta| śeṣagrahaṇaṃ
cānarthakam, na hi nityakabviṣaye vikalpaprasaṅgaḥ;
nityakavidherānarthakyaprasaṅgāt| dvitīye'pi dvidśā ityādau
syādeva prasaṅga iti manyamānastṛtīyaṃ pakṣamāśrayati--samāsānto na
vihita iti| bahukhaṭvaka ityādau ṭhāpo'nyatarasyām' iti hrasvaḥ,
bahukhaṭva ityādau ṭhgostriyorupasarjanasya' iti|
kathamityādi| yadi samāsāntāpekṣaḥ śeṣa iti praśnaḥ| viśeṣe sa iṣyata
iti| tataśca viṣayāntare sūkte sāmani ca bahuvrīheḥ samāsāntāpekṣaṃ
śeṣatvamastyeveti bhāvaḥ| kimarthaṃ punaḥ śeṣagrahaṇam, yāvatā yatra
samāsāntā vihitāstatra ta eva bādhakā bhaviṣyanti, anavakāśā vidhayo
bādhakā bhavanti, sāvakāśāśca te, ko'vakāśaḥ ? vibhāṣā kap, yadā
na kap so'vakāśaḥ--kapo'pyanyāḥ prakṛtayaḥ; viśeṣaprakṛtibhya
ubhayaprasaṅge paratvātkap syāt| tasmāccheṣagrahaṇam ||

īyasaśca || 5|4|156 ||
sarvā prāptiḥ pratiṣiddhyata iti| na tu ṭhanantarasya vidhirvā bhavati
pratiṣedho vā' iti śeṣalakṣaṇasyaiva kapaḥ pratiṣedha iti
sarvaśabdasyārthaḥ| etacca śeṣādityetasya
nivṛtatvātkabmātrasyānuvṛterlabhyate| bahuśreyasīti|
liṅgaviśiṣṭagrahaṇādatra pratiṣedhaḥ| yathātra sorhalṅyādilopaḥ,
tathā tatraiva vakṣyāmaḥ| hrasvatvamapi na bhavatīti|
ṭhgostriyorupasarjanasya' iti prāptam| kasmāt? ityāha--īyaso
bahuvrīhāvityādi| puṃvadvacanenātra na strīpratyayasya
nivṛttirvivakṣitā, kiṃ tarhi? hrasvaprakaraṇātadabhāvaḥ| tathā ca
ṭhgostriyoḥ' ityatra vṛtau-ṭhīyaso bahuvrīhau pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ'
ityevoktam ||

vandite bhrātuḥ || 5|4|157 ||
vanditaḥ stuta iti| yadyapi ṭhvadi abhivādanastutyoḥ' ityabhivādane'pi
vadiḥ paṭha|lte, tathāpi vyākhyānātstutyarthasyaiva grahaṇamiti
darśayati| tena vanditabhrātṛka ityatra kabbhavatyeva ||

nāḍītantryoḥ svāṅge || 5|4|159 ||
nāḍīśabdo jātilakṣaṇaṅīṣantaḥ| tantrīśabdaḥ ṭhavitṛstṛtantribhya īḥ'
itīkārāntaḥ| baharunāḍiriti| upasarjanahrasvam| bahutantrīrityatra tu
ṭhkṛtstriyāḥ pratiṣedhaḥ' iti vacanānna bhavati ||

niṣpravāṇiśca || 5|4|160 ||
proyate'syāmiti pravāṇīti| veño'dhikaraṇe lyuṭ, ṭhkṛtyacaḥ' iti
ṇatvam ||

iti śrīharadatamiśraviracitāyāṃ padamañjaryāṃ pañcamāsyādhyāyasya
caturtha pādaḥ 
------------|||||-------------
kāśikāvṛtī
atha ṣaṣṭhādhyāye prathamaḥ pādaḥ

ekāco dve prathamasya || 6|1|1 ||
iha yadyapi svārthatve sambhavati pārārthyamayuktm,
vidheyakāryiṇordvayornirdea śāt sambhavati ca svārthatvam, tathāpi
ṭhliṭi dhātoḥ' ityādau vidheyānirddesena vaiyarthyaprasaṅgānnāyam
ṭhaṇkuṭilikāyāḥ' ityādivatkevalo vidhiḥ, nāpi ṭhśeṣe'
ityādivallakṣaṇaṃ cādhikāraśca| tathā hi sati sarveṣāmeva śabdānāṃ
prathamasyaikāco'nena dvirvacane siddhe ṭhliṭi dhātoḥ' ityāhi vyarthaṃ
syāt| dhātorliṭha|leva, liṭi dātoreva-iti niyamānna vaiyarthyamiti
cet ? na; vidhiniyamasambhave vidhereva jyāyastvāt| asca hi
pārārthyemiti cet? na; vidhiniyamasambhave vidhereva
jyāyastāvāt| asya hi pārārthyo'vambhāvini sati yathā teṣāṃ
vidhitvaṃ tathāsya varṇanaṃ yuktamataḥ parārtha evāyam| tatrāpi na
paribhāṣā-dvirvacanaṃ vidhīyamānaṃ prathamasyaikāco veditavyamiti;
evaṃ hi sati ṭhsarvasya dve' ityatraivāsya vyāpāra iti tatraivaikācaḥ
prathamasyeti vācyaṃ syāt| ṭhliṭi dhātoḥ' ityādikaṃ ca
vidheyānirddeśādvyartha syāt| ataḥ
pāriśepyātsvaritatvāccādhikāra evāyamiti niścityāha--ekāca
itadi ceti| adhikāro'yamiti vaktavye pṛthak
svaritatvapradarśanārthamevamuktam| etatritayamiti| tasya
prayojanam--yatra yadapekṣitaṃ tatra tasya sambandhaḥ,
yathā--ṭhajāderdvitīyasya' ityatra ṭhekāco dve' iti, ṭhabhe abhyastam'
ityatra ṭhdve' iti, liṭi dhātorityādau sarva sambadhyate| ita
utaramityādi| anantaroktasyaiva vivaraṇam| prāk
samprasāraṇavidānāditi| tata ārabhya tu nāsya sambandhaḥ;
vidheyāntaranirdeśātsvarite kṛte nādhikāra iti vā vyākhyānāt| 
sāmānyenoktamudāharaṇaniṣṭhṃa darśayati--vakṣyatīti| atra yadi
ṭhdhātorerekācaḥ' iti sāmānādhikaraṇyena sambandhaḥ syāt,
paciprabhṛtīnāmeva syāt, na jāgartyādīnām| prathamagrahaṇaṃ
cānarthakaṃ syāt, na hyaekācāṃ dhātūnāṃ dvitīyādirekājasti| na ca
prathamasya dhātoriti sambandhaḥ| tathā hi sati dhātupāṭhe
prathamapaṭhitasya bhavatereva syāt, tataśca bhavatigrahaṇameva kartavyaṃ
syāt| athaikāco dhātoḥ prathamasya varṇasyeti sambandhaḥ ? tadayuktam;
sahanirddiṣṭayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyasya svataḥ prāptasya
tyāgāyogāt| ato vaiyadhikaraṇyena sambandha
ityāha-dātoravayavasyeti| dvitīyasya ceti| yadyapyatra dvitīyagrahaṇaṃ
nāsti, tathāpi ṭhliṭi dhātoḥ' ityatra tvadhikṛtamasti, tasya cārthaḥ
pradarśyate iti nāsaṅgataṃ kiñcita| jajāgāra-ityādīni
mukhyagauṇatayā krameṇodāharaṇāni|
ekāca iti yadyayaṃ tatpuruṣaḥ syātadā ṭhdhātoḥ' ityanena
sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ cet? iyāya āretyādāveva syād, vaiyadhikaraṇye
tu papācetyādiṣu bhavadapi dvirvacanamajmātrasyaiva syāt, tataśca
ṭhhalādiḥ śeṣaḥ', ṭhśarpūrvāḥ khayaḥ', ṭhliṭa|lbyāsasyobhyeṣām'
ityādyanupapannaṃ syāt| ekagrahaṇaṃ cānarthakama, prathamasyāca iti
viśeṣaṇādekasya ca dhātoranekaprathamājasambhavādaca ityekatvaṃ vā
vivakṣiṣyate, kimekagrahaṇena ? tasmād bahuvrīhirayam|
tadāha--ekāca iti bahuvrīhinirdeśa iti| bahuvrīhiṇā
vivakṣitasyārthasya pratipādanaṃ bahuvrīhervā uccāraṇaṃ
bahuvrīhinirddeṣaḥ| vigrahapradarśanaṃ vispaṣṭapratipatyartham| yadi
bahuvrīhinirddeśastato bahuvrīheranyapadārthapradhānatvādyathā
ṭhcitragurānīyatām' ityukte yasya tā gāvaḥ sa evānayate na citrā
gāvaḥ, tadvadatropalakṣitaṃ tadubhayapārśvavati vyañjanadvayameva
dvirucyeta, na tūpalakṣaṇabhūto'jityata āha--tatreti| bhavati vai
bahuvrīhāvapi kvacidvartipadārthasyāpi kāryayogaḥ,
tadyathā--śuklavāsasamānayeti matvarthe bahuvrīhiḥ, tatra yathā daṇḍī,
viṣāṇīti saṃsarge matvarthīya utpanne tasya dviṣṭhatvād guṇasyāpi
kāryayogaḥ; tadvad bahuvrīhāvapi yatra saṃsargo vācyastatrāviruddho
gumasyāpi kāryayogaḥ| abhyantaraśceti| antarbhūta ityarthaḥ|
ānyantaramiti pāṭhe abhyantaramumadhyam, tatra bhavamābhyantaram|
sāckasyaiva dvirvacanaṃ bhavatīti| yathā tatsannihitamavayavāntaraṃ
dvirucyate, tathopalakṣaṇībhūto'pyajityarthaḥ| atra ca jñāpakam
ṭhdīrgho'kitaḥ' ityādi| codayati--evaṃ ca pacityatreti| tenaiva
tadavayavocchabdaḥ paśabdaśceti| cakārādakāraśca
vyapadeśivadbhāvādekājeva, yathaivāṅgulyā
devadato'ṅgulimāṃstathā hasto'pi, tadvadatrāpi| tataśca
sarveṣāmeva teṣāṃ dvirvacanaprasaṅga iti śeṣaḥ| nanvarthavadghahaṇe
nānarthakasyeti samudāyasyaiva bhaviṣyati, nāvayavānām, nanvevaṃ
jāgatryādīnāṃ na syāt, kiñca yatra ṭhśe' ityādau viśiṣṭṃa
śabdasvarūpaṃ gṛhyate tatraiveyaṃ paribhāṣā, atra tu
ṭhdhātoravayavasyaikācaḥ' iti taṭasthenopalakṣaṇena jāg,
pac-ityevamādikaṃ gṛhyate, na tu svarūpeṇeti neha tasyāḥ pravṛttiḥ?
pariharati--tatreti|
teṣu samudāyādiṣvekākṣu madhye'vayavaikācaḥ prathamā na dvirucyante,
kutaḥ ? ityāha--tathā hītyādi| ayamabhiprāyaḥ---kimekasminneva
prayoge yugapacca sarvaprayogaścodyate? paryāyeṇa vā ? kiṃ vā
prayogabhedena kasyacit kvacaneti ? na tāvadādya kalpaḥ,
pramityanuṣṭhānayordvayorapyasambhavāt| tathā hi--ekāctvena
nirupitaṃ dvirvacanaṃ pramātavyam, na caiko'vayavo
yugapadanekāvayavatvena śakyonirūpayitum, tatkathaṃ
yugapatpramīyatām, pramitaṃ vā kathamanuṣṭhīyatām! na hyaekasminnekāci
dvirucyamāne tadaivānya ekācchakyo dvirvaktum; vācaḥ kramabhāvitvāt|
nāpi dvitīyaḥ; ṭhanabhyāsasya' iti pratiṣedhādanavasthāpātācca|
tasmātprayogabhedena sarvaprasaṅga ityeṣa eva pakṣaḥ sambhavati| tatra
ṭhṇijir śaucapoṣaṇayoḥ' ityasya ślau yadā niśabdasya
dvirvacanam, tadā nenekti, nenikta ityatra na kaściddoṣaḥ| nenijati,
anejijuḥ, nenijadityatra ṭhadabhyastāt', ṭhsijabyastavidibhyaśca',
ṭhnābhyastācchatuḥ' ityadbhāvajusabhāvanumpratiṣedhā na syuḥ; jakāreṇa
vyavadhānāt, ikārasyecchabdasya ca dvirvacane rupameva na sidhyatītyeṣa
eva doṣaḥ ? tasya parihāraḥ--ṭhśāstrahāniprasaṅgāt' iti| avayave hi
dvirucyamāne'vayavāntaraviṣayasamudāviṣayaṃ ca śāstraṃ hīyate|
nanu śāstreṇa pramitameva yadi nānuṣṭhīyeta syācchāstrahāniḥ, atra tu
paryāyeṇa pratīyata ityuktam, taccānuṣṭhitameva kathaṃ sāstrahāniḥ?
aṅga tu bhavānācaṣṭām--paśabde dvirucyamāne cakāraḥ kimiti na
dvirucyate, tadā taddvirvacanasyāpratītatvāditi cetkimiti na
pratīyate, tena sahaikāctvenānirūpitatvāditicetkimiti na
nirūpyate? maunamatrotaram, tasmādyasmin prayoge yacca yāvacca
prathamaikāctvena śakyate nirūpayitum, tasya sarvasya dvirvacanaṃ
pramātavyamanuṣṭātavyaṃ ca; anyathā tu kriyamāṇaṃ
pratītyanuṣṭhānayorubhayorapi śāstrahānimāvahati| tasmātsamudāyasya
dvirvacanamiti| na cātrāpi pakṣe'vayavaviṣaye śāstrahāniḥ;
avayavātmakatvātsamudāyasya na khalvavayavānāṃ dvirvacanamakṛtvā
samudāyaḥ śakyo dvirvaktum, tadyathā-vṛkṣaḥ pracalansahāvayavaiḥ pracalati|
atha kathaṃ papāceti dvirvacanam, yāvatā dhāturevāyaṃ na dhātvavayavaḥ,
nāpi prathamaḥ, dvitāyādiṣu hi satsu yasmātpūrvo nāsti sa prathamaḥ?
kathantarāṃ ceyāyetyādau yatraiko'jasyeti vyatirikto'nyapadārtho
nāsti? tatrāha--papācetyatreti| ekāctvamapīti|
apiśabdātprathamatvamapi, ubhayatrāpi dhātuṃ pratyavayavatvam|
vyapadeśivadbhāvāditi| mukhya ekājvyapadeśaḥ, avayavavyapadeśaśca
yeṣāmasti te vyapadeśino jāgrādiṣu jāgityevamādayaḥ,
teṣāmivaiṣāmapi kārya bhavatītyarthaḥ| na cedaṃ vacanam,
lokiko'yaṃ nyāyaḥ, loke hi ṭhśilāputrakasya śarīram' iti
bahirvastubhede'satyapi bedavyavahāro'vasthābedāśrayo dṛśyate|
śilāputrakaḥ krīyamāṇavikrīyamāṇatvādyavasthāyukto yo dṛṣṭastasyedaṃ
śarīramiti paridṛśyamānāvasthābhedena vyapadiśyate| papācetyatrāpi
paceranantaprayogaviṣayasya samprati prayujyamānaṃ liṭparaṃ rūpamavayava
iti śakyaṃ vyapadeṣṭuam, prathamaśabdo'pi prathamagarbeṇa
hatetyādāvasato'pi dvitīyādīn buddhyā parikalpya
mukhyaprathamasādharmyādyathā loke ekasminnapi prathama iti prayujyate,
tadvadatrāpi| iyāyetyatrāpi itaḥ, yanti, āyan, āgāt,
jigamiṣatītyanantaprayogasthenaiko'yamikaara ityanyapadārtho'pi
kalpitaḥ| prasiddhyaprasiddhikṛtaśca gauṇamukhyavivekaḥ| evaṃ vidhastu
vyavahāro mukhyādapi prasiddha iti na gauṇatvadoṣaḥ| evaṃ ca
kṛtvā--ṭhvyatho liṭi' ṭhbhavateraḥ',ṭhliṭa|lbhyāssayobhayeṣām', ṭhdīrgha
iṇaḥ kiti' ityādikamupapadyate|
atra ṭhdve' ityasya saṃkhyeyāpekṣāyāṃ śabdānuśāsanaprastāvācchabdarūpe
sakhyeye ṭhṣaṣṭhī sthāneyogā' iti vacanādekācaḥ prathamasyeti
sthānaṣaṣṭha|laṃ satyāmekasya sthāne dve śabdarupe ityartho bhavati,
yathā--ṭhasterbhūḥ' ityādau, tadā ṭhsthāne dvirvacanam' ityayaṃ pakṣo
bhavati| yadā śabdasambandhinī uccāraṇe saṃkhyeye kriyārūpasya śabdasya
ca sthānyādeśasambandhāyogādadhyāhṛtoccāraṇakriyāpekṣayaikāca iti
karmaṣaṣṭhī--ekāco dve uccāraṇe bhavataḥ, ekācaṃ dvirucyārayedityarthaḥ,
tadā ṭhdviḥprayogo dvirvacanam' ityayaṃ pakṣo bhavati| tatrādye pakṣe
ṭhsthāne'ntaratamaḥ' iti vacanācchabdataścāntaratamayordvayovidhānād
yadyapi ye kecana prāpnuta iti doṣanavatāraḥ| cicīṣatītyatra tu
ṭhsanyaṅeḥ' iti ṣaṣṭhayāḥ sthāpayiṣyamāṇatvāccis ityasya stāne
ciscis iti śabdāntara ādeśe sati tatsthasya sakārasya santve
pramāṇābhāvāt ṭhajjñanagamāṃ sani' iti dīrghatvaṃ na syāt; ādeśasya
sthānivadbhāva ucyate nādeśāvayavasya syānyavayavavadbhāva iti
sthānivadbhāvenāpi santvaṃ nāsti| tasya tu yatra sanmātrasya
dvirvacane sthānivadbhāvena santvaṃ so'vakāśaḥ, yathā--iṇaḥ san,
īṣiṣatīti|
nanu śabdāntaraprāptyā dvirvacanamanityam, aprāptyā tu
dīrghatvamityubhayoḥ paratvāddīrghatve kṛte dvirvakṣyate? iha tarhi
hvayateḥ sani hnās ityasya dvirvacanam, samudāyasya samudāya
ādeśastatra ādośa etannāsti--iyaṃ prakṛtirayaṃ pratyaya iti, tataśca
ṭhhvo'bhyastasya' iti saṃprasāraṇaṃ na syāt, juhāva
juhuvaturityādāveva tu syād--yatra hvāmātrasya
dvirvacanātsthānivatvam? naiṣa doṣaḥ; ṭhhvo'bhyastasya' iti
vyadhikaraṇe ṣaṣṭhayau, hvayaterabhyastasya bhaviṣyataḥ prāgeva
saṃprasāraṇaṃ parapūrvatvam, ṭhhalaḥ' iti ṭhajjñanagamām' iti vā
dīrghatvam, ṭhhvās' ityasya dvirvacanam| iha ca pipakṣati,
udvivakṣatītyatra ṭhpūrvatrāsiddhamadvirvacane' iti tarhi āṭiṭad,
āśiśad iti ṇilope kṛte'pi ṭhdvirvacane'ci' iti
rūpasthānivadbāvācchabdāntaraprāptyabhāvena nityatvātpūrvaṃ dvirvacane
sati samudāyasya samudāya ādeśastatra samprabhugdhatvātprakṛtipratyayatvaṃ
naṣṭam, sa ṇijna bhavatīti ṇilopo na syāt, tasya tu
kāraṇetyādiravakāśaḥ| iha ca jighāṃsatīti samudāyasya samudāya
ādeśe kṛte hanterabhāvād ṭhabhyāsācca' iti hanteriti kutvaṃ na
syāt| tasya tu jaghanathi, jaghantha, ahaṃ kila jaghana,
jaghanvānityādiravakāśaḥ, yatrahantimātrasya
dvirvacanātsthānivadbhāvaḥ| tadevamādyapakṣasya duṣṭatvād dvitīyaṃ
pakṣamāśrityāha-dviḥprayoge dvirvacanamiti| caśabdo'vadhāraṇe| kathaṃ
punaḥ ṭhṣaṣṭhī sthāneyogā' iti paribhāṣāyāṃ satyāṃ dviḥprayogapakṣaḥ
śakya āśrayitum? tatrāha--āvṛttisaṃkhyā hīti| yadyāvṛteḥ saṃkhyā
vidhīyate, evaṃ sati trirvacanaṃ prāpnoti| na hyādyamuccāraṇamāvṛttiḥ,
atastadekam, āvṛtī ca dve iti trirvacanaprasaṅgaḥ|
tasmādāvṛttikṛtā saṃkhyā| āvṛttisaṃkhyā kasya? uccāraṇasya,
āvṛtamuccāraṇaṃ vidhīyata ityarthaḥ| tatra ca sthānyādeśabhāvo na
sambhavatītyuktam| atra pakṣe yathāṭiṭadityādau doṣau na bhavati tathā
darśayati--tenetyādinā |
nanvatrāpi pakṣe nematuḥ, sehe ityādau natvasatvayoḥ
kṛtayordhātorādeśāditvasya
dviḥprayoge'pyanivṛteretvābhyāsalopau na syātām, pakṣāntare tu
nādeśādivyapadeśaḥ? alāśrayatvena
sthānivatvābhāvātsamudāyādeśatvenādeśāditvābhāvācca na doṣa)ḥ;
ṭhliṭi ādeśaḥ' iti viśeṣaṇāannatvasatvayoranaimitikatvād| iha
tarhi vebhiditeti vebhidyaśabdātṛci allopayalopayoḥ
kṛtayorupadeṣe ya ekājanudātaḥ sa evāyamitīṭpratiṣedhaḥ syāt,
pakṣāntare tvekājvyamapadeśasyālāśrayatvād bebhidyetyasya
dvyacakatvānniṣedhābhāvaḥ? dviḥprayoge'pi na doṣaḥ; pūrvasmādapi
vidhau allopasya sthānivadbhāvāt| iha tarhi jarīgṛhiteti
grahervaliṭi dīrghatvaṃ syāt, na hyatra sthānivatvam, dīrghavidhau
niṣedhāt? naiṣa doṣaḥ; ṭhekāca upadeśe' ityata ṭhekāca'
ityanuvartayiṣyate| yadvā-- grahervihitaṃ yadārddhadhātukaṃ tasya ya iṭ
tasya dīrgha iti jarīgṛhyaśabdādvihitasya na bhaviṣyati| ica ca
siṣecati, yadyapi sicerliḍvihitaḥ; tathāpi dvirvacane kṛte
samudāyasyaikā padasaṃjñā na tadavayavasya, secaśabdasya padasaṃjñāyāṃ
tadādigrahaṇānivṛterabhyāsasya varjanāyogāditi ṭhsātpadādyoḥ'
iti ṣatvaniṣedhābhāvaḥ| iha tarhi vibhidvānityādau
śatakṛtvo'pyuccāraṇe ekāctvaṃ na yāti, kiṃ punardviruccāraṇa iti
ṭhvasvekājāddhasām' itīṭprasaṅgaḥ? tanna;
uccāraṇabhedādviruddhasaṃkhyāprādurbhāve
pūrvasaṃkhyākṛtavyapadeśanivartanāt| ata evādgrahaṃṇaṃ kṛtaṃ
papivānityādāviḍaryam| iha tarhi viśuṣvāpeti, tasyaivārthavato
dviruktibhāvamātramityabhyāsasyārthavatvātsupeḥ ṣatvamityatrānarthako
visuṣupuriti vakṣyamāṇaṃ vihanyeta? naiṣa doṣaḥ;
anvayavyatirekābhyāṃ śabdasyāśeṣārthāvasāyaḥ, na cātrābhyāsopajanane
kaścidartha upajāyate, apāye cāpayāti| nanu sa eva ced dvirucyate,
arthapratyayenāpyāvatitavyam, yathā--ahirahirbudhyasvabudhyasveti?
kimatropālabhyemahi, na tāvadarthapratyayā āvartante! tadetadevaṃ
dṛśyatām-yathā svapnaḥ, suptaḥ, asvapadityādau kvacidavikṛtaḥ,
kvacidvikṛtaḥ, kvicidaḍāgamāpekṣo'rthaṃ pratipādayati, tathā
suṣvāpetyādāvāvṛta eva pratipādayatīti || 

ajāderdvitīyasya || 6|1|2 || 
prathamadvirvacanāpavādo'yamiti| nanu virodhe samānaphalatve ca
bādhyabādhakabhāvaḥ, yathā--ṭhaṣṭaśriryūpaḥ kartavyo vājapeyasya
caturaśriḥ' ityaṣṭāśritvacaturaśritvayortathā
naivāraścarurnakhāvapūtānāmiti nakhāvapanena vaituṣyaphalakena
tatphalako'vaghāto bādhyate, nakhaiscolūkhalamusalam; yatra
tvetadubhayaṃ na bhavati na tatra bādhaḥ, yathā--kṛtkṛtyapratyayasaṃjñānām,
yathā vā--taddhitatadrājapratyayasaṃjñānām| iha tu na samānaphalatvam;
phalasya kasyacidabhāvāt, asti ca sabhbhavo yadubhayaṃ syāt?
syādetat--dvayorāsīnayormadhye kasmiścidupaviṣṭe
dvitīyastṛtīyo bhavati, tathā prathame dvirukte dvitīyastṛtīyo
bhavatītyastyevākṣatrāpsasambhāva iti, syādapyevam, yadi
prathamadvirvacanameva niyogataḥ pūrvaṃ syāt, kiñca nātrautpatikasya
dvitīyasya dvirvacanamucyate, kiṃ tarhi? dvitīyamātrasya, tataḥ kim?
prathame dvirukte yo dvitīyastasya bhaviṣyati|
nanvevamanārambhasamaṃ syāt, kathamaṭeḥ san, prathamasya dvirvacanam,
aṭāṭ iti sthite halādiḥśeṣaśca prāpnoti, dvitīyadvirvacanaṃ ca,
paratvānnityatvācca halādiḥśeṣaḥ, tato dvirvacanam, āaṭa aṭ iti
sthite halādiśeṣe trayāṇāmakārāṇāmato guṇe
pararupatve'ṭiṣatītyetadrūpaṃ syād, akṛte'pi dvirvacane etadeva
rūpam, dvayorakārayoḥ pararūpamityetāvad nānārambhasamam,
katham? prathamaṃ dvirvacanam, halādiḥśeṣaḥ, āaṭ iti sthite ṭhsanyataḥ'
itītvaṃ ca prāpnoti dvirvacanaṃ ca, dvayornityayoḥ paratvāditvam|
nanvitvaṃ sanamabhyāsaṃ cāpekṣata iti bahiraṅgam, tataḥ kim?
antaraṅgam ṭhato guṇo' iti pararūpatvaṃ prāpnoti, samānāśraye ca
vārṇādāṅgaṃ balīya? evaṃ tarhi kṛte'pi pararūpe
tarayāntavadbhāvāditvaṃ prāpnoti, akṛte ceti nityatvaṃ paratvaṃ
ceti dve tasya prābalyakāraṇe| pararūpasya
tvantaraṅgatvamekamevetītvameva tāvad bhavati| sati tu tasmin
ṭhabhyāsasyāsavarṇe' itīyaṅ ca prāpnoti dvirvacanaṃ ca, tatra
dvirvacanamiyaṅ kṛte yiṅtyisya prāpnoti; akṛte tvaṅtyisyeti
śabdāntaraprāptyā'nityam, tena paratvānnityatvācceyaiṅ kṛte
yaṅśabdasya dvirvacane halaadiḥ śeṣaḥ, itvam, iyiyaṭiṣati,
oṇeḥ--uvuvoṇiṣatīti bhavati| asati dvitīye
dvirvacane--iyaṭiṣati, uvoṇiṣatīti bhavatīti nānārambhasāmyam |
evaṃ tarhi ṭhanabhyāsasya' iti niṣedhādekasmin dvirukte nāparo
dvirvaktuaṃ śakyata ityasyaivāsambavaḥ| atha vā--sāmānyavihitasya
viśeṣavihitaṃ satyapi sambhave bādhakaṃ bhavati, tadyathā--dadhi
brāhmaṇebhyo dīyatāṃ takraṃ kauṇkaḍinyāyeti| odanasekākhyasya
phalasya samānatvādatra dadhibādha iti ced? ihāpi tarhyarthābhidhānākhyaṃ
phalamekam, arthābhidhānāya hi dviruccāraṇam, taccaikenaiva sādhyate|
atha rūpaviśeṣākhyaṃ phalaṃ bhinnam, anyaddhi rūpaṃ prathamasya dvirvacane,
anyacca dvitīyasya ? itaratrāpi tṛptiviśeṣākhyaṃ phalaṃ bhidyate, anyā hi
dadhnastṛptiranyā hi takrasya, ato nāprāpte tasminnārabhyamāṇatvameva
bādhanibandhanam, nāsambhavaḥ, sāmānyaśabdā hi viśeṣaśabdasannidhau
tatraivopasaṃhriyante, tato'nyatra vā, yathā--vasiṣṭho brāhmaṇaḥ, brāhmaṇāḥ
āyātā vasiṣṭho'pyāyāta iti|
nanu kauṇḍinyasyāpi brāhmaṇatvād dadhi prāptam, iha tu
prathamasyocyamānaṃ dvirvacanaṃ dvitīyasya na prāpnotīti kathaṃ yena
nāprāptiḥ? na kramo dvitīyasya prāptamiti; kintu
dhātusāmānyavihitaṃ prathamadvirvacanamajāderdhātoḥ prāptamiti; tatra
dadhitakrākhyaṃ vidheyaṃ bhidyate, iha tu kāryaṃ bhidyate, vidheyaṃ
dvirvacanamekamityetāvān viśeṣaḥ| yadvā-tatrāpi dānameva vidheyaṃ
tasya tu deyabhedād bhedaḥ, ihāpi kāryibedādbhedaḥ,
taddamuktam--prathamadvirvacanāpavādo'yaṃ dvitīyadvirvacanamiti| sarvathā
prathamadvirvacanaṃ dvitīyadvirvacanena bādhyate| yadyaṃvam,
yathābhūtasyaikācaḥ prathamadvirvacanaṃ prāptaṃ
tathābhūtasyaivadvitīyadvirvacanaṃ bādhakaṃ syāt,
savyañjanasyaitatprāptamiti tena
sahavyañkajanānāmapyanāvṛttiprasaṅgaḥ? syādevaṃ yadyajādiṣu
prathamasyaikācaḥ kiñcidvihitaṃ pratiṣiddhaṃ vā bhavet, iha tu
viśeṣasannidhau sāmānyaśabdasya tato'nyatra vṛterajādiṣu
prathamadvirvacanarūpāpratītatvādaprāptyanumānameva bādhaḥ| vyañjanāni ca
yadā yasya kārthaṃ tadā tadaṅgānīti dvitīyaikācyantarbhāvātena saha
dvirvacanaṃ kena vāryate! atra ca liṅgam ṭhna ndrāḥ' iti pratiṣedhaḥ|
atheyāya, āretyādau kena dvirvacanam? na tāvadanenādvitīyatvāt,
nāpi pūrveṇājādiṣu tasyāpravṛteḥ, yatraitadapravṛttiḥ, yatra tu
dvitīyābhāvādetanna pravartate na tatra tasya pravṛttirvāryate ? tatrāpi
vāryate, ajāderiti sāmānyanirddeśāt| sāmānyanirddeśe hi
kvacidapi dvitīyavatyāṃ vyaktau sarvatra bādheta, yathā halādiḥśeṣe
vakṣyate--ṭhkvacidapi pravartamāno halādiḥśeṣaḥ sarvatra nivṛttiṃ
karoti' iti? naiṣa doṣaḥ;

jātyopalakṣitā vyaktiḥ prādhānyeneha gṛhyate|
dvitīyavatyāmevedaṃ vyaktau tena pravartate ||
pravartate ca yatredaṃ tatra pūrvaṃ nivartate|
jātirhalādiśeṣe tu prādhānyena samāśritā || iti|

guṇe ceti| nityatvātparatvācca| sthānivadbhāvaḥ prāpnotīti|
tataśca isa ityasya dvirvacane halādiḥśeṣe ca dīrghatve sati
arīṣatīti prasaṅgaḥ| na cātra dvirvacanamanimitamiḍiti| yatra parato
dvirvacanamucyate, tadeva tasya nimitamiti bhāvaḥ| ki tarhi kāryīti|
ṭhsanyaṅeḥ' iti ṣaṣṭha|laśrayaṇāt| tataḥ kim? ityāha na ceti|
tadbhāvabhāvitve satyapi kāyiṇaḥ saptamīnirddeśābāvānna
nimitatvaṃ śāstre sthitamityarthaḥ| avaśyaṃ caitadevaṃ
vijñeyamityāha--tathā hīti| guṇavṛddhyoriti| ṭhkṅiti ca' ityatra
vṛddherapi pratiṣedhād guṇavṛddhyorityuktam| śayitetyatra na
bhavatīti| guṇasya pratiṣedhaḥ| kvacitu--śāyaka ityapi paṭha|lte,
tadayuktam, aprakṛtitvādatra vṛddheḥ| yathā cotaragranthe guṇagrahaṇameva
kṛtam | 
teṣāṃ dvitīyasyeti vispaṣṭārthamiti| ṭhtasmādityuktarasya'
ityanantarasya dvirīyasyaiva bhaviṣyati, na tṛtīyādeḥ| yadā tu
bahuvrīheḥ ṣaṣṭhī-ajādiryasya dhātoriti, tadā
sāmarthyādaprathamārthe'pyārambhe tṛtīyāderapi prasaṅgaḥ ||

na ndrāḥ saṃyogādayaḥ || 6|1|3 ||
ṭhundī kledane,' ṭhadḍa abhiyoge' dopadhaḥ, ṣṭuatvam, ṭharca
pūjāyām', ṭhīkṣa jarśanāṅkanayoḥ' ana prāṇane', ṭhdrā kutsāyāṃ
gatau', ubjirviṣaye yadvaktavyaṃ tatsarvam ṭhhayavaraṭ' ityatraivoktam | 
yakāraparasyeti| yakāraḥ paro yasmādrakārātasyetyarthaḥ|
vyañjanasyeti| tṛtīyavyañjanasahitasyaikāca ityarthaḥ| tatra ṣakārasya
dvirvacanaṃna bhavati| apare punariti| asminpakṣe īrṣyatessani kṛte
iti vyākhyeyam, tatsambandhitastṛtīyasyaikāco'sambhavāt|
nāmadhātavaḥusubdhātavaḥ|

pūrvo'bhyāsaḥ || 6|1|4 ||
arthāditi| sāmarthyātpūrvaśabdo'yamavayavavacanaḥ, avayavaścāvayavino
bhavati, sa ceha kaścinna nirddiṣṭaḥ, ato'vaśyam ṭhdve' iti
atrānuvartanīyam| na vānuvṛtamapi
prathamāntamevāvasthimavayavyapekṣāṃ pūrayitumalamityetatsāmarthyam|
asminprakaraṇa iti| anena ṭhsarvasya dve' ityatra prakaraṇe iyaṃ saṃjñā na
bhavati, tena tatra halādiśeṣādyabhāvaḥ| yadyevam,
ṭhdyautigamijuhotyādīnāṃ dve' ityatra na prāpnoti? kartavyo'tra yatnaḥ|
tayoḥ pūrvo'vayava iti| avayavavācibhirdikśabdairyoge pañcamī na
bhavati; ṭhtasya pramāmreḍitam' iti liṅgāt| papācetyādau
ṭhhalādiḥ śeṣaḥ', ṭhsanyataḥ', ṭhdīrgho'kitaḥ', ṭhkuhoścuḥ', ṭhabhyāse
carca', ṭhsanvallaghuni', ṭhdīrgho laghoḥ' ityādīni
yathāyogamabyāsakāryāṇi ||

ubhe abhyastam || 6|1|5 ||
dve iti vartamāna ityādi| dviruktasamudāyasyaikā'bhyastasaṃjñā yathā
syād, dvayordvea saṃjñe mā bhūtāmityevamarthamubhegrahaṇam, na tu
saṃjñinirdeśārtham| dve ityasyānuvṛtyaiva saṃjñinirdeśasya
siddhatvādityarthaḥ| dadatītyādau ṭhadabhyastāt' ityadbhāvaḥ,
ṭhśnābhyastayorātaḥ' ityākāralopaḥ|
nenijatītyatretyādi| asatyubhe grahaṇe ṭhvṛddhirādaic' ityādau
pratyekaṃ vākyaparisamāptidarśanādihāpi pratyekaṃ syāt, tataśca
nenijatītyatra pṛthagādyaudātatvaṃ syāt| na ca ṭhanudātaṃ
padamekavarjam' ityekasyānudātatvam; varjanīyaviśeṣāvagamahetoḥ
satiśiṣṭatvāderasambhavāt| athāpi syāt, evamapi paryāyaḥ syāt|
nanu ca ṭhbhīhnībhṛhumada' iti jñāpakātparasya na bhaviṣyati?
pūrvasyāpi tarhi na syāt, pareṇa vyavadhānāt| ucyate ca svaraḥ,
tataśca sa eva paryāyaprasaṅgaḥ|
yadi tu saṃyogasamāsādisaṃjñāvadanvarthatvapratipacyarthaṃ
mahāsaṃjñākaraṇam, tenānvarthatāvijñāne samudāyasyaiva
saṃjñetyucyate, tadobhegrahaṇaṃ śakyamakartum| nanu yatrobhe śrūyete
tatra yathā syāt, anyatarābhāve mā bhūd-ityevamarthamubhegrahaṇaṃ
kartavyam; anyathā ṛdherāpaśca ṭhsanīvanta' iti iḍabhāvapakṣe paratvāt
pratipadavihitatvācca ṭhāpjñapyṛdhāmīt' itītve ṭhna ndrāḥ' iti
pratiṣedhādrephavarjaṃ dvitīyasyaikāco dvirvacane kṛteṭhatra
lopo'bhyāsasya' ityataḥ prāgantaraṅgatvādabhyastasaṃjñā syāt| sā ca
pratyekam, samudāyasya vā? tatra pratyekapakṣe'bhyāsalope'pi parasya na
nivarteta| samudāyapakṣe'pi pūrva saṃjñā samudāye pravṛtā;
paścādekadeśanivṛtāvapyavaśiṣṭe'vatiṣṭheta| yatheyasuna īkāre
lupte'pi tadvitasaṃjñā--bhūyānityatra| satyāṃ ca saṃjñāyām--īpsanti,
aipsan, īrtsanti, airtsan, ityatrādbhāvajusabhāvanumpratipedhāḥ
syuḥ, ataḥ śrūyamāṇapratipatyarthamubhegrahaṇaṃ kartavyam? tanna;
pratīṣiṣatītyādivatsiddheḥ| tathā hi-ṭhajāderdvitīyasya' iti sani
dvirukte śrūyamāṇayorubhyoḥ satyāmapyabhyastasaṃjñāyāmadbhāvādayo
na bhavanti| yathā ca putrīyaṣiṣantītyādau ṭhyatheṣṭṃa
nāmadhātūnām' iti sani dvirukte, tadvadatrāpi na bhaviṣyati| atra hi
īpsājhi, īrtsājhīti sthite'dbāvātprāgnityatvācchap, adbhāvo
hi śapi kṛte tena vyavadhānānna prāpnotītyanityaḥ tataḥ ṭhjño'ntaḥ'
prāpnoti, pūrveṇa sahaikādeśaśca, paratvādantādeśaḥ| nitya
ekādeśaḥ-kṛte'pyantādeśe prāpnoti, akṛtepi| antādeśastvanityaḥ,
kṛte ekādeśe tasyāntavadbhāvādabhyastagrahaṇena grahaṇādadbhāvena
bādhyate| yasya ca nimitaṃ lakṣaṇāntareṇa vihanyate tadanityam|
antaraṅgastarhye kādeśaḥ; varṇāśrayatvāt|
antādeśastvāṅgatvādbahiraṅgaḥ, samānāśraye ca ṭhvārṇādāṅgaṃ
balīyaḥ'; antādeśo'pyantaraṅgaḥ, vakṣyati
hi-āyannādiṣūpadeśivadvacanamiti|
tadevamubhayorapyantaraṅgayornityayośca paratvādantādeśaḥ, tato
jhakārābhāvādalāśrayatvena sthānivadbhāvābhāvāccādādeśo na
bhavati|
astu vā pūrvamekādeśaḥ evamapi ṭhātmanepadeṣvanataḥ' ityatra ṭhanataḥ'
ityasya ṭhadabhyastāt' iti pūrveṇāpi sambandhātpūrvasmādapi
vidhāvekādeśasya sthānivatvādvā'dbhāvo na bhaviṣyati|
evamaipsannityatrāpi, īpsaujhi iti sthite śap ca prāpnoti,
jusbhāvaśca, nityatvācchapi kṛte tena vyavadhānānna jusbhāvaḥ| na ca
pūrveṇa sahaikādeśe kṛte tasyāntadbhāvātpunarjusprasaṅgaḥ,
pūrvasmādapi vidhau sthānivatvāt| īpsannityatrāpi laṭaḥ śatrādeśaḥ,
īpsāśatṛ iti sthite sārvadhātukamātrāpekṣatvādantaraṅgatvācchapi
kṛte tatra sano'kāreṇāto guṇe pararūpe paścātsarvanāmasthāne
cotpanne numaḥ prasaktasya tasyāṃ daśāyāṃ
śatrabhyastayorvyapavargābhāvādubhayavarṇāśrayatvenāntādivadbhāvābhāvacca niṣedhābhāvaḥ| evaṃ pratīṣiṣantītyādāvapi| cikīrṣantītyādau tu yatra sano'kāro na dvirucyate, tatra tenaiva vyavadhānādadbhāvādyabhāvaḥ ||

jakṣityādayaḥ ṣaṭ || 6|1|6 ||
atra jakṣeḥ śtipi ṭhrudādibyaḥ sārvadhātuke' itīṭi kṛte
jakṣitiriti bhavati, sa ādiryaṣāṃ te jakṣityādaya iti vijñāyamāne
vevyateḥ saptamasya na syāt, lāghavārthamasandehārthaṃ ca hakaiva
nirddeṣṭavyaṃ syāt-jakṣyādaya iti| tasmānnāyamuktavigrahiḥ, kiṃ tarhi?
ṭhjakṣa' iti pṛthak padamityāha-jakṣa ityayaṃ dhāturityādayaḥ ṣaḍiti|
itinānantaro jakṣirnirddiśyate| ādiśabdaḥ samīpavacanaḥ,
atadguṇasaṃvijñāno bahuvrīhiḥ| seyamiti| yeyamuktaprakārā,
seyamityarthaḥ|
eṣa svara iti| anyathā ṅtvāllisārvadhātukānudātatvaṃ dhātusvaraḥ,
yaṇādeśe ṭhudātasvaritayoḥ' iti svaritatvaṃ prasajyate| śatari
vyatyayena sampādita iti| ṅtvātpirasmaipadāsambhavādvyatyayaḥ|
ṣaḍgrahaṇamanarthakam, santvāgaṇāntā jakṣityādayaḥ| vevīṅe'pi pare
ye paṭha|lnte teṣāṃ kasmānna bhavati? atraivaṃ gaṇapāṭhaḥ,
vevīṅe'nantaram ṭhṣasa svapne, vaśa kāntau, carkarītaṃ ca, hnuṅ
apanayane' iti, kecidvevīṅe'nantaram ṭhāṅḥ śasu' iti paṭhanti,
ṭhṣasti svapne' iti ca| tatrāśāso na viśeṣaḥ; abhyastakāryāṇi
bhūyiṣṭhāni parasmaipadiṣu, ātmanepadī cāyam| abhyastasvare'pi
nāsti viśeṣaḥ, katham? anabhyaste'pi tasminnanudātetaḥ paraṃ
lasārvadhātukamanudātaṃ dhātusvaraśca, carkarītamabyastameva, ṣasaṣastī
chāndasau, vaśirapi, tasyāpi bhāṣāyāṃ na
prayogassādhuḥ--bāṣyavārtikakārau cetpramāṇam| hnuṅe'pi
ṅtvātpirasmaipadāsambhavaḥ| svarastarhi prāpnoti, ṭhaṅnviṅeḥ' iti
pratiṣedhavacanasāmarthyānna bhaviṣyati, yadi syāt, tarhyapahnavata
ityādāvabhyastasvare sati lasārvadhātukasya bhavitavyameva
nighāteneti pratiṣedho'narthakaḥ syāt| tasmātpratyayasvaro yathā
syatāt, lasārvadhātukānudātatvaṃ mā būdityahanviṅeriti
pratiṣedho'rthavān bhavatīti pratiṣedhasāmarthyātpratyayasvaraḥ eva
bhaviṣyati, nābhyastarasvaraḥ| nanu cābhyastasvaro'jādau vidhīyate,
tataḥ kim? ajādau tasminpravaḥte'pi hraute, ṣehnu, hnuve-ityatra
tasyāpravṛtau yadyahnviṅeriti pratiṣedho na kriyate, tato
dhātusvareṇādyaudātaṃ padaṃ syāt| antodātaṃ yathā syāditi
pratiṣedhaḥ kriyeta| tadevaṃ sati prayojane na
pratiṣedhasāmarthyādabyastasvaraṃ bādhitvā pratyayasvaraḥ sidhyati| evaṃ
tarhi ṭhabhyastānāmādiḥ' ityatrāpyahnviṅerityanuvartiṣyate, tadevaṃ
nārthaḥ ṣaḍgrahaṇena| taduktam--aparigaṇanaṃ vā gaṇāntatvāt ||

tujādīnāṃ dīrghā'bhyāsasya || 6|1|7 ||
ayaṃ yogaḥ śakyo'vaktum, katham? chāndasametaddīrghatvaṃ cchandasi ca
dīrghatvaṃ na śakyaṃ parigaṇayitum, anyeṣāmapi darśanāt pūruṣaḥ,
nāraka iti| anekājaṅgatvācca yeṣāṃ cārabhyacate teṣāmeva
tasminprayoge na dṛśyate--māmahānaḥ, mamahāna iti vā ||

liṭi dhātoranabhyāsasya || 6|1|8 ||
dhātoriti kimiti| liṭi parato'nyo na sambhavati; tasya
dhātoreva vidhānāditi praśnaḥ| viśrṛṇvire iti| ṭhcchandasyubhayathā'
iti sārvadhātukatvāt ṭhśruvaḥ śrṛ ca' iti śnupratyayaḥ, śrṛbhāvaśca| atra
vikaraṇāntasya samudāyasya liṭparasyādhātutvātadīyasya
prathamasyaikāco dvirvacanābhāvaḥ| īkṣāñcakre ityādau tvāmantasya
liṭaparatvaṃ nāsti; ṭhāmaḥ' iti lukā kuptatvāditi dvirvacanābhāvaḥ|
siddhaḥ| anabhyāsasyeti kimiti| na tāvad nunāva, papācetyādau
tatraiva liṭi punardvirvacanaprasaṅgaḥ; sakṛtpravṛtyā lakṣaṇasya
caritārthatvāt, anavasthāpātācca| yastu pratyayāntare sanādau
sābhyāsaḥ, na tasya liṭi sambhavaḥ; tato hi ṭhkāspratyayād' ityāmā
bhavitavyamiti praśanaḥ| nonāveti| ṭhamantre' iti
pratiṣedhādatrāmabhāvaḥ| sammimikṣuriti| sampūrvānmiheḥ sani ṭhho
ḍhaḥ',ṭhṣaḍhoḥ kaḥ si' liṭ, jherus, atolopaḥ| dvivacanaprakaraṇa iti|
prakaraṇagrahaṇānna kevalaṃ sarva dvirvacanaṃ cchandasi vikalpyate| evaṃ ca
ṭhdhātoḥ', ṭhanabhyāsasya' ityubhayamutarārtham| etasmādeva
vikalpādvikaraṇāntasābhyāsayorna bhaviṣyati ||

sanyaṅeḥ || 6|1|9 ||
ṣaṣṭha|lntametaditi| tatra pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣāyā tadantasya
dvirvacanam, na tu sanyaṅereva, yadāha--sanantasya ceti| saptamīpakṣe
tu sanyaṅeḥ parataḥ pūrvasya dhātordvirvacanaṃ bhavatītyayamarthaḥ syāt,
tataśca sanbhaktasyeṭo dvirvacanaṃ na syāt--aṭiṭiṣati,
aśiśiṣatītyādau; tathā pratīṣiṣatītyādau sano na syāt|
evamarāryata ityādau yaṅaḥ, tathā saptamyāmiṣṭāyāṃ pūrveṇāpareṇa vā
sahaikameva yogaṃ kuryāt|
jugupsiṣata iti| gupe ṭhguptijkidbhayaḥ san' tatra sani
dvirvacanam, punaricchāsan, tatrākṛtatvātpunardvirvacanaprasaṅgaḥ|
lolūyiṣate iti| atrāpi yaṅidvirvacanam, na tu sanīti
dvirvacanaprasaṅgaḥ|
bhāgavṛttikārastāvāha--ṭhṭhpūrvasūtre ṭhdhātoranabhyāsasya' iti dvayamapi
pratyākhyāya bhāṣyakāreṇoktam---ṭhtiṣṭhatu tāvatsāṃnyāsikaṃ
dhātugrahaṇam' iti, utarārthamiti bhāvaḥ| anabhyāsagrahaṇasya tu na
kiñcitprayojanamuktam, tataścotarārthamapi tanna bhavatīti
bhāṣyakārasyābhiprāyo lakṣyate| tenātra bhavitavyameva dvirvacanena''
iti || 

ślau || 6|1|10 ||
ślau parata iti| varṇānāmapi yugapadavasthānābhāvād
buddhiparikalpitaṃ porvāparyam, taccābhāvarūpeṇa ślunāpyupapadyat
iti bhāvaḥ| anabyāsasyeti| adhīkāramātraiṇaitaduktam, na tu ślau
sābhyāso bhavati| evaṃ dvitīyasya cetyatra draṣṭavyam ||

caiṅ || 6|1|11 ||
eṣāṃ kāryāṇāṃ pravṛttikrama iti| etacca ṭhacaḥ parasmin'
ityatropapāditam, tata evāvadhātavyam| na kevalaṃ nyāpyatvādayaṃ
krama āśrīyate, kintu prayojanamapyananyathāsiddhamastītyāha--yathā
hīti| hrasvasya sthānivadbhāvānna pratiṣidhyata iti| ṭhhrasvasya
sthānivadbhāvātpratiṣidhyate' iti yatanma bhavati,
sthānivadbhāvābhāvādityarthaḥ| kathaṃ punarasmin kāryakrame sati
sathānivadbhāvo na bhavati? ityata āha--anādiṣṭāca iti| [karaṇe
hetau?ṭ| ṭhacaḥ parasmin' ityatra yo'nādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvastasya vidhiṃ
prati sthānivadbhāvo bhavatīti siddhāntaḥ sthāpitaḥ| na cāsmin krame
satyanādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvo'bhyāso bhavati, kiṃ tarhi? ādiṣṭādeva;
hrasvatve kṛte'bhyāsopajananāt| tena tasya vidhau kartavye
hrasvasta sthānivadbhāvo na bhavatīti laghutvānivṛteḥ
sanvadbhāvo na vyāhanyeta| yadi tu dvirvacane kṛte hrasvaḥ kriyate,
tarhyanādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvo'bhyāsaḥ syāt, tataśca tasya sthāvanivadbhāvaḥ
syādeva vidhau, tataśca dīrghatvāllaghusaṃjñāyā abhāvātsanvadbhāvo na
syāt| kva tarhi syād? aśīśamadityādau| atra hi ṇāveva ṇitāṃ
hrasvo vidhīyate| yadi tarhyayaṃ kāryakramaḥ, āṭiṭadityādaai
dvitīyasyaikācaṣṭiśabdasya dvirvacanaṃ na prāpnoti ?
atrāha--āṭiṭadityādi|
ṭhślucaṅeḥ' ityekayoga eva kartavye yogavibhāgo vaicitryārthaḥ ||

dāśvānsāhvānmīḍhavāṃśca || 6|1|12 ||
dāśvādīnāṃ prācuryeṇa cchandasi prayogadarśanācchāndasametatsūtramiti
manyamānaṃ pratyāha--aviśeṣeṇeti| viśeṣānupādānāditi bhāvaḥ|
parasmaipadamiti| bhauvādikasyātmanepaditvāt, caurādikasya tu ṭhā
dhṛṣādvā' iti ṇijabhāvapakṣe dīrghatvamaniṭtvaṃ ca nipātyata ityanye|
mīḍhavastokāyeti| ṭhmatuvasoḥ' iti numo rutvam|
kiṃ punaḥ sāmarthyam? ityāha--halādiśeṣe hīti| carācara iti|
dīrghoccāraṇasāmarthyād hrasvo na bhavati|
ṇilukceti| ṭhṇoraniṭi' iti ṇilope siddhe punarvacanaṃ
prat|yayalakṣaṇena punarvṛddhirmā bhūditi| pāṭūapaṭa iti|
pūrvavaddhalādiśeṣābhāvo hrasvatvābhāvaśca| dīrghoccāraṇādeva
ṭhabyāsasyānaci' iti vacanādvā ubhayatrāpi halādiśeṣābhāvaḥ| abhyāsasya
yaducyate tadaci na bhavatītyarthaḥ ||

ṣyaṅaḥ samprasāraṇaṃ putrapatyostatpuruṣe || 6|1|13 ||
ṭhigyaṇaḥ saṃprasāraṇam' ityatroktam--ṭhvākyārthaḥ saṃjñī varṇaśca' iti,
tatra vidhau vākyārtha upatiṣṭhate iti tadāśrayeṇā''ha--yaṇaḥ sthāna
igbhavatītyartha iti|
tadantāt ṣyaṅiti| ṣyaṅvidhāvādeśapakṣasya sthitvāllyablopa eṣā
pañcamī, tadantamāśrityetyarthaḥ| atadguṇasaṃvijñāne'tra bahuvrīhiḥ,
aṇ pratyayo'ntaḥ samīpo yasya kārīṣagandhestasmātparaḥ ṣyaṅtyirthaḥ|
pratyayapakṣa eva vāmanācāryasya tatrābhimataḥ| tathā ca ṭhye ca taddhite'
ityatra vakṣyati--ṭhaṇiñantādvā paraḥ ṣyaṅ pratyaya eṣitavyaḥ' iti|
ibhamarhatītībhyā, ṭhdaṇḍādibhyo yaḥ' iha kārīṣagandhyāmatikrāntasya
putro'tikārīṣagandhyāputra iti pratyagrahaṇaparibhāṣayā
samudāyasyāṣyaṅntatve'pi yo'traṣyaṅntastasya prasaṅgaḥ| tathā
putrasya kulaṃ putrakulam, kārīṣagandhyāputrakulamiti varṇagrahaṇe
tadādividhivijñānādiha ca tadabhāvātadādividhyabhāve'pi
putrapatyānantaryāśrayaṃ saṃgrasāraṇaṃ prāpnoti| nātra tarhīdānīmidaṃ
bhavati--kārīṣagandhīputrakulamiti| bhavati ca yadaitadvākyaṃ
bhavati--kārīṣagandhāyāḥ putraḥ kārīṣagandhīputrastasya kulaṃ
kārīṣagandhīputrakulamiti| na sidhyatīti codyārthaḥ|
tathā-atikārīṣagandhyāputrakulamityādāvapi sarvatra putrapatyoḥ
ṣyaṅntasya cānantaryamāśritya samprasāraṇaprasaṅgaḥ|
syādetat--yathā vṛkṣe śākheti vṛkṣaḥ śākhāyā avayavī pratīyate,
tathehāpi, ṣyaṅntasya putrapatyośca tatpuruṣaḥ, tatra pratyāsatyā yasya
tatpuruṣasya pyaṅnto'vayavastasyaiva putrapatī iti gamyate, iha na
tatheti? evamapyavayavāvayavasya samudāyāvayavatvādastyeva prasaṅgaḥ?
naiṣa doṣaḥ; putrapatyoriti saptatīnirddeśāt ṣyaṅntasya
putrapatyośca paurvāparyaṃ pratīyate, pūrvoktena nyāyena
tatpuruṣāvayavatvaṃ ca| tatpuruṣaśca
paurvāparyāvasthitāvayavadvayātmakaḥ| tadiha tatpuruṣāvayavayoḥ
paurvāparyoṇāvasthitayoridaṃ bhavatītyukte yayoḥ sa
tatpuru,stāvetāviti gamyate, ṣyaṅntasya pūrvapadasya
putrapatyorutarapadayorityarthaḥ| samāse ca yasāmācca pūrvaṃ nāsti
tatpūrvapadam, yasmācca paraṃ nāsti tadutarapadam,---yat ṣyaṅntaṃ
na tatpūrvapadam, yaccotarapadaṃ na tatputrapatyātmakam, yacca
putrapatyātmakaṃ na tadutarapadamiti nāsti prasaṅgaḥ| ihāpi tarhi na
prāpnoti--paramakārīṣagandhīputra iti? tatrāha---pyaṅ iti
strīpratyayagrahaṇamiti| ṭhstriyām' iti prakṛtya
vihitatvātsthānivadbhāvena svayameva vā pratyayatvācca
strīpratyayatvam| yadi strīpratyayagrahaṇam, tataḥ kim? ityata
āha-teneti|
apradhānamūpasarjanam| etaduktaṃ bhavati--yatrārthe strīpratyayo vihitaḥ
sa yāvati tadante prādhānyenocyate tāvānsamudāyastadantatayā grāhyaḥ|
apradhāne ca yato vihitastadādike ca tadante ca na bhavati| yadā
tatpuruṣākṣiptamutarapadaṃ putrapatibhyāṃ viśeṣyate tadā tadante
prasaṅgaḥ, iha tūtarapadena putrapatī viśeṣyete iti bhāvaḥ|
nirdiśyamānasyeti| etacca ṭhṣaṣṭhīsthāne yogā' ityatra vyākhyātam|
ṭhanantyavikāre'ntyasadeśasya' iti tu paribhāṣā
prayojanābāvānnāśritā|
samprasāraṇagrahaṇamutarārtham| iha tvīśāpi siddham, śakāraḥ
sarvādeśārthaḥ| tatrāyamapyarthaḥ--samprasāraṇasyeti yogavibhāgena
dīrghatvaṃ na vidheyaṃ bhavati, tadevotarārthatvaṃ
darśayati--samprasāraṇamiti cetyādi|
pūrvaṃ yatra ṣyaṅntaṃ padamuparitanaṃ putrapatyātmakaṃ syād 
dṛṣṭvā tatra ṣyaṅ tatpuruṣa iha yaṇa sthāna igbhāvanīyaḥ|
yatrārthe ṣyaṅ sa yāvatyapi sati na guṇo'sāviheṣṭastadante
yatretyarthaḥ pradhāno na bhavati sa yataḥ ṣyaṅ tadādyeva tatra ||

bandhuni bahuvrīhau || 6|1|14 ||
śabdarupāpekṣayeti| ṭhbandhu' ityetasmin śabdarupamityevaṃ
śabdarupamapekṣya napuṃsakanirdeśaḥ kṛtaḥ| kimarthamevaṃ vyākhyāyate?
ityata āha--puṃlliṅgābhidheyastvayamiti| yo'yamasminsūtre
bandhuśabda upātaḥ sa ityarthaḥ| kuta etat? nupuṃsakaliṅgasyāpi
vidyamānatvāt, badhyate'smin jātiriti bandhūdravyam, ṭhjātyantāccha
bandhuni' iti| yadyevam, tasyaiva grahaṇaṃ prāpnoti? naiṣadoṣaḥ;
pariputrasāhacaryājjātivacana eva grahīṣyate|

vacisvapiyajādīnāṃ kiti || 6|1|15 ||
ādiśabdo'yaṃ yajinaiva sambadhyate, na vacyādibhiḥ pratyekam;
svapigrahaṇāt| anyathā ṭhvaca paribhāṣaṇe', ṭhvida jñāne', ṭhasabhuvi',
ṭhmṛjūṣ śuddhau', ṭhrūdir aśruvivacaneḥ', ṭhñiṣvap śaye'--ityevaṃ
gaṇapāṭhād vacyādigrahaṇenaiva svapādīnāmapi grahaṇasiddheḥ pṛthak
svapādigrahaṇaÄ na kuryāt| āgaṇāntā iti| gaṇasyānto gaṇāntaḥ,
āgatā gaṇāantamāgaṇantāḥ| ukta iti| ṭhcoḥ kuḥ' iṣṭa iti|
vraścāditvātṣaḥ| ūḍha iti| ṭhho ḍhaḥ', ṭhjhaṣasthotardhodhaḥ',ṣṭuatvam,
ṭhḍho ḍhea lopaḥ' ṭhḍhralope pūrvasya dīrgho'ṇaḥ'| uṣita iti|
ṭhvasatikṣudhoriṭ', ṭhśāsivasighasīnāṃ ca' iti ṣatvam| saṃvītadau
ṭhhalaḥ' iti dīrghaḥ| śūna iti| ṭhoditaśca' iti niṣṭānatvam|
dhātoḥka svarūpagrahaṇa iti| yatra dhātuḥ svarūpeṇopādīyate, na
dhātuśabdena tatra tatpratyaye dhātorityevaṃ yo vihitaḥ
pratyayastatraiva kāryaṃ vijñāyate| etacca ṭhbhrauṇahatya' iti
tatvanipātanena jñāpayiṣyate| vācyati, vācikamiti| atra tu yadyapi
kvibantā dhātutvaṃ na jahati, tathāpi dhātorityevaṃ
pratyayasyāvidhānātsamprasāraṇābhāvaḥ ||

grahijyāvayivyadhivaṣṭivicativṛścatipṛcchatibhṛjjatīnāṃ ṅiti ca ||
6|1|16 ||
gṛhītaḥ, yadyapi prathamaṃ ṅiti pratyaye parataḥ samprasāraṇaṃ cakārātkiti
ceti kramo vyākyātaḥ, tathāpyanāsthayā prathamaṃ kityudāhṛtam|
vijādeśo gṛhyata iti| pūrvaparasāhacaryādyasya vapeḥ
parasmaipadasaṃbhavastasya grahaṇaṃ nyāyyam, yastu ṭhaya vaca gatau' iti
vayiḥ, so'nudātedātmanepadī| yadyevamiti| veñādeśasya
grahaṇamityarthaḥ| yajādiṣu veñ paṭha|lta iti| tataśca pūrveṇaiva
samprasāraṇaṃ siddhimiti bhāvaḥ| naivaṃ śakyamiti| vijñātumiti śeṣaḥ|
nānayopapatyā vayigrahaṇamanarthakaṃ śakyaṃ vijñātumityarthaḥ| evaṃ
pratiṣedho'pi prāpnotīti| nātrāviśabdena samuccaya ucyate, kiṃ
tarhi? yathā sthānivadbhāvādvidhiḥ prāpyate, tathā pratipedho'pi
prāpnoti, tatrāpi stānivadbhāvasya tulyatvāt iti
hetostulyatvamapiśabdena dyotyate, tena pratiṣedha eva bhavedityarthaḥ|
uṣṭa iti| tasantam| vyadhirdivādiḥ, vyaciprabhṛtayastudādayaḥ| vṛkṇa
iti| ṭhskoḥ saṃyogādyoḥ' iti salopaḥ, pūrvavanniṣṭhānatvam|
varīvṛścyata ityādau ṭhrīgṛtvataḥ' iti rīgbhāvaḥ ||

liṭa|lbyāsasyobhayeṣām || 6|1|17 ||
vivyatheti| ṭhvyaceḥ kuṭāditvamanasīti vaktavyam' ityatra
paryudāsavṛtyāspratyayasadṛśasya kṛto grahaṇādiha iṅtvābhāvāddhātoḥ
samprasāraṇābhāvaḥ|
ṭhvṛścatipṛcacatibhṛjjatīnāmaviseṣaḥ' iti vārtikam, tad
vṛścativiṣaye bhāṣyakāreṇa dūṣitam--ṭhyaducyate
vṛścateraviśeṣaḥ' ityādi| tatra
vātikakārasyābhiprāyamāha--vṛścateriti| asati sūtre yadrūpaṃ tadeva
satītyabhiprayeṇa vātikakāreṇaitaduktamityarthaḥ|
bhāṣyakārasyābhiprāyamāha--yogārambhe satīti| rephasya samprasāraṇe
satyasati vā nāsti viśeṣa iti
vārtikakāreṇoktamityadhyāropyabhāṣyakāreṇoktamityartha|
akidartamidamiti| kiti katham? ityata āha--kiti hīti|
adhikārādeviti| nātra sāstrīyo'dhikāraḥ, kiṃ tarhi? apekṣālakṣaṇa,
tena pūrvasūtre vacyādeḥ sambandho nāśaṅkanīyaḥ|
yogavibhāgasāmarthyādvā pūrvasūtre teṣāmasambandhaḥ|
halādiḥśeṣamapi bādhitveti| anyathā paratvāddhalādiḥśeṣaḥ syāt|
samprasāraṇameva yathā syāditi| punarvidhānamubhayepāṃgrahaṇādbhavati
tadvādhakabādhanārthamiti bhāvaḥ ||

śvāpeścaiṅ || 6|1|18 ||
svāperṇyantasya grahaṇamiti| āpranotestu supūrvasya grahaṇaṃ na
aṇyantasya; caṅe'sambhavāt| ṇyantasyāpi na bhavati; ṭhdhātoḥ'
ityadhikārāt| svāpyata iti| karmaṇi laṭ, ṇilopaḥ|
svāpita iti| ṭhniṣṭhāyāṃ seṭi' iti ṇilāpaḥ
nanu ca ṭhgrahijyā' ityādisūtrānṅtītyinuvartiṣyate, na cānyaḥ
svāperṅdisti, yaṅ tāvadanekāctvannāsti, apitsārvadhātukaṃ tu
vikaraṇairvyavahitam, aṅadayastvavihitā eva? tatrāha--ṅtīiti
kevalamityādi| nanu kitītyetaccānukṛṣṭṃa pūrvasūtra iti
nehānuvartiṣyate, kimarthaṃ durjñānaṃ ṅdgrihaṇam? ṅdgrihaṇamapi
tarhi pūrvasūtre nānuvartate; liṭo ṅito'sambhavāditi
tasyehānuvṛttirdurvijñānā || 

svapisyamivyeñāṃ yaiṅ || 6|1|19 ||
svapnagiti| ṭhsvapitṛṣornajiṅ' ||

cāyaḥ kī || 6|1|21 ||
kīti dīrghoccāraṇamanarthakam, hrasvādeśe'pi ṭhakṛtsārvadhātukayoḥ'
iti dīrghasya siddhatvāt? tatrāha--dīrghāccāraṇamityādi| kathaṃ
punaryaṅcyamāna ādeśo yaṅluki syāt? pratyayalakṣaṇena| ṭhna
lumatāṅgasya'? evaṃ tarhi dīrghoccāraṇasāmarthyāllukyapi bhaviṣyati,
pūrvasūtravihitaṃ tu prasāraṇaṃ yaṅluki na bhavatyeva| na ca
ṭhsamprasāraṇāśrayaṃ ca kāryaṃ balavat' iti prāgeva lukaḥ samprasāraṇam;
pratyāthyātatvādasyāḥ paribhāṣāyāḥ| tathā ca pūrvatrobhayeṣāṃ grahaṇaṃ
kṛtam, anayatā'nayaiva paribhāṣayā halādiśeṣātprageva samprasāraṇaṃ
bhaviṣyatītyanarthakaṃ tatsyāt| sāsvapīti, sāsvapti| sāsvaptaḥ,
sāśvapītaḥ| vāvyeti, vāvyāti ||

styaḥ prapūrvasya || 6|1|23 ||
dvayorapyetayoriti| dvayorapi syārupasya lākṣaṇikatvāt|
samprasāraṇe kṛte iti| tasyāsiddhatvātprāgeva samprasāraṇam |
prastya ityeva siddha iti| yathā ṭhprastyo'nyatarasyām' ityatra| na
caivamucyamāne praśabdasyāpi yo rephastasyāpi prasaṅgaḥ;
dhātorityadhikārāt| prasaṃstīta iti| ṭhprastyo'nyatarasyām' iti
matvamatra na bhavatyeva| tatkathamiti| kathamayamarthaḥ śabdenābhihito
bhavatīti praśnaḥ| ṣaṭha|lrthe bahuvrīhiriti|
pūrvaśabdasyāvayavavācitvāt, yathā--pūrvaṃ kāyasyeti| vyadhikaraṇe
ṣaṣṭa|laviti| prapūrvasyeti styāśabdāpekṣayāvayavaṣṣṭhī, stya
ityeṣāpi yaṇavayavāpekṣyā ṣaṣṭhī| yathā punarayamarthaḥka
prakṛtopayogī tathā darśayati--tatreti ||

dravamūrtisparśayoḥ syaḥ || 6|1|24 ||
dravakāṭhinya iti| dravāvastāyā utarāvasthāviśeṣaḥukāṭhinyam| sparśe
ceti| rūpādisahacarito guṇaḥuspaśaḥ|
śīto vāyuriti| kathaṃ punaḥ sparsamātrābhidhāyinaḥka śītaśabdasya
tadvaddravyavācinā vāyuśabdena sāmānādhikaraṇyam ?
tatrāha--guṇāmātra ityādi| śuklādiśabdavaditi bhāvaḥ ||

vibhāṣā'bhyavapūrvasya || 6|1|25 ||
seyamubhayatra vibhāṣeti| dravamūrtiviṣaye pūrveṇa prāpte'nyatrāprāpte|
atha pūrvagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, na ṭhvibhāṣābyavābhyām' ityevocyeta,
tatrāhapūrvagrahaṇasyetyādi| kriyamāṇe'pi pūrvagrahaṇe kasmādevātra na
bhavati? ityāha--na kileti| kilaśabdasūcitāmaruci
darśayati-yo'treti| mā bhūnmahāsamudāyo'bhyavapūrvaḥ,
avāntarasamudāyastvabhyavapūrvo'pyasti, tadāśrayo vikalpaḥ prāpnoti|
yatnāntaramāstheyamiti| vibhāṣāgrahaṇaṃ
vyavasthitavibhāṣārthamāśrayaṇīyamityarthaḥ| pūrvagrahaṇasya
cānyatprayojanaṃ vaktavyamiti| tatpunarabhisaṃśīnam, abhisaṃśyānam,
avasaṃśīnam, avasaṃśyānamityatrāpi vikalpapravṛttireva| tacca
pūrvagrahaṇe kriyamāṇe yathā labhyate tathā ṭhstyaḥ prapūrvasya' ityatra
vyākhyātam || 

śrṛtaṃ pāke || 6|1|27 || 
śrā pāka ityasya dhātoriti| ṭhśrā pāke' ityadādau paṭha|lte, ṭhśrau
pāke' iti curādau, ghaṭādiṣvapi mitvārthaḥ ṭhśrā pāke' iti paṭha|lte,
tatreha sarveṣāṃ grahaṇam| śrāyaterapi kṛtātvasyaitadrapaṃ bhavati,
nipātanasāmarthyācca lakṣaṇapratipadaktaparibhāṣā nāśrīyate| ṇyantasya
cāṇyantasya ceti| tathā coktam--ṭhśrāśrapyoḥ śrṛbhāvo nipātyate'
iti| ata eva prakṛtaṃ samprasāraṇameva na vihatam, śraperapi
śrṛtamityeva yathā syāditi|
yadi vibhāṣetyatadatrāvartate, kṣīrahaviṣoranyatra ca vikalpaḥ
prāpnoti sarvatra, tatrāha--vyavasthitavibhāṣā ceyamiti| yadā
tvityādi| prayojakavyāpāraḥ preṣaṇādilakṣaṇa prayojakaśabdenoktaḥ,
tasya ca bāhyatvaṃ bahirbhūtaṇijvyāpyatvāt| tadāpi neṣyata iti|
tathā coktam--śrapeḥ śrṛtamanyatra hetoriti| śrapitaṃ kṣīraṃ
devadatena| prayojakavyāpāreṇāpyamānasyāpi prayojyasya karmasaṃjñā
na bhavati, ṭhgatibuddhipratyavasāna' iti niyamāt| kathaṃ punarṇyantasya
nipātanaṃ labhyate, yāvatā pāka ityucyate, ṇyantena ca
pācanābhidhīyate, na pākaḥ; atha pācanāyāmapi guṇabhūtaḥ pākaḥ
pratīyate, tadāśrayaṃ nipātanaṃ syacāt? yadyevam, dvitīye'pi ṇici
prasaṅgaḥ| na hi tatra pāko guṇabhūto na gamyate|
athaṃ tatra guṇabhūtatvādeva pradhānabhūte pāke caritārthaṃ nipātanaṃ na
bhaviṣyatī tyucyeta ? prathame'pi na syād, vaktavyo vā viśeṣaḥ|
tamāha-śrātirayamityādi| athamabhiprāyaḥ--dvividhaḥ
pākaḥ--viklitilakṣaṇaḥ, vikledanālakṣaṇaśca;, ubhayatrāpi paceḥ
prayogadarśanāt, pacyate odanaḥ svayameva, pacatyodanaṃ devadata
iti| śrātiścāyaṃ yadyapi ṭhpāke' tyiviśeṣeṇa paṭha|lte, tathāpi
karmakartṛviṣayasya pacerarthevartete| sa ṇyanto'pi prākṛtacaṃ prakṛtau
bhavaṃ ṇijrahitapacivācyaṃ pacyarthamāha| so'pi pāka eva, na
pācayaterarthaḥ, yathā--siddhayatyodanaḥ, sādhayatyodanamiti| tatra yadā
śrāteḥ kta ||||tpadyate, tadā'karmakatvātkartari bhavati--śrṛtaṃ kṣīramiti,
śrapestu karmaṇai--śrṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ devadatena| dvitīye tu ṇici
pācayitṛvyāpāraḥ pācanālakṣaṇaḥ prādhānyenābhidhīyate, na tu pāka
iti nipātanābhāva iti| ṭhśrapeḥ śrṛtvamanyatra hetoḥ' iti vārtike
ṭhśrāśrapyoḥ śrṛbhāvo nipātyate' iti
pūrvamuktatvādādyaprakṛtalakṣaṇaprayojakavyāpārāṅgīkaraṇasāmarthyātpācayitṛlakṣaṇaprayojakavyāpāraniṣedho vijñeyaḥ ||
pāko'yaṃ pākyapaktyoradvividha iha sa viklitivikledanātmā 
śrātirvaktyekamanyaṃ śrapayatirubhayatraubhayokteḥ śrṛbhāvaḥ|
sve sve vācye śrapestu prasajati sati vā pācane na dvitīye 
nityaṃ kṣīre śṛbhāvo haviṣi ca na tu pākyeṣu cārthāntareṣu ||

pyāyaḥ pī || 6|1|28 ||
andhuḥ kūpaḥ ||

liḍa|lṅeśca || 6|1|29 ||
vibhāṣeti nivṛtamiti| utarasūtre punarvibāṣāgrahaṇāt| pyāyaḥ
pītyetaccakāreṇānukṛṣyate iti| asati cakāre prakaraṇinaḥ
samprasāraṇasyaivānuvṛttiḥ syād, yathotaratra| paratvātpībhāve kṛte
iti| nanu dvayoḥ sāvakāśayoḥ paratvaṃ bhavati, anavakāśaśca pībhāvaḥ,
evaṃ tarhi paratvādutkṛṣṭatvādanavakāśatvāditi bhāvaḥ| punaḥ
prasaṅgavijñānāditi| atrāpi ṭhvipratiṣedhe param' ityatra yaduktaṃ na
tadvivakṣitam, kiṃ tarhi? dvirvacanasya punaḥ prasaṅgo'stīti
kṛtvetyarthaḥ| yadi tarhyanavakāśaḥ pībhāvo nāprāpte dvirvacana
ārabhyamāṇena tena dvirvacanasya bādhaḥ prāpnoti? naiṣa doṣaḥ;
parasparasannidhau bādhyabādhakabāvaḥ| iha tu samprasāraṇaprakaraṇena
dvirvacanaprakaraṇaṃ vicchinnam| ata eva vakṣyate--ṭhdigyādeśena
dvitvabādhanamitaṣyate' iti||

vibhāṣā śveḥ || 6|1|30 ||
śuśāveti| parāvapi vṛddhyāyādeśau bādhitvā nityatvāt
samprasāraṇamantaraṅgatvātpūrvatvam| śuśuvaturiti| atrāpi
paratvātprāpamiyaṇṃó bādhitvā nityatvātsamprasāraṇam| tatra kṛte
paramapi ṭheranekācaḥ' iti yaṇaṃ bādhitvāntaraṅgatvātpūrvatvam,
paścāduvaṅadeśaḥ| anyatreti| pitsu vacaneṣu| tatra sarvatra vikalpa
iti| pitsu tāvadvikalpyate; pratiṣedhakābhāvāt| kitsvapi
paratvādayaṃ vikalpaḥ| yajādilakṣaṇasyāvakāśaḥ--śūnaḥ, śūnavān,
asyāvakāśaḥ pidvavacanāni; kiti liṭa|lubhayaprasaṃge paratvādayaṃ
vikalpaḥ| abyāsasyāpi na bhavatīti| kimiti na bhavati? na tāvat
paratvādanena kalpena bādhaḥ, dhātorayaṃ vikalpaḥ, nābhyāsasya|
kiñca--ubhayeṣāṃgrahaṇasya sa eva vidhiryathā syāditi|
tasmādvacanamevātra śaraṇam| yadāha--ṭhsverliṭa|lbhyāsalakṣaṇapratiṣedhaḥ'
iti ||

ṇau ca saṃścaṅeḥ || 6|1|31 ||
ṭhṇau' itika śvayatyapekṣayā parasptamī, ṭhsaṃścaṅeḥ' iti ṇyapekṣayā|
tadāha--sanpare caṅpare ca ṇau parata iti| antaraṅgamapīti|
antaraṅgatvaṃ tu ṇijmātrāpekṣatvāt| vṛddhyādikamiti|
ādiśabdenāyādeśo gṛhyate, yadā tu ṭhsaṃprasāraṇaṃ saṃprasāraṇāśrayaṃ
ca kāryaṃ balīyaḥ' iti paribhāṣā prayojanābāvātpratyākhyātā, tadā
ṭhṇau ca saṃkhcaṅerviṣayabhūtayoḥ' iti| oḥ puyaṇjītyādi| yathā
caitajjñāpakaṃ tathā ṭhdvirvacane'ci' ityatra pratipāditam| atra
sthānivadbhāvādityataḥ pūrvam ṭhdvitīyo'pi' itiśabdaḥ pāṭhayaḥ|
ṭhtena' iti vā paṭhitavyam ||

hvaḥ samprasāraṇam || 6|1|32 ||
saṃprasāraṇasya balīyastvāditi| balīyastvaṃ ca pūrvavat|
ekayogenaiva siddha iti| utarasūtre kasyacinnimitasya
saptamīnirdiṣṭasyābhyastaṃ pratyaśravaṇāṇṇāvapi saṃścaṅpare
hverabhyastakāraṇasya siddhameva samprasāraṇamiti bhāvaḥ|
anabhyastanimitapratyayeniti| abhyastasya yannimitaṃ na bhavati tena|
vyavadhāne iti| yadyautarasūtraṃ pravarteta, tadā yogavibāgo'narthakaḥ
syāditi jñāpakatvam ||

abhyastasya ca || 6|1|33 ||
atra ṭhhvaḥ' ityanuvartamānasya yadyabhyastaryetyanena sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ
syāt, tadā kṛte dvirvacane'bhyastasaṃjñāyāmupajātāyāṃ
samprasāraṇena bhavithavyam, tataścābhyāsasya samprasāraṇaṃ na syāt; ṭhna
samprasāraṇe samprasāraṇam' iti niṣedhāt| ākārahakārābhyāṃ
vyavahitatvādapratiṣedha iti cetu? na; samānāṅge
samprasāraṇapratiṣedhāt| samānāhgagrahaṇaṃ tatra codayiṣyati, na;
samānāṅge samprasāraṇapratiṣedhāt| samānāṅgagrahaṇaṃ tatra
codayiṣyati, etacca tatraiva vyaktaṃ vyākhyāsyate| tamimaṃ
sāmānādhikaraṇye doṣaṃ paścannāha--tadabhyastasyetyanena
vyadhikaraṇamiti| etadeva sphorayati--abyastasya yo hvayatiriti|
tena kiṃ siddhaṃ bhavati? ityāha--teneti ||

apaspṛdhethāmānṛcurānṛhuścicyuṣetityājaśrātāḥ
śritamāśīrāśīrtāḥ || 6|1|36 ||
apara āheti| kasyāñcicchākhāyāmapaspṛdhethāmityādyaudātaṃ paṭha|lte,
anyasyāṃ tu padadvayam, ubhayamapyanena nipātanena saṃgṛhyate|
tatraikapadye ṭhtiṅṅatiṅaḥ' iti nighātaḥ prāptaḥ, ṭhyadvṛtānnityam' iti
pratiṣiddhaḥ| tatrāṭsvareṇādyaudātaṃ padaṃ bhavati| yadā tu dve pade,
tadā nighātapratiṣedhe ṭhtāsyanudātet' iti
lasārvadhātukānudātatve dhātusvareṇa spṛdhethāmiti
padamādyaudātam,ṭhtiṅ codātivati' ityapaśabdasya nighātaḥ| 
bahuvacanasyāvivakṣitatvāditi| somasyaiva bahutve śrābhāva iti
niyamānāśrayaṇācca, anyathā bahutvātavivakṣāyāmapi somādanyatra
śrābhāvo na syād viṣayavibhāgavāditanām ||

na samprasāraṇe samprasāraṇam || 6|1|37 ||
yeṣāṃ samprasāraṇaṃ vihitaṃ teṣāṃ yāvanto yaṇasteṣāṃ sarveṣāṃ
samprasāraṇe prāpte pratiṣedho'yamucyate| nanu
cālontyaparibhāṣayāntyasyaiva bhaviṣyati? nānayā paribhāṣayā
śakyamihopasthātum, vacyādīnāmantyasya yaṇo'sambhavāt|
ṭhanantyavikāre'ntyasadeśasya' ityanayā paribhāṣayā tarhi
antyasadeśasyaiva bhaviṣyati, netarasya? naiṣāsti paribhāṣā;
prayojanābhāvāt| etaccāsmābhiḥ paribhāṣāprakaraṇākhye granthe
upapāditam|
evaṃ tarhi jñāpakātsiddham, yadayaṃ pyāyaḥ pībhāvaṃ śāsti,
tajjñāpayati--na sarvasya yaṇaḥ samprasāraṇaṃ bhavatīti| yadi syāt,
pyāyaḥ samprasāraṇameva vidadhyāt| dvayoryakārayoḥ samprasāraṇe
pūrvatve ca ṭhhalaḥ' iti dīrghatve ca siddhaṃ syātpīnaṃ mukhamiti| nanu
ca pyāyo'ntya yaṇaḥ| sambhvākatasyaiva syāt? syādevaṃ yadi
ṭhpyāyaḥ' iti sthānaṣaṣṭhī vijñāyeta, avayavaṣaṣṭhī caiṣā
vijñāsyate--pyāyo yo yaṇ tasyeti| evamapyetāvadevānena
jñāpyate-na jñāpyate--na sarvasya yaṇaḥ samprasāraṇaṃ bhavatīti, tatra kut
etat-- parasyaiva bhavati na pūrvasyeti, na ca
vidhyatītyādinirddeśātparasyaiveti śakyamavagantum? paryāyeṇa
pravṛtāvapi tadupapateḥ| tasmādārabhyamevaitat|
nanu pūrvaparayoryaṇorekayogalakṣaṇaṃ samprasāraṇaṃ tadyadi
parasyābhinirvṛtaṃ pūrvasyāpyabhinirvṛtameva, na cābhinirvṛtasya
pratiṣedhena nivṛttiḥ śakyā vijñātum, yo hi bhuktavantaṃ brūyād
mā bhuṃkthā iti, kiṃ tena kṛtaṃ syāt! atha pūrvasyānabhinirvṛtaṃ
parasyāpyanabhinirvṛtameva, tatra nimittvenāśrayaṇamanupapannam?
ityata āha--ekayogalakṣaṇamapīti| aparaḥ kalpaḥ-- astu
dvayorapyabhinirvṛtam, kathaṃ tarhi pratiṣiddhyate? na samprasāraṇaṃ
pratiṣiddhyate, kiṃ tarhi? tadāśrayaṃ pūrvatvam| tadeva tvatra
samprasāraṇaśabdenopacārāducyate, tasminpratiṣiddhe yaṇādeśena
siddhamiṣṭam| astu vā dvayorapyanabhinirvṛtam| kathaṃ tarhi
nimitatvam? naivātra samprasāraṇanimitam, kiṃ tarhi? tadbhāvī yo
yaṇ sa eva ca saptamyantena samprasāraṇaśabdenocyata iti|
punaḥ samprasāraṇagrahaṇamiti| asati tasmin, ṭhanantarasya vidhirvā
bhavati pratiṣedho vā' iti pūrvaprakaraṇavihitasyaiva samprasāraṇasya
pratiṣedhaḥ syānna videśasthasya| vibhinanno deśaḥuvideśaḥ|
sampabrasāraṇagrahaṇādeveti| iha tu ṭhvyatho liṭi' vivyathe iti
halādiḥśeṣāpavādaḥ samprasāraṇam, prakaraṇādutsargadeśaścāpavādo
bhavatīti parasyaiva saṃprasāraṇātsiddham| ata eva punaḥ
saṃprasāraṇādvideśasthepi saṃprasāraṇe pratiṣedha itīṣṭavyam, anyathā
tatreti vācyaṃ syāt| vyavadhānametāvadāśrayiṣyata iti|
tenopapūrvādvaseḥ ṭhbhāṣāyāṃ sadavasaśruvaḥ' iti liṭaḥ kvasau
vibhaktau ca parato vasossamprasāraṇe upeyuṣetyādau dhātoḥ
prāptasya yajādilakṣaṇasya saṃprasāraṇasya pratiṣedho na bhavati, pratyakṣeṇa
ṣakāreṇa vyavadānāditi bhāvaḥ| yadi tu vyavadhānamātre syāt, tadā
samānāṅgagrahaṇaṃ kartavyam| nimitanimitinau yatraikasminnevāṅge
bhavataḥ, tatra pratiṣedho bhavatīti vaktavyam| upeyuṣītyatra kvasau
dhāturaṅgam, kvasvantaṃ ca vibhaktāviti pratiṣedhābhāvaḥ|
antaraṅgatvādvā'tra pūrvameva dhātoḥ samprasāraṇam|
ṛci treriti| kalpasūtrakārāstu dviśabdasyāpi samprasāraṇaṃ
prayuñjate--ṭhtṛcāḥ pratipadanucarāḥ', ṭhdvacāḥ pragāthāḥ' iti ||

liṭi vayo yaḥ || 6|1|38 ||
liṅgrahaṇamutarārthamiti| nehārthaṃ liṭaḥ; anyatra
vayādeśasyāsambhavāt ||

vaścāsyānyatarasyāṃ kiti || 6|1|39 ||
asyagrahaṇena vayo yakāraḥ pratinirddiśyate,
anyathādeśākārasyoccāraṇārthatve pramāṇābhāvādvaya evāyaṃ sarvādeśaḥ
sambhāvyeta| asyagrahaṇe tu sati yadyaṣyakāravānādeśaḥ tathāpyato
lopena siddhamiṣṭam|
vaścāsyagrahaṇaṃ śakyamakartum| katham? ṭhanyatarasyāṃ kiti veñaḥ'
iti sūtraṃ kartavyam, liṭītyeva, kiti liṭi parato veñaḥ
samprasāraṇaṃ na bhavatyanyatarasyām--vavatuḥ, vavuḥ; samprasāraṇapakṣe
upaṅadeśe sati dvirvacanam, savarṇadīrghatvam--ūcatuḥ, ūcuḥ;
ṭhveño vayiḥ' --ūyatuḥ ūyuriti| kathaṃ vavau, vavitha? ṭhlyapi ca'
iti cakāreṇa liḍanukṛṣyate, tatpiti nityaniṣedhārthaṃ bhaviṣyati ||

lyapi ca || 6|1|40 ||
pūrvaṃ vaścāsyagrahaṇe kriyamāṇe ṭhlyapi vyo jyaśca' iti ekayoga eva
kartavyaḥ, evaṃ hi dviścakāro'pi na kartavyo bhavati ||

ādeca upadeśe'siti || 6|1|45 ||
ādeca upadeśe'śiti || atra yadi ṭhdhātoḥ' iti nānuvarteta, tato
viseṣyābhāvādevala nāsti tadantavidhirityupadeśe ya ec
tasyātvamityartho bhavati; tataśca ḍhaukitā, traukitā ityatrāpi
prāpnoti| nanu cāśitītyucyate, na cātrāśitaṃ paśyāmaḥ; na ca
kakāra evāśit, kiṃ kāraṇam? nañivayuktanyāyena śitsadṛśasya
pratyayasyaiva grahaṇāt ? syādevaṃ yadyaśitīti paryudāsaḥ syāt,
prasajyapratiṣedhastvayamiti vakṣyate|
tasmāddhātorityanuvartayamityāha--dhātoriti vartata iti| tasya
caico viśeṣaṇātadantavidhirityāha--ejanto yo dhāturiti| upadeśa
iti| anirjñātasvarūpasya svarūpajñāpanārthamādyamuccāraṇamūpadeśaḥ|
cetā, stoteti| ārdhadhātuke guṇavidhānaṃ tvātvārthameva syāt;
yaṃ vidhiṃ pratyupadeśa iti nyāyāt| kartā, hartā hatyādau ca
guṇavidhiścaritārthaḥ| evamapi lākṣaṇikatvādevātra na bhaviṣyati?
jñāpakācca; yadayaṃ krīṅjīnāṃ ṇāvātvaṃ śāsti, tajjñāpayati-na
paranimitasyaica ātvaṃ bhavatīti| naitadasti jñāpakam,
niyamārthametat syāt--krīṅjīnāṃ ṇāveveti| tatarhi
ṭhmīnātiminotidīṅaṃ lyapi ca' ityātvaṃ sāsti? evaṃ
taharyutarārthamavaśyaṃ kartavyamupadeśagrahaṇam, tadihaiva kriyate
mandadhiyāmanugrahāya|
kathamiti| aśidityayaṃ bahuvrīhiḥ, tatra śiti pratiṣedhe kriyamāṇe
śinmātrasya prāpnoti, tataśca jaglāye iti bhavitavyamiti praśnaḥ|
bhāve lakāraḥ, tatpuruṣāśrayeṇotaram| kaḥ punastatpuruṣe sati
guṇaḥ? ityata āha--tatreti| tatpuruṣe hi varṇagrahaṇamidaṃ bhavati,
varṇagrahaṇe ca tadādau kāryaṃ bhavati| stanandhaya ityatra tu
ṭhnāsikāstanayoḥ' iti khaśi kṛte madyapātinaṃ śapamāśritya pratiṣedhaḥ|
prayojanābhāvādevātra na śapapā bhitavyamiti cet? nanvidameva
prayojanaṃ yadutātvanivṛttiḥ| aśitīti| yadyayaṃ paryudāsaḥ
syāt--śito'nyo'śit, tasminnaśitīti, tato glāyanti,
malāyantītyatra śabakārasyāntyākārasya caikādeśe kṛte tasya paraṃ
pratyādivadbhāvādasti śito'nya iti kṛtvā''tvamatra prāpnoti|
prasajyapratiṣedhe tu na doṣaḥ; ekādeśasya pūrvaṃ pratyantavadbhāvāt
sidgrahaṇena grahaṇāt śiti pratiṣedha eva bhavati| kiṃ punaḥ
kāraṇamekādeśaviṣaya eva ātvaprāptiścodyate, na
punarglāyatītyādāvapi lakāra evāśiti parata ātvaṃ prāpnotīti?
naivaṃ śakyaṃ codayitum; evaṃ hyaśitīti pratiṣedho nirvaṣayaḥ
syāt, na ca ṭhpāghādhmādheṭdṛśaḥ' hṛti dheṭaḥ śapratyayo'nanyapūrvo
viṣayaḥ| na hyaekamudāharaṇaṃ sitpratiṣedhaṃ prayojayati| yadyetāvat|
prayojanaṃ syād ṭhaśe' ityeva brūyāt|
yadvā--antaraṅgatvānnityatvācca pūrvaṃ codyate? naiṣa doṣaḥ;
ekādeśasya pūrvavidhau sthānivadbhāvenādiśito'nyasya
pratyayasyābhavāt| iha tarhi--suglaḥ, suglā,
suglānamityākārāntalakṣaṇāḥ kāṅyano na syuḥ? eṣo'pyadoṣaḥ;
ātvabhāvina ejantādākārāntanimitakaḥ|
pratyayo jñāpyate sarvo hvāvāmaścetyaṇā punaḥ ||
iha tarhi glai-glānīyam, pai--pānīyam, anīyari kṛte ātvaṃ ca
prāpnoti, āyādayaśca, paratvādāyādayaḥ syuḥ? satyam; kṛteṣu
teṣvalontyasyātve savarṇadīrghatve glānīyamityādi siddham|
nanvāyādiṣu kṛteṣu nāyamejantaḥ, na ca
sthānivadbāvo'lāśrayatvāt? syādetadevaṃ yadi samprati yadejantaṃ
tasyātvaṃ bhavatītyucyeta, iha tūpadeśagatamejantatvaṃ na
sampratitanamiti nāsti sthānivadbāvāpekṣā| nanvevamapi
jaglaturityādau yakārasyātve kṛte jaglāāāatusiti
sthite'ntaraṅgamapyākārayorekādeśaṃ bādhitvā ṭhāto lopa iti
ca' ityāto lopaḥ syāt, na ca pūrvasyākārasya punarlopo labhyate,
yakārākāralopasya pūrvavidhau sthānivadbhāvāt
ṭhasiddhavadatrābhāt' ityasiddhatvācca? naiṣa doṣaḥ; samānāśraye
ṭhvārṇādāṅgaṃ balīyaḥ' iha tu vyāśrayatvādantaraṅga ekādeśe sati
paścādāllopa iti siddhamiṣṭam| evamapi ṭhdvirvacane'ci'
ityāyādīnāṃ sthānivatāvta glaiśabdasyadvirvacane'bhyāsasyevarṇāntatā
prāpnoti, pakṣāntare tvanaimitikatvādātvasya
dvirvacananimite'cyavihitatvānna doṣaḥ? paryudāsapakṣe'pi na doṣaḥ,
liṭi vayo yaḥ' iti dvilakārako'yaṃ nirdeśaḥ, tathānirddeśasya ca
tatra prayojanābhāvādihānuvṛtaṃ vākyabhedena sambaddhyate--aśityeva
ātvaṃ bhavati, liṭi tu lakārādau lāvasthāyāmeveti| tataścātvasya
dvirvacananimitājnimitatvābhāvāttsya tāvanna sthānivadbhāvaḥ|
āyādayastu liṭa|lprāptā eva| tadevaṃ paryudāsapakṣasya bahupratividheya
tvātprasajyapratiṣedho'yamityāha--aśitīti prasajyapratiṣedho'yamiti|
tena kiṃ siddhaṃ bhavati? ityāha--tenaitadityādi| evamādi siddhaṃ
bhavatīti| ādiśabdena sugletyatra ṭhātaścopasarge' ityaṅe grahaṇam|
anyāni bahunī prayojanāni prāgevāsmābhirddarśitāni |
iha kasmānna bhavati-gobhyām, naubhyāmiti? jñāpakāt| yadayam
ṭhrāyohali' ityātvaṃ śāsti, tajjñāpayati-na prātipadikasyātvaṃ
bhavatīti| naitadasti jñāpakam, niyamārthametatsyāt--rāyo halyeva;
ṭhautomsasoḥ' ityetatu gāṃ paśyetyatra, ṭhgoto ṇit' ṇitvādvṛddhiḥ
prāpnoti, gāḥ paśyetyatra tvaśitīti pratiṣedhaḥ prāpnotīti kṛtaṃ
bhavedityajñāpakam ? evaṃ taharyupadeśa ityucyate, na ca
gonauśabdayorupadeśo'sti, yaḥ ṭhgopayasoryan', ṭhnauvayodharma'
ityādau uccāraṇaṃ nāsāvupadeśaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? uddeśaḥ,
siddhavadupānāt| mā bhūd gaunauśabdayorupadeśaḥ,
ecastūpadeśo'sti--ṭhgamerḍoḥ', ṭhglānudibhyāṃ ḍauḥ' iti, na ca
ḍoḍāvorvidhānavaiyarthyam, śasi caritārthatvāt? evaṃ tarhi
ṭhdhātoriti vartate'--ityuktatvānna bhaviṣyati ||

na vyo liṭi || 6|1|46 ||
kityātve satyasati vā viśeṣābhāvātpityudāharaṇametasya
vṛttikāreṇa darśitam| thali ṭhiḍatyartivyayatīnām' itīṭa ||

krīṅjīnāṃ ṇau || 6|1|47 ||
yadyapi karoteḥ ṭhīṅ gatau' ityetasya yaṇādeśe ṅiti rūpaṃ
sambhavatati, tathāpi ṭhecaḥ' ityadhikārātkarotestāvad grahaṇaṃ na
sambhavati| tathā īṅe'pi grahaṇaṃ na bhavati, hrasvāntena pareṇa jayatinā
sāhacaryāt ||

sidhyaterapāralaukike || 6|1|48 ||
paralokaḥ prayojanamasya tatpāralaukikam ṭhprayojanam' iti ṭhak,
anuśatikāditvādubhayapadavṛddhiḥ| jñanaviśeṣe vartata iti|
heyopādeyatatvāvabodhaḥujñānaviśeṣaḥ| tāpasaḥ sidhyatīti|
