heyamupādeyaṃ ca tatvato jñātukāmaḥ pravarta ta ityarthaḥ|
tadāha--jñānaviśeṣamāsādayatīti| tapaḥ prayuṅkte iti|
jñānaviśeṣavantaṃ karotītyarthaḥ| paraloka ityasya
vivaraṇam-janmāntara iti| iha vā bhavatu, svargādau vā,
śarīrāntaropalakṣaṇārthaṃ pāralaukikagrahaṇamiti| upasaṃharanniti|
hetau śatṛpratyayaḥ|
iha kasmāditi| brāhmaṇebhyo dāsyāmītyanenābhiprāyeṇānuṣṭhito
dhātvarthaḥ paralokaprayojano bhavatīti praśnaḥ| siddhyaterartha
ityādinā aihalaukikatvaṃ dhātvarthasya darśayati| tasyaprayojanamiti|
taduddiśya pravṛtatvāt| punaḥ siddhireveti| pāralaukikīti
liṅgavipariṇāmena sambandhanīyam| siddhiḥu siddhireveti|
pāralaukikīti liṅgavipariṇāmena sambandhanīyam|
siddhiḥuniṣpatiḥ| yasyāṃ siddhau dhāturvartate sā ca pāralaukikī na
bhavati, tasmādātvaṃ na paryudasyate| sākṣāditi| yadi
sākṣādavyavadhānena pāralaukiko yaḥ siddhyaterarthastatra paryudāso
na caritārthaḥ syātadā pāramparyāśrayaṇam| idaṃ tu sākṣātparalokārthe
jñānaviśeṣe caritārtham, ato naivaṃvidhe viṣaye pravartate ityarthaḥ
||

mīnātiminotidīṅaṃ lyapi ca || 6|1|49 ||
upadeśa evātvavidhānāllyapaḥ paratvāsambhavāllyapīti
viṣayasaptamītyāha--lyapi viṣaya iti| ekācca iti| yadyapi
prakṛtiviśeṣaṇaṃ prāgāsīt,
tathāpīhopadeśādhikārānmīnātyādīnāṃ copadeśa
ejantatvāsambhavātsāmarthyādeva ityetadapi viṣayaviśeṣaṇaṃ vijñāyata
ityāha--ecaśca viṣaya iti| yatra pratyaye ejbhāvī tasminbuddhistha
ityarthaḥ| upadeśa evetyasya vivaraṇam--prāk pratyayotpateriti|
upadeśa evātvavidhāne yo'rthaḥ sampadyate taṃ darśayati--upadeśa
evātvavidhānāditi| ivarṇāntalakṣaṇaḥ pratyaya erac, ākārāntalakṣaṇastu
ghañ| yadyapi ghañākārāntāditi nocyate, tathāpyatrātve sati bhavati,
asati tu na bhavatītyetāvatā ghaña ākārāntalakṣaṇatvam| upadāyo
vartata iti| ṭhghañi ṭhāto yuk ciṇkṛtoḥ' iti yuk|
īṣadupadānamiti khalarthe ṭhāto yuc'| mīnātiminotyestu
khalacāveva bhavata; ṭhnimīmiliyāṃ khalacoḥ pratiṣedhaḥ' iti
vakṣyamāṇatvāt| ato dī|||vodāhṛtaḥ ||

vibhāṣā līyateḥ || 6|1|51 ||
tayorubayorapi yakā'yaṃ nirddeśaḥ kriyate iti| yadi tu
daivādikasyaiva śyanā nirddeśaḥ kriyeta, ṭhlīṅḥ' ityeva brūyāditi
bhāvaḥ| śitapaḥ śitkaraṇasāmarthyāccābāvakarmavācitve'pi yag
bhavati, yathā--akartṛvācitvaśabādayaḥ--ṭhbhavateraḥ' ityādau|
khalacoriti| pacādyaca eracaśca sāmānyena grahaṇam| evaṃ ceti|
vyavasthitavibhāṣāvijñānādevetyarthaḥ| ullāpayata iti| ṭhliyaḥ
sammānanaśālīnīkaraṇayośca' ityātmanepadam ||

khideścchandasi || 6|1|52 ||
cakhādeti| vyatyayena parasmaipadam, ātvasyānaimitikatvād
ṭhdvirvacane'ci' iti sthānivatvābhāvadabhyāsasyevarṇāntatā na bhavati|
ayaṃ yogaḥ śakyo'vaktam| katham? khādeḥ--cakhāda, khideḥ--cikhedeti,
anekārthatvāddātūnāmarthabhedo'pyakiñcitkaraḥ ||

apaguro ṇamuli || 6|1|53 |||
yadi giratirgurerarthe vartate, tadāyaṃ yogaḥ śakyo'vaktam| katham
? gireḥ--apagāramapagāram, guroḥ--apagoramapagoram ||

prajane viyateḥ || 6|1|54 ||
yadi vātiraprajane'pi vartate, tadā yogo'yaṃ śakyo'kartum|
katham? vāteḥ--pravāpayati, vīyateḥ--pravāyayatīti|
vīyaterityayamapi yakā nirddaśaḥ smaryate, veterādādikatvena
śyano'sambhavāt| prayojanaṃ hi yakā nirddeśasya cintyam| janmana
upakrama iti| janerbhave ghaña, praśabda ādikarmaṇi| garbhagrahaṇamiti|
gṛhīto hi garbho jāyate, tato garbhagrahaṇaṃ janmana upakramaḥ|

bibheterhetubhaye || 6|1|55 ||
hetubhayamiti| ṭhpañcamī bhayena' iti samāsaḥ,
tadāha--hetorbhayamiti| kiṃ punastat? ityāha-sa yasya bhayasyeti| sa
cātvapakṣe na bhavatīti| ekadeśavikṛtasyānanyaṭvātprāpnoti, kuto
na bhavati? ityāha--lībhiyorīkārapraśleṣanirddesāditi|
ṭhlīlornuglukau' iti liyo nugvidhīyate, yaśca ṭhbhiyaḥ
ṣuk'--tāvubhāvapyākārāntayorna bhavataḥ, kutaḥ? līaii bhīaii iti
īkārapraśleṣeṇekārāntayorvidhānāt| lībhiyoḥ
praśleṣanirddeśāditi vārtike saha pāṭhādiha liyo grahaṇam ||

nityaṃ smayateḥ || 6|1|57 ||
dhātvarthasāmānyāditi| sāmānyamusādṛśyam, dhātvarthayoḥ sāmānyaṃ
dhātvarthasāmānyam, dvayorapi dhātvorartho citavikārasvabhāvau,
tena bhayaśabdena smayaterarthe'bhidhīyate, ṭhkrīṅjīnāṃ ṇau' ityatra
smayatirnoktaḥ, ṭhhetubhaye' ityupādhiṃ vakṣyāmīti ||

sṛjidṛśorjhalyamakiti || 6|1|58 ||
dhātoḥ svarūpagrahaṇe tatpratyaye kāryaṃ vijñāyata iti pratyaya iha
sannidhāpito jhalā viśeṣyata iti tadādividhirvijñāyata
ityāhajhalādāviti| akiti pratyaye parata iti| kiti parato na
bhavatītyarthaḥ| prasajyapratiṣedho hyayamiṣyate, etacca gāṅkuṭādisūtra
samyagupapāditam| laghūpadhaguṇāpavā do'yamiti| akitīti
vṛddhistu bhavati, na bādhyateḥ yena nāprāptyabhāvāt| sāpyami kṛte
bhavati| tasyaiva vyākhyā| pūrva tu bādhyata iti| amāgamena;
nityatvātasya| rajjusṛḍbhyām, devadṛgbhyāmiti| ubhayatra
vraścādisūtreṇa ṣatve jaśtvamiti kecit| anye tu ṭhkvinpratyayasya
kuḥ' iti kutvamitcchanti| nanu na kvinnantāvetau, kiṃ tarhi?
kvibantau? naiṣa doṣaḥ; yasmāddhātoḥ kvacitkvin vihitaḥ, tasya
pratyayāntare kutvaṃ bhavati, ṭhkvinaḥ ku' iti vaktavye
pratyayagrahaṇāditi vakṣyate| padāntasyetyadhikārāt sraṣṭā, draṣṭetyatra
na bhavati, kutvavidhāveva tasya nirṇayaṃ vakṣyāmaḥ ||

anudātasya cardupadhasyānyatarasyām || 6|1|59 ||
upadeśa iti vartata iti| anudātasya viśeṣaṇārtham, tena draptetyatra
tṛni vihite yadyapi nitsvareṇa dhātorudātatvaṃ bhavati, tathāpi
upadeśe'nudāta ityambhavati| varḍheatyatra tṛci kṛte yadyapi
śeṣanighātena dhāturanudāto bhavati, tathāpyupadeśe nāyamanudāta
ityamna bhavati| kimarthaṃ punaranudātasyetyucyate, nāniṭa
ityevocyeta, evaṃ hi sati laghu sūtraṃ bhavati? tatrāhatṛpa prīṇana
ityādi| iḍāgamo radhādibhyaścetyanena vikalpita iti| tataśca
pākṣikeṇeṭā seṭtvātayorna syāt| atha pākṣikeṇeḍabhāvena
tayorapi syāt, varḍhā, varḍhuamityatrāpi syāditi bhāvaḥ| yadi tarhi
tayoḥ ṭhradhādibhyaśca' itīṅvikalpyate, anudātopadeśaḥ punastayoḥ
kimarthaḥ? ityāha--anudātopadeśaḥ punaramartha eveti|

śīrṣaṃścchandasi || 6|1|60 ||
na punarayamādeśaḥ śiraḥśabdasyeti| yadyapi sūtre śirasa iti sthānī
nopātaḥ, tathāpi samānārthatvādādeśenākṣipyate, yathā-śivādiṣu
viśravaṇaravaṇaśabdābhyāṃ viśravaḥśabda ityādeśatvaśaṅkā| so'pi hi
cchandasi prayujyata iti| ādeśakṣapakṣe tu tena nivartitatvācchiraḥśabdo
na prayujyeteti bhāvaḥ| nanu ca ṭhanyatarasyām' ityanuvṛtestasyāpi
prayogo bhaviṣyati, satyam; utaratrāpi vikalpānuvṛttiḥ
śaṅkyeteti prakṛtyantarapakṣa evāśritaḥ ||

ye ca taddhite || 6|1|61 ||
cchandasi pūrveṇaiva siddhamiti| bhāṣārthamidam, yadi
pūrvasūtravadihāpi śīrṣanniti prakṛtyantaraṃ vijñāyeta tadā| yadā
śiraḥ śabdādyacakārādistaddhita utpadyate tadā tasya śravaṇaṃ prasajyeteti
matvā''ha--ādeśo'yamiṣyata iti| sa kathamiti| sa ādeśaḥ kathaṃ
labhyate, na kathañcit, sthānino'nupādānāt pūrvasūtravaditi
praśnaḥ| tannanimitamanurūpāṃ śabdataścārthataścāntaratamāṃ prakṛtiṃ
śiraśabdamevākṣipati| śirasyātīti| ṭhsupa ātmanaḥ kcan'|
vā keseṣviti| sūtreṇa ntye prāpte vikalpitaḥ| atra śirasyaśabdasya
keśaikaviṣayatvātatprayoge keśaśabdo na prayoktavyaḥ,
śīrṣaṇyaśabdastu sāmānyavācīti tatprayoge viśeṣāvagamāya
keśaśabdaḥ prayoktavyaḥ ||

aci śīrṣaḥ || 6|1|62 ||
śīrṣanbhāve hyanniti prakṛtibhāvaḥ syāditi| ato'kārāntamādeśāntaraṃ
vihitamiti bhāvaḥ|
kartavyo'tra yatna iti| tatrāyaṃ yatnaḥ--śīrṣannādeśasanni pātakṛtaḥ
ṣyaṅadeśastadvighātasya nimitaṃ na bhavatīti| aṇiñantādvā para iti|
ṭhaṇiñoranārṣayoḥ' ityādeśapakṣaprahāṇena pratyayapakṣa āśrayaṇīyaḥ,
ādeśapakṣa eva vā sthitvā yatnaḥ kartavya iti vāśabdārthaḥ || 

padannomāshṛnniśasanyūṣandoṣanyakañcchakannudannāsañcchasprabhṛtiṣu ||
6|1|63 || 
ihāpi ṭhśasprabhṛtiṣu' iti nimitopādānādanurūpāḥ prakṛtayaḥ
ākṣipyante, padādayaścādeśa vijñāyante ityāha--pādadante tyādi|
ante āsanaśabdaḥ paṭha|lte, āsyaśabdastu paṭhitavyaḥ, āsno vṛkasya
vartikāmabhīke, grīvāyāṃ baddho api kakṣa āsani, āsno
yatsīsamuñcataṃ vṛkasyetyādau hyāsyārtho'vagamyate| āsanīti|
ṭhvibhāṣā ṅiśyoḥ' ityillopābhāvapakṣe rūpam| aparake
punaraviśeṣaṇecchantīti| bhāṣye tu chāndasmevaitaditi sthitam|
prakārārthe prabhṛtiśabda iti| vyavasthāvācini tu śasaḥ pūrveṣu
vacaneṣu na syuḥ| doṣaṇīti| prathamādvivacane, doḥśabdasya
doṣannādeśaḥ, auṅḥ śībhāvaḥ| māṃsapacāyā ukhāyā iti| ṭhmāṃsasya
paci yuṭghañoḥ' ityantalopo vakṣyate, tadvyutpacyantaram|
nasyamiti| hitārthe bhavārthe vā ṭhśarīrāvayavādyat'| nasta iti|
ṭhapādāne sāhīyaruhoḥ' iti tasi| naḥ kṣudraḥ iti| ṭhtṛtīyā
tatkṛtārthena' iti samāsaḥ| ṭhsaptamī' iti yogavibhāgādityanye|
bahuvrīhau viśeṣaṇasya kṣudraśabdasya rājadantāditvātparanipāta
ityanye |
yati varṇanagarayorniti vaktavyamiti| tatarhi vaktavyam? na vaktavyam;
iha tāvannāsikyo varṇa iti, parimukādipāṭhād ñyaḥ, nāsikyaṃ
nagaramiti saṅkāśādipāṭhād ṇyaḥ,
ṭhrājanyasāṅkāśyakāmyilpanāsikyadārvāghāṭānāmā dirvānto vā'
iti pratipadasvaravidhānātsvare'pi nāsti viśeṣaḥ, pratyuta yatpratyaye
satyanāsikyamityatra ṭhyayatoścātadarthe' ityutarapadāntodātatvaṃ
prasajyeta, avyayapūrvapadakṛtīsvaraśceṣyate ||

dhātvāde ṣaḥ saḥ || 6|1|64 ||
siñcatīti| ṭhse mucādīnām' iti num|
ṣoḍanniti| ṣaḍ dantā yasyeti bahuvrīhau ṭhvayasi dantasya datṛ' ṭhṣa,
utvaṃ datṛdaśadhāsu' iti ṣaṣa utvamutarapadādeṣṭuatvaṃ ca, ṭhugidacām'
iti num, halṅyādisayogācantalogau| kvacitu ṣoḍa iti
paṭha|lte, tatu ,ṣoḍantamācaṣṭa iti ṇici kṛte ṭilope pacādyaci
rūpam| ṣaṭaśabdo'valyutpannaṃ prātipadikam| anukampitaḥ
ṣaḍaṅguliḥ ṣaḍikaḥ, ṭhbahvaco manuṣyanāmnaṣṭhajvā',
ṭhṭhājādāvūrdhvam' ityaṅgaliśabdasya lopaḥ| laṣatīti|
ṣakāropadeśastu pranilaṣatītyādau ṭhśeṣe vibhāṣā'khakādāvaṣānta
upadeśe' iti nerṇatvapratiṣedhārthaṃ syāt, leṣatuḥ leṣurityatra
ṭhādeśapratyayayoḥ' iti ṣatvārtham| kvacitu kaṣatītyapi paṭha|lte;
tadayuktam; ṣakāropadeśasāmarthyādevātra na bhaviṣyati;
pranikaṣatītyatrāpi kakhādāvityeva ṇatvapratiṣedhaḥ siddhaḥ;
ādeśāditvābha}yāsalopau ca na staḥ---cakaṣatuḥ, cakaṣuḥ| 
kimarthaṃ punaḥ ṣādayo dhātava upadiṣṭā;, na sādaya evopadiśyeran,
evaṃ hyaetatsūtraṃ na kartavyaṃ bhavati? tatrāha--ādośapratyayayorityādi|
vyavasthāniyamaḥ-- ādeśapratyayayoriti sahādīnāmeva ṣatvaṃ yathā
syāt, sṛpisṛjīprabhṛtīnāṃ mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ ṣādayaḥ
kecidupadiṣṭāḥ; anyathā sahādīnāṃ ṣatvārthaṃ yatnāntaramāstheyam,
tacca guru bhavatīti bhāvaḥ| ke punasta iti| pāṭhe bhraṃśasambhavātpraśanaḥ|
ye tathā paṭha|lnta iti| apramādena paṭhitavyamityarthaḥ| atha vā lakṣaṇaṃ
kriyata iti| mandadhiyo'nugrahītumiti bhāvaḥ| ajdantyaparāḥ sādaya
iti| ajdantyau parau yeṣāṃ te'jdantyaparāḥ, paraśabdo'vayavavācī|
taccājdantyayoḥ paratvamavayavāntarāpekṣaṃ vijñāyamānaṃ
sannidhānātsakārāpekṣaṃ vijñāyate| smiṅsviditi| ṭhṣmiṅīṣaddhasane',
ṭhñiṣvidā gātraprakṣaraṇe',ṭhṣvanja saṅge', ṭhviṣvap śaye'--ete
svarūpeṇaiva paṭha|lnte| vakāramakārayoranajdantyatvādvakāro'pi
kevaladantasthāno na bhavati| ṭhsvada āsvādane' iti| svadimapi
kecitpaṭhanti| sṛpisṛjītyādi| ṭhsṛprṛ gatau', ṭhsṛja
visarge',ṭhstṛñ ācchādane', ṭhsatyai ṣṭa|lè śabdasaṅghātayoḥ',
ṭhsekatirgatyarthaḥ', ṭhsṛ gatau'---etānvarjayitvā
ye'nye'jdantyaparāste ṣopadeśāḥ|
subdātvityādi| subdhātuḥ kyajādyantaḥ, ṭhṣṭivu nirasane',
ṭhṣvaṣkatirgatyarthaḥ' anudātet--eṣāṃ satvasya pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ| tatra
subdātūnāṃ tāvanna vaktavyaḥ, upadeśa iti vartate, na ca subdhātavaḥ
kvacidupadiśyante, evaṃ ca kṛtvā dhātugrahaṇaṃ śakyamakartum|
upadeśābhāvādeva ṣoḍāderna bhaviṣyati, tat kriyate dhātorityasya
nivṛttiṃ sūcayitum| tena ṭhlopo vyorvali' iti aviśeṣeṇa
bhavati, ṣṭhīvatiṣvaṣkatī dviṣakārakau, tatra pūrvasyāstu satvam,
pareṇa sannipātena ṣatvaṃ bhaviṣyatīti| yadyevam, liṭ ṣvaṣkate,
ṣatvasyāsiddhatvād ṭhḍaḥ si dhuṭ' iti dhuṭ prasajyeta ? evaṃ tarhi
yakārādī ṣṭhivuṣvaṣkatī, yakārastu ṭhlopo vyorvali' iti
lupyate| ṣṭhīvatīti| ṭhṣṭhivuklamucamāṃ śiti' iti dīrghatvam|
athāsya dvitīyo varṇo yadi ṭhakāraḥ, teṣṭhīyata iti na sidhyati; atha
thākaraḥ, ṭeṣṭhīyata iti na siddhyati; ubhayaṃ ceṣyate, tatrāha--ṣṭhīvata
ityasyetyādi| ubhayathā hyācāryeṇa śiṣyāḥ pāṭhitā iti bhāvaḥ ||

ṇo naḥ || 6|1|65 ||
aṇatīti| ṇopadeśastu niraṇatītyādau ṭhupasaragādasamāse'pi
ṇopadeśasya' iti ṇatvārthaṃ syāt| subdhātorayamapi neṣyata iti|
pūrvavadeva sarve nādaya iti prayoge| nṛtīnandītyādi| ṭhnṛtī
gātravikṣepe', ṭhṭuanadi samṛddhau', ṭhnarda gardda śabde', ṭhnakka nāśane',
ṭhnaṭa avasyandane' curādiḥ, ṭhnāthṛ nādhṛ yācñopatāpaiśvaryeṣu' ||

lopo vyorvali || 6|1|66 ||
dhātoriti prakṛtamityādi| etad ṭhdhātvādeḥ ṣaḥ saḥ' ityatra
vyākhyātam| didivāniti| diveḥ kvasau rūpam|
ṭhvasvekājādghasām' iti niyamādiḍabhāvaḥ| atra vaktavyamasti tad
ṭhvasvekājādghasām' ityatra vakṣyāmaḥ| ṭhūyī tantusantāne', ṭhknūyī
śabde'| āsremāṇamiti| ṭhsrivu gatiśoṣaṇayoḥ', auṇādiko manin,
nañā samāsaḥ|
nanu ca sataḥ kāryiṇaḥ kāryeṇa bhavitavyamiti pūrvaṃ kāryinirddeśo
yuktaḥ, paścātkāryanirddeśaḥ--ṭhvyorvali lopaḥ' iti, lāghavaṃ ca
bhavatyarddhamātrayā, tatkimarthaṃ pūrvaṃ lopagrahaṇaṃ kṛtam? ityata
āha--pūrvaṃ lopagrahaṇamityādi| pūrvaṃ lopagrahaṇenāyamarthaḥ
sūcyate--vidhyantarātpūrvamevāyaṃ lopo bhatīti,
kaṇkaḍūayateryalopaśca prāpnoti, verapṛktalopaśca,
tatrāntaraṅgatvātpūrvamapṛktalopena bhavitavyam| 
kaṇḍūayateḥ kvibiti| ṭhkaṇḍvādibhyo yak' ityatra
bhāṣyam--ṭhnaitebyaḥ kvib dṛśyate' iti, tasmātkaṇḍūamicchatīti
kyajantātkvib dṛṣṭavyaḥ| dvividhā hi kaṇkaḍvādayaḥ--dhātavaḥ,
prātipadikāni ca| tatra dhātubhyo yagvidhānātprātipadikebhyaḥ
kyajādayo bhavantyeva, tatra kyajantātkivapi kṛte--ato lopaśca
prāpnoti, verapṛktalopaśca, tatrāntaraṅgatvātpūrvamapṛktalopena
bhāvyam| athāpyārddhadhātuka iti viṣayasaptamyāśrayaṇātpūrvamato
lopaḥ, paścātkivap? evamapi kvilopaśca prāpnoti,
verapṛktalopaśca, tatrāntaraṅgatvātpūrvamapṛktalopaḥ stāt,
tasmiśca sati nimitābhāvādalāśraye
pratyayalakṣaṇābhāvātsthānivadbhāvābhāvācca vali lopo na syāt
pūrvalopagrahaṇācca bhavati| athātra lopasya sthānivadbāvāduvaṅ
karamānna bhavati ? ucyate; kyajantātkvibityuktam, tataḥ kim ?
sthānivadbhāvenāpi kaṇkaḍūamātrasya dhātutvābhāvāduvah na
bhavati| yaṇādeśastarhi prāpnoti ? astu yaṇ, tasyoṭha kariṣyate| na
coṭhayapi kartavye sthānivadbhāvaḥ, ādiṣṭadacaḥ pūrvatvādvakārasya,
ata eva kaṇkaḍuvāvityādāvūṇuvaṅadiṣu kartavyeṣu nāstyallopasya
sthānivadbhāvaḥ|
atha vraścakaḥ, vraścanamityādau rephe vali parato vakārasya lopaḥ
kasmānna bhavati? tatrāha--vraścādīnāmityādi| nanu vṛścati,
vavraścetyādau samprasāraṇe kṛte halādiśeṣe ca vakārasya śravaṇaṃ
yathā syādityetadupadeśasya prayojanaṃ syāt, na hyatra lopaḥ
pravartate, valparatvābhāvadityata āha--vṛścati
vavraścetyādāvapītyādi| bahiraṅgatvāditi| bahiraṅgatvaṃ
samprasāraṇasya kḍitpratyayopekṣatvāt, halādiśeṣasya
tvabhyāsāpekṣatvāt, tataścākṛtayoreva tayorvalopaḥ prāpta
upadeśasāmarthyādeva na bhavati|
atra bhāṣye valopaḥ pratyākhyātaḥ| āsremāṇam, jīradānurityatra
chāndaso varṇalopaḥ, kvasāvapi chāndasa eva, diviprabṛtīnāṃ
yaṅlugantānāṃ tasādiṣūṭhā bhavativyam,
tipsiporīḍabhāvapakṣeṣūṭhā bhavitavyam| ye tatra kṅitīti
nānuvartayanti-dediviti dedyoti, dedivīṣi dedyoṣi, mipi
tvanunāsikatvādeva bhavati, dedivīmi dedyomi; ye tvanuvartayanti
teṣāmapi chāndaso yaṅlugiti ||

verapṛktasya || 6|1|67 ||
kvibādayo gṛhyanta iti| tato'nyasya verapṛktasyābhāvāt|
ghṛtaspṛgiti| ṭhkvinpratyayasya kuḥ' apṛktagrahaṇādvakāramātrasyedaṃ
grahaṇam, ikāra uccāraṇāthaḥ ||

halṅyābbhyo dīrghatsutirayapṛktaṃ hal || 6|1|68 ||
dīrghagrahaṇaṃ sambhavavyabhicārābhyāṃ ṅbhāporeva viśeṣaṇam|
ṅyābgrahaṇaṃ ca soviśeṣaṇam| halapṛktagrahaṇaṃ ca tisyoḥ|
sutisīti trīṇi padāni| tadihetyādi| prakṛtasya lopaśabdasya
śāstrīyasya bhāvasādhanasya sutisīti prathamāntena sambandhābhavāditi
bhāvaḥ| apara āha-ilṅyābbhyaḥ' iti pañcamyā sutisītyādikāyāḥ
prathamāyāḥ ṣaṣṭha|laṃ prakalpitāyāṃ śāstrīye'pi lāpaśabde na doṣa iti|
abhino'treti| bhidarlaṅ isilopaḥ, ṭhdaśca' iti dakārasya rūtvam,
tasya ṭhato roraplutādaplute' ityutvam, śnamo'kāreṇa
ṭhādguṇaḥ', ṭheṅaḥ padāntādati' iti pūrvarūpam|
niṣkauśāmbirati| nanu ca pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣayā
tadādigrahaṇādevātra na bhaviṣyati, ihāpi tarhi na
syāt--paramakumārī, paramakhaṭveki? ṭhstrīpratyaye cānupasarjane na'
iti tadādiniyamābāvādbhaviṣyati| niṣkauśāmbirityādau
upasarjanatvādbhavatyeva tadādiniyamaḥ ? evaṃ tarhi
etajjñāpayati--arddhapippalītyādau ṭhekavibhakti ca' ityupasarjanatve
satyapi lopo bhavati| nātropasarjanaṃ piplalī;
ekavibhaktāvaṣaṣṭha|lntamiti vacanāt| ata eva ṭhgostriyoruparjanasya'
iti hrasvatvaṃ na bhavati| mā bhūcchāstrīyamupasarjanam, apradhānaṃ
tāvadbhavatyeva--bahvyaḥ śreyasyo'sya bahuśreyasīti?
śāstrīyamapyusarjanatvamasti, ṭhīyasaśca' iti kapaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ, ṭhīyaso
bahuvrīhau pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ' iti hrasvābhāvaḥ| apara
āha--ṭhniṣkauśāmbirityādau samudāyasya ṅyābantatve'pi yadatra
ṅyābantaṃ kauśāmbyādi, tataḥ parasya sorlopaḥ prāpnoti
dīrghagrahaṇādvyāvartate' iti| nanu ca vihitaviśeṣaṇaṃ
vijñāyate--ṅyābantādvihitasyeti? naivaṃ śakyam; yā, sā,
ketyādau na syāt, na hyatra ṭābantātsubvihitaḥ| mā bhūdevam,
halantādvihita ityevaṃ bhaviṣyiti| yadyevam, yaḥ, saḥ, ka ityatrāpi
syāt, kartā hartetyādau cana syāt, na hyatra halantāt tsurvihita
iti ? ato'nyasmādapi vihitasya halṅyābbhyo'nantasya lopa
ityāstheyam| evaṃ ca niṣkauśāmbyādāvapi lopaḥ prāpno
dīrghagrahaṇena vyāvartanīyaḥ| tipā sahacaritasyeti| tipā tiśabdena
sāhacaryātsahāpi tiṅ eva grahaṇamityarthaḥ|
atha kimarthamityādi| ṭhṅyāpordīrghātsuḥ' ityeva vaktavyamiti
codyārthaḥ| na lopo na syāditi| nanu ca ṭhna ṅasimbuddhayoḥ' iti
kajñāpakānnalope kartavye saṃyogāntaloparaḥ siddha eva bhaviṣyati? na;
pacannityādāvapi prasaṅgāt| nakārasaṃbuddhayorānantarte pratiṣedho
vijñāyamānastulyajātīye nakāravibhaktayorānantarya eva
saṃyogāntalopasya siddhatvaṃ jñāpayati| pacannityādau tu takāreṇa
vyavahitatvād jñāpakābhāvāllopābhāvaḥ?--ityāśaṅkya
doṣāntaramāha--ukhāsrat, parṇaghvaditi| datvamiti| na
syādityanuṣaṅgaḥ| ukhāsrasasu iti sthite
saṃyogāntalopamapavādatvādbādhitvā ṭhskoḥ saṃyogādyoḥ'
iti prakṛtisakārasya lope śrūyamāṇaḥ sakāro na vasvādisambandhīti
ṭhvasusraṃsu' iti datvaṃ na syāt| na ca saṃyogādilopaṃ bādhitvā
pūrvameva prakṛtisakārasya datvaṃ labhyate; apadāntatvāt| na hi sau
śrūyamāṇe pūrvasya padasaṃjñā'sti; ṭhasarvanāmasthāne' iti
pratiṣedhāt| athāpisāvapi padatvamiti pakṣāśrayeṇa syātpadatvam?
evamapi datvasyāsiddhatvātpūrvaṃsaṃyogādilopa eva syāt| nanu ca
vasvādīnāṃ datvaṃ sau dīrghatve siddhamiti vakṣyati tatra, sau
dīrghagrahaṇaṃ na kariṣyate vasvādīnāṃ datvamityeva, tataśca pūrvameva
datvaṃ bhaviṣyati? evamapi rājā, takṣetyādau sāvapi padatve sati
saṃyogāntalopasyāsiddhatvātpūrvaṃ nalope sati
asaṃyogāntatvātsorlopo na syāt| tasmātsuṣṭhūaktam--datvaṃ na
syāditi| utvamiti| na syādityanuṣaṅgaḥ| sa eva hetuḥ--
saṃyogāntalopasyāsiddhatvāditi| utvamiti| na syādityunuṣaṅgaḥ|
sa eva hetuḥ-- saṃyogāntalopasyāsiddhatvāditi| etacca
ṭhsaṃyogāntalopo rorutve siddho
vaktavyaḥ'---ityetadanāśrityoktam| tadāśrayaṇe tu--harivo
medinīmityādivatsiddham| rātsasyeti niyamāllopa eva na
syāditi| nanu ṭhrātsasya' iti dvitakārakanirddeśāktakārasyāpi
praśleṣādrephādutarasya ca takārasyāpi lopo vidhāsyate? yadyevam,
kīrtayateḥ kvipi ṭhkīḥ' iti syāt, yathānyāse tu kīrditi bhavati|
tadevaṃ sigrahaṇamekaṃ na kartavyam, anyatsarvaṃ kartavyamiti sthitam|
saṃyogāntasya lope hītyādi| saṃgrahaślokaḥ| hiśabdo hetau,
nalopādītyādiśabdena datvotvayorgahaṇam| ye tu
saṃyogāntalopavādinasteṣāṃ repādutarasya takārasya
abibharbhavānityatra naiva lopaḥ syāt, tasmāddhala utareṣāṃ sutisīnāṃ
lopo vidhīyate ||

eṅhrasvātsambuddheḥ || 6|1|69 || 
atra yadi halgrahaṇaṃ nānuvarteta, tata eṅhrasvābhyāṃ sambuddhireva
viśeṣaṇīyā--eṅntād hrasvāntācca parasyāḥ sambuddherlopa iti, tataśca
he kuṇḍetyatra na syāt| katham? kuṇḍāsu iti sthite lopaśca
prāpnotyambhāvaśca, tatra lopaḥ śabdāntaraprāptyā'nityāḥ, sa hi
kṛte'mbhāve ṭhādeḥ parasya' ityamo'kārasya prāpnoti, akṛte tu
sakārasya ambhāvastu lope kṛte'tyantāprāptyā'nityaḥ-
ityubhayoranityayoḥ paratvādambhāve kṛte'mi pūrvasya prāpnoti
lopaśca| tatrāmi pūrvatve kṛte vyapavargābhāvādubhayat
āśraṇaṇe'ntādivadbhāvābhāvācca lopo na prāpnoti, lope ca
kṛte'mo'bhāvādamipūrvatvaṃ na prāpnotītyubhayoranityayoḥ
paratvādami pūrvatve kṛte lopo na syāt, tasmādanuvartyaṃ
halgrahaṇam| tadāha-haliti ceti| ṭhvartate' ityapekṣate| apṛktamiti
nādhikriyata iti| yadyadhikriyeta, he kuṇkaḍetyatra na syāt;
apṛktasaṃjñāyā abhāvāt| kathaṃ punarjñāyate--nāyamadhikriyata iti?
tatrā''ha--tathā ceti| anuvartamāne'pi halgrahaṇe yadyeṅhrasvābhyāṃ
sambuddhirviśeṣyeta, tayā hal viśeṣyeta--eṅntād hrasvāntācca parā
yā sambuddhistasyā hallupyate iti, tataḥ he kuṇḍetyatra na syāt
pūrvoktādeva hetoḥ| ata eṅhrasvābhyāṃ sambuddhyā ca haleva
viśeṣaṇīya iti matvā''ha--eṅntātprātipadikādityādi|
sambuddhyākṣiptapratipadikameṅhrasvābhyāṃ viśeṣyata iti
tadantavidhilābhaḥ| atra pakṣe kuṇḍetyatrāmi pūrvatvasya pūrvaṃ
pratyantavadbhāvād hrasvāntātparo halbhavati| vastutaśca sambuddheriti
lopaḥ siddhayati|
acchabda iti| etacca tatraiva vyākhyāsyate| hrasvābhāvāditi| nanu
cādaḍevākāro hrasvaḥ, tataḥ paro hal bhavati, sambuddheśca sambandhīti
lopaḥ syādeva, sambuddhautu viśeṣyamāṇāyāṃ prakṛtyakārasya lope
hrasvātprā sambuddhirna bhavatīti lopāprasaṅgaḥ? ucyate;
ṭhsambuddhyākṣiptaṃ prātipadikameṅhrasvābhyāṃ viśeṣyate' ityuktam,
tena kuṇkaḍetyatra na bhaviṣyati; ekādeśasya pūrvaṃ
pratyantavadbhāvāt prakṛtigrahaṇena grahaṇāt| he kataradityatra ca na
bhaviṣyati; ṭilope kṛte prakṛterahrasvāntatvāt|
sambuddhiguṇabalīyastvāditi| anyathā agniasu iti sthite
sambuddhiguṇaśca prāpnoti, hrasvāditi lopaśca; tatra
nityātvātparatvācca sambuddhiguṇe kṛte'hrasvāntatvānna bhavet| nanu
ca vihitaviśeṣaṇaṃ vijñāsyate--hrasvāntādvihitā yā sambuddhiriti?
evamapi he khaṭvetyatra na syāt| mā bhūdanena, ābantatvātpūrveṇa
bhaviṣyati ? evamapi he khaṭvetyatra na syāt| mā bhūdanena,
ābantatvātpūrveṇa bhaviṣyati? evamapi he nadi, he yavāgu, he
kumārītyatra na syāt, na cātra ṅyantatvāllopo labhyate,
dīrghagrahaṇāt| evaṃ tarhyubhayaṃ vijñāsyate--vihitaviśeṣaṇam,
paraviśeṣaṇaṃ ca; tenāgne, kumārītyādau sarvatra bhaviṣyati? tatra
sakṛcch4%atasya hrasvagrahaṇasyobhayaviśeṣaṇatvameva tāvad durlabham|
athāpi labhyate? evamapi he kataradityatra yadyapi ṭilope kṛte
sambuddherhra svaparatvābhāvaḥ, tathāpi hrasvāntādvihitā sambuddhiriti
syādeva lopaḥ| tasmādeṅgrahaṇaṃ kartavyam|
vayaṃ tu brūmaḥ--ye svabhāvata eṅntāstadarthamapyeṅgrahaṇaṃ
kartavyamiti| tadyathāheśabdamatikrānto brāhmaṇo'tiheḥ, tasya
sambodhanaṃ he atihe; anukṛtaḥ pacateśabdo yena tasya sambodhanaṃ
he'nukṛtapacate; vihita īrepratyayo yena sa vihitereḥ pāṇiniḥ,
tasya sambodhanam--he vihitere ityādi| atra saṃgrahaślokaḥ---
sambuddhirhra svabhedyā yadi hi na ca bhavennādivannāntavatsyād,
doṣo'sau halnivṛtāvapi lupi bhavato'm pūrvarūpe paratvāt|
hrasvāntāllubvidhiḥ syāddhala iti kataraḍḍitvato no halo lup,
hrasvaśrutyā na śakyaḥ paravihitavidhirnātihe'to'pyakārye'ṅ ||
lopanaṃ lup, lopa ityarthaḥ ||

śeścchandasi bahulam || 6|1|70 ||
yā kṣetreti| śerlope kṛte pratyayalakṣaṇena ṭhnapuṃsakasya jhalacaḥ' iti
num, ṭhsarvanāmasthāne ca' iti dīrghaḥ, nalopaḥ|
ayaṃ yogaḥ sakyo'vaktum, katham? ḍādeśena siddhatvāt|
kathamagnetrīti? triai iti sthite prathamayoḥ pūrvasavarṇadīrghatvenaiva
siddham| na siddhyati, numā vyavahitatvāt? cchandasi napuṃsakasya
puṃvadbhāvo paktavyaḥ, madhorgṛhṇātītyevamādyarthaṃ puṃvadbhāvenaiva
numo nivṛttiḥ| evamapi ṭhjasi ca' iti guṇaḥ prāpnoti,
vakṣyatyetat--ṭhusādiṣu cchandasi vāvacanaṃ prāṅ ṇau caṅyupadhāyāḥ'
iti| api ca yā kṣetrā, tā tā piṇḍānāmiti tāi iti sthite ṭhsupāṃ
suluk' itīkārasyākāre kṛte ṭhprathamayoḥ pūrvasavarṇaḥ' iti
dīrghatvena siddham || 

hrasvasya piti kṛti tuk || 6|1|71 ||
kṛtā dhāturākṣipyate, sa ca hrasvena viśeṣyate, tena
tadantavidhirbhavatītyāha--hrasvāntasya dhātoriti| agnicit,
somasuditi| ṭhagnau ceḥ', ṭhsome suñaḥ' itika kvip|
grāmaṇikulamiti vyastaṃ cennapuṃsakahrasvatvam, ṣaṣṭhīsamāse tu ṭhiko
hrasvo'ṅyo gālavasya', ṭhsome suñaḥ' iti kvip|
yadi punarayaṃ tuṭ parādiḥ kriyate? canaivaṃ śakyam;
ihāgnicitsomasut, ṭhverapṛktasya' iti valopo na prāpnoti| iha
ca paritanotīti kvip, ṭhkvau ca gamādīnām' ityanunāsikalopaḥ,
ṭhnahivṛtti' ityādinā dīrghaḥ--parītat, tuṭa
ārddhadhātukabhaktatvādiṭprasaṅgaḥ| iha cāvacchayād ṭhvā'nyasya
saṃyogādeḥ' ityetvaṃ prasajyeta| athābhaktaḥ syād, madhucchādayatīti
ṭhtiṅṅatiṅaḥ' iti nighāto na prāpnoti; takāreṇa vyavadhānāt| na
ca takāra evātiṅ; apadatvāt| tasmātpūrvānta eva kartavyaḥ|
yadyevam, napuṃsakahrasvatvamupasarjanahrasvatvaṃ dvigusvaraśca na
siddhyati| napuṃsakahrasvatvam--ārāśaṣkulicchatram,
dhānāśaṣkulicchatram| upasarjanahrasvatvam--niṣkauśāmbicchatram;
dvigusvaraḥ--pañcāratnicchatram, tuki kṛte'nantyatvādete vidhayo na
prāpnuvanti ? na vā bahiraṅgalakṣaṇatvāt|
bahiraṅgastuk--cchakārasannipātāpekṣatvāt, antaraṅgā ete vidhayaḥ
prāgeva tatsannidhā nādbhaviṣyanti ||

saṃhitāyām || 6|1|72 ||
ṭhsaṃhitāyām' iti viṣayasaptamīyam| kāryinimitayoḥ saṃhitāyāṃ
viṣayabhūtāyāṃ vakṣyamāṇaṃ kāryaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ| vakṣyati---ṭhiko yaṇaci'
iti, antaraṃ tu vidhimatikrāmato'bhiprāyo mṛgyaḥ| dadhi atreti| nanu
ca ṭhikoyaṇaci' ityadhikaraṇasaptamyeṣā,
taccādhikaraṇamaupaśleṣikādanyadvarṇeṣu na sambhavati,
tatrācyupaśliṣṭasyeko vidhīyamāno yaṇvarṇāntaravyavāye
kālavyavāye ca na bhaviṣyatīti nārthaḥ saṃhitādhikāreṇa? jñāpanārthaṃ
tu, etajjñāpayati--ṭhkālavyavāyo nirddiṣṭaparibhāṣāyāṃ nāśrīyate'
iti| tenotarapadādikāre'pi vidhīyamānaṃ kāryamalugādi
kālavyavadhāne'pi bhavatyeva--ākhareṣṭha ityākhare sthaḥ, agnāviṣṇū
ityagnā viṣṇū ityādi ||

che ca || 6|1|73 ||
cchakārekāra uccāraṇārthaḥ, ṭhvidibhidicchideḥ',
ṭhśācchāeranyatarasyām' ityādirnirddeśāt| adhikāre dvau
pakṣau--artādhikāraḥ, śabdādhikāra iti| tatrādye pakṣe pūrvasūtre
kṛtākṣiptasya dhāterhrasvena viśeṣaṇātadantaṃ hrasvaśabdena
pratyāyitamiti ihāpi tadantasyaiva grahaṇaṃ syāt| śabdādhikāre tu
hrasvaśabda evātrānuvartate, na pūrvaḥ prakṛto'rthaḥ, na ceha
kiñcidviśeṣyamastīti tadantavidhyabhāvād hrasva evāgamī bhavati|
tatreha dvitīyaḥ pakṣa āśrita ityāha--hrasva evātrāgamīti| kimevaṃ sati
siddhaṃ bhavati? tatrāha--teneti| yadi tu hrasvāntasya tuk syāt,
tuko'bhyāsagrahaṇena grahaṇāddhalādiśeṣeṇa nivṛttiḥ syāt| hrasvamātre
tvāgamini nāyamabhyāsasyāvayavo haliti na bhavatyeṣa prasaṅgaḥ| kathaṃ
punarhrasva agamini gugabhyāsagrahaṇena na gṛhyata ityata
āha--nāvayavāvayava iti| itikaraṇo hetau|
yadyavayavāvayavassamudāyāvayavo na bhavati, evaṃ tarhi śerata ityatra
rūḍāgamaḥ sārvadhātukāvayavasyādādeśasyāvayava iti so'pi
sārvadhātukasya samudāyasyāvayavo na syāt| tatra ko doṣaḥ ?
ṭhśīṅḥ sārvadhātuke guṇaḥ' iti guṇo na syāt; ruṭā vyavadhānāt|
sa hyavayavabhaktastameva na vyavadadhyāt, sārvadhātukaṃ tu vyavadadhātyeva|
kutaścaiṣa nyāyaḥ--ṭhavayavāvayavaḥ samudāyāvayavo na bhavati' iti ?
loke tāvaddevadatāvayavasya
hastasyāvayavo'ṅgulirdeavadatasyāpyavayavo
bhavatyeva--sāṅgulirdeavadata iti| tasmādayamatrābhiprāyaḥ--ṭhccha
āhbhāṅeśca' ityeka eva yogaḥ kartavyaḥ, cakārādanantarasya
prākkṛtasya ca; evaṃ siddhe yadyogavibhāgaṃ cakāraṃ ca karoti,
tasyaitprayojanam--prakṛtasya tadantasya prahāṇena kevalaṃ
hrasvamevānuvartayiṣyāmiti| yadi tvāgamastuk samudāyasyāvayavaḥ
syād, eṣa yatno'narthakaḥ syāditi ||

āṅmāhośca || 6|1|74 ||
āṅbhāḍorṅidviśṣṭayorupādāne prayojanamāhaḥ--āṅe ṅti iti|
arthaviśeṣasampādanārthaṃ ṅidviśiṣṭayorupādānamityarthaḥ| ācchāyāyā
iti| ṭhāṅ maryādāvacane' iti karmapravacanīyasaṃjñā,
ṭhpañcamyapāṅparibhiḥ' iti pañcamī| ācchāyamiti| ṭhāṅ
maryādābhividhyoḥ' ityavyayībhāvaḥ| mācchidaditi| ṭhirito vā'
ityaṅ|
āchāyā, ācchāyeti| smaraṇe cātrākāraḥ, ṭhvākyasmaraṇayoraiṅt'|
prameti| pramūrvānmāṅḥ ṭhātaścopasarge' ityaṅ, atra
dhātorṅtve'ipi ṭābanto na ṅt, ṭhgāmādāgrihaṇeṣvaviśeṣaḥ' iti
lākṣaṇīkasyāpyasya grahaṇasya prasaṅgaḥ| atrobhayatrāpi ṭhpadāntādvā' iti
vikalpa eva bhavati ||

dīrghāt || 6|1|75 ||
ṭhabhayanirddeśe pañcamīnirddeśo balīyān', acaritārthā ca
pañcamī, tena dīrghāditi pañcamyā ccha ityasyāḥ saptamyāḥ ṣaṣṭha|laṃ
prakalpitāyāṃ cchakārasyaiva tukā bhavitavyamiti
bhrāntimapākāroti--dīrghātparo ya ityādi| anena pañcamyā anvayo
darśitaḥ, prakramābhedāya tu cchakārasya nimitatvam, dīghasya ca kāryitvaṃ
darśayati| tasminpūrvasya tasyaiva dīrghasyeti| atra ca
liṅgam--ṭhśācchā', ṭhvibhāṣāsenāsurācchāyā' ityādi nirddeśaḥ,
avadhyavadhimadbhāvasya vivakṣitatvādadhikaraṇabhāvasya ca vivakṣitatvāt
ṭhtasminpūrvasya' iti saptamī kṛtā| hrīcchatīti| ṭhhrīccha lajjāyām'|
mlecchatītiṣa| ṭhmleccha avyakte śabde'| apacācchāyata iti| ṭhchāe
chedane', yaṅ, ṭhdīrgho'kitaḥ'||

padāntādvā || 6|1|76 ||
prakṛtena dīrghaṇa padaviśeṣaṇādeva tadantavidhau
siddhe'ntagrahaṇampadāntavidhirayaṃ tug yathā syāt, padavidhirmā
bhūditi| tena samarthaparibhāṣānupasthānāt--tiṣṭhatu kumārīcchatraṃ
hara devadatasyetyatrāpi vikalpo bhavati || 

iko yaṇaci || 6|1|77 ||
iko yaṇādeśo bhavatīti| ikāṃ yaṇāṃ ca sāmyādyathāsaṃkhyaṃ bhavati,
āntaryato vā vyavasthā| ika iti kim? vyañjanasya mā bhūt--vāgratra|
kutvajaśtavayorasiddhatvācchakārasya yakāraḥ prāpnoti| yatra ca
kutvāderaprasaṅgo'padānte pacatīti, tatrāpi prasaṅgaḥ? naiṣa
doṣaḥ; ṭhdīrghāt' iti vartete, tacca tatraiva pañcamīnirddeśe'pi
sthānibūtamihāpi tathaivānuvartate| yadi dīrghasya yaṇ bhavati, kathaṃ
dadhyatra madhvatreti, ṭhhrasvasya' ityetadapyanuvartate, tadevaṃ
hrasvadīrghayoryaṇvidhānānna vyañjanasya prasaṅga ? plutasya ca
prakṛtibhāvena bhavitavyam, cayanam, cāyaka
ityādāvecāmayādayo'pavādāḥ, nāprāpte tasmiṃstadārambhāt ?
devendraḥ, khaṭvaudanamityādau guṇavṛddhī bādhike bhaviṣyataḥ,
yathā--satyapīggrahaṇe dadhīndrādau savarṇa dīrghatvam, ato nārtha
haggrahaṇena ? idaṃ tarhi prayojanam--iko yaṇevāci yathā syād,
yadyadanyatprāpnoti tanmā bhūditi| kiñcānyat prāpnoti ? śākalm|
na ca tasyāpyatyantabādhaḥ; ārambhasāmarthyāt| evaṃ sati
sinnityasamāsayoḥ śākalapratiṣedha iti yatpūrvācāryaiḥ smaryate
tadaneneggrahaṇena sampādyate|
ikaḥ plutapūrvasyeti| plutaḥ pūrvo yasmātsa tathoktaḥ,
plutātparasyetyarthaḥ| bho 3 i indreti| bho a i a indra iti sthite
bhośabdasya gītivaśāt plutaḥ, ikāraḥ svarādipāṭhānnipāta
pragṛhyasaṃjñakaḥ, tasya prakṛtibhāve prāpte yaṇvidhīyate,
savarṇadīrghabādhanārthamityetatvādyaprāptyabhiprāyeṇoktam|
plutapūrvasyeti| plutagrahaṇamapi
mātrikadvimātrikavyatiriktācparigrahārtham, tena caturmātrādāvapi
bhavati, tathā ca cchandogā gāyanti, sāmanyeva cāyamiṣyate, bhoyindraṃ
gāyatītyetadapi sāmagasyānukaraṇam| evaṃ tāvadbhāṣye sthitam,
vṛtāvapyevameva draṣṭavyam ||

vānto yi pratyaye || 6|1|78 ||
kasya punarayaṃ vāntādeśaḥ ? eca iti vartate| yadyevamedaitorapi
prāpnoti--ceyam, jeyam, raiyatīti? evaṃ tarhi vāntagrahaṇaṃ na
kariṣyate, ṭheco'yavāyāvaḥ' ityeva| ihāpe tarhyādeśaḥ
prāpnoti--ceyam, jeyamiti? ṭhkṣayyajayyau śakyārthe', rṭhkyyastadarthe'
ityetanniyamārthaṃ bhaviṣyati--ecau yadi bhavati kṣijyoreveti| evamapi
raiyatītyatrāyādeśaḥ prāpnoti? raiśabdaśchāndasaḥ,
ṭhdṛśṭānuvidhiścchandasi'| bhāṣāyāṃ tu raiśabdaprayogo
bhāṣyavirodhādasādhuḥ| yadvaivaṃ niyama āśrayiṣyate--anauṣṭhasya yadi
bhavati kṣijyoreveti; tataḥ ṭhśakyārthe' iti dvitīyo yogaḥ,
kṣijyorapi śakyārtha eveti ? sidhyati; sūtrasya tu ko nirvahaḥ ?
ucyate; vāntaśabdo'yaṃ sannihite vānte vartate, na yatra kutracit;
sannihitaścaudautsthānikaḥ pūrvatra, yathāsaṃkhyāsambandhāt| tatra yathā
yaḥ kaścana vāntādeśo na bhavati, tathānyasthāniko na bhaviṣyati;
viśiṣṭasyaiva sannidhānāt| tadidamuktam--yo'yamecaḥ sthāne iti|
bābhravya iti| ṭhmadhubabhravorbrāhmaṇakauśikayoḥ' iti yañ|
maṇkaḍuśabdo gargādi| śaṅkupicuśabdābhyām ṭhtadarthaṃ vikṛteḥ
prakṛtau' ityatrārthe ṭhugavādibhyo yat' | nāvā tāryaṃ nāvyam,
nauvayodharma' ityādinā yat|

adhvaparimāṇe ceti| bhāṣārthamidam| gavyūtiḥukrośayugam ||
dhātaustannimitasyaiva|| dhātoriti kimiti| na tāvadaviśeṣeṇa
niyamaprasaṅgaḥ--
yi pratyaye yadi bhavati tannimitasyaiveti; evaṃ hi ṭhvānto yi
pratyaye tannimitasya' iti viśiṣṭavidhirāśrayaṇīyaḥ, yogavibhāga
evakāro niyama iti sarvametadanarthakamāpadyeta| tasmādasatyapi
dhātugrahaṇe viśiṣṭaviṣayo niyamo bhaviṣyatīti praśnaḥ| sa tu
viśiṣṭo viṣayaḥ prātipadakamapi sambhāvyetetyutaram| vābhravya
ityatraiva syāditi| ecastannimitatvāt| atra na syāditi| viparyayāt|
upoyata iti| veñaḥkarmaṇi laṭa, ātmanepadam, yak,
yajñāditvātsaṃprasāraṇam, ṭhakṛtsārvadhātukayoḥ' iti dīrghaḥ,
ṭhādguṇaḥ', tasya paraṃ pratyādivadbhāvāddhātugrahaṇena grahaṇam|
oyate iti| karmaṇyeva laṅ| lauyamāniriti| ṭhata iñ' ādivṛddhiḥ|
nanu cātra guṇaḥ padadvayāpekṣatvādbahiraṅgaḥ, vṛddhirapi
bāhyataddhitāpekṣatvādbahiraṅgaiva ? satyam; auyatetyatraitadubhayaṃ
nāsti, tadarthamavaśyaṃ yoga ārabdhavyaḥ, ārabdhenaiva
siddhatvādupoyate ityādikaṃ pratyudāhṛtam|
evakārakaraṇaṃ kimiti| siddhe satyārambho niyamārthatve hetuḥ, na
tvevakārakaraṇamapīti praśnaḥ| iṣṭato'vadhāraṇārtha ityutaram || 

kṣayyajayyau śakyārthe || 6|1|81 ||
udāharaṇe śakyārthe kṛtyaḥ, pratyudāharaṇe tvāvaśyake ||

krayyastadarthe || 6|1|82 ||
krayya ityatra pratyayārthaśca karma vidyate, karmaṇi kṛtyavidhānāt
prakṛtyarthaśca dravyavinimayaḥ, tatra pratyayārthaḥ pradhānam,
prakṛtyarthastūpasarjanam, tatra yadi prādhānyātadityanena pratyayārthaḥ
parāmṛśyameva krayyaśabdasya tasminnarthe vṛternārthastadarthagrahaṇena| atha
so'rtho yasya tadarthaḥ śabdastasminnabhidheya ityarthaḥ ? tadapyayuktam;
śabdasya vṛtyasambhavāt| ato guṇībhūto'pi prakṛtyarthe eva nirddaśyata
iti darśayati--tadarthe krayārthaṃ yatasminnabhidheya iti| krayārthaṃ yaḥ
prasārita iti| kretāraḥ krīṇīyuriti buddhyā''ṇe
yadvyavasthāpitamit«athaḥ| kreyamiti| mūlyenopādeyamityarthaḥ|
na cehāsti krayyamiti| āpaṇe vikrayāya prasāritaṃ dhānyaṃ
nāstītyarthaḥ| kecitu krayyaśabde krīṇātirvikraye vartata ityāhuḥ|
tenāpaṇe vikrayāya prasāritaṃ dravyam ṭhkrayyam' ityucyate ||

bhayyapravayye cacchandasi || 6|1|83 ||
vītyetasyeti| ṭhvī gatyādiṣu', ṭhajervyaghañapoḥ' iti vā|
hradayyā iti| ākārasyāyādeśaḥ ||

ekaḥ pūrvaparayoḥ || vakṣyamāṇaprakaraṇe paurvāparyeṇāvasthitau
nirdiśyete--ādaci, ādecītyādi, tayoḥ pūrvaparayoḥ sthāne
vakṣayamāṇo guṇādirekādeśo bhavatīti sūtrārthaḥ |
atha pūrvaparayoriti kimartham? sthāninirddeśārtham, asati hi
tasmin ṭhādguṇaḥ' ityādau sthāninirddeśābhāvāt kakya
guṇādirādeśaḥ syāt| naitadasti prayojanam, adityādikā pañcamī
acītyādikāyāḥ saptamyāḥ ṣaṣṭhaāā prakalpayiṣyati, sā ca tasyāstena
tayoreva pūrvaparayorguṇo bhaviṣyatīti nārtha etena ?
tadāha--pūrvaparagrahaṇamityādi| dvayorādeśapratipatyarthamiti|
yugapadādeśapratipatyarthamityarthaḥ|| asati tu tasminkasya syāt?
ityata nobhe saptamīpañcamyāviki| nobhe prakalpike bhavataḥ, yugapanna
prakalpike bhavata ityarthaḥ| itikaraṇo hetau| tatra ṭhādguṇaḥ'
ityatrācītyeṣā saptamī yaṇādividhau caritārthā; ādityeṣā tu
pañcamī na kvaciccaritārthā, tataśca saiva saptamyāḥ ṣaṣṭhaāā
prakalpayiṣyati ityaca eva sthāne guṇaḥ syād| ṭhvṛddhireci' ityatra tu
guṇavidhau pañcamī kṛtārtheti tasyāḥ ṭheci' iti saptamyakṛtārthā
ṣaṣṭhaāā prakalpayedityavarṇasyaiva vṛddhiḥ syāt| ṭhupasargādṛti dhātau'
ityādau dvayorapyakṛtārthatve'pi paryāyeṇa parasparaṣaṣṭhīprakalṛptiḥ
syāt, na yugapatkāryitvaṃ nimitatvaṃ ca; dvayoryugapadvirodhāt,
tataśca kāryamapi paryāyeṇa syāt| tasmātpūrvaparayoriti vaktavyam
? na vaktavyam; ekagrahaṇasāmarthyād| ṭhantādivacca' iti vacanācca
pūrvaparayordvayorevādeśo bhavaṣyati, nānyatarasya ? satyam;
sukhapratipatyarthaṃ tu pūrvaparayorityuktam; anyathā yugapat
ṣaṣṭhīprakalpanadvāreṇa vivakṣitapratipatau pratipatigauravaṃ syāt |
atha kimarthamekagrahaṇam, prathamanirdiṣṭamatikramya caramanirdiṣṭasya
ṭhpūrvaparayoḥ' ityasya prāk prayojanamuktam; pāṭhakramādarthakamasya
balīyastvāt| katham ? sataḥ kāryiṇaḥ kāryeṇa bhavitavyam, kāryasya ca
guṇāderviśeṣaṇamekagraṃhaṇam| nanu ca ṭhādguṇaḥ'
ityādāvekasyaivādeśasya sūtre upādānam, saṃkhyāyā
vivakṣitatvādupātasaṃkhyātyāge kāraṇābhāvāt, tataścaika eva
guṇādirādeśo bhaviṣyati| syādetat--ādeśasya vidheyatayā
prādhānyāt pradhāne ca grahaṃ sammārṣṭītyādau saṃkhyāyā
avivakṣitatvādanekādeśaprasaṅga iti ? tadasataḥ grahaṃ śeṣitayoddiśca
sammārgo hi vidhīyate, śāstrāntare ca vihitaṃ śeṣetvamupagacchati,
śāstrāntaro ca vijñātā grahāḥ saṃkhyāntarānvitāḥ,
tatraikatvavivakṣāyāṃ vākyabhedaḥ prasajyeteti kṛtvā
grahaikatvamavivakṣitamucyate| naivaṃ guṇādirādeśa ityekatvaṃ
vivakṣitam; ṭhprājāpatyā nava grahāḥ' iti
śāstrāntaravihitanavagrahoddeśena saṃskāraḥ sammārgo vidhīyate, tatra
śrutamapyekatvaṃ noddeśyakoṭau niveśayituṃ śakyate; tatra
saṃkhyāntarānvitatayā vihitatvāt| tataśca tadvivakṣāyāṃ tadapi
vidheyaṃ syāt, tataśca vākyabhedaprasaṅgaḥ| vacanavyaktibhedādyo
grahastaṃ sammāṣṭi, taṃ caikamiti| iha tu vidheyatayā guṇādeḥ
prādhānye'pi viśiṣṭavidhisambhavād na vākyabedaprasaṅgaḥ,
avivakṣākāraṇābhāvādviyakṣitamekatvaṃ lokavat,
tadyathā--loke'nayormṛtpiṇkaḍayorghaṭṃa kurviti, na cocyate
ekamiti ekameva cāsau karoti| na cārthaprakaraṇādinā tatraikasya
karaṇam, tadabhāve'pi darśanātasmānnārtha ekagrahaṇena? tatrāha--ekagrahaṃ
pṛthagādeśanivṛtyarthamiti| yathā punaḥ pṛthagādeśaprasaṅgastathā
darśayati--sthānibhedāditi| ṭhpūrvaparayoḥ' iti
nirddeśātsthānibhedaḥ pratīyate, tataśca tadvaśādādeśe'pi
śrutamapyekatvamavivakṣitaṃ syādityanekādeśaprasaṅga ityarthaḥ| avaśyaṃ
caitadevamabhyupagantavyamiti dṛṣṭāntena darśayati| bhinnādiṣu
natvavaditi| yathā ṭhradābhyāṃ niṣṭhāto naḥ pūrvasya ca daḥ' iti
natvamekatvāvivakṣayā pratisthāni bhavati, tadvadatrāpītyarthaḥ|
bhāṣye tvekagrahaṇaṃ pratyākhyātm| na tāvad guṇabhūtasthānyanurodhena
pradhānasyādeśasya bhedakalpanā yuktā, pradhānānurodhī hī guṇo
bhavati,na punarguṇānurodhī pradānam| yaccoktam--bhinnādiṣu
nanvavaditi, tatra na khalu natvavidhāvekatvasyāvivakṣitatayā dvau
nakārau bhavataḥ, kiṃ tarhi? pūrvasya ceti
cakārādvākyabhedo'vagamyate| tatra pūrveṇa niṣṭhāto natvam, pareṇa
dhātudakārasya, iha ca ṭhubhausābhyāsasya' iti
prāṇiṇiṣatītyupasargādanantarasya nakārasya ṭhaniteḥ' ityeva ṇātve
siddhe sābhyāsasyeteyetāvataiva dvayornakārayormatvaṃ siddhamiti
sthāninirddeśārthamubhaugrahaṇaṃ na kartavyam--ubhau nakārau
ṇatvamāpadyate iti| tasmādādeśārthamubhaugrahaṇaṃ
vijñāyate--sābyāsasyāniterthau nakārau dvau tayorubhau ṇau bhavata
iti| tenātrāpi naikatvasyāvivakṣitatvād dvayodvāê bhavataḥ,
kintūbhaugrahaṇāditi na kaściddoṣaḥ|
iha śrutismṛtivihitaṃ karma kiñcitsakṛdanuṣṭhīyate,
yathā--upanayanam, ādhānam, ācamanamiti; na hyupanītaḥ
punarupanīyate, nāpyagnyāhitaḥ punaragnīnādhate, nāpyācāntaḥ
punarācāmati| asati nimite, kiñcidasakṛdyathā--jyotiṣṭo mādayaḥ|
yathā--ṭhpūrvavayā brāhmaṇaḥ pratyuttheyaḥ' iti yo yo vṛddhavayāstasya
tasyāgamanaṃ pratyutthīyate| ṭhbrāhmaṇo na hantavyaḥ', ṭhsurā na peyā' iti
prativyaktiviṣedho'nuṣṭhīyate, na punarekaṃ brāhmaṇamahatvaikāṃ ca
surāmapītvānyatra kāmacāraḥ| vyākaraṇaṃ ca smṛtiḥ, tadiha
ṭhādguṇaḥ' ityanayā smṛtyā ṭhguṇaḥ kartavyaḥ' iti codite yadi
sakṛdanuṣṭhānaṃ khaṭvendra ityekasyāṃ vyaktau guṇe kṛte kṛtaḥ
śāstrārtha iti kṛtvā mālendra ityādiṣu na kriyeta,
tasmātpratyutthānādivadāvartate| kiṃ punaratra
nibhandhanam--kiñcitsakṛtkriyate, kiñcitpunaḥ punariti? upanayanaṃ
tāvanmāṇavakasya saṃskāraḥ, sakṛccāsau saṃskṛto'dhyayanādiṣu
yogyo bhavati, ādhānamapyagnisaṃskārārtham, sampanneṣvagniṣu
prayojanābāvātpunarna kriyate, ācamanamapi śaucārthamitya sati
nimite punarna kriyate| jyotiṣṭomādayastu
nityāścetpratyavāyaparihārāya vasante kriyante; atha kāmyāḥ
ṭhamuṣmin loka enamapsaraso jāyā bhūtvopaśerate iti
tatastamabhyudayam', bhūyobhūyaḥ parīpsubhiḥ punaḥ punaranuṣṭhīyante|
pūrvavayobrāhmaṇapratyutthānākaraṇe doṣaḥ, karaṇe cābyudayo
darśitaḥ--
ṭhūrdhva prāṇā hyutkāmanti yūnaḥ sthāvira āyati|
pratyutthānābhivādābhyāṃ punastān pratipadyate'|| iti|
tacca pratyāgamanamaviśiṣṭam, ato doṣanirhāṇātha punaḥ
punaranuṣṭhīyante| naimitikatvādvā pratinimitamāvṛttiḥ| tathā
brāhmaṇavadhe ca surāpāne ca do, uktaḥ| sa brāhmaṇamātre surāmātre ca
bhavati, tato doṣavanto mā bhūmeti sarvatraivānuṣṭhīyate| iha
śabdasya jñāne prayoge cābhyudayo daśitaḥ--ṭhekaḥ śabda samyag jñātaḥ
suprayuktaḥ svarge loke kāmadhug bhavati' iti| pratyavāyaśca yājñe
karmaṇyapaśabduprayoge darśitaḥ--ṭhte'surā helayaḥ' iti,
ṭhāhitāgnirapaśabdaṃ prayujya' iti ca| ata eva tadapi guṇādika
punaḥpunaranuṣṭhīyate| tadevaṃ nityatvaṃ naimitikatvaṃ kāmyatvaṃ
bhūyobūyo'nuṣṭhānanibandhanam| etacca sarvaśāstrasādhāraṇamapi
vātikakāreṇa proktaṃ bhāṣyakāreṇopapāditamityasmābhirapyatraiva
pratyapādi ||

antādivacca || 6|1|85 || 
antādiśabdayoravayavaviśeṣavācitvādavayaviśeṣāpekṣāyāṃ
pavaparayorityanuvṛtestasya ca
vakṣyamāṇaguṇādyādeśaviśeṣaṇatvādekādesa iti labhyate,
tadidamuktam--ekaḥ pūrvaparayoriti vartata ityādi| kaḥ
punaratrātideśārthaḥ, kiṃ yāvekādeśasya sthāninau pūrvaparau
tayorantādivadbhavati? kiṃ vā--akṛta ekādeśe
tamevaikādeśamapekṣya yau pūrvaparau samudāyau
tayorantādivadbhavatīti ? yadi vā--ekādeśasya sthāninau
pūrvaparau varṇai, tayoḥ samudāyayorantādī,
yatorekādeśo'pyantādivadbhavatīti ? tatrādyapakṣastāvanna sambhavati,
ekādeśena pūparayostatsthāninornivartitatvāt! kathamasatoḥ pūrva
parayorantādivatsyāt! dvitīye pakṣe vṛkṣāvityatra vṛkṣāau iti
sthite subasuporekādeśaḥ subapekṣasya
kasyacitparasyābhāvātparādivanna syāt ? 
ataḥ tṛtīyaḥ pakṣa aśrīyate| nanvayamapi pakṣo na sambhavatyeva| tathā
hi--brahmabandhūrityatra brahmabandhuauu iti sthite pūrvo varṇa ukāro
yasyānto brahmabandhuśabdasya sa ekādeśe nāstyeva, ukārasya
nivartitatvāt; yaścāsti dhakārānto na tasyānta ekādeśasya sthānī
ukāraḥ, anārambhakatvāt? evaṃ tarhi yadvyapadeśayuktasya sthāninau
pūrvaparāvantādī tadvyapadeśayuktasyaikādeśo'pyantādivadityarthaḥ|
edaduktaṃ bhavati--ekādeśātprāk pūrvaparayoḥ
pṛthagavasthitayostābhyāṃ saha yo vyapadeśaḥ
pūrvaparasamudāyaviṣayo dṛṣṭaḥ--prātipadikamiti vā, subantamiti
vā, sa vyapadeśa ekādeśe kṛte'pi bhavatīti| tadidamuktam--yathā
tasyānta ādirvā tadantarbhūta ityādi| tasyetyanena
ekādeśātprāgavasthitaḥ pūrvaḥ paraśca samudāyo nirddiśyate,
antādiśabdābhāyāṃ ca ekādeśasya sthāninau pūrvaparau| tadgrahaṇīna
gṛhyata ityanenāpi ṭhetaduktaṃ bhavati' ityārambhāyantaraṃ ca ekādeśasya
sthāninau pūrvaparau| tadgrahaṇena gṛhyata ityanenāpi ṭhetaduktaṃ
bhavati' ityārabhyānantaraṃ yaduktamasmābhistaddarśitam| eṣo'tideśārtha
iti| atidiśyata ityatideśaḥ, atideśaścāsāvarthaścetyatidesārthaḥ
karmadhārayo'yamartho'trātidiśyata ityarthaḥ|
varṇāśrayavidāvityādi| varṇasvarūpamāśritya yadvidhīyate na
tadantādivadbhāvenātidiśyata ityarthaḥ| tatkatham? nātra
tādrūpyanibandhanaṃ kāryamatidiśyate, yo'yamānta ādirvā
prāgekādeśādavasthitaḥ pūrvaḥ paraśca tadvadayamekādeśo bhavati|
tatprayuktaṃ kāryaṃ labhata iti| evaṃ ca tadvaccetyeva vaktvya stāt,
tacchabdena pūrvāparau parāmṛśyate| evaṃ hi siddhe'ntādivaditi
vacanādantāditvaprayuktaṃ kāryamekādeśasya bhavatu,
pūrvaparasvarūpaprayuktaṃ tu kāryaṃ kena bhavet ! liṅgaṃ cātra bhavati
tukyasiddhavacanam; anyathā adhītyetyādāvekādeśasyādivadbhāvādeva
tukaḥ siddhatvādanarthakaṃ tatsyāt| khaṭvābhiriti| taparakaraṇaṃ tu
yatraikādeśo nāsti tadarthaṃ syāt--śubhaṃyābhiriti| juhāveti|
ṭhabhyastasya ca' iti hvayateḥ samprasāraṇe kṛte juhuāa iti
yatpūrvarūpatvamākārasya tannādivadbhāvati, yo'yamādirākārastadvanna
bhavati, tena ṭhāta au ṇalaḥ' iti na bhavati| asyai aśva iti| syāṭo
vibhaktyekārasya yo'yaṃ ṭhvṛddhireci' iti vṛddhirekādeśaḥ sa
parasyādivanna bhavati, tena ṭheṅaḥ padāntādati' iti na bhavati| yatra ca
yugapadubhayamāśrīyate--antaścādiśca, tatrāpyantādivadbhāvo na
bhavati, yathā ṭheteliṅ' īti hrasvatvamupasargātparasyeṇo
vidhīyamānam-abhīyātparīyādityādau na bhavati| yadi hyayamekādeśaḥ
pūrvaṃ pratyantavad buddhyā gṛhyaeta, sa tadānīmeva kathaṃ paraṃ
pratyādivatsyāt! evaṃ paraṃ pratyādivatve tadānīmeva pūrvaṃ
pratyantavadbāvo'pyanupapannaḥ; ekasyobhayāpekṣayā
yugapatpāratantryasya virodhāt |
pūrvāpareti| yo yena nivartyate sa tasya stānī,
yathā--bhuvo'stiḥ| samudāyaścātra nivartyate, tataśca tatprayuktameva
kārthaṃ sthānivadbāvātsyād yadi kiñcidasti, na tu pratyekaṃ
pūrvaparayuktm| syādetad--avayayorapi
nivartyamānatvātayorapi sthānitvam? ityata āha--tatreti|
itikaraṇadvayamapi hetau| tatra samudāye
sthāninyavayavayoryatsthānitvaṃ
tadānumānikamavayavanivṛttimantareṇāvayavino
nivartayitumaśakyatvādavayavayornivṛttiḥ, na tvādiṣṭatvādityarthaḥ|
tataśca tadāśrayaṃ kāryaṃ sthānivadbhāvānna prāpnoti; sākṣācch4%atasyaiva
ca sthāninastatrāśrayaṇāt| iṣyate ca tadarthamantādivadbhāvo
vidhīyate| nanu viparītamidam--avayavayorānumānikaṃ
sthānitvamiti ? ṭhpūrvaparayoḥ' iti dvirvacananirddeśāt tayoreva
sthānitvaṃ śrutaṃ na samudāyasya śabdo'sti, dvayostu
nivartamānayorarthātsamudāyo nivartata ityetāvat| tathā ca
pūrvasūtre ṭhsthānibedādbhinnādiṣu natvavat' ityuktam|
taccānyatrāpi uktam--yo hyubhayasthāne bhavati labhate
so'nyataravyapadeśam, tena khaṭvarśya ityatra pararatvaṃ
bhavatyṛkārasyāpi sthānivadbhāvaḥ, kathama? ṭhsthānivadādeśaḥ' ityatra
sthāniśabdasya sambandhiśabdatvādevādeśaparigrahe siddhe
ādeśagrahaṇamānumānikasyāpyādeśasya sthānivadbhāvārtham, tataśca
sthānyapyānumānika āśritaḥ, yathā ṭheruḥ' pacatvityatra | atra hi
ikāreṇekārāntaḥ stānyanumīyate, ukāreṇāpyukārānta ādeśaḥ,
tasya sthānivadbhāvāt ṭhtiṅntaṃ padam' iti padasaṃjñā bhavati|
evamapyatrāvayavayorānumānike sthānitve siddhaḥ sthānivadbhāvaḥ ?
evaṃ tarhyanalvidhau sthānivadbāva uktaḥ alvidhyarthamidam,
yathā--kṣīrapeṇa,
surāpeṇotarapadavibhaktyorekādeśasyāntavadbhāvāt
ṭhekājutarapade ṇaḥ' iti ṇatvamalvidhirapi bhavati| nanu ca ṭhanalvidhau'
iti pratiṣedhaḥ sthānyalāśrayeṣveva kāryeṣu, asaya
tvekādeśasyotarapadaṃ pratyavayavatvameva sthānivatvena prārthanīyam;
actvaṃ tu svata eva siddam, tataśca yathā--aruditāmityatra svāśrayaṃ
valāditvaṃ sthānivadbāvakṛtaṃ ca sārvadātukatvamāśritya
ṭhrudādibhyaḥ sārvadhātuke'itīṅ bhavati, tadvadihāpi
sthānivaddhāvakṛtamutarapadāvalayavatvaṃ svāśrayaṃ cāctvamāśritya ṇatvaṃ
bhavati| tatu sthānyalkharūpanibandhanam, tatreṣyata eva, yathā
khaṭvābhirityādāvaisbhāvādi| tasmāt cintyabhasya prayojanam ||

ṣatvatukorasiddhaḥ || 6|1|86 ||
ṣatve tuki ceti| ṣatvaśāstre, tukśāstre cetyarthaḥ| ekādeśa iti|
ekādeśaśāstram ṭhādguṇaḥ' ityādītyarthaḥ| asiddho bhavatīti|
siddhaḥuniṣpannaḥ, tato'nyo'siddhaḥ| tatra śāstrasvarūpaṃ tāvanniṣpannamiti
paratra paraśabdaprayogādivārtho'vagamyate, tatkāryakaraṇācca
sādṛśyam, tadāha--siddhakāryāṇi na karotītyartha iti|
ṣatvatukśāstrasannidhāvekādeśaśāstraṃ svakāryamekādeśākhyaṃ kāryaṃ na
karotiuna pravartayati, na pratipādayatītyarthaḥ| sūtrasya
prayojanamāhṛ--asiddhavacanamiti| ādeśe kṛte yatkāryaṃ taddhetukaṃ
prāpnoti tadādeśalakṣaṇam, ādeso lakṣaṇaṃ nimitamasyeti kṛtvā;
tasya pratiṣedhārthamasiddhavacanam| utsargaḥusthānī,
sāmānyotsṛṣṭatvāt sa lakṣaṇaṃ yasya tadutsargalakṣaṇam, tasya bhāvaḥ
pravṛttiryathā syādityevamarthaṃ cāsiddhavacanam| ko'sicaditi|
ṭhlipisicihvaśca' iti cleraṅ, kaśabdātsorutvam, ṭhato
roraplutādalute' ityutvam, guṇaḥ| eṅaḥ padāntādatīti|
parampratyādivadbhāvāditi| ādivadbhāve hi osicadityetadantaṃ
padam, tataḥ sakāraḥ padādirna bhavatīti ṭhsātpadādyoḥ' iti
niṣedhābhāvādekādeśamokāramiṇamāśritya ṣatvaṃ prāpnoti,
tadasiddhatvānna bhavati| asiddhatve hi ṣatvaśāstraṃ
pratyekādeśaśāstrasyāpratipādakatvāt ko asicadityevamavasthitaṃ
padarūpaṃ bhavati, tatrākāreṇa vyavadhānātṣatvābhāvaḥ| ko'syeti| idamaḥ
ṣaṣṭa|lekavacanam, tyadādyatvam, ṭhṭāṅasiṅasāminātsyāḥ' iti
syādeśaḥ, hali lopaḥ, śeṣaṃ pūrvavat|
evamādeśalakṣaṇapratiṣedhasyodāharaṇāni darśitāni|
itarasya darśayati--adhītya, pretyeti| ekādeśasyāsiddhatvādityādi|
asiddhatve hitukśāstrasannidhāvadhi a i a iyetyeva sthitaṃ padarūpaṃ
bhavati, tataśca hrasvāśrayastuk pravartate| yadi tu
mukhyasyaikādeśasyaiva kāryasyāsiddhatvamucyate, tadā ṣatve nāsti
doṣaḥ, katham? okārastāvatsvakāryaṃ ṣatvaṃ na karoti, yau tu tataḥ
pūrvau kakārayakārau tadāśrayamapi ṣatvaṃ na bhavati, tenaivaukāreṇa
vyavadhānāt| tuki neṣṭasiddhiḥ| katham ? ekādeśena hrasvasya
nivatitatvāt, na caikādeśaḥ svakāryaṃ na karoti| anena sthāninaḥ
pratyāvṛttiḥ śakyā, tasmātiḥ śakyā, tasmātuki
śāstrāsiddhatvāmevāśrayaṇīyam| āha ca--sthānivadvacanānarthakyaṃ ca
śāstrāsiddhatvāditi|

samprasāraṇaṅīṭsviti| samprasāraṇe ṅai iṭi ca ya
ekādeśastasyāsiddhatvapratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ| śakahūṣviti| śakān
hvayatīti yajñāditvātsamprasāraṇaṃ pūrvatvam, kvip, ṭhhalaḥ' iti
dīrghaḥ| parivīṣviti| vyeñaḥ paripūrvāt kvibādi pūrvavat|
asiddhatvātṣatvaṃ na prāpnotīti| pūrvarūpasyāsiddhatve hi śakahuāa
ityevamavasthitaṃ padarūpaṃ bhavati| vṛkṣecchatramiti, apacecchatramiti|
pacerlaṅ, utamaikavacanamiṭ śap| ādguṇasyāsiddhatvāditi|
asiddhatve hi tasya vṛkṣa i cchatram, apaca i cchatramityevamavasthitaṃ
padarūpaṃ bhavati| atra samprasāraṇe tāvatpratiṣedho na vaktvyaḥ,
ekādeśo'siddha ityucyate, na cātraikādeśaṃ paśyāmaḥ; dīrgheṇa
nivartitatvāt| na cadīrghasya sthānivadbhāvādekādeśagrahaṇena
grahaṇam; alvidhitvāt| ṅṭostu pritiṣedho vaktavya eva|
atha vā--lāghavārthaṃ padasyeti vaktavyam| antādigrahaṇaṃ ca
pūrvasūtrādanuvartanīyam, tena padāntasya padādeśca ya ekādeśaḥ
so'siddha ityeṣo'rtho bhavati| yadyevam, supippalā
oṣadhīskṛdhītyatrauṣadhiśabdād dvitoyābahuvacanam,
ṭhauṣadheścavibhaktāvaprathamāyām' iti dīrghaḥ, tataḥ prathamayoḥ
pūrvasavarṇadīrghaḥ, rutvavisarjanīyau| atraidānīm
ṭhkaḥkaratkaratikṛti' iti visarjanāyasya satvamiṣyate, tanna
prāpnoti;ṭhpadāntapadādyoḥ' iti vacanāt|
ekādeśasyāsiddhatvābhāvād iṇa utaro visarjanīya iti ṭhiṇaḥ ṣaḥ' iti
ṣatvaṃ prāpnoti, aviśeṣeṇāsiddhatve oṣadhī a as
kṛdhītyevamavasthānādiṇa utaratvābhāvātṣatvāprasaṅgātsatvaṃ sidhyati
? jñāpakātsiddham; yadayaṃ kaskādiṣu bhrātuṣputraśabdaṃ paṭhati,
tajjñāpayati--naikādeśātparasya visarjanīyasya ṣatvaṃ bhavatīti| yadi
syād, bhrātṛśabdānṅasi ṭhṛta ud' ityutve ekādeśe rapare ca
kṛte ṭhrātsasya' iti sakāralope kṛte ṣaṣṭhīsamāse ṭhṛto
vidyāyonisambandhebhyaḥ' ityaluki rephasya visarjanīye ṭhṛta ud'
ityukārasyaikādeśasya siddhatvāt ṭhidudupadhasya ca' ityeva ṣatve
siddhe kaskādiṣu tanna paṭhet, paṭhati ca, tato
jñāyate--naikādeśātparasya ṣatvamiti| śakahūṣvityatrāpi tarhi na
prāpnoti ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; tulyajātīyasya jñāpakaṃ bhavati| kaśca
tulyajātīyaḥ ? yaḥ kupvoranantaraḥ| iha caṭa veñaḥ kvipi
samprasāraṇe pūrvatve ca ṭhhrasvasya piti kṛti' iti tuki prāpte
pūrvatvasya sūtreṇāsiddhatve prāpte ṭhpadāntapadādyoḥ' iti
vacanādasiddhatvābhāvāduditi tugbhavatyeva| na hi uāa
ityekādeśātprāgavastāyāmākāraḥ padāntaḥ| nāpyakāraḥ padādiḥ;
vibhakterabhāvāt| na caikādeśātprāgeva kṛdantatvādvibhaktayutpattiḥ;
ekādeśasyāntaraṅgatvāt| athāpi prāgeva vibhaktyutpattiḥ; evamapi
uāasu iti sthite ukāraḥ padādiḥ sakāraḥ padāntaḥ, subantaṃ hi
padam, na tu tataḥ pūrvam| athāpi bhyāmprabhṛtau uāabhyamiti sthite
ṭhsvādiṣu'iti padasaṃjñāyāṃ padāntapadādyorekādeśaḥ ? tathāpi na
dosaḥ; ṭhpūrvaparayoḥ' iti vartate, antādigrahaṇañca; tatra
yathāsaṃkyasambandhātpūrvapadasya yo'ntaḥ parasya
cādistayorekādeśo'siddha ityarthaḥ sampadyate| ākāraścātra padādirna
bhavati, nāpyukāraḥ padānta ityasiddhatvātug bhavatyeva|
kimarthaṃ punaḥ ṣatvatukorekādeśasyāsitaddhatvāducyate, yāvatā
dvipadāśrayatvād
bahiraṅgasyaikādeśasyaikapadāśrayatvenāntaraṅgayoḥ ṣatvatukoḥ
ṭhasiddhaṃ bahiraṅgamantaraṅge' ityevāsiddhatvaṃ siddham? jñāpanārthaṃ
tu, etajjñāpayati--ṭhyatra bahiraṅgasyāntaraṅgasya vā'corānantaya
nimitatvenāśritaṃ tatra bahiraṅgaparibhāṣā na pravartate' iti|
tenākṣadyauurityatra bahiraṅgasyāpyūṭho'siddhtavābhāvādyaṇādeśaḥ
siddho bhavati| ayamevārthaḥ paribhāṣārūpeṇa paṭha|lte ṭhnājānantaryaṃ
bahiṣṭvapraklṛptiḥ' iti ||

ādguṇaḥ || 6|1|87 ||
guṇagrahaṇaṃ kim, yāvatā'cīti vartate, ṭhekaḥ pūrvaparayo' iti ca,
tatrāntaryataḥ kaṇṭhatālavyayorakārekārayoḥ sthāne tādṛśa evaikāro
bhaviṣyati, kaṇṭhayauṣṭha|lyoścākārokārayoḥ sthāne tādṛśa
evaukāro bhaviṣyati, kaṇṭhayauṣṭha|lyoścākārokārayoḥ sthāne
tādṛśa evaukāro bhaviṣyati; caikāraukārayorapi prasaṅgaḥ,
vṛddirecīti niyamāt ? tadidānīṃ niyamārtham, aicoranenaiva
siddhatvāt, ecyeva vṛddhibharvati| ubhayathā niyamaśca vyākhyāsyate,
vṛddhirevaicīti| ira tarhi khaṭvarśyaḥ mālārśya iti
pramāṇato'ntaratamo mūrddhanta ṛkāraḥ prāpnāti ? māṇa eva raparo
bhavatīti sthānat ubharorantaratamaḥ| ākārastarhi prāpnoti ?
ṭhipasargādṛti dhātau' ityetannyamārthaṃ bhaviṣyati---ṛti
dhātāvevākāro nānyatreti| prutastarhi prāpnoti ----khaṭvendraḥ,
ṭhplutaśca viṣaye smṛtaḥ', plutavidāne hi sati yasminviṣe bluto
vihitastasminnapyanainaiva bhāvyam ? asminkartavye āṣṭamikasya
plutasyāsiddhatvāt, tataśca pakṣe'nuvādadoṣapasaṅgat plugo na
bhavatīti|
iha tarhi śaṭvā īṣā khaṭveṣā,śaṭvā ūḍhā khaṭveḍhā,
āntaryataścaturmātra ādeśaḥ prāpnoti, guṇagrahaṇe tu kriyamāṇe
guṇasaṃjñāyānparakaraṇaṃ sarvārthamiti
trimātracaturmātrāṇāmaguṇatvādaprasaṅgaḥ| tasmād guṇagrahaṇam|
ślekau cātra bhavata----
ādeśaśced guṇaḥ kena sthāne'ntaratamo hi sāḥ|
aidautau naici tāvuktāvṛkāro nobhayantaraḥ ||
ākāro nartidhātau sa plataśca viṣaye smṛta|
āntaryātricaturmātro guṇaśca taparaḥ samṛtaḥ || 
iha vṛkṣaśabdānṅḥ, vṛkṣi a i a indramiti sthite akārekāyorguṇaśca
prāpnotīkārayoḥ savarṇadīrghaśca, tatra
śabdaparavipratiṣedhāddīrghaprasaṅgaḥ, tathā tacchapabdān ṭhjaśśasoḥ
śiḥ', na i indram, pacerutamaikavacanamiṭ śap paca i candram ? naiṣa
doṣaḥ ekapadātaraṅgo guṇe bhaviṣyate prageva padāntarasannidānāt
|

lṛkārasya stānata itai| yathā caitallabhyate tathā| ṭhlaṇ' ityatra
vyākhyātam || 

etyedhatyūṭhūasu || 6|1|89 ||
na punaredhateravyabhicārāditi| bāhulyābhiprāyeṇaitaduktam| asti
hyasyāpi vyabhicāraḥ--caṅyupadhāhrasvatve bhavān mā
predidhadityatretyāhuḥ| praṣṭhauha iti| praṣṭhṃa vahatīti ṭhdhandasi sahaḥ',
ṭhvahaśca' iti ṇviḥ, ṭhvāha ūṭha' ityūṭha, samprasāraṇam, pūrvatvam,
tato vṛddhiḥ| etyedhatyorehi pararūpāpavāda iti| vṛddhirvidhīyata
ityanuṣaṅgaḥ|
yathaiva tarhi ṭheṅ pirarūpam' bādhate, evamāṅ pirarūpamapi bādhetaḥ
nāprāpte pararūpe'syā vṛddherārambhāt? ityata
āha-omāṅeścaitaccivati| kutaḥ? ityāhayeneti| sa tasya bādhako
bhavatīti| tasyaiva bādhako bhavatīti yāvat,
tadbādhasyāvaśyambhāvitvāt, tāvatā ca bādhakasya caritārthatvāt|
na cāprāpte eṅ pirarūpe iyaṃ vṛddhirārabhyate, āṅ pirarūpe tu ā
itaḥuetaḥ, pretaḥ, pareta ityatra prāpte; upaiti, praitītyatra tvaprāpte
tasmānna bādhate| parihārāntaramāha--purastāditi| anantare bādhye
jñāte tadbādhayā vacanasya caritārthatvādutareṇa saha sparddhāyāṃ
paratvātadeva bhavatīti bhāvaḥ|
akṣauhiṇīti| akṣairūhate'vaśyamiti āvaśyake ṇiniḥ, sādhanam ṭhkṛtā'
iti samāsaḥ|
svairamiti| ṭhīra gatau', īraṇamīraḥ, bhāve ghañ, svenābhiprāyeṇa
īraṇaṃ svairam, ṭhkartṛkaraṇe kṛtā bahulam' iti samāsaḥ,
kriyāviśeṣaṇātvāllokāśrayatvādvā liṅgasya napuṃsakatvam|
svenābhiprāyeṇerate gacchatīti svairī, ṭhsupyajātau' iti ṇiniḥ|
īrigrahaṇamanarthakam, svenābhiprāyeṇerate gacchatīti svairī,
ṭhsupyajātau' iti ṇiniḥ| īrigrahaṇamanarthakam, ṭhpadāsvairibāhya' iti
nipātanātsiddham, padāsvairaśabdādinā matvarthīyena siddham,
ṇinistvanabhidhānānna bhaviṣyati|
prādityādi| ūḍha, ūḍhi, eṣya--ityetānyutarapadāni|
iṣyatericchateriṣṇātervā yadā ṇyat tadā--praiṣyaḥ, yadā ghañ
tadā-praiṣaḥ, eṅ pirarūpāpavādo vṛddhiḥ| īṣyaśabde tu preṣya iti
bhavati| tathā āauuḍhā oḍhā proḍheati ṭhomāṅeśca' iti pararūpaṃ
bhavati| pūrvopātasya ṛṇasyāpanayanāya yadṛṇamanyadupātaṃ tad
ṛṇārṇam| daśārṇaśabdo nadīviśeṣasya, deśaviśeṣasya ca saṃjñā ||

āṭaśca || 6|1|90 ||
ṭhīkṣa darśane', ṭhubha umbha pūraṇe', ṭhubja ārjave',ṭhṛdhu vṛddhau'--
ityeteṣāmudāharaṇāni| cakāro'dhikavidhānārtha iti| asyaiva
vivaraṇam-- usyomāṅeśceti| pararūpabādhanārthaṃ iti| usi, omi,
āṅ ci yatpararūpaṃ prāpnoti tadbādhanārtha ityarthaḥ; anyathā
paratvātadeva pararūpaṃ syāt| ausrīyaditi| anarthake'pyusi
pararūpavidhānādatra prasaṅgaḥ ||

upasargādṛti dhātau || 6|1|91 ||
upārcchatīti| ṭhṛccha gantīndriyapralayamūrtibhāveṣu'| 
prarcchako deśa iti| atra yatkriyāyuktāḥ prādayaḥ iti gamiṃ prati
praśabdasyopasargatvaṃ narcchatiṃ pratīti bhavati pratyudāharaṇam|
vā supyāpiśaleriti hi vikalpaḥ syāditi|
tenotarārthantaparakaraṇamiti bhāvaḥ|
dhātugrahaṇamanarthakam, yatra copasargatvaṃ na sambhavati,
tatropasargagrahaṇena prādayo'pilakṣyante, yathā-nāsikāyā
nasbāvavidhau; iha tu mukhyamevopasargatvaṃ sambhavati tatkiṃ
dhātugrahaṇena ? ityata āha-upasargagrahaṇādeveti| śākalyasyedaṃ
śākalam, tasya nivṛtyarthaṃ punarddhātugrahaṇam| sati tu dātugrahaṇe
yogavibhāgena punarvṛddhirvidhīyata iti śākalaṃ bādhyate| asati tu
tasmin śākalyamatena paratvāt prakṛtibhāvaḥ syādeva ||

vā supyāpiśaleḥ || 6|1|92 ||
subantasya dhātorasambhavātsubityetyetaddhātoravayavadvārakaṃ
viśeṣaṇamityāha--subantāvayave dhātāviti| ācāryagrahaṇenaiva
pūjāvikalpayorapi siddhayoḥ punarvāgrahaṇamācāryagrahaṇasya
prādhānyena pūjārthatāṃ khyāpayituṃ kṛtam ||

auto'msasoḥ || 6|1|93 ||
gāṃ paśyeti| nanu cātra ṭhgoto ṇit' iti ṇitve sati paratvā
dvaddhau kṛtāyāmokārābhāvādātvena na bhāvyam, ātvavidhānaṃ tu
dyośabdārthaṃ syāt, na hi tatra ṇitvamasti, ṭhgotaḥ' iti vacanādityata
āha-dyośabdo'pītyādi| satyaṃ yadi ṇitvaṃ na syāt, asti tu tatrāpi
ṇitvam, ṭhgotaḥ' ityasyaukārāntopalakṣaṇatvāt, varṇanirddeśeṣu
taparatvaprasiddheḥ| tataḥ kim? ityāha--teneti|
śasā sāhacaryāditi| supa eva hi śaśo'tra sambhavaḥ, nānyasya;ṭhaci'
ityadhikārāt|
acitavamasunavamiti| cinoteḥ, sunoteśca laṅ, ṭhtasthasthamipāṇ'
ityami kṛte vikaraṇasya guṇāvādeśau ||

eṅ pirarūpam || 6|1|94 ||
ṭhila preraṇe' curādiḥ, ṭhokhṛ śākhṛ' iti bhūvādau paṭha|lete|
kecidvā supyāpiśalerityanuvartayantīti| yadyevam, tena
sahāsyaikavākyatāyām asubdhātuṣu nāsya pravṛttiḥ syād? ityata
āha--tacceti| atra vyākhyānameva śaraṇam|
śakandhvādiṣviti| śakandhvādayaḥ prayogato'nusartavyāḥ, teṣu
pararūpaṃ vaktavyam| ṭhkulaṭāyā vā', ṭhkatantebhyaḥ'
ityādinirddeśo'sminnarthe liṅgam| andhuḥukūpaḥ, bahūni
kulānyaṭati naikasminkule'vasthiteti kulaṭā| pacādiṣvayaṃ
paṭhitavyaḥ, anyathā ṭhkarmaṇyaṇ' syāt|
eve cāniyoga iti| niyogaḥuavaśyambhāvaḥ, niyamaḥuavadhāraṇam,
tato'nyatrārthe pararūpaṃ sambhavati| udāharaṇe'navaklṛptāvevaśabdaḥ,
yathā--kveva bhokṣyasa iti| avadhāraṇe tu vṛddhireva
bhavati---ṭhamaivāvyayena', ṭhdhātostannititasyaiva', ihaiva santatvāya,
mamaiva havyānyagna ityādi|
otuḥuviḍālaḥ| ṭhtunvorvi nipāta upasaṃkhyānam', vīti
saptamīnirddeśātadādividhiḥ, vakārādau nipāte parataḥ
tunu-ityetayoḥ pararūpaṃ bhavati--tu vai tvai, anubhūtatamaṃ caikam|
nuvai nvai| eka evāyaṃ nipātaḥ, arthābhedāt, yadāha--ṭhna vā,
nipātaikatvāt' iti| ata eva naitad vṛttikāreṇa paṭhitam |
sūtre pararūpagragrahaṇabhutarārtham, iha tveṅītyeva siddham--eṅ pirata
ekādeśo bhavatīti| rūpagrahaṇaṃ cintyaprayojanam, tathā ca ṭhami
pūrvaḥ' ityatra rūpagrahaṇaṃ na kṛtam |

omāṅeśca || 6|1|95 ||
adyoḍheati| āṅnāṅerekādeśa āṅgrahaṇena gṛhyata iti
bhavatyudāharaṇam| atra ca ṭhdhātūpasargayoḥ kāryamantaraṅgam' iti
pūrvamādguṇae kṛte paścādadyaśabdena sambandhe vṛddhiḥ prāpnoti,
evamāṅe rūpamavitaṣṭam| adya gāagata ityādau tatra savarmadīrghatvena
siddhaṃ rūpam|
akaḥ savarṇe dīrghatvaṃ bādhyata iti| nanu ca madhye'pavādanyāyena
vṛddhereva bādho yuktaḥ na dīrghatvasya? naiṣa doṣa; cakāro'tra
kriyate, sa punarvidānārtho bhaviṣyati || 

usyapadāntāt|| 6|1|96 ||
bhindyauriti| bhiderliṅ, yāsuṭ, jherjus, śnasorallopaḥ, ṭhliṅḥ
salopo'nantyasya' iti salopaḥ, bhindyāaus--anena pararūpam|
aduriti| dāño luṅ, ṭhgātisthā' ityādinā sico luk, ṭhātaḥ'
iti jherjus, adāaus--anena pararūpam |
kosreti| nanu cānarthakatvādevāsyoso grahaṇaṃ na bhaviṣyati ? evaṃ
tarhyetajjñāpayati--anarthasyāpyuso grahaṇamiti, tena
bhidyaurityādāvapyusi pararūpaṃ bhavati| atra hi yāsuḍādiḥ
samudāyo'rthavān, na tu tadavayava us| koṣiteti| vaseḥ ktaḥ,
ṭhvasatikṣudoriṭ', yajāditvātsamprasāraṇam, ṭhśāsivasighasīnāṃ ca'
iti ṣatvam, tasyāsiddhatvādusi na pararūpaṃ bhavati| asya tu
lākṣaṇikatvādevāgrahaṇaṃ siddham| abibhayuriti| bhiyo laṅ, śapaḥ
śluḥ, ṭhsijabhyasta' ityādinā jherjus, ṭhjusi ca' iti guṇaḥ ||

ato guṇe || 6|1|97 ||
akaḥ savarṇe dīrghasyāpavāda iti| nanu ca madhye'pavādanyāyena
vṛddherevāyamapavādo yuktaḥ, na dīrghasya? guṇagrahaṇāddīrghasyāpi
bādhako bhaviṣyati, anyathā--ṭhato'padāntāt' ityeva vaktavyam|
eṅītyeva, tato jusi ca, apadāntādityeva| evaṃ siddhaṃ guṇagrahaṇād
guṇamātre'yaṃ vidhaiḥ pravartamāno dīrghamapi bādhiṣyate|
ata iti kimiti aditi vartata eveti praśnaḥ| taparakaraṇe
tātparyamityutaram || 

avyaktānukaraṇasyāt itau || 6|1|98 ||
avyaktamaparisphuṭavarṇamiti| aparisphuṭāuanabhivyaktā akārādayo varṇā
yasmintatathoktam| yadyevam, tadanukaraṇenāpi tathāvidhenaiva
bhāvyam, sadṛśaṃ hyanukāraṇaṃ bhavati, tataścānukārya iva tatrāpi
naivācchabdo'vadhāryate, anavadhārite cāśakyaṃ pararūpaṃ kartum ?
tatrāha-tadanukaraṇaṃ bhavatyatiprasaṅgāt? ityata
āha--kenacitsādṛśyeneti| tatpunaḥ sādṛsyaṃ dhvanestulyatayā, tena
hyavyaktamanukāryamanukaroti puruṣaḥ, anukaraṇaṃ kartṛ avyaktaṃ
karmānukaroti, karaṇasya kartṛtvāvivakṣayāṃ kartṛpratyayaḥ,
anukaraṇaśabdastu karaṇasādhana eva| pararūpamekādeśo bhavatīti|
acchabdasayāpi sarvasya nālontyasya; ṭhnānarthake'lontyavidhiḥ' iti
vacanājjñāpakācca| yadayam ṭhāmreḍitasyāntyasya tu vā ' iti
antyagrahaṇaṃ karoti, tajjñāpayati --ṭhnātrālontyaparibhāṣā pravartate'
iti| kiñca--pūrvāparasamudāya ekādeśasya sthānītyuktam, tataśca
tadekadeśe pūrvasmin khalvetatparibhāṣāpravṛttiḥ kīdṛśīti
cintyam| paṭaditīti| prakriyāvākyametat, na prayogārham;
pararūpasya nityatvāt| pāṭitīti kathaṃ punaḥ pararūpe kṛte
tadanukāryasya pratipādakaṃ bhavati, kutaśca tasyānukaraṇatvam? naiṣa
doṣaḥ; yathā gavityayamāheti kṛtāvādeśamapi gośabdasyānukaraṇaṃ
bhavati śāstrāvāsanayā, tadvadatrā'pi bhaviṣyati|
dakārāntānukaraṇametaditi takārāntānukaraṇe tu rūpamevaitanna
syāt; apadatvena jaśtvābhāvād, yathā--paṭiti karotīti ||

nāmreḍitasyāntyāsya tu vā || 6|1|99 ||
avyaktānukarasyāmreḍitasyeti| vyadhikaraṇe ṣaṣṭhayau,
avyaktānukaraṇasya yadavayavabhūtamāmreḍitam, tasyetyarthaḥ|
nityavīpsayoriti dvirvacanamiti| vīpsāyogastu yayākathañcid
draṣṭavyaḥ|
apara āha--ṭhnityavīpsayoḥ' ityupalakṣaṇametat, ṭhḍāci bahulaṃ dve
bhavataḥ' ityatra bahulavacanādanyasyāpi dvirvacanamiti|
yadi tviti| dvirūktasya samudāyānukaraṇasya vārthabhedo bhavaṃti|

nityamāmreḍite ḍāci || 6|1|100 ||
vārtikamevedam| vṛttikṛtā sūtrarūpeṇa paṭhitam| ḍāci vivakṣita
iti| ṭhāśaṃsāyāṃ bhūtavacca' iti bhaviṣyati ktaḥ, vidhitsita ityarthaḥ|
anyathā kaḍājeva na syāt; dvyajavarārdhatvābhāvāt| tathā ca
ḍājvidhāvuktam--ṭhyasya ca dvirvacane dvyajavarārddhatā tataḥ pratyayaḥ'
iti, aṣṭame ca vakṣyatiḍācīti viṣayasaptamīti|
ḍāci vidhitsita eva dvirvacanaṃ kriyata ityatra
prayojanāntaramāha--tacceti| hyarthe caḥ, taddhi dvirvacanaṃ
ṭilopātpūrvamiṣyate| evaṃ ca pūrvaṃ siddhayati, yadi ḍācividhitsita
eva dvirvacanaṃ bhavati, nānyathā| yadi hi parabhūte dvirvacanaṃ syāt,
tato'ntaraṅgatvātpūrvaṃ ṭilope kṛte ṭakārāntasya dvirvacane
paṭapaṭeti na siddhyet|
yadvā--ḍāci vihite utpanne ityarthaḥ| nanu coktam--ḍājeva na
syāditi? naiṣa doṣaḥ; ṭhdvyajavarārddhāt' iti
bhāvivyapadeśo'yam| yasya dvyajavarārddhatā bhaviṣyati dvirvacane
kṛte tasmādityarthaḥ| yadi ḍāci vihitaṃ dvirvacanaṃ
paratvāṭṭilopaprasaṅga ityuktam ? tatrāha--taccetyādi| ṭhḍāci
bahulam' iti bahulagrahaṇād dvirvacane kṛte ṭilopa ityarthaḥ ||

akaḥ savarṇe dīrghaḥ || 6|1|101 || 
agnaya iti| ṭhgherṅiti' iti guṇe kṛte dīrghatvaprasaṅgaḥ|
dadhyatreti| asati savarṇagrahaṇe yaṇādeśasya dīrghasya ca viṣayavibhāgo
na jñāyeta, tataśca paryāyaḥ syāt|
kumārī śeta iti| nanu ca tulyāsyaprayatnatve'pi sāvarṇyamatra nāsti,
ṭhnājjñalau' iti pratiṣedhāt? ityata āha--nājjhalāvityartrati|
ṭhāṇuditsavarṇasya cāpratyayaḥ' iti grahaṇakavākyam, tacca ṭhnājjhalau'
ityasya pravṛttisamaye nābhinirvṛtam, tasya hi savarṇasaṃjñāṅgam,
tena yāvatsā na pravartate tāvadanabhinirvṛtam| savarṇasaṃjhā'pi
svāpavāde ṭhnājjhalau' ityasminnapravṛte na pravartate, tataśca pūrvaṃ
ṭhnājjhalau' ityasya pravṛttiḥ, paścātsavaṇasaṃjñāyāḥ pravṛttiḥ, paścād
grahaṇakavākyasyeti eṣa kramaḥ| tena ṭhnājjhalau'
ityatrāgṛhītasavarṇānāmacāṃ grahaṇamiti ikāraśakārayoḥ
sāvarṇyamapatiṣiddham, tasmādacītyanuvartyamiti|
ṛti rḥa va vacanamiti| madhye rephabhaktī dve,
ādito'jbhakterarddhamātrā, evamantataḥ|
evam lṛtītyatrāpi madhye dve lakārabhaktī, abhitaḥ pūrvavat| evaṃ
dvimātrayaurapyetayorīṣatspṛṣṭatvādvivṛtābhyāmṛkāralṛkārābhyāmasāvarṇyādagrahaṇāddīrghasaṃjñāyā abhāvādvacanam| arddhatṛtīyamātratvātatkālatvābhāvādityanye| etacca savarṇasaṃjñāyā prapañcitam| dīrghapakṣe tviti| ṛkāralukārayoḥ samudāyaḥ sthānī, na ca tasyāntaratamo dīrghaḥ sambhavati, ato'vayavasya yo'ntaratamaḥ sa eva bhavati| tatrāpi lṛvarṇasya dīrghāsambhavādṛkārasya yo'ntaratamaḥ sa eva bhavati| tatrāpi lṛvarṇasya dīrghāsambhavādṛkārasya yo'ntaratamaḥ sa ṛkāra eva bhavati ||

prathamayoḥ pūrvasavarṇaḥ || 6|1|102 ||
prathamāśabdo vibhaktiviśeṣe rūḍha iti| supāmādyatrike ṭhsapūrvāyāḥ
prathamāyāḥ',ṭhsaptamīpañcamīprathamābhyaḥ' ityādau tasyaiva grahaṇāt| nanu
ca strīliṅgaḥ prathamāśabdastatra rūḍhaḥ, na cāsya strīliṅgatve
pramāṇamasti, pratyuta prathamaśabdastiṅaṃ trikadvaye'sminneva śāstre
saṃjñātvena viniyuktaṃ iti tasyaiva grahaṇaṃ yuktam; tataśca pacati,
pacataḥ, pacanti, pacate, pacete, pacante, cakāra, cakratuḥ, cakruḥ;
cakre, cakrāte, cakrire--ityādau yathāprāptavidhyantarabādhenāyaṃ
vidhiryuktaḥ| kiñcaiva sati mukhye'pi prathamaśabde ṭhprathamayoḥ' iti
dvivacanamupapadyate, ātmanepadaparasmaipadabhedena prathamasya bhedāt?
ucyate; evaṃ sati dvivacananirdeśo'narthakaḥ; ṭhluṭaḥ prathamasya'
ityādivatsiddhatvāt| yadvā--ṭhvā supyāpiśaleḥ' ityataḥ
supītyanuvartayiṣyate, tena supa eva prathamasya grahaṇam, liṅgācca,
kiṃ liṅgam? ṭhdīrghājjasi ca' ṭhtasmācchaso naḥ puṃsi' iti| ata evala
liṅgātsupāmapyāditaḥ prathamayordvayorgrahaṇaṃ bhavati,
acītyadhikārācca, na hi surajādiḥ| surapi kuṇḍaṃ
tiṣṭhatītyadāvajādiḥ ? nātrāyaṃ vidhiḥ prāpnoti, kāraṇam ? ami
pūrvatvena bādhyate| tasmāt strīliṅgasya grahaṇamiti sthitam|
tatsāhacaryād dvitīyāpi prathametyukteti| dvivacanaṃ cātra pramāṇam|
nanu sakṛcch4%ataḥ śabdo mukhyavṛttireva vā bhavati, jaghanyavṛttireva
vā, na punarubhayavṛtti ? prathaṇādvitīyāsamudāye
jaghanyavṛttirevāyam, sa ca samudāya udbhūtāvayavabheda iti
dvivacanopapatiḥ, yathā--cchatriṇo gacchantīti|
vṛkṣāḥ, plakṣā iti| nanvatrāpi ṭhato guṇe' iti pararūpeṇa
bhavitavyam, nāprāpte vidhyantare tasyārambhāt|
syādetat--prathamayorityetadapi dīrghatvaṃ nāprāpte vidhyantare
ārabhyamāṇam agnī ityādau yathā bādhate, tathā pararūpamapi
bādhiṣyate iti? tatra, svarasandhiṣu guṇayāvutsargau, vṛddhiḥ
savarṇadīrghatvaṃ pūrvasavarṇādeśaśca tayorapavādā iti
dvitīyakakṣāprāptāḥ, pararūpaṃ tu tṛtīyakakṣāprāptamiti tadeva
prāpnoti| evaṃ tarhi yogavibhāgaḥ kariṣyate--prathamayoriti, akaḥ
savarṇa ityeva, tena vṛkṣā ityādau pararūpaṃ bādhitvā prathamayorakaḥ
savarṇo dīrghatvaṃ bhaviṣyati; yathaiva tarhi yogavibhāgaḥ pararūpaṃ
bādhate, tathā vṛkṣamityādāvami pūrvamapi bādheta, tasya
tvagnimityādiravakāśaḥ? naiṣa doṣaḥḥ; ṭhami pūrvaḥ' ityatrāmīti
yogavibhāgena prāptaṃ dīrghatvamapi na bhavatītyarthaḥ| evamapi
ṭhtasmācchaso naḥ puṃsi' ityatra tacchabdenānantaro dīrghaḥ paramṛśyate,
etān gāścarato balīvarddānpasya ityatra ṭhautomśasoḥ'
ityekādeśānmā bhūditi, tataḥ kim ? yogavibāge kriyamāṇe
agnīn, vāyunityādāveva natvaṃ syāt, na tu vṛkṣānityādau yatra
prathamayoriti yogavibhāgād dīrgho vidhīyate ? ayamapyadoṣaḥ;
tasmādityanenāksthāniko dīrghaḥ parāmṛśyate, nānantaraḥ, nāpi
dīrghamātram, etaccāka ityanuvṛterlabhyate| mā bhūdvā
yogavibhāgaḥ---prathamayoriti| nanu coktam--vṛkṣā ityādau
pararūpaprasaṅga iti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; ācāryapravṛttirjñāpayati--na
jassāsoḥ pararūpaṃ bhavatīti, yadayaṃ ṭhnādici' itījgrahaṇaṃ karoti;
anyathā avarṇāntasya nāstyeva dīrghaprasaṅga itika kimijgrahaṇena?
kevalotarārthe hi tasmiṃstatraiva kartavyaṃ syāt| yadvā--ṭhdīrghācchasi'
ityeva brūyāt, kimarthamidam? nīyamārtham---dīrghācchasyeveti|
tena jasśasorna bhaviṣyati|
vṛttikārastu yathokte parihāre pratipatigauravaprasaṅaganyāyataḥ
parihāramāhāto guṇa iti yadakāre pararūpamityādi| nyāyaṃ
darśati--purastuditi| itikaraṇo hetau || 
agnī ityatreti| asati hi pūrvagrahaṇe pūrvasamudāyasya
sthānino'ntaratamasya dīrghasyābhāvādavayavāntaratamo bhavan
pūrvasyaiveti niyamakāraṇābhāvātparasavarṇo'pi syāt,
tatastannivṛtyartham| pūrvagrahaṇaṃ tu vipratiṣedhanirākaraṇārtham;
anyathā agnī ityatra vipratiṣiddhamāpadyate| katham? ṭhdīrghaḥ' iti vartate,
yadi pūrvo na dīrghaḥ, yadi dīrgho na pūrvaḥ| nanu
dīrghagrahaṇānuvṛttisāmarthyāt pūrvaśabdena pūrvākṛtirgrahīpyate ?
kathaṃ punaḥ sāmarthyam, yāvatā yatra pūrvavyaktirdīrghabhūtā--kumārīḥ
paśya, bhastrāḥ paśyetyādau tatraiva yathā syāt, agnī ityādau mā
bhūdityevamarthā dīrghānuvṛttiḥ syāt? yadyetāvatprayojanaṃ
syād-ṭhdīrghācchasi pūrvo'mi ca' iti brūyāt; yatastu valu
prathamayorityārabhyate tato jñāyate--na kevalaṃ kumārīḥ
paśyetyādau dīrghasyaiva prathamayorityanena dīrgho vidhitsitaḥ, kiṃ
tarhi? agnī ityādāvapīti, taccākṛtivivakṣāyāmupapadyate ? satyam;
tadeva savarṇagrahaṇenāpi vispaṣṭīkriyate--trimātre stānini
trimātrādeśanivṛtyarthamiti| āntaratasyāt trimātra eva prāpnoti|
yatra plutāplutaprasaṅgaḥ sa eva ṭhplutaśca viṣaye smṛtaḥ' ityasya
viṣayaḥ, iha tu plutasyaiva prasaṅga iti nāyamasya viṣayaḥ ||

tasmācchaso naḥ puṃsi || 6|1|103 ||
tasmādityanenāntaraḥ pūrvasavarṇadīrgho nirddiśyata
ityāha-tasmātpūrvasavarṇadīrghāditi| utarasya śaśo'vayavasyeti|
utarasyetyetacchasavayavasya viśeṣaṇam, tasmādutaro yaḥ
śaso'vayavastasyeti, na tu śaśaḥ; asambhavāt| na hi
pūrvasavarṇadīrghāt paraḥ kvacicchas sambhavati| antādivadbhāvo'pi
na bhavati; ubhayata āśrayaṇāt| ata evānupātamapyavayavasyeti labhyate|
ṭhbahuṣu bahuvacanam' ityatra ṭhtrikaṃ prātipadikārthaḥ' ityuktam, tena
ṭhpusi' ityetatprakṛtiviśeṣaṇam--puṃśabdāt parasya
śaso'vayavasyeti| yadyevam, vṛkṣānityādikaṃ padaṃ
nakārāntamudāharaṇamupapadyate| ṣaṇukaṣaṇḍhakaśabdāviha
lokaprasiddhyā napuṃsake vartamānāvapi
puṃstāvanugatamevārthamāhatuḥ, yathā kumāryādiṣu
vartamāno'rthaśabdaḥ, sāmānyaviśeṣā eva strītvādayo na
punastanādayaḥ| strīsūtre caitadupapāditam| sthūrakānityādi
tūdāharaṇadvayamayuktam, katham? sthūrakāyā apatyāni, ararakāyā
apatyāni ṭhgargādibhyo yañ', bahuṣu luk, strīpratyayasyāpi ṭhluk
taddhitaluki' iti luk, sthūraka, araraka-ityetau strīśabdau, tābhyāṃ
paro'tra śas bhavati; na tu puṃśabdābyāmityata āha--sarva eta iti| na
kevalaṃ vṛkṣādayaḥ, api tvetāvapīti sarvaśabdasyārthaḥ, lupte'pi
pratyaye prakṛtireva tadarthe vartate, pratyayārthaścātrāyamanyarūpaḥ|
puṃstvaviśiṣṭa iti| strīvācakatvena prasiddhāvapyetāvasmin prayoge
puṃśabdāviti bhāvaḥ|
yadyevam, cañceva cañcāḥ pumāṃsa iti ṭhive pratikṛtau' iti kanaḥ
ṭhlummanuṣye' iti lupi kṛte prakṛtireva cañcāśabdaḥ
puṃstvaviśiṣṭṃa pratyārthamasmin prayoga āheti natvaprasaṅgaḥ? ityata
āha-iha tvityādi| pratyayārtho'pi naivātra puṃstvaviśiṣṭaḥ, kiṃ tarhi?
atideśāt strītvaviśiṣṭa ityarthaḥ|
tasmāditi kimiti| prakṛtasya dīrghagrahaṇasya pañcamyā
vipariṇāmātsiddhamiti praśnaḥ| etān gāḥ paśyeti| ṭhauto'mśasoḥ'
ityātvamekādeśaḥ, ṭhekaḥ pūrvaparayoḥ' iti mahāprakaraṇam, tataśca
tadviṣayameva natvaṃ syāditi manyate| nanvevaṃ ṭhṣatvatukorasiddhaḥ'
iti ca tatraiva kartavyam--śaśo naḥ puṃsīti, iha tu
prakaraṇādanantaramevopajīviṣyate? tadeva tarhi tasmādgrahaṇena
vispaṣṭa|lte ||

nādici || 6|1|104 ||
khaṭve iti| ṭhauṅ āpaḥ' iti auṅḥ śībhāvaḥ| kuṇkaḍe iti| atrāpi
ṭhnapaṃsakācca' iti ||

dīrghājjasi ca || 6|1|105 ||
āditi nānuvartate, cakāreṇeco'nukarṣaṇasāmarthāyat; anyathā
pūrveṇaiva dīrgādapyavarṇādici siddhaḥ pratiṣedha iti kiṃ
tadanuvṛtyarthena cakāreṇa! dīrghagrahaṇaṃ kim, yāvatā ṛvarṇasya
ṭhṛto ṅisarvanāmasthānayoḥ' iti guṇavidhānānnātiprasaṅgaḥ ?
evamidutorakapi, ṭhjati ca' iti guṇo vidhīyate| iha tahi vṛkṣāḥ,
agnī, vāyū; iti hrasvādapi pratiṣedhaḥ syāt? naiṣa doṣaḥ; ṭhnādici'
ityetanniyamārthaṃ bhaviṣyati,
agṛhyamāṇaviśeṣatvāccobhyathāniyamaḥ---ādicyeva, ādevecīti|
tatrādyena niyamena vṛkṣā ityādi siddham; dvitīyenāgnī, vāyū
ityādi| yathaiva tarhyagnī, vāyū hatyādau niṣedhau na bhavati; evaṃ
kumārthau, vadhvāvityādāvapi na syāt, tasmād dīrghāditi
vaktavyam| jasgrahaṇaṃ śasnivṛtyartham, anyathā kumārīḥ paśya, vadhūḥ
paśyetyādau śasyāpi pratiṣedhaḥ syāt| jñāpakānna bhaviṣyati,
yadayam, ṭhtasmācchaso naḥ puṃsi' iti puṃgrahaṇaṃ karoti,
tajjñāpayati--na śasi pratiṣedho bhavatīti; taddhi napuṃsake
savarṇadīrghatvāsambhavāt strīnivṛtyarthaṃ kṛtam, yadi ca
striyāmapyayaṃ kumārīḥ paśyetyādau śasyapi pratiṣedhaḥ sayātadā
pūrvasavarṇadīrgha tvābhāvādeva tatvaṃ na bhaviṣyati, kiṃ puṃgrahaṇena?
naitadasti jñāpakam; hrasvāntaṃ yat strīliṅgaṃ tadarthametat
syāt--kṛtīḥ paśya, dhenūḥ paśyeti| tasmāt ṭhjāsi ca' ityetadapi
vaktavyameva|

vā cchandasi || 6|1|106 ||
mārutīriti| maruto devatā āsāmiti ṭhsāsya devatā' ityaṇ,
ṅīp, jasi pūrvasavarṇadīrghatvam| vārāhīti| varāhasya vikāra iti
ṭhavayave ca prāṇyoṣadhivṛkṣebhyaḥ' iti ṭhprāṇirajatādibhyo'ñ', ṅīp,
dvivaṃcane pūrvasavarṇadīrghaḥ| upānahau viśeṣye ||

ami pūrvaḥ || 6|1|107 ||
ṭhdūrghāt' iti nānurktate, ārambhasāmarthyāt|
pūrvagrahaṇamityādi| yaḥ pūrvaḥ śrutaḥ, sa eva yathā syāt, kaḥ
punaranyaḥ prāpnoti ? tatrāha--pūrvasavarṇo dīrgho mā bhūditi|
kvacitu samāsaḥ paṭha|lte, sa karmadhārayo draṣṭavya| etaduktaṃ
bhavati--asatīha pūrvahrahaṇe prakṛtaṃ pūrvagrahaṇamanuvartyam,
tasmiṃścānuvartamāne tatsambaddhaṃ savarṇagrahaṇamapyanuvartyam, tataśca
pūrvasya yaḥ savarṇaḥ sa evāntaratamaḥ prasajyeta, tatra ko doṣaḥ ? na
tāvadvṛkṣamityātadau dvimātrasya sthānitvena dvimātraprasahgaḥ,
vacanasāmarthyāt ṭhprathayoḥ pūrvasavarṇaḥ' ityeva dīrghasya siddhatvāt ?
ata āha--kumārīmityatreti|
vā cchandasītyeveti| etacca vākyabhedena sambaddhyate, anyathā
bhāṣāyāṃ na syāt| śamyaṃ ceti|
vikalpavidānasāmarthyātpūrvatvābhāve pūrvasavarṇadīrgho'pi na
bhavati, tayoratra viśeṣābhāvāditi yaṇādeśa eva bhavati ||

samprasāraṇācca || 6|1|108 ||
samprasāraṇavidhānasāmarthyāditi| kathaṃ punaḥ sāmarthyam, yāvatā
saṃhitāyāṃ yaṇ vidhīyate, asaṃhitāyāṃ saṃprasāraṇaṃ caritārtham ?
naita dasti; ṭhsaṃhitaikapade nityā' iti vacanāt|
vā cchandasītyeveti| pūrvavadvākyabhedena sambandhaḥ| yajyamāna iti|
nanvidānī mevoktam--vigṛhītasya śravaṇaṃ prāpnoti, tatkathamatra
yaṇādeśaḥ ? ata āha-pūrvatvavidhāne hīti| satyam, anārabdhe
pūrvatve vigṛhītaśravaṇaṃ prāpnoti, samprasāraṇavidhānaṃ vyarthaṃ mā
bhūditi, pūrvatvavidhāne hi sati tatpratipativiṣaye
arthavatsamprasāraṇamiti pūrvatvābhāvapakṣe yaṇādeśe bhavatyeva,
ṭhsamprasāraṇapūrvatve samānāṅgagrahaṇam', yasminnaṅge
saṃprasāraṇamavasthitaṃ tadantarbhūto yo'c tenaiva saha yathā syāt,
iha mā bhūt--śakahvau, śakahvarthamiti, śakān hvayatīti kvipi
yajñāditvātsamprasāraṇam, yo'ntyo dhātorākāraḥ
tasminnevāṅge'ntarbhavati tasya tāvat pūrvatvam,
vibhaktyokāro'rthaśabdākāraśca na tasminnaṅge'ntarbhavata iti tayoḥ
pūrvatvaṃ na bhavati| atra parihāraḥ--yaṇaḥ sthāne ya ik sa
saṃprasāraṇam, ekādeśastu na yaṇstānikaḥ,
varṇāśrayatvāccāntādivadbhāvo'pi nāsti, evaṃ pūrvatvameva tāvanna
samprasāraṇam, kiṃ punaḥ, tatsthānika ūkāra iti pūrvaikādeśābhāvaḥ|
samprasāraṇadīrghatve tu vacanasāmarthyādekādeśasya pūrvaṃ
pratyantavadbhāvāt samprasāraṇavyapadeśaḥ| vṛttikārastu
samprasāraṇatvamabhyupetya parihārāntaramāha--antaraṅge ceti |
deśato viprakarṣo'tra bāhyatvenopavarṇitaḥ|
kālato viprakarṣastu paścādupanipātataḥ ||
dhātāvanantarbhāvakṛtaṃ bāhyatvam, paścādupanipātastu spaṣṭa eva ||

ṅasiṅsośca || 6|1|120 ||
eṅ utarayoriti| eṅ utarau yau ṅasiṅsau, tayoryaḥ sambandhayakāraḥ,
tasmin parata ityarthaḥ| agnerāgacchati, agneḥ svamiti| yadyapi
dvāveṅai, ṅasiṅasāvapi dvāveva; tathāpi yatāsaṅkhyaṃ na bhavati, na
hyatra ṅasiṅsoḥ kāya vidhīyate, kiṃ tarhi? tatsambandhinyati; sa caika
eva| athāpi sambandhibhedena tasya bhedaḥ syāt ? evamapi na doṣaḥ;
ṭhīdagneḥ somavaruṇayoḥ', ṭhdhātoḥ' ityādinirdeśāt || 

ṛta ut || 6|1|121 ||
dvayoḥ ṣaṣṭīnirddiṣṭayorityādi| nyāyaprāptipradarśanametat, na
punāparatve'kriyamāṇe kiñcidaniṣṭam ṭhṛtaḥ' iti taparakaraṇaṃ
dīrghanivṛtyartham, ṭhunnyorgrahaḥ' ṭhprestro'yajñe' ityādau na bhavati|
ṭhuc' ityapi taparakaraṇaṃ dīrghanivṛtyarthameva, āntaryato hi
dvimātrasya dvimātra eva prāpnoti| nanu ṭhbhāvyamāno'ṇsavarṇānna
gṛhṇāti' iti ? evaṃ tarhyejjñāpayati-ṭhbhāvyamāno'pyukāraḥ savarṇān
gṛhṇāti' iti, tenāmūbhyāmityatra ṭhadasoserdādu do maḥ' iti
dīrghasya dīrgha ūkāro bhavati| iha gamlṛprabhṛtibhyo ṅasiṅsoḥ
kṛtayoḥ ṛkaralukārayoḥ savarṇasaṃjñāvidānādasminnutve laparatve
ca kṛte saṃyogāntalope gamuliti rūpaṃ bhavati ||

khyatyāt parasya || 6|1|122 ||
khiśabdaśīśabdayorityādi| yaṇādeśe kṛte tulyarūpatvād
dvayorapi grahaṇam| etadarthamevāgantukenākāreṇa yaṇādeśaṃ kṛtvā
vikṛtanirddeśaḥ kṛtaḥ; anyathā khityoriti hrasvayorgahaṇe
dīrghayorna syāt, dīrghayorgahaṇe hrasvayornasyāt|
vikṛtanirddeśe tu dvayorapi bhavati| akārāntayostu
mukhyāpatyādivartinorgrahaṇaṃ na bhavati, ṭhsakhyuryaḥ' ṭhpatyurno'
ṭhāpatyasya ca' ityādirnirddeśāt|
sakhīyateḥ kvip sakhīriti| nanu cāllopasya sthānivadbhāvadyāṇā
bhāvyam, tatra kṛte yalope sthānivatvaniṣedhādādiṣṭadacaḥ
pūrvatvācca pūnaḥ sthānivatvābhāvāt ṭhlopo vyorvali' iti
yalope saśyurityādi na siddhyati ? naitadasti; ṭhkvau luptaṃ na
syānivat' iti sthānivatvaniṣedhāt|
vikṛtanirddeśaśya prayojanāntaramapyāha--vikṛtanirdeśāditi|
atisakheriti| atikrāntaḥ sakhā yeneti bahuvrīhiḥ| yadvā--śobhanaḥ
sakhā atisakhā, ṭhna pūjanāt' iti samāsāntaniṣedhaḥ| atha sa eva
yaṇādeśo'tra kasmānna bhavati, ṭhgheṅiti' iti guṇena bādhitatvāditi
cet? na; ṭhśeṣo ghyasakhi' iti ghisaṃjñāpratiṣedhādityata
āha--sakhiśabdasya kevalasyaiva hīti| etacca tatraiva pratipāditam ||

ato roraplutādaplute || 6|1|123 || 
ukārānubandhakasyeti| yadi ruśabdasamudāyaḥ sthānī syād,
agurvartham, tarvarthamityādāvapi prasajyeta| ṭhsasajuṣo ruḥ' ityatra
cokārasyānunāsikatvapratijñayā'nubandhakaraṇamanarthakaṃ syāt,
taddhyatraiva sūtre viśeṣaṇārthaṃ kriyate| rutvamapīti| apiśabdaḥ punaḥ
śabdasyārthe| yadi punā rutvamasiddhaṃ syāt,
sthānitvenāśrayaṇamanupapannaṃ syāt; ukārānubandhakasya
kasyacidrorabhāvāt|
tasyāpīti| nimitabūtasyāpītyarthaḥ| susrotā3 atra nvasīti|
ṭhdūrāddhūte ca, iti plutaḥ, nuśabdaḥ praśne| aśvin ātreti|
aśvaśabdānmatvarthīya iniḥ, sambuddhyantaṃ caitat, ṭhguroranṛtaḥ' iti
plutaḥ, he aśvin atraiva pradeśe payastiṣṭhatvityarthaḥ| prāyeṇa tu
takārāntaṃ paṭha|lte, tatrāśvicchandasya vyutpattirmṛgyā| nanu
taparakaraṇādeva plutātparasya plute vā parato na bhaviṣyati, yathā
dīrghe ? tatrāha--plutasyāsiddhatvāditi| nanu ca siddhaḥ plutaḥ
svarasandhiṣu yadayaṃ ṭhplutapragṛhyā aci' iti prakṛtibhāvaṃ śāsti, yasya
hi vikāraḥ prāpnoti tasya prakṛtibhāvo vidhātavyaḥ, na ca
plutasyāsiddhatve plutasya sato vikāraprāptirityanarthakaṃ tat
syāt? astu svarasandhiṣu plataḥ siddhaḥ, rorutvaṃ tu svarasandhirna
bhavati| 
yadi tu saṃhitādhikāre yadvidhīyate tanmātraviṣayaṃ jñāpakamāśrīyate
śakyamakartam--ṭhaplutādaplute' iti ||

iśi ca || 6|1|124 ||
aplutādityeva--susrotā3 dehīti| cakāro'tītyasyānukarṣaṇārthaḥ,
tenotaratra tasyaivānuvṛttirbhavati, na haśītyasya, nahi
tadanukarṣaṇasyānyatprayojanamasti ||

prakṛtyāntaḥpādamavyapare || 6|1|125 ||
atītyeveti| na tu haśīti| atra hetuḥ pūrvamevoktaḥ| eṅ iti yat
pañcamyantamityādi| ṭheṅaḥ' iti tāvad vyavahitamapyanuvartate, na
tvanantaramapi rorita, atra ca vyākhyānameva śaraṇam; tenāvyapare
haśi parato ru prakṛtyā bhavatītyartho na bhavati| tadarthāditi| nahi
pañcamyantasya ṭhprakṛtyā' ityanena sambandhaḥ sambhavati| prakṛtirityādi|
ubhatrāpi prakṛtiśabdo dṛṣṭaḥ--dustyajā prakṛtiḥ, dadhnaḥ kṣīraṃ
prakṛtiriti| antarityavyayamityādi| tena
madhyavācināntaḥ--śabdenopajanite vyatireke pādaśabdātṣaṣṭhī,
tadantena sahāvyayībhāvaḥ| ṛkpādasyaiva grahaṇamiṣyata iti|
iṣṭirevaiṣā |
anye tu ṭhvā cchandasi' ityato maṇḍūakaplutyā ṭhcchandasi'
ityanuvartayanti| evamavayavārthaṃ darśayitvā samudāyārthaṃ
darśayati--avakārayakārapara ityādinā| svabhāvenāvatiṣṭhata iti| yadā
prakṛtiśabdaḥ svabhāve vartate tadāyamarthaḥ--svabhāvaparityāgena na
saṃhitākāryamāpadyata ityarthaḥ| yadā tu kāraṇe vartate
tadāyamarthaḥ--eṅkāraṇātmanā bhavatīti| kāraṇaṃ parapūrvatvādeḥ
kāryasyaiṅ, tasyātmāu svarūpam, tenaiva bhavati| prāka
saṃhitākāryādeṅe yadrūpaṃ tenaivāvatiṣṭhata ityarthaḥ|
anantaroktamevārthadvayaṃ vispaṣṭīkaroti--
iti| evaṃ hi svabhāvena bhavati, yadi svabhāvādanyathālakṣaṇāṃ
prāpnoti; tathā evaṅkāraṇātmanā bhavati, yadi vikārarūpaṃ nāpadyate,
yadi kāryātmanā na vipariṇamatītyarthaḥ| tau cediti|
nimitamuakāraḥ, kāryamueṅ| udāharaṇeṣu ṭheṅaḥ padāntādati' iti
pūrvatvasyāyavādeśca yathāyogamabhāvaḥ |
ete'rcayantīti| atraitatpadānte vartate, arcayantītyakāraśca parasya
pādasyādau|
keciditi| yadi ṭhnāntaḥ pādam' iti paṭhanti, evaṃ sati
pūrvatvasyaivānantarasya pratiṣedhaḥ prāpnoti, nāyavorvyavahitayoḥ ?
ityata āha-saṃhitāyāmiti| ṭhsaṃhitāyām'
ityetāvadevātrāpekṣyatace, na tu pūrvarūpatvam; tenaiṅḥ
saṃhitādhikāre yaduktaṃ tanna bhavatītyarthaḥ| tenaitadapi na
codanīyam--anārabdhe'smin pratiṣedhe'yavoḥ prāptirnāsti,
pūrvatvena bādhitatvāt, anena tu pratiṣedhena pūrvatve bādhite
tayorudbhavaḥ syāt, tasyāṃ daśāyāmasya vyāpāro nāsti,
ātmāśrayadoṣaprasahgāditi| kathametacyodyaṃ parihṛtam ? yadi
pūrvatvasyaivāyaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ syātatastadevāpekṣya pratiṣedhayet,
yatastu khalu saṃhitāyāmityapekṣya sāmānyena pratiṣedhati
tasyaitatprayojanam--svapravṛtyutarakālamudbhavatorayavorapi
pratiṣedho yathā syāditi| atra ca ṭhpadāntād' ityanuvartyam, anyathā
agnerahaṃ suhuvasya praṇītau, vāyoriva sūnṛtānāmudarkka ityādau
ṭhṅasiṅsośca' iti yatpūrvarūpam, tasyāpi prakṛtibhāvapratiṣedhau
prāpnutaḥ ||

avyādavadyādavakramuravratāyamavantvavasyuṣu ca || 6|1|116 ||
avyādīnāmanukaraṇatvātsamāso vibhaktiśca| avyāditi| averāśiṣi
liṅ| avadyāditi| pañcamyekavacanāntam| avakramuriti| avapūrvasya
kramerliṭa|lusi ṭhdirvacanaprakaraṇe cchandasi vā vaktavyam' iti
dvirvacanābhāve rūpam| kecitu sūtre avacakramuriti kṛtadvirvacanaṃ
vaṭhanti, teṣāmudāharaṇaṃ mṛgyam;
bahvṛcastāvad--avakramurityadhīyate| avrateti| vṛṅvṛñoḥ ṭhmantre
ghasa' ityādinā clerluk, ṭhātmanepadepvanataḥ' iti adādeśaḥ|
ayamiti| idam-śabdāt suḥ, ṭhido'y puṃsi'| avaterloṭ, avantu,
tasmādevāsunantāt kyac, ṭhkyācchandasi' ityupratyayaḥ-- avasyuḥ|
tenovantu pitaro haveṣviti bahvṛcāḥ pūrvarūpamevādhīyate|
adhibruvantuṃ te'vantvasmāniti ||

āpo juṣāṇo vṛṣṇo varṣiṣṭhe'mbe'mbāle'mbikepūrve|| 6|1|118 ||
āpo ityādīni pṛthak padāni anukaraṇāni,
vibhaktistvanukāryānukaraṇayorbhedasyāvivakṣitatvānna bhavati| ṭhsupāṃ
suluk' iti vā vibhakterlug bhavati, ambikepūrva
