ityetadapyanukaraṇameva| tatra prathamaṃ jasantam, dvitīyaṃ svantam,
tṛtīyaṃ śasantam, caturthaṃ ṅyantam, itare sambuddhyante|
ambikeśabdātpūrvāviti| asmādeva nipātanātpañcamīsamāsaḥ|
asmādeva nipātanāditi| ambetyetadviṣayametat| itarayostu
ṭhambārthaṃ dvyakṣaram' iti vakṣyamāṇatvānnaiva hrasvaprasaṅgaḥ ||

aṅga ityādau ca || 6|1|119 || 
aṅgaśabde ya eṅiti| ṭhsa prakṛtyā bhavati' iti vakṣyamāṇena sambandhaḥ|
tadātau cākāre yaḥ pūrva iti| ṭheṅ' ityapekṣyate, pūrvavacca
sambandhaḥ| tacchabdenātikrāntapratyavamarśinetiśabdasyārthamācaṣṭe,
tasyāṅgaśabdasyādistadādiḥ| cakāra kimarthaḥ, asati
cakāre'ṅgaśabdasyaivaiṅ tadādāvati parataḥ prakṛtyā bhavatītyarthaḥ
syāt, tataścāṅge'ṅge ityatraiva syāt| sati tu
tasminnaṅgaśabdasya evaiṅ yatra kvacidati parataḥ prakṛtyā bhavati,
tadādau cāti parato yaḥ kaścideṅ prakṛtyā bhavatītyayamartho
bhavati| tena aṅge adīdhyat, prāṇo aṅge-- ityubhayatrāpi bhavati ||


anudāte ca kudhapare || 6|1|120 ||
kavargadhakārapare iti| kavargadhakārau parau yasmātsa tathoktaḥ|
dhakāre'kāra uccāraṇārthaḥ| agniśabdaḥ ṭhaṅgenirnalośca' iti
nipratyayānto'nto'dātaḥ adhvaraśabdaḥ prātipadikasvareyaṇāntodātaḥ|
ādyaudāto nipātyata iti| ṭhṛnnendrāgra' ityādāvuṇādisūtre agraśabdaḥ
prātipadikasvareṇāntodātaḥ ||

sarvatra vibhāṣā goḥ || 6|1|122 ||
sarvatra cchandasi bhāṣāyāṃ ceti| yadyapi ṭhcchandasi' iti na prakṛtam,
tathāpi ṭhantaḥ pādaṃ yajuṣi' iti vacanāt avakramuḥ, avratāvasyuriti
chāndasānukaraṇācca chāndasāni pūrvasūtrāṇīti bhāvaḥ| sarvatragrahaṇaṃ
tu yajuṣi, anyatra cetyapyupapantam| padāntādityeva--gorāgataṃ
goḥ svam ||

avaṅ sphoṭāyanasya || 6|1|123 || 
sphoṭo'yanaṃ parāyaṇaṃ yasya sa sphoṭāyanaḥuspoṭapratipādanaparo
vaiyākaraṇācāryaḥ| ye tvaukāraṃ paṭhanti, te naḍādiṣvaśvādiṣu vā
pāṭhṃa manyante| atīti nivṛtamiti| anyathā gavaudanādau na syāt|
na caivaṃ satyatiprasaṅgaḥ ? ityāha---acītyetatviti| sarvatra cātra
vyākhyānameva śaraṇam| yadyacītyanuvartate katham ṭhiko yaṇici'
ityatrauktam--ṭhṭhacīti cādhikāraḥ ṭhsamprasāraṇācca' iti yāvat'' iti ?
nirantarānuvṛtyabhiprāyaṃ tadityadoṣaḥ| gavāgram, gavājinamiti|
bahuvrīhiḥ, tatpuruṣo vā| gavoṣṭramiti| dvandvaḥ, goragvacanam
goragvaktavyaḥ, tatrāpi avādeśena siddhyatyeva| na ca ṭheṅaḥ
padāntāt' iti pūrvatvaprasaṅgaḥ; agāgamasya tadgrahaṇena
grahaṇādokārasyāpadāntatvāt| kiṃ prayojanam? lāghavaṃ
tāvadbhavati, svare ca na doṣaḥ|
kathamāgamā anudātāḥ ? tatra gavāgrādau bahuvrīhau
pūrvapadaprakṛtisvareṇāgamānudātatvaṃ sambhavati, avaṅadeśe
tvāntaryato'ntodātasyāntodāto'vaṅadeśaḥ syāt| nanu
cāsyaikācaḥ sato vyapadeśivadbhāvenāntodātatvameṣṭavyam, tata
evādyaudātatvamapi bhaviṣyati, tataḥ kimādyaudātasyādyaudāta ādeśo
bhaviṣyati ? satyamevametat; na tvidaṃ
lakṣaṇamasti--prātipadikasyādirudāto bhavatīti, idaṃ
punarasti--prātipadikasyānta udāto bhavatīti| yo'sau
lakṣaṇenāntodātaḥ, tatrāntaryato'ntodāta ādeśaḥ prāpnoti| nanu
gamerḍo vidhīyate? tataḥ kim, pratyayādyaudātatve kṛte āntaryata
ādyaudāta ādeśo bhaviṣyati| kathaṃ punarayamādyaudātaḥ, yāvatā ekāc
vyapadeśivadbāvena? yadyevam, tata evāntodāto'pi,
tatrāntaryato'ntodātasyāntodāto'vaṅadeśaḥ prasajyate ? satyam;
nanvicaṃ lakṣaṇamasti--pratyayasyāntodāto bhavatīti, idaṃ
punarasti--pratyayasyādirudāto bhavatīti| yo'sau
lakṣaṇenādyaudātastatrāntaryata ādyaudāta ādeśo bhaviṣyati| syādevaṃ
yadi ṭhādyantavadekasmin' iti śāstrātideśaḥ syāt| yadā tvanena
kāryamātramudātatvam, antatve asatyevāditve cātidiśyate
tadaukārasyaivāditvavyapadeśābhāvāt kutastadādeśasyādyaudātatvam!
tataśca paryāyeṇa tvaniyatadeśamādyaudātatvaṃ syāditi pakṣe
doṣaprasaṅgaḥ | tatra sūtrakāreṇa tāvallāghavamanādṛtyāvaṅgādeśaḥ
kṛtaḥ| tatra yathā svare doṣo na bhavati, tathā
darśayati--ādyaudāto'vaṅadeśo nipātyata iti| ekaśrutyā sūtrapāṭhe
yadatra yatnenādyaudātoccāraṇaṃ tadantodātatvabādhanārthaṃ vijñāyate,
anyatra samāsāntodātatvena vādhyata iti| etacca bhāṣye
ṭhupadeśivadbhāvo vaktavyaḥ' iti vacanena labhyate, anyathā paratvāt
pūrvaṃ samāsāntodātatve kṛte avaṅ ivaṅsvara eva satiśiṣṭatvāt
syāt| upadeśivadbhāve tu pūrvamavaṅ kṛte piścāt samāsa iti
satiśiṣṭatvāt samāsasvara eva bhavati| padāntādityeva--gavo,
gavoḥ, gavām, gavi || 
indre ca || 6|1|124 ||
atra yadi ṭhaci' iti viseṣaṇam, indraśabdo viśeṣyam, tadā'jādau
indraśabda ityarthaḥ syāt| tataśca gavendrayajña ityādau na syāt,
anutarapadatvāt| yadyapyatrotarapadagrahaṇaṃ nāsti, tathāpyarthātsamāsa
etadvidhānam, na hyanyatra goranantara indraśabdaḥ sambhavati| samāse ca
vidhānamarthādutarapada eva syāt--ṣyaṅaḥ samprasāraṇavat,
tasmādajviśeṣyam, indraśabdo viśeṣaṇam, aci parataḥ kasminnindre
yaḥ sthitastasminniti, tadidamuktam--indraśabdasthe'cīti ||

plutapragṛhyā aci nityam || 6|1|125 ||
nanu yasya vikāraḥ prāptastasya prakṛtibhāvo vidheyaḥ, na ca plutasya
vikāraḥ prāptaḥ, svarasandhiṣu tasyāsiddhatvāt? ityata āśrayātplutaḥ
siddhaḥ iti| yadidaṃ plutasya prakṛtibhāvaṃ prati kāyitvenāśrayaṇam,
āha--asmādeva jñāpakāt ṭhsvarasandhiṣu plutaḥ siddhaḥ' iti kalpyata
ityarthaḥ|
ādeśanimitasyācaḥ parigrahārthamiti| yasminnādeśo vidhīyate sa eva
prakṛtibhāvasyāpi nimitatvena parigṛhīto yathā
syādityevamarthamityarthaḥ| jānu u asyeti| uñ nipātaḥ, tasya pūrveṇa
sahaikādeśasya yannimitaṃ na sapragṛhyādutaraḥ, yaśca tataḥ paro na sa
ekādeśasya nimitamiti prakṛtibhāvābhāvādekādeśo bhavatyeva|
asati punarajgrahaṇe ṭhpragṛhyae'ci parataḥ prakṛtyā bhavati'
ityucyamāne pūrveṇasaha yo vikāraḥ prāptastasyāpi prakṛtibhāvaḥ
syāt| punarajgrahaṇe tu na bhavati, tatraikādeśe kṛte
tasyādivadbhāvātpragṛhyagrahaṇena grahaṇāt| ṭhiko yaṇaci' iti
yaṇādeśaḥ prakṛtivadbhāvānna bhavati, ṭhmaya uño vo vā' iti pakṣe
vakāraḥ| 
nityagrahaṇamanuvartata iti| pūrvasūtre nityagrahaṇametadarkhameva
kṛtam, tatra tvāranbhasāmarthyādeva nityo vidhiḥ siddhaḥ| nityameva
prakṛtibhāvo yathā syāditi| ayameva prakṛtibhāvo nityaṃ yathā
syāt, śāstrāntareṇa kāryāntarasahito mā bhūdityarthaḥ ||

āṅe'nunāsikaścchandasi || 6|1|126 ||
teneha na bhavatīti| anarthakasyaivākārasya bhavati, abhra āÄ apa ityādau
saptamyaiva tadarśasyoktatvātadaryavṛttirāṅnarthakaḥ;
anurthāntaravācitvāt| ātaradityatra tu kriyāviśeṣaṇatvādarthavān|
kathaṃ punaranarthakasya ṅtvim, yāvatā---
ṭhīṣadarthe kriyāyoge maryādā'bhividhau ca yaḥ|
etamātaṃ ṅtiṃ vidyādvākyasmaraṇayoraṅt' || ityuktim ?
satyam; ṭhvākyasmaraṇayoraṅt' ityitraiva tātparyam, anyatra sarvatra
āṅ ṅdveiditavyaḥ--evaṃ tāvadbhāṣye sthitam ||

iko'savarṇe śākalyasya hrasvaśca || 6|1|127 ||
kimarthaścakāraḥ, prakṛtyetyetadanukṛṣyate'nena ? nanu ca
hrasvavidhānasāmarthyādeva svarasandhirna bhaviṣyati ? bhaveddīrghāṇāṃ
hrasvavacanasāmarthyādeva svarasandhirna syāditi hrasvānāṃ tu prāpnoti|
na hi hrasvānāṃ hrasvo bhavati; prayojanābhāvāt| asti
prayojanam--svarasandhirmā bhūditi? idaṃ tarhi
prayojanam---prakṛtibhāvamātraṃ kvacidyathā syāditi, teneṣā akṣādiṣu
cchandasi prakṛtibhāvamātraṃ siddhaṃ bhavati|
śākalyagrahaṇaṃ pūjārthamiti| atha vikalpārthaṃ kasmānna bhavati?
ityāha--ārambhasāmarthyādeveti| savarṇe'ci
dīrghavidhānādyaṇādeśasyāsavarṇa evājviṣayaḥ, asyāpi vidheḥ sa eva
viṣayaḥ, tataśca viṣayaikyādeva vikalpe siddhe na tadarthaka
mācāryagrahaṇam |
sinnityasamāsayoriti| nityādhikāravihito'svapadavigrahaśca
samāso nityasamāsaḥ, ekāpi saptamī viṣayabhedādbhidyate, siti
parato nityasamāse ca viṣaya iti, śāklyasyāyāṃ vidhiḥ śākalaḥ,
ṭhkaṇvādibhyo gotre' ityaṇ| ṛtviya iti| ṛturasya prāpta iti
ṭhṛtoraṇ', ṭhcchandasi ghas'| vyākaraṇamiti| ṭhkugatiprādaya' iti
samāsaḥ, tatra ṭhnityam' ityanuvartate| kumāryathamiti| kumāryai idaṃ
kumāryartham, asvapadavigraho'yaṃ nityasamāsaḥ ||

ṛtyakaḥ || 6|1|128 ||
savarṇarthamanigarthaṃ ca vacanamiti| hotṛ ṛśyaḥ, khaṭva ṛśya ityādau;
inyatra pūrveṇaiva siddhatvāt ||

aplutavadupasthite || 6|1|129 ||
ṛṣiḥuvedaḥ tatra bhava ārṣaḥ, tato'nyonārṣaḥ,
samudāyādvākyādavacchidya pṛthakakṛtya svarūpe'vasthāpyate| kaiḥ?
padakāraiḥ| padasyeyatāparijñānāya aplutena tulyaṃ vartata
ityaplutavat| tatra yena sādharmyeṇāplutavatvam,
taddarśayati--aplutakāryamiti| tatrāpi plutaśabdena vihitasya
kāryasya pratiṣedha iti darśayati--prakṛtibhāvaṃ karotīti| anyathā
svarasandherapi pratiṣedhaḥ syāt, tasyāpi plukāryatvāt|
udāharaṇeṣu plutakāryapabratiṣedhādekādeśo bhavat
plutamevopamṛdya bhavati; svarasandhiprakaraṇe plutasya sidvatvāt|
tatra ko doṣa iti| ekādeśena nivartyamānatvāt plutasya śravaṇena
na bhavitavyamiti pluta eva niṣidhyatām, kimarthamatideśāśrayaṇamiti
praśanaḥ| agnī3 itīti| yatra plutāśrayo'pi prakṛtibhāvaḥ prāpnoti,
pragṛhyāśrayo'pi; tatra plutāśrayasya pratiṣedhe'pi pragṛhyāśrayasya
prakṛtibhāvasya pratiṣedhābhāvāt plutasya śravaṇaṃ siddhyati,
platapratiṣedhe tu kriyamāṇe'trāpi śravaṇaṃ na syāt ||

ī3 cākravarmaṇasya|| 6|1|130 ||
sūtre ī ceti trimātrikasya nirddeśaḥ| aci parata iti|
upasthitagrahaṇaṃ cāsvaritatvānnivṛtam| astu hī3 ityabrūtāmiti|
ṭhvibhāṣā pṛṣṭaprativacane heḥ' iti plataḥ, asterloṭi tip, ṭheruḥ'|
tadupasthite nivṛtyarthamiti| tatra pūrveṇāplutavadbhāvasya
nityaprāptatvāt, anupasthite prāptyarthamiti, tatra
kenacidaprāptatvāt|
īkārādanyatrāpīti| tathā ca bhāṣyam--ṭhīkāragrahaṇena nārthaḥ' ityādi
|| 


diva ut || 6|1|131 ||
padagrahaṇamanuvartata iti| antagrahaṇenopasamastamapi kevalaṃ
padagrahaṇamevānuvartate, tataścārthāt ṣaṣṭha|lntaṃ jāyate, divaśabdena
viśeṣaṇātadantavidhiḥ, ṭhgrahaṇavatā prātipadikena' iti tu
pratyayavidhiviṣayam| vyapadeśivadbhāvāt kevalasyāpi
bhavitavyam, ṭhvyapadeśivadbhāvo'prātipadikena' ityetadapi
pratyayavidhiviṣayameva| sānubandhakatvāditi|
dīvyaterdhātorukāro'nubandhaḥ, prātipadikasya tu na
kaścidanubandhaḥ| divaḥ padasyeti| tadantasya padasyetyarthaḥ| dyaukāma
iti| divaṃ kāmayate iti ṭhśīlikāmibhikṣācaribhyo ṇaḥ' vimaladyau iti|
vimalā dyaura'sminniti bahuvrīhiḥ| akṣadyaubhyāmiti| akṣaśabda upapade
dīvyateḥ kvip, tatra ṭhcchavoḥ śūḍanāsite ca' ityūṭha|
atha taparakaraṇaṃ kimartham, yadyapi ṭhṛta ut' iti taparakaraṇena
jñāpitam--ṭhbhāvyamāno'pyukāraḥ savarṇān gṛhṇāti' iti,
tathāpyāntarthato'rddhamātrākālasya vyañjanasya mātrika eva bhaviṣyati?
ityata āha--taparakaraṇamiti| yadyapyanena dīrgho na prāpneti,
prāpnoti, lakṣaṇāntareṇa tu prāptotītyāha--dyaubhyām, dyaubhiriti|
utvasyāvakāśo yatrāyajādiparaḥ--vimaladyau, ūṭho'vakāśaḥ--dyauutvā,
dyauutam; yatra tūbhayoḥ prasaṅgastatra paratvādūṭha prāpnoti,
taparakaraṇādutvameva bhavati| yadi prāptasyoṭho nivṛtyarthaṃ
taparakaraṇamityucyate evaṃ tarhi ṭhcachavoḥ śūḍanunāsite ca' ityatra
ṭhkathaṃ dyaubhyām, dyaubhiḥ' iti pareṇa codite yadvakṣyati--ṭhūṭhi kṛte
diva uditi taparakaraṇānāmātrākālo bhaviṣyati', tadviruddhyate,
tasya hyauuṭhi kṛte tasyaivoṭho mātrākālo bhaviṣyatītyayamarthaḥ ? naiṣaḥ
doṣaḥ; ṭhūṭhi kṛte' ityetasya pūrveṇa codyagranthena sambandhaḥ--ṭhkathaṃ
dyaubhyāṃ dyaubhiriti, ūṭhi kṛte' iti; ṭhdiva ut iti taparakaraṇāt
mātrākālo bhaviṣyati' ityetāvān parihāragranthaḥ| taparakaraṇasya
tūṇnivṛttireva prayojanam| tasmādutvamevātra kartavyam, na
punaruḍityarthaḥ ||

etatadoḥ sulopo'koranañsamāse hali || 6|1|132 ||
etena ṭhetatadoḥ' iti suśabdāpekṣayā sambandhalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhītyācaṣṭe|
yadyevam, su ityetasya sāpekṣatvāllopaśabdena samāso na prāpnoti
? naivāyaṃ samāsaḥ, su iti pṛthakpadam ṭhsupāṃ suluk' iti
luptaṣṭhīkam| kaśca tayoḥ suśabda iti| yadi yastābhyāṃ vihitaḥ suḥ
sa tayoḥ sambandhī bhavati, tadā paramasa dadāti, paramaiṣa
dadātītyādo na syāditi manyamānaḥ pṛcchati| itaro
viditābhiprāyaḥ parihati-yastadarthena sambaddha iti| arthadvārakaśca
sambanadhaḥ, yastadarthagatamekatvamācaṣṭa ityarthaḥ| paramasa
dadātītyādāvapi utarapadārthapradhānatvātadarthagatamevaikatvamācaṣṭa
iti siddho lopaḥ| prathamaikavacanasyātra suśabdasya grahaṇam, na
saptamībahuvacanasya| ṭhsyaścchandasi' ṭhso'ci lope cetpādapūrṇam'
ityatra hyasyaiva sambhavaḥ| dvayoḥ sāmānyena grahaṇaṃ tarhi kasmānna bhavati?
evaṃ tarhi ṭhniranubandhakagrahaṇe na sānubanadhakasya' iti
prathamaikavacanasyaiva grahaṇam, tasya hyukāra uccāraṇārthaḥ, nānubandhaḥ|
eṣa iti| ṭhtadoḥ sa sāvanantyayoḥ' iti sakāraḥ, tyadādyatvam, ṣatvam|
eṣaka iti| ṭhavyasarvanāmnāmakac prāk ṭeḥ' ityakac |
nanu rūpabhedātsākackāvetatadāveva na bhavataḥ, tatkim ṭhakoḥ' iti
pratiṣedhena ? tatrāha--tanmadhyapatiti iti| asyāśca paribhāṣāyā
astitve ayameva pratiṣedho liṅgam |
utarapadārthapradhānatvāditi| etacca nañsūtra eva vyākhyātam|
ṭhhalṅyābbhyaḥ' ityasyānantaramidaṃ na kṛtam--saṃhitāyāṃ yathā
syāt, asaṃhitāyāṃ mā bhūditi ||

syaścchandasi bahulam || 6|1|133 ||
sya iti yadityasya prathamāntasyānukaraṇam ṭhsupāṃ suluk' iti
luptaṣaṣṭhīkam|
anukāryānukaraṇayorbhedasyāvivakṣitatvādanutpattireva vā
ṣaṣṭhayāḥ| udāharaṇe satvādi pūrvavat ||

so'ci lope cetpādapūraṇam || 6|1|134 ||
sa iti nirdeśaḥ pūrvavat|
keciditi| svayaṃ tu cchando'dhikārādṛkpādasyaiva grahaṇaṃ manyate ||

suṭ kāt pūrvaḥ || 6|1|135 ||
saṃskartati| saṃmpuṃkānāṃ so vaktavyaḥ' iti vacanāt ṭhsamassuṭi'
iti dvisakārakatvādvā nirdeśasya samo makārasakya sakāraḥ,
ṭhatrānunāsikaḥ pūrvasya tu vā' iti pūrvasyānunāsikaḥ| iha
ṭhsamparyupebhyaḥ karotau bhūṣaṇe', ṭhkiratau lavane' ityādau
kakārādāvāgamini ṭitvādeva suṭ kātpūrvo labhyate|
ṭhhrasvāccandrotarapade' ityādau kātpūrvatvasambhavādanupayoga
evetyanarthakaṃ kātpūrvagrahaṇ| syādetat--saṃcaskāretyādāvabhyāse
sañjāte sābhyāsasya karotitvāccātpūrvaḥ suṭa syāt, mā
bhūccātpūrvaḥ, kātpava eva yathā syādityevamarthaṃ kātpūrvagrahaṇamiti ?
tanna; atra hi liṭi dvirvacanaṃ ca prāpnoti, suṭ ca; tatra
dvirvacanamakṛte suṭi kṛśabdasya prāpnoti, kṛte tu skṛśabdasya|
suḍapi kṛte dvirvacane cakṛśabdasya prāpnoti, akṛte tu
kṛśabdasyetyubhayoranityayoḥ paratvāt suṭi kṛte tasya
dhātugrahaṇena grahaṇāt sahaiva tena dvirvacane ṭhsarpūrvāḥ khayaḥ' iti
khayaḥ śeṣe saṃcaskāreti siddham| na ca sābhyāsasyākṛtaḥ sukaḍiti
punaḥ suṭprasaṅgaḥ; asminneva prayoge lakṣaṇasya pravṛtatvāt |
nanu ṭhpūrvaṃ dhātuḥ sādhanena yujyate' iti darśane pūrvaṃ
sādhanavācini lakāre tadāśraye ca dvirvacane
ekapadāśrayatvādantaraṅge kṛte padadvayāśrayatvādbahiraṅgaḥ suṭ
paścādbhāvan cātpūrvaḥ syāt, samaskārodityādau
cāntaraṅgatvāt paratvāccāṭi kṛte tena vyavadhānānnaiva suṭ
syāt, vikaraṇāntāṅgabhakto hyaḍāgamastameva na vyavadadhyāt,
karotiṃ tu vyavadadhātyeva; iha ca samaskṛta, saṃskṛthā iti yatra
karotirevāraṅgaṃ tatrāṭaḥ kṛgrahaṇena grahaṇādaṭa eva pūrvaḥ suṭ
syāt, ato'ḍabhyāsayorapi kṛtayoḥ kāt pūrvaḥ suḍa|lthā syāditi
kartavyaṃ kātpūrvagrahaṇam? na kartavyam; ṭhaḍabhyāsavyavāye'pi'
tyetismādeva nirdeśādetatsiddham| na ca tatra kariṣyāmīti
kātpūrvagrahaṇam, kṛte'pyasminnasiddheḥ| tathā
hi-kriyamāṇamapyetatkālāvadhāraṇārthaṃ vā
syāt--karotestasyāmavasthāyāṃ suḍ bhavati yasyāmavasthāyāṃ bhavan
kātpūrvo bhavatīti| karotyavadhāraṇārathaṃ vā--tasya karoteḥ suḍ
bhavati yasya bhavan kātpūrvo bhavatīti| tatra pūrvasminpakṣe
yadyapyantaraṅge apyaḍadvirvacane bādhitvā kātpūrvagrahaṇasāmarthyāt
pūrvaṃ suḍ bhavati, paścātayoḥ kṛtayoriṣṭṃa siddhyati| dvitīye
tu pratyutābhyāsavatornirvṛtyarthameva kātpūrvagrahaṇaṃ syāt, na
hi tadvatorbhavan kātpūrvaḥ kṛtaḥ syāt| syādetat--na
karotyavadhāraṇārthaṃ kātpūrvagrahaṇam, kiṃ tahi ? apakṛṣya vidhiḥ,
karoteḥ sarvatra suḍa bhavati, sa tu pradeśāntare prāptaḥ kātpūrvaḥ
kartavya iti ? evamapi samaskṛta, samaskṛthā iti siddhyati, aṭaṛḥ
prākprāpnuvan kātpūrvo nīyata iti, samāskarodityādau
tvasiddhireva, katham ? pradesāntare prāptasya vidhirapakṛṣya bhavati,na
cātra suṭ prāpto'cā vyavadānāditi kathamapakṛṣya vidhirbhavet|
kathaṃ ca saṃcaskāretyādāvapi ddhiḥprayoge dvirvacane
uccāraṇabhedācchabdabheda iti dvau karotī, tatra yaḥ samo'nantaro na
tasya kakāraḥ, yasya ca kakāro nāsau samo'nantaraḥ--iti aprāptatvān
na kātpūrvaṃ vidhīyeta ? sthāne dvirvacane ca sthānivadbhāvādeka eva
karotiḥ, sa cāvyavahita iti kātu pūrvaḥ prāptaḥ kāt pūrvaḥ kṛta
iti na kaściddoṣaḥ| tadevaṃ dhātuḥ pūrvaṃ sādhanena yujyate, tataśca
kriyamāṇe'pi kātpūrvagrahaṇe naiveṣṭṃa sidhyatīti
ṭhaḍbhyāsavyavāye'pi' ityetadeva kartavyam| kātpūrvagrahaṇaṃ tu
śakyamakartumati vātiṃkakārasya pakṣaḥ|
yadi tu ṭhsamparyupaiḥ karotau' iti tṛtīyānirddaśena
samādibhirupasṛṣṭasya suḍvidhīyate, tadā
vyavahitasyāpyupasṛṣṭatvātkātpūrvagrahaṇenāpyayamarthaḥ śakyate
sampādayitam| katham? samaskarodityādau tāvadantareṇāpi
kātpūrvagrahaṇamaṭo na bhaviṣyati; tasya karotiṃ pratyanavayavatvāt|
karotestu bhaviṣyati; vyavahitasyāpyupasṛṣṭatvāt|
samaskṛtetyādau tvaṭaḥ pūrva prāpartaḥ kātpūrvaṃ ceṣyate|
saṃcaskāretyādau ca sthāne dvirvacane kātpūrvaṃ ceṣyate|
saṃcaskāretyādau ca sthāne dvirvacane kātpūrvaṃ prāptaḥ kātpūrvaṃ
kariṣyate| dviḥprayoge tu dvayorapi karotyoḥ prāptaḥ pūrvasmādeva
kariṣyate, na hi tasya kṛtaḥ kātpūrvaḥ kṛtaḥ syāditi siddhamiṣṭamga|
bhāṣyakārastu mene--ubhayaṃ na kartavyam| pūrvaṃ dhāturupasargeṇa
yujyate, tataścānu tpanna eva pratyaye saṃkṛ iti sthite suṭi kṛte
lakāraḥ, tatastannibandhanāvaḍabhyāsau sasuṭkasyaiva bhaviṣyataḥ| nanu ca
labdhasvarūpā kriyā viseṣaṇamākāṅkṣati, tallābhaśca sādhanāntara iti
pūrvaṃ dhātuḥ sādhanena yujyate, labdhvasvarupeti, ko'ratha ? kiṃ
pratipannasvarūpā, uta niṣpannasvarūpā?
niṣpatistāvadviśeṣaṇasambandhenopayujyate, pratipatistu
viśeṣaṇasambandhātprāgapi kriyāyāḥ sambhavati| viśiṣṭā ca kriyā
sādhanena yujyate, tatā hi--tiṣṭhatīti gatinivṛteḥ sādhanasambandhaḥ
pratīyate, pratiṣṭhata iti gateḥ, gacchatīti gamanasya,
āgacchatītyāgamanasya, karotīti vyāpāramātrasya, saṃskarotīti
bhūṣaṇasya| viśiṣṭā ca kriyopasargasambandhe satyeva pratīyata iti
dyotakatvena vācakatvena vā pūrvamuparsgasambandho'pekṣaṇīyaḥ|
avaśyaṃ caitadevaṃ vijñeyam; anyathā bhavaterakarmatvādbhāve lakāra
utpanne paścādanuśabdena sambande anubhūyate kambalo devadateneti
kathaṃ karmaṇi lakāraḥsyāt? ataḥ ṭhpūrvaṃ dhāturūpasargeṇa yujyate'
ityetadeva sampratipannam| evaṃ ca pūrvoktanyāsena siddhamiṣṭamiti
nārthaḥ kātpūrvagrahaṇena, nāpi ṭhaḍabhyāsavyavāye'pi' ityanena| yadi
pūrvaṃ dhāturupasargeṇa yujyate; adhyetā, pratyetā, pratyāyaka ityādau
pūrvaṃ dhātūpasargayorekādeśe tasya dhātuṃ pratyādivatvātata eva
pratyayotpatāvaniṣṭṃa prāpnoti ? naiṣa doṣaḥ, ṭhnendrasya parasya'
ityatra jñāpitametat--pūrvotarapadayostāvatkāryaṃ bhavati, paścāt
svarasandhirati| pratyaya iti vā nirdeśo'syārthasya jñāpakaḥ|
vṛttikārastu--ubhayaṃ vaktavyamiti manyamānaḥ kātpūrvagrahaṇasya
tāvatprayojanamāha--kātpūrvagrahaṇamityādi| kiṃ punarabhaktatve
prayojanam ? ata āha--tathā hīti| saṃskṛṣīṣṭeti| āśiṣi liṅ,
ātmanepadam, ṭhuśca' iti kitvam, suṭ,tayoḥ kātpūrvaḥ suṭ,
tasya karotibhaktatvāt karotigrahaṇeṇa grahaṇāt kṛñaḥ
saṃyogāditā jñāyeteti ṭhṛtaśca saṃyogādeḥ' itīṭ prasajyeta|
saṃskriyata iti| karmaṇi laṭ ṭhriṅ śayagliṅkṣu'| atrāpi bhaktatve
suṭaḥ kṛñaḥ saṃyogāditvāt ṭhguṇo'rtisaṃyogādyoḥ' iti guṇaḥ
syāt, atasyau mā bhūtāmiti abhaktaḥ suḍeṣitavya iti bhāvaḥ|
nighāto'pi tarhi na prāpnoti? samaḥ padasya suṭā vyavahitatvāt,
suṭaścāpadatvāt|
guṇaḥ kathamiti| suṭo'bhaktatvenāṅgasya saṃyogāditvābhāvātpraśanaḥ|
ṭhtanmadhyapatitastadgrahaṇena gṛhyate'iti sthānedvirvacanapakṣe
dviḥprayoge ca samudāyasyaivāṅgasaṃjñetyukt, tataśca
tadaṅgamadhyapatitaḥ tadaṅgagrahaṇena gṛhyate|
nanvevamapi asaṃyogāditvaṃ tadavastham ? ata
āha--saṃyogopadhagrahaṇaṃ ceti| antyādacaḥ pūrvasya
varṇasyopadhāsaṃjñāvidhānāt ṭhtanmadhyapatitastadgrahaṇena gṛhyate'
ityetaduktaṃ bhavati, yadi na sambhaktaḥ suṭ ṭitkaraṇaṃ kimartham ?
ityata āha---ṭitkaraṇamamiti| ṭhsuṭastusvañjām' ityucyamāne
suretyādau yaḥ suśabdau yaścopasargastasyāpi grahaṇaṃ syāt, tataśca
surāṃ paricaṣṭe parisurayatītyādāvapi prāpnoti ||

aḍbhyāsavyavāye'pi || 6|1|136 || 
vyavāyaḥuvyavadhānam, apiśabdādavyavadhāne'pi, asati tu tasmin
vyavāya eva syāt| saṃcaskaritheti| ṭhṛto bhāradvājasya'
ityetadapyasuṭa eveṣyata iti vacanādiḍāgamaḥ| pūrvaṃ dhāturityādi|
yadyapi ṭhpūrvaṃ dhātuḥ sādhanena yujyate' ityatrāpi darśane
sutarāmetadanārambhaṇīyam, tathāpi
svadarśanatvādupapannatvāccedameva darśanamupanyastam| apara
āha--ṭhkimarthaṃ punaridamucyate' ityasyānantaraṃ yāvateti
paṭhitavyam, tataśca paścādaḍabhyāsāvityevamantaścodyagranthaḥ' iti|
pariharati--abhaktuśceti| castvarthe| tatreti| abhakte| etasmistu
satītyādi| nanu cāsmādeva
vacanātkṛtayorabhyāsayostadvyavāye'pi suṭ kātpūrvaḥ
kriyatām, yastu saṃkṛ ityasyāmavasthāyāṃ suṭ prāpnoti sa kena
vāryeta? ucyate; nāprāpte tasminnasyārambhātasyānena bādhaḥ| apare
tu-etaccodyabhayādbhāṣyakāramatameva jyāyo manyante|
yakatpunaruktamādguṇaprasaṃga iti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; ṭhṛtaśca saṃyogādeḥ'
ityatra tāvadupadeśa iti vartate, kva prakṛtam? ṭhekāca
upadeśe'nudātāt' iti, tataḥ kim? ṭhapadeśe saṃyogādeḥ' iti
suṭi kṛte na bhaviṣyati| ṭhguṇo'rtisaṃyogādyoḥ' ityatrāpi
nityamityanuvartate, kva prakṛtam ? ṭhnityaṃ cchandasi'iti, tataḥ kim
? nityaṃ yaḥ saṃyogādistasya guṇaḥ ? suṭi kṛte na bhaviṣyati ||

samparyupebhyaḥ karotau bhūṣaṇe || 6|1|137 ||
sampūrvasya kvacidabhūṣaṇe'pīṣyata iti| etacca ṭhsaṃskṛtaṃka bhakṣāḥ' iti
nirdeasāllabhyate ||

samavāye ca || 6|1|138 ||
udāharaṇeṣu bhāve niṣṭhā| evaṃ samuditamityatrāpi ||

upāt pratiyatnavaikṛtavākyādhyāhāreṣu || 6|1|139 ||
sata ityādi| labdhasatākasyārthasya pūrvaṃ ye guṇā ādhīyante| yena
tadguṇāntarādhāna tatpunaḥ kimartham ? ityāha--ādhikyāyeti|
ādhikyamuvṛddhiḥ| vṛddhasya vā tādavasthayāyeti| tasya
vṛddhiyuktāvasthāyāḥ pracyutiparihārāyetyarthaḥ| samīhāuceṣṭā|
agamyamānārthasyeti| arthaprakaraṇādinā| vākyasyeti|
vākyaikadeśasyetyarthaḥ| edho dakasyeti| jātidvandvaḥ, ṭhkṛñaḥ
pratiyatne' iti ṣaṣṭhī, ṭhpratiyatnaprakathanopayogeṣu kṛñaḥ'
ityātmanepadam| upaskṛtaṃ bhuṅktu iti| kriyāviśeṣaṇam, vikṛtaṃ
bhuṅkta ityarthaḥ| upaskṛtaṃ jalpatīti| sādhyāhāraṃ yathā tathā
jalpatītyarthaḥ|
athaivaṃ kasmānna kṛtam--ṭhsampratibhyāṃ karotau bhūṣaṇasamavāyayoḥ,
upātpratiyatnavaikṛtavākyādhyāhāreṣu ca' iti ? sūtrakāraṃ pṛccha ||

kiratau lavane || 6|1|140 ||
kiratau lavanaviṣaya iti| arthadvārakaṃ kiraterlavanaviṣayatvam,
lavanaviṣaye vikṣepe yaḥ kiratirvartate tatretyarthaḥ| tadāha--vikṣipya
lunantītyartha iti| sākṣātu viṣaye kiraterlavanamevārthaḥ syāt|
ṇamulatra vaktavya iti| ābhīkṣaṇyāderṇamularthasyābhāvāt ||
hisāyāṃ prateśca || hisāyāṃ viṣaya iti| na tvabhidheyāyām| vikṣepa
eva tvabhidheyaḥ, tadeva darśayati--tatheti| udāharaṇe napuṃsake bhāve
ktaḥ, haṃśabda kope| parinivibhya eva suṭaḥ ṣatvam, na prateḥ ||

apāccatuṣpācchakuniṣvālekhane || 6|1|142 ||
tasminviṣaya iti| na tvabhidheye| vikṣepa eva tvabhidheyaḥ,
tadāraha---ālikhya vikṣipatītyartha iti|
harṣajīviketyādi| harṣaḥupramodaḥ, jīvikāuprāṇaparitrāṇopāyaḥ,
kulāyaḥuāśrayaḥ|
kiṃ punarudāharaṇa evātmanepadaṃ bhavati, na pratyudāharaṇe? ata
āhaharṣajīviketyādi ||

kustumburūṇi jātiḥ || 6|1|143 ||
sūtre napuṃsakaliṅgena bahuvacanena ca nirddeśāt phalajātāveva
suṭā bhavitavyam, na tvoṣadhijātau ? ityāśaṅkyāha--sūtranirdeśa
iti| napuṃsakaliṅgagrahaṇaṃ bahuvacanasyāpyupalakṣaṇam ||

aparasparāḥ kriyāsātatye || 6|1|143 ||
aparasparā iti| apare ca pare ceti dvandvaḥ, nipā tanādalpāctarasya
paranipātaḥ| sārthā gacchantīti| sārthabhūtā gacchantītyarthaḥ|
satatamavicchedeneti| na kadācidasmin mahāpathe gamanaṃ vicchidyata
ityarthaḥ| ayaṃ cārthaḥ suṭā dyotyate| kimidamiti| ṭhasmādeva
nipātanān malopaḥ' ityucyamāne satatamiti na siddhayati, sūtre
ṭhpyañantoccāraṇāditi praśnaḥ| kathamiti malopasya lakṣaṇaṃ na dṛśyate|
atha ṭhsātatye' ityetadeva nipātanaṃ sāmānyena tataśabde parataḥ samo
makārasya lopo bhavatītyasyārthasya jñāpakaṃ kalpyate, santatamiti na
siddhyet, bādhakatvānnipātanānāmiti manyamānasya praśnaḥ|
samastate vikalpeneti| ayamabhiprāyaḥ---sātatyaśabdaṃ
pūrvācāryalakṣaṇasiddhamuccārayatā pūrvācāryalakṣaṇamāśritam,
atastena samo makārasya lopo vidhīyata iti evañca
kṛtvāvaśyaṃprabhṛtīnāmapi kṛtyādiṣu makāralopaḥ siddho bhavati,
tadeva pūrvācāryalakṣaṇaṃ paṭhanti--lumpedityādi| antyamiti śeṣaḥ|
kṛtyapratyayānte parato'vaśyaṃśabdasyāntyaṃ lumpet, lopamasya
kuryādityarthaḥ| ṭhśe mucādīnām' iti num|
avaśyakāryamityudāharaṇam| tumiti vṛtabhaṅgabhayātṣaṣṭhī na kṛtā|
tumpratyayāntasyāntyaṃ lumpet, kāmamanasoḥ śabdayoḥ
parataḥ--kartu kāmo'sya kartukāmaḥ, kartuṃ mano'sya kartumanāḥ,
tumapyatropasaṃkhyāyate, akriyopapadatvādityāhuḥ| saṃśabdasyāntyaṃ
lumpet, vāuvikalpena, hitatayoḥ śabdayoḥ parataḥ--sahitam,
saṃhitam, satatam, saṃtatam| nagisamāsaḥ| māṃsaśabdasyāpyantyaṃ
lumpet, kva? paci, pacatidhātau| kiṃviśiṣṭe ? yuḍghañoḥ, yuṭi
ghañi ca parato yaḥ pacistasminnityarthaḥ, māspacanam, māspākaḥ,
karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhayāḥ samāsaḥ| saṃhitāyāṃ samāse caiṣa malopa
ityāhuḥ|
atha santataśabdāt pyañ bhavati vā na vā sāntatyamiti, tetyāhuḥ ||
goṣpadaṃ sevitāsevitapramāṇeṣu || gāvaḥ padyante'sminniti| ṭhpuṃsi
saṃjñāyām' ityadhikaraṇe ghaḥ, kartari ṣaṣṭha|la samāsaḥ|
agoṣpadānyaraṇyānīti| nanu ca sūtre goṣpadaśabda upātaḥ, tat
kimidam? ityata āha--asevita ityādi| kriyate
cedamasevitagrahaṇam, na ca tatra goṣpadaśabdaḥ sambhavati,
tasmādasevite goṣpadaśabdārthanipātanaṃ vijñāyate| nārtha eteneti|
asevitagrahaṇena| kathaṃ tena vinā siddhiḥ ?
tatrāha--goṣpadapratiṣedhāditi| satyamiti| goṣpadapratiṣedhāditi
yaduktam, tat satyaṃ manyate, na tu nārtha eteneti| tad yadi
satyam, kimarthaṃ tarhyasevitagrahaṇam ? ityāha--yatra tviti|
nañsamāso hi tatpuruṣaḥ
svabhāvādutarapadārthasadṛśamarthamācaṣṭe-abrāhmaṇavat, tataśca na
goṣpadamagoṣpadamiti nañsamāse kṛte yatra sevitasya sevanasya
prasaṅgo'sti, tatraivāgoṣpadamiti syāt, sa eva goṣpada sya
deśasya sadṛśaḥ; yatra tvatyantāsmbhava eva sevitasya tatra na syāt|
asevita grahaṇasāmarthyātu bahuvrīhirāśrīyate, sa cātyantābhāve'pi
bhavati| tena yeṣu gavāmatyantāsambhavaḥ,
tānyaraṇyānyāsevitaśabdenocyante| tataśca tatrāpyagoṣpadamiti
bhavati| atyantāsambhavaṃ spaṣṭayati--yāni hi mahāntyaraṇyānīti| tatra
kecidāhuḥ--yatra gavāmatyantāsambhavaḥ, tatraivāgoṣpadaśabdaḥ
prayoktavyaḥ, na tvasambhava iti| anye tvaviśeṣeṇecchanti| na
caivamasevitagrahaṇasya vaiyarthyam, asati hyasminnatyantāsambhave na
syāt| goṣpadapūramiti| ṭhvarṣapramāṇa ūlopaścāsyānyatarasyām'
iti ṇamul| nanu ca goṣpadamiti ṣaṣṭhīsamāso'yam, tasya goḥ
sambandhi padamarthaḥ, na tu pramāṇam? tatrāha--nātra goṣpadaṃ
svārthapratipādanārthamupādīyata iti| tathā ca goṣpadapūraṃ vṛṣṭe
deva iti| asatyapi goṣpadapūraṇe prayujyate, yathā--celaknopaṃ
vṛṣṭo deva ityasatyapi celakrope ||

āspadaṃ pratiṣṭhāyām || 6|1|146 ||
ātmayāpanāyeti| prāṇadhāraṇamuātmayāpanam, tadartha yatsthānam, sā
pratiṣṭhā| āspadamiti| āṅpūrvātpadeḥ pūrvavadadhikaraṇe ghaḥ,
lokāśrayatvādasmādeva nipātanādvā napuṃsakaliṅgatā,
āpadamityavyayībhāvasamāsaḥ ||

āścaryamanitye || 6|1|147 ||
yadyāścaryamanitye nipātyate, ghaṭādāvatiprasaṅgaḥ ? ityata
āha--anityatayetyādi| loke yadanucitamadṛṣṭapūrvamupalabhyate,
tadanityātayā vyāptaṃ kādācitkatvam, ato'nityatā viṣayabhūtā
bhavati| tathā viṣayabhūtayā adbhūtatvaṃ pismayahetutvamupalakṣyate|
udāharaṇe ṭhanavaklṛptyamarṣayorakiṃvṛte'pi'
ityanavaklṛptāvasambhāvanāyāṃ liṅ| rugṇasya mandakarṇasya
cāviśiṣṭe kālādau bhojanamadhyayanaṃ cādṛṣṭapūrvaṃ
dṛśyamānamadbhūtaṃ bhavatīti| āścaryamiti| ṭhcarerāṅ cāguriu' iti
yan| ācaryamanuṣṭheyamityarthaḥ ||

varcaske'vaskaraḥ || 6|1|148 ||
kutsitaṃ varco varcaskam, ṭhkutsite' iti kan, ṭhso'padādau' iti
satvam| kanā nirddeśo dīptau mā bhūditi, dīptāvapi hi
varcaḥśabdo vartate| annamalamiti| bhāṇḍeṣu yallagnaṃ
kāṣṭhādinā'pakṛṣya kākādibhyo vikīryate tadannamalam| avakīryata
iti| bhūmāvavakṣipyata ityarthaḥ| tatsambandhād deśopīti| yatra
bhāṇḍāni parimṛjyante deśe sa deśaḥ| tathā ca yājñavalkayaḥ---
ṭhsammārjitāvaskarayā vyaye cāmuktahastayā' iti| apara āha--purīṣaṃ
varcaskaṃ taddeśaśceti| avakara iti| brahmacāriṇaḥ striyāṃ retaḥ
sekauavakaraḥ, yato'vakīrṇo bhavati ||

apaskaro rathāṅgam || 6|1|149 ||
atra sūtre tṛtīya upasargaḥ, pūrvatra ṣaṣṭhaḥ ||

viṣkiraḥ śakunirvikiro vā || 6|1|150 ||
viṣkiro vetyādi| śakunāvabhidheye viṣkira iti vā suṇnipātyata
ityetāvataiva suṅvikalpaḥ siddha ityarthaḥ| vikiragrahaṇamityādi|
asati tasmin kapratyayāntasya vikiraśabdasya śakunau
vikalpārthamevedaṃ vacanaṃ syāditi vikiraśabdasyānyatra prayogo na
nivartitaḥ syāditi| punarvikiragrahaṇe tu sati bhavati| yathā tu
bhāṣyaṃ tathā ṭhviṣkiraḥ śakunau vā' ityetāvat sūtram ||

hrasvāccandrotarapade mantre || 6|1|151 || 
suḍāgamo bhavatīti| pūrvaṃ kātpūrvagrahaṇādabhaktaḥ suḍityuktam, iha
tu kātpūrvatvaṃ na sambhavati, āgamaliṅgaṃ ca ṭitvamastītyāgama eva
suḍukta iti bhāvaḥ| sa ca bhavan ṭhubhayanirdeśe pañcamīnirddeśo
balīyān' iti candraśabdasyaiva bhavati, sūryācandramasāviti| dvandvaḥ,
ṭhdevatādvandve ca' ityānaṅ| 
utarapadamityādi| svanikāyaprasiddhireveṣā ||

pratiṣkaśaśca kaśeḥ || 6|1|152 ||
atra yadyapītyādi| kaśeriti| yaddhātorupādānaṃ tasya
nānyatprayojanamiti bhāvaḥ||

praskaṇvahariścandrāvṛṣī || 6|1|153 ||
hariścandro rājarṣiḥ| prakaṇvo deśa iti| kaṇvamupāpam, tatpragataṃ
yasmātsa evamucyate| ihiḥ candro yasya mugdhasya sa haricandraḥ| 

maskaramaskariṇau veṇuparivrājakayoḥ || 6|1|154 ||
parivrājake tvinirapīti| matvarthābhāvādiniraprāptaḥ, ataḥ so'pi
nipātyate, na hi parivrājako makareṇa tadvān, maskareṇa tu
veṇunā tadvān bhavati; daṇḍadhāraṇāt, tataḥ kim ?
maskaraśabdādininā siddham| evamapi saṃyoge
matvarthīyavidhānānmaskarasaṃyukta eva maskarītyucyeta, mā bhūdevaṃ
parivrājakamātravacano yathā syāditīnirnipātyate,
vyutpateradarśanādvā nātra spaṣṭṃa nipātyam, taddarśayati--keciditi|
mākaraṇaśīla iti| pratiṣedhaśīlasa ityarthaḥ| karmāpavāditvāditi|
karmaśabdeneha kāmyamarmāṇi vivakṣitāni, na nityanaimitikāni,
tāni hi mamukṣorapi kartavyāni| yathā''huḥ--
mokṣārthī na pravarteta tataḥ kāmyanipiddhayoḥ|
nityanaimitike kuryāt pratyavāyanivṛtaye || iti |
tāni karmāṇyapavadituṃ pratiṣeddhuaṃ śīlamasya sa karmāpavādī|
paramahaṃsāstu karmamātramapavadanti| mā kuruteti| na
kartavyānītyarthaḥ| karmaṇi luṅ ||

kāstīrājastunde nagare || 6|1|155 ||
kecinnagare iti prathamādvivacanāntabhāhuḥ| vṛtau tu saptamyantaṃ
vyākhyātm| kātīramiti| ṭhīṣadarthe ca' iti kābhāvaḥ ||

kāraskaro vṛkṣa || 6|1|156 ||
pāraskaraprabhṛtiṣveveti| nedaṃ sūtramadhīyata ityarthaḥ ||

pāraskaraprabhṛtīni ca saṃjñāyām || 6|1|157 ||
rūḍhiśabdā ete yathākathañcidvyutpādyāḥ| pāhaṅkarotīti pāraskaraḥ,
ṭhkṛño hetu' ityādinā ṭaḥ| rathaṃ yātīti rathaṣyā| ṭhāto'nupasarge
kaḥ'| ṣatvāgapyatra nipātyate| anye tu sakārameva paṭhanti| kiṃ
karotīti karoterḍuḥ, kimo'ntyalopaḥ, suṭ, kiṣkuḥ|
kimapi dhate kiṣkindhā | pūrvavatkaḥ, kimo dvirvacanaṃ pūrvasya
malopaḥ, suṭa, ubhayatrāpyatra ṣatvamapi nipātyate| tatkarotīti
taskaraḥ| atra hi tacchabdena corakarma prasiddhaṃ nindyaṃ parāmṛśyate|
prātumpatāviti| ṭhtupa tumpa hiṃsārthau' ityetasmindhātau parataḥ
praśabdātparaḥ suḍ bhavati dhātvarthasya ced gauḥ kartā bhavati,
prastumpatīti yatne tibante suṭ| svaśabdena dhātugrahaṇātadādāvapi
bhavati prastumpato gāvau, prastumpanti gāva iti|
citicitayoriti| ṭhcitī saṃjñāne', ktin, ṭhnapuṃsake bhāve ktaḥ'|
prāyo nāma tapaḥ proktaṃ citaṃ niścaya ucyate|
tapo niścayasaṃyogātprāyaścitamiti smṛtam ||

anudātaṃ padamekavarjam || 6|1|158 ||
ekavarjamiti| ekaṃ varjayitvetyarthaḥ| ṭhdvitīyāyāṃ ca' iti ṇamul|
tatra hi parīpsāyāmiti prāyikam| atra yadi padamiti
jātāvekavacanaṃ syātadaikavarjanamityekaśabdenāpi pratyāsatyā
padamevocyeta, tataścāyamartho bhavati--vākye padānyanudātāni
bhavanti ekaṃ padaṃ varjayitveti| anudātaśabdaścedānīṃ laukikaḥ,
loke hyacāmanudātādiguṇāyoge halapi tadanuraktatvātaddharmā gṛhyata
iti ajjñalsamudāyarūpaṃ padamevānudātamiti sāmānādhikaraṇyena
vyapadiśati| atra pakṣe kimekaṃ varjanīyamiti niyamakāraṇābhāvāt
sarveṣāmeva padānāṃ paryāyeṇa varjanātsvaraniyamo na syāt|
tasmātpadamiti vyaktinirddeśaḥ, vivakṣitaṃ caikatvam|
anudātaśabdaśca ṭhnīcairanudātaḥ' ityajviśeṣe pāribhāṣika iti
tasyaivagrahaṇaṃ yuktam| ekaśabdenāpi sannidhānādajevocyate| kathaṃ
tarhyajjhalsamudāyarūpasya padasyājmātravācinānudātaśabdena
sāmānādhikaraṇyam ? avayavāvayavinorabhedopacārāt
arsāadyacpratyāyāntatvādvā'nudātāckaṃ padamevānudātam| yadyevam,
anudātaśabdenāpi padameva prādhānyenocyate ajguṇābhāveneti
punarapyekaśabdasya saṃkhyeyāpekṣāyāṃ pradhānabhūtapadameva saṃkhyeyaṃ
prāpnoti ? ucyate; padamityekatvaṃ vivakṣitamityuktam, tatraikaṃ
padamanudātāckaṃ bhavatyekaṃ padaṃ varjayitveti nāyamarthaḥ sambhavatīti
sāmarthyād guṇabhūto'pyajevaikaśabdenocyate |
yadvā, padaśabdo'pi lakṣaṇayā tatstheṣvaktu vartate, tatrācāṃ
padaśthatvāvyabhicārādekatvavivakṣārthameva padagrahaṇam| sarvathā
tvayamartho vivakṣitaḥ---ekasminpade vartamānā aco'nudātā bhavanti
ekamacaṃ varjayitveti| evaṃ sthite yadīdaṃ svatantraṃ lakṣaṇaṃ syātadā
niyamo vā syād--ekamacaṃ varjayitvā, pariśiṣṭamanudātameva
bhavatīti vidhirvā|
tatrādye pakṣe yeṣāmacāṃ lakṣaṇāantareṇodātaḥ svarito vā vidhīyate,
tatrāniyamaprasaṅgābhāvātadvyatiriktaviṣayamevedaṃ bhavati| asti hi
tatrāniyamaprasaṅgaḥ; asvarasyāca uccāraṇāsambhavāt| ekavarjamiti|
yasya yasyodātasvaritavidhānaṃ sa sa varjya ityartho bhavati|
tataścatvāra ityādāvāgamādīnāṃ pṛthak svaraprasaṅgaḥ, āmalakīja
ityatra ṅīṣaḥ pratyayādyaudātatvam, ṭhgatikārakopapadātkṛt' iti
jaśabdasyodātatvam, ṭhdīrghakāśatuṣabhrāṣṭravaṭṃa je'iti
pūrvapadādyaudātatvam, ṭhantyātpūrvaṃ bahvacaḥ' iti
lakārākārasyodātatvamiti yugapadudātacatuṣṭayaprasaṅgaḥ| nanu ca
nāprāpte kṛtsvara ārabhyamāṇena ṭhdīrghakāśa'
ityādyaudātatvenāpoditatvādeva kṛtsvaro na bhaviṣyati,
tathā''dyaudātatvaṃ kuṭīja ityādau sāvakāśam, upasaraja ityādau
sāvakāśena ṭhantyātpūrvaṃ bahvacaḥ' ityanena paratvādbādhiṣyata iti
kathamudātuṣṭayaprasaṅgaḥ ? ucyate; virodhe samānaphalatve
bādhyabādhakabhāvaḥ, vipratiṣedho'pi virodha eva, taccobhayaṃ svareṣu
nāstīti kṛtkṛtyapratyayasaṃjñānāmiva samāveśaprasaṅgaḥ| satyapabi
vipratiṣedhe ṅīṣa udātatve kṛte paścāt ṭhantyātpūrvaṃ bahvacaḥ'
ityetasminpravṛte|pi pūrvakṛtasya ṅīṣa
udātasyānivṛteraniṣṭameva| yadi ca yasya
yasyodātasvaritavidhānam, taṃ taṃ varjayitvā
pariśiṣṭamanudātamevet«athaḥ syāt, tadā padamekavarjamiti dvayamapi
vyarthaṃ syāt| sāmānyenāco'nudātā ityevāstu,
pratyayādyaudātatvādiviṣaye tairbādhitatvādevānudātatvaṃ na
bhaviṣyati| tasmātpadamekavarjamiti vacanānnāyaṃ svatantro niyamaḥ|
atha vidhiḥ ? tadā yeṣāmacāṃ lakṣaṇāntareṇodātaḥ svarito vā na
vidhīyate, taṣvapyanudātasya pakṣe prāptatvādvidhiranupapanna iti
lakṣaṇāntareṇa yeṣāmudātaḥ svarito vā vihitaḥ, ta ekasminpade
vartamānā anudātā bhavantyekamacaṃ varjayitvet«athaḥ syāt| ka eka
varjya iti na jñāyeta! athāpi paranityādibhirvyavasthā ? evamapi
satiśiṣṭenāpi vyavasthā na syāt| kathamaupagavatvamityatra dve
pratyayādyaudātatve ? tatraikasyānudātatvaṃ vidīyamānaṃ kasya bhavatu ?
udātasvaritavyatiriktānāṃ cācāmaniyamaprasaṅga evāvatiṣṭheta|
tadevaṃ svatantre'smin vidhau niyame vā neṣṭṃa siddhyati|
athādhikāraḥ syātadā ṭhkakarṣātvato ghaño'ntaḥ' ityatrāsyopasthāne
satyayamartho bhavati--karṣaśabapdasyākāravato'nta udāto bhavati,
tamekaṃ varjayitvā tasminpade vartamānāḥ pariśiṣṭā aco'nudātā
bhavantīti| evamanyatrāpi--yatra yatropasthānaṃ tatra tatra vidhīyamānasya
svarasyopalakṣaṇārtham| tena ṭhtavai cāntaśca yugapat', ṭhubhe
vanaspatyādiṣu yugapat' ityādau dvayorapi varjanaṃ bhavati|
indrābṛhaspatī ityatra bṛhaspatiśabdo vanaspatyāditvād dvayudāte
indraśabdena dvandve ṭhdevatādvandve ca' iti dvayorapi prakṛtisvaratvamiti
trayaṇāṃ varjanaṃ bhavatītyevaṃ ṣāṣṭhike svare na kīściddoṣaḥ|
ṭhādyaudātaśca', ṭhsamānodare śayita o codātaḥ'
ṭhasthidadhisakthyakṣaṇāmanaṇudātaḥ' ityādiṣu pradeśāntaravartiṣu
svavidhiṣvasyānupasthānāteṣu pariśiṣṭasyānudātatvaṃ na syāt,
ekavarjamiti ca vyarthaṃ syāt| kathamanudātaṃ
padamityevādhikāro'stu, na cevaṃ tatatsūtravihitasyāpi
svarasyānudātaprasaṅgaḥ, tadvidhānasāmarthyāt| tadevaṃ
pakṣāntarasambhavātparibhāṣeyamiti niścityāha--paribhāṣeyamiti|
liṅgavatī ceyam, svaravidhiśca
liṅgamityāha--svaravidhiviṣayeti|
yatrānya iti| anudātāpekṣamanyatvam| udātaḥ svarito veti|
anudātasyānudātavarjanaṃ vyarthamiti tadvirodhād udātaḥ svarito
vā parisaṃkhyeyaḥ, tadvidhāvevāsyopasthānamiti bhāvaḥ|
upariyatamityanena svaravidhibhirasyaikavākyātā darśatā| kaḥ
punariti| varjyaviśeṣasya sūtre'nirdeśātpraśanaḥ| yasya svaro
vidhīyata iti| yatredamupatiṣṭhate tatra yaḥ svaro vidhīyate sa ucyate|
asāviti| yadi hyasāvapi na varjyeta tasya tatsvaravidānamanarthakaṃ
syāt| dhātusvaraṃ śanāsvaro bādhata iti| satiśiṣṭena vyavasthāyā
vakṣayamāṇatvāt| śnāsvaraṃ tassvaraṃ iti| bādhata ityanuṣaṅgaḥ| atrāpi
heturvakṣyate, vikaraṇasvarastu satiśiṣṭo'pi' ityatra
tassvaramāmsvara iti| pūrvavadanuṣaṅga| satiśiṣṭatvaṃ hetuḥ|
āgamasyetyādi| upalakṣaṇametat| anena hi tatallakṣaṇābhinirvṛtānāṃ
bahūnāmudātasvaritānāṃ samāveśanivṛttiḥ prayojanamasyetyucyate|
na caitāvadeva prayojanam, yeṣāmapi kenāpi svarita udāto vā na
vidhīyate, yathā'nekākṣu pratyayeṣu dhātuṣu
vā''dhantavyatiriktānāmacāṃ teṣāmapyanudātaniyamasyaitadadhīnatvāt|
catvāra iti| ṭhcateruran' iti caturśabda ādyaudātaḥ| anaḍvāha iti|
ṭhanasi vaheḥ kvivab uścānasaḥ' iti kvip, yajāditvāt
samprasāraṇam, anaḥ--śabdo'sanpratyayānta ādyaudātaḥ,
ṭhgatikārakopapadātkṛt' ityutarapadaprakṛtisvareṇa dhātoranta
udātaḥ| asthanīti| ṭhasisañjibhyāṃ kyin' ityādyaudāto'sthiśabdaḥ,
dadhiśabdaḥ ṭhnabviṣayasyānisantasya' ityādyaudātaḥ| nabiti
napuṃsakākhyā| yasyāsau svaro vidhīyate sa varjyate ityuktam|
sarveṣāṃ cāgamādīnāṃ svaro vidhīyata ityaviśeṣaṇa varjanaprasaṅga
ityata āha--paranityāntaraṅgāpavādairiti| sa tasminyoge
sarveṣāmeva teṣāṃ svakasvaravarjyamanyamanudātaṃ cikīrṣatā
parasparavirodha upajāyate, paratvādibhiryuktaiva vyavastā|
satiśiṣṭena ceti| vyavasthetyapekṣate| etadeva vivṛṇoti--yo
hīti| sāmānyenoktamudāharaṇaniṣṭhṃa karoti--tathā hīti| etacca
satiśiṣṭasya bādhakatvaṃ nyāyatassiddham|
kathamudātasvaritavidibhirekavākyatāpannayā'nayā śeṣanighātaḥ kriyata
ityuktam, tataḥ kim? utsargasyāpavādasya vā yā caramā
pravṛttistasyāmidamupatiṣṭhate, evañca tasyaiva lakṣaṇasya yacā caramā
pravṛttistatrāsyā upasthāne pūrvā pravṛttirbādhyate,
tadyathaupagavatvamiti| atra hi ṭhādyadātaśca' ityasya pratipratyayamāvṛtau
tvapratyaye yadā pravartate tadā'nayā nighātaḥ kriyate| yadi
satiśiṣṭasvaro bādhakaḥ, vikaraṇasvaro'pi lasārvadhātukasvarasya
bādhakaḥ prāpnoti ? tatrāha--vikaraṇasvarastiviti| evaṃ
manyate--yadayaṃ tāseḥ parasya lasārvadhātukasyānudātatvaṃ śāsti
tajjñāpakamuktasvārthasya; anyathā yadyapi lāvasthāyāṃ tāsividhīyate,
tathāpi lakāramāvāpekṣatvādantaraṅgeṣu ca lādeśeṣu kṛteṣu
paścātāsiriti tatsvarasya satiśiṣṭatvāccheṣanighātenaiva
siddheranarthakaṃ tatsyāditi|
vibhaktisvarāditi| satiśiṣṭatvādvibhaktisvare prāpte vacanam|
nañsvareṇeti| ṭhtatpuruṣe tulyārtha' iti prakṛtibhāvavihitena|
vibhaktinimitasvarāditi| vibhaktirnimitaṃ yasya tasya yaḥ
svarastasmādityarthaḥ| vākye hītyādi| devadataśabda
ārmontratasvareṇādyaudātaḥ, gābhityādyaudātaḥ, gamerḍoḥ pratyayasvaraḥ,
ṭhoto'mśasoḥ' ityātvamekādeśaḥ, ṭhekādeśa udātenodātaḥ',
ṭhnipātā ādyaudātāḥ' ṭhupasargāścābhivarjam' ityādyaudātatve
varjitatvādabheḥ phiṣityanenāntodātatvam| phiṣiti prātipadikasya
pūrvācāryāṇāṃ saṃjñā| āṅ upasargasvareṇādyaudātaḥ| ajerloṭ,
ṭhtiṅṅatiṅaḥ' iti nidhātaḥ, khuklaśabdaḥ
prātipadikasvareṇāntodātaḥ| ṭāpā vibhaktayā ca ṭhekādeśa
udātenodātaḥ'| tadevaṃ padagrahaṇādvākye pṛthageva svaro bhavati|
nanu ca yadi vākye'pi śeṣanighātaḥ syāt, tataśca
satiśiṣṭasvaratvādināṃ vyavasthāpakānāṃ tatrāsambhavātka eko
varjanīya iti na jñāyeta? satyam; viśeṣāgrahaṇātparyāyeṇa varjanaṃ
bhaviṣyati| yadi tarhi padagrahaṇaṃ kriyate, evaṃ sati yāvat padasaṃjñā
na bhavati, tāvaccheṣanighātena na bhavitavyam, tataśca kuvalyā
vikāraḥ kauvalamityatrānudātādeścetyañna prāpnoti, yataḥ
kuvalaśabdo'yaṃ grāmāditvenādyaudātaḥ, gaurāditvānṅīṣi
vihite'pi padavyapadeśābhāvādādyaudātatvaṃ na parityajati ? ityata
āha--parimāṇārthaṃ ceti| padamatra gauṇamabhipretam, yasya padasaṃjñā
bhaviṣyati na mukhyam; padādhikāre punaḥ padagrahaṇāt| kiṃ
codātasvaritavidhibhirekībhūya śeṣanighātaḥ kriyata ityuktam,
tasyāṃ ca daśāyāṃ yuṣmadasmadoṇÇósi, ṅyi cetyādāveva padatvaṃ
niṣpannaṃ bhavati, na punaḥ ṭhdhātoḥ' ityādiṣu dhātvādyaupadeśānantaraṃ
pravartamāneṣu| ataśca tairekībhūtasya padaśabdasya tadaikadeśe'pi
bhaviṣyati vṛttiḥ| yadyevam, yatra yatrāsyopasthānaṃ tatra tatra sava
padam, tato'pi cānyatra nyūnaṃ na kāryitvena saṃnihitamiti
tatraivākṣu pariśiṣṭamanudātaṃ bhaviṣyati, nārtho vākyanivṛtyarthena
padagrahaṇena? ucyate; asati padaghaṇe dātoranta udāto bhavati
pariśiṣṭamanudātamityukte dhātoreva yatpariśiṣṭṃa tadanudātamiti
gamyeta; evam ṭhādyaudātaśca' ityādau, tataśca dhātupratyayayoḥ
pṛthaksvaraḥ syādeva| ata ekapade bhaviṣyatāṃ sarveṣāmevānudātatvaṃ
yathā syādityevamarthaṃ padagrahaṇam|

kāśikāvṛttiḥ--4 (coddyatddvdyatod ḍhddhom 10dyaṇ trdvthy 2002)
--------
padamañjarī
--------

padādhikārasya nivṛtti karotīti| gauṇārthametatpadagrahaṇaṃ
mukhyapadādhikārasya nivṛttiṃ kārayati| tena kiṃ siddhaṃ bhavati?
tatrāha-teneti| jñāpakamapyasminnarthe darśayati--garbhiṇīśabdaśceti|
garbho'syā astīti matvarthīya iniḥ, ṅīp| garbhaśabdo grāmādiḥ| tatra
yadīnipratyayasyodātavidhisamakālamevānudātatvaṃ bhavati, tato
garbhiṇīśabdasyānudātāditvād ṭhanudātādeḥ' ityāñi prāpte
tadbādhanārthaṃ yujyate tasya bhikṣādiṣu pāṭhaḥ| atha padasaṃjñāyā
utarakālaṃ śiṣṭasyānudātatvaṃ bhavet, tato garbhiṇīśabda ādyaudātaḥ
syāt, tataścāño bādhanārthaṃ bhikṣādiṣu na paṭhitavyaḥ syāt|
kuvalagarbhaśabdāvādyaudātāviti| tatra cokta eva prakāraḥ, tataḥ
kuvalaśabdādañsiddhaye āśrayaṇīyam| garbhiṇīśabdaśca jñāpakamupapadyata
iti bhāvaḥ| atredaṃ
codyate-udātasvaritavidhibhirekībhūtamapyetanniyamārthaṃ ced
vihitasvararahitaṣvevasyāt, vidhyarthaṃ ced vihitasvareṣveva
syād--iti prāgukto dośastadavastha eva? ucyate; uktaṃ
padagrahaṇamekasminpade'ntarbhūtānāṃ sarveṣāmanudātatvamiti, ato
yathaitadupapadyate tathā vidhirūpeṇa, niyamarūpeṇa, ubhayarūpeṇa vā
pravṛttirbhaviṣyati|

karṣātvato ghaño'nta udātaḥ || 6|1|159 ||
ādasyāstītyātvān, ṭhtasau matvarthe' iti bhasaṃjñā, karṣaścātvāṃśceti
samāhāradvandvaḥ| vikṛtanirdeśa iti| vikaraṇāntasyedamanukaraṇam,
na tu ghañantanirdeśa iti bhāvaḥ| atha kimartho matubnirdeśaḥ, yāvatā na
kvacidapyākārātparo ghañastīti sāmarthyātadvato grahaṇaṃ bhaviṣyati?
ucyate; ghañākṣipto dhāturāta ityanena viśeṣyeta, tatra tadantavidhau
jñāyamāne ānantaryasyāsambhavādvidhānaṃ viśeṣyeta--ākārāntādyo
vihita iti, tataśca dāya ityādāveva syāt, pāka ityādau tu na
syāt; matubnirddeśātu sarvatra bhavatīti| lākṣaṇikasyāpyātvato
grahaṇamiṣyate; vṛṣādiṣu kāmapāmapadānāṃ pāṭhāt|
ṭhalo'ntyasya' ityeva siddhe'ntagrahaṇamutarārtham ||

uñchādīnāṃ ca || 6|1|160 || 
ṭhucchi ucche', ṭhmleccha avyakte śabde'| ṭhjaji yuddhe', atra kutvābhāvo
nipātanāt, ṭhjalpa vyaktāyāṃ vāci' ṭhvyadha tāḍane',
ṭhvyadhajaporanupasarge' ityap| vadha iti| ṭhhanaśca vadhaḥ' ityap|
kālaviśeṣa iti| katadvāparādau| ṭhghṛ gṛ nigaraṇe', ṭhṛdorap'|
viṣamityanena dūṣyaśabdasya viśeṣa vṛttiṃ darśayati|
ṭhvida jñāne', ṭhovijī bhayacalanayoḥ', ṭhveṣṭa veṣṭane', ṭhbandha
bandhane', ṭhṣṭuañ stutau', ṭhyu miśraṇe', ṭhdru gatau'|
upasamastārthametaditi| kevalānāṃ dhātūnāṃ kvibantānāṃ
dhātusvareṇaiva siddhatvāt| pariṣṭuaditi| sampadāditvātkvip,
tena prādisamāsaḥ, ṭhpūrvapadāt' iti ṣatvam|
avyayapūrvapadaprakṛtisvare prāpte'ntodātatvam| sopapadātu kvipi
kṛtsvareṇaiva casiddham|
anyatra madhyodāta iti| sa hi ṭhvṛtu vartane' ityasmādinipratyayena
vyutpādyate| ṭhdṛ vidāraṇe'|
sāmbatāpau bhāvagarhāyāmiti| sāmbo bhikṣate, ambayā saha bhikṣaṇaṃ
garhitam| bahuvrīhau pūrvapadaprakṛtisvarasyāpavādaḥ| tāpo
dasyūnām| dhārmikeṣu dasyukartṛkastāpo garhitaḥ| ṭhkarṣātvataḥ'
ityeva siddhe bhāvagarhāyā anyātrā''dyaudātārthaṃ vacanam| 
utamaśaśvatamāviti| tamabantāvetau| dravyaprakarṣavivakṣāyāmāmabhāvaḥ,
pitvādanudāte prāpte pāṭhaḥ| sarvatreti| bhāvagarhāyām, anyatra ca|
cchandasi, bhāṣāyāṃ cetyanye|
ṭhbhakṣa adane' curādiḥ, ṭhmantha viloḍane', ṭhbhuja kauṭilye', ṭhdiha
upacaye'| erajaṇyantānāmiti| ye tu anārṣametadacanamityāhuḥ,
teṣāṃ bhakṣaśabdasya pāṭhe prayojanaṃ mṛgyam ||

anudātasya ca yatrīdātalopaḥ || 6|1|161 ||
kumāraśabdo'ntodāta iti| phiṣityanena| anyatrāpi
prātipadikasyāntodātatvamanenaiva draṣṭavyam| pathinśabdo'ntodāta
iti| ṭhpatestha ca' itīnpratyayāntatvāt| kumudādayo'ntodātā iti|
kumudaśabdo mūlavibhujāditvātkapratyayāntaḥ, naḍaśabdo'vyutpannaḥ,
ṭhvi gatyādiṣu' asmādasac, tuḍāgamaśca|
vetasaścitsvareṇāntodātaḥ|
prāsaṅgya iti| prāsajyata iti prāsaṅgaḥ, karmaṇi ghañantaḥ, ṭhtadvahati'
iti ṭhprāgghitādyat' iti yat| naitadastīti| udāto lupyata iti|
yatasya pratiṣedhaḥ| kathaṃ naitadasti ? ityāha--svarite hīti| ṭhprāgeva
padasaṃjñāyāḥ svaravidhisamakālameva śeṣanighāto bhaviṣyati' ityuktaṃ
purastāt| tat kuta udātalopa iti| na kuta"sicidityarthaḥ|
tadetadityādi| yasmādevamanudātagrahaṇasya vyāvartya na sambhavati,
tasmādetadanudātagrahaṇamāderanudātārtham |
athāsatyanudātagrahaṇe kasya syāt? ityata āha--anta iti| mā hi
dhukṣātāmiti| duhermāṅ luṅitmanepadam, ātāmāthāmau, cleḥ
ksaḥ| ṭhadupadeśāt' iti lasārvadhātukānudātatvam, ksaḥ
pratyayasvareṇāntodātaḥ, ṭhksasyāci' ityakāralopaḥ| māṅḥ
prayogo'ḍāgamanivṛtyarthaḥ, aṭi hi sati padamādyaudātaṃ bhavati,
hiśabdaprayogaḥ ṭhhi ca' iti nighātapratiṣedhārthaḥ|
atrāsatyanudātagrahaṇe ātāmāthāmordvitīyasyāca udātaḥ syāt,
antādhikārāt; sati tvasminnāderbhavati| idaṃ du vaktavyam,
ṭhyatrodātalopaḥ' ityucyamāne kathamantyasya prasaṅgaḥ, na hi
tadudātalopasya nimitamiti ? ucyate; āderapi tarhi na prāpnoti,
tasyānudātalopaṃ pratyanimitatvāt, ṭhksasyāci' ityajādau pratyaye
vidhānāt| tasmādyatra pratyaya
udātalopastatsambandhino'nudātasyodāto bhavatīti
sūtrārthe'ntādhikārādantyasya prasaṅga| yadi tu nimitatvānādareṇa
yatrānudāte parataḥ udātalopaḥ, tasyodāto bhavatīti sūtrārthaḥ,
tadā nāntyasya prasaṅgaḥ|
bhṛgava iti| ṭhatribhṛgukutsa' ityādinā bahuṣu luk| tatra
bahuṣvityarthagrahaṇam, na bahuvacanasya| vaidīti| vidādyañantāt
ṭhśārṅgaravādyaño ṅīn' ||

citaḥ || 6|1|163 ||
bhaṅguramiti| ṭhcajoḥ ku ghiṇyatoḥ' iti kutvam| kuṇḍinā iti|
kuṇkaḍaśabdānmatvarthīya iniḥ, striyāṃ ṅīp, kuṇḍinīśabdo
madhyodātaḥ, kuṇḍinyā apatyāni bahūni, gargādiyaño bahuṣu
luk, pariśiṣṭasya kuṇḍinajādeśaḥ|
citi pratyaye iti| nanu ca nātra citīti pratyayagrahaṇaṃ
kuṇkaḍinajāderapi grahaṇāt ? tasmādayamatrārthaḥ---yatra
citpratyayastatra samudāyasyeṣyata iti| kathaṃ punaretallabhayate? cita
ityavayavādeṣā ṣaṣṭhī, na kāryiṇaḥ, cito'vayavasya sambandhī yaḥ
samudāyaḥ sa kāryā| atha vā--cidasyāstīti citaḥ,
arśāaderākṛtigaṇatvādac pratyayaḥ, ṣaṣṭha|lrthe prathamā, tena cidvataḥ
samudāyasyetyarthaḥ| atra ca liṅgam-akaḥ citkaraṇam, anyathā
tasyaikāctvādanarthakaṃ tatsyāt|
kuṇkaḍinajādervyapadeśivadbhāvena cidvatvam ||

taddhitasya || 6|1|164 || 
kauñjāyanā iti| kuñjasyāpatyāni bahuni, ṭhgotre
kuñjādibhyaścphañ', ṭhvrātacphañorastriyām' iti ñyaḥ,
ṭhñkayādayastadrājāḥ', ṭhtadrājasyabahuṣ' luk|
kimarthaṃmiti| pūrveṇa siddhamiti praśnaḥ| paramapīti| cakāraḥ
ṭhbrātacphañorastriyām' ityatra viśeṣaṇena caritārthaḥ| ñakāro'pi
vṛddhyarthaḥ, tatrāsatyasminparatvād ñitsvaraḥ ||

tisṛbhyo jasaḥ || 6|1|166 ||
arthagataṃ bahutvaṃ śabde āropya bahuvacananirddeśaḥ| tisna iti|
antodātasya triśabdasya sthāne tisṛśabda ādeśaḥ
sthānivapadbhāvādantodātaḥ| ṭhanudātau suppitau' iti
jasanudātaḥ, tatrā'ci parataḥ ṭhaci ra ṛtaḥ'| ṭhjasaḥ' iti kimartham ?
tisṛkā, svārthe ka pratyayaḥ, ṭhtisṛbhāve saṃjñāyāṃ kani' iti
tisrādeśaḥ ? nitsvro'tra bādhako bhaviṣyati| nāprapte svarāntare
tisṛsvara ārabhyate, sa yathaiva ṭhsuppitāvanudātau' ityetaṃ bādhate
evaṃ nitsvaramapi bādheta ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; yena nāprāpte ityetasya
bādhanaṃ bhaviṣyati, na vāprāpte ṭhanudātau suppitau' ityetasmin
tisṛsvara ārabhyate, tisṛketyatrāpi hi ṭāpā sahaikādeśasya
sthānivadbhātpitsvaraḥ prāpnoti| atha vā ṭhmadhye'pavādāḥ
pūrvānvidhīnbādhante' iti tisṛsvaraḥ ṭhanudātau suppitau'
ityetameva bādhiṣyate, na nitsvaram; bahuvacanaviṣayatvād
dvivacanaikavacane na staḥ| śasi tu bhavitavyam ṭhudātayaṇo
halpūrvāt' iti| anyāḥ sarvā halādayo vibhaktayastatra
ṭhṣaṭtricaturbhyo halādiḥ' ṭhjhalyupotamam' ityanena svareṇa
bhavitavyam, tatrāntareṇāpi jasgrahaṇaṃ jasa eva bhaviṣyati ? ata
āha-jasgrahaṇamupasamastārthamiti| samāse'pi tasṛśibdātparo jas
bhaviṣyati| 
atitisrāviti| atra ṭhaterakṛtpade' ityatra ṭhaterdhātulopa iti
vaktavyam' iti vacanātprāptamantodātatvaṃ bādhitvā vibhakterudātatvaṃ
syāt| jasgrahaṇātu ṭhudātasvaritayoryaṇaḥ' iti svarito bhavati|
atitisra ityatra tvanena jasa udātatvaṃ bhavatyeva ||

caturaḥ śasi || 6|1|167 ||
anukaraṇatvenārthaparatvābhāvādekavacanam| iha catasraḥ paśyaityatra
catasrādeśe kṛte sthānivadbhāvādayaṃ svaraḥ prāpnoti?
tatrāha--catasrādeśa iti| sthānivadbhāvādevādyaudātatve siddhe
punarādyaudātatvanipātanamasya svarasya bādhanārthamiti| bhāvaḥ| yathaiva
tarhi nipātanasvaraḥ śassvaraṃka bādhate, evam ṭhṣaṭtricaturbhyo
halādiḥ' ityetamapi vibhaktisvaraṃ bādheta--catasṛṇāmiti?
jñāpakātsiddham, yadayam ṭhṣaṭtricaturbhyo halādiḥ' iti
halādigrahaṇaṃ karoti, tajjñāpayati--ṭhna nipātanasvaro vibhaktisvaraṃ
bādhate' iti| taddhi tatra na kartavyam, katham ? sarveṣāmapi
bahuvacanaviṣayatvād dvivacanaikavacane na sambhavataḥ| na copasamaste
sambhavaḥ; vihitaviseṣaṇāśrayaṇāt| tatra ṣaḍbhyastāvat
jaśśasorlukā bhavativyam| anyāḥ sarvā halādayo vibhaktyaḥ|
strīśabda'pi jasi na bhavitayam; asarvanāmasthānamityadhikārāt, śasi
bhavitavyam ṭhekādeśa udātenodātaḥ' iti, anyā halādayaḥ|
tisṛśabde'pi jasi ṭhtisṛbhyo jasaḥ' iti bhavitavyam, śasyapi
ṭhudātayaṇo halapūrvāt' iti, anyā halādayaḥ| catur-śabde'pi
jasyasarvanāmasthāna iti niṣedhaḥ, śasi ṭhcaturaḥ śaśi' ityayameva
bhavati, anyāstu halādayaḥ| tadetaddhalādigrahaṇaṃ catasraḥ paśyetyatra mā
bhūdityetadarthameva kṛtam| yadi ca nipātanasvareṇa vibhaktisvaro
bādhyeta halādigrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| catasraḥ paśyetyatra
nipātanasvareṇaiva bādhitatvād vibhaktisvarasyāprasaṅgāt kiṃ
tannivṛtyarthena halādigrahaṇena! tatkriyamāṇam--vibhaktisvarasya
balīyastvaṃ jñāpayatīti catasṛṇāmityatra vibhaktisvaraḥ siddhaḥ|
yaṇādeśasya ceti| ṭhaci ra ṛtaḥ' iti rādeśasyāsmātsvarātpūrvaṃ
paratvātkṛtasya| etaduktaṃ bhavati--paratvādādeśe kṛte ṛkārasya
tāvanna bhavati, taśabdākārasyāpi na bhavati; rādeśasya
sthānivadbhāvāditi| na ca svaravidhau sthānivatvaniṣedhaḥ,
ṭhsvaradīrghayalopeṣu lopajādeśa eva na sthānivat' iti vacanāt ||

sāvekācastṛtīyādirvibhaktiḥ || 6|1|168 ||
sāviti saptamībahuvacanasya suśabdasya guhaṇamiti| na
prathamaikavacanasya; vyākhyānāt| prayojanaṃ tūtaratra vakṣyati| pāteti|
pāterlaṭaḥ śatrādeśaḥ| rājñeti| ṭhsau' ityetsminnasatyekācaḥ parā
tṛtīyādivibhaktirudātā bhavatītyartho bhavati, bhavati cāyamallope
kṛte ekāc| nanu ca vihitaviśeṣaṇaṃ vijñāsyate-ekāco yā
vihitā tṛtīyādiriti ? na; pramāṇābhāvāt| saptamībahuvacanasya
grahaṇāditi| prathamaikavacane tu ṭhtvāhau sau' iti tvādeśe kṛte
yuṣmacchabda ekāc bhavati, śeṣe lope kṛte'kārāntatvāt
ṭhsāvavarṇa' iti pratiṣedho bhaviṣyati| tadiha prathamaikavacanāgrahaṇe
ko heturiti cintyam ||

antodātādutarapadādanyatarasyāmanityasamāse || 6|1|169 ||
nityaśabdaḥ svaryate iti| svaritatvamasya kriyata ityarthaḥ| tatra svarito
guṇaḥ kriyārūpeṇa nirddiṣṭaḥ, svaritatve sati kiṃ bhavati?
ityāha--teneti| ṭhsvaritenādhikāraḥ' ityatrāyamapyartho
vyākhyātaḥ--svaritena liṅgena yadatrādhikāraḥ sa pratyetavya iti,
tato nityādhikāravihitaḥ samāso'tra pratiṣidhyate| avāceti|
nañsamāsaḥ| tatpuruṣo'yamiti| na bahuvrīhiḥ| tena ṭhnañsubhyām'
ityantodātatvaṃ na bhavati, avyayapūrvapadaprakṛtisvara eva bhavatīti
bhāvaḥ| prāyeṇa tu suvācā, sutvacā iti pāṭhaḥ| tatra
pratyudāharaṇādigiyaṃ darśiteti vyākhyeyam, na punaratra prasaṅgaḥ;
prādisamāsasya nityasamāsatvāt|
athotarapadagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā ṭhanityasamāse' ityādhārasaptamī
vijñāsyate---anityasamāsasthāntodatādekācaḥ parā
tṛtīyādirvibhaktiriti, caccotarapadameva?
tatrāha--utarapadagrahaṇamiti| ayaṃ bhāvaḥ--satsaptamī vijñāyeta, tataśva
samāsasyāśrayatvātasyaivekāttvamantodātvaṃ ca viśeṣaṇaṃ syāditi|
agnicitā, somasuteti| ṭhagnau ceḥ', ṭhsome suñaḥ' iti kvip|
ṭhnityaśabdaḥ svarthate' iti yaduktam, tasya prayojanamāha--yastviti ||

añceścchandasyāsarvanāmasthānam || 6|1|170 ||
dadhīca iti| dadhyañcatīti ṭhṛtvik' ityādinā kvin,
anunāsikalopaḥ, ṭhacaḥ' ityakāralopaḥ, ṭhcau' iti dīrghatvam| 
śaso'pi parigraharthamiti| śasādigrahaṇaṃ tu na kṛtam, napuṃsake
śasi mā bhūt, suṭi ca yathā syāditi ||

ūḍidampadādyappumraidyaubhyaḥ || 6|1|171 ||
praṣṭhauha iti| ṭhcchandasi sahaḥ', ṭhvahaśca' iti ṇviḥ| vāha ūṭhi
ṭhetyedhatyūṭhasu' iti vṛddhiḥ|
ūṭhayupadhāgrahaṇamiti| upadhābhūta ūṭha gṛhyate, na tvantya ityarthaḥ|
pañcamīnirddeśādantyasyaiva grahaṇe prāpte vacanam|
antodātādityadhikārādanvādeśe na bhavatīti| ata eva hetoḥ
ṭhsāvekācaḥ' ityanenāpi na bhavati| yadi syāt,
ihāntodātādhikāro vyarthaḥ syāt| nanu ca yadīme nānuśaso
abhyavarṣāditi śaso'nvādeśena mā bhūditi prayojanam, ṭhekācaḥ'
ityadhikārādeva siddham, tathā ca tadasmai tathya tadasya priyaṃ preṇā
tadeṣāmityādi sarvānudātaṃ padamadhīyate|
padādayo niśparyantā gṛhyanta iti| ṭhpadannomās' iti sūtre
nirddiṣṭāḥ, tatra ekāca ityanuvṛteniśaḥ pare na gṛhyante| yadā
tvallope kṛte ekāco bhavanti, tadodātanivṛttisvareṇa
vibhakterudātatvaṃ siddham| ye'pyādyaudātānāṃ sthāne vidhīyante
ādeśāste tatraivāntodātā nipātyante| vṛtāvapyetadevoktaṃ
draṣṭavyam| āsanīti| āsyaśabdasyāsanādeśaḥ| yatraikācasteṣāṃ śasarthaṃ
grahaṇam || 

aṣṭano dīrghāt || 6|1|172 ||
ghṛtādipāṭhādantodāta iti| tenotarārthamanuvartamānasya
ṭhantodātāt' ityasya nehāpi virodha iti bhāvaḥ| aṣṭasviti|
nanu cātra dīrghagrahaṇamanarthakam, yāvatā ṭhaṣṭana ā vibhaktau ityanena
bhavitavyam, tadvidhau vikalpasyābhāvāt ? ityata āha--idameveti|
nitye hyātve vyāvartyābhāvādiha dīrghagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt|
kṛtātvasya ca ṣaṭsaṃjñāmiti| idameva dīrghagrahamamaṣṭano jñāpayatīti
sambandhaḥ| kathametat ? ityata āha--anyathā hīti| ātvābhāvapakṣe'yaṃ
svaro mā būdityetadarthaṃ hi dīrghagrahaṇam| yadi ca kṛtātvasyāṣṭanaḥ
ṣaṭsaṃjñā na syāt, tadā''tvapakṣe sāvakāśamimamaṣṭanaḥ
svaramanātvapakṣe ṣaṭsaṃjñāyāṃ satyām ṭhjhalyupotamam' iti
ṣaṭsvaraḥ paratvādbādhiṣyate--ityanarthakaṃ dīrghagrahaṇaṃ syāt| yadā
tu kṛtātvasyāṣṭanaḥ ṣaṭsaṃjñā bhavati, tadā nāprāpte ṣaṭsvare
ārabhyamāṇo'ṣṭanaḥ svaro'nātvapakṣe'pi syāditi tannivṛtaye
kriyamāṇamarthavadbhavati| kathaṃ punarekena yatnenobhayaṃ śakyaṃ
jñpayitum ? ko doṣaḥ ! anyathānupapatyā hyaneko'pyartho
jñāpyate, tenaitadubhayamantareṇānupapadyamānamubhayamapi jñāpayati|

śaturanumo nadyajādī || 6|1|173 ||
tudatī, nudatīti| tudāditvācchaḥ, ṭhācchīnadyornum' vikalpitaḥ|
tatra numabhāvapakṣe udāharaṇam, numpakṣe pratyudāharaṇam|
tudantīti| ṭhśnābhyastayorāta' ityākāralopaḥ| atra pratyayasvareṇa
śatrantamantodātam| tatretyādinā pratyudāharaṇasya
dvyaṅgavikalatāṃ pariharati--tatra pūrvatrāsiddhamiti neṣyati iti|
atra ca jñāpakamayamevānuma iti pratiṣedhaḥ, na hi
kiñcidekādeśasvaramantareṇa śatrantaṃ sanumkamantodātamisti|
buhanmahatorupasaṃkhyānamiti| śatṛvadbhāvādeva siddhe
niyamārthamidam--pṛṣṭadādīnāṃ mā bhūditi| ṭhgaurādiṣu
bṛhanmahatoḥ pāṭho'narthakaḥ' iti strīprakaraṇa evoktam ||

udātayaṇo kahalpūrvāt || ṭhudātasvaritayoryaṇaḥ
svarito'nudātasya' iti prāpte vacanam| vahutitavā brāhmaṇyeti|
strīliṅgopādānaṃ nābhāvanivatyartham| ṭhtanoterḍauḥ sanvacca' iti,
ṭhcālanī titauḥ pumān', tato bahuvrīhiḥ,
ṭhbahornañvadutarapadabhūmni' ityutarapadāntodātaḥ, tatra
ṭhudātasvaritayoḥ' iti vibhakteḥ svaritatvam |
nakāragrahaṇaṃ ca kartavyamiti| udātasthāne yo nakārastato'pi
parasyā nadyā udātatvaṃ vaktavyamityarthaḥ| tadarthaṃ kecid ṭhudātahalo
halpūrvāt' iti paṭhanīyamiti manyante| vākpatnīti| tatpuruṣaḥ|
ṭhpatyāvaiśvaryye' iti pūrvapadaprakṛtisvarasya ṭhna bhūvākciddidhiṣu'
iti pratiṣedhātsamāsāntodātatve ṭhvibhāṣā sapūrvasya' iti nakāraḥ
||

noṅdhātvoḥ || 6|1|175 ||
ūṅe dhātośca ya udātayaṇ halpūrva iti| anena pūrvasyāḥ
prāpterayaṃ pratiṣedha iti darśayati| tasmātparā
tṛtīyādirvibhaktiriti| yadyapi pūrvasūtre ṭhnadyajādī' ityanuvartate na
ṭhtṛtīyādiḥ' iti, tathāpyatra bāhulyena tṛtīyādereva
sambhavādidhamuktam| tathā hi--ūṅdhātuyaṇaḥ parā nadī tāvanna
sambhavati, nāpyūṅyaṇaḥ śas sambhavati, dhātuyaṇastu sambhavati ||

hrasvanuḍbhyāmmatup || 6|1|176 || 
akṣaṇvateti| ṭhcchandasyapi dṛśyate' ityanaṅ, ṭhano nuṭ' iti
nuḍāgamaḥ, pūrvasya nakārasya lopaḥ| śīrṣatvateti| ṭhśīrṣañcchandasi'
iti nipātitaḥ| vasuśabdra ādyaudāta iti| vaserupratyayaḥ, ṭhdhānye
nit' ityadhikāre| athehakasmānna bhavati--maruto'sya santi
marutvāniti ? marucchabdo hi ṭhmṛgrorutiḥ' iti
utipratyayāntatvātpratyayasvareṇāntodātaḥ| na ca takāreṇa
vyavadhānam, svaravidhau vyañjanasyāvidyamānatvāt ? ityata
āha--atreti| kathaṃ punarjñāyate nākṣī yate iti ? nuḍgrahaṇāt|
taddhyakṣaṇvatetyādau yathā syādityevamartham, anyathā nakārasya
luptasyāpi svaravidhāvasiddhernakāreṇa vyavadhānānna syāditi| yadi
cātra vyañjanamavidyamānavatsyāt, tato'siddhalopasyāpi
tasyāvavidyamānatvādeva svaraḥ siddha iti nuḍgrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt ?
naitadyauktamucyate; yadi hi nakāralopasyāsiddhatve'pi
nakāro'vidyamānavatsyāt, svaravidhau
nakāralopasyāsiddhavadvacanamanarthakaṃ syāt|
tasmānnalopaviṣaye'vidyamānavadbhāvo na pravartata iti kartavyameva
nuḍgrahaṇam| evaṃ tarhīṣṭireveyam--ṭhatra svare'vidyamānavatparibhāṣā
na pravartate' iti|
reśabdācceti pāṭhaḥ| ārevāniti| rayi asyāstīti matupi
ṭhraryermatau bahulam' iti samprasāraṇam, pūrvatvam, ādgraṇaḥ,
tato hrasvābhāvādvacanam|
trivatīriti| ṭhcchandasīraḥ' iti vatvam, ṭhvā cchandasi' iti
pūrvasavarṇadīrghaḥ ||

nāmanyatarasyām || 6|1|177 ||
matubiti ceti| caccārthātsaptamyantaṃ sampadyate|
anyathā hi sāmpratika eva syāditi| sāmpratikābhāve hi
bhūtapūrvagatirbhavati, na tu tasminsatyapi; tatastisṛṇām,
catasṛṇāmityatra ṭhna tisṛcatasṛ' iti dīrghapratiṣedhātsāmpratika eva
hrasvo vidyate iti tatreva syāt; agnīnām, vāyūnāmityādau
paratvānnityatvācca dīrghatve kṛte hrasvābhāvānna syāt, tasmānmatupā
hlasvo viśeṣyate| yadyevam, ṭhmatau bahvaco'najirādīnām',
ṭhśarādīnāṃ ca' iti yeṣāṃ matau dīrghatvamucyate teṣāṃ na syāt ?
naiṣa doṣaḥ; saṃjñāyāmiti vartate, tataścāturarthika eva matau
dīrghatvam, na tu ṭhtadasyāsyāsmin' ityatra; tatra matau
hrasvāntatvādbhaviṣyati| evamapi tisṛṇām, catasṛṇāmityatra na
syāt, tisṛcatasṛbhāvasyaiva tatrābhāvāt ? iṣṭamevaitatsaṃgṛhītam|
atra hi ṭhṣaṣṭatricaturbhyo halādiḥ' iti nityameva
vibhakterudātatvamiṣyate| dhenvām, śakaṭa|lamiti| ṭhdheṭa icca' iti
nupratyayānto dhenuśabdo'ntodātaḥ, ṭhśakaṭiśakaṭa|lerakṣaramakṣaraṃ
paryāyeṇa' iti śakaṭīśabdo'pi pakṣe'ntodātaḥ| trapuśabdo
vasuśabdaścādyaudātaḥ ||

ṣaṭtricaturbhyo halādiḥ || 6|1|179 ||
antodātāditi nivṛtamiti| yadyetadanuvarteta pañcānām,
navānām, caturmāmityatra na syāt; ṭhnraḥ saṃkhyāyā'
ityādyaudātatvāt, kva tarhi syāt ? saptānām, aṣṭānām|
saptāṣṭaśabdau ghṛtāditvādantodātau| ṭhnraḥ' iti
rephanakārāntāyā ityarthaḥ|
catasraḥ paśyeti| yathaitadiha halādigrahaṇasya vyāvartyaṃ tathā ṭhcaturaḥ
śasi' ityatrāvocāma ||

jhalyupotamam || 6|1|180 ||
jhalādau vibhaktau parataḥ ṣaṭtricaturṇāṃ triprabhṛtyakṣarābhāvāt
jhalādivibhaktayantasya padasya grahaṇam, yadāha--vibhaktyante pade
upotamamudātambhavatīti ||

na gosvansāvavarṇarāḍaṅkruḍkṛdbhyaḥ || ṭhsau' iti yadi
saptamībahucanasya grahaṇaṃ syāt, tebhyaḥ, kebhya ityatra na syāt,
tatkiṃśabdayoḥ saptamībahuvacane paratastyadādyatve kṛte ṭhbahuvacane
jhalyet' ityetvavidhānāt; tābhiryābhirityādāveva syāt,
tāsuyāsvityatrāvarṇāntatvāt| tasmātprathamaikavacanasya
grahaṇāmityāha--sau prathamaikavacana iti| anantarasya
pratiṣedhyasyāsambhavātsarvasyaiva ṣāṣṭhikasvarasya pratiṣedho vijñāyate
ityāha-ityebhyo yaduktaṃ tanna bhavatīti| evaṃ ca vṛkṣavānityādau
ṭhhrasvanuḍbhyāṃ matup' ityapi pratiṣedho bhavati,
udātanivṛttisvarasya pratiṣedho neṣyate| suguneti | bahuvrīhau
ṭhgostriyorupasarjanasya' iti hrasvaḥ, ṭhnañsubhyām' ityantodātatvam
|
śuneti| nanu ca nalope kṛte sāvavarṇāntametat ? na ; svaravidhau
nalopasyāsiddhatvāt| na cāyaṃ svaravidhiḥ, svarapratiṣedho'yam ?
evaṃ tarhi śunaḥ pratiṣedhaṃ kurvannetajjñāpayati--asminpratiṣede
nalopo'siddho bhavatīti| tena nṛśabdātsaptamyekavacane narītyatra
ṭhsāvekācaḥ' iti vibhakterudātatvaṃ bhavati, pitṛmānityādau
ṭhhrasvanuḍbhyāṃ matup' iti matupa udātatvaṃ bhavati, anyathā
ṭhsāvavarṇa' iti pratiṣedhaḥ syāt|
prāceti| pūrvavannalopadīrghādi| kruñceti| ṭhkuñca kruñca
kauṭilyālpībhāvayoḥ', ṭhṛtvik' ityādinā kvin, tatraiva sūtre
kruñceti nipātanānnalopābhāvaḥ| kṛtirveti| ṭhkṛtī chedane' ||

divo jhal || 6|1|183 ||
jhalādiriti| kathaṃ punarasati saptamīnirdeśe tadādividhirbhavati;
kevalajhalātmikāyā vibhakterabhāvāt, astu tarhi tadantavidhiḥ, kā
punarjhalantā vibhakti, śasādiḥ sakārāntā ? evaṃ tarhi
ṭhṣaṭtricaturbhyā halādiḥ' ityata ādigrahaṇamanuvartate, divaḥ parā
vibhaktirnodātā bhavati, kīdṛśī ? yasyā jhalādiriti|
ayaṃ yogaḥ śakyo'vaktum| katham ? evaṃ vakṣyāmi---ṭhaṣṭano dīrghāt,
divojhalādiḥ, śataranumo nadī ca' iti, ṭhūḍidam' ityādau ca
divo grahaṇaṃ na kariṣyami ? evamapi ṭhnṛ cānyatarasyām'
ityutarasūtre tatra jhalgrahaṇaṃ kartavyam, ṭhnadi ca' iti cakāraśca
kriyata iti nāsti lāghave viśeṣaḥ ||

titsvaritam || 6|1|185 ||
iha kasmānna bhavati ṭhṛta iddhātoḥ' āstīrṇam, vistīrṇam,
tatkālagrahaṇārthatayā caritārthatvāditi cet ? na;
anekaprayojanadarśanādanubandhānām| tadyathā ākṣika ityādau ṭhaki sati
svaro vṛddhiśca bhavati| evaṃ narhi nāyamikārastaparaḥ, kiṃ tarhi?
daparaḥ| yadyevam, ṛkārasya sthāne āntaryyato dīrghaḥ prāpnoti ?
ṭhbhāvyamāno'ṇ savarṇānna gṛhyāti' | idyevam, ṭhadaso'serdādu do
maḥ' imūbhyām dīrghasya sthāne dīrgho na syāt ? naiṣa doṣaḥ
jñāpitametat ṭhdiva ut' ṭhṛta ut' iti
taparakaraṇena--bhāvyamāno'pyukāraḥ savarṇān gṛhṇātīti|
tayoreva tarhyukārayoḥ svaritatvaprasaṅgaḥ ? tāvapi tahi na
taparau, kiṃ tarhi ? daparau| kathaṃ ta"śha jñāpakam? ṭhtaparastatkālasya'
ityatra dakāro'pi cartvabhūtonirdiśyate, ṭhaṇuditsavarṇasya
cāpratyayastaparastatkālasya' iti, yadi dakāro'pi nirdiśyate
ṭhṛdorap' ityatrāpi dadgrahaṇādihaiva, syādyavaḥ, stavaḥ; lavaḥ, pava
ityatra na syāt; ṭhtādapi parastaparaḥ' iti tādapi parasya taparatvāt|
evaṃ tarhi ṛdorap' ityatra dhakāro jaśtvabhūta uccāraṇārtho
nirdiśyate, tatra jaśtvasyāsiddhatvānnāyamṛkāro daparaḥ| ye tu
ṭhpratyayāpratyayayoḥ pratyayasyaiva grahaṇam' iti paribhāṣāṃ paṭhanti,
teṣām ṭhṛta iddhātoḥ' ityādau satyapi titvenāsya svarasya
prasaṅgaḥ| ṭhtaparastatkālasya' ityatra dakāro'pi na praśleṣṭavyaḥ|
tasyāstu paribhāṣāyā bhāṣyavārtikayohira|
adarśanādayaṃ yatno mahānasmābhirādṛtaḥ ||
tāsyanudātenṅdidupadeśāllasārvadhātukamanudātamahnviṅeḥ ||
tāsyādīnāṃ samāhāradvandvaḥ| adupadeśāditi| upadiśyata
ityupadeśaḥ, tasyākāreṇa viśeṣaṇātadantavidhiḥ,
accāsāvupadeśaścādupadeśaḥ, upadiśyamānadaśāyāṃ yadavarṇāntaṃ
tasmārityarthaḥ| akāropadeśāditi| akārāntādupadeśādityarthaḥ|
kartetyādi| luṅatmanepade prathamapuruṣasya ḍāraurasaḥ, tāsiḥ|
ekavacane ṭilopaḥ, itaratra ṭhri ca' iti salopaḥ|
āste ityādāvadāditvācchapo luk|
tudata ityādīni tasantāni| kathaṃ punaḥ śabupadeśe'danto
bhaviṣyati, yāvatā pakārānto'yaṃ tatra? ityata
āha---anubandhasyānekāntatvādakārāntopadeśa eveti|
ṭhudīcāmāṅḥ'iti
kṛtātvanirddeśājjhāpakādanumīyate---kāryeṣvanubandhāḥ śrūyamāṇā
api na pratibandhakā iti| pacamāno yajamāna iti| laṭaḥ śānac| nanvatra
mukā vyavadhānam ? ata āha--yadyatreti| syāditi| sambhāvane liṅ|
aṅgasya yo'kārastasya mugityāśrayaṇādasya pakṣasya sambhavaḥ| tadā
lasārvadhātukamadupadeśādanantaramiti| pravartate nighātaḥ| ṭhāto
ṅtiḥ' itīyādeśastu na bhavati; kāta ityatra taparakaraṇāt|
anantarayoge pañcamī mṛgyā, paramiti vā'dhyāhāraḥ|
athākārāntasyāṅgasyeti| akāreṇāṅgasya viśeṣaṇāditi bhāvaḥ|
lasārvadhātukasyeti| ṭhsiddham' iti vakṣyamāṇena sabandhaḥ, nighāta iti
cānuṣaṅgaḥ, tathā ca lasārvadhātukasya nighātaḥ siddha ityarthaḥ| asiddha
iti| prakṛtatvānmugiti gamyate| bahiraṅgatvāditi| bahiraṅgatvaṃ
tu muko bahvapekṣatvāt| sa hi akārāntaviśiṣṭamaṅgamāśrayati
ānañca pratyayaviśeṣam| ayaṃ tu svaro'dupadeśaṇātraṃ
lasārvadhātukamātraṃ cāpekṣata ityantaraṅgaḥ| citsvaro'pītyādi|
citsvarasyāvakāśaḥ--calanaḥ, ṭhcalanaśabdaarthādakarmakādyauc'
asyāvakāśaḥ--āste, śete iti; pavamāna ityādau paratvādayaṃ
nighātaścitsvaraṃ bādhate| nanu caikasya dvikāryayoge vipratiṣedhaḥ,
na cātraiko dvikāryayuktaḥ, katham? āderanudātatvamantyasya citsvara
nātrāderanudātatvam, kiṃ tarhi ? saṅghātaḥ kāryī| atra jñāpakamutaratra
vakṣyāmaḥ| tataścānasya sarvānudātatvena bhavitavyam, na
tvāderityastyeva virodha iti paratvalādayaṃ bādhate iti yuktameva|
cinutaḥ, cinvantīti| nanu ca ṭhsārvadhātukamapit' iti śnurapi
ṅdevi tatkathamidaṃ pratyudāharaṇam ? ata āha--ṅdiyaṃ śnuḥ
pūrvasya kāryaṃ pratīti| tatra hi ṅiti yatkāryaṃ tadatidiśyate,
yadāha--siddhaṃ tu pūrvasya kāryātideśāditi| nāyaṃ sthitaḥ
siddhāntaḥ, ṭhāto ṅtiḥ' ityatra vakṣyati--ṭhṭhṭhsārvdhātukamapit' ityatra
ṅti iva dityaṅgīkriyate'' ityādi| atra tu pakṣe
parihāraḥ--upadeśagrahaṇamubhābhyāmapi sambhadhyate--ṅdupideśāt,
adupadeśāditi| pacāvaḥ, pacāma iti| asatyupadeśagrahaṇe
paratvānnityatvācca dīrghe kṛte taparakaraṇānna syāt| nanu ca
taparakaraṇaṃ na kariṣyate ? yaditu na kriyate--yātaḥ, vāta ityatrāpi
prāpnoti| hataḥ, hatha iti| atra ṭhanudātopadeśa'
ityādinānunāsikalope kṛte satyakārātparaṃ lasārvadhātukaṃ
bhavati, tathāpyupadeśagrahaṇānna bhavati| na hi hantiradanta upadiśyate|
atha yo'trādanto haśabdastadāśrayamanudātatvaṃ kasmānna bhavati?
tāvato'nupadeśāt, samudāyaparo hi hantyupadeśaḥ| katīha
pacamānā iti| ṭhpūṅyajoḥ śānanu', tatra ca ṭhlaṭaḥ' iti nivṛtatvānna
lādeśo'yam| śiśya iti| ṭheranekācaḥ' iti yaṇādeśaḥ, ṭhliṭ ca'
ityārddhadhātukametat| yadadhīta iti| yacchabdaprayogaḥ
ṭhnipātairyadyadi' iti nidhātapratiṣedhārthaḥ|

ādiḥ sico'nyatarasyām || 6|1|187 ||
mā hi kārṣṭāmiti| heḥ, māṅśca prayoge pūrvameva
prayojanamuktam| aparo madhyodāta iti| nanu na valādiriha pratyayaḥ,
iḍāgamaḥ, āgamāścānudātā bhavanti, tasmādihāpyantodātatvena
bhavitavyam ? ata āha--sicaścitkaraṇāditi|
aniṭaḥ pita iti| aniṭaḥ sicaḥ paraḥ pitpakṣe udāto bhavati, pakṣe
tvanudātaḥ, tena mā hi kārṣamiti tiṅntaṃ pakṣe ādyaudātam, pakṣe
tvantodātam; anyathā dhātusvareṇa nityamādyaudātaṃ syāt|
madhyodāta eveti| sicaḥ svareṇa, evakāreṇa na tvantodāta iti
darśayati ||

svapādihiṃsāmacyaniṭi || 6|1|188 ||
svapādirā vṛtkāraṇāditi| ā gaṇāntādityarthaḥ| tatra ṭhñiṣvap
śaye', ṭhśvasa prāṇane', ṭhana ca' ityetebyaḥ pare
jakṣityādayo'bhyastasaṃjñakāḥ, teṣu paratvātad ṭhabhyastānāmādiḥ' iti
svaro bhavati, ye tu tataḥ pare ṭhṣas svapne' , vaśa kāntau',
ṭhhnūṅ apanayane', carkarītamiti; tatra carkarītītamabhyastam| anye
tu ṭhṣasivasī chāndasau', cchandasi ca dṛṣṭānuvidhānam| hnuṅe'pyayaṃ
svaro na bhavati ṭhahanviṅeḥ' ityanuvṛteḥ|
pārīśeṣyādāditastrivevāyaṃ svaraḥ| hisantīti| ṭhhisi hiṃsāyām'
rudhādiḥ, ṭhśnānnalopaḥ', ṭhśnasorallopaḥ'|

abhyastānāmādiḥ || 6|1|189 ||
ādiriti vartamāna iti| ṭhādiḥ sico'nyacarasyām' ityataḥ|
punarādigrahaṇaṃ nityārthamiti| anyathā
ādigrahaṇasambaddhamanyatarasyāṃgrahaṇamanuvarteta |

anudāte ca || 6|1|190 ||
anajādyarthemidam| jihīte, mimīta iti| ṭhī halyaghoḥ',
ṅtvāllisārvadhātukānudātatvam| ṭhavidyamānodāte' iti vadatā
ṭhanudāta iti bahuvrīhinirdeśo'yam' ityuktam| tatra
prayojanamāha--anudāta iti| bahuvrīhinirdeśa ityādi| na vidyate
udāto yasminnityanudātaḥ| mā hi sm dadhāditi| śāstrīye'nudāte
gṛhyamāṇe nityatvādantaraṅgatvādvā ikāralope kṛte'co'nudātasya
parasyābhāvādādyaudātatvaṃ na syāt, bahuvrīhau vijñāte tu bhavati|
dadhātyatreti| atra yaṇādeśasya bahiraṅgatvenāsiddhatvādapi svaraḥ
siddhaḥ ||

sarvasya supi || 6|1|191 ||
sarvaśabda uṇādiṣu antodāto nipātitaḥ, sarvasya vikāraḥ sārva
ityanudātādilakṣaṇo'ñ yathā syāditi|
pratyayalakṣaṇenāpītyādi| ṭhna lumatāṅgasya' ityatraitadupapāditam|
sarvasvaro'nakackasyeti|

bhīhrībhṛhumadajanadhanadaridrājāgarāṃ pratyayātpūrvaṃ piti ||
ādyaudātasyāpavādo'yam| jāgarāmiti sautrau nirdeśaḥ| atra
madirdivādiḥ, daridrājāgrāvadādī, anye juhotyādayaḥ| pañcame
lakāra iti| lasyetvatra darśitakrame pañcamakalakāro leṭ|
leṭśabdastu vṛttikāradeśe jugupsitaḥ, yathā'tra dravihadeśe
nīvīśabdaḥ| dadhanaditi| ṭhitaśca lopaḥ parasmaipadeṣu',
ṭhleṭo'ḍāṭau' ityaṭ| daridratīti| atra paratvādākāralope kṛte
ikārasyodātatvaprasaṅgaḥ|
atha pratyayagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā bhyādibhyaḥ paraḥ pitpratyaya eva
sambhavati, nanu cāyamasti--ṭhāḍutamasya picca', bibhayāti, atrāpi
loḍutamasyaiva pitvaṃ vidhīyate, na tvāṭ iti, āṭasahito
loḍutamaḥ pidbhavati sa ca pratyaya eva| ata eva loṅadeśātpitaḥ
pūrvamāḍ bhavati, pratyayātu pūrvo na bhavati,
āṭasahitasyāpratyayatvāditi tannivṛtyarthaṃ pratyayagrahaṇamiti na
vācyam, kathaṇ? yathaiva pratyayatvamāṭsahitasya , tathā pittavamapi
tasyaiva| ihaṃ tarhi prayojanam-- pratyayātpūrvasyāca udātatvaṃ yathā
syātsaṅghātasya mā bhūditi, etadeva jñāpakam--svaravidhau saṅghātaḥ
kāryīti, tena ṭhtāsyanudātet' iti nighātaḥ ṭhpacamānaḥ' ityādau
citsvaraṃ paratvādbādhata iti yaduktaṃ tadupapannaṃ bhavati| atha
pūrvagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, pratyaye pitīti vaktavyam, tatra ṭhtasminniti
nirdiṣṭe pūrvasya' iti pūrvasyaiva bhaviṣyati ? idaṃ tarhi
prayejanam--piti pūrvaṃ kāryabhāgyathā syāt, pidantaṃ mā bhūditi|
kathaṃ punaḥ saptamīnirddeśe tadantasya prasaṅga? etadeva
jñāyati--svaravidhau saptamyastadantasaptamya iti | kiṃ siddhaṃ bhavati ?
upotamaṃ 
riti, ritpratyayayānte upotamamudātaṃ bhavati, na tu riti parataḥ
pūrvasya; ṭhcaṅyanyatarasyām' caṅntasya| yadyevam, ṭhcaturaḥ śasi'
iti śasantasya prāpnoti, śasgrahaṇasāmarthyānna bhaviṣyati| yadi hi
ṭhcaturaḥ śasi' ityanena śasa udātatvamiṣṭṃa syāt, tataḥ ṭhūḍidam'
ityasyānantaram ṭhcaturaśca' iti brūyāt
tatrāsarvanāmasthānagrahaṇānuvṛtyā ṭhṣaṭtricaturbhyo halādiḥ' iti
halāderudātatvavidhānācca śasa eva bhaviṣyati ||

liti || 6|1|193 ||
pparatyayātpūrvamiti vartate, tena lidante svaraprasaṅgo na
codanīyaḥ ||

ādirṇamulyanyatarasyām || 6|1|194 ||
lolūyaṃlolūyamiti| ekākṣu dhātuṣu litsvarasya, asya ca
viśeṣābhāvādanekājudāhṛtaḥ| āmreḍitānudātatve kṛta iti|
ṭhanudātaṃ ca' ityanena ||

acaḥ kartṛyaki || 6|1|195 ||
kartṛvācini sārvadhātuke vihito yak kartṛyak| upadeśa iti
vartata iti| ṭhadupadeśāt' itiyatra yadupadeśagrahaṇaṃ
tadupasamastamapi svaritatvapratijñānādiha sambaddhyate,
taccārthātsaptamyantaṃ sampadyata iti matvoktam, na tu
saptamyantamupadeśagrahaṇaṃ prakṛtamasti| yadi tūpadeśagrahaṇaṃ
nānuvarteta, kāryata ityādau raparatve sati na syāt, tasmādupadeśa
ityanuvartyam|
yadyevam, jāyate svayamevetyādau na syāt, ṭhye vibhāṣā' ityātve
satyutarakālamajantā janādayaḥ, na tūpadeśe ? ityata
āha--janādīnāmiti| ṭhye vibhāṣā' ityatra ṭhanudātopadeśe' ityata
upadeśagrahaṇamanuvartate, sā ca viṣayasaptamīti upadeśaeva
janādīnāmātvaṃ bhavati| jāyate svayameveti| antarbhāvitaṇyartho
janiḥ karmakartṛviṣayaḥ| dṛśyate cāntarbhāvitaṇyarthasya prayogaḥ,
yathā--ekaṃ dvādaśadhā jajñe iti ||

thali ca seṭīḍanto vā || 6|1|196 ||
ṭhanyatarasyām' iti vartamāne vāgrahaṇaṃ kāryivikalpārtham|
anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇena kāryaṃ vikalpyate, vāgrahaṇena kāryiṇaḥ|
teneḍādayaḥ paryayeṇa kāryaṃ pratipadyante| nanu ca ṭhantaśca tavai
yugapat' ityādau yugapadgrahaṇādevānyatra paryāyaḥ siddhaḥ ? satyam;
aderapi prāpte vāgrahaṇam; anyathā śrutayohiḍantayoreva kāryitvaṃ
vikalpet, vāgrahaṇe tu sati yadyevaṃ vikalpo'rthaḥ, athāpi
samucyayaḥ, sarvathāderapi bhavati |
seṭīti kimiti| iḍgrahaṇādeva thal seṭ grahīṣyata iti praśnaḥ|
yayātheti| ayamabhiprāyaḥ--iḍgrahaṇaṃ yadeḍāgamaḥ kriyate tadā
tasyodātārthaṃ syāt, tataśca yathā lulavithetyādau caturṇāṃ
paryāyeṇodātavalidhāne yayithepyādau caturthābhāve'pi
paryāyeṇodātatyaṃ bhavati, evamiḍabhāve'pi syāditi ||

ñnityādirnityam || 6|1|197 ||
pratyayasvarāpavāda iti| bāhulyādevamuktam| ṭhśrotriyaṃścchando'dhīte'
it, atra hi vākyārthe padavacanamityatra pakṣe na pratyayaśvaraprasaṅgaḥ |
pratyayalakṣaṇamatra neṣyata iti| nanu ca ṭhna lumatāṅgasya' iti
pratiṣedhādeva pratyayalakṣaṇaṃ na kariṣyate, kimucyate--pratyayalakṣaṇamatra
neṣyata iti ? evamanyato jñāpitametat--ṭhsvaravidhau
saptamyastadantasaptamyaḥ' iti| tataśca yathā pūrvasūtre thalantaṃ kāryi;
tathātrāpi ñnidantaṃ na tu tataḥ
pūrvamaṅgamityanaṅgakāryatvātpratiṣedho na siddhyatīti| yañi
kani ceti| cakārādbidādyañi ca ||

āmantritasya ca || 6|1|198 ||
atra ṭhkārakādataśrutyorevāśiṣi' iti prāptiḥ pratiṣiddhyate,
śeṣanidhātena bādhya tyirthaḥ| pratyayalakṣaṇamatreṣyata iti|
ṣaṣṭhīnirdeśena tatkāryasya spaṣṭatvāt| sarpiriti| sṛperisi sarpiḥ
sabdo'ntyodātaḥ, ṭhsvamornapuṃsakāt' iti sorluk| saptaśabdau
ghṛtāditvādantodātaḥ, ṭhṣaṅbhyo luk' iti jaso luk ||

pathimathoḥ sarvanāmasthāne || 6|1|199 || 
pathimathiśabdāvityādi| ṭhgameriniḥ', ṭhpuṣaḥ kit', ṭhmanthaḥ',
ṭhpatestha ca' itīnipratyayaḥ, manthaḥ kitvādupadhālopaḥ--panthāḥ, manthā
iti| ṭhpathimathyṛbhukṣāmāt' ityādikāryam |
pathaḥ paśyeti| bhasya ṭerlopaḥ| pratyayalakṣaṇamatrāpi neṣyate|
atiprasaṅgastu pūrvavat ||

antaśca tavai yugapat || 6|1|200 ||
kartevai iti| ṭhkṛtyārthe tavalaikenkenyatvanaḥ' iti tavaipratyayaḥ| kiṃ
punaḥ kāraṇaṃ paryāyanivṛtaye yatnaḥ kriyate ? ityāha--ekavarjamiti
hītyādi ||

kṣayo nivāse || 6|1|201 ||
ṭhkṣi nighāsagatyoḥ'--ityāsmād adhikaraṇe ghaḥ| kṣayo dasyūnāmiti|
kṣayerac, kartari ṣaṣṭhī ||

vṛṣādīnāṃ ca || 6|1|203 ||
ṭhvṛṣu secane', ṭhjanī prādurbhāve', ṭhjvara roge', ṭhhi gatau', ṭhkai
gai rai śabde'| ete sarve'cpratyayāntā iti| pacāditvāt|
bāhulyāccedamuktam| vṛṣaḥ--ityatregupadhalakṣaṇaḥ kaḥ| ṭhṇīñ prāpaṇe',
ṭhtāyṛ santānapālanayoḥ'| kecitaya iti paṭhanti, ṭhaya paya taya
gatau', kvaciccayaśabdaḥ paṭha|lte, sa cinoterdraṣṭavyaḥ| ṭhiṇ gatau',
aṃsa samādhāne', ṭhvida jñāne', ṭhṣūda nirāse', ṭhdu dāhe',| ṭhvada
vyaktāyāṃ vāci', ṭhata sātatyagamane'| kecidetau na paṭhanti|
ṭhguhūsaṃvaraṇe', ṭhśama upaśame', ṭhaṇa raṇa śabde'|
sammatau bhāvakarmaṇoriti| śamaraṇāviti vartate, sammatāvarthe
śamaraṇau bhāvakarmaṇoryathākramamādyaudātau bhavataḥ| ṭhmātri
guptabhāṣaṇe'| śāntiriti| śameḥ ktici ṭhkamu kāntau', ṭhyamu
uparame', kecidyamaśabdaṃ na paṭhanti|
ṭhṛ śabde gatau', ṭhghṛñ dhāraṇe', ṭhkṛ vikṣepe', bhidādipu
nipātanādvṛddhiḥ| ṭhvaha prāpaṇe', ṭhkṛpū sāmarthye', ṭhpada gatau' ||

saṃjñāyāmupamānam || 6|1|204 ||
yadyevamiti| yadyatra kano lubityarthaḥ| etadevetyādi| jñāpakābhāve tu
saptamīnirdeśe'pi pratyayalakṣaṇapratiṣedho na syāt, ṭhsvaravidhau
saptamyastadantasaptamyaḥ' iti jñāpanena tadantasya kāryitvāt|
kvaciditi| vacanātkvacidbhavatyeva, yathā--ṭhsarvasya supi' ityatra ||

niṣṭhā ca dvyajanāt || 6|1|205 ||
ihādyāktaḥ adyāta ityekādeśasya bahiraṅgatvādasiddhatvād ṭhanāt'
itika pratiṣedhābhāvaḥ| bhīṣmaśabdaḥ ṭhbhiyaḥ ṣukca' iti manpratyayāntaḥ|
cintita iti| ṭhciti smṛtyām' curādiḥ ||

āśitaḥ kartā || 6|1|207 ||
aśeriti| ṭhaśa bhojane' ityasmāt| āṅpūrvādavivakṣite karmaṇīti|
uktaṃ hi--ṭhprasiddheravivakṣātaḥ karmaṇo'karmikā kriyā' iti| kartari kta
iti| ṭhgatyarthākarmaka' ityādinā| bhāṣye tu ṭhkartari kto nipātyate'
iti sthitam| yadi tarhyāṅpūrvakasyāśerāśita iti rūpam, avagrahaḥ
prāpnoti, tasmāt ṭhupadhādīrghatvamapi nipātyate' iti vārtikakāraḥ|
vṛttikārastu--ṭhsaṃhitāpāṭha eva nityaḥ, padapāṭhastu paurupeyaḥ,
tataśca na lakṣaṇena padakārā anuvarttyāḥ padakārairnāma
lakṣaṇamanuvartyam' iti manyate| apara āha---aśerṇyantasya
prayojyakartari ṭhgatibuddhipratyavasānārtha' iti karmasaṃjñake
niṣṭhāyāmāśita iti rūpam, sa evātra bhūtapūrvagatyā kartā vivakṣita
iti ||

rikte vibhāṣā || 6|1|208 ||
rikta iti| ṭhricirvirecane'| saṃjñāyāmityādi| ṭhniṣṭhā ca
dvyajanāt' ityasyāvakāśaḥ--dataḥ, guptaḥ,
asyāvakāśo'saṃjñāyām--rikto ghaṭa iti; saṃjñāyāmubhayaprasaṃge
pūrvavipratipedhaḥ ||

juṣṭārpite cacchandasi || 6|1|209 ||
juṣṭa iti| ṭhjuṣī prītisevanayoḥ', ṭhśvīdite niṣṭhāyām'
itīṭpratiṣedhaḥ| apita iti| ṭhatirhrī' arterṇic, artyādinā puk ||

nityaṃ mantre || 6|1|210 ||
ārambhasāmarthyādeva siddhe nityagrahaṇamutarārtham ||

yuṣmadasmadoṇÇósi || 6|1|211 ||
ṭhyuṣyasibyāṃ madik', yuṣiḥ sautro dhātuḥ| tava, mameti|
ṭhyuṣmadasmadbhyāṃ ṅso's', ṭhtavamamau ṅasi' iti maparyantasya
tavamamādeśaḥ, śeṣe lopaḥ, ṭhato guṇe' iti pararūpatvam, ṭhekādeśa
udātenodātaḥ' iti vibhakterudātatve prāpte idamucyate ||

ṅyi ca|| 6|1|212 ||
tubhyam, mahyamiti| ṭhṇeó prathamayoram', ṭhtubhyamahyāi ṅyi'|
atha kimartho yogavibhāgaḥ, na ṭhyuṣmadasmadorṇeóṅsoḥ'
ityevocyeta, evaṃ hi cakāro na kartavyo bhavati ? ata
āha--pṛthagyogakaraṇamiti| āśaṅkāgrahaṇenāsvaritatvādeva
yathāsaṃkhyaṃ na bhaviṣyatīti śakyaṃ vaktumiti darśayati| atrāpi
pūrvavadvibhaktisvaraḥ prāptaḥ ||

yato'nāvaḥ || 6|1|213 ||
atra ṭhanāvaḥ' iti pratiṣedho jñāpayati--svaravidhau
vyañjanamavidyamānavaditi; anyathā ya ādirnakāro nāsau svarayogyaḥ,
yaśca svarogya akāro nāsāvādiriti pratiṣedho'narthakaḥ syāt ||

īḍavandavṛśaṃsaduhāṃ ṇyataḥ || 6|1|214 ||
ṭhīha stutau', ṭhvadi abhivādanastutyoḥ', ṭhvṛṅsambhaktau', ṭhśaṃsu
stutau', ṭhduha prapūraṇe'| kathaṃ vārya ityatra ṇyat, yāvatā
ṭhetistuśāsu' ityādinā viśeṣavihitena kyapā bhāvyam ? ata
āha--vārya ityādi| atha vṛṅe'pi kyabeva kasmānna bhavati ? ata
āha--kyabvidhau hītyādi| etacca tatraiva pratipāditam ||

vibhāṣā veṇvinadhānayoḥ || 6|1|215 ||
ṇupratyayānta iti| ṭhtiṣṭhaterṇuḥ' iti tatrānuvartate|
udātanivṛttisvareṇeti| ṭhśnasorallopaḥ' iti
śnaso'kārasyodātasya lopāt|
veṇurityādi| ṭhsaṃjñāyāmupamānam' ityasyāvakāśaḥ--cañcā
vardhrikā, vibhāṣāyā avakāśaḥ--anupamānabhūto veṇuḥ śuṣka
upavane; veṇuriti saṃjñāyāmupamāne pūrvavipratiṣedhaḥ|

tyāgarāgahāsakuhaśvaṭhakrathānām || 6|1|216 ||
ṭhkuha vismāpane', ṭhśvaṭha kratha bhāṣaṇo' caurādikāvadantau|
nidhākatasyaivāyamapavādo yuktaḥ ? naitadevam; yadyayaṃ
nighātasyāpavādaḥ syāt, tatraivāyaṃ brūyāt--ṭhanudātaṃ
padamekavarjam, na hi svārtham ||

caṅyanyatarasyām || 6|1|218 ||
udāharaṇe ekavacanātikramaṇe heturmṛgyaḥ| mā hi daghaditi| ṭhvibhāṣā
dheṭśyoḥ' itika cleścaṅadeśaḥ|

matoḥ pūrvamātsaṃjñāyāṃ striyām || 6|1|219 ||
matoḥ pūrvaṃ ākāra iti| arthavyākhyānametat| sūtre tu
śabdarūpāpekṣaya napuṃsakanirdeśaḥ| kecitu sūtre pūrvaśabdaṃ
puṃlliṅgameva paṭhanti| udāharaṇe cāturathikaḥ ṭhnadyāṃ matup',
ṭhmatau bahvaco'nacirādīnāṃ ca' iti dīrghatvam| matoriti kim ?
gavādinīti| matorityasminnasati pūrvagrahaṇamapi na kriyeteti
saṃjñāśabdasambandhina ākāramātrasya prasaṅgaḥ| pūrvagrahaṇaṃ
matoranantarasya pūrvasya yathā syāt, iha mā bhūt--sānumatīti || 

anto'vatyāḥ || 6|1|220 ||
ihāsandehārtham ṭhvatyā antaḥ' ityavacanādakārapraśleṣo niścitaḥ|
tatra prayojanaṃ pṛcchati--avatyā iti kimucyata iti| athāvatyā
ityucyagāne'pi rājavatītyatra kasmānna bhavati, bhavati hyaetadapi
nalope kṛte'vatīśabdāntam ? ata āha--svaravidhāvityādi| nanu
codāharaṇe'pi matorvatvasyāsiddhatvādavatīśabdāntatvaṃ nāsti ?
ityāhṛ--vatvaṃ punariti| punaḥśabdo nalopādviśeṣaṃ dyotayati ||

īvatyāḥ || 6|1|221 ||
ahīvatītyādau pūrvaṃ dīrghaḥ, ṭhsaṃjñāyām' iti vatvam|
yogavibhāgaścintyaprayojanaḥ ||

cau || 6|1|222 ||
udātanivṛttisvarāpavādo'yamiti|
kṛdutarapadaprakṛtisvareṇodātasyāñcatyakārasya vibhaktinimiktakaḥ
ṭhacaḥ' iti lopaḥ|
cāvataddhita iti vaktavyamiti| cau yaḥ svaraḥ sa taddhite parato na
bhavatītyarthaḥ; inyathā yo'nudātaḥ pratyayaḥ--dadhīcaḥ paśyetyādau, tatra
yathodātanivṛttisvaraṃ bādhate, tathā dādhīca ityādau pratyayasvaramapi
satiśiṣṭa svaro vādeta, tasmādataddhita iti vaktavyam, asmiśca sati
udātanivṛttisvarasyāyamapavādo bhavati ||

samāsasya || 6|1|223 ||
rājadṛṣaditi| nanu ca yo'tra samāsasyānto dakāro nāsau
svarabhāk, yaśca tataḥ pūrvo'kāro nāsau samāsasyāntaḥ ? ata
āha--svaravidhāviti| na svarasyaiva vidhiḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? yo'pi
ṭhanudātāderañ' ityādiḥ, so'pi svaravidhiḥ; svarāśrayatvāt| tena
so'pi vidhirvyañjanādau vyañjanānte ca bhavati| atra ca
jñāpakam--ṭhnotarapade'nudātādau' ityutavā pṛthivyāḥ pratiṣedhaḥ|

nānāsvarāpavāda iti yadyapi ṭhanudātaṃ padamekavarjam' ityasti,
tathāpi varjane viśeṣāśrayaṇātparyāyeṇa nānāsvaraprasaṅgaḥ| tatra
rājaśabdaḥ ṭhkaninyuvṛṣitakṣi' ityādinā kaninpratyāntatvādādyaudātaḥ;
ṭhpuraḥ kuṣan'----puruṣaḥ; brahmaṇo'patyaṃ brāhmaṇāḥ--aṇantaḥ;
ṭhkalatṛpaśca'; ṭhvṛṣādibhyaścit';ṭhkamerbuk ca'---kambalaḥ;
ṭhkanyārājanyaśipyāmanupyāṇāmantaḥ' iti kanyāśabdo'natasvaritaḥ;
ṭhsvanahasorvā' ityap, dhātusvaraḥ; paṭatpaṭaddhanyata iti paṭahaḥ,
pṛṣodarādirantodātaḥ; ṭhsvanahasorvā' ityap, dhātusvaraḥ;
paṭatpaṭaddhanyata iti paṭahaḥ, pṛṣodarādirantodātaḥ; ṭhśāśapibhyāṃ
danau', pacādiṣu nadaḍiti paṭha|lte, ṭitvānṅīp-nadī;
udātanivṛttisvaraḥ; poṣaśabdo ghañantaḥ; ṭhśradṛbhaso'diḥ' ṭhdṛṇāteḥ
ṣug hrasvaśca' dṛṣat, pratyayasvaraḥ; samidhyate yayeti samit,
sampadāditvātkvip, kṛdutarapadaprakṛtisvaraḥ--ete nānāsvarāḥ,
teṣāmapavādaḥ ||

iti śrīharadatamiśraviracitāyāṃ padamañjaryāṃ ṣaṣṭhasyādhyāyasya prathamaḥ
pādaḥ
-----|||-----e atha ṣaṣṭhādhyāye dvitīyaḥ pādaḥ 
e padamañjarī 
e bahuvrīhau prakṛtyā pūrvapadam || 6 - 2 - 1 || 
e iha yasya vikāraḥ prāptastasya prakṛtibhāvo vidheyaḥ| na ca kṛtsnasya
pūrvapadasya śeṣanighātalakṣaṇo vikāraḥ prāptaḥ kintu
tatsthayorudātasvaritayoreva, tasmātyoreva pūrvapadaśabdo
vartate,tadāha - pūrvapadagrahaṇamityādi| samāsāntodātatve
hītyādinā vikāraprāptiṃ darśayati|
samāsāntodātatvāpavādo'yamiti| nāprāpte tasminnārambhāt | nanu
ca yatra sāmānyavidhiprapṛtimanapekṣya
viśeṣavidhipravṛttistatrāpabādatvam, yathā -- karmaṇyaṇ
āto'nupasarge kaḥ iti iha tu satyāṃ vikāraprāptau prakutibhāvo
vidheyaḥ, vikāraprāptiśca samāsasyetyasmin pravavṛta iti kathaṃ
tatpravṛtyapekṣastadapavādaḥ, ataḥ samāsasyetyasminpravṛte prāptasya
śoṣanidhātasyaivāyamapavādo yuktaḥ naitadedhama, yadyayaṃ
nighātāpavādaḥ syāt, tatraivāyaṃ brūyād - anudātampadamekavarjama
bahuvrīhau pūryapadam iti | nanvevanutyamāne samapāda ityādau
svābhāvikasyāpi pūrvapadānudātasya pratiṣedhaprasaṅgaḥ, kiṃ kāraṇam
anantarasya vidhirvā bhavati pratipedho vā iti
tasmātsamāsasyeteyasyānantaramārabhyamāṇastasyaivāyamapavādaḥ| nanu
cektam -- kathaṃ tatpravṛkatyapekṣastadapavādaḥ iti ucyate
nidānaecchedena nidānina ucchedaḥ śakyate kartum,
samāsāntodātatvaṃ ca śeṣanidhātalakṣaṇasya pūrvapadavikārasya
nidānam, atastadabhāvadvayoreṇa nidānabhūtasya
samāsāntodātasyaivāsmin viṣaye'pravṛttirākhyāyate | nanvevaṃ
nānāpadasvaraprāptau samāsasāntodātasyārambhātadapravṛtau dvayorapi
pūrvetarapadayoḥ prakṛtsvaraprasaṅgaḥ, tathā hi sati na bahuvrīheḥ iti
