samāsāntodātatvameva ptipevet, astu vā samāsāntodātatvam,
astu vā soṣavidhātaḥ, paścātu prakṛtvetyanena svaraviśeśamupalakṣya
sa svaraḥ pūrvapadasya vidhīyate, śeṣavidhātātprāk pūrvapadāsya
prakṛtyā yaḥ svarastatsvarakaṃ pūrvapadaṃ bahuvrīhau bhavatītiḥ yadi vā
prakṛtyā ityanenasvaraviśeṣe upalakṣite satyayamartho bhavati
bahuvrīhau pūrvapadasya svabhāviko yaḥ svara ādyaudātatvādikaḥ sa
bhavatīti, evaṃ ca yathā pūrvapadasyādirudāto bhavatītyuktena
samāsasyetyetatpravṛtyapekṣā, tādṛgotaditi yujyate tadapavādatā| 
e kṛṣṇo mṛga iti| yasyājinaṃ kṛṣṇājinamityucyate| 
e brahmacārinśabdaḥ kṛdutarapadaprakṛtisvareṇāntodāta iti| tathā
cādhīyate--- 
ebrahmacārī carati viṣayadviṣām| kasya brahmacāryasītyādau ṇiniḥ,
pūrvapadādyauta dātatvaṃ tu na bhavati, pravṛddhādiṣu pāṭhādākutigaṇo
hi sa iṣyate | vṛtau tu kṛdutarapadaprakṛtisvareṇetyupalakṣaṇam |
apara āha-cchandasi parādiśca parāntaśca ityantedātatvam|
vṛtestvayamarthaḥ -- brahmaeva carati brahmacārītyupamānamatra pūrvapadam,
tataḥ kim upamānaṃ śabdārthaprakṛtāveva iti
niyamātkṛdutarapadaprakṛtisvara eva bhavatīti | snātakaśabdaḥ
kanpratyayānta iti| yāvādiṣu snāta vedasamāptau iti paṭha|lte | 
e manorjātāvañyatau ṣukca, manuṣyaḥ | yadi tarhmayaṃ prakṛtibhāvaḥ
samāsāntodātatvaṃ bādhate, sarvānudāte'pi pūrvapade bādheta,
tatrāpi hyasya pravṛttirna kenacidvāryate, viśeṣavidhiśca pravartamānaḥ
satyapi sambhave, sāmānyavidherbādhako bhavati, takradānamiva
dadhidānasya ityata āha -- udātagrahaṇamityādi | nyāyate'pyayamarthaḥ
siddhaḥ, kathaṃ yasya vikāraḥ prāptastasya prakṛtibhāvo vidheyaḥ,
vikāraprāptiścodātasvaritayoreva, ata eva pūrvamuktamudāte
svarite vā vartate iti| 
e samabhāga iti | samaśabdaḥ suño ḍamap iti vyutpāditaḥ
sarvānudātataḥ | nanvatrāsatyapi samāsāntodātatve bhāgaśabdasya
karṣātvataḥ iti antodātātvat samābhāgaśabdo'ntodāta eva
bhaviṣyati| tasmādudāharāṇadigiyaṃ darśitā, samapāda
ityudāhartavyam, pādaśabdo vṛṣāditvādādyaudātaḥ| 
e kimarthaṃ punaridamucyate pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaro yathā syāt,
samāsāntodātatvaṃ mā bhūditi,nañsubhyām ityetanniyamārthaṃ
bhaviṣyati - yadi bahuvrīhauvantodātatvaṃ bhavati
nañsubhayāmeveti| na caivaṃ nānāpadasvaraprāptau
samāsāntodātatvavidhānānniyamena tasminvyāvitite'pi
pūrvotarāpadayordvayorapi paryāyoṇa prakṛtisvaraprasaṅgaḥ, 
eśiternityābahvac ityasya niyamārthatvāt yadi bahuvrīhāvutarapadaṃ
prakṛtyā bhavati śitereva paramiti ucyate nañsubhayām ityeṣa
tāvanniyame nepapadyate anudaraḥ, sūdara ityādau udārāśveṣu kṣepe
iti pūrvapadāntodātasya prāptasya bādhanādvidhisambhavāt|
śiternityābahvac ityetadapi -- śiternityābahvajevetyanena
niyameta śītilalāṭādiṣevevotarapadāprakṛtisvaraṃ nivartayet,
na citraguprabhṛtiṣvityārabhyamevaitat | 
e bahuvrīhigrahaṇaṃ tu śakyamakartum tatpuruṣe kasmānna bhavati
tatpuruṣe tulyārtha ityādiniyamārthaṃ bhaviṣyati - tatpuruṣe
tutyārthādyeveti, gantavyapaṇyameva vāṇije,gatādiṣvevotaravadeṣu
dvigāvityādi| dvandve kasmānna bhavati rājanyabahuvacane
ityetanniyamārthaṃ bhaviṣyati - dvandve bhavati rājanyabahuvacanadvandva
eveti| avyayībhāve kāsmānna bhavati paripratyupāpāvarjyamāna ityādi
niyamārthaṃ bhaviṣyati -- paripratthupāpā evāvyayībhāva iti |
viparītastu niyamaḥ sarvatra na bhaviṣyati nāniṣṭārthā
śāstrapravūtiriti| evamapyasati bahuvīhigrahaṇe samāsāntodātasya
pūrvapadaprakṛtisvarasya caikaviśayatvādvirodhācca tulyaśvataḥ,
pañcāratnirityādau paryāyaḥ prāpnoti tatpuruṣādiṣu
tulyārthādīnyeva pūrvapadāni prakṛtisvarāṇi bhavanti nānyāni
ityeva hi niyamaḥ kṛtaḥ, na tulyārthādipūrvapadeṣu tatpurupādiṣu
pūvapadāprakṛtisvalatvameva iti |
athāmyagṛhyamāṇaviśeṣatvādubhayaniyamaḥ tatpurupādiṣu
tulyārthādīnyeva, teṣu pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratvameveti tathā ca
bahvanyatarasyām iti vartamāne diṣṭivitastyośca iti vikalpo
vidhīyate, pañcadiṣṭiḥ, pañcavitastirityādau igante dvigau iti
nityapūrvapadaprakṛtisvaro mā bhūditi tathāpi citragurityādau
bahuvrīhau paryāyaprasaṅgaḥ, jñāpakātsiddham, yadayam dvitribhyāṃ
pādadanmūrddhasu iti dvipādityādāvāntodātavikalpaṃ śāsti,
tajjñāpayati - na bahuvrīhāvantodātatvaṃ paryāyoṇa bhavati iti
evamapyudātaviṣayameva jñāpakaṃ syāt -- bahuvrīhāvantodātatvaṃ
paryāyeṇa bhavati iti | kiñca syāt udātasvaritayostu
pūrvotarapadasthayoḥ paryāyaprasaṅgaḥ | na ca svarite ya
udātastadāśrayaṃ jñāpakaṃ yujyate, aco hyudātasaṃjñā, na ca varṇaikadeśo
gṛhmate | atha varṇatvāvarṇatvakṛtaṃ bhedamutsṛnyodātaśrutiparaṃ
jñāpakaṃ vaṇyaita, tadā bahuvrīhigrahaṇaṃ śakyamakartum || 
etatpuruṣe tulyārthatutīyasaptamyupamānāvyayadvitīyākṛtyā || 6 - 2
- 2 || 
e sadṛkśabdo'pītyādi| kṛdutarapadaprakṛtīsvareṇetyetadapekṣate| 
e kumudaśabdo'pītyādi | tatra yadā kapratyayāntastadā
thāthādisvareṇāntodātaḥ, tathā ca anudātasya ca yatrodātalopaḥ
ityatra kumudvānityudāhṛtam, uktaṃ ca -- kumudātayo'ntodātā iti|
yadā tvavyutpannaṃ tadā nabviṣayasyanisantasya ityādyaudāta ityuktam |
apara āha - jalaje napuṃsakaviṣayaḥ kumudaśabdaḥ, yastu vānaraviśeṣe
kumudaśabdaḥ sa puṃlliṅgaḥ, tatreha jalajavācyudāhṛtaḥ, anudātasya
ca ityatra tu vānaravacana iti | 
e dūrvākāṇḍaśarakāṇḍaśabdāvityādi| ādyaprāptipradarśanametat, ṣaṭ
ca kaṇḍādīni ityutarapadādyaudātatvena tatra bhāvyam| 
e nañkunipātānāmiti| nipātatvādeva siddhe nañgrahaṇam
akaraṇirityādau parasyāpi kṛtsvarasya bādhanārtham | tathā
cāvyathītyatrāpi kṛtā saha nirdiṣṭo yatra nañ, tatrāpi naña eva
svaro bhavati, tathā vibhaktissarānnañsvaro balīyān bhavati |
kugrahaṇaṃ tu cādiṣu pāṭhābhāvāt, paṭhitavyastvasau,
anyathā'vyayasaṃkṣā na syāta svarādiṣvapi pāṭhābhāvāt | snātvākālaka
iti | mayūravyaṃsakādirayam | yadyevam,sa tatraivāntodātaḥ
paṭhiṣyate evamapi parigaṇanaṃ
kartavyam,sāmikṛtam,svayandhautamityādau prakṛtiravaro mā
bhūditi| iha kasmānna bhavati-paramaṃ kārakaṃ paramakārakam,parameṇa
kārakeṇa paramakārakeṇa,parame kārake paramakārake iti na hi
viśeṣaṇasamāsaḥ prathamāntānāmeveti niyame'sti | tena dvitīyādyantaṃ
pūrvapadamit codyam | parihārastu lakṣaṇapratipadoktaparibhāṣayā
tṛtīyādīnāṃ pratipadaṃ yaḥ samāsastatrāyaṃ svaraḥ| ayaṃ tu
vibhaktiviśaiṣamanupādāya viśeṣaṇasamāsa iti || 
evarṇe varṇoṣvanete|| 6 - 2 - 3 || 
e anete taiti pratiṣedhādvahuvacananirdeśāccotarapade svarūgrahaṇaṃ na
bhavati, tatsāhacaryātpūrvapade'pi| kṛṣṇāśabdo
nakpratyayānto'ntodāta iti | phiṣi tu kṛṣṇasyāmṛgākhyā cet ti
cchandasyantodātatvam, anyatrādyaudātatvaṃ vyavasthitam|| 
egāṃdhalavaṇāyoḥ pramāṇe|| 6 - 2 - 4 || 
e śambagādhamiti|gādhṛ pratiṣṭhāyām,gādhyata taiti gādhaḥ arddharcādiḥ,
iyatāyāḥ paricchitaḥ - iyatāparicchedaḥ | kriyāśabdo'tra pramāṇaśabdo
gṛhyate, na tvāyomamāne rūḍha ityarthaḥ || 
edāyādyaṃ dāyāde|| 6 - 2 - 5 || 
e dātavyo dāyaḥ - bhāgaḥ, aṃśa ityarthaḥ | dāyamādate dāyādaḥ,
mūlavibhujāditvātkaḥ, dāyādāsya bhāvo dāyādyam | kiṃ punastat
dāyāsyādānaṃ tatsambandho vā| iha tu lakṣyamāṇo''dīyamāne eva
dāyadyaśabdo vartate | 
e athetyādi | vakṣyamāṇo'bhiprāyaḥ | tamevāviṣkaroti - yadyevamiti |
śeṣalakṣaṇauveti| sāmānyalakṣaṇaivātra ṣaṣṭhī, na
pratipadamityevaśabdasyarthaḥ | yadi śeṣalakṣaṇaivātra ṣaṣṭhī, kimarthaṃ
punastatra vidhānam ityāha - tāsyāstviti | saptamī tāvadvidheyā,
aprāptatvāt | tatra yadi saiva vidhīyeta, tato'sau
viśeṣavihitatvāt ṣaṣṭha|la bādhikā vijñāyeta, maivaṃ vijñāyīti
punaḥ saiva śeṣalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭha|lbhyanujñāyate, na tvapūrvā vidhīyata
ityarthaḥ || 
epritibandhi cirakṛcchayoḥ || 6 - 2 - 6 || 
e kāryasiddha pratibadhnātīti pratibandhi, āvaśyake ṇiniḥ |
viśeṣaṇasamāsa iti | nanu ca sāmānādhikaraṇye sati sa bhavati, na
ceha tadasti gamanaśabdasya gativācitvāt ciraśabdasya ca
kālavācitvāt naiṣa doṣaḥ cirakālabhāvini gamane'tra ciraśabdo
vartate | mayūravyaṃsakādirvaiṣa iti | gamanamatra viśeṣyam,
tadviśeṣaṇe tu cirakṛcchre, ato viśeṣyasya pūrvanipātārthaṃ
mayūravyāsakāditvameṣṭavyamiti bhāvaḥ | pūrvapadasya
pratibandhivācitvamupapannayati | gamanaṃ hītyadi | karāṇanaikalyāddhi
cirakārabhāvi gamanaṃ kṛcchrayogi ca, kṛcchram - duḥkham, tadyogi ca
kāryasiddheḥ pratibandhi jāyate || 
epade'padeśe || 6 - 2 - 7 || 
e accāraḥ - pulīṣakriyā || 
enivāte vātatrāṇe|| 6 - 2 - 8 || 
e ḍa|lkpratyayānto'ntodāta ityapare iti | kavateḍa|lÇk iti
sūtramadhīyate | ḍakārasyetsaṃjñā na bhavati
guṇapratiṣedhārthātkakārānubandhāt || 
eśārade'nārtave || 6 - 2 - 9 || 
e udāharaṇe rajjūddhṛte rajjuśabdo dṛṣatpiṣṭeṣu dṛṣacchabdaḥ, tataḥ
karmadhāraya'svapadavigrahaḥ| sṛjerasum ca ityatra skandeḥ salopaśca
ityataḥ salopa iti vartate, tena sṛjerantyādacaḥ paro'yamasum,
salope yaṇādeśe'sumaḥ sakārasya jaśtve ca rajjuriti bhavati || 
eadhvaryukaṣāyayorjātau|| 6 - 2 - 10 || 
e niyataviṣayā iti| varaṇaviśeṣaniyatā ityarthaḥ|| 
esadṛśapratirupayoḥ sādṛśye || 6 - 2 - 11 || 
e sadṛśāgrahaṇamanarthakam tutīyāsamāsavacanāt| sadṛśaśabdena
tutīyāsamāsa ucyate - pūrvasadṛśasamonārtha iti, tatra tutīyāpūrva
padaṃ prakṛtisvaraṃ bhavatītyeva siddhamata āha - ṣaṣṭhīsamāsārthaṃ ceti|
tulyārthayoge ṣaṣṭha|lpi vidhīyate, tatra yadā tasyāḥ ṣaṣṭhayāḥ
samāsaḥ kriyate, tadāpi yathā syādityevamartha sadṛśagrahaṇam| nanu
cānabhidhānātṣaṣṭhīsamāso na bhaviṣyati traiśabdyaṃ hi naḥ sādhyam --
mātuḥ sadṛśaḥ,mātrā sadṛśaḥ mātṛsadṛśa iti etacca vināpi
ṣaṣṭhīsamāsena siddhyatyeva ata āha -- ihetyādi| aluki sati
rūpaviśeṣasya vidyamānatvādavaśyakartavyaḥ ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ, tadarthaṃ ceha
sadṛśagrahaṇaṃ kartavyam | yadyevam, tṛtīyāsamāse sadṛśagrahaṇam, yathā
-- vidyā sadṛśo vidyāsadṛśa iti| na hyatra ṣaṣṭha|lrtho'sti,kintu
tṛtīyārthaḥ, vidyayā hetunā sadṛśa ityarthaḥ, anyo devadatādiratra
pratiyogī | apara āha -- tṛtīyāsamāso'pyaluki prayajayati --
manasaḥ saṃjñāyāṃ manasāsadṛśa iti| atretyādi| daśi daśanasparśanayoḥ
daṃśeṣṭo na ā ca iti ṭapratyayaḥ nakārasya cākāraḥ ṭitvānṅīp,
yasyotilopaḥ, anudātasya ca yatrodātalopaḥ iti udātatvam |
vṛṣalaśabdājjātilakṣaṇo 
eṅīṣ || 
edvigau pramāṇe|| 6 - 2 - 12 || 
e kardamādīnāñca ityatra makarakuktakuṭapārevatetyādeḥ
sūtrādādigrahaṇamanuvartate| atha dvitīyaṃ prāgīpāt ityate
dvitīyagrahaṇam | paramasaptasamamiti|samāhāre dviguḥ
pātrāditvānnapuṃsakatvam,mūlodāharaṇe tu taddhitārthe
dvigurutarapadam|| 
egantavyapaṇyaṃ vāṇije|| 6 - 2 - 13 || 
e vaṇigeva vāṇijaḥ prajñāditvādaṇ| saptamīsamāsā eta eti | saptamī
iti yogavibhāgāt | govāṇijādayastu ṣaṣṭhīsamāsāḥ|| 
emātro pajñopakamacchāye napuṃsake|| 6 - 2 - 14 || 
e phipiti ādimena yogena śāntanavīyaṃ na catuṣkaṃ
sūtramupalakṣaṇayati | tatra samudraśabdaḥ gāgarārthatvādantodātaḥ || 
esukhapriyayorhite || 6 - 2 - 15 || 
e samānādhikaraṇasamāsā ete iti | gamanādīnāṃ viśeṣa
ṇatvātpūrvanipātaṃ manyate | atha tu sukhapriyayorviśeṣaṇatvaṃ tadā
mayūravyāṃsakāditvameṣṭavyama | āyatyāmiti | pariṇāme,
āgāmikāle, bhāvikāla iti yāvat || 
eprītau ca || 6 - 2 - 16 || 
e iha tu sukhapirayayoḥ taityetāvatsūtraṃ kṛtvā hite ca iti
vaktavyam, tatrādye sūtre sukhapriyayoḥ prītyavyabhicārādeva prītau
gamyamānāyāṃ bhaviṣyati tatrāha - sukhapriyayorityādi |
brāhmaṇaśabdo'ṇantaḥ | chātraśabdaḥ cchatrā dibhyo ṇaḥ iti ṇapratyayāntaḥ |
kanyāśabdaḥ svaritānta iti |
tilyaśikyamartyakāśmaryadhānyakanyārājanyamanuṣyāṇāmantaḥ iti phiṣi
pāṭhāt || 
epatyāvaiśvarye|| 6 - 2 - 18 || 
e dhānyamantaḥ svaritamiti | ānantarapaṭhitena phiṭsūtreṇa||
gavādīnāṃ tu pūrvameva svarakathanam || 
ena bhūvākciddidhiṣu|| 6 - 2 - 19 || 
e bhūvādīnāṃ samāhāradvandve napuṃsakahasvatvam, atra
pūrvapadaprakṛtisvarapratiṣedhād vṛttikāreṇa pūrvapadānāṃ svaro
vyākhyātaḥ | tatrāditastrayaḥ kkibantāḥ |
andūdṛbhbhūjambūkaphelūkarkandhūdidhiṣūḥ iti kūpratyayānto
didhiṣūśabdo nipātitiḥ || 
evā bhuvananam|| 6 - 2 - 20 || 
e bhuvanaśabdo bhāṣāyāṃ bahulavacanātsādhuḥ || 
eāśaṅkābādhanedīyassu samābhāvane || 6 - 2 - 21 || 
e śaki śaṅkāyām bādhṛ viloḍane, āṅpūrvābhyāṃ karmaṇi ghañ |
atiśayenāntiko nedīyaḥ, antikabāḍhayornedasādhau |
astitvādhyavasāyaḥ - astitvaniścayaḥ| gamanāśaṅkādayo
viśeṣaṇasamāsāḥ, mayūravyaṃsakādayo vā || 
epūrve bhūtapūrva|| 6 - 2 - 22 || 
e āḍhyo bhūtapūrva iti| yaḥ pūrvamāḍha|l āsītsa evamucyate|
atretyādi| paramaścāsau pūrvaśceti| so'yaṃ vākyārthaḥ
pūjyamānatālakṣaṇaḥ, tasminniha pratyudaharaṇe samāsa ityarthaḥ| na tviti
| paramo bhūtapūrva iti| yo'yaṃ vākyārthaḥ pūrva parama
āsīdityavaṃrūpaḥ, na tasmin tatra samāsa iti yāvat, kiṃ kāraṇam
ityāha-tathā 
eceti | hyarthe || 
esavidhasanīḍasamāryādasaveśasadeśeṣu sāmīpye|| 6 - 2 - 23 || 
e udāharaṇeṣu ṣaṣṭīsamāsaḥ, madrādīnāṃ pūrvameva svara uktaḥ|| 
evispaṣṭādīni guṇavacaneṣu|| 6 - 2 - 24 || 
e vispaṣṭa iti | spaśa bādhanasparśanayoḥ ityasya niṣṭāyām vā dānta
ityādinā spaṣṭhaśabdo nipātitaḥ viśabdena gatisamāsaḥ| citra
citrīkaraṇe curādiḥ, tasmāderace, viśeṣeṇa citraṃ vicitram,
prādisamāsaḥ | citī saṃjñāne vigataṃ citamasya vicitaḥ, āñjū
vyaktyādiṣu tasya vipūrvasya niṣṭāyā gatisvaraḥ, tatrekārasya yo
yaṇ sa udātayaṇ bhavati | 
e sampannaśabdasyāthādisvareṇeti | gatisvarastu na bhavati, kiṃ
kāraṇam, karmaṇi iti tatrānuvartate, ayaṃ tu kartari ktaḥ|
paṭuapaṇḍitaśabdau pratyayasvareṇeti| antodāta ityapekṣete|
yadekavacanāntaṃ prakṛtam, tasya vacanavipariṇāmaṃ
kṛtvā'ntodātāviti sambandhaḥ kartavyaḥ| pāṭayateḥ
pharipāṭinamijanīnāṃ gukpaṭinākidhaśca ityupratyayaḥ, paṭiścādeśaḥ,
ikāra uccāraṇārthaḥ paṭuaḥ | paḍi gatau niṣṭhā, paṇḍitaḥ| kuśān
lātīti kuśalaḥ, lā ādāne capalaśabdaścitsvareṇeti | antodāt
ityapekṣete | caciditi vartata iti | vṛṣādibhyaśicat ityataḥ|
nipuṇāśabda ityādi| pūrvavatsambandhaḥ| puṇa karmaṇi śubhe|| 
eśrajyāvamakanyāpavatsu bhāve karmadhāraye|| 6 - 2 - 25 || 
e udāharaṇeṣu mayuravyaṃsakāditvādviśeṣyasya pūrvanipātaḥ|
iṣṭheyasunoḥ praśāsyasya śraḥ jya ca yuvālpayoḥ kananyatarasyām|
pāpiṣṭha iti | vinmatorluk| 
ekumāraśca|| 6 - 2 - 26 || 
e kumāraśramaṇeti| liṅgaviśiṣṭaparibhāṣayā kumārīśabdasya samāse
puṃvadbhāvaḥ| kumāra krīḍāyām ityasmātpacādyac, kumāraḥ |
kecitpunarityādi cakāre hyatra, kriyate, asyaiva, vidhaḥ
samuñcayārthaḥ|| 
eādiḥ pratyenasi|| 6 - 2 - 27 || 
e pratigata enaseti| avādayaḥ kuṣṭādyarthe tṛtīyayā iti tatpuruṣaḥ |
dvitīye tu vigrahe bahuvrīhiḥ | kathaṃ
punanantareṇodātagrahamudātasvaro labhyate ityāha -- udāta
ityetaditi | sāmarthyameva darśayati | pūrvapadeti | prakṛtyeti hi
vartate, tatraivamabhisambandhaḥ -- pūrvatra kumāraśabde prakṛtibhāvena yaḥ
svaraḥ sathāpitaḥ so'trāderbhavatīti|| 
eigantakālakapālamagālaśarāveṣu dvigau|| 6 - 2 - 19 || 
e kṛtāṇapratyayalopā iti| kuto'ṇpratyayalopo yaṣāṃ te tathoktāḥ |
dvigāviti kiṃ paramaśarāva iti | ṣaṣṭhīsamāso'yam | bahuvrīrau tu
pūrvapadaprakutisvareṇa bhāvyameva | igantaprakutisvaratve yaṇguṇayo
rupasaṃkhyānam -- pañcāratnyo daśāratnyaḥ,yaṇguṇayoḥ
kṛtayorigante dvigāvityeṣa svaro na prāpnoti ityata āha
yaṇguṇayorityādi| prāksubutpate| svaro bhavannantaraṅgaḥ,
yaṇguṇau tu subapekṣatvādvahiraṅgau | sthānivadbhāvādveti | na
cātra svaravidhau na sthānivatvam, alopājādeśatvāt | pañcāratnya
iti | chāndaso'yaṃ prayogaḥ| tatra jasi ca iti guṇe na bhavati
jasādiṣu cchandasi vā vacanam iti vacanāt|| 
ebahvanyatarasyām|| 6 - 2 - 30 || 
e bahuśabdo'ntodāta iti| kurbhruśca iti vartamāne landhibaṃhyaerna
lopaśca iti kupratyaye vyutpāditatvāt || 
esaptamī siddhaśuṣkapakvabandheṣvakālāt|| 6 - 2 - 32 || 
e ṇyapratyayāntāviti| vuñcchaṇādiṣu saṅkāśādibhyo ṇyaḥ| avateḥ
kakpratyayaḥ, jvaratvara ityādinoṭha, ūkaḥ | kumbhakalaśaśabdābhyāṃ
jātilakṣaṇo ṅīṣ, bhrāṣṭraśabdo bhrasjeṣṭrani vṛddhau ca vyutpāditaḥ |
cakraśabdaḥ kuñaḥ ko dve ca| 
e saptamīsvara ityādi| tatpuruṣe tulyārtha ityādinā saptamyansya yaḥ
prakṛtibhāvaḥ paratvātthāthādisvareṇa bādhita iti| yatra tu kṛtsvareṇa
bādhita thaiti pāṭhaḥ, tatra kṛdāntasya yaḥ svaraḥ
thāthādilakṣaṇastenetyarthaḥ || 
eparipratyupāpā varjyamānāhorātrāvayadheṣu|| 6 - 2 - 33 || 
e paritrigartamiti | trigartanvarjayitvetyarthaḥ| apaparī varjane iti
karmapravacanīyasaṃjñā, pañcamyagāṅparibhiḥ iti pañcamī |
apaparibahirañcavaḥ pañcamyā ityavyayībhāvaḥ| sauvīrādayo'pi
janapadaviśeṣāḥ| pratipūrvāhṇamiti | lakṣaṇenābhipratī ābhimukhye
ityavyayībhāvaḥ| upapūrvāhṇamiti | avyayaṃ vibhakti ityādinā
sāmīpye| kiṃ punaḥ 
ekāraṇamapapararyoreva varjyamānamudāhṛtam, netarayoḥ tatrāha -
tatreti | athāhorātrāvayavā api itarayorapaparthoḥ
kasmānnodāhriyante ata āha -- ahorātrāvayavā apīti |
parivanamityatreti | paripratyupāpā ityasyāvakāśaḥ -
paritrigartamiti, vanaṃ samāse ityasyāvakāśaḥ -- pravaṇamiti
parivanamityatra vanaṃ samāse ityetadbhavati vipratiṣedhena |
apavādatvaṃ cātra hetuḥ, na vipratiṣedhaḥ | samāsasya ityeva siddhe
vanasya punarvacane etatprayojanam -- ye'nye
tadapavādāstadvādhanārtham | sarvayaivāvyayasvaraṃ bahuvrīhisvaraṃ ca
bādhate, evamidamapi bādhiṣyate|| 
erājanyabahuvacanadvandve'ndhakavṛṣṇiṣu|| 6 - 2 - 34 || 
e śvāphalkacaitrakarodhakā iti | pramādapāṭho'yam | atra tripade hi
dvandve yatyakvamapekṣeya pūrvapadaṃ tasyaiva bhavati, tataśca caitrakaśabdasya
svaravacanamanupapannaṃ, tasmāt śvāphalkacaitrakāścaitrakarīdhako iti
pāṭhaḥ | ekastu caitrakaśabdo lekhakaiḥ punaruktiśaṅkayā tyaktaḥ |
śiniśabda ādyaudāta iti | śiṅe nin hrasvaśca bahulavacanāt |
tadapatyeṣviti | yadyapi śiniśabda iti prakṛtam, tathāpi
śabdasyāpatyāsyāsambhavācchineḥ kṣatkṣiyasyaiva yānyapatyāni
teṣvityarthaḥ| abhedena - abhedopacāreṇa | 
e nanu ca rājño'patye jātigrahaṇam iti vacanād rājanyaśabdaḥ
kṣatriyajativacanaḥ, tataśca dvaipyabhaimāyanā 
eityuktaṃ pratyudāharaṇ nopapadyate, teṣāmapi kṣatriyatvād ata āha
-- rājanyagrahaṇamityādi | andhakavṛṣṇīnāṃ kṣatriyatvāvyabhicārād
rājanyagrahaṇamuktaviśeṣaparigrahārthamiti bhāvaḥ || 
esaṅkhyā|| 6 - 2 - 35 || 
e ekādaśoti | saṅkhyāyā alpīyasyāḥ ityekaśabdasya pūrvanipātaḥ,
prāgekādaśabhyo cchandasi iti nipātanāddīrghaḥ | dvādaśeti| dvyaṣṭanaḥ
saṅkhyāyām ityātvam || 
eācāryopasarjanaścāntevāsī|| 6 - 2 - 36 || 
e ācārya upasarjanaṃ yasya sa ācāryopasarjanaḥ, ante
vasatītyuntevāsī, śayavāsavāsiṣvakālād ityaluk| gauṇaścāyaṃ
nirdeśaḥ| dvandavasya yānyavayavapadāni
tānyācāryopasarjanavacanatvādantevāsivācitvāñca tathocyante|
tadavayavadvandvo'pyavayavadharmeṇa tathocyate| pāṇiniśabdādiñ na
bhavatīti pūrvamevoktam | rauḍhiśabdādapi na bhavati, na dvyacaḥ
prācyabhārateṣu iti niṣedhāt| 
e ācāryopasarjanagrahaṇaṃ dvandvaviśeṣaṇamiti | na pūrvavadaviśeṣaṇam
| prathamā tu saptamyarthe draṣṭavyā | kimarthaṃ punardvandvaviśeṣaṇaṃ
vijñāyate ityāha -- sakalo dvandva iti| iha mā bhūditi|
pūrvapadaviśeṣaṇetvatrāpi syāt || 
ekārtakījapādayaśca|| 6 - 2 - 37 || 
e prakṛtisparapūrvapadā iti | prakṛtiśabdaḥ spābhāvik varta te,
prakṛti -- svābhāvikaḥ svaro yeṣāṃ tāni prakṛtisvarāṇi,
evaṃvidhāni pūrvapadāni yeṣviti bahuvrīhiḥ| kṛtasyāpatyam,
kujasyāpatyamiti | āṇantānetāviti | ṛṣivācitvādābhyāmaṇ |
utarapadasya vyutpattipradarśanaṃ prāsaṅgikam, pūrvapadasyaiva tu
svarasiddhaye pradarśanīyam | māṇḍūakeśabdaḥ ḍhakca maṇḍūakāt iti
ḍhagantaḥ| 
e avantyaśmakā iti| avantiśabdo'ntodātaḥ, tasmāt
vṛddhetkosalājādāṅ tasya tadrājatvādbahuṣu luk, avantīnāṃ
nivāso janapadaḥ, jāturarthikasyāṇā janapade luk| aśmakaśabdāt
sālvāvayava ityādinā iñ, lugādi pūrvavat| 
e śyāparṇīti | śāṇÇóravādyaño ṅīn | 
e kapirantodāta iti | prātipadikasvareṇa, kamu kāntau ktic,
pṛṣodarāditvādata utvam | 
e kuntiśabdo'ntodātaḥ, avantivatkuntayaḥ| śobhanaṃ rāṣṭramasya
surāṣṭraḥ, tasyāpatyāni bahūni janapadaśabdātkṣatriyādañ lugādi
pūrvavat | citi smṛtyām, ktic, kuntivaccintayaḥ | 
e taḍi tāḍane, taṇḍaḥ, tasmādevāvapurvādvataṇḍaḥ, vaṣṭi
bhāgurirallopamavāpyorupasargayoḥ ityakāralopaḥ| madī harṣe,
vipūrvāt ktaḥ, na dhyākhyā ityādinā natvābhāvaḥ, na vimato'vimataḥ|

e śalaṅku śalaṅkaṃ ceti | naḍādiṣvetatpaṭha|lte | babhrorapatyaṃ
bābhratavaḥ, aṇ | dānaccayuto dānacyutaḥ tadapatyamapi dānacyuta eva|
kaṭaśabdaḥ pacādyajantaḥ, loke'kṣi yasya sa lokakṣaḥ, tasyāpatyaṃ
laukākṣiḥ, tasya 
echātrā laukākṣāḥ | strīkumāramiti | samāharadvandvaḥ | 
e muda harṣe, igupadhalakṣaṇaḥ kaḥ, mudaḥ, pippatamatīti pippalādaḥ,
karmaṇyaṇ | vadeḥ saḥ, vatsaḥ, jīryateratṛn, jaran , tayoḥ
samāhāradvandvaḥ | 
e ṣidbhidādibhyo'ṅ, jarā | bhujimṛṅbhyāṃ yuktyukau mṛtyuḥ ||

emahān
vrīhyaparāhvagṛṣṭīṣvāsajābālabhārabhāratahelihilarauravapravṛddheṣu|| 6
- 2 - 38 || 
e mahacchabdo'ntodāta iti | vartamāne pṛṣadbṛhanmahanat ityatra
tathā nipātanāt | tasyetyādi | etañca lakṣaṇapratipadoktaparibhāṣayā
labhyate | 
e yadyevam, pravṛddhagrahaṇamanarthakam, karmadhāraye'niṣṭhā iti
vakṣyamāṇenaiva siddhatvāt, kṛdgrahaṇe garikārakapūrvasyāpi
grahaṇam iti pravṛddhaśabdasyāpi ktāntatvād ata āha -
karmadhāraye'niṣṭhetyayamapīti | 
etatrāpi lakṣaṇapratipadoktaparibhāṣayā ktāntena pratipadokto yaḥ
karmadhārayastasya grahaṇamityarthaḥ || 
ekṣullakaśca vaiśvadeve|| 6 - 2 - 39 || 
e kṣudhaṃ lātīti kṣullaḥ| āto'nupasarga kaḥ, torli iti parasavarṇaḥ
|| 
euṣṭraḥ sādivāmyoḥ|| 6 - 2 - 40 || 
e uṣṭraśabdaḥ ṣṭranpratyayānta iti| uṣa dāhe ityetasmāt ṣṭran iti
vartamāne uṣikhanibhyāṃ kit ityevaṃ vyutpāditatvāt || 
egauḥ sādasādisārathiṣu|| 6 - 2 - 41 || 
e gosādā iti | saderghañ, tataḥ, ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ | gāṃ sādayatīti
veti | saderṇyantātkarmaṇyaṇ, tasmādeva ṇiniḥ - gosādī | atra
sādasādinoḥ kṛtsvarasyāpavādaḥ, sārathau tu samāsasvarasya|| 
ekurugārihapatariktagurvasūtajaratyaślīladṛḍharupā pārevaḍavā
taitilakadrūḥ paṇyakambalo dāsībhārāṇāṃ ca|| 6 - 2 - 42 || 
e atra kurugārhapatetyevamādayaḥ paṇyakambalaparyantāḥ sapta samāsāḥ |
tatrādito dvāvivibhaktikau, itare prathamaikavacanāntāḥ| sā ca prathamā
subvyatyayena ṣaṣṭhayāḥ sthāne draṣṭavyā | dāsībhārāṇāmiti |
bahuvacananirdeśādādyartho vyākhyāyate| 
e kurbhruśca, kṛgro rucca -- kuruḥ, vṛjī varjane nidityadhikāre
igupadhātkiḥ -- vṛjiḥ, phiṣi tu igantānāñca dvyaṣām iti
patre'ntodātaḥ| tasyārthaḥ-najapadaśabdānāmiti vartate,antaḥ pūrvo
vā iti ca,janapada vācināmigantānāṃ dvyacāmādirudāto bhavati
anto vā - kāśayaḥ ,cedayaḥ| etena kuruśabdo vyākhyātaḥ| 
e riktapūrvādayaḥ karmadhārayāḥ| śrīryasyāstīti śrīśabdo
lāvaṇyavacanaḥ | kapilakāditvāllalvamiti | kṛpo ro laḥ
ityatraitadvakṣyate | śrīryasyāsti tacchrīlaśabdenocyata iti |
etadevopapādayati -- aśalīladṛḍharūpeti hīti | saṃsthānamātreṇa
śobhaneti| kubjatvādīnāmabhāvāt, dṛḍhatvācca saṃsthānasya |
mātraśabdavyārvyaṃ darśayati - niḥśrīketi | aseyaivāryaṃ
vispaṣṭīkaroti - lāvaṇyarahitoti | 
e titilino'patyamiti| tilaśabdānmatvarthīya iniḥ,
pṛṣodarāditvātiśabdasya dvirvacanam| tatra yadāpatye'rthe'ṇ tadā
nastaddhite iti ṭilopaḥ yadā tu chāttre tadā nāntasya ṭilope
ityādinopasaṅkhyānena ṭilopaḥ | ye tu tatra taitiliśabdaṃ
paṭhanti, te'trāpi taitilino'patyamiti vigṛhṇanti,
pṛṣodarāditveneva ca rūpasiddhiḥ | paṇyaśabdaḥ avadyapaṇya it yadantaḥ
yato'nāvaḥ ityādyaudātaḥ| 
e paṇyakambalaḥ saṃjñāyāmiti | niyatapramāṇasya viyatamūlyasya
kambalasyaiṣā saṃjñā | samāsantodātatvameveti | nanu ca paṇyaśabdasya
kṛtyapratyayāntatvāt tatpuruṣe tulyārtha iti pūrvapadaprakṛtisvareṇa
bhāvyam ata āha pratipadokte hīti | kṛtyatulyākhyā ajātyā iti yaḥ
kṛtyasamāsaḥ pratipadoktaḥ, tatraiva sa svaraḥ | ayaṃ tu viśeṣyaṇa iti
sāmānyalakṣaṇavihitaḥ,kambalaśabdasya jātiśabdatvāt| kṛtyatulyākhyā
ajātyā ityetaddhi guṇakriyāvācināmaniyate pūrvanipātprasaṅge
kṛtyāntasya pūrvanipātārtham, na tu jātipratiṣedhārtham |
ānātyeti tu vacanaṃ nyayasiddhārthānuvāda eveti sthitiḥ| candre
māṅe ḍicca iti mithune'siḥ, pūrvavacca 
esarvamityasipratyayaḥ prakṛtaḥ| candraśabda upapade māṅmāne
ityasmādasipratyayo bhavati ḍicca, ḍitvāṭṭilopaḥ, candramiva
mīyate candramāḥ| candramiti rajatam, amṛtaṃ ca| candra iti vā mīyate
candramāḥ| candraśabdastu sphāyitañci ityādinā rakpratyayāntaḥ| 
e yasya tatpuruṣasvetyādinā dāsībhārāderākṛtigaṇatvaṃ darśayati|| 
ecaturthī tadarthe || 6 - 2 - 43 || 
e tasmai idaṃ tadartham , tacchabdena caturthyantārtha ucyate, yadāha --
tadabhidheyārthaṃ yaditi| tasya caturthyantasya yadabhidheyaṃ
tadarthamityarthaḥ | ramanta'sminsthitā iti rathaḥ,
hanikṛṣinīramikaśibhyaḥ kyan, anudātopadeśa
ityanunāsikalopaḥ,vallīśabdo gaurādiṅīṣantaḥ | 
e tadartha iti kim,kuberabaliriti | atra tādarthyasya bhāvād
gosukhamiti pratyadāhāryaṃ manyante | prakṛtivikārabhāve
svaro'yamiṣyata iti | samāsaprakaraṇa evaitatsamyagupapāditam,
ātrāpi jñāpakaṃ vakṣyati|| 
earthe|| 6 - 2 - 44 || 
e tadarthaviśeṣā eva dāruhiraṇyādayo bhavantīti| dāruhiraṇyādayo
viśeṣā eva tadarthā bhavantītyarthaḥ | tādarthyaṃ hi taccheṣabhāvaḥ, saca
viśeṣāṇameva bhavati, na sāmānyasyati manyate | 
e kecitpunarityādi | ta evaṃ manyante neyaṃ rājājñā - viśeṣā eva
tadarthā iti, tena sāmānyavācinyapyarthaśabde pūrveṇaiva siddham iti |
aśpaghāsa iti | nanu ca tadarthena prakṛtivikārabhāve samāsaḥ ityaktam
aśvaghāsādayaḥ ṣaṣṭhīsamāsāḥ iti ca evaṃ manyate -yadātra
prakṛtivikārabhāve sve iti sthitam ,tadāśvaghāsādau
caturthosamāse'pi doṣa iti| śvaśruśvaśuramiti| vibhāṣā senā
ityādinā napuṃsakatvam|| 
ekte ca || 6 - 2 - 45 || 
e gobhyo rakṣitaṃ dīyata iti sampradāne caturthīti| atha tādarthye
caturthyā ko doṣaḥ caturtho tadarthe ityeva svarasyasiddhatvāt |
naitadasyodāharaṇamupapadyate katham prakṛtivikārabhāve svaraḥ
ityuktam, na cātra prakṛtivikārabhavaḥ satyam samāsavidhau tu
rakṣitagrahaṇasyedaṃ prayojanaṃ darśitam || 
ekarmadhāyera'niṣṭā || 6 - 2 - 46 || 
e śriñ sevāyām, auṇādike ninpratyaye śreṇiḥ, mudi gro
gaggau,bahulavacanātpūṅe'pi gak pūgaḥ| kṛtākṛtamiti | ktena
nañviśiṣṭenānañ iti samāsaḥ | anihaṣṭetyanucyamāne'traiva
syāt, ayaṃ hi ktasaṃśabda nena vihitatvācchrāeṇyādisamāsādapi
pratipadoktaḥ || 
eahīne dvitīyā|| 6 - 2 - 47 || 
e hīnam - tyaktam| ahīnayācini samāsa iti | pūrvapadadvāreṇa
tasamāsasyāhinavācitvam| 
e dvitīyānupasarga iti vaktavyamiti | ahīnagrahaṇamapanīya
anupasargagrahaṇaṃ kartavyam, vyāpakatvādityarthaḥ| iha mā bhūditi|
ihāpi mā bhūdityarthaḥ| anupasargagrahaṇe ceha kriyamāṇe pravṛddhādiṣu
khaṭvārūḍhaśabdo na pāṭhayaḥ, ārūḍhaśabdasya sopasargatvāt|
etatsvarābhāve thāthādisvareṇaivāntodātasya siddhatvāt|| 
etṛtīyā karmaṇi || 6 - 2 - 48 || 
e ayamapi thāthādisvarapavādaḥ| ahirantodāta iti | āṅpūrvāddhano
ḍipratyayaḥ, āṅśca hrasvaḥ| āhanti parān, āhanyate parairiti vā
ahiḥ| keciditi| te tatrodātagrahaṇamanuvartayanti, tathāta ca
-ahannahim, ahiriva bhogairiti ādyaudātamadhīyate || 
egatiranantaraḥ|| 6 - 2 - 49 || 
e anantaraḥ iti puṃlliṅganirdeśād gatiśabdaḥ ktijantaḥ,
nipātanāccānunāsikalopaḥ| prakṛtaḥ, prahṛta iti | atra
samāsāntodātatvam, avyayapūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratvam, kṛtsavaraḥ,
thāthādisvaraḥ, ityeteṣu prāpteṣu pūrvapadaprakṛtibhāve vidhīyate| 
e vyavahitasya gaterayaṃ svarī na bhavatīti| nanu ca
nirdiṣṭagrahaṇamānantaryārtham, pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣayā ca
hṛtaśabdasktāntaḥ, tatkathaṃ ktānte parato vidhīyamāno vyavahitasya
prasajyate kṛdgraṇaparibhāṣāyā 
ektānte'nupraveśāducchabdasya prasaṅga iti cet, yadyevam,
kriyamāṇe'pyanantaragrahaṇe syāt, uddhṛtaśabdaḥ ktāntastasyānantara
eva gatiriti eva gatiriti naiṣa doṣaḥ,
anantaragrahaṇasāmardhyāddhāntoranantaro gatirāśrayiṣyate |
nanvevamapyatra paratvād gatirgatau iti nighāto bhaviṣyati, sati ca
tasmin udātasvaritādhikārādeva pūrvapadaprakṛtisvarasyāprasaṃga iti
vyavahitanivṛtyarthamanantaragrahaṇaṃ na kartavyam anantaraprāptyarthaṃ tu |
tatra ca yatraika eva gatistatra nārthā'nena | yatra tvaneko gatistatrāsau
na prāpnoti, tānantara ityanenānekagatisamavadhāne'nantarasya
prāpnoti, tadanantara ityanenānekagatisamavadhāne'nantarasya prāpyate
anyathā'bhyuddhṛtamityatroddhaḥtaśabdasya kṛdgrahaṇaparibhāṣayā
ktāntatve sati samāsāntodātatve tadapavāde ca kṛtsvare
tadavapādasthāthādisvaraḥ prāpnoti| nanu ca yathā prathame samāse
gatisvareṇa bādhitasya thāthādisvarasya punardvitīye samāse prāptiḥ,
tathā tadapavādo gatisvaro'pyanena punarbhaviṣyati naitadevam
apūrvapadatvāt | kugatiprādayaḥ ityatra niṣkāntodau
padakāryapravṛtaye subityanuvartanīyam, tatraikatvasya
vivakṣitatvātsubantasamudāyasya cāsubantatvānna
dūyoryugapatsamāso labhyata iti krameṇāsau vidheyaḥ |
gatikārakopapadānām ityanenāpyutarapadasya 
eprāk subutpateḥ samāsa ucyate, na pūrvapadasyāpi
niṣkrāntacarmakārādau padakāryasyāsiddhiprasaṅgāt | ata ucchabdasya
pūrvaṃ samāsaḥ, paścāduddhṛtaśabdenābhiśabdasya, tataścābhiśabda eva
pūrvapadaṃ nocchabda iti 
epūrvapadaṃ nocchabda iti pūrvapadasya gateḥ prakṛtisvaro
vidhiyamāno'pūrvapado na syād | ataḥ kakṣāntararptamapi
thāthādisvaraṃ bādhitva'pūrvapadasyāpyanantarasya vākyabhedena
prakṛtibhāvo yathā syādityevamarthamanantaragrahaṇam| tadāha --
anantare punariṣyata iti | 
e yadyevam, kārakabūrve'tiprasaṅgaḥ, dūrādāgato prāpto
devadatenetyatrāpyāgataśabdena stokāntikadūrārthakṛcchrāṇi ktena
iti samāse kṛte tasyāmavasthāyāṃ thāthādisvara iṣyate, tamapi
bādhitvā'pūrvapadasyāpyuda eva svaraḥ prāpneti naiṣa doṣaḥ
thāthādisūtre gatigrahaṇaṃ nivatiṣyate tataḥ kim prakṛtamityādau
kṛtsvarasyaiva prāptatvātasyaiva gatisvarāpavādaḥ,na tu thāthādisvarasya
prasaṅgaḥ, tatra sa eva bhaviṣyati| abhyuddhṛtamityādau tu yatra
kakṣāntare'pi kṛtspara eva prāptastatrāpi sa eva bhaviṣyatīti
tataścāpūrvapadārthamanantaraghaṇamapi na kartavyaṃ bhavati| katham
uddhṛtaśabde gatisvare pravṛte paścādabhiśabdasya samāse kṛte
gatirgatau iti iti nighāte codātasvaritādhikārād gatirityasya
pūrvapadaprakṛtibhāvasyāpravṛtatau samāsasvarāpavādaḥ kṛtsvaro
bhavan kṛdgrahaṇaparibhāśyoddhṛtaśabdasya kṛdantatvātatsvara
ucchabdodātatvameva bhaviṣyati| yadi thāthādiśūtreṇa gatigrahaṇaṃ
nivartiṣyate 
eprabheda ityatra kṛtsvareṇa ghaño ñitvāddhātorudātatvaṃ
syād,antodātatvaṃ ceṣyate| evaṃ tarhyanuvartate gatigrahaṇam,ktena
tu na sambaddhyate,tatkathaṃ thāthādisūtrāt ktagrahaṇamapanīya
pṛthakkartavyam tatra ca gatigrahaṇaṃ nivartiṣyate | 
e evamapi viśuṣka ityādau yatra kartari ktāntamutarapadam
śuṣkadhṛṣṭau ityākārakapūrvasya tvityādi| 
ekārakapūrvasya tu sati śiṣṭatvāta thāthādisvara eva bhavati
dūradāgata iti| dinā cādyaudātam tatra kṛtsvare
satyutarapadamādyaudātaṃ syādantodātaṃ ceṣyate|ataḥ kṛdgrahaṇenāpi
gatigrahaṇamavaśyaṃ sambandhanīyam,tataśca
pūrvoktadoṣaprasaṅgaḥ,tatrāha-kārakapūrvasya tviti|
ayamabhiprāyaḥ-anantaraśabdo'yamananantaramapekṣya pravartate,tatra ca
anantaro gatiḥ ityukte ananantaro'pi gatireva pratīyate
sannidhānāt| tataścāpūrvapadārthamapyanntaragrahaṇaṃ gatidvayasamavadhāna
evānantarasya prakṛtisvaratvaṃ prāpayatīti dūrādāgata ityādau na
doṣa iti| 
e atha vā - kārakāddataśrutayorevāśiṣi ityatra kārakāditi
vibhajyate, tatra ca ktaprahaṇamanuvartate, antodātaḥ iti gatiḥ iti ca,
kārakātparaṃ ktāntamutarapadamantodātaṃbhavatītyarthaḥ| tatra dūrād
gata ityādau thāthādisūtreṇai vāntodātatvasya siddhatvād
dūrādāgata ityādau gatiranantaraḥ
ityanantaragrahaṇenaivāpūrvapadārthena prāptāsya gatisvarasyāpavādaḥ
kārakādityayaṃ yogo jñāyate| yadyevam, anantaragrahaṇaṃ na
kartavyam,katham asatyanantaragrahaṇe dūrādāgataḥ,ābhyuddhṛta
taitvādau sarvatra dvitīye samāse kṛte satiśiṣṭasthāthādisvara eva
prāptaḥ, tataśca kārakādityayaṃ yogo niyamārtho bhavati| tatra ca
gatigrahaṇamanuvartayitavyam, tataścātrāyamarthaḥ - kārakādeva paraṃ
sagatikaṃ ktāntabhutarapadamantodātamiti| tataścābhyuddhṛta ityādau
niyamena thāthādikhare vyāvartite 
ekṛtsvaro bhavan kṛṭgrahaṇaparibhāṣayoddhṛtādeḥ
kṛdantatvātasyaiva yaḥ svara ādyaudātatvaṃ sa eva bhaviṣyati| nanu ca
viparīto'pi niyamaḥ sambhāvyeta - kārakātparaṃ
sagatikameveti,tataśca pūrvahṇaśuṣka ityatra thāthādisvare kṛtsvareṇa
śuṣkadhṛṣṭau ityādyaudātatvaṃ śrūyeta naiṣa
doṣaḥ,ācāyepravṛttirjñāpayati - na viparīto niyama iti, yadayam
dataśrutayorevāśiṣi ityāha| na hi viparīte niyame
kārakātparayordatakṣutayoranyasya vā
ktāntasyotarapadasyāntodātatvaṃ prasaktam| ato
nārtho'pūrvapadārthanānantaragrahaṇena | evaṃ tarhi
vyavahitanivṛtyathemevānantaragrahaṇam, nanu coktam-paratvād
gatirgatau iti nidhte kṛte udātasvaritādhikārādeva
prakṛtibhāvasyāprasaṅgaḥ iti yatra tarhi gatirgatau iti nighāto
nāsti tatra prasaṅgaḥ| kva cāsau nāsti 
epādādau| vakṣyati hi ā pādaparisamāpterapādādāvityadhikāraḥ
iti, tathā ca caupapretakuśitāścetadhvamiti pādādāvupaśabdaṃ
gatiparamapi udātamadhīyate,tathābhyuddhṛtamiti yadābhiśabdaḥ
pādādau vartate tadā nighātābhāvādanena vyavahitasyāpi gateḥ
prakṛtibhāvaḥ syāt naitadasti yāvatā pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣayā
hṛtaśabdaḥ ktāntaḥ,noddhṛtaśabdaḥ| evaṃ tarhyetad
jñāpayati-kṛdgrahaṇe gatikārakapūrvasyāpi grahaṇaṃ bhavatīti| 
e nanu kṛdgrahaṇe gatipūrvasya grahaṇ jñāpitam,kārakapūrvasya tu
katham ucyate pūrvacāryaistāvadeṣā paribhāṣā
vyutpāditā,ihāpyanantaragrahaṇenaikadeśadvāreṇa kṛtsna eva
paribhāṣārtho jñāpyate| yadita kṛdgrahaṇe gatikārakapūrvasyāpi
grahaṇaṃ bhavati, kathaṃ samuddhṛta iti pratyudāharaṇam, yāvatā
uddhṛtaśabdaḥ ktāntaḥ, tasya cānantara eva sam ityata āha -
anantaragrahaṇāsāmarthyāditi | iha
vyavahitanivṛttiphalenānantaragrahaṇena paribhāṣāyā
jñāpanādantatraitatphalalābha iti bhāvaḥ | 
e prakṛtaḥ kaṭamiti | ādikarmaṇi ktaḥ kartari ca iti kartari pratyayaḥ|| 
etādau ca niti kṛtyatau || 6 - 2 - 50 || 
e prajalpāka iti| jalapabhikṣa iti ṣākan| iha gateḥ svaro
vidhīyate,kriyāyoge ca gatisaṃjñā, dhātuśca kriyāvācī, dhātośca
dvaye pratyayāḥ - kṛtastiṅśca, tatra tiṅnte
pūrvapadasyāsambhavātkṛdantādeva bhaviṣyati, nārthaḥ kṛdgrahaṇena
idaṃ tarhi prayojanam -yathā tādigrahaṇaṃ kṛdviśeṣaṇaṃ vijñāyate
takārādau niti kṛtīti anyathā nitītyanena pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣayā
tadantasyopasthānātasyaivotarapadasya takārāditvaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ syāt|
tataścehaiva syāt - prataritā, prataritamiti iha na syāt -
prakartum| naitadasti prayojanam ,kriyamāṇe'pi kṛdgrahaṇe
aniṣṭṃa śakyaṃ vijñātumtakārādāvutarapade niti kṛtīti,
akriyamāṇe'pi ceṣṭam nidyastakārādistadantautarapadeti tataśca yathā
utaśca pratyayāt ityatrāsaṃyogapūrvagrahaṇenokāro viśeṣyate na
pratyayaḥ, tathehāpi nita eva viśeṣaṇaṃ tādigrahaṇaṃ bhaviṣyatīti atrāha
kṛdgrahaṇāmupadeśe tādyarthamiti| ayamabhiprāyaḥ - kṛdgrahaṇena
kṛtsaṃjñāpravṛttikāle yastādistatreti | kimevaṃ sati siddhaṃ bhavati
tatrāha -ihāpīti | asati kṛdgrahaṇe, tādigrahaṇena
svarapravṛttisamaye yastādistatreti vijñāyeta, tataśca pralapitetyādau
iḍāgame kṛte na syāt sampratyatāditvāt , kṛdgrahaṇātu bhavati 
e ādigrahaṇaṃ tu śakyamakartum ,yasminvidhistadādāvalgrahaṇe|| tavai
cāntaśca yugapat|| anta udāto bhavatīti| kathaṃ
pūnarantareṇodātagrahaṇamudāto bhavatītyayamartho labhyate evaṃ
manyate prakṛtyeti vartate, tatraivamabhisambandhaḥ
kriyate-tavaipratyayāntasya yaḥ svaraḥ prakṛtyārśyaḥ prāptaḥ so'ntasya
bhavatīti, sa codāta evati| yugapaditi paryāyanivṛtyartham|| 
eanigānto'ñcatau vapratyaye|| 6 - 2 - 52 || 
e vapratyaya iti| vakāraḥ pratyayo yasya sa tathoktaḥ| prāṅiti| ṛtvik
ityādinā kvin| sa ca vakāramātra eva kakārādīnāma nubandhatvāt|
ugidacām iti num halḍa|ladisaṃyogāntalopau| kvinpratyayasya
kuḥ iti kutvam - cakārasya ṅkāra| parāṅiti| pāraśabda ādyaudātaḥ,
tenātra svarito vā'nudāte'padādau ityeṣa vidhirna bhavati|
pratyaṅiti| nanu cātrāntaraṅgatvādyaṇādeśe
kṛte,anigantatvātprakṛtibhāvena bhavitavyam, anigantaḥ ityasya tu
pratīca ityādiravakāśaḥ tatra acaḥ ityakāralopādyaṇādeśābhāvaḥ| na ca
yaṇādeśasya sthānivadbhāvo'sti apūrvavidhitvāt, pūrvapadasya
prakṛtisvaravidhānāt yatarhi nyadhīcetyadheḥ prakṛtibhāvaṃ śāsti, 
etajjñāpayati-yaṇviṣaya'yaṃ svaro na bhavatīti| yadi
syād,adhyaṅtyitrāpya'nenaiva siddhaṃ syāt| naitadasti jñāpakam,adhīca
ityādau yatra yaṇ nāsti tadarthametatsyāt yatarhi neḥ prakṛtisvaraṃ
śasti,niśabdasyaikāctvād,nīca ityādāvutarasya prakṛtisvarasya ca
viśeṣo nāsti| etadaṣi na jñāpakam, vacanasāmarthyādakṛta
evāntaraṅge yaṇādeśe niśabdasya svarārthemetatsyāt,yaṇāadeśe
kṛte svarabhājo'bhāvāt pratyaṅadiṣu tu yaṇādeśa
evāntaraṅgatvātprāpnoti,tasmādyaṇviṣaye pratipedho vaktavyaḥ na
vaktavyaḥ sthānivadbhāvātsiddham| nanu coktam pūrvapadasya
prakṛtisvaro na yaṇaḥ pūrvasya iti naitadasti uktametat
pūrvapadaśabdaḥ pūrvapadasyoda udāte svarite vā vartate iti| 
e coriti| cau iti yatpūrvapadantodātatvaṃ vidhī|yat taccuśabdena
lakṣyate| coḥ-cusvarādityarthaḥ| eṣa svaro bhavatīti |
vipratiṣedheneti bhāvaḥ| cusvarasyāvakāśaḥ dadhīcaḥ dadhīcāta,yatra
gatirnāsti anigantasvarasyāvakāśaḥ -parāṅ, parāñcau,parāñcaḥ,
pāraca ityādāvubhayaprasaṅge paratvādinigantasvara eva bhavati| nāyaṃ
yukto vipratatiṣedhaḥ, cusvaraḥsatiśiṣṭaḥ katham cau ityucyate,
yatrāsyaitadrūpam, bhasaṃjñāvanimite pratyaye,allope ca kṛte
sambhavati evaṃ tarhi nāyaṃ vipratiṣedha upanyastaḥ kiṃ tarhi iṣṭireṣā
coranigantoñcatāvapratyaya ityeṣa svara iṣyate iti|| 
enayadhī ca|| 6 - 2 - 53 || 
e adhīca iti| atrāpi kṛtsvarādayameva iṣyata iti darśayati|| 
eīṣadanyatarasyām || 6 - 2 - 54 || 
eīṣadbheda ityādau tu kṛtsvaṃra eva bhavatīti | paratvāt | apara
tāaha - īṣadakṛtā taiti pratipadektasya samāsya 
egrahaṇādupadasamāsasyāpravṛttiriti || 
ehiraṇyaparimāṇaṃ ghane || 6 - 2 - 55 || 
e hiraṇyaparimāṇavācīti | paramāṇaviśiṣṭahiraṇyavācītyarthaḥ | tatra
suvarṇaśabdaḥ parimāṇe, upapadādau tatparicchinne hiraṇya ca vartate,
yathā - praśthādiśabdo dārvādinirmite parimāṇe tatparimite ca
vrīhyādau vartate | pañcakṛṣṇalako māṣaste suvarṇastu ṣoḍaśa palaṃ
suvarṇāśtvāraḥ , dvayoḥ suvarṇayoḥ samāhāro dvisuvarṇaṃ
pātrādi | dvisurṇaparimāṇamiti | atra suvarṇaśabda upale vartate |
kāñcanadhanamiti | parimāṇagrahaṇamakṛtvā hiraṇyamityucyamāne ihāpi
syāt, kāñcanaśabdasya hiraṇyavācitvāt | parimāṇavācī tveṣa na
bhavati || 
ekatarakatamī karmadhāraye || 6 - 2 - 57 || 
e iha tvityādi | katarakatamau jātiparipraśne iti pratipadasamāsaḥ
tasyeha grahaṇam, sa karmadhāraya eva | tasmānneḍāryaṃ
karmadhārayagrahaṇamiti bhāvaḥ | 
erājā ca || 6 - 2 - 59 || 
e rājāvrāhmaṇa iti | rājaśabdo brāhmaṇe tāddhūrmyādūrtata iti
sāmānādhikaraṇyātkarmadhārayaḥ, rājaśabdaḥ kaninpratyayāntatvādadyaudātaḥ
| 
e pṛthagyogakaraṇamutarārthamiti | utaro vidhī rājaśabdasyaiva yathā
syāt, āryaśabdasya ma bhūt | yathāsaṅkhyābhāvo'pi
pṛthagyogakaraṇasya prayojanam, tatu noktamityetāvat || 
e ṣaṣṭhī pratyenasi || 6 - 2 - 60 || 
e rājñaḥ pratyenā iti | ṣaṣṭha|la ākośe ityuluk || 
e kte nityārthe || 6 - 2 - 61 || 
enityaśabda ābhīkṣṇye kauṭasthye ca vartate , iha tvābhīkṣṇye| kṛta
etat kta ityucyate, ktaśca ityucyate, ktaśca dhātorvidhīyate, dhātuśca
kriyāvacanaḥ, kriyāyāḥ kṣaṇikatvātkauṭasthyaṃ nopapadyate,
tasmādābhīkṣṇya nityaśabdaḥ | dvatīyāsamāso'yamiti | dvitīya
punaratyantasaṃyoge atha vā - karṇaṇi, kālabhāvādhvagatavyāḥ karmasaṃjñā
hyakarmaṇām iti tatatam iti bhāve kta ityādi | yadā tu karmaṇi ktaḥ
tadā gatiranantaraḥ iti pūrvapadaprakṛtisvareṇādyaudāto bhavati |
samāsasvarasya dvītiyāpurvapadaprakṛtisvaro bādhakaḥ, tasya
thāthādisvaraḥ, tasyāpavādaḥ || 
egrāmaḥ śilpini || 6 - 2 - 62 || grama iti svarupagrahaṇam || 
erājā ca praśaṃsāyām || 6 - 2 - 63 || 
e ṣaṣṭhīsamāse ceti | praśaṃsetyanuṣaṅgaḥ | rājayogyatayā tasyeti
| sa hi karmaṇi pravīṇatvādrājānaṃ prati yogyo bhavati | rājārha iti
cokte praśaṃsā gamyate || 
eādirudātaḥ || 6 - 2 - 64 || 
e pūrapadagamityasyehārthātṣaṣṭha|la vipariṇāmaḥ | sarvatra vātra prakaraṇe
pūrvapadaviṣaye ṣaṣṭha|lrthe prathamā || 
esaptamīhāriṇī gharmye'haraṇe || 6 sa- 2 - 64 || 
e hārītyāvaśyake ṇiniḥ | gharmye ityarthagrahaṇam |
haraṇapratiṣedhātastāhacaryāddhārītyarthaghaṇam | ācāraniyatamiti |
ācāreṇa niyanamācāraniyatam, ācāravaśādavaśyakartavyamityarthaḥ |
kathaṃ punastāddharmyam tatrāha - gharmo hyanuvṛta ācāra iti | janapade
grāme caraṇe kuru vā'nuvṛtaḥ paramparāyāta ityarthaḥ | tasmādanapetaṃ
dharmyam, dharmapathyartha ityādinā yat | tena vā prāpyamiti |
nauvayodharma ityādinā yat | yājñikāśvādau ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ | 
e cidityādinā śāṇāderdeayasyācāraniyatatāṃ darśayati |
yājñikādīnāmaśvādīti | dātavyamityanupaṅgaḥ | 
e kvacidayamācārā vyapasthita iti ca | varddhitako nāma - mūle
sthūlo'gre sūkṣma odanapiṇḍaḥ, sa karmakarāya dīyate, anyathā karma na
kuryāditi, na tvayaṃ dharmaḥ | bījāvābaḥ - vījaniṣekaḥ, garbhādhānam
| vāḍavaharaṇamiti | kvacidayamācāro vyavasthitaḥ - vāḍavāya
bīcaniṣekādutarakālaṃ śarīrapuṣṭa|lrthaṃ yogyamaśnādi dātvyamiti
| haraṇaśabdaḥ karmasādhanaḥ | atrāsminsvare nivṛte kṛtsvare prāpte
ano bhāvakarmavacanaḥ ityutarapadāntodātatvaṃ bhavati | nanu ca
paratvādevāyaṃ svaro bhavatiṣyati, tatkiṃ haraṇapratiṣedhena tatrāha -
paro'pītyādi | atra pūrvapadānāṃ svaro nā''khyātaḥ aprayojanatvāt
|| 
e yukte ca || 6 - 2 - 66 || 
e vallavādayaḥ śabdā gavādīnāṃ pālakavacanāḥ | mathaṇiṃ dadātīti
maṇindaḥ pṛṣodarādiḥ | gāḥ sañcaṣṭe, sami khyaḥ iti kaḥ gausaṃkhyaḥ,
upapadasamāsaḥ | nanvatra paratvātthāthādisvaraḥ prāpnoti, asya tu
gauballavādiravakāśaḥ satyam, pūrvavipratiṣedhāstvatra paṭhitavyaḥ,
citsvarāddhārisvaraḥ - pitṛgavaḥ, mātṛgāvaḥ, kṛtsvarāñca
vāḍavahāryam | yuktasvaraśca kṛtsvarādityeva, kṛto yaḥ
svarasthāthādisṛtreṇa tasmādyauktasvaro bhavati
pūrvavipratiṣedhenetyarthaḥ | yuktaḥ samāhi iti | yuja samādhau
ityaseyaitadrūpamityarthaḥ || 
e vibhāṣā'dhyakṣe || 6 - 2 - 67 || 
e adhyakṣaśabdo'pi samāse yuktavācyeveti sūtre pūrveṇa nitye prāpte
vikalpaḥ || 
e pāpaṃ ca śilpini || 6 - 2 - 67 || 
e pāpamiti svarupagrahaṇam, śilpinīti cārthagrahaṇam vyākhyānāt ||

egotrāntevāsimāṇavabrāhmaṇeṣu kṣepe || 6 - 2 - 69 || 
e gotrāntevāsinorarthagrahaṇam, itarayoḥ svarupagarahṇam|
apatyādhakārādanyatra līkikaṃ gotramityanena laukikamapatyamātraṃ
gotraṃ gṛhyate | jaṅghādānagahaṃ dadānīti | jaṅghādānaṃ
karavāṇītyarthaḥ , odanapākaṃ pacatītivat | atra śādvādā
vātsyānābhava pādaprakṣālanaṃ kriyate, tatrāvātsyaḥ sanvātsyo'haṇiti
brūtaṃ, tallābhāya 
ejaṅghāvātsya iti kṣipyate | vatsaśbado sauśrutaḥ |
bhāryāpradhānatayeti | śākapārthivāditvādutarapadalopī samāsa kaiti
darśayati | vaśābrāhmakṛteya iti vaśā - vandhyā bhāryā, sauśru
tavatsamāsaḥ | dakṣeṇa proktaṃ dākṣam, tadadhīte dākṣaḥ, dākṣeśchāttro
vā dākṣaḥ | cāraśabdo naḍādiḥ, cārāyaṇena proktamadhīte tasya vā
śiṣyaścārāyaṇīyaḥ | evaṃ pāṇinīyaḥ | kumāryādilābhakāmā iti |
tatprokte granthe śradvāyāmasatyāmapi ye kumāryādilābhakāmāstatra
pravartante ta evaṃ kṣipyante | pūrvavatsamāsaḥ |
māṇavabrāhmaṇayorapatyavācitvena prasiddhyabhāvātpṛthaggrahaṇam |
apara ākaha - tasyedam ityaṇantayorgrahaṇ, nipātanāñca māṇave
ṇatvamiti | 
e bhayabrāhmaṇa iti | yo brāhmaṇa eva san rājadaṇḍādibhayena brāhmaṇācāraṃ
karoti, na śraddhayā, sa evaṃ 
ekṣipyate | kartṛkaraṇe kṛtā bahulam kaiti bahulavacanādakṛtāpi
samāsaḥ | dāsīśrotriyo dāsībrāhmaṇavat || 
e aṅgāni maireye || 6 - 2 - 70 || 
eaṅgam - ārambhakam, bahuvacanaṃ svarupavidhinirāsārthaṃm |
surāvyatiriktaṃ madyam - daireyam | tadaṅgavācinīti | daireyaśabda
iti prakṛtam, kaiha tu tacchabdena tadarthaḥ parāmṛśyate | pauṣpāsava
iti | āsavaḥ - madyaviśeṣaḥ, yat pauṣpaiṇa madhunā dravyāntareṇa
cārabhyate tasya pauṣpamaṅgaṃ bhavati | puṣpāsava kaiti tu yuktaḥ
pāṭhaḥ || 
e bhaktākhyāstadartheṣu || 6 - 2 - 71 || 
ebahuvacananirdeśādeva svarupavidhinirāse siddhe ākhyāgrahaṇaṃ
bhaktaviśeṣavācināṃ bhakṣādīnāṃ garhaṇārtham anyathā
paryāyāṇāmannādīnāmeva grahaṇaṃ syāt | bhikṣākaṃṇdayaḥ
ṣaṣṭhīsamāsāḥ yeṣāṃ prakṛtivikārabhāve caturthīsamāsa iti pakṣaḥ |
anyeṣāṃ caturthīsamāsāḥ || 
egoviḍālasihasaindhaveṣūpamāne || 6 - 2 - 72 || 
e gauviḍālasihasaindhaveṣūpamāne || upamānaśabdasya saha gavādibhiḥ
pratyekaṃ sambandhādekavacanam | upamānārtho'pīti | yo
yatrodāharaṇe upamānārthaḥ samābhavati sa tatra yojayitavyaḥ |
yathāprasiddhaṃ ceti | yasyodāharaṇasya ca yathā loke prasiddhiḥ sa tathā
yojayitavyaḥ | tatra diṅmātraṃ darśayati - gavākṛtyetyādi |
ākṛtiḥ - saṃsthānam , saṃniveśitam - vyavasthāpitam |
evamanyatrāpi yatkiñcit sādṛśyaṃ yojaniyam || 
e ake jīvikārthe || 6 - 2 - 73 || 
e jīvikāvājinīti | pravṛttinimitakathanametat,
jīvikārupapravṛttinimita ityarthaḥ | paryavasānabhūmistu tadhvān,
tadāha - dantalekhanādibhiryaṣāmiti | ramaṇīyakateti | atrāpi nityaṃ
krīḍājīvikayoḥ iti samāsaḥ, krīḍāyāmeva hi tṛjantaṃ sambhavati, na
punarjīvikāyāmiti tatrārthaḥ || 
e prācāṃ krīḍāyām || 6 - 2 - 74 || 
e prācāṃ krīḍāyāmiti śrutayorevānvayasambhavānmatenetyadhyāhāro
na yukta iti camatvā''ha - prāgdeśvatināṃ yā 
ekrīḍeti || 
e aṇi niyukte || 6 - 2 - 75 || 
eniyukta iti yujiryoge ityasyaitadrūpamityāha - niyuktī'dhikṛta iti
| sa ca kasmiścatkartavye tatparo na bhavatīti | kāryāntare'pi
niyogasambhāvāt || 
e śilpini cākṛñaḥ || 6 - 2 - 66 || 
e yukte ca ityeva siddhe kṛñaḥ pratiṣedhārtha vacanatam | tantuvāya iti
hvāvāmaśca ityaṇ, ato yuk | ayaskāra iti ataḥ kṛkagama ityādinā
visarjanīyasya satvam || 
e gautantiyavaṃ pāle || 6 - 2 - 78 ||tanu vistāre , ktic, tantiḥ -
vatsānāṃ bandhanarajjuḥ || 
e upamānaṃ śabdārthaprakṛtāveva || 6 - 2 - 80 || 
e uṣṭrakrośītyādau kartaryupamāne iti ṇiniḥ |
upamānagarhaṇamityādi | anyathā yogāvibhāgena
niyamāśrayaṇasāmarthyādviśiṣṭaviṣayo niyama ityetāvad gamyata, na
tviṣṭo viṣayavibhāga iti bhāvaḥ | 
e śabdārthaprakṛtāviti kimiti | sūtrārambhaḥ kimartha ityarthaḥ |
vṛkavañcīti | kṛtsavara eva bhavati | prakṛtirevetyādi | asati
prakṛtigarahṇe śabdārthātparo yo ṇinistadanta utarapade iti
vijñāyet, tataśca yatrāpi dhātūpasargasamudāyāt śabdārthātparo
ṇiniḥ, tatrāpi syāt kṛdugrahaṇe gatikārakapūrvasyāpi
grahaṇāṇṇinyantamevotarapadamiti kṛtvā | prakṛtigrahaṇe tu na bhavati
| 
e yo'tra dhāturnāsau śabdārthaḥ, yaśca śabdārtho dhātūpasargasamudāyo
na tato ṇinirvihita iti, siddhe
vidhirārabhyamāṇontarethaṇāpyevakāraṃ niyamāya bhavati, nārtha
evakāreṇa tatrāha - evakārakaraṇamityādi | asati hi tasminviparīto
niyamaḥ syāt - śabdārthaprakṛtau yadi bhavati upamāna eveti | evaṃ ca
prakṛtirniyamyeta, nopamānam | tasmādupamānāvadhāraṇārthamevakāraḥ
kriyate | kima punaḥ kāraṇamupamānāvadhāraṇamāśrīyate ata āha -
śabdārthaprakṛtāviti | tuśabdo hetau, upamānaniyame hi
śabdārthaprakṛteraniyatatvātatrāpyaviśeṣeṇa sarvasyādyaudātatvaṃ 
elabhyate, nānyathā | kiñca - prikṛtyavadhāraṇe'syāniyatatvād
vṛkavañcītyādāvādyaudātatvaprasaṅgaḥ || 
eyuktārohyādayaśca || 6 - 2 - 81 || 
e pūrvotarapadaniyamārthamiti | yatra yuktādīnyeva pūrvapadāni,
kāarohāyādīnyava cotarapadāni -- tatraiva yathā syādityarthaḥ |
āgatamatsyādiṣu ca bahuvrīhiḥ, karmadhārayo vā | 
e ekaśitipāditi | saṃkhyāsupūrvasya iti pādaśabdākārasya lopaḥ,
saṃkhyāsupūrvasya samāsasya yo'nte pādaśabdaratasya lopo bhavatīti
tatrārthaḥ | nanu ceha iṇbhakāpāśalyatimarñcibhyaḥ kan iti kannanta
ekaśabda ādyaudātaḥ, tataśca bahuvrīhau prakṛtya ityeva
siddhamādyaudātatvam tatrāha - ekaḥ śiti pādo'syeti tripadau
bahuvrīhiriti | tataḥ kimityāha - tatreti | yadyautarapade parata
ekaśitiśabdastatpuruṣaḥ, tato|pi kim ityāha - tasyeti | tasya
tatpuruṣasaṃjñakasyaikaśitiśabdasya samāsāntodātatvaṃ prāptam | nanu
samāsasvarāpavādo bahuvrīhisvaḥ tatrāhanimitisvarabalīyastvāditi
| samāsasvarasyeti śeṣaḥ | nimitamutarapadaṃ dvigostripado
bahuvrīhistasya yaḥ svaraḥ , tasmātsamāsasvarasya balīyastvādityarthaḥ |
balīyastvaṃtu satiśiṣṭatvāt | satiśiṣṭatvaṃ tu bahuvrīhau sati
paścātatpuruṣe kṛte prāpnotīti | 
e evamapītyādi | spaṣṭārtham | nimitisvara balīyastvasyāpītyādi |
tathā ca samarthasūtre vārtikam - ekaśitipātsvaravacanaṃ tu jñāpakaṃ
nimitisvarabalīyastvasya iti |
ubhayamantareṇāpyanupapadyamānamekaśitipādgrahaṇamubhayamapi
kajñāpayati || 
edīrghakāśatuṣabhrāṣṭravaṭṃa je || 6 - 2 - 82 || 
e kuṭīja iti | saptamyāṃ janerḍaḥ || 
eantyātpūrvaṃ bahvacaḥ || 6 - 2 - 83 || 
e āmalakīja iti | dīrghānte'pi bahvaci paratvādayameva svaro bhavati
|| 
egrame'nivasantaḥ || 6 - 2 - 84 || 
e nipūrvādvaserauṇādiko'dhikaraṇe jhac , nivasagtyasminniti
nivasantaḥ | devagrāma iti | prācīnaparikṣiptadeśe'yaṃ grāmaśabdaḥ |
yadyevam, nivasantavācī bhavati tatrāha - devasvāmika kaiti |
tataścāyaṃ na devāpekṣayā grāmo nivasanta iti bhāvaḥ | dākṣyādayo
nivasanti yasminnityādi | anye nivasantu, tatra mā vā yasan, te
tāvadavātsurityetāvatā tepāmiti vyapadiśyata ityarthaḥ || 
eghoṣādiṣu ca || 6 - 2 - 85 || 
e 
e yānyatreti | ghoṣakuṭādīni | apare punariti | theṣāṃ
ghoṣakuṭādiṣvapi śabdeṣu tāvadbhavati, na nivāsanāmadheyeṣu || 
echāttryādayaḥ śālāyām || 6 - 2 - 86 || 
e yadā śālānta thaityādi | vibhāṣā senāsurā ityādinā śālāntasya
tatpuruṣasya vibhāṣā napuṃsakatvamuktam | tatrāsyāvakāśo yo
napuṃsakaliṅgo na bhavati - chātriśālā, gośaritiḥ tatpuruṣe
śālāyām ityasyāvakāśo yaśchāttryādipūrvapado na bhavati -
vārāhmaṇaśālam, kṣatriyaśālamiti, yaśchāttryādipūrvapado
napuṃsakaliṅgaśca, tatraikadeśabikṛtasyānanyatvādayamapi prāpnoti,
tatpuruṣe śālāyām ityayaṃ ca tatra pūrvavipratiṣedhādayameva bhavati
|| 
e prasthe'vṛddhamakarkyādīnamā || 6 - 2 - 87 || 
e mālīdīnāṃ ca iti vacanādavṛddhamiti padacchedaḥ |
karkyādipratiṣedhastu nāmadheyārthaḥ syāt - vua nāmadheyasya
vṛddhasaṃjñā vaktavyā iti || 
earme cāvarṇaṃ dvayctryac || 6 - 2 - 90 || 
e vṛhadarmamiti | svaravidhau vyañjanamavidyamānavat ityetadatra
nāśrīyate anityatvāt | nahārmamiti | ātve kṛte'varṇāntatvādasti
prāptiḥ | navāmamiti | navaśabdaḥ pratyagravacano'kārāntaḥ || 
e na bhūtādhikasañjīvamadrāśmakajjalam ||la 6 - 2 - 91 || 
e madrāśmagrahaṇaṃ saṅghātavigṛhītārthamiti | madraśabdasya kevalasya
madrāśmaśabdasya ca saṅghātasya pratiṣedhārthamityarthaḥ | 
e madrāśmārmamiti | ano'śmāyaḥ sarasāṃ jātisaṃjñayoḥ iti
samāsānte satyavarṇānmetadbhavati, tadevam - madrārmam,
madrāśmārmamiti deva evodāharaṇe | prāyeṇa tu aśmārmamiti

maherinaṇ, bahulavacanāt śakerapi bhavati - śākinam,
śakādibhyo'ṭac, śakaṭam, tadvahatīti śakaṭādaṇ - śākaṭam | drāk
kṣarati drākṣā, pṛṣodarādiḥ | tusa śabde tato bahulavacanāt ktaḥ
upadhādīrghatvaṃ ca | kuaṃ dunoti, kutsitaṃ vā dunotīti kkip,
asmādeva nipātanātugabhāvaḥ, pūrvapadasya ca mum kunduaṃ mimīte
kundumaḥ | daleḥ kapan, dalapaḥ | camerasac camasaḥ tato
jātilakṣaṇo ṅīṣ - camasī | kanī dīptikāntigatiṣu - asmāt
pacādyac, asmādeva nipātanād dvarvacanam - cakkanaḥ | ckana ityanye
paṭhanti, tatrāpi nipātanādeva rupasiddhiḥ | colasyāpatyam dvyacaḥ
ityaṇ - caulaḥ | ete cūrṇādayaḥ | 
epūrvācāryopacāreṇeti | upacāraḥ prayogaḥ || 
ekuṇḍaṃ vanam || 6 - 2 - 136 || 
e kuṇḍaśabdadī'tretyādi | janaviśeṣābhidhāyī kuṇḍaśabdastasya
nāntareṇa sāddaśyam, tato'nyatra vane vṛttiḥ sambhavatīti bhāvaḥ |
anye tu vane'pi mukhya eva kuṇḍaśabda ityāhuḥ | tatra vanaśabdena
viśeṣaṇena bhājana viśeṣavājī nivartyate, samudāyavācī cātra
vanaśabdaḥ, na tūdakavācī, āha hi - kuṇḍādyaudātatve
tatsamudāyagrahaṇamiti, tacchabdena pūrvadārthaḥ parāmṛśyate | upara
āha - vanasamudāye iti vaktavyam, na tu vane iti 
e, tena śaravaṇasamudāyaḥ śarakuṇḍaśabdenocyata iti || 
eprakṛtyā bhagālam || 6 - 2 - 137 || 
ebhagālamityarthagraṇamityāha - bhagālavācīti | atra ca vyākhyānameva
śaraṇam | bhagālādayaco dadhyodātā iti | laghāvante dvayośca
bahvaṣo guruḥ iti vacanāt || 
eśitenityābahvajbabahuvrīhāvabhasat || 6 - 2 - 138 || 
e aṃsauṣṭhaśabdāvityādi | am roge, ameḥ san , asaḥ, uṣa dāheḥ
uṣikuṣigātibhyasthan, oṣṭhaḥ | darśanīyaśabdo'nīyar - pratyayānto
madhyodātaḥ | śitiśabdaḥ varṇānāṃ taṇatinitāntānām ityādyaudātaḥ
|| 
egatikārakopapadāt kṛt || 6 - 2 - 139 || 
e prakāraka ityādau kugatiprādayaḥ iti samāsaḥ | idhmapravraścānādau
karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhayāḥ samāsaḥ, karaṇe lyuṭ, idhmaṃ pravṛścyate yena
so'tra idhmapravaścanaḥ, śadlṛ śātane, ṇic, śaderagatau taḥ |
palaśāni śātyante yena sa daṇḍaḥ parāśaśatanaḥ | śmaśru kalpyate yena
sa kṣurādiḥ śmaśrukalpanaḥ | kṛpū sāmarthye ṇyantaḥ , kevalo vā |
īṣatkara iti | etadupapadagrahaṇasya sākṣādudāharaṇam| sudurostu
gatitvādapi siddham, stamberamādau ca kārakatvāt | uccaiḥ kṛtya
uccaiḥ kāramityādikamapyupadagarahṇasyaivodāharaṇam| 
e devadatasyeti śeṣalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhīti | na karmalakṣaṇā, tathā hi sati
kārakameva devadetaḥ syāt, tṛjakābhyāṃ karteri ca iti
samāsapratiṣedhaprasaṅśca | 
e atha kṛdgrahaṇaṃ kimarthaṃm nirgataḥ kauśāmbyāḥ
niṣkauśāmbirityatra mā bhūt | naitadasti prayojanam, 
eyatkriyāyuktāḥ pāradayastaṃ prati gatyupasargasaṃjñā bhavanti, na ca
kaiśāmbīśabdaṃ prati kriyāyogaḥ, kārakamapi kriyāyā eva sambhavati,
upapadamapi dhātvadhikāre saptamīnirdiṣṭṃa pratyayanimitamuccate
tadevaṃ gatyādibhistribhirapi kriyāvācyutarapadamākṣipyate, dhātuśca
kriyāvācī, dhātośca dvaye pratyayāḥ - kṛtaḥ tiṅśca, tatra tiṅnte
samāsābhāvātkṛdantameva sambhavatīti anuvyacaladityatra tu na
gatitvanibandhanaḥ samāsaḥ kiṃ tarhi subiti yogavibhāganibandhanaḥ
dhātupratyayasamudāyaparigrahārthaṃ tu, anyathā yatkriyāyuktāstaṃ pratīti
vacanāddhātumeva prati gatitvāddhātāvevotarapade svaraḥ syāt -
praṇīḥ, unnīriti iha na syāt - praṇayakaḥ ,unnāyaka iti | 
e etadapi nāsti prayojanam yatkriyāyuktāḥ iti naivaṃ vijñāyate -
yasya kriyā yatkriyā yatkriyāyuktāstaṃ pratīti, evaṃ vijñāyamāne
tvanvayavyatirekābhyāṃ dhātoreva kriyā vācyeti tameva prati
gatyupasargasaṃjñāprasaṅgaḥ, kathaṃ tarhi vijñāyate | yā kriyā yatkriyā
taṃ kriyālakṣaṇamarthaṃ pratigatyupasargasaṃjñe bhavataḥ, kevalāyāśca
kriyāyā vācakamutarapadaṃ nāstīti kriyāviśiṣṭasādhanavācini
praṇīḥ, prakāraka ityādau kriyāyāṃ siddhatābhidhāyini,
prabhavanamityādau ca sarvatra bhaviṣyatīti nārtha etena kṛdgrahaṇena
ata āha - kṛdgrahaṇaṃ vispaṣṭārthamiti | ya evaṃ pratipatumasamarthastaṃ
prati vispaṣṭārthaṃ kriyata ityarthaḥ | 
e yadi tarhi vispaṣṭārthamapi tāvatkṛdgrahaṇaṃ kriyate, āmante tarhi
na prāpnoti - prapacatitarām, prapacatitamāmiti, tataśca samāsasvaraṃ
bādhitvā'vyayasvara eva syāt ityata āha - prapacatitarāmityādi | atra
hi praśabdasya tarabantena samāsaḥ, nāmantena | katham
antaraṅgatvāddhātuḥ pūrvamupasargeṇa yujyate, prapacityasyāmavasthāyāṃ
subabhāvāt samāso na kṛta ityetāvat, tatastiṅ,
tasyāmapyavasthāyāṃ subabhāvaḥ, tatastarap, taddhitāntatvātsup , tena
samāsaḥ, tataścāmpratyayaḥ, tata āmśvaraḥ satiśiṣṭaḥ | kathaṃ
punastaravantena samāsaḥ kathaṃ ca na syāt gatikārakopapadānāṃ
kṛdbhiḥ saha samāsavacanam iti vacanāt nātra kṛdbhareva samāsa
iti niyamyate, ki tarhi yadi gatyādīnāṃ samāso bhavati tenatena
lakṣaṇena, tadā kṛdbhiḥ prak subutpatteriti nanu cevamapi
tarabantena samāso na labhyate, ki kāraṇam asubantatvāt
pratipadikādhikārāddhi tata eva kimetiṅvyayadhāt ityām bhavati, na
subantāt , na ca gatikārakopapadānāmityetadasti, akṛdantatvāt
atrāhuḥ - ghakālataneṣu iti jñāpakātsubantādeva sarve taddhitāḥ,
ṅyāpprātipadikagrahaṇaṃ tu vṛddhādyarthamevādhikriyate,
tataścāmutpataye yaḥ sup tadantena samaasa iti | apara āha -
kugatiprādayaḥ ityatrātiṅiti vakṣyamāṇasya
pratikarṣādutarapadamasubantameva samastayate, tataśca tarabantena
samāso labhyata iti | 
e ityeka iti | asya kṛdgrahaṇaṃ vispaṣṭārtham, na cāmante
doṣaprasaṅga ityevaṃ kecidvyācakṣate | 
e prapacideśyādyarthaṃ tvityādi | tuśabdaḥ pakṣaṃ vyāvartayati |
ādiśabdena prapacatikalpam , prapacatideśīyam,
prapacatirupamityeteṣāṃ grahaṇam| prapacatideśyādāvarthaḥ prayojanaṃ
yasya tatathoktam | etaduktaṃ bhavati - na vispaṣṭārthaṃ kṛdgarahthaṇam,
api tu prapaciti deśyādau yatra satiśiṣṭasvarāntaraṃ nāsti, tatrāyaṃ
svaro mā bhūd, avyayapūrvapadaprakṛtisvara eva yathā syādityevaṃ
saprayojanaṃ dṛśyate iti | idaṃ tu vaktavyam - prapacatitarāmityādau
tarabantena samāse paścādām bhavan pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣayā
pacititaraśabdasyaiva ghāntatvāt tata eva syāt | tatra ko doṣaḥ
sopasargasya saṅghātasyaikapadyābhāvād āmprapacatitarāṃ
devadetetyādau āma ekāntaramāmantritamanantike ityeṣa vidhirna
syāt, śeṣanighātaśca praśabdasya na syāt bhinnapadatvāt | tasmāt
praśabdasyāmantena samāso'ṅgī 
ekartavyaḥ, na tarabantena | tatra samāsatvāt samudāyasya
prātipadikatve vibhaktāvaikapadyaṃ bhavati | svare tu deṣaprasaṅgāt
kṛdgrahaṇamapi tyaktavyamiti bhāṣye sthitam, prapacatideśīyādau kā
gatiriti na vidmaḥ || 
eume vanaspatyādiṣu yugapat || 6 - 2 - 140 || 
e vanaśabdaḥ nabviṣayasvānisantasya ityādyaudātaḥ pāterḍatiḥ patiḥ | 
e tanuśabdo'ntodāta iti | kecitu tasyāpyādyaudātatvamatra
nipātayanti, tathā ca tanūnapāducyate garbha āsuraḥ
ityādyaudātamadhīyate | 
e narā asminnityādi | śaṃseḥ akartari ca kārake saṃjñāyām
ityadhikaraṇe vā ghañ | abanta iti | kṛtyalyuṭo bahulam iti
kartari āñdorap | 
e śunaḥ śepa iti | bahuvrīhiḥ | śunaḥ pucchaśepalāṅgūleṣu
ityenena ṣaṣṭha|la aluk | ubhāvādyaudātāviti | śvanśabdaḥ
prātipadikasvareṇa śepaśabdaḥ svāṅgaśiṭāmadantānām taityanena |
śiṭ iti sarvādīnāṃ saṃjñā, svāṅgavācināṃ śiṭāmadantānāṃ
cāṃdirudāto bhavatītyarthaḥ | śaḍi rujāyām pacādyac śaṇḍaḥ,
prāmāditvādādyaudātaḥ | 
e marcayateḥ imbhīkāpāślyatimarcibhyaḥ kan iti kan, titutra
taityādinā iṭ pratiṣedhaḥ, kutvam - markaśabda tāadyaudātaḥ | 
e tuṣṇābda iti | tṛṣerniṣṭhāyāmasmādeva nipātanādiḍabhāvaḥ ,
niṣṭhā ca dvyajanāt ityādyaudātatvam | 
e labi avasransane pacādyac, asmādeva nipātnāllakārasya bakāraḥ,
biśvāni vayāṃsyasya viśvavayāḥ, mṛḍaḥ anyebhyo'pi dṛśyate iti vic
- mariti | bhujimṛṅbhyāṃ yuktyukau - mṛtyuḥ || 
edevatādvandve ca || 6 - 2 - 141 || 
e udāharaṇeṣu devatādvandve ca iti pūrvapadasyānaṅ | atra traya udātā
iti | trayāṇāṃ papadānāmādayaḥ || 
e notarapade'nudātādāvapṛthivīrudrapūṣamanthiṣu || 6 - 2 - 142 || 
e agniśabdaḥ aṅgernirnalopaśca iti nipratyayāntaḥ |
kṛvāpācimisvadisādhyaśūbhya uṇ , yuk, vāyuḥ | 
e utarapadagrahakaṇamityādi | anyathā'sminprakaraṇe dvandveḥ saptamyā
nirdiṣṭaḥ, notarapadam tatra anudātādau iti saptamyantaṃ dvandvasyaiva
viśeṣaṇaṃ syāt, tataścandrasūryāvityādau pritaṣedhaḥ syacāt |
utarapadagrahaṇe tu sati tasyaiva śrutasya anudātādau tyetidviśeṣaṇaṃ
bhavati | 
e anudātādāvityādi | tānyathā vidhipratiṣedhayoḥ
samānaviṣayatvādvikalpaḥ prasajyeta | pratheḥ ṣivan samprasāraṇaṃ ca |
śukraśabdo'yam ṛjrendrāgra ityādinā nipātito'ntodātaḥ || 
eantaḥ || 6 - 2 - 143 || 
e tatra samāsasyotarapadasveti | kvacit samāsasyānta udāto bhavati,
kvacidutarapadasyetyarthaḥ | viṣayavibhāgamutaratra darśayiṣyati || 
ethāthādhañktājabitrakāṇām || 6 - 2 - 144 || 
e ādyaudātamutarapadaṃ syāditi | yadidaṃ nocyeteti bhāvaḥ |
dūrādāgata taiti | tātra karmaṇi ktaḥ , grāmādirabhigheyaḥ, kṛtā āṅe
gatisamāse gatiranantaraḥ iti prakṛtibhāve cāgata ityādyaudātam,
tena stokāntikadūrārthakṛcchrāṇi ktena iti samāsaḥ pañcamyāḥ
stokādibhyaḥ ityaluk, tatra kārakātparamāgatamityetat
kṛdutarapadaprakṛtisvareṇādyaudtaṃ syāt | viśuṣka iti |
śuṣerakarmakatvāt kartāri ktaḥ, śuṣkadhṛṣṭau ityādyaudātatvam, tato
gatisamāsaḥ | ātapaśuṣka iti | nāyam siddhasuṣka iti saptamīsamāsaḥ,
saptamī siddhaśuṣkapakvabandheṣvakālāt taiti
pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaraprasaṅgāt | tasmāt kartṛkaraṇe kṛtā
bahuram iti samāsaḥ | 
e prakṣayaḥ, prajaya iti | erac | nanu ca
kṛdutarapadaprakṛtisvareṇaivātrāntodātotvaṃ siddham ata āha -
kṣayo nivāsa ityādi | 
e pralavaḥ prasava ityādi | āñdorap | 
e pralavitramiti | artilūdhūsūkhanasahacara itra) | 
e govṛṣa iti | vṛṣu mṛṣu sevane | sustutamiti | suḥ
pūjāyām, atiratikramaṇe ca iti karmapravacanīyasaṃjñā, svatī
pūjāyām iti prādisamāsaḥ || 
esūpamānāt ktaḥ || 6 - 2 - 145 || 
e vṛkāvaluptamityādi | lūñ chedane , cyuṅ pruṅ pluṅ gatau,
narda garda śabde - sarvatra kartṛkarakaṇe kṛtā bahulam iti samāsaḥ |
kavṛkaisarivāluptamityādivigrahaḥ | upamānādapītyādi |
atretiśabdasyānantaraṃ prapta ityasyānuṣaṅgaḥ || 
esaṃjñāyāmanācitādīnām || 6 - 2 - 146 || 
e sambhūtādayaḥ śabdā rāmāyaṇādīnāṃ saṃjñāḥ, rāmāyaṇaśabdo
napuṃsakaliṅgaḥ, prāyeṇa tu puṃlliṅgaḥ paṭha|lte| upahūta iti |
hvaño niṣṭhāyāṃ yajāditvāt sagprasāraṇam| parijagdha iti | ado
jagdhirādeśaḥ | prāptyarthādbhavateriti | curādau ādhṛṣādvā
ityadhikāre bhū prāptavātmanepadī iti paṭha|lte | 
e kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ prayatnena karmaṇi kta taupapādyate ata āha -
gātiranantara ityatra hīti | tadvādhanārthañcedamiti |
prakṛtodāharaṇābhiprayametad , na sūtrābhiprāyam | ghanuṣkhāteti |
nityaṃ samāse'nutarapadasthasya iti ṣatvam | 
e ciñ cayane ṣṭhā gatinivṛtau, ṇyantaḥ kevalaśca, graha upādāne ,
vaca paribhāṣaṇe, pada gatau śilaṣa āliṅgane , ḍudhāñ
dhāraṇapoṣāṇayoḥ - sarvatra karṇami ktaḥ, ete ācitādayaḥ | 
e saṃhitā'gavīti gāṇasūtram, tad vyācaṣṭe - yāda goranyasveti
|| 
epravṛddhādīnāṃ ca || 6 - 2 - 147 || 
e vṛdhu vṛddhau yu miśraṇe ḍudhāñ dhāraṇe ruha bījajanmani śasu
hiṃsāyām | khaṭvāruḍha iti | khaṭvā kṣepe iti samāsaḥ | naitadiha
paṭhitavyamiti ahīne dvitīyā taityatrāvocāma | kavibhiḥ śastaḥ,
tṛtīya karmaṇi taityasyāpavādaḥ | 
e prāyovṛttipradarśanārtha iti | prāyo bāhulyena yā
vṛttiryānādiṣvartheṣu tasyāḥ pradarśanārtha ityarthaḥ | 
e punarutsyūtamiti | sīvyateḥ cchavoḥ śūḍanunāsike iti ūṭha,
panaścanasoścchandasi iti gatisaṃjñāyāṃ samāsaḥ || 
ekārakādataśrutayorevāśiṣi || 6 - 2 - 148 || 
e saṃjñāyāmanācitādīnām iti vahitamanto dātatvamanena
niyamyate, devā enaṃ deyāsuḥ ityevaṃ prārthitairdeavairdato devadataḥ,
āśiṣi liṅloṭau iti vartamāne ktic ktau ca saṃjñāyām iti ktaḥ
, do daddhoḥ | 
e samsūto rāmāyaṇa iti | kārakāt ityunacyamāne
gatikārakopapadāt iti tritayādhikārādyathaiva kārakānniyamo
bhavati, tathā gaterapi syāt | 
e evakārakaraṇaṃ kimiti | siddhe
vidhirārabhyamāṇo'ntareṇāpyevakāraṃ niyamārtho bhaviṣyatīti praśnaḥ
| kārakāvadhāraṇamityādi | asati hyaevakāraṃ viparīto|pi niyamaḥ
syāt - kārakādeva dataśrutayoriti | evaṃ cākārakād
dataśrutayorna syāt, iṣyate, ca , tathā kārakasyāniyatatvād
devapālita ityādāvantodātaprasaṅgaḥ | ataḥ kārakāvadhāraṇaṃ yathā
syāddataśrutāvadhāraṇaṃ mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ karaṇamityarthaḥ | ayamapi
niyama iṣyata iti | etacca tantreṇa sūtradvayoccāraṇādekasūtre'pi
āśiṣyeveti bhinnakamatvādevakārasya labhyate || 
eityambhūtena kṛtamiti ca || 6 - 2 - 149 || 
e saptapralapitamityādi | kathaṃ panaretānyudāharaṇāni, yāvatā
kṛtāmityucyate, na ca pralapitādīni kṛtāni, abhūtaprādurbhāva eva
hi karotirvartate, tataśca suprakṛtaṃ suprabhāṣitaṃ
suprotpāditamityādikamevodāhartavyam ata āha - kṛtamiti
kriyāsāmānye karotirvartata iti | tataśca yathā kriyāvacano dhātuḥ
kriyāyāṃ kriyārthāyām ityādau viśeṣāṇāmapi grahaṇaṃ bhavati,
tadvadatrāpi | abhūtaprādurbhāvaḥ - niṣpādanam || 
eano bhāvakarmavacanaḥ || 6 - 2 - 150 || 
e payaḥ pānādīnāmamupapadasamāsaḥ | rājabhojanādau ṣaṣṭha|la samāsaḥ |

e sarvaṣu pratyudāharaṇeṣvityādi | etena gātikārakopapadāt
ityasyāyamapavāda iti darśayati || 
emanktinvyākhyānaśayanāsanasthāṇnayājakādikrītāḥ ||e 6 - 2 - 151 || 
e rathavartmeti | vṛteradhikaraṇe manin, kartari ṣaṣṭha|la samāsaḥ |
pāṇinikṛtiriti | karmaṇi ktin, pūrvavatsamāsaḥ | vyākhyānaśabdaḥ
karaṇasādhanaḥ, śayanāsanasthānaśabdā adhikaraṇasādhanāḥ| prakṛtiḥ,
prahṛtiriti | tādau ca niti kṛtyatau iti pūrvapadaprakṛtisvara
evātra bhavati || 
esaptamyāḥ puṇyam || 6 - 2 - 152 || 
e uṇādīnāṃ tviti | ataḥ kṛkamikaṃsa ityatra kamigrahaṇainaiva siddhe
kaṃsagrahaṇāduṇādiṣu 
epākṣikavyutpattikāryamiti bhāvaḥ | pūño yat, ṇuk hrasvaśca,
puṇyam | hrasvavidhānādaguṇatvam | yato'nāvaḥ ityādyaudātavam || 
e ūnārthakalahaṃ tṛtīyāyāḥ || 6 - 2 - 153 || 
e udāharaṇeṣu pūrvasadṛśa iti tṛtīyāsamāsaḥ | 
e atra kecidityādi | nanvevamūnaśabdasyāpi svarupagrahaṇaṃ prasajyeta,
tataśca tadarthānāmānyeṣāṃ grahaṇaṃ na syāt ata āha - ūnaśabdenaiva
tviti | arthanirdeśārthatvaṃ tu vyākhyānādavaseyam || 
emiśraṃ cānupasargamasandhau || 6 - 2 - 154 || 
e kathaṃ punarmiśraśabdasya vidhīyamānaḥ sammiśraśabdasya prāpvoti, kathaṃ
vā miśraśabdena samāna ucyamānaḥ sopasargeṇa labhyate ata āha -
ihetyādi | 
e pratyudāharaṇe sandhiṃ darśayati - bāhmakaṇairiti | etadeva spaṣyayati
- ekārthyamāpaca iti | 
e kathaṃ punaḥ sandhiśabdasyāyamarthaḥ ityāha - sandhiriti | paṇabandhaḥ -
paribhāṣaṇam - yadi me bhavāneṣaṃ kuryādahamapi te idaṃ
kariṣyāmītyevaṃrupaḥ | 
e kecitpunariti | gṛhyamāṇo viśeṣo vyāvṛttirthasyāṃ pratyāsato
sā tathoktā | tataḥ kim ityāha - tatreti | yadyapi rājño'pi
brāhmaṇaissaha pratyāsatirasti, tathāpi satyāmapi tasyāṃ
parasparamūrtivibhāgasvarupabhedo gṛhyata iti
pratyudāharaṇopapatirityarthaḥ | 
e udāharaṇeṣu naivamityāha - udāharaṇeṣviti || 
enaño guṇapratiṣedhe sampādyarhahitālamarthāstaddhitāḥ || 6 - 2 - 155 || 
e sampādi - śobhanam | kārṇaveṣṭakikamiti | sampādini iti
prāgvateṣṭhay | chèadika iti | chèadādibhyo nityam iti
ārhādagopuccha ityādinā ṭhak | vatsīya iti | prāk krītācchaḥ |
sāntāpika iti | tasmai prabhavati santāpādibhyaḥ iti pāgvateṣṭhañ |

e naña titi kimiti | pratiṣedhe prāyeṇa naña eva pravṛttidarśanātpraśnaḥ
| vigārdabharathika taiti | avyayapūrvapadaprakṛtisvara evātra bhavati |
gardabharathikādanya ityādi | udāharaṇādasya viśeṣaṃma pradaśeyitum
guṇapratiṣedhe iti sūtrāvayavaṃ vyācaṣṭe - guṇa iti | taddhitārthaḥ
sampādyādiḥ, tasya yatpravṛttinimitaṃ sampāditvādi | ādiśabdena
tadarhatvādergrahaṇam, sa guṇa ityucyate | uktaṃ hi - saṃsargabhedakaṃ
yadyat savyāpāraṃ pratīyate | guṇatvaṃ paratantratvātasya śāstra
udāhṛtam || iti | 
e kathaṃ tasya guṇasya pratiṣedha ucyate ityāha - karṇaveṣṭakābhyāṃ na
sampādīti | vaveḍheati | arharthe tṛc, ḍhatvadhātvaṣṭuatvadhalopaṣu
sahivahorodavarṇasya ityotvam || 
e yayatoścātadarthe || 6 - 2 - 156 || 
e pāśatṛṇaśabdābhyāṃ samūhe pāśādibhyo yaḥ dantakarṇaśabdābhyāṃ
bhavārthe digādibhyo yat, śarīrāvayavācca iti yat | 
e pādyamiti | pādārghābhyāṃ ca iti yat | adeyamiti | arhārthe aco
yat īdyāti itītvam, guṇaḥ | niranubandhakaikānubandhayīriti | ete
ca paribhāṣe - vāmadevād ḍa|lḍḍa|lai ityatra jñāpite || 
eackāvaśaktau || 6 - 2 - 157 || 
e avikṣipa iti | vakṣyamāṇaiḥ kṛtyokeṣṇujbhiḥ sāhacaryādackayauḥ
kṛtoridaṃ grahaṇam, tena kṛdgrahaṇaparibhāṣayā vikṣipaśabdasya
kāntatvam | 
e dīkṣitaparivrājakau śāstraniṣedhānna pacataḥ, na tvaśaktatvāt, tena
tatra vrataṃ gamyate, na tvaśaktiḥ || 
eākrośe ca || 6 - 2 - 158 || 
e apaco'yaṃ jālma īti | lobho'tra vivakṣitaḥ, na tvaśāktiḥ || 
esaṃjñāyām || 6 - 2 - 159 || 
e adevadata iti | yo devadataḥ san tatkāryaṃ na karoti, sa
evamākruśyate || 
ekṛtyokeṣṇuccārvādayaśva || 6 - 2 - 160 || 
e dvyanubandhakasyāpi grahaṇamiti | bhavatīti vakṣyamāṇena sambandhaḥ |
atraiva hetuḥ - ikārādeviṃdhānasāmarthyāṃditi |
bhavaterudātatvātataḥ parasya khiṣṇuca iṭaivekārāditve siddhe
ikārādervidhānamiha sāmānyagrahaṇārthame veti bhāvaḥ | acārurityādi
| 
e carerñuṇ cāruḥ | sādheruṇ sādhuḥ | yudhā carati yaudhikaḥ |
ejeḥ khaś aṅgamejayaḥ, tato'nyo'naṅgamejayaḥ | vaderānyaḥ | na
kasmādakasmāt | vṛtu vartate, vṛdhu vṛddhau, ñitvarā sambhrame, ruca
dīptau dhṛṅ avasthāne - ete śānajāntāḥ gṛhyate | saṃjñāyāṃ kan -
gṛhapatikaḥ | gṛhapatirityanye paṭhanti || 
ebahuvrīhāvidametatadbhyaḥ prathamapūraṇayoḥ kriyāgaṇane || 6 - 2 - 162
|| 
e prathameti svarupagrahaṇam | pūraṇaśabdasya
svaritatatadadhikāravihitānāṃ pratyayānāṃ grahaṇam | 
e anena prathama iti | atra tṛtīyāpūrvapadaprakṛtisvara eva bhavati | 
e yatprathamā iti | yaḥ prathama eṣāmiti bahuvrīhiḥ | atrāpi
pūrvapagadaprakṛtisvara eva bhavati | 
e idampradhānā ityarthaṃ iti | 
e anena pradhānavacanaḥ prathamaśabdo na tvekasaṃkhyāvacana iti darśayan
gaṇanābhāvamāha - utarapadasvetyādi | sarvatreha samāsasyeti
prakṛtam, utarapadādiḥ ityataḥ prabhati utarapadasya iti ca, tatra
cotarapadaṃ kāyitvenāśrīyate | tena yadā kabutpadyate tadā kapi
parato yatpūrvaṃ prathameti tadantodātaṃ bhavati, na tu kabantam |
kappratyayo hi samāsasyaivāntaḥ, notarapadasya | yadā ca
samāsārthādutarapadādakṛta eva samāse samāsānta iti pakṣaḥ, tadāpi
prathamapūraṇayoḥ iti viśeṣṭarupagrahaṇāt, kapaśca
tatrāntarbhāvādupātayoreva svaraḥ | nanu yadatrotaparapadaṃ kabantaṃ na
tadupātam, yaccopātaṃ na tadutarapadam, kapā
sahotarapadatvāditi nātra kapaḥ svaraprasaṅgaḥ, nāpi tataḥ
pūrvapadasya sevareṇa bhavitavyam | tasmādismin pakṣe
utarapadagrahaṇamupāntasyopalakṣaṇam| prāyoṇa hi tadutarapadam,
utarapadasya kārthitvāt | ko'rthaḥ prāyoṇotarapadabhūtayoḥ
prathamapūraṇayoḥ kārtitvādityarthaḥ || 
e vibhāṣā cchandasi || 6 - 2 - 164 || 
e dvistanā - ityantodātam | catustanā - ityādyaudātam || 
esaṃjñāyāṃ mitrājinayoḥ || 6 - 2 - 165 || 
e viśvāmitra iti | mittre carṣau iti dīrghaḥ,
paratvādanenāntodātatvaṃ prāptaṃ pratiṣidhyate, tataḥ bahuvrīhau
viśvaṃ saṃjñāyām iti pūrvapadāntodātaṃ bhavati || 
e vyavāyino'ntaram || 6 - 2 - 166 || 
e udāharaṇe vyavadhānavācino'ntarāśabdāt tatkaroti iti ṇici
pacādyac | pratyudāharaṇe tvanyavācyantaraśabdaḥ || 
e mukhaṃ svāṅgamaḥ || 6 - 2 - 167 || 
e dīrghamukhā śāleti | mukhaśabdenātra dvārapradeśaḥ śālāyā ucyate |
nanu ca svamaṅgaṃ, tataśca bhavitavyamevātrāpi ata āha
svāṅgamadravādilakṣaṇaṃ gṛhyata iti || 
enāvyayadikśabdagomahatsthūlamuṣṭipṛthuvatsebhyaḥ || 6 - 2 - 167 || 
e uccairnīcaiḥ śabdai svarādiṣvantodātau | prākśabdaḥ aniganto'ñcatau
ityādyaudātaḥ | pratyaṅtyitra kṛdutarapadaprakṛtisvaraḥ | gomahatoruktaḥ
svaraḥ | sthūlaśabdaḥ ṛjrendra ityādau nipātitaḥ, antodātaḥ | muṣeḥ
ktic - muṣṭiḥ | kuśca, prathimradibhrasjāṃ samprasāraṇaṃ salopaśca iti
pṛthuḥ | vadeḥ saḥ vatsaḥ | gomuṣṭivatsapūrvasyatyādi | asya
pratiṣedhasyāvakāśo yatra gavādhyupamānaṃ na bhavati - gaurmukhamita
yasya, muṣṭirmukhamiva yasya, vatso mukhamiva yasyeti, sarvatra
gavādyaupameyam, nopamānam vikalpasyotarasyāvakāśo yatra
gavādipūrvapadaṃ na bhavati - siṃhamukhaḥ vyāghramukhaḥ, gāvādāvupamāne
ubhayaprasaṃge'yameva bhavati pratiṣedhaḥ pūrvavipratiṣedhena || 
e niṣṭhopamānādanyatarasyām || 6 - 2 - 169 || 
e hiṃseḥ pacādyac, paḥṣodarāditvādādyantaviparyayaḥ - siṃhaḥ |
vyājighratīti vyāghraḥ | ātaścopasarge iti kaḥ | pādhrādhmādheṭdṛśaḥ
iti śo na bhavati, jighrateḥ saṃjñāyāṃ pratiṣedhaḥ iti vacanāt || 
ejātikālasukhādibhyo'nācchādanāt kto'kṛtimitapratimannāḥ || 6 -
2- 170 || 
enanūdāharaṇeṣu pratyudārahaṇeṣu ca ni,ṭheti niṣṭhāntaṃ pūrvaṃ
prayoktavyaṃ syāt ityata āha - etaṣviti | pratyudārahaṇe,tyāidi |
tatra putraśabdo'ntodātaḥ | vaseṣṭran - vastram , dasyaiva lyuṭ -
vasanam | kuṇḍaśabdaḥ nabviṣayasyānisantasya ityādyadātaḥ || 
e vā jāte || 6 - 2 - 171 || 
e dantastanaśabdau svāṅgaśiṭāmadantānām ityādyaudātau | māsaśabdaḥ
prāmādīnāṃ ca ityādyaudātaḥ | saṃvatsaraśabdaḥ
baṃhiṣṭhavatsaratiśatthāntānām ityantodātaḥ | asyārthaḥ -
baṃhiṣṭavatsaratiśattha tyevimantānāmanta udāto bhavati - baṃhiṣṭhaḥ,
saṃvatsaraḥ, saptatiḥ, aśītiḥ, triṃśat, catvāriṃśat, gūtham, pūtham
| 
e sukhaduḥkhaśabdau khāntasyāśamādeḥ ityāntodātau | asyārthaḥ -
khāntasya śabdasyāśakāramakārāderanta udāto bhavati, nakhaḥ, taukhā |
aśamāderiti kim śikhā, mukham | tṛpeḥ sphāyitañci ityādinā
rakpratyayaḥ | kṛteśchara ca - kṛcchram | aserbahulavacanādrak, asram
| ambikādayaśca iti ambakaśabda ikanpratyayānto nipātitaḥ | pratigatā
āpo'tra pratīpam | kṛvāpājibhya uṇ - kāruḥ | kṛpeḥ kyun -
kṛpaṇaḥ | saheḥ kte soḍhaḥ | daśa sukhādayaḥ || 
enañsubhyām || 6 - 2 - 172 || 
e samāsasyaitadityādi | yadyapi samāsa utarapadaṃ ceti prakṛtam,
tathāpyatra samāsasyeva kāryirtvāmaṣyate | etacca kapi pūrvam iti
vacanādavasīyate | yadi hyanenotarapadasyāntodātatvaṃ syāt,
tato'kṛmārīka ityādāvanenaiva samaddhatvāt api pūrvam iti na
vācyaṃ syāt | samāsāntāśca samāsavayavā bhavantīti | samāsāntā
ityatrāntagrahaṇametadartham - samāsāntāḥ samāsagrahaṇena yathā
gṛhyaeranniti, tenānṛca ityādau kṛte samāsānte tasyaiva
samāsāntasyodātatvaṃ bhavati | vahavṛca iti | bahornañvad
ityatideśādidamatrodāhṛtam | etacca samāsāntāḥ
samāsasyaivāvayavāḥ, notarapadasya ityāśrityoktam | na kapi ityatra
tu pūrvaṃ samāsānteṣu paścātadantena samāsaḥ iti vakṣyati || 
e kapi pūrvam || 6 - 2 - 173 || 
e pūrveṇa kapa evādātatve prāpte tataḥ pūrvasyodātacaṃ dhīyate
hrasvante'ntyātpūrvam kaiti vacanādiha dīrghāntā evodāhṛtāḥ |
nadyaḥtaśca iti kap || 
e hrasvānte'ntyātpūrvam || 6 - 2 - 174 || 
e hrasvānte ityasya bahuvrīheranyapadārtha utarapadaṃ samāso vetyāha -
hrasvo'nto yasyatyādi | 
e atra ca kapi parataḥ iti pṛthagvacanātadrahitamutarapadaṃ samāsaśca
gṛhyate, pūrvagrahaṇamanarthakam, kapi pūrvamityanuvṛteḥ ityata āha -
pūrvamiti vartamāne ityādi | dvitīye pūrvagrahaṇe sati
pravṛttibhedo bhavati, tatraikayā pravṛtyā
hrasvānta'ntyātpūrvasyodātatvaṃ vidhīyate, aparayā tu niyamyate -
hrasvānte'nsyādeva pūrvamudātaṃ bhavati, na tu kapi pūrvamiti| tena
kiṃ siddhaṃ bhavati tatrāha - teneti | nāstyasya jña ityajñakaḥ, śobhano
jño'syeti sujñakaḥ | tatra yadyeṣa niyamo na syāt, tato'ntyātpūrva
udātabhāvī nāstīti kapi pūrvam ityayameva svaraḥ syāt | asmistu
niyame sati na bhavati, nañsubhyām iti kabantasyaiva bhavati | yathā
ca kabantasya bhavati tathā tatraiva pritapāditam | vyaktipakṣāśrayaṇe
caitatpūrvagrahaṇaṃ kṛtam | jātipakṣāśrayaṇe tu yathā halādiḥ śeṣaḥ
ityatra kvacidapi vartamāno halādiranādeḥ sarvatra nivṛttiṃ karoti,
(tathaiva ) hrasvānte'ntyātpūrvam ityatrāpi hrasvajāterāśrayaṇātsarvatra
hrasvānte takrakauṇḍinyanyāyena kapi pūrvam ityasyāpravṛttiḥ sidhyati
|| 
ebahornañvadutarapadabhūmni || 6 - 2 - 175 || 
e naña iva nañvat, asmādeva nipātānātpañcamīsamarthādvatiḥ | yadvā -
sambandhasamāmānye ṣaṣṭhī, tayā sarve vibhaktyarthā saṃgṛhyanta iti
pañcamyarthe'pi tatra tasyeva iti vatiḥ ṣaṣṭha|lntādeva | bahūnāṃ bhāvo
bhūmā, bahorlopo bhū 
eca bahoḥ, utarapadaśabdena tadartho gṛhyate, svarupaṇotarapadasya
bahutvāsambhavāt | tadāha - utarapadārthabahutva iti | kimarthaṃ
punaratideśa āśrīyate, na nañsubahubhya utarapadabhūmni ityucyeta,
evamapi hyucyamāne utarapadabhūmni ityetatsambhavavyabhicārābhyāṃ
bahoreva viśeṣaṇaṃ bhavatiṣyati, yo'pi na guṇādayo'vayavāḥ iti
pratiṣedhaḥ, tatrāpyutarapadabhūmnītyanuvṛterbahoreva bhavatiṣyati, na
nañsubhyām - aguṇaḥ saguṇaḥ iti idaṃ tarhi prayojanam -
prakaraṇāntare'pi yo nañāśrayaḥ svarastasyāpyatideśo yathā syāditi
| taddarśayati - nañī jaramaramitramṛtā ityuktamityādi || 
e na guṇādayo'vayavāḥ || 6 - 2 - 173 || 
e guṇa saṃkhyāne curāderadantāderac | aśeḥ saraḥ | akṣaraḥ | cchando
mīyate yena cchandomānam | vaceḥ supūrvāt ktaḥ - sūktam |
adhīyate'smāditi adhyāyaḥ , iṅśca iti ghañ | ete guṇādayaḥ || 
eupasargāt svāṅgaṃ dhruvamaṣarśu || 6 - 3 - 177 || 
e svāṅgaṃ prati kriyāyogābhāvād kaupasargagrahaṇaṃ pradyaupalakṣamam |
satataṃ yasyetyādinā ṣṛṣṭhasya dhruvatvaṃ darśayati |
tīrthapṛṣṭhagūḍhayūtha iti pṛṣṭhaśabdo nipātitaḥ | 
e udvāhuḥ krośatīti | atra krośanasamaya evodvāhutvaṃ na
sarvadetyadhruvatvam | spṛśeḥ śvaṇśunau pṛ ca svṛśerdhātoḥ śvaṇ,
n - ityetau pratyau bhavataḥ, dhātośca pṛ ityādeśaḥ |
bahulavacanācchakārasyotsaṃjñā na bhavati, yathākramaṃ vṛddhiguṇau -
pārśvam, parśuḥ || 
epareramitobhāvi maṇḍalam || bahuvrīhirayamityādi | yadā
bahuvrīhistadā paritaḥ kūlamasyeti vigrahaḥ | prādisamāse tu
parigataṃ kūlamiti | yadā punaravyayībhāvastadā parikūlāditi |
avyayībhāvapakṣe'pi hītyādi | avyayībhāve'pyayameva svara eṣitavyaḥ na
samāsasvareṇa siddhirityartthaḥ | amito
bhāvo'syāstītyamitobhāvīti | laukike yoge
lāghavasyāsārvatrikatvādvahuvrīhireva nāśrita ityāha - amitobhāvīti
| supyajātau iti ṇiniriti | yaccaivaṃsvabhāvamiti |
abhitobhavanasvabhāvam || 
e prādasvāṅgaṃ saṃjñāyām || 6 - 2 - 183 || 
e prakoṣṭhādiṣu prādisamāsaḥ bahuvrīhirvā || 
enirudakādīni ca || 6 - 2 - 184 || 
e eṣāmityādi | yadā pradisamāsastadā - nirgatamudakaṃ nirgataṃ
vodakāditi vigrahaḥ, bahuvrīhau -- nirgatamudakamasmāditi |
athāvyayībhāvārthamapyeṣāṃ grahaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavati atha āha --
avyayībhāve tviti | niṣkālika iti | kālaśabdajjānapadādisūtreṇa
ṅīṣ, tataḥ svārthe kan, ke'ṇaḥ iti hrasvaḥ, kālikā, tataḥ
prādisamāsaḥ | 
e niṣpeṣa iti | piṣerghañ | kutsitastarīya iti | duḥ kutsāyāṃ
vartata iti darśayati | apare nistarīka iti | paṭhantītyanuṣaṅgaḥ,
niṣpūrvo'jinaśabdaḥ | sa evodupapūrvaḥ | 
e parerityādi | parerutare hastādayo'ntodātā bhavanti | parihasta
ityādi | (harairiva keśā yasya harikeśaḥ , kaperiva kapikeśaḥ )|| 
eabhermukham ||6 - 2 - 185 || 
eupasargātsvāṅga dhruvamiti siddha iti | mukhaṃ svāṅgam iti na
siddhyati nāvyayadikśabda iti pratiṣedhāt || 
e apāñca || 6 - 2 - 186 || 
e avyayībhāvo'pyatra prayojayatīti | kutaḥ ityāha - tatrāpi hīti |
yasmātatrāpi paripratyupāpā iti pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratvamuktam,
tasmātso'pi prayojayatītyarthaḥ | 
e yogāvibhāgha utarārtha iti | utaratra upāt ityasyaivānuvṛttiryathā
syāt, abhermā bhūt || 
e sphigapūtavīṇāñcī'dhvakukṣisīranāma nāma ca || 6 - 2 - 187 || 
e nāmagrahaṇaṃ sīraśabdeneva sambadhyate, na
sphigādibhiḥsphigapūtakukṣīṇāṃ pṛthaggrahaṇāt | 
e upasargādadhvana iti yadā samāsānta ityādi | atra kāraṇamāha --
tasmin hi satīti | nanu ca 
ecaupasargādadhvanaḥ ityatra tu na vikalpaḥ śrutaḥ, nāpi prakṛtaḥ,
tatkimucyate - yadā samāsānto nāstīti ata āha -- anityasceti |
yadi nityaḥ samāsāntaḥ syadadhvagrahaṇamiha na kartavyaṃ syād,
acpratyayasya citvādevāntodātatvasya siddhatvāt kṛtaṃ tu, jñāpayati
-- samāsāntavidhiranitya iti | 
esphigapūtakukṣīṇāmityādi | yadā hyaetāni svāṅgavācīni dhruvāṇi
ca bhavanti, bahuvrīhiśca samāsaḥ, tadā upasarghātsvāṅgam ityeva
siddham || 
e adheruparistham || 6 - 2 - 188 || 
e upari tiṣṭhatītyuparistham, supi sthaḥ iti kaḥ | 
e dantasyoparītyādinoparisthatvaṃ darśayati | 
e adhikaraṇamiti | atra kṛdutarapadaprakṛtisvareṇa kakārākāra udātaḥ
|| 
eanorapradhānakanīyasī || 6 - 2 - 189 || 
e udārahaṇe utarapadārthasyāprādhānyaṃ darśayati | pūrvapadārthapradhānaḥ
prādisamāso'yamiti | pradhānārthe ca kanīyograhaṇamiti | anyatrā
pradhānagrahaṇenaiva siddhatvāt | 
e anugato jyaṣṭha iti | vigrahaviśeṣeṇa pradhānavācitvaṃ jyeṣṭaśabdasya
darśayati || 
e puruṣaścānvādiṣṭhaḥ || 6 - 2 - 190 || 
e anvādiṣṭaḥ - apradhānaśiṣṭaḥ, yathā bhikṣāmaṭha gāṃ cānayeti
gorānayanam | kathitānukathito veti | kasmiṃścitprākkathite
yo'nyaḥ paścātkathyate sa kathitānukathitaḥ | anugataḥ - paścādgataḥ
|| 
e aterakṛtpade || 6 - 2 - 191 || 
e akṛcca padacca akṛtpade || ātakāraka iti | śobhanaḥ kārakaḥ, svatī
pūjāyām iti prādisamāsaḥ | 
e aterdhātulopa iti vaktavyamiti | atyaṅkuśa caityādau
vṛttivaṣaye'tiśabdo|tikrantārthavṛttiriti krameraprayoga eva
dhātulopaḥ | atigārgya iti | yathānyāse tvatrāpi prāpnoti
gārgyaśabdasyākṛdantatvāt | atikāraka iti | yathānyāse tvatra na
syāt, kārakaśabdasya kṛdantatvāt |
tasmādavyāptyativyāptiparihārthamakṛtpade ityapanīya
aterdhātulopaḥ iti vaktavyam | 
e neranidhāne || 6 - 2 - 192 || 
e nidhānamaprakāśateti | na nidhānamanidhānam | nirgataṃ mūlamasya
nirgataṃ vā mūlannimūlam | 
e nidhānārthaṃ bravītīti | aprakāśatāṃ bravītītyarthaḥ | kathaṃ
punarniśabdasyāyamarthaḥ ityāha - prādayo hīti || 
eprateraṃśvādayastatpuruṣe || 6 - 2 - 193 || 
e aṃśuśabdaḥ kuśca iti vartamāne mṛgayvādayaśca iti nipātitaḥ |
rājateḥ kanin rājan | uṣa dāhe, ṣṭran --uṣṭraḥ | khiṭ, ṇvul
-kheṭakaḥ | ajiraśiśira iti kirac - ajiram | drāterāṅpūrvād
ātaścopasarge ityaṅ, asmādeva nipātanādāṅe ragāgamajhaḥ - ārdrā |
śrṛṇoterlyuṭ - śravaṇam | kṛtibhidilatibhyaḥ kit, tikan
prakṛtaḥ - kṛtikā | ṛgheḥ pacādyac - ardhaḥ | pura agragamane
igupadhātkaḥ puram | ete aṃśvādayaḥ || 
e ukapād dvyajajinamaragaurāyaḥ || 6 - 2 - 194 || 
e gurī udyamane, pacādyajantātprajñādyaṇ, gauram| tiṣyeṇa yuktaḥ
kālastaiṣaḥ | leṭ loṭ iti | kaṇḍvādipaṭhitābyāṃ pacādyac,
leṭaloṭau | diherjihvā uṇādiḥ | kṛṣervarṇe iti nak, ṭāp -
kṛṣṇā | kanyāśabdaḥ adhnyādayaśca iti nipātitaḥ | gugha ghanatve
igupadhātkaḥ gudhaḥ | klṛpipadibhyāṃ ghañ - kalpaḥ, pādaḥ || 
esoravakṣepaṇe || 6 - 2 - 195 || 
e udārahaṇe tu svatī pūjāyām iti karmapvacanīyasya samāsaḥ | tena
supratyavasite thāthādisvareṇa siddhirnāśaṅkyā | yadi suśabdo'tra
pūjāyāmeva vartate, kathaṃ tarhi kṣepo gamyate ityāha -
vākyārthastviti | katham ityāha - āsūyayā tathābhidhānāditi | yaḥ
khalvanarthaṃ upasthite sukhāyām āste taṃ prakṛtyaivamukte kṣepo
gamyate || 
e vibhāṣotpucche|| 6 - 2 - 196 || 
e seyamubhayatra vibhāṣeti | ādyapravṛtāvavyayapūrvapadaprakṛtisvareṇa
bādhitatvāt samāsasyāntodātatvamaprāptam, dvitīyāyāṃ tu
thāthādisvareṇa nityaṃ prāptamiti kṛtvā || 
edvitribhyāṃ pāddanmūrddhasu bahuvrīhau || dvitribhyām iti
digyogalakṣaṇā pañcamī, pāddanmūrddhasu iti satsaptamī, bahuvrīhiḥ
kāryīti, tadetadāha - dvitri ityetābhyāmiti | dvipāditi | saṃkhyā
supūrvasya ityakāralopaḥ samāsāntaḥ | danniti | vayasi dantasya datṛ|

e mūrddhannityādi | na hyakṛtsamāsāntasya sambhavaḥ ata āha - etadeveti | 
e yadi tarhyakṛtasamāsāntasyopādanam, evaṃ sati yadi samāsāntaḥ
kriyate, tadā na prāpanoti tasya śabdāntaratvādityata āha - yadapīti
| iha hi bahuvrīhiḥ kāryitvenopātaḥ, na mūrddhaśabdaḥ |
tadekadeśatvācceti | tasya bahuvrīherekadeśo'vayavaḥ
samāsāntastadbhāvastatvam, tasmādityarthaḥ | tadekadeśitvāditi
pāṭhe sa va vrīhirekadeśī avayavī yasya sa tadekadeśī, tasya
bhāvastatvam, tasmāditi sa evārthaḥ | tadevaṃ bahuvrīheḥ
kāryitvāttdekadeśatvācca samāsāntasya yadāpi samāsāntaḥ kriyate,
tadāpyayaṃ vidhirbhavatyeva | 
e apara āha - yadāpyutarapadasya kāryitvaṃ tadāpi
paratvādantodātatve kṛte paścātsamāsāntaḥ, tatra ṭilope sati
udātanivṛttisvareṇaiva ṣapratyayasya siddhamudātatvamiti |
kalyāṇamūrddheti | pūrvapadaprakṛtisvara evātra bhavati | kalyāṇaśabdaḥ
laghāvante iti madhyodātaḥ || 
esakthaṃ cākrāntāt || 6 - 2 - 198 || 
e bahuvrīhau sakthyakṣṇoḥ svāṅgātṣac iti samāsānte kṛte yaḥ
sakthaśabdaḥ so'tra gṛhyate | kraśabdo'nto yasya sa krāntaḥ,
tato'nyo'krānta iti | gaurasaktha iti | gauraśabdaḥ
prajñādyaṇantatvādantodātaḥ | śliṣerañcopapadhāyāḥ iti
ślakṣṇaśabdo'ntodātaḥ | 
e ṣacaścitvāditi | etena citsvarasyāyamapavādaḥ,
prāptavibhāṣeyamiti darśaṃyati || 
eparādiścchandasi bahulam || 6 - 2 - 199 || 
e parādiriti | paraśabdenātra sakthaśabda eva gṛhyata iti | tasyaiva
pūrvasūtre sannihitatvāt | yadyevam, paragrahaṇamanarthakam, pkṛto
hi sakthaśabdo'nuvartiṣyate naitadastiḥ bahuvrīherapi
prakṛtisyānuvṛttiḥ syāt, tasyādyaudātatvaṃ śaṅkyeta, vibhāṣāgrahaṇe
prakṛte bahulagrahaṇasya prayojanamanyadapi yathā syāditi |
ṛjuvāhuriti | bahuvrīhiḥ | vākyatiścitpatiriti | ṣaṣṭhīsamāsau
| atra bhāṣāviṣaye patyāvaiśvarye ityasya na bhūvākciddidhiṣu iti
pratiṣedhe samāsāntodātatvaṃ bhavati | 
e bahulagrahakaṇasiddhamarthaṃ ślokena darśayati - parādiśca parāntaśceti
| pūrvapara śabdābhyāṃ pūrvotarapadayorgrahaṇam| yata evaṃ
parādiprabhṛtirudātaścchandasi dṛśyate, tato hetorbahulaṃ
svaravyatyaya uktaḥ | svaravyatyayārthaṃ bahulagrahaṇaṃ kṛtamityarthaḥ || 

iti śrīharadatamaśraviracitāyāṃ padamañjaryāṃ ṣaṣṭhādhyāyasya dvitīyaḥ
pādaḥ|e atha ṣaṣṭhādhyāye tṛtīyaḥ pādaḥ 
e padamañjarī 

ealagutarapade || 6 - 3 - 1 || 
e alugiti cetyādi | pratyekaṃ svaritatvapratijñānaṃ daśeyati, asya
porayojanam - ekasya nivṛtāvaparasya nivṛttirmā bhūditi |
stokānmukta iti | karaṇe ca stokālpakṛcchra ityādinā pañcamī,
stokāntika ityādinā samāsaḥ | utarapada iti kimiti | luk
tāvatsamāsa eva prāptaḥ pratiṣidhyate iti sāmarthyādutarapada
taityetallabhyate | nalopo nañaḥ ityādau ca na samāse ityayo hi
samāsagrahaṇānuvṛterutarapadalābhāt natarāmityādau naño
nalopādyabhāvaḥ siddha iti paśnaḥ | nistoka iti |
atrotarapadabhūtebhyo'pi stokādibhyaḥ parasyāḥ pañcamyā
alukprasaṅgaḥ |
