e nanu ca lakṣaṇapratipadoktaparibhāṣayā stokādibhyaḥ pratipadaṃ yā
pañcamī vihitā, yaśca teṣāṃ pratipadoktaḥ samāsastasyā eva tatraiva vā
lugbhaviṣyati, tatkimetannivṛtyarthenotarapadagrahaṇena ityata āha -
anyārthamityādi | ānaṇḥóto dvandve utarapade parato yathā syāt,
utarapadasya mā bhūd - hotāpotārau, tānyathā paramapi
sarvanāmasthānāpekṣatvena bahiraṅgama ṛto ṅ guṇiṃ bādhitvā
dvandvakriyānantaraprāpta ānaṅ syāt, hotāpotṛbhyāmityādau ca
syādeva | tathā iko hrasvo'ṅyo gālavasya iti utarapade yathā syād
, grāmaṇīrityādāvutarasya padasya mā
bhūdityevamādyarthamutarapadādhikāro'vaśyaṃ kartavyaḥ sa ihaiva kriyeta,
samāsānuvṛttiḥ - lakṣakaṇapratipadoktaparibhāṣā nākṣayitavyā bhavatīti
| ā kuta taimāvadhikārau ityapekṣāyāmāha - alugadhikāra ityādi |
ṛkārāntasya hyutarapade'nantare pitṛputra ityādau ānaṅa bhavitavyam
| yadi cātrāluk syādvibhaktyā vyavadhānaṃ syāt | yadvā -
sākṣānnirdiṣṭamānaṅadikāryaṃ prakaraṇapptasyāluko nivartakamiti
alugadhikāraḥ pragānaṅḥ tathāṅgasya vidhīyamānaṃ kāryaṃ
yatrāṅgamityetadbhavati tatraiva bhavati | kasmiṃścaitadbhavati
pratyaye, na tūtarapada tathaiti sāmarthyād utarapadādhikāraḥ
prāgaṅgādhikārāt || 
epañcamyāḥ stokādibhyaḥ || 6 - 2 - 2 || 
e stokādīnāṃ pratipadikagaṇe'pāṭhātsūtrapaṭhitānāṃ grahaṇamityāha -
stokāntikadūrārthakṛcchāṇi stokādīnīti | karaṇe ca
stokālpakṛcchra ityādīni tustokādīni na gṛhyanta avyāptaḥ |
stokāntika ityatratyāni bhūyiṣṭhāni arthagrahaṇāt | alugbhavatīti |
lugna bhavatītyarthaḥ | supo luki prāpta iti | supo
dhātuprātipadikayoḥ ityanena | pratiṣedhaḥ kriyata iti | alugiti
prasajyapratiṣedha iti darśayati, utarapadādhikāropajīvanāya tu
nāvyayībhāvāt ityasyānantaramidaṃ prakaraṇaṃ nārabdham, ekavacca,
sarvasyālukprakaraṇasya śeṣabhūto'yamarthātideśaḥ, yasyā
vibhakteralugvidhīyate, tadartho dvyātmako
bahvātmakarścaikavadbhavatīti vaktavyam | tena stokābhyāṃ muktaḥ,
stokebhayo mukta ityapi vigrahe stokābhyāṃ muktaḥ stokebhyo mukta
ityatrāpyaikapadyamaikasvaryaṃ syāt naiṣa doṣaḥ, stokādibhyaḥ pratipadaṃ
yā pañcamī - karaṇe ca stokālpa iti, tasya aluk, sā
cāsatvavacanebhyo dvibahvorna sambhavatīti stokābhyām, stokebhya
ityapādāna eṣāṃ pañcamītyeva na bhaviṣyati | evamapi dūrābhyāmāgataḥ,
durebhya āgata ityatra prasaṅgaḥ atra hi dūrāntikārthebhyo dvitīyā ca
iti pratipadameva pañcamī | tathā'ntikābhyāṃ kṛtam, antikebhyaḥ
kṛtamityādāvapyalukprasaṅgaḥ tasmādekavacceti vaktavyam | nanu
vṛtāvupasarjanapadāni ekādisaṅkhyāṃ vihāyābhedaikatvāsaṅkhyāṃ
pratipadyante, kā punariyamabhedaikatvasaṅkhyā
viśeṣāṇāmavibhāgenāvasthānam, yathā - madhunyoṣadhirasānām, na
hi tatrāsyā oṣadherayaṃraso'syā ayamiti vibhāgo dṛśyate, atha ca ta
eva viśeṣā anubhūyante na punā rasasāmānyam, tadvadatrāpi
rājapuruṣa taiti rājārtho naikatvādiviśeṣāḥ | uktaṃ ca - 
e yathauṣadhirasāḥ sarve madhunyāhitaśaktayaḥ | 
e avibhāgena vartante tāṃ saṅkhyāṃ tādṛśīṃ viduḥ || iti | 
e yadvā - anupātasaṅkhyāviśeṣamekatvādiṣvanugataṃ
sāmānyamabhedaikatvasaṅkhyā, yathā santamase rupamātraṃ 
egṛhyate na punaḥ śukla iti vā, kṛṣṇa iti vā, tadvadatrāpīti
saṅkhyāvān rājārthaḥ, na cāvyayārthavanniḥsaṅkhya ityetāvatpratīyate
| uktaṃ ca 
e bhedānāṃ vā parityāgātsaṅkhyātmā sa tathāvidhaḥ | 
e vyāpārajjātibhāgasya bhedāpohena vartate || 
e antarhitaviśeṣeṇa yathā rupeṇa rupanān | 
e prakhyāyate na śuklādibhedo rupasya gamyate || iti | 
etadevamabhedaikatvasaṅkhyopādānād dvivacanabahvacanāntānāṃ sarvā
vṛttirna bhavati, kiṃ punaḥ samāsa eva, tataśca samāsābhāvādalugna
bhaviṣyatīti kimekavadbhavena ucyate kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇam -
vṛtāvabhedaikatvasaṅkhyā pratīyate saṅkhyāviśeṣapratipādakābhāvāt
| vibhaktirhi tasya pratipādikā, sā ca vṛtau nivṛtā, nivṛtāyāṃ ca
tasyām trikaṛ prātipadikāryaḥ iti pakṣe saṅkhyāsāmānyasyāpi
tāvatpradipādakābhāvaḥ | yadi paraṃ guḍa ityukte
māghuryādivadavyabhicārātsaṅkhyā pratīyate, avyabhicāraśca
casāmānyasyāniyatasya vā viśeṣasyeti, saivābhedaikatvasaṅkhyā |
pañcakapatre'pi saṅkhyāviśeṣapratipatau dyotakatvenāpi tāvad
vibhaktayo'pekṣyanta iti tadabhāvātsāmānyo'niyate vā viśeṣaḥ
pratīyata iti saivābhedaikatvasaṅkhyā | yatra hyarthaprakaraṇādikaṃ
viśeṣāvagatau pramāṇaṃ bhavatyeva tatra vṛttithaḥ | tadyathā, aryād
mudgauḥ krītaṃ maudgikam, na hyaekena mudgena krayaḥ sambhavati,
kārakamadhya iti ca, na hyaekasya madhyaṃ sambhavati prakaraṇāt -
bhavadgirāmavasarapradānāya iti ādeśāt - tāvakīno māmakīna iti
śaiṣikaḥ | māsajāta ityādau tu
prātipadikārthasyaivāktaparimāṇatvāt | dviputra ityādau
saṅkhyāśabdasannidhānāt | tadevaṃ yatra viṣeṣe
pramāṇābhāvastatrābhedaikatvasaṅkhyā | 
e yadyevam, atrāluki sati vibhaktireva pramāṇamiti
dvivacanabahuvacanāntānāṃ samāsa syādeva yadā tvarthaprakaraṇādinā
viśeṣāvagatau dvivacanabahuvacanāntānāṃ vṛttirbhavati tadā kā
śaṅghā vibhaktāveva satyām | yadi cābhedaikatvasaṅkhyopajanād
dvicanabahuvacanayoralugabhāvaḥ, ekavacanasyāpi na syāt, tasyāpi hi
suddhamekatvaṃ vācyam, mābhedaikatvasaṅkhyā | atha vibhāktyabhāve
saṅkhyāsāmānyasya pratītasya viṣeṣapayevasānāpekṣāyāṃ yo hi
bahūn kalpayati kalpayatyasāvekamiti nyāyena vṛtāvapi
śuddhamekatvaṃ pratīyata ityucyeta, abhaidaikatvasaṅkhyetyanupapannaṃ
syāt| tasmādekavacanāntamya, dvivacanāntasya, bahuvacanāntasya vā
yatheṣṭṃa vṛttiḥ, vṛtau 
ecābhedaikatvasaṅkhyā, arthaprakaraṇādinā viśeṣāvagatiriti vācyam|
evaṃ ca pūrvoktena nyānena dvivacanabahucanayoralukprasaṅgādatideśa
āśrayitavyaḥ | 
e yadyevam, gopucaraḥ apsuyoniḥ, apsavya iti ye
nityabahuvacanāntāḥ teṣā mapyaluki
ekatvātideśādekavacanaprasaṅgaḥ evaṃ tarhyanabhidhānamatra hetuḥ | tadāha
dvivacanabahuvacanāntānāṃ tvanabhidhānāditi | vākyamapi tarhi na
prāpnoti | na ca vācyam - samāse nāstyabhidhānam, vākye
punarastīti | nu hi samāsasaṃjñā'rthābhidhāne upayujyate,
yatpunarupayujyate - prātipadikam, vibhaktiśca, tatsarvamavikalamiti
kimatrānabhidhānaṃ kariṣyati | tatrāha - tenātretyādi |
svarasyāpyarthābhidhāna upayogāt, pṛthaksvarayuktasya vākyasya
pratipādakatvamaikasvaryayuktasya samāsasyāpratipādakatvaṃ ca
yuktamityarthaḥ | 
e brāhmaṇācchṃasina ityādi | kiṃ punaratropasaṅkhyāyate dvitīyārthe
pañcamī, brāhmaṇāni śaṃsati brāhmaṇacchṃasī, aluk tu tatpuruṣe kṛti
bahulam ityeva siddhaḥ | nanu śāsrāṇyasau śaṃsati, na brāhmaṇāni naiṣa
doṣaḥ brāhmaṇavihiteṣu śāsreṣu brāhmataṇaśabdo draṣṭavyaḥ | apara āra -
yukta evātra pañcamyarthaḥ, āharaṇapūrvake śaṃsane śaṃsatirvartate,
brāhmaṇādāhṛtya sūktāni śaṃsatīti brāhmaṇācchṃasī | evamāpi
hotṛprabhṛtiṣvapi brāhmaṇācchṃasīti prāpnoti tatrāha -
ṛtvigviśeṣasya ruḍhiriyamiti | tasyā iti | brāhmaṇācchṃasītyasyā
ruḍhearityarthaḥ | sateti | brāhmaṇācchṃasītyatra pakṣe pañcamyartho na
sambhavati, pakṣāntare tu sambhavati || 
eojaḥsahombhastamasastṛtīyāyāḥ || 6 - 3 - 3 || 
e ojaḥsahogbhastamasastṛtīyāyāḥ || udāharaṇeṣu kartṛkaraṇe kṛtā
bahulam iti samāsaḥ | iha kasmānna bhavati - satatanaiśatamovṛtāmiti
ucyate utarapadena pūrvapadamākṣipyate, tenopātamojaḥprabhṛti
viśeṣyate pūrvapadabhūtebhya 
eojaḥ prabhṛtibhya iti | na cātra tamaḥ śabdaḥ pūrvapadam, kiṃ tarhi
satatanaiśatamaḥ śabdaḥ | yatra tadantāvidhiriṣyate tatropātenākṣiptaṃ
pūrvapadaṃ viśeṣyate, tena tasya tadantasya ca bhavati - iṣṭakacitam,
pakveṣṭakacitamiti | kvacitu - yadevopātaṃ
tasyauvotarapade'nantare tatkāryaṃ bhavati, na tūpātasya tadantasya vā
pūrvapadatvamapekṣyate, yathā - ānaṅ ṛto dvandve
hotṛpotṛneṣṭodgātāraḥ iti, atra neṣṭḥaśabdaśca na pūrvapadam,
nāpi tadantaṃ pūrpadam, kiṃ tarhi hotṛśabdaḥ na
tasyotarapadamanantaram | 
e añcasā - ārjavena | yasya pumānagrajaḥ sa puṃsā hetunā'nuja iti
kṛtvā, januṣāndhaḥ - jātyandhaḥ, janu - janma | 
e ātmanaśca pūraṇe || 6 - 3 - 6 || 
e vārtikamevedaṃ sūtrarupeṇa paṭhitam | pūraṇaśabdasya
svaritatvātadadhikāravihitānāṃ pratyayānāmatra grahaṇaṃ na svarupasya
grahaṇamityāha - pṝaṇapratyayānta iti | yadyapyutarapadādhikāre
pratyayagrahaṇe tadantavidhirna bhavatīti dṛdayasya dṛllekha ityatra
jñāpayiṣyate, tathāpyātmanśabdāt pūrṇapratyayasyāsambhavātsāmarthyādatra
tadantavidhiḥ | ātmānā vā kṛta iti | vṛtau kṛtārthasyāntarbhāvāt
kartari karaṇe vā tṛtīyā, tṛtīyā tatkṛtārthena iti samāsaḥ, yathā -
kuṅkamalohitādāvityarthaḥ | 
e ātmā caturtho yasyeti | ekasyāpi vastuno
buddhiparikalpitavibhedasya vatipadārthatvam, tānyapadārthatvaṃ
cāviruddham || 
e vaiyākaraṇāruyāyāṃ caturthyāḥ || 6 - 3 - 7 || 
e vaiyākaraṇānāmityādi | yadi tu vyākaraṇe bhavā vaiyākaraṇī,
aṇṛgayanādibhyaḥ ityaṇ, vaiyākaraṇī cāsāvākhyā ceti
vaiyākāraṇākhyetyeṣaṃ vyākhyāyeta ātmanebhāṣaḥ , parasmaibhāṣa ityatra
na syāt anayoraṣṭādhyāyyāmapaṭhitatvāt | tasmādyayopadaśitameva
vyākhyātam | yadyevam, kuberabalirityādau lokikasajñāśabde
prasaṅgaḥ, vaiyākaraṇānāmapi tena vyavahārāt ata āha - yayota |
viśeṣaṇasāmarthyādavadhāraṇamāśrīyata iti bhāvaḥ | yadā tu
dhātusūtragaṇoṇādivākyātmakaṃ pañcasthānaṃ vyākaraṇam, tadā
vaiyākaraṇī cāsāvākhyā cetyāsman vyākhyāne'pi na doṣaḥ |
ātmanepadamiti | anvarthatmasya samāsavidhau darśitam | 
eparasya ca || 6 - 3 - 8 || 
e kimathemidamucyate alug yathā syāt - parasmaipadam,
parasmaibhāṣaḥ | siddho'trāluk pūrveṇeva na sidhyati ātmanaḥ iti tatra
vartate | nivartiṣyate yadi nivarteta, tebhyo hitāstaddhitā ityatrāpi
prāpnoti | tasmāt atmanaḥ thaiti tatrānuvartate,
tasmaścānuvartamāne parasya ceti vaktavyam || 
e haladantātsaptamyāḥ sajñāyām || 6 - 3 - 9 || 
e udāharaṇeṣu saṃjñāyām iti samāsaḥ | gaviṣṭhira ityādi | anyathā
antaraṅgānapi vidhīnbahiraṅgo lugbādhate
ityavādeśasyākaraṇādahaladantatvānna syāt, yathā - bhūmyāṃ pāśo
bhūmipāśa ityatreti bhāvaḥ | 
e hṛddyaubhyāmiti | asaṃjñārthamidam | hṛdispṛk, divispṛgiti |
dvitīyārthe caiṣā saptamī | tathā hi bhāṣyam - anyārthe caiṣā saptamī
draṣṭavyā, hṛdayaṃ spṛśatīti hṛdispṛk, divaṃ spṛśatīti divispṛk
iti | ākhyāgrahaṇasyopasamastatvādiha saṃjñāgrahaṇam | tatraiva
tvasamāstamākhyāgrahaṇaṃ kartavyam || 
e kāranāmni ca prācāṃ halādau || 6 - 3 - 10 || 
e vaṇimbhiḥ paśupālaiḥ karṣakaiśca kalpito rājagrāhyae bhāgaḥ - karaḥ,
kara kaeva kāraḥ, prajñāditvādaṇ | 
eniyamavikalpā iti niyamaviśeṣā ityarthaḥ | tāneva darśayati -
kāranāmnye netyādi | prācāṃ deśe halādau yadi bhavati
kāranāmnyeva iti prathamo niyamaḥ, aprāgdeśāvartini tu
tvacisārādāvakāranāmnyapi bhavatyeva | tathā kāranāmni halādau
yadi bhavati pracāmeva iti dvitīyaḥ | prācāṃ kāranāmni ca yadi bhavati
halādāveva iti tṛtīyaḥ | avīnāṃ samūho'vikaṭam, saṅghāte
kaṭac | kathaṃ purekasminvākye niyamatrayaṃ labhyate kaḥ punarāha -
ekamidaṃ vākyamiti āgṛhyamāṇaviśeṣatvena
pratyekamevakāradhyāhārāt trīṇyeva vākyāni | saṃjñāgrahaṇena
prakṛte'pi 
enāmagrahaṇaṃ kriyate niyamārthatvaṃ vispaṣṭayitum anyathā'saṃjñāyāṃ
vidhyarthatā'pi samābhāvyeta | kathaṃ purasaṃjñāyāṃ saptamīsamāsaḥ
etadeva jñāpakaṃ syāt - pracāṃ kāre halādinotarapadenāsaṃjñāyāṃ
saptamīsamāsaḥ etadeva jñāpakaṃ syat - pracāṃ kre
halādinotarapadenāsaṃjñānāmapi bhavati samāsa iti | yasminvidhiḥ
ityeva siddhe ādigrahaṇaṃ vispaṣṭārtham || 
e amūrddhamastakāt svāṅgādakāme || 6 - 3 - 12 || 
e udāharaṇeṣu pratyudārahaṇeṣu ca vyadhikaraṇapado bahuvrīhiḥ |
akṣaśauṇḍa iti | saptamī śauṇḍèaḥ iti tatpuruṣaḥ || 
e bandhe ca vibhāṣā || 6 - 3 - 13 || 
e svāṅgāt itadi nivṛttm, sāmānyanāyaṃ vidhiḥ | bandhe iti
dhāturevātra sahakāreṇā'nukṛtaḥ | nentsiddhabadhnādiṣu ca iti
dhātāveva pratiṣedha uktaḥ, tataśca bahuvrīhirevāsya vikalpasya viṣayaḥ
| tatrāpi hastabandhādau svāṅe praptavibhāṣā, cakrabandhādāvasvāṅge
tvapraptavibhāṣetyubhayatravibhāṣā samāpadyate tapuruṣe tu naivāsya
pravṛttiḥ itīmāṃ śaṅkāmapanayati bandha iti ghañanto gṛhyata iti |
tataśca tatpuruṣe'pi ghañantasya vṛttirviruddhā, pratiṣedhasya bandhanādau
caritārthatvāditi bhāvaḥ | ubhayatra vibhāṣeyamiti | kathamityāha -
svāṅgād bahuvrīhāviti | tatpuruṣe tviti | yadyapi
bahuvrīhāvevāsvāṅgādaprāpta iti śakyaṃ vaktum, tathāpyasya tatpurṣe
pravṛtti darśīyituṃ tatpuruṣe cāsya pravṛttiḥ pūrvavipratiṣedhena
anyathā bahuvrīhirasyāvakāśaḥ, badhnātipratiṣedhasya ca
bandhanādiraṣakāśaḥ ghañante tu tatpuruṣe ubhayaprasaṇeóge
paratvātpratiṣedha eva syāt || 
e tatpuruṣe kṛti bahulam || 6 - 3 - 14 || 
e atrāpi kṛdantasya grahaṇ, na kṛnmātrasya, tatra parataḥ saptamyā
asambhavat iha kasmānna bhavati - parame kārake paramakāraka iti ucyate
- antaraṅgā kṛtpratipādyakriyānimitā saptamī, iha tu
kriyāntaranimitāparame kārake nidhehīti, tena
bahiraṅgatvānnāsyā grahaṇam | 
e kurucara iti | haladantāt ityadhikāramanāśrityaitadudādṛtam |
vibhāṣāgrahaṇe prakṛte bahulagrahaṇaṃ kvacit
prakṛtyādīnāmupasaṃgrahārtham | tena karṇejapādāvalugeva,
madracarādau lugeva, brāhmaṇācchṃasyādau asaptamyā apyaluk | evaṃ ca
sarvamevālukprakaraṇamasyaiva prapañcaḥ || 
e prāvṛṭśaratkāladivāṃ je || 6 - 3 - 15 || 
e prāvṛṭśaradoḥ pṛthaggrahaṇātkāleti svarupagrahaṇam || 
eghakālataneṣu kālanāmnaḥ || 6 - 3 - 17 || 
e gha iti taraptamaporgrahaṇam| kāla iti svarupagrahaṇ, tana iti
ṭa|luṭa|lulorādeśasya satuṭkasya grahaṇam | 
epūrvāhṇetanamiti | saptamyarthaprakarṣe pratyaḥ,
tasyādravyaprakarṣatvādalukpakṣe, kimetiṅvyayaghāt ityāmupratyayaḥ |
lukpakṣe tu nimitābhāvādadravyaprakarṣe'pyāmabhāvaḥ | tarabantāt
saptamī | kvacitu - alukpakṣe'pi saptamī samudāyātpaṭha|lte, tatra
prakṛtyarthavivakṣayā adravyaprakarṣe iti pratiṣedho vyākhyeyaḥ | pūrvahṇe
iti | vibhāṣā pūrvahṇāparāhṇābhyām iti ṭa|luṭa|lulau,
anādeśāstuṭ ca | 
e kathaṃ punarghatanapratyayamātre'luk udāhṛtaḥ, yāvatā
pratyayagrahakaṇavaribhāṣayā tadanta utarapade'lugudārartavyaḥ ata āha -
utarapadādhikāra iti | kuta ityāha | lekhagrahaṇāditi | yadayam
hṛdayasya hṛllekhayadaṇalāseṣu ityaṇgrahaṇe kriyamāṇe lekhagrahaṇaṃ
karoti, tajjhāpayati - notarapadādhikāre pratyayagrahaṇe
tadantavidhirbhavatīti | yadi syāt, lekhagarhaṇaṃ na kuryāt aṇanta
ityeva siddhatvāt | nanu ca ghañarthaṃ lekhagarhaṇaṃ syāt, na vai ghañanta
iṣyate | kāleti na svarupagrahaṇamiti | nāmagrahaṇāt | kvacinnañ na
paṭha|lte, tatra ghakāle svarupagrahaṇamityarthaḥ || 
e śayavāsavāsiṣvakālāt || 6 - 3 - 18 || 
e atrākāla ityarthagarhaṇ, vyākhyānāt | tadāhākālavācina iti |
khaśaya iti | adhikaraṇe śeteḥ ityac | vāsa iti | ghañ |
grāmevāsīti | supyajātau ṇiniḥ | 
e apo yonītyādi | śabdapradhānatvādapa ityekavacanam, yoniḥ -
utpattiḥ apsuyoniryasya so'msuyoniḥ | apsavya iti | orguṇaḥ,
vānto yi pratyaye | apsumantāviti |
saptamyantāntupo'sambhavādapsviti śabdo yayorasti tāvapsumantau
kārīryāmājyabhāgau, tayorhi apsvagne sadhiṣṭavaḥ, apsu me somo
abravīt, ityanuvākyayorapsuśabdo'sti | yadyevam,
anukaraṇatvādasyavāmīyādivallugana bhaviṣyatīti kiṃ matubgrahaṇena
anya tu matiśabdaṃ paṭhanti, udārahanti - atra somo vāpsumatiriti
tatu bhāṣye na dṛṣṭam || 
e nentsiddhabadhnātiṣu ca || tatpuruṣe kṛti bahulam iti prāptaṃ
pratiṣidhyate, saptamyāṃḥ parasyāḥ parasya
kevalasyeno'sambhavādutarapadādhikāre'pi pratyayagrahaṇe
tadantavidhirityāha - innanta utarapada iti | sthaṇḍilavartīti | vrate iti
ṇiniḥ | upapadasamāsaḥ | sāṅkāśayasiddha iti | siddhaśuṣkapakvabandhaiśca
iti samāsaḥ | cārabaddha thaiti | baddhaśabdo niṣṭhāntaḥ | yogavibhāgāt
samāsa iti | baddhaśabdena | 
e taditi | bandha ityeva śabdarupam | atha dhañantaḥ kasmānna bhavati tatrāha
dhañante hīti | atha vā - pacādyajante ca bandhe ca vibhāṣā ityayaṃ
vikalpaḥ kasmānna bhavati ityata āha - dhañante hīti || 
e sthe ca bhāṣāyām || 6 - 3 - 20 || 
e ākhareṣṭha iti | sthaḥ ka ca iti kaḥ || 
eṣaṣṭha|la ākrośe || 6 - 3 - 21 || 
epaśyatohara iti | ṣaṣṭhī cānādare iti ṣaṣṭhī, paśyantamanādṛtya
haratītyarthaḥ | 
e śunaḥ śepa iti | ākāranto'pyasti śepaśabdaḥ na kevalaṃ sakārāntaḥ
| śuna iva śepamasyeti bahuvrīhiḥ | evaṃ pucchalāṅgūlābhyāmapi
bahuvrīhiḥ | ṛṣiviśeṣāṇāmetāḥ saṃjñāḥ || 
eṛto vidyāyonisambandhebhyaḥ || 6 - 3 - 23 || 
e vidyā ca yoniśca vidyāyonī, abhyarhitatvādvidyāyāḥ pūrvanipātaḥ,
tatkṛtaḥ sambandho yeṣāṃ te vidyāyonisambandhāḥ, kṛtaśabdo
gamyamānatvānna prayujyate | pituḥputra iti | prakhyātātpiturutpanna
ityarthaḥ | 
e vidyāyonisambandhebhyaḥ pūrvotarapadagrahaṇamiti | sūtre
pañcamīnirdeśātpūrvapadānāmeva vidyāyonisambandhavāvitvaṃ labhyate,
notarapadānām atha saptamīnirdeśaḥ kriyate | utarapadānāmeva
labhyate, na pūrvapadānām | tasmādubhayeṣāmapi tadvācitve'yaṃ
vidhiriti vaktavyamityarthaḥ | anyavṛttiparatvāccāsya teṣāṃ
parasparavyatikare'pi bhavati - hotuḥ putraḥ, piturantevāsīti || 
e ānaṅ ṛto dvandve || 6 - 3 - 25 || 
e atra yadyaḥkārasya dvandve ānaṅ bhavatītyavaṃ vijñāyeta,
pitṛpitāmahādapyāṅ syāt ṛtaḥ tyeticcānarthakaṃ prakṛtatvāt,
tasmād dvandvaviśepaṇamṛta iti | jātau cedamekavacanamiti manyamāna
āha - ṛkārāntānāmityādi| iha kāryārthaḥ śravaṇārtho vā
varṇānāmupadeśaḥ, nakāraścāyaṃ na kvacit śrūyate sarvatra nalopaḥ
prātipadikāntasya iti nalopena bhavitavyam, kāryamapi cāsya na
kiñcidupadiśyate, tasmānnārtha etena ityata āha -
nakāroñcāraṇamityādi | asati nakāre uḥ sthāne'ṇeva śiṣyate iti
uraṇ raparaḥ iti raparatvaṃ syāt, tasmiśca nyamaṇeva śiṣyate, kiṃ
tarhi thāṇ cānyacceti, nāsti raparatvaprasaṅgaḥ |
tasmādraparatvanivṛtyarthaṃ nakāroccāraṇam | ṅkāraḥ ṅcci
ityantyādeśārthaḥ | yatra ca nirdiśyamānaṃ kāryiṇo viśeṣaṇam, tatra
nirdiśyamānasyādeśā bhavantītyetadbhavati, nātra ṛtaḥ iti kāryiṇo
viśeṣaṇam, kiṃ tarhi dvandvasya viśeṣaṇam | putra ityatrānuvartata iti
| putre'nyatarasyām ityataḥ | yadyatra putra thaiti vartate, vibhāṣā
svasṛpatyoḥ ityatrānuvarteta, tataśca bhrātuṣputra ityādāvanākrośe'pi
vikalpaprasaṅgaḥ evaṃ tarhi vyākhyānādatraiva sambadhyate, ata eva
hyatretyuktam | evamapi putra utarapade pūrvapadamātrasyānaṅ prapnoti,
kāryiṇo'nirdeśāt, ṛtaḥ iti śrutasya dvandvaviśeṣamatvādata tāaha -
ṛta iti ceti | anuvartate ityuṣaṅgaḥ | ñatovidyāyoni ityataḥ
ñataḥ ityanuvartate, tatkāryiṇaṃ viśeṣayiṣyatītyarthaḥ | yadyapi tat
pañcamyantam, tathāpi tadiha vyākhyānātṣaṣṭha|lntaṃ vipariṇamyate || 
edevatādvandve ca || 6 - 3 - 26 || 
e anṛkārantārthamavidyāyonisambandhārthaṃ vacanam| dvandva iti vartamāna
ityādi | prakṛtaṃ dvandvagrahaṇaṃ 
esamāsaviśeṣapratipatyartham, idaṃ prasiddhaṃ sāhacaryaṃ yasya yugalasya
tatparigrahartham | kathaṃ punarna parigrahaḥ taityata āha atyantasahacārata
ityādi | dvandvaṃ rahasyamaryādā
ityatrābhivyaktigrahaṇenātyantasahacaritayugale dvandva iti nipātyate,
tasyātra grahaṇaṃ devatāpadena, samastaṃ cedamprakṛtasya
dvandvasyārthadvārakaṃ viśeṣaṇam - atyantasahacaritayugalābhidhāyini
dvandva iti yāvat | sāhacaryameva viśinaṣṭi - tatreti | sahavāpaḥ -
sahanirvāpaḥ | agnīṣomābhyāṃ juṣṭṃa nirvapāmi ityādi | ubhayatreti
| pūrvapatvenotarapadatvenetyarthaḥ || 
e id vṛddhau || 6 - 3 - 28 || 
e atra vṛddhimadutarapadaṃ vṛddhiśabdenocyate,
vṛddhyātmakasyotarapadatyāsambhavāt | agnīvaruṇau devate asya,
agnāmarutau devate asyoti vigrahaḥ, pūrvatretvam, utaratrānaṅ |
dvyadhiṣṭhānaṃ devatātvamiti | devatetyekavacanam | ānaṅmītvaṃ ca
bādhitumiti | varuṇe hītvasya prasaṅgaḥ, anyatrānaṅḥ | yadyapi prāg
vṛddhevigrahavākya evānaṅītvayoḥ prasaṅgaḥ,
tathāpyapavādaviṣayatvātprakriyāvākye na kriyete, laukike tu vākye
bhavata eva | 
e idvṛddhau viṣṇoḥ pritiṣedhaḥ - āgnāvaiṣṇavamekādaśakapālaṃ
nirvapet || 
e divasaśca pṛthivyām || 6 - 3 - 30 || 
e divasaḥ iti prathamāntam | akāroccāraṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā
prayojanābhāvātsakārasyetsaṃjñā na bhaviṣyati tatrāha -
akārīñcāraṇamiti | asati tasmin pṛthivīśabde parataḥ sakārasya
rutvam, visarjanīyaḥ, kupvoḥ - ka - pau ca ityete vikārāḥ
prāpnuvanti, akāre sati sakārasyoccāraṇaṃ bhavati, tena
prayoge'syāvikṛtasyaiva grahaṇaṃ bhavati | 
e kathamityādi | dvandve ityanuvṛtervākye naiva prāpnotīti praśnaḥ |
kartavyī'tra yatna iti | chāndaso'yaṃ prayogaḥ, dṛṣṭānuvidhaścchandasi
ityeṣo'tra yatnaḥ | 
e uṣāsoṣasaḥ || 6 - 3 - 31 || 
e uṣāsānakteti | chāndaso'yaṃ prayogaḥ | uṣāśca naktaṃ ceti dvandvaḥ,
prathamādvivacanasya ḍādeśaḥ | atra padakāle padakāle padakārāḥ -
uṣasānakteti hrasvamadhīyate || 
e striyāḥ puṃvadbhāṣitapuṃskādanūṅ samānādhikaraṇe
striyāmapūraṇīpriyādiṣu || 6 - 3 - 34 || 
e atra trayaḥ pakṣāḥ sambhavanti - striyā iti srīpratyayagrahaṇam,
arthagrahaṇam śabdagrahaṇaṃ ceti | tatra yadi srīgrahaṇaṃ svaryate,
svaritenādikārāvagatirbhavatīti stryadhikāravihitāṣṭābādayo
gṛhyanta, yathā - gosriyorupasarjanasya ityatra tadā cāyamartho bhavati -
bhāṣitapuṃskātpare ṭābādisrīpratyayā yathā puṃsi na bhavanti tathā
utarapade na bhavantīti | nanvaśrutakriyāpadesu vākyeṣu
bhavatītyadhyāhāro'nyatra dṛṣṭaḥ ucyate vatinirdeśeṣūpamāne satā,
asatā vā yā prasiddhā sopameye'tideśyā yathā - uśīnaravanmadreṣu
yavāḥ santi, na santīti tataḥ puṃsi
srīpratyayasyābhāvātsriyāmapyabhāvo'tidiśyata iti na bhaviṣyatityeva
vākyaśeṣaḥ parikalpanīyaḥ, tadā tvanūṅtyinena sāmānādhikaraṇyāt
sriyāḥ iti prathamārthe ṣaṣṭhī, puṃvaditi saptamīsamarthādvatiḥ | tatra ca
prageva samāsādvigraddavākya eva srīpratyayasya kṛtatvānna tasyotarapade
parataḥ na kroḍādibahvacaḥ itivat pragabhāvaḥ śakyaḥ
pratipādayitumiti luk taddhitaluki ityādivatkṛtasya nivṛttireva
pratipādyā | vigrahavākya eva kṛtāḥ srīpratyayā utarapade parato
nivartante, lupyanta ityarthaḥ | 
e yadā tu puṃvat srītvayuktaṃ dravyaṃ srīśabdenocyate, tadārthagrahaṇaṃ
bhavati, sriyāḥ stryarthasya puṃsa iti pumarthasyevala kāryaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ
| tadā ca ṣaṣṭhīsamārthādvatiḥ | yadā tu stryarthavācī śabdaḥ
srīśabdenocyate tadā śabdagrahaṇam, sriyāḥ - srīliṅgasya śabdasya
puṃvad rupaṃ bhavatīti rupatideśaḥ, vṛttiviṣaye puṃśabdasambandhinaḥ
kāryasyātideṣṭavyasyābhāvāt | tatra ca pratyāsateḥ puṃbhāvabhājaḥ
srīśabdasya prayogāntare pumāṃsamācakṣāṇasya yadrūpaṃ
tadevātidiśyate, na yasya kasyacit | 
e anūṅ iti ṣaṣṭha|lrthe prathamā, tatrārthagrahaṇe srīśabde mukhyaḥ | arthasya
tūtarapadena paurvāparyamanūṅḥ, tatvaṃ ca svato'nupannamiti
śabdadvārakamāśrayaṇīyam | itrayostu pakṣayoḥ strīśabdo gauṇaḥ |
paurvāparyādikaṃ tu samañcasamiti na pramāṇataḥ pakṣaviśeṣaparigrahaḥ
sambhavatīti nirdoṣataḥ pakṣaḥ parigrahyaḥ | 
e tatrādye pakṣe etabhārya ityetaśabdād varṇādanudātāt iti ṅīpi
takārasya ca nakāre
ekadeśāvikṛtasyānanyatvādetaśabdādbhāṣitapuṃskātpara īkāra iti
tannivṛtāvapyarthasya strītvamanivṛtamiti nakāraḥ śrūyeta | na ca
sanniyogaśiṣṭatvādīkāranivṛtau nakārasya nivatiḥ,
utarapadanimitāyāḥ strīpratyayanivṛternakāranivṛtyākhye pūrvavidhau
sthānikadbhāve satyanyatarābhāvasyāsiddheḥ | na ca nakārasyāpi
adikāravihitatvādikāravatpuṃvadbhāvenaiva nivṛttiḥ tasya
bhāṣitapuṃskātparatvābhāvāt, apratyayatvenoṅasādṛśyābhāvācca |
tathā paṭhvī bhāryāsya paṭuavī bhāryāsya paṭuabhārya iti nivṛtasyāpi
srīpratyayasya sthānivadbhāvādyaṇādeśaḥ syāt | 
e atha tūtarapade parato'nūṅ strīpratyayo bhāṣitapuṃskānna bhavatīti
na kroḍādibahṇacaḥ itivat prāgabhāva evātra vidheyaḥ tatsāmarthyācca
vigrahavākya taeva prāpto'ntāraṅgo'pi strīpratyayo na kriyate
ityucyeta tadaitaddoṣābhāve'pi lugalugastrīviṣayadvistrīpratyayeṣu
doṣaḥ | luk - vataṇḍasyāpatyaṃ strī vataṇḍācca luk striyām,
śārṅgaravādipāṭhānṅīn, vataṇḍī cāsauvṛndārikā ca
vātaṇḍa|lvṛndāriketi puṃvat karmadhāraya iti ikārasya nivṛtāvapi
arthagatasya strītvasyānivṛtatvāt luk striyamā iti yaño
lukprāpnoti | syādetat - strī - ī strīti īkārapraśleṣeṇa striyāṃ
ya īkārastatra parato lopaḥ, atra tu
puṃvadbhāvenekārasyānutpannatvālluṅ na bhaviṣyatīti tanna,
itretarāśrayaprasaṅgāt | katham śārṅgaravādiṣu vataṇḍaśabdaḥ
kṛtayañluk paṭha|lte, tataścākṛte luki īkāro nāsti, akṛte
cekāre luko'prasaṅgaḥ | aluk - gargasyāpatyaṃ striyaḥ,
gargādibhyo yañ yañaśca iti ṅīp , gārgyaśca tā vṛndārikāśta
gargavṛndārikā iti ṅīpi nivṛte'pi strītvasyānivṛtatvād
yañañośca striyāmiti lugna prāpnoti, vākyavadalugeva syāt |
astrīviṣayaḥ - kuñjasyāpatyaṃ strī gotre kuñjādibhyaścaphañ, gotraṃ ca
caraṇaiḥ saha iti jātitvān ṅīṣ, kauñjāyanī cāsau vṛndārikā
ca kauñjāyanavṛndārikāḥ ṅīṣi nivṛte'pi strītvasyānivṛteḥ
vrātacphañorastriyām ityastrīviṣayo na syāt | dvistrīpratyayaḥ -
gargasyāpatyaṃ strī gargādibhyo yañ, prācāṃ ṣpha taddhitaḥ, ṣillakṣaṇo
ṅīṣ, gārgyāyaṇī cāsau vṛndārikā ca gārgyavṛndāriketyādau
yatra dvau strīpratyayau tatra yo bhāṣitapuṃskātparaḥ ṣpho
nāsāvutarapade, ṅīṣā vyāvadhānāt| yaścotarapade ṅīṣ nāsau
bhāṣitapuṃskātparaḥ, ṣpheṇa vyavadhānāt, tasya ca striyāmeva
vihitatvāt iti puṃvadbhāva eva na syāt | tathā iḍaviḍo'patyaṃ
strī janapadaśabdātkṣatriyādañ darado'patyaṃ strī dvyañmagadha
ityaṇ, tayoḥ ataśca iti luk - iḍaviḍadarat, sa cāsau
vṛndārikā ca aiḍavivṛndārikā - atra puṃvadbhāvo na syāt
adhikāravihitasya kasyacitpratyasyābhāvāt | 
e dvitīye tu pakṣe'rthasya pumarthatve'tidiṣṭe tadvācī śabdaḥ pravartata
iti naite doṣāḥ, kintu khityanavyayasya iti hrasvatvasyāsya
puṃvadbhāvasya vipratiṣedho nopapadyate bhannaviṣayatvāt | aco
hrasvatvamarthasya puṃvadbhāvaḥ, tataḥ kālimmanyetyatra vipratiṣedhe
param itihrasvatvamiṣṭam, tanna prapnoti | śabdapakṣe tu
dvayorapyekaviṣayatvādvipratiṣedho'sti, puṃvadbhāvasyāvakāśaḥ, yatra
khidantaṃ nāsti - darghanīyabhāryaḥ, hrasvatvasyāvakāraśo yatra
puṃvadbhāvo nāsti - kālimmanyaḥ pumāniti kālimmanyā
strītyatrobhayaprasaṅge paratvād hrasvatvaṃ bhavati | na ca kṛte'pi
hrasvatve punaḥ prasaṅgavijñānātpuṃvadbhāvaprasaṅgaḥ,
sakṛdgatinyāyasyāśrayaṇāt | na
cārthapakṣe'pyasatyapyekaviṣayatve'sambhavādvipratiṣedhaḥ,
asambhavādityasyaivāsiddheḥ | yadyapi hi puṃvadbhāve sati strīpratyayasya
nivṛtau dīrghāntatvābhāvād hrasvasyāpravṛttiḥ, tathāpi hrasve
pravṛte'pyarthasyānivṛtatvātpuṃvadbhāvaḥ prāpnotyeva | 
e tadevamādyayorduṣṭatvātṛtīyaṃ pakṣmāśrityāha - bhāṣitaḥ
pumānyenetyādi | bhāṣitaḥ pumānyena śabdeneti śabde'nyapadārthe
bahuvrīhirāśrīyate, tataḥ striyāṃ puṃsi ca vartamānasya yasya
pravṛttinimitaṃ bhidyate, tasyāpi prāpnoti - droṇībhāryaḥ, pātrībhārya
iti | droṇaśabdaḥ parimāṇe puṃlliṅgaḥ,
pātraśabdo'rddharcāditvātparimāṇe puṃlliṅgaḥ, bhājanaviśeṣe tu
strīliṅgaḥ, sarvatrāpyatra pravṛttinimitabhede'pi ya eva prayogāntare
pumāṃsamākhyat, sa eva samprati striyāṃ vartata iti syādeva
puṃvadbhāva iti matvā viśinaṣṭi - samānāyāmākṛtāviti |
bhāṣyagrahantho'yam, ato vyācaṣṭe - ekasminpravṛttinimita iti | sa
bhāṣitapuṃskaḥ 
eśabdaḥ, ayaṃ tāvadartho vivakṣita ityarthaḥ | yathā punarayamarthaḥ
sūtrākṣaraireva labhyate, tathā pṛcchati - tadetadevamityādi |
tadetadartharupam evamprakāraṃ kathaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ |
pravṛttinimitalakṣaṇe'nyapadārthe saptamyarthe bahuvrīhirityutaram |
etaduktaṃ bhavati - yasminpiravṛttinimite pumān bhāṣitaḥ
pumāsamācakṣāṇasya yatpravṛttinimitaṃ tena yuktaṃ stryarthamāckṣāṇo
bhāṣitapuṃska iti | 
e nanvevamapi droṇībhārya ityādau doṣaḥ syadeva, katham yasyāṃ
gavādanyāṃ droṇīśabdo vartate, so'pi yadā artha ityucyate tadā
bhāṣitapuṃskena pravṛttinimitena yujyate, tatra cārthaṃ
śabdapravṛttinimitamapyarthyamānatvād gavādanyāṃ sannihitamiti tatra
vartamāno drotathaṇīśabdaḥ svayaṃ tatpravṛttinimitamanabhidadhāno'pi
vastutastadyauktamarthamāha naitadasti, evaṃ hi bhāṣitapuṃskagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ
syāt sarvatra sulabhatvāt | ato yaḥ śabdo bhāṣitapuṃsakena
pravṛttinimitena yuktaṃ svārthaṃ tenaiva rupeṇāha, na rupāntareṇa, sa
bhāṣitapuṃsko gṛhyate | droṇīśabdastu droṇītvajātiyuktena rupeṇa
gavādanyāṃ vartate, nārthyamānatayā | 
e evamapi dyaurbhāryā yasya dyaubhārya ityatra divyaśabdasya strīliṅsya
svarga iti puṃlliṅgaḥ prāpnoti, yenaiva rupeṇa
svargaśabdenocyate, tenaiva rupeṇa divśabdenāpīti kṛtvā evaṃ
tarhi pratyāsateryaṃsya puṃvadbhāvo vidhīyate, tenaiva yatra pumān
bhāṣita iti vijñāyate, ātmanaḥ prayogāntare pumāṃsamācakṣāṇasya
yatpravṛttinimitaṃ tadyauktaṃ stryartham, sampratyācakṣāṇasya strīśabdasya
pumbhāṣaṇadaśāyāṃ yadrū paṃ tadevādyāpi bhāvatītyarthaḥ |
ātideśikabhedācca puṃvaditi vatinirdeśaḥ | 
e anūṅiti paryudāse sati nañivayuktanyāyena ūṅsadṛśasya
ṭābādergrahaṇādaiḍaviḍavṛndāriketyādau strīpratyayābhāvānna
syāditi prasajyapratiṣedhaṃ darśayati - ūṅe'bhāvo'nūṅiti |
bhāṣitapuṃskādanūṅiti | yadyayamasamāsaḥ syāt - anūṅiti, tadā
prathamā syāt, luptaṣaṣṭhīkaṃ vā | ṣaṣṭhīpakṣe'yamartho bhavati -
bhāṣitapuṃskātparasya strīśabdasyeva rupaṃ bhavati, ūṅntasya tu neti |
tataśca puṃvadbhāvabhājaḥ strīśabdasya bhāṣitapuṃskatvaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ na
syāt, tatra ko doṣaḥ iha ca prasajyeta - aṅgārakā nāma śakunayaḥ
teṣāṃ kālikāḥ striyaḥ tata etāḥ kālikāvṛndārikā iti |
etacchabdādbhāṣitapuṃskātparaḥ kālikāśabda iti tasya
strīviṣayasyāpyaṅgārakaśabdatā syāt| śakyante hi tāḥ
sāhacaryādaṅgārakaśabdenābhidhātum | tathā aśvasya vaḍavā, puruṣasya
yoṣit, haṃsasya varaṭā, kacchapasya ḍulītyādāvapi prasaṅgaḥ |
darśanīyabhārya ityādau ca na syāt, na hyatra darśanīyaśabdo
bhāṣitapuṃskātparaḥ | prathamāyāṃ tu bhāṣitapuṃskādityanena
sāmānādhikaraṇyātstriyā iti pañcamī ṣaṣṭha|laṃ
kasyacidarthasyāsambhavāt | tataśca bhāṣitapuṃskāt strīliṅgātpara
ūṅe'nyaḥ pratyayaḥ puṃvadityartho bhavati, tatra sa eva doṣo yaḥ
prathamapakṣe | tadevaṃ samāse deṣaprasaṅgādvyadhikāraṇapado
bahuvrīhirāśrayaṇīya ityāha - bhāṣitapuskādanūṅtyāidi | ālukca
nipātanātpañcamyā iti | alaukikatvādasya nipātanādityaparihāraḥ |
lugapi tarhi na prāpnoti alaukikatvādeveti yatkiñcadetat |
anūṅ īti ṣaṣṭha|lrathe prathamā, tadāyamarthe'vasthitaḥ -
bhāṣitapuskātsvasmādūṅe'bhāvo yasmin | ko'rthaḥ yasmin
strīśabde bhāṣipuṃskātpara uṅna kṛta ityartha taiti | apara āha -
bhāṣitapuṃskāditi ṣaṣṭha|lrthe pañcamī, sarvamanyatpūrvavat |
bhāṣitapuṃskasya strīśabdasya puṃśabdasyeva rupaṃ bhavati, 
eūṅntasya tu neti | 
e nanvevamāśrīyamāṇe yatra bhāṣitapuskasyaivānantaramutarapadaṃ tatraiva
syāt darśanīyabaya ityādau, atra hi bhāṣitapuṃskasya
darśanīyaśabdasya ṭāpaścaikādeśaḥ pūrvaṃ
pratyantavadbhāvādbhāṣitapuṃskagrahaṇena gṛhyate, gārgī cāsau
vṛndārikā ca gārgyavṛndāriketyādau na syāt, yo'tra
bhāṣitapuṃsko gārgyaśabdo na tasyānantaramutarapadam ṅīpā
vyavadhānāt | yasya cānantaraṃ gārgīśabdasya nāsau bhāṣitapuṃskaḥ
syādetadevam, prayogāntare bhāṣitapuṃskasya samprati striyāṃ
vartamānasya puṃvadbhāva ucyeta | striyāṃ vartamānasya tadaiva
bhāṣitapuṃskasya puṃvadbhāvaṃ brūmaḥ, sambhavati ca strīyāṃ vartamānasya
tadaiva bhāṣitapuṃskatvaṃ bhāṣitapuṃskena pravṛttinimitena yuktāṃ
striyamāheti kṛtvā | evaṃ ca strīśabdasyaivāntara utarapade
puṃvadbhāva iti sarvatra sidhyati | 
e grāmaṇi dṛṣṭirasyeti | atra grāmaṇiśabdo'parityaktasvaliṅga taeva
dṛṣṭiśabdena samānādhikaraṇo bhavati 
e| atra yadi puṃvadbhāvaḥ syānnapuṃsakahrasvatvaṃ nivartetaḥ 
e kathamityādi | anavayavabhūtagarbhasambandhaḥ striyāṃ garbhiṇīśabdasya
pravṛttinimitam, puṃsi tvavayavabhūtagarbhasambandhaḥ | prasūta -
prajātaśabdayorapi striyāṃ garbhamocananimitama,
puṃsitugarbhādhānam | kartavyo'tra yatna iti |
antarvartivastusambandhamātraṃ garbhiṇīśabdasya
pravṛttinimitamavayavatvānavayavatvena tantram | evaṃ
prasūtaprajātaśabdayorapi ādhānavimocanatyāgenāpatyasambandhamātraṃ
nimitamāśrīyata ityayamatra yatnaḥ | 
ebrahmabandhūbhārya iti | ūṅe nivṛttirna bhavati | na kopadhāyāḥ
ityatraivoṅgrahaṇe kartavye pṛthakpratiṣedhādasya vailatraṇyaṃ jñayate |
tena brahmabandhūvṛndariketi puṃvatkarmadhāraya iti niṣedhavipaye
vidhīyamāno'pi puṃvadbhāvo na bhavati | eṣa cārtho'nūṅtyisya
tatrānuvṛterlabhyate | apūraṇīpriyādiṣvityayaṃ tu pratiṣedhastatraiva
kartavyaḥ, na hyasya puṃvatkarmadhāraya ityatrānuvṛttiriṣyate mahānavamī,
mahādvādaśī, akṣayatṛtīyā, kṛṣṇacaturdasītyādau pūraṇyāmapi
karmadhāraye puṃvadbhāvasyeṣṭatvāt | 
e pradhānapūraṇīgrahaṇaṃ kartavyamiti | pradhānaṃ yā pūraṇī tasyāmeva
pratiṣedho bhavatīti vaktavyamityarthaḥ | evacca pradhāne
kāryasampratyayāllabhyate | kalyāṇapañcamīkaḥ pakṣa iti | atra
tirohitāvayavabhedaḥ pakṣo'nyapadārtha iti tatra pūraṇyā
ananupraveśānnāsti prādhānyam, kalyāṇapañcamā rātraya
ityādāvudbhūtāvayavabhedā rātramo'nyapadārthaḥ, tatra yathā rātrayaḥ
samāsābhidheyā, evaṃ pañcamyapīti pūraṇyāḥ prādhānyam | 
e atha dṛḍhabhaktiḥ, śobhanabhaktirityatra kathaṃ puṃvadbhāvaḥ, yāvatā
priyādiṣu bhaktiśabdaḥ paṭha|lte ata āha - dṛḍhabhaktirityevamādiṣviti |
strīvācitvaṃ pūrvapadasyāvivakṣitam, ato
dṛḍhabhaktirityevamādisiddhirityevaṃ codyasamādhānaṃ kartavyamityarthaḥ |
dṛḍhaśabdo'tra dāḍha|lÇnivṛttiparaḥ, tatra dāḍha|lÇnivṛttiparāyāṃ
codanāyāṃ strīliṅgopādānamakiñcitkaramiti bhāvaḥ | na caivaṃ
sūtrasyānādaraṇīyatvam, liṅgaviśeṣavivakṣāyāṃ darśanīyabhārya
ityādyaniṣṭaprasaṅgāt | atheha kathaṃ bhavitavyam - paṭvīmṛdvyau
bhārye asyeti, paṭvīmṛdubhārya iti bhavitavyam
yasyotarapadamanantaraṃ tasya puṃvadbhāvo netarasyeti || 
etasilādiṣvākṛtvasucaḥ || 6 - 3 - 35 || 
e anutarapadārthamāsambhaḥ | tatastatreti | prāgdiśo vibhaktiḥ iti
vibhaktitvātyadādyatvam, ṭāp, anena puṃvadbhāvaḥ | 
e iha kecitasilādiṣu paṭha|lnte, yeṣu puṃvadbhāvo neṣyate,
keciccānyatra paṭha|lnte, yeṣu puṃvadbhāva iṣyate, tasmādāha -
parigaṇanamiti | tratasorudāhṛtam | taraptamapo darśanīyatarā,
darśanīyatamā | caraṭjātīyaroḥ paṭuacarī, paṭuajītīyā |
kalpadeśīyaroḥ - darśanīyakalpā, darśanīyadeśīyā | deśyapratyayasya
nāsti pāṭhaḥ | rupappāśapoḥ darśanīyarupā, paṭuapāśā | thamthāloḥ -
idamasthamuḥ, kimaśca iti vihitasthamuḥ, prakāravacane thāl anayā
prakṛtyā ittham, kayā prakṛtyā katham, tayā tathā | dārhiloḥ - tasyāṃ
velāyāṃ tadā, tarhi | tilthyanoḥ - vṛkajyeṣṭābhyāṃ tiltātilau
cacchandasi, vṛkī praśastā vṛkatiḥ | tātilo nāsiti pāṭhaḥ |
ajāvibhyāṃ thyan ajāyai hitā ajathyā | atra gharupakalpeṣu ṅyantasya
paratvāt hrasvaḥ - paṭivatamā, paṭivakalpā, paṭivarupā | 
e śasi bahūlpārthasyeti | bahvalpārthāt ityayamapi śas
tasilādiṣu draṣṭavya ityarthaḥ | 
e ṅastikamiti | yadyatra puṃvadbhāvo na syat, tadā hastinīśabdasya
yastetilope kṛte tasya sthānivatvād asiddhavadatrābhāt
ityasiddhatvācca nastaddhite iti ṭilopo na syāditi puṃbadbhāvo
vidhīyate | ṭhakcchasośca ityenana puṃpadbhāvo na labhyate cchasā
sahacaritasya ṭhako grahaṇāt | śyaineyaḥ, rohiṇeya iti |
śyetarohitābhyām varṇādanudātāt iti | ṅībnakārau | atra
puṃvadbhāve sati - śyaiteyaḥ, rauhiteya iti syāt | 
e kathamityādi | yadi ḍhea puṃvadbhāvaḥ pratiṣidhyate, tato'gneḥ srī
vṛṣākapyagnikusitakusidānāmudātaḥ iti agniśabdān ṅīpi kṛte
aikāre āyādeśe ca agnāyī, sa devatāsya agnerḍhak iti,
sarvatrāgnikalibhyāṃ ḍhak iti ḍhaki puṃvadbhāvanipedhādāgnāyeya
iti prāpnoti, tatkathamāgneya iti kartavyo'tra yatna iti |
kecidāhuḥ - aḍhea ityapanīyānapatya iti vaktavyam | idamapi siddhaṃ
bhavati - kuṇḍinyā apatyamiti gargādibhyo yañ, tatra
puṃvadbhāvābhāvādyasyeti lope tasya sthānivadbhāvāt nastaddhite
ityasati ṭilope kauṇḍinya iti bhavati, 
epuṃvadbhāve tu sati kauṇḍa|l iti prāpnoti | tathā sapatnyā apatyaṃ
śivāditvādaṇ, tatra puṃvadbhāvābhāvāt sāpatna iti bhavati,
puṃvadbhāve tu sati nityaṃ sapatnyādiṣu iti
vihitayorṅībnakārayonivṛtayoḥ sāpata iti syāt | tadevam,
anapatye iti vacanād ḍhea'pyanapatye puṃvadbhavati sa āgneya iti |
apatye tu na bhavati - śyaineyaḥ, rauhiṇeya iti | yadyanapatya
ityucyate, gargasyāpatyaṃ strī gārgyāyaṇī, tasyā apatyam gotrasriyāḥ
kutsane ṇa ca iti ṇapratyaye kṛte puṃvadbhāvo na prāpnoti, tataśca
gārgyayaṇo jālma iti syāt, gārgyo jālma iti ceṣyate,
tasmādanapatya iti na śakyaṃ vaktum| kathaṃ kauṇḍinyaḥ
āgastyakauṇḍinyayoḥ iti nipātanāt siddham | kathaṃ sāpatnaḥ
śatruparyāyaḥ sapatnaśabdo'stiḥ vyansapatne iti liṅgāt | sa
śārṅgaravādiṣu paṭhitavyaḥ, tataḥ śivādyaṇ, tasmāt strībhyoḍhak
ityatraiva puṃvadbhāvapratiṣedha iti vyākhyānamevātra śaraṇam | 
e ṭhakcchasoriti | cchasaḥ sitvāt siti ca iti
padasaṃjñāvidhānādbhatvābhāvād vacanam, ṭhagrahaṇaṃ kimartham,
ikādeśe kṛte bhasyāḍhea ityeva siddhe ṭhāvasthāyāmeva yathā syāt
kimevaṃ sati bhavati isusuktāntātkaḥ iti kādeśāḥ siddho bhavati
anyathā yadīkādeśe kṛte puṃvadbhāvaḥ syāt, tato yathā māthitika
ityatrekādeśe kṛte kādeśo na bhavati, evaṃ bhāvatka ityatrāpi na
syāt || 
ekyaṅmāninośca || 6 - 3 - 36 || 
e ayamasyāḥ, iyamasyā iti vaiyadhikaraṇyapradarśanārthamidamuktam |
pūrvaṇeva siddhamiti | ekasyā eva karmatvātkartṛtvācca
sāmānādhikaraṇyasyābhāvāt || 
e na kopadhāyā || 6 - 3 - 37 || 
e madreṣu bhavā madrikā, vṛjikā, madravṛjyoḥ kan | vailepikamiti
| aṇmahiṣyādibhyaḥ, atra bhāsyāḍhea taddhite 
eiti hyāipasaṃkhyānikī prāptiḥ pratiṣiddhyate | pūrveṣu tu sautrī |
taddhitavuyagrahaṇamiti | taddhitasya yaḥ kakāraḥ vośca yaḥ kakāraḥ
tasyeti vaktavyamityarthaḥ | pākabhārya iti | pākaśabdaḥ
prathamavayovācī, tato ṅībapavādo'jāditvāṭṭāp || 
esaṃjñāpūraṇyośca || 6 - 3 - 38 || 
e saṃjñāśabdā ye dānādikriyānibhitāḥ puṃsi ca striyāṃ ca loke
prayujyante tadarthaḥ saṃjñāpratiṣedhaḥ | ye tvekadravyanimitā
deśanimitā vā saṃjñāśabdāstatrābhāṣitapuṃskatvādevāprasaṅgaḥ |
datāyate, guptāyate iti | atra yadyapi satyasati vā pratiṣedhe
viṣeṣābhāvaḥ, tathāpi vastutaḥ pratiṣedhasyaca viṣaya
ityetāvatā'syopanyāsaḥ || 
evṛddhinimitasya ca taddhitasyāraktavikāre || 6 - 3 - 39 || 
e vṛddhenimitaṃ ṇakāraḥ | iha nimitagrahaṇaṃ na kartavyam,
vṛddhestaddhitasya ityeva vaktavyam - vṛddheryastaddhitaḥ, kaśca
vṛddhestaddhitaḥ yastasyā nimitamevaṃ siddhe
nimitagrahaṇādvyadhikaraṇapado bahuvrīhiḥ | apara āha -
ṣaṣṭhīsamāsādarśāadyacpratyaya iti | yadvā - nimitagrahaṇādvahuvacanāntasya
samāsaḥ vṛddhīnāṃ tisṛṇāmapi nimitaṃ vṛddhinimitamiti |
vatustvākārasyaiva nimitam | iha tu sarvasmai hitā sārvā sā
bhāryā yasya sa sārvabhārya iti yadyapi sarvapuruṣābhyām iti ṇapratyaye
ākāra eva vṛddhirbhavati, tathāpi nāsau svarupeṇa vṛddhernimitam, kiṃ
tarhi ṇitvena | tacca tisṛṇāmapi nimitam | 
e madhye bhavā madhyamā, tamadhyānmaḥ | kāṇḍaṃ lugātīti kāṇḍalāvī,
karmaṇyaṇ ṭiṭñāṇañ iti ṅīp , yatadetebhyaḥ parimāṇe vatup ā
sarvanāmnaḥ agitaścaṃ ṅp, tāvatī | tatpuraṣāśrayaṇe'syāpi
pratiṣeghaḥ syāt, bahuvrīhau tu ṇakāraderabhāvān na bhavati |
kāṣāyīti | tena raktaṃ rāgāt ityaṇ | lauhīti |
prāṇirajatādibhyo'ñ | khadiraśabdaḥ palāśādiḥ īṣā -
rathāvayavaviśeṣaḥ || 
esvāṅgañceto'mānini || 6 - 3 - 40 || 
esvāṅgācceto'mānini || amāninīti vārtike darśanātsūtre
prakṣiptam | svāṅgāccopasarjanāt iti ṅīṣ, dīrghakeśī | 
e sahanañvidyamānapūrvācca iti pratiṣedhādakeśā || 
ejāteśca || 6 - 3 - 41 || 
e kaṭhabahūvṛcayoḥ gautraṃ ca caraṇauḥ saha iti jātitvān ṅīṣ | 
e ayamityādi | vyākhyānamatra śaraṇam || 
epuṃvat karmadhārayajātīyadeśīyeṣu || 6 - 3 - 42 || 
e nanu karmadhāraye striyāḥ puṃvat ityādinā siddhaḥ puṃvadbhāvaḥ
jātīyadeśīyayorapi tasilādiṣviti, kimartho'yamārambhaḥ ityata āha
- pratiṣiddhārtho'yamiti | pratiṣiddho'pi puṃvadbhāvo yathā
syādityevamarthamityarthaḥ | pratiṣedhārtho'yamiti pāṭhe
pratiṣedhāviṣayaḥ pratiṣedhaśabdenoktaḥ | nivṛttivacano vārthaśabdaḥ | 
e kukkuṭa|ladīnāmityādi | astryarthemasamānādhikaraṇārthaṃ vacanam | na
vetyādi | upasaṃkhyānaṃ pratyācaṣṭe | na vā vaktavyam, kiṃ kāraṇam
strīpūrvapadasyāvivakṣitatvāt | nātra strītvāvasāyaḥ ārabhyamāṇe'pi
puṃvadbhāve samāśrayaṇīyaḥ, anārambha'pi tathā bhaviṣyati | yadi tarhi
strīliṅgena samāso na bhaviṣyati | yadyapi tāvadatraitacchakyate
vaktum, iha tu kathaṃ mṛgyā kṣīraṃ mṛgakṣīramiti, nahi puṃsaḥ kṣīreṇa
sambandho'sti atrāpi jātyantaranivṛttiparatvāccodanāyāḥ
strītvamākiñcitkaratvādavivakṣitam | yatra tu liṅga, viśeṣa
upakārakastatrāsau vivakṣita eva yathā - aḍāmūtreṇa paryukṣitaṃ
dātavyamiti | pūrvapadārtho'tra jātiriti | kukkuṭāṇḍājau
pūrvapadārtho jātiḥ sa ca samāmānyena strītvādiviśeṣarahitena
rupeṇa vivakṣita ityarthaḥ | 
e khidghādiṣviti | tatra khiti vipratiṣedhaḥ striyāḥ puṃvat
ityatraivodāhṛtaḥ | ghādiṣu nadyā hrasvo bhavatītyasyāvakāśaḥ -
nartakitarā, nartakitamā, nartakirupā, nartakikalpā, yatra
puṃvadbhāvaḥ pratiṣidhyate na kopadhāyāḥ iti - tasilādiṣviti |
puṃdbhāvasyāvakāśaḥ yad ṅyantaṃ na bhavati - darśanīyataretyādi |
paṭvitaretyādāvubhayaprasaṅge vipratiṣedhaḥ | ke'ṇo hrasvo
bhavatītyāvakāśaḥ - nartakikā, puṃvadbhāvasyāvakāraḥ - darado'patyaṃ
strī, dvyañmagadha ityaṇ, tasya ataśca luk, tataḥ prāgivātkaḥ,
tasilādiṣviti puṃvadbhāvāddāradaśabdaḥ, pratyayasthāt itītvaṃ
dāridikā | nanu ca parigaṇitāstasilādayaḥ na ca kapratyayasteṣu
samasti evaṃ tarhi vipratiṣedhādeva kapratyayo'pi tatrābhyupagamyata iti
anumīyate, paṭvikā mṛṭviketyādāvubhayaprasaṅge paratvād
hrasvaḥ, sarvatra cātra sakṛdityāśrayaṇād puṃvadbhāvābhāvaḥ | 
e anūṅiti yaduktaṃ tasya prayojanaṃ darśayati - ihetyādi |
tadrājapratyayasyeti | ye dvyacasteṣu dvyañmagadha ityaṇ, śeṣeṣu
janapadaśabdāt ityañ , pṛtha taiti thakārāntaḥ || 
e gharupakalpacelaḍbruvagotramatahateṣu ṅyo'nekāco hrasvaḥ || 6 - 3
- 43 || 
ecelādīnāṃ vṛtti viṣaye kutsanavacanatvātaiḥ kusitāni kutsanaiḥ
iti samāsaḥ | ṅya ityatra īyāścchandasi bahulam ityādivadāgamaḥ
prāptaḥ, sautratvānna kṛtaḥ || 
e datātareti | nanu ca svāṅgāccetaḥ ityataḥ ītaḥ ityanuvartiṣyate |
evamapi prāmaṇītaraḥ - atrāpi prāpnoti striyāmiti vartate | evamapi
pramaṇītarā - atrāpi prāpnoti striyāma iti vartate, strīyā ītaḥ
strīvācina īkāra syetyarthaḥ, grāmaṇīśabde tvanarthaka īkāraḥ |
śeṣapravalṛptyarthaṃ tarhi ṅībgrahaṇam, kriyamāṇe hi ṅībgrahaṇe
ṅyo'nekācaḥ iti śrutatvātadapekṣaḥ śeṣo labhyate - aṅīb yā nadī
ṅyantaṃ ca yadekājiti | antaraṇāpi ṅībgrahaṇaṃ pravalṛptaḥ śeṣaḥ,
katham īta iti vartate, anīcca yā nadī īdantaṃ ca yadekājiti |
tadetanṅīgrahaṇaṃ tiṣṭhatu tāvat || 
enadyāḥ śeṣasyānyatasyām || 6 - 3 - 44 || 
e bhāṣitapuṃskādanūṅ iti nivṛtam | kaśca śeṣa iti | yadi ca yatra
pūrvasūtreṇa hrasvo na vivatritaḥ sa śeṣaḥ, tato yadabhāṣitapuṃskam,
yacca bhinnāyāmākṛtau bhāṣitapuskamanekāja ṅyantaṃ tasyāpi hrasvatvaṃ
prasajyate - āmalakītarā, drīṇītareti | atrāpi pūrveṇa
vihitatvāditi praśnaḥ | pūrvasūtre yatsākṣāt śrutaṃ tadapekṣaḥ śeṣa
ityutaram | 
e śeṣagrahaṇaṃ śakyamakartum| katham nadyā anyatarasyāṃ hrasva ityutsargaḥ,
tasyānekāca īto nityahrasvatvamapavādaḥ, tasminnitye prāpte ugitaśca
iti vibhāṣā''rabhyate | yadyevam, nadyā anyatarasyām ityatra
bhāṣitapuṃskādityanuvartyate, droṇītarā - tātrāpi prāpnotī,
tasmātkartavyaṃ śeṣagrahaṇam | tasmiśca kriyamāṇe 
eśrutāpekṣaṃ śeṣatvaṃ yathā vijñāyeteti pūrvasūtre ṅīgrahaṇamapi
kartavyam | 
e lakṣmītreti | avitṛstatanvibhya īḥ lakṣermuṭ ca
itīkārapratyayānto lakṣmīśabda iti kṛnnadyanto bhavati | sa tarhi
pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ na vaktavyaḥ katham striyā ityunuvartate, tena nadaāā
viśeṣayiṣyāmaḥ striyā nadyā iti na ca kunnadī strīvācinī |
nadīsaṃjñā'pi tarhi na prāpnoti ukto'tra parihāro nadīsaṃjñāprakaraṇe
|| 
e ugitaśca || 6 - 3 - 45 || 
epuṃvadbhāvo'pyatra patre vaktavya iti | bhāṣye naitad dṛṣṭam |
prakarṣayogātprāgityādinā vaktavyaṃ pratyācaṣṭe | vivakṣā hi
śabdavyutpateḥ pradhānaṃ kāraṇam| na ceha
prakaṇayogātprākstrītvavivakṣāyāṃ strīpratyaya iti manyate || 
e ānmahataḥ samānādhikaraṇajātīyayoḥ || 6 - 3 - 46 || 
e mahataḥ putro mahatputra iti | nanu cātra ānmahataḥ ityetāvāneva
yogaḥ kartavyaḥ, tataḥ jātīye ca iti dvitīyaḥ, tatra pūrvasmin
yoge utarapadena samāsaḥ sannidhāpyate, sa ca
lakṣaṇapratipadoktaparibhāṣāyā sanmahat ityādinā tayo vihitaḥ sa
eva grahīṣyate, sa ca samānāparibhāṣayā sanmahat ityādinā yo
vihitaḥ sa eva grahīṣyate, sa ca samānādhikaraṇa eveti anarthakaṃ
samānādhikaraṇagrahaṇagrahaṇam, tadetadāśaṅkate tāvat -
lakṣaṇoktatvāditi | nirākaroti - bahuvrīhāvapīti | tadarthamiti |
bahuvrīhāvapi yathā syādityavamarthamityarthaḥ |
lakṣaṇapratipadektaparibhāṣāyā nivṛtyarthamiti vā | 
e iha āmahān mahānsampanno mahadbhūtaścandramā iti mahacchabdo
bhūtaśabdaśtaikasminnarthe candarmasi vartete iti sāmānādhikaraṇyādātvaṃ
prāpnoti | syādetat - abhūtatadbhāve cvirvidhīyate,
abhūtatadbhāvaśca kaḥ kāraṇasya vikāratmanā'bhūtasya tadātmanā bhāvaḥ,
tatra prakṛtiḥ kartrī, na vikṛtiḥ, tathā ca - saṅghībhavanti brāhmaṇāḥ,
paṭībhavanti tantavaḥ, atvaṃ tvaṃ sampadyate tvadbhavatīti prakṛtyāśrayeṇa
bahuvacanaprathamapuruṣau dṛśyete, na
vikṛtvāśrayeṇaikavacanamadhyamapuruṣau, tataśca bhūta iti ktapratyayo
bhavan kriyāyāḥ kartaryamahatyutpannaḥ, na tu vikāre mahati tataḥ
kim āmahato bhūtena sāmānādhikaraṇyam, na tu mahataḥ na
hyavasthāvata ekatve'pyavasthayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ sambhavati, nahi
bhavati bālaścāsau sthaviraśceti, bhavati tu bālaścāsau
devadataśceti, ato vaiyadhikaraṇyādātvābhāva iti | yadyevam, amahatī
mahatī sampannā brāhmaṇī mahadbhūtā brāhmaṇīti puṃvadbhāvo'pi na
syādvaiyadhikaraṇyādeva yathā prakṛteḥ kartṛtvaṃ dṛṣṭṃa tathā
vikṛterapi dṛśyate | tathā ca paspaśāyāṃ bhāṣyam - suvarṇapiṇḍaḥ
khadirāṅgāravarṇe kuṇḍale bhavati iti | tathā klṛpi sampadyamāne
caturthī vaktavyā iti sampadyakartara ividhīyamānā caturthī
vikārādbhavati - mūtrāya kalpate yavāgūriti, na prakṛteḥ | tathā
asaṅgho brāhmaṇasaṅgho bhavati, apaṭastantavaḥ paṭo bhavatīti
vikārāśrayaṃ vacanaṃ dṛśyate tatra yadi vikṛteḥ kartṛtvamāśritya
sāmānādhikaraṇyāśrayaḥ puṃvadbhāvo vidhīyeta, ātvamapi syāt |
atha prakṛteḥ kartṛtvādvaiyadhikaraṇyādātvaṃ na syāt,
puṃvadbhāvo'pi na syāt ucyate, darśitaṃ tāvadidaṃ yathā
cviviṣaye dvayorapi prakṛtivikṛtyoḥ kartṛtvamiti | yuktaṃ
caitat, yadi vikṛteḥ kartṛtvamāśritya pratyayaḥ | yadā caiko'rthaḥ
prakṛtivikārātmaka āśrīyate, tadā pariṇāmavyavahāraḥ | uktaṃ ca -
jahaddharmāntaraṃ pūrvamupādte yadā param | tatvādapracyuto dhamī
pariṇāma saḥ ucyate || iti | yadā tvanyataravyavasthā na vivakṣyate,
tadā cvarabhāvaḥ - tantavo bhavanti, paṭo bhavatīti, tajña yo'yaṃ
pūrvakaṃ dharmaṃ jahadutaraṃ copādadatsammṛcchito'rthaḥ sañjāyamānaḥ
sampadyakarteti cocyate, tadabhedācca pūrvotarāvasthayorapi
kartṛtvam, ata etadapi nirastam| asatyā utarāvasthāyā utpatau
śaśaviṣāṇamapyutpadyeta, satyāśca pūrvavasthāyā utpatau sarva eva
paṭādayaḥ sarvadotpadyamānā eva bhaveyuriti | kathaṃ nirastam kiṃ
sadutpadyataṃ, kiñcāsat pūrvotarayoravasthayoranuvartamānaṃ vastu
tasmānna bhinnena nāpyabhinnena kenacidrūpeṇotpadyate, yathā - mṛdvastu
dhaṭarupeṇa | yadyevam, pūrvavasthayā kimaparāddham, yatsaiva notpadyate
na kiñcidaparāddham, asatī tu sā kathaṃ kartro syāt | vinaṣṭāyāṃ hi
tasyāmutaravasthotpadyate, yathā ghaṭaḥ piṇḍāvasthāyām | ato
dṛdvagtveva teva teva piṇḍādirupeṇa pariṇamata iti yuktam |
evamāmūlaprakṛtitaḥ | sā tu prakṛtyantaranirapekṣaiva tena tena
pṛthivyādirupeṇa pariṇamata iti | tadevaṃ sthitametat
sammūrcchito'rthātmā sampadyakartā, tadabhedācca pūrvotarāvasthayorapi
kartṛtvamiti | uktaṃ ca - pūrvāvasthāmabhijahatsaṃspṛśan dharmamutaram
| sammūrcchita ivārthātmā 
ejāyamāno'bhidhīyate || iti | 
e tadevaṃ sati cvyarthe vākye kvacitprakṛtereva kartṛtvam,
cvyantasya gatitvād, gatīnāṃ ca kriyāviśeṣaṇatvādanyaddhi bhanam,
anyaddhi saṅghībhavanam tatra kevale bhavane saṅghaḥ kartā,
saṅghībhavane tu brāhmaṇaḥ | yathā - vyākaraṇasya sūtraṃ karotīti satraṃ
tadviśeṣaṇam, vyākaraṇaṃ satrayatītyatra viśiṣṭakarotervyākaraṇaṃ
karma tadvadatrāpi | tatra maddadbhataścandramā iti cvyanto'yaṃ
mahacchabdau bhūtaśabdasya pravṛttinimite bhavane paryavasyati |
bhūtaśabdastu mahatvenāsaṃspṛṣṭaścandramāḥ svarupe vartata iti
vaiyadhikaraṇyādātvābhāvaḥ | mahadbhūtā brāhmaṇītyatra tu
mṛgakṣīrādivatstrīpūrvapadasyāvivakṣitatvātsiddham | yatra tu strītvaṃ
vivakṣitam, na bhavatyeva tatra puṃvadbhāvaḥ -- agaumatī gomatī
sampanna gomatībhūtā brāhmaṇīti | 
e vṛttikāgstu vikṛteḥ kartṛtvāśrayeṇa sāmānādhikaraṇya satyapi
parihāramāha gīṇatvānmahaparthasyeti | goṇamukhyayohi mukhye
sampratyayo bhavati, tadyathā - gauranubandhyā'jo'gnīpomīya iti na
vāhīko'nubadhyate, svaśāstre'pi svarupam ityatra rupagrahaṇena
jñāpitarupavadartho'pi tantramiti mukhyārthasya mahacchabhdascātra grahaṇād
gauṇarthasyātvābhāvaḥ | cvyanteṣu hi ekasya vastunaḥ
prakṛtivikārātmakatayā dvyātmakatvaṃ gamyate | paṭībhavantīti hyukte
prāgapaṭaḥ samprati paṭātmanā pariṇamata iti pratīyate | paṭo
bhavatītyukte naivaṃ pratīyate, kintu paṭo raktādirupeṇa bhavatītyapi
gamyate | tatra kevalavikārāvasthāvācakasya paṭhaśabdasya
prāgavasthāyāmanugatāvasthāyāṃ ca vṛttirna lakṣaṇāmantareṇopapadyate | 
e apara āha mahatvena pariṇāmonmukhe'mahati mahacchabdasya vṛttiḥ | atra
ca pramāṇam - paṭo bhavatīti vākye raktādirupeṇa bhavatītyapi
gamyate, paṭībhavatītyatrāpaṭaḥ paṭo bhavatītyeva gamyate | evamarthe
pravṛttirupacāramantareṇa nopapadyate iti gauṇārthatvādātvābhāva thaiti
mantavyam | yadi tarhi puṃvadbhāvastu viśeṣamanupādāya
vidhīyamāno gauṇārthasyāpi bhavati, śabdaviśeṣopādāne hi
gauṇamukhyanyāyaḥ evaṃ tu gomatībhūtatyatra tu puṃvadbhāvanivṛtaye
yatitavyam | yadi tahi śāstatreṣu mukhyārthasya grahathaṇ, kathaṃ tarhi
vāhīk vṛddhyātve bhavataḥ - gaurvāhīkaḥ, gāṃ vāhīkamiti ucyate
padasya padāntarasambandhe sati gauṇārthatvābhivyaktiḥ vibhaktyantaṃ ca
padāntareṇa sambadhyate, tataśca padasya padāntarasambandhe sati yatkārthaṃ
prāptaṃ satraivasau nyāyaḥ , na pratipadikakāryeṣvati mukhya eva svārthe
sāsnādimati vṛddhyātve anubhūya gośabdo vāhīke vartiṣyate |
iha tu mahacchabdasyotarapade parato vidhīyamānamātvaṃ
tasyāmavasthāyāṃ mukhyārthasyaiva bhavitumarhati | anenaiva nyāyena ca
tasya gauśabdasya gau'bhavadityatra ot iti pragṛhyasaṃjñā na bhavati,
agnisomau māṇavakāravityatra agneḥ stutstomasomāḥ iti ṣatvaṃ na
bhavati, īdagneḥ thaitītvaṃ ca | 
e mahadātva ityādi | samuccaye caśabdaḥ, nānvācaye | teva yatraiva
puṃvadbhāvastatraivātvam | aṣṭākapālamiti | aṣṭasu kapāleṣu
saṃskṛtamiti taddhitārthe samāsaḥ, saṃskṛtaṃ bhakṣāḥ ityaṇ, tasya dvigoḥ
iti luk | aṣṭakapālamiti | samāhāre dviguḥ | pātrāditvāt
strītvābhāvaḥ | 
e aṣṭāgaveneti | aṣṭau gāvo yuktā asminniti tripado bahuvrīhiḥ,
pūrvayordvayorutarapade dvigau gorataddhitaluki iti ṭacsamāsāntaḥ |
tatra dīrghatvena yuktārthasampratyayādyauktaśabdasya nivṛttiḥ |
samāhāradvigorvā sāhacaryādabhedaupacārādyauktārthe vṛttiḥ | 
e kaṣakaraṇaṃ vispaṣṭārthamiti | na bhinnakālānāṃ nivṛtyartham,
anaṇtvāt, nāpi guṇabhinnānāṃ tatkālānāṃ grahaṇam abhadakatvād
guṇānām | ānaṅprakaraṇa evāsminvaktavye'tra āt iti vacanaṃ
yogavibhāgārtham | tenāṣṭākapāladāvāttvasiddhiḥ | evaṃ
caikādaśe'nyatrāpyātvaṃ bhavati, tathā ca prāgekādaśabhyo'cchandasi iti
prayogaḥ || 
e dvyaṣṭanaḥ saṃkhyāyāmabahuvrīhyaśītyoḥ || 6 - 3 - 47 || 
e atra saṃkhyātānudeśo na bhavati | yadi syād, aṣṭano'śītau
pratiṣedhaḥ syāt, tathā ca tasya vaiyarthyam | pratiṣiddhe'pyātve
savarṇadīrghatvena bhavitavyam | dvādaśa, dvāviśatirityādau samāhāre
dvandvaḥ | sa napuṃsakm ityettu na bhavati
lokāśrayatvālliṅgasya | 
e dvitrā iti | dvau vā trayo veti vārthe saṃkhyayāvyayāsanna iti
samāsaḥ, bahuvrīhau saṃkhyeye ḍac | dvirdaśa dvidaśāḥ | sujarthe
samāsaḥ || 
e trestrayaḥ || 6 - 3 - 48 || 
e sandhivelādiṣu trayodaśaśabdasya pāṭhātsakāranto'yamādeśaḥ || 
evibhāṣā catvāriṃśatprabhṛtau sarveṣām || 6 - 3 - 49 || 
e sarveṣāgrahaṇamityādi | asati hi tasmin anantarasya trestrayaḥ
ityasyaiva vikalpaḥ syāt || 
e hṛdasya hṛllekhayadaṇlāseṣu || 6 - 3 - 50 || 
eaṇantasya grahaṇamiṣyata iti | vyākhyānāt | atra vyāvartyaṃ darśayati -
ghañi tviti | yadā cāṇantasya grahaṇaṃ na dhañantasya, tadā lekhagrahaṇasya
jñāpakatvamupadyate || 
e vā śokaṣyañrogeṣu || 6 - 3 - 51 || 
e hṛdayaśabdenetyādi | yaduktataṃ tannānumanyante, ata eva
vikalpavidhānāt, paddannomāshṛt ityatra hṛdadeśavidhānācca || 
e pādasya padajyātigopahateṣu || 6 - 3 - 52 || 
e ākārānto'yamādeśo'vibhaktikaḥ | ajyatibhyāmiti | aja
gatikṣepathaṇayoḥ, ata sātatyagamane | padaga iti | ḍaprakaraṇe'nyatrāpi
dṛśyate iti ḍaḥ | apadeśa eveti | samasanakriyānantarameva prāgeva
samāsasya prāptasvarādityarthaḥ | antodāto nipātyata iti |
anyathā''ntaryata ādyaudātaḥ syāt | tenetyādinā
antodātanipātanasya prayojanamāha |
padājirityādinopadeśagrahaṇasya | yadi vṛtsvare kṛte
satyutarakāle padaśabdo'ntodāta ādeśaḥ syāt, tadā
satiśiṣṭatvātena kṛtsvaro bādhyeta | upadeśa eva tvāntodātādeśe
kṛtvasvara eva satiśiṣṭo bhavati | na cāntodātanipātnasya
vaiyarthyama, padopahata ityatra śrūsamāṇatvāditi piṇḍārthaḥ || 
epadyatyatadarthe || 6 - 3 - 53 || 
e ike caratāviti | caratyarthe ik pratyayaḥ kṛtpratyayastatretyarthaḥ |
etadvārtikādarśanātparpādiṣu pādaḥ pacca iti paṭhitam | 
e śarīrāvayavasyeti | vyākhyānamatra śaraṇam | apara āha - pūrvajña
tāvaccharīrāvayavasya grahaṇam, tasyaivājyādiṣu karaṇatvasambhavata
ihāpi sa evānuvartate | ṛcaḥ śe ityatra ṛgviṣaye
śarirāvayavasyāsambhavācchaturthabhāgavacanasya grahaṇamiti | tenetyādi
| paṇapādamāṣaśatāt ityatra hi parimāṇavacanaiḥ paṇādibhiḥ
sāhacaryātparimāṇasya grahaṇam, na śarīrāvayavasya | dvipādyamiti |
tena krītam ityatrārthe yatpratyayaḥ | idamapyatra śakyaṃ vaktum - pādena
yadviśeṣyate, pādasya yo yat, kaśca pādasya yat yastato 
evihitaḥ, dvipādyamityatra tu pādaśabdāntād dvigoryadvihita iti || 
e himakāṣihatiṣu ca || 6 - 3 - 54 || 
e pādasya himaṃ śītaṃ paddhimam | pādau kaṣantīti patkāṣiṇaḥ -
pādacāriṇaḥ | supyajātau iti ṇiniḥ | pādābhyāṃ hanyata iti paddhatiḥ
|| 
e ṛcaḥ śe || 6 - 3 - 55 || 
e śe iti śaspratyayasyedamekadeśānukaraṇam, anyasya śaśabdasyā
sambhavāt | nanu ca sambhavatyayam, pāde śete adhikaraṇe śeteḥ
ityac pādaśa iti | nāstyasya sambhavaḥ, na hi ṛkpāde kaścicchete |
yacca lomādibhyaḥ 
eśaḥ, tasyāpyasambhava taeva lomādiṣu pādaśabdasyābhāvāt || 
e vā ghoṣamiśraśabdeṣu || 6 - 3 - 56 || 
e panniṣka iti | niṣkaśabdaḥ suvarṇajātivacanaḥ, pādaśabdaḥ
parimāṇavacanaḥ, karmadhārayaḥ samāsaḥ || 
e udakasyodaḥ saṃjñāyām || 6 - 3 - 57 || 
e udamegha iti | ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ, sādṛśyātpuruṣasya saṃjñā,
pituraprasiddhatvātputreṇa vyapadeśaḥ| udakaṃ vahatīti 
ekarmaṇyaṇ - udavāhaḥ | 
e kṣīroda iti bahuvrīhiḥ | atra kecidāhuḥ - udakaśabdena samānārtha
udaśabdo'sti, tathā ca saṃjñāyāmapi prayujyate - aprasannoda iti | idaṃ
vacanaṃ saṃjñāyāmudakaśabdasya prayoganivṛtyarthamiti | evaṃ tu
vakṣyamāṇo vikalpo'narthakaḥ syāt || 
e peṣaṃvāsavāhanadhiṣu ca || 6 - 3 - 58 || 
e asaṃjñāryamidam | udadhiriti | karmaṇyadhikaraṇe ca ca iti kipratyayaḥ
| ghaṭādiratrodadhiḥ, samudre pūrveṇaiva siddheḥ || 
eekahalādau pūrayitavye'nyatarasyām || 6 - 3 - 59 || 
e eko'sahāya iti | yadyayamekaśabdaḥ saṃkhyāvacanaḥ syāt,
tarhyeketyanarthakaṃ syāt, na hi dvau ca bahavau vā ādibhūtāḥ
kvacitsambhavanti, tasmādasahāyavacana ekaśabdaḥ | nanvevamapyasya
vyāvartya na sambhavati, katham ekaikavarṇavaśavartitvādvācaḥ, yadi
hyanekasya varṇasya yugapaduccāraṇaṃ syāttdā
sthālīśabdo'nekahalādiḥ, yadi vā krameṇoccāritā api varṇā
avatiṣṭheran, tadāpi yugāpadvarṇayorupalambhādāditvaṃ syāt,
yatstu noñcāraṇe yugapadulabdhau vā varṇānāṃ yaugapadyam,
tasmādekasyaivāditvamiti na kiñcidekagrahaṇena śakyaṃ vyavacchetum
evaṃ tarhyekagrahaṇasāmarthyādviśiṣṭamasahāyatvāmāśrīyate | kiṃ punastat
ānantaryam | tadetadāha - tulyajātīyenānantareṇeti | hallvena
tulyajātīyatvena tulyāsthānādibhirbhinnajātīy vyavahite ca
saddāyatvāprasiddharevamuktam || 
emanthaudanasaktubinduvajrabhārahāravīvadhagāheṣu ca || 6 - 3 - 60 || 
e dravadravyasaṃyuktāḥ saktavaḥ - manthaḥ | udakena mantha iti | tṛtīyeti
yogavibhāgātsamāsaḥ | atha prathyata iti kriyāśabdaḥ, tadā kartṛkaraṇe
kṛtā bahulam it samāsaḥ, saktvaudanābhyām annena vyañcanam
iti, binduvajravīvadhaiḥ ṣaṣṭhīti bhārahāragāhaiḥ karmaṇyaṇantaiḥ
upapadamatiṅ iti samāsaḥ, udakasya vajraṃ krūram, yadapāṃ krūramiti
darśanāt | anye'pi yathāsambhavaṃ samāsā bhavantyeva udakaṃ vajramiva
bhindāno dṛdayamasāhinodavajraḥ || 
e iko hrasvo'ṅyo gālavasya || 6 - 3 - 61 || 
e grāmaṇiputra iti | satsūdviṣa ityādinā kvip, agragramābhyānnayateḥ
iti ṇatvam | gārgīputra iti | gārgyaśabdād yañaśca iti ṅīp
yasyeti ca, halastaddhitasya | 
e kārīṣagandhīputra iti | ṣyaṅaḥ saṃprasāraṇam saṃprasārathaṇasyaḥ iti
dīrghaḥ | kāṇḍībhūtamiti | ūryādijviḍāśca iti
nipātasaṃjñāyāmavyayatvam | strīveṣadhārī nartakaḥ pusṣaḥ bhrukuaṃsaḥ
| 
e ihālābukarkandhujambuphalamiti phalaśabda utarapade jambvā hrasvatvam,
dvandve jambvāmutarapade karkandhvā hrasvatvam, alābvāstu na
prāpnoti, karkandhva anutarapadatvāt evaṃ tarhyevaṃ vigrahaḥ kariṣyate -
alābūśca karkandhūśca alābukarkandhavau, te ca jambūśca
alābukarkandhujambvaḥ, tāsāṃ phalamalābukarkandhujambuphalamiti,
evamapi jambvāḥ pūrvanipātaḥ prāpnoti | evaṃ karkandhujambvorapi
dvandve draṣṭavyam | jambuśabdo jambuśabdo rājadantādiṣu draṣṭavyaḥ ||

e eka taddhite ca || 6 - 3 - 62 || 
e eka ityavibhaktiko nirdeśaḥ, samānādhikaraṇe hi striyāḥ
puṃvadbhāvenaiva siddhatvāt | vyadhikaraṇārthamidam | ekatvamiti |
asahāyādivacano'yamekaśabdaḥ | saṃkhyāvacanasya tu
tvatalorguṇavacanasya iti puṃvadbhāvenaiva siddham | kiṃ punaḥ
kāraṇaṃ strīliṅga evodāhriyate, na punaryathāśrutaḥ puṃlliṅgo
napuṃsakaliṅgo veti tatrāha - liṅgaviśiṣṭasyati |
strīliṅgasyaiva hrasvavidhānamarthavad bhavati, netarasya, tasya svata eva
hrasvāntatvāt | nanu cārastu svata evānto hrasvaḥ,
yastavasāvādirekāraḥ, tadarthamitarasyāpi grahaṇamarthavat ata āha -
aceti | syādetadevam, yadi gṛhyamāṇenaikaśabdena acaśca
ityupasthāpito'jviśeṣyeta - ekaśabdasya yo'c yatra kutra sthita iti,
iha tūpasthāpitenācā gṛhyamāṇa ekaśabdo viśeṣyate ekasya hrasvo
bhavati | kiṃviśiṣṭasya acaḥ ajantasyeti | tatra alontyasya ityantyasya
hrasvena bhāvyam, tacca ṭābantasyaivārthavat, netarasya | itikaraṇo 
ehetau || 
e ṅyāpoḥ saṃjñācchandasorbahulam || 6 - 3 - 63 || 
e bahulagrahaṇātkavaciṭuatarapade'pi bhavati - anugāyanti nayo
gabhiṇaya iti | evaṃ kṛtvā phālgunīpaurṇamāsīti
pratyudādāharaṇopapatiḥ, karmadhāraye puṃvadbhāvaḥ prāpnoti | 
e ūrṇamradā iti | ūrṇāvan mradīyasīti yāvat, chāndasa
īyasīśabdasyārāraḥ | taitirīyāstu dīrghamadhīyate - ūrṇāmradasaṃ
cāstṛṇāmīti || 
e iṣṭakeṣīkāmālānāṃ citatūlabhāriṣu || 6 - 3 - 65 || 
e iṣṭakacitamiti | kartṛkaraṇe kṛtā bahulam iti samāsaḥ |
iṣīkatūlamiti | ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ | mālāmbibhartīte mālabhāriṇī,
supyajātau iti ṇiniḥ | prāyeṇa tu haratimadhīyate, prayogastu
bibharteḥ, gāllikā mālabhāriṇya iti | 
e iṣṭakādibhistadantasyāpi grahaṇaṃ bhavatīti | yathā tu bhavati, tathā
alukprakaraṇa evoktam || 
e khityanavyayasya || 6 - 3 - 66 || 
e ikaha hrasvaśrutyā acaḥ ityupasthāpyate | tatra yadi
pūrvapadenājviśeṣyeta pūrvapadasyāco hrasvo bhavati yatra
sthitasyeti, tato vāḍmanya ityādāvapi prāpnoti, tasmādacā
pūrvapadaṃ viśeṣyate - ajantasya pūrvapadasyeti | tatra
kālimmanyetyādāvapi mumi kṛte'jantatvābhāvād hrasvābhāva ityata
tāaha - mumā hrasvo na bādhyata iti | kutaḥ ityata āha - anyathā hīti |
ucyate cedam - ajantasya hrasva iti, yadi pūrvaṃ mum
syādvacanamidamanarthakaṃ syāt | tasmānmumā hrasvo na bādhyate | kathaṃ
punarmumā hrasvabādhaḥ śāṅkitaḥ, yāvatā stanandhayādau caritārthasya
mumaḥ kālimmanyatyādau hrasvenaiva bādhaḥ śaṅkanīyaḥ
tasmādayamasyārthaḥ - yathā pūrvaṃ mumā hrasvo na bādhyate, tathā
sūtrasyārtho varṇanīyaḥ - ajantasya hrasvo vidheyaḥ, na tu
pūrvapadasambandhino'co hrasva iti | tasminpakṣe mumi kṛte'pi
hrasvapravṛttisambhavādanavakāśatvābhāvāt mumi kṛte paścāddhrasvaḥ
syāt, pūrvaṃ tu mumā bādhyeteti | yatpunarukkam - muma eva hrasvena
bādhaḥ śaṅkanīya iti atra parihāramutarasūtre vakṣyati | 
e kathaṃ punaratra khidantasya grahaṇam, yāvatā
jñāpitametadutarapadādhikāre pratyayagrahaṇe tadantavidhirna bhavati
tatrāha - anvayayasyetyetadeveti | dhātoreva khito
vidhānānnāvyayātparaḥ khitpratyayaḥ sambhavati | tasmādavyayapratiṣedhādatra
tadāntagrahaṇamityarthaḥ || 
e arurdviṣadajantasya mum || 6 - 3 - 67 || 
e aruntuda iti | vidhvaruṣostudaḥ iti khaś, tudāditvācchaḥ,
sakārātpūrvaṃ mumi kṛte sakārasya saṃyogāntalopaḥ | dviṣantapa iti
| dviṣatparayostāpe iti khac, khaci hrasvaḥ, mumādi pūrvavat |
vidvanmanya iti | vasusraṃsudhvaṃsu iti datvam,
yaro'nunāsike'nunāsiko vā | 
e antagrahaṇamanarthakam, varṇagrahaṇe sarvatra tadantavidherbhāvādityata
āha antagrahaṇamityādi | samīpavacano'ntaśabdaḥ, accāsāvantaśceti
ajantaḥ, nipātanādviśeṣaṇasya paranipātaḥ | kaḥ punarasau pūrvasūtre
vihito hrasvaḥ, tena pūrvapadasya tadantavidhiḥ etaduktaṃ bhavati -
yo'yamasya sūtrasya samīpabhūto yaḥ pūrvasūtre vihito
hrasvastadantasya mum iti, yato hrasve kṛte mum bhavatīti |
etenaidapi nirastam - muma eva hrasvena bādhaprasaṅga iti | kathaṃ
tannimitakatvānmumaḥ hrasvanimitako hyaeṣa mum bhavati | yadyevam,
standhayādau yatra hrasvo na kriyate tatra mum na prāpnoti kiṃ punaḥ
kāraṇamatra hrasvo na kriyate prayojanābhāvāt | asti prayojanam,
kim mum yathā syāditi | idānīmeva hyuktam - hrasvanimitako
mumiti || 
e ica ikāco'mpratyayavacca || 6 - 3 - 68 || 
e amāgamo bhavatīti | kathamasyāgamatvam mitvāt | yadyevam, makāra
itsaṃjñakaḥ prayoge śravaṇaṃ na prāpnoti - śriyammanyaḥ, bhruvammanya iti
naivāsya makārasya śravaṇam, kiṃ tarhi mumaḥ | nanu ca nāprāpte
mumyārabhyamāṇo'yamāgamastaṃ bādheta na bādheta uktaṃ tatra -antagrahaṇaṃ
kṛtājantakāryapratipatyarthamiti, tenāsminnapi prakṛte bhaviṣyati |
vayantu brūmaḥ - nevāyamitsaṃjñako makāraḥ, ampratyayavadbhāvena na
vibhaktau tusmāḥ iti 
epratiṣadhāt | yadyavam, ādeśaḥ prāpnoti ampratyayavadbhāvātparo
bhaviṣyati | āgamavyapadeśāstu yaugikaḥ samīpa āgacchatīti, yathā na
yvābhyāṃ padāntābhyām ityatraicaḥ | dvitīyo'pi vā makāraḥ
saṃyogāntalopena luptanirdiṣṭo draṣṭavyaḥ | 
e yadyatra pratyayavaccetyetāvaducyeta gāmmanya ityatra auto'mśasoḥ
ityākāro na syāt, śasā sahacaritasyāmastatra grahaṇāt | iha ca
strīmmanya iti ami pūrvaḥ iti pūrvarupaṃ na syāt prathamayoḥ iti
tatrānuvṛteḥ | iha ca narammanya iti ṛto ṅisarvanāmasthānayoḥ iti
guṇo na syāt sāmānyatideśe viśeṣānatideśāt | yatra hi
sāmānyaśabdenātideśastatra
viṣeṣāṇāmaśabdārthatvātsāmānyanibandhanameva kāryaṃ prāpyate yathā -
brāhmaṇavadasmin kṣatriye vartitavyamiti brāhmaṇamātraprayuktaṃ
kāryamatidiśyate, na māṭharādirviśeṣaprayuktam, tadvadatrāpi
pratyayamātraprayuktayoriyaṇuvaṅerevātideśaḥ syat, na
tvākāraderiti matvā''ha - am pratyayavacceci | etadeva vivṛṇoti
- dvitīyaikavacanavacceti | nanu cātraikamamgrahaṇaṃ yadi tenāgamo
nirdiṣṭaḥ pratyayo na viśeṣitaḥ syāt atha pratyayo viśeṣyate,
āgamo na nirdiṣṭaḥ syāt ityata āha - amiti hītyādi | nanvatrāpi
pakṣe ampratyayaprayuktayorātvapūrvatvayorevātideśaḥ syāt, na
guṇasya sarvanāmasthānamātranimitasya, natarāmiyaṇuvaṅeḥ
pratyayamātranimitayoḥ syādetadevam, yadyamityetadāhatya vihitaṃ
tasyaivātideśaḥ syāt | vayaṃ tu - āmi yad dṛṣṭṃa
sāmānyanibandhanaṃ viśeṣanabandhanaṃ vā tatsarvamatidiśāmaḥ | 
e tvaṅmanya iti | atra tvacaṃmanya iti prāpnoti, yeṣāmeko makāraḥ
pratyayavadbhāvāttu paro'yamiti pakṣaḥ | yeṣāmapi
dvitīyasteṣāmacaḥ paro'm prāpnoti, yeṣāṃ tvitsaṃjñako
makārasteṣāmakṣāpi ko doṣa iti cintyam |
nanvajgrahaṇānuvṛterevātra na bhaviṣyati, upasamastasya
pṛthaganuvṛttirdurjñāneti manyate | lekhābhrumanya iti | pūrvavad
hrasvatvaṃ mumāgamaśca | 
e athahetyādi | bhāṣye atheha kathamityārabhyaśrimanyamitibhavitavyamiti
sthitam, sthāpitamityarthaḥ | tena bhinnakartṛkatvaṃ nāśaṅkanīyam |
nanu ca strīliṅgaḥ śrīśabdastatkathaṃ śrimanyamiti
rupamityāśaṅkyopapādayati - taccedamiti | arthāntare hi
vartamānāḥ śabdāḥ kecitsvaliṅgatyāgena vartante, yathā -
yaṣṭa|ladayaḥ śabdāḥ puṃyogātstriyāṃ vartamānāḥ yaṣṭī, pracarī,
gaṇiketi | kecitu svaliṅgopādānena yaṣṭīḥ puruṣān
praveśayeti | tatreha prathamā vidhā bhāṣyakārasyābhipretā, tena
svamornapuṃsakāt ityamoluki kṛte śrimanyamiti bhavati |
yadyevam, supo dhātuprātipadikayoḥ ityasyāpi luko'tideśaḥ
prāpnoti, tasyāpyami dṛṣṭatvāt, athāmvidhānasāmarthyadasya luko
nātideśaḥ, khamornapuṃsakāt tityasyāpi na syāt ucyate, yena
nāprāpte iti vā, madhye'pavādāḥ iti vā supo dhātupratipadikayoḥ
ityasyaiva luko vidhānasāmarthyādvādhaḥ na svamornapuṃsakāt ityasya |
evamapyekapadāśrayatvāllugantaraṅgo viparyayādāgamo bahiraṅga
taityantaraṅge luki kartavye bahiraṅgo'māgamo nāstyeva,
tatkuto luk nātra bahiraṅgaparibhāṣā śakhyā''śrayitum |
anusvāro'pi hi na syād - aruntudaḥ, dviṣantapa iti | tasmādatra
luki sati śrimanyamiti bhavati, yeṣāṃ tvamo makāra itsaṃjñakaḥ
prayoge tu mumaḥ śravaṇam, teṣāmakāramātrasya luki sati mumaḥ
śevaṇaprasaṅgaḥ || 
evācaṃyamapurandarau ca || 6 - 3 - 69 || 
e vācaṃyama iti | vāci yamo vrate iti khac | puraṃdara iti |
pūḥsarvayordārisahoḥ iti khaci hrasvaḥ | ubhayasyāpi
pūrvapadasyāmantatvaṃ nipātyate || 
e kāre satyāgadasya || 6 - 3 - 70 || 
e satyaṅkāraḥ - samayakaraṇam | aśapatha'pi paratvād ḍācaṃ bādhitvā
kāre mumeva bhavati, tāagadaṅkāraḥ -
viṣapratipakṣadravyaviṣeṣakaraṇam | 
e makṣaṅkāraḥ - yāgaviśeṣe dravyabhakṣaṇsya karaṇam | bhakṣaṅkaretīti
vā bhakṣaṅkāraḥ, karmaṇyaṇ | 
e dhenumbhavyeti | bhaviṣyantī dhenurucyate, bhavyageya iti yatkartari |

e lokamapṛṇeti | pṛṇotiḥ pūraṇakarmā, mūlavibhujāditvātkaḥ | 
e anabhyāśāmitya iti | etistuśāsu ityādinā kyap - etavyam,
thaityam | anabhyāśam - dūram, 
etānabhyāśāmityaḥ , dūrataḥ parihartavya ucyate | 
e bhrāṣṭramindhaḥ, agnimindha iti | karmaṇyaṇ, ghañantena vā ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ
| 
e timiṅgila iti | matsyaviśeṣaḥ | timiṅgilatīti pūrvavatkaḥ,
itvam | aci vibhāṣā iti latvam | timiṅgilagilaḥ | ayamapi
matsyaviśeṣa eva | 
e gilagile ceti | yadā gilaṃ gilatīti gilagilaḥ timiṅgilagila
iti vyutpattistadedamupasaṃkhyānam | yadā hi timiṅgilaṃ
gilatīti timiṅgilagila iti vyutpādyate, tadā nārtha etena |
uṣṇaṅkaraṇam, bhadraṅkaraṇamiti | ṣaṣṭhīsamāsau | 
e putraḍveti | dakāro ṅībarthaḥ | 
e kecitvityādi | teṣāṃ pakṣa upasaṃkhyānamidaṃ nārabdhavyam | 
e anyatrāpi hītyādinā śārṅgaravādipāṭhameva draḍhayati | anye tu
śārṅgaravādipāṭhṃa necchanti || 
eśyenatilasya pāte ñe || 6 - 3 - 71 || 
eśyenapāto'syāṃ kriyāyāmiti | yadyapi ghañaḥ sāsyāṃ kriyeti ñaḥ
ityataḥ kriyāgrahaṇaṃ prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇam, na pratyayārthaḥ,
śyenapāto'syāṃ tithau śyenapātā tithiriti tatrodāhṛtatvāt ,
tathāpyasyāmiti strīliṅgamātrasya pratyayārthatvātkiyāyā api
pratyayārthatvāmaviruddham | śyainampāteti | patanaṃ pātaḥ śyenasya
pātaḥ, kartari ṣaṣṭha|la samāsaḥ, tataḥ ghañaḥ sāsyām iti ñaḥ || 
erātreḥ kṛti vibhāṣā || 6 - 3 - 72 || 
e kṛdanta utarapada iti | yadyapyācārakvibantasya
rātriśabdasyānantarastṛjādiḥ kṛtsambhavati, tathāpi tasya
gauṇārthatvādagrahaṇamiti sāmarthyādutarapadādhikāre'pyatra
tadantavidhirbhavati | rātriṣcara iti | rātrau caratīti careṣṭaḥ |
rāśrimaṭa iti | aṭatītyaṭaḥ, pacādyac, sādhanaṃ kṛteti samāsaḥ |
aprāptavimāṣeyamiti | 
e nanu cobhayatravibhāṣeyaṃ yuktā, rātrimmanyetyādāê khidante prāpte,
anyatrāprāpte ityata āha - khiti hi nityaṃ mum bhavatīti |
pūrvavipratiṣedheneti bhāvaḥ || 
e nalopo nañaḥ || 6 - 3 - 73 || 
e nañaḥ sānubandhavasya grahaṇam, pāmādibhyo naḥ - pāmanaputra ityādau
mā bhūt | atha kriyamāṇe'pi sānubandhakagrahaṇe straiṇaputra ityatra
kasmānna bhavati pratyañitvasya vṛddhisvarayoścaritārthatvāt,
nipātañitvasya cācaritārthatvāt, pūrvapadena vā nañ viśeṣyata
iti apūrvapadatvānna bhaviṣyati | evaṃ ca kṛtvā'nubandhoccāramamapi na
kartavyam, apūrvapadatvādeva pāmanaputre na bhaviṣyati | 
e avakṣepe tiṅīti | avakṣepaḥ - nindā | naño'śiti vā naño'niti
vā siddhe lopavacanaṃ sākackārthamityāhuḥ || 
e tasmānnuḍaci || 6 - 3 0 74 || 
e naña taeva hi syāditi | tasminnati nirddiṣṭe pūrvasya iti
vacanāt | nañaśca nuṭi satyaniṣṭṃa rupaṃ syāt,
nalopavidhānamanajādyarthaṃ syāt tasmādgrahaṇe tu sati
pañcamīnirdeśasya balīyastvādutarasyaiva bhavati | nanu yadi tatraiva
syānnācīti nalopameva pratiṣedhet | tadvacanaṃ tūtrapadasyaiva
bhaviṣyati | tasmādevaṃ kaktavyam - nāprāpte nalope ārabhyamāṇo
nuṭ tasya bādhakaḥ syāt, tasmādgrahaṇe tu sati nimitameva
nuṭo nalopo bhavati | 
e aya nugiti pūrvānta evāyaṃ kasmānna kṛtaḥ, evaṃ hi naña eva
syādityavamapi doṣo na bhaviṣyati, tatrāyamapyarthaḥ - tadoḥ saḥ sau
ityatra tadoḥ ityapanīya toḥ iti vargagrahaṇameva kartavyam parādau
hyaneṣa karotītyatra nuṭo nakārasyāpi prasaṅgādaśakyaṃ vargagrahaṇam
tatrāha - pūrvānte hīti | ṅmuṭ prāpnotīti | nalopaḥ
pratipadikāntasya iti nalopo vidhānasāmarthyānna bhavatīti bhāvaḥ |
atrāpi pakṣe idaṃ kartavyam - nāprāpte nalope ārabhyamāṇo nuk
tasya bādhakaḥ syāditi || 
e nabhrāṇnapānnavedānāsatyānamucinakulanakhanapuṃsakanakṣatranakanākeṣu
prakṛtyā || 6 - 3 - 75 || 
e nabhrāḍiti | bhrājabhāsa ityādinā kvip, vraścādiṣatvam, jaśtvam
- ḍakāraḥ, tasya vāvasāne iti pakṣe 
ecartvam - ṭakāraḥ | pāditi śātrantamiti | tanūnapāducyate,
apānnapādityādāvanapuṃsake'pi darśanād ubhe vanaspatyādiṣu ityatra
pāteḥ kvipi nipātanātugityabhidhānāccāpāṭho'yam |pāditi
kvibantamiti pāṭhaḥ | śatrantamityasya vānantara narairna
mantavyamityadhyāhāryam | auṇādikaḥ kipratyaya iti | igupadhātkiḥ
ityanena | kam - sukham, akam - duḥkham, tadyatra nāsti sa nākaḥ
svargaḥ | 
e duḥkhena yanna sambhannaṃ na ca grastamanantaram | 
e abhilāṣopanītaṃ ca sukhaṃ svargapadāspadam || 
e iti hi paṭhanti | atra napuṃsakāditraye nipātyamastīti te tathaiva
grāhyāḥ | itareṣu tūtarapadāmātrāṇi gṛhitvā nañ prakṛtyetyeva
bācyam | evaṃ siddhe sati samudāyapāṭhaḥ prasiddhyupasaṃgrahārthaḥ |
tena nāsatyāvityāśvinoreva bhavati, tānyatrānasatyā ityeva |
evamanyatrāpi yathāsambhavaṃ dṛṣṭavyam | 
e ekādiścaikasya cāduk || 6 - 3 - 76 || 
e ekādiriti bahuvrīhiḥ | ādiśabdo vyavasthā vacanaḥ |
ekānnaviśatiriti | pūrvaṃ naño viśatyādibhiḥ samāsaṃ kṛtvā
paścāt tṛtīyāsamāsaḥ kartavyaḥ | 
e kimarthaṃ punaḥ pūrvānto'yamāduk kriyate, na paradirāduṭ
kriyeta, evamekasyetyāgaminirdeśārthaṃ na kartavyaṃ bhavati, prakṛtasya
naña evāgamitvāt ityata āha - pūrvāntaścāyamiti |
yaro'nunāsike'nunāsiko vā ityatra na padāntāṭṭoranām
ityataḥ padantagrahaṇamanuvartate, avidhnaḥ, badhnātītyevamādiṣu mā
bhūditi | parādau sati dakāraḥ padānto na syāditi anunāsiko na
syāt | athānuṭ kriyeta, evamapi patre dakāraśravataṇaṃ na syāt
tadidamuktam - anunāsiko vikalpena yathā syāditi | kimarthaṃ
purāduk kriyate, adugeva nocajyeta, savarṇadīrghatve tāvat
siddham, ato guṇe iti pararupatvaṃ cākāroccāraṇasāmarthyādeva na
bhaviṣyati, yadi syād dukameva vidadhyāt | savarṇadīrghatvaṃ tu yaṃ
vidhiṃ pratyupadeśo'narthakaḥ iti nyāyādbhaviṣyati | vṛttikāreṇa tu
pratipatilāghavārthamādugayaṃ vyākhyātaḥ || 
e nago'prāṇipvanyatarasyām || gamerhapratyaya iti | ḍaprakaraṇe
anyatrāpi dṛśyate iti || 
esahasya saḥ saṃjñāyām || 6 - 3 - 78 || 
e sahayudhveti | yudhyateḥ kvanip rājani yudhi kṛñaḥ sahe ca iti
sādeśaḥ | 
e udāto nipātyata iti | anyathā tu kiṃ syāt ityata āha -
udātānudātāvatohīti | sahaśabde nipātā ādyaudātāḥ iti saśabda
udātaḥ, śeṣanidhāte haśabdo'nudātaḥ, tenāsāvudātānudātavān
tasya sthāne bhavat saśabda āntaryataḥ svaritaḥ syāt, tanmā bhūdeṣa
deṣa iti udāto nipātyate | yadyevam, avyayībhāve'pi
tasyaivodātatvaṃ śrūyeta tatrādda - sa ceti | ayamabhiprāyaḥ - samāse
kṛte samāsasvaraśca prāpnoti, ayaṃ cādeśaḥ, tatra
paratvādasminnādeśe udāte'bhinirvṛte punaḥ prasaṅgavijñānāt
samāsasvaraḥ, sa ca satiśiṣṭa iti tasyaiva śravaṇam | udātanipātanasya
tu yatra pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratvaṃ bahuvrīhitatpuruṣayostatraiva
śravaṇamiti | seṣṭi, sapaśubandhamiti | antavacane'vyayībhāvaḥ || 
e granthāntādhike ca || 6 - 3 - 79 || 
e sakalamiti | kalā - kālaviśeṣaḥ, tatsahacarito grantho'pi kalā |
evaṃ samuhūrtamityatrāpi | sasaṃgrahamiti | etatu pramādāllikhitam,
atra hi avyayībhāve cākāle iti vakṣyamāṇenaiva siddhaḥ sabhāvaḥ |
kālavācinyutarapada iti | kālādayaḥ śabdā yadyapi
tatsahacaritagranthaparāḥ, tathāpyadhīta iti
padāntaraprayojanasamadhigamyatvād granthaparatvaṃ bahiraṅgamiti
kālaśrayaḥ pratiṣedha eva syāditi manyate | 
e sadroṇeti | tena saheti tulyayoge iti bahuvrīhirayam | tena
vopasarjanasya iti vikalpe prāpte nityārthaṃ vacanam || 
e dvitīye cānupākhye || 6 - 3 - 80 || 
e apradhāno yaḥ saḥ dvitīya iti | tatraiva loke dvitīyaśabdasya
prayogāt, svāmibhṛtyayohi svāminaṃ prati bhṛtyo dvitīya
ityucyate, na viparyayeṇa | upākhyāyate ityasya vivaraṇam -
pratyakṣeṇīpalabhyata iti | ghañarthe 
ekavidhānam iti kaḥ karmaṇi | sāgniriti | pūrvavaddhahuvrīhiḥ,
idamapi nityārthaṃ vacanam | agnyādayaḥ tyāidinā anupākhyatvaṃ
darśayati, kapotaścedagāramupahanyātataśca kapotenāgniranumīyate
| vidyaudvātyayośca rakṣaḥ piśācaṃ vartata iti vārtā || 
eavyayībhāve cākāle || 6 - 3 - 81 || 
e akālavācinīti | svarupagrahaṇaṃ na bhavati , granthāntādhike ca ityatra
granthagrahaṇāt, taddhi samuhūrtamityādau yathā syādityevamartham |
yadi yātra svarupagrahaṇaṃ bhavati, tadā muhūrtādau
niṣedhābhāvādanenaiva siddhatvādanarthakaṃ tatsyāt | sacakramiti |
yaugapadye'vyayībhāvaḥ | sapuramiti | ṛkpūrabdhūḥ ityakāraḥ
samāsāntaḥ | sahapūrvāhvamiti | sākalye'vyayībhāvaḥ || 
e vopasarjanasya || 6 - 3 - 82 || 
e upasarjanasyetyasya sahaśabde viśeṣye sahayudhvā, sahakṛtavetyatrāpi
syāt, anarthakañca viśeṣaṇaṃ syāt, sahaśabdasya cāsatvavācitvād
dvandvo na sambhavati, samāsāntare ca saha upasarjanameva
tasmādutarapadena sannidhāpitasya samāsasyaivedaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ vijñāyate
| tatrāpyavayavadvārā | samāsasyoparjanasaṃjñāyāṃ abhāvāt sarvatra ca
samāse kaścidavayava upasarjanameva | ucyate cedamupasarjanasyeti,
tataśca sarvāvayavadvārā vijñāyate, tadidamuktam - upasarjanasarvakyava
iti | tadavayavasyeti | upasarjanasya ityavayavayogo ṣaṣṭhīti
darśayati | sahakṛtvapriya iti | vā priyasya iti pūrvanipātvikalpaḥ |
iha bahuvrīhau yadutarapadamiti | utarapadādhikārāt,
sarvopasarjanasya bahuvrīherāśrayaṇācca tatsambandhinyevotarapade
utarapadādhikārāt, sarvopasarjanasya bahuvrīherāśrayaṇācca
tatsambandhinyevotarapade sahaśabdasyānantare sabhāvena bhāvyamiti
bhāvaḥ | tatparaḥ sahaśabdo na bhavatīti | pūrvatra tāvanna bhavati,
kṛtvaśabdena vyavadhānāt, utaratrāpi sahakṛtvetyetadutarapadam, na
kṛtvaśabdaḥ || 
e prakṛtyāśiṣyagovatsahaleṣu || 6 - 3 - 83 || 
e prakṛtyāśiṣi ityetāvatsūtram, pariśiṣṭṃa bhāṣyavārtikadarśanāt
sūtrarupeṇa paṭhitam | na iti vaktavye prakṛtivacanaṃ vaicitryārtham || 
e samānasya cchandasyamūrghaprabhṛtyudarkeaṣu || 6 - 3 - 84 || 
e samānasyeti yogavibhāga iti | apara āha - sahaśabdaḥ
sadṛśavacano'sti, yathā - sadṛśaḥ sakhyā sasakhīti,
tasyāyamasvapadivigraho bahuvrīhiḥ - samāno dharmo'sya, samānaḥ
pakṣo'sya, samānā jātirasya vopasarjanasya iti sabhāvaḥ |
samānaśabdasya tu samānajātīya ityādi bhavati | yogavibhāge tu
tasya nityatvānnaitatsidhyati | ata | va bhāpyavārtikayoryogavibhāgasya
nopanyāsa iti || 
ejyotirjanapadarātrinābhināmagotrarupasthānavarṇavayovacanabandhuṣu
|| 6 - 3 - 85 || 
e sajyātiriti | samānaṃ jyotirasyeti bahuvrīhiḥ, yasmiñjyotiṣa
āditye nakṣatre vā upanipatitamānasyāstamayādanuvartamānamāśaucaṃ
sajyotirityucyate, sarupāṇāmekaśeṣaḥ, sthānāntādvibhāṣā,
sasthānena iti nirdheśādbahuvrīhāvapyayaṃ sabhāvo bhavati, na tu
pūrvoparaprathamacaramajaghanyasamāna iti pratipadokta eva tatpuruṣe || 
e caraṇe brahmacāriṇi || 6 - 3 - 86 || 
e caraṇaśabdaḥ kaṭhakalāpādaṃ śākhāviśeṣe mukhyaḥ, tadadhyāyiṣu
puruṣeṣu gauṇaḥ, tadiha mukhyo gṛhyate - samāno 
ebrahmacārī sabrahmacārīti, taccarati tadanutiṣṭhatītyarthaḥ | brahmacārīti |
vrate iti ṇiniḥ | evaṃ brahmacāriśabdaṃ nirupya sabrahmacārīśabdaṃ
nirvaktukāmaḥ samānaśabdasyārthamāha - pamānastasyaiva brahmaṇaḥ
saṇānatvāditi | tasyaiveti | pūrvamuktasya | itikaraṇo hetau,
yasmād brahmacāriṇāṃ samānatvaṃ tadvivakṣitaṃ tasmādayaṃ
vakṣyamāṇassabrahmacāriśabdasyārtho bhavati | tameva darśayatadi - samāne
brahmaṇīti | samāne sādhāraṇa ityarthaḥ | ekasminkāle ekena brahmaṇā
ekaśākhādhyayanārthaṃ yayorvratamādiṣṭṃa tāvanyo'nyaṃ
sabrahmacāriṇāvityarthaḥ | etacca caraṇagrahaṇāllabhyate, taddhicaraṇe samāne
yathā syādākārādau mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ kṛtam | evaṃ caraṇe
gamyamāne ityasyāpi caraṇe samānatvena gamyamāna ityayamartho draṣṭavyaḥ
|| 
etīrthe ye || 6 - 3 - 87 || 
e vibhāṣodare || yapratyayānta iti | pūrvasūtre ye iti yakārādeḥ
pratyayasya grahaṇaṃ yapratyayo'nte samīpe yasya sa tathoktaḥ | tatra yadā
sabhāvaḥ, tadā sodarādyaḥ, yadā tu na tadā samānodare śayitaḥ iti
yat || 
e dṛgdṛśavatuṣu || 6 - 3 - 89 || 
e vatugrahaṇamutarārthamiti | samānaśabde'sambhavāt | 
e dṛkṣe ceti | chāndasametaditi kecit | māṣye sadṛkṣam
tyinudāhṛtatvātasminpakṣe ksapratyayo'pi cchandasyeva || 
e idaṃ kimoriśkī || 6 - 3 - 90 || 
e iyānkiyāniti | ghasyeyādeśe kṛte yasyeti ca itīkāralopaḥ |
kimidammyāṃ vo gha iti vatubīti | nāsato vatupo vakārasya
ghakāraḥ śakyo vidhātumiti vatupo'pyanenaiva vidhānamiti bhāvaḥ ||

e ā sarvanāmnaḥ || 6 - 3 - 91 || 
e akāroccāraṇamato guṇo pararupatvaṃ mā bhūt | akāravidhānaṃ
tvantasya nivṛtyarthaṃ syāt, lopavidhau tu gauravaṃ bhavati || 
e viṣvagdevayośca deradra|lñcatau vapratyaye || 6 - 3 - 92 || 
e va pratyayo yasmātsa vapratyayaḥ | viṣvadra|lṅiti | añcateḥ kvini
lope ugidacām iti num, saṃyogāntalopaḥ, kvinpratyayasya kuḥ
iti kutvam - nakārasya ṅkāraḥ | adrisardhyoriti | vārtikasya
sādhāraṇatvādiha sadhraśabdepādānam, aśvamañcatīti aśvācī,
añcateścopa saṃkhyānam iti ṅīp acaḥ ityakāralopaḥ, cau iti
dīrghatvam | viṣvagyunaktīti viṣvagyuka, satmadviṣa ityādinā kvip
| viṣvagañcanamiti | lyuṭ | 
e kathaṃ puratra prasaṅgaḥ, yāvatā utarapade ityucyate, na
cātrāñcatirutarapadam, kiṃ tarhi lyuḍantam, na ca tadādividhirasti,
algrahaṇa eva tadādividhiḥ ityata āha vapratyayagrahaṇamiti | yadi
dhātugrahaṇe tadādividhirna syādvapratyayagrahaṇamakartavyaṃ syāt, kṛtaṃ
tu tadādividhiṃ jñāpayati | atra prayojanamāha teneti | apaskṛtamiti
| asati tu jñāpane ayaskṛdityādau yatra karotimātramutarapadaṃ
tatraiva syāt | 
e viśvācī ca dhṛtācī ceti | vedapāṭho'yaṃ pradaśitaḥ, na tu
pṛtājītyudāharaṇam prāptyabhāvāt | upasaṃkhyāne 
estriyām ityetena nāryaḥ, puṃsyapi hi kvacidadra|ladeśo na dṛśyate
| tasmādvipvañcau prāthaṇāpānāviti | kavrīcīti | kiṃśabdasya
ṭeradra|ladeśaḥ, pūrvavanṅīblopadīrghatvādi || 
e tirasaḥ tiryalope || 6 - 3 - 95 || 
e yadā'sya lopo na bhavīti | akārasya lope satītyayaṃ tvartho na
bhavati vyākhyānāt || 
e sadha mādasthayoścchandasi || 6 - 3 - 96 || 
e sadhamādo dyaumni iti kecidāhuḥ | asminmantredyaumnirityādikamapāṃ
viśeṣaṇam, sadhamāda ityapi tatsamānādhikaraṇaṃ śasantam, mādayateḥ
kvibantasya rupam| mādaḥ cchandasi sadhādeśo dṛśyate bahulam - ā
tvā vṛhanto harayo yujānāḥ, arvāgindrasaghamādo vahantu
ityādāvapīti | apara āha - madanaṃ mādaḥ, mado'nupasarge ityapi
prāpte chāndaso ghañ, tena saha vartata iti sadhamāda iti | revatīsthaḥ
sadhamādaḥ ityādau tu sadhamādau yajñaḥ, saha mādyanti devā asminniti
kṛtvā || 
e dvyantarupasargebhyo'pa īt || 6 - 3 - 97 || 
e udāharaṇeṣu dvirgatā āpo'sminnityādivigrahaḥ, ṛkpūbdhūḥ
ityakāraḥ samāsāntaḥ | 
e samāpaṃ nāmeti | ītve pratiṣidve anyeṣāmapi dṛśyate ityakārasya
dīrghaḥ | apara āha - samaśabdasyātra prayogaḥ, samā āpo'sminniti
samāpa iti | 
e apśabdaṃ pratītyādi | iha yatkriṃyāyuktāḥ prādayastaṃ
teṣāmupasargatvam, apśabdaśca na kriyāvacanaḥ, tasmādyasya
prāderanyatropasargatvaṃ tadupalakṣaṇārthamupasargagrahaṇaṃ vijñāyate || 
e ūdanordeaśe || 6 - 3 - 98 || 
e avagrahārthamiti | yatra samāsāvayavānāṃ rupāṇi pradarśyante
padakāraiḥ saḥ - avagrahaḥ || 
e aṣaṣṭha|ltṛtīyāsthasyānyasya
dugāśīrāśāsthasthitotsukotikārakarāgaccheṣu || 6 - 3 - 99 || 
e udārahaṇeṣu viśeṣaṇasamāsaḥ | gahādiṣvanyaśabdo draṣṭavya iti |
tepāmavṛtkṛtatvāt | 
e dugāgamo'viśeṣeṇetyādi | cchapratyaye parato'viśeṣeṇa
sāmānyena dukkartavyaḥ, kīdṛśe che sakārake, kārakaśabdasahite
kārakaśabde cetyarthaḥ | kārakacchayoriti pāṭhe
pūrvanipātalakṣaṇasyānityātvātasya paranipātḥ |
anyeṣvāśīrādiṣu saptasu ṣaṣṭītṛtīyayorneṣṭasteṣveva pratipedha
ityarthaḥ | 
e kathametallabhyate ityāha - asya ceti | aṣaṣṭhītṛtīyāsthasya ityeva
siddhe dvirnaña upādānaṃ pratiṣedhāsyānityatvajñāpanārtham,
vyākhyānaprakāraścāyam | śakyaṃ hi vaktuaṃ dvirnaña upādānaṃ
dārḍhyarthamiti | 
e koḥ katatparuṣe'ci || 6 - 3 - 101 || 
e udārahaṇeṣu kugatiprādayaḥ iti samāsaḥ | kūṣṭra iti | etadeva
tatpuruṣagrahaṇaṃ jñāpakam asminaprakaraṇe'pratipadokto'pi samāso
gṛhyata iti, tena jyotirjanapada iti sabhāvo bahuvrīhāvapi bhavati | 
e trāvupasaṃkhyānamiti | katryādibhyaḥ iti vacanātsiddham || 
e kā pathyakṣayoḥ || 6 - 3 - 104 || 
e anīṣadartha ārambhaḥ | kutsitaḥ panthāḥ kāpathaḥ | pūrvavatsamāsāntaḥ |
kākṣa iti | akṣaśabdena tatpuruṣaḥ, akṣiśabdena bahuvrīhirvā,
bahuvrīhau sakthyakṣṇoḥ iti ṣac || 
e īṣadarthe || 6 - 3 - 105 || 
e kāmadhuramiti | kugati iti samāsaḥ | kuḥ pāpārthaḥ ityetatu
prāyikam | kāmlamiti | nanu cātra koḥ katatpuruṣe'ci iti
kadbhāvaḥ prāpnoti, asya tvanajādiravakāśaḥ tatrāha - ajādāvapīti
|| 
e vibhāṣā puruṣe || 6 - 3 - 106 || 
e aprāptavibhāṣeyamiti | īṣadarthe ityasya nivṛtatvāt | 
e nanvevaṃ satyubhayatravibhāṣeyaṃ yuktā, īṣadarthe prāptatvāt, anyatra
cāprāptatvād ata āha - īṣadarthe tviti | īṣadarthe ca ityasyāvakāśaḥ -
kāmadhuramiti, vibhāṣā puruṣe ityasyāvakāśaḥ - kutsitaḥ puruṣaḥ
kāpuruṣaḥ īṣatpuruṣa ityatrobhayaprasaṅge pūrvavipratiṣedhaḥ || 
e kavañcoṣṇo || 6 - 3 - 107 || 
e cchandasyanyatrāpi dṛśyate - na kavādibhyo na hi te pṛṇantīti,
kavāśabdo'pi dṛśyate kevalaḥ - kavātiryaṃdi vopatiṣṭheteti,
īṣatirthaṅtyirthaḥ || 
e pṛṣodarādīni yathopadiṣṭam || 6 - 3 - 109 || 
e niruktādiśāstrasiddhānāmasamāsapadānām uṇādayo bahulam iti
saddhiruktā, anena tu samāsapadānāṃ jīmūtavalāhakādīnāṃ
siddhirucyate | prakāravacano'yamādiśabda iti darśayati
pṛṣodaraprakārāṇīti | vyavasthārthe tāvadiśabde
yathopadiṣṭamityanarthakamiti bhāvaḥ | prakāramāha - yeṣviti |
yathoyadiṣṭamiti | vīpsāyāmayamavyayībhāva ityāha - yāniyānīti |
diśiruccāraṇakriyaḥ, uccārya hi varṇānāha - upadiṣṭā ime varṇāḥ
iti, kaiḥ punarupadiṣṭāni śiṣṭeḥ | śiṣṭāḥ punarakāmātmāno
yathārthavedino yathāvihitabhāṣiṇaśca kiñcidantareṇa
kasyāścidvidyāyāḥ pāragāḥ, yānadhikṛtyedamucyate | 
e āvirbhūtaprakāśānāmanupaplutacetasām | 
e atītānāgatajñānaṃ pratyakṣānna viśiṣyate || 
e atīndriyānasaṃvedyān paśyantyārpaṇa cakṣuṣā | 
e ye bhāvānvacanaṃ teṣāṃ nānumānena bādhyate || iti | 
e yadi tarhi śiṣṭāḥ śabdeṣu pramāṇam, kimaṣṭādhyāthyā kriyate
śiṣṭaparijñānārthāṣṭādhyāyī | katham aṣṭādhyāyīmadhīyāno'nyaṃ
paśyatyanadhīyānam, ye cānuvihitāstān prayuñjānam | sa paśyati
- nūnamasya 
edaivānugrahaḥ svabhāvo vā yadasau nāṣṭādhyāyīmadhīte, atha cātra tu
vihitāḥ śabdāstānprayuṅkte, nūnamanyānapi ayaṃ jānāti | saiṣā
śiṣṭaparijñānārthāṣṭādhyāyī | 
e jīvanasya jalasya mūto bhācanaṃ jīmūtaḥ, yathā kusūlo
dhānyānām, kham - bilam | piśitam - māṃsam | bṛsī -
tṛṇamayamāsanam | evamanye'pītyādi | kapyaśvamahīśabdepūpapadeṣu
supi sthaḥ, sakārasya takāraḥ, mahīśabdasya hrasvaḥ | 
e dakṣiṇatāramiti | viśeṣaṇasamāsaḥ | vāgvāda iti | karmaṇyaṇ |
ṣoḍanniti | vayasi dantasya datṛ, ugitvānnum | 
e ghāsu neti | utvasyāyaṃ vikalpaḥ | utvapakṣe tu ṣṭuatvaṃ nityameva
bhavati, atrotarapadaśabdena dhāpratyayo'bhidhīyate | padyate
gamyate'nenārtha iti padam, utaraṃ ca tatpadaṃ ca utarapadam |
ṣaḍdheti | na padāntāṭṭoranām iti ṣṭuatvapratiṣedhaḥ |
nānādhikaraṇavācina iti | arthagataṃ bahutvaṃ śabde samāropya
dhāsviti bahuvacananirdeśaḥ, tena adhikaraṇavicāle ca iti vahitasya
dhāpratyayasyedaṃ grahaṇam | ṣaḍdheti | āto'nupasarge kaḥ striyāṃ
ṭāppratyayaḥ | lākṣaṇikatvādasyāgrahaṇamiti cet evamapi kvabante
prasaṅgaḥ |
