e nāśyata iti | ṇaśa adarśane ṇyantaḥ | dabhyata iti | dambhu dambhe | 
e svo rohāveti | loḍutamadvivacane | 
e varṇāgama ityādi | kau jīryata iti vṛñjara ityatra nakārasya
varṇasyāgamaḥ | hinastīti siṃha ityādyantayorvarṇayoviparyayo
vyatyāsaḥ | ṣoḍa ityatra ṣakārasyokārarupāpatiḥ varṇāvikāraḥ |
pṛṣodara ityādau takārādervarṇasya vināśaḥ | yasya dhātortho'rthaḥ
prasiddhaḥ, tasmādarthāntareṇa yogastadarthātiśayena yoga iti |
etatpañcavidhaṃ niruktam - nirvacanaprakāraḥ, śabdānāṃ tadantena
sūtreṇocyata iti ślokārthaḥ || 
e saṃkhyāvisāyapūrvasyāhrasyāhananyatarasyāṃ ṅai || 6 - 3 - 110 || 
e dvyahra iti | taddhitārtha iti samāsaḥ, kālāṭṭhañ, tasya
dvigorluganapatye iti luk, rājāhaḥ sakhibhyaṣṭac, ahro'hra
etebhyaḥ ityahrādeśaḥ | dvyahrīti | vibhāṣā ṅiśyoḥ
ityallopavikalpaḥ | vyahra iti |prādisamāsaḥ, śeṣaṃ pūrvavat | sāyāhra
iti | ekadeśisamāsaḥ | 
e nanu cāyaṃ pūrvāparādisūtre na paṭha|lte, tatkathamasyaikadeśisamāsaḥ
tatrāha - ekadeśisamāsa ityādi | ahro'hra etebhyaḥ ityatra
tatpuruṣasyāṅguleḥ saṃkhyāvyayādeḥ ahaḥ
sarvaikadeśasaṃkhyātapuṇyācca rātreḥ iti pakrāntāḥ saṃkhyādayaḥ
parāmṛśyanta | yadi ca pūrvādaya evaikadeśinā samāsyeranna | tataśca
tatra pūrvasyāhraśabdasyeha grahaṇamanupapannaṃ syāt | tasmātsāyaśabdasya
samāsastāvadanumīyate | tatra sidhyayati, taddarśayati - teneti |
syaterantakarmaṇaḥ sāyaśabdo ghañanto'haravasānavacanaḥ | pūrvāhṇa iti
| samāsādi pūrvavat, ahro'dantāt iti ṇatvam | 
e ḍhralope pūrvas dīrgho'ṇaḥ || 6 - 3 - 111 || 
e rephe akāra uccāraṇārthaḥ | yadyayaṃ ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣaḥ syāt, tadāṇaḥ
pūrvatvaṃ nopapadyate, lopasyābhāvarupatvāt | athāpi
buddhiparikalpitaṃ paurvāparyamāśrīyate evamapi
karaṇīyamityādāvapyanīyaro rephasya lope parataḥ pūrvasya
dīrghaprasaṅga iti tatpuruṣe evaṃ doṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā
kaṇṭhekālavadvyadhikaraṇapado bahuvrīhirityāha -
ḍhakārarephayorlopo yasminniti | atra liṅgam - bhavyageyapravacanīya
iti nirdeśaḥ | līḍhamiti | liha āsvādane, niṣṭhā,
ḍhatvadhatvaṣṭuatvaḍhalopeṣu rupam, miha secane, guha saṃvaraṇe, muha
naicitye | pūrvagrahaṇamanarthakam, tasminniti nirdiṣṭe pūrvasya iti
siddheḥ ityata āha - pūrvagrahaṇamityādi | sati pūrvagrahaṇe yadyapi
ḍhalope vacanaprāmāṇyādanutarapade'pi syāt, ralope tvanutarapade
na syāt nīraktamityādābutarapadasyāpi sambhāvta | ātṛḍhamiti |
tṛhūhiṃsāyām yasya vibhāṣā itīṭpratiṣedhaḥ | kvacidādṛḍhamiti
pāṭhaḥ, tadasat ,seṭtvādasya dhātoḥ dṛḍhaḥ sthūlabalayoḥ iti
halopo nipātyate | āvṛḍhamiti vṛhū udyamane || 
e sahivahorodavarṇasya || 6 - 3 - 112 || 
e ūḍha iti | atrāsatyāvarṇagrahaṇe vah - ta iti sthite na tāvadotvaṃ
ḍhalopanimittvat | atra 
epūrvatrāsiddham iti ḍhatvādīnāmasiddhatvātpūrvaṃ
yajāditvātsamprasāraṇam, tasminkṛte pūrvatve vokārasyotvaṃ
prāpnoti | 
e bhāṣve tvāvarṇagrahaṇaṃ pratyākhyātam | antaraṅgaṇi ḍhatvādīni,
varṇāśrayatvāt bahiraṅgaṃ samprasāraṇ,
pratyayaviśeṣatvātasyāpyasiddhatvāt pūrvatrāsiddham
ityasyānupasthānam | yadvā - ḍhalopasyautvadīrghavidhau
nimitatvenāśrayaṇādatra viṣaye ḍhatvādīnāmasiddhatvaṃ nāsti, tataḥ
prāgeva samprasāraṇātparatvāt ḍhatvādiṣu kṛteṣu vaḍha iti sthite
samprasāraṇaṃ ca prāpnoti, otvaṃ ca paratvādotvam, tataḥ
samprasāraṇam | pūrvatvaṃ ca na punarotvam, tasmanneva prayoge
kṛtatvātadabhāve nimitasadbhāvād dīrghatvaṃ pravartiṣyata iti | 
e varṇagrahaṇaṃ kimiti | odasyeti vaktavyamiti praśnaḥ |
kṛtāyāmapītyādi | utpūrvādvaherluṅ tāmāidiṣu sici vṛddhau
salopaḍhatvādīni | tatredānīmasati varṇagrahaṇe mātrikasyocyamāno
dīrghasya na syāta | nanvavarṇaḥ savarṇān gṛhṇātītyākārasyāpi
grahaṇaṃ bhavati tatrāha - tādapi parastapara iti | idameva varṇagrahaṇaṃ
liṅgaṃ taparastatkālasya ityatra pañcamīsamāso'pyāśrīyata iti |
tenaitanna codanīyam - sahivahorasyait ityevaṃ kasmānna kṛtamiti
|| 
esāḍha|lè sāḍhvā sāḍheati nigame || 6 - 3 - 113 || 
e sāḍheati tṛci rupamiti | apapāṭho'yam, āpāḍho'gnirbuhadvayāḥ,
āpāḍhamugraṃ sahamānam, āṣāḍhṃa yutsu pṛtanāsu, āṣāḍhāya
sahamānāya ityādau niṣṭhāyāmātvādarśanāt | tasmānnaṣṭhāyāṃ
rupamiti pāṭhaḥ | sūtravṛtau ca sāḍheati hrasvāntaṃ chetavyam | yadi
tṛjante'pi kvacidātvaṃ dṛśyate, tadānyataratsūtre itikaraṇasya
prakārārthatvātsādhyam || 
e saṃhitāyām || 6 - 3 - 114 || 
e anantarairyaugairatarapade kāryaṃ vidhīyate, utarapadaṃ ca samāse
bhavati | tatra nityameva saṃhitayā bhavitavyam saṃhitaikapade
nityeti vacanāt | avagrahe'pi kvacitkāryaṃ dṛśyate, kvacinna, ikaḥ
kāśe anūkāśamityanu - kaśamiti, aṣṭanaḥ saṃjñāyām,
aṣṭābandhuramityaṣṭā - bandhuramiti | ato na teṣvavaśyamasyopayoga
iti | yatrānutarapade kāryaṃ vidhīyate tadudāharati - vakṣyati
dvyaco'tastiṅ iti | atra hi tiṅntasya samāsāsambhavādutarapada iti
na sambadhyate | vadmā hi tveti | viderlaṭ, mas, vido laṭo vā
|| 
ekarṇe lakṣaṇasyāviṣṭāṣṭapañcamaṇibhinnacchinnacchidrasruvasvastikasya || 6 -
3 - 115 || 
e tadiha lakṣaṇaṃ gṛhyata iti | tatraiva lakṣaṇaśabdasya prasiddhatvāt
viṣṭādiparyudāsācca | dātrādiśabda upamānātadākāre cihrae vartate
|| 
e nahivṛttivṛṣivyadhirucisahitaniṣu kvau || 6 - 3 - 116 || 
e upanahyate ityupānat, sampadāditvātkarmaṇi kvap, naho dhaḥ |
parīṇaditi | upasargādasamāse'pi ṇatvam | nīvṛdīti | nīvṛdādau
kartari kvip, vyadhergrahijyādisamprasāraṇam | ṛtīṣāhamiti |
pūrvapadāt iti ṣatvam | parītaditi | anudāteti lopasya
kṅjjhilnimitakatvāt kvau ca tadabhāvād
gamādīnāmitītyanunāsikalope tuk || 
e vanagiryoḥ saṃjñāyāṃ koṭarakiśulakādīnām || 6 - 3 - 117 || 
e koṭarāvaṇamiti | vanaṃ puragā iti ṇatvam || 
evale || 6 - 3 - 118 || 
e valacpratyayo gṛhyata iti | vakṣyamāṇena matupā sāharyāt | tena vala
saṃvaraṇe ityataḥ pacādyaci yatprātipadikaṃ tatra dīrgho na bhavati | 
e aṇa ityeva - bhartuvalaḥ || 
ematau vahvaco'najirādīnām || 6 - 3 - 119 || 
e saṃjñāyāmiti matorvatvamiti | yadyapyudāhṛteṣu mādupadhāyāḥ iti
vatvaṃ siddham, tathāpi saṃjñāyāmatrāpi paratvādanenaiva vatvaṃ yuktam
| pratyudāharaṇe ca vrīhimatītyatrāpi nānena
vatvamityetadupanyastam | ajirādiṣvabahvacāṃ pāṭha uṣasamastārthaḥ || 
e iko vahe'pīloḥ || 6 - 3 - 121 || 
e ṛṣīvahādayaḥ ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ | vahaśabdaḥ pacādyajantaḥ || 
eupasargasya ghañyanuṣye bahulam || upasargād
ghaño'vidhānādutarapadādhikāre'pyatra tadantavidhirvijñāyata ityāha -
ghañanta utarapade iti | vīmārga iti | mṛjervṛddhiḥ | 
e kṛtrimam - karaṇena nirvṛtam |
puruṣavyāpārābhinirvṛtamityarthaḥ | 
e niṣīdatyasminpāpamiti niṣādaḥ, halaśca iti ghañ || 
eikaḥ kāśe || 6 - 3 - 123 || 
e pacādyacpratyayānto'yaṃ kāśaśabda iti | naghañantaḥ, tatra pūrveṇaiva
siddham | yathā nigame - prākāśāvadhvaryave dadātīti | iko
vahe'pīloḥ ityatra pūrvapadamātrasyeṣyate, iha tūpasargasya tena
dvirika ityuktam || 
e dasti || 6 - 3 - 124 || 
e dā ityetasyādi | atra takārādiśabdaḥ karmadhārayaḥ | tasminparata iti
| yasminvidhistadādau iti vacanātadādāvutarapade parata ityarthaḥ |
dā ityetasya sambandhī yastakārastadādāvutarapade dīrgha ityeṣo'rtho
vivakṣitaḥ | nītamiti | nanu cātra takāra ādirna bhavati, yastāvad
aca upasargātaḥ iti takāraḥ sa alo'ntyasya ityantasya kriyate, yo'pi
dakārasya khari ca iti takāraḥ, so'pyasmindīrghe kartavye'siddhaḥ ata
āha - aca upasargāta ityādi | ucyate cedaṃ takārādāvutarapada taiti
| yadi cartvamasiddhaṃ syād, dīrghavidhiranarthakaḥ syāt, ata
āśrayātsiddhaṃ cartvam | tena takāra ādirutarapadasya sambhavatītyarthaḥ |
yadyapīti | anenaitaddarśayati - dvitakārapakṣasyāśrayaṇe na
kiñcidvaktavyamiti | sudatamiti || 
e avadataṃ vidataṃ ca pradataṃ cādikarmaṇi | 
e sudatamanudataṃ ca nidataṃ ceti ceṣyate || 
e ityanayeṣṭa|la'tra dadādeśaḥ || 
ecchandasi ca || 126 || 
e aṣṭākapālamiti | ānmahataḥ ityatrāṣṭanaḥ kapāle haviṣīti aṣṭāgavaṃ
śakaṭamiti ca vyutpāditam, idaṃ tu
vyutvativikalpapradarśanārthamātvaṃ vā, dīrgho veti || 
e viśvasya vasurāṭoḥ || 6 - 3 - 128 || 
e viśvārāḍhiti | viśvasmitrājata iti satsūdviṣa ityādinā kvip |
yatrāsyaitaditi | padasaṃjñāviṣayaṃ ityarthaḥ || 
e ṛci tunughamakṣutaṅkṛtroruṣyāṇām || 6 - 3 - 133 || 
emantre iti prakṛti ṛggrahaṇaṃ mantraviśeṣapratipatyartham | gha iti
svarupagrahaṇam, na taraptamapoḥ, cchandasi ghaśabdasyaiva dīrghadarśanāt |
uta vā ghā syālāditi | bhāryāyā bhrātā syālaḥ tataḥ pañcamī | taṅiti
thādeśasya ṅtvipakṣe grahaṇamiti | loṇmadhyamapuruṣabahuvacanasya thasya
loṭo laṅvat ityatideśena yastādeśastasya yadā ṅtviṃ tadā
grahaṇamityarthaḥ | 
eśrṛṇota grāvāṇa iti | taptanaptanathanāśca iti tabādeśaḥ | atra
pitvānṅtviṃ nāsti | taṅiti pratyāhāragrahaṇamiti tu vṛtau na
kvāpi pāṭho dṛśyate | yacca tatroktam -
loṇmadhyamapuruṣabahuvacanādārabhya ā mahiṅe ṅkāratpratyāhāraḥ iti,
tadāpyayuktam asanniviṣṭena pratyāhārāyogāt | uruṣyā ṇa iti |
ruṣyatiḥ kaṇḍvādiyaganto rakṣatikarmā loṭ, serhiḥ, ato
heḥ iti luk, na ityasya naśca dhātusthoruṣubhyaḥ iti ṇatvam || 
eikaḥ suñiḥ || 6 - 3 - 134 || 
e suñiti nipātasya grahaṇam, tasya ca ñakāro'traiva viśeṣaṇārthaḥ |
ūṣuṇa iti | ukārasya dīrghaḥ || 
edvyaco'tastiṅḥ || 6 - 3 - 135 || 
e bhavateti | loṇmadhyamapuruṣabahuvacanam | vakṣi, yakṣīti |
baheryajeśca leḍ, sip | sibbahulaṃ leṭi ityayaṃ 
etu vidhirna bhavati, bahuvacanāt | bahulaṃ cchandasi iti śapo luk,
vaherḍhatvam, yajeḥ ṣatvam, ṣaḍhoḥ kaḥ si dvayorapi | devānāvaha
yaja ca ityagniṃ prati bharadvājasya vacanam || 
eniṣātasya ca || 6 - 3 - 136 || 
e evaśabdaścādiṣu pāṭhānnipātaḥ, accha gatyarthavadeṣu ityacchaśabdaḥ || 
eanyeṣāmapi dṛśyate || 6 - 3 - 137 || 
e mantre iti nivṛtam| keśākeśīti | tatra tenedam ityādinā
bahuvrīhiḥ, ic karmavyatihāre | jalāṣāḍiti | cchandasi sahaḥ iti
ṇviḥ, saheḥ sāḍaḥ saḥ iti ṣatvam | pūruṣa iti | puruṣaśabdasyādyaco
dīrghaḥ | 
e sunodantetyādi | tatra śvādaṃṣṭ iti bahuvrīhiḥ | anyatra
tatpuruṣaḥ, bahuvrīhirvā | daṃṣṭreti hrasvāntasya grahaṇāddīrghante nāyaṃ
dīrgho bhavatītyāhuḥ | anye tu dīrghāntameva
paṭhanto'viśeṣeṇecchanti || 
e cau || 6 - 3 - 137 || 
e añcatirgṛhyata iti | cavargasya tu grahaṇaṃ na bhavati vyākhyānāt |
daghīca iti | nanu cāntaraṅgatvādyaṇādeśenaiva prāgbhavitavyam,
akāralopo bhasya vidhīyate, bhasaṃjñā ca yakārādāvajādau ca
sambhavatīti bahiraṅgaḥ, dīrghatvaṃ tu lopamapekṣata iti
bahiraṅgam ata āha - antaraṅgo'pīti | evaṃ manyate - iha
dīrghaśrutyā acaśca ityupatiṣṭhate, tatrācā pūrvapadaṃ viśeṣyate -
ajantasya pūrvapadasyeti | yadi ca yaṇāadeśaḥ syānna
kvāpyajantapūrvapadaṃ syāt | prāca ityādāvapi pūrvameva
savarṇadīrghatvaprasaṅgaḥ, tasmādantaraṅgo'pi vidhirbādhyata iti | atra
ca liṅgaṃ pratīca iti nirdeśaḥ || 
e samprasāraṇasya || 6 - 3 - 139 || 
e akṛta evetyādi | kārīṣagandhiputra iti sthite hrasvatvaṃ ca
prāpnoti, anena dīrghatvaṃ ca tasyāvakāśaḥ - grāmaṇi kulam,
hrasvābhāvapakṣe dīrghasyāvakāśaḥ, pakṣāntare ubhayaprasaṅgaḥ | yadyapi
hrasvābhāvapakṣe sāvakāśaṃ dīrghatvam, tathāpi tena paratvād hrasvo
bādhyate | 
e athedānīṃ dīrghe kṛte punaḥ prasaṅgaḥ kasmānna bhavati tatrāha - punaḥ
prasaṅgavijñānaṃ ceti | 
e iti śrīharadatamiśraviracitāyāṃ padamañjaryāṃ ṣaṣṭhasyādhyāyasya
tṛtīyaḥ pādaḥ|e atha ṣaṣṭhādhyāye caturthaḥ pādaḥ 
eaṅgasya || 6 - 4 - 1 || 
e adhikāro'yamiti | svaritatvāt | iha kecinmanyante -
prāgabhyāsavikārebhyo'yamaṅgādhikāraḥ | evaṃ hi guṇo
yaṅlukoḥ ityatra lugprahaṇaṃ na kartavyaṃ bhavati, katham
pratyayalakṣaṇenaiva siddham | yadi tvabhyāsavikāre'pyayamadhikāraḥ
syāt, tato'ṅgādhikāravihitamiti na lumatāṅgasya iti
pratiṣedhaḥ syāditi | vṛttikārastu manyate - yadi
prāgabhyāsavikārebhyo'ṅgādhikāraḥ, vavraśceti vṛścaterliṭi
liṭa|lbhyāsasyobhayeṣām iti rephasya samprasāraṇe uradatve
halādiśerṣe ca kṛte vakārasyāpi samprasāraṇaṃ prāpnoti, tasya na
samprasāraṇe samprasāraṇam iti pratiṣedha iṣyate, sa na prāpnoti
uradatvasyāsamprasāraṇatvāt | na ca tasya sthānivatvam,
aparanimitatvāt | ā saptamādhyāyaparisamāpteḥ punaraṅgādhikāre
satyuradatvaṃ parinimitakaṃ bhavati, aṅgena svanimitasya
pratyayasyākṣepāt | yadaṣyuktam - luggrahaṇaṃ na kartavyaṃ bhavatīti,
tadapi na na hi tatrāṅgādhikāravihitasyaiva pratiṣedhaḥ, kasya tarhi
lumatā lupte pratyaye vastuto yadaṅgaṃ tasya pāraptaṃ
yatkāryamāṅgamanāṅga vā tasya sarvasya pratiṣedhaḥ |
tasmādāsaptamādhyāyaparisamāpterayamaṅgādhikāro yukta iti | hūta
ityādau yajāditvātsamprasāraṇam | jīna iti | grahijyā iti sūtreṇa
samprasāraṇam, lvādibhyaḥ iti niṣṭhānatvam | 
e nirutam, turutamiti | gheñ tantusantāne, yajādiḥ,
atrāṅge'nantarbhūtayornirduroravayavau yau halau tadāśrayaṃ
dīrghatvaṃ na bhavati | krimiṇāmiti | krimipāmanśabdābhyāṃ matvarthe
pāmādibhyo naḥ, pāmano nalopaḥ, striyāṃ ṭāp, dvitīyaikavacanam
| atra nāmiti samudāyasyāpratyayatvānna tadapekṣaṃ pūrvasyāṅgatvamiti
napratyayāpekṣayā'ṅgatve'pi dīrghatvaṃ na bhavati, pāmanāmityatra
nalope kṛte'jantatvād dīrghaprasaṅgaḥ | na ca nalopasyāsiddhatvam,
asubvidhitvāt | na hyasyāṃ daśāyāṃ dīrghatvaṃ subvidhirbhavati | astu
vā'siddhatvam, nopadhāyāḥ iti dīrghatvaprasaṅgaḥ | 
e bhismā - odanaḥ bhissadā- didhi | nanu krimiṇāmityatra
pratyayasyārthavatve'pi samudāyo'narthakaḥ, parasparāsambandhāt, evaṃ
bhissābhissadayorbhisśabdaḥ, tataśca arthavadgrahaṇe nānarthakasya ityeva
na bhaviṣyati tatrāha - aṅgā dhikāra ityādi |
sansamprasāraṇadīrghatvaitvatātaṅyiṅvaṅnuṭhrasvatvatve
cāṅgasyetyadhikāre prayojanam | sani dīrghaḥ prayojanam - dadhi
sanotīti dadhisetyatra mā bhūt | samprasāraṇadīrghatvam - nirutam,
durutabhityatra mā bhūt | etvama erliṅ vānyisya saṃyogādeḥ
niryāyāt, nirvāyādityatra mā bhūt | tātaṅ - nipātsya tormā
bhūt, jīva tu tvam | ivaṇuvadṛ - śayartham, vartham ityatra mā bhūt
| nuṭ - hrasvanadyāpo nuṭ, kumārī āmityāhetyatra mā bhūt |
hrasvatvam - ke'ṇaḥ, kumārī kasmai spṛhayati, kumāryāḥ kaṃ sukhaṃ
kumārīkamityatra mā bhūt | tatvam - apo phiḥ abbhāra ityatra mā
bhūdityevamarthaṃ kartavyo'ṅgādhikāraḥ | so'nyārthaḥ kṛto
nāmītyatrāpi dīrghatvaṃ vyavasthāpayati - abhimate viṣaye niyamayati |
arthavadgrahaṇaparibhāṣayeti | upalakṣaṇametat | anane muk, prāṇa
ityatra mā bhūt| akṛtsārvadhātukayodīrghaḥ dadhi yātamityatra mā
bhūt - ityevamarthaṃ lakṣaṇapratipadoktaparibhāṣā, nañivayuktanyāyaśca
nāśrayitavyo bhavati | 
e ṣaṣṭhī sthāneyogā iti vacanādaṅgasyeti sthānaṣaṣṭhīyam, tataśca
ato bhisa ais ityatrāta iti pañcamyantamaṅgasyetyasya ṣaṣṭha|lntasya
sāmānādhikaraṇyena viśeṣaṇaṃ nopapadyate ityakāramātrasya grahaṇāt
brāhmaṇabhissetyādāvapi prasaṅgaḥ | avayavaṣaṣṭha|ladīnāṃ cāprasiddhiḥ,
tataśca ūdupadhāyāṃ gohaḥ aṅgasya iti sthānaṣaṣṭha|la
antye'lyupasaṃhārād gohaścāntyasya syāt, upadhāyāśca iti
vacanādupadhāmātrasya ca | evaṃ śāsa idaṅhaloḥ
ityādāvapītyāśaṅkāyāmāha - aṅgasyeti sambandhasāmānye ṣaṣṭhīti
| ayamabhiprāyaḥ - adhikāro'yam, sa ca pararthaḥ, ṣaṣṭhīsthāne yogā
ityapi paribhāṣā parārthā, na ca parārthayoḥ parasparaṃ sambandho'sti,
yaśroktam - guṇānāṃ ca parārthatvādasambandhaḥ samātvātsyāt iti,
tataścāṅgasyeti ṣaṣṭhī svabhāvaprayuktaṃ
sambandhasāmānyamevārthamabhidhata iti | yathāyogamiti | yasminyoge
yasya sambandhaviśeṣasyābhivyañjakamasti tasminyoge tatraiva viśeṣe
paryavasyatītyarthaḥ | 
etadyathā hanterjaḥ tyādiu sthānaṣaṣṭhī, ūdupadhāyā gohaḥ
ityavayavaṣaṣṭhī, yuvoranākau ityādau nimitanimitisambandha ṣaṣṭhī,
lokavat, tadyathā - loke devadatasyetyabhedena prakṛtā ṣaṣṭhī- putraḥ
pāṇiḥ kambala iti pratisambandhavaśātatratatra viśeṣe paryavasyati | 
e atha vetyādi | pūrva vivakṣito'pi ṣaṣṭha|lrthaḥ sāmānyarupa ityuktam,
idānī tu prayogāsādhutvāyaiva ṣaṣṭhayuccāryate, na
tvarthavivakṣayetyucyate | avaśyaṃ ca yayā kayācana vibhaktayā
nirddeṣṭavyam | ṣaṣṭha|lnurodhastu bāhulyena
tadarthasyopayokṣyamāṇatvāt | yathāyogaṃ vibhaktiṣu vipariṇamyata
iti | lokavadeva | tadyayā - uccāni devadatasya gṛhāṇi, āḍhyo
vaidhaveyo devadataḥ, āmantrayasvainaṃ devadatam, kimanena kṛtyaṃ
devadateneti, tena ato bhisa ais ityatra pañcamyā vipariṇāme sati
akārāntadaṅgadityayamarthe bhavati | ādiśabdena yuṣmadasmadbhyāṃ
ṅso'ś ityevamādirgṛhyate | apiśabdenaitaddarśayati - na kevalaṃ
ṣaṣṭha|lrtha eva sasa viśeṣaḥ sidhyati, api tu pañcamyarthe'piti | pūrvatra
tu pakṣe ato bhisa ais ityatra nimitanimitisambandhe ṣaṣṭhī -
aṅgasya nimitaṃ yo bhis | kaścāṅgasya nimitam
yasminnaṅgamityetadbhavati | kasmiṃścaitadbhavati pratyaye || 
ehalaḥ || 6 - 4 - 2 || 
e hala iti kimiti | kenedānīmudāharaṇeṣu dīrghasiddhaḥ eṣaṃ manyate
- yathā śeṣe iti lakṣaṇaṃ cādhikāraśca, tathāṅgasyetyetadapi,
tataścābhimate viṣaye dīrgho bhaviṣyatīti | atiprasaṅga iti
tūtaram | viddhaḥ, vicita iti | vyadhatāḍane, vyaca vyājīkaraṇe,
grahijyā ityādinā samprasāraṇam | 
e aṇa ityeveti | ḍhralope pūrvasya dīrgho'ṇaḥ ityataḥ | na ca tasya ikaḥ
kāśe itiggrahaṇena vicchedaḥ | tatra hi
virodhābhāvādiggrahaṇenāṇeva viśeṣyate - iko'ṇa iti |
athedānīm cau ityārabhyāṇa ityevānuvartiṣyate, neka iti |
tṛtiyeti vā nipātanāditi | mā nāmāṇa ityetadanuvṛtat,
dvitīyatṛtīyacaturtheti yo'yaṃ nirddeśastasmādeva
nipātanādanaṇo dīrghatvaṃ na bhaviṣyatītyarthaḥ | 
e nanvekamaṅgagrahaṇaṃ prakṛtaṃ taddhalo yadi | 
e viśeṣaṇaṃ syātkāryitvamaṅgasyeha na labhyate || 
e tataśca viddhamityādāvapi dīrghaḥ prasaḍa|lte | 
e atha nirdiśyate kārthī nāhalaḥ syādviśeṣaṇam || 
e tato nirutamityādāvapi dīrghatvamāpatet | 
e sakṛcchutasya caikasya yujyate nobhayārthatā || 
e ata āha - aṅgagrahaṇamityādi | 
e āvartamānaṃ vasvekamapyanekasya śeṣatām | 
e bhajate bhājanaṃ yadvannṛṇāmasahabhojane || 
enāmi || 6 - 4 - 3 || 
e nāmityetasya śāstre kvacidapyavihitatvātatparijñānārthamāha -
nāmiti ṣaṣṭhībahuvacanamityādi | nāmīti dīrghapāṭhastu na
samācīnaḥ | āgatanuṭkamiti | gatyarthatvādrameḥ kamaṇi kartari vā
ktaḥ | āgato nuḍa|lena āgato vā nuḍa|lṃ tadā gatanuṭkam |
agnīnāmityādi | akārantasya tu supi ca iti dīrghaḥ siddhaḥ | 
ekartaṇāmiti | nanvaṇa iti vartate tatrāha - aṇa ityetaditi | na
tisṛcatasṛ iti pratiṣedhāditi bhāvaḥ | 
e utarārthamiti | nopadhāyāḥ iti dīrghatvaṃ sanuṭke āmi yathā
syāt - pañcānām, saptānām, ṣaṭcatubhyaśca iti nuṭ
carmaṇāmityādāvanuṭke mā bhūt | kṛte ca nuṭi
dīrghatvapratipatyarthamiti | āgatanuṭkasya grahaṇamityanuṣaṅgaḥ |
anyathā hītyādi | yadyāgatanuṭkasya grahaṇaṃ na kriyate, tataḥ agni -
ām iti sthite dīrghatvaṃ ca prāpnoti, nuṭ ca paro nuṭ, nityaṃ
dīrghatvam, kṛte'pi nuṭiprāprotyakṛte'pi, tato dīrghe
kṛte'hrasvatvānnuḍeva na syāt, yo'yaṃ siddhānte
nimitatvenopādānādayatnena siddho nuṭ, sa eva na
syādityevaśabdasyārthaḥ | nanu cāha cāyaṃ hrasvāntānnuḍiti , na ca
nityatvāddīrghe kṛte kvacidapi hrasvāntamasti, tata evaṃ vijñāsyāmaḥ -
bhūtapūrva yad hrasvāntamiti, nanu cedaṃ samprati hrasvāntamasti, na
tisṛcatasṛ tisṛṇām, 
ecatasṛṇām naitadasti iha tāvaccatasṛṇāmiti ṣaṭcaturbhyaśca iti
nuṭ siddhaḥ tisṛṇāmityatrāpi hrasvanadyāpo nuṭ ityatra trestrayaḥ
ityatastrerityanuvṛtereva nuṭ siddhaḥ | yadā tarhi nṛ ca iti
dīrghatva pratiṣadhastadāstyavakāśaḥ na caikamudārahaṇaṃ yogārambhaṃ
prayojayati, yadyetāvatprayojanaṃ syāt nṛnadyāpo nuṭ ityeva
brūyāt, hrasvagrahaṇātu bhūtapūrvagativiṃjñāyate | yadyevam, asthnām,
dadhnām, asthidadhisakthyakṣṇām tyinaṅ kṛte'ipi bhūtapūrvametad
hrasvāntamiti nuṭ prāpnoti, tataśca nopadhāyāḥ iti dīrghatve
nalope ca asthānāmiti prāpnoti | yadvā - yadā nuṅvidhau
bhūtapūrvagatistadā nuṇnityo bhavati, anaṅ tvanitya iti pūrvaṃ
nuṭi kṛti'sthīnāmiti prāpnoti, dvipadāmityādau pādasya lope
kṛte nuṭprasaṅgaḥ | evam paddannomās ityatra ye
hrasvāntasyādeśāsteṣvapi prasaṅgo yojyaḥ, tasmānna śakyaṃ
bhūtapūrvagativijñānam | yaccoktam - trerityanuvṛtereva
tisṛṇāmityatra nuṭ siddha iti tadapyapramāṇam, na hi
dvayoranyatarasya vā'pekṣāyāmasatyāṃ cakāre cāsatyanuvṛttiḥ
svadhyavasānā | tasmād - anyathā hi nuḍeva na syādita sthitimetat
| 
e ukta evārthe saṃgrahaślokaṃ paṭhiti | nāmidīrgha iti | yadi
nuṭamakṛtvā āmītyeva sūtraṃ kriyetetyarthaḥ | vacanāditi |
vacanasāmarthyād bhūtapūrvagativijñāyata iti bhāvaḥ | yatra tannāstīti
| tisṛṇāmityatra yatra dīrghatvaṃ nāsti sa vacanasyāvakāśa ityarthaḥ |
nopadhāyāśceti | caśabdaḥ samuccaye || 
ena tisṛcatasṛ || 6 - 4 - 4 || 
e sūtre ṣaṣṭhīdvavacanasya lukā nirddeśaḥ | tisṛṇām, catasṛṇāmiti
| kathaṃ punaratra dīrghaprasaṅgaḥ, yāvatā'jantasya dīrgho nāmīti, na
cātrājantatā sambhavati, katham tisṛ - ām iti sthite nuṭ
prāpnoti, aci ra ṛtaḥ iti rādeśāśca, paratvādrādeśaḥ tatrāha -
idameveti || 
ecchandasyubhayathā || 6 - 3 - 5 || 
e tisṛ catasṛ ityetayoriti | aviśeṣeṇa tu vikalpo dṛśyate ayaṃ
pitṛṇāmagniḥ, dhātā dhātṛṇāmiti taitirīke hrasvaḥ, vahvṛce
dīrghaḥ || 
enṛ ca || 6 - 4 - 6 || 
e kecidatreti | cchandasyubhayathā ityataḥ | yetvanuvartayanti te
pūrvasūtre tisṛcatasṛgrahaṇamanuvartayanti || 
enopadhāyāḥ || 6 - 3 - 7 || 
e anajantārtha ārambhaḥ, na iti ṣaṣṭha|lekavacanāntam |
sautratvānnirddeśaḥ, akāraścoccāraṇārtha iti | pañcānāmityādau
subvidhau nalopasyāsiddhatvānnāntatvam | upadhāgrahaṇamādyaco mā bhūt
| naitadasti prayojanam - dīrghaśrutyopasthāpitamacaṃ nāmparatayā
viśeṣayiṣyāmaḥ , utaratra ca sarvanāmasthānaparatayā, tatra yena
nāvyavadhānamityekena varṇena vyavadhāne bhaviṣyati utarārtha tu
inhanpūrṣāryamṇāṃ śau ityatra dīrghavidherupadhāniyamāt iti
vakṣyati, tadārthamupadhāgrahaṇam || 
e sarvanāmasthāne cāsambuddhī || 6 - 4 - 8 || 
e rājanīti | vibhāṣā ṅiśyoḥ ityillopābhāvapakṣe
dīrghatpaprasaṅgaḥ | evaṃ carmaṇāmityādāvapi prasaṅgaḥ || 
e vā ṣapūrvasya nigame || 6 - 4 - 9 || 
e atra dīrghaśrutyopasthāpitasyāco viśeṣeṇamupadhāgrahaṇam |
ṣapūrvasya ityetadapi tasyaiva viṣeṣaṇam, tena
puṃlliṅgasyāvirodha iti manyamāna āha - ṣapūrvasyāca iti |
ṛbhukṣaṇamiti | ṛbhukṣiśabda uṇāadiṣu nipātitaḥ ,
ityo'tsarvanāmasyāne ityakāraḥ || 
esāntamahatassaṃyogasya || 6 - 4 - 10 || 
e sakāre'kāra uccāraṇārthaḥ, so'nto yasya sa sāntaḥ | sānteti
pṛthakpadaṃ luptaṣaṣṭhīkaṃ saṃyogasya viśeṣaṇam, tadviśiṣṭasaṃyogo
nakārasya viśeṣaṇam, mahacchabdo'pi tasyaiva viṣeṣaṇ,
sarvanāmasthāne ityanenānuvṛtena sāntaḥ saṃyogo mahacchabdaśca
viśeṣyate, tena haṃsaḥ, haṃsāvityatra dīrghābhāvaḥ | mahataśceti | yo
nakāra ityapekṣyate | tasyeti nakārasya, kaḥ punarnakārasyopadhāyāśca
sambandhaḥ, yāvatā yasminsamudāye yo'ntyādalaḥ pūrvaḥ sa taṃ
pratyupadhā satyam iha tu gatyabhāvāt sāmīpyalakṣaṇaḥ sambandhaḥ, 
enakārasamīpavartinyāstameva nakārāntaṃ samudāyaṃ pratyupadhāyā
ityarthaḥ | kalpasūtreṣu ca prauḍho'yaṃ vyavahāraḥ tadyathā -
visarjanīyo'natyakṣaropadho riṣita iti | śreyāniti | praśasyasya śraḥ
, ugidacām iti num | śreyāṃsīti | jaśśasoḥ śiḥ, napuṃkasya
jhalacaḥ iti num | mahāniti | bṛhanmahacchatṛvacca iti vacanād
ugidacām iti num ||

eaptṛntṛcsvasṛnaptṛneṣṭaḥtvaṣṭaḥtvaṣṭḥakṣatṛhotṛpotṛpraśāstṛṇām || 6 - 4 - 11 || 
e āpa iti | apśabdasya nityaṃ bahuvacanāntatvād
dvivacanaikavacanayorasambhavaḥ | bahvāmpīti | bahuvrīhiḥ |
aṅgādhikāre tasya ca tadutarapadasya ca iti tadantavidhirabhyupagataḥ |
kiṃ punaratreṣṭavyam, na tāvad ṛkpūrabdhūḥ iti prāptasya
samāsāntasyābhāvaḥ ityāha - tatreti | yatpunareṣṭavyaṃ taddarśayati -
nityamapīti | kṛtākṛtaprasaṅgitvānnityo num | 
e janāpavādāniti | na lokāvyaya ityādinā tṛnyoge
ṣaṣṭhīpratiṣedhāt karmaṇi dvitīyaiva bhavati | etacca
tṛnnantatvābhivyaktaye prayuktam , etena kaṭasyetivyākhyātam |
turiṣṭhemeyassu, tuścchandasi itivat sāmānyanirddeśe kartavye,
tṛntṛcornedenopādāne prayojanaṃ cintyam | 
e avyutpattipakṣe iti | nāvaśyaṃ vyutpattikāryaṃ bhavatītyetad ataḥ
kṛkamikaṃsa ityatra kaṃsagrahaṇāllabhyate, jñāpakāditi bhāvaḥ |
vyutpattipakṣa iti | namestṛci makārasya pakāraḥ - naptā, nayatestṛni
ṣuk guṇaśca - neṣṭā, tviṣeraccopadhāyāḥ - tvāṣṭā
kṣadestṛnyaniṭtvam - kṣatā hotā, potā - tṛneva
prapūrvācchāsestṛc, aniṭtvaṃ ca - praśāstā | evambhūtānāmiti |
evambhūtānāmiti | asyaiva vivaraṇam - saṃjñāśabdānāmiti || 
einhanpūṣāryamṇāṃ śau || 6 - 4 - 12 || 
e aninasmangrahaṇānyarthavatā cānarthakena ca tadantavidhiṃ prayojayanti
iti ingrahaṇena tadantaṃ gṛhyate | itarebhyo'pi kevalebhyaḥ śirna
sambhavati, katham inniti hanteḥ kvibantasya grahaṇam, brahaṇam,
brahmadyaupadācca hanteḥ kvibvihitaḥ, itarau ca puṃlliṅgau,
tasmātsavaireva tadantavidhiviṃjñāyate, ityāha -
inhanpūṣannaryamannityevamantānāmiti | bahudaṇḍīnīti | 
e baiṣamyaparihārārthamādyayorbahupūrvayoḥ | 
e upanyāso bahutvaṃ ca pūṣādau kālabhedataḥ || iti | 
e iha daṇḍīni brāhmaṇakulāni, brahmahāṇi brāhmaṇakulāni - ityantareṇāpi
bahuśabdabhādyayorinhannityetayorudāharaṇatvenopanyāsaḥ
sambhāvatīti codyam, vaiṣamyaparihārārthaṃ tu bahupūrvayorupanyāsa
ityutaram | vṛtrahā indraḥ, sa ekaḥ , evaṃ pūṣāryamaṇau, teṣāṃ kathaṃ
bahutvaṃ viṣeṣaṇamiti codyam, manvantarādikālabhadenendrādayo
bhidyante ityutram | yadvā - bahuṣu yajñeṣvāhūtā indrādayo
yairbrāhmaṇakulaistāni tathocyante | 
e nanu ca sarvanāmasthāne cāsambuddhau iti dīrghatvaṃ siddham,
tatkimartho'yamārambhaḥ ityāha - siddhe satyārambha iti |
innādīnāmupadhāyāḥ śāveveti | viparītastu niyamo na bhavati -
innādīnāmeva śāviti sarvanāmāni
tāyekavacanadvivacanabahuvacanānyekaśaḥ iti nirdeśāt |
vṛtrahaṇāviti | nanvatrāstu sarvanāmasthāne cāsambuddhau thaiti prāpto
dīrghaḥ kasmānna bhavati, na hyasau tasya niyamaḥ
aprakṛtatvādasaṃśabditatvācca satyam niyamavidhānasāmarthyātu
tasyāpyanena nivṛttiḥ | 
e astvevaṃ sarvanāmasthāne, vibhaktyantare tu
sarvatrānunāsikalalakṣaṇo dīrghaḥ prāpnoti ata āha - dīrghavidhiriti
| ya iha śāstre innādīnāṃ dīrghavidhistaṃ viniyamya - tasya niyamaṃ
kṛtvā, kva suṭi sarvanāmasthāne | upalakṣaṇametat | tena
śasādeśo'pi śirgṛhyate | itiśabdo hetau, sa ca bhinnakramaḥ
ślokante draṣṭavyaḥ | 
etataḥ kiṃ kuryāt śau niyamaṃ punaviṃdadhyāt | evakāro bhinnakramo
netyasyānantaraṃ draṣṭavyaḥ | ekasmanyoge niyamadvayasya
kartumaśakyātvādyogavibhāgaḥ kartavya ityarthāduktaṃ bhavati |
inhanpūṣāryamṇām ityeko yogaḥ, sarvanāmasthāne iti ca vartate,
innādīnāṃ ca sarvanāmasthāna eva dīrgho bhavatītyarthaḥ | atra
hanvyatiriktānāṃ grahaṇamutarārtham | tataḥ śau iti dvitīyo yogaḥ,
sarvanāmasthāne'pi śāveva na sarvatra | tataḥ sau ca iti sūtraṃ 
evidhyartham | evaṃ ca yogadvayaṃ kriyamāṇe ca sati yadiṣṭṃa sampadyate
taddarśayati - bhrūṇahanīti tathāsya na duṣyediti | tatheti yogādvaye
satītyarthaḥ | asyeti ācāryasya | bhrūṇahanīti saptamyekavacane
vibhāṣā ṅiśyoḥ ityillopābhāvakṣe'nunāsikalakṣaṇo dīrgho na
bhavatītyarthaḥ | saptamyekavacanamupalakṣaṇam sarvatra
dīrghaprasaṅgasyoktatvāt | 
e evaṃ yogavibhāgena codyaṃ parihṛtyaikasminyoge parihartumāha -
śāsmīti | śāsmi - upadiśāmi taṃ prakāram, yenaikayoge'pi
doṣābhāvaḥ | atrāpi suḍiti sarvanāmasthānaṃ lakṣyate
sarvanāmasthānagrahaṇaṃ nivartya anāśritasarvanāmasthānatvaviśeṣe
pratyayatvamātrāśrayeṇa | śau niyamaṃ kuru vā | evaṃ vā kuru, pūrvoktaṃ
vā prakāramityarthaḥ | evaṃ ca viśeṣamanapekṣya śau niyamaḥ kriyamāṇaḥ
pratyayatvena tulyajātīye sarvatra pratyayāntare nivṛttiṃ karoti | 
e yadyevam, vṛtrahevācarati vṛtrahāyate iti kyaiṅ
akṛtsārvadhātukayoḥ ityapi dīrgho na syāt ata āha -
dīrghavidheriti | nirddhāraṇe eṣā ṣaṣṭhī, jātāvekavacanam |
upadhāśabdena upadhālakṣaṇaṃ dīrghatvamucyate | dīrghavidhānamadhye
upadhālakṣaṇasya dīrghasya niyamādityarthaḥ |
etaccopadhāgrahaṇānuvṛterlakṣyate | hanteryo hantiyaḥ, tasminyo
dīrghavidhistatra na doṣa ityarthaḥ | kvacitu - hanteti
nipāto'bhimukhīkaraṇārthaḥ paṭha|lte | atrāpi yigrahaṇamupalakṣaṇam,
daṇḍībhūtaityatra cvau ca ityapi dīrgho bhavatyeva | 
e idānīmasatyapi yogavibhāge sarvanāmasthānāpekṣāyāṃ satyāmapi na
doṣa ityāha - suṭa|lpīti | apiśabdaḥ aprakṛtipratiṣedhe ityanena
sambandhanīyaḥ | vāśabdaḥ pakṣāntaraṃ dyotayati | atrāpi suḍiti
sarvanāmasthānopalakṣaṇam, tadayamarthaḥ - atha vā - suṭi
sarvanāmasthāne prakṛte prakaraṇādapekṣyamāṇe | etena
laukikamadhikāramabhyupagacchati, śāstrīyastu naivābhyupagamyate |
anavakāśa iti | hetugarbhamidaṃ viśeṣaṇam | yato'navakāśaḥ śau
niyamo'to'prakṛtasyāpyanunāsikadīrghasya pratiṣedhe vyāvṛtau
kartavyāyāmapi pravartate | 
e kathamanavakāśatvam ata āha - yasya hīti | dvividhaṃ sarvanāmasthānam
- śiḥ suṭ ca, tatra śirnapuṃsakasya sambandhī, tata etasya vidhānāt,
suṭ tu strīpuṃsayoḥ suḍanaṃpusakasya iti vacanāt | tataśca yasya
napuṃsakasya sambandhini śau niyamaḥ kriyate suṭi
sarvanāmasthānasaṃjñake naitannapuṃsake sambhavati anapuṃsakasyeti
vacanāt | hiśabdo hetau, yasmādevaṃ tena kāraṇena tatra
sarvanāmasthāne suṭi niyantavyaṃ vyāvartya dīrghatvaṃ sambhavatīti
sāmarthyādaviśeṣeṇa niyama āśrīyate | etaduktaṃ bhavati - yadi
prakāraṇāprāptaṃ sarvanāmasthānatvaṃ śerāśrīyate, tadā
napuṃsakasambandhitvamapyāśrayaṇīyam | ubhayathāśrayaṇe vāyamartho bhavati
- innādīnāṃ napuṃsakānāṃ śāveva sarvanāma sthāne dīrghatvamiti |
evaṃvidhasya niyamasya kiṃ tulyajātīyaṃ vyāvatenīyam
napuṃsakānāmevaiṣāṃ sarvanāmasthānāntaraṃ na ca tadastīti
niyamavidhānasāmarthyātprakaraṇaprāptaṃ sarvanāmasthānatvaṃ sāmarthyaprāptaṃ
ca napuṃsakatvamubhayamapyaviśeṣātparityajya pratyayamātre
strīpuṃsasambandhini dīrghatvaṃ vyāvartyata iti | 
e viniyamyam - sādhu niyamyam | 
e hanteranunāsikasyetyādinā prathamaślokaṃ vyācaṣṭe | 
e sarvanāmasthāna ityādinā dvitīyasya pūrvārddham yastvityādinā
paścārddham | 
e atha vetyādinā tṛtīyaślokam | anuvartamāne'pīti |
laukakyatrānuvṛttirvivakṣitā, na śāstrīyā svaritatvanibandhanā | tathā
hi sati sāmarthyaprāptasya napuṃkatvasyaiva parityāgaḥ syāt, na
vacananaprāptasya sarvanāsthānatvasya | sāmarthyaprāptasya naṃpukatvasyeva
parityāgaḥ syāt, na vacanaprāptasya sarvanāsthānatvasya |
samārthyādityuktam, tadeva darśayati - śiśabdo hīti |
aviśeṣeṇoti | naṃpusakatvaṃ sarvanāmasthānatvaṃ ca
viśeṣamanāśrityetyarthaḥ | pūrva napuṃsakatvāprasañjanena
kevalasarvanāmasthānatvāśrayeṇa niyamo doṣaprasaṅgātathā nāśrīyata
ityādyayoḥ ślokayoruktam | 
e vṛttikārastu sarvanāmasthānatvaparityāgena
kevalanapuṃsakatvāśrayaṇamapi doṣaprasaṅgādeva sarvathā na
kāryamityāha - tatra tviti | tuśabdo'piśabdo'piśabdasyārthe
bhinnakramaścaitat ityasyānantaraṃ draṣṭavyaḥ | tatraitasminniyame kriyamāṇe
napuṃsakasyetyetadapi viśeṣaṇaṃ nāśrīyata ityarthaḥ | kimevaṃ sati
siddhaṃ bhavati taddarśayati 
e- teneti | tadāśrayaṇe hyayamarthaḥ syāt - innādīnāṃ napuṃsakānāṃ
śāveva dīrghatvamiti, tataśca bhrūṇahani brāhmaṇakule ityādāveva
dīrghatvaṃ na syāt, na liṅgāntare | tasmānnapuṃsakatvamapi
viśeṣaṇaṃ nāśrayaṇīyamiti bhāvaḥ | 
e kathaṃ punaraprakṛtasyāsaṃśabditasya napuṃsakatvasyāśrayaṇaprasaṅgaḥ
ityaha sarvanāmasthānavidhāne tviti | sarvanāmasthānamiti
taṭasthamupalakṣaṇam, yadidaṃ sarvanāmasthānaṃ śiśabdastasya yadvidhānaṃ
jaśśayorityetat, tatretyarthaḥ | sarvanāmasthānasaṃjñāvidhāne tviti
pāṭhe yo'yaṃ sarvanāmasthānasaṃjñaḥ pāṭhaḥ, na tatra samīcīnamarthaḥ
paśyāmaḥ | tathā hi - śi sarvanāmasthānam ityetatsaṃjñāvidhānam, tatra
napuṃsakagrahaṇamasti | atha śiśabdasya
napuṃsakatvāvyabhicārādārthānnapuṃsakasyāśrayaṇam tadatraiva sūtre
śakyate vaktum, kimucyate - saṃjñāvijñāne tviti | athāvaśyamayameva
pāṭho yojyastadāḍaḥ praśleṣaḥ sa ca dhātvarthānuvādī,
sarvanāmasthānasaṃjñasyāvidhānaṃ sarvanāmasthānasaṃjñāvidhānam, tatreti,
sa evārtho yaṃ pūrvamavocāma| tuśabdo hetau, api syāditi
sambhāvanāyām | yasmānnapuṃsakādeva śervidhānaṃ tasmātatra śiśabde
kriyamāṇasya niyamasya napuṃsakaviṣayatā sambhāvyate ityarthaḥ || 
e atvasantasya cādhātoḥ || atretyadi | nanu ca paratvānnityatvācca
numeva pūrva prāpnoti tatrāha - yadi hīti | iha dīrghaśrutyācaḥ
sthānitvam, tacca na svarupeṇa, kiṃ tarhi upadhāyāḥ
ityanuvṛterupadhātvanibandhanam, ata evājantasya dīrghābhāvaḥ |
tasmātsathāninyevātra nimitaśabdaḥ prayuktaḥ | 
e piṇḍagraścarmava iti | grasu glasu adane, vasa ācchādane kvip | nanu
cānarthakatvādevātra na bhaviṣyati, mūlodāharaṇeṣu
tvasunpratyayasyārthavatvātsiddham ata āha - anarthako'pīti | atraiva
hetumāha - aninasmingrahaṇānīti | ayameva dhātupratiṣedho jñāpayati
- astīyaṃ paribhāṣeti | naitadasti jñāpakam, asyarthametatsyāt -
śatranasyāt, śatrūnasyatīti śatrūva iti, tasmādvacanamevedam |
atugrahaṇe tvarthavato'tuśabdasyābhāvādevānarthakasya grahaṇam | 
e antagrahaṇamanarthakam, kevalayoratvasorabhāvādeva siddham ata āha
antagrahaṇamityādi | apadeśaḥ - lakṣaṇavākyāni gaṇapāṭhaśca, prayujyata
iti prayogaḥ, upadeśe prayoga upadeśaprayogaḥ | upadeśe yatprayujyate
śabdaṃrupaṃ tadekadeśasyāpyatvasantasya parigrahārthamityarthaḥ | asati
punarantagrahaṇe kasya grahaṇaṃ na syāt ityata āha - itarathā hīti |
matubgrahaṇamupalatraṇam | kumudanaḍavetasebhyo ḍamatup ityasyāpi
grahaṇaṃ na syāt | kiṃ kāraṇamityata āha - upadeśa iti | rupanirgrahaḥ -
rupaniścayaḥ | sa yadyapi laukite prayege bhavati, anubandhayuktaṃ tu
rupamupadeśa eva niścīyata ityupadeśa ityuktam | nāyamatvanta iti |
yadyapi tāvato'vadheraturantaḥ, tathāpi na tatpara upadeśaḥ,
yatparaścopadeśo na so'tvantaḥ, pakārāntatvāt | tataśca tasya
grahaṇaṃ na syāt, antagrahaṇasāmarthyātu tāvato'pyavadheratvantasya
grahaṇam || 
eanunāsikasya kvijhaloḥ kṅiti || 6 - 4 - 15 || 
e aṅgākṣiptasya jhalā viśeṣaṇātadādividhiḥ |
kitītyetatsambhavavyabhicārābhyāṃ jhalādereva viśeṣaṇam |
pratānityādi | tamu kāḍakṣāyām, śamu upaśame, damu glānau -
etebhyaḥ kvipa, mo no dhātoḥ iti natvam | yaṅlugantātasiti | sya
sārvadhātukamapit iti ṅtvim | vastukathanaṃ caitat, na tvanena
niṣṭhāśaṅkā vāryate ṅiti khalvapi ityupakramāt | kiñca
niṣṭhāyāmiṭā bhavitavyam, na coditvād yasya vibhāṣā iti
pratiṣedhaḥ, ekāca iti tatrānuvṛteḥ || 
eajjhanagamāṃ sani || 6 -4 - 16 || 
e atra yadyapadhāyā ityanuvarteta, ajanteṣu vyañjanasya dīrghaprasaṅgaḥ |
tasmānnivṛtam | yadyevam, hanigamyoralo'ntyasya dīrghaprasaṅgaḥ
tanna, acaśca ityupasthānāt | na caivamabhyāsasya prasaṅgaḥ, han sa iti
sthite paratvāddīrghatve kṛte punaḥ prasaṅgavijñānāt dvirvacanam |
astu vā'bhyāsasyāpi dīrghaḥ, hrasvaḥ iti bhaviṣyati | jighāṃsatīti |
abhyāsācca iti kutvam | adhijigāṃsata iti | iṅśca iti gamirādeśaḥ
| 
e iha bahavo gamayaḥ - gamlṛ saḥplṛ gatau iti dhātuḥ, ṇau
gamirabodhane, sani cetīṇādeśaḥ, iṇvadika iti vaktavyam itīka
ādeśaḥ, iṅśca itīṅadeśaśceti tatrāviśeṣātsarvatra prasaṅge satyāha
- gameriṅadeśasyeti vaktavyamiti | iṇa ika iṅścaika evādeśaḥ sa
ihopalakṣyate, ato dhātumekaṃ varjayitvā trayāṇāmādeśasya 
egrahaṇam, tathā ca vakṣyati - ajādeśasya gameriti | evaṃ
ceṇikorādeśasyāpi gamerbhāvakarmaṇorātmanepada iḍabhāve jhalādau
sani ajjhana iti dīrgho bhavatyeva sañjigāṃsyate iti | sañjigaṃsata iti
| gameḥ samo gamyṛcchi ityātmanepadaṃ vihitam, tatra ca akarmakāt
iti vartate, tena sanantādapi pūrvavatsanaḥ
ityātmanepadamakarmakādeva bhavati, tataśca mātaramityapaphāṭhaḥ, |
mātreti tṛtīyāntaṃ paṭhitavyam | sañcigāṃsaditi | sampūrvād
gameḥ san, sakarmakatvāt parasmaipadam, chāndasatvādiḍabhāvaḥ,
bahulaṃ cchandasyamāṅyoge'pi ityaḍabhāvaḥ | prāyeṇa tu vṛtau
sāṭkaṃ kaṭha|lte | 
e ihetyādinā gameriṅadeśasyeti vaktavyam ityetatpratyācaṣṭe |
kathaṃ punaḥ sani dīrghaḥ ityetāvati sūtre kriyamāṇa'jantasyaiva
dīrghatvaṃ labhyate ata āha - tatrācetyādi | sani dīrghaḥ iti sūtre
kriyamāṇae'ṅgasyeti vartate, dīrghaśrutyā vā acaśca ityupatiṣṭhate,
tatra viśeṣaṇaviṣeṣyabhāvaṃ prati kāmacārādutaratra
hanigamyodīrghavidhānād gṛhyamāṇamaṅgamacā viśeṣyate, tena
tvacāṅgama, viśeṣaṇena tadantavidhirbhavatīti siddhamajantasya
dīrghatvam, yathā akṛtsārvadhātukayoḥ ityatra | tasmādihājgrahaṇaṃ na
kartavyam | kimartha tarhi kriyate ityāha - tatkriyata iti |
pravṛttibhedena - vyāpārabhedena | tameva darśayati - ajantasyeti |
evaṃ ca ajgrahaṇaṃ sāmarthyādāvartate ityuktaṃ bhavati || 
etanotervibhāṣā || 6 - 4 - 17|| 
e upasaṃkhyāneneti | tanipatidaridrāṇāmupasaṃkhyānam ityanena | 
ekramaśca ktvi || 6 - 4 - 18 || 
e anunāsikasya kvijhaloḥ kṅiti iti nityasya dīrghasyāpavādo'yaṃ
vikalpaḥ | upadhāyā iti | yadyapyupadhāgrahaṇaṃ pūrvameva nivṛtam,
tathāpi acaśca ityupasthānād, anyasya cāco'sambhāvadevamuktam | 
e kramitveti | udito vā iti pakṣe iṭ | bahiraṅgo'pi lyabādeśa
iti | etacca ado agdhirlyapti kiti ityatra lyabgrahaṇena jñāpitam
|| 
ecchravoḥ śūḍanunāsike ca || 6 - 4 - 19 || 
e yadyatra kevalasya cchasya grahaṇaṃ syāt, tadā pṛccherupa deśānantaraṃ
tuki kṛte ktapratyaye parataścchakāramātrasya śādeśe ṣatve tukaḥ
ṣṭuatve ṣṛṭṣṭa ityaniṣṭṃa rupaṃ syāt | na ca nimitābhāve
naimitikasyāpyabhāvaḥ iti tuko nivṛttiḥ, na hīdaṃ vacanaṃ nāpi
nyāyaḥ, na hi kṛtasya nivṛtau kaścinnyāyaḥ | kathaṃ tarhi sthātetyatra
satve kṛte ṣṭuatvasya nivṛttiḥ, nātra kṛtameva ṣṭuatvaṃ nivartate, kiṃ
tahi tasyāsiddhatvātpūrvameva satvam, tatra ṣṭuatavasya prāptyabhāvaḥ
tadevaṃ vitukkasya grahaṇe doṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā''ha - ccha ityetasya
satukkasyeti | kathaṃ punarjñāyate - chetyasya satukkasya grahaṇamiti
yajayāca iti naṅe ṅtkiraṇāt | taddhi viśna ityatra guṇo mā
bhūditi, satukkasyaiva śādeśe laghūpadhatvād guṇaprasaṅgaḥ |
vitukkasya tu śādeśe takāra upadhā, nekāraḥ, saṃyoge guru iti
gurusaṃjñaśca | pṛcchestu kṅiti samprasāraṇārtha naṅe ṅtviṃ na
bhavati praśne cāsannakāle iti nipātanāt | tasmātsatukkasya grahaṇam
| evaṃ ca kṛtvā ṣṛṣṭaprativacane iti nirddeśopapatiḥ | nanu
satukkasya grahaṇe'pi alo'ntyasya iti cchamātrasya prasaṅgaḥ na
hyanarthake'lontyavidhirasti | atha satukkena cchenāṅgasya
viśeṣaṇātadantasyāṅgasyālo'ntyasya prasaṅgaḥ tadāpi
nirddiśyamānasyādeśā bhavanti iti saha tukā bhaviṣyati | 
eantaraṅgatvāditi | upadeśāntaraṃ prasaṅgādantaraṅgatvam, śastu
bahiraṅgaḥ, katham utpanne pratyaye'ṅgasaṃjñā, aṅgasya ca śādeśaḥ |
na ca vārṇādāṅgaṃ balīyaḥ, bhinnakālatvāt | 
e auṇādike napratyaya iti | sākṣātsiveravihito'pi
bāhulakānnapratyayaḥ | pugantalaghūpadhaguṇātpūrvamūṭha kriyate iti |
antaraṅgatvāditi vakṣyamāṇo heturihāvyapakraṣṭavyaḥ, guṇo hi
bahvahekṣo bahirbhūtapratyayāprekṣaśca, ūṭha tu viparyayādantaraṅgaḥ,
tena sa eva pūrva kriyate | tatra kṛte'ntaraṅgatvādyaṇādeśa iti |
antarbhūtājapekṣatvādyaṇo'ntaraṅgatvam, guṇastu pūrvavadeva
bahiraṅgaḥ | nānāśrayatvācceti | yatraikameva
nimitīkṛtyāṅgavarṇayoryugapatprāptistatra vārṇādāṅgaṃ balīyaḥ,
tathā aco ñṇiti iti vṛddheravakāśaḥ - gauriti, yaṇo'vakāśaḥ -
dadhyatreti cakāretyatra kṛ - a iti sthite ubhayaprasaṅge parāmapi
vṛddhiṃ bādhitvāntaraṅgatvādyaṇi 
eprāpte vārṇādāṅgaṃ balīyaḥ iti vṛddhirbhavati | 
e śabdaprāḍiti | vraścādiṣatvam, jaśtvajatve | goviḍiti | viccha
gatau, gāṃ vicchāyatīti vigṛhya āyādaya ārdhadhātuke vā
ityāyapratyayābhāvapakṣe kvip | akṣadyūḥ, hiraṇyaṣṭha|lūriti |
diviṣṭhivibhyāṃ kvip, subdhātuṣṭhibuṣvaṣkatītanāṃ pratiṣedhaḥ iti
satvābhāvaḥ | nanu cāntaraṅge yaṇi
bahiraṅgasyoṭho'siddhatvādyaṇādeśena nātra bhavitavyam ata āha -
asiddhaṃ bahiraṅgamantaraṅga iti | nājāntarya iti | asyāyamarthaḥ -
yatrāntaraṅge bahiraṅge vā'corānantaryamāśrīyate tatra
bahiraṅgaparibhāṣā na pravartata iti | etacca ṣatvatukorasiddhaḥ ityatra
jñāpitam | dyaumyāmiti | ūṭho'vakāśaḥ dyauutaḥ, dyauutavān,
utvasyāvakāśaḥ - aharvimaladyauḥ dyaubhyāmityādāvubhayaprasaṅgaḥ | tasmāt
kṅtītyitrānuvartayitavyamiti bhāvaḥ | 
e kecidityādi |teṣāṃ mate hi diviprabhṛtīnāṃ yaṅlugantānāṃ
tipsiporīḍabhāvapakṣe ūṭhi sati dedivīti dedyoti, dedivīṣi,
dedyoṣīti | pūrvatra tu pakṣe valilope- dedeti, dedevīti | 
e kathaṃ dyaubhyāṃ dyaubhiriti ūṭhi kṛta iti |
kṅtītyāsyāninuvṛtatvāt atrāpi paratvādūṭhā bhāvyam, ūṭhi ca
kṛte dyauubhyāṃ dyauubhiriti bhavitavyamiti praśnaḥ | diva uditi
taparakaraṇādityādi | atra hi taparakaraṇaṃ na kartavyam,
yato'rddhamātrākālasya vyañjanasya mātrākālo hrasva eva siddhaḥ, tatkriyate
lakṣaṇāntareṇāpi dīrgho mā bhūditi | tena paramapyūṭhṃa bādhitvā
diva ut ityanena mātrākālo bhaviṣyatītyarthaḥ | 
e atha vā - ūṭhi kṛte ityasya pareṇa pariharagranthena sambandhaḥ |
tatrāyamarthaḥ - kriyatāṃ sāmānyena kṅiti cānyatra ca ūṭha, kṛte tu
tasminnekadeśavikṛtasyānanyatvātasyaivoṭhaḥ sthāne
taparatvānmātrākālo bhaviṣyati | teṣāmityādi | kṅidgrahaṇe hi
nivṛte sati tṛjādāvapi śāsyānena vidhānād vraścādisūtre
cchagrahaṇaṃ na kartavyam, śakārasya ṣatvavidhānenaiva sarvasya siddhatvāt
| ye tu kṅidgrahaṇamanuvartayanti, teṣāṃ tṛjādau
śatvasyābhāvācchasyeva ṣatvaṃ vidhātavyam | tatrāpi satukkasya grahaṇam
| 
e ūḍayaṃ yadi ditsyād ādyantau ṭakitau ityādiḥ prasajyeta, astu
vakārasya, vali lope sati akṣadyauurityādi siddham | na ca nāprāpte
valilope ārabhyamāṇa ūṅvalopasya bādhakaḥ syāditi śaṅkanīyam,
bhinnajānīyatvāt - ūḍāgamaḥ, lopa ādeśaḥ, na ca bhinnajātīyaṃ
bādhakaṃ bhavati | na hi dadhi brāhmaṇebhyo dīyatāṃ kambalaḥ
kauṇḍinyāyeti dadhnaḥ kambalo bādhako bhavati satyam, utarasūtre
tvāgamibhedād dvāvūṭhau syātām - eko vakārātpūrvaḥ, apara
upadhāyāḥ, tasmādūṭhaṣṭitvamavaśyāṅgīkartavyamiti
manyamānastadaṅgīkaraṇe prayojanamāha - ūṭhaṣṭhitkaraṇamiti | evaṃ
bruvatā etyedhatyūṭhasu iti ṭhakārasya cartvena nirddeśa ityuktaṃ
bhavati | yatra ṭhakāro na kriyate tato vṛddhividhāvapi nopādīyeta,
tataśca pra - ūhate pohata ityatrāpi syāt | vāha ūḍityayamapi
ṭhideveti | anyathā tasya vṛddhividhau grahaṇaṃ na syāt, atrāpi
ṭhakārasyāśravaṇaṃ jaścatvacartvābhyām || 
ejvaratvarasrivyavimavāmupadhāyāśca || 6 - 4 - 20 || 
e jvara roge, ñitvarā sambhrame, strivu gatiśoṣaṇayoḥ, ava rakṣaṇe,
mava bandhane | jvaratvaretyādi | vastukathanam || 
erāllopaḥ || 6 - 4 - 21 || 
e murcheati | murchā mohasamucchrāyayoḥ | hurcheati | hurchā kauṭilye
| nanu ca pūrvatra satukkasya cchakārasya grahaṇaṃ vitukkaścāyam,
tatkathamatra lopaḥ ityāha - rāllopa ityādi | nanu yadi nāma
rephātparaḥ satukkaśacchakāro na sambhavati,
kimetāvatā'prakṛtasyāsaṃsthitasya kevalasya cchasya grahaṇaṃ bhavati
tasmādevaṃ vyākhyeyam - pūrvatra dvicchakāro nirddeśaḥ, tatraikaḥ
satukkaḥ, aparastu kevalo gṛhītaḥ, ta tra ca rāllopa satukkasya
cchasyāsambhāvtakevalo gṛhyata iti | yadi dvicchakārakaḥ pūrvatra
nirddeśaḥ, cchavoriti nirddeśo nopapadyate, katham
samāhāradvandve ekavacanaprasaṅgaḥ naiṣa doṣaḥ pūrvaṃ dvayoracchakārayoḥ
samāhāradvandvaṃ kṛtvā paścādvakāreṇetaretarayoga dvandvaḥ
kariṣyate | evamapi dvandvāccudaṣahāntātsamahāre iti samāsāntaḥ
prāpnoti tarhi cchakāravakārayoḥ samāhāradvandvaṃ kṛtvā tena saha
satukkasya cchasyetaretarayoge dvandvo bhaviṣyati | yadi pūrvatra
vitukko gṛhyate, vāñcchateḥ kvipi śatvaṃ prāpnoti
iṣṭamevaitatsaṃgṛhītam - vāṃśau, vāṃśa ityeva bhavitavyam || 
easiddhavadatrā bhāt || 6 - 4 - 22 || 
e ā bhāditinirddaśaḥ ā kaḍārāt ityanena vyākhyātaḥ | siddhaśabdo
niṣpannavacanaḥ, na siddho'siddhaḥ - yaḥ punaḥ siddho'pi siddhakārya na
karoti, sa tena tulyaṃ vartata iti asiddhavat | kiṃ punastat
prādhānyātkārya miti prāptam, śāstraṃ hi kāryārthatvādapradhānam |
kāryasya cāsiddhatve ādeśalakṣaṇapratiṣedha eva sidhdyet - āgahi,
jahīti na tūtsagalakṣaṇasya bhāvaḥ - edhi, śādhīti | kāryasyāsiddhatve
hyayamarthaḥ - ā bhācchāstrīyaṃ kārya pravṛtamapi pravṛtakāryaṃ na krotīti,
ataḥ pravṛtakāryanibandhanasyaiva kāryasya pratiṣedhaḥ syāt | na ca edhi,
śādhītyatra etvaśābhāvanibandhanaṃ kiñcitkārya prāptaṃ yasya pratiṣedho
vijñāyeta | ābhīyaṃ tu śāstraṃ svakārya kuryādeva | ata
etvaśābhāvaśāstrābhyāṃ svakāryayoretvaśābhāvayoḥ pravartitayoḥ
sthāninorabhāvātannibandhanaṃ dhitvaṃ na syādeva | śāstrāsiddhatve
tvayamarthaḥ - ābhīyaṃ śāstraṃ niṣpannamapi svakārya na karotīti | ata
etvaśābhāvaśāstrābhyāṃ
svakāryayoretvaśābhāvayorapravṛtatvādanivartitatvāccaitvadhibhāvaśāstrasya sthānibuddhireva vartate iti tannibandhanaṃ kāryasidhyati | ato vyāpakatvācchāstrasyaivāsiddhatvam, ā bhāditi śāstrasyaiva viṣayatvena nirddeśācca | 
e yadyayaṃ svatantravidhiḥ syāt, tadā bhādgrahaṇaṃ viṣayanirddeśārya
vā syāt - ā bhācchāstre|thatra kartavye'siddhavaditi, asiddhavadbhavato
vā nirddeśārtham, atragrahaṇaṃ tu viṣayārtham - ā bhādyacchāstraṃ
tadasiddhavadbhavati atraivābhīye śāstre kartavya iti tatrādye pakṣe
asiddhavadbhavato nirddeśābhāvādyatkiñcanāṣṭādhyāyyāṃ kārya
tatsarvamābhīye kartavye asiddhavat, tataśca cadhinvikṛṇvyora ca
ityasyāsiddhatvaddhinute, kṛṇuta tyeto lopo ni syta |
atragrahaṇaṃ cānarthakaṃ syāt, aparipūrṇatvādadhyāhāreṇauvā bhādyatatra
kartavya ityarthalābhāt | ddhitīye tu pakṣe samānāśrayatvaṃ viśeṣo na
labhyeta, tataśca praśamayyeti mito hrasvasyāsiddhatvāllaghupūrvo
makāro na bhavatīti lyapi laghupūrat ityayādeśo na syāt
prabebhidayyeti, bhidaryaṅntād ṇaci yasya halaḥ iti
yalopasyāsiddhatvāllaghupūrvādutaro ṇajna bhavati, yakāreṇa
vyavadhānādityayādeśo na syāt prastanyyeti, adantātstanaśabda
ityasmād ṇicyallopasyāsiddhatvāllaghoreva paro ṇic, na tu
laghupūrvādityayādeśāpraptiḥ, paśuṃ sanotīti janasanakhana iti
viṭ, viḍvanoḥ ityātvam, sanoterenaḥ iti śatvam - paśuṣāḥ,
tataḥ śasi paśuṣo navājānityādāvātvasyasiddhatvāt āto dhātoḥ
ityālopo na syāt cākhāyiteti, khaneryaṅ idvirvacanātparatvāt
ye vibhāṣā ityātve dvirvacane tṛci ātvasyāsiddhatvāt yasya halaḥ
iti yalopaḥ syāt papuṣa ityādau ca doṣo vakṣyate | 
e adhikāre ā bhādgrahaṇaṃ cānarthakaṃ syāt, thādhikārādeva
tadarthalābhāt | tathā hi - śanānnalopaḥ ityatrāsminnupasthite sati
śnādutarasya nakārasya lopo bhavati sa cāsiddhavadbhavatītyayamartho
bhavati | evam anudātopadeśa ityādāvapi, tatkimasiddhavadbhavato
nirddeśārthenābhādgrahaṇena | na cāsiddhavadbhavata
ityatāvadhāraṇārthamābhādgrahaṇam, adhikāre hyasminnavadhyanirddeśād
yuvoranākau ityādīnāmapi asiddhatvaṃ syāditi vācyam,
ṅyāppratipadikāt
itivadantareṇāpyavadhinirddeśamadhikāraparimāṇāvagateḥ |
nanvasatyābhādgrahaṇe'dhikāre'smin sati yatraitadadhikṛtaṃ tadeva
sūtraṃ taddhihitaṃ vā kāryamatragrahaṇena paramṛśyeta, anyasya
sannihitasyābhāvāt, tataśca śnānnalopaḥ ityasyāyamarthaḥ syāt -
śnādutarasya nakārasya lopo bhavati, sa cāsiddhavadbhavatyatraiva
śnānnalope kartavya iti | evaṃ sarvatra | tataśca ciṇo luk
ityatraiveṣṭṃa sidhyet - akāritarāmiti , gataḥ,
gatavānityādāvanyasminnābhīye'nyasyābhīyasyāsiddhatvānāpādanādato
lopādi syādeva | ā bhādgrahaṇaṃ tu kṛtvā vidhāvāśrīyamāṇe
tasyaiva sannihitasyātragrahaṇena
parāmarśādābhīyamābhīye'siddhavatsvasminnanyasminbetyayamartho labhyate
ucyate, adhikāre'pyasminsati anudātopadeśa ityādau tatraiva
kartavye tasyaivāsiddhavacane na kiñcitprayojanamastīti
tatkāryaviśeṣarupaparityāgena idamasiddhavadbhavati | atra kartavye
ityevaṃ sāmānyarupeṇa parāmarśādanyasminnapyanyasyāsiddhatvaṃ
bhaviṣyati, tadevamā bhādgraṇamatiricyamānaṃ viṣayārtha vijñāyate |
adhikārāccāsiddhavadbhavato'vagatiḥ | 
e atragrahaṇaṃ tu samānāśrayatvapratipatyartham, yadyaubhe apyābhīye ekameva
nimitamāśritya prāpnutaḥ, evamanyo'nyasminnasiddhavadbhavati,
kimatragrahaṇamatiricyate ityataḥ samānāśrayatvapratipatiḥ netyāha
akṣarārtha 
eevāyam tathā hi - anudātopadeśa ityatrāsminnupasthite satyayamartho
bhavati - anudātopadeśānāṃ lopo bhavati jhalādau kṅiti parataḥ,
sa cāsiddhavadbhavati | kutra kartavye atra yadā bhātatreti | ko'rthaḥ
kṅityanunāsikalopo bhavatītyuktam, atraiva kṅitinimite sati
yadābhīyaṃ prāpnoti tatra kartavya iti | evaṃ sarvatra | evaṃ ca
vispaṣṭamakṣaraireva samānāśrayatvaṃ pratipāditaṃ bhavati | 
e yadyayamadhikārastato yatrāsyopasthānaṃ tata evārabhya yadā bhātatraiva
tasyāsiddhatvaṃ syāt, na tu svasmātpurveṣvitareṣu, yaddeśasthena hi
vaktā āṇuccāryate tata taevārabhya maryādābhividhipratipatiḥ yathā - ā
pāṭaliputrādvṛṣṭo deva taiti, evaṃ ca dhvasoredvau ityasyāyamartho
bhavati - astehau ekāraḥ, sa ceta ārabhya yadā bhātatrāsiddhavaditi,
tataśca pūrvatra dhitve nāsiddhavatsyāt svatantre tu vidhau atraiva
pradeśe ārṅtha pratipadāyan ata evārabhya yadā
bhātadasiddhavadbhavatyatraiva kartavya iti śnānnalopaḥ ityārabhya
ṛtvyavāsttvya ityevamāntānāṃ
sarveṣāmevānyo'nyasminnasiddhatvamāpādayati ucyate dvau pakṣau -
śabdādhikāraścārthādhikāraśca, tataśca śabdādhikāre syādeṣa doṣaḥ,
arthādhikāre tvasminneva pradeśo ārṅtha pratipādayan
pūrvavatpratipādayati, sa ca pratipāditārthādutaratropatiṣṭhate,
upasthitaśca tatratatropasthitenātragrahaṇena viśeṣyata iti sarvamiṣṭṃa
siddham | tadanena sūkṣeṇāyamarthaḥ sampāditaḥ śnānnalopaḥ
ityārabhyāpādaparisamāpteryāni sūtrāṇi
tānyanyo'nyasminnasiddhavadbhavanti, tāni cetulyanimitānīti |
tadetatsarva vṛtau yathāsthānaṃ yojyam | tadāśrayameva
bhavatītyatrāsiddhavaditi vakṣyamāṇamapakraṣṭavyam | vibhinnāśrayam -
vyāśrayam, vibhinnanimitamityarthaḥ | 
e asiddhavacanamityādi | utsṛjyate ādeśena nivartyata ityutsargaḥ -
sthānī, sa lakṣaṇaṃ nimitaṃ yasya tadutsargalakṣaṇam, tasya bhāvaḥ -
pravṛttiryathā syāt | etacca śāstrāsiddhatvāśrayaṇāllabhyata ityuktam |
āgahīti | bahulaṃ cchandasi iti śapo luk anudātopadeśa
ityādinānunāsikalopaḥ | jahīti | hantarjaḥ | 
e abhājīti | bhañjeśca ciṇi ityanunāsikalopaḥ | rāga iti | rañceśca
ghañi ca bhāvakaraṇayoḥ ityanunāsikalopaḥ | 
e atragrahaṇaṃ kimiti | yadyapi samānāśrayatvapratipatyarthamiti
pūrvamevātragrahaṇasya prayojanamuktam, tathāpi samānāśrayatvapratipateḥ
ki phalamiti praśnāvasaro'styeva | papuṣa iti | pā pāne, āto
lopa iṭi ca | cicyuṣa iti | ciñ cayana, eranekācaḥ iti yaṇādeśaḥ
| luluviṣa iti | lūñ chedane | kathaṃ punaratra vyāśrayatvam ityāha -
ālopādīni hīti | nanvevamapi naivātrālopādīni sidhyanti,
antaraṅgāṇi hi tāni, tadantarbhūtasamprasāraṇāpekṣatvāt
bahiraṅgaṃ samprasāraṇam, bahirbhūtavibhaktyapekṣatvāt, tataḥ kim
asiddhaṃ bahiraṅgamantaraṅge tatrāha - asiddhaṃ bahiraṅgamantaraṅge
ityādi | etaditi vacanāpekṣaṃ napuṃsakatvam | krimiti na pravartate
ata āha - eṣā hīti | ā bhācchāstrīyeti | vāha ūṭha ityatra
jñāpitatvāt | tataḥ kim ityāha - tasyāmiti |
antaraṅgabahiraṅgayoryugapatsannidhānaṃ nāstīti paribhāṣayā saha
yaugapadyameṣṭavyam |
paribhāṣāsannidhāvantaraṅgabahiraṅgayoravasthānābhāvādityarthaḥ |
vasusamprasāraṇaṃ caikaṃ paribhāṣāyā āllopādīnāṃ cāśraya iti
samānāśrayatvamapyasti | etacca nājānantarye ityanāśrityoktam |
āllopādayo hi acorānantaryamāśritya prāpnovanti | 
e vugyuṭāviti | tatra yuṭā tāvatsiddhatvaṃ na vaktavyam,
yuḍvidhānasāmarthyāt yaṇ na bhaviṣyati | tatra yakāradyaśravaṇārtha
yuḍvidhānam yaṇo mayo dve bhavataḥ iti dvirvacanavidhānāt |
halo yamāṃ yami lopaḥ iti pakṣe lopavidhānācca pakṣe
yakāradvayaśravaṇasya siddhatvāt | vuko'pi siddhatvaṃ na vaktavyam,
katham nāprāpte uvaṅyārabhyamāṇo vuk tasyāpavādo bhaviṣyati |
nanu ca bādhakapravṛttivelāyāṃ yadvirudhyate tadvādhakena nivartitaṃ na
pravartate, uvaṅniravakāśe vuki
pravartamāne'siddhatvātsvamātmānamadarśayannaśakyo bādhitumiti vuki
kṛte tasyāsiddhatvātsyādeva evaṃ tarhi vugna kariṣyate, bhuvo
luṅliṭoruṭuapadhāyāḥ iti sūtramastu, tatra ca oḥ supi ityataḥ
orityanuvatiṣyate, tena bhuvā'ṅgasyopadhāyā ukārasya
ūdbhavatītyāśrayaṇe uvaṅ kṛti ūkāro bhaviṣyati | yadyevam,
babhūva, babhūvitheti guṇavṛddhyoravāvośca kṛtayoruvarṇa upadhāṃ
na bhavatītyūtvaṃ na syāt tatrāpi indhibhavatibhyāṃ ca iti pito'pi
liṭaḥ kitvād guṇavṛddhyorabhāve uvaṅ ūdbhiviṣyati | yadyevam,

eindhiśchandoviṣayatvādbhuṣo vuko nityatvāditi nyāyātanna
kartavyaṃ bhavati avaśyaṃ ca vuko nityatvamāśritya babhūveti
śādhayitavyam anyathā aco ñṇiti ityatreka
ityunapasthānādaniglakṣaṇā vṛddhiḥ syādeva evaṃ tarhi nārtho vukā,
nāpi kitvena, oḥ supi ityatrāvarṇamapi priślaṣyate,
akārokārayorādguṇe kṛte ṅasiṅsośca iti pūrvaikādeśena
nirdeśāt | tena babhūvatheti guṇavṛddhyoravādhośca
kṛtayoravarṇasyāpyupadhāyā ūdbhaviṣyati, babhūvaturityādāvuvaiṅ
kṛti uvarṇasyāpi | yadyevam, oḥ supi ityavarṇasyāpi
nirdeśātkīlālapaḥ paśyetyādāvapi yaṇ syāt paratvād āto
dhātoḥ iti lopo bādhako bhaviṣyati, lopasyāvakāśaḥ
saṃyogapūrvākāranto dhātuḥ, akārapraśleṣasyotaratrāvakāśaḥ -
babhūva, babhūvitha, kīlalapaḥ paśyetyatrobhayaprasaṅge
paratvādākāralopaḥ, vipratiṣedhe hyasiddhatvaṃ nāstīti jñāpayiṣyate |
evamapi kīlālapau sarvanāmasthāne bhasaṃjñāyā
abhāvādākāralopāprasaṅgādyaṇ syāt evaṃ tarhi oḥ supi ityatra aci
śnudhātu ityataḥ yvoḥ ityanuvartiṣyate,
tataścakārokāka,mujānirdeśe'pi yvoḥ ityanena
viśeṣaṇasāmarthyādukārasyaiva yaṇ bhaviṣyati, na tvavarṇasyeti
saamarthyādavarṇagrahaṇamutarārthameva sampadyate | tadevaṃ
satyapyasminyoge vugyuṭoḥ siddhatvaṃ na vaktavyamiti bhāṣye sthitam
| 
e ye tvāhuḥ - bhuvo vugluṅliṭoḥ ityatra oḥ ityanuvartanīyam,
uvarṇāntasya bhuvo vugyathā syāt - bobhāva, bobhavitheti
yaṅluki piti liṭi indhibhavatibhyāṃ ca ityatra śtipā
nideśādesati kitve guṇavṛddhyoḥ kṛtayoranuvarṇāntasya mā
bhūdityevamartham | evaṃ ca babhūva, babhūvithatyatrāpi guṇavṛddhyoḥ
kṛtayoḥ vuko'prasaṅgādanityātvāt indhibhavatibhyāṃ ca iti
kitvamāramabhaṇīyam | tatra ca
ṅidityadhikārātkitvaṅtviyorubhayorapi vidhānad
babhūvetyaniglakṣaṇāpi vṛddhirna bhavati | eṣa taeva ca kitve śtipā
nirdeśaṃ vuki ca tadabhāvaṃ kurvataḥ sūtrakārasyābhiprāya iti teṣāṃ
vukaḥ siddhatvaṃ vaktavyameva | na ca vatkaraṇaṃ svāśrayamapi yathā syāditi
vukaḥ siddhatvaṃ labhyate, satyasati vā
vatāvatideśeṣvātideśikāviruddhasyāśrayakāryāvivartanāṃtsiddhatvāsiddhatvayostu virodhātkathaṃ vatinā siddhatvaprāpathaṇam kathaṃ vā viṣayavibhāgo labhyeta sthānivadityādau tu vatimantareṇa saṃjñā syāditi vatkaraṇamatideśārtha sat svāśrayapratipatyarthaṃ varṇyate evaṃ tarhi śnasorallopaḥ iti taparakaraṇālliṅgāt kvacitsiddhatvamanumīyate, taddhi āstāmityādāvāṭo mā bhūditi | yadi cedamasiddhatvaṃ nityaṃ syāt, āṭo'siddhatvādeva lopo na bhaviṣyatīti kiṃ taparakaraṇena vatkaraṇaṃ tu pratipatilāghavārthameva | tathā ca ṣatvatukorasiddhaḥ, goto ṇid ityādo vatimantareṇāpi paratra paraśabdaprayogādevātideśa āśritaḥ, tatrāpi cāviruddhaṃ svāśrayaṃ bhavatyeva | 
e atrāṅ maryādāyāṃ yadi syād, bhādhikārīyasyāsiddhatvaṃ na syāt
| na cābhādgrahaṇaṃ viṣayārtham, asiddhavadbhavatastu
parijñānamadhikārādevetyuktam | ato maryādārthe'pyāiṅ
bhādhikāre'pyasyopasthānaṃ na vihanyate | tasmādevaṃ vaktavyam -
bhādhikārīye kartavye bhādhikārīyasya pūrvasyaiva
prakāraṇasyāpyasiddhatvaṃ noktaṃ syāditi satyam ayameva doṣaḥ - tatra
sūryeṇaikadigiti aṇi kṛte yasyetilopaḥ, ṅīp, punaraṇo
yasyetilopaḥ, tātredānīm sūryatiṣya iti yalopa iṣyate - saurī
balāketi, sa na prāpnoti bhādhikārīye yalope yasyeti
lopasyāsiddhatvābhāvādyakārasyānupadhātvāt | sthānivadbhāvaśca
yalopavidhiṃ prati niṣiddhaḥ tamimaṃ maryādāpatre doṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā''ha -
ā bhādityayamabhividhāvāṅiti | bhādhikāre'pyasiddhavadbhavatīti |
bhādhikāre'pi tadavasthitam, tatrāpi kartavye tatra
tyamanyaccāsiddhavadbhavatītyarthaḥ | evaṃ vyākhyātā vṛttiḥ | 
e kāni punarasya yogasya prayojanāni iha pādo'syāstīti ata
iniṭhanau, pādikaḥ, taudakaṃ vahatītyaṇ saṃjñāyāmudabhāvaḥ,
udavāhasyāpatyam ata iñ audavāhiḥ, sāraṇaśabdābhyāṃ
lyuhantābhyāmata iñ, sāraṇiḥ, vāraṇiḥ, śātanapātanaśabdābhyāṃ
ṭitvānṅīp, śātanī, pātanī sraṃserdhvaṃserṇyantādyaki sraṃsyate,
dhvaṃsyate, atra yasyetilope ṇilope ca kṛte padbhāvaḥ, ūṭha,
nastaddhite allopo'naḥ, aniditām ityete vidhayaḥ prāpnavanti,
lopasyāsidhdatvānna bhavinti tanna, acaḥ parasmin iti
sthānivadbhāvenāpyetāni siddhāni | śā hau ityatra śās hau iti
padacchedaḥ, śāsaḥ śāsityayamādeśo bhavati, kimarthamidam
itvabādhanārtham tataḥ hujhalbhyaḥ iti dhitvam, dhi ca iti salopaḥ
śādhīti siddham, dhi sakāre sico lopa iti nāśrīyate,
cakādhītyeva bhavitavyamiti nirṇeṣyate | 
edhvasoreddhāvabhyāsalopaśca ityatrāpi śnasorallopaḥ ityato
viṣayārthamallopa ityanuvṛterallopaviṣayatvaṃ bhavadakārasyaiva
bhaviṣyati, tataḥ pūrvavad hrasvasalopayoredhīti siddham | iha ca
kuru iti ka- uhi iti sthite hilukca prāpnoti guṇaśca, paratvād
guṇae kṛte ata utsārvadhātuke ityutvaṃ ca prāpnoti hilukca,
nityatvāddhiluki kṛte'pi sārvadhātukagrahaṇasāmarthyādabhūtapūrve'pi
tasminnutvaṃ siddhim | luṅlaṅlṛṅkṣvaḍudātaḥ ityatropadeśa
ityanuvṛteḥ dvilakārakanirddeśāśrayaṇādvā luṅadiṣu
lāvasthāyāmevāḍāṭo bhavata iti akāri, aikṣītyatra ciṇo luk iti
nitye luki kṛte'ḍāṭau siddho | evaṃ cāsannityatrāpi prāgeva
śnasorallopādāṭi kṛte taparakaraṇāllopābhāvaḥ | evaṃ
cāyannityatrāpi iṇo yaṇ iti yaṇādeśātpragāṭi sati siddhamiṣṭam |
yadyevam, aijyata, aupyateti laṅe lāvasthāyāṃ
yajivapyoranajāditvādaṭi sati āṭaśca iti vṛddhirna syāt atra
parihāram āḍajīdīnām ityatra vatryāmaḥ | ato heḥ ityatra ca utaśca
pratyayāt ityataḥ pratyayagrahaṇāapakarṣaṇājjahītyatra hanterjabhāve lugna
bhaviṣyati | ato lopaḥ ityatra ca anudātopadeśa ityata
upadeśagrahaṇānuvṛteḥ upadeśe yadakārāntaṃ tasya lopaḥ iti gataḥ,
gatavānityatrānunāsikalope kṛte sampratyakārāntatve'pi tadabhāvaḥ
| 
e ihāpi tarhi na syāt - dhinvikṛṇvyora ca, dhinutaḥ
nopadeśagrahaṇenāṅgamabhisambadhyate -
yadaṅgamupadeśakāle'kārāntamiti , api tu
ārddhadhātukamabhisambadhyate - ārddhadhātukopadeśe yadakārāntamiti |
etaduktaṃ bhavati - yadārddhadhātukamutpannaṃ na
muhūrtamātrapyanakārāntātparaṃ tatra tadantasya lopa iti dhinuta ityatra
copratyayasanniyogenākāravidhānādupratyaya utpanno na kadācidapi
anataḥ para iti | 
e iha ca madhamasyāstīti cchandasīvanipau ca iti vanibantācchas,
śvayuvamadhonām iti samprasāraṇam, magha - un - as iti sthite
samprasāraṇamākṣitya yasyeti lopaḥ praptastasyāsiddhatvānna bhavati
nātrāsiddhatvaṃ labhyate, vyāśrayatvāt - śasi samprasāraṇam,
samprasāraṇe yasyeti lopaḥ | tasmānmadhavacchabdo vyutpannaṃ
prātipadikam, tataśca taddhitābhāvādeva lopābhāvaḥ | 
e iha ca kaṃsvid garbha prathamaṃ daghra āpi iti | dadhāterliṭi dhā - ire
iti sthite nityatvāt irayore it chāndasoḥ rebhāvaḥ, liṭ,
cchandasi sārvadhātukamapīti śup, śāpaḥ śluḥ , dvirvajanam,
īhalyadhoḥ iti pratiṣedhātu śnābhyastorātaḥ iti siddho lopaḥ,
ghuvyatirikteṣu māprabhṛtiṣu chāndasatvādyathādarśanaṃ bhaviṣyati | 
e iha tarhi kurvaḥ, kurmaḥ, kuryāditi, kṛu - vas , kṛu - mas, kṛu
- yāt iti sthite nityaṃ karoteḥ ye ca iti lopaśca prāpnoti
karoterguṇaśca, tatrobhayoniṃtyayoḥ paratvād guṇe kṛte ata
tautsārvadhātuke ityutvaṃ bādhitvā nityatvādukāralope kṛte
sārvadhātukapara upratyaye vidhīyamānabhutvaṃ na syāt , na ca
sārvadhātuka eva parataḥ śakyamutvaṃ vidhātum, tathā hi sati kuruta
ityādau vikaraṇavyavāye'pi na syāt, kva tarhi syāt yatra
vikaraṇasya lopaḥ kuryāt, kurma ityādau yadyapyatrāpi
sthānivadbhāvāvdyavadhānaṃ tathāpi vacanādīdṛśaṃ vyavadhānamāśrīyate,
tasmādbhāvatīdaṃ prayojanam na prayojanam satyapyukāralope tasya
sthānivadbhāvātpratyayalakṣaṇena vā ata ut ityatra mvorya
ityanuvṛtervā utvaṃ bhaviṣyati | 
e iha tarhi kariṣyate iti ciṇvadiṭo'siddhatvāṇṇilopapo bhavati,
anyathā aniṭīti pratiṣedhaḥ syāt tatra ciṇvadiṭ ceti cakāraḥ
samuccaye - iṭ ca yaccānyatprāpnoti, kiṃ cānyatprapnoti ṇilopaḥ,
avaśyaṃ cakāreṇaiva ṇilopaḥ samuccetavyaḥ, anyathā
ciṇvadiṭo'siddhatve'pi valādilakṣaṇeneṭā seḍbuddhireva
ṇilopaśāstrasyāsminviṣaye vartata iti lopo naiva syāt, ciṇo
lug ityatra ca anudātopadeśa ityataḥ kṅidgrahaṇamanuvartya tasya
ciṇaḥ iti pañcamyā ṣaṣṭha|laṃ prakalpitāyāṃ ciṇa utarasya kiṅito
lugvidhīyate, tenākāritarāmityādau tarapo na bhaviṣyati | 
e iha tarhi śuna iti śvayuvamaghonāma iti samprasāraṇe su - an as
samprasāraṇapūrvatvaṃ bādhitvā allopo'naḥ ityakāralope sati
vibhakteranudātanivṛttisvaraḥ prāpnoti, kṛte'sminyoge
samprasāraṇasyāsiddhatvāt na saṃyogādvamantāt iti
pratiṣedhādallope'sati samprasāraṇapūrvatve sati ekādeśa
udātenodātaḥ ityādyaudātaṃ padaṃ bhavati | nātrāllope
satyudātanivṛttisvarasya prasaṅgaḥ, na gośvansāvavarṇa iti
pratiṣedhāt | naiṣa udātanivṛttisvarasya pratiṣedhaḥ , kasya tarhi
tṛtīyādisvarasya | sa ca śvabhyām, śvabhiriti halādau 
evibhaktāvudātalopābhāve caritārthaḥ evaṃ tarhi na lakṣaṇapratiṣedhaṃ
śiṣmaḥ, kiṃ tarhi yena kenacitpraptasaya tṛtīyādisvarasya | yatra tarhi
tṛtīyādirnāsti - śunaḥ paśyeti, tatrodātanivṛttisvaraḥ prāpnoti
evaṃ tarhi tṛtīyādigrahaṇamapi nivartiṣyate, aviśeṣeṇa
vibhaktisvaramātrasya pratiṣedhaḥ | thajñāpakādvā siddham, yadayaṃ śvanśabdaṃ
gaurādiṣu paṭhati, tajjhāpayati - nodātanivṛtasvaraḥ
śunyavataratīti | 
e evamapi vidyate viśeṣaḥ, allopena vā nivṛtau satyāṃ pūrvatvena
vā allope sati, bahavaḥ śvāno yasyāmiti
bahuvrīherupadhālopitvād ana upadhālopinaḥ iti ṅīpā bhāvyam -
bahuśunīti, tadabhāve tu bahuśveti bhavati |
gaurādiṅīṣo'pyanupasarjanādhikārādatrāprasaṅgaḥ | kiñca -
jñāpakātsāmānyena vā niṣedhādudatanivṛttisvarābhāve'pi
kathamādyaudātaṃ padaṃ bhavati, na hyallope satyekādeśāsvaro'sti,
tataśca sarvānudātaṃ padaṃ syāt, tadetadbhavati prayojanam na
prayojanam, antaraṅgatvātpūrvatvaṃ bhavati | na ca vārṇādāṅgasya
balīyastvam vyāśrayatvāt vibhaktirallopasya nimitam, pūrvatvasya
tu śvanśabdākāraḥ | 
e iha tahi bhūyāniti bhūbāvasyāsiddhatvādorguṇo na bhavediti |
dīrghoccāraṇasāmarthyānna bhaviṣyati | asti dīrghoccāraṇe prayojanam,
kim bhūmneta, nipātanādapyetasiddham utarapadābhūmnīti | idaṃ ca
sūryeṇaikadik saurī balāketi dvayorakārayoryasyeti lope'pi
vacanasāmarthyād bhūtapūrvaṃgatyopadhāśrayaṇāllopo bhaviṣyati | 
e tadevaṃ na santi prayojanāni, pratipatigauravaparihārārtha
sūtramārabdham || 
eśanānnalopaḥ || 6 - 4 - 23 || 
epṛthakpadaṃ luptaṣaṣṭhīkam, tenotaratropadhāgrahaṇena nakāro
viśeṣyate | śnamayamutsṛṣṭamakāro gṛhyata iti | anyasya
śnasyāsambhāvat | anaktīti | añjū vyaktimrakṣaṇakrāntigatiṣu, bhañjo
āmarddane, hisi hiṃsāyām | 
e śakāravato grahaṇaṃ kim iha mā bhūt, nanditā - nandakaḥ | evaṃ
vakṣyāmi nānnalopa'niditām taiti, tataḥ hala upadhāyāḥ kṅiti iti
aniditām ityeva, ihāpi na syāt - hinastīti | pāmādibhyo naḥ -
asya ca grahaṇaṃ syāt evaṃ tarhi kṅitīti vartate, satsaptamī caiṣā -
kṅiti satīti, tena hinastītyatra tipaḥ pitavādaṅtve'ipi
śnamameva ṅtimāśritya lopo bhaviṣyati | ihāpi tarhi prāpnoti -
nandamāna iti, cānaśo ṅtvāt eviṃ tarhi naśabdameva kṅtveni
viṣeṣayiṣyāmaḥ - kṅito niśbadāditi, tasmāt nānnalopaḥ iti
vaktavyamiti pṛcchati - śakāravato grahaṇaṃ kimiti | yajñānāmati |
yajayāca ityādinā naṅ, ścanatvam, tasyāsiddhatvānnaśabda evāyam |
nanu yadyapi nāmi dīrghādayaṃ lopaḥ paraḥ, supi ca
ityetarddarghatvamasmātparam, tatra kṛte nāditi vyapadeśābhāvādeva
lopo na bhaviṣyati ata āha - supi cetyādi | sthānivadbhāvāditi
| pūrvasyādapi vidhau sthānivadbhāvāt | 
e atha gṛhyamāṇe'pi śakāravato grahaṇe viśnānām, praśnānāmityatra
kasmānna bhavati, nanu samprati śnarupatvādatraiva prāpnoti ata āha -
viśnānāmiti | 
eatra saṃgrahalokaḥ - 
e nānnasyāyaṃ vidheyo nanu lubaniditāṃ nanditā cāpi sidhyed 
e hiṃserna prāptirevaṃ kṅiti sati tu tathā nandamāno na sidhyet
| 
e kṅnnācceccāthi yatnādvahuvacanābidhau duṣyati sthānivatvād 
e viśnānāṃ lakṣaṇoktapratipadavacanātsiddha evetyadoṣaḥ || 
e lopanaṃ lup, lopa ityarthaḥ | rāllopaḥ iti prakṛte lopagrahaṇaṃ
vispaṣṭārtham || 
eaniditāṃ hara upadhāyāḥ kṅiti || 6 - 4 0 24 || 
e ikāra itsaṃjñako yeṣā te iditaḥ tato'nye'niditaḥ, teṣāṃ
viṣeṣaṇam - halaḥ iti | vyatyayena tvekavacanam | sanīsraṃsyata iti |
nīgvañcu ityādinā'bhyāsasya nīgāgamaḥ | nānandyata iti | ṭuaṇadi
samṛddhau, yaṅ, dīrgho'kitaḥ | nahyata iti | kitparatvena nakāro
viśeṣyate | yena nāvyāvadhānamityekena vyāvadhānamāśrīyate -
ityetatu durjñānamiti bhāvaḥ | 
e laṅgikampyoriti | iditvādvacanam | kṛcchraprāptiratropatāpaḥ
na rogaḥ, śarīravikāra ityeva siddhatvāt | 
eśarīravikāro'tra vyādhirucyate, nasvābhāvikaḥ sthaulyādiḥ |
vilagitaḥ, vikapita iti | gatyarthākarmaka ityādinā kartari ktaḥ | 
e mitvādupadhāhrasvatvamiti | etadeva mitvavacanaṃ jñāpakam -
rañjerakṅityapyupadhālopo bhavatīti | 
e rajakarajanarajaḥ sūpasaṃkhyānamiti | kitvātsiddham | kita ete
auṇādikāḥ pratyayāḥ, kvun śilpisaṃjñayoḥ - rajakaḥ |
puṃyogānṅīṣu - rajakī | apuṃyoge tu naiva ṅīṣā bhavitavyam |
rañjeḥ kyun - rajanaḥ | sa ca bāhulakāṭṭit, rajanī |
śrṝañjibhyāṃ kicca ityasun, śiraḥ rajaḥ || 
edaṃśasañjasvañjāṃ śapi || 6 - 4 - 25 || 
e pariṣvajata iti | ṣvañja pariṣvaṅge, anudātet,
upasargātsunoti ityādinā ṣatvam || 
erañjeśca || 6 - 4 - 26 || 
e pṛthagyogakaraṇamutarārthamiti | utaratra rañjerevānuvṛttiryathā
syāt, daṃśiprabhūtīnāṃ mā bhūt || 
eghañi ca bhāvakaraṇayoḥ || 6 - 4 - 27 || 
e rāga iti | haraśca iti karaṇādhikaraṇayorghañ, cajoḥ ku
dhiṇṇyatoḥ iti kutvam || 
esyado jave || 6 - 4 - 28 || 
e javaḥ - vegaḥ | 
e gosyada iti | gorgativiṣayo vega ityarthaḥ | tailasyanda iti |
tailasya sravaṇamityarthaḥ || 
eavodaidhodmapraśrathahimaśrathāḥ || 6 - 4 - 29 || 
e undī tkedane, indhī dīptau, śrantha mocanaharṣayoḥ || 
enāñce pūjāyām || 6 - 4 - 30 || 
e udāharaṇe matibuddhipūjārtha ityādinā vartamāne ktaḥ, ktasya ca
vartamāne iti kartari ṣaṣṭhī | atha nāñceriṭi ityeva kasmānnoktam
naivaṃ śakyaṃ vaktum iha hi na syāt - samañcate guruḥ, guruṃ
samañcyāgata iti | iḍvidhau vṛttikāro vakṣyati - niṣṭhāyām asya
vibhāṣā iti pratiṣedhe prāpte ktvāyām, tathā udito vā iti
vikalpe prāpte pūjāyāṃ nityamiḍvidhīyate iti | tena
gurumaṅtveti pūjāyāmasādhureva || 
ektvi skandisyandoḥ || 6 - 4 - 31 || 
e na ktvā seḍiti kitvapratiṣedhādeveti | tena seṭaḥ
tavāpratyayasyodāharaṇaṃ na pradarśitamiti bhāvaḥ || 
ejāntanaśāṃ vibhāṣā || 6 - 4 - 32 || 
e maktvā, maṅtvā, naṣṭvā, naṃṣṭvā | masjinaśorjhali iti
tum | antagrahaṇaṃ vispaṣṭārtham varṇagrahaṇādeva tadantavidhilābhāt
|| 
e śāsa idaṅhaloḥ || 6 - 4 - 34 || 
e aṅgākṣiptasya pratyayasya halā viśeṣaṇātadādividhirityāha -
halādau ca kṅitīti | 
e kvau ca śāsa iti | nityātvātkvipo lope
halāderabhāvādvacanam | pratyayalakṣaṇena tu siddham, yatra kārye
varṇarupameva nimitatve nāśrīyate tadvarṇāśrayatvāt pratyayalakṣaṇena na
bhavati, yathā - rāyaḥ kulaṃ raikulamityāyādeśaḥ | yatu
varṇaviśiṣṭapratyayanimitaṃ tadbhavatyeva, yathā - atṛṇeḍiti,
halādau piti sārvadhātuke vidhīyamānastṛṇaha imāgamaḥ, idamapītvaṃ
halādau kṅiti pratyaye vidhīyamānaṃ lope'pi bhavati |
āryaśīriti | sakārasya rutve rvorupadhāyāḥ iti dīrghaḥ | 
e athā''śāste, āśāsyāmāna ityatra kasmānna bhavati ityāha -
yasmācchāseriti | aṅvidhau tāvatparasmaipadibhyāmartisartibhyāṃ
sāhacaryātparasmaipadinaḥ śāsergrahaṇam, ihāpyaṅsaṃsargādviśiṣṭasya
śāsergrahaṇaṃ saṃsargasya viśeṣāvagatihetutvāt | yathā - savatsā
dhenurānīyatāṃ sakalabhā sakiśoreti gavādirghenuḥ pratīyate | nanu
ca nātrāṅ kevalo nimitam, api tu halādirapi, sa
cātmanepadino'pi sambhavati, tatkutaḥ saṃsargādviśiṣṭasya pratītiḥ
naiṣa doṣaḥ sādhāraṇāsādhāraṇasambandhisannipāte yasyāsādhāraṇaḥ
sambandhī sannihitastasyaiva grahaṇaṃ bhavati, yathā vṛddhānāṃ kiśorīṇāṃ
ca madhye dhenavo badhyante ityukte baḍavā dhanavo badhyante | 
etasmādaṅhalordvayorapyupādāne yasmācchāseraṅ vihitastasyaiva
grahaṇam | śāsivasighasītanāṃ ca iti ṣatvavidhau śāsimātrasya grahaṇaṃ
draṣṭavyam āśiṣiliṅloṭau ityādinirdeśāt || 
e śā hau || 6 - 4 - 35 || 
e upadhāyā iti nivṛtamiti | taddhi upadhāgrahaṇaṃ kṅtītyinena
sambaddham, taiha ca kṅidgrahaṇaṃ nivṛtam iti vakṣyati, tena
tatsambaddhamupadhāgrahaṇaṃ ca nivṛtam | sthāneyogā ṣaṣṭhī bhavatīti |
etacca śabdādhikārapakṣasyāśrayaṇāllabhyate, arthādhikāre
tvihāpyavayavasambandhānna sarvasya syāt | 
e kṅtītyipi nivṛtamiti | utaratra punaḥ kṅidgrahaṇāt |
teneti | anyathā sārvadhātukamapit iti vacanātpitvapakṣe
ṅtivābhāvācchābhāvo na syāt | mā bhūtpitvapakṣe, dṛśyamānastu
prayogo'pitvapakṣe'pyupapadyate ata āha - śādhītyādyaudātamapīti |
yadi tu piti śābhāvo na syāt, tadā śādhītyetatsatiśiṣṭena
pratyasvareṇāntodāta eva syāt | ādyaudātamapi dṛśyate,
tasmātpityapi śābhāva eva draṣṭavyaḥ | 
e iha ā hau vaktavyam, upadhāyā ityeva,
ākārasyākāravacanamitvavādhānārtham, tataḥ huḍhalbhyo herdhiḥ iti
dhitvam, dhi ca iti sakāralopaḥ | yeṣāṃ tu dhi sakāre sico
lopaḥ iti pakṣaḥ, teṣāṃ śābhāva eva vidheya anyathā upadhāyāḥ tyisya
nivṛtāvapi sakārasyākāre tasyāsiddhatvādyadyapi dhitvaṃ labhyate,
upadhāyāstu pūrveṇetvamāśaṅkyeta, avirodhāt || 
ehanterjaḥ || 6 - 4 - 36 || 
e śtipā nirdeśo yaṅlugnivṛtyarthaḥ | 
e anudātepadeśāvanatitanotyādīnāmanunāsika lopo jhali
kṅiti || upadiśyante ityupadeśāḥ, anudātāśca te upadeśāśca
anudātopadeśāḥ | upadiśyamānāvasthāyāmanudātā ityarthaḥ |
anunāsiketi pṛthakpadaṃ luptaṣaṣṭhīkamanudātopadeśānāṃ
viśeṣaṇam, tena tadantavidhiḥ | 
e yamiramītyādi | yamiryamanteṣu iti śloko vakṣyate | vanateriti
| vana ṣaṇa sambhaktau | 
e sanoterātvaṃ vakṣyatīti | janasanakhanāṃ sañjhaloḥ ityanena | atata,
atathā iti | tanādibhyastathāsoḥ iti sico luk | 
e iha ca yathā syāditi | anyathā ktini nitsvareṇa sampratyudātatvānna
syāt | iha ca mā bhūditi | anyathā pratyayasvare kṛte śeṣanidhāte
sampratyanudātatvācchānta ityādāvapi syāt || 
egamaḥ kvau || 6 - 4 - 40 || 
e adhvagata iti | adhvano gantāra ityarthaḥ | anunāsikalope kṛte
hrasvasya tuk | 
e saṃyaditi | sampūrvādyameḥ kvip | parītaditi | tanoteḥ kpip,
nahivṛttivṛdhi ityādinā pūrvapadasya dīrghaḥ| 
e ūceti | cakārādanunāsikalopaśca | agregūriti |
anunāsikalope kṛte akārasya ūkāraḥ | kvacid ūṅiti ṅkāraḥ
paṭha|lte, na tsaya prayojanamasti | oḥ supi iti yaṇādeśo
dhātutvādbhavati - agregvau, agregva| agrebhrūriti | evaṃ, ca kṛtvā
aciṃ śnudhātu ityatra bhrūgrahaṇaṃ na kartavyaṃ dhātutvādeva siddham || 
eviḍvanoranunāsikasyāt || 6 - 4 - 41 || 
e agregā ityādi | yadyapyakāravidhāne'pi savarṇadīrgheṇa siddhyati,
ato guṇe iti pararupatve hi atolopameva vidadhyāt | ye
tvakāropadhā na bhavanti, tadartha dīrghoccāramam - ghuṇa ghūrṇa bhramaṇe,
anyabhyo'pi dṛśyante iti vanip, dhvāvā, dhūrāvā | kṣiṇu - kṣāvā,
ṛṇu - rāvā, oṇṛ - avāvā || 
e janasanakhanāṃ sañjhaloḥ || 6 - 4 - 42 || 
e jhalśabdenātra jhalādirgṛhyate aṅgenākṣiptasya pratyayasya jhalā
viśeṣaṇāt | kṅidgrahaṇaṃ tasya viśeṣaṇam | prakṛtaṃ tu
jhalgrahaṇaṃ sano viśeṣaṇam | 
e tadiheti | vākyopanyāse | vipratiṣedhāditi |
sanotestanotyādipāṭhasyāvakāśo'nyatanādi kāryam -
tanādikṛñbhya uḥ, tanādibhyastathāsoḥ iti, iha tvātvavidhau
sangrahaṇasyāvakāśaḥ san, śiṣāsati, syataḥ,
sātavānityatrobhayaprasaṅge paratvādātvaṃ bhavati | 
e nanu cāsiddhakāṇḍe vakṣyati - pūrvatrāsiddhe nāsti
vipratiṣedho'bhāvādutarasyeti, yatra kilaikasyāpyāṃsaddhatve
vipraṣedhābhāvastatra kā kathā dvayorapyasiddhatve ityata āha -
ghumāsthāgāpājahātītyādi | vipratiṣedho bhavatīti | vipratiṣedhena
vyavasthāyāṃ kriyamāṇāyāmāsaddhatvaṃ na bhavatītyatheḥ | kathaṃ kṛtvā
jñāpakam hargarhaṇasyaitatprayojanam - halādau yathā syāt, iha mā
bhūt - gaudaḥ, kambalada iti | yadi cātra vipratiṣeṣo na
syāddhalgrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt | astvatretvam,
tasyāsiddhatvādiyaṅadeśo asatyāllope tatsiddhaṃ syāt, sati
vipratiṣedhe āllopa syāvakāśaḥ - pāṇṇitram, aṅgulitramiti,
ītvasya - dīyate, mīyate goda ityādāvasati halgrahaṇe
paratvādītvaṃ syāditi halgrahaṇamarthavadbhavati naitadasti jñāpakam
vyavasthārthametatsyāt | asati hi tasminnītvasyāsiddhatvādālopaḥ,
tasyāsiddhatvādītvamiti cakrakamavyavasthā prāpnoti nāsti
cakrakaprasaṅgaḥ,na hyavyayasthākāriṇā śāstreṇa bhavitavyam, śāstrato
nāma vyavasthā | tatra pūrvamītvam, tasyāsiddhatvādāllopaḥ,
lopenāvasthānaṃ bhaviṣyati | evamapi kuta etat -
ītvāsyāsiddhatvādāllāpaḥ, lopenāvaasthānamiti, na punarviparyaṃyaḥ
syāt -pūrvamāllopaḥ, tasyāsiddhatvādītvamītvena vyavasthānamiti
evaṃ tarhi yadi vyavasthārthametatsyāt, naivāyaṃ halgrahaṇaṃ kurvīta,
aviśeṣeṇāyamītvaṃ kṛtvā tasyājādau lopamavādaṃ vidadhīta, katham
idamasti āto lopa iṭi ca, tato dhumāsthānagāpājahātisāṃ lopo
bhavati - iṭi cājādau ca kṅitīti, kimartha punaridamītvam
vakṣyati - tasya bādhanārthaṃ tat, īdbhavati dhvādhīnām, tataḥ elīṅ,
vānyasya saṃyogādeḥ, na lyapi, mayateridanyatarasyām, tataḥ yati
ca, yati ca īdbhavati ātaḥ ityeva so'yamevaṃ laghīyasā nyāsena
siddhe sati yati yaddhalgrahaṇaṃ karoti tad gariyāṃsaṃ yatnamārabhate,
tajjñāpayatyācāryaḥ - bhavatīha vipratiṣedha iti | 
e iha jhalgrahaṇaṃ śakyamakartum | katham yogavibhāgaḥ kartavyaḥ -
janasanakhanāmanunāsikasyākārādeśo bhavi, jhali kṅiti tataḥ sani
ca, janasanakhanāmākārādeśo bhavati jhalītyeva || 
e ye vibhāṣā || 6 - 4 - 43 || 
e jāyata iti | yak | nityaṃ jādeśo bhavatīti | tasyānavakāśatvāt
| tena śyani jāyate ityeva bhavati, na tu kadācit janyata iti || 
esanaḥ ktici lopaścāscānyatarasyām || 6 - 4 - 45 || 
e asyagrahaṇamanantarasya ktico mā bhūd, vyavahitasyāpi dhātoreva
yathā syāt | kriyamāṇe hi tasminkāyitvena prādhānyavdyavahitasyāpi
dhātoreva parāmarśo bhavati | 
e anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇamanarthakam, vibhāṣā iti prakṛtatvād ata āha -
anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇamiti | nanu naitadvispaṣṭanīyaṃ prakṛtamanuvartata
iti tadāha ye saṃbaddhaṃ hīti || 
eārdhadhātuke || 6 - 4 - 46 || 
e cikīrṣiteti | sanantātṛc bhavatīti sarvatrāto lope kṛte ato
dīrgho yañi ityasya ko'vakāśaḥ, vacanātpacāva tyādiu lopaṃ
bādhitvā dīrgho'stu | tatra caritārtham
adupadeśāllasarvadhātukānudātatvam iti tadapi na jñāpakaṃ
sārvadhātuke'to lopābhāvasya yatarhyadiprabhṛtibhyaḥ śapo lukaṃ
śāsti tajjñāpayati - na śapo'to lopa iti tatrāha - adipramṛtibhyaḥ
śapa iti | ye tarhi na guṇavṛddhibhājo'diprabhṛtayasteṣāmadādiṣu
pāṭhonarthakaḥ satyam vṛkṣatvam, vṛkṣatetyādāvato lope
ārdadhadhātukādhikārasya prayojanam - bebhidyate ityatra śapi
sārvadhātuke na bhavati | yaṅe yakāropaśastu halanteṣu caritārthaḥ
| 
e kāravatīti | ṇijvidhānaṃ pratyayalakṣaṇārthamiyaṅtha ca syāt | 
e yāntīti | nanu śnābhyastayorātḥ ityenniyamārtha bhaviṣyat -
sārvadhātuke śnābhyastayoreveti naitadasti viparīto'pi noyamaḥ
syāt - śnābhyastayoḥ sārvadhātuka eveti, tadā ca yayaturityādau
na syāt | śnāgrahaṇaṃ tūtarārtha syāt | 
e adātāmiti | luṅ, gātisthāghu ityādinā sico luk | 
e ciṇvadbhāve sati vṛddhiḥ syāditi | nanvato lopo vṛddheḥ
pūrvavipratiṣedhe, tadyathā - cikīrṣaka iti, adihanimāvāprabhṛtibhyaḥ
śapo lugvidhānena sārvadhātuke'tolopābhāvasya
jñāpitatvātsvāśrayo'to lāpo mā 
ebhūcciṇvadbhāvātu ciṇi tasya darśanātsyādeva | vṛttikāreṇa tu
prāptimātramāśritya vṛddhiḥ syāt - ityuktam | doṣopalakṣaṇaṃ
vṛddhagrahaṇam, lope'pi rupāsiddhareva | 
e tato yuk prasajyeteti | ādguṇaḥ, iti tu vārṇatvānna labhyate,
iṭprasaṅgastu viśeṣābhāvānnoktaḥ | 
e prayojanasaṃgraharśloko gatārthaḥ | bhrasjo
ropadhayoramanyatarasyām, dīṅe yuḍaci kṅiti ityatra tu nāsya
prayojanam, katham bhṛjjateḥ sārvadhātuke tudāditvācchaḥ, tatra
grahijyādisūtreṇa samprasāraṇam | dīṅe'pi divāditvān śyanā
bhāvyamityuktānyeva prayojanāni | 
e asiddhatvanivṛtyarthaṃ dvitīyādhyāyagocaroḥ | 
e ādeśā neha vihitā vugāllopau prayojanam || 
e anyathā - astyādeśasya bhavaterasiddhatvānna vugbhavet | 
e na cācakhyaturityādāvāllopaḥ khyāñasiddhitaḥ || 
ebhrāsjo ropadhayo ramanyatarasyām || 6 - 4 - 47 || 
e ramityayaṃ ropadhayoryadi sthāne bhavati mitvamasyānarthakaṃ syāt,
athāco'ntyātpara āgamo ropadhayoḥ śravaṇaṃ prāpnoti tatrā''ha -
ropadhayoḥ prasaṅge ram prayujyate, ropadhe na prayujyete ityarthaḥ
| prayujyamānaśca ram mitvādantyādacaḥ paraḥ prayujyate | yasya tu
deśāntare vidhānaṃ nāsti sa sthānideśa eva bhavati, tatprasaṅge hi
tasya vidhānam, viśiṣṭadeśaśca sthāninaḥ prasaṅgaḥ | iha tu
mitvenāyaṃ nyāyo bādhyate sthānaṣaṣṭhīnirdeśasāmarthyātu sanaḥ ktici
ityato lopagrahaṇamanuvartya ropadhayorlopaṃ ramāgamaṃ
cānyatarasyāṃ vidadhati | bhrajjanamiti | lyuṭi sakārasya jaśtvam -
dakāraḥ, tasya cutvam - jakāraḥ | 
e pūrvavipratiṣedheneti | ramo'vakāśaḥ - bhraṣṭā, bhraṣṭuam,
samprasāraṇasyāvakāśaḥ - bhṛjjati, sārvadhātukatvādatra ramo'prasaṅgaḥ,
bhṛṣṭaḥ bhṛṣṭavānityatra pūrvavipratiṣedhaḥ | athaivaṃ kasmānnoktam -
bhrasjo rasa ṛdanyatarasyām iti bhrasjeḥ sambandhī ramiti yo'yaṃ
saṅghātastasya ṛ ityayamādeśo bhavatītyarthaḥ | tasyākṅiti guṇe
kṛte bharjanamityādi rupaṃ bhavati, ṛkārābhāvapakṣe tu bhrajjanamiti
kṅiti ṛkārapakṣe bhṛṣṭamiti, tadabhāvapakṣe tu, grahijyādisūtreṇa
samprasāraṇe sati tadeva rupaṃ bhavatīti pūrvavipratiṣedho na vaktavyo
bhavati upadeśagrahaṇamapi nānuvartyam na hyatra pakṣe rīkaḥ prasaṅge'sti
atrāpi patre pūrvavipratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ kva sici vṛddhau
abhārkṣīditi anyathā ṛkāravikalpaṃ bādhitvā paratvāddhalantalakṣaṇā
vṛddharnityaṃ prāpnoti | rambhāve tu kriyamāṇe paratvādvṛddhau
kṛtāyāmapi punaṛ prasaṅgavijñānamiti siddham - abhārkṣīditi | na
cāntaraṅgatvātparvamṛkāraḥ, na sicyantaraṅgamastīti
vakṣyamāṇatvāt | evaṃ tarhi nityatvādḥbhāvaḥ, sa hi kṛtāyāmapi
vṛddhau prāpnotyakṛtāyāmapi ekadeśavikṛtasyānanyatvāt
śabdāntaraprāptirapi nāsti, vṛddhistu kṛte ṛbhāve ṛkārasyākṛte
tvakārasyeti śabdāntaraprāpteranityā, tasmādṛkāra eva vidheyaḥ tathā
tu na kṛtamityeva | bhrasjerbhṛjjirityucyamāne yaṅluki doṣaḥ,
sābhyāse bhṛjjibhāvaḥ prāpnoti, iṣyate tu tatrāpi ropadhayoreva
nivṛtī, rambhāvaśca | 
e barībhṛjyata iti | yaṅ simprasāraṇa rīgṛtvata iti vaktavyam iti
rīk, tasya tanmadhyapatitasya tadgrahaṇātprasaṅgaḥ || 
eato lopaḥ || 6 - 4 - 48 || 
e dhinutaḥ, kṛṇuta iti | ivi divi dhivi prīṇanārthāḥ, kṛvi
haāāsākaraṇayoḥ, laṭ, tasya tas, dhinvikṛṇvyora ca iti upratyayaḥ,
akāro'ntādeśaśca, tasya copratyaye'to lopaḥ | ekavacane
tvāntareṇāto lopamupratyayasya guṇe kṛte ato guṇe iti
pararupeṇāpi siddhiḥ | 
e cetā, stoteti | taparakaraṇasya pṛthagvyāvartyasya
darśayiṣyamāṇatvātadrahitasyākāraramātrasyedaṃ pratyudāharaṇam, evaṃ
ca guṇavṛddhyordīrgheṣu caritārthatvād hrasveṣu lopaprasaṅgaḥ |
nanu ca paratvād guṇo bhaviṣyati, tasmātkṛṭādiṣu gu
purīṣotsarge, dhruva gatisthairyayoḥ ityatra lopaprasaṅga udāhāryaḥ |
yātā, vātā taiti | asati takāre'trāpi lopaprasaṅgaḥ āto lopa
iṭi ca ityetanniyamārthaṃ bhaviṣyati - āta iṭa|levājādau ca kṅiti,
nānyatreti naitadasti viparīto'pi niyamaḥ syāt - āta eveṭi,
nānyasyeti | thā ca cikīrṣitetyatra na syāt | 
e vṛddhadīrghābhyāmiti | aco ñṇiti iti vaddherevakāśaḥ nauritisa
ato lopasyāvakāśaḥ cikīrṣiteti, cikīrṣakaḥ - ityatrobhayaprasaṅge
pūrvavipratiṣedhaḥ | vṛddhau tu yuki - cikīrṣāyaka iti syāt |
akṛtsārvadhātukayoḥ ityasya dīrghasyāvakāśaḥ cīyate, ato
lopasyāvakāśaḥ sa evaḥ cikīrṣyate - ityatrobhayaprasaṅge
pūrvapipratiṣedhaḥ || 
e yasya halaḥ || 6 - 4 - 49 || 
e yasyeti yadyāgantuko'kāraḥ, tato varṇagrahaṇam, anyathā tu
saṅghātagrahaṇamiti pakṣadvayasambhavādāha - yasyeti saṅghātagrahaṇamiti
| śrutasyākārasyāvivakṣāyāṃ kāraṇābhāvāditi bhāvaḥ ato lopa
ityanenaiva siddhatvāditi | astu tarhi niyamaḥ yasya hala eva nānyataḥ,
lolūyitakā, popūyitā, kaimarthyāddhi niyamo bhavati nidheyaṃ
nāstīti kṛtvā iha cāsti vidheyam, kim antyasya lopaḥ prāptaḥ
sarvasya vidheyaḥ | tatrāpūrvo vidhirastu, niyamo veti apūrvo
vidhireva bhaviṣyati | 
e evamapi kyasya vibhāṣāyāṃ doṣaḥ - samidhamicchati samidhyati,
samidhyatestṛca, iṭ , samidhitā, yadā lopastadā sarvasya lopaḥ,
yadā tvalopapakṣastadā sarvasyālopaḥ prāpnoti, saṅghatagrahaṇe hi
yasya halaḥ ityanena yenanāprāptinyāyena ato lopo bādhyaḥ,
yalopo'pi kyasya vibhāṣā iti vikalpena bādhyaḥ, tataśca pakṣe
saṅghātasyaiva śravaṇaṃ syāt, yalopavadāllopasyāpi vikalpena
bādhanāt ityata āha - hala iti vetyādi | evaṃ ca kyasya vibhāṣā iti
yakārasyaiva vikalpena lopaḥ, akārasya tu ato lopaḥ ityanena
nityamiti siddhimaṣṭam, avaśyaṃ cāto lopa evātraiṣṭavyaḥ, anyathā
pāpacaka ityādau ata upadhāyāḥ iti vṛddhiḥ syāt, sthānivadbhāvānna
bhavati | tasmātsaṅṅghātasya grahaṇam, avayavaśastu lopa iti, tadeva
yuktam | 
e mavyiteti | mavyatiḥ saṃyogānto'sti, jvaratvārādisūtre tu
vakārānta udādṛtaḥ || 
ekyasya vibhāṣā || 6 - 4 - 50 || 
e kyasya iti kyackyaṅeḥ sāmānyena grahaṇam, kyaṣastu
halantādasambhavaḥ | samidhamivātmānamācaratīti | apapāṭho'yam, evaṃ
hi kyaṅe vākyaṃ na pradarśitaṃ syāt, kyacaśca dvitīyaṃ vākyāmanarthakaṃ
syāt | vidhibhedānnānarthakamiti cet yadyevam, adhikaraṇācceti
vaktavyam ityasyāpi pradarśanīyaṃ syāt | tasmātsamidivācaratīti
pāṭhaḥ | atra kecitkaṇḍvādiyako'pi grahaṇamicchanti, kyasya iti
kato yakārasya grahaṇe tātparyam, tāaditvaṃ kakārasyāvivakṣitaṃ
vadanti, neti vayam āditvāvikṣāyaṃ pramāṇābhāvāt || 
eṇeraniṭi || 6 - 4 - 51 || 
e iyaṅadibhireva sarvasya viṣayasyāvaṣṭabdhatvādanavakāśo
ṇilopasteṣāṃ bādhaka ityāha - iyaṅyaṇityādi | 
enanu pācayateḥ pāktiḥ, yājayateryāṣṭirityudārahiṣyati,
ṇyāsaśrantho yuc iti yuci prāpte ktinnajādibhyaḥ iti ktinpratyayaḥ
ktijvā punarayaṃ draṣṭavyaḥ, tatkathamanavakāśaḥ ucyate, yadyetāvat
prayojanaṃ syāt, aniṭīti na vaktavyaṃsyat, ato'niṭīti
vacanādīrghadhātukamātraviṣayatāsyāvasīyate, tataśca
yuktamiyaṅadīnpratyapavādatvam | vārtikakāreṇa tu pūrvavipratiṣedhaḥ
paṭhitaḥ - ṇyallopāviyaṅyaṇguṇavṛddhidīrghebhyaḥ pūrvavipratiṣedhena
iti | atatakṣaditi | atra caṅe ṅitvād guṇisyāprasaṅgaḥ,
saṃyogapūrvatvād eranekācaḥ iti yaṇo'pyaprasaṅgaḥ | iyaṅ 
eevāyaṃ viṣayaḥ, saṃyogapūrvatvād eranekācaḥ iti
yaṇo'pyaprasaṅgaḥ | iyaṅ evāyaṃ viṣayaḥ, atreyaṅ siti punaḥ
prasaṅgavijñānāt bhavannapi lopo'ntyasya syāt | | āśiśaditi |
eranekācaḥ iti yaṇo'tra prasaṅgaḥ | atra satyapi yaṇi
asiddhatvātpunaḥprasaṅgavijñānena vā ṇilope sati siddhamiṣṭam | evaṃ
guṇavṛddhidīrghaviṣaye'pi draṣṭavyam | ca na
guṇavṛddhyorayādeśaprasaṅgaḥ, vārṇādāṅgaṃ balīyaḥ iti ṇilopaḥ
| jñīpsatīti | āpjñapyṛdhāmīt ajjhanagamāṃ sani iti dīrghaprasaṅgaḥ
| 
e aniṭīti śakyamakartum | kathaṃ kārayitā niṣṭhāyāṃ seṭi
ityetanniyamārthaṃ bhaviṣyati - seṭi yadi bhavati niṣṭhāyāmeveti |
viparītastu niyamo na bhavati - niṣṭhāyāṃ seṭa|leveti aniṭo
niṣṭhāyā asambhavāt | asambhāvaścotarasūtre vakṣyate | atha vā -
ayāmantālvāyyenviṣṇuṣu ityatra ṇeriti yogavibhāgaḥ kriyate,
seṭa|larddhadhātuke ṇerayādeśo bhavati lopasyāpavādaḥ || 
eniṣṭhāyāṃ seṭi || 6 - 4 - 52 || 
e seṭīti kimiti | aniṭi pūrveṇa siddhatvātseḍarthamevedaṃ sūtraṃ
bhaviṣyatīti praśnaḥ | sāmarthyātpūrvasūtraprāptereva
vyāvṛttirityutaram | 
e saṃjñāpita iti | vā dāntaśāntapūrṇa ityatra jñapernipātanamāśrīyate -
jñaptaḥ, jñapita iti | atha punariti | pratipatṛvipratipatyā
sandigdhābhidhānam | 
e kālāvadhāraṇārthamiti | seḍgrahaṇe kriyamāṇe yadā niṣṭhā
seḍbhavati tadā lopo bhavati na prāgiti kālābadhāraṇaṃ labhyate |
kiṃ punaḥ syādyadyevamarthaṃ seḍgrahaṇaṃ na kriyeta tatrāha - akṛte hīti |
ṇilope satīti | nityatvāt | sa hi kṛte'pīṭi
prāpnotyakṛte'pi, iṭpunaranityaḥ, ṇilope satyekāca iti
pratiṣedhāt |yasya ca nimitaṃ lakṣaṇāntareṇa vihanyate na
tadanityam, na hi bālisugrīvayoryudhyamānayorbhagavatā rāmeṇa
bālini hate sugrīvāpekṣayā bālino daurbalyaṃ manyante
śūramāninaḥ satyam kāryagatabhāvābhāvavivakṣāyāṃ tu tatrāśrīyate |
iṭpratiṣedhaḥ prasajyeteti | ekadeśavikṛtasyānanyatvāt | etacca
pūrvasmādapi vidhau sthānivadbhāvamanāśrityoktam| 
e bhāṣye tu sūtramidaṃ pratyākhyātam | saptame ṇeradhyayane vṛtam
ityayaṃ yogastredhā vibhaktavyaḥ, kramaviparyayaścāśrayaṇīyaḥ - ṇeḥ
ityeko yogaḥ, tatra niṣṭhāyāṃ neḍiti vartate - ṇyantādutarasya
niṣṭhāyā iṇna bhavati tataḥ vṛtam - vutamiti nipātyate, ṇilopaḥ |
kimarthamidam niyamārtham - atraiva niṣṭhāyāṃ ṇerlopo bhavati,
nānyatreti | kva mā bhūt kāritam, hāritam, kaimarthakyānniyamo
bhavati, vidheyaṃ nāstīti kṛtvā | iha cāsti vidheyam, kim
guṇābhāvaḥ | evaṃ tarhi tantrāvṛtyekaśeṣāṇāmanyatamāśrayaṇādekasya
niyamārthatvamaparasya guṇaniṣedhārthatvaṃ bhavati, tato'dhyayane,
varteradhyayana eva ṇilopa iti || 
eśamitā yajñe || 6 - 4 - 54 || 
e tṛci sambuddhyantametāditi | udāhṛtābhiprāyametat | sūtre tu
śuddhaprathamaikavacanāntam | sarvāsu ca vibhaktiṣu nipātanam
prathamaikavacanasthāvivakṣitatvāt | tathā ca sūtrārthakathanasamaye iḍādau
tṛci sāmānyenoktam | prayogo'pi tathāvidha eva - śāmitāro
yadatra sukṛtamiti, śamitṛbhyaścaivainantannigṛhītṛbyaśceti ca |
