śāmitramiti taddhite'pi bhavati | sūtre ca sambuddhyantaṃ vivakṣitaṃ
cecchamitaryajña iti prāpnoti || 
euyāmantālvāyyetnviṣṇuṣu || 6 - 4 - 55 || 
e gaṇḍayanta iti | gaḍi secane ghaṭādiḥ, maḍi bhūṣāyām -
ābhyāmauṇādiko jhac, jho'ntaḥ | spṛhayāluriti | spṛhigṛhi
ityādinā āluc | spṛhayāyya iti | bhṛdakṣispṛhibhya āyyaḥ |
stanayitnuriti | auṇādika itnuc | pārayiṣṇava iti | ṇeścchandasi
iti iṣṇuc || 
e neti vaktavye iti | ṇilope hi pratiṣiddhe guṇe satyayādeśaḥ
siddhaḥ, mātrālāghavaṃ ca bhavati | utarārthamiti | lyapi laghupūrvasya
iti ṣaṣṭha|lntamadhyāpitāḥ, anye pañcamyantam tatrādyapakṣe
praśamayyetyādau vyañjanānte na syāt, na hyatra ṇirlaghupūrvaḥ, kiṃ tarhi
vyañjanapūrvaḥ | na cāvyavahite | kva tarhi syāt pragaṇayya,
prastanayyetyādau yadyapyatrāllope kṛte ṇirlaghupūrvo na bhavati,
vyāśrayatvādallopasyāsiddhirapi nāsti, tathāpi
bhūtapūrvalaghupūrvatāmāśrityātraiva syāt | tathā
pracikīrpyetyādāvapi prasaṅgaḥ, samprati gurupūrvatve'pi
bhūtapūrvagatyā | tasmād dvitīyaṃ pakṣamāśritya vyācaṣṭe -
laghupūrvādvarṇāditi | 
e nanvatrāpi pakṣe praśamayyetyādau
hrasvādīnāmasiddhatvādayādeśāprasaṅgaḥ, kva tarhi syāt mṛdamācaṣṭa
iti ṇici prakṛtyaikāc iti prakṛtibhāvāṭṭilopābhāve pramṛdayya
gata ityādau syādata āha - hrasvayalopāllopānāmiti || 
evibhāṣā''paḥ || 6 - 4 - 57 || 
e āplṛ lambhane curādiḥ, āplṛ vyāptau svādiḥ - dvayorapi
grahaṇam | iha iṅ adhyayane, ṇic, krīṅjīnāṃ ṇau ityātvam, atihrī
ityādinā puka, adhyāpya gata ityatrāpi prāpnoti, āprupasya bhāvāt,
tasmāt sānubandhako nirddaśyaḥ | 
e āpuliti paṭhitavyam, āplṛśabdānṅasaḥ, ṛkāralṛkārayoḥ
savarṇatvāt ata ut ityutvam uraṇraparaḥ 
eityatra rapratyāhāragrahaṇāllaparatvam, sakārasya saṃyogāntalopaḥ,
tatahi tathā paṭhitavyam netyāha -ṅadeśasyeti || 
eniṣṭhāyāmaṇyadarthe || 6 - 4 - 60 || 
e ṇyataḥ kṛtyasyārtho bhāvakarmaṇī iti | yadyapi
bhavyageyādāvāplāvyāpātyaśabdayoḥ kartāpi pakṣe ṇyadantayorvācyaḥ,
tathāpi kṣiyaḥ sannidhānātadīyo ṇyadartha eva paryudasyate | 
e prakṣīṇamidaṃ devadatasyeti | adhikaraṇavācinaśca iti kartari ṣaṣṭhī |
adhikaraṇa iti | ktaḥ pratyaya ityanuṣaṅgaḥ | evamakṣitamiti bhāve
ityatrāpi || 
evā''krośadainyayoḥ || 6 - 4 - 61 || 
e kṣitāyuriti | pūrvavatkartari ktaḥ | kṣīṇaka iti | anukampāyām
iti kan | prāptavibhāṣeyam | aṇyadartha ityeva - kṣitaṃ sarvamasya,
kṣitamasya tapasvinaḥ || 
esyasicsīyuṭtāsiṣu bhāvakarmaṇorupadeśe'jjhanagrahadṛśāṃ vā
ciṇvadiṭ ca || 6 - 4 - 62 || 
e ciṇīva ciṇvat, tatra tasyeva iti saptamīsamarthādvatiḥ,
syasicsīyuṭtāsiṣu iti pratiyogini saptamīnirddeśāt,
yathā - mathurāvatpāṭaliputre prāsāda iti | bhāvakarmaviṣayeṣviti |
anena bhāvakarmaṇoḥ iti vaṣayasaptamīti darśayati | bhāvakarmaṇorye
syādayo vartante teṣvati tu vijñāyamāne sīyuḍeko viśeṣitaḥ
syāt, syādayo na viśeṣitāḥ syuḥ
bhāvakarmaṇorlādeśavācyatvātsīyuṭaśca viśeṣitaḥ syāt, syādayo
na viśeṣitājha syuḥ bhāvakarmaṇorlādeśavācyatvātsīyuṭaśca
tadbhaktatvāt | atha yadābāvakarmābhidhāyī pratyayo
bhāvakarmaśabdābhyāmabhidhīyate, tadāyamarthaḥ syāt - bhāvakarmavācini
pratyaye parato ye syādaya iti | tadā syādayo viśeṣitāḥ,
sīyuḍaviśeṣitaḥ, na hi tadbhaktasya tena saha paurvāparyaṃ sambhavati |
tasmātsarvānugrahāya viṣayasaptamyeva yuktā | yadā
ciṇvatadecaḍāgamo bhavatīti | cakārasya sanniyogārthatvāt |
kasyeti | ṣaṣṭhīniddiṣṭasyāgamo bhavati, syādayaśca
saptamīnirddiṣṭāḥ, ajjhanagrahadṛśām iti ṣaṣṭhīnirddiṣṭam,
aṅgasya iti ca vartate, ato'jantādīnāmaṅgānāmevāgāmitvaṃ
yuktamiti viparyayaṃ manyamānasya praśnaḥ |
syasicsīyuṭtāsīnāmevati | katham ityāha te hi prakṛtā iti
| sannihitā ityarthaḥ | nanvaṅgamapi prakṛtaṃ yogyavibhaktikaṃ ca tatrāha
- aṅgasya tviti | lakṣyavirodhāditi | yadvā - saptame yogavibāgaḥ
kriyate, ārdhadhātukasyeṭ, paribhāṣeyam, yo yāvānkaścidiḍāgamaḥ
sa sarva ārdhadhātukasyaiva draṣṭavyaḥ, tenāyamapīḍāgamaḥ syādīnāmeva
bhavati, nāṅgasya | 
e kāni punariti | ciṇi yadevāhatya vihitaṃ tadevātidiśyate,
āhosvit ciṇi dṛṣṭamātramiti praśnaḥ | tatra dvitīyaḥ pakṣa āśrīyata
iti ślokena darśayati - ciṇvadvaddhiriti | yathā ciṇi vṛddhiḥ tathā
syādiṣvapīṣyate - ghāniṣyate | etadekaṃ prayojanam, evamutaratrāpi
| pratyekaṃ sambandhena yathāyogamatideśo yojyaḥ| dāyiṣyata iti,
āto yuk ciṇ kṛtoḥ iti yuk, etacciṇyāhatya vihitam | yacca
ho hanterñṇinneṣu iti kutvamaghānītyatra dṛṣṭam, tadapi
dīrghavikalpavidhānaṃ tadapi prayojanam | etadapi ciṇyāhatya
vihitam - śamiṣyate,śāmiṣyata iti śamerṇici mitāṃ hrasvaṃ lṛṭi
sye ciṇvadbhāvena dīrghavikalpaḥ, taṇeraniṭi iti ṇilopaḥ | 
e nanvaniṭītyucyate, seṭ cāyam ata āha - iṭ cāsiddha iti | ā
bhācchāstrīye ṇilope kartavye ā bhācchāstrīyaściṇvadiḍasiddhaḥ,
tenāniḍāditvātsiddho ṇilopa ityarthaḥ | me iti |
sūtrakārāyamāṇsay vacanam | nanu cāsya ciṇvadiṭo'vakāśaḥ
ye'niṭaḥ, yeṣu ṛddhanoḥ sye ityādi pratipadavidhānaṃ nāsti
ārddhadhātukasyetyasyāvakāśaḥ seh yo'sya viṣayo na bavati yastu
seḍasya ca sūtrasya viṣayaḥ, tatra paratvāt ārdhadhātukasyeḍvalādeḥ
ityayameva prāpnoti, tatkathamasiddhatvam ata āha - nityaścāyamiti |
ayaṃ ciṇvadiṇṇinatyaḥ, kṛte'pi valādilakṣaṇa iṭ prāpnoti,
akṛte'pi, na hyayaṃ valāditvamabekṣate | asmiṃstu kṛte valādilakṣaṇa
iṇna prāpnoti, tasmād valnimita iḍanityaḥ | vidhātaḥ -
nimitābhāvādapravṛttiḥ, so'syāstīti vadhātī | tadevaṃ
nityatvātseḍbhyo'pyanenaivaiḍ bhavati, ayaṃ cāsiddhaiti na bhavati
ṇilopābhāvadoṣaḥ | avaśyaṃ cānenaiva seḍbhyo'pīḍeṣṭavyaḥ anyathā
etadiṭsanniyuktaściṇvadbhāvo'pi na syāt | na ca
śabdāntaraprāpterasyāpyanityatvam ākṛtipakṣe śabdāntaratvābhāvāt
| 
e prakṛtasyeṭo dīrghatvamiti | valādilakṣaṇasya prakṛtatvāt | 
e guṇe kṛta iti | paratvānnityatvācca | upadeśagrahaṇād bhavatīti |
yadyapi karotirutarakālamanajantaḥ, upadeśe tvajanta eva | 
e yadi ciṇi dṛṣṭamātrasyātideśaḥ, haniṇiṅadeśā api prāpnuvanti,
teṣāmapi tatra dṛṣṭatvāt ata āha - aṅgādhkāravihitamiti |
aṅgasyeti prakṛtya yaddhihitaṃ ciṇi dṛṣṭṃa tadevātidiśyate,
sannihatatvāt | na ca haniṇiṅamādeśā evaṃvidhā iti
teṣāmanatideśaḥ | atra vātikam - vadhābhāvātsīyuṭi ciṇvadbhāvo
vipratiṣedhena iti | vadhabhāvasyāvakāśaḥ - vadhyāt, vadhyāstām,
vadhyāsuḥ, ciṇvadbhāve hangrahaṇasyāvakāśaḥ - dhāniṣyate, adhāniṣyata,
adhāniṣātām, aghāniṣata, ghāniṣīṣṭetyatrobhayaprasaṅge
ciṇvadbhāvo bhavati vipratiṣedhena | athedānīṃ ciṇvadbhāve punaḥ
prasaṅgavijñānād vadhādeśaḥ kasmānna bhavati sakṛdgatau
vipratiṣedhe yadvādhitaṃ tadvādhitaṃ tadvādhitameveti | nanu
dvitīyādhyāye, tatra ārdhadhātuke iti vaṣyasaptamī, tataḥ
kimantaraṅgo vadhabhāvaḥ naitadasti liṅīti
viśeṣanirddeśātparasāptamī | yatra tu viśeṣanirdeśābhāvaḥ -
asterbhūḥ ityādau, tatraiva viṣayasaptamī bhavyādisiddhaye || 
edīṅe yuḍaci kṅiti || 6 - 4 - 63 || 
e dīṅ iti pañcamīnirdeśāditi | ṣaṣṭha|laṃ tvāsyāṃ dīṅ evādito
yuṭ syāt, pañcamyāṃ tūbhayanirdeśe pañcamīnirdeśo balīyāniti
acīti sapyamyāḥ ṣaṣṭha|laṃ prakalpitāyāmajāderyuḍ bhavati |
saptamīnirdeśastūtarārthaḥ, tadādividhyarthaśca | vidhānasāmarthyācceti
| yadi yuṭo'siddhatvena yaṇādeśaḥ syāt, yuḍvidhānamanarthakaṃ
syāt upadiyya iti rupe viśeṣābhāvāt | na ca
yakāradvayaśravaṇādviśeṣaḥ, halo yamāṃ yami lopaḥ, thaiti pakṣe
yalopavidhānāt | na ca pakṣe śrutibhadaḥ, yaṇo maye dve iti
dvirvacanavidhānādeva siddhatvāt | śrutibhedo'pi
vyañjanātparasyaikasyānekasya vā yakārasya kīdṛśa iti cintyam | 
e upadānamiti | mīnātiminotidīṅaṃ lyapi ca tyātvim, dīṅḥ
ityanubandhanirddeśo yaṅluki mā bhūditi || 
eāto lopa iṭi ca || 6 - 4 - 64 || 
e iha aci kṅiti, ārddhadhātuke iti trayāṇaṃ
prakṛtvādviśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāve ca
kāmacārāteṣāmanyatamenānubhūtānyataraviśeṣaṇena,
anubhūtobhayaviśeṣaṇena, ananubhūtaviśeṣaṇena vā iṭaḥ
samuccayasambhāvad dvādaśa pakṣāḥ sambhavanti | tatra yadi
tāvadviśeṣaṇasambandhāt pragevācā iṭaḥ samuccayaḥ, aṅgākṣiptaśca
pratyayo vā viśeṣyate, iṭa|ljādau ca pratyaye iti vijñāyate,
tadeḍgrahaṇamanajādyaryaṃ bhavati ajāderiṭo'jādinā pratyayena
samuccayāsambhavāt | tadā ca ṅdārdhidhātukeajādereva viśeṣaṇe
vyavatiṣṭhete, neṭaḥ halāderiṭaḥ kṅtvāsimbhāvat,
ārdhadhātukatvād, vyabhicārācca | tataśca dāsīyetyādau
lopaprasaṅgaḥ | atha kidviśibṭenācā samuccayaḥ - kṅityajādau
bhavatīṭi ceti, tatoprasaṅgaḥ | atha kidviśiṣṭenācā samuccayaḥ -
kṅityajādau bhavatīṭi ceti, tato'rkṅthimanajādyarthaṃ ceḍgrahaṇaṃ
bhavati - papitha, dāsīyeti, athārddhadhātukaviśiṣṭenācā samuccayaḥ,
tato'kṅidarthamanajādyarthamanārdhātukārthaṃ ceḍagrahaṇam - papitha,
dāsīya, vyatyare - itīṇmātre lopaprasaṅgaḥ, tadevamacā samuccaye
catvāraḥ pakṣāḥ | evamārdhadhātukena evaṃ kṅteiti dvādaśa pakṣāḥ |
tayorapyuphayaviśiṣṭayosta eva doṣāḥ, yāṃstvavocāma | 
e athaviśeṣitenārdhadhātukena samuccayastadā
nārdhadhātukārthamiḍagrahaṇamiti vyatyare ityatraiva prasaṅgaḥ atha
kṅidviśiṣṭenārdhadhātukena
samuccayastadā'kṅidarthamanārdhadhātukārthamiḍgrahaṇam - papitha,
vyatyare athājviśiṣṭenādhadhātukena samuccayaḥ,
anajādyarthamanārdhadhātukārthaṃ ceḍgrahaṇam - dāsīya, vyatyare
athājviśiṣṭena kṅtā simuccayaḥ, tato'najādyarthamākḍidarthaṃ
ceḍgrahaṇam - dāsīya, papitha | athārdhadhātukaviśiṣṭena kiṅtā
samuccayaḥ, tadānārdhadhātukārthamakṅidarthaṃ ceḍgrahaṇam -
vyatyare, papitha | tadevamekādaśapakṣā duṣṭāḥ | dvādaśaḥ pakṣaḥ śiṣyate
- aviśiṣṭena kṅtā simuccaya iti, atra ca pakṣe acyārdhadhātuke iti
viśeṣaṇadvayamaviśeṣād dvāvapi kṅidiṭāvupanipatatīti
akṅidarthamevaḍgrahaṇaṃ bhavati | tena papithetyādāvāllopo
bhavati dāsīya, vyatyare - 
eityanajādāvanārdhadhātuke ca na bhavati | sa eṣa nirdoṣaḥ pakṣa,
tamimamāśrayati - iṭa|ljādāvārdhadhātuka iti | kṅiti ceti |
ajādāvārdhadhātuke ityanuṣaṅgaḥ | dāsīyeti | āśiṣi liṅ,
utamaikavacanamiṭa, iṭo'n | atra sīyuṭa
iḍbhaktatvādiṭo'jāditvābhāvaḥ || 
eīdyāti || 6 - 4 - 65 || 
e dīrghavidhānamutarārtham - adhyagīṣṭa | iha tu guṇena bhavitavyamiti
hrasva eva vidheyaḥ || 
edhumāsthāgāpājahātisāṃ hali || 6 - 4 - 66|| 
e māgrahaṇena meṅ praṇidāne, māṅ māne, mā māne iti sarveṣāṃ

iṇo gā luṅ, iṇvidika iti kaktavyam, gāṅ liṭi iti sarveṣāṃ
gārupāṇāṃ grahaṇam gāmādāgrahaṇeṣvaviśeṣaḥ iti vacanāt | 
e jahateriti | ohāk tyāge | jihāteriti | ohāṅ gatau
ityasya | bhṛñāmit ityabhyāsasyetve sati jahātīti nirdeśo
nopapadyate | 
e kāmaṃ hāgityapi nirdeśena bhavati jihāteḥ prasaṅgaḥ, tathā tu na
kṛtāmityeva | 
e etadevatyādi | yathā caitajjñāpakaṃ tathā janasanakhanām ityatroktam |
ītve vakārapratiṣedhaḥ, vakārasya nimitabhāvena pratiṣedho
vakārapratiṣedhaḥ | vakārādāvītyaṃ na bhavatītyarthaḥ | āto
maninkvanibvanipaśca - ghṛtaṃ pibanti ghṛtapāvānaḥ, vasāṃ pibanti
vasāpāvānaḥ | kvanipītvaṃ na bhavati | dhīvarī, pīvarītvatra
tvauṇādikamītvaṃ dhāyāpyorvā samprasāraṇam tathā ca sthaḥ ka ca ityatra
kvipi ītvābhāva udāhṛtaḥ || 
evānyasya saṃyogādeḥ || 6 - 4 - 68 || 
e stheyāditi | anyasya grahaṇe'kriyamāṇe pūrvayogo'nyeṣu

paratvādayameva vidhiḥ syādityanyasya grahaṇam || 
ena lyāpi || 6 - 4 - 69 || 
e yaduktamiti | ītvam, na tvanantarametvam, prāptyabhāvāt || 
e mayateridanyatarasyām || apamityeti | udīcāṃ māṅe vyatīhāre
iti tavāpratyayaḥ, itve kṛte tuk || 
eāḍajādīnām || 6 - 4 - 72 || 
e aijyatetyādau yajivapivahīnāṃ halāditvādāṇana prāpnoti,

bhavitavyam, tato lādeśaiḥ, tato yakā, tataḥ samprasāraṇena, ata āha
- iheti | lādeśāsyāntaraṅgatvaṃ lakāramātrāpekṣitvāt |
aḍāgamastu lakāraviśeṣamaṅgaṃ cāpekṣate iti bahiraṅgaḥ,
kṛtākṛtaprasaṅgatvādvakaraṇasya nityatvam | nanvaḍāgamo'pi
kṛte'pi vikaraṇe prāpnotyakṛte'pīti nitya eva, tataśca
paratvādaḍāgama eva prāpnoti, tatrāha - śabdāntaraprāptoriti |
śabdāntaraprāptimeva darśayati - kṛte hīti | aṅgasyāḍāgamaḥ kṛte
vikaraṇo'pi śabdāntaraprapteranityaḥ tathā hi sa kṛte'ḍāgame
tadāderdhātorbhavati, tathākṛte tu dhātumātrāt ata āha -
śabdāntarasyeti | ṣaṣṭhīnirddeṣṭasya yadvidhīyate āgama ādeśo vā
tatraiṣā paribhāṣā, na pañcamīnirdeśa ityarthaḥ | 
e nityatvādeveti | evakāraḥ paunarvacanikaḥ, nityatvādaḍāgamaṃ
bādhate iti pūrvamuktam, tatrāpi sa eva heturiti | aḍāgamastu
samprasāraṇe kṛte na prāpnoti, āṭā bādhitatvāt | yasya nimitaṃ
lakṣaṇāntareṇa vihanyate iti tu na sārvatrikamiti bhāvaḥ | 
e ayaṃ yogaḥ śakyo'kartum, ajādīnāmapi pūrvasūtreṇa aḍevāstu |
katham āṭaśca iti vṛddhiḥ aṭaśca iti vakṣyāmi | ihāpi tarhi prāpnoti
- akārṣīt acīti vartate | evamapi svaperlaṅ, sip, aḍ
gārgyagālavayoḥ iti sipo'ṭ, rutvam, haśi ca ityutvam - asvapo
hasatītyatra vṛddhaprasaṅgaḥ ajādau dhātau vṛddhiṃ vakṣyāmi | tarhi
dhātāviti vaktavyam na vaktavyam yadetad upasargādṛti dhātau iti,
tatpūrvatrāpakṛṣyate, aṭaśca ityatra cakārastasyaiva vidheḥ samuccayārthaḥ
- aṭo vidhyantaraṃ bādhitvā vṛddhireva yathā syāt |
tenāṭiṭadityādau paramapyato guṇe pararupaṃ bādhitvā vṛddhireva
bhavati | yathā siddhānte'pi, ausīyat auṅkarīyat usyapadāntāt,
omāṅeśca 
eiti pararupaṃ na bhavati | utarārthaṃ tarhyāḍvacanam cchandasyapi dṛśyate -
suruco vena āvaḥ aṭa evātra chāndasaṃ dīrghatvaṃ bhaviṣyati - pūruṣo
nāraka iti | yathā āsannityatrāpi lāvasthāyāmevāṭi kṛte a - as -
l iti sthite aṭaśca iti vṛddhiśca prāpnoti, lādeśāśca,
tatrāntaraṅgatvāllādeśaḥ | vṛddharhyaṭamacaṃ ca nimitamapekṣate, kṛte
lādeśe vṛddhiśca prāpnoti, śnasorallopaḥ ca,
tatrāntaraṅgatvādvṛddhiḥ | nānāśrayatvācca vārṇādāṅgaṃ balīyaḥ iti
nāsti kṛtāyāṃ vṛddhau taparakaraṇādākārasya lopābhāvaḥ | iha ca
āyanniti iṇo laṅ iṭi a - i - an, aṭaśca iti vṛddhiḥ prāpnoti,
iṇo yaṇ iti yaṇādeśaśca, tatrāntaraṅgatvādvṛddhaḥ,
nānāśrayatvāccavārṇādāṅgaṃ balīyaḥ, iti nāsti, iṇo yaṇ eḥ iti
yogavibhāgādivarṇāntasyeṇo yaṇvidhānādekārasya
tadabhāvādāyādeśe siddhimiṣṭam | atra ślaukau - 
e ajādīnāmaṭā siddhaṃ vṛddhyarthamiti cedaṭaḥ | 
e asvapo halatītyatra dhātau vṛddhimaṭaḥ smaret || 
e pararupaṃ guṇenāṭa omāṅerusi tatsamam |

ena māṅyoge || 6 - 4 - 74 || 
e yadyayamanantarasyāṭa eva pratiṣedhaḥ syāt, tatsaṃyuktameva pratiṣedhaṃ
kuryāt - āḍajādīnāmamāṅyoge iti, asaṃyucya tu
pratiṣedhātsarvasya prākaraṇikasya pratiṣedhā vijñāyata ityāha -
luṅlaṅlṛṅkṣu yaduktaṃ tanna bhavatīti | tatra luṅ udāharaṇaṃ na
pradarśitam māṅyoge tadāsambhavat | ṅidviśiṣṭasyopādānam -
asamdādeśo yo māśabdaḥ tvomau dvitīyāyaḥ iti tadyoge pratiṣedho
mā bhūt - sukhinaṃ mā akārṣīditi | atha katham - mā
bālipathamanvagāḥ || 
e svacchandamanuvartante na śāstramṛṣayaḥ kila || 
ebahulaṃ cchandasyamāṅyoge'pi || 6 - 4 - 75 || 
e mā vaḥ kṣetra iti | vaḥ yuṣmākaṃ kṣetre bhāryāyāṃ parabījāni
pareṣāṃ vīryāṇi mā vāpsuḥ, uptāni mā bhūvan | vapeḥ karmaṇi
luṅ, vyatyayena parasmaipadam, jherjus, sic, vadavraja iti vṛddhiḥ
| kvacitu māṅyoge'pi bhavati iti prakamya avāpsuriti paṭha|lte,
tathādhyayanaṃ tu na kvaciddṛṣṭam abhitthā iti | bhidesthās, jhalo
jhali iti sico lopaḥ | āvariti | pūrvasūtre vṛtāveva
vyutpāditam || 
eharayo re || 6 - 4 - 76 || 
e daghra iti | nanu cātra paratvādrebhāve kṛte anajāditvādāllopo na

e nanvevamapi rebhāve kṛte tasyaiveḍāgamaḥ prāpnoti, na ca

rebhāvo bhavati kathaṃ vā svapravṛttimapekṣya tasminniḍāgame kṛte
punaḥ svayaṃ pravartamānasyātmāśrayadoṣo na bhavati tatrāha - tadarthe
ceti | dvivacananirdeśād doṣadvayaṃ na bhavatītyarthaḥ || 
eaci śnudhātubhruvāṃ yvoriyaṇuvaṅai || 6 - 4 - 77 || 
e iśca uśca yū, tayoryvoḥ | hrasvayoridaṃ grahaṇam, dīrghayorapi

śanvādīnāṃ tadantavidhiḥ | tatra nirddiśyamānasyādeśā bhavanti
ityevāntasya siddheṇÇókāro vispaṣṭārthaḥ | āpnuvantītyādi |
yatsaṃyogapūrvamekāc tadihodāharaṇam, anyatra huśnuvoḥ
sārvadhātuke, eranekācaḥ iti yaṇā bhāvyam | luluvaturityādikaṃ
tu bhavatyeva oḥ supiḥ iti vacanāt | 
e iyaṅbhyāmiti | guṇavṛddhyoravakāśaḥ - cetā, gauḥ,
iyaṇuvaṅeravakāśaḥ - cikṣiyatuḥ luluvatuḥ, cayanam, cāyakaḥ
lavanam, lāvaka ityatrobhayaprasaṃge vipratiṣedhaḥ | 
e tanuvamiti | adhātutvādaprāpta uvaṅ vidhīyate | tanvamiti | vā

satsūdviṣa iti kvip | atra nityam oḥ supi ityanena yaṇ prāptaḥ |
svargādiṣu 
eyajurvede - iyaṇuvaṅai, bahvṛce - yaṇ || 
eabhyāsasyāsavarṇe || 6 - 4 - 78 || 
e pūrvamaṅgasyājādau pratyaye vidhānādidamārabhyate | iyeṣeti |
atra guṇasya sthānivadbhāvaviṣaye yadvaktavyaṃ tad dvirvacane'ci
ityatroktam || 
estriyāḥ || 6 - 4 - 79 || 
e strī ityetasyeti | strīpratyayāntānaṃ stryarthavṝtarvā śabdasya grahaṇaṃ
na bhavati āṇnadyā, kumāryā vayasi ityādinirdeśāt | utarārthamiti |
utaratra striyāḥ evānuvṛttiryarthā syāt, śnudhātubhruvāṃ mā bhūt || 
eiṇo yaṇ || 6 - 4 - 81 || 
e atra sūtrārthakathanānantaraṃ kvacitpaṭha|lte - antaraṅgatvāt iko
yaṇaci iti siddhe samānāśraye vārṇādāṅgaṃ balīyaḥ iti jñāpanārtha
vacanam iti, tadayuktam iyaṅadeśāpavādo'yam iti vakṣyati,
tatkathamiyaṅviṣaye yaṇpravartate | iyaṅadeśāpavādo'yamiti |
iyaṅgādeśasyaivāpavāda ityarthaḥ | kutaḥ ityāha madhye'pavādā iti |
evaṃ sati yadiṣṭṃa siddham, taddarśayati - guthaṇavṛddhibhyamiti | yadi
tu nāprāpte vidhyantare ārambhātsarvameva vidhyantaraṃ yaṇbādheta,
guṇavṛddhivaṣaye'pi syat | atha iṇo na ityeva kasmānnoktam
iyaṅadeśe hi 
epratiṣiddhe iko yaṇaci ityeva yaṇabhaviṣyati aho sūkṣmadarśī
devānāṃpiyaḥ, yadidamapi na dṛṣṭam - īyiva, īyima, karmaṇi
īyire, atreyaṅ pritiṣiddhe sarvarṇaṃdīrghaḥ syāt | tasmādyaṇeva
vidheyaḥ || 
eeranekāco'saṃyogapūrvasya || 6 - 4 - 82 || 
e tena saṃyogo viśeṣyate iti | yadyapyanyapadārthaṃ prati guṇabhūtaḥ
saṃyogaḥ, tathāpi sa eva viśeṣyate dhātoḥ ityanuvṛtasya
prayojanāntarābhāvāt | astīdaṃ prayojanam - ivarṇa
viśeṣayiṣyāmīti naitadasti yadyadhātorivarṇo'saṃyogapūrvaḥ,
bhavitavyameva tasya yaṇā iko yaṇaci iti, tadyathā - kumārthau, kumārya
iti | nanu grahamaṇīvadadhātoḥ pūrvasavarṇaṃ bādhitvā yaṇ mā bhūditi
dhātunaivevarṇo viśeṣaṇīyaḥ netyāhaḥ iyaṅbādhanārtho yaṇ | na ca
dhātoriyaṅaḥ prasaṅgo'sti, tatkathamadhātunivṛtyarthā
dhātvanuvṛttirupadyate, tasmātsuṣṭhūaktam - guṇabhūta eva saṃyogo
viśeṣyata iti | 
e aṅgaviśeṣaṇaṃ mā bhūditi | anyathādhikāreṇa sannihitasya tasyaiva
viśeṣaṇaṃ syādasaṃyogapūrvagrahaṇam, tataśca yavakriyau, yaṣakriyaḥ -
ityatrāpi prasadhyeta, na hyatrāṅgasya saṃyogaḥ pūrvo'vayava iti | nanu
ca yvoriti prakṛtam , tatra erityanucyamāne orapi yaṇ syāt -
luluvaturityādau, tataśca tannivatyarthamapi syāt ityata āha 
eluluvalurllavurityetatviti | iha erityanucyamānenaivau
rapisiddhatvād oḥ supi ityetanniyamārthaṃ bhavati - oḥ supyeveti |
vaparītastu niyamo na bhavatioreva supīti na bhūsudhīyoḥ iti
yaṇpratiṣedhāt | tataścāstamādeva niyamālluluvurityādau
siddhatvāderityetadormivṛtyarthaṃ nopapadyate iti pūrvoktameva
prayojanam | yadi tvasaṃyogapūrvayoriti dvivacananirdeśena
yvorevaitadviśeṣaṇamucyeta, tarhyoriti śakyamakartum | ihāpi na
syāditi | yadi dhātunā saṃyogo na syāditi | yadi dhātunā
saṃyogo na viśeṣyeteti bhāvaḥ | kvacid ihāpi yathā syāditi
pāṭhaḥ, tatra prakṛtatvādyaṇādeśa ityarthaḥ |gatikārakābhyāmityādi |
iṣṭirevaiṣā | paramaniyāviti | bhāve kartari vā kvip || 
eoḥ supi || 6 - 4 - 83 || 
e sakṛllvāviti | kriyāviśeṣaṇatvāt sakṛdityasya kārakatvam | 
e kaṭapruvāviti | kvibvaci ityādinā kvip, dīrghaśca || 
evarṣābhvaśca || 6 - 4 - 84 || 
e na bhūsudhiyoḥ iti pratiṣedhe prāpte vacanam | 
e punarbhvaścetyādi | evaṃ ca punarvarṣāreṣu bhuvaḥ iti sūtranyāsaḥ
| 
ena bhūsudhiyoḥ || 6 - 4 - 85 || 
e bhūśabdena tadantasya grahaṇam kevalasya yaṇprāptyabhāvāt | 
e na covaṅḥ pratiṣedhaḥ, vicchinnatvāt, varṣābhvaśca ityārambhācca |
sudhiyāviti | dhyāyateḥ kvipa, dṛśagrahaṇātsamprasāraṇam || 
e huśnuvoḥ sārvadhātuk || 6 - 4 - 87 || 
e anekācaḥ, asaṃyogapūrvasya, oriti cānuvartate | yadyapi
huśnuvoruvarṇāntatvamabyabhicāri,
tathāpyasaṃyogapūrvagrahaṇamoviśeṣaṇaṃ yathā syāt, huśnuvormā
bhūdityevamarthamanuvartyamorityetat | huśnuvorviśeṣaṇe hi
takṣṇuvantītyādāveva pratiṣedhādāpnuvantītyādau na syāt, tatra
śnupratyayāntasyasaṃyogāpūrvasyoti vyadhikaraṇe ṣaṣṭhayau |
snupratyayāntasyāṅgasyāvayovo'saṃyogapūrvo ya ukārastasvatyarthaḥ
| anekācaḥ iti tvaṅgena samānādhikaraṇemeva, sārvadhātukagrahaṇaṃ
juhotyartham, na śanvartham avyabhicārāt | juhvatīti |
adabhyastāt | juhvaditi | nābhyastācchatuḥ iti numpratiṣedhaḥ | 
e yoyuvati, roruvatīti | yu ru - ityetābhyāṃ yaṅlugantābhyāṃ
laṭi pūrvat jheradbhāvaḥ | 
e idamevetyādi | etacca yaṅe'ci ca cityatra
cchando'nuvṛttimāśrityoktam | ayādityastu tatra cchando'navṛttiṃ
nāśiśriyat | kathaṃ punaretajjñāpakam ityāha - cchandasi hīti |
cchandasi yaṅlugantanivṛtatha huśnugarhaṇaṃ na bhavati tataḥ parasya
tiṅ ārdhadhātukatvāt | yaṇādeśasyāprasaṅgādityarthaḥ | tathā cātra
vārtikam - yaṅlugarthamiti cedārghaghātukatvātsiddham iti |
syādetat - yaṅlugantādanyavdyāvartya bhaviṣyati, ato na jñāpakaṃ
huśnugarhaṇamiti ata āha - na ceti | asaṃyogapūrvamiti |
asaṃyogapūrvovarṇāntamityarthaḥ | atra ostyinuvṛteḥ - mimate
ityādau na bhaviṣyati, anekācaḥ ityanuvṛterthuvantītyādau |
ayuvan, thāruvannityatrāpyaṭo'siddhatvādekāctvameva |
asaṃyogapūrvasyetyanuvṛteḥ prorṇuvantīlyatra na bhaviṣyati |
tanvantītyādau ca bhavitivyameva yaṇā | tasmādyaṅlugantādanyad
vyāvartyaṃ na sambhavati | āha ca -
huśnugrahaṇamanarthakamanyasyābhāvāditi || 
e bhuvo vugluṅliṭoḥ || 6 - 4 - 88 || 
e abhūvanniti | gātisthā ityādinā sico luk | abhūvamiti |
mipo'mabhāvaḥ | luṅliṭoriti kim bhavati, bhaviṣyati -
śapsyayorna bhavati | yadī kṅtītyinuvartiṣyate, abhūvamityatrāpi
tarhi na syāt evaṃ tarhmārityanuvartiṣyate, guṇe kṛte
anuvarṇāntatvānna bhaviṣyati, abhūvamityatra bhūsuvostiṅ īti
guthaṇapratiṣedhāduvarṇāntatvam | nātra śakyamorityanuvartayitum |
etacca indhībhavatibhyāṃ ca ityatra viśtareṇoktam || 
e ūdudhāyā gohaḥ || 6 - 4 - 89 || 
e udāharaṇeṣu ṇic, ṇvul, taṇaniḥ ābhīkṣṇye ṇamul, ghañ -
ityete pratyayāḥ | sarvatra guṇe kṛte okārasya ūkāraḥ | 
e upadhāyā iti kimiti | oḥ ityunuvṛterevokārasya bhaviṣyati, sa
copadhaiveti praśnaḥ | nanu ca orityucyate, na cāsyopadhokāraḥ
sambhavati orityanuvṛttisāmarthyād gohaḥ thaiti viṣayopalakṣaṇaṃ
bhaviṣyati, na tu 
ekṛtaguṇapratipatyartham | tāntayasya mā bhūditi | nopalakṣaṇatve
pramāṇamasti, tataścāsambhāvadorityasya
nivṛtarārthamapyavaśyamupadhāgarhaṇaṃ kartavyamiti bhāvaḥ | 
e vikṛtagrahaṇaṃ viṣayaniyamārthamiti | guha thaityucyamāne
dhātunirdeśo'yaṃ bhavati, tataśca kṅidviṣaye'pi
tatsvarupaprayuktamūtvaṃ syāt | tasmādūtvasya viśiṣṭo viṣayo
nirdiṣṭo yathā syāditi vikṛtasāya kṛtaguṇasya grahaṇaṃ kṛtam |
veṣayārthatāṃ spaṣṭayati - yatreti | guṇaviṣaye yathā syādityarthaḥ |
ayādeśaprativedhārtha ca kecidicchantītyādi | pūrvaviṣayāvadhāraṇe
tātaparyamityuktam, taccākṅtītyucyimāne siddhyati | lāghavārtha
tu gaha ityuktam , tacca kālāvadhāraṇārthamapyarthādbhavati,
guṇotarakālamūtvamiti | idānīṃ tūbhāyatrāpi tātparyamityuktaṃ
bhavati | guṇaviṣaye bhavati - tatrāpi kṛte guṇe iti | yadi hi
pragevāṃguṇādūtvaṃ syāt, tadā lyapi laghupūrvāt ityādeśe
tasyāsiddhtvāllaghupūrvo hakāra ityayādeśaḥ syāta | yadā tu
guṇo kṛte tasya sthāne ūtvam, tadā tasyāsiddhatve'pyokārasya
gurutvādayādeśābhāvaḥ siddhyatīti | tadetad dūṣayati -
vyāśrayatvāditi 
e| kathaṃ vyāśrayatvamityāha - ṇāvūtvamiti | 
e doṣo ṇau || 6 - 4 - 90 || 
e kiramarthaṃ duṣervikṛtsya grahaṇaṃ kriyate, na duṣaḥ ityevocyeta
viṣayārthamiti cet na ṇāviti viṣayasya sākṣānnirddeśāt |
pradūṣya gata ityādāvayādeśapratiṣedārthamiti cet na
datotaratvāt | uktotarameteta - vyāśrayatvādasiddhatvaṃ nāstīti |
tasmād duṣaḥ ityeva vaktvyam, ata āha - vikṛtagrahaṇamiti |
kramaḥ - prastāvaḥ, prakaraṇamityarthaḥ || 
e vā citavirāge || 6 - 4 - 91 || 
e citavirāgaḥ - citasyāprītatā | prāptavibhāṣeyam | 
e ṇāvityeva - citasya doṣaḥ || 
emitāṃ hrasvaḥ || 6 - 4 - 92 || 
e rajayatīti | rañjorṇau mṛgaramaṇa upasaṅkhyānam ityupadhālopaḥ ||

eciṇṇamulordīrdho'nyatarasyām || 6 - 4 - 93 || 
e na hrasvavikalpa eva vidhīyeteti | evamapi hrasvapakṣe aśamīti sidhyati,
pakṣāntare aśāmīti yathāprāptaṃ dīrgha evāṣasthāsyata iti bhāvaḥ |
śamayantaṃ prayuṃkte iti | yadyapi ciṇviṣaye karma pradarśanīyaṃ
bhūtakālaśca, tathāpi ṇijutpataye hetuvyāpāramātrapradarśanamatra
vivakṣitam, na kartā nāpi vartamānaḥ kāla taiti na doṣaḥ | 
e ṇilopasya sthānivadbhāvāditi | sthānivadbhāve hi sati
yaściṇṇamulparo ṇiḥ na tasminmidaṅgam, pūrveṇa ṇicā
vyāvadhānāt yarsmiśca midaṅgaṃ na sa ciṇṇamulparaḥ, pareṇa ṇicā
vyāvadhānāt tataśca hrasvavikalpo na syāt, pūrvethaṇa nityameva tu
hrasvaḥ syāt | nanu dīrghavikalpe'pi yāvatā sthānivadbhāvaḥ,
kathamivaitat siddhyati tatrāha - dīrghavidhau tviti | na
padāntadvirvacana ityādinā
sthānivadbhāvapratiṣedhāddīrghavikalpasyāyaṃ viṣaya evetyarthaḥ |
tathetyādi | atra dīrghavidhau tvajādeśo na
sthānivadbhāvatītyanuṣaṅgaḥ | śameryaṅ, dvirvacanam, nuk,
ṇicyato lopaḥ yasya hala, taśaṃśami iti sthite - yadā
tataściṇṇamulau bhavataḥ, tadā dīrghavikalpaḥ sidhyati ajādeśasya
sthānivatvābhāvādityarthaḥ | 
e etadeva spaṣṭayati - yo'sāviti | yaśca yaṅkāra iti | ṇau lupyata
thaityunaṣaṅgaḥ | evaṃ tāvaddīrghavidhau tvajādeśo na
sthānivdhbavatītyetaspaṣṭīkṛtam | ṇilopasya sthānivadbhāvād
hrasvaviklapo na syāt iti yaduktam, tatsamārthayate - hrasvavikalpe
tviti | ṇerṇiḥ ṇiṇiḥ, so'nto yasya sa ṇiṇyantaḥ | etena
yaḍṇyante iti vyākhyātam | 
e asiddhireveti | kasya prakṛtatvāddīrghasya, evakāreṇa tuśabdena
caitaddarśayati | ṇicamāśritya vṛddhividhānādasti dīrghasya śaṅkā,
ṇilopasya tu sthānivadbhāvādayaṃ vikalpo na syādityeva doṣaḥ |
yaṅṇyante tu bhavatu nāmāyaṃ vikalpaḥ, tathāpi pakṣe dīrghasya śravaṇaṃ
na sidhyati taṇicamapekṣya vṛddhau kartavyāyāmato lopasya
sthānivadbhāvād, dīrghasyānunmeṣāditi | 
e syādeta - dīrghavikalpe vidhīyamāne yadi nāma sthānivadbhāvo
nāsti, tathāpi naivātra dīrghaḥ sidhyati, asiddhavadatrābhāt iti
ṇiyaṅerlopasyāsiddhatvāditi ata thāaha - vyāśrayatvāditi |
vyāśrayatvameva darśayati - ṇau hītyādi | kiñca - heḍa veṣṭane
ghaṭādiḥ, tasya hrasvābhāvapakṣe aheḍīti syāt, dīrghe tu hrasvasya kṛte
- ahīḍīti bhavati | tasmādato'pi hetordīrgha eva vikalpanīyaḥ || 
ehlādo niṣṭhāyām || 6 - 4 - 95 || 
e hlādī sukhe ca, īditvānniṣṭhāyāmaniṭ | kvacitpaṭha|ltehlāda iti
yogavibhāgaḥ kriyate, ktinyapi yathā syāt pralhatiriti | māṣye tu
naitaddṛṣṭam || 
echāderghe'dvyupasargasya || 6 - 4 - 96 || 
e uraścchada iti | cchada āvaraṇe, curādiṇic, puṃsi saṃjñāyām iti
karaṇe ghaḥ, karmaṇi ṣaṣṭha|la samāsaḥ | nanu cātra ghe parato
ṇyantamaṅgaṃ tasyopadhādakāraḥ, na ca saṃ hrasvabhāvinī | na ca śakhyaṃ
vaktum - ṇilope kṛte 
eākāro hrasvabhāvinyupadheti ṇilopasya asiddhavadatrā bhāt
taityasiddhatvād acaḥ parasmin iti sthānivadbhāvācca | ata āha -
ṇilopasya ceti | apara āha - ṇāviti vartate, dhe parato yo
ṇistatra yadaṅgaṃ tasyopadhāyā hrasvaḥ | chādeḥ iti cekā nirddeśaḥ,
na ṇicā iti | 
e nanu yatra triprabhṛtayaḥ santi, dvāvapi tatra staḥ, tataśca
advyupasargasya ityeva siddham, kiṃ sūtraśikṣayā ata āha - utarā hīti
| etadeva lokavyavahārethaṇa draḍhayati - na hīti | 
e ismantranvivaṣu ca || ārciśucihusṛpicchadicchardibhya isiḥ
itīsipratyayaḥ | manin sarvadhātubhyaḥ | ṣṭran sarvadhātubhyaḥ |
yogavibhāgād dviprabhṛtyupasargādapi bhavati - samupacchadiḥ || 
egamahanajanakhanadhasāṃ lopaḥ kṅityanaiṅ || 6 - 4 - 98 || 
e jadhnatiriti | abhyāsācca iti kutvam | jajñaturiti | jana janane
parasmaipadī jaurotyādikaḥ, nakārasya cutvam | jajña iti | janī
pradurbhāve anudātet daivādikaḥ | jakṣaturiti | liṭa|lnyatarasyām
ityaderghaslādeśaḥ, ghakārasya cartvam, śāsivasighasītanāṃ ca iti
ṣatvam | akṣanniti | luṅsanorghaslṛ mantre ghasa iti cleluk | 
e acītyeveti | aci śnudhātu ityataḥ | tasya tu doṣo ṇau ityata
ārabhyopayogo na pradarśitaḥ, kvacidvyabhicārābhāvāt,
kvacidasaṃbhāvāt | iha tūpayogaḥ tathā cotarasūtre hali ca iti
vakṣyati || 
etanipatyoścchandasi || 6 - 4 - 99 || 
e vitatnira iti | lopavidhānasāmarthyādasiddhatve'pi tasya ata
ekahalmadhye ityetvābhyāsalopau na bhavataḥ | paptimeti | liṭ, mas,
iṭ || 
eghasibhasorhali ca || 6 - 4 - 100 || 
e sūtre cakārasya pāṭho'nārṣaḥ | tathā ca vārtikam -
halgrahaṇamaparibhāṣyam, anyatrāpi darśanāt iti | 
e tathā na kriyata iti | yadi kriyeta, anackatvād dvirvacanaṃ na
syāditi bhāvaḥ | pūrvatra acītyadhikārādiha halītyuktam,
tadupādānād - aci na syāditi cakāreṇa samuccayaḥ | 
e yadi pūrvavaivācītyanuvartate, naiha ityucyeta, tataḥ hali ca iti
śakyamakartum, utarārtha tu tatkratam || 
ehujhalbhyo herdhiḥ || 6 - 4 - 101 || 
e halāderiti | hujhalbhyaḥ iti pañcamyā halīti saptamyāḥ ṣaṣṭhī
prakalpyate iti bhāvaḥ | yadyevam, yasminvidhiḥ
tyisyābhāvātadādividhirna syāt
halītyanuvṛttisāmarthyāddhalantatvābhāvācca bhaviṣyati | bhindhīti |
śnasoralopaḥ | prīṇīhīti | ī halyadhoḥ | loṭo laṅvat |
juhutāmiti | tasastām | rudihīti | śabdāntaraprātyā
dvayorapyanityayoḥ paratvādiṭi kṛte punardvitvaprasaṅgaḥ | 
e ihetyādi | dhitvasyāvakāraśo'nāśiṣi - juhudhīti,
tātaṅe'vakāśo hujhalbhyo'nyaḥ - jīvatātvamiti, āśiṣi
hujhalbhyastūbhayaprasaṅge paratvātātaṅ | atha kṛte'pi tasmin
sthānivadbhāvāddhitvaṃ kasmānna bhavati tatrāha - tatra kute iti |
bhindhaki, cchindhakītyatrāpi tarhi paratvena dhitve kṛte akajna syāt
ityata āha - bhindhīkiti | apara āha - sthānyādeśayordvayorapīkāra
uccāraṇārthaḥ, tahakārasya dhakāra ādeśaḥ, halītyapi nānuvartyamam,
na kvāpyaniṣṭaprasaṅgaḥ iti || 
eśruśrṛṇupṛkṛvṛbhyaścchandasi || 6 - 4 - 102 || 
e urukṛduruṇaskṛdhīti | naśca dhātusthoruṣubhyaḥ iti ṇatvam, kaḥ
karat iti visarjanīyasya satvam | 
e anyaṣāmapi dṛśyata iti | dīrghatvamiti | na kevalaṃ śrṛṇudhī gira
ityatra, śrudhī havam, apāvṛdhītyatrāpyanenaiva dīrghatvam |
ato'nyatreti | śrṛṇudhītyato'nyaṣu sarvodāharaṇeṣu || 
eaṅtiśca || 6 - 4 - 103 || 
e malopābhāvastviti | anudātopadeśa taityādinā yo
malopastasyābhāvaḥ | aṅitvādeveiti | nāsau yatnasādhya
ityevaśbadārthaḥ | yameḥ śapo lugiti | vahulaṃ cchandasi ityeva |
evamutaratrāpi || 
e ciṇo luk || 6 - 4 - 104 || 
e ciṇa iti pañcamī, na ṣaṣṭhī vidhānasāmarthyāt | pratyayasyeti |
pratyayasya lukśalulupaḥ, iti vacanādaṅgādhikārāccaitallabhyate |
tenākāritarāmiti taśbadasya tarapa āmaśca yaḥ saṅghātastasya
yugapallugna bhavati pratyekaṃ pratyayatve'pi saṅghāto'pratyayo hyayam
| 
e nanu cedamasminnasiddhamiti bhedanibandhano viṣayaviṣayibhāvaḥ,
tatkathaṃ ciṇo lukciṇo lukyevāsiddho bhavati ata tāaha - ciṇo
lugityetaditi | atha vā - kṅiti iti vartate, ciṇaḥ iti pañcamī
tasya ṣaṣṭhī prakalpayiṣyati, tena kṅitaḥ pratyasya
lugvidhīyamānastarapo na bhaviṣyati || 
eato heḥ || 6 - 4 - 105 || 
e gaccheti | iṣugamiyamāṃ cchaḥ | ghāveti | ghāvu gātiśudhyoḥ,
pādhnādisūtreṇa sarterdhāvādeśaḥ | 
e lunīhīti | pvādīnāṃ hrasvaḥ ī halyaghoḥ | nanu
cātrānavarṇāntatvādeṣa na bhaviṣyati, ītvameva hi paratvādbhavati
tatrāha - itvasyeti | nanvevamapyutarasūtre utaḥ, pratyayāt iti
yadupātamupādhidvayaṃ tasmādevātra pratyudāharaṇadvaye'pi na bhaviṣyati
| yadi ca lunīhītyatra paratvādītvaṃ bhavati, tato'siddhatvaṃ nāsti,
vipratiṣedhaviṣaye tadabhāvasyoktatvāt | tasmādata ityasya ihi,
adhīhīti pratyudāharaṇam, taparakaraṇasya - yāhi, vāhiti || 
eutaśca pratyayādasaṃyogapūrvāt || 6 - 4 - 106 || 
e utaḥ, pratyayāt - ityanayorviśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāve kāmacāraḥ | tatra 
e ukārasya viśeṣyatvāt tena nāsti tadantatā | 
e na sambhavati cokāraḥ pratyayānto yadā punaḥ || 
e viśeṣyate ukāreṇa pratyayastatadantatā | 
e āśrīyate pratyayasya tatpakṣadvayasambhavaḥ || 
e tatrādye pakṣe tanu, kuru - ityādāveva syāt sun, cinu - ityādau
tu na syāt | tathā ukārasya
pratyayascāsaṃyogapūrvatvādasaṃyogapūrvagrahaṇamasminpakṣe
aṅgaviśeṣaṇaṃ vijñāyeta, tataśca kṣiṇu ityādau na syāt, kṣiṇu
hiṃsāyām tānādikaḥ, atra dhātorguṇo na bhavatītyāhuḥ |
tasmādukāro viśeṣaṇam, tena tadantavidhiḥ | yadyevam, tanu, kuru
- atra na prāpnoti, ikāra evātra pratyayo na tadantaḥ atrāpi tadantaḥ
katham vyapadeśivadbhāvāt | evaṃ sthite - 
e yadyasaṃyogapūrvatvamukārāntaviśeṣaṇam | 
e āpnuhītyatra herluksyātpratiṣedhastu takṣṇuhi | 
e tasmādiviśeṣāṇamidamukārasyaiva gṛhyatām || 
e nanu ca yena vidhistadantasya iti ukārastadantasya saṃjñā, tataḥ kim 
e saṃjñipratyāyanaparā saṃjñā tasyā viśeṣaṇam | 
e ayuktamiti cedatra samādhirabhidhīyate | 
e viśeṣaṇaṃ tadantasya saṃjñā, satyam, tathāpi tu | 
e viśeṣaṇatvasphurathaṇāt prāgevoto viśeṣaṇam | 
e pratyayasyeti, naiveha kiñcidasti tirohitam || 
e tadidamuktam - yo'yamukāro'saṃyogapūrvastadantātapratyayāditi
| yuhi, ruhīti | nanu juhoteḥ parasya herdhitvavidhānādeva dhātoḥ
parasya na bhaviṣyati satyam viśiṣṭaviṣayametajjñāpakaṃ syāditi
pratyayagrahaṇam | cchandasi veti ca vaktavyamiti | evaṃ ca
kṛtvotarasūtre'nyatarasyāṃgrahaṇaṃ na kartavyaṃ bhavati || 
elopaścāsyānyatarasyāṃ mvoḥ || 6 - 4 - 107 || 
e asyetyanenokārāntaḥ pratyayaḥ pratyavamṛśyate | asyetyanucyamāne
mvoḥ iti ṣaṣṭha|laśrayaṇe na mvoreva lopo vijñāyeta | evaṃ ca
utaśca pratyayādasaṃyogapūrvāt iti pañcamī na bādhitā bhavati |
lugiti vartamāne ityādi | yadi hi prakṛta eva luk kriyeta,
sarvasyaiva pratyayasya syāt | lugādayaḥ sarvādeśaḥ iti
saṃjñāvidhāvavocām | 
esarvasya lope kṛte sunvaḥ, sunuva iti na sidhyet |
tasmādantyasya lopārthaṃ lopagrahaṇam | kiñca - kurvaḥ , kurma ityatra
luki sati guṇo na syāt na lumatāṅgasya iti pratiṣedhāt |
lope tu sati bhavati || 
enityaṃ karoteḥ || 6 - 4 - 108 || 
e karoterupratyayāntasyeti | utaśca pratyayād ityanuvṛterlabhyate |
ukāralopasyetyādinā sopapatikāṃ dīrghapraptimanūdya pratiṣedhaṃ
darśayati | 
e ārambhasāmarthyādeva siddhe nityagrahaṇaṃ vispaṣṭārtham || 
eata utsārvadhātuke || 6 - 4 - 110 || 
e karoterupratyayāntasyeti | utaśca pratyayāt ityanuvṛterlabhyate | 
e sārvadhātuka iti kimiti | satyapi sārvadhātukagrahakhaṇe
syatāsyāntasya prasaṅgakariṣyāvaḥ, kartārāviti syātāsibhyāṃ
vyavadhānānna bhaviṣyati | kurute - tyitrāpi tarhyupratyayena
vyavadhānānna syāt | smātsārvadhātuke parataḥ
karoteraṅgasyetyarthasambhāvātsārvadhātuke parato yadaṅgaṃ
tadavayavasya karoterityāśrayaṇīyam | evaṃ ca syatāsyantasyāpi
prasaṅga iti | utaśca pratyayāt ityavaśyamanuvartyam,
upratyayāntātkaroteḥ paraṃ kṅtsārvidhātukameveti praśanaḥ |
bhūtapūrve'pīti | karu - hi iti sthite utvaṃ ca prāpnoti, hilukca,
nityatvāddhiluki kṛte kṅitaḥ parasyābhāvādutvaṃ na syāt |
pratyāt | pratyayalakṣaṇaṃ ca na lumatāṅgasya iti pratiṣiddham |
tasmād bhūtapūrve'pi sārvadhātuke yathā syāditi
sārvadhātukagrahaṇam | āsiddho hiluk, tasyāsiddhatvādutvaṃ
bhaviṣyati | tasmādvispaṣyārthaṃ sārvadhātukagrahaṇam | yathā
purasyotaratrāpyupayogābhāvaḥ, tathā tatra tatra vakṣyate | 
e iha yadyapi bhāvyamāno'pyukāraḥ savarṇān gṛhṇāti,
tathāpyāntaryato mātrikasyāto mātrika taukāra eva bhaviṣyati,
nārthastakāreṇa tatrāha - taparakarathakhaṇamiti | thāsati hi
tasminnupratyayamāśrityokārasya laghūpadhalakṣaṇo guṇaḥ syāt, sa mā
bhūditi taparakaraṇam | tasya hi prayojanam - lakṣaṇāntareṇāpi
dīrgho mā bhūt || 
eśnasoraṃllopa || 6 - 4 - 111 || 
e taparakaraṇaṃ kim āṭo mā bhūt - āstām, āsan, asiddha āṭ |
evaṃ tarhyābhībhīyasyāsiddhatvamanityamiti jñāpanārthaṃ taparakaraṇam |
athātra sārvadhātukādhikārasyopayogaḥ netyāha | śnaḥ sārvadhātuka
eva, asterapyārddhadhātuke bhūbhāvena bhāvyam | nanvanuprayoge
bhūbhāvo nāsti - īhāmāsuḥ satyam tatra dvirvacane halādiśeṣe ca
kṛte yenanāprāptinyāyena ato guṇe iti pararupaṃ bādhitvā ata
ādeḥ iti dīrghatve kṛte parasyākārasya saṇpi lope siddhamiṣṭam
|| 
eśnābhyastayorātaḥ || 6 - 4 - 112 || 
e lunata iti | laṭ, ātmanepadeṣpanataḥ iti jhasyādādeśaḥ |
lunatāmiti | loṭi āmetaḥ | alunateti | laṅ | mimate ityādau
bhṛñāmit itītvam | 
e yānti, vāntīti | asati hi śnābhyastagrahaṇe ato guṇe ityatra
taparakaraṇsaya yānamityādāvakṅiti cāritārthatvādiha lopa eva
syāditi bhāvaḥ | 
e alunāditi | atarasūtre kṅtītyisya sambandhaḥ sthita eveti
nāyamītvasya viṣayaḥ | ikahākāraṇābhyastaviṣeṣaṇādākārāntasya
lopo jāgratītyatra na bhavati | tatra nirddiśyamānasyādeśāḥ iti vā
alo'ntyasya iti vā ākārasyaiva lopa ityādi matvā vyākhyātam -
śna ityetasyābhyastānāṃ cākārasyaiti | ākārāntānām iti tu
vyākhyeyam | atrāpi ā sārvadhātuka eva sambhavati |
evamabhyastamapyākārāntam | vavaturityādau bhavatyeva lopaḥ || 
eī halyadhoḥ || 6 - 4 - 113 || 
e lunantīti | asati halgrahaṇe ītvalopayoḥ paryāyaḥ syāt
ekaviṣayatvāt | ghusaṃjñakeṣveva vā lopaḥ syāt | atrāpi pūrvavat
sārvadhātukameva sambhavati || 
eiddaridrasya || 6 - 4 - 114 || 
e idamapi sārvadhātuka eva anyatra lopavidhānāt | siddhascati | yathā
pratyayavidhau pratyayavidhānakāla thaeva siddho bhavati, tathā lopaḥ
kartavyaḥ, ārdhadhātuke taiti vaṣyasaptamyāśrayaṇīyeti bhāvaḥ | 
e ākārāntalakṣaṇa iti | ārdhadhātuke iti parasaptamyāṃ tasyotparti
prataukṣya lopaḥ kartavyaḥ, tataśca syāvdyaya tyākārāntilakṣaṇo
ṇapratyayaḥ syāt, tatra kṛte'nena lopaśca prāpnoti yukca, tatra
lopasya śabdāntaraprāptyā'nityatvam , yukastu lope kṛte'prāptiḥ,
tataśca ubhayorapyanityayoḥ paratvādyauk syāt | athāpi 
elopaḥ syāt, evamapi adaridra taityatra ackāvaśaktau ityeva svaro na
syāt | īṣaddaridramityatra ca āco yuc iti yuc syāt | 
e daridrāyak iti | ṇvuli, yuk | daridrāṇa iti | lyuṭ |
didaridrāsatīti | tanipatidaridrāṇāmupasaṃkhyānam iti
vyavasthitavibhāṣā, tena lopapakṣe iṭ | anyatreḍabhāvaḥ | 
e adyatanyāmiti | luṅ eṣā pūrvācāryasaṃjñā | adaridrāsīditi |
yamaramanamātāṃ sakca iti | ekācaḥ iti tatrānuvartata ityekīyaṃ matam
| ciṇi - adaritidri, tādaridrāyi | ṇali - dadaridrau | chāndasa
hrasvatvamiti | anyathā āto dhātoḥ iti lope daridra iti nirddeśaḥ
syāta ||

kṅitīti

e nanu ca babhaṇatuḥ,

e kimidaṃ niyamārtham, āhosvidvidhyartham kathaṃ cedaṃ niyamārtham,

esyāt, ṣapūrvadīnāmevāṇi, ṣapūrvadīnāmaṇyeveti evamapi

- tasyākārasya lopo bhavatīti | tākṣṇa iti | idamarthe'ṇ, apatye tu

grahaṇam, na jaśsasoḥ śiḥ ityasya hrasvāntasya tatra saṃjñāyā abhāvāt || 
ena saṃyogādvamantāt || 6 - 4 - 137 || 
e syādvakāramakārābhyāṃ saṃyogasya viśeṣaṇāt tadantavidhiratreti
vispaṣṭārthamantagrahakaṇ || 
eacaḥ || 6 - 4 - 138 || 
e aca ityayamañcatirluptanakāro gṛhyata iti | pratyāhāragrahaṇaṃ tu na
bhavati, yadi syād, ajantasyāṅgasya lopo bhavatītyarthaḥ syāt,
tataśca ātodhātoḥ ityetadanarthakaṃ syāt | yacca
dyauprāgapāgudakpratīco yat iti nirddiśati, yacca cau ityāha, tato
jñāyate - añcaterevātra grahaṇamiti | etena pacādyaco'pyagrahaṇam || 
eāto dhātoḥ || 6 - 4 - 140 || 
e evamādi siddhaṃ bhavatīti |sūtrādvahirasmadādiprayoge'pīti bhāvaḥ|
sūtre tu sautro nirddeśa ityeva siddham || 
emantreṣvāṅyāderātmanaḥ || 6 - 4 - 141|| 
e āṅiti pūrvācāryaprakriyayā tṛtīyaikavacanasya grahaṇam | 
e āṅe'nyatrāpi dṛśyeta iti | tasmādāṅīti na vaktavyamityarthaḥ | ātaḥ
ityanuvṛterāderityapi śakyamakartum | tmanyeti |
saptamyekavacanasya yāśabda ādeśaḥ || 
eti viṃśateḍaitiṃ || 6 - 4 - 142 || 
e tigrahaṇaṃ kim antyasya mā bhūt | siddho'ntyasya lopa utarasūtreṇa
siddhe satyārambho niyamārthaḥ syāt - ḍityeva yathā syādanyatra
yasyetilopo mā bhūditi | athāpi vidhiniyamasambhave vidhereva
jyāyastvam evamapyārambhasāmarthyāt alo'ntyasya ityetasmin
bādhite samudāyasyaiva ṣaṣṭhīnirddiṣṭasya lopaprasaṅgaḥ, na
tvasaṃśabditasya tiśabdasya lopaḥ sidhyati | tigrahaṇe tu sati
tatsāmarthyād alo'ntyasya ityasyānupasthānātsarvasya tiśabdasya
bhavati | viṃśam, viṃśakamityādau tilope kṛte ato guṇe
pararupatvam | yasyetilopastu na bhavati tilopasyāsiddhatvāt || 
eṭeḥ || 6 - 4 - 143 || 
e ḍityabhasyāpīti | śravaṃṇārthastu ḍakāro na bhavati, ḍmatupi
tāvad deśe tannāmni iti vartate, na ca ḍakāravatā pratyayena tannāmā
gamyate deśaḥ | ḍe'pi prāvṛṭśaratkāladivāṃ je iti
nirddiṣṭatvānna (vaṇārtho ḍakāraḥ | manduraja iti | ṅyāpoḥ
saṃjñācchandasorbahulam iti hrasvaḥ || 
enastaddhite || 6 - 4 - 144 || 
e teṣāmiti | an iti prakṛtibhāvaḥ prāpta ityanuṣaṅgaḥ | pīṭhena
sarpatīti pīṭhasarpī | kalāpiśabdātproktārthe kalāpino'ṇ,
cchandobrāhmaṇāni ca tadviṣayāṇi, tadadhīte ityaṇ, proktālluk,
kālāpāḥ | evaṃ kaurthumāḥ | kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇamuṣacāra āśrīyate, na
punarmukhyārthavṛttibhyām tena proktam ityādyarthe'ṇ kriyate ityata
āha - śaiṣikeṣviti | kecititaliśabdaṃ paṭhanti - lilānāṃ talaṃ
tilam, pṛṣodarādiḥ, tadasyāstīti titalī | evaṃ lāṅgalā iti |
upacārādi sarvamatidiśati | utareṣu triṣvidamarthe'ṇ | 
e evamāśmā ityatrāpi | cārma ityatra vikāre | cārmaṇa ityatredamarthe
vikāre'pi kośādanyatra | 
e śauva iti | tasyedamityaṇ, atra paratvādvṛddhiprāptau
dvārāditvātatpratiṣedhe aijāgame ca kṛte ṭilopaḥ | 
eśauvano'nya iti | vikārāvayavayostu prāṇitvādañiti
prakṛtibhāvābhāvāt śauva ityeva bhavati | 
e ke punariti | prātipadikagaṇe pāṭhābhāvātpraśnaḥ | ādiśabdasya
prakāravacanatvādākṛtigaṇo'yamityutaram | sāyamprātikamiti |
yathākathañcitkālavṛterapi bhavati ityuktatvātkālasamudāye'pi ṭhañ
eva bhavati, yeṣāṃ ca virodhaḥ śāśvatikaḥ iti nirddeśāt
isusuktāntātkaḥ iti kādeśābhāvaḥ | śāśvatamiti |
bhāṣyakāravacanādaṇ pratyayaḥ || 
eahraṣṭakhoreva || 6 - 4 - 145 || 
e dvyaha iti | na saṅkhyādeḥ samāhāre iti ahrādeśasya pratiṣedhaḥ |
dvyahīna iti | taddhitārthe dviguḥ, samāyāḥ khaḥ, dvigorvā,
rātryahaḥsaṃvatsarācca iti khaḥ | 
e āhrikamiti | ārhīyaṣṭhak | 
e evakārakaraṇaṃ vispaṣṭārthamiti | viparītaniyamanirāsārthaṃ tu na
bhavatītyāha - ahra eveti | viparīte hi niyame anyasya khe
ṭilopaprasaṅgād ātmādhvānau khe iti prakṛtibhāvavidhānamanarthakaṃ
syāditi bhāvaḥ || 
eorguṇaḥ || 6 - 4 - 146 || 
e bābhravyādau gotre yañ | śaṅkavyādau prākkrītīyaḥ ugavādibhyo
yat | aupagavādāvapatye'ṇ | 
e saṃjñāpūrvako vidhirityādi | bhāṣye'nuktamapi prayogo
bāhulyāduktam | taddhitaityeva - voto guṇavacanāt, paṭvī || 
eḍhea lopo'kadravāḥ || 6 - 4 - 147 || 
e madrabāhuśabdād bāhvantātsaṃjñāyām ityuṅ, kadruśabdādapi
kadrukamaṇḍalvoścchandasi saṃjñāyām ityūḍ, tābhyāmapatye strībhyo
ḍhak, anyatra catuṣpādbhyo ḍhañ, kamaṇḍalupada ādadhīteti
bahvṛgbrāhmaṇam | śrṛgālaḥ - jambuḥ, śivā - jambūḥ | jambureva
jambajambukaḥ || 
eyasyeti ca || 6 - 4 - 148 || 
e iśca aśca yam, samāhāradvandve dhyantādajādyadantaṃ vipratiṣedhena iti
aśbadasya pūrvanipātaḥ sautratvānna bhavita | yaśabdasya tu grahaṇaṃ na
bhavati, liṅgāta, yadayaṃ gargaśabdasya yañi kumāraśabdasya tu ṅīpi
lopaṃ nirddiśati - oto gārgyasya, kumāryā vayasi iti | ata eva
nirddeśādekāre tāvadhrasvasya grahaṇam, tatsāhacaryādikāre'pi |
kāryaṃ tu dīrghasyāpi bhavati savarṇagrahaṇāt | dākṣīti | ito
manuṣyajāteḥ iti ṅīṣa, sakhiśabdādapi sakhyaśiśvīti bhāṣāyām iti |
sarvatra savarṇadīrghatvena rupaṃ sidhyati, kiṃ lopena tatrāha -
savarṇadīrghatve hīti | atisakheriti | atikrāntaḥ sakhīmiti
tatpuruṣe liṅgaviśiṣṭaparibhāṣayā rājāhaḥsakhibhyaṣṭac iti ṭajna
bhavati, tasyānityatvāt | tata upasarjajahrasvatvam | ekādeśatasyeti |
ṅīṣā saha kṛtasya | asakhīti pratiṣedhaḥ syāditi | kathaṃ punaḥ
sakhiśabdasyocyamāno'tisakhiśabdasya pratiṣedhaḥ syāt
tadantavidhināḥ grahaṇavatā prātipadikena tadantavidhirnāsti | evaṃ
manyate - kāryakālaṃ saṃjñāparibhāṣam iti pakṣe gheṅiti ityatra
ghisaṃjñāyā upasthānād aṅgādhikāre tasya ca tadutarapadasya ca
ityasti tadantavidhiriti | yadvā - śeṣasyekārokāramātrasya ghisaṃjñā,
na tadantasya, tataḥ kim asakhītyapi sakhiśabdekārasya pratiṣedhaḥ, na
sakhiśabdasya | ekādeśe ca sakhiśabdekāra evāyamiti tadante'pi
pratiṣedhaḥ syādeva |lope tu sati yadyapyupasarjanahrasvatve kṛte
rupamaviśiṣṭam, tathāpi tasya lākṣaṇikatvānna bhavati pratiṣedhaḥ |
dauleyādau itaścāniñaḥ iti ḍhak | balākā - sumitrāśabdau
bāhvādī | saurya iti | tenaikadik ityaṇ, etacaca
sūryāgastyayośche ca ṅyāṃ ca ityanapekṣayodāhṛtam | 
e iyaṇuvaṅbhyāmiti | iyaṇuvaṅeravakāśaḥ - śriyau, bhravau,
lopasyāvakāśaḥ - dauleyaḥ kāmaṇḍaleyaḥ | 
esūryatiṣyāgastayamatsyānāṃ ya upadhāyāḥ || 6 - 4 - 149 || 
e yadyatra bhatvena sūryādayo viśeṣyante - sūryādīnāṃ
bhasaṃjñānāmiti, tataḥ sūryasya strī sūrī, āgastyasya agastītyādau
yatra sūryādyeva bhasaṃjñakaṃ tatraiva syāt, saurī balāketyatra tu na
syāt, na hyatra sūryaśabda īti bhasaṃjñakaḥ, kiṃ tarhi aṇantam |
tasmādanāśritarupasya bhamātrasya lopena sambandhaḥ |
sūryādibhiryakāro viśeṣyate 
eiti darśayannāha - sūryatiṣyāgastyamatsyetyateṣāmiti | bhasaṃjñakasya
yo yakāra upadhā tasya lopo bhavati, sa cetsūryādīnāṃ
sambandhītyarthaḥ | saurīti | atra īti parato bhasaṃjñakamaṅgamaṇantaṃ
tasya yakāra upadhā yathā bhavati tathā darśayati - aṇi yo yasyeti
lopa iti | vyāśrayatvāditi | aṇi yasyeti lopaḥ, īti yalopa iti
vyāśrayatvam | īkāre tu ya iti | lopa ityapekṣate |
bhasyāṇantasyeti | bhasaṃjñakasyāṇantasya yakāra upadhā bhavatītyarthaḥ |
sthānivadbhāvastu dvayorapi yasyetilopayoryalopavidhiṃ prati
pratiṣiddhaḥ | 
e matsyacarīti | matsī bhūtapūrveti caran, tasilādiṣviti
puṃvadbhāvaḥ , ṭitvānṅīp, bhavatyatra matsyacaraśabda īti bhasaṃjñakaḥ,
matsyasambandhī ca yakāraḥ na tvasau bhasaṃjñakasyopadheti lopābhāvaḥ | 
e yagrahaṇamutarārthamiti | iha tu sūryādisambandhī
bhasaṃjñakasyopadhāyakāra eva na varṇāntaramiti nārthastena | 
e saurīya iti | sauryaśabdādvṛddhacchaḥ | evam - āgastīyaḥ | āgastya
iti | upatye ṛṣyaṇ | 
e tiṣyapuṣyayoriti | tiṣyasya satreṇaiva prāpte nakṣatrāṇi niyamaḥ,
puṣyasyāprāpte vidhiḥ | sūtre tvarthagrahaṇe sidhyatyasyāpi prasaṅgaḥ | 
e antikasyetyādi | cchandasyetadiṣyate | kakārādeḥ śabdasyeti |
kakārasyākārasya cetyarthaḥ | ādyaudātañceti | pratyayasvarasyāpavādaḥ |
antita iti |apādāne cāhīyaruhoḥ iti tasiḥ | kādeśceti |
kaśabdasyetyarthaḥ | antiṣaditi | matmṛdvipa ityādinā kvip |
bahvacāstu vyastamadhīyate | 
e ye ceti | dṛśyata ityapekṣate | antiya iti | bhave cchandasi iti yat
| kādilopasyāsidvatvādyasyeni lopābhāvaḥ || 
ehalastaddhitasya || 6 - 4 - 150 || 
e taddhita iti nivṛtamiti | utarasūtre punastaddhitagrahaṇāt,
tenāyamītyeya vidhiḥ || 
eāpatyasya ca taddhite'nāti || 6 - 4 - 151 || 
e gārgakamiti | gotrokṣoṣṭra ityādinā vuñ, saṅkaśādibhyo ṇyaḥ
iti vuñcchaṇādisūtreṇa cāturarthikaḥ, tataḥ dhanvayopadhādvuñ iti
jātādāvarthe | 
e taddhitagrahaṇamityādi | somo devatāsyeti somāṭṭa|lṇ
ṭitvānṅīp, tatra parato'nāpatyayakārasyāpyasya halastaddhitasya iti
lopo yathā syādityevamarthamiha taddhitagrahaṇaṃ kṛtam anyathā hi
prakṛtaṃ taddhitagrahaṇihānuvartanīyam, tasmiṃścānuvartamāne
tatsambaddhamītītyapi sambadhyeta, taccobhayamiha sambadhyamānaṃ
pūrvasūtre'pi sambadhyeta, tataśca pūrveṇaiva siddhe satyubhayatra taddhita
īti ceti niyamo'yaṃ vijñāyeta - āpatyasyaivānākārādau taddhite
īti ceti | tato yathā taddhite'nāpatyasya na bhavati - sāṅkaśyaka
ityādau, tathā ītyapi na syāt - saumī iṣṭiriti | taddhitagrahaṇe tu
sati tena pūrvayoge taddhitagrahaṇasya
nivṛttirākhyātetyāpatyānāpatyayordvayorapi pūrveṇa īti lopo
vidhīyata iti saumī iṣṭirityatrāpi yalopaḥ
sidhyatītyatastaddhitagrahaṇam | nanu ca yadyaubhayasyāyaṃ niyamaḥ syād,
yogavibhāgo'narthakaḥ syād, hala āpatyasya taddhitasyānāti
ityekameva yogaṃkuryāt, tato
yogavibhāgādanyatarasyaivānuvṛttiḥ, tatrāpi anāti kaiti
vacanātasyaiva evamapi doṣaḥ, anāpatyasya taddhite'pi prāpnoti,
katham āpatyasya yadi bhavati thānākārādāveveti niyamasambhāvat,
sāṅkāśyakādau lopaḥ syādeva | anākārāviti niyamaḥ sambhavati |
atha na sambhavati tadā na kaściddoṣaḥ āpatyasyaiva taddhite,
tatrāpyanākārādeveti niyamadvayāśrayaṇāt || 
ekyacvyośca || 6 - 4 - 152 || 
e gargīyatīti | kyaci ca itītvam | gārgīyata iti |
akṛtsārvadhātukayordīrghaḥ , kyaṣastavāpatyādasambhavaḥ | gārgībhūta i |
asya cvau itītvam || 
ebilvakādibhyaścchasya luk || 6 - 4 - 153 || 
e bilvakādīnāmasminpradeśe prātipadikagaṇe
pāṭhābhāvātatparijñānārthamāha - naḍādiṣviti | naḍādiṣu
bilvādayastāvatpaṭha|lnte, tatra kuki kṛte yadrūpaṃ kakārāntaṃ
tadihānukṛtam | bilvak ādiryeṣāmiti vigṛhya samāsaḥ | jaśtve
tu kriyamāṇe rupavināśaprasaṅgānna kṛtamityarthaḥ | tena bilvaka
ādiryeṣāmiti ajñātādiṣu yaḥ 
ekastadantānāṃ grahaṇaṃ nāśaṅkanīyam pāṭhābhāvāt |cchagrahaṇaṃ
kimiti | kṛtakugāgamebhyaḥ parastādanyo na sambhavatīti praśnaḥ kathaṃ
punaḥ kuko nivṛttiprasaṅgaḥ ityāha - anyathā hīti | idameva
cchagrahaṇaṃ jñāpakam - astyeṣā paribhāṣeti | yakāramātrasyeti |
upadhāyā ityanuvṛtestasyaiva syād | athāpi tannivṛtam, evamapi,
ādeḥ parasya iti parasya prasaṅgādaniṣṭameva || 
eturiṣṭhemeyassu || 6 - 4 - 154 || 
e dohīyasītyatra ghatvādīnāmasiddhatvātpūrvaṃ tṛśabdasya lope kṛte
paścānnimitābhāvātepāmabhāvaḥ | lopo bhavati ityukta, tatrantyasya
prāpnātyata āha - sarvasyeti | kāraṇamāha - antyasya hīti | 
e nanvevamanantaro lugeva vidheyaḥ, evaṃ sukhameva sarvasya
nivṛttirlabhyate ata āha - lugityetatviti | kaḥ punastadanuvṛtau
doṣaḥ syād ata āha - tathā hīti | na ca pūrvameva guṇo bhavati
antaraṅgānapi vidhīnbahiraṅgo lugbādhate iti vacanāt | 
e imanijgrahaṇamutarārthamiti | nehārtham, tṛśabdātasyāsambhāvāt
| na cedameva kalpakaṃ bhavitumarhati, utarārthatayāpyupapateḥ |
nanvevam ajādī guṇavacanādeva iti niyamādiṣṭheyasunorapi na
sambhavaḥ ata āha - itarau tviti || 
eṭeḥ || 6 - 4 - 155 || 
e ṇāviṣṭhṃavaditi | saptamīsaptamarthādvatiḥ, ṇāviti pratiyogini
saptamīnirddeśāt teneṣṭhani yatkāryaṃ tadatidiśyate, na tviṣṭhano
yatkāryaṃ tadapi | tena bahūnācaṣṭe bahayatityatra iṣṭhasya yiṭ ca iti
ṇeryiṇ bhavati, tadabhāve tatsanniyogaśiṣṭo bhūbhāvo'pi na bhavati
| kecitu bhūbhāvamudāharanti - bhāvayatīti | etayatīti |
ṭilobātideśenaiva sanniyogaśiṣṭatvānnakāranivṛtāvapi siddhāyāṃ
puṃvadvacanaṃ sanniyogaśiṣṭaparibhāṣāyā anityatvajñāpanārtham, tena
śyaiveyaḥ, aineya ityādi siddhaṃ bhavati | 
e apara āha - iṅviḍamācaṣṭe aiḍaviḍayati, daradamācaṣṭe
dāradayatītyevamādau puṃśabdātideśārtha puṃvadvacanamiti | nanu
ceḍaviḍādīnāmiṣṭhani puṃvadbhāvo na dṛṣṭaḥ, iṣṭhana eva
tatrāsambhāvāt | neṣṭhani dṛṣṭasyātideśaḥ, kiṃ tarhi sambhāvitasya
anyathā atirājayatītyādau ṭilopo na syāt | 
e prātipadikagrahaṇaṃ prakṛtimātropalakṣaṇam | tena droṇīmācaṣṭhe
ityādāvapi ṭilopo bhavati | nātra puṃvadbhāvo'sti
abhāṣitapuṃskātvāt | liṅgaviśiṣṭaparibhāṣayā vā ṅībantasya
grahaṇam | uktaṃ hi prāk - yathākathañcitprātipadikagrahaṇe
liṅgaviśiṣṭṃa gṛhyate iti | sthavayatītyādau ata upadhāyāḥ iti
vṛddhirna bhavati aṅgavṛte punarvṛtāvavidhirniṣṭhitasya iti vacanāt
| asyārthaḥ - aṅgadhikāravihite kasmiṃścatkārthe vṛte punaḥ
kāryāntarasya vṛtau prāptāyāmavidhistasya kāryasya, taccedaṅgaṃ
niṣṭhitaṃ bhavati - prayogārhaṃ bhavati | yatra tvaniṣṭhitamaṅgaṃ tatra
bhavatyeva vṛttiḥ - prāpayati, sthāpayatīti | kartāramācaṣṭa ityādau
tṛśabdasya turiṣṭhemeyaḥ su iti lopo bhavati na veti | cintayam
|| 
esthūladūrayuvahrasvakṣiprakṣudrāṇāṃ yaṇādiparaṃ pūrvasya ca guṇaḥ || 6 - 4
- 156 || 
e yadyapi prakṛto lopaśabdo bhavāsādhanaḥ, tathāpīha karmasādhano'pi
jñāyate, yaṇādi paraṃ lopa iti sāmānādhikaraṇyena nirddeśāt |
tadāha - yaṇādiparaṃ lupyata iti | pūrvagrahaṇaṃ vispaṣṭārthamiti |
iko guṇavṛddhī iti vacanālluptāvaśiṣṭasya ya ik tasya guṇo
bhaviṣyatīti bhāvaḥ | ata eva vacanādajādī pratyayau bhavata iti |
imanica tu pṛthvādiṣvapaṭhitebhyo na bhavati, anabhidhānāt || 
eprayasthirasphirorubahulaguruvṛddhatṛpradīrghavṛndārakāṇāṃ
prasthasphavarbehigarvarṣitrabdradhivṛndāḥ || 6 - 4 - 157 || 
e priyasthirorubahuladīrghāḥ pṛthvādiṣu paṭha|lnte,
tenaiteṣvimanijanuvṛteścaritārthatvāditareṣvimanicaḥ
kalpakametadvacanaṃ na bhavati, tadāha - tenānyaṣāmiti || 
ebahorlopo bhū ca bahoḥ || 6 - 4 - 158 || 
e bhūyāniti | ādeḥ parasya ityāderlopaḥ | anyathā hīti | yadi punaḥ
bahoḥ iti nocyeta, tato yathā lopaḥ pratyayānāṃ bhavati, tathā
bhūbhāvo'pi teṣāmeva syāt | paryāyeṇa tatra lopa āderbhūbhāvaḥ
sarvasya śakyate 
evaktum pṛthagnirddeśātpratyayānāṃ na bhaviṣyati, anyathā bhūlopau
bahoḥ iti vrūyāt | evaṃ ca kṛtvā utarapadabhūmni iti nirddeśa
upapadyata iti || 
eiṣṭhasya yiṭ ca || 6 - 4 - 159 || 
e lopāpavādo yiḍāgama iti | nāprāpte tasminnārambhāt |
tasminniti | lopāpāvadabhūte | yadi tu lopo'pyanukṛṣya
vidhīyate tadā ikāro noccāraṇārthaḥ || 
ejyādādīyasaḥ || 6 - 4 - 160 || 
e lopasyeti | yadi lopo yiṭā na vyavahitaḥ syātenaiva
jyāyāniti sidhyatīti kṛtvā āditi na vaktavyaṃ syāditi bhāvaḥ |
kathaṃ purarlope siddhiḥ ityāha - lope hīti | akṛdyakāra iti | atra
kṅitīti nānuvartata iti bhāvaḥ | uruyetyādau
chāndasatvāddīrghābhāvaḥ || 
era ṛto halāderlaghoḥ || 6 - 4 - 161 || 
e parigaṇanaṃ kartavyamiti | evaṃ ca halāderlaghoḥ iti na vaktavyam |
mātayatīti | uṇādīnāmavyutpannatvāt turiṣṭhemeyaḥsu iti
tṛśabdasya lopo na bhavati, atra paratvāṭṭilopaṃ bādhitvā rabhāvaḥ
prāpnoti || 
eprakṛtyaṃkāc || 6 - 4 - 163 || 
e iṣṭhemeyassu parata iti | yadi tviṣṭhādīnāmihānuvṛttirna syāt,
tadā śriye hitam prāk krītācchaḥ śrīyam, jñā devatāsya jñaḥ
sthālīpāka ityatra yasyetilopo na syāt, tataśca
śrīyamityatreyaṅadeśaḥ syāt, tasmādanuvartyā iṣṭhādayaḥ | srajiṣṭha
iti | thātha prādayaḥ kimityupekṣitāḥ - preṣṭhaḥ, preyān, stheṣṭhaḥ,
stheyāniti asiddhatvātprādīnāṃ ṭilopo yasyetilopaśca na
bhaviṣyati | iha tarhi śreṣṭhaḥ, śreyāniti
akāroccāraṇasāmarthyāllopo na bhaviṣyati |
tasmādvinmatorlukyevāsyodāharaṇasya sambhavaḥ | yadyevam, nāprapte
ṭilope ārabhyamāṇe vinmatorluk lopaṃ bādhiṣyate satyam
vinnantasya matvantasya ca ṭilopaḥ prāptastaṃ bādhate | yastu tayoluki
kṛte avaśiṣṭasya ṭilopaḥ prāpnoti, tasya kathaṃ bādhakaḥ syāt | na
hi tasminnaprāpte vinmatorlugārabhyate | avaśyaṃ caitadevaṃ vijñeyam
- aviśiṣṭasya yaṣṭilopastaṃ na bādhata iti anyathā
yatrāvaśiṣṭamanekāc tatrāpi ṭilopo na syāt, tataśca vasiṣṭhaḥ,
vasīyāniti pratyudāharaṇaṃ nopapadyate | evaṃ cātiśayena brahmavān
brahmaṣṭhaḥ, avaśiṣṭasya nastaddhite iti ṭilopo bhavati | bahvacbrāhmaṇaṃ ca
- tasmādbhāhmaṇaṃ brahmiṣṭhṃa kurvīta iti, tathātiśayena payasvī payiṣṭha
iti bhavati, na tu payasiṣṭha iti | 
e apara āha - 
e iṣṭhemeyassvanekāco'pyavaśiṣṭasya neṣyate | 
e ṭilopo bhāṣyakāreṇa pravṛte vinmatorluki || iti | 
e prakṛtyetyādi | rājño'patyaṃ rājanyaḥ, rājaśvaśurādyat,
manorapatyaṃ manuṣyaḥ, manorjātāvañyato pukca, tābhyāṃ samūhe
gokṣokṣoṣṭra ityādinā vuñ | āpatyasya cetyādi |
etaccānayorapatyavācitvamaṅgīkṛtyoktam | yadā tu
jātimātramubhayatra śabdārthaḥ, apatyārthastu nāstyeveti pakṣaḥ
tadānāpatyatvādeva lopasyā prasaṅgānnārthaḥ prakṛtibhāvena || 
einaṇyanapatye || 6 - 4 - 164 || 
e sāṃkūṭinamiti | kūṭa dāhe, dīrghopadhaḥ, abhividhau bhāve inuṇ,
aminuṇaḥ || 
egāthividathikeśigaṇipaṇinaśca || 6 - 4 - 165 || 
e matvarthīyennantā ete | gāthāśabdo vrīhmādiḥ | vidathaḥ - yajñaḥ || 
esaṃyogādiśca || 6 - 4 - 166 || 
e ayamapatyārtha ārambhaḥ || 
ean || 6 - 4 - 167 || 
e anapatye iti nivṛtam | sāmanaḥ, vaimana iti | tasyedam ityaṇ,
suyajorṅvanip, hrasvasya tuk - sutvā, tasyāpatyaṃ sautvanaḥ || 
ebrāhmāe'jātau || 6 - 4 - 171 || 
e yogavibhāgo'tra kriyate iti | yadi na kriyate, tadāpatya
ityanuvartate vā, na vā tatrānuvṛtāvanantarasūtreṇa
prakṛtibhāvapratiṣedhāt nastaddhite ityeva ṭilopasya
siddhatvānniyamārthametadbhavati - ajātāvevāpatye iti, tatrāpatye
siddhamiṣṭam - brāhmāe nāradaḥ, brāhmaṇajātiriti | anapatye tu
jātāvajātau ca na kvaciṭṭilopaḥ syād - brāhmī oṣadhiḥ, brāhmaṃ
haviriti | ananuvṛtau tu vidhiniyamasambhave vidhireva jyāyāniti
anapatye an iti prakṛtibhāve prāpte ajātau ṭilopārthaṃ
vidhyarthametadbhavati , tatra brāhmaṃ havirityādi siddham, brāhmī
oṣadhiriti na sidhyati ajātāviti pratiṣedhāt, brāhmaṇī
oṣadhiriti prāpnoti | apatye ca jātau brāhmaṇa iti na sidhyati,
pūrvasūtreṇa prakṛtibhāve pratiṣiddhe ṭilopaprasaṅgāditi bhāvaḥ |
vibhaktasyārthamāha - brāhma ityetaditi | sāmarthyāditi | apatye
pūrveṇaiva ṭilopasya siddhatvādbhāhma ityetāvatā niyamasya
kartumaśakyatvācca, tatrāpatye'pi brāhmāe nārada iti paratvādanenaiva
ṭilopaḥ | apatye veti | anyathā anapatye vāpatye ca jātau
pratiṣedhaḥ syāt, prasajyapratiṣeścāyamityāha - apatye jātāviti || 
ekārmastācchīlyo || 6 - 4 - 172 || 
e yadyevamiti | yadi tu ṇapratyayo'yamityarthaḥ | nastaddhita iti
ṭilapoḥ siddha iti | aṇi hi prakṛtabhāvaḥ | jñāpanārthamiti | evaṃ ca
cchatrā dibhyo'ṇ iti lāghavāya kartavyam ṇavacane prayojanābhāvāt
| tācchīlika iti | lulyajītīyaviṣavatvājjñāpanasyaitallabhyate, tena
tadasyāṃ praharaṇam, prajñāśraddhārcā ityādike ṇe ṅībna bhavati ||

edāṇḍināyanahāstināyanārtharvaṇikajaihmāśineyavāśināyanibhrauṇahatyadhaivatyasāravaikṣvākamaitreyahiraṇmayāni || 6 - 4 - 174 || 
e upacārāditi | mukhyasyādhyayanāsambhava upacāre hetuḥ | 
e bhrauṇahatyeti tu nipātanānarthakyam , hanasto'ciṇṇaloḥ iti
takārasya siddhatvāt | na ca nastaddhite iti ṭilopaprasaṅgaḥ,
ubhayoranityayoḥ paratvātasyaiva bhāvādata āha -
hanasto'ciṇṇaloriti | dhātusvarupagrahaṇe tatpratyaye dhātorityevaṃ
vihito yastatraiva kāryaṃ vijñāyate, na ca ṣyañevaṃ vihitaḥ, kiṃ tarhi
prātipadikādityevam, tenātra to nipātyate | kathaṃ nipātanāt |
evaṃ tarhi kutvānivṛtyarthaṃ nipātanam maivam tathāhi - na kvādeḥ
ityatra prakaraṇe bhrūṇaghnaḥ ṣyañi ityavakṣyat, atastatvārthamapi nipātanaṃ
sat jñāpakameva | 
e aikṣvākaśabdo'yamādyaudāto'ntodātaścaṣyate, tatrānyatarasya pāṭhe
itarasyokāralaupo na siddhyati, tatrāha - svarasarvanāmnoti |
udātādīnāmavibhāgenāvasthānam - ekaśrutiḥ, sarvanāmavatsarvanāma |
yathaiva hi tasyāpatyam ityādau upaguprabhṛtīnviśeṣānsarvanāma
pratipādayati, tathaikaśrutirapyudātādīnsvaraviśeṣāniti ekaśruteḥ
sarvanāmatvam | 
e iyādeśāpavāda iti | kekayādisūtreṇa prāpta iyādeśaḥ | 
e iha mitrayuśabdasya caturgrahaṇaṃ kriyate - gṛṣṭa|ladiṣu
pratyayasiddhyartham, yaskādiṣu lugartham, kekayādisūtre
ityādeśārtham, idaṃ caturthaṃ yulopārtham tatra dvirgrahaṇamakartu
śakyamityabhiprāyeṇāha - atha kimarthamiti | lugarthaḥ pāṭho na kartavya
iti | yañañorityeva siddhatvāt | pariharati - naitadastīti |
aṇprāpnotīti | yadī tu saṅghāṅkalakṣaṇeṣu ityasyānantaraṃ na
maitreyādityucyeta, tadā trīṇi grahaṇāni, nārtho nipātanena |
yalopa iti | yuśabdasya lopa ityarthaḥ || 
eṛtvyavāstyavāstvyamādhvīhiraṇyayāni cchandasi || 6 - 4 - 175 || 
e malopo nipātyata iti | tasyāsiddhatvādyasyetilopābhāvaḥ | evamapi
akṛtsārvadhātukayordīrghaḥ iti dīrdhaḥ prāpnoti, aṅgavṛteḥ
punarvṛtau iti vacanānna bhaviṣyati | kvacitu makāralopa iti
paṭhanti | tatra yasyeti lope kṛte pratyayākārasya śravaṇam || 
e iti śrīharadatamiśraviracitāyāṃ padamañjaryo ṣaṣṭhāsyādhyāyasya
caturthaḥ pādaḥṇ eai 
ṇ ṇ e atha saptamādhyāye prathamaḥ pādaḥ 
eyuvoranākau || 7 - 1 - 1 || 
e śāstrasya lāghavārthaṃ yuvū pratyayau upadiṣṭau,
tayoranenānākāvādeśau vidhīyete tatratatra hyanākayorevopadeśe
śāstrasya gauravaṃ syāt | iha kasmānna bhavati - yu mikṣaṇe, yutaḥ
yutavān uditoryuvoridaṃ grahaṇam | katham
lyaḍādiṣūkāro'nunāsika itsaṃjñakaḥ | evamapi dyauutvā, dyauutaḥ, dyauutavāna
- atra prāpnoti, ūṭhastvanudidavakāśaḥ athārthavato yuvuśabdasya
grahaṇam, anarthakaścanāyam, tena dhātvantasya na bhavati | bhujyuḥ,
mṛtyuḥ, kaṃyuḥ śaṃyuḥ
ūrṇāyurityādāvukārasyānitsaṃjñakatvādādeśābhāvaḥ | yadi tarhi
lyuḍādiṣūkāra itsaṃjñakaḥ - nandanaḥ, kārakaḥ, ugidacām iti num
prāpnoti ugito jhalantasya num, na cautau jhalantau | tatarhi
jhalgrahaṇaṃ kartavyam netyāha, yadetat napuṃsakasya jhalacaḥ iti
jhalgrahaṇaṃ tatpurastādapakrakṣyate, ugidacāṃ
sarvanāmasthāne'dhātorjhalaḥ yujerasamāse, tataḥ - napuṃsakasya jhalaḍha,
ityeva, tataḥ, acaḥ, napuṃsakasya ityeva, taccāvaśyaṃ
jhalgrahaṇamapakraṣṭavyam, anyathogito liṅgaviśiṣṭasyāpi num
prasajyeta - gomatī bhavatī | iha tarhi nandanā, kārikā - ugitaśca iti
ṅīp prāpnoti jñāpakātsiddham, yadayaṃ kvacidyauvū ṣiṭṭitau
karoti - śilpini ṣvun, ṭa|luṭa|lulau tuṭ ca iti, tajjñāpayati - na
yuvorīkāro bhavatīti | naitadasti jñāpakam ṣitkaraṇaṃ ṅīṣartham,
ṭitkaraṇamanupasarjanārtham, ṭito hyanupasarjanāt ṅīp bhavati,
ugitaḥ punaraviśeṣeṇa | tathā śātanapātanaśabdau lyuḍantau
gaurādiṣu paṭhitau, tatra śātanitarā, pātanitarā, nadyāḥ
śeṣasyānyatarasyām ugitaśca ityugillakṣaṇo hrasvavikalpaḥ prāpnoti |
nanu cogita ityevamugitasaṃjñāśabdanena yā nadī vihitā tasyāstatra
grahaṇam netyāha, iha hi doṣaḥ syāt - bhogavatitarā,
gaurimatitarā, śārṅgaravādiṅīnantāvaitau, tatra hrasvavikalpo na
syāt, iṣyate cātrāpi hrasvavikalpo bhāṣyakāreṇa | tasmānnaivaṃ
śakyam - uditoryuvorguhaṇam iti | na cedevaṃ yutaḥ, yutvā,
bhujyuḥ, śaṃyurityatrāpi prāpnoti tatrāha - anunāsikayaṇoriti |
santi hi yaṇaḥ sānunāsikāḥ, niranunāsikāśca, tatra yeṣāmādeśa
iṣyate teṣu yakāravakārāvanunāsikau paṭhitavyau, tena
kvāpyaniṣṭaprasaṅgaḥ | pratyayoriti | vastukathanametat, na
tvapratyayanivṛtyartham, tathāvidhāsyānunāsikasya yaṇo'sambhavāt || 
e mutyuriti | bhujimṛṅbhyaṃ yuktyukau iti sūtre
sahanirdiṣṭatvādidamudāhṛtam, śakyate hyatra vaktum - aṅgasya yau
yuvū, kau cāṅgasya yuvū, yayoraṅgamityetadbhavati,
kayoścaitadbhavati pratyayoḥ na caiṣa pratyaya iti | ānarthakyācca
ṭa|luṭayulostvanādeśe kṛte paścātuḍityarthavattvaṃ pratyayatvaṃ ca
| kimucyate'nunāsikatvaṃ na pratijñāyata iti , na punarna paṭha|lte
ityata āha - pratijñānunāsikyā iti | pratijñayānunāsikyaṃ yeṣāṃ te
tathoktāḥ | sarvatra pāṭhābhāvātsato'pi vā pāṭhasya
saṅkīrṇatvātpratijñāsamadhigamyamevānunāsikatvamityarthaḥ | 
e yuvoriti samāharadvandveścet sa napuṃsakam iti napuṃsakatve
sati autvaguṇavṛddhitṛjvadbhāvebhyo num pūrvavipratiṣiddham iti
vacanāt gherṅiti iti guṇaṃ bādhitvā iko'ci vibhaktau iti numi
sati yuvuna iti bhavitavyam itaretarayogadvandve tu dvirvacane
yaṇādeśe ca sati dvayorvakārayoḥ śravaṇaprasaṅgaḥ |
sthānivadbhāvādvali lopo'pi nāsti, tatkathamayaṃ nirddeśaḥ ityāha
- yuvoriti | napuṃsakaliṅgatā ceti | na bhavatīti vakṣyamāṇena
sambandhaḥ | madhye hetuḥ | liṅgamaśiṣyamiti | chāndaso varṇalopa
iti | akṛta eva yaṇādeśa ukārasya lopaḥ, kṛte vā tasminnanyatarasya
vakārasya apara āha - karmadhārayo'yam, avayavadharmeṇa samudāyasya
vyapadeśaḥ | yuścāsau samudāyo yuvulakṣaṇo vuścāsāviti tatra
samudāyayasya kvacidabhāvādavayavayorevānākādeśāviti | 
eāyaneyīnīyiyaḥ phaḍhakhacchaghāṃ pratyayādīnām || 7 - 2 - 2 || 
ephakārādiṣvakāra uñcāraṇārthaḥ | vyañjanamātraṃ sthāni ante
phaḍhakhacchaghām ityanackanirdeśāt | evaṃ ca niranuvandhakaparibhāṣā na
pravartate | āḍha|lkulīna iti | apūrvapadāt iti vacanāt kulātkhaḥ
ityanena sapūrvapadādapi kho bhavati | 
e phakka nīcairgatau ḍhokṛ taukṛ gatyarthau | iha pratyayādyaudātatvaṃ
saṃjñāsanniyogena vidhānādantaraṅgam | 
e ete tvāyannādayo'ṅgādhikāre vidhānādvahiraṅgāḥ, tataśca yatra
svarārtho'nubandho nāsti - śilāyā ḍhaḥ , 
evṛddhacchaḥ ityādau tatrādyaudātatve kṛte paścādbhavanta ete ādeśā
asvarakasyāca uccāraṇasambhavādaniyatasvarāḥ syuḥ ityāṅkyāha -
āyannādaya ityādi | ayamabhiprāyaḥ - pratyayādīnāṃ
phakārādīnāmaṅgasambandhāvyabhicārātprayojanābhāvādiha aṅgasya
iti na sambadhyate, tena ete'pyantaraṅgā, tatra paratvādeteṣu
kṛteṣu paścādādyaudātatvamiti | atraiya jñāpakamāha - tathā ceti |
yadi pratyayasvare kṛte āyannādaya ādeśāḥ syuḥ, tato
ghaśabdākārasyodātatve kṛte ghakārasya halaḥ sraṃsanadharmiṇaḥ
sraṃsanadhamiṇyanudāta ādeśe kṛte'ntodātatvaṃ siddhamiti
citkaraṇamanarthakaṃ syāditi bhāvaḥ | iyaṅiti | vāvacanaṃ jñāpakamiti |
yadi dhātupratyayānāmapyete ādeśāḥ syuḥ ṛteścchaṅ ityeṣa brūyāt
| na ca cchaṅ siti valādilakṣaṇe iṭi kṛte anāditvādiyādeśo na
syāditi vācyam, idānīmeva hyuktam - antaraṅgā ādeśā iti | 
e apara āha - yadi dhātupratyayeṣvetajjñāpakaṃ prātipadikapratyayeṣvapi
śakhyaṃ vaktuaṃ yadayamīyasunaṃ śāsti, tajjñāpayatyācāryaḥ na
prātipadikapratyayānāmime ādeśā iti | yadi syustarhi cchasunameva
vidadhyāt | etāvantaśca pratyayāḥ - dhātupratyayāḥ,
pratipadikapratyayāśceti, ucyante cādeśāḥ te vacanātsarvatraiva
syuriti | 
e itsaṃjñayā bhavitavyamiti | na ca vacanasāmarthyāditsaṃjñāyā
bādhanamityāhatiddhiteṣu hīti | pratividhānaṃ kartavyamiti |
pratividhānaṃ tu prācāmavṛddhātphin bahulam iti phino
nitkaraṇāditsaṃjñāyā abhāva iti | na ca pheśccha ca ityatra phinaḥ, phiñaśca
sāmānyagrahaṇārthaṃ nitkaraṇam , vṛddhādityadhikārāddhi phiña eva tatra
grahaṇam, na phinaḥ || 
ejho'ntaḥ || 7 - 1 - 3 || 
e ādigrahaṇaṃ nivṛtamiti | tadanuvṛtau hi śayāntai ityatra śīṅe
leṭi leṭo'ḍāṭau iti lāvasthāyāmeva prāpte āṭi sati
jhakārasyānāditvānna syāt | kathaṃ punaḥ
samāsanirddiṣṭānāmekadeśo'navartate naiṣa doṣaḥ, anāśritārthakaṃ
śabdamātraṃ svaritatvavaśādanuvartate - iti pakṣe yasyaiva svaritatvaṃ
pratijñātaṃ tasyaivānuvṛttiḥ | arthādhikārapakṣe tu
samāsārthasyaikatvātasyaivānuvṛttiḥ syādvā, na vā | yadvā -
pratyayagrahaṇaṃ pūrvasūtre pṛthak padaṃ luptavibhaktikam, tena
tasyaivānuvṛttirbhaviṣyati | ādeśe tvakāra uccāraṇārthaḥ tena
pacantītyādau śravaṇaṃ na bhavati || 
eadabhyastāt || 7 - 1 - 4 || 
e dadatītyādi | jakṣatītyādau yatropadeśānantaramabhyastasaṃjñā,
tatrāpyavaśyaṃ vikaraṇābhāvaḥ pratīkṣyaḥ, anyathā nityatvācchapi kṛte
tena vyavadhānānna syāt, tataśca dadatītyādāvapi śapaḥ
ślāvabhyastasaṃjñāyāmadādeśo bhavati | 
e jusādeśena tu bādhyata iti | tasyānavakāśatvāt | atrāpyādeśe
kṛte pratyayādyaudātatvaṃ bhavatīti | utaratreti bhāvaḥ | iha tu
abhyastānāmādiḥ iti svaro bhavati || 
eātmanepadeṣvanataḥ || 7 - 1 - 5 || 
e anabhyastārthamidaṃ vacanam | cinvatāmiti | loṭ, ṭeretvam
āmetaḥ | cyavanta iti | 
e nanu cātrāpi prāgeva śapaḥ paratvādadādeśaprasaṅgaḥ, anataḥ ityasya
tu bebhidhante - ityādiravakaśaḥ ityata āha - nityatvāditi |
jhakāraviśeṣaṇaṃ kimiti | śrutānāmātmanepadānāmadhikṛtasya
pratyayasya vā viśeṣaṇe ko doṣa taiti praśnaḥ | śayāntai iti |
atrāṅgasyānantaramātmanepadamāṭastadbhaktasya tadgrahaṇena
grahatathaṇāt, jhakārastvāṭā vyavahitaḥ |
antādeśastvaṅgaviśeṣānupādānādatrāpi bhavati || 
eśīṅe ruṭ || 7 - 1 - 6 || 
e jhādeśasyāt iti | nanu ca nehādgrahaṇamasti, yadapi prakṛtaṃ
tadapi prathamānirdiṣṭam, ṣaṣṭhīnirdiṣṭena cehārthaḥ, śīṅ ityeṣā
pañcamī aditi prathamāyāḥ ṣaṣṭhaāā prakalpayiṣyati, tasmādityutarasya iti
| śerata iti | sārvadhātukāvayavasya jhasyādādeśastadāgamo ruṭ
tadgrahaṇena gṛhyate | avayavasya samudāyaṃ pratyavayavatvaṃ loke'pi
dṛśyate, yathā - devadatasyāṅguliriti | sārvadhātukasyāpyavayavo
ruḍiti śīḍaḥ sārvadhātuke guṇaḥ iti guṇo bhavati | 
e kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ ruḍāgamo jhadeśasyāto vidhīyate, najhakārasyaiva
vadhīyate, evaṃ hi na ṣaṣṭhī prakalpyā 
ebhavati ata āha - ruḍayamiti | yadi tu kakārāsañjanena pūrvāntaḥ
kriyeta, śerata ityatra guṇo na syād anigantatvāt | tasmāt
parādireva vaktavyaḥ | sa yadica jhakārasyaiva syāt, tato yathā
śayāntai ityatrāṭā vyavahitatvājjhasyādādeśo na bhavati, tathā śerate
ityatrāpi na syāt ruṭā vyavahitatvāt | 
e nanu ca yuktamāṭā vyavadhānam, sa hi sārvadhātukabhaktastadeva na
vyavadadhyāt, jhakāraṃ tu vyavadadhātyeva, ruṭ punarjhakārabhaktaḥ sa
kathaṃ tasya vyabadhāyakaḥ ucyate gṛhyatā tāvatadgrahathaṇena , tathāpi
nirddiśyamānasyādeśā bhavanti iti yadatra nirddiśyate jha iti
viśiṣṭṃa rupaṃ na tadanantaram, yaścānantaro rephajhakārasamudāyo na
sa nirddiśyata iti na syādevādeśaḥ | apara āha - ādeśo na
syāditi, ko'rthaḥ jhasya na syāditi, kasya tarhi syāt ādeḥ parasya
iti ruṭa eva syāt | na ca ruṭeḥ vaiyarthyaṃ syāt, jhakārasya
śravaṇārthatvāt iti, taccintyam anekāltvātsarvādeśaḥ prāpnoti |
sarvādeśe ruṭo vaiyarthyamiti cet kiṃ kurmaḥ mā bhūdādeśaḥ |
śīṅḥ ityanubandhoccāraṇaṃ yaṅlugnivṛtyartham - vyatiśeśyate |
guṇo'pi na bhavati tatrāpyanubandhanirddaśāt || 
evetervibhāṣā || 7 - 1 - 7 || 
e saṃvidrata iti | samo gamyṛcchi ityādinātmanepadam | vita
ityādi | vida vicāraṇe, rudhādiranudātet | satālābhārthayostu
vikaraṇavyavadhānādevāgrahaṇam | atra ca bahuvacanaṃ pratyudāharaṇam,
itarayorupanyāso vicāraṇārthasyedaṃ bahuvacane rupamiti
pradarśanārtham | vidante iti rupasya lābhārthe taudādike
svaritetvādātmanepade ekavacane śe mucādīnām iti numyapi
kṛte sambhavāt | kiñca - veteriti śtipā nirddeśādeva
yaṅluki na bhavati - vyativevidate iti || 
ebahulaṃ cchandasi || 7 - 1 - 8 || 
e bahulavacanādanyatrāpi bhavatīti | etadarthameva vibhāṣāgrahaṇe
prakṛte'pi bahulagrahaṇaṃ kṛtam | 
e adṛśramiti | irito vā iti vāṅ || 
eato bhisa aisaṃ || 7 - 1 - 9 || 
e atijarasairiti | atraiva caikārasya śravaṇārthamaisādeśaḥ kṛtaḥ |
vṛkṣairityādāvesādeśe'pi vṛddhyā rupaṃ siddham | ato guṇe iti
pararupaṃ tu na bhavati yadi syāta, isameva vidadhyāt | 
e paratvāditi | etvasyāvakāśaḥ - vṛkṣeṣu, aiso'vakāśaḥ kṛta etve,
prāgetvādubhayaprasaṅge paratvādetvaprasaṅga iti cenmanyase, ata esa
kva bhaviṣyati etve kṛte mukhyamakārānta na bhavatīti praśnaḥ kṛta etve
bhautapūrvyāditi | bhūtapūrvasya bhāvo bhautapūrvyam,
sāmpratikābhāvādbhūtapūrvagatirāśrīyata iti bhāvaḥ | es tu
nityastathā satīti | evaṃ hi satyaisbhāvo nityaḥ,
kṛtākṛtaprasaṅgitvāt | etvaṃ tvaisi kṛte na prāpnoti
ajhalāditvāt | na ca tatra bhūtapūrvagatiḥ mukhyasyaiva sambhāvāt |
etaccodyaparihāramutsargāpavādabhāvamanāśritya kṛtaṃ draṣṭavyam,
tadāśrayaṇe hi nāprāpta etva ārambhādaisapavāda ityayukto vipratiṣedhaḥ
syāt || 
enedamadasorakoḥ || 7 - 1 - 11 || 
e idamadasoḥ iti bhisapekṣayā sambandhalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhī | ebhiriti |
tyadādyatvam, hali lopaḥ itīdbhāgasya lopaḥ | amībhiriti | aisi
pratiṣiddhe bahuvacane jhalyet ityetvam eta īdvahuvacane itītvamatve
| 
eakorityetadanarthakam, katham viśiṣṭarupāśrayo'yaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ -
idamadasoḥ iti, tatrākaci kṛte rupabhedādeva na bhaviṣyati tatrāha -
akorityetadeveti | jñāpanasya parayojanam - sarvake ityādau
sarvanāmakāryapravṛttiḥ | 
e imau dvau pratiṣedhāvucyete, dvāvapi śakyāvavaktum | katham evaṃ
hi vakṣyāmi - idamadasoḥ kāt iti, tanniyamārthaṃ bhaviṣyati -
idamasoreva kāditi | tataśca sarvakairityādau na syāt,
ebhirityādau ca syādeva - tanmadhyaparibhāṣā ca na jñāpitā syāt |
kvacitu vṛtāveva paṭha|lte - idamadasoḥ kāditi noktam,
viparīto'pi niyamaḥ syāt - idamadasoreva kāditīti || 
eṭāṅasiṅasāminātsyāḥ || 7 - 1 - 12 || 
e atijarasinetyādi | samāse hrasvatve kṛte inādeśaḥ, tataḥ
sannipātparibhāṣāyā anityatvājjarasādeśaḥ | 
eevamatijarasādityatrāpyādādeśe kṛte jarasādeśaḥ | nanu ca
ṭāṅsyorevājāditvātprāginādādeśābhyāṃ jarasādeśaḥ 
eprāpnoti, sa hi nityaḥ paraśca, tatra
kṛte'nadantatvādevenādādeśayorabhāve atijarasā, atijarasa iti
bhavitavyam | naiṣa doṣaḥ, evaṃ hi inādeśasya, adādeśasya ca
vidhānamanarthakam, nādeśo'deśaśca vidheyaḥ syāt, kā rupasiddhaḥ 
eiha tāvad vṛkṣeṇeti etve yogavibhāgaḥ kariṣyate - bahuvacane
jhalyet, osi ca, tataḥ āṅ ci - āṅ ci parato'ta etvam- vṛkṣeṇa |
naivaṃ śakyam, thaiha hyaneneti hali lopaḥ iti idrapalope sati eneti
prāpnoti hali lopaḥ ityapanīya jhali lopaḥ iti sūtre kariṣyeta,
tatra nakārasyājhaltvāllopābhāvaḥ | na sa śakyo jhali lopo
vaktum, iha hi na syāt, - ayāviṣṭa, ajanayat, ayeti
idamaścaturthyakavacanasya supāṃ suluka ityādinā yādeśaḥ, supi ca
iti dīrghābhāvaḥ chāndasaḥ, tatrāsyājhalāditvādidrūpalopo na syāt
| tasmāddhali lopa eva kartavyaḥ, tataścāneneti na sidhyati evaṃ tarhi
anāpyakaḥ iti dvinakārako'yaṃ nirddeśaḥ, tatrādeśasambandhī
padāntatvālluptaḥ naśca āp ca nāp, tatra parata ido'nādeśa iti
sūtrārthāśrayaṇādidrūpalopāpavodo naśabde parato nādeśa eva
bhaviṣyati | yadyavam, ādeśena lopasyāsiddhatvādrājetyādāviva sūtre
dīrghaprasaṅgaḥ - anāpyakaḥ iti naiṣa doṣaḥ, supāṃ suluk iti luki
kṛte na lumatāṅgasya iti pratiṣedhaḥ | vṛkṣādityatrāpi
savarṇatvenaiva siddham, akāroccāraṇasāmarthyādato guṇe pararupaṃ na
bhaviṣyati | tadevaminādeśasyādādeśasya ca
vidhānasamarthyātpūrvaminādādeśau, paścājjarasādeśa
ityaṣāmabhiprāyaḥ | 
e yathā tvityādi | bhāṣye hi pūrvoktaprakriyāśrayaṇena
nādheśo'dādeśaśca vyavasthāpitaḥ | yadi caitadrūpadvayamiṣṭṃa syāt,
tayorādeśayoḥ pratyākhyānamanupapannaṃ syāt | tatra
sannipātaparibhāṣayā jarasādeśābhāvādatijareṇa, atijarāditi
bhāṣyakārasyābhipretimiti kecit | prāgeva jarasādeśe -
atijarasā, atijarasa ityabhipretamityanye || 
eṇeóryaḥ || 7 - 1 - 13 || 
e ṇeó iti caturthyakavacanasya grahaṇamiti | tasya hi ṇeó iti rupaṃ
pratipadoktaṃ saptamyekavacanasya gherṅiti iti guṇe lākṣaṇikam |
yadyapi ṇeóḥ iti vibhaktyantamupātam, taccobhayorapi lākṣaṇikam,
thathāpi pratyayātpūrvasya bhāgasya lākṣaṇikatvapratipadoktatvāpekṣeyā
paribhāṣāpravṛttiḥ | yadyevam, ṇeórāmnadyāmnībhyaḥ ityatrāpyevameva
prasaṅgaḥ tasmāvdyākhyānamevātra śaraṇam | liṅgaṃ ca - tasmai
prabhavati, tadasmai dīyate, tasmai hitam, tadasyaé praharaṇamiti
krīḍāyāṃ ṇaḥ ityādi | vṛkṣāyeti | supi ca iti dīrghaḥ | 
e kathaṃ punarakārasannipātakṛto yaśabadstadvidhātanimitaṃ bhavati ata
āha - sannipātalakṣaṇa iti | anityatvaṃ tasyāḥ kaṣṭāya kramaṇe iti
nirddeśādavasīyate || 
esarvanāmnaḥ smai || 7 - 1 - 14 || 
e bhavata iti | dviryantāstyadādayaḥ iti vacanādanyatra
tyadādyatvābhāvādanakārantatvam | anvādeśe'śadeśe kṛta iti |
ananvādeśe tvatrāsmai cedrūpalopaḥ, na cākṛte idrūpalope ekādeśaḥ
prāpnotīti | na cādguṇaprasaṅgaḥ, nityenedrūpalopena
bādhitatvāt | ekādeśaḥ prāpnotīti | nityatvāt |
vākyasaṃskārapakṣe caitaccodyam | taddhyarthapratipādanāya loke
prayujyate, tadeva ca śāstre vibhajyānvākhyāyate | antaraṅgatvāditi
| ekapadā(yatvādantaraṅgatvam, padadvayāśrayatvādekādeśo
bahiraṅgaḥ || 
epūrvādibhyo navabhyo vā || 7 - 1 - 16 || 
e dvaye pūrvādayaḥ - sūtrapaṭhitāḥ, gaṇapāṭhapaṭhitāśca, sarvanāmnaḥ iti
cehānuvartate tatrāsati navagrahaṇe ṅasiṅyoryena sarvanāmasaṃjñā sa
gaṇapāṭha eva gṛhyata iti navagrahaṇam | 
e iha jasiṅasiṅīnāṃ śīsmātsminaḥ pūrvādibhyo navabhyo vā, auṅ
āpaḥ, śī napuṃsakācca iti sūtranyāsaḥ kartavyaḥ, evaṃ jasi
vibhāṣārthāni trīthaṇi sūtrāṇi na kartavyāni bhavanti tathā tu na
kṛtamityeva || 
ejasaḥ śī || 7 - 1 - 17 || 
e dīrghoccāraṇamutarārthamiti | khathaiha tvata ityadhikārād guṇena
bhavitavyamiti, hrasve'pi siddham | na ca sarve cchatriṇa ityatra
ṣatvatukorasiddhaḥ ityekādeśasyāsiddhatvād hrasvāśrayasya nityasya
tukaḥ prasaṅgaḥ, tatra hi padāntapadādyorya ekādeśastasyaivāsiddhatvam
|| 
eauṅ āpaḥ || 7 - 1 - 18 || 
e auṅḥ iti nirddeśaṃ kriyamāṇamanuvādapūrvamākṣipati | 
e aukāro'yamiti | ko'yaṃ prakāraḥ, kṛtsito'yaṃ
sūtrapraṇayanaprakāraḥ, siddhasya hyanuvāda upapadyate, yathā - ṇeóryaḥ iti, ayaṃ
tu na kvāpi siddha iti pariharati - kāmānyārtha iti | autaḥ
ityucyamāne prathamādvivacanasyaiva syānrinubandhakatvāt, na
sānubandhakasyauṭaḥ | yadyapi ṭakāraḥ
pratyāhārārthatvātsamudāyānubandhaḥ, tathāpi pratyayānubandhatvamapi
tasyāviruddham | vdyarthā api hetavo bhavanti, tadyathā - āmrāśca siktāḥ
pitaraśca prīṇitāḥ iti, auṭa ityucyamāne prathamādvivacanasya na syāt
| tasmād dvayorapi sāmānyagrahaṇārtho ṅkārānubandhanirddeśaḥ |
nanvasato'vuvādo'nupapanna ityākṣepaḥ, tatra
prayojanābhidhānamasaṅgatam naiṣa doṣaḥ, odauṭorauṇiṃti
vadhivākyamasmādevānuvādādanumāsyate, tasyaiva prayojanābhidhānam
| punaścodayati - tasya ceti | tasya
ṅkārānubandhasyāsañjane'sminnevaṃ vijñāyamāne ṅtkāyiṃ yāḍāpaḥ
ityetate evaṃvādinastava, śyāṃ śīśabde parataḥ, prasaktam | prasajatu
nāma tatrāha - sa doṣa iti | doṣa ityanena sāmānādhikaraṇyātsa iti
puṃlliṅganirddeśaḥ | pariharati - ṅtvi iti | varṇamātranirddeśaḥ
iti vavakṣitam, vṛtabhaṅgabhayātvasthāne mākṣaśabdaḥ prayuktaḥ |
yāḍāpaḥ ityatra ṅtīiti yadanuvṛtaṃ na sa bahuvrīhiḥ ṅ idyasyeti kiṃ
tarhi karmadhārayaḥ - ṅścāsavicceti, tataḥ kim ityata āha varṇe
yatsyāditi | yasminvidhistadādāvalgrahaṇe | 
e ayaṃ tāvanṅtvimabhyupetya parihāra uktaḥ, ṅtvimeva tu
nāstītyāha - varṇaścāyamiti | caśabdo vārthe paṭhitaḥ | varṇo
vāyamityeva vā pāṭhaḥ | auṅiti varṇo vāyamupāto na pratyayaḥ |
ṅkārastu mukhasukhārthaḥ, yathā - ṛdorap ityatra dakāraḥ |
aṅgākṣiptasya pratyayasya tena viśeṣaṇādaukārāntasya
pratyayasyetyarthaḥ | varṇarupatayā caukāragrahaṇe sati
dvayorapyaukārayorgrahaṇaṃ bhavati
pratyayaviṣayatvādananubandhakaparibhāṣāyāḥ | ṅtve'pyidoṣa iti |
ṅtve siti yo doṣaḥ so'pi na bhavati, ṅtvisyaivābhāvādityarthaḥ,
pūrveṇa vā parihāreṇāsyānvayaḥ | 
e parihārāntaramāha - nirdeśo'yamiti | pūrvācāryāṇāṃ hi sūtre
dve apyete dvivacane auṅiti paṭha|lete, tadāśrayeṇāyaṃ nirdeśaḥ, tena
dvayorapi grahaṇaṃ bhavati | na ca ṅitkāryaprasaṅgaḥ, na hi
pūrvācāryānubandhairiha kāryāṇi kniyante || 
ejaśśasoḥ śiḥ || 7 - 1 - 20 || 
e kuṇḍaśa iti | jātiśabdo'pyayaṃ yadārthaprakaraṇādinā
jātyādhārabhūtāyāmekasyāṃ vyaktau vartate, tadā vṛttiviṣaya
ekavacano bhavatīti saṃkhyaikavacanāt iti śas bhavati |
arthaprakaraṇādyabhāve tu tatra pratyudāhṛtam - ghaṭṃaghaṭṃa dadātīti || 
eaṣṭābhya auś || 7 - 1 - 21 || 
e kṛtākāro'ṣṭanśabdo gṛhyata iti | kṛtākārasyānukaraṇamaṣṭāśabdaḥ,
na tu vibhaktau lakṣaṇavaśādātvaṃ kṛtamityarthaḥ | 
e kṛtākārasya grahaṇaṃ kimiti | ātvavato'nukaraṇaṃ
kimityāśritamityarthaḥ | yadā''tvaṃ bhavati tadaiva yathā
syādityutaram | 
e aṣṭeti | kathaṃ punaratrātvābhāvaḥ, yāvatā na hi tadvidhau vikalpaḥ
sannihitaḥ ityata āha - etadeveti | iha aṣṭanaḥ iti vaktavyam - yathā
aṣṭana ā vibhaktau ityatra, evaṃ siddhe aṣṭābhyaḥ iti
nirddeśātkṛtātvāsyānukarathaṇamiti tāvanniścitam taseya
caitatprayojanam - yadātvaṃ bhavati tadaiva yathā syāditi | yadi ca
nityananu ca aṣṭano dīrghāt iti dīrghagrahaṇenāyamārtho jñāpitaḥ,
tadvā jñāpakamidaṃ vā, ko navatra viśeṣaḥ iheyatāvadvaktavyam -
ṣaḍbhyo luk ityasyāyamapavāda iti | asyaivetyavadhāraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam
| kāraṇamāha - nāprāpte ceti | sa hi samāsa eva prāpnoti, na tu
vākye | aṣṭaputra iti | antaraṅgānapi vidhīnbahiraṅgo lugbādhate
iti vacanādvākyāvasthāyāmeva prāpto'pyauś na kriyate, auśa eva vā
sthānivadbhā bālluk | tadantagrahaṇamatreṣyata iti | aṅgādhikāre
tasya ca tadutarapadasya ca iti vacanāt | yadyevam, yatrāṣṭaśabdārtha
upasarjanaṃ tatrāpi prāpnoti ata āha - priyā,ṭāna ityatreti | yathā
punaratrātvaṃ na bhavati, tathā tadvidhāveva 
evakṣyate || 
eṣaḍbhyo luk || 7 - 1 - 22 || 
e ṣaṭpradhānāditi | ṣaṭsaṃjñakānāmarthaḥ pradhānaṃ yatra tasmādityarthaḥ
| priyaṣaṣa iti | anyapadārthapradhāno'yaṃ bahuvrīhiḥ,
sarvanāmasaṃkhyayorupasaṃkhyānam iti ṣaṣaḥ pūrvanipāte prāpte vā
priyasya iti priyaśabdasya pūrvanipātaḥ || 
esvamornapuṃsakāt || 7 - 1 - 23 || 
e su iti prathamaikavacanasya grahaṇam, na saptamībahuvacanasya amā
ekavacanena sāhacaryāt | tadbhāhmaṇakulamityatra paratvātyadādyatve
kṛte lugna prāpnoti ato'm ityambhāvena bādhitatvāt,
tasmātyadādibhyaśceti vaktavyam ata āha - tad brāhmaṇakulamityatreti |
nityatvādveti | lukā tyādādyatvaṃ bādhyata ityanuṣaṅgaḥ | 
e kathaṃ punarluko nityatvam, yāvatā tyadādyatve kṛte
ato'mityapavādavidhānāta so'pyanitya eva ata āha - luko hīti |
yadi hyato'mityetanna syādakārāntamapyaṅgaṃ luko nimitaṃ syādeva,
tataḥ kim ityata āha - yasya ceti | tyadādyatvaṃ tu luki kṛte naiva
prāpnoti na lumatāṅgasya iti niṣedhāt | yadyevam, tadapi
lakṣaṇāntareṇaiva bādhyate nāsāvatvasya pratiṣedhaḥ, kasya tarhi
pratyayalakṣaṇasya, prāptirhi pratyayalakṣaṇena || 
eato'm || 7 - 1 - 24 || 
e atrāmiti padacchedaḥ, na tu miti tathā hi sati lāghavāya mata
taityeva brūyāt | kimarthaṃ punarambidhīyate na makāra evocyeta,
dvitīyaikavacane'pi ādeḥ parasya ityakārasya makāra kṛte'nyasya
makārasya saṃyogāntalopenaiva siddhamiṣṭam dīrghaprasaṅgastu supi
ca iti dīrghaḥ prāpnoti | na ca dīrghavidhau sannipātaparibhāṣā 
epravartate vṛtrāyetyādāvapi prasaṅgāt | tasmādameva vidheyaḥ | 
e apara āha - amvidhānasāmarthyādatijarasamityatra jarasādeśo
bhavatīti, taccintyam sannipātaparibhāṣayā jarasādeśasyāprasaṅgāt
| amvidhānaṃ tu dīrghabādhanena caritārthamiti || 
eadḍḍarādibhyaḥ pañcabhyaḥ ||7 - 1 - 25 || 
e adḍḍādeśo bhavatīti | vavikṣitādeśarupapratipādanāya ṣṭuatvaṃ
na kṛtam | kathaṃ punarjñāyate - ḍidayamādeśa 
eiti yadi hi ḍinnasyāt ḍatarādibhyaḥ pañcabhyo't ityeva brūyāt |
kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ sāveva dīrghanivṛttiḥ prayojanamucyate, na tvami
ityāha - iha tviti | evaṃ tarhīti | pūrvasūtravihitamamamanuvartya
ḍatarādibhya iti pañcamyāḥ ṣaṣṭhī prakalpya tasyaivāmo dakāro
vidhāsyata iti codyārthaḥ | he kataradityatra sambuddhilopo mā
bhūditi | ayaṃ ca doṣa pūrvasminnapi pakṣe samānaḥ | 
e nanu ca sambuddhilope halḍa|labbhyaḥ
ityato'pṛktagrahaṇamanuvartayiṣyate, iha ca ādeḥ parasya
ityamo'kārasya dakāre kṛte makārasya saṃyogāntalopaḥ,
tasyāsiddhatvānnāyamapṛktaḥ, evamadādeśo nāpṛktaḥ,
yadyapṛtagrahaṇamanuvartate, he kāṇḍetyāmo'pi na syāditi doṣaḥ |
tadidamuktam -- atha nivṛtamapṛktagrahaṇam, tato nivṛte ḍatarādiṣu
doṣaḥ - he kataradityādau lopaḥ syāditi | ato
ḍitvādadḍādeśavidhānātasya ca ḍitvānna sambuddhilopaḥ, nāpi
pūrvasavarṇadīrghatvamityarthaḥ | 
e yadi punaḥ pūrvasūtrabihitamamamanuvartya tasyaivādādeśo
vidhīyate śakyaṃ ḍitvamakartum || 
enetarācchandasi || 7 - 1 - 26 || 
e ato'mityasyānantarameveti | amādeśa evādḍādeśasyāpavādo
bhaviṣyati, tataśca na iti vaktavyaṃ na bhavatīti bhāvaḥ || 
eyuṣmadasmadbhyāṃ ṅso'ś || 7 - 1 - 27 || 
e śitkaraṇaṃ sarvādeśārthamiti | anyathā ādeḥ parasya ityādeḥ syāt
| nanu cākārasyākāravacane prayojanābhāvādādyanusaṃhāre bādhite
alontyasya iti makārasyākāre sati ato guṇe iti pararupeṇaiva
siddham ata āha - anyathā hīti | ādeśa iti vyapadeśa
ādeśavyapadeśaḥ, yasyādeśasya prayojanaṃ nāstīti manyase tasayaiva
syādityevaśabdārthaḥ | kiṃ punarādeśavyapadeśena prayojanaṃ yata
ādereva syāt tatrāha -tataśceti | hyarthe caḥ 
epaṭhitaḥ | tato hyādeśavyapadeśād yo'ci iti yatvaṃ na syāt,
yatvābhāvaḥ prayojanamādeśavyapadeśasya syādityarthaḥ | yo'ci tyitra
yuṣmadasmadoranādeśe iti vartate | nanu cānādeśo yā
vibhaktirityevaṃ tatra vijñāsyate, na hi tadādividhirasti yata
anādeśādāviti vijñāyeta tataśca satyaṣyādeśāditve
vibhakteranādeśatvātsyādeva yatvamiti
vyarthamevākārasyākāravidhānam evaṃ manyate - sarve sarvapadādeśāḥ
iti nyāyenādivikāradvāreṇa vibhākterevādeśo vidhīyata iti
vibhaktirevādeśa iti | sarve sarvapadādeśāḥ ityatra na padaśabdena
suptiṅntamucyate, kiṃ tarhi padyate gamyate'nenārthaṃ iti padam,
tataśca pacatvityatra yathā tiśabdasya tuśabdo bhavati, tadvadatrāpi
ṅso'śeva vidhīyata iti bhavatyevādeśātvaṃ vibhakteḥ || 
eṇeó prathamayoram || 7 - 1 - 29 || 
e ṇeó ityāvibhaktiko'yaṃ nirdeśa iti | prathamayoriti
prathamādvitīyayorgrahaṇam iti vakṣyati, tadatra samāse sati
bahuvacanaprasaṅga iti bhāvaḥ | prādhānayalakṣaṇasya
prathamārthasyehāsambhāvatsanniveśaviśeṣāpekṣayā prathamasya grahaṇamiti
tāvanniścitam | tiṅprathamayostu yusmādasmadbhyāmasambhava eva,
tatra pratyayayorgrahaṇam, vibhaktyorveti saṃśayaḥ | yadi
strīliṅganirddeśastato vibhaktyorgrahaṇam, puṃlliṅganirdeśe
tu pratyayayoḥ | tatra nirvayamāha - prathamayośca vibhāktyoriti |
etadeva spaṣṭayati - prathamādvitīyoriti | kathaṃ kunaḥ prathamāśabdena
dvitīyocyate, sāhacaryāta | nanu sakṛtprayuktaḥ śabdo mukhyavṛttirvā
bhavatu, jaghanyavṛttirvā, na panarubhayavṛttiḥ satyam
prathamādvitīyāsamudāye jaghanyavṛttirevāyamudbhatāvayavabhedaśca
samudāya iti dvivacanam | kathaṃ punarjñāyate - vibhaktyorgrahaṇamiti
dvitīyāyāṃ ca ityātvavidhānāt | taddhyadeśārthamucyate, anādeśe
yuṣmadasmadoranādeśe ityeva siddhatvāt | yadi cātra
vibhaktyorgrahaṇaṃ syāt, evamasyādeśārthatopapadyate | nanu ca yo'ci
iti yatvabādhanārthaṃ tatsyāt yadyetābatprayojanaṃ syāt, yatvamevāyaṃ
viśiṣya brūyāt - yo'cyāpīti | ābiti pratyāhāraḥ anāpyakaḥ iti
vat | yatastu dvitīyāyāmātvaṃ śāsti, tato jñāyate -
vibhaktyoriha grahaṇamiti || 
eśaso na || 7 - 1 - 29 || 
e netyavibhaktiko nirddeśaḥ, tathā ca pūrvasūtreṇa prāptasyāyamamaḥ
pratiṣedha iti māṣye śaṅkitam - kaḥ punaḥ pratiṣedhe sati doṣaḥ,
yāvatā'mi pratiṣiddhe yo'ci iti yatve ca dvitīyāyāṃ ityātve kṛte
