prathamayoḥ pūrvasyarṇadīrghatve kṛte tasmācchaso naḥ puṃsi iti natve
ca yuṣmāniti siddhyatyeva satyaṃ puṃsi siddhyati
strīnapuṃsakayostu na siddhyati, tadidaṃ darśitam - yuṣmān
asmān brāhmaṇīrityādi | 
e aliṅge vā yuṣmāsmadī iti | liṅgānuśāsane tathā pāṭhāt |
udāharaṇe tu ādeḥ parasya ityakārasya nakāre sakārasya
saṃyogāntalopaḥ || 
ebhyaso bhyam || 7 - 1 - 30 || 
e etvaṃ prāpnotīti | supi ca iti dīrghasyāpyupalakṣaṇametat |
aṅgavṛta ityādi | asyārthaḥ pūrvameva vyākhyātaḥ | 
e kecitpunarityādi | yeṣāṃ śeṣelopo'ntyasya lopaḥ teṣām
ato guṇe pararupatvamekādeśaḥ, svaraśca | etvanivṛtvārthamiti |
atrāpi dīrghasyāpyupalakṣaṇam, etvanivṛtyā
cākāroccāraṇasyārthavatvātsavarṇadīrghatvaṃ teṣāṃ na 
ebhavati | yeṣāṃ tviti | antyalopapakṣe matabhedaḥ - bhayamādeśaḥ,
abhyamādeśa iti | ṭilopapakṣe tvaṣaśyamabhyamādeśaḥ, anyathā rupāsiddhe
| nanvevaṃ svare doṣaḥ, katham anudātasya ca yatrodātalopaḥ ityatra
karṣātvato ghañonta udātaḥ ityantodātagrahaṇamanuvartate, tataśca
bhyamo'ntodātatvaṃ prāpnoti atyata āha - udāttnivṛttisvaraśceti
| na tatrāntagrahaṇamanuvartate, uccāraṇakrame pratyāsatyā
cāderevodātatvaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ || 
esāma ākam || 7 - 1 - 33 || 
e sāmiti ṣaṣṭhībahuvacanamāgatasuṭkaṃ gṛhyata iti |
aṅgasaṃjñānimitasyānyasyāsambhavāt | 
e atha kimarthamāgatasuṭko gṛhyata iti | yadyapi
ṣaṣṭhībahuvacanamāgatasuṭkaṃ gṛhyata iti prakṛtam, iha tu
pratyopekṣayā puṃlliṅganirddeśaḥ | napuṃsakaliṅgameva vā
paṭhitavyam | atheti na prayojanapradhānaḥ praśnaḥ, kiṃ tarhi
yuṣmadasmadbhyāṃ parasyaivaṃvidhasyāsambhavapradhānaḥ | ata evāha - na
hyādeśavidhānakāle suḍvidyata iti | suḍvidhau 
eājjaserasuk ityata ādityanuvartate, akārāntatvaṃ ca
yuṣmadasmadoḥ śeṣe lopaḥ ityantyasya lope bhavati, kaśca śeṣaḥ
ādeśaḥ | anādeśe yatvātvayorvidhānāt | ādeśatvaṃ cākamādeśe
sati | na ca tyadādyatvenākārāntatvam tyadādyatvaṃ prati
dviparyantāstyadādayaḥ iti smaraṇāt | tasmādādeśavidhānakāle
suṇnavidyate | utaravādī tu - ādeśavidhānakāle'sata eva suṭa
upādānam, athāpi tasyopādāne prayojanamastītyāha - tasyaiva
tviti | yadyasuṭko gṛhyate, tataḥ pūrvoktena nyāyena paścādbhavataḥ
suṭaḥ kena nivṛttiḥ syāt sthāninyantarbhūtatvāditi | tena
sahasthānitvenopādānasāmarthyāditi bhāvaḥ | etacca pākṣikaṃ
prayojanam | katarasminpakṣe yadā śeṣelopo'ntyalopastadā, yadā
tu ṭilopastadā paścādapi suṭaḥ prasaṅgābhāvānnaitatprayojanam | 
e dīrghoccārataṇamityādi | anyathāto guṇe pararupatvaṃ syāt |
nanvakāroccāraṇasāmarthyānna bhaviṣyati, anyathā'kameva vidadhyāt ata
āha - akami tviti | 
eāta au ṇalaḥ || 7 - 1 - 34 || 
e papāvityādau pā - a iti sthite yugapat trīṇi kāryaṇi
prāpnuvanti dvirvacanam, savarṇadīrghatvamekādeśaḥ, autvamiti, tatra
yena krameṇaitāni kartavyāni, taddarśayati - atreti | litsvaraṃ tu
nopanyasyāti, sarvathāntodātatvasiddheḥ | uktakrame hetumāha -
ekādeśāditi | yadi pūrvamekādeśaḥ syāvdyapavargābhāvādautvaṃ na
syādityanavakāśaṃ tat | paratvādekādeśa iti | atra vṛddhirekādeśaḥ,
tasya sthānivadbhāvād dvirvacanam, sthānivadbhāvastu
dvirvacane'ci iti | tatra hyacīti na sthānivadbhāvasya
nimitanirddeśaḥ kiṃ tarhi ajādeśasya - dvirvacananimite'ci
yo'jādeśa iti | tena sampratyacparatvābhāve'pi sthānivadbhāvo
bhavatyeva | okāraukārayorlāghave
viśeṣābhāvātprayogasamavāyyaukāra eva vihitaḥ | apara āha -
āṅpraśliṣṭākāra okāraḥ, tasyoccāraṇe prayatnalāghavaṃ bhavati
viśliṣṭākāra aukārastasyoccāraṇe prayatnagauravaṃ bhavati,
tadvidhānaṃ daridrātyarthamdadaridrau, atra daridrāterārddhadhātuke lopo
vaktavyaḥ ityākāralope'pyaukārasya śravaṇam bhavati | yadyapi siddhaśca
pratyayavidhau iti vacanālliṭi vivakṣita evākāra lope
satyautvasyāprasaṅgaḥ, yadyapi ca sāsyanekājgrahaṇaṃ culumpādyartham
ityāmi sati ṇala evāsambhavaḥ, tathāpyautvavidhānasāmarthyād
dvayamapyetanna bhavati || 
etuhyaestātaṅaśiṣyanyatarasyām || 7 - 1 - 35 || 
e jīvatātvamiti | atra sthānivadbhāvena tātaṅe higrahaṇena
grahaṇād ato heḥ iti luk prāpnoti naiṣa doṣaḥ hujhalbhyo
herdhiḥ, ityanuvartamāne punaḥ ato heḥ iti higrahaṇam - hireva
yo histasya yathā syāt, sthānivadbhāvena yo histasya
mābhūdityevamartham | 
e ṅtkiraṇamityādi | yadyapi sarvādeśatāyāḥ
prāgguṇavṛddhipratiṣedhārthatvamaniścatam, tathāpi sarvādeśatve'pi
ṅtvisya prayojanaṃ tātaṅ simbhavati, anaṅadiṣu tu naiva
sarvādeśatve prayojanaṃ sambhavatīti teṣvananyārthaṅtveṣu iṅcci
ityetat sahasā pravartate, tātaṅ tu priyojanāntarasambhāvanayā
kiyānapi vilambo bhavati | tenāsminviṣaye
utsargāpavādayostulyakālā pravṛttirityapavādamapi ṅcci
ityetadvādhitvā anekālśitsarvasya ityetadeva paratvātpravartata iti
bhāvaḥ | etacca ṅcci ityatra samyagupapāditam | tatra brūtādityādau
guṇapratiṣedhaḥ, mṛṣṭādityatra vṛddhipratiṣedhaḥ | ṅtvāccāsyeiti |
nanu ca ṅitkāryaṃ bhavatu, sthānivadbhāvaprāptapitvātpitkāryamapi,
ko virodhaḥ ata āha - ṅcci pinna bhavatīti | vacanamidam
sārvadhātukamapit ityatra yogavibhāgena kalpitam | bruva īḍiti |
upalakṣaṇametat, tṛṇḍhādbhavān ityatra tṛṇaha im na bhavatīti | 
e tātaṅ iṅtvimityādi ślokadvayaṃ kvacitpaṭha|lte | tātaiṅ
vyavasthitaṃ ṅtviṃ saṃkamakṛtsyāt, saṃkramo nāma -
guṇavṛddhipratiṣedhaḥ, arhārthe liṅ,
guṇavṛddhipratiṣedhakṛddhavitumarhati | antyavidhiścet,
antyavidhihetutvādantyavidhirṅtvim | karaṇasādhano vā
vidhiśabdaḥ antyasya yathā syādityevamarthaṃ cet ṅtvimityarthaḥ |
nirākaroti - tacca tathā na | caśabdo'vadhāraṇe pratiṣedhena
sambadhyate, tat ṅtviṃ tathā sati naiva kartavyam | eruḥ
ityasyānantaram tuhyaestādāśiṣi iti vaktavyam, erurityeva, evaṃ
siddhe ṅtkiraṇaṃ guṇavṛddhipratiṣedhārthamiti niścīyate | na ca
sarvādeśatāmantareṇa tat tatpratiṣedhārthatvaṃ ṅtvisyopapadyata iti 
esarvādeśastātaṅ bhavati | nanu cāntyavidhiścāstu avayave kṛtaṃ
liṅgam iti nyāyena guṇavṛddhipratiṣedhārthaścāstu
ṅtkiraṇasāmarthyādityāśaṅkya parihārāntaramāha - heradhikāra iti
| ato heḥ ityatra lopavidhau hujhalbhyo herdhiḥ ityato
herityadhikāre satyeva tayo'yaṃ herityadhikārastaṃ jñāpakamāha
sūtrakāraḥ, tasya hyaetataprayojanam -sa hireva yo histasya yathā
stāt, sthānivadbhāvena yo histasya mā bhūditi | tacca
sarvādeśatve satyupapadyate | 
e nanu ca hireva yo histasya yathā syādvikṛto yo histasya mā
bhūdityantyā deśatve'pi tātaṅe herityadhikāra upapadyata
ityādaśaṅkya sākṣātparihāramāha - tātaṅe ṅtvisāmarthyāditi |
ṅtvisāmarthyātkilāyamāntyavidhiḥ syāt, tacca sāmarthyaṃ nāsti,
sarvādeśatve'pi prayojanasambhavāt | tataśca pūrvoktayā rītyā
vipratiṣedhātsarvādeśa eva tātaṅ bhavati | anaṅ sau
tityādāvanaṅadīnāṃ naivaṃ ṅtvisāmarthyābhāvaḥ, tena
te'ntyavikāradā jātāḥ || 
evideḥ śaturvasuḥ || 7 - 1 - 36 || 
e vida jñāna iti | satāvicāraṇārthayorātmanepaditvena
śaturasambhavaḥ, lābhārthasya tūbhayapaditvena śatuḥ sambhave'pi
tudāditvādvikaraṇena vyavadhānamiti jñānārthasyaiva lugvikaraṇasya
parasmaipadino grahaṇamiti bhāvaḥ | 
e kvasorapi sāmānyagrahaṇārthamiti | anyathā vasaḥ samprasāraṇam
ityucyamāne niranubandhakatvādasyaiva grahaṇaṃ syāt | nanu ca
kriyamāṇe'pyukārānubandhe ekānubandhakatvādasyaiva grahaṇaṃ syāt
tatrāha - ekānubandhakagrahaṇa iti | 
esamāse'navpūrve ktvo lyap || 7 - 1 - 37 || 
e pūrvaśabdo'vayavacanaḥ,, anañpūrvo'vayavo yatra samāse
so'nañpūrvaḥ | prakṛtyeti | samānakartukayoḥ pūrvakāle iti
ktvā, kugātiprādayaḥ iti samāsaḥ, lyapi sati hrasvasya tuk |
pārśvataḥkṛtyeti | ādyāditvātsaptamyantātasiḥ, svāṅge taspratyaye
kṛbhvoḥ iti ktvā, tṛtīyāprabhṛtīnyanyatarasyām ktvā ca iti
samāsaḥ | nānākṛtya, dvidhākṛtyeti | nādhārthapratyayecvyarthe iti
ktvā, pūrvavatsamāsaḥ | 
e akṛtvā, ahṛtveti | hṛtvetyetatpratyadāraṇam, atra kṛtvāśabdo
nañsadṛśaḥ pūrvo'sti, samudāyastu samāso na bhavati |
paramakṛtveti | sanmahan ityādinā samāsaḥ, tumarthādhikārādbhāve
ktvā pratyayaḥ | pāramyamapi kriyāyā eva viśeṣaṇamiti
samānādhikaraṇyam | 
e kathaṃ punaridaṃ pratyudārahaṇam, yāvatā bhavatyevāyamanañpūrvaḥ
samāsaḥ ityata āha- janañiti hīti anañ iti puryudāso'yam, tatra
nañivayuktanyāyena nañsadṛśamavyayaṃ parigṛhyate, tena nañ anavyayaṃ
ca paramaśabdākimanañ na bhavati, tāmedādanavyayatvācca |
snātvākalaka ityādiṣviti | ādiśabdena pītvāsthiraka
ityevamādergrahathaṇam, yatrotarapade kriyā nopādīyate
tatrādhyāhṛtakriyāpakṣeḥ ktvāpratyayaḥ | sāpekṣatve'pi
nipātanātsamāsaḥ | nipātanāllyabādeśo na bhavatīti | na
prākaraṇikaḥ samāsa eva tatra nipātyate, kiṃ tarhi yasya lakṣaṇaṃ nāsti
tatsarvamiti bhāvaḥ | 
e nirdhāraṇe saptamīti | jātāvekavacanam, vacanavyatyo vā | samāsa
eva nirdhāryata iti | nirdhāraṇasya tulyajātīyāpekṣatvāt | kathaṃ
punaḥ samāsaḥ ktvānto bhavati, yāvatā pratyayagrahaṇe yasmātsa
vihitastadādestadantasya grahaṇ, na ca samāsāt ktvā vihitaḥ atha
kṛdgrahaṇae gatikārakapūrvasyāpi grahaṇātsamāsasya ktvāntā
evamapi prakṛtya, pārśvataḥkṛtyetyādāveva syāt,
uccaikṛtyetyevamādau tu na syāt, agatitvādakārakatvācca
ityāśaṅkyāha - sa ceti | tatra nirddiśyamānasyādeśā bhavanti iti
ktvāmātrasyaiva lyabbhavati | nanu pratyayaviṣaye pūrveṇa
paribhāṣādvayena tadantavidhivyavasthā, na tu yena vidhistadantasya
ityanena tatrāha - tathā ceti | kathaṃ punaretajjñāpakam ityāha -
gatikārakapūrvasya tviti | kathaṃ nāsti prasaṅgaḥ ityāha - nañna
gatiriti | ado jagdhirlyapti kiti ityatra yaduktam - jagdhau
siddhamantaraṅgatvāt ityādi, tatsmārayati - pradhāya,
prasthāyatyevamādiṣviti | 
e ke punarantaraṅgā vidhayaḥ hitvadatvātvetvetvadīrghatvaśūḍiṭaḥ |
hitvam dadhāterhiḥ, hitvā, pradhāya| datvam - do daddhoḥ,
datvā, pradāya | ātvam - jana sanakhanāṃ sanjhaloḥ khātvā, prakhāya,
prakhanya| itvam - 
edyatisyatimāsthāmiti kiti, sthitvā, prasthāya | ītvam -
ghumāsthāgāpājahātisāṃ hali pītvā, prapāya| dīrghatvam -
anunāsikasya kvijhaloḥ kṅiti, śāntvā, praśamya | śū - cchavoḥ
śūḍanunāsike ca pṛṣṭvā, āpṛcchaya | uṭha - dyauutvā | iṭ - udito
vā, devitvā, pradīvya, atreṭi sati na ktvā seṭ iti
kitvapratiṣedhād guṇaḥ syāt | 
e pūrvagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, anañ ityevocyamāne bahuvrīhiḥ syāt -
avidyamāno nañ yasminnasāvanañiti, tathā ca straiṇīkṛtyetyatrāpi
pratiṣedhaḥ syāt | pūrvagrahaṇe tu sati, tasya
niyatadeśāvayavavacanatvānnāyaṃ doṣaḥ | litkaraṇaṃ pracikīrṣyetyatra
pratyayātpūrvasya svarārtham | prakṛtyetyādau tu dhātusvareṇeva
siddham | pitkaraṇaṃ tugartham || 
ektvāpi cchandasi || 7 - 1 - 38 || 
e apiśabdāllyabapīti | sa ca samāse'samāse ca bhavati, aprāptiviṣaye
lyapaḥ prāpaṇārthatvādapiśabdasya, anyathā vā cchandasi ityeva vācyaṃ
syāt, tathā ca chandovidhānamunavadadhānāḥ kalpasūtrakārā api
prayuñjate - ājyenākṣiṇī ajyetyādi || 
esupāṃ sulukpūrvasavarṇāccheyāḍāḍa|layājālaḥ || 7 - 1 - 39 || 
e suśabda ādeśa ucyamāne anye supo na prāpnuvanti, tasmāt
sugrahaṇamapanīya suḍgrahaṇaṃ kartavyamityāha - supāṃ supa iti |
tiṅaṃ tiṅ iti | etacca vyātyayo bahulam iti siddham | supāṃ
supa ityayamapi tasyaiva prapañcaḥ | takṣṇvantīti prāpta tu yuktaḥ pāṭhaḥ
| 
e ādre carmanniti | nanu ca pūrvasavarṇenāpyetatsiddham, katham
carman - i iti sthite ikārasya pūrvasavarṇo nakāraḥ, tatra parataḥ
svādiṣu iti padasaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ pūrvasya nakārasya lopaḥ,
tatrāyamapyarthaḥ - na ṅasimbuddhyoḥ ityatra ṅgrihaṇaṃ na kartavyaṃ
bhavati, aprātipadikatvādeva vibhaktinakārasya lopāprasaṅgāt,
pūrvasya tu nakārasyeṣṭa eva lopaḥ naitadasti atra hi pūrvasavarṇo
bhavannāntaryato niranunāsikasya niranunāsiko dakāra eva syāt |
astu, saṃyogāntalopo bhaviṣyati nātra saṃyogāntalopaḥ
prāpnoti, svādiṣu iti padasaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ pūrvanakārasya lope
sati asaṃyogāntatvāt | nalopo hi saṃyogāntalope siddhaḥ | evaṃ
tarhi na ṅasimbuddhyoḥ ityatra ṅgrihaṇaṃ kariṣyate, tatra nalopābhāve
saṃyogāntalopaḥ tadevamasyānyathāsiddhatvādudāharaṇāntaramāha -
havirddhāne yatsunvantīti | yat - i iti sthite atra yadi pūrvasavarṇo
dakāraḥ syātyadādyatve sati sthānivadbhāvātsminbhāvaḥ prāpnoti |
tasmādatra lugeva kartavyaḥ | anekālṣu ca bhyāmādiṣu antyasya
pūrvasavarṇe pūrvabhāgya śravaṇāprasaṅgaḥ, tasmātatrāpi lugeva kartavyaḥ
| 
e dhītītyādi | dhīti -mati - suṣṭuatiśabdebhyastṛtīyekavacanasya
pūrvasavarṇa ikāraḥ, kavarṇadīrghatvam | 
e na tādū brāhmaṇāditi | tacchabdād brāhmaṇaśabdācca śas,
tasyādādeśaḥ, na vibhaktau tusmāḥ iti itsaṃjñāpratiṣedhaḥ | yā deva
vipnatāt tvā mahāntam iti bahvacāḥ | yūyaṃ vayamiti prāpta iti |
pramādapāṭho'yam, tathā hi - na yuṣme bājabandhavaḥ ityatra mantre
ṛkṣāśvamedhanāmno rājñordānaṃ stūyate, vyatyayena
dvayorbahuvacanam, bājamityannanāma, annapradānena sarveṣāṃ
bandhavasteṣāṃ sambodhanaṃ he bājabandhavaḥ | yuṣmāa yuṣamāsu
adhītyasyānena sambandhaḥ, saca saptamyarthātanuvādī | ninitsuśca
nindanaśīlo'pi martyau yuṣmāsu avadyaṃ na dhārayati nāvadhārayati,
avadyābhāvādityarthaḥ | asme indrābṛhaspatī thaityatrāpi rayiṃ dhatamiti
kriyā, dadhātiśca dānārthaḥ | tasmādyauṣmāsu asmaḥyamiti yuktaḥ pāṭhaḥ |
yūyādeśa ityādyapi na paṭhitavyam | 
e anuṣṭameti prāpta iti | adhrigupraiṣai tu tā
anuṣṭa|levyāvayatāditi anupūrvātiṣṭhateḥ ātaścopasarge ityaṅ,
anuṣṭhānamanuṣṭhā, tayā'nuṣṭha|la | 
e prabāhaveti | dherṅiti iti guṇaḥ | nanu iṅtve
vidyādvarṇanirddeśamātraṃ varṇe yatsyātacca vidyātadādau ityuktam
satyam ṅtkiraṇasāmarthyātu guṇaḥ | prabahuneti prāpta iti |
bāhuneti tu yuktaḥ pāṭhaḥ praśabdasyākhyātena sambandhanāt |
ayāco'kāraḥ supi ca iti dīrghanivṛtyarthaḥ || 
eamo maś || 7 - 1 - 40 || 
e amiti mibādeśo gṛhyata iti | dvitīyaikavacanasya grahaṇaṃ na bhavati
cchandasi dṛṣṭānuvadhānādvakṣyamāṇeṣu bāhulyena tiṅa nirddeśāt |
vadhīmiti | hanterluṅ, luṅ ci iti vadhādeśaḥ, cleḥ sic, iṭ,
mipo'mbhāvaḥ, tasya maś - akāra uccāraṇārthaḥ, astisico'pṛkte
itīṭ, iṭa īṭi iti sico lopaḥ, savarṇadīrghatvam | 
e śitkaraṇaṃ sarvādeśārthamiti | anyathā hi alo'ntyasya iti makāratya
makāravacane prayojanābhāvātsarvādeśo bhaviṣyati, ata āha -
makārasyāpīti | yathā mo rāji samaḥ kau ityatreti bhāvaḥ |
pañcamīnirddeśābhāvātu ādeḥ parasya ityetanna bhavati | athocyate -
dvimakārako'yaṃ nirddeśaḥ kariṣyate, tatraikasya
saṃyogāntalope'pi vadhīmityādi siddhamiti evamapi lāghave nāsti
viśeṣaḥ | kiñcasaṃyogāntalopasyāsiddhatvādapṛktalakṣaṇa īṭ eva
syāt | evaṃ tarhi yakārādiḥ kariṣyate, kim yakāro na śrūyate,
bali luptanirddiṣṭo yakāraḥ nātra kiñcit prama, ṇamasti,
tasmācchitkaraṇam || 
elopasta ātmanepadeṣu || 7 - 1 - 41 || 
e aduhraeti | durerlaṅ ātmanepadeṣvanataḥ iti jhasyādādeśaḥ, bahulaṃ
cchandasi iti ruṭ, takārasya lope dvayorakārayoḥ ato guṇe
pararupatvam | śaye iti | śete ityatra talope kṛte ayādeśaḥ |
duhāmiti | loṭ, ṭeretvam, āmetaḥ, talopaḥ | 
e apītyadhikārāditi | evaṃ ca ātmanepadeṣu iti vacanaṃ tasyaiva
prapañcaḥ || 
etasya tāt || 7 - 1 - 44 || 
e loṇmadhyamapuruṣabahuvacanasyeti | prathamapuruṣaikavacanasya tu grahaṇaṃ
na bhavati, cchandasi dṛṣṭānuvidhānāt | pūrvotarābhyāṃ
bahuvacanābhyāṃ vā sāhacaryāt | kṛṇutāditi | kṛvi
hiṃsākaraṇayoḥ, dhinvakṛṇvyora ca ityupratyayaḥ, vakārasya cākaraḥ,
ato lopaḥ || 
etaptanaptanathanāśca || 7 - 1 - 45 || 
e śṛṇoteti | śruvaḥ śrṛ ca iti śnupratyayaḥ śrṛbhāvaśca, pitve sati
ṅtvābhāvād guṇiḥ | dadhātaneti | atrāpi pitvābhāvāt
śnābhyastayoḥ ityākāralopābhāvaḥ | jujuṣṭaneti | vyatyayena
parasmaipadam, tudāditvācchaḥ, tasya bahulaṃ cchansi iti śnuḥ
,dvirvajanam | juṣeranudātetvāt juṣadhvamiti prāpta iti tu yuktaḥ
pāṭhaḥ | yadicchateti prāpta iti | bahvacāstu - kovasto maruto
yatiṣṭana ityasyāmṛci yatiṣṭhaneti paṭhanti | yatisthaneti padakāle,
tatrāste rupam || 
eidanto masi || 7 - 1 - 46 || 
e masītyavibhaktiko nirddeśaḥ | ikāra uccāraṇārthaḥ |
antaśabdo'vayavavacanaḥ - it anto yasya sa idantaḥ |
taparakaraṇamasandehārtham, yantaḥ ityucyamāne sandehaḥ syāt - kiṃ
yakāranta īdantaḥ idanto veti tatra yadi sakāropamarddena
ikārāntamabhipretaṃ syāt, masa ita ityeva vācyaṃ syāt |
tasmādavasthita thaeva sakāra ikāha upasṛjyate | antagrahaṇācca
tadgrahaṇena gṛhyate, tataśca ṭitvāderāgamaliṅgasyābhāve'pi
arthādāgamo'yaṃ sampadyate | tadidamuktam - masaḥ sakārāntasyetyādi |
evaṃ ca masa ik iti vaktavyam pratyāhārasandehaprasaṅgātathā noktam
|| 
ektvā yak || 7 - 1 - 47 || 
e datvāyeti | do daddhoḥ | saubhāgyamasyai datvāya, datvāyāsmabhyaṃ
draviṇeha bhadraḥ - ityādimantragatamudāharaṇam | datvāya savitā
dhiyamiti kvacit, paṭha|lte, tatra taitirīyakāstatvāyeti paṭhanti | 
e ktvāpi cchandasītyādi | evaṃ hi punaḥ ktvāgrahaṇaṃ na kartavyaṃ bhavati
|| 
eājjaserasuk || 7 - 1 - 50 || 
e jaseḥ iti pūrvācāryānurodhena nirddeśaḥ | brāhmaṇāsa iti |
asuki kṛte jasaḥ sakārasya śravaṇam, asukaḥ sakārasya visarjanīyaḥ | 
e yepūrvāsa ityādi | codyam - uparāsa iti |
aparaśabdasyāderukāraśchāndasaḥ | yadi punarayaṃ pūrvāntaḥ kriyate -
asya jasyasuk iti, naivaṃ śakyam, ato guṇe pararupatvaṃ hi syāt |
akāroccāraṇaṃ tu - utarasūtre 
edadhyasyatītyādau śravaṇārtha syāt | sakṛdgatāvityādi parihāraḥ
| yadyapyetsarvanāmasaṃjñāyā pūrvādiṣu jasi vikalpanādeva siddham,
ubhayāso jātavedaḥsyāma ityatra tu śībhāvaprasaṅgaḥ, atra hi
prathamacarama iti vakalpaṃ bādhitvā sarvādiṣu pāṭhānnityā saṃjñā
bhavati, sā hyantaraṅgā || 
eaśvakṣīravṛṣalavaṇānāmatmaprītau kyaci || 7 - 1 - 51 || 
e aśvasyatīti | asuko'kāraḥ pūrvatra brāhmaṇāsa ityādau caritārtha iti
ato guṇe iti pararupatvaṃ bhavati, naḥ kye iti
niyamādapadāntokāraḥ | maithunecchāyāmiti | aśvaviṣayecchā yadā
maithunārthā, tadevāsugbhavati | maithunecchāparatvācca
prayogasyāśvavṛṣopādānamatantramiti manuṣyādiviṣaye'pi prayujyate
iti - rāmo vṛṣasvantīmiti | tṛṣṇātireka iti | abhyavajihīrṣā -
atirekaḥ, kṣīralavaṇaviṣaya icchātireko yadābhyavahārārtho na tu
homādyarthestadetyarthaḥ | sarvaprātipadikebhya iti | tādarthye eṣā
caturthī sarvaprātipadikārtham, sarveṣāṃ pratipadikānāmityarthaḥ | 
eāmi sarvanāmnaḥ suṭ || 7 - 1 - 52 || 
e ime bahava āmaḥ - ṅs - os - ām, ṇeórāmnadyāmnībhyaḥ,
kimetiṅvyayadhādāmvadravyaprakarṣe, kāspratyayādāmamantre liṭi teṣu
kasyedamāmo grahaṇam ityāha - āmiti ṣaṣṭhībahuvacanaṃ gṛhyata iti |
tasya hi paratvāditi | 
e suṭo nuṭaśca ṣaṣṭhībahuvacanamavakāśaḥ, āṭprabhṛtīnāṃ
caturthyekavacanādi, ṇeórāma ubhayaprasaṅge paratvādāḍādayo
bhavanti, teṣu kṛteṣu sakṛdgatinyāyāśrayaṇāt suṭnuṭau na
bhavataḥ | yaśca ghādāmuriti | kimetiṅvyayaghādāmu ityeva |
castvarthe, tureva vā paṭhitavyaḥ | ām ca liṭīti | liṭi parato ya
ām kāspratyayāt iti vihita ityarthaḥ | na tau sarvanāmnaḥ parau sta
iti | tenātra tāvatayoragrahaṇam, yasya cātra grahaṇaṃ
tasyaivotaratrāpyadhikāra iti nuḍvidhāvapi tayoragrahaṇamiti
bhāvaḥ | ācārakvibantānāṃ sarvādīnāṃ
sarvārthatvābhāvātsarvanāmasaṃjñābhāvātsarvanāmno liṭa|lamo'sambhavaḥ |
yastu manyate - iha sāmānyagrahaṇe sati yathāsambhavaṃ prakaraṇe
kāryapratipatiḥ, tataśca tayorapi nuṭprasaṅga iti, taṃ prati
parihārāntaramāha - sānubandhakāviti veti | sāmānyagrahaṇe tu
sati pacatitarāmityatra yasyetilopaṃ bādhitvā paratvānnuṭ syāt |
kārayām, cikīṣīmityatra tu nityatvād ayāmanta ityayādeśe, ato
lope ca kṛte hrasvābhāvānnāsti nuṭaḥ prasaṅgaḥ | 
e utarārthamiti | trestrayaḥ ityāmi parato yathā stāta | iha tviti |
pañcamīnirdeśastu āt it|yanuvṛtena sāmānādhikaraṇyādavasīyate,
evaṃ ca kṛtvā hali sarveṣām iti nirdeśopapatiḥ || 
etrastrayaḥ || 7 - 1 - 53|| 
e treriti ṣaṣṭhī, na pañcamī, ṇijāṃ trayāṇām iti nirdeśāt || 
ehrasvanadyāpo nuṭ || 7 - 1 - 54 || 
e hrasvanadyāpa iti pañcamī, nāmi iti liṅgena anyathā'ṅganimitasya
nāmo na hyasti sambhavaḥ || 
eṣaṭcaturbhyaśca || 7 - 1 - 55 || 
e nuṭi kṛte nopadhāyāḥ iti dīrghaḥ | nalopaḥ prātipadikāntasya |
ṣaṇṇamiti | jhalāṃ jaśo'nte - iti ṣakārasya ḍakāraḥ,
yaro'nunāsike iti ḍakārasya ṇakāraḥ, ṣṭuatvam | 
e atha ṣṇāntāḥ ṣaṭ iti rephasca prakṣepaṇena rephāntāyā kāpi
saṃkyāyā ṣaṭasaṃjñā kasmānna vihitā, evaṃ hyatra caturgrahathaṇaṃ na kartavyaṃ
bhavati, tathā ṣaṭtricarbhyo halādiḥ tyitrāpi ityata āha -
rephāntāyā iti | bahuvacananirdeśāditi | śabdaprādhānye
hītaretarayoge dvivacanena bhāvyam, samāhāradvandve tvekavacanena
bhāvyam, arthaprādhānye tu ṣaṭsaṃjñakā eva pratyekaṃ
bahvarthāścatuḥśabdaścetyupapadyate bahuvacanam | atrāmaḥ paratvaṃ
śabdadvārakam | paramaṣaṇṇāmiti | atrāpi baḍarthaprādhānyātata eva para
ām bhavati | bahuvrīhau tvanyapadārthasya prādhanyānna ṣaḍarthāpekṣaṃ
paratvamiti na bhavati | 
e priyapañcjāmiti | allope kṛte cutvam - ñakāraḥ || 
eśrīgrāmaṇyoścchandasi || 7 - 1 - 56 || 
e nityārtha vacanamiti | anyathā bhāṣāyāmiva vikalpaḥ syāt, cchandasi
nuḍeva ced dṛśyate, tasya ca lakṣaṇamasti, ko'yaṃ vikalpaprasaṅga
iti cintyametat | 
e sūtāśca te grāmaṇyaśceti | nedaṃ karmadhārayasya vākyam, kiṃ tarhi
bahuvacanāntayoryadetaretarayoge dvandvastadā nuḍvidheḥ
prayojanam | yadaikavacanāntayoḥ samāhāradvandvaṃ kṛtvā ekaśeṣaḥ
kriyate tadā hrasvāntatvādeva nuṭ siddha iti na prayojanamiti
darśayati | evaṃ ca teśabdo na paṭhitavyaḥ | 
e atrāpi nuḍeva ced dṛśyate tasya ca nirvāho'sti,
itaretaretarayogadvandvo na kariṣyate, tadevamidaṃ sūtraṃ bhāṣye
pratyākhyātam || 
egoḥ pādānte || 7 - 1 - 57 || 
e cchandasi ityadhikāradṛkpādasyai grahaṇam, ślokapādasyetyāha -
ṛkpādānta iti || 
eidito num dhātoḥ || 7 - 1 - 58 || 
e kuḍi dāhe, huṅ siṅghāte | 
e aṅgādhikārān numayaṃ pratyaye parato bhavet | 
e kuṇḍetyādau tataśca ktinsyānnākāro gurorhalaḥ 
e ityāśaṅkyāha - ayamiti | atra pramāṇamāha - tathā hīti | kathaṃ
punaretajjñāpakam, yāvatā ikśtipau dhātunirddeśe vakyatavyau
iti ikpratyaye kṛte'ṅgasaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ numā bhavitavyamiti
lakṣaṇavaśādeva numanuṣaktayorgrahaṇaṃ kartavyam evaṃ manyate -
nāyamikā nirdeśaḥ, kiṃ tarhi āgantukenekāreṇa, tatrāprāpto
numiti | 
e nātra kiñcitpramāṇamastītyāśaṅkyāha - dhātugrahaṇaṃ ceti |
dhātutvamevāpekṣitaṃ na tvaṅgatvamityevamarthaṃ dhātugrahaṇam,
nānyatkiñcitprayojanamastīti bhāvaḥ | nanu ca bhetā,
abhaitsīdityatrādhātvostāsicasicoriditornumnivṛtyarthaṃ
dhātugrahaṇaṃ syāt ata āha - tāsisicoriti | nanu cāmaṃstetyādau
ātmanepadaṃ ṅtimapekṣya sijantasya aniditām iti lopa mā
bhūdityetatsicīditkāryaṃ syāt ityata āha - amaṃstetyādāviti |
yathā hanaḥ sic iti kitvavidhānamasya liṅgaṃ tathā tatraiva
pratipāditam | 
e tāsestarhīditkaraṇaṃ mantetyādau ātmanepadaikavacanasya ḍādeśe
kṛte ṭilope ca manat - ā iti sthite nakārasyopadhālope mā
bhūdityevamarthaṃ syādata āhamantetyatreti | nakāralopo na
bhavatītyanuṣaṅgaḥ | 
e jayādityastu - ābhīyamasiddhatvamanityamāśritya
tāseriditakaraṇamanunāsikalopapratiṣedhārthamityavocat | tanmate
dhātugrahaṇaṃ tāsinivṛtyarthaṃ kartavyamiti upadeśe numbhavati ityatra
yatnāntaramāstheyam | 
e iha bhidirprabhṛtiṣu ikārasya upadeśe'janunāsika kait
itītsaṃjñā, rephasyāpi halantayam iti, tataśceditvānnum prāpnoti
tatrāha - iritāmiti | iritāmira upasaṅkhyānam
ityaupasaṅkhyānikī samudāyasyetsaṃjñā, na pratyekaṃ sautrī,
tataścāniditvānnum na bhavatītyarthaḥ | 
e nanvevamapi svaritetvanibandhanamātmanepadaṃ na prāpnoti
bhidirprabhṛtiṣu, tasmātpratyekapakṣe parihāro vācyaḥ - iti matvā
pratyekapakṣe parihāramāha - avayavaśo'pīti | apara āha - idita iti
nāyaṃ bahuvrīhiḥ, kiṃ tarhi karmadhāraḥ tataśca varṇagrahaṇamidaṃ bhavati |
tatra tadantavidhinetsaṃjñakekārāntasya dhātornumiti | athedito
dhātovo nanamanuṣaktā eva kasmānna paṭhitāḥ, evaṃ hīdaṃ na kartavyaṃ
bhavati numgrahaṇaṃ tāvadutarārthaṃ kartavyam, iditāṃ ca
bhūyastvātapratyekaṃ nakroccāraṇādidameva sūtraṃ laghīyaḥ || 
eśe mucādīnām || 7 - 1 - 59 || 
e mucādayaḥ muclṛ mokṣaṇe ityārabhya tudādiṣvā
gaṇāntādveditavyāḥ | 
e ke punastṛphādaya iti | vyavasthāvācinyādiśabde
niranuṣaṅgāṇāmapi grahaṇaprasaṅgāditi praśnaḥ | prakāravācī
ādiśabdaḥ, prakāraśca sādṛścam, tacca nakārānuṣaktatayetyutaram |
yadi sānuṣāṅgaṇāṃ punarnum vidhīyate, eṣaṃ sati parasya
nakārasyānusvāraparasavarṇayoḥ kṛtayornakāramakārayoḥ
śravaṇaprasaṅgaḥ ityata āha - teṣāmiti | athāsya numo'pi lopaḥ
kasmānna bhavati tatrāha - ceti | vidhānasāmarthyāditi | ayaṃ ca
mucādiṣveva 
elopābhāvasya hetuḥ | tṛmphādiṣu tu paranakāralopasya ciṇo
lugnyāyenāsiddhatvādeva pūrvanakārasya lopābhāvaḥ siddhaḥ | atha
mucādiṣveva tṛmphādayaḥ kasmānna paṭhitāḥ ityata āha - ye tviti |
ayamabhiprāyaḥ - sānuṣāṅgāṇāṃ niranuṣaṅgāṇāṃ ca
tantreṇārthanirdeśaḥ | tatra yadi sarve mucādiṣu paṭha|leran,
niranuṣaṅgāṇāmapi numprasaṅgaḥ | sānuṣāṅgāṇāṃ niṣkṛṣya pāṭhe
dvirarthanirddeśena gauravaprasaṅga iti || 
emasjinaśorjhali || 7 - 1 - 60 || 
e ṭuamasjo śuddhau tṛc, ekācaḥ, itīṭpratiṣedhaḥ,
antyājjakārātpūrvo num, skoḥ saṃyogādyorante ca iti salopaḥ,
kutvam, anusvāraparasavarṇau | naṃṣṭeti | radhādibhyaśca
itīḍabhāvapakṣe num | majjanamiti | jakāre parataḥ sakārasya ścutve
ca prāpte jaśtvasyāsiddhatvāt ścutvam, śakārasya jaśtvam -
jakāraḥ | 
e masjerityādi | yadyantyādacaḥ paraḥ syātadā nasajānāṃ
samudāyasyaikā saṃyogasaṃjñeti sakārasyāsaṃyogāditvāllopo na
syāt | athāpi sajayoḥ pṛthaksaṃyogasaṃjñāmāśritya lopaḥ syād
evamapi tasya lopasyāsiddhatvānnakāra upadhā na bhavatīti tasya lopo
na syāt | tasmādantyājjakārātpūrvaḥ sajayormadhye numeṣitavyaḥ || 
eradhijabhoraci || 7 - 1 - 61 || 
e radha hiṃsāsaṃrādhyoḥ jabha jṛbhī gātravināme, ihāsya
numo'vakāśaḥ - randhanam, rarandhaturityādi, ata upadhāyāḥ
vṛddheravakāśaḥ - pācakaḥ, pāṭhakaḥ, randhakaityādāvubhayaprasaṅge
paratvādvaddhiḥ prāpnoti tatrāha - parāpi satīti | vṛddhistu numi
kṛte na prāpnoti, akārasyānupadhātvādityanityā | raddheti |
radhādibhyaśca iti pakṣe iḍabhāvaḥ jhapastathordho'dhaḥ iti takārasya
dhatvam | 
e iha jabheraci radheliṭi ca neṭi - iti sūtranyāsaḥ kartavyaḥ tathā tu
na kṛtamityeva || 
eneṭaḹiṭi radheḥ || 7 - 1 - 62 || 
e numi kṛte ityādi | nanu ceṭi satyajāditvānnumā bhavitavyam,
prāgeva ceṭaḥ kitvaṃ prāpnoti na ca aliṭi ityasya vaiyarthyam,
thalyarthavatvān evaṃ hi dhātorityanuvṛterupadeśa eva num bhavati |
acītyeṣā tu vipayasaptamī | 
e atheti | yeṣāṃ chāndasaḥ kvasusteṣāmeṣa vicāro nāsti, cchandasi
dṛṣṭānuvidhānāt | etvābhyāsalopayoḥ kṛtayoriti |
vasvekājādghasām ityatra kṛtadvirvacanānāmekācāṃ grahaṇādeva
muktam | tatra numāgama iti | acīti vacanāt | tasyetyādi | yadyapi
rarandhivetyādivat kvasāvapyātideśikaṃ kitvaṃ nāsti,
tathāpyaupadeśikaṃ kitvamāśritya nalopo bhavatītyarthaḥ | 
e athetyādi | evaṃ sati neṭaḹiṭi iti dvāvapi pratiṣedhau na vaktavyau
bhavata iti bhāvaḥ | viparītamāvadhāraṇaṃ sambhāvyeteti | evakāre tu
kriyamāṇe na lāghrave viśeṣaḥ || 
erabheraśabliṭoḥ || 7 - 1 - 63 || 
e rabha rābhasye, anudātet || 
elabheśca || 7 - 1 - 64 || 
e ḍulabhaṣ prāptau, anudātena | lambho vartata iti | upasargādeva
khalghañoḥ iti niyamasya vakṣyamāṇatvādapapāṭho'yam | khano gha ca iti
cakārād bhagaḥ padam itivat ghapratyaya ityeke | yogavibhāga
utarārtha iti | utarovidhirlabhereva yathā syādrabhermā bhūt | kiñca
- śibliṭoryathāsaṃkhyanirāsārthaśca || 
eāṅe yi || 7 - 1 - 65 || 
e atra dhātoḥ ityanuvṛterupadeśāvasthāyāmeva numā bhavitavyam,
tasmād yi iti viṣayasaptamītyāha - yakārādau pratyaye viṣaya iti |
prāgityādinā viṣayasaptamyāśrayaṇasya phalaṃ darśayati | tatretyādi |
rupe tu nāsti viśeṣaḥ, ṇyatpratyaye'pi vṛddhyā naiva bhavitavyam ,
nitye numi sati vihitanimitatvāt | yati
punarutarapadādyaudātatvaṃ syāditi | yato'nāvaḥ
ityutarapadādyaudātatvāt | ālabhya iti | yak | anuṣaṅgalopaḥ
kriyata iti | etena yaklyapau vyākhyātau | tena yi iti
sāmānyoktāvapi ṇyadevodāhṛta iti bhāvaḥ || 
eupātpraśaṃsāyām || 7 - 1 - 66 || 
e atra prāptireva dhātvarthaḥ | praśaṃśā tu gamyamānatayā viśeṣaṇam |
ato yasya prāptiryato vā prāptiḥ praśaṃsāheturbhavati
tatrodāharaṇam | viparyaye tu pratyudāharaṇam || 
eupasargāt khalghañoḥ || 7 - 1 - 67 || 
e siddhe satīti | labheśca ityanena | upasargādeveti | viparītastu
viyamo na bhavati - upasargātkhalghañoreveti gṛdhivañcyoḥ
halambhane iti nirddeśāt || 
ena sudurbhyā kevalābhyām || 7 - 1 - 68 || 
e kevalaśabdaḥ śabdopātādanyasya sajātīyasyābhāvamācaṣṭe | yathā hi
- 
e kevalābhyāmihaitābhyāṃ praveṣṭavyamitīrite | 
e anyasya puruṣasyaiva praveśaḥ pratiṣidhyate || 
e na śukādeḥ, tathehāpi parasparayutādhimau | 
e ekākinau vijātīyasahitau cāpi kevalau || 
e sudurlabham, sulabham, durlabham, atisulabhamityudāharaṇāni |
sulābhaḥ, durlābha iti | bhāve ghañ | karmaṇi 
etu khal bhavati | yadvā - suḥ kṣepe, yathā - suṣiktaṃ nāmeti |
dirnindāyām, yathā - durbrāhmaṇa iti | tena
kṛcchrākṛcchrārthatvābhāvātkhalabhāvaḥ | 
e tṛtīyāṃ matveti | tṛtīyāpakṣe tvidaṃ pratyudāharaṇamityarthaḥ | atha
pañcamīpakṣe kasmānna pratyudāharaṇam kaityāha - pañcamyāṃ hīti | na ca
tadāpi prasulmbhamiti pratyudāharaṇam uktaṃ hi bhāṣye - naiṣo'sti
prayogaḥ iti | 
e atisulabhamityatreti | upasargāt ityanuvṛterupasargayoḥ
suduroriha grahaṇamiti bhāvaḥ | atiratikramaṇe ca ityateḥ
karṇapravacanīyasaṃjñā, tayā copasargasaṃjñā bādhyate,
ekasaṃjñādhikārāt | pañcamīnirdeśapakṣe'pīti | evaṃ ca sarvathā
kevalagrahaṇasya kartavyatvātkramavyatikrame
kārṇābhāvātpūrvatṛtīyāśrayaṇena pratyudāharaṇaṃ darśitam || 
evibhāṣā ciṇṇamuloḥ || 7 - 1 - 69 || 
e tenānupasṛṣṭāsya vikalpa iti | tathā ca vārtikam
ciṇṇamuloranupasargasya iti || 
eugidacāṃ sarvanāmasthāne'ghātoḥ || 7 - 1 - 70 || 
e dhātuvarjitānāmiti | nedamadhātorityasyāthapradarśanam ,
tasyānyaparatvāt | tasmād añcatigrahaṇaṃ niyamārtham iti yadvakṣyate,
tatsiddha evāyamarthaḥ pradarśitaḥ | adhātoḥ ityasya tvarthapradarśane
ugitāmaṅgānāmañcateścādhātoścohagito num bhavatīti
pradarśanīyam | añcateśceti | ajiti pratyahāragrahaṇaṃ tu na bhavati
napuṃsakasya jhalacaḥ iti punarajgrahaṇāt | tatra hi pratyāhārasyaiva
grahaṇam, nāñcateḥ, jhalantatvāt | bhāvaniti | atvasantasya ca iti
dīrghaḥ | atrāvayave kṛtaṃ liṅgaṃ samudāsyāpi viśeṣakaṃ
bhavatītyaṅgasyogitvam | prāṅiti | ṛtvik ityādinā kvina, suḥ,
halṅyādisaṃyogāntalopau, kvinpratyayasya kuḥ iti kutvam -
nakārasya ṅkāraḥ | 
e añcatigrahaṇaṃ niyamārthamiti | na hi adhātoḥ iti pratiṣedhādaprāpte
vidhyarthametadbhavati | evaṃ hyadhātoriti na vaktavyam niyamādeva
siddheḥ | ukhāsraditi | vasusraṃsu ityādinā datvam | 
e adhātoriti kimiti | añcatigrahaṇānniyamādeva dhātorna
bhaviṣyatīti praśnaḥ | adhātubhūtapūrvasyāpīti | yasya
kadācidadhātutvaṃ dṛṣṭṃa tasya samprati dhātutve satyapi yathā
syādityarthaḥ | gomatyateriti | supa ātmanaḥ kyac, avadyamānaḥ
pratyayaḥ - apratyayaḥ, sa punaḥ kvip | ato lopaḥ, kyasya vibhāṣā iti
yalopaḥ, num - gomān | kathaṃ punaratra dīrghatvam, yāvatā
atvāsantasya cādhātoḥ ityucyate naiṣa doṣaḥ, adhātoḥ iti
vibhajyate, tatsāmarthyādasantasyaiṣa pratiṣedhaḥ, nātvantasya | ata eva
tatra vṛtau asantasyaiva pratyudāharaṇamupanyastam || 
eyujerasamāse || 7 - 1 - 71 || 
e yuṅ, yuñjau, yuñja iti | pūrvavatkvibādi | aśvayugiti |
satsūdviṣa ityādinā kbip | etadevāsamāsavacanaṃ jñāpakam -
aṅgādhikāre tasya ca tadutarapadasya ca grahaṇaṃ bhavati iti | 
e yujeritīkāranirdeśāditi | nāvamikā dhātunirdeśaḥ, kiṃ tarhi
dhātupāṭhagatasyekārasyānukaraṇamiti bhāvaḥ | yujamiti |
sampadāditvādbhāve kvip || 
enapuṃsakasya jhalacaḥ || 7 - 1 - 72 || 
e trapūṇīti | yadyapyatra iko'ci vibhaktau ityeva numsiddhaḥ, tathāpi
acaḥ, iti pratyāhāragrahaṇasyānanyārthatvādanenaiva num bhavati | kaḥ
punaratra viśeṣaḥ - tena vā numi sati, anena vā na tu
kaścidviśeṣaḥ, bhyāyastu pradarśitaḥ | yadyevam, mā kāri
pratyāhāragrahaṇam, akāra eva gṛhyatām - jhalata iti kaḥ punarevaṃ
lāghave viśeṣaḥ | kiñcākṣa pratyāhāragrahaṇāt ugidajām ityatra
añcatergrahaṇam, na pratyāhārasya ityuktam, tadapi vighaṭitaṃ syāt | 
e bahupurīti | bahavaḥ puro yeṣāmiti bahuvrīhau ṛkpūrbdhūḥ
pathāmānakṣe ityakāraḥ samāsāntaḥ prāptaḥ, samāsāntavidheranityatvānna
bhavati | vimalādyauryeṣu tāni vimaladivi dināni | iha jhallakṣaṇasya
numo'vakāśo yadugidanupaṃsakam - sarpīṣi, dhanūṣi,
taugillakṣaṇasvāvakāśo yadanuginnapuṃsakam - gomān , yavamān,
ugito jhalantasya napuṃkasyobhayaprasaṅge paratvādanenaiva num
bhavati | astu, kṛte punaḥ prasaṅgavijñānādugillakṣaṇo'pi num
prāpnoti, kathaṃ punarekamantyamacamapekṣyānekasya paratvaṃ sambhavati
mā nāma sambhūtprayoge, vidhānakāle tu sambhavati, yathā pacatīti
laṭaḥ śapaśca tatra tudantī, nudantītyatra parastha
nakārasyānusvāraparasavarṇayoḥ kṛtayordvayornakārayoḥ śravaṇaṃ
prati viśeṣo'sti | 
e iha tarhi - kṛṣanti, rupantītyatra parasya
numo'nusvāraparasavarṇayoḥ kṛtayoḥ
pūrvasyājhalparatvādanusvārapasavarṇau na sta iti
aṭkupvāṅnumvyavāye'pi iti ṇatvaṃ prāpnoti, yadā punareko
num tadā tasyānusvāraśca prāpnoti ṇatvaṃ ca, tatra
ṇatvasyāsiddhatvādanusvāre kṛte parasavarṇaḥ,
tasyāsidhdatvāṇṇatvābhāvaḥ siddhaḥ, tasmādugillakṣaṇasya pratiṣedho
vaktavyaḥ ityāśaṅkyāha - ugito jhalantasyeti |
sakṛdgatinyāyo'trāśrīyata ityevakāreṇa darśayatiḥ anenaiveti | 
e antyātpūrva iti | rephajakārayormadhya ityarthaḥ || 
eiko'ci vibhaktau || 7 - 1 - 73 || 
e ika iti kimiti | pūrvatra yadajgrahaṇaṃ tadihaiva kartavyam -
napuṃsakasya jhalaḥ, aco'cīti tena tu halantasya na bhaviṣyati,
sandhyakṣarantaṃ tu napuṃsakaṃ nāstyeveti praśnaḥ | ata evādantaṃ
pratyudāharati, na halantam | 
e acīti kimiti | trapubhyāmityādau halādau satyapi numi svādiṣu
iti padasaṃjñāyāṃ satyām nalopaḥ prātipadikāntasya iti lopenaiva
siddhamiṣṭamiti praśnaḥ | itaro'pi viditābhiprāya āha - utarārthamiti
| asthidadhisakthyakṣṇāmanaṅ aci yathā syāt, halādau
asthibhyāmityādau mā bhūt | punaścodayatiyadyevamiti | pariharati
- iha tviti | he trapo iti | atra prāgeva guṇānnumaḥ prasaṅgaḥ , guṇe
kṛte'nigantatvādaprasaṅgaḥ | syādetat - astvatra num,
svamornapuṃsakāt iti sorluki subantaṃ padamiti padasaṃjñāyāṃ
nalopo bhaviṣyatīti tatrāhana ṅasimbuddhyoriti | nanu cetyādi
| evakāro bhinnakramaḥ pratiṣedhena sambaddhyamāna aupacārikamapi
vibhakterastitvaṃ pratiṣedhati | dvividhaṃ vibhakterastitvam - mukhyam,
aupacārikaṃ ca | tatra mukhyaṃ śrūyamāṇāyāḥ, itaralluptāyāḥ
pratyayalakṣaṇena | tadiha luptatvānmukhyaṃ tāvannāsti,
pratyayalakṣaṇapratiṣedhenaupacārikamapi nāstyeva, tatra vibhaktau
ityucyamāno num kaḥ prasaṅge yatsarvathaivāsatyāṃ vibhaktau syāt
naiṣa prāpnoti, nārtho'jgrahaṇena | etadevetyādi | anyathā
hyajgrahaṇaṃ na kuryāt, kṛtaṃ tu, jñāpayati - atrogante napuṃsake
sambuddhiviṣaye pratyayalakṣaṇapratiṣedho na bhavatīti | tathā cetyādinā
jñāpakasya prayojanaṃ darśayati | sambuddhau ca iti vartamāne hrasvasya
guṇaḥ iti vahito guṇaḥ sambuddhiguṇaḥ | 
e laumburavamiti | vikāre orañ | 
e iko'cītyādi | ikaḥ acītyucyate vyañjanādau mā bhūt -
trapubhyām, trapubhiḥ | astu lopaḥ, astvatra num nalopaḥ
prātipadikāntasya iti nalopo bhaviṣyati svaraḥ katham -
pañcatrapubhyām, pañcatrapubhiḥ igante utarapade dvigau pūrvapadaṃ
prakṛtyā bhavatītyeṣa svaro na prāpnoti numi satyanigantatvāt |
nalope'pi kṛte svaravidhau 
etasyāsiddhatvādanigantatvādanigantatvameva | 
e svaro vai śrūyamāṇe'pi lupte kinna bhaviṣyatīti | vaiśabdaḥ
kṣamāyām | śrūyamāṇe'pi vai nakāre svaro bhavati - pañcatrapuṇe,
pañcatrapuṇaḥ | sa lupte kiṃ na bhaviṣyati, yatra śāstravaśena sambhavo na
pratyakṣeṇa, tatra kiṃ na bhaviṣyati bhaviṣyatyeva | kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ
śrūyamāṇe'pi numi svaro bhavati saṅghātabhakto'sau notsahate
tadutarapadegantatāṃ vihantum | yadi cāntaraṅgaḥ svarāḥ, prāgeva
vibhatyutpaterbhaviṣyati | atra tarhi - atirābhyām, atirābhiriti -
atiribhyāmiti sthite numi kṛte tena vyavadhānād rāyo hali
ityākāro na prāpnoti, nalope'pi kṛte subvidhau
tasyāsiddhatvāvdyavadhānameva, saṅghātabhakto num tameva na
vyāvadadhyāt, raiśabdaṃ tu vyavadadhātyeva | athāpi atra aṅgādhikāre
tasya ca tadutarapadasya ca iti raiśabdāntasyāṅgatvavidhānānnāsti
numāṅgasya vyavadhānam athāpi nirdiśyamānasyādeśā bhavanti iti
raiśabdasya vyavadhānameva | athāpyaṅgasyātvam, evamapi numa evātvaṃ
prāpnoti, tatra pūrvasya yaṇi sati atiryābhyāmiti syāt | tathā
priyatisṛbhyāṃ brāhmaṇakulābhyāmityatra priyatribhyāmiti sthite
tisṛbhāvo na syāt numā vyavadhānāt | nalope'pi kṛta ityādi
pūrvavat | 
e naiṣa doṣaḥ, rāyātvaṃ tisṛbhāvaśca vyāvadhānānnumā api bhavataḥ |
vyavadhānāditi karmaṇi lyablope pañcamī, numā vyavadhānaṃ prāpyāpi
bhavata ityarthaḥ | vibhaktividhānadaśāyāṃ yadānantarthaṃ tatatrāśrīyate, na
tvādeśavidhānadaśāyāmiti bhāvaḥ | numā apītyatra saṃhitāyā
avivakṣitatvātsavarṇadīrghatvaṃ na kṛtam | anye madhye hi śabdaṃ
paṭhanti | apiśabdenaitatsūcayati - prakārāntareṇāpyātvatisṛbhāvau
siddhyata iti | tatkatham kātiribhyāmiti sthite
nubhātvayorubhayorapyanityayoḥ paratvādātvamevaṃ tisṛbhāvaḥ, tatra
sakṛdgatinyāyāśrayaṇena numabhāvaḥ, satyāpi vā numi na
kaściddoṣaḥ evaṃ tarhi numnuṭorvipratiṣedhārthamajgrahaṇaṃ kṛtam |
hrasvanadyāpo nuṭ ityasāyāvakāśaḥ - agnīnāṃ vāyūnām,
numo'vakāśaḥ - trapuṇe, jatune, trapūṇām,
jatūnāmityatrobhayaprasaṅge pūrvavipratiṣedhena nuḍiṣyate | nāmi
iti dīrgho yathā syād iti | sa ca vipratiṣedho'jgrahaṇe
satyupapadyate dvayorapyanityatvena tulyabalatvāt | asati hi
tvajgrahaṇe kṛtākṛtaprasaṅgitvānnityatvānnumeva syāt | 
e etadapi prayojanaṃ dūṣayati -nuṅ vācya iti |
kriyamāṇe'pyajgrahaṇe nuṭ tatra vācyaḥ - vacanenaiva sādhyaḥ, anyathā
paratvānnumeva syāt | tataścājgrahaṇaṃ kartavyam,
pūrvavipratiṣedhaśca vaktavyaḥ - iti yatnadvayamāśrayaṇīyam |
tatrājgrahaṇamakṛtvā eka eva nuḍartho yatnaḥ kartavya ityarthaḥ | 
e idaṃ tarhi prayojanam - tenaiva yatnena nuṭi tatraivānajādau num
mā bhūt astu, lopo bhaviṣyati, nalopasyāsiddhatvādanajantatvāt
nāmi iti dīrghatvaṃ na syāt | mā bhūdevam, nopadhāyāḥ ityevaṃ
bhaviṣyati iha tarhi śucīnām , inhanpūṣāryamṇāṃ śau, sau ca iti
niyamāddīrghatvaṃ na syāt, pratipadoktasyenastatra grahaṇam,
lākṣaṇikaścāyam | evaṃ pratyākhyāte'jgrahaṇe prayojanamāha - utarārthaṃ
tviti | tuśabdaḥ tarhyarthe | yadyautaratrāsya prayojanaṃ tarhi tatraiva
kartavyamā ata āha - iha kiñciditi | tuśabdasya yaṇ na kṛtaḥ
iko'savarṇe śākalyasya iti prakṛtibhāvavidhānāt | trapo iti | atra
tu sambuddhau śākalyasyetāvanārṣe iti pragṛhyatvādavādeśābhāvaḥ | 
e kecidatra he trapo, he trapu - iti dvairupyamicchanti,
pratyayalakṣaṇapratiṣedhasyānityatvaṃ jñāpyate, na tvasminviṣaye
sarvathaivābhāva iti vadanti | tathā ca bhāṣye he trapu, he trapo iti
dvayamapyudāhṛtam | anye tu he trapviti prāpte hi trapo iti
bhavatīti bhāṣyaṃ vyācakṣaṇāa nityameva guṇamicchanti | tathā ca vṛtau
guṇa evodāhṛtaḥ || 
etṛtīyādiṣu bhāṣitapuṃskaṃ puṃvad gālavasya || 7 - 1 - 74 || 
e napuṃsakasya iti yatṣaṣṭha|lntaṃ prakṛtaṃ tadiha bhāṣitapuṃskam
ityanena sambandhātprathamāntaṃ sampadyate | puṃvaditi | puṃśabdena
tulyamityarthaḥ | kena punaḥ prakāreṇa puṃśabdena tulyaṃ vartate
ityapekṣāyāmāha - yatheti | numhrasvayorabhāvaḥ puṃśabdena dṛṣṭaḥ,
taddvāreṇa yatsādṛśyaṃ tadihātidiśyate, anyasya
kasyacitṛtīyādiśu puṃśabdena sādṛśyasyāsambhāvat |
tenārthānnumhrasvayoḥ pratiṣedho'yaṃ sampadyate | nanvevamapi
prakṛtatvānnuma evābhāvātideśo yuktaḥ , na hrasvasya, tataśca
hrasvasyāvasthitatvātadāśrayāṇāṃ guṇanābhāvanuḍautvātvanāṃ pratiṣedho
vaktavyaḥ | guṇaḥ - gherṅiti, grāmaṇye kulānām autvam - aut,
acca gheḥ, grāmaṇyāṃ brāhmaṇakule naiṣa doṣaḥ, atideśasāmarthyād 
ehrasvābhāvo'pyatidiśyate, anyathā pratiṣedhameva gālavasya vidadhyāt
| grāmaṇīrbrāhmaṇa iti | bhāṣitapuṃskapradarśanamet | grāmaṇi
brāhmaṇakulamiti | napuṃsakahrasvatvaṃ bhavati, atastadabhāvo'tidiśyata
ityanena darśitam | pariśiṣṭamudāharaṇaṃ śuci brāhmaṇakulamiti
prakramābhedāya darśitam | pratyudāharaṇeṣu yathāyogaṃ nityameva
mumhrasvau bhavataḥ | 
e pīlu phalamiti | vikāre orañaḥ phale luk |
samānāyāmākṛtāviti | asyaiva vivaraṇam - tulye pravṛttinimita
iti | yadyogād dravye śabdaniveśaḥ, tatpravṛttinimitaṃ grāmanayanādi
| astvevam, prakṛte kimāyātam tatrāha - iha tviti | puṃsaśabdadasya
yā pravūtistatra vṛkṣākṛtiḥ vṛkṣāvāntarajātirnimitamityarthaḥ |
phalākṛtinaipuṃsaka iti | pravṛttinimitaśabdasyetyanuṣaṅgaḥ |
phalākṛtiḥ - phalāvāntarajātiḥ | tatra yadyapi pīloḥ phalamiti
vyutpatau vṛkṣāvāntarajātirapyaṅgīkṛtā, tathāpi na sā phale
pravṛttinimitam, kiṃ tarhi phalāvāntarajātireveti bhidyate nimitam
| tadetadevamityādi striyāḥ puṃvat ityatraitavdyākhyātam, tata
evāvadhāryam | 
ekīlālapeneti | hrasvasya nivṛtau ātoḥ dhātoḥ iti lopaḥ syāt
|| 
easthidadhisakthyakṣṇāmanaṇudātaḥ || 7 - 1 - 75 || 
e anaṅe dvitīyo'kāra uccāraṇārthaḥ, ṅkāro'ntādeśārthaḥ,
asthyādayaḥ nabviṣayasyānisantasya ityādyaudātaḥ, śeṣamanudātam |
tatrāntaryato'nudāta ādeśe prāpte udātavacanamasthnetyādau
allopo'naḥ ityakāralope anudātasya ca yatrodātalopaḥ iti
vibhakterudātatvārtham | vibhāṣā ṅiśyoḥ ityillopābhāvapakṣe
tvakārasya udātasya śravaṇaṃ bhavati - asthanīti, yathā cchandasyapi dṛśyate
ityatra - indro dadhīco asthamiriti | 
e etairasthyādibhirityādi | atra aṅgādhikāre tasya ca tadutarapadasya
ca iti tadantasya tāvad grahaṇaṃ bhavati | tathā nupaṃsakasya
ityanuvṛtaṃ śrutatvādasthyādīnāṃ viśeṣaṇam, na prakṛtasyāṅgasya,
tenānapuṃsakasyāpi tasya grahaṇam | kimarthaṃ punarasthyādayo
napuṃsakatvena viśeṣyante yadṛcchāśabdānāṃ puṃlliṅgānāṃ mā bhūt
- dadhirnāma kaścit, tena dadhineti | naitadasti prayojanam - 
e abhivyaktapadārthā ye svatantrā lopaviśrutāḥ | 
e śāstrārthasteṣu kartavyaḥ śabdeṣu na taduktiṣu || 
e evaṃ tarhi, napuṃsakasya ityanuvṛtasyānvayapradarśanamātraṃ kṛtam -
etairasthyādibhirnapuṃsakairiti || 
ecchandasyapi dṛśyate || 7 - 1 - 76 || 
e cchandasi ityeva siddhe api dṛśyate ityetatsarvopādhivyabhicārārtham
anyathārambhasāmarthyātkasyacideva vyabhicāraḥ śaṅkyeta | tadidamuktam
- yatra vihitastato'nyatrāpi dṛśyata iti | asthanvantamiti | anaiṅ
kṛte anonuṭ iti matupo nuṭ, anaṅe nakārasya lopaḥ || 
eī ca dvivacane || 7 - 1 - 77 || 
e akṣī iti | akṣi - au iti sthite auṅḥ śībhāvaḥ, pūrvasya ikāraḥ, tatra
prathamayoḥ pūrvasavarṇaḥ iti dīrghasya dīrghājjasi ca iti nitye
pratiṣedhe prāpte vā cchandasi iti pakṣe pūrvasavarṇadīrghatvam | akaḥ
savarṇedīrghaḥ iti vā dīrghatvam | nanu cāsatyapyasminvacane
pūrvasavarṇadīrghatvenaiva siddham nātra pūrvasavarṇadīrghatvam
prāpnoti, paratvānnumā bādhyate | evaṃ tarhi cchandasi napuṃsakasya
puṃvadbhāvo vaktavyaḥ - madhostṛptā ivāsate - ityevamādyartham, tena
puṃvadbhāvena numi śībhāve cāsati pūrvasavarṇadīrghatvanāpi
siddham - akṣī iti satyam svarastu na sidhyati, akṣiśabdasya
nabviṣayasyānisantasya ityādyaudātatvāt | na ca puṃvadbhāvena
svarasyāpyabhāvātideśa iṣyate | tasmātsvarārthamātrāpīkāra eva
vidheyaḥ || 
enābhyastācchatuḥ || 7 - 1 - 78 || 
e dadaditi | śnābhyastayorātaḥ ityakāralopaḥ | jakṣadityādau
jakṣityādayaḥ ṣaṭ ityabhyastasaṃjñā | kathaṃ
punaścaturbhiryogairvyavahitasya numaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ śakyo vijñātum
ityāha - śaturantaro na vihita iti | anantara īkāraḥ śatrantasya na
vihitaḥ, evaṃ tadanantara iti yāvadvihitānveṣaṇe numi paryavasānam
|| 
eācchīnadyornum || 7 - 1 - 80 || 
e avarṇāntādaṅgādutarasya śaturiti | sūtrākṣaraistāvadayamevārthaḥ
pratīyate ityevaṃ vyākhyātam, na punarayaṃ vyavasthitaḥ sūtrārthaḥ,
dūṣaṇasya vakṣyamāṇatvāt | tasmānnāpradarśitaviṣayaṃ dūṣaṇaṃ śakyaṃ
vaktumiti viṣayapradarśanaparamidaṃ draṣṭavyam | yātī kule iti |
napuṃsakācca ityauṅaḥ śībhāvaḥ | yātī brāhmaṇīti | ugitaśca iti ṅīp
| kariṣyatīti | lṛṭ, lṛṭaḥ sadvā, ṛdvanoḥ sye itīṭ | 
e atretyādi codyam | antaraṅgatvaṃ punarekādeśasya
śatṛmātrāpekṣatvāt | numastu bahiṅgatvam śīnadyautpatyapekṣatvāt
| vyapavargaḥ - bhedaḥ - idamavarṇāntamaṅgam, ayaṃ śatṛgratyaya
ityevaṃrupaḥ | sa ekādeśe kṛte nāsti, kṣīrodakavat | tadyathā -
kṣīrodake saṃyukte na jñāyete - idaṃ kṣīramidamudakam,
amuṣminnavakāśe kṣīramamuṣminnavakāśe udakamiti | 
e avarṇāntādaṅgādutarasya śaturiti na yujyate vaktumiti | yathā
pūrvamavocastathā na yujyata ityarthaḥ | tathā hi sarvatraivāvarṇasya
nivṛtyā bhavitavyam, kvacillukā - adatī, dhnatīti,
kvacicchlunā - juhvatīti, tudatītyādāvekādeśena,
lunatītyādau śnābhyastayorātaḥ ityākāralopena | syādetate -
ekādeśaviṣeye'ntādivadbhāvena vyāpavargo bhaviṣyatīti tatrāha -
ubhayata āśraya iti | yatra ca pūrva paraṃ cobhayaṃ yugapadāśrīyate na
tatrāntādivadbhāvo'stīti, yathā upasargāddhrasvaḥ ūhate, prohate
eterliṅ ibhīyāditi | ihāpyavarṇāntamaṅgaṃ śatā cetyubhayaṃ
yugapadāśrīyate, iti nāstyantādivadbhāvaḥ | etarhyacyate
cedamavarṇāntādaṅgādutarasya śaturiti, na ca sampratyevaṃvidhaḥ śatā
kvacitsambhavati, tatra bhūtapūrvagatirāśrayiṣyate - pūrvaṃ yaḥ śatā
kvacitsambhavati, tatra bhūtapūrvagatirāśrayiṣyate - pūrvaṃ yaḥ śatā
avarṇāntādaṅgādutara āsīditi tatrāhabhūtapūrvagatyāśrayaṇe veti |
samādhiḥ - samādhānam, parihāraḥ | avarṇāntācchabdāditi |
aṅgāditi draṣṭavyam, anyathā dadatītyādāvapi prasaṅgāt | bhavati
hyatrāpi śatravayavādakāratparastakāraḥ | kathaṃ
punaravarṇāntasyāṅgatvam ekādeśasyāntavadbhāvāt | na hīdānīṃ
parampratyādiṣatvaṃ vivakṣitam takārasya svayameva satravayavatvāt |
evaṃ tena takāreṇa punaraṅgasya tadantavidhiḥ, aṅgasya
ityetadatrāvartyate | 
e apare punariti | atrāpi pakṣe yugapadubhayaṃ nāśrīyate, kintu
krameṇetyastyantādivadbhāvaḥ | nanu ca
tudantītyādāvantādivadbhāvādavarṇāntamaṅgaṃ bhavatuḥ tathāpi na
tataḥ pare śīnadyau, takāreṇa vyavadhānāt ityata āha - tatreti |
prakṛto num pratiṣedhena sambaddha iti tadanuvatatāvihāpi pratiṣedha
eva vikalpena, śīnadyorvā num na bhavati avarṇāntāditi, kena punaḥ
prasaṅga idameva jñāpakaṃ syāt - asti śīnadyornumiti, tataśca
kurvatītyādāvanavarṇāntannityaṃ numaḥ prasaṅgaḥ, maivaṃ vijñāyīti
numgrahaṇam || 
eśapśyanornityam || 7 - 1 -81 || 
e ityetayoḥ śaturiti | etayoḥ sambanadhī yaḥ śatā tasyetyarthaḥ,
mbandhaśca nimitanimitibhāvaḥ | kvacitu sambandhina iti paṭha|lte |
nityagrahaṇamiti | nanu cārambhasāmarthyādeva nityaṃ bhaviṣyati tatrāha
- iheti || 
esāvanaḍuhaḥ || 7 - 1 - 82 || 
e iha caturanaḍuhorāmudātaḥ ityāmāgamaḥ sarvanāmasthānamātre
vidhīyamānaḥ soranyatra sāvakāśo niravakāśena numā bādhyeta, tathā
sambuddheranyatra sau sāvakāśo num sambuddhau viśeṣavihitena am
sambuddhau ityanena bādhyeta ityāśaṅkyāha - atra kecidityādi | kathaṃ
punarādityāsyānuvṛtau satyāmapyāmamoḥ kṛtayornuma bhavati, na
punartha evānaḍuhi nityaḥ sannihito'kārastata eva paraḥ syāt ucyate
evaṃ sati midaco'ntyātparaḥ iti paribhāṣā bādhyate,
tatrābādhenopapatau satyāṃ bādho na nyāyyaḥ | tatra yathā paribhāṣā na
bādhyate ādityanuvṛttiśca sārthikā bhavati, tathā vaktavyam | yadi
cāmamorakṛtayornum syāt, nedamubhayamanugṛhītaṃ syāditi
kṛtayoreva tayornum bhavi,yati | āmāmau ca na bādhyete iti |
na kevalamameva na bādhyate, api tvāmamāvubhāvapi na bādhyete
ityarthaḥ | amatra dṛṣṭāntatvenopātaḥ | yathā'm na bādhyate tathā
āmiti bhāvaḥ | na punaramo numā bādhaśaṅkā, amo
viśeṣavihitatvāt | āmambhyāṃ ca numitita | na bādhyate iti
vacanavipariṇāmenānuṣaṅgaḥ | atrāpi yathā āmā na bādhyate
tathā'māpītyarthaḥ | na punarāmā numo vādhaśaṅkā tasya
sāmānyatvāt | apare tvityādi | icchanti 
eiti vacanādiṣṭireveyamiti kecit | anye tvāhuḥ - bhavatu vā
sāmānyaviśeṣayoḥ sannidhau bādhyabādhakabhāvaḥ, iha tvanekena yogena
vyavadhānam, asati hi sambhave bādhanaṃ bhavati, tathaiha ca asti sambhavo
yadubhayaṃ syādityāmamornumaśca samāveśa iti | yatheti | akṣa
nāprāpte dvivarcane dīrgha ārabhyate | atha ca sambhāvātprakaraṇabhedācca
samāveśaḥ | bahvanaḍvāṃhi brāhmakulānīti paratvādāmi kṛte punaḥ
prasaṅgavijñānāt napuṃsakasya jhalacaḥ iti num bhavati || 
edṛksvavassvatavasāṃ cchandasi || 7 - 1 - 83 || 
e īdṛṅtyādiu tyadādiṣu dṛśo'nālocane kañca iti kvini numi ca
kṛte pūrvavatkutvam || 
ediva aut || 7 - 1 - 84 || 
e dhātoḥ pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ - akṣadyauuriti,
ekadeśavikṛtasyānanyatvādūṭhi kṛte divaśabda evāyamiti prasaṅga
iti adhātvadhikārātsiddham, adhātoḥ ityanuvartate, kva prakṛtam
ugdicāṃ sarvanāmasthāne'ghātoḥ iti |yadi tadanuvarteta,
napuṃsakasya jhalacaḥ ityatrāpi sambadhyeta, tataśca kāṣṭataṅkṣi
brāhmaṇakulānītyatra na syāt | tasmādaśakyaṃ tadanuvartayitum tataśca
dhātoḥ pratiṣedho vaktavya eva ityāśaṅkyāha - diviti
prātipadikamityādi || 
epathimathyṛbhukṣāmāt || 7 - 1 - 85 || 
epanthā iti | ito'tsarvanāmasthāne itīkārasyākāraḥ,
savarṇadīrghatvam, tho nthaḥ | anunāsikasya
nakārasyāntaryato'nunāsika ākāraḥ kasmānna bhavati ityāśaṅkyāha -
sthāninyanunāsike'pīti | akṣa kāraṇamāha - bhāvyamāneneti |
kecidbhāvyamāno'ṇ savarṇānna gṛhyati iti paṭhanti,
teṣāmpyaṇgrahaṇaṃ grāhakopalakṣaṇārtham, tenākāro'pi bhāvyamāno
grāhako na bhavati | taparastatkālasya ityanena tu grahaṇaśaṅkā, uktaṃ
hi tatra - anaṇi vidhyarthametaditi | syādetat - mā
bhūtsavarṇāgrahaṇam, anunāsikasyaiva tu sūtre uccāraṇātsa eva syāt
ityata āha - śūddho hyayamiti | akāravidhāne ato guṇe parupaṃ syāt
| akāravidhānaṃ tu nakāranivṛtyartha syāt lopavidhau
gauravaprasaṅgāt | tasmādākara eva vihitaḥ || 
eito'tsarvanāmasthāne || 7 - 1 - 86 || 
e advacanaṃ kimartham, hrasvasya śravaṇ yathā syāt naitadasti sai
tāvadakaḥ savarṇadīrghatvaṃ bhavati, anyatrāpi nopaṣāyāḥ,
sarvanāmasthāne iti dīrgheṇa bhāvyam, tasmātprakṛta ākāra eva vidheyaḥ
ata āha - āditi vartamāna iti | yatrāyaṃ vihito'kāraḥ ṣapūrvo
bhavati tatrāsya prayojanamityarthaḥ | tadeva darśayati -
ṛbhukṣaṇamityatreti | akāravidhau tvekameva rupaṃ syād |
dīrghavikalpastu takṣaṇām, takṣāṇāmityādyartha syāt | sthāninyādeśe
ca taparakaraṇaṃ mukhasukhārtham || 
etho nthaḥ || 7 - 1 - 87 || 
e pathimathoriti | trayāṇāṃ prakṛtatve'pyetayoreva thakārasambhavāt
sambandhaḥ | ādeśe'kāra uccāraṇārthaḥ | syādetat - theranthaḥ iti
sūtramastu, akāro'pi vivakṣito'stu ,thiśabdasyāntha ādeśaḥ evaṃ ca
kṛtvā ito't iti na vaktavyam iti tadapi vaktavyam
ṛbhukṣinśabdārtham || 
ebhasya ṭerlopaḥ || 7 - 1 - 88 || 
e pathyādīti | pratyekamabhisambandhād bhasya ityekavacanam |
virodhāditi || sarvanāmasthāne bhasaṃjñāyā abhāvo virodhaḥ | iha na
sambaddhyata iti | utarārthaṃ tvanuvartata eveti bhāvaḥ || 
epuṃso'suṅ || 7 - 1 - 89 || 
e asuṅe ṅkāro'ntādeśārthaḥ | ukāra uccāraṇārthaḥ | pumāniti |
puṃsśabdasyogitvānnum, sa hi puño ḍumasun iti vyutpādyate |
ḍakāraṣṭilopārthaḥ ukāra ugitkāryarthaḥ - bahupuṃsīti ṅīb
ugillakṣaṇo bhavati | nakāraḥ svarārthaḥ | makāre'kāra uccāraṇārthaḥ | 
e ihetyādi | codyam | prāgeva ca pratyayotpateriti | pratyayaḥ,
sarvanāmasthānam | samāsāntodātatvamiti | puṃsśabdokārasya |
aniṣṭaḥ svara iti | sraṃsanadharmaṇaḥ sakārasya halaḥ sthāne
taddharmā'nudāta ādeśaḥ syādityarthaḥ 
e| nanu cokārasyakṛtamapi samāsāntodātatvamasuiṅ
kṛte'nantyatvānnivartiṣyate, asuṅścāntyatvātpravartiṣyate naitadasti,
thāntaraṇeó svare kartavye bahiraṅgasyāsuṅe'siddhatvāt, pravṛtasya
nivartanāyogācca | tadarthamityādi | parihāraḥ | arthaśabdo
nivṛtavacanaḥ, tasyāniṣṭasvarasya nivṛtyarthamityarthaḥ |
upadeśivadvacanamiti | upadeśo'syāstītyupadeśī, sakāraḥ, sa
yathopadeśāvasthāyāṃ sannihitastayā'suṅpītyarthaḥ | sarvanāmasthāne
kaiti viṣayasaptamyāśrayaṇīyetyuktaṃ bhavatīti, tatra samāsānantarameva
paratvādasuṅ kṛte piścādudātatvaṃ bhavadasuṅ evākārasya bhavatīti
siddhamiṣṭam | yadyavam, pumānityādāvasamāse'pi
upadeśāvasthāyāmasuṅ kṛte pritipadikasvaro bhavannasuṅ eva syāt
ityata āha - pumānityayaṃ punariti | puṃsśabde pratyayo
nidityuktam, tatsāmarthyādādyaudātatvam || 
egotā ṇit || 7 - 1 - 90 || 
e gāṅkuṭādisūtre yāvantaḥ pakṣāḥ, ihāpi tāvanta eva, ta thaeva
guṇā doṣaśca, tadvadeva cātideśapakṣa āśrīyate, yadāha -
ṇidbhavatīti | paratra paraśabdaḥ prayukto'ntareṇāpi vatiṃ vatyarthaṃ
gamayati, yathā - siṃho māṇavaka iti | ṇidityanena
sāmānādhikaraṇyāt sarvanāmasthāne iti saptamyantaṃ prathamayā
vipariṇamyate, tatra sarvanāmasthānasya ṇityāryaṃ vidheyaṃ na
sambhavatīti ṇiti yatkāryaṃ tatsarvanāmasthāne pūrvasyātidiśyate |
tadāha - ṇitkāryāṇi tatra bhavantītyartha iti | 
e citraguriti | bahuvrīhau gosjñiyorupasarjanasya iti hrasvatvam |
atrāsati taparakaraṇe'ṅgādhikāre tadantavidherabhyupagamāt sarve
sarvapadādeśāḥ iti nyāyena sthānivadbhāvena gośabdāntatvāt
ṇidvadbhāvaḥ prāpnoti | taparakaraṇe tu tatkālārthe sati na bhavati
bhinnakālatvāt, taparastatkālasya ityatrāṇityasya nivṛtatvāda
naṇo'pi tatkālaniyamo bhavatīti manyate | 
e kathamiti | hrasvasya guṇaḥ jasi ca iti guṇe kṛte satyapi takāre
sthānivatvāt tatkālatvāṇṇitvaṃ prāpnotyeveti praśnaḥ | na ca
sthānivadbhāvaviṣaye lakṣaṇapratipadoktaparibhāṣā tasya
vaiyarthyaprasaṅgāt | aṅgavṛte ityādi parihāraḥ | ṇitvaṃ na
bhavatīti | ṇitkāryaṃ na bhavatītyarthaḥ | 
e bhavatu sambuddhāveṣa parihāraḥ, jasi
tvavādeśāmantareṇāniṣṭhītatvādaṅgasya nāyaṃ parihāraḥ
ityāśaṅkyāha - atha veti | yaccetyādinārthadvārakaṃ
viśeṣasambandhamāha | ānantaryalakṣaṇe tu sambandhe citraguśabdādapi
prasaṅge yadi, tarhyarthadvārakasambandhāśrayaṇādeva
citraguśabde'prasaṅgaḥ, kimarthaṃ taparakaraṇam ityāha - taparakaraṇaṃ tu
nirdeśārthameveti | spaṣṭanirdeśārthamevetyarthaḥ | itarathā goḥ
ityucyamāne guśabdasyāpi nirdeśaḥ sambhāvyeta | 
e kecidityādi | evaṃ pāṭhe prayojanamāha - dyośabdādapīti | ye
tarhyevaṃ na paṭhanti teṣāṃ kathaṃ dyośabde ṇidvadbhāvaḥ ityata āha - gota
tyetideveti | kathaṃ punaredokārāntopalakṣaṇaṃ draṣṭṃa śakyam
ityata āha - varṇanirddeśa eva taparatvaṃ dṛṣṭam,
tasmātaparakaraṇādiha okārāntopalakṣaṇaṃ vijñāyate || 
eṇalutamo vā || 7 - 1 - 91 || 
e ṇitkāryaṃ vā tatra bhavatītyarthaṃ iti | etena pakṣe ṇitkaryasyābhāvādvā
ṇidvavatītyucyate, na tu pakṣe ṇakārasyetsaṃjñāpratiṣedhāditi
darśayati | etacca pūrvatra kāryātideśāllabhyate | cakāreti |
ṇitvapakṣe vṛddhiḥ, anyadā tadabhāvaḥ || 
esakhyurasambuddhau || 7 - 1 - 92 || 
e atrāpi ṇidityanena sāmānādhikaraṇyāt sarvanāmasthāne iti
prathamāntam | tatrotarārtham asambuddhau iti saptamyantasyopātasya
yathehānvayaḥ, tathā darśayati - asambuddhau yaḥ sakhiśabda iti | 
e anaṅ sau || 7 - 1 - 93 || 
e sarvanāmasthānaprakaraṇātsambuddhiparyudāsācca sau iti
prathamaikavacanasya grahaṇam, na saptamībahuvacanasya, ākāravidhāne
sorhalṅyādilopo na syāt evaṃ tarhi sorṅadeśo
vidhīyatām, taevaṃ siddhe yadanaṇṃó śāsti tajjñāpayati - anaṅ eva
kvacicchravaṇamastīti | tena yadvakṣyati - sambuddhāvapi pakṣe'nāṅṣyite
iti, tadupapannaṃ bhavati || 
eṛduśanaspurudaṃso'nehasāṃ ca || 7 - 1 - 94 || 
e sambuddhāvapi pakṣe'naṅṣyite taiti yaduktaṃ tadāptagamena draḍhayati -
tathā coktamiti | sambodhane - sambuddhau, trayāṇāṃ rupāṇāṃ
samāhārastrirupam, pātrādiḥ | 
e kāni punastāni rupāṇi ityata āha - sāntamityādi |
sāntamanaṅe'bhāvapakṣe, nāntaṃ nalopābhāvapakṣe, tādantaṃ
nalopapakṣe, madhyandinasyāpatyaṃ mādhyandiniḥ - ācāryaḥ, vaṣṭi icchati
| bhāṣāyāmasya sādhutvaṃ cintyamiti jakṣityādayaḥ ṣaṭ ityatrāvocāma
| tathā vyādhrapadāṃ vyādhrapādapatyānāṃ madhye variṣṭho
vaiyāghrapadyāacāryaḥ napuṃsake napuṃsakasambandhini, igante he trapo
ityādau, guṇaṃ ṣaṣṭīti ślokasyārthaḥ || 
etṛjvatkroṣṭaḥ || 7 - 1 - 95 || 
e kroṣṭuaśabdastunpratyayānta iti | kruśa āhvāne,
sitanigamimasisacyavidhāñkuśibhyastun | saṃjñāśabda iti |
tunpratyayasya saṃjñārthe vidhānāt | jambukasya ceyaṃ saṃjñā |
vastusvarupakathanametat | atrānantaraṃ tasyeti paṭhitavyam
kroṣṭuariti sūtre ṣaṣṭhīnirdeśāt | tṛjvadbavatīti | tṛca iva
tṛjvat | tatra tasyeva iti ṣaṣṭhīsamarthādvatiḥ | tadetsarvamutaragranthe
spaṣṭīkṛtam | tṛjantasya yadrūpaṃ tadasya bhavatīti |
pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣayā tṛjantasyeti labhyate | 
e atideśo'nekaprakāraḥ - nimita vyāpadeśa - tādātmya - śāstra -
kārya - svarupaviṣayaḥ | tatrehāditastrayāṇāmasambhāvādanatideśaḥ,
śāstrakāryātideśayoścāyaṃ viśeṣaḥ | śāstrātideśe tenatena
śāstreṇa kāryāṇi bhavanti, kāryātideśe tvatideśavākyenaiveti
tatra vipratiṣedhe phalaviśeṣaḥ | tadyathā - karmavatkarmaṇā ityatra
śāstrātideśe karmakartari bhāvakarmaṇoḥ ityetadvādhitvā svāśrayaṃ
kartutvamāśritya śeṣātkartari parasmaipadaprasaṅgaḥ, kāryātideśe
tvātmanepadameva paratvādbhavatīti | iha tu naivaṃ viśeṣaḥ
sambhavatīti tayorabhedamāśritya vicāraḥ pravatiṃto mahābhāṣye - kiṃ
punarayaṃ śāstrātideśaḥ āhosvidrūpātideśa iti tatra śāstrasya
śāstraṃ pratyāsannamiti śāstrātideśaḥ āhosvidrūpātideśa iti tatra
śāstrasya śāstraṃ pratyāsannamiti śāstrātideśaḥ prāpnoti,
prādhānyāttu rupātideśaprasaṅgastadarthatvādatideśāntaraṇām |
tatrādye pakṣe āhatya tṛci yacchāstraṃ tadvātidiśyate anāhatya vā yadi
tṛcchabdavacchāstramatidiśyate tata āhatyeti pakṣaḥ, tātha tṛcchabde
ṛkāra eva vivakṣitaḥ, cakāraḥ svarārthaḥ,
takārastvaprasiddhāśaṅkānivṛtyarthaḥ ṛjvat ityucyamāne
aprasiddhāśrayo'tideśaḥ śaṅkyata, ṛkp) ityakśabdanibandhanasya vā
samāsāntasyātideśaḥ śaṅkyeta, tasmātajante yadṛkāraprayuktaṃ śāstraṃ
kāryaṃ vā tadatideśenāhatyeti pakṣaḥ | tatrāhatyeti pakṣe aptṛntṛc
iti dīrghatvamekamatidiṣṭṃa syādanaṅguṇaraparatvānyanatidiṣṭāni -
anaṅ ṛduśanaspurudaṃ so'nehasāṃ ca, ṛto ṅisarvanāmasthānayoḥ,
uraṇ raparaḥ iti, nahyaetāni tṛcsaṃśabdanena vidhīyante | nanu ca
dīrghatve'tidiṣṭe'naṅadīnyapyatidiṣṭānyeva bhavanti, katham
dīrghavidhau upadhāyāḥ iti vartate, acaśca iti copatiṣṭhate, tataśca
tṛjantasyeva tunnantasyāpi dīrgho bhavatītyukte - thaupadhāyā aco
dīrgho bhavatītyuktaṃ bhavati, na cākṛteṣvanaṅadiṣu tunnantasyopadhā
dīrghabhāvinī sambhavati | jasi guṇāvādeśayoḥ sambhavatīti cet na
hyaekamudāharaṇaṃ yogārambhaṃ prayojayati, yadyetāvatprayojanaṃ syāt,
aṃptṛn ityatraiva kroṣṭuagrahaṇaṃ kuryāt | nanvevam striyāṃ ca,
vibhāṣā tṛtīyādiṣvaci ityevamarthaṃ punaḥ tṛjāvatakroṣṭuaḥ iti
vaktavyaṃ syāditi gauravaṃ syāt syādetat aci ra ṛtaḥ
ityasyānantaram kroṣṭuaḥ striyām vibhāṣā tṛtīyādiṣvaci iti
rādeśārthaṃ vakṣyāmīti nāsti gauravamiti | evamapi kroṣṭuaḥ,
kroṣṭari, pañcakroṣṭuabhī rathairiti na siddhyati, nāpi udātayaṇo
halpūrvāt iti svaraḥ, tunnantasyādyaudātatvātadevaṃ jasi
dīrghātideśe'pi nātideśāśraṇaṃ vyarthamiti na
tatsāmarthyādanaṅadīnāmākṣepataḥ siddhiḥ - ityāhatyapakṣo duṣṭa eva | 
e athānāhatyapakṣaḥ, anaṅadīnyatidiṣṭāni dīrghatvamanatidiṣṭam, na
hi tadṛta ityevaṃ vidhīyate | atha tṛjītisamudāya eva vivakṣitaḥ, na
tvṛkāraḥ, na cāhatyapakṣa āśrīyate, kiṃ tarhi tṛci yad dṛṣṭṃa
yatkiñcana nibandhanaṃ tasya sarvasyātideśaḥ
evamapyaṅgaprakaraṇādaṅgādhikāra eva vihitaṃ yat śāstraṃ kāryaṃ
tadevātidiśyata, na viprakṛṣṭamanāṅgam | yathāci ravadbhāvena
vṛddhyādīnyeva bhavanti, na haniṇiṅadeśaḥ, tataśca
raparatvamanatidiṣṭṃa syāt | raparatvamapyāṅgam, kāryakālaṃ
saṃjñāparibhāṣam, ṛto ṅ sirvanāmasthānayoḥ guṇo bhavati,
upasthitamidaṃ 
ebhavati - uraṇ raparaḥ iti | striyāṃ ca ityatra tarhi
kroṣṭrītyatrānāṅgayorīkārayaṇoratideśo na syāt
vacanādbhaviṣyati, na tṛjantasya striyāmāṅgaṃ kiñcidasti |
striyāmapyāṅgaṃ kiñcidasti - pañcabhiḥ kartubhiḥ krīto rathaḥ
pañcakartā rathaḥ, he pañcakarta, pañcakartarīti strīliṅge kartṛśabde
ṅasimbuddhyordṛṣṭasya guṇasyātideśaḥ striyāṃ ca ityajña sambhavati na
hi sambuddhau tṛjvatkoṣṭuaḥ ityanena siddhiḥ, asambuddhau ityadhikārāt
| ṅai vibhāṣā tṛtīyādiṣavici iti vikalpaḥ syāt | syādetat -
striyāṃ ca ityatra na kiñacinnimitamupādīyate, tataśca prāgeva
vibhaktyutpateḥ striyāṃ vartata ityevaṃ tṛjante dṛṣṭasyātideśaḥ, na ca
tadāṅgaṃ sambhavatīti anāṅgasyāpyatideśa iti evamapi pañcabhiḥ
kroṣṭrabhiḥ krītai rethaiḥ pañcakroṣṭḥabhī rathairityatra na kathañcana
tṛjanatarupaprādurbhāvaḥ sambhavati | tathā vibhāṣā tṛtīyādiṣvaci
ityatrāpi kroṣṭarīti āṅgasya guṇasyātideśasambhavāt kroṣṭrā,
kroṣṭuariti yaṇśāstramutvaśāstraṃ cānāṅgaṃ nātidiśyate, nāpi
svaraḥ | nanu tannāpi tṛtīyādigrahaṇa
sāmarthyādanāṅgamapyatidiśyeta, anyathā vibhāṣā ṅai ityeva brūyāt
naitadasti abhāvātideśārthaṃ tṛtīyādigrahaṇaṃ syāt,
vatinirddeśeṣvabhāvātideśasyāpi dṛṣṭatvāt, yathā -
marubhūmivadasmingrāme jalamiti | śāstre'pi tṛtīyādiṣu
bhāṣitapuṃsakm - ityatra numhrasvayorabhāvo'tidiśyate | yadā hi
pratyāsaterāṅgamevātideśyamiti sthitam, tadā na sarvāsu
tṛtīyādiṣu bhāvātideśaḥ sambhavatīti yasya śāstrasya bhāvastṛjante
dṛṣṭaḥ, tunnante'pi tasya bhāvo'tidiśyate | yasya tvabhāvaḥ,
tṛjante'pi tasyābhāvo'tideśyaḥ syāt | tadevaṃ śāstrātideśāsya
bahucchidratvādrūpātideśa evāyamāśrayaṇīyaḥ | tadāha
rupātideśo'yamiti | 
e yadyavam, yasya kasyacitṛjantasya rupamatidiśyate - paktā, vakteti
tatrāha - pratyāsateriti | athaitasmin rupātideśe prayogasamavāyi
yadrūpam - kroṣṭā, kroṣṭārau, pañcakroṣṭḥabhī rathaiḥ, kroṣṭrā,
kroṣṭuaḥ, kroṣṭarītyevam - sāvākārantaṃ dvivacanādāvārantam,
striyāṃ kvacidrephāntaṃ kvacidakārāntam, tṛtīyādau rephāntam,
ṅasiṅsorukārāntam, ṅavarantamiti tadatidiśyate
āhosvicchāstrīyaṃ yadrūpam ṇvultṛcau, tṛjvatkroṣṭuaḥ
ityupadeśavākye'tideśavākye ca śrutaṃ tadatidiśyate tatrādye pakṣe
udātayaṇo halpūrvāt iti svaro na siddhyati, na hi
kroṣṭretyādāvṛkārāvasthā kadāciddṛṣṭā, yato'yamudātayaṇaḥ syāt
| tasmād dvitīyaḥ pakṣa āśraṇīyaḥ | tadāha - tacca kroṣṭḥa ityetaditi
| nanvatrāpi pakṣe upadeśavākye, atideśavākye ca
tṛśabdasyodātasyoccāraṇābhāvāduccāritasya vā
guṇānāmabhedakatvenākiñcitkaratvāt svarasyātideśo na syāt
satyam cakāragrahaṇasāmarthyātasyāpyatideśo bhaviṣyati | tadāha -
antodātamapi | yadvā - mā bhūtsvarasyātideśaḥ, tṛjantarupe'tidiṣṭe
tṛjbudhyā yathā dīrghādīni svenasvena śāstreṇa bhavanti,
svaro'pyevameva bhaviṣyati | vatinirddeśāccāyamatideśa āśritaḥ | 
e yadi vatinirdeśamakṛtvā sthānyādeśabhāvaṃ evāśrīyate, na
kiñcidaniṣṭam tathā tu na kṛtamityeva || 
estriyāṃ ca || 7 - 1 - 96 || 
e kroṣaṭuaśabdastṛjvadbhavatītyetatvarthakathanam | ṣaṣṭha|lntaṃ tu yuktaṃ
paṭhitum | anye tvetadgrahanthaparyālopacanayā pūrvasūtre'pi
kroṣṭaḥ iti prathamāntaṃ manyante | anukriyamāṇarupavināśaprasaṅgātu
tṛjvadbhāvo na kṛtaḥ | vatirapi tṛtīyāsamarthādeva | tṛjantena
tulyaṃ vartata iti tadrūpabhāktvena tulyatvamiti rupātideśatvam |
evaṃ ca pūrvasūkṣe'pyādyagrahanthe tasyeti na paṭhitavyam | tṛjantasya
yadrūpaṃ tadasya bhavatīti | etaccārthakathanam | atra vibhaktau
ityanuvartate cet kroṣṭrī bhaktirasyeti bahuvrīhau bhaktiśabdasya
priyādiśu pāṭhātpuṃvadbhāvābhāve kroṣaṭrī bhaktiriti na
siddhyati samāsārthāyā vibhakterlumatā luptatvāt | atha
vākyāvasthāyāmeva tṛjvadbhāvo bhaviṣyati antaraṅganapi
vidhīnbahihaṅgo lugbādhate | tasmānnātra vibhaktirnimitatvena śakyā
āśrayitum, kiṃ tarhi nimitam ityāha - kecidityādi | kathaṃ
punargaurādiṣu pāṭhe ṅīṣpratyayo nimitaṃ bhavati striyām iti
naivaṃ vijñāyate striyāmartha iti | kathaṃ tarhi striyā - ī - strī,
striyāmiti, strītvasya dyotako ya īkārastatretyarthaḥ | arthagataṃ ca
strītvamīkaare āropya striyāmiti nadīsaṃjñānimitāvāmāṭau
kriyete | evaṃ vadatāmaniṣṭamāha - teṣāmiti | pañcakroṣṭḥabhiriti |
taddhitārthe samāsaḥ, ārhīyasya ṭhakaḥ adhyarddhapūrva iti luk,
luktaddhitaluki iti strīpratyayasyāpi luk | tatra na lumatāṅgasya iti

epratiṣedhādīkāranimitastṛjvadbhāvo na siddhyati |
antaraṅgātaṇaṃ ca vidhīnāṃ lukā bādhanot na pūrvameva
tṛjvadbhāvo labhyate | tatra sarvanāmasthāne pūrveṇaiva
siddhastṛjvadbhāva iti tṛtīyādāvasiddhiruktā, sarvanāmasthāne'pi
sambuddhau pūrveṇāsiddhireva - he pañcakroṣṭariti | tathā śasi
pañcakroṣṭḥan, tathā tṛtīyādiṣvajādipvapyutarasūtreṇa vikalpaḥ
prāpnoti - pañacakroṣṭrā, pañcakroṣṭre | nanvārabdhe'pyasmin,
paratvādvikalpa eva prāpnoti thāntaraṅgatvādayameva nityo
vidharbhavati | tatra pratividheyamiti | vacanamevātra śaraṇam | 
e ye tarhi gaurādiṣu na paṭhanti teṣāṃ kiṃ nimitam na
kiñcidityāha - ya tvityādi | striyāṃ ca vartamāna iti |
sūtrākṣarāmanurodhena caśabdaḥ paṭhitaḥ | nanu ca yadyapi na śabdena
kiñcinnamitamāśrīyate, aṅgasya iti tvāśrīyate, aṅge cāśrite
pratyayo'pyāśrita eva, yathoktam, aṅgasya ityatra vavraścetyasya siddhaye
satyam kāryakālaṃ saṃjñāparibhāṣam taduktam | tatra hi pakṣe urat
ityatrāṅgasaṃjñāsūtramupatiṣṭhate, tataśca pratyayaḥ
tyisyāṅgasaṃjñāyāmuradatvaṃ ca prati nimitabhāvaḥ ,
sannidheraviśiṣṭatvāt | iha tu yathoddeśapakṣa āśrīyate, tadataśca
vastuto'ṅgasya striyāṃ vartamānasya kroṣṭuaśabdasya tṛjvadbhāvo
vidhīyate, na tu paranimitamāśrīyate | aṅgasaṃjñā ca pratyayalakṣaṇena
bhaviṣyati | aṅgasya iti vacanāllabdhāṅgasaṃjñasya yatkāryaṃ
pratyayalakṣaṇaṃ tadeva pratiṣiddhyati, na cāṅgasaṃjñā aṅgasya kāryam
| antodāta eva kroṣṭrīśabdo bhavatīti | gaurādiṣu pāṭhe
ṅīṣpratyayasvareṇāntodātaḥ | atrāpi pakṣe udātayaṇo halpūrvāt
tathaityantodāta thaeveti evaśabdārthaḥ | kecitu - ṅīpo'pi
udātayaṇaḥ ityevodātatvam anyathā ṅīṣi paratastṛjvadbhāve
citsvarasya satiśiṣṭatvena ṅīṣo'nudātatvaprasaṅga ityāhuḥ || 
evibhāṣā tṛtīyādiṣvaci || 7 - 1 - 97 || 
e aprāptavibhāṣeyam | striyām iti nānuvartate,
pañcakroṣṭretyādāvantaraṅgatvātpūrveṇa nityastṛjvadbhāva
ityavocāma, tenobhayatra vibhāṣāpi na bhavati |
pūrvavipratiṣedheneti | tṛjvadbhāvasyāvakāśaḥ kroṣṭre, puṃse
numnuṭoravakāśaḥ - trapuṇe, jatune, agnīnām, vāyūnāma,
priyakroṣṭuana ityādāvubhayaprasaṅge pūrvavipratiṣedhaḥ | atha kimartha
tṛjvadbhāvo vidhīyate, yāvatā kruśereva tṛci kroṣṭretyādi
siddhyati tunnantasyāsambuddhau sarvanāmasthāne sjñiyāṃ ca prayogo
mā bhūt, tṛjantasyaiva yathā syāt | vibhāṣā tṛtīyādiṣvaci
ityetatarhi kimartham, tṛjantasyaiva kroṣṭretyādi siddham, tunnantasya
kroṣṭuanetyādi yathaiva tarhyajādāvubhayaṃ bhavati tathā halādāvapi
syāt, evaṃ śasyapi tunnantasyaiva ca tatra prayoga iṣyate, tenaitadapi
niyamārtham - tṛtīyādāvevobhayam, tatrāpyajādāveveti | 
e yastu manyate -- abhidhānasvabhāvādeva tuṃstṛcorvyavasthitaviṣayaḥ
prayoga iti, taṃ prati sūtratrayamapi śakyamakartum || 
ecaturanaḍuhorāmudātaḥ || 7 - 1 - 98 || 
e atra sarvanāmasthāne iti svaryate, na tṛtīyādiṣviti |
āgamānudātatyavabādhanārthamudātavacanam | tadāntavidhiratreṣyata
thaiti | 
e aṅghādhikāre tasya ca tadutarapadasya ca iti vacanāt | prayacatvā
iti | bahuvrīhau sarvanāmasaṃkhyayorupasaṃkhyānamiti caturaśabdasya
pūrvanipāte prāpte vā priyasya iti priyaśabdasya pūrvanipātaḥ || 
eamsambuddhau || 7 - 1 - 99 || 
e catuḥśabdasya kevalasya sambuddhyabhāvādupasamastasyodāharaṇam |
anaḍuhastu prakramābhedāya, tadantavidhiratreṣyate iti pradarśanāya ca
tadantasyodāharaṇam || 
eṛta iddhātoḥ || 7 -1 - 100 || 
e kiratīti | kṛ vikṣepe , gṛ nigaraṇe tudādī | āstīrṇam,
viśīrṇamiti | stṛñ ācchādane, śṛ hiṃsāyām, hali ca iti
dīrghaḥ, radābhyām iti niṣṭhānatvam | 
e mātṛṇāmiti | dīrghatve kṛte'pi lākṣaṇikatvādevātra na
bhaviṣyatīti ata āha - lākṣaṇikasyāpīti | kiṃ prayojanam ityāha -
cikīrṣatītyādi | atastadartha dhātugrahaṇamiti bhāvaḥ | kvacitu
vṛtāvevaitatpaṭha|lte 
e|| 
eupadhāyāśca || 7 - 1 - 101 || 
e pūrveṇa āñkārāntasya dhātoritvamuktam, upadhāyāmapi yathā
syādityayamārambhaḥ | nanu pūrvayoge dhātunā āñkāraṃ
viśeṣayiṣyāmaḥ - dhātorya ṛkāro yatra sthita iti, ihāpi tarhi
prāpnoti - āñkāramicchati āñkārīyatīti evamapi kṛtasya itīyatā
siddham, āñtaḥ ityanuvṛterantyasya na bhaviṣyati tathā tu na
kṛtamityeva | 
ekīrtayatīti | kata saṃśabdane curādiḥ || 
eudoṣṭha|lpūrvasya || 7 - 1 - 102 || 
e pūtī iti | pṛ pālanapūraṇayoḥ na dhyākhyāpṛmurcchimadām iti
niṣṭhānatvapratiṣedhaḥ | mumūrṣatīti | mṛṅ prāṇatyāge |
susmūrṣatīti | smṛ cintāyām | susvūrṣatīti pāṭhe svṛ
śabdopatāpayoḥ, sanīvantardha ityādineḍabhāvapakṣe rupam | purva eva
tu yuktaḥ pāṭhaḥ, pṛthagudāharaṇasya vakṣyamāṇatvāt | 
e dantyoṣṭha|lpūrvo'pītyādi | oṣṭha|ltvamātraṃ vivakṣitaṃ
netaravyāvṛttiriti bhāvaḥ | oṣṭha|le'tretyādi | yathā halaḥ
ityatrāṅgena hal viśeṣyate, tena samprasāraṇam, tena ca
punaraṅgama tathehāpyaṅgasyāvayava oṣṭhayaḥ pūrvo
yasmātadantasyāṅgasyeti | 
e itvotvābhyāmityādi | itvotvayordarśitānyudāharaṇānyavakāśaḥ,
guṇavṛddhyoravakāśaḥ - cayanaṃ cāyakaḥ, ubhayaprasaṅge vipratiṣedhaḥ |
āstaraṇamiti | nātra guṇasya nityatvam lakṣaṇabhedāt | pūrvaṃ
hīgantalakṣaṇo guṇaḥ prāpnoti, itvotvayoḥ kṛtayorlaghūpadhalakṣaṇaḥ
|| 
ebahulaṃ cchandasi || 7 - 1 - 103 || 
e taturirjaguririti | tṛgṛbhyām ādṛgamahanaḥ iti kinpratyayaḥ,
utvam, tasya dvirvacane'ci iti sthānivadbhāvātṛgṛ - ityetasya
dvirvacanam | papritamamiti | pṛ ityetasmātpūrvavatkin,
itvotvayorabhāve yaṇ, tasya sthānivadbhāvād dvirvacanam,
atiśāyane tamap || 
e iti śrīharadatamiśraviracitāyāṃ padamañjayau saptamādhyāyasya prathamaḥ
pādaḥe atha saptamādhyāye dvitīyaḥ pādaḥ 
esici vṛddhiḥ parasmaipadeṣu || 7 -2 - 1 || 
e atra sici, parasmaipadeṣviti dve api parasaptamyau, tatra
sico'hgāpekṣaṃ paratvam, parasmaipadānāṃ sijapekṣam | iko
guṇavṛddhī iti vacanādika ityupatiṣṭhate, tatrekāṅgasya
viśeṣaṇāttdantavidhirbhavatītyāha - igantasyāṅgasyeti |
udāharaṇeṣu astisico'pṛkte itīṭ, seṭaḥ sicaḥ iṭa īṭi iti
lopaḥ | nanu cāntarbhūtasijmātrāpekṣatvād guṇo'ntaraṅgaḥ,
bahirbhūtaṃ parasmaipadaṃ sicaṃ cāpekṣata iti vṛddhirbahiraṅgā, tataśca
pūrva guṇe kṛte igantasyāṅgasyeti nopapadyate ityata āha -
antaraṅgamapīti | 
e yathaivata tarhi guṇaṃ bādhate tathovaṅmapi bādheta, tatrāha -
nyanuvīnnyadhuvīdityatreti | ṇū stutau, dhūñ vidhūnane kuṭādī |
yatra hi vṛddhiḥ pravartate tatrāntaraṅgaṃ bādheta, iha tu
pratiṣedhādapravṛtā satī notsahate vādhitam | nanu ca yathā guṇo
bādhyate, taevaṃ pratiṣedho'pi bādhanīyaḥ yena nāprāpte yo
vidhirārabhyate sa tasya bādhako bhavati, guṇe ca nāprāpte
vṛddhirārabhyate, pratiṣedhe ca prāpte cāprāpte ceti | athaivaṃ kasmānna
kalpyate - antaraṅgatvādguṇe kṛte vacanādaniko'pi
vṛddhirbhavati, yathā - acaiṣīdityādāvekārasya,
ahauṣīdityādāvokārasyeti tatrāyamarthaḥ - hmyantakṣaṇa ityatra
ṇiśvigrahaṇaṃ na kartavyaṃ bhavati, katham aunayīt, aśvayīdityādau
tāntaraṅgatvād guṇāyādeśayoḥ kṛtayoryāntānāṃ hmyanta ityeva
pratiṣedhaḥ siddhaḥ naivaṃ śakyaṃ kalpayitum , thaevaṃ hi kalpyamāne
abhaitsīdityādau vyañjanasyāpi vṛddhiprasaṅgaḥ | vadavrajahalantasyācaḥ
ityeṣā vyañjanavṛddhiṃ bādhipyate nāprāptāyāṃ tasyāmārambhāt | yatra
tarhi sā pratiṣidhyate - anandīt, adevīdityādau, tatra vyañjanasya
sici vṛddhiḥ prāpnoti - naiṣa doṣaḥ neṭi ityanena halantasya yā ca
yāvatī ca vṛddhiḥ prāpnoti - vadavrajaḥ iti vā, sici vṛddhiḥ iti vā,
sā sarvā pratiṣidhyate | iha tarhi āgavīditi
gośabdasyācārakvibantasya sici vṛddhiḥ prāpnoti
ātrāpyantaraṅgatvādavādeśo kṛte halantalakṣaṇāyā vṛddheḥ neṭi
iti pratiṣedhaḥ | ato halāderlaghoḥ iti vakalpastu satyapi sici
vṛddheriglakṣaṇatve bhavati | iha tarhi nyanuvīt, nyadhurvīditi -
kṅiti ca iti pratiṣedho na prāpnoti, aniglakṣaṇatvāt mā
bhūtpratiṣedhaḥ antaraṅgatvāduvaṅadeśo bhaviṣyati | iha ca
akārṣīditi - guṇe raparatve ca kṛte halantalakṣaṇā vṛddhiḥ yatrāpi sā
pratiṣidhyate - atārīt, astārīditi, tatrāpi ato larantasya iti
vṛddhiḥ siddhā | iha tarhyalāvīt, ayāvīdantaraṅgatvād
guṇāvādeśayoḥ kṛtayorhalantalakṣaṇāyāḥ neṭi iti pratiṣedhe ato
halādarlaghoḥ iti vakalpaḥ prāpnoti ato larantasya ityatra vakāro'pi
praśliṣyate | kiṃ vakāro na śrūyate luptanirddiṣṭo vakāraḥ |
ihāpi tarhi prāpnoti - mā bhavānavīd, amavīditi ṇiśvigrahaṇamiha
pakṣe na kartavyamityuktam, tayoḥ sthāne avimavī prakṣepsyāmi |
yatarhi lāghavamasminpakṣe pradarśitam -- ṇiśvigrahaṇaṃ na kartavyaṃ
bhavatīti, tadevaṃ sati hīyate kiṃ cāgavīdityatrāpi ato
halāderlaghoḥ iti vikalpaṃ bādhitvā vakārapraśleṣānnityā vṛddhiḥ
prāpnoti tathā ciprabhṛtibhyo yaṅlugantebhyo luṅi
acecāyīdityādau guṇāyādeśayoḥ kṛtayoryāntānāṃ neti
pratiṣedhaḥ prāpnoti, tathā ciriṇoti - ciriṇotyoḥ acirāyīta,
ajirāyīd | tasmādantarahgamapi guṇameṣā vṛddhirvacanādvādhata
ityetadeva sāmpratam | na punarantaraṅgasya pravṛttimabhyupetya
vacanādaniko'pi bhavatīti | kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇamiyameva kalpanā bhavati
ṇiśvigrahaṇāt anyathā ṇiśvigrahaṇaṃ na kartavyaṃ
bhavatītyanantaramevoktam || 
eato larantasya || 7 - 2 - 2 || 
e antaśabdo'yamastyavayavavacanaḥ - vastrāntaḥ, vasanānta iti , asti
samīpavacanaḥ - udakāntaṃ gata iti tatrādye pakṣe larantasya iti
bahuvrīhiḥ, aṅgamanyapadārthaḥ, anyasyārthasyāsambhavāt | tatra
varṇagrahaṇe sarvatra bahuvrīhiḥ aṅgamanyapadārthaḥ
anyasyārthasyāsambhavāt | tatra varṇagrahaṇe sarvatra tadantavidhirityeva
siddhatvādantagrahaṇamatiricyate | tasmātsamīpavacano'ntaśabdaḥ |
tatrāpi yadi ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ syāta - rephalakārayoḥ samīpabhūtasyāto
vṛddhirbhavatīti, tato laṣiraṇiprabhṛtiṣveva syāt | yadi
parasamīpavacano'ntaśabdaḥ, atha tu samīpamātravacanasatadā iṣṭaviṣye
tāvatsidhyati, aniṣṭe'pi tu viṣaye prāpnoti, tathā
akhallīdityatrāpi prasaṅgaḥ | tasmātkarmadhāyaḥ, nipātanācca
viśeṣaṇasya paranipātaḥ | samīpabhūtau rephalakārau larantaśabdena 
evivakṣitau | kasya samīpabhūtāvityapekṣāyām ata ityanena sambandhaḥ |
evaṃ viśeṣitābhyāṃ rephalakārābhyāmaṅgasya viśeṣaṇātadantavidhiḥ |
ataḥ samīpabhūtau yau rephalakārau tadantasyāṅgasyeti | yadyevam,
ekatvād ataḥ ityasya tasya ca rephalakārayoḥ viśeṣaṇe evaṃ
upakṣīṇatvānna vṛddhibhāṅ nirddiṣṭaḥ syāt viśeṣaṇatvenāi
tāvadakārasya śrutatvātasyaiva vṛddhirbhavatītyadoṣaḥ, tadidamuktam -
rephalakārau yāvataḥ samīpabhūtāvityādi | 
e vayaṃ tu brūmaḥ - samīpabhūtarephalakārāntasyāṅgasyātaḥ sthāne
vṛddhirbhavatītyevā kṣaravyāpāraḥ | tatra kasya samīpabhūtāvityapekṣāyāṃ
sannidhānādataḥ samīpabhūtāviti gamyate iti | apara āha - raśca laśca
larm, āgantuko'kāraḥ, ṣaṣṭha|la lukā nirddeśaḥ, atra lareṇāṅgasya
viśeṣaṇātadantavidhau larantasyāṅgasya yo'kārastatra vṛddhirbhavati |
kīdṛśasyātaḥ samīpabhūtasya | sannidhānācca larṃ prati samīpabhūtasyeti
| anyaśabdaśca samīpamātravacano na tu paramasīpavacanaḥ iti | 
e udāharaṇeṣu , kṣara sañcalane, tsara cchadma gatau, jvala dīptau, hvala
calane | 
e nyakhorīt, nyamīlīditi | khura chedane, mīla nimeṣaṇe | mā
bhavānityādi | aṭa gatau, aśa bhojane māṅḥ prayoga
aḍāgamanivṛtyarthaḥ | 
e avamrīt, akhallīditi | vabhrirgatyarthaḥ, khallirāśu gamane |
athāntagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, na lraḥ ityavocyeta ihāpi tarhi prapnoti -
avabhrīt, akhallīditi akārameva sicparatvena viśeṣayiṣyāmaḥ
larantasyāṅgasya yo'kārastasya sicyanantare vṛddhirbhavatīti | na ca
rephalakārantasyāṅgasya yo'kārastasya sijavyavahitaḥ sambhavatīti
sāmarthyāt yena nāvyavadhānaṃ tena vyavahite'pi
vacanaprāmāṇyādityekena varṇena vyavadhānamāśrayiṣyate | atha vā ato
halāderlaghoḥ ityasyānantara midaṃ kartavyam, tatrāyamapyarthaḥ ata
ityapi na vaktavyaṃ bhavati, tatra laghoḥ, tyinuvṛterakhallīdityādau na
bhaviṣyati | evamapi catuśśabdādācārikvipi luṅ isici
cakārasyāpi prāpnoti tatrāpi sicā''nantaryaṃ viśeṣayiṣyāmaḥ, tatra
yathā acakāsīdityatra ato halāderlaghoḥ iti cakārākārasya vṛddhirna
bhavati, tatkasya hetoḥ sicā ānantarthaṃ viśeṣyata iti | evaṃ
catuśśabde'pi na bhaviṣyati | evaṃ ca kṛtvā laghoḥ ityapi na vaktavyaṃ
bhavati tathā tu na kṛtamityeva || 
evadavrajahalantasyācaḥ || 7 - 2 - 3 || 
e vikalpabādhanārthamiti | ato halāderlaghoḥ iti vikalpo vakṣyate |
neṭi iti pratiṣedhe prāpta iti tu noktam vikalpasyaiva vastutaḥ
prāptatvāt | atretyādi | vadavrajyoḥ ityeko yogaḥ, acaḥ iti
dvitīyaḥ tatrāṅgenājviśeṣyata iti - aṅgasya yo'c yatra tatra
sthitastasyeti , tena halantasya siddhā vṛddhiriti bhāvaḥ | kiṃ punaḥ
kāraṇamaṅgenājviśeṣyate, na punaracā'ṅgasyeti asambhavāt |
acikīrṣīdityādau adantasya tāvat neṭi iti pratiṣedhaḥ ākārantaṃ
tu sici na sambhavati, yamaramanamātāṃ sakca iti sagmavidhānāt |
sambhave vā nāsti viśeṣaḥ satyāṃ vā vṛddhāvasatyāṃ vā | igantasya tu
sici vṛddhiḥ ityeva siddhā vṛddhiḥ | ejantamapyātvavidhānānnaiva
sambhavati | agavīdityatra tu neṭi iti pratiṣedhaḥ |
tadevamaṅgenājviśeṣyata iti sahṛdayamabhidhānam | evaṃ pratyākhyāte
halgrahaṇe, prayojanamāha - tadetaditi | kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇamantareṇa
halgrahaṇaṃ halsamudāyasya parigraho na siddhyati ata tathāaha -
anyathā hīti | etacca yadā vṛddhibhāgājeva sicparatvena viśeṣyate,
tadā veditavyam | aṅge tu viśeṣya māṇe sarvatra sidhyati | na
caivamacakāsīdityādiṣvanekākṣu pūrvasyāpyaco vṛddhiprasaṅgaḥ,
neṭi iti pratiṣedhāt | na cānekājaniḍasti | na
cāpākṣīdityādāvaṭaḥ prasaṅgḥ, kiṃ kāraṇam luṅ yidaṅgaṃ
sijantaṃ tadbhakto'ḍāgamastadgrahaṇenaiva gṛhyate na tu sici
yadaṅgaṃ tadgrahaṇena | yatrāpi sico luk kriyate - adātu,
adhāt iti, tatra sicparatvābhāvād vṛddheraprasaṅgaḥ | 
e udavoḍhāmiti | vaherluṅ, tasastām, sic, vaha - stāmiti
sthite - vṛddhiśca prāpnoti ḍhatvādīni ca, ādipadena jhalo jhali iti
sico lopaḥ, jhaṣastathorgho'dhaḥ iti dhatvaṃ ṣṭuatvaṃ ḍhalopa ityeteṣāṃ
grahaṇam | tatra ḍhatvādīnāmasiddhatvātpūrvaṃ vṛddhiḥ kriyate, paścāt
ḍhalopanimitamotavam | atha tasya punarvṛddhiḥ kasmānna bhavati tatrāha
- tatra kṛta iti | kṛtatvāditi | yadyapyekārasya na kṛtā vṛddhiḥ
tathāpi prayoge'smin kṛteti bhāvaḥ | 
e yatra tviti | na hyaekāratvanibandhano vṛddherabhāvaḥ, kintu
kṛtatvanibandhana iti bhāvaḥ | soḍhā abhibhūtā 
eamitrā yena sa soḍhāmitraḥ || 
eneṭi || 7 - 2 - 4 || 
e udāharaṇeṣu - divu krīḍādau , sivu tantusantāne, kuṣa niṣkarṣe,
muṣa steye iti dhātavaḥ | 
e nanucetyādi codyam | naitadevamityādi parihāraḥ |
ubhayamapyetat sicivṛddhisūtre vyākhyātam || 
ehmyantakṣaṇaśvasajāgṛṇiśvyeditām || 7 - 2 - 5 || 
e udāharaṇeṣu graha upādene, syamu svanadhvana śabde, ṭuavama
udgiraṇe, vyayavitasamutsarge, kṣaṇu hiṃsāyām, śvasa praṇane, jagṛ
nidrākṣaye, ūna parihāṇe ila preraṇe curādī, ṭuaośvi
gativṛddhyoḥ, rage lage sage sarvaraṇe, kakhe khage kage hasane iti
dhātavaḥ | ūnayatyelayatyornonayatidhvanayatīti caṅḥ pratiṣedhaḥ | 
e yadi ca pūrva guṇaḥ syādityādi | etadapi sicivṛddhisūtra eva
vyākhyātam | atha jāgṛgrahaṇaṃ kimarthamiti | yena pṛṣṭṃa sa eva
yathaitanna kartavyaṃ tathā darśayati - jāgro'viciṇṇalṅitsviti | kṛte
guṇe ityādi | aṅgavṛte punarvṛtāvavidhiḥ ityetat nāśritam,
niṣṭhitatvasya durjñānatvāt | atha tviti | anyathā vṛddhiviṣaye
guṇavidhānamanarthakaṃ syāditi bhāvaḥ | tathā ceti | ciṇṇaloḥ
pratiṣedhena utarakālabhāvivṛddhimātraṃ na bhavatīti sāmānyena
jñāpyate, na tūpadhālakṣaṇavṛddhirna bhavatītyevaṃ viśeṣeṇeti bhāvaḥ |
jāgṛgrahaṇe sati cāyaṃ sūtrāṇāṃ prāptikramaḥ, jāgṛ - is - īt iti
sthite pūrva yaṇ prāptaḥ, tamapavādatvāt
sārvadhātukārdhadhātukayoḥ iti guṇo bādhate, tamapi sici vṛddhiḥ,
tāmapi jāgartiguṇaḥ, tatra kṛte halantalatraṇā vṛddhiḥ, tasyāḥ neṭi
iti pratiṣedhaḥ, tataḥ ato halāderlaghoḥ iti vakalpaḥ, tataḥ ato
larantasya iti nityā vṛddhiḥ, tato'yaṃ pratiṣedha thaiti | āha ca 
e guṇo vṛddhirguṇo vṛddhiḥ pratiṣedho vikalpanam | 
e punarvṛddhirniṣedo'to yaṇpūrvāḥ prāptayo nava || 
eato halāderlaghoḥ || 7 - 2 - 7 || 
e nyukuṭīt, nyapuṭīditi | kuṭa kauṭilye, puṭa saṃśleṣaṇe |
nanvatra kuṭāditvānṅtve siti khiti ca pratiṣedhādeva vṛddhirna
bhaviṣyati, kimatra ataḥ ityanena tatrāha - ata ityetasminnasatīti |
atakṣīt, arakṣīditi | takṣū, tvakṣū, tanūkaraṇe, rakṣa pālane,
sicparatvenāṅgasya viśeṣaṇādatra prasaṅgaḥ | 
e atheha kasmānna bhavatīti | yadi sicparatvenāṅga viśeṣyate,
tato'trāpi prasaṅga iti praśnaḥ | sicparatvenāko viśeṣyate
ityāśrityotaram | yena nāvyavadhānamiti vacanaprāmaṇyāditi |
apipaṭhiṣīdityādāvanantatarasyākārasyāto lopena bhavitavyam |
nanu cobhayorapyanityayoḥ paratvādvaddhiḥ prāpnoti astu vṛddhiḥ,
āto lopa iṭi ca ityākāralopo bhaviṣyati na bhaviṣyati
paratvātsagiṭau syātām evaṃ tarhi
ṇyallopāviyaṇuvaṅyaṇguṇavṛddhidīrghabhyaḥ pūrvavipratiṣiddhau
ityato lopo bhavithyati, yathā - cikīrṣaka ityatra | yukataṃ tatra aco
ñṇiti iti vṛddhiranyatra caritārthā, iyaṃ tu sicyantarasyātau
vidhīyamānā niravakāśā eṣaṃ tarhi halantasya
ityanuvṛteranantaro'kāro na sambhavatītyetsāmarthyam | 
e atha tviti | vyavadhānena bhavitavyamiti sthite halā vyavadhānamiti
kalpanāyāṃ laghugrahaṇaṃ kartavyam, ekena varṇeneti tu kalpanāyāṃ na
kartavyamityarthaḥ || 
eneḍvaśi kṛti || 7 - 1 - 8 || 
e vaśi kṛtīti saptamīnirddeśastadādividhyarthaḥ tasya ca vayaṃ
purastātkaraṇasya prayojanaṃ krādisūtre vakṣyāmaḥ|
īśitetyaderupanyāsaḥ prakṛtyāśrayaḥ pratiṣedho na sidhyati iti
pradarśanārthaḥ | īśvara iti | stheśabhāsa ityādinā varac | dīpramiti |
namikampi ityādinā raḥ | bhasmeti | anyebhyo'pi dṛśyante iti
manin | auṇadike tvavyutpattipakṣāśrayaṇenāpi siddham | yācñeti
| yajayāca ityādinā naṅ | 
e sambhavodārahaṇapradarśanamiti | etāvantyudāharaṇāni sambhavantīti
pradarśanārthamityarthaḥ | rudiṃva, rudima iti | asati kṛdgrahaṇe
rudādibhyaḥ sārvadhātuke ityasyāpaci iṭo'tra pratiṣedhaḥ syāt, tasya
tvāśādiravakāśaḥ roditīti | kvacid rurudiva, rurudimeti liṭi
paṭha|lte, tadayuktam, krādiniyamādeveṭaḥ siddhatvāt || 
etitutratathasisusarakaseṣu ca || 7 - 2 - 9 || 
e ktinkticoḥ sāmānyena grahaṇamiti | roditītyasya tipa
ekānabacandhakasyāpyagrahaṇam kṛti ityanuvṛteḥ | 
e dīptiriti | ktinnābādibhyaścaḥ iti ktin | 
e auṇādikasyaiveti | etacca bhūyobhirauṇādikaiḥ sāhacaryāllabhyate
| 
e tatutreṣviti | asmin sūtra ityarthaḥ | agrahādīnāmiti |
grahadivyatiriktānāṃ dhātūnāṃ sambandhiṣu titutrādiṣu pratiṣedha
ityarthaḥ | ādiśabdaḥ prakāra ityāha - grahaprakārā iti | kaḥ punaḥ
prakāraḥ ityaha - yeṣāmiti | nikṛcitiriti | kuñceḥ pūrvavat
ktin, upadhālopaḥ, kuca śabdakaraṇe ityatasmādvā ktin || 
eekāca upadeśe'nudātāt || 7 - 1 - 10 || 
e anudātāditi bahuvrīhiḥ na vidyate udāto yasmin
so'yamanudātaḥ | pāribhāṣike tvanudāte'jmātrāṇāmiṇādīnāmeva
grahaṇaṃ syāt, nājjhalsamudāyarupāṇaṃ paciprabhṛtīnāma | tataśca
teṣāmanudātopadeśo'narthakaḥ syāt | atha vā -
anudātackatvātsamudāya evānudāta taityucyate, yathā anudātaṃ
padam iti | upadeśaḥ - prakṛtipāṭhaḥ | anudātaśceti | upadeśe
ityapekṣate | ubhayaviśeṣaṇaṃ caitadiṣyate | anyataraviśeṣaṇaṃ tu yadi
vijñāyeta - upadeśa ekācaḥ sampratyanudātāditi, tathaihāpi ca
prasajyeta - laviṣyati, paviṣyatīti, bhavati hyaetat pratyayasyodātatve
śeṣanighātena sampratyanudātam thaiha ca na syāt - kartā, kartum,
nitsvareṇa sampratyudātatvāt prakṛtipāṭhe
caiṣāmanudātopadeśo'narthakaḥ syāt | atha vijñāyeta -
upadeśe|ḥnudātādekācaḥ śrūyamāṇāditi krādisūtre niyamo
nopapadyeta cakṛva, cakṛmetyādau
śrūyamāṇarupasyānekāctvādvidhireva syāt, tatra ko doṣaḥ
bibhidiva, bibhidima atreḍāgamo na syāt | nanu ca
sampratyanekāctvādatra pratiṣedhāsyāprasaṅgādeveḍ bhaviṣyati iha
tarhi peciva, pecim, etvābhyāsalopayoḥ kṛtayorekācaḥ
śrūyamāṇādiṭpratiṣedhaḥ prāpnoti | paratvādiṭi kṛte
etavābhyāsalopau bhaviṣyataḥ nityāvetvābhyāsalopau kṛte'pīṭi
prapnato'kṛte'pi iṭ punaranityaḥ - kṛtayostayorekācchaḥ
śrūyamāṇāditi pratiṣedhāt | evaṃ tarhi thali ca seṭi ityatra
seṭgrahaṇaṃ kālavādhāraṇārthaṃ bhaviṣyati, katham tatra thalgrahaṇaṃ na
kartavyam, seṭītyetāvatā siddham, ata ekahalmadhye ityādi
sarvamanuvartete, kidgrahaṇamekaṃ nivṛtam, na ca thalo'nyaḥ seṭ
killiṭ sambhavati | so'yameṣaṃ siddhe yatthalgrahaṇaṃ karoti
tasyaitatprayojanam - kitā saha samuccayārtham, thali ca kiti ca
seṭi etvāabhyāsalopau bhavata iti | tatra kiti pūrveṇaiva siddhe
kālāvadhāraṇārthamidaṃ vacanamiti kṛte thaetvābhyāsalopau yathā
syātām, akṛte mā bhūtāmiti, yathā - niṣṭhāyāṃ seṭi ityatra |
evamapi vidhitsati, cicchitsatītyatra nityatvād dvirvacane kṛte
ekācaḥ śrūyamāṇāditi pratiṣedho na syāt
tasmādubhayaviśeṣaṇamupadeśagrahaṇam, tāta evedaṃ madhye paṭhitam |
yadyaubhayaviśeṣaṇam, bebhiditā, cecchiditā - atrāpi prāpnoti
allopasya pūrsmādapi vidhau sthānivadbhāvānna bhaviṣyati |
yaṅluganta tarhi prāpnoti - bebheditā, cecchiditā
yatraikājgrahaṇaṃ kiñcitpañcaitāni na yaṅluki iti vacanānna
bhaviṣyati | ke punariti | pāṭhe saṅkarasambhavātpraśnaḥ | asaṅkareṇa
paṭhitavyāḥ ityutaram | pravibhaktā iti |
svarāntahalantakakārādivarṇabhedenetyarthaḥ |
ślekeṣvaniḍagrahaṇamanudātopalakṣaṇam | ṣaṣṭhīsaptamyaśca
dhātuviṣayanirdhāraṇe draṣṭavyāḥ | śviḍīḍiti | samāhāradvandve
dvitīyāntam |
