e gaṇasthamiti | ślokapūraṇārtham | svabhāvakathanametat | mat mataḥ
nibodhata, avagacchata | 
e dvyetyādiślokaryorddhayorvivaraṇam | iti svarāntā iti | asya
punaḥ pāṭho nigadavyākhyānatāṃ darśayatuṃ draṣṭavyaḥ | anye tu pūrva
na paṭhanti | 
e yamiryamanteṣviti | śyani paṭha|lta iti | divādau paṭha|lta tityarthaḥ |
pratiṣedhavācināmiti | iṭpratiṣedhaṃ kurvatāmācāryāṇāṃ
matenetyarthaḥ | dihirduhiriti | yadviṣayaḥ saṃśayaḥ puruṣāṇāṃ
nāsti te muktasaṃśayāḥ | tantrāntaram - vyākaraṇāntaram,
āpiśalādi | sahervikalpa iti | tīṣasaha ityādinā | savikalpāviti
| vikalpastadviṣayaḥ saṃśaya ityarthaḥ | svarupeṇaiva sasaṃśayāviti | tau
sto na ityapi saṃśayastatretyarthaḥ | 
e diśi dṛśimiti | puraṇam - cirantanaṃ vyākaraṇaṃ ye'dhīyate te
puraṇagāḥ | pāṭheṣu, dhātvādiṣu | ṛdupadhānāmityādinā
teṣvanudātopadeśasya prayojanāntaraṃ samuccinoti | evaṃ ca
ślokeṣvaniṭa 
eityasyānudātopalakṣaṇatvaṃ niścitam | 
e rudhiḥ sarādhiriti | nyāyyavikaraṇayoriti | nyāyyaḥ - utsargaḥ,
śabvikaraṇayorityarthaḥ |kvacitu tathaiva pāṭhaḥ kecidbhauvādikaṃ
sidhimuditaṃ paṭhanti - ṣidhu gatyām iti, tena tasya ktvāyāṃ
vikarlpiteṭkatvānniṣṭhāyām yasya vibhāṣā iti pratiṣedhena
bhavitavyam | tathā daivādikasya bhauvādikasya ca budherarthe rupe vā
viśeṣo nāsti, tataścaika evāyaṃ budhiḥ, vikaraṇadvayārthaṃ tu
dvayorgaṇayoḥ pāṭhaḥ, tasya cārdhadhātukalakṣaṇa iḍapyuktaḥ,
pratiṣedho'pītyekaviṣayatvādvibhāṣiteṭkatvam, tataśca tasyāpi
niṣṭhāyāṃ pratiṣedhena bhavitavyamiti manyamānaṃ pratyāha -
niṣṭhāyāmapīti | sidheruditvaṃ tāvadananyārtham | na ca
yathākathañcidiṭo bhāvābhāvau niṣṭhāyāṃ niṣedhasya nimitam, kiṃ
tarhi vikalpavācinā vibhāṣādiśabdena vikalpiteṭtvamiti bhāvaḥ |

e tapi tipimiti | tipikṣapī iti pāṭhaḥ | nīcena svareṇānudātena
paṭhitānpratīhi nibodhateti | prastāvātapratīteti pāṭhaḥ, pratīhīti
pāṭhe utarānurodhaḥ - viddhyaniṭsvarāniti | 
e tepteti | tipṛ tepṛ ṣṭipṛ ṣṭepṛ kṣaraṇe | chāepteti | chupa
sparśane | paci vacimiti | sṛjimṛjīti | samāhāradvandvaḥ |
aniṭtvasya hetuḥ svaro yeṣāṃ te'niṭaṭsvarāḥ | 
e tato'sya vikalpena bhavitavyamiti |
tenāniṭsvarārtho'nudātapāṭho na bhavati | amāgamo'pīti | tena
tadartho'pyudātapāṭho na bhavati | tatkasmādihāniṭkārikāsu
paṭha|lte ityata āha - kecidityādi | yuktaṃ caitadityāhanijādiṣu
hīti | ṇijāṃ trayāṇāṃ guṇaḥ ślau ityatra paṭhitā nijādayaḥ | atraiva
vyākaraṇāntarānumatiṃ darśayati - tathā ceti | 
e avadhīditi | kiṃ punarayamupadeśe'nudātaḥ omityāha | kva
punarasyopadeśaḥ hano vadha liṅ īti | kimekājgrahaṇaṃ na
nivartayiṣyāmītyanudāta upadiśyate, na hyasyānyadanudātatve
prayojanam na brūmaḥ - asminnuṣadeśe'yamanudāta iti,
hantiranudātastasya sthāne bhavansthānivadbhāvenānudātaḥ |
kriyamāṇe'pi tarhyekājgrahaṇe yāvatā sthānivadbhāvaḥ kasmādasya
paratiṣedhāditi cet hantaivamanudātavyapadeśe'pi
sthānyalāśrayatvātkathamivāsya sāyt syādetat | nātra
sthānivadbhāvena prasaṅgaḥ, kiṃ tarhi upadeśagrahaṇena, yathā - kartā,
kartumityādau rupabhede svarabheme ca bhavati | tatkasya hetoḥ yaḥ sa
upadeśe'nudātaḥ sa evemāmavasthāmāpanna iti kṛtvā, na tu
sthānivadbhāvāt evamihāpi ya upadeśe'nudāto hantiḥ sa
evāyamiti upadeśagrahaṇātprasaṅga iti | kriyamāṇe'pi tarhyekājgrahaṇe
kathamivāsya vyāvṛttiḥ, yāvatā upadeśagrahaṇasyobhābhyāṃ sambandhaḥ - ya
upadeśe ekāc sa evāyamiti syādeva prasaṅgaḥ
tasmādvadherādyaudātanipātanaṃ kartavyam,
tatsāmarthyāddhantyupadeśaviṣayānudātatvaśrayo'pi pratiṣedho na
bhavati | na hyaetadādyaudātatvaṃ prayogasamavāyi, pratyayasvareṇa
bādhitatvādityevamatra hāro bācyaḥ | ekājgrahaṇamutarārtham || 
erśyukaḥ kiti || 7 - 2 - 11 || 
e yoṣāṃ prakṛtyāśra pratiṣedho nāsti tadarthamidam | śritaḥ,
śritavān, yutaḥ, yutavān iti | sanīvantardha iti
vikalpiteṭtvād yasya vibhāṣā iti pratiṣedhaḥ siddhaḥ | 
e kecidityādi | yathā glājisthaśca ksnuḥ ityatroktam -
ksnorgitvānna stha īkāraḥ ityādi | yadi gakāraḥ praśliṣyate śrayukaḥ
kiti iti nirddeśo nopapadyate, gakāre parataḥ haśi ca ityutvaṃ
prāpnoti cartve ca kṛte kupvoḥ ka pau ca ityeṣa vidhirbhavati,
cartvasyāsiddhatvādutvameva prāpnoti tatrāha sautratvāditi | atrāpi
granthe varṇayanti ityasya sambandhaḥ | tadetaddṭaṣayati - glājisthaśca
gsnurityatreti | ākārapraśleṣe sati tiṣṭhaterākārantādityartho
bhavati, tiṣṭhatiścākārānta eva, tatra
viśeṣaṇamutarakālabhāvīkāranivṛtyartha vijñāyate, tataśca - 
e kathaṃ prakṛtinirddeśe pañcamyāṃ parataḥ śrutaḥ | 
e ākāro'yaṃ vidheyaḥ syāditi codyamapākṛtam || 
e sthāsnoḥ | sthāsnuśabdasya | na kiñcidetaditi | etad
gakārapraśleṣavarṇanamaśebhanamityarthaḥ | gasnupratyayasya gitve hi
gapraśloṣo yujyate, kitve'pi tiṣṭhaterītvamuktāddhetornivartate | 
e tīrṇa ityatrāpi yathā syāditi | iha tu tīrtvā, pūrtveti
ānupūrvyātsiddham, katham tatvā, patvā iti sthite
yāvadiṭpratiṣedho na prarvatate tāvaditvotve prāpnoti, kiṃ
kāraṇam kṅiti ityucyate, na cākṛte iṭpratiṣadhe ktvā
kidbhavati, na ktvā seṭ iti pratiṣedhāt | kiñca bho itvotve
kiti vidhīyete na kiti vidhīyete, kiti tu vijñāyete | katham
itvotvābhyāṃ guṇavṛddhī bhavato vipratiṣedhena | tasmātaprageva
sannihitaṃ kitvamāśrityeṭtiṣedhe pravṛte itvotve bhavataḥ |
kṛtayostahi tayoḥ
pratiṣedhanimitasyogantatvasyāpagamātpunariṭprasaṅgaḥ, tasmiṃśca
sati na ktvā seṭ iti kitvapratiṣedhād guṇe sati teritvā,
poritveti prāpnoti naitadasti prasaṅgāvasthāyāmeva pratiṣedhena
bādhitasya bhraṣṭāvasarasya punaḥ pravṛtyayogāt | iha ca titīrṣati,
mumūrṣatīti nākṛta iṭaḥ pratiṣedhe sanaḥ kitvamajhalāditvāt, asati
ca kitve guṇasyāyaṃ viṣaya iti itvotvayoraprasaṅga iti
ānupūrvyātsiddhamityeva | yadi vā tṛ - sa iti sthite,
anavakāśatvādiṭ sani veti ṛkārāntanimita iḍvikalpaḥ
pravartate, tatreḍabhāvapakṣe kitvād guṇe niṣiddhe itvotvayoḥ
kṛtayorapi vikalpena bādhitasyeḍlakṣaṇasya bhraṣṭāvasaratvena punaḥ
pravṛtayayogātsiddhamiṣṭam | tasmātīrṇa ityatra
copadeśādhikārasyopayogaḥ | kasmātpunarasatyupadeśādhikāre'tra
na syāt ityata āha - itve hi kṛta iti | kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇamitvameva
tāvadbhavati nityatvāt | mā bhūdityādi codakaḥ | kasya
punarityādītaraḥ | āñta ityādi codakaḥ | yadyevamityādītaraḥ |
sthānivadbhāvāditi codakaḥ | anilvidhāvityādītaraḥ | alvidhitvaṃ
punarugiti pratyāhāragrahaṇāt | nanu cetvotvayoḥ kṛtayoḥ
samapratyṛkārābhāve'pyekadeśavikṛtasyānanyatvātsa eva dhāturyasya
sani vibhāṣā vihitetīṭpratiṣedho bhaviṣyati naitadasti āditaśca
iti yogavibhāgena jñāpayiṣyate - yadupādhervibhāṣā tadupādheḥ
pratiṣedha iti, tataśca ṛkārāntatvamupādhiraḍvikalpe, sa cetve
kṛte nāstīti kathaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ syāt tasmādityādi |
yasmādevamasatyupadeśagrahaṇe tīrṇa ityatra pratiṣedho na setsyati,
tasmāt upadeśe ityanuvartanīyam | tathā ca satīti | upadeśe
ityanuvartamāne satītyarthaḥ | atrāpi prāpnotīti |
jagarterupadeśāvasthāyāmugāntatvāt | tadarthamiti | jagarita
ityādisiddhyartham | jagarita ityādāviṭpratiṣedhanivṛtyarthamiti
vā | tathā ca vārtikam - ekājagrahaṇaṃ jagartyartham iti
pūrvasūtre'nupayogādihārthamekajgrahaṇamityarthaḥ | 
e bhaṣyakārastvāha - yasya kvacidiḍvikalpo dṛṣṭaḥ sa dhāturāśrīyate
- yasya vibhāṣā iti, na tu tadgataṃ vikalpakāraṇamakārādi | bhavati
cetvotvayoḥ kṛta yorayamapi sa eva dhāturiti tīrṇa ityādau
siddhaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ iti | yadyevam, vibhāṣā gamahanavidaviśām iti
viśinā sāhacaryātaudādikasya videḥ kvasāviṭi vikalpite
daivādikasyāpi viderniṣṭhāyāṃ pratiṣedhaḥ prāpnoti - viditaḥ,
viditavāniti na, dhātubhadāt | kathaṃ dhātubhedaḥ arthabhedād,
anubandhabhedād, vikaraṇabhedācca | tadevaṃ nārtha upadeśādhikāreṇa,
nāpi ekājgarahaṇānuvṛtyā | kimarthaṃ tarhi pūrvasutre ekajgrahaṇam
yaṅlugantanivṛtyartham | nanu ca kriyamāṇe'pyekājkahaṇe
yaṅlugantasya pratiṣedhaḥ prāpnoti,
upadeśagrahaṇasyobhayaviśeṣaṇatvāt, yathā bibhitsatīti,
tatraitatsyāt - kriyamāṇe ekājagrahaṇe yatraikājagrahaṇaṃ kiñcit iti
vacanād yaṅlugantasya na bhavatīti tacca vārtam akriyamāṇe'pi
caikājgarahaṇe vacanāntarāśrayaṇena yaṅlugante'pi parihāraḥ | tadeva
vacanamevaṃ paṭha|ltām - tropadeśāgrahaṇamiti |
anudātopadeśalakṣaṇo'nunāsikalopo'pi tarhi yaṅlugantānāṃ
tasādiṣu na syāt, tathā ibantānāṃ diviprabhṛtīnāṃ
yaṅlugantānāmapi sanīṅvikalpaḥ prāpnoti | kriyamāṇe
punarekājgrahaṇe na bhavati, taekācaḥ iti tatrānuvṛteḥ | yadi
neṣyate, evaṃ vakṣyāmi - upadeśe'nudātānna yaṅluka kiti |
adhikāro'yam, yatraikājgrahaṇena yaṅlugantasya vāyavṛttiriṣyate,
tatropatiṣṭhate | evamapi vāvṛtu varaṇe iti
divādāvanekājudidanudātetpaṭha|lte | tathā ca bhaṭṭikāvye
prayogaḥ - tato vāvṛtyamānā'sau rāmaśālāṃ nyavikṣata iti |
tasyodito vikalpiteṭo niṣṭhāyām yasya vibhā,a iti pratiṣedhaḥ
prāpnoti | ekājgrahaṇe tu kriyamāṇe na bhavati ekācaḥ iti
tatrānuvṛteḥ | tathā ca niṣṭhāyāṃ seṭi ( 6|4|52 | ityatrāpi
vṛttikāreṇoktam - atha punarekāca iti tatrānuvartate ityādi | 
e anye punarbhāṣyakāreṇaikājgrahaṇasya pratyākhyātatvānnaitadiṣyata
ityāhuḥ | tathā ca vṛttikāreṇāpi pākṣikatvenaivoktam - atha
punarekāca iti tatrānuvartate iti | kṛtamatitavistireṇa || 
esani grahaguhośca || 7 - 2 - 12 || 
e cakāra uganukarṣaṇārthaḥ | na ca iko jhal iti sanaḥ kitvāt
ugantānāṃ pūrveṇaiva siddhiḥ kiṃ kāraṇam jhalādau sanaḥ kitvam, na
cāntareṇeṭaṭpratiṣedhaṃ san jhalādirbhavati, tena yeṣu
prakṛtyāśrayaḥ pratiṣedho nāsti, teṣvanenaiveṭi pratiṣiddhe
jhalacāditve sanaḥ kitavamityeṣa kramaḥ | jidhṛkṣatīti | rudavida
ityādinā sanaḥ kittvam, grahijyādisūtreṇa tamprasāraṇam, ho
ḍhaḥ, ṣaḍho kassi, ekoco baśo bhaṣ | jughukṣatīti | guhū
saṃvaraṇe, svaritet, halantācca iti sanaḥ kitvam | atha
cakāreṇogidiva śrayatirapi kasmānnānukṛṣyate ata āha -
śrisvṛyūrṇvityādi || 
ekṛsṛmṛvṛstudrusruvo liṭi || 7 - 2 - 13 || 
e krādaya eva liṭa|lniṭa iti | liṭa|leva krādayo'niṭaḥ ityeṣa tu
viparīto'tra niyamo na bhavati krādīnāmanudātopadeśasāmarthyāt
| kṛtalabdhakrītakuśalāḥ, tamadhīṣṭo bhṛto bhūtaḥ, parivṛto rathaḥ
stutastomayoḥ ityādinirdeśācca | 
e kena punareṣāmiṭpratiṣedhaḥ siddhaḥ, yato niyamārtho'yamārambhaḥ
ityata āha - anudātopadeśānāmityādi |
vṛṅvṛñbhyāmanye'nudātopadeśāsteṣāṃ prakṛtyāśrayaḥ ekāca
upadeśe itīṭpratiṣedhaḥ siddhaḥ | vṛṅvṛñostu pratyayāśrayaḥ
rśyukaḥ kiti tyeṣiḥ | tasmādubhayasyāpi - prakṛtyāśrasya,
pratyayāśrayasya ca | kathaṃ punarayaṃ pratyayāśrayacasya niyamaḥ, yāvatā
vṛgrahaṇaṃ vṛñasthali vidhyarthaṃ sambhavati, na hi tatra prakṛtyāśrayaḥ
pratiṣedhaḥ, vṛña udātatvāt, nāpi ptyayāśrayaḥ thalaḥ kitvābhāvāt,
asati pratyayāśrayasya nitayame luluvithetyādāviṇna syāt ityata āha
- vṛño hīti | vyavasthā - niyamaḥ | iha tuṣṭothetyādau ṛto
bhāradvājasya ityetasmānniyamādiṭ prāpnoti, yayithetyādivat |
yathā hi yayitha, papithetyādau ādhedhātukasya itīṭ praptaḥ ekācaḥ
iti niṣiddhaḥ, punaḥ krādiniyamāt prāptaḥ acastāsvatthali iti
pratiṣiddhaḥ, tataḥ ṛto bhāradvājasya thali pratiṣedho nānyebhyaḥ iti
niyamātpakṣe iḍ bhavati, tathātrāpi syāt | kathaṃ khalu
krādiniyamasya bādhakam acastāsvat iti pratiṣedhaṃ bādhamāno
bhāradvājaniyamaḥ krādipratiṣedhaṃ na bādhate kṛsubhṛvṛ ityeteṣu
purvāyaṃ doṣasteṣāmṛkārāntatvena bhāradvājapakṣe'pīṭaḥ
pratiṣedhāt | evaṃ tarhi studrusruśruvāṃ grahaṇaṃ vidhyarthaṃ bhaviṣyati,
tāsati hi vidheye niyamo bhavati, iha cāsti vidheyam, kim thali
bhāradvājaniyamādiṭaḥ prāptasya pratiṣedhaḥ, itareṣāṃ tu krādīnāṃ
grahaṇaṃ niyamārtha bhaviṣyatīti | bibhidiva, luluvivetyādāvapi na
doṣaḥ | kathaṃ punastuṣṭuamaḥ atra hi krādiniyamādiṭ prāpnoti
naiṣa doṣaḥ studrusruśruvāṃ grahaṇamubhayorapi pratiṣedhārtham | yaśca
krādiniyamādiṭ prāptaḥ yaśca bhāradvājaniyamāt,
tayorubhayorapītyarthaḥ | 
e yadyevam, yena nāprāptinyāyena krādiniyamameva studrusruśruvāṃ
pratiṣedho bādheta, na tu vikalpena prāptaṃ bhāradvājaniyamam,
tataścāsau syādeva ityāśaṅkyāha -- pūrvakatvātapratiṣedhasya pūrva
vidhiprakaraṇaṃ paṭhitavyam, ārdhadhātukasya ityārabhya īḍaḍajanordhve
ca ityevamantam, paścātapratiṣedhaprakaraṇam, tadyathā'nyatrāpi - kartari
karmavyatihāre , na gatihiṃsārthebhyaḥ iti | tatrāyamartho
dviriḍgrahaṇaṃ na kartavyaṃ bhavati, prakṛtamanuvartate | nanvevam,
rudādibhyaḥ sārvadhātuke iti sārvadhātukagrahaṇam, liṅḥ
salopo'nantayasya ityatra vicchidyeta evaṃ tarhi na vṛdbhyaścaturbhyaḥ
ityatraiva paṭhitavyam, evaṃ hi vidhyutarakāraśca pratiṣedhaḥ kṛto
bhavati, dviśceḍgrahaṇaṃ na kartavyaṃ bhavati, sārvadhātukagrahaṇaṃ ca
salope na vicchidyate, api ca dviḥpratiṣedho na kartavyo bhavati,
so'yamevaṃ siddhe yatpurastātapratiṣedhakāṇḍaṃ karoti,
tasyaitataprayojanam -
thānāśritavidhānaviśeṣamiṇmātramanārabhyādhītena pratiṣedhena yathā
bādhyeteti | yadi tu bhāradvājaniyamātparamidaṃ kāṇḍaṃ kriyeta,
tato madhye'pavādanyāyeva māradvājaniyamaḥ acastāsvat iti
pratiṣedhemeva, bādheta, na tu krādiniṣedhamiti
purastātapratiṣedhakaraṇe na kaściddoṣaḥ | 
e apara āha - yatra tatra vā pratiṣedhakaraṇamastu, sarvathā tu
bhāradvājaniyamaḥ acastāsvat iti yogadvayena thali yaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ
prāptastasyaiva niyāmakaḥ, anantarasya vidhirvā bhavati pratiṣedho vā
iti, tataśca studrusruśruvāmapi bhāradvājaniyameva thācastāsvat iti
pratiṣedha eva nivartate, na tu krādipratiṣedhaḥ iti | tanmate
purastātpratiṣedhakaraṇasya prayojanamutaratra darśayiṣyāmaḥ | 
e kṛño'suṭa iti vaktavyamiti | kṛte'pi karotirbhavatyeveti
pratiṣedhaprasaṅgaḥ || 
eśvīdito niṣṭhāyām || 7 - 2 - 14 || 
e śvigrahaṇaṃ kimartham, na samprasāraṇe kṛte parasya pūrvatve
cogantatve sati rśyukaḥ kiti ityeva siddham na sidhyati, śvi - ta
iti sthite paratvādiṭ prāpnoti | athāpi pūrvaṃ samprasāraṇam
evamapi rśyukaḥ kiti ityatra upadeśe ityanuvṛtetarasya copadeśe
idantatvānna sidhyati | 
e ḍīṅ ityādi | ḍīṅyaṃ svādīnāṃ madhye paṭha|lte, te ca oditaḥ,
svādaya oditaḥ iti vacanāt, kathametajjñāpakam ityata āha - sa
hīti | niṣṭhātaḥ niṣṭhātakārasya | anantarasya vidhīyata iti | iṭi
satyānantarthaṃ vihanyeta | 
e evañca sati śvayaterapyatra grahaṇaṃ śakyamakartum, tathā
olasjīprabhṛtīnāmapi uktenaiva nyāyeneḍabhāvasya siddhatvāt || 
eyasya vibhāṣā || 7 - 2 - 15 || 
e yasya vibhāṣā ityanuvādavākyam | atra ca iḍvihitaḥ iti
vākyaśeṣaḥ | yatadornityasambandhātasya niṣṭhāyāmiṇna bhavatīti
pratiṣedhavākyaṃ sampadyate | nipātnādiḍāgama iti | apara āha -
anityo'yaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ, kṛtī chedane ityasya iditkaraṇasāmarthyāt |
yadi hyayaṃ vidhirnityaḥ syāt se'sici ityanena
vibhāṣiteṭtvādanenaiva pratiṣedhasya siddhatvādīditkaraṇamanarthakaṃ
syāditi || 
eāditaśca || 7 - 2 - 16 || 
e āśvastaḥ, vānta iti | bhāṣyavārtikayoranuktamapi
prayogabāhulyāduktam | yogavibhāgakaraṇaṃ kimiti | yogavibhāga
eva tāvaddoṣaḥ | api ca ekayogatve cakāro na kartavyo bhavatīti
praśnaḥ | evaṃ cotaragranthe cakāro na paṭhitavyaḥ | paṭha|lmānastu
anuktasamuccayārthe vyākhyeyaḥ | kathaṃ punarekrayogatve
bhāvādikarmaṃbhyāmanyatra pratiṣedhaḥ siddhaḥ tatrāha - anyatreti |
yaduṇadheriti |upādhirabhidheyādirbhedakaḥ | yadyaupādhīnāṃ bhedakatvaṃ na
syāt, yogavibhāgo'narthakaḥ syāt | bhedakatve tu teṣāṃ
bhāvādikarṇaṇorvikalpavidhānātkartṛkarmaṇoḥ pratiṣedho na syāditi
tadartho yogavibhāgaḥ kartavyaḥ | kimetasya jñāpane prayojanam ityata
āha - teneti | lābhārthasya vibhāṣeti | atra heturvakṣyate | yadi
tarhyupādhirbhedakaḥ, tataḥ udito vā iti ktvāpratyaye bhāvavācini
vikalpa iti niṣṭhāyāmapi bhāva eva pratiṣedhaḥ syāt, nārthāntare |
śabdenāśrīyamāṇo hyupādhirbhedakaḥ | na ca udito vā ityatra
bhāvavācitvaṃ śabdenāśritam | tathā ca tena nirvṛtam,
nirvṛte'kṣadyauutādibhyaḥ ityāderupapatiḥ || 
evibhāṣā bhāvādikarmaṇoḥ || 7 - 2 - 17 || 
e meditamaneneti | niṣṭhā śīṅ iti kitvapratiṣedhād guṇaḥ |
praminna iti | ādikarmaṇi ktaḥ kartari ca iti kartari ktaḥ | 
e saunāgā iti | sunāgasyācāryasya śiśyāḥ - saunāgāḥ | śakito
ghaṭaḥ kartumiti | yadyapi śakiḥ kevalo'karmakaḥ, tathāpi
tumunantavācyakriyāviśeṣaṇatvena sakarmako bhavati | tathā ca karmaṇi
lādayo dṛśyanta - ayaṃ yogaḥ śakyo'vaktum, ayamarthaḥ śakyate
vaktumiti || 
ekṣubdhasvāntadhvāntalagnamliṣṭaviribdhiphāṇbāḍhāni
manthamanastamaḥsaktāvispaṣṭasvarānāyāsabhṛśeṣu || 7 - 2 - 18|| 
e manthābhidhānaṃ cediti | samudāyena cenmantho'bhidhīyata ityarthaḥ |
etena samudāyānāmabhidheyabhāvena manthādaya 
eihopātā iti darśayati | yadi tu dhātvarthopādhitvenāśrīyeran -
manathādisādhane dhātvarthe kṣubdhādayo nipātyanta iti, tadā kṣubhitaṃ
manthenetyādāvapi syāt | dravadravyasampṛktāḥ saktavaḥ- manthaḥ |
dadhimanthānmadhumanthāṃśceti hi dṛśyate | anye tu mathyate'neneti
manthanadaṇḍaḥ khañjakaḥ - mantha ityāhuḥ | manthādiṣu kṣubdhādiśabdānāṃ
calānādikriyāyogo yathāsambhavaṃ draṣṭavyaḥ | upamānāditi |
upamānam - sādṛśyam, tacac yathāsambhavaṃ draṣṭavyam | 
e svāntaśabdena viṣayaṣvavikṣiptamanākulaṃ mana ucyate | svanitaṃ
śabdāyitamityarthaḥ | manaseti | kartari karaṇe vā tṛtīyā | evaṃ
dhvanitaṃ tamasetyatrāpi | 
e lagnimiti | rage lage ṣṭage saṃvaraṇe, atra niṣṭhānatvamapi
nipātyate | 
e gliṣṭamiti | mleccha avyakte śabde | mlecchitamiti |
apabhāṣitamityartha | atrārthasyāvispaṣṭatayā śabdasyāvispaṣṭatvam
apaśabdānāmapi svarupeṇābhivyaktatvāt | udāharaṇeṣu
varṇānabhivyaktiḥ - vispaṣṭatvam | phāṇḍamityādi | kaḥ
punaratrānāyāso vivakṣitaḥ ityata āha - yadaśrṛtamityādi | yasya
vyādheryadauṣadhaṃ jātaṃ tasya pañcadhā kalpāna - rasaḥ, kalkaḥ, śrṛtaḥ,
śītaḥ, phāṇṭa iti | rasaḥ - svarasaḥ | kalkaḥ - piṣṭam | śrṛtam -
kvāthaḥ | śīto nāma - kṣuṇṇamauṣadhajātamudake prakṣipya
rātrāvadhivāsitamudakaṃ prātaḥ pīyate | tadevoṣṇodake prakṣipya
sadyo'bhiṣutya pūtvā yatpīyate saḥ phāṇṭaḥ | yathāha vāgbhaṭaḥ -
sadyo'bhiṣutya pūtastu phāṇṭaḥ iti | pañcāpyete kaṣāyāḥ |
tatrāśrṛtamiti kvāthasya vyāvṛttiḥ, apiṣṭamiti kalkasya,
udakasamparkeaṇeti svarasya, īṣaduṣṇamiti śītasya, mātraśabdaḥ
svabhāvānuvādaḥ | vibhaktarasam prāghavasthāyā bhinnarasam |
yadevambhūtaṃ kaṣāyaṃ tatphāṇṭamityarthaḥ | kaṣāyaśabda ubhayaliṅgaḥ |
kathaṃ punaretadanāyāsaśabdenocyate lakṣaṇayā | yadāha -
anāyāseneti || 
e ghṛṣiśasī vaiyātye || 7 - 2 - 19 || 
eñidhṛṣā prāgalbhye, śasu hiṃsāyām, ṣaṣṭha|lrthe prathamā | virupaṃ
yātam - gmanam, ceṣṭataṃ yasya sa viyātaḥ - avinītaḥ | 
e śaserapītyādau granthe iṭpratiṣedhaḥ siddha ityanuṣaṅgaḥ | atha
dhṛṣeḥ vibhāṣā bhāvādikarmaṇoḥ iti vikalpe prāpte nityārthaṃ grahaṇaṃ
kasmānna bhavati tatrāha - bhāvādikarmaṇorapīti | evaṃ cāsya āditve
prayojanaṃ cintyam | dharṣitaḥ - abhibhūtaḥ pūrvavadakitvam |
viśasitaḥ - vikṛtaḥ || 
edṛḍhaḥ sthūlabalayoḥ || 7 - 2 - 20 || 
esthūlaḥ - māṃsalaḥ, durbalo'pi | asthūlo'pi balavān - balaḥ |
balavati ceti | sūtre arśāadyacpratyayāntaṃ balaśabdaṃ darśayati |
oaṃheriti | dṛhi vṛddhau ityetāvānpāṭhaḥ - iti vārtikakārasya pakṣaḥ,
dṛha dṛhi vṛddhau - iti bhāṣyakārasya | 
e atha kimartha hakārasya lopo nipātyate, na ḍhatvameva nipātyatām,
parasya dhatvaṃ ṣṭuatvam, ḍho ḍhea lopaḥ dṛḍha iti siddham ityata āha -
hakāralopanipātanamiti | repho na syāditi | rādiphaḥ ityatra
varṇāditi nāphekṣyate, tena raśabdo na syādityarthaḥ |
ḍhalopasyāsiddhatve saṃyoge guru iti gurusaṃjñayopajātayā
laghusaṃjñāyā bādhitatvātannibandhanakāryāprasaṅga ityarthaḥ | iha ceti |
gurusaṃjñānibandhanakāryaprasaṅgaścetyarthaḥ | oaṃhitamiti | oaṃheḥ
pratyudāharaṇam | dṛhitamiti dṛheḥ | atra ca dīrghādirupeṇa
vṛddhamucyate || 
eprabhau parivṛḍhaḥ || 7 - 2 - 21 || 
e pūrveṇa samānamiti | iḍabhāvādernipātyasya tulyatvāt |
vṛheriti | vṛhi vṛddhau iti vārtikakārasya pakṣaḥ | bṛhi vṛddhau iti
bhāṣyakārasya | 
e vṛhiśca yadi prakṛtyantaramastīti | tatastasyāpi nipātanamityarthaḥ
| tadeva prayojanamiti | asiddhatvābhāvaḥ | 
e athaṃ kathaṃ parivṛḍhayyetyatra lyabādeśaḥ, yāvatā parivṛḍhamācaṣṭe
iti vigrahe tata eva ṇic kartavyaḥ, samudāyasya ca dhātutvāt
ktvāpratyayo'pi tata thaeva kartavyaḥ, tataśca parerapi
ktvānte'ntarbhāvānnāyaṃ samāsaḥ, iha ca parivraḍhayatīti pariśabdasya
tiṅnte'ntarbhavāt tiṅḍatiṅḥ iti nidhāto na syāt ityata āha -
parivṛḍhamācaṣṭa iti vigṛhyaeti | ṇijutpadyata iti | ṇyantaṃ paṭhitavyam
| aṇyantapāṭhe tu vigṛhyaeti ktvāpratyayo na syāt,
asamānakartṛkatvāt | sgrāmayatereva sopasargāditi | tayadatra
vaktavyaṃ tad bhṛśādibhyo bhuvyacveḥ ityatraivoktam | nighāto
bhavatīti | aḍdvirvacanayorapyupalakṣaṇametat - paryavraḍhayat,
parivivraḍhayiṣati | parivṛṃhitamiti | vṛṃheḥ pratyudāharaṇam |
parivṛhitamiti | vṛheḥ || 
ekṛcchragahanayoḥ kaṣaḥ || 7 - 2 - 22 || 
e kaṣatirhisārthaḥ | kaṣṭo'gniriti | cīyamāno'gniratrāgniśabdena
vivakṣitaḥ, sa kaṣṭo bhavati, cayanaprakārasya durjñānatvāt |
vyākaramasya kaṣṭatvamiḍāgamādivyavasthāyā durjñānatvāt | sānnaṃ
kaṣṭatvaṃ varṣabhadasya 
esvarasya stomādīnāṃ ca durjñānatvāt | kāraṇamapīti | lakṣaṇayā,
kṛcchramiti vyutpatyā vā || 
edhuṣiraviśabdane || 7 - 2 - 23 || 
e ghuṣṭā - aviśabditā | avadhuṣitam - viśabditam,
āviṣkṛtābhiprāyamityarthaḥ | caurādikasya cāyaṃ prayogaḥ sa eva
hyasminnarthe vartate | dvāvapīti | ghuṣiriti sūtropātaṃ rupaṃ
dvayorapi sādhāraṇamityarthaḥ | kathaṃ sāmānyena grahaṇam, yāvatā
viśabdane ṇicā bhavitavyam, kevalaśceha ghuṣirupātaḥ ata tāaha -
viśabdanapratiṣedhaśceti | viśabdanārthasyānitya iti | anye tu
anityaṇyantāścanarādayaḥ iti sāmānyena jñāpakamāhuḥ | apara āha - 
e citi smṛtyāmitīditvamatra jñāpakamasya hi | 
e phalaṃ cintita tityādau na lopo mā sma bhūditi || 
e nitye ca ṇici satyatra nalopasyāprasaṅgataḥ | 
e cinta smṛtyāmityeva ca paṭhitavyaṃ bhavediti || 
e ayamapīti | yadyapi avadhuṣitaṃ vākyamāha - ityetadapi prayojanam,
tathāpi jughuṣurityapi prayoga upapanna ityarthaḥ || 
eabhoścāvidūrthe || 7 - 2 - 25 || 
e viśeṣeṇa dūraṃ vidūraṃ tato'nyaditi |
tatpunaryadāsannamaviprakṛṣṭṃa vā bhavati tadveditavyam | tasya bhāva
āvidūryamiti | brāhmaṇāderākṛtigaṇatvāt ṣyañ | nanu ca na
nañpūrvātatpuruṣāt iti pratiṣedhaḥ prāpnoti tatrāha -
etasmādeveti | na nañpūrvāt ityamayadhikāraḥ, tena tataḥ
sūtrādutarasya bhāṣapratyayasya pratiṣedhastatra kriyata iti
utarasyetyuktam || 
eṇeradhyayane vṛtam || 7 - 2 - 26 || 
e adhīyat ityadhyayanamiti kṛtyalyuṭo bahulam iti karmaṇi lyuṭ |
niṣaṭhāviśeṣaṇaṃ caitat - adhyayanābhidhāyinyāṃ niṣṭhāyāmiti |
ṇilukveti | pratyayalakṣaṇena guṇo mā bhūditi ṇerlugnipātanam,
lopanipātane tu guṇaḥ syāt | vṛto guṇo devadeteneti |
guṇaḥ - pāṭhaḥ, padakramasaṃhitārupo'dhyayanaviśeṣaḥ, sa vṛtaḥ -
sampādita ityarthaḥ | 
e vṛttirayamityādinā sūtrasyānārambhamāśaṅkate | akarmaka iti vṛtaṃ
guṇasuya, vṛtaṃ pārāyāṇasyate bhāve ktasya prayogārthamidamuktam |
akarmakatve hi bhāve niṣṭhā bhavati tayoreva ityatra bhāve
cākarmakebhyaḥ ityanuvṛteḥ | yo'pi napuṃsake bhāve ktaḥ, so'pi
sakarmakebhyo na bhavati tayoreva ityatra ktamātrasya grahaṇāt | anyathā
sakramakādbhāve kte vidhīyamāne karmaṇi dvitīyā prajyeta - grāmaṃ
gatam, odanaṃ bhuktamiti | yadi tarhyakarmakaḥ, kathaṃ 
evṛto guṇa iti karmaṇi niṣṭhā ityāśaṅkyāha - sa ṇyarthe vartamāne
iti | yadi vā - ayaṃ vṛttirakarmakaḥ sa ṇyarthe vartamānaḥ ityeka eva
granthaḥ, akarmakā api dhātavo'ntarbhāvitaṇyarthāḥ prayojyena karmaṇā
sakarmakā bhavanti, yathā - rājayudhveti, dṛśyate ca
vṛterantarbhāvitaṇyarthasya prayoga ityāha - tena nirvṛttimiti hīti
| na cātropasargavaśātsakarmakatvam, ṇyarthagateḥ vṛteṇici yo'rthaḥ |
nivartyate yairniyamābhiṣekaḥ ityādau tadavagaterityarthaḥ| tatasmāt
| vṛtereveti | prakṛtyantādevetyarthaḥ | vṛto guṇa iti | udito
vā iti ktvāyāṃ vikalpiteṭkatvād yasya vibhāṣā
itīṭpratiṣedhaḥ siddhaḥ | tadevaṃ nipātanamanarthakamityeva mataṃ
codyam | pariharati - tatkriyata iti |
iṣṭasyānyathāsiddhāvapyaniṣṭanivṛtyarthaṃ nipātanasityarthaḥ | apare
tviti | teṣāṃ mate nānenārthaḥ sūtreṇa || 
evā dāntaśāntapūrṇadastaspaṣṭacchannajñaptāḥ || 7 - 2 - 27 || 
e dāntaḥ, śānta iti | damiśamī upaśamanārthe | ṇalugiṭpratiṣedhayoḥ
anunāsikasya kvijhaloḥ iti dīrghaḥ | nipātyamānasya ca
ṇiluko'paranimitakatvāddīrghavidhiṃ prati niṣedhācca
sthānivadbhāvo nāsti | pūrṇa iti | pūrī āpyāyane divādiḥ,
curādiśca | dasta iti | tasu upakṣaye damu ca | atra hrasvatvamapi
nipātyate | spaṣṭaḥ cchanna iti | spaśabādhanasparśanayoḥ, cchada apavāraṇe
| atrāpi hrasvatvamapi nipātyate | jñapta iti | jñapa micca, 
ecurādiḥ | iṭpratiṣedho ṇilukca nipātyata iti |
cakārātkvacidupadhāhrasvatvaṃ ca | kvacitpaṭha|lte -
jñapebhaṃrajñapisanāmiti vikalpividhānādyasya vibhāṣetīṭpratiṣedhe
prāpte vikalpārthe nipātanamiti | ekājgrahaṇam yasya vibhāṣā ityatra
nānuvartata iti bhāvaḥ | 
e atrāditaścaturṇāṃ grahaṇaṃ śakyamakartum | katham
antarbhavitaṇyarthānāṃ prakṛtyantānāṃ dānta ityādīni rupāṇi, anyatra
ṇyantānāṃ damita ityādīni || 
eruṣyamatvarasaṃghuṣāsvanām || 7 - 2 - 28 || 
e abhyānta iti | ama gatyādiṣu, purvavaddīrghaḥ | tṝṇa iti | ñitvarā
sambhrame, jvaratvara taityādinoṭha | āditaścetīṭpratiṣedhe prāpta
iti | āditve tu prayojanaṃ mṛgyam | ātmanepadārthaṃ
tāvatkaścidanubandha thāasañjanīyaḥ | kaścidāha - āditvaṃ
yaṅlugarthamiti, na hi tatrāyaṃ vikalpaḥ, ekācaḥ ityanuvṛteḥ |
āditkaraṇasāmarthyāccānubandhano'pi āditaśca itīṭpiratiṣedho
yaṅluki bhavati | sampūrvas dhuṣeriti | ghuṣiraviśabdane
ityasyāsampūrvo'vakāśaḥ - ghuṣṭā rajjuḥ, asya vikalpasyāvakāśaḥ
sampūrvatve sati viśabdane - saṃghuṣṭṃa vākyamāha,
saṃpūrvasyāviśabdane vipratiṣedhaḥ | āṅpūrvasyetyādi |
kṣubdhasvānta iti nipātanasyāvakāśo'nāṅpūrvatve sati
mano'bhidhāne - svāntaṃ mana iti , asya vikalpasyāvakāśaḥ, -
āṅpūrvatve satyamano'bhidhāne āṅpūrvatve mano'bhidhāne ca
sati vipratiṣedhaḥ || 
ehṛṣerlomasu || 7 - 2 - 29 || 
e hṛṣṭāni - utsphuṭāni, mūddhaṃjāḥ - keśāḥ | aṅgāntarajāni
lomāni iti nighaṇṭuaprasiddhiḥ | kalpasūtrakāraṇāmapi tadanuguṇāḥ
prayogāḥ - keśaśmaśrulomanakhaṃ vāpayanti iti, taiha tu keśānāmapi
grahaṇam ityāha - mūrddhajānyaṅgajāni ceti | atra viśeṣyaṃ mṛghyam |
sāmānyena gṛhyanta iti | kva yathā ityātrāha - yatheti | nanu
kriyāvacanasya dhātoḥ kathaṃ dravyātmakeṣu lomasu vṛttiḥ ityata āha -
tadviṣaye ceti | pratihatāḥ kaṭhinadravyākhādanena, śītapīṅyā vā
hatā ityarthaḥ || 
eapacitaśca || 7 - 2 - 30 || 
e apacito'nena gururiti | cāyṛ pūjāniśāmanoyoḥ | niśāmane
cāyaṃ prayogaḥ | pūjāyāṃ tu matibuddhipūjārthebhyaśca iti vartamāne
kte sati ktasya ca vartamāne iti ṣaṣṭha|la bhavitavyam | ktini nityamiti
| ktinnābādibhyaḥ iti ktin | anyathā gurośca halaḥ ityākāraḥ syāt
|| 
ehrau hvareścchandasi || 7 - 2 - 31 || 
e hvareriti | hvṛ kauṭilye | āgantukekāre guṇena nirddeśaḥ || 
eaparihvṛtāśca || 7 - 2 - 32 || 
e ādeśasyābhāva iti | pūrvasūtreṇa prāptasya |
vahūvacananirddeśaścchandasi tasyaiva prayogadarśanāt || 
esome hvaritiḥ || 7 - 2 - 33 || 
e iḍāgamo guṇaśceti | cakārādādeśābhāvaśca || 
egrasitaskamitastabhitotabhitacatavikastā
viśastṛśastṛśāstṛtarutṛtarutṛvarutṛvarutṛvarutrīrujjvalitikṣaritikṣamitivamityamitīti caḥ || 
egrasu adane, skambhu stumbhu rodhanārthau, sautrau, cate yācane, kasa
gatau, śasu hiṃsāyām, śaṃsu stutau, śāsu anuśiṣṭau, tṛ
plavanataraṇayoḥ, vṛṅ varaṇe, jvala dīptau, kṣara sañcalane, kṣamūṣ
sahane, duvama udgiraṇe, amagatyādiṣu | utābhiteti | udaḥ
sthāstambhoḥ pūrvasya iti pūrvasarvaṇaḥ, sakārasya takāraḥ |
anyopasargapūrvaḥ stabhitaśabdo na bhavatīti | yadi syāt,
utabhitagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt | nipātanabahutvāpekṣamiti | tena
chāndasaḥ prayogaḥ ekavacanānto'pyudāhṛta iti bhāvaḥ | 
e itikaraṇaḥ pradarśanārtha iti | tasya prakārārthatvāt || 
eārdhadhātukasyeṅvalādeḥ || 7 - 2 - 35 || 
e āste, vasta iti | nanu ca rudādibhyaḥ sārvadhātuke ityetanniyamārtha
bhaviṣyati - rudādibhya eva 
esārvadhātuka iti tatrāha - rudādibhyaḥ sārvadhātuka ityetastaminniti
| niyame tvetasmin vijñāyamāne viparīto'pi niyamaḥ sambhāvyate
- rudādibhayaḥ sārvadhātuke eveti | tatra ca vaktavyaṃ rudavideti
ktvāsanoḥ kitvavidhānānna bhaviṣyati | tāniṭaḥ sano
jhalāderhalantācca ityeva siddhatvāt | ktvo'pyaniṭa
aupadeśikakitvasadbhāvāditi, tataśca pratipatigauravaṃ syāt |
nanu cāsatyārdhadhātukagrahataṇe aṅgsya ityadhikāratasyaiveṭ
prāpnoti, yathā luṅlaṅlṛṅkṣvaḍudātaḥ iti jñāpakātsiddham,
yadayam ekāca upadeśeṣanudātāt iti pratyayasyaṭpratiṣedhaṃ
śāsti, yacca niṣṭhāyāṃ seṭi na ktvā seṭ ityāha, tajjñāpayati -
pratyayasyaivāyamiḍiti | na ca vṛkṣatvamityādau pratipadikapratyayasya
prasaṅgaḥ, āñta taiddhatoḥ ityadhikārāt | evamapi jugupsate,
lbhyām, lūbhirityādau prasaṅgaḥ idito num dhātoḥ ityato
dvitīyamapi dhātugrahaṇamanuvartiṣyate, tatraikaṃ svarupapadārthakam,
tataśca dhātoḥ ityevaṃ dhātusaṃśbadanena vihitasya dhātoḥ
parasyeḍvidhānānna kvāpyaniṣṭṃa rūpam | tadevaṃ
bahupratividheyatvāt pratipatigauravaparihārtham ārdhadhātukasya
ityuktam | 
e pratiṣedhanivṛtyarthamiti | kena punaḥ prāptasya pratiṣedhaḥ śaṅkyate
idameva vacanaṃ kalpakaṃ syāt - astyārddhadhātukamātrasyeṭ, yato
valādeḥ pratiṣidhyata iti | taneṅvaśi kṛti thaityādikastu
pratiṣedho niyamārthaḥ syāt || 
esnukramoranātmanepadanimite || 7 - 2 - 36 || 
e snukramorudātatvādiṭi siddhe niyamārthaṃ vacanam -
anātmanepadanimita eva yathā syādanyatra mā bhūditi | atha prasnutaḥ,
prasnutavān, prasusnūṣati, krāntaḥ, krāntavān - ityatra rśyukaḥ
kiti, sani grahaguhośca, yasya vibhāṣā iti pratiṣedhe prāpte
vidhyarthametatkasmānna bhavati purastātpratiṣedhakāṇḍakaraṇāt | tasya
hi prayojanam - anāśritavidhānaviśeṣasyeṇmātrasya pratiṣedho yathā
syāditi | yadyanātmanepadanimita iti prasajyapratiṣedhaḥ
snukramorātmanepadanimitatve satīṇna bhavatīti, evaṃ ca
pratiṣedhaprakaraṇa evaitatpaṭhitavyam, tatrāyabhaṣyatheḥ - nañupādānaṃ na
kartavyaṃ bhavati tathā tu na kṛtamityeva | 
e atra yadyātmanepadaśabdena nañaḥ samāsaṃ kṛtvā paścānnimitaśabdena
ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ kriyeta - ātmanepadādanyadanātmanepadam,
parasmaipadamiti yāvat, tasya nimitam, tataśca yatra snukramau
parasmaipadanimite - cakramitha, cakramiva, cakramima, prāsnāvīt,
prasusnuvivetyādau - tatraiveḍbhavatītyarthaḥ syāt, tataśca kṛti na
syāt - prasnavitā, prastravitum, prasnavitavyam, prakramitā,
prakramitum, prakramitavyamiti, tathā cikramiṣatītyatrāpi na syāt, na
hi sanantādutpadyamānasya parasmaipadasya kramirnimitam,
parasmaipadagrahaṇameva ca kartavyaṃ syāt, tasmādātmanepadaśabdasya
nimitaśabdena samāsaṃ kṛtvā paścānnañā samāsaḥ kartavyaḥ |
prasajyapratiṣedhe tvanunmeṣa evāsya pakṣasya syāt | tatra
yadyanātmanepadanimita iti saptamyekavacanaṃ syāt, tato'yamarthaḥ
syāt - ātmanepadasya yannimitaṃ ṅkārādi tasminsati na bhavatīti,
tataśca prasnavitrīyata ityatrāpi pratiṣedhaḥ syāt, vidyate
hyatrātmanepadasya nimitam kyaṅe ṅkāra iti | prathamādvivacanāntaṃ
snukramorviśeṣaṇamiti darśayati - na cet snukramau ātmanepadasya
nimitamiti | vedāḥ pramāṇam itivadekavacanam | sūtre tu pratyekaṃ
nimitatvasya vivakṣitatvāt dvivacanam | nimitaśabdo'yamasti
yogyatāmātre - kusūlastheṣvapi bījeṣu vaktāro bhavanti -
aṅkuranimitānyatānīti asti ca kurvadrūpe | tatrādye pakṣe kṛtyāpi
pratiṣedhaḥ syāt - prasnavitā, prasnavitum, prasnavitavyam,
prakramitā, prakrimitum, prakramitavyamiti | asti hyatra yathāyogaṃ
bhāvakarmakartṛviṣayatvādātmanepadaṃ prati yogyatvam, tadiha kiṃ
vivakṣitam iti pṛcchati - kva ca tāvātmanepadasya nimitamiti |
itaro'pi kurvadrūpapakṣāśrayaṇena pariharati - yatretyādi | atraivaṃ
vyākhyeyam - yatrātmanepadaṃ tadāśrayaṃ bhavati tatraivātmanepadasya 
enimitam | kiṃ punastadyatra tadāśrayamātmanepadaṃ bhavati ityata āha -
bhāvakarmetyādi | atra hi viṣaye snukramyoḥ śrūyamāṇamātmanepadaṃ
bhavatīti, kurvadrūpa eva nimitaśabdo mukhyaḥ, yogyatāmātre
tvaupacārika iti bhāvaḥ | nanu ca bhāvakarmādiṣu ta evārthā
ātmanepadasya nimitam, snukramī, kva tarhi pratiṣedhaḥ syād yatra hi
krimireva nimitam, anupasargādvā - kraṃsyate naiṣa doṣaḥ,
bhāvakarmakartāraḥ krameśca vṛtyādayaḥ | sarvamevaitaddhātoreva
viṣayatayā viśeṣaṇam, dhātureva tu sākṣādātmanepadasya mimitam
- bhāvādiviṣayāddhātorātmanepadaṃ bhavatīti | tenetyādi | yata 
eevaṃ kurvadrūpamevātra nimitam, tenāyaṃ satyātmanepade pratiṣedha
ityarthaḥ | 
e kimucyate pratiṣedha iti, yāvatā paryudāsāśrayeṇokapakrame
vyākhyātam tatrāha - pratiṣedhaphalaṃ cedaṃ sūtramiti | satyaṃ
paryudāse'pi niyamārthatvānniyamasya
cetaravyāvṛttiphalakatvādevamuktamityarthaḥ | 
e prasnoṣīṣṭeti | āśiṣi liṅ, bhāvakarmaṇoḥ ityātmanepadam |
prakaṃsīṣṭeti | atra tu propābhyāṃ samarthābhyām iti kartari |
sarvatretyādinā sūtrārthamudāharaṇe darśayati | nanu
sanantādvidhīyamānasyātmanepadasya sa eva dhāturnimitaṃ na snukramī
tatrāha - sanantādapīti | pūrvavaditi vacanātprakṛtigatameva
sanante'pi nimitamiti bhāvaḥ | yadā tarhi
sanantādbhāvakarmaṇorātmanepadaṃ tadā pratiṣedho na prāpnoti, na
hi tadā prakṛtigataṃ nimitamapekṣitam, kiṃ tarhi sanantameva svatantraṃ
nimitam, putrīyata tyāidivat evaṃ tarhi
sanantādbhāvakarmaṇorapi pūrvavatsanaḥ ityātmanepadaṃ bhaviṣyati
etayorarthayoḥ sanprakṛtāvātmanepadasya dṛṣṭatvāt | tatra yadyapi
sanantamapi svayameva nimitamupapadyate, tathāpi bhāvakarmaṇoḥ
ityasyāvakāśaḥ - bhūyate, pacyate pūrvavatsanaḥ ityasyāvakāsaḥ -
śiśayiṣate sanantādbhāvakarmaṇorubhayaprasaṃge paratvāt
pūrvavatsanaḥ ityanena bhaviṣyati | yadi paraṃ viśeṣo nāstītyucyate
tadapi na atraiva viśeṣasya sambhavāt | evamapi na sidhyati,
pūrvavatsanaḥ ityatra kartari karmavyatihāre ityataḥ kartarītyanuvṛteḥ
| tatra hi prakaraṇe sarvajñaiva kartariti sambadhyate | athāpi na
sambadhyate, evamapi yadā sanantād ṇici kṛte ṇicaśca iti,
bhāvakarmaṇoḥ iti vā ātmanepadam, tadā pratiṣedho na sidhyati -
cikraṃsyate, cikraṃsyata iti | kiṃ ca - bhostadānīmapi pratiṣedha iṣyate
bāḍhamiṣyate | yadāha vārtikakāraḥ - siddhaṃ tu snorātmanepadena
samānapadasthasyoṭpratiṣedhāt, krameśca iti | tadevamātmanepadena
samānapadasthatve pratiṣedhaṃ kurvato vārtikakārasyaivaṃvidhe viṣaye
pratiṣedha iṣṭo lakṣyate | yathā punarvṛttikāreṇa vyākakhyātaṃ tathā na
prāpnoti kartavyo'tra yatraḥ | 
e yadi satyātmanepade pratiṣedhaḥ mā kāri nimitagrahaṇam
anātmanepade ityevāstu, satisaptamī vijñāsyate - ātmanepade sati
na bhavatīti, yadyetallabhyate kṛtaṃ syāt, tatu na labhyam, śāstre yāḥ
saptamyastāḥ sarvā parasaptamya iti niyamāt parasapatamyāṃ tu yadi
snukramorviśeṣaṇaṃ snukramorātmanepade'nantara iti, siddhaṃ
prasnoṣīṣṭa, prakrasīṣṭa, prasnoṣyate, prakraṃsyate - atra na prāpnoti,
syena vyavahitatvāt | ārthārdhadhātukasya viśeṣaṇam - snukramibhyāṃ
parasyārdhadhātukasyātmanepade'nantara iti siddhaṃ prasnoṣyate,
prakraṃsyate, prasnoṣīṣṭa, prakraṃsīṣṭa - atra na prāpnoti, sīyuṭa
ātmanepadabhaktatvāt | ubhayathāpi pracikraṃsiṣyate - atra na prāpnoti,
na hyatra kramestatparasya sārvadhātukasyātmanepadamanantaram |
tasmānnimitagrahaṇaṃ kartavyam | tadāhanimitagrahaṇamityādi |
tadātmanepadaṃ paraṃ yasmātsa tatapraḥ, pracikrasiṣyate ityādau
syapratyayaḥ, sa paro yasmātsa tatparaḥ, sanpratyayaḥ | iha tvityādi |
prageva vyākyātam | prasnavitrīyata iti | rīṅ ṛtaḥ |
vātikakāramate'pyatra pratiṣedho na bhavati, katham samānapadasthasya
iti vacanāt iḍāgamena padāvasthāpekṣaṇīyā | tatra tṛci
vibhaktāvutpannāyāṃ labdhe'pi padatve ātmanepadasyāsannidhānādiṭ
pravartate | pratikraṃsiṣyata ityatra tu
padāvasthāyāmātmanepadasannidhānāt pratiṣedhapravṛttiḥ| 
eātmanepadaviṣayāditi | tadyegyādityarthaḥ | satyātmanepade pratiṣedha
ityuktatvādidamārabhyate | anupasargātkrameḥ krantā, kramitā -
ityubhayamapi bhavati anupasargādvā iti
vakalpenātmanepadanimitatvādityeke | anye
tvātmanepadaviṣayāditi ananyabhāve viṣayaśabdaṃ varṇayantaḥ
krimitetyeva bhavitavyamityāhuḥ | 
e snauteḥ sani kiti ceti | upalakṣaṇametat | krameśca niṣṭhāyām
yasya vibhāṣā iti draṣṭavyam | pratiṣadho bhavatīti | atra hetuḥ
prāgevoktaḥ || 
e graho'liṭi dīrghaḥ || 7 - 2 - 37 || 
e graha utarasyeṭa iti | kathaṃ punariṭo dīrghatvaṃ labhyate, iḍiti
yatprakṛtaṃ tadvai prathamānirdiṣṭṃa ṣaṣṭhīnirdiṣṭena cehārthaḥ evaṃ tarhi
ṣaṣṭha|lntapraparaṃ kariṣyāmi | evamapi doṣaḥ, prakṛtamiṭamanapekṣyeṭa
ityucyamāne'viśeṣācciṇvadiṭo'pi dīrghaprasaṅgaḥ astu tarhi
praśamāntameva | tatra dīrgha iṭ bhavatīti sāmānādhikaraṇyenānvaye
sāmarthyādīḍāgame vidhiḥ sampadyate | iṭ dīrgha iti
cedvipratiṣiddham, yadiṭ na dīrghajha, 
eatha dīrgho neṭ, iṭ dīrghaśceti vipratiṣiddham syādetat - dīrgha
iḍadbhavatītyukte sāmarthyāvdyaktiparatyāgera ikārajātirāśrīyate,
dīrghagrahaṇācca tavdyaktisamavetā sā vidhīyata iti | evamapi doṣaḥ,
vivarīṣate ityatra sanīṭi prapte vṛto vā ityanena pakṣe dīrgha iṭi
ca prasakte sani grahaguhośca ityubhayasminnapi pratiṣiddhe iṭ sani
veti pakṣe iḍvidhīyate | tatra punariṭo vidhānābhāvātpakṣe dīrgha
īkāro na śrūyeteti naiṣa doṣaḥ iṭ sani vā ityatra dīrgha iṭ iti,
vṛtaḥ iti cānuvartiṣyate | yatarhi videśasthamiṭṃa pratiṣidhya
purvidhānaṃ tatra na sidhyati - jṛvraścoḥ ktvi, jaritvā, jarītvā,
atrodātatvādiṭ prāptaḥ vṛto vā ityanena ca dīrgha iṭ, tato
dvayorapi rśyukaḥ kiti caiti pratiṣedhe punariḍvidhīyate, na ca
tatra dīrghagrahaṇasyānuvṛttisambhavaḥ | nanu ca rśyukaḥ kiti ityatra
neḍvaśi ityadhikārāvdyaktipakṣāśrayaṇācca iṭa ekamātrasya niṣedhaḥ, na
dīrghasyeṭaḥ, tataḥ kim vṛto vā ityanena vihito dīrgha iṭ
tatheva sthitaḥ, jṛvraścoḥ ktvi ityanena ceṭ pratiprasūyate iti
jaritvā, carītveti davyamapi siddhaṃ bhavati syādevaṃ
yadyāgamāntaramīḍvīdhīyate, iha tu iḍ dīrghaḥ, iti
vacanādiṭakāryamasyāpi bhavatyeva | anyathā agrahīdityatra hmyantakṣaṇa
iti vṛddhapratiṣedhaḥ iṭa īṭi iti sijlopaśca agrahīḍhvam,
agrahīdhvam, vibhāṣeṭaḥ iti mūrddhanyavikalpaḥ, jarītveti na ktvā
seṭ iti kitvapratiṣedhaḥ ityete vidhayo na sidhyeyuḥ |
tasmādiṭkāryamasyāpīṭo bhavatītyaṅgīkartavyam, tataśca
videśasthaṃ pratiṣidhya punarvidhāne sthita eva doṣaḥ syāt,
tasmāddīrdha iḍaśakyo vidhātum | evaṃ tarhi ārdhadhātukasya iti
vartate, graha utarasyārddhadhātukasya dīrgho bhavati | ihāpi tarhi
prāpnoti - grahaṇīyam valādeḥ iti vartate | ihāpi tarhi na
prāpnoti - grītā, grahītumiti bhūtapūrvagatirvijñāsyate | ihāpi
tarhi prāpnoti - grāhaka iti astu tarhi iḍityeva | nanu coktaṃ
ṣaṣṭhīnirddeṣṭena cehārtha iti grahaḥ iti pañcamī iḍiti prathamāyāḥ
ṣaṣṭhī prakalpayiṣyati - tasmādityutarasya iti | 
e prakṛtasyeti | ārdhadhātukasyeḍ ityanantaraṃ vihitasya |
ciṇvadiṭo na bhavatīti | jaritvetyatra tu ārdhadhātukasyeḍ
ityayameveṭ pratiṣiddhaḥ pratiprasūyate iti bhavatyeva dīrghaḥ | iha
jarīgṛhiteti yaṅntātṛcyallopayalopayoḥ kṛtayordviṣprayogo
dvirvacanamiti sa evāyaṃ grahiriti dīrghaḥ prāpnoti pūrvasmādapi
vidhau yaḥ sthānivadbhāvaḥ so'pi dīrghavidhau pratiṣiddhaḥ |
tasmādvihitaviśeṣaṇamihāśrayaṇīyam - graheryadvihitamārdhadhātukaṃ
tasya ya iṭ tasya dīrgha iti | 
evṛto vā || 7 - 2 - 38 || 
e atra yadi vṛ varaṇe ityetasya tasilā nirddeśaḥ syāt vraḥ ityeva
nirdiśyeta, yathā gro yaṅ īti | atha tasya ṛkārāntānāṃ ca grahaṇam
evamapi tasya pṛthaggrahaṇamanarthakam, ṛkārāntatvāt | atha tasya
ṛkārāntānāṃ 
eca tathā ca sati ṛtaśca saṃyogādeḥ ityatra ṛtaḥ iti na vaktavyam
asyaivānuvṛteḥ | atha vṛṅvṛñoḥ ṛkārāntānāṃ ca tathāpi
vṛgrahaṇamanarthakamṛkārāntatvāt |
tasmādvṛttikāropadarśitānāmeva grahaṇam | 
e vṛta iti kimiti | uḥ iti vaktavyamiti manyate || 
ena līṅ || 7 - 2 - 39 || 
e vistariṣīṣṭeti | karmaṇyātmanepadam || 
esici ca parasmaipadeṣu || 7 - 2 - 40 || 
e atāriṣṭāmiti | tṛ plavanataraṇayoḥ | astāriṣṭamiti | stañ
ācchādane, ñidubhayapadī || 
eiṭ sani vā || 7 - 2 - 41 || 
e atrātistīrṣatīti parasmaidapāṭho na yuktaḥ || 
eliṅasicorātmanepadeṣu || 7 - 2 - 42 || 
e ātmanepade pare iti | sica evaitadviśeṣaṇam, na liṅḥ, asambhavāt
| na caivaṃ tasya parasmaipade'pi prasaṅgaḥ valādeḥ ityadhikārāt |
prāvṛṣīṣṭetyādau uśca iti kitvam || 
eṛtaśca saṃyogāderguṇaḥ || 7 - 2 - 43 || 
e udārahaṇeṣu bhāvakarmaṇoḥ ātmanepadam | 
e saṃskṛṣīṣṭeti | samaḥ suṭi ityatra sampuṃkānāṃ so vaktavyaḥ iti
vacanāt satvam || 
esvaratisūtisūyatidhūñūdito vā || 7 - 2- 44 || 
e atra svarateranudātatvādaprāpte, taitareṣāṃ tu prāpte vibhāṣā | 
e veti vatamāna iti | iṭ sani vā ityataḥ |
liṅasicornivṛtyarthamiti | anyathā
vāgrahataṇasambaddhayostayorapyanuvṛttiḥ syāt | pūpreraṇa ityasya
nivṛtyartha iti | anyathā niranubandhakatvātasyaiva grahakakaṇaṃ syāt |
evaṃ tarhi sūṅiti vaktavyam evamapi
lugvikaraṇālugvikarakaṇayoralugvikaraṇasyaiva grahakaṇam iti
sūyatereva grahaṇaṃ syāt, na sūteḥ | tasyāḥ paribhāṣāyā
astitve'yameva vikaraṇanirddeśo jñāpakaḥ | dhūvidhūnana ityasya
nivṛtyartha iti | anyathā pūrvavatasyaiva grahaṇaṃ syāt | dhuviteti |
kuṭāditvānḍitvam | 
e svarateriti | asya vikalpasyāvakāśaḥ - svartā, svaritā, ṛddhanoḥ
sye ityasyāvakāśaḥ - kariṣyati, svarateḥ sye ubhayaprasaṅge
vipratiṣedhaḥ | kiti tu pratyaya rśyuka iti | nanu cāyaṃ vikalpo
yathā ekājlakṣaṇaṃ pratiṣedhaṃ bādhate tṛjādau, tathā killakṣaṇamapi
pratiṣedhaṃ bādheta na bādheta, katham yena nāprāpte tasya bādhanaṃ
bhavati | tasmādapabādatā tāvadekājlakṣaṇameva pratiṣedhaṃ pratyasya
bhavati, kityubhayaprasaṅge purastātpratiṣedhakāṇḍakaraṇātpratiṣedha eva
bhavati | liṅgācca, yadayam svṛyūrṇubharajñapisanām iti vikalpaṃ
śāsti, anyathā anenaiva satyapi vikalpasya siddhatvātpunastaṃ na
vidadhyāt | vṛtau tu vipratiṣedhaśabdenāpi
purastātpratiṣedhakāṇḍakaraṇameva vivakṣitam, samānaphalatvāt || 
eradhādibhyaśca || 7 - 2 - 45 || 
e radhirnaśistṛpidṛpī druhirmuhi ṣṇuhiṣṇihī | 
e radhādayo'mī paṭhitā divādiṣvaṣṭa kṛṣṭibhiḥ || 
e neṣṭeti | masjinaśorjhala iti num | tṛpidṛpyoḥ - anudātasya
cardupadhasya iti pakṣe amāgamaḥ | droḍheatyādau vā
druhamuhaṣṇuraṣṇihām iti dhatvaḍhatve | 
e krādiniyamāditi | nanu ca pratiṣedhasyāsau niyamaḥ, na ca radhādau
kasyacitpratyayāśrayaḥ prakṛtyāśrayo vā pratiṣedhaḥ prāpnoti, yayorapi
prāpnoti tṛpidṛpyoḥ, tayorapi pratiṣedhe liṭa|lnena
vyāvartite'pyayaṃ vikalpaḥ syādeva, vikalpasyāniyatatvāt evaṃ
manyate -- yāvānkaścidiḍabhāvaḥ pratiṣedhanibandhano
vikalpanibandhano vā, tasya sarvasya krādisūtreṇa niyamaḥ iti | evaṃ
cotaragranthe pratiṣedhaniyamasyeti abhāvaniyamasthetyevārtho draṣṭavyaḥ
| apara iti | nanu cāstu pratiṣedhasya prābalyam, kimāyātam
niyamasya pratiṣedhaviṣayatvānniyamasyāpi prābalyamityadoṣaḥ |
nityamiṭā bhavitavyamiti | pratiṣedhādhikāreṇa krādīnāmeva liṭi
iṇna bhavati taiti niyame vijñāyamāne dhātvantareṣu yāvān
kaścitpratiṣedhaḥ sa sarvo mā bhūt, vikalpastu kasmānna syāditi || 
eniraḥ kuṣaḥ || 7 - 2 - 46 || 
e niṣkoṣṭoti | idudupadhasya cāpratyayasya iti ṣatvam | nisa iti
vaktavya iti | pradiṣu hi nisiti paṭha|lte, tathā ca nisastapatau titi
nirdeśa iti bhāvaḥ | kimetasya jñāpane prayojanam ityata āha -
tasyeti | nanu naca nitya eva rutve kṛte latvaṃ bhaviṣyati tatrāha -
niso hīti || 
eiṇniṣaṭhāyām || 7 - 2 - 47 || 
e iḍiti vartamāne punariḍgrahaṇaṃ kimartham ityata āha --
iḍgrahaṇa nityārthamiti | nanvārambhasāmarthyādeva nityamiḍ
bhaviṣyati, vikalpasya pūrvoṇeva siddhatvāt ityata āha - ārambho
hīti | yadi tarhi nityārthamiḍagrahaṇaṃ kriyate, utaratrāpi nitya eva
vidhiḥ syāt ityata tāaha -- ātraiveti || 
etīṣasahalubharuṣariṣaḥ || 7 - 2 - 49 || 
e iṣu icchāyāmityāsyeti | taudādikasya | preṣiteti | eiṅ
pararupam | uditaṃ paṭhantīti | dhātupāṭhe icchārthamuditaṃ paṭhitvā
thaihāpyukāropādānena tasyaiva grahakakaṇaṃ varṇayantītyarthaḥ | idameva
coditvasya prayojanam ktvāyāmiḍvikalpasyānenaiva sūtreṇa
siddhatvāt | ye tūditaṃ na paṭhanti, te sahinā sāhacaryādicchārthasya
grahaṇamāhuḥ | ubhayorapyakāramātraṃ vikarakaṇa iti | yathā tu vārtikaṃ
tathā kraiyādikasyāpyatra grahaṇamiṣyate, yadāha -- iṣestakāre
śyanpratyayāt pratiṣedhaḥ iti, tanmate troya'pi niranubandhakāḥ || 
esanīvantardhabhrasjadambhuśrisvṛyūrṇubharajñapisanām || 7 - 2 - 49 || 
e bhrasjerekāca iti | śrayaterugantānāṃ ca sani grahaguhośca iti
pratiṣedhaḥ prāptaḥ itareṣāṃ tu nityamiṭ prāptaḥ, takṣedamārabhyate
ardidhiṣatīti | laghūpadhalakṣaṇe guṇe ajāderdvitīyasya iti dhis
ityasya dvirvajanam, rephasya tu na ndrāḥ iti pratiṣedhaḥ | īrtsatīti |
āpjñapyṛdhāmīt taiti ṛkārasya rapara īkāraḥ, dhakāreṇa saśabdasya
dvirvacanam, atra lopo'bhyāsasya | 
e bibhrajjiṣatīti | bhrasco ropadhayo ramanyatarasyām | vibhrakṣatīti |
vraścādinā ṣatvam, ṣaḍhoḥ kaḥ si | 
e dhipsatīti | dambha icca itītvamitvaṃ ca, halantācca iti kitve
nalopaḥ, pūrvavadabhyāsalopaḥ | 
e yiyaviṣatīti | oḥ puyaṇjyapare ityabhyāsasyetvam | 
e bhṛñ ityetasyeti | dīrghānto'yam | thathā ca bharaḥ ityab bhavati
| 
e sisaniṣatīti | stautiṇyoreva iti niyamādatra ṣatvābhāvaḥ |
siṣāsatīti | ṣatvabhūte sani niyamādatra ṣatvam | 
e kecidatreti | ye tvetanna paṭhanti te upasaṃkhyānamārabhanta |
titāṃsatīti | tanoteviṃbhāṣāṃ iti pakṣe dīrghatvam | pitsatīti |
sani mīmādhu ityādinā aca is, skoḥ saṃyogādyoḥ iti
salopaḥ pūrvavadabhyāsalopaḥ | didaridrā satītyeke didaridraṣatīti
ceti | iṭ pakṣe daridrāterākāralopaḥ || 
ekliśaḥ ktvāniṣṭhayoḥ || 7 - 2 - 50 || 
e kliśitveti | mṛḍamṛda ityādinā kitvam | 
e vikalpaḥ siddha eveti | udatvātsvaratyādisūtreṇa | kimarthaṃ tarhi
ktvāgrahaṇam ityata āha - kliśa upatāpa taityasyeti || 
evasatikṣudhoriṭ || 7 - 2 - 52 || 
e uṣitveti | pūrvavatkitvam, yajāditvātsamprasāraṇam, śāsivasi
ityādinā ṣatvam | vastestviti | vasa ācchādane ityasya
yaṅlugnivṛtyartho'pi śapā nirddeśo na bhavati, tatrāpi
ktvāniṣṭhayoḥ sāmānyalakṣaṇena iḍ bhavatyeva - vāvasitaḥ ,
vāvasitavān, vāvasitvā | gaṇāśrayatvātsamprasārakaṇābhāvaḥ || 
eañceḥ pūjāyām || 7 - 2 - 53|| 
e añcitā asyeti | matibuddhi ityādinā vartamāne ktaḥ, nāñceḥ
pūjāyām ityupadhālopapratiṣedhaḥ, ktasya ca vartamāne iti kartari
ṣaṣṭhī || 
elubho vimohane || 7 - 2 - 54 || 
e lubhitvā, lobhitveti | ralo vyupadhāt ityādinā kitvavikalpaḥ
|| 
eso'sici kṛtacṛtacchḥadatṛdanṛtaḥ || 7 - 2 - 57 || 
e se ityakāra uccāraṇārthaḥ, tāsicīti pratiṣedhāt | tena sye'pyayaṃ
vikalpo bhavati | kṛtī chedane mucādiḥ, kṛtī chedane rudhādiḥ -
dvayorapi grahaṇam | iditvasya prayojanamuktam | cṛtī
hiṃsāgranthanayoḥ ūcchḥadirdīptidevanayoḥ, tauutṛdir
hiṃsānādarayoḥ, nṛtī gātravikṣepe | īditvaṃ pūrvavat || 
egameriṭ parasmaipadeṣu || 7 - 2 - 58 || 
esaṃgaṃsyata iti | samo gamyṛcchi ityātmanepadam |
gameriṅadeśasyeti | tena sañjigaṃsate ityatra na bhavatīti bhāvaḥ | 
e ātmanepadena samānapadasthasyeti | iha tu jigamiṣitevācarati
jigamiṣitrīyata iti bahiraṅgatvādātmanepadasya pratiṣedhābhāvaḥ |
etacca prasnavitrīyat , ityatra vārtikakārameta vyākhyātm | anyatra
sarvatraiveṣyata iti | kathaṃ punariṣyamāṇo'pi labhyate
yogavibhāgāt | gamaḥ sakārādāviḍ bhavatītyeko yogaḥ, tataḥ
parasmaipadeṣu iti dvitīyo niyamārthaḥ |
lulyajātīyacāpekṣatvānniyamasyātmanepadaviṣaya iṇnivartata iti
kecidāhuḥ | anye manyante -- parasmaipadeṣviti
saptamīnirdeśādānantaryāśrayaṇādayamartho bhavati - gamerutarasya
sakārāderārdhadhātukasya tiṅkṣbanantareṣu yadiḍbhavati
parasmaipadeṣveveti, tataśca saṅgaṃsyate ityatraiva vyāvṛttiḥ 
esyāt, na saṅgaṃsīṣṭetyatra | nāpi saṃjigāṃta tyādiu, śapā
vyāvadhānāt | ekādeśe nāsti vyāvadhānam ekādeśaḥ pūrvavidhau
sthānivadbhavati taiti sthānivadbhāvāvdyavadhānameva |
saṃjigaṃsiṣyayata ityādau ca naiva syāt, tasmādiṣṭireveyam | ata
teva iṣyata ityuktam | padaśeṣo nāma granthaviśeṣaḥ | tantenetyādi |
anantaroktasya dūṣaṇam na punarayaṃ pakṣaḥ syāpitaḥ,
vārtikavirodhāt | yadāha - siddhaṃ gamerātmanepadena
samānapadasthasyeṭpratiṣedhāt iti || 
ena vṛdbhyaścaturbhyaḥ || 7 - 2 - 59 || 
e bahuvacananirddeśāccaturgrahaṇāccādyartho gamyate | 
e vṛttirvṛdhiḥ śṛdhiḥ syandiścatvāro'mī vṛtādayaḥ | 
e śṛdhu śabdakutsāyām | anye prasiddhāḥ | udāharathaṇeṣu vṛdbhyaḥ
syasanoḥ iti taparasmaipadam | 
e caturbhya iti na vaktavyamiti | kiṃ kāraṇam ityata tathāaha -
vṛdgrahataṇaṃ hīti | yadi dyautādiparisamāptyarthaṃ tatkimāyātaṃ
vṛtādiparisamāpteḥ ityata āha -- tadevateti |
tāguhyayamāṇaviśeṣatvāditi bhāvaḥ | avantaraṅgamapīti |
antaraṅgatvaṃ vikalpasyārdhadhātukamātrāpekṣatvāt | ayaṃ tu
pratiṣedho bahiraṅgaḥ, sakārādiviśeṣāpekṣatvāt,
bahirbhūtaparasmaipadāpekṣatvācca | nanu cānyeṣvapi vṛtādiṣu
ārdhadhātukalakṣaṇo'pīḍantaraṅga eva, atha tasya
vacanasāmarthyātapratiṣedhaḥ, tarhi vikalpasyāpi bhaviṣyati naitadasti
yena nāprāpte tasya bādhanaṃ bhavati,
nāprāptiścārdhadhātukasyeḍityasya, na tūdillakṣaṇasya | yadi param,
paratvādudillakṣaṇamapīṭṃa pratiṣedho bādheta tatadapi na
antaraṅgabahiraṅgayorvipratiṣedhānupapateḥ | kathaṃ tarhi satyapi
caturgrahaṇe tasya pratiṣedhaḥ ityata āha - caturgrahaṇe hīti | sati ca
tasmin caturthyā pratiṣedhena bhāvyamiti pratītiḥ, itarathā
saṃkhyāśbadābhāvādekasya pratiṣedhābhāve'pi na kaścidbhāvadhaḥ | 
e parasmaipadeṣvityeveti | yadyevam, yatra vṛtādibhyaḥ
parasyārdhadhātukasya parasmaipadamanantaraṃ tatraiva syāt -
vartsyatītyādau, vivṛtsatītyādau na syāt, śapā vyavadhānāt |
taekādeśe'pi kṛte sthānivadbhāvāvdyavadhānameva, vivṛtsiṣyati,
vivṛtsayatītyādau pratiyakṣameva vyavadhānam, kṛti parasmaipadaluki
ca parasmaiparagandho'pi nāstīti na syādeva tatrāha - atrāpīti |
iṣṭireveyam | vivṛtsitrīyata ityādau cokta eva parihāraḥ || 
etāsi ca klṛpaḥ || 7 - 2 - 60 || 
e udāharaṇeṣu luṭi ca klṛpaḥ iti parasmaipadam |
klṛperapītyādi | anyathā kalpsyatītyādāveva syāt, na tu
ciklṛpsitā, ciklṛpsa tvamityādāviti bhāvaḥ | 
e iha tu na vṛdbhyaḥ pañcabhyastāsi ca iti vaktavyam, klṛpigrahaṇaṃ
tu śakyamakartum | na ca vṛtādibhyo'pi tāsau prasaṅgaḥ,
parasmaipadābhāvāt, ātmanepadena samānapadasthatvācca || 
eacastāsvatthalyaniṭo nityam || 7 - 2 - 61|| 
e yasthali krādiniyamādiṭ prāptaḥ sa niṣidhyate | 
e pañcasūtryeta ārabhya tāsvadityeṣa ḍervatiḥ || 
e upadeśagraho'pyatra vakṣyamāṇo'pakṛṣyate | 
e guṇe nitye kṛte'pyeṣa ṛdante prāpnuyātkatham || 
e kva nityamaniṭ ityapekṣāyāṃ tāseḥ sannidhānātatraiveti vijñāyate,
yadvāpūrvasūtrāt tāsi iti vartate | yāteti |
tāsāvaniṭpradarśanārthamupanyastam | 
e lūtveti | tāsvat ityanucyamāne yatra kvāpi nityāniṭasthali
pratiṣedhaḥ syāt | lunātiścāyam rśyukaḥ kiti iti
pratiṣedhātkiti nityāniṭkaḥ | yayiva, yayimeti | āto lopa
iṭi ca | aniḍgrahaṇaṃ nityamityanena viśeṣaṇārthamiti |
asatyaniḍgrahaṇe nityamityanena pratiṣedha taeva viśṣyeta -
nityamaṇna bhavatīti | yadyapyatra vikalpe na prakṛtaḥ, tathāpīdameva
nityagrahaṇaṃ pūrvasva vidheranityatvaṃ jñāpayet | seḍnivṛtyartha
tvaniḍgrahaṇaṃ na bhavati, katham tāsvadityucyate, yathā tāsau na
bhavati evaṃ thalyapīti | na ca yastāsau seṭ tasya 
ethali pratiṣedho bhavan tāsvatkṛto bhavati | vidhotā, vidhaviteti
| svaratyādisūtreṇa tāsāviḍvikalpitaḥ | 
ekramerapi cakramitheti bhāvyam, na hi tāsau nityāniṭ kramiḥ,
ātmanepade iḍabhāvātparasmaipade seṭatvāt | tāsau vibhāṣeṭasthali
nityamiḍāgamo bhavatīti | yāvānkaścidiḍabhāvaḥ pratiṣedhanibandhano
vikalpanibandhano vā sa sarvaḥ krādisūtreṇa niyamyate ityasminpakṣe
iti bhāvaḥ | yad tu pratiṣedhādhikāreṇa krādīnāmeveṇna bhavati
itiniyamātpratiṣedha eva sarvo nivartate, svaratyādi lakṣaṇastu
vikalpo bhavatyeva iti pakṣaḥ, tadā vidudhotha, vidudhavithetyubhayaṃ
bhavati | yadyevam, nityamaniṭa iti na vaktavyam astuḥ yastāsau
vikalpiteṭ tasyāpyayaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ ṛto bhāradvājasya iti
niyamādvikalpa evāvasthāsyate naivaṃ śakyam, svaratau hi dauṣaḥ
syāt | bhāradvājapakṣe'pi tasya pratiṣedhāt sasvarthetyeva syāt |
yadā tu vikalpiteṭasthali pratiṣedho'yaṃ na bhavati, tadā sasvartha,
sasvarithetyubhayaṃ bhavati | 
e tāsvaditi vatinirdeśa iti | tāsvadityasya nirdeśa ityarthaḥ |
tāsvadityanucyamāne prakṛtasya tāsītyasyānuvṛtāvapyetāvadeva
labhyeta - tāsau nityamaniṭasthalīṇ na bhavatīti, tataśca
yastāsāvasana, asatvādeva nityāniṭ, tasyāpi prasajyeta | 
e tāsvadityucyamāne tu vateḥ sādṛśyogocarāt | 
e yathābhūtasya tāsau neṭ tathābhūtasya thalyapi || 
e iṭā na bhāvyamityeṣa doṣo naiva prasajyate | 
e iṭastāsyasato dhātorniṣedhe vihite thali | 
e abhāvaḥ sadṛśo na syāt thali tāsyasato bhavet || 
e adhasitheti | sthānivadbhāvāt iḍatyartivyayatīnām ityevaiṣa siddha
ityāhuḥ | thautarasūtre'pīti | etenotarārthaṃ tāsvadityucyata taiti
darśayati | adādeśo hīti | nanu cāsya sthānī tāsāvasti, asti
cāniḍiti tadādeśasyāpi sthānivadbhāvāt satvāniṭtve
syātām naitadasti, sthānivadbhāvaḥ śāstrīyeṣu pravartate, na ca
tāsau satvaṃ nāma śāstrīyaṃ kāryam || 
eupadeśe'tvataḥ || 7 - 2 - 62 || 
e anajantārtha ārambhaḥ | iyaṣṭeti | liṭa|lbhyāsasyobhayeṣām iti
abhyāsasya samprasāraṇam, vraścādiṣtvam| cakrarṣitheti | kṛṣa
vilekhane | bhavatyayaṃ guṇe kṛte sampratyakāravān, na tūpadeśe |
jigrahitheti | sani grahaguhośca itīṭpratiṣedhādbhāvatyayaṃ sani
nityāniṭ, na tāsau | 
e ānañcitheti | ata ādeḥ tasmānnuḍdvihalaḥ, svaratyādisūtreṇa
tāsau vikalpiteḍayam || 
eṛto bhāradvājasya || 7 - 2 - 63 || 
e sasmartheti | smṛ cintāyām | dadhvartheti | dhvṛ hūrchane | 
e siddhe satītyādi | adantānāṃ vṛṅvṛñāvudātau | tatrāpi
vṛṅsthal na sambhavati, ātmanepaditvāt | vañastu vavartheti
nipātanādbhāṣāyāmiṭāṃ bhāvyam | tasmātayoriṭpratiṣedhārthaṃ
tāvadetannopapadyate | anye'dantāstāsau nityāniṭaḥ iti acastāsvat
ityanenaiva siddhaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ | nanu ca paratvād guṇe kṛte raparatve
cānajantatvānna siddhyati, pūrvasūtreṇāpyasiddhireva, na hyakārāntā
upadeśe'tvantaḥ, tasmānniyamānupapatiḥ astu tarhi dadhvarthetyādau
vidhyarthameva | yadyevam, sthāyāpaciprabhṛtiṣu pūrvayogābhyāṃ nityaṃ
thali pratiṣedhaprasaṅgaḥ, jaharthetyādau bhāradvājasyeti
vacanādvikalpeprasaṅgaḥ evaṃ acastāsvat ityajñaiva bhāradvājagrahaṇaṃ
kariṣyate, tadevānantarayoge'pyanuvartiṣyate, iha tu nivartiṣyate
satyam, ayaṃ tu bhāradvājaḥ svasmānmatātpracyāvito bhavati | tasya
matam - ṛkārāntadanyatra yayitha, pecithetīḍbhavati, akārānte
neti | tvadukte tu nyāse mataviparyayaḥ kṛto bhavati | evaṃ
tarhyupadeśagrahaṇasya acastāsvat
ityatrāpakarṣādupadeśe'jantatvātsiddhaḥ pratiṣedha iti manyate | ṛta eva
bhāradvājasyeti | viparītastu niyamo na bhavati - ṛto
bhāradvājasyaiveti | yadi syānniyamāśrayaṇanarthakaṃ syāt, pūrvoktena
prakāreṇa vidhyarthatvamevāśrayaṇīyaṃ syāt | pūrvayoryogayoriti |
ṛkārānteṣu anantarasya vidhirvā bhavati iti nyāyasya tāvadasambhavaḥ |
yasya tarhi prasaṅgaḥ acastāsvat iti, tasyaiva niyamo yuktaḥ, tatkathaṃ
pūrvayoryogayordvayorapi vikalpaḥ evaṃ manyate -
dvayoranantaramasyārambhātāsau nityamaniṭāṃ madhye ṛta eva
bhāradvājasya 
enānyeṣām - ityevaṃ sāmānyākāreṇa niyama āśrayaṇīya iti | tathā
hi satīti | asati taparakaraṇe āñkārāntanāmapyatra grahaṇaṃ syāt,
teṣāṃ ca tāsau siddhatvād atastāsvat ityasyāprasaṅge
vidhyarthamevedaṃ syāt, na hrasvagrahaṇena niyamārtham,
vidhiniyamasambhave vidhereva jyāyastvādityarthaḥ || 
evibhāṣā sṛjidṛśoḥ || 7 - 2 - 65 || 
e sasnaṣṭha, dadraṣṭeti | sṛjidṛśorjhalyamakiti, pūrvavat ṣatvam || 
eiḍatyartivyayatīnām || 7 - 2 - 66 || 
e atra iḍgrahaṇaṃ vispaṣṭārthamiti | atha vikalpe prāpte nityārtha
kasmānna bhavati tatrāha - vikalpavidhāne hīti | evamapi pratiṣedhaḥ
prakṛtaḥ, tannivṛtyarthamiḍgrahaṇaṃ syāt ita āha - pratiṣedhavidhāne
iti | 
evasvekājodghasām || 7 - 2 - 67 || 
e vasu ityavibhaktiko nirddeśaḥ | vasorityarthaḥ |
kṛtadvirvacanānāmiti | 
e kathaṃ punaraviśeṣoktāveṣa viśeṣo labhyate
ekājgrahaṇasāmarthyāt | na hi kaścicadakṛte dvirvacanenaikājasti
yannivṛtyarthamekājgrahaṇaṃ syāt | cirijiricakāśibhyaḥ
kāsyanekājgrahaṇaṃ culumpādyartham ityāmā bhavitavyamiti
vasorasambhavaḥ | ūrṇotestu ṇuvadbhāvādekājgrahaṇonānivaḥtiḥ
| nanu ca jāgartirasti uṣavidajāgṛbhyo'nyatarasyām ityāmo
vikalpitatvāt vede'pi - jāgṛvāṃso anugmanniti
dvirvacanaprakarakaṇe cchandasi veti vaktavyam iti dvirvacanābhāvaḥ,
naikamudāharaṇamekājgarahaṇaṃ prayojayati | yadyetāvatprayojanaṃ syāt
jāgarterna ityeva brūyāt, ladhīyasī hi sākṣātpratiṣedhapratipatiḥ |
yadi vā nyāyasiddho'yamarthaḥ | tathā hi dvirvacanasyāvakāśaḥ - paṃpāca,
iṭo'vakāśaḥ yatra kṛte dvirvacana ekāc -- pecivān, ādivān
bibhidvānityādau tūbhayaprasaṅge nityatvād dvirvacanam | 
e kādiniyamātprāpta iti | neḍvaśi kṛti iti pratyayāśrayasya
pratiṣedhasya sarvatra bhāvātkādiniyamāneva sarvatra vasoriṭaḥ prāptiḥ
| 
e ādgrahaṇamanekājarthamiti | nanu dvirvacane ākāralope sati
teṣāmapyekāctvādeva siddham ata āha - dvirvacane hīti | iṇnimita
ākāralopo nāsati tasminbhavati, tataścānekāctvamityarthaḥ | 
e athāpyāmna kriyata iti | āta au ṇalaḥ ityokāre vidhātavye
aukāravidhānena jñāpitametat -- daridrāteranitya āmiti |
tenāyamabhyupagamaḥ dadaridravāniti, neḍvaśi kṛti iti pratiṣedha
eva tatra bhavati | 
e atha ghasigrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā dvirvacane kṛte ghasibhasorhali
ca ityupadhālope satyekāctvādeva siddham ata āha - ghaserapīti |
paratvāditi | nityatvāccetyāpi draṣṭavyam tasya halyapi
vidhānāt | anaṣkatvāditi | sthānivadbhāvoṣa'pi nāsti,
halnimitatvādupadhālopasya | kriyamāṇe tu ghasigrahaṇe nāyaṃ doṣa
ityāha - kriyamāṇe tviti || 
ebhavibhāṣā gamahanavidaviśām || 7 - 2 - 68 || 
e jadhnivān, jaghanvāniti | ho hantorñṇinneṣu | abhyāsācca
iti kutvam | 
e viśinā taudādikeneti | yadyapyādādikena hantinā
sāhacaryamasti, tathāpi śabdaparavipratiṣedhādviśisāhacaryameva
vyavasthāpakamiti bhāvaḥ | jñānārthasya tviti |
satāvicāraṇārthayostvātmanepaditvāt kvasāvasambhava eveti bhāvaḥ |
vividvāniti | vūrvavidiṭpratiṣedhaḥ || 
esanisasanivāṃsam || 7 - 2 - 69 || 
e kvasośchāndasatvāt, ānupūrvyāśca
vivakṣitatvācchandasyevaitannipātanam || 
eṛdbhanoḥ sye || 7 - 2 - 70 || 
e svaratyādisūtre yaduktam - svarateretasmādvikalpādityādi, tadeva
smārayati - svaraterveṭtvāditi | vāvikalpita iḍa|lsya sa veṭ,
tasya bhāvo veṭtvam, sa punarvikalpiteṭsambandhaḥ || 
eyamaramanamātāṃ sakta || 7 - 2 - 73 || 
e vyaraṃsīditi | vyāṅparibhyo ramaḥ iti parasmaipadam | 
e yuktamatra dvivacanabahuvacanayorudāharaṇam, tatra hi saṃgiṭoḥ
satorasti viśeṣaḥ, ekavacane tkyuktam, viśeṣābhāvāt tatrāha -
yamādīnāmiti | hmyantakṣaṇa ityatrāpīṭīti vartate, apāsīdityetatu
prakramābhedāyodāhṛtam, natvatra viśeṣo'sti | nanu cātrāpi svare
viśeṣo'sti - mā hi māsīditi, iṭa|lsatyādyaudātaṃ padaṃ syāt, sati
tu tasya sijbhaktatvāccitsvareṇodātatve ekādeśa udātenodātaḥ
ityantodātaṃ padaṃ bhavati, tatra ādiḥ sico'nyatarasyām iti pakṣe
ādyaudātatvam, pakṣe'ntodātatvam naiṣo'sti viśeṣaḥ, aniṭaḥ sicaḥ
pakṣe upasaṃkhyānam iti vacanānma hi kārṣamityatra yathā pakṣe
ādyaudātatvaṃ pakṣe cāntodātatvaṃ ca bhavati, evamatrāpi bhaviṣyati |
āyaṃsteti | samudāṅbhyo yamo'granthe ityātmanepadam |
anaṃstetyatra karmakartari na duhastanunamāṃ yakciṇau iti ciṇaḥ
pratiṣedhaḥ || 
esmipūṅrañjvaśāṃ sani || 7 - 2 - 74 || 
e ṛ iti dhātorgrahaṇam, na ṛkārāntanām utaratra
kirādīnāmiḍvidhānāt | pipaviṣaya iti | oḥ puyaṇjyapare
ityabhyāsasyetvam | añjijiṣatīti | ajāderdvitīyasya iti jiśabdasya
dvirvacanam, nakārastu na dvirucyate, na ndrāḥ iti pratiṣedhāt || 
ekiraśca pañcabhyaḥ || 7 - 2 - 75 || 
e kiraḥ iti vyatyenaikavacanam | pañcabhyaḥ iti
bahuvacanādādyarthāvagatiḥ | kṛgṛdṛṅdhṛṅpṛcchatayaḥ tudādiṣu
kirādayaḥ | pipṛcchivatīti | rudavida ityādinā sanaḥ kitvam |
grahijyādisūtreṇa samprasāraṇam | 
e kiratigiratyeriti | śeṣāṇāṃ tvanudātatvātpratiṣedhaḥ | dīrghatvaṃ
necchantīti | iṣṭireveyam || 
erudādibh sārvadhātuke || 7 - 2 - 76 || 
e rudisvapśvasanijakṣiradādiṣu rudādayaḥ | ubhayanirdeśe
pañcamīnirddeśo balīyān iti rudādibhyaḥ iti pañcamyā
sārvadhātuke iti saptamyāḥ ṣaṣṭhī prakalpyate |
saptamīnirdeśastūtaratropayogaṃ yāsyati | prāṇitīti | aniteḥ iti
ṇatvam | 
e svapteti | anyebhyastu parasyārdhadhātukasyaiṭā bhavitavyam || 
eīśaḥ se || 7 - 2 - 77 || 
e īśa aiśvarye ādādikaḥ | se ityavibhaktiko nirddeśaḥ | iśiṣveti |
savābhyāṃ vāmau | ekadeśavikṛtasyānanyatvāt seśabda evāyam || 
eīḍajanordhve ca || 7 - 2 - 78 || 
e īḍa stutau adādiḥ | chāndasatvācchayano lugiti | bhāṣāyāṃ tu
jāyase - ityatra nityatvāt śyani kṛte tena vyavadhānādiḍabhāvaḥ | 
e jana janane ityasyāpīti | nanvasau parasmaipadī tatrāha - tasya
kamavyatihāra iti | yadi tarhi tasyāpyātmanepadaṃ sambhavati, tasyaiva
grahaṇaṃ prāpnoti, niranuvandhakatvāt īḍinā
sāhacaryādātmanepadino'pi grahaṇaṃ bhaviṣyati | 
e tadarthe keciditi | ye tvevaṃ na paṭhanti, te cakāreṇa kṛtsnameva
pūrvasūtramanuvartayanti | sakārāderiti | s 
eiti saptamyā lukā nirddeśātadādividhiḥ | 
e yadi tarhi īśerapi dhve śabde iḍāgato bhavati, yogāvibhāgo na
kartavyaḥ, iḍīśajanāṃ sedhvayoḥ iti vaktavyam, evaṃ hi
pṛthagvibhaktirnoccārayitavyā bhavati, cakāraśca na kartavyaḥ ata āha -
īśīḍjanāṃ sedhvayoriti | laṅ dhvimityasya na bhavatīti |
loṭa|lpi tarhi dhvamityasya na prāpnoti tatrāha - loṭi punariti || 
eliṅḥ salopo'nantyasya || 7 - 2 - 79 || 
e sārvadhātuke yo liṅiti | naiṣā parasaptamī, sārvadhātukaparasya
liṅe'sambhavāt | tasmānnirdhāraṇe saptamī | jātāvekavacanam,
sārvadhātukeṣu madhye yo liṅ sārvadhātukasaṃjñakastasyetyarthaḥ |
kuryāditi | ata utsārvadhātuke ityutvam, ye ca tyukārisya
lopaḥ | atra yāsuṭsuṭoḥ sakārasya lopaḥ | kuryuriti |
jherjum, |yāsuṭsakāralopaḥ, usyapadāntāt iti parūpatvam |
kurvīteti | sīyuṭsuṭoḥ salopaḥ | kurvīnniti | jhasya 
eran, atra sīyuṭa eva lopaḥ || 
eato yeyaḥ || 7 - 2 - 80 || 
e sārvadhātuke iti prakṛtamarthāt ṣaṣṭha|lntaṃ sampadyate, tadāha --
akārāntādaṅgādutarasya sārvadhātukasyeti | avayavasambandhe caiṣā
ṣaṣṭhī, sārvadhātukasyāvayavasya yāśabdasyetyarthaḥ | iy ityayamiti |
sūtre tvākāra uccāraṇārthaḥ | pacediti | iyādeśe kṛte śavakāreṇa
sahādguṇaḥ, valādiṣu vali lopaḥ | 
e yakārasya ca śravaṇam - paceyuḥ, paceyamityādau |
paceyurityatretyādi | pararūpasyāvakāśaḥ cinuyuḥ, sunuyuḥ,
iyādeśasya tu pacedityādi, paceyurityatrobhayaprasaṅge
paratvādiyādeśaḥ | yadi pūrvameva pararūpaṃ syāt,
yāśabdābhāvādiyādeśo na syāt | evamato lopasyāpi bādhakaḥ
syāditi | etacca madhye'pavādāḥ iti nyāyamanāśrityoktam |
tadāśrayaṇe tvato lopasyaiva bādhakaḥ syāt | dīrghastu
paratvātsyādeva | svādetadevamityādi | dīrghavidhau
turustuśamyamḥ sārvadhātuke iti prakṛtam, mūsuvostiṅ īti ca
| 
eyoya ityavibhaktiko nirdeśa iti | yeyaḥ ityasminsamudāye yā
ityuvibhaktiko nirdeśa ityarthaḥ | ya iti veti | yāśabdātṣaṣṭhī, āto
dhātoḥ ityākāralopaḥ | 
e kecitu -- ato yās iti sakārāntānukaraṇaṃ paṭhanti || 
eāto ṅtiḥ || 7 - 2 - 81 || 
eākāramātrasya ṅito'sambhavād ātaḥ ṅtiḥ iti vyadhikaraṇe
ṣaṣṭhayau | ṅito'viyavasyāt ityarthaḥ | udāharaṇeṣu
svaritatvādātmanepadam | nanu gāṅkuṭādisūtre paratra
paraśabdaprayogādadhyādahriyamāṇo vatiḥ saptamīsamarthādadhyāhartavyaḥ -
hitīva diti, anyathā cukuṭiṣaṃtītyatra sano
ṅitvādātminepadaprasaṅgādityuktam | sārvadhātukamapit ityatrāpi
tadevānuvartate, tataśca pūrvasya kārya pratyeva sārvadhātukasya
ṅtvim, na svakārya pratītyayuktānyudāharaṇāni laṅlṛṅestu
yuktamudāhartum - apacetām, akariṣyetāmiti asti hyatrāpi
sthānivadbhāvena ṅtvim ata āha - sārvadhātukamapidityatretyādi |

e mamāte, mimāthe iti | asati taparakaraṇe śnābhyastayorātaḥ iti
lopātparatvādayameva vidhiḥ syāt || 
eāne muk || 7 - 2 - 82 || 
e atra āne iti saptamyacaritārthā pūrvatra kṛtārthāyāḥ ataḥ iti
pañcamyāḥ ṣaṣṭhī prakalpayati tasminniti nirdiṣṭe pūrvasya iti , tatra
viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāve kāmacārādaṅgenādviśeṣyate, na
tvātā'ṅgamityabhiprāyeṇāha - akāramātrabhakto'yamiti |
aṅgasyāvayavo yo'kārastasya mugityarthaḥ | kimeṣaṃ sati bhavati
ityāha - adupadeśāgrahaṇeneti | upadeśe at adupadeśaḥ, yadi
tvakārāntāṅgabhaktaḥ syāt, tatastadeśāhgaṃ na vyāvadadhyāt,
tadavayavaṃ tvakāraṃ vyavadadhātyeveti svaro na syāt | na ca
svaravidhau vyañjanamavidyamānavata, kiṃ kāraṇam halsavaraprāptau
vyañjanamavidyamānavaditi paribhāṣāyā bhāṣyakāreṇa śikṣitatvāt |
anyathā'gnicidvānityādau hrasvanuḍbhyāṃ matup iti svaraprasaṅgāt
| yadi punarayamabhakto makāro vikaraṇavanmadhye kriyate, abhakte muki
svaro na syādityeva | yadi punarayaṃ parādijha kriyeta - ānasya
muḍiti, parāditve dīrghatvaprasaṅgaḥ - pacamāna iti ato dīrgho
yañi iti dīrghatvaṃ prāpnoti pākṣika eṣa doṣaḥ | katarasminpakṣe yadi
sārvadhātuka ityeva tat | atha ṅītyeva tatadā na doṣaḥ | tadayaṃ
bhaktastatrāpi pūrvāntaḥ, tatrāpyakārasya mugiti sthitam | yadyevamaiti
| yadyakāramātrabhaktatvātadgrahaṇena gṛhyata ityarthaḥ | adhyarddhamātra iti |
ardhamadhikaṃ yasyāḥ sā adhyardhā, adhyardhā mātrā yasyāsāvadhyardhamātraḥ |
lasāvaṃdhātukānudātatvamapi tarhi na prāpnotīti | yadvidhāvapi
taparanirddeśāt | tatrāha - upadeśagrahaṇamiha kriyata iti | tathā
ceti | yadā dvimātratve'pi bhavati, tadā kā śaṅkā'dhyardhamātratve 
eiti bhāvaḥ || 
eīdāsaḥ || 7 - 2 - 83 || 
e āsaḥ iti pañcamyacaritārthā pūrvatra kṛtārthāyāḥ āne iti saptamyāḥ
ṣaṣṭhaāā prakalpayati || 
eaṣṭana ā vibhaktau || 7 - 2 - 84 || 
e sautratvānnirddeśasya allopo na kṛtaḥ | 
e vyaktinirdeśo'yamiti |
yathāśrutaniranunāsikākāravyaktirnirddiśyata ityarthaḥ |
jātinirdeśastu duṣṭa ityāha -- ākṛtinirdeśo tviti |
ākṛtirjātiḥ, na saṃsthānam | jātinirddeśe hi śuddhāyā
jāterādeṣṭuaśamakyatvātadādhārabhūtānāṃ vyaktīnāṃ vidhānam | tatra
yadyapi dīrghoccāraṇasāmarthyānna hrasvaplutavyaktīnāṃ prasaṅgaḥ,
dīrghavyaktayastu sarvāḥ prasaktāḥ, tatrāntaryato'nunāsikavyaktireva
syāt, tasyāḥ pūrveṇa saha savarmadīrgho'pyanunāsika eva syāt |
vikalpena cāyamityādi | yathā ca dīrghagrahaṇaṃ
kṛtātvanirddeśaścāsminnarthe liṅgaṃ tathā tatraiva vyākhyātam |
tadantavidhiścātreṣyata iti | aṅgādhikāre tasya tadutarapadasya ca
iti vacanāt | ekavacananirdeśātsvarūpasya grahaṇaṃ nārthasya
tenopasarjane'pyaṣṭani bhavati, tatrāpi vikalpitatvātpriyāṣṭā,
priyāṣṭānau, priyāṣṭāna ityapi bhavati | tatrāpi bhasaṃjñāviṣaye
ātvapatre āto dhātoḥ ityakāralopamicchanti - priyāṣṭaḥ
paśyetyādi, ātvābhāvapakṣe tvallope ṣṭuatvam - priyāṣṭna
ityādi bhavati || 
erāyo hali || 7 - 2 - 85 || 
e mṛjervṛddhirityataḥ prāgvibhaktyadhikāra iti | pūrvasūtrānte
grantho'yaṃ paṭhitavyaḥ | 
eyuṣmadasmadoranādeśo || 7 - 2 - 86 || 
e yuṣmadasmaditi | pañcamyāṃ at iti bhyaso'dbhāvaḥ | 
e halītyadhikārādapyatra na syāditi | na cādeśo halādirasti,
bhyasobhyam tyiyaṃ tu abhyamādeśaḥ | utaratreti | yo'ci iti
yatvamādeśe mā bhūt tvamahamityādau śeṣe lopaḥ iti
śeṣavyavasthārthaṃ ca | tadihaiva kriyata iti | laghave viśeṣābhāvāt || 
edvitīyāyāṃ ca || 7 - 2- 87 || 
e udāharaṇeṣu ṇeó prathamayoram iti vibhakterambhāvaḥ || 
eprathamāyāśca dvivacane bhāṣāyām || 7 - 2 - 88 || 
e yuvayoriti | nanu ca yo'ci iti yatvamatra bādhakaṃ bhaviṣyati
prathamādvivacane'pi tarhi śeṣelopo bādhakaḥ syāt | atha tasya
vacanādvādhaḥ yatvasyāpi bādhaḥ syāt | purastādapavādanyāyena vā
yatvasyaiva bādhaḥ syāt || 
eyo'ci || 7 - 2 - 89 || 
e śakyayamakartumacītyetaditi | katham anādiṣṭāyāṃ vibhaktau
vidhīyamānaṃ yatvamutsargaḥ, tatraiva halādāvātvamapavādaḥ | tvat,
maditi | ekavacanasya ca iti ṅseradādeśaḥ || 
eśeṣe lopaḥ || 7 - 2 - 90 || 
e upayuktādanyaḥ śeṣaḥ | tasyaiva saṃgrahaślokaḥ -- pañcamyāścetyādi |
pañcamyādīnāṃ sambandhīni yānyadvivacanāni -- ayaṃ tāvaccheṣaḥ, tatra
śeṣe lopo vidhīyata iti | advivacanāni ityetadbhāṣāpekṣaṃ
draṣṭavyam | cchandasi tu - yuvaṃ vastrāṇīti dvivacanamapi śeṣa eva | 
e śeṣagrahaṇaṃ vispaṣṭārthamiti | katham vibhaktimātre lopaḥ,
tasyānādiṣṭāyāṃ vibhāktau yatvavamapavādaḥ | asyāpi
halādāvātvamapavāda ityasaṅkareṇātva - ya - lopaḥ sidhyanti |
anādeśagrahaṇaṃ tu kriyamāṇe'jgrahaṇe yatvalopayorviṣayavibhāgārthaṃ
kartavyameva | sannipātalakṣaṇa iti | vibhaktisannipātakṛtaṃ
yuṣmadasmadorakārāntatvam | tadyadi ṭopo nimitaṃ syāt,
tatsannipātaṃ vihanyāt | etecca
tyadādiśabdavatstrīlīṅgatvamabhyupetyoktam, idānīṃ ca liṅgameva
nāstiṃ ityāha - jaliṅge veti | 
e kecitviti | | ṭābnivṛtyarthameva ta evamicchanti | kathamiti |
yatrākāro yakāraśca na vihitaḥ sa śeṣaḥ, tatra vidhīyamāno lopaḥ
alo'ntyasāya ityantasyaiva yukta iti praśnaḥ | antaroktaṃ śeṣagrahaṇasya
ṣaiyarthyaṃ hṛdi kṛtvā''ha -- vakṣyamāṇeti | ādeśā vakṣyamāṇā yasya sa
vakṣyamāṇādeśaḥ | kaḥ punarasau ityāha - te ceti | 
e maparyantādyo'nyaḥ sa śeṣa iti | sa ca ṭireva | tatrāyaṃ lopa iti
sthānino'dhikaraṇatvavivakṣayā saptamī | kimarthaṃ puṃnarlopa
ityucyate, na tyādadyatvenaiṣa siddham na sidhyati,
dviparyantāstyadādayaḥ iti vacanāt | yadā copasarjane yuṣmadasmadī,
tadā tyadādyatvaṃ na sidhyati | ṭilopapakṣe tu sutarāmārambhaṇīyam ||

eṇaparyantasya || 7 - 2 - 91 || 
e maparyantasya ityavayavasya sthānitvena
nirdeśādyauṣmadasmadorityavayavaṣaṣṭhī vijñāyate - maḥ
paryanto'vadhiryasya sa maparyantaḥ | yadyapi dvayodvāê maparyantau,
tathāpyabhedakvikṣayaikavacanam | 
e maparyantasyaiti kimiti | samudāyayorapyādeśe
ādeśānāmapyadantatvāddoṣābāva iti praśnaḥ | sākackasya mā bhūditi |
tanmadhyapatitasya tadgrahaṇena grahaṇātprasaṅgaḥ | sarvasya mā bhūditi
| sākackasya mā bhūditi tu noktam, yasmādakajvidhāvuktam - tvayā,
mayā, tvayi, mayi ityatra subantasya prākṭerakac iti | aniṣṭṃa rūpaṃ
syāditi | tvyā, myetyaniṣṭṃa rūpam | 
e atha parigrahaṇaṃ kimartham, māntasyetyevocyeta, yuṣmadasmadoryo
mānto bhāgāstasyetyarthaḥ tatrāha -- māntasyetyeva siddhe'sminniti |
asmin sākackasyā deśābhāve, yuvakām, avakāmiti rūpe vā |
avadhidyotanārthamiti | paryantaśabdenāvadhiṃ dyotayāmītyarthaḥ | anyathā
māntasyetyucyamāne yuṣmadaṣmadoḥ samānādhikāraṇaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ
sambhāvyeta, pratyekasambandhāccaikavacanam, tataśca yatra mānte
yuṣmadasmadī tatraivādeśāḥ syuḥ | athāpi vaiyadhikaraṇyamākṣīyate,
tathāpi catra mānte tatra bhedābhāvādādeśā na syuḥ |
vyapadeśivadbhāvo'pi prātipadikena pratiṣiddhaḥ | paryantaśabdena
tvavadhidyotane tadupādānasāmarthyādyauṣmadsmadavayave'pi
yuṣmadasmacchabdau vartete iti sarvatrādeśasiddhiḥ | vaiyadhikaraṇyena vā
sambandhe parigrahaṇasāmarthyād vyapadeśivadbhāvo'pratipadikena iti
pratiṣedhāpravṛtau māntayorapyādeśāsiddhiḥ | 
e apara āha - sati śeṣe paryantaśabdaḥ, tena
sāmānādhikaraṇyāsambhāvadvaiyadhikaraṇyenaivānvayaḥ | yadā tu mānte
yuṣmadasmadī tadā naivādeśā bhavanti, tadidamuktam mānte mā bhūdyadā
tadeti | yadā yuṣmadasmadī mānte tadaiva mā bhūt, tadāpi vā mā
bhūdityarthaḥ | kva punarmānte yuṣmadasmadī ityāha - ṇyantayoriti |
yuṣmānācaṣṭe yuṣmayati, asmānācaṣṭe asmayati ṇicīṣṭhavadbhāve
ṭilopaḥ, pratyayotarapadeyośca
ityatraikavacanādhikārātvamādeśābhāvaḥ | kvipi ṇilopaḥ | nanu ca
vibhaktāvādeśairthāvyam, atra ca ṇilopasya
sthānivadbhāvāvdyavadhānam ata āha - sthānivatvaṃ ceti | ṇeḥ kvau
luptatvānna tallopasyātra sthānivat ityevamiti bhāṣvakāraḥ | 
e tatra yo manyate - māntayorapyādeśā bhavantīti ,
tanmatenodāharaṇāni | kṛdantatvādvibhaktayaḥ,
ekadeśavikṛtasyānanyatvādyauṣmadasmadāśrayavibhaktyādeśāḥ
prakṛtyādeśāśca tvādayaḥ tatra tvāhau sau ityādiviṣaye te bhavanti |
anyatrādeśavibhaktau lopaḥ, ajādau yatvam, halādāvātvam -- tvam,
yuṣām, yuyam, yuṣām, yuṣām, yuṣān, yuṣyā, yuṣābhāyam,
yuṣābhiḥ, tubhyaṃ yuṣābhyāṃ yuṣabhyam, yuṣat, yuṣābhyām, yuṣat,
tava, yuṣyoḥ, yuṣākam yuṣyi, yuṣyo, yuṣāsu | evamasmado'pi
draṣṭavyam | maparyantāpekṣayā tu śeṣa āśrīyamāṇe,
mātparasyābhāvāllopābhāvāt yuṣmabhāyam, yuṣmadityādi bhavati | 
e yadā tu tvāmocaṣṭe, māmācaṣṭa iti vigṛhya kvip kriyate, tadā
pratyayotarapadayośca iti tvamayoḥ kṛtayoḥ prakṛtyaikāc iti
prakṛtibhāvādasati ṭilope ata upadhāyāḥ iti vṛddhiḥ | yadi
niṣṭhitamaṅgaṃ tato vadaddhyabhāvaḥ | tvads tvāds, mads
camādas iti sthite maparyantābhāvāt tvāhau sau ityāderapravṛtau
vṛddhipakṣe tvāmiti bhavati | pakṣāntare tu tvamiti | dvivacane tu
tvām, jasi tvam | dvitīyādiṣu tu tvām, tvām, tvān, tvayā,
tvābhyām, tvābhiḥ, tvam, tvābhyām, tvabhyam, tvat, tvābhyām,
tvat, tva, tvayoḥ, tvākam, tvayi, tvayoḥ tvāsu | evamasmado'pi |

e yadā tu dvivacanāntāṇṇic kriyate, tadāpi yuṣmayatyasmayatīti
ṇici bhavati, vibhaktyabhāvādyauvāvayorabhāvaḥ | ekārthatvābhāvāt
pratyayotarapadayośca ityasyāpyabhāvaḥ | vibhaktau tu yuvāvādeśau |
tvahau so ityādiviṣaye tu ta eva bhavanti | ye tu
māntayorādeśau necchanti teṣāṃ sau, śeṣelopapakṣe -- yuṣam,
asamiti bhavati | pakṣāntare tu yuṣmam, asmamiti | evamanyatrāpi
draṣṭavyam | gahano'yaṃ prakiyātarka ityuparamyate || 
eyuvāvau dvivacane || 7 - 2 - 82 || 
e dvivacana ityarthagrahaṇamiti | vaktīti vacanam, kṛtyalyuṭo
bahulam, iti kartari lyuṭ, dvayorarthayorvacane 
edvivacane | prathamādvivacanāntaṃ caitat, tadāha - dvivacane
yuṣamadasmadī iti | ke punaste ityāha - dvyarthābhidhānaviṣaye iti
| etacca vacanagrahaṇāllabhyate | katham dvitva iti vaktavyam,
vibhaktāvityeva, dvitye yā vibhaktistasyāmityarthaḥ | 
e arthagrahaṇe sati yadiṣṭṃa sampadyate, tad darśayati - yadeti |
pāribhāṣikasya dvivacanasya grahaṇe tasyāsminviṣaye'bhāvadyauvāvādeśau
na syātāmityavyāptiḥ syāditi bhāvaḥ | ādeśāntareṇa na bādhyete
iti | bādhastu paratvādityatraiva vakṣyate | atikrāntaṃ yuvāmiti sau
jasi cādeśāntareṇa bādhaḥ | dvivacanasya tu pāribhāṣikasya grahaṇe'pi
siddhiriti prathamāyā atikramaḥ | utaratrāpi tu pāribhāṣikasya
grahaṇe'pi siddhiriti prathamāyā atikramaḥ | utaratrāpi
dvivacanasyātikrame'yameva hetuḥ | tatra cānādeśe vibhaktau halādau
dvitīyāyāṃ ca ātvam, ajādau yatvam, śeṣe lopaḥ,
ṇeóprathamayoram, ityādayo vibhaktyādeśāśca yatāyayaṃ draṣṭavyāḥ | 
e paratvāditi | tvāhādīnāmavakāśaḥ yadā bahvarthe yuṣmadasmadī -
atikrānto yuṣmānatitvam, atyaham, yuvāvayorakāśaḥ - yuvām,
āvām vdyarthatve sati, sāvubhayaprasaṅge vipratiṣedhaḥ | 
e yadā tvityādi | pāribhāṣikasya grahaṇe tatrāpi prasaṅga
ityativyāptiḥ syāditi bhāvaḥ | atikrāntau tvām , atitvāmiti |
prathamāyāśca dvivacane bhāṣāyām ityātvam | yadātra pāribhāṣikasya
grahaṇamiti matvedamudāhṛtam | athāpi tatrāpyarthagrahaṇam, tathāpi
bahvarthe'tiprasaṅga ityāha - atikrāntau yuṣmāniti | pūrvavadātvam
| evaṃ jñeyamiti | atiyuṣmām, atiyuṣmābhyām, atiyuṣmayoḥ |
evamasmadaḥ || 
eyūyavayau jasi || 7 - 2 - 93 || 
e paramayūyamiti | atra pāramyayogo yathāsambhavaṃ draṣṭavyaḥ |
tadantavidhiratra bhavatīti | aṅgādhikāre tasya ca tadutarapadasya ca
iti vacanāt | yadāpi tadantasya, tadāpi na sarvasya,
yuṣmadasmadormaparyantasyetyadhikārāt || 
etvāhau sau || 7 - 2 - 94 || 
e tvamiti | yadyaṣyatra tvamāvekavacane iti tvādeśaḥ siddhaḥ
tathāpyahādeśastāvadvidheyaḥ tatra ca ahaḥ sau tyucyimāne
yuṣmado'pi prasaṅgaḥ, asmado'haḥ sau ityucyamāne gauravaṃ syāt,
tasmādatrāpi tvādeśa eva vidheyayaḥ | kiñca - atikrānto yuvāṃ
yuṣmānvā'titvamityatra tvādeśasya śaṅkāpi nāsti || 
etvamāvekavacane || 7 - 2 - 97 || 
e ekavacana ityarthanirdeśa ityādi | etacca dvivacana ityarthanirddeśaḥ
ityetadanusāreṇa yojyam | 
e arthagrahaṇe yadiṣṭṃa sampadyate taddarśayati - tadeti | pāribhā, ikasya
tvekavacanasya grahaṇe'tra na syādityavyāptiḥ | atikrāntau tvāmiti |
tadāpi tvamau bhavata ityasyodāharaṇam | atitvāmiti |
pūrvavadātvam | evamanyadudāhartavyamiti | etad atitvam,
atyahamityanenāpi sambadhyate | atiyūyam, atitubhyam, atitava |
evamasmadaḥ | atitvāmatimāmityanena tu sambandhaḥ spaṣṭa eva | atitvāṃ
paśya atitvān, atitvābhyām, atitvābhiḥ, atitvabhāyam | atitvam
| atitvayoḥ atitvākam | atitvayi, atitvayoḥ, atitvāsu |
evamasmadaḥ | 
e atrānantaraṃ yadā yuṣmadasmadī dvitvabahutvayorvartete
samāsārthesyaikatvaṃ tadā tvamau na bhavataḥ atikrāntaṃ
yuvāmatiyuvām, atyāvām | atikrāntaṃ yuṣmān atiyuṣmān,
atyasmān | evaṃ neyamiti paṭhitavyam pūrvānusāreṇa
gamyamānatvānna paṭhitam || 
epratyayotarapadayośca || 7 - 2 - 98 || 
e ekavacane vartamānayoriti | ekārthābhidhānaviṣayayorityarthaḥ |
vastukathanaṃ caitam, na tu śabdārthakathanam | ekavacane ityasya
prathamādvivacanāntatvāt | tvadīya iti | tyadādīni ca iti ca
vṛddhasaṃjñā, vṛddhācchaḥ | tvatara iti | pāramyavatprarṣayogaḥ | 
e vabhaktāvityadhikārāditi | nanu ca pūrvasūtre vibhaktau iti na
sambhāntyate katham āvṛddheranuvartamānaṃ na sambadhyeta evamapi
yogavibhāgo na kartavyaḥ, tvamāvekavacane pratyayotarapadayoḥ
ityekayoga eva kartavyaḥ, evaṃ hi cakāro na kartavyo bhavati naivaṃ
śakyam, evaṃ hyucyamāne yathāsaṅkhyaṃ prāpnoti - yuṣmadaḥ pratyaye,
asmada utarapada 
eiti | atha kriyamāṇe'pi yogavibhāge, yāvatā nimitayoḥ sāmyaṃ
kasmādeva yathāsaṅkhyaṃ na syāt | nai, doṣaḥ cakāro'tra kriyate, sa
dvayorapi dve nimite samucceṣyati | 
e nanu ceti | codakaḥ | prakṛtipratyayayoḥ pūrvātarapadayośca madhye
yā vartate sāmantarvartinī vibhaktiḥ | pariharati - naiṣaṃ śakyamiti |
labdhumiti śeṣaḥ | kiṃ kāraṇam ityāha - tasyā lukā bhavitavyamiti |
luktu supo dhātuprātipadikayoḥ ityanena | antaraṅgāvityādi |
codakaḥ | vibhaktimātrāpekṣatvādantaraṅgatvam, luktu paścādutpannaḥ
pratyayamutarapadaṃ dhāpekṣya dhātutvapratipadikatvayorupajātayoḥ
prāpnuvan bahiraṅgaḥ | yadyapyayaṃ nityaḥ, tathāpi
nityāntaraṅgayorantaraṅgameva balīyaḥ | yathoktam -
parinityāntaraṅgapratipadavidhayo virodhinaḥ sannipāte teṣāṃ
mithaḥ prasaṅge parabalīyastvamiti | etadevetyādi | parihāraḥ |
kimetasya jñāpane prayojanam ityāhateneti | prathamenādibdena
gomatyatītyādergrahaṇam, dvitīyena dīrghahalṅyādilopayoḥ,
halṅyādilope hi pratyayalakṣaṇena numādi syādeva | luki tu na
lumatāṅgasya iti pratyayalakṣaṇapratiṣedhānna bhavati | jñāpanasya
prayojanāntaramāha - evaṃ ceti | 
e punaścodayati - atheti | asati hi prayojane jñāpakaṃ bhavati, asti
cātra prayojanam, kim eṣāmeva tvāhādīnāmādeśāntarāṇāṃ
bādhanam | satyetasmin prayojane na jñāpanamupapadyata iti |
pariharati - lakṣyasthityapakṣayeti | gomatpriya ityādikaṃ lakṣyaṃ loke
sādhubhāve sthitam, tadādeśāntarabādhanārthe'sminvijñāyamāne na
saṃgṛhītaṃ syāt, taccāpekṣyaṃ prayogamūlatvāvdyākaraṇasya |
tasmātadapekṣayā naitadādeśāntarāṇāṃ bādhanārthaṃ yuktaṃ vijñātumiti
| 
e apara āha - yadyetadādeśāntarāṇāṃ bādhanārtaṃ syāt maparyantasya
ityanuvṛttirapārthikā syāt | katham
utsargasamānadeśatvādapavādānāṃ śyanādiṣu tathā dṛṣṭatvāditi |
nāyaṃ niyamaḥ - utsargasamānadeśā apavādāḥ iti śnamādiṣu
vyabhicārāt | na hi śnambahujakacaḥ śabādibhiḥ samānadeśāḥ |
tasmādyadyavaśyamupapartirvaktavyā, evaṃ vaktavyam - iha
tvāhādayo'pyanuvartaneta, maparyantasyeti ca tatra tvāhādyanuvṛtyaiva
tadvādhe siddhe maparyantānuvṛttiraprāptaprāpaṇārthā satī
jñāpakamuktasyārthasyeti | 
e vayaṃ tu brūmaḥ - maparyantasya ityevānuvartya tasyādeśau vidheyau |
yadi cāntaraṅgā ādeśāḥ syuḥ , pratyayotarapadayormaparyantasya na
kvāpi sambhava iti tasyādeśavidhānamanupapannaṃ syāditi
jñāpakamuktasyārthasyeti || 
etricaturoḥ striyāṃ tisṛcatasṛ || 99 || 
e tricaturoreva viśeṣaṇamiti | śrutatvāt | nāṅgasyeti |
viparyayāt | tena kiṃ siddhaṃ bhavati ityāha - teneti | priyatiseti
| anaṅsau, ṛduśanaspurudaṃso'nehasāñca ityanaṅ | priyatisnāviti
| ṛto ṅisarvanāmasthānoyoḥ iti guṇaṃ paramapi
bādhitvotarasūtreṇa rādeśaḥ | priyatisṛ iti | iko'ci vibhaktau
ityajgrahaṇena jñāpitam - lumatā lupte'pi kvacitpratyayalakṣaṇaṃ
bhavatīti | tena svamornapuṃsakāt iti nitye luki kṛteti
tisṛbhāvaḥ | priyatisṛṇī iti | rādeśātpūrvavipratiṣedhena numiti
kvacitpaṭha|lte | nadyaḥtaśceti kabna bhavatīti |
samāsyamānadaśāyāmṛkārāntasya tatra grahaṇamiti bhāvaḥ | kababhāve
hetuḥ - vibhaktyāśrayatvādityādi | evaṃ tāvat striyām ityanena
tricaturorviśeṣaṇādavyāptiparihāro darśitaḥ | 
e ativyāptirapi parihṛtetyāha - yadā ceti | tisṛketi | svārthe
kanpratyayaḥ alpatve, kutsitatve, saṃjñāyāṃ vā | tatra vibhakterluki
kṛte tatra vidhīyamānastisṛbāvo na syāditi vacanam | tatra
svārthikapratyayāntatvādvahuvacanāntastisṛkāśabdaḥ saṃjñetyeke |
grāmasya kasyacideṣā saṃjñā rūḍhiriti nāsti bahuvacanaprasaṅga
ityanye | 
e catasarīti | yathā priyatisnāvityatra savanāmasthānalatraṇaṃ guṇaṃ
bādhitvā rādeśo bhavati, tathā ṅavapi prāpnoti tathā cotarasūtre
priyatisnīti ṅavapi rādeśamudāhariṣyati, pūrvapipratiṣedhaṃ ca
vakṣyati | atrāhuḥ - asmādeva nirdeśādarthapradhānayorevādeśaḥ | iha
tu svarūpapradhānatvāttdabhāve guṇa iti | catasna iti | atra
sthānivadbhāvāt caturaḥ śasi ityantodātatve sati udātayaṇo
halpūrvāt iti śasa udātatvaprasaṅgaḥ, sa nipātanasvareṇa bādhyate |
yathaiva tarhi nipātanasvaraḥ śasisvaraṃ bādhate, tathā
ṣaṭtricaturbhyo halādiḥ ityetaṃ 
evibhaktisvaramapi bādheta tatrāha - catasṛṇāmityatra tviti | tatra
kāraṇamāha - halādigrahaṇasāmarthyāditi | tatra halādigrahaṇasya
catasnaḥ paśyetyetadeva vyāvartyam, nānyatkiñcit | etacca
tatraivopapāditam | yadi ca nipātanasvaro vibhaktisvarasyāpi
bādhakaḥ syāt, tadāntareṇāpi halgrahaṇaṃ vibhakteḥ svaro na
bhaviṣyati, kiṃ halādigrahaṇena tatkriyamāṇaṃ jñāpayati --
nipātanasvaraṃ vibhaktisvaro bādhate iti | anye tvāhuḥ halādi -
grahaṇādeva catasnaḥ paśyetyatra caturaḥ śasi ityasyāpravṛttiravasīyate
| yadi syāt, tataḥ udātayaṇao halpūrvāt iti syādeva
vibhakterudātatvamiti tavdyāvṛtaye halādigrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt |
tasmādādyaudātanipātanameva na kartavyamiti | tatrādyaudātasya
catuśśabdasyānantaryata ādyaudāta eva catasnadeśe sati catasṛṇāmityatra
ṣaṭtricaturbhyo halādiḥ iti vibhakterudātatvaṃ bhavati || 
eaci ra ṛtaḥ || 7 - 2 - 100 || 
e pūrvasavarṇotvetyādi | tisnaḥ paśyetyatra prathamayoḥ pūrvasavarṇaḥ
ityasyāpavādaḥ | priyatisnaḥ svamityatra ṛta ut ityutvasya |
priyatisni, priyatisnau, priyatisnastiṣṭhantītyatra ṛto
ṅisarvanāmasthānayoḥ iti guṇasya | nanu yatra vidhyantarasyāprāptiḥ -
priyatisnā, priyatisne, priyatisnoriti, tatra ikoyaṇaci ityeva
siddhamiti vidhyantarasya viṣaye idamārabhyate tatra madhye'pavādāḥ
pūrvānvidhīn bādhante iti utvapūrvasavarṇau bādhata iti yuktam,
guṇaviṣaye tu paratvāt sa eva syāt ityata āha - paramapi hīti | 
e ṛta iti kimiti | tisṛcatasnoranuvṛttoḥ alo'ntyasya ityeva
siddhamiti praśnaḥ | tisṛcatasnoḥ pratipatyarthamiti |
tisṛcatasnorādeśayorajādāvapi vibhaktau pratipatiryathā
syādityarthaḥ | anyathā hīti | ṛtaḥ ityanucyamāne
ṣaṣṭhīnirddiṣṭatvāt tricaturorevāyamādeśaḥ syāt, sa ca
nāprāptayostisṛcatasnorvidhīyata iti tayārapavādaḥ syādityarthaḥ || 
ejarāyā jarasanyatarasyām || 7 - 2 - 101 || 
e atijarāṃsīti | atijara - i iti sthite yadi pūrva numāgamaḥ
syāt, so'ṅgabhakto'ṅgameva na vyāvadadhyāt | tadavayavaṃ tu
jarāśabdaṃ vyavadadhātyeveti satyapi tadantavidhau
nirdiśyamānasyādeśā bhavanti iti jaraśabdantasyāṅgasyāvayovo yo
jarāśabdaḥ tasya vibhaktyānantarthe vidhīyamāno jarasādeśo na
prāpnoti | athāpi syāt, tathāpi sakārātparasya numaḥ śravaṇaṃ syāt
| tasmātparatvātpūrvaṃ jarasādeśa eṣṭavyaḥ | tatra kṛte jhalantalakṣaṇo
numa | atijarasaṃ praśyetyatra atijara - am iti sthite
ekadeśavikṛtasyānanyatvājjaraśabdasya jarasādeśo kṛte
svamornapuṃsakāt iti luk prāpnoti | na ca tadānīmambhāvasya
prasaṅgaḥ anadantatvāt | nanu
cātijaraśabdasyādantatvātasyāmavasthāyāmambhāvena bādhitasya lukaḥ
punaḥ prasaṅgo na yuktaḥ, bhraṣṭāvasaratvāt naitadasti, nātrāmbhāvaḥ
pravṛtaḥ paratvānnityatvācca jarasādeśena bādhyate, tatra kṛte
lukprasaṅgaḥ | evaṃ tarhi sannipātaparibhāṣayā lugna bhaviṣyati |
ajādisannipātena jarasādeśo niṣpanno notsahate tasya luko
nimitatāṃ pratipatum | yadyevam, atijarasaṃ brāhmaṇakulaṃ tiṣṭhati
atijarasairiti na siddhyati, katham
sorbhisaścākārāntasannapātenājāidirādeśaḥ
kṛto'kārāntatvāvidhātino jarasādeśasya nimitaṃ na syāt |
iṣṭamevaitatsaṅgahītam | atijaramatijarairiti bhavitavyam, eṣa
gonardīyasya pakṣaḥ, tadidamucyate - ihetyādi | iheti
vākyopānyāse | atijarasaṃ brāhmaṇakulamityādi bhavitavyamityantaṃ
gonardīyasya matam | na punarluvaśāstraṃ pravartata iti yaduktam,
yaccoktam - atijaraṃ brāhmaṇakulamityādi, tatrobhayatrāpi hetuḥ -
sannipātalakṣaṇa iti | na punarlukśāstram ityatra punaḥ śabdasyāyamarthaḥ
- pūrvaṃ yā lukprāptiḥ, sāmbhāvena bādhitā yā tu jarasādeśe kṛte
