nunaḥ prāptiḥ, sāpi sannipātaparibhāṣayā na bhavatīti | 
e anye tvityādi | etacca ṭāṅasiṅasāminātsyāḥ, ato bhisa ais
ityatra vyākhyātam || 
etyadādīnām || 7 - 2 - 102 || 
e dviparyantā ityādi | iṣṭireveyam | yatūcyate - śeṣelopavacanaṃ
jñāpakamiti, tadayuktam, upasarjanārthatvādatiyūyamativayamiti |
yadā tu śeṣe lopaṣṭilopastadā tu sutarāmajñāpakam | 
e pāṭhādeva paryudastā iti | tathā ca sarvādisūtre vārtikam
saṃjñopasarjanānāṃ pratiṣedhaḥ pāṭhātparyudāsaḥ iti 
e| tena pāṭhopajīvanena pravartamānamidamapi saṃjñopasarjanībhūtānāṃ
na bhavati | tyadādīti | tyādādīnāmarthaḥ pradhānaṃ yatra samāse
tatretyarthaḥ | na hi te pāṭhātparyudastāḥ || 
ekimaḥ kaḥ || 7 - 2 - 103 || 
e tenākāra eva kimo na vidhīyata iti | kathaṃ punarakāravidhāne kaḥ
ityādirūpasiddhiḥ, yāvatāntyasya prāpnoti, na cāntyasya pūrṣeṇa
siddhaḥ, dviparyantāstyadādayaḥ ityuktatvāt apare
punaretaccodyabhayādevaṃ paṭhanti - tenākāra eva imo na vidhīyata iti
| ayamarthaḥ - imaḥ ityetāvatsūtramastu, tyadādīnāmaḥ ityeva
tyadādīnāṃ sambandhina imo'kāro bhavati tatra nānarthake'lentyavidhiḥ
iti sarvasyaivemo'kāro bhavati | teṣāmevaṃ paṭhatāmutaratra kimo
grahaṇaṃ kartavyam na kartavyam uti hoḥ iti vakṣyāmi imaḥ ityevra,
tato vāti imaḥ ityeva, imo vakārādeśo bhavati |
tasmātsākackārthameva kādeśo vihitaḥ || 
eku tihoḥ || 7 - 2 - 104 || 
e tiśabdasya vibhaktisaṃjñakasyābhāvātakāre ikāra uccāraṇārthaḥ |
kuheti | vā ha ca cchandasi iti hapratyayaḥ || 
ekvāti || 7 - 2 - 105 || 
e kveti | kimo't ityatpratyayaḥ || 
e athadeśāntarakaraṇaṃ kimartham, na prakṛtaḥ kuśabda eva vidhīyate, evaṃ
ca kṛtvā yogāvibhāgo'pi na kartavyaḥ kutihātsu ityevāstu kā
rūpasiddhiḥ yaṇādeśe kṛte kveti siddham, orguṇastu aṅgavṛte
punarvṛtau iti vacanānna bhaviṣyati,
yaṇadeśastvanāṅgatvādbhavatyeva tatrāha -
ādeśāntarakaraṇamorguṇanivṛtyarthamiti | niṣṭhitatatvaṃ
durjñānamiti bhāvaḥ | evaṃ tarhi kimo't ityetat kimoḍvat
iti vaktavyam, ṭilopo kṛte kveti siddham ata āha -
kimoḍvaditi ceti | kathaṃ punaḥ pratyayāntare rūpasiddhiḥ, yāvatā
kakārasya jaśtvaṃ prāpnoti ṭilopo hi ḍitpratyabhaviṣyati |
kathamasiddhatvam asiddhaṃ bahiraṅgamantaraṇeó | ṭilopo hi
ḍitpratyayāpekṣatvādvahiraṅgaḥ jaśtvaṃ tu tadanapekṣatvādantaraṅgam
| sākackārthamiti | sākacke hi pratyayāntare vihite kakveti
syat | yathānyāse tu tatrāpi kvetyeva bhavati || 
etadoḥ saḥ sāvanantyayoḥ || 7 - 2 - 106 || 
e sau, iti prathamaikavacanasya grahaṇam, na saptamībahuvacanasya,
syaścchandasi, so'ci lope cet ityādinirdeśāt | nāpyubhayoḥ
tathāhi sati si ityeva brūyāt, sakārādau vibhaktāviti | 
e anantyayoriti kimiti | viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāve
kāmacārātyadādiṣu takārāntasyāsambhāvacca
tyadādibhistadorviśeṣaṇādanantyayostāvastāvastiddham, antyasya tu
tyadādyatvaṃ bhaviṣyatīti praśnaḥ | atvasya soranyakṣa sāvakāśatvātsau
paratvādidameva syādityutaram | tatra kevale sau puṃlliṅge
viśeṣābhāvāt sambuddhau, striyāṃ ca pratyudāhṛtam | kimarthaṃ punaḥ
tadoḥ ityucyate, tavargagrahaṇameva kriyeta - toḥ saḥ sāvanantyasya
iti nakārasyāpi tarhi prāpnoti tasmānnuḍaci - aneṣaḥ, tānayam,
anasāviti | nuyaṃ parādistadgrahaṇena gṛhyate || 
eadasa au sulopaśca || 7 - 2 - 107 || 
e asuka iti | adakas su iti sthite autvapratiṣedhātyadādyatvaṃ
dakārasya satvaṃ sakārādutarasya cākaco'kārasya utvam | 
e utarapadabhūtānāmityādi | samāsādyā vibhaktirutpadyate,
tadapekṣatvādādeśo bahiṅgaḥ, tataścāntaraṅgatvādekādeśe kṛte
tasyādivadbhāvādādeśeṣu kriyamāṇeṣu paramayam,
paramahamityādyaniṣṭaprasaṅgaḥ | tasmādakṛtasandhikāryāṇāmevāmī
ādeśā vaktavyāḥ | etacca nendrasya parasya ityatra jñāpayiṣyate | 
e adasaḥ sorbhavedityādi | adasa au ityetāvadeva sūtramastu, sau
ityeva adasaḥ iti pañcamī, tayā pūrvasūtre kṛtārthāyāḥ saptamyāḥ
ṣaṣṭha|laṃ prakalpitāyām adasa utarasya soraukāro bhavatītyarthaḥ, tatra
tyadādyatve kṛte asāviti siddhe kiṃ sulopo vidhīyate |
hrasvāllupyeta sambuddhiḥ | yadi soraukāro vidhīyate, tadā hi
asāvityatra tyadādyatve hrasvātparasyāḥ sambuddheraukārasya lopaḥ syāt,
na halaḥ naiṣa doṣaḥ, halaḥ salope vidhīyate 
e| yadyevam, tatra halgrahaṇaṃ kartavyam netyāha - prakṛtaṃ hi tat |
halṅyābbhyo dīrghāt ityatra | nanu cedaṃ prathamānirdiṣṭam,
ṣaṣṭhaāā prakalpayiṣyati tasmādityutarasya iti | pūrvasūtravadvā prathamāyā
taeva yathākathañcinnirvāho bhaviṣyati | āpa etvaṃ bhavetasmin | iha
tarhi striyāṃ sambuddhau asā - au āṅ cāpiḥ sambuddhau ca thaityevaṃ
prāpnoti, prakṛte reva tvautve ṭāpo'bhāvādetvābhāvaḥ, na,
jhalītyuvartanāt naiṣa doṣaḥ, bahuvacane jhalyet ityato jhalīti
tatrānuvartate - jhalādau sambuddhāviti, autve kṛte ajhalāditvānna
bhaviṣyati | pratyayasthācca kāditvamiti | iha tarhi striyāmakaci asakā
- au iti sthite pratyayasthātkātpūrvasya itītvaṃ prāpnoti,
prakṛtereva tvaukāre ṭāpo'bhāvāditvābhāvaḥ | śībhāvaśca prasajyate
| iha ca striyām asā - au iti sthite auha āpaḥ iti śībhāvaḥ
prāpnoti, autvavidhānaṃ tu puṃsi caritārtham pākṣika eṣa doṣaḥ,
yadā auṅ āpaḥ iti pūrvācāryanirdeśastadā nāsti, itarayorastu
pakṣayorasti || 
eyaḥ sau || 7 - 2 - 110 || 
e striyāmayaṃ yakāra iti | napuṃsake tu svamamornapuṃsakāt iti
lumatā luptatvāt sorabhāvaḥ || 
ehali lopaḥ || 7 - 2 - 113 || 
e angrahaṇamanuvartata iti | yadyapi tatprathamāntam, tathāpi halīti
saptamyā tasya ṣaṣṭhī prakalpyate || 
emṛjervṛddhiḥ || 7 - 2 - 114 || 
e dhātośca kāryamucyamānamiti | vastuto dhātoryatkāryamucyate,
tadiha dhātorucyamānamiti vivakṣitam | sa dhātuḥ svarūpeṇaiva
gṛhyatāṃ mā vā, grāhitena anudātasya cardupadhasyānyatarasyām
ityayamapyamāgamo dhātupratyaya eva bhavati, na pramṛjbhyāmityādau |
tatpratyaya iti | dhātorityevaṃ vihite | kaṃsaparimṛḍbhyāmiti |
atra tadantavidhinā prasaṅgaḥ || 
eaco ñṇiti || 7 - 2 - 115 || 
e taṇḍulaniścāya ityādau parimāṇākhyayāṃ sarvebhyaḥ iti ghañ | 
e gauḥ, gāvau, gāva iti | atra gaurityetatsākṣādudāharaṇam,
itaratrāvādeśe kṛte ata upadhāyāḥ ityeva siddham | sakhāyau, sakhāya
iti | atrāpi sakhāyāvityetadudāharaṇam, jasi tu jasi ca iti guṇe
ayādeśe ca kṛte pūrvavatsiddham | cyautnamiti balanāma, chāndasam
-- tamiccyautnairāryanti | kimartha punaridamucyate, yāvatā
jetṛyotṛśabdābhāyāṃ prajñādyaṇi jaitram, yautramiti siddham |
cyautnamiti uṇādayo'vyutpannāni prātipadikāni |
taṇulaniścāyaḥ ścāvakaḥ, lāvaka ityādau goto ṇit ityetaṭ
gota aut iti vaktavyam - gota aukārādeśo bhavati
sarvanāmasthāne parataḥ | kathaṃ sakhāyau, sakhāyaḥ sakhyurasambuddhau
ityetat sakhyurait taiti vakṣyāmi, atrocyate ñṇiti iti
tāvadutarārthaṃ vaktavyam | kiñca - priyamācaṣṭe prāpyayatītyādau
prādyādeśeṣu vṛddhine syāt | atha te dīrghāntā vidhīyeran
tadatiguru syāditi yathānyāsamevāstu || 
etaddhiteṣvacāmādeḥ || 7 - 2 - 117 || 
e ajāmāderaco vṛddhiriti | nanu ca ikparibhāṣopasthānādika eva
sthānitvena bhavitavyam, yadyapi tulyajātīyasya nirdhāraṇaṃ bhavati,
yathā - gavāṃ kṛṣṇā sampannakṣīratametyukte gaureva pratīyate,
tathātrāpyacāmādirajeva tathāpi sākṣād acaḥ iti
nirdeśābhāvādikparibhāṣopatiṣṭhetaiva - igātmakasyāca iti,
tasmātsathāninirdeśārthamaca iti vaktavyam tanna vaktavyam
prakṛtamanuvartate -- aco ñṇiti iti, tatra
nirdiṣṭasthānikatvādikparibhāṣāyā avyāpāraḥ | 
e atha tvāṣṭraḥ, jāgata ityatra tvaṣṭrajagacchabdābhyām tasyedam ityaṇi
kṛte yathākramam aco ñṇiti, ata upadhāyāḥ iti vṛddhiḥ kasmānna
bhavati tatrāha - tvāṣṭraḥ jāgata tyitreti | antyopadhālakṣaṇāṃ vṛddhi
bādhata iti | paratvāditi bhāvaḥ | antyopadhālakṣaṇāyā vṛddheravakāśaḥ
- gauḥ, yācakaḥ, asyā avakāśaḥ suśrut sauśrutaḥ, tvāṣṭraḥ, jagata
ityatrobhacaprasaṅge paratvādādivṛddhirbhavati |
sakṛdratinyāyaścāśrīyate, na punaḥ prasaṅgavijñānam | evaṃ ca kṛtvā
puṣkarasacchabdasyānuśatikādiṣu pāṭho'rthavānna bhavati | yadi
tvādivṛddhiviṣaye'ntyopadhāvṛddhiḥ syāt, tadopadhālakṣaṇayaiva
vṛddhyā pauṣkarasādeḥ siddhatvādanuśatikādiṣu tanna paṭhet, ṭhagarthaṃ
tatra pāṭhaḥ syāt - 
epauṣkarasādikaḥ | na hyatropadhālakṣaṇā vṛddhiḥ prāpnoti, añṇitvāt
naitadasti, na hyasmāccaratyarthe ṭhagutpadyate, anabhidhānāt |
yadvāpratipadavihite bāhvādilakṣaṇa iñyovobhayapadavṛddhiḥ,
nānyatreti ṭhagarthaḥ pāṭho na bhavati | yatra tvādivṛddhiḥ pratiṣiṣyate,
tatrāntyopadhālakṣaṇā vṛddhiḥ | kasmānna bhavati -- vyamorbhavo
vaiyasavam, igantācca laghupūrvāt ityaṇ, vyāpadi bhaṣaṃ
vaiyāpadamiti tatrāpyaicau paratvāt bādhakāviti siddham || 
ekiti ca || 7 - 2 - 117 || 
e nāḍāyanaḥ, cārāyaṇa iti | naḍādibhyaḥ phak | ākṣikaḥ, śālākika
iti | dīvyatyarthe ṭhak || 
e iti śrīharadatamaśravirācatāyāṃ padamañjarayau saptamasyādhyāyasya
dvitīyaścaraṇaḥkāśikāvṛttiḥ---6
atha saptamādhyāye tṛtīyaḥ pādaḥ
devikāśiṃśapādityavāḍdīrghasatraśreyasāmāt || 7|3|1 ||
atra viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāve kāmacārād devikādibhiraṅgaṃ
viśeṣyate, tena vā tāni, tatrāpi sāmānādhikaraṇyena,
vaiyadhikaraṇyana vā---iti catvāraḥ pakṣāḥ | tatra devikādibhiḥ
sāmānādhikaraṇyenāṅgasya viśeṣaṇāt
tadantavidhisambhavāddevikādyantasyācāmāderākāro bhavatītyarthaḥ
syāt | tatra kevalānāṃ na syāt, na hi tadeva tadantaṃ bhavati |
vyapadeśivadbhāvo'pi prātipadikena niṣiddhaḥ | yadi tu
pratyayavidhiviṣayaḥ sa pratiṣedhaḥ | tadā kevalānāṃ bhavatu, tadādau
tu na syāt---devikākūle bhavā dāvikākūlāḥ śālaya iti |
tadante cātiprasaṅgaḥ---sudevikādau bhavaṃ saudevikamiti; atra
sorukārasyākāraḥ syāt | atha vaiyadhikaraṇyena
viśeṣaṇam---devikādīnāṃ yadaṅgamiti,
kiñci---devikādīnāmaṅgaṃ yatra ca te'vayavabhūtāḥ, tataśca kevalānna
syāt, na hi sa eva tasyāvayavo bhavati | vyapadeśivadbhāvo'pi
prātipadikena pratiṣiddhaḥ | yadi tu pratyayaviṣayaḥ sa pratiṣedhaḥ, tadā
kevalānāṃ bhavatu, tadante tvatiprasaṅgaḥ pūrvavat | kevalaṃ
tadādāvaprasaṅga evāsminpakṣe parihṛtaḥ | athāṅgaṃ samānādhikaraṇaṃ
viśeṣaṇam---aṅgaṃ ye devikādaya iti, tadā tadante'tiprasaṅgaḥ
parihṛtaḥ, tadādau tvaprasaṅgaḥ syādeva | tadeva tarhi vyadhikaraṇaṃ
vaśeṣiṇam---aṅgasya ye avayavabhūtā
devikādayasteṣāmacāmāderākāra iti ? tadā kevale tadādau ca na
doṣaḥ, kintu parapadabhūtānāmapi teṣāmākāraprasaṅgaḥ | tatra
prāggrāme pūrvaśāṃśapa ityādāviṣṭa evākāraḥ, sudevikādāvagrāme
tvaniṣṭaprasaṅgaḥ | tadevamete catvāro'pi pakṣā duṣṭāḥ |
athāparaḥ pakṣaḥ---aṅgena
devakādibhiścācāmādiviśeṣyate---aṅgasyācāmāderākāro bhavati
sa ceddevikādīnāṃ sambandhī bhavatīti | atra pakṣe kevaleṣu tadātau
cāṅge nāsti doṣaḥ, nāpi saudevikamityatra
pūrvapadasyotarapadasya vā prasaṅgaḥ; kintu prāggrāme
pūrvaśāṃśapaḥ---ityādāvutarapadabhūtānāṃ devikādīnāmākāro na
syāt ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; ṭhprācāṃ grāmanagarāṇām'
ityatraitadanuvartiṣyate, tatra ca vākyabedena sambandhaḥ---prācāṃ
grāmanagarāṇāmutarapadasyācāmāderaco vṛddhirbhavati,
devikādīnāmutarapadānāmacāmāderākāra iti | ayamapi
vṛttikārasya pakṣo na bhavati; yadyayaṃ pakṣo'bhaviṣyat,
utarapadavṛddhāvapyetadanuvartiṣyata ityevāvakṣyat |
kastarhi vṛttikārasya pakṣo'yamabhidhīyate ?
paribhāṣeyamāntaryaparibhāṣā'pavādinī ||
devikāderacāmāderyatra vṛddhiḥ prasajyate |
tatropatiṣṭhate, tena sarvamiṣṭṃa prasidhyati || iti |
anārabhyamāṇe etasmin, devikādīnāmāderaco vṛddhirbhavantī
sthāne'ntaratamavacanādaikāraḥ prāpnoti, tadapavādenākāraḥ prāpyate,
tatrāṅgaṃ bhavatu devikādayaḥ pūrvapadamutarapadaṃ vā; sarvathā yatra
devikādīnāmacāmāderaco vṛddhiprasaṅgaḥ, tatrākāro bhavatīti
paribhāṣyate | nanu ca ṭhaṅgasya' iti vartate ? satyam;
naivamasyābhisambandhaḥ---aṅgasyācāmāderākāro bhavati sa
ceddevikādīnāṃ sambandhīti, kiṃ tarhi ?
devikādīnāmacāmāderākāro bhavati sa cedaṅgasya sambandhīti |
athaivamabhisambandhe kiṃ vyāvartyam ? na kiñcit, anuvṛtasya tu
sambandho vaktavya ityetāvat | sāpyākāra eva bhavatīti | ukto'tra
hetuḥ |
vahīnarasyeti | vaho'syāstīti vahī, vahī cāsau naraśceti
vahīnaraḥ, ṭhanyeṣāmapi dṛśyate' iti dīrghatvam | vaihīnaririti |
atrākāravṛddhiḥ prāptā ikāreṇa bādhyate | tasya
tvaikāravṛddhirbhavatyeva, na hi tasyāṃ nāprāptāyāmikāro vidhīyate,
evaṃ ca kṛtvā sūtre'pyakāra eva vidheyaḥ, tasyākāravṛddhau
siddhamiṣṭam ? tathā tu na kṛtamityeva | kecitviti | vihīno
naro vihīnaraḥ, pṛṣodarāditvānnaśabdasya lopaḥ ||
kekayamitrayupralayānāṃ yāderiyaḥ || 7|3|2 ||
laukikaṃ hi tatra gotraṃ gṛhyata iti | mitrayu
śabdo'bhedhopacārātadapatyasantāne yadā vartate na paraṃ
prakṛtāveva, tadedamucyate | yadā tu gṛṣṭa|ladibhyaṣṭhaño
yaskāditvād bahuṣu luk kriyate, tadā pāribhāṣike'pi gotre na
doṣaḥ | atra yadyapi vṛddhiprasaṅge'yamādeśa ucyate, tathāpi vṛddhirna
bādhyate; viṣayabhedāt---acāmādervṛddhiḥ, yāderiyādeśaḥ, aṅgaṃ
tūbhayoviśeṣaṇam, na kāryi ||
na yvābhyāṃ padāntābhyāṃ pūrvau tu tābhyāmaic || 7|3|3 ||
atrārthadvayavidhānādvākyabhedaḥ, tasyaiva dyotakastuśabdaḥ, ṭhpūrvau'
ityanena sambandhādaicāviti prāpte ekavacanaṃ sautram | vṛtau tu
kriyāviśeṣaṇatvādekavacanam | tābhyāṃ tu pūrvamiti | aijāgamo
bhavatīti | ṭitvādyāgamaliṅgābhāve'pi pūrvaśabdena deśaviśeṣe
bhavannāgama ityucyate---āgacchatītyāgama iti | vaiyasanamiti |
ṭhgatikārakopapadānāṃ prāksubutpateḥ samāsaḥ'
ityutarapadaviṣayamityavīcāma | tena vaiyasanādiṣu yvoḥ
padāntatvam | svaśvaśabdaḥ śivadiḥ |
yāṣṭīka iti | ṭhśaktiyaṣṭa|lerīkak' | nanu cātrācāmādeḥ sthāne
yau yvau tābhyāmityāśrayaṇāadeva na bhaviṣyati ? tatrāha---yata ima
iti | ṭhiṇ gatau' laṭaḥ śatrādeśaḥ, śapo luk, ṭhiṇo yaṇ' |
ihāsatyapi pratiṣedhe vaiyasanamityādau vyasana a a iti sthite
vṛddhiśca prāpnoti, aijāgamaśca; tatra vṛddhiranityā, śabdāntaraprāpteḥ
| sā hyaeci kṛte tasyaiva prāpnoti; tanmadhyapatitasya tadgrahaṇena
prahaṇāt | aijāgamastu nitya iti sa eva tāvadbhavati | tatra kṛte
yadyapi punaḥ---prasaṅgavijñānād vṛddhiḥ, tathāpyāntaryata
aikārasyaikāraḥ, aukārasyaukāra iti na kaściddoṣaḥ, kiṃ pratiṣedhena
!
nanvasati tasmin, vaiyākaraṇī bhāryā asya vaiyākaraṇabhārya iti
ṭhvṛddhinimitasya' iti puṃvadbhāvapratiṣedhaḥ syāt, sati tu
pratiṣedhe na bhavati; kathaṃ na bhavati, yāvatā vṛddhernimitaṃ ñaṇakā
yasmiṃstaddhita iti bahuvrīhiḥ, vidyate cātra ṇakāraḥ ? satyaṃ vidyate,
nimitaṃ tu na bhavati; ṭhkurvadrūpe hi nimitaśabdo mukhyaḥ' ityuktam
| nanu ca mā bhūt ṭhtaddhiteṣvacāmādeḥ' ityasyā vṛddhernimitam, ya
eva tvasau ṇitaddhitāścaya aijvidhīyate tasyaiva vṛddhisaṃjñakasya nimitaṃ
ṇakāra iti syādeva puṃvadbhāvapratiṣedhaḥ ? ucyate; na hi vastuto
yā vṛddhistasyā yannimitaṃ ñakārādistadvati pratiṣedhaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ?
bṛddhirityevaṃ yā vidhīyate tannimite | ataḥ
puṃvadbhāvapratiṣedhanivṛtyarthaṃ vṛddheḥ pratiṣedho vaktavya eva ? na
vaktavyaḥ; ekasminnaṅge viśeṣavihitāvaicau sāmānyavihitāyā
vṛddherbādhakau bhaviṣyataḥ, satyapi sambhave bādhanaṃ bhavatīti nyāyāt;
tataśca pūrvavatpuṃvadbhāvapratiṣedho na bhaviṣyatīti ṭhyvābhyāṃ
pūrvamaic' ityevāstu, nārthaḥ pratiṣedhena ? ityata
āha---pratiṣedhavacanamiti | pratiṣedhavacane sati yābhyāṃ yvābhyāṃ
parasya vṛddhiḥ prāptā pratiṣidhyate, tābhyaameva pūrvāvaicau bhavata
ityarthau bhavati, asati hi tasmin yau kaucana yvau gṛhyaeyātām |
tasmādaicorviśiṣṭo viṣayaḥ pralkṛpto yathā syādityevamarthaṃ
pratiṣedhavacanaṃ kriyata ityarthaḥ | dādhyaśviḥ, mādhvaśviriti|
dadhipriyo'śvo yasya sa dadhyaśvaḥ | evaṃ madhvaśvaḥ, tābhyām ṭhata iñ' |
nanu ca ṭhachāmādeḥ' ityanena yvau viśeṣayiṣyāmaḥ---acāmāderacaḥ
sthāne yau yvāviti ? evamapi dve aśīti adhīṣṭaḥ, ṭhtaddhitārtha' iti
samāsaḥ, tamadhīṣṭa iti ṭhprāgvateṣṭhak', dvyāśītikaḥ---atra
prāpnoti | sati tu pratiṣedhe ṭhtaddhiteṣvacāmādeḥ'
ityanuvṛteryābhyāṃ parasya ṭhtaddhiteṣvacāmādeḥ' iti vṛddhiḥ prāptā
pratiṣidhyate, tābhyāmiti vijñāyate; atra tu ṭhsaṃkhyāyāḥ
saṃvatsarasaṃkhyasya ca' ityevamutarapadavṛddhirvidhīyata iti tasya
niṣedhābhāvādaijāgamābhāvaḥ siddhaḥ |
syādetat---acāmāderityanuvṛtaṃ svarūpaparaṃ sad
vṛddherviśeṣaṇam, acāmāderityevaṃ yā vṛddhistasyāḥ prasaṅge
tadapavādau yvābhyāṃ pūrvamaico bhavata ityarthaḥ, iha tu naivaṃ vṛddheḥ
prasaṅga ityaicau na bhaviṣyata iti ? evamapi yvāvaviśeṣitau
syātām, tataśca dādhyaśvādau prasaṅgaḥ | na ca

atra saṃgrahaślokau----
nāprāptāyā hi vṛddheḥ pratipadavidhiraijbādhako nañ kimartho 
yābhyāṃ yvābhyāṃ parasyaic prasajati tata evaiṣa pūrvo yathā syāt |
mā dādhyaśvādike bhūditi nanu vihitau yāvacāṃ sthāna āde-
ryvau tābhyāmaijihaivaṃ na bhavati iti ced dve aśīti adhīṣṭe ||
syādaij dvyāśītike'ṅgādyaca iti vihitasyaivamaiccetprasaṅgād
yvau na syātāṃ viśiṣṭau śrutamapi ca sakṛnnobhayaṃ bhetumarham |
syādetasyotaratrāpyadhikṛtiriha ca yvoḥ padasyotarasyai-
vaṃ pūrvatraiyalinde bhavati, na ca bhaved dve aśītī adhīṣṭe ||
dvārādīnāṃ ca || 7|3|4 ||
dauvārika iti | ṭhtatra niyuktaḥ' iti ṭhak | dvārapālasyedaṃ
dauvārapālamiti | ṭhsaṃjñāpūrvako vidhiranityaḥ' iti
vṛddhalakṣaṇaśchāe na bhavati, ṭhkalāpino'ṇ'
ityatrāṇgrahaṇasyādhikavidhānārthatvādvā | kathaṃ punardvāraśabdasya pāṭhe
dvārapālaśabdasya vidhirayaṃ bhavati ? tatrāha---tadādividhiścātra
bhavatīti | atra ca kāraṇaṃ devikādisūtra evoktam | jñāpakaṃ cātra
vakṣyati | sauvaro'dhyāya iti | sa punaḥ śantanupraṇītaḥ,
phiṣityādikaḥ | ṭhsauvaryaḥ saptamyastadantasaptamyaḥ' iti bhāṣye |
śobhano'dhyāyaḥ svādhyāya iti | āṅtra madhye prakṣeptavyaḥ, ṭhanyeṣāmapi
dṛśyate' iti vā utarapadādedīrghatvam | evamapītyādi |
yadyatra svaśabdaḥ paṭha|lte, kimāyātaṃ svādhyāyaśabdasya ?
tatrāha---tadādāvapi hīti | svārthika-svābhāvikādayastu
bhāṣyaprayogātsādhavaḥ | sphaiyakṛta iti ṛṣitvādaṇ | śauvādaṃṣṭro
maṇiriti | ṭhśuno dantadaṃṣṭrā' iti dīrghatvam, pūrvavadaṇ ||
nyagrodhasya ca kevalasya || 7|3|5 ||
naiyagrodha iti | nīcairgatau prarohairvardhata ityarthaḥ |
avyutpattipakṣe tu vidhyarthamiti | apadāntatvādyakārasya | athāsminnapi
pakṣe kevalagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā nyagrodhasyetyujyate, tatra kaḥ
prasaṅgo yatadādau syāt ? jñāpanārthaṃ tu |
etajjñāpayati---asaminprakaraṇe yānyupātāni tāni
tadādivṛddhibhājo'co viśeṣaṇānīti ||
na karmavyatihāre || 7|3|6 ||
karmavyatihāre yaduktamiti | yadasminprakaraṇe uktaṃ tatkarmavyatihāre
na bhavatītyarthaḥ ||
svāgatādīnāṃ ca || 7|3|7 ||
vyāvakrośītyādau vyavapūrvo dhātuḥ karmavyatihāre dṛṣṭa iti
vyavahāraśabdo'pi karmavyatihāre vartate, tataśca pūrveṇaivātra
siddheratrāsya pāṭho'narthaka ityāśaṅkyāha---vyavahāraśabdo'yamiti |
dvārādiṣu svaśabdasya pāṭādatra prasaṅga iti | ṭhtadāderapi tatra
grahaṇaṃ bhavati' ityuktameva ||
"svāderiñi || 7|3|8 ||
tatra cetyādi | yadi tatra tadādividhirna syāt etadvacanamanarthakam,
katham ? kevalaśvanśabdo dvārādiṣu paṭha|lte, tatra kaḥ prasaṅgo
yatadādeḥ syāt ! tadādividhirbhavatīti | asminprakaraṇe yaduktaṃ
tadvṛddhibhājo'co viśeṣaṇamityasminnarthe jñāpakamityarthaḥ |
ikārādigrahaṇaṃ cetyādi | śvāderitīti vaktavyamityarthaḥ | tatra
varṇagrahaṇe saptamīnirdeśātadādividhiḥ | śvāgaṇika iti |
ṭhśvagaṇāṭṭhañ' iti ṭhañ | tadantasyeti | iñantasya | śvābhastramiti |
ṭhiñaśca' ityaṇ | tannimito vṛddhipratiṣedhaḥ, aijāgamaśca
bhinnakakṣatvādaśakya iñāśrayeṇa pratiṣedhena nivārayitumiti
vacanārambhaḥ ||
utarapadasya || 7|3|10 ||
utaratra ṭhacāmādeḥ' ityanuvṛterutarapadasyācāmādervṛddhirveditavyā |
nanu caṭhavayavādṛtoḥ' ityādau ṭhavayavād' ityādikā pañcamī,
tatrāntareṇāpyutarapadagrahaṇamutarapadasyaiva bhaviṣyati ? ata
āha---yatreti | ādipadena ṭhhṛdbhagasindhvante pūrvapadasya ca',
anuśatikādīnāṃ ca', ṭhdevatādvandve ca'---ityeteṣāṃ grahaṇam | eṣu
yogeṣu
pañcamīnirdeśābhāvādasatyasminnadhikāre'ṅgasyācāmāderaco vṛddhiḥ
syāt, notarapadasya | vacanaṃ tu niyamārthaṃ syāt---ja eva
proṣṭhapadānām, nānyatra | proṣṭhapadānāmeva vā je iti |
vacanasāmarthyādvā pūrvapadasyaivānādyaco vṛddhividhānārthaṃ syāt |
tasmādetadarthamevāyamadhikāraḥ kartavyaḥ |
kimidānīṃ pañcamīnirdeśeṣvasyānuyoga eva ?
netyāha---pañcamīnirdeśeṣvapīti | vṛddheśca vyapadeśārthamiti |
utarapadādhikāre vihitā yā vṛddhiriti vyapadeśo yathā
syādityevamarthamityarthaḥ | kva punarevaṃvidhena vyapadeśena
prayojanam ? ityata āha---utarapadavṛddhau sarvaṃ cetyatreti |
sarvabhāsaḥ, sarvakāra ityādau mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ tatraivamāśritam ||
avayavādṛtoḥ || 7|3|11 ||
ṛtorvṛddhimadvidhāvityādi | ṛtoḥuṛtuvācinaḥ
śabdādvṛddhimadvidhauuvṛddhinimite pratyaye vidhīyamāne tadantavidhiḥ,
ṛtuśabdāntādapi pratyayo bhavatītyarthaḥ | kiṃ sarvatra ? netyata
āha---avayavāditi | avayavavacanāt paro yadā ṛtuvacanastadetyarthaḥ
| ye tu---avayavānāmiti ṣaṣṭhībahuvacanāntaṃ paṭhanti, teṣāṃ na
samīcīno'rthaḥ | tathā ca ṭhsusarvārdhadikśabdebhyaḥ' iti pañcamyā
niradeśi | pūrvāsu varṣāsu bhava iti | ṭhtaddhitārtha' iti samāsaḥ |
anye tu---adikśabdatvādviśeṣasamāsaṃ manyante | athātrāpi
tadantavidhinā varṣābhyaṣṭhageva kasmānna bhavati ? ata
āha---avayavapūrvasyaiva hīti ||
susarvārdhājjanapadasya || 7|3|12 ||
janapadavācina iti | svarūpagrahaṇaṃ tu na bhavati; utarasūtre
madrapratiṣedhāt | susarvārdhetyādi | janapadavācinaḥ śabdasyānantare
pratyaye vidhīyamāne tadantasyāpi grahaṇaṃ bhavati, yadi suprabhṛtibhyaḥ
paraḥ sambhavatītyarthaḥ ||
diśo'madrāṇām || 7|3|13 ||
pūrvapāñcālaka iti | taddhitārthe samāsaḥ | paurvapañcālaka iti |
avayavavācyatra pūrvaśabdaḥ, ekadeśisamāsād vuñpratyayaḥ |
adikśabdatvād ādivṛddhireva bhavati | yadyevam, vuñāpi na
bhavitavyamadikśabdatvādeva ? astyatra viśeṣaḥ, susarvārddhāddikśabdebhya
iti tadantavidhau śabdagrahaṇaṃ kriyate---diśi dṛṣṭaḥ śabdo dikśabda
ityevaṃ yathā vijñāyeta, vṛddhividhau tu diśa ityetāvaducyate | ante
tvaṇantameva pratyudāharaṇaṃ paṭhanti ||
prācāṃ grāmanagarāṇām || 7|3|14 ||
ṭhprācām' iti nācāryanirddeśaḥ; janapadādibhirdeaśaiḥ sāhacaryāt |
pūrvaiṣukāmaśama iti | pūrvā cāsāviṣukāmaśamī ceti ṭhdiksaṃkhye
saṃjñāyām' iti samāsaḥ, tato bhavārthe ṭhdikpūrvapadādasaṃjñāyāṃ ñaḥ'
iti ñapratyayaḥ |
pūrvapāṭaliputraka iti | pūrvavatsamāsaḥ, ṭhropadhetoḥ pracām' iti
vuñ | yadyapyekameva pāṭaliputram, tathāpi pāṭaliputrasyaikadeśe
pāṭaliputraśabdasya vṛteḥ pūrvatvaviśeṣaṇaṃ yuktameva |
janā yatra santi sa grāmaḥ, tataśca nagaramapi grāmaḥ | ye hi grāme
vidhayo neṣyante sādhīyaste nagare'pi na kriyante | tadyathā---ṭhabhakṣyo
grāmakukkuṭaḥ' iti sutarāṃ nāgaro'pi na bhakṣyate | ṭhgrāme
nādhyeyam' iti sādhīyo nagare'pi nādhīyate |
śāstre'pi--ṭhudīcyagramācca bahvaco'ntodātāt',
ṭhvāhīkagrāmebhyaśca', ṭhdikśabdāḥ
grāmajanapadākhyānacānarāṭeṣu'---nagaramapi gṛhyate, tasmādihāpi
nārtho nagaragrahaṇena ? ityata āha---grāmatvādeveti |
sambandhabhedapratipatyarthamiti | aṅgasyeti prakṛtam, utarapadasyeti
ca, tatra grāmāṇāmityetadaṅgasyetyanena
sambadhyate---grāmavācināmaṅgānāmiti |
nagarāṇāmityetadutarapadasyetyanena---nagaravācināmutarapadānāmiti | na cāyaṃ sambandhabhedaḥ sakṛdupāte grāmaśabde sambhavati, tasmānnagaragrahaṇaṃ kriyate | tatra dikpūrvapado hītyādinā sambandhabheda āśrayaṇīya ityatra heturdarśitaḥ | tatraityādinā tu sa eva sambandhabhedaḥ | iha pūrvaiṣukāmaśama iti samasanakriyānantaraṃ pūrvotarapadayorguṇaḥ prāpnuvannantaraṅgaḥ, utarapadavṛddhistu paścādupanatataddhitāpekṣatvādvahiraṅgā, tatra guṇe kṛte pūrvotarayorvyapavargābhāvādvṛddhirna prāpnoti; antādivadbhāvo'pyubhayata āśrayaṇe pratiṣiddhaḥ | atra hi dgvāci pūrvapadamutarapadaṃ ca yugapadāśrīyate, tatrāha---pūrvaiṣukāmaśama ityevamādiṣviti | yathā ṭhnendrasya parasya' iti jñāpakam, tathā tatraiva vakṣyāmaḥ ||
saṃkhyāyāḥ saṃvatsarasaṃkhyasya ca || 7|3|15 ||
saṃvatsaraśca saṃkhyā ca saṃvatsarasaṃkhyam, samāhāradvandvaḥ |
dvisāṃvatsarika iti | ṭhprāgvateṣṭhañ', tasya ṭhadhyardhapūrva' iti lugna
bhavati, anārhīyatvāt |
dviṣāṣṭika iti | nanu ṭhtamadhīṣṭo bhṛtaḥ' ityatra kālāditi vartate,
tatkathaṃ dviṣaṣṭa|ladiśabdebhyaḥ pratyayaḥ ? ityata āha---dviṣaṣṭa|ladiśabda
iti | kālavṛttiḥ śabdastatra gṛhyate, na māsādaya eveti bhāvaḥ |
nanu ca ṭhparamāṇāntasyāsaṃjñāśāṇayoḥ' ityatra paricchedahetutvamātraṃ
gṛhyate, na tvārohataḥ pariṇāitaśca yena mīyate tadeva prasthādi;
anyathā śāṇapratiṣedho'narthakaḥ syāt; kālaścāpi
paricchedaheturbhavatyeva, tataśca saṃbatsaragrahaṇamanarthakam,
parimāṇāntasyetyeva siddhatvāt ? ityata āha---saṃvatsaragrahaṇamiti |
dvaisamika iti | adhīṣṭādiṣu ṭhsamāyāḥ khaḥ', ṭhdvigorvā' iti pakṣe
ṭhañ |
na kevalaṃ vṛddhiviṣayameva jñāpakam, kiṃ tarhi ?
sārvatrikamityāha---dvivarṣā māṇaviketi | dve varṣe bhūtā iti
pūrvavaṭṭañ, tasya ṭhvarṣālluk', ṭhcitavati nityam' iti luk |
paryudāso na bhavatīti | pratiṣedhasya | tena pratiṣedha eva bhavati |
atha saṃkhyāgrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā saṃkhyayāpi paricchidyate, tatra
ṭhparimāṇāntasya' ityeva siddham ? kecidāhuḥ---saṃkhyāgrahaṇamapi
jñāpakārthameva, parimāṇagrahaṇena saṃkhyāpi na gṛhyata iti | tathā ca
ṭhaparimāṇabistācita' ityatra vṛtāvuktam---ṭhkālaḥ saṃkhyā ca
parimāṇaṃ na bhavati | dvivarṣā, trivarṣā, dviśatā, triśatā' iti | apara
āha---sākṣācchiṣṭena nimitabhāvenānumitaṃ kāryitvaṃ mā bādhīti
parimāṇātpṛthagiha saṃkhyāgrahaṇaṃ kṛtamiti ||
varṣasyābhaviṣyati || 7|3|16 ||
yasyetyādi | yasya yiyakṣoryāgavarṣādārabhya trīṇi varṣāṇi dhānyaṃ
bhāviutāvantaṃ kālaṃ jīvanāya paryāptam, sa somayāge'dhikārī, na
nyūna ityarthaḥ | gamyate hīti | vākyārthastatra bhaviṣyatā, na padārtha
ityarthaḥ | dvivāṣiṃko manuṣya iti | ṭhvarṣālluk', ṭhcitavati
nityam' iti nityaṃ lugna bhavati; bhūtārtha eva hi sa iṣyate, anyatra
citavatyapi vikalpa eva ||
parimāṇāntasyāsaṃjñāśāṇayoḥ || 7|3|17 ||

kalāpaḥukaścinmānaviśeṣaḥ |
yogavibhāgāditi | pūrvāsu vṛttiṣu ṭhtadasya parimāṇaṃ saṃkhyāyāḥ
saṃjñā' ityekayogena paṭhitatvād, bhāṣye tatra
yogavibhāgasyoktatvādevamuktam | taddhitāntaścāyamiti | yathā tu
ṭhadhyardhapūrvadvigoḥ' ityatra vārtikaṃ tathā taddhitaluki sati saṃjñeti
tatraivāvocāma | dvaiśāṇa iti | yadyatrotarapadavṛddhiḥ syāt,
pūrvapadasya na syāt | kulijamudhānyamānam | antagrahaṇaṃ
cintyaprayojanam ||
je proṣṭhapadānām || 7|3|18 ||
ja iti jātārtho nirdiśyata iti | upasaraja ityādau dṛṣṭasya
padaikadeśasya prayogaḥ, bhīmaseno bhīma itivat |
bahuvacananirdeśāditi | yadyapi jyotiṣāṃ
bahutvādbahuvacanāntaproṣṭhapadāśabdaḥ, tathāpi tasyaiva
śabdarūpāpekṣāyāmekavacanaṃ nyāyyaṃ manyate ||
hṛdbhagasindhvante pūrvapadasya ca || 7|3|19 ||
suhṛda iti | ṭhsuhṛddurhḍdau mitrāmitrayoḥ' iti nipātitaḥ
suhṛcchabdaḥ | yadā tu suhṛdayasyedamiti pāṭhaḥ, tadā ṭhhṛdayasya
hṛllekha' ityādinā hṛdbhāvaḥ | sauhārdyamiti | ṭhvā
śokaṣyañrogeṣu' iti hṛdbhāvaḥ | sindhavo janapadaḥ,
nadīvacanasyāpi grahaṇam, tathā samudravacanasyāpi ||
anuśatikādīnāṃ ca || 7|3|20 ||
ānuśātikamiti | śatena krītaṃ śatikam, ṭhśatācca ṭhanyatāvaśate,
iti ṭhan, anugataḥ śatikena anuśatikaḥ, tataḥ ṭhtasyedam' ityaṇa |
ānuhauḍikaṃ iti | ṭhcarati' iti ṭhak | ānusāṃvaraṇamiti | ṭhtatra ca
dīyate kāryaṃ bhavavat' ityaṇ | ānusāṃvatsarikamiti |
ṭhbahvaco'ntodātāṭṭhañ' |
kurukata-śabdo gargādiḥ |
sārvalaukikamiti | ṭhlokasarvalokābhyāṃ ṭhañ' | sārvabhauma iti |
ṭhsarvabhūmipṛthivībhyāmaṇañau' |
prayogādhidevādhibhūtetyadhyātmādayaḥ | kulaṭāyā vetīnaṅiti |
apapāṭho'yam, tatra hi svarūpagrahaṇam, | kalyāṇyādiṣu parastrīśabdaḥ
paṭha|lte, tasmāt kalyāṇyādīnāminaṅiti pāṭhaḥ | cāturvaidyamiti |
cāturvarṇyāditvātsvārthe ṣyañ, tāḥ punaścarasro vidyāḥucatvāro
vedāḥ ||
devatādvandve ca || 7|3|21 ||
agnivaruṇau devatā asya āgnivāruṇam, agnimarutau devatā asya
āgnimārutam | ṭhidvṛddhau' ityagniśabdasya itvam |
yo devatādvandva ityādi | yaḥ sūktaṃ bhajate stutyatayā sa
sūktasambandhī, haviryasmai nirūpyate sa haviḥ sambandhī | arthadvārakaṃ
cedaṃ dvandvasya viśeṣaṇam | skāndaviśākha iti | ṭhsāsya devatā'
ityaṇ | brāhmaprajāpatyamiti | ṭhpatyutarapadāṇṇyaḥ' | nanu ṭhsāsya
devatā' ityatra na jātivacano devatāśabdaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? yasyai
havirnirūpyate, yā vā mantrastutyā sāsya devatā gṛhyate; na
caivambhūto'tra dvandvārthaḥ, evambhūtatve vā yathā taddhitā bhavanti
tathāyamapi vidhiḥ prāpnoti ? atrāhuḥ---taddhitaḥ kvacidanyatrāpi
bhavati---jñā devatāsya jñaḥ, sthālīpāka iti hi bhāvye dṛṣṭamiti ||
nendrasya parasya || 7|3|22 ||
āgnendram, saumendramiti | ṭhajādyadantam' itīndraśabdasya
pūrvanipāto na bhavati; prāyikatvātasya |
indraśabda ityādi | indraśca maruccetyādau vyañjanāntena saha dvandve
indraśabdasya pūrvanipātena bhāvyam | yathā---aindrāmārutīṃ
bhedakāmālabheteti | vāyvindrāvityādikastu dvandvaḥ sūktahaviḥ
sambandhī na bhavatīti bhāvaḥ ||
dīrghācca varuṇasya || 7|3|23 ||
atra hītyādi | udāharaṇeṣu ṭhdevatādvandve ca' ityānaiṅkṛte
dīrghātparo varuṇaśabdaḥ ||
prācāṃ nagarānte || 7|3|24 ||
prācāṃ deśa iti | ācāryagrahaṇaṃ tu na bhavati; utarasūtre
ṭhvibhāṣitam' iti vacanāt ||
jaṅgaladhenuvalajāntasya vibhāṣitamutaram || 7|3|25 ||
jaṅgalamuvanaprāyo deśaḥ, kuruṣu jaṅgalaṃ kurujaṅgalam |
dhenuḥunavaprasūtā, viśveṣāṃ dhenurviśvadhenuḥ |
suvarṇavikāraḥuvalajam, sauvarṇavalajam | ṭhutaram' ityutarapadaṃ
lakṣyate, tasya nityasannihitatvāt svarūpeṇa
vibhāṣitatvānupapatervibhāṣitavṛddhikatvād vibhāṣitamiti gauṇo
vādaḥ ||
arddhātparimāṇasya pūvasya tu vā || 7|3|26 ||
arddhadrauṇikamiti | prāgvateṣṭhañ |
vāvacanamanarthakam, vibhāṣitamityanuvṛteḥ, tatraivaṃ
vaktavyam---pūrvaṃ tviti ? tathā tu na kṛtamityeva ||
nātaḥ parasya || 7|3|27 ||
ārdhaprasthikam, ārdhakaṃsikamiti | pūrvavaṭṭhañ |
kaṃsāṭṭiṭhaÄstu na bhavati; tadantavidherabhāvāt | prāgvateḥ
saṃkhyāpūrvapadānāṃ tadantavidhiḥ, na vārdhaśabdaḥ saṃkhyāvācī |
kiṃ ca syāditi | ākāro vṛddhireva, tatra satyasati vā
vṛddhipratiṣedhe nāsti viśeṣa iti manyate | kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ
puṃvadbhāvapratiṣedho na syāt ? ityata āha---yatra hīti |
taduktam---ṭhkurvadrūpe nimitaśabdo mukhyaḥ' iti |
parasyeti kim ? pūrvasya mā bhūt, ata iti
viśeṣaṇopādānasāmamarthyātpūrvasya na bhaviṣyati, na hi
pūrvasyādhaśabdasyākārādanyo vṛddhibhāgasti | kiñca---yadi pūrvasya
pratiṣedhaḥ syāt, ṭhpūrvasya tu vā' ityetadanarthakaṃ syāt | idaṃ tarhi
prayojanam---tadantavidhirmā bhūditi,
anyathā'kārāntasyotarapadasyaivaṃ vijñāyeta | tatra ko doṣaḥ ?
ihapratiṣedhaḥ syāt---ardhadrauṇikam, ardhakauḍavikamiti | pūrvastu
vidhiḥ---ardhamuṣṭinā krīto'rdhamauṣṭika ityādau caritārthaḥ |
tasmātadantavidhinirāsārtham ṭhparasya' ityuktam ||
pravāhaṇasya ḍhea || 7|3|28 ||
pravāhaṇaśabdasya ḍhea parata utarapadasyeti vyadhikaraṇe ṣaṣṭhayau |
pravāhaṇaśabdasya avayavabhūtaṃ yadutarapadaṃ tasyetyarthaḥ | nanu
vṛddhimadevātra svata evotarapadam, kasmai prayojanāyāsya
punarvṛddhirvidhīyate ? ucyate; yadā pūrvapade vṛddhirna bhavati tadā
yadyautarapade'pi vṛddhirna syāt, ṭhvṛddhinimitasya' iti
puṃvadbhāvapratiṣedho na syāt---pravāhaṇeyībhārya iti | mā
bhūdevam, ṭhjāteśca' ityevaṃ bhaviṣyati, ṭhgotraṃ ca caraṇaiḥ saha' iti
jātitvam ? evaṃ tarhyetajjñāpayati---anityo'yaṃ pratiṣedha iti | tena
hastinīnāṃ samūho hāstikamityatra bhasyāḍhea' iti vā, ṭhṭhakcchasośca'
iti vā prāptasyaupasaṃkhyānikasya puṃvadbhāvasya pratiṣedho na bhavati
| pravāhayatīti pravāhaṇaḥ, ṇyantād vahernandyāderlyuḥ,
ṭhṇervibhāṣā' iti ṇatvam |
tatpratyayasya ca || 7|3|29 ||
pravāhaṇeyiriti | yūnyapatye ṭhata iñ' | pravāhaṇeyakamiti |
ṭhgotracaraṇād vuñ' |
kimarthamidamucyate ? ḍhea parataḥ pūrveṇa vikalpa uktaḥ, ṭhāntasyeñādau
nityavṛddhirmā bhūditi | vaitadasti prayojanam, iñādinimitāyā
api vṛddherḍhāśraya eva vikalpo bādhako bhaviṣyati, ṭhḍhea' iti hi
parasaptamī, na nimitasaptamī, tenā nyanimitāyā api vṛddherḍhea
parataḥ pratiṣedho labhyata eva ? ata āha---brāhyataddhitanimiteti |
ayamabhipāyaḥ---ḍhea utpanne tadāśrayāṃ vṛddhiṃ bādhitvā
vikalpastāvatpravṛtaḥ, paścādiñādirutpannaḥ, tannimitā ca vṛddhiḥ
prāptā, na tvidānīṃ ḍanimito vikalpaḥ, pūrvameva pravṛtatvāt,
āvṛtyayogāditi ||
nañaḥ śucīśvarakṣetrajñakuśalanipuṇānām || 7|3|30 ||
aprāptaiva vidhīyata iti | aprāptimevopapādayati---na
nañpūrvāditi | utaro bhāvapratyaya iti | tvatalbhyāmutaraḥ ṣyañādiḥ,
tataścotaro bhāvapratyayaḥ prāgeva nañsamāsāt śucyādibhya eva
vidheyaḥ, paścānnañsamāsaḥ; tatra naño'ṅge'nantarbhāvādaprāptā
vṛddhirvidhīyata iti |
tadapare ityādi | asati viṣaye'ṅgādhikāra upamṛdyaḥ, asti ca
viṣayaḥ; kaḥ punarasau ? bhāvavacanādanyo'patyādiṣu vihitaḥ pratyayaḥ
| athāpi bhāvavacane śraddhā, so'pi śakyata eva
darśayitumityāha---bahuvrīheśceti |
ṭhutaro bhāvapratyayaḥ pratiṣidhyate' ityetadapyatra na
sārvatrikamityāha---akṣetrajñeti | tadevamaṅgādhikāro na bādhanīya
iti sthitam | evaṃ ca ṭhtadupasparśādaśaucam' ityādiprayogopapatiḥ
| ṭhdaśāhaṃ śāvamāśaucam' ityādau tvidamartho'ṇ draṣṭavyaḥ ||
yathātathayathāpurayoḥ paryāyeṇa || 7|3|31 ||
brāhmaṇādiṣu nañsamāsāvetau draṣṭavyāviti | tena ṭhna nañpūrvāt'
iti ṣyañaḥ pratiṣedho na bhavatīti bhāvaḥ | yathā'sādṛśya
ityavyayībhāvasamāsa iti | padārthānativṛtau | tathābhāvamanatikrāntaṃ
yathātathamusatyamucyate, yadvastu purā yathābhūtaṃ tadadyāpi
tathābhāvamanatikrāntaṃ yathāpuramucyate | kiṃ punaravyayībhāvatve
pramāṇam ? ityata āha---tathā hīti | bhāṣye tviti | na hi
hrasvatvamakṛtvā | vigrahapradarśanamavyayībhāvasyopapadyate |
ayaṃ yogaḥ śakyo'vaktum | katham ? yadā pūrvapadasya vṛddhiḥ,
nañsamāsādbhāvapratyayaḥ | yadā tūtarapadasya vṛddhistadā ṣyañantena
nañsamāsaḥ | svare'pi nāsti
viśeṣaḥ;avyayapūrvapadaprakṛtisvareṇāadyaudātatvāt | pratyayāntaraṃ
cābhyāṃ na bhavati; anabhidhānāt ||
hanasto'ciṇṇaloḥ || 7|3|32 ||
taddhiteṣviti nivṛtamiti | dhātoḥ svarūpagrahaṇe tatpratyaye
kāryavijñānāt | tatsambaddhaṃ kitītyapīti | nivṛtamityapekṣyate |
ñṇidgrahaṇaṃ tu pratyayamātreṇa sambaddham, ataḥ ṭhtaddhiteṣu'
ityasminnivṛte'pi tadanuvartata eva | udāharaṇaeṣu ṭhho
hanterñṇinneṣu' iti kutvam ||
āto yuk ciṇkṛtoḥ || 7|3|33 ||
ciṇgrahaṇamakṛdartham | dadau, dadhāviti | nanu ca ṭhāta au ṇalaḥ'
ityautvamatra bādhakaṃ bhaviṣyati, anavakāśā hi vidhayo bādhakā
bhavanti, sāvakāśaṃ cautvam, ko'vakāśaḥ ? yadā utame ṇali
ṇitvābhāvaḥ ? evaṃ tarhi ṭhaciṇāṇaloḥ' ityanuvartiṣyate, ciṇi tu
vacanādbhaviṣyati, tatrāha---cauḍirbālākiriti |
bāhvāditvādiñ | atra dākṣyādau caritārthaṃ yasyetilopaṃ bādhitvā
paratvādyauk syāt | acāmāderityanuvṛterna bhaviṣyati ? ata
āha---jñā devatā asyeti | ādivadbhāvātra prasaṅgaḥ |
kiñca---ṭhacāmādeḥ' ityanuvṛtau daridrāyaka ityatra na syāt ||
nodātopadeśasya māntasyānācameḥ || 7|3|34 ||
upadeśe udāta udātopadeśaḥ | asmādeva nipātanātsādhuḥ |
kiñcoktamiti | sannihitasya kasyacidaprasaṅgātpraśnaḥ | ata upadhāyā
iti vṛddhiriti | ciṇkṛdupajīvanārthaṃ tu na
tadanantaramidamārabdham |
nipātanādanugantavyamiti | yeṣāṃ tu ṭhapāṇinīyo
dhātupāṭhe'rthanirddeśaḥ' iti pakṣaḥ, teṣāmatra ṭhsaṃjñāpūrvako
vidhiranityaḥ' iti vṛddhyabhāvaḥ | śamī, tamīti | ṭhśamityaṣṭābhyo
ghinuṇ', atra pratyayasvare kṛte samprati dhāturanudātaḥ | yāmakaḥ,
rāmaka iti | litsvare kṛte bhavatyayaṃ sampratyudātaḥ |
ṭhanācameḥ' ityalpamidamucyate ? ityāha---anācamikamivamīnāmiti
vaktavyamiti | ṭhṭuavama udgiraṇe', ṭhkamu kāntau', ṭhcamu adane', tatra
sūtre āṅpūrvasya paryudāsaḥ, vākye tu kevalasya | vṛtau tu
vākyodāharaṇamapyāṅpūrvasyaiva darśitam, nātrāptairniraṇāyi |
kāma iti | kameḥ ṭhāyādaya ārdhadhātuke vā' iti ṇiṅbhāva pakṣe
ghañ, vṛddhiḥ | ṇici vṛddhau satyamiti | na hi tatrāyaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ;
ṇico'kṛtvāt | nanu ca satyāmapi vṛddhau
ṭhjanījṛṣknasurañjau'mantāśca' iti mitve sati ṭhmitāṃ hrasvaḥ' iti
hrasvena bhāvyam ? ata āha---tatra hīti | nānye mito'hetāvitīti |
ahetau curādiṇicyanukrāntebhyo'nye'mantādayo mito na
bhavantītyarthaḥ | anyāyyameva manyanta iti | ṭhviśrāntibhūmiḥ' iti
paṭhitavyamityarthaḥ | tena ṭhviśrāmaṃ labhatā midaṃ ca
śithilajyābandhamasmaddhanuḥ' iti vyākhyātam ||
janivadhyośca || 7|3|35 ||
vadhiḥ prakṛtyantaramiti | ṭhvadha hiṃsāyām' iti bhūvādau pāṭhāt |
bhakṣakaścediti | yo'pi māṃsaṃ krītvā bhakṣayati, tasyāpi
hiṃsānuṣaṅgo'stītyetadanena pratipādyate | yathāha manuḥ (mao smṛo
5|51)---
anumantā viśasitā nihantā krayavikrayī |
saṃskartā copahartā ca khādakaśceti ghātakāḥ || iti |
hanādeśasyeti | avadhi bhavatā dasyurityatra | jajāna garbhamiti |
vyatyayena parasmaipadam, antarbhāvitaṇyarthatvāt sakarmakatvam ||
artihrīvvīrīknuyīkṣmāyyātāṃ puṅ ṇau || 7|3|36 ||
ṭhvlīṅ varaṇe', ṭhknūyī śabde', ṭhkṣmāyī vidhūnane' | udāharaṇeṣu
pugantalakṣaṇo guṇaḥ | dvayorapi grahaṇamiti | viśeṣānupādānāt |
rī ityapīti | yadyapi prasravaṇārthaḥ sānubandhakaḥ tathāpi tasyāpi
grahaṇamācāryaiḥ smaryata iti bhāvaḥ |
pūrvāntakaraṇaṃ na yādṛcchikam, kiṃ tarhi ? vivakṣitamityāha---pukaḥ
pūrvāntakaraṇamiti | adīdapaditi | yadi punarṇeḥ puṭ syāt,
tasya ṇigrahaṇena grahaṇāṇṇau parato yadaṅgaṃ na tasyākāra upadheti
hrasvo na syāt | doṣopalakṣaṇaṃ caitat, dāpyate ityādau
ṭhṇeraniṭi' iti ṇerlopenāpahṛtatvātpakārasya śravaṇaṃ na syāt ?
naiṣa doṣaḥ; na hi lopaḥ sarvāpahārī, ṭhalo'ntyasya' ityantyasya
lopaḥ | iha tarhi knopayatītīḍāgamaḥ prāpnoti |
lābho'pi kaścinnaivātra parādau sati dṛśyate |
pugantasya guṇo vācyo vṛddhiḥ syādanyathā yataḥ ||
yatkiledamucyate---puṭi sati guṇavidhau pugantagrahaṇaṃ na
kartavyam, ṭhsārvadhātukārdhadhātukayoḥ' ityeva siddhatvāditi,
tadapyāśāvādamātram; yataḥ parādāvapyavaśyaṃ puṭi guṇo vidheyaḥ,
anyathā ṭhaco ñṇiti' iti vṛddhiprasaṅgāt ||
śācchāsāhvāvyāvepāṃ yuk || 7|3|37 ||
pāgrahaṇe ityādi | iṣṭireveyam; lākṣaṇikatvāt pārūpasya |
lugāgamastviti | yadyapi pālayatīti rūpam ṭhpāla rakṣaṇe' ityasyaiva
curādiṇijantasya punarhetumaṇṇici siddham, tathāpi pāteḥ puki
pāpayati, yuki tu pāyayati iti mā bhūditi lugvacanam |
dhūñprīñoriti | ṭhdhūñ kampane', ṭhprīñ tarpaṇe',
ñāntasyānukaraṇam; tena na daivādikasya nugbhavati |
ete'pīti | ete yugādayaḥ, vakṣyamāṇāśca jugādayaḥ | kṛtātvānāṃ
grahaṇamiti | ākārāntānāṃ yukaṃ vidhāya tadanantaramākārānteṣu
gṛhyamāṇeṣu yukaḥ prāptirākhyātā bhavatīti bhāvaḥ | evamādīti |
ādiśabdena---krāpayati, nijāpayati, vilāpayate, muṇḍo
vismāpayate, priyamācaṣṭe prāpayatītyādergrahaṇam ||
vo vidhūnane juk || 7|3|38 ||
ṭhvidhūnane' ityayameva nirdeśo liṅgam---dhūño ṇau nugbhavatīti
| vā ityetasyeti | ṭhvā gatigandhanayoḥ' ityasya | ṭhvaja vraja gatau'
ityasya ṇici rūpe vājayatīti siddhe, vāteḥ pugnivṛtyarthaṃ juko
vidhānam ||
līlornuglukāvanyatarasyāṃ snehavipātane || 7|3|39 ||
snehaḥu ghṛtādiḥ, tasya vipātanamuvigacchataḥ kāṭhinyaṃ tyajataḥ
prayojanakavyāpāraḥ | snehavipātanaṃ kāṭhinyamupagatasyāgnau
niṣṭapanādinā dravatvāpādānamityarthaḥ |
na tu kṛtātvasyeti | ekadeśavikṛtasyānanyatvāt prasaṅgaḥ |
jaṭābhirālāpayata iti | ṭhliyaḥ sammānanaśālīnīkaraṇayośca'
ityātmanepadam |
lī iti līlīṅergrahaṇamiti | kraiyādikadaivādikayoḥ |
niranubandhakapari bhāṣā tu neṣyate | kṛtātvasya ca līyateriti |
grahaṇamityapekṣyate ||
bhiyo hetubhaye ṣuk || 7|3|40 ||
hetuḥ pāribhāṣikaḥ, bhīḥubhayam, hetorbhayaṃ hetubhayam, tatra
vartamānasya | bhīṣayata iti | ṭhbhīsmyorhetubhaye' ityātmanepadam |
bhāpayata iti | ṭhbibheterhetubhaye' ityātvam ||
ruhaḥ po'nyatarasyām || 7|3|43 ||
ayaṃ yogaḥ śakyo'vaktum | katham ? ṭhrupa vimohane' iti divādau
paṭha|lte, sa ṇyanto'tra janmani vatiṣyate; anekārthatvāddhātūnām,
tasya ropayatīti | rūhestvārohayatīti |
pratyayasthātkātpūrvasyāt idāpyasupaḥ || 7|3|44 ||
atra yadi kādityatrākāro vivakṣitaḥ syāt, etikāścarantītyatretvaṃ
na syāt | etado'kaci jasi tyadādyatve ṭāpi ca rūpam | akaco

iti, na kakāramātraṃ kaścipratyayo'sti, tasmāt
kātpratyayādityucyamāne'pi pratyayāvayave pratyayaśabdo vartiṣyate
iti kiṃ sthagrahaṇenetyarthaḥ |
paṭuakā, mṛduketi | paṭuamṛduśabdābhyāṃ stryarthavṛttibhyāṃ ke kṛte

rākā, dhāketi | ṭhkṛdādhārārcikalibhyaḥ kaḥ' |

na yāsayoḥ || 7|3|45 ||
pūrveṇa nityamitve prāpte niṣedho'yamucyate, prāptipūrvakatvāt

saketi | yatadorakac, sau tyadādyatve ṭāp | yā seti

āha---yāseti nirdeśo na tantramiti | yatadorupalakṣaṇamiti |

kurmaḥ ! yakāṃyakāmadhīmaha iti | ṛcaṃ gāthāṃ ca | takāṃtakāmpacāmaha
iti | oṣadhiṃ śākinīṃ vā, dvāvetau prayogau |
upatyaketi | ṭhupādhibhyāṃ tyakannāsannārūḍhayoḥ' | atra

tadayuktam; pañcabhirupatyakābhiḥ krītaḥ pañcopatyaka ityādāvārhīyasya

nanu ca ṭhsupo dhātuprātipadikayoḥ' ityetadviṣayametat ? netyāha;
yaśca yāvāÄśca tuggrāmaḥ, sarvo'pyantaraṅgānvidhīnbādhate,
yathā---ṭhsanīsraṃsa' ityādau nalopo na bhavati | pañcakhaṭva ityādau
ṭāpā sahaikādeśo na bhavati; yadi syāt,
ādivadbhāvādāvgrahaṇena grahaṇālluki sati akāro'tra na śrūyeta |

bahuvrīheḥ kap |
jīvaketi | ṭhāśiṣi ca' iti vun |
devaketi | devadataśabdāt ṭhanukampāyāṃ kan', ṭhanajādau ca
vibhāṣā lopo vaktavyaḥ' iti dataśabdasya lopaḥ |

ṇvul---vartikā |

iti takan | pitaraśca tā devatāśca pitṛdevatāḥ, tadarthaṃ karma
pitṛdaivatyam ṭhdevatāntātādarthye yat' iti yat | aṣṭiketi |
aṣṭau parimāṇamasyāḥ, ṭhsaṃkhyāyā atiśadantāyāḥ kan' |
sūtaketi | ṭhna sāmivacane' iti pratiṣedhena jñāpitaḥ svārthe kan |
putriketi | śārṅgaravāditvānṅīni kṛte svāthikaḥ kan,
ṭhke'ṇaḥ' iti hrasva ikāraḥ, tasya pakṣe'tvaṃ vidhīyate | vṛndāriketi |
ṭhśrṛṅgavṛndābhyāmārakan vaktavyaḥ' ityārakan ||

yakau pūrvau yasyāḥ sā yakapūrvā, ko'nyapadārthaḥ ? ākāraḥ |
arthagataṃ strītvaṃ śabde samāropya strīliṅganirdeśaḥ, pūrvaśabdo
vyavasthāvacanaḥ | ibhyiketi | ibharhatīti ṭhdaṇḍādibhyo yaḥ'---ibhyā,

| sāṅkāśyiketi | saṅkāśaiḥ nirvṛtaṃ sāṅkāśyam,
ṭhsaṅkāśādibhyo ṇyaḥ', tato bhavārthe ṭhdhanvayopadhādvuñ' iti
vuñ |
sthānagrahaṇamanarthakam, ṭhṣaṣṭhī sthāneyogā' iti siddhatvāditi ? ata
āha---sthānagrahaṇamityādi | paribhāṣāyā vidhiśeṣatvādanuvāde
upasthānaṃ na syāditi bhāvaḥ | anuvādatvameva spaṣṭayati---āta
ityanena hīti | ato yo'kārastasyetvaṃ bhavatīti vacanavyaktau
nākārasya vidhisparśaḥ kaścidastītyarthaḥ |
strīpratyayasya pratipatyarthamiti | yaḥ ṭhstriyām' ityadhikṛtya
vihitaṣṭābādiḥ sa strīpratyayaḥ, tasya pratipatiryathā
syādityevamarthamityarthaḥ | asati hi strīliṅgeyaḥ kaścanākāro
gṛhyaeta |
śubhaṃ yāti, bhadraṃ yātīti | kvip | śubham, bhadramiti makārāntau
nipātitau, pūrvatkaḥ, hrasvatvaṃ ca |
pratiṣedha iti | tena vidhireva bhavati | sunayikā, suśayiketi |
nīśībhyām ṭherac', suśabdena bahuvrīhiḥ, ṭābādi pūrvavat |
supākikā, suśokiketi | paciśucibhyāṃ ghañ, ṭhcajoḥ ku
ghiṇṇyatoḥ' iti kutvam | śeṣaṃ pūrvavat ||
bhastraiṣācajājñādvāsvā nañpūrvāṇāmapi || 7|3|47 ||
ṭhsvā' iti ṣaṣṭhayāḥ sthāne prathamā | eṣeti kṛtaṣatvanirdeśastantram
| tathā ca---etikāścarantīti jasi nityamitvamudāhṛtam ||
atrātaḥ sthāna ityetat svaśabdasya viśeṣaṇaṇ |
sambhavavyabhicārau hi tatra staḥ kākacoḥ satoḥ ||
dvyetadoḥ sambhavo nāsti, nānyatra vyabhicāritā |
sarvanāmnaḥ svaśabdasya tena nāyaṃ vidhirbhavet ||
dvake iti | dvakiśabdād dvivacane tyadādyatve ṭāpi auṅḥ śībhāvaḥ |
tasyāṃ satyāmiti | samāsārthātu yā vibhaktistasyāṃ tyadādyatvaṃ na
bhavati; ṭhantaraṅgānapi vidhīnbahiraṅgo lugbādhate' iti vacanāt
| so'ntavertinyā vibhaktyā subantātpara iti | pratyayalakṣaṇena
subantatvam |
svaśabdo'pi tarhyanayaiva yuktyā nañpūrvo na prayojayedityata
āha---svaśabdastviti | svaśabdo hi ṭhsvamajñātidhanākhyāyām' iti
vacanājjñātidhanayorasarvanāmasaṃjñakaḥ, tena tasmātkapratyayenaiva
bhavitavyam, nākacā | tatra yadā nañsamāse kapratyayaḥ kriyate

| tenāsarvanāmasaṃjñakaḥ svaśabdo nañpūrvo'pi bhavatyeva prayojakaḥ |
abhastrakā, abhastriketi | ṭhalpe' iti ṭhprāgivātkaḥ' | asati tu
bhastrāgrahaṇe yathā na sidhyati tathā darśayati---atreti | bahuvrīhiḥ
puṃsyapi vartate---abhastraḥ puruṣa iti |
vihitagrahaṇenaitaddarśayati---yadyapyabhāṣitapuṃskādbhastrāśabdātparo
bhavati, tathāpi tasmādvihito na bhavati | vihitaviśeṣaṇaṃ

sā'khaṭvā, tato'khaṭvikā---ityādāvapi prasaṅgāditi |
apigrahaṇena kevalānāmeva bhastrādīnāṃ samuccayaḥ,
nānyapūrvāṇāmiti śaṅkamānaṃ
pratyāha---nañpūrvāṇāmapītyapiśabdāditi | iṣyate iti | anena
neyaṃ svataḥ prāptiriti darśayati | yadi tarhi sarvatreṣyeta,
nañpūrvāṇāmapīti na vaktavyam ṭhaṅgādhikāre tasya ca
tadutarapadasya ca' ityeva sarvatra bhaviṣyatyata āha---tatreti ||
abhāṣitapuṃskācca || 7|3|48 ||
abhāṣitapuṃskāditi
vihitaviśeṣaṇamityāha---abhāṣitapuṃskādvihitasyeti |
khaṭvāśabdaḥ striyāmeva niyata ityabhāṣitapuṃskaḥ,
bahuvrīherabhidheyaliṅgatvādabhāṣitapuṃskatvābhāvādanena vikalpena
na bhavitavyamiti manyamānaṃ pratyāha---bahuvrīhāviti | kathaṃ
bhavatītyata āha---tatrāpīti | itikaraṇo hetau |
yadā tviti | kababhāvapakṣa etat | akhaṭvā iti sthite
upasarjanahrasvatvam, ṭāp, punaḥ ṭhke'ṇaḥ' iti hrasvaḥ | sa ca
samāsādbhāṣitapuṃsakādutpannasya ṭāpa iti na bhavatyayaṃ vikalpaḥ |
ṭhabhāṣitapuṃskātparasyātaḥ' iti vijñāyamāne syādevātra vikalpaḥ |
atikhaṭviketi | atrāpi samāsādbhāṣitapuṃskāṭṭābutpannaḥ ||
ādācāryāṇām || 7|3|49 ||
itvāpavādo'yaṃ yogaḥ | ṭhke'ṇaḥ' iti hrasvāpavādaśca |

| apara āha---ācāryasya pāṇinerya ācāryaḥ sa ihācāryaḥ, gurutvātu
