ṭhasyekaḥ || 7|3|50 ||
atra dvau pakṣau---ṭheti vyañjanamātraṃ sthānitvena nirddiśyate,
akārastūccāraṇārthaḥ, evaṃ ḍhagādiṣvapītyekaḥ pakṣaḥ; saṅghātaḥ
pratyayaḥ, sthānyapyatra sa eveti dvitīyaḥ | tatrādye pakṣe paṭhitā,
paṭhitumityādau dhātvantasyāpi prasaṅgaḥ; dvitīye tu aṭhaci karmaṭha
ityatrāpi prāpnoti | tatra dvayorapi pakṣayoryathā doṣo na bhavati
tathā darśayannāha---aṅgasya nimitaṃ yaṣṭha iti | sambandhastatra
nāvayavāvayavibhāvalakṣaṇaḥ, paṭhitetyādāvapi prasaṅgāt; kiṃ tarhi ?
nimitanimitibhāvalakṣaṇaḥ | aṅgasya sambandhītyukte tadrūpasambandhyeva
pratīyate; pratyayaśca tadrūpasambandhī, tadāyatatvādaṅgavyapadeśasya |
tadevamaṅgavyapadeśanimitasya pratyayasya grahaṇādubhayorapi
pakṣayordoṣābhāvaḥ | kiñca---saṅghātapakṣe arthavataṣṭhaśabdasya grahaṇānna
bhavati karmaṭhaḥ---ityatra prasaṅgaḥ | varṇagrahaṇe tvarthavatparibhāṣā na
pravartate | tatra saṅgātapakṣe doṣāntaramāśaṅkya
pariharati--tatreti | punarapi tasminneva pakṣe codayati---mathitaṃ
paṇyamasyeti | varṇagrahaṇame tu ṭhanalvidhau' iti
sthānivatvaniṣedhādikasya kādeśāprasaṅgaḥ | kādeśaḥ | prāpnotīti
| nanu tāntādaṅgādityucyate, na cātra tāntamaṅgam, tataḥ
pratyayasyāvidhānāt ? naitadasti; ekadeśavikṛtasyānanyatvādaṅgaṃ
bhavati, tāntaṃ ca; tataśca yathā---anukampito bhānudata iti ṭhaci
dvitīyādaca ūrdhvasya lope kādeśo bhavati---bhānuka iti, tathātrāpi
prasaṅgaḥ ? pariharati---sannipāteti | ajādisannipātena
tāntatvamupajāyate, tataśca tadvighātasya nimitaṃ nopapadyate |
parihārāntaramāha---yasyetilopasyeti | sthānivadbhāvastu ṭhacaḥ
parisminpūrvavidhau' ityanena | nanu pūrvasya vidhāvityucyate,
parasyāyam ? tatrāha---pūrvasmādapihīti | pañcamīsamāso'pi
tatrāśrīyata ityarthaḥ | anye tvāhuḥ---varṇagrahaṇādeva tadantavidhau
siddhe, antagrahaṇaṃ pratyayopadeśakāle tāntapratipatyarthamiti ||
isusuktāntātkaḥ || 7|3|51 ||
sārpiṣka iti | ṭhtadasya paṇyam' iti ṭhak, ṭhiṇaḥ ṣaḥ' iti
visarjanīyasya ṣatvam | dhānuṣka iti | praharaṇamiti ṭhak | yājuṣka
iti | dīvyatyarthe ṭhak | naiṣādakarṣukaḥ, śābarajambuka iti |
bhavādāvarthe ṭhordeaśe ṭhañ', kādeśe kṛte ṭhke'ṇaḥ' iti hrasvatvam |
mātṛkam, paitṛkamiti | tata āgataḥ, ṭhṛtaṣṭhañ' | audaśvitka iti |
ṭhsaṃskṛta bhakṣāḥ', ṭhdadhnaṣṭhak', ṭhudaśvito'nyatarasyām' iti
saptamyantāṭṭhak | śākṛtkaḥ, yākṛtkaḥ, yākṛtka iti | ṭhsaṃsṛṣṭe'
iti ṭhañ | āśiṣeti | ṭhāṅḥ śāsu icchāyām'
ityasmādāśāsanamāśīriti sampadāditvād bhāve kvip, ṭhāśāsaḥ
kvāvupasaṃkhyānam' itītvam | uṣeti | vaseḥ kpip,
yajāditvātsamprasāraṇe lākṣaṇikaṃ rūpamiti | sarpirādau tu
ṭharciśucihūsṛpicchādibhya isiḥ', ṭhjanerusiḥ',
ṭhartivapiyajitrāpidhanibhyo nit' iti pratipadoktamisuso rūpam |
doṣa upasaṃkhyānamiti | varṇaikadeśānāṃ varṇagrahaṇenāgrahaṇādokāre
ya ukāraḥ, tasya ukāragrahaṇenāgrahaṇādupasaṃkhyānam ||
cajoḥ ku ghiṇṇyatoḥ || 7|3|52 ||
pāka ityādau bhāve ghañ | pākyamityādau karmaṇi ṭhṛhalorṇyat' |
yathāsaṃkhyamatra na bhavati---ghiti cakārasya, ṇyati jakārasyeti;
ṭhbhujanyubjau pāṇyupatāpayoḥ', ṭhprayājānuyājau yajñāṅge',
ṭhvaco'śabdasaṃjñāyām' ityāderliṅgāt |
kvacitu paṭha|lte---yathāsaṃkhyamatra neṣyate, tena raktaṃ rāgāditi
liṅgāditi ||
nyaṅkvādīnāṃ ca || 7|3|53 ||
nyaṅku ityevamādīnāṃ ceti | ṭhsiddhaye' iti śeṣaḥ,
kṛtakutvānāmeva gaṇe pāṭhāt | kimarthaṃ tarhi sūtram, yāvatā
yathaiva kutvādanyadapi ghatvaguṇadīrghatvādikaṃ nipātanādbhavati,
tathā kutvamapi bhaviṣyati ? satyam; asati tasmin, anuvāde gaṇasya
kvacidapyanupayogātpramādapāṭhaḥ śaṅkyeta | pacādyacīti | ghañi
kutvasyāsiddhatvāt |
saṃjñāyāṃ megha ityādi | meghaḥuparoyagharaḥ, nidāghaḥugharmaḥ,
avadāgho'pi sa eva | arghaḥuvikrīyamāṇasya dhānyāderiyatā,
mūlyamityanye | vīruditi | nipātanādupasargasya dīrghatvam ||
ho hanterñṇinneṣu || 7|3|54 ||
ñaśca ṇaśca ñṇau, tāvitau yayostau ñṇitau, tau ca naśca
ñṇinnāḥ, teṣu ñṇinneṣu | nakāre'kāra uccāraṇārthaḥ, tena
vṛtraghni, vṛtraghnorityādāvapi bhavati | ghnantītyādau ṭhgamahana'
ityupadhālopaḥ |
kimidaṃ ñṇinnagrahaṇaṃ hantiviśeṣaṇam---ñṇinnaparasya hanteryo
hakāra iti ? āhosviddhakāraviśeṣaṇam---ñṇinnaparasya hakārasya sa
ceddhanteriti ? tatrādye pakṣe hyatrāsiddhiḥ---ghnanti, ghnantu; na hi
svāvayava eva svasmātparo bhavati | dvitīye tu na kvacit syāt, na
hi ñṇinnakāraparatā hakārasya kvāpi sambhavati---ghātayatītyādau
tāvadakāreṇa takāreṇa ca vyavadhānam, ghnantītyādāvupadhā lopasya
sthānivadbhāvād vyavadhānameva | atha vacanādvyavadhāne'pi
bhaviṣyati ? ihāpi tarhi prāpnoti---hatamicchati hatīyati,
hatīyaterṇvul, hatāyaka iti, nakāre'pi hantā,
hananamityādāvapi prasaṅgaḥ | nakāragrahaṇamidānīṃ kimarthaṃ syāt ?
yatra nakāraḥ śrūyate tatra yathā syāt, iha mā bhūt---hataḥ, hatha iti
tadevaṃ dvayorapi pakṣayordoṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā pakṣāntaraṃ
darśayati---ñṇitpratyaya ityādi | yadyapi
dvandvanirddiṣṭānāmekayogakṣematā nyāyyā, tathāpi
sambhavavyabhicārau hi viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvasyāṅgamityayameva prakāra
āśrīyate | nanu ca ṭhsthānivadbhāvādānantaryaṃ nakārasya na sambhavati'
ityuktam ? ata āha---tacceti | sannipātakṛtamiti |
śrutikṛtamityarthaḥ |
atha vā---punarastu dvitīyaḥ pakṣaḥ, tatrāpi doṣaḥ supratividhānaḥ ?
ityāhayadāpīti | dhātvavayavena nakāreṇa vyavadhānamavyabhicārīti
tadevāśrīyate, na śabdāntareṇeti ñṇityayaṃ parihāraḥ | nakāre
tūkta eva ||
abhyāsācca || 7|3|55 ||
ahaṃ jaghaneti | ṇitvābhāve udāharaṇam | ṇitvapakṣe pūrveṇaiva
siddham | evaṃ jaghanitha, jaghantha, jaghanvānityudāharaṇam | 
abhyāsanimite pratyaya ityādi | aṅgādhikāreṇābhyāsena ca
pratyayasyākṣepādayamartho labhyate | jihananīyiṣatīti | atra
yasminhaniraṅgaṃ lyuṭi na tasyābhyāsanimitatvam, yaścābhyāsasya
nimitaṃ san na tasmin hantiraṅgam ||
haracaiṅ || 7|3|56 ||
prājīhayaditi | ṇyantālluṅ, caṅ, ṇilopaḥ, upadhāhrasvatvam,
ṭhcaṅ' īti dvirvacanam, ṭhkuhoścuḥ' iti kutvam, ṭhdīrgho laghoḥ'
iti dīrghaḥ | 
ṭhacaṅ' ityetitpratyācaṣṭe---acaṅīti śakyamakartumiti | katham ?
ityata āha---caṅyabhyāseti | yathā pūrvasūtre jihananīyiṣatītyatra na
bhavati, evaṃ prājīhayadityatrāpi na bhaviṣyati, kimacaṅītyanenetyarthaḥ
| tatkriyata ityādiparihāraḥ | kimetasya jñāpane prayojanam ? ityata
āha---teneti ||
sanliṭorjeḥ || 7|3|57 ||
ṭhjyā vayohānau'---ityasya kiti grahijyādisūtreṇa samprasāraṇe kṛte
pūrvatve ca jirūpasya bhāvād ṭhhalaḥ' iti dīrghatvaṃ bādhitvā kutvaṃ
prāpnoti, kṛte'pi vā dīrghatve
ekadeśavikṛtasyānanyatvātkutvaprasaṅgaḥ, yathā---jigīṣatītyatra,
ityata āha---jināterityādi | ṭheranekācaḥ' iti yaṇa deśaḥ ||
na kvādeḥ || 7|3|59 ||
kūja ityādi | ṭhkūja avyakte śabde', ṭhkharja vyathane', ṭhgarjaśabde' | atra
bārtikam---ṭhkvādyajivrajiyācirucīnāmapratiṣedho niṣṭhāyāmaniṭaḥ
kutvavacanāt' iti | asyārthaḥ---ṭhcajoḥ ku
ghiṇṇyatorniṣṭhāyāmaniḍ' iti sūtraṃ kartavyam, tenaiva
kvādyajādīnāṃ kutvanivṛteḥ siddhatvānnārthaḥ pratiṣedhavacaneneti |
nanvevaṃ prucuglucukujukhujūnāṃ niṣṭhāyāmamiṭatvātkutvaṃ
prāpnoti, tathā ajisajitarjīnāṃ niṣṭhāyāṃ seṭtvāt
kutvāprasaṅgaḥ, yathā tu sūtraṃ tathā viparyayaḥ ? ucyate; ṭhyathotaraṃ
munīnāṃ prāmāṇyam' iti vātikānusāreṇa kutvasya bhāvābhāvau
vyavasthāpyau | nanvasatyajeḥ pratiṣedhe nivīta iti
niṣṭhāyāmaniṭtvāt samāja iti kutvaprasaṅgaḥ ? netadasti;
vyādeśo niṣṭhāyāmaniṭ, na tvajiḥ, sa tu valādyārdhadhātuke
vikalpeneṣyate iti vībhāvābhāvapakṣe ajita iti seḍeva |
kathaṃ śokaḥ, samudga iti, yāvatā śucyuvjī niṣṭhāyāṃ seṭau ?
evaṃ tarhi ṭhśucyubjyorghañi' iti vakṣyāmi, tacca yathānyāse'pi
vaktavyam--ghañyeva yathā syād ṇyati mā
bhūditi---aśocyānanvaśocyastvamiti | tadeva vārtikakārapakṣe
vidhyartha bhaviṣyati ||
ajivrajyośca || 7|3|60 ||
samājaḥ, udāja iti | paśubhyo'nyatra ṭhhalaśca' iti ghañ, paśuṣu tu
ṭhsamudorajaḥ paśuṣu' ityabbhavati ||
bhujanyubjau pāṇyupatāpayoḥ || 7|3|61 ||
pāṇiśabdena tadvānbāhurlakṣyate, na tu maṇibandhasyādhaḥ
pañcaśākhāpradeśa ucyate | loke'pi bāhuparyāyo bhujaśabdaḥ |
bhujyate iti | ṭhbhuja pālanābhyavahārayoḥ' | nyubjitā iti |
adhomukhāḥ, niśceṣṭāḥ | vastu kathanaṃ caitat, vigrahastu
nyubjantyasminniti darśayitavyaḥ |
nyubjopatāpagrahaṇaṃ śakyamakartum | katham ? yasminvyādhau
nyubjitāḥ śerate sa tān nyubjayati, tatra ṇyantātpacādyaci nyubja
iti siddham; na cātra ghañacoḥ svare viśeṣaḥ, thāthādisūtreṇa
ghañyapyantodātatvavidhānāt | bhujaśabdastu ghañyādyaudāto bhavati,
igupadhalakṣaṇe tu ke'ntodātaḥ |
prayājānuyājau yajñāṅge || 7|3|62 ||
pañcānuyājā iti | darśapūrṇamāsayostrayo'nuyājāḥ,
cāturmāsyeṣu nava, paśuṣvekādaśa, pañcatvaṃ na kvāpi dṛṣṭam,
tasmāt trayo'nuyājā iti pāṭhaḥ |
pradarśanārthamiti | etacca yajñagrahaṇāllabhyate, upātayorhi
yajñāṅgaviṣayatvaṃ nipātanādeva siddham, upāṃśuyāgasya
ṛtuyājānāṃ ca yajñasamudāyaṃ pratyavayavatvād yajñāṅgatvam |
pradhānayāgā hyaete; itareṣāṃ tu phalavatsannidhāvaphalaṃ
tadaṅgamityaṅgatvam ||
vañcergatau || 7|3|63 ||
vañcyaṃ vañcantīti | gantavyaṃ gacchantītyarthaḥ | vaṅkamiti |
guṇaśabdo'yambhāve ghañ, abhedopacārād guṇini vṛttiḥ ||
oka ucaḥ ke || 7|3|64 ||
ṭhuca samavāye' | nyokaḥ śakunta iti | nyucati samavaiti
nīḍādāviti kṛtvā | nyoko gṛhamiti | nyucanti samavayanti
vasanti tasmin iti kṛtvā |
asuni pratyaya iti | ayameva loke sādhīyaḥ prayujyate ||
ṇya āvaśyake || 7|3|65 ||
udāharaṇeṣu ṭhāvaśyakādhamarṇyayorṇiniḥ', ṭhkṛtyāśca' iti ṇyat,
mayūravyaṃsakāditvāt samāsaḥ, ṭhlumpedavaśyamaḥ kṛtye' iti malopaḥ
||
yajayācarucapravacarcacaśca || 7|3|66 ||
arkṣyamiti | ṭhṛca stutau' | pravācyo nāmeti | prakarṣeṇocyata iti
pravācyaḥupāṭhaviśeṣopalakṣito granthaviśeṣaḥ | apare punariti | te
manyante---prapūrvo vaciraśabdasaṃjñāyāmeva vartate, tatra
vidheyāsambhavānniyama iti |
etacceti | avivākyamityetāvacchabdarūpam | kaḥ punarasau viśeṣaḥ ?
ityata āha---daśarātrasyeti | dvādaśāhe'bhito dvirātro madhye
daśarātraḥ, tasya daśamamahaḥuavivākyam | anyatreti | tathā ca
nāsminnahani kenacit kasyacidvivācyam, avivākyamityetadācakṣate
| saṃśaye bahirvedisvādhyāyaprayogo'ntarvedītyeke ityaharviśeṣe
kutvam, anyatra tadabhāvaḥ prayukta āśvalāyanena |
evamanyopasargapūrvasyāpi pratiṣedha eveṣyate, na niyamaḥ |
evañca kṛtvā pravacigrahaṇaṃ śakyamakartum; aharviśeṣa
pṛṣodarāditvātkutvam, anyatra pratiṣedha iti siddhamiṣṭam; anyathā
niyame hi bahu pratividheyaṃ syāt ||
prayojyaniyojyau śakyārthe || 7|3|68 ||
iha ṭhprayujaniyujaḥ śakyārthe' iti vaktavyam, ṭhṇye' ityeva, evaṃ siddhe
nipātanāśrayaṇaṃ rūḍha|lrtham---guṇabhūt evaitayoḥ prayogo yathā
syāt---prayonyo bhṛtyaḥ, niyojyo dāsa iti | svāmini
prayojyaniyojyaśabdau na bhavataḥ ||
bhojyaṃ bhakṣye || 7|3|69 ||
bhojyā yāvagūriti | nanu bhakṣirayaṃ kharaviśade'bhyavahārye vartata
iti ṭhsaṃskṛtaṃ bhakṣāḥ' ityatroktam, tatkathaṃ dravadravye bhavati ? ityata
āha---iheti | evaṃ manyate---nātra bhakṣiḥ kharaviśada eva vartate;
abbhakṣaḥ, vāyubhakṣa ityatrāpi darśanāditi
śabdāntarasannidhibalādetadevaṃ bhavati | ṭhsvabhāvatastu bhakṣiḥ
kharaviśada eva vartate' iti vārtikakārasya pakṣaḥ,
yadāha---ṭhbhojyamabhyavahārya iti vaktavyam' iti ||
ghorlopo leṭi vā || 7|3|70 ||
dadhaditi | dadhāterleṭ, tip ṭhitaśca lopaḥ parasmaipadeṣu'
itīkāralopaḥ | dāśuṣe yajamānāya satnāni, dadyādityarthaḥ | anye
tvāhuḥ---dadhaditi śatrantametat, dadaditi dāño rūpam |
vāvacanaṃ pratyācikhyāsurāha---āḍāgame satīti | astvatra lopaḥ; āṭaḥ
śravaṇaṃ bhaviṣyatītyarthaḥ |
kimartha tarhi vāvacanam ? ityata āha--tatreti | kimatra vispaṣṭanīyam
? ata āha---eṣā hīti | anye tvāhuḥ--jñāpakārthaṃ vāgrahaṇam,
etajjñāpayati---anityamāgamaśāsanamiti | anityatve tvāṭa|lsati
dadāditi na syāditi tatsiddhaye vāgrahaṇaṃ kartavyamiti ||
otaḥ śyani || 7|3|71 ||
śyatītyādi| ṭhśo tanūkaraṇe', ṭhchāe chedane', ṭhdo avakhaṇḍane', ṭhṣo
antakarmaṇi' |
ihi ṭhotaḥ śiti' iti vaktavyam, na ca okārāntānāṃ śyano'nyaḥ
śit sambhavati, ardhamātrayā ca lāghavaṃ bhavati;
tatrāyamapyarthaḥ---ṭhṣṭhivulkamucamāṃ śiti' iti śidgrahaṇaṃ na
kartavyaṃ bhavati, idamevānuvartiṣyate | nanu śyangrahaṇamutarārthaṃ
kartavyam---ṭhśamāmaṣṭānām' iti ? tatrāpyastu śitītyeva; yadi
śitītyucyate, bhrame ṭhvā bhrāśa' iti pakṣe śab bhramati---atrāpi
prāpnoti ? śamādibhiḥ śitaṃ viśeṣayiṣyāmaḥ---śamādibhyo yo
vihitaḥ śiditi, śyanneva ca sarvebhyaḥ śamādibhyo vihitaḥ, evamapi
śidviśeṣaṇatvena śamādīnāmupayogātkāryanirddeśābhāvāt
naśyatītyādāvapi prasaṅgaḥ ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; ṭhaṣṭānām' ityanena
saṃkhyeyāḥ kāryiṇo nirdiśyante, te ca sannidhānāt śamādaya eva
vijñāsyante ||
ksasyāci || 7|3|72 ||
adhukṣātāmiti | duheḥ svaritetvenātmanepadam, ātām, atrāsati
lope ṭhāto ṅtiḥ' iti iyādeśaḥ prāpnoti | adhukṣīti | iṭi lopaḥ
| 
kakāravataḥ saśabdasya grahaṇādiha na bhavati---vatsau; ṭhtṛṇādibhyaḥ saḥ',
tṛṇasau, tṛṇasaḥ ||
lugvā duhadihalihaguhāmātmanepade dantye || 7|3|73 ||
eteṣāmaṅgānāṃ ksasyeti | eteṣāṃ sambandhī yo nimitatvena ksaḥ,
tasyetyarthaḥ |
sarvādeśārthamiti | luksarvāpahārīti saṃjñāvidhāvuktam |
vahyarthamiti | utamapuruṣadvivacanārthamityarthaḥ | athānyārthaṃ kasmānna
bhavati ? tatrāha---anyatreti | alo'ntyasyeti | ṭhādeḥ parasya'
ityetatu na bhavati; pañcamīnirddeśābhāvāt | jhalo jhalīti
lopeneti | ṭhdhi sakāre sico lopaḥ' iti nāśrīyate |
clyādeśopalakṣaṇaṃ vā tatra sijgrahamamiti bhāvaḥ | akārasyeti |
akāralopasyetyarthaḥ | tathaiva vā pāṭhaḥ |
nanu ca kriyamāṇe'pi luggrahaṇe vahau lukā na bhavitavyameva,
adantatvāt, dantyauṣṭha|le hyasau ? ata āha---dantyoṣṭha|le'pītyādi
| dantānvayo'tra vivakṣitaḥ, netaravyāvṛttiriti bhāvaḥ | evaṃ
nyāyasiddhe'pyarthe vacanasāmarthyamapi darśayati---yadi ceti | tāviti
| tavargādāvityarthaḥ | vaheranyāni hi dantyādīni
sarvāṇyātmanepadāni tavargādīni ||
śamāmaṣṭānāṃ dīrghaḥ śyani || 7|3|74 ||
śamustamuḥ śramudam bhramukṣamumadalkamaḥ |
śamādayo'mī paṭhitā divādiṣvaṣṭa kṛṣṭibhiḥ ||
ṣṭhivaklamyācamāṃ śiti || 7|3|75 ||
klāmatīti | ṭhvā bhrāśa' ityādinā śap |
klamigrahaṇaṃ śabarthamiti | śyani pūrveṇaiva siddhatvāt | śamādiṣu
pāṭhaścintyaprayojanaḥ; śyanyapyanenaiva siddhatvāt |
tatra saptagrahaṇamevāstu, camerāṅpūrvasya grahaṇaṃ tantram, na
tūpeyivānityādivadavivakṣitam ? ityāha---camerāṅiti |
ṭhdīrghatvamāṅ cimaḥ' iti vārtikasyāpyayamevārthaḥ ||
kramaḥ parasmaipadeṣu || 7|3|76 ||
ihetyādi | codyam | herluki kṛta iti | ṭhato heḥ' ityanena | naiṣa
doṣa ityādi parihāraḥ | ṭhna lumatāṅgasya' ityatra hi
pratyasāterayamartho vyavasthāpitaḥ,---lumatā lupte pratyaye yadaṅgaṃ
tannibandhanaṃ kāryaṃ na bhavatīti | tataḥ kim ? ityatrāha---na ceti ||
iṣugamiyamāṃ cchaḥ || 7|3|77 ||
icchatīti | tudāditvācchaḥ | iṣyatīti | ṭhiṣa gatau'| iṣṇātīti | ṭhiṣa
ābhīkṣṇye'| ye punaruditamiṣi nādhīyata iti | dhātupāṭhe | iha ca
sūtre acītyanuvartayantīti | ṭhksasyāci' ityataḥ |
nanvacītyanuvṛtāvapi ṭhhalaḥ śnaḥ śānajjhau' iti śānajādeśe
iṣāṇetyatra cchatvaṃ syādeva, ajāditvāt ? ityata āha---tatreti |
syādetadevaṃ yadyacītyena śidviśepyeta---śiticchāe bhavati,
kiṃviśiṣṭe ? aci---ajādāviti; iha tu śitā ajviśeṣyate---aci chāe
bhavati, kiṃ viśiṣṭe ? śitīti, tena tadādividhirna bhavati | ki
kāraṇam ? ityata āhayasminvidhiriti | na kevalaṃ tadantavidhau
viśeṣaṇatvāpekṣā, api tarhi tadādividhāvapītyapiśabdasyārthaḥ |
iṣāṇetyatrāpīti | na kevalamiṣyatītyatraiva---ityapiśabdasyārthaḥ | na
hyayamajeveti | ajmātrasyātra śitvaṃ nāstītyarthaḥ | itikaraṇo hetau ||
prāghradhmāsthāmnādāṇdṛśyartisartiśadasadāṃ
pibajighraghamatiṣṭhamanayacchapaśyarcchadhauśīyasīdāḥ || 7|3|78 ||
ṭhpā pāne' | ṭhpā rakṣaṇe' ityasya tu grahaṇaṃ na bhavati;
lugvikaraṇatvāt śitaścāsambhavāt | ṭhghrā gandhopādāne', ṭhdhmā
śabdāgnisaṃyogayoḥ', ṭhṣṭhā gatinivṛtau', ṭhmnā abhyāse', ṭhdāṇ
dāne', ṭhdṛśira prekṣaṇe', ṭhṛgatiprāpaṇayoḥ', ṭhsṛgatau', bhauvādikau
| ṭhṛ sṛ gatau' iti jauhotyādikayostu grahaṇaṃ na bhavati;
śito'sambhavāt | nanveśaḥ sambhava iti cet ? uktamatra---ṭhvarṇe
yatsyātacca vidyātadādau' iti | śitīti hi
karmadhārayaḥ---śaścāsāvicceti | ṭhśadlṛ śātane' bhūvādiḥ,
ṭhśadlṛ viśaraṇe' tudādiḥ, ṭhṣadlṛviśaraṇagatyavasādaneṣu' |
ādyaudāto nipātyata iti | yadi na nipātyeta, tataḥ ṭhdhātoḥ'
ityantodātatve sati śapā sahaikādeśe kṛte ṭhekādeśa
udātenodātaḥ' iti pibatīti padaṃ madhyodātamāpadyeta, ādyaudātaṃ
ceṣyate |
vegitāyāmiti | sañjātavegayāyāmityarthaḥ | yadvā---vegino bhāvo
vegitā, tasyāṃ ca satyāṃ gatau vartamānasyetyarthaḥ ||
jñājanorjā || 7|3|79 ||
daivādikasya grahaṇamiti | na jauhotyādikasya, śito'sambhavāt |
dīrghoccaraṇasya prayojanamutarasūtre vakṣyate ||
pvādīnāṃ hrasvaḥ || 7|3|80 ||
pvādayaḥ rkyādau paṭha|lnta iti | ye tu bhūvādau paṭha|lnte---ṭhpūñ
pavane' ityādayaḥ, teṣāṃ grahaṇaṃ na bhavati, katipaye hi tatra
hrasvabhāvinaḥ, teṣāmapi śapi guṇena bhavitavyam |
kiñca---kraiyādikasya jānāterhrasvanivṛtyarthaṃ pūrvasūtre
dīrghoccāraṇam, tadapi kraiyādikānāṃ grahaṇe pramāṇam |
vṛtkaraṇamityādi | na hyubhayārthatve vṛtkaraṇasya kaścidbhāra iti
bhāvaḥ | apare tviti | lvādīnāmanantaratvāditi bhāvaḥ | tathā ṭhda
pūraṇe', ṭhda bhaye'---ityetayorapi vṛtkaraṇāt
parastātpaṭhitayorapi hrasvo bhavati---yaḥ pṛṇāti sa ha deveṣu
gacchati, pṛṇīyādinnādhamānāya, pṛṇantaṃ ca papuriṃ śrasyava,
ādṛṇātīti | pūrvasminpakṣe hrasvāntāvetau paṭhanti |
codayati---yeṣāmiti | āgatā gaṇāntamāgaṇāntāḥ,
pariharati--jñājanīrjā iti | yadi jānātītyatra hrasvatvaṃ syāt,
hrasvāntamevādeśaṃ vidadhyāt | nanu cānyārthaṃ dīrghāntādeśavidhānaṃ
syāt, na hyanyathā---jāyate iti siddhyati ? ata āha--ja ityapīti |
hrasvāntādeśavidhāne'pi ṭhato dīrgho yañi' iti dīrghatve---jāyate
iti siddham, tatra hi ṭhturustuśamyamaḥ sārvadhātuke' ityataḥ
sārvadhātukagrahaṇamanuvartate, na punaḥ ṭhtaṅ' īti | ata eva ṭhāne
muk' pūrvāntaḥ kṛto na parādiḥ; dīrghaprasaṅgāt | ye tarhi
vṛtkaraṇamubhayavyāvṛtyarthaṃ varṇayanti, teṣāṃ dīrghoccāraṇaṃ
kimartham ? jānātītyatra dīrgho yathā syāt | ṭhato dīrgho yañi'
ityeva dīrgho bhaviṣyati | na sidhyati; ṭhaṅgavṛte
punarvṛtāvavidhirniṣṭhitasya' na jādeśamātreṇa niṣṭhitamaṅgaṃ bhavati
| tatredaṃ dīrghoccāraṇameva liṅgam--āgaṇāntāḥ ṣvādaya iti ||
miderguṇaḥ || 7|3|82 ||
medyatīti | śyan | midyata iti | bhāve yak ||
jusi ca || 7|3|83 ||
udāharaṇeṣu laṅ śipaḥ śluḥ, dvirvacanam, abhyāsakāryam,
ṭhsijabhyastavidhibhyaśca' iti jherjus |
athetyādi | jusbhaktasya yāsuṭastadgrahaṇena grahaṇātprasaṅgaḥ |
sārvadhātukāśrayaṅtvinimita iti | sārvadhātukamāśrayo yasya
tatsārvadhātukāśraṃya tan ṅtviṃ nimitaṃ yasya pratiṣedhasya sa
tathoktaḥ | etena yāsuḍāśrayaṅtvinimitamiti vyākhyātam | tatra hi
prāpte cāprāpte ceti | cinuyurityādau prāpte,
ajuhavurityādāvaprāpte | ksasyācītyanuvartate iti |
parihārāntaram, jakāroccāraṇaṃ tu cakruḥ---ityādau liṭi mā
bhūt ||
sārvadhātukārdhadhātukayoḥ || 7|3|84 ||
sārvadhātukārdhadhātukayoriti kimiti | evaṃ manyatepratyaya iti
vaktavyam, evamapi hīṣṭe viṣaye siddhyatīti | saṅiti pratyāhāraḥ;
sanaḥ saśabdādāharabhyā mahiṅe ṅkārāt | agnitvamiti | pratyaya
ityucyamāne, atrāpi prāpnoti | agnikāmyatīti | saṅītyucyamāne
atrāpi prāpnoti ||
jāgro'viciṇṇaliṅtsu || 7|3|85 ||
aviciṇṇalṅtsu pirata iti | viciṇṇaliṅdbhyo'nye ye
pratyayāsteṣu parata ityarthaḥ | jāgārayatītyādīni vṛddhiviṣaye
udāharaṇāni | jāgaritaḥ, jāgaritavāniti pratiṣedhaviṣaye |
kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ vṛddhipratiṣedhaviṣayāṇyevodāharaṇāni upanyastāni
? tatrāha---vṛddhiviṣaye, pratiṣedhaviṣaye ceti | anyatra pūrveṇaiva
guṇasya siddhatvādetadviṣaya evāyaṃ guṇaḥ, tatrāpyubhayaviṣayaḥ, katham ?
ciṇṇaloḥ pratiṣedhāt vṛddhiviṣaye tāvadbhavati, ṅtpritiṣedhāt
pratiṣedhaviṣaye'pīti | tasminkṛta iti | ṭhaṅgavṛte punarvṛtau'
ityetadanāśrityocyate | sā na bhavatīti | kiṃ kāraṇam ?
ityāha---yadi hīti | yadyapi jāgaritaḥ, jagaritavānityatra
guṇavidhiścaritārthaḥ, tathāpi vṛddhiviṣaye'pyetadvidhānamityuktam,
tatrāsyānarthakyamucyate | kiñcetyāha---ciṇṇalośceti | yadi guṇe
kṛte ṭhata upadhāyā' iti vṛddhiḥ syācciṇṇalorguṇapratiṣedho'narthakaḥ
syāt | astu tatrāpi guṇaḥ; vṛddhau satyāmajāgāri, jajāgāreti
siddham |
jāgṛta iti | laṭ, tas, adāditvācchapo luk,
ṭhsārvadhātukamapit' iti ṅtvim |
atra vīti keciditi | ṭhaviciṇṇalṅtsu' ityitra yo vakārātpara
ikārastamuccāraṇārthaṃ varṇayanti, tatra ṭhyasminvidhiḥ' iti vakārādau
pratiṣedhaḥ | kimarthaṃ punasta evaṃ varṇayanti ? ityata āha---kvasāvapīti
| jajāgṛvāniti | ṭhneḍvaśi kṛti' iti iṭpratiṣedhaḥ | tatra
krādiniyamādiṭ prāptaḥ ṭhvasvekājādghasām' iti niyamānna bhavati
| ye tu kvipo lopādvarṇāśraye pratyayalakṣaṇapratiṣedhācca paryudāsaṃ
necchanti, teṣāṃ jāgariti guṇo bhavatyeva | anye tvāhuḥ---yathā
atṛṇeḍiti pratyayalakṣaṇenebhāgamī bhavati, varṇasya
pratyayaviśeṣaṇatvāt; evaṃ kvipo'pi paryudāsaḥ, tatastu jāgṛditi
bhavati |
codayati---kathamajāgaruriti | evaṃ manyate--prasajyapratiṣedho'yaṃ
viciṇṇalṅtsu ni bhavatīti, tataśca ṭhjusi ca' ityasyāpi guṇasya
pratiṣedhaḥ syāt, tathotame ṇali ṇitvābhāvapakṣe guṇa
iṣyate--ṭhsārvadhātukārdhadhātukayoḥ' iti, tasyāpi pratiṣedhaḥ
prāpnotīti | pariharati---nāpratiṣedhāditi | nāyaṃ doṣaḥ, kutaḥ ?
apratiṣedhāt | nāyaṃ prasajyapratiṣedhaḥ, kastarhyayam ?
ityāha---aviciṇṇalṅtsviti piryadāso'yamiti | paryudāse hi
viciṇṇalṅtsu ni vidhirna pratiṣedhaḥ, tato'nyatra vidhānam, tena
jusi ṇali ca lakṣaṇāntareṇa prāpto guṇo bhavatyeva |
prasajyapratiṣedhe'pyāha---atha veti | ṭhanantarasya vidhirvā bhavati
pratiṣedho vā' iti bhāvaḥ | keciddarvirityatra guṇadarśanādauṇādikaṃ
vicpratyayayaṃ varṇayanti, teṣāṃ jāgṛvirityatra guṇaḥ prāpnoti | na
ca veḥ pratiṣedhavaiyarthyam; kvipi kvasau ca caritārthatvāt |
tasmājjāgarteḥ kidvaktavyaḥ ||
pugantalaghūpaghasya ca || 7|3|86 ||
bhetā, cheteti | kathaṃ punaratra guṇaḥ, yāvatā
dhātvantapratyayādyorhalorānantarye ṭhsaṃyoge guru' iti gurusaṃjñayā
laghusaṃjñāyā bādhanānna prāpnoti, bhedanamityādau sāvakāśo guṇaḥ ?
ata āha---pratyayāderiti | knusanoḥ kitkaraṇeneti |
ṭhtrasigṛdhidhṛṣikṣipeḥ knuḥ' iti knoḥ
kikkaraṇasyaitatprayojanam---gṛdhnurityādau guṇo mā bhūditi |
yadi caivaṃvidhe viṣaye gurūpadhatvād guṇo na syāt, knoḥ
kitkaraṇamanarthakaṃ syāt | tathā ṭhhalantācca' iti sanaḥ
kitvavidhānasyaitatpratyojanam---pitsatītyādau guṇo mā bhūditi,
tadapi jñāpakamuktārthasya | idaṃ tu jñāpakaṃ nopapadyate; sisṛkṣati,
didṛkṣate ityatra ṭhsṛjidṛśoḥ' ityamāgamo mā
bhūdityevamarthametatsyāt, tathā dhipsatītyatra nalopārthaṃ tatsyāt |
tasmāt knoreva kitkaraṇaṃ jñāpakam | bhinati, cchinatītyatra
śramo'kāreṇa laghūpadhamaṅgam, tatra dhātorikārasya guṇaḥ
prāpnoti, ata āha---upadhātreti | na hyatra yā kācidupadhā gṛhyate, kiṃ
tarhi ? ṭhiko guṇavṛddhī' ityasyopasthānāt sthānitvena sannihita
igeva |
apare tviti | varṇayantīti sambandhaḥ | puki anta iti | antaśabdaḥ
samīpavacanaḥ | yadyapi ṭhpuganta' ityatra bahuvrīhāvapi na doṣaḥ,
tathāpyaikarūpyeṇa viśeṣaṇārthamayamapi tatpuruṣa eva vyākhyātaḥ | laghvī
upadheti | karmadhārayaḥ | atra pakṣe śābda evopadhāyā ikā
sambandhaḥ---laghvyā upadhāyā ika iti | pugantalaghūpaghamiti |
samāhāradvandvaḥ |
kvacid ṭhupadhātra' ityādergranthasya purastāt saṃyoge
gurusaṃjñāyāmiti ślokatrayaṃ paṭha|lte |
dhātvantapratyayādyorhalorānantarye sati gurusaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ guṇo
bheturbheśabdasya na sidhyati | pariharati--vidhyapekṣamiti | idaṃ
vidhānamiti śeṣaḥ | laghūpadhādye vihite sārvadhātukārdhadhātuke,
tayoraṅgasya guṇa ityarthaḥ | nanu pañcamyabhāvāt kathaṃ
vidhānamupapadyate ? ucyate; ṣaṣṭhīpakṣe'pi viśeṣyata iti cetko
doṣaḥ---laghūpadhasya ye sārvadhātukārdhadhātuke | ke ca te ? ye
tasmādvihite ityupapadyate | laghoścāsāviti pāṭhe laghūpadhāccāsau
tṛjvihita ityarthaḥ | upadhāśabdastu vṛtabhaṅgabhayānna prayuktaḥ | kathaṃ
kuṇḍiriti | aṅgādhikāre numo vidhānādakṛta eva numi pratyayo
laghūpadhādvihitaḥ, tatra parato nimite sthite kuṇḍitetyādau guṇaḥ
prāpnoti, yadi vidhānaṃ viśeṣyata ityarthaḥ |
pariharati---dhātornuma iti | hetau pañcamī, yasmātatra
dhātornumaṅgasya tasmādityarthaḥ | uktaṃ hi tatra---ṭhdhātugrahaṇasya
prayojanam---dhātūpadeśāvasthāyāmeva num yathā syāt' iti,
tataśca prāgeva num, paścātpratyayaḥ; na cāsau laghūpadhādvihito
bhavati | kathaṃ rañjeriti | yadi ṣaṣṭhīnirddeśe'pa ividhānaṃ
viśeṣyate, tadānyatrāpi prasaṅgaḥ, tataśca ṭhata upadhāyāḥ'
ityakāropadhādvihite pratyaye vidhīyamānā vṛddhī rañjerna syāt;
prāk pratyayotpaternakāropadhatvāt--rāga iti, ṭhghañi ca
bhāvakaraṇayoḥ' iti nakāralopaḥ | yadyapyu padhāyā akārasya
vṛddhirucyate, na ca tataḥ pratyayasya vidhānaṃ sambhavati,
tathāpyakāropadhādyadvidhānaṃ tadevopadhāyā vidhānaṃ manyate |
syandiśranthyoriti | yadayam ṭhsyado jave',
ṭhavodaidhodmapraśrathahihaśrathāḥ' iti syandiśranthyorvṛddhyabhāvaṃ
nipātayati, tajjñāpayati----bhavatyevañjātīyakānāṃ vṛddhiriti | tatra
hi nalopārtham, vṛddhyabhāvārthaṃ ca nipātanamāśrayaṇīyam | yadi ca
vṛddhiviṣaye vidhānaṃ viśeṣyeta, tato
vṛddhiprasaṅgābhāvānnipātanāśrayaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt | nalopasya
siddhaye vidhirevāśrayaṇīyaḥ, anekaprayojanasiddhaye hi
nipātanāśrayaṇam | anallopeti | anantasya yo'llopaḥ
so'nallopaḥ; śau dīrghatvam, śidīrghatvam---tayordvandvaḥ,
anallopaśidīrghatve vidhyapekṣe na siddhyataḥ | yadi ca
ṣaṣṭhīnirddeśe'pi vidhānaṃ viśeṣyeta, allopo rājña ityādāveva
syāt; asthnā, asthne, dadhnā, dadhne---ityādau na syāt | śau
dīrghatvaṃ ca sāmāni ityādāveva syāt, kuṇḍānītyādau tu na
syāt | tasmātṣaṣṭhīnirdeśeṣu vihitaviśeṣaṇagrahaṇe
doṣaprasaṅgād guṇo bheturna siddhyatīti | evaṃ tarhi
jñāpakātsiddham, yadayam ṭhnābhyastasyāci' ityajgrahaṇaṃ karoti,
tajjñāpayati---bhavatyevañjātīyake viṣaye guṇa iti | tasya hi
prayojanam---nenaktītyādau halādau guṇapratiṣedho mā bhūditi |
yadi ca halādāvalaghūpadhatvād guṇo na syāt, tadā guṇasya
prāptyabhāvātkiṃ tannivāraṇārthenājgrahaṇena ! naitadasti jñāpakam;
abhyastasya yadāhāci larṅthaṃ tatkṛtaṃ bhavet | abhyastasyājādau
pratiṣedhamāheti yat tallarṅthaṃ kṛtaṃ bhavet, yatra
halādirlupyate---anenegiti, tasmānna jñāpakam | evaṃ
tarhi---knusanoryatkṛtaṃ kitvaṃ jñāpakaṃ syāllaghorguṇe |
vyākhyātametat ||
nābhyastasyāci piti sārvadhātuke || 7|3|87 ||
nenijānītyādi | loṭ, ṭhmerniḥ', ṭhāḍutamasya picca' śapaḥ śluḥ,
dvirvacanam, ṭhṇijāṃ trayāṇāṃ guṇaḥ ślau' | anenijamityādi |
laṅ, mipo'mbhāvaḥ |
vedānīti | ṭhvida jñāne', loḍādi yathāyogaṃ pūrvavat, śapo
luk | nenektīti | laṭ, tip, kutvam |
pidgrahaṇamutarārthamiti | ṭhtṛṇaha im' piti yathā syāt, iha tu
pito'nyatrāpi ṭhsārvadhātukamapiti' iti ṅitvādbhivitavyameva
pratiṣedhena | ninejeti | ṇal, sa ca ṭhliṭ ca' ityārddhadhātukasaṃjñaḥ
|
jujoṣaditi | ṭhjuṣī prītisevanayoḥ', leṭ, vyatyayena
parasmaipadam, tip, ṭhitaśca lopaḥ parasmaipadeṣu', ṭhleṭo'ḍāṭau'
ityaṭ, vyatyayena śapaḥ śluḥ, dvirvacanam | yadyatra guṇapratiṣedha
iṣyate, paspaśāte ityādau upadhāhrasvatvamiṣyate, tanna prāpnoti |
tasmādabhyastānāmupadhāyā hrasvatvameva vidheyam, na guṇapratiṣedhaḥ |
kathaṃ nenijānītyādi, guṇe kṛte upadhāhrasvatvam, ṭheca igghrasvādeśa',
siddhamiṣṭam ? ata āha---paspaśāte ityādi |
spaśirvārtikakāravacanādapaṭhito'pi dhātuḥ, tasmālleṭ,
vyatyayenātmanepadam, ṭeretve ṭhleṭo'ḍāṭau' ityāṭ, śapaḥ
ṭhbahulaṃ cchandasi' iti śluḥ, dvirvacanam | atha vā---yaṅluki
chāndasamabhyāsasya hrasvatvam | cākaśītiti | ṭhkāśrṛ dīptau',
yaṅluk, laṭ, tip, ṭhyaṅe vā' itīḍāgamaḥ | vāvaśītiriti |
ṭhvāśrṛ dīptau', yaṅluk, laṭ, śatrādeśaḥ, ṅīp, śas |
chāndasaṃ hrasvatvamiti | yadi tu guṇaniṣedhaṃ
pratyākhyāyopadhāhrasvatvamucyeta, tadā narnṛtītītyādau ṛdupadhe
rapare guṇe kṛte hrasvabhāvinyupadhā nāstīti rūpaṃ na siddhyet |
tasmācchāndasameva hrasvatvameṣṭavyamiti bhāvaḥ |
prakṛtyantarāṇāmeveti | ṭhspaśa bādhanasparśanayoḥ' ṭhkaśa
gatiśāsanayoḥ', ṭhvaśa kāntau' ||
bhūsuvostīṅ || 7|3|88 ||
abhūditi | luṅ, ṭhgātisthā' ityādinā sico luk | suvai,
suvāvahai, suvāmahai iti | ṭhṣūṅ prāṇigarbhavimocane', loṭ,
ceretvam, ṭheta ai', ṭhāḍutamasya picca', śapo luk, uvaṅadeśaḥ |
suvatisūyatyostviti | ṭhṣū preraṇe' tudādiḥ, ṭhṣūṅ prāṇiprasave,
divādiḥ | bhavatīti | śapi guṇaḥ |
vyatibhaviṣīṣṭeti | āśiṣi liṅ, ṭhliṅaśiṣi'
ityārdhadhātukasaṃjñā, ṭhkartari karmavyatihāre' ityātmanepadam |
atheti | prakṛtigrahaṇe yaṅlugantasyāpi grahaṇātprasaṅgaḥ |
jñāpakāditi | sūtestu nipātanābhāvād guṇaniṣedho
bhavatyeva---soṣuvītīti ||
uto vṛddhirluki hali || 7|3|89 ||
yavānīti | loḍutamaikavacanam |
api stuyāditi | apiḥ sambhāvane karmapravacanīya iti
ṭhupasargātsunoti' ityādinā ṣatvaṃ na bhavati | ṅcci pinna bhavatīti
| yāsuḍādeḥ sārvadhātukasya sākṣācchiṣṭṃa ṅtvimanavakāśam,
tibādīnāṃ tu pitvaṃ lakārāntareṣu sāvakāśam, tena ṭhṅcci pinna
bhavati' iti ṭhpicca ḍinna bhavati' iti vacanadvayasadbhāve'pi ṭhṅcci
pinna bhavati' ityetadevātra pravartata iti bhāvaḥ | ṭhkṅiti ca' iti
pratiṣedhastvatra na labhyate, kiṃ kāraṇam ? ika ityevamiksaṃśabdanena yā
vṛddhistasyāḥ sa pratiṣedhaḥ, iha tu ṭhutaḥ' iti
nirdiṣṭasthānikatvādikparibhāṣā nopatiṣṭhate ||
guṇo'pṛkte || 7|3|91 ||
nanu ca ṭhhali' iti vartate, ṭhpiti' iti ca, aṅgena ca pratyaya
upasthāpyate; tatra halātmake pratyaye piti vidhāyamāno guṇo'pṛkta
eva bhaviṣyati, nārtho'pṛktagrahaṇena ? ityata āha---halīti vartamāna
iti | apṛktagrahaṇaṃ hyaevamarthaṃ kriyate--halādau mā bhūditi, yadi ceyaṃ
paribhāṣā na syāt, apṛktagrahaṇaṃ na kuryāt, kṛtaṃ tu,
jñāpayati--bhavatyeṣā paribhāṣeti | idaṃ tvatra
vaktavyam---tadantavidhinivṛtyarthamapṛktagrahaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavatīti,
tadantavidhau hi laṅ imipo'mbhāve'pi prasaṅgaḥ syāt | nanu
bhavatyeva tatra guṇaḥ, kathaṃ bhavati ? yadā pūrvatra vṛddhividhāvapi
tadantavidhireva bhavati | tadetadapṛktagrahaṇaṃ kathaṃ
tadādividherjñāpakamiti cintyam | ṭhnāpṛkte'
ityucyamāne'nantarāyā vibhāṣitāyā vṛddheḥ pratiṣedhaḥ syāt, nityā
tu vṛddhaiḥ syādeva | tasmād guṇagrahaṇam ||
tṛṇaha im || 7|3|92 ||
tṛṇeḍhaiiti | imi kṛte śnamo'kāreṇa saha ṭhādguṇaḥ', ṭhho ḍhaḥ',
ṭhjhaṣastathordho'dhaḥ', ṣṭuatvam, ḍhalopaḥ | tṛṇekṣīti | ṭhṣaḍhoḥ kaḥ si'
| atṛṇeḍiti | laṅ, tipsiporanyataraḥ, halṅyādilopaḥ,
ḍhatvajaścacartvāni |
nanuṃ ca ṭhhalādau' ityucyate, na cātra halādiṃ paśyāmaḥ ?
pratyayalakṣaṇena | varṇāśraye nāsti pratyayalakṣaṇam ? ata
āha--varṇāśraye'pyatreti | yatra kevalo varṇa eva nimitaṃ yasya sa
varṇāśrayaḥ, yathā---gave hitaṃ gohitamityavādeśaḥ | iha tu piti
sārvadhātuka iti pratyaya eva nimitam, hal tasya viśeṣaṇam,
tenāsau pratyayanimitatvādbhavatyevetyarthaḥ | tṛṇahānīti | loṭ,
ṭhmeniḥ' | tṛṇāḍha iti | tas ḍhatvādi pūrvavat, ṭhśnasorallopaḥ',
anusvāraparasavarṇau |
atha kimarthaṃ tṛhirāgataśnamko gṛhyate ? raudhādikasya ṭhtṛha
hiṃsāyām' ityasya grahaṇaṃ yathā syāt, ṭhtṛhi hiṃsāyām' ityasya
taudādikasya grahaṇaṃ mā bhūt | nāsya piddhalādisārvadhātuka
manantaraṃ sambhavati; vikaraṇena vyavadhānāt | nanu cāsyāpi
yaṅlugantasya sambhavati, evaṃ tarhi sānubandhakatvāt tasya grahaṇaṃ na
bhaviṣyati ? ata āha---tṛṇaha itītyādi | yadyāgataśnamko na gṛhyaeta,
tato nāprāpte śnamyārabhyamāṇa im tasya bādhakaḥ syāt | athāpi na
bādhakaḥ, evamapi śnami kṛte imitīṣṭavyavasthā na syāt |
viparyayo'pi syāt---pūrvamimāgamaḥ, paścāt śnamiti |
saśnamkanirddeśe tu na śnamo nivṛttirbhavati, iṣṭā ca vyavasthā
sidhyati---pūrvaṃ śnam, paścādimiti | atastadarthamāgataśnanko gṛhyate
| kiñca---raudhādikasyāpi yaṅlugantasya grahaṇaṃ bhavati
saśnamkanirddeśādeva ||
bruva īṭ || 7|3|93 ||
ṭhbruvaḥ' iti pañcamī, na ṣaṣṭhī; vyākhyānāt | tayā'caritārthayā
pūrvatra kṛtārthāyāḥ sārvadhātuka iti saptamyāḥ ṣaṣṭhī prakalpyate |
tadāha---bruva ityetasmādutarasyeti | iha brūtādbhavāniti tātaṅ
aupadeśikena ṅtveni sthānivadbhāvakṛtaṃ pitvaṃ bādhyate---ṭhṅcci
pinna bhavati' iti, teneḍ na bhavati ||
yaṅe vā || 7|3|94 ||
lālapītītyādi | lapivadirautibhyo yaṅluk, dvirvacanam |
rauterabhyāsasya guṇaḥ | itarayordīrghatvam | vavartīti | vṛte
rūpam, ṭhrugrikau ca luki' ityabhyāsasya ruk | kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ
yaṅlugantamevodāhṛtam, na punaryaṅntam ? tatrāha---halāderiti
| yaṅnte hi śapā bhavitavyam, sa ca halādirna bhavati ||
turustuśamyamaḥ sārvadhātuke || 7|3|95 ||
tu iti sautro'yaṃ dhāturiti | sa ca vṛddhau vartate, gatyartha ityanye,
hiṃsārtha ityapare | utavītiti | ṭhbahulaṃ cchandasi' iti śapo luk |
śamīdhvamiti | śamerantarbhāvitaṇyarthātpraiṣe loṭ,
vyatyayenātmanepadam, śap, tasya ṭhbahulaṃ cchandasi' iti luk |
āpiśalā iti | āpiśaleḥ śiṣyāḥ | sāvadhātukāsviti | ṭābantam |
tatra saṃjñātvena viniyuktaṃ sārvadhātukagrahaṇamanarthakam, ṭhnābhyastasya'
ityādeḥ sūtrādanuvṛteḥ ? ata āha---sārvadhātuke iti vartamāna iti
| taddhi sārvadhātukagrahaṇaṃ pitītyanena sambaddham, atastadanuvṛtau
tadapyanuvarteta, tanmānuvṛtadityevamarthaṃ punaḥ
sārvadhātukagrahaṇamiti | ṭhhali' itiyetatvanuvartata eva; na hi
tatsārvadhātukagrahaṇena sambaddham ||
astisico'pṛkte || 7|3|96 ||
ṭhapṛkte' iti ṣaṣṭha|lrthe saptamī, tenāpṛktasyaivāyamāgamaḥ | āsīditi |
ṭhas bhuvi', śapo luk, tipa īṭ | alāvīditi | luṅ, ṭhiṭa īṭi
iti sico lopaḥ |
āhibhuvorīṭpratiṣedha ityādi | sthānivatsūtra etadvārtikam |
āhibhuvoḥ sthānivadbhāvasya pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ, īṭpratiṣedhaḥ
prayojanamityarthaḥ | āttheti | ṭhvruvaḥ pañcānām' ityādinā
sipasthal, bruva āhādeśaḥ, ṭhāhasthaḥ' iti hakārasya thatvam, tasya
ṭhkhari ca' iti cartvam---takāraḥ | abhūditi | luṅ, ṭhasterbhūḥ'
ṭhgātisthā' ityādinā sico luk | atra
sthānivadbhāvapratiṣedhādastyāśrayastāvadīṇna bhavati | sijāśrayo'pi
na bhavati, sthānivadbhāvapratiṣedhasāmarthyāt | astvevamastyādeśe
bhuvi, śuddhe tu bhavatau sijāśraya īṭ prāpnoti, tasmādīḍevātra
pratiṣedhyaḥ | āhiviṣaye parihārāntaraṃ jñāpakātsiddham, yadayaṃ
jhalādiprakaraṇe ṭhāhasthaḥ' iti thatvaṃ śasti | nanu ca
bhūtapūrvagatyarthametasyāt---jhalādiryo bhūtapūrvastatreti ?
naitadasti; evaṃ tarhi pañcānāmapi tibādīnāṃ
bhūtapūrvajhalāditvamiti sarvatra thatvaprasaṅgaḥ, tataścāthameva
vidadhyāt ||
bahula cchandasi || 7|3|97 ||
ā iti | asterlaṅ, tip, śapo lup, rutvavisarjanīyau akṣāḥ,
atsā iti | ṭhkṣara sañcalane', ṭhtsara cchadmagatau', luṅ, tipo
halṅyādilopaḥ, ṭhrātsasya' iti sico lopaḥ, dāturephasya
visarjanīyaḥ | chāndasatvāditi | ṭhbahulaṃ cchandasyamāṅyoge'pi'
ityanena na kevalamamāṅyoge'ḍāṭorabhāvaḥ kriyate, kiṃ tarhi ?
māṅyoge tatsadbhāvo'pīti bhāvaḥ | iḍabhāvaśca sica iti |
chāndasatvādityapekṣate ||
rudaśca pañcabhyaḥ || 7|3|98 ||
rudiḥ svapiḥ śvasiranirjakṣiḥ pañca rudādayaḥ |
rudaḥ iti bahuvacanasthāna ekavacanam | ṭhpañcabhyaḥ' iti
nirddeśādādyarthāvagatiḥ ||
aḍ gārgyagālavayoḥ || 7|3|99 ||
gāgyagālavayorgrahaṇaṃ pūjārthamiti | na vikalpārtham;
vidhānasāmarthyādevāḍīṭorvikalpasya siddhatvāt |
anekācāryagrahaṇamapyata eva ||
adaḥ sarveṣām || 7|3|100 ||
sarveṣāṃgrahaṇaṃ nityārtham, anyathā gārgyagālavagrahaṇamiha vikalpārtha
sambhāvyeta ||
ato dīrgho yañi || 7|3|101 ||
kecidatra tiṅtyinuvartayantīti | ṭhbhūsuvostiṅ' ityitaḥ |
bhavavāniti | bhavateḥ kvasuḥ, tasya ṭhcchandasyubhayathā' iti
sārvadhātukatvācchap, ṭhliṭi dhāto' ityatra dhātugrahaṇācchabantasya
dvirvacanābhāvaḥ | ye tu ṭhsārvadhātuke' ityevānuvartayanti, teṣāṃ
chāndasatvāddīrghābhāvaḥ | atha prakṛto'ḍāgama eva kasmānna
vidhīyate---ṭhato yañi' iti, akārāntādaṅgādutarasya
yañādestiṅe'ḍāgamo bhavati, paca avas, savarṇadīrgatve pacāva iti
siddhaṇ, vidhānasāmarthyācca ṭhato guṇe' iti pararūpatvaṃ na bhaviṣyati
? naivaṃ śakyam; iha hyadhukṣāvahi, adhukṣāmahīti ṭhksasyāci' iti lopaḥ
prasajyeta | iha cātijarābhyāmiti jarasbhāvaḥ | evamapi
dīrghagrahaṇamanarthakam, ādityākāra eva vidheyaḥ ? iha tarhi
prayojanam---apākṣī rodanaṃ deva dataḥ | nanu pacāmi bhorityatrāpi
ṭhanantyasyāpi praśnākhyānayoḥ' iti plutaḥ prāpnoti ? sa mā bhūddīrgha
eva yathā syāditi dīrghagrahaṇam |
ata iti taparakaraṇamutarārtham, ṭhbahuvacane jhalyet' ityetvaṃ
khaṭvābhirityatra mā bhūt ||
supi ca || 7|3|102 ||
vṛkṣāyeti | sannipātaparibhāṣāyā anityatvādatra dīrghatvam |
anityatvaṃ ca ṭhkaṣṭāya' iti nirdeśādavasitam ||
bahuvacane jhalyet || 7|3|103 ||
vṛkṣāṇāmiti | ṭhjhali' ityanucyamāne'gnīnāmityādau sāvakāśam
ṭhnāmi' iti dīrghatvaṃ bādhitvedametvamakārānteṣu syāditi bhāvaḥ ||
āṅ cāpiḥ || 7|3|105 ||
khaṭvayā, khaṭvayorityādīni ṭābḍāpcāpāṃ krameṇodāharaṇāni |
kīlālapeti | kīlālaṃ pibati ṭhāto maninkvanibvanipaśca' iti
vic, tṛtīyaikavacane ṭhāto dhātoḥ' ityālopaḥ, asati tu
pidviśiṣṭasya grahaṇe kīlālapaḥ paśyetyādau caritārthaṃ lopaṃ
bādhitvā paratvādāṅesoridamevaitvaṃ syāt |
ḍa|labgrahaṇe'dīrghagrahaṇāditi | yatra ṅyāpau gṛhyaete tatra
dīrghayorgrahaṇam, na hrasvayoḥ | sthānivadbhāve tu prasaṅgaḥ, tatra
sthānivatpratiṣedhasūtraprastāve vārtikam---ṭhṅyābgrahaṇe'dīrghaḥ'
iti, ṅyāporgrahaṇe'dīrgha ādeśo na sthānivaditi |
tatrārthādidamuktaṃ bhavati---ṅyāporgrahaṇe dīrghayorgrahaṇamiti,
tadidaṃ vṛttikāreṇa darśitam ||
ambārthanadyorhrasvaḥ || 7|3|107 ||
ambārthāḥu mātrārthāḥ |
ḍalakavatīnāmiti | arthagatena strītvenāmbārthāḥ śabdā nirdiṣṭāḥ,
śrutyapekṣo vā strīliṅganirdeśaḥ---ṭhḍalakavatīnāṃ śrutīnāmityarthaḥ'
iti | asaṃyuktāśca ḍalakā gṛhyante; tenākka, alleti hrasvo bhavatyeva |
devate bhaktiriti | hrasvatve kṛte, ṭhṅyābgrahaṇe'dīrghaḥ' iti
sthānivatvaniṣedhādyāḍāgamo ṇeórāmapi na bhavataḥ |
mātṛṇāmiti | pūrvapadabhedana bahavo mātṛśabdā iti bahuvacanam
| putrārthamiti | putramabhidhātuṃ yo mātṛśabda upādīyata ityarthaḥ |
bahuvrīhau ca vartipadairanyapadārtho'bhidhīyata iti tatraivayamādeśaḥ |
kīdṛśāya putrāyeti | samāse guṇībhūtasyāpi putrastha buddhyā
pravibhajya nirddeśaḥ, yathā---ṭhatha śabdānuśāsanam, keṣāṃ
śabdānām' iti | mātrā vyapadeśamarhatīti | yaḥ putraḥ
ślāghyaguṇatvātkulasambhūtayā mātrā vyapadeśamarhatītyarthaḥ | yatra tu
piturasaṃvijñānena mātrā vyapadeśastatra na bhavati, etaccārhata iti
praśaṃsāyāṃ laṭaḥ śatrādeśavidhānāllabhate | samāsāntāpavāda iti |
nāprāpte tasminnasyārambhāt ||
hrasvasya guṇaḥ || 7|3|108 ||
hrasvavidhānasāmarthyāditi | nanu hrasvavidhānaṃ tasya guṇavidhānārthameva
syāt, anyathā hrasvatvābhāvād guṇo na syādata āha---yadīti | hrasvaṃ
vidhāya guṇe vidhīyamāne prakriyāgauravaṃ bhavatīti lāghavārthaṃ
sākṣādeva guṇaṃ vidadhyādityarthaḥ | nanu ṭhnadīhrasvayorguṇaḥ'
ityucyamāne ṭhjasi ca' ityatra nadyā apyanuvṛttiḥ syāt,
ekasamāsanirdiṣṭatvāt ? naiṣa doṣaḥ;
ekasamāsanirdiṣṭayorapyekadeśo'nuvartate,
tadyathā---ṭhsaṃkhyāvyayāderṅīp', ṭhdāmahāyanāntācca' ityatra
saṃkhyāgrahaṇamanuvartate, nāvyayagrahaṇam ||
jasi ca || 7|3|109 ||
jasādiṣviti | ādiśabdaḥ prakāre, tena pūrvayoganirdiṣṭānāmapi
grahaṇam | darvīti | ṭhkṛdikārādaktinaḥ' iti
ṅīṣvikalpamanapekṣyaitaduktam, tata eva tu siddhaṃ rūpadvayam | śatakratva
iti | ṭhjasi ca' iti guṇābhāvapakṣe ṭhprathamayoḥ' iti
pūrvasavarṇadīrgho'pi ṭhvā cchandasi' iti vacanānna bhavatīti yaṇādeśaḥ
pravartate | kikidīvyeti | ṭhāṅe nāstriyām' iti nābhāvo na
bhavati | kikidīviśabdaḥ ṭhkṛvidhṛṣvi' ityuṇādiṣu nipātitaḥ ||
ṛto ṅisarvanāmasthānayoḥ || 7|3|110 ||
taparakaraṇaṃ mukhasukhārthamiti |
ṅisarvanāmasthānayordīrghāntasyāsambhavāt | dhātvanukaraṇamapi na
sambhavati, ṭhṛta iddhātoḥ' itītvavidhānāt | karta ṇītyatyādāvapi
numaḥ pūrvāntatvādasambhavaḥ ||
gherṅiti || 7|3|111 ||
dhyantasyāṅgasyeti | ṭhvarṇamātrasya ghisaṃjñā' ityāśrityedamuktam |
ṭhtadantasya saṃjñā' ityatra tu pakṣe ghyekadeśe varṇe ghiśabdo draṣṭavyaḥ
| etena nadyantāditi vyākhyātam |
supītyeveti | ṭhsupi ca' ityataḥ | paṭvīti | ṭhvāto
guṇavacanāt' iti | kuruta iti | yasya nadīsaṃjñā nāsti sa sarvo'pi
ghisaṃjñaḥ, na liṅgavadeveti | kuruśabdasya ghisaṃjñā, tasya tasi ṅiti
guṇo na bhavati | etacca ṅcchibde bahuvrīhimāśrityocyate | yadi tu
ṅścāsāvicceti karmārayastadā naivātra prasaṅgaḥ,
ṭhsārvadhātukamapit' ityanena hi bahuvrīhau ṅito yitkāryaṃ
tadatidiśyate, na caitāvatā taseṇÇókāra ādirbhavati ||
āṇnadyāḥ || 7|3|112 ||
ṭhnadyāḥ' iti pañcamyakṛtārthā ṅtīiti saptamyāḥ ṣaṣṭhaāā prakalpayati, tena
ṅti evāyamāgamo vijñāyata ityāha---nadyantādaṅgādutarasyeti |
kumāryā iti | ṭhāṭaśca' iti vṛddhiḥ | atha dīrghoccāraṇaṃ kimartham,
aḍevocyeta, ṭhvṛddhireci' iti vṛddhyā savarṇadīrghatvena ca
kumāryai, kumāryā iti siddham ? na siddhyati; ṭhato guṇe'
pararūpatvaṃ prāpnoti | aḍvacanasāmarthyānna bhaviṣyati ?
astyaḍvacane prayojanam, kim ? śriyai, śriyā ityatra ṭhsāvekācaḥ'
ityādyaudātatvaṃ mā bhūt, āgamānudātatvaṃ yathā syāditi |
āgamānudātatvaṃ hi pratyayasvaramiva vibhaktisvaramapi bādhate,
viśeṣato'trāḍvacanasārthyāt ||
yāḍāpaḥ || 7|3|113 ||
dīrghoccāraṇaṃ kimartham, na yaḍevocyeta, vṛddhau kṛtāyāṃ
savarṇadīrghatve ca khaṭvāyai, khaṭvāyā iti siddham ? na sidhyati;
ṭhato guṇe' pararūpatvaṃ prāpnoti, akāroccāraṇasāmarthyānna
bhaviṣyati | astyanyadakāroccāraṇasya prayojanam---jñāye, jñāyā
ityatra ṭhsāvekācaḥ' ityādyaudātatvaṃ mā bhūt, āgamānudātatvaṃ yathā
syāditi | kiñca---uccāraṇārtho'pyakāraḥ sambhāvyeta, iha
khaṭvāmatikrānta iti prādisamāse hrasvatve ca tasya
sthānivadbhāvātataḥ parasya caturthyekavacanasya ṭhṇeóryaḥ' iti
yādeśaṃ bādhitvānena yāṭ prāpnoti, tatra kṛte dīrghatve
cātikhaṭvāyai devadatāyeti prasaṅgaḥ,
tatrāha---ātakhaṭvāyetyatreti | akṛte dīrghatva iti | yādeśāt
prāgavasthāyāmidamuktam | kṛte tahi yādeśe dīrghatve ca ṅccāsiu
bhūtapūrva iti yāṭ prāpnoti ? ata āha---kṛte ca lākṣaṇikatvāditi
||
sarvanāmnaḥ syāḍḍhrasvaśca || 7|3|114 ||
dīrghoccāraṇaṃ sarvasyā ityatra vṛddhiryathā syād, ṭhato guṇe'
pararūpatvaṃ mā bhūt | akāroccāraṇaṃ tu asyā ityatra ṭhūḍidampadādi'
iti vibhakterādyaudātatvaṃ mā bhūt, āgamānudātatvaṃ yathā
syādevamartha syāt | kiñca uccāraṇārtho'pyakāraḥ sambhāvyeta ||
vibhāṣā dvitīyātṛtīyābhyām || 7|3|115 ||
aprāptavibhāṣeyam; asarvanāmatvāt | nanu ca ṭhtīyasya vā
ṅtsūpisaṃkhyānam' ityanenaiva siddhatvānnārtha etena, taccāvaśyaṃ
vaktavyaṃ liṅgāntare'pi smāyādayo vikalpena yathā syuriti ?
naitadyauktamucyate; yaddhi sūtreṇāsiddhaṃ tadupasaṃkhyānena sādhanīyam, na
punarupasaṃkhyānāśrayaṇena sūtrasya pratyākhyānaṃ yujyate |
yadi punaratra hrasvayorgrahaṇaṃ kṛtvā syāḍgrahaṇaṃ ca nivartya
ṭhsarvanāmnaḥ' ityevā nuvartyātideśa āśrīyate---sarvanāmno yaduktaṃ
tadvibhāṣā bhavati dvitīyātṛtīyayoriti, tadopasaṃkhyānaṃ
śakyamakartum ||
ṇeórāmnadyāmnībhyaḥ || 7|3|116 ||
ṭhṇeóḥ' iti saptamyekavacanagrahaṇam; icchāyām,
striyāmityādinirdeśāt | grāmaṇyāmiti | ṭhsatsūdviṣa' ityādinā
kvip, ṭhagragrāmābhyām' iti ṇatvam, ṭheranekācaḥ' iti yaṇ ||
idudbhyām || 7|3|117 ||
nadīgrahaṇamihānuvartate | yadyevam, apārthakamidam, pūrveṇaiva
siddhatvāt, tataśca ṭhidudbhyāmaut' ityekayoga eva kartavyaḥ ? naivaṃ
śakyam; aukāro hi syāt,
nadīlakṣaṇasyāmo'vakāśaḥ---kumāryāmiti, autvasyāvakāśaḥ---patyau,
sakhyāviti; kṛtyāmityatra yadā nadīsaṃjñā tadā paratvādautvaṃ
prāpnoti ||
aut || 7|3|118 ||
yanna nadīsaṃjñamityādi | nadīsaṃjñake pūrveṇām vihitaḥ,
ghisaṃjñe'pyutareṇātvasaṃyuktamautvaṃ vakṣyati,
tasmādābhyāmanyadevodāharaṇam | tatra pūrvatra ṭhghyantānnadyantāt'
ityuktam, iha tvikārokārāntamityuktm, saṃjñāvidhau ca pakṣadvayaṃ
darśitam---varṇamātrasya saṃjñā, tadantasya veti; tena nāsti virodhaḥ
||
acca gheḥ || 7|3|119 ||
kṛtau, dhenāviti | athātrātve kṛte ṭhajādyataṣṭāp' iti ṭāpkasmānna
bhavati, astu ko doṣaḥ ? ṭhḍerāmnadyāmnībhyaḥ', ṭhyāḍāpaḥ' ityetau
vidhī prāpnutaḥ, autvavidhānaṃ tu puṃsi caritārtham ? ata
āha---taparakaraṇaṃ striyāmāpo nivṛtyarthamiti | iha hi sthānino
mātrikatvādbhāvyamānatvāccāṇo dīghasya prasaṅgo nāsti, yasya
nivṛtyarthaṃ taparakaraṇaṃ syāt | tasmācchāstrantareṇāpi dīrgho mā
bhūdityevamarthaṃ taparakaraṇaṃ kriyate, etacca
sannipātaparibhāṣāmanāśrityoktam | ṅasinnipātakṛtaṃ hyatvaṃ
tadvighātakasya ṭāpo nimitaṃ na bhavati |
audacca gheriti yeṣāmityādi | iha kecit ṭhaudacca gheḥ'
ityekayogamevādhīyate, tatra yadi samuccaye caśabdaḥ syāt, yatrātvaṃ
tatraivautvaṃ syāt---dhenāviti; gheścātvamityaghau sakhyau,
patyāvityatrautvamapi na syāt, asya doṣasya nivṛtaye
pradhānaśiṣṭamautvamanvācayaśiṣṭamatvamiti varṇayanti | tatra yathā
ṭhkartuḥ kyaṅ salopaśca' ityatra salopasyānvācayaśiṣṭasyābhāve'pi
śyenāyata ityādau kyaṅ bhavati, tathā atrāpi sakhyau,
patyāvityatvābhāve'pi autvaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ ||
āṅe nā'striyām || 7|3|120 ||
ṭhāṅḥ' iti sthānyantarasyopādānād gheriti ṣaṣṭhī pañcamyā
vipariṇamyata ityāha---gherutarasyeti | atha
kimarthamastriyāmityucyate, ṭhāṅe nā puṃsi' ityevocyeta, evaṃ hi
mātrayā lāghavaṃ bhavati, iṣṭṃa ca sidhyati ? evamucyamāne trapuṇā,
jatunetyatra napuṃsake na prāpnoti | mā bhūnnābhāvaḥ, ṭhikoci
vibhaktau, iti numi kṛte siddhamiṣṭam ? ata āha--puṃsīti
noktamityādi | amunā brāhmaṇakuleneti | ṭhpuṃsi' ityucyamāne
nābhāvo na syāt | numapīglakṣaṇo nāsti; mutvasyāsiddhatvāt |
ṭhastriyām' ityucyamāne napuṃsake'pi nābhāvo bhavati | nābhāve
kartavye mutvasyāsiddhatvaṃ nāsti | ṭhna mune' iti pratiṣedhāditi
ṭhnapuṃsake' ityucyamāne'pi na sidhyati | tasmādastriyāmityeva
vaktavyamiti ||
iti śrīharadatamiśraviracitāyāṃ padamañjaryāṃ saptamasyādhyāyasya
tṛtīyaḥ pādaḥ samāptaḥkāśikāvṛttiḥ---6
atha saptamādhyāye caturthaḥ pādaḥ
ṇau caṅyupadhāyā hrasvaḥ || 7|4|1 ||
ṭhṇau' ityaṅgāpekṣayā parasaptamī, ṭhcaṅ' īti ṇyapekṣayā |
udāharaṇeṣu kṛhṛlūpūbhyo ṇic, luṅ, caṅ, ṇilopaḥ, hrasvatvam,
dvirvacanam | tatra ṇau kṛtaṃ sthānivadbhavatīti kṛ ityādi
dhāturūpaṃ dvirucyate, kṛ hṛ ityetayoruradatvam, ṭhsanvallghuni'
iti sanvadbhāvāditvam | itarayorapi ṭhoḥ puyaṇjyapare'
itītvam | sarvatra ṭhdīrgho laghoḥ' iti dīrghaḥ | atreti |
anantarodāhṛteṣu | paratvāditi | caṅīti
dvirvacanasyāśiśrayadityādiravakāśaḥ, hrasvasya tu
kṛtadvirvacanamavakāśaḥ; akṛte tu dvirvacane vipratiṣedhaḥ | tatra kṛte
dvirvacanamiti | tataśca sanvadbhāve kartavye hrasvatvaṃ na
sthānivadbhavati; abhyāsasyādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvatvāditi bhāvaḥ |
codayati---iha tviti | māṅprayoga āḍ mā bhūditi |
nityatvāditi | dvirvacanaṃ hi kṛte'pi hrasvatve prāpnoti,
akṛte'pi, tataśca tadeva syātatra ko doṣaḥ ? ityata āha---tathā
satīti | pariharati---naiṣa doṣa iti | oṇeriti | ṭhoṇṛ
apanayane' ityasya ṛditkaraṇaṃ etatprayojanam---ṛdito neti
pratiṣedho yathā syāt | yadi cātra dvirvacanaṃ syāt,
ṛditkaraṇamanarthakaṃ syād, dvirvacane kṛte pararūpeṇa
vyavahitatvādeva hrasvatvaṃ na bhavaṣyiti, paśyati
tvācāryaḥ---dvirvacanād hrasvatvaṃ balīya iti, tata oṇimṛditaṃ
karoti | ṇāviti kimiti | hrasvaśrutyā acparibhāṣopasthānādaca
upadhāyā hrasvena bhāvyam | na cāṇyantānāṃ caṅ upidhā hrasvabhāvinī
sambhavati, na hi śridrusnudheṭśvīnāmajupadhā | kamigupyostu hrasva
evopadhā, tataśca caṅ yiḥ pratyayastasminnupadhāyā hrasvo bhavati sa ca
ṇireva, tatra ṇāvantaraṅgatvād vṛddhyādiṣu kṛteṣu upadhāyā hrasva
iti siddhamiṣṭamiti praśnaḥ | itaraḥ---yathāśrutasambandhasambhave caṅ yiḥ
pratyaya ityadhyāhāro na yukta iti vacanādantaraṅgamapi vṛddhyādikaṃ
bādheteti matvā''ha---caṅyupadhāyā iti | hrasvaḥ syāditi | nanu ca
ūkārasya hrasvaḥ, tasmiṃśca kṛte bādhitatvānmā bhūd vṛddhiḥ, guṇastu
kenacidabādhitatvādbhaviṣyati, tato'vādeśe siddhamalīlavaditi ?
naitadasti; guṇasya vṛddhyā bādhitatvād vṛddheśca hrasveneti
bhraṣṭāvasarasya guṇasya kutaḥ punaḥ pravṛttirityuvaṅ prasajyeta | astu
vā tatra guṇaḥ, doṣāntaramāha---adīdapadityatreti | yadā tu
caṅparanirhnāse sthānivatvaniṣedhaḥ, tadā vṛddhyāvādeśayoḥ
kṛtayoḥ puki ca ṇilopasya sthānivadbhāvābhāvāccaṅ yidaṅgaṃ
tasyaivopadhā hrasvabhāvinī sambhavatīti ṇāviti na vaktavyam |
sūtrakāreṇa sthānivatvaniṣedho na kṛta iti ṭhṇau' ityuktam |
caṅīti kimiti | mitāṃ hrasvavidhānādanena ṇau sarvatra hrasvo na
bhaviṣyati, prayogadarśanācceṣṭato vyavasthāśrayiṣyate iti praśnaḥ |
itaraḥ---nāntareṇa vacanamiṣṭāniṣṭavibhāgaḥ sujñāna iti
matvā''ha--kārayati, hārayatīti | kiñca---mitāṃ hrasvavacanam
ṭhasiddhavadatrābhāt' ityetadarthaṃ syāt | upadhāyā iti kimiti |
hrasvaśrutyā ṭhacaḥ' ityupatiṣṭhate, tatra viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāve
kāmacārādaṅgenājviśaṣyate, aṅgasya yatra tatra sthitasyāco hrasvo
bhavati, tenopadhāyāstāvatsiddhaṃ hrasvatvamiti praśnaḥ |
itaro'pyatiprasaṅgamudāharati--acakāṅkṣaditi | nanu ṭhṇau'
ityanenācaṃ viśeṣayiṣyāmaḥ---ṇau parato'ṅgasya yo'jiti, tatra
sāmarthyādakavarṇavyavadhānamavaśyambhāvitvādāśrayiṣyate ?
ityāha---tadetaditi | utarārthamiti | ṭhlopaḥ
pibaterīccābhyāsasya'---upadhāyā yathā syādantasya mā
bhūdityevamarthamavaśyamupadhāgrahaṇaṃ kartavyam |
yadyautarārthamupadhāgrahaṇam, tatraivaṃ kartavyam | yadyevam, tatraiva
kriyatām ? ata āhatadihāpīti | āllopaḥ pibateriti |
evamucyamāne'ntaraṅgamapi yukamanavakāśatvādāllopo bādhate,
upadhāgrahaṇe tvantaraṅgatvādyauki kṛte ākārasya upadhāyā lopa iti na
kaścad doṣiḥ | tasmādutarārthamupadhāgrahaṇam | apara
āha---ihārthamapyupadhāgrahaṇam, anyathā ṇāvanantarasya hrasvo
vidhīyamāno'ntaraṅgamapi vṛddhyādika vādhitvā lūai at iti
sthite ukārasyādeśaḥ prāpnoti, naiṣa doṣaḥ; yadayam
ṭhnāglopiśāsvṛditām' iti pratiṣedhe śāsti,
tajjñāpayati---nāntyasyeva hrasvatvamiti |
ṇau ṇicyupasaṃkhyānamiti | ṇau parato yo ṇistasminnityarthaḥ |
ṇeṇicīti pāṭhe ṇyantātpare ṇici vihita ityarthaḥ | vāditavantaṃ
prayojitavāniti | luṅe bhūtakālatvātprayojitavāniti
bhūtakālena vigrahaḥ | vāditavantamityatra tu katham, yadyasau
vāditavān kathaṃ prayuktiḥ, kurvato hi prayuktiḥ kariṣyato vā, na
tu kṛtavataḥ ? na brūmaḥ---prayuktikālāpekṣayātra bhūtakālatvamiti, ki
tahi ? yathāśabdaprayogakālapekṣayā | prayojitavānityatra bhūtakālatvaṃ
tadapekṣayaiva prayojyavyāpārasyāpīti | avīvadaditi |
vaderṇyantāṇṇici luṅadi | kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ na sidhyati ? ata
āha---yo'sāviti | sthānivadbhāve hi sati yaścaṅparo ṇirna
tatropadhā hrasvabhāvinī, yatropadhā hrasvabhāvinī na sa caṅparaḥ;
dvitīyena ṇicā vyavahitatvāt | tena ceti | ṇilopena |
aglopitvāditi |
nanu ca ṇyantāṇṇici vihite ṇilopaśca prāpnoti, ṭhaco ñṇiti'
iti vṛddhiśca, tatra lopaḥ śabdāntare prāpteranityaḥ, vṛddhestu lope
kṛte'tyantāprāptirityubhayoranityayoḥ paratvād vṛddhau
kṛtāyāmaikārasya lopaḥ, tannāglopyaṅga bhavati ? evaṃ tahi
yadaglopināṃ neti pratiṣedhaṃ śāsti, tajjñāpayati---vṛddherlopo
balīyāniti; anyathā sarvatrāko vṛddhau
kṛtāyāmaikāraukārayorlopaḥ, na tvakaḥ | naitadasti jñāpakam; yatra
vṛddhāvapi kṛtāyāmageva lupyate
tadarthametatsyāt---rājanamatikrāntavānnatyararājat, yatahi
pratyāhāragrahaṇaṃ karoti; anyathāllopināṃ netyeva brūyāt ?
etadapi nāsti jñāpakam; svāminamākhyadasasvāmat,
gomucamākhyadajugomat, prāvṛṣamākhyadapaprāvat,
yādṛśamākhyadayayādat--ityevamādyarthametatsyāt | atrāhuḥ---ṇijatra
nāsti; anabhidhānāt ! etacca bhāṣyakāreṇa
jñāpakatvasamarthanādavasitamiti | yatra tarhyabhidhānamaṅgīkṛtaṃ
tadrathametatsyāt ṭhvinmatorluk'---bhāsvantamākhyat ababhāsat ?
naitatpratyāhāragrahaṇasya prayojanam, akāra eva hyatra matupo lupyate |
yatra tarhi vino luk---sragviṇamākhyadasasrajat ? atrāpi nopadhā
hrasvabhāvinī | tasmātpratyāhāragrahaṇaṃ jñāpakamiti sthitametat |
evamapi harikalyoratvanipātanaṃ sanvadbhāvapratiṣedhārthamiti
yaduktaṃ tenaidvirudhyate | tathā hi---asatyapyatvanipātane vṛddhiṃ
bādhitvā ikārasya lope sati naiva sanvadbhāvasya prasaṅgaḥ |
tasmādaglopitvāditi nāyaṃ svapakṣaḥ, paramatena tvetaduktaṃ
draṣṭavyam ||
bhāṣyasyāpyevamevātra nirvāho dṛśyatāṃ budhaiḥ |
viparyaye tūcyamāne yuktiḥ kācinna dṛśyate ||
evaṃ ca paṭuamākhyat balimākhyat apīpaṭat, abībaladiti bhavati |
yathā tvatra bhāṣyaṃ tathā apapaṭat, ababaladiti bhavatītyalamiyatā |
upasaṃkhyānaṃ pratyācaṣṭe---ṇyākṛtinirdeśātsiddhamiti | ākṛtiratra
jātirnirddiśyate---caṅparā yā ṇyākṛtirjātistatreti | tataśca
satyapi sthānivatve ṇyākṛterevatvādyaścaṅparo ṇiḥ sa eva pūrvaḥ,
yaśca pūrvaḥ sa eva caṅpara iti siddhaṃ hrasvatvam |
yadapyuktam---ṭhaglopitvāt' iti, tadapi na; ākṛtinirddeśe hi
hrasvasya na ṇyākṛtinimitatvenāśrīyate | tatra gobalīvardanyāyena
tasyā ṇyākṛteranyasyāko lopaḥ pratiṣedhaviṣayatvenā''śrīyate iti
sarvamavadāt ||
nāglopiśāsvṛditām || 7|4|2 ||
yatra ṇau parato'glopastadihāglopi gṛhyate |
dīvyatiprabhṛternāyaṃ niṣedhaḥ śāsvṛdidgrahāt ||
śakyaḥ śāsigraho'kartumṛdideṣa paṭhiṣyate |
ṛśāsū anuśiṣṭāvityevameke pracakṣate ||
vadantyanye tu sūtre'smin śāsiṃ niranubandhakam |
paṭhantaḥ pratiṣedho'sya yaṅlukyapi bhavediti ||
tatra sthānivadbhāvādapi siddhamiti | sthānivadbhāve hi sati
hrasvabhāvinyupadhā na sambhavati | halacorādeśe tu na siddhyatīti |
yathā ṭhsudhāturakaṅ ca' iti
samudāyasyādeśatve'vayavasyānādeśatvādaṇo raparatvaṃ na
bhavati---saudhātakiriti, tathā samudāye
sthāninyavayavasyāsthānitvādajādeśatvābhāvānnāsti sthānivadbhāvaḥ |
iha tvaglopigrahaṇasāmarthyāt samudāyalopo'pyaglopa āśrīyate ||
bhrājabhāsabhāṣadīpajīvamīlapījāmanyatarasyām || 7|4|3 ||
ṭhbhrāja dīptau', ṭhbhāsṛ dīptau', ṭhbhāṣa vyaktāyāṃ vāci' bhauvādikāḥ;
ṭhdīpi dīptau', daivādikaḥ, sarve'nudātetaḥ; ṭhjīva prāṇadhāraṇe'
bhauvādikaḥ; ṭhmīla nimeṣaṇe', ṭhpīḍa avabādhane'---curādī |
bhrājabhāsorityādi | avaśyamanayoranudāto'nubandha āsaṅktavyaḥ,
ṛkārānurodhastvapāṇinīya ityucyate | ṛkārānubandhe prāpte
vibhāṣā, varṇāntare tvaprāpte vibhāṣeti | ṛkārānurodhe
phalaviśeṣābhāvādapāṇinīyatvam |
kāṇyādīnāmiti | kāṇivāṇirāṇiheṭhilopiprabhṛtayaḥ kāṇyādayaḥ |
ādiśabdaḥ | prakāre ||
lopaḥ pibaterīccābhyāsasya || 7|4|4 ||
apīpyaditi | nanu ca paratvānnityatvādupadhālope kṛte,
anackatvād dvirvacanaṃ na prāpnoti ? ata āha---upadhālope kṛta iti
| upadhāyā eva paryāyeṇetvaṃ mā bhūditi abhyāsasya grahaṇam |
ākāralopenāṅgasyāglopitvāllaghunaśca parasyāsambhavāt
ṭhsanvallaghuni' itītvadīrghatvayorabhāvādītvavidhiḥ | tipā nirdeśo
yaṅlugnivṛtyarthaḥ ||
tiṣṭhaterit || 7|4|5 ||
atiṣṭhipaditi | ṇau kṛtasyetvasya sthānivadbhāvāt sthāśabdasya
dvirvacanam, sanvadbhāvādabhyāsasyetvam | tipā nirdeśaḥ pūrvavat
||
urṛt || 7|4|7 ||
upadhāyā ṛvarṇasyeti | atha arterdhātorgrahaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavati, mā
bhavānarpipad iti yathā syāditi ? taparakaraṇāt | taddhi dīrghe'pi
sthānini hrasva eva yathā syāditi | hararārāmapavāda iti | ṭhkṛta
saṃśabdane'---ityasya ṭhṛta iddhātoḥ' itītvaṃ prāpnoti, ṭhvṛtu vartane'
ityādīnāṃ guṇaḥ, ṭhmṛjervṛddhiḥ'---te ca raparāḥ santa hararāro
bhavanti | acikīrtaditi | ṇau kṛtamapītvaṃ na sthānivad bhavati |
yatra dvirukte parabhāgasyādyo'javarṇastatra sthānivatvam | tathā ca ṭhoḥ
puyaṇjyapare' iti jñāpakamapyetādṛśameva | nanu cāntaraṅgā
irarāraḥ, ṇijmātrāpekṣatvāt; ṛkārastu bahiraṅgaḥ, sa hi
paścādbhāvinaṃ caṅmapekṣate, tatkathaṃ tenaite bādhyante ? ata
āha---vacanasāmarthyāditi | yadyantaraṅgatvādirarāraḥ syuḥ,
vyarthamevedaṃ vacanaṃ syāt |
taparakaraṇamityādi | asati tasminyatra sthānī
dīrghastatrāntaratamyāddīrgha eva syāt | nanu bhāvyamāno'ṇ savarṇānna
gṛhṇāti, tatkathaṃ dīrghasya prasaṅgaḥ ? ata āha---na cāyamiti | asati
taparakaraṇe iti bhāvaḥ | kathamabhāvyamānaḥ ? ata āha---ādeśāntareti |
ayamabhiprāyaḥ---prāptapratiṣedhasya pratiprasave sambhavati nāpūrvavidhānaṃ
yuktamiti tāvannyāyaḥ, tataścāsati taparakaraṇe
ādeśāntarāṇāmirarārāṃ nivṛtyarthaṃ
yathāvasthitamṛvarṇasvarūpamevābhyanujñāyeta | sambhāvane liṅ,
sambhavati ca savarṇagrahaṇe sati svarūpābhyanujñānam | tatra
svarūpamevābhyanujñāyatāmiti savarṇagrahaṇaṃ syāt, taparakaraṇe tu
sati svarūpābhyanujñānaṃ na sambhavati, ato bhāvyamānatvasampataye
taparakaraṇamiti | prāyeṇa tu abhyanujñāyate iti uḍantaṃ paṭha|lte, na
tatra samīcīno'rthaḥ; kriyamāṇānuvāde hi laḍ bhavati | anye tu
vyācakṣate---ādeśāntaranivṛtyartha svarūpamevābhyanujñāyata
ityevamāpadyeteti ||
dayaterdigi liṭi || 7|4|9 ||
avadigya iti | ṭhdeṅ rakṣaṇe', ṅitvādātminepadam, ṭheranekācaḥ'
iti yaṇ |
na tu dayetyasyeti | ṭhdaya dānagatirakṣaṇeṣu' ityasya | tasya
liṭa|lamvihita iti | ṭhdayāyāsasaśca' ityanena |
digyādeśena dvirvacanasya bādhanamiṣyata iti | nāprāpte
tasminnasyārambhāt | nanu dayateḥ prāptaṃ dvirvacanaṃ bādhyatām,
digyādeśasya tu sthānivadbhāvena dvirvacanaṃ prāpnoti, tatkathaṃ
bādhyate, na hi tasminnāprāpte tasyārambhaḥ ? ucyate; bādhyabādhakabhāve
hi dvetam---lakṣyaṃ vā lakṣaṇena bādhyate, lakṣaṇaṃ vā teneti | tatrādye
pakṣe syādetaccodyam, dvirvacanaśāstrasyābādhitatvāt; dvitīye tu
dvirvacanaśāstramevāsmin viṣaye digyādeśaśāstreṇa bādhitamiti
kṛte'pi digyādeśe nāsti dvirvacanasya prasaṅgaḥ | yadyevam,
ṭhastarbhūḥ'---babhūva, atra dvirvacanaṃ na syāt, anavakāśā hi vidhayo
bādhakā bhavanti, sāvakāśaścāyam, ko'vakāśaḥ ? bhavitā, bhavitum;
yastarhi liṭa|leva vidhīyate--ṭhcakṣiṅḥ khyāñ', ṭhvā liṭi' iti, tatra
dvirvacanaṃ na prāpnoti---ācakhyau ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; ārdhadhātuke
liṭīti viṣayasaptamī, tataśca dvirvacananimitasya liṭa utpateḥ
prāgeva khyāñādeśaḥ, paścālliṭi parato dvirvacanam | iha tu
parasaptamyāśrayaṇānnāprāpte dvirvacane digirārabhyamāṇastad bādhate |
evamanyatrāpi, yatra bādho neṣyate tatra lakṣya bādho vaktavyaḥ,
viṣayasaptamī vāśrayaṇīyā ||
ṛtaśca saṃyogāderguṇaḥ || 7|4|10 ||
sasvaraturityādi | ṭhsvṛ śabdopatāpayoḥ', ṭhdhvṛ hūrcchane', ṭhsmṛ
cintāyām' | atra paratvād guṇe kṛte paścād dvirvacanamiti
guṇavidhānasamaye saṃyogāditvamaṅgasya | yadvā---dvirvacane
halādiśeṣe kṛte sāmpratikāsambhāvād
bhūtapūrvasaṃyogāditvamāśritya guṇaḥ ||
pratiṣedhaviṣaya iti | thali, utame ṇali ṇitvābhāvapakṣe ca
sāmānyalakṣaṇo naiva guṇaḥ siddhaḥ---sasvartha, ahaṃ kila sasvara |
vṛddhiviṣaye tarhi paratvādayameva guṇaḥ prāpnoti ?
tatrāha---vṛddhiviṣaye tvityādi | guṇasyāvakāśaḥ---sasvaratuḥ, ṇiti
vṛddheravakāśaḥ---kārakaḥ, hārakaḥ; sasvāretyādau vṛddhiviṣaye
pūrvavipratiṣedhaḥ | nanu ca paratvād guṇe'pi kṛte tasmin ṭhata
upadhāyāḥ' iti siddham ? satyam; parihārāntaraṃ tvidaṃ
draṣṭavyam---taparakaraṇaṃ nirdeśārtham | dīrghasya tu
ātastarurityādāvutarasūtreṇa guṇo bhavatyeva | na ca tasyā api
prāpteḥ saṃyogādiṣu taparakaraṇasāmarthyādvyāvṛttiḥ;
nirdeśārthatayā tasyopapateḥ |
saṃyogāderityādi | aṅgasyāsaṃyogāditvādvacanam | upadhāgrahaṇaṃ

śyateriti | vrata iti viṣayo nirddiśyate, notaraṃ padam; tena
saṃśito brāhmaṇa ityatrāpi nityamitvaṃ bhavati | saṃśita iti |
vrataviṣaye yatnavānucyate | saṃśitavrata iti | bahuvrīhiḥ |
samyaksampāditavrata ityarthaḥ | vratādanyatrāpītvaṃ bhavati, vrate tu
nityamiti, saṃśitaśabdasya sāmānyaśabdatvādaviruddho vrataśabdasya
prayogaḥ |
vyavasthitavibhāṣāvijñānātsiddhamiti | kvacinnityaṃ pravṛttiḥ,
kvacidvakalpena, kvacinnaiva pravṛttiḥ---ityevaṃ vividhamavasthitā
vibhāṣā vyavasthitavibhāṣā |
vyavasthitavibhāṣāṇāṃ diṅbhātraṃ ślokena darśayati---devatrāta iti |
ṭhkticktau ca saṃjñāyām' iti ktaḥ | ṭhnudavidondatrā' iti natvaṃ
saṃjñāyāṃ na bhavati | devagrahaṇasyopalakṣaṇatvād bhavatrāta ityādāvapi
saṃjñāyāṃ natvābhāvaḥ | kriyāśabde tu trātam, trāṇamityubhayaṃ bhavati
| gala iti | ṭhaci vibhāṣā' iti latvam, prāṇyaṅge nityaṃ bhavati,
giratyannamiti galaḥ, viṣetu naiva bhavati, gīryate śapathārthibhiriti
garaḥ; kriyāśabde tūbhayaṃ bhavati---garaḥ, gala iti | grāha iti |
ṭhvibhāṣā grahaḥ' iti ādityādiṣu pacādyajeva bhavati | grahaṇa iti
kriyāśabde tu pūrvavat | itiyoga iti | hantīti palāyate,

śatṛśānacau na bhavataḥ | mitha iti | ekasminviṣaye na vikalpyante,
kintu viṣayabhedena | etaccākṛtipakṣa upapadyate, tatra hi sarvaṃ
lakṣyajātaṃ yugapadabhisamīkṣya dvayamupadiśyate---bhāvo'bhāvaśca, tatra
tayorviṣayabhedena pravṛtāvapi samudāye dvayaṃ pravṛtaṃ bhavati |
asaṅkīrṇatvaṃ tu prayogavaśāt pratyetavyam | gavākṣa iti |
vātāyane ṭhavaṅ sphoṭāyanasya' iti nityamavaṅ bhavati, prāṇyaṅge
go'kṣamityatra na bhavati; anyatra vikalpaḥ--mavāgram, go'gramiti |
dadhāterhiḥ || 7|4|42 ||
yadyapi hinoterhita ityādi siddham, dadhātestu dhīta
ityādinivṛtaye sūtrārambhaḥ | śtipā nirdeśo dheṭo mā bhūditi |
ṭhdha' ityucyamāne dheṭo'pyanukaraṇaṃ sambhāvyeta, yathā---ṭhdādhā
ghvadāp' ityatra | yaṅluki tviṭi sati dādhita iti bhavati ||
jahāteśca ktvi || 7|4|43 ||
idamapi vacanaṃ jahānehatvini mā bhṛditi | śtipā nirddeśasya tu
prayojanaṃ vṛtāveva darśitam | yaṅluki jāhitveti bhavati ||
vibhāṣā cchandasi || 7|4|44 ||
pūrvasūtrārambhādayamārambhaḥ, anyathā hinotijahātyo rūpadvayaṃ
siddham | hātveti | chāndasatvādītvābhāvaḥ ||

iḍāgamo veti | yadā iḍāgamaḥ, tadā ṭhāto lopa iṭi ca'
ityākāralopaḥ | vasudhitamiti | karmadhārayaḥ | ktinyapi dṛśyate---uta

dhatsveti | ṭhśnābhyastayorātaḥ' ityākāralopaḥ, ṭhdadhastathośca' iti
bhaṣbhāvaḥ ||
do dad ghoḥ || 7|4|46 ||
dhīta iti | ghumāsthādisūtreṇetvam | gheṭa etadrapamiti | dadhātestu
ṭhdadhāterhiḥ' iti hirādeśo bhavati | dātamiti | ṭhdāp lavane' |
lūnamityarthaḥ | avadātamiti | ṭhdaip śodhane' | ayamādeśasthānta
iṣyata iti | kutaḥ ? ityāha---evaṃ hyuktamiti | yadyapi dakāraḥ śrūyate,
tathāpi saṃhitāyāṃ takārādīnāmapi jaśtve kṛte etasya rūpasya

sudatamityatra ṭhdasti' iti dīrghatvaṃ syāt; ṭhdā' ityatasya

prasajyeta | atha dhakārāntaḥ, ṭhjhaṣastathordho'dhaḥ' iti dhatvamāpadyeta |
thānte'doṣa iti | naño'tra praśleṣaḥ, ṭhtasmātthāntaḥ' iti nigamanāt
|
yadi tviti | ṭhdasti' ityatra dvau pakṣau---ṭhdā- ityetasya yastakārānta
ādeśaḥ, takārādirveti | tatra dvitīyapakṣe nāyaṃ doṣaḥ |
dāntadhāntayorapīti | takārādipratyayasannipātena bhavan dadbhāvo
na tadvighātasya nimitaṃ bhavati |
avadatamityādi | ādikarmaṇīti ityetatpradatamityetasya viśeṣaṇam,
netareṣām; asambhavāt | iti ceṣyata iti | cakāradyathāprāptaṃ ca,
tena avatam, vitam, pratamityādyapi bhavati |
anupasargā vā eta iti | kathamanupasargatvam ? ityata
āha---kriyāntaraviṣayā iti | avagataṃ datamiti gaminā'vādināṃ
yogaḥ, tataśca ṭhyatkriyāyuktāḥ prādayastaṃ prati gatyupasargasaṃjñā
bhavanti' iti dadātiṃ pratyanupasargatvam ||
aca upasargātaḥ || 7|4|47 ||
ta ityayamiti | takāre'kāra uccāraṇārthaḥ | pratamiti | tatrākārasya

āderalaḥ prāpnotīti | ṭhādeḥ parasya' iti vacanāt | aca
ityetadāvartata iti | yadvā---asyeti vartate, kva prakṛtam ?
ṭhasyacvau' iti, ṭhdodadghoḥ' ityayamapi dadbhāvo'varṇasya
prāpnoti, tataśca datamiti saṃyogādi śrūyate, evaṃ tarhyevaṃ

dvitakārakoveti | ṭhalo'ntyasya' ityetasya dvāvapavādau---ṭhādeḥ
parasya', ṭhanekālśitsarvasya' iti, tayorvipratiṣedhe paraḥ pravartate |
ṭhapo bhi' ityatrāpi tarhi sarvādeśaprasaṅgaḥ ? ata āha---apo
bhītyatreti | atra dvayostakārayorantyasya saṃyogāntalopaḥ, pūrvasya
jaśtvam | atra kecidāhuḥ---avaśyamatrāca ityanuvartyam, anyathā
lūñ ṭhṛdorap', lavābhyāmityatrāpi syāditi, tanna; lupte pakāre
nāpśabda iti nātra bhaviṣyati ||
bhūtapūrvagatiryuktā na sāmpratikasambhavaḥ |
na pratyayāpratyayayorityasyāpyatra sambhavaḥ ||
dvayoratulyakakṣatvātpratyaye'po na hi śrutaḥ |
apo bhi || 7|4|48 ||

iti sautro dhātuḥ, svantavo yeṣāṃ te svatavasaḥ | mādbhiriti |
ṭhpaddannomās' iti māsaśabdasya māsādeśaḥ | uṣadbhiriti |
ṭhmithune'siḥ', ṭhvaseḥ kiñca' ityasipratyayaḥ ||

ṭhluṅsanorghaslṛ' | āsse, vasse iti | ṭhāsa upaveśane', ṭhvaśe

vyativatsīṣṭetyatrāpi na syāt ||

ri ca || 7|4|51 ||

ha eti || 7|4|52 ||

apara āha---utamaikavacanam, sārvadhātukaṃ ceti; tena supto'haṃ
tvāṃ prekṣāmāse, utame'pyārdhadātuke na bhavatīti ||
yīvarṇayordīdhīvevyoḥ || 7|4|53 ||
yakāre ikāra uccāraṇārthaḥ | lopo bhavatīti |
hakārastvanantaro'pyasvaritatvānnānuvartate | ādīdhyeti | lyap |
ādīdhyaka iti | yak | ādīdhiteti | tṛc, iṭ | 
ādīdhyanamiti | lyuṭ, ṭhdīdhīvevīṭām' iti guṇapratiṣedhaḥ |
ihādīdhayatervul---ādīdhyaka iti | śrūyamāṇa eva ṇau ṇvul |
utpateḥ prāgeva prāpto'pi lopo na bhavati; varṇagrahaṇāt | kiṃ

katham ? ṭhvarṇa varmane' curādiḥ, varṇyate upalabhyata iti varṇaḥ,
varṇaścāsāviśceti viśeṣaṇasamāse viśeṣaṇasya nipātanāt
paranipātaḥ ||
sani mīmāghurabhalabhaśakapatapadāmaca is || 7|4|54 ||

minoterapi ṭhajjhanagamāṃ sani' iti dīrghe kṛte ṭhmī' iti

yadāha---iṣyata iti | ṭhmā māne', ṭhmāṅ māne', ṭhmeṅ

ghusaṃjñakā dādhā gṛhyante |ṭhrabha rābhasye', ṭhḍulabhaṣ prāptau', śaklṛ
śaktau', ṭhpallṛ gatau' | mitsatīti | ṭhsa syārdhadhātuke' iti

| āripsate ityādau ṭhskoḥ saṃyogādyoḥ' iti salopaḥ ||

ṭhmāraṇatoṣaṇaniśāmaneṣu jñā' ṭhmicca' iti mitsaṃjñāyām ṭhmitāṃ
hrasvaḥ' | ṭhṛdhu vṛddhau' | īrtsatīti | rapara īkāraḥ, dhakārasya cartvam
|
jñaperityādi | iha ṭhacaḥ' ityanuvartate, tena ca jñapau viśiṣyamāṇe
ajantasya jñaperitvaṃ, vidhīyamānam ṭhalo'ntyasya' ityantyasya syāt,
ajantasyeti ca viśeṣaṇaṃ vyartham; vyabhicārābhāvāt; tena
jñapinājviśeṣyate---jñaperaco yatra tatrasthasyeti,
yathā---ābṛdhibhyām | evaṃ caikaprakāro viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvo
bhavati, tatrānantye'ci sāvakāśamītvamantye'ci pūrvavipratiṣedhena
ṇilopo bādhate, tadidamuktam---ṇerlopa iti | itarasya tviti |
apara āha---astu ṇerapītvam, tasya sthānivadbhāvāṇṇilopo
bhaviṣyati, ītvavacanaṃ tvanantye śravaṇārthamiti |
ardidhiṣatīti | sani iṭi laghūpadhaguṇe rapare kṛte ṭhna ndrāḥ' iti
pratiṣedhād rephavarjitadvitīyasyaikāco dvirvacanam ||
dambha icca || 7|4|56 ||
dhipsati, dhīpsatīti | ṭhhalantācca' iti sanaḥ kitvādupadhālopaḥ,
bhakārasya cartvam | itvaṃ śakyamavidhātum; evaṃ
vakṣyāmi---ṭhsanimīmādīnāmaca is dambha īcca', cakārādisbhāvaśca,
tataḥ ṭhāpjñapyṛdhāmit' ityeva ||
muco'karmakasya guṇo vā || 7|4|57 ||
mumukṣata iti | ṭhbhūṣākarmakirādisanāṃ cānyatrātmanepadāt' iti
karmakartari yagabhāvaḥ | atideśena svaśrayasyānivṛteḥ kartari
śabbhavati; yathā---namate daṇḍaḥ svayameveti |
karmaviśeṣasyāvivakṣitatvādveti | uktaṃ hi---
ṭhprasiddheravivakṣātaḥ karmaṇo'karmikā kriyā |' iti ||
atra lopo'bhyāsasya || 7|4|58 ||
atraśabdasyārthaṃ darśayati---yadetaditi |
athātragrahaṇaṃ kimartham ? atra ṭhsanimīmā' ityādau prakaraṇe yathā
syād; dadau, dadātītyatra mā bhūditi | naitadasti prayojanam, evaṃ
vakṣyāmi---ṭhsani mīmāghurabhalabhaśakapatapadāmaca
isabhyāsalopaśca'---iti, utaratrāpi ṭhabhyasalopaśca' ityeva ?
tatrāha---sani mīmādhvityādi | viṣayāvadhāraṇamuviṣayarniyamaḥ | kaḥ
punarasau ? ityata āha---atraivetyādi | avadhāraṇasya vyavacchedyaṃ
darśayati---sanvadbhāvaviṣaye na bhavatīti | amīmapaditi | miño
ṇici ṭhmīnātiminoti' ityātvam, puka, luṅ, caṅ idvirvacanam,
sanvadbhāvāditvam, ṭhdīrgho laghoḥ' |
kathaṃ punaḥ sanītyucyamānasyābhyāsalopasyātra prasaṅgaḥ ? ityata
āha---sanvallaghunīti | yathaiva hi sanvadbhāvenetvaṃ bhavati,
tathābhyāsalopo'pi syāt, ṭhalo'ntyasya' lopena
bhavitavyamityāśaṅkāyāmāha---sarvasyeti | kathaṃ punaḥ sarvasya
labhyate ? ata āha---tadarthameveti | ṭhitarābhyo'pi dṛśyante' iti
ṣaṣṭha|lntātral | yo'yamabhyāsaḥ prasiddho'sya lopaḥ, na
tadantasyetyarthaḥ | viṣayāvadhāraṇaṃ tvanyathāpi siddham |
sanvallaghunīti na kāryamatidiśyate, kiṃ tarhi ? rūpam |
lopaścāsāvabhāvarūpo na rūpamiti nātidiśyate |
nānarthake'lontyavidhirityapare sarvasya kurvantīti |
ṭhanabhyāsavikāreṣu' iti tu pratiṣedho na bhavati;
lopasyāvikāratvāt | tathā ca
paspaśāyām---ṭhlopāgamavarṇavikārajñaḥ' iti pṛthaggrahaṇam, ṭhdvau
cāparau varṇavikāranāśau' iti ca pṛṣodarādisūtre |
anvayavyatirekābhyāmarthavatāvadhāryate, na cābhyāsasyopajanane
kaścidarthaḥ pratīyata ityabhyāsasyānarthakyam ||

halādiśeṣo na bhavatīti | na
cāgamavidhānasāmarthyāddhalādiśeṣābhāvaḥ, anyathā''deśamevākāraṃ
vidadhyāditi vācyam | satyapi vā halādiśeṣe
vigṛhītaśravaṇārthatvādākārasya---calācalamiti ||
karmadhāraye hi viśeṣaṇatvādādiśabdasya pūrvanipātaḥ prāpnoti |
ṣaṣṭhīsamāse halantarāpekṣaṃ hala āditvam, nābhyāsāpekṣamiti
ajādiṣvapi prasaṅgaḥ | ṭhakṣu vyāptau' liṭ, ānakṣa, atra kakārasya
śeṣaḥ prāpnoti | āṭaturityādāvapyādivadbhāvātprasaṅgaḥ |

anādirlupyate iti | halityapekṣyate, etenāsamāsapakṣo darśitaḥ |
samāse hyupasamastasyāpekṣāyogādanādirhaliti punarhalgrahaṇaṃ
kartavyam |
nanu śeṣo'vasthānaṃ tatvādeḥ prāptameva, tatkimetena ? ata
āha---ādiśeṣanimito'yamiti | satyam, ṭhsiddhe satyārambho
niyamārthaḥ', ādireva śiṣyate na tvanādiriti,
tataścādiśeṣanimito'yamanāderlopo vidhīyata iti
nāsyānarthakyamityarthaḥ | yadyādiśeṣo nimitamanādilopasya,
papācetyādau yatrāderhalo'vasthānaṃ tatraivānyasya nivṛttiḥ syāt,
āṭaturityādau tu na syādityata āha---tatreti | jātipakṣe
abhyāsajātāvevāderavasthānamapekṣitam, na prativyaktīti doṣābhāvaḥ
|
apare tviti | pūrvatra pakṣe'vasthānameva śabdārthaḥ,
niyamāśrayaṇāatvitaravyāvṛttiḥ; atra tu pakṣe nivṛttirapi
guṇabhūtaśeṣaśabdenaivocyate | tataḥ kim ? ityata
āha---tadavasthānamityādi | uktitaḥuśabdavyāpārataḥ |
avidheyatvātviti | ārthamaprādhānyaṃ darśayati | nivṛttistu
viparītetyāha--nivṛtereva tviti | loke'pi
ṭhcaṅkramyamāṇo'dhīṣvātra japaÄścamaṅkraṇaṃ kuru'
ityevamarthābhede'pi śabdodbhedaḥ pratīyate | tataḥ kim ? ityata
āha---tatreti | sāvidheyatvātpradānabhūtā satī nivṛttiḥ |
kimityāderanivṛttimapekṣiṣyate | kimbhūtām ? avidheyā satīm |
avidheyatvādapradhānabhūtāṃ satīmityarthaḥ | na pradhānaṃ guṇanuvarti,
tasmādapekṣākaraṇaṃ nāstītyarthaḥ |
bhāṣye parihārāntaram---ṭhhal' ityeko yogaḥ, ṭhatra lopaḥ' iti
vartate; sa ca karmasādhanaḥ, yathā ṭhhalṅyābbhyo dīrghāt' ityatra,

śeṣaḥ' iti saṃhitāpāṭha eva, tatrāhaliti padacchedaḥ---abhyāso'hal
bhavati, avidyamānahalko bhavati, tata ādiḥ śeṣa iti ||

pūrveṇa śarāṃ śeṣe prāpte khayāṃ śeṣo vidhīyate,
natraikābhyāsaviṣayeṇānādiśeṣeṇādiśeṣo bādhyate; satyapi sambhave
bādhanaṃ bhavatīti nyāyāt | kiñcāsambhavo'pyatra śakyate vaktum,
katham ? śeṣaśabdo'yaṃ nivṛttimadavasthānamāha, na cobayoravasthāne

ṭhścyutir kṣaraṇo' | pispandiṣata iti | ṭhspadi kiñciccalane',

kharpūrvā iti | sūtre śargrahaṇamapanīya khargrahaṇaṃ kartavyamityarthaḥ |
ucicchiṣatīti | ṭhucchī vivāse'| antaraṅgatvāditi |

iti, yena cutvaṃ nivartate ||
kuhoścuḥ || 7|4|62 ||
cakhāneti | khakārasya cchakāraḥ, tasya ṭhabhyāse carcca' iti cakāraḥ |
jaghāseti | ghakārasya jhakāraḥ, tasya jaśtavam---jakāraḥ |
jihīrṣatīti | ṭhiko jhal' iti sanaḥ kitvam, hakārasyāpi jhakāraḥ,
tasya jaśtvam ||
na kavateryaiṅ || 7|4|63 ||
kavaterityādi | ṭhkūṅ śabde' iti tudādiḥ, ṭhku śabde' ityadādiḥ,
ṭhkuṅ khuṅ' iti bhūvādiḥ śabdārtha eva | tatrāsati vikaraṇanirdeśe
ṭhkoḥ' ityacyamāne trayāṇamapi grahaṇaṃ syād | atha taudādiko
dīrghāntaḥ ? evamapi dvayorgrahaṇaṃ syāt | na ca
niranubandhakatvādādādikasyaiva grahaṇam; lugvikaraṇatvāt |
tasmādbhauvādikasyaiva yathā syāditi vikaraṇanirddeśaḥ
||
dādhartidarghartidargharṣibobhūtutetikte'larṣyāpanīphaṇatsaṃsaniṣyadatkarikratkanikradadbharibhraddavidhyatodavidyautataritrataḥ sarīsṛpataṃvarīvṛjanmarmṛjyāganīgantīti ca || 7|4|65 ||
dhārayateriti | ṭhghṛṅ avasthāne' ṇyantaḥ | dhṛṅe veti | sa eva
prakṛtyantaram | ślau yaṅlukiceti | ṭhślau' ityetaddhārayateḥ,
dhṛṅe vetyubhābhyāṃ sambadhyate | ṭhyaṅluki ca' ityetatu ṭhdhṛṅe vā'
ityanenaiva | tadayamarthaḥ---dādhartīti dhārayateḥ ślau
ṇilugabhyāsadīrghatvaṃ ca nipātyate, dhṛṅe vā ślāvabhyāsadīrghatvam
| atra parasmaipadamapi nipātyam, tasyaiva vā yaṅluki
abhyāsadīrghatvaṃ nipātyata iti | dardhartītyatra tu yaṅluk | pakṣe
dādhartīti | nipātanena prāptasya dīrghatvasyābhāvo nipātyate,
ṭhrugrikau ca luki' ityeva ruk siddhaḥ | ślupakṣe tu rugapi nipātyaḥ |
dardharṣītyatra yaṅluk, pakṣe na kiñcinnipātyam |
bobhūtviti | yaṅlugantālloṭ | bobhavītīti | laṭ, ṭhyaho vā'
iti pakṣe īṭ | 
pratyayalakṣaṇeneti | yadyapi ṭhanudātaṅtiḥ' iti
ṅtvinimitamātmanepadaṃ na pratyanimitam; tathāpi lolūyate
ityādau yaṅntādātmanepadam, tatpratyayasya ṅtvāiditi pratyayalakṣaṇaṃ
bhavatyeva | evaṃ cādādiṣu ṭhcarkarītaṃ parasmaipadam' iti
parasmaipadagrahaṇamanuvādaḥ | kartaryeva cedamātmanepadaṃ niyamyate iti
bhāvakarmaṇoryaṅlugantādātmanepadaṃ bhavatyeva |
karikraditi | atra cutvābhāva eva nipātyaḥ, rigāgamastu ṭhrugrikau ca'
ityeva siddhaḥ | tathā cāsyeti | asaṃya mantrapadasya brāhmaṇe vivaraṇam |
bharibhraditi | atrāpi jaśtvābhāva eva nipātyaḥ | jasi rūpamiti |
ṭhnābhyastācchatuḥ' iti numaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ ||
urat || 7|4|66 ||
vavṛte ityādau halādiśeṣe kṛte
ṛkārāntatāyāmupajātāyāmadbhāvaḥ, raparatve punaḥ ṭhhalādiḥ
śeṣaḥ' |
narnartītyādau rugādiṣu kṛteṣu ṛkārāntatvābhāvādatvaṃ na
syādityāśaṅkyāha---narnartītyādāviti | yathā cābhyāsavikāreṣu
bādhakā na bādhante, tathā ṭhdīrgho'kitaḥ' ityatraiva vakṣyate ||
dyautisvāpyoḥ samprasāraṇam || 7|4|67 ||
vididyaute iti | ṭhdyauta dīptau' anudātet | vyadidyautaditi |
ṇyantālluṅ, caṅ idvirvacanam | vididyotiṣate, vididyautiṣata iti
| ṭhralo vyapadhāt' iti sanaḥ kitvavikalpaḥ |
svāpirṇyanto gṛhyata iti | svaperyo ṇijvihitastadantasya grahaṇam,
tena svāpaṃ karotīti ṇici kṛte yaḥ svāpistasya grahaṇaṃ na bhavati |
etacca ṭhsvāpi' ityukte sahasā prathamaṃ tasyaiva pratīterlabhyate |
aṇyantasyaiva yo'bhyāsastasyānenaiva samprasāraṇaṃ siddham | tathā
hi---liṭi tāvatkiti ṭhvacasvapiyajādīnāṃ kiti' iti
kṛtasamprasāraṇameva drirucyate, akityapi ṭhliṭa|lbhyāsasyobhayeṣām'
ityasti samprasāraṇam, sannipi ṭhrudavidamuṣagrahisvapi' iti kideva,
yaṅyapi ṭhsvapisyamivyeñāṃ yaṅ' īti kṛtasamprasāraṇameva dvirucyate
| athāpi yaṅlukyabhyāsasya samprasāraṇaṃ na kenacitprāptam, tathāpi
ṭhsvāpe' iti nirddeśādeva ṇyantasya grahaṇam | tasyetyādi |
abhyāsenātra svanimitaṃ pratyayaḥ sannidhāpitaḥ, tena svāpiraṅgaṃ
viśeṣyate---abhyāsanimite pratyaye yadaṅgaṃ svāpistasyeti |
sisvāpakī yiṣatītyatra cābhyāsanimitaṃ yaḥ pratyayaḥ san na
tasminsvāpiraṅgam, yasmiṃśca svāpiraṅgaṃ ṇvuli na tadabhyāsasya
nimitam | dyautestu---vyadidyautaditi, atrābhyāsasya nimitaṃ yaścaṅ
sa yadyapi ṇicā vyavahitaḥ, tathāpi samprasāraṇamiṣyate |
dvandvanirddiṣṭayoretadvaiṣamyaṃ labhyate katham ?
tasmādvaktavyamevaitaditi manyāmeha vayam ||
dyotakīyateḥ sani abhyāsasya prasāraṇaṃ bhavati, na veti cintyam |
vyatho liṭi || 7|4|68 ||
vivyathe iti | ṭhvyatha bhayacalanayoḥ', anudātet | atra yakāre
halādiśeṣeṇa nivṛte vakārasya prasāraṇaprasaṅga
ityāśaṅkyāha---yakārasyeti |
iha ṭhliṭa|lbhyāsasyobhayeṣām' ityasyanantaram ṭhvyathaḥ' iti vaktavyam,
tataḥ ṭhdyautisvāpyoḥ ? tathā tu na kṛtamityeva ||
dīrgha iṇaḥ kiti || 7|4|69 ||
yaṇādeśe kṛta iti | paratvāt | sthānivadbhāvāditi |
ṭhdvirvacane'ci' iti rūpasthānidbhāvaḥ | iyāya, iyayitheti | ṇali
thali ca vṛddhiguṇayoḥ kṛtayoḥ sthānivadbhāvād dvirvacanam,
ṭhabhyāsasyāsavarṇe' itīyaṅ ||
ata ādeḥ || 7|4|70 ||
ṭhādeḥ' iti vacanādatra tadantavidhirna bhavati, liṭītyanuvartate,
kidgrahaṇaṃ tu nivṛtam | ṭhato guṇe' pararūpatve prāpte
dīrghatvamidamārabhyate | taparakaraṇaṃ kim ? dīrghasya mā
bhūt---ṭhācchi āyāme', āccha, āñcchatuḥ, āñchuḥ | kiṃ ca syāt, yadyatra
dīrghaḥ syāt ? ṭhtasmānnuḍ dvahalaḥ' iti nuṭ prasajyeta |
yadyapyatrāpi hrasvatve kṛte adbhavati, tathāpi taparakaraṇasāmarthyād
ṭhadeva yo't' iti vijñānāt svābhāvikasya mātrikasya parigrahaḥ ||
tasmānnuḍ dvihalaḥ || 7|4|71 ||
ānaṅgeti | ṭhagi ragi laghi gatyarthāḥ' | ānañjeti | ṭhāñjū
vyaktimrakṣaṇakāntigatiṣu' | dvihalgrahaṇamanekahalupalakṣaṇ,
tenānarcheatyatra guṇe rapare kṛte trihalo'pi bhavati |
ṭhaiauc' ityatra ṭhvarṇeṣu ye varṇaikadeśā varṇāntarasamānākṛtayasteṣu
tatkāryaṃ na bhavati ityuktvā ṭhnuḍvidhilādeśavināmeṣu ṛkāre
pratividhātavyam' ityuktam, tatrāvasare prāpte nuḍvidhau
pratividhate---ṛkāraikadesa ityādi |
atra dvihalgrahaṇaṃ na kartavyam, ṭhtasmānnuṭ' ityevāstu;
evamucyamāne āṭatuḥ, āṭuarityatrāpi prāpnoti ? ṭhaśnoteśca'
ityetanniyamārthaṃ bhaviṣyati---advihalo yadi bhavati aśnotereveti;
aśnātinivṛtyarthaṃ nāśna ityevaṃ vācyaṃ syāt, tadevamantareṇāpi
dvihalgrahaṇaṃ siddhe yad dvihalgrahaṇaṃ karoti tasyaitadeva
prayojanam---dvihalchāyānukāriṇo'pi yathā syāditi ||
bhavateraḥ || 7|4|73 ||
ṭhurat' ityasyānantaramidaṃ noktaṃ liṭītyupajīvanāya | yadi
punastadatraivocyeta ? naivaṃ śakyam; liṭa|leva hi syāt | śtipā
nirddeśo yaṅlugnivṛtyarthaḥ ||
sasūveti nigame || 7|4|74 ||
dādhartyādiṣvevaitatpaṭhitavyam ||
ṇijāṃ trayāṇāṃ guṇaḥ ślau || 7|4|75 ||
nijiri, vijira, viṣlṛ vyāptau juhotyādiṣvamī trayaḥ |
trayāṇāṃ grahaṇamutarārthamiti | ṭhbhṛñāmit' itītvaṃ trayāṇāmeva yatā
syāt | athehārthamapi kasmānna bhavati ? tatrāha---eṣāṃ hīti | yadi
tarhyutarārthaṃ trigrahaṇaṃ kartavyam, tadevāstu, vṛtkaraṇaṃ tu
nijāmante śakyamakartum ? satyam; tadapi kṛtamityeva |
guṇagrahaṇamikparibhāṣopasthānārtham, tena halādiśeṣe kṛte guṇo
bhavati; anyathā tadapavādo hala eva ekāraḥ syāt | atha
ṭhabhyāsavikāreṣvapavādo notsargān bādhate' ityāśrīyeta ? tadā
vispaṣṭārthaṃ guṇagrahaṇam ||
bhṛñāmit || 7|4|76 ||
amī api juhotyādau bhṛñ, māṅ, ohāṅ---bhṛñādayaḥ | mimīta
iti | ṭhī halyaghoḥ' ||
artipipartyośca || 7|4|77 ||
iyartīti | ṭhṛ sṛ gatau', ṭhpṛ pālanapūraṇayoḥ' abhyāsasyāsavarṇe,
itīyaṅ | acchando'rthamidam; cchandasyutarasūtreṇaiva siddhatvāt ||
sanyataḥ || 7|4|79 ||
yiyakṣatīti | yajerbraścādinā ṣatvam, ṭhpaḍhoḥ kaḥ si' |
taparakaraṇaṃ kim ? pāpacyateḥ san, pāpaciṣate ityatra mā bhūt |
kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇamatra hrasvo na bhavati ? dīrghavidhānasāmarthyāt | yadi
tu ṭhsani yo'bhyāsaḥ' ityevaṃ vijñāyate, tato lāghave
viśeṣābhāvātaparakaraṇam ||
oḥ puyaṇjyapare || 7|4|80 ||
puyaṇājakārāṇāṃ samāhāradvandve saptamyekavacanam | puyaṇji
ṭhdvandvāccudaṣahāntātsamāhāre' iti samāsāntastvanityatvānna bhavati,
aḥ paro yasmātpuyaṇjastadaparam, avarṇaparamityarthaḥ | pipaviṣata
iti | ṭhpṛṅ pavane', ṭhsmipūṅrañjvaśāṃ sani'
itīdguṇāvādeśau, tayoḥ ṭhdvirvacane'ci' iti sthānivadbhāvāt
ṭhpū' iti dvirucyate | pipāvayiṣatīti | tata eva ṇyantātsan |
vibhāvayiṣatīti | bhavaterṇyantātsan | yiyaviṣatīti | ṭhyu
miśraṇe', ṭhsanīvantardhe' itīṭ | yiyāvayiṣatīti | tasmādeva
ṇyantātsan | rirāvayiṣati, lilāvayiṣatīti | rautilunātibhyāṃ
ṇyantābhyāmeva san | jijāvayiṣatīti | ṭhju' iti sautro dhātuḥ
ṭhjucaṅkramya' ityādau nirdiṣṭaḥ |
kathaṃ punarṇyanteṣu sanyuvarṇāntābhyāsasya, yāvatā ṇau
vṛddhyāvādeśayoḥ kṛtayorākārāntasya dvirvacanena bhavitavyam,
na hi ṇau kṛtasya kenacitsthānivadbhāvo vihitaḥ,
ṇeradvirvacananimitatvāt ? ityata āha---etadeveti | na hi ṇau
kṛtasya sthānivadbhāvamantareṇa puyaṇjo'varṇaparāḥ sambhavanti |
pipaciṣati, yiyaviṣate iti sambhavanīti cet ? kimetāvatā !
vargagrahaṇaṃ pratyāhāragrahaṇaṃ jagrahaṇaṃ cārthavadbhavati | tasmādetadeva
vacanamuktasyārthasya mṛvakamiti | yaccātra vaktavyaṃ tad ṭhdvirvacane'ci'
ityatroktam, tata evāvadhāryam |
pāpaciṣata iti | ṭhsani yo'bhyāsaḥ' ityetadanāśrityedaṃ
pratyudāharaṇam | tadāśraye tu pratyudāharaṇāntaraṃ mṛgyaṃ yadi
sambhavati | avatutāvayiṣatīti | ṭhtu' iti sautro dhātuḥ
ṭhturustuśamyamaḥ' ityatra nirdiṣṭaḥ | juhāvayiṣatīti |
juhoterṇyantātsan ||
sravatiśrṛṇotidravatipravatiplavaticyavatīnāṃ vā || 7|4|81 ||
ṭhśru śravaṇe', anye gatyarthāḥ | udāharaṇeṣu ṇyantebhyaḥ san |
kathaṃ punaryaṇi parata ucyamānamitvaṃ sakārādīnāṃ varṇena vyavadhāne
bhavati ? tatrāha--vacanasāmarthyāditi | pūrvasūtre ityādinā
aprāptavibhāṣeyamiti darsayati ||
guṇo yaṅlukoḥ || 7|4|82 ||
lukśabdenātra yaṅlugeva gṛhyate; sannidhānāt |
kiñca---abhyāsasyāyaṃ guṇo vidhīyate, na ca lugantare'bhyāsaḥ
sambhavati | cokruśītiti | kruśeryaṅlugantātip, ṭhyaṅe vā'
itīṭ, ṭhnābhyastasyāci piti' iti laghūpadhaguṇapratiṣedhaḥ ||
dīrgho'kitaḥ || 7|4|83 ||
apavādatvāditi | nāprāpte dīrghe nuka ārambhāvadapavādatvam |
anajantatvādeveti | dīrghaśrutyā ṭhacaśca'
ityupasthānādabhyāsaviśeṣaṇādajantasyābhyāsasya dīrgho vidhīyata iti
bhāvaḥ | abhyāsavikāreṣvityādi | apavādagrahaṇaṃ
bādhakamātropalakṣaṇam, utsargagrahaṇamapi bādhyamātropalakṣaṇam | tatra
hrasvatvasyāvakāśaḥ---yayāvityatra, dīrghatvasyāvakāśaḥ---pāpacyata
ityādi; ḍoḍhaukyata ityādāvubhayaprasaṅge paratvāddīrghatvasyaḥ
prasaṅgaḥ, nāpavādatvāt | tathā
sanvadbhāvasyāvakāśaḥ---acikṣaṇaditi,
dīrghatvasyāvakrāśaḥ---adīdipaditi; acīkaradityādāvubhayaprasaṅge
paratvāddīrghatvaprasaṅgaḥ | mīmāṃsate
ityatrāpyanaimitikatvenāntaraṅgatvāddīrghatvaprasaṅgaḥ, itvaṃ tu sani
parato'ṅgādhikāre'bhyāsasyākārāntasya vidhānādvahiraṅgam |
ajīgaṇadityatra tvekasmin yenanāprāptinyāyena
halādiśeṣasyetvamapavādatvād bādhakaṃ prāpnoti | iha tu
apacacchatuḥ, apacacchuḥ, cacchadatuḥ, cacchaduḥ, cicchādayiṣati,
cicchardayiṣati, cecchidyate---iti paratvāt hrasvatvātvetvaguṇeṣu
kṛteṣu paścātuk, kriyate; tenaitanna nodanīyam---tuki kṛte
eta vidhayo na prāpnuvantīti | ṭhohāk tyāge' ityasya
dhātorniṣedho na bhavati, dhāturhyayaṃ kit, na tvabhyāsaḥ | kakārastu
ṭhhaśca vrīhikālayoḥ' ityatra hāṅhākīḥ sāmānyena grahaṇārthaḥ ||
nīgvañcusraṃsudhvaṃsubhraṃsukasapatapadaskandām || 7|4|84 ||
vañcukasipatipadayo gatyarthāḥ | ṭhskandiḥ śoṣaṇārthaḥ', itare
avasraṃsanārthāḥ | vanīvacyate ityādau ṭhaniditām' ityupadhālopaḥ |
vanīvañcītītyādau na bhavati yaṅe lumatā
luptatvādīkāroccāraṇasāmarthyānnīki kṛte guṇahrasvau na bhavataḥ ||
nugato'nunāsikāntasya || 7|4|85 ||
nugityetadityādi | kena sambandhenopalakṣaṇam ? ata āha---sthāninā
hīti | upalakṣaṇatve kiṃ siddham ? ata āha---teneti |
ajhalparatve'pīti | tantanyata ityādau jhalparatve tu ṭhnaścāpadāntasya
jhali' ityanusvāraḥ siddha eva |
ṭhanusvārasya yayi parasavarṇaḥ' iti nityaṃ parasavarṇaḥ prāpnoti,
iṣyate ca pakṣe anusvārasya śravaṇam ? ata āha---padāntavacceti |
tatkathaṃ labhyate ? ihāntagrahaṇaṃ na kartavyaṃ tadantavidhinā siddham ?
tatkriyate---padāntasyānusvārasya yo dharmaḥ so'sya yathā syāditi |
evaṃ ca---anunāsikāntasyeti pṛthak pade, anunāsiketi
luptaṣaṣṭhīkam |
tetimyata iti | ṭhtima ārdrībhāve' |
taparakaraṇaṃ kimiti | sarvatra hlakvasyaiva bhāvānnāsya
kiñcidvyāvartyamiti praśnaḥ | bhūtapūrvasyāpīti | anyathā
taparakaraṇamanarthakaṃ syāditi bhāvaḥ | bābhamyata iti | ṭhbhāma krodhe ||
japajabhadahadaśabhanjapaśāṃ ca || 7|4|86 ||
ṭhjapa jalpa vyaktāyāṃ vāci', ṭhjabha jṛbhī gātravināme', ṭhdaha
bhasmīkaraṇe', ṭhdanśa daśane', ṭhbhanjo āmardane', ṭhpaśa' iti sautro
dhātuḥ | jañjapyata ityādicaturṣu ṭhlupasada' ityādinā yaṅ, itaratra
sāmānyalakṣaṇena ||
caraphalośca || 7|4|87 ||
caratirbhakṣaṇārthaḥ | ṭhñiphalā viśaraṇe', phala niṣpatau'---dvayorapi
grahaṇamiṣyate | cañcūryata iti | ṭhlupasada' ityādinā yaṅ |
utarasūtreṇā kārasyotve ṭhhali ca' iti dīrghatvam | yogavibhāga
utarārthaḥ ||
utparasyātaḥ || 7|4|88 ||
abhyāsasya mā bhūditi | anyathā prakaraṇātasyeva prasaṅgaḥ | 
antyasya mā bhūditi | ṭhādeḥ parasya' ityasya tvaprasaṅgaḥ;
pañcamīnirddeśābhāvāt |
taparakaraṇaṃ kimiti | yadyapi bhāvyamāno'pyukāraḥ |
savarṇāngṛhṇāti, tathā pyāntaryato mātrikasya mātrika eva siddha iti
praśnaḥ | laghūpadhaguṇanivṛtyarthamiti | anena lakṣaṇena dīrghasya
prāptyabhāvāllakṣaṇāntaraprāpte'pi vikārastaparakaraṇasāmarthyādvāryata
iti bhāvaḥ | yathaiva tarhi guṇo nivartate, tathā ṭhhali ca' iti
dīrghatvamapi nivarteta ? ata āha---dīrghatve hīti ||
ti ca || 7|4|89 ||
vacanasāmarthyāditi | yaṅluki pūrveṇaiva siddhatvāt ||
rīgṛdhupadhasyaca || 7|4|90 ||
ṛtvata iti | yeṅ pirato ya ṛkāravān tasyaiva grahaṇam, na
tūpadeśe ṛtvataḥ | tena parīpṛcchayata ityādau samprasāraṇe
kṛte'pi bhavati ||
rugrikau ca luki || 7|4|91 ||
marmṛjyata iti | luki vidhīyamāno rugyaṅ ni prāpnotīti vacanam
||
ṛtaśca || 7|4|92 ||
kiratimiti | ṛkārāntopalakṣaṇametat | ṭhcarkarītam' iti
yaṅlukaḥ pūrvācāryasaṃjñā | pacatīti | laṭa upalakṣaṇam, tena
cākartītyādīni rūpāṇi, kirateryo nayedityarthaḥ | yadvā---atra
yaṅluki kiratiṃ pacatīti yo nayetupacatinā tulyarūpāṇi yo
nayet, pacativad rugādikamakṛtvā nayedityarthaḥ | prāptijñamiti |
rugādīnāṃ viṣayavibhāgena yā prāptistāṃ jānātīti prāptijñaḥ |
prārabdha iti | saṃgrahaṇaṃ saṃgrahaḥ, sādhuśabdasaṃgrahastena prārabdha iti
yogyatātiśayodbhāvanenāyaṃ stūyate |
tatra prāpatijñamityatra prāptiṃ vyācaṣṭe---tatreyaṃ prāptiriti |
taparakaraṇasāmarthyāditi | abhyāsaviśeṣaṇe tu
bhūtapūrvadīrghanivṛtyarthaṃ taparakaraṇamiti vyākhyeyam | na hi
mukhyanivartyasambhave gauṇakalpanā nyānyeti aṅgaviśeṣaṇamṛta
ityāśrita mityarthaḥ ||
sanvallaghuni caṅpare'naglope || 7|4|93 ||
