ṭhlaghuni caṅpare' iti vyadhikaraṇe saptamyau, na sāmānādhikaraṇe;
caṅparasya laghuno'sambhavāt | caṅpare ṇau parata iti | kṛthaṃ
punarṇāviti labhyate ? caṅparasyānyasyāsambhavāt | nanu
cācakamatetyatra makāraḥ | sambhavati, adudruvad, asusravadityatra
vakāraḥ ? evaṃ tarhi ṭhcaṅpare' ityaṅgasya viśeṣaṇam---caṅpare
yadaṅgaṃ tasya yo'bhyāsastasya sanvatkāryaṃ bhavati | laghuni dhātvakṣara
iti | caṅpare ṇau yadaṅgaṃ tasya sambandhi yallaghvityarthaḥ |
sāmarthyāṇṇyantasya grahaṇamite | ṇeḥ samīpabhūtasyāṅgasya
grahaṇamityarthaḥ | ṇyantasyāvayavabhūtaṃ yadaṅgaṃ tasya grahaṇamiti vā |
anaglopa iti | nāsminnaglopo vidyata iti anaglopaḥ | etacca
ṭhcaṅpare' ityanena samānādhikaraṇam | tenāyamarthaḥ---caṅpare
ṇāvako lope'satīti | atatakṣadityatra saṃyogaparatvād gurusaṃjñayā
laghusaṃjñāyā bādhaḥ, ajajāgaradityatra ākāraḥ | paraḥ |
atra kecidityādi | nanu ca gakāro jāśabdena vyavahitaḥ ? ata
āha---sarvatraiveti | acīkaradityādāvapi kakārādinā
vyavadhānāllaghorānantaryaṃ nāsti, tataśca vacanaprāmāṇyādvyavadhāna
eva sanvadbhāvena bhavitavyamiti teṣāmabhiprāya ityarthaḥ |
dūṣayati---tadasaditi ||
yadi tahi varṇasaṅghātena vyavadhānaṃ nāśrīyate
vyañjanasaṅghātenāpi vyavadhāne na sidhyatīti manyamānaḥ
pṛcchati---kathamiti | evañjātīyakānāmiti |
saṃyogavyavahitānāmityarthaḥ |
acakamateti | ṭhkamerupasaṃkhyānam' iti cleścaṅadeśaḥ | acakathaditi
| ṭhkatha vākyaprabandhe' curādāvadantaḥ, ṭhato lopaḥ' | atrāllopasya
sthānivadbhāve sati vyavadhānānna bhaviṣyati, ataḥ
pratyudāharaṇāntaropanyāsaḥ | adadṛṣaditi | ṭhtadācaṣṭe' iti ṇica
iṣṭhavadbhāvena ṭilopaḥ | atrājjhalorlopaḥ, nāca eva kevalasyeti
nāsti sthānivadbhāvaḥ | etadarthaṃ ca ṭhanaglope'
ityetatkriyamāṇamacakathadityatra sanvadbhvāvaṃ nivartayatīti
tasyopanyāsaḥ |
yadi caṅpare ṇau yadaṅgaṃ tasya yallaghu tatra parato'bhyāsasya
sanvadbhāvo vidhīyate, vāditavantaṃ prayojitavānavīvadadityatrāpi
tarhi na prāpnoti, kiṃ kāraṇam ? yaścaṅparo ṇirna tatra laghuḥ;
pūrveṇa ṇicā vyavahitatvāt | lope kṛte nāsti vyavadhānam |
ajādeśaḥ pūrvavidhau sthānivad bhavatīti
sthānivadbhāvādvyavadhānameva | yadyapi dīrghavidhiṃ prati
sthānivadbhāvo nipiddhaḥ, sanvadbhāve tu prāpnoti | yasmiṃśca ṇau
laghurnāsau caṅparaḥ; dvitīyena ṇicā vyavahitatvāt | bhavatu vā
sthānivatvaniṣedhaḥ, aglopitvānna prāpnoti | vṛddhau kṛtāyāṃ
ṇelepiḥ, tannāglopyaṅgaṃ bhavati | aglopi vāstu, prāgeva
vṛddherṇilope kṛte ? tatrāpi parihāramāha---yo'sau ṇau ṇerlopa
ityādi | tato'nyo'glopa iti anyākāro'nya uktaḥ | jātyāśrayaṇe hi
gobalīvardanyāyena ṇijāteniṃmitatvena parigṛhītāyā anyasyāko
lopaḥ pratiṣedhaviṣayaḥ parigṛhyate, na tu tasyā ṇijāteḥ; tataścāsya
lopasyāglopatvenānāśrayaṇāatenāglopyaṅgaṃ na bhavatīti
bhavatyevātra sanvadbhāvaḥ | mīmādīnāmatra grahaṇāditi | tatra hyaca iti
ṭhabhyāsalopaśca' ityeva siddhe'tragrahaṇaṃ viṣayāvadhāraṇārtham | atra
mukhye sanyeva bhavati, na sanvadbhāvaviṣaya iti |
kiñcetyādi | anenedamāha---na kevalaṃ mukhyasanparigrahamātramatra
kāraṇam, kiṃ tarhi ? hasbhāvadyapi viṣayatvena nirdiśyate | iha ca
dhātoḥ sanvadbhāvādisbhāvādi na bhavati, tataścābhyāsalopo'pi
na bhavatīti | yadvā---sakārādau sanyabhyāsalopo vihitaḥ, na
sanmātre, tataśca sāmānyātideśe viśeṣānatideśāt lopābhāvaḥ ||
dīrgho laghoḥ || 7|4|94 ||
abribhrajaditi | ṭhbhrājabhāsa' ityādinā pakṣe upadhāhrasvanipedhaḥ ||
utsmṛdṛtvāraprathamradastṛspaśām || 7|4|95 ||
taparakaraṇasārthyāditi | sthānino hrasvatvād bhāvyamānatvena
savarṇagrahaṇācca nānena dīrghasya prasaṅgaḥ, ato lakṣaṇāntareṇa prāptaṃ
dīrghatvaṃ taparakaraṇena vyāvartyate ||
ī ca gaṇaḥ || 7|4|97 ||
ṭhgaṇa saṃkhyāne' curādāvadantaḥ, tasyāto lopenānaglopa iti
pratiṣedhādvacanam | kṛtayorhalādiśepadīrghatvayorītvamatvaṃ ca
vidhīyate |
ṭhlopaḥ pibateḥ' ityetadatraiva paṭhitavyam---pibaterālopaśceti,
cakārāt ī cābhyāsasya ? satyam; vibhāṣetyasyānuvṛttiḥ śaṅkyeta
||
iti śrīharadatamiśraviracitāyāṃ padamañcaryā saptamasyādhyāyasya
turīyaścaraṇaḥkāśikāvṛttiḥ --- 6
sarvasya dve || 8|1|1 ||
ṭhnityavīpsayoḥ' ityevamādīnāṃ vidheyakāryiṇoranirdeśena
sākāṅkṣatvātsvaritatvāccādhikāro'yam, tadāha---savasyeti dve
iti ceti | ṭhsarvasya' ityukte yatpratīyate, ṭhdve' it cetyukte
yatpratīyate, etadarthasvarūpamityarthaḥ | yadyapi ṭhsvaṃ rūpam' iti
vacanādubhayorapi svarūpagrahaṇaṃ yuktam, tathāpi ṭhnāmreḍitasyāntyasya
tu vā', ṭhnityamāmreḍite ḍāci' iti dvirukte'cchabdasya
satāmaṅgīkṛtya kāryavidhānātadabhāvaḥ | na hi dvayoranyatarasya vā
svarūpagrahaṇe dvirukte'cchabdasya sambhavaḥ, tathā ṭhtasya paramāmreḍitam'
iti pūrvaparābhāvādanupapannaṃ syāt | tasmādarthagrahaṇam |
sarvaśabdaścāyaṃ dravyaprakārāvayavakārtsnyavṛttiḥ, dravyakārtsnye
yathā---sarvasvaṃ dadātīti, yacca yāvacca svaṃ tatsarvaṃ dadātīti
gamyate | prakārakārtsnye yathā---sarvānnīno bhikṣuriti,
sarvaprakārakamannaṃ bhakṣayatīti gamyate | avayavakārtsnye yathā---sarvaḥ
paṭo dagdha itiḥ, sarvāvayavaḥ paṭo dagdha iti gamyate | iha tu
paryādīnāṃ viśiṣṭārthānāṃ śabdānāmupādānād
dravyaprakārakārtsnyayorasambhavaḥ | yatrāpi kiñcinnopādīyate
ṭhnityavīpsayoḥ' iti, tatrāpi viśeṣānupādaanādeva sarvasya
śabdasya siddham | tasmādavayavakārtsnyavṛttirgṛhyate | pareḥ sarvasya
dve bhavataḥ, na kaścidavayo dvirvacanena varjyata ityarthaḥ |
atra ṭhā daśabhyaḥ saṃkhyāḥ saṃkhyeye vartante' iti ṭhdve' ityasya
saṃkhyeyāpekṣāyāṃ śabdānuśāsanaprastāvācchabdarūpe saṃkhyeye ṭhṣaṣṭhī
sthāneyogā' iti vacanātsarvasyeti sthānaṣaṣṭhī, sarvasya paryādeḥ
sthāne dve śabdarūpe bhavata ityarthaḥ, yathā---ṭhasterbhūḥ' iti, tadā
ṭhsthāne dvirvacanam' ityayaṃ pakṣo bhavati | śabdasambandhini tūccāraṇe
saṃkhyeye sthānyādeśabhāvo na sambhavati, nivṛttidharmā hi sthānī
śabdaścennivṛta kasyoccāraṇaṃ syāt |
ato'dhyāhṛtoccāraṇaśabdāpekṣayā ṭhkartṛkarmaṇoḥ kṛti' iti
sarvasyeti karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī, sarvasya paryāderdvea uccāraṇe bhavataḥ, sarvaḥ
paryādidviruccāraṇīya ityarthaḥ, tadā ṭhdviḥ prayogo dvirvacanam'
ityeṣa pakṣo bhavati |
tatra prathamaṃ pakṣaṃma darśayati---sarvasya sthāne dve bhavata iti | ke dve
iti | viśeṣānupādānādye kecana dve prāpnuta iti praśnaḥ |
itaro'pyantaratamaparibhāṣāmāśrityāha---śabdataśceti |
bibhītakādivācināmakṣādiśabdānāṃ śabdata evāntaryam,
tarupādapādīnāmaryata eva, dvayostu pacatiśabdayorubhayathāntaryam;
tatra te eva yathā syātāmityubhayagrahaṇam | te evobhayathāntaratame
darśayati---ekasyeti |
nanu cārimanpakṣa rājārājā, vākvāk, liṭliṭ,
godhuggodhuk, śabdaprāṭśabdaprāṭ, upānadupānat,
gaurgaurityatra nalopa-kutvā-ḍhatva-ghatva-ṣatva-dhatva-dīrghatvā(vṛddhī)
nāmasiddhatvādakṛteṣveteṣu dvirvacane kṛte padasya sthāne
samudāyasyādiṣṭatvātasyaiva sthānivadbhāvena padatvaṃ
nāvayavayoriti pūrvatra bhāge nalopādīni na syuḥ, utaratra tu
samudāyapadatvenāpi siddhyati ? nanu ca nalopādīnyataraṅgāṇi
padatvamātrā pekṣatvād, dvirvacanaṃ tu bahiraṅgaṃ
vīpsādyarthāpekṣatvāt, tataśca teṣu kṛteṣu dvirvacanaṃ bhaviṣyati ?
evamapi kṛtānāmapi teṣāṃ dvirvacane kartavye'siddhatvānnakā
rādiyuktasya dvirvacanamiti punaḥ pūrvapade nimitabhāvānna syureva,
yathā aujaḍhadityatra kṛtānāvapi ḍhatvādīnāmasiddhatvāt hata ityetasya
dvirvacane'bhyāse hakārasyaiva śravaṇaṃ bhavati ? naiṣa doṣaḥ;
vakṣyatyetat ṭhpūrvatrāsiddhīyamadvirvacane' iti, tataśca
paratvādantaraṅgatvādvā nalopādiṣu kṛteṣu tadyauktasyaiva dvirvacanaṃ
bhaviṣyati |
yāni tarhi padakāryāṇi nākṛte dvirvacane prāpnuvanti, tāni na
syuḥ; tadyathā kiṅkimiti---ṭhvā padāntasya' iti parasavarṇavikalpaḥ,
apacannapacanniti ṅmuṭ, agnāagnāviti valopaḥ, chāyācchāyeti
tugvikalpaḥ, vṛkṣatvakṣāniti ṭhpadantasya' iti ṇatvapratiṣedhaḥ, aje'je
iti, ṭheṅaḥ padāntādati' iti pūrvarūpatvam | kiṃ cātra ṭhsvarito
vānudāte padādau' ityeṣa vidhirna syāt, utarabhāgasyāpadatvāt;
tathā'padatvātadāśrayāṇi kāryāṇi prāpnuvanti,
tadyathā---aṅganāṅganetyato guṇe pararūpatvaṃ syāt, payaḥ paya iti
ṭhso'padādau' iti satvaprasaṅga ityeṣā dik | ato dvayorapi
pṛthakpadatvameṣitavyam; taducyate---yadi pratyastamitāvayavabheda eka
evādaśaḥ syād, ṭhdve' iti dvirvacanamanupapannaṃ syāt; tataḥ ṭhdve' iti
vacanādekasya padasya sthāne dve pade samudite yugapadādeśatvena
vidhīyete, tatra sthānivadbhāvena samudāyasyāpi padatvaṃ svataḥ, evaṃ
cāvayavayorapīti samudāyasyāvayavayośca padakāryāṇi bhaviṣyanti |
evamapi visaṃvisam, musalaṃmusalamiti ṭhādeśapratyayayoḥ' iti
ṣatvaprasaṅgaḥ ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; naivaṃ vijñāyate---ādeśasya sakāra iti,
kathaṃ tarhi ? ādeśo yaḥ sakāra iti | atra ca samudāyasya samudāya
ādeśaḥ, na sakāramātrasya sakāramātramiti na bhaviṣyati | iha tahi
nṛbhirnṛbhiriti samudāyasya padatvādrephanakārayoḥ
samānapadasthatvādraṣābhyāmiti ṇatvaprasaṅgaḥ ? eṣo'pyadoṣaḥ; tatra
samānagrahaṇaṃ na kartavyam, ṭhpade' ityevāstu,
tatrāpadasthayornimitanimitinorasambhavādekatvavivakṣārthameva
padagrahaṇamiti samānapadasthatvaṃ sidhyati, tataśca samānagrahaṇāda yatra
samānapadasthatvameva, tatra ṇatvam | iha tu
sthānivadbhāvādekapadatvam | vastutastu padadvayātmaka ādeśa iti
pṛthakpadasthamiti ṇatvābhāvaḥ | tadevaṃ nirdoṣaḥ ṭhsthāne dvirvacana'
pakṣaḥ |
idānīṃ dvitīyaṃ pakṣaṃ darśayati---yadā tviti | dvirāvartata iti |
uccāryamāṇasya śabdasya yo vyāpāra uccāraṇaṃ nāma
sehāvṛttivivakṣitā | dviruccaratītyarthaḥ | dve āvṛtī bhavata iti | dve
uccāraṇakriye bhavata ityarthaḥ | na punarmukhye evāvṛtī dve bhavataḥ,
tathā sati trirvacanaprasaṅgāt | nanvasminpakṣe āṃ pacasipacasi
devadata3---ityatrāvṛttibhedanibandhanayā dvitvasaṃkhyayā
svāśrayasyaikatvasya nivartanādekāntaratāyā abhāvād ṭhāma
ekāntaram' iti nighātapratiṣedho na syādyathā
kiriṇetyādāvāvṛttibhedanibandhanenāpi dvyactvena
svāśrayasyaikāctvasya nivartānāt ṭhsāvekācaḥ' iti
vibhatayādyaudātatvaṃ na bhavati, tadvat | sthāne dvirvacane tu
samudāyasyāpi sthānivadbhāvena padatvātsidhyati, tathā paunaḥ
punyamiti punaḥ punarbhavitari vartamānātpunaḥpunaśabdādbhāve
ṣyañi yate; punaḥ punarbhavaḥ paunaḥ punika iti ca kālāṭṭhañ',
tatra dviḥ prayoge padasya vijñāyamāne samudāyasva vīpsālakṣaṇenārthena
satyapyarthavatve'rthavatsamudāyānāṃ samāsagrahaṇaṃ
niyamārthamityaprātipadikatvātadvito na rayātaḥ
subantādutpattipakṣe'pi samudāyasyāsubantatvānna syādeva, pakṣāntare
tu sthānivadbhāvādubhayamapyastīti sidhyati | yadyapyasya sthānī
subantaḥ, tathāpi subluki kṛte ṭhna ṅasimbuddhyoḥ' iti
niṣedhājjñāpakāt pratyayalakṣaṇena ṭhapratyayaḥ' iti
niṣedhābhāvātprātipadikatvamavyāvṛtamiti ? atraivaṃ bhāpye parihāra
uktaḥ---pacasipacasītyartharūpayoḥ samānatvātsa eva pacśabdaḥ, sa eva ca
tiṅ, tataśca yaḥ pūrvasmādvidditaḥ sa parasmādapi yaśca parasmātsa
pūrvasmādapi, tadādigrahaṇaṃ ca padasaṃjñāyāmanuvartate, tatra
samudāyasyāvayavayośca tulye'pi tiṅntatve samudāyasyaiva
padasaṃjñā bhaviṣyati dvirvacanavat, tadyathā---papācetyatra
samudāyasyāvayavānāṃ ca tulye'pyekāctve samudāyasyaiva |
dvirvacanaṃ bhavati, nāvayavānām; tatkasya hetoḥ ? śāstrahāneḥ,
avayavadvirvacane hyavayavāntare viṣaye samudāyaviṣaye ca śāstraṃ hīnaṃ
syāt, tadvatpadasaṃjñāpi samudāyasyaiva bhaviṣyatītyekāntaratā
yujyate | paunaḥ punyamityādau taddhito'pyuktena nyāyena
samudāyasya subantatvāt prātipadikatvācca siddhyatīti |
atraivaṃ codayanti---prāgeva dvirvacanāt pacasītyasyāmavasthāyāṃ
pravṛtā padasaṃjñā kimati punaḥ kṛte'pi dvirvacane pravartate,
pravartamānā vā kimiti samudāyasyaiva pravartate, na tu
pratyekamavayavayoḥ, na hyaevaṃvidho dvirvacananyāyasya viṣaya iti
saṃyogasaṃjñāyāmuktam; nirgleyādityādau triṣvapi dvayoḥ
saṃyogasaṃjñābhyupagamāt | kiñca yatra samudāyasyaiva
padatvam---apacannapacannityādau, tatrāvayaveṣu padakāryābhāvaprasaṅga
iti |
apara āha---uccāraṇakriyaivātra paraṃ bhidyate, tadbhedātvaupacārikaḥ
padabhedaḥ; tatvatastvekameva padamityekāntaratā yujyate, paunaḥ
punyamityau ca vīpsālakṣaṇenārthena samudāyasyāpyarthavatvāt
prātipadikatvam | na ca samāsagrahaṇānnivṛttiḥ; atulyajātīyatvāt |
yepāṃ hi bhinnārthānāṃ satāṃ parasparasambandhamātramadhikaṃ
tatsamudāyasyaiva tulyajātīyasya tena nivṛttiḥ | na
cātraitadubhyamasti | na hi dvayoḥ punaḥ śabdayorartho bhidyate, nāpi
tatsamudāye tatsambandho'dhikaḥ kiṃ tarhi ? vīpsārūpo'nya eveti |
yadyevam, kiriṇetyādau ṭhsāvekācastṛtīyādiḥ' iti vibhaktisvaraḥ
syāt ? tatrāpi hyuccāraṇakriyaiva bhidyate, tatvatastveka evekāraḥ |
kiñca----nityānāṃ vibhūnāṃ varṇānāṃ tadātmakānāṃ ca padānāṃ
svarūpeṇa vyavadhānamavyavadhānaṃ ca na sambhavatītyupalabdhigatameva
tadāśrayitavyam | tatra ca yathā padabhede'pyupalabdhibhedaḥ, tathā
tadabhede'pīti kathamekāntaratā ! yadi ca
paunaḥ---punyamityādāvuktena nyāyena samudāyasyāpi
prātipadikatvam, hantaivaṃ grāmogrāmo ramaṇīya ityādāvapyevameva
prātipadikatve sati subluk syāt, tasmātsthāne dvirvacanamevātra
rocayāmahe | ata eva ṭhsthaane dvirvacanam' pūrvaṃ vṛttikāreṇa
darśitam, paścātsambhavamātreṇa ṭhdviḥ prayogo'pi' darśitaḥ |
iha sarvasyeti vacanamalo'ntyanivṛtyarthaṃ vā syāt,
ṣaṣṭha|lrthaprasiddhayarthaṃ ca | tatra sthāne dvirvacanapakṣe
tāvacchabdato'rthataścāntaratamābhyāṃ dvābhyāmādeśābhyāṃ bhāvyam | ye
caivaṃ prakārāste niyogato'nekālsvabhāvāḥ---ityantareṇāpi
sarvagrahaṇam ṭhanekālśitsarvasya' iti sarvasya bhaviṣyati |
ṣaṣṭha|lrtho'pi ṭhparervarjane' ityādau yatra ṣaṣṭhayuccāryate tatra
tāvat siddhaḥ; yatrāpi ṣaṣṭhī nāsti---ṭhnityavīpsayoḥ' iti, tatrāpi
sāmarthyāllabhyate---nityavīpsayoyaḥ śabdastasya dve bhavata iti | dviḥ
prayogapakṣe tvalontyavidhiprasaṅga eva nāsti; sthānaṣaṣṭha|lbhāvāt |
ṣaṣṭha|lrtho'pi labhyata evaḥ, uccāraṇasya śabdadharmatvād | ato nāthaḥ
sarvagrahaṇenetyabhiprāyeṇāha---sarvasyeti kimiti | vispaṣṭāthamiti
| ya evaṃ pratipatumasamarthaḥ, taṃ prati sukhapratipataye sarvasyetyucyata
ityarthaḥ | athetyādi | evaṃ
manyate---samāsataddhitavākyanivṛtyarthamavaśyam ṭhpadasya' iti vaktavyam
| samāsanivṛtyartha tāvat---saptaparṇo'ṣṭāpadam, atra saptasaṃkhyāni
parṇāni vīpsyante, na tu tadvānvṛkṣa iti
vīpsāyāmekatvasyānantarbhāvātprāgeva vibhaktedvivacanaprasaṅgaḥ,
padādhikārātu na bhavati; taddhitaḥ---dvipadikāṃ dadāti, atra
dvitvasaṃkhyāyuktaḥ padārtho vīpsyata iti
strītvaikatvalakṣaṇayorliṅgasaṃkhyayoranantarbhāvātprāk taddhitotpateḥ
samāse kṛte prāptaṃ dvirvacanaṃ padatvābhāvānna bhavati;
vākyam---grāmegrāme pānīyam, atra vākyasyāpadatvād dvirvacanaṃ na
bhavati grāme pānīyamiti | kiñcotaratra padasyeti na vaktavyaṃ bhavati;
ṭhpadasya padāt' ityasyaivānuvṛteriti | naivaṃ śakyamiti |
asyāpyayamabhiprāyaḥ---ṭhpadasya' ityucyamāne'pi saptaparṇābhyāmityādau
svādiṣu pūrvasya padatvād dvirvacanaprasaṅgaḥ; tasmādevamatra
parihāro vācyaḥ---yadvīpsāyuktam, na adaḥ prayujyate; kiṃ punastat
? parvaṇiparvaṇi saptaparṇānyasyeti, yacca prayujyate na
tadvīpsāyuktam---saptaparṇānyasyeti parṇaśabda iti | taddhite tu
taddhitenaivoktatvād dvirvacanābhāvaḥ, sa hi ṭhvīpsāyām' ityucyate
| vākyasyāpi dvirvacanaṃ na bhavati; padadvirvacanenoktatvādvīpsāyāḥ |
tasmāt samāsādinivṛtyarthaṃ tāvatpadādhikāro na kartavya iti |
pratyuta kriyamāṇe padādhikāre'vyāptilakṣaṇo doṣa ityāha---iha hi
na syāditi | prapacatīti | dhātūpasargasamudāyaḥ kriyāviśeṣavācī |
aḍādivyavasthārthaṃ tu dhātūpasargayoḥ pṛthak kalpanam, tataśca
kriyādharmo nityatā samudāyasyeti tasyaiva dvirvacanam | ihetyādi |
druhestṛci vihite ṭhvā druhamuha' iti ghatvaḍhatve prāpnutaḥ,
dvirvacanaṃ ca; tatra ghatvaḍhatvayorasiddhatvātpūrvaṃ dvirvacanaṃ prāpnoti |
astu, ko doṣaḥ ? tatrāha---tatreti | paścādvikalpe pravartamāne yadā
paratra ḍhatvaṃ tadā pūrvatrāpi ḍhatvameveti niyamābhāvāt ghatvamapi
kadāciṃt syāt | evaṃ ghatve'pi draṣṭavyam---paratra ghatvaṃ pūrvatra
ḍhatvamiti | etaccaikasyā ākṛteścaritaḥ prayogo na
dvitīyasyāstṛtīyasyāśca bhavatīti nyāyamanāśrityoktaṃ draṣṭavyam |
ayaṃ ca nyāyaḥ ṭhkṛñcānuprayujyate liṭi' ityatraiva vyākhyātaḥ |
pūrvatrāsiddhīyamiti | ṭhpūrvatrāsiddham' ityasminnadhikāre bhavaṃ
nalopādikāryaṃ pūrvatrāsiddhīyam, tad dvirvacanādanyatrāsiddhaṃ
bhavati | atha vā---pūrvasyāṃ sapādasaptādhyāyyamasiddhaṃ nalopādi
pūrvatrāsiddham, tatra bhavamasiddhatvaṃ pūrvatrāsiddhīyam; tad
dvirvacane kartavye na bhavati, tataśca ghatve ḍhatve vā pravṛte
tadyauktasyaiva dvirvacanamiti nāsti doṣaḥ |
sarvasyetyetadevetyādi | pūrvaṃ ṭhpūrvatrāsiddhīyamadvirvacane' iti
vacanāśrayeṇa droḍhādroḍheati sādhitam, idānīm ṭhsarvasya' ityanena
sādhitamityekasminsādhye dvayorhetvorvikalpaḥ | kathaṃ punaḥ ṭhsarvasya'
ityanena kṛtasarvakāryapratipatiḥ ? arśāadyacpratyayānto'yaṃ
sarvaśabdaḥ---sarvaṃ kāryaṃ yasminnasti tadidaṃ sarvam, tasya dve bhavataḥ |
sarveṣu kāryeṣu kṛteṣu dvirvacanamityarthaḥ ||
tasya paramāmreḍitam || 8|1|2 ||
ṭhtasya' ityavayavayoge ṣaṣṭhī, paraśabdo'vayavacanaḥ |
ṭhdikśabdāñcūtarapada' ityatra yadyapi ṭhdiśi dṛṣṭaḥ śabdo
dikśabdaḥ'---ityāśrayaṇātsampratyadikśibdatve'pi pañcamī vihitā,
tathāpyasmādeva nirdeśādavayavavācibhiryoge ṣaṣṭhī bhavati | evaṃ ca
pūrvaṃ kāyasyetyādi siddhaṃ bhavati | udāharaṇe---ṭhāmraḍitaṃ bhartsane'
iti plutaḥ | tasya grahaṇaṃ viṣayāvadhāraṇārtham--tasyaitasyānantarasya
dviruktasyeti, tena pāṣṭhike dvirvacane iyaṃ saṃjñā na bhavati | nanu
āmreḍitaśabdo nighaṇṭuaṣu prasiddhaḥ---ṭhārmraḍitaṃ dvistriruktam' iti ?
satyamarthe prasiddhaḥ; iha tu śabde paribhāṣyate 
mahāsaṃjñākaraṇaṃ pūrvācāryānurodhena || 
anudātaṃ ca || 8|1|3 ||
paramityanena sāmānādhikaraṇyātasya
cājjhalsamudāyarūpatvādanyartho'trānudātaśabdaḥ---avidyamānamudātamanudātamiti | svarite'pyudātasya bhāvātasyāpi nivṛttiḥ | evamapi na jñāyate---kena svareṇāmreḍitaṃ prayoktavyamiti ? ucyate; udātasvaritau tāvanniṣiddhau, na cāsvarakasyāca uccāraṇaṃ sambhavati, tatra pāriśeṣyādanudātatvameva bhaviṣyati | yadvā---anudātāckamanudātam, āmreḍitasthā aco'nudātā bhavantītyarthaḥ | bhuṅktabhuṅkta iti | ṭhbhujo'navane' ityātmanepadam, tasya ṭhtāsyanudātet' ityanudātatvam, śnamaḥ pratyayasvaraḥ, tasya ṭhśnasorallopaḥ' ityallope udātanivṛttisvareṇa bhuṅkteśabdo'ntodrutiḥ, dvirvacanena parasyānudātatvam | paśuśabdaḥ kupratyayānto'ntodātaḥ ||
nityavīpsayoḥ || 8|1|4 ||
nitye cārthe vīpsāyāṃ ca yadvartate iti | anena
saptamīyamarthanirdeśārtheti darśayati | prayoktṛdharmabhūtā vīpsā, na ca
sā grāmādiśabdairabhidhīyate | pacatipacatītyatrāpi vastuto yannityaṃ
na tatiṅntenābhidhīyate | nityatvaṃ tu dvirvacanadyotyam |
tasmādayamatrārthaḥ---nityatve dyotyatvena viṣayabhūte, vīpsāyāṃ va
dyotyatvena viṣayabhūtāyāmiti | eṣaiva ca tatra vṛttiḥ, śabdasya yadvatā
tadviṣayatā | yadi punareṣā ṣaṣṭhī syātsavrūpavidhiḥ prasajyeta, tataśca
ṭhnityaṃ krīḍājīvikayoḥ', ṭhpādaśatasya saṃkhyādervīpsāyām'
ityādinirdeśo nopapadyate | yadi tu ṭhnityārthaviṣayaḥ śabdo
nityaḥ' ityucyeta, vīpsārthaviṣayaśca vīpseti; tadā
ṣaṣṭha|lamapyadoṣaḥ ? gauṇatvaprasaṅgātadanāśritam | nityaśabdo'yaṃ
sarvakālāvasthāyino ya ātmākāśādayaḥ, yeṣāmutpattivināśau
prayoktṛbhirnopalabhyete, teṣvapi prayujyamāno dṛśyate---nitya
ātmā, nitya ākāśaḥ, nityā dyauriti; ābhīkṣṇye'pi---nityaṃ
prahasitaḥ, nityaṃ prajalpita iti | tatrāviśeṣādubhayorapi
grahaṇādākāśādiśabdānāmapi dvirvacanaprasaṅga iti manyamānaḥ
pṛcchati--keṣu nityateti |
atha vā---nityaśabdasya kūṭasthalakṣaṇa eva mukhyo'rthaḥ,
śabdāntarasannidhyanapekṣaṇāt | ābhīkṣṇyaṃ tu
kriyāpadaprayogasamadhigamyaṃ gauṇo'rthaḥ;
avicchedopalabdhisāmānyamāśritya tatra prayogāt | tataśca
ṭhgauṇamukhyayormukhye sampratyayaḥ' iti kūṭasthavācināmeva
dvirvacanaprasaṅga iti manyamāna āha---keṣu nityateti | itaro'pi
viditābhiprāya āha---tiṅkṣviti | aviśeṣameva manyamānaḥ
pṛcchati---kuta iti | ābhīkṣṇyamiheti |
ayamabhiprāyaḥ---kūṭasthavacanagrahaṇe tiṅntāni na saṃgṛhītānisyuḥ,
ābhīkṣṇyalakṣaṇe tu nityatve gṛhyamāṇe tallakṣaṇaṃ dvirvacanaṃ
tiṅntānām, vīpsālakṣaṇaṃ tu subantānāmityubhayānugraho bhavati |
gauṇo'pi cārtho lakṣyadarśanavaśādihāśrīyate---yathā ṭhśītoṣṇābhyāṃ
kāriṇi', pārśvenānvicchatītyādau | ubhyavidhe'pi nityatve gṛhyamāṇe
tadvācināṃ subantānāṃ svārtha eva dvirvacanaṃ syāt, na caivaṃ loke
prayogo'sti---ātmātmeti | evaṃ hyukte vīpsā pratīyate, na tu
svārthaḥ | tasmādābhīkṣṇyasyaiva grahaṇamiti bhavatyābhīkṣṇyamiha nityatā |
sā ca tiṅkṣvavyayakṛtsu ceti | etatkutasatyam ?
ityāha--ābhīkṣṇyaṃ ca kriyādharma iti | paunaḥ punyamuābhīkṣṇyam
| tacca sādhyarūpāyāḥ kriyāyā eva sambhavati, tajjātīyasya tu punaḥ
karaṇaṃ ghaṭādiṣvapi rūmbhavati; tathāpi kriyāviṣayaiva punaḥ kriyata
iti pratītiḥ | tadvacanāśca punaḥ punaḥ, ābhīkṣṇyam, nityamityādayaḥ
śabdāḥ, yathā yugapatpṛthagityādayaḥ śabdāḥ kriyāviṣayāḥ, tadvat |
kriyā ca taṅkṣvivyavakṛtsu cābhidhīyate, pācakādiṣu tu sādhanaṃ
pradhānam | pākādiṣvapi tu siddhatā pradhānam, na kriyā |
kīdṛśī punaḥ sā kriyā yasyā ābhīkṣṇyaṃ dharmaḥ ? ityāha---yāṃ
kriyāmiti | tannityamiti | nityaśabdasya napuṃsakaliṅgatvātadvṛtti
tacchabdasyāpi napuṃsakatvam, yathā---aṇau yatkarma ṇau cetsa kartetyatra
puṃstvam | lunīhilunīhīti | kriyāsamabhihāre loṭua | yadyapi
tiṅntasya darśitamudāharaṇaṃ tathāpyastyatra vaktavyamiti punarupanyāsaḥ,
taddarśayati---katvāṇamulorloṭaśceti | ṭhsamānakartṛkayoḥ'
ityādinārthāntare'pi ktvāṇamulau vihitau, loḍapi
vidhyādāvarthāntare vihita iti sāmānyaśabdatvāt dvirvacanāpekṣā
eva paunaḥ punyaṃ prakāśayanti | yaṅ tu tannirapekṣa iti | sa hi
kriyāsamabhihāraṃ na vyabhicarati, tatkiṃ tasya taddyotane
dvirvacanāpekṣayā ! nanu yaṅntasyāpi kadācid dvirvacanamiṣyate,
tatkatham ? ityāha---yadā tviti | dvividho hi kriyāyāḥ
samabhihāraḥ---paunaḥ punyam, bhṛśārthaśca | tatra yadā dvirvacanaṃ
bhavati, tadā bhṛśārthe yaṅ, tasyaiva paunaḥ punyaṃ dyotayituṃ
dvirvacanam, tasya yaṅa'dyotitatvādityarthaḥ | vṛtau ca
sāmānyaśabdasyāpi kriyā samabhihāraśabdasya bhṛśārthalakṣaṇe
kriyāsamabhihāre vṛttivijñeyā | pāpacyata iti | sakalā avayavakriyāḥ
svayameva sampādayan punaḥ punaḥ pacatītyarthaḥ | loḍapi
bhavati---pāpacyasva pāpacyasvetyevāyaṃ pāpacyata iti | atha
nityatāyāṃ dvirvacanamucyamānaṃ dhātumātrasya kasmānna bhavati, sa hi
kriyāvacanaḥ ? ucyate; parigṛhītasādhanā kriyā vyavahāropayoginī
bhavati, tadabhidhānācca dhātumātrasya dvirvacanābhāvaḥ | padādhikāro
vāśrayaṇīyaḥ | anenaivābhiprāyeṇa pūrvamuktam---ṭhatha padasyetyeva
kasmānnocyate' iti, asminpakṣe sagatikasya dvirvacanaṃ vaktavyameva |
etenaitadapi nirastam---bhṛśārthe sāvakāśo yaṅ paunaḥ punye
pareṇa dvirvacanena bādhyata iti | kathamidaṃ nirastam ? padasya
dvirvacanaṃ dhātoryaṅ, tatrāntaraṅgasya na yukto bādha it
vyākhyātam |
nityaṃ vīpsāṃ vyākhyāsyan viṣayaṃ tāvatpṛcchati---atheti | supsu
vīpseti | supāmeva tadabhivyaktau samarthatvāt | evaṃ viṣayamuktvā
svarūpaṃ pṛcchati---kā punariti | yadi sāmānyena vyāptumicchā
vīpsā, tadā cikīrṣatītyādau dvirvacanaprasaṅgaḥ;
karotyādikriyābhiḥ kaṭādīnāṃ yā vyāptumicchā tadvicitvāt |
itaro ṭhyogarūḍhirvīpsāśabdaḥ'
ityabhiprāyeṇāha---vyāptiviśeṣaviṣayeti | prayokturiccheti | anena
nābhidheyā vīpsā gṛhyate---vīpsāvācino dve bhavata iti, kiṃ tarhi ?
prayoktṛdharmaḥ, ābādhavat | gatagata ityukte priyasya ciragamanādinā
pīḍito vākyaṃ prayuṅkta iti pratīyate, tena cikīrṣatītyādau
dvirvacanaṃ bhavatīti darśayati | vyāptiviśeṣavipayetyuktam, sa tu
viśeṣo nādyāpyabhihitada iti punaḥ pṛcchati---kā punarasāviti |
nānāvācināmityādi |
pūrvavṛttiṣu paṭhitaṃ vīpsālakṣaṇam, tad
vyācaṣṭe---nānābhūtārthavācināmiti | tatra nānāvācināmiti
vacanājjātivācināṃ dvirvacanaṃ na bhavati---brāhmaṇo na hantavyaḥ,
sampanno vrīhiriti | nahi jātiśabdā nānābhūtārthavācinaḥ;
jāterekatvāt | yugapadgrahaṇātkramavivakṣāyāṃ dvirvacanābhāvaḥ,
yathā---asminvane'yaṃ vṛkṣaḥ śobhano'yaṃ vṛkṣaḥ śobhana iti krameṇa
śobhanatvapratipādane bahūnāmapi śabdānāṃ prayogo bhavati,
tathaikaśeṣo'pi na bhavati---asminvane vṛkṣāḥ śobhanā iti;
nānāvācitvābhāvāt | pṛthagarthaparyavasāyitvaṃ hi nānāvācitvam,
na caikaśeṣe tadasti | ata eva tatra na pratyekaṃ vidheyasambandho
niyamena pratīyate | na ṭhhi brāhmaṇebhyaḥ śataṃ deyam' ityukte niyamena
pratyekaṃ śataṃ deyaṃ bhavati | brāhmaṇāya brāhmaṇāya śataṃ deyamityukte
pratyekaṃ śataṃ dīyate, tatkaraya hetoḥ ? pṛthagarthaparyavasāyitayā
pṛthagdeyasya sambandhāt | yadā ca pṛthagarthaparthavasāyitā, tadā
yāvanto'rthā abhidhitsitāḥ, tāvantaḥ śabdāḥ
pṛthagekaikaparyavasāyinaḥ prasaktāḥ, teṣāmanena nivṛttiḥ
kriyate---vīpsāyāṃ dve eva prayoktavye, na tu bahu prayoktavyamiti |
kathaṃ tahi nivṛtānāmarthaḥ pratīyate, yāvatā pratyekaparyavasāyitve
dvayoreva pratītiḥ syāt ? ucyate---
ekaśeṣe yathānyeṣāmarthaḥ śiṣṭena gamyate |
tadvadatra viśeṣe'pi śiṣṭābhyāmitarārthadhīḥ ||
yathaiva hi vṛkṣau vṛkṣā ityekaśeṣaviṣaye śiṣyamāṇameva
nivṛtānāmapyarthamāha, tathehāpi śiṣyamāṇe dve eva
vivakṣitānarthānabidhāsyataḥ | na ca bahuvacanaprasaṅgaḥ;
parigṛhītaikatvānāṃ bahūnāmabhidhānāt; anyathā
prateyakasambandhasyāpratīteḥ dvirvacanādutarakālaṃ satyāmapi
bahutvāvagatāvaprātipadikatvādvahuvacanābhāvaḥ, yathā---paśya mṛgo
dhāvatīti satyapi darśanakriyāpekṣe karmatve dvitīyābhāvaḥ |
ekaikamityatra tu satyapi bahuvrīhivadbhāvena prātipadikatvaṃ
parigṛhītaikatvasyaikārathasya vīpsāyogādantaraṅgatvādekavacanaṃ
bhavati, na bahuvacanam ; bahutvapratīterbahiraṅgatvāt |
asyaivāryasya ṭhekaikasya prācām' iti nirdeśo liṅgamityalamiyatā |
tadayamatrārthaḥ---nānābhūtārthavācināṃ yānyadhikaraṇāni vācyāni
teṣāṃ sahavivakṣitānāṃ pṛthak saṃkhyāyuktānāṃ pratyekaṃ kriyayā
guṇena vā vyāptumicchā vīpseti | kriyāguṇagrahaṇaṃ
dravyasyāpyupalakṣaṇam | grāmegrāme pānīyamiti |
dravyavyāpterudāharaṇam | puruṣaḥ puruṣo nidhanamupaitīti |
nidhanamumaraṇam | jātasya hi dhruvo mṛtyurityarthaḥ | apara
āha---sāmnāṃ bhaktiviśeṣaḥunidhanam, sarva eva ṛtvijo
nidhanamupayantītyartha iti |
yatiṅntamityādi | atra vipratiṣedho hetuḥ, dvirvacanasyāvakāśo
yatra nityatā vivakṣitā, na prakarṣaḥ---pacatipacatīti,
prakarṣapratyayasyāvakāśo yatra prakarṣa eva vivakṣyate, na
nityitā---pacatitarāmiti; ubhayavivakṣāyāmubhayaprasaṃge paratvād
dvirvacanam, tataḥ punaḥ prasaṅgavijñānātprakarṣapratyayaḥ |
yadvā---pratiyogyapekṣaḥ prakarṣo bahiraṅgaḥ,
paunaḥpunyamantaraṅgamiti pūrvaṃ dvirvacanam |
iha tvityādi | iṣṭireveyam | yadvā---prakarṣayuktā evāḍhyadaya
ānayanakriyāyāmupayujyanta iti laghuprakarṣā eva vīpsyante |
kiñca---kṛtadvirvacanātarapi satyāḍhyataramiti bhavitavyam, tathā ca
prakarṣārtho gamyeta, na vīpseti pūrvaṃ prakarṣayogaḥ ||
parervarjane || 8|1|5 ||
paripari trigartebhya iti | ṭhapaparī varjane' iti karmapravacanīya saṃjñā,
ṭhpañcamyapāṅparibhiḥ' iti pañcamī | pariṣiñcatīti | pariḥ sarvato
bhāve, ṭhupasārgātsunoti' ityādinā ṣatvam |
parervarjana ityādi | ṭhparervarjane' ityatrā ṭhasama se' iti vaktavyam,
ṭhvā' iti ca vaktavyam, tenāsamāsa eva bhavati, tatrāpi visaplena |
anyatra tu naiva bhavati, tadāha---samāse tviti | tenauvoktatvāditi
| nanu vākye tāvadvarjanaṃ parereva dyotyam, samāse'pi pariḥ
sannihitaḥ, tatkiṃ samāsasya varjane śaktiḥ kalpyate ?
tatrāhuḥ---ṭhjahatsvārthā vṛttiḥ' iti pakṣe samāsa eva
varjyamānopasarjane varjane vartate, avayavau tvanarthakāviti | yadā
tu ṭhajahatsvārthā vṛttiḥ' iti pakṣaḥ, tadā vākye kevale varjane
parirvartata iti tatraiva dvirvacanaṃ bhavati | samāse tu
varjyamānārthāskandānānna dvyarthaḥ pariḥ kevale varjane vartata iti
dvirvacanābhāvaḥ ||
prasamupodaḥ pādapūraṇe || 8|1|6 ||
prādīnāṃ samāhāradvandvaḥ, ṭhdvandvāccudaṣahāntātsamāhāre' iti
samāsāntastu na bhavati; samāsāntavidheranityātvāt | udityaṃ
jātavedasamiti kvacidudāhṛtam, tadayuktam; na hyatra dvitīya ucchabdaḥ,
kiṃ tarhi ? uśabdaḥ |
uparyadhyadhasaḥ sāmīpye || 8|1|7 ||
uparyādīnāṃ yo'rthastasya sāmīpyadyotanāya dvirvacanam |
sāmīpyamupratyāsatiḥ, tacca deśakṛtaṃ kālakṛtaṃ vā | uparyupariduḥ
khamiti | kālakṛtasyodāharaṇam | duḥ khasya
sāmīpyenopariṣṭādityarthaḥ | ṭhubhasarvatasoḥ' ityupasaṃkhyānena
dvitīyā | uparyupari grāmiti | grāmasya sāmīpyenopariṣṭāddeśa
ityarthaḥ | adhyadhi grāmamiti | adhiruparibhāve, yathā---ṭhsamidhaṃ srucaṃ
cādhyadhi gārhapatyaṃ hṛtvā' iti | adho'dho grāmamiti | grāmasya
sāmīpyenādhastād deśa ityarthaḥ | yathā ṭhnavānadho'dho bṛhataḥ
payodharān' iti |
uparyupari paśyantaḥ sarva eva daridrati |
adho'dho darśane kasya mahimā nopajāyate ||
iti tu vīpsāyāṃ dvirvacanam |
upari candramā iti | atra bhūgatamapekṣyoparibhāvasya sāmīpyaṃ nāsti |
upari śirasa ityādi | na hi vastusataiva śabdatyutpateḥ pradhānaṃ
kāraṇam, kiṃ tarhi ? vivakṣā, sā ceha nāsti | śirasa upariṣṭād
ghaṭṃa dhārayati nādhastāditi hyatra vivakṣitam | sāmīpyaṃ tu vastutaḥ
sambhavati ||
vākyāderāmantritasyāsūyāsammatikopakutsanabhartsaneṣu || 8|1|8 ||
ekārthaḥ padasamūho vākyamiti | yathāha
bhagavāñcaiminiḥ---arthaikatvādekaṃ vākyaṃ sākāṃkṣaṃ cedvibhāge syāt'
iti | kvacitu ṭhekatiṅpadasamūho vākyam' iti paṭha|lte, ekā
tiṅvibhaktiryatra sa ekatiṅ | kvacitu na kiñcidapi vākyalakṣaṇaṃ
paṭha|lte | asūyāsammatikopakutsanabhartsaneṣu yadi tadvākyaṃ bhavatīti
| yadyapi vākyāderiti samāse guṇībhūtaṃ vākyam,
tathāpyasūyādīnāṃ tenaiva sambandhaḥ---asūyādiṣu yadvākyaṃ
tadāderiti, na tu pradhānena vākyādinā''mantritena | prayoktṛdharmā
hyasūyādayo nābhidheyadharmāḥ, te ca vākyenaiva dyotyante,
nāmantritena | udāharaṇeṣu sammatāvanukampāyāṃ kan, itaratra
kutsite kaḥ | riktamu śūnyam, kṣudramityarthaḥ | śaktiyaṣṭiśabdābhyāṃ
tadvatyoḥ striyorvartamānābhyāṃ kutsite kaḥ | evaṃ hi kutsanam,
sambodhanaṃ ca samīcīnaṃ bhavati | bhartsane tvityādi | yadyapi ṭhbhatsene
paryāyeṇa' iti vacanātpūrvasyāpi tatra vidhīyamānaṃ
bhartsanakutsanayorapi siddhyati; kāraṇatvena tatrāpi
kopāsūyayorbhāvāt, tetaśca nārthaḥ kutsanabhatsenagrahaṇena ?
naitadasti;
guravo hi hitaiṣitvādakupyanto'pi bhartsanam |
kurvate bhartsyamānāstu kupitānpratiyanti tān ||
vināpyasūyayā kutsāṃ kurvantīti pṛthaktayoḥ |
nirdeśaḥ sūtrakāreṇa vihitaḥ sūkṣmadarśinā ||
sāmṛtaiḥ pāṇibhirghnanti guravo na viṣokṣitaiḥ |
lālanāśrayiṇo doṣāstāḍanāśrayiṇo guṇāḥ ||
abhiprāye duṣṭe lālane'pi doṣā bhavanti, viparyaye tu tāḍane'pi
guṇā ityarthaḥ ||
evaṃ bahuvrīhivat || 8|1|9 ||
atra yadi kevalo bahuvrīhivadbhāvo'nirdiṣṭaviṣayo'nena
vidhīyate, tataścehāpi prāpnoti---eka iti, tataśca subluk, syāt
| astu, bahuvrīhivadbhāvādaparaḥ suḥ prabhaviṣyati ? naiva cātra
subluk prāpnoti, eka ityasya pratyayāntatvenāprātipadikatvāt |
ṭhkṛtiddhitasamāsāśca' ityatra ca samāsagrahaṇaṃ niyamārtham, na
vidhyarthamiti tenāpi nāsti prātipadikatvam | iha tarhyeketi
puṃvadbhāvaḥ prāpnoti ? syādevatan---ṭhdve' ityadhikārād
dvirvacanasanniyogena vidhīyamāno bahuvrīhivadbhāvastadabhāvādiha
na bhavatīti | atha tadapi dvirvacanaṃ tena vidhīyamānamatra kasmānna
bhavati ? tasmādvaktavyo'sya viṣayaḥ | ata āha---ekamityetacchabdarūpaṃ
dviruktamiti | satyam; ṭhdve' ityanuvartate, na ca tena dvirvacanaṃ
vidhīyate, kiṃ tarhi ? anyena vihitanūdya tatra bahuvrīhivadbhāvo
vidhīyate | kva cānyena dvirvacanaṃ vihitam ? vīpsāyām | yadi
punarvīpsāgrahaṇamanuvartya tatra bahuvrīhivadbhāvo vidhīyeta ? naivaṃ
śakyam; bahuvrīhivadbhāvena dvirvacanaṃ bādhyate | atha yadi
vīpsāyāṃ dve ityevamubhayamanuvartya dvirvacanaṃ
bahuvrīhivadbhāvaḥ---ityubhayamanena vidhīyate, na doṣo bhavati |
vaḥtikārastu kimanayā vīpsāgrahaṇānuvṛtyeti ṭhdve'
ityevānvavīvṛtat |
sublopapuṃvadbhāvāviti | yadyapyetau bahuvrīhāviti nocyete,
tathāpi tatra dṛṣṭāvityetayoratideśaḥ | kvacitu vṛtāvevāyamarthaḥ
paṭha|lte | ekaikamiti | ekamityasya dvirvacane dvayorapi suporluki
sati punarbahuvrīhivadbhāvādeva sup | ekaikayeti |
ṭābantātṛtīyā, tadantasya dvirvacanam, subluki puṃvadbhāvena
pūrvabhāge ṭāpo nivṛttiḥ | kaḥ punaratra ṭāpo nivṛtau
satyāmasatyāṃ vā viśeṣaḥ | ? avagrahe'sti
viśeṣaḥ---aikaikayetyeka---ekayeti bhavati | utaratra ca gatagatetyādau
puṃvadbhāvasya prayojanam |
nanu yadi yacca yāvacca bahuvrīhau dṛṣṭṃa kārya tasya sarvasyātideśaḥ;
sarvanāmasaṃjñāpratiṣedhaḥ, svaraḥ, samāsānta ityete vidhayaḥ
prāpnuvanti ? ata āha---sarvanāmasaṃjñāpratiṣedhasvarasamāsāntā iti |
na bahuvrīhāviti pratiṣedho na bhavatīti | tatra hi ṭhvibhāṣā
diksamāse bahuvrīhau' ityataḥ ṭhbahuvrīhau' ityanuvartamāne
punarvahuvrīhigrahaṇam---bahuvrīhireva yo bahuvrīhistatra yathā
syād, bahuvrīhivadbhāvena yo bahuvrīhistatra mā bhūditi | tena
saṃjñāpratiṣedhastāvatsamāsādhikāre bahuvrīhau vijñāyate | nana,
susu iti | ṭhābādhe ca' iti dvirvacanam | nana karoti, susu
jāgartītyādivākyaikadeśa udāhṛtaḥ | nañsubhyāmityantodātatvaṃ na
bhavatīti | tatra hi ṭhvanaṃ samāse' ityataḥ siṃhāvalokitanyāyena
ṭhsamāse' iti sambadhyate, ṭhbahuvrīhāvidametatadbhyaḥ' ityataḥ
ṭhbahuvrīhau' iti ca | tatra bahuvrīheḥ samāsatvāvyabhicāre punaḥ
samāsa iti viśeṣaṇaṃ samāsādhikāravihitabahuvrīhiparigrahārthaṇ |
athātra ṭhnañsubhyām' ityantodātatve sati kaḥ svaro bhavati ? atra hi
catvāraḥ svarāḥ prāpnuvanti---samāsāntodātatvaṃ ca | tatra
ṭhnañsubhyām' ityayaṃ svaro na bhavatītyuktam |
āmreḍitānudātatvamapi na bhavati, kiṃ kāraṇam ? kāryātideśe
tāvadidameva kāryāṇāṃ vidhāyakamiti paratvādāmreḍitānudātatvaṃ
bahuvrīhisvareṇa bādhyate | śāstrātideśe'pi viruddhasya
svāśrayasyātideśena nivartanānnaivāmreḍitānudātatvaṃ bhavati,
ṭhbahuvrīhau prakṛtyā' ityatra ca na samāsagrahaṇamanuvartate, tena
bahuvrīhivadbhāvātpūrvapadaprakṛtisvaro bhavan samāsāntodātatvaṃ
bādhate | ṛgṛgiti | ṭhābādhe ca' iti dvirvacanam | ṛkpūriti
samāsānto na bhavatīti | tatra hi ṭhsamāsācca tadviṣayāt' ityataḥ
ṭhsamāsāt' ityanuvartamāne punaḥ samāsagrahaṇaṃ samāsādhikāre
vihito yaḥ samāsastatparigrahārtham | tenātideśike samāse
samāsānto na bhavatīti | evamete saṃjñāpratiṣedhādayaḥ
samāsādhikāravihite bahuvrīhau vijñāyante |
vārtikakārastu sarvamevaitadvācanikaṃ manyate,
yadāha---ṭhsarvanāmasvarasamāsānteṣu doṣaḥ' iti | atha nanetyatra
bahuvrīhivadbhāvānnalopaḥ kasmānna bhavati ? ucyate; ṭhutarapade' iti
vartate, naña iti ca kāryiṇo nirdeśaḥ, tatra sākṣācchiṣṭena kāryitvena
naño nimitabhāvo bādhyate, yathā---madrahrado bhadrahrada ityatra rephasya
ṭhaco rahābhyāṃ dve' iti dvirvacanaprasaṅge uktam---ṭhnemau rahau
kāryiṇau, kiṃ tahi ? nimitamimau dvirvacanasya' iti | ayaṃ tu
parihāraḥ pūrvatrāpi yathāsambhavaṃ draṣṭavyaḥ ||
ābādhe ca || 8|1|10 ||
ābādhanamābādha iti | bhāve ghañ | prayoktṛdharmo nābhidheyadharmaiti |
abhidheyadharmatve hi bādhitapīḍitādiśabdānāmeva dvirvacanaṃ syāt,
na gatādiśabdānām, prayoktṛdharmatve hi teṣāmapi bhavatīti
vyāptirbhavati | tatra vartamānasyeti | dvirvacane satyābādhasya
gamyamānatvād gatādiśabdānāṃ tatra vṛttiḥ, na tu tadabhidhānāt |
priyasya ciragamanādineti | prayoktṛdharmatvamābādhasya darśayati |
ādiśabdena nāśādergrahaṇam ||
karmadhārayavadutareṣu || 8|1|11 ||
kopadhāyā api karmadhārayavadbhāvāt puṃvadbhāvo bhavatīti |
tena bahuvrīhivadbhāve prakṛte karmadhārayavadbhāvo vidhīyate iti
bhāvaḥ | samāsāntodātatvamanena vidhīyata iti | kāryātideśapakṣe
idamuktam | śāstrātideśe tu yadyapyāmreḍitānudātatvameva param,
tathāpi na tadbhavati; viruddhasya svāśrayasyāti deśena nivartanāt ||
prakāre guṇavacanasya || 8|1|12 ||
prakāro bhedaḥ sādṛśyaṃ ceti | ubhyatrāpi prakāraśabdasya dṛṣṭatvāt |
bhede tāvat---bahubhiḥ prakārairbhuṅkte, bahubhirbhedaiḥ,
viśeṣairiti gamyate; sādṛśye---brāhmaṇaprakāro'yaṃ māṇavakaḥ,
brāhmaṇasadṛśa iti gamyate | tadiheti | taditi vākyopanyāse | avyayaṃ
vā saptamyarthavṛtti, tatretyartaḥ | sādṛśyaṃ prakāro gṛhyata iti |
dviruktāt tasyaiva pratīteḥ | atra cābhidānasvābhāvyaṃ hetuḥ | prakāre
vartamānasyeti | dvirvacanapravṛttidvāreṇa taddyotanātatra vṛttiḥ |
aparipūrṇaguṇa ityartha iti | kathametat ?
ityāha---paripūrṇaguṇeneti | yasya pūrṇaṃ pāṭavam, yaḥ
paṭuakāryāṇi karoti, tena yadā nyūnapāṭavamupamīyate, tadā
puṭuapaṭuariti prayogo bhavati, tenārthādaparipūrṇaguṇa ityartho
bhavati |
jātīyaro'nena dvirvacanena bādhanaṃ neṣyata iti | tadvidhau
dvividhasyāpi prakārasya grahaṇaṃ manyate | jayādityastu
tatrāha---ṭhsāmānyasya bhedako viśeṣaḥ prakāraḥ' iti | iṣṭiśceyam,
anyathā brāhmaṇajātīya ityādāvaguṇavacane, paṭuajātīya ityādau
guṇavacane'pi sādṛśyādanyatra bhede caritārthasya jātīyaro
guṇavacaneṣu sādṛśye bādhaḥ syāt |
paṭuardeavadata iti | paripūrṇaguṇa evātra paṭuaśabdo vartate,
natatsādṛśyānnyūnaguṇe |
agnirmāṇavaka iti | agniśabdo vahnau vṛtaḥ
so'yamatisādṛśyanimitādabhedopacārānmāṇavake vartata iti dravye
pūrvavṛtaḥ sampratyapi dravyavacana iti guṇavacano na bhavati | evaṃ
gaurvāhīka ityatra gośabdaḥ sāsnādimati vartitvā vāhīke vartamānaḥ
| nanvagniśabdo'gnigatataikṣṇyaṃ māṇavake pratipādayituṃ
prayujyata iti guṇavacana eva, tathā gośabdo'pi
sāsnādimadgatajāḍa|lpratipādanāya vāhīke prayujyata iti guṇavacana
eva ? ityata āha---yadyapyatrāgniśabda iti | agniśabdo māṇavake
prayujyamāno yādṛśamagnestaikṣṇyaṃ paraśvādibhyo vyāvṛtaṃ tadeva
pratipādayati, na taikṣṇyamātramiti, gośabdo'pi yādṛśaṃ gavāṃ jāḍa|lṃ
manuṣyebhyo vyāvṛtaṃ tadeva pratipādayati, āśrayaviśeṣasambandhāddhi
taikṣṇyajāḍa|ladikaṃ bhidyate, tadetadāha---mukhyārthasambandhādavadhṛtabhedaṃ
taikṣṇajāḍa|ladikamiti | śabdāntarasannidhīmantareṇa śabdaśravaṇamātrād
yo'rthaḥ pratīyate sa mukhyaḥ | viparīto gauṇa |
avadhṛtabhedam---niścitabhedam | ādiśabdena
paiṅgalyabhāravahanādergrahaṇam | arthāntare, gauṇe māṇavake
vāhīke ca | sarvadā guṇavacano na bhavatīti na dvirucyata iti |
ṭhprakāre vartamānasya' ityeva guṇavacanatve siddhe
punarguṇavacanagrahaṇāt sarvadā guṇavacanasyetyāśrīyate | na cāyaṃ
sarvadā gumavacanaḥ; prāk prakārād dravyavacanatvāt |
atra kecit---ṭhguṇamuktavān guṇavacanaḥ' iti
guṇopasarjanadravyavacanasya dvirvacanamicchanti | anye tu guṇavacanasya
guṇivacanasya ca aviśeṣeṇecchanti---śuklaśuklaṃ rūpam, śuklaśuklaḥ
paṭa iti | ṭhnavaṃnavaṃ prītiraho karoti' ityatra vīpsāyāṃ
dvirvacanam, anena tu dvirvacane sublopaprasaṅgaḥ,
yathā---navanavāvanavāyubhirādedhe' iti | mūlemūle iti | ekasya
vastuno veṇudalāderekameva mukhyamagraṃ mūlaṃ ca, itareṣāṃ tu
bhāgānāmāpekṣiko mūlāgravyapadeśaḥ | sthaulyasaukṣmye api naikarūpe,
kiṃ tarhi ? yathāmūlamupacīyate sthaulm, yathāgraṃ ca saukṣmyamiti
vīpsāyā atrāsambhavaḥ | iha ṭhmūlemūle pathi viṭapinām' iti
vīpsāyāmeva dvirvacanam |
svārtha iti | arthāntarābhāvapradarśanārthamidamuktam |
asmārtkārṣāṇāditi | anekamāṣasamudāyaḥukārṣāpaṇam | tatra na
sarve māṣā dānakriyayā vyāpyante, kiṃ tarhi ? dvāveveti vīpsāyā
abhāvaḥ | nanu yathā dvāveva māṣau nirjñātau dānakriyayā vyāpyete,
tadā māṣaṃmāṣaṃ dehi---iti vīpsāyāṃ dvirvacanaṃ bhavati;
evamanekamāṣasamudāyādapi kārṣāpaṇād dvayorevāsti
dānakriyāvyāptiḥ ? maivam, tatra hi sannihitasyārthasya na kasyacid
varjanamasti; iha tu varjanamasti, yato māṣaṃmāṣamasau datvā śeṣaṃ
pṛcchati---kimanena kriyatāmiti | tadidamuktam---atra hīti | māṣaṃ
dehi dvau māṣau dehi trīnmāṣāniti | anena yathecchṃa dehīti
vivakṣayā avadhāraṇābhāvaṃ darśayati | cāpala iti prayoktṛdharmo'yam,
tasmin dyotye subantasya tiṅntasya ca sarvasya vākyagatasya padasya
dvirvacanaṃ nāvaśyamiti nedaṃ śāstrīyaṃ dvirvacanam, kiṃ tarhi ?
parapratyāyanāyānekasya svatantrapadasya prayoga ityarthaḥ | evaṃ ca kṛtvā
āmreḍitānudātatvābhāvādyathāprāptaḥ svaro bhavati |
kriyāsamabhihāra iti | loḍantasyevedaṃ dvirvacanam, na yaṅntasya;
loṭaḥ samuccaye'pi vidhānāt kriyāsamabhihārābhivyaktau kevalasya
sāmarthyābhāvāt | yaṅ tu kriyāsamabhihāraviṣaya eveti
taddyotane svayaṃ sāmarthyānnāpekṣate dvirvacanam |
ābhīkṣṇya iti | pūrveṇa vākyena kriyāsamabhihārasaṃśabdanena yo
vihitastadantasyaiva dvirvacanamiti śaṅkamānaṃ pratyasya
vākyasyopanyāsaḥ | nitya ityeva siddhamiti tatroktamiti |
ṭhnityavīpsayoḥ' ityatra hi ṭhktvāṇamulorloṭaśca
dvirvacanasāpekṣāṇāmeva paunaḥ punyaprakāśane śaktiḥ' ityuktam | anye
tvāhuḥ---ṭhpunaḥ punaḥ kriyāyā utpādanamābhīkṣṇyam | tathā
hi---bhuktvābhuktvā vrajatītyukte satyapi kriyāyā vicchede punaḥ
punarbhuṅkte punaḥ punarvrajatīti kriyāvṛttiḥ pratīyate, nityatā
tu kriyāyā avicchedaḥ, yatā jīvatijīvatītyukte jīvatyevāyamiti
pratīyate, na tvasau jīvitvā mriyate mṛtvā ca jīvatīti, jīvanameva
tvavicchinnaṃ pratīyate | tasmādābhīkṣṇyaṃ nityamiti
bhinnāvetāvarthau' iti |
apara āha---bhuktvā vrajatītyādau ktvāṇamulantasya tiṅntasya ca
dvirvacane prāpte ābhīkṣṇyasaṃśabdanena yo vihitastadantasya yathā
syāt, tiṅntasya mā bhūditi niyamārthamidamiti |
ḍācīti | viṣayasaptamīyam, tenānutpanna eva ḍācyakṛtaṭilopasya
paṭadityāderdvirvacanam, tataḥ ṭhavyaktānukāraṇāt' iti ḍāci
ṭilopaḥ, ṭhnityamāmreḍite ṭhḍāci iti pararūpatvam | apara
āha---idamevācchabdasya pararūpavidhānaṃ liṅgam---ṭhḍāci' iti
parasaptamyāmapi ṭilopātpūrvaṃ dvirvacanaṃ bhavatītyasyārthasyeti,
tadasata; patadityādau ṭilopādutarakālamapyacchabdasya sambhavāt |
dvitīyā karotīti | ṭhkṛño dvitīyā' ityādinā ḍāc | tatarhi
ḍāci dvirvacanaṃ vaktavyam ? na vaktavyam;
ācāryapravṛttirjñāpayati---ṭhḍācyavyaktānukaraṇasya dvircanaṃ bhavatīti,
yadayam ṭhnityamāmreḍite ḍāci' iti pararūpatvaṃ śāsti |
pūrvaprathamayoriti | pūrva, prathama---ityetayordvirvacanaṃ bhavati, kva ?
arthātiśayavivakṣāyām | anayoryo'rthastasyātiśaye vivakṣite |
ātiśāyiko'pi dṛśyata iti | dvirvacanena bādhe prāpte vacanam |
atiśayaśabdo'nuśatikādiṣu draṣṭavyaḥ | kecitu
arthabedādātiśāyikasyābādhyatvamāhuḥ | tathā hi---ṭhpūrvataraṃ
bhuṅkte' ityukte kimātmasādhyakriyāntarāpekṣaṃ bhojanasya pūrvatvam
? atha bhoktrāntarasādhyabhojanakriyāpekṣam ? iti sandeho bhavati |
evaṃ pūrvataraṃ puṣpyatītyukte'yamartho gamyate | na tāvadeṣa
kisalayito yāvadeṣa puṣpyatīti | pūrvaṃpūrvaṃ |
puṣpyatītyasmātvanyebhyaḥ puṣpitṛbhyo'tiśayena pūrva
puṣpyatītyarthaḥ pratīyate |
ḍataraḍatamayoriti | ḍataraḍatamāntasya dve bhavataḥ, samenāḍha|ltvādinā
dharmeṇa sampradhāraṇāyāṃ viṣaye | strīnigade bhāva iti | bhāvaḥubhūtiḥ,
sampatuāḍha|ltā, nigadyata iti nigadaḥ, ṭhnau gada' ityādinā karmaṇyap
| strīśabdena strīliṅgaḥ śabdo'bidhīyate, striyā nigadaḥ, kartari
ṣaṣṭhayāḥ samāsaḥ | strīliṅgaśabdābhidheyāyāṃ bhūtau
vartamānasyetyarthaḥ | katarākatarā anayorāḍha|lteti | kiṃ
sādhanasampatkṛtā ? uta bhāgyakṛtā ? iti praśnārthaḥ |
karmavyatihāra iti | kriyāvyatihāre ityarthaḥ | tatra dvirvacanaṃ
nityam, samāsavadbhāvastu bahulam | tatrānyo'nyaśabde
samāsavadbhāvābhāvātsubluk, samāsāntodātatvaṃ ca na bhavati,
āmreḍitānudātatvaṃ bhavati | itaretaraśabde tu nityaḥ
samāsavadbhāva iti subluksamāsasvarau bhavataḥ | anyo'nyamiti |
dvitīyaikavacanāntasya dvirvacanam | anyo'nyasyeti |
ṣaṣṭha|lekavacanāntasya | anyo'nyasambandhinaḥ putrādīnityarthaḥ |
strīnapuṃsakayoriti | utarapadasthāyā vibhakterāmbhāvaḥ;
anyathā'nekālatvātsa sarvasyotarapadasya syāt | tatra ṭhsarvanāmno
vṛttimātre puṃvadbhāvaḥ' iti pūrvotarapadayordvayorapi
puṃvadbhāve kṛte pakṣe āmvidhiḥ | anyāśabdasya tu dvirvacane
samāsavadbhāvābhāvādvahulavacanātstriyāṃ ṭāpo nivṛttiḥ |
napuṃsake ca ṭhadḍutarādibhyaḥ' ityasya nivṛttiḥ | vārtikeṣu
ṭhkarmadhārayavat' iti na sambadhyata iti sublugādi na bhavati ||
akṛcchre priyasukhayoranyatarasyām || 8|1|13 ||
priyapriyeṇeti tṛtīyaikavacanāntasya dvirvacane
karmadhārayavadbhāvāt subluki punastadeva vacanam |
atyantadayitamapi vastvanāyāsena dadātītyarthaḥ ||
yathāsve yathāyatham || 8|1|14 ||
ṭhyathāsve' iti ṭhyathā'sādṛśye' iti vīpsāyamavyayībhāvaḥ | svaśabda
ātmavacanaḥ, ātmīyavacano veti darśayati | yo ya ātmeti |
jñātidhanavacanasya tu grahaṇaṃ na bhavati; dvirvacanasya tatrāsamarthatvāt
||
dvandvaṃ rahasyamaryādāvacanavyutkramaṇayajñapātraprayogābhivyaktiṣu ||
8|1|15 ||
pūpavadasyeti | dvi au dvi sthite karmadhārayavadbhāvātsubluki
kṛte pūrvapadāvayavabhūtasyekārasyāmbhāvaḥ, utarapadāvayavasya cātvaṃ
nipātyate, cakārānnapuṃsakatvam, kvacidekavadbhāvaśca nipātyate,
samāsāntodātatvaṃ tu karmadhārayavadbhāvād bhavati | tatra rahasyaṃ
dvandvaśabdavācyamiti | dvābhyāṃ nirvṛte rahasye yogarūḍhirepetyarthaḥ
| dvandvaṃ mantrayanta iti | dvau dvau bhūtvā mantrayanta ityarthaḥ | evaṃ hi
tadrahasyaṃ bhavati | ācaturamiti | āṅbhividhau | caturṇāṃ pūraṇe
catuḥ śabdo draṣṭavyaḥ, ācaturthādityarthaḥ | dvandvaṃ mithunīyantīti |
mithunaśabdena maithuṃ tatkarma lakṣyate, tadicchatīti kyac, prāyeṇa
mithunāyanta iti kyaṅntaṃ paṭha|lte, tatropamānārtho mṛgyaḥ | mātā
putreṇetyādinā maryādāvacane vyanakti | tatputreṇāpīti |
etāvadeva paśūnāmāyuḥ | dvandvaṃ vyutkrāntā iti | dvau pakṣau bhūtvā
pṛthagavasthitā ityarthaḥ | svārthe dvirvacanamekavadbhāvaśceti | dvandvaṃ
nyañci pātrāṇi prayunakti u sādayati, nyañciunyagbhūtāni,
avāgbilāni | dvandvaṃ s}yaśca kapālāni ceti dvedve ityarthaḥ | atra
vīpsāyāṃ dvirvacanam, ambhāvādi, ekavadbhāvaśca | dvāvabhivyaktau
sāhacaryeṇetyartha iti | atra svārthe dvirvacanamekavadbhāvādikaṃ sarvaṃ
nipātyate |
dvandvaṃ yuddhamiti | atrāpi vīpsāyāṃ dvirvacanam | dvandvāni sahanta
iti | śītamuṣṇaṃ cetyekaṃ dvandvam, sukhaduḥ khe cāparam, kṣutṛṣṇe
cāparam | atrāpi svārthe dvirvacanamekavadbhāvādi,
tatraikaśeṣavaśādvahutvam | cārthe dvandva iti | dve cārthanirddiṣṭe
pade samaste dvandvaḥ | atrāpi svārthe dvirvacanādi, puṃstvaṃ ca ||
padasya || 8|1|16 ||
prāgapadāntādhikārāditi | ṭhapadāntasya mūrddhanyaḥ' ityatra tu prakaraṇe
virodhyupādānānnādikriyate | pacantau, yajantāviti |
saṃyogāntasthe'pi lopo na bhavati | evaṃ rājānāvityatra nalopo
na bhavati, praśāmāvityādau ṭhmo no dhātoḥ' iti natvaṃ na bhavati |
anantareṣu yogaṣvāmantritādeḥ subantasya tiṅntasya ca padasyaiva
kāryavidhānāteṣāmullaṅghanam | na ca samarthaparibhāṣopasthānaṃma
teṣu prayojanam, anantareṇāpyetaṃ vastutaḥ padakāryatvādeva siddheḥ
| kiñca---ṭhsamānavākye nighātayuṣmapadasmādādeśāḥ' iti vakṣyate |
kutvādīni tvavayavasya bhatve'pi samudāyasya padatvāśrayeṇeṣyanta
eva---vaktari, dogdharīti | tasmānna bhasaṃjñakavyāvṛttirapi prayojanam
|
ṭhṣaṣṭhī sthāneyogā' iti vacanāt ṭhpadasya' iti sthānaṣaṣṭhī, tataśca
ṭhudātasvaritayoryaṇaḥ svarito'nudātasya' ityasyāyamartho
bhavati---udātasvaritayoryoyaṇ tataḥ paro yo'nudātastadantasya
padasya svaritatvamalo'ntyasya bhavatīti | tataścātraiva
syāt---kumāryāviti; kumārya ityatra na syāt, sakāro hyatra
padasyāntaḥ, halsvaraprāptau ca vyañjanamavidyamānavadbhavati | evam
ṭhekādeśa udātenodātaḥ' ityatrāpi ayamartho
bhavati---udātānudātayorya ekadeśastadantasya
padasyālontyasyādeśo bhavatīti | tadaścehaiva syāt---vṛkṣāviti;
vṛkṣānityatra na syāt, nakāro hyatra padasyāntyaḥ ?
---ityāśaṅkyāha---vakṣyamāṇavākyāpekṣayeti |
amayabhiprāyaḥ---adhikāro'yaṃ parārthaḥ, paribhāṣāpi parārthā, tataśca
ṭhguṇānāṃ ca parārthatvādasambandhaḥ samatvātsyāt' iti nyāyena nātra
sthāneyogaparibhāṣopatiṣṭhate | yatra tvasyā adhikāro vakṣyamāṇeṣu
vākyeṣu tetvevopasthānam, tatra viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāve
kāmacārādyaṇekādeśasvarayoḥ ṭhpadasya' ityanuvṛtaṃ
kāryiviśeṣaṇārtham, na tu kāryapratipatyartham | tena
padāvayavayoranudātaikādeśayoḥ svaravidhānādanantyayorapi bhavati
| saṃyogāntalaepādau tu saṃyogādinā padasya viśeṣaṇāt
sthānaṣaṣṭhī, tasmādvakṣyamāṇāni vākyānyapekṣya paryālocya padasyeti
ṣaṣṭha|la artho vyavasthāpyaḥ, na tvetatsūtraparyālocanayeti |
vyavasthāmeva darśayati---kvaciditi | yadyeṣā sthānaṣaṣṭha|leva syāt
ṭhnalopaḥ prātipadikāntasya' ityatrāntagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt | taddhi
padāntasya yathā syāt, padāvayavasya mā bhūdityevamartham |
sthānaṣaṣṭha|laṃ tu ṭhalontyasya' ityasya siddhatvādantagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ
syāt | tasmādantagrahaṇāt kvacidviśeṣaṇaṣaṣṭha|lpi vijñāyate ||
padāt || 8|1|17 ||
prāk kutsane ca supyagotrādāvityetasmāditi | yadi tvatra
padādityetadanuvarteta, yatpacati pūtītyatraiva tiṅntasya nighātaḥ
syāt, na tu pacati pūtītyatra ||
anudātaṃ sarvamapādādau || 8|1|18 ||
yate niyatamityādi | atra mṛtyo ityasya pādādau nighātābhāvaḥ,
yadaṅgadāśuṣe tvamityekaḥ pādaḥ, agne ityaparaḥ, agne bhadraṃ
kariṣyatītyādīni codāharaṇāni |
rudro viśveśvara ityādi | atra yuṣmākam,
asamākamityanayorādeśābhāvaḥ |
ṛkpādaḥ ślokapādaśca gṛhyate iti | viśeṣānupādānāt | atha
sarvagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā ṭhananudāta padamekavarjam' iti
vacanādekasminpade eka evodātaḥ svarito vā sambhavati | ye tu
dvyudātāḥ---ṭhubhe vanaspatyādiṣu yugapat' iti, na yeṣāmatra
prakaraṇe kvacidanudātatvaṃ vidhīyate | yadā tu teṣāmāmantritatvam,
tadā dvyudātatvameva | idaṃ tarhi
prayojanam---anāderapyudātasyānudītatvaṃ yathā syāt, anyathā
padīdityadhikārād ṭhādeḥ parasya' ityādereva syāt, tataśca
ṭhtiṅṅatiṅaḥ' iti ihaiva syāt---devadataḥ pacatīti, atra hi
śaptipāvanudātau, dhātoḥ svaraḥ; iha tu na syāt---devadataḥ
karotīti, vikaraṇasvareṇa madhyodātametat padam | sarvagrahaṇe tu
sati padasya sarvo'vayavo'nudāto bhavatītyarthaḥ saṃpadyate, luṭi
pratiṣedhātsiddham, yadayaṃ ṭhna luṭ' iti pratiṣedhaṃ śāsti,
tajjhāpayati---ṭhnātrādeḥ parasyetyetadvyāpriyate' iti | na hi
luḍantaṃ kiñcidādyaudātamasti | evamapi jñāpakenāpavāde
ādividhāvapanīte alo'ntyasyaiva svād---ubho kuruta ityādau ? atra
asārvadhātukasya pratyasvareṇāntodātatvaṃ vikaraṇasya tu nighātaḥ, na
tu vikaraṇasvaraḥ satiśiṣṭo'pa sārvidhātukasvaraṃ bādhate, tāseḥ
lasārvadhātukānudātatvavidhānena jñāpanāt | evaṃ tahi lṛṭi
pratiṣedhātsiddham, yadayaṃ ṭhgatyarthaloṭā lṛṇna cet' iti lṛḍantasya
pratiṣedhaṃ śāsti, tajjñāpayati---nātra ṭhalo'ntyasya'
ityetadvyāpriyata iti, na hi lṛḍantaṃ kiñcidantodātamasti,
adupadeśātparaṃ lasārvadhātukaṃ nihanyate ? naitadasti;
jñāpakamiḍarthametat syāt bhokṣya iti |
etaddhaṣekādeśasvareṇāntodātam |
evaṃ tarhyuktametat---padasyeti kvacidviśeṣaṇaṣaṣṭha|lpi bhavati na
sthānaṣaṣṭha|leveti, tataḥ kim ? anudātavidhau
viśeṣaṇaṣaṣṭha|laśrayiṣyate, tatsāmānādhikaraṇyātiṅiti ṣaṣṭha|lrthe
prathamā, tiṅntasya padasyāvayavo'janudāto bhavatītyarthaḥ, tatra
sthānaṣaṣṭha|lbhāvād ṭhalo'ntyasya' iti na pravartate, tasmānnārthaḥ
sarvagrahaṇena ? ityata āha---sarvagrahaṇamityādi | asati sarvagrahaṇe yatra
vidheyāntaraṃ nāstyāmantritasyetyādau, tatraivānudātatvaṃ vidhīyeta
| tatra hyaetadvidhānārthamāmantritādyanūdyate, vidheyāntarasadbhāve tu na
tasyānudātatvaṃ vidhīyeta; vākyabhedaprasaṅgāt | tathā hisiddhasya
vastuno dharmāntaraṃ śakyate vidhātuṃ nāsiddhasya, na hyasati kuḍa|le
citrakarma; tataśca vāṃnāvādaya ekena vākyena vidheyāḥ, apareṇa ca
teṣāmanudātatvamiti vākyabhedaḥ |
viśiṣṭavidhāne'pyanekārthavidhānādvidhigauravalakṣaṇo vākyabhedaḥ
syādeva | sambhavatyekavākyatve vākyabhedaśca neṣyate | sati tu
sarvagrahaṇe tansāmarthyādvākyabhedaḥ sahyate ? ityāha---teneti |
prayojanāntaramāha---yuṣmadasmadādeśāśca savasya subantasya yathā
syuriti | anyathā kevalayoryuṣmadasmadoreva syuḥ, ṣaṣṭha|lekavacane
ṅso'si ṭhṅasiṅsośca' iti pūrvaikādeśe yadyapi doṣābhāvaḥ; tathāpi
vacanāntare doṣaprasaṅgaḥ | sarvagrahaṇena tu sati yuṣmadasmadbhyāṃ
tadavayavakaṃ padaṃ lakṣyata iti sarvasya padasya vāṃnāvādayo bhavantīti
| nanu na padasyeti vartate, vibhaktyantaṃ ca padam, tatrāntareṇāpi
sarvagrahaṇaṃ vibhaktyantasya bhaviṣyati ? ityata āha---yatrāpīti |
bhavedevaṃ yatra vibhaktyantaṃ padam, yatra tu vibhaktau padaṃ tatra
yuṣmadasmadoreva prasaṅga ityarthaḥ | grāmovāṃ dīyata iti |
caturthodvivacane, ṭhsvādiṣu' iti pūrvaṃ padaṃ bhavati ||
āmantritasya ca || 8|1|19 ||
sarvamanudātaṃ bhavatīti | āmantritasambandhinaḥ sarve'co'nudātā
bhavantītyarthaḥ | etaccānuvṛtasya sarvaśabdasyānvayamātraṃ pradarśitam, na
tvatrāsyopayogaḥ kaścit |
samānavākya ityādi | arthaikatvādikaṃ laukikaṃ vākyalakṣaṇam, iha tu
pāribhāṣikaṃ vākyam | ākhyātaṃ sāvyayakārakaviśeṣaṇaṃ vākyamiti,
ākhyātamityekatvaṃ vivakṣitam, nimitanimitinoḥ samāna
ekasminvākya ādhārabhūte sati nighātādayo bhavantīti vaktavyam,
kimarthamityāha---iheti | ṭhbhavatīha viṣṇumitraḥ, devadatāgaccha' iti
vākyadvayametat; tiṅntadvayayogāt | tatra devadatetyasyāmantritasya
nighāto na bhavati | nanu ca padavidhirayam, tataścāsāmarthyādevātra
na bhaviṣyati, astyatra sāmarthyaṃ viṣṇumitramanviṣyānyatra gacchantaṃ
devadataṃ pratīdamucyate, tataśca viṣṇumitrasyeha bhavanaṃ
devadatāgamanasya nimitatvenocyata itiyasti vyapekṣā |
kvacidetadudāharaṇaṃ na paṭha|lte | ayaṃ daṇḍa iti | astīti
gamyamānatvādetāvadekaṃ vākyam | atrāpyaneneti sarvanāmnā
paramṛṣṭasya daṇḍasya karaṇatvādasti sāmarthyamiti tiṅntasya
nighātaprasaṅgaḥ | odanaṃ paceti | tvatkartṛkatvena tvatsvāmiko
matsvāmikaścaudano bhaviṣyatītyevaṃ pākasya yuṣma dasmadarthasya ca
vyapekṣā'stītyādeśaprasaṅgaḥ, evamatiprasaṅgaparihāraḥ
prayojanamityuktam | idānīmavyāpriparihāro'pi
prayojanamityāha---iha ceti |
kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇameṣūdāharaṇeṣu nighātādayo na syurityata
āha---āmantritāntamityādi | iha sthitā mātetyanvayaḥ, na tviha
devadateti; nadyāḥ kūlamityanvayaḥ, na nadyāstiṣṭhatīti;
śālīnāmodanamityanvayaḥ, na śālīnāṃ te iti, tataścāsāmarthyānna
syurityarthaḥ ||
yuṣmadasmadoḥ ṣaṣṭhīcaturthīdvitīyāsthayorvānnavau || 8|1|20 ||
dvivacanāntayoreveti | tena vacanāntareṇodāhṛtamiti bhāvaḥ |
sthagrahaṇamanarthakam, ṣaṣṭha|ladiṣvādeśavidhānādeva tātsthyaṃsiddheḥ ?
ityata āha---sthagrahaṇamiti | śrūyamāṇavibhaktikayorevādeśā yathā
syuḥ, luptavibhaktikayormā bhūvannityarthaḥ | śrūyamāṇāyāṃ hi vibhaktau
tatsthatvaṃ bhavati, na punarluptāyām | patyayalakṣaṇenāpi kāryaṃ
śāstraṃ vā'tidiśyate, na tātsthyam | yadi vā
tiṣṭhatiravamavihānāvapi dṛṣṭaḥ, yathā---samaye tiṣṭha sugrīveti,
samayaṃ mā vihāsīrityarthaḥ | tenāyamarthaḥ---ṣaṣṭhīcaturthīdvitīyā
ajahatoryuṣmadasmadorādeśā bhavantīti | iti yuṣmatputra iti |
itiśabdātpadātparayoḥ ṣaṣṭha|lntayoryuṣmadasmadoḥ pratyayalakṣaṇena
vānnāvau na bhavataḥ ||
na cavāhāhaivayukte || 8|1|24 ||
caḥ samuccaye, vā vikalpe, ha ahetyadbhute, ha khede ca,
evo'vadhāraṇe | ebhiryukta iti | ebhiryoge satītyarthaḥ |
yadvā---ebhiryukte yuṣmadasmadārartha ityarthaḥ | yuktagrahaṇamanarthakam,
tṛtīyānirddeśata eva siddham, yathā ṭhtulyārthairatulopamābhyām'
ityatra ? ityata āha---yuktagrahaṇamiti | yadā
yuṣmadasmadarthagatānsamuccayādaāāścādayo dyotayanti, tadā taistayoḥ
sākṣādyogaḥ; tatraivāyaṃ pratiṣedho yathā syāt, yuktayukte mā
bhūdityevamartha yuktagrahaṇamityarthaḥ | etadeva yuktagrahaṇaṃ
liṅgam---atra prakaraṇe yuktayuktasyāpi grahaṇamiti, tenotaraḥ
pratiṣedho yuktayukteṣu bhavati ||
paśyārthaiścānālocane || 8|1|25 ||
darśanam u paśyaḥ | asmādeva nipātanād bhāve śapratyayaḥ,
pāghrādisūtreṇa paśyādeśaḥ, paśyo'rtho teṣāṃ te paśyārthāḥ,
tadāha---paśyārthā darśanārthā iti | yadi tu ṭhpāghrādhmādheṭdṛśaḥ śaḥ'
iti kartari śapratyayaḥ syāt, tato draṣṭrarthairityarthaḥ syāt, tathā
cālocanaparyudāso'narthakaḥ syāt, na hyālocanārthā draṣṭrarthā
bhavanti | darśanaṃ jñānamiti | yadyapi dṛśiścakṣurvijñāne prasiddhaḥ,
tathāpi tasya paryudāsāt jñānamātre dṛśiriha vartata ityarthaḥ | grāmaḥ
u janasamudāyaḥ | samīkṣya manasā nirūpyetyarthaḥ ||
sapūrvāyāḥ prathamāyā vibhāṣā || 8|1|26 ||
vidyamānapūrvāditi | ṭhtena saheti tulyayoge' ityatra ṭhtulyayoge'
ityapādheḥ prāyikatvādvidyamānavacanasyāpi sahaśabdasya samāsaḥ,
ṭhvopasarjanasya' iti sabhāvaḥ |
yuṣmadasmadorvibhāṣā'nanvādeśa iti | yeyaṃ yuṣmadasmadorvibhāṣā
sā'nanvādeśe bhavati, anvādeśe tu nityamādeśavidhirityarthaḥ |
apara āheti | pūrvasyaiva vākyasya vyākhyānāntaram | pūrva
vibhāṣā'nuvādena ṭhviṣayo niyamyate' ityuktam, idānīṃ tu
ṭhviśiṣṭe viṣaye vikalpa eva vidhīyate' ityucyate | na kevalaṃ
sūtroktaviṣaye ye prāptāsta eva vikalpyante, api tu sarve
sarvaviṣayā ityarthaḥ |
na tarhīti | vaktavyenaiva siddhatvāditi bhāvaḥ | anvādeśārthamiti |
nanu pūrvam ṭhanvādeśe sūtraṃ na vyāpriyate, ityuktam, idānīṃ tu
ṭhtatrāva vyāpriyate' ityucyate, tatko'tra nirṇayaḥ ?
ityāha---tadayamiti | taditi tatretyarthe | vākyopanyāse vā | pūrvā
vyākhyayā bādhyata ityarthaḥ ||
tiṅe gotrādīni kutsanā''bhīkṣṇyayoḥ || 8|1|27 ||
pacati gotramiti | pacirvyaktībhāve, yathā---lokapaktiriti,
bhojanādyarthaṃ gotraṃ khyāpayatītyarthaḥ, evaṃ hi kutsā bhavati |
pacatipacati gotramiti | vivāhādiviṣaye punaḥ punargotraṃ
khyāpayatītyarthaḥ | tatra kutsāyā abhāvādābhīkṣṇyagrahaṇam |
ṭhnityavīpsayoḥ' iti dvirvacanam | bruvaśabdaḥ kutsitavacanaḥ, ata
evāsyābhīkṣṇye pṛthagudāharaṇaṃ pradarśitam | pacati
pravacanamityādāvātmapraśaṃsayā kutsā | pravacanamuadhyāpanam |
ṭhvā nāma' iti gaṇasūtraṃ vyācaṣṭe---nāmetyetaditi | pacati
pāpamiti | pāpamiti kriyāviśeṣaṇam | khanati gotraṃ sametya
kūpamiti | gotraṃ kulaṃ samuditaṃ bhūtvā kūpaṃ khanatītyarthaḥ |
kimidaṃ kutsanā''bhīkṣṇyagrahaṇaṃ gotrādīnāṃ
pāṭhaviśeṣaṇam---etayorarthayorgotrādīni bhavanti, tāni ca tiṅḥ
parāṇyanudātāni bhavantīti ? āhosvidanudātaviśeṣaṇam---tiṅḥ
parāṇi gotrādīni anudātāni bhavantyetayorarthayoriti ?
asminvivāde nirṇayamāha---kutsanābhīkṣṇyagrahaṇaṃ ceti | paṭha|lta iti
pāṭhaḥ, sanniveśaviśeṣaḥ | tasya viśeṣaṇaṃ veditavyam | ayaṃ cārtho
yogavibhāgāllabhyate, ṭhtiṅe gotrādīni' ityeko
yogo'nudātavidhānārthaḥ, ṭhkutsanābhīkṣṇyayoḥ' iti dvitīyo
yogaḥ, gotrādīnītyeva, paribhāṣeyam | iha śāstre gotrādīni
kutsanābhīkṣṇyaviṣayāṇyeva grāhyāṇīti, tena kiṃ siddhaṃbhavati ? ityata
āha---teneti | anyatrāpīti |
ṭhcanacidivagotrāditaddhitāmreḍiteṣvagateḥ', ṭhkutsane ca gotrādau'
ityatra ||
tiṅṅatiṅaḥ || 8|1|28 ||
bhavati pacatīti | pacatītyetadbhavati, pākakriyā bhavatītyarthaḥ | tatra
sādhyasādhanabhāvena dvayoḥ kriyayoranvayādasti sāmarthyam |
yathoktam---pacyādikriyā bhavatikriyāyāḥ kartryo bhavantīti | tatra
pākasya svasādhanāni prati sādhyasyāpi bhavanaṃ prati siddhatvam | yathāha
bhartṛhariḥ---
ṭhtatra yaṃ prati sādhyatvamasiddhaṃ taṃ prati kriyā |
siddhā tu yasminsādhyatvaṃ na tameva punaḥ prati' || iti |
astyetat ? kim ! tarhi atiṅgrahaṇamanarthakam;
samānavākyādhikārāt, ṭhsamānavākye' iti vartate, na
caikasminvākye tiṅntadvayamasti, taduktaṃ purastāt | sūtrakāreṇa tu
samānavākyādhikāro na kṛta ityatiṅgrahaṇamakāri ||
na luṭ || 8|1|29 ||
śvaḥ kartetyādi | athātra nighāte pratiṣiddhekaḥ svaraḥ śrūyate ?
ityāha---tāseḥ parasyeti ||
nīpātairyadyadihantakuvinnecceccaṇkaccidyatrayuktam || 8|1|30 ||
yadyadārthe ca hetau ca vicāre yadiceccaṇaḥ |
hanta harṣe'nukampāyāṃ vākyārambhaviṣādayoḥ ||
kaccitpraśne nenniṣedhe praśaṃsāyāṃ kuvitsmṛtam |
yatrādhāre nipātatvaṃ yadādīnāṃ viśeṣaṇam ||
samāse guṇabhūtānāmapi gatyantaraṃ na hi |
naiva vā'thaṃ samāsaḥ subavyayatvena lupyate ||
tatra bahvṛcāḥ---ṭhnecced' iti
nipātasamāhāramadhīyate---nedevamāyunajannatra devāḥ |
anyaścennābhigacchatīti cedarthe vartata iti | ya eva samuccayādiṣu
dṛṣṭaścaśabdaḥ sa eva cedarthe vartate, tadarthavartinastu cihnaṃ ṇakāraḥ |
tathā ca cādayo'nudātā ityayaṃ cedartho'pyanudātaḥ, indraśca
mṛḍayāti naḥ; nataḥ paścādaghaṃ naśat, indraścedasmānmṛḍayet,
sukhayedityarthaḥ | tvaṃ ca soma no vaśo jīvātuṃ na marāmahe---he
soma tvaṃ cedasmān jīvātuṃ jīvituṃ vaśaḥ uśyāḥ kāmayethā
ityarthaḥ |
samuccayādiṣu yaścaśabda iti | eṣvartheṣu na bhavatītyarthaḥ |
udāharaṇeṣu karotiśabdo vikaraṇasvareṇa madhyodātaḥ | bhuṅkta
iti | udātanivṛttisvareṇāntodātaḥ | adhīta iti | ṭhahanviṅeḥ' iti
lasārvadhātukānudātatvapratiṣedhādantodātaḥ | iṇaḥ śatari rūpamiti
| ṭhiṇo yaṇ' iti yaṇādeśaḥ | nanu pratipadoktatvādyadyādibhiḥ
sāhacaryācca nipātasyaiva grahaṇaṃ bhaviṣyati ? evaṃ
tarhyetajjñāpayati---atra prakaraṇe nedamubhayaṃ vyavasthāpakamiti | tena
ṭhyāvadyathābhyām' ityatra ṭhyatadetetebhyaḥ parimāṇe vatup' iti
vyutpāditasya lākṣaṇikasyānipātasyāpi yāvacchabdasya grahaṇaṃ
bhavati---tāvaduṣo rādho asmabhyam, rāsva yāvatstotṛbhyo arado
gṛṇānā iti; yāvato'śvān pratigṛhṇīyāditi ca |
yatra kva ceti | atra yatretyasya utaramityanena sākṣātsambandhaḥ | dadhasa
iti | ṭhtadha dhāraṇe' anudātet | iha---
hantā'haṃ pṛthivīmimāṃ nidadhānīha veha vā |
hanto nu kimāsa se prathamaṃ no rathaṃ kṛdhi || iti
chāndasatvānnighātaḥ ||
naha pratyārambhe || 8|1|31 ||
naheti nipātasamāhāraḥ pratiṣedhe vartate | pratyārambhaḥupunarārambhaḥ
| tasya viṣayamāha---coditasyeti | bhuṅkṣva, adhīṣvetyevaṃ
coditasya kartaṣyatayopanyastasya bhojanāderavadhīraṇe'vajñāte sati
tasyāvadhīrayiturupālipsayāūpālabdhumicchayā tasyaiva bhojanādeḥ
pratiṣedhena sambandhaḥ pratyārambhaḥ, punarupanyāsaḥ kriyate iti yāvat
||
aṅgāprātilomya || 8|1|33 ||
prātilomyamupratikūlakāritvam,
tato'nyadabhimatakāritvamaprātilomyam | evaṃ cānulomya iti
vaktavyam | aṅgaśabda udāharaṇe'nujñāyām | pratyudāharaṇe tvamarṣe
||
hi ca || 8|1|34 ||
hiśabdo'vadhāraṇe hetau vā, sa ca pratyudāharaṇe tvamarṣe ||
cchandasyanekamapi sākāṅkṣam || 8|1|35 ||
atra hetuhetumadbhāvasya dyotako hirityanekamapi tiṅntaṃ hiyuktaṃ
bhavati | tatra pūrveṇa sarvasya nighātapratiṣedhe prāpte kvacidanekasya
kvacidekasya yathā syāditi vanacam | tadāha---kadāciditi | tatra
cchandasi dṛṣṭānuvidhānādyathāprayogaṃ vyavasthā | anṛtaṃ hīti | pāpmā u
mada ucyate | yasmādasau mato'nṛtaṃ vadati tasmādanṛtavadanadoṣeṇa
yujyata ityarthaḥ |
udajayadityādyaudātamiti | atrājayadityādyaudātamityarthaḥ | ajaniṣṭa
garbhamiti antarbhāvitaṇyarthatvājjaneratra sakarmakatvam ||
yāvadyathābhyām || 8|1|36 ||
yāvatsākalye, adhyavasāye vā, yathā yogyatādiṣu | ṭhyāvadyathābhyām'
iti tṛtīyeti darśayituṃ parabhūtayorapi prayoga udāhṛtaḥ |
tenaitadapi na codanīyam---ṭhyadvṛtānnityam' ityeva yathāśabde
yāvacchabde ca vatubantai siddhaḥ pratiṣedha iti ||
pūjāyāṃ nānāntaram || 8|1|37 ||
dvau pratiṣedhau prakṛtamarthaṃ gamayata ityāha---ki tarhyanudātamiti |
yāvaddevadata iti | nanu cotaratra niyamo vijñāsyate---vyavāye yadi
bhavati upasargeṇaiveti ? evaṃ tarhyutaratrāsya
prayojanam---upasargavyapetasya yāvadyathāśabdayośca madhye śabdāntaraṃ
mā bhūt | atha tu ṭhvyavāye yadi bhavati upasargeṇaiva' ityasmādeva
niyamātatrāprasaṅgaḥ ? tato'nantaragrahaṇaṃ śakyamakartum ||
upasargavyapetaṃ ca || 8|1|38 ||
vyavāyaḥ u vyavadhānam | anantaramityeveti | taccānantaryaṃ
sopasargasya, na tiṅntamātrasya ||
tupaśyapaśyatāhaiḥ pūjāyām || 8|1|39 ||
tuprabhṛtīni pūjāviṣayāṇi | māṇavakastu bhuṅkta iti | āścarye
tuśabda iti bhojanasya pūjā gamyate, evamanyatrāpi---paśya mṛgo
dhāvatīti | tatvakathanametat |
nanu ṭhpūjāyāṃ nānantaram' ityataḥ pūjāyāmityanuvartata evaṃ, tatkiṃ
pūjāyāmityanena ? tatrāha---pūjāyāmiti vartamāna iti | taddhīti |
tataśca tadanuvṛtāvihāpi ṭhna luṭ' ityādike viṣaye pratiṣedhasya
priṣedhaḥ syāt, mā bhūdevam; nighātasyaiva pratiṣedho yathā
syādityevamarthaṃ pūjāgrahaṇamityarthaḥ | kiñca---anantaramityevaṃ
tadabhūt, iha tvaviśeṣeṇeṣyate ||
aho ca || 8|1|40 ||
pṛthagyogakaraṇamutarārthamiti | utaro yogo'hoyoga eva yathā
syāt, tuprabhṛtibhiryoge mā bhūt ||
śeṣe vibhāṣā || 8|1|41 ||
aśūyāvacanametaditi | anāśvaryabhūtameva
vastvasūyannāścaryavatpratipādayatītyarthaḥ |
śeṣavacanaṃ kim, yāvatā yogavibhāgasāmarthyādeva pūrvaprakṛteṣu
kiñcinnānuvartata iti jñātam, tatra cānukṛṣṭatvāt ṭhpūjāyām'
ityetannivartiṣyate ? ata āha---pūjāyāmityasyeti ||
purā ca parīpsāyām || 8|1|42 ||
purāśabdo'tra bhaviṣyadāsati dyotayatīti | bhaviṣyato
vidyotanāderadhyayanāntarāyabhūtasyācirakālabhāvitvaṃ dyotayati,
tenātra tvarā gamyate iti bhāvaḥ | vidyotanādāvadhyayanaṃ dharmaśāstre
pratiṣiddham, atastadupanyāsena tvaritamadhīṣveti gamyate ityarthaḥ |
udāharaṇe ṭhyāvatpurānipātayoḥ' iti bhaviṣyadarthe laṭ,
pratyudāharaṇe ṭhlaṭ sme' iti | atra bhūtakālaviprakarṣamiti |
bhūtasyādhyayanasya cirakālapravṛtatvaṃ dyotayati | tena nātra tvarā
gamyata iti bhāvaḥ ||
nanvityanujñaiṣaṇāyām || 8|1|43 ||
kiṃcitkartu svayamevodyauktasyaivaṃ kriyatāmityevaṃ rūpo'bhyupagamaḥ u
anujñā | sūtrārthamudāharaṇena darśayati---karaṇaṃ pratīti |
upalakṣaṇametat, karaṇagamane pratītyarthaḥ | udāharaṇe ṭhvartamāne
laṭ' | pratyudāharaṇe tu bhūte ṭhnanau pṛṣṭaprativacane' ityenena
|ṭhaṅgāpratilomye' ityādivat siddhe itikaraṇa ekanipāto'yamiti
darśanārthaḥ; anyathā dvayorapi nipātayorgrahaṇaṃ sambhāvyeta ||
kiṃ kriyāpraśne'nupasargamapratiṣaiddham || 8|1|44 ||
apratiṣiddhamiti | apratiṣiddhārthamityarthaḥ |
pūrvaṃ kiṃyuktamiti | tatsamīpe kimaḥ śrūyamāṇatvāt | utaraṃ tu na
kiṃyuktamiti | viparyayāt |
apare ityādi | na samīpe śrūyamāṇatvaṃ kiṃśabdena sambandhe hetuḥ,
kintu saṃśayaviṣayatvam | tacca dvitīyasyāpyasti, atastasyāpi tena
yoga ityubhayatra pratiṣedha ityarthaḥ | ye tvāhuḥ---pūrvaṃ kiṃyuktamiti,
te manyante---astu dvayoḥ saṃśayaviṣayatvam, kiṃśabdena tu samīpe
śrutakriyāviṣaya eva praśno dyotyate, kriyāntaraviṣayastu praśna
āhosvidityanena, kriyāpraśna iti cocyate, tasmātasyaiva
nighātapratiṣedha iti ||
lope vibhāṣā || 8|1|45 ||
prakṛtatvātkima eva lopo vijñāyata ityāha---kimo lopa iti |
kva cāsyeti | śāstre kvacidapi kimo lopasyāvihitatvāt praśnaḥ |
na śāstrīyasyaivādarśanasya lopasaṃjñā, kiṃ tarhi ?
adarśanamātrasyetyutaram | yatreti | na ca prayujyata iti |
arthaprakaraṇādinā gamyamānatvāt | udāharaṇe āhosvicchabdaḥ
pakṣāntarapraśne, sa ca nāntareṇa pūrvapraśnamityarthāt pūrvatra kimartho
gamyate, tadāha---vinaiva kimeti |
prāptavibhāṣeyamiti | kathaṃ punaḥ prāptiḥ, yāvatā kiṃśabdena yogena
pūrvo yogaḥ ? tatrāha---kimartheneti | pūrvavatpratyudāharaṇānīti |
tānyeva kiṃśabdarahitānītyarthaḥ ||
ehimanye prahāse lṛṭ || 8|1|46 ||
ehimanya ityaneneti | samudāyābhiprāyamekavacanam, anyathā ākhyāte
dve āṅ cāpara iti bahuvacanaprasaṅgaḥ | udāharaṇe ṭhprahāse ca
manyopapade' ityādinā puruṣavyatyayaḥ |
suṣṭhua ca manyase iti | bhūtamarthaṃ darśayan prahāsābhāvamāha, ata eva
puruṣavyatyayo'pi na kṛtaḥ |
gatyarthaloṭā lṛḍityeva siddha iti | āṅpūrvādiṇo loṭ, sipo
hiḥ | anyatra mā bhūditi | kvānyatra mā bhūt ? vṛttikāreṇa
yatpratyudāhṛtam--ehi manyasa ityādi tatra |
kathaṃ punarehimanye ityanena yoganiyamaḥ kriyamāṇa ehi manyasa
ityanena yoganivṛttiṃ karoti ? ityāha---utamopādānamatantramiti |
atantratve kāraṇamāha---prahāsa eva hīti | tantratve niyamasya vyāvartyaṃ
na sambhavedityarthaḥ | bhāṣye tu pratyudāharaṇe'pyutama eva prayuktaḥ,
tatrāyamarthaḥ---ehi rathena tvaṃ yāsyasītyevamahaṃ manya iti ||
jātvapūrvam || 8|1|47 ||
jātvityetadapūrvamiti | atha tiṅntaviśeṣaṇamapūrvatvaṃ kasmānna
bhavati, yuktaṃ caitat, viśaṣaṇena sambandhuṃ yogye sati nimitini
nimitasyāpradhānasya na hi yuktaṃ viśeṣaṇam ? ucyate; yadayam ṭhāho
utāho cānantaram' ityatrānantaragrahaṇaṃ karoti, tato
jñāyate---nimitasyedaṃ viśeṣaṇamiti; anyathā tatrāpi ṭhapūrvam'
ityanuvṛtereva kevalatiṅntasyānantaya labhyata iti kiṃ tena ! nanu ca
śeṣapraklṛptyarthaṃ tatsyāt---ṭhśeṣe vibhāṣā', kaśca śeṣaḥ ? sāntaraḥ
śeṣa iti ? antareṇāpyanantaragrahaṇaṃ praklṛptaḥ śeṣaḥ | katham ?
apūrvamiti prakṛtam, sapūrvaḥ śeṣa iti ||
kivṛtaṃ ca cidutaram || 8|1|48 ||
vṛttimityadhikaraṇe ktaḥ, kimo vṛtaṃ kiṃvṛtamiti,
ṭhadhikaraṇavācinaśca' iti kartari ṣaṣṭhī, ṭhadhikaraṇavācinā ca' iti
samāsapratiṣedhe prāpte'smādeva nipātanātsamāsaḥ | yadi yatra
kiṃśabdo vartate tatsarvaṃ gṛhyaeta---kimīyaḥ, kaimāyaniḥ,
kiṃtarāmityādergrahaṇaprasaṅga iti matvā
parisañcaṣṭe---kiṃvṛtagrahaṇeneti | cidutaramityetatkiṃvṛtasya
viśeṣaṇam, na tiṅntasya; pūrvoktāt sāmānyāpekṣayā jñāpakāt ||
āho utāho cānantaram || 8|1|49 ||
apūvimityeveti | ata evotāhograhaṇam,
utaśabdapūrvatvādāhośabdasya ||
śeṣa vibhāṣā || 8|1|50 ||
kaśca śeṣa iti | bahūnāṃ prakṛtatvātpraśnaḥ | yadanyadantarāditi |
pratiṣedhasya nimitabhūtamāho--utāhīgrahaṇaṃ tāvadavaśyamanuvartyam,
utāhograhaṇāccāpūrvamityapyanuvartate; tatra
pāriśeṣyādanantarāpekṣa eva śeṣa iti bhāvaḥ ||
gatyarthaloṭā lṛṇna cetkārakaṃ sarvānyat || 8|1|51 ||
gaminā samānārthā gatyarthā iti | arthapradarśanametat, gatirartho
yeṣāmiti tu vigrahaḥ, gatyarthaloṭā yuktamiti yogaḥ,
punararthadvārako nimitanimitibhāvaḥ, loḍantavācyaṃ hi nimitaṃ
lṛḍantavācyasya | na cetkārakaṃ sarvaṃmanyadbhavatīti | sarvaṃ
cetkārakamanyat, tadā nighātapratiṣedho na bhavatīti bhāvaḥ | atra---
loḍante ca lṛḍante ca yāvatkiñcana kārakam |
kṛhyaeta yadā tatsarvaṃ vācyāvācyavivekataḥ ||
tadehāpi tarhi prāpnoti---
ṭhvaha brāhmaṇa śālīṃstvaṃ pitaitāṃstava bhokṣyate' iti ?
yatra hi sarvaṃ bhidyate, tatraiva na bhavitavyam, yathā vṛtāvupanyastayoḥ
pratyudāharaṇayoḥ |
na cātra bhidyate sarvamabhedācchālikarmaṇaḥ |
athāyamarthaḥ syāt---sarvasminkārake'nanyasminnaghātapratiṣedhaḥ, na tu
kvacidapi bhinna iti tadehāpi na syāt---āgaccha devadata
grāmamodanaṃ bhokṣyasa iti, bhidyate hyatra karma, tasmādvyākhyeyametat ?
tatrāha---yatraiveti | evakāreṇa vācyavyatiriktasya nirāsaḥ, na tu
sarvasyānanyatvaṃ vivakṣitam, tatspaṣṭīkṛtam | kartṛkarmaṇī eveti |
etacca pratyāsaterlabhyate, pratyāsannaṃ hi tatasya, yatenaivābhidhīyate |
udāharaṇeṣu prathamatṛtīyayoḥ sarvamananyat | drakṣyasītyasya tu
nighātaprasaṅgaścintyaḥ; nānāvākyatvāt,
dvitīyacaturthayorvācyamātraṃ vaherguṇabhūtagamanābhiprāyaṃ
gatyarthatvam, prāpaṇārthastvayam | tathā ca---
ṭhnīvahyaerharateścāpi gatyarthānāṃ tathaiva ca' |
iti bhedena gaṇanaṃ kṛtam | nanu ca śaktiḥ kārakam, sā ca pratikriyaṃ
bhidyate, tatkathamihābhinnaṃ kārakam ?
śaktiśaktimatorbhedasyāvivakṣitatvādadoṣaḥ |
āgaccheriti | liṅyaṃ na leṭ | paśyatīti | laḍayaṃ na lṛṭ,
pratyudāharaṇayoḥ sarvamanyat | kārakaśabdenāpi sūtre
kārakavyaktirevāśrīyate, tena kartṛkarmatvābhede'pi vyaktibhedāt
kārakabhedaḥ---tvaṃ cāhaṃ ca drakṣyāva iti | akriyamāṇe sarvagrahaṇe yatra
vācyaṃ na bhidyate tatraiva bhavitavyam, iha ca bhidyate
vācyam---ekatraikam, aparatra dvayamiti nighātapratiṣedho na syāt |
kriyamāṇe tu sarvagrahaṇe yathā sidhyati, tathā
darśayati---lṛḍantavācye hīti ||
loṭ ca || 8|1|52 ||
śādhīti | śārserloṭ, sip, sipo hiḥ, ṭhśā hau' iti śādeśaḥ,
tasyāsiddhatvāt jhallakṣaṇaṃ dhitvam | praśādhīti prāyeṇa pāṭhaḥ, sa na
yuktaḥ; sopasargatvenotarasūtraviṣayatvāt |
pṛthagyogakaraṇamutarārthamiti | utaro vikalpo loṭa eva yathā
syāt, lṛṭo mā bhūditi ||
hanta ca || 8|1|54 ||
hanta prabhuñjāvahai iti | bhujerloṭ, ṭhbhujo'navane'
ityātmanepadam, vahiḥ, ṭeretvam, ṭhāḍutamasya picca', ṭheta ai',
anudātetvāllasārvadhātukamanudātatvam, vikaraṇasvaraḥ |
āma ekāntaramāmantritamanantike || 8|1|55 ||
antarayatītyantaram u vyavadhāyakam | ekamantaraṃ yasya tadekāntaram,
udāharaṇe nighāte pratiṣiddhe ṣāṣṭhikamādyaudātatvam, ṭhdūrāddhūte ca'
iti plutaḥ; bhavacchabdasya ṭhvibhāṣā bhavadbhagavadaghavatām' iti
rutvam, avaśabdasya ca okāraḥ, ṭhbhobhago' ityādinā yatvam, tasya
ṭhhali sarveṣām' iti lopaḥ |
nanu ca ṭhāmantritaṃ pūrvamavidyamānavat' iti bhoḥ
śabdasyāvidyamānatvādekāntaratā nopapadyate ? ata āha---bho
ityetaditi |
tadubhayamapyanena kriyata iti | kathaṃ punaraprakṛtāyā
asaṃśabditāyāścaikaśruteḥ pratiṣedhaḥ śakyo vijñātum ? ucyate;
nañatra vipakṣavacanaḥ, adharmānṛtādivat, antikaviruddhamanantikam,
dūramityarthaḥ, tatra caikaśrutirucyate, tataśca pacasi
devadatetyādāvantike sāvakāśamāmantritanighātaṃ bādhitvā ekaśrutiḥ
prāpnoti, sā tāvatpratiṣiddhyate, tato'pavāde pratiṣiddha
utsargabhūto nighātaḥ prāpnoti, so'pi pratiṣidhyate,
ekaśrutimātrapratiṣedhe hi tatraivāyaṃ brūyāt---nāma ekāntaramiti |
evaṃ hi ṭhāmantritamanantike' iti ca na vaktavyaṃ bhavati, so'yamevaṃ
siddhe yannighātaprakaraṇe idaṃ bravīti tena vijānīmaḥ---nighāto'pi
pratiṣidhyata iti | kevalasya nighātasyekaśrutyā bādhitasya
pratiṣedho'narthaka iti sāmarthyādubhayoḥ pratiṣedhaḥ |
nanu caikaśrutirapi devadatā3 āgacchetyādau sāvakāśā kathamāṃ bho
devadata ityādau nighātasya bādhikā, pratyuta paratvādekaśruternighāta
eva bādhaka iti tasyaivātra prasaṅga iti pratiṣedho'pi tasyaiva nyāyyaḥ,
tasya ca pratiṣedhe ekaśrutiḥ syādeva ?
atrāhuḥ---padadvayamātranibandhanatvādantaraṅgo nighātaḥ pūrvaṃ
pravartate, tato dūrātsambodhanamadhikaṃ
nimitamapekṣamāṇaikaśrutiriti saivānantaraṃ prāpnoti, tāṃ
tāvadvādhate pūrvoktena nyāyena nighātamapīti
suṣṭhūaktam---tadubhayamanena kriyata iti |
yathaiva tarhi ekaśrutirbādhyate, tathaiva plutodāto'pi bādhyeta ? ata
āha---plutodātaḥ punariti | apareṣāmiti | te
manyante---sādṛśye'tra nañ, na vipekṣe; anyathā dūra ityeva
brūyāditi prāptireva nāsti, adūratvāt | kathaṃ tarhi pluta
udāhriyate ? ata āha---pluto'pīti ||
yaddhituparaṃ cchandasi || 8|1|56 ||
jāye svo rohāvaihīti | ruherloṭ, vas, śap, ṭhāḍutamasya
picca', ṭhloṭo laṅvat' iti laṅvadbhāvāt ṭhnityaṃ ṅtiḥ' iti
salopaḥ, āhpūrvādiṇo loṭ, sipo hiḥ, ehītyanena
parabhūtena yuktasya rohāvetyasya ṭhloṭ ca ' iti prāpto
nighātapratiṣedho niyamena nivartyate, tena svaśabdāśrayo nighāto
bhavati | nanu ṭhparamapi cchandasi' iti vacanāt svaḥ śabdasya
pūrvāṅgavadbhāvajjāyesvarityāmantritam, tataśca ṭhāmantrita
pūrvamavidyamānavat' ityavidyamānatvānnighāto na prāpnoti,
pratiṣidhyate'trāṅgavadbhāvaḥ---avyayānāṃ pratiṣedha iti ? naivam;
atrāṅgavadbhāvaḥ prāpnoti, uktaṃ hi
tatra---ṭhṣaṣṭha|lamantritakārakavacanam' ṭhtannimitagrahaṇaṃ ca' iti | na hi
svaḥ śabdaḥ ṣaṣṭha|lnta āmantritakārakaṃ tannimitaṃ vā svare
vāṅgavadbhāvo nāvidyamānavatvam | svaḥ śabdasya ṭhro ri' iti
lopo na bhavati, utvaṃ ca bhavati; chāndasatvāt | athedānīṃ
rohāvetyanena yuktasya ehītyasya ṭhloṭ ca' iti nighātapratiṣedhaḥ
kasmānna bhavati, na ruhirgatyarthaḥ, ṭhgatyarthākarmaka' ityatra
pṛthaggrahaṇāt ? yadi na gatyarthaḥ, ārohanti hastinaṃ manuṣyāḥ
ārohayati hastī manuṣyān, ṭhgatibuddhipratyavasānārtha' iti
karmasaṃjñā na prāpnoti | tasmāduparigamanarūpavyāpāro ruherarthaḥ |
ṭhgatyarthākarmaka' ityatra ca ruhigrahaṇaṃ prapañcārtham | ehītyasya tu
nighātapratiṣedho na bhavati; ṭhvibhāṣita sopasargamanutamam' iti
vacanāt ||
canacidivagotrāditaddhitāmreḍiteṣvagateḥ || 8|1|57 ||
ihāpīti | na kevalaṃ tiṅe gotrādīnītyatraivetyapiśabdārthaḥ | tatra
hetustatraiva pratipāditaḥ | śuklīkaroti caneti | agateriti
pratiṣedhābhāvādatra nighātapratiṣedho bhavatyeva | yatkāṣṭhamiti |
śuklīśabdasya nighāto na bhavati ||
cādiṣu ca || 8|1|58 ||
ta iha gṛhyanta iti | pratyāsateḥ | ṭhcādayo'satve' ityatra yeṣāṃ grahaṇaṃ
te viprakṛṣṭaḥ | ṭhsamuccayo vikalpaścānekasya dharmaḥ' ityutarasūtre
vakṣyati, ataḥ khādati cetyasyopanyāsaḥ | na tvasya nighātaprasaṅgaḥ;
nānāvākyatvāt | khādati hetyādestu prakramābhedāyopanyāsaḥ |
paraṃtu nihanyata eveti | praśabdātsamānavākyagatāt padātparatvāt
||
cavāyoge prathamā || 8|1|59 ||
agateriti | pūvasūtra ityādi | ata eva pūrvasūtre
pratyudāharaṇāvasara uktam---prathamasyātra tiṅntasya cavāyoge
prathameti nighātaḥ pratiṣidhyata eveti | prathameti strīliṅgasya
nirvāhamāha---prathamā tiṅvibhaktiriti |
prathamāgrahaṇavyāvartyasya dvitīyādeḥ sambhavamāha---cavāyogo hīti ||
heti kṣiyāyām || 8|1|60 ||
ācārabhedaḥ u ācārollaṅghanam | udāharaṇe---upādhyāye padātau
gacchati śiṣyasya rathena gamanaṃ pratiṣiddham---ityācārabhedaḥ ||
aheti viniyoge ca || 8|1|61 ||
nānāprayojana iti | aneka prayojano niyogaḥ u preṣaṇam |
plutaśceti | sa punaḥ kṣiyāyāṃ kṣiyāhetukaḥ, viniyoge
praiṣahetukaḥ ||
cāhalopa evetyavadhāraṇam || 8|1|62 ||
udāharaṇe calopaṃ darśayati---grāmaṃ ceti | evamahalope'pi
draṣṭavyam | tatra prathame grāma karmakasyāraṇyakarmakasya ca devadata eva
karteti samānakartṛkatvam, dvitīye tu viparyayānnānākartṛkatā
draṣṭavyā | anavaklṛptiḥ u asambhavanam | yo hi devadatasya bhojanaṃ
kvacidapi na sambhāvayati, sa evaṃ prayuṅkte---kveva bhokṣyasa iti |
ṭheve cāniyoge' iti pararūpatvam | kvacitu vṛtāvevaitat paṭha|lte
||
cādilāpe vibhāṣā || 8|1|63 ||
pūrvo yoga evaśabdaprayoge nityārthaḥ ||
vaivāveti ca cchandasi || 8|1|64 ||
vai sphuṭārthe, kṣamāyāṃ ca | vāva prasiddhau, sphuṭārthe ca |
ekānyābhyāṃ samarthābhyām || 8|1|65 ||
samau tulyāvarthau yayostau samarthau, śakandhvādiṣu
darśanātpararūpatvam | nipātanādvā'ntalopaḥ | parasparaṃ samānārthatā
na; tiṅntena asambhavāt | tiṅntena saṅgatābhyāmityayaṃ tvartho na
bhavati, ṭhcavāyoge prathamā' ityato yogagrahaṇānuvṛterevāsyārthasya
siddhatvāt | jinvatīti | jiviḥ prīṇānārthaḥ, iditvānnum,
laṭtipśapaḥ | cākaśītīti | kāśinā samānārthaḥ kaśiḥ
prakṛtyantaramastītyuktam, tasyaitadyaṅluki rūpam |
ekaśabdasya vyavasthārthaṃ ceti | atastasyaiva pratyudāharaṇaṃ darśitam,
nānyaśabdasyeti bhāvaḥ | vyabhicāritvātasyeti | ekaśabdo hyanyātha
vyabhicaratīti | nānārtho hyayamiti hi ṭheko gotre' ityatra dasitam |
tatrāsati samarthagrahaṇe'nyaśabdena bhinnārthasyāpi grahaṇaprasaṅgaḥ | na ca
sāhacaryamatra prakaraṇe vyavasthāpakamiti ṭhnipātairyadyadihanta'
ityatrāvocāma ||
yadvṛtānnityam || 8|1|66 ||
ṭhkiṃvṛtaṃ ca cidutaram' ityatra kiṃvṛtaśabdasya darśitā
vyutpattirihānugantavyā | etannāśrīyata iti | tadāśrayaṇe hi yadra|lṅ,
yadīyam, yādāyanirityādibhyaḥ parasya na syāt | juhuma iti |
pratyayasvareṇāntodātametat, ṭhabhyastānāmādiḥ', ṭhbhīhrībhṛhumada'
iti cobhayatrāpi acīti vartate | yadra|lṅiti | yadañcati, kvin,
ṭhviṣvagdevayośca' iti ṭeradra|ladeśaḥ |
kathaṃ punaḥ pañcamīnirddeśe sati yatkāmāste, yadra|lṅ
vāyurityādau vyavadhāne bhavati ? ata āha---pañcamīnirdeśe'pyatreti
| etaccotarasūtre jñāpayiṣyate | yāthākāmye veti | yāthākāmyam u
yathecchapravṛttiḥ, deśakālānapekṣā, tatra gamyamāne vā
nighātapratiṣedhaḥ, yatra kvacana yajate ||
pūjānāt pūjitamanudātaṃ kāṣṭhādibhyaḥ || 8|1|67 ||
ṭhkāṣṭhādibhyaḥ' iti vārtike dṛṣṭṃa sūtrāvayavatvena
paṭhitatvātadanurodhena pūjanādityekavacanaṃ bahuvacanasthāna iti
vyācaṣṭe---pūjanebhyaḥ kāṣṭhādibhya iti | utarapadamiti | utarasūtre
tiṅgrahaṇādasya ca sūtrasya samāsaviṣayatvātsubantamiti draṣṭavyam |
kāṣṭhādayaścaite'dbhutaparyāyāḥ pūjanavacanā bhavanti, tatra yeṣāṃ
vṛttiviṣaya evādbhutaparyāyatvamamātāputrādīnāṃ tepvanyapadena
vigrahaḥ | kāṣṭhādhyāpaka iti kriyāviśeṣaṇam | kāṣṭhaśabdo
dvitīyāntaḥ samasyate | kṛdyogalakṣaṇā tu ṣaṣṭhī kriyāviśeṣaṇepu na
bhavati, dhātvarthaṃ prati yatkarma tatraiva ṣaṣṭhīḥ, kartṛpadena
sāhacaryāt | yo hi dhātvarthaṃ prati kartā tatra ṣaṣṭhī, tatsāhacaryāt
karmāpi tādṛśameva gṛhyate | viśeṣaṇaṃ tu dhātvarthena
samānādhikaraṇatvānna taṃ prati karma | sarvathā kriyāviśeṣaṇānna ṣaṣṭhī
bhavati, ata eva malopa iti vakṣyate | ṣaṣṭha|laṃ satyāṃ
makārābhāvādanupapannametatasyāt | kathaṃ punaḥ kartṛpradhāne kṛdante
guṇabhūtāyāḥ kriyāyā viśeṣaṇena sambandhaḥ,
sādhanasambandhavadupapadyate; tadyathā---grāmaṃ gata ityādau guṇabhūtāyā
api kriyāyāḥ sādhanena yogaḥ, tathā viśeṣaṇenāpi nānupapannaḥ |
kāṣṭhābhirūpaka iti | ābhirūpyaṃ kāṣṭhena viśeṣyata iti
napuṃsakaprathamāntasya samāsaḥ | evaṃ sarvatra pravṛttinimitamātreṇa
kāṣṭhādīnāmanvayād dravyavācibhiḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyābhāvāt
mayūravyaṃsakāditvamāśritam |
samāse cetyādi | cakāro'vadhāraṇe, yadi samāse evaitadiṣyate,
kathaṃ vārtikakāreṇoktam---pūjitasyānudātatve kāṣṭhādigrahaṇaṃ
malopaśceti; na hi samāse teṣāmantyo makāraḥ sambhavati,
vibhakterluptatvāt ? ityata āha---malopaścetyanenāpīti | kathaṃ
purathaṃ viṣayo'nenākhyāyate ? ata āha---yatreti | samāse hi
vibhakterabhāvānmakāro na śrūyate ayameva lopa iti | kiṃ punaḥ
kāraṇamevaṃ kāśakuśāvalambanena vātikaṃ vyākhyāyate ? ata
āha---asamāse hīti | anye tvāhuḥ---yadi samāsa
evaitadabhimatamabhaviṣyat ṭhsamāse' ityevāvakṣyat; malopavacanātu
vākyaviṣayamevaitat | dāruṇamadhyāpaka ityādikaṃ tu rūpaṃ yadīṣyate
vikalpena malopo vaktavya iti | 
pūjanādityeva pūjitaparigrahe siddha iti | pūjanasya
pūjatāpekṣatvāditi bhāvaḥ | anantarapūjitapratipatyarthamiti |
ṭhpūjanātpūjitam' iti sūtre sāmānyagatamānantarya viśeṣāṇāṃ
vijñāyata iti bhāvaḥ | kathaṃ punaḥ pañcamīnirdeśe vyavahitasya
prasaṅgaḥ ? ityāha---etadeveti | jñāpanasya prayojanamāha---tathā ceti
|
anudāta iti vartamāna ityādi | prakṛtaṃ hyanudātagrahaṇam ṭhna luṭ'
ityādinā pratiṣedhena sambaddham, atastadanuvṛtau
pratiṣedho'pyanuvarteta | tatra yadyapyasya yogasya
samāsaviṣayatvātādṛśo viṣayo na sambhavati, yatrāmantritādau
nighātaḥ pratiṣidhyate; tathāpi ṭhkutsane ca supi' ityādau utaratra
pratiṣedha eva syāt | tasmātannivṛtyarthaṃ punaranudātagrahaṇam ||
sagatirapi tiṅ || 8|1|68 ||
yatkāṣṭhṃa pacatīti | ye'pi ṭhmalopaśca' ityanena vākyena
malopamāhuḥ te'pi tiṅnte parato naiva lopamicchanti |
sagatigrahaṇādratirapi nihanyata iti | katham ? tulyayoge'tra
sahaśabdaḥ, yatra tulyayoge sahaśabdastatra dvayorapi kāryayogo
bhavati, tadyathā---saputro bhojyatāmityukte putro'pi bhojyate
apigrahaṇaṃ yatra gatirna prayujyate tatra kevalasyāpi tiṅntasya yathā
syāt, gatiprayoge tu dvayoḥ sahaiva bhavati, tiṅgrahaṇātpūrvo
yogaḥ subantaviṣaya eva vijñāyate ||
kutsane ca supyagotrādau || 8|1|69 ||
pacati kliśnātīti | kathamatra samānavākyatvaṃ sāmarthyaṃ ceti cintyam
|
kartuḥ kutsane mā bhūt, pacati pūtīti | kartṛtvamatra
kutsyate---asyedamayuktamiti | kriyā tu śobhanaiva, tatra kartṛtvasya
viśeṣaṇaṃ pūtitvaṃ na kartrā samānādhikaraṇamiti
dāruṇamabhirūpakamityādivannapuṃsakatvam | evaṃ
dvibahvorapyekavacanameva bhavati---pacataḥ pūti, pacanti pūtīti |
prāyeṇa pūtiriti puṃlliṅgaṃ paṭha|lte | nanu
kriyāpradhāne'sminnākhyāte sādhanaṃ kathaṃ viśeṣaṇena sambandhamapradhānaṃ
paṭha|leta ? ucyate; 
ekārthībhāvamāpannaṃ vṛtau yadupasarjanam |
viśeṣaṇena sambandhastasya naivopapadyate ||
na hi bhavati---ṛddhasya rājapuruṣa iti | yasya tu
naikārthībhāvastadapradhānamapi viśeṣaṇena saṃyujyate, yathā---ṛddhasya
rājñaḥ puruṣa iti | evaṃ sādhanaṃ kriyāṃ prati
guṇabhūtamapyekārthībhāvādviśeṣaṇena yujyate, tathā sādhanapradhāneṣu
kṛdanteṣu kriyā guṇabhūtā'pi viśeṣaṇena yujyate---dāruṇamadhyāyaka
iti | yathaiva tahi sādhanasya viśeṣaṇena yogaḥ, evaṃ kriyāntareṇāpi
prāpnoti---pacati paṭhati, pacati dṛśyati, pācakaḥ paṭhati, pācakaḥ
paśyatītivat ? kiṃ kurmaḥ, na tāvadevaṃ dṛśyate ! tadetadevaṃ
pratipatavyam---
bhāryā stryantarasambandhaṃ patyurna sahate yathā |
snānādikaṃ tu saṃskāraṃ svārthamevānumanyate ||
tathā kriyāpi---
viśeṣaṇena sambandhaṃ kartuḥ svasyānumanyate |
svānuraktaṃ tu kartāraṃ na kriyāntaragāminam || iti |
pūtiśceti | tibantaḥ pūtiśabda ādyaudātaḥ | vasestibiti | tib
bāhulakātpūño'pi bhavati, bāhulakādeva guṇābhāvaḥ | tasya
nighātanimitasyāntodātatvaṃ yathā syāditi citvamupasaṅkhyāyate |
vibhāṣitamiti | bahvatha tiṅntaṃ vibhāṣā nihanyate, yadā nihanyate
tadā pūtirantodātaḥ |
kriyākutsane ityādi yaduktam, tatra pramāṇatvena bhāṣyapaṭhitāmāryāṃ
paṭhati---supi kutsana iti | malopa iṣṭo'tiṅ coktārthimiti |
bhāṣye tāvadayamarthaḥ | malopaśceti vārtikakāreṇokte malopastīṅ
neṣṭaḥ---dāruṇaṃ pacatīti | ityevaṃ malopaśceti
vākyamuktārthamācāryairiti | vṛtau tu ślokāntargatatvādayaṃ pādaḥ
paṭhito na tvatrāsyopayogaḥ kaścit; ṭhsamāse
caitadanudātatvamiṣyate' ityuktatvāt ||
gatirgatau || 8|1|70 ||
abhyuddharatīti | sarvopasargasādhāraṇī haraṇakriyā pratīyate,
tāmudviśinaṣṭi uddharatīti | udaivordhvatā viśiṣṭā'vagamyata
tāmabhirviśinaṣṭi abhyaddharatīti | tatra---
anyo'nyāpekṣayā nāsti gatitvaṃ yadyapi dvayoḥ |
kriyāṃ prati gatitvātu nihato'bhirgatirgatau ||
samudānayatīti | atra samudordvayorapi nighātaḥ |
abhisamparyāharatīti | atra trayāṇām ||
gatāviti kimiti | kriyāṃ prati gatirbhavati, kriyā ca dhātuvācyā |
dhātuśca dvividhaḥ---sagatiḥ, agatiśca | pratyayā api dhātordvaye
bhavanti---kṛtaḥ, tiṅśca | tatra kṛdante sagatāvagatau ca
kṛtsvarathāthādisvareṣu kṛteṣu śeṣanighātena gatirnihanyata eva |
tiṅnte'pi kevale udātavati tāvadutarasūtreṇa bhavatyeva nighātaḥ,
anudātetu niyamāśrayaṇānna bhaviṣyati, tiṅnte yadi bhavati
udātavatyeva bhavati, tataśca sagatireva tiṅvaśiṣyate iti praśnaḥ |
āmandrairiti | nanu ca kriyāyoge gatibhavati, na cātrāṅḥ
