kriyāyogo'sti, mandraśabdasyākriyāvācitvāt ? ata
āha---yāhītyetatpratīti | ṭhte prāgdhātoḥ' iti prayoganiyamaḥ, na
saṃjñāniyamaḥ, tataśca vyavahitaprayoge'pi gatitvamastyeveti bhāvaḥ |
nanu yatkriyāyuktāḥ prādayastaṃ prati gatyupasargasaṃjñā bhavanti, tataśca
yāhītyetatprati gatitvena mandraṃ pratyagatitvādaprasaṅgaḥ, ihāpi tarhi
na prāpnoti---abhyuddharatīti, udaṃ pratyagatitvāt ? mā bhūdudaṃ prati
gatiḥ, samudāyaṃ tu prati gatirbhavati, udā viśiṣṭā hi kriyā abhinā
viśeṣyate | ā mandrairityatrāpi mandrādikaraṇakamindrakartṛkaṃ
yānamāṅa viśeṣyata iti samudāyaṃ kriyāviśeṣavācinaṃ pratyāṅe
gatitvānnighātaḥ prāpnoti ? na prāpnoti ; pūrvaṃ dhāturupasargeṇa
yujyate paścātsādhanena, āyāne hi mandrādeḥ sādhanatvaṃ
mandrairharibhirāyāhīti, na tu yāne; tataśca na samudāyaṃ pratyāṅe
gatitvamiti nāstyevātra prasaṅgaḥ | tatrāha---tasyeti | na hi
paranimitānupādāne ṭhyatkriyāyuktāḥ prādayastaṃ prati' iti gamyate,
tataśca vastuto gatitvāśrayo nighātaḥ syāditi manyate |
yadi punaḥ ṭhpadasya' ityadhikārātsamarthaparibhāṣopasthānādyena gateḥ
sāmarthyaṃ taṃ prati gateriti vijñāyate, tadā śakyaṃ gatāvityavaktum,
yadāha---ṭhgateranudātatve gatigrahaṇānararthakyam,
tiṅyavadhāraṇācchando'rthamiti cennāgatitvāt' iti ||
tiṅ codātivati || 8|1|71 ||
udāharaṇe ṭhnīpātairyadyadi' iti nighātapratiṣedhātiṅntamudātavat |
tiṅgrahaṇaṃ kimartham ? tiṅnte yathā syāt, mandraśabde mā
bhūt---ā mandrairindra haribhiryāhi | mandraśabdo
rakpratyayānto'ntodātaḥ |
nanu ca ṭhyatkriyāyuktāḥ' iti vacanādgatiśabdaḥ pitrādiśabdavat
sambandhiśabdatvāt svasambandhinamākṣipatīti
kriyāvācinyevodātavapi bhaviṣyati kṛdante cātiprasaṅgābhāvaḥ
pūrvasūtre evoktaḥ, tasmānnārthastiṅgrahaṇena ?
ityāśaṅkyāha---tiṅgrahaṇamiti | parimāṇamuiyatā |
parimāṇārthatvameva spaṣṭayati---anyathā hīti | akriyamāṇe
tiṅgrahaṇe dhātureva kriyāvācitvād gatisaṃjñānimitamiti
tatraivodātavati nighātaḥ syāt, na tu pratyaye | tiṅgrahaṇātu
prakṛtibhāgaṃ prati gateḥ pratyayodātatvenāpyudātavati tiṅntamātre
bhavati | dhātumeva prati gatisaṃjñeti | yasya kriyā yatkriyeti
ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ, anvayavyatirekābhyāṃ yasya vācyā kriyā taṃ pratītyarthaḥ |
dhātoreva cāsau vācyeti tameva prati gatitvam |
āmante tarhi na prāpnotīti | nanu cākriyamāṇe'pi tiṅgrahaṇe
naivāmante prāpnoti, yadā hi tiṅnte'pi
pratyayodātatvenodātavati na syāditi sthitam, tadā kā vārtā
āmante ! tatkimucyate---āmante tarhīti ? evaṃ tarhyayamatrārthaḥ---yadi
tiṅgrahaṇādyatnātprakarotītyādau bhavati, tarhi tasyāmante'bhāvānna
prāpnoti; tasmādyā kriyā yatkriyā---iti karmadhāraya āśrayaṇīyaḥ | evaṃ
hi kriyālakṣaṇamarthaṃ prati gatitvam, tatrārthe kāryasyāsambhavātadvācini
kāryaṃ vijñāyamānaṃ kriyāpradhāne sarvatra sidhyatīti | anantaroktaṃ
codyaṃ pakṣaviśeṣe vyavasthāpayitumāha---atra keciditi | atra pakṣe
gatikārakopapadānāmityasyāyamarthaḥ---gatyādīnāmaviśeṣeṇa
samāso bhavati, kṛddhistu prāk subutpateriti |
avyayapūvapadaprakṛtisvaratve iti | ṭhgatikārakopapadāt' ityatra
prapacatideśyādyarthaṃ kṛdgrahaṇaṃ sthitam, na pratyākhyātamiti
pūrvapadaprakṛtisvarasyaivātra prasaṅga iti manyate | akriyamāṇe'pi
tiṅgrahahaṇa iti | yathā vā kriyamāṇe tiṅgrahaṇe udātatve sati
nighātaḥ sidhyati, tathā'nantaramevoktam |
atha tarabantasyeti | yathāyaṃ pakṣaḥ sambhavati, yaścātra pakṣe
doṣaḥ---tatsarvam ṭhgatikārakopapātkṛt' ityatraivoktam |
yeṣāṃ tvityādi | kugatyādīnāṃ kṛdantenaiva, tatrāpi prāk
subutpaterityarthaḥ | tadarthaṃ yatnaḥ kartavya iti | tatrāyaṃ
yatnaḥ---tiṅgrahaṇaṃ na kariṣyate; yā kriyā, yatkriyeti vā''śrayiṣyata
iti |
āmantritaṃ pūrvamavidyamānavat || 8|1|72 ||
kimadamavidyamānavat ? ityāha---tasminsatītyādi | tatra tasminsati
yatkāryaṃ tanna bhavatītyatrodāharaṇamāha---āmantritatiḍanighāteti |
asati ca yatkāryaṃ tadbhavatītyatrodāharaṇamāha---pūjāyāmityādi |
āmantritādyaudātatve kartavye iti | asati pūrvagrahaṇe
ṭhāmantritamavidyamānavat' tyucyamāne svasyādyaudātatve'pi ṣāṣṭhike
kartavye'vidyamānavat syāt, ka idānīṃ tasyāvakāśaḥ ?
yatrāvidyamānavadbhāvaḥ pratiṣidhyate, vikalpyate vā; tathā ṭhapādādau'
vityadhikārātpādādirapyavakāśaḥ---uṣo no adhaṣu havā vyucchanan,
nasbhāvo hyatrāvidyamānavadbhāvādeva bhavati; indra tvā vṛṣabhaṃ vayam,
tvādeśo bhavati | evaṃ tu indra piba tulyaṃ suto madāya, indra piba
vṛṣabhūtasya vṛṣṇaḥ, agne yāhi śastribhiḥ, vāyo yāhi
śivādiva---ityādau tiṅnighātaḥ prāpnoti ? kartavyo'tra yatnaḥ,
uktaṃ hi purastāt---ṭhāpādaparisamāpterapādādāvityadhikāraḥ' iti
|
yadi ṭhāmantritaṃ pūrvamavidyamānavat' devadata pacasītyatra
pacasītyetadapekṣavā devadataśabdasya pūrvatvamastītyavidyamānavatve
sati āmantritādyaudātatvaṃ na syādityata āha---pūrvatvaṃ ceti |
pūrvaśabdasya sambandhiśabdatvādyaṃ prati pūrvatvaṃ tatkāryaṃ
pratyevāvidyamānavatvam, na svakāryaṃ prati; tena nāyaṃ doṣa ityarthaḥ |
kāryaśabdenaitaddarśayati---avidyamānavat kāryamatrātidiśyate | tatra
pūrvaśabdasya sambandhiśabdatvena parasya kārye kartavya
ityetāvadāśrīyate, na tu paraṃ pratyavidyamānavat; pūrvaṃ tu prati
vidyamānavadityartha iti syāt | imaṃ me gaṅge yamune sarasvatītyatra
gaṅgeśabdasya yamuneśabdaṃ pratyevāvidyamānavatvaṃ na meśabdaṃ pratīti
vyavadhānād yamuneśabdasya nighātaṃ prati meśabdo nimitaṃ na syāt
| yathopadarśite tvarthe, parasya kārye kartavye ityetāvatatkāryaṃ
svanimitamanyanimitaṃ veti viśeṣābhāvād meśabdāpekṣe'pi
nighāte gaṅgeśabdasyāvidyamānavatvaṃ sidhyati | tadetat
svanimite'nyanimite cetyatra sūcitam |
tadevamuktaṃ darśayati---ihetyādi | gaṅgeśabdo'vidyamānavatvātsvayaṃ
nimitaṃ na bhavatītvetāvat, na tu meśabdasya nimitabhāvaṃ
pratibadhnātītyarthaḥ | paraṃ pratyavidyamānavadbhavatītyāśrīyamāṇe hi
tathā syāt |
nanu vatkaraṇamantareṇāpi ṭhgoto ṇit' ityādāvatideśo dṛśyate,
tatkimatra vatkaraṇena ? nanvasati vatkaraṇe
ṭhpūrvamāmantritamavidyamānam' ityucyamāne pūrvasyāmantratasya
nivṛttiḥ syāt ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; arthapratyayanāya
śabdaprayogādanivṛte'rthe śabdanivṛtyabhāvāt | athāpi paraprayogo
bhavatu, pūrvaprayogo mā bhūdityarthaḥ kalpeta ? tathāpi
rājadantādiṣu paramāmantritaṃ veti vaktavyaṃ syāt |
paramevāmantritaṃ bhavati, na pūrvamityarthaḥ | tadevamantareṇāpi
vatimatideśaḥ siddhaḥ ? idaṃ tarhi prayojanam---svāśrayamapi yathā
syāt---āṃ bo devadata ṭhāma ekāntaramāmantritamanantike'
ityekāntaratā yathā syāt | ekavacanāntaṃ hyutarasūtrasya viṣayaḥ,
bahuvacanānte tu ṭhvibhāṣitaṃ viśeṣavacane bahuvacanam' iti pakṣe
nighātaprasaṅgaḥ | yadyapyatideśikakāryāviruddhaṃ
svāśrayamatideśepyavasatyapi vatkaraṇe bhavati, iha tu
vatkaraṇādyatnādviruddhamapi kvacitprāpyate | avidyamānavatvavirodhinī
hyaekāntaratā | vyākhyānāccātiprasaṅgo nodbhāvanīyaḥ ||
nāmantrite samānādhikaraṇe sāmānyavacanam || 8|1|73 ||
dvau nañau prakṛtamarthaṃ sūcayata ityāha---ki tarhi vidyamānavadeveti |
māṇavaka jaṭilakādhyāpaketi | atra jaṭilaśabdo māṇavakaśabdāpekṣayā
viśeṣavacanaḥ, adhyāpakaśabdāpekṣayā tu sāmānyavacana iti
dvayorapyavidyamānavatvaṃ na bhavati | pūrvasyetyādinā pratiṣedhasya
phalaṃ darśayati | devadatayajñadateti | ṭhsāmānyavacanaṃ
viśeṣavacanāpekṣam' iti vakṣyatyutarasūtre, tataśca yathā yajñadataśabdaḥ
samānādhikaraṇo na bhavati, evaṃ
pūrvāmantritārthagataviśeṣākāravacano'pi na bhavatīti
devadataśabdo'pi sāmānyavacano na bhavati, tasmād
dvyaṅgavikalatvāccintyamet | evaṃ hyuktamiti | taitirīyake brāhmaṇe
sahasratamīṃ prakṛtya iḍe rante'dite sarasvati priye preyasi mahi
viśrute---etāni te aghniye nāmānīti | vṛtau tvanyathā pāṭhaḥ
śākhāntare draṣṭavyaḥ ||
vibhāṣitaṃ viśeṣavacane || 8|1|74 ||
bahuvacanamiti vārtike darśanāt prakṣiptam | śaraṇatvena prāptiḥ
śaraṇam, tatra sādhavaḥ śaraṇyāḥ | śaraṇaśabdo hi śaraṇye'pi
dṛśyate---śaraṇaṃ bhavantamatikāstraṇakamiti | śarmaṇyā iti pāṭhe
śarmaṇi sādhavaḥ śarmaṇyāḥ |
sāmānvavacanādhikārādeveti | sāmānyasya viśeṣāpekṣatvādyaṃ prati
sāmānyamityetadbhavati, tasminviśeṣavacana eva bhaviṣyati ||
iti śrīharadatamiśraviracitāyāṃ padamañjaryāmaṣṭamasyādhyāyasya prathamaḥ
pādaḥkāśikāvṛttiḥ---6
atha aṣṭamādhyāye dvitīyaḥ pādaḥ
pūrvatrāsiddham || 8|2|1 ||
pūrvatrāsiddhamityayamadhikāra iti | yadi tu svatantro vidhiḥ syāt,
tato vakṣyamāṇasya tripādīlakṣaṇasamudāyasya pūrvatra
sapādasaptādhyāyīlakṣaṇe samudāye'siddhatvamuktaṃ syāt, na tu
tripādyāṃ pūrvatra parasyāsiddhatvamāpāditaṃ syāt; tataśca
guḍaliṇmān, godhuṅmānityādau ḍhatvaghatvāderasiddhatvābhāvāt
ṭhjhayaḥ' iti matupo vatvaprasaṅgaḥ | tasmānna vidhiḥ | atha paribhāṣā
syāt, sarvatraivāṣṭādhyāyyāṃ pūrva prati parasyāsiddhatvāt tena,
taiḥ, tasya---ityādāvinādiṣu kartavyeṣu
tyadādyatvasyāsiddhatvādakārāntanimitā inādayo na syuḥ |
tasmād---adhikāraḥ | evaṃ sati yadanena sampāditaṃ bhavati
taddarśayati---tatreti | tatrādhikāre satītyarthaḥ | adhikāre hi
tripādīgatānāmapyaviśeṣeṇa sapādasaptādhyāyīgatānpratyasiddhatvaṃ
tripādyaṃ ca pūrvatra parasyāsiddhatvaṃ siddhyati | vidhau tu
naitāvatsampādayituṃ śakyam; tripādyāṃ pūrvatra
parasyāsiddhatvānāpādanāt | paribhāṣāyāṃ ca naitāvati paryavasyati;
sarvatraiva prasaṅgāt | tasmādadhikāratvādetāvatsanpadyate | etāvadeva
ca sampadyata ityarthaḥ | na caivamatra bhramitavyam---yeyaṃ sapādasaptādhyāyī
anukrāntetyanena vidhirūpeṇa pravṛttirdarśitā, ita utaramityā dinā
tvadhikārarūpeṇa, tataśca śeṣa itivallakṣaṇaṃ cādhikāraśceti ?
niṣprayojanatvād, adhikāro'yamityuktatvācca | kiṃ hi nāmādhikāra
evāsminna sidhyati, yadartho vidhirāśrīyate ! saptānāmadhyāyānāṃ
sāmāhāraḥ saptādhyāyī, sapādācāsau saptādhyāyī ceti karmadhārayaḥ,
sapādeti ṭābantapāṭhe tvasamāsaḥ | utarautaro yoga iti
pāṭhaḥ;vīpsāyāṃ dvirvacane subluko'sambhavāt | atrādhyāyagrahaṇena
yogagrahaṇena ca śāstrāsiddhatvamāśrīyata iti darsayati | etacca
pūrvatreti vacanāllabhyate | śāstrasya hi mukhyaṃ pūrvatvam;
sanniveśaviśeṣayogitvāt | kāryasya tu
śāstradvārakamaupacārikam, na hi mukhye sambhavati gauṇasya grahaṇaṃ
yuktam | kathaṃ punaruccaritaṃ śāstramasiddhamityucyate, na hi
vacanaśatenāpi siddhamapi asiddhaṃ bhavati ? ata āha---siddhakāyaṃ na
karotītyartha iti | vacanādatideśa āśrīyata ityarthaḥ |
śāstrāsyāsiddhatvamāśrīyate, na kāryasyeti darśitam |
tatra prayojanamāha---tadetaditi | yadidaṃ śāstraviṣayamasiddhavacanaṃ
tadetadityarthaḥ | ādeśo lakṣaṇaṃ nimitaṃ yasya kāryasya tasya
pratiṣedhārthamutsṛjyate ādeśena nivartata iti utsargaḥusthānī, sa
lakṣaṇaṃ nimitaṃ yasya tasya bhāvaḥ pravṛttiryathā syādityevamarthaṃ
cāsiddhavacanam | kāryāsiddhatve tūtsargalakṣaṇasya bhāvo na na sidhyati
| tatrādeśalakṣaṇapratiṣedhasyodāharaṇamāha---asmā uddharetyādi |
āyāvoḥ kṛtayoḥ ṭhlopaḥ śakalyasya' iti lopaḥ |
vyalopasyāsiddhatvāditi | śāstradvārakaṃ vyalopasyāsiddhatvam | yadā
hi pūrvaśāstrasannidhau paraśāstramasiddham, tadā tatpratipāditaṃ kāryaṃ
sutarāmasiddhaṃ bhavati | utsargalakṣaṇabhāvasyodāharaṇamāha--amuṣmai iti
| atrāsatyasiddatve paratvād ṭhadaso'serdādu do maḥ' ityutve
satyata iti smāyādayo na syuḥ | asiddhatve tu pūrvaṃ smādayaḥ,
paścādutvamiti siddhamiṣṭam | utvasyeti | utvaśāstrasyetyarthaḥ |
śuṣkiketyādiślokaḥ | atra nidarśanamiti pratyekamabhisambadhyate |
nidarśanamudāharaṇadigityarthaḥ | matorvatve kartavye ṭhjhalāṃ
jaśo'nte' iti jaśtve'siddhe sati guḍaliṇmāniti darśanam |
na kopadhāyā iti puṃvadbhāvapratiṣedho na bhavatīti |
kopadhapratiṣedhe taddhitavugrahaṇamityetanāśrityedaṃ prayojanamuktam |
kṣāmimāniti | ṭhkṣāyo maḥ' iti niṣṭhātakārasya matvam, tataḥ ṭhata
iñ' iti iñantād ṭhata iniṭhanau' itīn, tadantādvā matup |
vaherityādi | ṭhvaha prāpaṇe', niṣṭhā, samprasāraṇam, ṭhho ḍhaḥ',
ṭhjhaṣastathordho'dhaḥ', ṣṭuatvam, ṭhḍho ḍhea lopaḥ', ṭhḍhralope pūrvasya
dīrgho'ṇaḥ', ūḍha iti sthite ṇici ṭilopaḥ, luṅ, ccheścaṅ |
hataityetad dvirucyate iti | ṭhajādervitīyasya' iti vacanāt, tataḥ
ṭhhalādiḥ śeṣaḥ', ṭhkuhoścuḥ', iti cutvam---hakārasya jhakāraḥ,
tasya ṭhabhyāse carca' iti jaśtvaṃ jākaraḥ | athātra ṭhsanvallaghuni'
itītvaṃ kasmānna bhavati ? tatrāha--anaglopa iti vacanāditi | kathaṃ
punaraujiḍhaditi bhavati ? ityata āha---anaglopa iti vacanāditi |
kathaṃ punaraujiḍhaditi bhavati ? ityata āha---aujiḍhadityetatviti |
pūrvatrāsiddhīyamadvirvacane' ityetatviha pravartate; anisyatvāt |
anityatvaṃ ca ṭhubhau sābhyāsasya' iti vacanādvijñāyate, anyathā ṭhaniteḥ'
iti ṇatve kṛte tasya siddhatvāt saha ṇakāreṇa dvirvacane sati siddhaṃ
syāt---prāṇiṇivatīti |
guḍaliṇmāniti | guḍaṃ leḍhaiiti kvip, tadantānmatup,
ḍhatvajaśtvayoḥ kṛtayoḥ ṭhyaro'nunāsikatve taddhite bhāṣāyāṃ
nityavacanam' iti ṇakāraḥ |
ṣaṣṭhīnirdeśā iti | ṭhsaṃyogāntasya lopaḥ' ityādayaḥ,
pañcamīnirdeśāḥ ṭhhrasvādaṅgāt' ityādayaḥ, saptamīnirdeśāḥ ṭhjhalo
jhali' ityādayalasteṣām | asiddhatvaṃ na bhavatīti | yadi syāt
ṭhsaṃyogāntasya lopaḥ' ityatra ṭhṣaṣṭhī sthāneyogā
ityetasyābhāvātaccheṣasya ṭhalo|ñantyasya' ityasyāpravṛteḥ sarvasya
padasya lopaprasaṅgaḥ; ṭhhrasvādaṅgāt' ityatrāpyaniyamena
dikśabdādhyāhārātpūrvasya parasya ca lopaprasaṅgaḥ; ṭhjhalo jhali'
ityatrāpyaupaśleṣike'dhikaraṇe saptamī vijñāyeteti
pūrvaparayoraviśeṣeṇa prasaṅgaḥ, satsaptamīvijñāne tu
vyavahitasyāpi prasaṅgaḥ | kathaṃ punaḥ pūrvāsu paribhāṣāsu
kartavyāsu teṣāmasiddhatvaṃ na bhavati ? ata āha---kāryakālaṃ hīti |
saṃjñāparibhāṣamiti samāhāradvandvaḥ | ayamabhiprāyaḥ---
saṃjñāḥ parārthā atyantaṃ paribhāṣāśca tadvidhāḥ |
na svātantryeṇa tāstasmāt kāryāvagatihetavaḥ ||
anekasya pradhānasya śeṣabhūtā bhavantviti |
etāḥ kevalamācāryaḥ pṛthandeśā upādiśat ||
vidhivākyaistu saṃhatya yatra tatra sthitairapi |
bodhayantyaḥ svakāryāṇi naikapūrvāḥ parā imāḥ || iti |
yadi kāryakālaṃ saṃjñāparibhāṣam, ṭhvipratiṣedhe param' ityeṣāpi
paribhāṣātropatiṣṭheta, tataśca visphoryam, avagoryamityatra guṇaṃ
bādhitvā paratvāt ṭhhali ca' iti dīrghatvaṃ syāt ? ityata
āha--vipratiṣedhe paramityeṣā tviti | eṣā tu na pravartata iti
sambandhaḥ | madhye heturyeneti | vipratiṣedho hi tasyā nimitam |
kaśca vipratiṣedhaḥ ? dvayostulyabalayorekasminviṣaye tvaṃ cāhaṃ
ceti pravṛttiprasaṅgaḥ | na cāyamatra sanbhavati, tasmānnimitābhāvānna
pravartata ityathaḥ | yadyevam, apavādo'pi paraḥ pūrvamutsaga na bādheta
? ata āha---apavādasyeti | yadyapavādasyāsiddhatvādutsarga eva syāt,
apavādavidhānaṃ vyarthaṃ syāt ||
nalopaḥ supsvarasaṃjñātugvidhiṣu kṛti || 8|2|2 ||
atra sūtre, utarasūtre ca kāryopādānāt kārye
kāryasyāsiddhatvamucyate | ṭhkṛti' ityetatu sambhavavyabhicārābhyāṃ
tugvidhinaiva sambadhyate | vidhiśabdo bhāvasādhanaḥ, karmasādhanaśca;
tatra bhāvasādhanānāṃ trayāṇāṃ karmasādhanasya caikasyaikaśeṣaḥ;
bhinnārthānāmapi sarūpāṇāmekaseṣavacanāt | vidhiśca vidhiśca
vidhiśca vidhayaḥ, tato bahuvacanāntena vidhiśabdena subādīnāṃ
dvandvasya ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ | sarvatra ca śeṣalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhī | tatra subvidhau
śeṣa eva śeṣaḥ, itareṣu tu karma śeṣatvena vivakṣitam |
tadidamuktam---vidhiśabdo'yamityādi |
sambandhasāmānyaṣaṣṭha|lnteneti | sambandhasāmānyamucyate ṣaṣṭha|la,
tadantenetyarthaḥ | sāmānyaśabdena sthāneyogavyavacchedaḥ | kathaṃ punaḥ
ṭhṣaṣṭhī sthāneyogā' iti paribhāṣāyāṃ satyāṃ sāmānyavacanatā
labhyate ? ucyate; nātra supaḥ sthāne kiñcidvidhīyate, kiṃ tarhi ?
anuvādo'yam---supo yo vidhistatreti | anuvāde ca paribhāṣā na
pravartate; ṭhudīcāmātaḥ sthāne' iti sthānegrahaṇālliṅgāt |
sambandhasāmānyavacanaṣaṣṭha|lnteneti yaduktam, tatra
prayojanamāha---supāṃ sthāna ityādi | sarvo'sau subvidhiriti |
sarvasya supsambandhitvātsubarthameva cedaṃ vidhigrahaṇaṃ kṛtam |
svarādiṣu tu nārthaḥ; tena yathā ṭhna mu ne' ityatra nābhāve kartavye
ityarthī bhavati, tathā svarādiṣu kartavyeṣvityartho bhaviṣyati |
dvandvātparasya tu pratyekaṃ sambandho durnivāra iti
bhāvasādhanatvamaṅgīkṛtam | ṭhsubvidhisvarasaṃjñātukṣu' ityucyamāne
tu na kiñcidyatnasādhyam |
rājavatīti | matubantād ṭhugitaśca' iti ṅīp, rājaśabdaḥ
kaninpratyayāntatvādādyaudātaḥ | pañcārmamiti | ṭhdiksaṃkhye saṃjñāyām'
iti samāsaḥ, tatra nalope kṛte pūrvapadamavarṇāntaṃ jātamiti svaraḥ
prāpto'siddhatvānna bhavati, samāsodātatvameva bhavati |
pañcadaṇḍīti | samāhāradviguḥ | nalopasyāsiddhatvāt ṣṇāntā ṣaḍiti
ṣaṭsaṃjñā bhavatīti | etacca
yatatroktam---ṭhastagrahaṇamaupadeśikapratipatyartham' iti,
tadanāśrityoktaṃ draṣṭavyam | na ṣaṭsvastrādibhya iti ṭāpaḥ
pratiṣedho bhavatīti | atra hi nāntatvādāpprāptaḥ, so'pi
niṣidhyate; ṭhstriyāṃ yaduktaṃ tanna bhavati' iti sāmānyena
niṣedhavidhānāt | tadetatprayojanaṃ kathaṃ bhavatīti | pākṣikatvaṃ
prayojanasya darśayituṃ praśnaḥ | keṣāñciddarśanam---anārabhya
kāryaviśeṣamādau tāvatsaṃjñā kriyate, tato yasyāṃ daśāyāṃ yatkāryaṃ
prāptaṃ tatkriyate lokavat, tadyathā---loke daśamyāmutthitāyāṃ
putrasya nāma dadhātīti sakṛtkṛtayā saṃjñayā sarvāṇi kāryāṇi
kriyante, na tu pratikāryaṃ nāma kurvanti, tadvaditi | ayaṃ ca
ṭhyathoddeśaṃ saṃjñāparibhāṣam' iti pakṣaḥ | kāryakālapakṣe tu tenatena
vidhivākyenekavākyatāpannena saṃjñāsūtreṇa saṃjñā praṇīyata iti
pratikāryaṃ saṃjñāpravṛttiḥ | tatrādye darśane jaśśasorlugarthā yā saṃjñā
tayaiva ṭāppratiṣedhasyāpi siddhatvānnedaṃ prayojanam, dvitīye tu
pakṣe bhavati prayojanamityāha---yadi pratikāryamiti | kathaṃ tadā
prayojanam ? ityāha---yā hīti | jaśśasorlugartheti |
upalakṣaṇametat, ṅīppratiṣedhārthetyapi draṣṭavyam | strīpratyayasyeti |
ṭāpa ityarthaḥ | atha prathame pakṣe na kartavyaṃ saṃjñāgrahaṇam, iha
hi---daṇḍiguptau, guptadaṇḍināviti nalope kṛte daṇḍiśabdasya
ghisaṃjñā prāpnoti, tataśca tasyaiva pūrvanipātaḥ syāt;
nalopasyāsiddhatvāddhi saṃjñāyā abhāvādaniyamaḥ pūrvanipātasya bhavati
|
atra ke cadityādi | supaḥ sannipātena nalopaḥ, sa yadi tukaṃ
pravartayet tatsannipātaṃ vihanyāt | kathaṃ punaḥ sannipātasya
vighātaḥ, yāvatā pūrvāntastuk sa tuggrahaṇena gṛhyate ? satyam;
hrasvamātrabhaktastugityāśrityedamuktam | bahiraṅgalakṣaṇatvena veti |
bahirbhūtavibhaktyapekṣo nalopo'ntarbhūtakvibapekṣe tukyasiddho
bhavatītyarthaḥ |
paribhāṣādvaysāpyanityatvaṃ jñāpayitumiti | tatra
sannipātaparibhāṣāyā anityatvād vṛkṣāyetyādau ṭhsupi ca' iti
dīrghatvaṃ bhavati | bahiraṅgaparibhāṣāyāstvanityatvād eṣā, dve
ityatra vibhaktyāśrayaṃ tyadādyatvaṃ bahiraṅgamapi prātipadikāśraye ṭāpi
na siddhaṃ bhavati |
vṛtrahacchatramiti | nātra sannipātalakṣaṇo nalopaḥ, nāpi nalopasya
bahiraṅgatvam; tuko'pi cchakārāpekṣatvāt | rājīyatīti | ṭhkyaci
ca' itītvam | rājāyata iti | ṭhakṛtsārvadhātukayoḥ' iti dīrghaḥ |
rājāśva iti | ṭhakaḥ savarṇa dīrghaḥ' ||
na mu ne || 8|2|3 ||
ṭhmu' ityavibhaktiko nirdeśaḥ | ghilakṣaṇo nābhāvo na syāditi |
yadyetannārabhyeteti śeṣaḥ | anena sūtrārambhasya prayojanamuktam |
kṛte tu nābhāve ityādi | yadyatra dīrghatvaṃ syāt
bhāvyamāno'pyukāraḥ savarṇān gṛhṇātīti, yathā---amūbhyāmityādau
dīrghasya sthānino dīrghokāro bhavati, tathātrāpyākārasya
dīrghokāraḥ syāt, tataśca hrasvasannipātakṛto nābhāvastaṃ
vihanyāditi bhāvaḥ | atra codayanti---mubhāvasya siddhatvātkila
dīrghaprasaṅgaścodyate, tat kiṃ mubhāvamapaśyad dīrghaśāstraṃ ghilakṣaṇaṃ
nābhāvamapi na paśyati, vṛkṣādiśabdasthānīyaṃ hyaetaddīrghaśāstraṃ prati,
tataśca yañāderabhāvātkathamatra dīrghaprasaṅga iti ? atrāhuḥ---prayoge
tāvannābhāvaḥ śrūyate, śāstramapi tasya siddhakāṇḍe paṭhitam, kevalaṃ
tannidānabhūtaṃ mubhāvameva dīrghaśāstraṃ na paśyatiṃ, tanmā drākṣīt,
nābhāvaṃ tāvatpaśyati, tataśca dīrghatvaṃ pravartayediti |
atha veti | yathā kaścitkuśalamatiḥ kiñjātīyo dhāvati, kiṃvarṇo
dhāvati---ityekenānekena vā pṛṣṭastantreṇa prativakti---śveto
dhāvatīti; tathātrāpi yogadvayametat; tatraikaṃ ne kartavye
mutvasyāsiddhatvaṃ niṣedhati, aparaṃ ne parato yatprāptaṃ tatra |
tadidamuktam---ubhayārthamiti | tantraṇeti | sādhāraṇaṃ bhavetantram,
yathā---tulyakakṣayorbhuñjānayoḥ pradīpaḥ, iha tu
sādhāraṇaprayatnastantram |
idānīmekasminneva yoge yathobhayaṃ sādhyate, tathā darśayati---atha
veti | arthātsaṃgṛhītamiti | vṛddhakumārīvākyavat,
tadyathā---vṛddhakumārīndreṇoktā varaṃ vṛṇīṣveti sā
varamavṛṇot---putrā me bahukṣīraghṛtamannaṃ kāṃsyapātryāṃ
bhuñjīranniti, patireva tāvadasyā na bhavati kutaḥ putrāḥ, kuto
gāvaḥ, kuto dhānyam ! anenaiva khalvekavākyena patiḥ putrāḥ gāvo
dhānyamiti sarvaṃ vṛtaṃ bhavati; tadvadatrāpi ne parato yatkāryaṃ tatra
kartavye mubhāvasyāsiddhatvasya pratiṣedhaṃ bruvatā nābhāve'pi
kartavye'rthānmutvasyāsiddhatvaṃ pratiṣiddhaṃ bhavati |
ekādeśasvaro'ntaraṅga iti | ekādeśasvare catvāri
darśanāni---udātānudātayorekādeśa āntaryataḥ
svarito'bhinirvṛtasya sthāne' ekādeśa udātenodātaḥ'
ityanenodātaguṇādeśaḥ kriyata ityekaṃ darśanam | tathaivābhinivṛta
ekādeśasvare svaritaguṇamātrasyodātamātraṃ vidhīyata iti dvitīyaṃ
darśanam | tṛtīyaṃ tu darśanam ṭhekādeśa udātenodātaḥ' iti
paribhāṣā ekādeśavidhiṣūpatiṣṭhate; tatrāyamartho
bhavati---ādguṇo bhavati, udātānudātayostvādguṇa udāta iti;
evaṃ satyekādeśo vidhīyamāna evodāto bhavati |
caturthadarśanamudātānudātayorekādeśaḥ svaritaguṇaḥ prāpta udāto
bhavatīti | tatra yenanāprāptinyāyena svaritatvāpavāda udātavidhiḥ
sampadyate, tatra paribhāṣāpakṣe siddhamudātatvamayādiṣu | itareṣu tu
pakṣeṣu asiddhatve prāpte siddhatvamucyate, āntaryato'yādeśa udāto
yathā syāditi, anyathā svaritaḥ syāt |
kumāryā idamiti | kumāraśabdaḥ prātipadikasvareṇāntodātaḥ,
tasmād ṭhvayasi prathame' iti ṅīp, ṭhyasyeti ca' iti lopaḥ,
ṭhanudātasya ca yatrodātalopaḥ' iti ṅīpa udātatvaṃ
caturthyekavacanam, kumārī a e iti sthite' āṇnadyāḥ' ityāṭ,
yaṇādeśaḥ, ṭhudātayaṇo halpūrvāt' ityāṭa udātatvam, ṭhāṭaśca' iti
vṛddhirekādeśaḥ, sa āntaryataḥ svaritaḥ prasaktaḥ ṭhekādeśa
udātenodātaḥ' ityanenodātaḥ kriyate, tatsiddhatvaṃ
vaktavyam--ayādeśa udāto yathā syāt | yadītyādi |
pūrvamudātatvaṃ kriyate paścādekādheśaḥ | yathānantaraṃ darśitaṃ tadā
bhavatīdaṃ prayojanamityarthaḥ | atha tvityādi | kumāryā e iti sthite
ṭhāṭaśca' iti vṛddhiśca prāpnoti, ṭhudātayaṇo halpūrvāt' iti āṭaḥ
svaraśca, dvāvapyanityau; svaraḥ śabdāntaraprāpteranityaḥ, sa hi
prāgākārasya prāpnoti kṛtāyāṃ vṛddhāvaikārasya, vṛddhirapi
prāganudātayoḥ paratvātsvare, āṭastu svare kṛte udātānudātayoḥ
svarabhinnasya prāpnuvanvidhiranityo bhavati, ubhayoranityayoḥ
paratvātsvare prāpte varṇāśrayatvenāntaraṅgatvādvaddhiḥ, svarastu
vibhakterucyamānaḥ padāśrayo bahiraṅgaḥ |
gāṅge'nūpa iti | gaṅgāyā idamityaṇ, pratyayasvareṇontodātaḥ,
tato ṅḥ, suptvādinudātaḥ, tayorekādeśa udātaḥ |
āpo'nugatamanūpamiti prādisamāsaḥ, avyayapūrvapadaprakṛtisvare
prāpte ṭhanorapradhānakanīyasī' ityutarapadāntodātatvaṃ śeṣanighātaḥ
| tasya siddhatvādityādi | ekādeśasvarasya siddhatve ṭheṅaḥ padāntādati'
ityayamekādeśa udātena saha bhavati | tataśca ṭhsvarito vānudāte
padādau' iti pakṣe svaritaḥ pakṣe udāto bhavati | yadi tvasiddhatvaṃ
syāt, tadāsāvekāra udātānudātasthānikatvādāntaryataḥ svaritaḥ
syāt | tathā ca sati tasya ṭheṅaḥ padāntādati' ityayamekādeśa
udātena na bhavati, kiṃ tarhi ? ṭhsvaritena' iti pakṣe svarito na
syāt | api tu svaritānudātayoḥ sthāne bhavannāntaryato nityameva
svaritaḥ syāt | sa udātenetyata iti pāṭhaḥ, sa ekādeśa udātena
sahetyato hetorityarthaḥ |
śatṛsvara iti | tudivadinadibhyo laṭ, tasya śatrāśrayo
nadyajādyoḥ svaraḥ śatṛsvaraḥ, ṭhśaturanumo nadyajādī' ityatra
ṭhantodātādutarapadāt' ityantodātādutarapadādītyanuvartate |
tudatī, nudatīti | tudinudibhyāṃ laṭa, śatrādeśaḥ, ṭhtudādibhyaḥ
śaḥ', pratyayasvareṇodātaḥ | anuma iti pratiṣedho jñāpaka iti | tena
naitadarthaṃ siddhatvaṃ vaktavyamiti bhāvaḥ | kathametat jñāpakam ?
ityāha---nadīti | anuma iti pratiṣedha
syetatprayojanam---nudantītyatra ṭhācchīnadyornum' iti yadā num
bhavati, tadā mā bhūditi | asiddhe
caikādāśasvare'ntodātatvābhāvādeva śatṛ na bhaviṣyati, kimanuma
iti pratiṣedhena ! pratiṣedhātu siddhatvamanumīyate | nanu yatra
lasārvadhātukānudātatvasya nimitaṃ nāsti, tadarthaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ
syāt; yāntī, vāntītyatra hi dhātupratyayorudātayorāntaryata
ekādeśa udātaḥ, sa ca śatṛsvare siddhaḥ ? atrāpi pratyayasvare sati
tadanantarameva dhātoḥ śeṣanighāto bhavati, tataścātrāpi
nāntareṇaikādeśasvaramantodātatvaṃ bhavati |
ekānudātatvamiti | evaṃ varjayitvā pariśiṣṭasya yadanudātatvaṃ
tadekānudātatvam | bhāṣye tvekānanudātamiti pāṭhaḥ, tatrāpi
ṭhanudātaṃ padamekavarjam' ityayameva svaro vivakṣitaḥ, tatra hi
ṭhekamevānudātamanyatsarvamudātam' ityucyate | tathā ca
tatroktam---ṭhsiddhaṃ tvekānanudātatvāt' iti | tudantīti |
śavikaraṇa udātaḥ, lasārvadhātukamanudātam, tayorekādeśaḥ |
aneneti | ekādeśasvareṇa siddhena | varjyamānateti | ṭhanudātaṃ
padamekavarjam' ityasyārtho lakṣyate | yadi tvasiddhatvaṃ syāt,
tato'satyāṃ varjyamānatāyāṃ dvayorudātayoḥ śravaṇaṃ syāt | nanu
codātasyāsiddhatve'piyo'sāvudātānudātayorekādeśa āntaryataḥ
svarito'bhinirvṛtastadāśrayā varjyamānatā bhaviṣyati ? satyam;
siddhyati yadā svaritasyodāto bhavatīti pakṣaḥ, yadā tu
svaritāpavāda udāto vidhīyate tadā tasyāsiddhatvāt sthāninaśca
svarāntarābhāvātkena varjyamānatā syāt ! tasmātsiddhatvamucyate | na
ca kāryakālapakṣāśrayeṇa paribhāṣāntaravadvajyamānaparibhāṣāyā api
tripādyāṃ pravṛttiḥ śakyābhyupagantum; atiprasaṅgāt |
ṭhudātasvaritayoryaṇaḥ svarito'nudātasya', ṭhudātādanudātasya
svaritaḥ' ityatrāpi śeṣanighātaprasaṅgāt | yathā tu yāntītyatra
prāgevaikādeśāccheṣanighāto bhavati, tathātrāpītyaprayojanamityāhuḥ
|
brāhmaṇāstudantīti | atrāpi svaritatvāpavāda udātatvamiti darśane
siddhatvamucyate, anyathodātasyānudātatvābhāvādudātaḥ prayoge
śrūyeta | bahariraṅgasyāsiddhatvameva bhavatīti | ṭhasiddha
bahiraṅgamantaraṅge' ityanena | pacatīti | itiśabdo
nipātatvādādyaudātaḥ | atra bāhyapadāpekṣatvādādekādeśasya
bahiraṅgatvātatsvaro'pi bahiraṅgaḥ, tasyāsiddhatvātena
varjyamānatā na bhavati | prapacatīti | atrāpi ṭhtiṅ codātivati' iti
gatinighāto na bhavati | ubhayatrāpi pūrvaṃ pratyantavadbhāvātprasaṅgaḥ
|
hariva iti | yadā ṭhcchandasīvanipau' iti vanippratyayaḥ kriyate ṭhvana
upasaṃkhyānam' iti, tasya ca rutvam, tadā nārthaḥ siddhavacanena | 
alāvīditi | luṅ, cleḥ sic, iṭ, ṭhastisico'pṛkte' itīṭ,
sici vṛddhiḥ nanu ca ṭhiṭa īṭi' ityatra iṭa iti ṣaṣṭhī vijñāsyate, na
pañcamī, sasyetyanuvartate, tatreḍādeḥ sasya lopo vidhīyamāna iṭo
bhaviṣyatīti siddhamalāvīditi ? satyaṃ rūpaṃ siddham; svare tu doṣaḥ
syāt---yadi lopenekāro nivartyeta, anudātasya īṭaḥ śravaṇaṃ
prasajyeta, udātanivṛttisvare lopasyāsiddhatvād | yadā tu
sakāramātrasya lope savarṇadīrghatvaṃ tadā sicaścitkaraṇādiḍudāta
ityekādeśasvaro bhavati |
vṛkṇa iti | ṭhoditaśca' iti niṣṭhānatvam |
ṣatvasvarapratyayeḍvidhiṣvityasya vyāvartyaṃ darśayati---kutvaṃ tu
pratīti | kṣībaśabda evodāhriyata iti | kathaṃ punarekameva triṣu
vidhiṣūdāharaṇam ? ityata āha---tatra hīti | tatra kvacitpakṣe
kiñcit prayojanaṃ pratyudāharaṇamityāha---yadeti | saṃjñāyāmiti
vacanam, tatra saṃjñāyāmupamānam' ityataḥ ṭhsaṃjñāyām' ityanuvṛteḥ |
eṣa svara iti | ādyaudātatvam | kṣībika iti | ṭhnaudvyacaḥ ṣṭhan' |
