agnipaṭuaśabdayoḥ sambuddhiguṇe kṛte ṭheco'pragṛhyasya' ityādinā
pūrvasyārdhasyākāraḥ plutaḥ, utarasya tvidutau | nityastugna
prāpnotīti | ṭhpadāntādvā' iti dīrghalakṣaṇo vikalpaḥ syāt | ccha iti
kim ? anyatra plutavikārasyāsiddhatvameva yathā syāt---khalapu
brāhmaṇakulam, tatra sambuddhāviha kiñcitrapo iti nyāyena guṇe khalapā
a u iti sthite ṭhhrasvasya piti kṛti' iti tug na bhavati | dvividhaṃ
cātrāsiddhatvam---bahiraṅgalakṣaṇam, pūrvatrāsiddhamiti ca |
kimartha punariti | sakārasya kvacidapi śravaṇābhāvātpraśnaḥ |
ucicchitīti | ṭhuchī vivāse', tuk, san, iṭ, ṭhajāderdvitīyasya'
iti cchisśabdasya dvirvacanam, ṭhśarpūrvāḥ khayaḥ' iti khayaḥ śeṣaḥ, cchasya
ṭhabhyāse carca' iti cakāraḥ |
saṃyyantetyādau ṭhmo'nusvāraḥ', ṭhanusvārasya yayi parasavarṇaḥ' |
padādhikāraścediti | yadi latvādividhipu padasyetyapekṣyate, tadā
latvādīnāṃ dvirvacanasya ca samakakṣatvam, anapekṣāyāṃ tu bahiraṅgaṃ
dvirvacanamantaraṅgeṣu latvādiṣvasiddhamiti ṭhpūrvatrāsiddham'
ityetanna pravartate iti latvādiṣu kṛteṣu dvirvacanamiti
siddhamiṣṭam | galogala iti | ṭhaci vibhāṣā' iti latvam | dogdheti
| ṭhvā druha' iti vā ghatvam, tadabhāve ṭhho ḍhaḥ' | nunna iti |
ṭhnudavida' iti vā niṣṭhānatvam | abhina iti | bhiderlaṅ, sipi
śnami halṅyādilopaḥ, ṭhsipi dhāto rurvā', ṭhdaśca' iti vā
rutvam, āḍāgamaḥ | mātuḥ ṣvaseti | ṭhmātuḥ
piturbhyāmanantarasyām' iti vā ṣatvam | māṣavāpāṇīti |
ṭhprātipadikānta' iti vā ṇatvam | vāṅnayanamiti |
ṭhyaro'nunāsike'nunāsiko vā' iti vā gakārasya ṅkāraḥ |
vākśayanamiti | ṭhśaśchāe'ṭi' iti vā cchatvam |
latvādīnāmityādinā'siddhatve latvādīnāṃ yo doṣastaṃ
darśayati---aniṣṭo'pi vikalpaḥ syāditi | pūrvotarayoḥ
padayorekatra pravṛttiḥ, aparatrāpravṛttirityeṣo'niṣṭo vikalpaḥ |
etatsarvamityādi | yogavibhāgārthameva ca pratiṣedhāśrayaṇam, anyathā
lāghavārthamamuneti nipātanamāśrayaṇīyaṃ syāt, tataḥ ṭhmu ne' iti
dvitīyo yogaḥ | kimarthamidam ?
pūrvayogasyāsarvaviṣayatvakhyāpanārtham, tenātiprasaṅgo
nodbhāvanīyaḥ ||
udātasvaritayoryaṇaḥ svarito'nudātasya || 8|2|4 ||
ṭhudātasvaritayoḥ' ityanuvāde'pi sthānaṣaṣṭha|leṣā; vyākhyānāt |
tena udātasvaritayoḥ samīpavartī yo yaṇ tataḥ parasyānudātasya
svaritatvaṃ na bhavati | sakṛllvyāśā, khalapvyāśā iti | tataḥ parasya
saptamyekavacanasya svaritatvamiti | kena ? ityata āha---udātayaṇ
ityaneneti | yo'yamasminsūtre pūrvo bhāgaḥ, tenetyarthaḥ |
ṭhudātayaṇo halpūrvāt' ityudātatvaṃ tu na bhavati,
ṭhnoṅdātvoḥ' iti pratiṣedhāt, āśāśabdaḥ ṭhāśāyā adigākhyā
cet' iti antodātatvādanudātādiḥ | tatkathamayaṃ svaritayaṇ
bhavatīti | na kathañcit, na hyayaṃ svaritamapanīya tatsthāne bhavati | na
hi pūrvaṃ śāstraṃ sthānibudhyā ādeśe pravartate, kiṃ tarhi ?
sthāninyeva | yathoktam---ṭhhata ityetad dvirucyate' iti, na
punastadvudhyā ḍhaśabdo dvirucyata iti | āśrayāditi |
āhāyam---svaritayaṇa iti, na cāsti siddhaḥ svaritaḥ, tatrāśrayāt
siddhatvaṃ bhaviṣyati |
evamucyamāne'tiprasaṅgamudbhāvayati---yadyevamiti | dadhyāśeti |
daviśabdaḥ ṭhnabviṣayasyānisantasya' ityādyaudātaḥ, seṣanighātaḥ,
ṭhudātādanudātasya svaritaḥ' iti tasya svaritatvam,
tasyāśrayātsiddhatve sati tatsthānikādapi yaṇaḥ parasyānudātasya
svaritatvaprasaṅga ityarthaḥ | tasmādityādi | yata evamāśrayātsiddhatve
doṣaḥ, tasmādayameva yaṇsvaro yatā siddho bhavati tathā vaktavyam |
tatkatham ? yogavibhāgaḥ kariṣyate--ṭhudātayaṇaḥ', udātayaṇaḥ
parasyānudātasya svarito bhavati; tataḥ ṭhsvaritayaṇaḥ;, svaritayaṇaśca
parasyānudātasya svarito bhavati, udātayaṇa ityeva | tena udātayaṇa
ityevaṃ yo'bhinirvṛtaḥ svaritaḥ, tadyaṇaḥ parasyānudātasya svaritatvaṃ
bhavatītyarthaḥ | tenāsyaiva svaritasyāśrayātsiddhatvaṃ bhaviṣyati |
yadyevamityādinā yo'tiprasaṅga udbhāvitaḥ, taṃ keṣāñcinmatena
pariharati---kecitviti | udātātsvaritayaṇo pīti | udātātparo
yaḥ svaritaḥ ṭhudātādanudātasya' iti vihitaḥ tasya yo yaṇ
tasmādapi parasyetyarthaḥ | taitirīyaka iti | titiriṇā
proktamadhīyate taitirīyāḥ, teṣāmāmnāyastaitirīyakam,
caraṇalakṣaṇo vuñ | śākhāntara iti | vṛttikāradeśe yā śākhā
tadapekṣaṃ śākhāntaratvam | ekaśataṃ hyadhvaryuśākhāḥ, viśeṣavacano
vāntaraśabdaḥ | yāste viśvā iti | ṭhyadvṛtānnityam' iti santītyasya
nighātapratiṣedhaḥ, agneśabdasyāmantritanighātaḥ | brāhmaṇa iti | tatraiva
taitirīyake dadhiśabda uktasvaraḥ, āśayatītyasya tiṅnighātaḥ | nanu
cobhayatrāpyatra yaṇādeśe kṛte ṭhudātādanudātasya svaritaḥ' ityeva
svaritaḥ, tathā ca yatra sa pratiṣidhyate ṭhnodātasvaritodayam' iti,
tatra svarito na dṛśyate ca---svasmabhyamābhara
pratyagnirupasāmagramakhyāditi, ayaṃ tu svarita udātasvaritaparasyāpi
bhavati---dahāśaso rakṣasaḥ pāhyasmāniti | tathā ca bhāṣye'pyudātapara
evānudāteti prasaṅga udbhāvitaḥ---dadhyāśeti | tasmāt
pūrvoktasyātiprasaṅgasya nāyaṃ vyabhicāra iti cintyametat |
nirākariṣyamāṇatvādvāsya nātra suṣṭhua nirbandhanīyaṃ darśayati---yathā
tviti | atra vārtikam---ṭhyaṇsvaro yaṇādeśe siddho vaktavyaḥ',
ṭhsvaritayaṇaḥ svaritārthaḥ āśrayātsiddhatvamiti cedudātāt svarite
doṣaḥ' iti | yadi ca ṭhudātādanudātasya svaritaḥ' iti yaḥ svaritaḥ
tasya yo yaṇ tataḥ parasyānudātasya svaritatvamiṣṭṃa syād,
doṣatvena vacanamanupapannaṃ syāt | bhāṣye tu yathāyamarthaḥ sthitaḥ,
tathā darsayati---tathā ceti | atra bhāṣyam---ṭhatha vā svaritagrahaṇaṃ na
kariṣyate; yadi na kriyate, kenedānīṃ svaritayaṇaḥ parasyānudātasya
svaritatvaṃ bhavati ? udātayaṇa ityeva, svaritayaṇā vyavahitatvānna
prāpnoti, ṭhsvaravidhau vyañjanamavidyamānavat' iti nāsti
vyavadhānam" iti | yadi codātāt svaritayaṇaḥ parasyānudātasya
svaritatvamiṣṭṃa syāt pratyākhyānaṃ na yujyeta | yadi pratyākhyānam,
kimarthaṃ tarhi svaritayaṇgrahaṇaṃ kriyate ? ityāha---tatkriyata iti |
sthānivadbhāvādvyavadhānamastīti | yaṇsthānikenekāreṇa |
vyañjanasya hyavidyamānavadbhāvaḥ, nācaḥ | nanu ca ṭhna padāntadvirvacana'
iti svaravidhau pratiṣiddhaḥ sthānivadbhāvaḥ ? tatrāha---svaradīrgheti |
baidyāśeti | bidasyāpatyaṃ strī ṭhanṛṣyānantarye bidādibhyo'ñ',
ṭhśārṅgavādyaño ṅīn', nitsvareṇādyaudāto baidīśabdaḥ ||
ekādeśa udātenodataḥ || 8|2|5 ||
ṭhanudātasya' iti vartate | agnyādiśabdāḥ
prātipadikasvareṇāntodātāḥ, vibhaktiranudātā |
pacantīti | atra śabakārasya yatsvaritatvam ṭhudātādanudātasya
svaritaḥ' iti, tasyāsiddhatvād dvayoranudātayorekādeśaḥ ||
svarito vānudāte padādau || 8|2|6 ||
prāditvātsamāse satīti | ṭhprādiprasaṅge karmapravacanīyānāṃ
pratiṣedhaḥ' ityasya tu tatraiva ṭhsvatī pūjāyām' iti pratiṣedhaḥ kṛtaḥ
| gatisamāsastvanāśritaḥ; ṭhgatirgatau' iti nigātaprasaṅgāt |
vasukaśabdaḥ pūrvavadantodātaḥ |
svaritagrahaṇaṃ vispaṣṭārthamiti | katham ? ityāha---udāte hīti |
āntaryata eva svarito bhaviṣyatīti | yadyevam, tasya
siddhatvāccheṣanighātaḥ syāt---gāṅge'nūpa iti ? ekādeśasya paraṃ
pratyādivadbhāvādanūpaśabdo'nudātaḥ prāpnoti, svaritagrahaṇe tu
sati asyāsiddhatvādyathoktadoṣābhāvaḥ | atha kriyamāṇe'pi svaritagrahaṇe
yaḥ siddhaḥ svaritaḥ tena varjyamānatā kasmānna bhavati---kanyānūpa iti ?
kanyāśabdaḥ ṭhkanyārājanyamanuṣyāṇāmantaḥ' ityantasvaritaḥ, tataḥ
svaritānudātayorekādeśa āntaryataḥ svaritaḥ, tasya siddhatvātena
varjyamānatā prāpnoti ? tataścātra yaḥ parihāraḥ sa eva gāṅge'nūpa
ityatra bhaviṣyati | kaḥ punarasau ? padadvayāśrayatvena ekādeśasya
bahiraṅgatvātsvaro'pi tadīyo bahiraṅgaḥ, śeṣanighātastu
ekapadāśrayatvāt svaro'pi tadīyo'ntaraṅgaḥ; tataḥ kim ? ṭhasiddhaṃ
bahiraṅgamantaraṅga' ||
nalopaḥ prātipadikāntasya || 8|2|7 ||
viśeṣyamantasyetyasya netyetadavibhaktikam |
tathaiva prātipadiketyetat padaviśeṣaṇam ||
prātipadikasya, padasya---iti samānādhikaraṇe ṣaṣṭhayau | ahanniti |
hanterlaṅtipo halṅyādilopaḥ |
antagrahaṇaṃ kimiti | ṭhnalopaḥ prātipadikasya' ityevāstu, ṭhpadasya'
iti vartate, tatra nakāreṇa pade viśeṣyamāṇe tadantavidhinā
nakārāntasya padasya lopo vidhīyamānaḥ ṭhalo'ntyasya' ityantyasyaiva
bhaviṣyatīti praśnaḥ | rājānāviti | asatyantagrahaṇe prātipadikasya
padasya yo'vayavo nakāraḥ, tasya yatra tatra sthitasya lopo
bhavatītyarthaḥ syāt, tataścehāpi syāditi bhāvaḥ | evaṃ ca
narābhyāmityādāvapi prasaṅgo darśayitavyaḥ | nanu ca
kriyamāṇamapyantagrahaṇaṃ prātipadikagrahaṇena samastam, tataśca
prātipadikāntasya padāvayavasya nakārasyetyeṣo'rtho bhavati, na punaḥ
padāntasyeti; tataścāhan, narābhyāmityādau mā bhūt;
rājānāvityādau tu syādeva ? ata āha---prātipadikagrahaṇamiti |
ahariti | ṭhsvamornapuṃsakāt' iti svamorluk, ṭhna lumatāṅgasya'
iti pratyayalakṣaṇapratiṣedhātsupparatvābhāvāt ṭhro'supi' iti rutvam
| ahobhyāmiti | ṭhahān' iti rutvam |
nanu cātra ratvarutvayoḥ kṛtayornakārābhāvādeva nalopo na
bhaviṣyatyata āha---rutvarephayīrasiddhatvāditi |
nanvanavakāśatvādratvarutve eva bhaviṣyataḥ, uktaṃ hyapavādasya parasyāpi
vacanaprāmāṇyāda siddhatvaṃ na bhavatīti ? ata āha---sāvakāśaṃ vai
tadubhayamiti | sambuddhau hi ṭhna ṅisaṃbuddhyoḥ' iti nalopaḥ
pratiṣiddhyate | he ahariti | ṭhvā napuṃsakānām' iti pakṣe
nalopapratiṣedhaḥ, atra ratvaṃ sāvakāśam | he dīrghāho nidāgheti |
puṃlliṅge'nyapadārthe bahuvrīhiḥ, sambuddherhalṅyādilopaḥ |
nidāghaśabdasya parasya prayogo viśeṣaṇārthaḥ, ṭhhaśi ca' ityutvam |
atha ahaḥ, ahobhyāmityādau
nalopekṛte'pyekadeśavikṛtasyānanyatvātsa evāhaḥ śabda
ityavasiṣṭasya yo'ntyākāraḥ so'vakāśā iti kasmānnoktam ? evaṃ
manyate---ahanniti nakārāparityāgena nirdeśānnakārāntasyaiva
sthānitvam, anyathā hasyetyeva brūyāditi | ahanniti
prathamaikavacanāntamiti | ādeśamātre vidhitsite ahna iti
nakārāntasyaiva ṣaṣṭha|la prathamaikavacanāntamiti | ādeśamātre
vidhitsite ahna iti nakārāntasyaiva ṣaṣṭha|la nirdeśaṃ kuryāt;
prathamāntasya nirdeśe prayojanam---etasya rūpasyānvākhyānameveti
bhāvaḥ ||
na ṅasimbuddhyoḥ || 8|2|8 ||
ārdrea carmanniti | ṭhsupāṃ suluk' ityādinā ṇeórluk |
nanu ca ṅasimbuddhyordvayorapi luptayoḥ pūrvasya prātipadikasajñā
nāsti, pratyayalakṣaṇenāpratyaya iti niṣedhāt; ṅai tu padasaṃjñāpi
nāsti, pratyayalakṣaṇenaiva pravṛtayā bhasaṃjñayā bādhitvātaḥ tatkuto'tra
nalopaprasaṅgaḥ ? ata āha---etasmādeveti | nanu ca he
surājannityādyarthametatsyād, atra hi ṭhkṛtaddhitasamāsāśca' iti
prātipadikasaṃjñā, na ca tasyā api ṭhapratyayaḥ' iti niṣedhaḥ,
sūtrāntargatatvāt ? evaṃ tarhyatrāpi ṭhapratyayaḥ' ityanuvartate, anyathā
surājetyādau vidhyarthatvasambhavāt samāsagrahaṇaṃ niyamārthaṃ na syāt
| tasmādupapannamevāsya jñāpakatvam | etacca pratikāryaṃ
saṃjñāpravṛttiriti pakṣāśrayeṇocyate, tatra hi vibhaktyarthamutpannayā
prātipadikasaṃjñayā nalopo na prāpnoti | bhasaṃjñā ca na bhavatīti |
atrāpi ṭhetasmādeva pratiṣedhavacanātpratyayalakṣaṇena jñāpyate'---iti ca
sambadhyate | jñāpanasya prayojanamāha---tathā ceti | nalopaśca
bhavatīti | prātipadikatvāt | allopaśca na bhavatīti | bhasaṃjñāyā
abhāvāt | apara āha---ṭhṭhnāyamartho jñāpakasādhyaḥ bhasaṃjñā na bhavatīti |
katham ? ṭhyaci' ityucyate, na cātra yajādiṃ paśyāmaḥ; pratyalakṣaṇena ?
ṭhna lumatāṅgasya' iti pratiṣedhaḥ, tatra hi lumatā lupte pratyaye
yadaṅgaṃ tasya yatkāryamāṅgamanāṅgaṃ vā tatsarvaṃ pratiṣidhyate" iti
|
carmatila iti | vaiyadhikaraṇye'pi gamakatvādvahuvrīhiḥ | nanu
cātyalpamidamucyate, ṅaviti sambuddhāvapyutarapade pratiṣedho
vaktavyaḥ; anyathā he rājan vṛndāraketi vigṛhya
ṭhvṛndārakanāgakuñjaraiḥ pūjyamānam' iti sambuddhyantayoḥ samāse
sati lopo na syāt | tathā ca
vārtikama---ṅasimbuddhyoranutarapada iti | ata āha---he
rājavṛndāraketyatra tviti | tatra na pūrvapadārthasambhodhanamiti | na
hi pṛthagavayavārthayorabhimukhīkaraṇe parasparamekārthībhāvaḥ sambhavati
| kiñca ṭhsambuddhau' ityucyate, na cātra sambuddhiṃ paśyāmaḥ |
pratyayalakṣaṇena ? ṭhna lumatāṅgasya' iti pratiṣedhaḥ | vacanaṃ tu he
rājannityādau yatra lopaśabdena sambuddhirlupyate tatra caritārtham |
ṅai tu nāyaṃ parihāraḥ sambhavati; sarvatra lumatā luptatvāt |
vā napuṃsakānāmiti | aprāptivibhāṣeyam; sambuddherlumatā
luptatvāt |
mādupadhāyāśca matorvo'yavādibhyaḥ || 8|2|9 ||
atra cakārādvākyabhedaḥ, maśca aśceti samāhāradvandvaḥ |
tasmānmātparasya matorvo bhavati | ṭhupadhāyāśca', mādityeva,
upadhāyāśca mātparasya matorvo bhavati, pūrveṇānantarye vihitaṃ
vyavadhāne'pi yathā syādityayamārambhaḥ | evaṃ vyākhyātavye matoriha
kāryitvenetyādi yaduktam, tatrābhiprāyo mṛgyaḥ |
kaścidāha---ṭhmakārāntānmakāropadhāvarṇāntādavarṇopadhācceti
vaiyākaraṇagoṣṭhīṣu paṭha|lte, tasyedamupapādanam' iti; tatrāpi
makāropadhādakāropadhāditi bahuvrīhyarthasya nopapādanaṃ dṛśyate | va
ityayamādeśo bhavatīti | atretiśabdaḥ paṭhitavyaḥ, tadayamartho
bhavatītyupakramāt, yavādivipratiṣedhe prakāre ādiśabdaḥ |
payasvāniti | ṭhtasau matvarthe' iti bhatvādrutvābhāvaḥ, |
iha naro'syāstīti nṛmān, tasyedaṃ nārmatamiti vṛddhau
kṛtāyāmavarṇopadhāditi vatvaṃ prāpnoti, tasya pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ ?
ityata āha---iheti | bahirbhūtataddhitāpekṣatvādvahiraṅgā
vṛddhirantarbhūtamatubapekṣe vatve asiddhā bhavatītyarthaḥ ||
jhayaḥ || 8|2|10 ||
agnicitvāniti | pūrvavadbhatvājjaśtvābhāvaḥ ||
saṃjñāyām || 8|2|11 ||
ahīvatītyādau cāturarthiko nadyāṃ matup ||
āsandīvadaṣṭīvaccakrīvatkakṣīvadrumaṇvaccarmaṇvatī || 8|2|12 ||
āsandīvadahisthalamiti | deśaviśeṣaḥ, yatredamucyate---
āsandīvati dhānyādaṃ rukmiṇaṃ haritasrajam |
aśvaṃ babandha sāraṅgaṃ devebhyo janamejayaḥ || iti |
tathā coktamiti | prayogaśāstreṣu | rājāsandī u somarājasyāsanam
| yadi tasyaiva saṃjñāyāmiti vatvena siddham,
āsandīvadityetatkimarthaṃ tahi nipātanam ? ityata āha---prapañcārthaṃ
tviha paṭha|lta iti | atretiśabdaḥ paṭhitavyaḥ, apare
tvāhurityupakramāt | śarīraikadeśasyeti | sa punarjānvoḥ
sandhiḥ | cakrīvanti sado havirdhānānīti | sārasvate satre
jaṅgamāni sadohavirdhānāni, na tvekatrāvasthitāni, tāni tatra tatra
karṣaṇāya cakrayuktāni bhavanti | kakṣīvāniti | ṭhhalaḥ' iti dīrghatvam
| rumanniti prakṛtyantaramastīti | ṭhrumā ca lavaṇākaraḥ' | ṇatvārthaṃ
ceti | ṭhpadāntasya' iti pratiṣedhaprasaṅgāt | matorvā nuḍarthamiti
| atra pakṣe pūrvasya nakārasya lopaḥ, ṇatvamapi ṭhraṣābhyām' ityeva
siddham ||
udanvānudadhau ca || 8|2|13 ||
udanvānnāma ṛṣiriti | yasya ca kāmavarṣo parjanyaḥ---yasminnudakaṃ
dhīyata iti, sa punastaṭākādiḥ | ṭhkarmaṇyadhikaraṇe ca' iti kipratyayaḥ,
ṭhpeṣaṃvāsavāhanadhiṣu ca' iti udakasyodbhāvaḥ |
udakasatāsambandhasāmānyamiti | tacca devadatādiṣvapi sambhavati |
asaṃjñārthaṃ vodadhigrahaṇam ||
rājanvān saurājye || 8|2|14 ||
śobhano rājā tasya bhāvaḥ saurājyam, brāhmaṇāditvātṣyañ,
ṭilopaḥ | tatpunaḥ śobhanena rājñā deśasya sambandhaḥ |
samāsakṛtaddhiteṣu sambandhābhidhānam; bhāvapratyayeneti vacanāt |
etacca rājanvānityasya pravṛttinimitam, deśa eva tvabhidheyaḥ,
yadāha---saurājye gamyamāna iti | rājanvāniti | praśaṃsāyāṃ
matup, nalopābhāvo nipātyate | sūtre
puṃlliṅgasyāvivakṣitatvaṃ darśayati---rājanvatī pṛthivīti ||
ano nuṭ || 8|2|16 ||
akṣaṇvanta iti | akṣiśabdasya matupi ṭhcchandasyapi dṛśyate' iti
anaṅadeśaḥ, nuṭo'siddhatvāt pūrvaṃ nalope bhūtapūrvagatyā nuṭ,
tasya ṇatvam | śīrṣaṇvatīti | ṭhśīrṣaṃścchandasi' śirasaḥ śīrṣannādeśaḥ |
prakṛtyantaraṃ vā śirasśabdena samānārthaḥ | śīrṣanniti cchandasi
nipātyate | nuḍayaṃ parādiḥ kriyate, tasya matubgrahaṇena grahaṇāt
ṭhmādupadhāyāḥ' iti vatvaṃ prāpnoti | makārasya tu na prāpnoti;
nuṭā vyavadhānāt | yadi punarayaṃ nuk pūrvāntaḥ kriyeta ? naivaṃ
śakyam; akṣaṇvatā, śīrṣaṇvatā---ṇatvaṃ na syāt | iha ca
supathintaraḥ---utarasūtreṇa nuki kṛte padāntatvāt ṭhnaścchavyapraśān'
iti rutvaṃ prāpnoti, tasmātparādireva kartavyaḥ, tatra cokto doṣaḥ
| ata āha---nuṭo'siddhatvāditi | nanvevamapyavagrahe doṣaḥ
prāpnoti---akṣaṇvanta iti akṣaṇvante iti ṇāntamavagṛhṇāti, tanna
prāpnoti ? na lakṣaṇena padakārā anuvartyāḥ padakārairnāma
lakṣaṇamanuvartyam ||
nād ghasya || 8|2|17 ||
bhūridāvatara iti | ṭhāto manin' ityādinā vanip |
rathītara iti | rathaśabdānmatvarthīya iniḥ, tadantātarap, nakāralope
kṛte dakārasya īkāraḥ | yadi tu nakāralopāpavādo nakārasya
sthāne vidhīyeta, tadā tasyāsiddhatvādekādeśo na syāt ||
kṛpo ro laḥ || 8|2|18 ||
kṛpo dhātoriti pāṭhaḥ | bhāṣye---ṭhkṛpo ro laḥ' iti paṭhitatvāt
| ṭhnuḍvidhilādeśavināmeṣvṛkāre pratividhātavyam' ityuktam,
tatrāvasare prāpte lādeśe pratividhate---iti sāmānyamiti |
varṇatvāvarṇatvakṛtabhedatiraskāreṇa varṇātmikāyāmavarṇātmikāyāṃ
ca rephavyaktau yatsāmānyaṃ vartate yato dvayorapi tayo ra
ityabhinnābhidhānapratyayau bhavataḥ, tadupādīyate; na tu varṇātmikaiva
rephavyaktirityarthaḥ | tataḥ kim ? ityata āha---teneti | ityapi
sāmānyaṃ ceti | upādīyata ityapekṣate | atrāpi tena yaśca kevalo
lakāraḥ, yaśca lṛkārasthaḥ, tayordvayorapi grahaṇamiti paṭhitavyam,
pūrvānusāreṇa tu gamyamānatvānna paṭhitam | yadi dvayorapi
grahaṇam, tato'pi kim ? ityāha---tato'yamiti | kevalasyauśuddhasya
| lakāra ādeśa iti | atrāpi kevala iti draṣṭavyam | ṛkārasyāpi
lṛkāra iti | āntaratamyāt | nanu satyapi dvayorapi grahaṇe
ṛkārasthasya rephasya lṛkārastho lakāra ādeśo bhavatu, kathaṃ tu
kṛtsnasya kṛtsno varṇa ādeśo labhyate ?
ityāśaṅkyoktam---ekadeśadvāreṇeti | ekadeśavikārastho rephaḥ,
tasya vikāra ekadeśavikāraḥ | yadvā---atra ekadeśa lṛkārastho lakāraḥ,
sa eva vikāra ekadeśavikāraḥ, taddvāreṇa | tata etaduktaṃ
bhavati---ajbhaktisampuṭitayo rephalakārayorniṣkṛṣya
kartumaśakyatvātsamudāyasya samudāya ādeśa iti | yadi
niṣkarṣo'śakyakriyaḥ, mā bhūtayorupādānam, na punaretāvatā
sūtre'nupātayoḥ samudāyayoḥ sthānyādeśabhāvo vidyate ? ityata
āha--tathā ceti | evamādaya iti | ādiśabdena ṭhtāsi ca klṛpaḥ',
ṭhṛdupadhāccāklṛpi cṛteḥ' ṭhanavaklṛptyavamarṣayoḥ'
ityādergrahaṇam | kalpteti | ūditvātpakṣe iḍabhāvaḥ | atra
latvasyāsiddhatvāt pūrvaṃ parasmaipade ṭhtāsi ca klapaḥ' itīḍabhāvaḥ,
anyatra tu guṇe kṛte rephasya lakāraḥ | ciklṛpsatīti | ṭhhalantācca'
iti sanaḥ kitvam |
kraperiti | ṭhkrapa kṛpāyām' | bhavatu samprasāraṇe kṛte rūpam,
tathāpi rūpasāmānyād grahaṇaprasaṅgaḥ ? ata āha---tasya hīti |
krapereva draṣṭavyā iti | ṭhrañje kyun', bahulavacanātkraperapi bhavati
ṭhkṛkṛpibhyāṃ kīṭan' ityatrāpi krapireva paṭhitavyaḥ |
ṭhkharjipiñjādibhya ūrolacau' kraperapi bhavatu, sarvatra bahulavacanāt
samprasāraṇam |
karpūrādaya iti | ādiśabdena kṛpāṇasya grahaṇam | ṭhyudhibudhidṛśeḥ
kicca' iti bāhulakāt kṛperapi ānac | yadyavaśyaṃ
bāhulakamāśrayaṇīyam, kṛperapi na doṣaḥ ? ityāha---uṇādaya iti |
bāleti | ṭhbala valla saṃvaraṇe', balyata iti bālaḥ | mūlamiti | ṭhmūla
pratiṣṭhāyām' ityasmādigupadhalakṣaṇaḥ kaḥ | ṭhlaṅghivaṃhyaernalopaśca'
iti kupratyayānto laghuśabdaḥ | alamityavyayam | ṭhaṅgeḥ kuliḥ'
aṅgulaḥ | ṭhamergurī raśca lo vā' iti nāśritam |
kapilakādiṣucārasya laḥ | romāṇīti | rautermanin, ṭhroman
nāman sīman stoman homan soman loman vyoman
vidharman pāpman dhāman' ityatra ṭhloman samān' iti nipātanaṃ
nāśritam | pāṃsuramiti | pāṃsurasminnastīti
ṭhnagapāṃsupāṇḍubhyaśca' iti raḥ | ṭhkṛño manin' karma | śukraḥ, śukla
iti | ṭhṛjrāgra' iti nipātanaṃ nāśritam | atha ṭhklṛpū sāmarthye,
ityeva kasmānna paṭhitam, evaṃ hi latvaṃ na vidheyaṃ bhavati ?
naitadasti; acīklṛpaditi hi na sidhyet | ṭhṛkāralṛkārayoḥ
savarṇavidhiḥ' iti lṛkārasya ṭhurat' iti akāre kṛte acīkṛpaditi
syāt, latvavidhau tasyāsiddhatvātpūrvamṛkāraḥ, tato latvamiti
siddhamiṣṭam | tathā calīklṛpyate iti rīko pi latvasiddhirbhavati
||
upargasyāyatau || 8|2|19 ||
ayatau para iti | atra dvau pakṣau---ayatigrahaṇaṃ
rephaviśeṣaṇam---ayatiparasya rephasya, sa cedupasargasyeti;
upasargaviśeṣaṇaṃ vā---ayatiparasyopasargasya yo repha iti | tatrādye
pakṣe evamanvayaḥ---ayatau parato yo repha upasargasambandhī tasyeti;
dvitīye tu---ayatau parato ya upasargastasya yo rephastasyeti |
plāyata iti | ayatiranudātet | kathaṃ tahi ṭhudayati
vitatordhvaraśmirajjau' iti parasmaipadam ? kimanena
vanyagajaśaucena ! yadi vā---pacādyajantādudayaśabdādācāre kvipi
laṭ | kecitu ṭhiṭa kaṭī gatau' ityatra ikāramapi dhātuṃ paṭhanti |
yathā tvatra darśite pakṣadvaye'pi doṣo na bhavati, tathā krameṇa
darśayati--atreti | sthānavadbhāvāditi | ṭhpūrvatrāsiddhe na
sthānivat' ityetatviha na bhavati; ṭhtasya doṣaḥ
saṃyogādilopalatvaṇatveṣu' ityapavādasmaraṇāt | yadyayatigrahaṇaṃ
rephasya viśeṣaṇamiti | kāryitvena pradhānatvāt | ekena varṇeneti |
ekagrahaṇaṃ pratyaya ityatra saṅghātena vyavāye na bhavatīti
pradarśanārtham | tathā ceti | evaṃ ca kṛtvetyarthaḥ | palyayata
ityatrāpīti | yatra śrūyamāṇenaikenaiva varṇena laukikaṃ vyavadhānam,
tatrāpi pravartate | na kevalaṃ plāyata ityādau yatra sthānibhāvadvāreṇa
śāstrīyaṃ tatraivetyapiśabdasyārthaḥ | amumeva viśeṣaṃ darśayitumasya
pṛthagupanyāsaḥ |
nanu ca ṭhnira kuṣaḥ', ṭhsuduroradhikaraṇe' iti
nirdeśādrekāntāvapyusargau staḥ, tau vacanasyāvakāśau iti kathaṃ
vyavadhāne bhavati ? ucyate; yadyetāvatprayojanaṃ syāt, ṭhdurorayatau'
ityeva brūyāt, upasargagrahaṇātu vyavāye'pi bhaviṣyati,
etaccaikavarṇavyavadhānenāpyupapannamiti na pratyayata ityatra prasaṅgaḥ |
upasargaviśeṣaṇetviti | śrutatvāditi bhāvaḥ | siddhamevaitatsavāmati
| ṭhyena nāvyavadhānamityādi na kaścit yatno'sminpakṣe'
ityevaśabdasyārthaḥ | praterapi tu prāpnotīti | pūrvasminpakṣe
saṅghātena vyavāyānna prāpnoti, atra tu prāpnotītyamuṃ viśeṣaṃ
tuśabdo dyotayati | prathamapakṣadarśanābhiniviṣṭāstviti | prathamapakṣasya
yā darśanāuparebhyaḥ pratipādanā, tatrābhiniviṣṭāḥ u tatparāyaṇā
ityarthaḥ | apare tvityādi | āptaparyāyaḥ pratyayitaśabda
itacpratyayāntaḥ, sañjātapratyayāḥ pratyayitā iti |
nisdus ityetayostviti | sakārāntaviṣayo granthaḥ,
rephāntayostu bhavitavyameva latvena ||
gro yaiṅ || 8|2|20 ||
udāharaṇe ṭhṛta iddhātoḥ' itītvam, raparatvam, ṭhhali ca' iti
dīrghasyāsiddhatvātpūrvamanena latvam,
tato'pahṛtanimitatvāddīrghābhāvaḥ |
girateḥ, gṛṇāteśceti | nigaraṇārthasya, śabdārthasya ca |
sāmānyeneti | viśeṣānupādānāt | apare tu giratereva
grahaṇamicchantītyanuṣaṅgaḥ | kaḥ punaratra hetuḥ ? ityata
āha---gṛṇātestviti | tu hyarthe | nigīryata iti | yak ||
aci vibhāṣā || 8|2|21 ||
dhātoḥ svarūpagrahaṇe tatpratyaye kāryavijñānātpratyayaḥ sannidhāpitaḥ,
tasyācā viśeṣaṇātadādividhirvijñāyate, yadāha---ajādau pratyaye
iti | nigiratīti | tudāditvācchaḥ, tasya ṅitvādisati guṇe itvam
| ṇilopasya sthānivadbhāvāditi | padasya
latvavidhānādantaraṅgatvābhāvāt ṭhpūrvatrāsiddham' iti ca
latvasyāsiddhatvāpūrvaṃ ṇilopa eva bhavatīti bhāvaḥ | pratyayalakṣaṇamapyatra
śakyaṃ vaktum | na ca varṇāśrayatvam; ṭhajādau pratyaye' ityuktatvāt |
kathaṃ punaḥ sthānivadbhāvaḥ, yāvatā ṭhpūrvatrāsiddhe na sthānivat'
iti paṭha|lte ? ata āha---pūrvatrāsiddha iti | kaḥ punarasyāpavādaḥ ?
ityata āha---tasya doṣa iti | antaraṅgatvādveti | ṭhpadasya'
ityadhikārāt
kālato'ntaraṅgatvābhāve'pyantarbhūtājādyapekṣatvāllatvamantaraṅgam,
bahirbhūtayagapekṣatvātu ṇilopo bahiraṅga iti bhāvaḥ | girau,
gira iti | vispaṣṭārtham ||
pareśca ghāṅkayoḥ || 8|2|22 ||
pari gha iti | ṭhparau ghaḥ' ityap, hanteṣṭilopaḥ, ghatvaṃ ca | paryaṅka
iti | ṭhaki lakṣaṇe' pacādyac, ṭhhalaśca' iti ghañ, cād ghaśca |
gha iti svarūpagrahaṇamatreṣyata iti | iṣṭireveyam | pariyogaḥ,
paryanuyogaḥ ||
saṃyogāntasya lopaḥ || 8|2|23 ||
iha śreyān, bhūyāniti saṃyogāntalopo na prāpnoti,
paratvādrutvena bādhyamānatvāt ? ityāśaṅkyāha---iheti |
yathaiva tarhi rutvamasiddhatvātsaṃyogāntalopaṃ na bādhate, tathā
jaśtvamapi na bādheta; tataśca payaḥ, yaśa iti jaśtvameva syād ? ata
āha---jaśtve tviti | saṃyogāntalope hi prāpte'prāpte ca
rutvamārabhyate---śreyānityādau prāpte, paya ityādau tvaprāpte |
jaśtve tu sarvatra prāpte eva | tasmādyenanāprāptinyāyena jaśtvameva
bādhyate, na saṃyogāntalopaḥ |
dadhyatretyādi | yaṇādeśo hi dvipadāśrayatvādvahiraṅgaḥ,
saṃyogāntasya lopastu ekapadāśrayatvādantaraṅgaḥ |
antagrahaṇaṃ śakyamakartum | ṭhpadasya' iti vartate, saṃyogena hi pade
viśeṣyamāṇe tadantavidhinā ṭhsaṃyogāntasya' iti labhyata eva ||
rātsasya || 8|2|24 ||
saṃyogāntasya padasyetyādi | saṃyogāntasya padasya yo'vayavo
rephaḥ, tasmādutarasya sakārasya lopo bhavati, tadeva padaṃ
pratyalo'ntyasyetyarthaḥ | akṣāḥ, atsā iti | ṭhkṣara sañcalane', ṭhtsara
cchadmagatau' | rātsasyaiveti | rādeva sasya nānyataḥ,
śreyānityādau---evaṃ tu niyamo na bhavati; uraḥ prabhṛtiṣu
pumāniti kṛtasaṃyogāntalopasya pāṭhāt | ūrgiti | ṭhūrja
bālaprāṇanayoḥ', ṭhbhrājabhāsa' ityādinā kvip | atra niyamājjakārasya
lopābhāve ṭhcoḥ kuḥ' iti kutvam---gakāraḥ, ṭhvāvasāne' iti
cartvam | nyamāḍatiṃ | ṭhmṛjū śuddhiu' adādiḥ, tipo
halṅyādilopaḥ, ṭhmṛjervṛddhiḥ', vraścādinā ṣatvam,
jaśtvacartve |
dhi ca || 8|2|25 ||
ṭhitaḥ prabhṛti sicaḥ sakārasya lopaḥ' iti vakṣyati, tataśca sicā pratyaya
ākṣipyate, tasya dhakāreṇa viśeṣaṇātadādividhirvijñāyate,
ityāha---dhakārādau pratyaya iti | bhāṣyakāramate tu dhakāre para iti
draṣṭavyam | alaviḍhvamiti | luṅ, cleḥ sic, iṭ, sico
lopaḥ, ṭhvibhāṣeṭaḥ' iti pakṣe mūrdhanyaḥ | dhakāro na śrūyeteti |
ṣṭuatve kṛte alaviḍhvamityeva syāt | vibhāṣāgrahaṇaṃ tu tatra
ṣīdhvamartham, lirṅthaṃ ca syāt |
itaḥ prabhṛtītyādi | ṭhudaḥ sthāstambhoḥ pūrvasya' iti
pūrvasavarṇavidhānamatra jñāpakamāhuḥ | anyathā utasthā iti sthite
takārātparasya sakārasya ṭhjhalo jhali' iti lope sati
utthānamityādeḥ siddhatvādanarthakaṃ tat syāt | sāmānyāpekṣaṃ ca
jñāpakam---asmin prakaraṇe yo lopaḥ sa sica iti | cakāddhīti | he
śiraḥ palitaṃ saccakāddhi, śobhasvetyarthaḥ | ṭhcakāsṛ dīptau' adādiḥ,
loṭ, sipo hiḥ, herddhiḥ, ṭhjhalāṃ jaś jhaśi' iti sakārasya
dakāraḥ | payo dhāvatīti | ṭhhaśi ca' iti rorutvam | yadi sico
lopa iṣyate, sagdhiḥ, babdhām---ṭhjhalo jhali' iti lopo na syāt
? ata āha---sagdhirbavdhāmiti | adeḥ ktini ṭhbahulaṃ cchandasi' iti
ghaslādeśaḥ, ṭhghasibhasorhali ca' ityupadhālopaḥ, ṭhbahulaṃ cchandasi'
iti salopaḥ, ṭhjhaṣastathordho'dhaḥ' jaśtvena ghakārasya gakāraḥ, samānā
gdhiḥ sagdhiriti ṭhpūrvāparaprathama' ityādinā karmadhārayaḥ, ṭhsamānasya
cchandasi' iti sabhāvaḥ | babdhāmiti | ṭhbhasa bhartsanadīptyoḥ'
juhotyādiḥ, loṭ, tasastām, ślau dvirvacanam,
pūrvavadupadhālopaḥ, sakārasya ca lopaḥ, takārasva dhakāraḥ, pakārasya
jaśtvam---bakāraḥ | payo dhāvatītyevamādāvapīti | anyathā rutvasya
siddhatvāt pūrvaṃ salopaḥ syāt |
bhāṣyakārastvāheti | pūrvaṃ tu ślokavārtikakārasya mataṃ darśitam |
yatnāntaramāstheyamiti | ekapadāśrayatvādantaraṅgaṃ rutvam,
padadvayāśrayatvādvahariṅgaḥ salopaḥ; tatra salopasyāsiddhatvāt
pūrvatreti nirddiṣṭasya visargasyābhāvādasiddhatvābhāvādutvameva
tāvatpravartate, alvidhitvācca sthānivatvābhāvādorlopābhāva iti |
dhi sakāra iti | sthānino'pi viṣayatvavivakṣayā sakāra iti
saptamīnirdeśaḥ | āśādhvamiti | ṭhāṅḥ śāsu icchāyām'
adādiranudātet | jaśtvamiti | ṭhjhalāṃ jaś jhaśi' ityanena |
sarvamevamiti | yadi sakārasya jaśtvenāśādhvamiti siddham, tataḥ
sarvameva lakṣyajātaṃ jaśtvenaiva siddhaṃ syāt, tataśca sūtramevedaṃ na
kartavyamiti | śrutiścāpi na bhidyata iti | vyañjanaparasyaikasyānekasya
vā halaḥ śravaṇe na dhāryata ityarthaḥ | luṅścāpīti | ayaṃ cāparo
jaśtve sati guṇaḥ, ṭhiṇaḥ ṣīdhvam' ityatra luṅe grahaṇaṃ na kartavyaṃ
bhavati; avyoḍhvam, aloḍhvamityādau ṣatvajaśtvaṣṭuatvaireva
rūpasya siddhatvāt |
hrasvādaṅgāditi sico lope'kṛḍhvaṃ kathaṃ bhavet |
doṣāntarābhidhānātu naitatsuṣṭhua nirūpitam ||
taddarśayati---seṭi duṣyatīti | etacca yadyatra sakārasya lopo na
syādityupakrame evoktam | tasmāddhi ceti kartavyam, mūrdhanye ca
luṅe grahaḥ | dhisakāre sico lopa iti tvetadavasthitam | tatra
doṣāntaraṃ darsayati---ghasibhasoriti |
sagdhirbabdhāmityetayorasiddhiprasaṅgāt, na sico lopaḥ śakyo
vijñātumityarthaḥ | pariharati---chāndaso varṇalopo veti |
vāśabdaḥ pakṣaṃ vyāvartayati, sica evāyaṃ lopaḥ, ghasibhasyostu
chāndaso varṇalopa iti | kva yathā ? ityāha---yatheti |
iṣkartāramadhvarasyetyasyaikadeśānukaraṇādiṣkartāramadhvaraśabdātsaptamī | tatra bahvacāḥ---iṣkartāramiti paṭhanti, taitirīyāstu niṣkartāramiti ||
jhalo jhali || 8|2|26 ||
bhidicchidī svaritetau, manyatihanudātet |
ayamapi sica eva lopa iti | yadi vā ṭhpadasya' iti vartate, tatra
pratyāsateḥ ṭhjhalo jhali' sasyeti nirddiṣṭānāṃ
trayāṇāmapyekasambandhatve vidhirayamiti somasut stotetyādau na
bhaviṣyati | samāse'pi na bhavati---somasutsthitiriti | kiṃ
kāraṇam ? sakārathakārābhyāṃ yatpadamārabdhaṃ tatprati
takārasyāvayavatvābhāvāt ||
hrasvādaṅgāt || 8|2|27 ||
acyoṣṭeti | salopasyāsiddhatvātpūrvaṃ guṇaḥ, tato
vihitanimitatvāllopābhāvaḥ | ayamapīti | atra ṭhudaḥ sthāstambhoḥ'
iti pūrvoktaṃ jñāpakameva śaraṇam | dviṣṭamāmiti | ṭhhrasvātādau
taddhite' iti ṣatvam ||
iṭa īṭi || 8|2|28 ||
atra sica eva sambhavaḥ ||
skoḥ saṃyogādyorante ca || 8|2|29 ||
guṇabhūto'pi saṃyogo jhalantābhyāṃ viśeṣyate |
saṃyogādyoḥ padasyānte skoryasmānnāsti sambhavaḥ ||
iti matvā''ha---padasyānta iti | jhali ca parata iti | padasya yaḥ
saṃyoga ityapekṣate | lagna iti | ṭholasjī vrīḍe', niṣṭhā,
īditvādiṭpratiṣedhaḥ | atra takāre jhali parataḥ sajayoryassaṃyogaḥ
tadādiḥ sakāraḥ, ṭhoditaśca' iti niṣṭhānatvam, tasyāsiddhatvāt
kutvam | sādhulagiti | sādhu lajjata iti kvip | magna iti |
ṭhmasjinaśorjhali' iti num, sa ca jakārātpūrvaḥ, ṭhmasjerantyātpūrvaṃ
numamicchanti' iti vacanāt | tena ṭhaniditām' iti nalopaḥ,
salopādi pūrvavat | taṣṭa iti | ṭhtakṣū tanūkaraṇe',
ūditāvadvikalpiteṭ, ṭhyasya vibhāṣā' itīṭpratiṣedhaḥ |
jhali saṅīti vaktavyamiti | saṅītyayaṃ prakaraṇaśeṣaḥ | kiṃ prayojanam ?

giro'bhodhirdviṣṭarāṃ ca dṛṣatsthaḥ kāṣṭaśaksthiraḥ |
kruñcā dhuryeti mā smaiṣu satvādīni bhavantviti ||
gira iti---atra ṭhaci vibhāṣā' iti latvaṃ mā bhūt |
abhodhiriti---ṭhdhi ca' iti salopo na bhavati |
dviṣṭarāmiti---ṭhhrasvādaṅgāt' iti na bhavati | dṛṣatsthaḥ---ṭhjhalo
jhali' iti na bhavati | kāṣṭhaśaksthiraḥ---ṭhskoḥ saṃyogādyoḥ' iti
na bhavati | kruñcā---ṭhcoḥ kuḥ' iti kutvaṃ na bhavati | dhuraṃ vahatīti
dhuryeti---ṭhhali ca' iti dīrghatvaṃ na bhavati | tathā ca
vārtikam---ṭhsaṅ litvalopasaṃyogādilopakutvadīrghatvāni' iti |
saṅīti prakṛtya latvādīni vaktavyānītyarthaḥ | tadevaṃ
vārtikakāramate'pi cakādhītyeva bhavitavyam; saṅīti vacanāt |
sanaḥ pramṛtīti | dhātupratyayānāṃ grahaṇamityarthaḥ | atra
saṃyogādilopaṃ prayojanaṃ pratyācaṣṭe---taditi | taditi
vākyopanyāse | śakeriti | kakārāntopalakṣaṇametat, tena ṭhkaka
laulye', ṭhkuka vṛka ādāne' ityāderapi kvibantasya prayogo
nāstyeva | āhuriti | bhāṣyakārādayaḥ | tatra bhāṣyaṃ tāvat
paṭhati---kāṣṭhaśageveti | vākyarthamityatra sthānivadbhāvo'pi śakyo
vaktum ṭhtasya doṣaḥ saṃyogādilopa' ityuktatvāt ||
coḥ kuḥ || 8|2|30 ||
nakāropadho veti | pūrvamautpatikaṃ ñakāropadhatvamāśrityektam,
idānīṃ tu nakārasyānusvāraparasavarṇābhyāmāgato ñakāra ityucyate |
nakāralope hīti | tathā sannipātaparibhāṣāyāḥ prayojaneṣu
paṭhitam---udupadhatvasya nikucita iti | kucitaśabde
kitvasannipātakṛtamudupadhatvam
ṭhudupadhādbhāvādikarmaṇoranyatarasyām' kitvasya nimitaṃ na
bhavatītyarthaḥ | nanvastu nopadhaḥ, tathāpyanusvāraparasavarṇayoḥ
kṛtayoḥ nakārasya kutvaprasaṅgaḥ ? ata āha---tatreti | cutvasya tvatra
prasaṅgo nāsti; anusvāraṃ prati tasyāsiddhatvāt ||
ho ḍhaḥ || 8|2|31 ||
soḍheati | ṭhtīṣasaha' itīḍ vikalpaḥ | turāṣāḍiti | ṭhcchandasi
sahaḥ' iti ṇviḥ, ṭhanyeṣāmapi dṛśyate' iti pūrvapadasya dīrghatvam;
ṭhsaheḥ sāḍaḥ saḥ' iti ṣatvam | praṣṭhavāḍiti | ṭhvahaśca' iti ṇviḥ ||
dāderdhātorghaḥ || 8|2|32 ||
kiṃ tarhi tadviśeṣaṇamiti | yadyapi samānādhikaraṇaṃ na
bhavatītyasyaitatpratipakṣabhūtaṃ na bhavati, samānādhikaraṇasyāpi
viśeṣaṇatvopapateḥ, tathāpi sāmānādhikaraṇyapakṣe ṭhdhātoḥ'
ityetadviśeṣyam; atra tu pakṣe viśeṣaṇamityasyaiva pratipakṣatā |
avayavaṣaṣṭha|lntamiti | avayavasambandhe yā ṣaṣṭhī tadantamityarthaḥ | atra
spaṣṭameva pratipakṣatvam---dhātoravayavo yo dādiḥ śabda iti | evaṃ
copakrame'pi dakārādeḥsa dhātoḥ---iti vyadhikaraṇe ṣaṣṭhayau | kiṃ
kṛtaṃ bhavatīti | kimiṣṭṃa siddhaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ | adhogityatrāpīti |
sāmānādhikaraṇye tvaḍāgamena dāditvasya vihitatvānna syāt |
kathamiti | dhāturevāyaṃ na dhātoravayava iti praśnaḥ | atha veti |
asminpakṣe upakrame'pi ṭhdāderdhātoḥ' iti yathāśrutameva | dhātūpadeśa
iti | etacca dhātugrahaṇāllabhyate |
na hyadhātordakārāderhakārāntasya sambhavaḥ |
devānaḍudbhyāmityādau yasmāḍḍhatvaṃ pravartate ||
tadetadasamīcīnamavadhānacyutaṃ vacaḥ |
yasmāddāmaliḍityāderadhātorapi sambhavaḥ ||
tasmāddhātugrahaṇamāvartanīyam | tatraikamatiricyamānamupadeśakālaṃ
lakṣayati | tathā ceti | pūrvatra tu pakṣe vyapadeśivadbhāvena
dāmaliḍityatrāpi prasaṅgaḥ ||
vā druhamuhaṣṇuhaṣṇihām || 8|2|33 ||
druhādaya ete divādiṣvanenaiva krameṇa prapaṭha|lnte,
radhāditvādvikalpiteṭaḥ | tatra ṭhvā druhādīnām' iti vaktavye
pratipadapāṭho yaṅlukyapi yathā syāt---dodhruk, dodhruṭ;
anyathā ṭhnirddiṣṭṃa yadgaṇena ca' iti na syāt ||
naho dhaḥ || 8|2|34 ||
parīṇaditi | sampadāditvātkvip, ṭhnahivṛtti' iti dīrgatvam,
ṭhupasargādasamāse'pi' iti ṇatvam | prakriyālāghavārthaṃ dakāra eva
vidhātavye dhakāravidhānam ṭhjhaṣastathordho'dhaḥ' iti dhatvaṃ yathā
syāt, naddhamityatra radābhyāṃ niṣṭhānatvaṃ ca mā bhūditi |
āhasthaḥ || 8|2|35 ||
atha prakṛto dhakāra eva kasmānna vidhīyate, tasyāpi hi cartvena
āttheti siddham, thakārasyāpi cartvena bhavitavyam, evaṃ ca kṛtvā
ṭhāhanahordhaḥ' ityeka eva yogaḥ kartavyaḥ ? ata
āha--ādeśāntarakaraṇamiti | evamapi takāra eva kartavyaḥ |
hṛgrahoriti | hakārasyeti vacanaṃ haratyartham | nigrābhamiti | ṭhudi
grahaḥ' ityatra ṭhcchandasi nipūrvādapīṣyate srugudyamananipātanayoḥ' iti
vacanādvā ghañ ||
vraścabhrasjasṛjamṛjayajarājabhrājacchaśāṃ ṣaḥ || 8|2|36 ||
atra śakārāntasya jaśtve prāpte, itareṣāṃ tu kutve tadapavādaḥ
ṣatvaṃ vidhīyate | mūlavṛṭ, dhānāmṛḍiti | grahijyādinā
samprasāraṇam, ṭhskoḥ saṃyogādyoḥ' iti salopaḥ, ṣakārasya
jaśtvam---ḍakāraḥ, ṭhvāvasāne' iti pakṣe ṭakāraḥ |
jhalādirābhyāmityādi | paryavapadyateuvyavadhīyate | rāṣṭiḥ,
bhrāṣṭiriti | ṭhgurośca halaḥ' ityakāre prāpte ṭhktinnābādibhyaḥ' iti
ktinpratyayaḥ, ṭhtitutratatha' ityādineṭpratiṣedhaḥ |
śabdaprāḍiti | ṭhkvibvaci' ityādinā kvip, dīrghatvam,
samprasāraṇābhāvaśca | cchagrahaṇamanarthakam; ṭhcchvoḥ śūḍ'
ityādinā cchasya śatve kṛte śāntānāmityeva ṣatvaṃ siddham ? ata
āha---cchvoḥ śūḍityādi ||
ekāco baśo bhaṣ jhaṣantasya sdhvoḥ || 8|2|37 ||
ṭhdhātoḥ' iti yadihānuvartate tadvyadhikaraṇamavayavaṣaṣṭha|lntam
ṭhekācaḥ' ityasya viśeṣaṇam | ṭhjhaṣantasya' ityetadapi tasyaiva
samānādhikaraṇaṃ viśeṣaṇam | evaṃviśiṣṭṃa tu ṭhekācaḥ'
ityetadavayavaṣaṣṭha|lntiviśeṣaṇam | tadāha---dhātoravayava ityādi |
jhali sakāra iti | etenānuvartamānasya jhalo viśeṣaṇaṃ sakāra iti
darśayati | kimatha punariha jhalītyanuvartate ? ṭhanta'
ityasyānuvṛttiryathā syād, anyathā jhalītyasya nivṛtau tatsambaddhamanta
ityapi nivarteta | nanu 
catvāro bhaṣa ādeśāḥ sthāninastu baśastrayaḥ |
ḍakārasya tu na kvāpi sambhavo'sti kathañcana ||
tataśca vaiṣamyātsaṃkhyātānudeśo na prāpnoti ? tatrāha---catvāro
baśaḥ sthānina ityādi |
śāstrapratītivelāyāṃ saṃkhyāsāmyasya sambhavāt ||
pravartate yathāsaṃkhyamanuṣṭhāne tvasambhavaḥ ||
ityarthaḥ | kvacitu nāyaṃ granthaḥ paṭha|lte | bhotsyanta iti |
budhiranudātet, lṛṭi syaḥ, tatra vyapadeśavadbhāvena dhātuṃ
pratyekāco'vayavatvam | abhughvamiti | 
ṭhdhi ca' iti sico lopaḥ | guhiduhī svaritetau |
ajardhā iti | gṛdheryaṅluki dvirvacane dhātuṃ
pratyekāco'vayavatvam, ṭhrugrikau ca luki' iti ruk, jargṛdh iti
sthite laṅadi |
gardabhayateriti | gardabhamācaṣṭa iti ṇic | aśrāvī pratyayo'pratyayaḥ
kvidiḥ |
asatyekājgrahaṇe ityādi | yadyekājgrahaṇaṃ na kriyeta,
tato'nyasyehāśrutatvād baśeva dhātorityanena viśeṣyeta | baśo
jhaṣantatvasyāsambhavājjhaṣantasyetyanenāpi dhātureva viśeṣyeta,
tataścāyamarthaḥ syāt---jhaṣantasya dhātoryo'vayavo vaś tasya
bhaṣiti, tato dāmaliḍityatrāpi prasaṅgaḥ | ṭhekācaḥ' ityasmiṃstu sati
vṛttikāropadarśita evārtho bhavatīti ca tatra prasaṅgaḥ | atra hi yo
jhaṣanta ekāc liḍiti na tasyāvayavo braś dakāraḥ, yasya cāvayavo
dāmityasya na sa jhaṣantaḥ | krotsyatīti | atra kakārasya ghakāro na
bhavati ||
dadhastathośca || 8|2|38 ||
dadhātirnirdiśyata iti | ṭhdadha dhāraṇe' ityasya grahaṇaṃ na bhavati; śapā
tayorvyavāyāt |
nanu yaṅluki vyavāyo nāsti, tataśca tasyaiva grahaṇaprasaṅgaḥ, evaṃ
ca varcanasāmarthyāditi vakṣyamāṇaṃ nāśrayitavyaṃ bhavati ?
tasmādvyākhyānamevātra śaraṇam |
vacanasāmarthyāditi | na hi dadhātirākāralopena vinā jhaṣanto
bhavati | etacca ṭhpūrvatrāsiddhe na sthānivat' ityanāśrityoktam |
abhyāsajaśtvasya cāsiddatvamiti | vacanasāmarthyānna bhavatītyapekṣate |
na hyabhyāsasya jaśtvena vinā dadhāterbaś kvacit sambhavati |
tathoriti kimiti | ṭhjhali' iti vartate, ṭhjhaṣantasya' iti ca; na ca
takārathakārābhyāmanyo dadho jhalasti, sdhvostāvadiṣṭameva |
tasmātathoriti na vaktavyam | evaṃ ca kṛtvā cakāro'pi na kartavyaḥ,
sarvatra jhalītyeva siddhamiti praśnaḥ | ānantaryāditi | nanu ca
sdhvoḥ pūrveṇeva siddham ? na sidhyati; āllopasyasthānivadbhāve
sati ajhaṣantatvāt | nanu ca pūrvatrāsiddhe nāsti sthānivadbhāvaḥ ?
evamapyabhyāsajaśtvasyāsiddhatvānna sidhyati |
yadi tu ṭhabhyāsajaśtvacartvametvatukoḥ siddhaṃ vaktavyam' ityatra
etvatukorityapanīyāviśeṣeṇa siddhatvamucyeta, phalibhajigrahaṇaṃ vā
sāmānyena jñāpakamāśrīyeta, na tvetvaviṣayameva; tataḥ ṭhtathośca' iti
śakyamakartum | katham ? sdhvoḥ pūrveṇaiva siddham, idaṃ tu
vyatirikte jhali yathā syādityevamarthaṃ bhaviṣyati ||
jhalāṃ jaśo'nte || 8|2|39 ||
padasyānte vartamānānāmiti | padāvasāne vartamānānām |
antaśabdo'vasānavacanaḥ, na tvavayavavacanaḥ | śvaliḍiti | atra hakārasya
jaśtve prāpte tasyāsiddhatvāt pūrvaṃ ḍhatvam, ḍhakārasya
jaśtvam---ḍakāraḥ |
jhaṣastathordho'ghaḥ || 8|2|40 ||
dadhātiṃ varjayitveti | anenādha iti dhātupratiṣedhaṃ darśayati | yadi
dhakārapratiṣedhaḥ syāt---dhakārātparayorneti, tataḥ ṭhgatibuddhi'
ityādayo nirdeśā nopapadyeran | alabdhaṣa alabdhā iti | luṅi
ta-thāsau | evamalīḍha, alīḍhā iti | dhataḥ, dhattha iti | dhatve pratiṣiddhe
dhakārasya cartvam |
ṭhadhaḥ' iti śakyamavaktum | iha kasmānna---dhataḥ, dhattha iti ? jaśtve
yogavibhāgaḥ kariṣyate, ṭhdadhastathośca', ṭhjhalāṃ jaśaḥ'---jhalāṃ jaśo
bhavanti dadhastathoḥ, tataḥ ṭhante'---ante ca jhalāṃ jaśo bhavanti, tatra
ṭhpūrvatrāsiddham' iti bhaṣbhāve jaśtvasyāsiddhatvājjhaṣantatvam | dhatve
parasmin siddhaṃ jaśtvamityajhaṣantatvāddhatvābhāva iti siddhamiṣṭam ||
radābhyāṃ niṣṭhāto naḥ pūrvasya ca daḥ || 8|2|42 ||
ṭhniṣṭhātaḥ' iti samāsanirdeśaḥ | tatra pradhānabhūtatakāraḥ ṭhradābhyām'
ityanena viśeṣyate, na guṇabhūtā
niṣṭhetyāha--rephadakārābhyāmutarasyeti | tena caritam,
muditamityatra niṣṭhāyā avyavadhāne'pi tasyeṭā vyavahitatvānnatvaṃ na
bhavati | avagūrṇamiti | ṭhgurī udyamane', ṭhśvīdito niṣṭhāyām'
itīṭapratiṣedhaḥ, pūrveṣu rṭhśyukaḥ kiti' iti | bhinnaḥ, bhinnavāniti
| ādeśe ṭhna' ityakāra uccāraṇārthaḥ, tena dakārasya sthāne śuddho
nakāro bhavati | kṛtaḥ kṛtavāniti |
nanu yathā ṭhkṛpo ro laḥ' ityṛkārasyāpi rephasya lakāro bhavati,
tathehāpi ṛkārasya rephamāśritya natvaṃ prāpnoti ? ata āha---ra
ityatreti | yuktaṃ tatra sāmānyopādānāt, iha tu na
sāmānyamupādīyate, kiṃ tarhi ? vyañjanam | kimātmakam ?
arddhamātrātmakam, ṛkārastu mātrācaturbhāgātmakaḥ | astu vā
sāmānyanirdeśaḥ, tathāpi na doṣa ityāha---sāmānyanirdeśe ceti |
ṛkāre hyabhito'jbhaktiḥ, madhye rephabhaktiḥ, tataśca parayā'jyabhaktyā
vyavadhānānnāsti natvaprasaṅgaḥ |
caritam, muditamiti | ṭhta' ityanucyamāne iṭo niṣṭhābhaktatvātasya
natvaprasaṅgaḥ | parasya mā bhūditi | parasyaiva mā bhūdityarthaḥ | asati
pūrvagrahaṇe pāṭhakrame niṣṭhā pratyāsanneti taddakārasyeva natvena
bhāvyam | tenaitadapi na
codanīyam---bahiraṅgatvāllākṣaṇikatvācca na bhaviṣyatīti |
kiñca---padasyetyadhikārāt padāvasthāyāṃ
natvavidhānādvahiraṅgatvamapi nāsti | kevalasya varṇasyānupadeśāt
pratipadoktatvamapi nāsti | athāpi pratyāsatirnāpekṣyate, tathāpi
pañcamīnirdeśāt parasyaiva prasaṅgaḥ | kārtirityatra
bahirbhūtataddhitāpekṣatvādvahiraṅgā vṛddhiḥ | vṛddheśca yannimitaṃ
tadeva rephasyāpi; ṭhuraṇ raparaḥ' ityasya vṛddhividhinaikavākyatvāt
||
saṃyogāderāto dhātoryaṇvataḥ || 8|2|43 ||
pradrāṇa iti | ṭhkṛtyacaḥ' iti ṇatvam |
niryāta iti | yo'tra dāturnāsau saṃyogādiḥ, yaśca
saṃyogādirnāsau dhātuḥ | na cātra saṃyogāditvasya bahiraṅgatvam
| katham ? pūrvaṃ dhāturupasargeṇa yujyate, tataśca niṣṭhotpateḥ
prāgeva saṃyogaḥ sannihitaḥ | pradrāṇa ityādāvapyetāvadeva ||
lvādibhyaḥ || 8|2|44 ||
jīna iti | ṭhjyā vayohānau', grahijyādinā samprasāraṇam |
niṣṭāvaditi | natvasannidhau vacanātadevātidiśyate, tena
pūnirityatra ṭhkliśaḥ ktvāniṣṭhayoḥ', ṭhpūṅśca' itīḍvikalpo na
bhavati |
dugvoriti | ṭhdu gatau' ityasyaiva dorgrahaṇam, na tu ṭhṭuadu
upatāpe' ityasya; sānubandhakatvāt | tathā māghe
prayuktam---ṭhmṛdutayā dutayā' iti | ṭhgu purīṣotsarge'| 
pūnā iti | anekārthatvāddhātūnāṃ pūñ vināśārthaḥ |
sino grāsa iti | ṭhṣiñ bandhane', badhyamānaḥupiṇḍīkriyamāṇo
grāso yadā dadhyadivyañjanavaśena tatrānukūlyaṃ pratipadyate, tadā
karmaṇaḥ kartṛtvavivakṣāyāmayaṃ prayogaḥ | sitā pāśeneti | śuddhe
karmaṇi ktaḥ, samudāyapratyudāharaṇametat |
idānīmavayavapratyudāharaṇaṃ darśayati---grāso'pīti |
oditaśca || 8|2|45 ||
āpīna iti | ṭhpyāyaḥ pī' iti pībhāvaḥ | svādayaḥ ṭhṣūṅ māṇiprasave'
ityādayaḥ ṭhbrīṅ vṛṇotyarthe' ityevamantā divādau paṭha|lnte ||
kṣiyo dīrghāt || 8|2|46 ||
ṭhkṣi kṣaye', ṭhkṣi nivāsagatyoḥ'---dvayorapi grahaṇam | kṣīṇā iti |
akarmakatvāt kartari ktaḥ, ṭhniṣṭhāyāmaṇyadarthe' iti dīrghaḥ |
kṣīṇastapasvīti | atrāpi ṭhvā''krośadainyayoḥ' iti |
ṭhdīrghāt' iti śakyamavaktum, ṭhkṣiyaḥ' iti nirdeśādeva dīrghasya
grahaṇaṃ vijñāyate, hrasvasya hi grahaṇe iyaṅadeśātparatvāt
ṭhghirṅiti' iti guṇe kṛte kṣeriti nirdeaṣṭavyaṃ syādityata
āha---hrasvāntasyāpīti | yathābhūtasya dīrghatvaṃ vidheyaṃ
tathābhūtamevānukartuṃ yuktam | hrasvāntasya ca dīrghatvaṃ vidheyamiti
tasyaiva dīrghavidhāvanukaraṇam | tatrāpi ceyaṅadeśo dṛṣṭaḥ,
tasmādiyaṅadeśo na dīrghagrahaṇe pramāṇamityarthaḥ |
yadi tarhi hrasvāntasyāpi dhātvanukaraṇasyeyaṅadeśo bhavati
ṭhviparābhyāṃ jeḥ' ityādāvapi prasaṅgaḥ ? ityata āha---viparābhyāṃ
jerityevamādau tviti | avivakṣitveti pāṭhaḥ | tatra hi
dhātāvanukārye'vasthitaṃ dhātutvaṃ
kriyāvācitvalakṣaṇamavivakṣitatvātasya vivakṣāmakṛtvā
rūpasāmānyasya---vijitam, kūjitamityādisādhāraṇasya
rūpasyānukaraṇam, tataśca viśeṣanibandhanasya kāryasya
sāmānye'bhāvātprakṛtāvadṛṣṭatvādanukaraṇe'pyabhāva ityarthaḥ | yadā tu
viśeṣo'nukriyate, tadā tannibandhanaṃ kāryamanukaraṇe pravartate,
yathātreyaṅadeśaḥ | yadyevam, vibhaktyutpattirna prāpnoti, ṭhadhātuḥ'
iti pratiṣedhena prātipadikasaṃjñāyā abhāvāt ? naiṣa doḥ;
adhāturiti paryudāso'yam, na prasajyapratiṣedhaḥ | tataḥ kim ?
ātideśikasya kasyacit kāryasyābhāvāt dhātoranyatvātsvāśrayā
prātipadikasaṃjñā pravartate | iyaṅadeśastvātideśiko
dhātorvidhīyamānatvādbhavati ||
śyo'sparśe || 8|2|47 ||
śīnamiti | ṭhśyaiṅ gatau', ṭhdravamūrtisparśayoḥ śyaḥ' iti
samprasāraṇam |
guṇabhūto'pi sparśa iti | etacca vyākhyānāllabhyate,
sparśaśabdo'yamasti guṇavacanaḥ, ṭhspṛśa saṃsparśane', bhāve karmaṇi vā
ghañ---sparśastvagindriyagrāhyae guṇaḥ; asti rogavacanaḥ, ṭhspṛśa
upatāpe', ghañ---sparśaḥ; tadiha viśeṣānupādānād dvayorapi
grahaṇam |
tataśca roge'pi pratiṣedhātpraśīna iti na sidhyet ? ata āha--guṇe
ceti | guṇa evetyarthaḥ | evaṃ manyate---yadayam ṭhdravamūrtisparśayoḥ
śyaḥ' iti sparśe saṃprasāraṇaṃ vidhāyapunaḥ ṭhprateśca' ityāha,
tajjñāpayati---śyāyatergrahaṇe sparśaśabdo rogaṃ na pratyāyayatīti |
yadi pratyāyayet punarna vidadhyāt, pratipūrvo roga eva
śyāyatirvartate ||
añco'napādāne || 8|2|48 ||
na cedapādānaṃ tatra bhavatīti | tatrāñcatyarthe viṣaye'pādānaṃ cenna
bhavatītyarthaḥ | samakāviti | saṅgatāvityarthaḥ | ṭhyasya vibhāṣā'
itīṭpratiṣedhaḥ, ṭhaniditām' ityupadhālopaḥ |
udaktamiti | uddhatamityarthaḥ | vyaktamityetaditi | ṭhañjū
vyaktimrakṣaṇakāntigatiṣu' ityasyedaṃ rūpam, nāñcateḥ; tena natvamidaṃ
na bhavatīti bhāvaḥ ||
divo'vijigīṣāyām || 8|2|49 ||
ādyauuna iti | ṭhcchavoḥ śūṅ' | ādyauunaḥuaudarikaḥ | paridyauunaḥukṣīṇaḥ |
dyauutaṃ vartate iti | nanvatrākṣādipatanalakṣaṇā krīḍā pratīyate, na
vijigīṣā ? ata āha---vijigīṣayā hīti ||
nirvāṇo'vāte || 8|2|50 ||
vātādhikaraṇa iti | vātakartṛka ityarthaḥ | yadi ṭhvātaścedabhidheyo na
bhavati' ityarthaḥ syāt, tadā nirvāto vāta ityatraiva pratiṣedhaḥ
syādyatra kartari ktaḥ; yatra tu bhāve tatra na syāt---nirvātaṃ vāteneti
|
nirvāṇo'gniriti | upaśānta ityarthaḥ | nirvāṇo bhikṣuriti |
uparata ityarthaḥ | vātastu karaṇamiti | yathāsambhavaṃ karaṇatve hetau
vā tṛtīyā draṣṭavyā | yathā tu vārtikaṃ tathā bhāve pratiṣedho na
bhavati, nirvāṇaṃ vātenetyeva bhavati ||
prastyo'nyatarasyām || 8|2|54 ||
prastīma iti | ṭhstyaḥ prapūrvasya' iti samprasāraṇam ||
anupasargāt phullakṣībakṛśollāghāḥ || 8|2|55 ||
phulla iti | ṭhāditaśca' itīṭpratiṣedhaḥ, ṭhutparasyātaḥ', ṭhti ca'
ityutvam |
ktavatvantasyāpyetallatvamiṣyata iti | niṣṭhāyāstaśabdāntaṃ yadrūpaṃ
tasya phullaḥ---ityetannipātyata iti bhāvaḥ | kṣībādiṣu tu
naitadiṣyate |
iḍabhāva iti | anyathā talopasyāsiddhatvādvalāditvādiṭ prasajyeta |
kṛte vā iṭi icchabdalopa iti | nipātyata ityapekṣate |
lāgherudo'nya iti | udastu pratiṣedho na bhavati; nirdeśasāmartyāt
| kṛśi pratyanupasarga eveti | ṭhyatkriyāyuktāḥ prādayastaṃ prati' iti
vacanāt | kriyāntarayogameva darśayati---parigataḥ kṛśa iti |
kārśyena parigata ityarthaḥ | yadyapi phullādayaḥ pacādyaci igupadhalakṣaṇe
ke ca sidhyanti, tathāpi ṭhniṣṭhā ca dvyajanāt' ityādikāryasiddhaye,
kṣībitādyaniṣṭaśabda nivṛtaye ca nipātanam; phullaśabde tu
phullāvanityetadarthaṃ ca ||
nudavidondatrāghāhrībhyo'nyatarasyām || 8|2|56 ||
atrānantarasya nipātanasya vidhātumaśakyatvādvyavahitaṃ vidheyamiti
sthite ṭhśuṣaḥ kaḥ' ityādibhirādeśāntarairvyavahitamapi natvameva
vidhīyate | katham ? utarasūtre tāvatadeva pratiṣidhyate;
prāptipūrvakatvātpratiṣedhasya | tasmātadeva buddhau
viparivartamānamatrāpi vikalpyate | samunna iti | ṭhundī kledane',
īditvādiṭpratiṣedhaḥ, ṭhaniditām' ityupadhālopaḥ | 
ubhayatra vibhāṣeyamityāha---hrī ityetasyeti |
vida vicāraṇa ityasyeti | raudhādikasya; undinā raudhādikena
sāhacaryāt | yadyapi taudādikena nudināpi sāhacaryam, tathāpi
parasāhacaryameva vyavasthāpakam; ṭhvipratiṣedhe param'
ityasyaivamādāvapyupayogāt |
vicāraṇārthasya grahaṇamityetadāptāgamena draḍhayati---evaṃ hyuktamiti |
viterdhātorniṣṭhāntaśabdarūpaṃ vidita itīṣyate, tasya seṭtvāt;
iha ca ṭhradābhyāṃ niṣṭhātaḥ' ityanuvṛteḥ vidyateḥ satārthasya vidervinna
itīṣyate; tasyāniṭtvāt, iha ca tasyāgrahaṇāt | vinteriti |
tiṅntānukaraṇāt ṣaṣṭhī | bhogavita iti | ekārthībhāvābhāve'pi
bhāṣyakaranipātanātsaptamīsamāsaḥ | bhogagrahaṇamupalakṣaṇam | bhoga
pratyayayorarthayoḥ vindatestaudādikasya vidervita itīṣyate, anyatra
vinna iti natvameva bhavati, na tvayaṃ vikalpa ityarthaḥ | ukto'tra hetuḥ
||
na dhyākhyāpamūrcchimadām || 8|2|57 ||
mūrta iti | ṭhāditaśca' itīṭpratiṣedhaḥ, ṭhrāllopaḥ' iti cchasya
lopaḥ | mata iti | īditvādiṭpratiṣedhaḥ ||
vito bhogapratyayayoḥ || 8|2|58 ||
lābhārthāditi | jñānārthādiṭā bhāvyam | satāvicāraṇārthayorapi na
bhogapratyayayorvṛttiḥ sambhavatīti bhāvaḥ | kathaṃ punarbhoge
nipātyamāno vitaśabdo dhane bhavati ? ityata āha---dhanaṃ hīti |
karmasādhanaḥ sūtre bhogaśabda ityarthaḥ | etena ṭhpratyayaḥ' iti
vyākhyātam |
vinna iti | ṭhvibhāṣā gamahanavidaviśām' iti taudādikasya kvasau
vikalpiteṭatvād ṭhyasya vibhāṣā' iti niṣṭhāyāmiṭhpratiṣedhaḥ ||
bhitaṃ śakalam || 8|2|59 ||
śakalaparyāyo'yamiti | yathā śakalaśabdo jātiśabdaḥ, na kriyāśabdaḥ,
tathā bhitaśabdo'pītyarthaḥ |
nanvayaṃ bhiderdhātoḥ vyutpādyamānaḥ kriyāśabdaḥ, sa kathaṃ jātiśabdasya
paryāyo bhavati ? ata āha---atreti | santi hi te śabdā yeṣu
vyutpattimātropayoginī kriyā, jātireva tu samudāyaśaktyā
śabdārthaḥ, yathā---tailaṃ pibatīti tailapāyiketi | kimarthaṃ
punarevamāśrīyate ? ityāha---bhidikriyāvivakṣāyāṃ hīti |
sāmyapratipādanārthaṃ śakalagrahaṇam | yatā vidāharaṇavivakṣāyāṃ bhinnaṃ
śakalamiti bhavati, tathā bhinnaṃ bhitamityeva prayoga ityarthaḥ |
kriyāśabdatve tu bhinnaśabdenaiva kriyāyā upātatvādbhinnamityasyaiva
prayogo na syāt | anye tvāhuḥ---yathā vidāraṇakriyayā śakalaṃ
nivartate, tadā tāmaṅgīkarotyeva bhinnaśabdaḥ, yat śakalasya sato
vidāraṇaṃ tadā tatpratipādanāya bhinnaṃ bhitamiti prayoga iti ||
ṛṇamādhamarṇye || 8|2|60 ||
ṛ ityetasmāditi | ṭhña sṛ gatau', ṭhṛ gatiprāpaṇayoḥ' iti vā |
etasmādeveti | śauṇḍādivyatirekeṇa saptamīsamāsa eva mṛgyaḥ,
prāgeva saptamyantotarapada iti bhāvaḥ | kālāntaretyādi |
ṛṇagrahaṇakālāpekṣayā kālāntaratvam, tatra deyaṃ kālāntaradeyam,
tatra yo vinimayaḥuviparivartanaṃ tadupalakṣaṇārthamādhamarṇyagrahaṇam,
na tu svārthapratipādanārtham | kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇamevaṃ vyākhyāyate ?
ityāha---utamarṇa ityapi hīti | etacca ṭhdhārerutamarṇaḥ' iti
nirdeśādavasitam ||
nasataniṣātānutapratūrtasūrtagūrtāni cchandasi || 8|2|61 ||
nasatetyādīnāmanukaraṇapadānāṃ dvandvaḥ | niṣatamiti |
ṭhsadiraprateḥ' iti ṣatvam |
anunnamiti bhāṣāyāmiti | ṭhnudavidondatrā' iti vikalpo na bhavati;
etannipātānārambhasāmarthyādityāhuḥ |
pratūrtamiti | yadā tvarateḥ, tadā ṭhjvaratvara' ityādinā ūṭh | udā
tu ṭhturvīhiṃsāyām' ityasya, tadā ṭhrāllopaḥ'| utvamiti |
raparatvam ṭhuraṇ raparaḥ' ityava siddham;
parabhāṣāṇāmasiddhaprakaraṇe'pi pravṛteḥ ||
kvinpratyayasya kuḥ || 8|2|62 ||
kvinaḥ kuriti vaktavye iti | na hi kvinpratyayatvaṃ vyabhicaratīti
bhāvaḥ | na caivamucyamāne ṭhverapṛktasya' iti lopaṃ bādhitvā kvina
eva vakārasya kutvaṃ ghakāraḥ prāpnotīti śaṅkanīyam; tathā kvina
iti pratyagrahaṇaparibhāṣayā tadantasya grahaṇe sati kvino vakārasya
lope kartavye sati kutvasyāsiddhatvāt ṭhrāllopa' eva bhavati,
tasmiṃśca sati paścādbhavatkutvaṃ pariśiṣṭasya dhātoreva bhaviṣyati |
syādetat---kvibādiṣu sāvakāśaṃ lopaṃ viśeṣavihitaṃ
kutvamapavādo vacanaprāmāṇyāditi nyāyena bādheteti ? tanna; evaṃ
hi vargagrahaṇamanarthakaṃsyāt | anekasya
sthānino'nekādeśapratipataye hi vargagrahaṇam, vakārasyaiva tu
sthānitve ghakāra eva nirdiśyeta, ṭhvargāṇāṃ tṛtīyacaturthāḥ' iti
śikṣāyāṃ vakāraghakārayorguṇasāmyapratipādanāt | tasmāt ṭhkvinaḥ
kuḥ' ityeva vaktavyam | bahuvrīhivijñānārthamiti |
bahuvrīhivijñānārthamiti | bahuvrīhiścopalakṣaṇe'pi bhavati,
yathā---citragurānīyatāmiti gavāmabhāve'pi
citragavībhirupalakṣitasyānayanaṃ bhavati, tathehāpyasatyapi kvipi
kvinopalakṣitasya dhātoḥ kāryaṃ bhavatīti | asrāg, adrāgiti |
sṛjidṛśibhyām ṭhmāṅ luṅ', itip, cleḥ sic,
halṅyādilopaḥ, ṭhvadavraja' iti vṛddhiḥ | atra vraścādiṣatve prāpte
kutvam---jasya gaḥ, śasya khaḥ, tasyāpi jaśtvam, ṭhvāvasāne' iti
cartvam---kakāraḥ | ṭhpūrvatrāsiddham' ityasiddhatvaṃ ṣatve kutvasya
nāsti; pratyayagrahaṇasāmarthyāt ṣatvāpavādatvāt kutvasya |
kvibantasyāpīti | draṣṭetyādau tu na bhavati; apadāntatvāt | evaṃ ca
satītyādi | tadvadeva | dṛgbhyāmiti kutvamudāhṛtam |
pratividhātavyamiti | pratividhānaṃ kartavyamiti | pratividhānaṃ
vacanameva ||
naśervā || 8|2|63 ||
jīvanāśahetutvādāhutiḥujīvanagityucyate, sampadāditvādbhāve
kvip ||
mo no dhātoḥ || 8|2|64 ||
nalopo na bhavatīti || natvaṃ tu lopārthameva syāditi manyate ||
sasajuṣo ruḥ || 8|2|66 ||
sajūriti | pūrvavadbhāve kvip, rutve kṛte rṭhvorupadhāyāḥ' iti
dīrghatvam, bahuvrīhau sahasya sabhāvaḥ | saprītirityarthaḥ ||
avayāḥ śvetavāḥ puroḍāśca || 8|2|67 ||
ṇvini kṛta iti | prāpta ityarthaḥ | śvetavahādīnāṃ yatra padatvaṃ bhātri
tatra ṇvino'pavādo ḍas vaktavya iti hi tatrārthaḥ, na
punarṇvinantānāṃ padatve sati ḍas vaktavya iti |
nanu śvetavobhyāmityādisiddhyarthamavaśyaṃ ḍas vaktavyaḥ, sa
ceducyate nārtho'nena, sāntatvātpūrvoṇaiva ruḥ siddhaḥ, dīrghatvam
ṭhatvasantasya' ityeva siddham ? tatrāha---sambuddhau dīrghārthamiti ||
ahan || 8|2|68 ||
ahobhyāmiti | ṭhhaśi ca' ityutvam | nalopamakṛtvetyādi |
nalopavidhāvetadvyākhyātam |
lākṣamikatvāditi | aḍāgamena ahanniti rūpalābhāt |
hrasvavidhāviti | samāse ca lumatā lopād rādeśe prāpte
rutvamutvārthamucyate | ahorūpamiti | ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ | gatamaho rūpaṃ
paśyetyasamāsaḥ | ahorātra iti | ṭhahassarvaikadeśa' ityādināc
samāsāntaḥ, ikāralope kṛte'pyekadeśavikṛtasyānanyatvādutvam |
rātragrahaṇaṃ tu na kṛtam; gatamaho rātrirāgatetyasamāse'pi
rutvārtham ||
ro'supi || 8|2|69 ||
pūrvasyāyamapavādaḥ | ṭhra' ityakāra uccāraṇārthaḥ | adardadātīti |
atyantasaṃyoge dvitīyā | ahno ruvidhāviti | yathā caitatsūtreṇaiva
siddham, tathā ṭhna lumatāṅgasya' ityatroktam | dīrghāho nidāgha iti
| ṭhasupi' iti prasajyapratiṣedhaḥ | paryudāse tu supsadṛśo
halparo'stīti syādevātra rephaḥ | prasajyapratiṣedhe tu pratyayalakṣaṇena
pratiṣedhe sati rureva bhavati, tataśca tannibandhane yatvotve bhavataḥ ||
amnarūdharavarityubhayathā cchandasi || 8|2|70 ||
nityaṃ rutve prāpte pakṣe ro'pi yathā syādityayamārambhaḥ | amnasśabda
īṣadarthe, amnarastamita iti yathā | avaḥurakṣaṇam |
pracetā rājanniti | sakārasya rephaḥ, tasya ṭhro ri' iti lopaḥ,
ṭhḍhralope pūrvasya dīrgho'ṇaḥ' iti dīrghaḥ |
aharādīnāmityādi | ubhayatrāpyādiśabdaḥ prakāre | idamapi cchandasi
bhāṣāyāṃ ca ||
bhuvaśca mahāvyāhṛteḥ || 8|2|71 ||
tisro mahāvyāhṛtayaḥ---pṛthivyantarikṣasvargāṇāṃ vācikāḥ, iha tu
madhyamāyā grahaṇam | bhuvo viśveṣu savaneṣviti | tiṅntametat |
bhavateḥ ṭhcchandasi luṅlaṅliṭaḥ' iti vartamāne laṅ, sip, śapi
guṇābhāvaścchandasaḥ, ṭhbahulaṃ cchandasyamāṅyoge'pi' ityaḍabhāvaḥ |
lākṣaṇikatvādevāsyāgrahaṇe siddhe mahāvyāhṛtigrahaṇam---asyāḥ
paribhāṣāyā anityatvajñāpanārtham | tena krāpayatītyādau puk
siddho bhavati ||
vasusraṃsudhvaṃsvanaḍuhāṃ daḥ || 8|2|72 ||
sa iti vartata iti | ananuvṛtau tu tasya vidvānityādau nakārasya
datvaṃ prāpnoti | na tu sraṃsudhvaṃsū iti | viśeṣyete iti
vipariṇāmenānvayaḥ | asambhavāccānaḍucchabda iti | na viśeṣyata
ityanvayaḥ |
ihedaṃ vasordatvaṃ nāprāpte vidhyantare ārabhyamāṇaṃ yathā
vidvadbhyāmityādau rutvaṃ bādhate, tathā vidvānityādau
saṃyogāntalopamapi bādheta ? ityata āha---rutve nāprāpta iti |
athānaḍvānityatra numo dakāraḥ kasmānna bhavati ? ata
āha---numastviti | datvaṃ yadi nakārasya syāt numo'narthako
vidhiḥ, hakārasyāpi datvena hyanaḍvāditi sidhyati | yathaiva tarhi
numo vidhānasāmarthyāddatvaṃ na bhavati, tathānaṅvān atretyādau
ṭhdīrghādaṭi samānapāde' iti rutvamapi na prāpnoti ? ṭhyaṃ vidhiṃ
pratyupadeśo'narthakaḥ sa vidhirbādhyate, yasya tu vidhenimitameva
nāsau bādhyate' datvaṃ ca pratinumo vidhiranarthakaḥ, ruvidheḥ
punarnimitameva ||
sipi dhāto rurvā || 8|2|74 ||
dhātugrahaṇamutarārthamiti | iha tu sipi parato
dātoranyasyāsambhavaḥ | rugrahaṇaṃ ceti | utarārthamityanuṣaṅgaḥ, iha
tu datve vikalpite sāntatvāde pakṣe ruḥ sidhyati ||
daśca || 8|2|75 ||
abhinaditi | tanmadhyapatitasya śnamastadbhaktasya vāṭastadgrahaṇena
grahaṇādatra padasya dhātutvam ||
rvaurupadhāyā dīrgha ikaḥ || 8|2|76 ||
dhātoḥ, padasya---ityubhayaṃ samānādhikaraṇaṃ rephavakārābhyāṃ
viśeṣyate, viśeṣaṇena ca
tadantavidhirbhavatītyāha---rephavakārāntasyeti |
vagrahaṇamutarārthamiti | iha tu vakārāntasya padasya dhātorasambhavaḥ |
abhyāsekārasya mā bhūditi | yadi syāt, tasyāsiddhatvād ṭhhrasvaḥ' iti
hrasvo na syāt ||
upadhāyāṃ ca || 8|2|78 ||
rṭhvorupadhāyāḥ' ityādi sarvamanuvartate | idamupadhāgrahaṇaṃ
rvorviśeṣaṇam | ṣaṣṭhīdvicanasya tu sthāne saptamyekavacanam |
prakṛtamupadhāgrahaṇamiko viśeṣaṇam, tacca rvapekṣayā pūrvatvaṃ
pratipādayati, tena vṛttikāropadarśitaḥ sūtrārtho bhavati |
hūrcchitetyādi | ṭhhurchā kauṭilye', ṭhmurchā mohasamucharāyayoḥ',
aco rahābhyām' iti dvirvacanasyāsiddhatvādrephasyopadhātve sati
pūrvavaddīrghatvam | ṭhcirijirī hiṃsārthau' |
iha riryatuḥ, vivyaturiti ṭhri gatau', ṭhvī gatyādiṣu', liṭ,
atus, dvirvacane ṭheranekācaḥ' iti yaṇādeśaḥ | atrābhyāsekārasya
dīrghaprasaṅgaḥ, tataśca tasyāsiddhatvād hrasvo na syāt,
tatrāha---riyeturityādi | yaṇādeśasya sthānivadbhāvāditi | na ca
dīrghavidhau sthānivadbhāvapratiṣedhaḥ; alopājādeśatvāt | evamapi
ṭhpūrvatrāsiddhe na sthānivat' ityāśaṅkya
parihārāntaramāha---asiddhatvātveti | aṅgādhikāre vidhānāt
pratyayāśrayatvādyaṇo bahiraṅgatvam, dīrghasya tu
tadanapekṣatvādantaraṅgatvam |
iha caturyiteḥ kyajantātṛc, iṭ, ato lope kṛte ṭhkyasya
vibhāṣā' iti yadā'yaṃ lopo na bhavati, tadā dhātorupadhābhūto
repho halparaśceti dīrghaprasaṅgaḥ ?
ityāśaṅkāyāmāha---caturyitetyatrāpīti |
atrāpyantaraṅgatvabahiraṅgatve pūrvavat | iha pratipūrvāddiveḥ
ṭhkaninyuvṛṣitakṣi' iti kaninpratyayāntātṛtīyaikavacane
ṭhallopo'naḥ' ityakārasya lope pratidīvneti dīrghatvamiṣyate, tanna
prāpnoti; vakārasya dhātuṃ pratyanupadhātvādityata
āha---pratidīvnetyatreti | kathaṃ punaḥ ṭhhali ca' iti dīrghatvam,
yāvatāllopasya sthānivadbhāve sati halparo vakāro na bhavati ?
ityata āha---dīrghavidhāviti | nanu mā bhūtsthānivadbhāvaḥ,
vibhaktyāśrayatvenāllopo bahiraṅgaḥ, tasyāsiddhatvāddhalparo na
bhavati ? ityata āha---asiddhaṃ bahiraṅgamantaraṅga ityetatviti |
anāśrayaṇaṃ tvasyāḥ paribhāṣayā anityatvāt |anityatvaṃ ca ṭhnalopaḥ
supsvara' itiyatra tugvidhigrahaṇena jñāpitam | iha jīryateḥ krin
raśca vaḥ---jivriḥ, kṛgṛbhyāṃ kipratyayaḥ---kiriḥ, giriḥ,
tābhyāmos, yaṇādeśaḥ---kiryoḥ, giryo ratra ṭhhali ca' iti
dīrghatvaṃ prāpnoti ? tatrāha---uṇādayo'pyutpannānīti | uṇādiṣu
nāvaśyaṃ vyutpattikāryaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ | etacca ṭhataḥ kṛkamikaṃsa' ityatra
kamigrahaṇenaiva siddhe kaṃsagrahaṇena jñāpitam---kvacid
vyutpattikāryaṃ bhavatyeva, yathā---pratidīvneti | kiryorityatra yaṇo
bahiraṅgatvamanāśrityayaṃ parihāra uktaḥ ||
na bhakurchuarām || 8|2|79 ||
churyāditi | ṭhchura chedane', āśiṣi liṅ |
pratidīvneti | yo'tra vakārānto nāsau bhasajñakaḥ, yaśca bhasaṃjño
nāsau vakārāntaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? nakārāntaḥ ||
adaso'serdādu do maḥ || 8|2|80 ||
ṭhaseḥ' iti sakāre ikāra uccāraṇārthaḥ | amūbhyāmiti | atra tyadādyatve
kṛte ṭhsupi ca' iti dīrghatvam, tata āntaratamyādākārasya ūkāraḥ |
nanu ca sūtre hrasvo nirddiṣṭaḥ, bhāvyamānatvācca savarṇagrahaṇamapi
nāsti, tatkathamūkāro labhyate ? ata āha---bhāvyamānenāpīti | etacca
ṭhdiva ut' iti taparakaraṇena jñāpitam | kecidatrāpyukāraṃ daparaṃ
paṭhanti---ṭhuddomaḥ' iti, teṣāmayamautpatiko dakāro mukhasukhārthaḥ,
na punarastakārasya jaśtvam, tathā hi sati savarṇagrahaṇaṃ na syāt |
adaparapāṭhastu bhadraḥ | adasyatīti | nanu ca ṭhpadasya' pati vartate, na
cedaṃ padam; ṭhnaḥ kye' iti niyamāt ? evaṃ tarhyetadeva
jñāpayati--padasyāpyadasa etanmutvaṃ bhavatīti---amum, amuyeti,
anyathā yatra svādau padaṃ tatraiva syād---amuṣyai, amūbhyāmiti |
anosra iti | okārasakārarephā na vidyante yasya tasyetyarthaḥ | adaḥ
kulamiti | visarjanīyasyāsiddhatvādrephāntametat |
tadarthamiti | okārarephayorapi pratiṣedhārtham | aḥ seryasyeti |
ko'rthaḥ ? ityatrāha---yatreti | tena kiṃ siddhaṃ bhavati ?
ityāha---teneti |
kathamadra|ladeśa iti | asaminviṣaye vaktavyamastīti praśnaḥ,
tadāha---adaso'dreriti | ślokasya pūrvārdhaṃ vyācaṣṭe---yairati |
tṛtīyaṃ pādaṃ vyācaṣṭe---ye tviti | caturtha pādaṃ vyācaṣṭe--yeṣāṃ
tviti | amumuyaṅiti | ado'ñcatīti ṭhṛtvig' ityādinā kvin,
ṭhviṣvagdevayośca' ityadasaṣṭeradra|ladeśaḥ adadra|ljiti sthite
adaḥ--śabdasyādra|ladeśasambandhino dakārarephayośca mutvam, sau
ṭhugidacām' iti num, halṅyādisaṃyogāntalopau,
ṭhkvinpratyayasya kuḥ' iti kutvam---nakārasya ṅkāraḥ | 
amuyā, amuyoriti | atra yakārasyotvaprasaṅgaḥ || 
eta īdvahuvacane || 8|2|81 ||
arthanirdaśo'yamiti | vyāpternyāyāt | kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇamevaṃ
vyākhyāyate ? ityata āha---pāribhāṣike iti | tadā hi ṭhtasminniti
nirdiṣṭe pūrvasya' iti paribhāṣopasthānādvahuvacane parata
ekārasyetvena bhavitavyam, na cātra bahuvacanaṃ param ||
vākyasya ṭeḥ pluta udātaḥ || 8|2|82 ||
adhikāro'dhikārāntaranivartaka iti vākyādhikāreṇa padādhikārasya
nivṛttiḥ prāpnoti, tataśca bhavantau---ityādāvapadāntasyāpi
nakārasya ṭhnaścchavyapraśān' iti rutvaṃ prasajyeta ?
ityāśaṅkyāha---padādhikāro'nuvartata eveti | na hi vākyagrahaṇena
padādhikāraḥ śakyo nivartayitum; yo hi vākyasya ṭiḥ, sa
sanniyogataḥ padasyāpi bhavatyeva |
atha vākyagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā vākyasthasyaiva padasya prayogaḥ, na
kevalasya ? tatrāha---vākyagrahaṇamiti | ṭhpadasya ṭeḥ' ityucyamāne
vākye yāvanti padāni teṣāṃ sarvaṣāṃ ṭeḥ plutaḥ prāpnoti, iṣyate
ca vākyapadayoryaṣṭistasyaiva yathā syāditi |
ṭigrahaṇamityādi | asati ṭigrahaṇe
plutaśrutyā'cparibhāṣopasthānādacā tadantavidhau sati ajantasyaiva
vākyasyālo'ntyasya plutaḥ syāt; yathā napuṃsakahrasvatvam---grāmaṇi
kulamityādau bhavati, na punaḥ suvāgityādau; tadvat | ṭigrahaṇe tu
sati tadupādānasāmarthyāṭṭinā ajviśeṣyate, na tvacā ṭiriti
halantasyāpi plutaḥ sidhyati ||
pratyabhivāde'śūdre || 8|2|83 ||
pratyabhāvādo nāmetyādi | gururityupalakṣaṇam | trivarṣapūrvaḥ
śrotriyo'bhivādamarhati, abhivādyamānaḥuāśiṣaṃ vācyamāno

tatraiva loke prasiddhatvāt | tadyathā---ṭhavidvāṃsaḥ pratyabhivāde nāmno
ye na plutiṃ viduḥ' iti | tatreti | āśīrvādaviṣaye | kīdṛśe ?
aśūdraviṣaye | aśūdro viṣayo yasya sa tathoktaḥ, abhivādane sati
pratyabhivāda iti | taṃ tāvadudāharati---abhivādaya iti |
namaskārapūrvamāśiṣaṃ vācayāmītyarthaḥ | evamabhivādito guruḥ
pratyabhivadati---āyuṣmāniti | āyuṣmatvasya
vidheyatvātsambodhanavibhaktyabhāvaḥ | edhīti | asterloṭi sipo hiḥ |
bhavetyarthaḥ |
ṭhāyuṣmānbhava saumyeti vipro vācyo'bhivādane' iti mānave

tatra ṭhakāraścāsya nāmno'nte vācyaḥ pūrvākṣaraḥ plutaḥ' ityuktam,

vyākaraṇe vaktavyam; akārastu kevalamadṛṣṭārthaḥ prayujyate, na tvasya
kaścidartho'sti |
anye tu mānavamanyathā
vyācakṣate---asyābhivādayiturnāmno'nteuavasāne yo'kāraḥ sa
pluto vācyaḥ, akāra ityupalakṣaṇam, pūrvākṣaraśca pluto vācyaḥ,

pinākapāṇa3ya, hara3ya, śambha3va, viṣṇa3va---iti | pratyabhivāde

tuṣajaka iti | kutsite kaḥ, ṭhśūdrasya tu jugupsitam' iti vacanāt

nāmagotrābhyāmabhivāda---pratyabhivādāvicchanti tanmatenāyaṃ

asūyatītyasūyakaḥuavinītaḥ | tasmiṃstvityādinā'sūyake pratiṣedhaṃ

sthālinniti pāṭhaḥ, na tu sthālīvaditi |

bhorājanyaviśāṃ veti | bho iti svarūpagrahaṇam, itarayostu

dūrāddhūte ca || 8|2|84 ||
dūrāditi ṭhdūrāntikārthebhyo dvitīyā ca' iti pañcamī,
hūtamuhvānam, bhāve niṣṭhā | dūrādityucyate, dūraṃ
cānavasthitam, tadeva hi kañcitpratyatidūraṃ kañcitpratyantikaṃ bhavati
| evaṃ hi kaścitkañcidāha--ya eṣa pārśvataḥ karakastamānayeti; sa
āha---utthāya gṛhāṇa, dūre na śaknomi gantumiti; apara āha---dūraṃ
mathurāyāḥ pāṭaliputramiti, sa āha---na dūramantikamiti, tadevaṃ
dūrasyānavasthitatvānna jñāyate---kasyāmavasthāyāṃ plutyā
bhavitavyamiti ? ata āha---dūramityādi | hvānam u hūtam,
tadapekṣayā yaddṭaraṃ tadihāśrīyate; dūrāddhūtamityanvayāt |
itikāraṇo hetau, na tu deśamapekṣya deśāntaraṃ dūraṃ bhavati |
kimidaṃ hūtāpekṣaṃ dūram ? ityata āha---yatreti | yatra hūte,
prākṛtātsvabhāvasiddhat | evaṃvidhe hūte deśadvārakahūtāpekṣamapi
dūratvamastīti bhāvaḥ |
hūtagrahaṇaṃ ceti | yena para āgamane niyujyate taddhūtam, tacca
nāntareṇa sambodhanaṃ sambavati, sambodhito hi puruṣa āgamane
pānādau vā niyujyate, ato nāntarīyakatvāddhūtena sambodhanamātraṃ
lakṣyate | upalakṣaṇe prayojanamāha---teneti |
ihāyaṃ pluto dūrātsambodhane vidhīyate, ekaśrutirapi
tatraiva---ṭhekaśruti dūrātsambuddhau' iti, ekasmiṃśca viṣaye prāptānāṃ
bādhavikalpasamuccayānāmanyatamena bhavitavyam, tadiha ko bhavati ?
ityāha---asyāśceti | bādhastāvadviṣayabhede sati bhavati, yathā
kāṇoḥ; tatra hi kasya viśeṣo viṣayaḥ, aṇastu dhātusāmānyam; iha
tu naivaṃ viṣayabhedo'sti | vikalpo'pi sahaprāptayorbhavati, yathā
tavyadādīnām | iha caikaśrutau kartavyāyāṃ
plutasyāsiddhatvātsahapraptirnāsti, tasmātpāriśeṣyātsamāveśa eva
bhavati | ekasminvākye dvayorapi yugapatpravṛttirityetāvatā cātra
samāveśavācoyuktiḥ, tatvatastu vākyasya ṭeḥ pluta udāhṛtaḥ,
pariśiṣṭasyaikaśrutyamiti bādha eva ||
haiheprayoge haihayoḥ || 8|2|85 ||
pūrveṇa hūyamānārthasya vākyāntasya padasya ṭeḥ
plutavidhānādatadarthayohuhayorna prāpnotīti vacanam |
haihayoreveti | evakāraḥ paunarvacanikaḥ---haihayoḥ prayoge
tayoreva haihayoriti | anye tu---haihayoreva bhavati, na na
hūyamānārthasya vākyasya ṭeriti varṇayanti | tadetatkathaṃ labhyate ?
apakṛṣya vidhānāt | hūyamānārthasya plute prāpte atadarthayoreva
tayovidhīyamānaḥ plutastaṃ bādhate;satyapi sambhave bādhanaṃ bhavatīti
nyāyāt | na cāsyāsiddhatvām; apavādo
vacanaprāmāṇyādityuktatvāt | hai3 iti | ṭhplutāvaica idutau' iti
vacanādikārabhāgaḥ plutaḥ | he3 iti | ṭheco'pragṛhyasya' ityanena
plutavikāro na bhavati; dūrāddhūtatvāt |
haihayoriti kimartham ? haihayoḥ pluto yathā syāt,
anyathā''rambhasāmarthyādanantyasya hūyamānavācina eva syāt---devadata
hai ityādau | evaṃ tarhi haihayorityevāstu, kiṃ ṭhhaiheprayoge'
ityanena, na hyaprayujyamānayoḥ plutavidhiḥ sambhavati ? ucyate;
ṭhprayoge' iti tāvadvaktavyam, prayogamātra yathā syāt | kiṃ siddhaṃ
bhavati ? anarthakayorapi grahaṇaṃ siddhaṃ bhavati | kva ca tāvanarthakau ?
yatra sambodhanavacanaṃ prāk prayujyate, tatra tenaivābhimukhyasya
dyotitatvānna haihayordyotyamastītyānarthakyam | yatra tu haihayoḥ
prāk prayogaḥ, tatrānayorābhimukhyaṃ dyotyamityarthavatvam | evamapi
prayoge haihayorityevāstu, haihayoḥ pluto bhavati prayoge, kasya
? haihayoreveti śrutatvāt, tasmātpunahuhegrahaṇasya prayojanaṃ
vaktavyam ? tadāha---punariti |
yadi tu prayogagrahaṇādevānarthakayorivānantyayorapi
bhaviṣyatītyucyate; śakyaṃ punahuhegrahaṇamakartum ||
guroranṛto'nantyasyāpyekaikasya prācām || 8|2|86 ||
anantyasyāpi ṭeriti | anenāpiśabdena prakṛtaṣṭiḥ samuccīyata iti
darśayati | yadi tu guroḥ sannidhānāt sa evāntyaḥ
samuccīyeta---guroranantyasyāntyasyāpīti, tato tena yatrāntyo
gurustatraiva paryāyaḥ syāt | laghau tvantye pūrveṇa tasya syād,
anena cānantyasya guroriti dvayoḥ plutayoryugapacchravaṇaṃ
prāpnoti | ṭhanudātaṃ padamekavarjam' iti vacanānnāsti
yaugapadyasambhavaḥ | asiddhaḥ plutaḥ, tasyāsiddhatvānniyamo na na prāpnoti
? naitadasti; ṭhkāryakālaṃ saṃjñāparibhāṣam', yatra kārya

udātaḥ; upasthitamidaṃ bhavati---ṭhanudātaṃ padamekavarjam' iti,

samāveśaḥ prāpnoti abhipūjate dūrāddhate pluto bhavannanudātaṃ

devadata iti, tatra tena gurorudātaḥ plutaḥ syāt, tasmāṭṭireva
samuccetavyaḥ | tatra hyaekaikasyeti vacanāt yathā'nantyasya paryoyo'yaṃ
bhavati, tathā'ntyasya ṭerapīti nāsti yaugapadyaprasaṅgaḥ |
ekaikagrahaṇaṃ paryāyārthamiti | anyathā'nantaroktena
prakāreṇodātānudātayoḥ plutayoḥ samāveśaḥ syāt |
kvacitpaṭha|lte---pratyabhivāda ityevamādinā yaḥ pluto

śabdasyedaṃ plutavidhānam, na yatra tatra sthitasya guroriti
draṣṭavyam |
prācāṃgrahaṇaṃ vikalpārthamiti | tena pakṣe na kasyacidapi pluto
bhavati | tadanenetyādi | taditi vākyopanyāse | ṭhagnītpreṣaṇe

omabhyādāne || 8|2|87 ||
plutaśrutyā'cparibhāṣopasthānādaca eva plutaḥ, makārastvarddhamātra iti
samudāyo'rdhacaturthamātraḥ sampadyate ||

ye yajāmaha ityatraivāyaṃ pluta iṣyate iti | pitryāyāṃ ye

ka eṣa praṇavo nāmeti | iha śāstre'paribhāṣitatvātpraśnaḥ | pādasyeti
| śāstrāntaraprasiddha āśrīyate, devatāvat, akṣaramac, antyamacaṃ

sarvatra cānayovikalpamicchanti, teṣāmeva cedaṃ sūtraṃ paṭhitam |

vana iti | kvanibvanipoḥ sāmānyena grahaṇam |
anubandhānirdeśādatra tadanubandhakaparibhāṣāyā anupasthānāt
kvanipo'pi grahaṇam | prātaritva iti | prātaretīti ṭhanyebhyo'pi
dṛśyante' iti kvanipi hrasvasya tuk | avaśabdasya ceti | sarvasyeti
draṣṭavyam; anarthake'lontyaparibhāṣāyā abhāvāt | upasaṃkhyānaṃ
pratyācaṣṭe---nipātavijñānādveti | etadeva vivṛṇoti---atha veti |
avaśyaṃ caitannipātatvameva vijñeyamityāha---asambuddhāvapi hīti |
striyāmiti | bho brāhmaṇīti | vibhaktinimiteṣu kāryeṣu
liṅgaviśiṣṭaparibhāṣā nopatiṣṭhata ityuktam---ṭhna vā vibhaktau
liṅgaviśiṣṭāgrahaṇāt' iti, tena bhavatīśabdasya rutvautve na
syātām | athāpi syātām ? evamīkārasya rutve avaśabdasya caukāro
rūpaṃ na sidhyati | tasmādasambuddhau striyāṃ ca darśanānnipātā eveti
vijñeyam | nipātatvaṃ ca vibhaktisvarapratirūpakatveneti |
nanvasatyasminnupasaṃkhyāne bhoityādikaḥ śabdo vibhaktyanto nāsti,
yatpratirūpakā ete syuḥ ? tasmātsautrā ete nipātāḥ, ṭhbhobhagoaghoḥ'
ityatra sūtre nirdiṣṭāḥ, cādiṣu vā paṭhitavyāḥ | tadevaṃ
pratyākhyātamupasaṃkhyānam |
anye tvāhuḥ---ṭhitarābhyo'pi dṛśyante' iti bhavadādiyoge
vidhīyamānāstasilādayaḥ, tataḥ ṭhbho' ityādāvapi yathā syuriti
vārtikārambha iti |
anye tu---bhavadāderaparigaṇitatvād nipātā bhoityādayo
bhaviṣyantīti manyante ||
atrānunāsikaḥ pūrvasya tu vā || 8|3|2 ||
pūrvatvamidamāpekṣikam, rutvaṃ ca sannihitam | na ca tadapekṣaṃ
pūrvatvaṃ sambhavati; roranunāsikasya ca sahavidhānāt | tasmādyasya
rurvidhīyate tadapekṣameva pūrvatvaṃ vijñāyata ityāha---yasya sthāna iti
|
athātragrahaṇaṃ kimartham ? atra ruprakaraṇe yathā syāt |
adhikārādapyetat siddham, adhikāre hi sati rutvānunāsikayoḥ
saha vidhānānnānyatra prasaṅgaḥ ? atha āha---atragrahaṇamiti | avadhāraṇamatra
draṣṭavyam---ruṇaiva saheti | nanvadhikārādapyetatsiddhamityuktam ? ata
āha---adhikāreti | asatyatragrahaṇe anunāsikādhikārasya parimāṇaṃ na
jñāyeta---etāvatsu yogeṣvasya vyāpāra iti, tataśca
ruprakaraṇātparatrāpyasyādhikāraḥ sambhāvyetetyarthaḥ | tuśabdaḥ
parasmātkāryiṇaḥ pūrvasya viśeṣadyotanārthaḥ---parasya nityaṃ rutvam,
pūrvasya tu vānunāsika iti |
vāvacanamanarthakam, jñāpakātsiddham, yadayamutaratra sūtre
yasyānunāsiko na vihitastasmādroḥ pūrvasmātparamanusvāraṃ
śāsti; tato jñāyate---vikalpenāyaṃ bhavatīti | na hi
nitye'sminvidhau sa roḥ pūrvaḥ sambhavati, yasyānunāsiko vihita
||
āto'ṭi nityam || 8|3|3 ||
keciditi | taitirīyāḥ | anusvāramadhīyata iti | śuddhā
dākārātparam | nityagrahaṇamanarthakam, arambhasāmarthyādeva nityo
vidhiḥ siddhaḥ ? astyārambhe prayojanam niyamo yathā syāt---āta
evāṭi, anyeṣāṃ tu neti | kaimarthyānniyamo bhavati vidheyaṃ
nāstīti kṛtvā, iha cāsti vidheyam, kim ? nityo'nunāsikaḥ ||
anunāsikāt paro'nusvāraḥ || 8|3|4 ||
anyaśabdo'trādhyāhartavya iti | asatyadhyāhāre paraśabdasya
śrutatvātadapekṣayevaṃ ṭhanunāsikāt' ityeṣā pañcamī
syāt---paraśabdasya digvṛttiḥ, anyārthavṛttirvā, pūrvavṛttirvā |
pūrvasminkalperoḥ pūrvasmādanunāsikādevaparo'nusvāro
vijñāyeta, na ca tasmātpara iṣyate |
itarasmiṃstvamanunāsikādanyo'nusvāro bhavatītyartho bhavati, tatra
cānarthakaṃ paragrahaṇam, na hyanusvāro'nunāsikāpekṣayā'nyatvaṃ
vyabhicarati | tasmādanyaśabdo'dhyāhāryaḥ | sa ca paraśabdāpekṣayā
pañcamyanto'dhyāhāryaḥ | pūrvasyetyetadapyatrānuvṛtaṃ para ityanena
yogātpañcamyantaṃ vipariṇamyate | evaṃ sthite yo'rthaḥ sampadyate taṃ
darśayati--anunāsikādanya iti | kaḥ punarasau ?
ityāha---yasyānunāsiko na kṛta iti | anusvāra āgamo bhavatīti |
ṭitvādyāgamaliṅgābhāve'pi paraśabhdenānusvārasya
deśaviśeṣasampādanādāgamatvam, yathā---ṭhna yvābhyāṃ pūrvāvaic'
iti ||
samaḥ suṭi || 8|3|5 ||
ṭhmo'nusvāraḥ' ityanusvāre prāpte vacanam | saṃskarteti |
ṭhsamparyuyebhyaḥ karotau bhūṣaṇe' iti suṭ, samo makārasya
rutvam, tasya visarjanīyaḥ, tasya ṭhvā śari' iti vikalpe yathā nityaṃ
sakāro bhavati tathā darśitam |
kathaṃ punarasminsūtre sakāro nirdiśyate ? ityāha---samaḥ ssuṭīti
dvisakārako nirdeśa iti | sa ca suṭaḥ sakāre
sandehābhāvātadvyatirekeṇa dvisakārakatvam | vastutastu trayaḥ
sakārāḥ---eko vibhaktisambandhī, dvitīya ādeśaḥ, tṛtīyastu
rusambandhī | yadi tarhi sakāre ādeśo vidhīyate, anunāsiko na
prāpnoti; yasmādatragrahaṇaṃ ruṇā saha sanniyogapratipatyarthamityuktam
? naiṣa doṣaḥ; atra ruprakaraṇe yadvidhīyate tadupalakṣaṇārthaṃ tatra
rugrahaṇam | etena pūrvasūtre roḥ pūrva iti vyākhyātam | tadatra
satve kṛte yadā pūrvasyānunāsikaḥ, tadā
satvasyāsiddhatvādrutvābhāvāt ṭhanaci ca' iti dvirvacane ṭhjharo jhari'
iti pākṣike lope dvisakārakaḥ, trisakārako vā prayogaḥ | yadā
tvanusvāraḥ, tadā'yogavāhānāṃ aṭpratyāhāra upadeśacodanātasya
ca haltvāt ṭhjharo jhari' iti vā lope dvisakārakaḥ, ekasakārako
vā prayogaḥ | yadā tvanusvārasya haltvavadactvamapīṣyate, tadā
tataḥ parasya dvirvacanapakṣe sakāratrayamapi bhavati | tadevaṃ pañca
rūpāṇi bhavanti---anunāsikapakṣe dvau sakārau, trayo vā,
anusvārapakṣe dvāvekastrayo vā | pañcasvapi pakṣeṣu ṭhśaraḥ khayaḥ' iti
vā kakārasya dvirvacane kṛte daśa rūpāṇi bhavanti | samo vā
lopameke | eke ācāryāḥ samo vikalpena lopamicchanti,
atrāpyanunāsikānusvārau bhavataḥ | tasyāpi ruprakaraṇe
vidhānātatrānunāsikapakṣe sakārasya ṭhanacica' iti dvirvacane pākṣike
ca lope ekasakārakatvamapi kadācidbhavati | tatrāpi kakārasya pakṣe
dvirvacanamiti dvādaśa rūpāṇi bhavanti ||
pumaḥ khayyampare || 8|3|6 ||
puṃsaḥ sakārādavaśiṣṭo yo bhāgastasyāyaṃ nirdeśaḥ, sakārasya
saṃyogāntalope kṛte tasyaiva kāyitvāt | amiti pratyāhārasya
grahaṇam, na dvitīyaikavacanasya; khayā pratyāhāreṇa sāhacaryāt |
puṃścalīti | pacādau calaḍiti pāṭhānṅīp, puṃścalīti
ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ | puṃskāmeti | pumāṃsaṃ kāmayata iti
ṭhśīlikāmibhikṣācaribhyo ṇaḥ' iti ṇaḥ | tasmādatra sakāra evādeśo
vaktavya iti | ṭhkupvoḥ ḥkaḥpau ca' ityatraitadvaktavyam |
dvisakārakanirdeśapakṣe tviti | yadā pūrvasūtre ṭhdvisakārako
nirdeśaḥ' iti pakṣaḥ, tadetyarthaḥ | sa ityanuvartate iti |
nanu ca rurapi prakṛtaḥ, so'pi prāpnītītyata āha---rutvaṃ tviti |
asambandhe kāraṇamāha---sambandhānuvṛttistasyati | itikaraṇo hetau,
yasmādasau svasambandhinā yaḥ sambandhastamanuvartate taṃ na jahāti
tasmādityarthaḥ | yadvā---sambadhyata iti sambandhaḥ | yasmādiha
svasambaddhameva tadanuvartate tasmādityarthaḥ | rutvaṃ
khalvihānuvartamānamapi ṭhmatuvaso ru sambuddhau' iti svena
sambandhinā sambaddhamevānuvartate, tasya prayojanam---sambandhyantareṇa
roḥ sambandho mā mūditi |
puṃdāsādayaḥ ṣaṣṭhīsamāsāḥ | puṃgava iti | ṭhgorataddhitaluki' iti
ṭacsamāsāntaḥ | paragrahaṇe kriyamāṇe khayi parato yo'm tatretyapi
vijñāyeta, tataśca pumakṣaḥ pumācāraḥ---ityatraiva syāt;
tasmātparagrahaṇam ||
naścchavyapraśān || 8|3|7 ||
praśānvarjitasyeti | sūtre tu ṭhapraśān' iti ṣaṣṭha|lrthe prathamā |
ṭīkatirgatyartho'nudātet | tsaruḥ u khaṅgagrahaṇapradeśaḥ, tatra kuśalaḥ
tsarukaḥ, ākarṣādibhyaḥ kan ||
dīrghādaṭi samānapāde || 8|3|9 ||
ekaparyāyaḥ samānaśabdaḥ usamānapāda ityucyate, tatredaṃ na
sidhyati---yajāmahe yajñiyānhanta devān ilāmahayiti ?
chāndasatvād bhaviṣyati | 
nṛnpe || 8|3|10 ||
nṛniti ṣaṣṭha|lrthe prathamā | evamutaratrāpi ṭhpe' ityakāra uccāraṇārthaḥ,
pakāramātraṃ nimitam ||
svatavānpāyau || 8|3|11 ||
ṭhtu vṛddhau' sautro dhātuḥ, tato'sun---svaṃ tavo yasyā'sau
svatavān, ṭhdṛksvavaḥ svatasāṃ cchandasi' iti num ||
kānāmreḍite || 8|3|12 ||
ṭhkānkān' iti vaktavye āmreḍitagrahaṇaṃ yatra dvirvacanaṃ tatraiva yathā
syāt, iha mā bhūt---kānkān paśyatīti, eko'tra kiṃ śabdaḥ praśne,
dvitīyaḥ kṣepe |
samaḥ suṭītyato vā sakāro'nuvartata iti | yadyevam, pūrveṣvapi
yogeṣu sa eva prāpnoti ? ityata āha---pūrveṣu yogeṣviti |
ḍho ḍhea lopaḥ || 8|3|13 ||
ākāra uccāraṇārthaḥ, ḍhakāramātraṃ nimitam; tena leḍhā,
leḍhaiityādāvapi bhavati | līḍhamityādau ṭhho ḍhaḥ',
ṭhjhaṣastathordho'dhaḥ', ṭhjhaṣastathordho'dhaṛ', ṣṭuatvam, tato'nena
ḍhalopaḥ | nanu cāsiddhaṃ ṣṭuatvaṃ tatkathamatra lopaḥ ?
tatrāha---ṣṭuatvasyeti | ucyate cedam---ḍhea parato ḍhasya lopo
bhavatīti, tatra ṣṭuatvasyāsiddhatve nirviṣayametatsyāt |
nanu ca yatrautpatiko ḍhakāraḥ---śvaliḍḍhaukata ityādau, tatra
sāvakāśaḥ syādata āha---śvaliḍḍhaukata ityatreti | jaśtve kṛta iti
| ekapadāśrayatvādantaraṅgatvāt ṭhpūrvatrāsiddham' iti
lopasyāsiddhatvādvā pūrvaṃ jaśtvam | nanu ca nirviṣayatvād
ḍhalopo jaśtvaṃ bādheta ? netyāha---na ceti | kutaḥ ?
ityāha---tasya hīti |
kathaṃ punarlīḍhādiravakāśaḥ, yāvatā yathā śvaliḍḍhaukate ityatra
jaśtve kṛte kāryiṇo'bhāvaḥ, tathā līḍhādāvapi
ṣṭuatvasyāsiddhatvānnimitasyābhāvaḥ; atha tatra vacanasāmarthyāt
ṣṭuatvasyāsiddhatvaṃ bādhyate, tadetaratrāpi jaśtvaṃ bādhanīyam,
vaktavyo vā viśeṣaḥ ? ata āha---tatra hīti | ayamabhiprāyaḥ---lopena
tāvadasiddhatvamavaśyaṃ bādhyam, tatra līḍhamityādāvekameva
ṭhpūrvatrāsiddham' ityasiddhatvam, atastadeva bādhyate; śvaliḍḍhaukata
ityatra tu ḍhalopasya jaśtvāpekṣayā bahiraṅgatvāt paratvācca
dvividhamasiddhatvamiti na tadvādhyate | tato jaśtve kṛte na
śrutikṛtamānantaryam, nāpi śāstrakṛtam;
jaśtvasyāsiddhatvābhāvāditi ḍhalopasyāyamaviṣaya iti ||
ro ri || 8|3|14 ||
kimidaṃ sānubandhakasya rorgrahaṇam ? āhosvidrephasya ? kutaḥ
saṃśayaḥ ? tulyātra saṃhitā---roḥ ri, raḥ rīti | kiṃ cātaḥ ? yadi
sānubandhakasya grahaṇam, siddhamindūrathaḥ agnīrathaḥ; idaṃ tu na
sidhyati---nīraktam, dūraktamiti | atha rephasya grahaṇam, siddhaṃ nīraktaṃ
dūraktamiti; idaṃ tu na sidhyatiagnīrathaḥ, indūratha iti,
ṭhniranubandhakagrahaṇe na sānubandhakasya' iti ? naiṣa doṣaḥ,
varṇagrahaṇeṣu naiṣā paribhāṣā pravartate |
padasyetyatra viśeṣaṇe ṣaṣṭhīti | etacca ṭhpadasya' ṭhpadāt' ityatraiva
vyākhyātam | tena kiṃ siddhaṃ bhavati ? ityāha---teneti | sthānaṣaṣṭha|laṃ
tu repheṇa padasya viśeṣaṇādrephāntasya padasya lopena bhavitavyam |
ajarghā iti | ṭhekāco baśo bhaṣ' ityatraitad vyutpāditam |
apāspā iti | ṭhsparddha saṅgharṣe', yaṅluki ṭhdīrgho'kitaḥ' iti
dīrghaḥ, laṅ isipi śapo luk, sipo halṅyādilopaḥ;
jaśtvam, ṭhdaśca' iti rutvam ||
kharavasānayorvisarjanīyaḥ || 8|3|15 ||
yadyatrāpi padasyeti viśeṣaṇaṣaṣṭhī syāt, tadā cakarṣa, karkaśa
ityādāvapadāntasyāpi rephasya visarjanīyaḥ syāt | sthānaṣaṣṭha|laṃ tu
repheṇa pade viśeṣite rephāntasya padasyālontyasya
visarjanīyavidhānānna kaściddoṣa iti manyamāna āha---rephāntasya
padasyeti | khari parato'vasāne ceti | ṭhparataḥ' ityetatkharaiva
sambadhyate, nāvasānena; asambhavāt | yena varṇena viramyate sa
evāvasānaṃ syāt | viratiḥuvarṇasyānuccāraṇam | tatra padāntasya
rephasya yena varṇana viramyate sa tāvatparo na sambhavati |
itaratpunaravasānamabhāvarūpam, na cābhāvena paurvāparyaṃ sambhavati |
tasmāt ṭhkharavasānayoḥ' ityekāpi saptamī viṣayabhedāddhidyatekhari
parasaptamī, avasāne viṣayasaptamīti |
apara āha---varṇeṣvapyuccaritapradhvaṃsiṣu buddhiviracitaṃ
paurvāparyamasti, tatvabhāvenāpi sambhavati; tasmādubhayatrāpi
parasaptamīti | udāharaṇeṣu khari visarjanīyasya satvam, cavarge
ścutvam, ṭavarge ṣṭuatvam |
nārpatya iti | patyutarapadāṇṇyaḥ | vṛddherbahiraṅgalakṣaṇatvāditi |
bahirbhūtataddhitāpekṣatvād vṛddherbahiraṅgatvam | tadāśrayasya
rephasyeti | tadāśrayatvaṃ tu tayā saha vidhānāt | ṭhuraṇ raparaḥ'
ityetaddhi guṇavṛddhividhibhirekatāmāpādya raparatvaṃ vidhate, tena
vṛddheryannimitaṃ tadeva rephasyāpi, tatastasyāpi bahiraṅgatvam |
visarjanīyastu kharmātramāśritya bhavannantaraṅgaḥ | nanu
bahiraṅgaparibhāṣā ṭhvāha ūṭh' ityatra jñāpitatvātaddeśā, tataḥ
kim ? tasyāṃ kartavyāyāṃ visarjanīyaḥ ṭhpūrvatrāsiddham' ityasiddhaḥ,
sā kathamantaraṅgamapaśyantī bahiraṅgasyāsiddhatvamāpādayati ? naiṣa
doṣaḥ; ṭhkāryakālaṃ saṃjñāparibhāṣam', tataśca paribhāṣāntaravad
bahiraṅgaparibhāṣāyā apyatra prakaraṇe pravṛttiraviruddhā ||
roḥ supi || 8|3|16 ||
payaḥ sviti | yatra sakāradvayaṃ paṭha|lte tatra ṭhvā śira' iti
visarjanīyasya vā sakāraḥ | sarpiḥ ṣviti | yatra visarjanīyaḥ paṭha|lte
tatra ṭhnumvisarjanīyaśarvyavāye'pi' iti pratyayasakārasya ṣatvam |
ṣakāradvayapāṭhe tu pūrvavaddhisarjanīyasya satvam, parasya pūrvavadeva
ṣatvam, pūrvasya ṣṭuatvam | saptamībahuvacanaṃ gṛhyata iti | na
pratyāhāraḥ; ṭhkhari' ityanuvṛteḥ, na hi saptamībahuvacanādanyaḥ sup
kharādirasti | tena payobhyāmityādau vidhyarthaṃ na bhavati, kiṃ tarhi ?
niyamārtham, yadāhasiddhe satyārambho niyamārtha iti | roreva
supīti | viparītastu niyamo na bhavati---roḥ supyeveti;
ṭhhalo'nantarāḥ saṃyogaḥ' ityādinirdeśāt ||
bhobhagoaghoapūrvasya yo'śi || 8|3|17 ||
aśgrahaṇamanarthakamanyatrābhāvāt, aśo'nyaḥ kharbhavati, tatra ca
ṭhpūrvatrāsiddham' iti yatvasyāsiddhatvādvisarjanīyena bhāvyam, kṛte
visarjanīye sthānivadbhāvād rugrahaṇe grahaṇāt syātprasaṅga iti
cet ? na; alsthānikatvāt | atra hi roryo rephasya visarjanīyasya
sthānī, na punā rureva | kiñca---yatvasyāpyasya roryo rephaḥ sa eva
sthānī, na punā rureva | tasmādalvidhitvādapi nāsti
sthānivadbhāvaḥ | saṃhitādhikārāccāvasāne yatvaṃ na bhaviṣyati,
tasmādaśgrahaṇamanarthakam ? ityata āha---aśgrahaṇamutarārthamiti |
etadeva vyanakti---hali sarveṣāmiti | vṛkṣavayaterapratyaya iti | sa
punarvica, na kvip | kvipi hi ekadeśavikṛtasyānanyatvādvayati
grahaṇena grahaṇādvakārasya samprasāraṇaṃ syāt | ṭhlopo vyorvali' iti
valopaḥ | sthānivatvaṃ ca ṇeratra kvau luptatvānna vidyate | vici tu
ṇilopasya sthānivadbhāvādvalopo nāsti | samprasāraṇasya
tvaprasaṅga eva | ṭhhali sarveṣām' ityanena tu lope kartavye
ṭhpūrvatrāsiddhe na sthānivat' iti sthānivatvaniṣedhād valopaḥ
syāditi viśeṣyate | atha kakāre parataḥ ṭhlopo vyoḥ' iti
valopaḥ kasmānna bhavati, ṇilopasya sthānivadbhāvae nāsti,
padāntavidhau pratiṣedhāt, vakārasya padāntatvāt ? naiṣa doṣaḥ;
bhāvasādhanastvatra vidhiśabdaḥ, tataśca padānte vidhīyamāne
sthānivatvaniṣedhaḥ | na ca lopaḥ padāntaḥ; tasyābhāvarūpatvāt |
atheti | yadi ṭhhali sarveṣām' ityatrāśgrahaṇasya prayojanam, tatraivaṃ
vaktavyam---ṭhhaśi' iti, tatkiṃ halgrahaṇaṃ kṛtvā'śgrahaṇena
tadviśeṣyata iti praśnārthaḥ | evakāro bhinnakramaḥ, tatra haśgrahaṇameva
kasmānna kṛtamiti | utarārthamiti | yadi tatra haśgrahaṇaÄ kriyate,
ṭhmo'nusvāraḥ' ityatra punarhalgrahaṇaṃ kartavyam | halmātre yathā
syāditi | sarvathobhābhyāṃ grahaṇābhyāṃ na mucyāmahe iti bhāvaḥ |
tathāpyatrāśgrahaṇānurodhe prayojanaṃ vaktavyam ?
tadāha---vyorlaghuprayatnatara iti ||
vyorlaghuprayatnataraḥ śākaṭāyanasya || 8|3|18 ||
atiśayena laghuprayatnaḥulaghuprayatnataraḥ | varṇoccāraṇaheturātmadharmaḥ
u prayatnaḥ | udāharaṇeṣvāntaryato vakārasya vakāraḥ, yakārasya yakāraḥ
| kiṃ punaridaṃ laghuprayatnataratvam ? ityāha---laghuprayatnataratvamiti
| sthānamutālvādi, jihvāyā agropāgramadhyamūlāniukaraṇāni,
prayatnasya laghutve tāni śithilāniulaghūni bhavanti ||
lopaḥ śākalyasya || 8|3|19 ||
avarṇapūrvayoriti | okārapūrvasya tūtarasūtreṇa tūtarasūtreṇa
nityaṃ lopo vidhāsyate |
śākalyagrahaṇaṃ vikalpārthamiti | nanu lopo'pyucyate,
laghuprayatnataro'pi, tāvubhauvacanādbhaviṣyataḥ; tatkiṃ vikalpārthena
śākalyagrahaṇena ? ata āha---teneti ||
oto gārgyasya || 8|3|20 ||
ākārādutarasya yakārasyeti | vakārastvasminviṣaye na sambhavati |
nityārtho'yamārambha iti | vikalpasya pūrvaṇaiva siddhatvāt |
kimarthaṃ tahi gārgyagrahaṇam ? ityāha---gāgyagrahaṇaṃ pūjārthamiti |
vyoriha prakaraṇe laghuprayatnataro'pi vihitaḥ, lopo'pi,
tatkasyāyaṃ nityo lopo bādhakaḥ, ānantaryāllapivikalpasya ?
ityāha---yo'yamiti |
kecitviti | yadasminprakaraṇe vyoḥ kāryaṃ tatsamudāyo'pekṣyate,
na tvanantaro lopavikalpa iti teṣāmabhiprāyaḥ ||
uñi ca pade || 8|3|21 ||
bhūtapūrveṇa ñakāreṇeti | bhūlodāharaṇe'pi bhūtapūrveṇaiva
ñakāreṇoñiti pratipatiḥ; anubandhasya prayoge'samavāyāt |
utarārthamiti | ṭhṅmo hrasvādacchi ṅmuṇnityam' ityeṣa vidhirajādau
pade yathā syāt, ida mā bhūt---daṇḍineti | naitadasti prayojanam;
ṭhpadasya' iti vartate | iha tarhi paramadaṇḍinā, atra hi subantasya
samāsa iti padatvamasti ? nāsti; uktaṃ hi ṭhutarapadatve
cāpadādividhau' iti | tadetatpadagrahaṇaṃ tiṣṭhatu tāvat | ayamapi
nityārtho yogaḥ ||
hali sarveṣām || 8|3|22 ||
yakārasya padāntasyeti | vakārastu bhobhagoaghopūrvo na sambhavati |
avarṇapūrvastu sambhavati--vṛkṣav karotīti | tasya tu lopo na
bhavati, aśi halīti viśeṣaṇādityuktam | tasmādyakārasyetyuktam |
