nanu vṛkṣav hasatītyādau sambhavati ? na sambhavati; anabhidhānāt,
nahyaevaṃvidhamabhidhānamasti | tathā ca ṭhlaṇ' ityatra bhāṣyakāra āha---ṭhna
padāntā halo'ṇaḥ santi' iti | evaṃ ca vṛkṣav karotītyayamapi
prayogaścintyaḥ ||
mo|ñanusvāraḥ || 8|3|23 ||
atra padasyeti sthānaṣaṣṭhī, makāreṇa padasya viśeṣaṇānnakārāntasya
padasyālontyasyānusvāro vijñāyate | tadāha---makārasya
padāntasyati ||
naścāpadāntasya jhali || 8|3|24 ||
ākraṃsyata iti | kramerlṛṭ, ṭhāṅ udgamane' ityātmanepadam ||
mo rāji samaḥ kvau || 8|3|25 ||
samrāḍiti | ṭhsatsūdviṣa' ityādinā kvip, vraścādinā ṣatvam |
sāmrājyamiti | kvibantād brāhmaṇāaditvāt ṣyañ |
adhikasadbhāve'pi kvibanto rājatistāvadastītyatrāpi bhavati,
kvibantāvasthāyāmeva vā prāgeva ṣyaña utpatermatvam |
saṃyaditi | ṭhgamaḥ kvau' ityatra gamādīnāmiti vacanāllopaḥ, hrasvasya
tuk | kirāḍiti | ṭhkiṃ kṣepe' iti samāsaḥ ||
he mapare vā || 8|3|26 ||
hmalayatīti | ṭhhmala calane', ṇic, ṭhjvalahvalahmalanamāmanupasargādvā' iti
pakṣe mitsaṃjñā, ṭhmitāṃ hrasvaḥ' iti hrasvatvam |
yavalapara iti | yavalāḥ pare yasmādvakāratsa tathoktaḥ, yavalāścaite
bhavanta āntaratamyādanunāsikā bhavanti, vāvacanātpakṣe'nusvāro'pi
bhavati |
paragrahaṇaṃ śakyamakartum; saptamyaiva tadarthalābhāt---makāre
parato yo hakārastatreti | viparyayastu na bhavati; asambhavāt | na
hi makārātparo hakāraḥ kvacit sambhavati ||
ṅṇoḥ kukṭuak śari || 8|3|28 ||
udāharaṇeṣu ṭhkhayo dvitīyāḥ śari pauṣkarasādeḥ' iti pakṣe kakārasya
khakāraḥ, ṭakārasya ṭhakāraḥ |
pūrvāntakaraṇamityādi | kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃpadādau cchatvaṃ na
sidhyatītyata āha---śaśchāe'ṭīti | virapśinniti | mahannāmaitat,
vipūrvādraperauṇādikaḥ karmaṇi śinipratyayaḥ | yadi vā virapaṇaṃ
virap, so'syāstīti virapśaḥ u śabditaḥ, saṅkīrtata ityarthaḥ |
ṣatvapratiṣedhārthamiti | parādau tu sakāraḥ padādirna syāt |
ṣṭuatvapratiṣedhārthamiti | parādau tu ṭakāraḥ padānto na syāt ||
ṅḥ si dhuṭ || 8|3|29 ||
ṭhubhayanirdeśe pañcamīnirdeśo balīyān' iti ṭhḍaḥ' iti pañcamyā
sīti saptamyāḥ ṣaṣṭhī prakalpyata iti matvā''ha---ḍakārāntāditi |
saptamīnirdeśastu lāghavārthaḥ | udāharaṇeṣu dhuṭi kṛte
cartvam--takāraḥ, tasya pūrvavatpakṣe thakāraḥ |
atha kimarthaṃ dhuṭ parādiḥ kriyate---na dhugeva pūrvāntaḥ kriyeta, evaṃ
hi ṭhśituk' ityatra tuggrahaṇaṃ na kartavyaṃ bhavati, eṣa dhuk
tatrānuvartiṣyate ? ata āha---parādikaraṇamiti | prakriyālāghavārthaṃ
tuḍiti vaktavye dhuḍgrahaṇamutarārtham---ṭhnaśca' iti dhuḍa|lthāsyāt,
tuṇmā bhauut | kiñca syāt, bhavāntsāya ityatra ṭhnaścchavyapraśān' iti
rutvaṃ prasajyeta ? naitadasti; ampara iti tatrānuvartate |
kiñca---tuṭo'siddhatvādapi roraprasaṅgaḥ | tasmātuḍeva vaktavyaḥ ||
naśca || 8|3|30 ||
atrāpi parāditvāt kurvan sīdatītyādau ṭhpadāntasya' iti
ṇatvapratiṣedho bhavati |
dhuṭaścartvasyāsiddhatvāditi | dhuṭo yaccartvaṃ
tasyāsiddhatvādityarthaḥ | yadyapi dhuḍapyasiddhaḥ, tathāpi na taducyate;
siddhe'pi tasminvinā cartvena rutvasyāprāpteḥ | nanvastu
cartvamasiddham, tathāpi naiva ruḥ prāpnoti, anamparatvāt ? satyam;
yastvasau dhuṭa ukāraḥ, tena bhūtapūrveṇāmparatvamaṃbhyupetyaitaduktam
| anye tu granthamimaṃ na paṭhanti ||
śi tuk || 8|3|31 ||
ṭhśi' ityeṣā saptamyakṛtārthā pūrvasūtre kṛtārthāyāḥ pañcamyāḥ ṣaṣṭhaāā
prakalpayati, tadāha---nakārasyeti |
atha kimarthamapūrvaḥ pūrvāntastuk kriyate, na prakṛtaḥ parādirdhuḍeva
vidhīyeta, tatrāpi cartvena sidhyatyeva ? ata
āha---pūrvāntakaraṇamiti | pūrvāntasyāpūrvasyatukaḥ karaṇamityarthaḥ
| nakārasyāpadāntatvāditi | tukā padāntatāyā vihatatvāt |
parādau tu ṭhpadāntasya' iti pratiṣedhādadoṣaḥ | tatretyādi | tatra
tuko yaccutvaṃ tadāśrayātsiddhaṃ bhavati ||
ṅmo hrasvādaci ṅmuṇ nityam || 8|3|32 ||
ṅmaḥ, ṅmuṭ---ityubhayatrāpi pratyāhāragrahaṇam | uḍiti pratyekaṃ
ṅkārādibhiḥ sambadhyate | saṃjñāyāṃ hi kṛtamāgamaliṅgaṃ saṃjñināṃ
bhavati | hrasvādityetanṅmo viśeṣaṇam, so'pi ṅm padasya
viśeṣaṇam, viśeṣaṇena ca tadantavidhirbhavati | padasyeti prakṛtaṃ
yadyapi ṣaṣṭha|lntam, tathāpi ṭhhamaḥ' ityanena sambandhāt pañcamyantaṃ
vipariṇamyate | ṭhubhayanirdeśe pañcamīnirdeśo balīyān' iti ṭhṅmaḥ'
iti pañcamyā ṭhaci' iti saptamyāḥ ṣaṣṭhī prakalpyate | saptamīnirdeśastu
lāghavārthaḥ, utarārthaśca | tadetatsarvaṃ manasi kṛtvāha---hrasvātpara iti
| saṃkhyātānudeśaśca devatitavyaḥ; āgamānāmam, āgamināṃ ca
samatvāt |
paramadaṇḍinetyādau subantayoḥ samāsaḥ, tatra samāsārthāyāṃ vibhaktau
luptāyāmapi pratyayalakṣaṇena daṇḍinnityasya padatvamastīti ṅmuṭ
prāpnotītyāśaṅkyāha---iheti | samāse ya utaro bhāgastasya padatve
kartavye pratyayalakṣaṇaṃ na bhavati, apadādividhauupadādividhiṃ
varjayitvā | ṭhsātpadādyoḥ' ityatra padādividhau pratyayalakṣaṇaṃ
bhavatyevetyarthaḥ | etadvārtikakāramatenoktam |
sūtrakāramatenāpyāha---atha veti || 
maya uño vo vā || 8|3|33 ||
ṭhiko yaṇaci' ityanenaiva siddhatvānnārtho'nena
?---ityāśaṅkyāha---pragṛhyatvāditi | pragṛhyatvaṃ ca ṭhnipāta
ekājanāṅ' iti | evamapi ṭhiko yaṇaci' ityasyānantaram ṭhmaya uño
vā' iti vaktavyam, evaṃ hi vagrahaṇa na kartavyaṃ bhavati ?
tatrāha---tasyāsiddhatvāditi | yadā tvitipara uñ bhavati mayaśca
paraḥ, tadā ṭhuñaḥ' iti prakagṛhyasaṃjñāyā vikalpaḥ, Äṣādeśaśca; tatra yadā
pragṛhyasaṃjñā na bhavati tadānena vatvaṃ ca prāpnoti yaṇādeśaśca,
tatrāsya vatvasyāsiddhatvādyaṇādeśe satyanusvāro'pi bhavati---kiṃviti
| pragṛhyasaṃjñāapakṣe tvanena vā vatvam---kivviti, kimu iti |
Äṣādeśasyāpi sthānivadbhāvādanena pakṣe vakāro bhavati, sa
cāntaratamatvādanunāsikaḥ, taccaturthaṃ rūpam | Äṣādeśasyaiva
vatvābhāvapakṣe śravaṇam, tatpañcamaṃ rūpam ||
visarjanīyasya saḥ || 8|3|34 ||
iha kharavasānayordvayorapi rephasya visarjanīya uktaḥ, tatreha
nimitaviśeṣānupādānātkhari vāvasāne'pi satvaṃ prāpnoti--vṛkṣaḥ,
plakṣa iti ? sahitāyāmiti vartate, na cāvasāne saṃhitāsti;
parasyābhāvāt | mā bhūtparaḥ, pūrveṇa yā saṃhitā tadāśrayaṃ satvaṃ
prāpnoti, ṭhiko yaṇaci' ityādau tu
kāryinimitayordvayorapyupātatvātayoreva parasparaṃ saṃhitāśrīyata
iti dadhiātreti pūrvaparābhyāmigacoḥ saṃhitāyāṃ satyāmapi kāryaṃ
na bhavati; parasparamasaṃhitatvāt | syādetat | sāmānyavihitā
saṃhitāsaṃjñā, viśeṣavihitāvasānasaṃjñā;
kāryayorekavarṇaviṣayatvātkāryārthatvācca saṃjñānāṃ
saṃjñayorapyekaviṣayatvādvādhyabhādakabhāvaḥ | yadvā---ṭhsannikarṣaḥ
saṃhitā' itīyatā siddhe paragrahaṇamatiśayapratipatyartham---prakṛṣṭo
yaḥ sannikarṣaḥ | kaśca prakṛṣṭaḥ ? yaḥ pūrvaparābhyāmubhābhyāmapi |
tadabhāvādavasānasya saṃhitāsaṃjñāyā abhāvaḥ | yadyevam,
aṇo|ñapragṛhasyānunāsike doṣaḥ, tatra hi ṭhvāvasāne' iti vartate;
saṃhitādhikāraścotarārtho'vaśyamanuvartyaḥ---ṭhtoli' iti
parasavarṇo'saṃhitāyāṃ mā bhūt---agnicit lunātīti, tataśca
saṃhitāvasānobhayāśrayo'nunāsiko dadhi ityādau na syāditi
saṃhitaavasānasaṃjñayoḥ samāveśa eṣitavyaḥ, tataścāvasāne'pi
satvaprasaṅgaḥ ? ata āha---kharītyanuvartata iti | tadanuvṛttiśca
maṇḍūakaplutinyāyena, sambandhānuvṛtyā vā veditavyā; anyathā hi
pūrvatrāpi khari kārya vijñāyeta |
kiṃ punaratra pramāṇaṃ kharītyanuvartate iti ? utaratra śarpara iti
vacanam, sa hi bahuvrīhiḥ, tasyānyapadārthāpekṣāyā yo
visarjanīyātparaḥ sambhavati sa evānyapadārthaḥ, sa ca kharevaḥ,
avasānasya śarparatvāsambhavāt | yadvā---yadi kharavasānayordvayorapi
satvaṃ syāt visarjanīyavidhānamanarthakaṃ syāt; ṭhkharavasānayossaḥ'
ityeva vācyaṃ syāt | evaṃ hi ṭhvisarjanīyasya' iti na vaktavyaṃ bhavati
| avaśyam ṭhśarpare visarjanīyaḥ' ityasya sthāninirdeśārthaṃ
visarjanīyasyeti vaktavyam ? na vaktavyam;
purastādapakarṣeṇāpyetatsiddham, evaṃ vakṣyāmi---ṭhro ri
kharavasānayoḥ saḥ, roḥ supi śarpare visarjanīyaḥ' iti, śarpara
ityatra ṭhra' iti vartate, na tu ṭhroḥ' iti, tena sugīḥ tsarukaḥ,
puruṣaḥ tsarukaḥ ityādau sarvatra bhavati | atha ṭhbhobhaghoagho'
ityādisūtraṃ kutra kariṣyasi ? ṭhśarpare visarjanīyaḥ' ityasyānantaram
| yadyevam, svaratra, svarnayatītyādāvapi yatvaprasaṅga iti punā
rugrahaṇaṃ kartavyam ? evaṃ tarhi ṭhroḥ supi' ityasyānantaram
ṭhbhobhago' ityādi rusthānikādeśavidhānārthaṃ paṭhitvā ṭhśarpare
visarjanīyaḥ' ityādikaṃ paṭhiṣyate | evamapi punāragrahaṇaṃ kartavyam;
ruṇā vicchinnatvāt ? evamapi yathānyāse sati trīṇi grahaṇāni---dve
visarjanīyagrahaṇe, tṛtīyaṃ sagrahaṇam; anyathānyāse tu dve sagrahaṇe
rugrahaṇaṃ ca | tadevaṃ laghīyasā nyāsena siddhe
visarjanīyavidhānasāmarthyānna sarvatra satvaṃ bhaviṣyati |
evamapi kuta etat---khari bhavati, na punaravakhāna iti ? jñāpakāt,
yadayaṃ śarpare khari visarjanīyaṃ vidhate, tajjñāpavati---khari
tāvadasti satvamiti | viparyaye hi puraṣaḥ tsaruka ityādau
satvābhāvādastyeva visarjanīya iti tadvidhānamanarthakaṃ syāt |
naitadasti jñāpakam; astyetasya vavane prayojanam, kim ? vāsaḥ
kṣaumam, adbhiḥ psātamityādau jihvāmūlayopadhmānīvau mā
bhūtāmiti ? naitadasti; yadyetāvatprayojanaṃ syāt ṭhkutvoḥ
ḥkaḥpau vā śari' ityeva brūyāt | tadevaṃ
vidhānasāmarthyātkharyevāyaṃ vidhiḥ | anena caivābhiprāyeṇa
ṭhkharītyanuvartate' ityuktam ||
śapare visarjanīyaḥ || 8|3|35 ||
śarparo yasmāditi bahuvrīhiḥ, paragrahaṇe'kriyamāṇe śaraeva kevalasya
nimitatā vijñāyeta, na kharītyanuvṛteḥ, ṭhvā śari' ityabhidhānācca |
viparyayastarhi vijñāyeta---kharpare śarīti, nityaḥ sphoṭaḥ, puruṣaḥ
sthāteti | tasmātparagrahaṇam |
atha kimarthaṇ, ṭhvisarjanīyaḥ' ityucyate, na ṭhna' ityevocyeta, satve
hi pratiṣiddhe visarjanīyaḥ svenaiva rūpeṇāvasthāsyate ? atha
āha---visarjanīyasyeti | satyam; puruṣaḥ tsaruka ityādau
satvaniṣedhenāpi siddham, yatra tu kupū śarparau---vāsaḥ kṣaumam,
addhiḥ psātamiti, tasya visarjanīyasya yo vikāro jihvāmūlīyādiḥ
sa eva syāt | visarjanīyagrahaṇe tu sati visarjanīya eva bhavati |
jihvāmūlīyopadhmānīyāvapi na bhavata iti | kevalaṃ sakāra evetyapi
śabdārthaḥ ||
vā śari || 8|3|36 ||
vṛkṣā sthātāra iti | lopābhāvapakṣe visarjanīyaḥ, satvaṃ vā ||
kupvoḥ ḥkaḥpau ca || 8|3|37 ||
visarjanīyaśceti | anena cakāro visarjanīyānukarṣaṇārtha iti
darśayati | atha vāgrahaṇamevānuvartya jihvāmūlīyopadhmānīyau
kasmānna vilpyete, evaṃ hi cakāro na kartavyo bhavati ? naivaṃ
śakyam; evaṃ hyābhyāmukte ṭhvisarjanīyasya saḥ' iti satvameva syāt |
tasmāccakāreṇaivānukṛṣya visarjanīyo vidhātavyaḥ, vāgrahaṇaṃ ca
nānuvartyam | tadanuvṛtau hi tribhirapi mukhye pakṣe satvaṃ
prasajyeta |
sūtre
kakārapakārasahitayorjihvāmūlīyopadhmānīyayoruccāraṇātathābhūtāveva visarjanīyasyādeśāviti śaṅkamānaṃ pratyāha---kapāvuccāraṇārthāviti | tābhyāṃ vinā tayoruccārayitumaśakyatvāditi bhāvaḥ | kīdṛśau tarhyādeśau ? ityāha---jihvāmūlīyeti | iha visarjanīyasya sthāne ādeśatrayaṃ vidhīyate, tataśca śarparayoreva kupvoḥ prāpnoti---vāsaḥ kṣaumam, adbhiḥ psātamiti, atra hi ṭhśarpare visarjanīyaḥ' iti visarjanīyo'sti, na ca tasya vaiyarthyam; yatra kupubhyāmanyaḥ śarparaḥ kharastipuruṣaḥ tsaruka ityādau, tatra sāvakāśatvāt | aśarparayostu kupvorna syāt, na hi tasya visarjanīyo'sti, ṭhvisarjanīyasya saḥ' iti satvena nirvartitatvāt | kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ satvameva tāvadbhavati ? tatra kartavye tasya vidherasiddhatvāt | tasmādatra sakāraḥ sthānī nirdeaṣṭavyaḥ---yaḥ ṭhvisarjanīyasya saḥ' iti saḥ, tasya sthāne kupvorādeśatrayaṃ bhavatīti |
evaṃ hi śarparayoḥ kupvoḥ sakārāpavādo visarjanīyo vidhīyeta
iti sakārābhāvādādeśāprasaṅgaḥ, kevalayostvādeśaprasaṅgaḥ,
tasmātsasyeti vaktavyam, yadāha vārtikakāraḥ---ṭhsakārasya
kupvorvisarjanīya---jihvāmūlīyopadhmānīyāḥ, visarjanīyādeśe
hi śarparayorevādeśaprasaṅgaḥ' iti ? atra
parihārāmāha---visarjanīyasya sa ityetasminniti |
ayamabhiprāyaḥ---ṭhvisarjanīyasya saḥ' iti sakārasya sthānī visarjanīya
upātaḥ, sa ca dvividhaḥ sambhavati---śarparalakṣaṇaḥ, kharavasānalakṣaṇaśca |
tatra śarparalakṣaṇasyāsiddhatvāditaraḥ sakārasya sthānī, sa eva
cehānuvartate; tataśca nāprāpte satve idamārabhyate; sarvasya
viṣayasya tena vyāptatvāt | ṭhśarpare visarjanīyaḥ' ityetatu
śarparayoḥ kupvoḥ prāptam, kevalayostvaprāptamiti na taṃ pratyasya
bādhakalakṣaṇayoga iti | syādetat, mā bhūdapavādatvam, paratvātu
śarparayorapi kupvorayameva vidhiḥ prāpnoti ?
tatrāha---pūrvratrāsiddhe iti |
parihārāntaramāha---kecitviti | ṭhkupvoḥ' ityeko yogaḥ, atra
ṭhśarpare visarjanīyaḥ' iti vartate, śarparayoḥ kupvoḥ visarjanīya
eva bhavati, na ḥkaḥpāviti | kiñca---pūrvaṃsūtre ṭhneti vaktavye
visarjanīyavidhānaṃ tadvikāranivṛtyartham' ityuktam | tena
śaparayoḥ kupvorasya vidheraprasaṅga eva ||
so'pavādādau || 8|3|38 ||
ṭhapadādau' iti kupvoretadviśeṣaṇam, vyatyayena tvekavacanam |
pūrvasyāyamapavādaḥ | pāśakalpakakāmyeṣviti | sambhavapradarśanametat,
na parigaṇanam; anyasyāsambhavāt | prātaḥ kalpamiti |
adhikaraṇaśaktipradhānasyāpi prātaḥ---śabdasya vṛttiviṣaye
śaktimadvācitvādīṣadasamāptyā yogaḥ, yathā---doṣābhūtamahaḥ,
divābhūtā rātrirityatrābhūtatadbhāvayogaḥ |
roḥ kāmye niyamārthamiti | etadeva vivṛṇoti---roreveti | gīḥ
kāmyatīti | utarasūtreṇa ṣatvaṃ na bhavati | yadi
punastatraivedamucyate ? naivaṃ śakyam ; ṣatvamātrapratiṣedhe'pyanena
satvaṃ prāpnoti | upaghmānīyasya ceti | asyaiva
vivaraṇam---kavargeparata iti | ubjirayamityādi | yathā punarayaṃ
dakāropadha eṣitavyaḥ, tathā ṭhhayaraṭ' ityatroktam ||
iṇaḥ ṣaḥ || 8|3|39 ||
pūrveṇa satve prāpte tadapavādaḥ ṣatvaṃ vidhīyate | atra
kecidāhuḥ---ṭhṭhyo'yam ṭhso'padādau' iti sakāraḥ, sa evotaratra
sarvatra kupvoḥ prakaraṇe vidhīyate, anena tu tasyaiva sakārasyeṇa
utarasya ṣatvaṃ vidhīyate, na visarjanīyasya, ṭhapadādau' iti cātra na
sambadhyate" iti | sa tarhi sakāraḥ sthānī nirdeaṣṭavyaḥ ? netyāha;
prakṛto'nuvartate---ṭhso'padādau' iti, tasya ṭhiṇaḥ' iti pañcamyā
ṣaṣṭhī prakalpyate |
evamapi vakṣyamāṇairyogairvihitasya sakārasya ṣatvaṃ na prāpanoti,
asminkartavye teṣāmasidvātvāt ? naiṣa doṣaḥ;
acāryapravṛttirjñāpayati---na yoge yogo'siddhaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? prakaraṇe
prakaraṇamasiddhamiti; yadayam ṭhupasargādasamāse'pi' ityatra
ṭhasamāse'pi' grahaṇaṃ karoti | kathaṃ kṛtvā jñāpakam ?
antareṇāpyasamāsepigrahaṇaṃ
viśeṣānupādānātsamāsāsamāsayorṇatvaṃ bhaviṣyati, na ca samāse
ṭhpūrvapadātsaṃjñāyāmagaḥ' iti niyamāṇṇatvasya nivṛttiḥ, niyame
kartavye ṭhupasargāt' ityasya ṇatvasyāsiddhatvāt | paśyati
tvācāryaḥ---prakaraṇe prakaraṇamasiddhamiti, tataḥ ṭhasamāsepi' grahaṇaṃ
karoti, tadā hi saha niyamena sarvameva ṇatvaprakaraṇamekamiti
niyame kartavye upasargāditi ṇatvasya siddhatvānniyamena vyāvṛttiḥ
syāditi kartavyaṃ samāse'pigrahaṇam | tadevaṃ sakārasya ṣatvaṃ
vidhīyate, na visarjanīyasya; utaratra ca satvamevānuvartate, na
ṣatvamiti |
ayamapi pakṣo nirdoṣa eva, kintu ṣaṣṭhīprakalpanaṃ jñāpakāśrayaṇaṃ ceti
pratipatigauravaprasaṅgād vṛttikāreṇa nāśritaḥ | kastarhi tasya pakṣaḥ
? utaratra dvayamapyanuvartate---sakāraḥ, ṣakāraśceti | yadyevam, sarvatra
dvayamapi prāpnoti---atha sakāro vānuvartate ṭhidudupadhasya ca'
ityādau yatreṇaḥ paro visarjanīyastatrāpi sakāra eva prāpnoti; atha
ṣakāra evānuvartate ṭhnamaspurasorgatyoḥ' ityādau yatrāniṇaḥ paro
nisarjanīyastatrāpi ṣakāra eva prāpnoti ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; ṭhiṇaḥ ṣaḥ' iti
samudāyasya svaritatvaṃ pratijñāyate | yadāha---iṇaḥ ṣa iti vartata iti
| tataḥ ṣatvaṃ tāvadaniṇviṣaye na bhaviṣyati | evamapi ṣatvaviṣaye
satvamapi prāpnoti ? na; ṣakāreṇa tasya bādhanāt, cakārākaraṇācca |
yadi paramanuvṛttisāmarthyātatprasaṅgaḥ ? tadapi na;
utarārthamapyanuvṛttisambhavāt | tadidamuktam---ya iṇaḥ pare
visarjanīyastasya ṣakāra ādeśo bhavatyanyasya tu sakāra iti | kimarthaṃ
punaridamārabhyate, yāvatā satvamevātra prakaraṇe vidhīyatām, tasya
tvādeśasakāratvāt ṭhiṇkoḥ' iti ṣatvaṃ bhaviṣyati ? sidhyati;
ṭhapadāntasya' iti tatra vartate, padāntārtho'yamārabhaḥ ||
nasaspurasorgatyoḥ || 8|3|40 ||
ataḥ prabhṛti ṭhapadādau' iti nivṛtam | namaḥ śabdasya tu
ṭhpuro'vyayam' iti |
puraḥ paśyeti | ṭhpṛ pālanapūraṇayoḥ', ṭhbhrājabhāsa' ityādinā
kvip, tadantācchas | asya tadantatāṃ darśayitum--pūḥ
purāvityanayorupanyāsaḥ ||
idudupadhasya cāpratyayasya || 8|3|41 ||
idutāvupadhe yasya sa idudupadhaḥ samudāyaḥ, tasya yo visarjanīya
iti vaiyadhikaraṇyena sambandhaḥ | apratyayasyetyetadapi vyadhikaraṇameva |
nirdurbahirāviścatuṣprāduriti | anyeṣāṃ sambhavatāṃ pratiṣedhasya
vakṣyamāṇatvānnedaṃ parigaṇanam, kiṃ tarhi ? sambhavapradarśanam |
catuṣkapālamiti | taddhitārthe dviguḥ, ṭhsaṃskṛtaṃ bhakṣāḥ' ityaṇaḥ
ṭhdvigorluganapatye' iti luk | catuṣkaṇṭakamiti | bahuvrīhiḥ |
mātuḥ karotītyādi | codyam---atra hi mātṛās iti sthite ṭhṛta
ut' ityukāro bhavan ṭhyo hyubhayoḥ sthāne' iti nyāyena raparo
bhavati, tataśca ṭhrātsasya' iti pratyayasakārasya lope kṛte rephasya
visarjanīyo bhavati | pariharati---karakādiṣviti |
ekādeśanimitāditi | karmadhārayaḥ, ekādeśarūpanimitādityarthaḥ,
ekādeśaśāstraṃ vā nimitaṃ yasyokārasya tasmādityarthaḥ |
pummuhusoriti | avyutpannāvetāviti pratiṣedha ucyate | tatra
puṃsaḥ pratiṣedhena nārthaḥ | ṣatvaṃ kasmānna bhavati ?
visarjanīyābhāvāt, uktaṃ hi ṭhsampuṃkānāṃ satvam' iti, tatra
satvasyāsiddhatvābhāvādvisarjanīyābhāvaḥ | taccāvaśyaṃ satvaṃ vaktavyam,
ruvidhau visarjanīyasya ṣatyapatiṣedhe'pi ṭhkupvoḥ ḥkaḥpau ca'
ityeva vidhiḥ prāpnoti---muhuḥ kāmo yasyāḥ sā muhuḥ kāmā, tatra
ṭhkupvoḥ ḥkaḥpau ca ityeṣa eva vidhirbhavati | kvacitu
muhuskāmeti satvaṃ paṭha|lte so'papāṭhaḥ, na hyatra satvasambhavaḥ;
sūtravārtikayoranibaddhatvāt | naiṣkulyamiti | brāhmaṇāaditvāt
ṣyañ | ni3ṣkulaṃ du3ṣkulamiti | ṭhguroranṛtaḥ' ityādinā plutaḥ
| bahiraṅgalakṣaṇayoriti |
bahirbhūtataddhitāpekṣatvādvadvirbahiraṅgā, pluto'pi
dūrāddhūtādikamarthaṃ vākyaṃ cāpekṣata iti bahiraṅgaḥ ||
tiraso'nyatarasyām || 8|3|42 ||
ṭhtiro'ntardhau' iti tiraḥ śabdasya gatisaṃjñā |
tiraḥ kṛtveti | atrāntardheravivakṣitatvādagatitvam ||
dvistriścaturiti kṛtvo'rthe || 8|3|43 ||
ubhayatravibhāṣeyam, ṭhcatur' ityasyāpratyayavisarjanīyatvād
ṭhidudupadhasya ca' iti prāpte, itarayoraprāpte | ṭhisusoḥ sāmarthye'
ityanena tvatra siddhirna śaṅkanīyā; isaḥ pratyayasya tatra grahaṇāt |
kṛtvortha iti kimiti | sujantāḥ kṛtvo'rthaṃ na vyabhicarantīti
praśnaḥ | catuḥ---śabdasya sujantatve pramāṇaṃ nāstītyutaram | yadi tu
sāhacaryaṃ vyasthāpakam, tadā tadarthamapi kṛtvo'rthagrahaṇaṃ na
kartavyam, kriyate ca ? tajjñāpakārtham, etajjñāpayati---na sarvatra
sāhacaryaṃ vyavasthāpakamiti | kiṃ siddhaṃ bhavati ? ṭhdīdhīvevīṭām'
ityatra dhātusāhacaryeṇāpyāgamasyeṭo grahaṇaṃ bhavati |
dvistriścaturiti kim ? pañcakṛtvaḥ karotītyatra satvaṃ mā bhūt |
naitadasti prayojanamityāha--idudupadhasyetyasyānuvṛtau
satyāmityādi | kṛtvo'rtho viṣayo yasyatatathoktam | kṛtvorthe
yatpadaṃ vartate tasya yo visarjanīyaḥ---ityevaṃ viśeṣyamāṇaṃ ityarthaḥ
| yadi tu kṛtvo'rthagrahaṇena visarjanīyo viśeṣyeta, tadā caturo
na syāt | etacca ślokeṣu vyaktīkariṣyati |
evaṃ ślokavārtikakāramatena dvistriścaturgrahaṇaṃ pratyākhyātam |
tāneva ślokānudāharati---kṛtvasujarthe iti | kasmāddhetoḥ
kṛtvasujarthe ṣatvaṃ vravīti, kṛtvo'rthagrahaṇasya kiṃ prayojanamityarthaḥ
| atra ca vakṣyamāṇo'bhiprāyaḥ | prayojanamāha---catuṣkapāla iti |
codayitā svābhiprāyaṃ prakāśayati---nanu siddhamiti |
nanvityabhyupagame | bhavatvanena catuṣkapāle'pi vibhāṣā, tathāpi
nityaṃ ṣatvaṃ siddham | katham ? anena mukte ṭhidudupadhasya ca' iti
ṣatvaṃ bhaviṣyati |
pariharati---siddhe hyayamiti | siddhe prāpta ityarthaḥ | kathaṃ prāptiḥ ?
ityāha---lupte iti | caturas iti sthite ṭhrātsasya' iti suco
lopaḥ, rephasya visarjanīyaḥ | so'yamapratyayavisarjanīyo bhavati,
yadi suco rutvaṃ pūrvasya ṭhrori' iti lopaḥ, rorvisarjanīyo
bhavati, kintu ṭhḍhralope' iti dīrghaḥ prāpnoti, rutvasyāsiddhatvāt,
pūrvameva ca lopena bhavitavyam, evaṃ ca kṛtvo'rthagrahaṇaṃ
kartavyamityuktam |
idānīṃ tadāśrayaṇena dvistraścaturgrahaṇaṃ pratyācaṣṭe---evaṃ satīti | kiṃ
kāryamiti | na kiñcidityarthaḥ | katham ? ityāha---anyo hīti |
itaro'sati dvirādigrahaṇe doṣaṃ darśayati---akriyamāṇa iti |
visarjanīyo viśeṣyeteti | tasya kāryitvena prādhānyāditi bhāvaḥ |
sambhāvane liṅ | viśeṣyatāṃ visarjanīyaḥ, ko doṣaḥ ? ityata
āha---catura iti | tatheti | anantarokte viśeṣaṇaprakāre caturo na
sidhyatīti | kasmāt ? ityāha---rephasyeti |
kriyamāṇe tu dvirādigrahaṇe nāyaṃ doṣaḥ, ityāha---tasmistviti |
itarayorviśeṣābhāvāccaturo viśeṣaṇaṃ yuktamityuktam |
pratyākhyānavādyāha---prakṛtaṃ padamiti | yaduktam---ṭhkāryitvena
pradhānabhūto visarjanīyaḥ' iti, tanna; so'pi prakṛtasya padasya
ṣatvamiti, sa tvarthād ṭhalo'ntyasya' iti visarjanīyasya
bhavatītyetāvat padameva tu kāryi, tadidamuktam---tadantamiti |
tasyāpīti | apiśabdo'vadhāraṇe, tasyaivetyarthaḥ |
evaṃ ślokavārtikakāreṇa pratyakhyāte dvirādigrahaṇe vṛttikāraḥ
sthāpayitumāhaevamiti | pūrveṇeti | ṭhidudupadhasya ca' ityanena |
nityaṃ ṣatvaṃ syāditi | asya tu dvistriḥ śabdāvavakāśau | na ca
paratvādayameva vidhiḥ siddhyatītyāha---pūrvatrāsiddha iti |
ślokavārtikakārasya tvayamabhiprāyaḥ---prakaraṇe prakaraṇamasiddham, na
yoge yogaḥ, tenāsyāsiddhatvaṃ bhavatīti | atha vā---ṭhidudupadhasya
kṛtvo'rthavṛternāprāpte nitye
ṣatvasyārambhādapavādatvamityapavādatvādeva, vacanaprāmāṇyāditivā
siddhatvamiti |
atha ṭhsucaḥ' ityeva kasmānnoktam, kimanena mahatā prabandhena ?
evamucyamāne suci visarjanīyo viśeṣyeta---suco yo
visarjanīya iti, tataśca caturo na syāt | evaṃ tarhi sujantasyeti
vaktavyam---sujantasya yo visarjanīya iti ? evamapi ṭhpadasya'
ityanuvṛteryatra sujantaṃ padaṃ tatraiva syāt---dviṣkarotīti, iha tu
na syāt---paramadviṣkarotīti | yatpadaṃ tanna sujantam,
tasmātsuco'vihitatvāt | yacca sujantaṃ dviriti na
tatpadam;ṭhutarapadatve cāpadādividhau' iti padasaṃjñāyāḥ
pratiṣedhāt |
isusoḥ sāmarthye || 8|3|44 ||
tiṣṭhatvityādi | atrasaparirityasya tiṣṭhatvityanena sambandhaḥ, ṭhpiba'
ityasya tūdakamityaneneti parasparalasambandhābhāvādasāmarthyam |
sāmarthyamiha vyapekṣeti | avadhāraṇamatra draṣṭavyam--vyapekṣaiveti |
prayojanamutaratra vakṣyate | na punarekārthībhāva iti | atrāpyavadhāraṇaṃ
draṣṭavyam---ekārthībhāva eva gṛhyata iti yatanna vyapekṣaivetyarthaḥ | nanu
ca sāmarthyaśabdaḥ sāmānyaśabdaḥ, na ca sāmānyaśabdaḥ
prakaraṇādikamantareṇa viśeṣe'vatiṣṭhate, tatkathaṃ vyapekṣaiva sāmarthyaṃ
gṛhyate, na punarekārthībhāva ityucyate, ubhayaṃ tu kasmānna gṛhyate ? ata
āha---ubhayaṃ veti | netyeva; ubhayamapi gṛhyata iti yatadapi
naivetyarthaḥ | ayaṃ bhāvaḥ---padavidhitvādeva
samarthaparibhāṣopasthānāt sāmarthye labdhe punaḥ
sāmarthyagrahaṇādiṣṭasya vyapekṣālakṣaṇasyaiva sāmarthyasya parigrahaḥ;
netarasya, nāpyubhayoriti ||
nityaṃ samāse'nutarapadasthasya || 8|3|45 ||
parasamarpiṣkuṇḍiketi | nanu ca ṭharciśucihusṛpicchadicchādibhya
isiḥ', ṭhjanerusiḥ', ṭhatipayajitanidhanivapibhyo nit' ityevaṃ
sarpiḥ, yajurityādaya isusantā vyutpādyante, tataśca
pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣayā sarpirādīnāmevesusantatvam, na
paramasarpirādīnām, tatkathamatra prasaṅgaḥ; avaśyaṃ coṇādīnāmapi
vyutpattipakṣa evāśrayaṇīyaḥ; avyutpattipakṣe hyāśrīyamāṇe sarpiṣā,
yajuṣetyādau ṣatvaṃ na siddhyati, apratyayasakāratvāt;
tasmādanarthakamanutarapadagrahaṇam ? ata āha---etadevetyādi |
jñāpanasya prayojanamāha--teneti | atha pūrvasūtreṇa samāse'pi
vikalpaḥ kasmānna bhavati ? ityata āha--vyapekṣā ceti | kecitu
ṭhṭhṭhnityaṃ samāse' ityeko yogaḥ, ṭhanutarapadasthasya' iti dvitīya iti
yogavibhāgena samāse sarvā ṣatvaprāptirutarapadasthasya pratiṣidhyate"
iti vadantaḥ pūrvatra dvividhe'pi sāmarthye samāśrite na doṣa
ityāhuḥ ||
ataḥ kṛkamikaṃsakumbhapātrakuśākarṇīṣvanavyayasya || 8|3|46 ||
kṛ, kamīti dhātugrahaṇam | itareṣāṃ svarūpagrahaṇam | ayaskāra iti |
ṭhkarmaṇyaṇ' | ayaskāma iti | ṭhśīlikāmi' ityādinā ṇapratyayaḥ,
ayaskaṃsādayaḥ ṣaṣṭhīsamāsāḥ | kaṃsagrahaṇamanarthakam, kamigrahaṇenaiva
siddhatvāt, kaṃsaśabdo hi ṭhvṛtṛvadihanikamibhyaḥ saḥ' iti
kamereva vyutpādyate ? jñāpanārthaṃ tu, etat jñāpayati---uṇādiṣu
nāvaśyaṃ vyutpattikāryaṃ bhavatīti | ayaskumbhīti |
kumbhaśabdājjātilakṣaṇo ṅīṣ | ayaspātrīti | pātraśabdaḥ
ṣṭranpratyayāntaḥ, ṣitvānṅīṣ | ayaskuśeti | nātrāyovikāro
vivakṣitaḥ, tena ṭhjānapada' iti sūtreṇa ṅīṣ na bhavati | ayaskarṇīti
| aya iva karṇī yasyāḥ sā ayaskarṇī, ṭhnāsikodara' ityādinā ṅīṣ |
śunaskarṇa ityayaṃ tviti | sūtre tvīkārāntasya karṇīśabdasya
nirdeśādatrāprasaṅgaḥ |
bhāḥ karaṇamiti | ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ | bhāskara ityayaṃ tviti | ṭhdivāvibhā'
ityādinā ṭapratyayaḥ | jayādityastu
tasminsūtre'vocad---ṭhbhāskarānteti pratyayasanniyogena satvaṃ
nipātyate' iti | śvaḥ kāraḥ, punaḥ kāma iti | dhañantena
mayūravyaṃsakāditvāt samāsaḥ ||
adhaḥ śirasī pade || 8|3|47 ||
ityetayoriti | sūtre tu ṣaṣṭhīsthāne prathamā | pada iti svarūpasya
grahaṇam na suptiṅntasya; tasya samāsādhikārādeva siddhatvāt |
tadāhapadaśabde parata iti |
mayūravyaṃsakāditvātsāmāsa iti | adhaspadamityatra tu ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ ||
kaskādiṣu ca || 8|3|48 ||
ṭhkupvoḥ ḥkaḥpau ca' ityasyāpavādaḥ | yathāyogamiti | iṇaḥ parasya
ṣatvam, anyasya satvamityeṣa yathāyogārthaḥ | kaska iti | svantasya
kimo vīpsāyāṃ dvirvacanam | kautaskuta iti | kutaḥ śabdasya
pūrvavad dvirvacanam, tasmāt ṭhtata āgataḥ' ityaṇ, ṭhavyayānāṃ
bhamātre ṭilopaḥ' | bhrātuṣputra iti | ṭhṛto vidyāyonisambandhebhyaḥ'
ityaluk | śunaskarṇa iti | ṭhṣaṣṭha|la ākrośe' ityaluk | pārāyaṇena
dīvyanti vyavaharantīti pārāyaṇikāḥ | pārāyaṇaṃ
dvividham---dhātupārāyaṇam, nāmapārāyaṇamiti |
bhāṣye vṛtāvityādinā'nantaroktamarthaṃ nirākaroti | avihitalakṣaṇa
ityādinā''kṛtigaṇo'yamiti darśayati | visarjanīyasthānikayoḥ
sakāraṣakārayoḥ upacāra iti saṃjñā ||
cchandasi vā'prāmreḍitayoḥ || 8|3|49 ||
ayaspātramiti | asamāso'yam | samāse hiṭhataḥ kṛkami' ityādinā
nityaṃ satvaṃ prāpnoti; asya vikalpasyāsiddhatvāt, asamāse cāsya
vikalpasya caritārthatvāt | yadi vā ṭhprakaraṇe prakaraṇamasiddham' iti
pakṣe samāse'pyudāharaṇam, kintvanena mukte tena nityaṃ prāpnoti,
tasmādasamāsa evāyam | samāse tu yadi vikalpo dṛśyate, sa
chāndasatvenopapādyaḥ | viśvataspātramiti | atrāvyayatvād ṭhataḥ
kṛkami' ityasyāprasaṅgaḥ | uruṇaskāra iti | asmado nasādeśaḥ, ṭhnaśca
dhātusthoruṣubhyaḥ' iti ṇatvam | kāraśabdo ghañantaḥ,
atrāsamāsatvādaprasaṅgaḥ |
agniḥ pravidvāniti | atra ṣatvaprasaṅgaḥ, ubhyakrame tu sakāra ādeśa
ityupalakṣaṇam | paruṣaḥ paruṣa iti | vīpsāyāṃ dvirvacanam |
aṅgamaṅgaṃ paruṣyaru, catuṣyaṣpā viśaste---ityādayastu kaskādiṣu
draṣṭavyāḥ | harikeśaḥ purastādityāderatropayogaṃ na paśyāmaḥ |
kathamatraiva sūtre vāgrahaṇāt satvaṣatvayorbhāvābhāvau pratipāditau ?
kimatra ? ṭhsarve vidhayaścchandasi vikalpyante' ityanena ||
kaḥ karatkaratikṛdhikṛteteṣvanaditeḥ || 8|3|50 ||
kariti | kṛño luṅ, ṭhmantre ghasa' ityādinā clerluk, tipo
halaṅyādilopaḥ, ṭhbahulaṃ cchandasyamāṅyoge'pi' ityaḍabhāvaḥ |
karaditi | kṛña eva luṅ, ṭhkṛmṛdṛhibhyaścchandasi' iti cleraṅ |
karatīti | laṭ, vyatyayena śap | kṛdhīti | kṛño loṭ,
serhiḥ, ṭhbahulaṃ cchandasi' iti śapo luk,
ṭhśruśrṛṇupṛkṛvṛbhyaścchandasi' iti herdhirādeśaḥ | kṛtamiti | kṛña
eva ktaḥ | sakāra ādeśa iti | ṣatvasyāpyupalakṣaṇametat |
viśvataskariti | avyatvādasamāsatvācca ṭhataḥ kṛkami' ityasyāprasaṅgaḥ
| itareṣu tvasamāsatvādaprasaṅgaḥ | śanna karat, yathā naḥ śreyasaḥ
karadityādau chāndasatvātsatvābhāvaḥ | tathā kṛdhītyatra
sakāra-ghakāra-kaśabdeṣu paratastaitirīyake satvaṃ na bhavati---tanma
āmanasaḥ kṛdhi svāhā, urukṣayāya naḥ kṛdhi ghṛtamanyāsai, śaṃ ca naḥ
kṛdhi kratve ||
pañcamyāḥ parāvadhyarthe || 8|3|51 ||
adhyartha iti | pareridaṃ viśeṣaṇam | himavataspari, himavata
uparītyarthaḥ | vyatyayena ṣaṣṭhayāḥ sthāne pañcamyāḥ prayogaḥ |
paryoja udbhatamiti | atra pariḥ sarvatobhāve vartate ||
pātau ca bahulam || 8|3|52 ||
kvacit paṭha|lte---pātāviti dhātunirdeśa iti | anye
tūdāharaṇaparyālocanayā loḍantānukaraṇaṃ manyate ||
ṣaṣṭhayāḥ patiputrapṛṣṭhaparāpadapayaspoṣeṣu | vācaspatiriti |
ṭhtatpuruṣe kṛti bahulam' ityaluk ||
apadāntasya mūrdhanyaḥ || 8|3|55 ||
mūrdhanyagrahaṇamanarthakam, ṭhṣa' ityeva siddham ? ata āha---ṣa ityeva
siddhe iti | ṭhṣa' ityucyamāne ṭhiṇaḥ ṣīdhvam' ityatrāpi ṣatvaṃ
prasajyeta, ḍhatvaṃ ceṣyate | athātraiva mūrdhanyagrahaṇaṃ kriyate, utareṣu
yogeṣu punaḥ ṣagrahaṇaṃ kartavyam | mūrdhanyagrahaṇe tu kreyamāṇe na
doṣo bhavati ||
saheḥ sāḍaḥ saḥ || 8|3|56 ||
sāḍrūpasyeti | sāḍiti rūpaṃ prāptasyetyarthaḥ | jalāṣāḍiti |
ṭhbhajo ṇviḥ', ṭhcchandasi sahaḥ', upadhāvṛddhiḥ, ḍhatvam, jaśtvacartve,
ṭhanyeṣāmapi dṛśyate' ityupapadasya dīrghaḥ, sakārasyāntaratamo
mūrdhanyaḥ ṣakāraḥ |
saheriti kimiti | anyatra sāḍaśabdasyāsambhavaṃ manyamānasya praśnaḥ |
saha ḍeneti | aḍaḥ u vṛścirakalāṅgalam, tasyāpatyaṃ sāḍiriti |
sāḍa ityatra tu sāḍśabdasyānarthakatvādaprasaṅgaṃ matvā taddhitāntaḥ
pratyudāhṛtaḥ, tatra hi yasyetilope kṛte sāḍaśabdo'rthavān bhavati
| na ca yasyetilopasya sthānivatvam; ṭhpūrvatrāsiddhe na sthānivata'
iti vacanāt | evamapi ṭhṣatvatukorasiddhaḥ' ityakādeśasyāsiddhatvāt
sāḍśabdasyābhāvaḥ | tasmātsaha ḍena vartata iti saḍa iti pāṭhaḥ |
yasya nāmni ḍaśabdo vartate sa saḍaḥ, yathā---mṛḍa iti, tasyāpatyaṃ
sāḍiḥ | nanvatrāpi bahirbhūtataddhitāpekṣatvādvahiraṅgā vṛddhiḥ, kva
tarhi syāt ? jalāṣāḍiti | nanvatrāpi bahirbhūta-ṇavyapekṣayā
bahiraṅgaiva vṛddhiḥ ? atha tatra vacanādbhavati, ihāpi
prāpnoti---turāsāhamiti ? turāsāhaṃ purodhāyetyādau tu
ṇvireva durlabhaḥ, prāgeva ṣatvam |
ākārasya mā bhūditi | ṭhantyasya mā bhūt' iti tu noktam; ḍakārasya
ḍakāravacane prayojanābhāvāt | athāpyanantaratamamūrdhanyārthaṃ vacanaṃ
syād ? evamapyapadāntasyetyantyasya na bhaviṣyati | nanvevamapi
ṭhalo'ntyasya' ityasminbādhite sarvādeśo mūrdhanyaḥ prāpnoti,
tatkimucyate---ākārasya mā bhūditi ? ucyate;
ṭhanantyavikāre'ntyasadeśasya' ityākarasya mūrdhanyaḥ prāpnoti ||
iṇkoḥ || 8|3|57 ||
ṭhiṇ' iti pareṇa ṇakāreṇa pratyāharaḥ, ṭhku' iti kavargasya grahaṇam,
tayoḥ samāhāradvandve ekavacanam | numāgamastu satyapi napuṃsakatve
na kṛtaḥ, ṭhanityamāgamaśāstram' iti kṛtvā | vākṣviti | ṭhcoḥ
kuḥ' iti kutve kṛte kavargātparaḥ sakāraḥ | vargagrahaṇam
ṭhśāsivasighasīnāṃ ca' ityatra ghakārasyāpi grahaṇārtham---jakṣaturiti;
anyathā cartvasyāsiddhatvānna syāt | atha vacanasāmarthyāt cartvasya
siddhatvamāśrīyeta; cintyaṃ vargagrahaṇasya prayojanam | dāsyatīti |
nanu ca ṭhnājjhalau' ityatrāgṛhītasavarṇānāmacāṃ
grahaṇam---ityasakṛduktam, tataśca yathā kumārī
śete---ityatrekāraśakārayoḥ sāvarṇyamapratiṣiddham, tataśca yathā
kumārī śete---ityatrekāraśakārayoḥ sāvarṇyamapratiṣiddham, tathā
ākārahakārayorapi, tataḥ kim ? hakāreṇeṇākārasya grahaṇāt
ṣatvaprasaṅgaḥ ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; hakāro vivṛtaḥ, ākāro vivṛtataraḥ |
evaṃ hi paṭhanti---vivṛtakaraṇāḥ svarāḥ, tebhya eo vivṛtatarau,
tābhyāmaiau, tābhyāmapyākāraḥ saṃvṛtokāra iti | evaṃ ca
kṛtvā---ṭhiṣṭakāsu', ṭhvayasyāsu'---ityādayo nirdeśā upapadyante |
asāviti | ṭhadasa au sulopaśca', ṭhtadoḥ saḥ sau'
ityādeśasakāro'yam, na tviṇkoḥ paraḥ ||
numvisarjanīyaśarvyavāye'pi || 8|3|58 ||
ṭhiṇkoḥ' iti pañcamīnirdeśāt vyavāye ṣatvaṃ na
prāpnotītyayamārambhaḥ | numgrahaṇamanusvāropalakṣaṇam; numā
vyavāyāsambhavāt, ṭhnaścāpadāntasya jhali' ityanusvārasya vidhānāt |
anusvāragrahaṇameva tu na kṛtam, numsthānikenaivānusvāreṇa
vyavadhāne yathā syāt, iha mā bhūt---puṃsviti; pumsśabdātsupi
ṭhsayogāntasya lopaḥ', makārasyānusvāraḥ | sarpīṣīti | ṭhnapuṃsakasya
jhalayaḥ' iti num, ṭhsāntamahataḥ saṃyogasya' iti dīrghaḥ | sarpiḥ
sviti | ṭhvā śari' iti pakṣe visarjanīyaḥ | sarpiṣṣviti | pakṣe
satvam, tenaéva vyavāye ṣatvam, sakārasya ṣṭuatvam |
sakāragrahaṇe kartavye śariti pratyāhāragrahaṇaṃ cintyaprayojanam |
iha yathā vṛṣalairna praveṣṭavyamiti vṛṣalanivṛttiparāyāṃ codanāyāṃ
pratyekaṃ saṃhatānāṃ ca praveśo na bhavati, tathā numādīnāṃ
ṣatvāpratibandhahetutvaparāyāṃ codanāyāṃ pratyekaṃ samudāyena ca
vyavāye ṣatvaṃ prāpnotīti tatra sarvavyavāyasya kvacidasambhavāt,
kvacitpratyekam, kvacid dvābhyāṃ vyavāye ṣatvaprasaṅgaḥ ? ityata
āha---numādibhiḥ pratyekaṃ vyavāya iti | evaṃ manyate---vyavāyaśabdaḥ
pratyekamabhisambadhyatenumvyavāye, visarjanīyavyavāye, śarvyavāya
iti | yathādarśitamupakrame, tatra ṭhiṇkoḥ' iti
pañcamīnirdeśenānantarye ṣatvapratipādanādanena ca
vākyatrayeṇaikaikavyavāye ṣatvābhyanujñānāt ṭhyena nāvyavadhānam'
iti nyāyena adhikavyavāye ṣatvābhāva iti | niṃssa iti | ṭhṇisi
cumbane', adādiranudātet | nissveti | loṭ, ṭhsavābhyāṃ vāmau'
||
ādeśapratyayayoḥ || 8|3|58 ||
kimavayavayogaiṣā ṣaṣṭhī---ādeśasya yaḥ sakāraḥ, pratyayasya ca yaḥ
sakāra iti ? āhosvitsamānādhikaraṇe---ādeśo yaḥ sakāraḥ,
pratyayo yaḥ sakāra iti ? tatrādye pakṣe ṭhsaḥ' ityasyānuvṛtasyeha
vacanavipariṇāmo na kartavyo bhavati, kāryeṇa tvādeśapratyayayoḥ
sākṣāt śrutayorasambandhaḥ; sakāraviśeṣaṇatvāt | dvitīye
tvādeśapratyayayoḥ sakārayoriti dvivacanaṃ vipariṇamyam | kāryeṇa
tu sākṣācch4%atayoḥ sambandha iti vacanadoṣasāmyānna yuktitaḥ
pakṣaviśeṣanirṇayaḥ | tatrāvayavaṣaṣṭhī ced dvirvacane
doṣaḥ---visaṃbisam, musalaṃmusalam | tatrāvayavaṣaṣṭhī ced
dvirvacane doṣaḥ---visaṃbisam, musalaṃmusalam | āṣṭamike hi
dvirvacane sthāne dvirvacanapakṣo'pi sthāpitaḥ, tataśca
ṭhnityavīpsayoḥ' ityekasya visamityetasya sthāne
bisaṃbisamityetasminnādeśe kṛte tasyāvayava sakāraḥ iti
ṣatvaprasaṅgaḥ | atha dvitīyaḥ pakṣaḥ ? kariṣyati, hariṣyatītyatra na
prāpanoti; samudāyo hyatra pratyayaḥ, na sakāramātram | kva tarhi syāt
? yatra sakāramātraṃ pratyayaḥ---indro mā vakṣat, sa devānyakṣat ;
vaciyajibhyāṃ leṭ, tip, ṭhitaśca lopaḥ' ityādinekāralopaḥ,
ṭhleṭo'ḍāṭau' ityaṭ, ṭhsibbahulaṃ leṭi' iti sip, vaceḥ kutvam,
yajeḥ ṣatvakatve | athāparau dvau pakṣau---ādeśasya yaḥ sakāraḥ,
pratyayo yaḥ sakāra iti; viparyayo vā---ādeśo yaḥ sakāraḥ,
pratyayasya yaḥ sakāra iti ? tatrādye pakṣe tāveva doṣau yau pūrvayoḥ
pakṣayoḥ bisabisamityādau prasaṅgaḥ, kariṣyatītyādau cāprasaṅga
iti | tasmādantyaḥ pakṣa āśrīyate, tadāha---ādeśapratyayayoriti ṣaṣṭhī
bhedena sambadhyata ityādi |
atra ca jñāpakaṃ yadayamutarasūtre ghasigrahaṇaṃ karoti,
tajjñāpayati---ādeśe samānādhikaraṇā ṣaṣṭhī, na vyadhikaraṇeti;
anyathā ghaserādeśatvādeva tasya sakārasyānenaiva ṣatvasiddheranarthakaṃ
tatsyāt | yacca ṭhsātpadādyoḥ' iti sātipratiṣedhaṃ śāsti,
tajjñāpayati---pratyaye'vayavaṣaṣṭhī, na samānādhikaraṇeti; anyathā
sātisakārasyāpratyayatvāt ṣatvasya prāptyabhāvādanarthakaṃ tatsyāt |
nanu cādeśasyeti ṣatvāpekṣayā sthānaṣaṣṭhī, pratyayasyeti
sakārāpekṣayāvayavaṣaṣṭhīti sahavivakṣābhāvād dvandvanupapatiḥ ? naiṣa
doṣaḥ; pūrvoktāt jñāpakadvayāt sahavivakṣāyā abhāve'pi dvandvo
bhaviṣyati |
yadi pratyayāvayavasya ṣatvamucyate, indro mā vakṣat, sa
devānyakṣadityatra ṣatvaṃ na prāpnoti, pratyaya evātra sakāro na tu
pratyayasyāvayavaḥ ? ata āha---indro mā vakṣadityādi | iha ṭhaśeḥ
saran'---akṣaramityatra ṣatvaṃ bhavati, tasyaiva tu ṭhkṛdhūmādibhyaḥ kit'
iti vihitasya ṣatvaṃ na bhavati, kṛsaram, dhūsaram | tathā
ṭhvṛtṛvadi' ityādinā vihitasya kakṣamityatra bhavati, varsamityatra na
bhavati; bahulavacanāt pratyayasaṃjñāyā abhāvāt ||
śāsivasighasīsāṃ ca || 8|3|60 ||
anviśiṣaditi | ṭhsartiśāsti' ityādinā cleraṅ, ṭhśāsa
idaṅhaloḥ' itītvam | uṣita iti | yajāditvāt samprasāraṇam,
ṭhvasatikṣudhauriṭ' | jakṣatuḥ, jakṣuriti | ṭhliṭa|lnyatarasyām'
ityaderghaslādeśaḥ, ṭhgamahana' ityupadhālopaḥ | akṣanniti | aderluḍ
ṭhluṅsanorghaslṛ', ṭhmantre ghasa' ṭhityādinā clerluk |
tatra yuktaṃ śāsivasyoranādeśārthaṃ vacanamiti,
ghasestvayuktamādeśatvāt ? ityata āha---ghasiryadyapyādeśa iti | ādeśa
iti | ādeśo yaḥ sakārastatra sthitamiti bhāvaḥ | yastvanādeśo
ghasistasyeha grahaṇaṃ na bhavati; viralaprayogatvāt ||
stautiṇyoreva ṣaṇyabhyāsāt || 8|3|61 ||
ṣatvabhūt iti | ṣatvaṃ prāpte, kṛtaṣatva ityarthaḥ | ādeśasakārasyeti
| pratyayasakārastvasambhavānna sambadhyate | suṣvāpayiṣatīti |
ṭhdyautisvāpyoḥ' ityabhyāsasya samprasāraṇam | sisikṣatīti | ṭhsici
kṣaraṇe' | susūṣata iti | ṭhṣūṅ prāṇiprasave' | parasmaipadapāṭhe tu
ṭhṣū preraṇe'---ityasya rūpam |
yadi siddhe satyārambho niyamārthaḥ, evakārastahi kimarthaḥ ?
tatrāha---evakārakaraṇamiti | atha viparīte'vadhāraṇe ko doṣaḥ ?
ityata āha---stautiṇyoḥ ṣaṇyeveti | iha ca syādeveti |
ṣaṇyevetyanena hyavadhāraṇena pratyayāntare stautiṇyoḥ ṣatvaṃ
vyavacchinnam, na tu dhātvantarasya ṣaṇi,
tataścābhihitadoṣadvayaprasaṅgaḥ |
siṣeceti | ṣaṇītyanucyamāne pratyayamātre niyamaḥ
syād---abhyāsātparasya yadi ṣatvaṃ bhavati stautiṇyoreveti, tataśca
siṣecetyādau na syāt |
ko vinate'nurodha iti | vinatamiti patvaṇatvayoḥ prātiśākhyeṣu
prasiddhiḥ---ekavarṇamanokāraṃ vinate susmeti, naḥ para iti yathā |
anurudhyate ānukūlyena prāpyata ityanurodhaḥuprayojanam |
kṛtaṣatvasya nirdeśe kiṃ prayojanamityarthaḥ | suṣupsatīti |
ṭhrudavida' ityādinā sanaḥ kitvam, ṭhvacisvapi' ityādinā
samprasāraṇam | sanītyucyamāne sanmātre niyamaḥ syāt, tataśca
yathā---ṣatvabhūte sanidhātvantarasya ṣatvaṃ na bhavati,
evamihāṣatvabhūte'pi na syāt |
kaḥ sānubandhe'nurodha iti | nakārānubandhavato grahaṇe kiṃ
prayojanamityarthaḥ | ṇatvasya tu prayojanaṃ na pṛcchati; tasya
lakṣaṇaprāptatvāt | suṣupiṣa indramiti | svaperliṭ, chāndasatvād
ṭhvyatyayo bahulam' iti thās, ṭhthāsaḥ seḥ', ṭhasaṃyogālliṭ kit'
iti liṭaḥ kitvāt pūrvavatsamprasāraṇam, dvirvacanam,
krādiniyamādiṭ, indraśabde parato yādeśaḥ, ṭhlopaḥ śākalyasya' iti
yalopaḥ | atra niyamābhāvādabhyāsāt parasya ṣatvaṃ bhavatyeva, ṭhṣa'
ityucyamāne tu yāvān kaścit ṣaśabdastatra sarvatra niyamaḥ syāt,
tasmātsānubandhakagrahaṇam |
abhyāsāditi kimiti | abhyāsād yā prāptistasyā niyamo yathā
syādupasargād yā prāptistasyā niyamo mā bhūt;
abhiṣiṣikṣatītyetatāvadaprayojanam, katham ?
asiddhamupasargātpatvam, tasyāsiddhatvānniyamo na bhaviṣyati |
syādetat---yathā ṭhata ekahalmadhye' ityatra liṭā ādeśo viśeṣyate,
tatheha sanābhyāsaḥ, sani yo'bhyāsastasmāt stautiṇyoreveti, tena
yaṅ yo'bhyāsistasmātṣaṇi dhātvantarasyāpi ṣatvaṃ bhavati,
svaperyaṅ, svapisyamivyeñāṃ yaṅ' īti samprasāraṇam, soṣupyateḥ
san, iṭ, ṭhato lopaḥ', ṭhyasya halaḥ',
soṣupiṣate---tadetadbhavati prayojanamiti ? tanna; antaraṅgamatra
ṣatvam, bahiraṅgo niyamaḥ; tasmādanarthakamabhyāsagrahaṇamiti praśnaḥ |
pariharati---pratiṣiṣatīti | iṇo bodhanārthatvād
gamyādeśābhāvo'jāderiti saśabdasya dvirvacanam, ṭhsanyataḥ'
itītvam | tatrābhyāsāśraye pratyayasya ṣatve kṛte'sya
niyamasyābhāvād dhātvāśrayaṃ ṣatvamabhyāsasya pravartate | nanu ṣaṇīti
parasaptamī, tataśca ṣaṇi pare stautiṇyoreveti ṣatvaniyamaḥ
kriyamāṇastulyajātīyasya ṣaṇvasya sisikṣatītyādeḥ ṣatvaṃ nivartayati
| pratīṣiṣatītyatra tu sani eva dvirvacanamiti ṣaṇparatvābhāvādayaṃ
niyamo na pravatiṣyate | ṭhsanyataḥ' itītvamapi tarhi na prāpanoti,
samudāyasya sayūpatvātasya ca sanparatvābhāvāt | tasmātsanpradeśeṣu
satsaptamī vijñeyā, tataśca yathetvaṃ pravartate tathā ṣatvaniyamo'pi
syādityabhyāsagrahaṇam ||
sa svidisvadisahīnāṃ ca || 8|3|62 ||
ṭhsa' ityavibhaktiko nirdeśaḥ | ṇyantānāmiti | ṣatvaprāptau
satvamucyate, ṣatvaprāptiśca ṇyantānāmiti sāmarthyalabhyametat,
kimarthaṃ punaḥ sakārasya sakāra ucyate ? ata āha---sakārasyeti |
neti pratiṣedha eva vaktavye sakāravacanaṃ lāghave viśeṣābhāvāt ||
prāksitādaḍvyavāye'pi || 8|3|63 ||
ṭhiṇkoḥ' iti pañcamīnirdeśādvyavāye na prāpnotīti vacanam |
aḍityāgamasya grahaṇam, na pratyāhārasya | etacca ṭhhayavaraṭ'
ityatropapāditam | prāk sitasaṃśabdanāditi | ṭhparinivibhyaḥ
sevasita' ityataḥ | apigrahaṇaṃ kim ? avyavadhāne'pi yathā syāt,
anyathā viśeṣavacanādvyavāya eva syāt | abhyaṣuṇoditi | ṭhṣuñ
abhiṣeve', laṅ, ṭhsvādibhyaḥ śnuḥ', aḍāgamaḥ, pāgeva yaṇādeśāt
ṣatvam; kṛte vā yaṇi yakārameveṇamāśritya ṣatvam ||
sthādiṣvabhyāsena cābhyāsasya || 8|3|64 ||
dve ete vākye---sthādiṣvabhyāsena vyavāye tvaṃ bhavati; abhyāsasya ca
ṣatvaṃ bhavati teṣveva sthādiṣviti | tatrādyaṃ vidhyartham, dvitīyaṃ
niyamārtham | aṣopadeśārthamiti | ṣopadeśe tu
paritiṣṭhāsatītyādau sāmānyalakṣaṇenaiva siddham |
abhiṣiṣeṇayiṣatīti | senayā'bhiyātumicchatīti vigṛhya
ṭhsatyāpapāśa' ityādinā ṇic, ṭilopaḥ, tataḥ san, dvirvacanam,
hrasvaḥ, eca ṭhigghrasvādeśe' avyutpannaḥ senāśabdaḥ | yadvā sahenena vatata
iti senā, ṭhsahasya saḥ saṃjñāyām' iti sādeśaḥ | yadā tu
sinoternapratyaye seneti vyutpādyate, tadāstyevā bhiḥ
ṣoṣadeśatvameti | abhitaṣṭhāviti | ādeśasakārasyāpyasya ṣatvaṃ na
siddhyati; iṇākorabhāvāt | abhiṣiṣikṣatīti |
yadyapyayamādeśasakāra iṇaśca paraḥ, tathāpyabhyāsamapekṣa ṣatvaṃ na
siddhyati; stautiṇyoreva ṣaṇīti niyamāt | ataḥ ṣaṇi
yatpratiṣiddhaṃ ṣatvaṃ niyamena vyāvartitaṃ tadapyupasargamāśritya bhavati
|
athābhyāsasyeti kimartham, yāvatābhyāsenetyatra kriyāpekṣāyāṃ
prakaraṇādvyavāya iti sambadhyate, taccāpiśabdasannihitameva
prakṛtamiti avyavāye'pi ṣatvaṃ bhaviṣyati pūrvasūtravat, nārthaḥ
ṭhabhyāsasya' ityanena ? ata āha---abhyāsasyeti vacanaṃ niyamārthamiti |
niyamasya svarūpaṃ darśayati---sthādiṣveveti | viparītastu niyamo
na bhavati---sthādiṣvabhyāsasyaiveti | yadi syāt, abhyāsena vyavāye
ṣatvavidhānamanupapannaṃ syāt | abhisusūṣatīti | ṭhṣū preraṇe', san,
ṭhsani grahaguhośca' itīḍniṣedhaḥ | atra dhātusakārasya
stautiṇyoreveti niyamādaṣatvam | abhyāsasakārasya
tvasmānniyamāt ṣatvābhāvaḥ
||
upasargātsunotisuvatisyatistautistobhatisthāsenayasdhasicasanjasvanjām || 8|3|65 ||
ṭhṣuñ, abhiṣave' svādiḥ, ṭhṣu preraṇe' tudādiḥ, ṭhṣo antakarmaṇi'
dvivādiḥ, ṭhotaḥ śyani' iti lopaḥ, ṭhṣṭuañ stutau' adādiḥ, ṭhuto
vṛddhirluki hali', ṣṭuabhastambhe', anudātet | eteṣāṃ śtipā
nirdeśo yaṅlugnivṛtyarthaḥ---ṭhabhisoṣavātītyādi | ṭhṣṭhā
gatinivṛtau' | senayatirṇyanta | śapā nirdeśena nārthaḥ;
yaṅe'sambhavāt | ṭhṣidha gatyām', ṣidhū śāstre māṅgalye ca'
bhauvādikau; tatra ṭhsedhatergatau' iti pratiṣedhādanyatra ṣatvam | śapā
nirdeśo yaṅlugnivṛtyarthaḥ, daivādikanivṛtyarthaśca ṭhṣidhū
saṃrādvau' iti | ṭhṣica kṣaraṇe' tudādirmucādiḥ, ṭhṣanja saṅge',
ṭhṣvanjapariṣvaṅge', anudātet, ṭhdaśaṃsañjasvañjāṃ śapi' iti
nalopaḥ, sivādīnāṃ yaṅlukyapi bhavati, abhiṣeṣicītītyādi |
eteṣāmaḍvyavāye, abhyāsavyavāye ca yathāsambhavaṃ ṣatvam |
ṭhiṇkoḥ' iti vartate, tatra kavargasyāsambhavādiṇa iti sambadhyate, tatra
yadīṇā upasargo viśeṣyeta---iṇantādupasargāditi, iha na
syāt---niṣṣuṇoti, duṣṣuṇotīti |
tasmādupasargeṇeṇviśeṣaṇīyaḥ---upasargasyeṇa iti | nanūpasargāditi
pañcamī, tatkathamiṇviśeṣyate ? na brūmo vaiyadhikaraṇyena viśeṣyata
iti, kiṃ tarhi ? tātsthātācchabdyam---upasargādiṇaḥ, upasargasthādiṇa iti
| tatra śarvyavāyasyāśritatvānniso'pi parasya ṣatvaṃ bhavati,
tadidamuktam---upasargasthānnimitāditi |
dadhi siñcatīti | ṭhsātpadādyoḥ' iti pratiṣedha evātra bhavati,
tadapavādo hyam |
niḥ secaka iti | nirayamupasarga eva, tatkathamidaṃ pratyudāharaṇam ?
ata āha---tāyaṃ sicerupasarga iti | yatkriyāyuktāḥ prādayastaṃ prati
gatyupasargasaṃjñe bhavataḥ | abhisāvakīyatīti | sāvakaśabdāt
ṇvulantātkyac, tasyābhinā yogaḥ | sunotinā yoge tu
bhavatyeva, abhiṣāvakamicchati abhiṣāvakīyatīti | ṇyante'pi tarhi
ṇijarthena praiṣādinopasargasya yogo na prakṛtyartheneti
ṣatvāprasaṅgaḥ ? ata āha---abhiṣāvayatītyatreti | abhiṣavaviṣayā
prayuktiḥ, na tu prayukterabhinā yoga ityarthaḥ | yadā tu prayukterabhinā
yogaḥ, tadā naiva ṣatvaṃ bhavati; kintu prakṛtyarthenāsaṃsṛṣṭasya
prayuktimātrasyābhinā yogaḥ kīdṛśa iti cintyam |
sadiraprateḥ || 8|3|66 ||
ṭhsadiḥ' iti ṣaṣṭha|lrthe prathamā | niṣasādeti | sadisvañjyoḥ parasya
liṭīti pratiṣedhādabhyāsāt parasya na bhavati ||
stanbheḥ || 8|3|67 ||
stanbhiḥ sautro dhātuḥ | abhiṣṭabhnātīti |
ṭhstunbhustunbhuskanbhuskunbhuskuñbhyaḥ śnuśca' iti śnāpratyayaḥ,
ṭhaniditām' iti nalopaḥ |
apraterityetadiha nānuvartata iti | yadyanuvarteta, pūrvasūtra eva
stambhigrahaṇaṃ kuryātkiṃ yogavibhāgena ? asti prayojanam, kim ?
ṭhavāccālambanāvidūryayoḥ' iti vakṣyati, tatstambheryathā syāt,
sadermā bhūt ? naitadasti; ekasminnapi yoge yasyālambanāvidūrye
staḥ, sa evānuvartiṣyate, stambhereva ca te sambhavataḥ ||
avāccālambanāvidūryayoḥ || 8|3|68 ||
ālambanamuāśrayaṇam | vidūramuviprakṛṣṭam, tadanyadavidūram,
tasya bhāva āvidūryam, ata eva nipātanāt nañpūrvādapi
tatpuruṣādbhāvapratyayaḥ | avaṣṭabhyeti | yaṣṭa|ladikamavalambyetyarthaḥ
| avaṣṭabdheti | āsannetyarthaḥ | avastabdha iti | abhyādita ityarthaḥ ||
veśca svano bhojane || 8|3|69 ||
udāharaṇeṣu svārthaparityāgena bhojanamātre svanirvartata iti
śaṅkāmapanayati---abhyavahārakriyāviśeṣa iti | tameva viśeṣaṃ
darśayati---yatreti | viṣvaṇatīti | saśabdaṃ bhuṅkta ityarthaḥ ||
parinivibhyaḥ sevasitasayasivusahasuṭstusvañjām || 8|3|70 ||
sevatirbhūvādiṣvanudātet | sita iti | ṭhṣiñ bandhane' ktāntaḥ |
saya iti | sa evairajantaḥ, ṭhṣivu tantusantāne' divādiḥ, ṭhṣaha
marṣaṇe' anudātet |
suḍiti | ṭhsuṭ kātpūrvaḥ' ityasya grahaṇam | stusvañjī uktārthau,
tayoḥ ṭhupasargātsunoti' ityādinaiva siddhe
paryādipūrvayorutarasūtreṇāḍvyavāye vikalpārthaṃ vacanam ||
sivādīnāṃ vā'ḍvyavāye'pi || 8|3|71 ||
sivādayaḥ pratyāsateḥ pūrvasūtre sanniviṣṭā gṛhyante |
abhyatravibhāṣeyam, stusvañjyoḥ ṭhprāk sitād' iti prāpte,
itareṣāmaprāpte ||
anuviparyabhinibhyaḥ syandateraprāṇiṣu || 8|3|72 ||
ṭhsyandū prasravaṇe' anudātet |
anusyandete matsyodake iti | matsyaścodaka ca matsyodake |
ṭhjātiraprāṇinām' ityanena yatra sarvāṇyavayavapadānyaprāṇivācīti,
tatraikavadbhāvaḥ; iha tu matsyaśabdasya
prāṇivācitvādekavadbhāvābhāvaḥ | atrāprāṇiṣviti prasajyapratiṣedhaḥ,
tena prāṇyaprāṇisamudāye'pi prāṇyastīti pratiṣedho bhavati | anye
tu paryudāsaṃ manyamānā bhavitavyamevātra ṣatvenetyāhuḥ |
iha paryādigrahaṇaṃ śakyamakartum, evaṃ vakṣyāmi---ṭhanvabhibhyāṃ ca' iti,
cakārāt parinivibhyaśceti ||
pareśca || 8|3|74 ||
pṛthagyogakaraṇasāmarthyāditi | anyathā ṭhviparibhyāṃ
skanderaniṣṭhāyām' ityeva brūyāt ||
veḥ skabhnāternityam || 8|3|77 ||
skambhiḥ sautro dhātuḥ ||
iṇaḥ ṣīdhvaṃluṅliṭāṃ dho'ṅgāt || 8|3|78 ||
iṇantādaṅgādutareṣāmityādinā iṇantamaṅgaṃ ṣīdhvamādīnāṃ
viṣeṇam, te'pi dhakārasyeti darśayati | dhakārasya tviṇantamaṅgaṃ
viśeṣaṇaṃ na bhavati---iṇantādaṅgādutarasya dhasya sa cet
ṣītvamādīnāmiti | tathā hi sati yoṣiḍhvamityādau
vacanasāmarthyātṣīśabdena vyavāya āśrayaṇīyaḥ syāt |
acyoḍhvamiti | ṭhdhi ca' iti salopaḥ |
iṇgrahaṇaṃ kavarganivṛtyarthamiti | prakṛtaṃ hīṇgrahaṇaṃ kavargeṇa
sambaddhamiti tadanuvṛtau tasyāpyanuvṛttiḥ syāt | pakṣīdhvamiti |
ṭhco kuḥ' iti kutve kṛte ḍhatvaprasaṅgaḥ | yakṣīdhvamiti | vraścādinā
ṣatve kṛte ṭhṣaḍhoḥ kaḥ si' iti katvam |
studhve iti | ṭeretvam | astudhvamiti | laṅ |
pariveviṣīdhvamiti | ṭhviṣlṛ vyāptau' juhotyādiḥ svaritet,
ṭhṇijāṃ trayāṇāṃ guṇaḥ ślau' ityabhyāsasya guṇaḥ, ṭhliṅḥ
salopo'nantyasya' iti sīyuṭaḥ sakāralopaḥ | atra dhātuṣakārasya,
īdhvaśabdasya ca yaḥ samudāyastadātmakaḥ ṣīdhvaṃśabdo'sti, na
tvasāvaṅgādutaraḥ | ṣakārāntaṃ hyatrāṅgam, na tu vevītyetāvat |
codayati---arthavadgrahaṇādapīti | pariharati---etatviti |
etadarthavato grahaṇamatra nāśritam | kiṃ kāraṇam ? na kiñcit,
nāśritamityeva ||
vibhāṣeṭaḥ || 8|3|79 ||
atreṇgrahaṇamiṭo viśeṣaṇam, so'pi ṣīdhvamādīnām, te'pi
dhakārasyeti darśayannāha---iṇaḥ parasmādiṭa ityādi | tatra ṣīdhvamo
liṭaśca śrutikṛtamānantaryam, śāstrakṛtaṃ tu na sambhavati,
iṭastadbhaktatvātadgrahaṇena grahaṇāt | ata evānayoḥ
prāptavibhāṣeyam |
tathaiva luṅyapyalaviḍhvamādau dhi ceti lupte sati sicsakāre |
iṇantamaṅgaṃ dhvami jātamātaḥ pūrvasya nityasya vidheḥ prasaṅgaḥ ||
evaṃ ca dhātāvaniṇanta iṣṭamaidhiḍhvamityādiṣu nityaḍhatvam |
yadi tviṇantādvihitasya ḍhatvaṃ tathā na te ḍhatvamadhiḍhvami syāt ||
tathā---lihidogdhinahāṃ ḍhatvaghatvadhatveṣu satsvapi |
iṇantādvihitaḥ ṣīdhvamiti ḍhatvaṃ prasajyate ||
tatheṇo luṅ gādeśe ivihite dhvami karmaṇi |
agādhvaṃ yūyametenetyatra ḍhatvaṃ prasajyate ||
evaṃ ṭhbrūvo vaciḥ' vakṣīdhvamiti |
iṣyate sarvamevaitaditi cennāptavāgiha |
tasmātpāptavibhāṣaiva sarvatreyamiti sthitam ||
tathā ca taitirīyake ṭhtān rudrā abruvanprayūyamajaniḍhvam' iti
ḍhatvaṃ prayuktam | laviṣīḍhvam, laviṣīdhvamiti | anye tviṭo
vibhāṣāyā vakṣyamāṇatvād gobalīvardanyāyena
tadvyatiriktamiṇantamaṅgamiha gṛhyata iti vadanta edhidhvamityādau
ḍhatvaṃ necchanti, teṣāmapyadhiḍhvamityatra bhavatyeva,
natsīdhvamityādau ca na bhavati |
āsiṣīdhvamiti | ṭhāsa upaveśane' | kathaṃ bhavitavyamiti | kimatrānena
vikatpena bhavitavyam, uta neti praśnārthaḥ | upadidīyadhva iti |
ṭhdīṅ kṣaye', liṭ, dhvami krādiniyamādiṭ, dīṅe yuḍaci
kṅiti' iti yuṭ | yuṭā vyavahitamiti | samudāyabhakte hi yuṭ
tameva na vyavadadhyāt, iṭṃa tu vyavadadhātyeva | na bhavitavyaṃ
ḍhatveneti | anena vikalpeneti bhāvaḥ | pūrveṇa tu nityaṃ
prāpnotyeva | apareṣāmiti | asminpakṣe vikalpa eva bhavati ||
samāse'ṅgaleḥ saṅgaḥ || 8|3|80 ||
saṅga iti ṣaṣṭhayāḥ sthāne prathamā | evamutareṣvapi yogeṣu |
sañjanaṃ saṅgaḥ, bhāve ghañ, aṅgalīṣu saṅgo yasyāḥ
sā'ṅguliṣaṅgā |
aṅgaleḥ saṅga iti | atra ṭhśarvyavāye' ityadhikārātprasaṅgaḥ | anye
tu ṭhaṅgule saṅgaḥ' iti sambudhyantamudāharanti ||
bhīroḥ sthānam || 8|3|81 ||
bhīro sthānamiti | pūrvavatsambuddhyantam, ṣaṣṭha|lntaṃ vā |
ṭhsamāse'ṅgalibhīrubhyāṃ saṅgasthāne' ityucyamāne bhyāmityadhikaṃ
prāpnoti, tasmādyogavibhāgaḥ ||
agneḥ stutstomasomāḥ || 8|3|82 ||
agniṣṭuaditi | sampadāditvādadhikaraṇe kvip, yatrāgniḥ stūyate
so'gniṣṭuatukratuviśeṣaḥ, tatredaṃ bhavati---api vā sarveṣu
devatāśabdeṣvagnimevābhisannamediti | agniṣṭoma iti |
somayāgasya saptaṃ saṃsthāḥ; tatrādyā saṃsthocyate |
agnerdīrghāditi | devatādvandve ṣatvamityarthaḥ; tatraiva dīrghasya
vidhānāt | 
agnisomau māṇavakāviti | atra māṇavake saṃjñātvena
viniyuktāvagnisomaṣatvābhāvaḥ | agnisomau tiṣṭhata iti |
āśvalāyanastu tatrāpi dīrghaṣatve prāyuṅkta---agnīṣomau
praṇeṣyāmīti ||
jyotirāyuṣaḥ stomaḥ || 8|3|83 ||
jyotiṣṭoma iti | atra ṭhśarvyavāye' ityadhikārāt ṣatvam |
evamāyuṣṭome'pi ||
mātuḥ piturbhyāmanyatarasyām || 8|3|85 ||
ekadeśavikṛtasyānanyatvād, ṭhvisarjanīyaśarvyavāye' ityadhikārācca
pūrveṇa nitye prāpte vikalpaḥ | mātuḥ ṣvaseti | ṭhvibhāṣā
svasṛpatyoḥ' iti ṣaṣṭha|la aluk |
rephāntayoridaṃ grahaṇamiti | taccotarapade spaṣṭṃa pūrvapadamapi
tatsāhacaryādrephāntameva | yadyevam, rephasya visarjanīye kṛte tasya
ṭhvā śari' iti pakṣe satve kṛte'rephāntatvānna prāpnoti ? ata
āha---ekadeśavikṛtasyānanyatvāditi | yadi tu sakārāntayorgrahaṇaṃ
kriyeta, visarjanīyāntayorna syāt | visarjanīyāntayostu grahaṇe
bhyāmi parato nirdeśo durghaṭaḥ syāt ||
abhinisastanaḥ śabdasaṃjñāyām || 8|3|86 ||
abhinis ityetasmāditi | etena samudāyo nimitaṃ na pratyekamiti
darśayati | abhiniṣṭāno visarjanīya iti | tathā
cāpastambaḥ---ṭhdvyakṣaraṃ caturakṣaraṃ vā nāma pūrvamākhyātotaraṃ
dīrghābhiniṣṭhāntaṃ ghoṣavadādyantarantarastham' iti | dvyakṣaraṃ
caturakṣaraṃ vā nāma kartavyam, kīdṛśam ? nāmapūrvam, nāma
prātipadikamakriyāvāci tatpūrvapadam, ākhyātotaraṃ
kriyāvācyutarapadaṃ dīrghātparo yo'bhiniṣṭāno
visarjanīyastadantaṃ dīrghāntaṃ visarjanīyāntaṃ cetyanye |
goṣavānvarṇa ādiryasya taddhoṣavadādi, antarantasthaṃ
yaralavānāmanyatamaṃ madhye yasya tatathoktamevaṃbhūtaṃ nāma kartavyam |
draviṇodā varivodā ityādyaudāharaṇam ||
upasargaprādurbhyāmastiryacyaraḥ || 8|3|87 ||
y ca acca yacau, tau parau yasmātsa yacparaḥ | yacoriti
saptamīnirdeśenaiva siddhe paragrahaṇaṃ cintyaprayojanam | abhiṣantīti
| adāditvācchapo luk, ṭhśnasorallopaḥ' |
anusṛtamiti | kathaṃ punaratra prasaṅgaḥ, yāvatā sakārasya
prakṛtatvātameva pratyupasargatvamāśrayiṣyate; na cātra sakāraṃ
pratyupasargatvamasti, tāvanmātrasyākriyāvacanatvāt,
tatkimastigrahaṇena; na ca prāduḥ śabdārthamastigrahaṇaṃ kṛtam, tasya
kṛbhvastiviṣayatvena niyatatvāt, tadetadāśaṅkate tāvat |
tathāpīti | anusuśabdaḥ śubhrādiḥ, catuṣpādvacana ityanye, tato
ṭhakṭhañoranyataraḥ, ṭhḍhea lopo'kadrvā' ityukāralope
sakāramātrasya kriyāvācitvāt ṣatvaprasaṅgaḥ ||
suvinirdurbhyaḥ supisūtisamāḥ || 8|3|88 ||
supītyāgantuka ikāraḥ, na punarikā nirdeśaḥ | tatra ṭhvacisvapi' iti
lakṣaṇaprāptena sanprasāraṇena dhātorevāyaṃ nirdeśaḥ syāt, tataśca
yatrāsyaitadrūpaṃ tatra ṣatvamityayamartho na labhyate |
tasmādāgantukenekāreṇa prayogasthasya kṛtasamprasāraṇasya
rūpasyedamanukaraṇam | tadāha---supīti svapiḥ kṛtasamprasāraṇo
gṛhyate iti | etacca ṭhsupi' iti nirdeśādeva labhyate, anyathā
ṭhvacisvapi' itivannirdiśet |
sūtīti svarūpagrahaṇamiti | sūteḥ ktinnantasya grahaṇamityarthaḥ |
sametyapi svarūpagrahaṇameva, na ṭhṣama ṣṭama vaiklavye' iti
dhātorgrahaṇam; ikśitaporanyatarasyābhāvāt |
atha kimatha svapeḥ supi bhūtasya ṣatvamucyate ? supeḥ ṣatvaṃ svapermā
bhūt, supeḥ ṣatvamucyate, svapermā bhūditi---visvapnaḥ,
visvapnamiti | visuṣvāpeti | atha kriyamāṇe'pi vikṛtagrahaṇe
visuṣvāpeti kena na hetunā kena visuṣvāpetyatrābhyāsasya ṣatvaṃ
na bhavati, ṭhliṭa|lbhyāsasyobhayeṣām' iti samprasāraṇe kṛte
supirūpasya bhāvāt prāgeva halādiśeṣāt, kṛte vā
tasminnekadeśavikṛtasyānanyatvādasti prasaṅgaḥ | halādiśeṣānna
supiḥ | dvirvacane kṛte paratvāddhalādiḥ śeṣeṇa yakāre nivṛte
vakārasya samprasāraṇam, tataśca supirūpasya kadācidapyabhāvāt
ṣatvābhāvaḥ | iṣṭṃa pūrvaṃ prasāraṇam | uktaṃ tatrobhayeṣāṃ grahaṇasya
prayojanam---paramapi halādiśeṣaṃ bādhitvā ubhayeṣāṃ
samprasāraṇameva yathā syāditi, tena samprasāraṇameva pūrvamiṣṭam,
viśeṣataścātreṣṭam, anyathā ṣakāravadvakāro'pi nivarteta | na hyatra
heturasti---ṣakāro nivartate vakāro'vatiṣṭhata iti | evaṃ tarhi
sthādiṣvevābhyāsasyetyetasmādeva niyamādatra ṣatvaṃ na bhaviṣyati ?
sthādīnāṃ niyamo nātra | kiṃ kāraṇam ? prāvisatādutaraḥ supi |
ṭhprāksitāt' iti tatra vartate, tena prāksitā ye dhātavasteṣāṃ madhye
sthādiṣvevābhyāsasya ṣatvamiti niyamena
sunotisuvatisyatistobhataya eva nivartyante, supistvayaṃ
tato'vadherutaraḥ | evaṃ tahi ṭharthavadgrahaṇe nānarthakasya'
ityeṣametasya na bhaviṣyati, sthāne hi dvirvacanena
samudāyo'rthavān, avayavau tvanarthakau,
dviṣprayoge'rthapratyāyanasyānāvartanād dvābhyāmarthaḥ pratyāyyata
ityekasyānarthakyameva ? tadetadāha---anarthake viṣuṣupuḥ |
yadyanarthakasya grahaṇaṃ na bhavati, viṣuṣupuriti na siddhyati ? naiṣaḥ
doṣaḥ; ṣuṣibhūto dvirucyate | ayamabhiprāyaḥ---pūrvaṃ dhāturupasargeṇa
yujyate, tatra dvirvacanāt paratvātsamprasāraṇam, paratvādeva
ṣatvam, kṛtaṣatvasyaiva tasya dvirvacanamiti |
nanu ṣatvasyāsiddhatvātpūrvaṃ dvirvacanameva prāpnoti ? ata
āha---pūrvatrāsiddhīyamadvirvacana iti ||
ninadībhyāṃ snāteḥ kauśale || 8|3|89 ||
niṣṇātaḥ kaṭakaraṇe iti | tatra kuśala ityarthaḥ | nadīṣṇa iti |
nadīsnāne kuśala ityarthaḥ | kavayastu kuśalamātre prayuñjate |
nadīsnāta iti | ṭhsaptamī' iti yogavibhāgāt samāsaḥ ||
sūtraṃ pratiṣṇātam || 8|3|90 ||
ṭhsūtraṃ prateḥ' iti vaktavye nipātanāśrayaṇaṃ pratyayāntare mā bhūt ||
kāpiṣṭhalo gotre || 8|3|91 ||
gotramiha pravarādhyāyapaṭhitaṃ gṛhyate, tatra ca svasantānasya
vyapadeśaheturādyaḥ puruṣo gotramityucyate | pāribhāṣikagrahaṇe tu
kāpiṣṭhalirityatraiva syādyatra gotrābhidhāyī pratyayaḥ | yadi tu gotraṃ
na ṣatvasya viṣayeṇa nirddiṣṭam, kiṃ tarhi ? darśanasya gotre yo
dṛṣṭaḥ kapiṣṭhalaśabdaḥ sa sādhurbhavati, kva ? yatra tatretyāśrīyate,
pāribhāṣike'pi gotre na doṣaḥ ||
praṣṭho'gragāmini || 8|3|92 ||
prasthe himavata iti | ṭhghañarthe kavidhānam' ityadhikāraṇe kaḥ ||
vṛkṣāsanayorviṣṭaraḥ || 8|3|93 ||
vistīryata iti viṣṭaraḥ, ṭhprathame vāvaśabde' iti ghañi prāpte |
asmādeva nipātanādap | ruḍhiśabdatvādvā pacādyaci vyutpādyaḥ | ulapena
kṛtā ṭīkā aulapī, sā vākyasya vistaraḥ, aśabda iti pratiṣedhādap
||
cchandonāmni ca || 8|3|94 ||
viṣṭāra iti nipātyata iti | nanu ca viṣṭara iti prakṛtam, tatkathaṃ
viṣṭāra iti nipātyate ? ata āha---vipūrvāditi |
yadi tviha cchandonāmni viṣṭāra ityātvaṃ kriyeta, ghañvidhau
ṭhcchandonāmni ca' iti śakyamakartum, iha vā ṭhviṣṭāra' ityucyeta,
tatra vā ṭhcchandonāmni' iti, ko nvatra viśeṣaḥ, apara āha---ghañvivau
vāviti nānuvartate; tena prastārapaṅktiḥ, saṃstārapaṅktirityapi
bhavatīti ||
gaviyudhibhyāṃ sthiraḥ || 8|3|95 ||
gaviṣṭhiraḥ, yudhiṣṭhira iti | ṭhsaṃjñāyām' iti saptamīsamāsaḥ |
gośabdādahalantādapīti | yadyapyavādeśe kṛte samprati halanto
bhavati, tathāpi utpattivelāyāmahalantatvānnipātanamāśritam ||
vikuśamiparibhyaḥ sthalam || 8|3|96 ||
vi, ku, pari---ityeteṣām ṭhkugatiprādayaḥ' iti samāsaḥ,
śamīśaśabdasya tu ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ, ṭhṅyāpoḥ saṃjñācchandasorbahulam'
iti hrasvatvam | sūtre hrasvoccāraṇe hrasvapakṣa eva ṣatvaṃ yathā syāt |
tena prayoge bahulavacanādyadā hrasvatvaṃ na bhavati, tadā ṣatvamapi na
bhavati
||
ambāmbagobhūmisavyāpadvitrikusekuśaṅvavaṅgumañjipuñjiparamebarhirdivyagnibhyaḥ sthaḥ || 8|3|97 ||
sthaśabdasakārasyeti | etena ṭhstha' iti sūtre svarūpagrahaṇaṃ
prathamāntamiti darśayati | yadi tu ṭhāto dhātoḥ' iti
tiṣṭhaterākāralopaṃ kṛtvā ṣaṣṭha|la nirdeśaḥ syāt, tadā
gosthānam, bhūmisthānamityādāvapi ṣatvaṃ syāditi bhāvaḥ | ambe
tiṣṭhatyambaṣṭhaḥ, ṭhsupi sthaḥ' iti kapratyayaḥ, ṭhṅyāpoḥ' iti hrasvatvam
| āmbaṣṭha iti | saṃjñeyaṃ janapadaviśeṣasya | goṣṭha iti | ṭhghañarthe
kavidhānam' ityadhikaraṇe kapratyayaḥ | bhūmiṣṭhādau ṭhsupi sthaḥ' |
savyeṣṭha iti | ṭhhaladantātsaptamyāḥ' ityaluk |
yadi ṭhsthaḥ' iti svarūpagrahaṇam, sthāsthinsthaṇāṃ na
prāpnotītidamāha---sthāsthinniti | sthāśabdaḥ kvibantaḥ | savyeṣṭhā
iti | ṭhītve vakārapratiṣedhaḥ' iti vacanāt pratyayalakṣaṇenetvaṃ na
bhavati | ṭhgameriniḥ' iti vartamāne ṭhparame sthaḥ kicca' iti
kidinipratyayaḥ, parameṣṭhīśabda ipratyayāntaḥ bāhulakādākāralopaḥ |
savye tiṣṭhati savyeṣṭhā sārathiḥ ||
suṣāmādiṣu ca || 8|3|98 ||
kvacit ṭhsātpadādyoḥ' iti pratiṣedhe prāpte kvaciccādita
evāprāpte ṣatve suṣāmādiṣu mūrdhanyo vidhīyate | duṣṣāmeti |
ṭhvisarjanīyaśarvyavāye'pi' ityadhikārādatra ṣatvam |
suśabdasyetyādi | atraivamabhisambandhaḥ---sudusśabdayostu
kriyāviśeṣaviṣayatvādanupasargatve sati---niṣedhaḥ, duḥ ṣedha iti
pāṭho'yamiti | tatra suśabdasya ṭhsuḥ pūjāyām' iti
karmapravacanīyasaṃjñā, sā copasargasaṃjñāyā bādhikā;
ākaḍārādhikārāt | nirdurorapyupasargatvābhāvaḥ,
kriyāntaraviṣayatvāt | gamikrayāviṣayau hi tau---nirgataḥ sedho
niḥ ṣedhaḥ, durgataḥ sedho duṣṣedha iti | tena ṭhupasargātsunoti'
ityādinā naiteṣu ṣatvaprāptiḥ | evaṃ tāvat ṭhṣidhū
hiṃsāsaṃrāddhyoḥ' ityasya ghañi sedha iti rūpamityāśrityoktam |
yadā tu ṭhṣidha gatyām' ityasya ghañantasya rūpam ?
tadāpyāha---seghatergatāviti pratiṣedhabādhanārthaṃ ceti |
suṣandhirityādau ṭhupasarge ghoḥ kiḥ', samaḥ ṣatvam |
uṇādiṣvetāviti | ṭhpṛbhidivyadhidhṛṣibhya' kuḥ' iti vartamāne
ṭhapaduḥ supu sthaḥ' iti kupratyayaḥ |
gauriṣaktha iti | ṭhbahuvrīhau sakthyakṣṇoḥ' iti ṣac | pratiṣṇaketi
| pratipūrvātsnāteḥ ṭhātaścopasarge' ityaṅ, tadantāṭṭāp,
tato'jñātādiṣu kaḥ ṭhke'ṇaḥ' iti hrasvatvam, ṭhpratyayasthāt' itītvam
| nauṣecanamiti | sicerlyuṭ | dundubhiṣevaṇamiti | sevateḥ,
sīvyatervā lyuṭ |
etasaṃjñāyāmagāditi gaṇasūtram | tadvyācaṣṭe---ekāraparasyeti |
harayaḥ senā asya hariṣeṇaḥ | paritaḥ senāsya pariṣeṇaḥ | pṛthvī
senā yasyeti | ṭhstriyāḥ puṃvat' iti pūrvapadasya puṃvadbhāvaḥ |
nakṣatrādveti | pūrveṇa nitye prāpte vikalpaḥ |
cakāro'nuktasamuccayārthaḥ, ākṛtigaṇatāmasya sūcayati,
tadāha---avihitalakṣaṇa iti ||
hrasvātādau taddhite || 8|3|99 ||
ṭhapadāntasya' ityadhikārādaprāptaṃ ṣatvaṃ vidhīyate, tarabādaya eva
tāvataddhitāḥ sambhavantītyāha---taraptamabiti | sarpiṣṭaramiti |
sarpirjāteḥ prakarṣābhāve'pi sahacāriṇo guṇasya gandhādeḥ prakarṣe
pratyayaḥ | catuṣṭaya iti | ṭhjasaḥ śī' | sarpiṣṭa iti | pratiprayoge
pañcamyāstasiḥ | āviṣṭa|l iti | avyayātyap' ityatrāviḥ śabdāt
ṭhcchandasi' iti vacanātyap |
sarpiḥ sāditi | ṭhvibhāṣā sātiḥ kārtsnye' | nanu ca
ṭhsātpadādyoḥ' iti pratiṣedhādevātra ṣatvaṃ na bhaviṣyati ? ityata
āha---pratyayasakārasyeti |
bhindyaustarām, cchandyaustarāmiti | bhidicchidibhyāṃ liṅ, jherjusi
yāsuṭ, ṭhtiṅśca' iti tarap, ṭhkimetiṅvyayaghāt' iti āmupratyayaḥ
|
ādigrahaṇaṃ śakyamakartum, ṭhti' ityeva
ṭhyasminvidhistadādāvalgrahaṇe', puṃsaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ, puṃstvam,
puṃstā || 
nisastapatāvanāsevane || 8|3|100 ||
nistaptaṃ rakṣaḥ, nistaptā arātaya ityatreti | evamapi
kasyāñcicchākhāyāṃ pāṭhamupalabhya parihāra ucyate | taitirīyakāstu
ṣatvameva paṭhanti ||
yuṣmatatatakṣuḥ ṣvantaḥ pādam || 8|3|101 ||
tatakṣuḥ ṣviti sakārāntānukaraṇātparasya suṣsakārasya
ṭhnumvisarjanīyaśarvyavāye'pi' iti ṣatvam | takārādiṣviti |
etadyauṣmada eva viśeṣaṇam; itarayoravyabhicārāt | tvaṃ tvā ityādi |
eteṣāmeva sambhava ityarthaḥ |
agnistatpunarāheti | agnirityayaṃ pūrvasya pādasyāntaḥ---yanma
ātmano mindābhūdagniriti; tenāyaṃ pādānte sakāraḥ, na pādamadhye
||
stutastomayoścchandasi || 8|3|103 ||
pūrvapadādityeva siddha iti | pūrvapadamiti sāmānyena tatrāśrīyate,
na tu samāsāvayava eveti vākye'pi tenaiva siddhaṃ ṣatvamiti bhāvaḥ |
tataśca stutastomagrahaṇaṃ prapañcārtham | cchandograhaṇaṃ tūtarārthaṃ
kartavyameva ||
pūrvapadāt || 8|3|104 ||
asamāse'pīti | etacca savanādiṣu ṭhsavanesavane' ityādīnāṃ
pāṭhādevāvasīyate ||
suñaḥ || 8|3|105 ||
abhīṣuṇa iti | ṭhikaḥ suñiḥ' iti dīrghatvam, ṭhnaśca dhātusthoruṣubhyaḥ'
iti ṇatvam | kvacitu vṛtāvevaitatpaṭha|lte ||
sanoteranaḥ || 8|3|106 ||
goṣā iti | ṭhjanasanakhanakramagamo viṭ',
ṭhviḍvanoranunāsikasyāt' | kvacitvidamapi vṛtāvevāsti |
gosanimiti | ṭhcchandasi vanasanarakṣimathām' itīnpratyaḥ |
sisānayiṣatīti | yadyapyaṇyantaḥ sūtra upātaḥ, tathāpyaṇyantasya
pratiṣedhavacane prayojanaṃ nāstīti kṛtvā ṇyartho vijñāsyate | iha tu
sisanīyatīti stautiṇyoreva ṣaṇītyetasmānniyamādaprasaṅgaḥ
ṣatvasya | sisanīriti | kvipyato lopaḥ, tataḥ suḥ,
halṅyādilopaḥ, sanaḥ sakārasya ṣatvaṃ prāpnoti rutvaṃ ca, tatra
ṣatvasyāsiddhatvādrutvam, rṭhvorupadhāyā dīrghaḥ' iti dīrghatvam | atra
san ṣatvabhūto na bhavatīti stautiṇyorevetyasya
niyamasyāyamaviṣaya iti ṣatvaṃ prasaktam, asmānniyamānna bhavati |
etasmiṃśca prayojane sati sāmarthyābhāvād ṇyantasya niyamābhāvāt
siṣāṇayivatīti ṣatvaṃ bhavatyeva ||
saheḥ pṛtanartābhyāṃ ca || 8|3|107 ||
yogavibhāgamiti | tatra dvitīyo yogaḥ
pūrvayogasyāsarvaviṣayatvajñāpanārthaḥ | saṃhitāyāmeveti |
ubhayatrāpi saṃhitādhikārādayaṃ viśeṣo labhyate, ṭhnahivṛttivṛṣa'
ityādinā dīrghatvam |
na raparasṛpisṛjispṛśispṛhisavanādīnām || 8|3|108 ||
visraṃsikāyā iti | ṭhrogākhyāyām' iti ṇvul | visrabdhamiti |
ṭhsṛmbhu viśvāse' ktaḥ, ṭhyasya vibhāṣā' itīṭpratiṣedhaḥ, ṭhaniditām'
iti nalopaḥ | visṛpa iti | ṭhsṛpitṛdoḥ kasun' |
savanesavana ityādau vīpsāyāṃ dvirvacanam | kiṃsa ityatra
ṭhayogavāhānāmaṭsuṇatvaṃ śarṣu jaśbhāvaṣatve' iti
vacanāccharvyavāye iti ṣatvaprasaṅgaḥ | yathā tu śaṣūpadeśo na
kartavyastathā ṭhhayavaraṭ' ityatroktam |
aśvasanigrahaṇamanarthakamaniṇantatvāt ? ata āha---aśvasanigrahaṇamiti |
jñāpanasya prayojanamāha---jalāṣāhamiti ||
sātpadādyoḥ || 8|3|109 ||
ādigrahaṇaṃ śakyamakartum, padāditi pañcamīnirddeśaḥ
kartavyaḥ---padātparasya sakārasya neti | ihāpi tarhi na
prāpnoti--agniṣu, vāyuṣu, tvakṣu ? sātipratiṣedho
jñāpayati---svādau yatpadaṃ na tasmātpratiṣedha iti |
tatrāyamapyarthaḥ---dadhisik, madhusigityādau pratiṣedhaḥ siddho
bhavati, na hyayaṃ sakāraḥ padādiḥ | gatikārakopapadānāṃ kṛddhiḥ saha
samāsavacanaṃ prāk subutpateḥ' iti vacanāt padātparastu bhavati,
tatrāpi pūrvapadasya subantatvāt | bahucastu pratiṣedhaḥ | bahuvastu
parasya pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ---bahusektā, na hyatra padātparaḥ sakāraḥ ||
sico yaiṅ || 8|3|110 ||
parisesicyata iti | atrābhyāsasakārasya ṭhupasargātsunoti' ityādinā
prāptiḥ, dhātusakārasya tvādeśasakāratvāt ṭhsthādiṣvabhyāsena ca'
ityetasmācca | nanu copasargātpratiṣedhaviṣaye ṣatvamārabhyate,
tadyathaiva padādipratiṣedhaṃ bādhate, evaṃ ṭhsico yaṅ' ityetimapi
bādheta ? ata āha---upasargādyā prāptiriti | yena nāprāpte tasya
bādhanaṃ bhavati, nāprāpte ca padādilakṣaṇe pratiṣedhe upasargāt
ṣatvamārabhyate, ṭhsico yaṅ' ityetismiṃstu prāpte cāprāpte ca | atha
vā---ṭhpurastādapavādā anantarānvidhīnbādhante na parān' iti |
anenaitadapi nirastam---ṭhsthādiṣvabhyāsena ca' ityanena
yathābhiṣiṣikṣatītyatra stautiṇyoreveti niyamaṃ bādhitvā ṣatvaṃ
bhavati, tathainamapi pratiṣedhaṃ bādhitvā dhātusakārasya prasaṅga iti ||
sedhatergatau || 8|3|111 ||
ṭhupasargāt' iti prāptiḥ pratiṣidhyate ||
pratistabdhanistabdhau ca || 8|3|112 ||
ṭhstanbheḥ' iti prāptiḥ prati ṣidhyate ||
soḍhaḥ || 8|3|113 ||
soḍbhūto gṛhyate iti | niṣṭhāntasya prathamayā
nirdeśaśaṅkāmapākaroti | parisoñeti | ṭhparinivibhyaḥ' iti
prāpte pratiṣedhaḥ ||
stambhusivusahāṃ caiṅ || 8|3|114 ||
atrādyasya ṭhstambheḥ' iti prāptiḥ, itarayostu ṭhparinivibhyaḥ sevasita'
iti | abhyatastambhaditi | ṭhprāksitādaḍvyavāye'pi' iti
ṭhsthādiṣvabhyāsena ca' iti prāptiḥ | paryasīṣivaditi | atrāpi
ṭhsivādīnāṃ vāḍvyavāye'pi' iti prāptiḥ ||
upasargāditi vaktavyamiti | kimartham ? ityāha---upasargādyā
prāptiriti ||
sunoteḥ syasanoḥ || 8|3|115 ||
atretyādi | itikaraṇo hetau, yasmāt stautiṇyoreveti
niyamādabhyāsādaprāptiḥ, rathādiṣvevābhyāsasyeti
niyamādupasargādapyaprāptiḥ, tasmādabhisusūrityudāharanti | atha vā
kathaṃ ṣatvaprasaṅgaḥ ? ata āha---atra hīti | yathā cātra
sanṣa--------------------ityatroktam | abhyāsātprāptimiti |
abhyāsagrahaṇamupasargātprāpterasambhavādabhyāsena vyavahitānna
dhātusakārasya prasaṅgaḥ, nāpyabhyāsasakārasya, sthādiniyamena
vyāvatitatvāt | evaṃ cātrābhigrahaṇamatantram,
susūrityevodāhartavyam ||
sadisvanjyoḥ parasya liṭi || 8|3|116 ||
liṭi dvirvacane kṛte dvau sakārau bhavataḥ, tatra sadeḥ
ṭhsthādiṣvabhyāsena ca' iti vacanāt ṭhsadiraprateḥ' iti ṣatvaprasaṅgaḥ,
svañcerapi ṭhupasargātsunoti' ityādinā | pariṣasvaja iti | kathaṃ
punaratra nalopaḥ, yāvatā saṃyogāntatvānnātra liṭaḥ kitvamasti ? ata
āha---svañjeriti | etacca ṭhindhibhavatibhyāṃ ca' ityatra vyākhyātam,
svañjigrahaṇañca vārtike darśanātsūtre prakṣiptam, yathāha---ṭhsado
liṭi pratiṣedhe svañcerupasaṃkhyānam' iti ||
nivyabhibhyo'ḍvyavāye vā cchandasi || 8|3|117 ||
prakaraṇe prāptasya satvamātrasya pratiṣedhaḥ | nyaṣṭauditi | ṭhuto
vṛddhirluki hali' iti vṛddhiḥ, abhyasthādviṣoḥ pṛtanā
arātīrityapyudāharaṇam ||
iti śrīharadatamiśraviricitāyāṃ padamañjaryāmaṣṭamasyādhyāyasya
tṛtīyaḥ pādaḥkāśikāvṛttiḥ----6
atha aṣṭamādhyāye caturthaḥ pādaḥ
raṣābhyāṃ no ṇaḥ samānapade || 8|4|1 ||
nimitayorādeśe cakāra uccāraṇārthaḥ | samānaṃ ca tatpadaṃ
samānapadam | nimitanimitinoścāyamādhāranirddeśaḥ |
tadāha---samānapadastho cediti | ekaparyāyaḥ samānaśabdaḥ | nimite
raṣau, nimitī nakāraḥ | yadyapyasau prāgeva siddhasvarūpaḥ, tathāpi
tatsthāne bhavato ṇakārasya yannimitam, tasyāpi tena
sambandho'styeva | ṇakāra eva vā nimitī, tasya tu vidhānotarakālaṃ
samānapadasthatvam |
ṣagrahaṇamutarārthamiti | aḍādivyavāye ṇatvaṃ vakṣyati, tadasmādapi
yathā syāt | athehārthamapi kasmānna bhavati ? ata āha---ṣṭuatvenaiva
siddhametaditi |
ṛvarṇācceti vaktavyamiti | raṣābhyāṃ ṇatvamucyamānamṛkārānna
prāpnoti vacanam | na ca śakyaṃ vaktum---ṛvarṇasthādrephād
bhaviṣyatīti | varṇo hyatra rephaḥ sūtra upātaḥ, ṣakāreṇa sāhacaryāt |
na ca varṇaikadeśā varṇagrahaṇena gṛhyante | tisṛṇāmiti | ṭhna
tisṛcatasṛ' iti pratiṣedhāt ṭhnāmi' iti dīrghatvābhāvaḥ |
tatarhi vaktavyam ? netyāha---raśrutisāmānyanirdeśātsiddhamiti | ra
iti śrutiḥuśrotreṇopalabdhiryayoste raśrutīuvarṇātmikā
cāvarṇātmikā ca vyaktiḥ, tayoryatsāmānyaṃ tannidiśyate; na tu
varṇātmikaiva vyaktirityarthaḥ | nanvevamapi ṛkāre trayo bhāgā
abhito'jbhaktirmadhye rephabhaktirmātrā caturbhāgātmikā, tataśca
parayājbhaktyā vyavadhānānna prāpnoti ? ṭhaḍvyavāye' ityevaṃ
bhaviṣyati | na parājbhaktiraṭsanniviṣṭā, sā hyarddhamātrā
caturbhāgātmikā ṛkārabhaktiḥ | na ca tasyāḥ savarṇagrahaṇena
nāpyaḍgrahaṇena grahaṇam; asavarṇatvāt, na hi tasyāḥ sthānaṃ
prayatno vā pṛthagasti | tasmātsāmānyanirdaśe'pi nai ṇatvaṃ sidhyati,
ata āha---varṇabhaktyāceti | varṇasya samudāyasyāvayavabhūtā yā
parājbhaktistayetyarthaḥ | nanu ca nṛnamanagrahaṇaṃ vṛddhyarthaṃ
syāt---nṛnamanasyāpatyaṃ nārnamaniriti ? naitadasti; bahiraṅgā
vṛddhiḥ, antaraṅgaṃ ṇatvam, ṭhasiddhaṃ bahiraṅgamantaraṅge' |
atha veti | vyaktinirddeśe'pi doṣa ityarthaḥ | aparaḥ
prakāraḥ---abhito'jbhaktī caturbhāgātmike, madhye śuddho
repho'rdhamātrātmakaḥ, tena vyaktinirdeśe'pyadoṣa ityarthaḥ | nanu ca
parayājbhaktyā vyavadhānam ? evaṃ tarhi utarasūtre yogavibhāgaḥ
kariṣyate---ṭhvyavāye'pi' iti, vyavāye'pi ṇetvaṃ bhavati; tataḥ
ṭhaṭkupvāṅnumbhiḥ' iti | idamidānīṃ kimartham ?
niyamārtham---varṇātmakairvyavāye yadi bhavati aḍādibhireveti |
ṭhapadāntasya mūrdhanyaḥ' ityadhikārādatra ṇagrahaṇaṃ śakyamakartum |
utaratra ca ṭhpadāntasya' iti pratiṣedhaḥ ||
aṭkupvāṅnumvyavāye'pi || 8|4|2 ||
ṭhraṣābhyām' iti pañcamīnirddeśādvyavāye na
prāpnotītyayamārambhaḥ | paryāṇaddhamiti | ṭhṇaha bandhane',
paryāṅpūrvaḥ niṣṭhā, ṭhnaho dhaḥ' |
nanu ca ṭhaḍvyavāye' ityevātra ṇatvaṃ siddhaṃ tatkimarthamāṅgrahaṇam
? ityata āha---aḍvyavāya ityeva siddhamiti | kvacitu āṅgrahaṇaṃ
padavyavāye'pītyasya bādhanārthamityetāvat paṭha|lte | bṛṃhaṇamiti |
ṭhbṛhi vṛddhau', ṭhidito num', ṭhnaścāpadāntasya jhali' ityanusvāraḥ |
yadyevam, anusvāreṇātra vyavāyo na numā ? ata
āha---numgrahaṇamanusvāropalakṣaṇārthamiti | jhalparasya
numo'nusvāravidhānātsthāninā numānusvāra upalakṣyate | evamapi
yo'nusvāro numsthāniko na bhavati tadvyavāye na prāpnoti
ṭhtṛṃha stṛṃha hiṃsārthau', tṛṃhaṇamiti ? ata āha---teneti | nātra
numsthāniko'nusvāra upalakṣyate, kiṃ tarhi ? anusvāramātraṃ
tenātrāpi bhavatītyarthaḥ | yatra tarhi numa eva śravaṇaṃ nānusvārasya tatra
ṇatvaṃ bhavati vā, na vā ? ata āha---satyapi ceti | yathā ṭhnakṣatraṃ
dṛṣṭvā vācaṃ visṛjet' iti kālaviśeṣopalakṣaṇaparāyāṃ
codanāyāṃ satyapi divā nakṣatradarśane vāg na visṛjyate,
upalakṣitasya kālasyābhāvāt; asatyapi nakṣatradarśane rātrau
visṛjyate, tasya kālasya bhāvāt; tathehāpi draṣṭavyam |
prenvanamiti | ṭhiviḥ prīṇanārthaḥ', ṭhidito num', atra ṭhijādeḥ
sanumaḥ' iti ṇatvaprasaṅgaḥ |
iha samudāye vākyaparisamāptirdṛṣṭā, yathā---gargāḥ śataṃ
daṇḍa|lntāmiti, arthinaśca rājāno hiraṇyena bhavanti, na ca pratyekaṃ
daṇḍayanti; pratyekamapi dṛṣṭā, yathā---vṛddhiguṇasaṃjñe pratyekaṃ bhavataḥ
| tatreha yadi pūrvaḥ kalpa āśrīyate, na kvacit syāt, na hi
samastairaḍādibhirvyavāyaḥ kvacidapi sambhavati | dvitīye tu
arheṇetyādau na syāt; aṭā kavargeṇa ca vyavāyāt | ata
āha---vyavāyopa lakṣaṇārthatvāditi | iha ye
yadupalakṣaṇāyopādīyante teṣāmekena dvābhyāṃ bahubhirapyupalakṣitaḥ
sa gṛhyate, tadyathā---ṭhgargaiḥ saha na bhoktavyam' ityukte pratyekaṃ ca saha
na bhujyate, samuditairapi, tathehāpi śaknuvantyaḍādayaḥ samastā
vyastāśca vyavāyamupalakṣayitumiti sarvatra bhavati | aḍādivyavāye
ṇatve'nyavyavāye pratiṣedhaḥ---ādarśena, sparśena | yadyapyatrānyenāpi
vyavāyaḥ, yastvaṭā vyavāyastadāśrayaṃ ṇatvaṃ prāpnoti, yatra
tvanirdiṣṭaireva vyavāyastatraiva na syāt---kṛtsnam, mṛdhnotīti ?
naiṣa doṣaḥ; ṭhraṣābhyām' ityatra ṭhtasmāt' iti
paribhāṣopasthānādvyavāye ṇatvāsaṅgāt
sūtramidamārabhyamāṇamaḍādivyavāya eva ṇatvamanujānāti,
nānyavyavāye; tasya nirdiṣṭagrahaṇena nivartitatvāt, yadi ca
nidiṣṭavyatiriktairapi vyavāye ṇatvaṃ syāt, numgrahaṇamanarthakaṃ
syāt; kevalena numā vyavāyāsambhavāt ||
pūrvapadātsaṃjñāyāmagaḥ || 8|4|3 ||
ṭhraṣābhyām' iti vartate, na ca tayoḥ pūrvapadatvaṃ sambhavatīti
sāmarthyātpūrvapadasthānnimitādutarasyetyeṣo'rtho vijñāyata
ityāha---pūrvapadasthāditi | rephaṣakārāntāpūrvapadādityayaṃ tvartho
na bhavati; vyākhyānāt | draṇasa iti | druriva nāsikā yasyeti
bahuvrīhiḥ, ṭhañnāsikāyāḥ' ityañpratyayo naśādeśaśca |
vārdhrīṇasa iti | vadhrarthā vikāro vārdhrī rajjuḥ, vārdhrīva
nāsikā yasya sa vārdhrīṇasaḥumṛgaviśeṣaḥ | tatra
pūrvapadasyopamānaniṣṭhatvādvyadhikaraṇatvāt puṃvadbhāvābhāvaḥ,
nasśabdaḥ priyādiṣu vā draṣṭavyaḥ | śūrpaṇakheti |
ṭhnakhamukhātsaṃjñāyām' iti pratiṣedhaḥ | yadā tu yogo vivakṣyate, na
saṃjñā---śūrpākārāṇi nakhāni yasyā iti; tadā ṅīṣ bhavati, ṇatvaṃ
tu na bhavati---śūrpanakhī | evaṃ ca ṇatvaṅīṣau na samavetaḥ---ṭhtataḥ
śūrpanakhīvākyāt' iti |
ṭhagaḥ' iti śakyamavaktum | kasmānna bhavati---ṛcāmayanamṛgayanamiti ?
nipātanādetatsiddham---ṭhaṇṛgayanādibhyaḥ' iti |
yathānyatroktam--sarvanāma saṃjñāyāṃ nipātanāṇṇatvābhāva iti |
pūrvapadātsaṃjñāyāmeveti | viparītastu niyamo na
bhavati---pūrvapadādeva saṃjñāyāmiti, śivādiṣu suṣeṇaśabdasya
pāṭhāt | siddhe satyārambho niyamāya bhavati, kathamatra siddhiḥ ?
ityāha---samānapade'pi hīti | yadyapi pūrvapadasthaṃ
nimitamutarapadastho nimitīti bhinnapadasthatvamapyasti, tathāpi
samāse kṛte tato vā vibhaktirutpadyate, tayā samudāyasya
padasaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ tasminsamāne'pi pade bhāvādastyeva pūrveṇa
prāptiḥ, samānapadatvaṃ hi tatrāśritam, na bhinnapadatvaṃ pratiṣiddham |
tasmādupapannaṃ niyamārthatvam | yadyevam, yathotarapadasthasya nakārasya
ṇatvaṃ niyamena vyāvartyate---carmanāsika iti; tathā
taddhitapūrvapadasthasyāpi vyāvartyeta---kharapasyāpatyam ṭhnaḍādibhyaḥ
phak'---khārapāyaṇaḥ, mātṛbhogāya hitaḥ
ṭhbhogotarapadātkhaḥ'---mātṛbhogīṇaḥ, karaṇaṃ priyamasya karaṇapriyaḥ ?
ityāha---sa ceti | sambandhiśabdo niyatameva
pratiyoginamupasthāpayati, tadyathā---mātari vartitavyaṃ pitari
śuśrūṣitavyamiti, na cocyate---svasyāṃ mātari svasminpitarīti,
atha ca sambandhādetad gamyate---yasya yā mātā tasyāmiti, yo yasya
pitā tasminniti | pūrvapadam, utarapadamiti ca
sambandhiśabdāvetau---pūrvapadamapekṣyotarapadaṃ bhavati, utarapadaṃ
cāpekṣya pūrvapadam | tatra sambandhādetadavagantavyam---yatprati
pūrvapadamityetadbhavati tatsthasya niyama iti | kiñca
pratyetadbhavati ? utarapadam |
ayaṃ tarhi doṣaḥ---ṭhagaḥ' iti niyamasyaiva pratiṣedhaḥ prāpnoti,
tenaikavākyatvāt, na ṇatvasya, tataśca saṃjñāyāñca gāntare ṇatvaṃ
prāpnoti ? ata āha---aga iti | ṭhagaḥ' iti yo'yaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ sa
ṇatvasya, na niyamasya | atra hetuḥ--yogavibhāgeneti |
ṭhpūrvapadātsaṃjñāyām' ityeko yogaḥ, ṭhagaḥ' iti dvitīyaḥ; anena ca
yā ca yāvatī ca ṇatvaprāptiḥ sā sarvā pratiṣidhyate,
yogavibhāgasāmarthyāt |
apare tvityādi | katha punaḥ samānamevetyavadhāraṇaṃ labhyate ? ata
āha---samānagrahaṇāditi | ṭhpade' ityeva vaktavyam,
tatrāpadasthayornirmitinimitanora sambhavāt
padagrahaṇamekatvavivakṣārthaṃ vijñāyate | evaṃ siddhe yatsamānagrahaṇaṃ
kriyate, tasyaitatprayojanaṃ yathaivaṃ vijñāyeta---samānameva
yatpadamiti | teṣāmevaṃ bruvatāṃ vidhyarthametadvijñāyata
ityāha---teṣāmiti | vidhyarthatvamevopapādayati---samāse hīti |
athāsminpakṣe khārapāyaṇa ityatra kathaṃ ṇatvam, yāvatā kharapaśabde
kharaśabdasyāpi padatvamasti, tatsthatvādrephasya samānapadasthatvameva na
bhavati ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; yatra dvāvapi nimitanimitinau samānapadasthatvaṃ
vyabhicarataḥ, tatra ṇatvābhāvaḥ; iha rephasya vyabhicāre'pi nakārasya
samānapadasthatvāvyabhicārāṇṇatvaṃ pravartate ||
vanaṃ puragāmiśrakāsidhrakāśārikākoṭarāgrebhyaḥ || 8|4|4 ||
ṭhvanam' iti ṣaṣṭhayāḥ sthāne prathamā | udāharaṇe ṭhvanagiryoḥ
saṃjñāyām' iti pūrvapadasya dīrghatvam | agrevaṇamiti | ṣaṣṭhīsamāse
rājadantāditvādvanaśabdasya paranipātaḥ, ṭhhaladantāt' iti saptamyā
aluk, atha na saṃjñā tato rājadantādiṣu nipādanādaluk |
siddhe satītyādi | puragādiṣvetaducyate, agreśabde tvasaṃjñāyāṃ
vidhyarthamityāhuḥ | etebhya eva vananakārasyeti | ṭhetebhyo
vananakārasyaiva' ityayaṃ tu niyamo na bhavati; dīrghīccāraṇāt | taddhi
dīrghānteṣvayaṃ niyago bhavediti | na ca vanādanyatrotarapade
dīrghāntatvameṣāṃ sambhavati, yatrāsya ṇatvaṃ dīrghānteṣu vyāvartyeta
|| 
pranirantaḥ śarekṣuplakṣāmrakārṣyakhadirapīyūkṣābhyo'saṃjñāyāmapi ||
8|4|5 ||
atrāditastriṣu saṃjñāyāmasajñāyāmaprāptaṃ ṇatvaṃ vidhīyate, katham ?
saṃjñāyāṃ tāvat ṭhpūrvapadātsaṃjñāyām' ityetadyadyapi niyamārtham,
athāpi vidhyartham---ubhayathāpi avaśyam ṭhvanaṃ puragā' ityādisūtraṃ
niyamārtham---puragādiṣveva vananakārasyeti, tataśca
prādiṣvaprāptiḥ | asaṃjñāyāmapi niyame tāvadaprāptiḥ;
saṃjñāyāmeveti niyamāt | vidhāvapi saṃjñāyāṃ
vidhānādanyatrāprāptireva | śarādiṣu tvoṣadhivanaspativāciṣu
saṃjñāyāmasaṃjñāyāṃ cotarasūtreṇa prāptasya vikalpasyāpavādaḥ |
ṭhasaṃjñāyāmapi' ityanucyamāne ṭhsaṃjñāyām' ityadhikārātatraiva syāt
| nivartiṣyate saṃjñāyāmiti ? yadi nivartate, saṃjñāyāṃ na
prāpnoti; puragādibhya eva vananakārasyeti niyamāt | ayaṃ tu
vidhirasaṃjñāyāṃ sāvakāśaḥ, saṃjñāyāmapi paratvādayameva
vidhirbhaviṣyati, ṭhpūrvatrāsiddhe nāsti vipratiṣedhaḥ',
tasmādasaṃjñāyāmapīti vaktavyam | pravaṇam, nirvaṇamiti |
prādisamāsau | antarvaṇamiti | vibhaktyarthe'vyayībhāvaḥ, śaravaṇādayaḥ
ṣaṣṭhīsasāsāḥ ||
vibhāṣauṣadhivanaspatibhyaḥ || 8|4|6 ||
ṭhasaṃjñāyāmapi' ityanuvartate, tena saṃjñā'saṃjñāyordvayorayaṃ
vikalpaḥ | anye tu vṛtāvanuktatvātasyādhikāraṃ necchanti, teṣāṃ
saṃjñāviṣaye puragādibhya iti niyamatvena bhavitavyam | yadi
tviṣyate yatnāntaramāstheyam | 
iha ye puṣpyanti phalanti ca te vānaspatyāḥ; ye phalantyeva na
puṣpyanti te vanaspatayaḥ; ubhaye'pi te vṛkṣā ityabhidhānavidaḥ |
tataśca vanaspatiśabdopādānena ṇatvaṃ vikalpyamānaṃ
śirīṣavaṇamityatraiva syāt, śirīṣādayo hi puṣpyanti phalanti ca,
tasmādvṛkṣagrahaṇaṃ kartavyam, tadidamāśaṅkate tāvat---
phalī navaspatirityādi | phalameva yasya na puṣpaṃ sa
vanaspatiḥūdumbarādi, puṣpopagā vetasādayaḥ, phalopagā
udumbarādayaḥ, ubhayopagā āmrādayaśca vṛkṣāḥ | antātyantādisūtre
ṭhḍo'nyatrāpi dṛśyate' iti vacanāḍuḥ | phalapākena vināśo yāsā tā
oṣadhyaḥ---śālyādayaḥ, latāpratānavatyo mālatyādayaḥ,
gulmāḥuhrasvaskandhāstaravaḥ, bahukāṇḍapatrāḥ vīrudha iti---yadyapi
vṛkṣavanaspatyorbhedaḥ smaryata iti śaṅkāṃ paraharati---ihābhedena
grahaṇaṃ draṣṭavyamiti | atra ca ṭhlupi yuktavadvyaktivacane' ityatra
bhāṣyakāravacanaṃ liṅgam | uktaṃ hi tatra---"vyaktivacana iti kim,
śirīṣāṇāmadūrabhavo grāmaḥ śirīṣāḥ, tasya vanaṃ
śirīṣavanamiti---vanaspatitvaṃ nātidiśyate | yadyatidiśyeta,
ṭhvibhāṣauṣadhivanaspatibhyaḥ' iti ṇatvaṃ prasajyeta" iti | yadi cokto
bheda ihāśritaḥ syāt, śirīṣaṇāmavanaspatitvādvanaspatitvaṇatvayoḥ
prasañjanaṃ nopapadyeta ||
ahno'dantāt || 8|4|7 ||
pūrvāhṇa iti | ahnaḥ pūrvo bhāga iti ṭhpūrvāpara' ityādisūtreṇa
samāsaḥ, ṭhrājāhaḥ sakhibhyaṣṭac', ṭhahno'hna etebhyaḥ' itya ahnādeśaḥ |
nirahna iti | nirgato'hna iti prādisamāsaḥ, śeṣaṃ pūrvavat |
dīrghāhnī śarādati | bahuvrīhirayam, tena ṭajna bhavati; ṭajvidhau
tatpuruṣādhikārāt | ṭhana upadhālopino'nyatarasyām' iti ṅīp,
ṭhallopo'naḥ' | akārāntasya grahaṇādatra ṇatvaṃ na bhavati | yadi tu
nakārasyāyaṃ ṣaṣṭha|la nirdeśaḥ syāt, atrāpi ṇatvaṃ syāt |
akārāntasya tu grahaṇaṃ prakaraṇādvijñāyate | sarvatra prakaraṇe sthānī
prathamayā nidiśyate---vanam, vāhanam, yānamiti |
yadvā---yuvādiṣu pāṭhādasya ṇatvābhāvaḥ | avaśyakartavyaśca yuvādiṣu
pāṭhaḥ; prātipadikānteti vikalpena ṇatvaṃ mā bhūditi | antagrahaṇaṃ
jñāpakam---atra prakaraṇe na yatnamantareṇa varṇenāpi
tadantavidhirbhavatīti | tena ṭhraṣābhyām' ityatra tadantavidhine bhavati
||
vāhanamāhitāt || 8|4|8 ||
uhyate'neneti vāhanamuśakaṭādi, karaṇe lyuṭ, asmādeva
nipātanādupadhāvṛddhiḥ | āhitamāropitamucyate | yadā bāhyaṃ
nāropitaṃ kevalaṃ sannihitaṃ tadāna na prāpnoti, tadāpīṣyate |
yadāha---āhitopasthitayoriti vaktavyamiti | na vā
bhūtakālasyāvivakṣitatvāt, svāmibhāvanivṛttiparāyāṃ
codanāyāmāhitamiti bhūtakālo na vivakṣyate,
tenāhitādādhāyiṣyamāṇācca bhaviṣyati | kevalaṃ
svasvāmibhāvavivakṣāyāmeva na bhavati, yathā pratyudāharaṇe
uktam---dākṣisvāmikamityartha iti | dākṣyādayo'pi yadā vāhyatvena
vivakṣyante na svāmitvena, tadā ṇatvaṃ bhavatyeva ||
pānaṃ deśe || 8|4|9 ||
kṣīraṃ pānaṃ yeṣāmiti | kartari ṣaṣṭhī | uśīnarādayaḥ śabdā
deśadvāreṇa puruṣeṣu vartanta iti deśābhidhāyino bhavanti |
dākṣaiiṇāṃ pānamiti | atrāpi karmasādhana eva pānaśabdaḥ ||
vā bhāvakaraṇayoḥ || 8|4|10 ||
girinadyādīnāmiti | saṃjñāyāṃ prāpte,
asaṃjñāyāmaprāpte---ityubhayatravibhāṣeyamityāhuḥ ||
prātipadikāntanumvibhaktiṣu ca || 8|4|11 ||
māṣavāpiṇāviti | ṭhbahulamābhīkṣṇye' iti ṇiniḥ | māṣavāpāṇīti
| māṣānvapantīti ṭhkarmaṇyaṇ', ṭhjaśśasoḥ śi', ṭhnapuṃsakasya jhalacaḥ'
iti num |
iha kasmānna bhavati---gargāṇāṃ bhaginī gargabhaginīti | bhaginnityasya
prātipadikasyānto nakāra ityasti prāptiḥ ? ityata
āha---pūrvapadādhikārāditi | etacca ṭhpūrvapadātsaṃjñāyām' ityatraiva
vyākhyātam | kimidānīṃ naiva bhavati---gargabhagiṇīti, bhavati
vivakṣāntare śāstrāntereṇa nityam, na tvanena ? ityāha---yadā
tviti | mātṛbhogīṇavaditi | etadapi tatraiva vyākhyātam |
yadyautarapadaṃ prātipadikaṃ gṛhyate māṣavāpiṇītyatra ṇatvaṃ na prāpnoti,
yadutarapadaṃ vāpinīti na tasyānto nakāraḥ, yasya cānto nakāro
vāpinniti na tadutarapadam ? ata āha---māṣavāpiṇītyādi |
ṭhupapadamatiṅ' ityatraitadvyākhyātam | ṭhutarapadabhūtaṃ prātipadikaṃ
gṛhyate' ityatra jñāpakamāha---tathā ceti | kathametajjñāpakam ?
ityāha---sa hīti | aṅgasya numvidhīyate, tataśca tadbhakto num
tadgrahaṇenaiva gṛhyate, notarapadagrahaṇena | yadi ca yatkiñcana
prātipadikaṃ gṛhyaeta notarapadameva, tato numgrahaṇamakartavyameva
syāt; ṭhsamāsaprātipadikānta' ityeva siddhatvāt |
āryayūneti | viśeṣaṇamāsaḥ | ṭhśvayuvamaghonāmataddhite' iti
samprasāraṇam | prapakvānīti | gatisamāsaḥ | atra ṭhkumati ca' iti
nityaṃ ṇatvaṃ prāpnoti | dīrghāhnī śaraditi | ayamapi yuvādiṣu
draṣṭavya ityuktam ||
ekājutarapade ṇaḥ || 8|4|12 ||
vikalpādhikāranivṛtevispaṣṭīkaraṇārthamiti | anyathā
yadyapyatrārambhasāmarthyānnityo vidhiḥ śakyo vijñātum, utaratra
tvanuvṛttiḥ sambhāvyeta ||
kumati ca || 8|4|13 ||
anekājutarapadārtho'yamārambhaḥ | vastrayugiṇāviti | yugaśabdādini
kṛte paścādinnantena samāsaḥ kartavyaḥ | evaṃ tarhi utarapadasya
prātipadikasyānto nakāro bhavati; anyathā
mātṛbhogīṇavallakṣaṇāntareṇaiva ṇatvaṃ siddhaṃ syāt, ṭhkau'
ityucyamāne'pi kavargamātrasyotarapadasyāsambhavānmatubartho labhyate,
nārtho matupā ? satyam; ṭhkau' ityucyamāne
tadādividhivijñāyeta---kavargādāvutarapada iti ||
upasargādasamāse'pi ṇopadeśasya || 8|4|14 ||
ṇa upadeśe yasya sa ṇopadeśaḥ | pranāyako deśa iti | atra
gatikriyāyogamātrameva prati prasyopasargatvam, na namatiṃ prati |
asamāse'pīti kimiti | viśeṣānupādānādeva
samāsāsamāsayordvayorapi bhaviṣyatiti praśnaḥ |
pūrvapadādhikārāditi | sarvatraivātra prakaraṇe ṭhpūrvapadāt' iti
vartate, samāse eva pūrvapadaṃ bhavati, tena samāsa eva syāt |
tadadhikāranivṛttidyotanārthamiti | nānena
vispaṣṭārthamasamāse'pigrahaṇamicyute | tathā hi---yadyapyasvaritatvāt
ṭhpūrvapadāt' iti nivartate, tathāpyasamāse'pigrahaṇaṃ kartavyam,
anyathā'saṃjñāyāṃ samāse na syāt; pūrvapadātsaṃjñāyāmeveti
niyamādasya ca vidherasamāse caritārthatvāt |
tasmātpūrvapadādhikāranivṛttidyotanamukhena
samāsāsamāsayordvayorapi yathā
syādityasamāse'pigrahaṇamityayamartho draṣṭavyaḥ |
nanvasiddhamupasargaṇatvam, tasyāsiddhatvānniyamo na bhaviṣyati, tena
ṭhpūrvapadāt' ityasminnivṛte na kartavyamasamāse'pigrahaṇam ? evaṃ
tarhyetajjñāpayati---na yoge yogo'siddhaḥ, api tu prakaraṇe
prakaraṇamasiddhamiti | yadā tu ṭhpūrvapadātsaṃjñāyām' iti sūtraṃ
niyamārthamiti pakṣaḥ, tadaitaducyate | yadā tu vidhyartha tadā
naitadupapadyate ||
hinumīnā || 8|4|15 ||
ṭhhi gatau' svādiḥ, ṭhmīñ hiṃsāyām' kriyādiḥ, dīrghāntaḥ |
hinumīnāgrahaṇae vikṛtasyopasaṃkhyānam, ihāpi yathā
syāt---prahiṇoti, pramiṇītaḥ ? siddhaṃ vā sthānivatvāt;
ītvaguṇayoḥ sthānivadbhāve sati upātameva rūpamiti ṇatvaṃ
bhaviṣyati | nanu ṭhpūrvatrāsiddhe na sthānivat' ? doṣa evāyamasyāḥ
paribhāṣāyāḥ ṭhtasya doṣaḥ saṃyogādilopalatvaṇatveṣu' iti |
āni loṭ || 8|4|16 ||
pravapāṇīti | vaperloṭ, ṭhmerniḥ' | ṭhāḍutamasya picca', prayāṇīti
