yāte rūpam | pravapānīti | prakṛṣṭā vapā yeṣu tāni pravapāni |
āniloḍgrahaṇamanarthakam; arthavadgrahaṇāt, arthavata āniśabdasya
grahaṇam, na caiṣo'rthavān | anupasargādvā, yat kriyāyuktāḥ
prādayastaṃ prati gatyupasargasaṃjñe bhavataḥ, na caitamāniśabda prati
kriyāyogaḥ, tadantaṃ tu prati bhavati | kathaṃ naivaṃ vijñāyate---yasya
kriyā yatkriyā, yatkriyāyuktā iti ? kathaṃ tarhi yā kriyā yatkriyā
yatkriyāyuktā iti, prayogaviṣayā ca kriyā na kvacidasaṃsṛṣṭāstīti
samudāyasyāśrīyata iti āniśabdāntaṃ samudāyaṃ prati kriyāyogaḥ |
tatrāyaṃ ca sūtrārthaḥ---upasargāt parasyāvayavo ya
āniśabdastannakārasya ṇatvamiti | tadevaṃ pratyākhyātaṃ loḍgrahaṇam
||
nergadanadapatapadaghumāsyatihantiyātivātidrātipsātivapativahatiśāmyaticinotidegdhiṣu ca || 8|4|17 ||
ṭhgāmādāgrahaṇeṣvaviśeṣaḥ' iti vacanāt ṭhmīnātiminotidīṅam'
ityātve kṛte yanmārūpam, yacca ṭhmā māne' iti, teṣāmapi
grahaṇaprasaṅgaḥ ? ityā śaṅkyāha---māṅmeṅergrahaṇamiṣyata iti |
iṣṭireveyam | praṇiṣyatīti | ṭhotaḥ śyani', ṭhupasargātsunoti'
ityādinā ṣatvam | hantiprabhṛtayaḥ psātiparyantā adādayaḥ, ṭhmā māne
ca' | praṇiśāmyatīti | ṭhśamāmaṣṭānāṃ dīrghaḥ śyani' |
sytyādiṣu tipā nirdeśo yaṅlugnivṛtyarthaḥ |
aḍvyavāye'pīti | anyathāṅgasyāḍucyate, vikaraṇāntaṃ cāṅgam,
so'sau saṅghātabhakto'śakyo gadādigrahaṇena grahītumiti na syāt
| āṅa ceti vaktavyam---praṇyāgadaditi | tatarhi vaktavyam ? na
vaktavyam, ṭhaṭakupvāṅnumvyavāye' iti vartate, tena
nergadādīnāṃ cāḍvyavāye ca bhaviṣyati | pranyupagadatītyādau tu
ṭhpadavyavāye'pi' iti pratiṣedhādapresaṅgaḥ ||
śeṣe vibhāṣā'kakhādāvaṣānta upadeśe || 8|4|18 ||
ṭhakakhādāvaṣānte' iti copasargasannidhāpitasya
dhātorviśeṣaṇamityāha---akakhādiraṣānta upadeśe yo dhāturiti |
ādigrahaṇaṃ śakyamakartum, ṭhakakhe iti vaktavyam,
ṭhyasminvidhistadādāvalgrahaṇe' | antagrahaṇaṃ tu kartavyam, asati hi
tasminna jñāyate---kena tadādividhiḥ, kena vā tadantavidhiriti |
śeṣagrahaṇaṃ kim ? gadādiṣu mā bhūt | yadi teṣvapi syāt,
pūrvayogo nirviṣayaḥ syāt;tasmāccheṣa iti śakyamavaktum |
pranipekṣyatīti | ṭhṣaḍho kaḥ si' iti katve kṛte sampratyaṣānto
bhavati | pranicakāreti | ṭhkuhoścuḥ' ityabhyāsasya cutve kṛte
sampratyayaṃ na kakārādirbhavati | praṇiveṣṭeti | ṭhvraśca' ityādiṣatve
kṛte samprati ṣānto bhavati, upadeśe tvaṣāntatvāṇṇatvaṃ bhavati ||
aniteḥ || 8|4|19 ||
prāṇitīti | ṭhśvasa prāṇane', ṭhana ca', rudādibhyassārvadhātuke' itīṭ
||
antaḥ || 8|4|20 ||
aniterantasyeti | aniteḥ sambandhinaḥ padāntasya nakārasyetyarthaḥ |
he prāṇiti | kvibantātsambuddhiḥ, ṭhna ṅasimbuddhyoḥ' iti
nalopapratiṣedhaḥ | anyatra tu padāntasya nakārasya lopena
bhavitavyamiti sambuddhyantamudāhṛtam | antaśca padāpekṣo gṛhyata
iti | nānityapekṣaḥ; vyabhicārābhāvāt |
kecitvityādi | ṭhaniterantaḥ' ityekameva yogaṃ paṭhanti,
samīpavacanaṃ cāntaśabdamāśrayantītyarthaḥ | kimartham ?
ityāha---nimitasamīpasyeti | nanu ca nāstyeva sa viṣayo yatra
nimitasya samīpabhūto'niternakāraḥ, prāṇitītyādāvekādeśe kṛte
ākāreṇa vyavāyaḥ, niraṇitītyatrākāreṇa, tatkathaṃ
nimitasamīpasthasyetyucyate ? ata āha---ekavarṇavyavahitasyeti |
sāmarthyādekavarṇana vyavadhānamāśratamityarthaḥ | na ca
prāṇitītyatraikādeśasya pūrvasmādvidhau sthānivadbhāvād
varṇadvayavyavāyaḥ śaṅkanīyaḥ; pūrvatrāsiddhe sthānivatvaniṣedhāt |
nanu coktam---ṭhtasya doṣaḥ saṃyogādilopalatvaṇatveṣu' iti ? evaṃ
tarhyanityaḥ pūrvasmādvidhau sthānivadbhāvaḥ; ṭhniṣṭhāyāṃ seṭi' iti
seḍgrahaṇāt, etacca sthānivatprakaraṇa eva vyākhyātam | tairityādi
| ekaṃ hyantagrahaṇam, tacca sāmīpyārthaṃ paryanitītyatra ṇatvavyāvṛtyā
caritārtham, tataśca he prāṇityatra padāntasyeti pratiṣedhaḥ
prāpnoti; tasmātaidvitīyamapyantagrahaṇamāvṛtyā tantreṇa
vā''śrayitavyam |
nanu ca ye'pi yogavibhāgaṃ kurvanti, avayavavacanaṃ
cāntaśabdamāśrayanti, terapi pūrvasūtre sāmīpyavācyantaśabdaḥ
paṭhitavya eva; anyathā paryanitītyatrāpi syāt ? ata āha---yeṣāṃ
tviti | te naikavarṇavyahitasyāpi ṇatvamicchantyeva,
tasmānnārthasteṣāṃ pūrvasūtre'ntagrahaṇenetyarthaḥ ||
ubhau sābhyāsasya || 8|4|21 ||
prāṇiṇiṣatīti | sani ṭhajāderdvitīyasya' iti niśabdasya dvivarcanam |
prāṇiṇaditi | ṇyantālluṅ, cleścaṅ, ṇiṃlopaḥ, ṭhdvirvacane'ci'
iti sthānivadbhāvānniśabdasya dvirvacanam |
pūrvatrāsiddhīyamityādi | ṭhpūrvatrāsiddhīyamadvirvacane' ityasminnasati
prānisatītisthite dvirvacanaṃ ca prāpnoti, ṇatvaṃ ca, tatra
ṇatvasyāsiddhatvātpūrva dvirvacane kṛte'bhyāsaṇakāreṇa
vyavāyāddhātunakārasya ṇatvaṃ na syāt | asmiṃstu sati paratvāṇṇatve
kṛte kṛtaṇatvasyaiva dvirvacane antareṇāpyetadvacanaṃ
prāṇiṇiṣatītyādi siddhaṃ bhavati | yadyevam, kimarthamidamārabhyate ?
ityāha---etatviti | śakyārthe kṛtyāḥ, itikaraṇo hetau |
tuśabdo'vadhāraṇe | yasmādetadapavādavacanametadarthaṃ naiva
śakyamāśrayitum, tasmādetadārabhyate | ayamabhiprāyaḥ---asya
vacanasyānityatvajñāpanārthamidamārabhyata iti | tena---ṭhaujaḍhadityatra
ḍhatvādīnāmasiddhatvāt hat ityetad dvirucyate'---ityupapannaṃ bhavati
|
atha ṭhubhau' iti kimartham, yāvatābhyāsanakārasya pūrveṇaiva ṇatvaṃ
sidhyati, ārambhasāmarthyāddhātunakārasya vyavāye'pyanena bhaviṣyati ?
satyam; vyavahitasya sidhyati, anantarasya tu takrakauḍinyanyāyānna
syāditi ṭhubhau' ityucyate ||
hanteratpūrvasya || 8|4|22 ||
hanterityavayavaṣaṣṭhī, atpūrvo yasmāditi bahuvrīhiḥ,
nakāro'nyapadārthaḥ | yadyapi nakāraviśeṣaṇāni prathamayā
niddiśyante---antaḥ, ubhāviti, tathāpīha ṣaṣṭha|la nirddeśaḥ kṛtaḥ |
idaṃ hi nyāyyaṃ vyatikramo'lpaḥ | prahaṇyata iti | bhāve, karmaṇi vā
laṭ | praghnantīti | ṭhgamahana' ityupadhālopaḥ, ṭhho hanteḥ' iti
kutvam | atra ṭhkuvyavāye' iti prasaṅgaḥ | prāghānīti | ṭhciṇ
bhāvakarmaṇoḥ' iti ciṇ |
śtipā nirdeśo dhātunirdeśārtha eva, na
yaṅlugnivṛtyarthaḥ---prajaṅghanīti | atra hi cutve kṛte jakāreṇa
vyavāyādeva na bhaviṣyati ||
vamorvā || 8|4|23 ||
pūrveṇa nitye prāpte vikalpaḥ ||
antaradeśe || 8|4|24 ||
ṭhantaḥ śabdasyāṅkividhiṇatveṣūpasaṃkhyānam' ityupasargasaṃjñāyā
bhāvād ṭhhanteratpūrvasya' iti siddhe deśapratiṣedhārthaṃ vacanam |
antarhanano deśa iti | adhikaraṇe lyuṭ ||
ayanaṃ ca || 8|4|25 ||
antarayaṇamiti | ayeḥ, iṇo vā lyuṭi rūpam | ṭhkṛtyacaḥ' iti siddhe
idamapi deśapratiṣedhārthaṃ vacanam ||
cchandasyṛdavagrahāt || 8|4|26 ||
avagṛhyateuvicchidya paṭha|lte ityavagrahaḥ, ṛccāsāvavagrahaśca ṛdavagrahaḥ |
ṛkārād, avagrahāt, pūrvapadāt---iti tisro'pi samānādhikaraṇāḥ
pañcamyaḥ | tatra ṛkāramātrasya pūrvapadasyāsambhavādṛkāreṇa
tadantavidhiḥ---avagrahaṇabhūto ya ṛkārastadantāditi |
saṃhitādhikārācca saṃhitākāla eteṣāṃ ṇatvam; padakāle cāvagrahaḥ
kriyate, tenāvagrahayogayatvādṛkāro'vagraha ityuktaḥ, na tu
taddaśāpannaḥ | tathā cāvagrahaṃ darśayatā ṇatvaṃ na prayuktam |
anavagṛhyamāṇāditi | anavagrahayogyādityarthaḥ | apadāditi | pade
hyavagrahaḥ kriyate, padamatra vicchidyata iti darśanāya ||
naśca dhātusthoruṣubhyaḥ || 8|4|27 ||
dhātau tiṣṭhatīti dhātustho rephaḥ, ṣakāraśca | ūru iti
svarūpagrahaṇam, ṣu iti kṛtaṣatvasya suño grahaṇam, na
saptamībahuvacanasya; tena indro dhatā gṛheṣu na ityatra na bhavati |
nasiti nāsikādeśasyāsmadādeśasya ca sāmānyena grahaṇam,
tato'trāsmadādeśa eva kāryī; tasyaiva dhātusthādibhyaḥ parasya
sambhavāt, utarasūtre tūbhayoḥ kāryitvam | rakṣā ṇa iti | rakṣeti
loṇmadhyamapuruṣaikavacanāntam, ṭhdvyaco'tastiṅḥ' iti dīrghaḥ |
śikṣā ṇa iti | śikṣatirdānakarmā cchandasi | uruṇaskṛdhīti | kṛño
loṭ, serhiḥ ṭhśruśṛṇupṛkṛvṛbhyaścchandasi' iti herdhirādeśaḥ,
ṭhkaḥ karat' ityādinā visarjanīyasya rutvam | abhīṣu ṇa iti | ṭhikaḥ
suñi' iti dīrghaḥ | evamūṣu ṇa ityatrāpi ||
upasargādvahulam || 8|4|28 ||
na samprati kriyāyogābhāvāt prādyaupalakṣaṇamupasargagrahaṇam | praṇa
ityasmado nasādeśaḥ, praṇasa iti bahuvrīhiḥ, ṭhupasargācca' ityac
samāsāntaḥ, nāsikāyāśca nasbhāvaḥ |
upasargādanotpara iti pāṭhāntaram, upasargātparasya naso nakārasya
ṇatvaṃ bhavati, otaḥ parasya okāre vā na bhavatītyarthaḥ |
ubhayathāpyativyāptyavyāptisambhavādvyākhyāta eva pāṭho
vṛttikāreṇāśritaḥ ||
kṛtyacaḥ || 8|4|29 || 
kṛtstho yo nakāra aca utara ityanenāca iti nakārasyedaṃ
viśeṣaṇam, na kṛta iti darśayati | yadi hi kṛta etadviśeṣaṇaṃ
syāt, prāpaṇamityādau na syāt, ṭhna
bhābhūpūkamigamiṣyāyivepām' ityatra ca kamyādīnāṃ
pratiṣedho'narthakaḥ syāt | anamānetyādi |
sambhavodāharaṇadarśanaparam, na parigaṇanam; anyasyāsambhavāt | ana
iti | yoranādeśaḥ | māna ityāgatamuka, śānajādiḥ |
tavyadādisūtravihito'nīyaḥ, ṭhākrośe nañyaniḥ'| ṭhsupyajātau
ṇiniḥ', āvaśyake ṇiniḥ | niṣṭhādeśaḥ ṭhradābhyām' iti vihitaḥ |
prahīṇa iti | ṭhghumāsthā' ityādinā ītvam |
pramagnaḥ, prabhugna iti | ṭhoditaśca' iti niṣṭhānatvam | nirviṇṇasyeti
| acaḥ paraḥ kṛtstho nakāro na bhavatīti vacanam | tatra parasya nasya
ṇatvam, pūrvasya ṣṭuatvam ||
ṇervibhāṣā || 8|4|30 ||
ṇyantādyo vihita iti | etena ṇerityasya vihitaviśeṣaṇatvaṃ
darśayati, prayojanaṃ vṛtāveva vakṣyate | aparaḥ
prakāraḥ---ṭhaḍvyavāye' iti vartate, tena ṇyantasya
kṛtaścāḍvyavāye'pi ṇatvasyābhyanujñānāt ṇyantātparaḥ
kṛdityevamāśrīyamāṇe'pi prayāpyamāṇityādau yakāravyavāye'pi
ṇatvasiddhiriti ||
halaścejupadhāt || 8|4|31 ||
prakopaṇamiti | ṭhkupa krodhane' | prehaṇam, prohaṇamiti | ṭhīha
ceṣṭāyām', ṭhūha vitarkea'| atra ṭhkṛtyacaḥ' iti ṇatvaṃ nityameva
bhavati |
kathaṃ punarasatyādigrahaṇe halādiriti labhyate ? ata
āha---ijupadhasyeti | ijupadhasya halantatvāvyabhicārāt
sāmarthyādādiviśeṣaṇaṃ halgrahaṇamityarthaḥ ||
ijāpeḥ sanumaḥ || 8|4|32 ||
hala iti vartata iti | prayojanamutaratra vakṣyati | nanu
tatrādiviśeṣaṇaṃ halgrahaṇam, antaviśeṣaṇena cehārthaḥ | ata
āha---teneti | ijāderhalāditvāsambhavātsāmarthyam | praṅkhaṇamiti
| ṭhikhi gatyarthaḥ', iditvānnum |
nanu cātrānusvāre kṛte nāyaṃ sanumko bhavati, kāmamatra
sthānivadbhāvāt siddhyati---prambhaṇamiti, atra tvādita eva num
bhavatītyatra na siddhyati, autpatiko hi tatra nakāraḥ; prenvanamityatra
ca prāpnoti, yatra numevāvikṛtaḥ śrūyate; tasmādihāpi
numgrahaṇamanusvāropalakṣaṇārthaṃ vyākhyeyam | nakṣatradarśananyā
yeneṣṭaviṣaye sarvatra bhaviṣyati, aniṣṭe ca na bhaviṣyati, evaṃ ca
kṛtvā niyamārthatopapadyate; anyathā prenvanamityatra vidhyarthatā
sambhāvyeta | na ca ṭhaṭkupvāṅnumvyavāye'pi' ityetena siddhiḥ,
tatrāpi numgrahaṇasyānusvāropalakṣaṇatvāt | nanu ṭhkṛtyacaḥ'
ityanenaiva siddhe nārtho'nena ? ata āha---siddhe satīti |
pramaṅganamiti | magirapi gatyartha eva | pramaṅkanamiti pāṭhe
maṇḍanārthaḥ |
nanu ca kaimarthyānniyamo bhavati, vidheyaṃ nāstīti kṛtvā, iha cāsti
vidheyam, kim ? ṇyantādvibhāṣā prāptā, tatra nityaṃ ṇatvaṃ vidheyam
? ata āha---halaityadhikārāditi | nanu caṇilope kṛte ṇyanto'pi
halanto bhavati, tataḥ kim ? satyapi haladhikāre vidhyarthatā
sambhavati ? naitadasti; vihitaviśeṣaṇasyāśrayaṇāt | etadeva
hyabhipretya vṛttikāreṇoktam---ṭhhalantāddhātoryo vihitaḥ' iti ||
vā niṃsanikṣanindām || 8|4|33 ||
ṭhṇisi cumbane' ṭhṇikṣa ropaṇe', ṇidi kutsāyām'
ṇopadeśatvādeteṣāṃ nitye ṇatve prāpte vikalpaḥ ||
na bhābhūpūkamigamipyāyīvepām || 8|4|34 ||
pūgrahaṇena pūñograhaṇameṣṭavyamiti | iṣṭireveyam | ṇyantānāṃ
ceti | ṇyantasyādhātvantaratvānna prāpnotīti vacanam, kiñca
ṇyanteṣvasya pravṛtau pakṣe'nuvādadoṣaprasaṅgaḥ; ṭhṇevibhāṣā' ityeva
pakṣe nivṛteḥ siddhatvāt ||
ṣāt padāntāt || 8|4|35 ||
niṣpānam, duṣpānamiti | ṭhidudupadhasya ca' iti visarjanīyasya
ṣatvam, atra ṭhkṛtyacaḥ' iti prasaṅgaḥ | sarpiṣpānamiti | karmaṇi
ṣaṣṭhayāḥ samāsaḥ | yajuṣpānamiti | ṭhkartṛkaraṇe kṛtā bahulam'
iti samāsaḥ | ubhayatrāpi ṭhnityaṃ samāse'nutarapadasthasya' iti ṣatvam,
atra ṭhpānaṃ deśe' ṭhvā bhāvakaraṇayoḥ' iti prāptiḥ |
pade anta iti | ṭhsaptamī' iti yogavibhāgātsamāsaḥ | susarpiṣkeṇeti
| śobhanaṃ sarpirasyeti bahuvrīhiḥ, kap, ṭhiṇaḥ ṣaḥ' iti ṣatvam |
nāyaṃ pade parataḥ pūrvamavasthitasyānto bhavati | padasya tvanto
bhavati; ṭhsvādiṣu' iti padasaṃjñāyā vidhānāt, tataśca
ṣaṣṭhīsamāse'trāpi prāpnoti | kathaṃ
punarjñāyate---saptamīsamāso'yamiti ? antagrahaṇāt; anyathā
varṇagrahaṇe sarvatra tadantavidhirityeva ṣakārantāt padāditi labhyate
||
naśeḥ ṣāntasya || 8|4|36 ||
pranaṣṭa iti | ṭhmaśjinaśorjhali' ityāgatasya numaḥ ṭhaniditām' iti
nalopaḥ, vraścādiṣatvam | | naśeraśaḥ | | aśakārāntasya naśeriti
vaktavyam, na tu ṣāntasyeti, ihāpi yathā syāt---pranaṅkṣyatīti,
ṭhṣaḍhoḥ kaḥ si' iti katvaṃ bhavati | tatarhi tathā vaktavyam ?
netyāha---antagrahaṇamiti | ṣakāreṇa naśerviśeṣaṇāt ṭhṣantasya' iti
siddhe punarantagrahaṇasāmarthyādyaḥ samprati ṣānto yaśca bhūtapūrvaḥ, tasya
bhavati pratiṣedhaḥ ||
padāntasya || 8|4|37 ||
he karinnityādyapyudāharaṇam ||
padavyavāye'pi || 8|4|38 ||
māṣakumbhavāpeneti | atra kecidāhuḥ---yadā māṣāṇāṃ kumbho
māṣakumbhaḥ, tasya vāpa iti pakriyā, tadā ṭhutarapadatve
cāpadādividhau' iti pratyayalakṣaṇapratiṣedhāt
padatvābhāvānniṣedhāpravṛterbhavitavyameva ṇatvena, tasmāt kumbhasya
vāpaḥ kumbhavāpaḥ, māṣāṇāṃ kumbhavāpo māṣakumbhavāpa iti
prakriyāśrayeṇodāharaṇamiti | atra ṭhkumati ca' iti prāptiḥ |
prāvanaddhamiti | ṭhupasargādasamāse'pi' ityavaśabdavyavāye'pi
ṭhaḍvyavāye' iti prāptiḥ | pragānnayāma iti | cchandasyayaṃ vyavahitaḥ
prayogaḥ | gāmiti dvitīyāntena padena vyavāyaḥ |
padavyavāye'taddhita iti | yo'yaṃ padavyavāye pratiṣedhaḥ, sa taddhite
yatpadaṃ tatra na bhavatīti vaktavyamityarthaḥ | ādragomayeṇeti | ṭhgośca
puruṣe' iti mayaṭ, tatra parato gośabdaḥ ṭhsvādiṣu' iti padam ||
kṣubhnādiṣu ca || 8|4|39 ||
kṣubhnā---iti svarūpagrahaṇam, na dhātugrahaṇam, tena
kṣobhaṇamityādau ṇatvaṃ bhavatyeva | kṣubhnītaḥ, kṣubhnantīti | atra
tvāllopayoḥ sthānivadbhāvādekadeśa vikṛtasyānanyatvādvā ṇatvaṃ
na bhavati | nṛnnamayatīti nṛnamaḥ | harinandīti tācchīliko ṇiniḥ
| harinandanaḥ, girinagaramiti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsau | narīnṛtyata iti |
ṭhrīgṛdupadhasya ca' | tṛpnotīti | cchandasi vyatyayena śnuḥ |
parinartanam, parigahanamiti | prādisamāsau | parinandanamiti |
gatisamāsaḥ | śaraniveśādayo darbhānūpāntāḥ ṣaṣṭhīsamāsāḥ |
ācāryabhogīnaḥ, ācāryānīti | atraivāsyapratiṣedhaḥ; ācāryeṇa,
ācāryāṇamityādau tu bhavatyeva | kṣubhnādirākṛtigaṇa iti |
cakāro'nuktasamuccayārtha evamevārthaṃ sūcayati ||
stoḥ ścunā ścuḥ || 8|4|40 ||
atra sannipāta ityadhyāhāryam | vṛkṣaśśete iti | ṭhvā śari' iti pakṣe
visarjanīyasya sakāraḥ | majjatīti | ṭhjhalāṃ jaś jhaśi' iti sakārasya
dakāre kṛte tasya cutvam---jakāraḥ | asiddhatvaṃ tu jaśtvasya na
bhavati; ṭhna mu ne' ityatra neti yogavibhāgāt | tathā ca bhṛjjatīnāṃ
ṅtīiti nirdeśa upapadyate |
iha sakāratavargau kāryiṇau dvau, nimite api dve eva---śakāracavargau,
tataśca sāmyātsaṃkhyātānudeśaḥ prāpnoti ? ityāśaṅkyāha---śāditi
pratiṣedha iti | ścuneti tṛtīyānirdeśaḥ pūrvabhūtenāpi yoge
yathā syāt---yajñaḥ, yācñeti | saptamīnirdeśe tu ṭhtasminniti
nirdiṣṭe pūrvasya' iti parabhūtenaiva yoge syāt ||
ṣṭuanā ṣṭuaḥ || 8|4|41 ||
aṭṭatītyādi | ṭhatṭa atikramaṇahiṃsayoḥ', ṭhadḍa abhiyoge',
takāradakāropadhayoretayorgaṇapāṭhaḥ kvibantayoḥ
saṃyogāntalope kṛte takāradakārayoḥ śravaṇārthaḥ, ṭhna ndrāḥ
saṃyogādayaḥ' iti pratiṣedho'pyaḍḍaterbhavati | ihāpi
tṛtīyānirdeśaḥ pūrvabhūtenāpi yoge ṣṭuatvaṃ yathā syāt,
yathā---droḍheati | atrāpi ṭhtoḥ ṣi' iti pratiṣedhānnimitinimitayoḥ
saṃkhyātānudeśo na bhavati |
na padāntāṭṭoranām || 8|4|42 ||
ṭhanām' iti ṣaṣṭhībahuvacanasyāgatanuṭkasya pratiṣedhaḥ |
śvaliṭsāya iti | dhuḍabhāvapakṣe sakārasya ṣṭuatvaṃ prāpnoti |
dhuṭpakṣe tu cartvasyāsiddhatvātasyaiva dhakārasyeti |
īṭṭe iti | ṭhīḍ stutau', adādiranudātet |
ṣaḍadhikā navatiḥ ṣaṇṇavatiḥ | ṣaṇṇāṃ nagarāṇāṃ samāhāraḥ ṣaṇṇagarī ||
toḥ ṣi || 8|4|43 ||
ṭhṣi' iti saptamīrnirdeśāt pūrvabhūtenāpi sannipāte
bhavatyevaloṣṭā, peṣṭeti ||
śāat || 8|4|44 ||
praśnaḥ, viśna iti | ṭhyajayāca' ityādinā naṅ, ṭhcchavoḥ
śūḍanunāsike ca' iti cchakārasya śakāraḥ | ṭhsarve vidhayaścchandasi
vikalpyante' iti taitirīyake nāyaṃ pratiṣedho
bhavati---ayo'śñāti | tatrāpi kāṭhake bhavatyeva---brahmacāriṇe
praśnān procya prajighāya | svādhyāyabrāhmaṇe ca bhavatīti sakalaṃ
bhadramaśnute ||
yaro'nunāsike'nunāsiko vā || 8|4|45 ||
ṭhpadāntāt' ityanuvṛtaṃ ṣaṣṭha|lntaṃ vipariṇamyate | vāṅmayamiti |
ṭhnityaṃ vṛddhaśarādibhyaḥ' iti mayaṭ ||
aco rahābhyāṃ dve || 8|4|46 ||
arcayaterghañ, kutvam, arkkaḥ | marciḥ sautro dhātuḥ, tasmāt
ṭhiṇbhīkāpāśalyatimarcibhyaḥ kan', ṭhcoḥ kuḥ' iti
kutvam---markkaḥ | atrākārādanantaro rephaḥ, tasmādapi kakāraḥ |
evamutareṣvapi draṣṭavyam ||
anaci ca || 8|4|47 ||
anacparasyeti | aco'nyo'nac, sa paro yasmātso'nacparaḥ | anena
paryudāso daśitaḥ, kiṃ prayojanam ? na kiñcit, pratyuta doṣa eva,
avasāne na sidhyati---vākka, acsadṛśasya varṇāntarasyābhāvāt,
pratipatigauravaprasaṅgātparyudāsa āśritaḥ | pakṣāntare hi
viśeṣapratiṣedhāt sāmānyena vidhiranumeyaḥ syāditi gauravam |
ulkkā, valmmīka iti | lakāro yaṇ, kakāramakārau yamau |
stthālīti sakāraḥ śara, thakāraḥ khay | vatssādiṣu
takārakakārapakārāḥ khayaḥ, sakāraṣakārau śarau |
avasāne iti | paryudāsāśrayaṇādidamārabdham | prasajyapratiṣedhe tu
parasya nimitasyānāśrayaṇād ṭhvā' ityadhikārātsiddham ||
nādinyākrośe putrasya || 8|4|48 ||
putrādinīti | tācchīlye ṇiniḥ |
tatpare ceti | sa ādinīśabdo yasmātparastatrāpi parataḥ
putraśabdasya dvirvacanaṃ na bhavati---putrāśca pautrāśca putrapautrāḥ,
tānatuṃ śīlamasyāḥ putrapautrādinī | anye tu ṭhtatpare putraśabde'
iti vyācakṣāṇāḥ putraputrādinītyudāharanti, tatra putrasya
putramatīti vigrahaḥ |
vā hatajagdhapara iti | hatajagdhaṃ ca tatparaṃ ceti viśeṣaṇasamāsaḥ,
rājadantāditvāt paraśabdasya paranipātaḥ | putrahatīti | putro
hato'nayeti bahuvrīhiḥ, ṭhasvāṅgapūrvapadādvā' iti ṅīṣ |
khayo dvitīyā iti | ṭhkhayaḥ' iti ṣaṣṭhī | dvitīyā iti | vargeṣu
khakārādayaḥ ||
śaro'ci || 8|4|49 ||
ādarśa iti | dṛśeradhikaraṇe ghañ | darśa iti | atrāpyadhikaraṇe ghañ
| viparītalakṣaṇā ceyam---na dṛśyate'smiṃścandramā iti darśa iti || 
triprabhṛtiṣu śākaṭāyanasya || 8|4|50 ||
indra ityādau nakāradakārayordvirvacanābhāvaḥ | bhrāṣṭramiti |
ṭhdīrghādācāryāṇām' ityasyāsiddhatvāt | triprabhṛtiṣvayameva
pratiṣedho bhavatīti manyate ||
sarvatra śākalyasya || 8|4|51 ||
atriprabhṛtyartho'yamārambhaḥ ||
dīrghādācāryāṇām || 8|4|52 ||
dātramityādau ṭhanaci ca' iti prāptiḥ ||
jhalāṃ jaś jhaśi || 8|4|53 ||
udāharaṇeṣu bha-gha-dhānāṃ ba-ga-dāḥ ||
abhyāse carca || 8|4|54 ||
cikhaniṣatīti | khaneḥ san, dvirvacanam, ṭhkuhoścaḥ' iti
cutvam---cchakāraḥ, tasya cartvam---cakāraḥ | ṭiṭhakārayiṣatīti |
ṭhakāramācaṣṭa iti ṇic, ṭilopaḥ, san, ṭhakārasya ṭakāraḥ |
tiṣṭhāsatīti | ṭhśūrpūrvāḥ khayaḥ' iti thakārasya śeṣaḥ, tasya cartvaṃ
takāraḥ |
prakṛtiścāṃ prakṛticara iti | jaśtvabādhanārthaṃ
parjanyavallakṣaṇapravṛtyā prakṛtirūpāścaraḥ sthāninā'bhinnarūpā
bhavantītyarthaḥ | etaccāntaratamaparibhāṣayā labhyate |
prakṛtijaśāṃ prakṛtijaśa iti | vyākhyātam | ḍiḍa|l iti | ḍīṅe liṭi
dvirvacane ṭheranekācaḥ' iti yaṇ ||
khari ca || 8|4|55 ||
yuyutsata iti | yudheḥ san, dhakārasya takāraḥ | āripsate, ālipsata
iti | rabhilabhyoḥ ṭhsani mīmāghu' ityādinā aca is, ṭhskoḥ
saṃyogādyoḥ' iti salopaḥ, bhakārasya pakāraḥ ||
vāvasāne || 8|4|56 ||
ṭhjhalāṃ jaśo'nte' iti nitye jaśtve prāpte cartvaṃ vidhīyate,
vāvacanāt pakṣe so'pi bhavati ||
aṇo'pragṛhyasyānunāsikaḥ || 8|4|57 ||
ṭhaṇaḥ' iti pūrveṇa ṇakāreṇa pratyāharaḥ | agnī, vāyū iti |
ṭhīdūdet' iti pragṛhyasaṃjñā ||
anusvārasya yayi parasavarṇaḥ || 8|4|58 ||
śaṅkitetyādi | ṭhśaki saṅkāyām', ṭhucchi uñche', ṭhkuḍi dāhe',
ṭhṭuanadi samṛddhau', ṭhkapi calane', idatvānnum, ṭhnaścāpadāntasya jhali'
ityanusvāraḥ, tasya kakārādiṣu parato yathāsaṃkhyaṃ parasavarṇā
vargapañcamāṅkārādayaḥ |
kurvanti, kṛṣantītyatra jherantādeśe nakārasya ṇatvaṃ prāpnoti,
tatkasmānna bhavati ? ityāha---iheti | ṇatvamanusvārātpūrvaṃ na bhavati,
yasmāṇṇatvasyāsiddhatvāt pūrvamanusvāra eva kriyate, paścādapi na
bhavati, anusvārasthānikasyāsya parasavarṇasya ṇatve kartavye
asiddhatvāt | parasavarṇeneti | parasavarṇārthena śāstreṇetyarthaḥ |
evamityādi | anusvārībhūto ṇatvamatikrāmatīti bhāṣye yaduktaṃ
tadevamuktaprakāreṇetyarthaḥ ||
vā padāntasya || 8|4|59 ||
taṅkthamityādi | kakārādiṣu parato ṅkārādayaḥ krameṇa bhavanti ||
torli || 8|4|60 ||
atra takārasya śuddho lakāraḥ, nakārasyānunāsikaḥ ||
udaḥ sthāstambhoḥ pūrvasya || 8|4|61 ||
parasavarṇa iti samastamapi savarṇagrahaṇamiha niṣkṛṣya sambaddhyate |
utthāteti | sakārasya pūrvasavarṇastakāraḥ | anye tu
bāhyaprayatnasāmyāt thakāramicchanti | tatra takhārādvayasya śravaṇam | na
ca pūrvasya cartvam; tatra kartavye'sya pūrvasavarṇasyāsidvatvāt |
roge ceti vaktavyamiti | idamaviśeṣeṇa cchandasi, bhāṣāyāṃ ca ||
jhayo ho'nyatarasyām || 8|4|62 ||
udāharaṇeṣu hakārasya mahāprāṇasya soṣmaṇo ghoṣavatastādṛśa evaṃ
ghakārādayaścaturthā bhavanti ||
śaśchāe'ṭi || 8|4|63 ||
śaśchāe'mītīti | aṭītyapanīyāmīti vaktavyamityarthaḥ |
tacchlokena, tacchmaśruṇeti atra lakāramakāraparasyāpi
śakārasya bhavati ||
halo yamāṃ yāma lopaḥ || 8|4|64 ||
dvau yakārāviti | ekaḥ ṭhsaṃjñāyāṃ samaja' ityādinā vihitasya kyapaḥ
sambandhī, dvitīyaḥ ṭhayaṅyi kṅiti' ityayaṅadeśasya | kramajastṛtīya
iti | kramaḥuānupūrvī, tato jātaḥ kramajaḥ, sa ca punaḥ ṭhanaci ca' iti
dvirvacanena sampāditaḥ | takārātpara eko yakāra iti |
ṭhdityadityāditya' ityādinā vihitasya ṇyasya sambandhī | dvau
yakārāviti | eko'ditiśabdātparasya ṇyasya sambandhī, dvitīya
ādityaśabdāt |
annamiti | bhavatyaṃ nakāro yam, yamparaśca, na tu halaḥ paraḥ |
ardhyamiti | ṭhpādārghābhyāṃ ca' iti tādarthye yat, bhavatyayaṃ
ghakārorephāddhalaḥ paroyamparaśca, na tu yam | śārṅgamiti |
śrṛṅgasya vikāra ityaṇ, ṛkārasya raparā vṛddhiḥ, atra ṅkāro yam
bhavati halakhca paraḥ, na tu yamparaḥ | nanu ca bahiraṅgā vṛddhiḥ,
tataḥ kim ? halaḥ paro na bhavati ? lopo'pi bahiraṅgaḥ;
anekanimitāpekṣatvāt |
jharo jhari savarṇe || 8|4|65 ||
trayastakārā iti | ṭhaca upasargātaḥ' ityākārasya takāraḥ, takārasyāpi
cartvaṃ takāraḥ; ekaḥ pratyayasambandhī, ṭhanaci ca' iti dvirvacane
kramajaścaturthaḥ | catvārastakārā iti | pūrvoktāstrayaḥ, caturtho
rucchabdasambandhī, pañcamo dvirvacanena sampāditaḥ |
marucchabdasyopasaṃkhyānasāmarthyāditi | etacca
ṭhmarucchabdasyopasaṃkhyānam' ityatraiva pratipāditam |
śārṅginniti | bhavatyayaṃ ṅkāro halaḥ paraḥ jhari savarṇe parataḥ, na
tvayaṃ jhariti na lupyate | priyayañcñeti | priyāḥ pañcāsyeti
bahuvrīhiḥ, ṭhvā priyasya' iti
priyaśabdapūrvanipātastṛtīyaikavacanam, allopaḥ, nakārasya
ścutvam---ñakāraḥ | bhavatyayaṃ cakāro halaḥ paraḥ svayaṃ ca jhar
savarṇe ca parataḥ, na tu ñakāro jhariti na lupyate | nanu
cāllopasya sthānivatvādanantaro na bhavati savarṇaḥ,
tatkimetannivṛtyarthena ṭhjhari' ityanena ? ityata āha---allopasyeti |
tarpteti | ṭhtṛpa prīṇane', pakārasya takāraḥ sthānebhedātsavarṇo na
bhavati | nanu ca nimitānāṃ kāyiṇāṃ ca saṃkhyāsāmānyādiha
saṃkhyātānudeśe sati naiva taptetyatra lopaḥ prāpnoti,
tatkimetannivṛtyarthena savarṇagrahaṇena ? ata
āha---savarṇagrahaṇasāmarthyāditi | na hi yathāsaṃkhye'savarṇe jharasti,
yadvyāvṛtyarthaṃ savarṇagrahaṇaṃ syāt | śiṇḍhi, piṇḍhaiiti | ṭhśiṣlṛ
viśeṣaṇe', ṭhpiṣlṛ sañcūrṇane'---rudhādī, loṭ, serhiḥ,
ṭhśnasorallopaḥ', herdhiḥ, ṭhjhalāṃ jaś jhaśi' iti ṣakārasya ḍakāraḥ,
ṭhnaścāpadāntasya jhali' ityanusvāraḥ, tasya parasavarṇo ṇakāraḥ,
dhakārasya ṣṭuatvam---ḍhakāraḥ, anena ḍakārasya ḍhakāre lopaḥ ||
udātādanudātasya svaritaḥ || 8|4|66 ||
gārgyaḥ, vātsya iti | ṭhgargādibhyo yañ', ñitvādādyaudātatvam,
śeṣanighātaḥ, tasya svaritaḥ | pacati, paṭhatīti | śaptipāvanudātau,
dhātusvaraḥ, śabakārasya svaritatvam |
ṭhtitsvaritam' ityasyānantaramidaṃ vaktavyam, evaṃ hi svaritagrahaṇaṃ na
kartavyaṃ bhavati ? ata āha---asyeti | yadi tatra kriyeta, ṭhanudātaṃ
padamekavarjam' ityetatpravarteta | iha tu karaṇe na pravartateḥ
svaritasyāsiddhatvāt | tena dvayorapyudātasvaritayoḥ śravaṇaṃ bhavati
||
nodātasvaritodayamagārgyakāśyapagālavānām || 8|4|67 ||
udātasvaritāvudayau yasmāditi bahuvrīhiḥ | udayaśabdaḥ
pratyekamabhisambadhyate, yadāha---udātodayasyeti | udayaśabdaḥ
paraśabdena samānārthaḥ prātiśākhyeṣu prasiddhaḥ | tatraśabdo
litsvareṇādyaudātaḥ, kvaśabdaḥ ṭhkimo't' ityatpratyayāntastitsvaritaḥ |
udātasvaritaparasyeti vaktavya iti | etadapyupalakṣaṇam,
udātasvaritayorityeva vaktavyamiti, ita eva paraśabdārthalābhāt |
maṅgalārthamiti | udayaśabdoccāraṇameva maṅgalam | ṇaṅgalādīni
hi śāstrāṇi prathante, maṅgalamadhyāni maṅgalāntāmi ca
vīrapuruṣāṇi ca bhavanti āyuṣmatpuruṣāṇi ca | iha cādau
vṛddhiśabdaḥ, madhye śivaśabdaḥ---ṭhśivaśamariṣṭasya kare' iti, ante
cāyamudayaśabdaḥ ||
a a || 8|4|68 ||
eko'tra vivṛtaḥ, paraḥ saṃvṛtaḥ, dvāvapyavibhaktikau, yo vivṛtassa
sthānī, yaḥ saṃvṛtaḥ sa ādeśaḥ |
kimarthamakārasyākāro vidhīyate ? ityāha---iheti | kāryārthamiti |
tatpunaḥ kāryamakārasya dīrghaplutābhyāṃ savarṇasaṃjñā, anyathā
prayatnabhedānna syāt, tataśca hrasvo'kāro gṛhyamāṇo dīrghaplutau na
gṛhṇīyāt | tatra cadoṣaḥ---ṭhakaḥ savarṇe dīrghaḥ', ihaiva
syād---aindrāgnamiti, iha na syāt---daṇḍāḍhakamiti |
tasmādevamādikāryārthamakāra iha śāstre vivṛtaḥ pratijñāyate, tatra
yadīyaṃ pratyāpatirna kriyeta, tadā tasya tathābhūtasyaiva prayogaḥ
syāt, sa mā bhūditi pratyāpatiriha kriyate |
iha sthānyakāro vivṛto'ṇtvāt savarṇānāṃ grāhaka iti
dīrghaplutayorapi sthāne saṃvṛto'kāraḥ prāpnoti, ādeśastvakāraḥ
saṃvṛto'ṇ na bhavatīti savarṇānāṃ grāhako na prāpnoti,
bhāvyamānatvāt; tataśca yadguṇaḥ saṃvṛta uccāritaḥ, tadguṇa
evāṣṭādaśabhedabhinnasyāpi avarṇasya prāpnoti ?
ityāśaṅkyāha---dīrghaplutayośceti | iṣṭireveyam |
yadvā---taparanirdeśātsiddham, ṭhada' iti sūtraṃ kartavyam, tatra taḥ
paro yasmāditi pūrvo'kārastaparaḥ, tātparastapara iti dvitīyaḥ,
tataśca sthānyakāro dīrghaplutau na grahīṣyati, ādeśastvanaṇapi
guṇāntarayuktāÄstatkālān grahīṣyati | ekaśeṣanirdeśo vāyaṃ
draṣṭavyaḥ | atra ṣaḍ mātrikā akārāḥ sthānino nirdiśyante, ādeśā
api ṣaḍeva, tata ubhayatraikaśeṣaḥ, tatra ṣaṇṇāṃ sthānināṃ
nirdeśasāmarthyāt sthānibhirdīrghaplutau bhinnakālau na gṛhyaete | tataḥ
ṣaṇṇāṃ sthānināṃ sthāne ṣaḍādeśāḥ saṃvṛtā yathāsaṃkhyaṃ bhavantīti
sarveṣṭasiddhiriti śam ||
iti śrībhaṭṭaharadatamiśraviracitāyāṃ padamañjaryāmaṣṭamasyādhyāyasya
caturthaḥ pādaḥ
